theorem bochner_riesz (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ C_δ : ℝ,
      0 ≤ C_δ ∧
      ∀ f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℂ,
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (bochnerRiesz δ f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal C_δ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume

theorem bochner_riesz (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ C_δ : ℝ,
      0 ≤ C_δ ∧
      ∀ f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℂ,
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (bochnerRiesz δ f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal C_δ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨B_δ, hB_nonneg, hK_cont, hK_bound, hBR⟩ := bochner_riesz_conv_representation δ hδ
  obtain ⟨K₀, a_pos, a_neg, M, Φ, hK₀_cont, hK₀_supp, ha_smooth, ha_supp, ha_deriv, hΦ⟩ :=
    bochner_riesz_kernel_dyadic_decomp δ hδ
  have hν_pos : 0 < δ / 2 := half_pos hδ
  obtain ⟨C_ν, hC_ν_nonneg, hC_ν⟩ := distance_phase_osc_l3_bound M (δ / 2) hν_pos
  let r : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 2)
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) (-δ / 2)
  have hr_lt_one : r < 1 := by
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 2) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℝ) :=
          Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      _ = 1 := Real.rpow_zero 2
  have h1mr_pos : 0 < 1 - r := sub_pos.mpr hr_lt_one
  let I₀ : ℝ := ∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖K₀ z‖
  have hI₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ I₀ := MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun z => norm_nonneg (K₀ z))
  let C_δ : ℝ := I₀ + 2 * C_ν / (1 - r)
  have hC_δ_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_δ :=
    add_nonneg hI₀_nonneg (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_ν_nonneg) h1mr_pos.le)
  refine ⟨C_δ, hC_δ_nonneg, fun f => ?_⟩
  let T : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := fun N x =>
    ∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      (bochnerRieszKernel δ (x - y) * (Φ N (x - y) : ℂ)) * f y
  
  have hT_tendsto : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun N => T N x) Filter.atTop (nhds (bochnerRiesz δ f x)) := by
    intro x
    rw [(hBR f).2 x]
    unfold spatialConv
    refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun y => B_δ * ‖f y‖) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro N
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
          (bochnerRieszKernel δ (x - y) * (Φ N (x - y) : ℂ)) * f y) :=
        ((hK_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ((hΦ N).1.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)))).mul
          f.continuous
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact f.integrable.norm.const_mul B_δ
    · intro N
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      have hΦ_01 := (hΦ N).2.1 (x - y)
      have hΦ_norm : ‖(Φ N (x - y) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hΦ_01.1]
        exact hΦ_01.2
      calc ‖(bochnerRieszKernel δ (x - y) * (Φ N (x - y) : ℂ)) * f y‖
          = ‖bochnerRieszKernel δ (x - y)‖ * ‖(Φ N (x - y) : ℂ)‖ * ‖f y‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ ≤ (B_δ * 1) * ‖f y‖ := by
            refine mul_le_mul ?_ (le_refl _) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hB_nonneg zero_le_one)
            exact mul_le_mul (hK_bound (x - y)) hΦ_norm (norm_nonneg _) hB_nonneg
        _ = B_δ * ‖f y‖ := by ring
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt ‖x - y‖
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, Filter.eventually_atTop]
      refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN => ?_⟩
      have h_le : ‖x - y‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ N := by
        have h_nat : N₀ ≤ 2 ^ N :=
          le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hN)
        have h_real : (N₀ : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ N := by exact_mod_cast h_nat
        exact le_trans hN₀.le h_real
      have hΦ_eq : Φ N (x - y) = 1 := (hΦ N).2.2.1 (x - y) h_le
      simp [hΦ_eq]
  
  obtain ⟨hConv0_cont, hConv0_int, hConv0_l3⟩ :=
    young_spatialConv_l3 K₀ hK₀_cont hK₀_supp f
  let K_pos : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ :=
    fun j => shellOscKernel δ 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) (a_pos j)
  let K_neg : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ :=
    fun j => shellOscKernel δ (-1) ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) (a_neg j)
  have hShell_pos : ∀ j : ℕ,
      Continuous (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f)) ∧
      (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => K_pos j (x - y) * f y) MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C_ν * r ^ j) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro j
    have hlam_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) := by
      have h_nat : 2 ^ 1 ≤ 2 ^ (j + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      exact_mod_cast h_nat
    have hlam_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) := by linarith
    have ha_c : Continuous (a_pos j) := ((ha_smooth j).1 0).continuous
    have ha_s : ∀ w, (‖w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ 2 ≤ ‖w‖) → a_pos j w = 0 :=
      fun w hw => (ha_supp j w hw).1
    obtain ⟨hc, hint, hgc, hgint, hgl3, himp⟩ :=
      dyadic_shell_rescaling_l3 δ 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) C_ν (δ / 2)
        hlam_pos hC_ν_nonneg (a_pos j) ha_c ha_s f
    have hosc := hC_ν 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) (Or.inl rfl) hlam_ge (a_pos j)
      (ha_smooth j).1 ha_s (fun k w => (ha_deriv j k w).1)
      (fun y => f (((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) • y)) hgc hgint hgl3
    have hbound := himp hosc
    refine ⟨hc, hint, le_trans hbound ?_⟩
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_) zero_le
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hC_ν_nonneg
    have hexp : (((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) ^ (-δ + δ / 2) : ℝ) = r ^ (j + 1) := by
      have hd : -δ + δ / 2 = -δ / 2 := by ring
      rw [hd, ← Real.rpow_natCast (2 : ℝ) (j + 1),
        ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (-δ / 2),
        mul_comm ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (-δ / 2),
        Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) (-δ / 2) ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ),
        Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [hexp, pow_succ]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le j) hr_lt_one.le
  have hShell_neg : ∀ j : ℕ,
      Continuous (spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f)) ∧
      (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => K_neg j (x - y) * f y) MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C_ν * r ^ j) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro j
    have hlam_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) := by
      have h_nat : 2 ^ 1 ≤ 2 ^ (j + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      exact_mod_cast h_nat
    have hlam_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) := by linarith
    have ha_c : Continuous (a_neg j) := ((ha_smooth j).2 0).continuous
    have ha_s : ∀ w, (‖w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ 2 ≤ ‖w‖) → a_neg j w = 0 :=
      fun w hw => (ha_supp j w hw).2
    obtain ⟨hc, hint, hgc, hgint, hgl3, himp⟩ :=
      dyadic_shell_rescaling_l3 δ (-1) ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) C_ν (δ / 2)
        hlam_pos hC_ν_nonneg (a_neg j) ha_c ha_s f
    have hosc := hC_ν (-1) ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) (Or.inr rfl) hlam_ge (a_neg j)
      (ha_smooth j).2 ha_s (fun k w => (ha_deriv j k w).2)
      (fun y => f (((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) • y)) hgc hgint hgl3
    have hbound := himp hosc
    refine ⟨hc, hint, le_trans hbound ?_⟩
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_) zero_le
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hC_ν_nonneg
    have hexp : (((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) ^ (-δ + δ / 2) : ℝ) = r ^ (j + 1) := by
      have hd : -δ + δ / 2 = -δ / 2 := by ring
      rw [hd, ← Real.rpow_natCast (2 : ℝ) (j + 1),
        ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (-δ / 2),
        mul_comm ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (-δ / 2),
        Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) (-δ / 2) ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ),
        Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [hexp, pow_succ]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le j) hr_lt_one.le
  
  have hT_eq : ∀ N : ℕ,
      T N = spatialConv K₀ (⇑f) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f)) := by
    intro N
    ext x
    simp only [T, Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
    have h_integrand : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
        (bochnerRieszKernel δ (x - y) * (Φ N (x - y) : ℂ)) * f y) =
      (fun y => K₀ (x - y) * f y + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        (K_pos j (x - y) * f y + K_neg j (x - y) * f y)) := by
      ext y
      rw [(hΦ N).2.2.2 (x - y), add_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
      simp only [add_mul, K_pos, K_neg]
    rw [h_integrand]
    have h_each_int : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range N, MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun y => K_pos j (x - y) * f y + K_neg j (x - y) * f y) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      fun j _ => ((hShell_pos j).2.1 x).add ((hShell_neg j).2.1 x)
    have h_sum_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun y => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (K_pos j (x - y) * f y + K_neg j (x - y) * f y))
        MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range N) h_each_int
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (hConv0_int x) h_sum_int,
      MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range N) h_each_int]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_add ((hShell_pos j).2.1 x) ((hShell_neg j).2.1 x)
  have h_sum_cont : ∀ N : ℕ, Continuous (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
      (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f))) := by
    intro N
    have h_fn : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f))) =
      (fun x => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) x + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f) x)) := by
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.add_apply]
    rw [h_fn]
    exact continuous_finsetSum (Finset.range N)
      (fun j _ => (hShell_pos j).1.add (hShell_neg j).1)
  have hT_meas : ∀ N : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (T N) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro N
    rw [hT_eq N]
    exact (hConv0_cont.add (h_sum_cont N)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hT_l3 : ∀ N : ℕ,
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (T N) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal C_δ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro N
    rw [hT_eq N]
    have hp1 : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 3 := by norm_num
    have h1 : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv K₀ (⇑f) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
          (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f))) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv K₀ (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume +
          MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
            (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f))) 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_add_le hp1
    have h2 : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
          (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f))) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm
          (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_sum_le hp1
    have h3 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f))
          3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C_ν * r ^ j) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
      have h_add : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm
            (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
          MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume +
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_add_le hp1
      have h_term_nn : 0 ≤ C_ν * r ^ j := mul_nonneg hC_ν_nonneg (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le j)
      calc MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f))
            3 MeasureTheory.volume
          ≤ MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume +
              MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume := h_add
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C_ν * r ^ j) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume +
              ENNReal.ofReal (C_ν * r ^ j) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
            add_le_add (hShell_pos j).2.2 (hShell_neg j).2.2
        _ = (ENNReal.ofReal (C_ν * r ^ j) + ENNReal.ofReal (C_ν * r ^ j)) *
              MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := (add_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C_ν * r ^ j) *
              MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
            rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add h_term_nn h_term_nn]
            congr 2
            ring
    have h_geom : I₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (2 * C_ν * r ^ j) ≤ C_δ := by
      have h_sum_r : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, r ^ j ≤ 1 / (1 - r) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ h1mr_pos]
        have h_id := geom_sum_mul_neg r N
        have hrN : 0 ≤ r ^ N := pow_nonneg hr_pos.le N
        linarith
      have h_factor : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (2 * C_ν * r ^ j) =
          (2 * C_ν) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, r ^ j := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      rw [h_factor]
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_r (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hC_ν_nonneg)
      calc I₀ + (2 * C_ν) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, r ^ j
          ≤ I₀ + (2 * C_ν) * (1 / (1 - r)) := add_le_add le_rfl h_mul
        _ = C_δ := by simp only [C_δ, mul_one_div]
    calc MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv K₀ (⇑f) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
          (spatialConv (K_pos j) (⇑f) + spatialConv (K_neg j) (⇑f))) 3 MeasureTheory.volume
        ≤ MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv K₀ (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume +
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
              ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C_ν * r ^ j) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
          le_trans h1 (add_le_add le_rfl (le_trans h2 h3))
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal I₀ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume +
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C_ν * r ^ j)) *
              MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          exact add_le_add hConv0_l3 le_rfl
      _ = (ENNReal.ofReal I₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C_ν * r ^ j)) *
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := (add_mul _ _ _).symm
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (I₀ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (2 * C_ν * r ^ j)) *
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
          have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (2 * C_ν * r ^ j) :=
            Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ =>
              mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_ν_nonneg) (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le j))
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun j _ =>
            mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_ν_nonneg) (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le j)),
            ← ENNReal.ofReal_add hI₀_nonneg h_sum_nn]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C_δ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_geom) zero_le
  
  have h_lim := MeasureTheory.Lp.eLpNorm_lim_le_liminf_eLpNorm
    (p := 3) hT_meas (bochnerRiesz δ f) (hBR f).1.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hT_tendsto)
  refine le_trans h_lim ?_
  exact Filter.liminf_le_of_frequently_le'
    ((Filter.Eventually.of_forall hT_l3).frequently)

bochner_riesz.definitions:
noncomputable def bochnerRieszKernel (δ : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
    (bochnerRieszSymbol δ ξ : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (inner ℝ z ξ : ℝ))


noncomputable def spatialConv (K g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), K (x - y) * g y


noncomputable def shellOscKernel (δ σ lam : ℝ)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ((lam ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * ‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
    a (lam⁻¹ • z)


noncomputable def distPhaseOscOp (σ lam : ℝ)
    (a g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
    Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      a (z - y) * g y

subgoal_signatures.name: bochner_riesz_conv_representation
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ B_δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_δ ∧
      Continuous (bochnerRieszKernel δ) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖bochnerRieszKernel δ z‖ ≤ B_δ) ∧
      ∀ f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℂ,
        Continuous (bochnerRiesz δ f) ∧

  obtain ⟨χ₀, ψ, a_pos, M, Φ, hχ₀_cont, hχ₀_supp, ha_pos_smooth, ha_pos_supp,

  let K₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := fun z => bochnerRieszKernel δ z * (χ₀ z : ℂ)

    rw [show a_neg j = ⇑Complex.conjLIE ∘ a_pos j from rfl,
      Complex.conjLIE.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]
    exact ha_pos_deriv j k w
  · intro N
    obtain ⟨hΦ_cont, hΦ_01, hΦ_one, hΦ_tel⟩ := hΦ_props N
    refine ⟨hΦ_cont, hΦ_01, hΦ_one, fun z => ?_⟩
    have h_shell : ∀ j : ℕ,
        shellOscKernel δ 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) (a_pos j) z +
          shellOscKernel δ (-1) ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) (a_neg j) z =
        bochnerRieszKernel δ z * (ψ (((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ • z) : ℂ) := by
      intro j
      set lam : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)
      have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by positivity
      have hlam_cancel : ((lam ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((lam ^ (2 + δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1 := by
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Real.rpow_add hlam_pos]
        have hz_exp : (-2 - δ) + (2 + δ) = 0 := by ring
        rw [hz_exp, Real.rpow_zero, Complex.ofReal_one]
      have h_pos_shell : shellOscKernel δ 1 lam (a_pos j) z =
          Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (‖z‖ : ℂ)) * b_pos ‖z‖ *
            (ψ (lam⁻¹ • z) : ℂ) := by
        unfold shellOscKernel
        rw [ha_pos_eval j z]
        simp only [lam, one_mul]
        calc ((((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (‖z‖ : ℂ)) *
              (((((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) ^ (2 + δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * b_pos ‖z‖ *
                (ψ (((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ • z) : ℂ))
            = (((lam ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((lam ^ (2 + δ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
              Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (‖z‖ : ℂ)) * b_pos ‖z‖ *
              (ψ (lam⁻¹ • z) : ℂ) := by simp only [lam]; ring
          _ = Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (‖z‖ : ℂ)) * b_pos ‖z‖ *
              (ψ (lam⁻¹ • z) : ℂ) := by rw [hlam_cancel, one_mul]
      have h_neg_eval : a_neg j (lam⁻¹ • z) =
          ((lam ^ (2 + δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.conjLIE (b_pos ‖z‖) *
            (ψ (lam⁻¹ • z) : ℂ) := by

          Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_ofReal, ← Complex.conjLIE_apply]
      have h_neg_shell : shellOscKernel δ (-1) lam (a_neg j) z =
          Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((-‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            Complex.conjLIE (b_pos ‖z‖) * (ψ (lam⁻¹ • z) : ℂ) := by

        rw [h_neg_eval]
        have hm1 : (-1 : ℝ) * ‖z‖ = -‖z‖ := by ring
        rw [hm1]
        calc ((lam ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * ((-‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *

              Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * ((-‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *

informal_problem.statement:
(K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ)
    (hK_cont : Continuous K)
    (hK_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → K z = 0)
    (f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℂ) :
    Continuous (spatialConv K (⇑f)) ∧
    (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => K (x - y) * f y) MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
    MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv K (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖K z‖) *
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume

proof.tactics:
by
  have hK_cpt : HasCompactSupport K := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) 2) ?_
    intro z hz

    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    by_contra h_not_le

    hK_cont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hK_cpt
  have hf_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (⇑f) MeasureTheory.volume := f.integrable
  have h_fib_int : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => K (x - y) * f y) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro x
    exact hf_int.bdd_mul
      (hK_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => hC_K (x - y)))
  have h_conv_cont : Continuous (spatialConv K (⇑f)) := by
    unfold spatialConv
    refine MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun y => C_K * ‖f y‖) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro x
      exact ((hK_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul
        f.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable
    · intro x
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul]

    · exact hf_int.norm.const_mul C_K
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      exact (hK_cont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).mul continuous_const
  let I_K : ENNReal := ∫⁻ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖K z‖ₑ ∂MeasureTheory.volume
  have hIK_eq : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖K z‖) = I_K :=
    MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm hK_int
  have hIK_ne_top : I_K ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [← hIK_eq]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hIK_sq_ne_top : I_K ^ (2 : ℝ) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg (by norm_num) hIK_ne_top
  have hpq : (3 / 2 : ℝ).HolderConjugate 3 := by
    rw [Real.holderConjugate_iff]

  have h_ptwise_cube : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      ‖spatialConv K (⇑f) x‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ≤
        I_K ^ (2 : ℝ) *
          ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),

    let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ENNReal :=
      fun y => ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * ‖f y‖ₑ

    have h_split : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖K (x - y) * f y‖ₑ = (u * v) y := by

      have h_add := ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg (x := ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ)

      have h23_13 : (2 / 3 : ℝ) + (1 / 3 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num

    have h_u_int :
        (∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), u y ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) = I_K := by
      have h_u_pow : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => u y ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) =

        ext y

          ≤ ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖K (x - y) * f y‖ₑ ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
            MeasureTheory.enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _
        _ = ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), (u * v) y ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
            simp_rw [h_split]
        _ ≤ (∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), u y ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ^
              (1 / (3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
            (∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), v y ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ^
              (1 / (3 : ℝ)) :=
            ENNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq MeasureTheory.volume hpq
              hu_meas.aemeasurable hv_meas.aemeasurable
        _ = I_K ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) *
              (∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
                ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
            have h_inv : (1 : ℝ) / (3 / 2 : ℝ) = 2 / 3 := by norm_num
            rw [h_u_int, h_v_int, h_inv]
    calc ‖spatialConv K (⇑f) x‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ)
        ≤ (I_K ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) *
            (∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
              ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) ^ (3 : ℝ) :=
          ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow h_pt (by norm_num)
      _ = I_K ^ (2 : ℝ) *
            ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
              ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
          rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3),
            ← ENNReal.rpow_mul, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
          have h23_3 : (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (3 : ℝ) = 2 := by norm_num
          have h13_3 : (1 / 3 : ℝ) * (3 : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num
          rw [h23_3, h13_3, ENNReal.rpow_one]
  have h_prod_meas : Measurable
      (Function.uncurry (fun x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
        ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ))) := by
    change Measurable (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
      ‖K (p.1 - p.2)‖ₑ * ‖f p.2‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ))
    exact ((hK_cont.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)).measurable.enorm).mul
      (((f.continuous.comp continuous_snd).measurable.enorm).pow_const (3 : ℝ))
  have h_int_cube :
      (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖spatialConv K (⇑f) x‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ≤
        I_K ^ (3 : ℝ) *
          ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have h_inner_eq : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
          ∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
            ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) =
        (fun y => I_K * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ)) := by
      ext y
      have hfy_ne_top : ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ≠ ⊤ :=
        ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg (by norm_num) enorm_ne_top
      rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_mul_const' (‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ)) _ hfy_ne_top,
        MeasureTheory.lintegral_sub_right_eq_self (fun z => ‖K z‖ₑ) y]
    calc (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖spatialConv K (⇑f) x‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume)
        ≤ ∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
            I_K ^ (2 : ℝ) *
              (∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
                ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono h_ptwise_cube
      _ = I_K ^ (2 : ℝ) *
            ∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
              ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
                ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          MeasureTheory.lintegral_const_mul' (I_K ^ (2 : ℝ)) _ hIK_sq_ne_top
      _ = I_K ^ (2 : ℝ) *
            ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
              ∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
                ‖K (x - y)‖ₑ * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_lintegral_swap h_prod_meas.aemeasurable]
      _ = I_K ^ (2 : ℝ) *
            ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
              I_K * ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
          rw [h_inner_eq]
      _ = I_K ^ (2 : ℝ) *
            (I_K * ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const_mul' I_K _ hIK_ne_top]
      _ = I_K ^ (3 : ℝ) *
            ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖f y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
          rw [← mul_assoc]
          congr 1
          have h_comb := ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg (x := I_K)
            (2 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
          have h21 : (2 : ℝ) + (1 : ℝ) = 3 := by norm_num
          rw [h21, ENNReal.rpow_one] at h_comb
          exact h_comb.symm
  have h_l3_bound :
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (spatialConv K (⇑f)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖K z‖) *
          MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have h3_ne_zero : (3 : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    have h3_ne_top : (3 : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤ := by norm_num
    have h3_toReal : (3 : ENNReal).toReal = (3 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal h3_ne_zero h3_ne_top
          h_conv_cont.aestronglyMeasurable,
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal h3_ne_zero h3_ne_top
          f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable,
        h3_toReal, hIK_eq]
    calc (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
            ‖spatialConv K (⇑f) x‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ))
        ≤ (I_K ^ (3 : ℝ) *
            ∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
              ‖f x‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) :=
          ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow h_int_cube (by norm_num)
      _ = I_K *
            (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
              ‖f x‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) := by
          rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3),
            ← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
          have h3_inv : (3 : ℝ) * (1 / (3 : ℝ)) = 1 := by norm_num
          rw [h3_inv, ENNReal.rpow_one]
  exact ⟨h_conv_cont, h_fib_int, h_l3_bound⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  let K_shell : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := shellOscKernel δ σ lam a
  let g_lam : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := fun y => f (lam • y)
  have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlam
  obtain ⟨M_a, hM_a⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) 2).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ha_cont.continuousOn
  let B_a : ℝ := max M_a 0
  have hB_a_nn : 0 ≤ B_a := le_max_right M_a 0
  have ha_bound : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖a w‖ ≤ B_a := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 2
    · exact le_trans (hM_a w (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr hw)) (le_max_left M_a 0)
    · have hw2 : 2 ≤ ‖w‖ := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hw)
      rw [ha_supp w (Or.inr hw2), norm_zero]
      exact hB_a_nn
  have hK_cont : Continuous K_shell := by
    unfold K_shell shellOscKernel
    have h_phase : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
        Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * ‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ))) :=
      Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)))
    exact (continuous_const.mul h_phase).mul (ha_cont.comp (continuous_id.const_smul lam⁻¹))
  let M_K : ℝ := lam ^ (-2 - δ) * B_a
  have hK_bound : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖K_shell z‖ ≤ M_K := by
    intro z
    unfold K_shell shellOscKernel
    have h_rpow_nn : 0 ≤ lam ^ (-2 - δ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hlam.le (-2 - δ)
    have h_c1 : ‖((lam ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = lam ^ (-2 - δ) := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h_rpow_nn]
    have h_exp : ‖Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * ‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ = 1 := by
      have h_eq : (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * ‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          ((2 * Real.pi * (σ * ‖z‖) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (2 * Real.pi * (σ * ‖z‖))
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, h_c1, h_exp, mul_one]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha_bound (lam⁻¹ • z)) h_rpow_nn
  have h_bound_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => M_K * ‖f y‖)
      MeasureTheory.volume :=
    f.integrable.norm.const_mul M_K
  have h_integrand_cont : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => K_shell (x - y) * f y) :=
    fun x => (hK_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul f.continuous
  have h_integrand_le : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      ‖K_shell (x - y) * f y‖ ≤ M_K * ‖f y‖ := by
    intro x y
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hK_bound (x - y)) (norm_nonneg (f y))
  have h_conv_int : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun y => shellOscKernel δ σ lam a (x - y) * f y)
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro x
    exact h_bound_int.mono' (h_integrand_cont x).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (h_integrand_le x))
  have h_conv_cont : Continuous (spatialConv (shellOscKernel δ σ lam a) (⇑f)) := by
    unfold spatialConv
    refine MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated
      (fun x => (h_integrand_cont x).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (fun x => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (h_integrand_le x))
      h_bound_int
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
    exact (hK_cont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).mul continuous_const
  have h_g_cont : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => f (lam • y)) :=
    f.continuous.comp (continuous_id.const_smul lam)
  have h_g_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => f (lam • y)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    f.integrable.comp_smul hlam_ne
  have h_dil : ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ),
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (fun y => h (r • y)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume =
        ENNReal.ofReal r⁻¹ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm h 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro r hr h
    have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
    have h_emb : MeasurableEmbedding (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => r • y) :=
      measurableEmbedding_const_smul₀ hr_ne
    have h_map_eq : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (fun y => h (r • y)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume =
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm h 3
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun y => r • y) MeasureTheory.volume) :=
      (h_emb.eLpNorm_map_measure (g := h) (p := 3) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)).symm
    rw [h_map_eq, MeasureTheory.Measure.map_addHaar_smul MeasureTheory.volume hr_ne,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    have hr3_inv_pos : 0 < (r ^ 3)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hr 3)
    rw [abs_of_pos hr3_inv_pos]
    have hc_ne : ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 3)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hr3_inv_pos)
    rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_smul_measure_of_ne_zero hc_ne h 3 MeasureTheory.volume, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    have h_exp_toReal : ((1 : ENNReal) / 3).toReal = (1 : ℝ) / 3 := by
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_div, ENNReal.toReal_one]
      norm_num
    rw [h_exp_toReal, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_pos hr3_inv_pos]
    congr 1
    rw [← inv_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast r⁻¹ 3, ← Real.rpow_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le),
      show ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = 1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_one]
  have h_g_l3 : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm
      (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => f (lam • y))
      3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤ := by
    rw [h_dil lam hlam (⇑f)]
    exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top (f.eLpNorm_lt_top 3 MeasureTheory.volume)
  have h_pt : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      spatialConv K_shell (⇑f) (lam • z) =
        (lam ^ (1 - δ) : ℝ) • distPhaseOscOp σ lam a g_lam z := by
    intro z
    let F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ :=
      fun y => K_shell (lam • z - lam • y) * f (lam • y)
    have h_sub : spatialConv K_shell (⇑f) (lam • z) =
        ∫ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), F (lam⁻¹ • u) := by
      unfold spatialConv
      congr 1 with u
      simp only [F, smul_inv_smul₀ hlam_ne]
    rw [h_sub,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_inv_smul_of_nonneg MeasureTheory.volume F hlam.le,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    have hF_eq : F = fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
        ((lam ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            a (z - y) * g_lam y) := by
      ext y
      simp only [F, K_shell, shellOscKernel, g_lam]
      rw [← smul_sub lam z y, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hlam.le,
        inv_smul_smul₀ hlam_ne (z - y)]
      have h_mul : σ * (lam * ‖z - y‖) = σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ := by ring
      rw [h_mul]
      ring
    have h_int_F : (∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), F y) =
        ((lam ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * distPhaseOscOp σ lam a g_lam z := by
      rw [hF_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      rfl
    rw [h_int_F, Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
    congr 2
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast lam 3, ← Real.rpow_add hlam]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  refine ⟨h_conv_cont, h_conv_int, h_g_cont, h_g_int, h_g_l3, fun h_osc => ?_⟩
  let S : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := spatialConv K_shell (⇑f)
  let A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := distPhaseOscOp σ lam a g_lam
  have hS_dil : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm S 3 MeasureTheory.volume =
      ENNReal.ofReal lam *
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (fun z => S (lam • z)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have h1 := h_dil lam⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hlam) (fun z => S (lam • z))
    have h_fn : (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => S (lam • (lam⁻¹ • x))) = S := by
      ext x
      rw [smul_inv_smul₀ hlam_ne]
    rw [h_fn, inv_inv] at h1
    exact h1
  have hS_smul : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (fun z => S (lam • z)) 3 MeasureTheory.volume =
      ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ (1 - δ)) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm A 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have h_eq : (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => S (lam • z)) =
        (lam ^ (1 - δ) : ℝ) • A := by
      ext z
      exact h_pt z
    rw [h_eq, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_const_smul,
      Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam.le (1 - δ))]
  have hg_dil : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g_lam 3 MeasureTheory.volume =
      ENNReal.ofReal lam⁻¹ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (⇑f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
    h_dil lam hlam (⇑f)
  calc MeasureTheory.eLpNorm S 3 MeasureTheory.volume
      = ENNReal.ofReal lam *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ (1 - δ)) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm A 3 MeasureTheory.volume) := by
        rw [hS_dil, hS_smul]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal lam *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ (1 - δ)) *
            (ENNReal.ofReal (C * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) *
              MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g_lam 3 MeasureTheory.volume)) := by
        gcongr
    _ = (ENNReal.ofReal lam * ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ (1 - δ)) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (C * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) * ENNReal.ofReal lam⁻¹) *
          MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (⇑f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
        rw [hg_dil]
        ring
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (C * lam ^ (-δ + ν)) *
          MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (⇑f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
        congr 1
        have h1_nn : 0 ≤ lam := hlam.le
        have h2_nn : 0 ≤ lam ^ (1 - δ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hlam.le (1 - δ)
        have h3_nn : 0 ≤ C * lam ^ (-1 + ν) :=
          mul_nonneg hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam.le (-1 + ν))
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul h1_nn,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg h1_nn h2_nn),
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h1_nn h2_nn) h3_nn)]
        congr 1
        have h_alg : lam * lam ^ (1 - δ) * (C * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) * lam⁻¹ =
            C * (lam ^ (1 : ℝ) * lam ^ (1 - δ) * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * lam ^ (-1 : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_neg_one]
          ring
        rw [h_alg, ← Real.rpow_add hlam, ← Real.rpow_add hlam, ← Real.rpow_add hlam]
        congr 2
        ring

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨M_cone, h_cone⟩ := annulus_six_cone_decomp M
  obtain ⟨a₀, a₁, A, Φ_s, ζ_s, ha₀, ha₁, hA, h_phase⟩ := pseudoconformal_gevrey_phase
  obtain ⟨M_B, h_slice⟩ := pseudoconformal_slice_reduction M_cone
  obtain ⟨C_osc, hC_osc_nn, h_osc⟩ :=
    osc_integral_2d_l3_bound a₀ a₁ A 2 5 ha₀ ha₁ hA (by norm_num) (by norm_num) M_B ν hν
  refine ⟨2520 * C_osc, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_osc_nn, ?_⟩
  intro σ lam hσ hlam a ha_smooth ha_supp ha_deriv g hg_cont hg_int hg_l3
  have hlam_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ lam := by linarith
  let C_2d : ℝ := C_osc * lam ^ (-1 + ν)
  have hC_2d_nn : 0 ≤ C_2d := mul_nonneg hC_osc_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn (-1 + ν))
  obtain ⟨h_is_phase, hΦ_eq⟩ := h_phase σ hσ
  have hΦ_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (Φ_s σ) := h_is_phase.1
  have h_dir_bound : ∀ (a_dir : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ),
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k a_dir) →
      (∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), (‖w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ∨ w 2 ≤ 1 / 6) → a_dir w = 0) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k a_dir w‖ ≤ M_cone k) →
      ∀ (g' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ),
        Continuous g' →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable g' MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g' 3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤ →
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (distPhaseOscOp σ lam a_dir g') 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (7 * (60 * C_2d)) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g' 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro a_dir ha_dir_smooth ha_dir_supp ha_dir_deriv g' hg'_cont hg'_int hg'_l3
    obtain ⟨B_a, hB_smooth, hB_supp, hB_deriv, hB_imp⟩ :=
      h_slice σ lam C_2d hC_2d_nn (Φ_s σ) hΦ_smooth hΦ_eq a_dir
        ha_dir_smooth ha_dir_supp ha_dir_deriv
    have h_loc_bound := hB_imp (fun f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l3 =>
      h_osc lam hlam (Φ_s σ) (ζ_s σ) h_is_phase B_a hB_smooth hB_supp hB_deriv
        f hf_meas (fun v hv => hf_supp v (by linarith)) hf_l3)
    exact unit_cube_localization_l3 σ lam (60 * C_2d) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_2d_nn)
      a_dir (ha_dir_smooth 0).continuous (fun w hw => ha_dir_supp w (Or.inr (Or.inl hw)))
      h_loc_bound g' hg'_cont hg'_int hg'_l3
  have h_global := h_cone σ lam (7 * (60 * C_2d))
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_2d_nn))
    h_dir_bound a ha_smooth ha_supp ha_deriv g hg_cont hg_int hg_l3
  have h_const_eq : 6 * (7 * (60 * C_2d)) = (2520 * C_osc) * lam ^ (-1 + ν) := by
    dsimp [C_2d]
    ring
  rwa [h_const_eq] at h_global

distance_phase_osc_l3_bound.definitions:
noncomputable def oscIntegralOp2D (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (B : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (cx : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ (cx.1, cx.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      B (cx.1, cx.2, v) * f v

def IsEllipticGevreyPhase (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
    (Φ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k Φ) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ζ) ∧
  (∀ (c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ (x v u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      fderiv ℝ (fun v' => Φ (c, x, v')) v u = inner ℝ (ζ (v, x - c • v)) u) ∧
  (∀ (v p u w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) w =
      inner ℝ u (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p w)) ∧
  ((∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
      inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) u ≤ a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2) ∨
   (∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ -inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
      -inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) u ≤ a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2)) ∧
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
      (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (q.1, p')) q.2) vp‖ ≤
      A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3))

          c ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 32) (23 / 32) →
          ‖x‖ ≤ 2 →

              Real.sqrt (1 + ‖(8 : ℝ) • x - (1 / 4 + 8 * c) • v‖ ^ 2)

      Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := (k : ℕ∞))
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun t : ℝ => 12 * (t - 1 / 6)) :=
      contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
    exact h1.comp h2
  have hθ_zero : ∀ {t : ℝ}, t ≤ 1 / 6 → θ t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hθ_one : ∀ {t : ℝ}, 1 / 4 ≤ t → θ t = 1 := by
    intro t ht
    exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
  let idxNat : ℕ → Fin 3 := fun m => ⟨(m / 2) % 3, by omega⟩
  let sgnNat : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => if m % 2 = 1 then -1 else 1
  let κ_raw : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ :=
    fun m w => θ (sgnNat m * w (idxNat m))
  let κ_nat : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ :=
    fun m w => κ_raw m w * ∏ s ∈ Finset.range m, (1 - κ_raw s w)
  let κ : Fin 6 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ := fun r => κ_nat r.val
  have hraw_smooth : ∀ (m k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (κ_raw m) := by
    intro m k
    have hproj : ContDiff ℝ k (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => w (idxNat m)) :=
      contDiff_piLp_apply 2 (E := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) (n := k) (i := idxNat m)
    exact (hθ_smooth k).comp (contDiff_const.mul hproj)
  have hκ_smooth : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (κ r) := by
    intro r k
    refine (hraw_smooth r.val k).mul ?_
    exact contDiff_prod (fun s _ =>
      show ContDiff ℝ k (fun w => 1 - κ_raw s w) from contDiff_const.sub (hraw_smooth s k))
  have h_tele : ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, κ_nat m w =
        1 - ∏ m ∈ Finset.range n, (1 - κ_raw m w) := by
    intro n w
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, Finset.prod_range_succ]
      dsimp only [κ_nat]
      ring
  have hκ_sum_one : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖w‖ → ∑ r : Fin 6, κ r w = 1 := by
    intro w hw
    have h_eq : ∑ r : Fin 6, κ r w = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range 6, κ_nat m w :=
      Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun m => κ_nat m w) 6
    rw [h_eq, h_tele 6 w]
    have h_norm_sq : 1 / 4 ≤ (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 + (w 2) ^ 2 := by
      have hsq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hsq
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at hsq
      change (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 + (w 2) ^ 2 at hsq
      linarith
    have h_exists : ∃ m ∈ Finset.range 6, 1 / 4 ≤ sgnNat m * w (idxNat m) := by
      by_contra h_not
      have h_lt : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range 6, sgnNat m * w (idxNat m) < 1 / 4 :=
        fun m hm => lt_of_not_ge (fun hge => h_not ⟨m, hm, hge⟩)
      have h0 : sgnNat 0 * w (idxNat 0) < 1 / 4 := h_lt 0 (by decide)
      have h1 : sgnNat 1 * w (idxNat 1) < 1 / 4 := h_lt 1 (by decide)
      have h2 : sgnNat 2 * w (idxNat 2) < 1 / 4 := h_lt 2 (by decide)
      have h3 : sgnNat 3 * w (idxNat 3) < 1 / 4 := h_lt 3 (by decide)
      have h4 : sgnNat 4 * w (idxNat 4) < 1 / 4 := h_lt 4 (by decide)
      have h5 : sgnNat 5 * w (idxNat 5) < 1 / 4 := h_lt 5 (by decide)
      have hi0 : idxNat 0 = 0 := by decide
      have hi1 : idxNat 1 = 0 := by decide
      have hi2 : idxNat 2 = 1 := by decide
      have hi3 : idxNat 3 = 1 := by decide
      have hi4 : idxNat 4 = 2 := by decide
      have hi5 : idxNat 5 = 2 := by decide
      have hs0 : sgnNat 0 = 1 := by norm_num [sgnNat]
      have hs1 : sgnNat 1 = -1 := by norm_num [sgnNat]
      have hs2 : sgnNat 2 = 1 := by norm_num [sgnNat]
      have hs3 : sgnNat 3 = -1 := by norm_num [sgnNat]
      have hs4 : sgnNat 4 = 1 := by norm_num [sgnNat]
      have hs5 : sgnNat 5 = -1 := by norm_num [sgnNat]
      rw [hi0, hs0] at h0
      rw [hi1, hs1] at h1
      rw [hi2, hs2] at h2
      rw [hi3, hs3] at h3
      rw [hi4, hs4] at h4
      rw [hi5, hs5] at h5
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀_mem, hm₀_ge⟩ := h_exists
    have h_raw_one : κ_raw m₀ w = 1 := hθ_one hm₀_ge
    have h_prod_zero : ∏ m ∈ Finset.range 6, (1 - κ_raw m w) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero hm₀_mem (by linarith)
    linarith
  let S_iso : Fin 3 → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :=
    fun i => LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ (Equiv.swap i 2)
  have hS_iso_apply : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), (S_iso i w) i = w 2 := by
    intro i w
    have h1 := congr_fun (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_apply
      (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := ℝ) (Equiv.swap i (2 : Fin 3)) w) i
    rw [Equiv.piCongrLeft'_apply, Equiv.symm_swap, Equiv.swap_apply_left] at h1
    exact h1
  let U : Fin 6 → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :=
    fun r => if r.val % 2 = 1 then
      (S_iso (idxNat r.val)).trans (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ)
    else
      S_iso (idxNat r.val)
  have hU_align : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      sgnNat r.val * (U r w) (idxNat r.val) = w 2 := by
    intro r w
    dsimp only [U, sgnNat]
    split_ifs with hodd
    · rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply]
      change (-1 : ℝ) * -((S_iso (idxNat r.val) w) (idxNat r.val)) = w 2
      rw [hS_iso_apply]
      ring
    · simp only [hS_iso_apply, one_mul]
  have hκ_dir_zero : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      w 2 ≤ 1 / 6 → κ r (U r w) = 0 := by
    intro r w hw2
    dsimp only [κ, κ_nat, κ_raw]
    rw [hU_align r w, hθ_zero hw2, zero_mul]
  have hκ_bound_exists : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (j : ℕ),
      ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) 3,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (κ r) u‖ ≤ B := by
    intro r j
    have hcont : Continuous (fun u => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (κ r) u) :=
      ContDiff.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (le_refl _) (hκ_smooth r j)
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) 3).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hcont.continuousOn
  let K : Fin 6 → ℕ → ℝ := fun r j => max (Classical.choose (hκ_bound_exists r j)) 0
  have hK_nonneg : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (j : ℕ), 0 ≤ K r j := fun r j => le_max_right _ _
  have hK_le : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (j : ℕ) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      ‖u‖ ≤ 3 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (κ r) u‖ ≤ K r j := by
    intro r j u hu
    have hu_mem : u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) 3 :=
      mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr hu
    exact le_trans (Classical.choose_spec (hκ_bound_exists r j) u hu_mem) (le_max_left _ _)
  let K_sum : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ∑ r : Fin 6, K r j
  have hK_sum_nonneg : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ K_sum j :=
    fun j => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun r _ => hK_nonneg r j)
  have hK_le_sum : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (j : ℕ) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      ‖u‖ ≤ 3 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (κ r) u‖ ≤ K_sum j := by
    intro r j u hu
    refine le_trans (hK_le r j u hu) ?_
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun r' _ => hK_nonneg r' j) (Finset.mem_univ r)
  let M_pos : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => max (M m) 0
  have hM_pos_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ M_pos m := fun m => le_max_right _ _
  let M_cone : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose j : ℝ) * K_sum j * M_pos (k - j)
  have hM_cone_nonneg : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ M_cone k := by
    intro k
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => ?_)
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hK_sum_nonneg j)) (hM_pos_nonneg (k - j))
  refine ⟨M_cone, ?_⟩
  intro σ lam C hC h_dir a ha_smooth ha_supp ha_deriv g hg_cont hg_int hg_l3
  let a_tilde : Fin 6 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := fun r u => κ r u • a u
  let a_dir : Fin 6 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := fun r => a_tilde r ∘ ⇑(U r)
  have ha_tilde_smooth : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (a_tilde r) :=
    fun r k => (hκ_smooth r k).smul (ha_smooth k)
  have ha_dir_smooth : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (a_dir r) :=
    fun r k => (ha_tilde_smooth r k).comp (U r).contDiff
  have ha_dir_supp : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      (‖w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ∨ w 2 ≤ 1 / 6) → a_dir r w = 0 := by
    intro r w hw
    dsimp only [a_dir, Function.comp_apply, a_tilde]
    rcases hw with hw_in | hw_out | hw_dir
    · have h_norm : ‖U r w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [(U r).norm_map]; exact hw_in
      rw [ha_supp (U r w) (Or.inl h_norm), smul_zero]
    · have h_norm : 2 ≤ ‖U r w‖ := by rw [(U r).norm_map]; exact hw_out
      rw [ha_supp (U r w) (Or.inr h_norm), smul_zero]
    · rw [hκ_dir_zero r w hw_dir, zero_smul]
  have ha_dir_deriv : ∀ (r : Fin 6) (k : ℕ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (a_dir r) w‖ ≤ M_cone k := by
    intro r k w
    dsimp only [a_dir]
    rw [(U r).norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_right (a_tilde r) w k]
    set u := U r w
    by_cases hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 3
    · have h_leib := norm_iteratedFDeriv_smul_le (hκ_smooth r k) (ha_smooth k) u
        (n := k) (le_refl _)
      refine le_trans h_leib ?_
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
      have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (κ r) u‖ ≤ K_sum j := hK_le_sum r j u hu
      have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - j) a u‖ ≤ M_pos (k - j) :=
        le_trans (ha_deriv (k - j) u) (le_max_left _ _)
      have h_prod : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (κ r) u‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - j) a u‖ ≤
          K_sum j * M_pos (k - j) :=
        mul_le_mul h1 h2 (norm_nonneg _) (hK_sum_nonneg j)
      calc (k.choose j : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (κ r) u‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - j) a u‖
          = (k.choose j : ℝ) * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (κ r) u‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - j) a u‖) :=
            mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ ≤ (k.choose j : ℝ) * (K_sum j * M_pos (k - j)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        _ = (k.choose j : ℝ) * K_sum j * M_pos (k - j) := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    · have hu_gt : 2 < ‖u‖ := by linarith
      have hV_open : IsOpen {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | 2 < ‖v‖} :=
        isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
      have h_ev : a_tilde r =ᶠ[nhds u] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
        refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hu_gt) (fun v hv => ?_)
        have hv_gt : 2 < ‖v‖ := hv
        dsimp only [a_tilde]
        rw [ha_supp v (Or.inr hv_gt.le), smul_zero]
      have h_iter_eq : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (a_tilde r) u = 0 := by
        rw [(h_ev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [h_iter_eq, norm_zero]
      exact hM_cone_nonneg k
  have h_cone_bound : ∀ r : Fin 6,
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_tilde r) g) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal C * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro r
    let g'_r : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := g ∘ ⇑(U r)
    have hg'_cont : Continuous g'_r := hg_cont.comp (U r).continuous
    have hg'_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g'_r MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (U r).measurePreserving.integrable_comp_of_integrable hg_int
    have hU_emb : MeasurableEmbedding ⇑(U r) := (U r).toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding
    have hg'_norm : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g'_r 3 MeasureTheory.volume =
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have h_emb := hU_emb.eLpNorm_map_measure (p := 3) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (g := g)
      rw [(U r).measurePreserving.map_eq] at h_emb
      exact h_emb.symm
    have hg'_l3 : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g'_r 3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤ := by
      rw [hg'_norm]; exact hg_l3
    have h_dir_r := h_dir (a_dir r) (ha_dir_smooth r) (ha_dir_supp r) (ha_dir_deriv r)
      g'_r hg'_cont hg'_int hg'_l3
    rw [hg'_norm] at h_dir_r
    have h_op_eq : distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_tilde r) g =
        (distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_dir r) g'_r) ∘ ⇑((U r).symm) := by
      ext z
      dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, distPhaseOscOp]
      let F_z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := fun u =>
        Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - u‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          a_tilde r (z - u) * g u
      have h_cov := (U r).measurePreserving.integral_comp hU_emb F_z
      change ∫ u, F_z u = _
      rw [← h_cov]
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
      dsimp only [F_z, a_dir, g'_r, Function.comp_apply]
      have h_diff : z - U r y = U r ((U r).symm z - y) := by
        rw [map_sub, (U r).apply_symm_apply]
      have h_norm : ‖z - U r y‖ = ‖(U r).symm z - y‖ := by
        rw [h_diff, (U r).norm_map]
      rw [h_norm, h_diff]
    have h_out_norm : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_tilde r) g)
        3 MeasureTheory.volume =
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_dir r) g'_r)
        3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [h_op_eq]
      have hUsymm_emb : MeasurableEmbedding ⇑((U r).symm) :=
        (U r).symm.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding
      have h_emb := hUsymm_emb.eLpNorm_map_measure
        (p := 3) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (g := distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_dir r) g'_r)
      rw [(U r).symm.measurePreserving.map_eq] at h_emb
      exact h_emb.symm
    rw [h_out_norm]
    exact h_dir_r
  have ha_sum : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), a w = ∑ r : Fin 6, a_tilde r w := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1 / 2
    · have ha0 : a w = 0 := ha_supp w (Or.inl hw)
      simp [a_tilde, ha0]
    · have hw_ge : 1 / 2 ≤ ‖w‖ := le_of_not_ge hw
      dsimp only [a_tilde]
      rw [← Finset.sum_smul, hκ_sum_one w hw_ge, one_smul]
  have h_op_sum : distPhaseOscOp σ lam a g =
      ∑ r ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)), distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_tilde r) g := by
    ext z
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, distPhaseOscOp]
    have h_integrand : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
        Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          a (z - y) * g y) =
      (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
        ∑ r ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)),
          Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            a_tilde r (z - y) * g y) := by
      ext y
      rw [ha_sum (z - y), Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [h_integrand]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun r _ => ?_)
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
        Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          a_tilde r (z - y) * g y) := by
      have h_sub : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => z - y) :=
        continuous_const.sub continuous_id
      have h_phase : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
          Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ))) :=
        Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
            (continuous_const.mul (continuous_norm.comp h_sub))))
      have h_amp : Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => a_tilde r (z - y)) :=
        (ha_tilde_smooth r 0).continuous.comp h_sub
      exact (h_phase.mul h_amp).mul hg_cont
    have h_supp : HasCompactSupport (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
        Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          a_tilde r (z - y) * g y) := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall z 2) ?_
      intro y hy
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hy
      by_contra hy_ball
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at hy_ball
      have h_norm_ge : 2 ≤ ‖z - y‖ := le_of_not_ge hy_ball
      have ha0 : a (z - y) = 0 := ha_supp (z - y) (Or.inr h_norm_ge)
      apply hy
      simp [a_tilde, ha0]
    exact h_cont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport h_supp
  rw [h_op_sum]
  have hp1 : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 3 := by norm_num
  calc MeasureTheory.eLpNorm
        (∑ r ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)), distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_tilde r) g)
        3 MeasureTheory.volume
      ≤ ∑ r ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)),
          MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (distPhaseOscOp σ lam (a_tilde r) g) 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_sum_le hp1
    _ ≤ ∑ _r ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)),
          ENNReal.ofReal C * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => h_cone_bound r)
    _ = 6 * (ENNReal.ofReal C * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g 3 MeasureTheory.volume) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        norm_num
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (6 * C) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 6), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]

(σ lam C_loc : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C_loc)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ)

    (ha_supp : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 2 ≤ ‖w‖ → a w = 0)

      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (distPhaseOscOp σ lam a h) 3

          { z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ z i ∧ z i < 1 }) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal C_loc * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm h 3 MeasureTheory.volume)

    (hg_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hg_l3 : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g 3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤) :
    MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (distPhaseOscOp σ lam a g) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (7 * C_loc) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g 3 MeasureTheory.volume

by
  have _ := hg_l3
  let K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := fun w =>
    Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖w‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) * a w
  have hK_cont : Continuous K :=
    (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)))).mul ha_cont
  have hK_cpt : HasCompactSupport K := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) 2) ?_
    intro w hw
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hw
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    by_contra h_not_le
    have hw2 : 2 ≤ ‖w‖ := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h_not_le)
    exact hw (by simp [K, ha_supp w hw2])
  obtain ⟨C_K, hC_K⟩ := hK_cpt.exists_bound_of_continuous hK_cont
  let F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ := distPhaseOscOp σ lam a g
  have hF_eq : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      F z = ∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), K (z - y) * g y :=
    fun _ => rfl
  have hF_cont : Continuous F := by
    change Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) =>
      ∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), K (z - y) * g y)
    refine MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun y => C_K * ‖g y‖) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro z
      exact ((hK_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul hg_cont).aestronglyMeasurable
    · intro z
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC_K (z - y)) (norm_nonneg (g y))
    · exact hg_int.norm.const_mul C_K
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      exact (hK_cont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).mul continuous_const
  have hF_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable F MeasureTheory.volume :=
    hF_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
  let k_vec : (Fin 3 → ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    fun k => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 3 => (k i : ℝ))
  let Q₀ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :=
    { z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ z i ∧ z i < 1 }
  let Q : (Fin 3 → ℤ) → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :=
    fun k => { z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | ∀ i : Fin 3, (k i : ℝ) ≤ z i ∧ z i < (k i : ℝ) + 1 }
  have hQ_zero : Q 0 = Q₀ := by
    ext z
    simp [Q, Q₀]
  have hQ_meas : ∀ k : Fin 3 → ℤ, MeasurableSet (Q k) := by
    intro k
    have h_eq : Q k = ⋂ i : Fin 3,
        (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => z i) ⁻¹' Set.Ico (k i : ℝ) ((k i : ℝ) + 1) := by
      ext z
      simp [Q, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_Ico]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter (fun i =>
      (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) i).measurable measurableSet_Ico)
  have hQ₀_meas : MeasurableSet Q₀ := hQ_zero ▸ hQ_meas 0
  have hQ_floor : ∀ (k : Fin 3 → ℤ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      z ∈ Q k ↔ k = (fun i => ⌊z i⌋) := by
    intro k z
    simp only [Q, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, funext_iff]
    refine forall_congr' (fun i => ?_)
    rw [← Int.floor_eq_iff, eq_comm]
  have hQ_univ : (⋃ k : Fin 3 → ℤ, Q k) = Set.univ := by
    rw [Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
    intro z
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨fun i => ⌊z i⌋, (hQ_floor _ z).mpr rfl⟩
  have hQ_disj : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint Q) := by
    intro k₁ k₂ hk
    rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hz₁ hz₂
    exact hk (((hQ_floor k₁ z).mp hz₁).trans ((hQ_floor k₂ z).mp hz₂).symm)
  have h_shift_lintegral : ∀ (k m : Fin 3 → ℤ) (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ENNReal),
      ∫⁻ z in Q (k + m), Φ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume =
        ∫⁻ y in Q m, Φ (k_vec k + y) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro k m Φ
    rw [← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator (hQ_meas (k + m)) Φ,
      ← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator (hQ_meas m) (fun y => Φ (k_vec k + y)),
      ← MeasureTheory.lintegral_add_left_eq_self ((Q (k + m)).indicator Φ) (k_vec k)]
    congr 1
    ext y
    have h_mem : k_vec k + y ∈ Q (k + m) ↔ y ∈ Q m := by
      simp only [Q, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Pi.add_apply, Int.cast_add]
      refine forall_congr' (fun i => ?_)
      have h_coord : (k_vec k + y) i = (k i : ℝ) + y i := rfl
      rw [h_coord]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Q m
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (h_mem.mpr hy), Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (mt h_mem.mp hy), Set.indicator_of_notMem hy]
  have h_shift_Q₀ : ∀ (k : Fin 3 → ℤ) (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ENNReal),
      ∫⁻ z in Q k, Φ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume =
        ∫⁻ z' in Q₀, Φ (k_vec k + z') ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro k Φ
    have h0 := h_shift_lintegral k 0 Φ
    rwa [add_zero, hQ_zero] at h0
  let θ₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => max 0 (min 1 (min (t + 3) (4 - t)))
  have hθ₁_cont : Continuous θ₁ :=
    continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min
      ((continuous_id.add continuous_const).min (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)))
  have hθ₁_nn : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ₁ t := fun t => le_max_left 0 _
  have hθ₁_le1 : ∀ t : ℝ, θ₁ t ≤ 1 := fun t => max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left 1 _)
  have hθ₁_eq1 : ∀ t : ℝ, (-2 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 3) → θ₁ t = 1 := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : 1 ≤ min (t + 3) (4 - t) := le_min (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2])
    simp only [θ₁, min_eq_left h1, max_eq_right zero_le_one]
  have hθ₁_eq0 : ∀ t : ℝ, (t ≤ -3 ∨ 4 ≤ t) → θ₁ t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : min (t + 3) (4 - t) ≤ 0 := by
      rcases ht with h | h
      · exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
      · exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
    exact max_eq_left (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) h1)
  let θ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ := fun y => θ₁ (y 0) * θ₁ (y 1) * θ₁ (y 2)
  have h_coord_cont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y i) :=
    fun i => PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) i
  have hθ_cont : Continuous θ :=
    ((hθ₁_cont.comp (h_coord_cont 0)).mul (hθ₁_cont.comp (h_coord_cont 1))).mul
      (hθ₁_cont.comp (h_coord_cont 2))
  have hθ_nn : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 0 ≤ θ y :=
    fun y => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hθ₁_nn (y 0)) (hθ₁_nn (y 1))) (hθ₁_nn (y 2))
  have hθ_le1 : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), θ y ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    have h01 : θ₁ (y 0) * θ₁ (y 1) ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [hθ₁_le1 (y 0), hθ₁_nn (y 1), hθ₁_le1 (y 1)]
    nlinarith [h01, hθ₁_nn (y 2), hθ₁_le1 (y 2)]
  have hθ_eq1 : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      (∀ i : Fin 3, -2 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 3) → θ y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [θ, hθ₁_eq1 (y 0) (hy 0), hθ₁_eq1 (y 1) (hy 1), hθ₁_eq1 (y 2) (hy 2), mul_one]
  have hθ_eq0 : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      (∃ i : Fin 3, y i ≤ -3 ∨ 4 ≤ y i) → θ y = 0 := by
    intro y ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hi3 : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 := by omega
    rcases hi3 with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [θ, hθ₁_eq0 _ hi]
  let h_fn : (Fin 3 → ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ :=
    fun k y => (θ y : ℂ) * g (k_vec k + y)
  have hh_cont : ∀ k : Fin 3 → ℤ, Continuous (h_fn k) := by
    intro k
    exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hθ_cont).mul
      (hg_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
  have hh_supp : ∀ (k : Fin 3 → ℤ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
      (∃ i : Fin 3, y i ≤ -3 ∨ 4 ≤ y i) → h_fn k y = 0 := by
    intro k y hy
    simp [h_fn, hθ_eq0 y hy]
  have hh_op_eq : ∀ (k : Fin 3 → ℤ), ∀ z' ∈ Q₀,
      distPhaseOscOp σ lam a (h_fn k) z' = F (k_vec k + z') := by
    intro k z' hz'
    have h_int_shift : F (k_vec k + z') =
        ∫ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), K (z' - y') * g (k_vec k + y') := by
      rw [hF_eq (k_vec k + z'),
        ← MeasureTheory.integral_add_left_eq_self
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => K ((k_vec k + z') - y) * g y) (k_vec k)]
      congr 1
      ext y'
      rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
    rw [h_int_shift]
    change (∫ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), K (z' - y') * h_fn k y') =
      ∫ y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), K (z' - y') * g (k_vec k + y')
    congr 1
    ext y'
    by_cases hy' : ∀ i : Fin 3, -2 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 3
    · simp [h_fn, hθ_eq1 y' hy']
    · rw [not_forall] at hy'
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hy'
      rw [not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hi
      have hz'i : 0 ≤ z' i ∧ z' i < 1 := hz' i
      have h_abs : 2 ≤ |z' i - y' i| := by
        rcases hi with h_lo | h_hi
        · exact le_trans (by linarith : (2 : ℝ) ≤ z' i - y' i) (le_abs_self _)
        · exact le_trans (by linarith : (2 : ℝ) ≤ -(z' i - y' i)) (neg_le_abs _)
      have h_norm : 2 ≤ ‖z' - y'‖ := by
        calc (2 : ℝ) ≤ |z' i - y' i| := h_abs
          _ = ‖(z' - y') i‖ := by rw [PiLp.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          _ ≤ ‖z' - y'‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le (z' - y') i
      simp [K, ha_supp (z' - y') h_norm]
  have hp0 : (3 : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hp_top : (3 : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top
  have hp_toReal : (3 : ENNReal).toReal = 3 := ENNReal.toReal_ofNat 3
  have h_cube_est : ∀ k : Fin 3 → ℤ,
      ∫⁻ z in Q k, ‖F z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) *
          ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖h_fn k y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro k
    have h_ae : distPhaseOscOp σ lam a (h_fn k) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict Q₀]
        (fun z' => F (k_vec k + z')) :=
      MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hQ₀_meas (hh_op_eq k)
    have h_loc_k := h_loc (h_fn k) (hh_cont k) (hh_supp k)
    rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_congr_ae h_ae] at h_loc_k
    have hF_shift_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun z' => F (k_vec k + z')) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict Q₀) :=
      (hF_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hp_top hF_shift_meas,
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hp_top (hh_cont k).aestronglyMeasurable,
      hp_toReal] at h_loc_k
    have h_pow3 := ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow h_loc_k (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)
    rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3),
      ← ENNReal.rpow_mul, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul] at h_pow3
    have h_third : (1 / (3 : ℝ)) * 3 = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h_third, ENNReal.rpow_one, ENNReal.rpow_one] at h_pow3
    rwa [← h_shift_Q₀ k (fun z => ‖F z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ))] at h_pow3
  let R₇ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :=
    { y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | ∀ i : Fin 3, (-3 : ℝ) ≤ y i ∧ y i < 4 }
  let M₇ : Finset (Fin 3 → ℤ) :=
    Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 3 => Finset.Icc (-3 : ℤ) 3)
  have hR₇_eq : R₇ = ⋃ m ∈ M₇, Q m := by
    ext y
    simp only [R₇, M₇, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro hy
      refine ⟨fun i => ⌊y i⌋, ?_, (hQ_floor _ y).mpr rfl⟩
      intro i
      dsimp only
      have h_lo : (-3 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊y i⌋ := Int.le_floor.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (hy i).1)
      have h_hi : ⌊y i⌋ < (4 : ℤ) := Int.floor_lt.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (hy i).2)
      omega
    · rintro ⟨m, hm, hym⟩
      intro i
      have hmi := hm i
      have hyi := hym i
      have hm_lo : (-3 : ℝ) ≤ (m i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmi.1
      have hm_hi : (m i : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmi.2
      constructor <;> linarith [hyi.1, hyi.2]
  have hR₇_meas : MeasurableSet R₇ := by
    rw [hR₇_eq]
    exact MeasurableSet.biUnion M₇.countable_toSet (fun m _ => hQ_meas m)
  have hM₇_disj : (↑M₇ : Set (Fin 3 → ℤ)).PairwiseDisjoint Q :=
    fun _ _ _ _ hne => hQ_disj hne
  have h_hk_bound : ∀ k : Fin 3 → ℤ,
      ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖h_fn k y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ∑ m ∈ M₇, ∫⁻ z in Q (k + m), ‖g z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro k
    have h_pt : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
        ‖h_fn k y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ≤
          R₇.indicator (fun y' => ‖g (k_vec k + y')‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ)) y := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ R₇
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
        refine ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow ?_ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)
        rw [enorm_le_iff_norm_le]
        dsimp [h_fn]
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hθ_nn y)]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (hθ_le1 y)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy]
        simp only [R₇, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_forall] at hy
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hy
        rw [not_and_or, not_le, not_lt] at hi
        have h_out : ∃ j : Fin 3, y j ≤ -3 ∨ 4 ≤ y j := by
          refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
          rcases hi with h_lo | h_hi
          · exact Or.inl (le_of_lt h_lo)
          · exact Or.inr h_hi
        rw [hh_supp k y h_out, enorm_zero, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
    calc ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖h_fn k y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume
        ≤ ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
            R₇.indicator (fun y' => ‖g (k_vec k + y')‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ)) y ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono h_pt
      _ = ∫⁻ y in R₇, ‖g (k_vec k + y)‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator hR₇_meas _
      _ = ∑ m ∈ M₇, ∫⁻ y in Q m, ‖g (k_vec k + y)‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
          rw [hR₇_eq]
          exact MeasureTheory.lintegral_biUnion_finset hM₇_disj (fun m _ => hQ_meas m) _
      _ = ∑ m ∈ M₇, ∫⁻ z in Q (k + m), ‖g z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
          exact (h_shift_lintegral k m (fun z => ‖g z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ))).symm
  have h_decomp : ∀ Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ENNReal,
      ∫⁻ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), Φ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume =
        ∑' k : Fin 3 → ℤ, ∫⁻ z in Q k, Φ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro Φ
    rw [← MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_univ Φ, ← hQ_univ]
    exact MeasureTheory.lintegral_iUnion hQ_meas hQ_disj Φ
  let A : (Fin 3 → ℤ) → ENNReal :=
    fun k => ∫⁻ z in Q k, ‖g z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume
  have hM₇_card : M₇.card = 343 := by
    dsimp [M₇]
    rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.card_Icc]
    decide
  have h_global_cubed :
      ∫⁻ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖F z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        (343 : ENNReal) * (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) *
          ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖g y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    calc ∫⁻ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖F z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume
        = ∑' k : Fin 3 → ℤ, ∫⁻ z in Q k, ‖F z‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          h_decomp _
      _ ≤ ∑' k : Fin 3 → ℤ, (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) * ∑ m ∈ M₇, A (k + m) := by
          refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => ?_)
          exact le_trans (h_cube_est k) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_hk_bound k) zero_le)
      _ = (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) * ∑' k : Fin 3 → ℤ, ∑ m ∈ M₇, A (k + m) :=
          ENNReal.tsum_mul_left
      _ = (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) * ∑ m ∈ M₇, ∑' k : Fin 3 → ℤ, A (k + m) := by
          rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun m _ => ENNReal.summable)]
      _ = (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) *
            ∑ _m ∈ M₇, ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖g y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
          congr 1
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
          let e : (Fin 3 → ℤ) ≃ (Fin 3 → ℤ) :=
            { toFun := fun k => k + m
              invFun := fun k => k - m
              left_inv := fun k => add_sub_cancel_right k m
              right_inv := fun k => sub_add_cancel k m }
          have h_tsum : (∑' k : Fin 3 → ℤ, A (k + m)) = ∑' k : Fin 3 → ℤ, A k := e.tsum_eq A
          rw [h_tsum, ← h_decomp]
      _ = (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) *
            ((343 : ENNReal) *
              ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖g y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hM₇_card, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      _ = (343 : ENNReal) * (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) *
            ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖g y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
          ring
  have h_const_pow :
      (343 : ENNReal) * (ENNReal.ofReal C_loc) ^ (3 : ℝ) =
        (ENNReal.ofReal (7 * C_loc)) ^ (3 : ℝ) := by
    have h3 : (3 : ℝ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [h3, ENNReal.rpow_natCast, ENNReal.rpow_natCast,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow hC 3,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 7) hC) 3]
    have h343 : (343 : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal 343 := by simp
    rw [h343, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 343)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [h_const_pow] at h_global_cubed
  have h_root := ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow h_global_cubed (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3)
  rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3),
    ← ENNReal.rpow_mul,
    (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) * (1 / 3) = 1),
    ENNReal.rpow_one] at h_root
  rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hp_top hF_meas,
    MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hp_top hg_cont.aestronglyMeasurable,
    hp_toReal]
  exact h_root

informal_problem.statement:
∃ (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
      (Φ_s : ℝ → ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ_s : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < a₀ ∧ a₀ ≤ a₁ ∧ 1 ≤ A ∧
      ∀ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
        IsEllipticGevreyPhase a₀ a₁ A (Φ_s σ) (ζ_s σ) ∧
        ∀ (c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          c ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 32) (23 / 32) →
          ‖x‖ ≤ 2 →
          ‖v‖ ≤ 5 →
          Φ_s σ (c, x, v) =
            2 * Real.pi * σ * (1 / 4 + 8 * c)⁻¹ *
              Real.sqrt (1 + ‖(8 : ℝ) • x - (1 / 4 + 8 * c) • v‖ ^ 2)

signature.statement:
∃ (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
      (Φ_s : ℝ → ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ_s : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < a₀ ∧ a₀ ≤ a₁ ∧ 1 ≤ A ∧
      ∀ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
        IsEllipticGevreyPhase a₀ a₁ A (Φ_s σ) (ζ_s σ) ∧
        ∀ (c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          c ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 32) (23 / 32) →
          ‖x‖ ≤ 2 →
          ‖v‖ ≤ 5 →
