proof.tactics:
by
  have h_part_a :
      (∀ (σ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (pcPhase σ)) ∧
      (∀ (σ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (pcGrad σ)) ∧
      (∀ (σ c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        ∀ (x v u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          fderiv ℝ (fun v' => pcPhase σ (c, x, v')) v u =
            inner ℝ (pcGrad σ (v, x - c • v)) u) ∧
      (∀ (σ c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        c ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 32) (23 / 32) →
        ‖x‖ ≤ 2 →
        ‖v‖ ≤ 5 →
        pcPhase σ (c, x, v) =
          2 * Real.pi * σ * (1 / 4 + 8 * c)⁻¹ *
            Real.sqrt (1 + ‖(8 : ℝ) • x - (1 / 4 + 8 * c) • v‖ ^ 2)) := by
    have h_prim_smooth : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k f) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, HasStrictDerivAt (fun x => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, f u) (f t) t) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (fun x => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, f u)) := by
      intro f hf
      have hf_cont : Continuous f := (hf 0).continuous
      have h_sderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasStrictDerivAt (fun x => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, f u) (f t) t :=
        fun t => Continuous.integral_hasStrictDerivAt hf_cont 0 t
      have h_diff : Differentiable ℝ (fun x => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, f u) :=
        fun t => (h_sderiv t).hasDerivAt.differentiableAt
      have h_deriv_eq : deriv (fun x => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, f u) = f :=
        funext (fun t => (h_sderiv t).hasDerivAt.deriv)
      refine ⟨h_sderiv, ?_⟩
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => exact contDiff_zero.mpr h_diff.continuous
      | succ k _ =>
        rw [show (((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞)) = (k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 from rfl,
          contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
        exact ⟨h_diff, by simp, h_deriv_eq.symm ▸ hf k⟩
    have h_bump_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pcGevrey2Bump := by
      intro k
      unfold pcGevrey2Bump
      exact expNegInvGlue.contDiff.mul
        (expNegInvGlue.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id))
    have h_step_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pcGevrey2Step := by
      intro k
      unfold pcGevrey2Step
      exact contDiff_const.mul ((h_prim_smooth pcGevrey2Bump h_bump_smooth).2 k)
    have h_utilde_floor : ∀ u : ℝ,
        1 / 4 ≤ 1 + Real.smoothTransition (2 * u + 3 / 2) * u := by
      intro u
      set θ := Real.smoothTransition (2 * u + 3 / 2)
      have hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hθ1 : θ ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      rcases le_or_gt u (-3 / 4) with hu1 | hu1
      · have h0 : θ = 0 := Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
        rw [h0]; norm_num
      · rcases lt_or_ge u 0 with hu2 | hu2 <;> nlinarith
    have h_utilde_eq : ∀ u : ℝ, -1 / 4 ≤ u →
        Real.smoothTransition (2 * u + 3 / 2) * u = u := by
      intro u hu
      have h1 : Real.smoothTransition (2 * u + 3 / 2) = 1 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
      rw [h1, one_mul]
    have h_profile_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pcDistDerivProfile := by
      intro k
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro u
      unfold pcDistDerivProfile
      have h_step_sub : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun y => pcGevrey2Step (y - 10000)) u :=
        ((h_step_smooth k).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).contDiffAt
      have h_inner : ContDiffAt ℝ k
          (fun y => 1 + Real.smoothTransition (2 * y + 3 / 2) * y) u :=
        (contDiff_const.add
          ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
            ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).add contDiff_const)).mul contDiff_id)).contDiffAt
      have h_pos : 0 < 1 + Real.smoothTransition (2 * u + 3 / 2) * u :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (h_utilde_floor u)
      have h_sqrt : ContDiffAt ℝ k
          (fun y => 2 * Real.sqrt (1 + Real.smoothTransition (2 * y + 3 / 2) * y)) u :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul (h_inner.sqrt h_pos.ne')
      have h_sqrt_ne : 2 * Real.sqrt (1 + Real.smoothTransition (2 * u + 3 / 2) * u) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h_pos).ne'
      exact ((contDiffAt_const.sub h_step_sub).mul (h_sqrt.inv h_sqrt_ne)).add
        (h_step_sub.mul contDiffAt_const)
    have h_depth_floor : ∀ c : ℝ, 1 / 8 ≤ pcSmoothRecipDepth c := by
      intro c
      unfold pcSmoothRecipDepth
      set θ := Real.smoothTransition (64 * c + 1)
      have hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hθ1 : θ ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      rcases le_or_gt c (-1 / 64) with hc1 | hc1
      · have h0 : θ = 0 := Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
        rw [h0]; norm_num
      · rcases lt_or_ge c 0 with hc2 | hc2 <;> nlinarith
    have h_depth_eq : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → pcSmoothRecipDepth c = 1 / 4 + 8 * c := by
      intro c hc
      unfold pcSmoothRecipDepth
      have h1 : Real.smoothTransition (64 * c + 1) = 1 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
      rw [h1]; ring
    have h_depth_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pcSmoothRecipDepth := by
      intro k
      unfold pcSmoothRecipDepth
      exact contDiff_const.add
        ((contDiff_const.mul
          (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
            ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).add contDiff_const))).mul contDiff_id)
    have h_dist2D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pcConvexifiedDist2D := by
      intro k
      have h_prim := (h_prim_smooth pcDistDerivProfile h_profile_smooth).2 k
      have h_fn : pcConvexifiedDist2D =
          fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            1 + (fun x => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, pcDistDerivProfile u) (‖q‖ ^ 2) := rfl
      rw [h_fn]
      exact contDiff_const.add (h_prim.comp (contDiff_id.norm_sq ℝ))
    have h_grad2D_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D := by
      intro k
      have h_fn : pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D =
          fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            (2 * pcDistDerivProfile (‖q‖ ^ 2)) • q := rfl
      rw [h_fn]
      exact (contDiff_const.mul ((h_profile_smooth k).comp (contDiff_id.norm_sq ℝ))).smul contDiff_id
    have h_phase_smooth : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (pcPhase σ) := by
      intro σ k
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro cxv
      have hc_smooth : ContDiff ℝ k
          (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            pcSmoothRecipDepth p.1) :=
        (h_depth_smooth k).comp contDiff_fst
      have hc_ne : pcSmoothRecipDepth cxv.1 ≠ 0 :=
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (h_depth_floor cxv.1)).ne'
      have h_arg : ContDiff ℝ k
          (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            (8 : ℝ) • p.2.1 - pcSmoothRecipDepth p.1 • p.2.2) := by
        simpa using ((contDiff_const (c := (8 : ℝ))).smul (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd)).sub
          (hc_smooth.smul (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd))
      have h_fn : pcPhase σ =
          fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            2 * Real.pi * σ * (pcSmoothRecipDepth p.1)⁻¹ *
              pcConvexifiedDist2D ((8 : ℝ) • p.2.1 - pcSmoothRecipDepth p.1 • p.2.2) := rfl
      rw [h_fn]
      exact (contDiffAt_const.mul (hc_smooth.contDiffAt.inv hc_ne)).mul
        (((h_dist2D_smooth k).comp h_arg).contDiffAt)
    have h_grad_smooth : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (pcGrad σ) := by
      intro σ k
      have h_arg : ContDiff ℝ k
          (fun vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            (8 : ℝ) • vp.2 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • vp.1) := by
        simpa using ((contDiff_const (c := (8 : ℝ))).smul contDiff_snd).sub
          ((contDiff_const (c := (1 / 4 : ℝ))).smul contDiff_fst)
      have h_fn : pcGrad σ =
          fun vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            (-2 * Real.pi * σ) • pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D ((8 : ℝ) • vp.2 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • vp.1) := rfl
      rw [h_fn]
      exact ((h_grad2D_smooth k).comp h_arg).const_smul (-2 * Real.pi * σ)
    have h_dist2D_fderiv : ∀ q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        HasFDerivAt pcConvexifiedDist2D (innerSL ℝ (pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D q)) q := by
      intro q
      have hF : HasDerivAt (fun x => 1 + ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, pcDistDerivProfile u)
          (pcDistDerivProfile (‖q‖ ^ 2)) (‖q‖ ^ 2) := by
        simpa using ((h_prim_smooth pcDistDerivProfile h_profile_smooth).1 (‖q‖ ^ 2)).hasDerivAt.const_add 1
      have h_comp0 := hF.comp_hasFDerivAt q (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq q).hasFDerivAt
      have h_comp : HasFDerivAt pcConvexifiedDist2D _ q := h_comp0
      refine h_comp.congr_fderiv ?_
      ext w
      simp [innerSL_apply_apply, pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D]
      ring
    have h_v_grad : ∀ (σ c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        ∀ (x v u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          fderiv ℝ (fun v' => pcPhase σ (c, x, v')) v u =
            inner ℝ (pcGrad σ (v, x - c • v)) u := by
      intro σ c hc x v u
      set s := pcSmoothRecipDepth c
      have hs_eq : s = 1 / 4 + 8 * c := h_depth_eq c hc.1
      have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := by linarith [hc.1]
      have h_aff : HasFDerivAt (fun v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (8 : ℝ) • x - s • v')
          (-(s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))) v := by
        refine ((hasFDerivAt_const ((8 : ℝ) • x) v).sub ((hasFDerivAt_id v).const_smul s)).congr_fderiv ?_
        simp
      have h_comp := (h_dist2D_fderiv ((8 : ℝ) • x - s • v)).comp v h_aff
      have h_full : HasFDerivAt (fun v' => pcPhase σ (c, x, v'))
          ((2 * Real.pi * σ * s⁻¹) •
            ((innerSL ℝ (pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D ((8 : ℝ) • x - s • v))).comp
              (-(s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))))) v := by
        simpa [pcPhase, s] using h_comp.const_mul (2 * Real.pi * σ * s⁻¹)
      rw [h_full.fderiv]
      simp only [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, innerSL_apply_apply,
        inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right, smul_eq_mul]
      have h_vec : (8 : ℝ) • x - s • v = (8 : ℝ) • (x - c • v) - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • v := by
        rw [hs_eq]
        module
      rw [h_vec]
      simp only [pcGrad, real_inner_smul_left]
      calc 2 * Real.pi * σ * s⁻¹ * -(s * inner ℝ (pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D ((8 : ℝ) • (x - c • v) - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • v)) u)
          = -(2 * Real.pi * σ * (s⁻¹ * s) * inner ℝ (pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D ((8 : ℝ) • (x - c • v) - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • v)) u) := by ring
        _ = -2 * Real.pi * σ * inner ℝ (pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D ((8 : ℝ) • (x - c • v) - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • v)) u := by
            rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hs_ne]; ring
    have h_step_nonpos : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → pcGevrey2Step t = 0 := by
      intro t ht
      unfold pcGevrey2Step
      have h_int : ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..t, pcGevrey2Bump u = 0 := by
        have h_z : ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..t, pcGevrey2Bump u = ∫ _u in (0 : ℝ)..t, (0 : ℝ) := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
          intro u hu
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht] at hu
          unfold pcGevrey2Bump
          rw [expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos hu.2, zero_mul]
        rw [h_z, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
      rw [h_int, mul_zero]
    have h_box_eq : ∀ (σ c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        c ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 32) (23 / 32) →
        ‖x‖ ≤ 2 →
        ‖v‖ ≤ 5 →
        pcPhase σ (c, x, v) =
          2 * Real.pi * σ * (1 / 4 + 8 * c)⁻¹ *
            Real.sqrt (1 + ‖(8 : ℝ) • x - (1 / 4 + 8 * c) • v‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro σ c x v hc hx hv
      have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by linarith [hc.1]
      have hs_eq : pcSmoothRecipDepth c = 1 / 4 + 8 * c := h_depth_eq c hc0
      unfold pcPhase
      dsimp only
      rw [hs_eq]
      congr 1
      set q := (8 : ℝ) • x - (1 / 4 + 8 * c) • v
      have hs_pos : 0 ≤ 1 / 4 + 8 * c := by linarith [hc.1]
      have hs_hi : 1 / 4 + 8 * c ≤ 6 := by linarith [hc.2]
      have hq_norm : ‖q‖ ≤ 100 := by
        calc ‖q‖ ≤ ‖(8 : ℝ) • x‖ + ‖(1 / 4 + 8 * c) • v‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = 8 * ‖x‖ + (1 / 4 + 8 * c) * ‖v‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num),
                Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_pos]
          _ ≤ 8 * 2 + 6 * 5 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
          _ ≤ 100 := by norm_num
      have hq_sq : ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ 10000 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg q]
      unfold pcConvexifiedDist2D
      have h_congr : ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(‖q‖ ^ 2), pcDistDerivProfile u =
          ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(‖q‖ ^ 2), (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + u))⁻¹ := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro u hu
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (sq_nonneg ‖q‖)] at hu
        unfold pcDistDerivProfile
        rw [h_step_nonpos (u - 10000) (by linarith [hu.2]),
          h_utilde_eq u (by linarith [hu.1])]
        ring
      rw [h_congr]
      have h_ftc : ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(‖q‖ ^ 2), (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + u))⁻¹ =
          Real.sqrt (1 + ‖q‖ ^ 2) - Real.sqrt (1 + 0) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := fun u => Real.sqrt (1 + u))
        · intro u hu
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (sq_nonneg ‖q‖)] at hu
          have h1u : 0 < 1 + u := by linarith [hu.1]
          refine (((hasDerivAt_id' u).const_add 1).sqrt h1u.ne').congr_deriv ?_
          simp only [one_div]
        · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (sq_nonneg ‖q‖)]
          intro u hu
          have h1u : 0 < 1 + u := by linarith [hu.1]
          exact ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
            ((continuousAt_const.mul ((continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id).sqrt)).inv₀
              (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h1u).ne'))
      rw [h_ftc]
      simp
    exact ⟨h_phase_smooth, h_grad_smooth, h_v_grad, h_box_eq⟩
  have h_part_b :
      ∃ (a₀ a₁ : ℝ), 0 < a₀ ∧ a₀ ≤ a₁ ∧
        (∀ (σ : ℝ) (v p u w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => pcGrad σ (v, p')) p u) w =
            inner ℝ u (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => pcGrad σ (v, p')) p w)) ∧
        (∀ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
          ((∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤
                inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => pcGrad σ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
              inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => pcGrad σ (v, p')) p u) u ≤
                a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2) ∨
           (∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤
                -inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => pcGrad σ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
              -inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => pcGrad σ (v, p')) p u) u ≤
                a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2))) := by
    have h_glue_nonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ expNegInvGlue t := by
      intro t
      rcases le_or_gt t 0 with h | h
      · rw [expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos h]
      · exact (expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos h).le
    have h_glue_le_one : ∀ t : ℝ, expNegInvGlue t ≤ 1 := by
      intro t
      unfold expNegInvGlue
      split_ifs with h
      · norm_num
      · exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr (inv_nonneg.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h).le))
    have h_bump_nonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ pcGevrey2Bump t :=
      fun t => mul_nonneg (h_glue_nonneg t) (h_glue_nonneg (1 - t))
    have h_bump_le_one : ∀ t : ℝ, pcGevrey2Bump t ≤ 1 := by
      intro t
      calc pcGevrey2Bump t = expNegInvGlue t * expNegInvGlue (1 - t) := rfl
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (h_glue_le_one t) (h_glue_le_one (1 - t))
            (h_glue_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    have h_bump_cont : Continuous pcGevrey2Bump :=
      (expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous.mul
        ((expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
    have h_bump_int : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable pcGevrey2Bump MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      fun a b => h_bump_cont.intervalIntegrable a b
    set I_β : ℝ := ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, pcGevrey2Bump u
    have h_Iβ_pos : 0 < I_β := by
      have h_sp1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (h_bump_int 0 (1 / 4)) (h_bump_int (1 / 4) 1)
      have h_sp2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (h_bump_int (1 / 4) (3 / 4)) (h_bump_int (3 / 4) 1)
      have h_nn1 : 0 ≤ ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(1 / 4), pcGevrey2Bump u :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun u _ => h_bump_nonneg u)
      have h_nn3 : 0 ≤ ∫ u in (3 / 4 : ℝ)..1, pcGevrey2Bump u :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun u _ => h_bump_nonneg u)
      set m₀ : ℝ := expNegInvGlue (1 / 4) * expNegInvGlue (1 / 4)
      have hm₀_pos : 0 < m₀ :=
        mul_pos (expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (by norm_num)) (expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (by norm_num))
      have h_mid : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ ≤ ∫ u in (1 / 4 : ℝ)..(3 / 4), pcGevrey2Bump u := by
        have h_mono : ∫ _u in (1 / 4 : ℝ)..(3 / 4), m₀ ≤
            ∫ u in (1 / 4 : ℝ)..(3 / 4), pcGevrey2Bump u := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
            intervalIntegrable_const (h_bump_int _ _)
          intro u hu
          exact mul_le_mul (expNegInvGlue.monotone hu.1)
            (expNegInvGlue.monotone (by linarith [hu.2]))
            (h_glue_nonneg _) (h_glue_nonneg _)
        have h_const : ∫ _u in (1 / 4 : ℝ)..(3 / 4), m₀ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
        linarith

      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Function.comp_apply, smul_apply]
      have h_aff : HasFDerivAt (fun p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (8 : ℝ) • p' - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • q.1)
          ((8 : ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) q.2 := by
        simpa using ((hasFDerivAt_id q.2).const_smul (8 : ℝ)).sub_const ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • q.1)
      have h_diff_q : DifferentiableAt ℝ pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D (L q) :=
        ((h_grad2D_smooth 1).differentiable (by simp)) (L q)
      have h_comp0 := (h_diff_q.hasFDerivAt.comp q.2 h_aff).const_smul (-2 * Real.pi * σ)
      have h_comp : HasFDerivAt (fun p' => pcGrad σ (q.1, p')) _ q.2 := h_comp0
      rw [h_comp.fderiv]
      simp only [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, map_smul, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [h_fn_eq]
    have hc_comp : ContDiffAt ℝ j (fderiv ℝ pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D ∘ ⇑L) vp :=
      ((h_fd_grad2D_smooth j).comp L.contDiff).contDiffAt
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hc_comp, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_abs_sc : |-16 * Real.pi * σ| = 16 * Real.pi := by
      rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;>
        simp [abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
    rw [h_abs_sc]
    rw [L.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right (h_fd_grad2D_smooth j) vp (le_rfl : (j : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ j)]
    have h_cml := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fderiv ℝ pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D) (L vp)) (fun _ => L)
    have h_prod_L : (∏ _i : Fin j, ‖L‖) ≤ (9 : ℝ) ^ j := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg L) hL_norm j
    have h_A_step : 16 * Real.pi * A₀ * (9 * A₀) ^ j ≤ A ^ (j + 1) := by
      have hpi : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi := Real.two_le_pi
      have h1 : 16 * Real.pi * A₀ ≤ A := by dsimp [A]; nlinarith [hA₀_ge_one]
      have h2 : 9 * A₀ ≤ A := by dsimp [A]; nlinarith [hA₀_ge_one]
      rw [pow_succ' A j]
      exact mul_le_mul h1 (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h2 j) (by positivity) hA_pos.le
    calc 16 * Real.pi *
          ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fderiv ℝ pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D) (L vp)).compContinuousLinearMap
            (fun _ => L)‖
        ≤ 16 * Real.pi *
            (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fderiv ℝ pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D) (L vp)‖ *
              ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖L‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cml (by positivity)
      _ ≤ 16 * Real.pi * ((A₀ ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) * (9 : ℝ) ^ j) := by
          gcongr
          exact h_grad2D_gevrey3 j (L vp)
      _ = (16 * Real.pi * A₀ * ((9 : ℝ) ^ j * A₀ ^ j)) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by
          rw [pow_succ' A₀ j]; ring
      _ = (16 * Real.pi * A₀ * (9 * A₀) ^ j) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by
          rw [← mul_pow]
      _ ≤ A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_A_step (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨h_phase_smooth, h_grad_smooth, h_v_grad, h_box_eq⟩ := h_part_a
  obtain ⟨a₀, a₁, ha₀, ha₁, h_symm, h_elliptic⟩ := h_part_b
  obtain ⟨A, hA, h_gevrey⟩ := h_part_c
  refine ⟨a₀, a₁, A, pcPhase, pcGrad, ha₀, ha₁, hA, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσ
  exact ⟨⟨h_phase_smooth σ, h_grad_smooth σ, h_v_grad σ, h_symm σ,
    h_elliptic σ hσ, h_gevrey σ hσ⟩, h_box_eq σ⟩

pseudoconformal_gevrey_phase.definitions:
noncomputable def pcGevrey2Bump (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  expNegInvGlue t * expNegInvGlue (1 - t)

noncomputable def pcGevrey2Step (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, pcGevrey2Bump u)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..t, pcGevrey2Bump u

noncomputable def pcDistDerivProfile (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - pcGevrey2Step (u - 10000)) *
    (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + Real.smoothTransition (2 * u + 3 / 2) * u))⁻¹ +
  pcGevrey2Step (u - 10000) * (1 / 2)

noncomputable def pcConvexifiedDist2D (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  1 + ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(‖q‖ ^ 2), pcDistDerivProfile u

noncomputable def pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  (2 * pcDistDerivProfile (‖q‖ ^ 2)) • q

noncomputable def pcSmoothRecipDepth (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / 4 + 8 * Real.smoothTransition (64 * c + 1) * c

noncomputable def pcPhase (σ : ℝ)
    (cxv : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  2 * Real.pi * σ * (pcSmoothRecipDepth cxv.1)⁻¹ *
    pcConvexifiedDist2D ((8 : ℝ) • cxv.2.1 - pcSmoothRecipDepth cxv.1 • cxv.2.2)

noncomputable def pcGrad (σ : ℝ)
    (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  (-2 * Real.pi * σ) • pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D ((8 : ℝ) • vp.2 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • vp.1)

def pcGluePolyCoeff : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
  | 0, 0 => 1
  | 0, _ + 1 => 0
  | _ + 1, 0 => 0
  | _ + 1, 1 => 0
  | j + 1, k + 2 => pcGluePolyCoeff j k - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * pcGluePolyCoeff j (k + 1)

noncomputable def pcHalfNegCoeff : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1 / 2
  | k + 1 => (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) * pcHalfNegCoeff k

informal_problem.statement:
(M_cone : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ M_B : ℕ → ℝ,
      ∀ (σ lam C_2d : ℝ), 0 ≤ C_2d →
      ∀ (Φ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k Φ) →
        (∀ (c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          c ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 32) (23 / 32) →
          ‖x‖ ≤ 2 →
          ‖v‖ ≤ 5 →
          Φ (c, x, v) =
            2 * Real.pi * σ * (1 / 4 + 8 * c)⁻¹ *
              Real.sqrt (1 + ‖(8 : ℝ) • x - (1 / 4 + 8 * c) • v‖ ^ 2)) →
      ∀ (a_dir : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k a_dir) →
        (∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
          (‖w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ∨ w 2 ≤ 1 / 6) → a_dir w = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k a_dir w‖ ≤ M_cone k) →
      (∃ B_a : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k B_a) ∧
        (∀ (c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          (c ∉ Set.Icc 0 1 ∨ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ 5 ≤ ‖v‖) → B_a (c, x, v) = 0) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k B_a p‖ ≤ M_B k) ∧
        ((∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 6 ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤ →
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ B_a f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal C_2d * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume) →
          ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ),
            Continuous h →
            (∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
              (∃ i : Fin 3, y i ≤ -3 ∨ 4 ≤ y i) → h y = 0) →
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (distPhaseOscOp σ lam a_dir h) 3
              (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict
                { z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ z i ∧ z i < 1 }) ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal (60 * C_2d) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm h 3 MeasureTheory.volume))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_norm2_sq : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_norm3_sq : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
      ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 + (w 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

  
  let L3_toLp : (Fin 3 → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ)).symm
  let sliceEmbed : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    fun v y₂ => L3_toLp ![v 0, v 1, y₂]
  let pseudoconformalPt : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    fun c x => L3_toLp
      ![8 * (1 / 4 + 8 * c)⁻¹ * x 0, 8 * (1 / 4 + 8 * c)⁻¹ * x 1, (1 / 4 + 8 * c)⁻¹]

  
  
  
  let θ_s : ℝ → ℝ := fun c =>
    Real.smoothTransition (64 * (c + 1 / 64)) * Real.smoothTransition (2 - c)
  let s_tilde : ℝ → ℝ := fun c => θ_s c * (1 / 4 + 8 * c) + (1 - θ_s c)
  have hs_tilde_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k s_tilde := by
    intro k
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun c : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (64 * (c + 1 / 64))) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
        (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const))
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun c : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 - c)) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
    have hθ : ContDiff ℝ k θ_s := h1.mul h2
    exact (hθ.mul (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))).add
      (contDiff_const.sub hθ)
  have hs_tilde_ge : ∀ c : ℝ, 1 / 8 ≤ s_tilde c := by
    intro c
    have hθ_nn : 0 ≤ θ_s c :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _) (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)
    have hθ_le : θ_s c ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [θ_s]
      nlinarith [Real.smoothTransition.le_one (64 * (c + 1 / 64)),
        Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (64 * (c + 1 / 64)),
        Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 - c),
        Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 - c)]
    by_cases hc : c ≤ -1 / 64
    · have h0 : Real.smoothTransition (64 * (c + 1 / 64)) = 0 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
      have hθ0 : θ_s c = 0 := by dsimp [θ_s]; rw [h0, zero_mul]
      dsimp [s_tilde]
      rw [hθ0]
      norm_num
    · push Not at hc
      dsimp [s_tilde]
      nlinarith
  have hs_tilde_ne : ∀ c : ℝ, s_tilde c ≠ 0 := fun c => by
    have := hs_tilde_ge c
    linarith
  have hs_tilde_eq : ∀ c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, s_tilde c = 1 / 4 + 8 * c := by
    intro c hc
    have h1 : Real.smoothTransition (64 * (c + 1 / 64)) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith [hc.1])
    have h2 : Real.smoothTransition (2 - c) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith [hc.2])
    have hθ1 : θ_s c = 1 := by dsimp [θ_s]; rw [h1, h2, mul_one]
    dsimp [s_tilde]
    rw [hθ1]
    ring

  let W : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    fun p => L3_toLp
      ![8 * (s_tilde p.1)⁻¹ * p.2.1 0 - p.2.2 0,
        8 * (s_tilde p.1)⁻¹ * p.2.1 1 - p.2.2 1,
        (s_tilde p.1)⁻¹]
  let θ_c : ℝ → ℝ := fun c =>
    Real.smoothTransition (64 * (c - 1 / 64)) * Real.smoothTransition (8 * (7 / 8 - c))
  let χ_x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun x =>
    Real.smoothTransition (15 / 4 - ((x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2))
  let χ_v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun v =>
    Real.smoothTransition (24 - ((v 0) ^ 2 + (v 1) ^ 2))
  let Θ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ :=
    fun p => θ_c p.1 * χ_x p.2.1 * χ_v p.2.2

  let proj2_0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ := PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 0
  let proj2_1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ := PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 1

  have hW_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k W := by
    intro k
    have hsinv : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (s_tilde p.1)⁻¹) :=
      ((hs_tilde_smooth k).comp contDiff_fst).inv (fun p => hs_tilde_ne p.1)
    have hx0 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => p.2.1 0) :=
      proj2_0.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd.fst
    have hx1 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => p.2.1 1) :=
      proj2_1.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd.fst
    have hv0 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => p.2.2 0) :=
      proj2_0.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd.snd
    have hv1 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => p.2.2 1) :=
      proj2_1.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd.snd
    refine L3_toLp.contDiff.comp (contDiff_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_))
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using ((contDiff_const.mul hsinv).mul hx0).sub hv0
    · simpa using ((contDiff_const.mul hsinv).mul hx1).sub hv1
    · simpa using hsinv

  have hΘ_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k Θ := by
    intro k
    have hst : ContDiff ℝ k Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
    have hc1 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Real.smoothTransition (64 * (p.1 - 1 / 64))) :=
      hst.comp (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_fst.sub contDiff_const))
    have hc2 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Real.smoothTransition (8 * (7 / 8 - p.1))) :=
      hst.comp (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_fst))
    have hx0 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => p.2.1 0) :=
      proj2_0.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd.fst
    have hx1 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => p.2.1 1) :=
      proj2_1.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd.fst
    have hv0 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => p.2.2 0) :=
      proj2_0.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd.snd
    have hv1 : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => p.2.2 1) :=
      proj2_1.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd.snd
    have hχx : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => χ_x p.2.1) :=
      hst.comp (contDiff_const.sub ((hx0.pow 2).add (hx1.pow 2)))
    have hχv : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => χ_v p.2.2) :=
      hst.comp (contDiff_const.sub ((hv0.pow 2).add (hv1.pow 2)))
    exact ((hc1.mul hc2).mul hχx).mul hχv

  let K_B : Set (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ
      (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 2 ×ˢ
        Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 5)
  have hK_B_compact : IsCompact K_B :=
    isCompact_Icc.prod ((isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _))

  have h_exists_KΘ : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ p ∈ K_B, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Θ p‖ ≤ B := by
    intro i
    have hc : Continuous (fun p => iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Θ p) :=
      (hΘ_smooth i).continuous_iteratedFDeriv le_rfl
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK_B_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
    exact ⟨max B 0, le_max_right _ _, fun p hp => le_trans (hB p hp) (le_max_left _ _)⟩
  have h_exists_KW : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ p ∈ K_B, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W p‖ ≤ B := by
    intro i
    have hc : Continuous (fun p => iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W p) :=
      (hW_smooth i).continuous_iteratedFDeriv le_rfl
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK_B_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
    exact ⟨max B 0, le_max_right _ _, fun p hp => le_trans (hB p hp) (le_max_left _ _)⟩

  let K_Θ : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => Classical.choose (h_exists_KΘ i)
  have hK_Θ_spec : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ K_Θ i ∧ ∀ p ∈ K_B, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i Θ p‖ ≤ K_Θ i :=
    fun i => Classical.choose_spec (h_exists_KΘ i)
  let K_W : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => Classical.choose (h_exists_KW i)
  have hK_W_spec : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ K_W i ∧ ∀ p ∈ K_B, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i W p‖ ≤ K_W i :=
    fun i => Classical.choose_spec (h_exists_KW i)

  let C_cone : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), max (M_cone j) 0
  let D_W : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), K_W j

    have hconj : Real.HolderConjugate 3 (3 / 2) := by

    have hG_z_cont : Continuous (fun y₂ : ℝ => G (z, y₂)) :=

    have h_hold := ENNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq μI hconj
      hG_z_cont.enorm.aemeasurable
      (aemeasurable_const : AEMeasurable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ENNReal)) μI)
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, mul_one, ENNReal.one_rpow,

    have hμI : μI Set.univ = 3 := by

    rw [hμI] at h_hold

  have h_z_trans : ∀ y₂ : ℝ,

      _ ≤ 9 * ((8192 * ENNReal.ofReal (C_2d ^ 3)) *
            ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖h y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume) := by
          rw [← h_pull]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_stepB zero_le
      _ = ((9 : ENNReal) * (8192 * ENNReal.ofReal (C_2d ^ 3))) *
            ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖h y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((60 * C_2d) ^ 3) *
            ∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖h y‖ₑ ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_const_le zero_le

  
  rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      h_dist_cont.aestronglyMeasurable,
    MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hh_cont.aestronglyMeasurable]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat]
  have h_rpow := ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow h_total_lintegral (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3)
  rw [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3)] at h_rpow
  have h_c_pow : (ENNReal.ofReal ((60 * C_2d) ^ 3)) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (60 * C_2d) := by
    have h60_nn : 0 ≤ 60 * C_2d := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_2d
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow h60_nn 3, ← ENNReal.rpow_natCast, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul,
      show ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 3 : ℝ) = 1 by norm_num, ENNReal.rpow_one]
  rw [h_c_pow] at h_rpow
  exact h_rpow

proof.tactics:
by
  let R_dom : ℝ := max 1 (max (R_x + 2) (R_v + 2))
  have hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom := le_max_left _ _
  have hRx_dom : R_x + 2 ≤ R_dom := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hRv_dom : R_v + 2 ≤ R_dom := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  let ν₀ : ℝ := min ν (1 / 2)
  have hν₀_pos : 0 < ν₀ := lt_min hν (by norm_num)
  have hν₀_le_ν : ν₀ ≤ ν := min_le_left _ _
  have hν₀_le_half : ν₀ ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  let γ : ℝ := ν₀
  let η : ℝ := ν₀
  have hγ₀ : 0 < γ := hν₀_pos
  have hγ₁ : γ < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hν₀_le_half (by norm_num)
  have hη : 0 < η := hν₀_pos
  obtain ⟨M_ψ, C_box, hC_box_nn, h_box⟩ :=
    endpoint_box_discretization_bound a₀ a₁ A R_x R_v R_dom ha₀ ha₁ hA hRx hRv
      hR_dom hRx_dom hRv_dom M_B
  obtain ⟨C_root, hC_root_ge, h_root⟩ :=
    root_packet_score_sublevel_bound a₀ a₁ A R_dom γ ha₀ ha₁ hA hR_dom hγ₀ hγ₁
  have hC_root_nn : 0 ≤ C_root := by linarith
  obtain ⟨Λ₀, C_pkt, hΛ₀_ge, hC_pkt_nn, h_pkt⟩ :=
    wave_packet_score_growth_bound a₀ a₁ A R_dom ha₀ ha₁ hA hR_dom M_ψ γ η hγ₀ hγ₁ hη
  let C_sub : ℝ := C_box * (C_pkt * C_root) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)
  have hC_sub_nn : 0 ≤ C_sub :=
    mul_nonneg hC_box_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC_pkt_nn hC_root_nn) _)
  let B_max : ℝ := max (M_B 0) 0
  have hB_max_nn : 0 ≤ B_max := le_max_right _ _
  obtain ⟨C_osc, hC_osc_nn, h_dyadic⟩ :=
    sublevel_to_l3_dyadic_interpolation R_x R_v B_max ν Λ₀ C_sub
      hRx hRv hB_max_nn hν hΛ₀_ge hC_sub_nn
  refine ⟨C_osc, hC_osc_nn, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam Φ ζ h_phase B hB_smooth hB_supp hB_deriv f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l3
  obtain ⟨Φ₀, ζ₀, B', f', h_norm, hB'_smooth, hB'_supp, hB'_deriv,
      hf'_meas, hf'_supp, hf'_l3_eq, h_op_eq⟩ :=
    elliptic_phase_gauge_reduction a₀ a₁ A R_x R_v hRx hRv lam Φ ζ h_phase
      B hB_smooth hB_supp M_B hB_deriv f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l3
  rw [h_op_eq, ← hf'_l3_eq]
  have hf'_l3 : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f' 3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤ := by
    rwa [hf'_l3_eq]
  have hB'_bound : ∀ p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖B' p‖ ≤ B_max := by
    intro p
    calc ‖B' p‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 B' p‖ := (norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero).symm
      _ ≤ M_B 0 := hB'_deriv 0 p
      _ ≤ B_max := le_max_left _ _
  refine h_dyadic lam hlam Φ₀ B' (h_norm.1 0).continuous (hB'_smooth 0).continuous
    hB'_supp hB'_bound ?_ f' hf'_meas hf'_supp hf'_l3
  intro hlam_Λ F hF_meas hF_sub g hg_meas hg_ind
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by linarith
  have hlam_nn : 0 ≤ lam := hlam_pos.le
  have hlam_ge_one : 1 ≤ lam := by linarith
  have hF_dom : F ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 R_dom :=
    hF_sub.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))
  have hF_lt_top : MeasureTheory.volume F < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hF_dom) MeasureTheory.measure_closedBall_lt_top
  have hF_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume F ≠ ⊤ := hF_lt_top.ne
  have hg_supp_dom : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → g v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hv_not_F : v ∉ F := by
      intro hvF
      have hv_ball := hF_sub hvF
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hv_ball
      linarith
    have h_le : ‖g v‖ ≤ 0 := by
      have h1 := hg_ind v
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv_not_F] at h1
      exact h1
    exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp h_le
  have h_ind_l1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Set.indicator F (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)))
      MeasureTheory.volume :=
    MeasureTheory.memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp
      (MeasureTheory.memLp_indicator_const 1 hF_meas (1 : ℝ) (Or.inr hF_ne_top))
  have h_ind_l2 : MeasureTheory.MemLp (Set.indicator F (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)))
      2 MeasureTheory.volume :=
    MeasureTheory.memLp_indicator_const 2 hF_meas (1 : ℝ) (Or.inr hF_ne_top)
  have hg_le_ind : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖g v‖ ≤ Set.indicator F (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) v := hg_ind
  have hg_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g MeasureTheory.volume :=
    h_ind_l1.mono' hg_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg_le_ind)
  have hg_l2 : MeasureTheory.MemLp g 2 MeasureTheory.volume :=
    h_ind_l2.mono' hg_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg_le_ind)
  have hg_sq_le_ind : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖‖g v‖ ^ 2‖ ≤ Set.indicator F (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) v := by
    intro v
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    by_cases hv : v ∈ F
    · have h1 := hg_ind v
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hv] at h1 ⊢
      change ‖g v‖ ≤ 1 at h1
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (g v)]
    · have h1 := hg_ind v
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv] at h1 ⊢
      change ‖g v‖ ≤ 0 at h1
      have h0 : ‖g v‖ = 0 := le_antisymm h1 (norm_nonneg _)
      simp [h0]
  have hg_sq_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖g v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    h_ind_l1.mono' (hg_meas.norm.pow 2) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg_sq_le_ind)
  by_cases hg_zero : ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖g v‖ ^ 2 = 0
  · have hg_sq_ae : (fun v => ‖g v‖ ^ 2) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] 0 :=
      (MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun v => sq_nonneg ‖g v‖) hg_sq_int).mp
        hg_zero
    have h_op_zero : oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B' g = 0 := by
      ext cx
      unfold oscIntegralOp2D
      rw [Pi.zero_apply]
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_of_ae ?_
      filter_upwards [hg_sq_ae] with v hv
      change ‖g v‖ ^ 2 = 0 at hv
      have hgv : g v = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hv)
      simp [hgv]
    rw [h_op_zero, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_zero]
    exact zero_le
  · have hg_int_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖g v‖ ^ 2 :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun v => sq_nonneg ‖g v‖)
    have hg_pos : 0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖g v‖ ^ 2 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hg_int_nn (Ne.symm hg_zero)
    obtain ⟨ψ_end, hψ_smooth, hψ_supp, hψ_deriv, h_box_est⟩ :=
      h_box lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_norm B' hB'_smooth hB'_supp hB'_deriv g hg_int
    have h_pkt_est :=
      h_pkt lam hlam_Λ Φ₀ ζ₀ h_norm ψ_end hψ_smooth hψ_supp hψ_deriv
        g hg_meas hg_supp_dom hg_l2 hg_pos
    have h_root_est :=
      h_root lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_norm F hF_meas hF_dom g hg_meas hg_ind hg_pos
    let S_end : ℝ := ∑ o ∈ endpointSiteFinset lam R_dom,
      (endpointPacketMass lam Φ₀ ψ_end g o) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2)
    have hS_nn : 0 ≤ S_end := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ?_ _)
      unfold endpointPacketMass
      exact sq_nonneg _
    have h_sum_bound : S_end ≤
        (C_pkt * C_root) * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal * lam ^ (3 * ν₀ / 2) := by
      have hexp : γ / 2 + η = 3 * ν₀ / 2 := by
        dsimp [γ, η]
        ring
      have h_split : lam ^ (rootPacketScore lam R_dom γ Φ₀ g + (γ / 2 + η)) =
          lam ^ (rootPacketScore lam R_dom γ Φ₀ g) * lam ^ (3 * ν₀ / 2) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_add hlam_pos, hexp]
      calc S_end
          ≤ C_pkt * lam ^ (rootPacketScore lam R_dom γ Φ₀ g + γ / 2 + η) := h_pkt_est
        _ = C_pkt * (lam ^ (rootPacketScore lam R_dom γ Φ₀ g) * lam ^ (3 * ν₀ / 2)) := by
            rw [add_assoc, h_split]
        _ ≤ C_pkt * ((C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal) * lam ^ (3 * ν₀ / 2)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hC_pkt_nn
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_root_est (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)
        _ = (C_pkt * C_root) * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal * lam ^ (3 * ν₀ / 2) := by ring
    have h_rpow_bound : S_end ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) ≤
        (C_pkt * C_root) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) *
          (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) *
          lam ^ (ν₀ / 2) := by
      have h_lhs := Real.rpow_le_rpow hS_nn h_sum_bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3)
      have h1 : 0 ≤ C_pkt * C_root := mul_nonneg hC_pkt_nn hC_root_nn
      have h2 : 0 ≤ (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have h3 : 0 ≤ lam ^ (3 * ν₀ / 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (mul_nonneg h1 h2) h3, Real.mul_rpow h1 h2,
        ← Real.rpow_mul hlam_nn] at h_lhs
      have hexp2 : (3 * ν₀ / 2) * ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = ν₀ / 2 := by ring
      rwa [hexp2] at h_lhs
    have h_real_bound : C_box * lam⁻¹ * S_end ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) ≤
        (C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2)) * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
      have h_cbox_lam : 0 ≤ C_box * lam⁻¹ := mul_nonneg hC_box_nn (inv_nonneg.mpr hlam_nn)
      have h_lam_exp : lam⁻¹ * lam ^ (ν₀ / 2) ≤ lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one lam, ← Real.rpow_add hlam_pos]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hlam_ge_one (by linarith)
      calc C_box * lam⁻¹ * S_end ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)
          ≤ C_box * lam⁻¹ * ((C_pkt * C_root) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) *
              (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) * lam ^ (ν₀ / 2)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_bound h_cbox_lam
        _ = C_sub * (lam⁻¹ * lam ^ (ν₀ / 2)) *
              (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
            dsimp [C_sub]
            ring
        _ ≤ C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) *
              (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lam_exp hC_sub_nn
    refine h_box_est.trans ?_
    have h_ofReal := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_real_bound
    have h_coeff_nn : 0 ≤ C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) :=
      mul_nonneg hC_sub_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul h_coeff_nn,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (by norm_num),
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hF_ne_top] at h_ofReal
    exact h_ofReal

osc_integral_2d_l3_bound.definitions:
noncomputable def gridPt2D (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then s * (k.1 : ℝ) else s * (k.2 : ℝ))

noncomputable def perp2D (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then -(e 1) else e 0)

def IsNormalizedPosDefPhase (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k Φ₀) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ζ₀) ∧
  (∀ (c : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), Φ₀ (c, x, 0) = 0) ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), Φ₀ (0, 0, v) = 0) ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ζ₀ (v, 0) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ (x v u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      fderiv ℝ (fun v' => Φ₀ (c, x, v')) v u = inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v, x - c • v)) u) ∧
  (∀ (v p u w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) w =
      inner ℝ u (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p w)) ∧
  (∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
    inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) u ≤ a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
      (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (q.1, p')) q.2) vp‖ ≤
      A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3))

def IsCanonicalRootWindow (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ) ∧
  (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 100 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ z = 0) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ z‖ ≤ (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 10))

noncomputable def canonicalRootMass (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) : ℝ :=
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  let V := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1
  let X := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2
  sSup { m : ℝ | ∃ ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
    IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ ∧
    m = ‖(ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      f v * ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 }

noncomputable def rootSiteFinset (lam R_dom : ℝ) : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  let B_V : ℤ := ⌈Real.sqrt lam * (R_dom + 100)⌉₊ + 1
  let B_X : ℤ := ⌈Real.sqrt lam * (R_dom + 100 + Real.log lam)⌉₊ + 1
  let boxV := (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V)
  let boxX := (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X)
  (boxV ×ˢ boxX).filter (fun o =>
    ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1‖ ≤ R_dom + 100 ∧
    ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2‖ ≤ R_dom + 100 + Real.log lam)

noncomputable def rootPacketScore (lam R_dom γ : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam R_dom
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  sSup ({ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2) / Real.log lam) } ∪
    { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
        (b a : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (e_dir V_c X_c : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b d ∧ b d ≤ a d ∧ a d ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ‖e_dir d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) ∧
        (∀ o d, o ∉ O₀ → p o d = 0) ∧
        (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) ∧
        (∀ o ∈ O₀, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
          0 < canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ f o ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-(b d)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-(a d)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-(b d)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-(a d))) ∧
        (let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
         let p_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d
         let H_O := (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / Real.log lam
         let H_O_D := (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / Real.log lam
         let E_mass := (∑ o ∈ O₀,
           p_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ f o)) / Real.log lam
         let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b d + (1 - γ) * a d)
         s = H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w) })

noncomputable def endpointSiteFinset (lam R_dom : ℝ) :
    Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let m_lam : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 ⌈lam⌉₊
  let B_V : ℤ := ⌈R_dom⌉₊ + 1
  let B_X : ℤ := ⌈lam * R_dom⌉₊ + 1
  let boxR := Finset.range (2 ^ m_lam)
  let boxV := (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V)
  let boxX := (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X)
  (boxR ×ˢ (boxV ×ˢ boxX)).filter (fun o =>
    ‖gridPt2D 1 o.2.1‖ ≤ R_dom ∧
    ‖gridPt2D lam⁻¹ o.2.2‖ ≤ R_dom)

noncomputable def endpointPacketMass (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ψ_end : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (o : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) : ℝ :=
  let m_lam : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 ⌈lam⌉₊
  let C_r : ℝ := ((o.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_lam)⁻¹
  let V_j := gridPt2D 1 o.2.1
  let X_k := gridPt2D lam⁻¹ o.2.2
  ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
    f v * ψ_end o (v - V_j) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (C_r, X_k, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def gridPt2D (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then s * (k.1 : ℝ) else s * (k.2 : ℝ))

noncomputable def perp2D (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then -(e 1) else e 0)

def IsNormalizedPosDefPhase (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k Φ₀) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ζ₀) ∧
  (∀ (c : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), Φ₀ (c, x, 0) = 0) ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), Φ₀ (0, 0, v) = 0) ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ζ₀ (v, 0) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ (x v u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      fderiv ℝ (fun v' => Φ₀ (c, x, v')) v u = inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v, x - c • v)) u) ∧
  (∀ (v p u w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) w =
      inner ℝ u (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p w)) ∧
  (∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
    inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) u ≤ a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
      (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (q.1, p')) q.2) vp‖ ≤
      A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3))

def IsCanonicalRootWindow (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ) ∧
  (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 100 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ z = 0) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ z‖ ≤ (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 10))

noncomputable def canonicalRootMass (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) : ℝ :=
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  let V := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1
  let X := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2
  sSup { m : ℝ | ∃ ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
    IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ ∧
    m = ‖(ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      f v * ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 }

  letI := Classical.propDecidable

  (boxV ×ˢ boxX).filter (fun o =>
    ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1‖ ≤ R_dom + 100 ∧
    ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2‖ ≤ R_dom + 100 + Real.log lam)

subgoal_signatures.name: elliptic_phase_gauge_reduction
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_x R_v : ℝ) (hRx : 0 < R_x) (hRv : 0 < R_v)
    (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (h_phase : IsEllipticGevreyPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ ζ)
    (B : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (hB_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k B)
    (hB_supp : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      (c ∉ Set.Icc 0 1 ∨ R_x ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ R_v ≤ ‖v‖) → B (c, x, v) = 0)
    (M_B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k B p‖ ≤ M_B k)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (hf_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hf_supp : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_v + 1 ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0)
    (hf_l3 : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤) :
    ∃ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (B' : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (f' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k B') ∧
      (∀ (c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        (c ∉ Set.Icc 0 1 ∨ R_x ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ R_v ≤ ‖v‖) → B' (c, x, v) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k B' p‖ ≤ M_B k) ∧
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f' MeasureTheory.volume ∧

subgoal_signatures.statement:

      ‖oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ B f cx‖ = ‖oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B' f' cx‖ := by
    intro cx
    rw [← h_op₁_norm cx]
    have h_pull : oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₁ B₁ f₁ cx =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₁ (cx.1, cx.2, 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B' f' cx := by
      unfold oscIntegralOp2D
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      ext v
      have h_phase_split :
          Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₁ (cx.1, cx.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₁ (cx.1, cx.2, 0) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
              (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (cx.1, cx.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
                Complex.I * ((lam * (Φ₁ (0, 0, v) - Φ₁ (0, 0, 0)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        dsimp [Φ₀]
        push_cast
        ring
      dsimp [B', f']
      rw [h_phase_split, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_add]
      ring
    rw [h_pull, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, one_mul]
  have hB_bound : ∀ p, ‖B p‖ ≤ B_max := by
    intro p
    calc ‖B p‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 B p‖ := norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero.symm
      _ ≤ M_B 0 := hB_deriv 0 p
      _ ≤ B_max := le_max_left _ _
  have hB'_bound : ∀ p, ‖B' p‖ ≤ B_max := by
    intro p
    calc ‖B' p‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 B₁ p‖ := norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero.symm
      _ ≤ M_B 0 := hB₁_deriv 0 p
      _ ≤ B_max := le_max_left _ _
  have h_op_orig_meas :
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ B f) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    h_op_meas Φ B f (hΦ_smooth 0).continuous (hB_smooth 0).continuous hB_bound hf_meas
      (fun _ => rfl)
  have h_op_new_meas :
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B' f') MeasureTheory.volume :=
    h_op_meas Φ₀ B' f' (hΦ₀_smooth 0).continuous (hB₁_smooth 0).continuous hB'_bound hf'_meas
      hf'_norm
  have h_op_eq :
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ B f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume =
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B' f') 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
    MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_congr_norm_ae h_op_orig_meas h_op_new_meas
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_op_norm)
  refine ⟨Φ₀, ζ₀, B', f', ?_, hB₁_smooth, hB₁_supp, hB₁_deriv,
    hf'_meas, hf'_supp, hf'_l3_eq, h_op_eq⟩
  refine ⟨hΦ₀_smooth, hζ₀_smooth, ?_, ?_, ?_, hΦ₀_grad, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c x; dsimp [Φ₀]; ring
  · intro v; dsimp [Φ₀]; ring
  · intro v; dsimp [ζ₀]; exact sub_self _
  · intro v p u w
    rw [hζ₀_fderiv v p]
    exact hζ₁_symm v p u w
  · intro v p u
    rw [hζ₀_fderiv v p]
    exact hζ₁_pos v p u
  · intro j vp
    have h_eq : (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (q.1, p')) q.2) =
      (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₁ (q.1, p')) q.2) := by
      ext q u
      rw [hζ₀_fderiv q.1 q.2]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hζ₁_gevrey j vp

informal_problem.statement:
(R_x R_v B_max ν Λ₀ C_sub : ℝ)
    (hRx : 0 < R_x) (hRv : 0 < R_v) (hB_max : 0 ≤ B_max)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hΛ₀ : 2 ≤ Λ₀) (hC_sub : 0 ≤ C_sub) :
    ∃ C_osc : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_osc ∧
      ∀ (lam : ℝ), 2 ≤ lam →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (B : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        Continuous Φ₀ →
        Continuous B →
        (∀ (c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          (c ∉ Set.Icc 0 1 ∨ R_x ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ R_v ≤ ‖v‖) → B (c, x, v) = 0) →
        (∀ p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖B p‖ ≤ B_max) →
        (Λ₀ ≤ lam →
          ∀ (F : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))),
            MeasurableSet F →
            F ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 (R_v + 1) →
            ∀ (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g MeasureTheory.volume →
              (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖g v‖ ≤ Set.indicator F 1 v) →
              MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B g) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
                ENNReal.ofReal (C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2)) *
                  (MeasureTheory.volume F) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) →
      ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
        (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_v + 1 ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤ →
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (C_osc * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) *
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume

signature.statement:
(R_x R_v B_max ν Λ₀ C_sub : ℝ)
    (hRx : 0 < R_x) (hRv : 0 < R_v) (hB_max : 0 ≤ B_max)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hΛ₀ : 2 ≤ Λ₀) (hC_sub : 0 ≤ C_sub) :
    ∃ C_osc : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_osc ∧
      ∀ (lam : ℝ), 2 ≤ lam →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (B : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        Continuous Φ₀ →
        Continuous B →
        (∀ (c : ℝ) (x v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          (c ∉ Set.Icc 0 1 ∨ R_x ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ R_v ≤ ‖v‖) → B (c, x, v) = 0) →
        (∀ p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖B p‖ ≤ B_max) →
        (Λ₀ ≤ lam →

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let S_out : Set (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) R_x
  have hS_out_lt_top : MeasureTheory.volume S_out < ⊤ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc]
    exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top MeasureTheory.measure_closedBall_lt_top
  have hS_out_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume S_out ≠ ⊤ := hS_out_lt_top.ne
  let K_in : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
    Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (R_v + 1)
  have hK_in_meas : MeasurableSet K_in := measurableSet_closedBall
  have hK_in_lt_top : MeasureTheory.volume K_in < ⊤ := MeasureTheory.measure_closedBall_lt_top
  have hK_in_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume K_in ≠ ⊤ := hK_in_lt_top.ne
  let V_out : ℝ := (MeasureTheory.volume S_out).toReal
  let V_in : ℝ := (MeasureTheory.volume K_in).toReal
  have hV_out_nn : 0 ≤ V_out := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hV_in_nn : 0 ≤ V_in := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  let C_L1 : ℝ := B_max * V_out ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)
  have hC_L1_nn : 0 ≤ C_L1 := mul_nonneg hB_max (Real.rpow_nonneg hV_out_nn _)
  let C_triv : ℝ := C_L1 * V_in ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3)
  have hC_triv_nn : 0 ≤ C_triv := mul_nonneg hC_L1_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg hV_in_nn _)
  let M_ν : ℝ := max 1 (max (Λ₀ ^ (1 - ν)) ((8 / (ν * Real.log 2)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3)))
  have hM_ν_ge_one : 1 ≤ M_ν := le_max_left _ _
  have hM_ν_nn : 0 ≤ M_ν := by linarith
  let C_osc : ℝ := max (C_triv * M_ν) (C_L1 * (V_in + 1) + 2 * C_sub * M_ν)
  have hC_osc_nn : 0 ≤ C_osc :=
    le_trans (mul_nonneg hC_triv_nn hM_ν_nn) (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨C_osc, hC_osc_nn, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam Φ₀ B hΦ₀ hB hB_supp hB_bound h_sub f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l3
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by linarith
  have hlam_nn : 0 ≤ lam := hlam_pos.le
  have hlam_ge_one : 1 ≤ lam := by linarith

  
  have h_L1_op : ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable h MeasureTheory.volume →
      Continuous (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B h) ∧
      (∀ cx : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun v => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (cx.1, cx.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            B (cx.1, cx.2, v) * h v)
          MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B h) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C_L1 * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖) := by
    intro h hh_int
    let F_ker : (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
      fun cx v => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (cx.1, cx.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        B (cx.1, cx.2, v) * h v
    have hF_norm : ∀ cx v, ‖F_ker cx v‖ ≤ B_max * ‖h v‖ := by
      intro cx v
      dsimp only [F_ker]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, one_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB_bound (cx.1, cx.2, v)) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hF_fib_int : ∀ cx, MeasureTheory.Integrable (F_ker cx) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro cx
      have h_tup : Continuous (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (cx.1, cx.2, v)) :=
        continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hc_v : Continuous (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (cx.1, cx.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            B (cx.1, cx.2, v)) :=
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.mul (hΦ₀.comp h_tup))))).mul
          (hB.comp h_tup)
      exact (hh_int.norm.const_mul B_max).mono'
        (hc_v.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hh_int.aestronglyMeasurable)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hF_norm cx))
    have h_op_cont : Continuous (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B h) := by
      unfold oscIntegralOp2D
      refine MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated
        (fun cx => (hF_fib_int cx).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (fun cx => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hF_norm cx))
        (hh_int.norm.const_mul B_max)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => ?_))
      have h_tup_cx : Continuous (fun cx : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (cx.1, cx.2, v)) :=
        continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact ((Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.mul (hΦ₀.comp h_tup_cx))))).mul
        (hB.comp h_tup_cx)).mul continuous_const
    have h_op_supp : Function.support (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B h) ⊆ S_out := by
      intro cx hcx
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hcx
      by_contra h_not
      apply hcx
      unfold oscIntegralOp2D
      have hB_zero : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), B (cx.1, cx.2, v) = 0 := by
        intro v
        apply hB_supp cx.1 cx.2 v
        by_cases hc1 : cx.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
        · right; left
          have hc2 : cx.2 ∉ Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) R_x :=
            fun h2 => h_not ⟨hc1, h2⟩
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hc2
          exact hc2.le
        · exact Or.inl hc1
      simp [hB_zero]
    have h_int_h_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun v => norm_nonneg _)
    have h_ptwise : ∀ cx, ‖oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B h cx‖ ≤
        B_max * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ := by
      intro cx
      calc ‖oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B h cx‖
          = ‖∫ v, F_ker cx v‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ ∫ v, ‖F_ker cx v‖ := MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ ≤ ∫ v, B_max * ‖h v‖ :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_mono (hF_fib_int cx).norm (hh_int.norm.const_mul B_max)
              (hF_norm cx)
        _ = B_max * ∫ v, ‖h v‖ := MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul B_max _
    have h_el3 : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B h) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C_L1 * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖) := by
      rw [← MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_restrict_eq_of_support_subset
        h_op_cont.aestronglyMeasurable h_op_supp]
      have h_ae := MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_le_of_ae_bound (p := 3)
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict S_out)
        (h_op_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)).restrict
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_ptwise)
      refine h_ae.trans ?_
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
      have hp3 : (3 : ENNReal).toReal⁻¹ = (1 : ℝ) / 3 := by norm_num
      rw [hp3, ← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hS_out_ne_top,
        ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hV_out_nn (by norm_num),
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg hV_out_nn _)]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_of_eq (by dsimp only [C_L1, V_out]; ring))
    exact ⟨h_op_cont, hF_fib_int, h_el3⟩

  have hf_supp_in : Function.support f ⊆ K_in := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hv
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    by_contra h_not
    rw [not_le] at h_not
    exact hv (hf_supp v h_not.le)
  have hf_l1_le : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 1 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (V_in ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3)) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have h_cmp := MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_mul_rpow_measure_univ
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K_in) (p := 1) (q := 3) (by norm_num) hf_meas.restrict
    rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_restrict_eq_of_support_subset (p := 1) hf_meas hf_supp_in,
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_restrict_eq_of_support_subset (p := 3) hf_meas hf_supp_in,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ] at h_cmp
    have hexp : 1 / (1 : ENNReal).toReal - 1 / (3 : ENNReal).toReal = (2 : ℝ) / 3 := by norm_num
    rw [hexp, ← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hK_in_ne_top,
      ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hV_in_nn (by norm_num), mul_comm] at h_cmp
    exact h_cmp
  have hf_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have hf_l1_lt : MeasureTheory.MemLp f 1 MeasureTheory.volume :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt hf_l1_le (ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top hf_l3)
    exact MeasureTheory.memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp hf_l1_lt
  have h_triv_f : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal C_triv * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have h_int_eq : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖) =
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 1 MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm hf_int,
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm hf_meas]
    calc MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B f) 3 MeasureTheory.volume
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C_L1 * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖) := (h_L1_op f hf_int).2.2
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal C_L1 * ENNReal.ofReal (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖) :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_mul hC_L1_nn
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal C_L1 * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 1 MeasureTheory.volume := by rw [h_int_eq]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C_L1 *
            (ENNReal.ofReal (V_in ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3)) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf_l1_le zero_le
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal C_triv * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hC_L1_nn]

  
  by_cases hlam_Λ : Λ₀ ≤ lam
  swap
  · have hlam_le_Λ : lam ≤ Λ₀ := le_of_not_ge hlam_Λ
    have h_lam_1mν : lam ^ (1 - ν) ≤ M_ν := by
      by_cases h1ν : 0 ≤ 1 - ν
      · exact (Real.rpow_le_rpow hlam_nn hlam_le_Λ h1ν).trans
          ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
      · calc lam ^ (1 - ν) ≤ lam ^ (0 : ℝ) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hlam_ge_one (le_of_not_ge h1ν)
          _ = 1 := Real.rpow_zero lam
          _ ≤ M_ν := hM_ν_ge_one
    have h_one_le : 1 ≤ M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν) := by
      have hexp0 : (1 - ν) + (-1 + ν) = 0 := by ring
      calc (1 : ℝ) = lam ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero lam).symm
        _ = lam ^ ((1 - ν) + (-1 + ν)) := by rw [hexp0]
        _ = lam ^ (1 - ν) * lam ^ (-1 + ν) := Real.rpow_add hlam_pos _ _
        _ ≤ M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_lam_1mν (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)
    have h_ctriv_le : C_triv ≤ C_osc * lam ^ (-1 + ν) := by
      calc C_triv = C_triv * 1 := (mul_one C_triv).symm
        _ ≤ C_triv * (M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_one_le hC_triv_nn
        _ = (C_triv * M_ν) * lam ^ (-1 + ν) := by ring
        _ ≤ C_osc * lam ^ (-1 + ν) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)
    exact h_triv_f.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_ctriv_le) zero_le)

  by_cases hf_zero : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume = 0
  · refine h_triv_f.trans ?_
    rw [hf_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero]

  
  let N : ℝ := (MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume).toReal
  have hN_pos : 0 < N := ENNReal.toReal_pos hf_zero hf_l3.ne
  have hN_ofReal : ENNReal.ofReal N = MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
    ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hf_l3.ne

  
  let K : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 ⌈lam⌉₊
  have h_ceil_ge : 2 ≤ ⌈lam⌉₊ := by
    exact_mod_cast (hlam.trans (Nat.le_ceil lam))
  have hK_ge_one : 1 ≤ K := by
    by_contra hK0
    have hK_le : K ≤ 0 := by omega
    have h_le_one := (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow (by norm_num : 1 < 2)).mp hK_le
    omega
  have hlam_le_pow : lam ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K := by
    have h_nat : ⌈lam⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ K := Nat.le_pow_clog (by norm_num : 1 < 2) ⌈lam⌉₊
    exact (Nat.le_ceil lam).trans (by exact_mod_cast h_nat)
  have h_2negK : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(K : ℤ)) ≤ lam ^ (-1 + ν) := by
    rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
    have h_inv : ((2 : ℝ) ^ K)⁻¹ ≤ lam⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hlam_pos hlam_le_pow

  have h_2neg2K : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-2 * (K : ℤ)) ≤ lam ^ (-1 + ν) :=
    (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by omega : -2 * (K : ℤ) ≤ -(K : ℤ))).trans
      h_2negK

          _ ≤ (8 / ν) * lam ^ α := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp_bound (by positivity)
      calc 2 * (K : ℝ) = ((2 * (K : ℝ)) * Real.log 2) / Real.log 2 := by field_simp
        _ ≤ ((8 / ν) * lam ^ α) / Real.log 2 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_mul_log2 h_log2_pos.le
        _ = (8 / (ν * Real.log 2)) * lam ^ α := by ring
    have h_rpow_2K : (2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ≤ M_ν * lam ^ (ν / 2) := by
      have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h_2K_bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 / 3)
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _), ← Real.rpow_mul hlam_nn] at h1
      have hexp_α : α * ((2 : ℝ) / 3) = ν / 2 := by dsimp only [α]; ring
      rw [hexp_α] at h1

          rw [← Real.rpow_add hlam_pos]

  let f_m : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := Set.indicator K_in (hf_meas.mk f)
  have hf_m_smeas : MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable f_m :=
    hf_meas.stronglyMeasurable_mk.indicator hK_in_meas
  have hf_m_norm_meas : Measurable (fun v => ‖f_m v‖) := hf_m_smeas.norm.measurable
  have hf_ae_eq : f =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] f_m := by
    filter_upwards [hf_meas.ae_eq_mk] with v hv
    dsimp only [f_m]
    by_cases hvK : v ∈ K_in
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hvK, hv]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hvK]
      have hv_out : R_v + 1 < ‖v‖ := by
        rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hvK

  have hf_m_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable f_m MeasureTheory.volume :=
    hf_int.congr hf_ae_eq
  have hf_m_l3_eq : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f_m 3 MeasureTheory.volume = ENNReal.ofReal N := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_congr_ae hf_ae_eq.symm, hN_ofReal]

    change MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f_m 3 MeasureTheory.volume < ⊤
    rw [hf_m_l3_eq]

    have h_rpow := hf_m_memLp.integrable_norm_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

      ext v
      have h3 : (3 : ENNReal).toReal = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
      rw [h3, Real.rpow_natCast]
    rwa [h_eq_fn] at h_rpow
  have hf_m_cube_le : ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 ≤ N ^ 3 := by
    have h_eq_el3 := MeasureTheory.MemLp.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hf_m_memLp
    rw [hf_m_l3_eq] at h_eq_el3
    have h3 : (3 : ENNReal).toReal = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
    have h3_inv : (3 : ENNReal).toReal⁻¹ = (1 : ℝ) / 3 := by norm_num
    have h_int_eq : (∫ v, ‖f_m v‖ ^ (3 : ENNReal).toReal) = ∫ v, ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 := by

    rw [h_int_eq, h3_inv] at h_eq_el3
    have h_int_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 :=

      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hN_pos.le,

    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast _ 3, ← Real.rpow_mul h_int_nn] at h_pow3
    have hexp1 : ((1 : ℝ) / 3) * ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [hexp1, Real.rpow_one] at h_pow3
    exact h_pow3.le

  
  let a : ℤ → ℝ := fun k => N * (2 : ℝ) ^ k

  have ha_mono : ∀ {k₁ k₂ : ℤ}, k₁ ≤ k₂ → a k₁ ≤ a k₂ :=

  let F_lo : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) := K_in ∩ {v | ‖f_m v‖ ≤ a (-(K : ℤ))}

  have hF_hi_meas : MeasurableSet F_hi :=
    hK_in_meas.inter (hf_m_norm_meas measurableSet_Ioi)
  have hF_shell_meas : ∀ k : ℤ, MeasurableSet (F_shell k) :=
    fun k => hK_in_meas.inter ((hf_m_norm_meas measurableSet_Ioi).inter
      (hf_m_norm_meas measurableSet_Iic))
  have hF_shell_sub : ∀ k : ℤ, F_shell k ⊆ K_in := fun _ => Set.inter_subset_left
  let g_lo : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := Set.indicator F_lo f_m
  let g_hi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := Set.indicator F_hi f_m
  let g_unit : ℤ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
    fun k => (a (k + 1))⁻¹ • Set.indicator (F_shell k) f_m

    hf_m_int.indicator hF_lo_meas
  have hg_hi_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g_hi MeasureTheory.volume :=
    hf_m_int.indicator hF_hi_meas
  have hg_unit_int : ∀ k : ℤ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (g_unit k) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    fun k => (hf_m_int.indicator (hF_shell_meas k)).smul (a (k + 1))⁻¹
  have hg_unit_ind : ∀ (k : ℤ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

    intro k v
    dsimp only [g_unit, Pi.smul_apply]
    by_cases hv : v ∈ F_shell k
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hv, Set.indicator_of_mem hv, Pi.one_apply,
        norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (ha_pos (k + 1)).le)]
      have hv_le : ‖f_m v‖ ≤ a (k + 1) := hv.2.2
      exact (inv_mul_le_iff₀ (ha_pos (k + 1))).mpr (by linarith)
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv, Set.indicator_of_notMem hv, smul_zero, norm_zero]

  let S : Finset ℤ := Finset.Ico (-(K : ℤ)) (K : ℤ)
  have hf_m_part : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),

    intro v
    have h_smul_cancel : ∀ k : ℤ, a (k + 1) • g_unit k v = Set.indicator (F_shell k) f_m v :=

    simp_rw [h_smul_cancel]

        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hv_lo, Set.indicator_of_notMem hv_not_hi, h_sum_zero,

        · have hv_not_lo : v ∉ F_lo := fun h => hlo h.2
          have hv_hi : v ∈ F_hi := ⟨hvK, hhi⟩
          have h_sum_zero : ∑ k ∈ S, Set.indicator (F_shell k) f_m v = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k hk => ?_)
            refine Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => ?_) f_m
            rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
            exact not_lt_of_ge (h.2.2.trans (ha_mono (by omega : k + 1 ≤ (K : ℤ)))) hhi
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv_not_lo, Set.indicator_of_mem hv_hi, h_sum_zero,

        · have hv_not_lo : v ∉ F_lo := fun h => hlo h.2

          have hy_gt : a (-(K : ℤ)) < ‖f_m v‖ := lt_of_not_ge hlo

            refine Int.leInduction ?_ ?_
            · intro h_contra
              exact absurd h_contra (not_le_of_gt hy_gt)
            · intro n hn ih h_le_succ
              by_cases h_le_n : ‖f_m v‖ ≤ a n
              · obtain ⟨k, hk_mem, hk_bd⟩ := ih h_le_n
                rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk_mem
                exact ⟨k, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hk_mem.1, by omega⟩, hk_bd⟩
              · exact ⟨n, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hn, by omega⟩, lt_of_not_ge h_le_n, h_le_succ⟩

            · exact Set.indicator_of_mem hv_k₀ f_m
            · intro k _ hk_ne

              · exact not_lt_of_ge (h.2.2.trans (ha_mono (by omega : k + 1 ≤ k₀))) hk₀_gt

    · have hv_not_lo : v ∉ F_lo := fun h => hvK h.1
      have hv_not_hi : v ∉ F_hi := fun h => hvK h.1
      have h_sum_zero : ∑ k ∈ S, Set.indicator (F_shell k) f_m v = 0 :=
        Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ =>
          Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun (h : v ∈ F_shell k) => hvK h.1) f_m)
      have hfm0 : f_m v = 0 := Set.indicator_of_notMem hvK _
      rw [hfm0, Set.indicator_of_notMem hv_not_lo, Set.indicator_of_notMem hv_not_hi, h_sum_zero,
        add_zero, add_zero]

  
  have hg_lo_l1 : ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖g_lo v‖ ≤

    have h_ind_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable

          dsimp only [V_in, a]

          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_2negK hV_in_nn

    have haK_pos : 0 < a (K : ℤ) := ha_pos (K : ℤ)

      dsimp only [g_hi]
      by_cases hv : v ∈ F_hi

        have h_mul : (a (K : ℤ)) ^ 2 * ‖f_m v‖ ≤ ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 := by

            _ = ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 := by ring

      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv, norm_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg _)) (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) 3)
    have h_alg : ((a (K : ℤ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * N ^ 3 = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-2 * (K : ℤ)) * N := by

      have hN_ne : N ≠ 0 := hN_pos.ne'
      have h2K_ne : (2 : ℝ) ^ (K : ℤ) ≠ 0 := (zpow_pos (by norm_num) (K : ℤ)).ne'

      rw [hzpow]

      _ = ((a (K : ℤ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ v, ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 := MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul _ _
      _ ≤ ((a (K : ℤ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * N ^ 3 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf_m_cube_le (inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg _))
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-2 * (K : ℤ)) * N := h_alg
      _ ≤ lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_2neg2K hN_pos.le

  
  have hF_shell_lt_top : ∀ k : ℤ, MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k) < ⊤ :=
    fun k => lt_of_le_of_lt (MeasureTheory.measure_mono (hF_shell_sub k)) hK_in_lt_top
  have hF_disj : (S : Set ℤ).Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint F_shell) := by
    intro k₁ _ k₂ _ hk_ne
    rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left]
    intro v hv1 hv2
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk_ne with hlt | hgt
    · exact not_lt_of_ge (hv1.2.2.trans (ha_mono (by omega : k₁ + 1 ≤ k₂))) hv2.2.1
    · exact not_lt_of_ge (hv2.2.2.trans (ha_mono (by omega : k₂ + 1 ≤ k₁))) hv1.2.1
  have h_packing : ∑ k ∈ S, ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal ≤ 1 := by
    have h_each : ∀ k ∈ S,
        (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal * (a k) ^ 3 ≤
          ∫ v in F_shell k, ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 := by
      intro k _
      have hk_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k) ≠ ⊤ := (hF_shell_lt_top k).ne
      have h_const_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun _ => (a k) ^ 3) (F_shell k)
          MeasureTheory.volume := MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const (hs := hk_ne_top)
      calc (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal * (a k) ^ 3
