              rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, smul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ ∫ v in F_shell k, ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 :=
              MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on h_const_int hf_m_cube_int.integrableOn
                (hF_shell_meas k) (fun v hv => pow_le_pow_left₀ (ha_pos k).le hv.2.1.le 3)
    have h_sum_int : ∑ k ∈ S, (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal * (a k) ^ 3 ≤ N ^ 3 := by
      calc ∑ k ∈ S, (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal * (a k) ^ 3
          ≤ ∑ k ∈ S, ∫ v in F_shell k, ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each
        _ = ∫ v in ⋃ k ∈ S, F_shell k, ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 :=
            (MeasureTheory.integral_biUnion_finset S (fun k _ => hF_shell_meas k) hF_disj
              (fun k _ => hf_m_cube_int.integrableOn)).symm
        _ ≤ ∫ v, ‖f_m v‖ ^ 3 :=
            MeasureTheory.setIntegral_le_integral hf_m_cube_int
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) 3))
        _ ≤ N ^ 3 := hf_m_cube_le
    have h_factor : ∑ k ∈ S, (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal * (a k) ^ 3 =
        N ^ 3 * ∑ k ∈ S, ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [a]
      ring
    rw [h_factor] at h_sum_int
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (h_sum_int.trans_eq (mul_one (N ^ 3)).symm) (pow_pos hN_pos 3)

  have h_shell_sum :
      ∑ k ∈ S, (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) ≤
        2 * (2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) := by
    let w : ℤ → ℝ :=
      fun k => (2 : ℝ) ^ k * ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)
    have hw_nn : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 ≤ w k :=
      fun k => mul_nonneg (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num) k) (Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)
    have hpq : Real.HolderConjugate (3 / 2) 3 :=
      Real.holderConjugate_iff.mpr ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    have h_holder := Real.inner_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg S hpq
      (f := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (g := w) (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) (fun k _ => hw_nn k)
    have hS_card : (S.card : ℝ) = 2 * (K : ℝ) := by
      have hc : S.card = K + K := by
        dsimp only [S]
        rw [Int.card_Ico]
        omega
      rw [hc]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_lhs_eq : ∑ k ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) * w k = ∑ k ∈ S, w k :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => one_mul (w k))
    have h_p_term : (∑ _ ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (3 / 2 : ℝ)) =
        (2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) := by
      have h1 : ∑ _ ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = 2 * (K : ℝ) := by
        simp [Real.one_rpow, hS_card]
      have h2 : (1 : ℝ) / (3 / 2 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) / 3 := by norm_num
      rw [h1, h2]
    have h_q_sum : ∑ k ∈ S, w k ^ (3 : ℝ) =
        ∑ k ∈ S, ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [w]
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num) k) (Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _),
        ← Real.rpow_mul ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
      have h1 : ((1 : ℝ) / 3) * 3 = 1 := by norm_num
      have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (3 : ℝ) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (3 : ℕ) := by
        rw [show (3 : ℝ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
      rw [h1, Real.rpow_one, h2]
    have h_q_le_one : (∑ k ∈ S, w k ^ (3 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
      have h_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ S, w k ^ (3 : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hw_nn k) _)
      rw [h_q_sum] at h_nn ⊢
      calc (∑ k ∈ S, ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ))
          ≤ (1 : ℝ) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow h_nn h_packing (by norm_num)
        _ = 1 := Real.one_rpow _
    rw [h_lhs_eq, h_p_term] at h_holder
    have h_w_le : ∑ k ∈ S, w k ≤ (2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) := by
      calc ∑ k ∈ S, w k
          ≤ (2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) * (∑ k ∈ S, w k ^ (3 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) := h_holder
        _ ≤ (2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_q_le_one (by positivity)
        _ = (2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) := mul_one _
    have h_shift : ∑ k ∈ S,
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) =
        2 * ∑ k ∈ S, w k := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [w]
      rw [zpow_add_one₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) k]
      ring
    rw [h_shift]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_w_le (by norm_num)

  
  let E_lo := oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B g_lo
  let E_hi := oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B g_hi
  let E_k : ℤ → ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
    fun k => oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B (g_unit k)
  have h_op_decomp : oscIntegralOp2D lam Φ₀ B f =
      E_lo + E_hi + ∑ k ∈ S, a (k + 1) • E_k k := by
    ext cx
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
    let ker_cx : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
      fun v => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (cx.1, cx.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * B (cx.1, cx.2, v)
    have h_ae_ker : (fun v => ker_cx v * f v) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
        (fun v => ker_cx v * f_m v) := by
      filter_upwards [hf_ae_eq] with v hv
      rw [hv]
    change ∫ v, ker_cx v * f v = _
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae h_ae_ker]
    have h_expand : (fun v => ker_cx v * f_m v) =
        (fun v => ker_cx v * g_lo v +
          (ker_cx v * g_hi v + ∑ k ∈ S, a (k + 1) • (ker_cx v * g_unit k v))) := by
      ext v
      rw [hf_m_part v, mul_add, mul_add, add_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [mul_smul_comm]
    rw [h_expand]
    have h_lo_fib : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ker_cx v * g_lo v) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (h_L1_op g_lo hg_lo_int).2.1 cx
    have h_hi_fib : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ker_cx v * g_hi v) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (h_L1_op g_hi hg_hi_int).2.1 cx
    have h_k_fib : ∀ k : ℤ, MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun v => a (k + 1) • (ker_cx v * g_unit k v)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      fun k => ((h_L1_op (g_unit k) (hg_unit_int k)).2.1 cx).smul (a (k + 1))
    have h_sum_fib : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun v => ∑ k ∈ S, a (k + 1) • (ker_cx v * g_unit k v)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum S (fun k _ => h_k_fib k)
    have h_hi_sum_fib : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun v => ker_cx v * g_hi v + ∑ k ∈ S, a (k + 1) • (ker_cx v * g_unit k v))
        MeasureTheory.volume := h_hi_fib.add h_sum_fib
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add h_lo_fib h_hi_sum_fib,
      MeasureTheory.integral_add h_hi_fib h_sum_fib, ← add_assoc,
      MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum S (fun k _ => h_k_fib k)]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_smul (a (k + 1)) (fun v => ker_cx v * g_unit k v)

  have hp1 : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 3 := by norm_num
  have h_el3_lo : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm E_lo 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C_L1 * V_in * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N) := by
    refine ((h_L1_op g_lo hg_lo_int).2.2).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
    calc C_L1 * ∫ v, ‖g_lo v‖
        ≤ C_L1 * (V_in * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_lo_l1 hC_L1_nn
      _ = C_L1 * V_in * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N := by ring
  have h_el3_hi : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm E_hi 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C_L1 * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N) := by
    refine ((h_L1_op g_hi hg_hi_int).2.2).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
    calc C_L1 * ∫ v, ‖g_hi v‖
        ≤ C_L1 * (lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_hi_l1 hC_L1_nn
      _ = C_L1 * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N := by ring
  have h_el3_shells : ∑ k ∈ S, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (a (k + 1) • E_k k) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C_sub * M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N) := by
    have h_term : ∀ k ∈ S,
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (a (k + 1) • E_k k) 3 MeasureTheory.volume ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) * N *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3))) := by
      intro k _
      rw [MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_const_smul, Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (ha_pos (k + 1)).le]
      have h_sub_k := h_sub hlam_Λ (F_shell k) (hF_shell_meas k) (hF_shell_sub k)
        (g_unit k) (hg_unit_int k).aestronglyMeasurable (hg_unit_ind k)
      have h_vol_eq : (MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) =
          ENNReal.ofReal (((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (by norm_num),
          ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (hF_shell_lt_top k).ne]
      rw [h_vol_eq, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg hC_sub (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _))] at h_sub_k
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (a (k + 1)) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (E_k k) 3 MeasureTheory.volume
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (a (k + 1)) *
              ENNReal.ofReal (C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) *
                ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sub_k zero_le
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) * N *
              ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3))) := by
            rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (ha_pos (k + 1)).le]
            congr 1
            dsimp only [a]
            ring
    have h_term_nn : ∀ k ∈ S, 0 ≤ C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) * N *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) :=
      fun k _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC_sub (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)) hN_pos.le)
        (mul_nonneg (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _) (Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _))
    calc ∑ k ∈ S, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (a (k + 1) • E_k k) 3 MeasureTheory.volume
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ S, ENNReal.ofReal (C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) * N *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3))) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_term
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ k ∈ S, C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) * N *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3))) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg h_term_nn).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C_sub * M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N) := by
          apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          calc (C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) * N) *
                ∑ k ∈ S, (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) *
                  ((MeasureTheory.volume (F_shell k)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)
              ≤ (C_sub * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2) * N) * (2 * (2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_shell_sum
                  (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC_sub (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)) hN_pos.le)
            _ = (2 * C_sub * N) * ((2 * (K : ℝ)) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) * lam ^ (-1 + ν / 2)) := by ring
            _ ≤ (2 * C_sub * N) * (M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log_shell
                  (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_sub) hN_pos.le)
            _ = 2 * C_sub * M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N := by ring

  rw [h_op_decomp]
  have h_tri1 := MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_add_le (p := 3) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
    (f := E_lo + E_hi) (g := ∑ k ∈ S, a (k + 1) • E_k k) hp1
  have h_tri2 := MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_add_le (p := 3) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
    (f := E_lo) (g := E_hi) hp1
  have h_tri3 := MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_sum_le (p := 3) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
    (s := S) (f := fun k => a (k + 1) • E_k k) hp1
  have h_nn1 : 0 ≤ C_L1 * V_in * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC_L1_nn hV_in_nn) (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)) hN_pos.le
  have h_nn2 : 0 ≤ C_L1 * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC_L1_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)) hN_pos.le
  have h_nn3 : 0 ≤ 2 * C_sub * M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_sub) hM_ν_nn)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)) hN_pos.le
  calc MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (E_lo + E_hi + ∑ k ∈ S, a (k + 1) • E_k k) 3 MeasureTheory.volume
      ≤ (MeasureTheory.eLpNorm E_lo 3 MeasureTheory.volume +
          MeasureTheory.eLpNorm E_hi 3 MeasureTheory.volume) +
          ∑ k ∈ S, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (a (k + 1) • E_k k) 3 MeasureTheory.volume :=
        h_tri1.trans (add_le_add h_tri2 h_tri3)
    _ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (C_L1 * V_in * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N) +
          ENNReal.ofReal (C_L1 * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N)) +
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C_sub * M_ν * lam ^ (-1 + ν) * N) :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add h_el3_lo h_el3_hi) h_el3_shells
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (((C_L1 * (V_in + 1) + 2 * C_sub * M_ν) * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) * N) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add h_nn1 h_nn2, ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (add_nonneg h_nn1 h_nn2) h_nn3]
        congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((C_osc * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) * N) := by
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hN_pos.le
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (C_osc * lam ^ (-1 + ν)) * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 3 MeasureTheory.volume := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg hC_osc_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg hlam_nn _)), hN_ofReal]

    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) :
    ∃ C_root : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_root ∧
      ∀ (lam : ℝ), 2 ≤ lam →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

      ∀ (F : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))),

        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
        (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ≤ Set.indicator F 1 v) →
        0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2 →
        lam ^ (rootPacketScore lam R_dom γ Φ₀ f) ≤
          C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨C_pair, hC_pair_ge, h_gram⟩ := canonical_root_gram_decay a₀ a₁ A ha₀ ha₁ hA
  let C_Bes : ℝ := 1447209 * C_pair
  have hC_Bes_pos : 0 < C_Bes := by dsimp [C_Bes]; linarith
  let C_cap : ℝ := 48400 * C_Bes
  have hC_cap_pos : 0 < C_cap := by dsimp [C_cap]; linarith
  let C_ap : ℝ := C_Bes * C_cap ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)
  let V_dom : ℝ :=
    (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) R_dom)).toReal
  have hV_dom_nn : 0 ≤ V_dom := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  let C_norm : ℝ := V_dom ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)
  let C_root : ℝ := max 1 (max C_ap C_norm)
  have hC_root_ge : 1 ≤ C_root := le_max_left _ _
  have hC_root_pos : 0 < C_root := by linarith
  have hC_ap_le : C_ap ≤ C_root := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hC_norm_le : C_norm ≤ C_root := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨C_root, hC_root_ge, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase F hF_meas hF_sub f hf_meas hf_ind hf_pos
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by linarith
  have hlam_gt_one : 1 < lam := by linarith
  have hlam_ge_one : 1 ≤ lam := by linarith
  have hlog_pos : 0 < Real.log lam := Real.log_pos hlam_gt_one
  have hball_lt_top :
      MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) R_dom) < ⊤ :=
    MeasureTheory.measure_closedBall_lt_top
  have hF_le_ball :
      MeasureTheory.volume F ≤
        MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) R_dom) :=
    MeasureTheory.measure_mono hF_sub
  have hF_lt_top : MeasureTheory.volume F < ⊤ := lt_of_le_of_lt hF_le_ball hball_lt_top
  have hF_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume F ≠ ⊤ := hF_lt_top.ne
  have hF_le_Vdom : (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal ≤ V_dom :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono hball_lt_top.ne hF_le_ball
  have hf_le_one : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro v
    have h1 := hf_ind v
    by_cases hv : v ∈ F
    · rwa [Set.indicator_of_mem hv, Pi.one_apply] at h1
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv] at h1
      linarith
  have hf_sq_le_ind : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖f v‖ ^ 2 ≤ Set.indicator F (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ) v := by
    intro v
    by_cases hv : v ∈ F
    · have h1 := hf_ind v
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hv, Pi.one_apply] at h1 ⊢
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (f v)]
    · have h1 := hf_ind v
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv] at h1 ⊢

    intro v

    exact hf_sq_le_ind v

      (Set.indicator F (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    MeasureTheory.memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp
      (MeasureTheory.memLp_indicator_const 1 hF_meas (1 : ℝ) (Or.inr hF_ne_top))
  have hf_sq_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖f v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    h_ind_int.mono' (hf_meas.norm.pow 2) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hf_sq_norm_le_ind)
  have h_ind_integral : ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      Set.indicator F (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ) v = (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one hF_meas, MeasureTheory.Measure.real_def]
  have hI₂_le_F :
      (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ≤ (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal := by
    rw [← h_ind_integral]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_mono hf_sq_int h_ind_int hf_sq_le_ind
  have hF_pos : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal := lt_of_lt_of_le hf_pos hI₂_le_F
  have hCF_pos : 0 < C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal := mul_pos hC_root_pos hF_pos
  let B_target : ℝ := Real.log (C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal) / Real.log lam
  have h_score_le : rootPacketScore lam R_dom γ Φ₀ f ≤ B_target := by
    unfold rootPacketScore
    dsimp only []
    refine csSup_le ?_ ?_
    · exact ⟨_, Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_singleton _)⟩
    · intro s hs_mem
      rcases hs_mem with hs_norm | hs_ap
      · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hs_norm
        rw [hs_norm]
        set I₂ : ℝ := ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2
        have hI₂_le_Vdom : I₂ ≤ V_dom := le_trans hI₂_le_F hF_le_Vdom
        have hI₂_half_le : I₂ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ C_norm :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow hf_pos.le hI₂_le_Vdom (by norm_num)
        have hI₂_32_eq : I₂ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) = I₂ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * I₂ := by
          have hexp : ((3 : ℝ) / 2) = (1 : ℝ) / 2 + 1 := by ring
          rw [hexp, Real.rpow_add hf_pos, Real.rpow_one]
        have hI₂_32_le : I₂ ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal := by
          rw [hI₂_32_eq]
          calc I₂ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * I₂
              ≤ C_norm * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal :=
                mul_le_mul hI₂_half_le hI₂_le_F hf_pos.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hV_dom_nn _)
            _ ≤ C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_norm_le hF_pos.le
        have h_log_le : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log I₂ ≤
            Real.log (C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal) := by
          rw [← Real.log_rpow hf_pos ((3 : ℝ) / 2)]
          exact Real.log_le_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hf_pos _) hI₂_32_le
        calc (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log I₂ / Real.log lam)
            = ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log I₂) / Real.log lam := (mul_div_assoc _ _ _).symm
          _ ≤ Real.log (C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal) / Real.log lam :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_log_le hlog_pos.le
      · rcases hs_ap with ⟨N_D, b, a, e_dir, V_c, X_c, p,
            h_geom, hp_nn, _hp_out, hp_sum, hp_compat, hs_eq⟩

        have hΦ₀_cont : Continuous Φ₀ := (h_phase.1 0).continuous
        have h_gram_pair := h_gram lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase
        obtain ⟨hm_nn_all, hm_O₀_le⟩ :=
          canonical_root_bessel_of_gram_decay lam C_pair hlam hC_pair_ge Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont O₀

            f hf_meas hf_sq_int
        have hm_tot : ∑ o ∈ O₀, m o ≤ M_tot := by
          calc ∑ o ∈ O₀, m o
              ≤ C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2 := hm_O₀_le
            _ ≤ C_Bes * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI₂_le_F hC_Bes_pos.le
        have hp_cap : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
            ∃ S_d : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
              S_d ⊆ O₀ ∧
              (∀ o ∈ O₀, 0 < p o d → o ∈ S_d) ∧
              ∑ o ∈ S_d, m o ≤ C_cap * lam ^ (-(a d + b d)) := by
          intro d
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          let S_d := O₀.filter (fun o => 0 < p o d)
          refine ⟨S_d, Finset.filter_subset _ _,
            fun o ho hpod => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ho, hpod⟩, ?_⟩
          obtain ⟨hbd_nn, hba_d, had_half, he_norm⟩ := h_geom d
          obtain ⟨f_Ud, hf_Ud_meas, hf_Ud_sq, hf_Ud_int_le, hf_Ud_mass_eq⟩ :=
            rotated_aperture_cap_localization lam (b d) (a d) hlam hbd_nn hba_d had_half
              (e_dir d) (V_c d) he_norm Φ₀ f hf_meas hf_le_one
          obtain ⟨_, hm_Sd_Ud_le⟩ :=
            canonical_root_bessel_of_gram_decay lam C_pair hlam hC_pair_ge Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont S_d
              (fun ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ o₁ _ o₂ _ => h_gram_pair ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ o₁ o₂)
              f_Ud hf_Ud_meas hf_Ud_sq
          have h_sum_eq : ∑ o ∈ S_d, m o = ∑ o ∈ S_d, canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ f_Ud o := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o ho => ?_)
            obtain ⟨ho_O₀, hpod⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho
            have h_comp := hp_compat o ho_O₀ d hpod
            exact hf_Ud_mass_eq o h_comp.2.1 h_comp.2.2.1
          calc ∑ o ∈ S_d, m o
              = ∑ o ∈ S_d, canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ f_Ud o := h_sum_eq
            _ ≤ C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f_Ud v‖ ^ 2 := hm_Sd_Ud_le

                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf_Ud_int_le hC_Bes_pos.le
            _ = C_cap * lam ^ (-(a d + b d)) := by dsimp [C_cap]; ring
        have hs_shannon :=
          shannon_aperture_score_bound lam γ M_tot C_cap s
            hlam hγ₀ hM_tot_pos hC_cap_pos O₀ m (fun o _ => hm_nn_all o) hm_tot
            N_D b a (fun d => (h_geom d).2.1) p hp_nn hp_sum
            (fun o ho d hpod => (hp_compat o ho d hpod).1) hp_cap hs_eq
        have h_prod_le : M_tot * C_cap ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ≤
            C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal := by
          have h_eq : M_tot * C_cap ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) =

            ring

        have h_log_ap_le : Real.log (M_tot * C_cap ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ≤
            Real.log (C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal) :=
          Real.log_le_log (mul_pos hM_tot_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hC_cap_pos _)) h_prod_le

      ≤ lam ^ B_target := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hlam_ge_one h_score_le
    _ = C_root * (MeasureTheory.volume F).toReal := by

noncomputable def canonicalRootAtom (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  let V := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1
  let X := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2
  (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V))) *
    Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A) :
    ∃ C_pair : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_pair ∧
      ∀ (lam : ℝ), 2 ≤ lam →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (ψ₁ ψ₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₁ →
        IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₂ →
      ∀ (o₁ o₂ : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
        (200 ≤ ‖gridPt2D 1 (o₁.1.1 - o₂.1.1, o₁.1.2 - o₂.1.2)‖ →
          ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₁ o₁ v *
              star (canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₂ o₂ v) = 0) ∧
        ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₁ o₁ v *
            star (canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₂ o₂ v)‖ ≤
          C_pair / (1 + ‖gridPt2D 1 (o₁.2.1 - o₂.2.1, o₁.2.2 - o₂.2.2)‖) ^ 4

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(lam b a : ℝ)
    (hlam : 2 ≤ lam) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) (ha : a ≤ 1 / 2)
    (e V_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (hf_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hf_le_one : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ f_U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f_U MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖f_U v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f_U v‖ ^ 2) ≤ 48400 * lam ^ (-(a + b)) ∧
      ∀ o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
        |inner ℝ (gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹ o.1 - V_c) e| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-b) →
        |inner ℝ (gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹ o.1 - V_c) (perp2D e)| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-a) →
        canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ f o = canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ f_U o

subgoal_signatures.name: shannon_aperture_score_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(lam γ M_tot C_cap s : ℝ)
    (hlam : 2 ≤ lam) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hM_tot : 0 < M_tot) (hC_cap : 0 < C_cap)
    (O₀ : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
    (m : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ℝ)
    (hm_nn : ∀ o ∈ O₀, 0 ≤ m o)
    (hm_tot : ∑ o ∈ O₀, m o ≤ M_tot)
    (N_D : ℕ)
    (b a : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (hba : ∀ d : Fin N_D, b d ≤ a d)
    (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (hp_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d)
    (hp_sum : ∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1)
    (hp_pos_m : ∀ o ∈ O₀, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d → 0 < m o)
    (hp_cap : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
      ∃ S_d : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
        S_d ⊆ O₀ ∧
        (∀ o ∈ O₀, 0 < p o d → o ∈ S_d) ∧
        ∑ o ∈ S_d, m o ≤ C_cap * lam ^ (-(a d + b d)))
    (hs :
      let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
      let p_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d
      let H_O := (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / Real.log lam
      let H_O_D := (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / Real.log lam
      let E_mass := (∑ o ∈ O₀, p_O o * Real.log (m o)) / Real.log lam
      let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b d + (1 - γ) * a d)
      s = H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w) :
    s ≤ Real.log (M_tot * C_cap ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) / Real.log lam

    let τ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.smoothTransition (2 * s + 1 / 2)

    let proj1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=

        (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ)).toContinuousLinearMap
    let χ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun z => η₁ (z 0) * η₁ (z 1)
    have hτ_zero : ∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ -1 / 4 → τ s = 0 := by
      intro s hs
      exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
    have hτ_one : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 / 4 ≤ s → τ s = 1 := by
      intro s hs
      exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
    have hη_supp : ∀ t : ℝ, 3 / 4 ≤ |t| → η₁ t = 0 := by
      intro t ht
      rcases le_abs.mp ht with h | h
      · dsimp [η₁]
        rw [hτ_one (t + 1 / 2) (by linarith), hτ_one (t - 1 / 2) (by linarith), sub_self]
      · dsimp [η₁]
        rw [hτ_zero (t + 1 / 2) (by linarith), hτ_zero (t - 1 / 2) (by linarith), sub_self]
    have hτ_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k τ := fun k =>
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := k)).comp
        ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).add contDiff_const)
    have hη_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k η₁ := fun k =>
      ((hτ_smooth k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).sub
        ((hτ_smooth k).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))
    have hχ_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k χ₀ := by
      intro k
      have hχ_eq : χ₀ = fun z => η₁ (proj0 z) * η₁ (proj1 z) := rfl
      rw [hχ_eq]
      exact ((hη_smooth k).comp proj0.contDiff).mul ((hη_smooth k).comp proj1.contDiff)

    have hχ_supp_54 : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 5 / 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → χ₀ z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      by_cases h0 : 3 / 4 ≤ |z 0|
      · dsimp [χ₀]
        rw [hη_supp (z 0) h0, zero_mul]
      · have h1 : 3 / 4 ≤ |z 1| := by

          push_neg at h0 h1
          have hsq0 : (z 0) ^ 2 < 9 / 16 := by nlinarith [abs_lt.mp h0]
          have hsq1 : (z 1) ^ 2 < 9 / 16 := by nlinarith [abs_lt.mp h1]
          have hnorm_sq : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = (z 0) ^ 2 + (z 1) ^ 2 := by
            rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _),

            simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

    have hχ_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 3 / 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → χ₀ z = 0 :=

    intro R_v' R_dom' _hRv' _hR_dom' hRv_dom' v hv

        · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩

    rw [Finset.sum_product]
    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have hN_eq : (⌈R_dom'⌉₊ + 1 : ℤ) = (N : ℤ) := by dsimp [N]
    rw [hN_eq, h1d (v 0) hv0, h1d (v 1) hv1, mul_one]
  have h_s2 : ∀ (M_χ : ℕ → ℝ),
      ∃ M_ψ : ℕ → ℝ,
        (∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ M_ψ k) ∧
        ∀ (lam : ℝ), 1 ≤ lam →

        ∀ (c₁ C₀ : ℝ) (x₁ X₀ V₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (endpointPhaseWindow lam Φ₀ χ₀ B c₁ C₀ x₁ X₀ V₀) z‖ ≤ M_ψ k) := by
    intro M_χ
    have h_param_fderiv : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W]
        (K : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → W),
        ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) K →
        ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, K (τ, y)) z =
            ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ (fun y => K (τ, y)) z := by
      intro W _ _ K hK z
      have hK_diff : Differentiable ℝ K := (contDiff_infty.mp hK 1).differentiable (by norm_num)
      have hK_cont : Continuous K := (contDiff_infty.mp hK 0).continuous
      let F' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] W) :=
        fun y τ => (fderiv ℝ K (τ, y)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
      have h_has : ∀ (τ : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          HasFDerivAt (fun y' => K (τ, y')) (F' y τ) y := by
        intro τ y
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt K (fderiv ℝ K (τ, y)) (τ, y) := (hK_diff (τ, y)).hasFDerivAt
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (τ, y'))

        exact h1.comp y h2
      have hF'_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => F' p.2 p.1) := by
        have hfderiv_cont : Continuous (fderiv ℝ K) :=

        exact hfderiv_cont.clm_comp continuous_const
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ((isCompact_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := (1 : ℝ))).prod
        (isCompact_closedBall z 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hF'_cont.continuousOn
      have h_int_fderiv := intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
        (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := 0) (b := 1)
        (s := Metric.closedBall z 1) (bound := fun _ => C)
        (F := fun y τ => K (τ, y)) (F' := F') (x₀ := z)
        (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds z zero_lt_one)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y =>
          (hK_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable)
        ((hK_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
        ((hF'_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ hτ y hy => by
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hτ

        intervalIntegrable_const
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ _ y _ => h_has τ y)
      rw [h_int_fderiv.fderiv]
      congr 1
      funext τ
      exact ((h_has τ z).fderiv).symm
    have h_param_iterated : ∀ (j : ℕ)
        (K : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) K →
        ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, K (τ, y)) z =
            ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => K (τ, y)) z := by
      intro j
      induction' j with j ih
      · intro K hK z
        have hK_cont : Continuous K := (contDiff_infty.mp hK 0).continuous
        let L₀ := (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ
          (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        have h_int0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => K (τ, z)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
          (hK_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
        change L₀ (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, K (τ, z)) = _
        rw [← L₀.intervalIntegral_comp_comm h_int0]
        congr 1
      · intro K hK z
        have : CompleteSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ]
            ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (j + 1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))).toIsometryEquiv.completeSpace_iff.mp inferInstance
        let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ]
            ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

        let compL := ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL
          (𝕜 := ℝ) (F := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (fun _ : Fin j => inrE)
        let K_j : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →

          fun p => iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun y => K (p.1, y)) p.2
        have hKj_eq : K_j = fun p => compL (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j K p) := by

          have h_fn : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => K (p.1, y)) =

          rw [h_fn, inrE.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_cd p.2 (by exact_mod_cast le_top),

          have hp_eq : (p.1, (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) + inrE p.2 = p := by

        let L_curry := (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ

        simp only [Function.comp_apply]

        rw [← L_curry.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hF'_int]
        congr 1
    let M_χp : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => max (M_χ i) 0
    let M_Bp : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => max (M_B i) 0
    let M_G : ℕ → ℝ := fun j =>
      (R_dom + 3) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * (A ^ (i + 1) * (i.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)
    let D_exp : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, M_G j
    let M_exp : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (m.factorial : ℝ) * (D_exp m) ^ m
    let M_12 : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * M_χp i * M_Bp (n - i)
    let M_ψ : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose m : ℝ) * M_12 m * M_exp (k - m)
    have hMG_nn : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ M_G j := fun j =>
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by positivity)
    have hD_ge_one : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ D_exp m := fun m =>
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hMG_nn j)
    have hMexp_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ M_exp m := fun m =>
      mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one (hD_ge_one m)) m)
    have hM12_nn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ M_12 n := fun n =>

      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_each, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      by_cases hv : ‖v‖ ≤ R_v
      · have hsum1 := hχ_sum R_v R_dom hRv hR_dom hRv_dom v hv
        have hsumC : (∑ j ∈ J_V, (χ₀ (v - gridPt2D 1 j) : ℂ)) = 1 := by
          rw [← Complex.ofReal_sum]
          dsimp [J_V]
          rw [hsum1, Complex.ofReal_one]
        rw [hsumC, one_mul]
      · push_neg at hv
        have hB0 : B (c₁, x₁, v) = 0 := hB_supp c₁ x₁ v (Or.inr (Or.inr hv.le))
        simp [hB0]
    have h_term_int : ∀ j ∈ J_V, MeasureTheory.Integrable (term j) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro j _
      refine (hf_int.norm.const_mul (M_ψ 0)).mono' ?_ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v => ?_)
      · have hψ_c : Continuous (fun v => ψ_end (r, j, k) (v - gridPt2D 1 j)) :=
          (((hψ_props (r, j, k)).1 0).continuous).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
        have hexp_c : Continuous (fun v =>
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (C_r, X_k, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :=
          Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
            (continuous_const.mul ((h_phase.1 0).continuous.comp
              (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))))))
        exact (hf_int.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hψ_c.aestronglyMeasurable).mul hexp_c.aestronglyMeasurable
      · dsimp [term]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        have hexp1 : ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (C_r, X_k, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ = 1 := by
          rw [mul_comm Complex.I, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
        have hψ_le : ‖ψ_end (r, j, k) (v - gridPt2D 1 j)‖ ≤ M_ψ 0 := by
          rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero (𝕜 := ℝ)]
          exact (hψ_props (r, j, k)).2.2 0 (v - gridPt2D 1 j)
        rw [hexp1, mul_one, mul_comm ‖f v‖]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hψ_le (norm_nonneg _)
    have hF_eq : F_op (cx_max r k) = ∑ j ∈ J_V, ∫ v, term j v := by
      change (∫ v, Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (c₁, x₁, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * B (c₁, x₁, v) * f v) = _
      simp_rw [h_pt_sum]
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum J_V h_term_int
    let a : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ := fun j => ‖∫ v, term j v‖
    have hF_norm_le : ‖F_op (cx_max r k)‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ J_V, a j := by
      rw [hF_eq]
      exact norm_sum_le J_V (fun j => ∫ v, term j v)
    have hF_cube_le : ‖F_op (cx_max r k)‖ ^ 3 ≤ (N_patch : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ j ∈ J_V, (a j) ^ 3 :=
      le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hF_norm_le 3)
        (h_cubic_sum a (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _))
    refine le_trans hF_cube_le ?_
    dsimp [b]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_) (sq_nonneg _)
    have ha_mass : (a j) ^ 3 = (endpointPacketMass lam Φ₀ ψ_end f (r, j, k)) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) := by
      unfold endpointPacketMass
      dsimp [a, term, C_r, X_k, Δ_c, m_lam]
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast _ 2, ← Real.rpow_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
      have hexp : ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (3 / 2) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
      rw [hexp, Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [ha_mass]
  have h_red := h_l3_red S (fun i => endpointOutputBox lam i.1 i.2) b
    (fun i hi => (h_box_geom i.1 (Finset.mem_product.mp hi).1 i.2).2.2.1)
    (fun i hi => (h_box_geom i.1 (Finset.mem_product.mp hi).1 i.2).2.2.2.1)
    (fun c x hc hx => by
      obtain ⟨r, hr, k, hk, hmem⟩ := h_box_cov c x hc hx
      exact ⟨(r, k), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hr, hk⟩, hmem⟩)
    hb_nn hb_sup
  refine le_trans h_red (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
  let S_end : ℝ := ∑ o ∈ endpointSiteFinset lam R_dom,
    (endpointPacketMass lam Φ₀ ψ_end f o) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2)
  have hS_nn : 0 ≤ S_end := by
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun o _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ?_ _
    unfold endpointPacketMass
    exact sq_nonneg _
  have h_bij : ∑ i ∈ S, b i = (N_patch : ℝ) ^ 2 * S_end := by
    dsimp [b, S_end]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_product']
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_bij (fun p _ => (p.1.1, p.2, p.1.2)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_product] at hp
      exact h_site_mem p.1.1 hp.1.1 p.2 hp.2 p.1.2 hp.1.2
    · intro p₁ _ p₂ _ h
      rcases p₁ with ⟨⟨r₁, k₁⟩, j₁⟩
      rcases p₂ with ⟨⟨r₂, k₂⟩, j₂⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
      rfl
    · intro o ho
      have ho' := (@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun a => Classical.propDecidable _) _ o).mp ho
      rcases Finset.mem_product.mp ho'.1 with ⟨hr, hbox⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_product.mp hbox with ⟨hboxV, hboxX⟩
      refine ⟨((o.1, o.2.2), o.2.1), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_product]
        refine ⟨⟨hr, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · exact (@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun a => Classical.propDecidable _) _ o.2.2).mpr ⟨hboxX, ho'.2.2⟩
        · exact (@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun a => Classical.propDecidable _) _ o.2.1).mpr ⟨hboxV, ho'.2.1⟩
      · rcases o with ⟨r, j, k⟩
        rfl
    · intro _ _
      rfl
  rw [h_bij, Real.mul_rpow (sq_nonneg _) hS_nn]
  exact le_of_eq (by dsimp [C_box, S_end]; ring)

noncomputable def endpointVelFinset (R_dom : ℝ) : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=

noncomputable def endpointPosFinset (lam R_dom : ℝ) : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let B_X : ℤ := ⌈lam * R_dom⌉₊ + 1
  ((Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X)).filter

noncomputable def endpointPhaseWindow (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (χ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (B : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (c₁ C₀ : ℝ) (x₁ X₀ V₀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  (χ₀ z : ℂ) * B (c₁, x₁, V₀ + z) *
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * (Φ₀ (c₁, x₁, V₀ + z) - Φ₀ (C₀, X₀, V₀ + z)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

noncomputable def endpointOutputBox (lam : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (k : ℤ × ℤ) :
    Set (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
  let m_lam : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 ⌈lam⌉₊
  let Δ_c : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_lam)⁻¹
  let X_k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D lam⁻¹ k
  Set.Icc ((r : ℝ) * Δ_c) (((r : ℝ) + 1) * Δ_c) ×ˢ
    { x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) |
      |x 0 - X_k 0| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam⁻¹ ∧
      |x 1 - X_k 1| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam⁻¹ }

(a₀ a₁ A R_dom : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hR : 1 ≤ R_dom)

    ∃ (Λ₀ C_pkt : ℝ), 2 ≤ Λ₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C_pkt ∧
      ∀ (lam : ℝ), Λ₀ ≤ lam →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

      ∀ (ψ_end : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ o, ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_end o)) →
        (∀ o, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_end o z = 0) →
        (∀ o, ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_end o) z‖ ≤ M_ψ k) →
      ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →

        MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →

          (endpointPacketMass lam Φ₀ ψ_end f o) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) ≤
          C_pkt * lam ^ (rootPacketScore lam R_dom γ Φ₀ f + γ / 2 + η)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_one : (1 : ℝ) ∈ ValidPacketGrowthRates γ :=
    preliminary_packet_growth_le_one γ hγ₀ hγ₁
  have h_cl : ClassicalLineGrowthBound γ :=
    classical_positive_transport_growth γ hγ₀ hγ₁
  have h_rate : quantumPacketRate γ ≤ γ / 2 := by
    by_contra h_not
    have h_gt : γ / 2 < quantumPacketRate γ := lt_of_not_ge h_not
    let c_gain : ℝ := 4 * quantumPacketRate γ - 2 * γ
    have hc_pos : 0 < c_gain := by
      dsimp [c_gain]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 / c_gain)
    let q : ℕ := q₀ + 1
    have hq : 1 ≤ q := Nat.le_add_left 1 q₀
    have hq_lt : (q₀ : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [q]
      push_cast
      linarith
    have hq_div : 2 / c_gain < (q : ℝ) := lt_trans hq₀ hq_lt
    have hq_gain : 2 < (q : ℝ) * c_gain := (div_lt_iff₀ hc_pos).mp hq_div
    let ε_err : ℝ := ((q : ℝ) * c_gain - 2) / (2 * ((q : ℝ) + 1))
    have hq_pos : 0 < 2 * ((q : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε_err := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hq_gain) hq_pos
    obtain ⟨h, k, hh_pos, hk0, hk_step, hk_cap⟩ :=
      quantum_packet_credit_chain_bound γ hγ₀ hγ₁ h_cl h_one h_gt q hq ε_err hε_pos
    have hk_ind : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ hm : m ≤ q,
        (m : ℝ) * (c_gain - ε_err) * h ≤ k ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩ := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro hm
        have h0 : (⟨0, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩ : Fin (q + 1)) = 0 := by
          ext
          simp
        rw [h0, hk0]
        simp
      | succ m ih =>
        intro hm1
        have hm : m ≤ q := Nat.le_of_succ_le hm1
        let i : Fin q := ⟨m, hm1⟩
        have h_cast : i.castSucc = ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩ := by
          ext
          simp [i]
        have h_succ : i.succ = ⟨m + 1, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm1⟩ := by
          ext
          simp [i]
        have h_step := hk_step i
        rw [h_cast, h_succ] at h_step
        have h_ih := ih hm
        have h_alg : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (c_gain - ε_err) * h =
            (m : ℝ) * (c_gain - ε_err) * h + (c_gain - ε_err) * h := by
          push_cast
          ring
        linarith [h_ih, h_step, h_alg]
    have hk_q := hk_ind q (le_refl q)
    have h_last : (⟨q, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (le_refl q)⟩ : Fin (q + 1)) = Fin.last q := by
      ext
      simp
    rw [h_last] at hk_q
    have h_comb : (q : ℝ) * (c_gain - ε_err) * h ≤ (2 + ε_err) * h :=
      le_trans hk_q hk_cap
    have h_div_h : (q : ℝ) * (c_gain - ε_err) ≤ 2 + ε_err :=
      le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_comb hh_pos
    have h_err_eq : ((q : ℝ) + 1) * ε_err = ((q : ℝ) * c_gain - 2) / 2 := by
      dsimp [ε_err]
      have hq1_ne : ((q : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hq1_ne]
    linarith
  have h_ne : (ValidPacketGrowthRates γ).Nonempty := ⟨1, h_one⟩
  have h_inf_lt : sInf (ValidPacketGrowthRates γ) < γ / 2 + η / 2 := by
    change quantumPacketRate γ < γ / 2 + η / 2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀_mem, hb₀_lt⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt h_ne h_inf_lt
  obtain ⟨Λ₀, C_pkt, hΛ₀, hC_pkt, h_end⟩ :=
    endpoint_gibbs_score_reduction a₀ a₁ A R_dom ha₀ ha₁ hA hR M_ψ γ hγ₀ hγ₁
      b₀ (η / 2) hb₀_mem (half_pos hη)
  refine ⟨Λ₀, C_pkt, hΛ₀, hC_pkt, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase ψ_end hψ_smooth hψ_supp hψ_deriv f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2 hf_pos
  have h_est := h_end lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase ψ_end hψ_smooth hψ_supp hψ_deriv
    f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2 hf_pos
  refine le_trans h_est ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hC_pkt
  have hlam_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ lam := by linarith
  refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hlam_ge_one ?_
  linarith

noncomputable def classicalRootSupremum (ε L γ : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  sSup { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
      (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ L ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) ∧
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
      (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
       let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
         q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
       let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
       s = E_w - I_TD) }

noncomputable def classicalTransportScore (ε γ : ℝ) (N_ω N_T N_G : ℕ)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ) (G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G)
    (b_G a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let p_TG : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun tid g =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let S_cells : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image k_time
  let p_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then π ω else 0
  let E_w := ∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g)
  let I_TG := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
    p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell
  let S_t := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
    -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) / ell
  E_w - I_TG + 2 * S_t

def ClassicalLineGrowthBound (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (B_cl K_hor t_min δ_cl : ℝ),
    1 ≤ B_cl → 1 ≤ K_hor → 0 < t_min → t_min ≤ K_hor → 0 < δ_cl →
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε t L Δ_time : ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε₀ → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → L ≤ K_hor →
        B_cl⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ Δ_time → Δ_time ≤ B_cl * ε ^ t →
      ∀ (N_ω N_T N_G : ℕ)
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ)
        (G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (b_G a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ)
        (e_G V_G X_G : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (k_G : Fin N_G → ℤ),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl) →
        (∀ g, 0 ≤ b_G g ∧ b_G g ≤ a_G g ∧ a_G g + t ≤ L ∧ ‖e_G g‖ = 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
          let tid := T_idx ω
          let g := G_idx ω
          let c_mid := ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time
          c_mid ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
          k_G g = k_time ω ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧

def IsAdmissiblePacketLaw (ε H_P L t B_sys R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (N_O N_D : ℕ)
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
    (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
    (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
  let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ B_sys) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
      r_O o = r ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧
    a_D d ≤ min (L - t) ((H_P - t) / 2) ∧ r_D d < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
  (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) ∧
  (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
    0 < generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ∧
    r_O o = r_D d ∧
    |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
    |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
    |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d + t) ∧
    |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d + t))

def ValidPacketGrowthRates (γ : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  { b : ℝ | 0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
    ∀ (a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys K_hor R_win t_min δ : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A → 1 ≤ R_dom → 2 ≤ B_sys →
      1 ≤ K_hor → 2 ≤ R_win → 0 < t_min → t_min ≤ K_hor → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ N_mult →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
          0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
          t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor → L ≤ K_hor →
          B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
          B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ B_sys * ε ^ t →
        ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
        ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2 →
        ∀ (N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
          (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
            lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
            generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + (b + δ) * t }

noncomputable def quantumPacketRate (γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf (ValidPacketGrowthRates γ)

  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)

         q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell

noncomputable def classicalTransportScore (ε γ : ℝ) (N_ω N_T N_G : ℕ)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ) (G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G)
    (b_G a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let p_TG : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun tid g =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let S_cells : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image k_time
  let p_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then π ω else 0
  let E_w := ∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g)

    p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell
  let S_t := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,

    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
  let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ B_sys) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
      r_O o = r ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ)) ∧

    a_D d ≤ min (L - t) ((H_P - t) / 2) ∧ r_D d < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
  (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) ∧
  (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
    0 < generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ∧

    |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
    |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d + t) ∧
    |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d + t))

def ValidPacketGrowthRates (γ : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  { b : ℝ | 0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
    ∀ (a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys K_hor R_win t_min δ : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A → 1 ≤ R_dom → 2 ≤ B_sys →
      1 ≤ K_hor → 2 ≤ R_win → 0 < t_min → t_min ≤ K_hor → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ N_mult →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
          0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
          t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor → L ≤ K_hor →
          B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
          B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ B_sys * ε ^ t →
        ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
        ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2 →
        ∀ (N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
          (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
            lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
            generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + (b + δ) * t }

noncomputable def quantumPacketRate (γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf (ValidPacketGrowthRates γ)

          intro v

          change ((ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ₁ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V₁))) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X₁, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) *

  have h_window_bounds :
      ∃ B_win : ℕ → ℝ,
        ∀ (ψ₁ ψ₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₁ →
          IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₂ →
        ∀ (w δ_V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖w‖ = 1 →
        ∀ (y₁ : ℝ),
          let u : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
            star (ψ₁ (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) * ψ₂ (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w - δ_V)

          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 4 → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B_win k) := by
    let W : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (100 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 10)

    have hLw_norm : ‖L_w‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun t => ?_)
      rw [hLw_apply, norm_smul, hw, mul_one, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]

          (∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun s : ℝ => ψ (s • w + z₀)) t‖ ≤ W j) := by
      intro ψ hψ z₀
      have h_eq : (fun s : ℝ => ψ (s • w + z₀)) = (fun z => ψ (z + z₀)) ∘ ⇑L_w := by
        ext s; simp [hLw_apply]
      refine ⟨fun k => ?_, fun j t => ?_⟩
      · rw [h_eq]
        exact ((hψ.1 k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).comp L_w.contDiff
      · rw [h_eq]
        have h_shift_cd : ContDiff ℝ j (fun z => ψ (z + z₀)) :=

        have h_prod_le : (∏ _ : Fin j, ‖L_w‖) ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
          exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg L_w) hLw_norm
        calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ (L_w t + z₀)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L_w)‖
            ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ (L_w t + z₀)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin j, ‖L_w‖ := h_le1
          _ ≤ W j * 1 := mul_le_mul (hψ.2.2 j (L_w t + z₀)) h_prod_le

    let z₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := y₁ • perp2D w

    have hf₁_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k f₁ := fun k => by

    refine ⟨fun k => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hu_eq]

    · intro t ht
      have hw_sq : (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by

  have h_phase_bounds :
      ∃ D_phase : ℕ → ℝ,

          (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ 4 → ∀ t : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j (deriv θ) t| ≤ (a₀ * K) * D_phase j) := by
    let D_phase : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => a₀⁻¹ * A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)

    intro lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase V₀ X₁ X₂ w hw K hK_pos hX_diff

    let ρ₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹

  have h_fourfold_ibp : ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R →

      | 2 => H2

      have h2 : 0 ≤ M 2 := hM 2 (by omega)
      have h3 : 0 ≤ M 3 := hM 3 (by omega)
      have h4 : 0 ≤ M 4 := hM 4 (by omega)

    intro L hL θ hθ hθ_lower hθ_deriv u hu hu_supp hu_bound

                iteratedDeriv 3 ψ_θ t * h t := by simp only [iteratedDeriv_one]; linarith

            nlinarith [abs_nonneg (iteratedDeriv 3 h t)]

          linarith
        have hw4 := hw_bd 4 (by omega) t
        have hd1 := hψ_deriv_bd 1 le_rfl (by omega) t
        have hd2 := hψ_deriv_bd 2 (by omega) (by omega) t
        have hd3 := hψ_deriv_bd 3 (by omega) (by omega) t
        have hd4 := hψ_deriv_bd 4 (by omega) le_rfl t
        have hm1 : |iteratedDeriv 1 ψ_θ t| * |iteratedDeriv 3 h t| ≤ D' 1 * H_step M 3 :=
          mul_le_mul hd1 h3 (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 1)
        have hm2 : |iteratedDeriv 2 ψ_θ t| * |iteratedDeriv 2 h t| ≤ D' 2 * H_step M 2 :=
          mul_le_mul hd2 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 2)
        have hm3 : |iteratedDeriv 3 ψ_θ t| * |iteratedDeriv 1 h t| ≤ D' 3 * H_step M 1 :=
          mul_le_mul hd3 h1 (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 3)
        have hm4 : |iteratedDeriv 4 ψ_θ t| * |h t| ≤ D' 4 * H_step M 0 :=
          mul_le_mul hd4 h0 (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 4)
        dsimp only [H_step] at hm1 hm2 hm3 hm4 ⊢
        linarith
      have hwn_bd : ∀ (k : ℕ), k ≤ N → ∀ t : ℝ,
          |iteratedDeriv k w_next t| ≤ H_step M (k + 1) := by
        intro k hk t
        dsimp only [w_next]
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
        exact hh_bd (k + 1) (by omega) t
      have h_ibp_eq : L * ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (w t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ =
          ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (w_next t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ := by
        let u_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (h t : ℂ)
        let u_c' : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (w_next t : ℂ)
        let v_c' : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => v_c t * (Complex.I * ((deriv θ t : ℝ) : ℂ))
        have hu_c_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (-T) T, HasDerivAt u_c (u_c' t) t := by
          intro t _
          have h1 : HasDerivAt h (w_next t) t :=
            (((hh_cd 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt).hasDerivAt
          exact Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
        have hv_c_deriv' : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (-T) T, HasDerivAt v_c (v_c' t) t :=
          fun t _ => hv_c_deriv t
        have hu_c'_int : IntervalIntegrable u_c' MeasureTheory.volume (-T) T :=
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hwn_cd 0).continuous).intervalIntegrable (-T) T
        have hv_c'_int : IntervalIntegrable v_c' MeasureTheory.volume (-T) T := by
          have hdθ_cd0 : ContDiff ℝ (0 : ℕ) (deriv θ) := (hθ (0 + 1)).deriv'
          have h_cont : Continuous v_c' :=
            (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
              (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hθ 0).continuous))).mul
              (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hdθ_cd0.continuous))
          exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable (-T) T
        have h_parts := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
          hu_c_deriv hv_c_deriv' hu_c'_int hv_c'_int
        have hh_T : h T = 0 := hh_supp T (by rw [abs_of_pos hT_pos]; dsimp [T]; linarith)
        have hh_mT : h (-T) = 0 := hh_supp (-T) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hT_pos]; dsimp [T]; linarith)
        simp only [u_c, hh_T, hh_mT, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_sub] at h_parts
        have h_lhs_eq : (fun t => (h t : ℂ) * v_c' t) =
            fun t => (Complex.I * (L : ℂ)) * ((w t : ℂ) * v_c t) := by
          ext t
          dsimp only [v_c']
          have hd_eq : deriv θ t = L * ψ_θ t := by
            dsimp [ψ_θ]; rw [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hL.ne']
          have hw_eq : (w t : ℂ) = (ψ_θ t : ℂ) * (h t : ℂ) := by
            rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, hw_prod t]
          rw [hd_eq, hw_eq]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_lhs_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_parts
        have h_norm := congr_arg norm h_parts
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le, norm_neg] at h_norm
        exact h_norm
      exact ⟨w_next, hwn_cd, hwn_supp, hwn_bd, h_ibp_eq⟩
    have h_real_ibp : ∀ w₀ : ℝ → ℝ,
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w₀) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R < |t| → w₀ t = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 4 → ∀ t : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k w₀ t| ≤ M0 k) →
        ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (w₀ t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ ≤ (2 * (R + 1) * M4 0) / L ^ 4 := by
      intro w₀ hw₀_cd hw₀_supp hw₀_bd
      obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁_cd, hw₁_supp, hw₁_bd, heq1⟩ :=
        h_step 3 (by omega) M0 w₀ hw₀_cd hw₀_supp hw₀_bd
      obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂_cd, hw₂_supp, hw₂_bd, heq2⟩ :=
        h_step 2 (by omega) M1 w₁ hw₁_cd hw₁_supp hw₁_bd
      obtain ⟨w₃, hw₃_cd, hw₃_supp, hw₃_bd, heq3⟩ :=
        h_step 1 (by omega) M2 w₂ hw₂_cd hw₂_supp hw₂_bd
      obtain ⟨w₄, _hw₄_cd, _hw₄_supp, hw₄_bd, heq4⟩ :=
        h_step 0 (by omega) M3 w₃ hw₃_cd hw₃_supp hw₃_bd
      have hL4 : L ^ 4 * ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (w₀ t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ =
          ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (w₄ t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ := by
        calc L ^ 4 * ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (w₀ t : ℂ) * v_c t‖
            = L * (L * (L * (L * ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (w₀ t : ℂ) * v_c t‖))) := by ring
          _ = ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (w₄ t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ := by rw [heq1, heq2, heq3, heq4]
      have hw₄_norm : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc (-T) T, ‖(w₄ t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ ≤ M4 0 := by
        intro t _
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have hv_norm : ‖v_c t‖ = 1 := Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal (θ t)
        rw [hv_norm, mul_one]
        simpa using hw₄_bd 0 le_rfl t
      have h_int4 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hw₄_norm
      have h_len : |T - (-T)| = 2 * (R + 1) := by
        have hpos : 0 < T - (-T) := by linarith
        rw [abs_of_pos hpos]
        dsimp [T]
        ring
      rw [h_len, mul_comm (M4 0)] at h_int4
      rw [le_div_iff₀' (pow_pos hL 4), hL4]
      exact h_int4
    let u_re : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (u t).re
    let u_im : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (u t).im
    have hre_eq : u_re = ⇑Complex.reCLM ∘ u := rfl
    have him_eq : u_im = ⇑Complex.imCLM ∘ u := rfl
    have hre_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u_re := fun k => Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp (hu k)
    have him_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u_im := fun k => Complex.imCLM.contDiff.comp (hu k)
    have hre_supp : ∀ t : ℝ, R < |t| → u_re t = 0 := fun t ht => by
      simp [u_re, hu_supp t ht.le]
    have him_supp : ∀ t : ℝ, R < |t| → u_im t = 0 := fun t ht => by
      simp [u_im, hu_supp t ht.le]
    have hre_norm_clm : ‖Complex.reCLM‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun z => by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm z)
    have him_norm_clm : ‖Complex.imCLM‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun z => by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm z)
    have hre_bd : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 4 → ∀ t : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k u_re t| ≤ M0 k := by
      intro k hk t
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hre_eq,
        Complex.reCLM.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (hu k).contDiffAt le_rfl]
      calc ‖Complex.reCLM.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u t)‖
          ≤ ‖Complex.reCLM‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u t‖ :=
            Complex.reCLM.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _
        _ ≤ 1 * B k := by
            rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
            exact mul_le_mul hre_norm_clm (hu_bound k hk t) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ ≤ M0 k := by rw [one_mul]; exact le_max_left _ _
    have him_bd : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 4 → ∀ t : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k u_im t| ≤ M0 k := by
      intro k hk t
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, him_eq,
        Complex.imCLM.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (hu k).contDiffAt le_rfl]
      calc ‖Complex.imCLM.compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u t)‖
          ≤ ‖Complex.imCLM‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u t‖ :=
            Complex.imCLM.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _
        _ ≤ 1 * B k := by
            rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
            exact mul_le_mul him_norm_clm (hu_bound k hk t) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ ≤ M0 k := by rw [one_mul]; exact le_max_left _ _
    have h_est_re := h_real_ibp u_re hre_cd hre_supp hre_bd
    have h_est_im := h_real_ibp u_im him_cd him_supp him_bd
    have h_split : (fun t : ℝ => u t * v_c t) =
        fun t => (u_re t : ℂ) * v_c t + Complex.I * ((u_im t : ℂ) * v_c t) := by
      ext t
      have hu_eq : u t = (u_re t : ℂ) + Complex.I * (u_im t : ℂ) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [u_re, u_im]
      conv_lhs => rw [hu_eq]
      ring
    have hre_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => (u_re t : ℂ) * v_c t)
        MeasureTheory.volume (-T) T :=
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hre_cd 0).continuous).mul
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hθ 0).continuous)))).intervalIntegrable (-T) T
    have him_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => (u_im t : ℂ) * v_c t)
        MeasureTheory.volume (-T) T :=
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (him_cd 0).continuous).mul
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hθ 0).continuous)))).intervalIntegrable (-T) T
    have h_ivl_eq : (∫ t : ℝ, u t * v_c t) = ∫ t in (-T)..T, u t * v_c t := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith : -T ≤ T)]
      refine (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun t ht => ?_)).symm
      have hR_le : R ≤ |t| := by
        rw [Set.mem_Ioc, not_and_or, not_lt, not_le] at ht
        rcases ht with hle | hlt
        · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; dsimp [T] at hle; linarith
        · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; dsimp [T] at hlt; linarith
      simp [hu_supp t hR_le]
    change ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * v_c t‖ ≤ C_ibp / L ^ 4
    rw [h_ivl_eq]
    have h_sum_ivl : (∫ t in (-T)..T, u t * v_c t) =
        (∫ t in (-T)..T, (u_re t : ℂ) * v_c t) +
          Complex.I * (∫ t in (-T)..T, (u_im t : ℂ) * v_c t) := by
      simp_rw [h_split]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hre_int (him_int.const_mul Complex.I),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    rw [h_sum_ivl]
    calc ‖(∫ t in (-T)..T, (u_re t : ℂ) * v_c t) +
          Complex.I * (∫ t in (-T)..T, (u_im t : ℂ) * v_c t)‖
        ≤ ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (u_re t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ +
            ‖Complex.I * (∫ t in (-T)..T, (u_im t : ℂ) * v_c t)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (u_re t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ +
            ‖∫ t in (-T)..T, (u_im t : ℂ) * v_c t‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 * (R + 1) * M4 0) / L ^ 4 + (2 * (R + 1) * M4 0) / L ^ 4 :=
          add_le_add h_est_re h_est_im
      _ = C_ibp / L ^ 4 := by dsimp [C_ibp]; ring

  obtain ⟨B_win, hB_win⟩ := h_window_bounds
  obtain ⟨D_phase, hD_phase⟩ := h_phase_bounds
  obtain ⟨C_ibp, hC_ibp_nn, h_ibp⟩ := h_fourfold_ibp 100 (by norm_num) B_win D_phase
  let C_osc : ℝ := 3200 * a₀⁻¹ ^ 4 * C_ibp
  have hC_osc_nn : 0 ≤ C_osc := by positivity
  let C_pair : ℝ := max 1 (max 400000000 C_osc)
  have hC_pair_ge : 1 ≤ C_pair := le_max_left _ _
  have h4e8_le : (400000000 : ℝ) ≤ C_pair := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hC_osc_le : C_osc ≤ C_pair := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨C_pair, hC_pair_ge, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ o₁ o₂
  have hΦ₀_cont : Continuous Φ₀ := (h_phase.1 0).continuous
  obtain ⟨h_disj, h_triv, h_slice⟩ :=
    h_slice_red lam hlam Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ o₁ o₂
  refine ⟨h_disj, ?_⟩
  by_cases hX_eq : o₁.2 = o₂.2
  · have h_zero_pt : gridPt2D 1 (o₁.2.1 - o₂.2.1, o₁.2.2 - o₂.2.2) = 0 := by
      rw [hX_eq]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [gridPt2D]
    rw [h_zero_pt, norm_zero, add_zero, one_pow, div_one]
    exact le_trans h_triv h4e8_le
  · let Δk_X : ℤ × ℤ := (o₂.2.1 - o₁.2.1, o₂.2.2 - o₁.2.2)
    let Δ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D 1 Δk_X
    let K : ℝ := ‖Δ_X‖
    have h_neg_pt : gridPt2D 1 (o₁.2.1 - o₂.2.1, o₁.2.2 - o₂.2.2) = -Δ_X := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Δ_X, Δk_X, gridPt2D] <;> ring
    have h_norm_symm : ‖gridPt2D 1 (o₁.2.1 - o₂.2.1, o₁.2.2 - o₂.2.2)‖ = K := by
      rw [h_neg_pt, norm_neg]
    rw [h_norm_symm]
    have hK_nn : 0 ≤ K := norm_nonneg Δ_X
    have hK_sq_ge_one : 1 ≤ K ^ 2 := by
      have h_ne : Δk_X.1 ≠ 0 ∨ Δk_X.2 ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h_both
        rw [not_or, not_not, not_not] at h_both
        apply hX_eq
        ext
        · dsimp [Δk_X] at h_both; omega
        · dsimp [Δk_X] at h_both; omega
      have h_sq_eq : K ^ 2 = (Δk_X.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (Δk_X.2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [K]
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp [Δ_X, gridPt2D, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [h_sq_eq]
      rcases h_ne with h1 | h2
      · have habs : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |Δk_X.1| := Int.one_le_abs h1
        have habs_r : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(Δk_X.1 : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast habs
        have hsq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (Δk_X.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Δk_X.2 : ℝ)]
      · have habs : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |Δk_X.2| := Int.one_le_abs h2
        have habs_r : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(Δk_X.2 : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast habs
        have hsq2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (Δk_X.2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Δk_X.1 : ℝ)]
    have hK_ge_one : 1 ≤ K := by nlinarith
    have hK_pos : 0 < K := by linarith
    let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := K⁻¹ • Δ_X
    have hw : ‖w‖ = 1 := by
      dsimp [w]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hK_nn)]
      exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hK_pos.ne'
    let ρ₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
    let V₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D ρ₀ o₁.1
    let X₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D ρ₀ o₁.2
    let X₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D ρ₀ o₂.2
    let δ_V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D 1 (o₂.1.1 - o₁.1.1, o₂.1.2 - o₁.1.2)
    have hX_diff : X₂ - X₁ = (ρ₀ * K) • w := by
      have h1 : X₂ - X₁ = ρ₀ • Δ_X := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [X₁, X₂, Δ_X, Δk_X, gridPt2D] <;> ring
      dsimp [w]
      rw [smul_smul, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hK_pos.ne', mul_one, h1]
    have h_slice_est : ∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-100 : ℝ) 100,
        ‖∫ t : ℝ,
          (star (ψ₁ (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) *
            ψ₂ (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w - δ_V)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam * (Φ₀ (1 / 2, X₂, V₁ + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) -
              Φ₀ (1 / 2, X₁, V₁ + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
        C_ibp / (a₀ * K) ^ 4 := by
      intro y₁ _hy₁
      let V₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := V₁ + ρ₀ • (y₁ • perp2D w)
      obtain ⟨hu_cd, hu_supp, hu_bd⟩ := hB_win ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ w δ_V hw y₁
      obtain ⟨hθ_cd, hθ_low, hθ_der⟩ :=
        hD_phase lam hlam Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase V₀ X₁ X₂ w hw K hK_pos hX_diff
      have h_ibp_y₁ := h_ibp (a₀ * K) (mul_pos ha₀ hK_pos)
        (fun t => lam * (Φ₀ (1 / 2, X₂, V₀ + ρ₀ • (t • w)) - Φ₀ (1 / 2, X₁, V₀ + ρ₀ • (t • w))))
        hθ_cd hθ_low hθ_der
        (fun t => star (ψ₁ (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) * ψ₂ (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w - δ_V))
        hu_cd hu_supp hu_bd
      have h_arg_eq : ∀ t : ℝ, V₁ + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) = V₀ + ρ₀ • (t • w) := by
        intro t
        dsimp [V₀]
        rw [smul_add]
        abel
      simpa only [h_arg_eq] using h_ibp_y₁
    have h_200 := h_slice w hw (C_ibp / (a₀ * K) ^ 4)
      (div_nonneg hC_ibp_nn (pow_nonneg (mul_pos ha₀ hK_pos).le 4)) h_slice_est
    have h_1pK_pos : 0 < (1 + K) ^ 4 := pow_pos (by linarith) 4
    have h_1pK_le : (1 + K) ^ 4 ≤ 16 * K ^ 4 := by
      have h_le2 : 1 + K ≤ 2 * K := by linarith
      calc (1 + K) ^ 4 ≤ (2 * K) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) h_le2 4
        _ = 16 * K ^ 4 := by ring
    calc ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₁ o₁ v *
            star (canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₂ o₂ v)‖
        ≤ 200 * (C_ibp / (a₀ * K) ^ 4) := h_200
      _ = (3200 * a₀⁻¹ ^ 4 * C_ibp) / (16 * K ^ 4) := by
          field_simp [ha₀.ne', hK_pos.ne']
          ring
      _ ≤ C_osc / (1 + K) ^ 4 := by
          dsimp only [C_osc]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hC_osc_nn h_1pK_pos h_1pK_le
      _ ≤ C_pair / (1 + K) ^ 4 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC_osc_le h_1pK_pos.le

informal_problem.statement:
(lam C_pair : ℝ)
    (hlam : 2 ≤ lam) (hC_pair : 1 ≤ C_pair)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (hΦ₀_cont : Continuous Φ₀)
    (S : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
    (h_gram : ∀ (ψ₁ ψ₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₁ →
      IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₂ →
      ∀ o₁ ∈ S, ∀ o₂ ∈ S,
        (200 ≤ ‖gridPt2D 1 (o₁.1.1 - o₂.1.1, o₁.1.2 - o₂.1.2)‖ →
          ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₁ o₁ v *

  have h_atom_props : ∀ (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),

        Continuous (canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ o) ∧
        ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),

            (100 * ρ₀⁻¹) *
              Set.indicator (Metric.closedBall (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1) (100 * ρ₀))

    let X := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2

  have h_ball_ind_int : ∀ o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),

            Set.indicator (Metric.closedBall (gridPt2D ρ₀ o₁.1) (100 * ρ₀))

            (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) v))

  have h_row_bound : ∀ (K : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ℝ),
