    obtain ⟨ε_i, hε_i_pos, hε_i_lt, h_go_init⟩ := h_init_cls cls_init
    obtain ⟨ε_nfi, hε_nfi_pos, _, h_go_nfi⟩ :=
      h_nf_init_cls (localRescaledClass cls_init (7 / 8))
    obtain ⟨ε_c, hε_c_pos, _, h_go_chain⟩ := h_chain (nextPacketClass M_atom cls_init)
    let ε_all : ℝ := min ε_i (min ε_nfi ε_c)
    obtain ⟨ε, H_P, L, lam_sys, m_init, Φ₀, ζ₀, f, N_O, N_D, r_O, V_O, X_O, ψ_O,
      b_D, a_D, r_D, e_D, V_D, X_D, p, hε_lt, hHP, hL, henv, hm1, hm2, hadm, hscore⟩ :=
      h_sat_init ε_all (lt_min hε_i_pos (lt_min hε_nfi_pos hε_c_pos))
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) hε_i_lt)
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε := henv.1
    have h_lt_i : ε < ε_i := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_lt_nfi : ε < ε_nfi :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_right _ _)) (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_lt_c : ε < ε_c :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_right _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)
    obtain ⟨hslk, hstate0⟩ :=
      h_go_init ε H_P L lam_sys m_init Φ₀ ζ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
        b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p
        h_lt_i hHP hL henv (h_go_nfi ε hε_pos h_lt_nfi) hm1 hm2 hadm hscore
    have ht0_eq : t₀ - 2 * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h = 1 / 8 := by
      dsimp [t₀]
      ring
    rw [← ht0_eq] at hstate0
    have hk0_le : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 + ε_eff) * h := by positivity
    obtain ⟨k_sol, hk_sol0, hk_sol_step, hk_sol_last⟩ :=
      h_go_chain ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f 0 h_lt_c hHP hL hslk
        (h_next_env cls_init ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f henv) le_rfl hk0_le hstate0
    refine ⟨h, k_sol, hh_pos, hk_sol0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      have h_step_i := hk_sol_step i
      nlinarith [h_step_i, hε_eff_le_err, hh_pos]
    · nlinarith [hk_sol_last, hε_eff_le_err, hh_pos]

quantum_packet_credit_chain_bound.definitions:
structure PacketBoundClass where
  a₀ : ℝ
  a₁ : ℝ
  A : ℝ
  R_dom : ℝ
  B_sys : ℝ
  K_hor : ℝ
  R_win : ℝ
  N_mult : ℕ
  M_win : ℕ → ℝ
  ha₀ : 0 < a₀
  ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁
  hA : 1 ≤ A
  hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom
  hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys
  hK_hor : 1 ≤ K_hor
  hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win
  hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult

noncomputable def nextPacketClass (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) : PacketBoundClass where
  a₀ := cls.a₀
  a₁ := cls.a₁
  A := cls.A
  R_dom := cls.R_dom
  B_sys := 16 * cls.B_sys + 4 * cls.R_win + 20
  K_hor := cls.K_hor
  R_win := 4
  N_mult := 81
  M_win := M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win
  ha₀ := cls.ha₀
  ha₁ := cls.ha₁
  hA := cls.hA
  hR_dom := cls.hR_dom
  hB_sys := by linarith [cls.hB_sys, cls.hR_win]
  hK_hor := cls.hK_hor
  hR_win := by norm_num
  hN_mult := by omega

noncomputable def localRescaledClass (cls : PacketBoundClass) (d : ℝ) : PacketBoundClass where
  a₀ := cls.a₀
  a₁ := cls.a₁
  A := 3 * cls.A
  R_dom := 8 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 20
  B_sys := 8 * cls.B_sys + 20
  K_hor := max 1 (cls.K_hor / d)
  R_win := cls.R_win
  N_mult := cls.N_mult
  M_win := cls.M_win
  ha₀ := cls.ha₀
  ha₁ := cls.ha₁
  hA := by linarith [cls.hA]
  hR_dom := by linarith [cls.hB_sys, cls.hR_win]
  hB_sys := by linarith [cls.hB_sys]
  hK_hor := le_max_left 1 _
  hR_win := cls.hR_win
  hN_mult := cls.hN_mult

def IsValidPacketEnv (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 2 ∧
  0 < H_P ∧ H_P ≤ cls.K_hor ∧ 0 < L ∧ L ≤ cls.K_hor ∧
  cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys ∧ lam_sys ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) ∧
  IsNormalizedPosDefPhase cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A Φ₀ ζ₀ ∧
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) ∧
  MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
  0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def localGaugePhase
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (cxv : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let c := C_r + s_c * (cxv.1 - 1 / 2)
  let x := X_J + (s_c * (cxv.1 - 1 / 2)) • V_J + s_x • cxv.2.1
  let v := V_J + s_v • cxv.2.2
  let c₀ := C_r - s_c / 2
  let x₀ := X_J - (s_c / 2) • V_J
  (s_c * s_v ^ 2)⁻¹ *
    (Φ₀ (c, x, v) - Φ₀ (c, x, V_J) - Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, v) + Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J))

noncomputable def localGaugeGrad
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let v := V_J + s_v • vp.1
  s_x⁻¹ •
    (ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + s_x • (vp.2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • vp.1)) -
     ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_x) • vp.1))

noncomputable def localGaugeInput
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let c₀ := C_r - s_c / 2
  let x₀ := X_J - (s_c / 2) • V_J
  let v := V_J + s_v • v'
  (s_v : ℂ) * f v *
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, v) - Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

def LocalPhaseRescalingValid : Prop :=
  ∀ (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ), 0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A →
  ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
  ∀ (m_r m_t q_r : ℕ), m_r ≤ m_t → q_r < 2 ^ m_r →
  ∀ (ε H_P t r b_star s_v lam_sys : ℝ),
    0 < ε → 0 < s_v → s_v ≤ 1 → s_v = ε ^ b_star → 0 < lam_sys →
  ∀ (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
    let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
    let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
    let s_x := s_c * s_v
    let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
    let ζ'₀ := localGaugeGrad ζ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
    let f'₀ := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J f
    IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ (3 * A) Φ'₀ ζ'₀ ∧
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f'₀ MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f'₀ 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (∫ v', ‖f'₀ v'‖ ^ 2 = ∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ R_supp : ℝ, (∀ v, R_supp ≤ ‖v - V_J‖ → f v = 0) →
      ∀ v', s_v⁻¹ * R_supp ≤ ‖v'‖ → f'₀ v' = 0) ∧
    (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
      ∀ (V'_o X'_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        let r_full := q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc
        let C_t := ((r_full : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
        generalPacketObsMass ε (H_P - r - 2 * b_star) (t - r) (s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys)
          (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ f'₀ r_loc V'_o X'_o ψ_o =
        generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f r_full
          (V_J + s_v • V'_o) (X_J + (C_t - C_r) • V_J + s_x • X'_o) ψ_o)

def HasRootWidthGap (ν κ ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let K₀ := generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f
  ∀ (N_D : ℕ) (b a : Fin N_D → ℝ) (e_dir V_c X_c : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b d ∧ b d ≤ a d ∧ a d ≤ min L (H_P / 2) ∧ ‖e_dir d‖ = 1) →
    (∀ d : Fin N_D, (0 < ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d) → H_P / 2 - ν ≤ b d) →
    (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) →
    (∀ o d, o ∉ O₀ → p o d = 0) →
    (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
    (∀ o ∈ O₀, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
      0 < canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d)) →
    let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
    let p_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d
    let H_O := (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell
    let H_O_D := (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell
    let E_mass := (∑ o ∈ O₀, p_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)) / ell
    let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b d + (1 - γ) * a d)
    H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w ≤ K₀ - κ

def IsDurationOneSaturatingClass (γ Δ : ℝ) (cls : PacketBoundClass) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      ε < ε₀ ∧ 1 ≤ H_P ∧ 1 ≤ L ∧
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f ∧
      cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ∧
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L 1 cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ∧
      generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + quantumPacketRate γ - Δ ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p

def IsForcedSaturatingClass (γ ν κ Δ : ℝ) (cls : PacketBoundClass) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      ε < ε₀ ∧ 1 ≤ H_P ∧ 1 ≤ L ∧
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f ∧
      cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ∧
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L 1 cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ∧
      generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + quantumPacketRate γ - Δ ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ∧
      HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f

def ForcedRootSystemExists (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ν κ : ℝ), 0 < ν ∧ 0 < κ ∧
    ∀ Δ : ℝ, 0 < Δ → ∃ cls : PacketBoundClass, IsForcedSaturatingClass γ ν κ Δ cls

def UniformPacketGrowthModulus (γ b_rate : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (t_min δ : ℝ),
    0 < t_min → t_min ≤ cls.K_hor → 0 < δ →
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        ε < ε₀ → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + (b_rate + δ) * t

def DurationScalingValid (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (ε H_P L d R_dom B_sys R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ) (lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < d → ε ^ d < 1 / 2 →
    (IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L d B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) 1 B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O (fun j => b_D j / d) (fun j => a_D j / d)
        r_D e_D V_D X_D p) ∧
    generalPacketScore (ε ^ d) γ (H_P / d) 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
      (fun j => b_D j / d) (fun j => a_D j / d) p =
      d⁻¹ * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ∧
    generalPacketRootScore (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f =
      d⁻¹ * generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ∧
    (∀ ν κ : ℝ,
      HasRootWidthGap (ν / d) (κ / d) (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ↔
      HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f)

def PacketCutDecompositionValid (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u A_amp B_cut : ℝ),
    0 < Δ_u → 0 < A_amp → 2 * A_amp + 12 * cls.K_hor + 16 ≤ B_cut →
    ∃ (C_cut C_can C_Bes : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr C_rtail : ℕ → ℝ) (ε_cut : ℝ),
      2 ≤ C_cut ∧ 1 ≤ C_can ∧ 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧
      (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) ∧ (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_rtail M) ∧ 0 < ε_cut ∧ ε_cut < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t q_r : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ε < ε_cut → IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ H_P → 0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
        ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
         (0 < r ∧ (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ r ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ∧
           ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ r)) →
        m_r ≤ m_t → q_r < 2 ^ m_r →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        ‖V_J‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys → ‖X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys →
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        ∃ (N_atom : ℕ) (o_atom : Fin N_atom → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
          (ψ_atom : Fin N_atom → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (c_atom : Fin N_atom → ℂ),
          let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (o_atom α).1
          let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (o_atom α).2
          let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
            (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_atom α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
          (∀ α, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_atom α)) ∧
            (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_atom α z = 0) ∧
            (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_atom α) z‖ ≤
              M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k)) ∧
          (∀ α, ‖V_at α - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v + cls.R_win * s_v + 4 * s_v ∧
            ‖X_at α - X_J‖ ≤ 8 * cls.B_sys * s_x + 2 * cls.R_win * s_x + 10 * s_x) ∧
          (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => o_atom α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
          ((N_atom : ℝ) ≤ C_cut * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor + 4))) ∧
          (∀ α, ε ^ B_cut * (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (∑ α : Fin N_atom, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (0 < r → ∀ α, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 =
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P r lam_sys m_r Φ₀ f q_r (V_at α) (X_at α) (ψ_atom α)) ∧
          (r = 0 → ∀ α, o_atom α ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys cls.R_dom ∧
            ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (o_atom α)) ∧
          (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
            let C_t := (((q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
            ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
              ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v →
              ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x →
              (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
              (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
              (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
              let pair_fn := fun h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ =>
                (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
              ‖pair_fn f - pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_atom, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                C_cut * ε ^ A_amp * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
              ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (M_tr : ℕ) (R_tr : ℝ), 2 ≤ M_tr → 2 ≤ R_tr →
                letI := Classical.propDecidable
                let S_near := S.filter (fun α =>
                  ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t ∧
                  ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * R_tr * σ_r)
                ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v) -
                 pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                  C_tr M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2)) ∧
          (∀ S : Finset (Fin N_atom),
            let h_S := fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v
            let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
            let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
            let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
            let h'_S := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_S
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h_S MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            MeasureTheory.MemLp h_S 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            (∫ v, ‖h_S v‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_Bes * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
            (∀ R'_dom : ℝ, 1 ≤ R'_dom →
              (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
                C_Bes * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
              ∀ (b_F a_F R_cap : ℝ) (M_cap : ℕ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
                2 ≤ R_cap → 3 ≤ M_cap → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
                F_sites ⊆ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom →
                (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
                letI := Classical.propDecidable
                let S_cap := S.filter (fun α =>
                  let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
                  let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
                  |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀)
                ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
                  C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) +
                  C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2)))

def CoherentStripMassBoundValid : Prop :=
  ∀ (a₀ a₁ A B_cell R_win : ℝ) (N_mult M_mult : ℕ) (M_atom M_win : ℕ → ℝ),
    0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A → 2 ≤ B_cell → 2 ≤ R_win → 1 ≤ N_mult → 1 ≤ M_mult →
    ∃ C_coh : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_coh ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam_loc ρ s c_end R : ℝ),
        0 < lam_loc → 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ 1 →
        B_cell⁻¹ ≤ lam_loc * s ^ 2 → lam_loc * s ^ 2 ≤ B_cell →
        c_end ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 1 ≤ R →
      ∀ (V_P X_Q n_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖n_P‖ = 1 →
      ∀ (d_dim N_Q K N_obs : ℕ), (d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2) → 1 ≤ K →
      ∀ (V_T X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (η_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (c_T : Fin N_Q → ℂ) (bin_of : Fin N_Q → Fin K)
        (V_O X_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let σ := (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹
         (∀ T, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (η_T T)) ∧ (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → η_T T z = 0) ∧
           (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (η_T T) z‖ ≤ M_atom k) ∧
           ‖V_T T - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ ∧
           ‖(X_T T + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V_T T) - X_Q‖ ≤ R * s) ∧
         (∀ v₀ x₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
           ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
         (∀ T₁ T₂, bin_of T₁ = bin_of T₂ →
           (d_dim = 1 → |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P| ≤ B_cell * s) ∧
           (d_dim = 2 → ‖V_T T₁ - V_T T₂‖ ≤ B_cell * s)) ∧
         (∀ o, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧ (∀ z, R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
           (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) ∧
           ‖V_O o - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ) ∧
         (∀ v₀ x₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_obs =>
           ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ))) →
        let σ := (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹
        let h_Q := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ∑ T : Fin N_Q, c_T T *
          ((s⁻¹ : ℂ) * η_T T (s⁻¹ • (v - V_T T)) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_T T, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
        let m_obs := fun o : Fin N_obs =>
          ‖(ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_Q v * ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2
        (∑ o : Fin N_obs, m_obs o ≤ C_coh * ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ (x_Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S_Z : Finset (Fin N_obs)),
          (∀ o ∈ S_Z,
            (d_dim = 1 → |inner ℝ (X_O o - x_Z) n_P| ≤ B_cell * σ ∧
              |inner ℝ (X_O o - x_Z) (perp2D n_P)| ≤ B_cell * s) ∧
            (d_dim = 2 → ‖X_O o - x_Z‖ ≤ B_cell * σ)) →
          ∑ o ∈ S_Z, m_obs o ≤
            C_coh * (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ d_dim * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2))

noncomputable def projAngleDist (n₁ n₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  |inner ℝ n₁ (perp2D n₂)|

def HasIncomingCredit (ε H_P t h C_cell : ℝ) (d_dim N_O N_D : ℕ)
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (e_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (k_f α_f : ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  k_f ≤ 0 ∨
  (0 < k_f ∧
   ∃ (L_grid : ℝ) (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
     (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
     (n_f : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
     (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ),
     let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
     let s_Vf := L_grid * ε ^ (u_t - h)
     let s_Xf := L_grid * ε ^ (t + u_t - h)
     1 ≤ L_grid ∧ L_grid ≤ C_cell ∧
     (∀ p_c, ‖n_f p_c‖ = 1) ∧
     (∀ o : Fin N_O, (P_f o).1 = r_O o ∧
       ‖V_O o - (τ_V + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)‖ ≤ s_Vf ∧
       ‖X_O o - (τ_X + gridPt2D s_Xf (P_f o).2.2)‖ ≤ s_Xf ∧
       (d_dim = 1 →
         |inner ℝ (V_O o - (τ_V + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)) (n_f (P_f o)) -
           ((W_f o).1 : ℝ) * ε ^ u_t| ≤ ε ^ u_t ∧ (W_f o).2 = 0) ∧
       (d_dim = 2 →
         ‖V_O o - (τ_V + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1) - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_t) (W_f o)‖ ≤
           2 * ε ^ u_t)) ∧
     (d_dim = 1 → ∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
       projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_f (P_f o)) ≤ C_cell * ε ^ h) ∧
     (∀ (p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (w : ℤ × ℤ),
       ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w), (∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) ≤
         ε ^ (k_f - α_f) *
           ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), (∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d)))

def IsCutChainState (γ : ℝ) (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ)
    (C_cell : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (δ_def k_cred α_cred : ℝ) : Prop :=
  let m_t : ℕ := Nat.floor (t * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
  ∃ (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ∧
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t ∧
    IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
      lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ∧
    (d_dim = 2 → ∀ d : Fin N_D, b_D d = (H_P - t) / 2 ∧ a_D d = (H_P - t) / 2) ∧
    generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
      quantumPacketRate γ * t - δ_def ≤
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ∧
    HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h C_cell d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_cred α_cred

def LocalNonForcedAtScale (γ : ℝ) (loc_cls : PacketBoundClass) (d ν_loc κ_loc τ_no ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (H'_P L' lam_loc : ℝ) (m_loc : ℕ)
    (Φ'₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ'₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (h'_in : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    d ≤ H'_P → H'_P ≤ d * loc_cls.K_hor → d ≤ L' → L' ≤ d * loc_cls.K_hor →
    loc_cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H'_P) ≤ lam_loc → lam_loc ≤ loc_cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-H'_P) →
    loc_cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ d ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_loc)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_loc)⁻¹ ≤ loc_cls.B_sys * ε ^ d →
    IsNormalizedPosDefPhase loc_cls.a₀ loc_cls.a₁ loc_cls.A Φ'₀ ζ'₀ →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h'_in MeasureTheory.volume →
    (∀ v', loc_cls.R_dom ≤ ‖v'‖ → h'_in v' = 0) →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp h'_in 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
    0 < ∫ v', ‖h'_in v'‖ ^ 2 →
    IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H'_P L' d loc_cls.B_sys loc_cls.R_win loc_cls.N_mult loc_cls.M_win
      lam_loc m_loc Φ'₀ h'_in N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
    generalPacketRootScore ε H'_P L' loc_cls.R_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_in +
      quantumPacketRate γ * d - τ_no ≤
      generalPacketScore ε γ H'_P d lam_loc m_loc Φ'₀ h'_in N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
    ¬ HasRootWidthGap ν_loc κ_loc ε H'_P L' loc_cls.R_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_in

and_nodes.definitions_block:
structure PacketBoundClass where
  a₀ : ℝ
  a₁ : ℝ
  A : ℝ
  R_dom : ℝ
  B_sys : ℝ
  K_hor : ℝ
  R_win : ℝ
  N_mult : ℕ
  M_win : ℕ → ℝ
  ha₀ : 0 < a₀
  ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁
  hA : 1 ≤ A
  hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom
  hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys
  hK_hor : 1 ≤ K_hor
  hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win
  hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult

noncomputable def nextPacketClass (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) : PacketBoundClass where
  a₀ := cls.a₀
  a₁ := cls.a₁
  A := cls.A
  R_dom := cls.R_dom
  B_sys := 16 * cls.B_sys + 4 * cls.R_win + 20
  K_hor := cls.K_hor
  R_win := 4
  N_mult := 81
  M_win := M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win
  ha₀ := cls.ha₀
  ha₁ := cls.ha₁
  hA := cls.hA
  hR_dom := cls.hR_dom
  hB_sys := by linarith [cls.hB_sys, cls.hR_win]
  hK_hor := cls.hK_hor
  hR_win := by norm_num
  hN_mult := by omega

noncomputable def localRescaledClass (cls : PacketBoundClass) (d : ℝ) : PacketBoundClass where
  a₀ := cls.a₀
  a₁ := cls.a₁
  A := 3 * cls.A
  R_dom := 8 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 20
  B_sys := 8 * cls.B_sys + 20
  K_hor := max 1 (cls.K_hor / d)
  R_win := cls.R_win
  N_mult := cls.N_mult
  M_win := cls.M_win
  ha₀ := cls.ha₀
  ha₁ := cls.ha₁
  hA := by linarith [cls.hA]
  hR_dom := by linarith [cls.hB_sys, cls.hR_win]
  hB_sys := by linarith [cls.hB_sys]
  hK_hor := le_max_left 1 _
  hR_win := cls.hR_win
  hN_mult := cls.hN_mult

def IsValidPacketEnv (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 2 ∧
  0 < H_P ∧ H_P ≤ cls.K_hor ∧ 0 < L ∧ L ≤ cls.K_hor ∧
  cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys ∧ lam_sys ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) ∧
  IsNormalizedPosDefPhase cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A Φ₀ ζ₀ ∧
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) ∧
  MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
  0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def localGaugePhase
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (cxv : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let c := C_r + s_c * (cxv.1 - 1 / 2)
  let x := X_J + (s_c * (cxv.1 - 1 / 2)) • V_J + s_x • cxv.2.1
  let v := V_J + s_v • cxv.2.2
  let c₀ := C_r - s_c / 2
  let x₀ := X_J - (s_c / 2) • V_J
  (s_c * s_v ^ 2)⁻¹ *
    (Φ₀ (c, x, v) - Φ₀ (c, x, V_J) - Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, v) + Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J))

noncomputable def localGaugeGrad
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let v := V_J + s_v • vp.1
  s_x⁻¹ •
    (ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + s_x • (vp.2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • vp.1)) -
     ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_x) • vp.1))

noncomputable def localGaugeInput
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let c₀ := C_r - s_c / 2
  let x₀ := X_J - (s_c / 2) • V_J
  let v := V_J + s_v • v'
  (s_v : ℂ) * f v *
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, v) - Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

def LocalPhaseRescalingValid : Prop :=
  ∀ (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ), 0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A →
  ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
  ∀ (m_r m_t q_r : ℕ), m_r ≤ m_t → q_r < 2 ^ m_r →
  ∀ (ε H_P t r b_star s_v lam_sys : ℝ),
    0 < ε → 0 < s_v → s_v ≤ 1 → s_v = ε ^ b_star → 0 < lam_sys →
  ∀ (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
    let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
    let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
    let s_x := s_c * s_v
    let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
    let ζ'₀ := localGaugeGrad ζ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
    let f'₀ := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J f
    IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ (3 * A) Φ'₀ ζ'₀ ∧
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f'₀ MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f'₀ 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (∫ v', ‖f'₀ v'‖ ^ 2 = ∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ R_supp : ℝ, (∀ v, R_supp ≤ ‖v - V_J‖ → f v = 0) →
      ∀ v', s_v⁻¹ * R_supp ≤ ‖v'‖ → f'₀ v' = 0) ∧
    (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
      ∀ (V'_o X'_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        let r_full := q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc
        let C_t := ((r_full : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
        generalPacketObsMass ε (H_P - r - 2 * b_star) (t - r) (s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys)
          (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ f'₀ r_loc V'_o X'_o ψ_o =
        generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f r_full
          (V_J + s_v • V'_o) (X_J + (C_t - C_r) • V_J + s_x • X'_o) ψ_o)

def HasRootWidthGap (ν κ ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let K₀ := generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f
  ∀ (N_D : ℕ) (b a : Fin N_D → ℝ) (e_dir V_c X_c : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b d ∧ b d ≤ a d ∧ a d ≤ min L (H_P / 2) ∧ ‖e_dir d‖ = 1) →
    (∀ d : Fin N_D, (0 < ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d) → H_P / 2 - ν ≤ b d) →
    (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) →
    (∀ o d, o ∉ O₀ → p o d = 0) →
    (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
    (∀ o ∈ O₀, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
      0 < canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d)) →
    let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
    let p_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d
    let H_O := (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell
    let H_O_D := (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell
    let E_mass := (∑ o ∈ O₀, p_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)) / ell
    let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b d + (1 - γ) * a d)
    H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w ≤ K₀ - κ

def IsDurationOneSaturatingClass (γ Δ : ℝ) (cls : PacketBoundClass) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      ε < ε₀ ∧ 1 ≤ H_P ∧ 1 ≤ L ∧
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f ∧
      cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ∧
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L 1 cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ∧
      generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + quantumPacketRate γ - Δ ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p

def IsForcedSaturatingClass (γ ν κ Δ : ℝ) (cls : PacketBoundClass) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      ε < ε₀ ∧ 1 ≤ H_P ∧ 1 ≤ L ∧
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f ∧
      cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ∧
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L 1 cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ∧
      generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + quantumPacketRate γ - Δ ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ∧
      HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f

def ForcedRootSystemExists (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ν κ : ℝ), 0 < ν ∧ 0 < κ ∧
    ∀ Δ : ℝ, 0 < Δ → ∃ cls : PacketBoundClass, IsForcedSaturatingClass γ ν κ Δ cls

def UniformPacketGrowthModulus (γ b_rate : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (t_min δ : ℝ),
    0 < t_min → t_min ≤ cls.K_hor → 0 < δ →
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        ε < ε₀ → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + (b_rate + δ) * t

def DurationScalingValid (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (ε H_P L d R_dom B_sys R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ) (lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < d → ε ^ d < 1 / 2 →
    (IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L d B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) 1 B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O (fun j => b_D j / d) (fun j => a_D j / d)
        r_D e_D V_D X_D p) ∧
    generalPacketScore (ε ^ d) γ (H_P / d) 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
      (fun j => b_D j / d) (fun j => a_D j / d) p =
      d⁻¹ * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ∧
    generalPacketRootScore (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f =
      d⁻¹ * generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ∧
    (∀ ν κ : ℝ,
      HasRootWidthGap (ν / d) (κ / d) (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ↔
      HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f)

def PacketCutDecompositionValid (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u A_amp B_cut : ℝ),
    0 < Δ_u → 0 < A_amp → 2 * A_amp + 12 * cls.K_hor + 16 ≤ B_cut →
    ∃ (C_cut C_can C_Bes : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr C_rtail : ℕ → ℝ) (ε_cut : ℝ),
      2 ≤ C_cut ∧ 1 ≤ C_can ∧ 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧
      (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) ∧ (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_rtail M) ∧ 0 < ε_cut ∧ ε_cut < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t q_r : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ε < ε_cut → IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ H_P → 0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
        ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
         (0 < r ∧ (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ r ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ∧
           ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ r)) →
        m_r ≤ m_t → q_r < 2 ^ m_r →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        ‖V_J‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys → ‖X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys →
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        ∃ (N_atom : ℕ) (o_atom : Fin N_atom → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
          (ψ_atom : Fin N_atom → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (c_atom : Fin N_atom → ℂ),
          let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (o_atom α).1
          let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (o_atom α).2
          let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
            (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_atom α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
          (∀ α, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_atom α)) ∧
            (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_atom α z = 0) ∧
            (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_atom α) z‖ ≤
              M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k)) ∧
          (∀ α, ‖V_at α - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v + cls.R_win * s_v + 4 * s_v ∧
            ‖X_at α - X_J‖ ≤ 8 * cls.B_sys * s_x + 2 * cls.R_win * s_x + 10 * s_x) ∧
          (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => o_atom α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
          ((N_atom : ℝ) ≤ C_cut * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor + 4))) ∧
          (∀ α, ε ^ B_cut * (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (∑ α : Fin N_atom, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (0 < r → ∀ α, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 =
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P r lam_sys m_r Φ₀ f q_r (V_at α) (X_at α) (ψ_atom α)) ∧
          (r = 0 → ∀ α, o_atom α ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys cls.R_dom ∧
            ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (o_atom α)) ∧
          (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
            let C_t := (((q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
            ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
              ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v →
              ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x →
              (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
              (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
              (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
              let pair_fn := fun h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ =>
                (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
              ‖pair_fn f - pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_atom, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                C_cut * ε ^ A_amp * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
              ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (M_tr : ℕ) (R_tr : ℝ), 2 ≤ M_tr → 2 ≤ R_tr →
                letI := Classical.propDecidable
                let S_near := S.filter (fun α =>
                  ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t ∧
                  ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * R_tr * σ_r)
                ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v) -
                 pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                  C_tr M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2)) ∧
          (∀ S : Finset (Fin N_atom),
            let h_S := fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v
            let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
            let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
            let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
            let h'_S := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_S
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h_S MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            MeasureTheory.MemLp h_S 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            (∫ v, ‖h_S v‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_Bes * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
            (∀ R'_dom : ℝ, 1 ≤ R'_dom →
              (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
                C_Bes * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
              ∀ (b_F a_F R_cap : ℝ) (M_cap : ℕ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
                2 ≤ R_cap → 3 ≤ M_cap → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
                F_sites ⊆ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom →
                (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
                letI := Classical.propDecidable
                let S_cap := S.filter (fun α =>
                  let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
                  let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
                  |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀)
                ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
                  C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) +
                  C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2)))

def CoherentStripMassBoundValid : Prop :=
  ∀ (a₀ a₁ A B_cell R_win : ℝ) (N_mult M_mult : ℕ) (M_atom M_win : ℕ → ℝ),
    0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A → 2 ≤ B_cell → 2 ≤ R_win → 1 ≤ N_mult → 1 ≤ M_mult →
    ∃ C_coh : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_coh ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam_loc ρ s c_end R : ℝ),
        0 < lam_loc → 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ 1 →
        B_cell⁻¹ ≤ lam_loc * s ^ 2 → lam_loc * s ^ 2 ≤ B_cell →
        c_end ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 1 ≤ R →
      ∀ (V_P X_Q n_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖n_P‖ = 1 →
      ∀ (d_dim N_Q K N_obs : ℕ), (d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2) → 1 ≤ K →
      ∀ (V_T X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (η_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (c_T : Fin N_Q → ℂ) (bin_of : Fin N_Q → Fin K)
        (V_O X_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let σ := (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹
         (∀ T, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (η_T T)) ∧ (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → η_T T z = 0) ∧
           (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (η_T T) z‖ ≤ M_atom k) ∧
           ‖V_T T - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ ∧
           ‖(X_T T + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V_T T) - X_Q‖ ≤ R * s) ∧
         (∀ v₀ x₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
           ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
         (∀ T₁ T₂, bin_of T₁ = bin_of T₂ →
           (d_dim = 1 → |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P| ≤ B_cell * s) ∧
           (d_dim = 2 → ‖V_T T₁ - V_T T₂‖ ≤ B_cell * s)) ∧
         (∀ o, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧ (∀ z, R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
           (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) ∧
           ‖V_O o - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ) ∧
         (∀ v₀ x₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_obs =>
           ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ))) →
        let σ := (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹
        let h_Q := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ∑ T : Fin N_Q, c_T T *
          ((s⁻¹ : ℂ) * η_T T (s⁻¹ • (v - V_T T)) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_T T, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
        let m_obs := fun o : Fin N_obs =>
          ‖(ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_Q v * ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2
        (∑ o : Fin N_obs, m_obs o ≤ C_coh * ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ (x_Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S_Z : Finset (Fin N_obs)),
          (∀ o ∈ S_Z,
            (d_dim = 1 → |inner ℝ (X_O o - x_Z) n_P| ≤ B_cell * σ ∧
              |inner ℝ (X_O o - x_Z) (perp2D n_P)| ≤ B_cell * s) ∧
            (d_dim = 2 → ‖X_O o - x_Z‖ ≤ B_cell * σ)) →
          ∑ o ∈ S_Z, m_obs o ≤
            C_coh * (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ d_dim * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2))

noncomputable def projAngleDist (n₁ n₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  |inner ℝ n₁ (perp2D n₂)|

def HasIncomingCredit (ε H_P t h C_cell : ℝ) (d_dim N_O N_D : ℕ)
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (e_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (k_f α_f : ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  k_f ≤ 0 ∨
  (0 < k_f ∧
   ∃ (L_grid : ℝ) (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
     (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
     (n_f : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
     (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ),
     let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
     let s_Vf := L_grid * ε ^ (u_t - h)
     let s_Xf := L_grid * ε ^ (t + u_t - h)
     1 ≤ L_grid ∧ L_grid ≤ C_cell ∧
     (∀ p_c, ‖n_f p_c‖ = 1) ∧
     (∀ o : Fin N_O, (P_f o).1 = r_O o ∧
       ‖V_O o - (τ_V + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)‖ ≤ s_Vf ∧
       ‖X_O o - (τ_X + gridPt2D s_Xf (P_f o).2.2)‖ ≤ s_Xf ∧
       (d_dim = 1 →
         |inner ℝ (V_O o - (τ_V + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)) (n_f (P_f o)) -
           ((W_f o).1 : ℝ) * ε ^ u_t| ≤ ε ^ u_t ∧ (W_f o).2 = 0) ∧
       (d_dim = 2 →
         ‖V_O o - (τ_V + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1) - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_t) (W_f o)‖ ≤
           2 * ε ^ u_t)) ∧
     (d_dim = 1 → ∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
       projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_f (P_f o)) ≤ C_cell * ε ^ h) ∧
     (∀ (p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (w : ℤ × ℤ),
       ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w), (∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) ≤
         ε ^ (k_f - α_f) *
           ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), (∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d)))

def IsCutChainState (γ : ℝ) (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ)
    (C_cell : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (δ_def k_cred α_cred : ℝ) : Prop :=
  let m_t : ℕ := Nat.floor (t * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
  ∃ (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ∧
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t ∧
    IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
      lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ∧
    (d_dim = 2 → ∀ d : Fin N_D, b_D d = (H_P - t) / 2 ∧ a_D d = (H_P - t) / 2) ∧
    generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
      quantumPacketRate γ * t - δ_def ≤
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ∧
    HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h C_cell d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_cred α_cred

def LocalNonForcedAtScale (γ : ℝ) (loc_cls : PacketBoundClass) (d ν_loc κ_loc τ_no ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (H'_P L' lam_loc : ℝ) (m_loc : ℕ)
    (Φ'₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ'₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (h'_in : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    d ≤ H'_P → H'_P ≤ d * loc_cls.K_hor → d ≤ L' → L' ≤ d * loc_cls.K_hor →
    loc_cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H'_P) ≤ lam_loc → lam_loc ≤ loc_cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-H'_P) →
    loc_cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ d ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_loc)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_loc)⁻¹ ≤ loc_cls.B_sys * ε ^ d →
    IsNormalizedPosDefPhase loc_cls.a₀ loc_cls.a₁ loc_cls.A Φ'₀ ζ'₀ →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h'_in MeasureTheory.volume →
    (∀ v', loc_cls.R_dom ≤ ‖v'‖ → h'_in v' = 0) →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp h'_in 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
    0 < ∫ v', ‖h'_in v'‖ ^ 2 →
    IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H'_P L' d loc_cls.B_sys loc_cls.R_win loc_cls.N_mult loc_cls.M_win
      lam_loc m_loc Φ'₀ h'_in N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
    generalPacketRootScore ε H'_P L' loc_cls.R_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_in +
      quantumPacketRate γ * d - τ_no ≤
      generalPacketScore ε γ H'_P d lam_loc m_loc Φ'₀ h'_in N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
    ¬ HasRootWidthGap ν_loc κ_loc ε H'_P L' loc_cls.R_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_in

subgoal_signatures.name: finite_entropy_cut_and_credit_repayment
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_cl : ClassicalLineGrowthBound γ)
    (h_gt : γ / 2 < quantumPacketRate γ)
    (hβ_pos : 0 < quantumPacketRate γ) (hβ_le : quantumPacketRate γ ≤ 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ))
    (h_cut : PacketCutDecompositionValid M_atom)
    (h_coh : CoherentStripMassBoundValid) :
    ∃ (C_star C_cell : ℝ), 2 ≤ C_star ∧ 2 ≤ C_cell ∧
      (∀ (ν κ t₀ h α_cap δ_out : ℝ),
        0 < ν → 0 < κ → 0 < t₀ → t₀ ≤ min (ν / 2) (1 / 8) →
        0 < h → h ≤ t₀ / 4 → C_star * h < γ * (ν / 4) → 0 < α_cap → 0 < δ_out →
        ∃ Δ_in : ℝ, 0 < Δ_in ∧
          ∀ cls : PacketBoundClass,
            ∃ ε_init : ℝ, 0 < ε_init ∧ ε_init < 1 / 2 ∧
              ∀ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ) (m_init : ℕ)
                (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
                (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
                (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
                (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
                ε < ε_init → 1 ≤ H_P → 1 ≤ L →
                IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
                cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_init)⁻¹ →
                ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_init)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) →
                IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L 1 cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                  lam_sys m_init Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
                generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                  quantumPacketRate γ - Δ_in ≤
                  generalPacketScore ε γ H_P 1 lam_sys m_init Φ₀ f
                    N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
                HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f →
                IsCutChainState γ (nextPacketClass M_atom cls) ε H_P L t₀ h lam_sys
                  C_cell 1 Φ₀ f δ_out 0 α_cap) ∧
      (∀ (ν κ t h ε_err δ_out : ℝ),
        0 < ν → 0 < κ → 0 < h → 2 * h < t → t ≤ min (ν / 2) (1 / 8) →
        C_star * h < γ * (ν / 4) → 0 < ε_err → ε_err ≤ 1 → 0 < δ_out →
        let α_cap := (ε_err * h) / (8 * C_star)
        ∃ δ_in : ℝ, 0 < δ_in ∧
          ∀ cls : PacketBoundClass,
            ∃ ε_step : ℝ, 0 < ε_step ∧ ε_step < 1 / 2 ∧
              ∀ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ)
                (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
                (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (k_f : ℝ),
                ε < ε_step → 1 ≤ H_P → 1 ≤ L →
                IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
                HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f →
                0 ≤ k_f → k_f ≤ (1 + ε_err) * h →
                IsCutChainState γ cls ε H_P L t h lam_sys C_cell 1 Φ₀ f δ_in k_f α_cap →
                ∃ k_next : ℝ,
                  0 ≤ k_next ∧ k_next ≤ (1 + ε_err) * h ∧
                  k_f + (4 * quantumPacketRate γ - 2 * γ - ε_err) * h ≤ k_next ∧
                  IsCutChainState γ (nextPacketClass M_atom cls) ε H_P L (t - 2 * h) h lam_sys
                    C_cell 1 Φ₀ f δ_out k_next α_cap) ∧
      (∀ (h α_cap δ_out : ℝ),
        0 < h → h ≤ 1 / 32 → 0 < α_cap → 0 < δ_out →
        ∃ (ν_init κ_init : ℝ), 0 < ν_init ∧ 0 < κ_init ∧
          ∀ τ_no : ℝ, 0 < τ_no →
            ∃ Δ_in : ℝ, 0 < Δ_in ∧
              ∀ cls : PacketBoundClass,
                ∃ ε_init : ℝ, 0 < ε_init ∧ ε_init < 1 / 2 ∧
                  ∀ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ) (m_init : ℕ)
                    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
                    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
                    (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
                    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
                    ε < ε_init → 1 ≤ H_P → 1 ≤ L →
                    IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
                    LocalNonForcedAtScale γ (localRescaledClass cls (7 / 8))
                      (7 / 8) ν_init κ_init τ_no ε →
                    cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_init)⁻¹ →
                    ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_init)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) →
                    IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L 1 cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                      lam_sys m_init Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →

proof.tactics:
by
  have pktRound2D_err : ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖x - gridPt2D s (pktRound2D s x)‖ ≤ s := by
    intro s hs x
    let k := pktRound2D s x
    have h0 : |x.ofLp 0 - s * (k.1 : ℝ)| ≤ (1 / 2) * s := by
      have hfl : (k.1 : ℝ) ≤ s⁻¹ * x 0 + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
      have hlt : s⁻¹ * x 0 + 1 / 2 < (k.1 : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfl hs.le
      have hm2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hs
      have hmul : s * (s⁻¹ * x 0 + 1 / 2) = x.ofLp 0 + (1 / 2) * s := by
        field_simp [hs.ne']
      rw [hmul] at hm1 hm2
      rw [mul_add, mul_one] at hm2
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hm1], by linarith only [hm2]⟩
    have h1 : |x.ofLp 1 - s * (k.2 : ℝ)| ≤ (1 / 2) * s := by
      have hfl : (k.2 : ℝ) ≤ s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
      have hlt : s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2 < (k.2 : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfl hs.le
      have hm2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hs
      have hmul : s * (s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2) = x.ofLp 1 + (1 / 2) * s := by
        field_simp [hs.ne']
      rw [hmul] at hm1 hm2
      rw [mul_add, mul_one] at hm2
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hm1], by linarith only [hm2]⟩
    have hsq : ‖x - gridPt2D s k‖ ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hc0 : (x - gridPt2D s k).ofLp 0 = x.ofLp 0 - s * (k.1 : ℝ) := by simp [gridPt2D]
      have hc1 : (x - gridPt2D s k).ofLp 1 = x.ofLp 1 - s * (k.2 : ℝ) := by simp [gridPt2D]
      rw [hc0, hc1, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h0_nn : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hs.le
      have h0s : |x.ofLp 0 - s * (k.1 : ℝ)| ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / 2) * s) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_abs, abs_of_nonneg h0_nn])
      have h1s : |x.ofLp 1 - s * (k.2 : ℝ)| ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / 2) * s) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_abs, abs_of_nonneg h0_nn])
      nlinarith only [h0s, h1s]
    have h_nn := norm_nonneg (x - gridPt2D s k)
    nlinarith only [hsq, h_nn, hs]
  have admissible_obs_site_count_bound : ∀ (B_sys K_hor : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ),
      2 ≤ B_sys → 1 ≤ K_hor → 1 ≤ N_mult →
      ∃ C_cnt : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_cnt ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
          0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
          0 ≤ t → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor →
          0 < lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
          B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
        ∀ (N_O : ℕ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
          (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ B_sys) →
          (let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
           let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
           ∀ (r : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
             ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
               r_O o = r ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤
               (N_mult : ℝ)) →
          (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * K_hor)) := by
    intro B_sys K_hor N_mult hB_sys hK_hor hN_mult
    let C_cnt : ℝ := 2401 * (N_mult : ℝ) * B_sys ^ 7
    have hN_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN_mult
    have hB_pos : 0 < B_sys := by linarith
    have hB7_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ B_sys ^ 7 := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ B_sys)
    have hC_cnt_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_cnt := by dsimp [C_cnt]; nlinarith
    refine ⟨C_cnt, hC_cnt_ge1, ?_⟩
    intro ε H_P t lam_sys m_time hε_pos hε_half ht0 htH hHK hlam_pos hlam_hi hm_lo
      N_O r_O V_O X_O h_bound h_pack
    have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
    let ρ_obs : ℝ := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
    let σ_obs : ℝ := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ_obs := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _
    have hσ_pos : 0 < σ_obs := inv_pos.mpr (mul_pos hlam_pos hρ_pos)
    let L_V : ℝ := B_sys * ε ^ (-((H_P - t) / 2))
    let L_X : ℝ := B_sys ^ 2 * ε ^ (-((H_P + t) / 2))
    have h_expV_ge1 : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-((H_P - t) / 2)) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ ≤ ε ^ (-((H_P - t) / 2)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith)
    have h_expX_ge1 : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-((H_P + t) / 2)) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ ≤ ε ^ (-((H_P + t) / 2)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith)
    have hLV_ge1 : 1 ≤ L_V := by dsimp [L_V]; nlinarith
    have hLX_ge1 : 1 ≤ L_X := by
      have : 4 ≤ B_sys ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      dsimp [L_X]; nlinarith
    have h_rho_inv_B : ρ_obs⁻¹ * B_sys = L_V := by
      dsimp [ρ_obs, L_V]
      rw [← Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le, mul_comm]
    have h_sig_inv_B : σ_obs⁻¹ * B_sys ≤ L_X := by
      dsimp [σ_obs, L_X]
      rw [inv_inv]
      calc lam_sys * ρ_obs * B_sys
          ≤ (B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P)) * ρ_obs * B_sys := by
            gcongr
        _ = B_sys ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-H_P) * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)) := by dsimp [ρ_obs]; ring
        _ = B_sys ^ 2 * ε ^ (-((H_P + t) / 2)) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
            congr 2; ring
    have h_floor_mem : ∀ (M u : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → |u| ≤ M →
        ⌊u + 1 / 2⌋ ∈ Finset.Icc (-((⌈M⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((⌈M⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      intro M u _ hu
      obtain ⟨hu1, hu2⟩ := abs_le.mp hu
      have hMc : M ≤ (⌈M⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil M
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      refine ⟨Int.le_floor.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
      · push_cast; linarith
      · exact Int.cast_le (R := ℝ).mp (le_trans (Int.floor_le _) (by push_cast; linarith))
    have h_icc_card : ∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M →
        ((Finset.Icc (-((⌈M⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((⌈M⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).card : ℝ) ≤ 7 * M := by
      intro M hM
      rw [Int.card_Icc]
      have h_toNat : (((⌈M⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 - -((⌈M⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).toNat =
          2 * ⌈M⌉₊ + 3 := by omega
      rw [h_toNat]
      have h_ceil : (⌈M⌉₊ : ℝ) < M + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith)
      push_cast
      linarith
    let B_V : ℕ := ⌈L_V⌉₊ + 1
    let B_X : ℕ := ⌈L_X⌉₊ + 1
    let I_V : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-(B_V : ℤ)) (B_V : ℤ)
    let I_X : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-(B_X : ℤ)) (B_X : ℤ)
    let box := Finset.range (2 ^ m_time) ×ˢ ((I_V ×ˢ I_V) ×ˢ (I_X ×ˢ I_X))
    let Φ : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun o =>
      (r_O o, pktRound2D ρ_obs (V_O o), pktRound2D σ_obs (X_O o))
    have h_maps : ∀ o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)), Φ o ∈ box := by
      intro o _
      obtain ⟨hr_o, hV_o, hX_o⟩ := h_bound o
      have hV_coord : ∀ i : Fin 2, |ρ_obs⁻¹ * (V_O o) i| ≤ L_V := by
        intro i
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hρ_pos)]
        have hi : |(V_O o) i| ≤ B_sys := by
          calc |(V_O o) i| = ‖(V_O o).ofLp i‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
            _ ≤ ‖V_O o‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le (V_O o) i
            _ ≤ B_sys := hV_o
        calc ρ_obs⁻¹ * |(V_O o) i| ≤ ρ_obs⁻¹ * B_sys :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_pos.le)
          _ = L_V := h_rho_inv_B
      have hX_coord : ∀ i : Fin 2, |σ_obs⁻¹ * (X_O o) i| ≤ L_X := by
        intro i
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hσ_pos)]
        have hi : |(X_O o) i| ≤ B_sys := by
          calc |(X_O o) i| = ‖(X_O o).ofLp i‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
            _ ≤ ‖X_O o‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le (X_O o) i
            _ ≤ B_sys := hX_o
        calc σ_obs⁻¹ * |(X_O o) i| ≤ σ_obs⁻¹ * B_sys :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (inv_nonneg.mpr hσ_pos.le)
          _ ≤ L_X := h_sig_inv_B
      simp only [box, Φ, pktRound2D, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨hr_o,
        ⟨h_floor_mem L_V _ (by linarith) (hV_coord 0), h_floor_mem L_V _ (by linarith) (hV_coord 1)⟩,
        ⟨h_floor_mem L_X _ (by linarith) (hX_coord 0), h_floor_mem L_X _ (by linarith) (hX_coord 1)⟩⟩
    have h_fib_le : ∀ q ∈ box,
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => Φ o = q)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ) := by
      intro q _
      have h_sub : Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => Φ o = q) ⊆
          Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
            r_O o = q.1 ∧ ‖V_O o - gridPt2D ρ_obs q.2.1‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧
              ‖X_O o - gridPt2D σ_obs q.2.2‖ ≤ σ_obs) := by
        intro o ho
        have hq : Φ o = q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2
        have hr : r_O o = q.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hq
        have hkv : pktRound2D ρ_obs (V_O o) = q.2.1 := congrArg (fun p => p.2.1) hq
        have hkx : pktRound2D σ_obs (X_O o) = q.2.2 := congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) hq
        refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, hr, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← hkv]; exact pktRound2D_err ρ_obs hρ_pos (V_O o)
        · rw [← hkx]; exact pktRound2D_err σ_obs hσ_pos (X_O o)
      exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card h_sub)
        (h_pack q.1 (gridPt2D ρ_obs q.2.1) (gridPt2D σ_obs q.2.2))
    have h_NO_le_box : (N_O : ℝ) ≤ (box.card : ℝ) * (N_mult : ℝ) := by
      have h_sum_eq : (N_O : ℝ) = ∑ _o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)), (1 : ℝ) := by simp
      rw [h_sum_eq, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps]
      calc ∑ q ∈ box, ∑ _o ∈ Finset.univ with Φ _o = q, (1 : ℝ)
          = ∑ q ∈ box, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => Φ o = q)).card : ℝ) := by simp
        _ ≤ ∑ _q ∈ box, (N_mult : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib_le
        _ = (box.card : ℝ) * (N_mult : ℝ) := by simp
    have h_2m_le : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_time ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-t) := by
      have h_lhs_pos : 0 < B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hB_pos) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos t)
      have h_inv := inv_anti₀ h_lhs_pos hm_lo
      rw [inv_inv, mul_inv, inv_inv, ← Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le] at h_inv
