    have hT_pos : 0 < T := by dsimp [T]; linarith
    let v_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ s : ℂ))
    let v'_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => Complex.I * ((deriv θ s : ℝ) : ℂ) * v_c s
    have hv_hd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt v_c (v'_c s) s := by
      intro s
      have hθ_d : HasDerivAt θ (deriv θ s) s :=
        ((hθ_sm 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have h_ofR : HasDerivAt (fun s' => (θ s' : ℂ)) ((deriv θ s : ℝ) : ℂ) s :=
        Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hθ_d
      have h_exp := (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (Complex.I * (θ s : ℂ))).comp s
        (h_ofR.const_mul Complex.I)
      change HasDerivAt v_c _ s at h_exp
      convert h_exp using 1
      dsimp [v'_c, v_c]; ring
    have hv'_cont : Continuous v'_c := by
      dsimp [v'_c, v_c]
      exact (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hθ'_sm 0).continuous)).mul
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hθ_sm 0).continuous)))
    have h_one_step : ∀ (N : ℕ), N ≤ 3 → ∀ (M : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 ≤ M k) →
        ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w) →
          (∀ s : ℝ, R < |s| → w s = 0) →
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N + 1 → ∀ s : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k w s| ≤ M k) →
          ∃ w_nx : ℝ → ℝ,
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w_nx) ∧
            (∀ s : ℝ, R < |s| → w_nx s = 0) ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → ∀ s : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k w_nx s| ≤ S_tbl M k) ∧
            L * ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ =
              ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w_nx s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ := by
      intro N hN M hM_nn w hw_sm hw_supp hw_bd
      let h_st : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (ψ_θ s)⁻¹ * w s
      let w_nx : ℝ → ℝ := deriv h_st
      have hh_sm : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k h_st := fun k =>
        ((hψ_sm k).inv hψ_ne).mul (hw_sm k)
      have hwnx_sm : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w_nx := by
        intro k
        have hc : ContDiff ℝ ((k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) h_st := by exact_mod_cast hh_sm (k + 1)
        exact hc.deriv'
      have hh_supp : ∀ s : ℝ, R < |s| → h_st s = 0 := by
        intro s hs
        dsimp [h_st]
        rw [hw_supp s hs, mul_zero]
      have hwnx_supp : ∀ s : ℝ, R < |s| → w_nx s = 0 := by
        intro s₀ hs₀
        have hU_open : IsOpen {s : ℝ | R < |s|} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_abs
        have h_ev : h_st =ᶠ[nhds s₀] (0 : ℝ → ℝ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU_open.mem_nhds hs₀) (fun s hs => hh_supp s hs)
        dsimp [w_nx]
        rw [h_ev.deriv_eq, deriv_zero]
        rfl
      have h_prod : (fun s => ψ_θ s * h_st s) = w := by
        ext s; dsimp [h_st]; rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hψ_ne s), one_mul]
      have hwnx_bd : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → ∀ s : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k w_nx s| ≤ S_tbl M k := by
        intro k hk s
        have h_abs_p0 : ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ |ψ_θ s * x| := by
          intro x
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith [hψ_ge1 s] : 0 < ψ_θ s)]
          exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (abs_nonneg x) (hψ_ge1 s)
        have h_sub_tri : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a - b| ≤ |a| + |b| := by
          intro a b
          rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
          exact (abs_add_le a (-b)).trans (by rw [abs_neg])
        have h_leib : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n w s =
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (n.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i ψ_θ s * iteratedDeriv (n - i) h_st s := by
          intro n
          rw [← h_prod]
          exact iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (hψ_sm n).contDiffAt (hh_sm n).contDiffAt
        let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => iteratedDeriv n h_st s
        let p : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => iteratedDeriv j ψ_θ s
        have hd0 : |d 0| ≤ H_tbl M 0 := by
          have hl0 : ψ_θ s * h_st s = w s := congrFun h_prod s
          calc |d 0| = |h_st s| := by dsimp [d]; rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
            _ ≤ |ψ_θ s * h_st s| := h_abs_p0 _
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 0 w s| := by rw [hl0, iteratedDeriv_zero]
            _ ≤ M 0 := hw_bd 0 (Nat.zero_le _) s
            _ = H_tbl M 0 := rfl
        have hd1 : 1 ≤ N + 1 → |d 1| ≤ H_tbl M 1 := by
          intro hn1
          have hl1 := h_leib 1
          simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, zero_add,
            Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero,
            Nat.sub_self, iteratedDeriv_zero] at hl1
          have h_eq : ψ_θ s * d 1 = iteratedDeriv 1 w s - p 1 * d 0 := by
            dsimp [d, p]; rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]; linarith
          calc |d 1| ≤ |ψ_θ s * d 1| := h_abs_p0 _
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 1 w s - p 1 * d 0| := by rw [h_eq]
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 1 w s| + |p 1 * d 0| := h_sub_tri _ _
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 1 w s| + |p 1| * |d 0| := by rw [abs_mul]
            _ ≤ M 1 + D' 1 * H_tbl M 0 := add_le_add (hw_bd 1 hn1 s)
                (mul_le_mul (hψ_hi 1 (by omega) (by omega) s) hd0 (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 1))
            _ = H_tbl M 1 := rfl
        have hd2 : 2 ≤ N + 1 → |d 2| ≤ H_tbl M 2 := by
          intro hn2
          have hl2 := h_leib 2
          simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, zero_add,
            Nat.choose, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self,
            iteratedDeriv_zero] at hl2
          push_cast at hl2
          have h_eq : ψ_θ s * d 2 = iteratedDeriv 2 w s - (2 * p 1 * d 1 + p 2 * d 0) := by
            dsimp [d, p]; rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]; linarith
          have h1_bd := hd1 (by omega)
          calc |d 2| ≤ |ψ_θ s * d 2| := h_abs_p0 _
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 2 w s - (2 * p 1 * d 1 + p 2 * d 0)| := by rw [h_eq]
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 2 w s| + |2 * p 1 * d 1 + p 2 * d 0| := h_sub_tri _ _
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 2 w s| + (|2 * p 1 * d 1| + |p 2 * d 0|) :=
                add_le_add le_rfl (abs_add_le _ _)
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 2 w s| + 2 * |p 1| * |d 1| + |p 2| * |d 0| := by
                rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]; ring
            _ ≤ M 2 + 2 * D' 1 * H_tbl M 1 + D' 2 * H_tbl M 0 := by
                have hp1 := hψ_hi 1 (by omega) (by omega) s
                have hp2 := hψ_hi 2 (by omega) (by omega) s
                have hm1 : |p 1| * |d 1| ≤ D' 1 * H_tbl M 1 :=
                  mul_le_mul hp1 h1_bd (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 1)
                have hm2 : |p 2| * |d 0| ≤ D' 2 * H_tbl M 0 :=
                  mul_le_mul hp2 hd0 (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 2)
                linarith [hw_bd 2 hn2 s]
            _ = H_tbl M 2 := rfl
        have hd3 : 3 ≤ N + 1 → |d 3| ≤ H_tbl M 3 := by
          intro hn3
          have hl3 := h_leib 3
          simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, zero_add,
            Nat.choose, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self,
            iteratedDeriv_zero] at hl3
          push_cast at hl3
          have h_eq : ψ_θ s * d 3 =
              iteratedDeriv 3 w s - (3 * p 1 * d 2 + 3 * p 2 * d 1 + p 3 * d 0) := by
            dsimp [d, p]; rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]; linarith
          have h1_bd := hd1 (by omega)
          have h2_bd := hd2 (by omega)
          calc |d 3| ≤ |ψ_θ s * d 3| := h_abs_p0 _
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 3 w s - (3 * p 1 * d 2 + 3 * p 2 * d 1 + p 3 * d 0)| := by rw [h_eq]
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 3 w s| + |3 * p 1 * d 2 + 3 * p 2 * d 1 + p 3 * d 0| := h_sub_tri _ _
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 3 w s| +
                  (|3 * p 1 * d 2 + 3 * p 2 * d 1| + |p 3 * d 0|) :=
                add_le_add le_rfl (abs_add_le _ _)
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 3 w s| +
                  ((|3 * p 1 * d 2| + |3 * p 2 * d 1|) + |p 3 * d 0|) :=
                add_le_add le_rfl (add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 3 w s| + 3 * |p 1| * |d 2| + 3 * |p 2| * |d 1| + |p 3| * |d 0| := by
                simp only [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]; ring
            _ ≤ M 3 + 3 * D' 1 * H_tbl M 2 + 3 * D' 2 * H_tbl M 1 + D' 3 * H_tbl M 0 := by
                have hm1 : |p 1| * |d 2| ≤ D' 1 * H_tbl M 2 :=
                  mul_le_mul (hψ_hi 1 (by omega) (by omega) s) h2_bd (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 1)
                have hm2 : |p 2| * |d 1| ≤ D' 2 * H_tbl M 1 :=
                  mul_le_mul (hψ_hi 2 (by omega) (by omega) s) h1_bd (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 2)
                have hm3 : |p 3| * |d 0| ≤ D' 3 * H_tbl M 0 :=
                  mul_le_mul (hψ_hi 3 (by omega) (by omega) s) hd0 (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 3)
                linarith [hw_bd 3 hn3 s]
            _ = H_tbl M 3 := rfl
        have hd4 : 4 ≤ N + 1 → |d 4| ≤ H_tbl M 4 := by
          intro hn4
          have hl4 := h_leib 4
          simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, zero_add,
            Nat.choose, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self,
            iteratedDeriv_zero] at hl4
          push_cast at hl4
          have h_eq : ψ_θ s * d 4 = iteratedDeriv 4 w s -
              (4 * p 1 * d 3 + 6 * p 2 * d 2 + 4 * p 3 * d 1 + p 4 * d 0) := by
            dsimp [d, p]; rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]; linarith
          have h1_bd := hd1 (by omega)
          have h2_bd := hd2 (by omega)
          have h3_bd := hd3 (by omega)
          calc |d 4| ≤ |ψ_θ s * d 4| := h_abs_p0 _
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 4 w s -
                  (4 * p 1 * d 3 + 6 * p 2 * d 2 + 4 * p 3 * d 1 + p 4 * d 0)| := by rw [h_eq]
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 4 w s| +
                  |4 * p 1 * d 3 + 6 * p 2 * d 2 + 4 * p 3 * d 1 + p 4 * d 0| := h_sub_tri _ _
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 4 w s| +
                  (|4 * p 1 * d 3 + 6 * p 2 * d 2 + 4 * p 3 * d 1| + |p 4 * d 0|) :=
                add_le_add le_rfl (abs_add_le _ _)
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 4 w s| +
                  ((|4 * p 1 * d 3 + 6 * p 2 * d 2| + |4 * p 3 * d 1|) + |p 4 * d 0|) :=
                add_le_add le_rfl (add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
            _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 4 w s| +
                  (((|4 * p 1 * d 3| + |6 * p 2 * d 2|) + |4 * p 3 * d 1|) + |p 4 * d 0|) :=
                add_le_add le_rfl
                  (add_le_add (add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl) le_rfl)
            _ = |iteratedDeriv 4 w s| +
                  4 * |p 1| * |d 3| + 6 * |p 2| * |d 2| + 4 * |p 3| * |d 1| + |p 4| * |d 0| := by
                simp only [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4),
                  abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]; ring
            _ ≤ M 4 + 4 * D' 1 * H_tbl M 3 + 6 * D' 2 * H_tbl M 2 +
                  4 * D' 3 * H_tbl M 1 + D' 4 * H_tbl M 0 := by
                have hm1 : |p 1| * |d 3| ≤ D' 1 * H_tbl M 3 :=
                  mul_le_mul (hψ_hi 1 (by omega) (by omega) s) h3_bd (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 1)
                have hm2 : |p 2| * |d 2| ≤ D' 2 * H_tbl M 2 :=
                  mul_le_mul (hψ_hi 2 (by omega) (by omega) s) h2_bd (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 2)
                have hm3 : |p 3| * |d 1| ≤ D' 3 * H_tbl M 1 :=
                  mul_le_mul (hψ_hi 3 (by omega) (by omega) s) h1_bd (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 3)
                have hm4 : |p 4| * |d 0| ≤ D' 4 * H_tbl M 0 :=
                  mul_le_mul (hψ_hi 4 (by omega) (by omega) s) hd0 (abs_nonneg _) (hD'_nn 4)
                linarith [hw_bd 4 hn4 s]
            _ = H_tbl M 4 := rfl
        have h_id_succ : iteratedDeriv k w_nx s = d (k + 1) := by
          dsimp [w_nx, d]
          rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
        rw [h_id_succ]
        have hk3 : k ≤ 3 := le_trans hk hN
        interval_cases k
        · exact hd1 (by omega)
        · exact hd2 (by omega)
        · exact hd3 (by omega)
        · exact hd4 (by omega)
      have h_ibp_eq : L * ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ =
          ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w_nx s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ := by
        let u_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => (h_st s : ℂ)
        let u'_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => (w_nx s : ℂ)
        have hu_hd : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc (-T) T, HasDerivAt u_c (u'_c s) s := by
          intro s _
          have hd : HasDerivAt h_st (w_nx s) s :=
            ((hh_sm 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
          exact Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hd
        have hu'_int : IntervalIntegrable u'_c MeasureTheory.volume (-T) T :=
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hwnx_sm 0).continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _
        have hv'_int : IntervalIntegrable v'_c MeasureTheory.volume (-T) T :=
          hv'_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _
        have h_ibp := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
          hu_hd (fun s _ => hv_hd s) hu'_int hv'_int
        have hT_gt : R < |T| := by rw [abs_of_pos hT_pos]; dsimp [T]; linarith
        have hmT_gt : R < |-T| := by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hT_pos]; dsimp [T]; linarith
        have huT : u_c T = 0 := by dsimp [u_c]; rw [hh_supp T hT_gt, Complex.ofReal_zero]
        have humT : u_c (-T) = 0 := by dsimp [u_c]; rw [hh_supp (-T) hmT_gt, Complex.ofReal_zero]
        rw [huT, humT, zero_mul, zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_sub] at h_ibp
        have h_lhs_fn : (fun s => u_c s * v'_c s) =
            fun s => (Complex.I * (L : ℂ)) * ((w s : ℂ) * v_c s) := by
          ext s
          dsimp [u_c, v'_c]
          have h_real : h_st s * deriv θ s = L * w s := by
            have : deriv θ s = L * ψ_θ s := by dsimp [ψ_θ]; field_simp [hL.ne']
            rw [this]
            dsimp [h_st]
            have hne := hψ_ne s
            field_simp [hne]
          have h_cast : (h_st s : ℂ) * ((deriv θ s : ℝ) : ℂ) = (L : ℂ) * (w s : ℂ) := by
            exact_mod_cast h_real
          calc (h_st s : ℂ) * (Complex.I * ((deriv θ s : ℝ) : ℂ) * v_c s)
              = Complex.I * ((h_st s : ℂ) * ((deriv θ s : ℝ) : ℂ)) * v_c s := by ring
            _ = (Complex.I * (L : ℂ)) * ((w s : ℂ) * v_c s) := by rw [h_cast]; ring
        rw [h_lhs_fn, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_ibp
        have h_norm := congrArg (‖·‖) h_ibp
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le, norm_neg] at h_norm
        exact h_norm
      exact ⟨w_nx, hwnx_sm, hwnx_supp, hwnx_bd, h_ibp_eq⟩
    have h_four_steps : ∀ w₀ : ℝ → ℝ,
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w₀) →
        (∀ s : ℝ, R < |s| → w₀ s = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 4 → ∀ s : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k w₀ s| ≤ M0 k) →
        ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₀ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ ≤ (2 * (R + 1) * M4 0) / L ^ 4 := by
      intro w₀ hw₀_sm hw₀_supp hw₀_bd
      obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁_sm, hw₁_supp, hw₁_bd, h_eq1⟩ :=
        h_one_step 3 (le_refl 3) M0 hM0_nn w₀ hw₀_sm hw₀_supp hw₀_bd
      obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂_sm, hw₂_supp, hw₂_bd, h_eq2⟩ :=
        h_one_step 2 (by omega) M1 hM1_nn w₁ hw₁_sm hw₁_supp hw₁_bd
      obtain ⟨w₃, hw₃_sm, hw₃_supp, hw₃_bd, h_eq3⟩ :=
        h_one_step 1 (by omega) M2 hM2_nn w₂ hw₂_sm hw₂_supp hw₂_bd
      obtain ⟨w₄, _, _, hw₄_bd, h_eq4⟩ :=
        h_one_step 0 (by omega) M3 hM3_nn w₃ hw₃_sm hw₃_supp hw₃_bd
      have hL4 : L ^ 4 * ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₀ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ =
          ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₄ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ := by
        calc L ^ 4 * ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₀ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖
            = L ^ 3 * (L * ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₀ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖) := by ring
          _ = L ^ 2 * (L * ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₁ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖) := by rw [h_eq1]; ring
          _ = L * (L * ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₂ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖) := by rw [h_eq2]; ring
          _ = L * ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₃ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ := by rw [h_eq3]
          _ = ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₄ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ := h_eq4
      have h_term : ‖∫ s in (-T)..T, (w₄ s : ℂ) * v_c s‖ ≤ 2 * (R + 1) * M4 0 := by
        have h_int_bd := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
          (a := -T) (b := T) (C := M4 0) (f := fun s => (w₄ s : ℂ) * v_c s)
          (fun s _ => by
            dsimp [v_c]
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one]
            simpa using hw₄_bd 0 (le_refl 0) s)
        have habs : |T - (-T)| = 2 * (R + 1) := by
          have : T - (-T) = 2 * (R + 1) := by dsimp [T]; ring
          rw [this, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
        rw [habs] at h_int_bd
        linarith
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hL 4), mul_comm]
      linarith
    have h_clm_iter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (Λ_c : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℂ),
        (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ m g) →
        ∀ s : ℝ, iteratedDeriv k (fun t => Λ_c (g t)) s = Λ_c (iteratedDeriv k g s) := by
      intro k Λ_c
      induction k with
      | zero => intro g _ s; rfl
      | succ k ih =>
        intro g hg s
        have hg' : ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ m (deriv g) := by
          intro m
          have hc : ContDiff ℝ ((m : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) g := by exact_mod_cast hg (m + 1)
          exact hc.deriv'
        have h_d : deriv (fun t => Λ_c (g t)) = fun t => Λ_c (deriv g t) := by
          ext t
          have hd : HasDerivAt g (deriv g t) t :=
            ((hg 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
          exact (Λ_c.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hd).deriv
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', h_d, ih (deriv g) hg' s, ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
    let u_re : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Complex.reCLM (u s)
    let u_im : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Complex.imCLM (u s)
    have h_re_bd := h_four_steps u_re
      (fun k => Complex.reCLM.contDiff.comp (hu_sm k))
      (fun s hs => by change Complex.reCLM (u s) = 0; rw [hu_supp s hs.le, map_zero])
      (fun k hk s => by
        change |iteratedDeriv k (fun t => Complex.reCLM (u t)) s| ≤ M0 k
        rw [h_clm_iter k Complex.reCLM u hu_sm s]
        exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans ((hu_bd k hk s).trans (le_max_left _ _)))
    have h_im_bd := h_four_steps u_im
      (fun k => Complex.imCLM.contDiff.comp (hu_sm k))
      (fun s hs => by change Complex.imCLM (u s) = 0; rw [hu_supp s hs.le, map_zero])
      (fun k hk s => by
        change |iteratedDeriv k (fun t => Complex.imCLM (u t)) s| ≤ M0 k

          = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (ψ_O o) (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_O o))‖ :=
            norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero.symm
        _ ≤ M_win 0 := hO_deriv o 0 _
        _ ≤ max (M_win 0) 0 := le_max_left _ _
    dsimp [M₀]
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hψ_le (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_pos.le)
  have hg_supp : ∀ o ∈ S, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      v ∉ Metric.closedBall (V_O o) (R_win * ρ_obs) → g o v = 0 := by
    intro o _ v hv
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hv
    have hlt : R_win * ρ_obs < ‖v - V_O o‖ := lt_of_not_ge hv
    have hn : R_win ≤ ‖ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_pos.le)]
      exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hρ_pos).mpr (by linarith)
    simp [g, hO_supp o _ hn]
  have h_gram_int : ∀ o₁ ∈ S, ∀ o₂ ∈ S,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => g o₁ v * star (g o₂ v)) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro o₁ _ o₂ _
    exact (h_slice lam_sys ρ_obs C_box hρ_pos Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont (V_O o₁) (X_O o₁) (V_O o₂) (X_O o₂)
      (ψ_O o₁) (ψ_O o₂) (hO_smooth o₁) (hO_supp o₁) (hO_deriv o₁)
      (hO_smooth o₂) (hO_supp o₂) (hO_deriv o₂)).1
  have h_gram_disj : ∀ o₁ ∈ S, ∀ o₂ ∈ S,
      2 * R_win * ρ_obs ≤ ‖V_O o₁ - V_O o₂‖ →
        ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g o₁ v * star (g o₂ v) = 0 := by
    intro o₁ _ o₂ _
    exact (h_slice lam_sys ρ_obs C_box hρ_pos Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont (V_O o₁) (X_O o₁) (V_O o₂) (X_O o₂)
      (ψ_O o₁) (ψ_O o₂) (hO_smooth o₁) (hO_supp o₁) (hO_deriv o₁)
      (hO_smooth o₂) (hO_supp o₂) (hO_deriv o₂)).2.1
  have h_gram_decay : ∀ o₁ ∈ S, ∀ o₂ ∈ S,
      ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g o₁ v * star (g o₂ v)‖ ≤
        C_pair / (1 + σ_obs⁻¹ * ‖X_O o₁ - X_O o₂‖) ^ 4 := by
    intro o₁ _ o₂ _
    obtain ⟨_, _, h_triv12, h_rot12⟩ :=
      h_slice lam_sys ρ_obs C_box hρ_pos Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont (V_O o₁) (X_O o₁) (V_O o₂) (X_O o₂)
        (ψ_O o₁) (ψ_O o₂) (hO_smooth o₁) (hO_supp o₁) (hO_deriv o₁)
        (hO_smooth o₂) (hO_supp o₂) (hO_deriv o₂)
    let K : ℝ := σ_obs⁻¹ * ‖X_O o₂ - X_O o₁‖
    have hK_eq : σ_obs⁻¹ * ‖X_O o₁ - X_O o₂‖ = K := by
      dsimp [K]; rw [norm_sub_rev]
    have hK_nn : 0 ≤ K := mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hσ_pos.le) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [hK_eq]
    by_cases hK : K ≤ 1
    · have h1K_pos : 0 < (1 + K) ^ 4 := by positivity
      have h1K_le : (1 + K) ^ 4 ≤ 16 := by
        calc (1 + K) ^ 4 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) 4
          _ = 16 := by norm_num
      calc ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g o₁ v * star (g o₂ v)‖
          ≤ C_triv := h_triv12
        _ = (C_triv * (1 + K) ^ 4) / (1 + K) ^ 4 := by field_simp [h1K_pos.ne']
        _ ≤ (16 * C_triv) / (1 + K) ^ 4 := by
            refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ h1K_pos.le
            nlinarith
        _ ≤ C_pair / (1 + K) ^ 4 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) h1K_pos.le
    · have hK_gt1 : 1 < K := lt_of_not_ge hK
      have hK_pos : 0 < K := by linarith
      let δX := X_O o₂ - X_O o₁
      have hδX_eq : ‖δX‖ = σ_obs * K := by
        dsimp [K, δX]; field_simp [hσ_pos.ne']
      have hδX_pos : 0 < ‖δX‖ := by rw [hδX_eq]; positivity
      let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := ‖δX‖⁻¹ • δX
      have hw : ‖w‖ = 1 := by
        dsimp [w]
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hδX_pos.le),
          inv_mul_cancel₀ hδX_pos.ne']
      have hX_diff : X_O o₂ - X_O o₁ = ((lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹ * K) • w := by
        change δX = (σ_obs * K) • (‖δX‖⁻¹ • δX)
        rw [← hδX_eq, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hδX_pos.ne', one_smul]
      have h_slice_est : ∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-R_win) R_win,
          ‖∫ s : ℝ,
            (star (ψ_O o₁ (s • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) *
              ψ_O o₂ (s • w + y₁ • perp2D w - ρ_obs⁻¹ • (V_O o₂ - V_O o₁))) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_O o₂, V_O o₁ + ρ_obs • (s • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) -
                Φ₀ (C_box, X_O o₁, V_O o₁ + ρ_obs • (s • w + y₁ • perp2D w))) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
            C_ibp / (a₀ * K) ^ 4 := by
        intro y₁ _
        obtain ⟨hu_sm, hu_supp, hu_bd⟩ := (h_rot12 w hw).1 y₁
        let V₀ := V_O o₁ + ρ_obs • (y₁ • perp2D w)
        obtain ⟨hθ_sm, hθ_lo, hθ_hi⟩ := h_phase_dir lam_sys ρ_obs C_box
          hlam_pos hρ_pos hρ_le1 hC_mem Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase V₀ (X_O o₁) (X_O o₂) w hw K hK_pos hX_diff
        have h_ibp_y := h_ibp (a₀ * K) (mul_pos ha₀ hK_pos) _ hθ_sm hθ_lo hθ_hi _
          hu_sm hu_supp hu_bd
        have h_v_aff : ∀ s : ℝ,
            V_O o₁ + ρ_obs • (s • w + y₁ • perp2D w) = V₀ + ρ_obs • (s • w) := by
          intro s
          dsimp [V₀]
          rw [smul_add]; abel
        simpa only [h_v_aff] using h_ibp_y
      have h_main_2d := (h_rot12 w hw).2 (C_ibp / (a₀ * K) ^ 4) (by positivity) h_slice_est
      have h1K_le_2K : (1 + K) ^ 4 ≤ 16 * K ^ 4 := by
        calc (1 + K) ^ 4 ≤ (2 * K) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) 4
          _ = 16 * K ^ 4 := by ring
      have h1K_pos : 0 < (1 + K) ^ 4 := by positivity
      have hK4_pos : 0 < K ^ 4 := pow_pos hK_pos 4
      calc ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g o₁ v * star (g o₂ v)‖
          ≤ 2 * R_win * (C_ibp / (a₀ * K) ^ 4) := h_main_2d
        _ = (32 * R_win * a₀⁻¹ ^ 4 * C_ibp) / (16 * K ^ 4) := by
            field_simp [ha₀.ne', hK4_pos.ne']; ring
        _ ≤ (32 * R_win * a₀⁻¹ ^ 4 * C_ibp) / (1 + K) ^ 4 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) h1K_pos h1K_le_2K
        _ ≤ C_pair / (1 + K) ^ 4 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) h1K_pos.le
  have h_bes := h_bessel ρ_obs σ_obs M₀ hρ_pos hσ_pos hM₀_nn N_O S V_O X_O g
    hS_pack hg_cont hg_norm hg_supp h_gram_int h_gram_disj h_gram_decay h hh_meas hh_sq
  have h_sum_eq : ∑ o ∈ S, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ h
        (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) =
      ∑ o ∈ S, ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), h v * star (g o v)‖ ^ 2 := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o ho => ?_)
    rw [hS_r o ho]
    unfold generalPacketObsMass
    dsimp only
    congr 1
    have h_pt : (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => h v * star (g o v)) =
        fun v => (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * (h v * ψ_O o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
      ext v
      dsimp [g, C_box, ρ_obs]
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_inv₀, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_conj,
        ← Complex.exp_conj, map_neg, map_mul, Complex.conj_I, Complex.conj_ofReal]
      have h_neg : -(-Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹,
          X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹,
            X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by ring
      rw [h_neg]
      ring
    rw [h_pt, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  rwa [h_sum_eq]

informal_problem.statement:
∃ C_χ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_χ ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) ∧
      (∀ (lam_sys R_dom : ℝ), 1 ≤ lam_sys → 1 ≤ R_dom →
        ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
          Continuous Φ₀ →
        ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
            Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2)) ∧
          (∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
            (∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2) =
              ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (∀ (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            Continuous g →
            (∃ R_g : ℝ, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_g ≤ ‖v‖ → g v = 0) →
            (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
                pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n *
                  ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * g v)) ∧
            ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), f v * g v =
              ∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
                ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n *
                  ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * g v) ∧
          (∀ (F : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
              (fun v => ∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun v => ‖∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              ‖∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v‖ ^ 2) ≤
              4 * ∑ q ∈ F, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  let activeCells2D : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
    fun w => ({⌊w 0⌋, ⌊w 0⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ) ×ˢ ({⌊w 1⌋, ⌊w 1⌋ + 1} : Finset ℤ)
  
  have h_part1 : ∃ C_χ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_χ ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 0 ≤ pktPou2D z ∧ pktPou2D z ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) ∧
      (∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        (activeCells2D w).card ≤ 4 ∧
        (∀ j : ℤ × ℤ, j ∉ activeCells2D w → pktPou2D (w - gridPt2D 1 j) = 0) ∧
        ∑ j ∈ activeCells2D w, (pktPou2D (w - gridPt2D 1 j)) ^ 2 = 1) := by
    have h_glue_nonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ expNegInvGlue t := by
      intro t
      rcases le_or_gt t 0 with h | h
      · rw [expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos h]
      · exact (expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos h).le
    have h_b1_nonneg : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ pktUnitBump1D s :=
      fun s => mul_nonneg (h_glue_nonneg _) (h_glue_nonneg _)
    have h_b1_supp : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ |s| → pktUnitBump1D s = 0 := by
      intro s hs
      unfold pktUnitBump1D pcGevrey2Bump
      rcases le_abs.mp hs with hs1 | hs2
      · rw [expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (x := 1 - (s + 1) / 2) (by linarith), mul_zero]
      · rw [expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (x := (s + 1) / 2) (by linarith), zero_mul]
    set β₀ : ℝ := expNegInvGlue (1 / 4) * expNegInvGlue (1 / 4)
    have h_qtr_pos : 0 < expNegInvGlue (1 / 4) := expNegInvGlue.pos_of_pos (by norm_num)
    have h_qtr_lt_one : expNegInvGlue (1 / 4) < 1 := by
      unfold expNegInvGlue
      rw [if_neg (by norm_num)]
      exact Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
    have hβ₀_pos : 0 < β₀ := mul_pos h_qtr_pos h_qtr_pos
    have hβ₀_lt_one : β₀ < 1 := by dsimp [β₀]; nlinarith
    have hβ₀_inv_ge_one : 1 ≤ β₀⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hβ₀_pos).mpr hβ₀_lt_one.le
    have hβ₀_inv_pos : 0 < β₀⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hβ₀_pos
    have h_b1_core : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 1 / 2 → β₀ ≤ pktUnitBump1D s := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨hs_lo, hs_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hs
      unfold pktUnitBump1D pcGevrey2Bump
      exact mul_le_mul (expNegInvGlue.monotone (by linarith))
        (expNegInvGlue.monotone (by linarith)) h_qtr_pos.le (h_glue_nonneg _)
    let J₁ : ℝ → Finset ℤ := fun s => {⌊s⌋, ⌊s⌋ + 1}
    let D₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∑' m : ℤ, (pktUnitBump1D (s - (m : ℝ))) ^ 2
    have h_J1_vanish : ∀ (s : ℝ) (m : ℤ), m ∉ J₁ s → pktUnitBump1D (s - (m : ℝ)) = 0 := by
      intro s m hm
      have hm_ne1 : m ≠ ⌊s⌋ := fun h => hm (by simp [J₁, h])
      have hm_ne2 : m ≠ ⌊s⌋ + 1 := fun h => hm (by simp [J₁, h])
      apply h_b1_supp
      have hfl1 : (⌊s⌋ : ℝ) ≤ s := Int.floor_le s
      have hfl2 : s < (⌊s⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one s
      rcases (by omega : m ≤ ⌊s⌋ - 1 ∨ ⌊s⌋ + 2 ≤ m) with hlo | hhi
      · have hm_r : (m : ℝ) ≤ (⌊s⌋ : ℝ) - 1 := by exact_mod_cast hlo
        exact le_trans (by linarith) (le_abs_self _)
      · have hm_r : (⌊s⌋ : ℝ) + 2 ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hhi
        exact le_trans (by linarith) (neg_le_abs _)
    have h_D1_hasSum : ∀ s : ℝ,
        HasSum (fun m : ℤ => (pktUnitBump1D (s - (m : ℝ))) ^ 2)
          (∑ m ∈ J₁ s, (pktUnitBump1D (s - (m : ℝ))) ^ 2) := by
      intro s
      refine hasSum_sum_of_ne_finset_zero (fun m hm => ?_)
      rw [h_J1_vanish s m hm, sq, zero_mul]
    have h_D1_summable : ∀ s : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℤ => (pktUnitBump1D (s - (m : ℝ))) ^ 2) :=
      fun s => (h_D1_hasSum s).summable
    have h_D1_eq_sum : ∀ s : ℝ, D₁ s = ∑ m ∈ J₁ s, (pktUnitBump1D (s - (m : ℝ))) ^ 2 :=
      fun s => (h_D1_hasSum s).tsum_eq
    have h_D1_floor : ∀ s : ℝ, β₀ ^ 2 ≤ D₁ s := by
      intro s
      let m₀ : ℤ := ⌊s + 1 / 2⌋
      have hm1 : (m₀ : ℝ) ≤ s + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le (s + 1 / 2)
      have hm2 : s + 1 / 2 < (m₀ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (s + 1 / 2)
      have habs : |s - (m₀ : ℝ)| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hcore := h_b1_core (s - (m₀ : ℝ)) habs
      have hsq : β₀ ^ 2 ≤ (pktUnitBump1D (s - (m₀ : ℝ))) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ hβ₀_pos.le hcore 2
      exact le_trans hsq ((h_D1_summable s).le_tsum m₀ (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
    have h_D1_pos : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < D₁ s :=

        exact Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp h_sum2_int
      have h_lhs_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (pktPou2D z) ^ 2 * ‖P_j z‖ ^ 2)
          MeasureTheory.volume := by
        have hc : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (pktPou2D z) ^ 2 * ‖P_j z‖ ^ 2) := by
          refine (h_pou_cont.pow 2).mul ((continuous_finsetSum N_j (fun n _ => ?_)).norm.pow 2)
          refine continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp ?_))
          exact continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
            (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.inner continuous_id)))
        refine hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
          (HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact
            (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 2) ?_)
        intro z hz
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        by_contra hnot
        push_neg at hnot
        exact hz (by rw [h_pou_supp z hnot.le]; ring)
      have h_mp_ofLp := PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin 2)
      have h_emb_ofLp : MeasurableEmbedding (WithLp.ofLp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) :=
        MeasurableEmbedding.of_measurable_inverse
          h_mp_ofLp.measurable
          (by rw [Set.range_eq_univ.mpr (fun u => ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 u, rfl⟩)]; exact MeasurableSet.univ)
          (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 2)).measurable
          (fun _ => rfl)
      have h_rhs_ofLp_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖Set.indicator Q₂ g₂ (WithLp.ofLp z)‖ ^ 2)
          MeasureTheory.volume :=
        h_mp_ofLp.integrable_comp_of_integrable h_ind_int
      have h_le_u : (∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), (pktPou2D z) ^ 2 * ‖P_j z‖ ^ 2) ≤
          ∫ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖Set.indicator Q₂ g₂ u‖ ^ 2 := by
        calc (∫ z, (pktPou2D z) ^ 2 * ‖P_j z‖ ^ 2)
            ≤ ∫ z, ‖Set.indicator Q₂ g₂ (WithLp.ofLp z)‖ ^ 2 :=
              MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_lhs_int h_rhs_ofLp_int h_dom_Q2
          _ = ∫ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖Set.indicator Q₂ g₂ u‖ ^ 2 :=
              h_mp_ofLp.integral_comp h_emb_ofLp (fun u => ‖Set.indicator Q₂ g₂ u‖ ^ 2)
      refine le_trans h_le_u (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [funext h_ind_expand, Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm h_sum2_int,
        MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum N_j (fun n _ =>
          MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum N_j (fun m _ =>
            (h_prod_int (m.1 - n.1) (m.2 - n.2)).const_mul _))]
      have h_inner_sum : ∀ n ∈ N_j,
          (∫ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ m ∈ N_j, (star (c (j, n)) * c (j, m)) *
            ∏ i : Fin 2, φ₁ (if i = 0 then m.1 - n.1 else m.2 - n.2) (u i)) =
            (‖c (j, n)‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) := by
        intro n hn
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum N_j (fun m _ =>
          (h_prod_int (m.1 - n.1) (m.2 - n.2)).const_mul _)]
        have h_each_m : ∀ m ∈ N_j,
            (∫ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, (star (c (j, n)) * c (j, m)) *
              ∏ i : Fin 2, φ₁ (if i = 0 then m.1 - n.1 else m.2 - n.2) (u i)) =
              if m = n then (‖c (j, n)‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) else 0 := by
          intro m _
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
            MeasureTheory.integral_fin_nat_prod_volume_eq_prod
              (fun (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) => φ₁ (if i = 0 then m.1 - n.1 else m.2 - n.2) t),
            Fin.prod_univ_two]
          simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, one_ne_zero]
          rw [h_phi1_eval (m.1 - n.1), h_phi1_eval (m.2 - n.2)]
          by_cases hmn : m = n
          · rw [hmn, sub_self, sub_self, if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl, mul_one, mul_one]
            change (starRingEnd ℂ) (c (j, n)) * c (j, n) = _
            rw [mul_comm, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
            push_cast; rfl
          · rw [if_neg hmn]
            have h_neq_coord : m.1 - n.1 ≠ 0 ∨ m.2 - n.2 ≠ 0 := by
              by_contra hboth
              push_neg at hboth
              exact hmn (Prod.ext (sub_eq_zero.mp hboth.1) (sub_eq_zero.mp hboth.2))
            rcases h_neq_coord with h1 | h2
            · rw [if_neg h1, zero_mul, mul_zero]
            · rw [if_neg h2, mul_zero, mul_zero]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_each_m, Finset.sum_ite_eq' N_j n, if_pos hn]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_inner_sum]
      simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_re]
      dsimp [N_j]
      rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq => ?_)
      have hq1 : q.1 = j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      conv_rhs => rw [← Prod.eta q, hq1]
    calc (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            ‖∑ q ∈ F, c q * pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v‖ ^ 2)
        ≤ 4 * ∑ j ∈ J, ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖A_cell j v‖ ^ 2 := h_int_4
      _ ≤ 4 * ∑ j ∈ J, ∑ q ∈ F.filter (fun q => q.1 = j), ‖c q‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum h_cell_bound) (by norm_num)
      _ = 4 * ∑ q ∈ F, ‖c q‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun q hq => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst hq)]
  exact ⟨h_part2.1, h_part2.2.1, h_part2.2.2, h_part3⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys R_win C_χ : ℝ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom) (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hC_χ : 1 ≤ C_χ)
    (h_pou_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D)
    (h_pou_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0)
    (h_pou_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    ∃ (C_can C_modes : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tail : ℕ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ C_can ∧ 1 ≤ C_modes ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧ (∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ C_tail M) ∧
      ∀ (lam_sys : ℝ), 4 ≤ lam_sys →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∃ (F_modes : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
        (X_ex : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (o_root : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        (∀ q ∈ F_modes, q.1 ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom ∧
          (o_root q).1 = q.1 ∧ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ (o_root q).2 - X_ex q‖ ≤ ρ₀) ∧
        ((F_modes.card : ℝ) ≤ C_modes * lam_sys ^ 2) ∧
        (2 * B_sys + 5 ≤ Real.log lam_sys →
          ∀ q ∈ F_modes, o_root q ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom) ∧
        (∀ o_r : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
          (F_modes.filter (fun q => o_root q = o_r)).card ≤ M_mult) ∧
        (∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          ∀ q ∈ F_modes,
            ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤
              C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (o_root q)) ∧
        (∀ (M : ℕ), 3 ≤ M →
          ∀ (ρ_obs C_box E_f : ℝ),
            ρ₀ ≤ ρ_obs → ρ_obs ≤ 1 → C_box ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ E_f →
          ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ‖V_o‖ ≤ B_sys → ‖X_o‖ ≤ B_sys →
          ∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
            (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
          ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
            MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          let pair_o : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ := fun j n =>
            (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (((∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2)) →
            (∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2) ≤ E_f →
            (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
                if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ)
                else pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n * pair_o j n)) ∧
            ‖∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ,
                if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ)
                else pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n * pair_o j n‖ ^ 2 ≤
              C_tail M * ρ₀ ^ (2 * M - 2) * E_f) ∧
           (∀ (R : ℝ), 1 ≤ R →
             ∀ (S_far : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))), S_far ⊆ F_modes →
               (∀ q ∈ S_far,
                 R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1 - V_o‖ ∨
                 R * ρ₀ ≤ ‖X_ex q - (X_o + (1 / 2 - C_box) • gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1)‖) →
               (∑ q ∈ S_far, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f) →
               ‖∑ q ∈ S_far, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 * pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤
                 C_tail M * R ^ (-((2 * M - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * E_f)))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨C_modes, M_mult, hC_modes, hM_mult, h_bij⟩ :=
    normalized_phase_mode_bijection_and_grid a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys ha₀ ha₁ hA hR_dom hB_sys
  let R_cut : ℝ := 2 * B_sys + R_dom + 10
  have hR_cut : 1 ≤ R_cut := by dsimp [R_cut]; linarith
  obtain ⟨C_can, hC_can, h_can⟩ :=
    retained_mode_canonical_root_mass_bound a₀ a₁ A R_dom R_cut C_χ
      ha₀ ha₁ hA hR_dom hR_cut hC_χ h_pou_smooth h_pou_supp h_pou_deriv
  obtain ⟨d_thresh, B_amp, D_phase, hd_thresh, hB_amp, hD_phase, h_slice⟩ :=
    transport_slice_reduction_and_phase_bounds a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys R_win C_χ M_win
      ha₀ ha₁ hA hR_dom hB_sys hR_win hC_χ h_pou_smooth h_pou_supp h_pou_deriv
  choose C_ibp hC_ibp_nn hC_ibp using
    fun M : ℕ => nonstationary_phase_1d_arbitrary_ibp M 2 (by norm_num) B_amp D_phase
  let K_pair : ℕ → ℝ := fun M =>
    max 1 (max (4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_thresh) ^ M) (C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M))
  have hK_pair : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ K_pair M := fun _ => le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨C_tail, hC_tail, h_lat⟩ :=
    lattice_tail_and_transport_cauchy_schwarz A R_win K_pair hA hR_win hK_pair
  refine ⟨C_can, C_modes, M_mult, C_tail, hC_can, hC_modes, hM_mult, hC_tail, ?_⟩
  intro lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase
  obtain ⟨h_lip, F_modes, X_ex, o_root, h_mode, hF_mem, hF_compl, hF_card, hF_root, hF_mult⟩ :=
    h_bij lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase
  refine ⟨F_modes, X_ex, o_root, ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  let ρ₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam_sys := by linarith
  have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam_pos)
  refine ⟨?_, hF_card, hF_root, hF_mult, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q hq
    obtain ⟨hq1, _, hq_o1, hq_err⟩ := hF_mem q hq
    exact ⟨hq1, hq_o1, hq_err⟩
  · intro f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2 q hq
    obtain ⟨_, hq_cut, hq_o1, hq_err⟩ := hF_mem q hq
    have hq_mode : ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1, X_ex q - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1) =
        ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1)) -
          ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 q.2) := by
      simpa using h_mode q.1 q.2
    have h_est := h_can lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase q.1 q.2 (o_root q).2 (X_ex q)
      hq_cut hq_err hq_mode f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2
    have ho_eq : (q.1, (o_root q).2) = o_root q := Prod.ext hq_o1.symm rfl
    rwa [ho_eq] at h_est
  · intro M hM ρ_obs C_box E_f hρ₀_obs hρ_obs_le1 hC_box hE_f
      V_o X_o hVo hXo ψ_o hψ_smooth hψ_supp hψ_deriv f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2
    let pair_o : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ := fun j n =>
      (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    have hρ_obs_pos : 0 < ρ_obs := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ₀_pos hρ₀_obs
    have h_ratio_nn : 0 ≤ ρ₀ / ρ_obs := div_nonneg hρ₀_pos.le hρ_obs_pos.le
    let Y_j : (ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j =>
      X_o + (1 / 2 - C_box) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j
    let ν_j : (ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j =>
      ((2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀) : ℝ)) •
        (ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) -
          ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, Y_j j - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j))
    refine h_lat M hM lam_sys R_dom ρ_obs E_f hlam_sys hρ₀_obs hE_f V_o Y_j ν_j
      F_modes X_ex (pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f) pair_o
      (fun q hq => (hF_mem q hq).1) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro j hj n hnot
      have hj_norm : ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ j‖ ≤ R_dom + 2 := by
        unfold pktVelBox at hj
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hC_abs : |1 / 2 - C_box| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [abs_le]
        exact ⟨by linarith [hC_box.2], by linarith [hC_box.1]⟩
      have hY_norm : ‖Y_j j‖ ≤ B_sys + (1 / 2) * (R_dom + 2) := by
        calc ‖Y_j j‖
            ≤ ‖X_o‖ + ‖(1 / 2 - C_box) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖X_o‖ + |1 / 2 - C_box| * ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ j‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          _ ≤ B_sys + (1 / 2) * (R_dom + 2) := by
              refine add_le_add hXo ?_
              exact mul_le_mul hC_abs hj_norm (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have hX_gt : 2 * B_sys + R_dom + 10 < ‖X_ex (j, n)‖ := hF_compl j hj n hnot
      have h_tri : ‖X_ex (j, n)‖ - ‖Y_j j‖ ≤ ‖X_ex (j, n) - Y_j j‖ :=
        norm_sub_norm_le (X_ex (j, n)) (Y_j j)
      linarith
    · intro j hj hsep n
      exact (h_slice lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase ρ_obs C_box hρ₀_obs hρ_obs_le1 hC_box
        V_o X_o hVo hXo ψ_o hψ_smooth hψ_supp hψ_deriv j n (X_ex (j, n)) hj (h_mode j n)).1 hsep
    · intro j hj n
      dsimp only
      set d_jn : ℝ := ρ₀⁻¹ * ‖X_ex (j, n) - Y_j j‖
      have hd_nn : 0 ≤ d_jn := mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ₀_pos.le) (norm_nonneg _)
      have h1d_pos : 0 < 1 + d_jn := by linarith
      have h1d_pow_pos : 0 < (1 + d_jn) ^ M := pow_pos h1d_pos M
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · let V_j := gridPt2D ρ₀ j
        have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
        have hpi_gt3 : 3 < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_three
        have hc_pos : 0 < 2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀) := div_pos (by norm_num) (mul_pos hpi_pos hρ₀_pos)
        have h_sub_mode : ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) =
            ζ₀ (V_j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)) - ζ₀ (V_j, X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j) := by
          have hm := h_mode j n
          change ζ₀ (V_j, X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j) =
            ζ₀ (V_j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)) - ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) at hm
          rw [hm]
          abel
        have h_n_eq : gridPt2D 1 n = ((2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀) : ℝ)) •
            (ζ₀ (V_j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)) - ζ₀ (V_j, X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)) := by
          have h_inv : (2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀) : ℝ) * (Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2) = 1 := by
            field_simp [hpi_pos.ne', hρ₀_pos.ne']
          calc gridPt2D 1 n
              = ((2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀) : ℝ) * (Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2)) • gridPt2D 1 n := by
                rw [h_inv, one_smul]
            _ = ((2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀) : ℝ)) • ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) :=
                mul_smul _ _ _
            _ = ((2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀) : ℝ)) •
                (ζ₀ (V_j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)) - ζ₀ (V_j, X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)) := by
                rw [h_sub_mode]
        have h_diff_eq : gridPt2D 1 n - ν_j j = ((2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀) : ℝ)) •
            (ζ₀ (V_j, Y_j j - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j) -
              ζ₀ (V_j, X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)) := by
          rw [h_n_eq]
          dsimp [ν_j, V_j]
          rw [← smul_sub]
          congr 1
          abel
        have h_lip_ub := (h_lip V_j (Y_j j - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)
          (X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)).2
        have h_arg_eq : (Y_j j - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j) - (X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j) =
            Y_j j - X_ex (j, n) := by abel
        rw [h_arg_eq, norm_sub_rev (Y_j j) (X_ex (j, n))] at h_lip_ub
        have h2pi_le1 : 2 / Real.pi ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_one hpi_pos]
          linarith
        calc ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν_j j‖
            = (2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀)) *
                ‖ζ₀ (V_j, Y_j j - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j) -
                  ζ₀ (V_j, X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j)‖ := by
              rw [h_diff_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc_pos.le]
          _ ≤ (2 / (Real.pi * ρ₀)) * (A * ‖X_ex (j, n) - Y_j j‖) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lip_ub hc_pos.le
          _ = (2 / Real.pi) * (A * d_jn) := by
              dsimp [d_jn]
              field_simp [hpi_pos.ne', hρ₀_pos.ne']
          _ ≤ 1 * (A * d_jn) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2pi_le1 (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hd_nn)
          _ = A * d_jn := one_mul _
      · obtain ⟨_, h_uncond, h_cond⟩ :=
          h_slice lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase ρ_obs C_box hρ₀_obs hρ_obs_le1 hC_box
            V_o X_o hVo hXo ψ_o hψ_smooth hψ_supp hψ_deriv j n (X_ex (j, n)) hj (h_mode j n)
        by_cases hd_ge : d_thresh ≤ d_jn
        · obtain ⟨θ_sl, u_sl, h_sl_props, h_sl_int⟩ := h_cond hd_ge
          have hd_ge1 : 1 ≤ d_jn := le_trans hd_thresh hd_ge
          let L : ℝ := (a₀ / 2) * d_jn
          have hL_pos : 0 < L := mul_pos (half_pos ha₀) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hd_ge1)
          have h_sl_bound : ∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2,
              ‖∫ t : ℝ, u_sl y₁ t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ_sl y₁ t : ℂ))‖ ≤
                C_ibp M / L ^ M := by
            intro y₁ hy₁
            obtain ⟨hθ_sm, hu_sm, hθ_lo, hθ_hi, hu_supp, hu_der⟩ := h_sl_props y₁ hy₁
            exact hC_ibp M L hL_pos (θ_sl y₁) hθ_sm
              (fun t ht => hθ_lo t (by linarith))
              (fun m hm1 _ t ht => hθ_hi m hm1 t (by linarith))
              (u_sl y₁) hu_sm hu_supp (fun k _ t => hu_der k t)
          have h_pair_le : ‖pair_o j n‖ ≤ (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * (C_ibp M / L ^ M) :=
            h_sl_int (C_ibp M / L ^ M) (div_nonneg (hC_ibp_nn M) (pow_nonneg hL_pos.le M))
              h_sl_bound
          have h_L_ge : (a₀ / 4) * (1 + d_jn) ≤ L := by
            dsimp [L]
            nlinarith [ha₀, hd_ge1]
          have h_a4_pos : 0 < (a₀ / 4) * (1 + d_jn) := by positivity
          have h_pow_ge : ((a₀ / 4) * (1 + d_jn)) ^ M ≤ L ^ M :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ h_a4_pos.le h_L_ge M
          have h_div_le : C_ibp M / L ^ M ≤ (C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M := by
            calc C_ibp M / L ^ M
                ≤ C_ibp M / ((a₀ / 4) * (1 + d_jn)) ^ M :=
                  div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hC_ibp_nn M) (pow_pos h_a4_pos M) h_pow_ge
              _ = (C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M := by
                  rw [mul_pow, div_pow, div_pow]
                  field_simp [ha₀.ne', h1d_pow_pos.ne']
          have h_K_ge : C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M ≤ K_pair M :=
            le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
          calc ‖pair_o j n‖
              ≤ (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * (C_ibp M / L ^ M) := h_pair_le
            _ ≤ (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * ((C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div_le h_ratio_nn
            _ ≤ (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * (K_pair M / (1 + d_jn) ^ M) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_K_ge h1d_pow_pos.le) h_ratio_nn
            _ = K_pair M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M := by ring
        · have hd_lt : d_jn ≤ d_thresh := le_of_not_ge hd_ge
          have h_pow_le : (1 + d_jn) ^ M ≤ (1 + d_thresh) ^ M :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ h1d_pos.le (by linarith) M
          have h_K_ge : 4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_jn) ^ M ≤ K_pair M := by
            calc 4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_jn) ^ M
                ≤ 4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_thresh) ^ M :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow_le (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hB_amp 0))
              _ ≤ K_pair M := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
          calc ‖pair_o j n‖
              ≤ 4 * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * B_amp 0 := h_uncond
            _ = (4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_jn) ^ M) * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M := by
                field_simp [h1d_pow_pos.ne']
            _ ≤ K_pair M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_K_ge h_ratio_nn) h1d_pow_pos.le

subgoal_signatures.name: normalized_phase_mode_bijection_and_grid
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys : ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom) (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) :
    ∃ (C_modes : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ),
      1 ≤ C_modes ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧
      ∀ (lam_sys : ℝ), 4 ≤ lam_sys →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      (∀ (v p₁ p₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        a₀ * ‖p₁ - p₂‖ ≤ ‖ζ₀ (v, p₁) - ζ₀ (v, p₂)‖ ∧
        ‖ζ₀ (v, p₁) - ζ₀ (v, p₂)‖ ≤ A * ‖p₁ - p₂‖) ∧
      ∃ (F_modes : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
        (X_ex : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (o_root : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        (∀ j n : ℤ × ℤ,
          ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, X_ex (j, n) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j) =
            ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) -
              ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n)) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ F_modes,
          q.1 ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom ∧
          ‖X_ex q‖ ≤ 2 * B_sys + R_dom + 10 ∧
          (o_root q).1 = q.1 ∧
          ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ (o_root q).2 - X_ex q‖ ≤ ρ₀) ∧
        (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom, ∀ n : ℤ × ℤ,
          (j, n) ∉ F_modes → 2 * B_sys + R_dom + 10 < ‖X_ex (j, n)‖) ∧
        ((F_modes.card : ℝ) ≤ C_modes * lam_sys ^ 2) ∧
        (2 * B_sys + 5 ≤ Real.log lam_sys →
          ∀ q ∈ F_modes, o_root q ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom) ∧
        (∀ o_r : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
          (F_modes.filter (fun q => o_root q = o_r)).card ≤ M_mult)

subgoal_signatures.name: retained_mode_canonical_root_mass_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_dom R_cut C_χ : ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom) (hR_cut : 1 ≤ R_cut) (hC_χ : 1 ≤ C_χ)
    (h_pou_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D)
    (h_pou_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0)
    (h_pou_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    ∃ C_can : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_can ∧
      ∀ (lam_sys : ℝ), 4 ≤ lam_sys →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (j n k_X : ℤ × ℤ) (X_q_ex : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        ‖X_q_ex‖ ≤ R_cut →
        ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X - X_q_ex‖ ≤ ρ₀ →
        ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, X_q_ex - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j) =
          ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) -
            ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) →
      ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
        (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
        MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
        ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2 ≤
          C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (j, k_X)

subgoal_signatures.name: transport_slice_reduction_and_phase_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys R_win C_χ : ℝ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom) (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hC_χ : 1 ≤ C_χ)
    (h_pou_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D)
    (h_pou_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0)
    (h_pou_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    ∃ (d_thresh : ℝ) (B_amp D_phase : ℕ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ d_thresh ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ B_amp k) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ D_phase m) ∧
      ∀ (lam_sys : ℝ), 4 ≤ lam_sys →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (ρ_obs C_box : ℝ),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        ρ₀ ≤ ρ_obs → ρ_obs ≤ 1 → C_box ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖V_o‖ ≤ B_sys → ‖X_o‖ ≤ B_sys →
      ∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
      ∀ (j n : ℤ × ℤ) (X_jn : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom →
        ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, X_jn - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j) =
          ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) -
            ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) →
        let pair_jn : ℂ := (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        let d_jn : ℝ := ρ₀⁻¹ * ‖X_jn - (X_o + (1 / 2 - C_box) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j)‖
        (R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ j - V_o‖ → pair_jn = 0) ∧
        (‖pair_jn‖ ≤ 4 * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * B_amp 0) ∧
        (d_thresh ≤ d_jn →
          ∃ (θ_sl : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (u_sl : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
            (∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2,
              (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (θ_sl y₁)) ∧
              (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (u_sl y₁)) ∧
              (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 → (a₀ / 2) * d_jn ≤ deriv (θ_sl y₁) t) ∧
              (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 →
                |iteratedDeriv m (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) t| ≤ ((a₀ / 2) * d_jn) * D_phase m) ∧
              (∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ |t| → u_sl y₁ t = 0) ∧
              (∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv k (u_sl y₁) t‖ ≤ B_amp k)) ∧
            (∀ (M_sl : ℝ), 0 ≤ M_sl →
              (∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2,
                ‖∫ t : ℝ, u_sl y₁ t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ_sl y₁ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ M_sl) →
              ‖pair_jn‖ ≤ (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * M_sl))

subgoal_signatures.name: nonstationary_phase_1d_arbitrary_ibp
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (B D : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ C_ibp : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ibp ∧
      ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 → L ≤ deriv θ t) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 →
          |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| ≤ L * D m) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B k) →
        ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L ^ M

subgoal_signatures.name: lattice_tail_and_transport_cauchy_schwarz
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A R_win : ℝ) (K_pair : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hK_pair : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ K_pair M) :
    ∃ C_tail : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ C_tail M) ∧
      ∀ (M : ℕ), 3 ≤ M →
      ∀ (lam_sys R_dom ρ_obs E_f : ℝ),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        4 ≤ lam_sys → ρ₀ ≤ ρ_obs → 0 ≤ E_f →
      ∀ (V_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

          rw [heq]
          exact h_card_ent boxSub (β d) (p_cD d) (N_sub : ℝ)
            (fun m _ => hβ_nn d m) (hβ_sum d) hN_sub_pos le_rfl
        linarith only [h_β_ent]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      calc ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o ∈ O₀, -(π_root o d * Real.log (π_root o d / p_cD d))
          ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              ((∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ m_sub : ↥boxSub,
                -(p_comp o (e_idx (d, m_sub)) *
                  Real.log (p_comp o (e_idx (d, m_sub)) / p_comp_D (e_idx (d, m_sub))))) +
                p_cD d * Real.log (N_sub : ℝ)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_each_d d)
        _ = (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ dt : Fin (N_D * N_sub),
              -(p_comp o dt * Real.log (p_comp o dt / p_comp_D dt))) +
              Real.log (N_sub : ℝ) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp_cD_sum, one_mul, Finset.sum_comm]
            congr 1
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
            exact (h_sum_dt
              (fun dt => -(p_comp o dt * Real.log (p_comp o dt / p_comp_D dt)))).symm
    have h_Ew_eq : ∑ dt : Fin (N_D * N_sub),
          p_comp_D dt * ((1 + γ) * b_tilde dt + (1 - γ) * a_tilde dt) =
        ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cD d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) := by
      rw [h_sum_dt]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      have heq : ∑ m_sub : ↥boxSub,
            p_comp_D (e_idx (d, m_sub)) *
              ((1 + γ) * b_tilde (e_idx (d, m_sub)) + (1 - γ) * a_tilde (e_idx (d, m_sub))) =
          ∑ m_sub : ↥boxSub,
            p_comp_D (e_idx (d, m_sub)) * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m_sub _ => ?_)
        dsimp [b_tilde, a_tilde]
        rw [hd_of_apply]
      rw [heq, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp_comp_D_sum_m d]
    
    have hlog_Munit_Mlow : Real.log M_unit = Real.log M_low + ξ * ell + Real.log C_fib := by
      have h1 : Real.log M_unit =
          Real.log C_fib + (-(((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ)) * ell + Real.log E_f) := by
        dsimp [M_unit]
        rw [Real.log_mul (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_fib).ne'
            (mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hE_f_pos).ne',
          Real.log_mul (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne' hE_f_pos.ne', hlog_rpow]
      have h2 : Real.log M_low = -((((m_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1) * ξ)) * ell + Real.log E_f := by
        dsimp [M_low]
        rw [Real.log_mul (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne' hE_f_pos.ne', hlog_rpow]
      have h_alg : -(((m_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1) * ξ) * ell = -((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ) * ell - ξ * ell := by
        ring
      linarith only [h1, h2, h_alg]
    have hlog_Btime : Real.log B_time = Real.log B_sys + t * ell := by
      dsimp [B_time]
      rw [Real.log_mul hB_pos.ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne', hlog_rpow]
      ring
    have hlog_Mcell : Real.log M_cell = Real.log C_cell + 2 * η * ell := by
      dsimp [M_cell]
      rw [Real.log_mul (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_cell).ne'
          (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne', hlog_rpow]
      ring
    have hlog_6Renl : Real.log (6 * R_enl) = Real.log (6 * C_enl_base) + (η + ξ) * ell := by
      have h6eq : 6 * R_enl = (6 * C_enl_base) * ε ^ (-η - ξ) := by dsimp [R_enl]; ring
      rw [h6eq, Real.log_mul (by linarith only [hC_enl_base])
          (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne', hlog_rpow]
      ring
    
    have h_HO_comp_eq : ∑ o ∈ O₀, -(π_O o * Real.log (π_O o)) =
        ∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_comp_O o * Real.log (p_comp_O o)) := by
      simp_rw [hp_comp_O_eq]
    have h_Emass_comp_eq : ∑ o ∈ O₀, π_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o) =
        ∑ o ∈ O₀, p_comp_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o) := by
      simp_rw [hp_comp_O_eq]
    let Num_pc : ℝ :=
      (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_cO o * Real.log (p_cO o))) +
      (1 / 2) * (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_c o d * Real.log (p_c o d / p_cD d))) +
      (3 / 2) * (∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cO o * Real.log (m_obs o))
    let Num_comp : ℝ :=
      (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_comp_O o * Real.log (p_comp_O o))) +
      (1 / 2) * (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ dt : Fin (N_D * N_sub),
        -(p_comp o dt * Real.log (p_comp o dt / p_comp_D dt))) +
      (3 / 2) * (∑ o ∈ O₀, p_comp_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o))
    let C_rem : ℝ :=
      (3 / 2) * Real.log C_fib +
      Real.log B_sys +
      (3 / 2) * Real.log C_cell +
      (3 / 2) * Real.log M_loss +
      2 * Real.log (6 * C_enl_base) +
      (3 / 2) * Real.log (M_mult : ℝ) +
      (3 / 2) * Real.log C_can
    have h_num_chain : Num_pc ≤ Num_comp + (t + 5 * η + (7 / 2) * ξ) * ell + C_rem := by
      dsimp [Num_pc, Num_comp, C_rem]
      linarith only [h_step3_1, h_step3_2, h_uncond_contrib, h_cond_contrib,
        h_push_HO, h_push_HOD, h_push_mass, h_sub_HOD, h_log_Nsub,
        hlog_Munit_Mlow, hlog_Btime, hlog_Mcell, hlog_6Renl,
        h_HO_comp_eq, h_Emass_comp_eq]
    have h_div_chain := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_chain hell_pos.le
    have h_rhs_div : (Num_comp + (t + 5 * η + (7 / 2) * ξ) * ell + C_rem) / ell =
        Num_comp / ell + (t + 5 * η + (7 / 2) * ξ) + C_rem / ell := by
      field_simp [hell_pos.ne']
    rw [h_rhs_div] at h_div_chain
    have h_pc_eq : generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
        N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_c =
        Num_pc / ell + (1 / 2) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cD d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) := by
      unfold generalPacketScore
      dsimp [Num_pc, p_cO, p_cD, m_obs, ell]
      ring
    have hs_comp_split : s_comp =
        Num_comp / ell + (1 / 2) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cD d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) := by
      dsimp [s_comp, Num_comp]
      rw [h_Ew_eq]
      ring
    have hC1_split : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (M_split : ℝ) / ell) + C_rem / ell = C_info_1 / ell := by
      dsimp [C_info_1, C_rem, M_loss]
      ring
    have hC1_le : C_info_1 / ell ≤ C_info / ell :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hell_pos.le
    change generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
        N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
      generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
        t + 5 * η + 4 * ξ + C_info / ell
    linarith only [h_score_split, h_pc_eq, hs_comp_split, h_div_chain, hs_comp_le_root,
      hC1_split, hC1_le, hξ₀]

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro B_cl K_hor t_min δ_cl hB _hK ht_min _ht_K hδ
  let K_sub : ℕ := ⌈B_cl⌉₊
  let m_box : ℕ := 2 * K_sub + 1
  let M_sub : ℕ := (m_box * m_box) * (m_box * m_box)
  let C_const : ℝ := 2 * Real.log (3 * B_cl) + Real.log (M_sub : ℝ) + 1
  let ε₀ : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (Real.exp (-(C_const / (δ_cl * t_min))))
  have hε₀_pos : 0 < ε₀ := lt_min (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hε₀_lt : ε₀ < 1 / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, ?_⟩
  intro ε t L Δ_time hε0 hε1 ht_ge htL _hLK hΔ_lo _hΔ_hi
    N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx V_part A_part b_G a_G e_G V_G X_G k_G
    hπ_nn hπ_sum _hVA hG_adm h_supp
  have hm_box_pos : 1 ≤ m_box := by dsimp [m_box]; omega
  have hM_sub_ge1 : 1 ≤ M_sub := by
    dsimp [M_sub]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul hm_box_pos hm_box_pos)
      (Nat.mul_le_mul hm_box_pos hm_box_pos)
  have hM_sub_pos : 0 < M_sub := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hM_sub_ge1
  have hε_lt_qtr : ε < 1 / 4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε1 (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε_lt_one : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have hε_le_one : ε ≤ 1 := hε_lt_one.le
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have h1_lt_inv : 1 < ε⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hε0).mpr hε_lt_one
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos h1_lt_inv
  have hell_eq : ell = -Real.log ε := Real.log_inv ε
  have h_err_budget : (2 * Real.log (3 * B_cl) + Real.log (M_sub : ℝ)) / ell ≤ δ_cl * t := by
    have hε_lt_exp : ε < Real.exp (-(C_const / (δ_cl * t_min))) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε1 (min_le_right _ _)
    have hlog_lt : Real.log ε < -(C_const / (δ_cl * t_min)) := by
      calc Real.log ε < Real.log (Real.exp (-(C_const / (δ_cl * t_min)))) :=
            Real.log_lt_log hε0 hε_lt_exp
        _ = -(C_const / (δ_cl * t_min)) := Real.log_exp _
    have hdiv_lt : C_const / (δ_cl * t_min) < ell := by linarith [hell_eq, hlog_lt]
    have hδt_pos : 0 < δ_cl * t_min := mul_pos hδ ht_min
    have hC_lt : C_const < ell * (δ_cl * t_min) := (div_lt_iff₀ hδt_pos).mp hdiv_lt
    have h_num_le : 2 * Real.log (3 * B_cl) + Real.log (M_sub : ℝ) ≤ (δ_cl * t_min) * ell := by
      dsimp [C_const] at hC_lt
      linarith
    have h1 : (2 * Real.log (3 * B_cl) + Real.log (M_sub : ℝ)) / ell ≤ δ_cl * t_min :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mpr h_num_le
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_ge hδ.le)
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let p_TG : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun tid g =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let S_cells : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image k_time
  let p_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then π ω else 0
  have hpT_nn : ∀ tid, 0 ≤ p_T tid := fun tid =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
  have hpG_nn : ∀ g, 0 ≤ p_G g := fun g =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
  have hpTG_nn : ∀ tid g, 0 ≤ p_TG tid g := fun tid g =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
  have hpTC_nn : ∀ tid k, 0 ≤ p_TC tid k := fun tid k =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
  have hpT_sum : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T tid = 1 := by
    dsimp [p_T]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_inner : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, (∑ x : Fin N_T, if T_idx ω = x then π ω else 0) = π ω := by
      intro ω
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp_rw [h_inner]
    exact hπ_sum
  have hpG_sum : ∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g = 1 := by
    dsimp [p_G]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_inner : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, (∑ x : Fin N_G, if G_idx ω = x then π ω else 0) = π ω := by
      intro ω
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp_rw [h_inner]
    exact hπ_sum
  have hpTG_row : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G, p_TG tid g = p_T tid := by
    intro tid
    dsimp [p_TG, p_T]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : T_idx ω = tid
    · simp [h, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    · simp [h]
  have hpTG_col : ∀ g : Fin N_G, ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_TG tid g = p_G g := by
    intro g
    dsimp [p_TG, p_G]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : G_idx ω = g
    · simp [h, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    · simp [h]
  have hpTC_row : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells, p_TC tid k = p_T tid := by
    intro tid
    dsimp [p_TC, p_T]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : T_idx ω = tid
    · have hk_mem : k_time ω ∈ S_cells := Finset.mem_image_of_mem k_time (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      simp [h, Finset.sum_ite_eq, hk_mem]
    · simp [h]
  obtain ⟨ω₀, _, hπω₀_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero (by rw [hπ_sum]; norm_num)
  have hπω₀_pos : 0 < π ω₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn ω₀) (Ne.symm hπω₀_ne)
  have h_ent_card : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ) (W : ℝ),
      0 < S.card → (∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ w x) → (∑ x ∈ S, w x = W) →
      ∑ x ∈ S, -(w x * Real.log (w x / W)) ≤ W * Real.log (S.card : ℝ) := by
    intro α S w W hS_card hw_nn hw_sum
    by_cases hW0 : W = 0
    · subst hW0
      simp
    · have hW_nn : 0 ≤ W := hw_sum ▸ Finset.sum_nonneg hw_nn
      have hW_pos : 0 < W := lt_of_le_of_ne hW_nn (Ne.symm hW0)
      let N : ℝ := (S.card : ℝ)
      have hN_pos : 0 < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hS_card
      have h_term : ∀ x ∈ S, -(w x * Real.log (w x / W)) - w x * Real.log N ≤ W / N - w x := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases hwx0 : w x = 0
        · rw [hwx0]
          simp only [zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, neg_zero, sub_zero]
          exact div_nonneg hW_pos.le hN_pos.le
        · have hwx_pos : 0 < w x := lt_of_le_of_ne (hw_nn x hx) (Ne.symm hwx0)
          have hWN_pos : 0 < W / N := div_pos hW_pos hN_pos
          have hu_pos : 0 < (W / N) / w x := div_pos hWN_pos hwx_pos
          have hlog_le := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu_pos
          have hlog_eq : Real.log ((W / N) / w x) = -(Real.log (w x / W)) - Real.log N := by
            rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hWN_pos) (ne_of_gt hwx_pos),
              Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hW_pos) (ne_of_gt hN_pos),
              Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hwx_pos) (ne_of_gt hW_pos)]
            ring
          rw [hlog_eq] at hlog_le
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_le hwx_pos.le
          have hlhs : w x * (-Real.log (w x / W) - Real.log N) =
              -(w x * Real.log (w x / W)) - w x * Real.log N := by ring
          have hrhs : w x * (W / N / w x - 1) = W / N - w x := by
            rw [mul_sub, mul_one, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hwx_pos)]
          linarith
      have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_term
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hw_sum] at h_sum
      have hN_mul : (S.card : ℝ) * (W / N) = W := mul_div_cancel₀ W (ne_of_gt hN_pos)
      linarith
  have h_mi_nonneg : ∀ (N_D : ℕ) (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) →
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) →
      let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
      0 ≤ ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d)) := by
    intro N_D q hq_nn hq_row
    dsimp only
    let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
    have hqD_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun tid _ => hq_nn tid d)
    have hqD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d = 1 := by
      dsimp [q_D]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [hq_row]
      exact hpT_sum
    have h_row_le : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
        ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) ≤ 0 := by
      intro tid
      have h_term : ∀ d ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_D)),
          -(q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) ≤
            p_T tid * q_D d - q tid d := by
        intro d _
        by_cases hq0 : q tid d = 0
        · rw [hq0]
          simp only [zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero, sub_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg (hpT_nn tid) (hqD_nn d)
        · have hq_pos : 0 < q tid d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq_nn tid d) (Ne.symm hq0)
          have hpT_ge : q tid d ≤ p_T tid := by
            rw [← hq_row tid]
            exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hq_nn tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d)
          have hqD_ge : q tid d ≤ q_D d :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => hq_nn tid' d) (Finset.mem_univ tid)
          have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos hpT_ge
          have hqD_pos : 0 < q_D d := lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos hqD_ge
          have hprod_pos : 0 < p_T tid * q_D d := mul_pos hpT_pos hqD_pos
          have hu_pos : 0 < (p_T tid * q_D d) / q tid d := div_pos hprod_pos hq_pos
          have hlog_le := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu_pos
          have hlog_eq : Real.log ((p_T tid * q_D d) / q tid d) =
              -Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d)) := by
            rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hprod_pos) (ne_of_gt hq_pos),
              Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hq_pos) (ne_of_gt hprod_pos)]
            ring
          rw [hlog_eq] at hlog_le
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_le hq_pos.le
          have hlhs : q tid d * (-Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) =
              -(q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) := by ring
          have hrhs : q tid d * ((p_T tid * q_D d) / q tid d - 1) =
              p_T tid * q_D d - q tid d := by
            rw [mul_sub, mul_one, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hq_pos)]
          linarith
      have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_term
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hqD_sum, hq_row tid, mul_one, sub_self] at h_sum
      exact h_sum
    have h_tot : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) ≤ 0 :=
      Finset.sum_nonpos (fun tid _ => h_row_le tid)
    simp only [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h_tot
    linarith
  let S_root : Set ℝ := { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
      (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
