      |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) := by
    intro tid d hq_pos
    let g := (e_idx.symm d).1
    let s := (e_idx.symm d).2
    have hs_eq : s = s_box tid g := by
      dsimp [q] at hq_pos
      by_contra hne
      rw [if_neg hne] at hq_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hq_pos
    have hpTG_pos : 0 < p_TG tid g := by
      dsimp [q] at hq_pos
      rwa [if_pos hs_eq] at hq_pos
    obtain ⟨ω, _, hω_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hpTG_pos)
    have hω_cond : T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g := by
      by_contra hnot
      rw [if_neg hnot] at hω_ne
      exact hω_ne rfl
    rw [if_pos hω_cond] at hω_ne
    have hπω_pos : 0 < π ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn ω) (Ne.symm hω_ne)
    obtain ⟨hc_mid, hk_eq, hv_e, hv_p, hx_e, hx_p⟩ := h_supp ω hπω_pos
    rw [hω_cond.2] at hk_eq
    rw [hω_cond.1, hω_cond.2] at hv_e hv_p hx_e hx_p
    have hc_eq : c_G g = ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time := by
      dsimp [c_G]
      rw [hk_eq]
    rcases Set.mem_Icc.mp hc_mid with ⟨hc_lo, hc_hi⟩
    have hc_abs : |c_G g| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hc_eq, abs_of_nonneg hc_lo]
      exact hc_hi
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le ht_min ht_ge
    have hε_bt : ε ^ (b_G g + t) ≤ ε ^ (b_G g) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε0 hε_le_one (by linarith)
    have hε_at : ε ^ (a_G g + t) ≤ ε ^ (a_G g) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε0 hε_le_one (by linarith)
    have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B_cl := by linarith
    have hv_e2 : |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| ≤ 2 * B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) := by
      have h_pos : 0 ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) :=
        mul_nonneg hB_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg hε0.le _)
      linarith
    have hv_p2 : |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ 2 * B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g) := by
      have h_pos : 0 ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g) :=
        mul_nonneg hB_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg hε0.le _)
      linarith
    have hA_vec : A_part tid - A_G g =
        ((A_part tid + (((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time) • V_part tid) - X_G g) -
        (c_G g) • (V_part tid - V_G g) := by
      dsimp [A_G]
      rw [hc_eq, smul_sub]
      abel
    have ha_e2 : |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_G g) (e_G g)| ≤ 2 * B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) := by
      rw [hA_vec, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left]
      have h_tri := h_abs_sub
        (inner ℝ ((A_part tid + (((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time) • V_part tid) - X_G g) (e_G g))
        (c_G g * inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g))
      rw [abs_mul] at h_tri
      have h_cmul : |c_G g| * |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| ≤
          1 * |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_abs (abs_nonneg _)
      have h_xstep : B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g + t) ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε_bt hB_nn
      linarith
    have ha_p2 : |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ 2 * B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g) := by
      rw [hA_vec, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left]
      have h_tri := h_abs_sub
        (inner ℝ ((A_part tid + (((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time) • V_part tid) - X_G g)
          (perp2D (e_G g)))
        (c_G g * inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g)))
      rw [abs_mul] at h_tri
      have h_cmul : |c_G g| * |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤
          1 * |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_abs (abs_nonneg _)
      have h_xstep : B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g + t) ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε_at hB_nn
      linarith
    have he1 : ‖e_G g‖ = 1 := (hG_adm g).2.2.2
    have hVo := h_ortho (e_G g) (V_part tid - V_G g)
      ((((s.1.1).1 : ℝ) - (K_sub : ℝ)) * (10 * ε ^ (b_G g)))
      ((((s.1.2).1 : ℝ) - (K_sub : ℝ)) * (10 * ε ^ (a_G g))) he1
    have hAo := h_ortho (e_G g) (A_part tid - A_G g)
      ((((s.2.1).1 : ℝ) - (K_sub : ℝ)) * (10 * ε ^ (b_G g)))
      ((((s.2.2).1 : ℝ) - (K_sub : ℝ)) * (10 * ε ^ (a_G g))) he1
    change |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_G g)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_G g)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_G g)
    have hVD_sub : V_part tid - V_D d = (V_part tid - V_G g) -
        (((((s.1.1).1 : ℝ) - (K_sub : ℝ)) * (10 * ε ^ (b_G g))) • e_G g +
         ((((s.1.2).1 : ℝ) - (K_sub : ℝ)) * (10 * ε ^ (a_G g))) • perp2D (e_G g)) :=
      sub_add_eq_sub_sub _ _ _
    have hAD_sub : A_part tid - A_D d = (A_part tid - A_G g) -
        (((((s.2.1).1 : ℝ) - (K_sub : ℝ)) * (10 * ε ^ (b_G g))) • e_G g +
         ((((s.2.2).1 : ℝ) - (K_sub : ℝ)) * (10 * ε ^ (a_G g))) • perp2D (e_G g)) :=
      sub_add_eq_sub_sub _ _ _
    rw [hVD_sub, hAD_sub, hVo.1, hVo.2, hAo.1, hAo.2]
    have hs11 : s.1.1 = idx1D (inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)) (10 * ε ^ (b_G g)) := by
      rw [hs_eq]
    have hs12 : s.1.2 = idx1D (inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))) (10 * ε ^ (a_G g)) := by
      rw [hs_eq]
    have hs21 : s.2.1 = idx1D (inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_G g) (e_G g)) (10 * ε ^ (b_G g)) := by
      rw [hs_eq]
    have hs22 : s.2.2 = idx1D (inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))) (10 * ε ^ (a_G g)) := by
      rw [hs_eq]
    rw [hs11, hs12, hs21, hs22]
    exact ⟨h_idx1D _ _ hv_e2, h_idx1D _ _ hv_p2, h_idx1D _ _ ha_e2, h_idx1D _ _ ha_p2⟩
  have hqD_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun tid _ => hq_nn tid d)
  have hqD_fiber_sum : ∀ g : Fin N_G, ∑ s : Box4, q_D (e_idx (g, s)) = p_G g := by
    intro g
    dsimp [q_D]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [hq_apply]
    have h_in : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
        (∑ s : Box4, if s = s_box tid g then p_TG tid g else 0) = p_TG tid g := by
      intro tid
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    simp_rw [h_in]
    exact hpTG_col g
  have hEw_eq : E_w_D = E_w_G := by
    dsimp [E_w_D, E_w_G]
    rw [← e_idx.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => ?_)
    have hb_eq : ∀ s : Box4, b_D (e_idx (g, s)) = b_G g := by
      intro s; dsimp [b_D]; rw [e_idx.symm_apply_apply]
    have ha_eq : ∀ s : Box4, a_D (e_idx (g, s)) = a_G g := by
      intro s; dsimp [a_D]; rw [e_idx.symm_apply_apply]
    simp_rw [hb_eq, ha_eq, ← Finset.sum_mul, hqD_fiber_sum g]
  have hI_diff : I_TD - I_TG ≤ Real.log (M_sub : ℝ) / ell := by
    have h_pt : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (g : Fin N_G) (s : Box4),
        q tid (e_idx (g, s)) *
          Real.log (q tid (e_idx (g, s)) / (p_T tid * q_D (e_idx (g, s)))) -
        q tid (e_idx (g, s)) * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g)) =
        -(q tid (e_idx (g, s)) * Real.log (q_D (e_idx (g, s)) / p_G g)) := by
      intro tid g s
      by_cases hq0 : q tid (e_idx (g, s)) = 0
      · rw [hq0]
        ring
      · have hq_pos : 0 < q tid (e_idx (g, s)) :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (hq_nn tid (e_idx (g, s))) (Ne.symm hq0)
        have hs_eq : s = s_box tid g := by
          rw [hq_apply] at hq0
          by_contra hne
          rw [if_neg hne] at hq0
          exact hq0 rfl
        have hq_val : q tid (e_idx (g, s)) = p_TG tid g := by
          rw [hq_apply, if_pos hs_eq]
        have hpTG_pos : 0 < p_TG tid g := hq_val ▸ hq_pos
        have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hpTG_pos ?_
          rw [← hpTG_row tid]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun g' _ => hpTG_nn tid g') (Finset.mem_univ g)
        have hpG_pos : 0 < p_G g := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hpTG_pos ?_
          rw [← hpTG_col g]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => hpTG_nn tid' g) (Finset.mem_univ tid)
        have hqD_pos : 0 < q_D (e_idx (g, s)) := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos ?_
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => hq_nn tid' (e_idx (g, s)))
            (Finset.mem_univ tid)
        rw [hq_val,
          Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hpTG_pos) (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hpT_pos hqD_pos)),
          Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hpT_pos) (ne_of_gt hqD_pos),
          Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hpTG_pos) (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hpT_pos hpG_pos)),
          Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hpT_pos) (ne_of_gt hpG_pos),
          Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hqD_pos) (ne_of_gt hpG_pos)]
        ring
    have h_num_eq :
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) -
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
          p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) =
        ∑ g : Fin N_G, ∑ s : Box4,
          -(q_D (e_idx (g, s)) * Real.log (q_D (e_idx (g, s)) / p_G g)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have h_tid : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) -
          (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) =
          ∑ g : Fin N_G, ∑ s : Box4,
            -(q tid (e_idx (g, s)) * Real.log (q_D (e_idx (g, s)) / p_G g)) := by
        intro tid
        rw [← e_idx.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => ?_)
        have hpTG_expand : p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g)) =
            ∑ s : Box4, q tid (e_idx (g, s)) * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g)) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 1
          simp [hq_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
        rw [hpTG_expand, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s _ => h_pt tid g s)
      simp_rw [h_tid]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    have h_num_le :
        ∑ g : Fin N_G, ∑ s : Box4,
          -(q_D (e_idx (g, s)) * Real.log (q_D (e_idx (g, s)) / p_G g)) ≤
        Real.log (M_sub : ℝ) := by
      have h_card_pos : 0 < (Finset.univ : Finset Box4).card := by
        rw [hBox4_card]
        exact hM_sub_pos
      calc ∑ g : Fin N_G, ∑ s : Box4,
            -(q_D (e_idx (g, s)) * Real.log (q_D (e_idx (g, s)) / p_G g))
          ≤ ∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * Real.log ((Finset.univ : Finset Box4).card : ℝ) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun g _ =>
              h_ent_card Finset.univ (fun s => q_D (e_idx (g, s))) (p_G g)
                h_card_pos (fun s _ => hqD_nn (e_idx (g, s))) (hqD_fiber_sum g))
        _ = (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g) * Real.log (M_sub : ℝ) := by
            rw [hBox4_card, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = Real.log (M_sub : ℝ) := by rw [hpG_sum, one_mul]
    dsimp [I_TD, I_TG]
    rw [← sub_div, h_num_eq]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le hell_pos.le
  have hs_mem : s_comp ∈ S_root :=
    ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, hd_adm, hq_nn, hq_row, hq_geom, rfl⟩
  have hs_le_sup : s_comp ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part := by
    rw [h_root_eq]
    exact le_csSup h_bdd hs_mem
  rw [h_score_eq]
  have h_comb_div :
      Real.log (M_sub : ℝ) / ell + 2 * (Real.log (3 * B_cl) / ell) =
        (2 * Real.log (3 * B_cl) + Real.log (M_sub : ℝ)) / ell := by
    rw [add_div]
    ring
  dsimp [s_comp] at hs_le_sup
  linarith [hs_le_sup, hEw_eq, hI_diff, hS_t_bound, h_comb_div, h_err_budget]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (h_gt : γ < classicalGrowthRate γ) :
    HasIsotropicExtremizer γ ∨
      ∃ (m : ℝ) (_ : MatchedAspectProfileSystem γ m), 0 < m

signature.name: least_aspect_dichotomy
signature.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (h_gt : γ < classicalGrowthRate γ) :
    HasIsotropicExtremizer γ ∨
      ∃ (m : ℝ) (_ : MatchedAspectProfileSystem γ m), 0 < m

proof.tactics:
by
  let m : ℝ := leastClassicalAspect γ
  obtain ⟨h_sat_m, _, h_min_m⟩ := least_aspect_existence_and_attainment γ hγ₀ hγ₁ h_two h_gt
  have hm_nn : 0 ≤ m := h_sat_m.1
  obtain ⟨path⟩ := coherent_dyadic_saturated_path γ m hγ₀ hγ₁ h_two h_gt h_sat_m h_min_m
  let f_b : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => if u ≤ 0 then -(1 + m) else if u ≤ 1 then -path.b_path u else 0
  let f_a : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => if u ≤ 0 then 0 else if u ≤ 1 then path.a_path u + u else 1 + m
  let f_e : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => f_a u + f_b u
  have hf_b_mono : Monotone f_b := by
    intro u₁ u₂ hu
    dsimp only [f_b]
    by_cases hu₂0 : u₂ ≤ 0
    · have hu₁0 : u₁ ≤ 0 := le_trans hu hu₂0
      rw [if_pos hu₁0, if_pos hu₂0]
    · rw [if_neg hu₂0]
      have hu₂_pos : 0 < u₂ := lt_of_not_ge hu₂0
      by_cases hu₁0 : u₁ ≤ 0
      · rw [if_pos hu₁0]
        by_cases hu₂1 : u₂ ≤ 1
        · rw [if_pos hu₂1]
          have h_sh := path.h_shape_mono u₂ u₂ hu₂_pos le_rfl hu₂1
          linarith
        · rw [if_neg hu₂1]
          linarith
      · rw [if_neg hu₁0]
        have hu₁_pos : 0 < u₁ := lt_of_not_ge hu₁0
        by_cases hu₁1 : u₁ ≤ 1
        · rw [if_pos hu₁1]
          by_cases hu₂1 : u₂ ≤ 1
          · rw [if_pos hu₂1]
            have h_sh := path.h_shape_mono u₁ u₂ hu₁_pos hu hu₂1
            linarith
          · rw [if_neg hu₂1]
            have h_sh := path.h_shape_mono u₁ u₁ hu₁_pos le_rfl hu₁1
            linarith
        · have hu₂1 : ¬ u₂ ≤ 1 := fun h => hu₁1 (le_trans hu h)
          rw [if_neg hu₁1, if_neg hu₂1]
  have hf_a_mono : Monotone f_a := by
    intro u₁ u₂ hu
    dsimp only [f_a]
    by_cases hu₂0 : u₂ ≤ 0
    · have hu₁0 : u₁ ≤ 0 := le_trans hu hu₂0
      rw [if_pos hu₁0, if_pos hu₂0]
    · rw [if_neg hu₂0]
      have hu₂_pos : 0 < u₂ := lt_of_not_ge hu₂0
      by_cases hu₁0 : u₁ ≤ 0
      · rw [if_pos hu₁0]
        by_cases hu₂1 : u₂ ≤ 1
        · rw [if_pos hu₂1]
          have h_sh := path.h_shape_mono u₂ u₂ hu₂_pos le_rfl hu₂1
          linarith
        · rw [if_neg hu₂1]
          linarith
      · rw [if_neg hu₁0]
        have hu₁_pos : 0 < u₁ := lt_of_not_ge hu₁0
        by_cases hu₁1 : u₁ ≤ 1
        · rw [if_pos hu₁1]
          by_cases hu₂1 : u₂ ≤ 1
          · rw [if_pos hu₂1]
            have h_sh := path.h_shape_mono u₁ u₂ hu₁_pos hu hu₂1
            linarith
          · rw [if_neg hu₂1]
            have h_sh := path.h_shape_mono u₁ u₁ hu₁_pos le_rfl hu₁1
            linarith
        · have hu₂1 : ¬ u₂ ≤ 1 := fun h => hu₁1 (le_trans hu h)
          rw [if_neg hu₁1, if_neg hu₂1]
  have hf_e_mono : Monotone f_e := hf_a_mono.add hf_b_mono
  have hf_S_mono : Monotone path.S_path := by
    intro u₁ u₂ hu
    linarith [(path.hS_lip u₁ u₂ hu).1]
  have hfe_eq : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, f_e u = (path.a_path u - path.b_path u) + u := by
    intro u ⟨hu0, hu1⟩
    dsimp only [f_e, f_a, f_b]
    simp only [if_neg (not_le.mpr hu0), if_pos hu1]
    ring
  have hfe_one : f_e 1 = m + 1 := by
    rw [hfe_eq 1 ⟨zero_lt_one, le_rfl⟩, path.ha_one, path.hb_one]
    ring
  have h_ae_reg : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f_b x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ f_a x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ path.S_path x := by
    filter_upwards [hf_b_mono.ae_differentiableAt, hf_a_mono.ae_differentiableAt,
      hf_S_mono.ae_differentiableAt] with x hb ha hS
    exact ⟨hb, ha, hS⟩
  have h_reg_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f_b x → DifferentiableAt ℝ f_a x → DifferentiableAt ℝ path.S_path x →
      HasDerivAt path.b_path (-deriv f_b x) x ∧
      HasDerivAt path.a_path (deriv f_a x - 1) x ∧
      HasDerivAt path.S_path (deriv path.S_path x) x ∧
      deriv f_e x = deriv f_a x + deriv f_b x := by
    intro x hx hb ha hS
    have h_eq_b : path.b_path =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun u => -f_b u) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hx] with u hu
      dsimp only [f_b]
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hu.1), if_pos hu.2.le, neg_neg]
    have h_eq_a : path.a_path =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun u => f_a u - u) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hx] with u hu
      dsimp only [f_a]
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hu.1), if_pos hu.2.le]

        have h_L'_eq : (![b₀ + d, (b₀ + d) + u₀, b₀ + m * u₀, (b₀ + m * u₀) + u₀] : Fin 4 → ℝ) = L' := by
          ext j
          fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [L']; try ring }
        rw [h_L'_eq] at h_obs
        have h_cont := h_contact u₀ hu₀
        rw [← h_Lbase_zero u₀] at h_cont
        dsimp only [g_x]
        rw [max_eq_left hd0]
        linarith [h_cap.2, h_obs, h_cont]
      · intro lam_s h i t hlam₀ hlam_min hh₀ hh_u hi_lo hi_hi ht₀ hit_hi
        let b₀ : ℝ := b u₀
        let v : ℝ := u₀ - h
        have hv_ioo : v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hu₀.1], by linarith [hu₀.2]⟩
        have hlam_lt1 : lam_s < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hlam_min (min_le_left 1 m)
        have hlam_ltm : lam_s < m := lt_of_lt_of_le hlam_min (min_le_right 1 m)
        let Δ₁ : ℝ := (b₀ + u₀) - (i + v)
        let Δ₂ : ℝ := (b₀ + m * u₀) - (i + m * v)
        let Δ₃ : ℝ := (b₀ + (1 + m) * u₀) - (i + (1 + m) * v)
        have hΔ₁_pos : 0 < Δ₁ := by
          dsimp only [Δ₁, b₀, v]
          have h1 : lam_s * h < 1 * h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlam_lt1 hh₀
          linarith
        have hΔ₂_pos : 0 < Δ₂ := by
          dsimp only [Δ₂, b₀, v]
          have h1 : lam_s * h < m * h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlam_ltm hh₀
          linarith
        have hΔ₃_pos : 0 < Δ₃ := by
          dsimp only [Δ₃, b₀, v]
          have h1 : lam_s * h < 1 * h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlam_lt1 hh₀
          have hm_h : 0 < m * h := mul_pos hm_pos hh₀
          linarith
        let p_fn : ℝ → (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ := fun x =>
          (![x, i + v, i + m * v, i + (1 + m) * v], v)
        let q₁_fn : ℝ → (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ := fun x =>
          (![x, i + v, i + m * v, i + (1 + m) * v], u₀)
        let q₂_fn : ℝ → (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ := fun x =>
          (![x, b₀ + u₀, i + m * v, i + (1 + m) * v], u₀)
        let q₃_fn : ℝ → (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ := fun x =>
          (![x, b₀ + u₀, b₀ + m * u₀, i + (1 + m) * v], u₀)
        let q₄_fn : ℝ → (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ := fun x =>
          (![x, b₀ + u₀, b₀ + m * u₀, b₀ + (1 + m) * u₀], u₀)
        have h_cones : ∀ x : ℝ, b₀ ≤ x → i ≤ x →
            InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 (p_fn x) ∧
            InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 (q₁_fn x) ∧
            InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 (q₂_fn x) ∧
            InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 (q₃_fn x) ∧
            InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 (q₄_fn x) := by
          intro x hxb hxi
          have hm_h : 0 < m * h := mul_pos hm_pos hh₀
          refine ⟨⟨hv_ioo, ?_⟩, ⟨hu₀, ?_⟩, ⟨hu₀, ?_⟩, ⟨hu₀, ?_⟩, ⟨hu₀, ?_⟩⟩
          · intro j k hE
            rcases hE with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
              { dsimp [p_fn]; linarith }
          · intro j k hE
            rcases hE with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
              { dsimp [q₁_fn, v]; linarith }
          · intro j k hE
            rcases hE with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
              { dsimp [q₂_fn, v]; linarith [hΔ₃_pos] }
          · intro j k hE
            rcases hE with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
              { dsimp [q₃_fn, v]; linarith [hΔ₃_pos] }
          · intro j k hE
            rcases hE with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
              { dsimp [q₄_fn]; linarith }
        obtain ⟨hc_pi, hc_q1i, hc_q2i, hc_q3i, hc_q4i⟩ := h_cones i hi_lo le_rfl
        obtain ⟨hc_pt, hc_q1t, hc_q2t, hc_q3t, hc_q4t⟩ :=
          h_cones (i + t) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have h_upd_p0 : Function.update (p_fn i).1 0 ((p_fn i).1 0 + t) = (p_fn (i + t)).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [p_fn, Function.update]
        have h_v_add : v + h = u₀ := by dsimp [v]; ring
        have h_step0 := h_sm4 (p_fn i).1 v t h 0 ht₀.le hh₀.le hc_pi
          (by rw [h_upd_p0]; exact hc_pt)
          (by rw [h_v_add]; exact hc_q1i)
          (by rw [h_upd_p0, h_v_add]; exact hc_q1t)
        rw [h_upd_p0, h_v_add] at h_step0
        have h_upd_q1_0 : Function.update (q₁_fn i).1 0 ((q₁_fn i).1 0 + t) = (q₁_fn (i + t)).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [q₁_fn, Function.update]
        have h_upd_q1_1 : Function.update (q₁_fn i).1 1 ((q₁_fn i).1 1 + Δ₁) = (q₂_fn i).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [q₁_fn, q₂_fn, Δ₁, Function.update]; try ring }
        have h_upd_q1_01 : Function.update ((q₁_fn (i + t)).1) 1 (((q₁_fn (i + t)).1) 1 + Δ₁) =
            (q₂_fn (i + t)).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [q₁_fn, q₂_fn, Δ₁, Function.update]; try ring }
        have h_step1 := h_sm3 (q₁_fn i).1 u₀ t Δ₁ 0 1 (by decide) ht₀.le hΔ₁_pos.le hc_q1i
          (by rw [h_upd_q1_0]; exact hc_q1t)
          (by rw [h_upd_q1_1]; exact hc_q2i)
          (by rw [h_upd_q1_0, h_upd_q1_01]; exact hc_q2t)
        rw [h_upd_q1_0, h_upd_q1_1, h_upd_q1_01] at h_step1
        have h_upd_q2_0 : Function.update (q₂_fn i).1 0 ((q₂_fn i).1 0 + t) = (q₂_fn (i + t)).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [q₂_fn, Function.update]
        have h_upd_q2_2 : Function.update (q₂_fn i).1 2 ((q₂_fn i).1 2 + Δ₂) = (q₃_fn i).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [q₂_fn, q₃_fn, Δ₂, Function.update]; try ring }
        have h_upd_q2_02 : Function.update ((q₂_fn (i + t)).1) 2 (((q₂_fn (i + t)).1) 2 + Δ₂) =
            (q₃_fn (i + t)).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [q₂_fn, q₃_fn, Δ₂, Function.update]; try ring }
        have h_step2 := h_sm3 (q₂_fn i).1 u₀ t Δ₂ 0 2 (by decide) ht₀.le hΔ₂_pos.le hc_q2i
          (by rw [h_upd_q2_0]; exact hc_q2t)
          (by rw [h_upd_q2_2]; exact hc_q3i)
          (by rw [h_upd_q2_0, h_upd_q2_02]; exact hc_q3t)
        rw [h_upd_q2_0, h_upd_q2_2, h_upd_q2_02] at h_step2
        have h_upd_q3_0 : Function.update (q₃_fn i).1 0 ((q₃_fn i).1 0 + t) = (q₃_fn (i + t)).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [q₃_fn, Function.update]
        have h_upd_q3_3 : Function.update (q₃_fn i).1 3 ((q₃_fn i).1 3 + Δ₃) = (q₄_fn i).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [q₃_fn, q₄_fn, Δ₃, Function.update]; try ring }
        have h_upd_q3_03 : Function.update ((q₃_fn (i + t)).1) 3 (((q₃_fn (i + t)).1) 3 + Δ₃) =
            (q₄_fn (i + t)).1 := by
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [q₃_fn, q₄_fn, Δ₃, Function.update]; try ring }
        have h_step3 := h_sm3 (q₃_fn i).1 u₀ t Δ₃ 0 3 (by decide) ht₀.le hΔ₃_pos.le hc_q3i
          (by rw [h_upd_q3_0]; exact hc_q3t)
          (by rw [h_upd_q3_3]; exact hc_q4i)
          (by rw [h_upd_q3_0, h_upd_q3_03]; exact hc_q4t)
        rw [h_upd_q3_0, h_upd_q3_3, h_upd_q3_03] at h_step3
        have h_q4_i : (L_base u₀ (max (i - b₀) 0), u₀) = q₄_fn i := by
          rw [max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hi_lo)]
          refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [L_base, q₄_fn, b₀]; try ring }
        have h_q4_it : (L_base u₀ (max (i - b₀ + t) 0), u₀) = q₄_fn (i + t) := by
          rw [max_eq_left (by linarith [sub_nonneg.mpr hi_lo])]
          refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [L_base, q₄_fn, b₀]; try ring }
        have h_p0_eq : planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h) = p_fn i := by
          refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
          ext j; fin_cases j <;> { dsimp [planeEmbed, p_fn, v]; try ring }
        have h_pt_eq : (Function.update (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h)).1 0
            ((planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h)).1 0 + t),
              (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h)).2) = p_fn (i + t) := by
          rw [h_p0_eq, h_upd_p0]
        dsimp only [g_x]
        change (f_raw (L_base u₀ (max (i - b₀ + t) 0), u₀) - f_raw (L_base u₀ 0, u₀)) -
            (f_raw (L_base u₀ (max (i - b₀) 0), u₀) - f_raw (L_base u₀ 0, u₀)) ≤
          f_raw (Function.update (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h)).1 0
            ((planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h)).1 0 + t),
              (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h)).2) -
          f_raw (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h))
        rw [h_q4_i, h_q4_it, h_pt_eq, h_p0_eq]
        change (f_raw (q₁_fn (i + t)) - f_raw (p_fn (i + t)) - f_raw (q₁_fn i) + f_raw (p_fn i) ≤ 0) at h_step0
        change (f_raw (q₂_fn (i + t)) - f_raw (q₁_fn (i + t)) - f_raw (q₂_fn i) + f_raw (q₁_fn i) ≤ 0) at h_step1
        change (f_raw (q₃_fn (i + t)) - f_raw (q₂_fn (i + t)) - f_raw (q₃_fn i) + f_raw (q₂_fn i) ≤ 0) at h_step2
        change (f_raw (q₄_fn (i + t)) - f_raw (q₃_fn (i + t)) - f_raw (q₄_fn i) + f_raw (q₃_fn i) ≤ 0) at h_step3
        linarith [h_step0, h_step1, h_step2, h_step3]
    let sys : MatchedAspectProfileSystem γ m := {
      B_sys := B_sys
      κ := κ
      τ := τ
      b := b
      S := S
      f_raw := f_raw
      g_x := g_x
      ε_seq := ε_seq
      N_ω := N_ω
      N_T := N_T
      π_seq := π_seq
      T_seq := T_seq
      V_seq := V_seq
      A_seq := A_seq
      c_seq := c_seq
      R_seq := R_seq
      H_uncond := H_uncond
      H_condT := H_condT
      hB_sys := hB_sys
      hκ := hκ
      hτ := hτ
      hb_lip := hb_lip
      hb_dom := hb_dom
      hS_lip := hS_lip
      hS_zero := hS_zero
      hε_bounds := hε_bounds
      hε_tendsto := hε_tendsto
      h_law := h_law
      h_homog := h_homog
      h_time_ent := h_time_ent
      h_orient_pred := h_orient_pred
      h_orient_growth := h_orient_growth
      h_f_lim := h_f_lim
      h_submod := h_submod
      h_obstacle := h_obstacle
      h_contact := h_contact
      h_x_refine := h_x_refine
    }
    exact Or.inr ⟨m, sys, hm_pos⟩

least_aspect_dichotomy.definitions:
def cyclicBinDist (M k₁ k₂ : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  min |k₁ - k₂| (M - |k₁ - k₂|)

noncomputable def angBin (ε e θ : ℝ) : ℤ :=
  let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
  min ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1)

noncomputable def angUnitVec (ε e : ℝ) (k_ang : ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
  let φ := ((k_ang : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ]

noncomputable def stdApertureObs (ε u b a : ℝ)
    (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s θ_s : ℝ) :
    ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let k_t := dyadicTimeBin ε u c_s
  let c_m := dyadicTimeMid ε u c_s
  let k_r := angBin ε (a - b) θ_s
  let e_dir := angUnitVec ε (a - b) k_r
  let x_p := A_p + c_m • V_p
  (k_t, k_r,
    dyadicRealBin ε b (inner ℝ V_p e_dir),
    dyadicRealBin ε a (inner ℝ V_p (perp2D e_dir)),
    dyadicRealBin ε (b + u) (inner ℝ x_p e_dir),
    dyadicRealBin ε (a + u) (inner ℝ x_p (perp2D e_dir)))

noncomputable def stdApertureScore (ε γ u b a : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a) -
    finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω =>
      stdApertureObs ε u b a (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)) +
    2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))

def IsPosDyadicUnit (u : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 2 ^ k ∧ u = (j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k

def IsStdSaturatedAspect (γ e : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ e ∧
  ∃ (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (N_ω N_T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (π_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ)
    (T_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → Fin (N_T n))
    (V_seq A_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_seq θ_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ),
    (∀ n, 0 < ε_seq n ∧ ε_seq n < 1 / 2) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ n, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_seq n ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n), π_seq n ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid, ‖V_seq n tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_seq n tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_seq n ω →
        c_seq n ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ θ_seq n ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      stdApertureScore (ε_seq n) γ 1 0 e (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n)
        (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) -
      classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq n) (1 + e) γ (N_ω n) (N_T n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (V_seq n) (A_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (classicalGrowthRate γ))

noncomputable def leastClassicalAspect (γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf { e : ℝ | IsStdSaturatedAspect γ e }

structure CoherentSaturatedPath (γ m : ℝ) : Type where
  K_coh : ℝ
  τ_path : ℝ
  b_path : ℝ → ℝ
  a_path : ℝ → ℝ
  S_path : ℝ → ℝ
  ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  N_ω : ℕ → ℕ
  N_T : ℕ → ℕ
  π_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ
  T_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → Fin (N_T n)
  V_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  A_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  c_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ
  θ_time : ℝ → ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ
  hK_coh : 0 < K_coh
  hτ_bounds : 0 ≤ τ_path ∧ τ_path ≤ 2 * (1 + m)
  hb_one : b_path 1 = 0
  ha_one : a_path 1 = m
  h_shape_mono : ∀ (r t : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
    0 ≤ b_path t ∧ b_path t ≤ b_path r ∧ b_path r ≤ a_path r ∧
    a_path r + r ≤ a_path t + t ∧ a_path t + t ≤ 1 + m
  h_aspect_lb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, m * u ≤ a_path u - b_path u
  hS_zero : S_path 0 = 0
  hS_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ →
    0 ≤ S_path u₂ - S_path u₁ ∧ S_path u₂ - S_path u₁ ≤ u₂ - u₁
  hε_bounds : ∀ n, 0 < ε_seq n ∧ ε_seq n < 1 / 2
  hε_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  h_law : ∀ n, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_seq n ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n), π_seq n ω = 1) ∧
    (∀ tid, ‖V_seq n tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_seq n tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ ω, 0 < π_seq n ω → c_seq n ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    (∀ u, IsPosDyadicUnit u → ∀ ω, 0 < π_seq n ω →
      θ_time u n ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)
  h_root_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
    classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq n) (1 + m) γ (N_ω n) (N_T n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
      (V_seq n) (A_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds τ_path)
  h_time_ent : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      finCondEntropy (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (S_path u))
  h_time_homog : ∀ (r q : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → r ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      let ε := ε_seq n
      let X_r := fun ω => (T_seq n ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_seq n ω))
      let Y_q := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε q (c_seq n ω)
      ∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
        if δ < |condSurprise ε (π_seq n) X_r Y_q ω - (S_path q - S_path r)|
        then π_seq n ω else 0)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  h_dyad_sat : ∀ u : ℝ, IsPosDyadicUnit u →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      stdApertureScore (ε_seq n) γ u (b_path u) (a_path u) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (V_seq n) (A_seq n) (c_seq n) (θ_time u n) -
      classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq n) (1 + m) γ (N_ω n) (N_T n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (V_seq n) (A_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (classicalGrowthRate γ * u))
  h_dyad_pred : ∀ u : ℝ, IsPosDyadicUnit u →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      finCondEntropy (ε_seq n) (π_seq n)
        (fun ω => (T_seq n ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω)))
        (fun ω => angBin (ε_seq n) (a_path u - b_path u) (θ_time u n ω)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  h_dyad_coh : ∀ (r t d : ℝ), IsPosDyadicUnit r → IsPosDyadicUnit t → r < t →
    0 < d →
    d < min (a_path r - b_path r) (a_path t - b_path t) -
      K_coh * (|b_path r - b_path t| + |a_path r - a_path t| + (t - r)) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      let ε := ε_seq n
      let M_bin : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
      ∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),

def cyclicBinDist (M k₁ k₂ : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  min |k₁ - k₂| (M - |k₁ - k₂|)

noncomputable def angBin (ε e θ : ℝ) : ℤ :=
  let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
  min ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1)

noncomputable def angUnitVec (ε e : ℝ) (k_ang : ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
  let φ := ((k_ang : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ]

noncomputable def stdApertureObs (ε u b a : ℝ)
    (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s θ_s : ℝ) :
    ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let k_t := dyadicTimeBin ε u c_s
  let c_m := dyadicTimeMid ε u c_s
  let k_r := angBin ε (a - b) θ_s
  let e_dir := angUnitVec ε (a - b) k_r
  let x_p := A_p + c_m • V_p
  (k_t, k_r,
    dyadicRealBin ε b (inner ℝ V_p e_dir),
    dyadicRealBin ε a (inner ℝ V_p (perp2D e_dir)),
    dyadicRealBin ε (b + u) (inner ℝ x_p e_dir),
    dyadicRealBin ε (a + u) (inner ℝ x_p (perp2D e_dir)))

noncomputable def stdApertureScore (ε γ u b a : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a) -
    finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω =>
      stdApertureObs ε u b a (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)) +
    2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))

def IsPosDyadicUnit (u : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 2 ^ k ∧ u = (j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k

def IsStdSaturatedAspect (γ e : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ e ∧
  ∃ (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (N_ω N_T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (π_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ)
    (T_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → Fin (N_T n))
    (V_seq A_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_seq θ_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ),
    (∀ n, 0 < ε_seq n ∧ ε_seq n < 1 / 2) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ n, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_seq n ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n), π_seq n ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid, ‖V_seq n tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_seq n tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_seq n ω →
        c_seq n ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ θ_seq n ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      stdApertureScore (ε_seq n) γ 1 0 e (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n)
        (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) -
      classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq n) (1 + e) γ (N_ω n) (N_T n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (V_seq n) (A_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (classicalGrowthRate γ))

noncomputable def leastClassicalAspect (γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf { e : ℝ | IsStdSaturatedAspect γ e }

  K_coh : ℝ

  hε_bounds : ∀ n, 0 < ε_seq n ∧ ε_seq n < 1 / 2

  h_law : ∀ n, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_seq n ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n), π_seq n ω = 1) ∧

      finCondEntropy (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)

  h_time_homog : ∀ (r q : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → r ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      let ε := ε_seq n
      let X_r := fun ω => (T_seq n ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_seq n ω))
      let Y_q := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε q (c_seq n ω)
      ∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
        if δ < |condSurprise ε (π_seq n) X_r Y_q ω - (S_path q - S_path r)|
        then π_seq n ω else 0)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  h_dyad_sat : ∀ u : ℝ, IsPosDyadicUnit u →

      stdApertureScore (ε_seq n) γ u (b_path u) (a_path u) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (V_seq n) (A_seq n) (c_seq n) (θ_time u n) -
      classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq n) (1 + m) γ (N_ω n) (N_T n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (V_seq n) (A_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (classicalGrowthRate γ * u))
  h_dyad_pred : ∀ u : ℝ, IsPosDyadicUnit u →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      finCondEntropy (ε_seq n) (π_seq n)
        (fun ω => (T_seq n ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω)))
        (fun ω => angBin (ε_seq n) (a_path u - b_path u) (θ_time u n ω)))

  h_dyad_coh : ∀ (r t d : ℝ), IsPosDyadicUnit r → IsPosDyadicUnit t → r < t →
    0 < d →
    d < min (a_path r - b_path r) (a_path t - b_path t) -

      have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt p W ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_pos hp2_le
      have hlog_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 p W X ω / finProbAt p W ω) ≤ 0 :=
        Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg hp2_pos.le hp1_pos.le) ((div_le_one hp1_pos).mpr hp2_le)
      exact mul_nonneg (hp0 ω) (div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hlog_np) hell0.le)
    · have hpz : p ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hp0 ω)
      simp [hpz]
  have hs2_equiv : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α_t) (Y : Fin N → β_t) (Z : Fin N → γ_t),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) →
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < p ω₁ → 0 < p ω₂ → X ω₁ = X ω₂ → (Y ω₁ = Y ω₂ ↔ Z ω₁ = Z ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p X Y = finCondEntropy ε₀ p X Z := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p X Y Z hp0 heqv
    let _ : DecidableEq α_t := Classical.decEq α_t
    let _ : DecidableEq β_t := Classical.decEq β_t
    let _ : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < p ω
    · have hp_eq : finProbAt2 p X Y ω = finProbAt2 p X Z ω := by
        rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hpos' : 0 < p ω'
        · by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω
          · have hyz := heqv ω' ω hpos' hpos hx
            by_cases hy : Y ω' = Y ω
            · have hz : Z ω' = Z ω := hyz.mp hy
              simp [hx, hy, hz]
            · have hz : Z ω' ≠ Z ω := fun hz => hy (hyz.mpr hz)
              simp [hx, hy, hz]
          · simp [hx]
        · have hpz' : p ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos') (hp0 ω')
          simp [hpz']
      rw [hp_eq]
    · have hpz : p ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hp0 ω)
      simp [hpz]
  have h_chain_rule : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N → α_t) (X : Fin N → β_t) (Y : Fin N → γ_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) →
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε₀ p W X + finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0
    let _ : DecidableEq α_t := Classical.decEq α_t
    let _ : DecidableEq β_t := Classical.decEq β_t
    let _ : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < p ω
    · have hp_wxy : finProbAt2 p W (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) ω =
          finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω := by
        rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω <;>
          by_cases hy : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, hw, hx, hy]
      have hp_wx : finProbAt p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) ω = finProbAt2 p W X ω :=
        h_probAt_pair p W X ω
      rw [hp_wxy, hp_wx]
      obtain ⟨hB_pos, hB_le_A⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω hp0 hpos
      have hA_pos : 0 < finProbAt p W ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hB_pos hB_le_A
      obtain ⟨hC_pos, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω hp0 hpos
      have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p W X ω / finProbAt p W ω := div_pos hB_pos hA_pos
      have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt2 p W X ω :=
        div_pos hC_pos hB_pos
      have h_prod : finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt p W ω =
          (finProbAt2 p W X ω / finProbAt p W ω) *
            (finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt2 p W X ω) := by
        field_simp [hA_pos.ne', hB_pos.ne']
      rw [h_prod, Real.log_mul h1_pos.ne' h2_pos.ne']
      ring
    · have hpz : p ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hp0 ω)
      simp [hpz]
  have h_ent_comm : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N → α_t) (X : Fin N → β_t) (Y : Fin N → γ_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, p ω = 1) →
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p W Y + finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => (W ω, Y ω)) X =
        finCondEntropy ε₀ p W X + finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0 _
    have hc1 := h_chain_rule ε₀ p W Y X hε0 hε1 hp0
    have hc2 := h_chain_rule ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0
    rw [← hc1, ← hc2]
    exact hs2_equiv ε₀ p W (fun ω => (Y ω, X ω)) (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) hp0
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => by simp [Prod.ext_iff, and_comm])
  have h_gibbs : ∀ {N : ℕ} (Q r : Fin N → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → 0 < r ω) →
      (∑ ω ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ, Q ω * r ω) ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ, Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) := by
    intro N Q r hQ0 hQ1 hr_pos hr_sum
    let S_Q := @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    have hS_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_Q, Q ω = 1 := by
      rw [← hQ1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_Q)]
      intro ω _ hnot
      have hnot_pos : ¬ 0 < Q ω := fun hp =>
        hnot ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hp⟩)
      exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnot_pos) (hQ0 ω)
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S_Q, Q ω - Q ω * r ω ≤ Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hpos : 0 < Q ω :=
        ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mp hω).2
      have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (hr_pos ω hpos)
      have h1 : 1 - r ω ≤ -Real.log (r ω) := by linarith only [hlog]
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (hQ0 ω)
      have h3 : Q ω * (1 - r ω) = Q ω - Q ω * r ω := by ring
      linarith only [h2, h3]
    have h_sum_le := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hS_sum] at h_sum_le
    linarith only [h_sum_le, hr_sum]
  have h_cmi_nn : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N → α_t) (X : Fin N → β_t) (Y : Fin N → γ_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, p ω = 1) →
      0 ≤ finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p W X Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0 hp1
    let _ : DecidableEq α_t := Classical.decEq α_t
    let _ : DecidableEq β_t := Classical.decEq β_t
    let _ : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
    have hell0 := h_ell_pos_gen ε₀ hε0 hε1
    let S_p := @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < p ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    have h_mem_Sp : ∀ ω, ω ∈ S_p ↔ 0 < p ω := fun ω => by
      simp only [S_p, @Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _),
        Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    have hp_zero_out : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S_p → p ω = 0 := fun ω hnot =>
      le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hpos => hnot ((h_mem_Sp ω).mpr hpos))) (hp0 ω)
    have hSp_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω = 1 := by
      rw [← hp1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
      intro ω _ hnot; exact hp_zero_out ω hnot
    let r : Fin N → ℝ := fun ω =>
      (finProbAt2 p W Y ω * finProbAt2 p W X ω) /
        (finProbAt p W ω * finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω)
    have hr_pos : ∀ ω, 0 < p ω → 0 < r ω := by
      intro ω hpos
      obtain ⟨hWY, hWY_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p W Y ω hp0 hpos
      have hW : 0 < finProbAt p W ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hWY hWY_le
      obtain ⟨hWX, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω hp0 hpos
      obtain ⟨hWXY, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω hp0 hpos
      exact div_pos (mul_pos hWY hWX) (mul_pos hW hWXY)
    have h_cmi_eq : finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p W X Y =
        (∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * (-Real.log (r ω))) / Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) := by
      unfold finCondMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p), Finset.sum_div]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hpos : 0 < p ω := (h_mem_Sp ω).mp hω
        obtain ⟨hWY, hWY_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p W Y ω hp0 hpos
        have hW : 0 < finProbAt p W ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hWY hWY_le
        obtain ⟨hWX, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω hp0 hpos
        obtain ⟨hWXY, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω hp0 hpos
        have hp_wx : finProbAt p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) ω = finProbAt2 p W X ω :=
          h_probAt_pair p W X ω
        rw [hp_wx]
        have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p W Y ω / finProbAt p W ω := div_pos hWY hW
        have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt2 p W X ω :=
          div_pos hWXY hWX
        have hr_div : r ω = (finProbAt2 p W Y ω / finProbAt p W ω) /
            (finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt2 p W X ω) := by
          dsimp [r]
          field_simp [hW.ne', hWX.ne', hWXY.ne']
        rw [hr_div, Real.log_div h1_pos.ne' h2_pos.ne']
        ring
      · intro ω _ hnot
        simp [hp_zero_out ω hnot]
    let I_W := S_p.image W
    let I_X := S_p.image X
    let I_Y := S_p.image Y
    let P_W : α_t → ℝ := fun w => ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if W ω' = w then p ω' else 0
    let P_WX : α_t → β_t → ℝ := fun w x => ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if W ω' = w ∧ X ω' = x then p ω' else 0
    let P_WY : α_t → γ_t → ℝ := fun w y => ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if W ω' = w ∧ Y ω' = y then p ω' else 0
    let P_WXY : α_t → β_t → γ_t → ℝ := fun w x y =>
      ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if (W ω' = w ∧ X ω' = x) ∧ Y ω' = y then p ω' else 0
    have hr_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * r ω ≤ 1 := by
      have h_fib := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (s := S_p) (t := I_W ×ˢ (I_X ×ˢ I_Y)) (g := fun ω => (W ω, (X ω, Y ω)))
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem W hω,
          Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω, Finset.mem_image_of_mem Y hω⟩⟩)
        (fun ω => p ω * r ω)).symm
      rw [h_fib]
      have h_cell : ∀ t ∈ I_W ×ˢ (I_X ×ˢ I_Y),
          (∑ ω ∈ S_p.filter (fun ω => (W ω, (X ω, Y ω)) = t), p ω * r ω) ≤
            (P_WY t.1 t.2.2 * P_WX t.1 t.2.1) / P_W t.1 := by
        intro ⟨w, x, y⟩ _
        let F_t := S_p.filter (fun ω => (W ω, (X ω, Y ω)) = (w, (x, y)))
        change (∑ ω ∈ F_t, p ω * r ω) ≤ (P_WY w y * P_WX w x) / P_W w
        by_cases hne : F_t.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
          obtain ⟨hω₀_sp, _⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
          have hPW_eq : ∀ ω ∈ F_t, finProbAt p W ω = P_W w := by
            intro ω hω
            have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2).1
            rw [h_probAt_eq, hw, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
          have hPWX_eq : ∀ ω ∈ F_t, finProbAt2 p W X ω = P_WX w x := by
            intro ω hω
            have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
            have hx : X ω = x := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).1
            rw [h_probAt2_eq, hw, hx, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
          have hPWY_eq : ∀ ω ∈ F_t, finProbAt2 p W Y ω = P_WY w y := by
            intro ω hω
            have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
            have hy : Y ω = y := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).2
            rw [h_probAt2_eq, hw, hy, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
          have hPWXY_eq : ∀ ω ∈ F_t,
              finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω = P_WXY w x y := by
            intro ω hω
            have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
            have hx : X ω = x := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).1
            have hy : Y ω = y := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).2
            rw [h_probAt2_eq, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              simp only [Prod.ext_iff, hw, hx, hy]
            · intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
          have hFt_sum : ∑ ω ∈ F_t, p ω = P_WXY w x y := by
            dsimp [F_t, P_WXY]
            rw [Finset.sum_filter]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            simp only [Prod.ext_iff, and_assoc]
          have hPWXY_pos : 0 < P_WXY w x y := by
            rw [← hPWXY_eq ω₀ hω₀]
            exact (h_prob_bds p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω₀ hp0 ((h_mem_Sp ω₀).mp hω₀_sp)).1
          have hPW_pos : 0 < P_W w := by
            rw [← hPW_eq ω₀ hω₀]
            obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω₀ hp0 ((h_mem_Sp ω₀).mp hω₀_sp)
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
          have h_congr : ∑ ω ∈ F_t, p ω * r ω =
              ∑ ω ∈ F_t, p ω * ((P_WY w y * P_WX w x) / (P_W w * P_WXY w x y)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
            dsimp [r]
            rw [hPW_eq ω hω, hPWX_eq ω hω, hPWY_eq ω hω, hPWXY_eq ω hω]
          rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul, hFt_sum]
          have h_eq : P_WXY w x y * ((P_WY w y * P_WX w x) / (P_W w * P_WXY w x y)) =
              (P_WY w y * P_WX w x) / P_W w := by
            field_simp [hPW_pos.ne', hPWXY_pos.ne']
          exact h_eq.le
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
          have h1 : 0 ≤ P_WY w y := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp0 ω])
          have h2 : 0 ≤ P_WX w x := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp0 ω])
          have h3 : 0 ≤ P_W w := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp0 ω])
          exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg h1 h2) h3
      have h_sum_w : ∀ w ∈ I_W,
          (∑ xy ∈ I_X ×ˢ I_Y, (P_WY w xy.2 * P_WX w xy.1) / P_W w) = P_W w := by
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨ω_w, hω_w_sp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
        have hPW_pos : 0 < P_W (W ω_w) := by
          have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun ω' => if W ω' = W ω_w then p ω' else 0)
            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp0 ω']) hω_w_sp
          simp only [↓reduceIte] at hle
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((h_mem_Sp ω_w).mp hω_w_sp) hle
        have h_sum_x : ∑ x ∈ I_X, P_WX (W ω_w) x = P_W (W ω_w) := by
          dsimp [P_WX, P_W]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
          have hx_in : X ω' ∈ I_X := Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω'
          by_cases hw_eq : W ω' = W ω_w <;> simp [hw_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq, hx_in]
        have h_sum_y : ∑ y ∈ I_Y, P_WY (W ω_w) y = P_W (W ω_w) := by
          dsimp [P_WY, P_W]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
          have hy_in : Y ω' ∈ I_Y := Finset.mem_image_of_mem Y hω'
          by_cases hw_eq : W ω' = W ω_w <;> simp [hw_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq, hy_in]
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_product]
        dsimp only
        have h_prod_xy : (∑ x ∈ I_X, ∑ y ∈ I_Y, P_WY (W ω_w) y * P_WX (W ω_w) x) =
            (∑ y ∈ I_Y, P_WY (W ω_w) y) * (∑ x ∈ I_X, P_WX (W ω_w) x) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm)
        rw [h_prod_xy, h_sum_y, h_sum_x]
        field_simp [hPW_pos.ne']
      have h_tot_w : ∑ w ∈ I_W, P_W w = 1 := by
        dsimp [P_W]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        have h1 : ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, ∑ w ∈ I_W, (if W ω' = w then p ω' else 0) = ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, p ω' := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
          have hw_in : W ω' ∈ I_W := Finset.mem_image_of_mem W hω'
          simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hw_in]
        rw [h1]
        exact hSp_sum
      calc ∑ t ∈ I_W ×ˢ (I_X ×ˢ I_Y),
              ∑ ω ∈ S_p.filter (fun ω => (W ω, (X ω, Y ω)) = t), p ω * r ω
          ≤ ∑ t ∈ I_W ×ˢ (I_X ×ˢ I_Y), (P_WY t.1 t.2.2 * P_WX t.1 t.2.1) / P_W t.1 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_cell
        _ = ∑ w ∈ I_W, ∑ xy ∈ I_X ×ˢ I_Y, (P_WY w xy.2 * P_WX w xy.1) / P_W w := by
            rw [Finset.sum_product]
        _ = ∑ w ∈ I_W, P_W w := Finset.sum_congr rfl h_sum_w
        _ = 1 := h_tot_w
    rw [h_cmi_eq]
    exact div_nonneg (h_gibbs p r hp0 hp1 hr_pos hr_sum) hell0.le
  have hs2_mi_step : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t δ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N → α_t) (X : Fin N → β_t) (Y : Fin N → γ_t) (U : Fin N → δ_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, p ω = 1) →
      finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) U Y ≤
        finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p W Y U - finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p W X U +
          finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => (W ω, Y ω)) X := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t δ_t ε₀ p W X Y U hε0 hε1 hp0 hp1
    have h1 := h_ent_comm ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0 hp1
    have h2 := h_ent_comm ε₀ p W Y U hε0 hε1 hp0 hp1
    have h3 := h_ent_comm ε₀ p W X U hε0 hε1 hp0 hp1

      let _ : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
      let _ : DecidableEq δ_t := Classical.decEq δ_t

        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω <;>

        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω <;>

  have hs2_card : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t : Type} [DecidableEq β_t] (ε₀ N_max : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α_t) (Y : Fin N → β_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ N_max →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, p ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < p ω₀ → ∃ S_Y : Finset β_t, (S_Y.card : ℝ) ≤ N_max ∧
        ∀ ω, 0 < p ω → X ω = X ω₀ → Y ω ∈ S_Y) →
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p X Y ≤ Real.log N_max / Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) := by
    intro N α_t β_t _ ε₀ N_max p X Y hε0 hε1 hNmax hp0 hp1 hcov
    let _ : DecidableEq α_t := Classical.decEq α_t
    have hell0 := h_ell_pos_gen ε₀ hε0 hε1
    have hN_pos : 0 < N_max := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hNmax
    let S_p := @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < p ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    have h_mem_Sp : ∀ ω, ω ∈ S_p ↔ 0 < p ω := fun ω => by
      simp only [S_p, @Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _),
        Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    have hp_zero_out : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S_p → p ω = 0 := fun ω hnot =>
      le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hpos => hnot ((h_mem_Sp ω).mpr hpos))) (hp0 ω)
    have hSp_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω = 1 := by
      rw [← hp1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
      intro ω _ hnot; exact hp_zero_out ω hnot
    let r : Fin N → ℝ := fun ω => finProbAt p X ω / (N_max * finProbAt2 p X Y ω)
    have hr_pos : ∀ ω, 0 < p ω → 0 < r ω := by
      intro ω hpos
      obtain ⟨hp2, hp2_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p X Y ω hp0 hpos
      exact div_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hp2 hp2_le) (mul_pos hN_pos hp2)
    have hr_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * r ω ≤ 1 := by
      have h_fib_x := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (s := S_p) (t := S_p.image X) (g := X)
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω) (fun ω => p ω * r ω)).symm
      rw [h_fib_x]
      have h_each_x : ∀ x ∈ S_p.image X,
          (∑ ω ∈ S_p.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), p ω * r ω) ≤
            ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if X ω' = x then p ω' else 0 := by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀_sp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
        obtain ⟨S_Y, hSY_card, hSY_mem⟩ := hcov ω₀ ((h_mem_Sp ω₀).mp hω₀_sp)
        let F_x := S_p.filter (fun ω => X ω = X ω₀)
        have h_fib_y := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
          (s := F_x) (t := S_Y) (g := Y)
          (fun ω hω => by
            obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
            exact hSY_mem ω ((h_mem_Sp ω).mp h1) h2)
          (fun ω => p ω * r ω)).symm
        rw [h_fib_y]
        let PX := ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if X ω' = X ω₀ then p ω' else 0
        have hPX_eq : finProbAt p X ω₀ = PX := by
          rw [h_probAt_eq, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
          intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
        have hPX_nn : 0 ≤ PX := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp0 ω'])
        have h_each_y : ∀ y ∈ S_Y,

          intro y _
          let F_xy := F_x.filter (fun ω => Y ω = y)
          change (∑ ω ∈ F_xy, p ω * r ω) ≤ PX / N_max
          by_cases hne : F_xy.Nonempty
          · obtain ⟨ω₁, hω₁⟩ := hne
            obtain ⟨hω₁_fx, hy1⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₁
            obtain ⟨hω₁_sp, hx1⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₁_fx
            have hPXY_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p X Y ω₁ :=
              (h_prob_bds p X Y ω₁ hp0 ((h_mem_Sp ω₁).mp hω₁_sp)).1
            have hFxy_sum : ∑ ω ∈ F_xy, p ω = finProbAt2 p X Y ω₁ := by
              rw [h_probAt2_eq, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
              · dsimp [F_xy, F_x]
                rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
                by_cases hxa : X ω = X ω₀ <;> by_cases hya : Y ω = y <;>
                  simp [hxa, hya, hx1, hy1]
              · intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
            have h_congr : ∑ ω ∈ F_xy, p ω * r ω =
                ∑ ω ∈ F_xy, p ω * (PX / (N_max * finProbAt2 p X Y ω₁)) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
              obtain ⟨h_fx, hy_w⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
              have hx_w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp h_fx).2
              have h1 : finProbAt p X ω = PX := by
                rw [← hPX_eq, h_probAt_eq, h_probAt_eq]; simp_rw [hx_w]
              have h2 : finProbAt2 p X Y ω = finProbAt2 p X Y ω₁ := by
                rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq]; simp_rw [hx_w, hy_w, hx1, hy1]
              dsimp [r]; rw [h1, h2]
            rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul, hFxy_sum]
            have h_eq : finProbAt2 p X Y ω₁ * (PX / (N_max * finProbAt2 p X Y ω₁)) =
                PX / N_max := by
              field_simp [hN_pos.ne', hPXY_pos.ne']
            exact h_eq.le
          · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
            exact div_nonneg hPX_nn hN_pos.le
        calc ∑ y ∈ S_Y, ∑ ω ∈ F_x.filter (fun ω => Y ω = y), p ω * r ω
            ≤ ∑ _y ∈ S_Y, PX / N_max := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_y
          _ = (S_Y.card : ℝ) * (PX / N_max) := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ ≤ N_max * (PX / N_max) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSY_card (div_nonneg hPX_nn hN_pos.le)
          _ = PX := mul_div_cancel₀ PX hN_pos.ne'
      calc ∑ x ∈ S_p.image X, ∑ ω ∈ S_p.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), p ω * r ω
          ≤ ∑ x ∈ S_p.image X, ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, (if X ω' = x then p ω' else 0) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_x
        _ = ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, ∑ x ∈ S_p.image X, (if X ω' = x then p ω' else 0) := Finset.sum_comm
        _ = ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, p ω' := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => by
            simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω'])
        _ = 1 := hSp_sum
    have h_gibbs_card := h_gibbs p r hp0 hp1 hr_pos hr_sum
    have h_ent_eq : finCondEntropy ε₀ p X Y =
        (∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 p X Y ω / finProbAt p X ω))) /
          Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) := by
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p), Finset.sum_div]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
      · intro ω _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω hnot]
    have h_id : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) =
        Real.log N_max -
          ∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 p X Y ω / finProbAt p X ω)) := by
      have h_term : ∀ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) =
          p ω * Real.log N_max -
            p ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 p X Y ω / finProbAt p X ω)) := by
        intro ω hω
        obtain ⟨hp2, hp2_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p X Y ω hp0 ((h_mem_Sp ω).mp hω)
        have hp1_p : 0 < finProbAt p X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2 hp2_le
        have hr_inv : r ω = (N_max * (finProbAt2 p X Y ω / finProbAt p X ω))⁻¹ := by
          dsimp [r]; field_simp [hN_pos.ne', hp2.ne', hp1_p.ne']
        rw [hr_inv, Real.log_inv, Real.log_mul hN_pos.ne' (div_pos hp2 hp1_p).ne']
        ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_term, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hSp_sum, one_mul]
    rw [h_id] at h_gibbs_card
    rw [h_ent_eq, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell0]
    linarith only [h_gibbs_card]
  have hs2_kl : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t : Type} (ε₀ d_min K : ℝ) (p Q : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α_t) (Y : Fin N → β_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ K →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, p ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, Q ω ≤ K * p ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → d_min ≤ condSurprise ε₀ p X Y ω) →
      d_min - Real.log K / Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) ≤ finCondEntropy ε₀ Q X Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t ε₀ d_min K p Q X Y hε0 hε1 hK hp0 hp1 hQ0 hQ1 hQp hd_min
    let _ : DecidableEq α_t := Classical.decEq α_t
    let _ : DecidableEq β_t := Classical.decEq β_t
    have hell0 := h_ell_pos_gen ε₀ hε0 hε1
    have hK_pos : 0 < K := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hK
    let S_Q := @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    have h_mem_SQ : ∀ ω, ω ∈ S_Q ↔ 0 < Q ω := fun ω => by
      simp only [S_Q, @Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _),
        Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    have hQ_zero_out : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S_Q → Q ω = 0 := fun ω hnot =>
      le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hpos => hnot ((h_mem_SQ ω).mpr hpos))) (hQ0 ω)
    have hSQ_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_Q, Q ω = 1 := by
      rw [← hQ1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_Q)]
      intro ω _ hnot; exact hQ_zero_out ω hnot
    have hp_pos_of_Q : ∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → 0 < p ω := fun ω hpos => by
      have h1 : 0 < K * p ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (hQp ω)
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_right h1 hK_pos.le
    let r : Fin N → ℝ := fun ω => finProbAt p X ω / finProbAt Q X ω
    have hr_pos : ∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → 0 < r ω := by
      intro ω hpos
      obtain ⟨hp2, hp2_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p X Y ω hp0 (hp_pos_of_Q ω hpos)
      obtain ⟨hq2, hq2_le⟩ := h_prob_bds Q X Y ω hQ0 hpos
      exact div_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hp2 hp2_le) (lt_of_lt_of_le hq2 hq2_le)
    have hr_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_Q, Q ω * r ω ≤ 1 := by
      have h_fib := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (s := S_Q) (t := S_Q.image X) (g := X)
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω) (fun ω => Q ω * r ω)).symm
      rw [h_fib]
      have h_each_x : ∀ x ∈ S_Q.image X,
          (∑ ω ∈ S_Q.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), Q ω * r ω) ≤
            ∑ ω' : Fin N, if X ω' = x then p ω' else 0 := by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀_sq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
        let F_x := S_Q.filter (fun ω => X ω = X ω₀)
        obtain ⟨hq2, hq2_le⟩ := h_prob_bds Q X Y ω₀ hQ0 ((h_mem_SQ ω₀).mp hω₀_sq)
        have hq1_pos : 0 < finProbAt Q X ω₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hq2 hq2_le
        have hFx_sum : ∑ ω ∈ F_x, Q ω = finProbAt Q X ω₀ := by
          rw [h_probAt_eq, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_Q)]
          · dsimp [F_x]; rw [Finset.sum_filter]
          · intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hQ_zero_out ω' hnot]
        have h_congr : ∑ ω ∈ F_x, Q ω * r ω =
            ∑ ω ∈ F_x, Q ω * (finProbAt p X ω₀ / finProbAt Q X ω₀) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
          have hx_w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
          have h1 : finProbAt p X ω = finProbAt p X ω₀ := by
            rw [h_probAt_eq, h_probAt_eq]; simp_rw [hx_w]
          have h2 : finProbAt Q X ω = finProbAt Q X ω₀ := by
            rw [h_probAt_eq, h_probAt_eq]; simp_rw [hx_w]
          dsimp [r]; rw [h1, h2]
        rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul, hFx_sum, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hq1_pos.ne', h_probAt_eq]
      calc ∑ x ∈ S_Q.image X, ∑ ω ∈ S_Q.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), Q ω * r ω
          ≤ ∑ x ∈ S_Q.image X, ∑ ω' : Fin N, (if X ω' = x then p ω' else 0) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_x
        _ = ∑ ω' : Fin N, ∑ x ∈ S_Q.image X, (if X ω' = x then p ω' else 0) := Finset.sum_comm
        _ ≤ ∑ ω' : Fin N, p ω' := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => by
            by_cases hmem : X ω' ∈ S_Q.image X
            · simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hmem]
            · simp [hmem, hp0 ω'])
        _ = 1 := hp1
    have h_gibbs_kl := h_gibbs Q r hQ0 hQ1 hr_pos hr_sum
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S_Q,
        Q ω * (d_min * Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) - Real.log K) + Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) ≤
          Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω)) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hposQ : 0 < Q ω := (h_mem_SQ ω).mp hω
      have hposp : 0 < p ω := hp_pos_of_Q ω hposQ
      obtain ⟨hq2, hq2_le⟩ := h_prob_bds Q X Y ω hQ0 hposQ
      have hq1 : 0 < finProbAt Q X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hq2 hq2_le
      obtain ⟨hp2, hp2_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p X Y ω hp0 hposp
      have hp1 : 0 < finProbAt p X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2 hp2_le
      have hq2_le_Kp2 : finProbAt2 Q X Y ω ≤ K * finProbAt2 p X Y ω := by
        rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        split_ifs
        · exact hQp ω'
        · simp
      have h_rat_le : finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω ≤
          (K * (finProbAt2 p X Y ω / finProbAt p X ω)) * r ω := by
        have h1 : finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω ≤
            (K * finProbAt2 p X Y ω) / finProbAt Q X ω :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hq2_le_Kp2 hq1.le
        have h2 : (K * finProbAt2 p X Y ω) / finProbAt Q X ω =
            (K * (finProbAt2 p X Y ω / finProbAt p X ω)) * r ω := by
          dsimp [r]; field_simp [hq1.ne', hp1.ne']
        rwa [h2] at h1
      have hlog_le := Real.log_le_log (div_pos hq2 hq1) h_rat_le
      rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos hK_pos (div_pos hp2 hp1)).ne' (hr_pos ω hposQ).ne',
        Real.log_mul hK_pos.ne' (div_pos hp2 hp1).ne'] at hlog_le
      have hd := hd_min ω hposQ
      unfold condSurprise at hd
      have hd' : d_min * Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) ≤ -Real.log (finProbAt2 p X Y ω / finProbAt p X ω) :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hell0).mp hd
      have h_in : d_min * Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) - Real.log K + (-Real.log (r ω)) ≤
          -Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω) := by
        linarith only [hlog_le, hd']
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_in (hQ0 ω)
      linarith only [hmul, mul_add (Q ω) (d_min * Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) - Real.log K) (-Real.log (r ω))]
    have h_sum_pt := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hSQ_sum, one_mul] at h_sum_pt
    have h_ent_eq : finCondEntropy ε₀ Q X Y =
        (∑ ω ∈ S_Q, Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω))) /
          Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) := by
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_Q), Finset.sum_div]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
      · intro ω _ hnot; simp [hQ_zero_out ω hnot]
    rw [h_ent_eq, le_div_iff₀ hell0]
    have halg : (d_min - Real.log K / Real.log (ε₀⁻¹)) * Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) =
        d_min * Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) - Real.log K := by
      rw [sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell0.ne']
    linarith only [h_sum_pt, h_gibbs_kl, halg]
  have h_unit_ent : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α_t) (Y : Fin N → β_t),
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => ((), X ω)) Y = finCondEntropy ε₀ p X Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t ε₀ p X Y
    have h1 : ∀ ω, finProbAt p (fun ω' => ((), X ω')) ω = finProbAt p X ω := by
      intro ω; unfold finProbAt
      congr 1; ext ω'; by_cases h : X ω' = X ω <;> simp [h]
    have h2 : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => ((), X ω')) Y ω = finProbAt2 p X Y ω := by
      intro ω; unfold finProbAt2
      congr 1; ext ω'; by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h]
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    simp_rw [h1, h2]
  have h_unit_mi : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α_t) (U : Fin N → β_t) (V : Fin N → γ_t),
      finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p (fun ω => ((), X ω)) U V = finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p X U V := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p X U V
    unfold finCondMutualInfo
    rw [h_unit_ent]
    congr 1
    have h1 : ∀ ω, finProbAt p (fun ω' => (((), X ω'), U ω')) ω =
        finProbAt p (fun ω' => (X ω', U ω')) ω := by
      intro ω; unfold finProbAt
      congr 1; ext ω'; by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ U ω' = U ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, h]
    have h2 : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (((), X ω'), U ω')) V ω =
        finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (X ω', U ω')) V ω := by
      intro ω; unfold finProbAt2
      congr 1; ext ω'
      by_cases h : (X ω' = X ω ∧ U ω' = U ω) ∧ V ω' = V ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, h]
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    simp_rw [h1, h2]
  have h_rpow_le_iff : ∀ (ρ A B : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → ρ ^ A ≤ ρ ^ B → B ≤ A := by
