  let F_at : ℝ → Fin M_ω → ℤ × ℤ :=
    fun u => isoLastBlockObs ε k u T_idx V_part A_part c_val n_dir
  let X_r : Fin M_ω → ℤ := isoTanVelBin ε k (r * l) T_idx V_part A_part c_val n_dir
  let V_d : Fin M_ω → ℤ × ℤ := isoVelObs ε d_star T_idx V_part

  let ρ₂ : ℝ := ε ^ (r * l)
  have hρ₂_pos : 0 < ρ₂ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos (r * l)
  have hρ₂_lt_half : ρ₂ < 1 / 2 := by
    refine h_exp_small (1 / 2) (r * l) (by norm_num) (mul_pos hr_pos hl_pos) ?_
    have : 1 / (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 2 := by norm_num
    rw [this]
    exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
      (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))
  have hρ₂_lt1 : ρ₂ < 1 := lt_trans hρ₂_lt_half (by norm_num)
  let κ₂ : ℝ := 6 * e₁ / (ϑ * r)
  have hκ₂_pos : 0 < κ₂ := div_pos (by positivity) (mul_pos hϑ_pos hr_pos)
  have hκ₂_le : κ₂ ≤ e₂ / 100 := by
    dsimp [κ₂]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hϑ_pos hr_pos)]
    have h_eq : (e₂ / 100) * (ϑ * r) = 6 * (ϑ * r * e₂ / 600) := by ring
    linarith only [he₁_le_e₂, h_eq]
  have hm_strip_ρ₂ : ρ₂ ^ κ₂ ≤ m_strip := by
    have h_eq : ρ₂ ^ κ₂ = ε ^ (6 * e₁ * h) := by
      dsimp [ρ₂, κ₂, l]
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
      congr 1; field_simp [hϑ_pos.ne', hr_pos.ne']
    rwa [h_eq]
  have hm_strip_inv_ub : m_strip⁻¹ ≤ ρ₂ ^ (-κ₂) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ₂_pos.le]
    exact inv_anti₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ₂_pos κ₂) hm_strip_ρ₂
  have hρ₂_a0 : ρ₂ ^ a₀ = ε ^ d_star := by
    dsimp [ρ₂, d_star]; rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]; congr 1; ring

  have h_Fc_ent : ∀ (u₁ u₂ : ℝ), a ≤ u₁ → u₁ ≤ u₂ → u₂ ≤ 1 →
      finCondEntropy ε π_strip (fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at u₂ ω)) (F_at u₁) ≤ Real.log C_amb / ell := by
    intro u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₁₂ hu₂
    refine hs2_card ε C_amb π_strip (fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at u₂ ω)) (F_at u₁)
      hε_pos hε_lt_half hC_amb_ge hπ_s_nn hπ_s_sum ?_
    intro ω₀ _
    obtain ⟨S_Fc, hSFc_card, hSFc_mem⟩ := hS_Fc_cov u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₁₂ hu₂ ω₀
    refine ⟨S_Fc, hSFc_card, fun ω _ h_eq => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hB_eq, hF_eq⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.mp h_eq
    exact hSFc_mem ω hB_eq hF_eq

  have h_sum_miB : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range R,
      finCondMutualInfo ε π_strip (fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at (a + (m : ℝ) * r * l) ω))
        X_r (F_at (a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l)) ≤ 2 * (r * l) := by
    let gB : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => finCondMutualInfo ε π_strip B_obs (F_at (a + (m : ℝ) * r * l)) X_r
    have h_step : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range R,
        finCondMutualInfo ε π_strip (fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at (a + (m : ℝ) * r * l) ω))
          X_r (F_at (a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l)) ≤
        (gB (m + 1) - gB m) + Real.log C_amb / ell := by
      intro m hm
      have hmR : (m + 1 : ℕ) ≤ R := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
      have hu1 : a ≤ a + (m : ℝ) * r * l := by
        have hnn : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) * r * l :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) hr_pos.le) hl_pos.le
        linarith only [hnn]
      have hu12 : a + (m : ℝ) * r * l ≤ a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l := by
        have hle : (m : ℝ) * r * l ≤ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ m) hr_pos.le) hl_pos.le
        linarith only [hle]
      have hu2 : a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l ≤ 1 := by
        have hmr : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmR
        have h1 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ≤ 1 := by
          calc ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ≤ (R : ℝ) * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmr hr_pos.le
            _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hR_pos.ne'
        have h2 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l ≤ l := by
          calc ((m + 1 : ℕ) * r) * l ≤ 1 * l := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hl_pos.le
            _ = l := one_mul l
        dsimp [a]; linarith only [h2]
      have hmi := hs2_mi_step ε π_strip B_obs (F_at (a + (m : ℝ) * r * l))
        (F_at (a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l)) X_r hε_pos hε_lt_half hπ_s_nn hπ_s_sum
      have hc := h_Fc_ent (a + (m : ℝ) * r * l) (a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l) hu1 hu12 hu2
      dsimp [gB]; linarith only [hmi, hc]
    have h_tel : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range R, ((gB (m + 1) - gB m) + Real.log C_amb / ell) =
        (gB R - gB 0) + (R : ℝ) * (Real.log C_amb / ell) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_range_sub, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range,
        nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hg0_nn : 0 ≤ gB 0 :=
      h_cmi_nn ε π_strip B_obs (F_at (a + (0 : ℕ) * r * l)) X_r
        hε_pos hε_lt_half hπ_s_nn hπ_s_sum
    have hgR_le : gB R ≤ r * l + Real.log C_amb / ell := by
      have h_sub_nn : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π_strip
          (fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at (a + (R : ℝ) * r * l) ω)) X_r :=
        h_ent_nn ε π_strip (fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at (a + (R : ℝ) * r * l) ω)) X_r
          hε_pos hε_lt_half hπ_s_nn
      have h_pow_ge : 1 ≤ (ε ^ (r * l)) ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ₂_pos.le, Real.rpow_one, one_le_inv₀ hρ₂_pos]
        exact hρ₂_lt1.le
      have hN_ge : 1 ≤ C_amb * (ε ^ (r * l)) ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) :=
        one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hC_amb_ge h_pow_ge
      have hH_Xr := hs2_card ε (C_amb * (ε ^ (r * l)) ^ (-(1 : ℝ))) π_strip B_obs X_r
        hε_pos hε_lt_half hN_ge hπ_s_nn hπ_s_sum (fun ω₀ _ => by
          obtain ⟨S_Xr, hSXr_c, hSXr_m⟩ := hS_Xr_cov (r * l) (mul_nonneg hr_pos.le hl_pos.le) ω₀
          exact ⟨S_Xr, hSXr_c, fun ω _ hb => hSXr_m ω hb⟩)
      rw [h_log_eps_pow C_amb (r * l) 1 hC_amb_pos, one_mul] at hH_Xr
      dsimp [gB, finCondMutualInfo]; linarith only [hH_Xr, h_sub_nn]
    have h_errB_ell : ((R : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.log C_amb / ell) ≤ r * l := by
      have hL : ((R : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log C_amb / (r * l) ≤ L_big :=
        le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
          (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))))
      have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hr_pos hl_pos)).mp (le_trans hL hell_gt_L.le)
      rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
      linarith only [h1, mul_comm ell (r * l)]
    have h_le1 := Finset.sum_le_sum h_step
    rw [h_tel] at h_le1
    have heq : (r * l + Real.log C_amb / ell) + (R : ℝ) * (Real.log C_amb / ell) =
        r * l + ((R : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.log C_amb / ell) := by ring
    linarith only [h_le1, hgR_le, hg0_nn, heq, h_errB_ell]

  let miB_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    finCondMutualInfo ε π_strip (fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at (a + (m : ℝ) * r * l) ω))
      X_r (F_at (a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l))
  let Good_R : Finset ℕ :=
    @Finset.filter ℕ (fun m => miB_fn m ≤ θ_R * (r * l))
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (Finset.range R)
  have hGood_R_card : (R : ℝ) - 2 / θ_R ≤ (Good_R.card : ℝ) := by
    let Bad_R := @Finset.filter ℕ (fun m => ¬ (miB_fn m ≤ θ_R * (r * l)))
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (Finset.range R)
    have h_part_card : Good_R.card + Bad_R.card = R := by
      have h1 := @Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not ℕ (Finset.range R)
        (fun m => miB_fn m ≤ θ_R * (r * l))
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _)
      rwa [Finset.card_range] at h1
    have h_bad_sum : (Bad_R.card : ℝ) * (θ_R * (r * l)) ≤ 2 * (r * l) := by
      calc (Bad_R.card : ℝ) * (θ_R * (r * l))
          = ∑ _m ∈ Bad_R, θ_R * (r * l) := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Bad_R, miB_fn m := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm =>
            le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge
              ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mp hm).2))
        _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range R, miB_fn m :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
              (@Finset.filter_subset _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _) (fun m _ _ =>
                h_cmi_nn ε π_strip _ X_r _ hε_pos hε_lt_half hπ_s_nn hπ_s_sum)
        _ ≤ 2 * (r * l) := h_sum_miB
    have h_bad_ub : (Bad_R.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 / θ_R := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hθ_R_pos]
      have h1 : (Bad_R.card : ℝ) * θ_R * (r * l) ≤ 2 * (r * l) := by
        have heq : (Bad_R.card : ℝ) * θ_R * (r * l) = (Bad_R.card : ℝ) * (θ_R * (r * l)) := by ring
        linarith only [h_bad_sum, heq]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h1 (mul_pos hr_pos hl_pos)
    have h_cast : (Good_R.card : ℝ) + (Bad_R.card : ℝ) = (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_part_card
    linarith only [h_cast, h_bad_ub]

  let K_q2 : ℝ := (256 / c_ret2) * ρ₂ ^ (-ζ₂)
  have hK_q2_ge1 : 1 ≤ K_q2 := by
    have h1 : c_ret2 ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [c_ret2]
      have hJ2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (J_bins2 : ℝ) := by dsimp [J_bins2]; exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right 1 _
      have hden : (64 : ℝ) ≤ 16 * (2 + 2) * (J_bins2 : ℝ) := by linarith only [hJ2]
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith only [hΔ_le, hden]
    have h2 : 1 ≤ ρ₂ ^ (-ζ₂) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ₂_pos.le, one_le_inv₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ₂_pos ζ₂)]
      exact Real.rpow_le_one hρ₂_pos.le hρ₂_lt1.le hζ₂_pos.le
    dsimp [K_q2]
    have h3 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 256 / c_ret2 := (le_div_iff₀ hc_ret2_pos).mpr (by linarith only [h1])
    exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le h3 h2

  have h_goodR_step : ∀ m ∈ Good_R,
      (2 * s - Δ_star / 2) * (r * l) ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π_strip (fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at (a + (m : ℝ) * r * l) ω))
          (F_at (a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l)) := by
    intro m hm_good
    have hm_range : m ∈ Finset.range R :=
      ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mp hm_good).1
    have hmi_m : miB_fn m ≤ θ_R * (r * l) :=
      ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mp hm_good).2
    have hm_ltR : m < R := Finset.mem_range.mp hm_range
    let u_m : ℝ := a + (m : ℝ) * r * l
    let u_m1 : ℝ := a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l
    have hu_m1_eq : u_m1 = u_m + r * l := by dsimp [u_m, u_m1]; push_cast; ring
    have ha_le_um : a ≤ u_m := by
      dsimp [u_m]
      have : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) * r * l :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) hr_pos.le) hl_pos.le
      linarith only [this]
    have hum1_le1 : u_m1 ≤ 1 := by
      have hm1R : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm_ltR
      have h1 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ≤ 1 := by
        calc ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ≤ (R : ℝ) * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm1R hr_pos.le
          _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hR_pos.ne'
      have h2 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r * l ≤ l := by
        calc ((m + 1 : ℕ) * r) * l ≤ 1 * l := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hl_pos.le
          _ = l := one_mul l
      dsimp [u_m1, a]; linarith only [h2]
    have hum_le1 : u_m ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hu_m1_eq] at hum1_le1
      have : 0 < r * l := mul_pos hr_pos hl_pos
      linarith only [hum1_le1, this]
    have hum_in_U : u_m ∈ U_fin := by
      let _ : DecidableEq ℝ := Classical.decEq ℝ
      simp only [U_fin, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
      right; exact ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hm_ltR, rfl⟩
    have hum1_in_U : u_m1 ∈ U_fin := by
      let _ : DecidableEq ℝ := Classical.decEq ℝ
      simp only [U_fin, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
      right; exact ⟨m + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hm_ltR, rfl⟩

    let W_m : Fin M_ω → ((ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
      fun ω => (B_obs ω, F_at u_m ω)
    by_contra h_not_ge
    have h_ent_lt : finCondEntropy ε π_strip W_m (F_at u_m1) < (2 * s - Δ_star / 2) * (r * l) :=
      lt_of_not_ge h_not_ge
    have h_ent_nn2 : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π_strip W_m (F_at u_m1) :=
      h_ent_nn ε π_strip W_m (F_at u_m1) hε_pos hε_lt_half hπ_s_nn
    have hp_hi2_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * s - Δ_star / 4 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ 2 * s - Δ_star / 2 := nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left
        (le_trans h_ent_nn2 h_ent_lt.le) (mul_pos hr_pos hl_pos)
      linarith only [h0, hΔ_pos]

    let E_pos_s := @Finset.filter (Fin M_ω) (fun ω => 0 < π_strip ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    have h_mem_pos_s : ∀ ω, ω ∈ E_pos_s ↔ 0 < π_strip ω := fun ω => by
      simp only [E_pos_s, @Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _),
        Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    let Bad_B1 := @Finset.filter (Fin M_ω)
      (fun ω => finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω < ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) E_pos_s
    have h_mem_B1 : ∀ ω, ω ∈ Bad_B1 ↔
        ω ∈ E_pos_s ∧ finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω < ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω :=
      fun ω => @Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _
    let Bad_B2 := @Finset.filter (Fin M_ω)
      (fun ω => finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω < ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) E_pos_s
    have h_mem_B2 : ∀ ω, ω ∈ Bad_B2 ↔
        ω ∈ E_pos_s ∧ finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω < ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω :=
      fun ω => @Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _
    let E_good_OW := (E_pos_s \ Bad_B1) \ Bad_B2

    have hBad_B1_mass : ∑ ω ∈ Bad_B1, π_strip ω ≤ ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ := by
      have h_fib := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := Bad_B1)
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem O₁ hω) π_strip).symm
      rw [h_fib]
      have h_each : ∀ o ∈ Bad_B1.image O₁,
          (∑ ω ∈ Bad_B1.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), π_strip ω) ≤
            ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = o then π₀ ω else 0 := by
        intro o ho
        obtain ⟨ω_o, hω_o_in, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ho
        have hbad := ((h_mem_B1 ω_o).mp hω_o_in).2
        have h_sub : ∑ ω ∈ Bad_B1.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_o), π_strip ω ≤
            finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω_o := by
          rw [h_probAt_eq, ← Finset.sum_filter (p := fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_o)]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun ω hω => ?_) (fun ω _ _ => hπ_s_nn ω)
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2⟩
        rw [← h_probAt_eq π₀ O₁ ω_o]
        exact le_trans h_sub hbad.le
      calc ∑ o ∈ Bad_B1.image O₁, ∑ ω ∈ Bad_B1.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), π_strip ω
          ≤ ∑ o ∈ Bad_B1.image O₁, (ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = o then π₀ ω else 0) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_each
        _ = ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * ∑ o ∈ Bad_B1.image O₁, ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = o then π₀ ω else 0 :=
            (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * 1 := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ₂_pos _).le
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            calc ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, ∑ o ∈ Bad_B1.image O₁, (if O₁ ω = o then π₀ ω else 0)
                ≤ ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π₀ ω := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => by
                  by_cases hmem : O₁ ω ∈ Bad_B1.image O₁
                  · simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hmem]
                  · simp [hmem, hπ₀_nn ω])
              _ = 1 := hπ₀_sum
        _ = ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ := mul_one _

    have hBad_B2_mass : ∑ ω ∈ Bad_B2, π_strip ω ≤ C_amb * ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ := by
      have h_fib1 := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := Bad_B2)
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem O₁ hω) π_strip).symm
      rw [h_fib1]
      have h_each_o : ∀ o ∈ Bad_B2.image O₁,
          (∑ ω ∈ Bad_B2.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), π_strip ω) ≤
            (C_amb * ρ₂ ^ ζ₂) * ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = o then π_strip ω else 0 := by
        intro o ho
        obtain ⟨ω_o, hω_o_in, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ho
        have hω_o_pos : 0 < π_strip ω_o := (h_mem_pos_s ω_o).mp ((h_mem_B2 ω_o).mp hω_o_in).1
        let B2_o := Bad_B2.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_o)
        obtain ⟨S_BF, hS_BF_card, hS_BF_mem⟩ := hS_BF_cov u_m ha_le_um hum_le1 ω_o
        have h_img_sub : B2_o.image W_m ⊆ S_BF := by
          intro wm hwm
          obtain ⟨ω, hω_b2o, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hwm
          obtain ⟨hω_b2, hω_eq_o⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_b2o
          have hω_pos : 0 < π_strip ω := (h_mem_pos_s ω).mp ((h_mem_B2 ω).mp hω_b2).1
          exact hS_BF_mem ω (hπ_s_pos_iff ω hω_pos).2.2 hω_eq_o
        have h_card_wm : ((B2_o.image W_m).card : ℝ) ≤ C_amb :=
          le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card h_img_sub) hS_BF_card
        have h_fib2 := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := B2_o)
          (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem W_m hω) π_strip).symm
        rw [h_fib2]
        have h_each_wm : ∀ wm ∈ B2_o.image W_m,

        have halg : (B_iso + 2) * ε ^ u_m = ε ^ u_m + B_iso * ε ^ u_m + ε ^ u_m := by ring
        linarith only [htri, hm1, hm2, h_le_e, hym_diff, halg]
      have hx_bd : |x_pt2 (F_at u_m1 ω)| ≤ B_iso + 6 := by
        dsimp [x_pt2]; rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_eum_pos]
        calc ε ^ (-u_m) * |x_raw2 (F_at u_m1 ω) - xb2|
            ≤ ε ^ (-u_m) * ((B_iso + 2) * ε ^ u_m) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hraw_diff h_eum_pos.le
          _ = (B_iso + 2) * (ε ^ (-u_m) * ε ^ u_m) := by ring
          _ = B_iso + 2 := by rw [h_eum_m, mul_one]
          _ ≤ B_iso + 6 := by linarith only []
      exact ⟨hc_bd, hx_bd⟩

    have hP2_sep : ∀ p₁ ∈ S_P2, ∀ p₂ ∈ S_P2, p₁ ≠ p₂ →
        ρ₂ / 2 ≤ max |c_pt2 p₁ - c_pt2 p₂| |x_pt2 p₁ - x_pt2 p₂| := by
      intro p₁ _ p₂ _ hne
      have hdy := hs4_dyadic ε u_m1 u_m1 0 u_m1 u_m1 0 hε_pos hε_lt_half hum1_nn le_rfl le_rfl
      by_cases hk12 : p₁.1 ≠ p₂.1
      · refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
        have hint : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(p₁.1 : ℝ) - (p₂.1 : ℝ)| := by
          have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |p₁.1 - p₂.1| := Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.mpr hk12)
          exact_mod_cast this
        have hstep_lb : (1 / 2) * ε ^ u_m1 ≤ step_tm1 := hdy.2.2.1
        have heq : c_pt2 p₁ - c_pt2 p₂ = ε ^ (-u_m) * (((p₁.1 : ℝ) - (p₂.1 : ℝ)) * step_tm1) := by
          dsimp [c_pt2, c_raw2]; ring
        rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_eum_pos, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ step_tm1)]
        calc ρ₂ / 2 = ε ^ (-u_m) * (1 * ((1 / 2) * ε ^ u_m1)) := by rw [← h_eum_m1]; ring
          _ ≤ ε ^ (-u_m) * (|(p₁.1 : ℝ) - (p₂.1 : ℝ)| * step_tm1) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul hint hstep_lb (by positivity) (by positivity))
                h_eum_pos.le
      · push_neg at hk12
        have hx12 : p₁.2 ≠ p₂.2 := fun hx => hne (Prod.ext hk12 hx)
        refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_right _ _)
        have hint : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(p₁.2 : ℝ) - (p₂.2 : ℝ)| := by
          have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |p₁.2 - p₂.2| := Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.mpr hx12)
          exact_mod_cast this
        have hstep_lb : ε ^ u_m1 ≤ dyadicRealStep ε u_m1 := hdy.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
        have hstep_nn : 0 ≤ dyadicRealStep ε u_m1 :=
          le_trans (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos u_m1).le hstep_lb
        have heq : x_pt2 p₁ - x_pt2 p₂ =
            ε ^ (-u_m) * (((p₁.2 : ℝ) - (p₂.2 : ℝ)) * dyadicRealStep ε u_m1) := by
          dsimp [x_pt2, x_raw2]; ring
        rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_eum_pos, abs_of_nonneg hstep_nn]
        calc ρ₂ / 2 ≤ ρ₂ := by linarith only [hρ₂_pos]
          _ = ε ^ (-u_m) * (1 * ε ^ u_m1) := by rw [← h_eum_m1]; ring
          _ ≤ ε ^ (-u_m) * (|(p₁.2 : ℝ) - (p₂.2 : ℝ)| * dyadicRealStep ε u_m1) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul hint hstep_lb
                (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le (by positivity)) h_eum_pos.le

    have hV2_bds : ∀ v ∈ S_V2, |v_bar2 v| ≤ B_iso + 6 := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨ω, hω_in, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
      have hω_ok : O_at k ω = ok_m := h_wm_ok ω hω_in
      let xtan := inner ℝ (V_part (T_idx ω)) e_tan_m
      have hmid : v_bar2 (X_r ω) = dyadicRealMid ε (r * l) xtan := by
        dsimp [v_bar2, dyadicRealMid, X_r, isoTanVelBin, xtan, e_tan_m]
        rw [h_wm_ok_iso ω hω_in]
      have hm := (hs4_dyadic ε (r * l) (r * l) 0 (r * l) (r * l) xtan
        hε_pos hε_lt_half (mul_nonneg hr_pos.le hl_pos.le) le_rfl le_rfl).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
      have hv_tan : |xtan| ≤ B_iso := by
        have hcs := abs_real_inner_le_norm (V_part (T_idx ω)) e_tan_m
        rw [he_tan_norm, mul_one] at hcs
        exact le_trans hcs (hVA_bds (T_idx ω)).1
      rw [hmid]
      have htri : |dyadicRealMid ε (r * l) xtan| ≤ |xtan| + |xtan - dyadicRealMid ε (r * l) xtan| := by
        have h1 := abs_sub_le (dyadicRealMid ε (r * l) xtan) xtan 0
        rw [sub_zero, sub_zero, abs_sub_comm] at h1
        linarith only [h1]
      linarith only [htri, hv_tan, hm, hρ₂_lt1]

    have hq_PV2_eq : ∀ p v,
        q_PV2 p v = ∑ ω ∈ E_wm, if F_at u_m1 ω = p ∧ X_r ω = v then q2 ω else 0 := by
      intro p v; dsimp [q_PV2]
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ E_wm)]
      intro ω _ hnot; simp [hq2_out ω hnot]
    have hq_PV2_sum_V : ∀ p, ∑ v ∈ S_V2, q_PV2 p v =
        ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if F_at u_m1 ω = p then q2 ω else 0 := by
      intro p; simp_rw [hq_PV2_eq p]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h1 : ∑ ω ∈ E_wm, ∑ v ∈ S_V2, (if F_at u_m1 ω = p ∧ X_r ω = v then q2 ω else 0) =
          ∑ ω ∈ E_wm, if F_at u_m1 ω = p then q2 ω else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hv_in : X_r ω ∈ S_V2 := Finset.mem_image_of_mem X_r hω
        by_cases hp_eq : F_at u_m1 ω = p <;> simp [hp_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq, hv_in]
      rw [h1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ E_wm)]
      intro ω _ hnot; simp [hq2_out ω hnot]
    have hq_PV2_sum_P : ∀ v, ∑ p ∈ S_P2, q_PV2 p v =
        ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if X_r ω = v then q2 ω else 0 := by
      intro v; simp_rw [fun p => hq_PV2_eq p v]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h1 : ∑ ω ∈ E_wm, ∑ p ∈ S_P2, (if F_at u_m1 ω = p ∧ X_r ω = v then q2 ω else 0) =
          ∑ ω ∈ E_wm, if X_r ω = v then q2 ω else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hp_in : F_at u_m1 ω ∈ S_P2 := Finset.mem_image_of_mem (F_at u_m1) hω
        by_cases hv_eq : X_r ω = v <;> simp [hv_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq, hp_in]
      rw [h1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ E_wm)]
      intro ω _ hnot; simp [hq2_out ω hnot]
    have hq_PV2_tot : ∑ p ∈ S_P2, ∑ v ∈ S_V2, q_PV2 p v = 1 := by
      simp_rw [hq_PV2_sum_V]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h1 : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, ∑ p ∈ S_P2, (if F_at u_m1 ω = p then q2 ω else 0) =
          ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, q2 ω := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases hω : ω ∈ E_wm
        · have hp_in : F_at u_m1 ω ∈ S_P2 := Finset.mem_image_of_mem (F_at u_m1) hω
          simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hp_in]
        · simp [hq2_out ω hω]
      rw [h1, hq2_sum]

    have h_int_nonconc : ∀ (x₀ : ℝ) (S_int : Finset ℤ), S_int ⊆ S_V2 →
        (∀ v ∈ S_int, |v_bar2 v - x₀| ≤ ρ₂ ^ a₀) →
        (∑ v ∈ S_int, ∑ p ∈ S_P2, q_PV2 p v) ≤ 1 / (4 * K_q2 ^ 2) := by
      intro x₀ S_int hS_sub hS_int
      obtain ⟨S_Vd1, hSVd1_c, hSVd1_m⟩ := hS_Vd_cov d_star (x₀ - ε ^ d_star) ok_m hd_pos hd_lt_l.le
      obtain ⟨S_Vd2, hSVd2_c, hSVd2_m⟩ := hS_Vd_cov d_star (x₀ + ε ^ d_star) ok_m hd_pos hd_lt_l.le
      let S_Vd := S_Vd1 ∪ S_Vd2
      have hS_Vd_card : (S_Vd.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * C_amb := by
        have h1 : S_Vd.card ≤ S_Vd1.card + S_Vd2.card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
        have h2 : (S_Vd.card : ℝ) ≤ (S_Vd1.card : ℝ) + (S_Vd2.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
        linarith only [h2, hSVd1_c, hSVd2_c]
      let E_wm_int := E_wm.filter (fun ω => X_r ω ∈ S_int)
      have h_in_Vd : ∀ ω ∈ E_wm_int, V_d ω ∈ S_Vd := by
        intro ω hω
        obtain ⟨hω_wm, hω_v⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
        have hω_good2 : ω ∈ E_good2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_wm).1
        have hω_ow : ω ∈ E_good_OW := hE_good2_sub hω_good2
        have hω_pos_s : 0 < π_strip ω :=
          (h_mem_pos_s ω).mp (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hω_ow).1).1
        have hω_ok : O_at k ω = ok_m := h_wm_ok ω hω_wm
        have h_strip_ω : |inner ℝ (V_part (T_idx ω)) (n_dir ok_m) - w_off ok_m| ≤ 4 * ε ^ l := by
          have := (hπ_s_pos_iff ω hω_pos_s).2.2
          rwa [hω_ok] at this
        let xtan := inner ℝ (V_part (T_idx ω)) e_tan_m
        have hmid : v_bar2 (X_r ω) = dyadicRealMid ε (r * l) xtan := by
          dsimp [v_bar2, dyadicRealMid, X_r, isoTanVelBin, xtan, e_tan_m]
          rw [h_wm_ok_iso ω hω_wm]
        have hm := (hs4_dyadic ε (r * l) (r * l) 0 (r * l) (r * l) xtan
          hε_pos hε_lt_half (mul_nonneg hr_pos.le hl_pos.le) le_rfl le_rfl).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
        have hv_int := hS_int (X_r ω) hω_v
        rw [hρ₂_a0, hmid] at hv_int
        have hρ_le_d : ρ₂ ≤ ε ^ d_star := by
          rw [← hρ₂_a0]
          simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ₂_pos hρ₂_lt1.le ha₀_lt1.le
        have h_xtan_x0 : |xtan - x₀| ≤ 2 * ε ^ d_star := by
          have htri : |xtan - x₀| ≤
              |xtan - dyadicRealMid ε (r * l) xtan| + |dyadicRealMid ε (r * l) xtan - x₀| :=
            abs_sub_le _ _ _
          linarith only [htri, hm, hv_int, hρ_le_d]
        by_cases hsign : xtan ≤ x₀
        · refine Finset.mem_union_left _ (hSVd1_m ω hω_ok h_strip_ω ?_)
          change |xtan - (x₀ - ε ^ d_star)| ≤ ε ^ d_star
          rw [abs_le]
          have := abs_le.mp h_xtan_x0
          exact ⟨by linarith only [this.1], by linarith only [hsign]⟩
        · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ (hSVd2_m ω hω_ok h_strip_ω ?_)
          change |xtan - (x₀ + ε ^ d_star)| ≤ ε ^ d_star
          rw [abs_le]
          have := abs_le.mp h_xtan_x0
          exact ⟨by linarith only [hsign], by linarith only [this.2]⟩

      let E_ow_wm := E_good_OW.filter (fun ω => W_m ω = wm)
      let E_exp_v : ℝ := α * a₀ - η₀ / (r * l) - κ₂ - 2 * ζ₂
      have h_vd_cell : ∀ vd ∈ S_Vd,
          (∑ ω ∈ E_ow_wm.filter (fun ω => V_d ω = vd), π_strip ω) ≤
            (K_max * ρ₂ ^ E_exp_v) * ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if W_m ω = wm then π_strip ω else 0 := by
        intro vd _
        let F_vd := E_ow_wm.filter (fun ω => V_d ω = vd)
        have h_fib_o := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := F_vd)
          (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem O₁ hω) π_strip).symm
        rw [h_fib_o]
        have h_each_o : ∀ o ∈ F_vd.image O₁,
            (∑ ω ∈ F_vd.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), π_strip ω) ≤
              (K_max * ρ₂ ^ E_exp_v) *
                ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = o ∧ W_m ω = wm then π_strip ω else 0 := by
          intro o ho
          obtain ⟨ω_v, hω_v_in, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ho
          obtain ⟨hω_v_owm, hω_v_vd⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_v_in
          obtain ⟨hω_v_ow, hω_v_wm⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_v_owm
          obtain ⟨hω_v_1, hnot_b2⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hω_v_ow
          obtain ⟨hω_v_pos, hnot_b1⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hω_v_1
          have hpos_s : 0 < π_strip ω_v := (h_mem_pos_s ω_v).mp hω_v_pos
          have hpos_0 : 0 < π₀ ω_v := (hπ_s_pos_iff ω_v hpos_s).2.1
          have hb1_ge : ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω_v ≤ finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω_v :=
            le_of_not_gt (fun hlt => hnot_b1 ((h_mem_B1 ω_v).mpr ⟨hω_v_pos, hlt⟩))
          have hb2_ge : ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ * finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω_v ≤ finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v :=
            le_of_not_gt (fun hlt => hnot_b2 ((h_mem_B2 ω_v).mpr ⟨hω_v_pos, hlt⟩))
          have h_vel := h_vel_pt ω_v hpos_0
          have h_π0_o_pos : 0 < finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω_v := by
            rw [h_probAt_eq]
            have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun ω' : Fin M_ω => if O₁ ω' = O₁ ω_v then π₀ ω' else 0)
              (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ₀_nn ω']) (Finset.mem_univ ω_v)
            simp only [↓reduceIte] at hle
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos_0 hle
          have h_π0_ov : finProbAt2 π₀ O₁ V_d ω_v ≤
              (K_max * ε ^ (α * d_star - η₀)) * finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω_v := by
            have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ h_π0_o_pos).mp h_vel
            exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK₀_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le) h_π0_o_pos.le)
          have h_sub_s : ∑ ω ∈ F_vd.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_v), π_strip ω ≤
              m_strip⁻¹ * finProbAt2 π₀ O₁ V_d ω_v := by
            calc ∑ ω ∈ F_vd.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_v), π_strip ω
                ≤ ∑ ω ∈ F_vd.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_v), m_strip⁻¹ * π₀ ω :=
                  Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => hπ_s_le_π0 ω)
              _ = m_strip⁻¹ * ∑ ω ∈ F_vd.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_v), π₀ ω :=
                  (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
              _ ≤ m_strip⁻¹ * finProbAt2 π₀ O₁ V_d ω_v := by
                  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (inv_nonneg.mpr hm_strip_pos.le)
                  rw [h_probAt2_eq, ← Finset.sum_filter]
                  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun ω hω => ?_) (fun ω _ _ => hπ₀_nn ω)
                  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
                  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h2,
                    (Finset.mem_filter.mp h1).2.trans hω_v_vd.symm⟩
          have h_o_to_ow : finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω_v ≤
              ρ₂ ^ (-(2 * ζ₂)) * finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v := by
            have h_pos_r : 0 < ρ₂ ^ ζ₂ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ₂_pos ζ₂
            have h1 : finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω_v ≤ (ρ₂ ^ ζ₂)⁻¹ * finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω_v := by
              have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1_ge (inv_nonneg.mpr h_pos_r.le)
              rwa [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ h_pos_r.ne'] at this
            have h2 : finProbAt π_strip O₁ ω_v ≤ (ρ₂ ^ ζ₂)⁻¹ * finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v := by
              have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2_ge (inv_nonneg.mpr h_pos_r.le)
              rwa [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ h_pos_r.ne'] at this
            calc finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω_v
                ≤ (ρ₂ ^ ζ₂)⁻¹ * ((ρ₂ ^ ζ₂)⁻¹ * finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v) :=
                  le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (inv_nonneg.mpr h_pos_r.le))
              _ = ((ρ₂ ^ ζ₂)⁻¹ * (ρ₂ ^ ζ₂)⁻¹) * finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v := by ring
              _ = ρ₂ ^ (-(2 * ζ₂)) * finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v := by
                  congr 1
                  rw [← Real.rpow_neg hρ₂_pos.le, ← Real.rpow_add hρ₂_pos]
                  congr 1; ring
          have h_eps_ρ₂ : ε ^ (α * d_star - η₀) = ρ₂ ^ (α * a₀ - η₀ / (r * l)) := by
            dsimp [ρ₂, d_star]
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
            congr 1; field_simp [hr_pos.ne', hl_pos.ne']
          have h_ow_eq : finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v =
              ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = O₁ ω_v ∧ W_m ω = wm then π_strip ω else 0 := by
            rw [h_probAt2_eq]; simp_rw [hω_v_wm]
          calc ∑ ω ∈ F_vd.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_v), π_strip ω
              ≤ m_strip⁻¹ * ((K_max * ε ^ (α * d_star - η₀)) * finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω_v) :=
                le_trans h_sub_s (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_π0_ov (inv_nonneg.mpr hm_strip_pos.le))
            _ ≤ ρ₂ ^ (-κ₂) * ((K_max * ρ₂ ^ (α * a₀ - η₀ / (r * l))) *
                  (ρ₂ ^ (-(2 * ζ₂)) * finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v)) := by
                rw [h_eps_ρ₂]
                refine mul_le_mul hm_strip_inv_ub ?_ (by positivity) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ₂_pos _).le
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_o_to_ow (by positivity)
            _ = (K_max * (ρ₂ ^ (-κ₂) * (ρ₂ ^ (α * a₀ - η₀ / (r * l)) * ρ₂ ^ (-(2 * ζ₂))))) *
                  finProbAt2 π_strip O₁ W_m ω_v := by ring
            _ = (K_max * ρ₂ ^ E_exp_v) *
                  ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = O₁ ω_v ∧ W_m ω = wm then π_strip ω else 0 := by
                rw [← h_ow_eq, ← Real.rpow_add hρ₂_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hρ₂_pos]
                congr 2; dsimp [E_exp_v]; ring
        calc ∑ o ∈ F_vd.image O₁, ∑ ω ∈ F_vd.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), π_strip ω
            ≤ ∑ o ∈ F_vd.image O₁,
                ((K_max * ρ₂ ^ E_exp_v) *
                  ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = o ∧ W_m ω = wm then π_strip ω else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_o
          _ = (K_max * ρ₂ ^ E_exp_v) *
                ∑ o ∈ F_vd.image O₁,
                  ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω = o ∧ W_m ω = wm then π_strip ω else 0 :=
              (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
          _ ≤ (K_max * ρ₂ ^ E_exp_v) * ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if W_m ω = wm then π_strip ω else 0 := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
              rw [Finset.sum_comm]
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
              by_cases hwm_eq : W_m ω = wm
              · by_cases ho_mem : O₁ ω ∈ F_vd.image O₁
                · simp [hwm_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq, ho_mem]
                · simp [hwm_eq, ho_mem, hπ_s_nn ω]
              · simp [hwm_eq]

      have h_q_int_eq : ∑ v ∈ S_int, ∑ p ∈ S_P2, q_PV2 p v = ∑ ω ∈ E_wm_int, q2 ω := by
        simp_rw [hq_PV2_sum_P]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_filter]
        rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ E_wm)]
        · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          by_cases hv : X_r ω ∈ S_int
          · simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hv]
          · simp [hv]
        · intro ω _ hnot; simp [hq2_out ω hnot]
      have h_sum_wm_int : ∑ ω ∈ E_wm_int, π_strip ω ≤

    linarith only [hH_O1_s_ub, hH_k1_T_lb, hτ_s_ub, h_e1_Δ, hη₀_Δl, h_log81K_ell,
      h_logK_le_81, h_dl_pos]

  have hQ_B_ub : Q_B ≤ β - β * l + Δ_star * l := by
    have h1 : Q_B ≤ (β + δ_cl) * a := by dsimp [Q_B]; linarith only [hQ_B_univ]
    have h2 : δ_cl * a ≤ δ_cl := by
      calc δ_cl * a ≤ δ_cl * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha_lt1.le hδ_cl_pos.le
        _ = δ_cl := mul_one _
    have h3 : (β + δ_cl) * a = β - β * l + δ_cl * a := by dsimp [a]; ring
    have h4 : δ_cl ≤ Δ_star * l := by dsimp [δ_cl]; linarith only [h_dl_pos]
    linarith only [h1, h2, h3, h4]

  have h_diff_id : Q_B - Q_O1 = (1 - γ) * l + finCondEntropy ε π_strip B_obs O₁ -
      finCondEntropy ε π_strip O₁ B_obs -
      3 * (finCondEntropy ε π_strip T_idx k₁_fn - finCondEntropy ε π_strip T_idx ka_fn) := by
    have hcomm := h_ent_comm ε π_strip (fun _ => ()) B_obs O₁ hε_pos hε_lt_half hπ_s_nn hπ_s_sum
    rw [h_unit_ent, h_unit_ent] at hcomm
    dsimp [Q_B, Q_O1]
    unfold finMutualInfo
    rw [hH_O1_T, hH_B_T]
    linarith only [hcomm]

  have h_time_diff : 3 * (finCondEntropy ε π_strip T_idx k₁_fn -
      finCondEntropy ε π_strip T_idx ka_fn) ≤ (3 * s + Δ_star / 2) * l := by
    have h_sa : s - s * a = s * l := by dsimp [a]; ring
    have h_rhs : (3 * s + Δ_star / 2) * l = 3 * (s * l) + (1 / 2) * (Δ_star * l) := by ring
    linarith only [hH_k1_T_ub, hH_ka_T_lb, h_sa, h_rhs, h_e1_Δ, hη₀_Δl, h_log81K_ell,
      h_logK_le_81, h_dl_pos]

  have h_diff_lb : (1 - γ - s - 2 * Δ_star) * l ≤ Q_B - Q_O1 := by
    rw [h_diff_id]
    have halg : (1 - γ) * l + (2 * s - (3 / 4) * Δ_star) * l - (Δ_star / 8) * l -
        (3 * s + Δ_star / 2) * l = (1 - γ - s - (11 / 8) * Δ_star) * l := by ring
    have h_dl : 0 < Δ_star * l := mul_pos hΔ_pos hl_pos
    have h_step : (1 - γ - s - 2 * Δ_star) * l ≤ (1 - γ - s - (11 / 8) * Δ_star) * l := by
      have : (1 - γ - s - (11 / 8) * Δ_star) * l - (1 - γ - s - 2 * Δ_star) * l =
          (5 / 8) * (Δ_star * l) := by ring
      linarith only [this, h_dl]
    linarith only [hH_O1_given_B, hH_B_given_O1, h_time_diff, halg, h_step]

  have h_diff_ub : Q_B - Q_O1 ≤ (-β + 2 * Δ_star) * l := by
    have halg : (β - β * l + Δ_star * l) - (β - Δ_star * l) = (-β + 2 * Δ_star) * l := by ring
    linarith only [hQ_B_ub, hQ_O1_lb, halg]

  have h_final_l : (1 - γ - s - 2 * Δ_star) * l ≤ (-β + 2 * Δ_star) * l :=
    le_trans h_diff_lb h_diff_ub
  have h_final : 1 - γ - s - 2 * Δ_star ≤ -β + 2 * Δ_star :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_final_l hl_pos
  have h_Δ_def : β - γ = 10 * Δ_star := by dsimp [Δ_star]; ring
  linarith only [h_final, h_Δ_def, hΔ_pos, hs₁]

isotropic_extremizer_exclusion.definitions:
noncomputable def negPerp2D (n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then n 1 else -(n 0))

noncomputable def isoAnchoredObs {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (ε u : ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_val : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (ω : Fin N_ω) : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let tid := T_idx ω
  let x_pos := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε u (c_val ω)) • V_part tid
  (dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_val ω),
    dyadicRealBin ε u (x_pos 0),
    dyadicRealBin ε u (x_pos 1))

noncomputable def isoVelObs {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (ε d : ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ω : Fin N_ω) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  let v := V_part (T_idx ω)
  (dyadicRealBin ε d (v 0), dyadicRealBin ε d (v 1))

noncomputable def isoStripEarlierObs {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (ε k a : ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_val : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (n_dir : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ω : Fin N_ω) : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × ℤ :=
  let ok := isoAnchoredObs ε k T_idx V_part A_part c_val ω
  let oa := isoAnchoredObs ε a T_idx V_part A_part c_val ω
  let tid := T_idx ω
  let x_a := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε a (c_val ω)) • V_part tid
  (ok, oa, dyadicRealBin ε 1 (inner ℝ x_a (n_dir ok)))

noncomputable def isoLastBlockObs {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (ε k u_glob : ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_val : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (n_dir : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ω : Fin N_ω) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  let ok := isoAnchoredObs ε k T_idx V_part A_part c_val ω
  let e_tan := negPerp2D (n_dir ok)
  let tid := T_idx ω
  let x_u := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε u_glob (c_val ω)) • V_part tid
  (dyadicTimeBin ε u_glob (c_val ω), dyadicRealBin ε u_glob (inner ℝ x_u e_tan))

noncomputable def isoTanVelBin {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (ε k d_vel : ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_val : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (n_dir : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ω : Fin N_ω) : ℤ :=
  let ok := isoAnchoredObs ε k T_idx V_part A_part c_val ω
  dyadicRealBin ε d_vel (inner ℝ (V_part (T_idx ω)) (negPerp2D (n_dir ok)))

noncomputable def finCondMutualInfo {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (W : Fin N_ω → α) (U : Fin N_ω → β) (V : Fin N_ω → γ_t) : ℝ :=
  finCondEntropy ε π W V - finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, U ω)) V

subgoal_signatures.name: isotropic_grid_incidence_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(B_dom : ℝ) (hB : 1 ≤ B_dom) :
    ∃ (C_LW C_inv : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_LW ∧ 1 ≤ C_inv ∧
      (∀ {α_P : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] (S_P E_v : Finset α_P)
         (c_pt : α_P → ℝ) (x_pt : α_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (v_bar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ρ R₀ m_ch : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → 0 ≤ R₀ → 0 < m_ch → E_v ⊆ S_P →
        (∀ p ∈ E_v, ∃ F_p : Finset α_P, F_p ⊆ S_P ∧ m_ch ≤ (F_p.card : ℝ) ∧
          ∀ p' ∈ F_p,
            |(x_pt p' 0 - c_pt p' * v_bar 0) - (x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar 0)| ≤ R₀ * ρ ∧
            |(x_pt p' 1 - c_pt p' * v_bar 1) - (x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar 1)| ≤ R₀ * ρ) →
        ((E_v.image (fun p =>
          (⌊(x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar 0) / ρ⌋,
           ⌊(x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar 1) / ρ⌋))).card : ℝ) ≤
          (((2 * ⌈R₀⌉₊ + 3) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (S_P.card : ℝ) / m_ch) ∧
      (∀ {α_P α_V : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
         (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_V : Finset α_V)
         (c_pt : α_P → ℝ) (x_pt : α_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (v_bar : α_V → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (q : α_P → α_V → ℝ) (ρ ϑ K M_P N_int : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 < ϑ → ϑ < 1 → 1 ≤ K → 0 < M_P → 0 ≤ N_int →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, |c_pt p| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p 0| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p 1| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p₁ ∈ S_P, ∀ p₂ ∈ S_P, p₁ ≠ p₂ →
          ρ / 2 ≤ max |c_pt p₁ - c_pt p₂|
            (max |x_pt p₁ 0 - x_pt p₂ 0| |x_pt p₁ 1 - x_pt p₂ 1|)) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, |v_bar v 0| ≤ B_dom ∧ |v_bar v 1| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V, 0 ≤ q p v) →
        (∑ p ∈ S_P, ∑ v ∈ S_V, q p v = 1) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V,
          q p v ≤ K * (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') * (∑ p' ∈ S_P, q p' v)) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') ≤ M_P⁻¹) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, ∃ I_v : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), (I_v.card : ℝ) ≤ N_int ∧
          ∀ p ∈ S_P, 0 < q p v →
            (⌊(x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar v 0) / ρ⌋,
             ⌊(x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar v 1) / ρ⌋) ∈ I_v) →
        (∃ (n_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (w_off : ℝ) (S_strip : Finset α_V),
          ‖n_vec‖ = 1 ∧ S_strip ⊆ S_V ∧
          (∀ v ∈ S_strip, |inner ℝ (v_bar v) n_vec - w_off| ≤ 2 * ρ ^ ϑ) ∧
          1 / (8 * K ^ 3) ≤ ∑ v ∈ S_strip, ∑ p ∈ S_P, q p v) ∨
        (M_P / (2 * K ^ 3)) ^ 2 ≤ C_LW * ρ ^ (-(12 * ϑ)) * N_int ^ 3) ∧
      (∀ {α_P α_V : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
         (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_V : Finset α_V)
         (c_pt x_pt : α_P → ℝ) (v_bar : α_V → ℝ)
         (q : α_P → α_V → ℝ) (ρ a₀ K M_P N_int : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 < a₀ → a₀ < 1 → 1 ≤ K → 0 < M_P → 0 ≤ N_int →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, |c_pt p| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p₁ ∈ S_P, ∀ p₂ ∈ S_P, p₁ ≠ p₂ →
          ρ / 2 ≤ max |c_pt p₁ - c_pt p₂| |x_pt p₁ - x_pt p₂|) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, |v_bar v| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V, 0 ≤ q p v) →
        (∑ p ∈ S_P, ∑ v ∈ S_V, q p v = 1) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V,
          q p v ≤ K * (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') * (∑ p' ∈ S_P, q p' v)) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') ≤ M_P⁻¹) →
        (∀ (x₀ : ℝ) (S_int : Finset α_V), S_int ⊆ S_V →
          (∀ v ∈ S_int, |v_bar v - x₀| ≤ ρ ^ a₀) →
          (∑ v ∈ S_int, ∑ p ∈ S_P, q p v) ≤ 1 / (4 * K ^ 2)) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, ∃ I_v : Finset ℤ, (I_v.card : ℝ) ≤ N_int ∧
          ∀ p ∈ S_P, 0 < q p v → ⌊(x_pt p - c_pt p * v_bar v) / ρ⌋ ∈ I_v) →
        M_P / (2 * K ^ 2) ≤ C_inv * ρ ^ (-(2 * a₀)) * N_int ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: finite_entropy_and_core_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (W : Fin N_ω → α) (X : Fin N_ω → β) (Y : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π W X ∧
      0 ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W X ∧
      0 ≤ finCondMutualInfo ε π W X Y ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π W X + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π W Y - finCondEntropy ε π W X ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, Y ω)) X ∧
      finMutualInfo ε π W Y - finMutualInfo ε π W X ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t δ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (W : Fin N_ω → α) (X : Fin N_ω → β) (Y : Fin N_ω → γ_t) (U : Fin N_ω → δ_t),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      finCondMutualInfo ε π (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) U Y ≤
        finCondMutualInfo ε π W Y U - finCondMutualInfo ε π W X U +
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, Y ω)) X) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ → X ω₁ = X ω₂ → (Y ω₁ = Y ω₂ ↔ Z ω₁ = Z ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y = finCondEntropy ε π X Z) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (ε N_max : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ N_max →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < π ω₀ → ∃ S_Y : Finset β, (S_Y.card : ℝ) ≤ N_max ∧
        ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → X ω = X ω₀ → Y ω ∈ S_Y) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y ≤ Real.log N_max / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε d_min K : ℝ) (π Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ K →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, Q ω ≤ K * π ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → d_min ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω) →
      d_min - Real.log K / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ finCondEntropy ε Q X Y) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_W α_Par α_P α_V : Type}
       [DecidableEq α_W] [DecidableEq α_Par] [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
       (ε K_amb u_blk ζ δ_gap D_cap C_ch p_hi ζ_MI : ℝ)
       (π π_amb : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (W : Fin N_ω → α_W) (Par : Fin N_ω → α_Par)
       (P : Fin N_ω → α_P) (V_obs : Fin N_ω → α_V)
       (E_allow : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ K_amb →
      0 < u_blk → 0 < ζ → 0 < δ_gap → 0 < D_cap → 1 ≤ C_ch →
      0 ≤ p_hi → p_hi ≤ D_cap → 0 ≤ ζ_MI →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_amb ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_amb ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, π ω ≤ K_amb * π_amb ω) →
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, Par ω₁ = Par ω₂ → W ω₁ = W ω₂) →
      1 - δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_allow, π ω →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < π ω₀ → ∃ S_ch : Finset α_P,
        (S_ch.card : ℝ) ≤ C_ch * (ε ^ u_blk) ^ (-D_cap) ∧
        ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → W ω = W ω₀ → P ω ∈ S_ch) →
      finCondEntropy ε π W P ≤ (p_hi - δ_gap) * u_blk →
      finCondMutualInfo ε π W V_obs P ≤ ζ_MI * u_blk →
      ζ_MI / ζ + 1 / (ζ * u_blk * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ≤ δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) →
      C_ch * ε ^ u_blk ≤ δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) →
      let ρ := ε ^ u_blk
      let J_bins : ℕ := 1 + ⌈(D_cap + 2) / ζ⌉₊
      let c_ret : ℝ := δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2) * (J_bins : ℝ))
      ∃ (p_star : ℝ) (E_good : Finset (Fin N_ω)) (G_W : Finset α_W),
        0 ≤ p_star ∧ p_star ≤ p_hi - δ_gap / 2 ∧
        E_good ⊆ E_allow ∧
        (∀ ω ∈ E_good, 0 < π ω) ∧
        c_ret / 2 ≤ ∑ w ∈ G_W, ∑ ω ∈ E_good, (if W ω = w then π ω else 0) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ G_W,
          let E_w := E_good.filter (fun ω => W ω = w)
          let m_w := ∑ ω ∈ E_w, π ω
          0 < m_w ∧
          (c_ret / 4) * (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if W ω = w then π ω else 0) ≤ m_w ∧
          ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) ≤ ρ ^ (-(p_star + ζ)) ∧
          ∃ q : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
            (∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, q ω = 1) ∧
            (∀ ω, ω ∉ E_w → q ω = 0) ∧

    (U_fin : Finset ℝ) (hU_sub : ∀ u ∈ U_fin, u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (d_vel η₀ : ℝ) (hd₀ : 0 < d_vel) (hd₁ : d_vel < 1) (hη₀ : 0 < η₀) :

           0 ≤ h_cap + η₀ ∧

            (∀ ω₀ : Fin M_ω,
              (∃ S_F0 : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), (S_F0.card : ℝ) ≤ C_amb ∧

              (∃ S_F1 : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), (S_F1.card : ℝ) ≤ C_amb ∧

                  isoLastBlockObs ε k u₁ T_idx V_part A_part c_val n_dir ω =
                    isoLastBlockObs ε k u₁ T_idx V_part A_part c_val n_dir ω₀ →

subgoal_signatures.name: isotropic_grid_incidence_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(B_dom : ℝ) (hB : 1 ≤ B_dom) :
    ∃ (C_LW C_inv : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_LW ∧ 1 ≤ C_inv ∧
      (∀ {α_P : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] (S_P E_v : Finset α_P)
         (c_pt : α_P → ℝ) (x_pt : α_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (v_bar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ρ R₀ m_ch : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → 0 ≤ R₀ → 0 < m_ch → E_v ⊆ S_P →
        (∀ p ∈ E_v, ∃ F_p : Finset α_P, F_p ⊆ S_P ∧ m_ch ≤ (F_p.card : ℝ) ∧
          ∀ p' ∈ F_p,
            |(x_pt p' 0 - c_pt p' * v_bar 0) - (x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar 0)| ≤ R₀ * ρ ∧
            |(x_pt p' 1 - c_pt p' * v_bar 1) - (x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar 1)| ≤ R₀ * ρ) →
        ((E_v.image (fun p =>
          (⌊(x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar 0) / ρ⌋,
           ⌊(x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar 1) / ρ⌋))).card : ℝ) ≤
          (((2 * ⌈R₀⌉₊ + 3) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (S_P.card : ℝ) / m_ch) ∧
      (∀ {α_P α_V : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
         (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_V : Finset α_V)
         (c_pt : α_P → ℝ) (x_pt : α_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (v_bar : α_V → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (q : α_P → α_V → ℝ) (ρ ϑ K M_P N_int : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 < ϑ → ϑ < 1 → 1 ≤ K → 0 < M_P → 0 ≤ N_int →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, |c_pt p| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p 0| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p 1| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p₁ ∈ S_P, ∀ p₂ ∈ S_P, p₁ ≠ p₂ →
          ρ / 2 ≤ max |c_pt p₁ - c_pt p₂|
            (max |x_pt p₁ 0 - x_pt p₂ 0| |x_pt p₁ 1 - x_pt p₂ 1|)) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, |v_bar v 0| ≤ B_dom ∧ |v_bar v 1| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V, 0 ≤ q p v) →
        (∑ p ∈ S_P, ∑ v ∈ S_V, q p v = 1) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V,
          q p v ≤ K * (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') * (∑ p' ∈ S_P, q p' v)) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') ≤ M_P⁻¹) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, ∃ I_v : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), (I_v.card : ℝ) ≤ N_int ∧
          ∀ p ∈ S_P, 0 < q p v →
            (⌊(x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar v 0) / ρ⌋,
             ⌊(x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar v 1) / ρ⌋) ∈ I_v) →

          (∀ v ∈ S_strip, |inner ℝ (v_bar v) n_vec - w_off| ≤ 2 * ρ ^ ϑ) ∧
          1 / (8 * K ^ 3) ≤ ∑ v ∈ S_strip, ∑ p ∈ S_P, q p v) ∨
        (M_P / (2 * K ^ 3)) ^ 2 ≤ C_LW * ρ ^ (-(12 * ϑ)) * N_int ^ 3) ∧
      (∀ {α_P α_V : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
         (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_V : Finset α_V)
         (c_pt x_pt : α_P → ℝ) (v_bar : α_V → ℝ)
         (q : α_P → α_V → ℝ) (ρ a₀ K M_P N_int : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 < a₀ → a₀ < 1 → 1 ≤ K → 0 < M_P → 0 ≤ N_int →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, |c_pt p| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p₁ ∈ S_P, ∀ p₂ ∈ S_P, p₁ ≠ p₂ →
          ρ / 2 ≤ max |c_pt p₁ - c_pt p₂| |x_pt p₁ - x_pt p₂|) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, |v_bar v| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V, 0 ≤ q p v) →
        (∑ p ∈ S_P, ∑ v ∈ S_V, q p v = 1) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V,
          q p v ≤ K * (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') * (∑ p' ∈ S_P, q p' v)) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') ≤ M_P⁻¹) →
        (∀ (x₀ : ℝ) (S_int : Finset α_V), S_int ⊆ S_V →

      1 - δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_allow, π ω →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < π ω₀ → ∃ S_ch : Finset α_P,
        (S_ch.card : ℝ) ≤ C_ch * (ε ^ u_blk) ^ (-D_cap) ∧

subgoal_signatures.statement:

            P_rates s r_p0 ∧ γ ≤ r_p0 j₀ ∧ r_p0 j_top = z_plus ∧
            (2 * p - m + ∑ j, (c j - p) * r_p0 j) + D_plus = 2 * s - β - γ * m) ∧
          (0 < p ∧ p < 1 + m → (1 + m - p) * (z_plus - z_minus) ≤ D_minus - D_plus))

signature.name: characteristic_plane_trace_and_contact
signature.statement:
(n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j₀ j_top : Fin n)
    (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hc_inj : Function.Injective c)
    (hc_zero : c j₀ = 0)
    (hc_min : ∀ j : Fin n, c j₀ ≤ c j)
    (hc_top : ∀ j : Fin n, j ≠ j_top → c j < c j_top)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ d j_top ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ d_v)
    (hE_pos : ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → 0 < c k - c j)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : IsSubmodularConeProfile n c d d_v E_cone f) :
    ∃ (a : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (h_seq : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ j, Measurable (a j) ∧ ∀ iu, 0 ≤ a j iu ∧ a j iu ≤ d j) ∧
      (Measurable D ∧ ∀ iu, 0 ≤ D iu ∧ D iu ≤ d_v) ∧
      (∀ l, 0 < h_seq l) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      (∀ᵐ iu : ℝ × ℝ, iu.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        ∀ (R ε_err : ℝ), 1 ≤ R → 0 < ε_err →
          ∀ᶠ l in Filter.atTop, ∀ ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
            InDispCone n c E_cone ξ → (∀ j, |ξ.1 j| ≤ R) → |ξ.2| ≤ R →
            |(f (planeEmbed n c iu + h_seq l • ξ) - f (planeEmbed n c iu)) / h_seq l -
              ((∑ j : Fin n, a j iu * ξ.1 j) + D iu * ξ.2)| ≤ ε_err) ∧
      (∀ (γ m β τ : ℝ) (b S : ℝ → ℝ) (g_x : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
         (P_rates : ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Prop),
        0 < γ → 0 < m → c j_top = 1 + m →
        (∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ → 0 ≤ b u₁ - b u₂ ∧ b u₁ - b u₂ ≤ (1 + m) * (u₂ - u₁)) →
        (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ b u ∧ b u + (1 + m) * u ≤ 1 + m) →
        (∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ → 0 ≤ S u₂ - S u₁ ∧ S u₂ - S u₁ ≤ u₂ - u₁) →
        (∀ (i u : ℝ), u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ i → i + (1 + m) * u ≤ 1 + m →
          2 * i + (1 - γ) * m * u + 2 * S u - β * u - τ ≤ f (planeEmbed n c (i, u))) →
        (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          f (planeEmbed n c (b u, u)) = 2 * (b u) + (1 - γ) * m * u + 2 * S u - β * u - τ) →
        (∀ u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          g_x u₀ 0 = 0 ∧
          (∀ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, d₁ ≤ d₂ → 0 ≤ g_x u₀ d₂ - g_x u₀ d₁ ∧ g_x u₀ d₂ - g_x u₀ d₁ ≤ d₂ - d₁) ∧
          (∀ d_r : ℝ, 0 ≤ d_r → d_r ≤ m * u₀ → γ * d_r ≤ g_x u₀ d_r) ∧
          (∀ (lam_s h i t : ℝ),
            0 < lam_s → lam_s < min 1 m → 0 < h → h < u₀ →
            b u₀ ≤ i → i ≤ b u₀ + lam_s * h → 0 < t → i + t < b u₀ + m * u₀ →
            let p₀ := planeEmbed n c (i, u₀ - h)
            let p_t := (Function.update p₀.1 j₀ (p₀.1 j₀ + t), p₀.2)
            g_x u₀ (i - b u₀ + t) - g_x u₀ (i - b u₀) ≤ f p_t - f p₀)) →
        IsClosed { sr : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) | P_rates sr.1 sr.2 } →
        (∀ᵐ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < iu.1 ∧ iu.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
          ∃ s_u : ℝ, HasDerivAt S s_u iu.2 ∧ 0 < s_u ∧ s_u ≤ 1 ∧ P_rates s_u (fun j => a j iu)) →
        ∃ (p s z_minus z_plus D_minus D_plus : ℝ),
          0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 1 + m ∧ 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧
          0 ≤ z_minus ∧ z_minus ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ z_plus ∧ z_plus ≤ 1 ∧
          0 ≤ D_minus ∧ 0 ≤ D_plus ∧
          (0 < p → ∃ r_m : Fin n → ℝ,
            P_rates s r_m ∧ (∑ j, r_m j) - 2 ≤ 0 ∧ γ ≤ r_m j₀ ∧
            (p < 1 + m → r_m j_top = z_minus) ∧
            (2 * p - m + ∑ j, (c j - p) * r_m j) + D_minus = 2 * s - β - γ * m) ∧
          (p < 1 + m → ∃ r_p : Fin n → ℝ,
            P_rates s r_p ∧ 0 ≤ (∑ j, r_p j) - 2 ∧ r_p j_top = z_plus ∧
            (2 * p - m + ∑ j, (c j - p) * r_p j) + D_plus = 2 * s - β - γ * m) ∧
          (p = 0 → ∃ r_p0 : Fin n → ℝ,
            P_rates s r_p0 ∧ γ ≤ r_p0 j₀ ∧ r_p0 j_top = z_plus ∧
            (2 * p - m + ∑ j, (c j - p) * r_p0 j) + D_plus = 2 * s - β - γ * m) ∧
          (0 < p ∧ p < 1 + m → (1 + m - p) * (z_plus - z_minus) ≤ D_minus - D_plus))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hd_pair : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v := ⟨hd_nn.1, hd_nn.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨a, D, h_tr⟩ :=
    submodular_plane_strong_traces n hn j_top c d d_v E_cone hc_inj hc_top hd_pair hE_pos f hf
  obtain ⟨h_seq, hh_pos, hh_lim, h_blow⟩ :=
    cone_uniform_affine_blowup n hn j_top c d d_v E_cone hc_inj hd_pair hE_pos f hf a D h_tr
  refine ⟨a, D, h_seq, h_tr.1, h_tr.2.1, hh_pos, hh_lim, h_blow, ?_⟩
  intro γ m β τ b S g_x P_rates hγ hm hc_top_val hb_lip hb_dom hS_lip h_obs h_cont h_xref
    hP_closed h_rates_ae
  have h_ex_Ioo : ∀ {P : ℝ → Prop}, (∀ᵐ x : ℝ, P x) → ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, P x := by
    intro P hP
    by_contra h_none
    have h_sub : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ { x : ℝ | ¬ P x } :=
      fun x hx hPx => h_none ⟨x, hx, hPx⟩
    have h_zero : MeasureTheory.volume { x : ℝ | ¬ P x } = 0 := MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp hP
    have h_le := MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null h_sub h_zero
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo] at h_le
    norm_num at h_le
  have hb_abs_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, |b u₁ - b u₂| ≤ (1 + m) * |u₁ - u₂| := by
    intro u₁ u₂
    rcases le_total u₁ u₂ with h_le | h_ge
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb_lip u₁ u₂ h_le
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr h_le)]
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb_lip u₂ u₁ h_ge
      rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h_ge)]
      exact h2
  have h1m_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + m := by linarith
  have h_curve_ae :=
    directional_bv_transverse_curve_traces n j_top c d d_v E_cone hd_nn f a D h_tr b (1 + m)
      h1m_nn hb_abs_lip
  have h_rates_swap : ∀ᵐ ui : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < ui.2 ∧ ui.1 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∃ s_u : ℝ, HasDerivAt S s_u ui.1 ∧ 0 < s_u ∧ s_u ≤ 1 ∧
        P_rates s_u (fun j => a j (ui.2, ui.1)) :=
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (ν := MeasureTheory.volume)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h_rates_ae
  have h_S_der_ae : ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∃ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt S s u₀ ∧ 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1 := by
    filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod h_rates_swap] with u₀ hu₀_ae hu₀_mem
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀_mem, hi₀_prop⟩ := h_ex_Ioo hu₀_ae
    obtain ⟨s, hS_der, hs_pos, hs_le, _⟩ := hi₀_prop ⟨hi₀_mem.1, hu₀_mem⟩
    exact ⟨s, hS_der, hs_pos, hs_le⟩
  have hS_lip1 : LipschitzWith 1 S := by
    refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun u₁ u₂ => ?_)
    simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, Real.dist_eq]
    rcases le_total u₁ u₂ with h_le | h_ge
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hS_lip u₁ u₂ h_le
      rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr h_le)]
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hS_lip u₂ u₁ h_ge
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h_ge)]
      exact h2
  have h_derivS_loc : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable (deriv S) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have h_mem : MeasureTheory.MemLp (deriv S) ⊤ MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.memLp_top_of_bound (measurable_deriv S).aestronglyMeasurable 1
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
          simpa using norm_deriv_le_of_lipschitz (𝕜 := ℝ) hS_lip1 (x₀ := x)))
    exact h_mem.locallyIntegrable le_top
  have h_S_leb_ae : ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
        ρ⁻¹ * ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), |deriv S u - deriv S u₀|)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
    filter_upwards [IsUnifLocDoublingMeasure.ae_tendsto_average_norm_sub
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) h_derivS_loc 1] with u₀ hu₀_leb
    have h_avg : Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
        ⨍ u in Metric.closedBall u₀ ρ, ‖deriv S u - deriv S u₀‖ ∂MeasureTheory.volume)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
      refine hu₀_leb (fun _ => u₀) id Filter.tendsto_id ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ρ (hρ : 0 < ρ)
      simp only [one_mul, id_eq]
      exact Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le
    have h_mul := h_avg.const_mul (2 : ℝ)
    rw [mul_zero] at h_mul
    refine h_mul.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ρ (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq, smul_eq_mul, Real.closedBall_eq_Icc,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.real, Real.volume_Icc,
      MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith : u₀ - ρ ≤ u₀ + ρ)]
    have h_diff : (u₀ + ρ) - (u₀ - ρ) = 2 * ρ := by ring
    rw [h_diff, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ρ)]
    have h_int_eq : (∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), ‖deriv S u - deriv S u₀‖) =
        ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), |deriv S u - deriv S u₀| := by rfl
    rw [h_int_eq, ← mul_assoc]
    have h2ρ : (2 : ℝ) * (2 * ρ)⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ := by
      field_simp [hρ.ne']
    rw [h2ρ]
  let ξ₀ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ := (Function.update 0 j₀ 1, 0)
  have hξ₀_cone : InDispCone n c E_cone ξ₀ := by
    intro j k hjk
    have hckj : 0 < c k - c j := hE_pos j k hjk
    have hcj : c j₀ ≤ c j := hc_min j
    have hk_ne : k ≠ j₀ := by
      intro h_eq
      subst h_eq
      linarith
    have hξk : ξ₀.1 k = 0 := by simp [ξ₀, Function.update_of_ne hk_ne]
    have hξj : 0 ≤ ξ₀.1 j := by
      by_cases hj : j = j₀
      · subst hj; simp [ξ₀]
      · simp [ξ₀, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    simp only [ξ₀, mul_zero] at hξk ⊢
    rw [hξk]
    linarith
  have hξ₀_b1 : ∀ j : Fin n, |ξ₀.1 j| ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = j₀
    · subst hj; simp [ξ₀]
    · simp [ξ₀, Function.update_of_ne hj]
  have hξ₀_b2 : |ξ₀.2| ≤ 1 := by simp [ξ₀]
  have h_blow_swap : ∀ᵐ vi : ℝ × ℝ, vi.1 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∀ (R ε_err : ℝ), 1 ≤ R → 0 < ε_err →
        ∀ᶠ l in Filter.atTop, ∀ ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
          InDispCone n c E_cone ξ → (∀ j, |ξ.1 j| ≤ R) → |ξ.2| ≤ R →
          |(f (planeEmbed n c (vi.2, vi.1) + h_seq l • ξ) - f (planeEmbed n c (vi.2, vi.1))) /
            h_seq l - ((∑ j : Fin n, a j (vi.2, vi.1) * ξ.1 j) + D (vi.2, vi.1) * ξ.2)| ≤
            ε_err :=
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (ν := MeasureTheory.volume)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h_blow
  have h_blow_v : ∀ᵐ v : ℝ, v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → ∀ᵐ i : ℝ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun l : ℕ =>
        let p₀ := planeEmbed n c (i, v)
        let p_t := (Function.update p₀.1 j₀ (p₀.1 j₀ + h_seq l), p₀.2)
        (f p_t - f p₀) / h_seq l) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j₀ (i, v))) := by
    filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod h_blow_swap] with v hv_ae hv_mem
    filter_upwards [hv_ae] with i hi_blow
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε_err hε_pos
    have h_ev := hi_blow hv_mem 1 (ε_err / 2) le_rfl (half_pos hε_pos)
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_ev
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := h_ev
    refine ⟨L₀, fun l hl => ?_⟩
    have h_spec := hL₀ l hl ξ₀ hξ₀_cone hξ₀_b1 hξ₀_b2
    have h_pt_eq : planeEmbed n c (i, v) + h_seq l • ξ₀ =
        (Function.update (planeEmbed n c (i, v)).1 j₀
          ((planeEmbed n c (i, v)).1 j₀ + h_seq l), (planeEmbed n c (i, v)).2) := by
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (by simp [ξ₀, planeEmbed])
      ext j
      by_cases hj : j = j₀
      · subst hj; simp [ξ₀]
      · simp [ξ₀, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    have h_lin_eq : (∑ j : Fin n, a j (i, v) * ξ₀.1 j) + D (i, v) * ξ₀.2 = a j₀ (i, v) := by
      have h_sum : ∑ j : Fin n, a j (i, v) * ξ₀.1 j = a j₀ (i, v) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j₀]
        · simp [ξ₀]
        · intro j _ hj
          simp [ξ₀, Function.update_of_ne hj]
        · intro h_abs
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j₀) h_abs
      simp [ξ₀, h_sum]
    rw [h_pt_eq, h_lin_eq] at h_spec
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, h_curve_u₀, h_S_der_u₀, h_S_leb_u₀⟩ :=
    h_ex_Ioo (h_curve_ae.and (h_S_der_ae.and h_S_leb_ae))
  obtain ⟨p, D_minus, D_plus, a_minus, a_plus, hb_der, hDm0, hDm1, hDp0, hDp1,
    ha_bds, hD_tr, ha_tr, h_jmp⟩ := h_curve_u₀ hu₀
  obtain ⟨s, hS_der, hs_pos, hs_le⟩ := h_S_der_u₀ hu₀
  rw [hS_der.deriv] at h_S_leb_u₀
  have h_blow_j₀ : ∀ᵐ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < u₀ → ∀ᵐ i : ℝ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun l : ℕ =>
        let p₀ := planeEmbed n c (i, u₀ - h)
        let p_t := (Function.update p₀.1 j₀ (p₀.1 j₀ + h_seq l), p₀.2)
        (f p_t - f p₀) / h_seq l) Filter.atTop (nhds (a j₀ (i, u₀ - h))) := by
    have h_sub := (MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_sub_left
      MeasureTheory.volume u₀).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h_blow_v
    filter_upwards [h_sub] with h hh_ae hh_pos hh_lt
    exact hh_ae ⟨by linarith [hu₀.1], by linarith [hu₀.2]⟩
  exact obstacle_contact_tuple_extraction n j₀ j_top c d d_v E_cone hc_zero hc_min hd_nn hE_pos
    f hf a D h_seq h_tr hh_pos hh_lim γ m β τ b S g_x P_rates hγ hm hc_top_val hb_lip hb_dom
    hS_lip h_obs h_cont h_xref hP_closed h_rates_ae u₀ p s D_minus D_plus a_minus a_plus
    hu₀ hb_der hS_der hs_pos hs_le h_S_leb_u₀ ⟨hDm0, hDm1, hDp0, hDp1⟩ ha_bds hD_tr ha_tr
    h_jmp h_blow_j₀

characteristic_plane_trace_and_contact.definitions:
def IsStrictDispCone (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → η.1 k - η.1 j < (c k - c j) * η.2

def InStrictResolutionCone (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : Prop :=
  p.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ IsStrictDispCone n c E_cone p

noncomputable def strictConeRestrict (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p then f p else 0

noncomputable def conePartialL (n : ℕ) (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let f₀ := strictConeRestrict n c E_cone f
  Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
    max 0 (min (d j) (((m + 1 : ℝ)) *
      (f₀ (Function.update p.1 j (p.1 j + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹), p.2) - f₀ p))))
    Filter.atTop

noncomputable def conePartialV (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let f₀ := strictConeRestrict n c E_cone f
  Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
    max 0 (min d_v (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ (p.1, p.2 + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹) - f₀ p))))
    Filter.atTop

def HasTangentBoxTrace (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (b₀ u₀ p val_minus val_plus : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
    ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ),
      ∫ r in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), |g (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - val_minus|)
    (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
    ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ),
      ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, |g (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - val_plus|)
    (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)

def IsCharacteristicTraceData (n : ℕ) (j_top : Fin n) (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ)
    (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  (∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (a j) ∧ ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ a j iu ∧ a j iu ≤ d j) ∧
  (Measurable D ∧ ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ D iu ∧ D iu ≤ d_v) ∧
  (∃ M_lip : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_lip ∧
    ∀ p q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
      InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → InResolutionCone n c E_cone q →
      |f p - f q| ≤ M_lip * ((∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|) + |p.2 - q.2|)) ∧
  (∀ (K δ R : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ R →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ =>
      ∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
        ∫ ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,

def IsStrictDispCone (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → η.1 k - η.1 j < (c k - c j) * η.2

def InStrictResolutionCone (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : Prop :=
  p.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ IsStrictDispCone n c E_cone p

noncomputable def strictConeRestrict (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p then f p else 0

noncomputable def conePartialL (n : ℕ) (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let f₀ := strictConeRestrict n c E_cone f
  Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
    max 0 (min (d j) (((m + 1 : ℝ)) *
      (f₀ (Function.update p.1 j (p.1 j + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹), p.2) - f₀ p))))
    Filter.atTop

noncomputable def conePartialV (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let f₀ := strictConeRestrict n c E_cone f
  Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
    max 0 (min d_v (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ (p.1, p.2 + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹) - f₀ p))))
    Filter.atTop

def HasTangentBoxTrace (g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (b₀ u₀ p val_minus val_plus : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
    ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ),
      ∫ r in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), |g (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - val_minus|)
    (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
    ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ),
      ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, |g (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - val_plus|)
    (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)

    (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  (∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (a j) ∧ ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ a j iu ∧ a j iu ≤ d j) ∧
  (Measurable D ∧ ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ D iu ∧ D iu ≤ d_v) ∧
  (∃ M_lip : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_lip ∧
    ∀ p q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
      InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → InResolutionCone n c E_cone q →
      |f p - f q| ≤ M_lip * ((∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|) + |p.2 - q.2|)) ∧
  (∀ (K δ R : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ R →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ =>
      ∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),

          if IsStrictDispCone n c E_cone ξ ∧ (∀ j, |ξ.1 j| ≤ R) ∧ |ξ.2| ≤ R then
            (∑ j : Fin n,

              |conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + h • ξ) - D (i, u)|
          else 0)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)) ∧
  ((∀ (j : Fin n) (K δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ (g_seq : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (C_var : ℝ),
        0 ≤ C_var ∧
        (∀ m, ContDiff ℝ 1 (g_seq m) ∧ ∀ rs, 0 ≤ g_seq m rs ∧ g_seq m rs ≤ d j) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun m =>
          ∫ r in (-K)..K, ∫ s in δ..(1 - δ), |g_seq m (r, s) - a j (r - c j * s, s)|)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ m, (∫ r in (-K)..K, ∫ s in δ..(1 - δ),
          |deriv (fun s' => g_seq m (r, s')) s|) ≤ C_var)) ∧
   (∀ (K δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ (G_seq : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (C_var : ℝ),
        0 ≤ C_var ∧
        (∀ m, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G_seq m) ∧ ∀ iu, 0 ≤ G_seq m iu ∧ G_seq m iu ≤ d_v) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun m =>
          ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K, |G_seq m (i, u) - D (i, u)|)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ m, (∫ u in δ..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K,
          |deriv (fun i' => G_seq m (i', u)) i|) ≤ C_var))) ∧
  ((∀ᵐ u : ℝ, u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → ∀ i₁ i₂ : ℝ,
      f (planeEmbed n c (i₂, u)) - f (planeEmbed n c (i₁, u)) =
        ∫ i in i₁..i₂, ∑ j : Fin n, a j (i, u)) ∧
   (∀ p : ℝ, ∀ᵐ r : ℝ, ∀ u₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ u₂ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      f (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u₂, u₂)) - f (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u₁, u₁)) =
        ∫ u in u₁..u₂, ((∑ j : Fin n, (c j - p) * a j (r - p * u, u)) + D (r - p * u, u)))) ∧
  (∀ (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K δ : ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
    (∀ iu, 0 ≤ φ iu) →
    (∀ iu, (K ≤ |iu.1| ∨ iu.2 ≤ δ ∨ 1 - δ ≤ iu.2) → φ iu = 0) →
    0 ≤ ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K,
      (-a j_top (i, u) * (deriv (fun u' => φ (i, u')) u - c j_top * deriv (fun i' => φ (i', u)) i) +
        D (i, u) * deriv (fun i' => φ (i', u)) i))

                ((∑ j : Fin 4, a_pt j * ξ.1 j) + D_pt * ξ.2)| ≤ ε_err) →
          0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧ MatchedClockRatesDistinct s σ a_pt) ∧
      (m = 1 →
        ∀ (i u s D_pt : ℝ) (a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ) (h_seq : ℕ → ℝ),

          HasDerivAt sys.S s u →

          Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          (∀ (R ε_err : ℝ), 1 ≤ R → 0 < ε_err →
            let f3 := fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => sys.f_raw (![p.1 0, p.1 1, p.1 1, p.1 2], p.2)
            ∀ᶠ l in Filter.atTop, ∀ ξ : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ,
              InDispCone 3 ![0, 1, 2] (fun j k => j < k) ξ → (∀ j, |ξ.1 j| ≤ R) → |ξ.2| ≤ R →

                ((∑ j : Fin 3, a_pt j * ξ.1 j) + D_pt * ξ.2)| ≤ ε_err) →
