proof.tactics:
by
  let σ : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (sys.κ / (4 * m))
  have hσ₀ : 0 < σ := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos sys.hκ (by positivity))
  have hσ_quarter : σ ≤ 1 / 4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hσ₁ : σ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hσ_κ : 4 * m * σ ≤ sys.κ := by
    have h1 : σ ≤ sys.κ / (4 * m) := min_le_right _ _
    have hm4 : 0 < 4 * m := by positivity
    calc 4 * m * σ ≤ 4 * m * (sys.κ / (4 * m)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hm4.le
      _ = sys.κ := mul_div_cancel₀ sys.κ hm4.ne'
  have h_wt : WeightedTaggedProjectionBound := weighted_tagged_planar_projection
  
  have h_uv : UnitVectorTaggedProjectionBound := by
    classical
    intro d s_rate α B_dom C_cov hd0 hd2 hs0 hs1 hα hB hC
    have h2C : 1 ≤ 2 * C_cov := by linarith
    obtain ⟨η₀, ρ₀, hη₀, hρ₀, hρ₀_half, h_wt_app⟩ :=
      h_wt d s_rate α B_dom (2 * C_cov) hd0 hd2 hs0 hs1 hα hB h2C
    let η : ℝ := min (η₀ / 3) (1 / 3)
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
    have h3η_le : 3 * η ≤ η₀ := by
      have h1 : η ≤ η₀ / 3 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    let ρ_cap : ℝ := (1 / 12 : ℝ) ^ (1 / η)
    have hρ_cap_pos : 0 < ρ_cap := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    let ρ₁ : ℝ := min ρ₀ ρ_cap
    have hρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁ := lt_min hρ₀ hρ_cap_pos
    have hρ₁_half : ρ₁ < 1 / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) hρ₀_half
    have h_norm2 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ^ 2 = (v 0) ^ 2 + (v 1) ^ 2 := by
      intro v
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have h_inner2 : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        inner ℝ u v = u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 := by
      intro u v
      simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, mul_comm]
    have h_chart : ∀ (ρ M : ℝ) (N_P N_B : ℕ)
        (μ : Fin N_P → ℝ) (x_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ν : Fin N_B → ℝ) (e_B : Fin N_B → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (G : Fin N_P → Fin N_B → Prop)
        (C_set : Finset (Fin N_B)),
        0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → 0 < M →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) → (∑ i, μ i = 1) →
        (∀ i, ‖x_P i‖ ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ i else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ d) →
        (∀ j, 0 ≤ ν j) → (∑ j, ν j = 1) →
        (∀ j, ‖e_B j‖ = 1) →
        (∀ (e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ‖e₀‖ = 1 → ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ j : Fin N_B, if ‖e_B j - e₀‖ < r then ν j else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ s_rate) →
        (∀ j ∈ C_set, 1 / 2 ≤ (e_B j 1) ^ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ e_B j 1) →
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ρ ^ η ≤
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if G i j ∧ j ∈ C_set then μ i * ν j else 0) →
        (∀ j : Fin N_B, ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ, (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ M ∧
          ∀ i : Fin N_P, G i j →
            ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov, |inner ℝ (x_P i) (e_B j) - c₀| ≤ C_cov * ρ) →
        ρ ^ (-min 1 (min d ((d + s_rate) / 2)) + α) ≤ M := by
      intro ρ M N_P N_B μ x_P ν e_B G C_set
        hρ hρ₁ hM hμ_nn hμ_sum hx_dom hx_ball hν_nn hν_sum he_unit he_ball hC_prop hG_mass h_cov
      have hρ_lt_ρ₀ : ρ < ρ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ₁ (min_le_left _ _)
      have hρ_lt_cap : ρ < ρ_cap := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ₁ (min_le_right _ _)
      have hρ_lt_one : ρ < 1 := by linarith [lt_trans hρ₁ hρ₁_half]
      have hρη_lt : ρ ^ η < 1 / 12 := by
        calc ρ ^ η < ρ_cap ^ η := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hρ.le hρ_lt_cap hη_pos
          _ = ((1 / 12 : ℝ) ^ (1 / η)) ^ η := rfl
          _ = (1 / 12 : ℝ) ^ ((1 / η) * η) := (Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) (1 / η) η).symm
          _ = (1 / 12 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel hη_pos.ne']
          _ = 1 / 12 := Real.rpow_one _
      have hρη_pos : 0 < ρ ^ η := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ η
      have h12_le : (12 : ℝ) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ.le, inv_eq_one_div, le_div_iff₀ hρη_pos]
        linarith
      have h_3η_pow : ρ ^ (-3 * η) ≤ ρ ^ (-η₀) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith)
      have h_η_le_η₀ : ρ ^ (-η) ≤ ρ ^ (-η₀) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith)
      let m_C : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ C_set, ν j
      have hm_C_le_one : m_C ≤ 1 := by
        calc m_C = ∑ j ∈ C_set, ν j := rfl
          _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin N_B, ν j := Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg hν_nn
          _ = 1 := hν_sum
      have hm_C_lb : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ρ ^ η ≤ m_C := by
        calc (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ρ ^ η
            ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if G i j ∧ j ∈ C_set then μ i * ν j else 0 := hG_mass
          _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if j ∈ C_set then μ i * ν j else 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_))
              split_ifs with h1 h2
              · exact le_rfl
              · exact absurd h1.2 h2
              · exact mul_nonneg (hμ_nn i) (hν_nn j)
              · exact le_rfl
          _ = ∑ i : Fin N_P, (μ i * m_C) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
              rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.filter_univ_mem, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          _ = (∑ i : Fin N_P, μ i) * m_C := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          _ = m_C := by rw [hμ_sum, one_mul]
      have hm_C_pos : 0 < m_C := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hm_C_lb
      let ν' : Fin N_B → ℝ := fun j => if j ∈ C_set then ν j / m_C else 0
      let a_B : Fin N_B → ℝ := fun j => if j ∈ C_set then -(e_B j 0) / (e_B j 1) else 0
      let G' : Fin N_P → Fin N_B → Prop := fun i j => G i j ∧ j ∈ C_set
      have hν'_nn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ν' j := by
        intro j; dsimp [ν']; split_ifs; exact div_nonneg (hν_nn j) hm_C_pos.le; exact le_rfl
      have hν'_sum : ∑ j, ν' j = 1 := by
        dsimp [ν']
        rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.filter_univ_mem, ← Finset.sum_div]
        exact div_self hm_C_pos.ne'
      have he1_bounds : ∀ j ∈ C_set,
          (e_B j 0) ^ 2 + (e_B j 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∧ 1 / 2 < e_B j 1 ∧ e_B j 1 ≤ 1 := by
        intro j hj
        have hsq : (e_B j 0) ^ 2 + (e_B j 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
          have hu := he_unit j
          have h1 := h_norm2 (e_B j)
          rw [hu, one_pow] at h1
          exact h1.symm
        obtain ⟨h_half, h_nn⟩ := hC_prop j hj
        refine ⟨hsq, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (by norm_num) h_nn).mp (by linarith)
        · exact (sq_le_sq₀ h_nn zero_le_one).mp (by linarith [sq_nonneg (e_B j 0)])
      have ha_dom : ∀ j, |a_B j| ≤ B_dom := by
        intro j
        dsimp [a_B]
        split_ifs with hj
        · obtain ⟨hsq, he1_gt, _⟩ := he1_bounds j hj
          obtain ⟨h_half, _⟩ := hC_prop j hj
          have he1_pos : 0 < e_B j 1 := by linarith
          have h0_le : |e_B j 0| ≤ e_B j 1 := by
            have hsq0 : (e_B j 0) ^ 2 ≤ (e_B j 1) ^ 2 := by linarith
            have habs := sq_le_sq.mp hsq0
            rwa [abs_of_pos he1_pos] at habs
          rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_pos he1_pos]
          have h_le1 : |e_B j 0| / e_B j 1 ≤ 1 := (div_le_one he1_pos).mpr h0_le
          linarith
        · simp; linarith
      refine h_wt_app ρ M N_P N_B μ x_P ν' a_B G' hρ hρ_lt_ρ₀ hM hμ_nn hμ_sum hx_dom ?_
        hν'_nn hν'_sum ha_dom ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro z r hr0 hr1
        calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ i else 0)
            ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ d := hx_ball z r hr0 hr1
          _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η₀) * r ^ d :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_η_le_η₀ (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
      · intro a₀ r hr0 hr1
        have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ hr0
        let S_hit : Finset (Fin N_B) :=
          C_set.filter (fun j => |a_B j - a₀| < r)
        have h_sum_eq : (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_B j - a₀| < r then ν' j else 0) =
            (∑ j ∈ S_hit, ν j) / m_C := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
          dsimp [ν', S_hit]
          rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
          have h_f : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N_B => |a_B j - a₀| < r)).sum
              (fun j => if j ∈ C_set then ν j / m_C else 0) =
              (C_set.filter (fun j => |a_B j - a₀| < r)).sum (fun j => ν j / m_C) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
            refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
            ext j
            simp [and_comm]
          exact h_f
        rw [h_sum_eq]
        by_cases h_emp : S_hit = ∅
        · rw [h_emp, Finset.sum_empty, zero_div]
          exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hr_pos.le _)
        · obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr h_emp
          have hj₀_C : j₀ ∈ C_set := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj₀).1
          have hj₀_r : |a_B j₀ - a₀| < r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj₀).2
          have h_chord : ∀ j ∈ S_hit, ‖e_B j - e_B j₀‖ < 3 * r := by
            intro j hj
            have hj_C : j ∈ C_set := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1
            have hj_r : |a_B j - a₀| < r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
            have h_diff_a : |a_B j - a_B j₀| < 2 * r := by
              calc |a_B j - a_B j₀| = |(a_B j - a₀) - (a_B j₀ - a₀)| := by ring_nf
                _ ≤ |a_B j - a₀| + |a_B j₀ - a₀| := abs_sub _ _
                _ < r + r := add_lt_add hj_r hj₀_r
                _ = 2 * r := by ring
            obtain ⟨hu_sq, hu1_gt, hu1_le1⟩ := he1_bounds j hj_C
            obtain ⟨hv_sq, hv1_gt, hv1_le1⟩ := he1_bounds j₀ hj₀_C
            obtain ⟨hu1_half, _⟩ := hC_prop j hj_C
            obtain ⟨hv1_half, _⟩ := hC_prop j₀ hj₀_C
            have hu1_pos : 0 < e_B j 1 := by linarith
            have hv1_pos : 0 < e_B j₀ 1 := by linarith
            have ha_j : a_B j = -(e_B j 0) / (e_B j 1) := if_pos hj_C
            have ha_j₀ : a_B j₀ = -(e_B j₀ 0) / (e_B j₀ 1) := if_pos hj₀_C
            have h_cross : e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1 * (a_B j - a_B j₀) =
                -(e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 1 - e_B j₀ 0 * e_B j 1) := by
              rw [ha_j, ha_j₀]
              field_simp [hu1_pos.ne', hv1_pos.ne']
              ring
            have h_a_sq : (a_B j - a_B j₀) ^ 2 < 4 * r ^ 2 := by
              have h1 : |a_B j - a_B j₀| ^ 2 < (2 * r) ^ 2 :=
                (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr h_diff_a
              rw [sq_abs] at h1
              linarith [show (2 * r) ^ 2 = 4 * r ^ 2 by ring]
            have h_u1v1_pos : 0 < e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1 := mul_pos hu1_pos hv1_pos
            have h_u1v1_le1 : (e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
              have h_prod_le1 : e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1 ≤ 1 := by
                calc e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1 ≤ 1 * 1 :=
                      mul_le_mul hu1_le1 hv1_le1 hv1_pos.le zero_le_one
                  _ = 1 := mul_one 1
              have h1 := (sq_le_sq₀ h_u1v1_pos.le zero_le_one).mpr h_prod_le1
              simpa using h1
            have h_cross_sq : (e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 1 - e_B j₀ 0 * e_B j 1) ^ 2 < 4 * r ^ 2 := by
              have h_id : (e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 1 - e_B j₀ 0 * e_B j 1) ^ 2 =
                  (e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2 * (a_B j - a_B j₀) ^ 2 := by
                have hc := congrArg (fun x => x ^ 2) h_cross
                dsimp at hc
                linarith [show (-(e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 1 - e_B j₀ 0 * e_B j 1)) ^ 2 =
                  (e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 1 - e_B j₀ 0 * e_B j 1) ^ 2 by ring,
                  show (e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1 * (a_B j - a_B j₀)) ^ 2 =
                  (e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2 * (a_B j - a_B j₀) ^ 2 by ring]
              calc (e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 1 - e_B j₀ 0 * e_B j 1) ^ 2
                  = (e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2 * (a_B j - a_B j₀) ^ 2 := h_id
                _ ≤ 1 * (a_B j - a_B j₀) ^ 2 :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_u1v1_le1 (sq_nonneg _)
                _ = (a_B j - a_B j₀) ^ 2 := one_mul _
                _ < 4 * r ^ 2 := h_a_sq
            let α_dot : ℝ := e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 0 + e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1
            have h_u1v1_ge : 1 / 2 ≤ e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1 := by
              have hsq1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2 := by
                calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) := by norm_num
                  _ ≤ (e_B j 1) ^ 2 * (e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2 :=
                      mul_le_mul hu1_half hv1_half (by norm_num) (by positivity)
                  _ = (e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2 := by ring
              exact (sq_le_sq₀ (by norm_num) h_u1v1_pos.le).mp hsq1
            have h_u0v0_ge : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 0 := by
              have hu0_half : (e_B j 0) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
              have hv0_half : (e_B j₀ 0) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
              have hsq0 : |e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 0| ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
                rw [sq_abs]
                calc (e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 0) ^ 2 = (e_B j 0) ^ 2 * (e_B j₀ 0) ^ 2 := by ring
                  _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) := mul_le_mul hu0_half hv0_half (sq_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
                  _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by norm_num
              have habs : |e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 0| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
                (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mp hsq0
              exact (abs_le.mp habs).1
            have hα_nn : 0 ≤ α_dot := by dsimp [α_dot]; linarith
            have h_norm_diff : ‖e_B j - e_B j₀‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (1 - α_dot) := by
              rw [h_norm2]
              have h0 : (e_B j - e_B j₀) 0 = e_B j 0 - e_B j₀ 0 := rfl
              have h1 : (e_B j - e_B j₀) 1 = e_B j 1 - e_B j₀ 1 := rfl
              rw [h0, h1]
              dsimp [α_dot]
              linarith [show (e_B j 0 - e_B j₀ 0) ^ 2 + (e_B j 1 - e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2 =
                ((e_B j 0) ^ 2 + (e_B j 1) ^ 2) + ((e_B j₀ 0) ^ 2 + (e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2) -
                2 * (e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 0 + e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1) by ring]
            have h_lagrange : 1 - α_dot ^ 2 =
                (e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 1 - e_B j₀ 0 * e_B j 1) ^ 2 := by
              dsimp [α_dot]
              calc 1 - (e_B j 0 * e_B j₀ 0 + e_B j 1 * e_B j₀ 1) ^ 2

        have hh_l : 0 < h_seq l := hh_pos l

        let L4 : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![i, i + u, i + u, i + 2 * u]

            · simp [Function.update]

        rw [h_lin0] at h_b0
        rw [h_lin1] at h_b1

def dyadicSquare (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
  { x | (k.1 : ℝ) * ρ ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < ((k.1 : ℝ) + 1) * ρ ∧
        (k.2 : ℝ) * ρ ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < ((k.2 : ℝ) + 1) * ρ }

def IsDyadicSquare (ρ : ℝ) (p : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) : Prop :=
  (∃ k : ℤ × ℤ, p = dyadicSquare ρ k) ∧
  p ⊆ { x | x 0 ∈ Set.Ico 0 1 ∧ x 1 ∈ Set.Ico 0 1 }

def IsTubeParamSquare (ρ : ℝ) (q : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) : Prop :=
  (∃ k : ℤ × ℤ, q = dyadicSquare ρ k) ∧
  q ⊆ { u | u 0 ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1 }

def dyadicTube (q : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
  { x | ∃ u ∈ q, x 1 = u 0 * x 0 + u 1 }

open Classical in
def IsRhoSet (ρ d C : ℝ) (P : Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))) : Prop :=
  P.Nonempty ∧
  ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ∀ r : ℝ, ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    ((P.filter (fun p => (p ∩ Metric.ball z r).Nonempty)).card : ℝ) ≤
      C * r ^ d * (P.card : ℝ)

open Classical in
axiom ren_wang (s d α : ℝ) (hs₀ : 0 < s) (hs₁ : s ≤ 1)
    (hd₀ : 0 < d) (hd₂ : d ≤ 2) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ (η₀ ρ₀ c : ℝ),
      0 < η₀ ∧ 0 < ρ₀ ∧ 0 < c ∧
      ∀ (ρ M : ℝ) (P : Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))
        (T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))),
        0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → 0 < M →
        (∀ p ∈ P, IsDyadicSquare ρ p) →
        IsRhoSet ρ d (ρ ^ (-η₀)) P →
        (∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ T p, IsTubeParamSquare ρ q ∧ (dyadicTube q ∩ p).Nonempty) →
        (∀ p ∈ P, M / 2 ≤ ((T p).card : ℝ) ∧ ((T p).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M) →
        (∀ p ∈ P, IsRhoSet ρ s (ρ ^ (-η₀)) (T p)) →
        c * ρ ^ (-min 1 (min d ((d + s) / 2)) + α) * M ≤
          ((P.biUnion T).card : ℝ)

def WeightedTaggedProjectionBound : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  ∀ (d s α B_dom C_cov : ℝ),
    0 < d → d ≤ 2 → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → 0 < α → 1 ≤ B_dom → 1 ≤ C_cov →
    ∃ (η ρ₁ : ℝ), 0 < η ∧ 0 < ρ₁ ∧ ρ₁ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ρ M : ℝ) (N_P N_B : ℕ)
        (μ : Fin N_P → ℝ) (x_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ν : Fin N_B → ℝ) (a_B : Fin N_B → ℝ)
        (G : Fin N_P → Fin N_B → Prop),
        0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → 0 < M →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) → (∑ i, μ i = 1) →
        (∀ i, ‖x_P i‖ ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ i else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ d) →
        (∀ j, 0 ≤ ν j) → (∑ j, ν j = 1) →
        (∀ j, |a_B j| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ (a₀ r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_B j - a₀| < r then ν j else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ s) →
        ρ ^ η ≤ (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if G i j then μ i * ν j else 0) →
        (∀ j : Fin N_B, ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ, (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ M ∧
          ∀ i : Fin N_P, G i j →
            ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov, |(x_P i 1 - a_B j * x_P i 0) - c₀| ≤ C_cov * ρ) →
        ρ ^ (-min 1 (min d ((d + s) / 2)) + α) ≤ M

def UnitVectorTaggedProjectionBound : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  ∀ (d s α B_dom C_cov : ℝ),
    0 < d → d ≤ 2 → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → 0 < α → 1 ≤ B_dom → 1 ≤ C_cov →
    ∃ (η ρ₁ : ℝ), 0 < η ∧ 0 < ρ₁ ∧ ρ₁ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ρ M : ℝ) (N_P N_B : ℕ)
        (μ : Fin N_P → ℝ) (x_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ν : Fin N_B → ℝ) (e_B : Fin N_B → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (G : Fin N_P → Fin N_B → Prop),
        0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → 0 < M →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) → (∑ i, μ i = 1) →
        (∀ i, ‖x_P i‖ ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ i else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ d) →
        (∀ j, 0 ≤ ν j) → (∑ j, ν j = 1) →
        (∀ j, ‖e_B j‖ = 1) →
        (∀ (e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ‖e₀‖ = 1 → ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ j : Fin N_B, if ‖e_B j - e₀‖ < r then ν j else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ s) →
        ρ ^ η ≤ (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if G i j then μ i * ν j else 0) →
        (∀ j : Fin N_B, ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ, (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ M ∧
          ∀ i : Fin N_P, G i j →
            ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov, |inner ℝ (x_P i) (e_B j) - c₀| ≤ C_cov * ρ) →
        ρ ^ (-min 1 (min d ((d + s) / 2)) + α) ≤ M

noncomputable def canonicalShear4 (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ :=
  ![P 0, P 1 + θ.1 * P 0, P 2 + θ.2 * P 0,
    P 3 + θ.1 * P 2 + θ.2 * P 1 + θ.1 * θ.2 * P 0]

noncomputable def canonicalGridBin (ρ x : ℝ) : ℤ :=
  ⌊x / ρ⌋

noncomputable def canonicalGridMid (ρ x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((canonicalGridBin ρ x : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ

noncomputable def canonicalMidU (ρ : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 1),
                  canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 2)]

noncomputable def paramTreeBin (ρ d : ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (dyadicRealBin ρ d θ.1, dyadicRealBin ρ d θ.2)

noncomputable def paramTreeMid (ρ d : ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![dyadicRealMid ρ d θ.1, dyadicRealMid ρ d θ.2]

      (∑ b', π_seq l i b') * (∑ i', π_seq l i' b)
  h_coord_prod : ∀ l b,
    let lam_b := ∑ i, π_seq l i b
    0 < lam_b →
    ∀ k : Fin 4 → ℤ,
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      (∑ i : Fin (N_P l),
        if (∀ j : Fin 4,
          canonicalGridBin (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) j) = k j)
        then π_seq l i b / lam_b else 0) ≤
      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * ∏ j : Fin 4,
        (∑ i : Fin (N_P l),
          if canonicalGridBin (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) j) = k j
          then π_seq l i b / lam_b else 0)
  h_time_ball : ∀ l (z₀ r : ℝ), ρ_seq l ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    (∑ b : Fin (N_Θ l),
      if |(θ_seq l b).1 - z₀| < r then (∑ i, π_seq l i b) else 0) ≤
      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * r ^ s
  h_norm_ball : ∀ l (z₀ r : ℝ), ρ_seq l ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    (∑ b : Fin (N_Θ l),
      if |(θ_seq l b).2 - z₀| < r then (∑ i, π_seq l i b) else 0) ≤
      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * r ^ σ
  h_coord_ball : ∀ l b (j : Fin 4) (z₀ r : ℝ),
    let lam_b := ∑ i, π_seq l i b
    0 < lam_b → ρ_seq l ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    (∑ i : Fin (N_P l),
      if |canonicalGridMid (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) j) - z₀| < r
      then π_seq l i b / lam_b else 0) ≤
      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * r ^ (a_pt j)
  h_coord_cov : ∀ l b (j : Fin 4) (r : ℝ),
    0 < (∑ i, π_seq l i b) → ρ_seq l ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ,
      (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * r ^ (-a_pt j) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin (N_P l), 0 < π_seq l i b →
        ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov,
          |canonicalGridMid (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) j) - c₀| ≤ r

  hgY_lip : ∀ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, d₁ ≤ d₂ → 0 ≤ g_Y d₂ - g_Y d₁ ∧ g_Y d₂ - g_Y d₁ ≤ d₂ - d₁
  hgY_le_q : g_Y 1 ≤ a_pt 1
  hπ_nn : ∀ l i b, 0 ≤ π_seq l i b
  hπ_sum : ∀ l, (∑ i : Fin (N_P l), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ l), π_seq l i b) = 1
  hP_dom : ∀ l i j, |P_seq l i j| ≤ 4
  hθ_dom : ∀ l b, |(θ_seq l b).1| ≤ 4 ∧ |(θ_seq l b).2| ≤ 4
  h_pair_dom : ∀ l i b,
    π_seq l i b ≤ (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) *
      (∑ b', π_seq l i b') * (∑ i', π_seq l i' b)
  h_coord_prod : ∀ l b,
    let lam_b := ∑ i, π_seq l i b
    0 < lam_b →
    ∀ (k_X : ℤ) (k_U : ℤ × ℤ) (k_Z : ℤ),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let bX := fun i => canonicalGridBin (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) 0)
      let bU := fun i => (canonicalGridBin (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) 1),
                          canonicalGridBin (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) 2))
      let bZ := fun i => canonicalGridBin (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) 3)

      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) *
        (∑ i, if bX i = k_X then π_seq l i b / lam_b else 0) *
        (∑ i, if bU i = k_U then π_seq l i b / lam_b else 0) *
        (∑ i, if bZ i = k_Z then π_seq l i b / lam_b else 0)
  h_time_ball : ∀ l (z₀ r : ℝ), ρ_seq l ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    (∑ b : Fin (N_Θ l),
      if |(θ_seq l b).1 - z₀| < r then (∑ i, π_seq l i b) else 0) ≤
      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * r ^ s
  h_norm_ball : ∀ l (z₀ r : ℝ), ρ_seq l ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    (∑ b : Fin (N_Θ l),
      if |(θ_seq l b).2 - z₀| < r then (∑ i, π_seq l i b) else 0) ≤
      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * r ^ σ

    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    (∑ b : Fin (N_Θ l),
      if ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ![(θ_seq l b).1, (θ_seq l b).2] - z₀‖ < r

      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * r ^ s
  h_param_child : ∀ (j a δ_err : ℝ),
    0 < j → 0 < a → j + a < 1 → 0 < δ_err →
    ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ l : ℕ, L₀ ≤ l →
      ∀ b₀ : Fin (N_Θ l),
        let p_par := paramTreeBin (ρ_seq l) j (θ_seq l b₀)
        let a_mid := paramTreeMid (ρ_seq l) j (θ_seq l b₀)
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let m_par := ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ l),

    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    (∑ i : Fin (N_P l),

    (∑ i : Fin (N_P l),

    0 < lam_b → ρ_seq l ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    (∑ i : Fin (N_P l),

      (ρ_seq l) ^ (-κ_seq l) * r ^ (a_pt 2)

        ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov,
          |canonicalGridMid (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) 3) - c₀| ≤ r
  h_Y_ball : ∀ l b (z₀ r : ℝ),
    let lam_b := ∑ i, π_seq l i b
    0 < lam_b → ρ_seq l ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let d_r := Real.log (r⁻¹) / Real.log ((ρ_seq l)⁻¹)
    (∑ i : Fin (N_P l),
      if |canonicalGridMid (ρ_seq l) (canonicalShear4 (P_seq l i) (θ_seq l b) 1) - z₀| < r
      then π_seq l i b / lam_b else 0) ≤
      (ρ_seq l) ^ (g_Y d_r - κ_seq l)

    ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ l : ℕ, L₀ ≤ l →
      ∀ b : Fin (N_Θ l), 0 < (∑ i, π_seq l i b) →
        ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ,
          (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ (ρ_seq l) ^ (-g_Y d - δ_err) ∧

            ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov,

def NoStripConcentration {s σ : ℝ} {a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (blk : CanonicalAffineBlockTied s σ a_pt) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 →
    ∃ (κ_t : ℝ) (L₀ : ℕ), 0 < κ_t ∧ ∀ l : ℕ, L₀ ≤ l →
      ∀ (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c₀ : ℝ), ‖e‖ = 1 →
        (∑ b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l),
          if |(blk.θ_seq l b).1 * e 0 + (blk.θ_seq l b).2 * e 1 - c₀| ≤ (blk.ρ_seq l) ^ t
          then (∑ i, blk.π_seq l i b) else 0) ≤ (blk.ρ_seq l) ^ κ_t

def dyadicSquare (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
  { x | (k.1 : ℝ) * ρ ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < ((k.1 : ℝ) + 1) * ρ ∧
        (k.2 : ℝ) * ρ ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < ((k.2 : ℝ) + 1) * ρ }

def IsDyadicSquare (ρ : ℝ) (p : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) : Prop :=
  (∃ k : ℤ × ℤ, p = dyadicSquare ρ k) ∧
  p ⊆ { x | x 0 ∈ Set.Ico 0 1 ∧ x 1 ∈ Set.Ico 0 1 }

def IsTubeParamSquare (ρ : ℝ) (q : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) : Prop :=
  (∃ k : ℤ × ℤ, q = dyadicSquare ρ k) ∧
  q ⊆ { u | u 0 ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1 }

def dyadicTube (q : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
  { x | ∃ u ∈ q, x 1 = u 0 * x 0 + u 1 }

open Classical in
def IsRhoSet (ρ d C : ℝ) (P : Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))) : Prop :=
  P.Nonempty ∧
  ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ∀ r : ℝ, ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
    ((P.filter (fun p => (p ∩ Metric.ball z r).Nonempty)).card : ℝ) ≤
      C * r ^ d * (P.card : ℝ)

open Classical in
axiom ren_wang (s d α : ℝ) (hs₀ : 0 < s) (hs₁ : s ≤ 1)
    (hd₀ : 0 < d) (hd₂ : d ≤ 2) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ (η₀ ρ₀ c : ℝ),
      0 < η₀ ∧ 0 < ρ₀ ∧ 0 < c ∧
      ∀ (ρ M : ℝ) (P : Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))
        (T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))),
        0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → 0 < M →
        (∀ p ∈ P, IsDyadicSquare ρ p) →
        IsRhoSet ρ d (ρ ^ (-η₀)) P →
        (∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ T p, IsTubeParamSquare ρ q ∧ (dyadicTube q ∩ p).Nonempty) →
        (∀ p ∈ P, M / 2 ≤ ((T p).card : ℝ) ∧ ((T p).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M) →
        (∀ p ∈ P, IsRhoSet ρ s (ρ ^ (-η₀)) (T p)) →
        c * ρ ^ (-min 1 (min d ((d + s) / 2)) + α) * M ≤
          ((P.biUnion T).card : ℝ)

def WeightedTaggedProjectionBound : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  ∀ (d s α B_dom C_cov : ℝ),
    0 < d → d ≤ 2 → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → 0 < α → 1 ≤ B_dom → 1 ≤ C_cov →
    ∃ (η ρ₁ : ℝ), 0 < η ∧ 0 < ρ₁ ∧ ρ₁ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ρ M : ℝ) (N_P N_B : ℕ)
        (μ : Fin N_P → ℝ) (x_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ν : Fin N_B → ℝ) (a_B : Fin N_B → ℝ)
        (G : Fin N_P → Fin N_B → Prop),
        0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → 0 < M →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) → (∑ i, μ i = 1) →
        (∀ i, ‖x_P i‖ ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ i else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ d) →
        (∀ j, 0 ≤ ν j) → (∑ j, ν j = 1) →
        (∀ j, |a_B j| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ (a₀ r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_B j - a₀| < r then ν j else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ s) →
        ρ ^ η ≤ (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if G i j then μ i * ν j else 0) →
        (∀ j : Fin N_B, ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ, (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ M ∧
          ∀ i : Fin N_P, G i j →
            ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov, |(x_P i 1 - a_B j * x_P i 0) - c₀| ≤ C_cov * ρ) →
        ρ ^ (-min 1 (min d ((d + s) / 2)) + α) ≤ M

def UnitVectorTaggedProjectionBound : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  ∀ (d s α B_dom C_cov : ℝ),
    0 < d → d ≤ 2 → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → 0 < α → 1 ≤ B_dom → 1 ≤ C_cov →
    ∃ (η ρ₁ : ℝ), 0 < η ∧ 0 < ρ₁ ∧ ρ₁ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ρ M : ℝ) (N_P N_B : ℕ)
        (μ : Fin N_P → ℝ) (x_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ν : Fin N_B → ℝ) (e_B : Fin N_B → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (G : Fin N_P → Fin N_B → Prop),
        0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → 0 < M →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) → (∑ i, μ i = 1) →
        (∀ i, ‖x_P i‖ ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ i else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ d) →
        (∀ j, 0 ≤ ν j) → (∑ j, ν j = 1) →
        (∀ j, ‖e_B j‖ = 1) →
        (∀ (e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ‖e₀‖ = 1 → ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          (∑ j : Fin N_B, if ‖e_B j - e₀‖ < r then ν j else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * r ^ s) →
        ρ ^ η ≤ (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if G i j then μ i * ν j else 0) →
        (∀ j : Fin N_B, ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ, (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ M ∧
          ∀ i : Fin N_P, G i j →
            ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov, |inner ℝ (x_P i) (e_B j) - c₀| ≤ C_cov * ρ) →
        ρ ^ (-min 1 (min d ((d + s) / 2)) + α) ≤ M

noncomputable def canonicalShear4 (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ :=
  ![P 0, P 1 + θ.1 * P 0, P 2 + θ.2 * P 0,
    P 3 + θ.1 * P 2 + θ.2 * P 1 + θ.1 * θ.2 * P 0]

noncomputable def canonicalGridBin (ρ x : ℝ) : ℤ :=
  ⌊x / ρ⌋

noncomputable def canonicalGridMid (ρ x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((canonicalGridBin ρ x : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ

noncomputable def canonicalMidU (ρ : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 1),
                  canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 2)]

noncomputable def paramTreeBin (ρ d : ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (dyadicRealBin ρ d θ.1, dyadicRealBin ρ d θ.2)

noncomputable def paramTreeMid (ρ d : ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![dyadicRealMid ρ d θ.1, dyadicRealMid ρ d θ.2]

        rw [h_fn]
        exact (((h_slice_comp c x).sub (h_slice_comp c₀ x₀)).add_const _).const_mul
          (s_c * s_v ^ 2)⁻¹
      rw [h_deriv_Φ'.fderiv]
      change (s_c * s_v ^ 2)⁻¹ *
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => Φ₀ (c, x, w)) v (s_v • u) -
           fderiv ℝ (fun w => Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, w)) v (s_v • u)) =
        inner ℝ (ζ'₀ (v', x' - c' • v')) u
      rw [hΦ₀_grad c hc_mem x v (s_v • u), hΦ₀_grad c₀ hc₀_mem x₀ v (s_v • u),
        real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right]
      have hx_cv : x - c • v = X_J - C_r • v + s_x • ((x' - c' • v') + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v') := by
        ext i
        simp [x, c, v, s_x]
        ring
      have hx₀_c₀v : x₀ - c₀ • v = X_J - C_r • v + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_x) • v' := by
        ext i
        simp [x₀, c₀, v, s_x]
        ring
      rw [hx_cv, hx₀_c₀v]
      change (s_c * s_v ^ 2)⁻¹ *
          (s_v * inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + s_x • ((x' - c' • v') + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v'))) u -
           s_v * inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_x) • v')) u) =
        inner ℝ (s_x⁻¹ •
          (ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + s_x • ((x' - c' • v') + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v')) -
           ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_x) • v'))) u
      rw [real_inner_smul_left, inner_sub_left]
      have h_scale : (s_c * s_v ^ 2)⁻¹ * s_v = s_x⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [s_x]
        have hsc_ne : s_c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_c_pos
        have hsv_ne : s_v ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_v_pos
        field_simp [hsc_ne, hsv_ne]
      linear_combination
        (inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + s_x • ((x' - c' • v') + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v'))) u -
         inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_x) • v')) u) * h_scale

    have hζ'₀_fderiv : ∀ (v' p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        fderiv ℝ (fun q' => ζ'₀ (v', q')) p' =
          fderiv ℝ (fun q => ζ₀ (V_J + s_v • v', q))
            (X_J - C_r • (V_J + s_v • v') + s_x • (p' + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v')) := by
      intro v' p'
      let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := V_J + s_v • v'
      let c_shift : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := X_J - C_r • v + s_x • ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • v')
      let β : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        fun q' => X_J - C_r • v + s_x • (q' + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v')
      have hβ_eq : β = fun q' => c_shift + s_x • q' := by
        ext q' i
        simp [β, c_shift]
        ring
      have hβ_deriv : HasFDerivAt β
          (s_x • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) p' := by
        rw [hβ_eq]
        exact ((hasFDerivAt_id p').const_smul s_x).const_add c_shift
      have hc1 : ContDiff ℝ (1 : ℕ) (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ζ₀ (v, q)) :=
        (hζ₀_smooth 1).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ζ₀ (v, q)) (β p') :=
        (hc1.differentiable (by norm_num)).differentiableAt
      have h_comp := hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp p' hβ_deriv
      have h_deriv : HasFDerivAt (fun q' => ζ'₀ (v', q'))
          (s_x⁻¹ • ((fderiv ℝ (fun q => ζ₀ (v, q)) (β p')).comp
            (s_x • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))) p' := by
        change HasFDerivAt
          (fun q' => s_x⁻¹ • (ζ₀ (v, β q') - ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_x) • v'))) _ p'
        exact (h_comp.sub_const _).const_smul s_x⁻¹
      rw [h_deriv.fderiv]
      ext u
      simp only [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, map_smul, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs_x_ne, one_smul]
      rfl

    have h_norm_phase : IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ (3 * A) Φ'₀ ζ'₀ := by
      refine ⟨hΦ'₀_smooth, hζ'₀_smooth, hΦ'₀_v0, hΦ'₀_cx0, hζ'₀_p0, hΦ'₀_grad, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro v' p' u w
        rw [hζ'₀_fderiv v' p']
        exact hζ₀_symm _ _ u w
      · intro v' p' u
        rw [hζ'₀_fderiv v' p']
        exact hζ₀_ell _ _ u
      · intro j vp
        let G : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →
            (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
          fun q => fderiv ℝ (fun p => ζ₀ (q.1, p)) q.2
        have hG_smooth : ContDiff ℝ j G := by
          let inrE : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ]
              EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          let Λ : ((EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →L[ℝ]
              EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →L[ℝ]
              (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
            (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))).flip inrE
          have hG_eq : G = fun q => Λ (fderiv ℝ ζ₀ q) := by
            funext q
            apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
            intro u
            have h_slice : HasFDerivAt (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (q.1, p)) inrE q.2 := by
              have h1 : (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (q.1, p)) =
                  fun p => (q.1, (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) + inrE p := by
                ext p <;> simp [inrE]
              rw [h1]
              exact inrE.hasFDerivAt.const_add (q.1, (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
            have h_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ₀ q :=
              ((hζ₀_smooth 1).differentiable (by norm_num)).differentiableAt
            have h_comp : HasFDerivAt (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ζ₀ (q.1, p))
                ((fderiv ℝ ζ₀ q).comp inrE) q.2 := by
              have hq : (q.1, q.2) = q := Prod.mk.eta
              have h_diff' : HasFDerivAt ζ₀ (fderiv ℝ ζ₀ q) (q.1, q.2) := by
                rw [hq]
                exact h_diff.hasFDerivAt
              exact h_diff'.comp q.2 h_slice
            change fderiv ℝ (fun p => ζ₀ (q.1, p)) q.2 u = ((fderiv ℝ ζ₀ q).comp inrE) u
            rw [h_comp.fderiv]
          rw [hG_eq]
          have hfderiv : ContDiff ℝ j (fderiv ℝ ζ₀) :=
            (hζ₀_smooth (j + 1)).fderiv_right (m := (j : WithTop ℕ∞)) (by norm_cast)
          exact Λ.contDiff.comp hfderiv
        let c_const : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
          (V_J, X_J - C_r • V_J)
        let π₁ : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →L[ℝ]
            EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        let π₂ : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →L[ℝ]
            EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        let L_lin : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →L[ℝ]
            (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
          (s_v • π₁).prod ((-((q_r : ℝ) * s_x)) • π₁ + s_x • π₂)
        have hL_norm : ‖L_lin‖ ≤ 3 := by
          refine L_lin.opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num) (fun q => ?_)
          rw [Prod.norm_def]
          have hq1 : ‖q.1‖ ≤ ‖q‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_left _ _
          have hq2 : ‖q.2‖ ≤ ‖q‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
          have hq_nn : 0 ≤ ‖q‖ := norm_nonneg q
          refine max_le ?_ ?_
          · change ‖s_v • q.1‖ ≤ 3 * ‖q‖
            rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_v_pos.le]
            nlinarith [hs_v_le, hq1, hq_nn]
          · change ‖(-((q_r : ℝ) * s_x)) • q.1 + s_x • q.2‖ ≤ 3 * ‖q‖
            have h_qr_sx_nn : 0 ≤ (q_r : ℝ) * s_x :=
              mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg q_r) hs_x_pos.le
            have h_tri : ‖(-((q_r : ℝ) * s_x)) • q.1 + s_x • q.2‖ ≤
                ((q_r : ℝ) * s_x) * ‖q.1‖ + s_x * ‖q.2‖ := by
              calc ‖(-((q_r : ℝ) * s_x)) • q.1 + s_x • q.2‖
                  ≤ ‖(-((q_r : ℝ) * s_x)) • q.1‖ + ‖s_x • q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
                _ = ((q_r : ℝ) * s_x) * ‖q.1‖ + s_x * ‖q.2‖ := by
                    rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, norm_neg, Real.norm_of_nonneg h_qr_sx_nn,
                      Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_x_pos.le]
            have h_sum_coeff : (q_r : ℝ) * s_x + s_x ≤ 1 := by
              calc (q_r : ℝ) * s_x + s_x = (((q_r : ℝ) + 1) * s_c) * s_v := by dsimp [s_x]; ring
                _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul hq_r_sc_le1 hs_v_le hs_v_pos.le zero_le_one
                _ = 1 := one_mul 1
            nlinarith [h_tri, h_sum_coeff, hq1, hq2, hq_nn, h_qr_sx_nn, hs_x_pos]
        have h_map_eq :
            (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
              fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ'₀ (q.1, p')) q.2) =
            (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
              G (c_const + z)) ∘ L_lin := by
          funext q
          rw [hζ'₀_fderiv q.1 q.2]
          have h_aff : (V_J + s_v • q.1,
              X_J - C_r • (V_J + s_v • q.1) + s_x • (q.2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • q.1)) =
              c_const + L_lin q := by
            refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
            · rfl
            · ext i
              simp [c_const, L_lin, π₁, π₂, C_r, s_x]
              ring
          change G (V_J + s_v • q.1,
              X_J - C_r • (V_J + s_v • q.1) + s_x • (q.2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • q.1)) =
            G (c_const + L_lin q)
          rw [h_aff]
        let G_shift : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →
            (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
          fun z => G (c_const + z)
        have hG_shift_smooth : ContDiff ℝ j G_shift :=
          hG_smooth.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id)
        rw [h_map_eq, L_lin.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right hG_shift_smooth vp le_rfl]
        have h_add : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G_shift (L_lin vp) =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G (c_const + L_lin vp) := by
          dsimp [G_shift]
          rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left]
        rw [h_add]
        have h_norm1 :=
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G (c_const + L_lin vp)).norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
            (fun _ => L_lin)
        have h_prod : (∏ _ : Fin j, ‖L_lin‖) ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          calc ‖L_lin‖ ^ j ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ j := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg L_lin) hL_norm j
            _ ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.le_succ j)
        have h_base := hζ₀_gevrey j (c_const + L_lin vp)
        have h_fact_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3 := by positivity
        have h_A_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ A ^ (j + 1) := pow_nonneg (by linarith) (j + 1)
        calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G (c_const + L_lin vp)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L_lin)‖
            ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j G (c_const + L_lin vp)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin j, ‖L_lin‖ := h_norm1
          _ ≤ (A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) * (3 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) := by
              refine mul_le_mul h_base h_prod ?_ (mul_nonneg h_A_nn h_fact_nn)
              exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg L_lin)
          _ = (3 * A) ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by
              rw [mul_pow]
              ring

    
    have h_haar : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
        (H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → F),
        ∫ v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), H (V_J + s_v • v') =
          (s_v ^ 2)⁻¹ • ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), H v := by
      intro F _ _ H
      have h_smul := MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_smul (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => H (V_J + w)) s_v
      rw [h_smul, MeasureTheory.integral_add_left_eq_self (fun v => H v) V_J,
        finrank_euclideanSpace_fin,
        abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hs_v_pos 2))]

    have hf'₀_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f'₀ MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have h_qmp :=
        ((MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_add_left MeasureTheory.volume V_J).quasiMeasurePreserving).comp
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_smul MeasureTheory.volume
            (ne_of_gt hs_v_pos))
      have hf_comp_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => f (V_J + s_v • v')) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hf_meas.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving h_qmp
      have h_tup_cont : Continuous
          (fun v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (c₀, (x₀, V_J + s_v • v'))) :=
        continuous_const.prodMk
          (continuous_const.prodMk
            (continuous_const.add ((continuous_const (y := s_v)).smul continuous_id)))
      have h_exp_cont : Continuous (fun v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J + s_v • v') - Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :=
        Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
              (continuous_const.mul
                (((hΦ₀_smooth 0).continuous.comp h_tup_cont).sub continuous_const))))
      exact (continuous_const.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hf_comp_meas).mul
        h_exp_cont.aestronglyMeasurable

    have hf'₀_norm_sq : ∀ v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖f'₀ v'‖ ^ 2 = s_v ^ 2 * ‖f (V_J + s_v • v')‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro v'
      dsimp [f'₀, localGaugeInput]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_v_pos.le,
        Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one, mul_pow]

    have hf'₀_l2 : MeasureTheory.MemLp f'₀ 2 MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have hf_sq_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖f v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hf_meas).mp hf_l2
      have hf_shift_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖f (V_J + w)‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hf_sq_int.comp_add_left V_J
      have hf_aff_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖f (V_J + s_v • v')‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hf_shift_int.comp_smul (ne_of_gt hs_v_pos)
      exact (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hf'₀_meas).mpr
        ((hf_aff_int.const_mul (s_v ^ 2)).congr
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v' => (hf'₀_norm_sq v').symm)))

    have hf'₀_int_eq : ∫ v', ‖f'₀ v'‖ ^ 2 = ∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp_rw [hf'₀_norm_sq]
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h_haar (fun v => ‖f v‖ ^ 2), smul_eq_mul,
        ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 (ne_of_gt hs_v_pos)), one_mul]

    have hf'₀_supp : ∀ R_supp : ℝ, (∀ v, R_supp ≤ ‖v - V_J‖ → f v = 0) →
        ∀ v', s_v⁻¹ * R_supp ≤ ‖v'‖ → f'₀ v' = 0 := by
      intro R_supp hf_supp v' hv'
      have h_dist : R_supp ≤ ‖(V_J + s_v • v') - V_J‖ := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_v_pos.le]
        calc R_supp = s_v * (s_v⁻¹ * R_supp) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hs_v_pos), one_mul]
          _ ≤ s_v * ‖v'‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv' hs_v_pos.le
      dsimp [f'₀, localGaugeInput]
      rw [hf_supp (V_J + s_v • v') h_dist]
      simp

    refine ⟨h_norm_phase, hf'₀_meas, hf'₀_l2, hf'₀_int_eq, hf'₀_supp, ?_⟩
    intro r_loc _ V'_o X'_o ψ_o
    let r_full : ℕ := q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc
    let C_t : ℝ := ((r_full : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
    let C'_box : ℝ := ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
    let V_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := V_J + s_v • V'_o
    let X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := X_J + (C_t - C_r) • V_J + s_x • X'_o
    let ρ_obs : ℝ := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
    let ρ'_obs : ℝ := ε ^ ((H_P - r - 2 * b_star - (t - r)) / 2)
    have hρ'_inv : ρ'_obs⁻¹ = s_v * ρ_obs⁻¹ := by
      have hexp : (H_P - r - 2 * b_star - (t - r)) / 2 = (H_P - t) / 2 - b_star := by ring
      dsimp [ρ'_obs, ρ_obs]
      rw [hexp, Real.rpow_sub hε, ← hs_v_eq, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hm_add : m_r + (m_t - m_r) = m_t := Nat.add_sub_of_le hm_le
    have h2mt : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r * (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r) := by
      rw [← pow_add, hm_add]
    have hC_mid : C_r + s_c * (C'_box - 1 / 2) = C_t := by
      dsimp [C_r, s_c, C'_box, C_t, r_full]
      rw [h2mt]
      push_cast
      have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
      have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
      field_simp [h1, h2]
      ring
    have hX_mid : X_J + (s_c * (C'_box - 1 / 2)) • V_J + s_x • X'_o = X_o := by
      have hsc_sub : s_c * (C'_box - 1 / 2) = C_t - C_r := by linarith [hC_mid]
      rw [hsc_sub]
    let ω₀ : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((-lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_J) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    let H_int : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun w =>
      f w * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (w - V_o)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, w) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    unfold generalPacketObsMass
    have h_integrand : (fun v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        f'₀ v' * ψ_o (ρ'_obs⁻¹ • (v' - V'_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            (((s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys) * Φ'₀ (C'_box, X'_o, v') : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
        fun v' => ((s_v : ℂ) * ω₀) * H_int (V_J + s_v • v') := by
      ext v'
      have h_win : ρ'_obs⁻¹ • (v' - V'_o) = ρ_obs⁻¹ • ((V_J + s_v • v') - V_o) := by
        rw [hρ'_inv]
        ext i
        simp [V_o]
        ring
      have h_phase_val :
          (s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys) * Φ'₀ (C'_box, X'_o, v') =
            lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_J + s_v • v') - Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_J) -
              Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J + s_v • v') + Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J)) := by
        change (s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys) *

              _ = (H_P / d) / 2 := by ring
        · intro j hpD
          have hw := h_wid j hpD
          calc (H_P / d) / 2 - ν / d = (H_P / 2 - ν) / d := by field_simp [hd_ne]
            _ ≤ b j / d := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hw hd.le
        · intro o ho j hp_pos
          obtain ⟨hm, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := h_cap o ho j hp_pos
          rw [h_rpow_div, h_rpow_div]
          exact ⟨hm, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩
      · intro hgap N_D' b' a' e_dir V_c X_c p' h_ap h_wid hp_nn hp_out hp_sum h_cap
        have h_est := hgap N_D' (fun j => d * b' j) (fun j => d * a' j)
          e_dir V_c X_c p' ?_ ?_ hp_nn hp_out hp_sum ?_
        · dsimp only at h_est ⊢
          rw [h_ell_d, h_root_eq]
          have hEw : (∑ j : Fin N_D', (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom, p' o j) *
                ((1 + γ) * (d * b' j) + (1 - γ) * (d * a' j))) =
              d * ∑ j : Fin N_D', (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom, p' o j) *
                ((1 + γ) * b' j + (1 - γ) * a' j) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
            ring
          rw [hEw] at h_est
          have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_est (inv_pos.mpr hd).le
          have h_lhs_eq :
              d⁻¹ *
                ((∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom,
                    -((∑ j : Fin N_D', p' o j) * Real.log (∑ j : Fin N_D', p' o j))) /
                  Real.log (ε⁻¹) +
                 (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom, ∑ j : Fin N_D',
                    -(p' o j * Real.log (p' o j / ∑ o' ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom, p' o' j))) /
                  Real.log (ε⁻¹)) +
                 (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom,
                    (∑ j : Fin N_D', p' o j) * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)) /
                  Real.log (ε⁻¹)) +
                 (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (d * ∑ j : Fin N_D',
                  (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom, p' o j) *
                    ((1 + γ) * b' j + (1 - γ) * a' j))) =
              (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom,
                  -((∑ j : Fin N_D', p' o j) * Real.log (∑ j : Fin N_D', p' o j))) /
                (d * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) +
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom, ∑ j : Fin N_D',
                  -(p' o j * Real.log (p' o j / ∑ o' ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom, p' o' j))) /
                (d * Real.log (ε⁻¹))) +
              (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom,
                  (∑ j : Fin N_D', p' o j) * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)) /
                (d * Real.log (ε⁻¹))) +
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin N_D',
                (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom, p' o j) *
                  ((1 + γ) * b' j + (1 - γ) * a' j) := by
            field_simp [hd_ne, h_ell_ne]
          have h_rhs_eq :
              d⁻¹ * (generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f - κ) =
                d⁻¹ * generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f - κ / d := by
            field_simp [hd_ne]
          rw [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq] at h_mul
          exact h_mul
        · intro j
          obtain ⟨hb0, hba, ha_min, he⟩ := h_ap j
          refine ⟨mul_nonneg hd.le hb0, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hba hd.le,
            le_min ?_ ?_, he⟩
          · exact (le_div_iff₀' hd).mp (le_trans ha_min (min_le_left _ _))
          · have h2 : a' j ≤ (H_P / 2) / d := by
              calc a' j ≤ (H_P / d) / 2 := le_trans ha_min (min_le_right _ _)
                _ = (H_P / 2) / d := by ring
            exact (le_div_iff₀' hd).mp h2
        · intro j hpD
          have hw := h_wid j hpD
          have hw_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw hd.le
          calc H_P / 2 - ν = d * ((H_P / d) / 2 - ν / d) := by field_simp [hd_ne]
            _ ≤ d * b' j := hw_mul
        · intro o ho j hp_pos
          obtain ⟨hm, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := h_cap o ho j hp_pos
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε.le] at hc1 hc2 hc3 hc4
          exact ⟨hm, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩

  
  have h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ) := by
    intro cls t_min δ ht_min ht_hor hδ
    have h_ne : (ValidPacketGrowthRates γ).Nonempty := ⟨1, h_one⟩
    have h_lt : sInf (ValidPacketGrowthRates γ) < quantumPacketRate γ + δ / 2 := by
      change quantumPacketRate γ < quantumPacketRate γ + δ / 2
      linarith
    obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀_mem, hb₀_lt⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt h_ne h_lt
    obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, h_est⟩ :=
      hb₀_mem.2.2 cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.R_dom cls.B_sys cls.K_hor cls.R_win
        t_min (δ / 2) cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        cls.ha₀ cls.ha₁ cls.hA cls.hR_dom cls.hB_sys cls.hK_hor cls.hR_win
        ht_min ht_hor (half_pos hδ) cls.hN_mult
    refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, ?_⟩
    intro ε H_P L t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ ζ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
      b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p hε_lt ht_ge ht_L ht_HP henv hm1 hm2 hadm
    rcases henv with ⟨hε_pos, _, _, hHP_K, _, hL_K, hlam1, hlam2,
      hphase, hf_meas, hf_supp, hf_l2, hf_pos⟩
    have h_bound := h_est ε H_P L t lam_sys m_time hε_pos hε_lt
      ht_ge ht_L ht_HP hHP_K hL_K hlam1 hlam2 hm1 hm2
      Φ₀ ζ₀ hphase f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2 hf_pos
      N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p hadm
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le ht_min ht_ge
    nlinarith

  
  have h_sat : ∀ Δ : ℝ, 0 < Δ →
      ∃ cls : PacketBoundClass, IsDurationOneSaturatingClass γ Δ cls := by
    intro Δ hΔ
    by_contra h_no_sat
    let b_low : ℝ := max 0 (quantumPacketRate γ - Δ / 2)
    have hb_low_nn : 0 ≤ b_low := le_max_left _ _
    have hb_low_lt : b_low < quantumPacketRate γ := max_lt hβ_pos (by linarith)
    have hb_low_le : b_low ≤ 1 := le_trans hb_low_lt.le hβ_le
    have hb_low_ge : quantumPacketRate γ - Δ / 2 ≤ b_low := le_max_right _ _
    have hb_mem : b_low ∈ ValidPacketGrowthRates γ := by
      refine ⟨hb_low_nn, hb_low_le, ?_⟩
      intro a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys K_hor R_win t_min δ N_mult M_win
        ha₀ ha₁ hA hR_dom hB_sys hK_hor hR_win ht_min ht_hor hδ hN_mult
      let cls : PacketBoundClass := {
        a₀ := a₀
        a₁ := a₁
        A := A
        R_dom := R_dom
        B_sys := B_sys
        K_hor := K_hor / t_min
        R_win := R_win
        N_mult := N_mult
        M_win := M_win
        ha₀ := ha₀
        ha₁ := ha₁
        hA := hA
        hR_dom := hR_dom
        hB_sys := hB_sys
        hK_hor := (one_le_div ht_min).mpr ht_hor
        hR_win := hR_win
        hN_mult := hN_mult
      }
      have h_not_cls : ¬ IsDurationOneSaturatingClass γ Δ cls :=
        fun hcls => h_no_sat ⟨cls, hcls⟩
      unfold IsDurationOneSaturatingClass at h_not_cls
      push Not at h_not_cls
      obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, h_no_wit⟩ := h_not_cls
      let ε₁ : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (ε₀ ^ (t_min⁻¹))
      have hε₁_pos : 0 < ε₁ := lt_min (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀_pos _)
      have hε₁_lt : ε₁ < 1 / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
      refine ⟨ε₁, hε₁_pos, hε₁_lt, ?_⟩
      intro ε H_P L t lam_sys m_time hε_pos hε_lt ht_ge ht_L ht_HP hHP_K hL_K
        hlam1 hlam2 hm1 hm2 Φ₀ ζ₀ hphase f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2 hf_pos
        N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p hadm
      by_contra h_not_le
      have h_gt_score :
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + (b_low + δ) * t <
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
              N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p :=
        lt_of_not_ge h_not_le
      have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le ht_min ht_ge
      have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht_pos
      have hε_le_quarter : ε < 1 / 4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
      have hε_half : ε < 1 / 2 := by linarith
      have hε_le_one : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
      have hε_lt_rpow : ε < ε₀ ^ (t_min⁻¹) := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_right _ _)
      have hεt_min_lt : ε ^ t_min < ε₀ := by
        have h1 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hε_pos.le hε_lt_rpow ht_min
        rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε₀_pos.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt ht_min),
          Real.rpow_one] at h1
        exact h1
      have hεt_le : ε ^ t ≤ ε ^ t_min :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le_one ht_ge
      have hεt_lt_ε₀ : ε ^ t < ε₀ := lt_of_le_of_lt hεt_le hεt_min_lt
      have hεt_half : ε ^ t < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hεt_lt_ε₀ hε₀_lt
      have hεt_pos : 0 < ε ^ t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos t
      have hHP_div1 : 1 ≤ H_P / t := (one_le_div ht_pos).mpr ht_HP
      have hL_div1 : 1 ≤ L / t := (one_le_div ht_pos).mpr ht_L
      have hK_nn : 0 ≤ K_hor := by linarith
      have hHP_divK : H_P / t ≤ K_hor / t_min := by
        calc H_P / t ≤ K_hor / t := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hHP_K ht_pos.le
          _ ≤ K_hor / t_min := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hK_nn ht_min ht_ge
      have hL_divK : L / t ≤ K_hor / t_min := by
        calc L / t ≤ K_hor / t := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hL_K ht_pos.le
          _ ≤ K_hor / t_min := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hK_nn ht_min ht_ge
      have h_exp_HP : (ε ^ t) ^ (-(H_P / t)) = ε ^ (-H_P) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
        congr 1
        field_simp [ht_ne]
      have henv_sc : IsValidPacketEnv cls (ε ^ t) (H_P / t) (L / t) lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f := by
        refine ⟨hεt_pos, hεt_half, by linarith, hHP_divK, by linarith, hL_divK,
          ?_, ?_, hphase, hf_meas, hf_supp, hf_l2, hf_pos⟩
        · change B_sys⁻¹ * (ε ^ t) ^ (-(H_P / t)) ≤ lam_sys
          rwa [h_exp_HP]
        · change lam_sys ≤ B_sys * (ε ^ t) ^ (-(H_P / t))
          rwa [h_exp_HP]
      have hm1_sc : cls.B_sys⁻¹ * (ε ^ t) ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ := by
        change B_sys⁻¹ * (ε ^ t) ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
        rwa [Real.rpow_one]
      have hm2_sc : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * (ε ^ t) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
        change ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ B_sys * (ε ^ t) ^ (1 : ℝ)
        rwa [Real.rpow_one]
      have h_sc := h_dur ε H_P L t R_dom B_sys R_win N_mult M_win lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
        N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p
        hε_pos hε_half ht_pos hεt_half
      have hadm_sc := h_sc.1 hadm
      have hscore_sc :
          generalPacketRootScore (ε ^ t) (H_P / t) (L / t) cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
              quantumPacketRate γ - Δ ≤
            generalPacketScore (ε ^ t) γ (H_P / t) 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
              N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O (fun j => b_D j / t) (fun j => a_D j / t) p := by
        change generalPacketRootScore (ε ^ t) (H_P / t) (L / t) R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ - Δ ≤ _
        rw [h_sc.2.1, h_sc.2.2.1]
        have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_gt_score (inv_pos.mpr ht_pos)
        have h_id : t⁻¹ *
            (generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + (b_low + δ) * t) =
            t⁻¹ * generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + b_low + δ := by
          field_simp [ht_ne]
          ring
        linarith
      exact not_le_of_gt
        (h_no_wit (ε ^ t) (H_P / t) (L / t) lam_sys m_time Φ₀ ζ₀ f
          N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O (fun j => b_D j / t) (fun j => a_D j / t)
          r_D e_D V_D X_D p
          hεt_lt_ε₀ hHP_div1 hL_div1 henv_sc hm1_sc hm2_sc hadm_sc)
        hscore_sc
    have h_le : quantumPacketRate γ ≤ b_low := csInf_le h_bdd hb_mem
    linarith

  exact ⟨hβ_pos, hβ_le, h_resc, h_dur, h_mod, h_sat⟩

signature.name: fourier_wave_packet_cut_decomposition
signature.statement: ∃ M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ, PacketCutDecompositionValid M_atom

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨C_χ, hC_χ, h_pou_smooth, h_pou_supp, h_pou_deriv, h_pou_synth⟩ :=
    gevrey_partition_and_fourier_synthesis
  obtain ⟨M_atom, hM_atom_nn, h_mode_gen⟩ :=
    cut_mode_inversion_and_window_bounds C_χ hC_χ h_pou_smooth h_pou_supp h_pou_deriv
  refine ⟨M_atom, ?_⟩
  intro cls Δ_u A_amp B_cut hΔ_u hA_amp hB_cut
  obtain ⟨C_can, M_mult, hC_can, hM_mult, h_mode⟩ :=
    h_mode_gen cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win
      cls.ha₀ cls.ha₁ cls.hA cls.hB_sys cls.hR_win
  obtain ⟨C_tr, hC_tr_nn, h_tr⟩ :=
    cut_linear_transport_nonstationary_tail cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win C_χ cls.M_win
      cls.ha₀ cls.ha₁ cls.hA cls.hB_sys cls.hR_win hC_χ h_pou_smooth h_pou_supp h_pou_deriv
  obtain ⟨C_Bes, C_rtail, hC_Bes_4, hC_rtail_nn, h_loc⟩ :=
    local_gauge_bessel_and_cap_tail cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys M_mult
      (M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win)
      cls.ha₀ cls.ha₁ cls.hA cls.hB_sys hM_mult
  have hB_sys_pos : 0 < cls.B_sys := by linarith [cls.hB_sys]
  have hR_win_pos : 0 < cls.R_win := by linarith [cls.hR_win]
  have ha₁_pos : 0 < cls.a₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le cls.ha₀ cls.ha₁
  let R_dom_big : ℝ := max cls.R_dom (6 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4)
  have hR_dom_big_ge : cls.R_dom ≤ R_dom_big := le_max_left _ _
  have hR_dom_big_1 : 1 ≤ R_dom_big := le_trans cls.hR_dom hR_dom_big_ge
  let C_V : ℝ := (2 * cls.B_sys * (R_dom_big + 2) + 5) ^ 2
  let C_X : ℝ := (2 * cls.a₁ * (8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 8) * (2 * cls.B_sys ^ 3) + 5) ^ 2
  have hC_V_pos : 0 < C_V := by positivity
  have hC_X_pos : 0 < C_X := by positivity
  let M₀ : ℕ := max 2 (⌈A_amp / Δ_u⌉₊ + 2)
  have hM₀_ge2 : 2 ≤ M₀ := le_max_left _ _
  let M_win0 : ℝ := max (cls.M_win 0) 0
  have hM_win0_nn : 0 ≤ M_win0 := le_max_right _ _
  let C_piece2 : ℝ := C_tr M₀ * (2 * cls.B_sys ^ 3) ^ ((M₀ : ℝ) - 1)
  let C_piece3 : ℝ := 4 * cls.R_win * M_win0 * Real.sqrt (C_V * C_X)
  have hC_p2_nn : 0 ≤ C_piece2 :=
    mul_nonneg (hC_tr_nn M₀) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
  have hC_p3_nn : 0 ≤ C_piece3 := by positivity
  let C_cut : ℝ :=
    max (104 + 8 * cls.B_sys)
      (max (cls.R_win + 2 * cls.B_sys + 4) (max (C_V * C_X) (C_piece2 + C_piece3)))
  have hC_cut_104 : 104 + 8 * cls.B_sys ≤ C_cut := le_max_left _ _
  have hC_cut_vel : cls.R_win + 2 * cls.B_sys + 4 ≤ C_cut :=
    le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hC_cut_card : C_V * C_X ≤ C_cut :=
    le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  have hC_cut_err : C_piece2 + C_piece3 ≤ C_cut :=
    le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  have hC_cut_ge2 : 2 ≤ C_cut := by linarith [cls.hB_sys, hC_cut_104]
  have hC_Bes_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_Bes := by linarith [hC_Bes_4]
  let K_u : ℝ :=
    max (16 * cls.B_sys ^ 3) (cls.B_sys * Real.exp (12 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10))
  have hK_u_16 : 16 * cls.B_sys ^ 3 ≤ K_u := le_max_left _ _
  have hK_u_exp : cls.B_sys * Real.exp (12 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10) ≤ K_u :=
    le_max_right _ _
  have hK_u_pos : 0 < K_u := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hK_u_16
  let ε_cut : ℝ := min (1 / 4) ((K_u⁻¹) ^ (Δ_u⁻¹))
  have hε_cut_pos : 0 < ε_cut :=
    lt_min (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hK_u_pos) _)
  have hε_cut_lt : ε_cut < 1 / 2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨C_cut, C_can, C_Bes, M_mult, C_tr, C_rtail, ε_cut,
    hC_cut_ge2, hC_can, hC_Bes_ge1, hM_mult, hC_tr_nn, hC_rtail_nn, hε_cut_pos, hε_cut_lt, ?_⟩
  intro ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t q_r Φ₀ ζ₀ f V_J X_J
    hε_lt henv hr_nn hrt ht_HP hb_nn hb_le hΔ_gap h_mr hm_rt hq_r hm_t_lo hm_t_hi hVJ hXJ
    s_c C_r s_v s_x ρ_r σ_r ρ_t
  obtain ⟨hε_pos, hε_half, hHP_pos, hHP_K, hL_pos, hL_K,
    hlam_lo, hlam_hi, h_phase, hf_meas, hf_supp, hf_l2, hf_pos⟩ := henv
  have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
  
  have h_grid_coord : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ), 0 < s →
      |(k.1 : ℝ)| ≤ s⁻¹ * ‖gridPt2D s k‖ ∧ |(k.2 : ℝ)| ≤ s⁻¹ * ‖gridPt2D s k‖ := by
    intro s k hs
    have h0 : |s * (k.1 : ℝ)| ≤ ‖gridPt2D s k‖ := by
      simpa [gridPt2D, Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le (gridPt2D s k) 0
    have h1 : |s * (k.2 : ℝ)| ≤ ‖gridPt2D s k‖ := by
      have h10 : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 := by decide
      simpa [gridPt2D, h10, Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le (gridPt2D s k) 1
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs] at h0 h1

        have h_vol_ball : MeasureTheory.volume K_ball = ENNReal.ofReal (r_B ^ 2 * Real.pi) := by
          dsimp [K_ball]
          rw [EuclideanSpace.volume_closedBall_fin_two,
            ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow hr_B_pos.le 2, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg r_B)]
        have h_vol_lt_top : MeasureTheory.volume K_ball < ⊤ := by
          rw [h_vol_ball]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
        have h_vol_le : (MeasureTheory.volume K_ball).toReal ≤ (2 * r_B) ^ 2 := by
          rw [h_vol_ball, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg r_B) Real.pi_pos.le)]
          calc r_B ^ 2 * Real.pi ≤ r_B ^ 2 * 4 :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Real.pi_lt_four.le (sq_nonneg r_B)
            _ = (2 * r_B) ^ 2 := by ring
        let α_cs : ℝ := Real.sqrt U_tiny / (2 * r_B)
        have hα_pos : 0 < α_cs := div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hU_tiny_pos) (by positivity)
        have hW_norm_le : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖W_end v‖ ≤ M_win0 := by
          intro v
          dsimp [W_end]
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one,
            ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := ψ_o)]
          exact (hψ_o_deriv 0 _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
        have h_const1_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
            (fun _ => α_cs / 2) K_ball MeasureTheory.volume :=
          MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const h_vol_lt_top.ne (by simp)
        have h_int_ball : ∫ v, ‖h_tiny v * W_end v‖ ≤
            M_win0 * (2 * r_B * Real.sqrt U_tiny) := by
          have h_compl : ∀ v ∉ K_ball, ‖h_tiny v * W_end v‖ = 0 :=
            fun v hv => by simp [hW_supp_ball v hv]
          rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero h_compl]
          have h_lhs_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
              (fun v => ‖h_tiny v * W_end v‖) K_ball MeasureTheory.volume :=
            (h_cont_int h_tiny h_htiny_cont).norm.integrableOn
          have h_rhs_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
              (fun v => M_win0 * ((2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * ‖h_tiny v‖ ^ 2 + α_cs / 2))
              K_ball MeasureTheory.volume :=
            ((h_tiny_sq_int.integrableOn.const_mul (2 * α_cs)⁻¹).add h_const1_int).const_mul M_win0
          have h_pt : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              ‖h_tiny v * W_end v‖ ≤ M_win0 * ((2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * ‖h_tiny v‖ ^ 2 + α_cs / 2) := by
            intro v
            rw [norm_mul]
            have h_amgm : ‖h_tiny v‖ ≤ (2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * ‖h_tiny v‖ ^ 2 + α_cs / 2 := by
              have h_id : ((2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * ‖h_tiny v‖ ^ 2 + α_cs / 2) - ‖h_tiny v‖ =
                  (2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * (‖h_tiny v‖ - α_cs) ^ 2 := by
                have hne : α_cs ≠ 0 := hα_pos.ne'
                field_simp [hne]
                ring
              have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ (2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * (‖h_tiny v‖ - α_cs) ^ 2 := by positivity
              linarith only [h_id, h_rhs_nn]
            calc ‖h_tiny v‖ * ‖W_end v‖
                ≤ ‖h_tiny v‖ * M_win0 :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hW_norm_le v) (norm_nonneg _)
              _ = M_win0 * ‖h_tiny v‖ := mul_comm _ _
              _ ≤ M_win0 * ((2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * ‖h_tiny v‖ ^ 2 + α_cs / 2) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_amgm hM_win0_nn
          have h_mono : ∫ v in K_ball, ‖h_tiny v * W_end v‖ ≤
              ∫ v in K_ball, M_win0 * ((2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * ‖h_tiny v‖ ^ 2 + α_cs / 2) :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae h_lhs_int h_rhs_int (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_pt)
          refine h_mono.trans ?_
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
            MeasureTheory.integral_add (h_tiny_sq_int.integrableOn.const_mul _) h_const1_int,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const,
            MeasureTheory.Measure.real_def, smul_eq_mul]
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hM_win0_nn
          have h_set_le : ∫ v in K_ball, ‖h_tiny v‖ ^ 2 ≤ U_tiny :=
            (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_le_integral h_tiny_sq_int
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => sq_nonneg _))).trans h_l2_U
          have h_comb : (2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * (∫ v in K_ball, ‖h_tiny v‖ ^ 2) +
              (MeasureTheory.volume K_ball).toReal * (α_cs / 2) ≤
              (2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * U_tiny + (2 * r_B) ^ 2 * (α_cs / 2) :=
            add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_set_le (by positivity))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_vol_le (by positivity))
          refine h_comb.trans ?_
          let sU : ℝ := Real.sqrt U_tiny
          have hrB_ne : r_B ≠ 0 := hr_B_pos.ne'
          have hsU_ne : sU ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hU_tiny_pos).ne'
          have hsU_sq : U_tiny = sU ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hU_tiny_pos.le).symm
          have h_alg_eq : (2 * α_cs)⁻¹ * U_tiny + (2 * r_B) ^ 2 * (α_cs / 2) =
              2 * r_B * sU := by
            change (2 * (sU / (2 * r_B)))⁻¹ * U_tiny +
              (2 * r_B) ^ 2 * (sU / (2 * r_B) / 2) = 2 * r_B * sU
            rw [hsU_sq]
            field_simp [hrB_ne, hsU_ne]
            ring
          rw [h_alg_eq]
        have h_pair_norm : ‖pair_fn h_tiny‖ ≤ ρ_t⁻¹ * ∫ v, ‖h_tiny v * W_end v‖ := by
          dsimp [pair_fn]
          rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ_t_pos.le]
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_t_pos.le)
          have h_eq : (fun v => h_tiny v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
              (fun v => h_tiny v * W_end v) := by
            ext v; dsimp [W_end]; ring
          rw [h_eq]
          exact MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        have h_sqrt_U : Real.sqrt U_tiny =
            2 * Real.sqrt (C_V * C_X) * ε ^ ((B_cut - 2 * cls.K_hor) / 2) * Real.sqrt E_f := by
          dsimp [U_tiny]
          have h_e_sq : ε ^ (B_cut - 2 * cls.K_hor) = (ε ^ ((B_cut - 2 * cls.K_hor) / 2)) ^ 2 := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
            congr 1
            ring
          rw [h_e_sq, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
            Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
          have h4_sq : Real.sqrt 4 = 2 := by norm_num
          rw [h4_sq]
        have h_exp_bcut : ε ^ ((B_cut - 2 * cls.K_hor) / 2) ≤ ε ^ A_amp :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith only [hB_cut, cls.hK_hor])
        calc ‖pair_fn h_tiny‖
            ≤ ρ_t⁻¹ * (M_win0 * (2 * r_B * Real.sqrt U_tiny)) :=
              h_pair_norm.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_ball (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_t_pos.le))
          _ = 2 * cls.R_win * M_win0 * Real.sqrt U_tiny := by
              dsimp [r_B]
              have hρt_ne : ρ_t ≠ 0 := hρ_t_pos.ne'
              field_simp [hρt_ne]
          _ = C_piece3 * ε ^ ((B_cut - 2 * cls.K_hor) / 2) * Real.sqrt E_f := by
              rw [h_sqrt_U]
              dsimp [C_piece3]
              ring
          _ ≤ C_piece3 * ε ^ A_amp * Real.sqrt E_f :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp_bcut hC_p3_nn) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      calc ‖pair_fn f - pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_atom, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖
          = ‖S_unret + pair_fn h_tiny‖ := by rw [h_diff_split]
        _ ≤ ‖S_unret‖ + ‖pair_fn h_tiny‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ C_piece2 * ε ^ A_amp * Real.sqrt E_f + C_piece3 * ε ^ A_amp * Real.sqrt E_f :=
            add_le_add h_unret_bound h_tiny_bound
        _ = (C_piece2 + C_piece3) * ε ^ A_amp * Real.sqrt E_f := by ring
        _ ≤ C_cut * ε ^ A_amp * Real.sqrt E_f :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_cut_err (by positivity)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    · 
      intro S M_tr R_tr hM_tr hR_tr
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let S_near := S.filter (fun α =>
        ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t ∧
        ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * R_tr * σ_r)
      let S_far := S \ S_near
      let F_far : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := S_far.map emb_ret
      have h_sub_sum : ∀ T : Finset (Fin N_atom),
          pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ T, c_atom α * g_at α v) =
            ∑ q ∈ T.map emb_ret, c_lin q.1 q.2 * pair_jn q.1 q.2 := by
        intro T
        have h_fn : (fun v => ∑ α ∈ T, c_atom α * g_at α v) =
            (fun v => ∑ q ∈ T.map emb_ret,
              c_lin q.1 q.2 * cutLinearAtom lam_sys ρ_r C_r X_J Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v) := by
          ext v
          rw [Finset.sum_map]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => by rw [h_g_eq_atom α v])
        rw [h_fn, h_pair_sum _ (fun q => c_lin q.1 q.2)]
      have h_diff_S :
          pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v) -
            pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, c_atom α * g_at α v) =
          ∑ q ∈ F_far, c_lin q.1 q.2 * pair_jn q.1 q.2 := by
        rw [h_sub_sum S, h_sub_sum S_near]
        simp only [Finset.sum_map, F_far]
        rw [← Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.filter_subset _ S)]
        ring
      have h_far_energy : ∑ q ∈ F_far, ‖c_lin q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f := by
        rw [Finset.sum_map]
        exact (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ S_far)
          (fun _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _)).trans h_sum_c_le_Ef
      have h_far_sep : ∀ q ∈ F_far,
          cls.R_win * ρ_t + 2 * ρ_r ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ_r q.1 - V_o‖ ∨
          R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_o - X_ex q.1 q.2 - (C_t - C_r) • gridPt2D ρ_r q.1‖ := by
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hq
        obtain ⟨hα_S, hα_not_near⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hα
        by_cases hv : ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t
        · refine Or.inr ?_
          have hx_not : ¬ ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * R_tr * σ_r :=
            fun hx => hα_not_near (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hα_S, hv, hx⟩)
          push Not at hx_not
          have h_rd := hX_round (emb_ret α).1 (emb_ret α).2
          have h_tri : ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤
              ‖X_o - X_ex (emb_ret α).1 (emb_ret α).2 - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ +
                ‖X_at α - X_ex (emb_ret α).1 (emb_ret α).2‖ := by
            have h_id : X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α =
                (X_o - X_ex (emb_ret α).1 (emb_ret α).2 - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α) -
                  (X_at α - X_ex (emb_ret α).1 (emb_ret α).2) := by abel
            rw [h_id]
            exact norm_sub_le _ _
          have h_2R : R_tr + 1 ≤ C_cut * R_tr := by
            have h1 : 2 * R_tr ≤ C_cut * R_tr :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_cut_ge2 (by linarith only [hR_tr])
            linarith only [h1, hR_tr]
          have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_2R hσ_r_pos.le
          dsimp [V_at, X_at, o_atom] at hx_not h_tri ⊢
          linarith only [hx_not, h_tri, h_rd, h_mul]
        · refine Or.inl ?_
          push Not at hv
          rw [norm_sub_rev] at hv
          have hρ_le_B_full : ρ_r ≤ cls.B_sys * ρ_t :=
            hρ_le_Bρt.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sqrtB_le hρ_t_pos.le)
          have h_cc : cls.R_win * ρ_t + 2 * ρ_r ≤ C_cut * ρ_t := by
            calc cls.R_win * ρ_t + 2 * ρ_r
                ≤ cls.R_win * ρ_t + 2 * (cls.B_sys * ρ_t) := by linarith only [hρ_le_B_full]
              _ = (cls.R_win + 2 * cls.B_sys) * ρ_t := by ring
              _ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [hC_cut_vel]) hρ_t_pos.le
          exact h_cc.trans hv.le
      change ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v) -
        pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
        C_tr M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt E_f
      rw [h_diff_S]
      exact (h_tr M_tr hM_tr Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_sys ρ_r ρ_t s_c s_v C_r C_t R_tr E_f
        X_J V_o X_o hlam_pos hρ_r_pos hρ_r_le1 hρ_t_pos hρ_le_Bρt hρ_t_le_sv hs_v_le1
        hs_c_pos hs_c_le1 hC_r_Icc hC_t_Icc hCt_Cr_abs h_chirp_hi hR_tr hf_pos.le hXo_XJ
        ψ_o hψ_o_smooth hψ_o_supp hψ_o_deriv X_ex hX_mode).2
        F_far (fun q => c_lin q.1 q.2) h_far_energy h_far_sep
  · 
    intro S
    obtain ⟨hS_meas, hS_l2, hS_4⟩ := h_T_synth S
    refine ⟨hS_meas, hS_l2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc ∫ v, ‖∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v‖ ^ 2
          ≤ 4 * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 := hS_4
        _ ≤ C_Bes * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_Bes_4
              (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
    · intro R'_dom hR'_dom
      obtain ⟨h_tot_bes, h_cap_bes⟩ :=
        h_loc Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase ε lam_sys ρ_r s_v m_r q_r V_J X_J
          hε_pos hlam_pos hρ_r_pos hρ_r_le1 hs_v_pos hs_v_le1 hq_r
          h_chirp_lo h_chirp_hi (by linarith only [hlam_loc_ge4])
          N_atom o_atom ψ_atom c_atom h_win_all h_mult_nat h_T_synth S R'_dom hR'_dom
      refine ⟨h_tot_bes, ?_⟩
      intro b_F a_F R_cap M_cap e_F V_F X_F F_sites hR_cap hM_cap he_F hF_sub hF_cap
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      exact h_cap_bes C_cut b_F a_F R_cap M_cap e_F V_F X_F F_sites
        hC_cut_104 hR_cap hM_cap he_F hF_sub hF_cap _
        (Finset.filter_subset _ S)
        (fun α hα hcond => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hα, hcond⟩)

noncomputable def cutLinearCoeff (lam_sys ρ_r C_r : ℝ)
    (X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (j n : ℤ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let V_j := gridPt2D ρ_r j
  ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ)) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
    f v * (pktPou2D (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I *
        ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_J, v) -

  let V_j := gridPt2D ρ_r j

    Complex.exp (Complex.I *
      ((-lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_J, v) +
        (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

noncomputable def cutPacketWindow (lam_sys ρ_r C_r : ℝ)

      ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_r, X_J, V_j + ρ_r • z) - Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, V_j + ρ_r • z)) -
        (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) z : ℝ) : ℂ))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ C_χ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_χ ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) ∧
      (∀ (lam_sys R_dom : ℝ), 1 ≤ lam_sys → 1 ≤ R_dom →
        ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
          Continuous Φ₀ →
        ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
