      exact ⟨hT.1, hT.2.1, le_trans hT.2.2 h_dual_s⟩
    obtain ⟨hh_Q_meas, hh_Q_sq, hh_Q_l2⟩ :=
      (h_bes_syn Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_loc s (1 / 2)
        hlam hs (le_trans hsρ hρ1) ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
        N_Q V_T X_T η_T
        (fun T => ⟨(hT_reg T).1, (hT_reg T).2.1, (hT_reg T).2.2.1⟩)
        hT_pack_syn).1 c_T
    let w_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
      fun o => ⇑Complex.conjLIE ∘ ψ_O o
    have hw_O_reg : ∀ o : Fin N_obs,
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (w_O o)) ∧
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → w_O o z = 0) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (w_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) := by
      intro o
      refine ⟨fun k => Complex.conjLIE.contDiff.comp ((hO_reg o).1 k), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz
        dsimp [w_O]
        rw [(hO_reg o).2.1 z hz]
        exact map_zero Complex.conjLIE
      · intro k z
        dsimp [w_O]
        rw [Complex.conjLIE.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (ψ_O o) z k]
        exact (hO_reg o).2.2.1 k z
    have hO_pack_ana :
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_obs =>
            ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹)).card : ℝ) ≤
            (N_mult : ℝ) := hO_pack
    have h_ana := (h_bes_ana Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_loc ρ c_end
      hlam hρ hρ1 hc_end N_obs V_O X_O w_O hw_O_reg hO_pack_ana).2
      h_Q hh_Q_meas hh_Q_sq
    have hm_obs_eq : ∀ o : Fin N_obs,
        m_obs o =
          ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), h_Q v *
            star ((ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * w_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro o
      dsimp only [m_obs, w_O, Function.comp_apply]
      have h_int : (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => h_Q v *
            star ((ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * Complex.conjLIE (ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o))) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))) =
          (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            (h_Q v * ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) := by
        ext v
        simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.conjLIE_apply, map_mul, map_inv₀,
          Complex.conj_ofReal, RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply,
          ← Complex.exp_conj, map_neg, Complex.conj_I, neg_mul, neg_neg]
        ring
      rw [h_int, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    have h_sum_eq : ∑ o : Fin N_obs, m_obs o =
        ∑ o : Fin N_obs,
          ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), h_Q v *
            star ((ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * w_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))‖ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => hm_obs_eq o)
    calc ∑ o : Fin N_obs, m_obs o
        ≤ C_ana * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h_Q v‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [h_sum_eq]
          exact h_ana
      _ ≤ C_ana * (C_syn * ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh_Q_l2 (by linarith)
      _ = (C_ana * C_syn) * ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ C_coh * ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_ana_syn_le hc_sum_nn
  · intro x_Z S_Z hS_Z
    have hΦ₀_cont : Continuous Φ₀ := (h_phase.1 0).continuous
    have hη_cont : ∀ T : Fin N_Q, Continuous (η_T T) :=
      fun T => ((hT_reg T).1 0).continuous
    have hη_max : ∀ T : Fin N_Q, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖η_T T z‖ ≤ max (M_atom 0) 1 := by
      intro T z
      calc ‖η_T T z‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (η_T T) z‖ := (norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero).symm
        _ ≤ M_atom 0 := (hT_reg T).2.2.1 0 z
        _ ≤ max (M_atom 0) 1 := le_max_left _ _
    have hψ_cont : ∀ o : Fin N_obs, Continuous (ψ_O o) :=
      fun o => ((hO_reg o).1 0).continuous
    have hψ_max : ∀ o : Fin N_obs, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖ψ_O o z‖ ≤ max (M_win 0) 1 := by
      intro o z
      calc ‖ψ_O o z‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (ψ_O o) z‖ := (norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero).symm
        _ ≤ M_win 0 := (hO_reg o).2.2.1 0 z
        _ ≤ max (M_win 0) 1 := le_max_left _ _
    rcases hd_dim with rfl | rfl
    · let W_b : Fin K → Finset (Fin N_Q) :=
        fun b => Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q => bin_of T = b)
      let g_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun T v =>
        (s⁻¹ : ℂ) * η_T T (s⁻¹ • (v - V_T T)) *
          Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_T T, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      let h_Wb : Fin K → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
        fun b v => ∑ T ∈ W_b b, c_T T * g_T T v
      let I_Wb : Fin K → Fin N_obs → ℂ := fun b o =>
        (ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          h_Wb b v * ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have hg_cont : ∀ T : Fin N_Q, Continuous (g_T T) := by
        intro T
        dsimp only [g_T]
        refine (continuous_const.mul ((hη_cont T).comp
          ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).const_smul s⁻¹))).mul ?_
        refine Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Continuous.neg (continuous_const.mul ?_))
        exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (hΦ₀_cont.comp
            (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))))
      have hh_Wb_cont : ∀ b : Fin K, Continuous (h_Wb b) := by
        intro b
        exact continuous_finsetSum (W_b b) (fun T _ => continuous_const.mul (hg_cont T))
      have h_Q_split : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          h_Q v = ∑ b : Fin K, h_Wb b v := by
        intro v
        dsimp only [h_Q, h_Wb, g_T, W_b]
        exact (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
          (fun T _ => Finset.mem_univ (bin_of T)) _).symm
      have hm_obs_le : ∀ o ∈ S_Z,
          m_obs o ≤ (K : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin K, ‖I_Wb b o‖ ^ 2 := by
        intro o _
        let F_bo : Fin K → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun b v =>
          h_Wb b v * ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        have hF_int : ∀ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)),
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (F_bo b) MeasureTheory.volume := by
          intro b _
          have hF_cont : Continuous (F_bo b) := by
            dsimp only [F_bo]
            refine ((hh_Wb_cont b).mul ((hψ_cont o).comp
              ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).const_smul ρ⁻¹))).mul ?_
            refine Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul ?_)
            exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
              (continuous_const.mul (hΦ₀_cont.comp
                (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))))
          have hF_supp : HasCompactSupport (F_bo b) := by
            refine HasCompactSupport.intro
              (isCompact_closedBall (V_O o) (R_win * ρ)) (fun v hv => ?_)
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, not_le] at hv
            have h_norm : R_win ≤ ‖ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ.le)]
              exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hρ).mpr (by linarith [hv.le])
            dsimp only [F_bo]
            rw [(hO_reg o).2.1 _ h_norm]
            simp
          exact hF_cont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hF_supp
        have h_int_eq : (ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            h_Q v * ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
            ∑ b : Fin K, I_Wb b o := by
          have h_fn : (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
              h_Q v * ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
              (fun v => ∑ b : Fin K, F_bo b v) := by
            ext v
            rw [h_Q_split v, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
          rw [h_fn, MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum Finset.univ hF_int, Finset.mul_sum]
        have h_norm_le : ‖∑ b : Fin K, I_Wb b o‖ ≤ ∑ b : Fin K, ‖I_Wb b o‖ :=
          norm_sum_le Finset.univ (fun b => I_Wb b o)
        have h_sq_le : ‖∑ b : Fin K, I_Wb b o‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ b : Fin K, ‖I_Wb b o‖) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_norm_le 2
        have h_cs : (∑ b : Fin K, ‖I_Wb b o‖) ^ 2 ≤
            ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).card : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin K, ‖I_Wb b o‖ ^ 2 :=
          sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
        simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h_cs
        dsimp only [m_obs]
        rw [h_int_eq]
        exact le_trans h_sq_le h_cs
      have h_bin_est : ∀ b : Fin K,
          ∑ o ∈ S_Z, ‖I_Wb b o‖ ^ 2 ≤
            (C_dec * C_tan * C_box) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) * ∑ T ∈ W_b b, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 := by
        intro b
        have hW_norm_loc : ∀ T₁ ∈ W_b b, ∀ T₂ ∈ W_b b,
            |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P| ≤ B_cell * s := by
          intro T₁ hT₁ T₂ hT₂
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hT₁ hT₂
          exact (h_bin_loc T₁ T₂ (hT₁.2.trans hT₂.2.symm)).1 rfl
        have hW_fib :
            letI := Classical.propDecidable
            ∀ m : ℤ,
              (((W_b b).filter (fun T =>
                Int.floor (inner ℝ (V_T T - V_P) (perp2D n_P) / s) = m)).card : ℝ) ≤
                C_box * R ^ 2 :=
          h_tan_fib s c_end R hs hc_end hR V_P X_Q n_P hn_P N_Q V_T X_T (W_b b)
            (fun T _ => (hT_reg T).2.2.2.2) hT_pack hW_norm_loc
        have hM_fib_nn : 0 ≤ C_box * R ^ 2 := by positivity
        let M_strip : ℝ :=
          C_tan * (C_box * R ^ 2) * (s / ρ) * ∑ T ∈ W_b b, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2
        have hM_strip_nn : 0 ≤ M_strip := by
          dsimp [M_strip]
          have h_sum_w : 0 ≤ ∑ T ∈ W_b b, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 :=
            Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
          have hC_tan_nn : 0 ≤ C_tan := by linarith
          have hsρ_nn : 0 ≤ s / ρ := div_nonneg hs.le hρ.le
          positivity
        have h_mod_bound :=
          h_tan Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_loc ρ s c_end (C_box * R ^ 2)
            hlam hs hsρ hρ1 hlam_lo hlam_hi hc_end hM_fib_nn
            V_P x_Z n_P hn_P N_Q V_T X_T η_T c_T (W_b b)
            ⟨fun T _ => ⟨hη_cont T, (hT_reg T).2.1, hη_max T⟩, hW_norm_loc, hW_fib⟩
        have hh_Wb_supp : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            (B_cell + 4) * ρ ≤ ‖v - V_P‖ → h_Wb b v = 0 := by
          intro v hv
          dsimp only [h_Wb, g_T]
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun T _ => ?_)
          have hVT : ‖V_T T - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ := (hT_reg T).2.2.2.1
          have h_tri : ‖v - V_P‖ ≤ ‖v - V_T T‖ + ‖V_T T - V_P‖ := by
            have h_eq : v - V_P = (v - V_T T) + (V_T T - V_P) := by abel
            rw [h_eq]
            exact norm_add_le _ _
          have h4s : 4 * s ≤ ‖v - V_T T‖ := by nlinarith
          have h4 : 4 ≤ ‖s⁻¹ • (v - V_T T)‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hs.le)]
            exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hs).mpr (by linarith [h4s])
          rw [(hT_reg T).2.1 _ h4]
          simp
        have h_dec_app :=
          h_dec Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_loc ρ s c_end
            hlam hs hsρ hρ1 hlam_lo hlam_hi hc_end
            V_P x_Z n_P hn_P N_obs V_O X_O ψ_O S_Z
            ⟨hO_reg, hO_pack, fun o ho => (hS_Z o ho).1 rfl⟩
            (h_Wb b) M_strip (hh_Wb_cont b) hh_Wb_supp hM_strip_nn
            (fun μ_mod hμ_cont hμ_le => h_mod_bound μ_mod hμ_cont hμ_le)
        calc ∑ o ∈ S_Z, ‖I_Wb b o‖ ^ 2
            ≤ C_dec * M_strip := h_dec_app
          _ = (C_dec * C_tan * C_box) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) * ∑ T ∈ W_b b, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 := by
              dsimp [M_strip]
              ring
      have h_fib_c : ∑ b : Fin K, ∑ T ∈ W_b b, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 = ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun T _ => Finset.mem_univ (bin_of T)) _
      have h_factor_nn : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 1 * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) := by
        have hsρ_nn : 0 ≤ s / ρ := div_nonneg hs.le hρ.le
        positivity
      calc ∑ o ∈ S_Z, m_obs o
          ≤ ∑ o ∈ S_Z, (K : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin K, ‖I_Wb b o‖ ^ 2 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum hm_obs_le
        _ = (K : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin K, ∑ o ∈ S_Z, ‖I_Wb b o‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm]
        _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin K,
              ((C_dec * C_tan * C_box) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) * ∑ T ∈ W_b b, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => h_bin_est b)) ?_
            positivity
        _ = (C_dec * C_tan * C_box) * ((K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 1 *
              (∑ b : Fin K, ∑ T ∈ W_b b, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2)) := by
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
            ring
        _ = (C_dec * C_tan * C_box) * (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 1 *
              (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) := by
            rw [h_fib_c]
            ring
        _ ≤ C_coh * (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 1 * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) := by
            nlinarith [hC_prod_le, h_factor_nn]
    · have h_c2 := h_cell2 Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont lam_loc ρ s c_end R
        hlam hs hsρ hc_end hR V_P X_Q x_Z N_Q K N_obs hK
        V_T X_T η_T c_T bin_of V_O X_O ψ_O S_Z
        ⟨fun T => ⟨hη_cont T, (hT_reg T).2.1, hη_max T, (hT_reg T).2.2.2.2⟩,
         hT_pack,
         fun T₁ T₂ hbin => (h_bin_loc T₁ T₂ hbin).2 rfl,
         fun o ho => ⟨hψ_cont o, (hO_reg o).2.1, hψ_max o,
           (hO_reg o).2.2.2, (hS_Z o ho).2 rfl⟩,
         hO_pack⟩
      have h_factor_nn : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 2 * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) := by
        positivity
      calc ∑ o ∈ S_Z, m_obs o
          ≤ C_box * (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 2 * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) := h_c2
        _ ≤ C_coh * (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 2 * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) := by
            nlinarith [hC_box_le, h_factor_nn]

subgoal_signatures.name: equal_time_packed_wave_packet_bessel
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_w : ℝ) (N_pack : ℕ) (M_w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hRw : 2 ≤ R_w) (hN_pack : 1 ≤ N_pack) :
    ∃ C_Bes : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam ρ₀ c₀ : ℝ),
        0 < lam → 0 < ρ₀ → ρ₀ ≤ 1 → c₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (V X : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (w : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ α : Fin N, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (w α)) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_w ≤ ‖z‖ → w α z = 0) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (w α) z‖ ≤ M_w k)) →
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let σ₀ := (lam * ρ₀)⁻¹
         ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N =>
             ‖V α - v₀‖ ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ‖X α - x₀‖ ≤ σ₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_pack : ℝ)) →
        let φ := fun (α : Fin N) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * w α (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V α)) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (c₀, X α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        (∀ c : Fin N → ℂ,
          let H := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ∑ α : Fin N, c α * φ α v
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖H v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖H v‖ ^ 2 ≤
            C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N, ‖c α‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          ∑ α : Fin N, ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), h v * star (φ α v)‖ ^ 2 ≤
            C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: box_packing_and_isotropic_cell_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(B_cell R_win : ℝ) (N_mult M_mult : ℕ) (M_atom M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB : 2 ≤ B_cell) (hRw : 2 ≤ R_win) (hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) :
    (letI := Classical.propDecidable
     ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (N_Q : ℕ) (V_T X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
       (∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
         ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
           ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) →
       ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
         ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
           ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ B_cell * s)).card : ℝ) ≤
           (((2 * ⌈B_cell⌉₊ + 1) ^ 2 * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ)) ∧
    ∃ C_box : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_box ∧

  let u_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := PiLp.single 2 (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)

  have h_ell_pos : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [one_lt_inv₀ hε₀]
    linarith

  have h_floor_step : ∀ {ε r : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < r →
      let m_r := Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
      ε ^ r ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ∧ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ r := by
    intro ε r hε₀ hε₁ hr m_r
    have hell : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    let x : ℝ := r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2
    have hx_nn : 0 ≤ x := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr.le hell.le) hlog2.le
    have h2x : (2 : ℝ) ^ x = (ε ^ r)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      have hmul : Real.log 2 * x = Real.log (ε⁻¹) * r := by
        dsimp only [x]
        rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hlog2.ne', mul_comm]
      rw [hmul, ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hε₀), Real.inv_rpow hε₀.le]
    have hfl_le : (m_r : ℝ) ≤ x := Nat.floor_le hx_nn
    have hlt_fl : x < (m_r : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one x
    have hpow_mr : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_r : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_natCast 2 m_r).symm
    have hεr_pos : 0 < ε ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ r
    have h2mr_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r := by positivity
    constructor
    · have h1 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r : ℝ) ≤ (ε ^ r)⁻¹ := by
        rw [hpow_mr, ← h2x]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hfl_le
      exact (le_inv_comm₀ hεr_pos h2mr_pos).mpr h1
    · have h2 : (ε ^ r)⁻¹ < 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r : ℝ) := by
        calc (ε ^ r)⁻¹ = (2 : ℝ) ^ x := h2x.symm
          _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((m_r : ℝ) + 1) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) hlt_fl
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_r : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_add (by norm_num) _ _
          _ = 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_one, ← hpow_mr]; ring
      have h3 : (2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ r := by
        have hlt := (inv_lt_inv₀ (by positivity) (inv_pos.mpr hεr_pos)).mpr h2
        rw [inv_inv] at hlt
        exact hlt.le
      calc ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ = 2 * (2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
            rw [mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_mul]
        _ ≤ 2 * ε ^ r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by norm_num)

  have h_mr_le_mt_floor : ∀ {ε r t : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → r ≤ t →
      Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) ≤
        Nat.floor (t * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := by
    intro ε r t hε₀ hε₁ hrt
    have hell : 0 ≤ Real.log (ε⁻¹) := (h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁).le
    have hlog2 : 0 ≤ (Real.log 2)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)).le
    apply Nat.floor_mono
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrt hell) hlog2

  have h_mr_le_mt_bound : ∀ {ε r t d B : ℝ} {m_t : ℕ},
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < r → 0 < d → d ≤ t - r → 1 ≤ B →
      ε < ((2 * B)⁻¹) ^ (d⁻¹) → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ B * ε ^ t →
      Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) ≤ m_t := by
    intro ε r t d B m_t hε₀ hε₁ hr hd hdrt hB hε_lt hmt
    let m_r := Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
    have hfl := (h_floor_step hε₀ hε₁ hr).1
    have h2B_pos : 0 < (2 * B)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have h_ed : ε ^ d < (2 * B)⁻¹ := by
      have h1 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hε₀.le hε_lt hd
      rwa [← Real.rpow_mul h2B_pos.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd.ne', Real.rpow_one] at h1
    have h_etr : ε ^ (t - r) ≤ ε ^ d :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ (by linarith) hdrt
    have h_εr_pos : 0 < ε ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ r
    have h_Bt : B * ε ^ t < ε ^ r := by
      have ht_eq : ε ^ t = ε ^ (t - r) * ε ^ r := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]; ring_nf
      rw [ht_eq]
      have h_prod : B * ε ^ (t - r) < 1 / 2 := by
        have hle : B * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ B * ε ^ d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_etr (by linarith)
        have hlt : B * ε ^ d < B * (2 * B)⁻¹ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_ed (by linarith)
        have heq : B * (2 * B)⁻¹ = 1 / 2 := by
          have hB0 : B ≠ 0 := by linarith
          rw [mul_inv, mul_comm (2 : ℝ)⁻¹, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hB0, one_mul]
          norm_num
        linarith
      nlinarith
    have h_pow_lt : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ < ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt hmt (lt_of_lt_of_le h_Bt hfl)
    have h2mr : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r : ℝ) < ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t : ℝ) :=
      (inv_lt_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mp h_pow_lt
    by_contra hnot
    have hge : m_t ≤ m_r := (Nat.lt_of_not_le hnot).le
    have hle_pow : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.zero_lt_two hge
    linarith

  have h_log_div_ell : ∀ {ε A δ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < δ →
      ε < (Real.exp ((A + 1) / δ))⁻¹ → A / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ δ := by
    intro ε A δ hε₀ hε₁ hδ hε_lt
    have hell : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp ((A + 1) / δ) := Real.exp_pos _
    have h_inv : Real.exp ((A + 1) / δ) < ε⁻¹ := (lt_inv_comm₀ hε₀ hexp_pos).mp hε_lt
    have h_log : (A + 1) / δ < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      have h1 := Real.log_lt_log hexp_pos h_inv
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at h1
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hell]
    have h2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp h_log
    linarith

  have h_rpow_le_half : ∀ {ε ζ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 0 < ζ →

    intro ε ζ hε₀ hζ hε_lt
    have h1 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hε₀.le hε_lt hζ
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2), inv_mul_cancel₀ hζ.ne',

  have h_win_floor : ∀ {ε A₀ m_sub : ℝ} {S : ℕ},

      ε ^ A₀ ≤ 4 * ((S : ℝ) ^ 2) * m_sub →

    have hS_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (S : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hS)
    have h_le1 : Real.log (S : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((ε⁻¹) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) := by
      rw [Real.log_rpow (inv_pos.mpr hε₀)]
      have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ hell).mp hlogS

    have hS_le : (S : ℝ) ≤ (ε⁻¹) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) :=

    have hS_sq : (S : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ε⁻¹ := by
      have hsq : ((S : ℝ) ^ 2) = (S : ℝ) * (S : ℝ) := sq _
      have h_rpow_sq : (ε⁻¹) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * (ε⁻¹) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) = ε⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add (inv_pos.mpr hε₀)]; norm_num
      rw [hsq, ← h_rpow_sq]
      exact mul_le_mul hS_le hS_le hS_pos.le (Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr hε₀).le _)
    have h4_le : (4 : ℝ) ≤ ε⁻¹ := by rw [le_inv_comm₀ (by norm_num) hε₀]; linarith
    have h_prod : 4 * ((S : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ (ε⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      calc 4 * ((S : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ ε⁻¹ * ε⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul h4_le hS_sq (sq_nonneg _) (inv_pos.mpr hε₀).le

    have hm_nn : 0 ≤ m_sub := by

    have h_step : ε ^ A₀ ≤ (ε⁻¹) ^ 2 * m_sub :=

      _ ≤ ((ε⁻¹) ^ 2 * m_sub) * (ε ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_step (sq_nonneg _)

  have h_pi_sum : ∀ {N_O N_D N_J : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J),
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
      let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
        ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d

      (∀ (Q : Fin N_J → Prop),

        ∑ j : Fin N_J, if Q j then π_J j else 0) := by
    intro N_O N_D N_J p win_of hp_nn hp_sum π_J

    · intro j

      rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ win_of (fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d)]

    · intro Q
      have h1 : ∀ o : Fin N_O,

        intro o; split_ifs <;> simp

      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ win_of
        (fun o => if Q (win_of o) then (∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) else 0)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      by_cases hQ : Q j
      · simp only [hQ, ↓reduceIte]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o ho => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ho
        simp [ho.2, hQ]
      · simp only [hQ, ↓reduceIte]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ho
        simp [ho.2, hQ]

  have h_markov_compl : ∀ {N_J : ℕ} (π_J cost : Fin N_J → ℝ) (Q : Fin N_J → Prop)
      {B_tot thr : ℝ},

      (∀ j, 0 < π_J j → 0 ≤ cost j) →

      0 < thr → (∀ j, 0 < π_J j → ¬ Q j → thr ≤ cost j) →
      1 - B_tot / thr ≤ ∑ j : Fin N_J, if Q j then π_J j else 0 := by
    intro N_J π_J cost Q B_tot thr hπ_nn hπ_sum hcost_nn hcost_sum hthr hbad
    have h_bad_bound : thr * (∑ j : Fin N_J, if ¬ Q j then π_J j else 0) ≤ B_tot := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine le_trans ?_ hcost_sum
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
      by_cases hπ0 : π_J j = 0
      · simp [hπ0]
      · have hπ_pos : 0 < π_J j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn j) (Ne.symm hπ0)
        by_cases hQj : Q j
        · simp only [hQj, not_true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg hπ_pos.le (hcost_nn j hπ_pos)
        · simp only [hQj, not_false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
          have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbad j hπ_pos hQj) hπ_pos.le
          linarith
    have h_div : (∑ j : Fin N_J, if ¬ Q j then π_J j else 0) ≤ B_tot / thr := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hthr]; linarith
    have h_split : (∑ j : Fin N_J, if Q j then π_J j else 0) +
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, if ¬ Q j then π_J j else 0) = 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← hπ_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      by_cases hQj : Q j <;> simp [hQj]
    linarith

  have h_exists_active : ∀ {N_O N_D : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
      1 ≤ N_O ∧ ∃ (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D), 0 < p o d := by
    intro N_O N_D p hp_nn hp_sum
    have hex : ∃ (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D), 0 < p o d := by
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      have hzero : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 0 := by

  have h_cond_adm : ∀ {ε H_P L t B_sys R_win : ℝ} {N_mult : ℕ} {M_win : ℕ → ℝ}
      {lam_sys : ℝ} {m_t : ℕ}

      {N_O N_D N_J : ℕ}
      {r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ} {V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
      {ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ} {b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ}
      {r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ} {e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
      {p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ} (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J) (j : Fin N_J),
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
        N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
      let π_J := ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d

      let p_c := fun o d => if win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J then p o d / π_J else 0
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f

    intro ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D N_J
      r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p win_of j hadm π_J hπ_pos p_c
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, _, h9⟩ := hadm
    have hsupp : ∀ o d, 0 < p_c o d → win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p o d := by
      intro o d hpc
      dsimp [p_c] at hpc
      by_cases hw : win_of o = j
      · simp only [hw, hπ_pos, and_self, ↓reduceIte] at hpc
        exact ⟨hw, (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hπ_pos).mp hpc⟩
      · simp [hw] at hpc
    refine ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hsupp⟩
    · intro o d
      dsimp [p_c]
      split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (h7 o d) hπ_pos.le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have hsum_eq : (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_c o d) =
          (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) / π_J := by

        have h_flt : (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j),

          ∑ o : Fin N_O, if win_of o = j then (∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) / π_J else 0 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_filter]

        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
        by_cases hw : win_of o = j
        · simp [p_c, hw, hπ_pos, Finset.sum_div]
        · simp [p_c, hw]

      exact div_self hπ_pos.ne'
    · intro o d hpc

  have h_credit_mono : ∀ {ε H_P t h C_c : ℝ} {d_dim N_O N_D : ℕ}

  have h_site_geom : ∀ {ε H_P L t B_sys R_win : ℝ} {N_mult : ℕ} {M_win : ℕ → ℝ}

  have h_2d_bin : ∀ {N_O N_D N_g : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      {mesh : ℝ}, 0 < mesh → 1 ≤ N_g →
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
      (∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
        0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d < (N_g : ℝ) * mesh ∧ 0 ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d < (N_g : ℝ) * mesh) →
      let E : Fin (N_g * N_g) → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Prop := fun k _ d =>
        Nat.floor (b_D d / mesh) = k.1 / N_g ∧ Nat.floor (a_D d / mesh) = k.1 % N_g
      1 ≤ N_g * N_g ∧
      (∀ o d k₁ k₂, E k₁ o d → E k₂ o d → k₁ = k₂) ∧
      (1 ≤ ∑ k : Fin (N_g * N_g), ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, if E k o d then p o d else 0) ∧
      (∀ k o d, E k o d → 0 ≤ b_D d → 0 ≤ a_D d →
        ((k.1 / N_g : ℕ) : ℝ) * mesh ≤ b_D d ∧
        |b_D d - ((k.1 / N_g : ℕ) : ℝ) * mesh| ≤ mesh ∧
        |a_D d - ((k.1 % N_g : ℕ) : ℝ) * mesh| ≤ mesh) := by
    intro N_O N_D N_g p b_D a_D mesh hmesh hNg hp_nn hp_sum hdom E
    have hNg_pos : 0 < N_g := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hNg
    refine ⟨Nat.mul_le_mul hNg hNg, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro o d k₁ k₂ hk₁ hk₂
      ext
      have hdiv : k₁.1 / N_g = k₂.1 / N_g := hk₁.1.symm.trans hk₂.1
      have hmod : k₁.1 % N_g = k₂.1 % N_g := hk₁.2.symm.trans hk₂.2
      have hid1 := Nat.div_add_mod k₁.1 N_g
      have hid2 := Nat.div_add_mod k₂.1 N_g
      rw [← hid1, ← hid2, hdiv, hmod]
    · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h2 : (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ k : Fin (N_g * N_g), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          if E k o d then p o d else 0) =
        ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ k : Fin (N_g * N_g),
          if E k o d then p o d else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
      rw [h2, ← hp_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun o _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => ?_))
      by_cases hp0 : p o d = 0
      · simp [hp0]
      · have hp_pos : 0 < p o d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp_nn o d) (Ne.symm hp0)
        obtain ⟨hb0, hblt, ha0, halt⟩ := hdom o d hp_pos
        let ib := Nat.floor (b_D d / mesh)
        let ia := Nat.floor (a_D d / mesh)
        have hib : ib < N_g :=
          (Nat.floor_lt (div_nonneg hb0 hmesh.le)).mpr ((div_lt_iff₀ hmesh).mpr hblt)
        have hia : ia < N_g :=
          (Nat.floor_lt (div_nonneg ha0 hmesh.le)).mpr ((div_lt_iff₀ hmesh).mpr halt)
        have hk_lt : ib * N_g + ia < N_g * N_g := by
          calc ib * N_g + ia < ib * N_g + N_g := Nat.add_lt_add_left hia _
            _ = (ib + 1) * N_g := by ring
            _ ≤ N_g * N_g := Nat.mul_le_mul_right N_g hib
        let k₀ : Fin (N_g * N_g) := ⟨ib * N_g + ia, hk_lt⟩
        have hEk₀ : E k₀ o d := by
          dsimp [E, k₀]
          have hdiv : (ib * N_g + ia) / N_g = ib := by
            rw [Nat.mul_comm ib N_g, Nat.mul_add_div hNg_pos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hia, add_zero]
          have hmod : (ib * N_g + ia) % N_g = ia := by
            rw [Nat.mul_comm ib N_g, Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hia]
          exact ⟨hdiv.symm, hmod.symm⟩
        calc p o d = if E k₀ o d then p o d else 0 := by simp [hEk₀]
          _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin (N_g * N_g), if E k o d then p o d else 0 :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => if E k o d then p o d else 0)
              (fun k _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp_nn o d]) (Finset.mem_univ k₀)
    · intro k o d hEk hb0 ha0
      have h1 := Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hb0 hmesh.le)
      have h2 := (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (b_D d / mesh)).le
      have h3 := Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg ha0 hmesh.le)
      have h4 := (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (a_D d / mesh)).le
      rw [hEk.1] at h1 h2
      rw [hEk.2] at h3 h4
      have hb_lo : ((k.1 / N_g : ℕ) : ℝ) * mesh ≤ b_D d := (le_div_iff₀ hmesh).mp h1
      have hb_hi : b_D d ≤ (((k.1 / N_g : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * mesh := (div_le_iff₀ hmesh).mp h2
      have ha_lo : ((k.1 % N_g : ℕ) : ℝ) * mesh ≤ a_D d := (le_div_iff₀ hmesh).mp h3
      have ha_hi : a_D d ≤ (((k.1 % N_g : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * mesh := (div_le_iff₀ hmesh).mp h4
      refine ⟨hb_lo, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hb_lo, hb_hi, hmesh], by linarith only [hb_lo, hb_hi]⟩,
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [ha_lo, ha_hi, hmesh], by linarith only [ha_lo, ha_hi]⟩⟩

  have h_k_bin : ∀ {N_O N_D N_J S_k : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)

    let Δ_3 : ℝ := 6 * Δ_2 + 13 * δ_mod
    let α_3 : ℝ := α_2 + 2 * ζ_ret
    have hsc_3 : generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁ +
        quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_3 ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f₁ N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_3 := by
      refine le_trans ?_ hsc_3_raw
      have hl := h_logS_le le_rfl hS1_max
      have hΔ2_nn : 0 ≤ Δ_2 := by dsimp only [Δ_2, Δ_1]; positivity
      dsimp only [Δ_3]; linarith only [hl, hδt_le, hδ_mod_pos, hΔ2_nn]
    have hcred_3 : HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 2 N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p_3 k_f α_3 :=
      h_credit_mono hε₀ hε_h hadm_3.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
        (by dsimp only [α_3]; linarith only [h_ret_le le_rfl hS1_max (le_rfl : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4)])
        hcred_3_raw

    have hk_grid_2 : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ∃ m_k : ℕ, m_k < S_k ∧ (menu j).k_bin = (m_k : ℝ) * ξ := by
      intro j
      simpa [S_k] using ((hmenu_all j).2.2.2 rfl).1
    obtain ⟨hdisj_k, hcov_k⟩ :=
      h_k_bin p_3 win_of (fun j => (menu j).k_bin) hξ_pos hS_k_1
        hadm_3.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 hadm_3.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 hk_grid_2
    obtain ⟨b_k_sel, p_fin, hsupp_fin, hadm_fin, hsc_fin_raw, hcred_fin_raw⟩ :=
      (h_prep ε H_P L t h lam_sys m_t 2 N_O N_D Φ₀ ζ₀ f₁
        r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_3 Δ_3 k_f α_3
        hε_lt_prep le_rfl ht_L ht_HP henv₁ hf₁_norm hm_t1 hm_t2 hadm_3 hsc_3 hcred_3).2
        S_k _ 1 ζ_ret hS_k_1 hdisj_k zero_lt_one hcov_k hζ_ret_pos h_rpow_ret
    let k_next : ℝ := (b_k_sel.1 : ℝ) * ξ
    let Δ_fin : ℝ := 6 * Δ_3 + 13 * δ_mod
    let α_fin : ℝ := α_3 + 2 * ζ_ret
    have hSk_max : S_k ≤ S_max := le_max_left S_k 16
    have hsc_fin : generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁ +
        quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_fin ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f₁ N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_fin := by
      refine le_trans ?_ hsc_fin_raw
      have hl := h_logS_le hS_k_1 hSk_max
      have hΔ3_nn : 0 ≤ Δ_3 := by dsimp only [Δ_3, Δ_2, Δ_1]; positivity

    have hcred_fin : HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 2 N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p_fin k_f α_fin :=
      h_credit_mono hε₀ hε_h hadm_fin.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
        (by dsimp only [α_fin]; linarith only [h_ret_le hS_k_1 hSk_max (by norm_num : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1)])
        hcred_fin_raw
    have hk_next0 : 0 ≤ k_next := by positivity
    have hk_next_bound : k_next ≤ 2 * h + 3 * ξ := by
      have hlt_nat : b_k_sel.1 ≤ Nat.ceil (((2 : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 2 :=
        Nat.le_of_lt_succ b_k_sel.2
      have hle_real : (b_k_sel.1 : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.ceil (((2 : ℝ) * h) / ξ) : ℝ) + 2 := by
        exact_mod_cast hlt_nat
      have hceil_lt :=
        (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (a := ((2 : ℝ) * h) / ξ) (div_nonneg (by positivity) hξ_pos.le)).le
      have h1 : (b_k_sel.1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) * h) / ξ + 3 := by linarith only [hle_real, hceil_lt]
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hξ_pos.le
      have h3 : (((2 : ℝ) * h) / ξ + 3) * ξ = 2 * h + 3 * ξ := by
        rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ_pos.ne']
      dsimp only [k_next]; linarith only [h2, h3]
    have hk_next_cap : k_next ≤ (2 + ε_err) * h := by
      have hexp : (2 + ε_err) * h = 2 * h + ε_err * h := by ring
      have herr_pos : 0 < ε_err * h := mul_pos hε_err_pos hh_pos
      linarith only [hk_next_bound, hξ_err, hexp, herr_pos]
    have hk_next_3h : k_next ≤ 3 * h := by linarith only [hk_next_bound, hξ_h4, hh_pos]
    have hα_fin_nn : 0 ≤ α_fin := by dsimp only [α_fin, α_3, α_2, α_1]; positivity
    have hα_fin_le : α_fin ≤ (ε_err * h) / 256 := by
      dsimp only [α_fin, α_3, α_2, α_1, ζ_ret, α_cap]
      have herr_pos : 0 < ε_err * h := mul_pos hε_err_pos hh_pos
      linarith only [herr_pos]

    have h_if_r_pos : (if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)) =
        ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2) := if_neg hr_pos.ne'
    have hu_plus_h_Lr2 : ((H_P - t) / 2 - 0) + h ≤ L - r - 0 := by
      dsimp only [r] at hu_r_le_Lr ⊢; linarith only [hu_r_le_Lr, hh_pos]
    have h_rep_est := h_rep ε H_P L t 0 lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc
      Φ₀ ζ₀ f₁ τ_V τ_X n_dummy r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D
      N_ret_of menu win_of p_fin k_f α_fin k_next
      hε_lt_rep hr_pos ht_le1 ht_L ht_HP hNO_1 hNJ_1 hS_loc_1
      (by linarith only [hlog_S_loc, hR_bud_erep, he_rep_pos]) hcard_loc hn_dummy henv₁ hf₁_norm
      le_rfl (by linarith only [hu_t_ge]) hu_plus_h_Lr2 (fun _ => rfl) rfl hmr_le_mt hm_t1 hm_t2
      hk_f0 hα_fin_nn hk_next0 hk_next_3h hadm_fin hcred_fin
      (fun j => ⟨(hmenu_all j).1, by
        have h4 := ((hmenu_all j).2.2.2 rfl).2.2.2
        simp (config := { decide := false }) only [h_if_r_pos] at h4
        exact h4⟩)
      (fun o d hp_f => by
        obtain ⟨hk_eq, hp3⟩ := hsupp_fin o d hp_f
        have hp2 := (hsupp_3 o d hp3).2
        obtain ⟨hQbuf, _⟩ := hsupp_2 o d hp2
        obtain ⟨hb_iso, ha_iso⟩ := hiso_ba d
        have hw_o := hwin_all o
        have hm_le := hw_o.2
        rw [h_if_r_pos] at hm_le
        have ha_zero : |(H_P - t) / 2 - a_D d| ≤ ζ_sh := by
          rw [ha_iso, sub_self, abs_zero]; exact hζ_sh_pos.le
        refine ⟨hw_o.1, hk_eq, (hadm_fin.2.2.2.2.2.1 d).1,
          fun hd => Nat.noConfusion hd (fun h0 => Nat.noConfusion h0),
          ha_zero, fun _ => ⟨hb_iso, ha_iso⟩,
          fun hd => Nat.noConfusion hd (fun h0 => Nat.noConfusion h0),
          hQbuf, hfl_mass o, hm_le⟩)
    obtain ⟨d₀_f, d₂_f, d₃_f, hd₀_f, hd_nnf, hd₀_eqf, _, hd_sumf, hBr_f, _, _, hcut_f, _⟩ :=
      hcomp_p p_fin hadm_fin (fun _ d _ => (hadm_fin.2.2.2.2.2.1 d).1)
    let π_f := fun j : Fin N_J =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_fin o d
    have hπ_f := h_pi_sum p_fin win_of hadm_fin.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 hadm_fin.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    obtain ⟨hd1_nnf, _, _, hd01_lef⟩ := h_d1_sum_le hd₀_f hπ_f.1 hd_nnf hd_sumf
    have hΔ_fin_req : Δ_fin ≤ Δ_req := by
      dsimp only [Δ_fin, Δ_3, Δ_2, Δ_1]; linarith only [hδ_mod_req, hΔ_req_pos]
    rw [htr_2h] at hBr_f
    have hk_gain : k_f + (4 * quantumPacketRate γ - 2 * γ - ε_err) * h ≤ k_next := by
      have hexp1 : quantumPacketRate γ * (2 * h) = 2 * (quantumPacketRate γ * h) := by ring
      have hexp2 : (4 * quantumPacketRate γ - 2 * γ - ε_err) * h =
          4 * (quantumPacketRate γ * h) - 2 * (γ * h) - ε_err * h := by ring
      have herr_pos : 0 < ε_err * h := mul_pos hε_err_pos hh_pos
      linarith only [h_rep_est, hBr_f, hsc_fin, hα_fin_le, he_rep_err,
        hΔ_fin_req, hΔ_req_err, hR_bud_err, hexp1, hexp2, herr_pos]
    have h_g_sum_f : ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_f j * ((menu j).g_bin - 2 * ((H_P - r) / 2)) ≤ ζ_g := by
      calc ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_f j * ((menu j).g_bin - 2 * ((H_P - r) / 2))
          ≤ ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_f j * ζ_g := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
            by_cases h0 : π_f j = 0
            · simp [h0]
            · have hπj_pos : 0 < π_f j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_f.1 j) (Ne.symm h0)
              have hex : ∃ o d, win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p_fin o d := by
                by_contra hall
                push Not at hall
                have hz : π_f j = 0 := by
                  dsimp only [π_f]
                  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => ?_))
                  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ho
                  exact le_antisymm (hall o d ho.2) (hadm_fin.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 o d)
                linarith only [hπj_pos, hz]
              obtain ⟨o_j, d_j, hw_j, hpf_j⟩ := hex
              have hp3_j := (hsupp_fin o_j d_j hpf_j).2
              have hQg : Q_g j := by rw [← hw_j]; exact (hsupp_3 o_j d_j hp3_j).1
              dsimp only [Q_g] at hQg
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hQg]) hπj_pos.le
        _ = (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_f j) * ζ_g := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = ζ_g := by rw [hπ_f.2.1, one_mul]
    have h_st_next_f₁ : IsCutChainState γ (nextPacketClass M_atom cls) ε H_P L r h lam_sys
        4 2 Φ₀ f₁ δ_out k_next α_cap := by
      refine (hcut_f hr_pos δ_out k_next α_cap hα_pos hξ_α).2 rfl hu_r_le_Lr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩) ?_
      · intro j hπj
        have hex : ∃ o d, win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p_fin o d := by
          by_contra hall
          push Not at hall
          have hz : (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_fin o d) = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => ?_))
            rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ho
            exact le_antisymm (hall o d ho.2) (hadm_fin.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 o d)
          linarith only [hπj, hz]
        obtain ⟨o_j, d_j, hw_j, hpf_j⟩ := hex
        have hk_eq := (hsupp_fin o_j d_j hpf_j).1
        rwa [hw_j] at hk_eq
      · linarith only [hd₀_eqf, hd₀_f, hd1_nnf, hd01_lef, hsc_fin, h_g_sum_f, hζ_g_out,
          hΔ_fin_req, hΔ_req_out, hR_bud_out, hδ_out]
    refine ⟨k_next, hk_next0, hk_next_cap, hk_gain, ?_⟩
    exact (h_st₁ (nextPacketClass M_atom cls) r h 4 2 δ_out k_next α_cap).mp h_st_next_f₁

finite_entropy_cut_and_credit_repayment.definitions:
noncomputable def pktWeight (γ b a : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a

noncomputable def roundShift2D (s : ℝ) (τ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (Int.floor ((z 0 - τ 0) / s), Int.floor ((z 1 - τ 1) / s))

noncomputable def atomOutCell (ε H_P t r : ℝ)
    (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (q_r : ℕ) (v_at x_at : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
  (q_r,
   roundShift2D (ε ^ u_t) τ_V v_at,
   roundShift2D (ε ^ (r + u_t)) τ_X x_at)

noncomputable def fineOutCell (ε H_P t r : ℝ) (m_r m_t : ℕ)
    (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (r_idx : ℕ) (v x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  let q_r := r_idx / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
  atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v (x + (C_r - C_t) • v)

def coarseOfFineCell (M_L : ℕ) (p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  (p_c.1,
   (p_c.2.1.1 / (M_L : ℤ), p_c.2.1.2 / (M_L : ℤ)),
   (p_c.2.2.1 / (M_L : ℤ), p_c.2.2.2 / (M_L : ℤ)))

noncomputable def fineCellCenterV (s_Vf : ℝ) (τ_V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (k_V : ℤ × ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  τ_V + gridPt2D s_Vf k_V +
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_Vf)

noncomputable def fineCellCenterX (s_Xf : ℝ) (τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (k_X : ℤ × ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  τ_X + gridPt2D s_Xf k_X +
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_Xf)

noncomputable def fineVelBin (ε H_P t r : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ)
    (τ_V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (n_cell : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
  let u_r := (H_P - r) / 2
  let v_rel := v - fineCellCenterV (ε ^ u_t) τ_V p_c.2.1
  if d_dim = 1 then
    (Int.floor (inner ℝ v_rel (n_cell p_c) / (ε ^ u_r)), 0)
  else
    (Int.floor (v_rel 0 / (ε ^ u_r)), Int.floor (v_rel 1 / (ε ^ u_r)))

noncomputable def cutLocalizerIdx (ε b_star : ℝ) (m_r m_t : ℕ)
    (r_idx : ℕ) (v x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  let q_r := r_idx / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let s_v := ε ^ b_star
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
  (q_r,
   (Int.floor (v 0 / s_v + 1 / 2), Int.floor (v 1 / s_v + 1 / 2)),
   (Int.floor ((x 0 + (C_r - C_t) * v 0) / s_x + 1 / 2),
    Int.floor ((x 1 + (C_r - C_t) * v 1) / s_x + 1 / 2)))

structure LocalizerSubclass (N_ret : ℕ) where
  loc_idx : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)
  N_all : ℕ
  m_bin : ℝ
  g_bin : ℝ
  b_loc : ℝ
  a_loc : ℝ
  k_bin : ℝ
  is_aligned : Bool
  o_at : Fin N_ret → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)
  ψ_at : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ
  c_at : Fin N_ret → ℂ
  cap_id : Fin N_ret → ℕ
  e_cap : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  V_cap : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  X_cap : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

def IsValidSubclassAtoms (cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov : ℝ) (m_r m_t M_mult : ℕ)
    (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    {N_ret : ℕ} (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let q_r := sub.loc_idx.1
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let s_v := ε ^ b_star
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
  let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
  let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
  let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
  let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
  let W_max := min (L - r - b_star) ((H_P - r) / 2 - b_star)
  let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
  let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
  let V'_at := fun α => s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
  let X'_at := fun α => s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
  let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
    (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
      Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
  1 ≤ N_ret ∧ N_ret ≤ sub.N_all ∧ q_r < 2 ^ m_r ∧
  ‖V_J‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys ∧ ‖X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys ∧
  0 < sub.m_bin ∧ 0 ≤ sub.b_loc ∧ sub.b_loc ≤ sub.a_loc ∧ sub.a_loc ≤ W_max ∧
  (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
    (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (sub.ψ_at α)) ∧
    (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → sub.ψ_at α z = 0) ∧
    (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (sub.ψ_at α) z‖ ≤
      M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) ∧
    ‖V'_at α‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4 ∧
    ‖X'_at α‖ ≤ 8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10 ∧
    sub.m_bin ≤ ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ∧ ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin ∧
    ‖sub.e_cap α‖ = 1 ∧
    |inner ℝ (V'_at α - sub.V_cap α) (sub.e_cap α)| ≤ ε ^ sub.b_loc ∧
    |inner ℝ (V'_at α - sub.V_cap α) (perp2D (sub.e_cap α))| ≤ ε ^ sub.a_loc ∧
    |inner ℝ (X'_at α - sub.X_cap α) (sub.e_cap α)| ≤ ε ^ sub.b_loc ∧
    |inner ℝ (X'_at α - sub.X_cap α) (perp2D (sub.e_cap α))| ≤ ε ^ sub.a_loc ∧
    (∀ α' : Fin N_ret, sub.cap_id α = sub.cap_id α' →
      sub.e_cap α = sub.e_cap α' ∧ sub.V_cap α = sub.V_cap α' ∧ sub.X_cap α = sub.X_cap α')) ∧
  (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret => sub.o_at α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
  (((Finset.univ.image sub.cap_id).card : ℝ) ≤
    C_cov * (sub.N_all : ℝ) * ε ^ (sub.g_bin - pktWeight γ sub.b_loc sub.a_loc - 2 * ξ)) ∧
  (∀ (b_F a_F R_F : ℝ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    0 ≤ b_F → b_F ≤ a_F → a_F ≤ W_max → 1 ≤ R_F → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
      |inner ℝ (V'_at α - V_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
      |inner ℝ (V'_at α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F ∧
      |inner ℝ (X'_at α - X_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
      |inner ℝ (X'_at α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F)).card : ℝ) ≤
      C_cov * R_F ^ 4 * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin + pktWeight γ b_F a_F - 2 * ξ)) ∧
  (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
    let C_t := (((q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
    ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v →
      ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
      (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
      (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
      let pair_fn := fun h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ =>
        (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      ∀ (M_tr : ℕ) (R_tr : ℝ), 2 ≤ M_tr → 2 ≤ R_tr →
        let S_near := Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
          ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * ρ_t ∧
          ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * R_tr * σ_r)
        ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) -
         pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
          C_tr M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)))

noncomputable def subclassProxyA (ε : ℝ) {N_ret : ℕ} (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) : ℝ :=
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log sub.m_bin / ell) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sub.g_bin

noncomputable def subclassWinScore (γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    {N_O N_D : ℕ} (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    {N_ret : ℕ} (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret)
    (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let q_r := sub.loc_idx.1
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
  let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
  let h_sub := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
    ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
      ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
        Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
  generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_cond - b_star

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def pktWeight (γ b a : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a

noncomputable def roundShift2D (s : ℝ) (τ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (Int.floor ((z 0 - τ 0) / s), Int.floor ((z 1 - τ 1) / s))

noncomputable def atomOutCell (ε H_P t r : ℝ)
    (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (q_r : ℕ) (v_at x_at : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
  (q_r,
   roundShift2D (ε ^ u_t) τ_V v_at,
   roundShift2D (ε ^ (r + u_t)) τ_X x_at)

noncomputable def fineOutCell (ε H_P t r : ℝ) (m_r m_t : ℕ)
    (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (r_idx : ℕ) (v x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  let q_r := r_idx / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
  atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v (x + (C_r - C_t) • v)

def coarseOfFineCell (M_L : ℕ) (p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  (p_c.1,
   (p_c.2.1.1 / (M_L : ℤ), p_c.2.1.2 / (M_L : ℤ)),
   (p_c.2.2.1 / (M_L : ℤ), p_c.2.2.2 / (M_L : ℤ)))

noncomputable def fineCellCenterV (s_Vf : ℝ) (τ_V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (k_V : ℤ × ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  τ_V + gridPt2D s_Vf k_V +
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_Vf)

noncomputable def fineCellCenterX (s_Xf : ℝ) (τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (k_X : ℤ × ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  τ_X + gridPt2D s_Xf k_X +
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_Xf)

noncomputable def fineVelBin (ε H_P t r : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ)
    (τ_V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (n_cell : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
  let u_r := (H_P - r) / 2
  let v_rel := v - fineCellCenterV (ε ^ u_t) τ_V p_c.2.1
  if d_dim = 1 then
    (Int.floor (inner ℝ v_rel (n_cell p_c) / (ε ^ u_r)), 0)
  else
    (Int.floor (v_rel 0 / (ε ^ u_r)), Int.floor (v_rel 1 / (ε ^ u_r)))

noncomputable def cutLocalizerIdx (ε b_star : ℝ) (m_r m_t : ℕ)
    (r_idx : ℕ) (v x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  let q_r := r_idx / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let s_v := ε ^ b_star
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
  (q_r,
   (Int.floor (v 0 / s_v + 1 / 2), Int.floor (v 1 / s_v + 1 / 2)),
   (Int.floor ((x 0 + (C_r - C_t) * v 0) / s_x + 1 / 2),
    Int.floor ((x 1 + (C_r - C_t) * v 1) / s_x + 1 / 2)))

structure LocalizerSubclass (N_ret : ℕ) where
  loc_idx : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)
  N_all : ℕ
  m_bin : ℝ
  g_bin : ℝ
  b_loc : ℝ
  a_loc : ℝ
  k_bin : ℝ
  is_aligned : Bool
  o_at : Fin N_ret → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)
  ψ_at : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ
  c_at : Fin N_ret → ℂ
  cap_id : Fin N_ret → ℕ
  e_cap : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  V_cap : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  X_cap : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

def IsValidSubclassAtoms (cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov : ℝ) (m_r m_t M_mult : ℕ)
    (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    {N_ret : ℕ} (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let q_r := sub.loc_idx.1
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let s_v := ε ^ b_star
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
  let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
  let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
  let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
  let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
  let W_max := min (L - r - b_star) ((H_P - r) / 2 - b_star)
  let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
  let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
  let V'_at := fun α => s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
  let X'_at := fun α => s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
  let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
    (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
      Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
  1 ≤ N_ret ∧ N_ret ≤ sub.N_all ∧ q_r < 2 ^ m_r ∧
  ‖V_J‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys ∧ ‖X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys ∧
  0 < sub.m_bin ∧ 0 ≤ sub.b_loc ∧ sub.b_loc ≤ sub.a_loc ∧ sub.a_loc ≤ W_max ∧
  (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
    (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (sub.ψ_at α)) ∧
    (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → sub.ψ_at α z = 0) ∧
    (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (sub.ψ_at α) z‖ ≤
      M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) ∧
    ‖V'_at α‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4 ∧
    ‖X'_at α‖ ≤ 8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10 ∧
    sub.m_bin ≤ ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ∧ ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin ∧
    ‖sub.e_cap α‖ = 1 ∧
    |inner ℝ (V'_at α - sub.V_cap α) (sub.e_cap α)| ≤ ε ^ sub.b_loc ∧
    |inner ℝ (V'_at α - sub.V_cap α) (perp2D (sub.e_cap α))| ≤ ε ^ sub.a_loc ∧
    |inner ℝ (X'_at α - sub.X_cap α) (sub.e_cap α)| ≤ ε ^ sub.b_loc ∧
    |inner ℝ (X'_at α - sub.X_cap α) (perp2D (sub.e_cap α))| ≤ ε ^ sub.a_loc ∧
    (∀ α' : Fin N_ret, sub.cap_id α = sub.cap_id α' →
      sub.e_cap α = sub.e_cap α' ∧ sub.V_cap α = sub.V_cap α' ∧ sub.X_cap α = sub.X_cap α')) ∧
  (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret => sub.o_at α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
  (((Finset.univ.image sub.cap_id).card : ℝ) ≤
    C_cov * (sub.N_all : ℝ) * ε ^ (sub.g_bin - pktWeight γ sub.b_loc sub.a_loc - 2 * ξ)) ∧
  (∀ (b_F a_F R_F : ℝ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    0 ≤ b_F → b_F ≤ a_F → a_F ≤ W_max → 1 ≤ R_F → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
      |inner ℝ (V'_at α - V_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
      |inner ℝ (V'_at α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F ∧
      |inner ℝ (X'_at α - X_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
      |inner ℝ (X'_at α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F)).card : ℝ) ≤
      C_cov * R_F ^ 4 * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin + pktWeight γ b_F a_F - 2 * ξ)) ∧
  (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
    let C_t := (((q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
    ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v →
      ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
      (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
      (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
      let pair_fn := fun h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ =>
        (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      ∀ (M_tr : ℕ) (R_tr : ℝ), 2 ≤ M_tr → 2 ≤ R_tr →
        let S_near := Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
          ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * ρ_t ∧
          ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * R_tr * σ_r)
        ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) -
         pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
          C_tr M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)))

noncomputable def subclassProxyA (ε : ℝ) {N_ret : ℕ} (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) : ℝ :=
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log sub.m_bin / ell) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sub.g_bin

noncomputable def subclassWinScore (γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    {N_O N_D : ℕ} (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    {N_ret : ℕ} (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret)
    (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let q_r := sub.loc_idx.1
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
  let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
  let h_sub := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
    ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
      ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
        Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
  generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_cond - b_star

subgoal_signatures.name: endpoint_preparation_and_normal_prediction
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ)) :
    (∀ u v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → ‖w‖ = 1 →
      projAngleDist u v = projAngleDist v u ∧
      projAngleDist (perp2D u) (perp2D v) = projAngleDist u v ∧
      projAngleDist u w ≤ projAngleDist u v + projAngleDist v w ∧
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        projAngleDist u v * ‖z‖ ≤ |inner ℝ z u| + |inner ℝ z v|) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
      ∃ f₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f₁ ∧
        (∫ v, ‖f₁ v‖ ^ 2 = 1) ∧
        0 ≤ generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁ ∧
        (∀ ν κ : ℝ,
          HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ↔
          HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁) ∧
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (m_t N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
          (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          (IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
             lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ↔
           IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
             lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f₁ N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p) ∧
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f₁ N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p -
            generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁ =
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p -
            generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f) ∧
        (∀ (cls' : PacketBoundClass) (t h C_cell : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ) (δ_def k_cred α_cred : ℝ),
          IsCutChainState γ cls' ε H_P L t h lam_sys C_cell d_dim Φ₀ f₁ δ_def k_cred α_cred ↔
          IsCutChainState γ cls' ε H_P L t h lam_sys C_cell d_dim Φ₀ f δ_def k_cred α_cred)) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (t_min δ_mod : ℝ),
      0 < t_min → t_min ≤ cls.K_hor → 0 < δ_mod →
      ∃ ε_prep : ℝ, 0 < ε_prep ∧ ε_prep < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ) (m_t d_dim N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (Δ_cur k_f α_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_prep → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f → (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2 = 1) →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur ≤
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_f α_cur →
          let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
          let A₀ := 4 * cls.K_hor + 4
          (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t ≤ 1 / 4 →
            ∀ ζ_fl : ℝ, 0 < ζ_fl → ε ^ ζ_fl ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (N'_O : ℕ) (emb : Fin N'_O → Fin N_O) (p' : Fin N'_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              1 ≤ N'_O ∧ Function.Injective emb ∧
              (∀ o' d, 0 < p' o' d → 0 < p (emb o') d) ∧
              (∀ o' : Fin N'_O, ε ^ A₀ ≤
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  (r_O (emb o')) (V_O (emb o')) (X_O (emb o')) (ψ_O (emb o'))) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb)
                b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p' ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t - (4 * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t + 3 / ell) + δ_mod * t) ≤
                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D
                  (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb) b_D a_D p' ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N'_O N_D
                (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) e_D p' k_f
                (α_cur + ζ_fl + Real.log 4 / ell)) ∧
          (∀ (S_bins : ℕ) (E : Fin S_bins → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Prop) (p_union ζ_ret : ℝ),
            1 ≤ S_bins → (∀ o d, ∀ b₁ b₂, E b₁ o d → E b₂ o d → b₁ = b₂) →
            0 < p_union →
            (letI := Classical.propDecidable
             p_union ≤ ∑ b : Fin S_bins, ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
               if E b o d then p o d else 0) →
            0 < ζ_ret → ε ^ ζ_ret ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (b_sel : Fin S_bins) (p_sel : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              (∀ o d, 0 < p_sel o d → E b_sel o d ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_sel ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t -
                  ((4 / p_union) * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t +
                    (3 * Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2)) / (2 * ell)) + δ_mod * t) ≤
                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_sel ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p_sel k_f
                (α_cur + ζ_ret + Real.log (8 * (S_bins : ℝ) / p_union) / ell))) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (M_L : ℕ), 64 ≤ M_L →
      ∀ (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        0 < h → 2 * h < t → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        ∃ (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          let r := t - 2 * h
          let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
          let δ_buf := ((M_L : ℝ) / 32)
          3 / 4 ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              let q_r := r_O o / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
              let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
              let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
              ‖v' - V_O o‖ ≤ δ_buf * ε ^ u_t →
              ‖x' - (X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o)‖ ≤ δ_buf * ε ^ (r + u_t) →
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x'))
            then p o d else 0) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h e₀ ζ_sh δ_mod : ℝ) (M_L : ℕ),
      0 < h → 64 * h < γ * e₀ → 0 < ζ_sh → 64 * ζ_sh ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h →
      0 < δ_mod → 64 * δ_mod ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h → 64 ≤ M_L →
      ∃ ε_norm : ℝ, 0 < ε_norm ∧ ε_norm < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (b_ref a_ref Δ_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_norm → 2 * h < t → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          ε ^ (t - 2 * h) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ (t - 2 * h) →
          m_r ≤ m_t → cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          e₀ ≤ a_ref - b_ref → (H_P - t) / 2 - ζ_sh ≤ a_ref →
          (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh) →
          64 * Δ_cur ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h →
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur ≤
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          ∃ n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            letI := Classical.propDecidable
            (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) ∧
            3 / 4 ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              if projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d))
                   (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L
                     (fineOutCell ε H_P t (t - 2 * h) m_r m_t τ_V τ_X
                       (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)))) ≤ ε ^ (4 * h)
              then p o d else 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: greedy_cap_menu_and_packet_composition
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hβ_pos : 0 < quantumPacketRate γ) (hβ_le : quantumPacketRate γ ≤ 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ))
    (h_cut : PacketCutDecompositionValid M_atom) :
    ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u t_rem_min A₀ ξ η R_bud : ℝ)
      (use_vel_sub : Bool) (d_dim : ℕ),
      0 < Δ_u → 0 ≤ t_rem_min → t_rem_min ≤ cls.K_hor →
      0 < A₀ → 0 < ξ → 0 < η → 4 * η ≤ Δ_u →
      128 * (η + ξ) ≤ R_bud → (d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2) →
      ∃ (C_cov : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ) (ε_comp : ℝ),
        2 ≤ C_cov ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧ (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) ∧ 0 < ε_comp ∧ ε_comp < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (M_L : ℕ) (ε H_P L t r h b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          1 ≤ M_L → ε < ε_comp → 1 ≤ N_O → (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f → (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2 = 1) →
          0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P → t_rem_min ≤ t - r →
          (use_vel_sub = true → 0 < h ∧ r = t - 2 * h) →
          0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ L - t → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 → Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
          ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
           (0 < r ∧ m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2))) →
          m_r ≤ m_t →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_t ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ cls.B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ cls.B_sys ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧
            (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
            (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) ∧
            ε ^ A₀ ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) →
          (∀ (r_i : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
              r_O o = r_i ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) ∧
                ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ (lam_sys * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2))⁻¹)).card : ℝ) ≤
              (cls.N_mult : ℝ)) →
          ∃ (N_J S_per_loc : ℕ) (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
            (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
            (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J),
            let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
            let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
            let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
            let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
            1 ≤ N_J ∧ 1 ≤ S_per_loc ∧
            Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell ≤ R_bud / 32 ∧
            (∀ j₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N_J =>
              (menu j).loc_idx = j₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (S_per_loc : ℝ)) ∧
            (∀ j : Fin N_J,
              IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
                m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ (menu j) ∧
              2 * min (L - r - b_star) ((H_P - r) / 2 - b_star) - R_bud ≤ (menu j).g_bin ∧
              (use_vel_sub = false → N_ret_of j = (menu j).N_all) ∧
              (use_vel_sub = true →
                (∃ m_k : ℕ, m_k < Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3 ∧
                  (menu j).k_bin = (m_k : ℝ) * ξ) ∧
                (d_dim = 1 → ∀ α : Fin (N_ret_of j),
                  let p_c := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2)
                  ((menu j).is_aligned = true ↔
                    projAngleDist (perp2D ((menu j).e_cap α)) (n_fine p_c) ≤ 2 * ε ^ h)) ∧
                (∀ p_c w,
                  ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
                    let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2)
                    p_at = p_c ∧
                    fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) = w)).card : ℝ) ≤
                  ε ^ ((menu j).k_bin - ξ) *
                    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
                      atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                        (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2) =
                        p_c)).card : ℝ)) ∧
                (∀ p_buf,
                  (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
                    let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2)
                    (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1)))).filter
                      (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
                  ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-((menu j).k_bin + ξ))))) ∧
            (∀ o : Fin N_O,
              let j := win_of o
              (menu j).loc_idx = cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) ∧
              (let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
               let C_r := (((menu j).loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
               let h_j := fun v => ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), (menu j).c_at α *
                 ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star ((menu j).ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1))) *
                   Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
                 4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                   generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_j (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) ∧
            (∀ (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
              (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → b_star ≤ b_D d) →
              letI := Classical.propDecidable
              let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
                ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
              let p_cond := fun (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) =>
                if win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j then p o d / π_J j else 0
              let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
              let d₁ := fun j : Fin N_J =>
                Real.log (((menu j).N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret_of j : ℝ)) / ell
              let A_of := fun j : Fin N_J => subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
              let P_of := fun j : Fin N_J =>
                subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
                  r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (menu j) (p_cond j)
              let B_r := H_J + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * A_of j
              let K_r_star := B_r + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * d₁ j
              let K₀ := generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f
              let P_t := generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p
              ∃ (d₀ : ℝ) (d₂ d₃ : Fin N_J → ℝ),
                0 ≤ d₀ ∧ (∀ j, 0 < π_J j → 0 ≤ d₁ j ∧ 0 ≤ d₂ j ∧ 0 ≤ d₃ j) ∧
                d₀ = K₀ + quantumPacketRate γ * r - K_r_star + 2 * R_bud ∧
                (∀ j, 0 < π_J j →
                  d₂ j + d₃ j = A_of j + quantumPacketRate γ * (t - r) - P_of j + 2 * R_bud) ∧
                d₀ + (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (d₁ j + d₂ j + d₃ j)) ≤
                  (K₀ + quantumPacketRate γ * t - P_t) + 5 * R_bud ∧
                B_r + quantumPacketRate γ * (t - r) - P_t ≤
                  (K₀ + quantumPacketRate γ * t - P_t) + 2 * R_bud ∧
                (0 < r → b_star = 0 → (H_P - r) / 2 ≤ L - r → t_rem_min ≤ t - r →
                  ∀ (ζ_g ν_l κ_l τ_no : ℝ),
                    0 < ζ_g → 32 * R_bud ≤ ζ_g → ν_l = ζ_g / 16 → κ_l = ζ_g / 4 → 0 < τ_no →
                    LocalNonForcedAtScale γ (localRescaledClass cls (t - r))
                      (t - r) ν_l κ_l τ_no ε →
                    ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_J j → d₂ j ≤ ζ_g / 8 → d₃ j ≤ τ_no →
                      (menu j).g_bin ≤ 2 * ((H_P - r) / 2) + ζ_g) ∧
                (0 < r → t_rem_min ≤ t - r →
                  ∃ (N'_O : ℕ) (r'_O : Fin N'_O → ℕ) (V'_O X'_O : Fin N'_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                    (ψ'_O : Fin N'_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
                    (N_allD : ℕ) (j_of_D : Fin N_allD → Fin N_J)
                    (b_all a_all : Fin N_allD → ℝ) (r_all : Fin N_allD → ℕ)
                    (e_all V_all X_all : Fin N_allD → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                    (p_all : Fin N'_O → Fin N_allD → ℝ),
                    let cls' := nextPacketClass M_atom cls
                    IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L r cls'.B_sys cls'.R_win cls'.N_mult cls'.M_win
                      lam_sys m_r Φ₀ f N'_O N_allD r'_O V'_O X'_O ψ'_O
                      b_all a_all r_all e_all V_all X_all p_all ∧
                    (∀ d', b_all d' = b_star + (menu (j_of_D d')).b_loc ∧
                      a_all d' = b_star + (menu (j_of_D d')).a_loc) ∧
                    (∀ j : Fin N_J,
                      ∑ o' : Fin N'_O, ∑ d' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d' => j_of_D d' = j),
                        p_all o' d' = π_J j) ∧
                    K_r_star - R_bud ≤
                      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P r lam_sys m_r Φ₀ f
                        N'_O N_allD r'_O V'_O X'_O ψ'_O b_all a_all p_all) ∧
                (0 < r →
                  ∀ (δ_out k_out α_out : ℝ),
                    0 < α_out → 2 * ξ ≤ α_out →
                    ((k_out ≤ 0 ∨
                      (use_vel_sub = true ∧ d_dim = 1 ∧
                       ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_J j →
                         (menu j).k_bin = k_out ∧ (menu j).is_aligned = true)) →
                     K₀ + quantumPacketRate γ * r - δ_out ≤
                       B_r - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * d₁ j) - R_bud →
                     IsCutChainState γ (nextPacketClass M_atom cls) ε H_P L r h lam_sys
                       4 1 Φ₀ f δ_out k_out α_out) ∧
                    (b_star = 0 → (H_P - r) / 2 ≤ L - r →
                     (k_out ≤ 0 ∨
                      (use_vel_sub = true ∧ d_dim = 2 ∧
                       ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_J j → (menu j).k_bin = k_out)) →
                     K₀ + quantumPacketRate γ * r - δ_out ≤
                       B_r - (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                         (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((menu j).g_bin - 2 * ((H_P - r) / 2))) - R_bud →

          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
          (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
          (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (k_f α_cur k_out : ℝ),
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
