              m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ (menu j) ∧
            (∀ p_buf,
              (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
                let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                  (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2)
                (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                  (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1)))).filter
                  (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
              ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-((menu j).k_bin + ξ)))) →
          (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
            let j := win_of o
            (menu j).loc_idx = cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) ∧
            (menu j).k_bin = k_out ∧
            b_star ≤ b_D d ∧ (d_dim = 1 → |b_D d - b_star| ≤ ζ_sh) ∧
            |(H_P - t) / 2 - a_D d| ≤ ζ_sh ∧
            (d_dim = 2 → b_D d = (H_P - t) / 2 ∧ a_D d = (H_P - t) / 2) ∧
            (d_dim = 1 →
              projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d))
                (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L
                  (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)))) ≤

            (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

              coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x')) ∧
            ε ^ A₀ ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ∧
            (let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
             let C_r := (((menu j).loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
             let h_j := fun v => ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), (menu j).c_at α *
               ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star ((menu j).ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1))) *
                 Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
               4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                 generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_j (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) →
          let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
            ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
          let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
          let B_r := H_J + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
            N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
            B_r + γ * h + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - k_f + α_cur) + e_rep

           generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f₁ N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p -
             generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁ =
           generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p -
             generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f)) ∧
        (∀ (cls' : PacketBoundClass) (t h C_cell : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ) (δ_def k_cred α_cred : ℝ),
          IsCutChainState γ cls' ε H_P L t h lam_sys C_cell d_dim Φ₀ f₁ δ_def k_cred α_cred ↔
          IsCutChainState γ cls' ε H_P L t h lam_sys C_cell d_dim Φ₀ f δ_def k_cred α_cred)) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (t_min δ_mod : ℝ),
      0 < t_min → t_min ≤ cls.K_hor → 0 < δ_mod →
      ∃ ε_prep : ℝ, 0 < ε_prep ∧ ε_prep < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ) (m_t d_dim N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (Δ_cur k_f α_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_prep → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f → (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2 = 1) →

          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +

            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_f α_cur →
          let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)

          (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t ≤ 1 / 4 →
            ∀ ζ_fl : ℝ, 0 < ζ_fl → ε ^ ζ_fl ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (N'_O : ℕ) (emb : Fin N'_O → Fin N_O) (p' : Fin N'_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              1 ≤ N'_O ∧ Function.Injective emb ∧
              (∀ o' d, 0 < p' o' d → 0 < p (emb o') d) ∧
              (∀ o' : Fin N'_O, ε ^ A₀ ≤
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  (r_O (emb o')) (V_O (emb o')) (X_O (emb o')) (ψ_O (emb o'))) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb)
                b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p' ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +

                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D
                  (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb) b_D a_D p' ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N'_O N_D
                (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) e_D p' k_f
                (α_cur + ζ_fl + Real.log 4 / ell)) ∧
          (∀ (S_bins : ℕ) (E : Fin S_bins → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Prop) (p_union ζ_ret : ℝ),
            1 ≤ S_bins → (∀ o d, ∀ b₁ b₂, E b₁ o d → E b₂ o d → b₁ = b₂) →
            0 < p_union →
            (letI := Classical.propDecidable
             p_union ≤ ∑ b : Fin S_bins, ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
               if E b o d then p o d else 0) →
            0 < ζ_ret → ε ^ ζ_ret ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (b_sel : Fin S_bins) (p_sel : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              (∀ o d, 0 < p_sel o d → E b_sel o d ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_sel ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t -
                  ((4 / p_union) * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t +
                    (3 * Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2)) / (2 * ell)) + δ_mod * t) ≤
                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_sel ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p_sel k_f

    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (M_L : ℕ), 64 ≤ M_L →
      ∀ (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),

        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        ∃ (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          let r := t - 2 * h
          let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
          let δ_buf := ((M_L : ℝ) / 32)
          3 / 4 ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              let q_r := r_O o / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
              let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹

              ‖v' - V_O o‖ ≤ δ_buf * ε ^ u_t →
              ‖x' - (X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o)‖ ≤ δ_buf * ε ^ (r + u_t) →
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x'))
            then p o d else 0) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h e₀ ζ_sh δ_mod : ℝ) (M_L : ℕ),
      0 < h → 64 * h < γ * e₀ → 0 < ζ_sh → 64 * ζ_sh ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h →
      0 < δ_mod → 64 * δ_mod ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h → 64 ≤ M_L →
      ∃ ε_norm : ℝ, 0 < ε_norm ∧ ε_norm < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (b_ref a_ref Δ_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_norm → 2 * h < t → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          ε ^ (t - 2 * h) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ (t - 2 * h) →
          m_r ≤ m_t → cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →

          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur ≤
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          ∃ n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            letI := Classical.propDecidable
            (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) ∧
            3 / 4 ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              if projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d))
                   (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L
                     (fineOutCell ε H_P t (t - 2 * h) m_r m_t τ_V τ_X

subgoal_signatures.name: greedy_cap_menu_and_packet_composition
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hβ_pos : 0 < quantumPacketRate γ) (hβ_le : quantumPacketRate γ ≤ 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ))
    (h_cut : PacketCutDecompositionValid M_atom) :
    ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u t_rem_min A₀ ξ η R_bud : ℝ)
      (use_vel_sub : Bool) (d_dim : ℕ),
      0 < Δ_u → 0 ≤ t_rem_min → t_rem_min ≤ cls.K_hor →
      0 < A₀ → 0 < ξ → 0 < η → 4 * η ≤ Δ_u →
      128 * (η + ξ) ≤ R_bud → (d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2) →
      ∃ (C_cov : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ) (ε_comp : ℝ),
        2 ≤ C_cov ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧ (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) ∧ 0 < ε_comp ∧ ε_comp < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (M_L : ℕ) (ε H_P L t r h b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          1 ≤ M_L → ε < ε_comp → 1 ≤ N_O → (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f → (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2 = 1) →
          0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P → t_rem_min ≤ t - r →
          (use_vel_sub = true → 0 < h ∧ r = t - 2 * h) →
          0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ L - t → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 → Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
          ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
           (0 < r ∧ m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2))) →
          m_r ≤ m_t →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_t ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ cls.B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ cls.B_sys ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧
            (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
            (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) ∧
            ε ^ A₀ ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) →
          (∀ (r_i : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
              r_O o = r_i ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) ∧
                ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ (lam_sys * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2))⁻¹)).card : ℝ) ≤
              (cls.N_mult : ℝ)) →
          ∃ (N_J S_per_loc : ℕ) (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
            (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
            (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J),
            let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
            let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
            let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
            let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
            1 ≤ N_J ∧ 1 ≤ S_per_loc ∧
            Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell ≤ R_bud / 32 ∧
            (∀ j₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N_J =>
              (menu j).loc_idx = j₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (S_per_loc : ℝ)) ∧
            (∀ j : Fin N_J,
              IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
                m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ (menu j) ∧
              2 * min (L - r - b_star) ((H_P - r) / 2 - b_star) - R_bud ≤ (menu j).g_bin ∧
              (use_vel_sub = false → N_ret_of j = (menu j).N_all) ∧
              (use_vel_sub = true →
                (∃ m_k : ℕ, m_k < Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3 ∧
                  (menu j).k_bin = (m_k : ℝ) * ξ) ∧
                (d_dim = 1 → ∀ α : Fin (N_ret_of j),
                  let p_c := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2)
                  ((menu j).is_aligned = true ↔
                    projAngleDist (perp2D ((menu j).e_cap α)) (n_fine p_c) ≤ 2 * ε ^ h)) ∧
                (∀ p_c w,
                  ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
                    let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2)
                    p_at = p_c ∧
                    fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) = w)).card : ℝ) ≤
                  ε ^ ((menu j).k_bin - ξ) *
                    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
                      atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                        (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2) =
                        p_c)).card : ℝ)) ∧
                (∀ p_buf,
                  (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
                    let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X (menu j).loc_idx.1
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2)
                    (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1)))).filter
                      (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
                  ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-((menu j).k_bin + ξ))))) ∧
            (∀ o : Fin N_O,
              let j := win_of o
              (menu j).loc_idx = cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) ∧
              (let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
               let C_r := (((menu j).loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
               let h_j := fun v => ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), (menu j).c_at α *
                 ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star ((menu j).ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1))) *
                   Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
                 4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                   generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_j (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) ∧
            (∀ (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
              (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → b_star ≤ b_D d) →
              letI := Classical.propDecidable
              let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
                ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
              let p_cond := fun (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) =>
                if win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j then p o d / π_J j else 0
              let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
              let d₁ := fun j : Fin N_J =>
                Real.log (((menu j).N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret_of j : ℝ)) / ell
              let A_of := fun j : Fin N_J => subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
              let P_of := fun j : Fin N_J =>
                subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
                  r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (menu j) (p_cond j)
              let B_r := H_J + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * A_of j
              let K_r_star := B_r + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * d₁ j
              let K₀ := generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f
              let P_t := generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p
              ∃ (d₀ : ℝ) (d₂ d₃ : Fin N_J → ℝ),
                0 ≤ d₀ ∧ (∀ j, 0 < π_J j → 0 ≤ d₁ j ∧ 0 ≤ d₂ j ∧ 0 ≤ d₃ j) ∧
                d₀ = K₀ + quantumPacketRate γ * r - K_r_star + 2 * R_bud ∧
                (∀ j, 0 < π_J j →
                  d₂ j + d₃ j = A_of j + quantumPacketRate γ * (t - r) - P_of j + 2 * R_bud) ∧
                d₀ + (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (d₁ j + d₂ j + d₃ j)) ≤
                  (K₀ + quantumPacketRate γ * t - P_t) + 5 * R_bud ∧
                B_r + quantumPacketRate γ * (t - r) - P_t ≤
                  (K₀ + quantumPacketRate γ * t - P_t) + 2 * R_bud ∧

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)

    (h_cl : ClassicalLineGrowthBound γ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (h_coh : CoherentStripMassBoundValid) :
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h_slk ζ_slk A_win ξ C_cov e_slk : ℝ)
       (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 < h_slk → 0 < ζ_slk → 4 * h_slk ≤ ζ_slk →
      0 < A_win → 0 < ξ → 2 ≤ C_cov → 1 ≤ M_mult → (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) →

      ∃ ε_slk : ℝ, 0 < ε_slk ∧ ε_slk < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          let r := t - 2 * h_slk
          ε < ε_slk → 0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
          m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
            m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
          (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
            cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
            b_star ≤ b_D d ∧ ζ_slk ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 - a_D d ∧
            (let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
             let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
             let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
             let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
             let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
               ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
                 Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
             ε ^ A_win ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) →
          subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
            r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond ≤
            subclassProxyA ε sub + γ * h_slk + e_slk) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h e₀ ζ_sh A_win ξ C_cov e_al : ℝ)

      0 < e_al → e_al ≤ γ * e₀ → 64 * (ζ_sh + ξ) ≤ e_al →
      ∃ ε_al : ℝ, 0 < ε_al ∧ ε_al < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)

          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (b_ref a_ref : ℝ),
          let r := t - 2 * h
          let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
          ε < ε_al → 0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P → (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          0 ≤ b_star → b_star + 2 * h ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
          e₀ ≤ a_ref - b_ref → |(H_P - t) / 2 - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh → |b_star - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh →

          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
            m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
          (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
            let p_c := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1
              (gridPt2D (ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)) (sub.o_at α).1)
              (gridPt2D ((lam_sys * ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2))⁻¹) (sub.o_at α).2)
            2 * ε ^ h < projAngleDist (perp2D (sub.e_cap α))
              (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c))) →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
          (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
            cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
            |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧
            projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d))
              (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L
                (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)))) ≤
              ε ^ (4 * h) ∧
            (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              let q_r := r_O o / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
              let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
              let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹

              ‖x' - (X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o)‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ (r + (H_P - t) / 2) →
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x')) ∧
            (let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
             let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
             let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
             let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
             let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
               ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
                 Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
             ε ^ A_win ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) →
          2 * γ * e₀ - 20 * h - e_al ≤
            (Real.log ((sub.N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret : ℝ)) / ell) +
            4 * (subclassProxyA ε sub + 2 * quantumPacketRate γ * h -
              subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
                r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond))

subgoal_signatures.name: candidate_coherence_and_credit_repayment
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)

    (h_coh : CoherentStripMassBoundValid) :
    ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h u_min ζ_sh A₀ ξ C_cov e_rep : ℝ)
      (d_dim M_L M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 < h → (3 / 2 : ℝ) * h ≤ u_min → 0 < ζ_sh → 0 < A₀ → 0 < ξ →
      2 ≤ C_cov → (d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2) →
      64 ≤ M_L → (64 * C_cov * cls.B_sys : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ) →
      1 ≤ M_mult → (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) →
      0 < e_rep → 64 * (ζ_sh + ξ) ≤ e_rep →
      ∃ ε_rep : ℝ, 0 < ε_rep ∧ ε_rep < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)

          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
          (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
          (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (k_f α_cur k_out : ℝ),
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          let r := t - 2 * h

          (∀ j : Fin N_J,
            IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
              m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ (menu j) ∧
            (∀ p_buf,
              (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin (N_ret_of j) =>

            let j := win_of o

            (d_dim = 1 →
              projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d))
                (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L
                  (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)))) ≤
                ε ^ (4 * h)) ∧
            (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

              coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x')) ∧
            ε ^ A₀ ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ∧
            (let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
             let C_r := (((menu j).loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
             let h_j := fun v => ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), (menu j).c_at α *
               ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star ((menu j).ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1))) *
                 Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
               4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                 generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_j (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) →
          let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
            ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
          let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
          let B_r := H_J + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
            N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
            B_r + γ * h + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - k_f + α_cur) + e_rep

      rw [Real.coe_toNNReal A hA_nn, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]

      have hL_range :

    have h1 := PiLp.norm_apply_le (gridPt2D s k) 1

    have hc1 : (gridPt2D s k).ofLp 1 = s * (k.2 : ℝ) := by simp [gridPt2D]

    rw [hc1, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs] at h1

      have hm2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hs

      have hm2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hs
      have hmul : s * (s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2) = x.ofLp 1 + (1 / 2) * s := by
        field_simp [hs.ne']
      rw [hmul] at hm1 hm2
      rw [mul_add, mul_one] at hm2
      rw [abs_le]
      exact ⟨by linarith only [hm1], by linarith only [hm2]⟩

      have hc1 : (x - gridPt2D s k).ofLp 1 = x.ofLp 1 - s * (k.2 : ℝ) := by
        simp [gridPt2D]

      have h1s : |x.ofLp 1 - s * (k.2 : ℝ)| ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / 2) * s) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_abs, abs_of_nonneg h0_nn])
      nlinarith only [h0s, h1s]

    nlinarith only [hsq, h_nn, hs]

    rw [Nat.cast_mul, h_real, sq]

    have h4 : Real.sqrt 4 ≤ Real.sqrt lam_sys := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hlam_sys

        have hd2_abs : |((q.2.2 - q₀.2.2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ (K_Z : ℝ) :=
          le_trans hd2 (le_trans h_dn_le hKZ_ge)
        rw [abs_le] at hd1_abs hd2_abs
        have hd1_lo : -K_Z ≤ q.2.1 - q₀.2.1 := by exact_mod_cast hd1_abs.1
        have hd1_hi : q.2.1 - q₀.2.1 ≤ K_Z := by exact_mod_cast hd1_abs.2
        have hd2_lo : -K_Z ≤ q.2.2 - q₀.2.2 := by exact_mod_cast hd2_abs.1
        have hd2_hi : q.2.2 - q₀.2.2 ≤ K_Z := by exact_mod_cast hd2_abs.2
        exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩,
           Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
      have h_card_le : S.card ≤ T_n₀.card :=
        Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Prod.snd h_maps h_inj
      have h_T_card : T_n₀.card = M_mult := by
        dsimp [T_n₀, M_mult]
        rw [Finset.card_product, Int.card_Icc, Int.card_Icc]
        have h1 : (q₀.2.1 + K_Z + 1 - (q₀.2.1 - K_Z)).toNat = 2 * K_mult + 1 := by
          dsimp [K_Z]; omega
        have h2 : (q₀.2.2 + K_Z + 1 - (q₀.2.2 - K_Z)).toNat = 2 * K_mult + 1 := by
          dsimp [K_Z]; omega
        rw [h1, h2, sq]
      exact h_T_card ▸ h_card_le

    (h_pou_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0)

        MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
        ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2 ≤
          C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (j, k_X)

proof.tactics:
by
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  let B_θ : ℝ := A + 2 * (R_cut + 1) * A ^ 2
  have hB_θ_ge1 : 1 ≤ B_θ := by
    dsimp [B_θ]
    nlinarith
  have hB_θ_pos : 0 < B_θ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB_θ_ge1
  let M₁ : ℝ := max C_χ (B_θ * Real.exp 3)
  have hM₁_ge1 : 1 ≤ M₁ := le_trans hC_χ (le_max_left _ _)
  have hM₁_pos : 0 < M₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM₁_ge1
  let C₁ : ℝ := 2 * M₁
  have hC₁_pos : 0 < C₁ := by
    dsimp [C₁]
    positivity
  let C_amp : ℝ := max 1 ((C₁ / 100) * Real.exp (C₁ / 100))
  have hC_amp_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_amp := le_max_left _ _
  have hC_amp_pos : 0 < C_amp := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_amp_ge1
  let C_can : ℝ := C_amp ^ 2
  have hC_can_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_can := by
    dsimp [C_can]
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨C_can, hC_can_ge1, ?_⟩
  intro lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase j n k_X X_q_ex
  dsimp only
  intro hX_cut hX_err h_mode f hf_meas _hf_supp hf_l2
  let ρ₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  let V_j : E := gridPt2D ρ₀ j
  let X_q : E := gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam_sys := by linarith
  have hsqrt_ge2 : 2 ≤ Real.sqrt lam_sys := by
    calc (2 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 4 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt lam_sys := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hlam_sys
  have hsqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt lam_sys := by linarith
  have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := inv_pos.mpr hsqrt_pos
  have hρ₀_le_half : ρ₀ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have h1 := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hsqrt_ge2
    dsimp [ρ₀]
    linarith
  have hρ₀_le1 : ρ₀ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hlam_ρ₀_sq : lam_sys * ρ₀ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    dsimp [ρ₀]
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hlam_pos.le, mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam_pos.ne']
  have hXq_norm : ‖X_q‖ ≤ R_cut + 1 := by
    have htri : ‖X_q‖ ≤ ‖X_q - X_q_ex‖ + ‖X_q_ex‖ := by
      calc ‖X_q‖ = ‖(X_q - X_q_ex) + X_q_ex‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖X_q - X_q_ex‖ + ‖X_q_ex‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    change ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X - X_q_ex‖ ≤ ρ₀ at hX_err
    dsimp [X_q] at htri ⊢
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hΦ_smooth, hζ_smooth, _, _, _, hΦ_fderiv, _, _, hζ_gevrey⟩ := h_phase

  
  let θ_q : E → ℝ := fun z =>
    lam_sys * (Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_q, V_j + ρ₀ • z) - Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, V_j + ρ₀ • z)) +
      (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) z
  let G_q : E → E := fun z =>
    (lam_sys * ρ₀) •
      (ζ₀ (V_j + ρ₀ • z, X_q - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (V_j + ρ₀ • z)) -
        ζ₀ (V_j + ρ₀ • z, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (V_j + ρ₀ • z)))) +
      ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n)
  have hθ_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ_q := by
    intro k
    have h_aff : ContDiff ℝ k (fun z : E => V_j + ρ₀ • z) :=
      contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.const_smul ρ₀)
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun z : E => Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_q, V_j + ρ₀ • z)) :=
      (hΦ_smooth k).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk (contDiff_const.prodMk h_aff))
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun z : E => Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, V_j + ρ₀ • z)) :=
      (hΦ_smooth k).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk (contDiff_const.prodMk h_aff))
    have h3 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun z : E => (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) z) :=
      contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.inner ℝ contDiff_id)
    exact (contDiff_const.mul (h1.sub h2)).add h3
  have hθ_fderiv : ∀ z : E, fderiv ℝ θ_q z = InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E (G_q z) := by
    intro z
    let v : E := V_j + ρ₀ • z
    have h_half_mem : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
    have h_aff_hd : HasFDerivAt (fun z' : E => V_j + ρ₀ • z') (ρ₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) z := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun _ : E => V_j) (0 : E →L[ℝ] E) z := hasFDerivAt_const V_j z
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun z' : E => ρ₀ • z') (ρ₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) z :=
        (ρ₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E).hasFDerivAt
      have h3 := h1.add h2
      rw [zero_add] at h3
      exact h3
    have h_phi_hd : ∀ x : E, HasFDerivAt (fun z' : E => Φ₀ (1 / 2, x, V_j + ρ₀ • z'))
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun v' : E => Φ₀ (1 / 2, x, v')) v).comp (ρ₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) z := by
      intro x
      have h_cd : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun v' : E => Φ₀ (1 / 2, x, v')) :=
        (hΦ_smooth 1).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id))
      exact ((h_cd.differentiable (by simp)) v).hasFDerivAt.comp z h_aff_hd
    let L_lin : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n)
    have h_lin_eq : (fun z' : E => (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) z') = ⇑L_lin := by
      funext z'
      simp [L_lin, InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, real_inner_smul_left]
    have h_lin_hd : HasFDerivAt (fun z' : E => (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) z') L_lin z := by
      rw [h_lin_eq]
      exact L_lin.hasFDerivAt
    have h_tot : HasFDerivAt θ_q
        (lam_sys • (((fderiv ℝ (fun v' : E => Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_q, v')) v).comp
            (ρ₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) -
          ((fderiv ℝ (fun v' : E => Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v')) v).comp
            (ρ₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))) + L_lin) z := by
      exact (((h_phi_hd X_q).sub (h_phi_hd 0)).const_mul lam_sys).add h_lin_hd
    rw [h_tot.fderiv]
    ext u
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,
      L_lin, InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply]
    rw [hΦ_fderiv (1 / 2) h_half_mem X_q v (ρ₀ • u),
      hΦ_fderiv (1 / 2) h_half_mem 0 v (ρ₀ • u)]
    have h_zero_sub : (0 : E) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v = -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • v) := zero_sub _
    rw [h_zero_sub]
    dsimp [G_q, v]
    rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, inner_sub_left,
      real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  have hθ_iter_norm : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) θ_q z‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m G_q z‖ := by
    intro m z
    have hfderiv_eq : fderiv ℝ θ_q = ⇑(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E) ∘ G_q := funext hθ_fderiv
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv, hfderiv_eq,
      (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left]

  
  let H : E × E → (E →L[ℝ] E) := fun q => fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (q.1, p')) q.2
  have hH_eq : ∀ q : E × E, H q = (fderiv ℝ ζ₀ q).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E E) := by
    intro q
    have h_inr : HasFDerivAt (fun p' : E => (q.1, p')) (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E E) q.2 :=
      (hasFDerivAt_const q.1 q.2).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id q.2)
    have h_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ₀ (q.1, q.2) := ((hζ_smooth 1).differentiable (by simp)) q
    exact (h_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp q.2 h_inr).fderiv
  have hH_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k H := by
    intro k
    let R_inr : ((E × E) →L[ℝ] E) →L[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] E) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E (E × E) E).flip (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E E)
    have hH_fn : H = ⇑R_inr ∘ fderiv ℝ ζ₀ := by
      funext q
      exact hH_eq q
    rw [hH_fn]
    exact R_inr.contDiff.comp ((hζ_smooth (k + 1)).fderiv_right (by norm_cast))
  let w_q : E := (lam_sys * ρ₀) • X_q
  let c_mode : E := (Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n
  let ev_wq : (E →L[ℝ] E) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E w_q
  let A_ρ : E →L[ℝ] (E × E) :=
    (ρ₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E).prod ((-(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ρ₀) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)
  let q₀ : ℝ → E × E := fun τ => (V_j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j) + τ • X_q)
  let K : ℝ → E → E := fun τ y => ev_wq (H (q₀ τ + A_ρ y))
  let I_K : E → E := fun y => ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, K τ y
  let D_K : ∀ (m : ℕ), ℝ → E → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E) E :=
    fun m τ y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (K τ) y
  have hq₀_A : ∀ (τ : ℝ) (y : E),
      q₀ τ + A_ρ y = (V_j + ρ₀ • y, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (V_j + ρ₀ • y)) + τ • X_q) := by
    intro τ y
    refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
    simp only [q₀, A_ρ, Prod.snd_add, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
    rw [neg_mul, neg_smul, smul_add, neg_add, smul_smul]
    abel
  have hG_eq_int : ∀ y : E, G_q y = c_mode + I_K y := by
    intro y
    let v : E := V_j + ρ₀ • y
    let p₀ : E := -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • v)
    let γ : ℝ → E := fun τ => (lam_sys * ρ₀) • ζ₀ (v, p₀ + τ • X_q)
    have hγ_deriv : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt γ (K τ y) τ := by
      intro τ _
      have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => p₀ + s • X_q) X_q τ := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => p₀) 0 τ := hasDerivAt_const τ p₀
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • X_q) ((1 : ℝ) • X_q) τ :=
          (hasDerivAt_id τ).smul_const X_q
        have h3 := h1.add h2
        rw [zero_add, one_smul] at h3
        exact h3
      have h_cd : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun p' : E => ζ₀ (v, p')) :=
        (hζ_smooth 1).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
      have h_z : HasFDerivAt (fun p' : E => ζ₀ (v, p')) (H (v, p₀ + τ • X_q)) (p₀ + τ • X_q) :=
        ((h_cd.differentiable (by simp)) (p₀ + τ • X_q)).hasFDerivAt
      have h_comp : HasDerivAt γ ((lam_sys * ρ₀) • (H (v, p₀ + τ • X_q) X_q)) τ :=
        (h_z.comp_hasDerivAt τ h_line).const_smul (lam_sys * ρ₀)
      have h_eq : (lam_sys * ρ₀) • (H (v, p₀ + τ • X_q) X_q) = K τ y := by
        dsimp [K, ev_wq, w_q]
        rw [hq₀_A τ y, map_smul]
      rwa [h_eq] at h_comp
    have hK_tau_cont : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => K τ y) := by
      dsimp [K, q₀]
      exact ev_wq.continuous.comp ((hH_smooth 0).continuous.comp (by fun_prop))
    have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hγ_deriv
      (hK_tau_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    dsimp [I_K]
    rw [h_ftc]
    dsimp [G_q, c_mode, γ, p₀, v]
    have hp1 : -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (V_j + ρ₀ • y)) + (1 : ℝ) • X_q =
        X_q - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (V_j + ρ₀ • y) := by
      rw [one_smul]
      abel
    have hp0 : -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (V_j + ρ₀ • y)) + (0 : ℝ) • X_q =
        -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (V_j + ρ₀ • y)) := by
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
    rw [hp1, hp0, ← smul_sub, add_comm]
  have hK_smooth : ∀ (τ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (K τ) := by
    intro τ k
    exact ev_wq.contDiff.comp ((hH_smooth k).comp (contDiff_const.add A_ρ.contDiff))
  have hDK_eq : ∀ (m : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (y : E),
      D_K m τ y = ev_wq.compContinuousMultilinearMap
        ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (q₀ τ + A_ρ y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => A_ρ)) := by
    intro m τ y
    dsimp [D_K, K]
    have h_add_smooth : ContDiff ℝ m (fun q : E × E => H (q₀ τ + q)) :=
      (hH_smooth m).comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id)
    have h_comp_A : ContDiff ℝ m (fun y' : E => H (q₀ τ + A_ρ y')) :=
      h_add_smooth.comp A_ρ.contDiff
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (⇑ev_wq ∘ (fun y' : E => H (q₀ τ + A_ρ y'))) y = _
    rw [ev_wq.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left h_comp_A.contDiffAt le_rfl]
    congr 1
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ m ((fun q : E × E => H (q₀ τ + q)) ∘ ⇑A_ρ) y = _
    rw [A_ρ.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_add_smooth y le_rfl,
      iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left m (q₀ τ) (A_ρ y)]
  have hDK_cont : ∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × E => D_K m p.1 p.2) := by
    intro m
    have h_eq_fn : (fun p : ℝ × E => D_K m p.1 p.2) = fun p =>
        (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMapL ℝ
          (fun _ : Fin m => E) (E →L[ℝ] E) E ev_wq)
          ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL (fun _ : Fin m => A_ρ))
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H (q₀ p.1 + A_ρ p.2))) := by
      funext p
      exact hDK_eq m p.1 p.2
    rw [h_eq_fn]
    have h_arg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × E => q₀ p.1 + A_ρ p.2) := by
      dsimp [q₀]
      fun_prop
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.continuous _).comp
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.continuous _).comp
        (((hH_smooth m).continuous_iteratedFDeriv le_rfl).comp h_arg_cont))
  have hev_norm : ‖ev_wq‖ ≤ ‖w_q‖ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound ev_wq (norm_nonneg w_q) (fun T => by
      dsimp [ev_wq]
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact T.le_opNorm w_q)
  have hA_norm : ‖A_ρ‖ ≤ ρ₀ := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound A_ρ hρ₀_pos.le (fun u => ?_)
    dsimp [A_ρ]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,

    unfold pktLinearCoeff
    dsimp only
    have h_fn : (fun v : E => f v * (pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v) -
            (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
      (fun v : E => ((4 : ℂ) * (C_amp : ℂ)) *
        (f v * ψ_q (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_q, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) :=
      funext h_integrand_eq
    change ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) *
      (∫ v : E, f v * (pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v) -
            (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) = _
    rw [h_fn, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    have h4_inv : (4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (4 : ℂ) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (by norm_num)
    calc ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) *
          (((4 : ℂ) * (C_amp : ℂ)) * ∫ v : E,
            f v * ψ_q (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_q, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        = ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (4 : ℂ)) * (C_amp : ℂ) *
            ((ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : E,
              f v * ψ_q (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_q, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by ring
      _ = (C_amp : ℂ) * ((ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : E,
            f v * ψ_q (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_q, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
          rw [h4_inv, one_mul]
  have h_norm_sq : ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2 = C_can * m_q := by
    rw [h_coeff_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hC_amp_pos.le, mul_pow]
  rw [h_norm_sq]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_q_le (by positivity)

informal_problem.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys R_win C_χ : ℝ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom) (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hC_χ : 1 ≤ C_χ)
    (h_pou_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D)
    (h_pou_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0)
    (h_pou_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    ∃ (d_thresh : ℝ) (B_amp D_phase : ℕ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ d_thresh ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ B_amp k) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ D_phase m) ∧
      ∀ (lam_sys : ℝ), 4 ≤ lam_sys →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (ρ_obs C_box : ℝ),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        ρ₀ ≤ ρ_obs → ρ_obs ≤ 1 → C_box ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖V_o‖ ≤ B_sys → ‖X_o‖ ≤ B_sys →
      ∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
      ∀ (j n : ℤ × ℤ) (X_jn : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom →
        ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, X_jn - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j) =
          ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ₀ j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) -
            ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) →
        let pair_jn : ℂ := (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        let d_jn : ℝ := ρ₀⁻¹ * ‖X_jn - (X_o + (1 / 2 - C_box) • gridPt2D ρ₀ j)‖
        (R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ j - V_o‖ → pair_jn = 0) ∧
        (‖pair_jn‖ ≤ 4 * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * B_amp 0) ∧
        (d_thresh ≤ d_jn →
          ∃ (θ_sl : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (u_sl : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
            (∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2,
              (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (θ_sl y₁)) ∧
              (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (u_sl y₁)) ∧
              (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 → (a₀ / 2) * d_jn ≤ deriv (θ_sl y₁) t) ∧
              (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 →
                |iteratedDeriv m (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) t| ≤ ((a₀ / 2) * d_jn) * D_phase m) ∧
              (∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ |t| → u_sl y₁ t = 0) ∧
              (∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv k (u_sl y₁) t‖ ≤ B_amp k)) ∧
            (∀ (M_sl : ℝ), 0 ≤ M_sl →
              (∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2,
                ‖∫ t : ℝ, u_sl y₁ t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ_sl y₁ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ M_sl) →
              ‖pair_jn‖ ≤ (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * M_sl))

proof.tactics:
by
  let M'_win : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => max (M_win k) 0
  let W_χ : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => C_χ ^ (i + 1) * ((i.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)
  let B_amp : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * W_χ i * M'_win (k - i)
  let C_term : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    (B_sys + R_dom + 8) * A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) +
      (m : ℝ) * A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)
  let D_phase : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => 2 * C_term m
  let d_thresh : ℝ := max 1 ((12 * D_phase 1 + 2) / a₀)
  have hC_χ_pos : 0 < C_χ := by linarith
  have hA_pos : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hW_χ_nn : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ W_χ i := fun i => by dsimp only [W_χ]; positivity
  have hM'_nn : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ M'_win k := fun k => le_max_right _ _
  have hB_amp_nn : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ B_amp k := fun k =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hW_χ_nn i)) (hM'_nn (k - i)))
  have hB_amp_zero : B_amp 0 = C_χ * M'_win 0 := by
    simp [B_amp, W_χ]
  have hC_term_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_term m := fun m => by
    dsimp only [C_term]
    have h_sum_pos : 0 < B_sys + R_dom + 8 := by linarith
    positivity
  have hD_phase_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ D_phase m := fun m =>
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hC_term_nn m)
  have hd_thresh_ge : 1 ≤ d_thresh := le_max_left _ _
  have h_pou_cont : Continuous pktPou2D := (h_pou_smooth 0).continuous
  have h_pou_bound : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), |pktPou2D z| ≤ C_χ := by
    intro z
    have h0 := h_pou_deriv 0 z
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h0
    simpa using h0

  
  have h_haar_slice :
      ∀ (lam_sys ρ_obs C_box : ℝ), 0 < lam_sys → 0 < ρ_obs →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
        Continuous Φ₀ →
      ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        Continuous ψ_o →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖ψ_o z‖ ≤ M'_win 0) →
      ∀ (j n : ℤ × ℤ),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        let V_j := gridPt2D ρ₀ j
        let pair_jn : ℂ := (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖V_j - V_o‖ → pair_jn = 0) ∧
        (‖pair_jn‖ ≤ 4 * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * B_amp 0) ∧
        (∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖w‖ = 1 →
          ∀ (M_sl : ℝ), 0 ≤ M_sl →
            (∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2,
              ‖∫ t : ℝ,
                ((pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) : ℂ) *
                  ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (V_j - V_o) + (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                  (((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, V_j + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) -
                      Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, V_j + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))) +
                    (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
              M_sl) →
            ‖pair_jn‖ ≤ (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * M_sl) := by
    intro lam_sys ρ_obs C_box hlam_pos hρ_obs_pos Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont V_o X_o ψ_o
      hψ_cont hψ_supp hψ_bd j n
    dsimp only
    let ρ₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
    have hsqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt lam_sys := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam_pos
    have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := inv_pos.mpr hsqrt_pos
    have hρ₀_nn : 0 ≤ ρ₀ := hρ₀_pos.le
    have hρ₀_ne : ρ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hρ₀_pos
    have hρ_obs_ne : ρ_obs ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hρ_obs_pos
    let V_j : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D ρ₀ j
    let pair_jn : ℂ := (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    have h_disj : R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖V_j - V_o‖ → pair_jn = 0 := by
      intro h_sep
      have h_zero : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        intro v
        have h_tri : ‖V_j - V_o‖ ≤ ‖v - V_j‖ + ‖v - V_o‖ := by
          calc ‖V_j - V_o‖ = ‖(V_j - v) + (v - V_o)‖ := by abel_nf
            _ ≤ ‖V_j - v‖ + ‖v - V_o‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖v - V_j‖ + ‖v - V_o‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
        by_cases hv1 : 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖v - V_j‖
        · have hz1 : 2 ≤ ‖ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ₀_nn)]
            exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀' hρ₀_pos).mpr hv1
          have h0 : pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) = 0 := h_pou_supp _ hz1
          dsimp only [pktLinearAtom]
          change (((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) * (pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) * _) * _ * _ = 0
          rw [h0]
          simp
        · have hv2 : R_win * ρ_obs ≤ ‖v - V_o‖ := by linarith
          have hz2 : R_win ≤ ‖ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_obs_pos.le)]
            exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀' hρ_obs_pos).mpr hv2
          have h0 : ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) = 0 := hψ_supp _ hz2
          rw [h0]
          simp
      dsimp only [pair_jn]
      simp_rw [h_zero, MeasureTheory.integral_zero, mul_zero]
    have h_slice : ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖w‖ = 1 →
        ∀ (M_sl : ℝ), 0 ≤ M_sl →
          (∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2,
            ‖∫ t : ℝ,
              ((pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) : ℂ) *
                ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (V_j - V_o) + (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                (((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, V_j + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) -
                    Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, V_j + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))) +
                  (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
            M_sl) →
          ‖pair_jn‖ ≤ (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * M_sl := by
      intro w hw M_sl hM_nn h_bound
      let g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z =>
        ((pktPou2D z : ℂ) * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (V_j - V_o) + (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) • z)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            (((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, V_j + ρ₀ • z) - Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, V_j + ρ₀ • z)) +
              (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) z) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have h_int_eq : pair_jn = (((ρ₀ / (4 * ρ_obs)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g z := by
        dsimp only [pair_jn]
        have h_pt : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
            ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) *
              (((pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                  (((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) - Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v)) +
                    (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j))) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
          intro v
          dsimp only [pktLinearAtom]
          let e₁ : ℝ := -lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v) +
            (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j))
          let e₂ : ℝ := lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v)
          change (((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) * (pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * (e₁ : ℂ))) * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * (e₂ : ℂ)) = _
          have h_exp : Complex.exp (Complex.I * (e₁ : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (e₂ : ℂ)) =
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                (((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) - Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v)) +
                  (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j))) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
            rw [← Complex.exp_add]
            congr 1
            dsimp only [e₁, e₂]
            push_cast
            ring
          calc (((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) * (pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * (e₁ : ℂ))) * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * (e₂ : ℂ))
              = ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) *
                (((pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o))) *
                  (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (e₁ : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (e₂ : ℂ)))) := by
                ring
            _ = _ := by rw [h_exp]
        simp_rw [h_pt]
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self
          (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            ((pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o))) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                (((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) - Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v)) +
                  (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j))) : ℝ) : ℂ))) V_j]
        have h_shift : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            ((pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (u + V_j - V_j)) : ℂ) * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (u + V_j - V_o))) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                (((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, u + V_j) - Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, u + V_j)) +
                  (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (u + V_j - V_j))) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
            g (ρ₀⁻¹ • u) := by
          intro u
          dsimp only [g]
          have h1 : u + V_j - V_j = u := add_sub_cancel_right u V_j
          have h2 : ρ_obs⁻¹ • (u + V_j - V_o) =
              ρ_obs⁻¹ • (V_j - V_o) + (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) • (ρ₀⁻¹ • u) := by
            ext i
            simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            field_simp [hρ₀_ne, hρ_obs_ne]
            ring
          have h3 : V_j + ρ₀ • (ρ₀⁻¹ • u) = u + V_j := by
            rw [smul_inv_smul₀ hρ₀_ne, add_comm]
          rw [h1, h2, h3]
        simp_rw [h_shift]
        rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_inv_smul_of_nonneg MeasureTheory.volume g hρ₀_nn,
          finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, Complex.real_smul]
        have h_pref : (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * (((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) * ((ρ₀ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
            (((ρ₀ / (4 * ρ_obs)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          have hρ₀_c : (ρ₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hρ₀_ne
          have hρ_obs_c : (ρ_obs : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hρ_obs_ne
          push_cast
          field_simp [hρ₀_c, hρ_obs_c]
        calc (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * (((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) *
              (((ρ₀ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g x))
            = ((ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * (((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) * ((ρ₀ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
              ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g x := by ring
          _ = (((ρ₀ / (4 * ρ_obs)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g x := by
              rw [h_pref]
      have hg_cont : Continuous g := by
        refine ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h_pou_cont).mul
          (hψ_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul (ρ₀ / ρ_obs))))).mul ?_
        refine Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_))
        refine (continuous_const.mul ((hΦ₀_cont.comp ?_).sub (hΦ₀_cont.comp ?_))).add
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.inner continuous_id))
        · exact continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk
            (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul ρ₀)))
        · exact continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk
            (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul ρ₀)))
      have hg_supp : HasCompactSupport g := by
        refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 2)
          (fun z hz => ?_)
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
        have h0 : pktPou2D z = 0 := h_pou_supp z hz.le
        simp [g, h0]
      have hg_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hg_cont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hg_supp
      have hw_sq : (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have h1 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [hw]; norm_num
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
      let R_w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        { toFun := fun u => (u 0) • w + (u 1) • perp2D w
          map_add' := fun u v => by
            ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D] <;> ring
          map_smul' := fun c u => by
            ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D] <;> ring
          invFun := fun z =>
            WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 =>
              if i = 0 then inner ℝ z w else inner ℝ z (perp2D w))
          left_inv := fun u => by
            ext i
            fin_cases i
            · simp [perp2D, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              linear_combination (u 0) * hw_sq
            · simp [perp2D, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              linear_combination (u 1) * hw_sq
          right_inv := fun z => by
            ext i
            fin_cases i
            · simp [perp2D, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              linear_combination (z 0) * hw_sq
            · simp [perp2D, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              linear_combination (z 1) * hw_sq
          norm_map' := fun u => by
            have hsq : ‖(u 0) • w + (u 1) • perp2D w‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
              rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, perp2D,
                Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
              dsimp
              linear_combination ((u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2) * hw_sq
            exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp hsq }
      let e_toLp : (Fin 2 → ℝ) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv
      let Φ_rot : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.symm.trans (e_toLp.trans R_w.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv)
      have hΦ_mp : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving Φ_rot
          MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume := by
        have h1 : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.symm
            MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume :=
          (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).symm
        have h2 : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving e_toLp
            MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume :=
          PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 2)
        have h3 : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving R_w.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv
            MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume :=
          R_w.measurePreserving
        exact (h3.comp h2).comp h1
      have h_fubini : (∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g z) =
          ∫ y₁ : ℝ, ∫ t : ℝ, g (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) := by
        rw [← hΦ_mp.integral_comp' g]
        have hg_prod_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g (Φ_rot p))
            MeasureTheory.volume :=
          (hΦ_mp.integrable_comp_emb Φ_rot.measurableEmbedding).mpr hg_int
        have h_vol_prod : (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) =
            MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume := rfl
        rw [h_vol_prod, MeasureTheory.integral_prod_symm _ hg_prod_int]
        rfl
      have h_out_zero : ∀ y₁ : ℝ, y₁ ∉ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 →
          (∫ t : ℝ, g (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) = 0 := by
        intro y₁ hy₁
        have hy_abs : 2 < |y₁| := by
          rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hy₁
          rcases hy₁ with hlt | hgt
          · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
          · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
        have h_pt0 : ∀ t : ℝ, g (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) = 0 := by
          intro t
          have h_norm_sq : 2 ^ 2 ≤ ‖t • w + y₁ • perp2D w‖ ^ 2 := by
            have h_eq : ‖t • w + y₁ • perp2D w‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2 := by
              rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, perp2D,
                Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
              dsimp
              linear_combination (t ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2) * hw_sq
            rw [h_eq]
            have hy_sq : 2 ^ 2 < y₁ ^ 2 := by
              rw [← sq_abs y₁]
              nlinarith
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
          have h_norm : 2 ≤ ‖t • w + y₁ • perp2D w‖ := by
            nlinarith [norm_nonneg (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)]
          have h0 : pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) = 0 := h_pou_supp _ h_norm
          simp [g, h0]
        simp_rw [h_pt0, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
      have h_int_norm : ‖∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g z‖ ≤ 4 * M_sl := by
        rw [h_fubini, ← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero h_out_zero]
        have h_meas_lt : MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) < ⊤ := by
          rw [Real.volume_Icc]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
        have h_est := MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const h_meas_lt h_bound
        have h_vol_real : MeasureTheory.volume.real (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) = 4 := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.real_def, Real.volume_Icc]
          norm_num
        rw [h_vol_real, mul_comm] at h_est
        exact h_est
      have h_pref_nn : 0 ≤ ρ₀ / (4 * ρ_obs) := by positivity
      rw [h_int_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h_pref_nn]
      calc (ρ₀ / (4 * ρ_obs)) * ‖∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g z‖
          ≤ (ρ₀ / (4 * ρ_obs)) * (4 * M_sl) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_norm h_pref_nn
        _ = (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * M_sl := by
            field_simp [hρ_obs_ne]
    have h_triv : ‖pair_jn‖ ≤ 4 * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) * B_amp 0 := by
      let w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D 1 (1, 0)
      have hw₀ : ‖w₀‖ = 1 := by
        have hsq : ‖w₀‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
          rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
          simp [w₀, gridPt2D]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg w₀]
      have hM_sl_nn : 0 ≤ 4 * B_amp 0 := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hB_amp_nn 0)
      have h_step := h_slice w₀ hw₀ (4 * B_amp 0) hM_sl_nn ?_
      · linarith
      · intro y₁ _hy₁
        let F_t : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
          ((pktPou2D (t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀) : ℂ) *
            ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (V_j - V_o) + (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) • (t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            (((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, V_j + ρ₀ • (t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀)) -
                Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, V_j + ρ₀ • (t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀))) +

        have hF_out : ∀ t : ℝ, t ∉ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 → F_t t = 0 := by
          intro t ht

            rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at ht
            rcases ht with hlt | hgt
            · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
            · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
          have h_norm_sq : 2 ^ 2 ≤ ‖t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀‖ ^ 2 := by
            have h_eq0 : ‖t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2 := by
              rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              simp only [w₀, gridPt2D, perp2D, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply,
                smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_zero]
              dsimp
              ring
            rw [h_eq0]
            have ht_sq : 2 ^ 2 < t ^ 2 := by rw [← sq_abs t]; nlinarith
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg y₁]
          have h_norm : 2 ≤ ‖t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀‖ := by
            nlinarith [norm_nonneg (t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀)]
          have h0 : pktPou2D (t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀) = 0 := h_pou_supp _ h_norm
          simp [F_t, h0]
        change ‖∫ t : ℝ, F_t t‖ ≤ 4 * B_amp 0
        rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hF_out]
        have h_meas_lt : MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) < ⊤ := by
          rw [Real.volume_Icc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
        have hF_pt : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2, ‖F_t t‖ ≤ B_amp 0 := by
          intro t _ht
          dsimp only [F_t]
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one, hB_amp_zero]
          exact mul_le_mul (h_pou_bound _) (hψ_bd _) (norm_nonneg _) hC_χ_pos.le
        have h_est := MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const h_meas_lt hF_pt
        have h_vol_real : MeasureTheory.volume.real (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) = 4 := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.real_def, Real.volume_Icc]; norm_num
        rw [h_vol_real] at h_est
        linarith
    exact ⟨h_disj, h_triv, h_slice⟩

  
  have h_win_bounds :
      ∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
      ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (z_sh w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖w‖ = 1 →
      ∀ (y₁ : ℝ),
        let u : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
          (pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) : ℂ) *
            ψ_o (z_sh + r • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) ∧
        (∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ |t| → u t = 0) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B_amp k) := by
    intro ψ_o hψ_smooth hψ_deriv r hr0 hr1 z_sh w hw y₁
    dsimp only
    let Λ₁ : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) w
    let Λ₂ : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (r • w)
    have hΛ₁_app : ∀ t : ℝ, Λ₁ t = t • w := fun t => by simp [Λ₁]
    have hΛ₂_app : ∀ t : ℝ, Λ₂ t = t • (r • w) := fun t => by simp [Λ₂]
    have hΛ₁_norm : ‖Λ₁‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun t => ?_)
      rw [hΛ₁_app, norm_smul, hw, mul_one, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hΛ₂_norm : ‖Λ₂‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun t => ?_)
      rw [hΛ₂_app, norm_smul, norm_smul, hw, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr0,
        one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg t) hr1
    let z₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := y₁ • perp2D w
    let z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := z_sh + r • (y₁ • perp2D w)
    let g₁ : ℝ → ℝ := (fun z => pktPou2D (z + z₁)) ∘ ⇑Λ₁
    have hg₁_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k g₁ := fun k =>
      ((h_pou_smooth k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).comp Λ₁.contDiff
    have hg₁_bd : ∀ (i : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g₁ t‖ ≤ W_χ i := by
      intro i t
      have h_shift_cd : ContDiff ℝ i (fun z => pktPou2D (z + z₁)) :=
        (h_pou_smooth i).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      dsimp only [g₁]
      rw [Λ₁.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_shift_cd t le_rfl, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
      have h_le1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i pktPou2D (Λ₁ t + z₁)) (fun _ : Fin i => Λ₁)
      have h_prod_le : (∏ _ : Fin i, ‖Λ₁‖) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg Λ₁) hΛ₁_norm
      calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i pktPou2D (Λ₁ t + z₁)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ₁)‖
          ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i pktPou2D (Λ₁ t + z₁)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin i, ‖Λ₁‖ := h_le1
        _ ≤ W_χ i * 1 := mul_le_mul (h_pou_deriv i (Λ₁ t + z₁)) h_prod_le
            (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg Λ₁)) (hW_χ_nn i)
        _ = W_χ i := mul_one _
    let f₁ : ℝ → ℂ := ⇑Complex.ofRealLI ∘ g₁
    have hf₁_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k f₁ := fun k =>
      Complex.ofRealLI.contDiff.comp (hg₁_cd k)
    have hf₁_bd : ∀ (i : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f₁ t‖ ≤ W_χ i := by
      intro i t
      dsimp only [f₁]
      rw [Complex.ofRealLI.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (hg₁_cd i).contDiffAt
        (le_rfl : (i : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ i)]
      exact hg₁_bd i t
    let f₂ : ℝ → ℂ := (fun z => ψ_o (z + z₂)) ∘ ⇑Λ₂
    have hf₂_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k f₂ := fun k =>
      ((hψ_smooth k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).comp Λ₂.contDiff
    have hf₂_bd : ∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f₂ t‖ ≤ M'_win j := by
      intro j t
      have h_shift_cd : ContDiff ℝ j (fun z => ψ_o (z + z₂)) :=
        (hψ_smooth j).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      dsimp only [f₂]
      rw [Λ₂.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_shift_cd t le_rfl, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
      have h_le1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ t + z₂)) (fun _ : Fin j => Λ₂)
      have h_prod_le : (∏ _ : Fin j, ‖Λ₂‖) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg Λ₂) hΛ₂_norm
      have hψ_M' : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ t + z₂)‖ ≤ M'_win j :=
        le_trans (hψ_deriv j (Λ₂ t + z₂)) (le_max_left _ _)
      calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ t + z₂)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ₂)‖
          ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ t + z₂)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin j, ‖Λ₂‖ := h_le1
        _ ≤ M'_win j * 1 := mul_le_mul hψ_M' h_prod_le
            (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg Λ₂)) (hM'_nn j)
        _ = M'_win j := mul_one _
    have hu_eq : (fun t : ℝ =>
