        (hζ_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ hp_d)
      have h_fn_eq : (⇑dual_u ∘ (fun p' => ζ₀ (V_j, p')) ∘ fun (τ' : ℝ) => p_B + τ' • u) =
          fun (τ' : ℝ) => inner ℝ (ζ₀ (V_j, p_B + τ' • u)) u := by
        ext τ'
        dsimp only [dual_u, Function.comp_apply]
        rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, real_inner_comm]
      have h_val_eq : dual_u (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (V_j, p')) (p_B + τ • u) u) =
          inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (V_j, p')) (p_B + τ • u) u) u := by
        dsimp only [dual_u]
        rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, real_inner_comm]
      rw [h_fn_eq, h_val_eq] at h_comp
      exact h1.sub h_comp
    have h_anti := antitone_of_deriv_nonpos (fun τ => (hφ_deriv τ).differentiableAt)
      (fun τ => by
        rw [(hφ_deriv τ).deriv]
        linarith [hζ_pos V_j (p_B + τ • u) u])
      (zero_le_one : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    dsimp only [φ] at h_anti
    have hp1 : p_B + (1 : ℝ) • u = p_A := by
      dsimp only [u]
      rw [one_smul]
      abel
    have hp0 : p_B + (0 : ℝ) • u = p_B := by simp
    rw [hp1, hp0, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_sub] at h_anti
    have h_inner_ge : a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B)) u := by
      rw [inner_sub_left]
      linarith
    have h_cs : inner ℝ (ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B)) u ≤
        ‖ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B)‖ * ‖u‖ :=
      real_inner_le_norm _ _
    have h_diff_ge : a₀ * ρ₀ * d_jn ≤ ‖ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B)‖ := by
      have h1 : (a₀ * ‖u‖) * ‖u‖ ≤ ‖ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B)‖ * ‖u‖ := by
        calc (a₀ * ‖u‖) * ‖u‖ = a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ ‖ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B)‖ * ‖u‖ := le_trans h_inner_ge h_cs
      have h2 : a₀ * ‖u‖ ≤ ‖ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B)‖ :=
        le_of_mul_le_mul_right h1 hu_pos
      rw [hu_norm] at h2
      linarith
    let W_jn : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := (lam_sys * ρ₀) • (ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B))
    have hW_ge : a₀ * d_jn ≤ ‖W_jn‖ := by
      dsimp only [W_jn]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hlam_ρ₀_pos.le]
      calc a₀ * d_jn = (lam_sys * ρ₀ ^ 2) * (a₀ * d_jn) := by rw [hlam_ρ₀_sq, one_mul]
        _ = (lam_sys * ρ₀) * (a₀ * ρ₀ * d_jn) := by ring
        _ ≤ (lam_sys * ρ₀) * ‖ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B)‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_ge hlam_ρ₀_pos.le
    have hW_pos : 0 < ‖W_jn‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos ha₀ hd_pos) hW_ge
    have hW_ne : ‖W_jn‖ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW_pos
    let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := ‖W_jn‖⁻¹ • W_jn
    have hw_norm : ‖w‖ = 1 := by
      dsimp only [w]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hW_pos.le), inv_mul_cancel₀ hW_ne]
    have hw_perp : ‖perp2D w‖ = 1 := by
      have hw_sq : (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have h1 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [hw_norm]; norm_num
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
      have hp_sq : ‖perp2D w‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp only [perp2D, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
        dsimp
        linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D w)]
    have hW_inner : inner ℝ W_jn w = ‖W_jn‖ := by
      dsimp only [w]
      rw [inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      field_simp [hW_ne]
    have hW_expand : inner ℝ W_jn w =
        (lam_sys * ρ₀) *
          (inner ℝ (ζ₀ (V_j, X_o - C_box • V_j)) w -
            inner ℝ (ζ₀ (V_j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j))) w) +
        (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) w := by
      have h_sub_mode : ζ₀ (V_j, p_A) - ζ₀ (V_j, p_B) =
          (ζ₀ (V_j, X_o - C_box • V_j) - ζ₀ (V_j, -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_j))) +
            ((Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2 : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) := by
        dsimp only [p_A, p_B]
        rw [h_mode]
        abel
      dsimp only [W_jn]
      rw [h_sub_mode, smul_add, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, inner_sub_left,
        smul_smul, real_inner_smul_left]
      have h_pi : (lam_sys * ρ₀) * (Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2) = Real.pi / 2 := by
        calc (lam_sys * ρ₀) * (Real.pi * ρ₀ / 2)
            = (lam_sys * ρ₀ ^ 2) * (Real.pi / 2) := by ring
          _ = Real.pi / 2 := by rw [hlam_ρ₀_sq, one_mul]
      rw [h_pi]
    refine ⟨w, hw_norm, hw_perp, ?_⟩
    rw [← hW_expand, hW_inner]
    exact hW_ge

  
  refine ⟨d_thresh, B_amp, D_phase, hd_thresh_ge, hB_amp_nn, hD_phase_nn, ?_⟩
  intro lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase ρ_obs C_box ρ₀ hρ₀_obs hρ_obs_le1 hC_box
    V_o X_o hVo hXo ψ_o hψ_smooth hψ_supp hψ_deriv j n X_jn hj h_mode pair_jn d_jn
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam_sys := by linarith
  have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam_pos)
  have hρ_obs_pos : 0 < ρ_obs := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ₀_pos hρ₀_obs
  have h_ratio_nn : 0 ≤ ρ₀ / ρ_obs := div_nonneg hρ₀_pos.le hρ_obs_pos.le
  have h_ratio_le1 : ρ₀ / ρ_obs ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hρ_obs_pos).mpr hρ₀_obs
  let V_j : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D ρ₀ j
  have hVj_norm : ‖V_j‖ ≤ R_dom + 2 := by
    unfold pktVelBox at hj
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
  have hΦ₀_cont : Continuous Φ₀ := (h_phase.1 0).continuous
  have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ_o := (hψ_smooth 0).continuous
  have hψ_bd0 : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖ψ_o z‖ ≤ M'_win 0 := by
    intro z
    have h0 := hψ_deriv 0 z
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h0
    exact le_trans h0 (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨h_disj, h_uncond, h_slice_red⟩ :=
    h_haar_slice lam_sys ρ_obs C_box hlam_pos hρ_obs_pos Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont V_o X_o ψ_o
      hψ_cont hψ_supp hψ_bd0 j n
  refine ⟨h_disj, h_uncond, ?_⟩
  intro hd_ge
  have hd_ge1 : 1 ≤ d_jn := le_trans hd_thresh_ge hd_ge
  have hd_pos : 0 < d_jn := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hd_ge1
  have hd_thresh_ineq : 12 * D_phase 1 + 2 ≤ a₀ * d_jn := by
    have h1 : (12 * D_phase 1 + 2) / a₀ ≤ d_thresh := le_max_right _ _
    have h2 : (12 * D_phase 1 + 2) / a₀ ≤ d_jn := le_trans h1 hd_ge
    have h3 := (div_le_iff₀ ha₀).mp h2
    linarith
  have ha₀_d_ge1 : 1 ≤ (a₀ / 2) * d_jn := by
    have hD1 := hD_phase_nn 1
    linarith
  have ha₀_d_margin : (a₀ / 2) * d_jn ≤ a₀ * d_jn - 6 * D_phase 1 := by
    linarith
  obtain ⟨w, hw_norm, hw_perp, h_center_lo⟩ :=
    h_coercive lam_sys C_box hlam_pos ζ₀ h_phase.2.1
      (fun v p u => (h_phase.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 v p u).1) V_j X_o X_jn n h_mode hd_pos
  let θ_sl : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun y₁ t =>
    lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, V_j + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)) -
      Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, V_j + ρ₀ • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))) +
    (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)
  let u_sl : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun y₁ t =>
    (pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) : ℂ) *
      ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (V_j - V_o) + (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))
  refine ⟨θ_sl, u_sl, ?_, h_slice_red w hw_norm⟩
  intro y₁ hy₁
  have hy₁_abs : |y₁| ≤ 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨hy₁.1, hy₁.2⟩
  let z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := y₁ • perp2D w
  have hz₀_norm : ‖z₀‖ ≤ 2 := by
    dsimp only [z₀]
    rw [norm_smul, hw_perp, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hy₁_abs
  obtain ⟨hu_cd, hu_supp, hu_der⟩ :=
    h_win_bounds ψ_o hψ_smooth hψ_deriv (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) h_ratio_nn h_ratio_le1
      (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (V_j - V_o)) w hw_norm y₁
  have hc_half : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
  have h0_Bsys : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ≤ B_sys := by
    rw [norm_zero]; linarith
  obtain ⟨hγ₁_cd, hΦ₁_cd, hΦ₁_deriv, hγ₁_bd⟩ :=
    h_phase_line lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase C_box hC_box
      X_o V_j z₀ w w hXo hVj_norm hz₀_norm hw_norm hw_norm
  obtain ⟨hγ₂_cd, hΦ₂_cd, hΦ₂_deriv, hγ₂_bd⟩ :=
    h_phase_line lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase (1 / 2) hc_half
      0 V_j z₀ w w h0_Bsys hVj_norm hz₀_norm hw_norm hw_norm
  let v_fn : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun s => V_j + ρ₀ • (s • w + z₀)
  let γ₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (lam_sys * ρ₀) * inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn s, X_o - C_box • v_fn s)) w
  let γ₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (lam_sys * ρ₀) * inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn s, 0 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v_fn s)) w
  let κ_n : ℝ := (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) w
  let c_n : ℝ := (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) z₀
  have hθ_eq : θ_sl y₁ = fun s =>
      (lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v_fn s) - lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v_fn s)) +
        (s * κ_n + c_n) := by
    ext s
    dsimp only [θ_sl, v_fn, z₀, κ_n, c_n]
    rw [inner_add_right, inner_smul_right]
    ring
  have hθ_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (θ_sl y₁) := fun k => by
    rw [hθ_eq]
    exact ((hΦ₁_cd k).sub (hΦ₂_cd k)).add ((contDiff_id.mul contDiff_const).add contDiff_const)
  have hθ_deriv_eq : ∀ s : ℝ, deriv (θ_sl y₁) s = κ_n + (γ₁ s - γ₂ s) := by
    intro s
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun s' => lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v_fn s')) (γ₁ s) s := by
      have hd := ((hΦ₁_cd 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt (x := s)
      rwa [hΦ₁_deriv rfl s] at hd
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun s' => lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v_fn s')) (γ₂ s) s := by
      have hd := ((hΦ₂_cd 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt (x := s)
      rwa [hΦ₂_deriv rfl s] at hd
    have hd3 : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => s' * κ_n + c_n) κ_n s := by
      have hm : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => s' * κ_n) (1 * κ_n) s := (hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const κ_n
      rw [one_mul] at hm
      exact hm.add_const c_n
    have hd_all : HasDerivAt
        (fun s' => (lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v_fn s') - lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v_fn s')) +
          (s' * κ_n + c_n))
        ((γ₁ s - γ₂ s) + κ_n) s := (hd1.sub hd2).add hd3
    rw [hθ_eq, hd_all.deriv]
    ring
  have hθ_deriv_fn : deriv (θ_sl y₁) = fun s => κ_n + (γ₁ s - γ₂ s) := funext hθ_deriv_eq
  have hθ_hi_raw : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 →
      |iteratedDeriv m (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) t| ≤ D_phase m := by
    intro m hm t ht
    rw [hθ_deriv_fn, iteratedDeriv_const_add (by omega : 0 < m)]
    have h_sub_fn : (fun s => γ₁ s - γ₂ s) = γ₁ - γ₂ := rfl
    rw [h_sub_fn, iteratedDeriv_sub (hγ₁_cd m).contDiffAt (hγ₂_cd m).contDiffAt]
    calc |iteratedDeriv m γ₁ t - iteratedDeriv m γ₂ t|
        ≤ |iteratedDeriv m γ₁ t| + |iteratedDeriv m γ₂ t| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ C_term m + C_term m := add_le_add (hγ₁_bd m hm t ht) (hγ₂_bd m hm t ht)
      _ = D_phase m := by dsimp only [D_phase]; ring
  have hθ_hi : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 →
      |iteratedDeriv m (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) t| ≤ ((a₀ / 2) * d_jn) * D_phase m := by
    intro m hm t ht
    calc |iteratedDeriv m (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) t|
        ≤ D_phase m := hθ_hi_raw m hm t ht
      _ = 1 * D_phase m := (one_mul _).symm
      _ ≤ ((a₀ / 2) * d_jn) * D_phase m :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha₀_d_ge1 (hD_phase_nn m)
  have hθ_lo : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 → (a₀ / 2) * d_jn ≤ deriv (θ_sl y₁) t := by
    intro t ht
    
    have hf_d_diff : Differentiable ℝ (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) := by
      have hcd : ContDiff ℝ (1 : ℕ) (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) := by
        rw [hθ_deriv_fn]
        exact contDiff_const.add ((hγ₁_cd 1).sub (hγ₂_cd 1))
      exact hcd.differentiable (by simp)
    have h_hop2_bd : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4, ‖deriv (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) s‖ ≤ D_phase 1 := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← iteratedDeriv_one]
      exact hθ_hi_raw 1 le_rfl s (abs_le.mpr ⟨hs.1, hs.2⟩)
    have h0_Icc4 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4 := by constructor <;> norm_num
    have ht_Icc4 : t ∈ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4 := abs_le.mp ht
    have h_mvt2 := (convex_Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun s _ => hf_d_diff s) h_hop2_bd h0_Icc4 ht_Icc4
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero] at h_mvt2
    have h_hop2 : |deriv (θ_sl y₁) t - deriv (θ_sl y₁) 0| ≤ 4 * D_phase 1 := by
      calc |deriv (θ_sl y₁) t - deriv (θ_sl y₁) 0|
          ≤ D_phase 1 * |t| := h_mvt2
        _ ≤ D_phase 1 * 4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (hD_phase_nn 1)
        _ = 4 * D_phase 1 := mul_comm _ _
    
    have h0_norm2 : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ≤ 2 := by rw [norm_zero]; norm_num
    obtain ⟨hγp₁_cd, _, _, hγp₁_bd⟩ :=
      h_phase_line lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase C_box hC_box
        X_o V_j 0 (perp2D w) w hXo hVj_norm h0_norm2 hw_perp hw_norm
    obtain ⟨hγp₂_cd, _, _, hγp₂_bd⟩ :=
      h_phase_line lam_sys hlam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase (1 / 2) hc_half
        0 V_j 0 (perp2D w) w h0_Bsys hVj_norm h0_norm2 hw_perp hw_norm
    let vp_fn : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun σ => V_j + ρ₀ • (σ • perp2D w + 0)
    let γp₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ =>
      (lam_sys * ρ₀) * inner ℝ (ζ₀ (vp_fn σ, X_o - C_box • vp_fn σ)) w
    let γp₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ =>
      (lam_sys * ρ₀) * inner ℝ (ζ₀ (vp_fn σ, 0 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • vp_fn σ)) w
    let g_perp : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ => κ_n + (γp₁ σ - γp₂ σ)
    have hgp_diff : Differentiable ℝ g_perp :=
      (contDiff_const.add ((hγp₁_cd 1).sub (hγp₂_cd 1))).differentiable (by simp)
    have h_hop1_bd : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2, ‖deriv g_perp σ‖ ≤ D_phase 1 := by
      intro σ hσ
      have hσ_abs4 : |σ| ≤ 4 := by
        have h2 : |σ| ≤ 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨hσ.1, hσ.2⟩
        linarith
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← iteratedDeriv_one]
      dsimp only [g_perp]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const_add (by omega : 0 < 1)]
      have h_sub_fn : (fun s => γp₁ s - γp₂ s) = γp₁ - γp₂ := rfl
      rw [h_sub_fn, iteratedDeriv_sub (hγp₁_cd 1).contDiffAt (hγp₂_cd 1).contDiffAt]
      calc |iteratedDeriv 1 γp₁ σ - iteratedDeriv 1 γp₂ σ|
          ≤ |iteratedDeriv 1 γp₁ σ| + |iteratedDeriv 1 γp₂ σ| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ C_term 1 + C_term 1 :=
            add_le_add (hγp₁_bd 1 le_rfl σ hσ_abs4) (hγp₂_bd 1 le_rfl σ hσ_abs4)
        _ = D_phase 1 := by dsimp only [D_phase]; ring
    have h0_Icc2 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 := by constructor <;> norm_num
    have h_mvt1 := (convex_Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun σ _ => hgp_diff σ) h_hop1_bd h0_Icc2 hy₁
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero] at h_mvt1
    have h_hop1 : |g_perp y₁ - g_perp 0| ≤ 2 * D_phase 1 := by
      calc |g_perp y₁ - g_perp 0|
          ≤ D_phase 1 * |y₁| := h_mvt1
        _ ≤ D_phase 1 * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₁_abs (hD_phase_nn 1)
        _ = 2 * D_phase 1 := mul_comm _ _
    have hgp_y1 : g_perp y₁ = deriv (θ_sl y₁) 0 := by
      rw [hθ_deriv_eq 0]
      dsimp only [g_perp, γp₁, γp₂, γ₁, γ₂, vp_fn, v_fn, z₀]
      have hv_eq : V_j + ρ₀ • (y₁ • perp2D w + 0) = V_j + ρ₀ • ((0 : ℝ) • w + y₁ • perp2D w) := by
        simp
      rw [hv_eq]
    have hgp_0_ge : a₀ * d_jn ≤ g_perp 0 := by
      have hv0 : vp_fn 0 = V_j := by simp [vp_fn]
      dsimp only [g_perp, γp₁, γp₂, κ_n]
      rw [hv0, zero_sub, ← mul_sub, add_comm]
      exact h_center_lo
    have h_d1 := (abs_le.mp h_hop1).1
    have h_d2 := (abs_le.mp h_hop2).1
    rw [hgp_y1] at h_d1
    linarith [ha₀_d_margin, hgp_0_ge, h_d1, h_d2]
  exact ⟨hθ_cd, hu_cd, hθ_lo, hθ_hi, hu_supp, hu_der⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (B D : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ C_ibp : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ibp ∧
      ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 → L ≤ deriv θ t) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 →
          |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| ≤ L * D m) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B k) →
        ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L ^ M

signature.name: nonstationary_phase_1d_arbitrary_ibp
signature.statement:
(M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (B D : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ C_ibp : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ibp ∧
      ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 → L ≤ deriv θ t) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 →
          |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| ≤ L * D m) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B k) →
        ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L ^ M

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_glob : ∀ (K : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 → L ≤ deriv θ t) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ K → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 →
          |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| ≤ L * D m) →
        ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ,
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ) ∧
          (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ ψ t) ∧
          (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 1 → deriv θ t = L * ψ t) ∧
          (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ K → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 1 →
            |iteratedDeriv m ψ t| ≤ max (D m) 0) := by
    intro K L hL θ hθ hθ_lo hθ_hi
    let χ_cut : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
      Real.smoothTransition (2 * (R + 2 - t)) * Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t + R + 2))
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => χ_cut t * (L⁻¹ * deriv θ t) + (1 - χ_cut t)
    have hdθ_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (deriv θ) := by
      intro k
      have hk1 : ContDiff ℝ ((k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) θ := by exact_mod_cast hθ (k + 1)
      exact hk1.deriv'
    have hχ_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k χ_cut := by
      intro k
      have hst : ContDiff ℝ k Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := k)
      have h_aff1 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun t : ℝ => 2 * (R + 2 - t)) :=
        contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
      have h_aff2 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun t : ℝ => 2 * (t + R + 2)) :=
        contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).add contDiff_const)
      exact (hst.comp h_aff1).mul (hst.comp h_aff2)
    have hψ_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ := by
      intro k
      exact ((hχ_cd k).mul (contDiff_const.mul (hdθ_cd k))).add (contDiff_const.sub (hχ_cd k))
    have hψ_ge1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ ψ t := by
      intro t
      have ha0 : 0 ≤ Real.smoothTransition (2 * (R + 2 - t)) := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t + R + 2)) := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hχ0 : 0 ≤ χ_cut t := mul_nonneg ha0 hb0
      by_cases ht : |t| ≤ R + 2
      · have h1 : 1 ≤ L⁻¹ * deriv θ t := by
          rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ hL, mul_one]
          exact hθ_lo t ht
        have hmul : χ_cut t * 1 ≤ χ_cut t * (L⁻¹ * deriv θ t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hχ0
        dsimp only [ψ]
        linarith
      · have ht_gt : R + 2 < |t| := lt_of_not_ge ht
        rcases lt_abs.mp ht_gt with ht_pos | ht_neg
        · have hz : Real.smoothTransition (2 * (R + 2 - t)) = 0 :=
            Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
          have hχz : χ_cut t = 0 := by dsimp only [χ_cut]; rw [hz, zero_mul]
          dsimp only [ψ]
          rw [hχz, zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_add]
        · have hz : Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t + R + 2)) = 0 :=
            Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
          have hχz : χ_cut t = 0 := by dsimp only [χ_cut]; rw [hz, mul_zero]
          dsimp only [ψ]
          rw [hχz, zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_add]
    have h_open_eq : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| < R + 3 / 2 → ψ s = L⁻¹ * deriv θ s := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨hs_lo, hs_hi⟩ := abs_lt.mp hs
      have h1 : Real.smoothTransition (2 * (R + 2 - s)) = 1 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
      have h2 : Real.smoothTransition (2 * (s + R + 2)) = 1 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
      have hχ1 : χ_cut s = 1 := by dsimp only [χ_cut]; rw [h1, h2, mul_one]
      dsimp only [ψ]
      rw [hχ1, one_mul, sub_self, add_zero]
    have hψ_eq : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 1 → deriv θ t = L * ψ t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [h_open_eq t (by linarith), mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hL.ne']
    have hψ_der : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ K → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 1 →
        |iteratedDeriv m ψ t| ≤ max (D m) 0 := by
      intro m hm1 hmK t ht
      let U : Set ℝ := {s : ℝ | |s| < R + 3 / 2}
      have hU_open : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_abs continuous_const
      have ht_U : t ∈ U := by change |t| < R + 3 / 2; linarith
      have h_ev : ψ =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun s => L⁻¹ * deriv θ s) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU_open.mem_nhds ht_U) (fun s hs => h_open_eq s hs)
      have h_it : iteratedDeriv m ψ t = L⁻¹ * iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t := by
        rw [h_ev.iteratedDeriv_eq m]
        exact iteratedDeriv_const_mul L⁻¹ (hdθ_cd m).contDiffAt
      have hL_inv_pos : 0 < L⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hL
      have h_hi := hθ_hi m hm1 hmK t (by linarith)
      calc |iteratedDeriv m ψ t|
          = L⁻¹ * |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| := by
            rw [h_it, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hL_inv_pos]
        _ ≤ L⁻¹ * (L * D m) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_hi hL_inv_pos.le
        _ = D m := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hL.ne' (D m)
        _ ≤ max (D m) 0 := le_max_left _ _
    exact ⟨ψ, hψ_cd, hψ_ge1, hψ_eq, hψ_der⟩
  have h_quot : ∀ (N : ℕ) (B' : ℕ → ℝ),
      ∃ B_next : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ B_next k) ∧
        ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ),
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ) →
          (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ ψ t) →
          (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ N + 1 → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 1 →
            |iteratedDeriv m ψ t| ≤ max (D m) 0) →
        ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ),
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
          (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N + 1 → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B' k) →
          ∃ h : ℝ → ℂ,
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k h) ∧
            (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → h t = 0) ∧
            (∀ t : ℝ, (ψ t : ℂ) * h t = u t) ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (deriv h)) ∧
            (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → deriv h t = 0) ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k (deriv h) t‖ ≤ B_next k) := by
    intro N B'
    let D' : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => max (D m) 0
    have hD'_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ D' m := fun m => le_max_right (D m) 0
    let K_step : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
      Nat.rec (max (B' 0) 0)
        (fun m prev =>
          max prev
            (max (B' (m + 1)) 0 +
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ((m + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * D' (i + 1)) * prev)) n
    have hK_zero : K_step 0 = max (B' 0) 0 := rfl
    have hK_succ : ∀ m : ℕ, K_step (m + 1) =
        max (K_step m)
          (max (B' (m + 1)) 0 +
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ((m + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * D' (i + 1)) *
              K_step m) := fun _ => rfl
    have hK_mono : Monotone K_step :=
      monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun m => by rw [hK_succ]; exact le_max_left _ _)
    have hK_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ K_step m := fun m =>
      le_trans (by rw [hK_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _) (hK_mono (Nat.zero_le m))
    let B_next : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => K_step (k + 1)
    refine ⟨B_next, fun k => hK_nn (k + 1), ?_⟩
    intro ψ hψ_cd hψ_ge1 hψ_der u hu_cd hu_supp hu_bd
    let ψ_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (ψ t : ℂ)
    let h : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (ψ_c t)⁻¹ * u t
    have hψ_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < ψ t := fun t => lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hψ_ge1 t)
    have hψ_c_ne : ∀ t : ℝ, ψ_c t ≠ 0 := fun t =>
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hψ_pos t).ne'
    have hψ_c_norm_ge1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ ‖ψ_c t‖ := by
      intro t
      dsimp only [ψ_c]
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hψ_pos t)]
      exact hψ_ge1 t
    have hh_prod : ∀ t : ℝ, (ψ t : ℂ) * h t = u t := fun t =>
      mul_inv_cancel_left₀ (hψ_c_ne t) (u t)
    have hψ_c_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_c := fun k =>
      Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (hψ_cd k)
    have hh_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k h := fun k =>
      ((hψ_c_cd k).inv hψ_c_ne).mul (hu_cd k)
    have hdh_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (deriv h) := by
      intro k
      have hk1 : ContDiff ℝ ((k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) h := by exact_mod_cast hh_cd (k + 1)
      exact hk1.deriv'
    have hh_supp : ∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → h t = 0 := by
      intro t ht
      dsimp only [h]
      rw [hu_supp t ht, mul_zero]
    have hh_ext : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t₀ : ℝ), R < |t₀| → iteratedDeriv m h t₀ = 0 := by
      intro m t₀ ht₀
      let V : Set ℝ := {s : ℝ | R < |s|}
      have hV_open : IsOpen V := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_abs
      have ht₀_V : t₀ ∈ V := ht₀
      have h_ev : h =ᶠ[nhds t₀] (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds ht₀_V) (fun s hs => hh_supp s (le_of_lt hs))
      rw [h_ev.iteratedDeriv_eq m, iteratedDeriv_const]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    have hdh_ext : ∀ t₀ : ℝ, R < |t₀| → deriv h t₀ = 0 := by
      intro t₀ ht₀
      have h1 := hh_ext 1 t₀ ht₀
      rwa [iteratedDeriv_one] at h1
    have hdh_supp : ∀ t₀ : ℝ, R ≤ |t₀| → deriv h t₀ = 0 := by
      intro t₀ ht₀
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ht₀ with hlt | heq
      · exact hdh_ext t₀ hlt
      · have h_abs : |t₀| = R := heq.symm
        have hdh_cont : Continuous (deriv h) := (hdh_cd 0).continuous
        let x : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => R + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
        have hx_lim : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds R) := by
          have h0 : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds (R + 0)) :=
            tendsto_const_nhds.add tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
          rwa [add_zero] at h0
        have hx_gt : ∀ n : ℕ, R < |x n| := by
          intro n
          have hpos : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
          have hxn_pos : 0 < x n := by dsimp only [x]; linarith
          rw [abs_of_pos hxn_pos]
          dsimp only [x]
          linarith
        rcases (abs_eq hR.le).mp h_abs with ht₀_eq | ht₀_eq
        · rw [ht₀_eq]
          have h_ev0 : (deriv h ∘ x) = fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℂ) := by
            ext n
            exact hdh_ext (x n) (hx_gt n)
          have h_t1 : Filter.Tendsto (deriv h ∘ x) Filter.atTop (nhds (deriv h R)) :=
            (hdh_cont.tendsto R).comp hx_lim
          have h_t2 : Filter.Tendsto (deriv h ∘ x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
            rw [h_ev0]
            exact tendsto_const_nhds
          exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_t1 h_t2
        · rw [ht₀_eq]
          let y : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => -(x n)
          have hy_lim : Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atTop (nhds (-R)) := hx_lim.neg
          have h_ev0 : (deriv h ∘ y) = fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℂ) := by
            ext n
            refine hdh_ext (y n) ?_
            dsimp only [y]
            rw [abs_neg]
            exact hx_gt n
          have h_t1 : Filter.Tendsto (deriv h ∘ y) Filter.atTop (nhds (deriv h (-R))) :=
            (hdh_cont.tendsto (-R)).comp hy_lim
          have h_t2 : Filter.Tendsto (deriv h ∘ y) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
            rw [h_ev0]
            exact tendsto_const_nhds
          exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_t1 h_t2
    have hψ_c_iter : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv m ψ_c t‖ = |iteratedDeriv m ψ t| := by
      intro m t
      have hcomp : ψ_c = ⇑Complex.ofRealLI ∘ ψ := rfl
      rw [hcomp, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv,
        Complex.ofRealLI.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (hψ_cd m).contDiffAt le_rfl,
        norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hh_loc_bd : ∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ R + 1 →
        ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≤ N + 1 → ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ n → ‖iteratedDeriv j h t‖ ≤ K_step n := by
      intro t ht n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro _ j hj
        have hj0 : j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hj
        subst hj0
        rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, hK_zero]
        have hu0 : ‖u t‖ ≤ B' 0 := by
          have h0 := hu_bd 0 (Nat.zero_le _) t
          rwa [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0
        calc ‖h t‖
            = 1 * ‖h t‖ := (one_mul _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖ψ_c t‖ * ‖h t‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hψ_c_norm_ge1 t) (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖ψ_c t * h t‖ := (norm_mul _ _).symm
          _ = ‖u t‖ := by rw [hh_prod t]
          _ ≤ B' 0 := hu0
          _ ≤ max (B' 0) 0 := le_max_left _ _
      | succ n ih =>
        intro hn1 j hj
        have ih' := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn1)
        rcases Nat.of_le_succ hj with hj_le | rfl
        · exact (ih' j hj_le).trans (hK_mono (Nat.le_succ n))
        · have hu_fn : u = fun s => ψ_c s * h s := funext (fun s => (hh_prod s).symm)
          have h_leib : iteratedDeriv (n + 1) u t =
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ((n + 1) + 1),
                ((n + 1).choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i ψ_c t *
                  iteratedDeriv ((n + 1) - i) h t := by
            conv_lhs => rw [hu_fn]
            exact iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (hψ_c_cd (n + 1)).contDiffAt (hh_cd (n + 1)).contDiffAt
          rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h_leib
          simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, iteratedDeriv_zero,
            Nat.sub_zero, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub] at h_leib
          have h_iso : ψ_c t * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) h t =
              iteratedDeriv (n + 1) u t -
                ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                  ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv (i + 1) ψ_c t *
                    iteratedDeriv (n - i) h t :=
            eq_sub_of_add_eq' h_leib.symm
          have h_sum_le :
              ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv (i + 1) ψ_c t *
                  iteratedDeriv (n - i) h t‖ ≤
                (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * D' (i + 1)) *
                  K_step n := by
            calc ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                    ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv (i + 1) ψ_c t *
                      iteratedDeriv (n - i) h t‖
                ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                    ‖((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv (i + 1) ψ_c t *
                      iteratedDeriv (n - i) h t‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
              _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                    (((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * D' (i + 1)) * K_step n := by
                  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_)
                  have hi_lt : i < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
                  rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, hψ_c_iter (i + 1) t]
                  have hd_le : |iteratedDeriv (i + 1) ψ t| ≤ D' (i + 1) :=
                    hψ_der (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) t ht
                  have hh_le : ‖iteratedDeriv (n - i) h t‖ ≤ K_step n :=
                    ih' (n - i) (Nat.sub_le n i)
                  have h_ch_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
                  exact mul_le_mul
                    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_le h_ch_nn)
                    hh_le (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg h_ch_nn (hD'_nn (i + 1)))
              _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * D' (i + 1)) *
                    K_step n := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          have hu_le : ‖iteratedDeriv (n + 1) u t‖ ≤ max (B' (n + 1)) 0 :=
            (hu_bd (n + 1) hn1 t).trans (le_max_left _ _)
          calc ‖iteratedDeriv (n + 1) h t‖
              = 1 * ‖iteratedDeriv (n + 1) h t‖ := (one_mul _).symm
            _ ≤ ‖ψ_c t‖ * ‖iteratedDeriv (n + 1) h t‖ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hψ_c_norm_ge1 t) (norm_nonneg _)
            _ = ‖ψ_c t * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) h t‖ := (norm_mul _ _).symm
            _ ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv (n + 1) u t‖ +
                  ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                    ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv (i + 1) ψ_c t *
                      iteratedDeriv (n - i) h t‖ := by
                rw [h_iso]
                exact norm_sub_le _ _
            _ ≤ max (B' (n + 1)) 0 +
                  (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : ℝ) * D' (i + 1)) *
                    K_step n := add_le_add hu_le h_sum_le
            _ ≤ K_step (n + 1) := by
                rw [hK_succ]
                exact le_max_right _ _
    have hdh_bd : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k (deriv h) t‖ ≤ B_next k := by
      intro k hk t
      rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
      by_cases ht : |t| ≤ R + 1
      · exact hh_loc_bd t ht (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hk) (k + 1) le_rfl
      · have ht_gt : R < |t| := by linarith [lt_of_not_ge ht]
        rw [hh_ext (k + 1) t ht_gt, norm_zero]
        exact hK_nn (k + 1)
    exact ⟨h, hh_cd, hh_supp, hh_prod, hdh_cd, hdh_supp, hdh_bd⟩
  let T : ℝ := R + 1
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by dsimp only [T]; linarith
  have h_ivl_eq : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℂ) (θ : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → g t = 0) →
      (∫ t : ℝ, g t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))) =
        ∫ t in (-T)..T, g t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ)) := by
    intro g θ hg_supp
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith : -T ≤ T)]
    refine (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun t ht => ?_)).symm
    have hR_le : R ≤ |t| := by
      rw [Set.mem_Ioc, not_and_or, not_lt, not_le] at ht
      rcases ht with hle | hlt
      · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
        dsimp only [T] at hle
        linarith
      · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
        dsimp only [T] at hlt
        linarith
    rw [hg_supp t hR_le, zero_mul]
  have h_ibp_base : ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (B₀ : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℂ),
      (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
      (∀ t : ℝ, ‖u t‖ ≤ B₀) →
      ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ 2 * (R + 1) * max B₀ 0 := by
    intro θ B₀ u hu_supp hu_bd
    rw [h_ivl_eq u θ hu_supp]
    have h_pt : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc (-T) T,
        ‖u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ max B₀ 0 := by
      intro t _
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal (θ t), mul_one]
      exact (hu_bd t).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have h_est := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const h_pt
    have h_len : |T - (-T)| = 2 * (R + 1) := by
      have hpos : 0 < T - (-T) := by linarith
      rw [abs_of_pos hpos]
      dsimp only [T]
      ring
    rw [h_len, mul_comm (max B₀ 0)] at h_est
    exact h_est
  have h_ibp_step : ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
      ∀ (u h : ℝ → ℂ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k h) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (deriv h)) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → h t = 0) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → deriv h t = 0) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 1 → ((deriv θ t : ℝ) : ℂ) * h t = (L : ℂ) * u t) →
        L * ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ =
          ‖∫ t : ℝ, deriv h t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ := by
    intro L hL θ hθ u h hh_cd hdh_cd hu_supp hh_supp hdh_supp h_rel
    let v_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))
    let v_c' : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => v_c t * (Complex.I * ((deriv θ t : ℝ) : ℂ))
    rw [h_ivl_eq u θ hu_supp, h_ivl_eq (deriv h) θ hdh_supp]
    have hh_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (-T) T, HasDerivAt h (deriv h t) t := fun t _ =>
      (((hh_cd 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt).hasDerivAt
    have hv_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (-T) T, HasDerivAt v_c (v_c' t) t := by
      intro t _
      have hθ_d : HasDerivAt θ (deriv θ t) t :=
        (((hθ 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt).hasDerivAt
      have hθ_c : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (θ s : ℂ)) ((deriv θ t : ℝ) : ℂ) t :=
        Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hθ_d
      exact (hθ_c.const_mul Complex.I).cexp
    have hdh_int : IntervalIntegrable (deriv h) MeasureTheory.volume (-T) T :=
      (hdh_cd 0).continuous.intervalIntegrable (-T) T
    have hv'_int : IntervalIntegrable v_c' MeasureTheory.volume (-T) T := by
      have hdθ_cd0 : ContDiff ℝ (0 : ℕ) (deriv θ) := (hθ (0 + 1)).deriv'
      have h_cont : Continuous v_c' :=
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hθ 0).continuous))).mul
          (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hdθ_cd0.continuous))
      exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable (-T) T
    have h_parts :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hh_deriv hv_deriv hdh_int hv'_int
    have hh_T : h T = 0 := hh_supp T (by rw [abs_of_pos hT_pos]; dsimp only [T]; linarith)
    have hh_mT : h (-T) = 0 :=
      hh_supp (-T) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hT_pos]; dsimp only [T]; linarith)
    rw [hh_T, hh_mT, zero_mul, zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_sub] at h_parts
    have h_lhs_eq : (fun t : ℝ => h t * v_c' t) =
        fun t : ℝ => (Complex.I * (L : ℂ)) * (u t * v_c t) := by
      ext t
      by_cases ht : |t| ≤ R + 1
      · dsimp only [v_c']
        calc h t * (v_c t * (Complex.I * ((deriv θ t : ℝ) : ℂ)))
            = Complex.I * ((((deriv θ t : ℝ) : ℂ) * h t) * v_c t) := by ring
          _ = Complex.I * (((L : ℂ) * u t) * v_c t) := by rw [h_rel t ht]
          _ = (Complex.I * (L : ℂ)) * (u t * v_c t) := by ring
      · have hR_le : R ≤ |t| := by linarith [lt_of_not_ge ht]
        rw [hh_supp t hR_le, hu_supp t hR_le, zero_mul, zero_mul, mul_zero]
    rw [h_lhs_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_parts
    have h_norm := congr_arg norm h_parts
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le, norm_neg] at h_norm
    exact h_norm
  induction M generalizing B with
  | zero =>
    let C_ibp : ℝ := 2 * (R + 1) * max (B 0) 0
    refine ⟨C_ibp, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro L _hL θ _hθ _hθ_lo _hθ_hi u _hu hu_supp hu_bd
    rw [pow_zero, div_one]
    refine h_ibp_base θ (B 0) u hu_supp (fun t => ?_)
    have h0 := hu_bd 0 le_rfl t
    rwa [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0
  | succ N ih =>
    obtain ⟨B_next, _hBn_nn, h_op⟩ := h_quot N B
    obtain ⟨C_N, hCN_nn, h_ih⟩ := ih B_next
    refine ⟨C_N, hCN_nn, ?_⟩
    intro L hL θ hθ hθ_lo hθ_hi u hu hu_supp hu_bd
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ_cd, hψ_ge1, hψ_eq, hψ_der⟩ :=
      h_glob (N + 1) L hL θ hθ hθ_lo hθ_hi
    obtain ⟨h, hh_cd, hh_supp, hh_prod, hdh_cd, hdh_supp, hdh_bd⟩ :=
      h_op ψ hψ_cd hψ_ge1 hψ_der u hu hu_supp hu_bd
    have h_rel : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 1 → ((deriv θ t : ℝ) : ℂ) * h t = (L : ℂ) * u t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hψ_eq t ht, Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_assoc, hh_prod t]
    have h_eq := h_ibp_step L hL θ hθ u h hh_cd hdh_cd hu_supp hh_supp hdh_supp h_rel
    have h_rec := h_ih L hL θ hθ hθ_lo
      (fun m hm1 hmN t ht => hθ_hi m hm1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmN) t ht)
      (deriv h) hdh_cd hdh_supp hdh_bd
    rw [le_div_iff₀' (pow_pos hL (N + 1))]
    have hLN_pos : 0 < L ^ N := pow_pos hL N
    calc L ^ (N + 1) * ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖
        = L ^ N * (L * ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖) := by
          rw [pow_succ]
          ring
      _ = L ^ N * ‖∫ t : ℝ, deriv h t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ := by
          rw [h_eq]
      _ ≤ L ^ N * (C_N / L ^ N) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rec hLN_pos.le
      _ = C_N := mul_div_cancel₀ C_N hLN_pos.ne'

informal_problem.statement:
(A R_win : ℝ) (K_pair : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hK_pair : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ K_pair M) :
    ∃ C_tail : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ C_tail M) ∧
      ∀ (M : ℕ), 3 ≤ M →
      ∀ (lam_sys R_dom ρ_obs E_f : ℝ),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        4 ≤ lam_sys → ρ₀ ≤ ρ_obs → 0 ≤ E_f →
      ∀ (V_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (Y_j ν_j : (ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (F_modes : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
        (X_ex : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c pair_o : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ),
        (∀ q ∈ F_modes, q.1 ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom) →
        (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom, ∀ n : ℤ × ℤ,
          (j, n) ∉ F_modes → 1 ≤ ‖X_ex (j, n) - Y_j j‖) →
        (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
          R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ j - V_o‖ →
          ∀ n : ℤ × ℤ, pair_o j n = 0) →
        (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom, ∀ n : ℤ × ℤ,
          let d_jn := ρ₀⁻¹ * ‖X_ex (j, n) - Y_j j‖
          ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν_j j‖ ≤ A * d_jn ∧
          ‖pair_o j n‖ ≤ K_pair M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M) →
        (((∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom, Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ‖c j n‖ ^ 2)) →
          (∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom, ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖c j n‖ ^ 2) ≤ E_f →
          (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
            Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
              if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ) else c j n * pair_o j n)) ∧
          ‖∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
            ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ,
              if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ) else c j n * pair_o j n‖ ^ 2 ≤
            C_tail M * ρ₀ ^ (2 * M - 2) * E_f) ∧
         (∀ (R : ℝ), 1 ≤ R →
           ∀ (S_far : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))), S_far ⊆ F_modes →
             (∀ q ∈ S_far,
               R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1 - V_o‖ ∨
               R * ρ₀ ≤ ‖X_ex q - Y_j q.1‖) →
             (∑ q ∈ S_far, ‖c q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f) →
             ‖∑ q ∈ S_far, c q.1 q.2 * pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤
               C_tail M * R ^ (-((2 * M - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * E_f))

proof.tactics:
by
  let C_ov : ℝ := (2 * R_win + 8) ^ 2
  let C_lat : ℕ → ℝ := fun M => 16 * (2 * A) ^ (2 * M) * (K_pair M) ^ 2
  let C_tail : ℕ → ℝ := fun M => C_ov * C_lat M
  have hC_ov_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_ov := by
    dsimp [C_ov]
    nlinarith [hR_win]
  have hC_lat_ge1 : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ C_lat M := by
    intro M
    dsimp [C_lat]
    have h2A : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * A) ^ (2 * M) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 ^ (2 * M) := (one_pow _).symm
        _ ≤ (2 * A) ^ (2 * M) := pow_le_pow_left₀ zero_le_one (by linarith [hA]) (2 * M)
    have hKp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (K_pair M) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hK_pair M]
    nlinarith [h2A, hKp]
  have hC_tail_ge1 : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ C_tail M := by
    intro M
    dsimp [C_tail]
    nlinarith [hC_ov_ge1, hC_lat_ge1 M]
  refine ⟨C_tail, hC_tail_ge1, ?_⟩
  intro M hM lam_sys R_dom ρ_obs E_f
  dsimp only
  set ρ₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  intro hlam_sys hρ_le hE_f V_o Y_j ν_j F_modes X_ex c pair_o
    hF_vel h_compl_sep h_vel_zero h_pair_bound
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam_sys := by linarith
  have hsqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt lam_sys := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam_pos
  have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := inv_pos.mpr hsqrt_pos
  have hρ_obs_pos : 0 < ρ_obs := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ₀_pos hρ_le
  
  have h_lat_sum : ∀ (R : ℝ), 1 ≤ R → ∀ (ν : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      ∑ n ∈ S, ((R + ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν‖) ^ (2 * M))⁻¹ ≤ 16 / R ^ (2 * M - 2) := by
    intro R hR ν S
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
    have h_ray : ∀ K : ℕ,
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, ((R + (j : ℝ)) ^ M)⁻¹ ≤ 2 / R ^ (M - 1) := by
      intro K
      cases K with
      | zero =>
        simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]
        positivity
      | succ m =>
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
        have h0 : ((R + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ M)⁻¹ ≤ 1 / R ^ (M - 1) := by
          simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, one_div]
          have hM1_eq : (M - 1) + 1 = M := by omega
          have hRM : R ^ (M - 1) ≤ R ^ M := by
            rw [← hM1_eq, pow_succ]
            exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (pow_nonneg hR_pos.le _) hR
          exact inv_anti₀ (pow_pos hR_pos (M - 1)) hRM
        have h_step : ∀ i : ℕ,
            ((R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ M)⁻¹ ≤
              (R ^ (M - 2))⁻¹ * ((R + (i : ℝ))⁻¹ - (R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) := by
          intro i
          set u : ℝ := R + (i : ℝ)
          have hu_ge : R ≤ u := by
            dsimp [u]
            linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) i]
          have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hR_pos hu_ge
          have hu1_eq : R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = u + 1 := by
            dsimp [u]
            push_cast
            ring
          rw [hu1_eq]
          have hu1_pos : 0 < u + 1 := by linarith
          have hM2 : (M - 2) + 2 = M := by omega
          have h_denom : R ^ (M - 2) * (u * (u + 1)) ≤ (u + 1) ^ M := by
            rw [← hM2, pow_add]
            refine mul_le_mul ?_ ?_ (mul_nonneg hu_pos.le hu1_pos.le) (pow_nonneg hu1_pos.le _)
            · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hR_pos.le (by linarith) (M - 2)
            · nlinarith
          have h_inv := inv_anti₀ (mul_pos (pow_pos hR_pos (M - 2)) (mul_pos hu_pos hu1_pos)) h_denom
          refine le_trans h_inv (le_of_eq ?_)
          have hRpow_ne : R ^ (M - 2) ≠ 0 := (pow_pos hR_pos (M - 2)).ne'
          field_simp [hRpow_ne, hu_pos.ne', hu1_pos.ne']
          ring
        have h_sum_step : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ M)⁻¹ ≤
            1 / R ^ (M - 1) := by
          calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ M)⁻¹
              ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
                  (R ^ (M - 2))⁻¹ * ((R + (i : ℝ))⁻¹ - (R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_step i)
            _ = (R ^ (M - 2))⁻¹ *
                  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((R + (i : ℝ))⁻¹ - (R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) :=
                (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
            _ = (R ^ (M - 2))⁻¹ * ((R + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ - (R + (m : ℝ))⁻¹) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_range_sub' (fun i : ℕ => (R + (i : ℝ))⁻¹) m]
            _ ≤ (R ^ (M - 2))⁻¹ * R⁻¹ := by
                refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg hR_pos.le _))
                have hm_nn : 0 ≤ (R + (m : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
                  have : 0 < R + (m : ℝ) := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hR_pos (Nat.cast_nonneg m)
                  positivity
                simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
                linarith
            _ = 1 / R ^ (M - 1) := by
                have hM1 : (M - 2) + 1 = M - 1 := by omega
                rw [← hM1, pow_succ]
                field_simp [hR_pos.ne']
        calc (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, ((R + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ M)⁻¹) +
                ((R + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ M)⁻¹
            ≤ 1 / R ^ (M - 1) + 1 / R ^ (M - 1) := add_le_add h_sum_step h0
          _ = 2 / R ^ (M - 1) := by ring
    have h_1d : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (K : ℕ),
        let k₀ : ℤ := ⌊μ⌋
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc (k₀ - (K : ℤ)) (k₀ + 1 + (K : ℤ)),
          ((R + |(m : ℝ) - μ|) ^ M)⁻¹ ≤ 4 / R ^ (M - 1) := by
      intro μ K
      dsimp only
      set k₀ : ℤ := ⌊μ⌋
      let I_set : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (k₀ - (K : ℤ)) (k₀ + 1 + (K : ℤ))
      let L : Finset ℤ := (Finset.range (K + 1)).image (fun j : ℕ => k₀ - (j : ℤ))
      let U : Finset ℤ := (Finset.range (K + 1)).image (fun j : ℕ => k₀ + 1 + (j : ℤ))
      have h_sub : I_set ⊆ L ∪ U := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hz
        rw [Finset.mem_union]
        by_cases hzk : z ≤ k₀
        · left
          rw [Finset.mem_image]
          refine ⟨(k₀ - z).toNat, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
        · right
          rw [Finset.mem_image]
          refine ⟨(z - (k₀ + 1)).toNat, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
      have h_disj : Disjoint L U := by
        rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
        intro z hzL hzU
        obtain ⟨j₁, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hzL
        obtain ⟨j₂, _, h_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hzU
        omega
      have hL_le : ∑ m ∈ L, ((R + |(m : ℝ) - μ|) ^ M)⁻¹ ≤ 2 / R ^ (M - 1) := by
        have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun j : ℕ => k₀ - (j : ℤ)) ↑(Finset.range (K + 1)) := by
          intro j₁ _ j₂ _ h
          dsimp only at h
          omega
        rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
        refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)) (h_ray (K + 1))
        have hj_abs : (j : ℝ) ≤ |((k₀ - (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) - μ| := by

    have h_fact : ∀ n : ℤ × ℤ,
        ((R + ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν‖) ^ (2 * M))⁻¹ ≤
          ((R + |(n.1 : ℝ) - ν.ofLp 0|) ^ M)⁻¹ * ((R + |(n.2 : ℝ) - ν.ofLp 1|) ^ M)⁻¹ := by
      intro n

      set y : ℝ := |(n.2 : ℝ) - ν.ofLp 1|
      set r : ℝ := ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν‖
      have hx_nn : 0 ≤ x := abs_nonneg _
      have hy_nn : 0 ≤ y := abs_nonneg _
      have hr_nn : 0 ≤ r := norm_nonneg _
      have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by

        have hc1 : (gridPt2D 1 n - ν).ofLp 1 = (n.2 : ℝ) - ν.ofLp 1 := by simp [gridPt2D]

      have hRy_pos : 0 < R + y := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hR_pos hy_nn
      have h_pow : (R + x) ^ M * (R + y) ^ M ≤ (R + r) ^ (2 * M) := by

      refine le_trans h_inv (le_of_eq ?_)

      have hyM_ne : (R + y) ^ M ≠ 0 := (pow_pos hRy_pos M).ne'

      rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc]

    have h0_sum := h_1d (ν.ofLp 0) K
    have h1_sum := h_1d (ν.ofLp 1) K
    have h1_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ n₂ ∈ I₁, ((R + |(n₂ : ℝ) - ν.ofLp 1|) ^ M)⁻¹ :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun n₂ _ => by

    calc ∑ n ∈ S, ((R + ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν‖) ^ (2 * M))⁻¹

      _ = (∑ n₁ ∈ I₀, ((R + |(n₁ : ℝ) - ν.ofLp 0|) ^ M)⁻¹) *

          have h_exp : (M - 1) + (M - 1) = 2 * M - 2 := by omega

  have h_vel_card : ∀ (J : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),

      have hc1_le : |ρ₀ * (j.2 : ℝ) - V_o.ofLp 1| ≤ (R_win + 2) * ρ_obs := by

      have hL_ge : (R_win + 2) * (ρ_obs / ρ₀) ≤ (L : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _

        have h_id : (j.1 : ℝ) - ρ₀⁻¹ * V_o.ofLp 0 = ρ₀⁻¹ * (ρ₀ * (j.1 : ℝ) - V_o.ofLp 0) := by
          field_simp [hρ₀_pos.ne']
        rw [h_id, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hρ₀_pos)]
        calc ρ₀⁻¹ * |ρ₀ * (j.1 : ℝ) - V_o.ofLp 0|

          _ = (R_win + 2) * (ρ_obs / ρ₀) := by ring

          field_simp [hρ₀_pos.ne']

      obtain ⟨hj2_lo, hj2_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hj2_abs

      have hk0_lt : ρ₀⁻¹ * V_o.ofLp 0 < (k₀ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hk1_fl : (k₁ : ℝ) ≤ ρ₀⁻¹ * V_o.ofLp 1 := Int.floor_le _
      have hk1_lt : ρ₀⁻¹ * V_o.ofLp 1 < (k₁ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hj1_a : ((k₀ - (L : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (j.1 : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
      have hj1_b : (j.1 : ℝ) < ((k₀ + (L : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
      have hj2_a : ((k₁ - (L : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (j.2 : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
      have hj2_b : (j.2 : ℝ) < ((k₁ + (L : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith

      have hj2_int_b : j.2 < k₁ + (L : ℤ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hj2_b

  have h_l2_cs : ∀ (a b : (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ) (B : ℝ),
      0 ≤ B →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ‖a n‖ ^ 2) →

        ‖∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, a n * b n‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖a n‖ ^ 2) * B := by
    intro a b B hB ha hb

      summable_of_sum_le (fun n => sq_nonneg ‖b n‖) hb

      hab_dom.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => by

      intro S

      _ = E_a * B := Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg hEa_nn hB)

            pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_norm_le 2
        _ = ((K_pair M) ^ 2 * (2 * A) ^ (2 * M) * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2) *
              ((R + ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν_j j‖) ^ (2 * M))⁻¹ := by
            have hA_exp : ((2 * A) ^ M) ^ 2 = (2 * A) ^ (2 * M) := by
              rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm M 2]
            have hR_exp : (((R + ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν_j j‖) ^ M)⁻¹) ^ 2 =
                ((R + ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν_j j‖) ^ (2 * M))⁻¹ := by
              rw [inv_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm M 2]
            rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, hA_exp, hR_exp]
    calc ∑ n ∈ N, ‖pair_o j n‖ ^ 2
        ≤ ∑ n ∈ N, ((K_pair M) ^ 2 * (2 * A) ^ (2 * M) * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2) *
            ((R + ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν_j j‖) ^ (2 * M))⁻¹ :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_term
      _ = ((K_pair M) ^ 2 * (2 * A) ^ (2 * M) * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2) *
            ∑ n ∈ N, ((R + ‖gridPt2D 1 n - ν_j j‖) ^ (2 * M))⁻¹ :=
          (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ ((K_pair M) ^ 2 * (2 * A) ^ (2 * M) * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2) *
            (16 / R ^ (2 * M - 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_lat_sum R hR (ν_j j) N) (by positivity)
      _ = C_lat M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2 / R ^ (2 * M - 2) := by
          dsimp [C_lat]
          ring
  let p_ov : (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop := fun j => ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ j - V_o‖ < R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro hc_sum hc_tot
    let R₀ : ℝ := ρ₀⁻¹
    have hR₀_eq_sqrt : R₀ = Real.sqrt lam_sys := by
      dsimp [R₀, ρ₀]
      rw [inv_inv]
    have hR₀_ge2 : 2 ≤ R₀ := by
      have hsq : R₀ ^ 2 = lam_sys := by
        rw [hR₀_eq_sqrt, Real.sq_sqrt hlam_pos.le]
      have hR₀_nn : 0 ≤ R₀ := by rw [hR₀_eq_sqrt]; exact hsqrt_pos.le
      nlinarith [hsq, hlam_sys, hR₀_nn]
    have hR₀_ge1 : 1 ≤ R₀ := by linarith
    have hR₀_pow : (R₀ ^ (2 * M - 2))⁻¹ = ρ₀ ^ (2 * M - 2) := by
      dsimp [R₀]
      rw [inv_pow, inv_inv]
    let B₀ : ℝ := C_lat M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2 * ρ₀ ^ (2 * M - 2)
    have hB₀_nn : 0 ≤ B₀ := by
      dsimp [B₀]
      have := hC_lat_ge1 M
      positivity
    have h_j_all : ∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
        Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
          if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ) else c j n * pair_o j n) ∧
        ‖∑' n : ℤ × ℤ,
          if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ) else c j n * pair_o j n‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖c j n‖ ^ 2) * B₀ := by
      intro j hj
      let b_j : (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ := fun n => if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then 0 else pair_o j n
      have h_fn_eq : (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
          if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ) else c j n * pair_o j n) =
          (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => c j n * b_j n) := by
        ext n
        dsimp [b_j]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [h_fn_eq]
      refine h_l2_cs (c j) b_j B₀ hB₀_nn (hc_sum j hj) (fun S => ?_)
      let S' : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := S.filter (fun n => (j, n) ∉ F_modes)
      have h_sum_eq : ∑ n ∈ S, ‖b_j n‖ ^ 2 = ∑ n ∈ S', ‖pair_o j n‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
        dsimp [b_j]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [h_sum_eq]
      have h_sep_S' : ∀ n ∈ S', R₀ ≤ ρ₀⁻¹ * ‖X_ex (j, n) - Y_j j‖ := by
        intro n hn
        have hnot : (j, n) ∉ F_modes := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
        have h1 : 1 ≤ ‖X_ex (j, n) - Y_j j‖ := h_compl_sep j hj n hnot
        calc R₀ = ρ₀⁻¹ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
          _ ≤ ρ₀⁻¹ * ‖X_ex (j, n) - Y_j j‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ₀_pos.le)
      calc ∑ n ∈ S', ‖pair_o j n‖ ^ 2
          ≤ C_lat M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2 / R₀ ^ (2 * M - 2) :=
            h_patch j hj R₀ hR₀_ge1 S' h_sep_S'
        _ = B₀ := by
            dsimp [B₀]
            rw [div_eq_mul_inv, hR₀_pow]
    refine ⟨fun j hj => (h_j_all j hj).1, ?_⟩
    letI : DecidablePred p_ov := Classical.decPred p_ov
    let J_ov : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := (pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom).filter p_ov
    let T_j : (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ := fun j =>
      ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ) else c j n * pair_o j n
    have h_outer_eq : ∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom, T_j j = ∑ j ∈ J_ov, T_j j := by
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset p_ov _) (fun j hj hnot => ?_)).symm
      have hj_sep : R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ j - V_o‖ := by
        have hnot_ov : ¬ p_ov j := fun hp => hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hj, hp⟩)
        exact not_lt.mp hnot_ov
      simp only [T_j, h_vel_zero j hj hj_sep, mul_zero, ite_self, tsum_zero]
    change ‖∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom, T_j j‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_tail M * ρ₀ ^ (2 * M - 2) * E_f
    rw [h_outer_eq]
    have hJ_card : (J_ov.card : ℝ) ≤ C_ov * (ρ_obs / ρ₀) ^ 2 :=
      h_vel_card J_ov (fun j hj => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.le)
    have hT_sum_sq : ∑ j ∈ J_ov, ‖T_j j‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f * B₀ := by
      calc ∑ j ∈ J_ov, ‖T_j j‖ ^ 2
          ≤ ∑ j ∈ J_ov, (∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖c j n‖ ^ 2) * B₀ :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => (h_j_all j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1).2)
        _ = (∑ j ∈ J_ov, ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖c j n‖ ^ 2) * B₀ := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ (∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom, ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖c j n‖ ^ 2) * B₀ := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hB₀_nn
            exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
              (fun _ _ _ => tsum_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _))
        _ ≤ E_f * B₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_tot hB₀_nn
    calc ‖∑ j ∈ J_ov, T_j j‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (∑ j ∈ J_ov, ‖T_j j‖) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_sum_le J_ov T_j) 2
      _ ≤ (J_ov.card : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ J_ov, ‖T_j j‖ ^ 2 := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
      _ ≤ (C_ov * (ρ_obs / ρ₀) ^ 2) * (E_f * B₀) :=
          mul_le_mul hJ_card hT_sum_sq
            (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
            (by have := hC_ov_ge1; positivity)
      _ = C_tail M * ρ₀ ^ (2 * M - 2) * E_f := by
          dsimp [C_tail, B₀]
          field_simp [hρ₀_pos.ne', hρ_obs_pos.ne']
  · 
    intro R hR S_far hS_sub h_sep hc_far
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
    letI : DecidablePred p_ov := Classical.decPred p_ov
    letI : DecidablePred (fun q : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) => p_ov q.1) := Classical.decPred _
    let S_act : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := S_far.filter (fun q => p_ov q.1)
    have h_sum_act : ∑ q ∈ S_far, c q.1 q.2 * pair_o q.1 q.2 =
        ∑ q ∈ S_act, c q.1 q.2 * pair_o q.1 q.2 := by
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (fun q hq hnot => ?_)).symm
      have hq_vel : q.1 ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom := hF_vel q (hS_sub hq)
      have hq_sep : R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1 - V_o‖ := by
        have hnot_ov : ¬ p_ov q.1 := fun hp => hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hq, hp⟩)
        exact not_lt.mp hnot_ov
      rw [h_vel_zero q.1 hq_vel hq_sep q.2, mul_zero]
    rw [h_sum_act]
    have hc_act : ∑ q ∈ S_act, ‖c q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f := by
      refine le_trans ?_ hc_far
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        (fun _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    let J_act : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := S_act.image Prod.fst
    have hJ_act_props : ∀ j ∈ J_act, j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom ∧ p_ov j := by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨q, hq_act, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
      obtain ⟨hq_far, hq_ov⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq_act
      exact ⟨hF_vel q (hS_sub hq_far), hq_ov⟩
    have hJ_act_card : (J_act.card : ℝ) ≤ C_ov * (ρ_obs / ρ₀) ^ 2 :=
      h_vel_card J_act (fun j hj => (hJ_act_props j hj).2.le)
    have h_pair_act : ∑ q ∈ S_act, ‖pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤
        C_tail M / R ^ (2 * M - 2) := by
      have h_maps : ∀ q ∈ S_act, q.1 ∈ J_act :=
        fun q hq => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst hq
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps]
      have h_each_j : ∀ j ∈ J_act,
          (∑ q ∈ S_act with q.1 = j, ‖pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2) ≤
            C_lat M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2 / R ^ (2 * M - 2) := by
        intro j hj
        obtain ⟨hj_vel, hj_ov⟩ := hJ_act_props j hj
        let F_j : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := S_act.filter (fun q => q.1 = j)
        let N_j : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := F_j.image Prod.snd
        have hinj : Set.InjOn Prod.snd (↑F_j : Set ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) := by
          intro q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂ h2
          exact Prod.ext ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hq₁).2.trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq₂).2.symm) h2
        have h_fib_eq : (∑ q ∈ F_j, ‖pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2) =
            ∑ n ∈ N_j, ‖pair_o j n‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq => ?_)
          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2]
        change (∑ q ∈ F_j, ‖pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2) ≤ _
        rw [h_fib_eq]
        refine h_patch j hj_vel R hR N_j (fun n hn => ?_)
        obtain ⟨q, hqF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn
        obtain ⟨hq_act, hq1⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hqF
        have hq_eq : q = (j, q.2) := Prod.ext hq1 rfl
        have hq_far : (j, q.2) ∈ S_far := hq_eq ▸ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq_act).1
        rcases h_sep (j, q.2) hq_far with h_vsep | h_xsep
        · exfalso
          exact not_le.mpr hj_ov h_vsep
        · calc R = ρ₀⁻¹ * (R * ρ₀) := by field_simp [hρ₀_pos.ne']
            _ ≤ ρ₀⁻¹ * ‖X_ex (j, q.2) - Y_j j‖ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_xsep (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ₀_pos.le)
      calc ∑ j ∈ J_act, ∑ q ∈ S_act with q.1 = j, ‖pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2
          ≤ ∑ _j ∈ J_act, (C_lat M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2 / R ^ (2 * M - 2)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_j
        _ = (J_act.card : ℝ) * (C_lat M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2 / R ^ (2 * M - 2)) := by simp
        _ ≤ (C_ov * (ρ_obs / ρ₀) ^ 2) * (C_lat M * (ρ₀ / ρ_obs) ^ 2 / R ^ (2 * M - 2)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hJ_act_card
              (by have := hC_lat_ge1 M; positivity)
        _ = C_tail M / R ^ (2 * M - 2) := by
            dsimp [C_tail]
            field_simp [hρ₀_pos.ne', hρ_obs_pos.ne', hR_pos.ne']
    have h_rpow_eq : C_tail M / R ^ (2 * M - 2) =
        C_tail M * R ^ (-((2 * M - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Real.rpow_neg hR_pos.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
    calc ‖∑ q ∈ S_act, c q.1 q.2 * pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (∑ q ∈ S_act, ‖c q.1 q.2 * pair_o q.1 q.2‖) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
            (norm_sum_le S_act (fun q => c q.1 q.2 * pair_o q.1 q.2)) 2
      _ = (∑ q ∈ S_act, ‖c q.1 q.2‖ * ‖pair_o q.1 q.2‖) ^ 2 := by
          congr 1
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => norm_mul _ _)
      _ ≤ (∑ q ∈ S_act, ‖c q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2) * (∑ q ∈ S_act, ‖pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2) :=
          Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq S_act _ _
      _ ≤ E_f * (C_tail M / R ^ (2 * M - 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul hc_act h_pair_act
            (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)) hE_f
      _ = C_tail M * R ^ (-((2 * M - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * E_f := by
          rw [h_rpow_eq]
          ring

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨h_meas_L, h_meas_V, M_lip, K_ext, f_ext, hM_nn, h_lip_cone, hf_lip, hf_eq, hf_ae⟩ :=
    submodular_cone_global_lipschitz_and_partials n hn c d d_v E_cone hc_inj hd_nn hE_pos f hf
  obtain ⟨F_seq, hF_c2, hF_unif, hF_signs, hF_L1⟩ :=
    submodular_mollifier_approximants n c d d_v E_cone hd_nn f hf h_meas_L h_meas_V
      K_ext f_ext hf_lip hf_eq hf_ae
  obtain ⟨h_flux_lip, h_top_flux, h_ftc_smooth⟩ :=
    smooth_plane_flux_and_slice_lipschitz n hn j_top c d d_v hc_inj hc_top hd_nn
  have hF_slice_lip : ∀ (K δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ C_mix : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_mix ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ) (η η' : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
          (∀ (θ i u : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            |i| ≤ K + 1 → u ∈ Set.Icc (δ / 2) (1 - δ / 2) →
            HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v (F_seq k)
              (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + ((1 - θ) • η + θ • η'))) →
          (∀ j : Fin n, η.1 j = 0 → η'.1 j = 0 →
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j) -
                fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisL n j)|) ≤
              C_mix * ((∑ k' : Fin n, |η.1 k' - η'.1 k'|) + |η.2 - η'.2|)) ∧
          (η.2 = 0 → η'.2 = 0 →
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisV n) -
                fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisV n)|) ≤
              C_mix * (∑ k' : Fin n, |η.1 k' - η'.1 k'|)) := by
    intro K δ hK hδ0 hδ1
    obtain ⟨C_mix, hC_nn, _, h_sl⟩ := h_flux_lip K δ hK hδ0 hδ1
    exact ⟨C_mix, hC_nn, fun k η η' h_sg => h_sl (F_seq k) η η' (hF_c2 k) h_sg⟩
  obtain ⟨a, D, η_seq, k_seq, ha_meas_bds, hD_meas_bds, h_cl4, h_mk, h_cone_nbhd, h_diag_err⟩ :=
    strong_plane_trace_limit_extraction n hn c d d_v E_cone hc_inj hd_nn hE_pos
      (conePartialL n c d E_cone f) (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f)
      h_meas_L h_meas_V F_seq hF_c2 hF_signs hF_L1 hF_slice_lip
  have h_zpow_eq : ∀ m : ℕ, (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m : ℤ)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m
    rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, one_div, inv_pow]
  have h_half_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h_zpow_shift_tendsto : ∀ m₀ : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((m + m₀ : ℕ) : ℤ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro m₀
    simp_rw [h_zpow_eq]
    exact (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat m₀).mpr h_half_tendsto
  have h_plane_c1 : ∀ (α β : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 1 α → ContDiff ℝ 1 β →
      ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ => planeEmbed n c (α xy, β xy) + η) := by
    intro α β η hα hβ
    change ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ =>
      (fun j : Fin n => α xy + c j * β xy + η.1 j, β xy + η.2))
    exact (contDiff_pi.mpr (fun j =>
      (hα.add (contDiff_const.mul hβ)).add contDiff_const)).prodMk (hβ.add contDiff_const)
  have h_fderiv_c1 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (α β : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (v : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 1 α → ContDiff ℝ 1 β →
      ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ =>
        fderiv ℝ (F_seq (k_seq m)) (planeEmbed n c (α xy, β xy) + η_seq m) v) := by
    intro m α β v hα hβ
    exact ((hF_c2 (k_seq m)).contDiff_fderiv_apply (by norm_num : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 2)).comp
      ((h_plane_c1 α β (η_seq m) hα hβ).prodMk contDiff_const)
  have h_signs_diag : ∀ (m : ℕ) (i u : ℝ),
      u ∈ Set.Icc ((2 * (m + 4 : ℝ))⁻¹) (1 - (2 * (m + 4 : ℝ))⁻¹) →
      HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v (F_seq (k_seq m)) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η_seq m) :=
    fun m i u hu => hF_signs (k_seq m) _ (h_cone_nbhd m i u hu)
  let G_diag : ℕ → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ := fun m => F_seq (k_seq m)
  let dL_diag : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun m j iu =>

        (-a j_top (i, u) * W₁ (i, u) + D (i, u) * W₂ (i, u))
    have hI_sm_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ I_sm m := by
      intro m
      let m' : ℕ := m + m₀
      refine h_top_flux (G_diag m') (η_seq m') φ K δ (hF_c2 (k_seq m')) hφ_c1 hK hδ0 hδ1
        hφ_nn hφ_supp (fun i u _ hu => ?_)
      have hm_δ : ((2 * ((m' : ℕ) + 4 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ≤ δ := by
        have h_le : (m₀ + 4 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((m' : ℕ) + 4 : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [m']
          push_cast
          linarith
        exact (inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h_le).trans hm₀_δ
      exact h_signs_diag m' i u ⟨hm_δ.trans hu.1, hu.2.trans (by linarith)⟩
    have hI_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto I_sm Filter.atTop (nhds I_lim) := by
      rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
      have h_zero_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ =>
          B_φ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((m + m₀ : ℕ) : ℤ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (h_zpow_shift_tendsto m₀).const_mul B_φ
      refine squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun m => ?_) h_zero_lim
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      let m' : ℕ := m + m₀
      let F_sm : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun iu => -dL_diag m' j_top iu * W₁ iu + dV_diag m' iu * W₂ iu
      let F_tr : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun iu => -a j_top iu * W₁ iu + D iu * W₂ iu
      have hF_sm_cont : Continuous F_sm :=
        ((hdL_cont m' j_top).neg.mul hW₁_cont).add ((hdV_cont m').mul hφ_i_cont)
      have hF_tr_meas : Measurable F_tr :=
        ((ha_meas_bds j_top).1.neg.mul hW₁_cont.measurable).add
          (hD_meas_bds.1.mul hφ_i_cont.measurable)
      let H_c_tr : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun iu => d j_top * |W₁ iu| + d_v * |W₂ iu|
      have hHc_tr_cont : Continuous H_c_tr :=
        (continuous_const.mul hW₁_cont.abs).add (continuous_const.mul hφ_i_cont.abs)
      have hF_tr_le : ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, |F_tr iu| ≤ |H_c_tr iu| + 0 := by
        intro iu
        have ha_iu := (ha_meas_bds j_top).2 iu
        have hD_iu := hD_meas_bds.2 iu
        have hHc_nn : 0 ≤ H_c_tr iu := by
          dsimp [H_c_tr]
          exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hd_nn.1 j_top) (abs_nonneg _))
            (mul_nonneg hd_nn.2 (abs_nonneg _))
        rw [add_zero, abs_of_nonneg hHc_nn]
        calc |-a j_top iu * W₁ iu + D iu * W₂ iu|
            ≤ |-a j_top iu * W₁ iu| + |D iu * W₂ iu| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a j_top iu * |W₁ iu| + D iu * |W₂ iu| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg ha_iu.1, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hD_iu.1]
          _ ≤ d j_top * |W₁ iu| + d_v * |W₂ iu| :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha_iu.2 (abs_nonneg _))
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD_iu.2 (abs_nonneg _))
      have hF_sm_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun ui : ℝ × ℝ => F_sm (ui.2, ui.1))
          (Set.Ioc δ (1 - δ) ×ˢ Set.Ioc (-K) K) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        h_bdd_rect_int _ (fun ui => F_sm (ui.2, ui.1)) 0 δ (1 - δ) (-K) K
          (hF_sm_cont.comp continuous_swap).measurable (hF_sm_cont.comp continuous_swap)
          (fun _ => by simp)
      have hF_tr_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun ui : ℝ × ℝ => F_tr (ui.2, ui.1))
          (Set.Ioc δ (1 - δ) ×ˢ Set.Ioc (-K) K) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        h_bdd_rect_int _ (fun ui => H_c_tr (ui.2, ui.1)) 0 δ (1 - δ) (-K) K
          (hF_tr_meas.comp measurable_swap) (hHc_tr_cont.comp continuous_swap)
          (fun ui => hF_tr_le (ui.2, ui.1))
      have h_diff_eq : I_sm m - I_lim =
          ∫ p in Set.Ioc δ (1 - δ) ×ˢ Set.Ioc (-K) K,
            (F_sm (p.2, p.1) - F_tr (p.2, p.1)) := by
        dsimp [I_sm, I_lim]
        rw [h_rect_eq_prod (fun ui => F_sm (ui.2, ui.1)) δ (1 - δ) (-K) K
          (by linarith) (by linarith) hF_sm_int,
          h_rect_eq_prod (fun ui => F_tr (ui.2, ui.1)) δ (1 - δ) (-K) K
          (by linarith) (by linarith) hF_tr_int,
          ← MeasureTheory.integral_sub hF_sm_int hF_tr_int]
      rw [h_diff_eq]
      have h_K_m' : K ≤ (m' + 2 : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [m']
        push_cast
        linarith
      have h_δ_m' : ((m' + 4 : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ δ := by
        have h_le : (m₀ + 4 : ℝ) ≤ (m' + 4 : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [m']
          push_cast
          linarith
        exact (inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h_le).trans hm₀_δ
      have hEtot_big := h_bdd_rect_int (E_tot m') (H_cont_diag m') B_cap
        (-((m' + 2 : ℝ))) (m' + 2 : ℝ) ((m' + 4 : ℝ)⁻¹) (1 - (m' + 4 : ℝ)⁻¹)
        (hEtot_meas m') (hH_cont_diag m') (hEtot_le_cont m')
      have hEtot_sub : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (E_tot m')
        (Set.Ioc (-K) K ×ˢ Set.Ioc δ (1 - δ)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hEtot_big.mono_set (Set.prod_mono
          (Set.Ioc_subset_Ioc (by linarith) h_K_m')
          (Set.Ioc_subset_Ioc h_δ_m' (by linarith)))
      have hEtot_sw_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun ui : ℝ × ℝ => B_φ * E_tot m' (ui.2, ui.1))
          (Set.Ioc δ (1 - δ) ×ˢ Set.Ioc (-K) K) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (h_bdd_rect_int (fun ui => E_tot m' (ui.2, ui.1))
          (fun ui => H_cont_diag m' (ui.2, ui.1)) B_cap δ (1 - δ) (-K) K
          ((hEtot_meas m').comp measurable_swap) ((hH_cont_diag m').comp continuous_swap)
          (fun ui => hEtot_le_cont m' (ui.2, ui.1))).const_mul B_φ
      have h_abs_le : |∫ p in Set.Ioc δ (1 - δ) ×ˢ Set.Ioc (-K) K,
          (F_sm (p.2, p.1) - F_tr (p.2, p.1))| ≤
          ∫ p in Set.Ioc δ (1 - δ) ×ˢ Set.Ioc (-K) K,
            B_φ * E_tot m' (p.2, p.1) := by
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        refine (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans ?_
        refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on (hF_sm_int.sub hF_tr_int).norm hEtot_sw_int
          (measurableSet_Ioc.prod measurableSet_Ioc) (fun p hp => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have hp_cc : (p.2, p.1) ∈ Set.Icc (-K) K ×ˢ Set.Icc δ (1 - δ) :=
          ⟨Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hp.2, Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hp.1⟩
        obtain ⟨hW₁_p, hW₂_p⟩ := hW_bds (p.2, p.1) hp_cc
        have h_alg : F_sm (p.2, p.1) - F_tr (p.2, p.1) =
            -(dL_diag m' j_top (p.2, p.1) - a j_top (p.2, p.1)) * W₁ (p.2, p.1) +
              (dV_diag m' (p.2, p.1) - D (p.2, p.1)) * W₂ (p.2, p.1) := by
          dsimp [F_sm, F_tr]
          ring
        rw [h_alg]
        have hEL_top_le : E_L m' j_top (p.2, p.1) ≤ ∑ k : Fin n, E_L m' k (p.2, p.1) :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k : Fin n => E_L m' k (p.2, p.1))
            (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ j_top)
        calc |-(dL_diag m' j_top (p.2, p.1) - a j_top (p.2, p.1)) * W₁ (p.2, p.1) +
              (dV_diag m' (p.2, p.1) - D (p.2, p.1)) * W₂ (p.2, p.1)|
            ≤ |-(dL_diag m' j_top (p.2, p.1) - a j_top (p.2, p.1)) * W₁ (p.2, p.1)| +
                |(dV_diag m' (p.2, p.1) - D (p.2, p.1)) * W₂ (p.2, p.1)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = E_L m' j_top (p.2, p.1) * |W₁ (p.2, p.1)| +
                E_V m' (p.2, p.1) * |W₂ (p.2, p.1)| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ E_L m' j_top (p.2, p.1) * B_φ + E_V m' (p.2, p.1) * B_φ :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW₁_p (abs_nonneg _))
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW₂_p (abs_nonneg _))
          _ ≤ B_φ * E_tot m' (p.2, p.1) := by
              dsimp [E_tot]
              nlinarith [abs_nonneg (dV_diag m' (p.2, p.1) - D (p.2, p.1))]
      refine h_abs_le.trans ?_
      rw [← h_rect_eq_prod (fun ui => B_φ * E_tot m' (ui.2, ui.1)) δ (1 - δ) (-K) K
        (by linarith) (by linarith) hEtot_sw_int]
      have hB_Etot_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun iu => B_φ * E_tot m' iu)
          (Set.Ioc (-K) K ×ˢ Set.Ioc δ (1 - δ)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hEtot_sub.const_mul B_φ
      rw [← h_rect_swap (fun iu => B_φ * E_tot m' iu) (-K) K δ (1 - δ)
        (by linarith) (by linarith) hB_Etot_int]
      simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hB_φ_nn
      exact (h_rect_mono (E_tot m') (-((m' + 2 : ℝ))) (m' + 2 : ℝ)
        ((m' + 4 : ℝ)⁻¹) (1 - (m' + 4 : ℝ)⁻¹) (-K) K δ (1 - δ)
        (by linarith) (by linarith) h_K_m' h_δ_m' (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (hEtot_nn m') hEtot_big).trans (h_diag_err m')
    exact ge_of_tendsto' hI_tendsto hI_sm_nn

submodular_plane_strong_traces.definitions:
noncomputable def coneBasisL (n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ :=
  (Function.update 0 j 1, 0)

noncomputable def coneBasisV (n : ℕ) : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ :=
  (0, 1)

def HasSmoothSubmodularSigns (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ)
    (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ j : Fin n,
    0 ≤ fderiv ℝ F p (coneBasisL n j) ∧ fderiv ℝ F p (coneBasisL n j) ≤ d j) ∧
  (0 ≤ fderiv ℝ F p (coneBasisV n) ∧ fderiv ℝ F p (coneBasisV n) ≤ d_v) ∧
  (∀ j k : Fin n, j ≠ k →
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) p (coneBasisL n j) (coneBasisL n k) ≤ 0) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin n,
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) p (coneBasisL n j) (coneBasisV n) ≤ 0)

noncomputable def coneProjZeroL (n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) (ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ :=
  (fun k => ξ.1 k - ξ.1 j, ξ.2)

noncomputable def coneProjZeroV (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ :=
  (fun k => ξ.1 k - c k * ξ.2, 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: submodular_cone_global_lipschitz_and_partials
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hc_inj : Function.Injective c)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v)
    (hE_pos : ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → 0 < c k - c j)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : IsSubmodularConeProfile n c d d_v E_cone f) :
    (∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ∧ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ≤ d j) ∧
    (Measurable (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ∧ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ≤ d_v) ∧
    ∃ (M_lip : ℝ) (K_ext : NNReal) (f_ext : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ),
      0 ≤ M_lip ∧
      (∀ p q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
        InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → InResolutionCone n c E_cone q →
        |f p - f q| ≤ M_lip * ((∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|) + |p.2 - q.2|)) ∧
      LipschitzWith K_ext f_ext ∧
      (∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → f_ext p = f p) ∧
      (∀ᵐ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p →
        (∀ j : Fin n,
          fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisL n j) = conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p) ∧
        fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisV n) = conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p)

subgoal_signatures.name: submodular_mollifier_approximants
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(n : ℕ) (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : IsSubmodularConeProfile n c d d_v E_cone f)
    (h_meas_L : ∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ∧ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ≤ d j)
    (h_meas_V : Measurable (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ∧ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ≤ d_v)
    (K_ext : NNReal) (f_ext : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf_lip : LipschitzWith K_ext f_ext)
    (hf_eq : ∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → f_ext p = f p)
    (hf_ae : ∀ᵐ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p →
      (∀ j : Fin n,
        fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisL n j) = conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p) ∧
      fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisV n) = conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p) :
    ∃ F_seq : ℕ → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ,
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 2 (F_seq k)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        |F_seq k p - f_ext p| ≤ (K_ext : ℝ) * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        (∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ 2 * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
        HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v (F_seq k) p) ∧
      (∀ (K_c : Set ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)) (r_margin : ℝ),
        MeasurableSet K_c → MeasureTheory.volume K_c < ⊤ → 0 < r_margin →
        (∀ p ∈ K_c, ∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ r_margin →
          InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
        (∀ j : Fin n,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
            ∫ p in K_c, |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisL n j) -
              conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p|)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
          ∫ p in K_c, |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisV n) -
            conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p|)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

subgoal_signatures.name: smooth_plane_flux_and_slice_lipschitz
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j_top : Fin n)
    (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ)
    (hc_inj : Function.Injective c)
    (hc_top : ∀ j : Fin n, j ≠ j_top → c j < c j_top)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v) :
    (∀ (K δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ C_mix : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_mix ∧
        (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ 2 F →
          (∀ (i u : ℝ), |i| ≤ K + 1 → u ∈ Set.Icc (δ / 2) (1 - δ / 2) →
            HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η)) →
          (∀ j : Fin n,
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |deriv (fun s' =>
                fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i + c j * (u - s'), s') + η)
                  (coneBasisL n j)) u|) ≤ C_mix) ∧
          (∫ u in δ..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K,
            |deriv (fun i' =>
              fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i', u) + η) (coneBasisV n)) i|) ≤ C_mix) ∧
        (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η η' : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ 2 F →
          (∀ (θ i u : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            |i| ≤ K + 1 → u ∈ Set.Icc (δ / 2) (1 - δ / 2) →
            HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v F
              (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + ((1 - θ) • η + θ • η'))) →
          (∀ j : Fin n, η.1 j = 0 → η'.1 j = 0 →
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j) -
                fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisL n j)|) ≤
              C_mix * ((∑ k : Fin n, |η.1 k - η'.1 k|) + |η.2 - η'.2|)) ∧
          (η.2 = 0 → η'.2 = 0 →
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisV n) -
                fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisV n)|) ≤
              C_mix * (∑ k : Fin n, |η.1 k - η'.1 k|)))) ∧
    (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)
       (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K δ : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 F → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ iu, 0 ≤ φ iu) →
      (∀ iu, (K ≤ |iu.1| ∨ iu.2 ≤ δ ∨ 1 - δ ≤ iu.2) → φ iu = 0) →
      (∀ (i u : ℝ), |i| ≤ K → u ∈ Set.Icc δ (1 - δ) →
        HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η)) →
      0 ≤ ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K,
        (-fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j_top) *
            (deriv (fun u' => φ (i, u')) u - c j_top * deriv (fun i' => φ (i', u)) i) +
          fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisV n) *
            deriv (fun i' => φ (i', u)) i)) ∧
    (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),

  have h_dir_step : ∀ (iu : ℝ × ℝ) (h δ_box M : ℝ) (p e : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)

    intro iu h δ_box M p e d_α α partFn Δ hh hδ he_norm hpart_meas hpart_bds hα0 hα1
