  have h_end0 := h_endpt_approx iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 0) hh hδ_pos
    (h_seg_box 0 le_rfl zero_le_one).1 (h_seg_box 0 le_rfl zero_le_one).2.1
    (h_seg_box 0 le_rfl zero_le_one).2.2
  have h_end1 := h_endpt_approx iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1) hh hδ_pos
    (h_seg_box 1 zero_le_one le_rfl).1 (h_seg_box 1 zero_le_one le_rfl).2.1
    (h_seg_box 1 zero_le_one le_rfl).2.2
  have h_pl_res : InResolutionCone n c E_cone (planeEmbed n c iu) := by
    refine ⟨hiu_u, fun j k _ => ?_⟩
    dsimp [planeEmbed]
    linarith
  have h_G0 : |G_h (ξ_seg 0)| ≤ M_lip * s := by
    dsimp only [G_h]
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hh, div_le_iff₀ hh]
    have hp1 := h_disp_to_res iu h (ξ_seg 0) hh
      (h_seg_box 0 le_rfl zero_le_one).1 (h_seg_box 0 le_rfl zero_le_one).2.1
    have h_l := h_lip _ _ hp1 h_pl_res
    have hd1 : ∀ j : Fin n, |(planeEmbed n c iu + h • ξ_seg 0).1 j - (planeEmbed n c iu).1 j| = 0 := by
      intro j
      simp [ξ_seg, planeEmbed]
    have hd2 : |(planeEmbed n c iu + h • ξ_seg 0).2 - (planeEmbed n c iu).2| = h * s := by
      have heq : (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ξ_seg 0).2 - (planeEmbed n c iu).2 = h * s := by
        simp [ξ_seg, planeEmbed]
      rw [heq, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hh hs_pos)]
    simp_rw [hd1, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, hd2] at h_l
    linarith
  have h_G1 : |G_h ζ - G_h (ξ_seg 1)| ≤ M_lip * s := by
    dsimp only [G_h]
    have h_sub : (f (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ζ) - f (planeEmbed n c iu)) / h -
        (f (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ξ_seg 1) - f (planeEmbed n c iu)) / h =
        (f (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ζ) - f (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ξ_seg 1)) / h := by ring
    rw [h_sub, abs_div, abs_of_pos hh, div_le_iff₀ hh]
    have hζ_t : iu.2 + h * ζ.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      have h_abs : |h * ζ.2| < d_u := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hh]
        have hRM : R ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; linarith
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hζ_2 hRM) hh.le) hl_h
      have hb := abs_lt.mp h_abs
      exact ⟨by linarith [min_le_left iu.2 (1 - iu.2)],
             by linarith [min_le_right iu.2 (1 - iu.2)]⟩
    have hpζ := h_disp_to_res iu h ζ hh hζ_cone hζ_t
    have hp1 := h_disp_to_res iu h (ξ_seg 1) hh
      (h_seg_box 1 zero_le_one le_rfl).1 (h_seg_box 1 zero_le_one le_rfl).2.1
    have h_l := h_lip _ _ hpζ hp1
    have hd1 : ∀ j : Fin n,
        |(planeEmbed n c iu + h • ζ).1 j - (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ξ_seg 1).1 j| = 0 := by
      intro j
      simp [ξ_seg, planeEmbed]
    have hd2 : |(planeEmbed n c iu + h • ζ).2 - (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ξ_seg 1).2| = h * s := by
      have heq : (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ζ).2 - (planeEmbed n c iu + h • ξ_seg 1).2 = -(h * s) := by
        dsimp [ξ_seg, planeEmbed]
        ring
      rw [heq, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hh hs_pos)]
    simp_rw [hd1, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, hd2] at h_l
    linarith
  change |G_h ζ - L_lin| ≤ ε_err
  have h_decomp : G_h ζ - L_lin =
      (G_h ζ - G_h (ξ_seg 1)) + (G_h (ξ_seg 1) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1)) +
        (avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 0) - L_lin) +
        (-(G_h (ξ_seg 0) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 0)) + G_h (ξ_seg 0)) := by ring
  have h_tri1 := abs_add_le
    ((G_h ζ - G_h (ξ_seg 1)) + (G_h (ξ_seg 1) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1)) +
      (avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 0) - L_lin))
    (-(G_h (ξ_seg 0) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 0)) + G_h (ξ_seg 0))
  have h_tri2 := abs_add_le
    ((G_h ζ - G_h (ξ_seg 1)) + (G_h (ξ_seg 1) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1)))
    (avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 0) - L_lin)
  have h_tri3 := abs_add_le
    (G_h ζ - G_h (ξ_seg 1))
    (G_h (ξ_seg 1) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1))
  have h_tri4 := abs_add_le
    (-(G_h (ξ_seg 0) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 0)))
    (G_h (ξ_seg 0))
  rw [abs_neg] at h_tri4
  rw [h_decomp]
  have h_box_s : 2 * (M_lip * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * δ_box) ≤ M_lip * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * s := by
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ M_lip * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := mul_nonneg hM_lip (by positivity)
    nlinarith [hδ_le_half_s]
  change |G_h (ξ_seg 0) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 0)| ≤ _ at h_end0
  change |G_h (ξ_seg 1) - avgQ iu h δ_box (ξ_seg 1)| ≤ _ at h_end1
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(n : ℕ) (j_top : Fin n)
    (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ d j_top ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ d_v)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (h_tr : IsCharacteristicTraceData n j_top c d d_v E_cone f a D)
    (b : ℝ → ℝ) (L_b : ℝ) (hL_b : 0 ≤ L_b)
    (hb_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, |b u₁ - b u₂| ≤ L_b * |u₁ - u₂|) :
    ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∃ (p D_minus D_plus : ℝ) (a_minus a_plus : Fin n → ℝ),
        HasDerivAt b (-p) u₀ ∧
        0 ≤ D_minus ∧ D_minus ≤ d_v ∧
        0 ≤ D_plus ∧ D_plus ≤ d_v ∧
        (∀ j : Fin n, 0 ≤ a_minus j ∧ a_minus j ≤ d j ∧ 0 ≤ a_plus j ∧ a_plus j ≤ d j) ∧
        HasTangentBoxTrace D (b u₀) u₀ p D_minus D_plus ∧
        (∀ j : Fin n, c j ≠ p → HasTangentBoxTrace (a j) (b u₀) u₀ p (a_minus j) (a_plus j)) ∧
        (c j_top ≠ p → (c j_top - p) * (a_plus j_top - a_minus j_top) ≤ D_minus - D_plus)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨ha_reg, hD_reg, _, _, ⟨ha_approx, hD_approx⟩, _, h_flux⟩ := h_tr
  let K_D : ℝ := max 1 (|b 0| + L_b + 2)
  have hK_D : 1 ≤ K_D := le_max_left _ _
  have hK_D_lt : -K_D < K_D := by linarith
  have hb_in_K : ∀ u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, b u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-K_D) K_D := by
    intro u₀ hu₀
    have h_lip0 : |b u₀ - b 0| ≤ L_b * |u₀ - 0| := hb_lip u₀ 0
    have hu_abs : |u₀ - 0| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hu₀.1]
      exact hu₀.2.le
    have h_diff_le : |b u₀ - b 0| ≤ L_b := by
      calc |b u₀ - b 0| ≤ L_b * |u₀ - 0| := h_lip0
        _ ≤ L_b * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_abs hL_b
        _ = L_b := mul_one L_b
    obtain ⟨hl1, hl2⟩ := abs_le.mp h_diff_le
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_le.mp (le_refl |b 0|)
    have hK_rhs : |b 0| + L_b + 2 ≤ K_D := le_max_right _ _
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hD_m_ae : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ,
      u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 3)) (1 - 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 3)) →
      ∃ p D_minus D_plus : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt b (-p) u₀ ∧
        0 ≤ D_minus ∧ D_minus ≤ d_v ∧
        0 ≤ D_plus ∧ D_plus ≤ d_v ∧
        HasTangentBoxTrace D (b u₀) u₀ p D_minus D_plus := by
    intro m
    let δ_m : ℝ := 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 3)
    have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 3 := by positivity
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_m := div_pos one_pos hm_pos
    have hδ_lt_half : δ_m < 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp only [δ_m]
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hm_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      have hm_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
      linarith
    have hδ_lt_one_sub : δ_m < 1 - δ_m := by linarith
    obtain ⟨G_seq, C_var, hC_var, hG_reg, hG_l1, hG_var⟩ :=
      hD_approx K_D δ_m hK_D hδ_pos hδ_lt_half
    let F_D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun ui => D (ui.2, ui.1)
    let F_D_seq : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun l ui => G_seq l (ui.2, ui.1)
    have hFD_meas : Measurable F_D := hD_reg.1.comp measurable_swap
    have hFD_bds : ∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ F_D xy ∧ F_D xy ≤ d_v :=
      fun xy => hD_reg.2 (xy.2, xy.1)
    have hFD_seq_reg : ∀ l : ℕ,
        ContDiff ℝ 1 (F_D_seq l) ∧ ∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ F_D_seq l xy ∧ F_D_seq l xy ≤ d_v :=
      fun l => ⟨(hG_reg l).1.comp (contDiff_snd.prodMk contDiff_fst),
        fun xy => (hG_reg l).2 (xy.2, xy.1)⟩
    obtain ⟨D_m_minus, D_m_plus, hDm_meas, hDp_meas, hDmp_bds, hD_slices⟩ :=
      bv_slice_steklov_onesided_limits δ_m (1 - δ_m) (-K_D) K_D d_v C_var
        hδ_lt_one_sub hK_D_lt hd_nn.2.2 hC_var F_D hFD_meas hFD_bds F_D_seq
        hFD_seq_reg hG_l1 hG_var
    have h_gr := onesided_slice_lipschitz_graph_traces δ_m (1 - δ_m) (-K_D) K_D d_v
      hδ_lt_one_sub hK_D_lt hd_nn.2.2 F_D D_m_minus D_m_plus hFD_meas hDm_meas hDp_meas
      hFD_bds hDmp_bds hD_slices b L_b hL_b hb_lip
    filter_upwards [h_gr] with u₀ hu₀_gr hu₀_mem
    have hu₀_Ioo : u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨lt_trans hδ_pos hu₀_mem.1, lt_trans hu₀_mem.2 (by linarith)⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq_der, h_tb⟩ := hu₀_gr hu₀_mem (hb_in_K u₀ hu₀_Ioo)
    have h_neg_neg : -(-q) = q := neg_neg q
    refine ⟨-q, D_m_minus (u₀, b u₀), D_m_plus (u₀, b u₀), ?_,
      (hDmp_bds (u₀, b u₀)).1, (hDmp_bds (u₀, b u₀)).2.1,
      (hDmp_bds (u₀, b u₀)).2.2.1, (hDmp_bds (u₀, b u₀)).2.2.2, h_tb⟩
    rwa [h_neg_neg]
  have hD_ae : ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∃ p D_minus D_plus : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt b (-p) u₀ ∧
        0 ≤ D_minus ∧ D_minus ≤ d_v ∧
        0 ≤ D_plus ∧ D_plus ≤ d_v ∧
        HasTangentBoxTrace D (b u₀) u₀ p D_minus D_plus := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_countable_forall.mpr hD_m_ae] with u₀ hu₀_all hu₀
    let η : ℝ := min u₀ (1 - u₀)
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min hu₀.1 (sub_pos.mpr hu₀.2)
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / η)
    have hm3_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 3 := by positivity
    have h_inv_lt : 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 3) < η := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hm3_pos]
      have h1 : 1 < (m : ℝ) * η := (div_lt_iff₀ hη_pos).mp hm
      nlinarith
    have hη_le1 : η ≤ u₀ := min_le_left _ _
    have hη_le2 : η ≤ 1 - u₀ := min_le_right _ _
    exact hu₀_all m ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le h_inv_lt hη_le1, by linarith⟩
  have ha_ae : ∀ j : Fin n, ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∀ p : ℝ, HasDerivAt b (-p) u₀ → c j ≠ p →
        ∃ a_minus a_plus : ℝ,
          0 ≤ a_minus ∧ a_minus ≤ d j ∧ 0 ≤ a_plus ∧ a_plus ≤ d j ∧
          HasTangentBoxTrace (a j) (b u₀) u₀ p a_minus a_plus := by
    intro j
    refine transverse_curve_trace_of_graph_trace (c j) (d j) (hd_nn.1 j) (a j)
      (ha_reg j).1 (ha_reg j).2 ?_ b L_b hL_b hb_lip
    intro K δ hK hδ0 hδ1 h L_h hL_h hh_lip
    have hK_lt : -K < K := by linarith
    have hδ_lt : δ < 1 - δ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨g_seq, C_var, hC_var, hg_reg, hg_l1, hg_var⟩ :=
      ha_approx j K δ hK hδ0 hδ1
    let F_a : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun rs => a j (rs.1 - c j * rs.2, rs.2)
    have hFa_meas : Measurable F_a :=
      (ha_reg j).1.comp
        ((measurable_fst.sub (measurable_const.mul measurable_snd)).prodMk measurable_snd)
    have hFa_bds : ∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ F_a xy ∧ F_a xy ≤ d j :=
      fun xy => (ha_reg j).2 (xy.1 - c j * xy.2, xy.2)
    obtain ⟨F_m, F_p, hFm_meas, hFp_meas, hFmp_bds, h_slices⟩ :=
      bv_slice_steklov_onesided_limits (-K) K δ (1 - δ) (d j) C_var
        hK_lt hδ_lt (hd_nn.1 j) hC_var F_a hFa_meas hFa_bds g_seq hg_reg hg_l1 hg_var
    have h_gr := onesided_slice_lipschitz_graph_traces (-K) K δ (1 - δ) (d j)
      hK_lt hδ_lt (hd_nn.1 j) F_a F_m F_p hFa_meas hFm_meas hFp_meas
      hFa_bds hFmp_bds h_slices h L_h hL_h hh_lip
    filter_upwards [h_gr] with r₀ hr₀_gr hr₀_K hhr₀_δ
    obtain ⟨q, hq_der, h_tb⟩ := hr₀_gr hr₀_K hhr₀_δ
    exact ⟨q, F_m (r₀, h r₀), F_p (r₀, h r₀),
      (hFmp_bds (r₀, h r₀)).1, (hFmp_bds (r₀, h r₀)).2.1,
      (hFmp_bds (r₀, h r₀)).2.2.1, (hFmp_bds (r₀, h r₀)).2.2.2,
      hq_der, h_tb⟩
  filter_upwards [hD_ae, eventually_countable_forall.mpr ha_ae] with u₀ hu₀_D hu₀_a hu₀
  obtain ⟨p, D_minus, D_plus, hb_der, hDm0, hDm1, hDp0, hDp1, hD_tr⟩ := hu₀_D hu₀
  have h_ex_j : ∀ j : Fin n, ∃ am ap : ℝ,
      0 ≤ am ∧ am ≤ d j ∧ 0 ≤ ap ∧ ap ≤ d j ∧
      (c j ≠ p → HasTangentBoxTrace (a j) (b u₀) u₀ p am ap) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hcj : c j = p
    · exact ⟨0, 0, le_rfl, hd_nn.1 j, le_rfl, hd_nn.1 j, fun hne => False.elim (hne hcj)⟩
    · obtain ⟨am, ap, ham0, ham1, hap0, hap1, htr⟩ := hu₀_a j hu₀ p hb_der hcj
      exact ⟨am, ap, ham0, ham1, hap0, hap1, fun _ => htr⟩
  choose a_minus a_plus ha_spec using h_ex_j
  refine ⟨p, D_minus, D_plus, a_minus, a_plus, hb_der, hDm0, hDm1, hDp0, hDp1,
    fun j => ⟨(ha_spec j).1, (ha_spec j).2.1, (ha_spec j).2.2.1, (ha_spec j).2.2.2.1⟩,
    hD_tr, fun j hcj => (ha_spec j).2.2.2.2 hcj, fun hc_top => ?_⟩
  let M_top : ℝ := max (d j_top) d_v
  have hM_top : 0 ≤ M_top := le_trans (hd_nn.1 j_top) (le_max_left _ _)
  have ha_top_bds : ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ a j_top iu ∧ a j_top iu ≤ M_top :=
    fun iu => ⟨((ha_reg j_top).2 iu).1, le_trans ((ha_reg j_top).2 iu).2 (le_max_left _ _)⟩
  have hD_top_bds : ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ D iu ∧ D iu ≤ M_top :=
    fun iu => ⟨(hD_reg.2 iu).1, le_trans (hD_reg.2 iu).2 (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  exact weak_flux_tangent_box_jump_ineq (c j_top) M_top hM_top (a j_top) D
    (ha_reg j_top).1 hD_reg.1 ha_top_bds hD_top_bds h_flux
    (b u₀) u₀ p (a_minus j_top) (a_plus j_top) D_minus D_plus hu₀
    ((ha_spec j_top).2.2.2.2 hc_top) hD_tr

subgoal_signatures.name: bv_slice_steklov_onesided_limits
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi M C_var : ℝ)
    (hx : x_lo < x_hi) (hy : y_lo < y_hi) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hC : 0 ≤ C_var)
    (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hF_meas : Measurable F)
    (hF_bds : ∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ F xy ∧ F xy ≤ M)
    (F_seq : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hF_seq_reg : ∀ m : ℕ,
      ContDiff ℝ 1 (F_seq m) ∧ ∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ F_seq m xy ∧ F_seq m xy ≤ M)
    (hF_seq_l1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ =>
      ∫ x in x_lo..x_hi, ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, |F_seq m (x, y) - F (x, y)|)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (hF_seq_var : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (∫ x in x_lo..x_hi, ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi,
        |deriv (fun y' => F_seq m (x, y')) y|) ≤ C_var) :
    ∃ F_minus F_plus : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      Measurable F_minus ∧ Measurable F_plus ∧
      (∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ,
        0 ≤ F_minus xy ∧ F_minus xy ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ F_plus xy ∧ F_plus xy ≤ M) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
        (∀ y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => F_plus (x, y)) (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Ioi y₀))
            (nhds (F_plus (x, y₀)))) ∧
        (∀ y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => F_minus (x, y)) (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Iio y₀))
            (nhds (F_minus (x, y₀)))) ∧

      ∀ (c₁ c₂ : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous c₁ → Continuous c₂ → ∀ (u₁ u₂ : ℝ),
      IntervalIntegrable (fun u => ∫ r in (c₁ u)..(c₂ u), G (u, r))

    intro G hG_meas M_G hM_G hG_bd c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₂ u₁ u₂
    have h_sm_part : ∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f₁ → Continuous f₂ →
        MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable
          (fun u => ∫ r in Set.Ioc (f₁ u) (f₂ u), G (u, r)) := by
      intro f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂
      let S_ioc : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := { q | f₁ q.1 < q.2 ∧ q.2 ≤ f₂ q.1 }
      have hS_meas : MeasurableSet S_ioc :=
        (measurableSet_lt (hf₁.measurable.comp measurable_fst) measurable_snd).inter
          (measurableSet_le measurable_snd (hf₂.measurable.comp measurable_fst))
      have h_eq : (fun u => ∫ r in Set.Ioc (f₁ u) (f₂ u), G (u, r)) =
          (fun u => ∫ r : ℝ, S_ioc.indicator G (u, r)) := by
        ext u
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
        rfl
      rw [h_eq]
      exact MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
        (ν := MeasureTheory.volume) (hG_meas.indicator hS_meas).stronglyMeasurable
    have h_sm : MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable
        (fun u => ∫ r in (c₁ u)..(c₂ u), G (u, r)) :=
      (h_sm_part c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₂).sub (h_sm_part c₂ c₁ hc₂ hc₁)
    obtain ⟨L_c, hL_c⟩ := (isCompact_uIcc (a := u₁) (b := u₂)).bddAbove_image
      (hc₂.sub hc₁).norm.continuousOn

        (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (A h) (B h), ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (C h u) (E h u),
          0 < b u₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r ∧ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ ε_tol : ℝ, 0 < ε_tol → ∀ᶠ h : ℝ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0),
        ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u),
          ψ_vec (fun j => a j (b u₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u)) ≤
          ε_tol * (∫ u in (A h)..(B h), (E h u - C h u))) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ =>
        (∫ u in (A h)..(B h), (E h u - C h u))⁻¹ *
          ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), |deriv S u - s|)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) →
      (∀ j : Fin n, c j ≠ p → Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ =>
        (∫ u in (A h)..(B h), (E h u - C h u))⁻¹ *
          ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u),
            |a j (b u₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - a_target j|)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)) →
      ∃ r_lim : Fin n → ℝ,
        (∀ j : Fin n, 0 ≤ r_lim j ∧ r_lim j ≤ d j) ∧
        P_rates s r_lim ∧
        ψ_vec r_lim ≤ 0 ∧
        (∀ j : Fin n, c j ≠ p → r_lim j = a_target j) := by
    intro a_target A B C E hCE_cont ψ_vec hψ_cont h_geom h_mean_ψ h_mean_S h_mean_tr
    let K_box : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := Set.univ.pi (fun j => Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (d j))
    have hK_comp : IsCompact K_box := isCompact_univ_pi (fun _ => isCompact_Icc)
    obtain ⟨m_low, hm_low⟩ := (hK_comp.image hψ_cont).bddBelow
    obtain ⟨m_high, hm_high⟩ := (hK_comp.image hψ_cont).bddAbove
    let L_low : ℝ := max 1 (-m_low)
    have hL_low_pos : 0 < L_low := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
    let M_ψ : ℝ := max L_low m_high
    have hM_ψ_nn : 0 ≤ M_ψ := le_trans hL_low_pos.le (le_max_left _ _)
    have hψ_box : ∀ r ∈ K_box, -L_low ≤ ψ_vec r ∧ |ψ_vec r| ≤ M_ψ := by
      intro r hr
      have h1 : m_low ≤ ψ_vec r := hm_low ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
      have h2 : ψ_vec r ≤ m_high := hm_high ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
      have h_lo : -L_low ≤ ψ_vec r := by
        have : -m_low ≤ L_low := le_max_right _ _
        linarith
      have h_hi : ψ_vec r ≤ M_ψ := le_trans h2 (le_max_right _ _)
      have h_lo2 : -M_ψ ≤ ψ_vec r := by
        have : L_low ≤ M_ψ := le_max_left _ _
        linarith
      exact ⟨h_lo, abs_le.mpr ⟨h_lo2, h_hi⟩⟩
    let φ_sh : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun ur => (b u₀ - p * (ur.1 - u₀) + ur.2, ur.1)
    let F_tr : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => c j ≠ p)
    let ψ_tilde : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun ur => ψ_vec (fun j => a j (φ_sh ur))
    have ha_in_box : ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, (fun j => a j iu) ∈ K_box :=
      fun iu j _ => (ha_meas j).2 iu
    have hψt_meas : Measurable ψ_tilde :=
      hψ_cont.measurable.comp (Measurable.of_eval (fun j => (ha_meas j).1.comp h_shear_meas))
    have hψt_bd : ∀ ur : ℝ × ℝ, |ψ_tilde ur| ≤ M_ψ :=
      fun ur => (hψ_box _ (ha_in_box _)).2
    let err : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun ur =>
      |deriv S ur.1 - s| + ∑ j ∈ F_tr, |a j (φ_sh ur) - a_target j|
    have herr_nn : ∀ ur : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ err ur :=
      fun ur => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _))
    have herr_meas : Measurable err :=
      (((measurable_deriv S).comp measurable_fst).sub measurable_const).abs.add
        (Finset.measurable_sum F_tr
          (fun j _ => (((ha_meas j).1.comp h_shear_meas).sub measurable_const).abs))
    let M_err : ℝ := (1 + |s|) + ∑ j ∈ F_tr, (d j + |a_target j|)
    have hM_err_nn : 0 ≤ M_err :=
      add_nonneg (by positivity)
        (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => add_nonneg (hd_nn.1 j) (abs_nonneg _)))
    have herr_bd : ∀ ur : ℝ × ℝ, |err ur| ≤ M_err := by
      intro ur
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (herr_nn ur)]
      refine add_le_add ?_ (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_))
      · exact le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add (hS_deriv_bd ur.1) le_rfl)
      · refine le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)
        rw [abs_of_nonneg ((ha_meas j).2 _).1]
        exact ((ha_meas j).2 _).2
    have h_rates_swap : ∀ᵐ ui : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < ui.2 ∧ ui.1 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        ∃ s_u : ℝ, HasDerivAt S s_u ui.1 ∧ 0 < s_u ∧ s_u ≤ 1 ∧
          P_rates s_u (fun j => a j (ui.2, ui.1)) :=
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (ν := MeasureTheory.volume)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h_rates_ae
    have h_rates_ur : ∀ᵐ u : ℝ, ∀ᵐ r : ℝ,
        0 < b u₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r ∧ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        P_rates (deriv S u) (fun j => a j (φ_sh (u, r))) := by
      filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod h_rates_swap] with u hu_ae
      filter_upwards [(MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_add_left MeasureTheory.volume
        (b u₀ - p * (u - u₀))).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hu_ae] with r hr ⟨hr_pos, hu_in⟩
      obtain ⟨s_u, hS_u, _, _, hP_u⟩ := hr ⟨hr_pos, hu_in⟩
      rwa [← hS_u.deriv] at hP_u
    obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀_pos, hh₀_geom⟩ := h_geom
    let W : ℝ → ℝ := fun h => ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), (E h u - C h u)
    have hW_pos : ∀ h ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) h₀, 0 < W h := by
      intro h hh
      obtain ⟨hAB, hCE, _⟩ := hh₀_geom h hh
      refine h_pos_int hAB (((hCE_cont h).2.sub (hCE_cont h).1).intervalIntegrable _ _) ?_
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun u hu => sub_pos.mpr (hCE u (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hu)))
    have h_mean_err : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ =>
        (W h)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), err (u, r))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
      have h_sum_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ =>
          ((W h)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), |deriv S u - s|) +
          ∑ j ∈ F_tr, ((W h)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u),
            |a j (b u₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - a_target j|))
          (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
        have h_tr_sum := tendsto_finsetSum F_tr (fun j hj => h_mean_tr j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2)
        rw [Finset.sum_const_zero] at h_tr_sum
        simpa using h_mean_S.add h_tr_sum
      refine h_sum_lim.congr' ?_
      have h_mem : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) h₀ ∈ nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
        mem_nhdsWithin.mpr ⟨Set.Iio h₀, isOpen_Iio, hh₀_pos, fun x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ => ⟨hx2, hx1⟩⟩
      filter_upwards [h_mem] with h hh
      obtain ⟨hc_cont, he_cont⟩ := hCE_cont h
      have hS_int : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun u => ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), |deriv S u - s|)
          MeasureTheory.volume (A h) (B h) :=
        h_param_ii (fun ur => |deriv S ur.1 - s|)
          (((measurable_deriv S).comp measurable_fst).sub measurable_const).abs
          (1 + |s|) (by positivity)
          (fun ur => by
            rw [abs_abs]
            exact le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add (hS_deriv_bd ur.1) le_rfl))
          (C h) (E h) hc_cont he_cont _ _
      have haj_int : ∀ j : Fin n, IntervalIntegrable
          (fun u => ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), |a j (φ_sh (u, r)) - a_target j|)
          MeasureTheory.volume (A h) (B h) := fun j =>
        h_param_ii (fun ur => |a j (φ_sh ur) - a_target j|)
          (((ha_meas j).1.comp h_shear_meas).sub measurable_const).abs
          (d j + |a_target j|) (add_nonneg (hd_nn.1 j) (abs_nonneg _))
          (fun ur => by
            rw [abs_abs]
            refine le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)
            rw [abs_of_nonneg ((ha_meas j).2 _).1]
            exact ((ha_meas j).2 _).2)
          (C h) (E h) hc_cont he_cont _ _
      have h_inner_split : ∀ u : ℝ,
          ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), err (u, r) =
            (∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), |deriv S u - s|) +
            ∑ j ∈ F_tr, ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), |a j (φ_sh (u, r)) - a_target j| := by
        intro u
        have hr_aj : ∀ j : Fin n, IntervalIntegrable
            (fun r => |a j (φ_sh (u, r)) - a_target j|)
            MeasureTheory.volume (C h u) (E h u) := by
          intro j
          rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]
          refine MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound
            (by rw [Real.volume_uIoc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
            ((((ha_meas j).1.comp (h_shear_meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk
              measurable_id))).sub measurable_const).abs).aestronglyMeasurable
            (d j + |a_target j|)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => by
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs]
              refine le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)
              rw [abs_of_nonneg ((ha_meas j).2 _).1]
              exact ((ha_meas j).2 _).2))
        dsimp only [err]
        have hr_sum : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun r => ∑ j ∈ F_tr, |a j (φ_sh (u, r)) - a_target j|)
            MeasureTheory.volume (C h u) (E h u) :=
          h_sum_ii F_tr _ _ _ (fun j _ => hr_aj j)
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const hr_sum,
          intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun j _ => hr_aj j)]
      simp_rw [h_inner_split]
      have hu_sum : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun u => ∑ j ∈ F_tr, ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), |a j (φ_sh (u, r)) - a_target j|)
          MeasureTheory.volume (A h) (B h) :=
        h_sum_ii F_tr _ _ _ (fun j _ => haj_int j)
      symm
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hS_int hu_sum,
        intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun j _ => haj_int j), left_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    have h_ex_seq : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ sr : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ),
        sr.2 ∈ K_box ∧
        P_rates sr.1 sr.2 ∧
        ψ_vec sr.2 ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ ∧
        |sr.1 - s| ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ ∧
        (∀ j ∈ F_tr, |sr.2 j - a_target j| ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) := by
      intro k
      let δ_k : ℝ := ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_k := by positivity
      let K_k : ℝ := (L_low + δ_k) / δ_k
      have hK_pos : 0 < K_k := by positivity
      have h_ev1 : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) h₀ ∈ nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
        mem_nhdsWithin.mpr ⟨Set.Iio h₀, isOpen_Iio, hh₀_pos, fun x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ => ⟨hx2, hx1⟩⟩
      have h_ev2 := h_mean_ψ (δ_k / 2) (half_pos hδ_pos)
      have h_ev3 := h_mean_err.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (div_pos hδ_pos (mul_pos two_pos hK_pos)))
      obtain ⟨h, ⟨⟨hh_mem, hh_ψ⟩, hh_err⟩⟩ :=
        Filter.nonempty_of_mem (Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem h_ev1 h_ev2) h_ev3)
      have hW_p : 0 < W h := hW_pos h hh_mem
      obtain ⟨hAB, hCE, h_dom⟩ := hh₀_geom h hh_mem
      obtain ⟨hc_cont, he_cont⟩ := hCE_cont h
      let H_k : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun ur => ψ_tilde ur + K_k * err ur - δ_k
      have hH_meas : Measurable H_k :=
        (hψt_meas.add (measurable_const.mul herr_meas)).sub measurable_const
      let M_H : ℝ := M_ψ + K_k * M_err + δ_k
      have hM_H_nn : 0 ≤ M_H :=
        add_nonneg (add_nonneg hM_ψ_nn (mul_nonneg hK_pos.le hM_err_nn)) hδ_pos.le
      have hH_bd : ∀ ur : ℝ × ℝ, |H_k ur| ≤ M_H := by
        intro ur
        dsimp only [H_k]
        calc |ψ_tilde ur + K_k * err ur - δ_k|
            ≤ |ψ_tilde ur + K_k * err ur| + |δ_k| := abs_sub _ _
          _ ≤ |ψ_tilde ur| + |K_k * err ur| + |δ_k| := add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ M_ψ + K_k * M_err + δ_k := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hK_pos, abs_of_pos hδ_pos]
              exact add_le_add (add_le_add (hψt_bd ur)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (herr_bd ur) hK_pos.le)) le_rfl
      have hH_int_u : IntervalIntegrable

          MeasureTheory.volume (A h) (B h) :=

      have h_int_H_le : (∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), H_k (u, r)) ≤ 0 := by
        have hψ_int : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun u => ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), ψ_tilde (u, r))
            MeasureTheory.volume (A h) (B h) :=
          h_param_ii ψ_tilde hψt_meas M_ψ hM_ψ_nn hψt_bd (C h) (E h) hc_cont he_cont _ _
        have herr_int : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun u => ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), err (u, r))
            MeasureTheory.volume (A h) (B h) :=
          h_param_ii err herr_meas M_err hM_err_nn herr_bd (C h) (E h) hc_cont he_cont _ _
        have hδ_int : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun u => ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), δ_k)
            MeasureTheory.volume (A h) (B h) :=
          h_param_ii (fun _ => δ_k) measurable_const δ_k hδ_pos.le
            (fun _ => by rw [abs_of_pos hδ_pos]) (C h) (E h) hc_cont he_cont _ _
        have h_split_in : ∀ u : ℝ, ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), H_k (u, r) =
            (∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), ψ_tilde (u, r)) +
            K_k * (∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), err (u, r)) -
            (∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), δ_k) := by
          intro u
          have hr_ψ : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => ψ_tilde (u, r))
              MeasureTheory.volume (C h u) (E h u) := by
            rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]
            exact MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound
              (by rw [Real.volume_uIoc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
              (hψt_meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable M_ψ
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => hψt_bd _))
          have hr_err : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => err (u, r))
              MeasureTheory.volume (C h u) (E h u) := by
            rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]
            exact MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound
              (by rw [Real.volume_uIoc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
              (herr_meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable M_err
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => herr_bd _))
          dsimp only [H_k]
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hr_ψ.add (hr_err.const_mul K_k)) intervalIntegrable_const,
            intervalIntegral.integral_add hr_ψ (hr_err.const_mul K_k),
            intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        simp_rw [h_split_in]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hψ_int.add (herr_int.const_mul K_k)) hδ_int,
          intervalIntegral.integral_add hψ_int (herr_int.const_mul K_k),
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        have h_δ_eq : (∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), δ_k) = δ_k * W h := by
          simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, mul_comm]
        have h_err_bd : K_k * (∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), err (u, r)) ≤

          have h1 : (∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), err (u, r)) ≤

                ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), err (u, r) := by
              field_simp [hW_p.ne']
            rw [h_cancel] at this
            linarith
          have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hK_pos.le
          have h3 : K_k * ((δ_k / (2 * K_k)) * W h) = (δ_k / 2) * W h := by

          linarith
        rw [h_δ_eq]
        change (∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), ψ_tilde (u, r)) ≤
          (δ_k / 2) * W h at hh_ψ
        linarith
      have h_ex_ur : ∃ u ∈ Set.Ioo (A h) (B h), ∃ r ∈ Set.Ioo (C h u) (E h u),

        by_contra h_none
        push Not at h_none
        have h_pos_outer : 0 < ∫ u in (A h)..(B h), ∫ r in (C h u)..(E h u), H_k (u, r) := by
          refine h_pos_int hAB hH_int_u ?_
          filter_upwards [h_rates_ur] with u hu_ae hu_ioo
          have hCE_u : C h u < E h u := hCE u (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hu_ioo)
          have hr_H_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => H_k (u, r))
              MeasureTheory.volume (C h u) (E h u) := by
            rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]
            exact MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound
              (by rw [Real.volume_uIoc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
              (hH_meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable M_H
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => hH_bd _))
          refine h_pos_int hCE_u hr_H_int ?_
          filter_upwards [hu_ae] with r hr_rates hr_ioo
          exact h_none u hu_ioo r hr_ioo (hr_rates (h_dom u hu_ioo r hr_ioo))
        linarith
      obtain ⟨u_k, _, r_k, _, hP_k, hH_le⟩ := h_ex_ur
      let v_k : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => a j (φ_sh (u_k, r_k))
      have hv_box : v_k ∈ K_box := ha_in_box _
      have hψ_lo : -L_low ≤ ψ_vec v_k := (hψ_box v_k hv_box).1
      have herr_nn_k : 0 ≤ err (u_k, r_k) := herr_nn _
      have hK_err_nn : 0 ≤ K_k * err (u_k, r_k) := mul_nonneg hK_pos.le herr_nn_k
      dsimp only [H_k, ψ_tilde] at hH_le
      change ψ_vec v_k + K_k * err (u_k, r_k) - δ_k ≤ 0 at hH_le
      have hψ_ub : ψ_vec v_k ≤ δ_k := by linarith
      have hK_err_ub : K_k * err (u_k, r_k) ≤ L_low + δ_k := by linarith
      have herr_ub : err (u_k, r_k) ≤ δ_k := by
        have h1 := (le_div_iff₀' hK_pos).mpr hK_err_ub
        have h2 : (L_low + δ_k) / K_k = δ_k := by
          dsimp [K_k]
          field_simp [hδ_pos.ne', show L_low + δ_k ≠ 0 by positivity]
        rwa [h2] at h1
      have hs_ub : |deriv S u_k - s| ≤ δ_k := by
        have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ F_tr, |a j (φ_sh (u_k, r_k)) - a_target j| :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
        dsimp only [err] at herr_ub
        linarith
      have htr_ub : ∀ j ∈ F_tr, |v_k j - a_target j| ≤ δ_k := by
        intro j hj
        have h_le_sum : |a j (φ_sh (u_k, r_k)) - a_target j| ≤
            ∑ j' ∈ F_tr, |a j' (φ_sh (u_k, r_k)) - a_target j'| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j' => |a j' (φ_sh (u_k, r_k)) - a_target j'|)
            (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) hj

            ((ha_meas j₀).1.comp ((measurable_const.add measurable_id).prodMk
              measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable (d j₀)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => by
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ((ha_meas j₀).2 _).1]

        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const hr_ii,

    have h_mean_S_0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ =>
        (∫ u in (u₀ - 2 * h)..(u₀ - h), (lam_s * (u₀ - u) - (0 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *

      have h_up : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (8 / 3 : ℝ) *
          ((2 * h)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (u₀ - 2 * h)..(u₀ + 2 * h), |deriv S u - s|))

        have h1 := (hS_leb.comp (h_scale_ioi 2 two_pos)).const_mul (8 / 3 : ℝ)

      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_up ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with h (hh : 0 < h)

            (2 * lam_s * h) * ∫ u in (u₀ - 2 * h)..(u₀ + 2 * h), |deriv S u - s| := by

              (fun ur => by

          ((2 * h)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ u in (u₀ - 2 * h)..(u₀ + 2 * h),

      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with h (hh : 0 < h)
        rw [h_area_0 h]
        refine mul_nonneg (by positivity) (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg
          (by linarith) (fun u ⟨_, hu2⟩ =>
            intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (mul_nonneg hlam_pos.le (by linarith))

      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with h (hh : 0 < h)

          h_param_ii (fun ur => |a j (b u₀ - p * (ur.1 - u₀) + ur.2, ur.1) - a_plus j|)

        have h_box_ii : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable
            (fun u => ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * h),

          h_param_ii (fun ur => |a j (b u₀ - p * (ur.1 - u₀) + ur.2, ur.1) - a_plus j|)

              rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]

                (by rw [Real.volume_uIoc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
                ((((ha_meas j).1.comp ((measurable_const.add measurable_id).prodMk

(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (h_gt : γ < classicalGrowthRate γ) :
    IsStdSaturatedAspect γ (leastClassicalAspect γ) ∧

signature.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (h_gt : γ < classicalGrowthRate γ) :

proof.tactics:
by
  let β : ℝ := classicalGrowthRate γ
  let K_cap : ℝ := 6 / γ + 1
  have hβ_pos : 0 < β := lt_trans hγ₀ h_gt
  have hK_pos : 0 < K_cap := by
    dsimp only [K_cap]
    have h6 : (0 : ℝ) < 6 / γ := div_pos (by norm_num) hγ₀
    linarith
  have hK_nn : 0 ≤ K_cap := hK_pos.le
  have hlog2_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hlog2_le1 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
  obtain ⟨h_calc_univ, h_calc_split, h_calc_lip⟩ :=
    std_aperture_score_and_root_calculus γ hγ₀ hγ₁
  have h_log_inv_gt : ∀ (ε X : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < Real.exp (-X) → X < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε X hε0 hlt
    have h1 : Real.log ε < Real.log (Real.exp (-X)) := Real.log_lt_log hε0 hlt
    rw [Real.log_exp] at h1
    rw [Real.log_inv]
    linarith
  have h_tendsto_zero : ∀ u : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) →
      Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / δ)
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (hu n).1]
    have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hN_lt : (N : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have h_nat : (N : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
      linarith
    have h_div_lt : 1 / δ < (n : ℝ) + 1 := lt_trans hN hN_lt
    have h_inv_lt : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) < δ := (div_lt_iff₀ hn_pos).mpr (by
      have h2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp h_div_lt
      linarith)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hu n).2 h_inv_lt
  have h_mk_sat : ∀ (e_t : ℝ)
      (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ → ℕ)
      (π_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ)
      (T_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → Fin (N_T n))
      (V_seq A_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_seq θ_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ),
      0 ≤ e_t →
      (∀ n, 0 < ε_seq n ∧ ε_seq n < 1 / 2) →
      Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      (∀ n, IsUnitBallStdLaw (π_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n) (c_seq n) (θ_seq n)) →
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
        β - δ <
          stdApertureScore (ε_seq n) γ 1 0 e_t (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n)
            (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) -
          classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq n) (1 + e_t) γ (N_ω n) (N_T n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
            (V_seq n) (A_seq n)) →
      IsStdSaturatedAspect γ e_t := by
    intro e_t ε_seq N_ω N_T π_seq T_seq V_seq A_seq c_seq θ_seq
      he_t hε_bds hε_lim h_laws h_lb
    refine ⟨he_t, ε_seq, N_ω, N_T, π_seq, T_seq, V_seq, A_seq, c_seq, θ_seq,
      hε_bds, hε_lim, h_laws, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨ε_u, hε_u0, _, h_u⟩ := h_calc_univ h_two e_t (δ / 2) he_t (half_pos hδ)
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hε_lim) ε_u hε_u0
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := h_lb δ hδ
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hn1 : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left N₁ N₂) hn
    have hn2 : N₂ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right N₁ N₂) hn
    have hε_lt_u : ε_seq n < ε_u := by
      have hd := hN₁ n hn1
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (hε_bds n).1] at hd
      exact hd
    have h_upper := h_u (ε_seq n) e_t (hε_bds n).1 hε_lt_u he_t le_rfl
      (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n) (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) (h_laws n)
    have h_lower := hN₂ n hn2
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
    dsimp only [β] at h_lower
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have h_step5 : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ (ε e : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 3) ∧ 0 ≤ e ∧ e ≤ K_cap ∧
      IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
      β - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤
        stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ∧
      12 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro j
    let J1 : ℝ := (j : ℝ) + 1
    have hJ1_pos : 0 < J1 := by positivity
    have hJ1_ge1 : 1 ≤ J1 := by
      dsimp only [J1]
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) j]
    let η_j : ℝ := min (γ / 20) (1 / (60 * J1))
    have hη_j : 0 < η_j := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hη_le_γ : η_j ≤ γ / 20 := min_le_left _ _
    have hη_le_J : η_j ≤ 1 / (60 * J1) := min_le_right _ _
    obtain ⟨E_max, hE_max, h_viol⟩ :=
      duration_one_std_saturation_of_violation γ η_j hγ₀ hγ₁ hη_j h_two h_gt
    have hE_cap_nn : 0 ≤ max E_max K_cap := le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_left E_max K_cap)
    obtain ⟨ε_univ, hε_u0, hε_u1, h_univ⟩ :=
      h_calc_univ h_two (max E_max K_cap) η_j hE_cap_nn hη_j
    let L_err : ℝ := max (2 * Real.log ((⌊4 * E_max⌋₊ : ℝ) + 2) + 40) (30 * J1)
    have hL_ge : 30 * J1 ≤ L_err := le_max_right _ _
    have hL_pos : 0 < L_err := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hL_ge
    let ε_cap : ℝ :=
      min (min (1 / 64 : ℝ) (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 3))) (min ε_univ (Real.exp (-(2 * L_err))))
    have hε_cap0 : 0 < ε_cap :=
      lt_min (lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity))
        (lt_min hε_u0 (Real.exp_pos _))
    have hε_cap1 : ε_cap < 1 / 2 := by
      have h1 : ε_cap ≤ 1 / 64 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)

subgoal_signatures.name: std_aperture_score_and_root_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ →
      ∀ (E_cap δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ E_cap → 0 < δ →
        ∃ ε_univ : ℝ, 0 < ε_univ ∧ ε_univ < 1 / 2 ∧
          ∀ (ε e : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < ε_univ → 0 ≤ e → e ≤ E_cap →
          ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
            (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
            IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s →
            stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ≤
              classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
                classicalGrowthRate γ + δ) ∧
    (∀ (ε e : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ e →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (ev : Fin N_ω → Bool),
        IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s →
        let p_E : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if ev ω then π ω else 0
        0 < p_E →
        let π_E : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => if ev ω then π ω / p_E else 0
        IsUnitBallStdLaw π_E V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
        (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π_E ω → ev ω = true) ∧
        (p_E = 1 ∧
           stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π_E T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
             classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π_E T_idx V_part A_part =
           stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
             classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ∨
         p_E < 1 ∧
           let π_Ec : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => if ev ω then 0 else π ω / (1 - p_E)
           IsUnitBallStdLaw π_Ec V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
           (stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
             classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part) -
             (3 * Real.log 2) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
             p_E * (stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π_E T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
               classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π_E T_idx V_part A_part) +
             (1 - p_E) * (stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π_Ec T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
               classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π_Ec T_idx V_part A_part))) ∧
    (∀ (ε e₁ e₂ : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ e₁ → 0 ≤ e₂ →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s →
        (stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e₁ π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e₁) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part) -
          5 * |e₂ - e₁| - 12 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
          stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e₂ π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e₂) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part)

    fun n ω hω => ((h_law₀ n).2.2.2 ω hω).2
  have h_def₀ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      stdApertureDeficit (ε_seq₀ n) γ (1 + m) 1 0 m

    rw [sub_self] at h_sub

  obtain ⟨h_bin_split, h_stage_hom, h_time_ext⟩ :=
    finite_tag_splitting_and_time_homogenization γ m hγ₀ hγ₁ hm h_two
  
  let u_mesh : ∀ k : ℕ, Fin (2 ^ k) → ℝ := fun k i => ((i : ℝ) + 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k
  have hu_mesh_pos : ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ k)), 0 < u_mesh k i ∧ u_mesh k i ≤ 1 := by
    intro k i
    have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
    have hi_le : ((i : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      have h_nat : (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ 2 ^ k := i.2
      exact_mod_cast h_nat
    exact ⟨div_pos (by positivity) hpow_pos, (div_le_one hpow_pos).mpr hi_le⟩
  have hu_mesh_lt : ∀ (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin (2 ^ k)),

    intro k i j

      Nat.mul_pos hj₁ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by positivity))
    have hmul_le : j₀ * 2 ^ (k - k₀) ≤ 2 ^ k := by

    refine ⟨⟨j₀ * 2 ^ (k - k₀) - 1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩

  have h_stage : ∀ k : ℕ,
      let i_top : Fin (2 ^ k) := ⟨2 ^ k - 1,
        Nat.sub_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by positivity)) zero_lt_one⟩
      let η_k : ℝ := 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
      ∃ st : (n_k : ℕ) × (N_ω_k : ℕ) × (Fin N_ω_k → ℝ) ×

          stdApertureDeficit (ε_seq₀ n_k) γ (1 + m) (u_mesh k i) (b_m i) (a_m i)
            π_k T_k (V_seq₀ n_k) (A_seq₀ n_k) c_k
            (fun ω => θ_d i (T_k ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq₀ n_k) (u_mesh k i) (c_k ω))) ≤ η_k) ∧

        have h_eq : (2 ^ k - 1) + 1 = 2 ^ k := by omega
        exact_mod_cast h_eq
      rw [h_cast, div_self (by positivity)]

        · intro i j hi hj

def IsUnitBallTimeLaw {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) ∧
  (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) ∧
  (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

noncomputable def stdApertureDeficit (ε γ L u b a : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
    classicalGrowthRate γ * u -
    stdApertureScore ε γ u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s

(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (h_gt : γ < classicalGrowthRate γ)
    (path : CoherentSaturatedPath γ m)
    (x₀ b' a' s : ℝ) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb_deriv : HasDerivAt path.b_path b' x₀)
    (ha_deriv : HasDerivAt path.a_path a' x₀)
    (hS_deriv : HasDerivAt path.S_path s x₀) :
    IsStdSaturatedAspect γ (max (a' - b') 0) ∧
    (m = 0 → a' - b' ≤ 0 → HasIsotropicExtremizer γ)

signature.name: tangent_blowup_at_regular_point
signature.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (h_gt : γ < classicalGrowthRate γ)
    (path : CoherentSaturatedPath γ m)
    (x₀ b' a' s : ℝ) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb_deriv : HasDerivAt path.b_path b' x₀)
    (ha_deriv : HasDerivAt path.a_path a' x₀)
    (hS_deriv : HasDerivAt path.S_path s x₀) :
    IsStdSaturatedAspect γ (max (a' - b') 0) ∧
    (m = 0 → a' - b' ≤ 0 → HasIsotropicExtremizer γ)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hm_nn, hs0, hs1, r_seq, t_seq, d_seq, h_ivl, hη_lim, he_lim, hS_unif, h_ang_ent⟩ :=
    dyadic_tangent_chain_and_angle_coherence γ m path x₀ b' a' s hx₀ hb_deriv ha_deriv hS_deriv
  obtain ⟨h_univ, h_split, ⟨C_shift, hC_shift, h_shift⟩, h_iso_end, h_time_ivl⟩ :=
    score_stability_and_binary_splitting γ hγ₀ hγ₁ h_two

  have h_restrict_law : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → 0 < ∑ ω ∈ S, π ω →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ restrictLaw π S ω) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, restrictLaw π S ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < restrictLaw π S ω → ω ∈ S ∧ 0 < π ω) := by
    intro N_ω π S hπ_nn hm_pos
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ω
      dsimp only [restrictLaw]
      split_ifs with hω
      · exact div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) hm_pos.le
      · exact le_rfl
    · dsimp only [restrictLaw]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, ← Finset.sum_div, div_self (ne_of_gt hm_pos)]
    · intro ω h_pos
      dsimp only [restrictLaw] at h_pos
      split_ifs at h_pos with hω
      · refine ⟨hω, ?_⟩
        by_contra h_le
        have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_le) (hπ_nn ω)
        rw [h0, zero_div] at h_pos
        exact lt_irrefl 0 h_pos
      · exact absurd h_pos (lt_irrefl 0)

  have h_restrict_one : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) → (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω = 1) →
      restrictLaw π E = π := by
    intro N_ω π E hπ_nn hπ_sum hE_sum
    have h_compl_zero : ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ \ E, π ω = 0 := by
      have h_add := Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ E) (f := π)
      linarith
    have h_zero_out : ∀ ω ∈ Finset.univ \ E, π ω = 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun ω _ => hπ_nn ω)).mp h_compl_zero
    ext ω
    dsimp only [restrictLaw]
    rw [hE_sum]
    split_ifs with hω
    · exact div_one (π ω)
    · symm
      exact h_zero_out ω (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hω⟩)

  have h_restrict_filter : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (E : Finset (Fin N_ω))
      (J : Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
      0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω →
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then restrictLaw π E ω else 0) =
        (∑ ω ∈ E, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) / (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) ∧
      restrictLaw (restrictLaw π E) (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j)) =
        restrictLaw π (E.filter (fun ω => J ω = j)) := by
    intro N_ω π E J j hm_pos
    set m_E := ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω
    have hm_ne : m_E ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hm_pos
    have h_pJE : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then restrictLaw π E ω else 0) =
        (∑ ω ∈ E, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) / m_E := by
      calc (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then restrictLaw π E ω else 0)
          = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if ω ∈ E then (if J ω = j then π ω / m_E else 0) else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            dsimp only [restrictLaw]
            split_ifs <;> rfl
        _ = ∑ ω ∈ E, (if J ω = j then π ω / m_E else 0) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]
        _ = ∑ ω ∈ E, (if J ω = j then π ω else 0) / m_E := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            split_ifs <;> simp
        _ = (∑ ω ∈ E, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) / m_E := (Finset.sum_div _ _ _).symm
    refine ⟨h_pJE, ?_⟩
    ext ω
    dsimp only [restrictLaw]
    have h_sum1 : (∑ ω' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω' => J ω' = j),
        if ω' ∈ E then π ω' / m_E else 0) =
        (∑ ω' ∈ E.filter (fun ω' => J ω' = j), π ω') / m_E := by
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, ← Finset.sum_div]
      refine congr_arg (fun S => (∑ ω' ∈ S, π ω') / m_E) ?_
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, and_comm]
    rw [h_sum1]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    by_cases hJ : J ω = j
    · by_cases hE : ω ∈ E
      · simp only [hJ, hE, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases hm_j : (∑ ω' ∈ E.filter (fun ω' => J ω' = j), π ω') = 0
        · rw [hm_j, zero_div, div_zero, div_zero]
        · dsimp only [m_E] at hm_ne ⊢
          field_simp [hm_ne, hm_j]
      · simp only [hJ, hE, false_and, ↓reduceIte, zero_div]
    · simp only [hJ, and_false, ↓reduceIte]

  have h_fiber_sum : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (J : Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.image J, (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω := by
    intro N_ω π J
    simp only [← Finset.sum_filter]
    rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem J (Finset.mem_univ ω))]

  have h_log_bound : ∀ (K δ x : ℝ),
      1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → 0 < x → x < 1 / 2 → x < Real.exp (-(Real.log K / δ)) →
      Real.log K / Real.log (x⁻¹) ≤ δ := by
    intro K δ x _ hδ hx0 hx_half hx_exp
    have hx_lt1 : x < 1 := lt_trans hx_half (by norm_num)
    have hlog_neg : Real.log x < 0 := Real.log_neg hx0 hx_lt1
    have hlog_inv_pos : 0 < Real.log (x⁻¹) := by
      rw [Real.log_inv]
      linarith
    have hlog_lt : Real.log x < -(Real.log K / δ) :=
      (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp hx0).mpr hx_exp
    have h_mul : δ * Real.log x < -(Real.log K) := by
      have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlog_lt hδ
      have h_eq : δ * -(Real.log K / δ) = -(Real.log K) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hδ]
      rwa [h_eq] at h1
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hlog_inv_pos, Real.log_inv]
    linarith

  have h_rpow_thresh : ∀ (ε η B : ℝ),
      0 < ε → 0 < η → 0 < B → ε < B ^ (1 / η) → ε ^ η < B := by
    intro ε η B hε hη hB h_lt
    calc ε ^ η < (B ^ (1 / η)) ^ η := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hε.le h_lt hη
      _ = B ^ ((1 / η) * η) := (Real.rpow_mul hB.le _ _).symm
      _ = B ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hη)]
      _ = B := Real.rpow_one B

  have h_surp_scale : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β_t : Type} (ε η : ℝ) (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β_t) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      0 < ε →
      condSurprise (ε ^ η) Q X Y ω = condSurprise ε Q X Y ω / η := by
    intro N_ω α β_t ε η Q X Y ω hε
    unfold condSurprise
    rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_rpow hε, Real.log_inv, div_div]
    have h_eq : -(η * Real.log ε) = -Real.log ε * η := by ring
    rw [h_eq]

  have h_inv_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat

  have h_pow_half_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    let e_inf : ℝ := max (a' - b') 0
    let β : ℝ := classicalGrowthRate γ
    refine ⟨le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
    have h_stage1 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ (n_k : ℕ) (j_k : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
        let r_k := r_seq k
        let t_k := t_seq k
        let d_k := d_seq k
        let η_k := t_k - r_k
        let b_k := path.b_path t_k
        let a_k := path.a_path t_k
        let e_k := (a_k - b_k - d_k) / η_k
        let δ_k : ℝ := 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
        let ε_k := path.ε_seq n_k
        let ε_tilde := ε_k ^ η_k
        let J_k := fun ω : Fin (path.N_ω n_k) =>
          stdApertureObs ε_k r_k b_k (b_k + d_k)
            (path.V_seq n_k (path.T_seq n_k ω)) (path.A_seq n_k (path.T_seq n_k ω))
            (path.c_seq n_k ω) (path.θ_time t_k n_k ω)
        let π_j := restrictLaw (path.π_seq n_k) (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J_k ω = j_k))
        let V_j := fun tid => locCellVel ε_k r_k b_k d_k j_k (path.V_seq n_k tid)
        let A_j := fun tid => locCellPos ε_k r_k b_k d_k j_k (path.V_seq n_k tid) (path.A_seq n_k tid)
        let c_loc := fun ω => locTime ε_k r_k (path.c_seq n_k ω)
        let θ_loc := fun ω => locTheta ε_k (a_k - b_k) d_k (path.θ_time t_k n_k ω)
        0 < ε_tilde ∧ ε_tilde < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) ∧
        Real.log C_shift / Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹) ≤ δ_k ∧
        0 < (∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J_k ω = j_k), path.π_seq n_k ω) ∧
        (∀ tid, ‖V_j tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_j tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ ω, 0 < path.π_seq n_k ω →
          c_loc ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ θ_loc ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
        |(stdApertureScore ε_tilde γ 1 0 e_k π_j (path.T_seq n_k) V_j A_j c_loc θ_loc -
            classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde (1 + e_k) γ (path.N_ω n_k) (path.N_T n_k)
              π_j (path.T_seq n_k) V_j A_j) - β| ≤ 3 * δ_k := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨hr_dyad, ht_dyad, hr0, hrx, hxt, ht1, hd0, hd_le⟩ := h_ivl k
      set r_k := r_seq k
      set t_k := t_seq k
      set d_k := d_seq k
      set η_k := t_k - r_k
      set b_k := path.b_path t_k
      set a_k := path.a_path t_k
      set δ_k : ℝ := 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
      have hrt : r_k < t_k := lt_trans hrx hxt
      have hη_pos : 0 < η_k := sub_pos.mpr hrt
      have ht0 : 0 < t_k := lt_trans hr0 hrt
      have ht_le1 : t_k ≤ 1 := ht1.le
      have ht_le_L : t_k ≤ 1 + m := by linarith
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_k := by positivity
      have h_sh := path.h_shape_mono t_k t_k ht0 le_rfl ht_le1
      obtain ⟨ε_loc0, hε_loc0_pos, _, h_loc⟩ :=
        anisotropic_cell_localization_deficit_bound γ r_k t_k (1 + m) δ_k
          hγ₀ hγ₁ h_two hr0 hrt ht_le1 ht_le_L hδ_pos
      let B_k : ℝ := min ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2)) (Real.exp (-(Real.log C_shift / δ_k)))
      have hBk_pos : 0 < B_k := lt_min (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _)
      let ε_thresh : ℝ := min ε_loc0 (B_k ^ (1 / η_k))
      have hε_thresh_pos : 0 < ε_thresh :=
        lt_min hε_loc0_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hBk_pos _)
      have h_ev1 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, path.ε_seq n < ε_thresh :=
        path.hε_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε_thresh_pos)
      have h_sat_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
          β * t_k +
            classicalRootSupremum (path.ε_seq n) (1 + m) γ (path.N_ω n) (path.N_T n)
              (path.π_seq n) (path.T_seq n) (path.V_seq n) (path.A_seq n) -
            stdApertureScore (path.ε_seq n) γ t_k b_k a_k (path.π_seq n) (path.T_seq n)
              (path.V_seq n) (path.A_seq n) (path.c_seq n) (path.θ_time t_k n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h1 := tendsto_const_nhds (x := β * t_k).sub (path.h_dyad_sat t_k ht_dyad)
        rw [sub_self] at h1
        refine h1.congr (fun n => ?_)
        dsimp only [β, b_k, a_k]
        ring
      have h_ev2 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
          β * t_k +
            classicalRootSupremum (path.ε_seq n) (1 + m) γ (path.N_ω n) (path.N_T n)
              (path.π_seq n) (path.T_seq n) (path.V_seq n) (path.A_seq n) -
            stdApertureScore (path.ε_seq n) γ t_k b_k a_k (path.π_seq n) (path.T_seq n)
              (path.V_seq n) (path.A_seq n) (path.c_seq n) (path.θ_time t_k n) <
            η_k * δ_k :=
        h_sat_lim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (mul_pos hη_pos hδ_pos))
      have h_ev3 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
          finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n)
            (fun ω => (path.T_seq n ω, dyadicTimeBin (path.ε_seq n) r_k (path.c_seq n ω)))
            (fun ω => angBin (path.ε_seq n) d_k (path.θ_time t_k n ω)) <
            (1 / 2) * (η_k * δ_k) :=
        (h_ang_ent k).eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity))
      obtain ⟨n_k, hn1, hn2, hn3⟩ := (h_ev1.and (h_ev2.and h_ev3)).exists
      have hε_pos : 0 < path.ε_seq n_k := (path.hε_bounds n_k).1
      have hε_loc : path.ε_seq n_k < ε_loc0 := lt_of_lt_of_le hn1 (min_le_left _ _)
      have hε_Bk : (path.ε_seq n_k) ^ η_k < B_k :=
        h_rpow_thresh (path.ε_seq n_k) η_k B_k hε_pos hη_pos hBk_pos
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hn1 (min_le_right _ _))
      have hε_pow : (path.ε_seq n_k) ^ η_k < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hε_Bk (min_le_left _ _)
      have hε_half : (path.ε_seq n_k) ^ η_k < 1 / 2 := by
        have h_pow_le : ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (k + 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          calc ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (k + 2) = ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k * (1 / 4) := by
                rw [pow_add]; norm_num
            _ ≤ 1 * (1 / 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)
            _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hε_pow h_pow_le
      have hε_exp : (path.ε_seq n_k) ^ η_k < Real.exp (-(Real.log C_shift / δ_k)) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hε_Bk (min_le_right _ _)
      have h_law_nk := path.h_law n_k
      have h_dom_nk : ∀ ω, 0 < path.π_seq n_k ω →
          path.c_seq n_k ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
          path.θ_time t_k n_k ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi :=
        fun ω hω => ⟨h_law_nk.2.2.2.1 ω hω, h_law_nk.2.2.2.2 t_k ht_dyad ω hω⟩
      obtain ⟨h_ent_le, h_vel_pos_bd, h_dom_loc, h_loc_lb, h_loc_avg⟩ :=
        h_loc (path.ε_seq n_k) b_k a_k d_k hε_pos hε_loc hε_half
          h_sh.1 h_sh.2.2.1 h_sh.2.2.2.2 hd0 hd_le
          (path.π_seq n_k) (path.T_seq n_k) (path.V_seq n_k) (path.A_seq n_k)
          (path.c_seq n_k) (path.θ_time t_k n_k)
          h_law_nk.1 h_law_nk.2.1 h_law_nk.2.2.1 h_dom_nk
      let J_k := fun ω : Fin (path.N_ω n_k) =>
        stdApertureObs (path.ε_seq n_k) r_k b_k (b_k + d_k)
          (path.V_seq n_k (path.T_seq n_k ω)) (path.A_seq n_k (path.T_seq n_k ω))
          (path.c_seq n_k ω) (path.θ_time t_k n_k ω)
      let S_J : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.univ.image J_k
      let p_J := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin (path.N_ω n_k), if J_k ω = j then path.π_seq n_k ω else 0
      let e_k := (a_k - b_k - d_k) / η_k
      let Δ_loc := fun j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ =>
        let π_j := restrictLaw (path.π_seq n_k) (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J_k ω = j))
        let V_j := fun tid => locCellVel (path.ε_seq n_k) r_k b_k d_k j (path.V_seq n_k tid)
        let A_j := fun tid => locCellPos (path.ε_seq n_k) r_k b_k d_k j
          (path.V_seq n_k tid) (path.A_seq n_k tid)
        let c_loc := fun ω => locTime (path.ε_seq n_k) r_k (path.c_seq n_k ω)
        let θ_loc := fun ω => locTheta (path.ε_seq n_k) (a_k - b_k) d_k (path.θ_time t_k n_k ω)
        β + classicalRootSupremum ((path.ε_seq n_k) ^ η_k) (1 + e_k) γ
              (path.N_ω n_k) (path.N_T n_k) π_j (path.T_seq n_k) V_j A_j -
          stdApertureScore ((path.ε_seq n_k) ^ η_k) γ 1 0 e_k
            π_j (path.T_seq n_k) V_j A_j c_loc θ_loc
      have h_avg_3δ : ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * Δ_loc j ≤ 3 * δ_k := by
        have h_num : (β * t_k +
              classicalRootSupremum (path.ε_seq n_k) (1 + m) γ (path.N_ω n_k) (path.N_T n_k)
                (path.π_seq n_k) (path.T_seq n_k) (path.V_seq n_k) (path.A_seq n_k) -
              stdApertureScore (path.ε_seq n_k) γ t_k b_k a_k (path.π_seq n_k) (path.T_seq n_k)
                (path.V_seq n_k) (path.A_seq n_k) (path.c_seq n_k) (path.θ_time t_k n_k)) +
            2 * finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n_k) (path.π_seq n_k)
              (fun ω => (path.T_seq n_k ω, dyadicTimeBin (path.ε_seq n_k) r_k (path.c_seq n_k ω)))
              J_k ≤ 2 * (η_k * δ_k) := by
          linarith [hn2, hn3, h_ent_le]
        have h_div : ((β * t_k +
              classicalRootSupremum (path.ε_seq n_k) (1 + m) γ (path.N_ω n_k) (path.N_T n_k)
                (path.π_seq n_k) (path.T_seq n_k) (path.V_seq n_k) (path.A_seq n_k) -
              stdApertureScore (path.ε_seq n_k) γ t_k b_k a_k (path.π_seq n_k) (path.T_seq n_k)
                (path.V_seq n_k) (path.A_seq n_k) (path.c_seq n_k) (path.θ_time t_k n_k)) +
            2 * finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n_k) (path.π_seq n_k)
              (fun ω => (path.T_seq n_k ω, dyadicTimeBin (path.ε_seq n_k) r_k (path.c_seq n_k ω)))
              J_k) / η_k ≤ 2 * δ_k := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hη_pos]
          linarith
        linarith [h_loc_avg, h_div]

            rw [div_div, mul_comm (Real.log (ε_k⁻¹)) η_k, ← h_log_scale]
          rw [h_eq_div]
          refine le_trans ?_ h_log_K
          refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hlog_iso_pos.le
          have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_seq k := by dsimp [δ_seq]; positivity
          have hmE_pos : 0 < m_Ek := by linarith [hmE_half]
          have h_arg_pos : 0 < 2 * ((M_seq k : ℝ) + 1) / (m_Ek * (δ_seq k) ^ 2) := by positivity
          have h_arg_le : 2 * ((M_seq k : ℝ) + 1) / (m_Ek * (δ_seq k) ^ 2) ≤
              4 * ((M_seq k : ℝ) + 1) / (δ_seq k) ^ 2 := by
            rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hmE_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hδ_pos)) (sq_pos_of_pos hδ_pos)]
            have h_pos_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((M_seq k : ℝ) + 1) * (δ_seq k) ^ 2 := by positivity
            nlinarith [hmE_half]
          exact Real.log_le_log h_arg_pos (le_trans h_arg_le (le_max_right _ _))
        linarith
      have h_S_approx : |d_targ k l_idx / η_k - s * u| ≤ δ / 4 + ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k := by
        have h1 := hK_S k hk_KS l_nat hl_le
        have h_su_diff : |s * u_0 - s * u| ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k := by
          have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ u - u_0 := sub_nonneg.mpr hu0_le_u
          rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs0, abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg h_nonneg]
          calc s * (u - u_0) ≤ 1 * (u - u_0) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs1 h_nonneg
            _ = u - u_0 := one_mul _
            _ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k := hu_diff_le
        have h_tri := abs_sub_le (d_targ k l_idx / η_k) (s * u_0) (s * u)
        dsimp only [d_targ, q_grid, u_0, u_grid, l_idx, r_k, t_k, η_k] at h1 h_tri ⊢
        linarith
      have h_surp_cell_k := h_cell_surp l_idx
      let err_mut := Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (6 : ℝ)) / Real.log ((ε_iso k)⁻¹) + δ / 4
      have h_ptwise : ∀ ω : Fin (N_ω_iso k),
          (if δ < |condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₂ ω - s * u|
           then π_iso k ω else 0) ≤
          (if Ω_err < |condSurprise ε_k (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω - d_targ k l_idx|
           then π_iso k ω else 0) +
          (if err_mut < |condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₂ ω -
              condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω|
           then π_iso k ω else 0) := by
        intro ω
        have hπ_nn_ω := (h_law_iso_full k).1 ω
        by_cases h_bad : δ < |condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₂ ω - s * u|
        · rw [if_pos h_bad]
          by_cases hA : Ω_err < |condSurprise ε_k (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω - d_targ k l_idx|
          · rw [if_pos hA]
            split_ifs <;> linarith
          · rw [if_neg hA]
            have hA_le : |condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω -
                d_targ k l_idx / η_k| ≤ Ω_err / η_k := by
              have h_sc := h_surp_scale ε_k η_k (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω hε_k_pos
              dsimp only [ε_iso, η_k, t_k, r_k, ε_k] at h_sc ⊢
              rw [h_sc, ← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hη_pos]
              exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_of_not_gt hA) hη_pos.le
            have hB : err_mut < |condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₂ ω -
                condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω| := by
              by_contra hB_not
              have hB_le := le_of_not_gt hB_not
              dsimp only [err_mut] at hB_le
              have h_tri1 := abs_sub_le (condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₂ ω)
                (condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω) (s * u)
              have h_tri2 := abs_sub_le (condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω)
                (d_targ k l_idx / η_k) (s * u)
              linarith [h_bad, h_tri1, h_tri2, hB_le, hA_le, h_err_mut_le, h_Ω_div_le,
                h_S_approx, hk_err]
            rw [if_pos hB, zero_add]
        · rw [if_neg h_bad]
          positivity
      calc (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω_iso k),
            if δ < |condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₂ ω - s * u|
            then π_iso k ω else 0)
          ≤ ∑ ω : Fin (N_ω_iso k),
              ((if Ω_err < |condSurprise ε_k (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω - d_targ k l_idx|
                then π_iso k ω else 0) +
               (if err_mut < |condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₂ ω -
                   condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω|
                then π_iso k ω else 0)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_ptwise ω)
        _ = (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω_iso k),
              if Ω_err < |condSurprise ε_k (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω - d_targ k l_idx|
              then π_iso k ω else 0) +
            (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω_iso k),
              if err_mut < |condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₂ ω -
                  condSurprise (ε_iso k) (π_iso k) (T_iso k) Y₁ ω|
              then π_iso k ω else 0) := Finset.sum_add_distrib
        _ ≤ 2 * δ_seq k + 2 * (ε_iso k) ^ (δ / 4) := add_le_add h_surp_cell_k h_mut

noncomputable def restrictLaw {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ω)) :
    Fin N_ω → ℝ :=
  let m := ∑ ω ∈ S, π ω
  fun ω => if ω ∈ S then π ω / m else 0

noncomputable def projAngleOfVec (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if 0 < w 1 then Real.arccos (w 0 / ‖w‖)
  else if w 1 < 0 then Real.arccos (-(w 0 / ‖w‖))
  else 0

noncomputable def clampUnitBall2D (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if ‖w‖ ≤ 1 then w else 0

noncomputable def locTime (ε r c_s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let m_r := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
  c_s * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r - (dyadicTimeBin ε r c_s : ℝ)

noncomputable def locTheta (ε e_t d θ_s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let e_fine := angUnitVec ε e_t (angBin ε e_t θ_s)
  let e_coarse := angUnitVec ε d (angBin ε d θ_s)
  projAngleOfVec (WithLp.toLp 2 ![inner ℝ e_fine e_coarse,
    ε ^ (-d) * inner ℝ e_fine (perp2D e_coarse)])

noncomputable def locCellVel (ε r b_t d : ℝ) (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)
    (V_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let (_, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, _, _) := j
  let _ := r
  let e_J := angUnitVec ε d k_ang_d
  let v_J1 := ((k_V1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t
  let v_J2 := ((k_V2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + d)
  let v_J := v_J1 • e_J + v_J2 • perp2D e_J
  let dV := V_p - v_J
  clampUnitBall2D ((1 / 10 : ℝ) • WithLp.toLp 2
    ![ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ dV e_J, ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ dV (perp2D e_J)])

noncomputable def locCellPos (ε r b_t d : ℝ) (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)
    (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) := j
  let Δ_r := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r))⁻¹
  let c_low := (k_r : ℝ) * Δ_r
  let e_J := angUnitVec ε d k_ang_d
  let v_J1 := ((k_V1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t
  let v_J2 := ((k_V2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + d)
  let v_J := v_J1 • e_J + v_J2 • perp2D e_J
  let x_J1 := ((k_X1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + r)
  let x_J2 := ((k_X2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + d + r)
  let x_J := x_J1 • e_J + x_J2 • perp2D e_J
  let a_J := x_J - ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) • v_J
  let dX := (A_p + c_low • V_p) - a_J
  clampUnitBall2D ((10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ • WithLp.toLp 2
    ![ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ dX e_J, ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ dX (perp2D e_J)])

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (path : CoherentSaturatedPath γ m)
    (x₀ b' a' s : ℝ) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hb_deriv : HasDerivAt path.b_path b' x₀)
    (ha_deriv : HasDerivAt path.a_path a' x₀)
    (hS_deriv : HasDerivAt path.S_path s x₀) :
    0 ≤ m ∧ 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧
    ∃ (r_seq t_seq d_seq : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ k : ℕ, IsPosDyadicUnit (r_seq k) ∧ IsPosDyadicUnit (t_seq k) ∧
        0 < r_seq k ∧ r_seq k < x₀ ∧ x₀ < t_seq k ∧ t_seq k < 1 ∧
        0 ≤ d_seq k ∧ d_seq k ≤ path.a_path (t_seq k) - path.b_path (t_seq k)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k => t_seq k - r_seq k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
        ((path.a_path (t_seq k) - path.b_path (t_seq k)) - d_seq k) / (t_seq k - r_seq k))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (max (a' - b') 0)) ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K₀ ≤ k → ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 ^ k →
        |(path.S_path (r_seq k + ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) * (t_seq k - r_seq k)) -
            path.S_path (r_seq k)) / (t_seq k - r_seq k) -
          s * ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k)| ≤ δ) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
        finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n)
          (fun ω => (path.T_seq n ω, dyadicTimeBin (path.ε_seq n) (r_seq k) (path.c_seq n ω)))
          (fun ω => angBin (path.ε_seq n) (d_seq k) (path.θ_time (t_seq k) n ω)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

subgoal_signatures.name: markov_trim_and_typical_cell_surprise
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ {N_ω M : ℕ} {α_T α_C α_J : Type} [DecidableEq α_J]
      (ε δ_hom δ_trim lam : ℝ)
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (T : Fin N_ω → α_T)
      (J : Fin N_ω → α_J)
      (proj_C : α_J → α_C)
      (D : Fin M → Fin N_ω → ℤ)
      (d_target : Fin M → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < δ_hom → 0 < δ_trim → 0 < lam → lam < 1 →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      let B := fun ω => (T ω, proj_C (J ω))
      let ζ := finCondEntropy ε π B J
      let p_bad : ℝ := ∑ l : Fin M, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if δ_hom < |condSurprise ε π B (D l) ω - d_target l| then π ω else 0
      ∃ E : Finset (Fin N_ω),
        (∀ ω ∈ E, 0 < π ω) ∧
        1 - ((2 * (M : ℝ) + 1) * ζ / δ_trim + p_bad) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω ∧
        (0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω →
          finCondEntropy ε (restrictLaw π E) B J ≤ δ_trim) ∧
        (1 / 2 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω →
          ∃ G_cells : Finset α_J,
            (∀ j ∈ G_cells, 0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) ∧
            1 - lam ≤ ∑ j ∈ G_cells,
              (∑ ω ∈ E, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) / (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) ∧
            ∀ j ∈ G_cells, ∀ l : Fin M,
              let Q_j := restrictLaw π (E.filter (fun ω => J ω = j))
              let Ω_err := δ_hom + 2 * δ_trim +
                Real.log (2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) / ((∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) * lam ^ 2)) /
                  Real.log (ε⁻¹)
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
                if Ω_err < |condSurprise ε Q_j T (D l) ω - d_target l|
                then Q_j ω else 0) ≤ 2 * lam)) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_T : Type}
      (ε τ : ℝ) (N₁₂ N₂₁ : ℕ)
      (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T : Fin N_ω → α_T) (Y₁ Y₂ : Fin N_ω → ℤ)
      (lo₁₂ : ℤ → ℤ) (lo₂₁ : ℤ → ℤ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < τ → 1 ≤ N₁₂ → 1 ≤ N₂₁ →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → lo₁₂ (Y₁ ω) ≤ Y₂ ω ∧ Y₂ ω < lo₁₂ (Y₁ ω) + (N₁₂ : ℤ)) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → lo₂₁ (Y₂ ω) ≤ Y₁ ω ∧ Y₁ ω < lo₂₁ (Y₂ ω) + (N₂₁ : ℤ)) →
      let err := Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + τ
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if err < |condSurprise ε Q T Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q T Y₁ ω|
        then Q ω else 0) ≤ 2 * ε ^ τ)

subgoal_signatures.name: anisotropic_cell_localization_deficit_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ r t L_hor δ_cl : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (hr₀ : 0 < r) (hrt : r < t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 1)
    (htL : t ≤ L_hor) (hδ : 0 < δ_cl) :
    ∃ ε_loc₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε_loc₀ ∧ ε_loc₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε b_t a_t d : ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε_loc₀ → ε ^ (t - r) < 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ b_t → b_t ≤ a_t → a_t + t ≤ L_hor →
        0 ≤ d → d ≤ a_t - b_t →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ θ_s ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
        let η := t - r
        let ε_tilde := ε ^ η
        let e_loc := (a_t - b_t - d) / η
        let J := fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
          stdApertureObs ε r b_t (b_t + d) (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)
        let S_J : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.univ.image J
        let p_J := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0
        let ζ := finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))) J
        let Δ_glob := classicalGrowthRate γ * t +
          classicalRootSupremum ε L_hor γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
          stdApertureScore ε γ t b_t a_t π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s
        let Δ_loc := fun j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ =>
          let π_j := restrictLaw π (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j))
          let V_j := fun tid => locCellVel ε r b_t d j (V_part tid)
          let A_j := fun tid => locCellPos ε r b_t d j (V_part tid) (A_part tid)
          let c_loc := fun ω => locTime ε r (c_s ω)
          let θ_loc := fun ω => locTheta ε (a_t - b_t) d (θ_s ω)
          classicalGrowthRate γ +
            classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde (1 + e_loc) γ N_ω N_T π_j T_idx V_j A_j -
            stdApertureScore ε_tilde γ 1 0 e_loc π_j T_idx V_j A_j c_loc θ_loc
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))) J ≤
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)))
            (fun ω => angBin ε d (θ_s ω)) ∧
        (∀ tid j, ‖locCellVel ε r b_t d j (V_part tid)‖ ≤ 1 ∧
          ‖locCellPos ε r b_t d j (V_part tid) (A_part tid)‖ ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
          locTime ε r (c_s ω) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
          locTheta ε (a_t - b_t) d (θ_s ω) ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ j ∈ S_J, 0 < p_J j → -δ_cl ≤ Δ_loc j) ∧
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * Δ_loc j ≤ (Δ_glob + 2 * ζ) / η + δ_cl

subgoal_signatures.name: score_stability_and_binary_splitting
subgoal_signatures.statement:

        rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_iff₀ h2l_pos]
        exact hj_le_real
      have h_uq_lt : u - q < 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ l := by
        dsimp [q]
        rw [sub_lt_iff_lt_add, ← add_div, lt_div_iff₀ h2l_pos]
        linarith
      have h_abs_uq : |u - q| < 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ l := by
        rwa [abs_of_nonneg h_uq_nn]
      have hg_q : g_diff q = 0 := by
        dsimp [g_diff]
        rw [h_dyad_contact q hq_ioo hq_dyad]
        ring
      have h_lip_uq := hg_lip u hu q hq_ioo
      rw [hg_q, sub_zero] at h_lip_uq
      have h_prod_lt : M_lip * (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ l) < |g_diff u| / 2 := by
        rw [mul_one_div, div_lt_iff₀ h2l_pos]
        have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ h_pos).mp h2l_g
        linarith
      have h_mul_uq : M_lip * |u - q| < M_lip * (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ l) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_abs_uq hM_pos
      dsimp [M_lip] at h_mul_uq h_prod_lt
      linarith
    dsimp [g_diff] at hg_zero
    linarith
  have h_all_sat : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
        rowObsScore (ε_seq k) γ m t (b t) (π_seq k) (T_seq k) (V_seq k) (A_seq k)
          (c_seq k) (R_seq k) -
        classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq k) (1 + m) γ (N_ω k) (N_T k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
          (V_seq k) (A_seq k))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (classicalGrowthRate γ * t)) := by
    intro t ht
    have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
        ((2 * b t + (1 - γ) * m * t) - F_seq k (planeEmbed 4 c4 (b t, t)) +
          2 * finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
            (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) t (c_seq k ω))) -
        classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq k) (1 + m) γ (N_ω k) (N_T k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
          (V_seq k) (A_seq k))
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds (((2 * b t + (1 - γ) * m * t) - f_raw (planeEmbed 4 c4 (b t, t)) + 2 * S t) - τ)) :=
      ((tendsto_const_nhds.sub (hF_pt _ (h_plane_cone t ht))).add
        ((h_time_ent t ht).const_mul 2)).sub h_tau_lim
    have h_val : ((2 * b t + (1 - γ) * m * t) - f_raw (planeEmbed 4 c4 (b t, t)) + 2 * S t) - τ =
        classicalGrowthRate γ * t := by
      rw [h_contact t ht]
      ring
    rw [h_val] at h_lim
    refine h_lim.congr (fun k => ?_)
    unfold rowObsScore
    rw [h_plane_obs k t]
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, h_orient_growth⟩ :=
    row_frame_positive_orientation_growth γ m hγ₀ hγ₁ hm h_two h_gt h_min b hb_dom
      ε_seq N_ω N_T π_seq T_seq V_seq A_seq c_seq R_seq
      hε_bounds hε_tendsto h_law1 h_all_sat
  refine ⟨1, κ, τ, S, f_raw, ε_seq, N_ω, N_T, π_seq, T_seq, V_seq, A_seq,
    c_seq, R_seq, H_uncond, H_condT,
    le_rfl, hκ, hτ, hS_lip, hS_zero, hε_bounds, hε_tendsto, h_law1,
    h_homog, h_time_ent, h_orient_pred, h_orient_growth,
    h_f_lim, h_submod, h_gen_obs, h_contact⟩
