subgoal_signatures.name: row_obs_cone_submodularity_and_obstacle
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ C_cone : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_cone ∧
      (∀ (ε : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |R_s ω| ≤ 1) →
        let F : ((Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ := fun p =>
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω =>
            rowObs6 ε m (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (R_s ω)
              (p.1 0, p.1 1, p.1 2, p.1 3, p.2))
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let c4 : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![0, 1, m, 1 + m]
        (∀ (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) (v h : ℝ) (j : Fin 4),
          0 ≤ h →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L, v) →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (Function.update L j (L j + h), v) →
          0 ≤ F (Function.update L j (L j + h), v) - F (L, v) ∧
          F (Function.update L j (L j + h), v) - F (L, v) ≤ h + C_cone / ell) ∧
        (∀ (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) (v h : ℝ),
          0 ≤ h →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L, v) →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L, v + h) →
          -(C_cone / ell) ≤ F (L, v + h) - F (L, v) ∧
          F (L, v + h) - F (L, v) ≤ (1 + m) * h + C_cone / ell) ∧
        (∀ (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) (v h₁ h₂ : ℝ) (j k : Fin 4),
          j ≠ k → 0 ≤ h₁ → 0 ≤ h₂ →
          let L_j := Function.update L j (L j + h₁)
          let L_k := Function.update L k (L k + h₂)
          let L_jk := Function.update L_j k (L_j k + h₂)
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L, v) →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L_j, v) →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L_k, v) →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L_jk, v) →
          F (L_jk, v) - F (L_j, v) - F (L_k, v) + F (L, v) ≤ 0) ∧
        (∀ (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) (v h₁ h₂ : ℝ) (j : Fin 4),
          0 ≤ h₁ → 0 ≤ h₂ →
          let L_j := Function.update L j (L j + h₁)
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L, v) →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L_j, v) →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L, v + h₂) →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (L_j, v + h₂) →
          F (L_j, v + h₂) - F (L_j, v) - F (L, v + h₂) + F (L, v) ≤ C_cone / ell) ∧
        (∀ p p' : (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ,
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 p →
          InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 p' →
          |F p - F p'| ≤
            (∑ j : Fin 4, |p.1 j - p'.1 j|) + (1 + m) * |p.2 - p'.2| + C_cone / ell)) ∧
      (∀ (b₀ u b' a' δ_cl : ℝ),
        b₀ ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ →
        u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ b' → b' ≤ a' → a' + u ≤ 1 + m → 0 < δ_cl →
        ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧
          ∀ (ε : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
            (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
            (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
            0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
            (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
            (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
            (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |R_s ω| ≤ 1) →
            ((1 + γ) * b' + (1 - γ) * a') -
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω =>
                rowObs6 ε m (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (R_s ω)
                  (b', b' + u, a', a' + u, u)) +
              2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)) ≤
              classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
                (b₀ + δ_cl) * u)

          ∑ α : Fin N, ∑ β : Fin N, (c α * star (c β)) * (φ α v * star (φ β v)) := by
      intro v
      have h_normSq : ((‖H v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = H v * star (H v) := by
        rw [Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
      rw [h_normSq]
      dsimp only [H]
      rw [star_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun β _ => ?_)
      rw [star_mul]
      ring
    have h_inner_int : ∀ α ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun v : E => ∑ β : Fin N, (c α * star (c β)) * (φ α v * star (φ β v)))
          MeasureTheory.volume :=
      fun α _ => MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ
        (fun β _ => (hφ_pair_int α β).const_mul (c α * star (c β)))
    have h_cplx_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v : E => ((‖H v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [funext hH_expand]
      exact MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ h_inner_int
    have hH_sq_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v : E => ‖H v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have h_norm := h_cplx_int.norm
      have h_eq : (fun v : E => ‖((‖H v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖) = (fun v : E => ‖H v‖ ^ 2) := by
        ext v
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      rwa [h_eq] at h_norm
    refine ⟨hH_cont.aestronglyMeasurable, hH_sq_int, ?_⟩
    have h_int_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ v : E, ‖H v‖ ^ 2 :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun v => sq_nonneg _)
    have h_int_cplx : (((∫ v : E, ‖H v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        ∑ α : Fin N, ∑ β : Fin N,
          (c α * star (c β)) * ∫ v : E, φ α v * star (φ β v) := by
      have h_ofr : (((∫ v : E, ‖H v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          ∫ v : E, ((‖H v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := integral_ofReal.symm
      rw [h_ofr, funext hH_expand,
        MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum Finset.univ h_inner_int]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum Finset.univ
        (fun β _ => (hφ_pair_int α β).const_mul (c α * star (c β)))]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun β _ => ?_)
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul _ _
    have h_lhs_eq : ∫ v : E, ‖H v‖ ^ 2 = ‖(((∫ v : E, ‖H v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h_int_nn]
    rw [h_lhs_eq, h_int_cplx]
    have h_double_norm : ‖∑ α : Fin N, ∑ β : Fin N,
          (c α * star (c β)) * ∫ v : E, φ α v * star (φ β v)‖ ≤
        ∑ α : Fin N, ∑ β : Fin N,
          ((‖c α‖ ^ 2 + ‖c β‖ ^ 2) / 2) * K_gram α β := by
      refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α _ => ?_))
      refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun β _ => ?_))
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.star_def, RCLike.norm_conj]
      change (‖c α‖ * ‖c β‖) * K_gram α β ≤ ((‖c α‖ ^ 2 + ‖c β‖ ^ 2) / 2) * K_gram α β
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (hK_gram_nn α β)
      have h_amgm := two_mul_le_add_sq ‖c α‖ ‖c β‖
      linarith
    have h_split_sum : ∑ α : Fin N, ∑ β : Fin N,
          ((‖c α‖ ^ 2 + ‖c β‖ ^ 2) / 2) * K_gram α β =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ α : Fin N, ‖c α‖ ^ 2 * (∑ β : Fin N, K_gram α β) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ β : Fin N, ‖c β‖ ^ 2 * (∑ α : Fin N, K_gram β α) := by
      have h1 : ∀ α β : Fin N, ((‖c α‖ ^ 2 + ‖c β‖ ^ 2) / 2) * K_gram α β =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (‖c α‖ ^ 2 * K_gram α β) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (‖c β‖ ^ 2 * K_gram β α) := by
        intro α β
        rw [hK_gram_symm α β]
        ring
      simp_rw [h1, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    have h_half_bound : ∑ α : Fin N, ‖c α‖ ^ 2 * (∑ β : Fin N, K_gram α β) ≤
        C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N, ‖c α‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α _ => ?_)
      calc ‖c α‖ ^ 2 * (∑ β : Fin N, K_gram α β)
          ≤ ‖c α‖ ^ 2 * C_Bes := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_row_sum α) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = C_Bes * ‖c α‖ ^ 2 := mul_comm _ _
    linarith [h_double_norm, h_split_sum, h_half_bound]
  
  refine ⟨h_synthesis, fun h hh_meas hh_sq => ?_⟩
  have h_pair_h_int : ∀ α : Fin N,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v : E => h v * star (φ α v)) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro α
    let B_α : Set E := Metric.closedBall (V α) (R_w * ρ₀)
    have hB_meas : MeasurableSet B_α := measurableSet_closedBall
    have hB_fin : MeasureTheory.volume B_α ≠ ⊤ := MeasureTheory.measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne
    have h_ind_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Set.indicator B_α (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)))
        MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp
        (MeasureTheory.memLp_indicator_const 1 hB_meas (1 : ℝ) (Or.inr hB_fin))
    let D_α : E → ℝ := fun v => (M₀ / 2) * (‖h v‖ ^ 2 + Set.indicator B_α (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) v)
    have hD_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable D_α MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (hh_sq.add h_ind_int).const_mul (M₀ / 2)
    have hm_prod : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : E => h v * star (φ α v))
        MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hh_meas.mul (continuous_star.comp (hφ_cont α)).aestronglyMeasurable
    refine hD_int.mono' hm_prod (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => ?_))
    dsimp only [D_α]
    by_cases hv : v ∈ B_α
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hv, norm_mul, Complex.star_def, RCLike.norm_conj]
      have hφ_le := hφ_bound α v
      have h_am := two_mul_le_add_sq ‖h v‖ 1
      have h1 : ‖h v‖ * ‖φ α v‖ ≤ ‖h v‖ * M₀ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hφ_le (norm_nonneg _)
      have h2 : ‖h v‖ * M₀ ≤ (M₀ / 2) * (‖h v‖ ^ 2 + 1) := by
        nlinarith [h_am, hM₀_nn]
      linarith
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv, hφ_supp α v hv, star_zero, mul_zero, norm_zero]
      have h_sq_nn : 0 ≤ ‖h v‖ ^ 2 + 0 := by positivity
      exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) h_sq_nn
  let a_coeff : Fin N → ℂ := fun α => ∫ v : E, h v * star (φ α v)
  let G_syn : E → ℂ := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N, a_coeff α * φ α v
  obtain ⟨hG_meas, hG_sq, hG_bessel⟩ := h_synthesis a_coeff
  have h_sum_sq_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ α : Fin N, ‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have h_duality_id : (((∑ α : Fin N, ‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ∫ v : E, h v * star (G_syn v) := by
    have h_pt : (fun v : E => h v * star (G_syn v)) =
        (fun v : E => ∑ α : Fin N, star (a_coeff α) * (h v * star (φ α v))) := by
      ext v
      dsimp only [G_syn]
      rw [star_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
      rw [star_mul]
      ring
    rw [h_pt, MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum Finset.univ
      (fun α _ => (h_pair_h_int α).const_mul (star (a_coeff α))), Complex.ofReal_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    change (((‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = star (a_coeff α) * a_coeff α
    rw [mul_comm, Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have h_cs_le : ∑ α : Fin N, ‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ v : E, ‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖ := by
    have h_lhs : ∑ α : Fin N, ‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2 = ‖(((∑ α : Fin N, ‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h_sum_sq_nn]
    rw [h_lhs, h_duality_id]
    have h_norm_eq : (fun v : E => ‖h v * star (G_syn v)‖) = (fun v : E => ‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖) := by
      ext v
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.star_def, RCLike.norm_conj]
    rw [← h_norm_eq]
    exact MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
  have hC_Bes_pos : 0 < C_Bes := by linarith [hC_Bes_ge1]
  let Y_maj : E → ℝ := fun v => (C_Bes / 2) * ‖h v‖ ^ 2 + (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * ‖G_syn v‖ ^ 2
  have hY_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable Y_maj MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (hh_sq.const_mul (C_Bes / 2)).add (hG_sq.const_mul (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹)
  have h_young_pt : ∀ v : E, ‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖ ≤ Y_maj v := by
    intro v
    dsimp only [Y_maj]
    have h_sq_diff : 0 ≤ (C_Bes * ‖h v‖ - ‖G_syn v‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have h_lin : 2 * C_Bes * (‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖) ≤ C_Bes ^ 2 * ‖h v‖ ^ 2 + ‖G_syn v‖ ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lin (inv_nonneg.mpr (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * C_Bes))
    have h_lhs_id : (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * (2 * C_Bes * (‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖)) = ‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖ := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hC_Bes_pos]
    have h_rhs_id : (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * (C_Bes ^ 2 * ‖h v‖ ^ 2 + ‖G_syn v‖ ^ 2) =
        (C_Bes / 2) * ‖h v‖ ^ 2 + (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * ‖G_syn v‖ ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hC_Bes_pos]
    linarith
  have h_prod_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v : E => ‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖)
      MeasureTheory.volume := by
    refine hY_int.mono' (hh_meas.norm.mul hG_meas.norm) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
    exact h_young_pt v
  have h_int_young : ∫ v : E, ‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖ ≤
      (C_Bes / 2) * (∫ v : E, ‖h v‖ ^ 2) + (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * (∫ v : E, ‖G_syn v‖ ^ 2) := by
    calc ∫ v : E, ‖h v‖ * ‖G_syn v‖
        ≤ ∫ v : E, Y_maj v := MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_prod_int hY_int h_young_pt
      _ = (C_Bes / 2) * (∫ v : E, ‖h v‖ ^ 2) + (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * (∫ v : E, ‖G_syn v‖ ^ 2) := by
          dsimp only [Y_maj]
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (hh_sq.const_mul _) (hG_sq.const_mul _),
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  have h_g_term : (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * (∫ v : E, ‖G_syn v‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ α : Fin N, ‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * (∫ v : E, ‖G_syn v‖ ^ 2)
        ≤ (2 * C_Bes)⁻¹ * (C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N, ‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG_bessel (by positivity)
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ α : Fin N, ‖a_coeff α‖ ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hC_Bes_pos]
  linarith [h_cs_le, h_int_young, h_g_term]

informal_problem.statement:
(B_cell R_win : ℝ) (N_mult M_mult : ℕ) (M_atom M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB : 2 ≤ B_cell) (hRw : 2 ≤ R_win) (hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) :
    (letI := Classical.propDecidable
     ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (N_Q : ℕ) (V_T X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
       (∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
         ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
           ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) →
       ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
         ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
           ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ B_cell * s)).card : ℝ) ≤
           (((2 * ⌈B_cell⌉₊ + 1) ^ 2 * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ)) ∧
    ∃ C_box : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_box ∧
      (letI := Classical.propDecidable
       ∀ (s c_end R : ℝ), 0 < s → c_end ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 1 ≤ R →
       ∀ (V_P X_Q n_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖n_P‖ = 1 →
       ∀ (N_Q : ℕ) (V_T X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (W : Finset (Fin N_Q)),
         (∀ T ∈ W, ‖(X_T T + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V_T T) - X_Q‖ ≤ R * s) →
         (∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
             ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) →
         (∀ T₁ ∈ W, ∀ T₂ ∈ W, |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P| ≤ B_cell * s) →
         ∀ m : ℤ,
           ((W.filter (fun T =>
             Int.floor (inner ℝ (V_T T - V_P) (perp2D n_P) / s) = m)).card : ℝ) ≤
             C_box * R ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
         Continuous Φ₀ →
       ∀ (lam_loc ρ s c_end R : ℝ),
         0 < lam_loc → 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → c_end ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 1 ≤ R →
       ∀ (V_P X_Q x_Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (N_Q K N_obs : ℕ), 1 ≤ K →
       ∀ (V_T X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (η_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
         (c_T : Fin N_Q → ℂ) (bin_of : Fin N_Q → Fin K)
         (V_O X_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (ψ_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
         (S_Z : Finset (Fin N_obs)),
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          let σ := (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹
          (∀ T, Continuous (η_T T) ∧ (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → η_T T z = 0) ∧
            (∀ z, ‖η_T T z‖ ≤ max (M_atom 0) 1) ∧
            ‖(X_T T + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V_T T) - X_Q‖ ≤ R * s) ∧
          (∀ v₀ x₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
            ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
          (∀ T₁ T₂, bin_of T₁ = bin_of T₂ → ‖V_T T₁ - V_T T₂‖ ≤ B_cell * s) ∧
          (∀ o ∈ S_Z, Continuous (ψ_O o) ∧ (∀ z, R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
            (∀ z, ‖ψ_O o z‖ ≤ max (M_win 0) 1) ∧
            ‖V_O o - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ ∧ ‖X_O o - x_Z‖ ≤ B_cell * σ) ∧
          (∀ v₀ x₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_obs =>
            ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ))) →
         let h_Q := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ∑ T : Fin N_Q, c_T T *
           ((s⁻¹ : ℂ) * η_T T (s⁻¹ • (v - V_T T)) *
             Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_T T, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
         let m_obs := fun o : Fin N_obs =>
           ‖(ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_Q v * ψ_O o (ρ⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
             Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2
         ∑ o ∈ S_Z, m_obs o ≤
           C_box * (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 2 * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2))

          dsimp [M_bin_nat, M_vel]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_c (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      have h_prod_le : (S_Z.card : ℝ) * (M_bin_nat : ℝ) * (64 * W_at * W_wi) ^ 2 ≤

        have h1 : (S_Z.card : ℝ) * (M_bin_nat : ℝ) ≤

        calc (S_Z.card : ℝ) * (M_bin_nat : ℝ) * (64 * W_at * W_wi) ^ 2

              dsimp [C_box]
              ring
      have h_rest_nn : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) * (s / ρ) ^ 2 * E_c := by positivity

        _ = (S_Z.card : ℝ) * U_obs := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]

            dsimp [U_obs]
            ring
        _ ≤ (C_box * R ^ 2) * ((K : ℝ) * (s / ρ) ^ 2 * E_c) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod_le h_rest_nn
        _ = C_box * (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s / ρ) ^ 2 * E_c := by ring

(a₀ a₁ A B_cell R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)

      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam_loc ρ s c_end : ℝ),

        (ψ_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (S_Z : Finset (Fin N_obs)),

           (∀ z, R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧

           ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ)) ∧

           σ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ p in R_strip,
             ‖(ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),

                   ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, x_Z + p.1 • n_P + p.2 • perp2D n_P, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 ≤

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have equal_time_phase_diff_slice_bounds :
      ∀ (a₀ a₁ A C_χ : ℝ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ),
        0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A → 1 ≤ C_χ →
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) →
        ∃ B_amp : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ B_amp k) ∧
          ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
            (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
          ∀ (lam_loc ρ c_end : ℝ),
            0 < lam_loc → 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 → c_end ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
          ∀ (V_P V_o X_o x V_j : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ‖X_o - x‖ ≤ (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹ →
          ∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
            let U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun y =>
              ψ_o ((y + V_j) + ρ⁻¹ • (V_P - V_o)) * (pktPou2D y : ℂ) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                  ((lam_loc * (Φ₀ (c_end, X_o, V_P + ρ • (y + V_j)) -
                    Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • (y + V_j))) : ℝ) : ℂ))
            Continuous U ∧
            ∀ (z₀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖e‖ = 1 →
              (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (fun t : ℝ => U (z₀ + t • e))) ∧
              (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 4 → ∀ t : ℝ,
                ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun t : ℝ => U (z₀ + t • e)) t‖ ≤ B_amp k) := by
    intro a₀ a₁ A C_χ M_win _ha₀ _ha₁ hA hC_χ h_pou_smooth h_pou_deriv
    let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
    let W_win : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => max (M_win i) 1
    let M_χ : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => C_χ ^ (i + 1) * ((i.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)
    let M₁₂ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * W_win i * M_χ (n - i)
    let D_exp : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
      1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)
    let M_exp : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (m.factorial : ℝ) * (D_exp m) ^ m
    let B_amp : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose m : ℝ) * M₁₂ m * M_exp (k - m)
    have hW_win_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ W_win i := fun i => le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _)
    have hM_χ_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M_χ i := fun i => by dsimp [M_χ]; positivity
    have hM₁₂_nn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ M₁₂ n := fun n =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hW_win_nn i)) (hM_χ_nn (n - i)))
    have hD_exp_ge1 : ∀ m, 1 ≤ D_exp m := fun m => by
      dsimp [D_exp]
      have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by positivity)
      linarith
    have hM_exp_nn : ∀ m, 0 ≤ M_exp m := fun m => by
      dsimp [M_exp]
      exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one (hD_exp_ge1 m)) m)
    have hB_amp_nn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ B_amp k := fun k =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ =>
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hM₁₂_nn m)) (hM_exp_nn (k - m)))
    have h_clairaut : ∀ (j : ℕ) (K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k K) →
        ∀ (t τ : ℝ),
          HasDerivAt (fun τ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv j (fun s => K (s, τ')) t)
            (iteratedDeriv j (fun s => deriv (fun τ' => K (s, τ')) τ) t) τ := by
      have h_hd1 : ∀ (K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 K → ∀ (s τ : ℝ),
          HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => K (u, τ)) (fderiv ℝ K (s, τ) (1, 0)) s := by
        intro K hK1 s τ
        have h_emb : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (u, τ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) s :=
          (hasDerivAt_id s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s τ)
        exact (((hK1.differentiable (by simp)) (s, τ)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h_emb)
      have h_hd2 : ∀ (K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 K → ∀ (s τ : ℝ),
          HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => K (s, v)) (fderiv ℝ K (s, τ) (0, 1)) τ := by
        intro K hK1 s τ
        have h_emb : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (s, v)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) τ :=
          (hasDerivAt_const τ s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id τ)
        exact (((hK1.differentiable (by simp)) (s, τ)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ h_emb)
      have h_d1_smooth : ∀ (K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k K) →
          ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ K p (1, 0)) := by
        intro K hK k
        let ev10 : ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
        change ContDiff ℝ k (⇑ev10 ∘ fderiv ℝ K)
        exact ev10.contDiff.comp ((hK (k + 1)).fderiv_right (by norm_cast))
      have h_comm2 : ∀ (K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k K) → ∀ (s τ : ℝ),
          deriv (fun τ' : ℝ => fderiv ℝ K (s, τ') (1, 0)) τ =
            deriv (fun s' : ℝ => fderiv ℝ K (s', τ) (0, 1)) s := by
        intro K hK s τ
        let ev10 : ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
        let ev01 : ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))
        have hK_fd_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ K) (s, τ) :=
          (((hK 2).fderiv_right (by norm_num : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ (2 : ℕ))).differentiable (by simp)) (s, τ)
        have h_emb2 : HasDerivAt (fun τ' : ℝ => (s, τ')) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) τ :=
          (hasDerivAt_const τ s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id τ)
        have h_emb1 : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => (s', τ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) s :=
          (hasDerivAt_id s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s τ)
        have h_lhs :=
          ((ev10.hasFDerivAt.comp (s, τ) hK_fd_diff.hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt τ h_emb2).deriv
        have h_rhs :=
          ((ev01.hasFDerivAt.comp (s, τ) hK_fd_diff.hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt s h_emb1).deriv
        change deriv ((⇑ev10 ∘ fderiv ℝ K) ∘ fun τ' : ℝ => (s, τ')) τ =
          deriv ((⇑ev01 ∘ fderiv ℝ K) ∘ fun s' : ℝ => (s', τ)) s
        rw [h_lhs, h_rhs]
        have h_symm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ K (s, τ) :=
          ((hK 2).contDiffAt).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)
        exact h_symm.eq (0, 1) (1, 0)
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero =>
        intro K hK t τ
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        rw [(h_hd2 K (hK 1) t τ).deriv]
        exact h_hd2 K (hK 1) t τ
      | succ j ih =>
        intro K hK t τ
        let K₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ K p (1, 0)
        have h_step := ih K₁ (h_d1_smooth K hK) t τ
        have h_fn_eq : (fun τ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun s => K (s, τ')) t) =
            (fun τ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv j (fun s => K₁ (s, τ')) t) := by
          funext τ'
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
          congr 1
          funext s
          exact (h_hd1 K (hK 1) s τ').deriv
        have h_val_eq : iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun s => deriv (fun τ' => K (s, τ')) τ) t =
            iteratedDeriv j (fun s => deriv (fun τ' => K₁ (s, τ')) τ) t := by
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
          congr 1
          funext s
          have h_d2_eq : (fun s' : ℝ => deriv (fun τ' => K (s', τ')) τ) =
              (fun s' : ℝ => fderiv ℝ K (s', τ) (0, 1)) := by
            funext s'
            exact (h_hd2 K (hK 1) s' τ).deriv
          rw [h_d2_eq]
          exact (h_comm2 K hK s τ).symm
        rw [h_fn_eq, h_val_eq]
        exact h_step
    let g_exp : ℝ → ℂ := fun r => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (r : ℂ))
    have hg_exp_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k g_exp := fun k =>
      Complex.contDiff_exp.comp (contDiff_const.mul Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff)
    have hg_exp_norm : ∀ r : ℝ, ‖g_exp r‖ = 1 := fun r => by
      dsimp [g_exp]
      exact Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal r
    have hg_exp_iter : ∀ (i : ℕ) (r : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g_exp r‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have h_id_deriv : ∀ (i : ℕ) (r : ℝ), iteratedDeriv i g_exp r = Complex.I ^ i * g_exp r := by
        intro i
        induction i with
        | zero => intro r; simp
        | succ i ih =>
          intro r
          have h_ofReal : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) 1 r :=
            (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt (x := r)).hasDerivAt
          have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) (Complex.I * 1) r :=
            h_ofReal.const_mul Complex.I
          have h_exp : HasDerivAt g_exp (g_exp r * (Complex.I * 1)) r := h_lin.cexp
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, funext ih, (h_exp.const_mul (Complex.I ^ i)).deriv, pow_succ]
          ring
      intro i r
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, h_id_deriv i r, norm_mul, norm_pow,
        Complex.norm_I, one_pow, one_mul, hg_exp_norm r]
    refine ⟨B_amp, hB_amp_nn, ?_⟩
    intro Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_loc ρ c_end hlam hρ hρ_le1 hc_end V_P V_o X_o x V_j hXo_x ψ_o hψ_smooth hψ_deriv
    obtain ⟨hΦ_smooth, hζ_smooth, _, _, _, hΦ_fderiv, _, _, hζ_gevrey⟩ := h_phase
    dsimp only
    let U : E → ℂ := fun y =>
      ψ_o ((y + V_j) + ρ⁻¹ • (V_P - V_o)) * (pktPou2D y : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_loc * (Φ₀ (c_end, X_o, V_P + ρ • (y + V_j)) -
            Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • (y + V_j))) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ₀ := (hΦ_smooth 0).continuous
    have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ_o := (hψ_smooth 0).continuous
    have hpou_cont : Continuous pktPou2D := (h_pou_smooth 0).continuous
    have hU_cont : Continuous U := by
      dsimp [U]
      have hv_cont : Continuous (fun y : E => V_P + ρ • (y + V_j)) :=
        continuous_const.add ((continuous_id.add continuous_const).const_smul ρ)
      refine ((hψ_cont.comp ((continuous_id.add continuous_const).add continuous_const)).mul
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hpou_cont)).mul ?_
      refine Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
        (continuous_const.mul ((hΦ_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk hv_cont))).sub
          (hΦ_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk hv_cont)))))))
    refine ⟨hU_cont, ?_⟩

    have hRo_vol : ∀ o, MeasureTheory.volume (R_o o) = ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ 2) := by

      ring

    have hRo_sub : ∀ o ∈ S_Z, R_o o ⊆ R_strip := by

      obtain ⟨hn_lo, hn_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hn_bd
      obtain ⟨hτ_lo, hτ_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hτ_bd
      rw [hR_strip]
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · linarith [hp.1.1]
      · linarith [hp.1.2]
      · linarith [hp.2.1, hB]
      · linarith [hp.2.2, hB]

      intro o _ p hp
      have h_vec : (x_Z + p.1 • n_P + p.2 • τ_P) - X_O o =
          (p.1 - t_n o) • n_P + (p.2 - t_τ o) • τ_P := by
        have hX := h_decomp (X_O o - x_Z)
        change X_O o - x_Z = t_n o • n_P + t_τ o • τ_P at hX
        have h1 : (x_Z + p.1 • n_P + p.2 • τ_P) - X_O o =

        rw [h1, hX]
        module
      have hd1 : |p.1 - t_n o| ≤ σ / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hp.1.1], by linarith [hp.1.2]⟩
      have hd2 : |p.2 - t_τ o| ≤ σ / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hp.2.1], by linarith [hp.2.2]⟩

      have hsq2 : (p.2 - t_τ o) ^ 2 ≤ (σ / 2) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hd2 2

    let μ_st := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict R_strip

          obtain ⟨ho_S, hp_Ro⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho_A

      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
      dsimp [F_ox, g_x]
      have hv_sub : ρ⁻¹ • ((V_P + ρ • z) - V_O o) = z + ρ⁻¹ • (V_P - V_O o) := by
        have h1 : (V_P + ρ • z) - V_O o = ρ • z + (V_P - V_O o) := by abel
        rw [h1, smul_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ.ne', one_smul]
      have hexp :
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * (Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, V_P + ρ • z) -
              Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • z)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • z) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, V_P + ρ • z) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hv_sub]
      calc (ρ : ℂ) * (h_W (V_P + ρ • z) * ψ_O o (z + ρ⁻¹ • (V_P - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, V_P + ρ • z) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
          = (ρ : ℂ) * (h_W (V_P + ρ • z) * ψ_O o (z + ρ⁻¹ • (V_P - V_O o)) *
              (Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * (Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, V_P + ρ • z) -
                  Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • z)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • z) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) := by
            rw [hexp]
        _ = _ := by ring

    have h_atom_pair : ∀ j ∈ J_pat, ∀ n : ℤ × ℤ,
        (∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom 1 Φ_zero j n z * g_x z) =
          ((C_χ : ℂ) * (4 : ℂ)⁻¹) * J_op j n x := by
      intro j _ n
      dsimp [J_op]
      rw [haar_2d ρ hρ V_P, ← mul_assoc, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
      unfold pktLinearAtom
      dsimp [Φ_zero, g_x, μ]
      have hv_z : ρ⁻¹ • ((V_P + ρ • z) - V_P) = z := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ.ne', one_smul]
      simp only [Real.sqrt_one, Complex.ofReal_one, inv_one, one_smul, hv_z,
        mul_one, neg_mul, mul_zero, neg_zero, zero_add]
      have hC_ne : (C_χ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hC_χ_pos.ne'
      have h_chi : ((C_χ : ℂ) * (4 : ℂ)⁻¹) * ((C_χ : ℂ)⁻¹) = (4 : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp [hC_ne]
      calc (4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (pktPou2D (z - gridPt2D 1 j) : ℂ) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * (((Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (z - gridPt2D 1 j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
              ((ρ : ℂ) * h_W (V_P + ρ • z) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • z) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
          = (((C_χ : ℂ) * (4 : ℂ)⁻¹) * (C_χ : ℂ)⁻¹) * (pktPou2D (z - gridPt2D 1 j) : ℂ) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * (((Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (z - gridPt2D 1 j) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
              ((ρ : ℂ) * h_W (V_P + ρ • z) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • z) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
            rw [h_chi]
        _ = (C_χ : ℂ) * (4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ : ℂ) *
              (h_W (V_P + ρ • z) *
                ((C_χ : ℂ)⁻¹ * (pktPou2D (z - gridPt2D 1 j) : ℂ) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * (((Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (z - gridPt2D 1 j) : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • z) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
            ring

    have h_coeff_ox : ∀ j ∈ J_pat, ∀ n : ℤ × ℤ,
        ‖pktLinearCoeff 1 Φ_zero F_ox j n‖ ≤ C_coeff * w n := by
      intro j _ n
      let V_j := gridPt2D 1 j
      let U_j : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun y =>
        ψ_O o ((y + V_j) + ρ⁻¹ • (V_P - V_O o)) * (pktPou2D y : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_loc * (Φ₀ (c_end, X_O o, V_P + ρ • (y + V_j)) -
              Φ₀ (c_end, x, V_P + ρ • (y + V_j))) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have h_slice_j := h_slice Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_loc ρ c_end hlam hρ hρ1 hc_end
        V_P (V_O o) (X_O o) x V_j hXo_x (ψ_O o) (hO_reg o).1 (hO_reg o).2.2.1
      have hU_supp : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖y‖ → U_j y = 0 := by
        intro y hy
        dsimp [U_j]
        rw [h_pou_supp y hy, Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul]
      have h_eq_c : pktLinearCoeff 1 Φ_zero F_ox j n =
          ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹) * ∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            U_j y * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((-(Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) y : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        unfold pktLinearCoeff
        dsimp [Φ_zero, F_ox, U_j, V_j]
        rw [Real.sqrt_one, inv_one]
        simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, inv_one, mul_one, one_smul, mul_zero, zero_sub]
        congr 1
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self _ V_j]
        refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
        dsimp only
        rw [add_sub_cancel_right]
        have hexp_neg : Complex.I * ((-((Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) y) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            Complex.I * ((-(Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [hexp_neg]
        ring
      rw [h_eq_c]
      exact h_coeff_bd U_j h_slice_j.1 hU_supp h_slice_j.2 n

    let S_j : (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ := fun j =>
      ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, pktLinearCoeff 1 Φ_zero F_ox j n * J_op j n x
    have h_IW_gabor : I_W o = ((C_χ : ℂ) * (4 : ℂ)⁻¹) * ∑ j ∈ J_pat, S_j j := by
      rw [h_IW_eq, h_pair_eq]
      change (∑ j ∈ J_pat, ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ,
          pktLinearCoeff 1 Φ_zero F_ox j n *
            ∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom 1 Φ_zero j n z * g_x z) =
        ((C_χ : ℂ) * (4 : ℂ)⁻¹) * ∑ j ∈ J_pat, S_j j
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
      have h_term : (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
          pktLinearCoeff 1 Φ_zero F_ox j n *
            ∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom 1 Φ_zero j n z * g_x z) =
          (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ((C_χ : ℂ) * (4 : ℂ)⁻¹) *
            (pktLinearCoeff 1 Φ_zero F_ox j n * J_op j n x)) := by
        funext n
        rw [h_atom_pair j hj n]
        ring
      rw [h_term, tsum_mul_left]

    have h_norm_IW : ‖I_W o‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (C_χ ^ 2 / 16) * (J_pat.card : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ J_pat, ‖S_j j‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_IW_gabor, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hC_χ_pos.le,
        norm_inv, Complex.norm_ofNat, mul_pow]
      have h_sum_le1 : ‖∑ j ∈ J_pat, S_j j‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ J_pat, ‖S_j j‖ :=
        norm_sum_le J_pat S_j
      have h_sq_le1 : ‖∑ j ∈ J_pat, S_j j‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j ∈ J_pat, ‖S_j j‖) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_sum_le1 2
      have h_cs : (∑ j ∈ J_pat, ‖S_j j‖) ^ 2 ≤ (J_pat.card : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ J_pat, ‖S_j j‖ ^ 2 :=
        sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
      have h_comb := le_trans h_sq_le1 h_cs
      calc (C_χ * 4⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖∑ j ∈ J_pat, S_j j‖ ^ 2
          ≤ (C_χ * 4⁻¹) ^ 2 * ((J_pat.card : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ J_pat, ‖S_j j‖ ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_comb (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (C_χ ^ 2 / 16) * (J_pat.card : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ J_pat, ‖S_j j‖ ^ 2 := by ring

    have h_Sj_bd : ∀ j ∈ J_pat,
        ‖S_j j‖ ^ 2 ≤ 9 * C_coeff ^ 2 * ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, w n * ‖J_op j n x‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro j hj
      exact (h_wcs B₀ (pktLinearCoeff 1 Φ_zero F_ox j) (fun n => J_op j n x)
        hB₀_nn (h_coeff_ox j hj) (fun n => hJ_op_bd j hj n x)).2

    have h_coeff_nn : 0 ≤ (C_χ ^ 2 / 16) * (J_pat.card : ℝ) :=
      mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg C_χ) (by norm_num)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    calc ‖I_W o‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (C_χ ^ 2 / 16) * (J_pat.card : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ J_pat, ‖S_j j‖ ^ 2 := h_norm_IW
      _ ≤ (C_χ ^ 2 / 16) * (J_pat.card : ℝ) *
            ∑ j ∈ J_pat, (9 * C_coeff ^ 2 * ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, w n * ‖J_op j n x‖ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum h_Sj_bd) h_coeff_nn
      _ = ((C_χ ^ 2 / 16) * (J_pat.card : ℝ) * (9 * C_coeff ^ 2)) * Ψ p := by
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          dsimp [Ψ, x]
          ring
      _ = K_pt * Ψ p := by
          congr 1
          dsimp [K_pt]
          ring

  
  have h_pack_sub : ∀ (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (F : Finset (Fin N_obs)),
      (∀ o ∈ F, ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ) → (F.card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ) := by
    intro v₀ x₀ F hF
    have h_sub : F ⊆ @Finset.filter (Fin N_obs)
        (fun o => ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ)
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ := by
      intro o ho
      exact (@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ o).mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, hF o ho⟩
    exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card h_sub) (hO_pack v₀ x₀)

  
  have h_avg := rotated_strip_square_averaging_and_overlap B_cell ρ σ s N_mult N_obs
    hB hρ hσ hs hσ_le V_P x_Z n_P hn_P V_O X_O S_Z
    (fun o _ => (hO_reg o).2.2.2) h_pack_sub hS_Z
    (fun o => ‖I_W o‖ ^ 2) (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    (fun p => K_pt * Ψ p) R_strip rfl
    (fun p _ => mul_nonneg hK_pt_nn (hΨ_nn p))
    (hΨ_int.const_mul K_pt)
    h_pt_gabor
  rw [← hN_ov_eq] at h_avg

  have h_int_K : ∫ p in R_strip, K_pt * Ψ p = K_pt * ∫ p in R_strip, Ψ p :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul K_pt Ψ
  rw [h_int_K] at h_avg

  obtain ⟨I_st, hI_st_eq⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ∫ p in R_strip, Ψ p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hI_st_eq] at h_avg hΨ_strip_bd

  calc ∑ o ∈ S_Z, ‖I_W o‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (N_ov : ℝ) * (σ⁻¹ ^ 2 * (K_pt * I_st)) := h_avg
    _ = (N_ov : ℝ) * K_pt * (σ⁻¹ ^ 2 * I_st) := by ring
    _ ≤ (N_ov : ℝ) * K_pt * ((J_pat.card : ℝ) * 9 * M_strip) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΨ_strip_bd (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hK_pt_nn)
    _ = (9 * (N_ov : ℝ) * (J_pat.card : ℝ) * K_pt) * M_strip := by ring
    _ ≤ C_dec * M_strip := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_dec_ge_prod hM_strip

subgoal_signatures.name: gevrey_partition_and_fourier_synthesis
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ C_χ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_χ ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) ∧
      (∀ (lam_sys R_dom : ℝ), 1 ≤ lam_sys → 1 ≤ R_dom →
        ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
          Continuous Φ₀ →
        ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
            Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2)) ∧
          (∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
            (∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2) =
              ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (∀ (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            Continuous g →
            (∃ R_g : ℝ, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_g ≤ ‖v‖ → g v = 0) →
            (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
                pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n *
                  ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * g v)) ∧
            ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), f v * g v =
              ∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
                ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n *
                  ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * g v) ∧
          (∀ (F : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
              (fun v => ∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun v => ‖∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              ‖∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v‖ ^ 2) ≤
              4 * ∑ q ∈ F, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2))

subgoal_signatures.name: nonstationary_phase_1d_arbitrary_ibp
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (B D : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ C_ibp : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ibp ∧
      ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 → L ≤ deriv θ t) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 →
          |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| ≤ L * D m) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B k) →
        ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L ^ M

informal_problem.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_cell : ℝ) (M_atom : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hB : 2 ≤ B_cell) :
    ∃ C_tan : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_tan ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam_loc ρ s c_end M_fib : ℝ),
        0 < lam_loc → 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ 1 →
        B_cell⁻¹ ≤ lam_loc * s ^ 2 → lam_loc * s ^ 2 ≤ B_cell →
        c_end ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ M_fib →
      ∀ (V_P x_Z n_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖n_P‖ = 1 →
      ∀ (N_Q : ℕ) (V_T X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (η_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (c_T : Fin N_Q → ℂ) (W : Finset (Fin N_Q)),
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         (∀ T ∈ W, Continuous (η_T T) ∧ (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → η_T T z = 0) ∧
           (∀ z, ‖η_T T z‖ ≤ max (M_atom 0) 1)) ∧
         (∀ T₁ ∈ W, ∀ T₂ ∈ W, |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P| ≤ B_cell * s) ∧
         (∀ m : ℤ,
           ((W.filter (fun T =>
             Int.floor (inner ℝ (V_T T - V_P) (perp2D n_P) / s) = m)).card : ℝ) ≤ M_fib)) →
      ∀ μ_mod : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
        Continuous μ_mod →
        (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖μ_mod v‖ ≤ 1) →
        let σ := (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹
        let R_strip := Set.Icc (-(B_cell + 1) * σ) ((B_cell + 1) * σ) ×ˢ
          Set.Icc (-(2 * B_cell * s)) (2 * B_cell * s)
        let h_W := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ∑ T ∈ W, c_T T *
          ((s⁻¹ : ℂ) * η_T T (s⁻¹ • (v - V_T T)) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_T T, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
        σ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ p in R_strip,
          ‖(ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            h_W v * μ_mod v *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, x_Z + p.1 • n_P + p.2 • perp2D n_P, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 ≤
          C_tan * M_fib * (s / ρ) * ∑ T ∈ W, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2

signature.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_cell : ℝ) (M_atom : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hB : 2 ≤ B_cell) :
    ∃ C_tan : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_tan ∧

        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

        (η_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (c_T : Fin N_Q → ℂ) (W : Finset (Fin N_Q)),
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         (∀ T ∈ W, Continuous (η_T T) ∧ (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → η_T T z = 0) ∧

         (∀ T₁ ∈ W, ∀ T₂ ∈ W, |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P| ≤ B_cell * s) ∧

  have stepD_schur :

        linarith [abs_nonneg ((q T₁ : ℝ) - (q T₂ : ℝ))]

      have h1 : ‖n_P‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [hn_P]; norm_num
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
    have hsq : ‖τ_P‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [τ_P, perp2D, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      dsimp
      linear_combination hn_sq
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg τ_P]
  let M_ker : Fin N_Q → Fin N_Q → ℝ := fun T₁ T₂ =>
    C_ker / (1 + |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) τ_P| / s) ^ 4
  have hM_ker : ∀ T₁ ∈ W, ∀ T₂ ∈ W, 0 ≤ M_ker T₁ T₂ ∧
      ∀ (t_n : ℝ) (v v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖v - V_T T₁‖ ≤ 4 * s → ‖v' - V_T T₂‖ ≤ 4 * s →
        ‖∫ y : ℝ, (ω_tan y : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_loc * (Φ₀ (c_end, x_Z + t_n • n_P + (s * y) • τ_P, v) -
              Φ₀ (c_end, x_Z + t_n • n_P + (s * y) • τ_P, v')) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
          M_ker T₁ T₂ := by
    intro T₁ hT₁ T₂ hT₂
    let Δ_τ : ℝ := |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) τ_P|
    have hΔ_nn : 0 ≤ Δ_τ := abs_nonneg _
    have h_den_pos : 0 < 1 + Δ_τ / s := by positivity
    have h_den4_pos : 0 < (1 + Δ_τ / s) ^ 4 := pow_pos h_den_pos 4
    refine ⟨by dsimp only [M_ker]; positivity, ?_⟩
    intro t_n v v' hv hv'
    let x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := x_Z + t_n • n_P
    let Θ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
      lam_loc * (Φ₀ (c_end, x₀ + (s * y) • τ_P, v) - Φ₀ (c_end, x₀ + (s * y) • τ_P, v'))
    by_cases h_sep : M_cut * s ≤ Δ_τ
    · have hv_split : v - v' = (v - V_T T₁) + (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) + (V_T T₂ - v') := by abel
      have hv'_rev : ‖V_T T₂ - v'‖ ≤ 4 * s := by rwa [norm_sub_rev]
      have h_in1_n : |inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) n_P| ≤ 4 * s := by
        calc |inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) n_P| ≤ ‖v - V_T T₁‖ * ‖n_P‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ ≤ 4 * s * 1 := by rw [hn_P]; linarith
          _ = 4 * s := mul_one _
      have h_in3_n : |inner ℝ (V_T T₂ - v') n_P| ≤ 4 * s := by
        calc |inner ℝ (V_T T₂ - v') n_P| ≤ ‖V_T T₂ - v'‖ * ‖n_P‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ ≤ 4 * s * 1 := by rw [hn_P]; linarith
          _ = 4 * s := mul_one _
      have h_norm_off : |inner ℝ (v - v') n_P| ≤ (B_cell + 8) * s := by
        have h_add : inner ℝ (v - v') n_P =
            (inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) n_P + inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P) +
              inner ℝ (V_T T₂ - v') n_P := by
          conv_lhs => rw [hv_split]
          rw [inner_add_left, inner_add_left]
        rw [h_add]
        have h12 := abs_add_le (inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) n_P) (inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P)
        have h123 := abs_add_le
          (inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) n_P + inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P)
          (inner ℝ (V_T T₂ - v') n_P)
        have h_bin := h_bin_W T₁ hT₁ T₂ hT₂
        linarith
      have h_in1_τ : |inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) τ_P| ≤ 4 * s := by
        calc |inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) τ_P| ≤ ‖v - V_T T₁‖ * ‖τ_P‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ ≤ 4 * s * 1 := by rw [hτ_norm]; linarith
          _ = 4 * s := mul_one _
      have h_in3_τ : |inner ℝ (V_T T₂ - v') τ_P| ≤ 4 * s := by
        calc |inner ℝ (V_T T₂ - v') τ_P| ≤ ‖V_T T₂ - v'‖ * ‖τ_P‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ ≤ 4 * s * 1 := by rw [hτ_norm]; linarith
          _ = 4 * s := mul_one _
      have h_Δ_le : Δ_τ ≤ |inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P| + 8 * s := by
        have h_sub_τ : inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) τ_P =
            (inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P - inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) τ_P) -
              inner ℝ (V_T T₂ - v') τ_P := by
          have h_vec : V_T T₁ - V_T T₂ = (v - v') - (v - V_T T₁) - (V_T T₂ - v') := by abel
          conv_lhs => rw [h_vec]
          rw [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_left]
        dsimp only [Δ_τ]
        rw [h_sub_τ]
        have h1 := abs_sub (inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P - inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) τ_P)
          (inner ℝ (V_T T₂ - v') τ_P)
        have h2 := abs_sub (inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P) (inner ℝ (v - V_T T₁) τ_P)
        linarith
      have h_half_Δ : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_τ ≤ |inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P| := by
        nlinarith [hM_cut_ge20, hs, h_sep, h_Δ_le]
      have h_tan_sep : (a₁ * (B_cell + 8) / a₀) * s ≤ |inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P| := by
        have h_eq : (a₁ * (B_cell + 8) / a₀) * s = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (M_cut * s) := by
          dsimp only [M_cut]; ring
        linarith
      obtain ⟨hL_pos, ε_sgn, hε_cases, hθ_cd, hθ_lo, hθ_hi⟩ :=
        stepC_clairaut Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_loc s c_end hlam hs hs1 hlam_lo hlam_hi hc_end
          x₀ n_P v v' hn_P h_norm_off h_tan_sep
      let L : ℝ := (a₀ / (2 * B_cell)) * (|inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P| / s)
      let θ_pos : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ε_sgn * Θ y
      have h_ibp_est : ‖∫ y : ℝ, (ω_tan y : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ_pos y : ℂ))‖ ≤
          C_ibp / L ^ 4 :=
        h_ibp L hL_pos θ_pos hθ_cd hθ_lo (fun m hm1 _ y => hθ_hi m hm1 y)
          (fun t => (ω_tan t : ℂ))
          (fun k => Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (hω_cd k))
          (fun t ht => by rw [hω_supp t (le_of_lt ht), Complex.ofReal_zero])
          (fun k _ y => (hB_ω k).2 y)
      have h_norm_eq : ‖∫ y : ℝ, (ω_tan y : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Θ y : ℂ))‖ =
          ‖∫ y : ℝ, (ω_tan y : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ_pos y : ℂ))‖ := by
        rcases hε_cases with hε1 | hεm1
        · congr 2
          ext y
          dsimp only [θ_pos]
          rw [hε1, one_mul]
        · have h_conj_fn : (fun y : ℝ => (ω_tan y : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ_pos y : ℂ))) =
              fun y : ℝ => (starRingEnd ℂ)
                ((ω_tan y : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Θ y : ℂ))) := by
            ext y
            rw [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, ← Complex.exp_conj]
            congr 2
            dsimp only [θ_pos]
            rw [hεm1]
            simp [Complex.conj_ofReal]
          rw [h_conj_fn, integral_conj, RCLike.norm_conj]
      have h_den_le_4 : 1 + Δ_τ / s ≤ 4 * (|inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P| / s) := by
        have h_div_ge20 : 20 ≤ Δ_τ / s := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mpr (by nlinarith [hM_cut_ge20, hs, h_sep])
        have h_div_half : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Δ_τ / s) ≤ |inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P| / s := by
          have h1 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_half_Δ hs.le
          have h_id : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_τ / s = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Δ_τ / s) := by ring
          linarith
        linarith
      have h_L_lo : (a₀ / (8 * B_cell)) * (1 + Δ_τ / s) ≤ L := by
        have h_pos_fac : 0 < a₀ / (8 * B_cell) := by positivity
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_den_le_4 h_pos_fac.le
        have h_id : (a₀ / (8 * B_cell)) * (4 * (|inner ℝ (v - v') τ_P| / s)) = L := by
          dsimp only [L]; ring
        linarith
      have h_lo_pos : 0 < (a₀ / (8 * B_cell)) * (1 + Δ_τ / s) := by positivity
      have h_pow_lo : ((a₀ / (8 * B_cell)) * (1 + Δ_τ / s)) ^ 4 ≤ L ^ 4 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ h_lo_pos.le h_L_lo 4
      have h_B_ne : B_cell ≠ 0 := by linarith
      calc ‖∫ y : ℝ, (ω_tan y : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Θ y : ℂ))‖
          = ‖∫ y : ℝ, (ω_tan y : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ_pos y : ℂ))‖ := h_norm_eq
        _ ≤ C_ibp / L ^ 4 := h_ibp_est
        _ ≤ C_ibp / ((a₀ / (8 * B_cell)) * (1 + Δ_τ / s)) ^ 4 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hC_ibp_nn (pow_pos h_lo_pos 4) h_pow_lo
        _ = (C_ibp * (8 * B_cell / a₀) ^ 4) / (1 + Δ_τ / s) ^ 4 := by
            rw [mul_pow, div_pow, div_pow]
            field_simp [ha₀.ne', h_B_ne, h_den4_pos.ne']
        _ ≤ C_ker / (1 + Δ_τ / s) ^ 4 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) h_den4_pos.le
    · have h_div_le : Δ_τ / s ≤ M_cut := (div_le_iff₀ hs).mpr (le_of_not_ge h_sep)
      have h_pow_le : (1 + Δ_τ / s) ^ 4 ≤ (1 + M_cut) ^ 4 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ h_den_pos.le (by linarith) 4
      calc ‖∫ y : ℝ, (ω_tan y : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Θ y : ℂ))‖
          ≤ 4 * B_cell + 2 := hω_triv Θ
        _ = ((4 * B_cell + 2) * (1 + Δ_τ / s) ^ 4) / (1 + Δ_τ / s) ^ 4 := by
            field_simp [h_den4_pos.ne']
        _ ≤ ((4 * B_cell + 2) * (1 + M_cut) ^ 4) / (1 + Δ_τ / s) ^ 4 := by
            refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ h_den4_pos.le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow_le (by linarith)
        _ ≤ C_ker / (1 + Δ_τ / s) ^ 4 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) h_den4_pos.le
  have h_strip := h_fub Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont lam_loc ρ s c_end hlam hs hsρ hlam_hi
    x_Z n_P N_Q V_T X_T η_T c_T W M_ker hη_W hM_ker μ_mod hμ_cont hμ_le
  have h_quad := stepD_schur s M_fib C_ker hs hM_fib (by linarith [hC_ker_ge1])
    V_P τ_P N_Q V_T c_T W M_ker h_fib_W (fun _ _ _ _ => le_rfl)
  have h_pref_nn : 0 ≤ 8192 * B_cell * (B_cell + 1) * A_atom ^ 2 * (s / ρ) := by
    have hsρ_nn : 0 ≤ s / ρ := div_nonneg hs.le hρ.le
    positivity
  calc ((lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ p in
        Set.Icc (-(B_cell + 1) * (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹) ((B_cell + 1) * (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹) ×ˢ
          Set.Icc (-(2 * B_cell * s)) (2 * B_cell * s),
        ‖(ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          (∑ T ∈ W, c_T T *
            ((s⁻¹ : ℂ) * η_T T (s⁻¹ • (v - V_T T)) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_T T, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))) *
            μ_mod v *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((lam_loc * Φ₀ (c_end, x_Z + p.1 • n_P + p.2 • perp2D n_P, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 8192 * B_cell * (B_cell + 1) * A_atom ^ 2 * (s / ρ) *
          ∑ T₁ ∈ W, ∑ T₂ ∈ W, ‖c_T T₁‖ * ‖c_T T₂‖ * M_ker T₁ T₂ := h_strip
    _ ≤ 8192 * B_cell * (B_cell + 1) * A_atom ^ 2 * (s / ρ) *
          (48 * C_ker * M_fib * ∑ T ∈ W, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_quad h_pref_nn
    _ = C_tan * M_fib * (s / ρ) * ∑ T ∈ W, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp only [C_tan]
        ring

informal_problem.statement:
(C_χ : ℝ) (hC_χ : 1 ≤ C_χ)
    (h_pou_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D)
    (h_pou_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0)
    (h_pou_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    ∃ M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win k, 0 ≤ M_atom a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win k) ∧
      ∀ (a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win : ℝ),
        0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A → 2 ≤ B_sys → 2 ≤ R_win →
        ∃ (C_can : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ),
          1 ≤ C_can ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧
          ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
            (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
          ∀ (lam_sys ρ_r s_c C_r : ℝ) (X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            0 < lam_sys → 0 < ρ_r → ρ_r ≤ 1 → 0 < s_c → s_c ≤ 1 →
            C_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * s_c ≤ 2 * B_sys ^ 2 →
            let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
            ∃ X_ex : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              (∀ j n : ℤ × ℤ,
                ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ_r j, X_ex j n - C_r • gridPt2D ρ_r j) =
                  ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ_r j, X_J - C_r • gridPt2D ρ_r j) -
                    ((Real.pi * σ_r / 2) : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) ∧
              (∀ p₁ p₂ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                a₀ * ‖p₁ - p₂‖ ≤ ‖ζ₀ (v, p₁) - ζ₀ (v, p₂)‖ ∧
                ‖ζ₀ (v, p₁) - ζ₀ (v, p₂)‖ ≤ a₁ * ‖p₁ - p₂‖) ∧
              (∀ j n : ℤ × ℤ,
                ‖gridPt2D σ_r (pktRound2D σ_r (X_ex j n)) - X_ex j n‖ ≤ σ_r) ∧
              (∀ (S_fib : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) (o₀ : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
                (∀ q ∈ S_fib, (q.1, pktRound2D σ_r (X_ex q.1 q.2)) = o₀) →
                  S_fib.card ≤ M_mult) ∧
              (∀ (j n : ℤ × ℤ) (X_at : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
                let ψ_at := cutPacketWindow lam_sys ρ_r C_r X_J X_at Φ₀ j n
                let V_j := gridPt2D ρ_r j
                (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                  (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_j))) *
                    Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
                  cutLinearAtom lam_sys ρ_r C_r X_J Φ₀ j n v) ∧
                (∀ f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
                  (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                    f v * ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) *
                      Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
                  cutLinearCoeff lam_sys ρ_r C_r X_J Φ₀ f j n) ∧
                (‖X_at - X_ex j n‖ ≤ σ_r →
                  ‖X_at - X_J‖ ≤ (8 * B_sys + 2 * R_win + 10) * s_c →
                  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_at) ∧
                  (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_at z = 0) ∧
                  (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
                    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_at z‖ ≤ M_atom a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win k))) ∧
              (C_r = 1 / 2 → s_c = 1 → ρ_r = (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ → 2 ≤ lam_sys →
                ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
                  MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                  ∀ j n : ℤ × ℤ,
                    let k_X := pktRound2D ρ_r (X_ex j n)
                    ‖gridPt2D ρ_r k_X - X_J‖ ≤ 8 * B_sys + 2 * R_win + 10 →
                    ‖cutLinearCoeff lam_sys ρ_r (1 / 2) X_J Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2 ≤
                      C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (j, k_X))

  have h_surj : ∀ v : E, Function.Surjective (fun p => ζ₀ (v, p)) := by

                      ((Real.exp 3) ^ m₁ * ((m₁.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) :=

          let F_χ : E → ℂ := fun y => (pktPou2D y : ℂ)

    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul, ψ_can]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hψ_can : IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ_can := by
    refine ⟨fun k => by rw [hψ_can_smul]; exact (hψ_smooth k).const_smul (C_amp⁻¹ : ℝ), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z hz
      dsimp [ψ_can, ψ_at]
      rw [hψ_supp z (by linarith), mul_zero]
    · intro k z
      rw [hψ_can_smul, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply (hψ_smooth k).contDiffAt,
        norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hC_amp_pos.le)]
      have h_at_k : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_at z‖ ≤ C₁ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4) := by
        dsimp [ψ_at]
        rw [← show M_atom a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win k = C₁ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4) by
          dsimp [M_atom]; rw [hC₁_eq]]
        exact hψ_deriv k z
      have h_prom : C₁ ^ (k + 1) ≤ C_amp * (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 6) := by
        have h_exp := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (C₁ / 100) (by positivity) k
        have hfac_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos k
        have h1 : (C₁ / 100) ^ k ≤ Real.exp (C₁ / 100) * (k.factorial : ℝ) :=
          (div_le_iff₀ hfac_pos).mp h_exp
        have h2 : (C₁ / 100) ^ (k + 1) ≤
            ((C₁ / 100) * Real.exp (C₁ / 100)) * (k.factorial : ℝ) := by
          rw [pow_succ' (C₁ / 100) k]
          calc (C₁ / 100) * (C₁ / 100) ^ k
              ≤ (C₁ / 100) * (Real.exp (C₁ / 100) * (k.factorial : ℝ)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
            _ = ((C₁ / 100) * Real.exp (C₁ / 100)) * (k.factorial : ℝ) := by ring
        have hfac_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos k
        have hfac_pow6 : (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 6) :=
          le_self_pow₀ hfac_ge1 (by omega)
        have h3 : (C₁ / 100) ^ (k + 1) ≤ C_amp * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 6) := by
          calc (C₁ / 100) ^ (k + 1)
              ≤ ((C₁ / 100) * Real.exp (C₁ / 100)) * (k.factorial : ℝ) := h2
            _ ≤ C_amp * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 6) :=
                mul_le_mul (le_max_right _ _) hfac_pow6 (by positivity) hC_amp_pos.le
        have h100_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
        have h_eq : C₁ ^ (k + 1) = (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * (C₁ / 100) ^ (k + 1) := by
          rw [← mul_pow]
          congr 1
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * (C₁ / 100) ^ (k + 1)
            ≤ (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * (C_amp * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 6)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h100_pos.le
          _ = C_amp * (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 6) := by ring
      calc C_amp⁻¹ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_at z‖
          ≤ C_amp⁻¹ * (C₁ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_at_k (inv_nonneg.mpr hC_amp_pos.le)
        _ ≤ C_amp⁻¹ *
              ((C_amp * (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 6)) *
                ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prom (by positivity))
              (inv_nonneg.mpr hC_amp_pos.le)
        _ = (C_amp⁻¹ * C_amp) * (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 10) := by ring
        _ = (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 10) := by
            rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hC_amp_pos.ne', one_mul]

  
  let ρ₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := inv_pos.mpr hsqrt_pos
  let B_V : Set E := Metric.closedBall (gridPt2D ρ₀ j) (100 * ρ₀)
  let D_o : E → ℝ := fun v => 50 * (‖f v‖ ^ 2 + Set.indicator B_V (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) v)
  have h_ind_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Set.indicator B_V (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)))
      MeasureTheory.volume :=
    MeasureTheory.memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp
      (MeasureTheory.memLp_indicator_const 1 measurableSet_closedBall (1 : ℝ)
        (Or.inr MeasureTheory.measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne))
  have hDo_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable D_o MeasureTheory.volume :=
    ((hf_l2.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)).add h_ind_int).const_mul 50
  have hDo_nn : ∀ v : E, 0 ≤ D_o v := by
    intro v
    dsimp [D_o]
    have h_ind_nn : 0 ≤ Set.indicator B_V (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) v := by
      by_cases hv : v ∈ B_V
      · simp [hv]
      · simp [hv]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖f v‖]
  let W_set : Set ℝ := { m : ℝ | ∃ ψ : E → ℂ, IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ ∧
    m = ‖(ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : E,
      f v * ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 }
  have hW_bdd : BddAbove W_set := by
    refine ⟨(ρ₀⁻¹ * ∫ v : E, D_o v) ^ 2, ?_⟩
    rintro m ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩
    have h_ptwise : ∀ v : E,
        ‖f v * ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤ D_o v := by
      intro v
      by_cases hv : v ∈ B_V
      · have h_ind : Set.indicator B_V (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) v = 1 := Set.indicator_of_mem hv _
        have hψ_le100 : ‖ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j))‖ ≤ 100 := by
          have h0 := hψ.2.2 0 (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j))
          rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h0
          simpa using h0
        have hexp_norm :
            ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ = 1 := by
          rw [mul_comm Complex.I _]
          exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, hexp_norm, mul_one]
        dsimp [D_o]
        rw [h_ind]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (f v), sq_nonneg (‖f v‖ - 1)]
      · have h_dist : 100 * ρ₀ < ‖v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j‖ := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hv
          linarith
        have h_scaled : 100 ≤ ‖ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j)‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ₀_pos.le)]
          have h_lt : 100 < ρ₀⁻¹ * ‖v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j‖ :=
            (lt_inv_mul_iff₀ hρ₀_pos).mpr (by linarith)
          exact h_lt.le
        rw [hψ.2.1 _ h_scaled, mul_zero, zero_mul, norm_zero]
        exact hDo_nn v
    have h_int_le : ‖∫ v : E, f v * ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤ ∫ v : E, D_o v :=
      MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hDo_int (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_ptwise)
    have h_prod_le : ‖(ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : E, f v * ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤ ρ₀⁻¹ * ∫ v : E, D_o v := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hρ₀_pos.le]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_le (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ₀_pos.le)
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_prod_le 2
  let m_can : ℝ := ‖(ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : E,
    f v * ψ_can (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I *
        ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2
  have hm_can_le : m_can ≤ canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (j, k_X) := by
    unfold canonicalRootMass
    exact le_csSup hW_bdd ⟨ψ_can, hψ_can, rfl⟩
  have h_coeff_eq : cutLinearCoeff lam_sys ρ_r (1 / 2) X_J Φ₀ f j n =
      (C_amp : ℂ) * ((ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : E,
        f v * ψ_can (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
    rw [← h_props.2.1 f]
    have h_pt : (fun v : E =>
        f v * ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
      (fun v : E => (C_amp : ℂ) *
        (f v * ψ_can (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ₀ j)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ₀ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) := by
      funext v
      have hC_ne : (C_amp : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hC_amp_pos.ne'
      dsimp [ψ_can, ψ_at, V_j, X_at, ρ₀]
      rw [hρ_eq]
      calc f v * cutPacketWindow lam_sys (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ (1 / 2) X_J
              (gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ k_X) Φ₀ j n
              ((Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ j)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
          = ((C_amp : ℂ) * (C_amp⁻¹ : ℂ)) *
              (f v * cutPacketWindow lam_sys (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ (1 / 2) X_J
                (gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ k_X) Φ₀ j n
                ((Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ j)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
            rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hC_ne, one_mul]
        _ = (C_amp : ℂ) *
              (f v * ((C_amp⁻¹ : ℂ) * cutPacketWindow lam_sys (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ (1 / 2) X_J
                (gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ k_X) Φ₀ j n
                ((Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ j))) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ k_X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
            ring
    change (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : E,
      f v * ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = _
    rw [h_pt, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    dsimp [ρ₀]
    rw [hρ_eq]
    ring
  have h_norm_sq : ‖cutLinearCoeff lam_sys ρ_r (1 / 2) X_J Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2 = C_can * m_can := by
    rw [h_coeff_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hC_amp_pos.le, mul_pow]
  rw [h_norm_sq]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_can_le (by positivity)

informal_problem.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win C_χ : ℝ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hC_χ : 1 ≤ C_χ)
    (h_pou_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D)
    (h_pou_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0)
    (h_pou_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    ∃ C_tr : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ M : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_tr M) ∧
      ∀ (M : ℕ), 2 ≤ M →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam_sys ρ_r ρ_t s_c s_v C_r C_t R₀ E_f : ℝ)
        (X_J V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        0 < lam_sys → 0 < ρ_r → ρ_r ≤ 1 → 0 < ρ_t →
        ρ_r ≤ Real.sqrt B_sys * ρ_t → ρ_t ≤ s_v → s_v ≤ 1 →
        0 < s_c → s_c ≤ 1 →
        C_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 →
        lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * s_c ≤ 2 * B_sys ^ 2 →
        2 ≤ R₀ → 0 ≤ E_f →
        ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * B_sys * (s_c * s_v) →
      ∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
      ∀ (X_ex : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        (∀ j n : ℤ × ℤ,
          ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ_r j, X_ex j n - C_r • gridPt2D ρ_r j) =
            ζ₀ (gridPt2D ρ_r j, X_J - C_r • gridPt2D ρ_r j) -
              ((Real.pi * σ_r / 2) : ℝ) • gridPt2D 1 n) →
        let pair_jn : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ := fun j n =>
          (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            cutLinearAtom lam_sys ρ_r C_r X_J Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        ((∀ (J_vel : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (N_ret : (ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
            (c_jn : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ),
            (∀ j ∈ J_vel, Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ‖c_jn j n‖ ^ 2)) →
            (∑ j ∈ J_vel, ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖c_jn j n‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f) →
            (∀ j ∈ J_vel, ∀ n : ℤ × ℤ, n ∉ N_ret j →
              R_win * ρ_t + 2 * ρ_r ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ_r j - V_o‖ ∨
              R₀ * σ_r ≤ ‖X_o - X_ex j n - (C_t - C_r) • gridPt2D ρ_r j‖) →
            ‖∑ j ∈ J_vel, ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ,
              if n ∈ N_ret j then (0 : ℂ) else c_jn j n * pair_jn j n‖ ≤
              C_tr M * R₀ ^ (1 - (M : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt E_f) ∧
         (∀ (S_far : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) (c_q : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ℂ),
            (∑ q ∈ S_far, ‖c_q q‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f) →
            (∀ q ∈ S_far,
              R_win * ρ_t + 2 * ρ_r ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ_r q.1 - V_o‖ ∨
              R₀ * σ_r ≤ ‖X_o - X_ex q.1 q.2 - (C_t - C_r) • gridPt2D ρ_r q.1‖) →
            ‖∑ q ∈ S_far, c_q q * pair_jn q.1 q.2‖ ≤
              C_tr M * R₀ ^ (1 - (M : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt E_f))

          field_simp [hρ_r_c, hρ_t_c]
        calc (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * (((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ)) *
              (((ρ_r ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g x))
            = ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * (((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ)) * ((ρ_r ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
              ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g x := by ring
          _ = (((ρ_r / (4 * ρ_t)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g x := by
              rw [h_pref]
      have hg_cont : Continuous g := by
        refine ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h_pou_cont).mul
          (hψ_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul (ρ_r / ρ_t))))).mul ?_
        refine Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_))
        refine (continuous_const.mul ((hΦ₀_cont.comp ?_).sub (hΦ₀_cont.comp ?_))).add
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.inner continuous_id))
        · exact continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk
            (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul ρ_r)))
        · exact continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk
            (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul ρ_r)))
      have hg_supp : HasCompactSupport g := by
        refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 2)

        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
        have h0 : pktPou2D z = 0 := h_pou_supp z hz.le
        simp [g, h0]
      have hg_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hg_cont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hg_supp
      have hw_sq : (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have h1 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [hw]; norm_num
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
      let R_w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        { toFun := fun u => (u 0) • w + (u 1) • perp2D w
          map_add' := fun u v => by
            ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D] <;> ring
          map_smul' := fun c u => by
            ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D] <;> ring
          invFun := fun z =>
            WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 =>
              if i = 0 then inner ℝ z w else inner ℝ z (perp2D w))
          left_inv := fun u => by
            ext i
            fin_cases i
            · simp [perp2D, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              linear_combination (u 0) * hw_sq
            · simp [perp2D, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              linear_combination (u 1) * hw_sq

            have hsq : ‖(u 0) • w + (u 1) • perp2D w‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by

      let e_toLp : (Fin 2 → ℝ) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=

      let Φ_rot : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=

      have hΦ_mp : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving Φ_rot

        have h1 : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.symm

      have h_fubini : (∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g z) =

        have h_pt0 : ∀ t : ℝ, g (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) = 0 := by

                Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

            rw [h_eq]
            have hy_sq : 2 ^ 2 < y₁ ^ 2 := by rw [← sq_abs y₁]; nlinarith
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
          have h_norm : 2 ≤ ‖t • w + y₁ • perp2D w‖ := by
            nlinarith [norm_nonneg (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)]
          have h0 : pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) = 0 := h_pou_supp _ h_norm
          simp [g, h0]
        simp_rw [h_pt0, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
      have h_int_norm : ‖∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g z‖ ≤ 4 * M_sl := by
        rw [h_fubini, ← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero h_out_zero]
        have h_meas_lt : MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) < ⊤ := by
          rw [Real.volume_Icc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
        have h_est := MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const h_meas_lt h_bound
        have h_vol_real : MeasureTheory.volume.real (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) = 4 := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.real_def, Real.volume_Icc]; norm_num
        rw [h_vol_real, mul_comm] at h_est
        exact h_est
      have h_pref_nn : 0 ≤ ρ_r / (4 * ρ_t) := by positivity
      rw [h_int_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h_pref_nn]
      calc (ρ_r / (4 * ρ_t)) * ‖∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g z‖

            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_norm h_pref_nn
        _ = (ρ_r / ρ_t) * M_sl := by field_simp [hρ_t_ne]
    have h_triv : ‖pair_jn‖ ≤ 4 * (ρ_r / ρ_t) * B_amp 0 := by
      let w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D 1 (1, 0)

        nlinarith [norm_nonneg w₀]

      · linarith
      · intro y₁ _hy₁

            · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith

            have h_eq0 : ‖t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2 := by
              rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              simp only [w₀, gridPt2D, perp2D, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply,
                smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_zero]
              dsimp
              ring
            rw [h_eq0]
            have ht_sq : 2 ^ 2 < t ^ 2 := by rw [← sq_abs t]; nlinarith
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg y₁]
          have h_norm : 2 ≤ ‖t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀‖ := by
            nlinarith [norm_nonneg (t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀)]
          have h0 : pktPou2D (t • w₀ + y₁ • perp2D w₀) = 0 := h_pou_supp _ h_norm
          simp [F_t, h0]
        change ‖∫ t : ℝ, F_t t‖ ≤ 4 * B_amp 0
        rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hF_out]
        have h_meas_lt : MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) < ⊤ := by
          rw [Real.volume_Icc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
        have hF_pt : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2, ‖F_t t‖ ≤ B_amp 0 := by
          intro t _ht
          dsimp only [F_t]
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one, ← hB_amp_zero]
          exact mul_le_mul (h_pou_bound _) (hψ_bd _) (norm_nonneg _) hC_χ_pos.le
        have h_est := MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const h_meas_lt hF_pt
        have h_vol_real : MeasureTheory.volume.real (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) = 4 := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.real_def, Real.volume_Icc]; norm_num
        rw [h_vol_real] at h_est
