    exact ⟨h_disj, h_triv, h_slice⟩

  
  have h_win_bounds :
      ∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
      ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → r ≤ B_sys →
      ∀ (z_sh w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖w‖ = 1 →
      ∀ (y₁ : ℝ),
        let u : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
          (pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) : ℂ) *
            ψ_o (z_sh + r • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) ∧
        (∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ |t| → u t = 0) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B_amp k) := by
    intro ψ_o hψ_smooth hψ_deriv r hr0 hrB z_sh w hw y₁
    dsimp only
    let Λ₁ : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) w
    let Λ₂ : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (r • w)
    have hΛ₁_app : ∀ t : ℝ, Λ₁ t = t • w := fun t => by simp [Λ₁]
    have hΛ₂_app : ∀ t : ℝ, Λ₂ t = t • (r • w) := fun t => by simp [Λ₂]
    have hΛ₁_norm : ‖Λ₁‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun t => ?_)
      rw [hΛ₁_app, norm_smul, hw, mul_one, one_mul]
    have hΛ₂_norm : ‖Λ₂‖ ≤ B_sys := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hB_sys_pos.le (fun t => ?_)
      rw [hΛ₂_app, norm_smul, norm_smul, hw, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr0, mul_comm ‖t‖ r]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrB (norm_nonneg t)
    let z₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := y₁ • perp2D w
    let z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := z_sh + r • (y₁ • perp2D w)
    let g₁ : ℝ → ℝ := (fun z => pktPou2D (z + z₁)) ∘ ⇑Λ₁
    have hg₁_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k g₁ := fun k =>
      ((h_pou_smooth k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).comp Λ₁.contDiff
    have hg₁_bd : ∀ (i : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g₁ t‖ ≤ W_χ i := by
      intro i t
      have h_shift_cd : ContDiff ℝ i (fun z => pktPou2D (z + z₁)) :=
        (h_pou_smooth i).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      dsimp only [g₁]
      rw [Λ₁.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_shift_cd t le_rfl, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
      have h_le1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i pktPou2D (Λ₁ t + z₁)) (fun _ : Fin i => Λ₁)
      have h_prod_le : (∏ _ : Fin i, ‖Λ₁‖) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg Λ₁) hΛ₁_norm
      calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i pktPou2D (Λ₁ t + z₁)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ₁)‖
          ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i pktPou2D (Λ₁ t + z₁)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin i, ‖Λ₁‖ := h_le1
        _ ≤ W_χ i * 1 := mul_le_mul (h_pou_deriv i (Λ₁ t + z₁)) h_prod_le
            (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg Λ₁)) (hW_χ_nn i)
        _ = W_χ i := mul_one _
    let f₁ : ℝ → ℂ := ⇑Complex.ofRealLI ∘ g₁
    have hf₁_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k f₁ := fun k =>
      Complex.ofRealLI.contDiff.comp (hg₁_cd k)
    have hf₁_bd : ∀ (i : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f₁ t‖ ≤ W_χ i := by
      intro i t
      dsimp only [f₁]
      rw [Complex.ofRealLI.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (hg₁_cd i).contDiffAt
        (le_rfl : (i : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ i)]
      exact hg₁_bd i t
    let f₂ : ℝ → ℂ := (fun z => ψ_o (z + z₂)) ∘ ⇑Λ₂
    have hf₂_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k f₂ := fun k =>
      ((hψ_smooth k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).comp Λ₂.contDiff
    have hf₂_bd : ∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f₂ t‖ ≤ B_sys ^ j * M'_win j := by
      intro j t
      have h_shift_cd : ContDiff ℝ j (fun z => ψ_o (z + z₂)) :=
        (hψ_smooth j).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      dsimp only [f₂]
      rw [Λ₂.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_shift_cd t le_rfl, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
      have h_le1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ t + z₂)) (fun _ : Fin j => Λ₂)
      have h_prod_le : (∏ _ : Fin j, ‖Λ₂‖) ≤ B_sys ^ j := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg Λ₂) hΛ₂_norm j
      have hψ_M' : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ t + z₂)‖ ≤ M'_win j :=
        le_trans (hψ_deriv j (Λ₂ t + z₂)) (le_max_left _ _)
      calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ t + z₂)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ₂)‖
          ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ t + z₂)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin j, ‖Λ₂‖ := h_le1
        _ ≤ M'_win j * B_sys ^ j := mul_le_mul hψ_M' h_prod_le
            (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg Λ₂)) (hM'_nn j)
        _ = B_sys ^ j * M'_win j := mul_comm _ _
    have hu_eq : (fun t : ℝ =>
          (pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) : ℂ) *
            ψ_o (z_sh + r • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w))) =
        fun t => f₁ t * f₂ t := by
      ext t
      dsimp only [f₁, f₂, g₁, z₁, z₂, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [hΛ₁_app t, hΛ₂_app t]
      have h_arg2 : t • (r • w) + (z_sh + r • (y₁ • perp2D w)) =
          z_sh + r • (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) := by
        ext i
        simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [h_arg2]
      rfl
    refine ⟨fun k => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hu_eq]
      exact (hf₁_cd k).mul (hf₂_cd k)
    · intro t ht
      have hw_sq : (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have h1 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [hw]; norm_num
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
      have h_norm_sq : 2 ^ 2 ≤ ‖t • w + y₁ • perp2D w‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_eq : ‖t • w + y₁ • perp2D w‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2 := by
          rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, perp2D,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
          dsimp
          linear_combination (t ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2) * hw_sq
        rw [h_eq]
        have ht_sq : 2 ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 := by rw [← sq_abs t]; nlinarith
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg y₁]
      have h_norm : 2 ≤ ‖t • w + y₁ • perp2D w‖ := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w)]
      have h0 : pktPou2D (t • w + y₁ • perp2D w) = 0 := h_pou_supp _ h_norm
      simp [h0]
    · intro k t
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hu_eq]
      have h_mul := norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le (hf₁_cd k) (hf₂_cd k) t
        (le_rfl : (k : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ k)
      refine le_trans h_mul (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _hi => ?_))
      have h_choose_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f₁ t‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) f₂ t‖
          = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f₁ t‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) f₂ t‖) :=
            mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (W_χ i * (B_sys ^ (k - i) * M'_win (k - i))) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ h_choose_nn
            exact mul_le_mul (hf₁_bd i t) (hf₂_bd (k - i) t) (norm_nonneg _) (hW_χ_nn i)
        _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * W_χ i * B_sys ^ (k - i) * M'_win (k - i) := by ring

  
  have h_iter_id_mul : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n g) →

          have hθ_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (θ_sl y₁) := fun k => by
            rw [hθ_eq]
            exact (hΦ_diff_cd k).add ((contDiff_id.mul contDiff_const).add contDiff_const)
          have hθ_deriv_eq : ∀ s : ℝ, deriv (θ_sl y₁) s = κ_n + δ s := by
            intro s
            have hd1 : HasDerivAt
                (fun s' => lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v_fn s') - Φ₀ (C_r, X_J, v_fn s')))
                (δ s) s := by
              have hd := ((hΦ_diff_cd 1).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
                (x := s)
              rwa [hΦ_diff_deriv rfl s] at hd
            have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => s' * κ_n + c_n) κ_n s := by
              have hm : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => s' * κ_n) (1 * κ_n) s :=
                (hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const κ_n
              rw [one_mul] at hm
              exact hm.add_const c_n
            have hd_all : HasDerivAt
                (fun s' => lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v_fn s') - Φ₀ (C_r, X_J, v_fn s')) +
                  (s' * κ_n + c_n))
                (δ s + κ_n) s := hd1.add hd2
            rw [hθ_eq, hd_all.deriv]
            ring
          have hθ_deriv_fn : deriv (θ_sl y₁) = fun s => κ_n + δ s := funext hθ_deriv_eq
          have hθ_hi_raw : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 →
              |iteratedDeriv m (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) t| ≤ C_term m := by
            intro m hm t ht
            rw [hθ_deriv_fn, iteratedDeriv_const_add (by omega : 0 < m)]
            exact hδ_bd m hm t ht
          have hθ_hi : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 →
              |iteratedDeriv m (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) t| ≤ L * C_term m := by
            intro m hm _ t ht
            calc |iteratedDeriv m (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) t|
                ≤ C_term m := hθ_hi_raw m hm t ht
              _ = 1 * C_term m := (one_mul _).symm
              _ ≤ L * C_term m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha₀_d_ge1 (hC_term_nn m)
          have hθ_lo : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 4 → L ≤ deriv (θ_sl y₁) t := by
            intro t ht
            
            have hf_d_diff : Differentiable ℝ (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) := by
              rw [hθ_deriv_fn]
              exact (contDiff_const.add (hδ_cd 1)).differentiable (by simp)
            have h_hop2_bd : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4,
                ‖deriv (deriv (θ_sl y₁)) s‖ ≤ C_term 1 := by
              intro s hs
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← iteratedDeriv_one]
              exact hθ_hi_raw 1 le_rfl s (abs_le.mpr ⟨hs.1, hs.2⟩)
            have h0_Icc4 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4 := by constructor <;> norm_num
            have ht_Icc4 : t ∈ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4 := abs_le.mp ht
            have h_mvt2 := (convex_Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
              (fun s _ => hf_d_diff s) h_hop2_bd h0_Icc4 ht_Icc4
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero] at h_mvt2
            have h_hop2 : |deriv (θ_sl y₁) t - deriv (θ_sl y₁) 0| ≤ 4 * C_term 1 := by
              calc |deriv (θ_sl y₁) t - deriv (θ_sl y₁) 0|
                  ≤ C_term 1 * |t| := h_mvt2
                _ ≤ C_term 1 * 4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (hC_term_nn 1)
                _ = 4 * C_term 1 := mul_comm _ _
            
            have h0_norm2 : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ≤ 2 := by rw [norm_zero]; norm_num
            obtain ⟨hδp_cd, _, _, hδp_bd⟩ :=
              h_paired_line Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_sys ρ_r s_c C_r C_t
                hlam_pos hρ_r_pos hρ_r_le1 hs_c_pos hs_c_le1 hC_r hC_t hCt_Cr_abs h_chirp
                X_J X_o V_j 0 (perp2D w) w h_rel_pos h0_norm2 hw_perp hw_norm
            let vp_fn : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun σ => V_j + ρ_r • (σ • perp2D w + 0)
            let δp : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ =>
              (lam_sys * ρ_r) *
                inner ℝ (ζ₀ (vp_fn σ, X_o - C_t • vp_fn σ) - ζ₀ (vp_fn σ, X_J - C_r • vp_fn σ)) w
            let g_perp : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ => κ_n + δp σ
            have hgp_diff : Differentiable ℝ g_perp :=
              (contDiff_const.add (hδp_cd 1)).differentiable (by simp)
            have h_hop1_bd : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2, ‖deriv g_perp σ‖ ≤ C_term 1 := by
              intro σ hσ
              have hσ_abs4 : |σ| ≤ 4 := by
                have h2 : |σ| ≤ 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨hσ.1, hσ.2⟩
                linarith
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← iteratedDeriv_one]
              dsimp only [g_perp]
              rw [iteratedDeriv_const_add (by omega : 0 < 1)]
              exact hδp_bd 1 le_rfl σ hσ_abs4
            have h0_Icc2 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 := by constructor <;> norm_num
            have h_mvt1 := (convex_Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
              (fun σ _ => hgp_diff σ) h_hop1_bd h0_Icc2 hy₁
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero] at h_mvt1
            have h_hop1 : |g_perp y₁ - g_perp 0| ≤ 2 * C_term 1 := by
              calc |g_perp y₁ - g_perp 0|
                  ≤ C_term 1 * |y₁| := h_mvt1
                _ ≤ C_term 1 * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₁_abs (hC_term_nn 1)
                _ = 2 * C_term 1 := mul_comm _ _
            have hgp_y1 : g_perp y₁ = deriv (θ_sl y₁) 0 := by
              rw [hθ_deriv_eq 0]
              dsimp only [g_perp, δp, δ, vp_fn, v_fn, z₀]
              have hv_eq : V_j + ρ_r • (y₁ • perp2D w + 0) =
                  V_j + ρ_r • ((0 : ℝ) • w + y₁ • perp2D w) := by simp
              rw [hv_eq]
            have hgp_0_ge : a₀ * d_jn ≤ g_perp 0 := by
              have hv0 : vp_fn 0 = V_j := by simp [vp_fn]
              dsimp only [g_perp, δp, κ_n]
              rw [hv0, add_comm]
              exact h_center_lo
            have h_d1 := (abs_le.mp h_hop1).1
            have h_d2 := (abs_le.mp h_hop2).1
            rw [hgp_y1] at h_d1
            dsimp only [L]
            linarith [ha₀_d_margin, hgp_0_ge, h_d1, h_d2]
          exact hC_ibp M L hL_pos (θ_sl y₁) hθ_cd hθ_lo hθ_hi
            (u_sl y₁) hu_cd hu_supp (fun k _ t => hu_der k t)
        have h_pair_le : ‖pair_jn j n‖ ≤ (ρ_r / ρ_t) * (C_ibp M / L ^ M) :=
          h_slice_red w hw_norm (C_ibp M / L ^ M)
            (div_nonneg (hC_ibp_nn M) (pow_nonneg hL_pos.le M)) h_sl_bound
        have h_L_ge : (a₀ / 4) * (1 + d_jn) ≤ L := by
          dsimp only [L]
          nlinarith [ha₀, hd_ge1]
        have h_a4_pos : 0 < (a₀ / 4) * (1 + d_jn) := by positivity
        have h_pow_ge : ((a₀ / 4) * (1 + d_jn)) ^ M ≤ L ^ M :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ h_a4_pos.le h_L_ge M
        have h_div_le : C_ibp M / L ^ M ≤ (C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M := by
          calc C_ibp M / L ^ M
              ≤ C_ibp M / ((a₀ / 4) * (1 + d_jn)) ^ M :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hC_ibp_nn M) (pow_pos h_a4_pos M) h_pow_ge
            _ = (C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M := by
                rw [mul_pow, div_pow, div_pow]
                field_simp [ha₀.ne', h1d_pow_pos.ne']
        have h_K_ge : C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M ≤ K_pair M := le_max_right _ _
        calc ‖pair_jn j n‖
            ≤ (ρ_r / ρ_t) * (C_ibp M / L ^ M) := h_pair_le
          _ ≤ (ρ_r / ρ_t) * ((C_ibp M * (4 / a₀) ^ M) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div_le h_ratio_nn
          _ ≤ (ρ_r / ρ_t) * (K_pair M / (1 + d_jn) ^ M) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_K_ge h1d_pow_pos.le) h_ratio_nn
          _ = K_pair M * (ρ_r / ρ_t) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M := by ring
      · 
        have hd_lt : d_jn ≤ d_thresh := le_of_not_ge hd_ge
        have h_pow_le : (1 + d_jn) ^ M ≤ (1 + d_thresh) ^ M :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ h1d_pos.le (by linarith) M
        have h_K_ge : 4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_jn) ^ M ≤ K_pair M := by
          calc 4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_jn) ^ M
              ≤ 4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_thresh) ^ M :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow_le (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hB_amp_nn 0))
            _ ≤ K_pair M := le_max_left _ _
        calc ‖pair_jn j n‖
            ≤ 4 * (ρ_r / ρ_t) * B_amp 0 := h_uncond
          _ = (4 * B_amp 0 * (1 + d_jn) ^ M) * (ρ_r / ρ_t) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M := by
              field_simp [h1d_pow_pos.ne']
          _ ≤ K_pair M * (ρ_r / ρ_t) / (1 + d_jn) ^ M :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_K_ge h_ratio_nn) h1d_pow_pos.le
  obtain ⟨h_part1, h_part2⟩ :=
    h_lat_tail M hM ρ_r ρ_t σ_r R₀ E_f hρ_r_pos hρ_t_pos hρ_le_Bρt hσ_r_pos hR₀ hE_f
      V_o Y_j ν_j X_ex pair_jn h_vel_vanish h_pt_all
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro J_vel N_ret c_jn hc_sum hc_tot h_sep
    refine h_part1 J_vel N_ret c_jn hc_sum hc_tot (fun j hj n hn => ?_)
    rw [hY_sub j n]
    exact h_sep j hj n hn
  · intro S_far c_q hc_far h_sep_far
    refine h_part2 S_far c_q hc_far (fun q hq => ?_)
    rw [hY_sub q.1 q.2]
    exact h_sep_far q hq

informal_problem.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ) (M_win_at : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys)
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) :
    ∃ (C_Bes : ℝ) (C_rtail : ℕ → ℝ),
      4 ≤ C_Bes ∧ (∀ M : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_rtail M) ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (ε lam_sys ρ_r s_v : ℝ) (m_r q_r : ℕ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        0 < ε → 0 < lam_sys → 0 < ρ_r → ρ_r ≤ 1 → 0 < s_v → s_v ≤ 1 →
        q_r < 2 ^ m_r →
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
        let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
        let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
        (2 * B_sys ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * s_c →
        lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * s_c ≤ 2 * B_sys ^ 2 →
        2 ≤ lam_loc →
      ∀ (N_atom : ℕ) (o_atom : Fin N_atom → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (ψ_atom : Fin N_atom → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (c_atom : Fin N_atom → ℂ),
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (o_atom α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (o_atom α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_atom α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        (∀ α, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_atom α)) ∧
          (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_atom α z = 0) ∧
          (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_atom α) z‖ ≤ M_win_at k)) →
        (∀ (T_fib : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (o₀ : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
          (∀ α ∈ T_fib, o_atom α = o₀) → T_fib.card ≤ M_mult) →
        (∀ T : Finset (Fin N_atom),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
            (fun v => ∑ α ∈ T, c_atom α * g_at α v) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          MeasureTheory.MemLp
            (fun v => ∑ α ∈ T, c_atom α * g_at α v) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          (∫ v, ‖∑ α ∈ T, c_atom α * g_at α v‖ ^ 2) ≤ 4 * ∑ α ∈ T, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) →
        ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (R'_dom : ℝ), 1 ≤ R'_dom →
          let h_S := fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v
          let h'_S := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_S
          (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
            C_Bes * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (∀ (C_cut b_F a_F R_cap : ℝ) (M_cap : ℕ)
             (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
             (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
             104 + 8 * B_sys ≤ C_cut → 2 ≤ R_cap → 3 ≤ M_cap → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
             F_sites ⊆ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom →
             (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
               |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
               |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
               |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
               |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
             ∀ (S_cap : Finset (Fin N_atom)),
               S_cap ⊆ S →
               (∀ α ∈ S,
                 (let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
                  let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
                  |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀) →
                 α ∈ S_cap) →
               ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
                 C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) +
                 C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2))

  have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ₀ := (h_phase.1 0).continuous
  have hΦ'_cont : Continuous Φ'₀ := (h_phase'.1 0).continuous
  obtain ⟨h_in_l2, h_in_add⟩ := h_s1_input Φ₀ hΦ_cont lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J hs_v_pos
  have h_subset_bessel : ∀ (F : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) (T : Finset (Fin N_atom)),
      let h_T := fun v => ∑ α ∈ T, c_atom α * g_at α v
      let h'_T := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_T
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h'_T MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v' => ‖h'_T v'‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      ∑ o ∈ F, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_T o ≤
        4 * (1447209 * C_pair) * ∑ α ∈ T, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro F T h_T h'_T
    obtain ⟨hh_T_meas, hh_T_l2, hh_T_4⟩ := h_T_synth T
    obtain ⟨hh'_T_meas, hh'_T_sq, hh'_T_eq⟩ := h_in_l2 h_T hh_T_meas hh_T_l2
    have h_bes := (canonical_root_bessel_of_gram_decay lam_loc C_pair hlam_loc_ge2 hC_pair_ge1
      Φ'₀ hΦ'_cont F
      (fun ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ o₁ _ o₂ _ =>
        h_gram_gen lam_loc hlam_loc_ge2 Φ'₀ ζ'₀ h_phase' ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ o₁ o₂)
      h'_T hh'_T_meas hh'_T_sq).2
    rw [hh'_T_eq] at h_bes
    refine ⟨hh'_T_meas, hh'_T_sq, h_bes.trans ?_⟩
    calc (1447209 * C_pair) * ∫ v, ‖h_T v‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (1447209 * C_pair) * (4 * ∑ α ∈ T, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh_T_4 (by positivity)
      _ = 4 * (1447209 * C_pair) * ∑ α ∈ T, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 := by ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h_tot := (h_subset_bessel (rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom) S).2.2
    refine h_tot.trans ?_
    have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ h_sum_nn
    dsimp [C_Bes]
    linarith [hC_pair_ge1]
  · intro C_cut b_F a_F R_cap M_cap e_F V_F X_F F_sites
      hC_cut hR_cap hM_cap he_F _ hF_cap S_cap hS_cap_sub hS_cap_contain
    let S_far : Finset (Fin N_atom) := S \ S_cap
    let h_cap := fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_cap, c_atom α * g_at α v
    let h_far := fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_far, c_atom α * g_at α v
    let h'_cap := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_cap
    let h'_far := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_far
    obtain ⟨hh'_cap_meas, hh'_cap_sq, h_cap_bes⟩ := h_subset_bessel F_sites S_cap
    obtain ⟨hh'_far_meas, hh'_far_sq, _⟩ := h_subset_bessel F_sites S_far
    have hh'_S_split : h'_S = fun v' => h'_cap v' + h'_far v' := by
      ext v'
      have hh_S_split : h_S = fun v => h_cap v + h_far v := by
        ext v
        dsimp [h_S, h_cap, h_far, S_far]
        rw [add_comm, Finset.sum_sdiff hS_cap_sub]
      dsimp [h'_S]
      rw [hh_S_split]
      exact h_in_add h_cap h_far v'
    have h_split_sum : ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
        2 * (∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_cap o) +
          2 * (∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_far o) := by
      rw [hh'_S_split, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun o _ =>
        h_s1_subadd lam_loc Φ'₀ hlam_loc_ge2 hΦ'_cont
          h'_cap h'_far hh'_cap_meas hh'_cap_sq hh'_far_meas hh'_far_sq o)
    have h_sq_to_lin : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
        (2 * B_sys ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ x ^ 2 → x ^ 2 ≤ 2 * B_sys ^ 2 →
        (2 * B_sys)⁻¹ ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 * B_sys := by
      intro x hx h_lo h_hi
      have h1 : ((2 * B_sys)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        refine le_trans ?_ h_lo
        rw [inv_pow]
        refine (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr ?_
        nlinarith [hB_pos]
      have h2 : x ^ 2 ≤ (2 * B_sys) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [h_hi, hB_pos]
      exact ⟨by nlinarith [hx, inv_pos.mpr (show 0 < 2 * B_sys by positivity), h1],
        by nlinarith [hx, hB_pos, h2]⟩
    have h_rv_sq : ((ρ_r / s_v) / ρ'₀) ^ 2 = lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * s_c := by
      dsimp [ρ'₀, lam_loc]
      rw [div_inv_eq_mul, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hlam_loc_pos.le]
      have hsv_ne : s_v ≠ 0 := hs_v_pos.ne'
      field_simp [hsv_ne]
      ring
    have h_sx_sq : ((σ_r / s_x) / ρ'₀) ^ 2 = (lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * s_c)⁻¹ := by
      dsimp [σ_r, s_x, ρ'₀, lam_loc]
      rw [div_inv_eq_mul, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hlam_loc_pos.le]
      have hlam_ne : lam_sys ≠ 0 := hlam_pos.ne'
      have hρ_ne : ρ_r ≠ 0 := hρ_r_pos.ne'
      have hsc_ne : s_c ≠ 0 := hs_c_pos.ne'
      have hsv_ne : s_v ≠ 0 := hs_v_pos.ne'
      field_simp [hlam_ne, hρ_ne, hsc_ne, hsv_ne]
      ring
    obtain ⟨h_rv_lo, h_rv_hi⟩ := h_sq_to_lin ((ρ_r / s_v) / ρ'₀) (by positivity)
      (by rw [h_rv_sq]; exact h_chirp_lo) (by rw [h_rv_sq]; exact h_chirp_hi)
    have h_inv_lo : (2 * B_sys ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * s_c)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr h_chirp_hi
    have h_inv_hi : (lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * s_c)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * B_sys ^ 2 := by
      have h := (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr h_chirp_lo
      rwa [inv_inv] at h
    obtain ⟨h_sx_lo, h_sx_hi⟩ := h_sq_to_lin ((σ_r / s_x) / ρ'₀) (by positivity)
      (by rw [h_sx_sq]; exact h_inv_lo) (by rw [h_sx_sq]; exact h_inv_hi)
    have h_far_schur := h_s3_est M_cap hM_cap ρ_r σ_r s_v s_x ρ'₀ C_cut
      (10 * ε ^ b_F) (10 * ε ^ a_F) R_cap e_F V_J X_J V_F X_F
      N_atom o_atom c_atom F_sites S_far (canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_far)
      hρ_r_pos hσ_r_pos hs_v_pos hs_x_pos hρ'₀_pos
      h_rv_lo h_rv_hi h_sx_lo h_sx_hi hC_cut hR_cap he_F
      h_fib hF_cap
      (fun α hα h_in => (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hα).2
        (hS_cap_contain α (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hα).1 h_in))
      (fun o _ B_o hB_o => by
        unfold canonicalRootMass
        have hψ0_win : IsCanonicalRootWindow (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
          refine ⟨fun k => contDiff_const, fun _ _ => rfl, fun k z => ?_⟩
          rw [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero, Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
          positivity
        refine csSup_le ⟨0, (fun _ => 0), hψ0_win, by simp⟩ ?_
        rintro m ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩
        let V'_o := gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1
        let X'_o := gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2
        let J_ψ : Fin N_atom → ℂ := fun α =>
          (ρ'₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J (g_at α) v' *
              ψ (ρ'₀⁻¹ • (v' - V'_o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ'₀ (1 / 2, X'_o, v') : ℝ) : ℂ))
        have h_sum_int_eq :
            (ρ'₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * (∫ v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              h'_far v' * ψ (ρ'₀⁻¹ • (v' - V'_o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ'₀ (1 / 2, X'_o, v') : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
              ∑ α ∈ S_far, c_atom α * J_ψ α := by
          have h_pt_sum : (fun v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
              h'_far v' * ψ (ρ'₀⁻¹ • (v' - V'_o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ'₀ (1 / 2, X'_o, v') : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
              (fun v' => ∑ α ∈ S_far, c_atom α *
                (localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J (g_at α) v' *
                  ψ (ρ'₀⁻¹ • (v' - V'_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ'₀ (1 / 2, X'_o, v') : ℝ) : ℂ)))) := by
            ext v'
            dsimp [h'_far, h_far]
            unfold localGaugeInput
            dsimp only
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => by ring)
          rw [h_pt_sum, MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum S_far]
          · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
            rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
            dsimp [J_ψ]
            ring
          · intro α _
            have h_int_α := (h_s2_est M_cap Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_sys ρ_r s_v m_r q_r
              V_J X_J (V_at α) (X_at α) (ψ_atom α) ψ o
              hlam_pos hρ_r_pos hρ_r_le1 hs_v_pos hs_v_le1 hq_r
              h_chirp_lo h_chirp_hi hlam_loc_ge2
              (h_win_at α).1 (h_win_at α).2.1 (h_win_at α).2.2 hψ).2.2
            exact h_int_α.const_mul (c_atom α)
        change ‖(ρ'₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          h'_far v' * ψ (ρ'₀⁻¹ • (v' - V'_o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ'₀ (1 / 2, X'_o, v') : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ B_o
        rw [h_sum_int_eq]
        refine hB_o J_ψ (fun α _ => ?_)
        have h_est_α := h_s2_est M_cap Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_sys ρ_r s_v m_r q_r
          V_J X_J (V_at α) (X_at α) (ψ_atom α) ψ o
          hlam_pos hρ_r_pos hρ_r_le1 hs_v_pos hs_v_le1 hq_r
          h_chirp_lo h_chirp_hi hlam_loc_ge2
          (h_win_at α).1 (h_win_at α).2.1 (h_win_at α).2.2 hψ
        exact ⟨h_est_α.1, h_est_α.2.1⟩)
    have h_sfar_le_S : ∑ α ∈ S_far, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.sdiff_subset (fun _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hR_cap_pos : 0 < R_cap := by linarith
    have h_tail_coeff_nn : 0 ≤ C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) :=
      mul_nonneg (hC_rtail_nn M_cap) (Real.rpow_nonneg hR_cap_pos.le _)
    calc ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o
        ≤ 2 * (∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_cap o) +
            2 * (∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_far o) := h_split_sum
      _ ≤ 2 * (4 * (1447209 * C_pair) * ∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) +
            2 * (C_schur M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * ∑ α ∈ S_far, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cap_bes (by norm_num))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_far_schur (by norm_num))
      _ = C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) +
            C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α ∈ S_far, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) := by
          dsimp [C_Bes, C_rtail]
          ring
      _ ≤ C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) +
            C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) :=
          add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sfar_le_S h_tail_coeff_nn)

subgoal_signatures.name: canonical_root_gram_decay
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A) :
    ∃ C_pair : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_pair ∧
      ∀ (lam : ℝ), 2 ≤ lam →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (ψ₁ ψ₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₁ →
        IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₂ →
      ∀ (o₁ o₂ : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
        (200 ≤ ‖gridPt2D 1 (o₁.1.1 - o₂.1.1, o₁.1.2 - o₂.1.2)‖ →
          ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₁ o₁ v *
              star (canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₂ o₂ v) = 0) ∧
        ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₁ o₁ v *
            star (canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₂ o₂ v)‖ ≤
          C_pair / (1 + ‖gridPt2D 1 (o₁.2.1 - o₂.2.1, o₁.2.2 - o₂.2.2)‖) ^ 4

subgoal_signatures.name: canonical_root_bessel_of_gram_decay
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(lam C_pair : ℝ)
    (hlam : 2 ≤ lam) (hC_pair : 1 ≤ C_pair)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (hΦ₀_cont : Continuous Φ₀)
    (S : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
    (h_gram : ∀ (ψ₁ ψ₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₁ →
      IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ₂ →
      ∀ o₁ ∈ S, ∀ o₂ ∈ S,
        (200 ≤ ‖gridPt2D 1 (o₁.1.1 - o₂.1.1, o₁.1.2 - o₂.1.2)‖ →
          ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₁ o₁ v *
              star (canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₂ o₂ v) = 0) ∧
        ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₁ o₁ v *
            star (canonicalRootAtom lam Φ₀ ψ₂ o₂ v)‖ ≤
          C_pair / (1 + ‖gridPt2D 1 (o₁.2.1 - o₂.2.1, o₁.2.2 - o₂.2.2)‖) ^ 4)
    (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (hh_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hh_sq : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume) :
    (∀ o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ h o) ∧
    ∑ o ∈ S, canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ h o ≤
      (1447209 * C_pair) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: nonstationary_phase_1d_arbitrary_ibp
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (B D : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ C_ibp : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ibp ∧
      ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 → L ≤ deriv θ t) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 →
          |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| ≤ L * D m) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B k) →
        ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L ^ M

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have h_lp2 : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      (WithLp.toLp 2 ![a, b] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 0 = a ∧
      (WithLp.toLp 2 ![a, b] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 1 = b :=
    fun a b => ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
  have h_sub_apply : ∀ (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (idx : Fin 2),
      (u - v) idx = u idx - v idx := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have h_norm2 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ^ 2 = (v 0) ^ 2 + (v 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have h_coord_le : ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (idx : Fin 2), |v idx| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    intro v idx
    simpa using PiLp.norm_apply_le v idx

  
  
  
  have h_chernoff_sample :
      ∀ {ι_P ι_B : Type}
        (N_P N_B N Q : ℕ) (_hN : 1 ≤ N) (_hQ : 1 ≤ Q)
        (μ : Fin N_P → ℝ) (_hμ_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ i) (_hμ_sum : ∑ i, μ i = 1)
        (ν : Fin N_B → ℝ) (_hν_nn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ν j) (_hν_sum : ∑ j, ν j = 1)
        (G : Fin N_P → Fin N_B → Prop)
        (S_P : Finset ι_P) (E_P : ι_P → Fin N_P → Prop) (p_P : ι_P → ℝ)
        (_hp_P : ∀ a ∈ S_P, (∑ i : Fin N_P, if E_P a i then μ i else 0) ≤ p_P a)
        (_hp_P_nn : ∀ a ∈ S_P, 0 ≤ p_P a)
        (S_B : Finset ι_B) (E_B : ι_B → Fin N_B → Prop) (p_B : ι_B → ℝ)
        (_hp_B : ∀ b ∈ S_B, (∑ j : Fin N_B, if E_B b j then ν j else 0) ≤ p_B b)
        (_hp_B_nn : ∀ b ∈ S_B, 0 ≤ p_B b)
        (q T : ℝ) (_hq_pos : 0 < q) (_hT_nn : 0 ≤ T)
        (_hq_lb : q ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if G i j then μ i * ν j else 0)
        (_h_tail : ((S_P.card + S_B.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) < q / 2),
        ∃ (ω_P : Fin N → Fin N_P) (ω_B : Fin Q → Fin N_B),
          (∀ a ∈ S_P,
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N => E_P a (ω_P u))).card : ℝ) ≤
              Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T) ∧
          (∀ b ∈ S_B,
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q => E_B b (ω_B v))).card : ℝ) ≤
              Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T) ∧
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * q * (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ≤
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun uv : Fin N × Fin Q => G (ω_P uv.1) (ω_B uv.2))).card : ℝ) := by
    intro ι_P ι_B N_P N_B N Q hN hQ μ hμ_nn hμ_sum ν hν_nn hν_sum G
      S_P E_P p_P hp_P hp_P_nn S_B E_B p_B hp_B hp_B_nn q T hq_pos hT_nn hq_lb h_tail
    have h_mgf_tail : ∀ {M_s K : ℕ} (w : Fin K → ℝ) (_hw_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
        (_hw_sum : ∑ i, w i = 1) (E : Fin K → Prop) (p₀ : ℝ) (_hp₀_nn : 0 ≤ p₀)
        (_hp₀ : (∑ i : Fin K, if E i then w i else 0) ≤ p₀),
        let cnt := fun ω : Fin M_s → Fin K =>
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin M_s => E (ω u))).card
        (∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K,
          if Real.exp 2 * (M_s : ℝ) * p₀ + T < (cnt ω : ℝ)
          then (∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u)) else 0) ≤ Real.exp (-T) := by
      intro M_s K w hw_nn hw_sum E p₀ hp₀_nn hp₀ cnt
      have h_exp_cnt : ∀ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K,
          Real.exp (2 * (cnt ω : ℝ)) =
            ∏ u : Fin M_s, (if E (ω u) then Real.exp 2 else 1) := by
        intro ω
        rw [Finset.prod_ite, Finset.prod_const, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one,
            mul_comm (2 : ℝ) (cnt ω : ℝ), Real.exp_nat_mul]
      have h_sum_mgf : (∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K,
          (∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u)) * Real.exp (2 * (cnt ω : ℝ))) ≤
          Real.exp (Real.exp 2 * (M_s : ℝ) * p₀) := by
        have h_eq : (∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K,
            (∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u)) * Real.exp (2 * (cnt ω : ℝ))) =
            (∑ i : Fin K, w i * (if E i then Real.exp 2 else 1)) ^ M_s := by
          simp_rw [h_exp_cnt, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
          rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : Fin M_s) (i : Fin K) =>
            w i * (if E i then Real.exp 2 else 1))]
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        rw [h_eq]
        have h_inner_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin K, w i * (if E i then Real.exp 2 else 1) :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by
            split_ifs
            · exact mul_nonneg (hw_nn i) (Real.exp_pos 2).le
            · rw [mul_one]; exact hw_nn i)
        have h_inner_ub : (∑ i : Fin K, w i * (if E i then Real.exp 2 else 1)) ≤
            Real.exp (Real.exp 2 * p₀) := by
          have h_pt : ∀ i : Fin K, w i * (if E i then Real.exp 2 else 1) ≤
              w i + Real.exp 2 * (if E i then w i else 0) := by
            intro i
            have hwi := hw_nn i
            split_ifs <;> linarith only [hwi]
          calc (∑ i : Fin K, w i * (if E i then Real.exp 2 else 1))
              ≤ ∑ i : Fin K, (w i + Real.exp 2 * (if E i then w i else 0)) :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_pt i)
            _ = (∑ i : Fin K, w i) + Real.exp 2 * (∑ i : Fin K, if E i then w i else 0) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
            _ ≤ 1 + Real.exp 2 * p₀ := by
                rw [hw_sum]
                exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp₀ (Real.exp_pos 2).le)
            _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp 2 * p₀) := by
                have h_e := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.exp 2 * p₀)
                linarith only [h_e]
        calc (∑ i : Fin K, w i * (if E i then Real.exp 2 else 1)) ^ M_s
            ≤ (Real.exp (Real.exp 2 * p₀)) ^ M_s := pow_le_pow_left₀ h_inner_nn h_inner_ub M_s
          _ = Real.exp ((M_s : ℝ) * (Real.exp 2 * p₀)) := (Real.exp_nat_mul _ M_s).symm
          _ = Real.exp (Real.exp 2 * (M_s : ℝ) * p₀) := by ring_nf
      let A := Real.exp 2 * (M_s : ℝ) * p₀
      have hA_nn : 0 ≤ A := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 2).le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hp₀_nn
      have h_markov : (∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K,
          if A + T < (cnt ω : ℝ) then (∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u)) else 0) *
          Real.exp (A + T) ≤
          ∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K, (∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u)) * Real.exp (2 * (cnt ω : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
        have hw_prod_nn : 0 ≤ ∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u) :=
          Finset.prod_nonneg (fun u _ => hw_nn (ω u))
        split_ifs with h_bad
        · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) hw_prod_nn
          linarith only [hA_nn, hT_nn, h_bad]
        · rw [zero_mul]
          exact mul_nonneg hw_prod_nn (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have h_comb := le_trans h_markov h_sum_mgf
      rw [Real.exp_add] at h_comb
      have h_posA : 0 < Real.exp A := Real.exp_pos A
      have h_posT : 0 < Real.exp T := Real.exp_pos T
      rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_eq_one_div, le_div_iff₀ h_posT]
      have h_rearr : ((∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K,
          if A + T < (cnt ω : ℝ) then (∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u)) else 0) * Real.exp T) *
          Real.exp A ≤ 1 * Real.exp A := by
        linarith only [h_comb]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_rearr h_posA

    have h_marginal : ∀ {M_s K : ℕ} (w : Fin K → ℝ) (_hw_sum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
        (u₀ : Fin M_s) (φ : Fin K → ℝ),
        ∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K, (∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u)) * φ (ω u₀) =
          ∑ i : Fin K, w i * φ i := by
      intro M_s K w hw_sum u₀ φ
      let F : Fin M_s → Fin K → ℝ := fun u i => if u = u₀ then w i * φ i else w i
      have h_prod_sum := Fintype.prod_sum F
      have h_lhs : (∏ u : Fin M_s, ∑ i : Fin K, F u i) = ∑ i : Fin K, w i * φ i := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun u => ∑ i : Fin K, F u i) (Finset.mem_univ u₀)]
        have h_u0 : (∑ i : Fin K, F u₀ i) = ∑ i : Fin K, w i * φ i := by simp [F]
        have h_er : (∏ u ∈ Finset.univ.erase u₀, ∑ i : Fin K, F u i) = 1 := by
          refine Finset.prod_eq_one (fun u hu => ?_)
          have hne : u ≠ u₀ := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hu).1
          simp [F, hne, hw_sum]
        rw [h_u0, h_er, mul_one]
      have h_rhs : (∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K, ∏ u : Fin M_s, F u (ω u)) =
          ∑ ω : Fin M_s → Fin K, (∏ u : Fin M_s, w (ω u)) * φ (ω u₀) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun u => F u (ω u)) (Finset.mem_univ u₀),
            ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun u => w (ω u)) (Finset.mem_univ u₀)]
        have h_er : (∏ u ∈ Finset.univ.erase u₀, F u (ω u)) =
            ∏ u ∈ Finset.univ.erase u₀, w (ω u) := by
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun u hu => ?_)
          have hne : u ≠ u₀ := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hu).1
          simp [F, hne]
        dsimp [F]
        rw [if_pos rfl, h_er]
        ring
      linarith only [h_prod_sum, h_lhs, h_rhs]

    let W_P : (Fin N → Fin N_P) → ℝ := fun ω_P => ∏ u : Fin N, μ (ω_P u)
    let W_B : (Fin Q → Fin N_B) → ℝ := fun ω_B => ∏ v : Fin Q, ν (ω_B v)
    have hWP_nn : ∀ ω_P, 0 ≤ W_P ω_P :=
      fun ω_P => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun u _ => hμ_nn (ω_P u))
    have hWB_nn : ∀ ω_B, 0 ≤ W_B ω_B :=
      fun ω_B => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun v _ => hν_nn (ω_B v))
    have hWP_sum : ∑ ω_P : Fin N → Fin N_P, W_P ω_P = 1 := by
      dsimp [W_P]
      rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : Fin N) (i : Fin N_P) => μ i)]
      simp [hμ_sum]
    have hWB_sum : ∑ ω_B : Fin Q → Fin N_B, W_B ω_B = 1 := by
      dsimp [W_B]
      rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : Fin Q) (j : Fin N_B) => ν j)]
      simp [hν_sum]
    let cnt_P : ι_P → (Fin N → Fin N_P) → ℕ := fun a ω_P =>
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N => E_P a (ω_P u))).card
    let cnt_B : ι_B → (Fin Q → Fin N_B) → ℕ := fun b ω_B =>
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q => E_B b (ω_B v))).card
    let Good : ((Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B)) → Prop := fun ω =>
      (∀ a ∈ S_P, (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T) ∧
      (∀ b ∈ S_B, (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T)
    let W_prod : ((Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B)) → ℝ :=
      fun ω => W_P ω.1 * W_B ω.2
    have hW_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ W_prod ω := fun ω => mul_nonneg (hWP_nn ω.1) (hWB_nn ω.2)
    have hW_sum : ∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B), W_prod ω = 1 := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp_rw [W_prod, ← Finset.mul_sum, hWB_sum, mul_one, hWP_sum]

    have h_bad_mass : (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
        if ¬ Good ω then W_prod ω else 0) < q / 2 := by
      have h_pt : ∀ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
          (if ¬ Good ω then W_prod ω else 0) ≤
            (∑ a ∈ S_P, if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ)
              then W_prod ω else 0) +
            (∑ b ∈ S_B, if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ)
              then W_prod ω else 0) := by
        intro ω
        have h_s1_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ S_P,
            if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ) then W_prod ω else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => by split_ifs; exact hW_nn ω; exact le_rfl)
        have h_s2_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ b ∈ S_B,
            if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ) then W_prod ω else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => by split_ifs; exact hW_nn ω; exact le_rfl)
        by_cases hG_ω : Good ω
        · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr hG_ω)]
          linarith only [h_s1_nn, h_s2_nn]
        · rw [if_pos hG_ω]
          dsimp [Good] at hG_ω
          push_neg at hG_ω
          by_cases h1 : ∃ a ∈ S_P, Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ)
          · obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀_mem, ha₀_lt⟩ := h1
            have h_le1 : W_prod ω ≤ ∑ a ∈ S_P,
                if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ) then W_prod ω else 0 := by
              calc W_prod ω
                  = (if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a₀ + T < (cnt_P a₀ ω.1 : ℝ)
                      then W_prod ω else 0) := (if_pos ha₀_lt).symm
                _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ S_P,
                      if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ)
                      then W_prod ω else 0 :=
                    Finset.single_le_sum
                      (f := fun a => if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ)
                        then W_prod ω else 0)
                      (fun a _ => by split_ifs; exact hW_nn ω; exact le_rfl) ha₀_mem
            linarith only [h_le1, h_s2_nn]
          · push_neg at h1
            obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀_mem, hb₀_lt⟩ := hG_ω h1
            have h_le2 : W_prod ω ≤ ∑ b ∈ S_B,
                if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ) then W_prod ω else 0 := by
              calc W_prod ω
                  = (if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b₀ + T < (cnt_B b₀ ω.2 : ℝ)
                      then W_prod ω else 0) := (if_pos hb₀_lt).symm
                _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ S_B,
                      if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ)
                      then W_prod ω else 0 :=
                    Finset.single_le_sum
                      (f := fun b => if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ)
                        then W_prod ω else 0)
                      (fun b _ => by split_ifs; exact hW_nn ω; exact le_rfl) hb₀_mem
            linarith only [h_le2, h_s1_nn]
      have h_a_ub : ∀ a ∈ S_P,
          (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
            if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ) then W_prod ω else 0) ≤
            Real.exp (-T) := by
        intro a ha
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        have h_fact : ∀ ω_P : Fin N → Fin N_P,
            (∑ ω_B : Fin Q → Fin N_B,
              if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω_P : ℝ)
              then W_P ω_P * W_B ω_B else 0) =
            (if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω_P : ℝ) then W_P ω_P else 0) := by
          intro ω_P
          split_ifs
          · rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hWB_sum, mul_one]
          · simp
        simp_rw [W_prod, h_fact]
        exact h_mgf_tail μ hμ_nn hμ_sum (E_P a) (p_P a) (hp_P_nn a ha) (hp_P a ha)
      have h_b_ub : ∀ b ∈ S_B,
          (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
            if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ) then W_prod ω else 0) ≤
            Real.exp (-T) := by
        intro b hb
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
        have h_fact : ∀ ω_B : Fin Q → Fin N_B,
            (∑ ω_P : Fin N → Fin N_P,
              if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω_B : ℝ)
              then W_P ω_P * W_B ω_B else 0) =
            (if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω_B : ℝ) then W_B ω_B else 0) := by
          intro ω_B
          split_ifs
          · rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hWP_sum, one_mul]
          · simp
        simp_rw [W_prod, h_fact]
        exact h_mgf_tail ν hν_nn hν_sum (E_B b) (p_B b) (hp_B_nn b hb) (hp_B b hb)
      calc (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B), if ¬ Good ω then W_prod ω else 0)
          ≤ ∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
              ((∑ a ∈ S_P, if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ)
                then W_prod ω else 0) +
               (∑ b ∈ S_B, if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ)
                then W_prod ω else 0)) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_pt ω)
        _ = (∑ a ∈ S_P, ∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
              if Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P a + T < (cnt_P a ω.1 : ℝ) then W_prod ω else 0) +
            (∑ b ∈ S_B, ∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
              if Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B b + T < (cnt_B b ω.2 : ℝ) then W_prod ω else 0) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_comm, @Finset.sum_comm _ _ _ _ S_B]
        _ ≤ (∑ _a ∈ S_P, Real.exp (-T)) + (∑ _b ∈ S_B, Real.exp (-T)) :=
            add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum h_a_ub) (Finset.sum_le_sum h_b_ub)
        _ = ((S_P.card + S_B.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add]
            ring
        _ < q / 2 := h_tail

    let q_act : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ j : Fin N_B, if G i j then μ i * ν j else 0
    let E_cnt : ((Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B)) → ℕ := fun ω =>
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun uv : Fin N × Fin Q => G (ω.1 uv.1) (ω.2 uv.2))).card
    have h_edge_exp : (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
        W_prod ω * (E_cnt ω : ℝ)) = q_act * ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ)) := by
      have h_card_real : ∀ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
          (E_cnt ω : ℝ) = ∑ u : Fin N, ∑ v : Fin Q, (if G (ω.1 u) (ω.2 v) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
        intro ω
        dsimp [E_cnt]
        rw [Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> simp
      simp_rw [h_card_real, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h_uv : ∀ u : Fin N,
          (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
            ∑ v : Fin Q, W_prod ω * (if G (ω.1 u) (ω.2 v) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
          (Q : ℝ) * q_act := by
        intro u
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        have h_single : ∀ v : Fin Q,
            (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
              W_prod ω * (if G (ω.1 u) (ω.2 v) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = q_act := by
          intro v
          rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
          have h_step1 : ∀ ω_P : Fin N → Fin N_P,
              (∑ ω_B : Fin Q → Fin N_B,
                (W_P ω_P * W_B ω_B) * (if G (ω_P u) (ω_B v) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
              W_P ω_P * (∑ j : Fin N_B, ν j * (if G (ω_P u) j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
            intro ω_P
            simp_rw [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
            rw [h_marginal ν hν_sum v (fun j => if G (ω_P u) j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)]
          simp_rw [W_prod, h_step1]
          rw [h_marginal μ hμ_sum u
            (fun i => ∑ j : Fin N_B, ν j * (if G i j then (1 : ℝ) else 0))]
          dsimp [q_act]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> ring
        simp_rw [h_single, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      simp_rw [h_uv, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring

    have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have hQ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have hNQ_pos : 0 < (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) := mul_pos hN_pos hQ_pos
    have h_exists : ∃ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
        Good ω ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * q * (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ≤ (E_cnt ω : ℝ) := by
      by_contra h_none
      push_neg at h_none
      have h_max_E : ∀ ω, (E_cnt ω : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) := by
        intro ω
        have h1 : E_cnt ω ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N × Fin Q)).card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
        rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
        exact_mod_cast h1
      have h_q_le : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * q * ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ)) ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * q_act * ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ)) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hNQ_pos.le
        linarith only [hq_lb]
      have hq_act_nn : 0 ≤ q_act := le_trans hq_pos.le hq_lb
      have h_split_pt : ∀ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
          W_prod ω * (E_cnt ω : ℝ) ≤
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * q_act * ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ))) * W_prod ω +
            ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ)) * (if ¬ Good ω then W_prod ω else 0) := by
        intro ω
        by_cases hG_ω : Good ω
        · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr hG_ω), mul_zero, add_zero]
          have hlt : (E_cnt ω : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * q_act * ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ)) := by
            have h1 := (h_none ω hG_ω).le
            linarith only [h1, h_q_le]
          have h_m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlt (hW_nn ω)
          linarith only [h_m]
        · rw [if_pos hG_ω]
          have h_nn1 : 0 ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * q_act * ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ))) * W_prod ω :=
            mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hq_act_nn) hNQ_pos.le) (hW_nn ω)
          have h_le2 : W_prod ω * (E_cnt ω : ℝ) ≤ ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ)) * W_prod ω := by
            rw [mul_comm ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ)) (W_prod ω)]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_max_E ω) (hW_nn ω)
          linarith only [h_nn1, h_le2]
      have h_sum_ub : (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B), W_prod ω * (E_cnt ω : ℝ)) <
          q_act * ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ)) := by
        calc (∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B), W_prod ω * (E_cnt ω : ℝ))
            ≤ ∑ ω : (Fin N → Fin N_P) × (Fin Q → Fin N_B),
                (((1 / 2 : ℝ) * q_act * ((N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ))) * W_prod ω +

    obtain ⟨⟨ω_P, ω_B⟩, ⟨hgP, hgB⟩, hE⟩ := h_exists

  have h_net_transfer :

      · simp only [pow_zero, one_mul]

  have h_inc_regularize :
      ∀ (N Q : ℕ) (_hN : 1 ≤ N) (_hQ : 1 ≤ Q)
        (ρ d s q M C_cov B_P B_B : ℝ)

        (_hd₀ : 0 < d) (_hs₀ : 0 < s)
        (_hq₀ : 0 < q) (_hM₀ : 0 < M) (_hC_cov : 1 ≤ C_cov)
        (_hB_P : 1 ≤ B_P) (_hB_B : 1 ≤ B_B)
        (_hN_lb : ρ ^ (-d) ≤ (N : ℝ)) (_hQ_lb : ρ ^ (-s) ≤ (Q : ℝ))
        (y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (_hy_dom : ∀ u : Fin N,

        (a_sl : Fin Q → ℝ)

        (_hS_card : ∀ v : Fin Q, ((S_cov v).card : ℝ) ≤ M)
        (_hS_cov : ∀ (u : Fin N) (v : Fin Q), G_samp u v →
