          (∀ p ∈ P, M₀ / 2 ≤ ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) ∧ ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M₀) ∧
          (∀ p ∈ P, IsRhoSet ρ s (4 * B_B ^ 2 / q) (T_fam p)) ∧
          (((P.biUnion T_fam).card : ℝ) ≤ (Q : ℝ) * (2 * (⌈C_cov⌉₊ : ℝ) + 1) * M) := by
    intro N Q hN hQ ρ d s q M C_cov B_P B_B hρ hρ₆ hd₀ hs₀ hq₀ hM₀ hC_cov hB_P hB_B
      hN_lb hQ_lb y hy_dom a_sl ha_dom G_samp h_edges h_occ_P h_occ_B S_cov hS_card hS_cov
    have hρ_lt1 : ρ < 1 := by linarith only [hρ₆]
    have hQ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)

    have h_dyad_inj : ∀ k₁ k₂ : ℤ × ℤ, dyadicSquare ρ k₁ = dyadicSquare ρ k₂ → k₁ = k₂ := by
      intro k₁ k₂ h_eq
      let pt : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![(k₁.1 : ℝ) * ρ, (k₁.2 : ℝ) * ρ]
      have h_pt0 : pt 0 = (k₁.1 : ℝ) * ρ := (h_lp2 _ _).1
      have h_pt1 : pt 1 = (k₁.2 : ℝ) * ρ := (h_lp2 _ _).2
      have h_mem1 : pt ∈ dyadicSquare ρ k₁ := by
        dsimp [dyadicSquare]
        rw [h_pt0, h_pt1]
        exact ⟨le_rfl, by linarith only [hρ], le_rfl, by linarith only [hρ]⟩
      rw [h_eq] at h_mem1
      dsimp [dyadicSquare] at h_mem1
      rw [h_pt0, h_pt1] at h_mem1
      obtain ⟨h1_le, h1_lt, h2_le, h2_lt⟩ := h_mem1
      have hk1_a : (k₂.1 : ℝ) ≤ (k₁.1 : ℝ) := le_of_mul_le_mul_right h1_le hρ
      have hk1_b : (k₁.1 : ℝ) < ((k₂.1 + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h1_lt hρ.le
      have hk2_a : (k₂.2 : ℝ) ≤ (k₁.2 : ℝ) := le_of_mul_le_mul_right h2_le hρ
      have hk2_b : (k₁.2 : ℝ) < ((k₂.2 + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h2_lt hρ.le
      have hk1_z1 : k₂.1 ≤ k₁.1 := by exact_mod_cast hk1_a
      have hk1_z2 : k₁.1 < k₂.1 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hk1_b
      have hk2_z1 : k₂.2 ≤ k₁.2 := by exact_mod_cast hk2_a
      have hk2_z2 : k₁.2 < k₂.2 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hk2_b
      exact Prod.ext (by omega) (by omega)

    have h_pt_in_dyad : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        w ∈ dyadicSquare ρ (⌊w 0 / ρ⌋, ⌊w 1 / ρ⌋) := by
      intro w
      exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.floor_le (w 0 / ρ)),
             (div_lt_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (w 0 / ρ)),
             (le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.floor_le (w 1 / ρ)),
             (div_lt_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (w 1 / ρ))⟩

    have h_dyad_diam : ∀ (k : ℤ × ℤ) (w₁ w₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        w₁ ∈ dyadicSquare ρ k → w₂ ∈ dyadicSquare ρ k → ‖w₁ - w₂‖ < 2 * ρ := by
      intro k w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂
      obtain ⟨h1a, h1b, h1c, h1d⟩ := hw₁
      obtain ⟨h2a, h2b, h2c, h2d⟩ := hw₂
      have hd0 : |w₁ 0 - w₂ 0| < ρ :=
        abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith only [h1a, h2b], by linarith only [h1b, h2a]⟩
      have hd1 : |w₁ 1 - w₂ 1| < ρ :=
        abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith only [h1c, h2d], by linarith only [h1d, h2c]⟩
      have hsq0 : (w₁ 0 - w₂ 0) ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hρ.le).mpr hd0
      have hsq1 : (w₁ 1 - w₂ 1) ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hρ.le).mpr hd1
      have h_nsq : ‖w₁ - w₂‖ ^ 2 < (2 * ρ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_norm2 (w₁ - w₂), h_sub_apply, h_sub_apply]
        have hρ2_pos : 0 < ρ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hρ
        have h4 : (2 * ρ) ^ 2 = 4 * ρ ^ 2 := by ring
        linarith only [hsq0, hsq1, hρ2_pos, h4]
      exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp h_nsq

    let deg : Fin N → ℕ := fun u => (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q => G_samp u v)).card
    have h_deg_sum : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * q * (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ≤ ∑ u : Fin N, (deg u : ℝ) := by
      have h_eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun uv : Fin N × Fin Q => G_samp uv.1 uv.2)).card =
          ∑ u : Fin N, deg u := by
        dsimp [deg]
        rw [Finset.card_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.card_filter]
      have h_cast : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun uv : Fin N × Fin Q => G_samp uv.1 uv.2)).card : ℝ) =
          ∑ u : Fin N, (deg u : ℝ) := by
        rw [h_eq, Nat.cast_sum]
      linarith only [h_edges, h_cast]

    let U_high : Finset (Fin N) :=
      Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N => (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (Q : ℝ) ≤ (deg u : ℝ))
    have hU_high_card : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (N : ℝ) ≤ (U_high.card : ℝ) := by
      let U_low :=
        Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N => ¬ ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (Q : ℝ) ≤ (deg u : ℝ)))
      have h_split := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
        (fun u : Fin N => (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (Q : ℝ) ≤ (deg u : ℝ)) (fun u => (deg u : ℝ))
      change (∑ u ∈ U_high, (deg u : ℝ)) + (∑ u ∈ U_low, (deg u : ℝ)) =
        ∑ u : Fin N, (deg u : ℝ) at h_split
      have h_low_ub : (∑ u ∈ U_low, (deg u : ℝ)) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) := by
        have h_u : ∀ u ∈ U_low, (deg u : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (Q : ℝ) :=
          fun u hu => le_of_not_ge (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2
        have h_card : (U_low.card : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : U_low.card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
          rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
          exact_mod_cast h1
        calc (∑ u ∈ U_low, (deg u : ℝ))
            ≤ ∑ _u ∈ U_low, ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (Q : ℝ)) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_u
          _ = (U_low.card : ℝ) * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (Q : ℝ)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ ≤ (N : ℝ) * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (Q : ℝ)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card (by positivity)
          _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) := by ring
      have h_high_ub : (∑ u ∈ U_high, (deg u : ℝ)) ≤ (U_high.card : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) := by
        have h_u : ∀ u ∈ U_high, (deg u : ℝ) ≤ (Q : ℝ) := by
          intro u _
          have h1 : deg u ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Q)).card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
          rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
          exact_mod_cast h1
        calc (∑ u ∈ U_high, (deg u : ℝ))
            ≤ ∑ _u ∈ U_high, (Q : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_u
          _ = (U_high.card : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have h_high_lb : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ≤ (U_high.card : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) := by
        linarith only [h_deg_sum, h_split, h_low_ub, h_high_ub]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_high_lb hQ_pos

    let p_of : Fin N → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
      fun u => dyadicSquare ρ (⌊y u 0 / ρ⌋, ⌊y u 1 / ρ⌋)
    let P_sq : Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) := U_high.image p_of
    have hp_of_dyad : ∀ u : Fin N, IsDyadicSquare ρ (p_of u) := by
      intro u
      refine ⟨⟨(⌊y u 0 / ρ⌋, ⌊y u 1 / ρ⌋), rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      intro w hw
      have hy_u := hy_dom u
      obtain ⟨hw0_ge, hw0_lt, hw1_ge, hw1_lt⟩ := hw
      obtain ⟨hy0_ge, _, hy1_ge, _⟩ := h_pt_in_dyad (y u)
      have hk0_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (⌊y u 0 / ρ⌋ : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (div_nonneg hy_u.1.1 hρ.le)
      have hk1_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (⌊y u 1 / ρ⌋ : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (div_nonneg hy_u.2.1 hρ.le)
      have hy_u0_hi := hy_u.1.2
      have hy_u1_hi := hy_u.2.2
      refine ⟨⟨le_trans (mul_nonneg hk0_nn hρ.le) hw0_ge, ?_⟩,
              ⟨le_trans (mul_nonneg hk1_nn hρ.le) hw1_ge, ?_⟩⟩
      · have h_step : ((⌊y u 0 / ρ⌋ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ = (⌊y u 0 / ρ⌋ : ℝ) * ρ + ρ := by ring
        linarith only [hw0_lt, hy0_ge, hy_u0_hi, hρ₆, h_step]
      · have h_step : ((⌊y u 1 / ρ⌋ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ = (⌊y u 1 / ρ⌋ : ℝ) * ρ + ρ := by ring
        linarith only [hw1_lt, hy1_ge, hy_u1_hi, hρ₆, h_step]

    have hP_sq_card : (q * (N : ℝ)) / (4 * B_P) ≤ (P_sq.card : ℝ) := by
      have h_fib_sum : U_high.card = ∑ p ∈ P_sq, (U_high.filter (fun u => p_of u = p)).card :=
        Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image p_of U_high
      have h_fib_ub : ∀ p ∈ P_sq, ((U_high.filter (fun u => p_of u = p)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_P := by
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨u₀, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
        have h_sub : U_high.filter (fun u => p_of u = p_of u₀) ⊆
            Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N => ‖y u - y u₀‖ < 3 * ρ) := by
          intro u hu
          have heq : p_of u = p_of u₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2
          refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ u, ?_⟩
          have h_in_u : y u ∈ p_of u₀ := by rw [← heq]; exact h_pt_in_dyad (y u)
          have h_diam := h_dyad_diam _ (y u) (y u₀) h_in_u (h_pt_in_dyad (y u₀))
          linarith only [h_diam, hρ]
        have h_occ := h_occ_P (y u₀) ρ le_rfl hρ_lt1.le
        rw [div_self hρ.ne', Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at h_occ
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card h_sub) h_occ
      have h_sum_real : (U_high.card : ℝ) ≤ (P_sq.card : ℝ) * B_P := by
        calc (U_high.card : ℝ)
            = ∑ p ∈ P_sq, ((U_high.filter (fun u => p_of u = p)).card : ℝ) := by
              rw [h_fib_sum, Nat.cast_sum]
          _ ≤ ∑ _p ∈ P_sq, B_P := Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib_ub
          _ = (P_sq.card : ℝ) * B_P := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith only [hU_high_card, h_sum_real]

    let u_p : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Fin N := fun p =>
      if hp : p ∈ P_sq then Classical.choose (Finset.mem_image.mp hp) else ⟨0, by omega⟩
    have hu_p_spec : ∀ p ∈ P_sq, u_p p ∈ U_high ∧ p_of (u_p p) = p := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp [u_p]
      rw [dif_pos hp]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (Finset.mem_image.mp hp)
    have hu_p_inj : Set.InjOn u_p ↑P_sq := by
      intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ heq
      rw [← (hu_p_spec p₁ hp₁).2, ← (hu_p_spec p₂ hp₂).2, heq]

    let V_inc : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Finset (Fin Q) :=
      fun p => Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q => G_samp (u_p p) v)
    let k_sl : Fin Q → ℤ := fun v => ⌊a_sl v / ρ⌋
    let K_s : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Finset ℤ := fun p => (V_inc p).image k_sl
    let v_pk : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → ℤ → Fin Q := fun p k₀ =>
      if hk : k₀ ∈ K_s p then Classical.choose (Finset.mem_image.mp hk) else ⟨0, by omega⟩
    have hv_pk_spec : ∀ p (k₀ : ℤ), k₀ ∈ K_s p →
        v_pk p k₀ ∈ V_inc p ∧ k_sl (v_pk p k₀) = k₀ := by
      intro p k₀ hk
      dsimp [v_pk]
      rw [dif_pos hk]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (Finset.mem_image.mp hk)
    have hv_pk_inj : ∀ p, Set.InjOn (v_pk p) ↑(K_s p) := by
      intro p k₁ hk₁ k₂ hk₂ heq
      rw [← (hv_pk_spec p k₁ hk₁).2, ← (hv_pk_spec p k₂ hk₂).2, heq]

    let q_mk : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → ℤ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
      fun p k₀ => dyadicSquare ρ (k₀, ⌊(y (u_p p) 1 - a_sl (v_pk p k₀) * y (u_p p) 0) / ρ⌋)
    have hq_mk_inj : ∀ p, Function.Injective (q_mk p) := by
      intro p k₁ k₂ heq
      exact (Prod.ext_iff.mp (h_dyad_inj _ _ heq)).1
    let T_fam : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) :=
      fun p => if p ∈ P_sq then (K_s p).image (q_mk p) else ∅

    have hT_fam_bounds : ∀ p ∈ P_sq,
        1 ≤ (T_fam p).card ∧ (T_fam p).card ≤ Q ∧
        (q * (Q : ℝ)) / (4 * B_B) ≤ ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) := by
      intro p hp
      have hT_card_eq : (T_fam p).card = (K_s p).card := by
        dsimp [T_fam]
        rw [if_pos hp]
        exact Finset.card_image_of_injective (K_s p) (hq_mk_inj p)
      have hu_high := (hu_p_spec p hp).1
      have hV_lb : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q * (Q : ℝ) ≤ ((V_inc p).card : ℝ) :=
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu_high).2
      have hV_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < ((V_inc p).card : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hV_lb
      have hV_ne : (V_inc p).Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (Nat.cast_pos.mp hV_pos_real)
      have hK_ge1 : 1 ≤ (K_s p).card := Finset.one_le_card.mpr (hV_ne.image k_sl)
      have hK_le_Q : (K_s p).card ≤ Q := by
        calc (K_s p).card ≤ (V_inc p).card := Finset.card_image_le
          _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Q)).card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
          _ = Q := by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      have h_fib_sum : (V_inc p).card =
          ∑ k₀ ∈ K_s p, ((V_inc p).filter (fun v => k_sl v = k₀)).card :=
        Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image k_sl (V_inc p)
      have h_fib_ub : ∀ k₀ ∈ K_s p,
          (((V_inc p).filter (fun v => k_sl v = k₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_B := by
        intro k₀ _
        have h_sub : (V_inc p).filter (fun v => k_sl v = k₀) ⊆
            Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q => |a_sl v - (k₀ : ℝ) * ρ| < 2 * ρ) := by
          intro v hv
          have hk_eq : ⌊a_sl v / ρ⌋ = k₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
          refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, ?_⟩
          have h_ge : (k₀ : ℝ) * ρ ≤ a_sl v := by
            rw [← hk_eq]
            exact (le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.floor_le (a_sl v / ρ))
          have h_lt : a_sl v < ((k₀ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ := by
            rw [← hk_eq]
            exact (div_lt_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (a_sl v / ρ))
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith only [h_ge])]
          have h_step : ((k₀ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ = (k₀ : ℝ) * ρ + ρ := by ring
          linarith only [h_lt, h_step, hρ]
        have h_occ := h_occ_B ((k₀ : ℝ) * ρ) ρ le_rfl hρ_lt1.le
        rw [div_self hρ.ne', Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at h_occ
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card h_sub) h_occ
      have hK_lb : (q * (Q : ℝ)) / (4 * B_B) ≤ ((K_s p).card : ℝ) := by
        have h_sum_real : ((V_inc p).card : ℝ) ≤ ((K_s p).card : ℝ) * B_B := by
          calc ((V_inc p).card : ℝ)
              = ∑ k₀ ∈ K_s p, (((V_inc p).filter (fun v => k_sl v = k₀)).card : ℝ) := by
                rw [h_fib_sum, Nat.cast_sum]
            _ ≤ ∑ _k₀ ∈ K_s p, B_B := Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib_ub
            _ = ((K_s p).card : ℝ) * B_B := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith only [hV_lb, h_sum_real]
      rw [hT_card_eq]
      exact ⟨hK_ge1, hK_le_Q, hK_lb⟩

    have hT_fam_geom : ∀ p ∈ P_sq, ∀ q_sq ∈ T_fam p,
        IsTubeParamSquare ρ q_sq ∧ (dyadicTube q_sq ∩ p).Nonempty := by
      intro p hp q_sq hq_sq
      dsimp [T_fam] at hq_sq
      rw [if_pos hp] at hq_sq
      obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀_mem, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq_sq
      have hv_spec := hv_pk_spec p k₀ hk₀_mem
      have hk₀_eq : ⌊a_sl (v_pk p k₀) / ρ⌋ = k₀ := hv_spec.2
      have ha_v := ha_dom (v_pk p k₀)
      have ha_lo := ha_v.1
      have ha_hi := ha_v.2
      have h_a_ge : (k₀ : ℝ) * ρ ≤ a_sl (v_pk p k₀) := by
        have h_fl := Int.floor_le (a_sl (v_pk p k₀) / ρ)
        rw [hk₀_eq] at h_fl
        exact (le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp h_fl
      have h_a_lt : a_sl (v_pk p k₀) < ((k₀ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ := by
        have h_fl := Int.lt_floor_add_one (a_sl (v_pk p k₀) / ρ)
        rw [hk₀_eq] at h_fl
        exact (div_lt_iff₀ hρ).mp h_fl
      refine ⟨⟨⟨(k₀, ⌊(y (u_p p) 1 - a_sl (v_pk p k₀) * y (u_p p) 0) / ρ⌋), rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro w hw
        obtain ⟨hw0_ge, hw0_lt, _, _⟩ := hw
        have h_step : ((k₀ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ = (k₀ : ℝ) * ρ + ρ := by ring
        exact ⟨by linarith only [hw0_ge, h_a_lt, ha_lo, hρ₆, h_step],
               by linarith only [hw0_lt, h_a_ge, ha_hi, hρ₆, h_step]⟩
      · refine ⟨y (u_p p), ?_, ?_⟩
        · let u_star : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
            WithLp.toLp 2 ![a_sl (v_pk p k₀),
                            y (u_p p) 1 - a_sl (v_pk p k₀) * y (u_p p) 0]
          have hu0 := (h_lp2 (a_sl (v_pk p k₀))
            (y (u_p p) 1 - a_sl (v_pk p k₀) * y (u_p p) 0)).1
          have hu1 := (h_lp2 (a_sl (v_pk p k₀))
            (y (u_p p) 1 - a_sl (v_pk p k₀) * y (u_p p) 0)).2
          refine ⟨u_star, ?_, ?_⟩
          · dsimp [q_mk, dyadicSquare]
            rw [hu0, hu1]
            exact ⟨h_a_ge, h_a_lt,
                   (le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.floor_le _),
                   (div_lt_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one _)⟩
          · rw [hu0, hu1]
            ring
        · have h_in : y (u_p p) ∈ p_of (u_p p) := h_pt_in_dyad (y (u_p p))
          rwa [(hu_p_spec p hp).2] at h_in

    let k_sh : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → ℕ := fun p => Nat.log 2 (T_fam p).card
    let L_sh : ℕ := Nat.log 2 Q + 1
    have hL_sh_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (L_sh : ℝ) := by dsimp [L_sh]; positivity
    have h_maps : Set.MapsTo k_sh ↑P_sq ↑(Finset.range L_sh) := by
      intro p hp
      have h_le_Q := (hT_fam_bounds p hp).2.1
      have h_log_le : Nat.log 2 (T_fam p).card ≤ Nat.log 2 Q := Nat.log_mono_right h_le_Q
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by dsimp [k_sh, L_sh]; omega)
    have h_shell_sum : P_sq.card =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range L_sh, (P_sq.filter (fun p => k_sh p = k)).card :=
      Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise h_maps
    have h_shell_exists : ∃ k_star ∈ Finset.range L_sh,
        (q * (N : ℝ)) / (4 * B_P * (L_sh : ℝ)) ≤
          ((P_sq.filter (fun p => k_sh p = k_star)).card : ℝ) := by
      by_contra h_all
      push_neg at h_all
      have h_ne : (Finset.range L_sh).Nonempty := ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by dsimp [L_sh]; omega)⟩
      have h_sum_lt : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range L_sh,
          ((P_sq.filter (fun p => k_sh p = k)).card : ℝ)) < (q * (N : ℝ)) / (4 * B_P) := by
        calc (∑ k ∈ Finset.range L_sh, ((P_sq.filter (fun p => k_sh p = k)).card : ℝ))
            < ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range L_sh, ((q * (N : ℝ)) / (4 * B_P * (L_sh : ℝ))) :=
              Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty h_ne h_all
          _ = (L_sh : ℝ) * ((q * (N : ℝ)) / (4 * B_P * (L_sh : ℝ))) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ = (q * (N : ℝ)) / (4 * B_P) := by
              have hBP_pos : 0 < B_P := by linarith only [hB_P]
              field_simp [hBP_pos.ne', hL_sh_pos.ne']
      have h_sum_eq : (P_sq.card : ℝ) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range L_sh, ((P_sq.filter (fun p => k_sh p = k)).card : ℝ) := by
        rw [h_shell_sum, Nat.cast_sum]
      linarith only [hP_sq_card, h_sum_eq, h_sum_lt]

    obtain ⟨k_star, _, hk_star_card⟩ := h_shell_exists
    let P : Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) := P_sq.filter (fun p => k_sh p = k_star)
    let M₀ : ℝ := ((2 ^ k_star : ℕ) : ℝ)
    have hM₀_pos : 0 < M₀ := by dsimp [M₀]; positivity
    have hP_card_lb : (q * (N : ℝ)) / (4 * B_P * (L_sh : ℝ)) ≤ (P.card : ℝ) := hk_star_card
    have hP_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (P.card : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hP_card_lb
    have hP_ne : P.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (Nat.cast_pos.mp hP_pos_real)
    have hP_sub : P ⊆ P_sq := Finset.filter_subset _ _

    have hT_deg_shell : ∀ p ∈ P,
        M₀ / 2 ≤ ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) ∧ ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M₀ := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hp_sq, hk_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
      dsimp [k_sh] at hk_eq
      have h1_le := (hT_fam_bounds p hp_sq).1
      have h_lo_nat : 2 ^ k_star ≤ (T_fam p).card := by
        rw [← hk_eq]
        exact Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)
      have h_hi_nat : (T_fam p).card ≤ 2 * 2 ^ k_star := by
        have h_lt := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by omega : 1 < 2) (T_fam p).card
        rw [hk_eq, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, pow_succ'] at h_lt
        omega
      have h_lo_real : M₀ ≤ ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [M₀]
        exact_mod_cast h_lo_nat
      have h_hi_real : ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M₀ := by
        dsimp [M₀]
        exact_mod_cast h_hi_nat
      exact ⟨by linarith only [hM₀_pos, h_lo_real], h_hi_real⟩

    have hM₀_lb : (q / (8 * B_B)) * (Q : ℝ) ≤ M₀ := by
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := hP_ne
      have h1 := (hT_fam_bounds p₀ (hP_sub hp₀)).2.2
      have h2 := (hT_deg_shell p₀ hp₀).2
      have h_comb : (q * (Q : ℝ)) / (4 * B_B) ≤ 2 * M₀ := le_trans h1 h2
      have h_eq : (q / (8 * B_B)) * (Q : ℝ) = ((q * (Q : ℝ)) / (4 * B_B)) / 2 := by ring
      linarith only [h_comb, h_eq]

    have hP_rhoset : IsRhoSet ρ d (4 * B_P ^ 2 * (L_sh : ℝ) / q) P := by
      refine ⟨hP_ne, fun z r hr₀ hr₁ => ?_⟩
      let P_hit := P.filter (fun p => (p ∩ Metric.ball z r).Nonempty)
      have h_img_sub : P_hit.image u_p ⊆
          Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N => ‖y u - z‖ < 3 * r) := by
        intro u hu
        obtain ⟨p, hp_hit, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
        obtain ⟨hp_P, w, hw_p, hw_ball⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp_hit
        have hp_sq : p ∈ P_sq := hP_sub hp_P
        refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        have hp_eq := (hu_p_spec p hp_sq).2
        rw [← hp_eq] at hw_p
        have h_diam := h_dyad_diam _ (y (u_p p)) w (h_pt_in_dyad _) hw_p
        have hw_dist : ‖w - z‖ < r := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw_ball
        have h_tri : ‖y (u_p p) - z‖ ≤ ‖y (u_p p) - w‖ + ‖w - z‖ := by
          calc ‖y (u_p p) - z‖ = ‖(y (u_p p) - w) + (w - z)‖ := by abel_nf
            _ ≤ ‖y (u_p p) - w‖ + ‖w - z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        linarith only [h_tri, h_diam, hw_dist, hr₀]
      have h_inj_hit : Set.InjOn u_p ↑P_hit :=
        hu_p_inj.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr ((Finset.filter_subset _ P).trans hP_sub))
      have h_hit_card : (P_hit.card : ℝ) ≤ B_P * (r / ρ) ^ d := by
        have h_eq : (P_hit.image u_p).card = P_hit.card := Finset.card_image_of_injOn h_inj_hit
        have h_le : P_hit.card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N => ‖y u - z‖ < 3 * r)).card := by
          rw [← h_eq]
          exact Finset.card_le_card h_img_sub
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h_le) (h_occ_P z r hr₀ hr₁)
      have h_N_le_P : (N : ℝ) ≤ (4 * B_P * (L_sh : ℝ) / q) * (P.card : ℝ) := by
        have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * B_P * (L_sh : ℝ))).mp hP_card_lb
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hq₀]
        linarith only [h1]
      have h_div_rpow : (r / ρ) ^ d = r ^ d * ρ ^ (-d) := by
        have hr_nn : 0 ≤ r := le_trans hρ.le hr₀
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Real.mul_rpow hr_nn (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ.le),
            Real.inv_rpow hρ.le, Real.rpow_neg hρ.le]
      calc (P_hit.card : ℝ)
          ≤ B_P * (r / ρ) ^ d := h_hit_card
        _ = B_P * r ^ d * ρ ^ (-d) := by rw [h_div_rpow]; ring
        _ ≤ B_P * r ^ d * (N : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN_lb (mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hB_P])
              (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_trans hρ.le hr₀) _))
        _ ≤ B_P * r ^ d * ((4 * B_P * (L_sh : ℝ) / q) * (P.card : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_N_le_P (mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hB_P])
              (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_trans hρ.le hr₀) _))
        _ = (4 * B_P ^ 2 * (L_sh : ℝ) / q) * r ^ d * (P.card : ℝ) := by ring

    have hT_rhoset : ∀ p ∈ P, IsRhoSet ρ s (4 * B_B ^ 2 / q) (T_fam p) := by
      intro p hp
      have hp_sq : p ∈ P_sq := hP_sub hp
      obtain ⟨hT_ge1, _, hT_lb⟩ := hT_fam_bounds p hp_sq
      refine ⟨Finset.one_le_card.mp hT_ge1, fun z r hr₀ hr₁ => ?_⟩
      let T_hit := (T_fam p).filter (fun q_sq => (q_sq ∩ Metric.ball z r).Nonempty)
      let K_hit := (K_s p).filter (fun k₀ => (q_mk p k₀ ∩ Metric.ball z r).Nonempty)
      have hT_hit_eq : T_hit = K_hit.image (q_mk p) := by
        dsimp [T_hit, K_hit, T_fam]
        rw [if_pos hp_sq, Finset.filter_image]
      have h_img_sub : K_hit.image (v_pk p) ⊆
          Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q => |a_sl v - z 0| < 2 * r) := by
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀_hit, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
        obtain ⟨hk₀_mem, w, hw_q, hw_ball⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hk₀_hit
        refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        have hk₀_eq : ⌊a_sl (v_pk p k₀) / ρ⌋ = k₀ := (hv_pk_spec p k₀ hk₀_mem).2
        obtain ⟨hw0_ge, hw0_lt, _, _⟩ := hw_q
        have ha_ge : (k₀ : ℝ) * ρ ≤ a_sl (v_pk p k₀) := by
          have h_fl := Int.floor_le (a_sl (v_pk p k₀) / ρ)
          rw [hk₀_eq] at h_fl
          exact (le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp h_fl
        have ha_lt : a_sl (v_pk p k₀) < ((k₀ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ := by
          have h_fl := Int.lt_floor_add_one (a_sl (v_pk p k₀) / ρ)
          rw [hk₀_eq] at h_fl
          exact (div_lt_iff₀ hρ).mp h_fl
        have h_step : ((k₀ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ = (k₀ : ℝ) * ρ + ρ := by ring
        have h_aw : |a_sl (v_pk p k₀) - w 0| < ρ :=
          abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith only [ha_ge, hw0_lt, h_step],
                      by linarith only [ha_lt, hw0_ge, h_step]⟩
        have hw_dist : ‖w - z‖ < r := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw_ball
        have h_wz : |w 0 - z 0| < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (h_coord_le (w - z) 0) hw_dist
        have h_tri : |a_sl (v_pk p k₀) - z 0| ≤
            |a_sl (v_pk p k₀) - w 0| + |w 0 - z 0| := by
          calc |a_sl (v_pk p k₀) - z 0|
              = |(a_sl (v_pk p k₀) - w 0) + (w 0 - z 0)| := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ |a_sl (v_pk p k₀) - w 0| + |w 0 - z 0| := abs_add_le _ _
        linarith only [h_tri, h_aw, h_wz, hr₀]
      have h_inj_K : Set.InjOn (v_pk p) ↑K_hit :=
        (hv_pk_inj p).mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr (Finset.filter_subset _ _))
      have h_hit_card : (T_hit.card : ℝ) ≤ B_B * (r / ρ) ^ s := by
        have h1 : T_hit.card ≤ K_hit.card := by
          rw [hT_hit_eq]
          exact Finset.card_image_le
        have h2 : K_hit.card = (K_hit.image (v_pk p)).card :=
          (Finset.card_image_of_injOn h_inj_K).symm
        have h3 : K_hit.card ≤
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q => |a_sl v - z 0| < 2 * r)).card := by
          rw [h2]
          exact Finset.card_le_card h_img_sub
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (le_trans h1 h3)) (h_occ_B (z 0) r hr₀ hr₁)
      have h_Q_le_T : (Q : ℝ) ≤ (4 * B_B / q) * ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) := by
        have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * B_B)).mp hT_lb
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hq₀]
        linarith only [h1]
      have h_div_rpow : (r / ρ) ^ s = r ^ s * ρ ^ (-s) := by
        have hr_nn : 0 ≤ r := le_trans hρ.le hr₀
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Real.mul_rpow hr_nn (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ.le),
            Real.inv_rpow hρ.le, Real.rpow_neg hρ.le]
      calc (T_hit.card : ℝ)
          ≤ B_B * (r / ρ) ^ s := h_hit_card
        _ = B_B * r ^ s * ρ ^ (-s) := by rw [h_div_rpow]; ring
        _ ≤ B_B * r ^ s * (Q : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ_lb (mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hB_B])
              (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_trans hρ.le hr₀) _))
        _ ≤ B_B * r ^ s * ((4 * B_B / q) * ((T_fam p).card : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_Q_le_T (mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hB_B])
              (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_trans hρ.le hr₀) _))
        _ = (4 * B_B ^ 2 / q) * r ^ s * ((T_fam p).card : ℝ) := by ring

    let K_c : ℕ := ⌈C_cov⌉₊
    have h_biUnion_ub : ((P.biUnion T_fam).card : ℝ) ≤ (Q : ℝ) * (2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1) * M := by
      let Win : Fin Q → ℝ → Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) := fun v c_t =>
        (Finset.Icc (⌊c_t / ρ⌋ - (K_c : ℤ)) (⌊c_t / ρ⌋ + (K_c : ℤ))).image
          (fun m_int => dyadicSquare ρ (k_sl v, m_int))
      have hWin_card : ∀ (v : Fin Q) (c_t : ℝ), ((Win v c_t).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1 := by
        intro v c_t
        have h1 : (Win v c_t).card ≤
            (Finset.Icc (⌊c_t / ρ⌋ - (K_c : ℤ)) (⌊c_t / ρ⌋ + (K_c : ℤ))).card :=
          Finset.card_image_le
        have h2 : (Finset.Icc (⌊c_t / ρ⌋ - (K_c : ℤ)) (⌊c_t / ρ⌋ + (K_c : ℤ))).card =
            2 * K_c + 1 := by
          rw [Int.card_Icc]
          omega
        have h_nat : (Win v c_t).card ≤ 2 * K_c + 1 := le_trans h1 (le_of_eq h2)
        have h_cast : ((Win v c_t).card : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * K_c + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_nat
        push_cast at h_cast
        exact h_cast
      have h_sub_union : P.biUnion T_fam ⊆
          Finset.univ.biUnion (fun v : Fin Q => (S_cov v).biUnion (fun c_t => Win v c_t)) := by
        intro q_sq hq_mem
        obtain ⟨p, hp_P, hq_Tp⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hq_mem
        have hp_sq : p ∈ P_sq := hP_sub hp_P
        dsimp [T_fam] at hq_Tp
        rw [if_pos hp_sq] at hq_Tp
        obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀_mem, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq_Tp
        let v := v_pk p k₀
        have hv_spec := hv_pk_spec p k₀ hk₀_mem
        have hG_uv : G_samp (u_p p) v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv_spec.1).2
        obtain ⟨c_t, hc_t_mem, hc_t_est⟩ := hS_cov (u_p p) v hG_uv
        have hC_le_Kc : C_cov ≤ (K_c : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        let val := y (u_p p) 1 - a_sl v * y (u_p p) 0
        have h_val_est : |val - c_t| ≤ (K_c : ℝ) * ρ :=
          le_trans hc_t_est (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_le_Kc hρ.le)
        obtain ⟨h_val_lo, h_val_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h_val_est
        have h_div_lo : c_t / ρ - (K_c : ℝ) ≤ val / ρ := by
          have h1 : c_t - (K_c : ℝ) * ρ ≤ val := by linarith only [h_val_lo]
          have h2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hρ.le
          rwa [sub_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hρ.ne'] at h2
        have h_div_hi : val / ρ ≤ c_t / ρ + (K_c : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : val ≤ c_t + (K_c : ℝ) * ρ := by linarith only [h_val_hi]
          have h2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hρ.le
          rwa [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hρ.ne'] at h2
        have hm_icc : ⌊val / ρ⌋ ∈ Finset.Icc (⌊c_t / ρ⌋ - (K_c : ℤ)) (⌊c_t / ρ⌋ + (K_c : ℤ)) := by
          refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
            have h_fl := Int.floor_le (c_t / ρ)
            push_cast
            linarith only [h_fl, h_div_lo]
          · have h_lt : (⌊val / ρ⌋ : ℝ) < ((⌊c_t / ρ⌋ + (K_c : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
              have h_fl1 := Int.floor_le (val / ρ)
              have h_fl2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (c_t / ρ)
              push_cast
              linarith only [h_fl1, h_div_hi, h_fl2]
            have h_lt_z : ⌊val / ρ⌋ < ⌊c_t / ρ⌋ + (K_c : ℤ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h_lt
            omega
        refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨v, Finset.mem_univ v, ?_⟩
        refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨c_t, hc_t_mem, ?_⟩
        refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⌊val / ρ⌋, hm_icc, ?_⟩
        change dyadicSquare ρ (k_sl v, ⌊val / ρ⌋) = dyadicSquare ρ (k₀, ⌊val / ρ⌋)
        rw [hv_spec.2]
      have h_card_nat : (P.biUnion T_fam).card ≤
          ∑ v : Fin Q, ∑ c_t ∈ S_cov v, (Win v c_t).card := by
        calc (P.biUnion T_fam).card
            ≤ (Finset.univ.biUnion (fun v : Fin Q =>
                (S_cov v).biUnion (fun c_t => Win v c_t))).card :=
              Finset.card_le_card h_sub_union
          _ ≤ ∑ v : Fin Q, ((S_cov v).biUnion (fun c_t => Win v c_t)).card :=
              Finset.card_biUnion_le
          _ ≤ ∑ v : Fin Q, ∑ c_t ∈ S_cov v, (Win v c_t).card :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun v _ => Finset.card_biUnion_le)
      calc ((P.biUnion T_fam).card : ℝ)
          ≤ ∑ v : Fin Q, ∑ c_t ∈ S_cov v, ((Win v c_t).card : ℝ) := by
            have h1 : ((P.biUnion T_fam).card : ℝ) ≤
                ((∑ v : Fin Q, ∑ c_t ∈ S_cov v, (Win v c_t).card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
              exact_mod_cast h_card_nat
            simpa only [Nat.cast_sum] using h1
        _ ≤ ∑ v : Fin Q, ∑ _c_t ∈ S_cov v, (2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun v _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun c_t _ => hWin_card v c_t))
        _ = ∑ v : Fin Q, ((S_cov v).card : ℝ) * (2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ ∑ _v : Fin Q, M * (2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun v _ =>
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hS_card v) (by positivity))
        _ = (Q : ℝ) * (2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1) * M := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
            ring

    refine ⟨M₀, P, T_fam, hM₀_pos, hM₀_lb, ?_, hP_rhoset, ?_, hT_deg_shell, hT_rhoset, h_biUnion_ub⟩
    · intro p hp
      rw [← (hu_p_spec p (hP_sub hp)).2]
      exact hp_of_dyad _
    · exact fun p hp => hT_fam_geom p (hP_sub hp)

  
  
  
  intro d s α B_dom C_cov hd₀ hd₂ hs₀ hs₁ hα hB hC
  obtain ⟨η₀, ρ₀, c_rw, hη₀, hρ₀, hc_rw, h_rw⟩ :=
    ren_wang s d (α / 2) hs₀ hs₁ hd₀ hd₂ (half_pos hα)
  let η : ℝ := min (1 / 8) (min (η₀ / 12) (α / 24))
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have hη_le_eighth : η ≤ 1 / 8 := min_le_left _ _
  have h12η_le_η₀ : 12 * η ≤ η₀ := by
    have h1 : η ≤ η₀ / 12 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith only [h1]
  have h24η_le_α : 24 * η ≤ α := by
    have h1 : η ≤ α / 24 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    linarith only [h1]
  let k_deg : ℕ := ⌈(4 + η) / (3 * η)⌉₊
  let K_c : ℕ := ⌈C_cov⌉₊
  let C_P0 : ℝ := 4 * (Real.exp 2 * 4608 * B_dom ^ 4 + 1)
  let C_B0 : ℝ := 2 * (Real.exp 2 * 20 * B_dom + 1)
  have hB_pos : 0 < B_dom := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB
  have hC_B0_pos : 0 < C_B0 := by positivity
  have hC_P0_pos : 0 < C_P0 := by positivity
  have h1_le_CB0 : 1 ≤ C_B0 := by
    have h_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 * 20 * B_dom := by positivity
    dsimp [C_B0]
    linarith only [h_nn]
  have h1_le_CP0 : 1 ≤ C_P0 := by
    have h_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 * 4608 * B_dom ^ 4 := by positivity
    dsimp [C_P0]
    linarith only [h_nn]
  have hCB0_le_CP0 : C_B0 ≤ C_P0 := by
    have hB_le_B4 : B_dom ≤ B_dom ^ 4 := by
      calc B_dom = B_dom ^ 1 := (pow_one B_dom).symm
        _ ≤ B_dom ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hB (by omega)
    have h_mul : Real.exp 2 * (20 * B_dom) ≤ Real.exp 2 * (4608 * B_dom ^ 4) := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.exp_pos 2).le
      have hB4_nn : 0 ≤ B_dom ^ 4 := pow_nonneg hB_pos.le 4
      linarith only [hB_le_B4, hB4_nn]
    dsimp [C_B0, C_P0]
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp 2 * (4608 * B_dom ^ 4) := by positivity
    linarith only [h_mul, h_nn]

  let δ_2 : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ η - 1
  have hδ_2_pos : 0 < δ_2 := sub_pos.mpr (Real.one_lt_rpow (by norm_num) hη_pos)
  let C_log : ℝ := 2 / δ_2 + 1
  let C_rho : ℝ := 4 * C_P0 ^ 2 * C_log
  have hC_rho_pos : 0 < C_rho := by positivity
  let C_end : ℝ := c_rw / (8 * C_B0 * (2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1))
  have hC_end_pos : 0 < C_end := by positivity
  let ρ_tail : ℝ := 1 / (90 * (k_deg.factorial : ℝ))
  let ρ_rset : ℝ := C_rho⁻¹ ^ (1 / η)
  let ρ_end : ℝ := (min 1 C_end) ^ (4 / α)
  have hρ_tail_pos : 0 < ρ_tail := by
    have hf_pos : 0 < (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos k_deg)
    positivity
  have hρ_rset_pos : 0 < ρ_rset := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hC_rho_pos) _
  have hρ_end_pos : 0 < ρ_end := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (lt_min zero_lt_one hC_end_pos) _
  let ρ₁ : ℝ := min (1 / 6) (min ρ₀ (min ρ_tail (min ρ_rset ρ_end)))
  have hρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁ :=
    lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min hρ₀ (lt_min hρ_tail_pos (lt_min hρ_rset_pos hρ_end_pos)))
  have hρ₁_sixth : ρ₁ ≤ 1 / 6 := min_le_left _ _
  have hρ₁_half : ρ₁ < 1 / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt hρ₁_sixth (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨η, ρ₁, hη_pos, hρ₁_pos, hρ₁_half, ?_⟩
  intro ρ M N_P N_B μ x_P ν a_B G
    hρ hρ_lt_ρ₁ hM hμ_nn hμ_sum hx_dom hx_ball hν_nn hν_sum ha_dom ha_ball hG_mass h_cov
  have hρ_sixth : ρ < 1 / 6 := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt_ρ₁ (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρ_lt_ρ₀ : ρ < ρ₀ :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt_ρ₁ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hρ_lt_tail : ρ < ρ_tail :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt_ρ₁
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hρ_lt_rset : ρ < ρ_rset :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt_ρ₁
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))))
  have hρ_lt_end : ρ < ρ_end :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt_ρ₁
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))))
  have hρ_lt_one : ρ < 1 := by linarith only [hρ_sixth]

  
  let y_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun i =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 ![(x_P i 0 + B_dom) / (3 * B_dom),
                    (x_P i 1 + 2 * B_dom ^ 2) / (6 * B_dom ^ 2)]
  let a_sl : Fin N_B → ℝ := fun j => a_B j / (2 * B_dom)
  have hy_P0 : ∀ i : Fin N_P, y_P i 0 = (x_P i 0 + B_dom) / (3 * B_dom) :=
    fun i => (h_lp2 _ _).1
  have hy_P1 : ∀ i : Fin N_P, y_P i 1 = (x_P i 1 + 2 * B_dom ^ 2) / (6 * B_dom ^ 2) :=
    fun i => (h_lp2 _ _).2
  have hB_le_B2 : B_dom ≤ B_dom ^ 2 := by
    calc B_dom = B_dom ^ 1 := (pow_one B_dom).symm
      _ ≤ B_dom ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hB (by omega)
  have hy_P_dom : ∀ i : Fin N_P,
      (0 ≤ y_P i 0 ∧ y_P i 0 ≤ 2 / 3) ∧ (0 ≤ y_P i 1 ∧ y_P i 1 ≤ 2 / 3) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨h0_lo, h0_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp (le_trans (h_coord_le (x_P i) 0) (hx_dom i))
    obtain ⟨h1_lo, h1_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp (le_trans (h_coord_le (x_P i) 1) (hx_dom i))
    rw [hy_P0, hy_P1]
    refine ⟨⟨div_nonneg (by linarith only [h0_lo]) (by positivity), ?_⟩,
            ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith only [h1_lo, hB_le_B2, hB_pos]) (by positivity), ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      linarith only [h0_hi]
    · rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      have hB2_nn : 0 ≤ B_dom ^ 2 := sq_nonneg B_dom
      linarith only [h1_hi, hB_le_B2, hB2_nn]
  have ha_sl_dom : ∀ j : Fin N_B, -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ a_sl j ∧ a_sl j ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨hj_lo, hj_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp (ha_dom j)
    dsimp [a_sl]
    refine ⟨(le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith only [hj_lo]),
            (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith only [hj_hi])⟩

  have h1_le_6B2 : 1 ≤ 6 * B_dom ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ B_dom ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hB
    linarith only [h1]
  have hy_P_ball : ∀ (z' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (R' : ℝ), ρ ≤ R' →
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖y_P i - z'‖ < R' then μ i else 0) ≤
        36 * B_dom ^ 4 * ρ ^ (-η) * R' ^ d := by
    intro z' R' hR'
    have hR'_pos : 0 < R' := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ hR'
    let z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      WithLp.toLp 2 ![3 * B_dom * z' 0 - B_dom, 6 * B_dom ^ 2 * z' 1 - 2 * B_dom ^ 2]
    have h_imp : ∀ i : Fin N_P, ‖y_P i - z'‖ < R' → ‖x_P i - z‖ < 6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R' := by
      intro i hi
      have h0 : (x_P i - z) 0 = 3 * B_dom * (y_P i 0 - z' 0) := by
        rw [h_sub_apply, (h_lp2 _ _).1, hy_P0]
        field_simp [hB_pos.ne']
        ring
      have h1 : (x_P i - z) 1 = 6 * B_dom ^ 2 * (y_P i 1 - z' 1) := by
        rw [h_sub_apply, (h_lp2 _ _).2, hy_P1]
        field_simp [hB_pos.ne']
        ring
      have hB2_le_B4 : B_dom ^ 2 ≤ B_dom ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hB (by omega)
      have hsq_le : ‖x_P i - z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (6 * B_dom ^ 2 * ‖y_P i - z'‖) ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_norm2 (x_P i - z), h0, h1]
        have hy_sq := h_norm2 (y_P i - z')
        rw [h_sub_apply, h_sub_apply] at hy_sq
        have h_lhs_eq : (3 * B_dom * (y_P i 0 - z' 0)) ^ 2 +
            (6 * B_dom ^ 2 * (y_P i 1 - z' 1)) ^ 2 =
            9 * B_dom ^ 2 * (y_P i 0 - z' 0) ^ 2 + 36 * B_dom ^ 4 * (y_P i 1 - z' 1) ^ 2 := by
          ring
        have h_rhs_eq : (6 * B_dom ^ 2 * ‖y_P i - z'‖) ^ 2 =
            36 * B_dom ^ 4 * ((y_P i 0 - z' 0) ^ 2 + (y_P i 1 - z' 1) ^ 2) := by
          rw [← hy_sq]
          ring
        have h_term0 : 9 * B_dom ^ 2 * (y_P i 0 - z' 0) ^ 2 ≤
            36 * B_dom ^ 4 * (y_P i 0 - z' 0) ^ 2 := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sq_nonneg _)
          have hB4_nn : 0 ≤ B_dom ^ 4 := pow_nonneg hB_pos.le 4
          linarith only [hB2_le_B4, hB4_nn]
        linarith only [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq, h_term0]
      have hsq_lt : (6 * B_dom ^ 2 * ‖y_P i - z'‖) ^ 2 < (6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R') ^ 2 :=
        (sq_lt_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
          (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hi (by positivity))
      exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp (lt_of_le_of_lt hsq_le hsq_lt)
    have h6Bd_le : (6 * B_dom ^ 2) ^ d ≤ 36 * B_dom ^ 4 := by
      calc (6 * B_dom ^ 2) ^ d
          ≤ (6 * B_dom ^ 2) ^ (2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1_le_6B2 hd₂
        _ = (6 * B_dom ^ 2) ^ (2 : ℕ) := Real.rpow_natCast _ 2
        _ = 36 * B_dom ^ 4 := by ring
    by_cases h_le1 : 6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R' ≤ 1
    · have h_sub : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖y_P i - z'‖ < R' then μ i else 0) ≤
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < 6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R' then μ i else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
        split_ifs with h_y h_x
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact absurd (h_imp i h_y) h_x
        · exact hμ_nn i
        · exact le_rfl
      have h_ρ_le : ρ ≤ 6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R' := by
        calc ρ ≤ 1 * R' := by rw [one_mul]; exact hR'
          _ ≤ 6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1_le_6B2 hR'_pos.le
      have h_xb := hx_ball z (6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R') h_ρ_le h_le1
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hR'_pos.le] at h_xb
      calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖y_P i - z'‖ < R' then μ i else 0)
          ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * ((6 * B_dom ^ 2) ^ d * R' ^ d) := le_trans h_sub h_xb
        _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * (36 * B_dom ^ 4 * R' ^ d) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h6Bd_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hR'_pos.le _)
        _ = 36 * B_dom ^ 4 * ρ ^ (-η) * R' ^ d := by ring
    · have h_gt1 : 1 ≤ 6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R' := le_of_not_ge h_le1
      have h_le_sum : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖y_P i - z'‖ < R' then μ i else 0) ≤ 1 := by
        calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖y_P i - z'‖ < R' then μ i else 0)
            ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, μ i := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => by
              split_ifs; exact le_rfl; exact hμ_nn i)
          _ = 1 := hμ_sum
      have h1_le_ρη : 1 ≤ ρ ^ (-η) := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = ρ ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ρ).symm
          _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hη_pos])
      have h1_le_rpow : 1 ≤ 36 * B_dom ^ 4 * R' ^ d := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) ^ d := (Real.one_rpow d).symm
          _ ≤ (6 * B_dom ^ 2 * R') ^ d := Real.rpow_le_rpow zero_le_one h_gt1 hd₀.le
          _ = (6 * B_dom ^ 2) ^ d * R' ^ d := Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hR'_pos.le
          _ ≤ 36 * B_dom ^ 4 * R' ^ d :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h6Bd_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hR'_pos.le _)
      calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖y_P i - z'‖ < R' then μ i else 0)
          ≤ 1 := h_le_sum
        _ = 1 * 1 := (mul_one 1).symm
        _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * (36 * B_dom ^ 4 * R' ^ d) :=
            mul_le_mul h1_le_ρη h1_le_rpow zero_le_one (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
        _ = 36 * B_dom ^ 4 * ρ ^ (-η) * R' ^ d := by ring

  have ha_sl_ball : ∀ (a'₀ R' : ℝ), ρ ≤ R' →
      (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_sl j - a'₀| < R' then ν j else 0) ≤
        2 * B_dom * ρ ^ (-η) * R' ^ s := by
    intro a'₀ R' hR'
    have hR'_pos : 0 < R' := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ hR'
    let a₀ := 2 * B_dom * a'₀
    have h_imp : ∀ j : Fin N_B, |a_sl j - a'₀| < R' → |a_B j - a₀| < 2 * B_dom * R' := by
      intro j hj
      have h_eq : a_B j - a₀ = 2 * B_dom * (a_sl j - a'₀) := by
        dsimp [a_sl, a₀]
        field_simp [hB_pos.ne']
      rw [h_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * B_dom)]
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hj (by positivity)
    have h1_le_2B : 1 ≤ 2 * B_dom := by linarith only [hB]
    have h2Bs_le : (2 * B_dom) ^ s ≤ 2 * B_dom := by
      calc (2 * B_dom) ^ s
          ≤ (2 * B_dom) ^ (1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1_le_2B hs₁
        _ = 2 * B_dom := Real.rpow_one _
    by_cases h_le1 : 2 * B_dom * R' ≤ 1
    · have h_sub : (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_sl j - a'₀| < R' then ν j else 0) ≤
          ∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_B j - a₀| < 2 * B_dom * R' then ν j else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
        split_ifs with h1 h2
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact absurd (h_imp j h1) h2
        · exact hν_nn j
        · exact le_rfl
      have h_ρ_le : ρ ≤ 2 * B_dom * R' := by
        calc ρ ≤ 1 * R' := by rw [one_mul]; exact hR'
          _ ≤ 2 * B_dom * R' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1_le_2B hR'_pos.le
      have h_ab := ha_ball a₀ (2 * B_dom * R') h_ρ_le h_le1
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hR'_pos.le] at h_ab
      calc (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_sl j - a'₀| < R' then ν j else 0)
          ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * ((2 * B_dom) ^ s * R' ^ s) := le_trans h_sub h_ab
        _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * (2 * B_dom * R' ^ s) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2Bs_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hR'_pos.le _)
        _ = 2 * B_dom * ρ ^ (-η) * R' ^ s := by ring
    · have h_gt1 : 1 ≤ 2 * B_dom * R' := le_of_not_ge h_le1
      have h_le_sum : (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_sl j - a'₀| < R' then ν j else 0) ≤ 1 := by
        calc (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_sl j - a'₀| < R' then ν j else 0)
            ≤ ∑ j : Fin N_B, ν j := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by
              split_ifs; exact le_rfl; exact hν_nn j)
          _ = 1 := hν_sum
      have h1_le_ρη : 1 ≤ ρ ^ (-η) := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = ρ ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ρ).symm
          _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hη_pos])
      have h1_le_rpow : 1 ≤ 2 * B_dom * R' ^ s := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) ^ s := (Real.one_rpow s).symm
          _ ≤ (2 * B_dom * R') ^ s := Real.rpow_le_rpow zero_le_one h_gt1 hs₀.le
          _ = (2 * B_dom) ^ s * R' ^ s := Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hR'_pos.le
          _ ≤ 2 * B_dom * R' ^ s :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2Bs_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hR'_pos.le _)
      calc (∑ j : Fin N_B, if |a_sl j - a'₀| < R' then ν j else 0)
          ≤ 1 := h_le_sum
        _ = 1 * 1 := (mul_one 1).symm
        _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * (2 * B_dom * R' ^ s) :=
            mul_le_mul h1_le_ρη h1_le_rpow zero_le_one (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
        _ = 2 * B_dom * ρ ^ (-η) * R' ^ s := by ring

  let S_orig : Fin N_B → Finset ℝ := fun j => Classical.choose (h_cov j)
  have hS_orig_spec : ∀ j : Fin N_B, ((S_orig j).card : ℝ) ≤ M ∧
      ∀ i : Fin N_P, G i j →
        ∃ c₀ ∈ S_orig j, |(x_P i 1 - a_B j * x_P i 0) - c₀| ≤ C_cov * ρ :=
    fun j => Classical.choose_spec (h_cov j)
  let S_tilde : Fin N_B → Finset ℝ := fun j =>
    (S_orig j).image (fun c₀ => c₀ / (6 * B_dom ^ 2) + (2 * B_dom - a_B j) / (6 * B_dom))
  have hS_tilde_card : ∀ j : Fin N_B, ((S_tilde j).card : ℝ) ≤ M := by
    intro j
    exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_image_le) (hS_orig_spec j).1
  have hS_tilde_cov : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (j : Fin N_B), G i j →
      ∃ c_t ∈ S_tilde j, |(y_P i 1 - a_sl j * y_P i 0) - c_t| ≤ C_cov * ρ := by
    intro i j hGij
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀_mem, hc₀_est⟩ := (hS_orig_spec j).2 i hGij
    refine ⟨c₀ / (6 * B_dom ^ 2) + (2 * B_dom - a_B j) / (6 * B_dom),
      Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hc₀_mem, ?_⟩
    have h_id : (y_P i 1 - a_sl j * y_P i 0) -
        (c₀ / (6 * B_dom ^ 2) + (2 * B_dom - a_B j) / (6 * B_dom)) =
        ((x_P i 1 - a_B j * x_P i 0) - c₀) / (6 * B_dom ^ 2) := by
      rw [hy_P0, hy_P1]
      dsimp [a_sl]
      field_simp [hB_pos.ne']
      ring
    rw [h_id, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 6 * B_dom ^ 2)]
    calc |(x_P i 1 - a_B j * x_P i 0) - c₀| / (6 * B_dom ^ 2)
        ≤ (C_cov * ρ) / (6 * B_dom ^ 2) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hc₀_est (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (C_cov * ρ) / 1 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) zero_lt_one h1_le_6B2
      _ = C_cov * ρ := div_one _

  
  let N : ℕ := ⌈ρ ^ (-d)⌉₊
  let Q : ℕ := ⌈ρ ^ (-s)⌉₊
  have hρ_inv_gt1 : 1 < ρ⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hρ).mpr hρ_lt_one
  have h1_lt_ρd : 1 < ρ ^ (-d) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ.le, ← Real.inv_rpow hρ.le]
    exact Real.one_lt_rpow hρ_inv_gt1 hd₀
  have h1_lt_ρs : 1 < ρ ^ (-s) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ.le, ← Real.inv_rpow hρ.le]
    exact Real.one_lt_rpow hρ_inv_gt1 hs₀
  have hN_lb : ρ ^ (-d) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hQ_lb : ρ ^ (-s) ≤ (Q : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hN_ub : (N : ℝ) < 2 * ρ ^ (-d) := by
    have h1 : (N : ℝ) < ρ ^ (-d) + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
    linarith only [h1, h1_lt_ρd]
  have hQ_ub : (Q : ℝ) < 2 * ρ ^ (-s) := by
    have h1 : (Q : ℝ) < ρ ^ (-s) + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
    linarith only [h1, h1_lt_ρs]
  have hN_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith only [h1_lt_ρd]) hN_lb
  have hQ_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith only [h1_lt_ρs]) hQ_lb
  have hN_ge1 : 1 ≤ N := by
    have : 0 < N := Nat.cast_pos.mp hN_pos_real
    omega
  have hQ_ge1 : 1 ≤ Q := by
    have : 0 < Q := Nat.cast_pos.mp hQ_pos_real
    omega

  let K_g : ℕ := ⌈1 / ρ⌉₊
  let S_P : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × ℕ) :=
    ((Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) (K_g : ℤ)) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) (K_g : ℤ))) ×ˢ
      (Finset.range (K_g + 1))
  let S_B : Finset (ℤ × ℕ) :=
    (Finset.Icc (-(K_g : ℤ) - 1) (K_g : ℤ)) ×ˢ (Finset.range (K_g + 1))
  have hSP_SB_card : ((S_P.card + S_B.card : ℕ) : ℝ) < 45 / ρ ^ 3 := by
    let K1 : ℝ := ((K_g + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    have hKg1_ub : K1 < 3 / ρ := by
      have h1 : (K_g : ℝ) < 1 / ρ + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
      have h2 : 2 < 2 / ρ := (lt_div_iff₀ hρ).mpr (by linarith only [hρ_sixth])
      have h3 : 1 / ρ + 2 / ρ = 3 / ρ := by ring
      have hK1 : K1 = (K_g : ℝ) + 1 := by dsimp [K1]; push_cast; rfl
      linarith only [h1, h2, h3, hK1]
    have hc1 : (Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) (K_g : ℤ)).card = K_g + 1 := by
      rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
    have hc2 : (Finset.Icc (-(K_g : ℤ) - 1) (K_g : ℤ)).card = 2 * (K_g + 1) := by
      rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
    have hSP : (S_P.card : ℝ) = K1 ^ 3 := by
      have h_nat : S_P.card = (K_g + 1) ^ 3 := by
        dsimp [S_P]
        rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, hc1, Finset.card_range]
        ring
      rw [h_nat, Nat.cast_pow]
    have hSB : (S_B.card : ℝ) = 2 * K1 ^ 2 := by
      have h_nat : S_B.card = 2 * (K_g + 1) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [S_B]
        rw [Finset.card_product, hc2, Finset.card_range]
        ring
      rw [h_nat, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow]
    have hK_nn : 0 ≤ K1 := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have h_cube : K1 ^ 3 < 27 / ρ ^ 3 := by
      calc K1 ^ 3 < (3 / ρ) ^ 3 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hKg1_ub hK_nn (by omega)
        _ = 27 / ρ ^ 3 := by ring
    have h_sq : 2 * K1 ^ 2 < 18 / ρ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : K1 ^ 2 < (3 / ρ) ^ 2 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hKg1_ub hK_nn (by omega)
      have h2 : 2 * (3 / ρ) ^ 2 = 18 / ρ ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith only [h1, h2]
    have h_ρ3_lt_ρ2 : ρ ^ 3 < ρ ^ 2 := by
      calc ρ ^ 3 = ρ ^ 2 * ρ := by ring
        _ < ρ ^ 2 * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hρ_lt_one (sq_pos_of_pos hρ)
        _ = ρ ^ 2 := mul_one _
    have h_18 : 18 / ρ ^ 2 < 18 / ρ ^ 3 :=
      div_lt_div_of_pos_left (by norm_num) (pow_pos hρ 3) h_ρ3_lt_ρ2
    have h45 : 27 / ρ ^ 3 + 18 / ρ ^ 3 = 45 / ρ ^ 3 := by ring
    rw [Nat.cast_add, hSP, hSB]
    linarith only [h_cube, h_sq, h_18, h45]

  let E_P : ((ℤ × ℤ) × ℕ) → Fin N_P → Prop := fun a i =>
    ‖y_P i - WithLp.toLp 2 ![(a.1.1 : ℝ) * ρ, (a.1.2 : ℝ) * ρ]‖ < 8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ a.2 * ρ
  let p_P : ((ℤ × ℤ) × ℕ) → ℝ := fun a =>
    2304 * B_dom ^ 4 * ρ ^ (-η) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ a.2) ^ d * ρ ^ d
  let E_B : (ℤ × ℕ) → Fin N_B → Prop := fun b j =>
    |a_sl j - (b.1 : ℝ) * ρ| < 5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ b.2 * ρ
  let p_B : (ℤ × ℕ) → ℝ := fun b =>
    10 * B_dom * ρ ^ (-η) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ b.2) ^ s * ρ ^ s
  have hp_P_bound : ∀ a : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℕ,
      0 ≤ p_P a ∧ (∑ i : Fin N_P, if E_P a i then μ i else 0) ≤ p_P a := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨by dsimp [p_P]; positivity, ?_⟩
    have h1_le_8 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ a.2 := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ a.2 := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      linarith only [this]
    have hρ_le : ρ ≤ 8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ a.2 * ρ := by
      calc ρ = 1 * ρ := (one_mul ρ).symm
        _ ≤ (8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ a.2) * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1_le_8 hρ.le
    have hb := hy_P_ball (WithLp.toLp 2 ![(a.1.1 : ℝ) * ρ, (a.1.2 : ℝ) * ρ])
      (8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ a.2 * ρ) hρ_le
    have h8d : (8 : ℝ) ^ d ≤ 64 := by
      calc (8 : ℝ) ^ d ≤ (8 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hd₂
        _ = (8 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := Real.rpow_natCast 8 2
        _ = 64 := by norm_num
    have h_split : (8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ a.2 * ρ) ^ d = 8 ^ d * ((2 : ℝ) ^ a.2) ^ d * ρ ^ d := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hρ.le, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
    rw [h_split] at hb
    calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if E_P a i then μ i else 0)
        ≤ 36 * B_dom ^ 4 * ρ ^ (-η) * (8 ^ d * ((2 : ℝ) ^ a.2) ^ d * ρ ^ d) := hb
      _ ≤ 36 * B_dom ^ 4 * ρ ^ (-η) * (64 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ a.2) ^ d * ρ ^ d) := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h8d (by positivity)
      _ = p_P a := by dsimp [p_P]; ring

  have hp_B_bound : ∀ b : ℤ × ℕ,
      0 ≤ p_B b ∧ (∑ j : Fin N_B, if E_B b j then ν j else 0) ≤ p_B b := by
    intro b
    refine ⟨by dsimp [p_B]; positivity, ?_⟩
    have h1_le_5 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ b.2 := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ b.2 := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      linarith only [this]
    have hρ_le : ρ ≤ 5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ b.2 * ρ := by
      calc ρ = 1 * ρ := (one_mul ρ).symm
        _ ≤ (5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ b.2) * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1_le_5 hρ.le
    have hb := ha_sl_ball ((b.1 : ℝ) * ρ) (5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ b.2 * ρ) hρ_le
    have h5s : (5 : ℝ) ^ s ≤ 5 := by
      calc (5 : ℝ) ^ s ≤ (5 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hs₁
        _ = 5 := Real.rpow_one 5
    have h_split : (5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ b.2 * ρ) ^ s = 5 ^ s * ((2 : ℝ) ^ b.2) ^ s * ρ ^ s := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hρ.le, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
    rw [h_split] at hb
    calc (∑ j : Fin N_B, if E_B b j then ν j else 0)
        ≤ 2 * B_dom * ρ ^ (-η) * (5 ^ s * ((2 : ℝ) ^ b.2) ^ s * ρ ^ s) := hb
      _ ≤ 2 * B_dom * ρ ^ (-η) * (5 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ b.2) ^ s * ρ ^ s) := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5s (by positivity)
      _ = p_B b := by dsimp [p_B]; ring

  let q : ℝ := ρ ^ η
  let T : ℝ := ρ ^ (-3 * η)
  have hq_pos : 0 < q := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ η
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ (-3 * η)
  have h_tail : ((S_P.card + S_B.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) < q / 2 := by
    have hk_ge : 4 + η ≤ 3 * η * (k_deg : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : (4 + η) / (3 * η) ≤ (k_deg : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      have h2 : 4 + η ≤ (k_deg : ℝ) * (3 * η) :=
        (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 3 * η)).mp h1
      linarith only [h2]
    have hTk_ge : (ρ ^ 4 * q)⁻¹ ≤ T ^ k_deg := by
      have h_lhs : (ρ ^ 4 * q)⁻¹ = ρ ^ (-(4 + η)) := by
        dsimp [q]
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast ρ 4, ← Real.rpow_add hρ, ← Real.rpow_neg hρ.le]
        congr 1
      have h_rhs : T ^ k_deg = ρ ^ (-3 * η * (k_deg : ℝ)) := by
        dsimp [T]
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast _ k_deg, ← Real.rpow_mul hρ.le]
      rw [h_lhs, h_rhs]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hk_ge])
    have h_fac_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos k_deg)
    have h_expT : (ρ ^ 4 * q)⁻¹ / (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T :=
      le_trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hTk_ge h_fac_pos.le)
        (Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp T hT_pos.le k_deg)
    have h_exp_neg : Real.exp (-T) ≤ (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) * (ρ ^ 4 * q) := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      have h_pos_lhs : 0 < (ρ ^ 4 * q)⁻¹ / (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h_inv := (inv_le_inv₀ (Real.exp_pos T) h_pos_lhs).mpr h_expT
      calc (Real.exp T)⁻¹ ≤ ((ρ ^ 4 * q)⁻¹ / (k_deg.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ := h_inv
        _ = (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) * (ρ ^ 4 * q) := by
            field_simp [h_fac_pos.ne', hρ.ne', hq_pos.ne']
    have h_prod_lt : (45 / ρ ^ 3) * ((k_deg.factorial : ℝ) * (ρ ^ 4 * q)) < q / 2 := by
      have h_alg : (45 / ρ ^ 3) * ((k_deg.factorial : ℝ) * (ρ ^ 4 * q)) =
          (45 * (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) * ρ) * q := by
        field_simp [hρ.ne']
      rw [h_alg]
      have h90_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 90 * (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h_45 : 45 * (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) * ρ < 1 / 2 := by
        have h2 := (lt_div_iff₀ h90_pos).mp hρ_lt_tail
        linarith only [h2]
      calc (45 * (k_deg.factorial : ℝ) * ρ) * q
          < (1 / 2) * q := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_45 hq_pos
        _ = q / 2 := by ring
    calc ((S_P.card + S_B.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T)
        ≤ (45 / ρ ^ 3) * ((k_deg.factorial : ℝ) * (ρ ^ 4 * q)) :=
          mul_le_mul hSP_SB_card.le h_exp_neg (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
      _ < q / 2 := h_prod_lt

  
  obtain ⟨ω_P, ω_B, h_good_P, h_good_B, h_edges⟩ :=
    h_chernoff_sample N_P N_B N Q hN_ge1 hQ_ge1 μ hμ_nn hμ_sum ν hν_nn hν_sum G
      S_P E_P p_P (fun a _ => (hp_P_bound a).2) (fun a _ => (hp_P_bound a).1)
      S_B E_B p_B (fun b _ => (hp_B_bound b).2) (fun b _ => (hp_B_bound b).1)
      q T hq_pos hT_pos.le hG_mass h_tail

  
  let y : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun u => y_P (ω_P u)
  let a_samp : Fin Q → ℝ := fun v => a_sl (ω_B v)
  let A_P : ℝ := (Real.exp 2 * 4608 * B_dom ^ 4 + 1) * ρ ^ (-3 * η)
  let A_B : ℝ := (Real.exp 2 * 20 * B_dom + 1) * ρ ^ (-3 * η)
  let B_P : ℝ := C_P0 * ρ ^ (-3 * η)
  let B_B : ℝ := C_B0 * ρ ^ (-3 * η)
  have hBP_eq : 4 * A_P = B_P := by dsimp [B_P, C_P0, A_P]; ring
  have hBB_eq : 2 * A_B = B_B := by dsimp [B_B, C_B0, A_B]; ring
  have h1_le_ρ3η : 1 ≤ ρ ^ (-3 * η) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = ρ ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ρ).symm
      _ ≤ ρ ^ (-3 * η) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hη_pos])
  have h1_le_BP : 1 ≤ B_P := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := (mul_one 1).symm
      _ ≤ C_P0 * ρ ^ (-3 * η) := mul_le_mul h1_le_CP0 h1_le_ρ3η zero_le_one hC_P0_pos.le
  have h1_le_BB : 1 ≤ B_B := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := (mul_one 1).symm
      _ ≤ C_B0 * ρ ^ (-3 * η) := mul_le_mul h1_le_CB0 h1_le_ρ3η zero_le_one hC_B0_pos.le

  have h_net_P : ∀ g₀ ∈ Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) (K_g : ℤ),
      ∀ g₁ ∈ Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) (K_g : ℤ),
      ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (K_g + 1),
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N =>
          ‖y u - WithLp.toLp 2 ![(g₀ : ℝ) * ρ, (g₁ : ℝ) * ρ]‖ < 8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ)).card : ℝ) ≤
          A_P * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ d := by
    intro g₀ hg₀ g₁ hg₁ m hm
    have ha_mem : ((g₀, g₁), m) ∈ S_P :=
      Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hg₀, hg₁⟩, hm⟩
    have h_gb := h_good_P ((g₀, g₁), m) ha_mem
    have hNd_ub : (N : ℝ) * ρ ^ d ≤ 2 := by
      have h1 : (N : ℝ) * ρ ^ d < 2 * ρ ^ (-d) * ρ ^ d :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_ub (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ d)
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hρ (-d) d, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one] at h1
      exact h1.le
    have h_ρη_le : ρ ^ (-η) ≤ ρ ^ (-3 * η) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hη_pos])
    have h1_le_2md : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ d := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) ^ d := (Real.one_rpow d).symm
        _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ d := Real.rpow_le_rpow zero_le_one (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)) hd₀.le
    calc ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N =>
            ‖y u - WithLp.toLp 2 ![(g₀ : ℝ) * ρ, (g₁ : ℝ) * ρ]‖ <
              8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ) * p_P ((g₀, g₁), m) + T := h_gb
      _ = Real.exp 2 * 2304 * B_dom ^ 4 * ((N : ℝ) * ρ ^ d) * ρ ^ (-η) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ d +
          ρ ^ (-3 * η) * 1 := by dsimp [p_P, T]; ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * 2304 * B_dom ^ 4 * 2 * ρ ^ (-3 * η) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ d +
          ρ ^ (-3 * η) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ d := by
          refine add_le_add ?_ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_le_2md hT_pos.le)
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
          exact mul_le_mul
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNd_ub (by positivity))
            h_ρη_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _) (by positivity)
      _ = A_P * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ d := by dsimp [A_P]; ring

  have h_net_B : ∀ g ∈ Finset.Icc (-(K_g : ℤ) - 1) (K_g : ℤ),
      ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (K_g + 1),
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q =>
          |a_samp v - (g : ℝ) * ρ| < 5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ)).card : ℝ) ≤
          A_B * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ s := by
    intro g hg m hm
    have hb_mem : (g, m) ∈ S_B := Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hg, hm⟩
    have h_gb := h_good_B (g, m) hb_mem
    have hQs_ub : (Q : ℝ) * ρ ^ s ≤ 2 := by
      have h1 : (Q : ℝ) * ρ ^ s < 2 * ρ ^ (-s) * ρ ^ s :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hQ_ub (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ s)
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hρ (-s) s, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one] at h1
      exact h1.le
    have h_ρη_le : ρ ^ (-η) ≤ ρ ^ (-3 * η) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hη_pos])
    have h1_le_2ms : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ s := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) ^ s := (Real.one_rpow s).symm
        _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ s := Real.rpow_le_rpow zero_le_one (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)) hs₀.le
    calc ((Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q =>
            |a_samp v - (g : ℝ) * ρ| < 5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ Real.exp 2 * (Q : ℝ) * p_B (g, m) + T := h_gb
      _ = Real.exp 2 * 10 * B_dom * ((Q : ℝ) * ρ ^ s) * ρ ^ (-η) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ s +
          ρ ^ (-3 * η) * 1 := by dsimp [p_B, T]; ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * 10 * B_dom * 2 * ρ ^ (-3 * η) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ s +
          ρ ^ (-3 * η) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ s := by
          refine add_le_add ?_ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_le_2ms hT_pos.le)
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
          exact mul_le_mul
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQs_ub (by positivity))
            h_ρη_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _) (by positivity)
      _ = A_B * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ s := by dsimp [A_B]; ring

  have hy_unit_dom : ∀ u : Fin N, (0 ≤ y u 0 ∧ y u 0 ≤ 1) ∧ (0 ≤ y u 1 ∧ y u 1 ≤ 1) := by
    intro u
    have h1 := hy_P_dom (ω_P u)
    have h0_hi := h1.1.2
    have h1_hi := h1.2.2
    exact ⟨⟨h1.1.1, by linarith only [h0_hi]⟩, ⟨h1.2.1, by linarith only [h1_hi]⟩⟩

  obtain ⟨h_occ_P_raw, h_occ_B_raw⟩ :=
    h_net_transfer N Q ρ d s A_P A_B hρ hd₀ hd₂ hs₀ hs₁
      (by dsimp [A_P]; positivity) (by dsimp [A_B]; positivity)
      y hy_unit_dom a_samp (fun v => ha_sl_dom (ω_B v)) h_net_P h_net_B
  have h_occ_P : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin N => ‖y u - z‖ < 3 * r)).card : ℝ) ≤
        B_P * (r / ρ) ^ d := by
    intro z r hr₀ hr₁
    rw [← hBP_eq]
    exact h_occ_P_raw z r hr₀ hr₁
  have h_occ_B : ∀ (a₀ r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin Q => |a_samp v - a₀| < 2 * r)).card : ℝ) ≤
        B_B * (r / ρ) ^ s := by
    intro a₀ r hr₀ hr₁
    rw [← hBB_eq]
    exact h_occ_B_raw a₀ r hr₀ hr₁

  
  obtain ⟨M₀, P, T_fam, hM₀_pos, hM₀_lb, hP_dyad, hP_rho_raw,
      hT_geom, hT_deg_shell, hT_rho_raw, h_biUnion_ub⟩ :=
    h_inc_regularize N Q hN_ge1 hQ_ge1 ρ d s q M C_cov B_P B_B
      hρ hρ_sixth hd₀ hs₀ hq_pos hM hC h1_le_BP h1_le_BB hN_lb hQ_lb
      y (fun u => hy_P_dom (ω_P u)) a_samp (fun v => ha_sl_dom (ω_B v))
      (fun u v => G (ω_P u) (ω_B v)) h_edges h_occ_P h_occ_B
      (fun v => S_tilde (ω_B v)) (fun v => hS_tilde_card (ω_B v))
      (fun u v hGuv => hS_tilde_cov (ω_P u) (ω_B v) hGuv)

  
  let L_sh : ℕ := Nat.log 2 Q + 1
  have hL_sh_ub : (L_sh : ℝ) ≤ C_log * ρ ^ (-η) := by
    let k_Q := Nat.log 2 Q
    have h2kQ_le : ((2 ^ k_Q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ρ⁻¹ := by
      have h_nat : 2 ^ k_Q ≤ Q := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)
      have h_real : ((2 ^ k_Q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (Q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_nat
      have h_ρs_le : ρ ^ (-s) ≤ ρ⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one ρ]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hs₁])
      linarith only [h_real, hQ_ub, h_ρs_le]
    have h_bern : 1 + (k_Q : ℝ) * δ_2 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ η) ^ k_Q := by
      have h1 := one_add_mul_le_pow (a := δ_2) (by linarith only [hδ_2_pos]) k_Q
      have h_add : 1 + δ_2 = (2 : ℝ) ^ η := by dsimp [δ_2]; ring
      rwa [h_add] at h1
    have h_pow_eq : ((2 : ℝ) ^ η) ^ k_Q = (((2 ^ k_Q : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ η := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast ((2 : ℝ) ^ η) k_Q, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) η (k_Q : ℝ),
          mul_comm η (k_Q : ℝ), Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) (k_Q : ℝ) η, Real.rpow_natCast]
      push_cast
      rfl
    have h2η_le2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ η ≤ 2 := by
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ η ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith only [hη_le_eighth])
        _ = 2 := Real.rpow_one 2
    have h_rhs_ub : (((2 ^ k_Q : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ η ≤ 2 * ρ ^ (-η) := by
      calc (((2 ^ k_Q : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ η
          ≤ (2 * ρ⁻¹) ^ η := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h2kQ_le hη_pos.le
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ η * (ρ⁻¹) ^ η := Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ η * ρ ^ (-η) := by rw [Real.inv_rpow hρ.le, Real.rpow_neg hρ.le]
        _ ≤ 2 * ρ ^ (-η) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2η_le2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
    have hkQ_ub : (k_Q : ℝ) ≤ (2 / δ_2) * ρ ^ (-η) := by
      have h1 : (k_Q : ℝ) * δ_2 ≤ 2 * ρ ^ (-η) := by
        linarith only [h_bern, h_pow_eq, h_rhs_ub]
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hδ_2_pos]
      exact h1
    have h1_le_ρη : 1 ≤ ρ ^ (-η) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ρ ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ρ).symm
        _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hη_pos])
    change ((k_Q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 / δ_2 + 1) * ρ ^ (-η)
    push_cast
    linarith only [hkQ_ub, h1_le_ρη]

  have hC_rho_lt : C_rho ≤ ρ ^ (-η) := by
    have h1 : ρ ^ η < (C_rho⁻¹ ^ (1 / η)) ^ η :=
      Real.rpow_lt_rpow hρ.le hρ_lt_rset hη_pos
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), one_div_mul_cancel hη_pos.ne', Real.rpow_one] at h1
    have h_inv := (inv_lt_inv₀ (inv_pos.mpr hC_rho_pos) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ η)).mpr h1
    rw [inv_inv, ← Real.rpow_neg hρ.le] at h_inv
    exact h_inv.le

  have h_const_P_le : 4 * B_P ^ 2 * (L_sh : ℝ) / q ≤ ρ ^ (-η₀) := by
    have h_alg : 4 * B_P ^ 2 * (C_log * ρ ^ (-η)) / q = C_rho * ρ ^ (-8 * η) := by
      dsimp [B_P, C_rho, q]
      have h_pow : (ρ ^ (-3 * η)) ^ 2 * ρ ^ (-η) / ρ ^ η = ρ ^ (-8 * η) := by
        rw [sq, div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.rpow_neg hρ.le,
            ← Real.rpow_add hρ, ← Real.rpow_add hρ, ← Real.rpow_add hρ]
        congr 1
        ring
      calc 4 * (C_P0 * ρ ^ (-3 * η)) ^ 2 * (C_log * ρ ^ (-η)) / ρ ^ η
          = (4 * C_P0 ^ 2 * C_log) * ((ρ ^ (-3 * η)) ^ 2 * ρ ^ (-η) / ρ ^ η) := by ring
        _ = (4 * C_P0 ^ 2 * C_log) * ρ ^ (-8 * η) := by rw [h_pow]
    calc 4 * B_P ^ 2 * (L_sh : ℝ) / q
        ≤ 4 * B_P ^ 2 * (C_log * ρ ^ (-η)) / q := by
          refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq_pos.le
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL_sh_ub (by positivity)
      _ = C_rho * ρ ^ (-8 * η) := h_alg
      _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η) * ρ ^ (-8 * η) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_rho_lt (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
      _ = ρ ^ (-9 * η) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ ρ ^ (-η₀) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [hη_pos, h12η_le_η₀])

  have h_const_B_le : 4 * B_B ^ 2 / q ≤ ρ ^ (-η₀) := by
    have hBB_le_BP : B_B ≤ B_P :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCB0_le_CP0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ.le _)
    have h1_le_Lsh : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (L_sh : ℝ) := by
      have : 1 ≤ L_sh := by dsimp [L_sh]; omega
      exact_mod_cast this
    have h_sq : B_B ^ 2 ≤ B_P ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith only [h1_le_BB]) hBB_le_BP 2
    have h_le_P : 4 * B_B ^ 2 / q ≤ 4 * B_P ^ 2 * (L_sh : ℝ) / q := by
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hq_pos.le
      calc 4 * B_B ^ 2 = (4 * B_B ^ 2) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ ≤ (4 * B_P ^ 2) * (L_sh : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul (by linarith only [h_sq]) h1_le_Lsh zero_le_one (by positivity)
    exact le_trans h_le_P h_const_P_le

  have h_rhoset_mono : ∀ {γ_exp C₁ C₂ : ℝ} {F : Finset (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))},
      C₁ ≤ C₂ → IsRhoSet ρ γ_exp C₁ F → IsRhoSet ρ γ_exp C₂ F := by
    intro γ_exp C₁ C₂ F hC12 ⟨hF_ne, hF_b⟩
    refine ⟨hF_ne, fun z r hr₀ hr₁ => le_trans (hF_b z r hr₀ hr₁) ?_⟩
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC12 (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_trans hρ.le hr₀) _)

  have hP_rhoset : IsRhoSet ρ d (ρ ^ (-η₀)) P := h_rhoset_mono h_const_P_le hP_rho_raw
  have hT_rhoset : ∀ p ∈ P, IsRhoSet ρ s (ρ ^ (-η₀)) (T_fam p) :=
    fun p hp => h_rhoset_mono h_const_B_le (hT_rho_raw p hp)

  have h_rw_est := h_rw ρ M₀ P T_fam hρ hρ_lt_ρ₀ hM₀_pos
    hP_dyad hP_rhoset hT_geom hT_deg_shell hT_rhoset

  let χ : ℝ := min 1 (min d ((d + s) / 2))
  have h_q_BB : q / (8 * B_B) = ρ ^ (4 * η) / (8 * C_B0) := by
    dsimp [q, B_B]
    have h_canc : ρ ^ (3 * η) * ρ ^ (-3 * η) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ]
      have hz : 3 * η + -3 * η = 0 := by ring
      rw [hz, Real.rpow_zero]
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    calc ρ ^ η * (8 * C_B0)
        = (ρ ^ η * 1) * (8 * C_B0) := by ring
      _ = (ρ ^ η * (ρ ^ (3 * η) * ρ ^ (-3 * η))) * (8 * C_B0) := by rw [← h_canc]
      _ = (ρ ^ η * ρ ^ (3 * η)) * (8 * (C_B0 * ρ ^ (-3 * η))) := by ring
      _ = ρ ^ (4 * η) * (8 * (C_B0 * ρ ^ (-3 * η))) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ]
          ring_nf

  have h_M_lb1 : C_end * (ρ ^ (-χ + α / 2) * ρ ^ (4 * η)) ≤ M := by
    have h_lhs_le : c_rw * ρ ^ (-χ + α / 2) * ((ρ ^ (4 * η) / (8 * C_B0)) * (Q : ℝ)) ≤
        (Q : ℝ) * (2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1) * M := by
      rw [← h_q_BB]
      exact le_trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM₀_lb (by positivity))
        (le_trans h_rw_est h_biUnion_ub)
    have h_Q_canc : (c_rw * ρ ^ (-χ + α / 2) * (ρ ^ (4 * η) / (8 * C_B0))) * (Q : ℝ) ≤
        ((2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1) * M) * (Q : ℝ) := by
      linarith only [h_lhs_le]
    have h_no_Q := le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_Q_canc hQ_pos_real
    have h2Kc_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have h_div : (c_rw * ρ ^ (-χ + α / 2) * (ρ ^ (4 * η) / (8 * C_B0))) /
        (2 * (K_c : ℝ) + 1) ≤ M := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ h2Kc_pos]
      linarith only [h_no_Q]
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) h_div
    dsimp [C_end]
    field_simp [hC_B0_pos.ne', h2Kc_pos.ne']

  have h_end_pow : ρ ^ (α / 4) ≤ C_end := by
    have hα4_pos : 0 < α / 4 := by positivity
    have h1 : ρ ^ (α / 4) < ((min 1 C_end) ^ (4 / α)) ^ (α / 4) :=
      Real.rpow_lt_rpow hρ.le hρ_lt_end hα4_pos
    have h_mul1 : (4 / α) * (α / 4) = 1 := by field_simp [hα.ne']
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), h_mul1, Real.rpow_one] at h1
    exact le_trans h1.le (min_le_right 1 C_end)

  calc ρ ^ (-χ + α)
      ≤ ρ ^ (α / 4 + (-χ + α / 2 + 4 * η)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ hρ_lt_one.le (by linarith only [h24η_le_α, hη_pos])
    _ = ρ ^ (α / 4) * (ρ ^ (-χ + α / 2) * ρ ^ (4 * η)) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_add hρ, Real.rpow_add hρ]
    _ ≤ C_end * (ρ ^ (-χ + α / 2) * ρ ^ (4 * η)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_end_pow (by positivity)
    _ ≤ M := h_M_lb1

(γ m σ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (sys : MatchedAspectProfileSystem γ m)
    (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ ≤ 1 / 4) (hσ_κ : 4 * m * σ ≤ sys.κ)
    (i u s D_pt : ℝ) (h_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hi : 0 < i) (hu : u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hs₀ : 0 < s) (hs₁ : s ≤ 1) (hS_der : HasDerivAt sys.S s u)
    (hh_pos : ∀ l, 0 < h_seq l) (hh_lim : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
    (m ≠ 1 → ∀ a_pt : Fin 4 → ℝ,
      (∀ j, 0 ≤ a_pt j ∧ a_pt j ≤ 1) →
      (∀ (R ε_err : ℝ), 1 ≤ R → 0 < ε_err →
        ∀ᶠ l in Filter.atTop, ∀ ξ : (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ,
          InDispCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 ξ → (∀ j, |ξ.1 j| ≤ R) → |ξ.2| ≤ R →
          |(sys.f_raw (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u) + h_seq l • ξ) -
            sys.f_raw (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u))) / h_seq l -
            ((∑ j : Fin 4, a_pt j * ξ.1 j) + D_pt * ξ.2)| ≤ ε_err) →
      Nonempty (CanonicalAffineBlockDistinct s σ a_pt)) ∧
    (m = 1 → ∀ a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (0 ≤ a_pt 0 ∧ a_pt 0 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 1 ∧ a_pt 1 ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 2 ∧ a_pt 2 ≤ 1) →
      (∀ (R ε_err : ℝ), 1 ≤ R → 0 < ε_err →
        let f3 := fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => sys.f_raw (![p.1 0, p.1 1, p.1 1, p.1 2], p.2)
        ∀ᶠ l in Filter.atTop, ∀ ξ : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ,
          InDispCone 3 ![0, 1, 2] (fun j k => j < k) ξ → (∀ j, |ξ.1 j| ≤ R) → |ξ.2| ≤ R →
          |(f3 (planeEmbed 3 ![0, 1, 2] (i, u) + h_seq l • ξ) -
            f3 (planeEmbed 3 ![0, 1, 2] (i, u))) / h_seq l -
            ((∑ j : Fin 3, a_pt j * ξ.1 j) + D_pt * ξ.2)| ≤ ε_err) →
      Nonempty (CanonicalAffineBlockTied s σ a_pt))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_disj_supp_card : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
      (w : Fin N → ℝ) (S_idx : Finset (Fin N)) (f : Fin N → α) (c : ℝ),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      (∀ idx, 0 ≤ w idx) → (∑ idx : Fin N, w idx = 1) → 0 < c →
      (∀ idx ∈ S_idx, c ≤ ∑ idx' : Fin N, if f idx' = f idx then w idx' else 0) →
      (((S_idx.image f).card : ℝ) ≤ c⁻¹) := by
    intro N α _ w S_idx f c
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    intro hw_nn hw_sum hc_pos h_lb
    rw [inv_eq_one_div, le_div_iff₀ hc_pos]
    calc ((S_idx.image f).card : ℝ) * c
        = ∑ _q ∈ S_idx.image f, c := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ S_idx.image f, (∑ idx' : Fin N, if f idx' = q then w idx' else 0) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q hq => ?_)
          obtain ⟨idx₀, hidx₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
          exact h_lb idx₀ hidx₀
      _ = ∑ idx' : Fin N, (∑ q ∈ S_idx.image f, if f idx' = q then w idx' else 0) :=
          Finset.sum_comm
      _ ≤ ∑ idx' : Fin N, w idx' := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun idx' _ => ?_)
          by_cases h_mem : f idx' ∈ S_idx.image f
          · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (f idx')]
            · simp
            · intro q _ hq_ne
              exact if_neg (Ne.symm hq_ne)
            · intro h_abs
              exact absurd h_mem h_abs
          · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
            · exact hw_nn idx'
            · intro q hq
              refine if_neg (fun h_eq => h_mem ?_)
              rwa [h_eq]
      _ = 1 := hw_sum
  have h_sum_comm_ite : ∀ {N_P N_Θ : ℕ} (p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ)
      (P_b : Fin N_Θ → Prop),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if P_b b then (∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, p0 idx_p b) else 0) =
      (∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if P_b b then p0 idx_p b else 0) := by
    intro N_P N_Θ p0 P_b
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · exact Finset.sum_const_zero.symm
  have h_uncond_transfer : ∀ {N_P N_Θ : ℕ} {α : Type}
      (p0 π : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ) (H_set : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop)
      (M_ret B_p0 B_out : ℝ) (f_θ : Fin N_Θ → α) (q : α),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      0 ≤ B_out → 4 * B_p0 ≤ B_out → 1 / 4 ≤ M_ret →
      (∀ idx_p b, 0 ≤ π idx_p b) →
      (∀ idx_p b, M_ret * π idx_p b ≤ p0 idx_p b) →
      (∀ idx_p b, 0 < π idx_p b → H_set idx_p b ∧ 0 < p0 idx_p b) →
      (∀ idx_p b, H_set idx_p b → 0 < p0 idx_p b → f_θ b = q →
        (∑ b' : Fin N_Θ, if f_θ b' = q then (∑ i' : Fin N_P, p0 i' b') else 0) ≤ B_p0) →
      (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if f_θ b = q then (∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, π idx_p b) else 0) ≤ B_out := by
    intro N_P N_Θ α p0 π H_set M_ret B_p0 B_out f_θ q
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    intro hBout_nn h4B hM_qtr hπ_nn hπ_le hπ_supp h_p0_bd
    set S := ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if f_θ b = q then (∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, π idx_p b) else 0
    have hS_nn : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => by
      split_ifs
      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun idx_p _ => hπ_nn idx_p b
      · exact le_rfl
    by_cases h_zero : S = 0
    · rw [h_zero]; exact hBout_nn
    · obtain ⟨b₀, _, hb₀⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h_zero
      by_cases hq_b₀ : f_θ b₀ = q
      · rw [if_pos hq_b₀] at hb₀
        obtain ⟨idx₀, _, hidx₀_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hb₀
        have hπ₀_pos : 0 < π idx₀ b₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn idx₀ b₀) (Ne.symm hidx₀_ne)
        obtain ⟨hH₀, hp0_pos⟩ := hπ_supp idx₀ b₀ hπ₀_pos
        have h_b0 := h_p0_bd idx₀ b₀ hH₀ hp0_pos hq_b₀
        have h_le_p0 : M_ret * S ≤
            ∑ b' : Fin N_Θ, if f_θ b' = q then (∑ i' : Fin N_P, p0 i' b') else 0 := by
          dsimp [S]
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun b' _ => ?_
          split_ifs
          · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              ; exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i' _ => hπ_le i' b'
          · simp
        have h_qtr_S : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * S ≤ M_ret * S :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM_qtr hS_nn
        have h_S_le_4 : S ≤ 4 * B_p0 := by linarith only [h_qtr_S, h_le_p0, h_b0]
        exact le_trans h_S_le_4 h4B
      · rw [if_neg hq_b₀] at hb₀
        exact absurd rfl hb₀
  have h_obs_b_floor : ∀ {N_P N_Θ N_obs : ℕ}
      (p0 π : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ)
      (F : Fin N_obs → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)
      (m_idx0 : Fin N_obs) (M_ret δ : ℝ) (b : Fin N_Θ),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      0 < M_ret → 0 < (∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, π idx_p b) →
      (∀ idx_p b', F m_idx0 idx_p b' = ((b'.1 : ℤ), 0, 0, 0)) →
      (∀ (m_idx : Fin N_obs) (z : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
        let r_F := ∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, ∑ b' : Fin N_Θ,
          if F m_idx idx_p b' = z then M_ret * π idx_p b' else 0
        let p0_F := ∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, ∑ b' : Fin N_Θ,
          if F m_idx idx_p b' = z then p0 idx_p b' else 0
        0 < r_F → δ * p0_F ≤ r_F ∧ r_F ≤ p0_F) →
