  let lam0 : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b
  ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
    p0 i b * Real.log (p0 i b / (mu0 i * lam0 b))

noncomputable def condCoordMultiInfo {N_P N_Θ k_grp : ℕ}
    (p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin k_grp → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let lam0 : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b
  ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
    let p_joint := ∑ i' : Fin N_P,
      if (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q g i' b = Q g i b) then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0
    let p_prod := ∏ g : Fin k_grp,
      (∑ i' : Fin N_P, if Q g i' b = Q g i b then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0)
    p0 i b * Real.log (p_joint / p_prod)

noncomputable def canonicalGroupBinsDistinct (ρ : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Fin 4 → ℤ × ℤ :=
  fun j => (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ j), 0)

noncomputable def canonicalGroupBinsTied (ρ : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Fin 3 → ℤ × ℤ
  | 0 => (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 0), 0)
  | 1 => (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 1),
          canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 2))
  | 2 => (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 3), 0)

noncomputable def canonicalGroupPrefixDistinct (ρ d : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Fin 4 → ℤ × ℤ :=
  fun j => (dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ j)), 0)

noncomputable def canonicalGroupPrefixTied (ρ d : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Fin 3 → ℤ × ℤ
  | 0 => (dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 0)), 0)
  | 1 => (dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 1)),
          dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 2)))
  | 2 => (dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 3)), 0)

structure PreCoreDistinctStage (s σ : ℝ) (a_pt : Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (M : ℕ) (η_stage L_min : ℝ) : Type where
  ρ : ℝ
  N_P : ℕ
  N_Θ : ℕ
  p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ
  P : Fin N_P → Fin 4 → ℝ
  θ : Fin N_Θ → ℝ × ℝ
  H_good : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop
  hρ_bounds : 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 1 / 2
  hL_min : L_min ≤ Real.log (ρ⁻¹)
  hp0_nn : ∀ i b, 0 ≤ p0 i b
  hp0_sum : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, p0 i b) = 1
  hP_dom : ∀ i j, |P i j| ≤ 4
  hθ_dom : ∀ b, |(θ b).1| ≤ 4 ∧ |(θ b).2| ≤ 4
  hH_mass :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    1 - η_stage ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_good i b then p0 i b else 0
  hD_pair : pairKLDivergence p0 ≤ η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹)
  hD_coord : condCoordMultiInfo p0
    (fun g i b => canonicalGroupBinsDistinct ρ (P i) (θ b) g) ≤ η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹)
  h_time_mesh : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ), H_good i b → 0 < p0 i b →
    ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M →
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      let q := dyadicRealBin ρ d (θ b).1
      (∑ i' : Fin N_P, ∑ b' : Fin N_Θ,
        if dyadicRealBin ρ d (θ b').1 = q then p0 i' b' else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (s * d - η_stage)
  h_norm_mesh : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ), H_good i b → 0 < p0 i b →
    ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M →
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      let q := dyadicRealBin ρ d (θ b).2
      (∑ i' : Fin N_P, ∑ b' : Fin N_Θ,
        if dyadicRealBin ρ d (θ b').2 = q then p0 i' b' else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (σ * d - η_stage)
  h_coord_mesh : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ), H_good i b → 0 < p0 i b →
    ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ j : Fin 4,
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      let lam0_b := ∑ i' : Fin N_P, p0 i' b
      let q_val := canonicalGroupPrefixDistinct ρ d (P i) (θ b) j
      let p_cond := ∑ i' : Fin N_P,
        if canonicalGroupPrefixDistinct ρ d (P i') (θ b) j = q_val then p0 i' b / lam0_b else 0
      ρ ^ (a_pt j * d + η_stage) ≤ p_cond ∧ p_cond ≤ ρ ^ (a_pt j * d - η_stage)

structure PreCoreTiedStage (s σ : ℝ) (a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ)

  h_param_ball_mesh : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ), H_good i b → 0 < p0 i b →

  h_param_mesh : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ), H_good i b → 0 < p0 i b →

      ρ ^ (s * (d₂ - d₁) - η_stage) *

  P : Fin N_P → Fin 4 → ℝ

  hP_dom : ∀ i j, |P i j| ≤ 4

  h_pair_dom : ∀ i b, π i b ≤ ρ ^ (-κ_err) * (∑ b', π i b') * (∑ i', π i' b)
  h_coord_prod : ∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) → ∀ k : Fin 4 → ℤ,

      if (∀ j : Fin 4, canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P i) (θ b) j) = k j)
      then π i b / lam_b else 0) ≤
    ρ ^ (-κ_err) * ∏ j : Fin 4,
      (∑ i : Fin N_P,
        if canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P i) (θ b) j) = k j
        then π i b / lam_b else 0)
  h_time_mesh : ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ q : ℤ,
    letI := Classical.propDecidable

    (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if dyadicRealBin ρ d (θ b).1 = q then (∑ i, π i b) else 0) ≤
      ρ ^ (s * d - κ_err)
  h_norm_mesh : ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ q : ℤ,
    letI := Classical.propDecidable

    (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if dyadicRealBin ρ d (θ b).2 = q then (∑ i, π i b) else 0) ≤

  h_coord_mesh : ∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) →
    ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ (j : Fin 4) (q : ℤ),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)

structure CoredTiedMeshStage (s σ : ℝ) (a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (M : ℕ) (κ_err : ℝ) : Type where
  ρ : ℝ
  g_stage : ℝ → ℝ
  N_P : ℕ
  N_Θ : ℕ
  π : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ
  P : Fin N_P → Fin 4 → ℝ
  θ : Fin N_Θ → ℝ × ℝ
  hρ_bounds : 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 1 / 2
  hg_zero : g_stage 0 = 0
  hg_lip : ∀ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, d₁ ≤ d₂ → 0 ≤ g_stage d₂ - g_stage d₁ ∧ g_stage d₂ - g_stage d₁ ≤ d₂ - d₁
  hg_le_q : g_stage 1 ≤ a_pt 1 + κ_err
  hπ_nn : ∀ i b, 0 ≤ π i b
  hπ_sum : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, π i b) = 1

  h_pair_dom : ∀ i b, π i b ≤ ρ ^ (-κ_err) * (∑ b', π i b') * (∑ i', π i' b)
  h_coord_prod : ∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) → ∀ (k_X : ℤ) (k_U : ℤ × ℤ) (k_Z : ℤ),
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let lam_b := ∑ i, π i b
    let bX := fun i => canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P i) (θ b) 0)
    let bU := fun i => (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P i) (θ b) 1),
                        canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P i) (θ b) 2))
    let bZ := fun i => canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P i) (θ b) 3)
    (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X ∧ bU i = k_U ∧ bZ i = k_Z then π i b / lam_b else 0) ≤
    ρ ^ (-κ_err) *
      (∑ i, if bX i = k_X then π i b / lam_b else 0) *
      (∑ i, if bU i = k_U then π i b / lam_b else 0) *
      (∑ i, if bZ i = k_Z then π i b / lam_b else 0)
  h_time_mesh : ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ q : ℤ,
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
    (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if dyadicRealBin ρ d (θ b).1 = q then (∑ i, π i b) else 0) ≤
      ρ ^ (s * d - κ_err)
  h_norm_mesh : ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ q : ℤ,
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
    (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if dyadicRealBin ρ d (θ b).2 = q then (∑ i, π i b) else 0) ≤
      ρ ^ (σ * d - κ_err)
  h_param_ball_mesh : ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ q : ℤ × ℤ,
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
    (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if paramTreeBin ρ d (θ b) = q then (∑ i, π i b) else 0) ≤
      ρ ^ (s * d - κ_err)
  h_param_mesh : ∀ (r₁ r₂ : ℕ), 1 ≤ r₁ → r₁ < r₂ → r₂ ≤ M → ∀ q₁ q₂ : ℤ × ℤ,
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let d₁ := (r₁ : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
    let d₂ := (r₂ : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
    (∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
      if paramTreeBin ρ d₁ (θ b) = q₁ ∧ paramTreeBin ρ d₂ (θ b) = q₂
      then (∑ i, π i b) else 0) ≤
    ρ ^ (s * (d₂ - d₁) - κ_err) *
      (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if paramTreeBin ρ d₁ (θ b) = q₁ then (∑ i, π i b) else 0)
  h_param_cap_floor : ∀ (r₁ r₂ : ℕ), 1 ≤ r₁ → r₁ < r₂ → r₂ ≤ M → ∀ b₀ : Fin N_Θ,
    0 < (∑ i, π i b₀) →
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d₁ := (r₁ : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      let d₂ := (r₂ : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      let q₁ := paramTreeBin ρ d₁ (θ b₀)
      let q₂ := paramTreeBin ρ d₂ (θ b₀)
      ρ ^ (2 * (d₂ - d₁) + κ_err) *
        (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if paramTreeBin ρ d₁ (θ b) = q₁ then (∑ i, π i b) else 0) ≤
      (∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
        if paramTreeBin ρ d₁ (θ b) = q₁ ∧ paramTreeBin ρ d₂ (θ b) = q₂
        then (∑ i, π i b) else 0)
  h_coord_mesh : ∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) →
    ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ (g : Fin 3) (q : ℤ × ℤ),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      let lam_b := ∑ i, π i b
      (∑ i : Fin N_P,
        if canonicalGroupPrefixTied ρ d (P i) (θ b) g = q
        then π i b / lam_b else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (a_pt g * d - κ_err)
  h_Z_supp_mesh : ∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) →
    ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M →
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      (((Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N_P => 0 < π i b)).image
        (fun i => dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (P i) (θ b) 3)))).card : ℝ) ≤
        ρ ^ (-a_pt 2 * d - κ_err)
  h_Y_mesh : ∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) →
    ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ q : ℤ,
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      let lam_b := ∑ i, π i b
      (∑ i : Fin N_P,
        if dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (P i) (θ b) 1)) = q
        then π i b / lam_b else 0) ≤ ρ ^ (g_stage d - κ_err)
  h_Y_supp_mesh : ∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) →
    ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M →
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
      (((Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N_P => 0 < π i b)).image

noncomputable def pairKLDivergence {N_P N_Θ : ℕ}
    (p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let mu0 : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, p0 i b
  let lam0 : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b
  ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
    p0 i b * Real.log (p0 i b / (mu0 i * lam0 b))

noncomputable def condCoordMultiInfo {N_P N_Θ k_grp : ℕ}
    (p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin k_grp → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let lam0 : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b
  ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
    let p_joint := ∑ i' : Fin N_P,
      if (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q g i' b = Q g i b) then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0
    let p_prod := ∏ g : Fin k_grp,
      (∑ i' : Fin N_P, if Q g i' b = Q g i b then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0)
    p0 i b * Real.log (p_joint / p_prod)

noncomputable def canonicalGroupBinsDistinct (ρ : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Fin 4 → ℤ × ℤ :=

  | 1 => (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 1),
          canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 2))
  | 2 => (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 3), 0)

noncomputable def canonicalGroupPrefixDistinct (ρ d : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :

noncomputable def canonicalGroupPrefixTied (ρ d : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) :

  | 0 => (dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 0)), 0)
  | 1 => (dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 1)),
          dyadicRealBin ρ d (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 2)))

subgoal_signatures.name: affine_block_kl_core

    (hk : 1 ≤ k_grp)
    (p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin k_grp → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ)

    (H_set : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop)
    (ζ v M_low : ℝ)
    (hp0_nn : ∀ i b, 0 ≤ p0 i b)
    (hp0_sum : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, p0 i b) = 1)
    (hζ_nn : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hH_mass :
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      1 - ζ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_set i b then p0 i b else 0)
    (hv_pos : 0 < v)
    (hM_low_pos : 0 < M_low)
    (hM_low_le : M_low ≤ 1 - ζ -
      (pairKLDivergence p0 + condCoordMultiInfo p0 Q + 1) / v) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let N_tot : ℕ := N_obs + k_grp + 2
    let δ : ℝ := M_low / (2 * (N_tot : ℝ))
    ∃ (M_ret : ℝ) (π : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ),
      M_low / 2 ≤ M_ret ∧ M_ret ≤ 1 ∧
      (∀ i b, 0 ≤ π i b) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, π i b = 1) ∧
      (∀ i b, 0 < π i b → H_set i b ∧ 0 < p0 i b) ∧
      (∀ i b, M_ret * π i b ≤ p0 i b) ∧
      (∀ i b, π i b ≤ Real.exp v * M_ret * δ ^ (-2 : ℤ) *
        (∑ b', π i b') * (∑ i', π i' b)) ∧
      (∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) →
        ∀ q : Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ,
          let lam_b := ∑ i, π i b
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if (∀ g, Q g i b = q g) then π i b / lam_b else 0) ≤
            Real.exp v * δ ^ (-(k_grp : ℤ)) *
              ∏ g : Fin k_grp,
                (∑ i : Fin N_P, if Q g i b = q g then π i b / lam_b else 0)) ∧
      (∀ (m_idx : Fin N_obs) (z : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
        let r_F := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if F m_idx i b = z then M_ret * π i b else 0
        let p0_F := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if F m_idx i b = z then p0 i b else 0

    (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hη : 0 < η_err) :

    ∃ (t₀ c_ret : ℝ),

                  (i, i + u', i + m * u', i + (1 + m) * u', u')

  have h_ite_eq : ∀ {N : ℕ} (P Q : Fin N → Prop) {d₁ : DecidablePred P} {d₂ : DecidablePred Q}
      (w : Fin N → ℝ), (∀ i, P i ↔ Q i) →
      (∑ i : Fin N, @ite ℝ (P i) (d₁ i) (w i) 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N, @ite ℝ (Q i) (d₂ i) (w i) 0 := by
    intro N P Q d₁ d₂ w hiff
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases hP : P i
    · rw [@if_pos _ (d₁ i) hP, @if_pos _ (d₂ i) ((hiff i).mp hP)]
    · rw [@if_neg _ (d₁ i) hP, @if_neg _ (d₂ i) (fun hQ => hP ((hiff i).mpr hQ))]
  have h_factor2 : ∀ (S₁ S₂ : Finset ℤ) (C : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : ℤ → ℝ),
      (∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, ∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, C * f₁ k₁ * f₂ k₂) =
        C * (∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, f₁ k₁) * (∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, f₂ k₂) := by
    intro S₁ S₂ C f₁ f₂
    calc ∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, ∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, (C * f₁ k₁) * f₂ k₂
        = ∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, (C * f₁ k₁) * (∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, f₂ k₂) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k₁ _ => (Finset.mul_sum S₂ f₂ (C * f₁ k₁)).symm)
      _ = (∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, C * f₁ k₁) * (∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, f₂ k₂) :=
          (Finset.sum_mul S₁ (fun k₁ => C * f₁ k₁) _).symm
      _ = C * (∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, f₁ k₁) * (∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, f₂ k₂) := by
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have h_sum_ind : ∀ {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → ℝ) (g : Fin N → ℤ) (S : Finset ℤ),

        ∑ i : Fin N, if g i ∈ S then w i else 0 := by
    intro N w g S
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases hm : g i ∈ S
    · rw [if_pos hm, Finset.sum_eq_single (g i)]
      · exact if_pos rfl
      · intro k _ hk; exact if_neg hk.symm
      · intro habs; exact absurd hm habs
    · rw [if_neg hm]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k hk => if_neg ?_)
      intro heq; rw [heq] at hm; exact hm hk
  have h_sum_ind2 : ∀ {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → ℝ) (g₁ g₂ : Fin N → ℤ) (S₁ S₂ : Finset ℤ),

        (∑ i : Fin N, if g₁ i = k₁ ∧ g₂ i = k₂ then w i else 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N, if g₁ i ∈ S₁ ∧ g₂ i ∈ S₂ then w i else 0 := by
    intro N w g₁ g₂ S₁ S₂
    have h_inner : ∀ k₁ : ℤ,

      intro k₁
      have h_eq : ∀ k₂ : ℤ,
          (∑ i : Fin N, if g₁ i = k₁ ∧ g₂ i = k₂ then w i else 0) =
            ∑ i : Fin N, if g₂ i = k₂ then (if g₁ i = k₁ then w i else 0) else 0 := by
        intro k₂
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : g₁ i = k₁ <;> by_cases h2 : g₂ i = k₂ <;> simp [h1, h2]
      simp_rw [h_eq]
      rw [h_sum_ind]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      by_cases h1 : g₁ i = k₁ <;> by_cases h2 : g₂ i ∈ S₂ <;> simp [h1, h2]
    simp_rw [h_inner]
    rw [h_sum_ind]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases h1 : g₁ i ∈ S₁ <;> by_cases h2 : g₂ i ∈ S₂ <;> simp [h1, h2]
  have h_sum_im : ∀ {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → ℝ) (g : Fin N → ℤ),

    intro N w g

    exact if_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem g (Finset.mem_univ i))

  have h_pigeonhole_slice : ∀ {N_P : ℕ} (μ₀ : Fin N_P → ℝ) (f_sl g_sl : Fin N_P → ℤ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ μ₀ i) → (∑ i, μ₀ i = 1) →
      ∃ kf kg : ℤ,
        0 < (∑ i, if f_sl i = kf ∧ g_sl i = kg then μ₀ i else 0) ∧
        (∑ i, if f_sl i = kf then μ₀ i else 0) * (∑ i, if g_sl i = kg then μ₀ i else 0) ≤
          (∑ i, if f_sl i = kf ∧ g_sl i = kg then μ₀ i else 0) := by
    intro N_P μ₀ f_sl g_sl hμ₀_nn hμ₀_sum
    let p_f := fun kf : ℤ => ∑ i, if f_sl i = kf then μ₀ i else 0
    let p_g := fun kg : ℤ => ∑ i, if g_sl i = kg then μ₀ i else 0
    let p_fg := fun kf kg : ℤ => ∑ i, if f_sl i = kf ∧ g_sl i = kg then μ₀ i else 0

    let S_g := Finset.univ.image g_sl

    obtain ⟨i₀, _, hi₀_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h_sum_ne
    have hi₀_pos : 0 < μ₀ i₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hμ₀_nn i₀) (Ne.symm hi₀_ne)
    let kf₀ := f_sl i₀
    let kg₀ := g_sl i₀
    have hkf₀_mem : kf₀ ∈ S_f := Finset.mem_image_of_mem f_sl (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    have hkg₀_mem : kg₀ ∈ S_g := Finset.mem_image_of_mem g_sl (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    have hpfg₀_pos : 0 < p_fg kf₀ kg₀ := by
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hi₀_pos ?_
      have h_self : μ₀ i₀ = (if f_sl i₀ = kf₀ ∧ g_sl i₀ = kg₀ then μ₀ i₀ else 0) :=
        (if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩).symm
      rw [h_self]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun i => if f_sl i = kf₀ ∧ g_sl i = kg₀ then μ₀ i else 0)
        (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    by_contra h_none
    push_neg at h_none
    have hpf_nn : ∀ kf, 0 ≤ p_f kf := fun kf =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    have hpg_nn : ∀ kg, 0 ≤ p_g kg := fun kg =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    have hpfg_nn : ∀ kf kg, 0 ≤ p_fg kf kg := fun kf kg =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    have hpfg_le : ∀ kf kg, p_fg kf kg ≤ p_f kf * p_g kg := by
      intro kf kg
      by_cases hpos : 0 < p_fg kf kg
      · exact (h_none kf kg hpos).le
      · have h0 : p_fg kf kg = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hpfg_nn kf kg)
        rw [h0]
        exact mul_nonneg (hpf_nn kf) (hpg_nn kg)
    have h_lt_kf0 : ∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_fg kf₀ kg < ∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_f kf₀ * p_g kg :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun kg _ => hpfg_le kf₀ kg) ⟨kg₀, hkg₀_mem, h_none kf₀ kg₀ hpfg₀_pos⟩
    have h_lt_tot : ∑ kf ∈ S_f, ∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_fg kf kg <
        ∑ kf ∈ S_f, ∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_f kf * p_g kg :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum
        (fun kf _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun kg _ => hpfg_le kf kg))
        ⟨kf₀, hkf₀_mem, h_lt_kf0⟩
    have h_lhs : ∑ kf ∈ S_f, ∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_fg kf kg = 1 := by
      dsimp [p_fg, S_f, S_g]
      rw [h_sum_im2, hμ₀_sum]
    have h_rhs : ∑ kf ∈ S_f, ∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_f kf * p_g kg = 1 := by
      have h1 : ∑ kf ∈ S_f, ∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_f kf * p_g kg =
          (∑ kf ∈ S_f, p_f kf) * (∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_g kg) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun kf _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [h1]
      have hf1 : ∑ kf ∈ S_f, p_f kf = 1 := by dsimp [p_f, S_f]; rw [h_sum_im, hμ₀_sum]
      have hg1 : ∑ kg ∈ S_g, p_g kg = 1 := by dsimp [p_g, S_g]; rw [h_sum_im, hμ₀_sum]
      rw [hf1, hg1, mul_one]
    linarith

      ρ ^ (-min 1 (min d ((d + s_rate) / 2)) + α) ≤ M_wt

       let μ₀ := fun i => π i b₀ / lam_b0

         (∑ i, if q_x i = kx ∧ q_y i = ky ∧ f_sl i = kf ∧ g_sl i = kg then μ₀ i else 0) ≤

      (let lam_b0 := ∑ i, π i b₀
       let μ₀ := fun i => π i b₀ / lam_b0
       ∀ (z₀ r : ℝ), ρ_eff ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
         (∑ i, if |mid_y (q_y i) - z₀| < r then μ₀ i else 0) ≤ K_y * r ^ d_y) →
      (∀ (a₀ r : ℝ), ρ_eff ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →

        ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ, (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ M ∧

      ρ_eff ^ (-min 1 (min (d_x + d_y) ((d_x + d_y + s_rate) / 2)) + α) ≤ M := by
    intro d_x d_y s_rate α η ρ₁ ρ_eff M K K_c K_x K_y N_P N_Θ π b₀ q_x q_y f_sl g_sl mid_x mid_y a_B
      h_wt_app hρ_eff hρ_lt hM hK hKc hKx hKy hπ_nn hπ_sum hlam0 h_pair hK_prod hK_inv
      hmid_dom ha_dom h_prod4 h_bx h_by h_ba h_cov_sl
    let lam : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i, π i b
    let lam_b0 : ℝ := lam b₀
    let μ₀ : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => π i b₀ / lam_b0
    have hlam0' : 0 < lam_b0 := hlam0
    have hμ₀_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ₀ i := fun i => div_nonneg (hπ_nn i b₀) hlam0'.le
    have hμ₀_sum : ∑ i, μ₀ i = 1 := by

    obtain ⟨kf_s, kg_s, hpfg_pos, h_sl_corr⟩ := h_pigeonhole_slice μ₀ f_sl g_sl hμ₀_nn hμ₀_sum
    let p_fg_s : ℝ := ∑ i, if f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s then μ₀ i else 0
    have hpfg_pos' : 0 < p_fg_s := hpfg_pos
    have h_corr_div : ((∑ i, if f_sl i = kf_s then μ₀ i else 0) *
        (∑ i, if g_sl i = kg_s then μ₀ i else 0)) / p_fg_s ≤ 1 :=
      (div_le_one hpfg_pos').mpr h_sl_corr
    let μ_sl : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i =>
      if f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s then μ₀ i / p_fg_s else 0
    let x_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun i =>
      WithLp.toLp 2 ![mid_x (q_x i), mid_y (q_y i)]
    let G_sl : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop := fun i b₁ =>
      f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s ∧ 0 < π i b₀ ∧ 0 < π i b₁
    have hμ_sl_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ_sl i := by
      intro i; dsimp [μ_sl]; split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hμ₀_nn i) hpfg_pos'.le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hμ_sl_sum : ∑ i, μ_sl i = 1 := by
      have h_eq : ∑ i, μ_sl i = p_fg_s / p_fg_s := by
        dsimp [μ_sl, p_fg_s]
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> simp

    have hx_P_dom : ∀ i, ‖x_P i‖ ≤ 250 :=
      fun i => h_xP_dom _ _ (hmid_dom i).1 (hmid_dom i).2
    
    have h_sl_cell : ∀ kx ky : ℤ,
        (∑ i, if q_x i = kx ∧ q_y i = ky then μ_sl i else 0) ≤
          K_c * (∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0) *
            (∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0) := by
      intro kx ky
      have h_lhs_eq : (∑ i, if q_x i = kx ∧ q_y i = ky then μ_sl i else 0) =
          (∑ i, if q_x i = kx ∧ q_y i = ky ∧ f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s then μ₀ i else 0) /
            p_fg_s := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        dsimp [μ_sl]
        by_cases hx : q_x i = kx <;> by_cases hy : q_y i = ky <;>
          by_cases hf : f_sl i = kf_s <;> by_cases hg : g_sl i = kg_s <;>
          simp [hx, hy, hf, hg]
      rw [h_lhs_eq]
      have h4 := h_prod4 kx ky kf_s kg_s
      have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h4 hpfg_pos'.le
      have hpx_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
      have hpy_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
      calc (∑ i, if q_x i = kx ∧ q_y i = ky ∧ f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s then μ₀ i else 0) /
            p_fg_s
          ≤ (K_c * (∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0) *
              (∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0) *
              (∑ i, if f_sl i = kf_s then μ₀ i else 0) *
              (∑ i, if g_sl i = kg_s then μ₀ i else 0)) / p_fg_s := h_div
        _ = (K_c * (∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0) *
              (∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0)) *
              (((∑ i, if f_sl i = kf_s then μ₀ i else 0) *
                (∑ i, if g_sl i = kg_s then μ₀ i else 0)) / p_fg_s) := by ring
        _ ≤ K_c * (∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0) *
              (∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0) :=
            mul_le_of_le_one_right (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hKc hpx_nn) hpy_nn) h_corr_div
    have h_ball_2d : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ_eff ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ_sl i else 0) ≤
          ρ_eff ^ (-η) * r ^ (d_x + d_y) := by
      intro z r hr0 hr1
      have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_eff hr0
      let B_x := (Finset.univ.image q_x).filter (fun kx => |mid_x kx - z 0| < r)
      let B_y := (Finset.univ.image q_y).filter (fun ky => |mid_y ky - z 1| < r)
      have h_mem_B : ∀ i : Fin N_P, ‖x_P i - z‖ < r → q_x i ∈ B_x ∧ q_y i ∈ B_y := by
        intro i h_lt
        have hsq : ‖x_P i - z‖ ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
          (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mpr h_lt
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2] at hsq
        have hc0 : (x_P i - z) 0 = mid_x (q_x i) - z 0 := rfl
        have hc1 : (x_P i - z) 1 = mid_y (q_y i) - z 1 := rfl
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hc0, hc1, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at hsq
        have hx_sq : |mid_x (q_x i) - z 0| ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
          rw [sq_abs]; linarith [sq_nonneg (mid_y (q_y i) - z 1)]
        have hy_sq : |mid_y (q_y i) - z 1| ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
          rw [sq_abs]; linarith [sq_nonneg (mid_x (q_x i) - z 0)]
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem q_x (Finset.mem_univ i),
            (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mp hx_sq⟩,
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem q_y (Finset.mem_univ i),
            (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mp hy_sq⟩⟩
      have h_le_rect : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ_sl i else 0) ≤
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, if q_x i ∈ B_x ∧ q_y i ∈ B_y then μ_sl i else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
        split_ifs with h1 h2
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact absurd (h_mem_B i h1) h2
        · exact hμ_sl_nn i
        · exact le_rfl
      have h_bx_sum : ∑ kx ∈ B_x, (∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0) ≤ K_x * r ^ d_x := by
        rw [h_sum_ind]
        have h_eq : (∑ i, if q_x i ∈ B_x then μ₀ i else 0) =
            ∑ i, if |mid_x (q_x i) - z 0| < r then μ₀ i else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          have hm : q_x i ∈ B_x ↔ |mid_x (q_x i) - z 0| < r := by
            simp [B_x, Finset.mem_image_of_mem q_x (Finset.mem_univ i)]
          by_cases h : |mid_x (q_x i) - z 0| < r <;> simp [hm, h]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_bx (z 0) r hr0 hr1
      have h_by_sum : ∑ ky ∈ B_y, (∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0) ≤ K_y * r ^ d_y := by
        rw [h_sum_ind]
        have h_eq : (∑ i, if q_y i ∈ B_y then μ₀ i else 0) =
            ∑ i, if |mid_y (q_y i) - z 1| < r then μ₀ i else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          have hm : q_y i ∈ B_y ↔ |mid_y (q_y i) - z 1| < r := by
            simp [B_y, Finset.mem_image_of_mem q_y (Finset.mem_univ i)]
          by_cases h : |mid_y (q_y i) - z 1| < r <;> simp [hm, h]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_by (z 1) r hr0 hr1
      have h_sx_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ kx ∈ B_x, (∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by
          split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl))
      have h_sy_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ ky ∈ B_y, (∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by

      calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z‖ < r then μ_sl i else 0)

        _ ≤ ∑ kx ∈ B_x, ∑ ky ∈ B_y,

            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun kx _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ky _ => h_sl_cell kx ky))
        _ = K_c * (∑ kx ∈ B_x, (∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0)) *
              (∑ ky ∈ B_y, (∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0)) :=
            h_factor2 B_x B_y K_c
              (fun kx => ∑ i, if q_x i = kx then μ₀ i else 0)
              (fun ky => ∑ i, if q_y i = ky then μ₀ i else 0)
        _ ≤ K_c * (K_x * r ^ d_x) * (K_y * r ^ d_y) := by
            have hm1 := mul_le_mul h_bx_sum h_by_sum h_sy_nn (mul_nonneg hKx (Real.rpow_nonneg hr_pos.le _))
            have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm1 hKc
            linarith
        _ = (K_c * K_x * K_y) * (r ^ d_x * r ^ d_y) := by ring
        _ = (K_c * K_x * K_y) * r ^ (d_x + d_y) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hr_pos]
        _ ≤ ρ_eff ^ (-η) * r ^ (d_x + d_y) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK_prod (Real.rpow_nonneg hr_pos.le _)
    
    have h_inc_mass : ρ_eff ^ η ≤
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, if G_sl i b₁ then μ_sl i * lam b₁ else 0 := by
      let μ_P : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ∑ b, π i b
      let ν_sl : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b₁ =>
        if f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s ∧ 0 < μ_P i then

      have hμ_P_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ_P i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hπ_nn i b)
      have h_pi_le_muP : ∀ i b, π i b ≤ μ_P i := fun i b =>
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun b' _ => hπ_nn i b') (Finset.mem_univ b)
      have hν_sum_i : ∀ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, ν_sl i b₁ = μ_sl i := by
        intro i
        dsimp [ν_sl, μ_sl, μ₀]
        by_cases hsl : f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s
        · by_cases hpos : 0 < μ_P i
          · have hc : f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s ∧ 0 < μ_P i := ⟨hsl.1, hsl.2, hpos⟩
            rw [if_pos hsl]
            have h_pull : (∑ x : Fin N_Θ, if f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s ∧ 0 < μ_P i

                (π i b₀ / (p_fg_s * lam_b0 * μ_P i)) * ∑ x : Fin N_Θ, π i x := by
              calc (∑ x : Fin N_Θ, if f_sl i = kf_s ∧ g_sl i = kg_s ∧ 0 < μ_P i
                    then (π i b₀ * π i x) / (p_fg_s * lam_b0 * μ_P i) else 0)

                    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
                    rw [if_pos hc]
                    ring
                _ = (π i b₀ / (p_fg_s * lam_b0 * μ_P i)) * ∑ x : Fin N_Θ, π i x :=
                    (Finset.mul_sum Finset.univ (fun x => π i x) _).symm
            rw [h_pull]
            change (π i b₀ / (p_fg_s * lam_b0 * μ_P i)) * μ_P i = (π i b₀ / lam_b0) / p_fg_s
            field_simp [hpfg_pos'.ne', hlam0'.ne', hpos.ne']
          · have h0_mu : μ_P i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hμ_P_nn i)

          simp [hc, hsl]
      have hν_pt : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b₁ : Fin N_Θ),

        intro i b₁
        by_cases hG : G_sl i b₁
        · rw [if_pos hG]
          obtain ⟨hf, hg, hpi0, hpi1⟩ := hG
          have hpos_mu : 0 < μ_P i := lt_of_lt_of_le hpi0 (h_pi_le_muP i b₀)
          have hν_eq : ν_sl i b₁ = (π i b₀ / (p_fg_s * lam_b0)) * (π i b₁ / μ_P i) := by
            dsimp [ν_sl]
            rw [if_pos ⟨hf, hg, hpos_mu⟩]
            field_simp [hpfg_pos'.ne', hlam0'.ne', hpos_mu.ne']
          have hμ_eq : μ_sl i = π i b₀ / (p_fg_s * lam_b0) := by
            dsimp [μ_sl, μ₀]
            rw [if_pos ⟨hf, hg⟩, div_div, mul_comm lam_b0 p_fg_s]
          have h_dom1 : π i b₁ / μ_P i ≤ K * lam b₁ := by
            rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos_mu]
            have hp := h_pair i b₁
            dsimp [μ_P, lam] at hp ⊢
            linarith
          rw [hν_eq, ← hμ_eq]
          calc μ_sl i * (π i b₁ / μ_P i)
              ≤ μ_sl i * (K * lam b₁) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_dom1 (hμ_sl_nn i)
            _ = K * (μ_sl i * lam b₁) := by ring
        · rw [if_neg hG]
          dsimp [ν_sl]
          split_ifs with h_cond
          · obtain ⟨hf, hg, hpos_mu⟩ := h_cond
            by_cases hpi0 : 0 < π i b₀
            · by_cases hpi1 : 0 < π i b₁
              · exact absurd ⟨hf, hg, hpi0, hpi1⟩ hG
              · have h0 : π i b₁ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpi1) (hπ_nn i b₁)
                simp [h0]
            · have h0 : π i b₀ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpi0) (hπ_nn i b₀)
              simp [h0]
          · exact le_rfl
      have h_one_le : 1 ≤ K * ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
          if G_sl i b₁ then μ_sl i * lam b₁ else 0 := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = ∑ i : Fin N_P, μ_sl i := hμ_sl_sum.symm
          _ = ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, ν_sl i b₁ :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hν_sum_i i).symm)
          _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
                if G_sl i b₁ then K * (μ_sl i * lam b₁) else 0 :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₁ _ => hν_pt i b₁))
          _ = K * ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
                if G_sl i b₁ then μ_sl i * lam b₁ else 0 := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => ?_)
              split_ifs <;> ring
      have hK_inv_le : K⁻¹ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
          if G_sl i b₁ then μ_sl i * lam b₁ else 0 := by
        rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_iff₀ hK]
        linarith
      exact le_trans hK_inv hK_inv_le
    
    have h_inc_mass' : ρ_eff ^ η ≤
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
          @ite ℝ (G_sl i b₁) (Classical.propDecidable (G_sl i b₁)) (μ_sl i * lam b₁) 0 := by
      refine le_trans h_inc_mass (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)))
      exact h_ite_eq (fun b₁ => G_sl i b₁) (fun b₁ => G_sl i b₁)
        (fun b₁ => μ_sl i * lam b₁) (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
    refine h_wt_app ρ_eff M N_P N_Θ μ_sl x_P lam a_B G_sl
      hρ_eff hρ_lt hM hμ_sl_nn hμ_sl_sum hx_P_dom h_ball_2d hlam_nn hlam_sum ha_dom h_ba
      h_inc_mass' ?_
    intro b₁
    by_cases hlam1 : 0 < lam b₁
    · obtain ⟨S_cov, hS_card, hS_mem⟩ := h_cov_sl kf_s kg_s b₁ hlam1
      refine ⟨S_cov, hS_card, fun i hG => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hf, hg, hpi0, hpi1⟩ := hG
      exact hS_mem i hpi0 hpi1 hf hg
    · refine ⟨∅, by simp [hM.le], fun i hG => ?_⟩
      have h_le : π i b₁ ≤ lam b₁ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hπ_nn i' b₁) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le hG.2.2.2 h_le) hlam1

  
  have h_exists_b0 : ∀ {N_P N_Θ : ℕ} (π : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ),
      (∀ i b, 0 ≤ π i b) → (∑ i, ∑ b, π i b = 1) → ∃ b₀ : Fin N_Θ, 0 < ∑ i, π i b₀ := by
    intro N_P N_Θ π hnn hsum

      have hρ_l1 : ρ_l < 1 := by linarith

      have h3κ_le : 3 * κ_l ≤ d * min η α := by linarith
      have h3κ_η : 3 * κ_l ≤ d * η := le_trans h3κ_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left η α) hd0.le)
      have hρ_eff0 : 0 < ρ_eff := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_l0 d
      have hρ_eff_lt : ρ_eff < ρ₁ := by
        calc ρ_l ^ d < (ρ₁ ^ (1 / d)) ^ d := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hρ_l0.le hl_ρ hd0
          _ = ρ₁ ^ ((1 / d) * d) := (Real.rpow_mul hρ₁.le (1 / d) d).symm
          _ = ρ₁ ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel hd0.ne']
          _ = ρ₁ := Real.rpow_one ρ₁
      have hρ_l_le_eff : ρ_l ≤ ρ_eff := by
        calc ρ_l = ρ_l ^ (1 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one ρ_l).symm
          _ ≤ ρ_l ^ d := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_l0 hρ_l1.le hd1
      obtain ⟨b₀, hlam0⟩ := h_exists_b0 (blk.π_seq l) (blk.hπ_nn l) (blk.hπ_sum l)
      let K := ρ_l ^ (-κ_l)
      let M := ρ_l ^ (-blk.g_Y d - δ_err)
      have hK_pos : 0 < K := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_l0 _
      have hM_pos : 0 < M := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_l0 _
      have hK_prod : K * K * K ≤ ρ_eff ^ (-η) := by
        calc ρ_l ^ (-κ_l) * ρ_l ^ (-κ_l) * ρ_l ^ (-κ_l)
            = ρ_l ^ (-κ_l + -κ_l) * ρ_l ^ (-κ_l) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ_l0]
          _ = ρ_l ^ ((-κ_l + -κ_l) + -κ_l) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ_l0]
          _ = ρ_l ^ (-3 * κ_l) := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ρ_l ^ (d * (-η)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_l0 hρ_l1.le (by linarith)
          _ = (ρ_l ^ d) ^ (-η) := Real.rpow_mul hρ_l0.le d (-η)
      have hK_inv : ρ_eff ^ η ≤ K⁻¹ := by
        calc (ρ_l ^ d) ^ η = ρ_l ^ (d * η) := (Real.rpow_mul hρ_l0.le d η).symm
          _ ≤ ρ_l ^ κ_l := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_l0 hρ_l1.le (by linarith)
          _ = (ρ_l ^ (-κ_l))⁻¹ := by rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ_l0.le, inv_inv]
      have hK_le_eff : K ≤ ρ_eff ^ (-η) := by
        calc ρ_l ^ (-κ_l) ≤ ρ_l ^ (d * (-η)) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_l0 hρ_l1.le (by linarith)
          _ = (ρ_l ^ d) ^ (-η) := Real.rpow_mul hρ_l0.le d (-η)
      let bX := fun i => canonicalGridBin ρ_l (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) 0)
      let bY := fun i => canonicalGridBin ρ_l (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) 1)
      let mid : ℤ → ℝ := fun k => ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ_l
      let a_B : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → ℝ := fun b₁ => -((blk.θ_seq l b₁).1 - (blk.θ_seq l b₀).1)
      have h_res := h_two_rep_stage d_x g_star s α η ρ₁ ρ_eff M K K K K
        (blk.N_P l) (blk.N_Θ l) (blk.π_seq l) b₀ bX bY (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0)
        mid mid a_B h_wt_app hρ_eff0 hρ_eff_lt hM_pos hK_pos hK_pos.le hK_pos.le hK_pos.le
        (blk.hπ_nn l) (blk.hπ_sum l) hlam0 (blk.h_pair_dom l) hK_prod hK_inv
        (fun i => ⟨h_mid_dom ρ_l _ _ 0 hρ_l0 hρ_l_half (blk.hP_dom l i)
            (blk.hθ_dom l b₀).1 (blk.hθ_dom l b₀).2,
          h_mid_dom ρ_l _ _ 1 hρ_l0 hρ_l_half (blk.hP_dom l i)
            (blk.hθ_dom l b₀).1 (blk.hθ_dom l b₀).2⟩)
        (fun b => by
          dsimp [a_B]; have h1 := (blk.hθ_dom l b).1; have h0 := (blk.hθ_dom l b₀).1
          rw [abs_le] at h1 h0 ⊢; constructor <;> linarith)
        (h_prod_XY l b₀ hlam0)
        (fun z₀ r hr0 hr1 => blk.h_X_ball l b₀ z₀ r hlam0 (le_trans hρ_l_le_eff hr0) hr1)
        (fun z₀ r hr0 hr1 => le_trans (blk.h_Y_ball l b₀ z₀ r hlam0 (le_trans hρ_l_le_eff hr0) hr1)
          (h_Y_rpow l r (le_trans hρ_l_le_eff hr0) hr1))
        (fun a₀ r hr0 hr1 => by
          have h_eq : (∑ b, if |a_B b - a₀| < r then (∑ i, blk.π_seq l i b) else 0) =
              ∑ b, if |(blk.θ_seq l b).1 - ((blk.θ_seq l b₀).1 - a₀)| < r
              then (∑ i, blk.π_seq l i b) else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
            have ha : a_B b - a₀ = -((blk.θ_seq l b).1 - ((blk.θ_seq l b₀).1 - a₀)) := by
              dsimp [a_B]; ring
            rw [ha, abs_neg]
          rw [h_eq]
          calc (∑ b, if |(blk.θ_seq l b).1 - ((blk.θ_seq l b₀).1 - a₀)| < r
                then (∑ i, blk.π_seq l i b) else 0)
              ≤ K * r ^ s := blk.h_time_ball l _ r (le_trans hρ_l_le_eff hr0) hr1
            _ ≤ ρ_eff ^ (-η) * r ^ s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK_le_eff
                (Real.rpow_nonneg (lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_eff0 hr0).le _))
        (fun _ _ b₁ hlam1 => by
          obtain ⟨S_cov, hS_card, hS_mem⟩ := hL₀ l hl_L₀ b₁ hlam1
          refine ⟨S_cov, hS_card, fun i _ hpi1 _ _ => ?_⟩
          obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀_mem, hc₀_est⟩ := hS_mem i hpi1
          refine ⟨c₀, hc₀_mem, ?_⟩
          have hs_u := h_shear_u1 ρ_l (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) (blk.θ_seq l b₁)
            hρ_l0 (blk.hθ_dom l b₀).1 (blk.hθ_dom l b₁).1
          let A_lhs := canonicalGridMid ρ_l (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) 1) -
            a_B b₁ * canonicalGridMid ρ_l (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) 0)
          let A_mid := canonicalGridMid ρ_l (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₁) 1)
          change |A_lhs - c₀| ≤ 50 * ρ_eff
          change |A_lhs - A_mid| ≤ 5 * ρ_l at hs_u
          change |A_mid - c₀| ≤ ρ_eff at hc₀_est
          have h_id : A_lhs - c₀ = (A_lhs - A_mid) + (A_mid - c₀) := by ring
          rw [h_id]
          linarith [abs_add_le (A_lhs - A_mid) (A_mid - c₀)])
      have h_lhs_eq : ρ_eff ^ (-χ + α) = ρ_l ^ (d * (-χ + α)) :=
        (Real.rpow_mul hρ_l0.le d (-χ + α)).symm
      rw [h_lhs_eq] at h_res
      have hexp := h_rpow_exp_le ρ_l (d * (-χ + α)) (-blk.g_Y d - d * α) hρ_l0 hρ_l1 h_res
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hd0]
      linarith
    have h_chi_le_gstar : χ ≤ g_star := by
      refine le_csInf hS_ne ?_
      rintro y ⟨d, hd_mem, rfl⟩
      exact h_chi_le_ratio d hd_mem
    have h_min_le : min 1 (d_x + s) ≤ g_star :=
      h_min_rate_deduce d_x g_star s hx_pos h_chi_le_gstar
    have hs_le_min : s ≤ min 1 (d_x + s) := le_min hs₁ (by linarith)
    exact le_trans hs_le_min (le_trans h_min_le (le_trans hg_star_le_g1 blk.hgY_le_q))

  exact ⟨h_distinct, h_tied⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(s σ : ℝ) (a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hs₀ : 0 < s) (hs₁ : s ≤ 1) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ ≤ 1)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a_pt 0 ∧ a_pt 0 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 1 ∧ a_pt 1 ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 2 ∧ a_pt 2 ≤ 1)
    (h_proj : WeightedTaggedProjectionBound)
    (h_uproj : UnitVectorTaggedProjectionBound)
    (blk : CanonicalAffineBlockTied s σ a_pt)
    (h_nostrip : NoStripConcentration blk) :
    (0 < a_pt 0 ∧ a_pt 2 < 1 → a_pt 0 + s ≤ a_pt 2) ∧
    (a_pt 2 < 1 → a_pt 1 ≤ 2 - s)

signature.statement:
(s σ : ℝ) (a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hs₀ : 0 < s) (hs₁ : s ≤ 1) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ ≤ 1)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a_pt 0 ∧ a_pt 0 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 1 ∧ a_pt 1 ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 2 ∧ a_pt 2 ≤ 1)
    (h_proj : WeightedTaggedProjectionBound)
    (h_uproj : UnitVectorTaggedProjectionBound)
    (blk : CanonicalAffineBlockTied s σ a_pt)
    (h_nostrip : NoStripConcentration blk) :
    (0 < a_pt 0 ∧ a_pt 2 < 1 → a_pt 0 + s ≤ a_pt 2) ∧
    (a_pt 2 < 1 → a_pt 1 ≤ 2 - s)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨prof⟩ := exists_three_replica_homog_profile s σ a_pt blk
  have hF := nostrip_pinned_direction_bootstrap s σ a_pt hs₀ hs₁ h_uproj blk h_nostrip prof
  have h_norm2 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ^ 2 = (v 0) ^ 2 + (v 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have h_flip_inv : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), flip2D (flip2D v) = v := by
    intro v; ext idx; fin_cases idx <;> simp [flip2D]
  have h_flip_sub : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), flip2D (u - v) = flip2D u - flip2D v := by
    intro u v; ext idx; fin_cases idx <;> simp [flip2D]
  have h_flip_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖flip2D v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
    rw [h_norm2, h_norm2]
    simp [flip2D]
    ring
  have h_dirVec_unit : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖dirVec v‖ = 1 := by
    intro v
    unfold dirVec
    split_ifs with hv
    · refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one).mp ?_
      rw [h_norm2]
      simp
    · have hv_pos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hv_pos, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv_pos.ne']
  have h_rot_sub : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      chartRot c (u - v) = chartRot c u - chartRot c v := by
    intro c u v; fin_cases c <;> { ext idx; fin_cases idx <;> simp [chartRot] <;> ring }
  have h_rot_norm : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖chartRot c v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro c v
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
    rw [h_norm2, h_norm2]
    fin_cases c <;> simp [chartRot] <;> ring
  have h_chart_cap : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 0) ^ 2 + (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      0 < chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1 ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro e he
    have he_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_norm2 e
      rw [he, one_pow] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have h_ab : (e 0 + e 1) ^ 2 + (e 0 - e 1) ^ 2 = 2 := by linarith [he_sq]
    unfold s1Chart
    split_ifs with h0 h1 h2
    · change (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∧ 0 < e 1 ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ (e 1) ^ 2
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h0.1.le h0.2
      exact ⟨he_sq, by linarith [h0.1, h0.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 1 e 0 = e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 1 e 1 = e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 1 - e 0) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h1.1 (by linarith [h1.2])
      exact ⟨by linarith [he_sq], by linarith [h1.1, h1.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 2 e 0 = -e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 2 e 1 = -e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h2.1.le h2.2
      exact ⟨by nlinarith [he_sq], by linarith [h2.1, h2.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 3 e 0 = -e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 3 e 1 = -e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have ha_le : e 0 + e 1 ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra ha_gt
        have ha_pos : 0 < e 0 + e 1 := lt_of_not_ge ha_gt
        have hb_pos : 0 < e 0 - e 1 := by
          by_contra hb_le
          exact h0 ⟨ha_pos, le_of_not_gt hb_le⟩
        exact h1 ⟨ha_pos.le, hb_pos⟩
      have hb_lt : e 0 - e 1 < 0 := by
        by_contra hb_ge
        have hb_nn : 0 ≤ e 0 - e 1 := le_of_not_gt hb_ge
        have ha_eq : e 0 + e 1 = 0 := by
          by_contra ha_ne
          exact h2 ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne ha_le ha_ne, hb_nn⟩
        have hb_eq : e 0 - e 1 = 0 := by
          by_contra hb_ne
          exact h1 ⟨by linarith [ha_eq], lt_of_le_of_ne hb_nn (Ne.symm hb_ne)⟩
        nlinarith [h_ab, ha_eq, hb_eq]
      have hp : (-(e 0 + e 1)) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith [ha_le]) hb_lt.le
      exact ⟨by nlinarith [he_sq], by linarith [ha_le, hb_lt], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
  have h_s1Coord_lip : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → s1Chart u = c → s1Chart v = c →
      |s1Coord u - s1Coord v| ≤ 2 * ‖u - v‖ := by
    intro c u v hu hv hcu hcv
    let u' := chartRot c u
    let v' := chartRot c v
    have hu_cap := h_chart_cap u hu
    have hv_cap := h_chart_cap v hv
    rw [hcu] at hu_cap
    rw [hcv] at hv_cap
    obtain ⟨_, hu1_pos, hu1_sq⟩ := hu_cap
    obtain ⟨hv_sq, hv1_pos, hv1_sq⟩ := hv_cap
    have h_coord_u : s1Coord u = u' 0 / u' 1 := by simp [s1Coord, hcu, u']
    have h_coord_v : s1Coord v = v' 0 / v' 1 := by simp [s1Coord, hcv, v']
    let num := (u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 1 - v' 0 * (u' 1 - v' 1)
    have h_diff_eq : s1Coord u - s1Coord v = num / (u' 1 * v' 1) := by
      rw [h_coord_u, h_coord_v]
      dsimp [u', v', num]
      field_simp [hu1_pos.ne', hv1_pos.ne']
      ring
    have h_uv_sq : ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = (u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2 := by
      calc ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = ‖chartRot c (u - v)‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h_rot_norm]
        _ = ‖u' - v'‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h_rot_sub]
        _ = (u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2 := h_norm2 (u' - v')
    have h_num_sq : num ^ 2 ≤ ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_lag : ((u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2) * ((v' 0) ^ 2 + (v' 1) ^ 2) - num ^ 2 =
          ((u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 0 + (u' 1 - v' 1) * v' 1) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [num]; ring
      have h_nn := sq_nonneg ((u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 0 + (u' 1 - v' 1) * v' 1)
      rw [hv_sq, mul_one, ← h_uv_sq] at h_lag
      linarith
    have h_num_abs : |num| ≤ ‖u - v‖ :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp (by rwa [sq_abs])
    have h_den_pos : 0 < u' 1 * v' 1 := mul_pos hu1_pos hv1_pos
    have h_den_ge : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ u' 1 * v' 1 := by
      refine (sq_le_sq₀ (by norm_num) h_den_pos.le).mp ?_
      calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) := by norm_num
        _ ≤ (u' 1) ^ 2 * (v' 1) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul hu1_sq hv1_sq (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (u' 1 * v' 1) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h_diff_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos h_den_pos, div_le_iff₀ h_den_pos]
    calc |num| ≤ ‖u - v‖ := h_num_abs
      _ = (2 * ‖u - v‖) * (1 / 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * ‖u - v‖) * (u' 1 * v' 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_den_ge (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (norm_nonneg _))
  have h_dyadic_step : ∀ (ρ L : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ L →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ρ L) * ρ ^ L ≤ 1 ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dyadicRealStep ρ L ≤ ρ ^ L := by
    intro ρ L hρ0 _ _
    let m : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ρ L
    have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    have hm_le : (m : ℝ) ≤ L * (Real.log (ρ⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := Int.floor_le _
    have hm_lt : L * (Real.log (ρ⁻¹) / Real.log 2) < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hm1 : (m : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ L * (-Real.log ρ) := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le hlog2.le
      rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlog2.ne', Real.log_inv] at h
      exact h
    have hm2 : L * (-Real.log ρ) < ((m : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 := by
      have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm_lt hlog2
      rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlog2.ne', Real.log_inv] at h
      exact h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ ^ L ≤ 1
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ ^ L
          = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m : ℝ) * ρ ^ L := by rw [Real.rpow_intCast]
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (m : ℝ)) * Real.exp (Real.log ρ * L) := by
            rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos zero_lt_two, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ0]
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (m : ℝ) + Real.log ρ * L) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp 0 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = 1 := Real.exp_zero
    · have h_step_le : dyadicRealStep ρ L ≤ 2 * ρ ^ L := by
        change (2 : ℝ) ^ (-m) ≤ 2 * ρ ^ L
        calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-m)
            = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((-m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_intCast]
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * ((-m : ℤ) : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_def_of_pos zero_lt_two _
          _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log 2 + Real.log ρ * L) := by
              refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
              push_cast
              linarith
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2) * Real.exp (Real.log ρ * L) := Real.exp_add _ _
          _ = 2 * ρ ^ L := by rw [Real.exp_log zero_lt_two, ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ0]
      linarith
  have h_dirBin_ball_cover : ∀ (ρ d_k : ℝ) (e₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ d_k → ‖e₁‖ = 1 →
      ∃ S_bins : Finset (Fin 4 × ℤ), (S_bins.card : ℝ) ≤ 36 ∧
        ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖u - e₁‖ < ρ ^ d_k →
          dirBin ρ d_k u ∈ S_bins := by
    intro ρ d_k e₁ hρ0 hρ1 hd_k _
    let P_wit : Fin 4 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Prop :=
      fun c v => ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ ‖v - e₁‖ < ρ ^ d_k ∧ s1Chart v = c
    let k_wit : Fin 4 → ℤ := fun c =>
      if hc : ∃ v, P_wit c v then dyadicRealBin ρ d_k (s1Coord (Classical.choose hc)) else 0
    let S_bins : Finset (Fin 4 × ℤ) :=
      Finset.univ.biUnion (fun c : Fin 4 =>
        (Finset.Icc (k_wit c - 4) (k_wit c + 4)).image (fun k => (c, k)))
    refine ⟨S_bins, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_card : S_bins.card ≤ 36 := by

by
  classical
  have h_core : FiniteMarginalCoreBound := finite_simultaneous_marginal_core
  
  have h_ex_t : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ (κ_t : ℝ) (L₀ : ℕ), 0 < κ_t →
        ∃ l : ℕ, L₀ ≤ l ∧ ∃ (e_n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c₀ : ℝ),

    apply h_strip
    unfold NoStripConcentration

    intro t ht₀ ht₁
    by_contra h_no_κ
    apply h_all
    refine ⟨t, ht₀, ht₁, fun κ_t L₀ hκ_t => ?_⟩
    by_contra h_no_l
    apply h_no_κ
    refine ⟨κ_t, L₀, hκ_t, fun l hl e c₀ he => ?_⟩
    by_contra h_gt
    apply h_no_l
    refine ⟨l, hl, e, c₀, he, lt_of_not_ge (fun hle => h_gt ?_)⟩
    refine le_trans ?_ hle
    refine le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    split_ifs <;> rfl

  have h_ρ_rpow_zero : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun l => (blk.ρ_seq l) ^ p) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun l => (blk.ρ_seq l) ^ p) Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : ℝ) ^ p)) :=

  have h_stage : ∀ (η_target ρ₁ : ℝ), 0 < η_target → 0 < ρ₁ →
      ∃ (l : ℕ) (e_n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c₀ : ℝ)
        (π_tilde : Fin (blk.N_P l) → Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → ℝ),
        let ρ_l := blk.ρ_seq l
        let ρ_tilde := ρ_l ^ t
        let κ_l := blk.κ_seq l

        ρ_l ^ (-κ_l) = ρ_tilde ^ (-(κ_l / t)) ∧
        ‖e_n‖ = 1 ∧
        (∀ i b, 0 ≤ π_tilde i b) ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (blk.N_P l), ∑ b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), π_tilde i b = 1) ∧

    intro η_target ρ₁ hη_t hρ₁

    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp

    let ρ_l := blk.ρ_seq l

    let κ_l := blk.κ_seq l

    have hρ_half : ρ_l < 1 / 2 := (blk.hρ_bounds l).2

    have hρ_le_tilde : ρ_l ≤ ρ_tilde := by

    have hρ_t_lt_one : ρ_tilde < 1 := by

        _ = 1 := Real.rpow_zero ρ_l
    have h_rpow_div_t : ∀ p : ℝ, ρ_tilde ^ (p / t) = ρ_l ^ p := by

      dsimp [ρ_tilde]
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul hρ₀.le, mul_div_cancel₀ p ht₀.ne']
    have h_rpow_mul_t : ∀ p : ℝ, ρ_tilde ^ p = ρ_l ^ (t * p) := by

    have hκ_le_η8 : κ_l / t ≤ η_target / 8 := le_trans hκ_div_le (min_le_left _ _)

    have hκ_le_σ4 : κ_l / t ≤ σ * η_d / 4 :=

    let d₀ := perp2D e_n

    let inn_fn : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → ℝ :=

    let τ_fn : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → ℝ :=

      have h2_sq : ((blk.θ_seq l b).2) ^ 2 ≤ 16 := by

    let in_S : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → Prop := fun b => |inn_fn b - c₀| ≤ ρ_tilde

    have hm_S_pos : 0 < m_S := lt_trans (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_t_pos _) hm_S_lb
    
    have hρ_t_le_ηd : ρ_tilde ≤ ρ_tilde ^ η_d := by

      have h_rhs_le : ρ_l ^ (-κ_l) * (7 * ρ_tilde ^ η_d) ^ s ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (δ_strip / t) := by
        rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 7) h_pos_ηd.le,

          _ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (δ_strip / t) :=

    have hd₀_1_lb : ρ_tilde ^ η_d ≤ |d₀ 1| := by

      push_neg at h_lt

  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  ∀ (M r : ℕ)

    (F : Fin r → Fin 3 → Fin M → ℤ × ℤ)

      obtain ⟨u, hu_def⟩ : ∃ u : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, u m =
          max 0 (min M (((m : ℝ) + 1) * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..((m : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹, G (xy.1, xy.2 + τ))) :=
        ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      simp_rw [← hu_def]
      have hu_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ u m := fun m => by rw [hu_def]; exact le_max_left _ _
      have hu_le : ∀ m : ℕ, u m ≤ M := fun m => by rw [hu_def]; exact max_le hM (min_le_left _ _)
      have h_bdd : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop u :=
        Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨M, hu_le⟩
      have h_cobdd : Filter.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop u :=
        Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_eventually_le Filter.atTop
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu_nn)
      exact ⟨Filter.le_limsup_of_frequently_le
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu_nn).frequently h_bdd,
        Filter.limsup_le_of_le h_cobdd (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu_le)⟩

  
  have h_stage2 : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
      ∃ (B : ℝ) (E : Set ℝ),
        0 ≤ B ∧
        E ⊆ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi ∧
        (∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi → y ∈ E) ∧
        (∀ (N : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ), Monotone u → (∀ i ≤ N, u i ∈ E) →
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, |F (x, u (i + 1)) - F (x, u i)|) ≤ B) := by
    have h_ex_σ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ,
        (∫ x in x_lo..x_hi, ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, |F_seq m (x, y) - F (x, y)|) ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hF_seq_l1 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨N₀, ?_⟩
      have h1 := hN₀ N₀ le_rfl
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at h1
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h1.le
    choose σ hσ using h_ex_σ
    let μ_x := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc x_lo x_hi)
    let μ_y := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc y_lo y_hi)
    obtain ⟨d, hd_def⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
        ∀ (k : ℕ) (xy : ℝ × ℝ), d k xy = |F_seq (σ k) xy - F xy| :=
      ⟨fun k xy => |F_seq (σ k) xy - F xy|, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    have hd_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (d k) := by
      intro k
      have h_eq : d k = fun xy => |F_seq (σ k) xy - F xy| := funext (hd_def k)
      rw [h_eq]
      exact continuous_abs.measurable.comp ((hF_seq_reg (σ k)).1.continuous.measurable.sub hF_meas)
    have hd_nn : ∀ (k : ℕ) (xy : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ d k xy := by
      intro k xy; rw [hd_def]; exact abs_nonneg _
    have hd_le : ∀ (k : ℕ) (xy : ℝ × ℝ), d k xy ≤ M := by
      intro k xy
      rw [hd_def]
      have h1 := (hF_seq_reg (σ k)).2 xy
      have h2 := hF_bds xy
      exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_l1_k : ∀ k : ℕ,
        (∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (d k (x, y)) ∂μ_y) ∂μ_x) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by
      intro k
      let I_y : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, d k (x, y)
      have h_inner_eq : ∀ x : ℝ,
          ENNReal.ofReal (I_y x) = ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (d k (x, y)) ∂μ_y := by
        intro x
        have h_int_y : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => d k (x, y)) μ_y :=
          h_int_Ioc_of_bdd y_lo y_hi M (fun y => d k (x, y))
            ((hd_meas k).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
            (fun y => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (hd_nn k (x, y))]; exact hd_le k (x, y))
        dsimp only [I_y]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy.le]
        exact MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal h_int_y
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => hd_nn k (x, y)))
      have hIy_eq_mu : I_y = fun x => ∫ y, d k (x, y) ∂μ_y := by
        ext x
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy.le
      have hIy_meas : Measurable I_y := by
        rw [hIy_eq_mu]
        exact ((hd_meas k).stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right').measurable
      have hIy_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ I_y x := fun x =>
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hy.le (fun y _ => hd_nn k (x, y))
      have hIy_abs : ∀ x : ℝ, |I_y x| ≤ M * |y_hi - y_lo| := by
        intro x
        have h_norm := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const_ae
          (a := y_lo) (b := y_hi) (C := M) (f := fun y => d k (x, y))
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y _ => by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hd_nn k (x, y))]
            exact hd_le k (x, y)))
        simpa [I_y, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_norm
      have hIy_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable I_y μ_x :=
        h_int_Ioc_of_bdd x_lo x_hi (M * |y_hi - y_lo|) I_y hIy_meas hIy_abs
      have h_outer_eq : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in x_lo..x_hi, I_y x) =
          ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (I_y x) ∂μ_x := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx.le]
        exact MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hIy_int
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hIy_nn)
      simp_rw [← h_inner_eq, ← h_outer_eq]
      have h_eq_int : (∫ x in x_lo..x_hi, I_y x) =
          ∫ x in x_lo..x_hi, ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, |F_seq (σ k) (x, y) - F (x, y)| := by
        dsimp only [I_y]
        simp_rw [hd_def]
      rw [h_eq_int]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hσ k)
    have h_tsum_lt_top :
        (∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ y, (∑' k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (d k (x, y))) ∂μ_y) ∂μ_x) < ⊤ := by
      have h_in : ∀ x : ℝ,
          (∫⁻ y, (∑' k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (d k (x, y))) ∂μ_y) =
            ∑' k : ℕ, ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (d k (x, y)) ∂μ_y := fun x =>
        MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum (fun k =>
          ((hd_meas k).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable)
      simp_rw [h_in]
      have h_out_meas : ∀ k : ℕ,
          AEMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (d k (x, y)) ∂μ_y) μ_x := fun k =>
        ((hd_meas k).ennreal_ofReal.lintegral_prod_right').aemeasurable
      rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum h_out_meas]
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum h_l1_k) ?_
      have h_geom : ∀ k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) = ((2 : ENNReal)⁻¹) ^ k := by
        intro k
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num), one_div, ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by norm_num),
          ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]
      simp_rw [h_geom, ENNReal.tsum_geometric]
      rw [ENNReal.inv_lt_top]
      norm_num
    have h_meas_tsum : Measurable (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (d k xy)) :=
      Measurable.tsum (fun k => (hd_meas k).ennreal_ofReal)
    have h_ae_x_tsum : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
        ∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => F_seq (σ k) (x, y)) Filter.atTop (nhds (F (x, y))) := by
      have hx_ae_mu := MeasureTheory.ae_lt_top
        h_meas_tsum.lintegral_prod_right' h_tsum_lt_top.ne
      rw [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc] at hx_ae_mu
      filter_upwards [hx_ae_mu] with x hx_fin hx_mem
      have hy_lt := hx_fin (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioc_self hx_mem)
      have hy_ae_mu := MeasureTheory.ae_lt_top
        (h_meas_tsum.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)) hy_lt.ne
      rw [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc] at hy_ae_mu
      filter_upwards [hy_ae_mu] with y hy_fin hy_mem
      have h_ne_top := (hy_fin (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioc_self hy_mem)).ne
      have h_enn_zero := ENNReal.tendsto_atTop_zero_of_tsum_ne_top h_ne_top
      have h_real_zero := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp h_enn_zero
      simp only [Function.comp_def, ENNReal.toReal_zero] at h_real_zero
      have h_abs_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => |F_seq (σ k) (x, y) - F (x, y)|)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        refine h_real_zero.congr (fun k => ?_)
        dsimp only [id_eq]
        rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hd_nn k (x, y)), hd_def]
      rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_abs_zero
    
    have h_pderiv_cont : ∀ m : ℕ,
        Continuous (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun y' => F_seq m (xy.1, y')) xy.2) := by
      intro m
      have hG : ContDiff ℝ 1 (F_seq m) := (hF_seq_reg m).1
      have h_eq : (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (fun y' => F_seq m (xy.1, y')) xy.2) =
          fun xy : ℝ × ℝ => fderiv ℝ (F_seq m) xy (0, 1) := by
        ext ⟨x, y⟩
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F_seq m) (x, y) :=
          (hG.differentiable one_ne_zero).differentiableAt
        exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt y
          ((hasDerivAt_const y x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id y))).deriv
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (hG.continuous_fderiv_apply one_ne_zero).comp
        (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    obtain ⟨v_var, hv_def⟩ : ∃ v_var : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ,
        ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), v_var k x =
          ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, |deriv (fun y' => F_seq (σ k) (x, y')) y| :=
      ⟨fun k x => ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, |deriv (fun y' => F_seq (σ k) (x, y')) y|, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    have hv_cont : ∀ k : ℕ, Continuous (v_var k) := by
      intro k
      have h_eq : v_var k = fun x =>
          ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, |deriv (fun y' => F_seq (σ k) (x, y')) y| := funext (hv_def k)
      rw [h_eq]
      have h_un : Continuous
          (Function.uncurry (fun x y : ℝ => |deriv (fun y' => F_seq (σ k) (x, y')) y|)) :=
        (continuous_abs.comp (h_pderiv_cont (σ k))).comp
          (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd)
      exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' h_un y_lo y_hi
    have hv_nn : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ v_var k x := by
      intro k x; rw [hv_def]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hy.le (fun y _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hv_lintegral : ∀ k : ℕ,
        (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (v_var k x) ∂μ_x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C_var := by
      intro k
      have hv_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (v_var k) μ_x := (hv_cont k).integrableOn_Ioc
      rw [← MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hv_int
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hv_nn k)),
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx.le]
      simp_rw [hv_def k]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hF_seq_var (σ k))
    have h_fatou :
        (∫⁻ x, Filter.liminf (fun k : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal (v_var k x)) Filter.atTop ∂μ_x) < ⊤ := by
      have h1 := MeasureTheory.lintegral_liminf_le (μ := μ_x)
        (f := fun k x => ENNReal.ofReal (v_var k x)) (u := Filter.atTop)
        (fun k => (hv_cont k).measurable.ennreal_ofReal)
      have h2 : Filter.liminf (fun k : ℕ => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (v_var k x) ∂μ_x)
          Filter.atTop ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C_var :=
        Filter.liminf_le_of_frequently_le' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hv_lintegral).frequently
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans h1 h2) ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    have h_ae_x_var : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
        Filter.liminf (fun k : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal (v_var k x)) Filter.atTop < ⊤ := by
      have hx_mu := MeasureTheory.ae_lt_top
        (Measurable.liminf (fun k => (hv_cont k).measurable.ennreal_ofReal))
        h_fatou.ne
      rw [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc] at hx_mu
      filter_upwards [hx_mu] with x hx_fin hx_mem
      exact hx_fin (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioc_self hx_mem)
    filter_upwards [h_ae_x_tsum, h_ae_x_var] with x hx_conv hx_var hx_mem
    let V_enn : ENNReal := Filter.liminf (fun k : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal (v_var k x)) Filter.atTop
    have hV_lt : V_enn < ⊤ := hx_var hx_mem
    let E : Set ℝ := { y : ℝ | y ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => F_seq (σ k) (x, y)) Filter.atTop (nhds (F (x, y))) }
    refine ⟨V_enn.toReal, E, ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, fun y hyE => hyE.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [hx_conv hx_mem] with y hy_c hy_ioo
      exact ⟨hy_ioo, hy_c hy_ioo⟩
    · intro N u hu_mono hu_E
      cases N with
      | zero => simp [ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
      | succ M_n =>
        have h_chain_k : ∀ k : ℕ,
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M_n + 1),
              |F_seq (σ k) (x, u (i + 1)) - F_seq (σ k) (x, u i)|) ≤ v_var k x := by
          intro k
          let g_k : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => F_seq (σ k) (x, y)
          have hgk_diff : ∀ y : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ g_k y := by
            intro y
            have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F_seq (σ k)) (x, y) :=
              ((hF_seq_reg (σ k)).1.differentiable one_ne_zero).differentiableAt
            exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt y
              ((hasDerivAt_const y x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id y))).differentiableAt
          have hgk_der_cont : Continuous (deriv g_k) :=
            (h_pderiv_cont (σ k)).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
          have hgk_abs_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => |deriv g_k y|) :=
            continuous_abs.comp hgk_der_cont
          have h_step : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (M_n + 1),
              |g_k (u (i + 1)) - g_k (u i)| ≤ ∫ y in u i..u (i + 1), |deriv g_k y| := by
            intro i _
            have hui : u i ≤ u (i + 1) := hu_mono (Nat.le_succ i)
            have h_ftc : ∫ y in u i..u (i + 1), deriv g_k y = g_k (u (i + 1)) - g_k (u i) :=
              intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun y _ => hgk_diff y)
                (hgk_der_cont.intervalIntegrable (u i) (u (i + 1)))
            rw [← h_ftc]
            simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
              (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm
                (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (f := deriv g_k) hui)
          have h_sum_le : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M_n + 1), |g_k (u (i + 1)) - g_k (u i)|) ≤
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M_n + 1), ∫ y in u i..u (i + 1), |deriv g_k y| :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_step
          have h_adj : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M_n + 1), ∫ y in u i..u (i + 1), |deriv g_k y|) =
              ∫ y in u 0..u (M_n + 1), |deriv g_k y| :=
            intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals
              (fun i _ => hgk_abs_cont.intervalIntegrable (u i) (u (i + 1)))
          have hu0_E : u 0 ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi := (hu_E 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1
          have huN_E : u (M_n + 1) ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi := (hu_E (M_n + 1) le_rfl).1
          have hu0N : u 0 ≤ u (M_n + 1) := hu_mono (Nat.zero_le _)
          have h_sub_ioc : Set.Ioc (u 0) (u (M_n + 1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc y_lo y_hi :=
            fun y hy_mem => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hu0_E.1 hy_mem.1.le, le_trans hy_mem.2 huN_E.2.le⟩
          have h_mono_set : (∫ y in u 0..u (M_n + 1), |deriv g_k y|) ≤ v_var k x := by
            rw [hv_def k]
            dsimp only [g_k]
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hu0N, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy.le]
            exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set
              hgk_abs_cont.integrableOn_Ioc
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => abs_nonneg _))
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_sub_ioc)
          exact le_trans h_sum_le (h_adj.trans_le h_mono_set)
        have h_sum_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun k : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M_n + 1),
              |F_seq (σ k) (x, u (i + 1)) - F_seq (σ k) (x, u i)|)
            Filter.atTop
            (nhds (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M_n + 1), |F (x, u (i + 1)) - F (x, u i)|)) := by
          refine tendsto_finsetSum (Finset.range (M_n + 1)) (fun i hi => ?_)
          have hi_lt : i < M_n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
          have hi1 : i + 1 ≤ M_n + 1 := hi_lt
          have hi0 : i ≤ M_n + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt hi_lt
          exact ((hu_E (i + 1) hi1).2.sub (hu_E i hi0).2).abs
        have h_enn_tendsto := ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal h_sum_tendsto
        have h_liminf_le : ENNReal.ofReal
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M_n + 1), |F (x, u (i + 1)) - F (x, u i)|) ≤ V_enn := by
          rw [← h_enn_tendsto.liminf_eq]
          exact Filter.liminf_le_liminf
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun k => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (h_chain_k k)))
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hV_lt.ne).mp h_liminf_le

  
  have h_stage3 : ∀ (a_lo a_hi B : ℝ), a_lo < a_hi → 0 ≤ B →
      ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Measurable g → (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ g y ∧ g y ≤ M) →
      ∀ (E : Set ℝ), E ⊆ Set.Ioo a_lo a_hi →
        (∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo a_lo a_hi → y ∈ E) →
        (∀ (N : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ), Monotone u → (∀ i ≤ N, u i ∈ E) →
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, |g (u (i + 1)) - g (u i)|) ≤ B) →
        (∀ y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo a_lo a_hi,
          Filter.Tendsto (rightSteklov g) (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Ioi y₀))
            (nhds (rightSteklov g y₀))) ∧
        (∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo a_lo a_hi → g y = rightSteklov g y) := by
    intro a_lo a_hi B ha hB g hg_meas hg_bds E hE_sub hE_ae hE_var
    
    have hE_dense : ∀ p q : ℝ, a_lo ≤ p → p < q → q ≤ a_hi → ∃ u ∈ E, u ∈ Set.Ioo p q := by
      intro p q hp hpq hq
      by_contra h_empty
      have h_sub_null : Set.Ioo p q ⊆ { y : ℝ | ¬ (y ∈ Set.Ioo a_lo a_hi → y ∈ E) } := by
        intro y hy_pq h_imp
        have hy_ab : y ∈ Set.Ioo a_lo a_hi :=
          ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hp hy_pq.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hy_pq.2 hq⟩
        exact h_empty ⟨y, h_imp hy_ab, hy_pq⟩
      have h_zero : MeasureTheory.volume { y : ℝ | ¬ (y ∈ Set.Ioo a_lo a_hi → y ∈ E) } = 0 :=
        MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp hE_ae
      have h_ioo_zero := MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null h_sub_null h_zero
      rw [Real.volume_Ioo, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] at h_ioo_zero
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨W, hW_mono, hW_lip_E⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ → ℝ,
        Monotone W ∧
        (∀ u₁ ∈ E, ∀ u₂ ∈ E, u₁ ≤ u₂ → |g u₂ - g u₁| ≤ W u₂ - W u₁) := by
      let S_var : ℝ → Set ℝ := fun y =>
        insert (0 : ℝ) { V : ℝ | ∃ (N : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ),
          Monotone u ∧ (∀ i ≤ N, u i ∈ E ∧ u i ≤ y) ∧
          V = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, |g (u (i + 1)) - g (u i)| }
      let W₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => sSup (S_var y)
      have hS_ne : ∀ y : ℝ, (S_var y).Nonempty := fun _ => ⟨0, Set.mem_insert 0 _⟩
      have hS_bdd : ∀ y : ℝ, BddAbove (S_var y) := by
        intro y
        refine ⟨B, fun V hV => ?_⟩

    measurable_fst.prodMk measurable_snd.neg
  obtain ⟨hFp_meas, hFp_bds⟩ := h_stage1 F hF_meas
  obtain ⟨hG_refl_meas, hG_refl_bds⟩ := h_stage1 F_refl (hF_meas.comp hΨ_meas)
  have hFm_meas : Measurable F_minus := hG_refl_meas.comp hΨ_meas
  refine ⟨F_minus, F_plus, hFm_meas, hFp_meas,
    fun xy => ⟨(hG_refl_bds (xy.1, -xy.2)).1, (hG_refl_bds (xy.1, -xy.2)).2,
      (hFp_bds xy).1, (hFp_bds xy).2⟩, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h_stage2] with x hx_slice hx_mem
  obtain ⟨B, E, hB_nn, hE_sub, hE_ae, hE_var⟩ := hx_slice hx_mem
  
  have hg_plus_meas : Measurable (fun y : ℝ => F (x, y)) :=
    hF_meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  obtain ⟨hFp_rc, hFp_ae⟩ := h_stage3 y_lo y_hi B hy hB_nn
    (fun y => F (x, y)) hg_plus_meas (fun y => hF_bds (x, y)) E hE_sub hE_ae hE_var
  
  let g_refl : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => F (x, -u)
  let E_refl : Set ℝ := { u : ℝ | -u ∈ E }
  have hg_refl_meas : Measurable g_refl :=
    hF_meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id.neg)
  have hE_refl_sub : E_refl ⊆ Set.Ioo (-y_hi) (-y_lo) := by
    intro u hu
    have h_in := hE_sub hu
    exact ⟨neg_lt.mp h_in.2, lt_neg.mp h_in.1⟩
  have hE_refl_ae : ∀ᵐ u : ℝ, u ∈ Set.Ioo (-y_hi) (-y_lo) → u ∈ E_refl := by
    have h_neg := (MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_neg
      MeasureTheory.volume).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hE_ae
    filter_upwards [h_neg] with u hu_imp hu_ioo
    exact hu_imp ⟨lt_neg.mp hu_ioo.2, neg_lt.mp hu_ioo.1⟩
  have hE_refl_var : ∀ (N : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ), Monotone u → (∀ i ≤ N, u i ∈ E_refl) →
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, |g_refl (u (i + 1)) - g_refl (u i)|) ≤ B := by
    intro N u hu_mono hu_E
    cases N with
    | zero => simp [hB_nn]
    | succ M_n =>
      let N' : ℕ := M_n + 1
      let v : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => if j ≤ N' then -u (N' - j) else -u 0
      have hv_mono : Monotone v := by
        intro i j hij
        dsimp only [v]
        split_ifs with hi hj hj
        · exact neg_le_neg (hu_mono (by omega))
        · exact neg_le_neg (hu_mono (Nat.zero_le _))
        · omega
        · exact le_rfl
      have hv_E : ∀ j ≤ N', v j ∈ E := by
        intro j hj
        dsimp only [v]
        simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte]
        exact hu_E (N' - j) (by omega)
      have h_rev : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N', |g_refl (u (i + 1)) - g_refl (u i)|) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N', |F (x, v (j + 1)) - F (x, v j)| := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun i => |g_refl (u (i + 1)) - g_refl (u i)|) N']
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
        have hj_lt : j < N' := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        have hj0 : j ≤ N' := Nat.le_of_lt hj_lt
        have hj1 : j + 1 ≤ N' := hj_lt
        have h_idx1 : N' - 1 - j + 1 = N' - j := by omega
        have h_idx0 : N' - 1 - j = N' - (j + 1) := by omega
        dsimp only [g_refl, v]
        simp only [hj1, hj0, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [h_idx1, h_idx0, abs_sub_comm]
      change (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N', |g_refl (u (i + 1)) - g_refl (u i)|) ≤ B
      rw [h_rev]
      exact hE_var N' v hv_mono hv_E
  obtain ⟨hGr_rc, hGr_ae⟩ := h_stage3 (-y_hi) (-y_lo) B (neg_lt_neg hy) hB_nn
    g_refl hg_refl_meas (fun u => hF_bds (x, -u)) E_refl hE_refl_sub hE_refl_ae hE_refl_var
  have hFm_lc : ∀ y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun y => F_minus (x, y)) (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Iio y₀))
        (nhds (F_minus (x, y₀))) := by
    intro y₀ hy₀
    have h_ny₀ : -y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-y_hi) (-y_lo) := ⟨neg_lt_neg hy₀.2, neg_lt_neg hy₀.1⟩
    have h_rc_at := hGr_rc (-y₀) h_ny₀
    have h_neg_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => -y)
        (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Iio y₀)) (nhdsWithin (-y₀) (Set.Ioi (-y₀))) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _
        continuous_neg.continuousWithinAt
        (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun y (hy_lt : y < y₀) => neg_lt_neg hy_lt))
    exact h_rc_at.comp h_neg_nhds
  have hFm_ae : ∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi → F (x, y) = F_minus (x, y) := by
    have h_neg_ae := (MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_neg
      MeasureTheory.volume).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hGr_ae
    filter_upwards [h_neg_ae] with y hy_imp hy_ioo
    have h_ny : -y ∈ Set.Ioo (-y_hi) (-y_lo) := ⟨neg_lt_neg hy_ioo.2, neg_lt_neg hy_ioo.1⟩
    have h_eq := hy_imp h_ny
    simpa [g_refl, F_minus, F_refl] using h_eq
  refine ⟨hFp_rc, hFm_lc, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hFp_ae, hFm_ae] with y hyp hym hy_ioo
  exact ⟨hyp hy_ioo, hym hy_ioo⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi M : ℝ)
    (hx : x_lo < x_hi) (hy : y_lo < y_hi) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (F F_minus F_plus : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hF_meas : Measurable F) (hFm_meas : Measurable F_minus) (hFp_meas : Measurable F_plus)
    (hF_bds : ∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ F xy ∧ F xy ≤ M)
    (hFmp_bds : ∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ,
      0 ≤ F_minus xy ∧ F_minus xy ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ F_plus xy ∧ F_plus xy ≤ M)
    (h_slices : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
      (∀ y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun y => F_plus (x, y)) (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Ioi y₀))
          (nhds (F_plus (x, y₀)))) ∧
      (∀ y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun y => F_minus (x, y)) (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Iio y₀))
          (nhds (F_minus (x, y₀)))) ∧
      (∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi →
        F (x, y) = F_plus (x, y) ∧ F (x, y) = F_minus (x, y)))
    (h : ℝ → ℝ) (L_h : ℝ) (hL_h : 0 ≤ L_h)
    (hh_lip : ∀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ, |h x₁ - h x₂| ≤ L_h * |x₁ - x₂|) :
    ∀ᵐ x₀ : ℝ, x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi → h x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi →
      ∃ q : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt h q x₀ ∧
        HasTangentBoxTrace (fun yx => F (yx.2, yx.1)) (h x₀) x₀ (-q)
          (F_minus (x₀, h x₀)) (F_plus (x₀, h x₀))
