proof.tactics:
by
  have h_ii : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (B a b : ℝ),
      a ≤ b → Measurable φ → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ φ t ∧ φ t ≤ B) →
      IntervalIntegrable φ MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro φ B a b hab hφ_meas hφ_bds
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hab]
    have : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b)) :=
      ⟨by simp [Real.volume_Ioc]⟩
    exact MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 B hφ_meas.aemeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hφ_bds)

  have h_leb_1d : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ),
      Measurable g → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ M) →
      ∀ᵐ x₀ : ℝ,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
          ρ⁻¹ * ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |g x - g x₀|)
          (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
    intro g hg_meas hg_bds
    have h_mem : MeasureTheory.MemLp g ⊤ MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.memLp_top_of_bound hg_meas.aestronglyMeasurable M
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hg_bds x).1]
          exact (hg_bds x).2))
    have h_loc : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_mem.locallyIntegrable le_top
    filter_upwards [IsUnifLocDoublingMeasure.ae_tendsto_average_norm_sub
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) h_loc 1] with x₀ hx₀_leb
    have h_avg : Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
        ⨍ x in Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ, ‖g x - g x₀‖ ∂MeasureTheory.volume)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
      refine hx₀_leb (fun _ => x₀) id Filter.tendsto_id ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ρ (hρ : 0 < ρ)
      simp only [one_mul, id_eq]
      exact Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le
    have h_mul := h_avg.const_mul (2 : ℝ)
    rw [mul_zero] at h_mul
    refine h_mul.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ρ (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq, smul_eq_mul, Real.closedBall_eq_Icc,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.real, Real.volume_Icc,
      MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith : x₀ - ρ ≤ x₀ + ρ)]
    have h_diff : (x₀ + ρ) - (x₀ - ρ) = 2 * ρ := by ring
    rw [h_diff, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ρ)]
    have h_int_eq : (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), ‖g x - g x₀‖) =
        ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |g x - g x₀| := by rfl
    rw [h_int_eq, ← mul_assoc]
    have h2ρ : (2 : ℝ) * (2 * ρ)⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ := by
      field_simp [hρ.ne']
    rw [h2ρ]

  have h_right_mod : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : ℝ) (G G_p : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (f_h : ℝ → ℝ),
      Measurable G_p →
      (∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ G_p xy ∧ G_p xy ≤ M) →
      Continuous f_h →
      ∃ Ω : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ,
        (∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (Ω k) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ Ω k x ∧ Ω k x ≤ M) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ,
          (∀ y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y₁ y₂,
            Filter.Tendsto (fun y => G_p (x, y)) (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Ioi y₀))
              (nhds (G_p (x, y₀)))) →
          (f_h x ∈ Set.Ioo y₁ y₂ →
            Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => Ω k x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
          ((∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo y₁ y₂ → G (x, y) = G_p (x, y)) →
            ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᵐ y : ℝ,
              y ∈ Set.Ioo y₁ y₂ →
              f_h x < y → y < f_h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ →
                |G (x, y) - G_p (x, f_h x)| ≤ Ω k x)) := by
    intro y₁ y₂ G G_p f_h hGp_meas hGp_bds hf_cont
    let P : ℕ → ℚ → Set ℝ := fun k q =>
      { x : ℝ | f_h x < (q : ℝ) } ∩
      ({ x : ℝ | (q : ℝ) < f_h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ } ∩
       ({ x : ℝ | y₁ < (q : ℝ) } ∩ { x : ℝ | (q : ℝ) < y₂ }))
    let ψ : ℕ → ℚ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k q =>
      Set.indicator (P k q) (fun x => |G_p (x, (q : ℝ)) - G_p (x, f_h x)|)
    let Ω : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k x => ⨆ q : ℚ, ψ k q x
    have hP_meas : ∀ (k : ℕ) (q : ℚ), MeasurableSet (P k q) := by
      intro k q
      refine IsOpen.measurableSet ?_
      exact (isOpen_lt hf_cont continuous_const).inter
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (hf_cont.add continuous_const)).inter
          ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_const).inter
            (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_const)))
    have hψ_meas : ∀ (k : ℕ) (q : ℚ), Measurable (ψ k q) := by
      intro k q
      refine Measurable.indicator ?_ (hP_meas k q)
      exact ((hGp_meas.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).sub
        (hGp_meas.comp (measurable_id.prodMk hf_cont.measurable))).abs
    have hψ_bds : ∀ (k : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ ψ k q x ∧ ψ k q x ≤ M := by
      intro k q x
      by_cases hxq : x ∈ P k q
      · dsimp only [ψ]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxq]
        have h1 := hGp_bds (x, (q : ℝ))
        have h2 := hGp_bds (x, f_h x)
        exact ⟨abs_nonneg _, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
      · dsimp only [ψ]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxq]
        exact ⟨le_rfl, hM⟩
    have hψ_bdd : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), BddAbove (Set.range (fun q : ℚ => ψ k q x)) := by
      intro k x
      refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact (hψ_bds k q x).2
    have hΩ_reg : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (Ω k) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ Ω k x ∧ Ω k x ≤ M := by
      intro k
      refine ⟨Measurable.iSup (fun q => hψ_meas k q), fun x => ?_⟩
      refine ⟨le_trans (hψ_bds k 0 x).1 (le_ciSup (hψ_bdd k x) (0 : ℚ)), ?_⟩
      exact ciSup_le (fun q => (hψ_bds k q x).2)
    refine ⟨Ω, hΩ_reg, fun x h_rc => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro hfx_mem
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ :=
        Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.mp (h_rc (f_h x) hfx_mem) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
      obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt δ⁻¹
      refine ⟨K₀, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      have hk_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hk_gt : δ⁻¹ < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
        have hk_cast : (K₀ : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hk
        linarith
      have hk_inv_lt : ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ < δ := by
        rwa [inv_lt_comm₀ hk_pos hδ_pos]
      have hΩ_le : Ω k x ≤ ε / 2 := by
        refine ciSup_le (fun q => ?_)
        by_cases hxq : x ∈ P k q
        · have hq1 : f_h x < (q : ℝ) := hxq.1
          have hq2 : (q : ℝ) < f_h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := hxq.2.1
          have hq_dist : dist (q : ℝ) (f_h x) < δ := by
            rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hq1)]
            linarith
          have hG_lt : dist (G_p (x, (q : ℝ))) (G_p (x, f_h x)) < ε / 2 :=
            hδ hq1 hq_dist
          rw [Real.dist_eq] at hG_lt
          dsimp only [ψ]
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxq]
          exact hG_lt.le
        · dsimp only [ψ]
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxq]
          linarith
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg ((hΩ_reg k).2 x).1]
      linarith
    · intro h_ae k
      filter_upwards [h_ae] with y hy hy_mem h_gt h_lt
      rw [hy hy_mem]
      refine le_of_forall_pos_lt_add (fun η hη => ?_)
      obtain ⟨δ_y, hδy_pos, hδy⟩ :=
        Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.mp (h_rc y hy_mem) η hη
      let y_top : ℝ := min (min y₂ (f_h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹)) (y + δ_y)
      have hy_top : y < y_top := lt_min (lt_min hy_mem.2 h_lt) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨q, hq_gt, hq_lt⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hy_top
      have hq_le1 : (q : ℝ) < min y₂ (f_h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hq_lt (min_le_left _ _)
      have hq_y2 : (q : ℝ) < y₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hq_le1 (min_le_left _ _)
      have hq_col : (q : ℝ) < f_h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hq_le1 (min_le_right _ _)
      have hq_δy : (q : ℝ) < y + δ_y := lt_of_lt_of_le hq_lt (min_le_right _ _)
      have hxq : x ∈ P k q :=
        ⟨lt_trans h_gt hq_gt, hq_col, lt_trans hy_mem.1 hq_gt, hq_y2⟩
      have h_le_Ω : |G_p (x, (q : ℝ)) - G_p (x, f_h x)| ≤ Ω k x := by
        have h_ind : ψ k q x = |G_p (x, (q : ℝ)) - G_p (x, f_h x)| := by
          dsimp only [ψ]
          exact Set.indicator_of_mem hxq _
        rw [← h_ind]
        exact le_ciSup (hψ_bdd k x) q
      have hq_dist_y : dist (q : ℝ) y < δ_y := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hq_gt)]
        linarith
      have h_lt_η : dist (G_p (x, (q : ℝ))) (G_p (x, y)) < η :=
        hδy hq_gt hq_dist_y
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at h_lt_η
      calc |G_p (x, y) - G_p (x, f_h x)|
          ≤ |G_p (x, y) - G_p (x, (q : ℝ))| + |G_p (x, (q : ℝ)) - G_p (x, f_h x)| :=
            abs_sub_le _ _ _
        _ < Ω k x + η := by linarith

  have h_pt_right_trace : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : ℝ) (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℝ → ℝ)
      (Ω : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f_h : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ q : ℝ),
      Measurable G →
      (∀ xy : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ G xy ∧ G xy ≤ M) →
      Measurable T →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ T x ∧ T x ≤ M) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (Ω k) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ Ω k x ∧ Ω k x ≤ M) →
      x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
      f_h x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y₁ y₂ →
      HasDerivAt f_h q x₀ →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => Ω k x₀) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => ρ⁻¹ * ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |T x - T x₀|)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => ρ⁻¹ * ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
        ∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo y₁ y₂ →
          f_h x < y → y < f_h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ →
            |G (x, y) - T x| ≤ Ω k x) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
        ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ),
          ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, |G (x, f_h x₀ + q * (x - x₀) + r) - T x₀|)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
    intro y₁ y₂ G T Ω f_h x₀ q hG_meas hG_bds hT_meas hT_bds hΩ_reg
      hx₀ hfx₀ hf_der hΩ_lim hT_leb hΩ_leb h_collar
    let ℓ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => f_h x₀ + q * (x - x₀)
    let Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun xr => |G (xr.1, ℓ xr.1 + xr.2) - T x₀|
    let I_in : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun ρ x => ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, Φ (x, r)
    have hℓ_cont : Continuous ℓ :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
    have hΦ_meas : Measurable Φ :=
      ((hG_meas.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk
        ((hℓ_cont.measurable.comp measurable_fst).add measurable_snd))).sub
        measurable_const).abs
    have hΦ_bds : ∀ xr : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ Φ xr ∧ Φ xr ≤ M := by
      intro xr
      have h1 := hG_bds (xr.1, ℓ xr.1 + xr.2)
      have h2 := hT_bds x₀
      exact ⟨abs_nonneg _, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
    have hΦ_slice_meas : ∀ x : ℝ, Measurable (fun r : ℝ => Φ (x, r)) :=
      fun x => hΦ_meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨k, hk_lim⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hΩ_lim (ε / 8) (by positivity)
    have hk : Ω k x₀ < ε / 8 := by
      have h1 := hk_lim k le_rfl
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg ((hΩ_reg k).2 x₀).1] at h1
      exact h1
    let η_tan : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (ε / (16 * (M + 1)))
    have hM1_pos : 0 < M + 1 := by linarith
    have hη_pos : 0 < η_tan := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
    have hη_le_qtr : η_tan ≤ 1 / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hη_le_eps : η_tan ≤ ε / (16 * (M + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
    have h2Mη : 2 * M * η_tan ≤ ε / 8 := by
      have h1 : 2 * M * η_tan ≤ 2 * (M + 1) * (ε / (16 * (M + 1))) := by
        have hM_le : 2 * M ≤ 2 * (M + 1) := by linarith
        exact mul_le_mul hM_le hη_le_eps hη_pos.le (by positivity)
      have h2 : 2 * (M + 1) * (ε / (16 * (M + 1))) = ε / 8 := by
        field_simp [hM1_pos.ne']
        ring
      linarith
    have h_o := (hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO.mp hf_der).def hη_pos
    obtain ⟨δ_der, hδ_der_pos, hδ_der_ball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp h_o
    have hδ_der : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - x₀| < δ_der → |f_h x - ℓ x| ≤ η_tan * |x - x₀| := by
      intro x hx_lt
      have h1 := hδ_der_ball (by rwa [Real.dist_eq])
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul] at h1
      have h_eq : f_h x - f_h x₀ - (x - x₀) * q = f_h x - ℓ x := by
        dsimp only [ℓ]
        ring
      rwa [h_eq] at h1
    let δ_x : ℝ := min (x₀ - x_lo) (x_hi - x₀)
    have hδ_x_pos : 0 < δ_x := lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hx₀.1) (sub_pos.mpr hx₀.2)
    have hq1_pos : 0 < |q| + 1 := by positivity
    let δ_y : ℝ := min (f_h x₀ - y₁) (y₂ - f_h x₀) / (|q| + 1)
    have hδ_y_pos : 0 < δ_y :=
      div_pos (lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hfx₀.1) (sub_pos.mpr hfx₀.2)) hq1_pos
    let δ_k : ℝ := ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ / 2
    have hδ_k_pos : 0 < δ_k := by positivity
    let ρ_max : ℝ := min (min δ_der δ_x) (min δ_y δ_k)
    have hρ_max_pos : 0 < ρ_max :=
      lt_min (lt_min hδ_der_pos hδ_x_pos) (lt_min hδ_y_pos hδ_k_pos)
    have hT_ev := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hT_leb) (ε / 4) (by positivity)
    have hΩ_ev := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (hΩ_leb k)) (ε / 4) (by positivity)
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hρ_max_pos, hT_ev, hΩ_ev] with ρ hρ_mem hT_lt hΩ_lt
    obtain ⟨hρ_pos, hρ_lt_max⟩ := hρ_mem
    have hρ_lt1 : ρ < min δ_der δ_x := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt_max (min_le_left _ _)
    have hρ_lt2 : ρ < min δ_y δ_k := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt_max (min_le_right _ _)
    have hρ_der : ρ < δ_der := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt1 (min_le_left _ _)
    have hρ_x : ρ < δ_x := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt1 (min_le_right _ _)
    have hρ_y : ρ < δ_y := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt2 (min_le_left _ _)
    have hρ_k : ρ < δ_k := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_lt2 (min_le_right _ _)
    have hI_meas : Measurable (I_in ρ) := by
      have h_eq : I_in ρ =
          (fun x : ℝ => ∫ r, Φ (x, r) ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 ρ))) := by
        ext x
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hρ_pos.le
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hΦ_meas.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'.measurable
    have hI_bds : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ I_in ρ x ∧ I_in ρ x ≤ ρ * M := by
      intro x
      refine ⟨intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hρ_pos.le (fun r _ => (hΦ_bds (x, r)).1), ?_⟩
      calc ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, Φ (x, r)
          ≤ ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, M :=
            intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hρ_pos.le
              (h_ii _ M 0 ρ hρ_pos.le (hΦ_slice_meas x) (fun r => hΦ_bds (x, r)))
              intervalIntegrable_const (fun r _ => (hΦ_bds (x, r)).2)
        _ = ρ * M := by simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    have h_ae_x : (fun x : ℝ => I_in ρ x) ≤ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict
        (Set.Icc (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ))]
        (fun x : ℝ => ρ * ((M * η_tan + Ω k x₀) + (|Ω k x - Ω k x₀| + |T x - T x₀|))) := by
      rw [Filter.EventuallyLE, MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc]
      filter_upwards [h_collar k] with x hx_col hx_Icc
      have hx_abs : |x - x₀| ≤ ρ :=
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hx_Icc.1], by linarith [hx_Icc.2]⟩
      have hx_lo : ρ < x₀ - x_lo := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_x (min_le_left _ _)
      have hx_hi : ρ < x_hi - x₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_x (min_le_right _ _)
      have hx_in_x : x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi :=
        ⟨by linarith [hx_Icc.1], by linarith [hx_Icc.2]⟩
      have h_lin : |f_h x - ℓ x| ≤ η_tan * ρ := by
        calc |f_h x - ℓ x| ≤ η_tan * |x - x₀| := hδ_der x (lt_of_le_of_lt hx_abs hρ_der)
          _ ≤ η_tan * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx_abs hη_pos.le
      have hηρ_nn : 0 ≤ η_tan * ρ := mul_nonneg hη_pos.le hρ_pos.le
      have hηρ_le : η_tan * ρ ≤ ρ := by nlinarith [hη_le_qtr]
      have h_split : I_in ρ x =
          (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..(η_tan * ρ), Φ (x, r)) +
          (∫ r in (η_tan * ρ)..ρ, Φ (x, r)) :=
        (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
          (h_ii _ M 0 (η_tan * ρ) hηρ_nn (hΦ_slice_meas x) (fun r => hΦ_bds (x, r)))
          (h_ii _ M (η_tan * ρ) ρ hηρ_le (hΦ_slice_meas x) (fun r => hΦ_bds (x, r)))).symm
      have h_part1 : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..(η_tan * ρ), Φ (x, r)) ≤ ρ * (M * η_tan) := by
        calc ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..(η_tan * ρ), Φ (x, r)
            ≤ ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..(η_tan * ρ), M :=
              intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hηρ_nn
                (h_ii _ M 0 (η_tan * ρ) hηρ_nn (hΦ_slice_meas x) (fun r => hΦ_bds (x, r)))
                intervalIntegrable_const (fun r _ => (hΦ_bds (x, r)).2)
          _ = (η_tan * ρ) * M := by
              simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
          _ = ρ * (M * η_tan) := by ring
      have h_ae_r : (fun r : ℝ => Φ (x, r)) ≤ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict
          (Set.Icc (η_tan * ρ) ρ)]
          (fun _ : ℝ => Ω k x + |T x - T x₀|) := by
        rw [Filter.EventuallyLE, MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc]
        have h_shift := (MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_add_left
          MeasureTheory.volume (ℓ x)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hx_col hx_in_x)
        filter_upwards [h_shift,
          MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ne MeasureTheory.volume (η_tan * ρ),
          MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ne MeasureTheory.volume ρ] with r hr_col hr_ne1 hr_ne2 hr_Icc
        have hr_gt : η_tan * ρ < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hr_Icc.1 (Ne.symm hr_ne1)
        have hr_lt : r < ρ := lt_of_le_of_ne hr_Icc.2 hr_ne2
        have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_lt hηρ_nn hr_gt
        have hy_dist : |(ℓ x + r) - f_h x₀| < min (f_h x₀ - y₁) (y₂ - f_h x₀) := by
          have h_eq : (ℓ x + r) - f_h x₀ = q * (x - x₀) + r := by
            dsimp only [ℓ]
            ring
          rw [h_eq]
          have h_tri : |q * (x - x₀) + r| ≤ |q| * |x - x₀| + |r| := by
            rw [← abs_mul]
            exact abs_add_le _ _
          have h_le : |q| * |x - x₀| + |r| ≤ (|q| + 1) * ρ := by
            rw [abs_of_pos hr_pos]
            have hq_mul : |q| * |x - x₀| ≤ |q| * ρ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx_abs (abs_nonneg q)
            linarith
          have h_lt_min : ρ * (|q| + 1) < min (f_h x₀ - y₁) (y₂ - f_h x₀) :=
            (lt_div_iff₀ hq1_pos).mp hρ_y
          linarith
        have hy1 : |(ℓ x + r) - f_h x₀| < f_h x₀ - y₁ :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hy_dist (min_le_left _ _)
        have hy2 : |(ℓ x + r) - f_h x₀| < y₂ - f_h x₀ :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hy_dist (min_le_right _ _)
        have hy_in : ℓ x + r ∈ Set.Ioo y₁ y₂ :=
          ⟨by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hy1).1], by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hy2).2]⟩
        obtain ⟨h_lin1, h_lin2⟩ := abs_le.mp h_lin
        have hy_gt : f_h x < ℓ x + r := by linarith
        have hy_lt : ℓ x + r < f_h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by
          have h2ρ_lt : 2 * ρ < ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by
            dsimp only [δ_k] at hρ_k
            linarith
          linarith
        have hG_le : |G (x, ℓ x + r) - T x| ≤ Ω k x :=
          hr_col hy_in hy_gt hy_lt
        calc Φ (x, r)
            = |G (x, ℓ x + r) - T x₀| := rfl
          _ ≤ |G (x, ℓ x + r) - T x| + |T x - T x₀| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
          _ ≤ Ω k x + |T x - T x₀| := by linarith
      have h_part2 : (∫ r in (η_tan * ρ)..ρ, Φ (x, r)) ≤ ρ * (Ω k x + |T x - T x₀|) := by
        have h_const_nn : 0 ≤ Ω k x + |T x - T x₀| :=
          add_nonneg ((hΩ_reg k).2 x).1 (abs_nonneg _)
        calc ∫ r in (η_tan * ρ)..ρ, Φ (x, r)
            ≤ ∫ r in (η_tan * ρ)..ρ, (Ω k x + |T x - T x₀|) :=
              intervalIntegral.integral_mono_ae_restrict hηρ_le
                (h_ii _ M (η_tan * ρ) ρ hηρ_le (hΦ_slice_meas x) (fun r => hΦ_bds (x, r)))
                intervalIntegrable_const h_ae_r
          _ = (ρ - η_tan * ρ) * (Ω k x + |T x - T x₀|) := by
              simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
          _ ≤ ρ * (Ω k x + |T x - T x₀|) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) h_const_nn
      have hΩ_tri : Ω k x ≤ Ω k x₀ + |Ω k x - Ω k x₀| := by
        have h1 : Ω k x - Ω k x₀ ≤ |Ω k x - Ω k x₀| := le_abs_self _
        linarith
      have h_mul_tri : ρ * (Ω k x + |T x - T x₀|) ≤
          ρ * (Ω k x₀ + |Ω k x - Ω k x₀| + |T x - T x₀|) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hρ_pos.le
      rw [h_split]
      linarith
    have hx_le : x₀ - ρ ≤ x₀ + ρ := by linarith
    have h_ii_Ω : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|)
        MeasureTheory.volume (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ) := by
      refine h_ii _ M (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ) hx_le (((hΩ_reg k).1).sub measurable_const).abs
        (fun x => ?_)
      have h1 := (hΩ_reg k).2 x
      have h2 := (hΩ_reg k).2 x₀
      exact ⟨abs_nonneg _, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
    have h_ii_T : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => |T x - T x₀|)
        MeasureTheory.volume (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ) := by
      refine h_ii _ M (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ) hx_le (hT_meas.sub measurable_const).abs
        (fun x => ?_)
      have h1 := hT_bds x
      have h2 := hT_bds x₀
      exact ⟨abs_nonneg _, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
    have h_ii_rhs : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => ρ * ((M * η_tan + Ω k x₀) + (|Ω k x - Ω k x₀| + |T x - T x₀|)))
        MeasureTheory.volume (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ) :=
      (intervalIntegrable_const.add (h_ii_Ω.add h_ii_T)).const_mul ρ
    have h_outer_le : (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), I_in ρ x) ≤
        ρ * (2 * ρ * (M * η_tan + Ω k x₀) +
          ((∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|) +
           (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |T x - T x₀|))) := by
      calc ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), I_in ρ x
          ≤ ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ),
              ρ * ((M * η_tan + Ω k x₀) + (|Ω k x - Ω k x₀| + |T x - T x₀|)) :=
            intervalIntegral.integral_mono_ae_restrict hx_le
              (h_ii _ (ρ * M) (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ) hx_le hI_meas hI_bds)
              h_ii_rhs h_ae_x
        _ = ρ * ((∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), (M * η_tan + Ω k x₀)) +
              ((∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|) +
               (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |T x - T x₀|))) := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
              intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const (h_ii_Ω.add h_ii_T),
              intervalIntegral.integral_add h_ii_Ω h_ii_T]
        _ = ρ * (2 * ρ * (M * η_tan + Ω k x₀) +
              ((∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|) +
               (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |T x - T x₀|))) := by
            simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
            ring
    have h_outer_nn : 0 ≤ ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), I_in ρ x :=
      mul_nonneg (by positivity)
        (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hx_le (fun x _ => (hI_bds x).1))
    have h_scaled_le : ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), I_in ρ x) ≤
        2 * M * η_tan + 2 * Ω k x₀ +
        ρ⁻¹ * (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|) +
        ρ⁻¹ * (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |T x - T x₀|) := by
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_outer_le (by positivity : 0 ≤ ρ⁻¹ ^ 2)
      have h_alg : ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * (ρ * (2 * ρ * (M * η_tan + Ω k x₀) +
          ((∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|) +
           (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |T x - T x₀|)))) =
        2 * M * η_tan + 2 * Ω k x₀ +
        ρ⁻¹ * (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|) +
        ρ⁻¹ * (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |T x - T x₀|) := by
        field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']
        ring
      rwa [h_alg] at h_mul
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hT_lt hΩ_lt
    have hΩ_avg_lt : ρ⁻¹ * (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω k x - Ω k x₀|) < ε / 4 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) hΩ_lt
    have hT_avg_lt : ρ⁻¹ * (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |T x - T x₀|) < ε / 4 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) hT_lt
    change dist (ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), I_in ρ x) 0 < ε
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg h_outer_nn]
    linarith

  have hh_lip_nn : LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal L_h) h := by
    refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun x₁ x₂ => ?_)
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal L_h hL_h, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
    exact hh_lip x₁ x₂
  have hh_cont : Continuous h := hh_lip_nn.continuous
  have hh_diff_ae : ∀ᵐ x₀ : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ h x₀ :=
    hh_lip_nn.ae_differentiableAt_real

  let T_plus : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => F_plus (x, h x)
  have hTp_meas : Measurable T_plus :=
    hFp_meas.comp (measurable_id.prodMk hh_cont.measurable)
  have hTp_bds : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ T_plus x ∧ T_plus x ≤ M :=
    fun x => ⟨(hFmp_bds (x, h x)).2.2.1, (hFmp_bds (x, h x)).2.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨Ω_plus, hΩp_reg, hΩp_spec⟩ :=
    h_right_mod y_lo y_hi F F_plus h hFp_meas
      (fun xy => ⟨(hFmp_bds xy).2.2.1, (hFmp_bds xy).2.2.2⟩) hh_cont
  have h_col_plus : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
      ∀ᵐ y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi →
        h x < y → y < h x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ →
          |F (x, y) - T_plus x| ≤ Ω_plus k x := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [h_slices] with x hx hx_mem
    obtain ⟨h_rc, _, h_eq⟩ := hx hx_mem
    exact (hΩp_spec x h_rc).2
      (by filter_upwards [h_eq] with y hy hy_mem; exact (hy hy_mem).1) k

  let F_refl : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun xz => F (xz.1, -xz.2)
  let Fp_refl : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun xz => F_minus (xz.1, -xz.2)
  let h_refl : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -h x
  let T_minus : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Fp_refl (x, h_refl x)
  have hFr_meas : Measurable F_refl :=
    hF_meas.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk measurable_snd.neg)
  have hFpr_meas : Measurable Fp_refl :=
    hFm_meas.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk measurable_snd.neg)
  have hhr_cont : Continuous h_refl := hh_cont.neg
  have hTm_meas : Measurable T_minus :=
    hFpr_meas.comp (measurable_id.prodMk hhr_cont.measurable)
  have hFr_bds : ∀ xz : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ F_refl xz ∧ F_refl xz ≤ M :=
    fun xz => hF_bds (xz.1, -xz.2)
  have hFpr_bds : ∀ xz : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ Fp_refl xz ∧ Fp_refl xz ≤ M :=
    fun xz => ⟨(hFmp_bds (xz.1, -xz.2)).1, (hFmp_bds (xz.1, -xz.2)).2.1⟩
  have hTm_bds : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ T_minus x ∧ T_minus x ≤ M :=
    fun x => hFpr_bds (x, h_refl x)
  obtain ⟨Ω_minus, hΩm_reg, hΩm_spec⟩ :=
    h_right_mod (-y_hi) (-y_lo) F_refl Fp_refl h_refl hFpr_meas hFpr_bds hhr_cont
  have h_rc_refl_of_lc : ∀ x : ℝ,
      (∀ y₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun y => F_minus (x, y)) (nhdsWithin y₀ (Set.Iio y₀))
          (nhds (F_minus (x, y₀)))) →
      ∀ z₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-y_hi) (-y_lo),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun z => Fp_refl (x, z)) (nhdsWithin z₀ (Set.Ioi z₀))
          (nhds (Fp_refl (x, z₀))) := by
    intro x h_lc z₀ hz₀
    have h_neg_z₀ : -z₀ ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi :=
      ⟨by linarith [hz₀.2], by linarith [hz₀.1]⟩
    exact (h_lc (-z₀) h_neg_z₀).comp tendsto_neg_nhdsGT
  have h_col_minus : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi →
      ∀ᵐ z : ℝ, z ∈ Set.Ioo (-y_hi) (-y_lo) →
        h_refl x < z → z < h_refl x + ((k : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ →
          |F_refl (x, z) - T_minus x| ≤ Ω_minus k x := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [h_slices] with x hx hx_mem
    obtain ⟨_, h_lc, h_eq⟩ := hx hx_mem
    have h_eq_refl : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ, z ∈ Set.Ioo (-y_hi) (-y_lo) → F_refl (x, z) = Fp_refl (x, z) := by
      have h_pull := (MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_neg
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h_eq
      filter_upwards [h_pull] with z hz hz_mem
      have h_neg_z : -z ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi :=
        ⟨by linarith [hz_mem.2], by linarith [hz_mem.1]⟩
      exact (hz h_neg_z).2
    exact (hΩm_spec x (h_rc_refl_of_lc x h_lc)).2 h_eq_refl k

  have ae_Tp := h_leb_1d T_plus hTp_meas hTp_bds
  have ae_Tm := h_leb_1d T_minus hTm_meas hTm_bds
  have ae_Ωp : ∀ᵐ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => ρ⁻¹ * ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω_plus k x - Ω_plus k x₀|)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) :=
    eventually_countable_forall.mpr (fun k => h_leb_1d (Ω_plus k) (hΩp_reg k).1 (hΩp_reg k).2)
  have ae_Ωm : ∀ᵐ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => ρ⁻¹ * ∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ), |Ω_minus k x - Ω_minus k x₀|)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) :=
    eventually_countable_forall.mpr (fun k => h_leb_1d (Ω_minus k) (hΩm_reg k).1 (hΩm_reg k).2)

  filter_upwards [hh_diff_ae, h_slices, ae_Tp, ae_Tm, ae_Ωp, ae_Ωm] with
    x₀ hx₀_diff hx₀_sl hx₀_Tp hx₀_Tm hx₀_Ωp hx₀_Ωm hx₀ hhx₀
  let q : ℝ := deriv h x₀
  have hq : HasDerivAt h q x₀ := hx₀_diff.hasDerivAt
  obtain ⟨h_rc, h_lc, _⟩ := hx₀_sl hx₀
  refine ⟨q, hq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hhx₀_refl : h_refl x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-y_hi) (-y_lo) :=
      ⟨by dsimp only [h_refl]; linarith [hhx₀.2],
       by dsimp only [h_refl]; linarith [hhx₀.1]⟩
    have hq_refl : HasDerivAt h_refl (-q) x₀ := hq.neg
    have h_lim_m := h_pt_right_trace (-y_hi) (-y_lo) F_refl T_minus Ω_minus h_refl x₀ (-q)
      hFr_meas hFr_bds hTm_meas hTm_bds hΩm_reg hx₀ hhx₀_refl hq_refl
      ((hΩm_spec x₀ (h_rc_refl_of_lc x₀ h_lc)).1 hhx₀_refl) hx₀_Tm hx₀_Ωm h_col_minus
    refine h_lim_m.congr (fun ρ => ?_)
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun u _ => ?_)
    have h_integrand : (fun r : ℝ =>
        |F_refl (u, h_refl x₀ + (-q) * (u - x₀) + r) - T_minus x₀|) =
      (fun r : ℝ =>
        |F (u, h x₀ - (-q) * (u - x₀) + (-r)) - F_minus (x₀, h x₀)|) := by
      ext r
      dsimp only [F_refl, h_refl, T_minus, Fp_refl]
      congr 1
      have h1 : -(-h x₀ + (-q) * (u - x₀) + r) = h x₀ - (-q) * (u - x₀) + (-r) := by ring
      have h2 : -(-h x₀) = h x₀ := neg_neg (h x₀)
      rw [h1, h2]
    rw [h_integrand]
    simpa only [neg_zero] using
      (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := ρ)
        (fun r : ℝ => |F (u, h x₀ - (-q) * (u - x₀) + r) - F_minus (x₀, h x₀)|))
  · have h_lim_p := h_pt_right_trace y_lo y_hi F T_plus Ω_plus h x₀ q
      hF_meas hF_bds hTp_meas hTp_bds hΩp_reg hx₀ hhx₀ hq
      ((hΩp_spec x₀ h_rc).1 hhx₀) hx₀_Tp hx₀_Ωp h_col_plus
    refine h_lim_p.congr (fun ρ => ?_)
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun u _ => ?_)
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun r _ => ?_)
    dsimp only [T_plus]
    have h1 : h x₀ + q * (u - x₀) + r = h x₀ - (-q) * (u - x₀) + r := by ring
    rw [h1]

informal_problem.statement:
(c₀ M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hA_meas : Measurable A)
    (hA_bds : ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ A iu ∧ A iu ≤ M)
    (h_graph : ∀ (K δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (L_h : ℝ), 0 ≤ L_h →
        (∀ r₁ r₂ : ℝ, |h r₁ - h r₂| ≤ L_h * |r₁ - r₂|) →
        ∀ᵐ r₀ : ℝ, r₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-K) K → h r₀ ∈ Set.Ioo δ (1 - δ) →
          ∃ q T_minus T_plus : ℝ,
            0 ≤ T_minus ∧ T_minus ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ T_plus ∧ T_plus ≤ M ∧
            HasDerivAt h q r₀ ∧
            HasTangentBoxTrace (fun sr => A (sr.2 - c₀ * sr.1, sr.1)) (h r₀) r₀ (-q)
              T_minus T_plus)
    (b : ℝ → ℝ) (L_b : ℝ) (hL_b : 0 ≤ L_b)
    (hb_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, |b u₁ - b u₂| ≤ L_b * |u₁ - u₂|) :
    ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∀ p : ℝ, HasDerivAt b (-p) u₀ → c₀ ≠ p →
        ∃ a_minus a_plus : ℝ,
          0 ≤ a_minus ∧ a_minus ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ a_plus ∧ a_plus ≤ M ∧
          HasTangentBoxTrace A (b u₀) u₀ p a_minus a_plus

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => b u + c₀ * u
  have hg_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, |g u₁ - g u₂| ≤ (L_b + |c₀|) * |u₁ - u₂| := by
    intro u₁ u₂
    have hdiff : g u₁ - g u₂ = (b u₁ - b u₂) + c₀ * (u₁ - u₂) := by
      dsimp only [g]
      ring
    calc |g u₁ - g u₂|
        = |(b u₁ - b u₂) + c₀ * (u₁ - u₂)| := by rw [hdiff]
      _ ≤ |b u₁ - b u₂| + |c₀ * (u₁ - u₂)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |b u₁ - b u₂| + |c₀| * |u₁ - u₂| := by rw [abs_mul]
      _ ≤ L_b * |u₁ - u₂| + |c₀| * |u₁ - u₂| := add_le_add (hb_lip u₁ u₂) le_rfl
      _ = (L_b + |c₀|) * |u₁ - u₂| := by ring
  have hg_cont : Continuous g := by
    let L_g : NNReal := ⟨L_b + |c₀|, add_nonneg hL_b (abs_nonneg c₀)⟩
    have h_lw : LipschitzWith L_g g := by
      refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun u₁ u₂ => ?_)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
      exact hg_lip u₁ u₂
    exact h_lw.continuous
  let S_piece : (ℕ × ℕ × ℚ × Bool) → ℚ → Set ℝ := fun idx v =>
    let k : ℝ := ((idx.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let N : ℝ := ((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let σ : ℝ := if idx.2.2.2 then 1 else -1
    { u : ℝ | u < (v : ℝ) ∧ (v : ℝ) < u + N⁻¹ → k⁻¹ * ((v : ℝ) - u) ≤ σ * (g v - g u) }
  let E : (ℕ × ℕ × ℚ × Bool) → Set ℝ := fun idx =>
    let N : ℝ := ((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let q_mid : ℝ := (idx.2.2.1 : ℝ)
    Set.Ioo (N⁻¹) (1 - N⁻¹) ∩
      Set.Ioo (q_mid - (2 * N)⁻¹) (q_mid + (2 * N)⁻¹) ∩
      ⋂ v : ℚ, S_piece idx v
  have hE_meas : ∀ idx, MeasurableSet (E idx) := by
    intro idx
    refine (isOpen_Ioo.measurableSet.inter isOpen_Ioo.measurableSet).inter ?_
    refine (isClosed_iInter (fun v => ?_)).measurableSet
    let k : ℝ := ((idx.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let N : ℝ := ((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let σ : ℝ := if idx.2.2.2 then 1 else -1
    have hS_eq : S_piece idx v =
        (Set.Ioo ((v : ℝ) - N⁻¹) (v : ℝ))ᶜ ∪
          { u : ℝ | k⁻¹ * ((v : ℝ) - u) ≤ σ * (g v - g u) } := by
      ext u
      simp only [S_piece, Set.mem_ofPred, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_Ioo]
      constructor
      · intro h
        by_cases hu : (v : ℝ) - N⁻¹ < u ∧ u < (v : ℝ)
        · exact Or.inr (h ⟨hu.2, by linarith [hu.1]⟩)
        · exact Or.inl hu
      · intro h ⟨hu1, hu2⟩
        rcases h with hnot | hle
        · exact False.elim (hnot ⟨by linarith, hu1⟩)
        · exact hle
    rw [hS_eq]
    exact isOpen_Ioo.isClosed_compl.union
      (isClosed_le (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub hg_cont)))
  have hE_bilip_lt : ∀ idx, ∀ u₁ ∈ E idx, ∀ u₂ ∈ E idx, u₁ < u₂ →
      u₂ - u₁ ≤ ((idx.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * |g u₁ - g u₂| := by
    intro idx u₁ hu₁ u₂ hu₂ hlt
    let k : ℝ := ((idx.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let N : ℝ := ((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let q_mid : ℝ := (idx.2.2.1 : ℝ)
    let σ : ℝ := if idx.2.2.2 then 1 else -1
    have hk_pos : 0 < k := by positivity
    have hN_pos : 0 < N := by positivity
    have h2N : (2 * N)⁻¹ + (2 * N)⁻¹ = N⁻¹ := by
      field_simp [hN_pos.ne']
      ring
    have hu₁_q : q_mid - (2 * N)⁻¹ < u₁ ∧ u₁ < q_mid + (2 * N)⁻¹ := hu₁.1.2
    have hu₂_q : q_mid - (2 * N)⁻¹ < u₂ ∧ u₂ < q_mid + (2 * N)⁻¹ := hu₂.1.2
    have hu₂_lt : u₂ < u₁ + N⁻¹ := by linarith [hu₁_q.1, hu₂_q.2, h2N]
    have h_rat : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ v : ℚ,
        max u₁ (u₂ - (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) < (v : ℝ) ∧ (v : ℝ) < u₂ := by
      intro m
      exact exists_rat_btwn (max_lt hlt (sub_lt_self u₂ (by positivity)))
    choose v_seq hv_seq using h_rat
    have h_step : ∀ m : ℕ, k⁻¹ * ((v_seq m : ℝ) - u₁) ≤ σ * (g (v_seq m) - g u₁) := by
      intro m
      have hv1 : u₁ < (v_seq m : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) (hv_seq m).1
      have hv2 : (v_seq m : ℝ) < u₁ + N⁻¹ := lt_trans (hv_seq m).2 hu₂_lt
      exact Set.mem_iInter.mp hu₁.2 (v_seq m) ⟨hv1, hv2⟩
    have hv_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (v_seq m : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds u₂) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt ε⁻¹
      refine ⟨M₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hv_lo : u₂ - (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) < (v_seq m : ℝ) :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) (hv_seq m).1
      have hv_hi : (v_seq m : ℝ) < u₂ := (hv_seq m).2
      have hinv_lt : (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) < ε := by
        rw [inv_lt_comm₀ hm_pos hε]
        have hM_lt : (M₀ : ℝ) < ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm
        exact lt_trans hM₀ hM_lt
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hv_hi)]
      linarith
    have hg_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => g (v_seq m)) Filter.atTop (nhds (g u₂)) :=
      hg_cont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hv_lim
    have h_lim_ineq : k⁻¹ * (u₂ - u₁) ≤ σ * (g u₂ - g u₁) :=
      le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto
        ((hv_lim.sub_const u₁).const_mul k⁻¹)
        ((hg_lim.sub_const (g u₁)).const_mul σ)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_step)
    have hσ_le : σ * (g u₂ - g u₁) ≤ |g u₁ - g u₂| := by
      by_cases hb : idx.2.2.2
      · simp only [σ, hb, ↓reduceIte, one_mul]
        rw [abs_sub_comm]
        exact le_abs_self _
      · simp only [σ, hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        have h_eq : (-1 : ℝ) * (g u₂ - g u₁) = g u₁ - g u₂ := by ring
        rw [h_eq]
        exact le_abs_self _
    have h_comb : k⁻¹ * (u₂ - u₁) ≤ |g u₁ - g u₂| := le_trans h_lim_ineq hσ_le
    calc u₂ - u₁ = k * (k⁻¹ * (u₂ - u₁)) := by field_simp [hk_pos.ne']
      _ ≤ k * |g u₁ - g u₂| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_comb hk_pos.le
  have hE_bilip : ∀ idx, ∀ u₁ ∈ E idx, ∀ u₂ ∈ E idx,
      |u₁ - u₂| ≤ ((idx.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * |g u₁ - g u₂| := by
    intro idx u₁ hu₁ u₂ hu₂
    rcases lt_trichotomy u₁ u₂ with hlt | rfl | hgt
    · rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlt)]
      exact hE_bilip_lt idx u₁ hu₁ u₂ hu₂ hlt
    · simp
    · rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgt), abs_sub_comm (g u₁) (g u₂)]
      exact hE_bilip_lt idx u₂ hu₂ u₁ hu₁ hgt
  have h_inv_ex : ∀ idx, ∃ h : ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ r₁ r₂ : ℝ, |h r₁ - h r₂| ≤ ((idx.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * |r₁ - r₂|) ∧
      (∀ u ∈ E idx, h (g u) = u) := by
    intro idx
    let k : ℝ := ((idx.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    have hk_nn : 0 ≤ k := by positivity
    have hinj : Set.InjOn g (E idx) := by
      intro u₁ hu₁ u₂ hu₂ heq
      have h0 := hE_bilip idx u₁ hu₁ u₂ hu₂
      rw [heq, sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero] at h0
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_nonpos_iff.mp h0)
    let h₀ := Function.invFunOn g (E idx)
    have hleft : Set.LeftInvOn h₀ g (E idx) := hinj.leftInvOn_invFunOn
    let K_nn : NNReal := ⟨k, hk_nn⟩
    have hlip_on : LipschitzOnWith K_nn h₀ (g '' E idx) := by
      refine LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ => ?_)
      rcases hr₁ with ⟨u₁, hu₁, rfl⟩
      rcases hr₂ with ⟨u₂, hu₂, rfl⟩
      rw [hleft hu₁, hleft hu₂, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
      exact hE_bilip idx u₁ hu₁ u₂ hu₂
    obtain ⟨h_ext, hh_lip, hh_eq⟩ := hlip_on.extend_real
    refine ⟨h_ext, fun r₁ r₂ => ?_, fun u hu => ?_⟩
    · have hd := hh_lip.dist_le_mul r₁ r₂
      rwa [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq] at hd
    · rw [← hh_eq ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩]
      exact hleft hu
  choose h_inv hh_inv using h_inv_ex
  have h_cover : ∀ u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ Δ : ℝ, Δ ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt g Δ u₀ →
      ∃ idx, u₀ ∈ E idx := by
    intro u₀ hu₀ Δ hΔ_ne hg_der
    let b_pos : Bool := decide (0 < Δ)
    let σ : ℝ := if b_pos then 1 else -1
    have hσ_Δ : σ * Δ = |Δ| := by
      by_cases hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ
      · have hb : b_pos = true := decide_eq_true hΔ_pos
        simp [σ, hb, abs_of_pos hΔ_pos]
      · have hb : b_pos = false := decide_eq_false hΔ_pos
        have hΔ_neg : Δ < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hΔ_pos) hΔ_ne
        simp [σ, hb, abs_of_neg hΔ_neg]
    have hσ_abs : |σ| = 1 := by
      by_cases hb : b_pos <;> simp [σ, hb]
    have hΔ_abs_pos : 0 < |Δ| := abs_pos.mpr hΔ_ne
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 / |Δ|)
    let k : ℝ := ((k₀ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    have hk_pos : 0 < k := by positivity
    have hkinv_pos : 0 < k⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hk_pos
    have hk_gt : 2 / |Δ| < k := lt_trans hk₀ (by dsimp [k]; push_cast; linarith)
    have hΔ_gt : 2 * k⁻¹ < |Δ| := by
      have h2 : 2 < k * |Δ| := (div_lt_iff₀ hΔ_abs_pos).mp hk_gt
      calc 2 * k⁻¹ < (k * |Δ|) * k⁻¹ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2 hkinv_pos
        _ = |Δ| := by field_simp [hk_pos.ne']
    have ho := (hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO.mp hg_der).bound hkinv_pos
    rcases Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp ho with ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩
    let η : ℝ := min (min u₀ (1 - u₀)) δ₁
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min (lt_min hu₀.1 (sub_pos.mpr hu₀.2)) hδ₁_pos
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt η⁻¹
    let N : ℝ := ((N₀ + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    have hN_pos : 0 < N := by positivity
    have hN_gt : η⁻¹ < N := lt_trans hN₀ (by dsimp [N]; push_cast; linarith)
    have hNinv_lt : N⁻¹ < η := (inv_lt_comm₀ hN_pos hη_pos).mpr hN_gt
    have h2Ninv_pos : 0 < (2 * N)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨q_mid, hq_mid⟩ :=
      exists_rat_btwn (by linarith : u₀ - (2 * N)⁻¹ < u₀ + (2 * N)⁻¹)
    refine ⟨(k₀, N₀, q_mid, b_pos), ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    · have h1 : η ≤ u₀ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      have h2 : η ≤ 1 - u₀ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hNinv_lt h1, by linarith⟩
    · exact ⟨by linarith [hq_mid.2], by linarith [hq_mid.1]⟩
    · rw [Set.mem_iInter]
      intro v ⟨hv1, hv2⟩
      let d : ℝ := (v : ℝ) - u₀
      have hd_pos : 0 < d := sub_pos.mpr hv1
      have hd_lt_δ₁ : dist (v : ℝ) u₀ < δ₁ := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos hd_pos]
        have hη_δ₁ : η ≤ δ₁ := min_le_right _ _
        dsimp only [d]
        linarith
      have h_err_raw := hδ₁ hd_lt_δ₁
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul] at h_err_raw
      rw [abs_of_pos hd_pos] at h_err_raw
      have hσ_err : -(k⁻¹ * d) ≤ σ * (g v - g u₀ - d * Δ) := by
        refine neg_le_of_abs_le ?_
        rw [abs_mul, hσ_abs, one_mul]
        exact h_err_raw
      have h_decomp : σ * (g v - g u₀) = (σ * Δ) * d + σ * (g v - g u₀ - d * Δ) := by ring
      rw [hσ_Δ] at h_decomp
      have h_main : 2 * k⁻¹ * d < |Δ| * d := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hΔ_gt hd_pos
      dsimp only [d] at hσ_err h_decomp h_main
      linarith

  
  have h_pullback : ∀ (S_E : Set ℝ), MeasurableSet S_E →
      ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (L_h : ℝ), 0 ≤ L_h →
        (∀ r₁ r₂ : ℝ, |h r₁ - h r₂| ≤ L_h * |r₁ - r₂|) →
        (∀ u ∈ S_E, h (g u) = u) →
        ∀ (P : ℝ → Prop), (∀ᵐ r₀ : ℝ, P r₀) →
          ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ S_E →
            P (g u₀) ∧
            (∀ Δ q : ℝ, HasDerivAt g Δ u₀ → HasDerivAt h q (g u₀) → q * Δ = 1) := by
    intro S_E hSE_meas h L_h hL_h hh_lip h_left P hP_ae
    have hP_pull : ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ S_E → P (g u₀) := by
      let B_bad : Set ℝ := { r₀ : ℝ | ¬ P r₀ }
      have hB_null : MeasureTheory.volume B_bad = 0 := MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp hP_ae
      have h_lip : LipschitzWith ⟨L_h, hL_h⟩ h := by
        refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun r₁ r₂ => ?_)
        rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
        exact hh_lip r₁ r₂
      have himg_null : MeasureTheory.volume (h '' B_bad) = 0 := by
        rw [← MeasureTheory.hausdorffMeasure_real] at hB_null ⊢
        have hle := h_lip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) B_bad
        rw [hB_null, mul_zero] at hle
        exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp hle
      rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
      refine MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null (fun u₀ hu₀ => ?_) himg_null
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred, not_imp] at hu₀
      exact ⟨g u₀, hu₀.2, h_left u₀ hu₀.1⟩
    have h_chain : ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ S_E →
        ∀ Δ q : ℝ, HasDerivAt g Δ u₀ → HasDerivAt h q (g u₀) → q * Δ = 1 := by
      filter_upwards [Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet
        MeasureTheory.volume hSE_meas] with u₀ hu₀_dens hu₀_E Δ q hg_der hh_der
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hu₀_E, Pi.one_apply] at hu₀_dens
      have hev : ∀ᶠ r in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
          (0 : ENNReal) < MeasureTheory.volume (S_E ∩ Metric.closedBall u₀ r) /
            MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall u₀ r) :=
        hu₀_dens.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds zero_lt_one)
      rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff, Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at hev
      obtain ⟨r_star, hr_star_pos, hr_star⟩ := hev
      have h_nonempty : ∀ m : ℕ,
          let r_m := min (r_star / 2) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)
          ((S_E ∩ Metric.closedBall u₀ r_m) \ {u₀}).Nonempty := by
        intro m
        dsimp only
        let r_m := min (r_star / 2) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)
        have hrm_pos : 0 < r_m := lt_min (half_pos hr_star_pos) (by positivity)
        have hrm_lt : dist r_m 0 < r_star := by
          rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hrm_pos]
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self hr_star_pos)
        have hpos := hr_star hrm_lt hrm_pos
        by_contra hemp
        have h_sub_u₀ : S_E ∩ Metric.closedBall u₀ r_m ⊆ {u₀} := by
          intro x hx
          by_contra hx_ne
          exact hemp ⟨x, hx, hx_ne⟩
        have hvol0 : MeasureTheory.volume (S_E ∩ Metric.closedBall u₀ r_m) = 0 :=
          MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null h_sub_u₀ (MeasureTheory.measure_singleton u₀)
        rw [hvol0, ENNReal.zero_div] at hpos
        exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
      choose u_seq hu_seq using h_nonempty
      have hu_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto u_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ) := by
        rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
        refine ⟨Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr (fun ε hε => ?_),
          Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun m => (hu_seq m).2)⟩
        obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt ε⁻¹
        refine ⟨M₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
        have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
        have hdist_le : dist (u_seq m) u₀ ≤ min (r_star / 2) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
          Metric.mem_closedBall.mp (hu_seq m).1.2
        have hinv_lt : (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) < ε := by
          rw [inv_lt_comm₀ hm_pos hε]
          have hM_lt : (M₀ : ℝ) < ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm
          exact lt_trans hM₀ hM_lt
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans hdist_le (min_le_right _ _)) hinv_lt
      have hcomp_der : HasDerivAt (h ∘ g) (q * Δ) u₀ := hh_der.comp u₀ hg_der
      have hslope_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => slope (h ∘ g) u₀ (u_seq m))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (q * Δ)) :=
        (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hcomp_der).comp hu_tendsto
      have hslope_one : (fun m => slope (h ∘ g) u₀ (u_seq m)) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
        ext m
        have hu_mem : u_seq m ∈ S_E := (hu_seq m).1.1
        have hu_ne : u_seq m ≠ u₀ := (hu_seq m).2
        rw [slope_def_field]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, h_left (u_seq m) hu_mem, h_left u₀ hu₀_E]
        exact div_self (sub_ne_zero.mpr hu_ne)
      rw [hslope_one] at hslope_lim
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hslope_lim tendsto_const_nhds
    filter_upwards [hP_pull, h_chain] with u₀ hu₁ hu₂ hu_E
    exact ⟨hu₁ hu_E, hu₂ hu_E⟩

  
  have h_box_lintegral : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ENNReal) (B : ENNReal),
      Measurable F → B < ⊤ → (∀ xz, F xz ≤ B) →
      ∀ (x₀ c_sh α ρ y_lo y_hi : ℝ), 0 < ρ → y_lo ≤ y_hi →
        let S : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
          { xz : ℝ × ℝ | x₀ - ρ < xz.1 ∧ xz.1 < x₀ + ρ } ∩
          { xz : ℝ × ℝ | c_sh + α * (xz.1 - x₀) + y_lo < xz.2 ∧
            xz.2 < c_sh + α * (xz.1 - x₀) + y_hi }
        (∫ x in (x₀ - ρ)..(x₀ + ρ),
          ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, (F (x, c_sh + α * (x - x₀) + y)).toReal) =
        (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ∫⁻ z : ℝ, S.indicator F (x, z)).toReal ∧
        (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ∫⁻ z : ℝ, S.indicator F (x, z)) < ⊤ ∧
        (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ∫⁻ z : ℝ, S.indicator F (x, z)) =
        (∫⁻ z : ℝ, ∫⁻ x : ℝ, S.indicator F (x, z)) := by
    intro F B hF_meas hB_lt hF_le x₀ c_sh α ρ y_lo y_hi hρ hy_le
    dsimp only
    let U_x : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := { xz : ℝ × ℝ | x₀ - ρ < xz.1 ∧ xz.1 < x₀ + ρ }
    let W : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := { xz : ℝ × ℝ |
      c_sh + α * (xz.1 - x₀) + y_lo < xz.2 ∧ xz.2 < c_sh + α * (xz.1 - x₀) + y_hi }
    let S : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := U_x ∩ W
    have hU_meas : MeasurableSet U_x :=
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const)).measurableSet
    have hW_meas : MeasurableSet W := by
      refine ((isOpen_lt ?_ continuous_snd).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_snd ?_)).measurableSet
      · fun_prop
      · fun_prop
    have hS_meas : MeasurableSet S := hU_meas.inter hW_meas
    have h_inner_bound : ∀ x : ℝ,
        (∫⁻ z : ℝ, W.indicator F (x, z)) ≤ B * ENNReal.ofReal (y_hi - y_lo) := by
      intro x
      let c_x := c_sh + α * (x - x₀)
      have h_le : (∫⁻ z : ℝ, W.indicator F (x, z)) ≤
          ∫⁻ z : ℝ, (Set.Ioo (c_x + y_lo) (c_x + y_hi)).indicator (fun _ => B) z := by
        refine MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono (fun z => ?_)
        by_cases hz : (x, z) ∈ W
        · have hz_ioo : z ∈ Set.Ioo (c_x + y_lo) (c_x + y_hi) := by
            simp only [W, Set.mem_ofPred] at hz
            exact ⟨by dsimp [c_x]; linarith, by dsimp [c_x]; linarith⟩
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Set.indicator_of_mem hz_ioo]
          exact hF_le (x, z)
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
          exact zero_le
      refine le_trans h_le ?_
      rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo, MeasureTheory.lintegral_const,
        MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ, Set.univ_inter, Real.volume_Ioo]
      have h_diff : (c_x + y_hi) - (c_x + y_lo) = y_hi - y_lo := by ring
      rw [h_diff]
    have h_inner_lt_top : ∀ x : ℝ, (∫⁻ z : ℝ, W.indicator F (x, z)) < ⊤ :=
      fun x => lt_of_le_of_lt (h_inner_bound x) (ENNReal.mul_lt_top hB_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
    have h_inner_eq : ∀ x : ℝ,
        (∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, (F (x, c_sh + α * (x - x₀) + y)).toReal) =
        (∫⁻ z : ℝ, W.indicator F (x, z)).toReal := by
      intro x
      let c_x := c_sh + α * (x - x₀)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy_le, MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
      have h_meas_y : Measurable (fun y : ℝ => (F (x, c_x + y)).toReal) :=
        (hF_meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk (measurable_const.add measurable_id))).ennreal_toReal
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg))
        h_meas_y.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict]
      rw [← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo]
      have h_ind : (fun y : ℝ =>
          (Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi).indicator (fun y' => ENNReal.ofReal (F (x, c_x + y')).toReal) y) =
          (fun y : ℝ => W.indicator F (x, c_x + y)) := by
        ext y
        have h_mem : y ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi ↔ (x, c_x + y) ∈ W := by
          simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, W, Set.mem_ofPred, c_x]
          constructor <;> intro h <;> constructor <;> linarith
        by_cases hy_in : y ∈ Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy_in, Set.indicator_of_mem (h_mem.mp hy_in)]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (lt_of_le_of_lt (hF_le _) hB_lt).ne
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy_in, Set.indicator_of_notMem (mt h_mem.mpr hy_in)]
      change (∫⁻ y : ℝ, (Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi).indicator
        (fun y' => ENNReal.ofReal (F (x, c_x + y')).toReal) y).toReal = _
      rw [h_ind]
      have h_shift := MeasureTheory.lintegral_add_left_eq_self
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (fun z : ℝ => W.indicator F (x, z)) c_x
      rw [h_shift]
    have h_outer_congr : ∀ x : ℝ,
        (Set.Ioo (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ)).indicator (fun x' => ∫⁻ z : ℝ, W.indicator F (x', z)) x =
        ∫⁻ z : ℝ, S.indicator F (x, z) := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx_in : x ∈ Set.Ioo (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx_in]
        refine MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr (fun z => ?_)
        have h_iff : (x, z) ∈ W ↔ (x, z) ∈ S := by
          simp only [S, U_x, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred]
          exact ⟨fun h => ⟨hx_in, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩
        by_cases hz : (x, z) ∈ W
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Set.indicator_of_mem (h_iff.mp hz)]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz, Set.indicator_of_notMem (mt h_iff.mpr hz)]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx_in]
        symm
        have h_zero : (fun z : ℝ => S.indicator F (x, z)) = fun _ => 0 := by
          ext z
          have h_not : (x, z) ∉ S := fun hs => hx_in hs.1
          exact Set.indicator_of_notMem h_not _
        simp [h_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp_rw [h_inner_eq]
      have hx_le : x₀ - ρ ≤ x₀ + ρ := by linarith
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx_le, MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
      have h_lint_meas : Measurable (fun x : ℝ => ∫⁻ z : ℝ, W.indicator F (x, z)) :=
        (hF_meas.indicator hW_meas).lintegral_prod_right'
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg))
        h_lint_meas.ennreal_toReal.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict]
      rw [← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo]
      congr 1
      refine MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr (fun x => ?_)
      rw [← h_outer_congr x]
      by_cases hx_in : x ∈ Set.Ioo (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx_in, Set.indicator_of_mem hx_in]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (h_inner_lt_top x).ne
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx_in, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx_in]
    · have h_le_const : (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ∫⁻ z : ℝ, S.indicator F (x, z)) ≤
          ∫⁻ x : ℝ, (Set.Ioo (x₀ - ρ) (x₀ + ρ)).indicator
            (fun _ => B * ENNReal.ofReal (y_hi - y_lo)) x := by
        refine MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono (fun x => ?_)
        rw [← h_outer_congr x]
        exact Set.indicator_le_indicator (h_inner_bound x)
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt h_le_const ?_
      rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo, MeasureTheory.lintegral_const,
        MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ, Set.univ_inter, Real.volume_Ioo]
      exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top (ENNReal.mul_lt_top hB_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top) ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    · exact MeasureTheory.lintegral_lintegral_swap (hF_meas.indicator hS_meas).aemeasurable

  have h_shear_transfer : ∀ (b₀ u₀ p q T_minus T_plus : ℝ),
      c₀ ≠ p → q * (c₀ - p) = 1 →
      HasTangentBoxTrace (fun sr => A (sr.2 - c₀ * sr.1, sr.1))
        u₀ (b₀ + c₀ * u₀) (-q) T_minus T_plus →
      HasTangentBoxTrace A b₀ u₀ p
        (if 0 < c₀ - p then T_plus else T_minus)
        (if 0 < c₀ - p then T_minus else T_plus) := by
    intro b₀ u₀ p q T_minus T_plus hc_ne hq_inv h_tr
    let Δ : ℝ := c₀ - p
    let r₀ : ℝ := b₀ + c₀ * u₀
    let C : ℝ := |Δ| + |q| + 1
    have hC_pos : 0 < C := by
      dsimp only [C]
      positivity
    let H : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ENNReal :=
      fun v ru => ENNReal.ofReal |A (ru.1 - c₀ * ru.2, ru.2) - v|
    have hH_meas : ∀ v : ℝ, Measurable (H v) := by
      intro v
      have h_arg : Measurable (fun ru : ℝ × ℝ => (ru.1 - c₀ * ru.2, ru.2)) :=
        (measurable_fst.sub (measurable_const.mul measurable_snd)).prodMk measurable_snd
      exact (continuous_abs.measurable.comp ((hA_meas.comp h_arg).sub measurable_const)).ennreal_ofReal
    have hH_le : ∀ (v : ℝ) (ru : ℝ × ℝ), H v ru ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (M + |v|) := by
      intro v ru
      refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
      have hbds := hA_bds (ru.1 - c₀ * ru.2, ru.2)
      have hv1 : -|v| ≤ v := neg_abs_le v
      have hv2 : v ≤ |v| := le_abs_self v
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hbds.1, hbds.2], by linarith [hbds.1, hbds.2]⟩
    have h_half_transfer : ∀ (v : ℝ) (w_lo_fn w_hi_fn s_lo_fn s_hi_fn : ℝ → ℝ),
        (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → w_lo_fn ρ ≤ w_hi_fn ρ) →
        (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → s_lo_fn R ≤ s_hi_fn R) →
        (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∀ u r : ℝ,
          (u₀ - ρ < u ∧ u < u₀ + ρ) ∧
            (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀) + w_lo_fn ρ < r ∧ r < r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀) + w_hi_fn ρ) →
          (r₀ - C * ρ < r ∧ r < r₀ + C * ρ) ∧
            (u₀ + q * (r - r₀) + s_lo_fn (C * ρ) < u ∧
              u < u₀ + q * (r - r₀) + s_hi_fn (C * ρ))) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun R : ℝ =>
          R⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ r in (r₀ - R)..(r₀ + R),
            ∫ s in (s_lo_fn R)..(s_hi_fn R),
              |A (r - c₀ * (u₀ - (-q) * (r - r₀) + s), u₀ - (-q) * (r - r₀) + s) - v|)
          (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ =>
          ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ),

      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ρ (hρ : 0 < ρ)
        have h_eq₁ := (h_box_lintegral F₁ B_v hF₁_meas hBv_lt (fun ur => hH_le v (ur.2, ur.1))

              ∫ w in (w_lo_fn ρ)..(w_hi_fn ρ), (F₁ (u, r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀) + w)).toReal) := by
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun u _ =>
            intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun w _ => ?_))

        rw [h_congr₁, h_eq₁]
        exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ρ (hρ : 0 < ρ)
        let R : ℝ := C * ρ
        have hR : 0 < R := mul_pos hC_pos hρ
        obtain ⟨h_eq₁, _, h_swap₁⟩ := h_box_lintegral F₁ B_v hF₁_meas hBv_lt
          (fun ur => hH_le v (ur.2, ur.1)) u₀ r₀ Δ ρ (w_lo_fn ρ) (w_hi_fn ρ) hρ (hw_le ρ hρ)
        obtain ⟨h_eq₂, h_lt₂, _⟩ := h_box_lintegral (H v) B_v (hH_meas v) hBv_lt
          (hH_le v) r₀ u₀ q R (s_lo_fn R) (s_hi_fn R) hR (hs_le R hR)
        have h_congr₁ : (∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ),

          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun u _ =>
            intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun w _ => ?_))
          dsimp only [F₁, H]
          rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (abs_nonneg _)]

          dsimp only [H]

          have h_alg : u₀ + q * (r - r₀) + s = u₀ - (-q) * (r - r₀) + s := by ring
          rw [h_alg]
        have h_int_le : (∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ),
            ∫ w in (w_lo_fn ρ)..(w_hi_fn ρ), |A (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - v|) ≤
            (∫ r in (r₀ - R)..(r₀ + R),
              ∫ s in (s_lo_fn R)..(s_hi_fn R),
                |A (r - c₀ * (u₀ - (-q) * (r - r₀) + s), u₀ - (-q) * (r - r₀) + s) - v|) := by
          rw [h_congr₁, h_eq₁, h_swap₁, h_congr₂, h_eq₂]
          refine ENNReal.toReal_mono h_lt₂.ne ?_
          refine MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono (fun r => MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono (fun u => ?_))
          by_cases h_mem : (u, r) ∈
              { xz : ℝ × ℝ | u₀ - ρ < xz.1 ∧ xz.1 < u₀ + ρ } ∩
              { xz : ℝ × ℝ | r₀ + Δ * (xz.1 - u₀) + w_lo_fn ρ < xz.2 ∧
                xz.2 < r₀ + Δ * (xz.1 - u₀) + w_hi_fn ρ }
          · have h_im : (r, u) ∈
                { xz : ℝ × ℝ | r₀ - R < xz.1 ∧ xz.1 < r₀ + R } ∩
                { xz : ℝ × ℝ | u₀ + q * (xz.1 - r₀) + s_lo_fn R < xz.2 ∧
                  xz.2 < u₀ + q * (xz.1 - r₀) + s_hi_fn R } := by
              exact h_sub ρ hρ u r h_mem
            rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h_mem, Set.indicator_of_mem h_im]
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h_mem]
            exact zero_le
        have h_coeff : ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 = C ^ 2 * R⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
          dsimp only [R]
          field_simp [hρ.ne', hC_pos.ne']
        rw [h_coeff, mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_le (sq_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have h_r_bound : ∀ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ (u r : ℝ),
        u₀ - ρ < u ∧ u < u₀ + ρ →
        -(ρ) < r - (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀)) ∧ r - (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀)) < ρ →
        (r₀ - C * ρ < r ∧ r < r₀ + C * ρ) ∧
        (-(C * ρ) < -q * (r - (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀))) ∧
          -q * (r - (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀))) < C * ρ) ∧
        u = u₀ + q * (r - r₀) + (-q * (r - (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀)))) := by
      intro ρ hρ u r hu hw
      let w : ℝ := r - (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀))
      have hu_abs : |u - u₀| < ρ := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [hu.1], by linarith [hu.2]⟩
      have hw_abs : |w| < ρ := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by dsimp [w]; linarith [hw.1], by dsimp [w]; linarith [hw.2]⟩
      have hr_diff : r - r₀ = Δ * (u - u₀) + w := by dsimp [w]; ring
      have hr_abs : |r - r₀| < C * ρ := by
        calc |r - r₀| = |Δ * (u - u₀) + w| := by rw [hr_diff]
          _ ≤ |Δ * (u - u₀)| + |w| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |Δ| * |u - u₀| + |w| := by rw [abs_mul]
          _ < |Δ| * ρ + ρ := by
              have h1 : |Δ| * |u - u₀| ≤ |Δ| * ρ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_abs.le (abs_nonneg Δ)
              linarith
          _ ≤ (|Δ| + |q| + 1) * ρ := by
              have hq_nn : 0 ≤ |q| * ρ := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg q) hρ.le
              linarith
      have hqw_abs : |-q * w| < C * ρ := by
        calc |-q * w| = |q| * |w| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_neg]
          _ ≤ |q| * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_abs.le (abs_nonneg q)
          _ < (|Δ| + |q| + 1) * ρ := by
              have h1 : 0 < (|Δ| + 1) * ρ := mul_pos (by positivity) hρ
              linarith
      have hu_id : u = u₀ + q * (r - r₀) + (-q * w) := by
        have h1 : (u₀ + q * (r - r₀) + (-q * w)) - u = (q * Δ - 1) * (u - u₀) := by
          dsimp [w]
          ring
        have hqΔ : q * Δ = 1 := hq_inv
        rw [hqΔ, sub_self, zero_mul] at h1
        linarith
      obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hr_abs
      obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hqw_abs

    by_cases hΔ_pos : 0 < c₀ - p
    · simp only [hΔ_pos, ↓reduceIte]
      have hq_pos : 0 < q := by nlinarith [hq_inv, hΔ_pos]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · refine h_half_transfer T_plus (fun ρ => -ρ) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun R => R)
          (fun ρ hρ => by linarith) (fun R hR => hR.le) ?_ h_tr.2
        intro ρ hρ u r ⟨hu, hw⟩
        obtain ⟨hr_in, hs_in, hu_id⟩ := h_r_bound ρ hρ u r hu ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2]⟩
        have hw_neg : r - (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀)) < 0 := by linarith [hw.2]
        have hs_pos : 0 < -q * (r - (r₀ + Δ * (u - u₀))) := by nlinarith
        exact ⟨hr_in, ⟨by linarith [hu_id], by linarith [hu_id, hs_in.2]⟩⟩
      · refine h_half_transfer T_minus (fun _ => 0) (fun ρ => ρ) (fun R => -R) (fun _ => 0)

        intro ρ hρ u r ⟨hu, hw⟩
        obtain ⟨hr_in, hs_in, hu_id⟩ := h_r_bound ρ hρ u r hu ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2]⟩

  let K : ℝ := max 1 (|b 0| + L_b + |c₀| + 2)
  have hK : 1 ≤ K := le_max_left _ _
  have hg_in_K : ∀ u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, g u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-K) K := by
    intro u₀ hu₀
    have h_diff := hg_lip u₀ 0
    have hu_abs : |u₀ - 0| ≤ 1 := by

      calc |g u₀ - b 0| ≤ (L_b + |c₀|) * |u₀ - 0| := h_diff
        _ ≤ (L_b + |c₀|) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_abs (add_nonneg hL_b (abs_nonneg c₀))

    obtain ⟨hl1, hl2⟩ := abs_le.mp h_le
    have hb1 : -|b 0| ≤ b 0 := neg_abs_le (b 0)
    have hb2 : b 0 ≤ |b 0| := le_abs_self (b 0)
    have hK_rhs : |b 0| + L_b + |c₀| + 2 ≤ K := le_max_right _ _
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_piece_ae : ∀ idx : ℕ × ℕ × ℚ × Bool, ∀ᵐ u₀ : ℝ, u₀ ∈ E idx →
      (g u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-K) K →
        h_inv idx (g u₀) ∈
          Set.Ioo (((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) (1 - (((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) →
        ∃ q T_minus T_plus : ℝ,
          0 ≤ T_minus ∧ T_minus ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ T_plus ∧ T_plus ≤ M ∧
          HasDerivAt (h_inv idx) q (g u₀) ∧
          HasTangentBoxTrace (fun sr => A (sr.2 - c₀ * sr.1, sr.1))
            (h_inv idx (g u₀)) (g u₀) (-q) T_minus T_plus) ∧
      (∀ Δ q : ℝ, HasDerivAt g Δ u₀ → HasDerivAt (h_inv idx) q (g u₀) → q * Δ = 1) := by
    intro idx
    let δ_idx : ℝ := (((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)
    let L_idx : ℝ := ((idx.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_idx := inv_pos.mpr hN_pos
    have hδ_lt_half : δ_idx < 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp only [δ_idx]
      rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_lt_div_iff₀ hN_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (idx.2.1 : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      push_cast
      linarith
    have hL_nn : 0 ≤ L_idx := by positivity
    have h_gr := h_graph K δ_idx hK hδ_pos hδ_lt_half
      (h_inv idx) L_idx hL_nn (hh_inv idx).1
    exact h_pullback (E idx) (hE_meas idx) (h_inv idx) L_idx hL_nn
      (hh_inv idx).1 (hh_inv idx).2 _ h_gr
  filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_all_iff.mpr h_piece_ae] with u₀ hu₀_all hu₀ p hb_der hc_ne
  have hc_der : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => c₀ * u) (c₀ * 1) u₀ :=
    (hasDerivAt_id u₀).const_mul c₀
  have hg_der : HasDerivAt g (c₀ - p) u₀ := by
    have h_sum := hb_der.add hc_der
    have h_val : -p + c₀ * 1 = c₀ - p := by ring
    rwa [h_val] at h_sum
  have hΔ_ne : c₀ - p ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hc_ne
  obtain ⟨idx, hu_E⟩ := h_cover u₀ hu₀ (c₀ - p) hΔ_ne hg_der
  have h_left_u₀ : h_inv idx (g u₀) = u₀ := (hh_inv idx).2 u₀ hu_E
  have hu_dom : h_inv idx (g u₀) ∈
      Set.Ioo (((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) (1 - (((idx.2.1 + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) := by
    rw [h_left_u₀]
    exact hu_E.1.1
  obtain ⟨h_gr_u₀, h_chain_u₀⟩ := hu₀_all idx hu_E
  obtain ⟨q, T_minus, T_plus, hTm0, hTmM, hTp0, hTpM, hq_der, h_tr_u₀⟩ :=
    h_gr_u₀ (hg_in_K u₀ hu₀) hu_dom

  have hq_inv : q * (c₀ - p) = 1 := h_chain_u₀ (c₀ - p) q hg_der hq_der
  have h_res := h_shear_transfer (b u₀) u₀ p q T_minus T_plus hc_ne hq_inv h_tr_u₀
  refine ⟨if 0 < c₀ - p then T_plus else T_minus,
    if 0 < c₀ - p then T_minus else T_plus, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, h_res⟩

(c_top M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (a_top D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (ha_meas : Measurable a_top) (hD_meas : Measurable D)
    (ha_bds : ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ a_top iu ∧ a_top iu ≤ M)

          D (i, u) * deriv (fun i' => φ (i', u)) i))

    (hD_tr : HasTangentBoxTrace D b₀ u₀ p D_minus D_plus) :
    (c_top - p) * (z_plus - z_minus) ≤ D_minus - D_plus

by
  
  have h_ii_1d : ∀ {g : ℝ → ℝ} (B : ℝ),
      Measurable g → (∀ x : ℝ, |g x| ≤ B) → ∀ a b : ℝ,
