        calc (1 : ℝ) = ρ⁻¹ * ρ := (inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne').symm
          _ ≤ ρ⁻¹ * |u - u₀| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu hρ_inv_pos.le
      obtain ⟨h0, hd0⟩ := hχ_supp _ h1
      have hF0 : ∀ i : ℝ, F i u = 0 := fun i => by simp [F, h0, hd0]
      simp [hF0]
    have h_u_split1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hG_ii δ (u₀ - ρ)) (hG_ii (u₀ - ρ) (1 - δ))
    have h_u_split2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hG_ii (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ)) (hG_ii (u₀ + ρ) (1 - δ))
    have h_u_left : (∫ u in δ..(u₀ - ρ), ∫ i in (-K)..K, F i u) = 0 := by
      have h_le : δ ≤ u₀ - ρ := by
        have : 4 * δ ≤ u₀ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
        linarith
      refine (intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun u hu => ?_)).trans
        intervalIntegral.integral_zero
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h_le] at hu
      exact hG_zero_u u ((by linarith [hu.2] : ρ ≤ -(u - u₀)).trans (neg_le_abs _))
    have h_u_right : (∫ u in (u₀ + ρ)..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K, F i u) = 0 := by
      have h_le : u₀ + ρ ≤ 1 - δ := by
        have : 4 * δ ≤ 1 - u₀ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
        linarith
      refine (intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun u hu => ?_)).trans
        intervalIntegral.integral_zero
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h_le] at hu
      exact hG_zero_u u ((by linarith [hu.1] : ρ ≤ u - u₀).trans (le_abs_self _))
    have h_mid_u_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), ∫ i in (-K)..K, F i u := by
      linarith

    let K_a : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u w =>
      (p - c_top) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)) +
        χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))
    let K_D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u w =>
      deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))
    let Φ_orig : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u w =>
      -a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) * K_a u w + D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) * K_D u w

    have h_inner_eq : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ),
        (∫ i in (-K)..K, F i u) = ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ w in (-ρ)..ρ, Φ_orig u w := by
      intro u hu
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith : u₀ - ρ ≤ u₀ + ρ)] at hu
      have hu_abs : |u - u₀| ≤ ρ := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hu.1], by linarith [hu.2]⟩
      let c_u : ℝ := b₀ - p * (u - u₀)
      have hcu_abs : |c_u| ≤ |b₀| + |p| := by
        dsimp [c_u]
        calc |b₀ - p * (u - u₀)| ≤ |b₀| + |p * (u - u₀)| := abs_sub _ _
          _ = |b₀| + |p| * |u - u₀| := by rw [abs_mul]
          _ ≤ |b₀| + |p| * 1 := add_le_add le_rfl
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (abs_nonneg p))
          _ = |b₀| + |p| := by ring
      obtain ⟨hcu1, hcu2⟩ := abs_le.mp hcu_abs
      have h_i_split1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (hF_ii_i u (-K) (c_u - ρ)) (hF_ii_i u (c_u - ρ) K)
      have h_i_split2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (hF_ii_i u (c_u - ρ) (c_u + ρ)) (hF_ii_i u (c_u + ρ) K)
      have hF_zero_i : ∀ i : ℝ, ρ ≤ |i - c_u| → F i u = 0 := by
        intro i hi
        have hr_eq : i - b₀ + p * (u - u₀) = i - c_u := by dsimp [c_u]; ring
        have h1 : 1 ≤ |ρ⁻¹ * (i - b₀ + p * (u - u₀))| := by
          rw [hr_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hρ_inv_pos]
          calc (1 : ℝ) = ρ⁻¹ * ρ := (inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne').symm
            _ ≤ ρ⁻¹ * |i - c_u| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi hρ_inv_pos.le
        obtain ⟨h0, hd0⟩ := hχ_supp _ h1
        simp [F, h0, hd0]
      have h_i_left : (∫ i in (-K)..(c_u - ρ), F i u) = 0 := by
        have h_le : -K ≤ c_u - ρ := by linarith
        refine (intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun i hi => ?_)).trans
          intervalIntegral.integral_zero
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h_le] at hi
        exact hF_zero_i i ((by linarith [hi.2] : ρ ≤ -(i - c_u)).trans (neg_le_abs _))
      have h_i_right : (∫ i in (c_u + ρ)..K, F i u) = 0 := by
        have h_le : c_u + ρ ≤ K := by linarith
        refine (intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun i hi => ?_)).trans
          intervalIntegral.integral_zero
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le h_le] at hi
        exact hF_zero_i i ((by linarith [hi.1] : ρ ≤ i - c_u).trans (le_abs_self _))
      have h_trunc : (∫ i in (-K)..K, F i u) = ∫ i in (c_u - ρ)..(c_u + ρ), F i u := by
        linarith
      rw [h_trunc]
      have h_shift := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right (fun i => F i u) c_u
        (a := -ρ) (b := ρ)
      have he1 : -ρ + c_u = c_u - ρ := by ring
      have he2 : ρ + c_u = c_u + ρ := by ring
      rw [he1, he2] at h_shift
      rw [← h_shift]
      have h_fn_eq : (fun w : ℝ => F (w + c_u) u) = (fun w : ℝ => ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * Φ_orig u w) := by
        ext w
        have hw1 : w + c_u = b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w := by dsimp [c_u]; ring
        have hw2 : (w + c_u) - b₀ + p * (u - u₀) = w := by dsimp [c_u]; ring
        dsimp only [F, Φ_orig, K_a, K_D]
        rw [hw2, hw1]
      rw [h_fn_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

    have hJ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), ∫ w in (-ρ)..ρ, Φ_orig u w := by
      have h_congr := intervalIntegral.integral_congr (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) h_inner_eq
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_congr
      linarith

    
    have h_shear_m : Measurable (fun uw : ℝ × ℝ => (b₀ - p * (uw.1 - u₀) + uw.2, uw.1)) :=
      (((measurable_const.sub (measurable_const.mul (measurable_fst.sub measurable_const))).add
        measurable_snd).prodMk measurable_fst)
    have hKa_m : Measurable (fun uw : ℝ × ℝ => K_a uw.1 uw.2) :=
      ((measurable_const.mul (hχ'_cont.measurable.comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_snd))).mul
        (hχ_cont.measurable.comp (measurable_const.mul (measurable_fst.sub measurable_const)))).add
      ((hχ_cont.measurable.comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_snd)).mul
        (hχ'_cont.measurable.comp (measurable_const.mul (measurable_fst.sub measurable_const))))
    have hKD_m : Measurable (fun uw : ℝ × ℝ => K_D uw.1 uw.2) :=
      (hχ'_cont.measurable.comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_snd)).mul
        (hχ_cont.measurable.comp (measurable_const.mul (measurable_fst.sub measurable_const)))
    have hΦ_m : Measurable (fun uw : ℝ × ℝ => Φ_orig uw.1 uw.2) :=
      ((ha_meas.comp h_shear_m).neg.mul hKa_m).add ((hD_meas.comp h_shear_m).mul hKD_m)
    have hΦ_bd : ∀ uw : ℝ × ℝ, |Φ_orig uw.1 uw.2| ≤ M * C_a + M * C_D := by
      intro ⟨u, w⟩
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hK_ker_bds (ρ⁻¹ * w) (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))
      dsimp only [Φ_orig, K_a, K_D]
      calc |-a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) *
              ((p - c_top) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)) +
                χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) +
            D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) * (deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)))|
          ≤ |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u)| *
              |(p - c_top) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)) +
                χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))| +
            |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u)| *
              |deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))| := by
            refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
            rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ M * C_a + M * C_D := add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul (ha_abs _) hk1 (abs_nonneg _) hM)
            (mul_le_mul (hD_abs _) hk2 (abs_nonneg _) hM)

    let Φ_up : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun z_s D_s u w =>
      (-z_s * K_a u w + D_s * K_D u w) +
        (C_a * |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s| +
          C_D * |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s|)
    have hΦ_le_up : ∀ z_s D_s u w : ℝ, Φ_orig u w ≤ Φ_up z_s D_s u w := by
      intro z_s D_s u w
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hK_ker_bds (ρ⁻¹ * w) (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))
      have h_id : Φ_orig u w - (-z_s * K_a u w + D_s * K_D u w) =
          -(a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s) * K_a u w +
            (D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s) * K_D u w := by
        dsimp only [Φ_orig]; ring
      have h_diff_le : -(a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s) * K_a u w +
            (D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s) * K_D u w ≤
          C_a * |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s| +
            C_D * |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s| := by
        calc -(a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s) * K_a u w +
              (D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s) * K_D u w
            ≤ |-(a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s) * K_a u w +
                (D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s) * K_D u w| := le_abs_self _
          _ ≤ |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s| * |K_a u w| +
                |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s| * |K_D u w| := by
              refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
              rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s| * C_a +
                |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s| * C_D := add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1 (abs_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk2 (abs_nonneg _))
          _ = C_a * |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - z_s| +
                C_D * |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + w, u) - D_s| := by ring
      dsimp only [Φ_up]
      linarith

    have h_cst_m : ∀ z_s D_s : ℝ,
        Measurable (fun uw : ℝ × ℝ => -z_s * K_a uw.1 uw.2 + D_s * K_D uw.1 uw.2) :=
      fun z_s D_s => (measurable_const.mul hKa_m).add (measurable_const.mul hKD_m)
    have h_cst_bd : ∀ (z_s D_s : ℝ) (uw : ℝ × ℝ),
        |-z_s * K_a uw.1 uw.2 + D_s * K_D uw.1 uw.2| ≤ |z_s| * C_a + |D_s| * C_D := by
      intro z_s D_s ⟨u, w⟩
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hK_ker_bds (ρ⁻¹ * w) (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))
      calc |-z_s * K_a u w + D_s * K_D u w|
          ≤ |z_s| * |K_a u w| + |D_s| * |K_D u w| := by
            refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
            rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ |z_s| * C_a + |D_s| * C_D := add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1 (abs_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk2 (abs_nonneg _))
    have h_err_a_m : ∀ z_s : ℝ,
        Measurable (fun uw : ℝ × ℝ => |a_top (b₀ - p * (uw.1 - u₀) + uw.2, uw.1) - z_s|) :=
      fun z_s => continuous_abs.measurable.comp ((ha_meas.comp h_shear_m).sub measurable_const)
    have h_err_a_bd : ∀ (z_s : ℝ) (uw : ℝ × ℝ),
        |(|a_top (b₀ - p * (uw.1 - u₀) + uw.2, uw.1) - z_s|)| ≤ M + |z_s| := by
      intro z_s ⟨u, w⟩
      rw [abs_abs]
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (add_le_add (ha_abs _) le_rfl)
    have h_err_D_m : ∀ D_s : ℝ,
        Measurable (fun uw : ℝ × ℝ => |D (b₀ - p * (uw.1 - u₀) + uw.2, uw.1) - D_s|) :=
      fun D_s => continuous_abs.measurable.comp ((hD_meas.comp h_shear_m).sub measurable_const)
    have h_err_D_bd : ∀ (D_s : ℝ) (uw : ℝ × ℝ),
        |(|D (b₀ - p * (uw.1 - u₀) + uw.2, uw.1) - D_s|)| ≤ M + |D_s| := by
      intro D_s ⟨u, w⟩
      rw [abs_abs]
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (add_le_add (hD_abs _) le_rfl)
    have hΦ_up_m : ∀ z_s D_s : ℝ, Measurable (fun uw : ℝ × ℝ => Φ_up z_s D_s uw.1 uw.2) :=
      fun z_s D_s => (h_cst_m z_s D_s).add
        ((measurable_const.mul (h_err_a_m z_s)).add (measurable_const.mul (h_err_D_m D_s)))
    have hCa_nn : 0 ≤ C_a := by dsimp [C_a]; positivity
    have hCD_nn : 0 ≤ C_D := by dsimp [C_D]; positivity
    have hΦ_up_bd : ∀ (z_s D_s : ℝ) (uw : ℝ × ℝ),
        |Φ_up z_s D_s uw.1 uw.2| ≤
          (|z_s| * C_a + |D_s| * C_D) + (C_a * (M + |z_s|) + C_D * (M + |D_s|)) := by
      intro z_s D_s uw
      dsimp only [Φ_up]
      refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (h_cst_bd z_s D_s uw) ?_)
      refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCa_nn (abs_nonneg _))]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (by simpa [abs_abs] using h_err_a_bd z_s uw) hCa_nn
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCD_nn (abs_nonneg _))]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (by simpa [abs_abs] using h_err_D_bd D_s uw) hCD_nn

    
    have h_dχ_neg : (∫ w in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)) = ρ := by
      have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (deriv χ) hρ_inv_ne (a := -ρ) (b := 0)
      have he1 : ρ⁻¹ * (-ρ) = -1 := by field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']
      rw [he1, mul_zero, inv_inv, smul_eq_mul, hχ_int_neg, mul_one] at h1
      exact h1
    have h_dχ_pos : (∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)) = -ρ := by
      have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (deriv χ) hρ_inv_ne (a := 0) (b := ρ)
      rw [mul_zero, inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ_pos.ne', inv_inv, smul_eq_mul, hχ_int_pos, mul_neg_one] at h2
      exact h2
    let A_m : ℝ := ∫ w in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)
    let A_p : ℝ := ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)
    have hdχ_w_ii : ∀ a b : ℝ,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun w => deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      fun a b => (hχ'_cont.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable a b
    have hχ_w_ii : ∀ a b : ℝ,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun w => χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      fun a b => (hχ_cont.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable a b

    
    have h_cst_w : ∀ u : ℝ,
        (∫ w in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), (-z_minus * K_a u w + D_minus * K_D u w)) +
          (∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, (-z_plus * K_a u w + D_plus * K_D u w)) =
        (ρ * Δ_RH) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)) -
          (z_minus * A_m + z_plus * A_p) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)) := by
      intro u
      have h_lin : ∀ z_s D_s a b : ℝ,
          ∫ w in a..b, (-z_s * K_a u w + D_s * K_D u w) =
            ((-z_s * (p - c_top) + D_s) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) *
              (∫ w in a..b, deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)) +
            (-z_s * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) *
              (∫ w in a..b, χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)) := by
        intro z_s D_s a b
        have h_fn : (fun w : ℝ => -z_s * K_a u w + D_s * K_D u w) =
            (fun w : ℝ =>
              ((-z_s * (p - c_top) + D_s) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * w) +
              (-z_s * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * w)) := by
          ext w; dsimp only [K_a, K_D]; ring
        rw [h_fn, intervalIntegral.integral_add
          ((hdχ_w_ii a b).const_mul _) ((hχ_w_ii a b).const_mul _),
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      rw [h_lin z_minus D_minus (-ρ) 0, h_lin z_plus D_plus 0 ρ, h_dχ_neg, h_dχ_pos]
      dsimp only [A_m, A_p, Δ_RH]
      ring

    let R_u : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
      ((ρ * Δ_RH) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)) -
        (z_minus * A_m + z_plus * A_p) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) +
      (C_a * (∫ r in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - z_minus|) +
        C_D * (∫ r in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - D_minus|)) +
      (C_a * (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - z_plus|) +
        C_D * (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - D_plus|))

    have h_w_le : ∀ u : ℝ, (∫ w in (-ρ)..ρ, Φ_orig u w) ≤ R_u u := by
      intro u
      have hΦ_ii_w : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun w => Φ_orig u w) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
        fun a b => h_ii_1d (M * C_a + M * C_D) (hΦ_m.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
          (fun w => hΦ_bd (u, w)) a b
      have h_sp := (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (hΦ_ii_w (-ρ) 0) (hΦ_ii_w 0 ρ)).symm
      rw [h_sp]
      have hm_neg : (∫ w in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), Φ_orig u w) ≤
          ∫ w in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), Φ_up z_minus D_minus u w :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono (by linarith)
          (h_ii_1d _ (hΦ_m.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
            (fun w => hΦ_bd (u, w)) (-ρ) 0)
          (h_ii_1d _ ((hΦ_up_m z_minus D_minus).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
            (fun w => hΦ_up_bd z_minus D_minus (u, w)) (-ρ) 0)
          (fun w => hΦ_le_up z_minus D_minus u w)
      have hm_pos : (∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, Φ_orig u w) ≤
          ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, Φ_up z_plus D_plus u w :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono hρ_pos.le
          (h_ii_1d _ (hΦ_m.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
            (fun w => hΦ_bd (u, w)) 0 ρ)
          (h_ii_1d _ ((hΦ_up_m z_plus D_plus).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
            (fun w => hΦ_up_bd z_plus D_plus (u, w)) 0 ρ)
          (fun w => hΦ_le_up z_plus D_plus u w)
      have h_up_split : ∀ z_s D_s a b : ℝ,
          (∫ w in a..b, Φ_up z_s D_s u w) =
            (∫ w in a..b, (-z_s * K_a u w + D_s * K_D u w)) +
            (C_a * (∫ r in a..b, |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - z_s|) +
              C_D * (∫ r in a..b, |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - D_s|)) := by
        intro z_s D_s a b
        have hii_c : IntervalIntegrable (fun w => -z_s * K_a u w + D_s * K_D u w)
            MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
          h_ii_1d _ ((h_cst_m z_s D_s).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
            (fun w => h_cst_bd z_s D_s (u, w)) a b
        have hii_ea : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - z_s|)
            MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
          h_ii_1d _ ((h_err_a_m z_s).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
            (fun w => h_err_a_bd z_s (u, w)) a b
        have hii_eD : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - D_s|)
            MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
          h_ii_1d _ ((h_err_D_m D_s).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
            (fun w => h_err_D_bd D_s (u, w)) a b
        dsimp only [Φ_up]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hii_c
          ((hii_ea.const_mul C_a).add (hii_eD.const_mul C_D)),
          intervalIntegral.integral_add (hii_ea.const_mul C_a) (hii_eD.const_mul C_D),
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      rw [h_up_split z_minus D_minus (-ρ) 0] at hm_neg
      rw [h_up_split z_plus D_plus 0 ρ] at hm_pos
      have hc := h_cst_w u
      dsimp only [R_u]
      linarith

    
    have hχ_u_int : (∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) = ρ * I_χ := by
      have h_eq : (fun u : ℝ => χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) =
          (fun u : ℝ => χ (ρ⁻¹ * u + (-ρ⁻¹ * u₀))) := by ext u; congr 1; ring
      rw [h_eq]
      have h3 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_add χ hρ_inv_ne (-ρ⁻¹ * u₀)
        (a := u₀ - ρ) (b := u₀ + ρ)
      have he1 : ρ⁻¹ * (u₀ - ρ) + -ρ⁻¹ * u₀ = -1 := by field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']; ring
      have he2 : ρ⁻¹ * (u₀ + ρ) + -ρ⁻¹ * u₀ = 1 := by field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']; ring
      rw [he1, he2, inv_inv, smul_eq_mul] at h3
      exact h3
    have hdχ_u_int : (∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) = 0 := by
      have h_eq : (fun u : ℝ => deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀))) =
          (fun u : ℝ => deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * u + (-ρ⁻¹ * u₀))) := by ext u; congr 1; ring
      rw [h_eq]
      have h3 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_add (deriv χ) hρ_inv_ne (-ρ⁻¹ * u₀)
        (a := u₀ - ρ) (b := u₀ + ρ)
      have he1 : ρ⁻¹ * (u₀ - ρ) + -ρ⁻¹ * u₀ = -1 := by field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']; ring
      have he2 : ρ⁻¹ * (u₀ + ρ) + -ρ⁻¹ * u₀ = 1 := by field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']; ring
      rw [he1, he2, inv_inv, smul_eq_mul, hχ_int_all, mul_zero] at h3
      exact h3

    have hii_χu : IntervalIntegrable (fun u => χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)))
        MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      (hχ_cont.comp (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))).intervalIntegrable
        _ _
    have hii_dχu : IntervalIntegrable (fun u => deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)))
        MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      (hχ'_cont.comp (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))).intervalIntegrable
        _ _
    have hii_c0 : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => (ρ * Δ_RH) * χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)) -
          (z_minus * A_m + z_plus * A_p) * deriv χ (ρ⁻¹ * (u - u₀)))
        MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      (hii_χu.const_mul _).sub (hii_dχu.const_mul _)
    have hii_eam : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => ∫ r in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - z_minus|)
        MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      h_ii_2d (M + |z_minus|) (h_err_a_m z_minus) (h_err_a_bd z_minus) (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) (-ρ) 0
    have hii_eap : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, |a_top (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - z_plus|)
        MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      h_ii_2d (M + |z_plus|) (h_err_a_m z_plus) (h_err_a_bd z_plus) (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) 0 ρ
    have hii_eDm : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => ∫ r in (-ρ)..(0 : ℝ), |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - D_minus|)
        MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      h_ii_2d (M + |D_minus|) (h_err_D_m D_minus) (h_err_D_bd D_minus) (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) (-ρ) 0
    have hii_eDp : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, |D (b₀ - p * (u - u₀) + r, u) - D_plus|)
        MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      h_ii_2d (M + |D_plus|) (h_err_D_m D_plus) (h_err_D_bd D_plus) (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) 0 ρ
    have hii_Ru : IntervalIntegrable R_u MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      (hii_c0.add ((hii_eam.const_mul C_a).add (hii_eDm.const_mul C_D))).add
        ((hii_eap.const_mul C_a).add (hii_eDp.const_mul C_D))
    have hii_Φu : IntervalIntegrable (fun u => ∫ w in (-ρ)..ρ, Φ_orig u w)
        MeasureTheory.volume (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) :=
      h_ii_2d (M * C_a + M * C_D) hΦ_m hΦ_bd (u₀ - ρ) (u₀ + ρ) (-ρ) ρ

    have h_u_mono : (∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), ∫ w in (-ρ)..ρ, Φ_orig u w) ≤
        ∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), R_u u :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono (by linarith) hii_Φu hii_Ru h_w_le
    have h_Ru_eval : ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * (∫ u in (u₀ - ρ)..(u₀ + ρ), R_u u) =
        I_χ * Δ_RH + C_a * (E_a_m ρ + E_a_p ρ) + C_D * (E_D_m ρ + E_D_p ρ) := by
      dsimp only [R_u]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
        (hii_c0.add ((hii_eam.const_mul C_a).add (hii_eDm.const_mul C_D)))
        ((hii_eap.const_mul C_a).add (hii_eDp.const_mul C_D)),
        intervalIntegral.integral_add hii_c0
          ((hii_eam.const_mul C_a).add (hii_eDm.const_mul C_D)),
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hii_χu.const_mul _) (hii_dχu.const_mul _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        hχ_u_int, hdχ_u_int,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add (hii_eam.const_mul C_a) (hii_eDm.const_mul C_D),
        intervalIntegral.integral_add (hii_eap.const_mul C_a) (hii_eDp.const_mul C_D),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      dsimp only [E_a_m, E_a_p, E_D_m, E_D_p]
      have hρ_cancel : ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * (ρ * Δ_RH * (ρ * I_χ)) = I_χ * Δ_RH := by
        field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']
      linarith [hρ_cancel]
    have h_mul_mono := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_u_mono hρ_sq_pos.le
    linarith

  
  have h_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun ρ => I_χ * Δ_RH + C_a * (E_a_m ρ + E_a_p ρ) + C_D * (E_D_m ρ + E_D_p ρ))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
      (nhds (I_χ * Δ_RH + C_a * (0 + 0) + C_D * (0 + 0))) :=
    (tendsto_const_nhds.add ((ha_tr.1.add ha_tr.2).const_mul C_a)).add
      ((hD_tr.1.add hD_tr.2).const_mul C_D)
  simp only [add_zero, mul_zero] at h_tendsto
  have h_ev : ∀ᶠ ρ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
      0 ≤ I_χ * Δ_RH + C_a * (E_a_m ρ + E_a_p ρ) + C_D * (E_D_m ρ + E_D_p ρ) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hδ_pos) h_scale_ineq
  have h_prod_nn : 0 ≤ I_χ * Δ_RH := ge_of_tendsto h_tendsto h_ev
  have hΔ_nn : 0 ≤ Δ_RH := by
    by_contra h_neg
    have h_lt : I_χ * Δ_RH < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hI_pos (lt_of_not_ge h_neg)
    linarith
  dsimp only [Δ_RH] at hΔ_nn
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ →
      ∀ (E_cap δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ E_cap → 0 < δ →
        ∃ ε_univ : ℝ, 0 < ε_univ ∧ ε_univ < 1 / 2 ∧
          ∀ (ε e : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < ε_univ → 0 ≤ e → e ≤ E_cap →
          ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
            (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
            IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s →
            stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ≤
              classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
                classicalGrowthRate γ + δ) ∧
    (∀ (ε e : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ e →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (ev : Fin N_ω → Bool),
        IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s →
        let p_E : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if ev ω then π ω else 0
        0 < p_E →
        let π_E : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => if ev ω then π ω / p_E else 0
        IsUnitBallStdLaw π_E V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
        (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π_E ω → ev ω = true) ∧
        (p_E = 1 ∧
           stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π_E T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
             classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π_E T_idx V_part A_part =
           stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
             classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ∨
         p_E < 1 ∧
           let π_Ec : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => if ev ω then 0 else π ω / (1 - p_E)
           IsUnitBallStdLaw π_Ec V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
           (stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
             classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part) -
             (3 * Real.log 2) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
             p_E * (stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π_E T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
               classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π_E T_idx V_part A_part) +
             (1 - p_E) * (stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π_Ec T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
               classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π_Ec T_idx V_part A_part))) ∧
    (∀ (ε e₁ e₂ : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ e₁ → 0 ≤ e₂ →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s →
        (stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e₁ π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e₁) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part) -
          5 * |e₂ - e₁| - 12 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
          stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e₂ π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e₂) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have h_ite_iff : ∀ {P Q : Prop} {instP : Decidable P} {instQ : Decidable Q} (a b : ℝ),
      (P ↔ Q) → @ite ℝ P instP a b = @ite ℝ Q instQ a b := by
    intro P Q instP instQ a b hPQ
    by_cases hQ : Q
    · rw [@if_pos _ instP (hPQ.mpr hQ), @if_pos _ instQ hQ]
    · rw [@if_neg _ instP (mt hPQ.mp hQ), @if_neg _ instQ hQ]
  
  have h_fin2 : ∀ i : Fin 2, i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by
    intro ⟨v, hv⟩
    rcases v with _ | ⟨_ | v⟩
    · left; rfl
    · right; rfl
    · omega
  have h_inner_2D : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ x y = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
    intro x y
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    ring
  have h_norm_sq_2D : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_perp_coord : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      (perp2D e) 0 = -(e 1) ∧ (perp2D e) 1 = e 0 := by
    intro e
    unfold perp2D
    simp
  have h_orthonorm : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      ‖perp2D e‖ = 1 ∧
      inner ℝ e e = 1 ∧
      inner ℝ (perp2D e) (perp2D e) = 1 ∧
      inner ℝ e (perp2D e) = 0 ∧
      inner ℝ (perp2D e) e = 0 ∧
      (∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        w = (inner ℝ w e) • e + (inner ℝ w (perp2D e)) • perp2D e) ∧
      (∀ α β : ℝ,
        inner ℝ (α • e + β • perp2D e) e = α ∧
        inner ℝ (α • e + β • perp2D e) (perp2D e) = β) := by
    intro e he
    have he_sq : e 0 ^ 2 + e 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← h_norm_sq_2D e, he]
      norm_num
    obtain ⟨hp0, hp1⟩ := h_perp_coord e
    have h_pnorm_sq : ‖perp2D e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [h_norm_sq_2D, hp0, hp1]
      linarith
    have h_pnorm : ‖perp2D e‖ = 1 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D e)]
    have hee : inner ℝ e e = 1 := by
      rw [h_inner_2D]
      linarith
    have hpp : inner ℝ (perp2D e) (perp2D e) = 1 := by
      rw [h_inner_2D, hp0, hp1]
      linarith
    have hep : inner ℝ e (perp2D e) = 0 := by
      rw [h_inner_2D, hp0, hp1]
      ring
    have hpe : inner ℝ (perp2D e) e = 0 := by
      rw [h_inner_2D, hp0, hp1]
      ring
    refine ⟨h_pnorm, hee, hpp, hep, hpe, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w
      ext i
      rcases h_fin2 i with rfl | rfl
      · simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h_inner_2D, hp0, hp1]
        linear_combination -(w 0) * he_sq
      · simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h_inner_2D, hp0, hp1]
        linear_combination -(w 1) * he_sq
    · intro α β
      constructor
      · rw [inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_left, hee, hpe]
        simp
      · rw [inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_left, hep, hpp]
        simp
  have h_angUnit_norm : ∀ (ε e : ℝ) (k : ℤ), ‖angUnitVec ε e k‖ = 1 := by
    intro ε e k
    have hsq : ‖angUnitVec ε e k‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [h_norm_sq_2D]
      unfold angUnitVec
      simp [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (angUnitVec ε e k)]
  have h_angUnit_rot : ∀ (ε e₁ e₂ : ℝ) (k₁ k₂ : ℤ),
      let φ₁ := ((k₁ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e₁))⁻¹
      let φ₂ := ((k₂ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e₂))⁻¹
      let u₁ := angUnitVec ε e₁ k₁
      let u₂ := angUnitVec ε e₂ k₂
      |inner ℝ u₁ u₂| ≤ 1 ∧

        · simp [hx']

        · simp [hx']

        simp_rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hx, ite_true]

          intro x

  have h_ent_card_le : ∀ (ε M : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ M →

        (∀ x : α, (∃ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω ∧ X ω = x) →
          ∃ S_x : Finset β, (S_x.card : ℝ) ≤ M ∧

      intro g
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_pos)]
      intro ω _ hω
      rw [hπ_zero_of_not_mem ω hω, zero_mul]

      have h1 := h_sum_Fpos (fun _ => 1)

      linarith

      if hx : ∃ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω ∧ X ω = x then (h_fib x hx).choose else ∅

    let mXY : α → β → ℝ := fun x y => ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, if X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0

    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [h_sum_Fpos, Finset.sum_mul]

      intro ω hω

        have h1 := h_sum_Fpos (fun ω' => if X ω' = X ω then 1 else 0)
        simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] at h1
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ Iff.rfl)).trans
          (h1.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ Iff.rfl)))
      have h_eq_mXY : finProbAt2 π X Y ω = mXY (X ω) (Y ω) := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        have h1 := h_sum_Fpos (fun ω' => if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then 1 else 0)
        simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] at h1
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ Iff.rfl)).trans

      have hpXY : 0 < mXY (X ω) (Y ω) := by

      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ub hπ_pos.le

    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt) ?_
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, h_Fpos_one, one_mul]
    have h_expand : ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * (mX (X ω) / (M * mXY (X ω) (Y ω))) =
        ∑ x ∈ ImgX, ∑ y ∈ S_fib x,
          ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, if X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y then π ω * (mX x / (M * mXY x y)) else 0 := by
      have h_step1 : ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * (mX (X ω) / (M * mXY (X ω) (Y ω))) =

            if X ω = x then π ω * (mX x / (M * mXY x (Y ω))) else 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)

        simp_rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hx, ite_true]

      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      by_cases hX : X ω = x
      · have hπ_pos : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        have hex : ∃ ω' : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω' ∧ X ω' = x := ⟨ω, hπ_pos, hX⟩
        have hy : Y ω ∈ S_fib x := by
          dsimp only [S_fib]
          rw [dif_pos hex]

        simp only [hX, true_and, Finset.sum_ite_eq, hy, ite_true]
      · simp [hX]

      rw [h_expand]
      calc ∑ x ∈ ImgX, ∑ y ∈ S_fib x,
            (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, if X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y then π ω * (mX x / (M * mXY x y)) else 0)
          ≤ ∑ x ∈ ImgX, ∑ y ∈ S_fib x, mX x / M := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y _ => ?_))
            let C_val := mX x / (M * mXY x y)
            have h_fac : (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, if X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y then
                π ω * C_val else 0) = mXY x y * C_val := by
              calc (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, if X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y then π ω * C_val else 0)
                  = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, (if X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0) * C_val :=
                    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> ring)
                _ = mXY x y * C_val := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
            rw [h_fac]
            dsimp only [C_val]
            by_cases hm0 : mXY x y = 0
            · rw [hm0, zero_mul]
              exact div_nonneg (hmX_nn x) hM_pos.le
            · have h_eq : mXY x y * (mX x / (M * mXY x y)) = mX x / M := by
                field_simp [hm0, hM_pos.ne']

            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x hx => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]

      ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (W : Fin N_ω → α) (ev : Fin N_ω → Bool),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        finCondEntropy ε π W ev ≤ Real.log 2 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁ N_ω α π W ev hπ_nn hπ_sum
    refine h_ent_card_le ε 2 hε₀ hε₁ (by norm_num) π W ev hπ_nn hπ_sum ?_
    intro x _
    exact ⟨Finset.univ, by norm_num, fun _ _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _⟩

          have hqD_inr : ∀ d₀ : Fin N₀, q_D (e_sum (Sum.inr d₀)) = (1 - p_E) * q₀_D d₀ := by
            intro d₀
            dsimp only [q_D, q, q₀_D]
            simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inr, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀),
            q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
          let E_w := ∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀), q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
          have hs_mem : E_w - I_TD ∈ S_0 := by
            refine ⟨N₁ + N₀, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
            · intro d
              rcases hx : e_sum.symm d with d₁ | d₀
              · dsimp only [b_D, a_D, e_D]; rw [hx]; exact hadm₁ d₁
              · dsimp only [b_D, a_D, e_D]; rw [hx]; exact hadm₀ d₀
            · intro tid d
              rcases hx : e_sum.symm d with d₁ | d₀
              · dsimp only [q]; rw [hx]; exact mul_nonneg hp_pos.le (hqnn₁ tid d₁)
              · dsimp only [q]; rw [hx]; exact mul_nonneg h1mp_pos.le (hqnn₀ tid d₀)
            · intro tid
              rw [← e_sum.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
              dsimp only [q]
              simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
                ← Finset.mul_sum, hqrow₁, hqrow₀, hp_Tt_eq, hp_Tf_eq, hp_T_add]
            · intro tid d hq_pos
              rcases hx : e_sum.symm d with d₁ | d₀
              · dsimp only [q, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D] at hq_pos ⊢
                rw [hx] at hq_pos ⊢
                exact hgeom₁ tid d₁ ((mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hp_pos).mp hq_pos)
              · dsimp only [q, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D] at hq_pos ⊢
                rw [hx] at hq_pos ⊢
                exact hgeom₀ tid d₀ ((mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left h1mp_pos).mp hq_pos)
          have hs_le_sup : E_w - I_TD ≤ sSup S_0 := le_csSup hS0_bdd hs_mem
          have hEw_split : E_w =
              p_E * (∑ d₁ : Fin N₁, q₁_D d₁ * ((1 + γ) * b₁ d₁ + (1 - γ) * a₁ d₁)) +
              (1 - p_E) * (∑ d₀ : Fin N₀, q₀_D d₀ * ((1 + γ) * b₀ d₀ + (1 - γ) * a₀ d₀)) := by
            dsimp only [E_w]
            rw [← e_sum.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
            congr 1
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ => ?_)
              rw [hqD_inl d₁]; dsimp only [b_D, a_D]
              simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inl]; ring
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₀ _ => ?_)
              rw [hqD_inr d₀]; dsimp only [b_D, a_D]
              simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inr]; ring
          have hITD_split : I_TD =
              p_E * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d₁ : Fin N₁,
                q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_T1 tid * q₁_D d₁))) / ell) +
              (1 - p_E) * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d₀ : Fin N₀,
                q₀ tid d₀ * Real.log (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_T0 tid * q₀_D d₀))) / ell) +
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx ev := by
            have h_row_split : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
                (∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀), q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) =
                p_E * (∑ d₁ : Fin N₁, q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_T1 tid * q₁_D d₁))) +
                (1 - p_E) * (∑ d₀ : Fin N₀, q₀ tid d₀ * Real.log (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_T0 tid * q₀_D d₀))) +
                (p_Tt tid * Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E) +
                 p_Tf tid * Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E))) := by
              intro tid
              rw [← e_sum.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
              have h_inl_sum :
                  (∑ d₁ : Fin N₁, q tid (e_sum (Sum.inl d₁)) *
                    Real.log (q tid (e_sum (Sum.inl d₁)) / (p_T tid * q_D (e_sum (Sum.inl d₁))))) =
                  p_E * (∑ d₁ : Fin N₁, q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_T1 tid * q₁_D d₁))) +
                  p_Tt tid * Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E) := by
                have h_term : ∀ d₁ : Fin N₁,
                    q tid (e_sum (Sum.inl d₁)) *
                      Real.log (q tid (e_sum (Sum.inl d₁)) / (p_T tid * q_D (e_sum (Sum.inl d₁)))) =
                    p_E * (q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_T1 tid * q₁_D d₁))) +
                    (p_E * q₁ tid d₁) * Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E) := by
                  intro d₁
                  rw [hqD_inl d₁]
                  dsimp only [q]
                  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inl]
                  by_cases hq0 : q₁ tid d₁ = 0
                  · simp [hq0]
                  · have hq_pos : 0 < q₁ tid d₁ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hqnn₁ tid d₁) (Ne.symm hq0)
                    have hpT1_pos : 0 < p_T1 tid := by
                      rw [← hqrow₁ tid]
                      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
                        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hqnn₁ tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d₁))
                    have hq1D_pos : 0 < q₁_D d₁ :=
                      lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
                        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun t' _ => hqnn₁ t' d₁) (Finset.mem_univ tid))
                    have hpTt_pos : 0 < p_Tt tid := by
                      rw [← hp_Tt_eq tid]; exact mul_pos hp_pos hpT1_pos
                    have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
                      rw [← hp_T_add tid]; linarith [hp_Tf_nn tid]
                    have h_rat : (p_E * q₁ tid d₁) / (p_T tid * (p_E * q₁_D d₁)) =
                        (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_T1 tid * q₁_D d₁)) * ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E) := by
                      rw [← hp_Tt_eq tid]
                      field_simp [hp_pos.ne', hpT1_pos.ne', hq1D_pos.ne', hpT_pos.ne']
                    rw [h_rat, Real.log_mul
                      (div_pos hq_pos (mul_pos hpT1_pos hq1D_pos)).ne'
                      (div_pos (div_pos hpTt_pos hpT_pos) hp_pos).ne']
                    ring
                simp_rw [h_term, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum,
                  hqrow₁ tid, hp_Tt_eq tid]
              have h_inr_sum :
                  (∑ d₀ : Fin N₀, q tid (e_sum (Sum.inr d₀)) *
                    Real.log (q tid (e_sum (Sum.inr d₀)) / (p_T tid * q_D (e_sum (Sum.inr d₀))))) =
                  (1 - p_E) * (∑ d₀ : Fin N₀, q₀ tid d₀ * Real.log (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_T0 tid * q₀_D d₀))) +
                  p_Tf tid * Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E)) := by
                have h_term : ∀ d₀ : Fin N₀,
                    q tid (e_sum (Sum.inr d₀)) *
                      Real.log (q tid (e_sum (Sum.inr d₀)) / (p_T tid * q_D (e_sum (Sum.inr d₀)))) =
                    (1 - p_E) * (q₀ tid d₀ * Real.log (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_T0 tid * q₀_D d₀))) +
                    ((1 - p_E) * q₀ tid d₀) * Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E)) := by
                  intro d₀
                  rw [hqD_inr d₀]
                  dsimp only [q]
                  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inr]
                  by_cases hq0 : q₀ tid d₀ = 0
                  · simp [hq0]
                  · have hq_pos : 0 < q₀ tid d₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hqnn₀ tid d₀) (Ne.symm hq0)
                    have hpT0_pos : 0 < p_T0 tid := by
                      rw [← hqrow₀ tid]
                      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
                        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hqnn₀ tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d₀))
                    have hq0D_pos : 0 < q₀_D d₀ :=
                      lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
                        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun t' _ => hqnn₀ t' d₀) (Finset.mem_univ tid))
                    have hpTf_pos : 0 < p_Tf tid := by
                      rw [← hp_Tf_eq tid]; exact mul_pos h1mp_pos hpT0_pos
                    have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
                      rw [← hp_T_add tid]; linarith [hp_Tt_nn tid]
                    have h_rat : ((1 - p_E) * q₀ tid d₀) / (p_T tid * ((1 - p_E) * q₀_D d₀)) =
                        (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_T0 tid * q₀_D d₀)) * ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E)) := by
                      rw [← hp_Tf_eq tid]
                      field_simp [h1mp_pos.ne', hpT0_pos.ne', hq0D_pos.ne', hpT_pos.ne']
                    rw [h_rat, Real.log_mul
                      (div_pos hq_pos (mul_pos hpT0_pos hq0D_pos)).ne'
                      (div_pos (div_pos hpTf_pos hpT_pos) h1mp_pos).ne']
                    ring
                simp_rw [h_term, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum,
                  hqrow₀ tid, hp_Tf_eq tid]
              rw [h_inl_sum, h_inr_sum]
              ring
            have h_mi_term :
                (∑ tid : Fin N_T, (p_Tt tid * Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E) +
                  p_Tf tid * Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E)))) / ell =
                finMutualInfo ε π T_idx ev := by
              unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
              rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
              have h_rw : (∑ tid : Fin N_T,
                  (p_Tt tid * Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E) +
                   p_Tf tid * Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E))) / ell) =
                  ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ tid : Fin N_T,

                      π ω * (Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E) / ell) else 0) +
                     (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ ev ω = false then
                      π ω * (Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E)) / ell) else 0)) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_comm]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
                rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
                have ht : (p_Tt tid * Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E)) / ell =
                    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ ev ω = true then
                      π ω * (Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E) / ell) else 0 := by
                  have h1 : (p_Tt tid * Real.log ((p_Tt tid / p_T tid) / p_E)) / ell =

                  rw [h1]; dsimp only [p_Tt]; rw [Finset.sum_mul]
                  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> ring)
                have hf : (p_Tf tid * Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E))) / ell =
                    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ ev ω = false then
                      π ω * (Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E)) / ell) else 0 := by
                  have h1 : (p_Tf tid * Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E))) / ell =
                      p_Tf tid * (Real.log ((p_Tf tid / p_T tid) / (1 - p_E)) / ell) := by ring
                  rw [h1]; dsimp only [p_Tf]; rw [Finset.sum_mul]
                  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> ring)
                rw [add_div, ht, hf]

                exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ Iff.rfl)

                · have h_z2 : (∑ tid : Fin N_T,
                      if T_idx ω = tid ∧ ev ω = false then

                    simp [hev]
                  rw [h_z2, add_zero]
                  simp only [hev, and_true, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
                  have hpTt_eq : p_Tt (T_idx ω) = finProbAt2 π T_idx ev ω := by
                    dsimp only [p_Tt]; unfold finProbAt2
                    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _
                      (and_congr_right (fun _ => by rw [hev])))
                  have hpE_eq : p_E = finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) ev ω := by
                    dsimp only [p_E]; unfold finProbAt2
                    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _
                      ⟨fun h => ⟨rfl, h.trans hev.symm⟩, fun h => h.2.trans hev⟩)
                  have hpTt_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx ev ω :=
                    lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_pos (h_prob_bounds π T_idx ev hπ_nn ω).2.2
                  rw [hpTt_eq, hpT_eq, hpU1, div_one,
                      Real.log_div (div_pos hpTt_pos hpT_pos).ne' hp_pos.ne', ← hpE_eq]
                  dsimp only [ell]
                  ring
                · have hev_f : ev ω = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hev
                  have h_z1 : (∑ tid : Fin N_T,
                      if T_idx ω = tid ∧ ev ω = true then

                    simp [hev]
                  rw [h_z1, zero_add]

                    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _

                    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)

            simp_rw [h_row_split]
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,

        rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ h1mp_pos.ne'] at h_mul2
        linarith

        have hδX_e1 : |inner ℝ δX e_dir₁| ≤ ε := by
          dsimp only [δX, x_hat]
          rw [inner_sub_left, (h_proj1 _ _).1, ← hjxb1_eq]
          have h1 := (h_dyadicReal ε (0 + 1) hε₀ hε₁).2.2.2.1 (inner ℝ x_p e_dir₁)
          have h2 := (h_dyadicReal ε (0 + 1) hε₀ hε₁).2.1
          rw [zero_add, Real.rpow_one] at h2
          linarith
        have hδX_p1_raw : |inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁)| ≤ ε ^ (e₁ + 1) := by
          dsimp only [δX, x_hat]
          rw [inner_sub_left, (h_proj1 _ _).2, ← hjxa1_eq]
          have h1 := (h_dyadicReal ε (e₁ + 1) hε₀ hε₁).2.2.2.1 (inner ℝ x_p (perp2D e_dir₁))
          have h2 := (h_dyadicReal ε (e₁ + 1) hε₀ hε₁).2.1
          linarith
        have hδX_p1_eps : |inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁)| ≤ ε := by
          refine hδX_p1_raw.trans ?_
          conv_rhs => rw [← Real.rpow_one ε]
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (by linarith)
        have hδX_p1_rot : |inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁)| ≤ ε ^ (e₂ + 1 - Δe) := by
          refine hδX_p1_raw.trans ?_
          have h_exp_le : e₂ + 1 - Δe ≤ e₁ + 1 := by
            have := min_le_left e₁ e₂
            linarith [h_e2_sub_Δ]
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 h_exp_le
        have h_pi_lt4 : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
        
        have h_mem_vb : dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ V_p e_dir₂) ∈ I_vb := by
          refine ((h_dyadicReal ε 0 hε₀ hε₁).2.2.2.2 0 1 zero_le_one).1 _ ?_
          rw [sub_zero]
          exact (abs_real_inner_le_norm V_p e_dir₂).trans
            (by rw [he2_norm, mul_one]; exact (hVA tid).1)
        have h_mem_va : dyadicRealBin ε e₂ (inner ℝ V_p (perp2D e_dir₂)) ∈ I_va kr₂ := by
          refine ((h_dyadicReal ε e₂ hε₀ hε₁).2.2.2.2
            (inner ℝ v_hat (perp2D e_dir₂)) (3 * ε ^ (e₂ - Δe)) (by positivity)).1 _ ?_
          have h_sub_in : inner ℝ V_p (perp2D e_dir₂) - inner ℝ v_hat (perp2D e_dir₂) =
              inner ℝ δV e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ (perp2D e_dir₂) +
              inner ℝ δV (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) (perp2D e_dir₂) := by
            rw [← inner_sub_left]
            change inner ℝ δV (perp2D e_dir₂) = _
            conv_lhs => rw [h_exp1 δV]
            rw [inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_left]
            simp
          rw [h_sub_in]
          have ht1 : |inner ℝ δV e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ (perp2D e_dir₂)| ≤
              (1 / 2) * (Real.pi * ε ^ (e₂ - Δe)) := by
            rw [abs_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul hδV_e1 (h_rot_ep.trans h_phi_diff) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          have ht2 : |inner ℝ δV (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) (perp2D e_dir₂)| ≤
              ε ^ (e₂ - Δe) * 1 := by
            rw [abs_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul hδV_p1 h_rot_pp (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have h_tri := abs_add_le
            (inner ℝ δV e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ (perp2D e_dir₂))
            (inner ℝ δV (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) (perp2D e_dir₂))
          have h_pow_pos : 0 < ε ^ (e₂ - Δe) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
          nlinarith
        have h_mem_xb : dyadicRealBin ε (0 + 1) (inner ℝ x_p e_dir₂) ∈ I_xb kr₂ := by
          refine ((h_dyadicReal ε (0 + 1) hε₀ hε₁).2.2.2.2
            (inner ℝ x_hat e_dir₂) (2 * ε) (by positivity)).1 _ ?_
          have h_sub_in : inner ℝ x_p e_dir₂ - inner ℝ x_hat e_dir₂ =
              inner ℝ δX e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ e_dir₂ +
              inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) e_dir₂ := by
            rw [← inner_sub_left]
            change inner ℝ δX e_dir₂ = _
            conv_lhs => rw [h_exp1 δX]
            rw [inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_left]
            simp
          rw [h_sub_in]
          have ht1 : |inner ℝ δX e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ e_dir₂| ≤ ε * 1 := by
            rw [abs_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul hδX_e1 h_rot_ee (abs_nonneg _) hε₀.le
          have hpe_le1 : |inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) e_dir₂| ≤ 1 :=
            (abs_real_inner_le_norm (perp2D e_dir₁) e_dir₂).trans
              (by rw [(h_orthonorm e_dir₁ he1_norm).1, he2_norm, mul_one])
          have ht2 : |inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) e_dir₂| ≤ ε * 1 := by
            rw [abs_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul hδX_p1_eps hpe_le1 (abs_nonneg _) hε₀.le
          have h_tri := abs_add_le
            (inner ℝ δX e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ e_dir₂)
            (inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) e_dir₂)
          linarith
        have h_mem_xa : dyadicRealBin ε (e₂ + 1) (inner ℝ x_p (perp2D e_dir₂)) ∈ I_xa kr₂ := by
          refine ((h_dyadicReal ε (e₂ + 1) hε₀ hε₁).2.2.2.2
            (inner ℝ x_hat (perp2D e_dir₂)) (5 * ε ^ (e₂ + 1 - Δe)) (by positivity)).1 _ ?_
          have h_sub_in : inner ℝ x_p (perp2D e_dir₂) - inner ℝ x_hat (perp2D e_dir₂) =
              inner ℝ δX e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ (perp2D e_dir₂) +
              inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) (perp2D e_dir₂) := by
            rw [← inner_sub_left]
            change inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₂) = _
            conv_lhs => rw [h_exp1 δX]
            rw [inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_left]
            simp
          rw [h_sub_in]
          have h_exp_prod : ε * (Real.pi * ε ^ (e₂ - Δe)) = Real.pi * ε ^ (e₂ + 1 - Δe) := by
            have h1 : ε ^ (1 : ℝ) * ε ^ (e₂ - Δe) = ε ^ (e₂ + 1 - Δe) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
              congr 1; ring
            rw [Real.rpow_one] at h1
            calc ε * (Real.pi * ε ^ (e₂ - Δe))
                = Real.pi * (ε * ε ^ (e₂ - Δe)) := by ring
              _ = Real.pi * ε ^ (e₂ + 1 - Δe) := by rw [h1]
          have ht1 : |inner ℝ δX e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ (perp2D e_dir₂)| ≤
              Real.pi * ε ^ (e₂ + 1 - Δe) := by
            rw [abs_mul, ← h_exp_prod]
            exact mul_le_mul hδX_e1 (h_rot_ep.trans h_phi_diff) (abs_nonneg _) hε₀.le
          have ht2 : |inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) (perp2D e_dir₂)| ≤
              ε ^ (e₂ + 1 - Δe) * 1 := by
            rw [abs_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul hδX_p1_rot h_rot_pp (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have h_tri := abs_add_le
            (inner ℝ δX e_dir₁ * inner ℝ e_dir₁ (perp2D e_dir₂))
            (inner ℝ δX (perp2D e_dir₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e_dir₁) (perp2D e_dir₂))
          have h_pow_pos : 0 < ε ^ (e₂ + 1 - Δe) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
          nlinarith
        
        dsimp only [S_box]
        rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
        refine ⟨kr₂, hkr2_mem, ?_⟩
        dsimp only [boxAt, G₂, stdApertureObs]
        simp only [h_sub2, hkt_eq]
        change (kt₁, kr₂,
          dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ V_p e_dir₂),
          dyadicRealBin ε e₂ (inner ℝ V_p (perp2D e_dir₂)),
          dyadicRealBin ε (0 + 1) (inner ℝ x_p e_dir₂),
          dyadicRealBin ε (e₂ + 1) (inner ℝ x_p (perp2D e_dir₂))) ∈
          ({kt₁} : Finset ℤ) ×ˢ (({kr₂} : Finset ℤ) ×ˢ
            (I_vb ×ˢ (I_va kr₂ ×ˢ (I_xb kr₂ ×ˢ I_xa kr₂))))
        simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton, true_and]
        exact ⟨h_mem_vb, h_mem_va, h_mem_xb, h_mem_xa⟩
    
    have h_log_M_ub : Real.log M_fib / ell ≤ 3 * Δe + 12 / ell := by
      dsimp only [M_fib]
      have h_pow_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-3 * Δe) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
      rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) h_pow_pos.ne',
          Real.log_pow, Real.log_rpow hε₀]
      have h_log_inv_eq : (-3 * Δe) * Real.log ε = 3 * Δe * ell := by
        dsimp only [ell]
        rw [Real.log_inv]
        ring
      rw [h_log_inv_eq]
      have h12_le : ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ 12 := by
        push_cast; linarith [h_log2_le1]
      have h_sum_le : ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + 3 * Δe * ell ≤ 12 + 3 * Δe * ell := by
        linarith
      calc (((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + 3 * Δe * ell) / ell
          ≤ (12 + 3 * Δe * ell) / ell := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sum_le hell_pos.le
        _ = 12 / ell + (3 * Δe * ell) / ell := add_div _ _ _
        _ = 3 * Δe + 12 / ell := by
            rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hell_pos.ne']
            ring
    have h_mi_diff :
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G₂ - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G₁ ≤ 3 * Δe + 12 / ell :=
      h_mi_le_cond.trans (h_cond_le.trans h_log_M_ub)
    have h_root_lip := (h_root_props ε hε₀ hε₁ π T_idx V_part A_part hπ_nn hπ_sum hVA).2
      (1 + e₁) (1 + e₂) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h_sub_1e : (1 + e₂) - (1 + e₁) = e₂ - e₁ := by ring
    rw [h_sub_1e] at h_root_lip
    unfold stdApertureScore
    change (((1 + γ) * 0 + (1 - γ) * e₁ - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G₁ +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε 1 (c_s ω))) -
        classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e₁) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part) -
        5 * |e₂ - e₁| - 12 / ell ≤
      ((1 + γ) * 0 + (1 - γ) * e₂ - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G₂ +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε 1 (c_s ω))) -
        classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e₂) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part
    dsimp only [Δe] at h_mi_diff
    rcases le_or_gt e₂ e₁ with h_le | h_gt
    · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith)] at h_mi_diff h_root_lip
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
      have h_lin : -(5 * (e₁ - e₂)) ≤ (1 - γ) * (e₂ - e₁) := by nlinarith
      linarith
    · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith)] at h_mi_diff h_root_lip
      rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      have h_lin : 0 ≤ (1 - γ) * (e₂ - e₁) := by nlinarith
      linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(γ η : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hη : 0 < η)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (h_gt : γ < classicalGrowthRate γ) :
    ∃ E_max : ℝ, 1 ≤ E_max ∧
      ∀ ε_cap : ℝ, 0 < ε_cap → ε_cap < 1 / 2 →
        ∃ (ε e : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
          (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
          (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
          (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
          0 < ε ∧ ε < ε_cap ∧ 0 ≤ e ∧ e ≤ E_max ∧
          IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
            classicalGrowthRate γ - η ≤
            stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s

(γ η : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hη : 0 < η)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_dur_scale : ∀ (ε t e_raw : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < t →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        stdApertureScore (ε ^ t) γ 1 0 (e_raw / t) π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s =
          t⁻¹ * stdApertureScore ε γ t 0 e_raw π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
        classicalRootSupremum (ε ^ t) (1 + e_raw / t) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part =
          t⁻¹ * classicalRootSupremum ε (e_raw + t) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part := by
    intro ε t e_raw hε0 ht N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s
    have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
    have h_log_scale : Real.log ((ε ^ t)⁻¹) = t * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_rpow hε0, Real.log_inv]
      ring
    have h_div_scale : ∀ z : ℝ, z / Real.log ((ε ^ t)⁻¹) = t⁻¹ * (z / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
      intro z
      rw [h_log_scale, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    have h_time_lvl : ∀ u : ℝ, dyadicTimeLevel (ε ^ t) (u / t) = dyadicTimeLevel ε u := by
      intro u
      unfold dyadicTimeLevel
      have hexp : (ε ^ t) ^ (-(u / t)) = ε ^ (-u) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε0.le]
        congr 1
        field_simp [ht_ne]
      rw [hexp]
    have h_time_lvl_1 : dyadicTimeLevel (ε ^ t) 1 = dyadicTimeLevel ε t := by
      have h1 := h_time_lvl t
      rwa [div_self ht_ne] at h1
    have h_time_bin : ∀ c : ℝ, dyadicTimeBin (ε ^ t) 1 c = dyadicTimeBin ε t c := by
      intro c
      unfold dyadicTimeBin
      rw [h_time_lvl_1]
    have h_time_mid : ∀ c : ℝ, dyadicTimeMid (ε ^ t) 1 c = dyadicTimeMid ε t c := by
      intro c
      unfold dyadicTimeMid
      rw [h_time_lvl_1, h_time_bin]
    have h_ang_lvl : dyadicTimeLevel (ε ^ t) (e_raw / t - 0) = dyadicTimeLevel ε (e_raw - 0) := by
      rw [sub_zero, sub_zero]
      exact h_time_lvl e_raw
    have h_ang_bin : ∀ θ : ℝ, angBin (ε ^ t) (e_raw / t - 0) θ = angBin ε (e_raw - 0) θ := by
      intro θ
      unfold angBin
      rw [h_ang_lvl]
    have h_ang_vec : ∀ k : ℤ, angUnitVec (ε ^ t) (e_raw / t - 0) k = angUnitVec ε (e_raw - 0) k := by
      intro k
      unfold angUnitVec
      rw [h_ang_lvl]
    have h_real_lvl : ∀ L_d : ℝ, dyadicRealLevel (ε ^ t) (L_d / t) = dyadicRealLevel ε L_d := by
      intro L_d
      unfold dyadicRealLevel
      have harg : (L_d / t) * (Real.log ((ε ^ t)⁻¹) / Real.log 2) =
          L_d * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := by
        rw [h_log_scale]
        field_simp [ht_ne]
      rw [harg]
    have h_real_bin : ∀ (L_d x : ℝ), dyadicRealBin (ε ^ t) (L_d / t) x = dyadicRealBin ε L_d x := by
      intro L_d x
      unfold dyadicRealBin
      rw [h_real_lvl]
    have h_rb0 : ∀ x : ℝ, dyadicRealBin (ε ^ t) 0 x = dyadicRealBin ε 0 x := by
      intro x
      simpa [zero_div] using h_real_bin 0 x
    have h_obs_eq : ∀ (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c θ : ℝ),
        stdApertureObs (ε ^ t) 1 0 (e_raw / t) V_p A_p c θ =
          stdApertureObs ε t 0 e_raw V_p A_p c θ := by
      intro V_p A_p c θ
      unfold stdApertureObs
      have hd3 : (0 : ℝ) + 1 = (0 + t) / t := by field_simp [ht_ne]; ring
      have hd4 : e_raw / t + 1 = (e_raw + t) / t := by field_simp [ht_ne]
      simp only [h_time_bin, h_time_mid, h_ang_bin, h_ang_vec, hd3, hd4, h_real_bin, h_rb0]
    have h_ent_scale : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        finCondEntropy (ε ^ t) π X Y = t⁻¹ * finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
      intro α β X Y
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      rw [h_div_scale]
      ring
    have h_mi_scale : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        finMutualInfo (ε ^ t) π X Y = t⁻¹ * finMutualInfo ε π X Y := by
      intro α β X Y
      unfold finMutualInfo
      rw [h_ent_scale, h_ent_scale]
      ring
    constructor
    · unfold stdApertureScore
      have h_obs_fn :
          (fun ω => stdApertureObs (ε ^ t) 1 0 (e_raw / t) (V_part (T_idx ω))
            (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)) =
          (fun ω => stdApertureObs ε t 0 e_raw (V_part (T_idx ω))
            (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)) :=
        funext (fun ω => h_obs_eq _ _ _ _)
      have h_tbin_fn :
          (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin (ε ^ t) 1 (c_s ω)) =
          (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε t (c_s ω)) :=
        funext (fun ω => h_time_bin _)
      rw [h_obs_fn, h_tbin_fn, h_mi_scale, h_ent_scale]
      field_simp [ht_ne]
      ring
    · let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
      let S₁ : Set ℝ := { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ 1 + e_raw / t ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ t) ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ t) ^ (a_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ t) ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ t) ^ (a_D d)) ∧
          (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
           let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
             q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / Real.log ((ε ^ t)⁻¹)
           let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
           s = E_w - I_TD) }
      let S_t : Set ℝ := { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ e_raw + t ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
          (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
           let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
             q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)
           let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
           s = E_w - I_TD) }
      have h_root1_eq :
          classicalRootSupremum (ε ^ t) (1 + e_raw / t) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part =
            sSup S₁ := rfl
      have h_roott_eq :
          classicalRootSupremum ε (e_raw + t) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part =
            sSup S_t := rfl
      have h_set_eq : S₁ = (fun y => t⁻¹ * y) '' S_t := by
        ext s'
        simp only [Set.mem_image]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨N_D, b'_D, a'_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, hd_adm, hq_nn, hq_row, hq_geom, hs'_eq⟩
          let b_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => t * b'_D d
          let a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => t * a'_D d
          let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
          let num : ℝ := ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))
          let E_w_t : ℝ := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
          refine ⟨E_w_t - num / Real.log (ε⁻¹), ?_, ?_⟩
          · refine ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, ?_, hq_nn, hq_row, ?_, rfl⟩
            · intro d
              obtain ⟨hb0, hba, ha_ub, he1⟩ := hd_adm d
              have ha_t : t * a'_D d ≤ e_raw + t := by
                have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha_ub ht.le
                have hrhs : t * (1 + e_raw / t) = e_raw + t := by field_simp [ht_ne]; ring
                rwa [hrhs] at hm
              exact ⟨mul_nonneg ht.le hb0, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hba ht.le, ha_t, he1⟩
            · intro tid d hq_pos
              obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := hq_geom tid d hq_pos
              rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε0.le] at hc1 hc2 hc3 hc4
              exact ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩
          · dsimp only at hs'_eq
            rw [hs'_eq]
            have hEw : E_w_t = t * ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d *
                ((1 + γ) * b'_D d + (1 - γ) * a'_D d) := by
              dsimp only [E_w_t, b_D, a_D]
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
              ring
            rw [hEw, h_div_scale num]
            dsimp only [q_D, num]
            field_simp [ht_ne]
        · rintro ⟨s, ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, hd_adm, hq_nn, hq_row, hq_geom, hs_eq⟩, rfl⟩
          let b'_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => b_D d / t
          let a'_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => a_D d / t
          let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
          let num : ℝ := ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))
          refine ⟨N_D, b'_D, a'_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, ?_, hq_nn, hq_row, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro d
            obtain ⟨hb0, hba, ha_ub, he1⟩ := hd_adm d
            have ha_div : a_D d / t ≤ 1 + e_raw / t := by
              calc a_D d / t ≤ (e_raw + t) / t := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ha_ub ht.le
                _ = 1 + e_raw / t := by field_simp [ht_ne]; ring
            exact ⟨div_nonneg hb0 ht.le, div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hba ht.le, ha_div, he1⟩
          · intro tid d hq_pos
            obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := hq_geom tid d hq_pos
            have hrpow : ∀ u : ℝ, (ε ^ t) ^ (u / t) = ε ^ u := by
              intro u
              rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε0.le, mul_div_cancel₀ _ ht_ne]
            dsimp only [b'_D, a'_D]
            rw [hrpow, hrpow]
            exact ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩
          · dsimp only at hs_eq ⊢
            rw [hs_eq]
            have hEw : (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b'_D d + (1 - γ) * a'_D d)) =
                t⁻¹ * ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) := by
              dsimp only [b'_D, a'_D]
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
              field_simp [ht_ne]
            rw [hEw, h_div_scale num]
            ring
      open scoped Pointwise in
      have h_smul : (fun y => t⁻¹ * y) '' S_t = t⁻¹ • S_t := rfl
      rw [h_root1_eq, h_roott_eq, h_set_eq, h_smul,
        Real.sSup_smul_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr ht.le), smul_eq_mul]

  
  let β : ℝ := classicalGrowthRate γ
  have hβ_pos : 0 < β := lt_trans hγ₀ h_gt
  have h_bdd : BddBelow (ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ) := ⟨0, fun _ hb => hb.1⟩
  have hβ_le2 : β ≤ 2 := csInf_le h_bdd h_two
  let η₀ : ℝ := min (β / 2) (η / 2)
  have hη₀_pos : 0 < η₀ := lt_min (half_pos hβ_pos) (half_pos hη)
  have hη₀_le_β : η₀ ≤ β / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hη₀_le_η : η₀ ≤ η / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  let b_low : ℝ := β - η₀
  have hb_low_nn : 0 ≤ b_low := by dsimp only [b_low]; linarith
  have hb_low_le2 : b_low ≤ 2 := by dsimp only [b_low]; linarith
  have h_gap : β - η ≤ b_low := by dsimp only [b_low]; linarith

  
  by_contra h_no_sat
  have hb_mem : b_low ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ := by
    refine ⟨hb_low_nn, hb_low_le2, ?_⟩
    intro B_cl K_hor t_min δ_cl hB hK ht_min ht_K hδ
    let E_max : ℝ := max 1 (K_hor / t_min)
    have hE_max : 1 ≤ E_max := le_max_left 1 (K_hor / t_min)
    have h_ex_cap : ∃ ε_cap : ℝ, 0 < ε_cap ∧ ε_cap < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε' e' : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
          (π' : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
          (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
          (V' A' : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
          0 < ε' → ε' < ε_cap → 0 ≤ e' → e' ≤ E_max →
          IsUnitBallStdLaw π' V' A' c_s θ_s →
          stdApertureScore ε' γ 1 0 e' π' T_idx V' A' c_s θ_s <
            classicalRootSupremum ε' (1 + e') γ N_ω N_T π' T_idx V' A' + β - η := by
      by_contra h_all
      apply h_no_sat
      refine ⟨E_max, hE_max, fun ε_cap h0 h1 => ?_⟩
      by_contra h_no_wit
      apply h_all
      refine ⟨ε_cap, h0, h1, fun ε' e' N_ω N_T π' T_idx V' A' c_s θ_s
        hε'0 hε'1 he'0 he'1 h_law => lt_of_not_ge fun h_ge => h_no_wit ?_⟩
      exact ⟨ε', e', N_ω, N_T, π', T_idx, V', A', c_s, θ_s,
        hε'0, hε'1, he'0, he'1, h_law, h_ge⟩
    obtain ⟨ε_cap, hε_cap0, hε_cap1, h_no_wit⟩ := h_ex_cap
    let ξ : ℝ := δ_cl * t_min / 4
    have hξ_pos : 0 < ξ := by dsimp only [ξ]; positivity
    let C₁ : ℝ := 4 * Real.log ((2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
      4 * Real.log ((⌊K_hor / ξ⌋₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1
    let C₂ : ℝ := 2 * Real.log ((2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 12
    let C_tot : ℝ := C₁ + C₂ + 23
    have hC_tot_pos : 0 < C_tot := by
      have hlog1 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 1))
      have hlog2 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((⌊K_hor / ξ⌋₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ ⌊K_hor / ξ⌋₊ + 1))
      have hlog3 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 2))
      dsimp only [C_tot, C₁, C₂]
      linarith
    let ε₀ : ℝ :=
      min (min (1 / 4) (ε_cap ^ (t_min⁻¹))) (Real.exp (-(2 * C_tot / (δ_cl * t_min))))
    have hε₀_pos : 0 < ε₀ :=
      lt_min (lt_min (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_cap0 _)) (Real.exp_pos _)
    have hε₀_lt : ε₀ < 1 / 2 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, ?_⟩
    intro ε t L Δ_time hε0 hε_lt_ε₀ ht_ge htL hLK hΔ_lo _hΔ_hi
      N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx V_part A_part b_G a_G e_G V_G X_G k_G
      hπ_nn hπ_sum hVA hG_adm h_supp
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le ht_min ht_ge
    have hε_lt_qtr : ε < 1 / 4 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_ε₀ (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hε_lt_rpow : ε < ε_cap ^ (t_min⁻¹) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_ε₀ (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have hε_lt_exp : ε < Real.exp (-(2 * C_tot / (δ_cl * t_min))) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_ε₀ (min_le_right _ _)
    have hε_lt_half : ε < 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have hε_le_one : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hεt_pos : 0 < ε ^ t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε0 t
    have hεt_lt_cap : ε ^ t < ε_cap := by
      have h1 : ε ^ t ≤ ε ^ t_min := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε0 hε_le_one ht_ge
      have h2 : ε ^ t_min < (ε_cap ^ (t_min⁻¹)) ^ t_min :=
        Real.rpow_lt_rpow hε0.le hε_lt_rpow ht_min
      have h3 : (ε_cap ^ (t_min⁻¹)) ^ t_min = ε_cap := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε_cap0.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht_min.ne', Real.rpow_one]
      linarith
    let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have h_err_tot : C_tot / ell ≤ (δ_cl / 2) * t := by
      have hlog_lt : Real.log ε < -(2 * C_tot / (δ_cl * t_min)) := by
        calc Real.log ε < Real.log (Real.exp (-(2 * C_tot / (δ_cl * t_min)))) :=
              Real.log_lt_log hε0 hε_lt_exp
          _ = -(2 * C_tot / (δ_cl * t_min)) := Real.log_exp _
      have hell_eq : ell = -Real.log ε := Real.log_inv ε
      have hδt_pos : 0 < δ_cl * t_min := mul_pos hδ ht_min
      have hdiv_pos : 0 < 2 * C_tot / (δ_cl * t_min) := div_pos (by linarith) hδt_pos
      have hell_gt : 2 * C_tot / (δ_cl * t_min) < ell := by linarith
      have hell_pos : 0 < ell := lt_trans hdiv_pos hell_gt
      have hmul_gt : 2 * C_tot < ell * (δ_cl * t_min) := (div_lt_iff₀ hδt_pos).mp hell_gt
      have h_le_min : C_tot / ell ≤ (δ_cl / 2) * t_min :=
        (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      exact le_trans h_le_min (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_ge (by positivity))
    have h2ξ_le : 2 * ξ ≤ (δ_cl / 2) * t := by
      have h_eq : 2 * ξ = (δ_cl / 2) * t_min := by dsimp only [ξ]; ring
      rw [h_eq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_ge (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨b_star, a_star, π₁, V₁, A₁, V_G1, X_G1,
        hb₀, hba, hat_L, hπ₁_nn, hπ₁_sum, hVA₁, h_supp₁, h_s1⟩ :=
      unit_ball_mesh_shape_reduction γ B_cl K_hor ε t L Δ_time ξ
        hγ₀ hγ₁ hB hK hε0 hε_lt_half ht_pos htL hLK hξ_pos
        π T_idx k_time G_idx V_part A_part b_G a_G e_G V_G X_G k_G
        hπ_nn hπ_sum hVA hG_adm h_supp
    obtain ⟨c_s, θ_s, h_law₁, h_s2⟩ :=
      fixed_shape_to_std_aperture_transfer γ B_cl ε t Δ_time b_star a_star
        hγ₀ hγ₁ hB hε0 hε_lt_half ht_pos hΔ_lo hb₀ hba
        π₁ T_idx k_time G_idx V₁ A₁ e_G V_G1 X_G1 k_G
        hπ₁_nn hπ₁_sum hVA₁ (fun g => (hG_adm g).2.2.2) h_supp₁
    obtain ⟨π₂, V₂, A₂, h_law₂, h_s3⟩ :=
      isotropic_prefix_std_localization γ ε t b_star a_star
        hγ₀ hγ₁ hε0 hε_lt_half ht_pos hb₀ hba
        π₁ T_idx V₁ A₁ c_s θ_s h_law₁
    let e_raw : ℝ := a_star - b_star
    let e' : ℝ := e_raw / t
    have he_raw_nn : 0 ≤ e_raw := sub_nonneg.mpr hba
    have he'_nn : 0 ≤ e' := div_nonneg he_raw_nn ht_pos.le
    have he'_ub : e' ≤ E_max := by
      have he_raw_le : e_raw ≤ K_hor := by
        dsimp only [e_raw]
        linarith
      have h1 : e_raw / t ≤ K_hor / t := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right he_raw_le ht_pos.le
      have h2 : K_hor / t ≤ K_hor / t_min :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) ht_min ht_ge
      exact le_trans h1 (le_trans h2 (le_max_right 1 (K_hor / t_min)))
    obtain ⟨h_sc_score, h_sc_root⟩ :=
      h_dur_scale ε t e_raw hε0 ht_pos π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ c_s θ_s
    have h_exc_scale :
        stdApertureScore ε γ t 0 e_raw π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ c_s θ_s -
          classicalRootSupremum ε (e_raw + t) γ N_ω N_T π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ =
        t * (stdApertureScore (ε ^ t) γ 1 0 e' π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ c_s θ_s -
          classicalRootSupremum (ε ^ t) (1 + e') γ N_ω N_T π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂) := by
      dsimp only [e'] at h_sc_score h_sc_root ⊢
      rw [h_sc_score, h_sc_root]
      field_simp [ht_pos.ne']
    have h_viol_inst :=
      h_no_wit (ε ^ t) e' N_ω N_T π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ c_s θ_s
        hεt_pos hεt_lt_cap he'_nn he'_ub h_law₂
    have h_exc_ub :
        t * (stdApertureScore (ε ^ t) γ 1 0 e' π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ c_s θ_s -
          classicalRootSupremum (ε ^ t) (1 + e') γ N_ω N_T π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂) ≤
        b_low * t := by
      have h_diff_le :
          stdApertureScore (ε ^ t) γ 1 0 e' π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ c_s θ_s -
            classicalRootSupremum (ε ^ t) (1 + e') γ N_ω N_T π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ ≤ b_low := by
        linarith
      calc t * (stdApertureScore (ε ^ t) γ 1 0 e' π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂ c_s θ_s -
              classicalRootSupremum (ε ^ t) (1 + e') γ N_ω N_T π₂ T_idx V₂ A₂)
          ≤ t * b_low := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_le ht_pos.le
        _ = b_low * t := mul_comm t b_low
    have h_sum_C : C₁ / ell + C₂ / ell + 23 / ell = C_tot / ell := by
      dsimp only [C_tot]
      ring
    dsimp only [C₁, C₂, ell] at h_sum_C
    dsimp only [ell] at h_err_tot
    dsimp only [e_raw] at h_exc_scale
    linarith [h_s1, h_s2, h_s3, h_exc_scale, h_exc_ub, h_sum_C, h_err_tot, h2ξ_le]

  
  have h_le : classicalGrowthRate γ ≤ b_low := csInf_le h_bdd hb_mem
  dsimp only [b_low, β] at h_le
  linarith [h_le, hη₀_pos]

subgoal_signatures.name: unit_ball_mesh_shape_reduction
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ B_cl K_hor ε t L Δ_time ξ : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hB : 1 ≤ B_cl) (hK : 1 ≤ K_hor)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htL : t ≤ L) (hLK : L ≤ K_hor)
    (hξ : 0 < ξ)
    {N_ω N_T N_G : ℕ}
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ)
    (G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (b_G a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ)
    (e_G V_G X_G : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (k_G : Fin N_G → ℤ)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω)
    (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1)
    (hVA : ∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl)
    (hG_adm : ∀ g, 0 ≤ b_G g ∧ b_G g ≤ a_G g ∧ a_G g + t ≤ L ∧ ‖e_G g‖ = 1)
    (h_supp : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
      let tid := T_idx ω
      let g := G_idx ω
      let c_mid := ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time
      c_mid ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      k_G g = k_time ω ∧
      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (e_G g)| ≤
        B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g + t) ∧
      |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤
        B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g + t)) :
    ∃ (b_star a_star : ℝ)
      (π₁ : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (V₁ A₁ : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (V_G1 X_G1 : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 ≤ b_star ∧ b_star ≤ a_star ∧ a_star + t ≤ L ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π₁ ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π₁ ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid, ‖V₁ tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A₁ tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π₁ ω →
        let tid := T_idx ω
        let g := G_idx ω
        let c_mid := ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time
        c_mid ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        k_G g = k_time ω ∧
        |inner ℝ (V₁ tid - V_G1 g) (e_G g)| ≤ ε ^ b_star ∧
        |inner ℝ (V₁ tid - V_G1 g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ ε ^ a_star ∧
        |inner ℝ ((A₁ tid + c_mid • V₁ tid) - X_G1 g) (e_G g)| ≤
          ε ^ (b_star + t) ∧
        |inner ℝ ((A₁ tid + c_mid • V₁ tid) - X_G1 g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤
          ε ^ (a_star + t)) ∧
      classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx b_G a_G -
        classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ≤
      classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π₁ T_idx k_time G_idx
          (fun _ => b_star) (fun _ => a_star) -

noncomputable def stdRootObs (ε e : ℝ)
    (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (θ_s : ℝ) :
    ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let k_r := angBin ε e θ_s
  let e_dir := angUnitVec ε e k_r
  (k_r,
    dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ V_p e_dir),
    dyadicRealBin ε e (inner ℝ V_p (perp2D e_dir)),
    dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ A_p e_dir),
    dyadicRealBin ε e (inner ℝ A_p (perp2D e_dir)))

noncomputable def rootCellVecV (ε e : ℝ) (d : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let e_dir := angUnitVec ε e d.1
  (((d.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 0) • e_dir +
    (((d.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε e) • perp2D e_dir

    (((d.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε e) • perp2D e_dir

open Classical in
noncomputable def replicaSepTag (ε e : ℝ) (k₁ k₂ : ℤ) : ℕ :=
  let s := |inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e k₁) (perp2D (angUnitVec ε e k₂))|
  if s ≤ ε ^ e then ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 1
  else min ⌊4 * (-Real.log s / Real.log (ε⁻¹))⌋₊ ⌊4 * e⌋₊

noncomputable def replicaSepDepth (e : ℝ) (kt : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if kt = ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 1 then e else (kt : ℝ) / 4

noncomputable def replicaCommonCell (ε e : ℝ) (kt : ℕ)
    (d₁ : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) : ℕ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let v := replicaSepDepth e kt
  let m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
  let m_v := dyadicTimeLevel ε v
  let k_c := d₁.1 / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m_e - m_v))
  let e_c := angUnitVec ε v k_c
  let V₁ := rootCellVecV ε e d₁
  let A₁ := rootCellVecA ε e d₁
  (kt, k_c,
    dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ V₁ e_c),
    dyadicRealBin ε v (inner ℝ V₁ (perp2D e_c)),
    dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ A₁ e_c),
    dyadicRealBin ε v (inner ℝ A₁ (perp2D e_c)))

open Classical in
noncomputable def twoReplicaProb {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T) (ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω)) : ℝ :=
  let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
  let p_T := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = T_idx p.1 then π ω else 0
  if T_idx p.1 = T_idx p.2 ∧ 0 < p_T then (π p.1 * π p.2) / p_T else 0

def twoReplicaT {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω)) : Fin N_T :=
  T_idx (finProdFinEquiv.symm ij).1

open Classical in
noncomputable def twoReplicaTailProb {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (ε e thresh : ℝ)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T) (θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
    let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
    if thresh <
        replicaSepDepth e
          (replicaSepTag ε e (angBin ε e (θ_s p.1)) (angBin ε e (θ_s p.2)))
    then twoReplicaProb π T_idx ij else 0

noncomputable def rootCellVecA (ε e : ℝ) (d : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :
