  let e_dir := angUnitVec ε e d.1
  (((d.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 0) • e_dir +
    (((d.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε e) • perp2D e_dir

open Classical in
noncomputable def replicaSepTag (ε e : ℝ) (k₁ k₂ : ℤ) : ℕ :=
  let s := |inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e k₁) (perp2D (angUnitVec ε e k₂))|
  if s ≤ ε ^ e then ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 1
  else min ⌊4 * (-Real.log s / Real.log (ε⁻¹))⌋₊ ⌊4 * e⌋₊

noncomputable def replicaSepDepth (e : ℝ) (kt : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if kt = ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 1 then e else (kt : ℝ) / 4

noncomputable def replicaCommonCell (ε e : ℝ) (kt : ℕ)
    (d₁ : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) : ℕ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let v := replicaSepDepth e kt
  let m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
  let m_v := dyadicTimeLevel ε v
  let k_c := d₁.1 / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m_e - m_v))
  let e_c := angUnitVec ε v k_c
  let V₁ := rootCellVecV ε e d₁
  let A₁ := rootCellVecA ε e d₁
  (kt, k_c,
    dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ V₁ e_c),
    dyadicRealBin ε v (inner ℝ V₁ (perp2D e_c)),
    dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ A₁ e_c),
    dyadicRealBin ε v (inner ℝ A₁ (perp2D e_c)))

open Classical in
noncomputable def twoReplicaProb {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T) (ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω)) : ℝ :=
  let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
  let p_T := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = T_idx p.1 then π ω else 0
  if T_idx p.1 = T_idx p.2 ∧ 0 < p_T then (π p.1 * π p.2) / p_T else 0

def twoReplicaT {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω)) : Fin N_T :=
  T_idx (finProdFinEquiv.symm ij).1

open Classical in
noncomputable def twoReplicaTailProb {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (ε e thresh : ℝ)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T) (θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
    let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
    if thresh <
        replicaSepDepth e
          (replicaSepTag ε e (angBin ε e (θ_s p.1)) (angBin ε e (θ_s p.2)))
    then twoReplicaProb π T_idx ij else 0

modal_prefix_anisotropic_localization.definitions:
noncomputable def modalPrefixCell (ε d₀ : ℝ)
    (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (k₀ : ℤ) :
    ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let e₀ := angUnitVec ε d₀ k₀
  (k₀,
    dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ V_p e₀),
    dyadicRealBin ε d₀ (inner ℝ V_p (perp2D e₀)),
    dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ A_p e₀),
    dyadicRealBin ε d₀ (inner ℝ A_p (perp2D e₀)))

noncomputable def modalPrefixCenter (ε d₀ : ℝ) (k₀ j_b j_a : ℤ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let e₀ := angUnitVec ε d₀ k₀
  (((j_b : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 0) • e₀ +
    (((j_a : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε d₀) • perp2D e₀

noncomputable def modalPrefixLocalVec (ε d₀ : ℝ)
    (e₀ center vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2
    ![(1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (vec - center) e₀,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-d₀) * inner ℝ (vec - center) (perp2D e₀)]

noncomputable def modalPrefixCancelAngle (ε e d₀ θ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
  let m_d := dyadicTimeLevel ε d₀
  let φ_e := ((angBin ε e θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹
  let φ_0 := ((angBin ε d₀ θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_d)⁻¹
  let α := φ_e - φ_0
  let u_raw : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos α, ε ^ (-d₀) * Real.sin α]
  let u_unit : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := ‖u_raw‖⁻¹ • u_raw
  let u_pos : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    if 0 < u_unit 1 ∨ (u_unit 1 = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ u_unit 0) then u_unit else -u_unit
  Real.arccos (u_pos 0)

by
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  have h1_dyad : IsPosDyadicUnit 1 := ⟨0, 1, le_rfl, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨h_vec_norm, h_root_inv, h_std_ub, h_bin_split⟩ :=

  obtain ⟨h_slope_bd, h_chart_fibers⟩ := chart_slope_and_cross_frame_fiber_bounds
  let E₀ : ∀ n, Finset (Fin (path.N_ω n)) := fun n =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ ≤ |Real.cos (path.θ_time 1 n ω)|)
  let use0 : ℕ → Bool := fun n =>
    decide (1 / 2 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E₀ n, path.π_seq n ω)
  let E_sel : ∀ n, Finset (Fin (path.N_ω n)) := fun n =>
    if use0 n then E₀ n else (E₀ n)ᶜ
  have h_sel : ∀ n, (1 / 2 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_sel n, path.π_seq n ω) ∧
      (∀ ω ∈ E_sel n, IsOnSelectedChart (use0 n) (path.θ_time 1 n ω)) := by
    intro n
    have h_compl : (∑ ω ∈ E₀ n, path.π_seq n ω) + (∑ ω ∈ (E₀ n)ᶜ, path.π_seq n ω) = 1 :=
      (Finset.sum_add_sum_compl (E₀ n) (path.π_seq n)).trans (path.h_law n).2.1
    by_cases h_half : 1 / 2 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E₀ n, path.π_seq n ω
    · have hu0 : use0 n = true := decide_eq_true h_half
      have hEs : E_sel n = E₀ n := by simp [E_sel, hu0]
      refine ⟨by rw [hEs]; exact h_half, fun ω hω => ?_⟩
      rw [hEs] at hω
      have h_cos : (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ ≤ |Real.cos (path.θ_time 1 n ω)| :=
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      simp [IsOnSelectedChart, hu0, h_cos]
    · have hu0 : use0 n = false := decide_eq_false h_half
      have hEs : E_sel n = (E₀ n)ᶜ := by simp [E_sel, hu0]
      refine ⟨by rw [hEs]; linarith, fun ω hω => ?_⟩
      rw [hEs, Finset.mem_compl] at hω
      have h_not : ¬ ((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ ≤ |Real.cos (path.θ_time 1 n ω)|) := fun hc =>
        hω (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hc⟩)
      simp [IsOnSelectedChart, hu0, lt_of_not_ge h_not]
  let π'_seq : ∀ n, Fin (path.N_ω n) → ℝ := fun n =>
    chartRowRestrictPi (path.π_seq n) (E_sel n)
  let V'_seq : ∀ n, Fin (path.N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun n tid =>
    chartRowVec (use0 n) (path.V_seq n tid)
  let A'_seq : ∀ n, Fin (path.N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun n tid =>
    chartRowVec (use0 n) (path.A_seq n tid)
  let R_seq : ∀ n, Fin (path.N_ω n) → ℝ := fun n ω =>
    chartRowSlope (use0 n) (path.θ_time 1 n ω)
  have hπ'_props : ∀ n,
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π'_seq n ω) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin (path.N_ω n), π'_seq n ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, π'_seq n ω ≤ 2 * path.π_seq n ω) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π'_seq n ω → ω ∈ E_sel n ∧ 0 < path.π_seq n ω) ∧

          2 * finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n) X Y) := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨h_ent1, _, h_rest⟩ := fin_entropy_bounded_fiber_and_restriction
      (path.ε_seq n) (path.hε_bounds n).1 (path.hε_bounds n).2
      (path.N_ω n) (path.π_seq n) (path.h_law n).1 (path.h_law n).2.1
    have hp_ge : 1 / 2 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_sel n, path.π_seq n ω := (h_sel n).1
    have hp_pos : 0 < ∑ ω ∈ E_sel n, path.π_seq n ω := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hπ'_nn, hπ'_sum, hπ'_le, hπ'_supp, hπ'_ent⟩ := h_rest (E_sel n) hp_pos
    refine ⟨hπ'_nn, hπ'_sum, fun ω => ?_, hπ'_supp, fun X Y => ?_⟩
    · have h1 := hπ'_le ω
      have h2 : path.π_seq n ω / (∑ ω' ∈ E_sel n, path.π_seq n ω') ≤
          path.π_seq n ω / (1 / 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ((path.h_law n).1 ω) (by norm_num) hp_ge
      linarith
    · have h1 := hπ'_ent X Y
      have hH_nn : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n) X Y :=
        (h_ent1 X X Y).1
      have h2 : finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n) X Y /
          (∑ ω' ∈ E_sel n, path.π_seq n ω') ≤
          finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n) X Y / (1 / 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hH_nn (by norm_num) hp_ge
      linarith
  have h_law_out : ∀ n, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π'_seq n ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (path.N_ω n), π'_seq n ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid, ‖V'_seq n tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A'_seq n tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π'_seq n ω → path.c_seq n ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |R_seq n ω| ≤ 1) := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨(hπ'_props n).1, (hπ'_props n).2.1, fun tid => ?_, fun ω hω => ?_⟩
    · dsimp only [V'_seq, A'_seq]
      rw [h_vec_norm, h_vec_norm]
      exact (path.h_law n).2.2.1 tid
    · obtain ⟨h_in_sel, hπ_pos⟩ := (hπ'_props n).2.2.2.1 ω hω

        h_slope_bd (use0 n) (path.θ_time 1 n ω) ((h_sel n).2 ω h_in_sel)⟩
  have h_ell_pos : ∀ n, 0 < Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) := by
    intro n

    exact Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have h_inv_ell_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹))⁻¹)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro δ hδ
    let η : ℝ := (Real.exp (2 / δ))⁻¹
    have hη : 0 < η := inv_pos.mpr (Real.exp_pos _)
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp path.hε_tendsto η hη
    refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hε_pos := (path.hε_bounds n).1
    have h_dist := hN₀ n hn
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hε_pos] at h_dist
    have h_exp_lt : Real.exp (2 / δ) < (path.ε_seq n)⁻¹ := by
      have h1 := (inv_lt_inv₀ hη hε_pos).mpr h_dist
      rwa [inv_inv] at h1
    have h_log_lt : 2 / δ < Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) := by
      have h1 := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos _) h_exp_lt
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at h1
    have h2δ_pos : 0 < 2 / δ := div_pos (by norm_num) hδ
    have h_inv_lt : (Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹))⁻¹ < δ / 2 := by
      have h1 := (inv_lt_inv₀ (lt_trans h2δ_pos h_log_lt) h2δ_pos).mpr h_log_lt
      have h2 : (2 / δ)⁻¹ = δ / 2 := by field_simp
      rwa [h2] at h1
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (h_ell_pos n))]
    linarith
  have h_ceil_info : ∀ (C ε a : ℝ),
      1 ≤ C → 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < a →
      1 ≤ ⌈C * ε ^ (-a)⌉₊ ∧
      Real.log (⌈C * ε ^ (-a)⌉₊ : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
        Real.log (C + 1) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + a := by
    intro C ε a hC hε0 hε1 ha
    have h_inv_gt1 : 1 < ε⁻¹ := by
      have h1 := (inv_lt_inv₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) hε0).mpr hε1
      linarith
    have h_rpow_ge1 : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-a) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow]
      calc (1 : ℝ) = (ε⁻¹) ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero _).symm
        _ ≤ (ε⁻¹) ^ a := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h_inv_gt1.le ha.le
    have h_prod_ge1 : 1 ≤ C * ε ^ (-a) := by nlinarith
    have h_ceil_real_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (⌈C * ε ^ (-a)⌉₊ : ℝ) :=
      h_prod_ge1.trans (Nat.le_ceil _)
    have h_ceil_ge1 : 1 ≤ ⌈C * ε ^ (-a)⌉₊ := by exact_mod_cast h_ceil_real_ge1
    have h_ceil_ub : (⌈C * ε ^ (-a)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (C + 1) * ε ^ (-a) := by
      have hlt := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith : 0 ≤ C * ε ^ (-a))
      nlinarith
    have hell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := Real.log_pos h_inv_gt1
    have h_log_ub : Real.log (⌈C * ε ^ (-a)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤
        Real.log (C + 1) + a * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      calc Real.log (⌈C * ε ^ (-a)⌉₊ : ℝ)
          ≤ Real.log ((C + 1) * ε ^ (-a)) :=
            Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h_ceil_ub
        _ = Real.log (C + 1) + Real.log (ε ^ (-a)) :=
            Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (by linarith)) (ne_of_gt (by linarith))
        _ = Real.log (C + 1) + (-a) * Real.log ε := by
            rw [Real.log_rpow hε0]
        _ = Real.log (C + 1) + a * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
            rw [Real.log_inv]
            ring
    refine ⟨h_ceil_ge1, ?_⟩
    calc Real.log (⌈C * ε ^ (-a)⌉₊ : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        ≤ (Real.log (C + 1) + a * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_log_ub hell_pos.le
      _ = Real.log (C + 1) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + a := by
          rw [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ a hell_pos.ne']

          have h2 : (G_std ω₁).2.1 = (G_std ω₂).2.1 := congrArg (fun x => x.2.1) h

subgoal_signatures.name: fin_entropy_bounded_fiber_and_restriction
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (N_ω : ℕ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) :
    (∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Z ∧
      ((∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ → X ω₁ = X ω₂ → Y ω₁ = Y ω₂) →
        finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤ finCondEntropy ε π Y Z) ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z ∧
      |finMutualInfo ε π X Z - finMutualInfo ε π X Y| ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π Y Z + finCondEntropy ε π Z Y) ∧
    (∀ {α β : Type} (A : Fin N_ω → α) (B : Fin N_ω → β)
      (E_bad : Finset (Fin N_ω)) (K_loc K_glob : ℕ),
      1 ≤ K_loc → 1 ≤ K_glob →
      (∃ S_glob : Finset β, S_glob.card ≤ K_glob ∧ ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → B ω ∈ S_glob) →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < π ω₀ → ω₀ ∉ E_bad →
        ∃ S_loc : Finset β, S_loc.card ≤ K_loc ∧
          ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → ω ∉ E_bad → A ω = A ω₀ → B ω ∈ S_loc) →
      finCondEntropy ε π A B ≤
        (Real.log 2 + Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) +
          (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω →
      let p_E := ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω
      let π_E := chartRowRestrictPi π E
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_E ω) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_E ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, π_E ω ≤ π ω / p_E) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_E ω → ω ∈ E ∧ 0 < π ω) ∧
      (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        finCondEntropy ε π_E X Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y / p_E))

subgoal_signatures.name: std_aperture_binary_split_and_perp_invariance
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ (useChart0 : Bool) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖chartRowVec useChart0 v‖ = ‖v‖) ∧
    (∀ (useChart0 : Bool) (ε L γ : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx
        (fun tid => chartRowVec useChart0 (V_part tid))
        (fun tid => chartRowVec useChart0 (A_part tid)) =
      classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part) ∧
    (∀ (γ m b₀ u b_u a_u δ_cl : ℝ),
      0 < γ → γ < 1 → 0 < m →
      b₀ ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ →
      u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ b_u → b_u ≤ a_u → a_u + u ≤ 1 + m → 0 < δ_cl →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧
        ∀ (ε : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
          (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
          (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
          0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
          (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
          (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
          (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
          stdApertureScore ε γ u b_u a_u π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ≤
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
              (b₀ + δ_cl) * u) ∧
    (∀ (ε L γ u b_u a_u β η_lb : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

        have hu := h_sum_union_le (B_u a ∪ B_c a) (s.biUnion (fun x => B_u x ∪ B_c x))
        have hab := h_sum_union_le (B_u a) (B_c a)
        linarith [(hB_spec a).1, (hB_spec a).2.1, ih]
    have h_Spos_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π_seq k ω = 1 := by
      rw [← h_law_k.2.1]
      dsimp only [S_pos]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hω : 0 < π_seq k ω
      · exact if_pos hω
      · rw [if_neg hω]
        exact le_antisymm (h_law_k.1 ω) (not_lt.mp hω)
    have h_good_mass : 1 - δ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_good, π_seq k ω := by
      have h_part : (∑ ω ∈ E_good, π_seq k ω) + (∑ ω ∈ S_pos ∩ B_all, π_seq k ω) =
          ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π_seq k ω := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_union (Finset.disjoint_sdiff_inter S_pos B_all),
          Finset.sdiff_union_inter]
      have h_inter_le : (∑ ω ∈ S_pos ∩ B_all, π_seq k ω) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ B_all, π_seq k ω :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.inter_subset_right
          (fun ω _ _ => h_law_k.1 ω)
      have h_ball_le : (∑ ω ∈ B_all, π_seq k ω) ≤ (Q_fin.card : ℝ) * (4 * η) := by
        calc ∑ ω ∈ B_all, π_seq k ω
            ≤ ∑ _x ∈ Q_fin.attach, (4 * η) := h_biUnion_le Q_fin.attach
          _ = (Q_fin.attach.card : ℝ) * (4 * η) := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ = (Q_fin.card : ℝ) * (4 * η) := by rw [Finset.card_attach]
      have h_4Q_le : (Q_fin.card : ℝ) * (4 * η) ≤ δ := by
        have hη_le : η ≤ δ / (4 * ((Q_fin.card : ℝ) + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
        calc (Q_fin.card : ℝ) * (4 * η)
            = 4 * (Q_fin.card : ℝ) * η := by ring
          _ ≤ 4 * (Q_fin.card : ℝ) * (δ / (4 * ((Q_fin.card : ℝ) + 1))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hη_le (by linarith)
          _ ≤ 4 * ((Q_fin.card : ℝ) + 1) * (δ / (4 * ((Q_fin.card : ℝ) + 1))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (div_nonneg hδ.le h_den_pos.le)
          _ = δ := mul_div_cancel₀ δ (ne_of_gt h_den_pos)
      linarith [h_part, h_Spos_sum, h_inter_le, h_ball_le, h_4Q_le]
    refine ⟨E_good, h_good_mass, fun ω hω L_list hL => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hω_S, hω_not_B⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hω
    have hω_pos : 0 < π_seq k ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_S).2
    let x : { L_l // L_l ∈ Q_fin } := ⟨L_list, hL⟩
    have hx_att : x ∈ Q_fin.attach := Finset.mem_attach Q_fin x
    have hω_not_Bu : ω ∉ B_u x := fun h_in =>
      hω_not_B (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x, hx_att, Finset.mem_union_left _ h_in⟩)
    have hω_not_Bc : ω ∉ B_c x := fun h_in =>
      hω_not_B (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x, hx_att, Finset.mem_union_right _ h_in⟩)
    obtain ⟨h_pt_u, h_pt_c⟩ := (hB_spec x).2.2 ω hω_pos
    have h_u1 := h_pt_u hω_not_Bu
    have h_c1 := h_pt_c hω_not_Bc
    have h_enum_eq : (enumL (idx ⟨x.1, hQ x.1 x.2⟩)).1 = L_list :=
      congr_arg Subtype.val (h_idx ⟨x.1, hQ x.1 x.2⟩)
    dsimp only at h_u1 h_c1 ⊢
    rw [h_enum_eq] at h_u1 h_c1
    obtain ⟨h_cu, h_cc⟩ := hk_coords x hx_att
    dsimp only [x] at h_cu h_cc h_u1 h_c1
    constructor
    · have h_tri := abs_add_le
        (condSurprise (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (fun _ => ())
          (fun ω' => L_list.map (fun q => rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m
            (V_seq k (T_seq k ω')) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω')) (c_seq k ω') (R_seq k ω')
            (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2))) ω -
          (d_u_st (φ k) (idx ⟨L_list, hQ L_list hL⟩)).1)
        ((d_u_st (φ k) (idx ⟨L_list, hQ L_list hL⟩)).1 - H_uncond L_list)
      rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
    · have h_tri := abs_add_le
        (condSurprise (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
          (fun ω' => L_list.map (fun q => rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m
            (V_seq k (T_seq k ω')) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω')) (c_seq k ω') (R_seq k ω')
            (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2))) ω -
          (d_c_st (φ k) (idx ⟨L_list, hQ L_list hL⟩)).1)
        ((d_c_st (φ k) (idx ⟨L_list, hQ L_list hL⟩)).1 - H_condT L_list)
      rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
  · intro q hq
    have h_sq : ∀ q' ∈ ([q] : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ)),
        (q'.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      intro q' hq'
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hq'
      rwa [hq']
    let i₀ : ℕ := idx ⟨[q], h_sq⟩
    have h_enum_q : (enumL i₀).1 = [q] := congr_arg Subtype.val (h_idx ⟨[q], h_sq⟩)
    have hHu_q : H_uncond [q] = (lim_u i₀).1 := by
      dsimp [H_uncond]; rw [dif_pos h_sq]
    have hHc_q : H_condT [q] = (lim_c i₀).1 := by
      dsimp [H_condT]; rw [dif_pos h_sq]
    have h_ent_u_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
        finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (fun _ => ())
          (fun ω => [rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m (V_seq k (T_seq k ω)) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω))
            (c_seq k ω) (R_seq k ω) (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2)]))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (H_uncond [q])) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε_r hε_r
      have hev1 := h_ev_abs_le _ (H_uncond [q]) (ε_r / 2) (hHu_q ▸ hu_lim i₀) (half_pos hε_r)
      have hev2 := h_ev_lt_zero _ (ε_r / 2) h_inv_φ_lim (half_pos hε_r)
      have hev_both := hev1.and hev2
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hev_both
      obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := hev_both
      refine ⟨max i₀ K₁, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hK₁ k (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk)
      have hi₀_le : i₀ ≤ φ k := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk) (hφ_ge k)
      have h_st_u := ((h_st_spec (φ k)).2.2.2.1 i₀ hi₀_le).1
      rw [h_enum_q] at h_st_u
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil] at h_st_u
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have h_tri := abs_add_le
        (finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (fun _ => ())
          (fun ω => [rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m (V_seq k (T_seq k ω)) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω))
            (c_seq k ω) (R_seq k ω) (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2)]) -
          (d_u_st (φ k) i₀).1)
        ((d_u_st (φ k) i₀).1 - H_uncond [q])
      rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
    have h_ent_c_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
        finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
          (fun ω => [rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m (V_seq k (T_seq k ω)) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω))
            (c_seq k ω) (R_seq k ω) (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2)]))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (H_condT [q])) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε_r hε_r
      have hev1 := h_ev_abs_le _ (H_condT [q]) (ε_r / 2) (hHc_q ▸ hc_lim i₀) (half_pos hε_r)
      have hev2 := h_ev_lt_zero _ (ε_r / 2) h_inv_φ_lim (half_pos hε_r)
      have hev_both := hev1.and hev2
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hev_both
      obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := hev_both
      refine ⟨max i₀ K₁, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hK₁ k (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk)
      have hi₀_le : i₀ ≤ φ k := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk) (hφ_ge k)
      have h_st_c := ((h_st_spec (φ k)).2.2.2.1 i₀ hi₀_le).2.1
      rw [h_enum_q] at h_st_c
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil] at h_st_c
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have h_tri := abs_add_le
        (finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
          (fun ω => [rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m (V_seq k (T_seq k ω)) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω))
            (c_seq k ω) (R_seq k ω) (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2)]) -
          (d_c_st (φ k) i₀).1)
        ((d_c_st (φ k) i₀).1 - H_condT [q])
      rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
    have h_mi_list := h_ent_u_lim.sub h_ent_c_lim
    refine h_mi_list.congr (fun k => ?_)
    exact h_mi_singleton (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
      (fun ω => rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m (V_seq k (T_seq k ω)) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω))
        (c_seq k ω) (R_seq k ω) (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2))

countable_row_obs_homogenization.definitions:
def IsBoundedRowLaw {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) ∧
  (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) ∧
  (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |R_s ω| ≤ 1)

noncomputable def rowListCap (m : ℝ) : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ) → ℝ
  | [] => 0
  | q :: tl =>
      (17 + m + max (q.1 : ℝ) 0 + max (q.2.1 : ℝ) 0 +
        max (q.2.2.1 : ℝ) 0 + max (q.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) 0) + rowListCap m tl

subgoal_signatures.name: finite_uniform_surprise_bin_homogenization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_X α_Y : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α_X) (Y : Fin N_ω → α_Y) (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω ∈ E, 0 < π ω) → 0 < (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ restrictLaw π E ω) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, restrictLaw π E ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < restrictLaw π E ω ↔ ω ∈ E) ∧
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε (restrictLaw π E) X Y ∧
      finCondEntropy ε (restrictLaw π E) X Y ≤
        (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω)⁻¹ * finCondEntropy ε π X Y) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω M_obs : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
      (ε a : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → α)
      (obs : Fin M_obs → Fin N_ω → β) (A_cap : Fin M_obs → ℝ),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < a →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ i : Fin M_obs, 0 ≤ A_cap i ∧
        (((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)).image (obs i)).card : ℝ) ≤
          ε ^ (-(A_cap i))) →
      let J_max : ℕ := ∏ i : Fin M_obs, (1 + ⌈(A_cap i + 1) / a⌉₊) ^ 2
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      ∃ (Z : Fin N_ω → Fin (J_max + 1))
        (Z_ret : Finset (Fin J_max))
        (d_uncond d_condT : Fin J_max → Fin M_obs → ℝ),
        1 ≤ J_max ∧
        (∀ z i, d_uncond z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (A_cap i + 1) ∧
          d_condT z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (A_cap i + 1)) ∧
        1 - 2 * (M_obs : ℝ) * ε - 1 / 4 ≤
          (∑ z ∈ Z_ret, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Z ω = z.castSucc then π ω else 0) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Z_ret,
          let E_z := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z.castSucc ∧ 0 < π ω)
          let m_z := ∑ ω ∈ E_z, π ω
          let π_z := restrictLaw π E_z
          (4 * (J_max : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ m_z ∧
          (∀ i : Fin M_obs,
            (d_uncond z i - Real.log (4 * (J_max : ℝ)) / ell ≤
              finCondEntropy ε π_z (fun _ => ()) (obs i) ∧
             finCondEntropy ε π_z (fun _ => ()) (obs i) ≤ d_uncond z i + a) ∧
            (d_condT z i - Real.log (4 * (J_max : ℝ)) / ell ≤
              finCondEntropy ε π_z T_idx (obs i) ∧
             finCondEntropy ε π_z T_idx (obs i) ≤ d_condT z i + a)) ∧
          (∀ (i : Fin M_obs) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → η < 1 →
            ∃ B_u B_c : Finset (Fin N_ω),
              (∑ ω ∈ B_u, π_z ω) ≤ 2 * η ∧
              (∑ ω ∈ B_c, π_z ω) ≤ 2 * η ∧
              ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π_z ω →
                (ω ∉ B_u →
                  d_uncond z i - Real.log (4 * (J_max : ℝ) / η) / ell ≤
                    condSurprise ε π_z (fun _ => ()) (obs i) ω ∧
                  condSurprise ε π_z (fun _ => ()) (obs i) ω ≤
                    d_uncond z i + a + Real.log (1 / η) / ell) ∧
                (ω ∉ B_c →
                  d_condT z i - Real.log (4 * (J_max : ℝ) / η) / ell ≤
                    condSurprise ε π_z T_idx (obs i) ω ∧
                  condSurprise ε π_z T_idx (obs i) ω ≤
                    d_condT z i + a + Real.log (1 / η) / ell)))

subgoal_signatures.name: row_obs_list_alphabet_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (f : Fin N_ω → β),
      finMutualInfo ε π X (fun ω => [f ω]) = finMutualInfo ε π X f) ∧

      {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)

        L_list.map (fun q => rowObs6 ε m

subgoal_signatures.name: root_supremum_bounds_and_row_score_splitting
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m) (b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∀ (ε : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      IsBoundedRowLaw π V_part A_part c_s R_s →
      0 ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ∧
      classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ≤ 2 * (1 + m)) ∧
    (∀ (ε δ_ub : ℝ) (U_fin : Finset ℝ) (J_max : ℕ)
      {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (Z : Fin N_ω → Fin (J_max + 1))
      (Z_ret : Finset (Fin J_max)),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < δ_ub →
      (∀ u ∈ U_fin, u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ u ∈ U_fin, ∀ (π' : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        IsBoundedRowLaw π' V_part A_part c_s R_s →
        rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π' T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s ≤
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π' T_idx V_part A_part +
            (classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_ub) * u) →
      IsBoundedRowLaw π V_part A_part c_s R_s →
      1 / 2 ≤ (∑ z ∈ Z_ret, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Z ω = z.castSucc then π ω else 0) →
      ∃ z_star ∈ Z_ret,
        let E_star := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z_star.castSucc ∧ 0 < π ω)
        let π_star := restrictLaw π E_star
        0 < (∑ ω ∈ E_star, π ω) ∧
        IsBoundedRowLaw π_star V_part A_part c_s R_s ∧
        ∀ u ∈ U_fin,
          |rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π_star T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π_star T_idx V_part A_part -
            classicalGrowthRate γ * u| ≤
          δ_ub + 2 * ((∑ u' ∈ U_fin,
            (|rowObsScore ε γ m u' (b u') π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
              classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
              classicalGrowthRate γ * u'| + δ_ub)) +
            (U_fin.card : ℝ) *
              (3 * Real.log ((J_max + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))))

subgoal_signatures.name: dyadic_time_and_orientation_entropy_extension
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (∀ (ε u : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      IsBoundedRowLaw π V_part A_part c_s R_s →
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)) ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)) ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ → ℕ)
      (π_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ)
      (T_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → Fin (N_T k))
      (V_seq A_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_T k) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_seq R_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have h_ent : ∀ (N_ω : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      (∀ {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Type}
        (X₁ : Fin N_ω → α₁) (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁)
        (X₂ : Fin N_ω → α₂) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂),
        (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
          (X₁ ω₁ = X₁ ω₂ ↔ X₂ ω₁ = X₂ ω₂) ∧
          (X₁ ω₁ = X₁ ω₂ → (Y₁ ω₁ = Y₁ ω₂ ↔ Y₂ ω₁ = Y₂ ω₂))) →
        finCondEntropy ε π X₁ Y₁ = finCondEntropy ε π X₂ Y₂) ∧
      (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y) ∧
      (∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
        finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) =
          finCondEntropy ε π X Y + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z) ∧
      (∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y) ∧
      (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β)
        (M : ℕ) (f_cover : α → Finset β),
        1 ≤ M →
        (∀ a : α, (f_cover a).card ≤ M) →
        (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → Y ω ∈ f_cover (X ω)) →
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y ≤ Real.log (M : ℝ) / ell) ∧
      (∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (A : Fin N_ω → β) (B : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
        finMutualInfo ε π X B - finMutualInfo ε π X A ≤ finCondEntropy ε π A B) := by
    intro N_ω ε π hε₀ hε₁ hπ_nn hπ_sum ell
    have hε_inv_gt2 : 2 < ε⁻¹ := by
      rw [lt_inv_comm₀ (by norm_num) hε₀]
      linarith
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hπ_zero_of_not_pos : ∀ ω, ¬ (0 < π ω) → π ω = 0 := fun ω h =>
      le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h) (hπ_nn ω)
    let S_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)
    have hS_mem : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ω ∈ S_pos ↔ 0 < π ω := by
      intro ω
      simp [S_pos]
    have hS_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω = 1 := by
      rw [← hπ_sum]
      dsimp [S_pos]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : 0 < π ω
      · exact ite_eq_left_iff.mpr (fun hn => absurd h hn)
      · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun hp => absurd hp h), hπ_zero_of_not_pos ω h]
    have h_sum_Spos : ∀ f : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * f ω) = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * f ω := by
      intro f
      dsimp [S_pos]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : 0 < π ω
      · exact (ite_eq_left_iff.mpr (fun hn => absurd h hn)).symm
      · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun hp => absurd hp h), hπ_zero_of_not_pos ω h, zero_mul]
    have h_prob_bounds : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
        0 < π ω →
        0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω ∧ finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω ∧ 0 < finProbAt π X ω := by
      intro α β X Y ω hω
      have hp2_ge : π ω ≤ finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        let term : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω' =>
          @ite ℝ (X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (π ω') 0
        change π ω ≤ ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, term ω'
        have hself : π ω = term ω := by
          dsimp [term]
          simp
        rw [hself]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := term)
          (fun ω' _ => by dsimp [term]; split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω'])
          (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      have hp2_le_p1 : finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω
        · by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [hX, hY, hπ_nn ω']
        · simp [hX]
      exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hω hp2_ge, hp2_le_p1, lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hω hp2_ge) hp2_le_p1⟩
    have h_equiv : ∀ {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Type}
        (X₁ : Fin N_ω → α₁) (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁)
        (X₂ : Fin N_ω → α₂) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂),
        (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
          (X₁ ω₁ = X₁ ω₂ ↔ X₂ ω₁ = X₂ ω₂) ∧
          (X₁ ω₁ = X₁ ω₂ → (Y₁ ω₁ = Y₁ ω₂ ↔ Y₂ ω₁ = Y₂ ω₂))) →
        finCondEntropy ε π X₁ Y₁ = finCondEntropy ε π X₂ Y₂ := by
      intro α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ heq
      unfold finCondEntropy
      rw [h_sum_Spos, h_sum_Spos]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (hS_mem ω).mp hω
      congr 1
      unfold condSurprise
      have hp1 : finProbAt π X₁ ω = finProbAt π X₂ ω := by
        unfold finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hω' : 0 < π ω'
        · have hx := (heq ω' ω hω' hω_pos).1
          by_cases h1 : X₁ ω' = X₁ ω
          · have h2 : X₂ ω' = X₂ ω := hx.mp h1
            simp [h1, h2]
          · have h2 : ¬ (X₂ ω' = X₂ ω) := fun h2 => h1 (hx.mpr h2)
            simp [h1, h2]
        · simp [hπ_zero_of_not_pos ω' hω']
      have hp2 : finProbAt2 π X₁ Y₁ ω = finProbAt2 π X₂ Y₂ ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hω' : 0 < π ω'
        · obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := heq ω' ω hω' hω_pos
          by_cases h1 : X₁ ω' = X₁ ω
          · have h2 : X₂ ω' = X₂ ω := hx.mp h1
            have hy' := hy h1
            by_cases hy1 : Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω
            · have hy2 : Y₂ ω' = Y₂ ω := hy'.mp hy1
              simp [h1, h2, hy1, hy2]
            · have hy2 : ¬ (Y₂ ω' = Y₂ ω) := fun h => hy1 (hy'.mpr h)
              simp [h1, h2, hy1, hy2]
          · have h2 : ¬ (X₂ ω' = X₂ ω) := fun h2 => h1 (hx.mpr h2)
            simp [h1, h2]
        · simp [hπ_zero_of_not_pos ω' hω']
      rw [hp1, hp2]
    have h_nonneg : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
      intro α β X Y
      unfold finCondEntropy
      rw [h_sum_Spos]
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (hS_mem ω).mp hω
      obtain ⟨hp2_pos, hp2_le, hp1_pos⟩ := h_prob_bounds X Y ω hω_pos
      refine mul_nonneg hω_pos.le ?_
      unfold condSurprise
      refine div_nonneg ?_ hell_pos.le
      rw [neg_nonneg]
      exact Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg hp2_pos.le hp1_pos.le) ((div_le_one hp1_pos).mpr hp2_le)
    have h_chain : ∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
        finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) =
          finCondEntropy ε π X Y + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z := by
      intro α β γ_t X Y Z
      unfold finCondEntropy
      rw [h_sum_Spos, h_sum_Spos, h_sum_Spos, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (hS_mem ω).mp hω
      rw [← mul_add]
      congr 1
      unfold condSurprise
      have hp_XY_eq : finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) ω = finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases h2 : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h1, h2]
      have hp_XYZ_eq : finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) Z ω =
          finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases h2 : Y ω' = Y ω <;> by_cases h3 : Z ω' = Z ω <;>
          simp [h1, h2, h3]
      rw [hp_XY_eq, hp_XYZ_eq]
      obtain ⟨hp3_pos, _, hp1_pos⟩ := h_prob_bounds X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω hω_pos
      obtain ⟨hp2_pos, _, _⟩ := h_prob_bounds X Y ω hω_pos
      have h_prod : finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω / finProbAt π X ω =

    have h_cond_mono : ∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),

      have : DecidableEq β := Classical.decEq β
      have : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t

      let P_XY : α → β → ℝ := fun x y => ∑ ω' ∈ S_pos, if X ω' = x ∧ Y ω' = y then π ω' else 0
      let P_XZ : α → γ_t → ℝ := fun x z => ∑ ω' ∈ S_pos, if X ω' = x ∧ Z ω' = z then π ω' else 0

        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hpos : 0 < π ω'
        · by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω <;> simp [hpos, hx]
        · simp [hπ_zero_of_not_pos ω' hpos]

        have h_diff : (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * condSurprise ε π (fun ω' => (X ω', Z ω')) Y ω) -

            (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * Real.log (r ω)) / ell := by

          rw [hpXZ_eq] at hpXZ_pos
          rw [hpXY_eq] at hpXY_pos
          rw [hpX_eq] at hpX_pos
          rw [hpXYZ_eq, hpXZ_eq, hpXY_eq, hpX_eq]

        rw [hpXZ_eq] at hpXZ_pos
        rw [hpXY_eq] at hpXY_pos
        rw [hpX_eq] at hpX_pos
        have hr_pos : 0 < r ω := div_pos (mul_pos hpXY_pos hpXZ_pos) (mul_pos hpX_pos hpXYZ_pos)
        have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hr_pos

      let I_X := S_pos.image X
      let I_Y := S_pos.image Y
      let I_Z := S_pos.image Z
      have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos, (X ω, (Y ω, Z ω)) ∈ I_X ×ˢ (I_Y ×ˢ I_Z) := fun ω hω =>

          ∑ t ∈ I_X ×ˢ (I_Y ×ˢ I_Z),

        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ⟨x, y, z⟩ _ => ?_)
        have h_const : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => (X ω, (Y ω, Z ω)) = (x, y, z)), π ω * r ω =
            P_XYZ x y z * ((P_XY x y * P_XZ x z) / (P_X x * P_XYZ x y z)) := by
          have h_eq1 : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => (X ω, (Y ω, Z ω)) = (x, y, z)), π ω * r ω =
              ∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => (X ω, (Y ω, Z ω)) = (x, y, z)),

            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
            have hxyz := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            rcases Prod.ext_iff.mp hxyz with ⟨hx, hyz⟩
            rcases Prod.ext_iff.mp hyz with ⟨hy, hz⟩
            dsimp at hx hy hz
            dsimp [r]
            rw [hx, hy, hz]

          dsimp [P_XYZ]
          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)

        by_cases h0 : P_XYZ x y z = 0

          have hPXY_nn : 0 ≤ P_XY x y := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω])

      refine le_trans h_fib_le (le_of_eq ?_)

      have h_marg_Y : ∀ x, ∑ y ∈ I_Y, P_XY x y = P_X x := by
        intro x; dsimp [P_XY, P_X]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hy_mem : Y ω ∈ I_Y := Finset.mem_image_of_mem Y hω
        by_cases hx : X ω = x <;> simp [hx, hy_mem]
      have h_marg_Z : ∀ x, ∑ z ∈ I_Z, P_XZ x z = P_X x := by

        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hz_mem : Z ω ∈ I_Z := Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z hω
        by_cases hx : X ω = x <;> simp [hx, hz_mem]

        by_cases hpx : P_X x = 0
        · simp [hpx]
        · exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ (P_X x) hpx
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_inner]
      dsimp [P_X]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hx_mem : X ω ∈ I_X := Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω
      simp [hx_mem]
    have h_cover : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β)

        rw [hpX_eq] at hpX_pos

        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hω_pos.le
        linarith

      let I_X := S_pos.image X

              rw [hx, hy]
            rw [h_eq1, ← Finset.sum_mul]

            exact div_nonneg hPX_nn hM_pos.le

                = (P_XY x y * P_X x) / (P_XY x y * (M : ℝ)) := by
                  rw [← mul_div_assoc, mul_comm (M : ℝ)]
              _ = P_X x / (M : ℝ) := mul_div_mul_left _ _ h0

        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        have hPX_nn : 0 ≤ P_X x := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω])

        calc ((f_cover x).card : ℝ) * (P_X x / (M : ℝ))

              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card_real (div_nonneg hPX_nn hM_pos.le)

      refine le_trans h_x_le (le_of_eq ?_)
      dsimp [P_X]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hx_mem : X ω ∈ I_X := Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω
      simp [hx_mem]
    have h_mi_inc : ∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (A : Fin N_ω → β) (B : Fin N_ω → γ_t),

      have hrhs : finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_time =
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_time ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)))) / ell := by
        unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        change π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / ell) = _
        rw [hpTC_eq, hpT_eq]
        ring
      rw [hrhs]
      congr 1
      have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
          (T_idx ω, k_time ω) ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) ×ˢ S_cells := fun ω hω =>
        Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_image_of_mem k_time hω⟩
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps, Finset.sum_product]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      have h_eq1 : (∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_time ω) = (tid, k)),
          -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_time ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)))) =
          ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_time ω) = (tid, k)),
            π ω * (-Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have htk := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        rcases Prod.ext_iff.mp htk with ⟨ht, hk⟩
        dsimp at ht hk
        rw [ht, hk]
        ring
      rw [h_eq1, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      have h_sum_pTC : (∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_time ω) = (tid, k)), π ω) =
          p_TC tid k := by
        dsimp [p_TC]
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        simp [Prod.ext_iff]
      rw [h_sum_pTC]
      ring
    have hITG : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
        p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell =
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx O_ba := by
      have h_mi_G : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx O_ba = finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_idx := by
        unfold finMutualInfo
        rw [h_equiv (fun _ => ()) O_ba (fun _ => ()) G_idx
            (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ => ⟨Iff.rfl, fun _ => (hG_iff ω₁ ω₂).symm⟩),
          h_equiv T_idx O_ba T_idx G_idx
            (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ => ⟨Iff.rfl, fun _ => (hG_iff ω₁ ω₂).symm⟩)]
      rw [h_mi_G]
      have hpU_eq : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
        intro ω; unfold finProbAt; simp [hπ_sum]
      have hpG_eq : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) G_idx ω = p_G (G_idx ω) := by
        intro ω; unfold finProbAt2; dsimp [p_G]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h : G_idx ω' = G_idx ω <;> simp [h]
      have hpTG_eq : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω = p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) := by
        intro ω; unfold finProbAt2; dsimp [p_TG]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> by_cases h2 : G_idx ω' = G_idx ω <;> simp [h1, h2]
      have hrhs : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_idx =
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω *
            Real.log (p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_G (G_idx ω)))) / ell := by
        unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
        · have hpTG_pos : 0 < p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) := by
            have hle : π ω ≤ p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) := by
              dsimp [p_TG]
              have hs : π ω = (if T_idx ω = T_idx ω ∧ G_idx ω = G_idx ω then π ω else 0) := by simp
              rw [hs]
              exact Finset.single_le_sum
                (f := fun ω' => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ G_idx ω' = G_idx ω then π ω' else 0)
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω']) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω hle
          have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω) := by
            have hle : p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) ≤ p_T (T_idx ω) := by
              dsimp [p_TG, p_T]
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω
              · by_cases h2 : G_idx ω' = G_idx ω <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω']
              · simp [h1]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpTG_pos hle
          have hpG_pos : 0 < p_G (G_idx ω) := by
            have hle : p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) ≤ p_G (G_idx ω) := by
              dsimp [p_TG, p_G]
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases h2 : G_idx ω' = G_idx ω
              · by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω']
              · simp [h2]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpTG_pos hle
          change π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) G_idx ω /
              finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω)) / ell) -
            π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / ell) = _
          rw [hpG_eq, hpU_eq, hpTG_eq, hpT_eq, div_one]
          have h_div_eq : (p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) / p_G (G_idx ω) =
              p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_G (G_idx ω)) := div_div _ _ _
          have h_log : Real.log (p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_G (G_idx ω))) =
              Real.log (p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) - Real.log (p_G (G_idx ω)) := by
            rw [← h_div_eq, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpTG_pos hpT_pos)) (ne_of_gt hpG_pos)]
          rw [h_log]
          ring
        · have hz := hπ_zero_of_not_pos ω hω
          change π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) G_idx ω /
              finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω)) / ell) -
            π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / ell) = _
          rw [hz]
          ring
      rw [hrhs]
      congr 1
      have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
          (T_idx ω, G_idx ω) ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_G)) :=
        fun _ _ => Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps, Finset.sum_product]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => ?_)
      have h_eq1 : (∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G_idx ω) = (tid, g)),
          π ω * Real.log (p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_G (G_idx ω)))) =
          ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G_idx ω) = (tid, g)),
            π ω * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have htg := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        rcases Prod.ext_iff.mp htg with ⟨ht, hg⟩
        dsimp at ht hg
        rw [ht, hg]
      rw [h_eq1, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      congr 1
      dsimp [p_TG]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      simp [Prod.ext_iff]
    change (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g)) -
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
        p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell +
      2 * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
        -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) / ell) = _
    rw [hEw, hITG, hSt]

(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (h_gt : γ < classicalGrowthRate γ)
    (h_min : ∀ e : ℝ, IsStdSaturatedAspect γ e → m ≤ e)
    (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hb_dom : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ b u ∧ b u + (1 + m) * u ≤ 1 + m)
    (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (N_ω N_T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (π_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ)
    (T_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → Fin (N_T k))
    (V_seq A_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_T k) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_seq R_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ)
    (hε_bounds : ∀ k, 0 < ε_seq k ∧ ε_seq k < 1 / 2)
    (hε_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (h_law : ∀ k, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_seq k ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω k), π_seq k ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid, ‖V_seq k tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_seq k tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_seq k ω → c_seq k ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |R_seq k ω| ≤ 1))
    (h_all_sat : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
        rowObsScore (ε_seq k) γ m t (b t) (π_seq k) (T_seq k) (V_seq k) (A_seq k)
          (c_seq k) (R_seq k) -
        classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq k) (1 + m) γ (N_ω k) (N_T k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
          (V_seq k) (A_seq k))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (classicalGrowthRate γ * t))) :
    ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧
      ∀ (v a δ : ℝ), 0 < v → 0 < a → v + a < 1 → 0 < δ →
        ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K₀ ≤ k →
          κ * a - δ ≤ finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k)
            (fun ω => (T_seq k ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) v (c_seq k ω)))
            (fun ω => dyadicRealBin (ε_seq k) (m * (v + a)) (R_seq k ω))

proof.tactics:
by
  by_contra h_not
  let θ : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)
  have hθ_pos : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < θ j := fun j => by
    dsimp [θ]
    positivity
  let H_ent : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ := fun v a k =>
    finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k)
      (fun ω => (T_seq k ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) v (c_seq k ω)))
      (fun ω => dyadicRealBin (ε_seq k) (m * (v + a)) (R_seq k ω))
  have h_ex_stage : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ (v a : ℝ),
      0 < v ∧ 0 < a ∧ v + a < 1 ∧
      (∃ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, H_ent v a k < θ j * a) := by
    intro j
    by_contra h_all
    apply h_not
    refine ⟨θ j, hθ_pos j, ?_⟩
    intro v a δ hv ha hva hδ
    by_contra h_no_K
    apply h_all
    refine ⟨v, a, hv, ha, hva, ?_⟩
    rw [Filter.frequently_atTop]
    intro K₀
    have h_ex_k : ∃ k : ℕ, K₀ ≤ k ∧ H_ent v a k < θ j * a - δ := by
      by_contra h_contra
      apply h_no_K
      refine ⟨K₀, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      by_contra h_lt
      exact h_contra ⟨k, hk, lt_of_not_ge h_lt⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk, h_lt⟩ := h_ex_k
    exact ⟨k, hk, by linarith⟩
  have h_stage : ∀ j : ℕ,
      ∃ (ε_tilde : ℝ) (k_idx : ℕ)
        (π_loc : Fin (N_ω k_idx) → ℝ)
        (V_loc A_loc : Fin (N_T k_idx) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_loc : Fin (N_ω k_idx) → ℝ),
        (0 < ε_tilde ∧ ε_tilde < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 3)) ∧
        ((∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_loc ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω k_idx), π_loc ω = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid, ‖V_loc tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_loc tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
          (∀ ω, 0 < π_loc ω → c_loc ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ∧
        (classicalGrowthRate γ - 5 * θ j ≤
          stdApertureScore ε_tilde γ 1 0 0 π_loc (T_seq k_idx) V_loc A_loc c_loc (fun _ => 0) -
            classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ (N_ω k_idx) (N_T k_idx)
              π_loc (T_seq k_idx) V_loc A_loc ∧
         stdApertureScore ε_tilde γ 1 0 0 π_loc (T_seq k_idx) V_loc A_loc c_loc (fun _ => 0) -
            classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ (N_ω k_idx) (N_T k_idx)
              π_loc (T_seq k_idx) V_loc A_loc ≤
          classicalGrowthRate γ + 5 * θ j) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨v, a, hv, ha, hva, h_freq⟩ := h_ex_stage j
    let r : ℝ := v
    let t : ℝ := v + a
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := hv
    have hrt : r < t := by dsimp [r, t]; linarith
    have ht_lt1 : t < 1 := hva
    have htr_eq : t - r = a := by dsimp [r, t]; ring
    have ht_ioo : t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith, ht_lt1⟩
    have ht_icc : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith, ht_lt1.le⟩
    have hb_t : 0 ≤ b t ∧ b t + (1 + m) * t ≤ 1 + m := hb_dom t ht_icc
    have hθj : 0 < θ j := hθ_pos j
    have hθa : 0 < θ j * a := mul_pos hθj ha
    obtain ⟨ε_back₀, hε_back_pos, _, h_back⟩ :=
      row_localization_backward_root_composition γ m r t (θ j)
        hγ₀ hγ₁ hm h_two hr_pos hrt ht_lt1 hθj
    obtain ⟨ε_iso₀, hε_iso_pos, _, h_iso⟩ :=
      isotropic_unit_score_upper_bound γ hγ₀ hγ₁ h_two (θ j) hθj
    have hj3_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (j : ℝ) + 3 := by positivity
    let ε_tilde_cap : ℝ := min (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 3)) ε_iso₀
    have h_cap_pos : 0 < ε_tilde_cap := lt_min (div_pos zero_lt_one hj3_pos) hε_iso_pos
    let ε_req : ℝ := min ε_back₀ (min (ε_tilde_cap ^ (1 / a)) (Real.exp (-16 / (a * θ j))))
    have h_req_pos : 0 < ε_req :=
      lt_min hε_back_pos
        (lt_min (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h_cap_pos (1 / a)) (Real.exp_pos _))
    have h_ev_eps : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, ε_seq k < ε_req := by
      have h_lim := hε_tendsto
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at h_lim
      obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := h_lim ε_req h_req_pos
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
      refine ⟨K₁, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      have hdist := hK₁ k hk
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (hε_bounds k).1] at hdist
      exact hdist
    have h_ev_sat : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop,
        classicalGrowthRate γ * t +
          classicalRootSupremum (ε_seq k) (1 + m) γ (N_ω k) (N_T k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
            (V_seq k) (A_seq k) -
          rowObsScore (ε_seq k) γ m t (b t) (π_seq k) (T_seq k) (V_seq k) (A_seq k)
            (c_seq k) (R_seq k) < θ j * a := by
      have h_lim := h_all_sat t ht_ioo
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at h_lim
      obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂⟩ := h_lim (θ j * a) hθa
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
      refine ⟨K₂, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      have hdist := hK₂ k hk
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist
      have h_lt := (abs_lt.mp hdist).1
      linarith
    obtain ⟨k, ⟨hε_lt_req, h_glob_def⟩, hH_lt⟩ :=
      ((h_ev_eps.and h_ev_sat).and_frequently h_freq).exists
    let ε : ℝ := ε_seq k
    have hε₀ : 0 < ε := (hε_bounds k).1
    have hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2 := (hε_bounds k).2
    have hε_back : ε < ε_back₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_req (min_le_left _ _)
    have hε_pow : ε < ε_tilde_cap ^ (1 / a) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_req (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hε_exp : ε < Real.exp (-16 / (a * θ j)) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_req (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    let ε_tilde : ℝ := ε ^ (t - r)
    have hε_tilde_pos : 0 < ε_tilde := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (t - r)
    have hε_tilde_lt_cap : ε_tilde < ε_tilde_cap := by
      dsimp [ε_tilde]
      rw [htr_eq]
      have h1 : ε ^ a < (ε_tilde_cap ^ (1 / a)) ^ a :=
        Real.rpow_lt_rpow hε₀.le hε_pow ha
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul h_cap_pos.le, one_div_mul_cancel ha.ne', Real.rpow_one] at h1
      exact h1
    have hε_tilde_lt_j3 : ε_tilde < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 3) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_tilde_lt_cap (min_le_left _ _)
    have hε_tilde_lt_iso : ε_tilde < ε_iso₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_tilde_lt_cap (min_le_right _ _)
    have hε_tilde_half : ε_tilde < 1 / 2 := by
      have hj_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg j
      have h_lt23 : (2 : ℝ) < (j : ℝ) + 3 := by linarith
      exact lt_trans hε_tilde_lt_j3 (one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by norm_num) h_lt23)
    have h_log_err : 16 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) < θ j * a := by
      have h_log_lt : Real.log ε < -16 / (a * θ j) := by
        have h1 := Real.log_lt_log hε₀ hε_exp
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at h1
      have h_aθ_pos : 0 < a * θ j := mul_pos ha hθj
      have h_log_inv_gt : 16 / (a * θ j) < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        rw [neg_div] at h_log_lt
        rw [Real.log_inv]
        linarith
      have h_log_inv_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
        lt_trans (div_pos (by norm_num) h_aθ_pos) h_log_inv_gt
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h_log_inv_pos]

noncomputable def rowGrowthRestrictLaw {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Fin N_ω)) : Fin N_ω → ℝ :=
  let m_S := ∑ ω ∈ S, π ω
  fun ω => if ω ∈ S then π ω / m_S else 0

noncomputable def rowGrowthClamp2D (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if ‖w‖ ≤ 1 then w else 0

noncomputable def rowGrowthCell (ε m r t b_t : ℝ)
    (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s R_s : ℝ) :
    ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let k_cr := dyadicTimeBin ε r c_s
  let C_r := dyadicTimeMid ε r c_s
  let k_rt := dyadicRealBin ε (m * t) R_s
  let R_bar := dyadicRealMid ε (m * t) R_s
  let X := V_p 0
  let Y_r := A_p 0 + C_r * X
  let W := V_p 1 - R_bar * X
  let Z_r := A_p 1 + C_r * (V_p 1) - R_bar * Y_r
  (k_cr, k_rt,
    dyadicRealBin ε b_t X,
    dyadicRealBin ε (b_t + r) Y_r,
    dyadicRealBin ε (b_t + m * t) W,
    dyadicRealBin ε (b_t + m * t + r) Z_r)

noncomputable def rowGrowthLocTime (ε r : ℝ) (k_cr : ℤ) (c_s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c_s * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r) - (k_cr : ℝ)

noncomputable def rowGrowthLocVel (ε m t b_t : ℝ)
    (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (V_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let (_, k_rt, k_X, _, k_W, _) := j
  let R_bar := ((k_rt : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t)
  let X_bar := ((k_X : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t
  let W_bar := ((k_W : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t)
  let X := V_p 0
  let W := V_p 1 - R_bar * X
  rowGrowthClamp2D (WithLp.toLp 2
    ![(X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t), (W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t))])

noncomputable def rowGrowthLocPos (ε m r t b_t : ℝ)
    (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let (k_cr, k_rt, k_X, k_Y, k_W, k_Z) := j
  let Δ_r := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r))⁻¹
  let C_r := ((k_cr : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
  let R_bar := ((k_rt : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t)
  let X_bar := ((k_X : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t
  let Y_bar := ((k_Y : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + r)
  let W_bar := ((k_W : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t)
  let Z_bar := ((k_Z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t + r)
  let X := V_p 0
  let W := V_p 1 - R_bar * X
  let Y_r := A_p 0 + C_r * X
  let Z_r := A_p 1 + C_r * (V_p 1) - R_bar * Y_r
  rowGrowthClamp2D (WithLp.toLp 2
    ![((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r),
      ((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r)])

  have posSupport_zero_of_not_mem {N_ω : ℕ} {π : Fin N_ω → ℝ} (h_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω)

      (f : Fin N_ω → ℝ) :
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * f ω = ∑ ω ∈ stdApPosSupport π, π ω * f ω := by
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
    intro ω _ hω
    rw [posSupport_zero_of_not_mem h_nn hω, zero_mul]
  have sum_posSupport_eq_one {N_ω : ℕ} {π : Fin N_ω → ℝ}

      ∑ ω ∈ stdApPosSupport π, π ω = 1 := by
    have := sum_posSupport_mul h_nn (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    simp only [mul_one] at this
    linarith

      (h_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (X : Fin N_ω → α) (ω : Fin N_ω) :
      finProbAt π X ω = (letI := Classical.propDecidable

    unfold finProbAt
    let _ := Classical.propDecidable
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
    intro ω' _ hω'
    rw [posSupport_zero_of_not_mem h_nn hω']
    split_ifs <;> rfl

    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hω

    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
    congr 2
    congr 1
    unfold finProbAt
    let _ := Classical.propDecidable

                π ω * ((finProbAt2 π X Y ω * finProbAt π (fun ω => (T ω, X ω)) ω) /
                  (finProbAt π X ω * finProbAt2 π (fun ω => (T ω, X ω)) Y ω)) =
                π ω * ((P_XY (X ω₀) (Y ω₀) * P_TX (T ω₀, X ω₀)) /
                  (P_X (X ω₀) * P_TXY ((T ω₀, X ω₀), Y ω₀))) := by
              intro ω hω_fil
              obtain ⟨_, h_eq_z⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_fil
              rw [hpX_eq ω, hpXY_eq ω, hpTX_eq ω, hpTXY_eq ω]
              have ht : T ω = T ω₀ := congrArg (fun p => p.1.1) h_eq_z
              have hx : X ω = X ω₀ := congrArg (fun p => p.1.2) h_eq_z
              have hy : Y ω = Y ω₀ := congrArg (fun p => p.2) h_eq_z
              rw [ht, hx, hy]
            rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul]
            have h_sum_fil : (∑ ω ∈ F.filter (fun ω => ((T ω, X ω), Y ω) = ((T ω₀, X ω₀), Y ω₀)),

              dsimp [P_TXY]
              rw [Finset.sum_filter]
            rw [h_sum_fil]

              rw [← hpX_eq ω₀]; exact (finProbAt_pos_of_mem h_nn X hω₀F).ne'
            field_simp [hpX0, hpz_pos.ne']
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_each_z]
          have h_sub_prod : S_TXY ⊆ S_TX ×ˢ S_Y := by
            intro z hz
            obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
            exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hω, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hω⟩
          have h_term_nn : ∀ z ∈ S_TX ×ˢ S_Y, z ∉ S_TXY →
              0 ≤ (P_XY z.1.2 z.2 * P_TX z.1) / P_X z.1.2 := by
            intro z _ _
            have h1 : 0 ≤ P_XY z.1.2 z.2 :=
              Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
            have h2 : 0 ≤ P_TX z.1 :=
              Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
            have h3 : 0 ≤ P_X z.1.2 :=
              Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
            exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg h1 h2) h3
          calc ∑ z ∈ S_TXY, (P_XY z.1.2 z.2 * P_TX z.1) / P_X z.1.2
              ≤ ∑ z ∈ S_TX ×ˢ S_Y, (P_XY z.1.2 z.2 * P_TX z.1) / P_X z.1.2 :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub_prod h_term_nn
            _ = ∑ tx ∈ S_TX, ∑ y ∈ S_Y, (P_XY tx.2 y * P_TX tx) / P_X tx.2 :=
                Finset.sum_product _ _ _
            _ = ∑ tx ∈ S_TX, P_TX tx := by
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tx htx => ?_)
                obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp htx
                have hpX0_pos : 0 < P_X (X ω₀) := by
                  rw [← hpX_eq ω₀]; exact finProbAt_pos_of_mem h_nn X hω₀
                have h_factor_tx : (∑ y ∈ S_Y, (P_XY (X ω₀) y * P_TX (T ω₀, X ω₀)) / P_X (X ω₀)) =
                    (∑ y ∈ S_Y, P_XY (X ω₀) y) * (P_TX (T ω₀, X ω₀) / P_X (X ω₀)) := by
                  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => by ring)
                rw [h_factor_tx]
                have h_sum_Y : ∑ y ∈ S_Y, P_XY (X ω₀) y = P_X (X ω₀) := by
                  dsimp [P_XY, P_X]
                  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
                  have h_ite_y : ∀ y : β,
                      (if (X ω, Y ω) = (X ω₀, y) then π ω else 0) =
                      (if X ω = X ω₀ then (if Y ω = y then π ω else 0) else 0) := by
                    intro y
                    by_cases hx : X ω = X ω₀ <;> simp [hx]
                  simp_rw [h_ite_y]
                  by_cases hx : X ω = X ω₀
                  · simp only [hx, ↓reduceIte]
                    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq S_Y (Y ω), if_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem Y hω)]
                  · simp [hx]
                rw [h_sum_Y, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpX0_pos.ne']
            _ = 1 := by
                dsimp [P_TX]
                rw [Finset.sum_comm]
                have h_s : (∑ ω ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ S_TX, if (T ω, X ω) = y then π ω else 0) =
                    ∑ ω ∈ F, π ω := by
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
                  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq S_TX (T ω, X ω), if_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hω)]
                rw [h_s, sum_posSupport_eq_one h_nn h_sum]
      _ = 0 := sub_self 1
  have finMutualInfo_sub_le_condEntropy {N_ω : ℕ} {τ α β : Type}
      {ε : ℝ} {π : Fin N_ω → ℝ}
      (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
      (h_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (h_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1)
      (T : Fin N_ω → τ) (G₁ : Fin N_ω → α) (G₂ : Fin N_ω → β) :
      finMutualInfo ε π T G₁ - finMutualInfo ε π T G₂ ≤ finCondEntropy ε π G₂ G₁ := by
    have h1 := finCondEntropy_cond_le hε₀ hε₁ h_nn h_sum T G₁ G₂
    have h2 := finCondEntropy_nonneg hε₀ hε₁ h_nn (fun ω => (T ω, G₂ ω)) G₁
    rw [finMutualInfo_eq_raw ε h_nn h_sum T G₁,
        finMutualInfo_eq_raw ε h_nn h_sum T G₂,
        finCondEntropy_eq_raw_sub ε h_nn G₂ G₁]
    rw [finCondEntropy_eq_raw_sub ε h_nn (fun ω => (T ω, G₁ ω)) G₂,
        finCondEntropy_eq_raw_sub ε h_nn G₁ G₂] at h1
    rw [finCondEntropy_eq_raw_sub ε h_nn (fun ω => (T ω, G₂ ω)) G₁] at h2
    have h_symm1 : stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => (G₁ ω, G₂ ω)) =
        stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => (G₂ ω, G₁ ω)) := by
      apply rawFinEntropy_congr ε h_nn
      intro ω₁ _ ω₂ _
      simp [and_comm]
    have h_symm2 : stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((T ω, G₁ ω), G₂ ω)) =
        stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((T ω, G₂ ω), G₁ ω)) := by
      apply rawFinEntropy_congr ε h_nn
      intro ω₁ _ ω₂ _
      simp only [Prod.ext_iff]
      tauto
    linarith
  have finCondEntropy_le_card_bound {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β]
      {ε M : ℝ} {π : Fin N_ω → ℝ}
      (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) (hM : 0 < M)
      (h_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (h_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β)
      (B : α → Finset β)
      (h_mem : ∀ ω ∈ stdApPosSupport π, Y ω ∈ B (X ω))
      (h_card : ∀ x : α, ((B x).card : ℝ) ≤ M) :
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y ≤ Real.log M / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    letI := Classical.decEq α
    have hell : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := log_eps_inv_pos hε₀ hε₁
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    rw [sum_posSupport_mul h_nn, ← sub_nonpos]
    let F := stdApPosSupport π
    have h_one : ∑ ω ∈ F, π ω = 1 := sum_posSupport_eq_one h_nn h_sum
    have h_lhs : (∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))) -
        Real.log M / Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
        (∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) - Real.log M)) /
          Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      have h_s1 : (∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))) =
          (∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
      have h_s2 : Real.log M = ∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * Real.log M := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h_one, one_mul]
      rw [h_s1, ← sub_div]
      congr 1
      conv_lhs => rw [h_s2]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
    rw [h_lhs]
    refine div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ?_ hell.le
    have h_kl : ∀ ω ∈ F,
        π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) - Real.log M) ≤
        π ω * (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω) - 1) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hπ_pos : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hπ_pos.le
      have hpX : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := finProbAt_pos_of_mem h_nn X hω
      have hpXY : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
        rw [finProbAt2_eq_finProbAt_prod]; exact finProbAt_pos_of_mem h_nn _ hω
      have h_eq : -Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) - Real.log M =
          Real.log (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω)) := by
        rw [Real.log_div hpXY.ne' hpX.ne', Real.log_div hpX.ne' (mul_pos hM hpXY).ne',
            Real.log_mul hM.ne' hpXY.ne']
        ring
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hpX (mul_pos hM hpXY))
    calc ∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) - Real.log M)
        ≤ ∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω) - 1) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_kl
      _ = (∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω))) - 1 := by
          have : ∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω) - 1) =
              (∑ ω ∈ F, π ω * (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω))) - ∑ ω ∈ F, π ω := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
          rw [this, h_one]
      _ ≤ 1 - 1 := by
          gcongr
          let P_X : α → ℝ := fun x => ∑ ω' ∈ F, if X ω' = x then π ω' else 0
          let P_XY : α × β → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω' ∈ F, if (X ω', Y ω') = z then π ω' else 0
          have hpX_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt π X ω = P_X (X ω) := by
            intro ω
            rw [finProbAt_eq_sum_posSupport h_nn X ω]
          have hpXY_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 π X Y ω = P_XY (X ω, Y ω) := by
            intro ω
            rw [finProbAt2_eq_finProbAt_prod, finProbAt_eq_sum_posSupport h_nn]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by split_ifs <;> rfl)
          let S_X := F.image X
          let S_XY := F.image (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω))
          let S_cov := S_X.biUnion (fun x => (B x).image (fun y => (x, y)))
          have h_fib := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
            (g := fun ω => (X ω, Y ω))
            (t := S_XY)
            (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hω)
            (fun ω => π ω * (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω)))).symm
          rw [h_fib]
          have h_each : ∀ z ∈ S_XY,
              (∑ ω ∈ F.filter (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω) = z),
                π ω * (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω))) = P_X z.1 / M := by
            intro z hz
            obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀F, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
            have hpXY0 : 0 < P_XY (X ω₀, Y ω₀) := by
              rw [← hpXY_eq ω₀, finProbAt2_eq_finProbAt_prod]
              exact finProbAt_pos_of_mem h_nn _ hω₀F
            have h_congr : ∀ ω ∈ F.filter (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω) = (X ω₀, Y ω₀)),
                π ω * (finProbAt π X ω / (M * finProbAt2 π X Y ω)) =
                π ω * (P_X (X ω₀) / (M * P_XY (X ω₀, Y ω₀))) := by
              intro ω hω_fil
              obtain ⟨_, h_eq_z⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_fil
              rw [hpX_eq ω, hpXY_eq ω]
              have hx : X ω = X ω₀ := congrArg Prod.fst h_eq_z
              have hy : Y ω = Y ω₀ := congrArg Prod.snd h_eq_z
              rw [hx, hy]
            rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul]
            have h_fil_sum : (∑ ω ∈ F.filter (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω) = (X ω₀, Y ω₀)), π ω) =
                P_XY (X ω₀, Y ω₀) := by
              dsimp [P_XY]
              rw [Finset.sum_filter]
            rw [h_fil_sum]
            field_simp [hM.ne', hpXY0.ne']
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_each]
          have h_sub : S_XY ⊆ S_cov := by
            intro z hz
            obtain ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
            refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨X ω, Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω, ?_⟩
            exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (h_mem ω hω)
          have h_nn_z : ∀ z ∈ S_cov, z ∉ S_XY → 0 ≤ P_X z.1 / M := by
            intro z _ _
            refine div_nonneg ?_ hM.le
            exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
          calc ∑ z ∈ S_XY, P_X z.1 / M
              ≤ ∑ z ∈ S_cov, P_X z.1 / M := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub h_nn_z
            _ = ∑ x ∈ S_X, ∑ z ∈ (B x).image (fun y => (x, y)), P_X z.1 / M := by
                refine Finset.sum_biUnion ?_
                intro x₁ _ x₂ _ hne
                rw [Function.onFun, Finset.disjoint_left]
                intro z hz₁ hz₂
                obtain ⟨y₁, _, hy₁⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz₁
                obtain ⟨y₂, _, hy₂⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz₂
                exact hne (by rw [← hy₁] at hy₂; exact (congrArg Prod.fst hy₂).symm)
            _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ S_X, P_X x := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => ?_)
                have h_im : ∑ z ∈ (B x).image (fun y => (x, y)), P_X z.1 / M =
                    ((B x).card : ℝ) * (P_X x / M) := by
                  rw [Finset.sum_image (fun y₁ _ y₂ _ h => congrArg Prod.snd h)]
                  simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
                rw [h_im]
                have hpX_nn : 0 ≤ P_X x :=
                  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
                calc ((B x).card : ℝ) * (P_X x / M)
                    ≤ M * (P_X x / M) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_card x) (div_nonneg hpX_nn hM.le)
                  _ = P_X x := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hM.ne'
            _ = 1 := by
                dsimp [P_X]
                rw [Finset.sum_comm]
                have h_s : (∑ ω ∈ F, ∑ x ∈ S_X, if X ω = x then π ω else 0) = ∑ ω ∈ F, π ω := by
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
                  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq S_X (X ω), if_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω)]
                rw [h_s, h_one]
      _ = 0 := sub_self 1

      (∀ (ε L : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
