            ((∑ d : Fin (N_loc js), qD_loc js d * ((1 + γ) * B_loc js d + (1 - γ) * A_loc js d)) -
             (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N_loc js),
               q_loc js tid d * Real.log (q_loc js tid d / (p_Tj js.1 tid * qD_loc js d))) /
               Real.log (ε⁻¹))) =
          (∑ js : ActSub, p_J js.1 *
            (∑ d : Fin (N_loc js), qD_loc js d * ((1 + γ) * B_loc js d + (1 - γ) * A_loc js d))) -
          (∑ js : ActSub, p_J js.1 *
            ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N_loc js),
              q_loc js tid d * Real.log (q_loc js tid d / (p_Tj js.1 tid * qD_loc js d))) /
              Real.log (ε⁻¹))) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => mul_sub _ _ _)
      have h_div_add16 : (1 + Real.log 16) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
          1 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + Real.log 16 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := add_div _ _ _
      linarith [h_glob_root, hEw_glob, hITD_glob, h_loc_avg, h_split_loc, h_div_add16]
    let Δ'_cell : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun j =>
      stdApertureDeficit ε γ L' u 0 e_u (π_cell j) T_idx (V'_cell j) (A'_cell j) c_s θ_s
    have h_avg_def :
        ∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j * Δ'_cell j ≤
        stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b_u a_u π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s +
          C_loc / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      have h_expand :
          (∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j * Δ'_cell j) =
          (∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j * τ'_cell j) + classicalGrowthRate γ * u -
          (∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j *
            stdApertureScore ε γ u 0 e_u (π_cell j) T_idx (V'_cell j) (A'_cell j) c_s θ_s) := by
        have hbu : classicalGrowthRate γ * u = ∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j * (classicalGrowthRate γ * u) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hpJ_sum, one_mul]
        rw [hbu, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        dsimp [Δ'_cell, τ'_cell]
        unfold stdApertureDeficit
        ring
      rw [h_expand]
      unfold stdApertureDeficit
      have hC_split : C_loc / Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
          (1 + Real.log 16) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + (Real.log 3600 + Real.log 81) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        dsimp [C_loc]; ring
      linarith [h_avg_root_ub, h_avg_score_lb, hC_split]
    obtain ⟨j_star, hj_star_mem, hj_star_min⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image ActiveJ Δ'_cell hAct_ne
    refine ⟨π_cell j_star, V'_cell j_star, A'_cell j_star,
      (h_cell_law j_star hj_star_mem).1,
      fun ω hω => ((h_cell_law j_star hj_star_mem).2 ω hω).1, ?_⟩
    have h_min_le_avg : Δ'_cell j_star ≤ ∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j * Δ'_cell j := by
      calc Δ'_cell j_star
          = (∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j) * Δ'_cell j_star := by rw [hpJ_sum, one_mul]
        _ = ∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j * Δ'_cell j_star := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ ActiveJ, p_J j * Δ'_cell j := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => ?_)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hj_star_min j hj) (hpJ_pos j hj).le
    exact le_trans h_min_le_avg h_avg_def
  obtain ⟨_, h_root_gen, h_lb_gen⟩ := s1_root_and_deficit_lb
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, s2_deficit_transfer, ?_⟩
  · intro ε N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part c_s hε₀ hε₁ h_law
    exact h_root_gen ε (1 + m) π T_idx V_part A_part c_s hε₀ hε₁ (by linarith) h_law
  · intro u_min η hu_min0 hu_min1 hη
    obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, h_lb⟩ :=
      h_lb_gen (1 + m) u_min η (by linarith) hu_min0 hu_min1 hη
    exact ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, fun ε u b a _ _ π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s
      hε₀ hε_lt hu_lo hu_hi hb₀ hba hau h_law hθ =>
      h_lb ε (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s
        hε₀ hε_lt hu_lo hu_hi le_rfl hb₀ hba hau h_law hθ⟩
  · intro u b_u a_u hu₀ hu₁ hb_u ha_u hau_m
    rintro ⟨ε_seq, N_ω, N_T, π_seq, T_seq, V_seq, A_seq, c_seq, θ_seq,
      hε_bds, hε_lim, h_laws, h_def_lim⟩
    let e_u := a_u - b_u
    have he_u_nn : 0 ≤ e_u := sub_nonneg.mpr ha_u
    have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := hu₀.ne'
    obtain ⟨C_loc, hC_loc_nn, h_loc⟩ := s3_zero_base_loc
    have h_loc_n : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ∃ (π' : Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ) (V' A' : Fin (N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          IsUnitBallTimeLaw π' V' A' (c_seq n) ∧
          (∀ ω, 0 < π' ω → 0 < π_seq n ω) ∧
          stdApertureDeficit (ε_seq n) γ (e_u + u) u 0 e_u
            π' (T_seq n) V' A' (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) ≤
            stdApertureDeficit (ε_seq n) γ (1 + m) u b_u a_u
              (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n) (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) +
              C_loc / Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹) :=
      fun n => h_loc (ε_seq n) u b_u a_u (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n)
        (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) (hε_bds n).1 (hε_bds n).2 hu₀ hu₁ hb_u ha_u hau_m
        (h_laws n).1 (h_laws n).2
    choose π'_seq V'_seq A'_seq h'_spec using h_loc_n
    let Δ' : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
      stdApertureDeficit (ε_seq n) γ (e_u + u) u 0 e_u
        (π'_seq n) (T_seq n) (V'_seq n) (A'_seq n) (c_seq n) (θ_seq n)
    have hΔ'_lim : Filter.Tendsto Δ' Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro η hη
      obtain ⟨ε_lb, hε_lb_pos, _, h_lb⟩ :=
        h_lb_gen (1 + m) u (η / 2) (by linarith) hu₀ hu₁ (half_pos hη)
      let M_log : ℝ := 2 * (C_loc + 1) / η
      have hM_pos : 0 < M_log := div_pos (by linarith) hη
      let ε_log : ℝ := Real.exp (-M_log)
      have hε_log_pos : 0 < ε_log := Real.exp_pos _
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hε_lim) (min ε_lb ε_log)
        (lt_min hε_lb_pos hε_log_pos)
      obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_def_lim) (η / 2) (half_pos hη)
      refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hε_n_pos : 0 < ε_seq n := (hε_bds n).1
      have hε_dist := hN₁ n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hε_n_pos] at hε_dist
      have hε_lt_lb : ε_seq n < ε_lb := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_dist (min_le_left _ _)
      have hε_lt_log : ε_seq n < ε_log := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_dist (min_le_right _ _)
      have h_lo : -(η / 2) ≤ Δ' n :=
        h_lb (ε_seq n) (e_u + u) u 0 e_u (π'_seq n) (T_seq n) (V'_seq n) (A'_seq n)
          (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) hε_n_pos hε_lt_lb le_rfl hu₁
          (by dsimp [e_u]; linarith) le_rfl he_u_nn le_rfl
          (h'_spec n).1 (fun ω hω => (h_laws n).2 ω ((h'_spec n).2.1 ω hω))
      have h_inv_gt : Real.exp M_log < (ε_seq n)⁻¹ := by
        have := inv_strictAnti₀ hε_n_pos hε_lt_log
        rwa [← Real.exp_neg, neg_neg] at this
      have h_log_gt : M_log < Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹) := by
        have := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos M_log) h_inv_gt
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      have h_cloc_lt : C_loc / Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹) < η / 2 := by
        calc C_loc / Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹)
            ≤ C_loc / M_log := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hC_loc_nn hM_pos h_log_gt.le
          _ < (C_loc + 1) / M_log := div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by linarith) hM_pos
          _ = η / 2 := by
              dsimp [M_log]
              have hC1_ne : C_loc + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
              field_simp [hC1_ne, hη.ne']
      have hΔ_dist := hN₂ n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hΔ_dist
      have hΔ_lt : stdApertureDeficit (ε_seq n) γ (1 + m) u b_u a_u
          (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n) (c_seq n) (θ_seq n) < η / 2 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) hΔ_dist
      have h_hi : Δ' n < η := by linarith [(h'_spec n).2.2]
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_lt]
      exact ⟨by linarith, h_hi⟩
    have h_pow_lt : ∀ {x r : ℝ}, 0 < x → 0 < r → x < r ^ (1 / u) → x ^ u < r := by
      intro x r hx hr hlt
      calc x ^ u < (r ^ (1 / u)) ^ u := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hx.le hlt hu₀
        _ = r := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul hr.le, one_div_mul_cancel hu_ne, Real.rpow_one]
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hε_lim)
      ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (1 / u)) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _)
    let ε_tilde : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (ε_seq (k + N₀)) ^ u
    have hε_tilde_bds : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < ε_tilde k ∧ ε_tilde k < 1 / 2 := by
      intro k
      have hk_pos : 0 < ε_seq (k + N₀) := (hε_bds (k + N₀)).1
      refine ⟨Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hk_pos u, ?_⟩
      have h_dist := hN₀ (k + N₀) (Nat.le_add_left N₀ k)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hk_pos] at h_dist
      have h_quarter : ε_tilde k < 1 / 4 := h_pow_lt hk_pos (by norm_num) h_dist
      linarith
    have hε_tilde_lim : Filter.Tendsto ε_tilde Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro r hr
      obtain ⟨N_r, hN_r⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hε_lim)
        (r ^ (1 / u)) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr _)
      refine ⟨N_r, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      have hk_pos : 0 < ε_seq (k + N₀) := (hε_bds (k + N₀)).1
      have h_dist := hN_r (k + N₀) (by omega)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hk_pos] at h_dist
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (hε_tilde_bds k).1]
      exact h_pow_lt hk_pos hr h_dist
    refine ⟨div_nonneg he_u_nn hu₀.le,
      ε_tilde, fun k => N_ω (k + N₀), fun k => N_T (k + N₀),
      fun k => π'_seq (k + N₀), fun k => T_seq (k + N₀),
      fun k => V'_seq (k + N₀), fun k => A'_seq (k + N₀),
      fun k => c_seq (k + N₀), fun k => θ_seq (k + N₀),
      hε_tilde_bds, hε_tilde_lim, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨h_ulaw, h_supp_imp, _⟩ := h'_spec (k + N₀)
      exact ⟨h_ulaw.1, h_ulaw.2.1, h_ulaw.2.2.1,
        fun ω hω => ⟨h_ulaw.2.2.2 ω hω, (h_laws (k + N₀)).2 ω (h_supp_imp ω hω)⟩⟩
    · have h_shift_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Δ' (k + N₀)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N₀).mpr hΔ'_lim
      have h_lin_lim : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun k => classicalGrowthRate γ - u⁻¹ * Δ' (k + N₀))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (classicalGrowthRate γ)) := by
        simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.sub (h_shift_lim.const_mul (u⁻¹))
      refine h_lin_lim.congr (fun k => ?_)
      have h_inv := s4_power_invariance (ε_seq (k + N₀)) u e_u
        (π'_seq (k + N₀)) (T_seq (k + N₀)) (V'_seq (k + N₀)) (A'_seq (k + N₀))
        (c_seq (k + N₀)) (θ_seq (k + N₀)) (hε_bds (k + N₀)).1 hu₀
      dsimp [ε_tilde]
      rw [h_inv]
      dsimp [Δ']
      unfold stdApertureDeficit
      field_simp [hu_ne]
      ring

std_aperture_shape_and_duration_reductio.definitions:
noncomputable def stdApUVec2D (φ : ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ]

noncomputable def stdApPosSupport {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) : Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)

noncomputable def stdApRawEntropy {N_ω : ℕ} {α : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (X : Fin N_ω → α) : ℝ :=
  (∑ ω ∈ stdApPosSupport π, -(π ω * Real.log (finProbAt π X ω))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)

noncomputable def stdApIvFinset (ε s x₀ R : ℝ) : Finset ℤ :=
  Finset.Icc ⌊(x₀ - R) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε s)⌋
             ⌊(x₀ + R) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε s)⌋

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ) :
    (∀ (u η_loss : ℝ), 0 < u → u ≤ 1 → 0 < η_loss →
      ∃ (δ_in ε₀ : ℝ), 0 < δ_in ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε b a : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < ε₀ → 0 ≤ b → b ≤ a → a + u ≤ 1 + m →
        ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
          (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
          IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s →
          (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ_s ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
          stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ≤ δ_in →
          ∃ θ_det : Fin N_T × ℤ → ℝ,
            (∀ p, θ_det p ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
            stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s
              (fun ω => θ_det (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))) ≤ η_loss) ∧
    (∀ (u b a d η_slack : ℝ),
      0 < u → u ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ b → b < a → a + u ≤ 1 + m →
      0 < d → d < a - b → 0 < η_slack →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
        ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
          (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (c_s θ₂ : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (θ_det : Fin N_T × ℤ → ℝ),
          IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s →
          (∀ p, θ_det p ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
          (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ₂ ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
          (let θ₁ := fun ω => θ_det (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))
           let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
           (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
             1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁ ω)) (angBin ε d (θ₂ ω))) →
           2 * γ * (a - b - d) ≤
             stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₁ +
             stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₂ +
             η_slack))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_log_gt_of_lt_exp : ∀ (K ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < Real.exp (-K) → K < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro K ε hε_pos hε_lt
    have h1 : ε * Real.exp K < Real.exp (-K) * Real.exp K :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hε_lt (Real.exp_pos K)
    rw [← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero] at h1
    have h2 : Real.exp K < ε⁻¹ := by
      have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 (inv_pos.mpr hε_pos)
      rwa [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hε_pos), one_mul, mul_one] at h_mul
    have h3 := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos K) h2
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at h3
  have h_log_nat_pow : ∀ (ε C α : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
      0 < ε → 1 ≤ C → 1 ≤ N → (N : ℝ) ≤ C * ε ^ (-α) →
      Real.log (N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log C + α * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε C α N hε_pos hC_ge hN_ge hN_le
    have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by omega))
    have hC_pos : 0 < C := by linarith
    have hpow_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-α) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos (-α)
    have h_le : Real.log (N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (C * ε ^ (-α)) := Real.log_le_log hN_pos hN_le
    rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hC_pos) (ne_of_gt hpow_pos), Real.log_rpow hε_pos] at h_le
    rw [Real.log_inv]
    linarith
  have h_master_sep : ∀ (u ν_gap η_err : ℝ),
      0 < u → u ≤ 1 → 0 < ν_gap → 0 < η_err →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε b a d : ℝ),
          0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
          0 ≤ b → b < a → a + u ≤ 1 + m →

        π_rep T_rep V_part A_part c_rep θ₁_rep θ₂_rep h_law_rep hθ_rep h_subindep_rep
      dsimp only at h_sep_ineq
      have h_abd_eq : a - b - d = ν := by
        dsimp only [d]
        ring
      rw [h_abd_eq, h_def1_rep, h_def2_rep] at h_sep_ineq
      have h_P_rep_le : P_sep_rep ≤ ζ_max := by
        have h_2gν_pos : 0 < 2 * γ * ν := by positivity
        have h_rhs : stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s +
            stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s + η_rep ≤
            (2 * γ * ν) * ζ_max := by
          dsimp only [η_rep]
          linarith [h_def_in, hδ_le_rep]
        have h_comb : (2 * γ * ν) * P_sep_rep ≤ (2 * γ * ν) * ζ_max :=
          le_trans h_sep_ineq h_rhs
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_comb h_2gν_pos
      let E_bad : Fin N_ω → Bool := fun ω =>
        decide (1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ_s ω)) (angBin ε d (θ' ω)))
      let P_bad : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_bad ω then π ω else 0
      have hP_bad_le : P_bad ≤ ζ_max := by
        have hP_bad_eq : P_bad = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
            if 1 < cyclicBinDist (2 ^ dyadicTimeLevel ε d) (angBin ε d (θ_s ω))
                (angBin ε d (θ_det (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))))
            then π ω else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          dsimp only [E_bad, M_d, θ']
          by_cases hc : 1 < cyclicBinDist (2 ^ dyadicTimeLevel ε d) (angBin ε d (θ_s ω))
              (angBin ε d (θ_det (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))))
          · rw [if_pos (decide_eq_true hc), if_pos hc]
          · rw [if_neg (by simpa using hc), if_neg hc]
        rw [hP_bad_eq]
        exact le_trans h_miss_le h_P_rep_le
      obtain ⟨M_all, N_good, hM_ge, hM_le, hNg_ge, hNg_le, h_cond_raw⟩ :
          ∃ (M_all N_good : ℕ), 1 ≤ M_all ∧
            (M_all : ℝ) ≤ 100000 * ε ^ (-(6 + 5 * m)) ∧
            1 ≤ N_good ∧
            (N_good : ℝ) ≤ 10000000 * ε ^ (-(3 * ν)) ∧
            finCondEntropy ε π G_s G' ≤
              (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ) +
                P_bad * Real.log (M_all : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        obtain ⟨⟨M_all, hM_ge, hM_le, hM_card⟩, _, h_good_cnt⟩ :=
          aperture_orientation_replacement_counts ε m u b a ν hε₀ hε_lt_half hm hu₀ hu₁
            hb hba hau hν_pos π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s θ' h_law hθ_s
            (fun ω _ => hθ_det_mem _)
        obtain ⟨N_good, hNg_ge, hNg_le, hNg_card⟩ := h_good_cnt h_gt_2ν
        have h_bad_sub : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
            0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = true)).image G').card ≤ M_all := by
          refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.image_subset_image ?_)) hM_card
          intro ω hω
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hω ⊢
          exact ⟨hω.1, hω.2.1⟩
        have h_good_fib : ∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
              0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = false ∧ G_s ω = G_s ω₀)).image G').card ≤ N_good := by
          intro ω₀ hω₀
          have h_eq : Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
              0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = false ∧ G_s ω = G_s ω₀) =
            Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
              0 < π ω ∧ cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ_s ω)) (angBin ε d (θ' ω)) ≤ 1 ∧
              G_s ω = G_s ω₀) := by
            refine Finset.filter_congr (fun ω _ => ?_)
            have h_iff : E_bad ω = false ↔
                cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ_s ω)) (angBin ε d (θ' ω)) ≤ 1 := by
              dsimp only [E_bad]
              rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_lt]
            exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h_iff.mp h.2.1, h.2.2⟩,
              fun h => ⟨h.1, h_iff.mpr h.2.1, h.2.2⟩⟩
          rw [h_eq]
          exact hNg_card ω₀ hω₀
        have h_cond_raw := h_supp G_s G' E_bad N_good M_all hNg_ge hM_ge h_good_fib h_bad_sub
        have hP_bad_cls : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_bad ω = true then π ω else 0) = P_bad := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          cases hEb : E_bad ω with
          | false =>
            rw [if_neg Bool.false_ne_true, if_neg Bool.false_ne_true]
          | true =>
            rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl]
        rw [hP_bad_cls] at h_cond_raw
        exact ⟨M_all, N_good, hM_ge, hM_le, hNg_ge, hNg_le, h_cond_raw⟩
      have h_split_div : (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ) +
          P_bad * Real.log (M_all : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
          (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) +
          P_bad * (Real.log (M_all : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
        rw [add_div, mul_div_assoc]
      rw [h_split_div] at h_cond_raw
      have h_logNg : Real.log (N_good : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 10000000 + (3 * ν) * Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
        h_log_nat_pow ε 10000000 (3 * ν) N_good hε₀ (by norm_num) hNg_ge hNg_le
      have h_term_good : (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ η_loss / 2 := by
        have h_num : Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ) ≤
            (Real.log 2 + Real.log 10000000) + (3 * ν) * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by linarith
        have h_div : (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
            (Real.log 2 + Real.log 10000000) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + 3 * ν := by
          calc (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)
              ≤ ((Real.log 2 + Real.log 10000000) + (3 * ν) * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num h_ell_pos.le
            _ = (Real.log 2 + Real.log 10000000) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + 3 * ν := by
                rw [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (ne_of_gt h_ell_pos)]
        linarith
      have h_logM : Real.log (M_all : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 100000 + (6 + 5 * m) * Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
        h_log_nat_pow ε 100000 (6 + 5 * m) M_all hε₀ (by norm_num) hM_ge hM_le
      have h_M_ratio : Real.log (M_all : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ 25 + 5 * m := by
        have h_div : Real.log (M_all : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
            Real.log 100000 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + (6 + 5 * m) := by
          calc Real.log (M_all : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)
              ≤ (Real.log 100000 + (6 + 5 * m) * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_logM h_ell_pos.le
            _ = Real.log 100000 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + (6 + 5 * m) := by
                rw [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (ne_of_gt h_ell_pos)]
        linarith
      have h_M_ratio_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (M_all : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
        div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hM_ge)) h_ell_pos.le
      have h_term_bad : P_bad * (Real.log (M_all : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ≤ η_loss / 4 := by
        have h_mul : P_bad * (Real.log (M_all : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ≤ ζ_max * (25 + 5 * m) :=
          mul_le_mul hP_bad_le h_M_ratio h_M_ratio_nn hζ_pos.le
        have h_eq_zeta : ζ_max * (25 + 5 * m) = η_loss / 4 := by
          dsimp only [ζ_max]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt h_25m_pos]
        rwa [h_eq_zeta] at h_mul
      have h_rep_θ := h_def_replace θ'
      linarith
  · intro u b a d η_slack hu₀ hu₁ hb hba hau hd hd_lt hη_slack
    have hν_gap : 0 < a - b - d := sub_pos.mpr hd_lt
    obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, h_sep_bound⟩ :=
      h_master_sep u (a - b - d) η_slack hu₀ hu₁ hν_gap hη_slack
    refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, ?_⟩
    intro ε hε₀_lt_ε hε_lt N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₂ θ_det h_law hθ_det hθ₂ θ₁ M_d h_sep
    have hε_lt_half : ε < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hε_lt hε₀_lt
    let C_u := fun ω : Fin N_ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)
    let D₁ := fun ω : Fin N_ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
      (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₁ ω)
    let D₂ := fun ω : Fin N_ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
      (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₂ ω)
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, h_det_subindep⟩ :=
      fin_entropy_submod_and_support_bounds ε hε₀_lt_ε hε_lt_half π h_law.1 h_law.2.1
    have h_D1_det : ∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
        T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ → C_u ω₁ = C_u ω₂ → D₁ ω₁ = D₁ ω₂ := by
      intro ω₁ ω₂ _ _ hT hC
      dsimp only [D₁, θ₁, C_u, stdApertureObs, dyadicTimeMid] at hC ⊢
      rw [hT, hC]
    have h_subindep := h_det_subindep T_idx C_u D₁ D₂ h_D1_det
    have h_bound := h_sep_bound ε b a d hε₀_lt_ε hε_lt hb hba hau hd le_rfl
      π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₁ θ₂ h_law
      (fun ω hω => ⟨hθ_det _, hθ₂ ω hω⟩) h_subindep
    have hP_one : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁ ω)) (angBin ε d (θ₂ ω))
        then π ω else 0) = 1 := by
      calc (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
            if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁ ω)) (angBin ε d (θ₂ ω))
            then π ω else 0)
          = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
            · exact if_pos (h_sep ω hω)
            · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (h_law.1 ω)
              simp [h0]
        _ = 1 := h_law.2.1
    dsimp only at h_bound
    rw [hP_one, mul_one] at h_bound
    exact h_bound

subgoal_signatures.name: fin_entropy_submod_and_support_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) :
    (∀ {α β₁ β₂ : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (A : Fin N_ω → β₁) (B : Fin N_ω → β₂),
      finMutualInfo ε π T B ≤ finMutualInfo ε π T A + finCondEntropy ε π A B) ∧
    (letI := Classical.propDecidable
     ∀ {β₁ β₂ : Type} [DecidableEq β₂] (A : Fin N_ω → β₁) (B : Fin N_ω → β₂)
       (E_bad : Fin N_ω → Bool) (N_good M_all : ℕ),
       1 ≤ N_good → 1 ≤ M_all →
       (∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
         ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω =>
           0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = false ∧ A ω = A ω₀)).image B).card ≤ N_good) →
       ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = true)).image B).card ≤ M_all →
       finCondEntropy ε π A B ≤
         (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ) +
           (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_bad ω then π ω else 0) * Real.log (M_all : ℝ)) /
           Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ {α κ β₁ β₂ β_c : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (C : Fin N_ω → κ)
      (D₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (D₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂) (G_c : Fin N_ω → β_c),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
        (D₁ ω₁ = D₁ ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂) ∧
        (D₂ ω₁ = D₂ ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂) ∧
        (G_c ω₁ = G_c ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₁ +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) →
      finMutualInfo ε π T (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) + finMutualInfo ε π T G_c -
        finMutualInfo ε π T D₁ - finMutualInfo ε π T D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π D₁ G_c + finCondEntropy ε π D₂ G_c) ∧
    (∀ {α κ β₁ β₂ : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (C : Fin N_ω → κ)
      (D₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (D₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
        T ω₁ = T ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂ → D₁ ω₁ = D₁ ω₂) →
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₁ +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)))

subgoal_signatures.name: two_aperture_common_intersection_geometry
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ m u ξ ν_gap δ_cl : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (hu₀ : 0 < u) (hu₁ : u ≤ 1)
    (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hν : 0 < ν_gap) (hδ : 0 < δ_cl) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε b a d : ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
        0 ≤ b → b < a → a + u ≤ 1 + m →
        0 < d → ν_gap ≤ a - b - d →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ₁ θ₂ : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
          θ₁ ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧ θ₂ ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
        let D₁ := fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
          (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₁ ω)
        let D₂ := fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
          (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₂ ω)
        let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
        let P_sep := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁ ω)) (angBin ε d (θ₂ ω))
          then π ω else 0
        ∃ G_c : Fin N_ω → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
          (∀ ω, (G_c ω).2.1 = dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)) ∧
          (∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ D₁ ω = D₁ ω₀)).image G_c).card ≤
              3000000 * (⌊(1 + m) / ξ⌋₊ + 1) ∧
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ D₂ ω = D₂ ω₀)).image G_c).card ≤
              3000000 * (⌊(1 + m) / ξ⌋₊ + 1)) ∧
          2 * γ * (a - b - d - 2 * ξ) * P_sep - ξ ≤
            stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₁ +
            stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₂ +
            4 * δ_cl * u +
            (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) +
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_c -
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D₁ -
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D₂)

subgoal_signatures.name: coupled_replica_and_cyclic_modal_window
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ε γ m u b a d : ℝ)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hu₀ : 0 < u) (hu₁ : u ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) (hau : a + u ≤ 1 + m) (hd : 0 < d)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (h_law : IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s)
    (hθ : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ_s ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
    ∃ (π_rep : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → ℝ)
      (T_rep : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → Fin N_T)
      (c_rep θ₁_rep θ₂_rep : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → ℝ)
      (θ_det : Fin N_T × ℤ → ℝ),
      IsUnitBallTimeLaw π_rep V_part A_part c_rep ∧
      (∀ p, 0 < π_rep p →
        θ₁_rep p ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧ θ₂_rep p ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
      stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π_rep T_rep V_part A_part c_rep θ₁_rep =
        stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
      stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π_rep T_rep V_part A_part c_rep θ₂_rep =
        stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
      (let C_rep := fun p => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_rep p)
       let D₁ := fun p => stdApertureObs ε u b a
         (V_part (T_rep p)) (A_part (T_rep p)) (c_rep p) (θ₁_rep p)
       let D₂ := fun p => stdApertureObs ε u b a
         (V_part (T_rep p)) (A_part (T_rep p)) (c_rep p) (θ₂_rep p)
       finCondEntropy ε π_rep (fun p => (T_rep p, C_rep p)) D₁ +
         finCondEntropy ε π_rep (fun p => (T_rep p, C_rep p)) D₂ ≤
         finCondEntropy ε π_rep (fun p => (T_rep p, C_rep p)) (fun p => (D₁ p, D₂ p))) ∧
      (∀ q, θ_det q ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ_s ω))
            (angBin ε d (θ_det (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))))
        then π ω else 0) ≤
        (∑ p : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁_rep p)) (angBin ε d (θ₂_rep p))
          then π_rep p else 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: aperture_orientation_replacement_counts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ε m u b a ν : ℝ)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hu₀ : 0 < u) (hu₁ : u ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) (hau : a + u ≤ 1 + m) (hν : 0 < ν)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s θ' : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (h_law : IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s)
    (hθ_s : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ_s ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)
    (hθ' : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ' ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let G_s := fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
      (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)
    let G' := fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
      (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ' ω)
    (∃ M_all : ℕ, 1 ≤ M_all ∧
      (M_all : ℝ) ≤ 100000 * ε ^ (-(6 + 5 * m)) ∧
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)).image G').card ≤ M_all) ∧
    (a - b ≤ 2 * ν → (∀ ω, θ' ω = 0) →
      ∃ N_small : ℕ, 1 ≤ N_small ∧
        (N_small : ℝ) ≤ 10000 * ε ^ (-(4 * ν)) ∧
        ∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ G_s ω = G_s ω₀)).image G').card ≤ N_small) ∧

    have hb_ge_bt : b_t ≤ b_star z := by
      rw [hb_eq]
      exact (h_raw_bds (D_hat ω_b)).1
    have hba_star : b_star z ≤ a_star z := by
      rw [hb_eq, ha_eq]
      exact le_trans (hω_b.2 ω_a hω_a.1) (h_raw_bds (D_hat ω_a)).2.1
    have ha_ub_star : a_star z + r ≤ a_t + t := by
      rw [ha_eq]
      have h1 := (h_raw_bds (D_hat ω_a)).2.2.1
      dsimp only [L'] at h1
      linarith
    refine ⟨hb_ge_bt, hba_star, ha_ub_star, fun ω_h hπ_z => ?_⟩
    dsimp only [π_Z] at hπ_z
    by_cases hz : Z_shape ω_h = z
    · rw [if_pos hz] at hπ_z
      have hπ_pos : 0 < π_hat ω_h := by
        have h_mul := mul_pos hπ_z hpz
        rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hpz)] at h_mul
      have h_in_pos : ω_h ∈ S_hat_pos := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hπ_pos⟩
      have h_mem : ω_h ∈ E_z z := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨h_in_pos, hz⟩
      have h_eq_b_bin : ⌊b_raw (D_hat ω_h) / ξ⌋₊ = ⌊b_raw (D_hat ω_b) / ξ⌋₊ := by
        have hZ_eq : Z_shape ω_h = Z_shape ω_b := hz.trans hω_b_z.symm
        have h_pair := finProdFinEquiv.injective hZ_eq
        have h_fst : jb_fn (D_hat ω_h) = jb_fn (D_hat ω_b) := congr_arg Prod.fst h_pair
        exact congr_arg Fin.val h_fst
      have h_eq_a_bin : ⌊a_raw (D_hat ω_h) / ξ⌋₊ = ⌊a_raw (D_hat ω_a) / ξ⌋₊ := by
        have hZ_eq : Z_shape ω_h = Z_shape ω_a := hz.trans hω_a_z.symm
        have h_pair := finProdFinEquiv.injective hZ_eq
        have h_snd : ja_fn (D_hat ω_h) = ja_fn (D_hat ω_a) := congr_arg Prod.snd h_pair
        exact congr_arg Fin.val h_snd
      rw [hb_eq, ha_eq]
      exact ⟨hπ_pos, hω_b.2 ω_h h_mem,
        h_same_bin_diff _ _ (hb_raw_range _).1 (hb_raw_range _).1 h_eq_b_bin,
        hω_a.2 ω_h h_mem,
        h_same_bin_diff _ _ (ha_raw_range _).1 (ha_raw_range _).1 h_eq_a_bin⟩
    · rw [if_neg hz] at hπ_z
      exact absurd hπ_z (lt_irrefl 0)
  let θ_obs_hat : Fin L_obs → Fin N_hat → ℝ :=
    fun l ω_h => θ_det l (T_hat ω_h) (dyadicTimeBin ε (u_obs l) (c_hat ω_h))
  let θ_r_hat : Fin N_hat → ℝ := fun ω_h => φ_raw (D_hat ω_h)
  let Δ_obs : Fin L_obs → Fin M_shape → ℝ :=
    fun l z => stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) (u_obs l) (b_obs l) (a_obs l)
      (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part c_hat (θ_obs_hat l)
  let Δ_r : Fin M_shape → ℝ :=
    fun z => stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) r (b_star z) (a_star z)
      (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part c_hat θ_r_hat
  have h_avg_obs : ∀ l : Fin L_obs, ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Δ_obs l z ≤ η₁ := by
    intro l
    let G_l : Fin N_hat → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun ω_h =>
      stdApertureObs ε (u_obs l) (b_obs l) (a_obs l)
        (V_part (T_hat ω_h)) (A_part (T_hat ω_h)) (c_hat ω_h) (θ_obs_hat l ω_h)
    let k_ul : Fin N_hat → ℤ := fun ω_h => dyadicTimeBin ε (u_obs l) (c_hat ω_h)
    obtain ⟨_, h_sp_root, h_sp_mi⟩ :=
      h_tag_split ε (u_obs l) π_hat T_hat V_part A_part c_hat Z_shape G_l
        hε_pos hε_half hM_shape_pos h_law_hat
    change (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z *
        classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_hat N_T (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part) ≤
      τ_hat + finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat Z_shape at h_sp_root
    change (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z *
        (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_hat G_l - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_hat k_ul)) ≤
      (finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat G_l - 2 * finCondEntropy ε π_hat T_hat k_ul) -
        finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat Z_shape +
        (3 * Real.log (M_shape : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) at h_sp_mi
    have h_def_hat_l : stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) (u_obs l) (b_obs l) (a_obs l)
        π_hat T_hat V_part A_part c_hat (θ_obs_hat l) ≤ δ_in := by
      have h_eq := h_def_pull (u_obs l) (b_obs l) (a_obs l)
        (fun ω => θ_det l (T_idx ω) (dyadicTimeBin ε (u_obs l) (c_s ω)))
      dsimp only [θ_obs_hat, T_hat, c_hat]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact h_def_in l
    let C_const : ℝ := classicalGrowthRate γ * u_obs l -
      ((1 + γ) * b_obs l + (1 - γ) * a_obs l)
    have h_expand : (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Δ_obs l z) =
        (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z *
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_hat N_T (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part) +
        (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z) * C_const +
        (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z *
          (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_hat G_l - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_hat k_ul)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [Δ_obs, stdApertureDeficit, stdApertureScore, C_const, G_l, k_ul]
      ring
    rw [h_expand, hp_Z_sum, one_mul]
    dsimp only [stdApertureDeficit, stdApertureScore] at h_def_hat_l
    change τ_hat + classicalGrowthRate γ * u_obs l -
        (((1 + γ) * b_obs l + (1 - γ) * a_obs l) -
          finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat G_l + 2 * finCondEntropy ε π_hat T_hat k_ul) ≤ δ_in
      at h_def_hat_l
    dsimp only [C_const, τ_hat] at h_def_hat_l ⊢
    dsimp only [δ_in] at h_def_hat_l
    linarith [h_sp_root, h_sp_mi, h_def_hat_l, h_log1_le, hη₁_pos]
  obtain ⟨h_law_Z, h_sp_root_r, h_sp_mi_r⟩ :=
    h_tag_split ε r π_hat T_hat V_part A_part c_hat Z_shape D_hat
      hε_pos hε_half hM_shape_pos h_law_hat
  change ∀ z : Fin M_shape, 0 < p_Z z → IsUnitBallTimeLaw (π_Z z) V_part A_part c_hat at h_law_Z
  change (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z *
      classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_hat N_T (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part) ≤
    τ_hat + finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat Z_shape at h_sp_root_r
  change (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z *
      (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_hat D_hat - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_hat k_r_hat)) ≤
    (finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat D_hat - 2 * finCondEntropy ε π_hat T_hat k_r_hat) -
      finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat Z_shape +
      (3 * Real.log (M_shape : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) at h_sp_mi_r
  have h_avg_r : ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Δ_r z ≤ η₁ := by
    let C_r_const : ℝ := classicalGrowthRate γ * r + 2 * ξ + C_rnd / Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have h_pt : ∀ z : Fin M_shape,
        p_Z z * Δ_r z ≤
          p_Z z * classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_hat N_T (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part +
          p_Z z * C_r_const -
          p_Z z * (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_Z z ω_h * W_raw ω_h) +
          p_Z z * (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_hat D_hat -
            2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_hat k_r_hat) := by
      intro z
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hp_Z_nn z) with hp0 | hp_pos
      · rw [← hp0]
        simp
      · obtain ⟨hb_ge, hba_z, _, h_supp_z⟩ := h_star_props z hp_pos
        have hb_nn_z : 0 ≤ b_star z := le_trans hb_t_nn hb_ge
        have h_rnd_z := h_rnd ε r (b_star z) (a_star z) ξ
          (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part c_hat D_hat k_D b_raw a_raw φ_raw V_glob X_glob
          hε_pos hε_half hr_pos hb_nn_z hba_z hξ_pos.le (h_law_Z z hp_pos)
          (fun d_r => (h_raw_bds d_r).2.2.2)
          (fun ω_h _ => hk_D ω_h)
          (fun ω_h hω => ⟨(h_supp_z ω_h hω).2.1, (h_supp_z ω_h hω).2.2.1,
            (h_supp_z ω_h hω).2.2.2.1, (h_supp_z ω_h hω).2.2.2.2⟩)
          (fun ω_h hω => h_raw_geom ω_h (h_supp_z ω_h hω).1)
        have h_def_z : Δ_r z ≤
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_hat N_T (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part +
              C_r_const - (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_Z z ω_h * W_raw ω_h) +
              (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_hat D_hat -
                2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_hat k_r_hat) := by
          dsimp only [Δ_r, stdApertureDeficit, C_r_const, W_raw, k_r_hat, θ_r_hat] at h_rnd_z ⊢
          linarith [h_rnd_z]
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_def_z hp_pos.le
        linarith [h_mul]
    have h_sum_le := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z (_ : z ∈ Finset.univ) => h_pt z)
    have h_ew_eq : (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_Z z ω_h * W_raw ω_h)) =
        E_w_hat := by
      have h_cell : ∀ (z : Fin M_shape) (ω_h : Fin N_hat),
          p_Z z * (π_Z z ω_h * W_raw ω_h) =
            if Z_shape ω_h = z then π_hat ω_h * W_raw ω_h else 0 := by
        intro z ω_h
        dsimp only [π_Z]
        by_cases hz : Z_shape ω_h = z
        · rw [if_pos hz, if_pos hz]
          by_cases hp0 : p_Z z = 0
          · have hπ0 : π_hat ω_h = 0 := by
              have h_le : π_hat ω_h ≤ p_Z z := by
                have h_single : (if Z_shape ω_h = z then π_hat ω_h else 0) ≤ p_Z z := by
                  dsimp only [p_Z]
                  exact Finset.single_le_sum
                    (f := fun ω' : Fin N_hat => if Z_shape ω' = z then π_hat ω' else (0 : ℝ))
                    (fun ω' _ => by
                      split_ifs
                      · exact h_law_hat.1 ω'
                      · exact le_rfl) (Finset.mem_univ ω_h)
                rwa [if_pos hz] at h_single
              exact le_antisymm (h_le.trans hp0.le) (h_law_hat.1 ω_h)
            simp [hp0, hπ0]
          · rw [← mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp0]
        · rw [if_neg hz, if_neg hz]
          ring
      have h1 : (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_Z z ω_h * W_raw ω_h)) =
          ∑ z : Fin M_shape, ∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat,
            if Z_shape ω_h = z then π_hat ω_h * W_raw ω_h else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω_h _ => h_cell z ω_h)
      rw [h1, Finset.sum_comm]
      dsimp only [E_w_hat]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω_h _ => ?_)
      simp
    have h_rhs_eq : (∑ z : Fin M_shape,
        (p_Z z * classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_hat N_T (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part +
          p_Z z * C_r_const -
          p_Z z * (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_Z z ω_h * W_raw ω_h) +
          p_Z z * (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_hat D_hat -
            2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_hat k_r_hat))) =
      (∑ z : Fin M_shape,
          p_Z z * classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_hat N_T (π_Z z) T_hat V_part A_part) +
        (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z) * C_r_const -
        (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_Z z ω_h * W_raw ω_h)) +
        (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_hat D_hat -
          2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_hat k_r_hat)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [h_rhs_eq, hp_Z_sum, one_mul, h_ew_eq] at h_sum_le
    have h_comb_log : C_rnd / Real.log (ε⁻¹) +
        (3 * Real.log (M_shape : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
        (3 * Real.log (M_shape : ℝ) + C_rnd) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by ring
    have h_xi_val : 2 * ξ = η₁ / 6 := by dsimp only [ξ]; ring
    dsimp only [C_r_const, τ_hat, S_raw_hat] at h_raw_def_hat h_sum_le
    linarith [h_sum_le, h_sp_root_r, h_sp_mi_r, h_raw_def_hat, h_comb_log, h_log2_le, h_xi_val]
  let Tot : Fin M_shape → ℝ := fun z => Δ_r z + ∑ l : Fin L_obs, Δ_obs l z
  have h_tot_avg : ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Tot z ≤ η_step / 2 := by
    have h_split : (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Tot z) =
        (∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Δ_r z) +
          ∑ l : Fin L_obs, ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Δ_obs l z := by
      dsimp only [Tot]
      simp_rw [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_obs_sum : ∑ l : Fin L_obs, ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Δ_obs l z ≤
        (L_obs : ℝ) * η₁ := by
      calc ∑ l : Fin L_obs, ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Δ_obs l z
          ≤ ∑ _l : Fin L_obs, η₁ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => h_avg_obs l)
        _ = (L_obs : ℝ) * η₁ := by simp
    have h_eta1_eq : η₁ + (L_obs : ℝ) * η₁ = η_step / 2 := by
      dsimp only [η₁]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hL1_pos]
      ring
    linarith [h_split, h_avg_r, h_obs_sum, h_eta1_eq]
  let S_pos : Finset (Fin M_shape) :=
    @Finset.filter (Fin M_shape) (fun z => 0 < p_Z z) (Classical.decPred _) Finset.univ
  have hS_pos_ne : S_pos.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h_empty
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h_empty
    have h_zero : ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z = 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun z _ => ?_)
      by_contra hz_ne
      have hz_pos : 0 < p_Z z := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp_Z_nn z) (Ne.symm hz_ne)
      have h_mem : z ∈ S_pos := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hz_pos⟩
      simp [h_empty] at h_mem
    linarith [hp_Z_sum]
  have h_sum_pos_p : ∑ z ∈ S_pos, p_Z z = 1 := by
    rw [← hp_Z_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos) (fun z _ hz_not => ?_)
    have h_not_pos : ¬ 0 < p_Z z := fun hp => hz_not (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hp⟩)
    exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_not_pos) (hp_Z_nn z)
  have h_sum_pos_tot : ∑ z ∈ S_pos, p_Z z * Tot z = ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Tot z := by
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos) (fun z _ hz_not => ?_)
    have h_not_pos : ¬ 0 < p_Z z := fun hp => hz_not (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hp⟩)
    have hp0 : p_Z z = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_not_pos) (hp_Z_nn z)
    rw [hp0, zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨z_star, hz_star_mem, hz_star_min⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image S_pos Tot hS_pos_ne
  have hp_z_star_pos : 0 < p_Z z_star := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz_star_mem).2
  have h_tot_z_star : Tot z_star ≤ η_step / 2 := by
    calc Tot z_star
        = 1 * Tot z_star := (one_mul _).symm
      _ = (∑ z ∈ S_pos, p_Z z) * Tot z_star := by rw [h_sum_pos_p]
      _ = ∑ z ∈ S_pos, p_Z z * Tot z_star := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ z ∈ S_pos, p_Z z * Tot z :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z hz =>
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hz_star_min z hz) (hp_Z_nn z))
      _ = ∑ z : Fin M_shape, p_Z z * Tot z := h_sum_pos_tot
      _ ≤ η_step / 2 := h_tot_avg
  obtain ⟨hb_star_ge, hba_z_star, ha_star_ub, _⟩ := h_star_props z_star hp_z_star_pos
  have hb_star_nn : 0 ≤ b_star z_star := le_trans hb_t_nn hb_star_ge
  have ha_star_1m : a_star z_star + r ≤ 1 + m := le_trans ha_star_ub hat_ub
  have h_law_z_star : IsUnitBallTimeLaw (π_Z z_star) V_part A_part c_hat :=
    h_law_Z z_star hp_z_star_pos
  have h_lb_r : -η_lb ≤ Δ_r z_star :=
    h_lb ε r (b_star z_star) (a_star z_star)
      (π_Z z_star) T_hat V_part A_part c_hat θ_r_hat
      hε_pos hε_lt_lb le_rfl hr_le_one hb_star_nn hba_z_star ha_star_1m
      h_law_z_star (fun ω_h _ => (h_raw_bds (D_hat ω_h)).2.2.2)
  have h_lb_obs : ∀ l : Fin L_obs, -η_lb ≤ Δ_obs l z_star :=
    fun l => h_lb ε (u_obs l) (b_obs l) (a_obs l)
      (π_Z z_star) T_hat V_part A_part c_hat (θ_obs_hat l)
      hε_pos hε_lt_lb (hu_obs l).1.le (hu_obs l).2
      (h_ba_obs l).1 (h_ba_obs l).2.1 (h_ba_obs l).2.2
      h_law_z_star (fun _ _ => hθ_det l _ _)
  have h_eta_lb_eq : ((L_obs : ℝ) + 1) * η_lb = η_step / 4 := by
    dsimp only [η_lb]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hL1_pos]
  have h_r_final : Δ_r z_star ≤ η_step := by
    have h_sum_lb : -(L_obs : ℝ) * η_lb ≤ ∑ l : Fin L_obs, Δ_obs l z_star := by
      calc -(L_obs : ℝ) * η_lb
          = ∑ _l : Fin L_obs, (-η_lb) := by simp
        _ ≤ ∑ l : Fin L_obs, Δ_obs l z_star := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => h_lb_obs l)
    dsimp only [Tot] at h_tot_z_star
    linarith [h_tot_z_star, h_sum_lb, h_eta_lb_eq, hη_lb_pos, hη]
  have h_obs_final : ∀ l₀ : Fin L_obs, Δ_obs l₀ z_star ≤ η_step := by
    intro l₀
    have h_split_l0 :=
      Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ (fun l => Δ_obs l z_star) (Finset.mem_univ l₀)
    have h_card_er : ((Finset.univ.erase l₀).card : ℝ) + 1 = (L_obs : ℝ) := by
      have h_nat : (Finset.univ.erase l₀).card + 1 = L_obs := by
        simpa using Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ l₀)
      exact_mod_cast h_nat
    have h_er_lb : -((Finset.univ.erase l₀).card : ℝ) * η_lb ≤
        ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase l₀, Δ_obs l z_star := by
      calc -((Finset.univ.erase l₀).card : ℝ) * η_lb
          = ∑ _l ∈ Finset.univ.erase l₀, (-η_lb) := by simp
        _ ≤ ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase l₀, Δ_obs l z_star :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => h_lb_obs l)
    have h_er_alg : ((Finset.univ.erase l₀).card : ℝ) * η_lb + η_lb = (L_obs : ℝ) * η_lb := by
      calc ((Finset.univ.erase l₀).card : ℝ) * η_lb + η_lb
          = (((Finset.univ.erase l₀).card : ℝ) + 1) * η_lb := by ring
        _ = (L_obs : ℝ) * η_lb := by rw [h_card_er]
    dsimp only [Tot] at h_tot_z_star
    linarith [h_tot_z_star, h_split_l0, h_lb_r, h_er_lb, h_er_alg, h_eta_lb_eq, hη_lb_pos, hη]
  exact ⟨N_hat, π_Z z_star, T_hat, c_hat, b_star z_star, a_star z_star, θ_r_hat,
    h_law_z_star, hb_star_ge, hba_z_star, ha_star_ub,
    fun ω_h _ => (h_raw_bds (D_hat ω_h)).2.2.2,
    h_obs_final, h_r_final⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: std_aperture_deficit_lower_and_tag_splitting
subgoal_signatures.statement:

          (div_le_one hM_pos).mpr h_ratio_sum
        linarith
      linarith
    · intro τ hτ
      have h_restrict : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
            if finProbAt2 π X Y ω < τ * finProbAt π X ω then π ω else 0) =
          ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, if finProbAt2 π X Y ω < τ * finProbAt π X ω then π ω else 0 := by
        symm
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_pos) (fun ω _ hω => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hω
        have h0 : π ω = 0 :=
          le_antisymm (not_lt.mp fun h => hω ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, h⟩) (hπ_nn ω)
        simp [h0]

        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω)]
      calc ∑ x ∈ F_pos.image X,
            ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => X ω = x),
              (if finProbAt2 π X Y ω < τ * finProbAt π X ω then π ω else 0)
          ≤ ∑ x ∈ F_pos.image X,
              (M_cap * τ) * (∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω) := by

            obtain ⟨ω_x, hω_x_mem, hω_x_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx

            have hcard_x : ((S_fib x).card : ℝ) ≤ M_cap := by
              rw [← hω_x_eq]

            rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := F_x) (t := S_fib x)

                have h1 := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω

                  let F_xy := F_x.filter (fun ω => Y ω = y)

                    (if finProbAt2 π X Y ω < τ * finProbAt π X ω then π ω else 0) ≤ τ * p_x
                  by_cases hex : ∃ ω₀ ∈ F_xy, finProbAt2 π X Y ω₀ < τ * finProbAt π X ω₀
                  · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀, hlt₀⟩ := hex
                    have h1 := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
                    have h2 := Finset.mem_filter.mp h1.1
                    rw [h_Fx_eq x ω₀ h2.2, h_Fxy_eq x y ω₀ h2.2 h1.2] at hlt₀
                    calc ∑ ω ∈ F_xy,

                        ≤ ∑ ω ∈ F_xy, π ω :=
                          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => by
                            split_ifs <;> [exact le_rfl; exact hπ_nn ω])
                      _ ≤ τ * p_x := hlt₀.le

                      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω hω => if_neg (not_lt.mpr (hex ω hω)))

                    exact mul_nonneg hτ hp_x_nn
              _ = ((S_fib x).card : ℝ) * (τ * p_x) := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
              _ ≤ M_cap * (τ * p_x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard_x (mul_nonneg hτ hp_x_nn)
              _ = (M_cap * τ) * p_x := by ring
        _ = (M_cap * τ) * ∑ x ∈ F_pos.image X, ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω :=
            (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ = (M_cap * τ) * ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω := by
            rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω)]
        _ = M_cap * τ := by rw [h_sum_Fpos, mul_one]

  have h_univ_ent : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β)
        (S_fib : α → Finset β) (M_cap : ℝ),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →

        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → ((S_fib (X ω)).card : ℝ) ≤ M_cap) →

    fun ε hε₀ hε₁ _ _ _ _ π X Y S_fib M_cap hπ_nn hπ_sum hM h_mem h_card =>
      (h_univ_fib ε hε₀ hε₁ π X Y S_fib M_cap hπ_nn hπ_sum hM h_mem h_card).1

  have h_s3 : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →

        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →

          (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →

                condSurprise ε π T_idx (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω')) ω) ∧

                finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)) ∧
          finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε q (c_s ω)) -
            finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)) ≤

    clear γ m hγ₀ hγ₁ hm h_two

    have h_bin0 : ∀ c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, dyadicTimeBin ε 0 c = 0 := by

      unfold dyadicTimeBin

          have hb := h_bin0 (c_s ω) (hc_mem ω hω)
          by_cases hT : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω

    have h_part1_ent : finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε 0 (c_s ω)) = 0 := by

      by_cases hω : 0 < π ω

    have h_nest : ∀ (r q : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → r ≤ q →
        let m_r := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
        let m_q := dyadicTimeLevel ε q
        m_r ≤ m_q ∧
        (∀ c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          let K : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (m_q - m_r)

      have hq : 0 ≤ q := le_trans hr hle
      have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
      let m_r := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
      let m_q := dyadicTimeLevel ε q
      have hm_le : m_r ≤ m_q := by
        dsimp [m_r, m_q, dyadicTimeLevel]
        exact Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (Nat.ceil_mono

      have h_pow_q := (h_dyad_pow ε hε₀ hε₁).2.2 q hq
      have h_diff_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_q - m_r) < 4 * ε ^ (-(q - r)) := by

          unfold dyadicTimeBin
          change min ⌊(1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r⌋ ((2 ^ m_r : ℤ) - 1) = (2 ^ m_r : ℤ) - 1

            rw [one_mul]
            exact_mod_cast Int.floor_intCast (2 ^ m_r : ℤ)
          rw [hfl]

        have hbq : dyadicTimeBin ε q 1 = (2 ^ m_q : ℤ) - 1 := by
          unfold dyadicTimeBin
          change min ⌊(1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_q⌋ ((2 ^ m_q : ℤ) - 1) = (2 ^ m_q : ℤ) - 1
          have hfl : ⌊(1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_q⌋ = (2 ^ m_q : ℤ) := by

      · have hbr : dyadicTimeBin ε r c = ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r⌋ := by
          unfold dyadicTimeBin
          change min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r⌋ ((2 ^ m_r : ℤ) - 1) = ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r⌋

            rw [Int.floor_lt]
            push_cast

            rw [Int.floor_lt]

          rw [div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hp_T.ne']

        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
        · rw [h_tele ω hω]

          simp [h0]
      refine ⟨h_tele, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [h_ent_diff]
        exact (h_prob_pos ε hε₀ hε₁ π X_r k_q hπ_nn hπ_sum).2
      · rw [h_ent_diff]
        let S_fib : Fin N_T × ℤ → Finset ℤ := fun p => Finset.Ico (p.2 * K) ((p.2 + 1) * K)
        let M_cap : ℝ := 4 * ε ^ (-(q - r))
        have hM_pos : 0 < M_cap := by positivity
        have h_mem_fib : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → k_q ω ∈ S_fib (X_r ω) := by
          intro ω hω
          rw [Finset.mem_Ico]

        have h_card_fib : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → ((S_fib (X_r ω)).card : ℝ) ≤ M_cap := by
          intro ω _

          rw [Int.card_Ico]

          rw [h_sub]

            rw [hK_nat, Int.toNat_natCast]

            rfl

          have h_le₂ : S_path u₂ ≤ S_dyad q₂ := by
            rw [hS₂_def]
            exact csInf_le (hA_bdd u₂) ⟨q₂, hq₂, hu₂_q₂, rfl⟩
          have h_lip := (hS_dyad_lip q₁ q₂ hq₁ hq₂ hq₁_le_q₂).2
          linarith
    let cl : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => min 1 (max 0 u)
    have hS_cl : ∀ u : ℝ, S_path (cl u) = S_path u := by
      intro u
      dsimp [cl]
      by_cases hu0 : u ≤ 0
      · rw [max_eq_left hu0, min_eq_right zero_le_one, hS_zero]
        dsimp [S_path]
        rw [if_pos hu0]
      · have hu_pos : 0 < u := not_le.mp hu0
        rw [max_eq_right hu_pos.le]
        by_cases hu1 : u ≤ 1
        · rw [min_eq_right hu1]
        · rw [min_eq_left (not_le.mp hu1).le, hS_one]
          dsimp [S_path]
          rw [if_neg hu0, if_neg hu1]
    have hS_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ →
        0 ≤ S_path u₂ - S_path u₁ ∧ S_path u₂ - S_path u₁ ≤ u₂ - u₁ := by
      intro u₁ u₂ hle
      have hcl₁ : cl u₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨le_min zero_le_one (le_max_left 0 u₁), min_le_left 1 _⟩
      have hcl₂ : cl u₂ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨le_min zero_le_one (le_max_left 0 u₂), min_le_left 1 _⟩
      have hcl_mono : cl u₁ ≤ cl u₂ := min_le_min_left 1 (max_le_max_left 0 hle)
      have hcl_diff : cl u₂ - cl u₁ ≤ u₂ - u₁ := by
        dsimp [cl]
        rcases le_or_gt u₂ 0 with h20 | h20
        · rw [max_eq_left h20, max_eq_left (le_trans hle h20), min_eq_right zero_le_one]
          linarith
        · rw [max_eq_right h20.le]
          have h_min2 : min 1 u₂ ≤ u₂ := min_le_right 1 u₂
          rcases le_or_gt u₁ 1 with h11 | h11
          · have h_max1 : u₁ ≤ max 0 u₁ := le_max_right 0 u₁
            have h_eq1 : min 1 (max 0 u₁) = max 0 u₁ :=
              min_eq_right (max_le zero_le_one h11)
            rw [h_eq1]
            linarith
          · have h_gt1 : 1 < u₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le h11 hle
            rw [max_eq_right (by linarith : 0 ≤ u₁), min_eq_left h11.le, min_eq_left h_gt1.le]
            linarith
      have h_icc := hS_icc_lip (cl u₁) (cl u₂) hcl₁.1 hcl_mono hcl₂.2
      rw [hS_cl u₁, hS_cl u₂] at h_icc
      exact ⟨h_icc.1, le_trans h_icc.2 hcl_diff⟩
    have h_time_ent : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
          finCondEntropy (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
            (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (S_path u)) := by
      intro u hu
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hu.1 with rfl | hu_pos
      · rw [hS_zero]
        refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr (fun n => ?_)
        exact ((h_s3 (ε_seq n) (hε_bds n).1 (hε_bds n).2
          (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (c_seq n)
          (h_law_seq n).1 (h_law_seq n).2.1 (h_law_seq n).2.2.2).1.1).symm
      · rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
        intro η hη
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hu_q, hq_ub⟩ :=
          h_dyad_approx u (η / 4) hu_pos.le hu.2 (by positivity)
        have hS_diff := hS_icc_lip u q hu_pos.le hu_q (h_dyad_ioc q hq).2
        rw [hS_eq_dyad q hq] at hS_diff
        obtain ⟨N_q, hN_q⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (h_dyad_conv q hq).1 (η / 4) (by positivity)
        obtain ⟨N_l, hN_l⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_log4_tendsto (η / 4) (by positivity)
        refine ⟨max N_q N_l, fun n hn => ?_⟩
        have hd_q := hN_q n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
        have hd_l := hN_l n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hd_q hd_l ⊢
        rw [sub_zero] at hd_l
        have h_abs_q := abs_lt.mp hd_q
        have h_abs_l := abs_lt.mp hd_l
        have h_inc := (h_s3 (ε_seq n) (hε_bds n).1 (hε_bds n).2
          (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (c_seq n)
          (h_law_seq n).1 (h_law_seq n).2.1 (h_law_seq n).2.2.2).2.1
          u q hu_pos.le hu_q
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith [h_inc.2.1, h_inc.2.2, hS_diff.1, hS_diff.2, hq_ub]
    have h_single_surp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
          ∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
            if δ < |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω')) ω - S_path u|
            then π_seq n ω else 0)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      intro u hu δ hδ
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hu.1 with rfl | hu_pos
      · refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr (fun n => ?_)
        symm
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases hω : 0 < π_seq n ω
        · have hs0 := (h_s3 (ε_seq n) (hε_bds n).1 (hε_bds n).2
            (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (c_seq n)
            (h_law_seq n).1 (h_law_seq n).2.1 (h_law_seq n).2.2.2).1.2 ω hω
          rw [hs0, hS_zero, sub_self, abs_zero, if_neg (not_lt.mpr hδ.le)]
        · have h0 : π_seq n ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hω) ((h_law_seq n).1 ω)
          simp [h0]
      · obtain ⟨q, hq, hu_q, hq_ub⟩ :=
          h_dyad_approx u (δ / 6) hu_pos.le hu.2 (by positivity)
        have hS_diff := hS_icc_lip u q hu_pos.le hu_q (h_dyad_ioc q hq).2
        rw [hS_eq_dyad q hq] at hS_diff
        let ν : ℝ := δ / 6
        have hν_pos : 0 < ν := by dsimp [ν]; positivity
        have h_rpow_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (ε_seq n) ^ ν) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have h1 := hε_tendsto.rpow_const (Or.inr hν_pos.le)
          rwa [Real.zero_rpow hν_pos.ne'] at h1
        have h_q_tail := (h_dyad_conv q hq).2 (δ / 3) (by positivity)
        have h_ub_lim : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun n =>
              (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
                if δ / 3 < |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                    (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω - S_dyad q|
                then π_seq n ω else 0) + (ε_seq n) ^ ν)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          simpa using h_q_tail.add h_rpow_lim
        obtain ⟨N_l, hN_l⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_log4_tendsto (δ / 6) (by positivity)
        refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_ub_lim
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by
            split_ifs <;> [exact (h_law_seq n).1 ω; exact le_rfl])))
          (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N_l, fun n hn => ?_⟩)
        have hd_l := hN_l n hn
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hd_l
        have h_log_le : Real.log 4 / Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹) ≤ δ / 6 :=
          le_trans (le_abs_self _) hd_l.le
        have h_inc_tail := (h_s3 (ε_seq n) (hε_bds n).1 (hε_bds n).2
          (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (c_seq n)
          (h_law_seq n).1 (h_law_seq n).2.1 (h_law_seq n).2.2.2).2.2
          u q ν hu_pos.le hu_q hν_pos
        have h_pt_split : ∀ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
            (if δ < |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                  (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω')) ω - S_path u|
             then π_seq n ω else 0) ≤
            (if δ / 3 < |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                  (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω - S_dyad q|
             then π_seq n ω else 0) +
            (if (q - u) + ν + Real.log 4 / Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹) <
                |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                  (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω -
                 condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                  (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω')) ω|
             then π_seq n ω else 0) := by
          intro ω
          by_cases hω : 0 < π_seq n ω
          · let Su := condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
              (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω')) ω
            let Sq := condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
              (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω
            have h1_nn : 0 ≤ (if δ / 3 < |Sq - S_dyad q| then π_seq n ω else 0) := by
              split_ifs <;> [exact hω.le; exact le_rfl]
            have h2_nn : 0 ≤ (if (q - u) + ν + Real.log 4 / Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹) < |Sq - Su|
                then π_seq n ω else 0) := by
              split_ifs <;> [exact hω.le; exact le_rfl]
            by_cases h_big : δ < |Su - S_path u|
            · rw [if_pos h_big]
              by_cases h_q_big : δ / 3 < |Sq - S_dyad q|
              · rw [if_pos h_q_big]
                linarith
              · rw [if_neg h_q_big]
                by_cases h_inc_big : (q - u) + ν + Real.log 4 / Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹) < |Sq - Su|
                · rw [if_pos h_inc_big]
                  linarith
                · exfalso
                  have h_le1 := not_lt.mp h_q_big
                  have h_le2 := not_lt.mp h_inc_big
                  have h_tri : |Su - S_path u| ≤
                      |Sq - Su| + |Sq - S_dyad q| + |S_dyad q - S_path u| := by
                    have h_eq : Su - S_path u =
                        -(Sq - Su) + (Sq - S_dyad q) + (S_dyad q - S_path u) := by ring
                    rw [h_eq]
                    calc |-(Sq - Su) + (Sq - S_dyad q) + (S_dyad q - S_path u)|
                        ≤ |-(Sq - Su) + (Sq - S_dyad q)| + |S_dyad q - S_path u| :=
                          abs_add_le _ _
                      _ ≤ |-(Sq - Su)| + |Sq - S_dyad q| + |S_dyad q - S_path u| :=
                          add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl
                      _ = |Sq - Su| + |Sq - S_dyad q| + |S_dyad q - S_path u| := by rw [abs_neg]
                  have h_S_abs : |S_dyad q - S_path u| ≤ δ / 6 := by
                    rw [abs_of_nonneg hS_diff.1]
                    linarith [hS_diff.2, hq_ub]
                  dsimp [ν] at h_le2
                  linarith
            · rw [if_neg h_big]
              linarith
          · have h0 : π_seq n ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hω) ((h_law_seq n).1 ω)
            simp [h0]
        have h_sum_le :
            (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
              if δ < |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                  (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω')) ω - S_path u|
              then π_seq n ω else 0) ≤
            (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
              if δ / 3 < |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                  (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω - S_dyad q|
              then π_seq n ω else 0) +
            (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
              if (q - u) + ν + Real.log 4 / Real.log ((ε_seq n)⁻¹) <
                  |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                    (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω -
                   condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                    (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) u (c_seq n ω')) ω|
              then π_seq n ω else 0) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_pt_split ω)
        linarith
    refine ⟨S_path, hS_zero, hS_lip, h_time_ent, ?_⟩
    intro r q hr0 hrq hq1 δ hδ
    have hr_mem : r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hr0, le_trans hrq hq1⟩
    have hq_mem : q ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_trans hr0 hrq, hq1⟩
    have h_ub_lim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
            if δ / 2 < |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω - S_path q|
            then π_seq n ω else 0) +
          (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
            if δ / 2 < |condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
                (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) r (c_seq n ω')) ω - S_path r|
            then π_seq n ω else 0))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (h_single_surp q hq_mem (δ / 2) (half_pos hδ)).add
        (h_single_surp r hr_mem (δ / 2) (half_pos hδ))
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds h_ub_lim
      (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by
        split_ifs <;> [exact (h_law_seq n).1 ω; exact le_rfl]))
      (fun n => ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hω : 0 < π_seq n ω
    · have h_tele := ((h_s3 (ε_seq n) (hε_bds n).1 (hε_bds n).2
        (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (c_seq n)
        (h_law_seq n).1 (h_law_seq n).2.1 (h_law_seq n).2.2.2).2.1
        r q hr0 hrq).1 ω hω
      let Sq := condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω
      let Sr := condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n)
        (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) r (c_seq n ω')) ω
      let S2 := condSurprise (ε_seq n) (π_seq n)
        (fun ω' => (T_seq n ω', dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) r (c_seq n ω')))
        (fun ω' => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq n) q (c_seq n ω')) ω
      have h1_nn : 0 ≤ (if δ / 2 < |Sq - S_path q| then π_seq n ω else 0) := by
        split_ifs <;> [exact hω.le; exact le_rfl]
      have h2_nn : 0 ≤ (if δ / 2 < |Sr - S_path r| then π_seq n ω else 0) := by
        split_ifs <;> [exact hω.le; exact le_rfl]
      change (if δ < |S2 - (S_path q - S_path r)| then π_seq n ω else 0) ≤
        (if δ / 2 < |Sq - S_path q| then π_seq n ω else 0) +
        (if δ / 2 < |Sr - S_path r| then π_seq n ω else 0)
      by_cases h_big : δ < |S2 - (S_path q - S_path r)|
      · rw [if_pos h_big]
        by_cases h_q_big : δ / 2 < |Sq - S_path q|
        · rw [if_pos h_q_big]
          linarith
        · rw [if_neg h_q_big]
          by_cases h_r_big : δ / 2 < |Sr - S_path r|
          · rw [if_pos h_r_big]
            linarith
          · exfalso
            have h_eq_s2 : S2 = Sq - Sr := h_tele
            rw [h_eq_s2] at h_big
            have h_le_q := not_lt.mp h_q_big
            have h_le_r := not_lt.mp h_r_big
            have h_tri : |(Sq - Sr) - (S_path q - S_path r)| ≤
                |Sq - S_path q| + |Sr - S_path r| := by
              have h_eq : (Sq - Sr) - (S_path q - S_path r) =
                  (Sq - S_path q) - (Sr - S_path r) := by ring
              rw [h_eq]
              exact abs_sub _ _
            linarith
      · rw [if_neg h_big]
        linarith
    · have h0 : π_seq n ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hω) ((h_law_seq n).1 ω)
      simp [h0]

informal_problem.statement:
(n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hc_inj : Function.Injective c)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v)
    (hE_pos : ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → 0 < c k - c j)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : IsSubmodularConeProfile n c d d_v E_cone f) :
    (∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ∧ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ≤ d j) ∧
    (Measurable (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ∧ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ≤ d_v) ∧
    ∃ (M_lip : ℝ) (K_ext : NNReal) (f_ext : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ),
      0 ≤ M_lip ∧
      (∀ p q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
        InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → InResolutionCone n c E_cone q →
        |f p - f q| ≤ M_lip * ((∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|) + |p.2 - q.2|)) ∧
      LipschitzWith K_ext f_ext ∧
      (∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → f_ext p = f p) ∧
      (∀ᵐ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p →
        (∀ j : Fin n,
          fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisL n j) = conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p) ∧
        fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisV n) = conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p)
