proof.tactics:
by
  
  let i₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let i₁ : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hi₀₁ : i₀ ≠ i₁ := by
    intro h
    have hv := congr_arg Fin.val h
    dsimp [i₀, i₁] at hv
    omega
  have hne_off : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).offDiag.Nonempty :=
    ⟨(i₀, i₁), by simp [Finset.mem_offDiag, hi₀₁]⟩
  let g_min : ℝ :=
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).offDiag.inf' hne_off (fun jk => |c jk.2 - c jk.1|)
  let c_gap : ℝ := min 1 g_min
  have hg_min_pos : 0 < g_min := by
    rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
    intro jk hjk
    have hne : jk.1 ≠ jk.2 := by
      simp [Finset.mem_offDiag] at hjk
      exact hjk
    have hc_ne : c jk.2 ≠ c jk.1 := fun h => hne (hc_inj h.symm)
    exact abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hc_ne)
  have hc_gap_pos : 0 < c_gap := lt_min zero_lt_one hg_min_pos
  have hc_gap_ne : c_gap ≠ 0 := hc_gap_pos.ne'
  have hc_gap_edge : ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → c_gap ≤ c k - c j := by
    intro j k hE
    have hpos : 0 < c k - c j := hE_pos j k hE
    have hjk : j ≠ k := by
      intro h
      subst h
      linarith
    have hmem : (j, k) ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).offDiag := by
      simp [Finset.mem_offDiag, hjk]
    have h_inf : g_min ≤ |c k - c j| :=
      Finset.inf'_le (fun jk => |c jk.2 - c jk.1|) hmem
    rw [abs_of_pos hpos] at h_inf
    exact le_trans (min_le_right 1 g_min) h_inf
  let S_d : ℝ := ∑ j : Fin n, d j
  have hS_d_nn : 0 ≤ S_d := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hd_nn.1 j)
  let M_lip : ℝ := S_d + d_v * (1 + 2 / c_gap)
  have hM_lip_nn : 0 ≤ M_lip := by
    dsimp [M_lip]
    have h_pos : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 / c_gap := by positivity
    exact add_nonneg hS_d_nn (mul_nonneg hd_nn.2 h_pos)

  
  have h_orthant : ∀ (A B : Fin n → ℝ) (w : ℝ),
      (∀ j : Fin n, A j ≤ B j) →
      (∀ L : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ j : Fin n, A j ≤ L j ∧ L j ≤ B j) →
        InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L, w)) →
      0 ≤ f (B, w) - f (A, w) ∧ f (B, w) - f (A, w) ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, d j * (B j - A j) := by
    intro A B w hAB h_box
    let L_step : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ := fun m k => if k.1 < m then B k else A k
    have hL0 : L_step 0 = A := by
      ext k
      simp [L_step]
    have hLn : L_step n = B := by
      ext k
      simp [L_step, k.2]
    have hL_cone : ∀ m : ℕ, InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L_step m, w) := by
      intro m
      refine h_box (L_step m) (fun j => ?_)
      dsimp [L_step]
      split_ifs
      · exact ⟨hAB j, le_rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨le_rfl, hAB j⟩
    have hL_upd : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < n),
        Function.update (L_step m) ⟨m, hm⟩
          (L_step m ⟨m, hm⟩ + (B ⟨m, hm⟩ - A ⟨m, hm⟩)) = L_step (m + 1) := by
      intro m hm
      ext k
      by_cases hk : k = ⟨m, hm⟩
      · subst hk
        simp [L_step]
      · have hval : k.1 ≠ m := fun hv => hk (Fin.ext hv)
        have hiff : (k.1 < m) ↔ (k.1 < m + 1) := by omega
        simp [Function.update, hk, L_step, hiff]
    have h_ind : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ n →
        0 ≤ f (L_step m, w) - f (L_step 0, w) ∧
        f (L_step m, w) - f (L_step 0, w) ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
            (if hi : i < n then d ⟨i, hi⟩ * (B ⟨i, hi⟩ - A ⟨i, hi⟩) else 0) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro _
        simp
      | succ m ih =>
        intro hm1
        have hm : m < n := hm1
        have hm_le : m ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt hm
        obtain ⟨h_ih1, h_ih2⟩ := ih hm_le
        let j_m : Fin n := ⟨m, hm⟩
        have hh_nn : 0 ≤ B j_m - A j_m := sub_nonneg.mpr (hAB j_m)
        have h_step := hf.1 (L_step m) w (B j_m - A j_m) j_m hh_nn
          (hL_cone m) (by rw [hL_upd m hm]; exact hL_cone (m + 1))
        rw [hL_upd m hm] at h_step
        have h_dite : (if hi : m < n then d ⟨m, hi⟩ * (B ⟨m, hi⟩ - A ⟨m, hi⟩) else 0) =
            d j_m * (B j_m - A j_m) := by simp [hm, j_m]
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, h_dite]
        exact ⟨by linarith [h_step.1], by linarith [h_step.2]⟩
    have h_end := h_ind n (le_refl n)
    have h_sum_eq : (∑ j : Fin n, d j * (B j - A j)) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          (if hi : i < n then d ⟨i, hi⟩ * (B ⟨i, hi⟩ - A ⟨i, hi⟩) else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range (fun j => d j * (B j - A j))
    rw [hL0, hLn, ← h_sum_eq] at h_end
    exact h_end

  
  have h_lift_one : ∀ (u : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (L_sup : Fin n → ℝ) (v_top δ : ℝ),
      InResolutionCone n c E_cone u →
      0 ≤ δ →
      u.2 ≤ v_top →
      v_top < 1 →
      δ / c_gap ≤ v_top - u.2 →
      (∀ r : Fin n, u.1 r ≤ L_sup r ∧ L_sup r - u.1 r ≤ δ) →
      0 ≤ f (L_sup, v_top) - f u ∧
      f (L_sup, v_top) - f u ≤ d_v * (v_top - u.2) + ∑ j : Fin n, d j * (L_sup j - u.1 j) := by
    intro u L_sup v_top δ hu hδ hv_le hv_lt1 hv_gap hL_bds
    have hv_top_mem : v_top ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hu.1.1 hv_le, hv_lt1⟩
    have h_box_cone : ∀ L : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ r : Fin n, u.1 r ≤ L r ∧ L r ≤ L_sup r) →
        InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L, v_top) := by
      intro L hL
      refine ⟨hv_top_mem, fun j k hE => ?_⟩
      have h_edge_u : u.1 k - u.1 j ≤ (c k - c j) * u.2 := hu.2 j k hE
      have h_c_ge : c_gap ≤ c k - c j := hc_gap_edge j k hE
      have h_δ_le : δ ≤ (c k - c j) * (v_top - u.2) := by
        calc δ = c_gap * (δ / c_gap) := (mul_div_cancel₀ δ hc_gap_ne).symm
          _ ≤ c_gap * (v_top - u.2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv_gap hc_gap_pos.le
          _ ≤ (c k - c j) * (v_top - u.2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_c_ge (sub_nonneg.mpr hv_le)
      have hLk : L k ≤ u.1 k + δ := by linarith [(hL k).2, (hL_bds k).2]
      have hLj : u.1 j ≤ L j := (hL j).1
      linarith
    have hu_vtop_cone : InResolutionCone n c E_cone (u.1, v_top) :=
      h_box_cone u.1 (fun r => ⟨le_rfl, (hL_bds r).1⟩)
    have hv_add : u.2 + (v_top - u.2) = v_top := add_sub_cancel u.2 v_top
    have h_v_step := hf.2.1 u.1 u.2 (v_top - u.2) (sub_nonneg.mpr hv_le) hu
      (by rw [hv_add]; exact hu_vtop_cone)
    rw [hv_add] at h_v_step
    have h_L_step := h_orthant u.1 L_sup v_top (fun r => (hL_bds r).1) h_box_cone
    exact ⟨by linarith [h_v_step.1, h_L_step.1], by linarith [h_v_step.2, h_L_step.2]⟩

  have h_max_sub_add : ∀ a b : ℝ, (max a b - a) + (max a b - b) = |a - b| := by
    intro a b
    rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
    · rw [max_eq_right hab, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hab)]
      ring
    · rw [max_eq_left hba, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hba)]
      ring

  have h_step_pair : ∀ (x y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (δ : ℝ),
      InResolutionCone n c E_cone x →
      InResolutionCone n c E_cone y →
      0 ≤ δ →
      (∀ r : Fin n, |x.1 r - y.1 r| ≤ δ) →
      max x.2 y.2 + δ / c_gap < 1 →
      |f x - f y| ≤
        d_v * (|x.2 - y.2| + 2 * (δ / c_gap)) + S_d * (∑ j : Fin n, |x.1 j - y.1 j|) := by
    intro x y δ hx hy hδ hxy_δ hv_lt1
    let L_sup : Fin n → ℝ := fun r => max (x.1 r) (y.1 r)
    let v_top : ℝ := max x.2 y.2 + δ / c_gap
    have hδ_div_nn : 0 ≤ δ / c_gap := div_nonneg hδ hc_gap_pos.le
    have hx_lift := h_lift_one x L_sup v_top δ hx hδ
      (by dsimp [v_top]; linarith [le_max_left x.2 y.2]) hv_lt1
      (by dsimp [v_top]; linarith [le_max_left x.2 y.2])
      (fun r => ⟨le_max_left _ _, by
        dsimp [L_sup]
        have hb := abs_le.mp (hxy_δ r)
        rcases le_total (x.1 r) (y.1 r) with hle | hge
        · rw [max_eq_right hle]
          linarith [hb.1]
        · rw [max_eq_left hge]
          linarith⟩)
    have hy_lift := h_lift_one y L_sup v_top δ hy hδ
      (by dsimp [v_top]; linarith [le_max_right x.2 y.2]) hv_lt1
      (by dsimp [v_top]; linarith [le_max_right x.2 y.2])
      (fun r => ⟨le_max_right _ _, by
        dsimp [L_sup]
        have hb := abs_le.mp (hxy_δ r)
        rcases le_total (x.1 r) (y.1 r) with hle | hge
        · rw [max_eq_right hle]
          linarith
        · rw [max_eq_left hge]
          linarith [hb.2]⟩)
    have h_abs_f : |f x - f y| ≤ (f (L_sup, v_top) - f x) + (f (L_sup, v_top) - f y) :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hx_lift.1, hy_lift.1], by linarith [hx_lift.1, hy_lift.1]⟩
    have hv_sum : (v_top - x.2) + (v_top - y.2) = |x.2 - y.2| + 2 * (δ / c_gap) := by
      have hm := h_max_sub_add x.2 y.2
      dsimp [v_top]
      linarith
    have hL_sum :
        (∑ j : Fin n, d j * (L_sup j - x.1 j)) + (∑ j : Fin n, d j * (L_sup j - y.1 j)) ≤
          S_d * (∑ j : Fin n, |x.1 j - y.1 j|) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
      have hj_eq : d j * (L_sup j - x.1 j) + d j * (L_sup j - y.1 j) = d j * |x.1 j - y.1 j| := by
        rw [← mul_add, h_max_sub_add (x.1 j) (y.1 j)]
      rw [hj_eq]
      have hd_le : d j ≤ S_d :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => hd_nn.1 k) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd_le (abs_nonneg _)
    calc |f x - f y|
        ≤ (f (L_sup, v_top) - f x) + (f (L_sup, v_top) - f y) := h_abs_f
      _ ≤ (d_v * (v_top - x.2) + ∑ j : Fin n, d j * (L_sup j - x.1 j)) +
            (d_v * (v_top - y.2) + ∑ j : Fin n, d j * (L_sup j - y.1 j)) :=
          add_le_add hx_lift.2 hy_lift.2
      _ = d_v * ((v_top - x.2) + (v_top - y.2)) +
            ((∑ j : Fin n, d j * (L_sup j - x.1 j)) + (∑ j : Fin n, d j * (L_sup j - y.1 j))) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ d_v * (|x.2 - y.2| + 2 * (δ / c_gap)) + S_d * (∑ j : Fin n, |x.1 j - y.1 j|) := by
          rw [hv_sum]
          linarith [hL_sum]

  
  have h_cone_lip : ∀ p q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
      InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → InResolutionCone n c E_cone q →
      |f p - f q| ≤ M_lip * ((∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|) + |p.2 - q.2|) := by
    intro p q hp hq
    let v_max : ℝ := max p.2 q.2
    have hv_max_lt1 : v_max < 1 := max_lt hp.1.2 hq.1.2
    have h1mv_pos : 0 < 1 - v_max := sub_pos.mpr hv_max_lt1
    let D_L : ℝ := ∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|
    have hD_L_nn : 0 ≤ D_L := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have h_denom_pos : 0 < c_gap * (1 - v_max) := mul_pos hc_gap_pos h1mv_pos
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (D_L / (c_gap * (1 - v_max)))
    let N : ℕ := N₀ + 1
    have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hN_ne : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hN_pos.ne'
    have hN_gt : D_L / (c_gap * (1 - v_max)) < (N : ℝ) := by
      refine lt_trans hN₀ ?_
      dsimp [N]
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_lift_lt : (D_L / (N : ℝ)) / c_gap < 1 - v_max := by
      have h_mul : D_L < (N : ℝ) * (c_gap * (1 - v_max)) :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ h_denom_pos).mp hN_gt
      rw [div_div, div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos hN_pos hc_gap_pos)]
      linarith
    let γ : ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ :=
      fun t => (fun j => (1 - t) * p.1 j + t * q.1 j, (1 - t) * p.2 + t * q.2)
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = p := Prod.ext (funext fun j => by simp [γ]) (by simp [γ])
    have hγ1 : γ 1 = q := Prod.ext (funext fun j => by simp [γ]) (by simp [γ])
    have hγ_cone : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        InResolutionCone n c E_cone (γ t) ∧ (γ t).2 ≤ v_max := by
      intro t ht
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
      have ht1 : 0 ≤ 1 - t := sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2
      have hv_lo : 0 < (γ t).2 := by
        have h_min_pos : 0 < min p.2 q.2 := lt_min hp.1.1 hq.1.1
        have h_ge_min : min p.2 q.2 ≤ (γ t).2 := by
          dsimp [γ]
          have h1 : (1 - t) * min p.2 q.2 ≤ (1 - t) * p.2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left _ _) ht1
          have h2 : t * min p.2 q.2 ≤ t * q.2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right _ _) ht0
          linarith
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_min_pos h_ge_min
      have hv_hi : (γ t).2 ≤ v_max := by
        dsimp [γ]
        have h1 : (1 - t) * p.2 ≤ (1 - t) * v_max :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) ht1
        have h2 : t * q.2 ≤ t * v_max :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) ht0
        linarith
      refine ⟨⟨⟨hv_lo, lt_of_le_of_lt hv_hi hv_max_lt1⟩, fun j k hE => ?_⟩, hv_hi⟩
      dsimp [γ]
      have hp_e := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hp.2 j k hE) ht1
      have hq_e := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hq.2 j k hE) ht0
      linarith
    let δ_step : ℝ := D_L / (N : ℝ)
    have hδ_step_nn : 0 ≤ δ_step := div_nonneg hD_L_nn hN_pos.le
    have h_sub_bound : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range N,
        |f (γ (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (N : ℝ))) - f (γ ((m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)))| ≤
          (M_lip * (D_L + |p.2 - q.2|)) / (N : ℝ) := by
      intro m hm
      have hm_lt : m < N := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
      let t₀ : ℝ := (m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)
      let t₁ : ℝ := ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)
      have ht₀_mem : t₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        refine ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) hN_pos.le, (div_le_iff₀ hN_pos).mpr ?_⟩
        rw [one_mul]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt hm_lt
      have ht₁_mem : t₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        refine ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hN_pos.le, (div_le_iff₀ hN_pos).mpr ?_⟩
        rw [one_mul]
        exact_mod_cast hm_lt
      have hL_diff : ∀ r : Fin n, |(γ t₁).1 r - (γ t₀).1 r| = |p.1 r - q.1 r| / (N : ℝ) := by
        intro r
        have h_alg : (γ t₁).1 r - (γ t₀).1 r = -(p.1 r - q.1 r) / (N : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [γ, t₀, t₁]
          push_cast
          field_simp [hN_ne]
          ring
        rw [h_alg, neg_div, abs_neg, abs_div, abs_of_pos hN_pos]
      have hv_diff : |(γ t₁).2 - (γ t₀).2| = |p.2 - q.2| / (N : ℝ) := by
        have h_alg : (γ t₁).2 - (γ t₀).2 = -(p.2 - q.2) / (N : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [γ, t₀, t₁]
          push_cast
          field_simp [hN_ne]
          ring
        rw [h_alg, neg_div, abs_neg, abs_div, abs_of_pos hN_pos]
      have hL_le_δ : ∀ r : Fin n, |(γ t₁).1 r - (γ t₀).1 r| ≤ δ_step := by
        intro r
        rw [hL_diff r]
        refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hN_pos.le
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j : Fin n => |p.1 j - q.1 j|)
          (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ r)
      have hv_top_lt : max (γ t₁).2 (γ t₀).2 + δ_step / c_gap < 1 := by
        have h_max_le : max (γ t₁).2 (γ t₀).2 ≤ v_max :=
          max_le (hγ_cone t₁ ht₁_mem).2 (hγ_cone t₀ ht₀_mem).2
        linarith [h_lift_lt]
      have h_pair := h_step_pair (γ t₁) (γ t₀) δ_step
        (hγ_cone t₁ ht₁_mem).1 (hγ_cone t₀ ht₀_mem).1 hδ_step_nn hL_le_δ hv_top_lt
      have h_sum_div : (∑ j : Fin n, |(γ t₁).1 j - (γ t₀).1 j|) = D_L / (N : ℝ) := by
        simp_rw [hL_diff, div_eq_mul_inv]
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [hv_diff, h_sum_div] at h_pair
      refine le_trans h_pair ?_
      have h_rhs_eq : d_v * (|p.2 - q.2| / (N : ℝ) + 2 * (δ_step / c_gap)) +
            S_d * (D_L / (N : ℝ)) =
          ((S_d + d_v * (2 / c_gap)) * D_L + d_v * |p.2 - q.2|) / (N : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [δ_step]
        field_simp [hN_ne, hc_gap_ne]
        ring
      rw [h_rhs_eq]
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hN_pos.le
      have h1 : S_d + d_v * (2 / c_gap) ≤ M_lip := by
        dsimp [M_lip]
        linarith [hd_nn.2]
      have h2 : d_v ≤ M_lip := by
        dsimp [M_lip]
        have h_extra : 0 ≤ d_v * (2 / c_gap) := mul_nonneg hd_nn.2 (by positivity)
        linarith [hS_d_nn, h_extra]
      have h_m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hD_L_nn
      have h_m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (abs_nonneg (p.2 - q.2))
      linarith
    let g_tel : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => f (γ ((m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)))
    have hg0 : g_tel 0 = f p := by simp [g_tel, hγ0]
    have hgN : g_tel N = f q := by simp [g_tel, hγ1]
    have h_tel : f q - f p = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (g_tel (m + 1) - g_tel m) := by
      rw [← hgN, ← hg0, ← Finset.sum_range_sub g_tel N]
    calc |f p - f q|
        = |f q - f p| := abs_sub_comm (f p) (f q)
      _ = |∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (g_tel (m + 1) - g_tel m)| := by rw [h_tel]
      _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, |g_tel (m + 1) - g_tel m| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _m ∈ Finset.range N, (M_lip * (D_L + |p.2 - q.2|)) / (N : ℝ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_sub_bound
      _ = (N : ℝ) * ((M_lip * (D_L + |p.2 - q.2|)) / (N : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = M_lip * (D_L + |p.2 - q.2|) := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hN_ne

  
  let K_real : ℝ := M_lip * ((n : ℝ) + 1)
  have hK_real_nn : 0 ≤ K_real := by
    dsimp [K_real]
    positivity
  let K_ext : NNReal := Real.toNNReal K_real
  have hK_ext_coe : (K_ext : ℝ) = K_real := Real.coe_toNNReal K_real hK_real_nn
  have hf_lip_on : LipschitzOnWith K_ext f { p | InResolutionCone n c E_cone p } := by
    refine LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun p hp q hq => ?_)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hK_ext_coe]
    have h_l1 := h_cone_lip p q hp hq
    have h_coord : ∀ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j| ≤ dist p q := by
      intro j
      calc |p.1 j - q.1 j| = dist (p.1 j) (q.1 j) := (Real.dist_eq _ _).symm
        _ ≤ dist p.1 q.1 := dist_le_pi_dist p.1 q.1 j
        _ ≤ max (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2) := le_max_left _ _
        _ = dist p q := Prod.dist_eq.symm
    have h_time : |p.2 - q.2| ≤ dist p q := by
      calc |p.2 - q.2| = dist p.2 q.2 := (Real.dist_eq _ _).symm
        _ ≤ max (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2) := le_max_right _ _
        _ = dist p q := Prod.dist_eq.symm
    have h_sum_le : (∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|) + |p.2 - q.2| ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * dist p q := by
      have hs : ∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j| ≤ (n : ℝ) * dist p q := by
        calc ∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|
            ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, dist p q := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => h_coord j)
          _ = (n : ℝ) * dist p q := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      linarith
    calc |f p - f q|
        ≤ M_lip * ((∑ j : Fin n, |p.1 j - q.1 j|) + |p.2 - q.2|) := h_l1
      _ ≤ M_lip * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * dist p q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_le hM_lip_nn
      _ = K_real * dist p q := by dsimp [K_real]; ring
  obtain ⟨f_ext, hf_lip, hf_eq_on⟩ := hf_lip_on.extend_real
  have hf_eq : ∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → f_ext p = f p :=
    fun p hp => (hf_eq_on hp).symm

  
  let S_strict : Set ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) := { p | InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p }
  have hS_sub : ∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p →
      InResolutionCone n c E_cone p :=
    fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, fun j k hE => (hp.2 j k hE).le⟩
  have hS_open : IsOpen S_strict := by
    have h_eq : S_strict = (Prod.snd ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) ∩
        ⋂ j : Fin n, ⋂ k : Fin n,
          { p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ | E_cone j k → p.1 k - p.1 j < (c k - c j) * p.2 } := by
      ext p
      simp [S_strict, InStrictResolutionCone, IsStrictDispCone]
    rw [h_eq]
    refine (isOpen_Ioo.preimage continuous_snd).inter ?_
    refine isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun j => isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun k => ?_))
    by_cases hjk : E_cone j k
    · have h_sub : { p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ | E_cone j k → p.1 k - p.1 j < (c k - c j) * p.2 } =
          { p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ | p.1 k - p.1 j < (c k - c j) * p.2 } := by
        ext p
        simp [hjk]
      rw [h_sub]
      exact isOpen_lt
        (((continuous_apply k).comp continuous_fst).sub ((continuous_apply j).comp continuous_fst))
        (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)
    · have h_univ : { p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ | E_cone j k → p.1 k - p.1 j < (c k - c j) * p.2 } =
          Set.univ := by
        ext p
        simp [hjk]
      rw [h_univ]
      exact isOpen_univ
  let f₀ : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ := strictConeRestrict n c E_cone f
  have hf₀_ind : f₀ = S_strict.indicator f_ext := by
    ext p
    by_cases hp : InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p
    · have hp_mem : p ∈ S_strict := hp
      simp [f₀, strictConeRestrict, hp, Set.indicator_of_mem hp_mem, hf_eq p (hS_sub p hp)]
    · have hp_nmem : p ∉ S_strict := hp
      simp [f₀, strictConeRestrict, hp, Set.indicator_of_notMem hp_nmem]
  have hf₀_meas : Measurable f₀ := by
    rw [hf₀_ind]
    exact hf_lip.continuous.measurable.indicator hS_open.measurableSet
  have h_shiftL : ∀ (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (j : Fin n) (τ : ℝ),
      (Function.update p.1 j (p.1 j + τ), p.2) = p + τ • coneBasisL n j := by
    intro p j τ
    refine Prod.ext (funext fun k => ?_) (by simp [coneBasisL])
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst hkj
      simp [coneBasisL, Function.update]
    · simp [coneBasisL, Function.update, hkj]
  have h_shiftV : ∀ (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (τ : ℝ),
      (p.1, p.2 + τ) = p + τ • coneBasisV n := by
    intro p τ
    exact Prod.ext (funext fun k => by simp [coneBasisV]) (by simp [coneBasisV])
  have h_clamped_meas_bds : ∀ (e : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (D_α : ℝ), 0 ≤ D_α →
      Measurable (fun p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
          max 0 (min D_α (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e) - f₀ p))))
          Filter.atTop) ∧
      ∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
        0 ≤ Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
          max 0 (min D_α (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e) - f₀ p))))
          Filter.atTop ∧
        Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
          max 0 (min D_α (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e) - f₀ p))))
          Filter.atTop ≤ D_α := by
    intro e D_α hD_nn
    refine ⟨?_, fun p => ?_⟩
    · refine Measurable.limsup (fun m => ?_)
      have hm_shift : Measurable (fun p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ => f₀ (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e)) :=
        hf₀_meas.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const).measurable
      exact measurable_const.max (measurable_const.min (measurable_const.mul (hm_shift.sub hf₀_meas)))
    · let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
        max 0 (min D_α (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e) - f₀ p)))
      have hu0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ u m := fun m => le_max_left 0 _
      have huD : ∀ m, u m ≤ D_α := fun m => max_le hD_nn (min_le_left _ _)
      have hbdd : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop u :=
        ⟨D_α, Filter.eventually_map.mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall huD)⟩
      have hcobdd : Filter.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop u :=
        Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_eventually_le Filter.atTop (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu0)
      exact ⟨Filter.le_limsup_of_frequently_le (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu0).frequently hbdd,
        Filter.limsup_le_of_le hcobdd (Filter.Eventually.of_forall huD)⟩
  have h_partL_eq : ∀ j : Fin n, conePartialL n c d E_cone f j =
      (fun p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
          max 0 (min (d j) (((m + 1 : ℝ)) *
            (f₀ (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • coneBasisL n j) - f₀ p))))
          Filter.atTop) := by
    intro j
    ext p
    dsimp [conePartialL, f₀]
    simp_rw [h_shiftL]
  have h_partV_eq : conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f =
      (fun p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
          max 0 (min d_v (((m + 1 : ℝ)) *
            (f₀ (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • coneBasisV n) - f₀ p))))
          Filter.atTop) := by
    ext p
    dsimp [conePartialV, f₀]
    simp_rw [h_shiftV]
  have h_partL : ∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ∧ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ≤ d j := by
    intro j
    rw [h_partL_eq j]
    exact h_clamped_meas_bds (coneBasisL n j) (d j) (hd_nn.1 j)
  have h_partV : Measurable (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ∧ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ≤ d_v := by
    rw [h_partV_eq]
    exact h_clamped_meas_bds (coneBasisV n) d_v hd_nn.2

  
  have h_clamped_fderiv : ∀ (p e : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (D_α : ℝ),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f_ext p →
      InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p →
      (∀ m : ℕ, InResolutionCone n c E_cone (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e) →
        0 ≤ f (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e) - f p ∧
        f (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e) - f p ≤ D_α * ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹) →
      fderiv ℝ f_ext p e = Filter.limsup (fun m : ℕ =>
        max 0 (min D_α (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ (p + ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ • e) - f₀ p))))
        Filter.atTop := by
    intro p e D_α hd hp h_mono
    let τ : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    have hτ_pos : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < τ m := fun m => inv_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have hτ_lim : Filter.Tendsto τ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [τ, one_div] using tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)
    have hτ_within : Filter.Tendsto τ Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hτ_lim, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hτ_pos⟩
    have hq_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => p + τ m • e) Filter.atTop (nhds p) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := p)).add (hτ_lim.smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := e)))
    have hm_strict : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone (p + τ m • e) :=
      hq_lim.eventually (hS_open.mem_nhds hp)
    have h_slope_raw := ((hd.hasFDerivAt.hasLineDerivAt e).tendsto_slope_zero_right).comp hτ_within
    have h_slope : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m : ℕ => ((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f_ext (p + τ m • e) - f_ext p))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (fderiv ℝ f_ext p e)) := by
      refine h_slope_raw.congr (fun m => ?_)
      dsimp [Function.comp, τ]
      rw [inv_inv]
    have h_ev_eq : (fun m : ℕ => ((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f_ext (p + τ m • e) - f_ext p)) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
        (fun m : ℕ => max 0 (min D_α (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ (p + τ m • e) - f₀ p)))) := by
      filter_upwards [hm_strict] with m hm
      let q_m : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ := p + τ m • e
      have hf0_q : f₀ q_m = f q_m := by simp [f₀, strictConeRestrict, q_m, hm]
      have hf0_p : f₀ p = f p := by simp [f₀, strictConeRestrict, hp]
      have hfext_q : f_ext q_m = f q_m := hf_eq q_m (hS_sub q_m hm)
      have hfext_p : f_ext p = f p := hf_eq p (hS_sub p hp)
      obtain ⟨hm_lo, hm_hi⟩ := h_mono m (hS_sub q_m hm)
      have hm1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hq_lo : 0 ≤ ((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f q_m - f p) := mul_nonneg hm1_pos.le hm_lo
      have hq_hi : ((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f q_m - f p) ≤ D_α := by
        calc ((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f q_m - f p)
            ≤ ((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (D_α * τ m) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_hi hm1_pos.le
          _ = D_α := by
              dsimp [τ]
              field_simp [hm1_pos.ne']
      change ((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f_ext q_m - f_ext p) =
        max 0 (min D_α (((m + 1 : ℝ)) * (f₀ q_m - f₀ p)))
      rw [hf0_q, hf0_p, hfext_q, hfext_p, min_eq_right hq_hi, max_eq_right hq_lo]
    exact ((h_slope.congr' h_ev_eq).limsup_eq).symm

  have h_ae_fderiv : ∀ᵐ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p →
      (∀ j : Fin n,
        fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisL n j) = conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p) ∧
      fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisV n) = conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p := by
    have : (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
      MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume
    filter_upwards [hf_lip.ae_differentiableAt_of_real] with p hd hp
    refine ⟨fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_partL_eq j]
      refine h_clamped_fderiv p (coneBasisL n j) (d j) hd hp (fun m hq_in => ?_)
      rw [← h_shiftL p j ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹] at hq_in ⊢
      exact hf.1 p.1 p.2 ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ j (by positivity) (hS_sub p hp) hq_in
    · rw [h_partV_eq]
      refine h_clamped_fderiv p (coneBasisV n) d_v hd hp (fun m hq_in => ?_)
      rw [← h_shiftV p ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹] at hq_in ⊢
      exact hf.2.1 p.1 p.2 ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ (by positivity) (hS_sub p hp) hq_in

  exact ⟨h_partL, h_partV, M_lip, K_ext, f_ext, hM_lip_nn, h_cone_lip, hf_lip, hf_eq, h_ae_fderiv⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(n : ℕ) (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : IsSubmodularConeProfile n c d d_v E_cone f)
    (h_meas_L : ∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ∧ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ≤ d j)
    (h_meas_V : Measurable (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ∧ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ≤ d_v)
    (K_ext : NNReal) (f_ext : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf_lip : LipschitzWith K_ext f_ext)
    (hf_eq : ∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → f_ext p = f p)
    (hf_ae : ∀ᵐ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p →
      (∀ j : Fin n,
        fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisL n j) = conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p) ∧
      fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisV n) = conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p) :
    ∃ F_seq : ℕ → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ,
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 2 (F_seq k)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        |F_seq k p - f_ext p| ≤ (K_ext : ℝ) * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        (∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ 2 * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
        HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v (F_seq k) p) ∧
      (∀ (K_c : Set ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)) (r_margin : ℝ),
        MeasurableSet K_c → MeasureTheory.volume K_c < ⊤ → 0 < r_margin →
        (∀ p ∈ K_c, ∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ r_margin →
          InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
        (∀ j : Fin n,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
            ∫ p in K_c, |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisL n j) -
              conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p|)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
          ∫ p in K_c, |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisV n) -
            conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p|)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

signature.name: submodular_mollifier_approximants
signature.statement:
(n : ℕ) (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v)
    (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : IsSubmodularConeProfile n c d d_v E_cone f)
    (h_meas_L : ∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ∧ conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p ≤ d j)
    (h_meas_V : Measurable (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) ∧
      ∀ p, 0 ≤ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ∧ conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p ≤ d_v)
    (K_ext : NNReal) (f_ext : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf_lip : LipschitzWith K_ext f_ext)
    (hf_eq : ∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InResolutionCone n c E_cone p → f_ext p = f p)
    (hf_ae : ∀ᵐ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone p →
      (∀ j : Fin n,
        fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisL n j) = conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p) ∧
      fderiv ℝ f_ext p (coneBasisV n) = conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p) :
    ∃ F_seq : ℕ → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ,
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 2 (F_seq k)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        |F_seq k p - f_ext p| ≤ (K_ext : ℝ) * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        (∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ 2 * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
        HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v (F_seq k) p) ∧
      (∀ (K_c : Set ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)) (r_margin : ℝ),
        MeasurableSet K_c → MeasureTheory.volume K_c < ⊤ → 0 < r_margin →
        (∀ p ∈ K_c, ∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ r_margin →
          InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
        (∀ j : Fin n,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
            ∫ p in K_c, |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisL n j) -
              conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p|)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
          ∫ p in K_c, |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisV n) -
            conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p|)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

proof.tactics:
by
  have : (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume
  let rad : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹
  have hrad_pos : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < rad k := fun k => inv_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  let bump : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffBump (0 : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) := fun k =>
    ⟨rad k / 2, rad k, half_pos (hrad_pos k), half_lt_self (hrad_pos k)⟩
  let mollify : (((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) → ℕ → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ := fun g k =>
    MeasureTheory.convolution ((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume) g
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume
  let F_seq : ℕ → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ := fun k => mollify f_ext k

  have hf_cont : Continuous f_ext := hf_lip.continuous
  have hf_loc : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable f_ext MeasureTheory.volume :=
    hf_cont.locallyIntegrable
  have hφ_cs : ∀ k : ℕ, HasCompactSupport ((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume) :=
    fun k => (bump k).hasCompactSupport_normed
  have hφ_c2 : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (↑(2 : ℕ∞)) ((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume) :=
    fun k => (bump k).contDiff_normed (n := (2 : ℕ∞))
  have hφ_cont : ∀ k : ℕ, Continuous ((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume) :=
    fun k => (hφ_c2 k).continuous
  have hφ_int : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasureTheory.Integrable ((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume)
      MeasureTheory.volume :=
    fun k => (hφ_cont k).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hφ_cs k)
  have hφ_nn : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ), 0 ≤ (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y :=
    fun k y => (bump k).nonneg_normed y
  have hφ_int_one : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y) = 1 :=
    fun k => (bump k).integral_normed
  have hφ_supp : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ < rad k := by
    intro k y hy
    have hmem : y ∈ Function.support ((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume) := hy
    rw [(bump k).support_normed_eq, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hmem
    exact hmem

  have hF_c2 : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 2 (F_seq k) := by
    intro k
    simpa using HasCompactSupport.contDiff_convolution_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
      (hφ_cs k) (hφ_c2 k) hf_loc

  have hF_unif : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      |F_seq k p - f_ext p| ≤ (K_ext : ℝ) * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
    intro k p
    rw [← Real.dist_eq]
    refine (bump k).dist_normed_convolution_le hf_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx
    exact (hf_lip.dist_le_mul x p).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.le (NNReal.coe_nonneg K_ext))

  have he_L_norm : ∀ j : Fin n, ‖coneBasisL n j‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [coneBasisL, Prod.norm_mk]
    refine max_le ?_ (by simp)
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg zero_le_one).mpr (fun i => ?_)
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp
    · simp [Function.update_of_ne hij]
  have he_V_norm : ‖coneBasisV n‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [coneBasisV, Prod.norm_mk]
    simp
  have h_shift_L : ∀ (z : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (j : Fin n) (h : ℝ),
      z + h • coneBasisL n j = (Function.update z.1 j (z.1 j + h), z.2) := by
    intro z j h
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (by simp [coneBasisL])
    ext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp [coneBasisL]
    · simp [coneBasisL, Function.update_of_ne hij]
  have h_shift_V : ∀ (z : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (h : ℝ),
      z + h • coneBasisV n = (z.1, z.2 + h) := by
    intro z h
    ext <;> simp [coneBasisV]

  have h_conv_int : ∀ (k : ℕ) (q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun y => (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext (q - y))
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro k q
    simpa using (HasCompactSupport.convolutionExists_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
      (hφ_cs k) (hφ_cont k) hf_loc q).integrable
  have hF_eq : ∀ (k : ℕ) (q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      F_seq k q =
        ∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext (q - y) := by
    intro k q
    simpa using MeasureTheory.convolution_def (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
      (f := (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume) (g := f_ext) (x := q)
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)

  have h_slope1 : ∀ (k : ℕ) (q e : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (F_seq k (q + t • e) - F_seq k q))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) q e)) := by
    intro k q e
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F_seq k) q :=
      (hF_c2 k).differentiable (by norm_num) q
    have hd0 : HasFDerivAt (F_seq k) (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) q) (q + (0 : ℝ) • e) := by
      simpa using hd.hasFDerivAt
    have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => q + t • e) e 0 := by
      simpa [one_smul] using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const e).const_add q
    have h_comp := hd0.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line
    simpa [Function.comp_def, zero_add, smul_eq_mul] using h_comp.tendsto_slope_zero_right

  have h_slope2 : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p e₁ e₂ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (p + t • e₁) e₂ - fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p e₂))
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
        (nhds (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k)) p e₁ e₂)) := by
    intro k p e₁ e₂
    have hd_fderiv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k)) p :=
      ((hF_c2 k).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num) p
    let ev : (((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ e₂
    have hd_eval := ev.hasFDerivAt.comp p hd_fderiv.hasFDerivAt
    have hd_eval0 : HasFDerivAt (ev ∘ fderiv ℝ (F_seq k))
        (ev.comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k)) p)) (p + (0 : ℝ) • e₁) := by
      simpa using hd_eval
    have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => p + t • e₁) e₁ 0 := by
      simpa [one_smul] using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const e₁).const_add p
    have h_comp := hd_eval0.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line
    simpa [ev, Function.comp_def, zero_add, smul_eq_mul] using h_comp.tendsto_slope_zero_right

  have hF_signs : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      (∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ 2 * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ →
        InResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
      HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v (F_seq k) p := by
    intro k p hp_cone
    have h_in_cone : ∀ (y v : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        ‖y‖ < rad k → ‖v‖ ≤ rad k → InResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y + v) := by
      intro y v hy hv
      refine hp_cone (p - y + v) ?_
      have h_eq : p - y + v - p = v - y := by abel
      rw [h_eq]
      calc ‖v - y‖ ≤ ‖v‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_sub_le v y
        _ ≤ rad k + rad k := add_le_add hv hy.le
        _ = 2 * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ := by dsimp [rad]; ring
    have h_first_bds : ∀ (e : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (D : ℝ),
        ‖e‖ ≤ 1 →
        (∀ (z : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (h : ℝ),
          0 ≤ h →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone z →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone (z + h • e) →
          0 ≤ f (z + h • e) - f z ∧ f (z + h • e) - f z ≤ D * h) →
        0 ≤ fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p e ∧ fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p e ≤ D := by
      intro e D he h_step
      have h_mem : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (rad k / 2) ∈ nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0) :=
        Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (half_pos (hrad_pos k))
      have h_ev : ∀ h ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (rad k / 2),
          0 ≤ h⁻¹ * (F_seq k (p + h • e) - F_seq k p) ∧
          h⁻¹ * (F_seq k (p + h • e) - F_seq k p) ≤ D := by
        intro h hh
        have hh_pos : 0 < h := hh.1
        have hhe_norm : ‖h • e‖ ≤ rad k := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hh_pos.le]
          calc h * ‖e‖ ≤ (rad k / 2) * 1 :=
                mul_le_mul hh.2.le he (norm_nonneg e) (half_pos (hrad_pos k)).le
            _ ≤ rad k := by linarith [hrad_pos k]
        have h_diff_eq : F_seq k (p + h • e) - F_seq k p =
            ∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
              (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
                (f_ext (p - y + h • e) - f_ext (p - y)) := by
          rw [hF_eq k (p + h • e), hF_eq k p,
            ← MeasureTheory.integral_sub (h_conv_int k (p + h • e)) (h_conv_int k p)]
          refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
          dsimp only
          have h_arg : p + h • e - y = p - y + h • e := by abel
          rw [h_arg]
          ring
        have h_pt : ∀ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
            0 ≤ (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
                (f_ext (p - y + h • e) - f_ext (p - y)) ∧
            (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
                (f_ext (p - y + h • e) - f_ext (p - y)) ≤
              (D * h) * (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y := by
          intro y
          by_cases hφ0 : (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y = 0
          · simp [hφ0]
          · have hy_lt : ‖y‖ < rad k := hφ_supp k y hφ0
            have hc0 : InResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y) := by
              simpa using h_in_cone y 0 hy_lt (by simp [(hrad_pos k).le])
            have hc1 : InResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y + h • e) :=
              h_in_cone y (h • e) hy_lt hhe_norm
            rw [hf_eq _ hc0, hf_eq _ hc1]
            obtain ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩ := h_step (p - y) h hh_pos.le hc0 hc1
            refine ⟨mul_nonneg (hφ_nn k y) h_lo, ?_⟩
            rw [mul_comm (D * h)]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_hi (hφ_nn k y)
        have h_int_diff : MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun y => (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
              (f_ext (p - y + h • e) - f_ext (p - y)))
            MeasureTheory.volume := by
          have h_sub := (h_conv_int k (p + h • e)).sub (h_conv_int k p)
          refine h_sub.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
          dsimp only [Pi.sub_apply]
          have h_arg : p + h • e - y = p - y + h • e := by abel
          rw [h_arg]
          ring
        have h_int_lo : 0 ≤ F_seq k (p + h • e) - F_seq k p := by
          rw [h_diff_eq]
          exact MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun y => (h_pt y).1)
        have h_int_hi : F_seq k (p + h • e) - F_seq k p ≤ D * h := by
          rw [h_diff_eq]
          calc (∫ y, (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
                (f_ext (p - y + h • e) - f_ext (p - y)))
              ≤ ∫ y, (D * h) * (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y :=
                MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_int_diff ((hφ_int k).const_mul (D * h))
                  (fun y => (h_pt y).2)
            _ = (D * h) * ∫ y, (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y :=
                MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul (D * h) _
            _ = D * h := by rw [hφ_int_one k, mul_one]
        refine ⟨mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hh_pos.le) h_int_lo, ?_⟩
        calc h⁻¹ * (F_seq k (p + h • e) - F_seq k p)
            ≤ h⁻¹ * (D * h) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_hi (inv_nonneg.mpr hh_pos.le)
          _ = D := by field_simp [hh_pos.ne']
      exact ⟨ge_of_tendsto (h_slope1 k p e)
          (Filter.eventually_of_mem h_mem (fun h hh => (h_ev h hh).1)),
        le_of_tendsto (h_slope1 k p e)
          (Filter.eventually_of_mem h_mem (fun h hh => (h_ev h hh).2))⟩
    have h_second_sign : ∀ (e₁ e₂ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        ‖e₁‖ ≤ 1 → ‖e₂‖ ≤ 1 →
        (∀ (z : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (h₁ h₂ : ℝ),
          0 ≤ h₁ → 0 ≤ h₂ →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone z →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone (z + h₁ • e₁) →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone (z + h₂ • e₂) →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone (z + h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂) →
          f (z + h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂) - f (z + h₁ • e₁) - f (z + h₂ • e₂) + f z ≤ 0) →
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k)) p e₁ e₂ ≤ 0 := by
      intro e₁ e₂ he₁ he₂ h_step2
      have h_mem : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (rad k / 2) ∈ nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0) :=
        Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (half_pos (hrad_pos k))
      refine le_of_tendsto (h_slope2 k p e₁ e₂) (Filter.eventually_of_mem h_mem (fun h₁ hh₁ => ?_))
      have hh₁_pos : 0 < h₁ := hh₁.1
      have h_diff1_nonpos : fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (p + h₁ • e₁) e₂ - fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p e₂ ≤ 0 := by
        have h_lim_h2 : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun h₂ : ℝ =>
              h₂⁻¹ * (F_seq k ((p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂) - F_seq k (p + h₁ • e₁)) -
              h₂⁻¹ * (F_seq k (p + h₂ • e₂) - F_seq k p))
            (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
            (nhds (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (p + h₁ • e₁) e₂ - fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p e₂)) :=
          (h_slope1 k (p + h₁ • e₁) e₂).sub (h_slope1 k p e₂)
        refine le_of_tendsto h_lim_h2 (Filter.eventually_of_mem h_mem (fun h₂ hh₂ => ?_))
        have hh₂_pos : 0 < h₂ := hh₂.1
        have hv1_norm : ‖h₁ • e₁‖ ≤ rad k / 2 := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hh₁_pos.le]
          calc h₁ * ‖e₁‖ ≤ (rad k / 2) * 1 :=
                mul_le_mul hh₁.2.le he₁ (norm_nonneg e₁) (half_pos (hrad_pos k)).le
            _ = rad k / 2 := mul_one _
        have hv2_norm : ‖h₂ • e₂‖ ≤ rad k / 2 := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hh₂_pos.le]
          calc h₂ * ‖e₂‖ ≤ (rad k / 2) * 1 :=
                mul_le_mul hh₂.2.le he₂ (norm_nonneg e₂) (half_pos (hrad_pos k)).le
            _ = rad k / 2 := mul_one _
        have hv12_norm : ‖h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂‖ ≤ rad k := by
          calc ‖h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂‖ ≤ ‖h₁ • e₁‖ + ‖h₂ • e₂‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ rad k / 2 + rad k / 2 := add_le_add hv1_norm hv2_norm
            _ = rad k := add_halves _
        have h_four_eq :
            (F_seq k ((p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂) - F_seq k (p + h₁ • e₁)) -
              (F_seq k (p + h₂ • e₂) - F_seq k p) =
            ∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
              (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
                (f_ext (p - y + h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂) - f_ext (p - y + h₁ • e₁) -
                  f_ext (p - y + h₂ • e₂) + f_ext (p - y)) := by
          have hi1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun y =>
                (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext ((p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂ - y) -
                  (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext (p + h₁ • e₁ - y))
              MeasureTheory.volume :=
            (h_conv_int k ((p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂)).sub (h_conv_int k (p + h₁ • e₁))
          have hi2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun y =>
                (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext (p + h₂ • e₂ - y) -
                  (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext (p - y))
              MeasureTheory.volume :=
            (h_conv_int k (p + h₂ • e₂)).sub (h_conv_int k p)
          have h_rhs_split :
              (∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
                (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
                  (f_ext (p - y + h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂) - f_ext (p - y + h₁ • e₁) -
                    f_ext (p - y + h₂ • e₂) + f_ext (p - y))) =
              ∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
                (((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext ((p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂ - y) -
                    (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext (p + h₁ • e₁ - y)) -
                  ((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext (p + h₂ • e₂ - y) -
                    (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * f_ext (p - y))) := by
            refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
            dsimp only
            have ha1 : (p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂ - y = p - y + h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂ := by abel
            have ha2 : p + h₁ • e₁ - y = p - y + h₁ • e₁ := by abel
            have ha3 : p + h₂ • e₂ - y = p - y + h₂ • e₂ := by abel
            rw [ha1, ha2, ha3]
            ring
          rw [h_rhs_split,
            MeasureTheory.integral_sub hi1 hi2,
            MeasureTheory.integral_sub
              (h_conv_int k ((p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂)) (h_conv_int k (p + h₁ • e₁)),
            MeasureTheory.integral_sub (h_conv_int k (p + h₂ • e₂)) (h_conv_int k p),
            ← hF_eq k ((p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂), ← hF_eq k (p + h₁ • e₁),
            ← hF_eq k (p + h₂ • e₂), ← hF_eq k p]
        have h_int_nonpos :
            (F_seq k ((p + h₁ • e₁) + h₂ • e₂) - F_seq k (p + h₁ • e₁)) -
              (F_seq k (p + h₂ • e₂) - F_seq k p) ≤ 0 := by
          rw [h_four_eq]
          refine MeasureTheory.integral_nonpos (fun y => ?_)
          by_cases hφ0 : (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y = 0
          · simp [hφ0]
          · have hy_lt : ‖y‖ < rad k := hφ_supp k y hφ0
            have hc0 : InResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y) := by
              simpa using h_in_cone y 0 hy_lt (by simp [(hrad_pos k).le])
            have hc1 : InResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y + h₁ • e₁) :=
              h_in_cone y (h₁ • e₁) hy_lt (hv1_norm.trans (by linarith [hrad_pos k]))
            have hc2 : InResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y + h₂ • e₂) :=
              h_in_cone y (h₂ • e₂) hy_lt (hv2_norm.trans (by linarith [hrad_pos k]))
            have hc12 : InResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y + h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂) := by
              simpa [add_assoc] using h_in_cone y (h₁ • e₁ + h₂ • e₂) hy_lt hv12_norm
            rw [hf_eq _ hc0, hf_eq _ hc1, hf_eq _ hc2, hf_eq _ hc12]
            exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hφ_nn k y)
              (h_step2 (p - y) h₁ h₂ hh₁_pos.le hh₂_pos.le hc0 hc1 hc2 hc12)
        rw [← mul_sub]
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (inv_nonneg.mpr hh₂_pos.le) h_int_nonpos
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (inv_nonneg.mpr hh₁_pos.le) h_diff1_nonpos
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j
      refine h_first_bds (coneBasisL n j) (d j) (he_L_norm j) (fun z h hh hz hzh => ?_)
      rw [h_shift_L] at hzh ⊢
      exact hf.1 z.1 z.2 h j hh hz hzh
    · refine h_first_bds (coneBasisV n) d_v he_V_norm (fun z h hh hz hzh => ?_)
      rw [h_shift_V] at hzh ⊢
      exact hf.2.1 z.1 z.2 h hh hz hzh
    · intro j k' hjk
      refine h_second_sign (coneBasisL n j) (coneBasisL n k') (he_L_norm j) (he_L_norm k')
        (fun z h₁ h₂ hh₁ hh₂ hz hz1 hz2 hz12 => ?_)
      rw [h_shift_L, h_shift_L] at hz12 ⊢
      rw [h_shift_L] at hz1 hz2 ⊢
      exact hf.2.2.1 z.1 z.2 h₁ h₂ j k' hjk hh₁ hh₂ hz hz1 hz2 hz12
    · intro j
      refine h_second_sign (coneBasisL n j) (coneBasisV n) (he_L_norm j) he_V_norm
        (fun z h₁ h₂ hh₁ hh₂ hz hz1 hz2 hz12 => ?_)
      simp only [h_shift_L, h_shift_V] at hz1 hz2 hz12 ⊢
      exact hf.2.2.2 z.1 z.2 h₁ h₂ j hh₁ hh₂ hz hz1 hz2 hz12

  have h_comm : ∀ (e : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (P : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ),
      ‖e‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∀ᵐ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q →
        fderiv ℝ f_ext q e = P q) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
        (∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ rad k →
          InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
        fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p e = mollify P k p := by
    intro e P he hP_ae k p hp_strict
    let h_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => ((m + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    have hh_pos : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < h_seq m := fun m => inv_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have hh_tendsto_zero : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h_nat0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
      have h_nat1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr h_nat0
      simpa [h_seq, Nat.cast_add] using h_nat1
    have hh_nhdsGT : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hh_tendsto_zero, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hh_pos⟩
    have h_lim1 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m : ℕ => (h_seq m)⁻¹ * (F_seq k (p + h_seq m • e) - F_seq k p))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p e)) :=
      (h_slope1 k p e).comp hh_nhdsGT
    let G : ℕ → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ := fun m y =>
      (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
        ((h_seq m)⁻¹ * (f_ext (p - y + h_seq m • e) - f_ext (p - y)))
    have h_int_eq : ∀ m : ℕ,
        (h_seq m)⁻¹ * (F_seq k (p + h_seq m • e) - F_seq k p) =
          ∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, G m y := by
      intro m
      rw [hF_eq k (p + h_seq m • e), hF_eq k p,
        ← MeasureTheory.integral_sub (h_conv_int k (p + h_seq m • e)) (h_conv_int k p),
        ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
      dsimp [G]
      have h_arg : p + h_seq m • e - y = p - y + h_seq m • e := by abel
      rw [h_arg]
      ring
    have h_rad_ae : ∀ᵐ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f_ext q :=
      hf_lip.ae_differentiableAt
    have h_pull_ae : ∀ᵐ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ f_ext (p - y) ∧
        (InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y) → fderiv ℝ f_ext (p - y) e = P (p - y)) :=
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_sub_left MeasureTheory.volume p).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
        (h_rad_ae.and hP_ae)
    have h_lim2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, G m y)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds (∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * P (p - y))) := by
      refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
        (fun y => (K_ext : ℝ) * (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro m
        have hc : Continuous (G m) :=
          (hφ_cont k).mul (continuous_const.mul
            ((hf_cont.comp ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).add continuous_const)).sub
              (hf_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))))
        exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact (hφ_int k).const_mul (K_ext : ℝ)
      · intro m
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
        change |(bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y *
          ((h_seq m)⁻¹ * (f_ext (p - y + h_seq m • e) - f_ext (p - y)))| ≤
          (K_ext : ℝ) * (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul,
          abs_of_nonneg (hφ_nn k y), abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (hh_pos m).le)]
        have h_lip_y : |f_ext (p - y + h_seq m • e) - f_ext (p - y)| ≤
            (K_ext : ℝ) * h_seq m := by
          have hd := hf_lip.dist_le_mul (p - y + h_seq m • e) (p - y)
          rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (hh_pos m).le] at hd
          exact hd.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (hh_pos m).le he)) (NNReal.coe_nonneg K_ext))
        have h_q : (h_seq m)⁻¹ * |f_ext (p - y + h_seq m • e) - f_ext (p - y)| ≤
            (K_ext : ℝ) := by
          calc (h_seq m)⁻¹ * |f_ext (p - y + h_seq m • e) - f_ext (p - y)|
              ≤ (h_seq m)⁻¹ * ((K_ext : ℝ) * h_seq m) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lip_y (inv_nonneg.mpr (hh_pos m).le)
            _ = (K_ext : ℝ) := by field_simp [(hh_pos m).ne']
        rw [mul_comm (K_ext : ℝ)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_q (hφ_nn k y)
      · filter_upwards [h_pull_ae] with y ⟨hy_diff, hy_P⟩
        by_cases hφ0 : (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y = 0
        · simp [G, hφ0]
        · have hy_lt : ‖y‖ < rad k := hφ_supp k y hφ0
          have hy_strict : InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone (p - y) := by
            refine hp_strict (p - y) ?_
            have h_sub_eq : p - y - p = -y := by abel
            rw [h_sub_eq, norm_neg]
            exact hy_lt.le
          have h_fderiv_eq : fderiv ℝ f_ext (p - y) e = P (p - y) := hy_P hy_strict
          have hy_diff0 : HasFDerivAt f_ext (fderiv ℝ f_ext (p - y)) ((p - y) + (0 : ℝ) • e) := by
            simpa using hy_diff.hasFDerivAt
          have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (p - y) + t • e) e 0 := by
            simpa [one_smul] using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const e).const_add (p - y)
          have h_der : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f_ext ((p - y) + t • e)) (P (p - y)) 0 := by
            rw [← h_fderiv_eq]
            exact hy_diff0.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h_line
          have h_sl : Filter.Tendsto
              (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (f_ext ((p - y) + t • e) - f_ext (p - y)))
              (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (P (p - y))) := by
            simpa [zero_add, smul_eq_mul] using h_der.tendsto_slope_zero_right
          exact (h_sl.comp hh_nhdsGT).const_mul ((bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y)
    simp_rw [h_int_eq] at h_lim1
    have h_moll_P : mollify P k p =
        ∫ y : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume y * P (p - y) := by
      simpa using MeasureTheory.convolution_def (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
        (f := (bump k).normed MeasureTheory.volume) (g := P) (x := p)
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
    rw [← h_moll_P] at h_lim2
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_lim1 h_lim2

  have h_L1_approx : ∀ (D_max : ℝ) (P : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
      (K_c : Set ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)),
      0 ≤ D_max →
      Measurable P →
      (∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, 0 ≤ P q ∧ P q ≤ D_max) →
      MeasurableSet K_c →
      MeasureTheory.volume K_c < ⊤ →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ∫ p in K_c, |mollify P k p - P p|)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro D_max P K_c hD_nn hP_meas hP_bds _ hKc_vol
    have hP_loc : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable P MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have h_mem : MeasureTheory.MemLp P ⊤ MeasureTheory.volume :=
        MeasureTheory.memLp_top_of_bound hP_meas.aestronglyMeasurable D_max
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun q => by
            rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hP_bds q).1]
            exact (hP_bds q).2))
      exact h_mem.locallyIntegrable le_top
    have h_rout_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (bump k).rOut) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h_nat0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
      have h_nat2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 2).mpr h_nat0
      simpa [bump, rad, Nat.cast_add] using h_nat2
    have h_rout_le : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop, (bump k).rOut ≤ 2 * (bump k).rIn :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun k => by
        change rad k ≤ 2 * (rad k / 2)
        linarith)
    have h_ae_conv : ∀ᵐ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => mollify P k p) Filter.atTop (nhds (P p)) :=
      ContDiffBump.ae_convolution_tendsto_right_of_locallyIntegrable
        (φ := bump) (K := 2) h_rout_lim h_rout_le hP_loc
    have h_lim_zero : (∫ _p in K_c, (0 : ℝ)) = 0 := MeasureTheory.integral_zero _ _
    rw [← h_lim_zero]
    refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun _ => D_max) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro k
      have hmoll_cont : Continuous (mollify P k) :=
        HasCompactSupport.continuous_convolution_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
          (hφ_cs k) (hφ_cont k) hP_loc
      exact ((hmoll_cont.measurable.sub hP_meas).abs).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const (hs := hKc_vol.ne)
    · intro k
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _), ← Real.dist_eq]
      refine (bump k).dist_normed_convolution_le hP_meas.aestronglyMeasurable (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_le_iff]
      exact ⟨by linarith [(hP_bds x).2, (hP_bds p).1],
        by linarith [(hP_bds p).2, (hP_bds x).1]⟩
    · filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_ae h_ae_conv] with p hp
      simpa [sub_self] using (hp.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := P p))).abs

  refine ⟨F_seq, hF_c2, hF_unif, hF_signs, ?_⟩
  intro K_c r_margin hKc_meas hKc_vol hr_pos hKc_margin
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (r_margin⁻¹)
  have hk_rad : ∀ k : ℕ, k₀ ≤ k → rad k ≤ r_margin := by
    intro k hk
    have hk_cast : (k₀ : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hk
    have h_lt : r_margin⁻¹ < (k + 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact ((inv_lt_comm₀ hr_pos (by positivity)).mp h_lt).le
  refine ⟨fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h_ae_j : ∀ᵐ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q →
        fderiv ℝ f_ext q (coneBasisL n j) = conePartialL n c d E_cone f j q :=
      hf_ae.mono (fun q hq h_in => (hq h_in).1 j)
    have h_base := h_L1_approx (d j) (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) K_c
      (hd_nn.1 j) (h_meas_L j).1 (h_meas_L j).2 hKc_meas hKc_vol
    refine h_base.congr' ?_
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, Filter.eventually_atTop]
    refine ⟨k₀, fun k hk => MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hKc_meas (fun p hp => ?_)⟩
    have hp_strict : ∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ rad k →
        InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q :=
      fun q hq => hKc_margin p hp q (hq.trans (hk_rad k hk))
    change |mollify (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) k p - conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p| =
      |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisL n j) - conePartialL n c d E_cone f j p|
    rw [h_comm (coneBasisL n j) (conePartialL n c d E_cone f j) (he_L_norm j) h_ae_j k p hp_strict]
  · have h_ae_V : ∀ᵐ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q →
        fderiv ℝ f_ext q (coneBasisV n) = conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f q :=
      hf_ae.mono (fun q hq h_in => (hq h_in).2)
    have h_base := h_L1_approx d_v (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) K_c
      hd_nn.2 h_meas_V.1 h_meas_V.2 hKc_meas hKc_vol
    refine h_base.congr' ?_
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, Filter.eventually_atTop]
    refine ⟨k₀, fun k hk => MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hKc_meas (fun p hp => ?_)⟩
    have hp_strict : ∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ rad k →
        InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q :=
      fun q hq => hKc_margin p hp q (hq.trans (hk_rad k hk))
    change |mollify (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) k p - conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p| =
      |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisV n) - conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f p|
    rw [h_comm (coneBasisV n) (conePartialV n c d_v E_cone f) he_V_norm h_ae_V k p hp_strict]

informal_problem.statement:
(n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j_top : Fin n)
    (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ)
    (hc_inj : Function.Injective c)
    (hc_top : ∀ j : Fin n, j ≠ j_top → c j < c j_top)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v) :
    (∀ (K δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ C_mix : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_mix ∧
        (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ 2 F →
          (∀ (i u : ℝ), |i| ≤ K + 1 → u ∈ Set.Icc (δ / 2) (1 - δ / 2) →
            HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η)) →
          (∀ j : Fin n,
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |deriv (fun s' =>
                fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i + c j * (u - s'), s') + η)
                  (coneBasisL n j)) u|) ≤ C_mix) ∧
          (∫ u in δ..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K,
            |deriv (fun i' =>
              fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i', u) + η) (coneBasisV n)) i|) ≤ C_mix) ∧
        (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η η' : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ 2 F →
          (∀ (θ i u : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            |i| ≤ K + 1 → u ∈ Set.Icc (δ / 2) (1 - δ / 2) →
            HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v F
              (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + ((1 - θ) • η + θ • η'))) →
          (∀ j : Fin n, η.1 j = 0 → η'.1 j = 0 →
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j) -
                fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisL n j)|) ≤
              C_mix * ((∑ k : Fin n, |η.1 k - η'.1 k|) + |η.2 - η'.2|)) ∧
          (η.2 = 0 → η'.2 = 0 →
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisV n) -
                fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisV n)|) ≤
              C_mix * (∑ k : Fin n, |η.1 k - η'.1 k|)))) ∧
    (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)
       (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K δ : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 F → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ iu, 0 ≤ φ iu) →
      (∀ iu, (K ≤ |iu.1| ∨ iu.2 ≤ δ ∨ 1 - δ ≤ iu.2) → φ iu = 0) →
      (∀ (i u : ℝ), |i| ≤ K → u ∈ Set.Icc δ (1 - δ) →
        HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η)) →
      0 ≤ ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K,
        (-fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j_top) *
            (deriv (fun u' => φ (i, u')) u - c j_top * deriv (fun i' => φ (i', u)) i) +
          fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisV n) *
            deriv (fun i' => φ (i', u)) i)) ∧
    (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 F →
      (∀ u i₁ i₂ : ℝ,
        F (planeEmbed n c (i₂, u) + η) - F (planeEmbed n c (i₁, u) + η) =
          ∫ i in i₁..i₂,
            ∑ j : Fin n, fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j)) ∧
      (∀ p r u₁ u₂ : ℝ,
        F (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u₂, u₂) + η) -
          F (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u₁, u₁) + η) =
          ∫ u in u₁..u₂,
            ((∑ j : Fin n, (c j - p) *
                fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j)) +
              fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u, u) + η) (coneBasisV n))))

        (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η η' : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ 2 F →
          (∀ (θ i u : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →

                fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisV n)|) ≤
              C_mix * (∑ k : Fin n, |η.1 k - η'.1 k|)))) ∧
    (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)
       (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K δ : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 F → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ iu, 0 ≤ φ iu) →
      (∀ iu, (K ≤ |iu.1| ∨ iu.2 ≤ δ ∨ 1 - δ ≤ iu.2) → φ iu = 0) →
      (∀ (i u : ℝ), |i| ≤ K → u ∈ Set.Icc δ (1 - δ) →
        HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η)) →
      0 ≤ ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ), ∫ i in (-K)..K,

            (deriv (fun u' => φ (i, u')) u - c j_top * deriv (fun i' => φ (i', u)) i) +
          fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisV n) *

    (∀ (F : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (η : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_basis : ∀ w : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
      w = (∑ k : Fin n, w.1 k • coneBasisL n k) + w.2 • coneBasisV n := by
    intro w
    ext m
    · simp [coneBasisL, coneBasisV, Prod.fst_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Function.update_apply]

          ∑ k : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n k) (coneBasisV n) =
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisV n) (coneBasisL n j_top) +
          ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j_top,
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n k) (coneBasisV n) := by
        rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ j_top),
          h_symm F hF (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n j_top) (coneBasisV n)]
      have hs3 :
          (∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j_top,
            (c j_top - c k) *
              (-fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n k) (coneBasisL n j_top))) -
          (∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j_top,
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n k) (coneBasisV n)) =
          ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase j_top,
            ((c j_top - c k) *
              (-fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n k) (coneBasisL n j_top)) +
              (-fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n k) (coneBasisV n))) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
      linarith [hs1, hs2, hs3]
    have hR_nn : 0 ≤ R_top := by
      rw [hR_eq]
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun k hk => ?_
      have hk_ne : k ≠ j_top := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1
      have hc_lt : c k < c j_top := hc_top k hk_ne
      have hf1 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n k) (coneBasisL n j_top) ≤ 0 :=
        hs.2.2.1 k j_top hk_ne
      have hf2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (p_fn (i, u)) (coneBasisL n k) (coneBasisV n) ≤ 0 :=
        hs.2.2.2 k
      exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by linarith)
    exact mul_nonneg hR_nn (hφ_nn (i, u))
  · 
    intro F η hF
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u i₁ i₂
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun i : ℝ =>
          ∑ j : Fin n, fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j)) :=
        continuous_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
          (h_cont_fderiv F hF (coneBasisL n j)).comp
            ((h_cont_plane.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).add continuous_const)
      refine (intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (f := fun i => F (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η)) (fun i _ => ?_)
        (h_cont.intervalIntegrable i₁ i₂)).symm
      have hd := h_deriv_F F hF (fun i' => planeEmbed n c (i', u) + η)
        (fun _ => 1, 0) i (h_curve_hor η u i)
      exact hd.congr_deriv (by simp)
    · intro p r u₁ u₂
      have h_sh_cont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => planeEmbed n c (r - p * u, u) + η) :=
        (h_cont_plane.comp ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).prodMk
          continuous_id)).add continuous_const
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ =>
          (∑ j : Fin n, (c j - p) *
            fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j)) +
          fderiv ℝ F (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u, u) + η) (coneBasisV n)) :=
        (continuous_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
          continuous_const.mul ((h_cont_fderiv F hF (coneBasisL n j)).comp h_sh_cont)).add
          ((h_cont_fderiv F hF (coneBasisV n)).comp h_sh_cont)
      refine (intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (f := fun u => F (planeEmbed n c (r - p * u, u) + η)) (fun u _ => ?_)
        (h_cont.intervalIntegrable u₁ u₂)).symm
      have hd := h_deriv_F F hF (fun u' => planeEmbed n c (r - p * u', u') + η)
        (fun k => c k - p, 1) u (h_curve_sh η p r u)
      exact hd.congr_deriv (by simp)

informal_problem.statement:
(n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hc_inj : Function.Injective c)
    (hd_nn : (∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) ∧ 0 ≤ d_v)
    (hE_pos : ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → 0 < c k - c j)
    (P_L : Fin n → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (P_V : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hP_L : ∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (P_L j) ∧ ∀ p, 0 ≤ P_L j p ∧ P_L j p ≤ d j)
    (hP_V : Measurable P_V ∧ ∀ p, 0 ≤ P_V p ∧ P_V p ≤ d_v)
    (F_seq : ℕ → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hF_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 2 (F_seq k))
    (hF_signs : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      (∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ 2 * ((k + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ →
        InResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
      HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v (F_seq k) p)
    (hF_L1 : ∀ (K_c : Set ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)) (r_margin : ℝ),
      MeasurableSet K_c → MeasureTheory.volume K_c < ⊤ → 0 < r_margin →
      (∀ p ∈ K_c, ∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖q - p‖ ≤ r_margin →
        InStrictResolutionCone n c E_cone q) →
      (∀ j : Fin n,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
          ∫ p in K_c, |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisL n j) - P_L j p|)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
        ∫ p in K_c, |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) p (coneBasisV n) - P_V p|)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (hF_slice_lip : ∀ (K δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ C_mix : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_mix ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ) (η η' : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
          (∀ (θ i u : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            |i| ≤ K + 1 → u ∈ Set.Icc (δ / 2) (1 - δ / 2) →
            HasSmoothSubmodularSigns n d d_v (F_seq k)
              (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + ((1 - θ) • η + θ • η'))) →
          (∀ j : Fin n, η.1 j = 0 → η'.1 j = 0 →
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisL n j) -
                fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisL n j)|) ≤
              C_mix * ((∑ k' : Fin n, |η.1 k' - η'.1 k'|) + |η.2 - η'.2|)) ∧
          (η.2 = 0 → η'.2 = 0 →
            (∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
              |fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η) (coneBasisV n) -
                fderiv ℝ (F_seq k) (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η') (coneBasisV n)|) ≤
              C_mix * (∑ k' : Fin n, |η.1 k' - η'.1 k'|))) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    ∃ (a : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
      (η_seq : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (k_seq : ℕ → ℕ),
      (∀ j : Fin n, Measurable (a j) ∧ ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ a j iu ∧ a j iu ≤ d j) ∧
      (Measurable D ∧ ∀ iu : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ D iu ∧ D iu ≤ d_v) ∧
      (∀ (K δ R : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ R →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ =>
          ∫ i in (-K)..K, ∫ u in δ..(1 - δ),
            ∫ ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
              if IsStrictDispCone n c E_cone ξ ∧ (∀ j, |ξ.1 j| ≤ R) ∧ |ξ.2| ≤ R then
                (∑ j : Fin n,
                  |P_L j (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + h • ξ) - a j (i, u)|) +
                  |P_V (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + h • ξ) - D (i, u)|
              else 0)
          (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ k_seq m ∧ ‖η_seq m‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m : ℤ))) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ (i u : ℝ),
        u ∈ Set.Icc ((2 * (m + 4 : ℝ))⁻¹) (1 - (2 * (m + 4 : ℝ))⁻¹) →
        ∀ q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ,
          ‖q - (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η_seq m)‖ ≤ 2 * ((k_seq m + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ →
          InResolutionCone n c E_cone q) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ,
        (∫ i in (-((m + 2 : ℝ)))..(m + 2 : ℝ),
          ∫ u in ((m + 4 : ℝ)⁻¹)..(1 - (m + 4 : ℝ)⁻¹),
            (∑ j : Fin n,
              |fderiv ℝ (F_seq (k_seq m))
                  (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η_seq m) (coneBasisL n j) - a j (i, u)|) +
              |fderiv ℝ (F_seq (k_seq m))
                  (planeEmbed n c (i, u) + η_seq m) (coneBasisV n) - D (i, u)|) ≤
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m : ℤ)))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have : (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)).IsAddHaarMeasure :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.instIsAddHaarMeasure MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume
  
  have h_norm_fst : ∀ (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (j : Fin n), |p.1 j| ≤ ‖p‖ := by
    intro p j
    calc |p.1 j| = ‖p.1 j‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖p.1‖ := norm_le_pi_norm p.1 j
      _ ≤ ‖p‖ := le_max_left ‖p.1‖ ‖p.2‖
  have h_norm_snd : ∀ p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ, |p.2| ≤ ‖p‖ := by
    intro p
    calc |p.2| = ‖p.2‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖p‖ := le_max_right ‖p.1‖ ‖p.2‖
  have h_norm_le_iff : ∀ (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
      (((∀ j : Fin n, |p.1 j| ≤ R) ∧ |p.2| ≤ R) ↔ ‖p‖ ≤ R) := by
    intro p R hR
    rw [Prod.norm_def, max_le_iff, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hR]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  let c_sum : ℝ := ∑ j : Fin n, |c j|
  have hc_sum_nn : 0 ≤ c_sum := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hc_le_sum : ∀ j : Fin n, |c j| ≤ c_sum :=
    fun j => Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k : Fin n => |c k|)
      (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  let C_cone : ℝ := 2 + 2 * c_sum
  have hC_cone_ge : 2 ≤ C_cone := by
    dsimp [C_cone]
    linarith
  have hC_cone_pos : 0 < C_cone := by linarith
  let edgeSlack : Fin n → Fin n → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun j₁ j₂ p => (c j₂ - c j₁) * p.2 - (p.1 j₂ - p.1 j₁)
  have h_slack_cont : ∀ j₁ j₂ : Fin n, Continuous (edgeSlack j₁ j₂) := by
    intro j₁ j₂
    exact (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).sub
      (((continuous_apply j₂).comp continuous_fst).sub ((continuous_apply j₁).comp continuous_fst))
  have h_slack_lip : ∀ (j₁ j₂ : Fin n) (p q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      |edgeSlack j₁ j₂ q - edgeSlack j₁ j₂ p| ≤ C_cone * ‖q - p‖ := by
    intro j₁ j₂ p q
    have h_eq : edgeSlack j₁ j₂ q - edgeSlack j₁ j₂ p =
        (c j₂ - c j₁) * (q - p).2 - (q - p).1 j₂ + (q - p).1 j₁ := by
      dsimp [edgeSlack]
      ring
    rw [h_eq]
    have hc_diff : |c j₂ - c j₁| ≤ 2 * c_sum := by
      calc |c j₂ - c j₁| ≤ |c j₂| + |c j₁| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ c_sum + c_sum := add_le_add (hc_le_sum j₂) (hc_le_sum j₁)
        _ = 2 * c_sum := by ring
    have h1 : |(c j₂ - c j₁) * (q - p).2| ≤ (2 * c_sum) * ‖q - p‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul hc_diff (h_norm_snd (q - p)) (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have h2 : |(q - p).1 j₂| ≤ ‖q - p‖ := h_norm_fst (q - p) j₂
    have h3 : |(q - p).1 j₁| ≤ ‖q - p‖ := h_norm_fst (q - p) j₁
    calc |(c j₂ - c j₁) * (q - p).2 - (q - p).1 j₂ + (q - p).1 j₁|
        ≤ |(c j₂ - c j₁) * (q - p).2 - (q - p).1 j₂| + |(q - p).1 j₁| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ |(c j₂ - c j₁) * (q - p).2| + |(q - p).1 j₂| + |(q - p).1 j₁| :=
          add_le_add (abs_sub _ _) le_rfl
      _ ≤ (2 * c_sum) * ‖q - p‖ + ‖q - p‖ + ‖q - p‖ := add_le_add (add_le_add h1 h2) h3
      _ = C_cone * ‖q - p‖ := by dsimp [C_cone]; ring
  have h_slack_lower : ∀ (j₁ j₂ : Fin n) (p q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      edgeSlack j₁ j₂ p - C_cone * ‖q - p‖ ≤ edgeSlack j₁ j₂ q := by
    intro j₁ j₂ p q
    have h := (abs_le.mp (h_slack_lip j₁ j₂ p q)).1
    linarith
  have h_slack_plane : ∀ (j₁ j₂ : Fin n) (iu : ℝ × ℝ),
      edgeSlack j₁ j₂ (planeEmbed n c iu) = 0 := by
    intro j₁ j₂ iu
    dsimp [edgeSlack, planeEmbed]
    ring
  have h_slack_add : ∀ (j₁ j₂ : Fin n) (p q : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      edgeSlack j₁ j₂ (p + q) = edgeSlack j₁ j₂ p + edgeSlack j₁ j₂ q := by
    intro j₁ j₂ p q
    dsimp [edgeSlack]
    ring
  have h_slack_smul : ∀ (j₁ j₂ : Fin n) (t : ℝ) (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      edgeSlack j₁ j₂ (t • p) = t * edgeSlack j₁ j₂ p := by
    intro j₁ j₂ t p
    dsimp [edgeSlack]
    ring
  have h_slack_projL : ∀ (j₁ j₂ j : Fin n) (ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      edgeSlack j₁ j₂ (coneProjZeroL n j ξ) = edgeSlack j₁ j₂ ξ := by
    intro j₁ j₂ j ξ
    dsimp [edgeSlack, coneProjZeroL]
    ring
  have h_slack_projV : ∀ (j₁ j₂ : Fin n) (ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      edgeSlack j₁ j₂ (coneProjZeroV n c ξ) = edgeSlack j₁ j₂ ξ := by
    intro j₁ j₂ ξ
    dsimp [edgeSlack, coneProjZeroV]
    ring
  have h_shift_L1 : ∀ (i u : ℝ) (j : Fin n) (ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      planeEmbed n c (i, u) + coneProjZeroL n j ξ =
        planeEmbed n c (i - ξ.1 j, u) + ξ := by
    intro i u j ξ
    ext k <;> dsimp [planeEmbed, coneProjZeroL]
    ring
  have h_shift_L2 : ∀ (i u : ℝ) (j : Fin n) (ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ),
      planeEmbed n c (i, u) + ξ =
        planeEmbed n c (i + ξ.1 j, u) + coneProjZeroL n j ξ := by
    intro i u j ξ

    rw [Finset.mem_offDiag]

    intro s hs

        _ = (5 / 4) * s := by ring

      lt_of_le_of_lt (h_norm_snd (ξ - ((0 : Fin n → ℝ), s))) (lt_of_lt_of_le hξ hr_le)
    have hξ2_lo : (3 / 4) * s < ξ.2 := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hξ2_diff).1]
    have hξ2_hi : ξ.2 < (5 / 4) * s := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hξ2_diff).2]
    have h_sl : ∀ j₁ j₂ : Fin n, E_cone j₁ j₂ → (1 / 2) * s * c_gap < edgeSlack j₁ j₂ ξ := by
      intro j₁ j₂ hE

        rw [sub_zero, sub_zero]

    refine ⟨hξ_norm, hξ2_lo, hξ2_hi, h_sl, fun j₁ j₂ hE => ?_⟩
    have h_pos : 0 < edgeSlack j₁ j₂ ξ := lt_trans (by positivity) (h_sl j₁ j₂ hE)
    dsimp [edgeSlack] at h_pos
    linarith

  have h_fubini_3fold : ∀ (F : (ℝ × ℝ) → ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) (B a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ),

      linarith
  let η_seq : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ := fun m => (Classical.choose (h_diag_ex m)).1
  let k_seq : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => (Classical.choose (h_diag_ex m)).2
  have h_diag_spec := fun m => Classical.choose_spec (h_diag_ex m)
  refine ⟨a, D, η_seq, k_seq, ha_meas_bds, hD_meas_bds, ?_,
    fun m => (h_diag_spec m).1,
    fun m => (h_diag_spec m).2.1,
    fun m => (h_diag_spec m).2.2⟩
  intro K δ R hK hδ0 hδ1 hR
  refine (h_cl3 K δ R hK hδ0 hδ1 hR).congr (fun h => ?_)
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun i _ => intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun u _ => ?_))
  congr 1 with ξ
  congr

    (ha_deriv : HasDerivAt path.a_path a' x₀)
    (hS_deriv : HasDerivAt path.S_path s x₀) :
