proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have h_lin : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (g' : ℝ), HasDerivAt g g' x₀ →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ u : ℝ, |u - x₀| < ρ →
        |g u - g x₀ - (u - x₀) * g'| ≤ ε * |u - x₀| := by
    intro g g' hg ε hε
    have ht := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto.mp hg
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds] at ht
    have h_ev := ht ε hε
    rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at h_ev
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ_pos, hρ⟩ := h_ev
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ_pos, fun u hu => ?_⟩
    by_cases hux : u = x₀
    · subst hux
      simp
    · have h_pos : 0 < |u - x₀| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hux)
      have h1 := hρ (by rwa [Real.dist_eq])
      simp only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_inv,
        abs_abs] at h1
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 h_pos
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h_pos), one_mul] at h2
      linarith

  have h_ba_nn : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ path.a_path u - path.b_path u := by
    intro u hu
    have hsh := path.h_shape_mono u u hu.1 le_rfl hu.2
    linarith

  have hm_nn : 0 ≤ m := by
    have h1 := h_ba_nn 1 ⟨zero_lt_one, le_rfl⟩
    rw [path.ha_one, path.hb_one] at h1
    linarith

  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    by_contra h_neg
    have hs_lt : s < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h_neg
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ_pos, hρ⟩ := h_lin path.S_path s hS_deriv (-s / 2) (by linarith)
    let u := x₀ + ρ / 2
    have h_eq : u - x₀ = ρ / 2 := by dsimp [u]; ring
    have hu_dist : |u - x₀| < ρ := by
      rw [h_eq, abs_of_pos (half_pos hρ_pos)]
      linarith
    have h_app := hρ u hu_dist
    rw [h_eq, abs_of_pos (half_pos hρ_pos)] at h_app
    have h_lip := (path.hS_lip x₀ u (by dsimp [u]; linarith)).1
    have h_ub := (abs_le.mp h_app).2
    nlinarith

  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra h_gt
    have hs_gt : 1 < s := lt_of_not_ge h_gt
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ_pos, hρ⟩ := h_lin path.S_path s hS_deriv ((s - 1) / 2) (by linarith)
    let u := x₀ + ρ / 2
    have h_eq : u - x₀ = ρ / 2 := by dsimp [u]; ring
    have hu_dist : |u - x₀| < ρ := by
      rw [h_eq, abs_of_pos (half_pos hρ_pos)]
      linarith
    have h_app := hρ u hu_dist
    rw [h_eq, abs_of_pos (half_pos hρ_pos)] at h_app
    have h_lip := (path.hS_lip x₀ u (by dsimp [u]; linarith)).2
    have h_lb := (abs_le.mp h_app).1
    dsimp [u] at h_lip
    nlinarith

  
  
  
  let δ₀ : ℝ := min x₀ (1 - x₀)
  have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := lt_min hx₀.1 (sub_pos.mpr hx₀.2)
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (4 / δ₀)
  have hk₀_pow : (k₀ : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := k₀))
  have h4_lt : 4 < δ₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := by
    have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ₀_pos).mp (lt_trans hk₀ hk₀_pow)
    linarith

  let M_nat : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => 2 ^ (k + k₀)
  let j_nat : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => ⌊x₀ * (M_nat k : ℝ)⌋₊
  let r_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ((j_nat k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (M_nat k : ℝ)
  let t_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ((j_nat k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (M_nat k : ℝ)
  let u_grid : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun k i =>
    r_seq k + ((i : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) * (t_seq k - r_seq k)

  have h_grid : ∀ k : ℕ,
      4 ≤ j_nat k ∧ j_nat k + 1 < M_nat k ∧
      0 < r_seq k ∧ r_seq k < x₀ ∧ x₀ < t_seq k ∧ t_seq k < 1 ∧
      t_seq k - r_seq k = (2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) ∧
      u_grid k 0 = r_seq k ∧ u_grid k (2 ^ k) = t_seq k ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ 2 ^ k →
        IsPosDyadicUnit (u_grid k i) ∧
        r_seq k ≤ u_grid k i ∧ u_grid k i ≤ t_seq k ∧
        |u_grid k i - x₀| < t_seq k - r_seq k) := by
    intro k
    have hM_ge : (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ ≤ (M_nat k : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [M_nat]
      have h_le : 2 ^ k₀ ≤ 2 ^ (k + k₀) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.le_add_left k₀ k)
      exact_mod_cast h_le
    have hM_pos : 0 < (M_nat k : ℝ) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hM_ge
    have hxM_gt4 : 4 < x₀ * (M_nat k : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : δ₀ ≤ x₀ := min_le_left _ _
      calc (4 : ℝ) < δ₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := h4_lt
        _ ≤ x₀ * (M_nat k : ℝ) := mul_le_mul h1 hM_ge (by positivity) hx₀.1.le
    have h1mxM_gt4 : 4 < (1 - x₀) * (M_nat k : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : δ₀ ≤ 1 - x₀ := min_le_right _ _
      have h1mx_nn : 0 ≤ 1 - x₀ := (sub_pos.mpr hx₀.2).le
      calc (4 : ℝ) < δ₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := h4_lt
        _ ≤ (1 - x₀) * (M_nat k : ℝ) := mul_le_mul h1 hM_ge (by positivity) h1mx_nn
    have hj_ge4 : 4 ≤ j_nat k :=
      Nat.le_floor (by norm_num; exact hxM_gt4.le)
    have hj_ge1 : 1 ≤ j_nat k := by omega
    have hj_le : (j_nat k : ℝ) ≤ x₀ * (M_nat k : ℝ) :=
      Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hx₀.1.le hM_pos.le)
    have hj_lt : x₀ * (M_nat k : ℝ) < (j_nat k : ℝ) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_floor_add_one (x₀ * (M_nat k : ℝ))
    have hj1_lt_M_real : (j_nat k : ℝ) + 1 < (M_nat k : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    have hj1_lt_M : j_nat k + 1 < M_nat k := by
      exact_mod_cast hj1_lt_M_real
    have hj_sub_cast : ((j_nat k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (j_nat k : ℝ) - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hj_ge1]
      simp
    have hj_add_cast : ((j_nat k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (j_nat k : ℝ) + 1 := by
      push_cast
      rfl
    have hr_pos : 0 < r_seq k := by
      dsimp [r_seq]
      rw [hj_sub_cast]
      refine div_pos ?_ hM_pos
      have hj4_real : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (j_nat k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj_ge4
      linarith
    have hr_lt_x : r_seq k < x₀ := by
      dsimp [r_seq]
      rw [hj_sub_cast, div_lt_iff₀ hM_pos]
      linarith
    have hx_lt_t : x₀ < t_seq k := by
      dsimp [t_seq]
      rw [hj_add_cast, lt_div_iff₀ hM_pos]
      exact hj_lt
    have ht_lt_1 : t_seq k < 1 := by
      dsimp [t_seq]
      rw [hj_add_cast, div_lt_one hM_pos]
      exact hj1_lt_M_real
    have hM_cast : (M_nat k : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := by
      dsimp [M_nat]
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_add]
    have hη_eq : t_seq k - r_seq k = (2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by
      dsimp [t_seq, r_seq]
      rw [hj_add_cast, hj_sub_cast, hM_cast, one_div_pow]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hu0 : u_grid k 0 = r_seq k := by
      dsimp [u_grid]
      simp
    have hu_end : u_grid k (2 ^ k) = t_seq k := by
      dsimp [u_grid]
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, div_self (by positivity)]
      ring
    refine ⟨hj_ge4, hj1_lt_M, hr_pos, hr_lt_x, hx_lt_t, ht_lt_1, hη_eq, hu0, hu_end, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    have hη_pos : 0 < t_seq k - r_seq k := sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hr_lt_x hx_lt_t)
    have hi_frac_nn : 0 ≤ (i : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
    have hi_frac_le1 : (i : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      have hi_real : (i : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hi
      simpa using hi_real
    have hu_ge_r : r_seq k ≤ u_grid k i := by
      dsimp [u_grid]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hi_frac_nn hη_pos.le)
    have hu_le_t : u_grid k i ≤ t_seq k := by
      dsimp [u_grid]
      have h1 : ((i : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) ≤ 1 * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi_frac_le1 hη_pos.le
      linarith
    have hu_abs : |u_grid k i - x₀| < t_seq k - r_seq k := by
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hu_dyad : IsPosDyadicUnit (u_grid k i) := by
      refine ⟨2 * k + k₀, (j_nat k - 1) * 2 ^ k + 2 * i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h2k_pos : 1 ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.one_le_two_pow
        have hj_sub_ge3 : 3 ≤ j_nat k - 1 := by omega
        nlinarith
      · have h_le1 : (j_nat k - 1) * 2 ^ k + 2 * i ≤ (j_nat k + 1) * 2 ^ k := by
          have h_id : (j_nat k + 1) * 2 ^ k = (j_nat k - 1) * 2 ^ k + 2 * 2 ^ k := by
            have hj_eq : j_nat k + 1 = (j_nat k - 1) + 2 := by omega
            rw [hj_eq, Nat.add_mul]
          linarith
        have h_le2 : (j_nat k + 1) * 2 ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (2 * k + k₀) := by
          have h_exp : 2 * k + k₀ = (k + k₀) + k := by omega
          rw [h_exp, Nat.pow_add]
          exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ k) hj1_lt_M.le
        exact le_trans h_le1 h_le2
      · dsimp [u_grid, t_seq, r_seq]
        push_cast
        rw [hj_sub_cast, hM_cast]
        have h_exp : 2 * k + k₀ = k + k + k₀ := by omega
        rw [h_exp, pow_add, pow_add]
        field_simp
        ring
    exact ⟨hu_dyad, hu_ge_r, hu_le_t, hu_abs⟩

  have h_half_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

  have hη_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => t_seq k - r_seq k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h1 := h_half_lim.const_mul (2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀)
    rw [mul_zero] at h1
    exact h1.congr (fun k => ((h_grid k).2.2.2.2.2.2.1).symm)

  let e_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => path.a_path u - path.b_path u
  let e_min : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (Finset.range (2 ^ k + 1)).inf' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ _)⟩
      (fun i => e_fn (u_grid k i))
  let D_link : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun k i =>
    |path.b_path (u_grid k i) - path.b_path (u_grid k (i + 1))| +
    |path.a_path (u_grid k i) - path.a_path (u_grid k (i + 1))| +
    (u_grid k (i + 1) - u_grid k i)
  let D_max : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (Finset.range (2 ^ k)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by positivity)⟩ (D_link k)
  let X_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    path.K_coh * D_max k + (t_seq k - r_seq k) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
  let d_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => max (e_min k - X_seq k) 0

  have h_d_props : ∀ k : ℕ,
      0 ≤ e_min k ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ 2 ^ k → e_min k ≤ e_fn (u_grid k i)) ∧
      0 ≤ d_seq k ∧ d_seq k ≤ e_min k ∧
      d_seq k ≤ e_fn (r_seq k) ∧ d_seq k ≤ e_fn (t_seq k) ∧
      0 ≤ e_min k - d_seq k ∧ e_min k - d_seq k ≤ X_seq k ∧
      (0 < d_seq k → ∀ i : ℕ, i < 2 ^ k →
        u_grid k i < u_grid k (i + 1) ∧
        d_seq k < min (e_fn (u_grid k i)) (e_fn (u_grid k (i + 1))) -
          path.K_coh * D_link k i) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨_, _, hr0, hrx, hxt, ht1, _, hu0, hu_end, hu_all⟩ := h_grid k
    have hη_pos : 0 < t_seq k - r_seq k := sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hrx hxt)
    have he_le : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ 2 ^ k → e_min k ≤ e_fn (u_grid k i) := by
      intro i hi
      exact Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    have he_nn : 0 ≤ e_min k := by
      refine Finset.le_inf' _ _ (fun i hi => ?_)
      have hi_le : i ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      obtain ⟨_, hur, hut, _⟩ := hu_all i hi_le
      exact h_ba_nn (u_grid k i) ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hr0 hur, le_trans hut ht1.le⟩
    have h_step_pos : ∀ i : ℕ, u_grid k i < u_grid k (i + 1) := by
      intro i
      have h_diff : u_grid k (i + 1) - u_grid k i = (t_seq k - r_seq k) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        dsimp [u_grid]
        push_cast
        ring
      have h_pos : 0 < (t_seq k - r_seq k) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := div_pos hη_pos (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hD0_pos : 0 < D_link k 0 := by
      dsimp [D_link]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ |path.b_path (u_grid k 0) - path.b_path (u_grid k 1)| := abs_nonneg _
      have h2 : 0 ≤ |path.a_path (u_grid k 0) - path.a_path (u_grid k 1)| := abs_nonneg _
      have h3 := h_step_pos 0
      linarith
    have hDmax_pos : 0 < D_max k :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hD0_pos (Finset.le_sup' (D_link k) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by positivity)))
    have h_slack_pos : 0 < (t_seq k - r_seq k) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) :=
      div_pos hη_pos (by positivity)
    have hX_pos : 0 < X_seq k :=
      add_pos (mul_pos path.hK_coh hDmax_pos) h_slack_pos
    have hd_nn : 0 ≤ d_seq k := le_max_right _ _
    have hd_le_emin : d_seq k ≤ e_min k :=
      max_le (by linarith) he_nn
    have hd_le_r : d_seq k ≤ e_fn (r_seq k) := by
      calc d_seq k ≤ e_min k := hd_le_emin
        _ ≤ e_fn (u_grid k 0) := he_le 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
        _ = e_fn (r_seq k) := by rw [hu0]
    have hd_le_t : d_seq k ≤ e_fn (t_seq k) := by
      calc d_seq k ≤ e_min k := hd_le_emin
        _ ≤ e_fn (u_grid k (2 ^ k)) := he_le (2 ^ k) le_rfl
        _ = e_fn (t_seq k) := by rw [hu_end]
    have h_diff_ub : e_min k - d_seq k ≤ X_seq k := by
      have h1 : e_min k - X_seq k ≤ d_seq k := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
    refine ⟨he_nn, he_le, hd_nn, hd_le_emin, hd_le_r, hd_le_t,
      sub_nonneg.mpr hd_le_emin, h_diff_ub, ?_⟩
    intro hd_pos i hi
    have hd_eq : d_seq k = e_min k - X_seq k := by
      dsimp [d_seq] at hd_pos ⊢
      rcases le_or_gt (e_min k - X_seq k) 0 with hle | hgt
      · rw [max_eq_right hle] at hd_pos
        exact absurd hd_pos (lt_irrefl 0)
      · exact max_eq_left hgt.le
    have hDi_le : D_link k i ≤ D_max k :=
      Finset.le_sup' (D_link k) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi)
    have hKDi_le : path.K_coh * D_link k i ≤ path.K_coh * D_max k :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDi_le path.hK_coh.le
    have he_min_pair : e_min k ≤ min (e_fn (u_grid k i)) (e_fn (u_grid k (i + 1))) :=
      le_min (he_le i hi.le) (he_le (i + 1) hi)
    refine ⟨h_step_pos i, ?_⟩
    rw [hd_eq]
    dsimp [X_seq]
    linarith

  have hS_unif : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K₀ ≤ k → ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 ^ k →
      |(path.S_path (r_seq k + ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) * (t_seq k - r_seq k)) -
          path.S_path (r_seq k)) / (t_seq k - r_seq k) -
        s * ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k)| ≤ δ := by
    intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ_pos, hρ⟩ := h_lin path.S_path s hS_deriv (δ / 2) (half_pos hδ)
    have h_ev := hη_lim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hρ_pos)
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_ev
    obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩ := h_ev
    refine ⟨K₀, fun k hk l hl => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hrx, hxt, _, _, hu0, _, hu_all⟩ := h_grid k
    have hη_pos : 0 < t_seq k - r_seq k := sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hrx hxt)
    have hη_lt : t_seq k - r_seq k < ρ := hK₀ k hk
    have hq_abs : |u_grid k l - x₀| < t_seq k - r_seq k := (hu_all l hl).2.2.2
    have hr_abs : |r_seq k - x₀| < t_seq k - r_seq k := by
      have h0 := (hu_all 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).2.2.2
      rwa [hu0] at h0
    have h1 := hρ (u_grid k l) (lt_trans hq_abs hη_lt)
    have h2 := hρ (r_seq k) (lt_trans hr_abs hη_lt)
    have h_diff_u : u_grid k l - r_seq k = ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) := by
      dsimp [u_grid]
      ring
    have h_num : |(path.S_path (u_grid k l) - path.S_path (r_seq k)) -
        (s * ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k)) * (t_seq k - r_seq k)| ≤ δ * (t_seq k - r_seq k) := by
      have h_id : (path.S_path (u_grid k l) - path.S_path (r_seq k)) -
          (s * ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k)) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) =
          (path.S_path (u_grid k l) - path.S_path x₀ - (u_grid k l - x₀) * s) -
          (path.S_path (r_seq k) - path.S_path x₀ - (r_seq k - x₀) * s) := by
        dsimp [u_grid]
        ring
      rw [h_id]
      have h_tri := abs_sub (path.S_path (u_grid k l) - path.S_path x₀ - (u_grid k l - x₀) * s)
        (path.S_path (r_seq k) - path.S_path x₀ - (r_seq k - x₀) * s)
      have hb1 : (δ / 2) * |u_grid k l - x₀| ≤ (δ / 2) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_abs.le (by positivity)
      have hb2 : (δ / 2) * |r_seq k - x₀| ≤ (δ / 2) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_abs.le (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h_div : |(path.S_path (u_grid k l) - path.S_path (r_seq k)) / (t_seq k - r_seq k) -
        s * ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k)| ≤ δ := by
      have h_eq : (path.S_path (u_grid k l) - path.S_path (r_seq k)) / (t_seq k - r_seq k) -
          s * ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) =
          ((path.S_path (u_grid k l) - path.S_path (r_seq k)) -
            (s * ((l : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k)) * (t_seq k - r_seq k)) / (t_seq k - r_seq k) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hη_pos]
      rw [h_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hη_pos, div_le_iff₀ hη_pos]
      exact h_num
    exact h_div

  have hD_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => D_max k / (t_seq k - r_seq k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨ρ_b, hρb_pos, hρb⟩ := h_lin path.b_path b' hb_deriv (ε / 8) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨ρ_a, hρa_pos, hρa⟩ := h_lin path.a_path a' ha_deriv (ε / 8) (by positivity)
    have h_ev1 := hη_lim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (lt_min hρb_pos hρa_pos))
    have h_pow_mul : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (|b'| + |a'| + 1) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_half_lim.const_mul (|b'| + |a'| + 1)
    have h_ev2 := h_pow_mul.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (half_pos hε))
    have h_ev := h_ev1.and h_ev2
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_ev
    obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩ := h_ev
    refine ⟨K₀, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hη_lt, hpow_lt⟩ := hK₀ k hk
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hrx, hxt, _, _, _, _, hu_all⟩ := h_grid k
    have hη_pos : 0 < t_seq k - r_seq k := sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hrx hxt)
    have h_ne_links : (Finset.range (2 ^ k)).Nonempty :=
      ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by positivity)⟩
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀_mem, hi₀_eq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' h_ne_links (D_link k)
    have hi₀ : i₀ < 2 ^ k := Finset.mem_range.mp hi₀_mem
    let u₁ := u_grid k i₀
    let u₂ := u_grid k (i₀ + 1)
    have hu₁_abs : |u₁ - x₀| < t_seq k - r_seq k := (hu_all i₀ hi₀.le).2.2.2
    have hu₂_abs : |u₂ - x₀| < t_seq k - r_seq k := (hu_all (i₀ + 1) hi₀).2.2.2
    have hu_step : u₂ - u₁ = ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k * (t_seq k - r_seq k) := by
      dsimp [u₁, u₂, u_grid]
      rw [one_div_pow]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hu_step_pos : 0 < u₂ - u₁ := by
      rw [hu_step]
      positivity
    have hb1 := hρb u₁ (lt_trans hu₁_abs (lt_of_lt_of_le hη_lt (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hb2 := hρb u₂ (lt_trans hu₂_abs (lt_of_lt_of_le hη_lt (min_le_left _ _)))
    have ha1 := hρa u₁ (lt_trans hu₁_abs (lt_of_lt_of_le hη_lt (min_le_right _ _)))
    have ha2 := hρa u₂ (lt_trans hu₂_abs (lt_of_lt_of_le hη_lt (min_le_right _ _)))
    have hb_diff : |path.b_path u₁ - path.b_path u₂| ≤
        (ε / 4) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) + |b'| * (u₂ - u₁) := by
      have h_id : path.b_path u₁ - path.b_path u₂ =
          (path.b_path u₁ - path.b_path x₀ - (u₁ - x₀) * b') -
          (path.b_path u₂ - path.b_path x₀ - (u₂ - x₀) * b') + (u₁ - u₂) * b' := by ring
      rw [h_id]
      have ht1 := abs_add_le
        ((path.b_path u₁ - path.b_path x₀ - (u₁ - x₀) * b') -
          (path.b_path u₂ - path.b_path x₀ - (u₂ - x₀) * b'))
        ((u₁ - u₂) * b')
      have ht2 := abs_sub
        (path.b_path u₁ - path.b_path x₀ - (u₁ - x₀) * b')
        (path.b_path u₂ - path.b_path x₀ - (u₂ - x₀) * b')
      have ht3 : |(u₁ - u₂) * b'| = |b'| * (u₂ - u₁) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_sub_comm, abs_of_pos hu_step_pos, mul_comm]
      have hm1 : (ε / 8) * |u₁ - x₀| ≤ (ε / 8) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu₁_abs.le (by positivity)
      have hm2 : (ε / 8) * |u₂ - x₀| ≤ (ε / 8) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu₂_abs.le (by positivity)
      linarith
    have ha_diff : |path.a_path u₁ - path.a_path u₂| ≤
        (ε / 4) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) + |a'| * (u₂ - u₁) := by
      have h_id : path.a_path u₁ - path.a_path u₂ =
          (path.a_path u₁ - path.a_path x₀ - (u₁ - x₀) * a') -
          (path.a_path u₂ - path.a_path x₀ - (u₂ - x₀) * a') + (u₁ - u₂) * a' := by ring
      rw [h_id]
      have ht1 := abs_add_le
        ((path.a_path u₁ - path.a_path x₀ - (u₁ - x₀) * a') -
          (path.a_path u₂ - path.a_path x₀ - (u₂ - x₀) * a'))
        ((u₁ - u₂) * a')
      have ht2 := abs_sub
        (path.a_path u₁ - path.a_path x₀ - (u₁ - x₀) * a')
        (path.a_path u₂ - path.a_path x₀ - (u₂ - x₀) * a')
      have ht3 : |(u₁ - u₂) * a'| = |a'| * (u₂ - u₁) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_sub_comm, abs_of_pos hu_step_pos, mul_comm]
      have hm1 : (ε / 8) * |u₁ - x₀| ≤ (ε / 8) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu₁_abs.le (by positivity)
      have hm2 : (ε / 8) * |u₂ - x₀| ≤ (ε / 8) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu₂_abs.le (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hD_nn : 0 ≤ D_max k := by
      dsimp only [D_max]
      rw [hi₀_eq]
      dsimp [D_link]
      linarith [abs_nonneg (path.b_path u₁ - path.b_path u₂),
        abs_nonneg (path.a_path u₁ - path.a_path u₂), hu_step_pos]
    have hD_ub : D_max k < ε * (t_seq k - r_seq k) := by
      dsimp only [D_max]
      rw [hi₀_eq]
      dsimp [D_link]
      change |path.b_path u₁ - path.b_path u₂| + |path.a_path u₁ - path.a_path u₂| + (u₂ - u₁) <
        ε * (t_seq k - r_seq k)
      have h_alg : (ε / 4) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) + |b'| * (u₂ - u₁) +
          ((ε / 4) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) + |a'| * (u₂ - u₁)) + (u₂ - u₁) =
          ((|b'| + |a'| + 1) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k + ε / 2) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) := by
        rw [hu_step]
        ring
      have h_prod_lt : ((|b'| + |a'| + 1) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ k + ε / 2) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) <
          ε * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) hη_pos
      linarith
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hD_nn hη_pos.le),
      div_lt_iff₀ hη_pos]
    exact hD_ub

  have hX_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => X_seq k / (t_seq k - r_seq k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun k : ℕ => path.K_coh * (D_max k / (t_seq k - r_seq k)) + 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (hD_lim.const_mul path.K_coh).add tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    refine h1.congr (fun k => ?_)
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hrx, hxt, _⟩ := h_grid k
    have hη_pos : 0 < t_seq k - r_seq k := sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hrx hxt)
    dsimp [X_seq]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hη_pos]

  have he_rem_lim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun k => (e_min k - d_seq k) / (t_seq k - r_seq k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hX_lim
      (fun k => ?_) (fun k => ?_)
    · obtain ⟨_, _, _, hrx, hxt, _⟩ := h_grid k
      exact div_nonneg (h_d_props k).2.2.2.2.2.2.1 (sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hrx hxt)).le
    · obtain ⟨_, _, _, hrx, hxt, _⟩ := h_grid k
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (h_d_props k).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
        (sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hrx hxt)).le

  have he_min_lim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun k => (e_fn (t_seq k) - e_min k) / (t_seq k - r_seq k))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (max (a' - b') 0)) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    have he_deriv : HasDerivAt e_fn (a' - b') x₀ := ha_deriv.sub hb_deriv
    obtain ⟨ρ_e, hρe_pos, hρe⟩ := h_lin e_fn (a' - b') he_deriv (ε / 3) (by positivity)
    have h_ev := hη_lim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hρe_pos)
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_ev
    obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩ := h_ev
    refine ⟨K₀, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    have hη_lt : t_seq k - r_seq k < ρ_e := hK₀ k hk
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hrx, hxt, _, _, hu0, hu_end, hu_all⟩ := h_grid k
    have hη_pos : 0 < t_seq k - r_seq k := sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hrx hxt)
    have ht_abs : |t_seq k - x₀| < t_seq k - r_seq k := by
      have h1 := (hu_all (2 ^ k) le_rfl).2.2.2
      rwa [hu_end] at h1
    have hr_abs : |r_seq k - x₀| < t_seq k - r_seq k := by
      have h1 := (hu_all 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).2.2.2
      rwa [hu0] at h1
    have h_et := hρe (t_seq k) (lt_trans ht_abs hη_lt)
    have h_er := hρe (r_seq k) (lt_trans hr_abs hη_lt)
    have h_ne_pts : (Finset.range (2 ^ k + 1)).Nonempty :=
      ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ _)⟩
    obtain ⟨i_star, hi_star_mem, hi_star_eq⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' h_ne_pts (fun i => e_fn (u_grid k i))
    have hi_star : i_star ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi_star_mem)
    obtain ⟨_, hu_star_ge_r, hu_star_le_t, hu_star_abs⟩ := hu_all i_star hi_star
    have h_estar := hρe (u_grid k i_star) (lt_trans hu_star_abs hη_lt)
    have h_ub : e_fn (t_seq k) - e_min k ≤
        (max (a' - b') 0 + 2 * ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) := by
      dsimp only [e_min]
      rw [hi_star_eq]
      have h_id : e_fn (t_seq k) - e_fn (u_grid k i_star) =
          (e_fn (t_seq k) - e_fn x₀ - (t_seq k - x₀) * (a' - b')) -
          (e_fn (u_grid k i_star) - e_fn x₀ - (u_grid k i_star - x₀) * (a' - b')) +
          (t_seq k - u_grid k i_star) * (a' - b') := by ring
      have ht_le1 : e_fn (t_seq k) - e_fn x₀ - (t_seq k - x₀) * (a' - b') ≤
          (ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        le_trans (le_abs_self _) (le_trans h_et
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_abs.le (by positivity)))
      have hs_le1 : -(e_fn (u_grid k i_star) - e_fn x₀ - (u_grid k i_star - x₀) * (a' - b')) ≤
          (ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
        le_trans (neg_le_abs _) (le_trans h_estar
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_star_abs.le (by positivity)))
      have h_slope_le : (t_seq k - u_grid k i_star) * (a' - b') ≤
          (t_seq k - r_seq k) * max (a' - b') 0 := by
        have h_diff_nn : 0 ≤ t_seq k - u_grid k i_star := sub_nonneg.mpr hu_star_le_t
        have h_diff_le : t_seq k - u_grid k i_star ≤ t_seq k - r_seq k := by linarith
        calc (t_seq k - u_grid k i_star) * (a' - b')
            ≤ (t_seq k - u_grid k i_star) * max (a' - b') 0 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) h_diff_nn
          _ ≤ (t_seq k - r_seq k) * max (a' - b') 0 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_diff_le (le_max_right _ _)
      linarith
    have h_lb : (max (a' - b') 0 - 2 * ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) ≤
        e_fn (t_seq k) - e_min k := by
      have he_le_r : e_min k ≤ e_fn (r_seq k) := by
        have h1 := (h_d_props k).2.1 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
        rwa [hu0] at h1
      have he_le_t : e_min k ≤ e_fn (t_seq k) := by
        have h1 := (h_d_props k).2.1 (2 ^ k) le_rfl
        rwa [hu_end] at h1
      have h_lb1 : ((a' - b') - 2 * ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) ≤
          e_fn (t_seq k) - e_min k := by
        have ht_ge : -((ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k)) ≤
            e_fn (t_seq k) - e_fn x₀ - (t_seq k - x₀) * (a' - b') := by
          have h1 := (abs_le.mp h_et).1
          have h2 : (ε / 3) * |t_seq k - x₀| ≤ (ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_abs.le (by positivity)
          linarith
        have hr_le : e_fn (r_seq k) - e_fn x₀ - (r_seq k - x₀) * (a' - b') ≤
            (ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) :=
          le_trans (le_abs_self _) (le_trans h_er
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_abs.le (by positivity)))
        have h_id : e_fn (t_seq k) - e_fn (r_seq k) =
            (e_fn (t_seq k) - e_fn x₀ - (t_seq k - x₀) * (a' - b')) -
            (e_fn (r_seq k) - e_fn x₀ - (r_seq k - x₀) * (a' - b')) +
            (t_seq k - r_seq k) * (a' - b') := by ring
        linarith
      have h_lb2 : (0 - 2 * ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) ≤ e_fn (t_seq k) - e_min k := by
        have h_neg : (0 - 2 * ε / 3) * (t_seq k - r_seq k) ≤ 0 :=
          mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hη_pos.le
        linarith
      rcases max_choice (a' - b') 0 with hmax | hmax <;> rw [hmax]
      · exact h_lb1
      · exact h_lb2
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have h_abs_le : |(e_fn (t_seq k) - e_min k) / (t_seq k - r_seq k) - max (a' - b') 0| ≤
        2 * ε / 3 := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, le_div_iff₀ hη_pos]
        linarith
      · rw [sub_le_iff_le_add, div_le_iff₀ hη_pos]
        linarith
    linarith

  have he_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
      ((path.a_path (t_seq k) - path.b_path (t_seq k)) - d_seq k) / (t_seq k - r_seq k))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (max (a' - b') 0)) := by
    have h_sum := he_min_lim.add he_rem_lim
    rw [add_zero] at h_sum
    refine h_sum.congr (fun k => ?_)
    dsimp [e_fn]
    ring

  
  
  
  let cyclicWindow : ℤ → ℤ → ℕ → Finset ℤ := fun M a R =>
    (Finset.Icc (-(R : ℤ)) (R : ℤ)).image (fun q => (a + q) % M)

  have h_ang0 : ∀ (ε θ : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi → angBin ε 0 θ = 0 := by
    intro ε θ hθ
    unfold angBin dyadicTimeLevel
    have h_ceil : ⌈ε ^ (-(0 : ℝ))⌉₊ = 1 := by simp
    rw [h_ceil]
    have h_clog : Nat.clog 2 1 = 0 := by decide
    rw [h_clog]
    simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, sub_self, min_eq_right_iff]
    have h_fl : ⌊θ / Real.pi⌋ = 0 := by
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_add]
      exact ⟨div_nonneg hθ.1 Real.pi_pos.le, (div_lt_one Real.pi_pos).mpr hθ.2⟩
    rw [h_fl]

  have h_level_bd : ∀ (ε d : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ d →
      ((2 ^ dyadicTimeLevel ε d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-d) := by
    intro ε d hε0 hε_half hd0
    have hε1 : ε < 1 := lt_trans hε_half (by norm_num)
    have h_rpow_ge1 : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-d) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ ≤ ε ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε0 hε1.le (by linarith)
    set n := ⌈ε ^ (-d)⌉₊
    set m := dyadicTimeLevel ε d
    have hn_lt : (n : ℝ) < 2 * ε ^ (-d) := by
      have h1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith : 0 ≤ ε ^ (-d))
      linarith
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hm_pos
    · rw [hm0]
      simp only [pow_zero, Nat.cast_one]
      linarith
    · have hm_lt : m - 1 < Nat.clog 2 n := by
        change m - 1 < m
        omega
      have h_pow_lt : 2 ^ (m - 1) < n := Nat.pow_lt_of_lt_clog hm_lt
      have h_pow_eq : 2 ^ m = 2 * 2 ^ (m - 1) := by
        have hm_eq : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
        nth_rw 1 [hm_eq]
        rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
      have h_nat_le : 2 ^ m ≤ 2 * n := by omega
      have h_real_le : ((2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_nat_le
      linarith

  have h_ang_range : ∀ (ε d θ : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
      0 ≤ angBin ε d θ ∧ angBin ε d θ < (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d) := by
    intro ε d θ hθ
    dsimp only [angBin]
    set m := dyadicTimeLevel ε d
    have h_fl_nn : 0 ≤ ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ :=
      Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hθ.1 Real.pi_pos.le) (by positivity))
    have h_pow_ge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    constructor
    · exact le_min h_fl_nn (by omega)
    · have h_le : min ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1) ≤ (2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 :=
        min_le_right _ _
      omega

  have h_ang_div : ∀ (ε d e θ : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ d → d ≤ e →
      angBin ε d θ =
        angBin ε e θ / (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e - dyadicTimeLevel ε d) := by
    intro ε d e θ hε0 hε_half hd0 hde
    have hε1 : ε < 1 := lt_trans hε_half (by norm_num)
    have h_rpow_le : ε ^ (-d) ≤ ε ^ (-e) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε0 hε1.le (by linarith)
    have hmd_le : dyadicTimeLevel ε d ≤ dyadicTimeLevel ε e :=
      Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (Nat.ceil_mono h_rpow_le)
    set m_d := dyadicTimeLevel ε d
    set m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
    set k := m_e - m_d
    have hme_eq : m_e = m_d + k := (Nat.add_sub_of_le hmd_le).symm
    set q : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ k
    have hq_ge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ q := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hq_pos : (0 : ℤ) < q := by omega
    have h_ediv_mono : ∀ u v : ℤ, u ≤ v → u / q ≤ v / q := by
      intro u v huv
      rw [Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hq_pos]
      exact le_trans ((Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hq_pos).mp le_rfl) huv
    have h_min_div : ∀ u v : ℤ, min u v / q = min (u / q) (v / q) := by
      intro u v
      rcases le_total u v with huv | hvu
      · rw [min_eq_left huv, min_eq_left (h_ediv_mono u v huv)]
      · rw [min_eq_right hvu, min_eq_right (h_ediv_mono v u hvu)]
    have h_fl_div : ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e⌋ / q =
        ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d⌋ := by
      set x := (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d
      have h_x_mul : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e = x * (q : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [x, q]
        rw [hme_eq, pow_add, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_ofNat, mul_assoc]
      rw [h_x_mul]
      have hq_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq_pos
      refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
      · set y := ⌊x * (q : ℝ)⌋ / q
        have hyq : y * q ≤ ⌊x * (q : ℝ)⌋ := (Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hq_pos).mp le_rfl
        have hyq_real : (y : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ≤ x * (q : ℝ) := by
          calc (y : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) = ((y * q : ℤ) : ℝ) := (Int.cast_mul y q).symm
            _ ≤ (⌊x * (q : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hyq
            _ ≤ x * (q : ℝ) := Int.floor_le _
        have hy_le : (y : ℝ) ≤ x := le_of_mul_le_mul_right hyq_real hq_real_pos
        exact Int.le_floor.mpr hy_le
      · rw [Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hq_pos]
        refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
        rw [Int.cast_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Int.floor_le x) hq_real_pos.le
    have h_cap_div : ((2 ^ m_e : ℤ) - 1) / q = (2 ^ m_d : ℤ) - 1 := by
      have h_pow_z : (2 : ℤ) ^ m_e = (2 : ℤ) ^ m_d * q := by
        dsimp [q]
        rw [hme_eq, pow_add]
      refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
      · set y := ((2 ^ m_e : ℤ) - 1) / q
        have hyq : y * q ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m_d * q - 1 := by
          rw [← h_pow_z]
          exact (Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hq_pos).mp le_rfl
        have hy_lt : y < (2 : ℤ) ^ m_d := by nlinarith
        omega
      · rw [Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hq_pos, h_pow_z]
        nlinarith
    unfold angBin
    change min ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d⌋ ((2 ^ m_d : ℤ) - 1) =
      min ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e⌋ ((2 ^ m_e : ℤ) - 1) / q
    rw [h_min_div, h_fl_div, h_cap_div]

  have h_cyc_tri : ∀ (M a b c : ℤ), 1 ≤ M →
      0 ≤ a → a < M → 0 ≤ b → b < M → 0 ≤ c → c < M →
      cyclicBinDist M a c ≤ cyclicBinDist M a b + cyclicBinDist M b c := by
    intro M a b c hM ha0 haM hb0 hbM hc0 hcM
    unfold cyclicBinDist
    rcases abs_cases (a - b) with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩ <;>
      rcases abs_cases (b - c) with ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ <;>
      rcases abs_cases (a - c) with ⟨h3, _⟩ | ⟨h3, _⟩ <;>
      rw [h1, h2, h3] <;> omega

  have h_cyc_win_card : ∀ (M a : ℤ) (R : ℕ), (cyclicWindow M a R).card ≤ 2 * R + 1 := by
    intro M a R
    dsimp [cyclicWindow]
    calc ((Finset.Icc (-(R : ℤ)) (R : ℤ)).image (fun q => (a + q) % M)).card
        ≤ (Finset.Icc (-(R : ℤ)) (R : ℤ)).card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = 2 * R + 1 := by
          rw [Int.card_Icc]
          omega

  have h_cyc_win_mem : ∀ (M a b : ℤ) (R : ℕ),
      1 ≤ M → 0 ≤ a → a < M → 0 ≤ b → b < M →
      cyclicBinDist M a b ≤ (R : ℤ) → b ∈ cyclicWindow M a R := by
    intro M a b R hM ha0 haM hb0 hbM h_dist
    dsimp [cyclicWindow]
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    have hb_mod : b % M = b := Int.emod_eq_of_lt hb0 hbM
    unfold cyclicBinDist at h_dist
    rcases min_le_iff.mp h_dist with hab | hMab
    · refine ⟨b - a, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases abs_cases (a - b) with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩ <;> omega
      · have h_eq : a + (b - a) = b := by ring
        rw [h_eq, hb_mod]
    · rcases le_or_gt a b with h_le | h_gt
      · have hab_eq : |a - b| = b - a := by
          rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]
        rw [hab_eq] at hMab
        refine ⟨b - a - M, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
        have h_eq : a + (b - a - M) = b - M := by ring
        rw [h_eq, Int.sub_emod_right, hb_mod]
      · have hab_eq : |a - b| = a - b := abs_of_nonneg (by omega)
        rw [hab_eq] at hMab
        refine ⟨b - a + M, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
        have h_eq : a + (b - a + M) = b + M := by ring
        rw [h_eq, Int.add_emod_right, hb_mod]

  
  
  
  have h_log_inv_pos : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε0 hε_half
    refine Real.log_pos ?_
    rw [one_lt_inv₀ hε0]
    linarith

  have h_prob_bounds : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ π ω') → 0 < π ω →
      0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω ∧ finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
    intro N_ω α β π X Y ω hπ_nn hω_pos
    have h_le1 : π ω ≤ finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
      dsimp only [finProbAt2]
      refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum ?_ (Finset.mem_univ ω))
      · split_ifs with h
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ h
      · intro ω' _
        split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω']
    have h_le2 : finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
      unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω
      · by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω
        · simp [hX, hY]
        · simp [hX, hY, hπ_nn ω']
      · simp [hX]
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos h_le1, h_le2⟩

  have h_ent_nn : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
    intro N_ω α β ε π X Y hε0 hε_half hπ_nn
    have hell_pos := h_log_inv_pos ε hε0 hε_half
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hπ_nn ω) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0, zero_mul]
    · obtain ⟨hp2_pos, hp2_le⟩ := h_prob_bounds π X Y ω hπ_nn hpos
      have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_pos hp2_le
      unfold condSurprise
      have h_rat_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω := div_pos hp2_pos hp1_pos
      have h_rat_le1 : finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω ≤ 1 :=
        (div_le_one hp1_pos).mpr hp2_le
      have h_log_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) ≤ 0 :=
        Real.log_nonpos h_rat_pos.le h_rat_le1
      exact mul_nonneg hpos.le (div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr h_log_np) hell_pos.le)

  have h_ent_const : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (y₀ : β),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → Y ω = y₀) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y = 0 := by
    intro N_ω α β ε π X Y y₀ hπ_nn hY_const
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω _ => ?_)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hπ_nn ω) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0, zero_mul]
    · obtain ⟨hp2_pos, hp2_le⟩ := h_prob_bounds π X Y ω hπ_nn hpos
      have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_pos hp2_le
      have h_eq : finProbAt2 π X Y ω = finProbAt π X ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hπ_nn ω') with h0' | hpos'
        · rw [← h0']
          split_ifs <;> rfl
        · have hY1 := hY_const ω' hpos'
          have hY2 := hY_const ω hpos
          rw [hY1, hY2]
          by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> simp [hX]
      unfold condSurprise
      rw [h_eq, div_self (ne_of_gt hp1_pos), Real.log_one, neg_zero, zero_div, mul_zero]

  have h_ent_dp : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β₁ β₂ : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂) (g : β₁ → β₂),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → Y₂ ω = g (Y₁ ω)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y₂ ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y₁ := by
    intro N_ω α β₁ β₂ ε π X Y₁ Y₂ g hε0 hε_half hπ_nn hg
    have hell_pos := h_log_inv_pos ε hε0 hε_half
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hπ_nn ω) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · obtain ⟨hp21_pos, hp21_le⟩ := h_prob_bounds π X Y₁ ω hπ_nn hpos
      have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp21_pos hp21_le
      have hp21_le_22 : finProbAt2 π X Y₁ ω ≤ finProbAt2 π X Y₂ ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hπ_nn ω') with h0' | hpos'
        · rw [← h0']
          split_ifs <;> linarith
        · by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω
          · by_cases hY1 : Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω
            · have hY2 : Y₂ ω' = Y₂ ω := by rw [hg ω' hpos', hg ω hpos, hY1]
              simp [hX, hY1, hY2]
            · simp [hX, hY1]
              split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω']
          · simp [hX]
      unfold condSurprise
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hpos.le
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hell_pos.le
      refine neg_le_neg ?_
      exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos hp21_pos hp1_pos)
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hp21_le_22 hp1_pos.le)

  have h_ent_sub : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (A : Fin N_ω → γ_t) (B : Fin N_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X B ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π X A +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, A ω)) B := by
    intro N_ω α β γ_t ε π X A B hε0 hε_half hπ_nn
    have h_dp := h_ent_dp ε π X (fun ω => (A ω, B ω)) B Prod.snd hε0 hε_half hπ_nn
      (fun _ _ => rfl)
    refine le_trans h_dp ?_
    suffices h_eq : finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω => (A ω, B ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π X A + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, A ω)) B by
      linarith
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hπ_nn ω) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0, zero_mul, zero_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
    · obtain ⟨hpXAB_pos, hpXAB_le⟩ :=
        h_prob_bounds π X (fun ω' => (A ω', B ω')) ω hπ_nn hpos
      obtain ⟨hpXA_pos, hpXA_le⟩ := h_prob_bounds π X A ω hπ_nn hpos
      have hpX_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hpXA_pos hpXA_le
      have h_eq1 : finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', A ω')) ω = finProbAt2 π X A ω := by
        unfold finProbAt finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hA : A ω' = A ω <;> simp [hX, hA]
      have h_eq2 : finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', A ω')) B ω =
          finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (A ω', B ω')) ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hA : A ω' = A ω <;>
          by_cases hB : B ω' = B ω <;> simp [hX, hA, hB]
      unfold condSurprise
      rw [h_eq1, h_eq2]
      have h_prod : finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (A ω', B ω')) ω / finProbAt π X ω =
          (finProbAt2 π X A ω / finProbAt π X ω) *
          (finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (A ω', B ω')) ω / finProbAt2 π X A ω) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hpX_pos, ne_of_gt hpXA_pos]
      rw [h_prod, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpXA_pos hpX_pos))
        (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpXAB_pos hpXA_pos))]
      ring

  have h_ent_amb : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
      (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N_ω → α) (B : Fin N_ω → β)
      (S_all : Finset β) (S_good : α → Finset β) (N M : ℕ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      1 ≤ N → 1 ≤ M →
      S_all.card ≤ M → (∀ w, (S_good w).card ≤ N) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → B ω ∈ S_all) →
      finCondEntropy ε π W B ≤
        (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N : ℝ) +
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if B ω ∉ S_good (W ω) then π ω else 0) * Real.log (M : ℝ)) /
          Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro N_ω α β _ _ ε π W B S_all S_good N M hε0 hε_half hπ_nn hπ_sum hN1 hM1
      hSall_card hSgood_card hB_all
    have hell_pos := h_log_inv_pos ε hε0 hε_half
    have hN_pos : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hM_pos : 0 < (M : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hN_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN1
    let Ω_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)
    have h_zero_out : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ω ∉ Ω_pos → π ω = 0 := by
      intro ω hnot
      simp only [Ω_pos, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_lt] at hnot
      exact le_antisymm hnot (hπ_nn ω)
    have hΩ_sum : ∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω = 1 := by
      rw [← hπ_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ Ω_pos) (fun ω _ hnot => h_zero_out ω hnot)
    have hζ_eq : (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, if B ω ∉ S_good (W ω) then π ω else 0) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if B ω ∉ S_good (W ω) then π ω else 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ Ω_pos) (fun ω _ hnot => ?_)
      rw [h_zero_out ω hnot]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    let c : α → β → ℝ := fun w b =>
      if b ∈ S_good w then 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ)) else 1 / (2 * (M : ℝ))
    have hc_pos : ∀ w b, 0 < c w b := by
      intro w b
      dsimp [c]
      split_ifs <;> positivity
    let x_fn : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
      c (W ω) (B ω) * finProbAt π W ω / finProbAt2 π W B ω
    have h_ent_Ω : finCondEntropy ε π W B =
        (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π W B ω / finProbAt π W ω))) /
          Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      have h_sub : (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos,
            π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π W B ω / finProbAt π W ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
            π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π W B ω / finProbAt π W ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
        calc (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos,
              π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π W B ω / finProbAt π W ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))
            = ∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos,
                π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π W B ω / finProbAt π W ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => mul_div_assoc _ _ _)
          _ = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
                π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π W B ω / finProbAt π W ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :=
              Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ Ω_pos) (fun ω _ hnot => by
                rw [h_zero_out ω hnot, zero_mul])
      exact h_sub.symm
    rw [h_ent_Ω]
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hell_pos.le
    have h_ptwise : ∀ ω ∈ Ω_pos,
        π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π W B ω / finProbAt π W ω)) ≤
          π ω * (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N : ℝ)) +
          (if B ω ∉ S_good (W ω) then π ω else 0) * Real.log (M : ℝ) +
          π ω * x_fn ω - π ω := by
      intro ω hω
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      obtain ⟨hpWB_pos, hpWB_le⟩ := h_prob_bounds π W B ω hπ_nn hω_pos

        have hell_pos := h_log_inv_pos (path.ε_seq n) hε_pos hε_half
        have h_lt_exp := hN₀ n hn
        have h_log_lt : Real.log (path.ε_seq n) < -(2 * C_k / η) :=
          (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp hε_pos).mpr h_lt_exp
        have h_ell_gt : 2 * C_k / η < Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) := by
          rw [Real.log_inv]
          linarith
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hCk_pos.le hell_pos.le),
          div_lt_iff₀ hell_pos]
        have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_ell_gt hη
        have h_id : η * (2 * C_k / η) = 2 * C_k := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hη]
        linarith
      have h_cond_ub_lim : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n => C_k / Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) + ζ_n n * d_seq k)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_log_term_lim.add (hζ_lim.mul_const (d_seq k))
      have h_total_ub_lim : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n => finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n) (X_n n) (A_n n) +
            (C_k / Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) + ζ_n n * d_seq k))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using hA_lim.add h_cond_ub_lim
      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds h_total_ub_lim
        (fun n => h_ent_nn (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n) (X_n n) (B_n n)
          (path.hε_bounds n).1 (path.hε_bounds n).2 (path.h_law n).1)
        (fun n => ?_)
      have h_sub := h_ent_sub (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n) (X_n n) (A_n n) (B_n n)
        (path.hε_bounds n).1 (path.hε_bounds n).2 (path.h_law n).1
      refine le_trans h_sub (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
      set m_n := dyadicTimeLevel (path.ε_seq n) (d_seq k)
      let S_all : Finset ℤ := Finset.Ico 0 (M_n n)
      let S_good : (Fin (path.N_T n) × ℤ) × ℤ → Finset ℤ :=
        fun w => cyclicWindow (M_n n) w.2 (2 ^ k)
      have hSall_card : S_all.card ≤ 2 ^ m_n := by
        dsimp [S_all, M_n]
        rw [Int.card_Ico, sub_zero]
        have h_eq : (2 : ℤ) ^ m_n = ((2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [h_eq, Int.toNat_natCast]
      have hB_in_all : ∀ ω, 0 < path.π_seq n ω → B_n n ω ∈ S_all := by
        intro ω hω
        obtain ⟨hb0, hbM⟩ := h_ang_range (path.ε_seq n) (d_seq k)
          (path.θ_time (t_seq k) n ω)
          ((path.h_law n).2.2.2.2 (t_seq k) ht_dyad ω hω)
        exact Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hb0, hbM⟩
      have h_amb := h_ent_amb (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n)
        (fun ω => (X_n n ω, A_n n ω)) (B_n n) S_all S_good N_good (2 ^ m_n)
        (path.hε_bounds n).1 (path.hε_bounds n).2 (path.h_law n).1 (path.h_law n).2.1
        (by dsimp [N_good]; omega) Nat.one_le_two_pow
        hSall_card (fun w => h_cyc_win_card (M_n n) w.2 (2 ^ k)) hB_in_all
      have hε_pos := (path.hε_bounds n).1
      have hε_half := (path.hε_bounds n).2
      have hell_pos := h_log_inv_pos (path.ε_seq n) hε_pos hε_half
      have h_lev := h_level_bd (path.ε_seq n) (d_seq k) hε_pos hε_half hd0
      have h_log_M : Real.log ((2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          Real.log 4 + d_seq k * Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) := by
        have h_pos1 : 0 < ((2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
        calc Real.log ((2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ)
            ≤ Real.log (4 * (path.ε_seq n) ^ (-d_seq k)) := Real.log_le_log h_pos1 h_lev
          _ = Real.log 4 + Real.log ((path.ε_seq n) ^ (-d_seq k)) :=
              Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _))
          _ = Real.log 4 + d_seq k * Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) := by
              rw [Real.log_rpow hε_pos, Real.log_inv]
              ring
      have hζ_nn : 0 ≤ ζ_n n :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [(path.h_law n).1 ω])
      have hζ_le1 : ζ_n n ≤ 1 := by
        calc ζ_n n ≤ ∑ ω : Fin (path.N_ω n), path.π_seq n ω :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [(path.h_law n).1 ω])
          _ = 1 := (path.h_law n).2.1
      have h_num_le : Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ) +
          ζ_n n * Real.log ((2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          C_k + (ζ_n n * d_seq k) * Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) := by
        have h1 : ζ_n n * Real.log ((2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
            ζ_n n * (Real.log 4 + d_seq k * Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log_M hζ_nn
        have h2 : ζ_n n * Real.log 4 ≤ 1 * Real.log 4 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hζ_le1 (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
        dsimp [C_k]
        linarith
      calc finCondEntropy (path.ε_seq n) (path.π_seq n) (fun ω => (X_n n ω, A_n n ω)) (B_n n)
          ≤ (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ) +
              ζ_n n * Real.log ((2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ)) / Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) := h_amb
        _ ≤ (C_k + (ζ_n n * d_seq k) * Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹)) /
              Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le hell_pos.le
        _ = C_k / Real.log ((path.ε_seq n)⁻¹) + ζ_n n * d_seq k := by
            rw [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (ne_of_gt hell_pos)]

  refine ⟨hm_nn, hs0, hs1, r_seq, t_seq, d_seq, ?_, hη_lim, he_lim, hS_unif, h_ang_ent⟩
  intro k
  obtain ⟨_, _, hr0, hrx, hxt, ht1, _, hu0, hu_end, hu_all⟩ := h_grid k
  obtain ⟨_, _, hd0, _, _, hd_le_t, _⟩ := h_d_props k
  have hr_dyad : IsPosDyadicUnit (r_seq k) := by
    have h1 := (hu_all 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1
    rwa [hu0] at h1
  have ht_dyad : IsPosDyadicUnit (t_seq k) := by
    have h1 := (hu_all (2 ^ k) le_rfl).1
    rwa [hu_end] at h1
  exact ⟨hr_dyad, ht_dyad, hr0, hrx, hxt, ht1, hd0, hd_le_t⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ {N_ω M : ℕ} {α_T α_C α_J : Type} [DecidableEq α_J]
      (ε δ_hom δ_trim lam : ℝ)
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (T : Fin N_ω → α_T)
      (J : Fin N_ω → α_J)
      (proj_C : α_J → α_C)
      (D : Fin M → Fin N_ω → ℤ)
      (d_target : Fin M → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < δ_hom → 0 < δ_trim → 0 < lam → lam < 1 →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      let B := fun ω => (T ω, proj_C (J ω))
      let ζ := finCondEntropy ε π B J
      let p_bad : ℝ := ∑ l : Fin M, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if δ_hom < |condSurprise ε π B (D l) ω - d_target l| then π ω else 0
      ∃ E : Finset (Fin N_ω),
        (∀ ω ∈ E, 0 < π ω) ∧
        1 - ((2 * (M : ℝ) + 1) * ζ / δ_trim + p_bad) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω ∧
        (0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω →
          finCondEntropy ε (restrictLaw π E) B J ≤ δ_trim) ∧
        (1 / 2 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω →
          ∃ G_cells : Finset α_J,
            (∀ j ∈ G_cells, 0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) ∧
            1 - lam ≤ ∑ j ∈ G_cells,
              (∑ ω ∈ E, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) / (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) ∧
            ∀ j ∈ G_cells, ∀ l : Fin M,
              let Q_j := restrictLaw π (E.filter (fun ω => J ω = j))
              let Ω_err := δ_hom + 2 * δ_trim +
                Real.log (2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) / ((∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) * lam ^ 2)) /
                  Real.log (ε⁻¹)
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
                if Ω_err < |condSurprise ε Q_j T (D l) ω - d_target l|
                then Q_j ω else 0) ≤ 2 * lam)) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_T : Type}
      (ε τ : ℝ) (N₁₂ N₂₁ : ℕ)
      (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T : Fin N_ω → α_T) (Y₁ Y₂ : Fin N_ω → ℤ)
      (lo₁₂ : ℤ → ℤ) (lo₂₁ : ℤ → ℤ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < τ → 1 ≤ N₁₂ → 1 ≤ N₂₁ →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → lo₁₂ (Y₁ ω) ≤ Y₂ ω ∧ Y₂ ω < lo₁₂ (Y₁ ω) + (N₁₂ : ℤ)) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → lo₂₁ (Y₂ ω) ≤ Y₁ ω ∧ Y₁ ω < lo₂₁ (Y₂ ω) + (N₂₁ : ℤ)) →
      let err := Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + τ
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if err < |condSurprise ε Q T Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q T Y₁ ω|
        then Q ω else 0) ≤ 2 * ε ^ τ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_ite_iff : ∀ {P Q : Prop} (dP : Decidable P) (dQ : Decidable Q) (a b : ℝ),
      (P ↔ Q) → @ite ℝ P dP a b = @ite ℝ Q dQ a b := by
    intro P Q dP dQ a b hPQ
    cases dP with
    | isTrue hP => cases dQ with
      | isTrue _ => rfl
      | isFalse hQ => exact absurd (hPQ.mp hP) hQ
    | isFalse hP => cases dQ with
      | isTrue hQ => exact absurd (hPQ.mpr hQ) hP
      | isFalse _ => rfl
  have h_div_mul_le : ∀ (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → (A / B) * B ≤ A := by
    intro A B hA
    by_cases hB : B = 0
    · rw [hB, mul_zero]; exact hA
    · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ A hB]
  have h_ell_pos : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁
    rw [Real.log_inv, neg_pos]
    exact Real.log_neg hε₀ (by linarith)
  have h_pos_nn : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
        0 < finProbAt π X ω ∧
        0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω ∧
        0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω) ∧
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
    intro N_ω α β ε π X Y hε₀ hε₁ hπ_nn
    have hℓ : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁
    have h_atom : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
        0 < finProbAt π X ω ∧
        0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω ∧
        0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω := by
      intro ω hπ_pos
      have h_le2 : π ω ≤ finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        calc π ω = (if X ω = X ω ∧ Y ω = Y ω then π ω else 0) := by simp
          _ ≤ ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then π ω' else 0 :=
            Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then π ω' else 0)
              (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
              (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      have h2_le_1 : finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : X ω' = X ω
        · by_cases h2 : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω']
        · simp [h1]
      have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_pos h_le2
      have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le h2_pos h2_le_1
      have h_surp_nn : 0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω := by
        unfold condSurprise
        have h_log_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) ≤ 0 :=
          Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg h2_pos.le h1_pos.le) ((div_le_one h1_pos).mpr h2_le_1)
        exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr h_log_np) hℓ.le
      exact ⟨h1_pos, h2_pos, h_surp_nn⟩
    refine ⟨h_atom, ?_⟩
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < π ω
    · exact mul_nonneg hpos.le (h_atom ω hpos).2.2
    · have hzero : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hπ_nn ω)
      simp [hzero]
  have h_kl_helper : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α₁ α₂ α_J : Type} (ε : ℝ)
      (u v : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (X₁ : Fin N_ω → α₁) (f : α₁ → α₂) (J : Fin N_ω → α_J),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ u ω) → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ v ω) → (∀ ω, 0 < u ω → 0 < v ω) →
      finCondEntropy ε u X₁ J ≤
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, u ω * condSurprise ε v (fun ω' => f (X₁ ω')) J ω := by
    intro N_ω α₁ α₂ α_J ε u v X₁ f J hε₀ hε₁ hu_nn hv_nn huv
    haveI : DecidableEq α₁ := Classical.decEq α₁
    haveI : DecidableEq α₂ := Classical.decEq α₂
    haveI : DecidableEq α_J := Classical.decEq α_J
    let X₂ : Fin N_ω → α₂ := fun ω' => f (X₁ ω')
    have hℓ : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁
    let S_u : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < u ω)
    have hu_zero_off : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S_u → u ω = 0 := by
      intro ω hω
      simp only [S_u, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_lt] at hω
      exact le_antisymm hω (hu_nn ω)
    have h_sum_Su : ∀ g : Fin N_ω → ℝ, (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, u ω * g ω) = ∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * g ω := by
      intro g
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_u)
        (fun ω _ hω => by rw [hu_zero_off ω hω, zero_mul])).symm
    let u1 : α₁ → ℝ := fun x₁ => ∑ ω' ∈ S_u, if X₁ ω' = x₁ then u ω' else 0
    let u1J : α₁ → α_J → ℝ := fun x₁ j => ∑ ω' ∈ S_u, if X₁ ω' = x₁ ∧ J ω' = j then u ω' else 0
    let v2 : α₂ → ℝ := fun x₂ => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₂ ω' = x₂ then v ω' else 0
    let v2J : α₂ → α_J → ℝ := fun x₂ j => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₂ ω' = x₂ ∧ J ω' = j then v ω' else 0
    have h_u1_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt u X₁ ω = u1 (X₁ ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      have h1 : (letI := Classical.propDecidable; ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₁ ω' = X₁ ω then u ω' else 0) =
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₁ ω' = X₁ ω then u ω' else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h : X₁ ω' = X₁ ω <;> simp [h]
      rw [h1]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_u) (fun ω' _ hω' => by
        rw [hu_zero_off ω' hω', ite_self])).symm
    have h_u1J_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 u X₁ J ω = u1J (X₁ ω) (J ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      have h1 : (letI := Classical.propDecidable;
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ∧ J ω' = J ω then u ω' else 0) =
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ∧ J ω' = J ω then u ω' else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h : X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ∧ J ω' = J ω <;> simp [h]
      rw [h1]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_u) (fun ω' _ hω' => by
        rw [hu_zero_off ω' hω', ite_self])).symm
    have h_v2_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt v X₂ ω = v2 (X₂ ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : X₂ ω' = X₂ ω <;> simp [h]
    have h_v2J_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 v X₂ J ω = v2J (X₂ ω) (J ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : X₂ ω' = X₂ ω ∧ J ω' = J ω <;> simp [h]
    let R : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
      (v2J (f (X₁ ω)) (J ω) * u1 (X₁ ω)) / (v2 (f (X₁ ω)) * u1J (X₁ ω) (J ω))
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S_u,
        u ω * (condSurprise ε u X₁ J ω - condSurprise ε v X₂ J ω) ≤
          (Real.log (ε⁻¹))⁻¹ * (u ω * R ω - u ω) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hu_pos : 0 < u ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      have hv_pos : 0 < v ω := huv ω hu_pos
      obtain ⟨hu1_p, hu1J_p, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn ε u X₁ J hε₀ hε₁ hu_nn).1 ω hu_pos
      obtain ⟨hv2_p, hv2J_p, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn ε v X₂ J hε₀ hε₁ hv_nn).1 ω hv_pos
      rw [h_u1_eq ω] at hu1_p
      rw [h_u1J_eq ω] at hu1J_p
      rw [h_v2_eq ω] at hv2_p

          exact ⟨⟨⟨hT, congrArg proj_C hJ⟩, hD⟩, hJ⟩
        · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hT, _⟩, hD⟩, hJ⟩
          exact ⟨⟨hT, hJ⟩, hD⟩
      have h_mul_id :
          (finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (B ω', D l ω')) J ω / finProbAt2 π B J ω) *
          (finProbAt2 π B J ω / finProbAt π B ω) =
          (finProbAt2 π B (D l) ω / finProbAt π B ω) *
          (finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (B ω', D l ω')) J ω / finProbAt2 π B (D l) ω) := by
        field_simp [hp_B.ne', hp_BJ.ne', hp_BD.ne']
      have h_log_id :
          Real.log (finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (B ω', D l ω')) J ω / finProbAt2 π B J ω) +
            Real.log (finProbAt2 π B J ω / finProbAt π B ω) =
          Real.log (finProbAt2 π B (D l) ω / finProbAt π B ω) +
            Real.log (finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (B ω', D l ω')) J ω / finProbAt2 π B (D l) ω) := by
        rw [← Real.log_mul (div_pos hp_BDJ hp_BJ).ne' (div_pos hp_BJ hp_B).ne',
          ← Real.log_mul (div_pos hp_BD hp_B).ne' (div_pos hp_BDJ hp_BD).ne', h_mul_id]
      have h_surp_id : condSurprise ε π (fun ω' => (T ω', J ω')) (D l) ω +
          condSurprise ε π B J ω =
          condSurprise ε π B (D l) ω +
          condSurprise ε π (fun ω' => (B ω', D l ω')) J ω := by
        unfold condSurprise
        rw [h_eq_TJ, h_eq_BD, h_eq_TJD, ← add_div, ← add_div]
        congr 1
        linarith [h_log_id]
      obtain ⟨h_hom_lo, h_hom_hi⟩ := abs_sub_le_iff.mp hs_BD_hom
      rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
      constructor <;> linarith
    let err_j : ℝ := (δ_hom + 2 * δ_trim) +
      Real.log (1 / ((∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) * lam ^ 2)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have h_tail_errj := hG_trans j hj (D l) (d_target l) (δ_hom + 2 * δ_trim)
      (by linarith) h_bayes_E
    have herr_le : err_j ≤ Ω_err := by
      dsimp [err_j, Ω_err]
      have hm_lam_pos : 0 < (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) * lam ^ 2 := mul_pos hmE_pos (pow_pos hlam₀ 2)
      have hM_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg M
      have h_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith
      have h_frac : 1 / ((∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) * lam ^ 2) ≤
          2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) / ((∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) * lam ^ 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num hm_lam_pos.le
      have h_log : Real.log (1 / ((∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) * lam ^ 2)) ≤
          Real.log (2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) / ((∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) * lam ^ 2)) :=
        Real.log_le_log (div_pos zero_lt_one hm_lam_pos) h_frac
      linarith [div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_log hℓ.le]
    have hQj_nn : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 ≤ Q_j ω := by
      intro ω
      dsimp [Q_j, restrictLaw]
      have hEj_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ ω' ∈ E.filter (fun ω' => J ω' = j), π ω' :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => hπ_nn ω')
      split_ifs <;> [exact div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) hEj_nn; exact le_rfl]
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)) h_tail_errj
    change (if Ω_err < |condSurprise ε Q_j T (D l) ω - d_target l| then Q_j ω else 0) ≤
      (if err_j < |condSurprise ε Q_j T (D l) ω - d_target l| then Q_j ω else 0)
    by_cases hΩ : Ω_err < |condSurprise ε Q_j T (D l) ω - d_target l|
    · have hj_lt : err_j < |condSurprise ε Q_j T (D l) ω - d_target l| :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt herr_le hΩ
      split_ifs
      exact le_rfl
    · simp only [hΩ, ↓reduceIte]
      split_ifs <;> [exact hQj_nn ω; exact le_rfl]
  · 
    intro N_ω α_T ε τ N₁₂ N₂₁ Q T Y₁ Y₂ lo₁₂ lo₂₁
      hε₀ hε₁ hτ hN₁₂ hN₂₁ hQ_nn hQ_sum h_ivl₁₂ h_ivl₂₁ err
    have hℓ : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁
    have hN12_pos : 0 < (N₁₂ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hN₁₂)
    have hN21_pos : 0 < (N₂₁ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hN₂₁)
    let c₁₂ : ℝ := Real.log (N₁₂ : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + τ
    let c₂₁ : ℝ := Real.log (N₂₁ : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + τ
    have hc12_le : c₁₂ ≤ err := by
      dsimp [c₁₂, err]
      have h1 : Real.log (N₁₂ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hN12_pos (le_max_left _ _)
      linarith [div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hℓ.le]
    have hc21_le : c₂₁ ≤ err := by
      dsimp [c₂₁, err]
      have h1 : Real.log (N₂₁ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hN21_pos (le_max_right _ _)
      linarith [div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hℓ.le]
    let X₁₂ : Fin N_ω → α_T × ℤ := fun ω' => (T ω', Y₁ ω')
    let X₂₁ : Fin N_ω → α_T × ℤ := fun ω' => (T ω', Y₂ ω')
    have h_pt : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
        (if err < |condSurprise ε Q T Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q T Y₁ ω| then Q ω else 0) ≤
        (if c₁₂ < condSurprise ε Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω then Q ω else 0) +
        (if c₂₁ < condSurprise ε Q X₂₁ Y₁ ω then Q ω else 0) := by
      intro ω
      by_cases hQ_p : 0 < Q ω
      · obtain ⟨hqT_p, hq1_p, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn ε Q T Y₁ hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn).1 ω hQ_p
        obtain ⟨_, hq2_p, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn ε Q T Y₂ hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn).1 ω hQ_p
        obtain ⟨_, hq12_p, hs12_nn⟩ := (h_pos_nn ε Q X₁₂ Y₂ hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn).1 ω hQ_p
        obtain ⟨_, _, hs21_nn⟩ := (h_pos_nn ε Q X₂₁ Y₁ hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn).1 ω hQ_p
        have h_eq1 : finProbAt Q X₁₂ ω = finProbAt2 Q T Y₁ ω := by
          unfold finProbAt finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          refine h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ ?_
          simp [X₁₂, Prod.mk.injEq]
        have h_eq2 : finProbAt Q X₂₁ ω = finProbAt2 Q T Y₂ ω := by
          unfold finProbAt finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          refine h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ ?_
          simp [X₂₁, Prod.mk.injEq]
        have h_eq12 : finProbAt2 Q X₂₁ Y₁ ω = finProbAt2 Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          refine h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ ?_
          simp only [X₁₂, X₂₁, Prod.mk.injEq]
          tauto
        have h_mul_id : (finProbAt2 Q T Y₂ ω / finProbAt Q T ω) *
            (finProbAt2 Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω / finProbAt2 Q T Y₂ ω) =
            (finProbAt2 Q T Y₁ ω / finProbAt Q T ω) *
            (finProbAt2 Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω / finProbAt2 Q T Y₁ ω) := by
          field_simp [hqT_p.ne', hq1_p.ne', hq2_p.ne']
        have h_log_id :
            Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T Y₂ ω / finProbAt Q T ω) +
              Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω / finProbAt2 Q T Y₂ ω) =
            Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T Y₁ ω / finProbAt Q T ω) +
              Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω / finProbAt2 Q T Y₁ ω) := by
          rw [← Real.log_mul (div_pos hq2_p hqT_p).ne' (div_pos hq12_p hq2_p).ne',
            ← Real.log_mul (div_pos hq1_p hqT_p).ne' (div_pos hq12_p hq1_p).ne', h_mul_id]
        have h_diff : condSurprise ε Q T Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q T Y₁ ω =
            condSurprise ε Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q X₂₁ Y₁ ω := by
          unfold condSurprise
          rw [h_eq1, h_eq2, h_eq12, ← sub_div, ← sub_div]
          congr 1
          linarith [h_log_id]
        by_cases herr : err < |condSurprise ε Q T Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q T Y₁ ω|
        · simp only [herr, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [h_diff, lt_abs] at herr
          rcases herr with h_left | h_right
          · have hc12_lt : c₁₂ < condSurprise ε Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω := by linarith
            simp only [hc12_lt, ↓reduceIte]
            have h2_nn : 0 ≤ (if c₂₁ < condSurprise ε Q X₂₁ Y₁ ω then Q ω else 0) := by
              split_ifs <;> [exact hQ_p.le; exact le_rfl]
            linarith
          · have hc21_lt : c₂₁ < condSurprise ε Q X₂₁ Y₁ ω := by linarith
            simp only [hc21_lt, ↓reduceIte]
            have h1_nn : 0 ≤ (if c₁₂ < condSurprise ε Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω then Q ω else 0) := by
              split_ifs <;> [exact hQ_p.le; exact le_rfl]
            linarith
        · simp only [herr, ↓reduceIte]
          exact add_nonneg
            (by split_ifs <;> [exact hQ_p.le; exact le_rfl])
            (by split_ifs <;> [exact hQ_p.le; exact le_rfl])
      · have hQ_z : Q ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hQ_p) (hQ_nn ω)
        simp [hQ_z]
    calc (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if err < |condSurprise ε Q T Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q T Y₁ ω|
            then Q ω else 0)
        ≤ ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, ((if c₁₂ < condSurprise ε Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω then Q ω else 0) +
            (if c₂₁ < condSurprise ε Q X₂₁ Y₁ ω then Q ω else 0)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_pt ω)
      _ = (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if c₁₂ < condSurprise ε Q X₁₂ Y₂ ω then Q ω else 0) +
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if c₂₁ < condSurprise ε Q X₂₁ Y₁ ω then Q ω else 0) :=
          Finset.sum_add_distrib
      _ ≤ ε ^ τ + ε ^ τ := add_le_add
          (h_ico_tail ε τ N₁₂ Q X₁₂ Y₂ (fun p => lo₁₂ p.2) hε₀ hε₁ hτ hN₁₂ hQ_nn hQ_sum
            (fun ω hQp => h_ivl₁₂ ω hQp))
          (h_ico_tail ε τ N₂₁ Q X₂₁ Y₁ (fun p => lo₂₁ p.2) hε₀ hε₁ hτ hN₂₁ hQ_nn hQ_sum
            (fun ω hQp => h_ivl₂₁ ω hQp))
      _ = 2 * ε ^ τ := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(γ r t L_hor δ_cl : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (hr₀ : 0 < r) (hrt : r < t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 1)
    (htL : t ≤ L_hor) (hδ : 0 < δ_cl) :
    ∃ ε_loc₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε_loc₀ ∧ ε_loc₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε b_t a_t d : ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε_loc₀ → ε ^ (t - r) < 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ b_t → b_t ≤ a_t → a_t + t ≤ L_hor →
        0 ≤ d → d ≤ a_t - b_t →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ θ_s ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
        let η := t - r
        let ε_tilde := ε ^ η
        let e_loc := (a_t - b_t - d) / η
        let J := fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
          stdApertureObs ε r b_t (b_t + d) (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)
        let S_J : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.univ.image J
        let p_J := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0
        let ζ := finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))) J
        let Δ_glob := classicalGrowthRate γ * t +
          classicalRootSupremum ε L_hor γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
          stdApertureScore ε γ t b_t a_t π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s
        let Δ_loc := fun j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ =>
          let π_j := restrictLaw π (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j))
          let V_j := fun tid => locCellVel ε r b_t d j (V_part tid)
          let A_j := fun tid => locCellPos ε r b_t d j (V_part tid) (A_part tid)
          let c_loc := fun ω => locTime ε r (c_s ω)
          let θ_loc := fun ω => locTheta ε (a_t - b_t) d (θ_s ω)
          classicalGrowthRate γ +
            classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde (1 + e_loc) γ N_ω N_T π_j T_idx V_j A_j -
            stdApertureScore ε_tilde γ 1 0 e_loc π_j T_idx V_j A_j c_loc θ_loc
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))) J ≤
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)))
            (fun ω => angBin ε d (θ_s ω)) ∧
        (∀ tid j, ‖locCellVel ε r b_t d j (V_part tid)‖ ≤ 1 ∧
          ‖locCellPos ε r b_t d j (V_part tid) (A_part tid)‖ ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
          locTime ε r (c_s ω) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
          locTheta ε (a_t - b_t) d (θ_s ω) ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ j ∈ S_J, 0 < p_J j → -δ_cl ≤ Δ_loc j) ∧
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * Δ_loc j ≤ (Δ_glob + 2 * ζ) / η + δ_cl

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨⟨ε₀', hε₀'_pos, _, h_loc_univ⟩, ⟨ε₀'', hε₀''_pos, _, h_root_glue⟩⟩ :=
    cell_root_competitor_gluing_and_local_lower_bound γ r t L_hor δ_cl
      hγ₀ hγ₁ h_two hr₀ hrt htL hδ
  have hη₀_pos : 0 < t - r := sub_pos.mpr hrt
  let δ_third : ℝ := (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl * (t - r)
  have hδ_third_pos : 0 < δ_third := by positivity
  let ε_exp : ℝ := Real.exp (-(Real.log (384000000 : ℝ) / δ_third))
  let ε_loc₀ : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (min (ε₀' ^ (1 / (t - r))) (min ε₀'' ε_exp))
  have hε_loc₀_pos : 0 < ε_loc₀ := by
    refine lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min ?_ (lt_min hε₀''_pos (Real.exp_pos _)))
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀'_pos _
  have hε_loc₀_half : ε_loc₀ < 1 / 2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨ε_loc₀, hε_loc₀_pos, hε_loc₀_half, ?_⟩
  intro ε b_t a_t d hε₀ hε_loc hε_tilde hb₀ hba hatL hd₀ hda N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s
    hπ_nn hπ_sum hVA hcθ η ε_tilde e_loc J S_J p_J ζ Δ_glob Δ_loc

  have hη_pos : 0 < η := hη₀_pos
  have hε_lt_quarter : ε < 1 / 4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_loc (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hε_lt_quarter (by norm_num)
  have hε_lt_rpow : ε < ε₀' ^ (1 / η) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hε_loc (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hε_lt_two : ε < ε₀'' :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hε_loc
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hε_lt_exp : ε < ε_exp :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hε_loc
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))

  have hε_tilde_pos : 0 < ε_tilde := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ η
  have hε_tilde_lt : ε_tilde < ε₀' := by
    calc ε_tilde = ε ^ η := rfl
      _ < (ε₀' ^ (1 / η)) ^ η := Real.rpow_lt_rpow hε₀.le hε_lt_rpow hη_pos
      _ = ε₀' ^ ((1 / η) * η) := (Real.rpow_mul hε₀'_pos.le _ _).symm
      _ = ε₀' ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hη_pos)]
      _ = ε₀' := Real.rpow_one ε₀'

  have h_log_inv_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := lt_trans hε₁ (by norm_num)
    have hlog_neg : Real.log ε < 0 := Real.log_neg hε₀ hε_lt1
    rw [Real.log_inv]

            p_J j * τ_loc j - p_J j * F_loc j) := by

      have h_mul_sum : η * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * Δ_loc j) =

        rw [h_Δloc_sum]
        ring
      dsimp only [Δ_glob]
      linarith [h_mul_sum, h_β_split, h_fwd_score, h_bwd_root]

    have h_div_rhs : (Δ_glob + 2 * ζ + δ_cl * η) / η = (Δ_glob + 2 * ζ) / η + δ_cl := by

        ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)

            classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ≤
            (classicalGrowthRate γ + δ) * u) ∧
    (∀ (ε u L b a : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}

      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),

        (classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
          stdApertureScore ε γ u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s) +
          3 * Real.log 2 / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (∃ C_shift : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_shift ∧
      ∀ (ε e₁ e₂ : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}

    ((∀ (ε : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}

          ∀ c : ℝ, c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → dyadicTimeBin ε r c = k_r →
            let y₁ := dyadicTimeBin ε (r + u₀ * η) c
            let y₂ := dyadicTimeBin ε_tilde u (locTime ε r c)
            (lo₁₂ y₁ ≤ y₂ ∧ y₂ < lo₁₂ y₁ + (N₁₂ : ℤ)) ∧
