proof.tactics:
by
  have h_s1 :
      (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_T α₁ α₂ : Type} [DecidableEq α₁] [DecidableEq α₂]
        (ε M₁₂ M₂₁ : ℝ)
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T : Fin N_ω → α_T) (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → α₁) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → α₂)
        (F₁₂ : α₁ → Finset α₂) (F₂₁ : α₂ → Finset α₁),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ M₁₂ → 1 ≤ M₂₁ →
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ y₁, ((F₁₂ y₁).card : ℝ) ≤ M₁₂) →
        (∀ y₂, ((F₂₁ y₂).card : ℝ) ≤ M₂₁) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → Y₂ ω ∈ F₁₂ (Y₁ ω) ∧ Y₁ ω ∈ F₂₁ (Y₂ ω)) →
        |finMutualInfo ε π T Y₂ - finMutualInfo ε π T Y₁| ≤
          Real.log (max M₁₂ M₂₁) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
      (∀ (ε γ u b a : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω → ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω < 1 →
        let m_E := ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω
        let π_E := restrictLaw π E
        let π_Ec := restrictLaw π (Finset.univ \ E)
        let Z := fun ω : Fin N_ω => decide (ω ∈ E)
        stdApertureScore ε γ u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
          (m_E * stdApertureScore ε γ u b a π_E T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s +
           (1 - m_E) * stdApertureScore ε γ u b a π_Ec T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s) ≤
          -finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z + 3 * Real.log 2 / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
    have h_ell_pos : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      intro ε hε0 hε1
      rw [Real.log_inv]
      linarith [Real.log_neg hε0 (lt_trans hε1 (by norm_num))]
    have h_prob_bds : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
        (∀ ω', 0 ≤ π ω') → 0 < π ω →
        0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω ∧ finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω ∧ 0 < finProbAt π X ω := by
      intro N_ω α β π X Y ω hπ_nn hω
      have h1 : π ω ≤ finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun ω' => @ite ℝ (X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (π ω') 0)
          (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
          (Finset.mem_univ ω)
        simpa using h_le
      have h2 : finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω
        · by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [hX, hY, hπ_nn ω']
        · simp [hX]
      exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hω h1, h2, lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hω h1) h2⟩
    have h_ent_nn : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
        0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
      intro N_ω α β ε π X Y hε0 hε1 hπ_nn
      have hell := h_ell_pos ε hε0 hε1
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
      · obtain ⟨hp2, hle, hp1⟩ := h_prob_bds π X Y ω hπ_nn hω
        refine mul_nonneg hω.le (div_nonneg ?_ hell.le)
        rw [neg_nonneg]
        exact Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg hp2.le hp1.le) ((div_le_one hp1).mpr hle)
      · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (hπ_nn ω)
        simp [h0]
    have h_prob2_eq_prob1 : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
        finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) ω = finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
      intro N_ω α β π X Y ω
      unfold finProbAt finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [hX, hY]
    have h_prob2_assoc : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (W : Fin N_ω → γ_t) (ω : Fin N_ω),
        finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) W ω =
          finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', W ω')) ω := by
      intro N_ω α β γ_t π X Y W ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω <;> by_cases hW : W ω' = W ω <;>
        simp [hX, hY, hW]
    have h_chain : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (W : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
        finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', W ω')) =
          finCondEntropy ε π X Y + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) W := by
      intro N_ω α β γ_t ε π X Y W hπ_nn
      unfold finCondEntropy
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
      · obtain ⟨hpXY, _, hpX⟩ := h_prob_bds π X Y ω hπ_nn hω
        obtain ⟨hpXYW, _, _⟩ := h_prob_bds π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', W ω')) ω hπ_nn hω
        unfold condSurprise
        rw [h_prob2_eq_prob1, h_prob2_assoc]
        have h_mul : finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', W ω')) ω / finProbAt π X ω =
            (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) *
              (finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', W ω')) ω / finProbAt2 π X Y ω) := by
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hpX, ne_of_gt hpXY]
        rw [h_mul, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpXY hpX)) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpXYW hpXY))]
        ring
      · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (hπ_nn ω)
        simp [h0]
    have h_ent_pair_comm : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (W : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
        finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', W ω')) =
          finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω' => (W ω', Y ω')) := by
      intro N_ω α β γ_t ε π X Y W
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      have h_eq : finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', W ω')) ω =
          finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (W ω', Y ω')) ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω <;> by_cases hW : W ω' = W ω <;>
          simp [hX, hY, hW]
      rw [h_eq]
    have h_ent_cond_comm : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (W : Fin N_ω → β) (Y : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y =
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y := by
      intro N_ω α β γ_t ε π X W Y
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      have e1 : finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) ω = finProbAt π (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) ω := by
        unfold finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hW : W ω' = W ω <;> simp [hX, hW]
      have e2 : finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω = finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hW : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω <;>
          simp [hX, hW, hY]
      rw [e1, e2]
    have h_ent_unit_fst : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (Z : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => ((), Z ω')) Y = finCondEntropy ε π Z Y := by
      intro N_ω α β ε π Z Y
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      have h1 : finProbAt π (fun ω' => ((), Z ω')) ω = finProbAt π Z ω := by
        unfold finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by by_cases hZ : Z ω' = Z ω <;> simp [hZ])
      have h2 : finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => ((), Z ω')) Y ω = finProbAt2 π Z Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by
          by_cases hZ : Z ω' = Z ω <;> by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [hZ, hY])
      rw [h1, h2]
    have h_cond_mono : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (W : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
      intro N_ω α β γ_t ε π X Y W hε0 hε1 hπ_nn hπ_sum
      haveI : DecidableEq α := Classical.decEq α
      haveI : DecidableEq β := Classical.decEq β
      haveI : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
      have hell := h_ell_pos ε hε0 hε1
      let S_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
        @Finset.filter (Fin N_ω) (fun ω => 0 < π ω) (fun ω => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
      have h_mem_S : ∀ ω, ω ∈ S_pos ↔ 0 < π ω := by intro ω; simp [S_pos]
      have h_zero_out : ∀ ω ∉ S_pos, π ω = 0 := by
        intro ω hω
        rw [h_mem_S, not_lt] at hω
        exact le_antisymm hω (hπ_nn ω)
      have h_sum_S : ∀ f : Fin N_ω → ℝ, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * f ω = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * f ω := by
        intro f
        exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos) (fun ω _ hω => by simp [h_zero_out ω hω])).symm
      have h_S_one : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω = 1 := by
        have h1 := h_sum_S (fun _ => 1)
        simp only [mul_one] at h1
        linarith
      have h_diff_ge : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos,
          (π ω - π ω * ((finProbAt2 π X Y ω * finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) ω) /
            (finProbAt π X ω * finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
          π ω * condSurprise ε π X Y ω - π ω * condSurprise ε π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω := by
        intro ω hω
        have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (h_mem_S ω).mp hω
        obtain ⟨hpXY, _, hpX⟩ := h_prob_bds π X Y ω hπ_nn hω_pos
        obtain ⟨hpXWY, _, hpXW⟩ := h_prob_bds π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω hπ_nn hω_pos
        set u := (finProbAt2 π X Y ω * finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) ω) /
          (finProbAt π X ω * finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω)
        have hu_pos : 0 < u := div_pos (mul_pos hpXY hpXW) (mul_pos hpX hpXWY)
        have h_log_u : Real.log u = Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) -
            Real.log (finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω /
              finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) ω) := by
          have h_eq_u : u = (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) /
              (finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω /
                finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) ω) := by
            dsimp [u]; field_simp [ne_of_gt hpX, ne_of_gt hpXW, ne_of_gt hpXWY]
          rw [h_eq_u, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpXY hpX)) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpXWY hpXW))]
        have h_ineq : 1 - u ≤ -Real.log u := by linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu_pos]
        have h_surp_diff : π ω * condSurprise ε π X Y ω -
            π ω * condSurprise ε π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω =
            (π ω * (-Real.log u)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
          unfold condSurprise; rw [h_log_u]; ring
        rw [h_surp_diff]
        refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hell.le
        nlinarith
      let f3 : Fin N_ω → α × β × γ_t := fun ω => (X ω, Y ω, W ω)
      let T3 := S_pos.image f3
      let IX := S_pos.image X
      let IY := S_pos.image Y
      let IW := S_pos.image W
      let qX : α → ℝ := fun x => ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, if X ω = x then π ω else 0
      let qXY : α → β → ℝ := fun x y => ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, if X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0
      let qXW : α → γ_t → ℝ := fun x w => ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, if X ω = x ∧ W ω = w then π ω else 0
      let qXWY : α × β × γ_t → ℝ := fun t => ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, if f3 ω = t then π ω else 0
      have h_sum_u_le1 : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos,
          π ω * ((finProbAt2 π X Y ω * finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) ω) /
            (finProbAt π X ω * finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω)) ≤ 1 := by
        have h_fib := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := S_pos) (t := T3)
          (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem f3 hω)
          (fun ω => π ω * ((finProbAt2 π X Y ω * finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) ω) /
            (finProbAt π X ω * finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', W ω')) Y ω)))
        rw [← h_fib]

      have hp_T0_eq : ∀ tid, (1 - m_E) * p_TEc tid = p_T0 tid := by
        intro tid
        dsimp [p_TEc, p_T0, π_Ec, restrictLaw]
        have h1 : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then (if ω ∈ Ec then π ω / ∑ x ∈ Ec, π x else 0) else 0) =
            (∑ ω ∈ Ec, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0) / (∑ x ∈ Ec, π x) := by
          calc _ = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if ω ∈ Ec then (if T_idx ω = tid then π ω / ∑ x ∈ Ec, π x else 0) else 0 :=
                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> rfl)
            _ = ∑ ω ∈ Ec, (if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0) / (∑ x ∈ Ec, π x) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]
                exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> simp)
            _ = _ := (Finset.sum_div _ _ _).symm
        rw [h1, hmEc_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hmEc_pos)]
      have hp_T_split : ∀ tid, p_T1 tid + p_T0 tid = p_T tid := by
        intro tid
        dsimp [p_T1, p_T0, p_T]
        rw [add_comm, Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ E)]
      have h_mut_Z : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z =
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, (p_T1 tid * Real.log (p_T1 tid / (p_T tid * m_E)) +
            p_T0 tid * Real.log (p_T0 tid / (p_T tid * (1 - m_E))))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ E)]
        have h_on_S : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_ω)) (z : Bool) (mS : ℝ) (p_Tz : Fin N_T → ℝ),
            (∀ ω', ω' ∈ S ↔ Z ω' = z) →
            (∑ ω' ∈ S, π ω') = mS → 0 < mS →
            (∀ tid, p_Tz tid = ∑ ω' ∈ S, if T_idx ω' = tid then π ω' else 0) →
            (∀ tid, p_Tz tid ≤ p_T tid) →
            (∑ ω ∈ S, (π ω * condSurprise ε π (fun _ => ()) Z ω -
              π ω * condSurprise ε π T_idx Z ω)) =
            (∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_Tz tid * Real.log (p_Tz tid / (p_T tid * mS))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
          intro S z mS p_Tz hS_iff hmS_eq hmS_pos hpTz_def hpTz_le
          have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S,
              π ω * condSurprise ε π (fun _ => ()) Z ω - π ω * condSurprise ε π T_idx Z ω =
              π ω * (Real.log (p_Tz (T_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * mS)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
            intro ω hω
            by_cases hω_pos : 0 < π ω
            · have hz : Z ω = z := (hS_iff ω).mp hω
              have hp_u1 : finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
                unfold finProbAt; simp [hπ_sum]
              have hp_u2 : finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) Z ω = mS := by
                unfold finProbAt2
                rw [← hmS_eq, ← Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ S)]
                have h_out : ∑ ω' ∈ Finset.univ \ S,
                    @ite ℝ ((fun _ : Fin N_ω => ()) ω' = () ∧ Z ω' = Z ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (π ω') 0 = 0 := by
                  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
                  have hnot : ω' ∉ S := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hω').2
                  have hne : Z ω' ≠ z := fun h => hnot ((hS_iff ω').mpr h)
                  simp [hz, hne]
                dsimp only
                rw [h_out, zero_add]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
                have hz' : Z ω' = z := (hS_iff ω').mp hω'
                simp [hz, hz']
              have hp_t1 : finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
                unfold finProbAt; dsimp [p_T]
                exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by by_cases h : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [h])
              have hp_t2 : finProbAt2 π T_idx Z ω = p_Tz (T_idx ω) := by
                unfold finProbAt2
                rw [hpTz_def (T_idx ω), ← Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ S)]
                have h_out : ∑ ω' ∈ Finset.univ \ S,
                    @ite ℝ (T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (π ω') 0 = 0 := by
                  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
                  have hnot : ω' ∉ S := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hω').2
                  have hne : Z ω' ≠ z := fun h => hnot ((hS_iff ω').mpr h)
                  simp [hz, hne]
                rw [h_out, zero_add]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
                have hz' : Z ω' = z := (hS_iff ω').mp hω'
                by_cases hT : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [hz, hz', hT]
              have hpTz_pos : 0 < p_Tz (T_idx ω) := by
                rw [hpTz_def (T_idx ω)]
                have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω' => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω then π ω' else 0)
                  (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]) hω
                simp only [↓reduceIte] at h_le
                exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos h_le
              have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hpTz_pos (hpTz_le (T_idx ω))
              unfold condSurprise
              rw [hp_u1, hp_u2, hp_t1, hp_t2, div_one]
              have h_div : (p_Tz (T_idx ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) / mS =
                  p_Tz (T_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * mS) := div_div _ _ _
              rw [← h_div, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpTz_pos hpT_pos)) (ne_of_gt hmS_pos)]
              ring
            · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω_pos) (hπ_nn ω)
              simp [h0]
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_pt]
          have h_fib : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_Tz tid * Real.log (p_Tz tid / (p_T tid * mS))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
              ∑ tid : Fin N_T, (p_Tz tid * (Real.log (p_Tz tid / (p_T tid * mS)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_div]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => mul_div_assoc _ _ _)
          rw [h_fib]
          have h_lhs_fib : ∀ ω ∈ S,
              π ω * (Real.log (p_Tz (T_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * mS)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) =
              ∑ tid : Fin N_T, if T_idx ω = tid then
                π ω * (Real.log (p_Tz tid / (p_T tid * mS)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) else 0 := by
            intro ω _
            rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (T_idx ω)]
            simp
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_lhs_fib, Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
          set c_tid := Real.log (p_Tz tid / (p_T tid * mS)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)
          change (∑ ω ∈ S, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω * c_tid else 0) = p_Tz tid * c_tid
          rw [hpTz_def tid, Finset.sum_mul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by by_cases h : T_idx ω = tid <;> simp [h])
        have h1 := h_on_S E true m_E p_T1 (fun ω' => by simp [Z]) rfl hmE0 (fun _ => rfl)
          (fun tid => by
            have h0_nn : 0 ≤ p_T0 tid := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
            linarith [hp_T_split tid])
        have h0 := h_on_S Ec false (1 - m_E) p_T0 (fun ω' => by simp [Ec, Z]) hmEc_eq hmEc_pos (fun _ => rfl)
          (fun tid => by
            have h1_nn : 0 ≤ p_T1 tid := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
            linarith [hp_T_split tid])
        rw [h0, h1, ← add_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine congr_arg (· / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => add_comm _ _))
      have h_pair : ∀ s₁ ∈ rootSet ε L π_E T_idx V_part A_part,
          ∀ s₀ ∈ rootSet ε L π_Ec T_idx V_part A_part,
            m_E * s₁ + (1 - m_E) * s₀ ≤
              classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
                finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z := by
        rintro s₁ ⟨N₁, b₁, a₁, e₁, V₁, A₁, q₁, hadm₁, hqnn₁, hqp₁, hcap₁, hs₁_eq⟩
               s₀ ⟨N₀, b₀, a₀, e₀, V₀, A₀, q₀, hadm₀, hqnn₀, hqp₀, hcap₀, hs₀_eq⟩
        let σ : Fin (N₁ + N₀) ≃ Fin N₁ ⊕ Fin N₀ := finSumFinEquiv.symm
        let b_D : Fin (N₁ + N₀) → ℝ := fun d => Sum.elim b₁ b₀ (σ d)
        let a_D : Fin (N₁ + N₀) → ℝ := fun d => Sum.elim a₁ a₀ (σ d)
        let e_D : Fin (N₁ + N₀) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => Sum.elim e₁ e₀ (σ d)
        let V_D : Fin (N₁ + N₀) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => Sum.elim V₁ V₀ (σ d)
        let A_D : Fin (N₁ + N₀) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => Sum.elim A₁ A₀ (σ d)
        let q : Fin N_T → Fin (N₁ + N₀) → ℝ := fun tid d =>
          Sum.elim (fun d₁ => m_E * q₁ tid d₁) (fun d₀ => (1 - m_E) * q₀ tid d₀) (σ d)
        have h_adm : ∀ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀), 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ L ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1 := by
          intro d
          dsimp [b_D, a_D, e_D]
          cases σ d with
          | inl d₁ => exact hadm₁ d₁
          | inr d₀ => exact hadm₀ d₀
        have hq_nn : ∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d := by
          intro tid d
          dsimp [q]
          cases σ d with
          | inl d₁ => exact mul_nonneg hmE0.le (hqnn₁ tid d₁)
          | inr d₀ => exact mul_nonneg hmEc_pos.le (hqnn₀ tid d₀)
        have hq_sum : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀), q tid d = p_T tid := by
          intro tid
          dsimp [q]
          rw [Equiv.sum_comp σ, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
          simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          change m_E * (∑ d₁, q₁ tid d₁) + (1 - m_E) * (∑ d₀, q₀ tid d₀) = p_T tid
          rw [hqp₁ tid, hqp₀ tid, hp_T1_eq tid, hp_T0_eq tid, hp_T_split tid]
        have h_cap : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀), 0 < q tid d →
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) := by
          intro tid d hq_pos
          dsimp [q, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D] at hq_pos ⊢
          cases hσ : σ d with
          | inl d₁ =>
            rw [hσ] at hq_pos; dsimp at hq_pos ⊢
            exact hcap₁ tid d₁ (pos_of_mul_pos_right hq_pos hmE0.le)
          | inr d₀ =>
            rw [hσ] at hq_pos; dsimp at hq_pos ⊢
            exact hcap₀ tid d₀ (pos_of_mul_pos_right hq_pos hmEc_pos.le)
        let q_D : Fin (N₁ + N₀) → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
        let q₁_D : Fin N₁ → ℝ := fun d₁ => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q₁ tid d₁
        let q₀_D : Fin N₀ → ℝ := fun d₀ => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q₀ tid d₀
        have hqD_inl : ∀ d₁ : Fin N₁, q_D (σ.symm (Sum.inl d₁)) = m_E * q₁_D d₁ := by
          intro d₁; dsimp [q_D, q, q₁_D]; simp [← Finset.mul_sum]
        have hqD_inr : ∀ d₀ : Fin N₀, q_D (σ.symm (Sum.inr d₀)) = (1 - m_E) * q₀_D d₀ := by
          intro d₀; dsimp [q_D, q, q₀_D]; simp [← Finset.mul_sum]
        have h_Ew_eq : (∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀), q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) =
            m_E * (∑ d₁ : Fin N₁, q₁_D d₁ * ((1 + γ) * b₁ d₁ + (1 - γ) * a₁ d₁)) +
            (1 - m_E) * (∑ d₀ : Fin N₀, q₀_D d₀ * ((1 + γ) * b₀ d₀ + (1 - γ) * a₀ d₀)) := by
          rw [← Equiv.sum_comp σ.symm, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
          simp only [hqD_inl, hqD_inr, b_D, a_D, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
            mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        have h_ITD_branch : ∀ {N_k : ℕ} (mS : ℝ) (p_TS p_Tz : Fin N_T → ℝ)
            (qk : Fin N_T → Fin N_k → ℝ) (qk_D : Fin N_k → ℝ),
            0 < mS →
            (∀ tid d_k, 0 ≤ qk tid d_k) →
            (∀ tid, ∑ d_k, qk tid d_k = p_TS tid) →
            (∀ d_k, qk_D d_k = ∑ tid, qk tid d_k) →
            (∀ tid, mS * p_TS tid = p_Tz tid) →
            (∀ tid, p_Tz tid ≤ p_T tid) →
            ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
              (∑ d_k : Fin N_k, (mS * qk tid d_k) *
                Real.log ((mS * qk tid d_k) / (p_T tid * (mS * qk_D d_k)))) =
              mS * (∑ d_k : Fin N_k, qk tid d_k * Real.log (qk tid d_k / (p_TS tid * qk_D d_k))) +
                p_Tz tid * Real.log (p_Tz tid / (p_T tid * mS)) := by
          intro N_k mS p_TS p_Tz qk qk_D hmS_pos hqk_nn hqk_pTS hqk_D_def hpTz_mS hpTz_le tid
          have h_term : ∀ d_k : Fin N_k,
              (mS * qk tid d_k) * Real.log ((mS * qk tid d_k) / (p_T tid * (mS * qk_D d_k))) =
              mS * (qk tid d_k * Real.log (qk tid d_k / (p_TS tid * qk_D d_k))) +
                (mS * qk tid d_k) * Real.log (p_Tz tid / (p_T tid * mS)) := by
            intro d_k
            by_cases hqk_pos : 0 < qk tid d_k
            · have hpTS_pos : 0 < p_TS tid := by
                rw [← hqk_pTS tid]
                exact lt_of_lt_of_le hqk_pos
                  (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hqk_nn tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d_k))
              have hqkD_pos : 0 < qk_D d_k := by
                rw [hqk_D_def d_k]
                exact lt_of_lt_of_le hqk_pos
                  (Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => hqk_nn tid' d_k) (Finset.mem_univ tid))
              have hpTz_pos : 0 < p_Tz tid := by rw [← hpTz_mS tid]; exact mul_pos hmS_pos hpTS_pos
              have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := lt_of_lt_of_le hpTz_pos (hpTz_le tid)
              have h_prod : (mS * qk tid d_k) / (p_T tid * (mS * qk_D d_k)) =
                  (qk tid d_k / (p_TS tid * qk_D d_k)) * (p_Tz tid / (p_T tid * mS)) := by
                rw [← hpTz_mS tid]
                field_simp [ne_of_gt hmS_pos, ne_of_gt hpTS_pos, ne_of_gt hqkD_pos, ne_of_gt hpT_pos]
              rw [h_prod, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos hqk_pos (mul_pos hpTS_pos hqkD_pos)))
                (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpTz_pos (mul_pos hpT_pos hmS_pos)))]
              ring
            · have h0 : qk tid d_k = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hqk_pos) (hqk_nn tid d_k)
              simp [h0]
          simp_rw [h_term]
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum,
            hqk_pTS tid, hpTz_mS tid]
        have h_ITD_eq : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀),
            q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
            m_E * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d₁ : Fin N₁,
              q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_TE tid * q₁_D d₁))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) +
            (1 - m_E) * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d₀ : Fin N₀,
              q₀ tid d₀ * Real.log (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_TEc tid * q₀_D d₀))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) +
            finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z := by
          rw [h_mut_Z]
          have h_tid : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
              (∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀), q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) =
              m_E * (∑ d₁ : Fin N₁, q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_TE tid * q₁_D d₁))) +
              (1 - m_E) * (∑ d₀ : Fin N₀, q₀ tid d₀ * Real.log (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_TEc tid * q₀_D d₀))) +
              (p_T1 tid * Real.log (p_T1 tid / (p_T tid * m_E)) +
                p_T0 tid * Real.log (p_T0 tid / (p_T tid * (1 - m_E)))) := by
            intro tid
            rw [← Equiv.sum_comp σ.symm, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
            simp only [hqD_inl, hqD_inr, q, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
            have hb1 := h_ITD_branch m_E p_TE p_T1 q₁ q₁_D hmE0 hqnn₁ hqp₁ (fun _ => rfl) hp_T1_eq
              (fun tid' => by
                have h0_nn : 0 ≤ p_T0 tid' := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
                linarith [hp_T_split tid']) tid
            have hb0 := h_ITD_branch (1 - m_E) p_TEc p_T0 q₀ q₀_D hmEc_pos hqnn₀ hqp₀ (fun _ => rfl) hp_T0_eq
              (fun tid' => by
                have h1_nn : 0 ≤ p_T1 tid' := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
                linarith [hp_T_split tid']) tid
            rw [hb1, hb0]
            ring
          simp_rw [h_tid, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          ring
        let s_glued := (∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀), q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) -
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₀),
            q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        have hs_mem : s_glued ∈ rootSet ε L π T_idx V_part A_part :=
          ⟨N₁ + N₀, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h_adm, hq_nn, hq_sum, h_cap, rfl⟩
        have hs_le_sup : s_glued ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part :=
          le_csSup hS_bdd hs_mem
        change s₁ = (∑ d₁, q₁_D d₁ * ((1 + γ) * b₁ d₁ + (1 - γ) * a₁ d₁)) -
          (∑ tid, ∑ d₁, q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_TE tid * q₁_D d₁))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) at hs₁_eq
        change s₀ = (∑ d₀, q₀_D d₀ * ((1 + γ) * b₀ d₀ + (1 - γ) * a₀ d₀)) -
          (∑ tid, ∑ d₀, q₀ tid d₀ * Real.log (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_TEc tid * q₀_D d₀))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) at hs₀_eq
        dsimp [s_glued] at hs_le_sup
        rw [h_Ew_eq, h_ITD_eq] at hs_le_sup
        have h_lin : m_E * s₁ + (1 - m_E) * s₀ - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z =
            (m_E * (∑ d₁, q₁_D d₁ * ((1 + γ) * b₁ d₁ + (1 - γ) * a₁ d₁)) +
             (1 - m_E) * (∑ d₀, q₀_D d₀ * ((1 + γ) * b₀ d₀ + (1 - γ) * a₀ d₀))) -
            (m_E * ((∑ tid, ∑ d₁, q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_TE tid * q₁_D d₁))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) +
             (1 - m_E) * ((∑ tid, ∑ d₀, q₀ tid d₀ * Real.log (q₀ tid d₀ / (p_TEc tid * q₀_D d₀))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) +
             finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z) := by
          rw [hs₁_eq, hs₀_eq]; ring
        linarith [hs_le_sup, h_lin]

      let g := G_idx ω
      let c_mid := ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time

      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (e_G g)| ≤

        |inner ℝ ((A₁ tid + c_mid • V₁ tid) - X_G1 g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤
          ε ^ (a_star + t)) ∧
      classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx b_G a_G -

      classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π₁ T_idx k_time G_idx

        classicalRootSupremum ε (a_star + t) γ N_ω N_T π₁ T_idx V₁ A₁ +

        (4 * Real.log ((2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
