proof.tactics:
by
  have : DecidablePred (fun ω : Fin N_ω => 0 < π ω) := Classical.decPred _
  have : DecidablePred (fun e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
    0 < e 1 ∨ (e 1 = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ e 0)) := Classical.decPred _
  have hε_lt_one : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have hε_le_one : ε ≤ 1 := hε_lt_one.le
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr hε_lt_one)
  have hell_ne : ell ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hell_pos
  have hB_pos : 0 < B_cl := by linarith
  have hB_ne : B_cl ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hB_pos
  have hεt_pos : 0 < ε ^ t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ t
  have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ_time := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hB_pos) hεt_pos) hΔ_lo
  have hΔ_ne : Δ_time ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hΔ_pos
  have hεt_le_BΔ : ε ^ t ≤ B_cl * Δ_time := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔ_lo hB_pos.le
    rwa [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hB_ne, one_mul] at hm

  
  have h_dyad_lvl_inv : ∀ u : ℝ, ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u))⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ u := by
    intro u
    unfold dyadicTimeLevel
    have hε_neg_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-u) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-u)
    have h_le_ceil : ε ^ (-u) ≤ (⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil (ε ^ (-u))
    have h_clog_nat : ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ (Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊) :=
      Nat.le_pow_clog (by norm_num : 1 < 2) _
    have h_clog_real : (⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊) := by
      exact_mod_cast h_clog_nat
    have h_le_pow : ε ^ (-u) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊) :=
      le_trans h_le_ceil h_clog_real
    calc ((2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊))⁻¹
        ≤ (ε ^ (-u))⁻¹ := (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) hε_neg_pos).mpr h_le_pow
      _ = ε ^ u := by rw [Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le u, inv_inv]

  have h_mid_approx : ∀ c : ℝ, c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      |dyadicTimeMid ε t c - c| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ t := by
    intro c hc
    let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε t
    have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
    have h2m_ne : (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2m_pos
    have h2m_inv_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr h2m_pos
    have h2m_inv_le : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ t := h_dyad_lvl_inv t
    unfold dyadicTimeMid dyadicTimeBin
    change |(((min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ - c| ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ t
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hc.2 with hc_lt | rfl
    · have h_prod_lt : c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < ((2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        calc c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc_lt h2m_pos
          _ = ((2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      have h_fl_lt_real : (⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ : ℝ) < ((2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (Int.floor_le _) h_prod_lt
      have h_fl_lt : ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ < (2 ^ m : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast h_fl_lt_real
      have h_min : min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1) = ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ :=
        min_eq_left (by omega)
      rw [h_min]
      have h_fl_le : (⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ : ℝ) ≤ c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := Int.floor_le _
      have h_lt_fl1 : c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < (⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h_factor : (((⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ - c) =
          (((⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) - c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp [h2m_ne]
      rw [h_factor, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h2m_inv_pos]
      have h_abs_half : |((⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) - c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      calc |((⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) - c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m| * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_abs_half h2m_inv_pos.le
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ t :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2m_inv_le (by norm_num)
    · have h_one_mul : (1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m = ((2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_one_mul, Int.floor_intCast, min_eq_right (by omega)]
      have h_simp : ((((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ - 1 =
          -((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) := by
        push_cast
        field_simp [h2m_ne]
        ring
      rw [h_simp, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) h2m_inv_pos)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2m_inv_le (by norm_num)

  let m_t : ℕ := dyadicTimeLevel ε t
  let R_nat : ℕ := ⌈B_cl⌉₊
  let R_int : ℤ := (R_nat : ℤ)
  let z₀_time : ℤ → ℝ := fun k_d =>
    (((k_d : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹) / Δ_time - 1 / 2
  let S_time : ℤ → Finset ℤ := fun k_d =>
    Finset.Icc (⌊z₀_time k_d⌋ - R_int) (⌊z₀_time k_d⌋ + R_int)
  have hS_time_card : ∀ k_d : ℤ, (S_time k_d).card ≤ 2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 2 := by
    intro k_d
    dsimp only [S_time, R_int, R_nat]
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    omega
  have hS_time_mem : ∀ k_tm : ℤ,
      let c_mid := ((k_tm : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time
      c_mid ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      k_tm ∈ S_time (dyadicTimeBin ε t c_mid) := by
    intro k_tm c_mid hc_mid
    let k_d := dyadicTimeBin ε t c_mid
    have h_diff_eq : (k_tm : ℝ) - z₀_time k_d =
        (c_mid - dyadicTimeMid ε t c_mid) / Δ_time := by
      dsimp only [z₀_time, k_d, m_t, dyadicTimeMid, c_mid]
      field_simp [hΔ_ne]
      ring
    have h_abs_le : |(k_tm : ℝ) - z₀_time k_d| ≤ (R_int : ℝ) := by
      rw [h_diff_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hΔ_pos, abs_sub_comm]
      have h1 : |dyadicTimeMid ε t c_mid - c_mid| / Δ_time ≤
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B_cl * Δ_time)) / Δ_time := by
        refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hΔ_pos.le
        exact le_trans (h_mid_approx c_mid hc_mid)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hεt_le_BΔ (by norm_num))
      have h2 : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B_cl * Δ_time)) / Δ_time = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B_cl := by
        field_simp [hΔ_ne]
      have h3 : B_cl ≤ (R_nat : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil B_cl
      have h4 : (R_nat : ℝ) = (R_int : ℝ) := by dsimp only [R_int]; push_cast; rfl
      linarith
    have h_abs_bounds := abs_le.mp h_abs_le
    have h_fl_le : (⌊z₀_time k_d⌋ : ℝ) ≤ z₀_time k_d := Int.floor_le _
    have h_lt_fl1 : z₀_time k_d < (⌊z₀_time k_d⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have h_lo_real : ((⌊z₀_time k_d⌋ - R_int : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (k_tm : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_hi_real : (k_tm : ℝ) < ((⌊z₀_time k_d⌋ + R_int + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_lo : ⌊z₀_time k_d⌋ - R_int ≤ k_tm := by exact_mod_cast h_lo_real
    have h_hi_lt : k_tm < ⌊z₀_time k_d⌋ + R_int + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h_hi_real
    dsimp only [S_time, k_d] at h_lo h_hi_lt ⊢
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h_lo, by omega⟩

  
  have h_inner2D : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ x y = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
    intro x y
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [mul_comm]

  have h_inner_perp_neg : ∀ w v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ w (perp2D (-v)) = -inner ℝ w (perp2D v) := by
    intro w v
    rw [h_inner2D, h_inner2D]
    simp [perp2D]
    ring

  let u_pos : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun e =>
    if 0 < e 1 ∨ (e 1 = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ e 0) then e else -e
  let θ_of : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun e =>
    Real.arccos ((u_pos e) 0)

  have hθ_props : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      θ_of e ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧
      Real.cos (θ_of e) = (u_pos e) 0 ∧
      Real.sin (θ_of e) = (u_pos e) 1 := by
    intro e he
    have he_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [he]; norm_num
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
    have hu_sq : ((u_pos e) 0) ^ 2 + ((u_pos e) 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      dsimp only [u_pos]
      split_ifs
      · exact he_sq
      · simp [he_sq]
    have hu0_abs : |(u_pos e) 0| ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [hu_sq, sq_nonneg ((u_pos e) 1), sq_abs ((u_pos e) 0), abs_nonneg ((u_pos e) 0)]
    obtain ⟨hu0_ge_neg1, hu0_le1⟩ := abs_le.mp hu0_abs
    have hu1_nn : 0 ≤ (u_pos e) 1 := by
      dsimp only [u_pos]
      split_ifs with h_cond
      · rcases h_cond with h_pos | ⟨h_eq0, _⟩ <;> linarith
      · have h_le0 : e 1 ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt (fun hgt => h_cond (Or.inl hgt))
        simp
        linarith
    have hu0_gt_neg1 : -1 < (u_pos e) 0 := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne hu0_ge_neg1 (fun h_eq => ?_)
      have hu1_sq0 : ((u_pos e) 1) ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [hu_sq, h_eq]
      have hu1_zero : (u_pos e) 1 = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hu1_sq0
      dsimp only [u_pos] at h_eq hu1_zero
      split_ifs at h_eq hu1_zero with h_cond
      · rcases h_cond with h_pos | ⟨_, h_nn⟩ <;> linarith
      · simp at h_eq hu1_zero
        exact h_cond (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    refine ⟨⟨Real.arccos_nonneg _, Real.arccos_lt_pi.mpr hu0_gt_neg1⟩,
      Real.cos_arccos hu0_ge_neg1 hu0_le1, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [θ_of]
    rw [Real.sin_arccos]
    have h_diff_sq : 1 - ((u_pos e) 0) ^ 2 = ((u_pos e) 1) ^ 2 := by linarith [hu_sq]
    rw [h_diff_sq, Real.sqrt_sq hu1_nn]

  have hu_pos_inner : ∀ w e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      |inner ℝ w (u_pos e)| = |inner ℝ w e| ∧
      |inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e))| = |inner ℝ w (perp2D e)| := by
    intro w e
    dsimp only [u_pos]
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [inner_neg_right, abs_neg, h_inner_perp_neg, abs_neg]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

  have h_rot_bound : ∀ (e w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (C b a : ℝ),
      ‖e‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ C → b ≤ a → a - b = a_star - b_star →
      |inner ℝ w e| ≤ C * ε ^ b →
      |inner ℝ w (perp2D e)| ≤ C * ε ^ a →
      let k_r := angBin ε (a_star - b_star) (θ_of e)
      let e_dir := angUnitVec ε (a_star - b_star) k_r
      |inner ℝ w e_dir| ≤ 2 * C * ε ^ b ∧
      |inner ℝ w (perp2D e_dir)| ≤ (1 + Real.pi / 2) * C * ε ^ a := by
    intro e w C b a he hC_nn hba_loc h_asp_eq hw_e hw_perp k_r e_dir
    obtain ⟨⟨hθ_nn, hθ_lt_pi⟩, h_cosθ, h_sinθ⟩ := hθ_props e he
    let e_asp := a_star - b_star
    let m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e_asp
    have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e := by positivity
    have h2m_ne : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2m_pos
    have h2m_inv_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr h2m_pos
    have h2m_inv_le : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ e_asp := h_dyad_lvl_inv e_asp
    have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpi_pos
    have h_div_lt1 : θ_of e / Real.pi < 1 := (div_lt_one hpi_pos).mpr hθ_lt_pi
    have h_prod_lt : (θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e < ((2 ^ m_e : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      calc (θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e < 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_div_lt1 h2m_pos
        _ = ((2 ^ m_e : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    have h_fl_lt : ⌊(θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e⌋ < (2 ^ m_e : ℤ) := by
      exact_mod_cast lt_of_le_of_lt (Int.floor_le _) h_prod_lt
    have hk_r_eq : k_r = ⌊(θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e⌋ := by
      dsimp only [k_r, angBin, e_asp, m_e] at h_fl_lt ⊢
      exact min_eq_left (by omega)
    let φ := ((k_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹
    let Δφ := φ - θ_of e
    have hφ_eq : φ = θ_of e + Δφ := by dsimp only [Δφ]; ring
    have hΔφ_abs : |Δφ| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ e_asp := by
      have h_fl_le : (k_r : ℝ) ≤ (θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e := by
        rw [hk_r_eq]
        exact Int.floor_le _
      have h_lt_fl1 : (θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e < (k_r : ℝ) + 1 := by
        rw [hk_r_eq]
        exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h_fac : Δφ = (((k_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) - (θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e) *
          (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹) := by
        dsimp only [Δφ, φ]
        field_simp [hpi_ne, h2m_ne]
      have h_step_pos : 0 < Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹ := mul_pos hpi_pos h2m_inv_pos
      rw [h_fac, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_step_pos]
      have h_half : |((k_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) - (θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      calc |((k_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) - (θ_of e / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e| *
              (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹)
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_half h_step_pos.le
        _ = (Real.pi / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹ := by ring
        _ ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ e_asp :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2m_inv_le (by positivity)
    have h_edir0 : e_dir 0 = (u_pos e) 0 * Real.cos Δφ - (u_pos e) 1 * Real.sin Δφ := by
      dsimp only [e_dir, angUnitVec, e_asp, m_e]
      change (WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 0 = _
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [hφ_eq, Real.cos_add, h_cosθ, h_sinθ]
    have h_edir1 : e_dir 1 = (u_pos e) 1 * Real.cos Δφ + (u_pos e) 0 * Real.sin Δφ := by
      dsimp only [e_dir, angUnitVec, e_asp, m_e]
      change (WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 1 = _
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [hφ_eq, Real.sin_add, h_sinθ, h_cosθ]
    have h_in_tan : inner ℝ w e_dir =
        Real.cos Δφ * inner ℝ w (u_pos e) + Real.sin Δφ * inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e)) := by
      rw [h_inner2D w e_dir, h_inner2D w (u_pos e), h_inner2D w (perp2D (u_pos e)),
        h_edir0, h_edir1]
      simp [perp2D]
      ring
    have h_in_nrm : inner ℝ w (perp2D e_dir) =
        Real.cos Δφ * inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e)) - Real.sin Δφ * inner ℝ w (u_pos e) := by
      rw [h_inner2D w (perp2D e_dir), h_inner2D w (perp2D (u_pos e)), h_inner2D w (u_pos e)]
      simp [perp2D, h_edir0, h_edir1]
      ring
    obtain ⟨hu_e, hu_perp⟩ := hu_pos_inner w e
    have hw_ue : |inner ℝ w (u_pos e)| ≤ C * ε ^ b := hu_e.trans_le hw_e
    have hw_uperp : |inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e))| ≤ C * ε ^ a := hu_perp.trans_le hw_perp
    have h_rpow_mono : ε ^ a ≤ ε ^ b :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le_one hba_loc
    have h_rpow_add : ε ^ e_asp * ε ^ b = ε ^ a := by
      dsimp only [e_asp]
      rw [← h_asp_eq, ← Real.rpow_add hε₀, sub_add_cancel]
    constructor
    · rw [h_in_tan]
      calc |Real.cos Δφ * inner ℝ w (u_pos e) + Real.sin Δφ * inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e))|
          ≤ |Real.cos Δφ * inner ℝ w (u_pos e)| + |Real.sin Δφ * inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e))| :=
            abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |Real.cos Δφ| * |inner ℝ w (u_pos e)| +
              |Real.sin Δφ| * |inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e))| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 * (C * ε ^ b) + 1 * (C * ε ^ a) :=
            add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul (Real.abs_cos_le_one Δφ) hw_ue (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
              (mul_le_mul (Real.abs_sin_le_one Δφ) hw_uperp (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
        _ ≤ C * ε ^ b + C * ε ^ b := by
            linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_mono hC_nn]
        _ = 2 * C * ε ^ b := by ring
    · rw [h_in_nrm]
      have h_sin_le : |Real.sin Δφ| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ e_asp :=
        le_trans Real.abs_sin_le_abs hΔφ_abs
      calc |Real.cos Δφ * inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e)) - Real.sin Δφ * inner ℝ w (u_pos e)|
          ≤ |Real.cos Δφ * inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e))| +
              |Real.sin Δφ * inner ℝ w (u_pos e)| :=
            abs_sub _ _
        _ = |Real.cos Δφ| * |inner ℝ w (perp2D (u_pos e))| +
              |Real.sin Δφ| * |inner ℝ w (u_pos e)| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 * (C * ε ^ a) + ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ e_asp) * (C * ε ^ b) :=
            add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul (Real.abs_cos_le_one Δφ) hw_uperp (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
              (mul_le_mul h_sin_le hw_ue (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
        _ = C * ε ^ a + (Real.pi / 2) * C * (ε ^ e_asp * ε ^ b) := by ring
        _ = (1 + Real.pi / 2) * C * ε ^ a := by rw [h_rpow_add]; ring

  let I_bin : ℝ → ℝ → ℤ → Finset ℤ := fun L x₀ K =>
    Finset.Icc (dyadicRealBin ε L x₀ - K) (dyadicRealBin ε L x₀ + K)
  have h_I_bin_card : ∀ (L x₀ : ℝ) (K : ℕ), (I_bin L x₀ (K : ℤ)).card = 2 * K + 1 := by
    intro L x₀ K
    dsimp only [I_bin]
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    omega

  have h_real_bin_mem : ∀ (L x x₀ : ℝ) (K : ℕ),
      |x - x₀| ≤ (K : ℝ) * ε ^ L →
      dyadicRealBin ε L x ∈ I_bin L x₀ (K : ℤ) := by
    intro L x x₀ K h_dist
    let m_L : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L := zpow_pos (by norm_num) m_L
    have h2m_le : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L ≤ ε ^ (-L) := by
      have h_fl : (m_L : ℝ) ≤ L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := Int.floor_le _
      have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
      have hlog2_ne : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlog2_pos
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_L : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) m_L).symm
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) h_fl
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2))) :=
            Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num) _
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log ε * (-L)) := by
            congr 1
            rw [Real.log_inv]
            field_simp [hlog2_ne]
        _ = ε ^ (-L) := (Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀ (-L)).symm
    have h_scaled : |x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L - x₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L| ≤ (K : ℝ) := by

              unfold finProbAt2
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              rw [hω_eq.1, hω_eq.2, hω₀_eq.1, hω₀_eq.2]
            dsimp only [u]
            rw [hp1_eq, hp2_eq]
          have h_sum_fib : ∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω = finProbAt2 π X Y ω₀ := by
            dsimp only [fib]
            rw [h_Fpos_filter_sum]
            unfold finProbAt2
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
            by_cases h_eq : X ω' = x_v ∧ Y ω' = y_v
            · have hs : g_sig ω' = ⟨x_v, y_v⟩ := (h_sig_iff ω').mpr h_eq
              have hr : X ω' = X ω₀ ∧ Y ω' = Y ω₀ :=
                ⟨h_eq.1.trans hω₀_eq.1.symm, h_eq.2.trans hω₀_eq.2.symm⟩
              simp only [hs, hr.1, hr.2, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
            · have hs : ¬ g_sig ω' = ⟨x_v, y_v⟩ := fun hg => h_eq ((h_sig_iff ω').mp hg)
              have hr : ¬ (X ω' = X ω₀ ∧ Y ω' = Y ω₀) :=
                fun hh => h_eq ⟨hh.1.trans hω₀_eq.1, hh.2.trans hω₀_eq.2⟩
              simp only [hs, hr, ↓reduceIte]
          have h_eq_val : ∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω * u ω = P_X x_v / M_r := by
            calc ∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω * u ω
                = ∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω * (P_X x_v / (finProbAt2 π X Y ω₀ * M_r)) :=
                  Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => by rw [hu_const ω hω])
              _ = (∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω) * (P_X x_v / (finProbAt2 π X Y ω₀ * M_r)) :=
                  (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
              _ = finProbAt2 π X Y ω₀ * (P_X x_v / (finProbAt2 π X Y ω₀ * M_r)) := by
                  rw [h_sum_fib]
              _ = P_X x_v / M_r := by
                  have hp2_ne : finProbAt2 π X Y ω₀ ≠ 0 := hp2_pos.ne'
                  field_simp [hp2_ne, hM_ne]
          exact h_eq_val.le
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h_ne, Finset.sum_empty]
          exact div_nonneg (hPX_nn x_v) hM_pos.le
      calc (∑ xy ∈ Sig, ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => g_sig ω = xy), π ω * u ω)
          ≤ ∑ xy ∈ Sig, P_X xy.1 / M_r := Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib_le
        _ = ∑ x ∈ F_pos.image X, ∑ _y ∈ S x, P_X x / M_r := by
            dsimp only [Sig]
            rw [Finset.sum_sigma]
        _ = ∑ x ∈ F_pos.image X, ((S x).card : ℝ) * (P_X x / M_r) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ F_pos.image X, M_r * (P_X x / M_r) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => ?_)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr (hS_card x))
              (div_nonneg (hPX_nn x) hM_pos.le)
        _ = ∑ x ∈ F_pos.image X, P_X x := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => mul_div_cancel₀ _ hM_ne)
        _ = ∑ x ∈ F_pos.image X, ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
            dsimp only [P_X]
            exact (h_Fpos_filter_sum (fun ω => X ω = x)).symm
        _ = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω :=
            Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω) π
        _ = 1 := h_sum_Fpos
    linarith

  
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let p_TG : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun tid g =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let S_cells : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image k_time
  let p_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then π ω else 0

  have h_Ew_eq : (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_star + (1 - γ) * a_star)) =
      (1 + γ) * b_star + (1 - γ) * a_star := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have h_pG_sum : ∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g = 1 := by
      dsimp only [p_G]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp [hπ_sum]
    rw [h_pG_sum, one_mul]

  have h_St_eq : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
      -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) / ell =
      finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_time := by
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    have h_rhs : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))) =
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          -(π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω))) / ell := by
      dsimp only [ell]
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
    rw [h_rhs]
    congr 1
    have h_prod_st : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
        -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) =
        ∑ tk ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) ×ˢ S_cells,
          -(p_TC tk.1 tk.2 * Real.log (p_TC tk.1 tk.2 / p_T tk.1)) :=
      (Finset.sum_product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) S_cells
        (fun tk => -(p_TC tk.1 tk.2 * Real.log (p_TC tk.1 tk.2 / p_T tk.1)))).symm
    rw [h_prod_st]
    have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
        (T_idx ω, k_time ω) ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) ×ˢ S_cells :=
      fun ω _ => Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_image_of_mem k_time (Finset.mem_univ ω)⟩
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tk _ => ?_)
    have h_inner : (∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω => (T_idx ω, k_time ω) = tk),
        -(π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω))) =
        ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω => (T_idx ω, k_time ω) = tk),
          -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tk.1 tk.2 / p_T tk.1)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have htk : T_idx ω = tk.1 ∧ k_time ω = tk.2 :=
        Prod.ext_iff.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      have hp2 : finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω = p_TC tk.1 tk.2 := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        dsimp only [p_TC]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all)
      have hp1 : finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T tk.1 := by
        unfold finProbAt
        dsimp only [p_T]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all)
      rw [hp2, hp1]
    rw [h_inner, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    have h_fib_sum : (∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω => (T_idx ω, k_time ω) = tk),
        π ω) = p_TC tk.1 tk.2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      dsimp only [p_TC]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [Prod.ext_iff])
    rw [h_fib_sum]

  have h_time_ent_step : finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_time - finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_dyad ≤
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_dyad ω)) k_time := by
    let TK_d : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T × ℤ := fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_dyad ω)
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    rw [h_sum_Fpos_mul, h_sum_Fpos_mul, h_sum_Fpos_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => ?_)
    have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
    have hpT_pos : 0 < finProbAt π T_idx ω :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (le_trans (h_prob_pos T_idx k_time ω hω).1
        (h_prob_pos T_idx k_time ω hω).2)
    have hpTC_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (h_prob_pos T_idx k_time ω hω).1
    have hpTD_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx k_dyad ω :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (h_prob_pos T_idx k_dyad ω hω).1
    have hpTKD_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π TK_d k_time ω :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (h_prob_pos TK_d k_time ω hω).1
    have hpTK_eq : finProbAt π TK_d ω = finProbAt2 π T_idx k_dyad ω := by
      unfold finProbAt finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [TK_d])
    have hp3_le_p2 : finProbAt2 π TK_d k_time ω ≤ finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω := by
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> first | exact le_rfl | exact hπ_nn ω' | simp_all [TK_d]
    have h_log_le : -(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) -
        (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_dyad ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω))) ≤
        -(Real.log (finProbAt2 π TK_d k_time ω / finProbAt π TK_d ω)) := by
      rw [hpTK_eq,
        Real.log_div hpTC_pos.ne' hpT_pos.ne',
        Real.log_div hpTD_pos.ne' hpT_pos.ne',
        Real.log_div hpTKD_pos.ne' hpTD_pos.ne']
      linarith [Real.log_le_log hpTKD_pos hp3_le_p2]
    have h_div_le := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_log_le hell_pos.le
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div_le hω_pos.le
    dsimp only [ell, TK_d] at h_mul
    have h_alg :
        π ω * ((-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) -
          (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_dyad ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) =
        π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) -
        π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_dyad ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :=
      by ring
    linarith [h_mul, h_alg]

  
  let I_TG : ℝ := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
    p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell

  have h_ITG_mul : I_TG * ell = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos,
      π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω /
        (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_idx ω)) := by
    dsimp only [I_TG]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell_ne]
    have h_prod_tg : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
        p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) =
        ∑ tg ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_G)),
          p_TG tg.1 tg.2 * Real.log (p_TG tg.1 tg.2 / (p_T tg.1 * p_G tg.2)) :=
      (Finset.sum_product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_G))
        (fun tg => p_TG tg.1 tg.2 * Real.log (p_TG tg.1 tg.2 / (p_T tg.1 * p_G tg.2)))).symm
    rw [h_prod_tg]
    have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ F_pos,
        (T_idx ω, G_idx ω) ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_G)) :=
      fun _ _ => Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tg _ => ?_)
    have h_inner : (∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G_idx ω) = tg),
        π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω /
          (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_idx ω))) =
        ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G_idx ω) = tg),
          π ω * Real.log (p_TG tg.1 tg.2 / (p_T tg.1 * p_G tg.2)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have htg : T_idx ω = tg.1 ∧ G_idx ω = tg.2 :=
        Prod.ext_iff.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      have hpTG : finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω = p_TG tg.1 tg.2 := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        dsimp only [p_TG]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all)
      have hpT : finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T tg.1 := by
        unfold finProbAt
        dsimp only [p_T]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all)
      have hpG : finProbAt π G_idx ω = p_G tg.2 := by
        unfold finProbAt
        dsimp only [p_G]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all)
      rw [hpTG, hpT, hpG]
    rw [h_inner, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    have h_fib_sum : (∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G_idx ω) = tg), π ω) =
        p_TG tg.1 tg.2 := by
      rw [h_Fpos_filter_sum]
      dsimp only [p_TG]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [Prod.ext_iff])
    rw [h_fib_sum]

  have h_MI_obs_mul : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_obs * ell = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos,
      π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω /
        (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_obs ω)) := by
    unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
    rw [h_sum_Fpos_mul, h_sum_Fpos_mul, sub_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
    have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
    have hpTB_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (h_prob_pos T_idx G_obs ω hω).1
    have hpT_pos : 0 < finProbAt π T_idx ω :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hpTB_pos (h_prob_pos T_idx G_obs ω hω).2
    have hpB_pos : 0 < finProbAt π G_obs ω :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (le_trans (h_prob_pos G_obs T_idx ω hω).1
        (h_prob_pos G_obs T_idx ω hω).2)
    have hp_unit : finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
      unfold finProbAt
      simp [hπ_sum]
    have hp2_unit : finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) G_obs ω = finProbAt π G_obs ω := by
      unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h_eq : G_obs ω' = G_obs ω
      · simp only [h_eq, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
      · simp only [h_eq, and_false, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [hp_unit, hp2_unit, div_one]
    have h_ell_cancel :
        (π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt π G_obs ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))) * ell -
          (π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) /
            Real.log (ε⁻¹))) * ell =
        π ω * (Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω) -
          Real.log (finProbAt π G_obs ω)) := by
      change (π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt π G_obs ω)) / ell)) * ell -
          (π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / ell)) * ell = _
      rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell_ne, mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell_ne]
      ring
    rw [h_ell_cancel, Real.log_div hpTB_pos.ne' hpT_pos.ne',
      Real.log_div hpTB_pos.ne' (mul_pos hpT_pos hpB_pos).ne',
      Real.log_mul hpT_pos.ne' hpB_pos.ne']
    ring

  have h_MI_step : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_obs - I_TG ≤ finCondEntropy ε π G_idx G_obs := by
    have h_CE_mul : finCondEntropy ε π G_idx G_obs * ell = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos,
        π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π G_idx G_obs ω / finProbAt π G_idx ω)) := by
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [h_sum_Fpos_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      change (π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π G_idx G_obs ω / finProbAt π G_idx ω)) / ell)) * ell = _
      rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell_ne]
    suffices h_mul_le :
        (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_obs - I_TG - finCondEntropy ε π G_idx G_obs) * ell ≤ 0 by
      have h_nonpos : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_obs - I_TG - finCondEntropy ε π G_idx G_obs ≤ 0 :=
        by nlinarith [h_mul_le, hell_pos]
      linarith
    rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, h_MI_obs_mul, h_ITG_mul, h_CE_mul,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    let v : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
      (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω * finProbAt2 π G_idx G_obs ω) /
        (finProbAt π G_obs ω * finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω)
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ F_pos,
        π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω /
            (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_obs ω)) -
          π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω /
            (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_idx ω)) -
          π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π G_idx G_obs ω / finProbAt π G_idx ω)) ≤
        π ω * v ω - π ω := by
      intro ω hω
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      have hpTB_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (h_prob_pos T_idx G_obs ω hω).1
      have hpT_pos : 0 < finProbAt π T_idx ω :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hpTB_pos (h_prob_pos T_idx G_obs ω hω).2
      have hpGB_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π G_idx G_obs ω :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (h_prob_pos G_idx G_obs ω hω).1
      have hpG_pos : 0 < finProbAt π G_idx ω :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hpGB_pos (h_prob_pos G_idx G_obs ω hω).2
      have hpTG_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (h_prob_pos T_idx G_idx ω hω).1
      have hpB_pos : 0 < finProbAt π G_obs ω :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos (le_trans (h_prob_pos G_obs T_idx ω hω).1
          (h_prob_pos G_obs T_idx ω hω).2)
      have hv_pos : 0 < v ω :=
        div_pos (mul_pos hpTB_pos hpGB_pos) (mul_pos hpB_pos hpTG_pos)
      have h_log_eq :
          Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω /
              (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_obs ω)) -
            Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω /
              (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_idx ω)) -
            (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π G_idx G_obs ω / finProbAt π G_idx ω)) =
          Real.log (v ω) := by
        dsimp only [v]
        rw [Real.log_div hpTB_pos.ne' (mul_pos hpT_pos hpB_pos).ne',
          Real.log_mul hpT_pos.ne' hpB_pos.ne',
          Real.log_div hpTG_pos.ne' (mul_pos hpT_pos hpG_pos).ne',
          Real.log_mul hpT_pos.ne' hpG_pos.ne',
          Real.log_div hpGB_pos.ne' hpG_pos.ne',
          Real.log_div (mul_pos hpTB_pos hpGB_pos).ne' (mul_pos hpB_pos hpTG_pos).ne',
          Real.log_mul hpTB_pos.ne' hpGB_pos.ne',
          Real.log_mul hpB_pos.ne' hpTG_pos.ne']
        ring
      have h_factor :
          π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω /
              (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_obs ω)) -
            π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω /
              (finProbAt π T_idx ω * finProbAt π G_idx ω)) -
            π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π G_idx G_obs ω / finProbAt π G_idx ω)) =
          π ω * Real.log (v ω) := by
        rw [← h_log_eq]
        ring
      rw [h_factor]
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hv_pos) hω_pos.le
      linarith
    have h_sum_pt := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    have h_rhs_pt : (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, (π ω * v ω - π ω)) = (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * v ω) - 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h_sum_Fpos]
    rw [h_rhs_pt] at h_sum_pt
    let B_im : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := F_pos.image G_obs
    let P_B : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ :=
      fun b => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if G_obs ω' = b then π ω' else 0
    let P_TB : Fin N_T → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ :=
      fun tid b => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω' = tid ∧ G_obs ω' = b then π ω' else 0
    let P_GB : Fin N_G → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ :=
      fun g b => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if G_idx ω' = g ∧ G_obs ω' = b then π ω' else 0
    have hPB_nn : ∀ b, 0 ≤ P_B b :=
      fun _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl)
    have hPTB_nn : ∀ tid b, 0 ≤ P_TB tid b :=
      fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl)
    have hPGB_nn : ∀ g b, 0 ≤ P_GB g b :=
      fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl)
    have : DecidableEq ((ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × Fin N_T × Fin N_G) := Classical.decEq _
    let Triples := B_im ×ˢ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_T)) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_G)))
    let g_tri : Fin N_ω → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × Fin N_T × Fin N_G :=
      fun ω => (G_obs ω, (T_idx ω, G_idx ω))
    have h_maps_tri : ∀ ω ∈ F_pos, g_tri ω ∈ Triples :=
      fun ω hω => Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem G_obs hω,
        Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_univ _⟩⟩
    have h_v_sum_le : ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * v ω ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps_tri]
      have h_fib_le : ∀ btg ∈ Triples,
          (∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => g_tri ω = btg), π ω * v ω) ≤
            (P_TB btg.2.1 btg.1 * P_GB btg.2.2 btg.1) / P_B btg.1 := by
        rintro ⟨b, tid, g⟩ _
        have h_tri_iff : ∀ ω' : Fin N_ω,
            g_tri ω' = (b, (tid, g)) ↔ G_obs ω' = b ∧ T_idx ω' = tid ∧ G_idx ω' = g := by
          intro ω'
          dsimp only [g_tri]
          constructor
          · intro h
            exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst h, congrArg (fun p => p.2.1) h, congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) h⟩
          · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
            rw [h1, h2, h3]
        let fib := F_pos.filter (fun ω => g_tri ω = (b, (tid, g)))
        change ∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω * v ω ≤ (P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / P_B b
        have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ (P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / P_B b :=
          div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hPTB_nn tid b) (hPGB_nn g b)) (hPB_nn b)
        by_cases h_ne : fib.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := h_ne
          have hω₀_pos : ω₀ ∈ F_pos := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀).1
          have hω₀_eq : G_obs ω₀ = b ∧ T_idx ω₀ = tid ∧ G_idx ω₀ = g :=
            (h_tri_iff ω₀).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀).2
          have hv_const : ∀ ω ∈ fib,
              v ω = (P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / (P_B b * p_TG tid g) := by
            intro ω hω_fib
            have hω_eq : G_obs ω = b ∧ T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g :=
              (h_tri_iff ω).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_fib).2
            have h1 : finProbAt2 π T_idx G_obs ω = P_TB tid b := by
              unfold finProbAt2; dsimp only [P_TB]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              rw [hω_eq.2.1, hω_eq.1]
              split_ifs <;> rfl
            have h2 : finProbAt2 π G_idx G_obs ω = P_GB g b := by
              unfold finProbAt2; dsimp only [P_GB]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              rw [hω_eq.2.2, hω_eq.1]
              split_ifs <;> rfl
            have h3 : finProbAt π G_obs ω = P_B b := by
              unfold finProbAt; dsimp only [P_B]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              rw [hω_eq.1]
              split_ifs <;> rfl
            have h4 : finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω = p_TG tid g := by
              unfold finProbAt2; dsimp only [p_TG]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              rw [hω_eq.2.1, hω_eq.2.2]
              split_ifs <;> rfl
            dsimp only [v]
            rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
          have hpTG_pos : 0 < p_TG tid g := by
            have hp0 : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω₀ :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_pos).2
                (h_prob_pos T_idx G_idx ω₀ hω₀_pos).1
            have h_eq : finProbAt2 π T_idx G_idx ω₀ = p_TG tid g := by
              unfold finProbAt2; dsimp only [p_TG]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              rw [hω₀_eq.2.1, hω₀_eq.2.2]
              split_ifs <;> rfl
            rwa [h_eq] at hp0
          have h_fib_le_pTG : ∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω ≤ p_TG tid g := by
            dsimp only [fib]
            rw [h_Fpos_filter_sum]
            dsimp only [p_TG]
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
            by_cases h_tr : g_tri ω' = (b, (tid, g))
            · have h_eqs := (h_tri_iff ω').mp h_tr
              simp only [h_tr, h_eqs.2.1, h_eqs.2.2, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
              exact le_rfl
            · simp only [h_tr, ↓reduceIte]
              split_ifs
              · exact hπ_nn ω'
              · exact le_rfl
          have h_ratio_le1 : (∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω) / p_TG tid g ≤ 1 :=
            (div_le_one hpTG_pos).mpr h_fib_le_pTG
          calc ∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω * v ω
              = ∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω * ((P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / (P_B b * p_TG tid g)) :=
                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => by rw [hv_const ω hω])
            _ = (∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω) * ((P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / (P_B b * p_TG tid g)) :=
                (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
            _ = ((∑ ω ∈ fib, π ω) / p_TG tid g) * ((P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / P_B b) := by
                ring
            _ ≤ 1 * ((P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / P_B b) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_ratio_le1 h_rhs_nn
            _ = (P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / P_B b := one_mul _
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h_ne, Finset.sum_empty]
          exact h_rhs_nn
      calc (∑ btg ∈ Triples, ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => g_tri ω = btg), π ω * v ω)
          ≤ ∑ btg ∈ Triples, (P_TB btg.2.1 btg.1 * P_GB btg.2.2 btg.1) / P_B btg.1 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib_le
        _ = ∑ b ∈ B_im, ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G, (P_TB tid b * P_GB g b) / P_B b := by
            dsimp only [Triples]
            rw [Finset.sum_product]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_product]
        _ = ∑ b ∈ B_im, P_B b := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b hb => ?_)
            obtain ⟨ω_b, hω_b_pos, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
            have hPB_pos : 0 < P_B (G_obs ω_b) := by
              have hp0 : 0 < finProbAt π G_obs ω_b :=
                lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_b_pos).2
                  (le_trans (h_prob_pos G_obs T_idx ω_b hω_b_pos).1
                    (h_prob_pos G_obs T_idx ω_b hω_b_pos).2)
              have h_eq : finProbAt π G_obs ω_b = P_B (G_obs ω_b) := by
                unfold finProbAt; dsimp only [P_B]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
                split_ifs <;> rfl
              rwa [h_eq] at hp0
            have h_sum_g : ∑ g : Fin N_G, P_GB g (G_obs ω_b) = P_B (G_obs ω_b) := by
              dsimp only [P_GB, P_B]
              rw [Finset.sum_comm]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases hb_eq : G_obs ω' = G_obs ω_b
              · simp only [hb_eq, and_true, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ]
              · simp only [hb_eq, and_false, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
            have h_sum_tid : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) = P_B (G_obs ω_b) := by
              dsimp only [P_TB, P_B]
              rw [Finset.sum_comm]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases hb_eq : G_obs ω' = G_obs ω_b
              · simp only [hb_eq, and_true, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ]
              · simp only [hb_eq, and_false, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
            have h_inner_g : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
                (∑ g : Fin N_G, (P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) * P_GB g (G_obs ω_b)) / P_B (G_obs ω_b)) =
                  P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) := by
              intro tid
              calc (∑ g : Fin N_G,
                    (P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) * P_GB g (G_obs ω_b)) / P_B (G_obs ω_b))
                  = ∑ g : Fin N_G,
                      (P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) / P_B (G_obs ω_b)) * P_GB g (G_obs ω_b) :=
                    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
                _ = (P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) / P_B (G_obs ω_b)) *
                      ∑ g : Fin N_G, P_GB g (G_obs ω_b) :=
                    (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
                _ = P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) := by
                    rw [h_sum_g, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hPB_pos.ne']
            calc (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
                  (P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) * P_GB g (G_obs ω_b)) / P_B (G_obs ω_b))
                = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, P_TB tid (G_obs ω_b) :=
                  Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => h_inner_g tid)
              _ = P_B (G_obs ω_b) := h_sum_tid
        _ = ∑ b ∈ B_im, ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => G_obs ω = b), π ω := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
            dsimp only [P_B]
            exact (h_Fpos_filter_sum (fun ω => G_obs ω = b)).symm
        _ = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω :=
            Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem G_obs hω) π
        _ = 1 := h_sum_Fpos
    linarith

  
  have h_fib_obs : finCondEntropy ε π G_idx G_obs ≤ Real.log ((4096 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ell :=
    h_cond_ent_fiber G_idx G_obs S_G 4096 (by omega)
      (fun g => hS_obs_card _ _ _ _) h_Gobs_mem

  have h_fib_time : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_dyad ω)) k_time ≤
      Real.log ((2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ell :=
    h_cond_ent_fiber (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_dyad ω)) k_time
      (fun tk => S_time tk.2) (2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 2) (by omega)
      (fun tk => hS_time_card tk.2) h_ktime_mem

  have h_log_4096 : Real.log ((4096 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 12 := by
    have h_pow : ((4096 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (12 : ℕ) := by norm_num
    have h_log2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
      linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    rw [h_pow, Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    linarith

  have h_log_4096_div : Real.log ((4096 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ell ≤ 12 / ell :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_log_4096 hell_pos.le

  refine ⟨c_s, θ_s, h_law, ?_⟩
  have h_cl_eq : classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx
      (fun _ => b_star) (fun _ => a_star) =
      ((1 + γ) * b_star + (1 - γ) * a_star) - I_TG +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_time := by
    unfold classicalTransportScore
    dsimp only [ell, p_T, p_G, p_TG, S_cells, p_TC, I_TG] at h_Ew_eq h_St_eq ⊢
    rw [h_Ew_eq, h_St_eq]
  have h_std_eq : stdApertureScore ε γ t b_star a_star π T_idx V₁ A₁ c_s θ_s =
      ((1 + γ) * b_star + (1 - γ) * a_star) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_obs +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_dyad := rfl
  rw [h_cl_eq, h_std_eq]
  have h_pen_split : (2 * Real.log ((2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 12) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
      2 * (Real.log ((2 * ⌈B_cl⌉₊ + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ell) + 12 / ell := by
    dsimp only [ell]
    ring
  rw [h_pen_split]
  linarith [h_MI_step, h_fib_obs, h_time_ent_step, h_fib_time, h_log_4096_div]

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_s1 :
      (∀ (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        let j := isoPrefixCell ε b_star V_p A_p
        let v_j := isoPrefixCenter ε b_star j.1 j.2.1
        let a_j := isoPrefixCenter ε b_star j.2.2.1 j.2.2.2
        ‖isoPrefixLocalVec ε b_star v_j V_p‖ ≤ 1 ∧
        ‖isoPrefixLocalVec ε b_star a_j A_p‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      ∃ F_amb : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) →
          Finset ((ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)),
        (∀ g, (F_amb g).card ≤ 99225) ∧
        ∀ (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c θ : ℝ),
          c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
          let g := stdApertureObs ε t b_star a_star V_p A_p c θ
          let j := isoPrefixCell ε b_star V_p A_p
          let v_j := isoPrefixCenter ε b_star j.1 j.2.1
          let a_j := isoPrefixCenter ε b_star j.2.2.1 j.2.2.2
          let V' := isoPrefixLocalVec ε b_star v_j V_p
          let A' := isoPrefixLocalVec ε b_star a_j A_p
          let g_loc := stdApertureObs ε t 0 (a_star - b_star) V' A' c θ
          (j, g_loc) ∈ F_amb g := by
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hlog2_ne : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlog2_pos
    have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have h_dyad_step : ∀ L : ℝ,
        0 < dyadicRealStep ε L ∧
        dyadicRealStep ε L * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L) = 1 ∧
        ε ^ L ≤ dyadicRealStep ε L ∧
        dyadicRealStep ε L < 2 * ε ^ L := by
      intro L
      let m_L : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
      have hδ_pos : 0 < dyadicRealStep ε L := by
        unfold dyadicRealStep
        exact zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (-m_L)
      have hδ_mul : dyadicRealStep ε L * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L = 1 := by
        unfold dyadicRealStep
        rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero]
      let α : ℝ := L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
      have h_two_alpha : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) = ε ^ L := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀]
        congr 1
        dsimp only [α]
        rw [Real.log_inv]
        field_simp [hlog2_ne]
      have h_step_rpow : dyadicRealStep ε L = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m_L : ℝ)) := by
        unfold dyadicRealStep
        change (2 : ℝ) ^ (-m_L) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m_L : ℝ))
        rw [← Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) (-m_L), Int.cast_neg]
      have hm_le : (m_L : ℝ) ≤ α := Int.floor_le α
      have hm_lt : α < (m_L : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one α
      have h_ge : ε ^ L ≤ dyadicRealStep ε L := by
        rw [← h_two_alpha, h_step_rpow]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      have h_lt : dyadicRealStep ε L < 2 * ε ^ L := by
        have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m_L : ℝ)) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α + 1) :=
          Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α + 1) = 2 * ε ^ L := by
          rw [Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one, h_two_alpha, mul_comm]
        linarith [h_step_rpow, h1, h2]
      exact ⟨hδ_pos, hδ_mul, h_ge, h_lt⟩
    have h_mid_err : ∀ (L x : ℝ),
        |x - ((dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L| ≤ ε ^ L := by
      intro L x
      obtain ⟨hδ_pos, hδ_mul, _, hδ_lt⟩ := h_dyad_step L
      let m_L : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
      let δ_L : ℝ := dyadicRealStep ε L
      have hk_lo : (dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) ≤ x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L := Int.floor_le _
      have hk_hi : x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L < (dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hx_eq : (x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L) * δ_L = x := by
        dsimp only [m_L, δ_L]
        rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L)) (dyadicRealStep ε L),
          hδ_mul, mul_one]
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk_lo hδ_pos.le
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hk_hi hδ_pos
      rw [hx_eq] at h1 h2
      have ha1 : ((dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * δ_L =
          (dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) * δ_L + (1 / 2) * δ_L := by ring
      have ha2 : ((dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) + 1) * δ_L =
          (dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) * δ_L + δ_L := by ring
      rw [abs_le]
      dsimp only [δ_L] at ha1 ha2 h1 h2
      constructor <;> linarith

  have h_s2 : ∀ (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (B A_dep : ℝ)

    intro j B A_dep e_loc V_loc A_loc hB_nn hBA hA_le he_loc
    let v_j := isoPrefixCenter ε b_star j.1 j.2.1
    let a_j := isoPrefixCenter ε b_star j.2.2.1 j.2.2.2

    let A_sub : Fin 16 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun m =>

    have h_pp : inner ℝ (perp2D e_loc) (perp2D e_loc) = 1 := by

      simp only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, Fin.one_eq_zero_iff]

          (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π₂ ω) ∧

          (∀ ω, 0 < π₂ ω → J_part (T_idx ω) = j_star ∧ 0 < π₁ ω) ∧
          ((2 * b_star - finMutualInfo ε π₁ T_idx G_glob + 2 * finCondEntropy ε π₁ T_idx k_t) -
            classicalRootSupremum ε L_glob γ N_ω N_T π₁ T_idx V₁ A₁) ≤
          ((-finMutualInfo ε π₂ T_idx (G_loc j_star) + 2 * finCondEntropy ε π₂ T_idx k_t) -
            classicalRootSupremum ε L_loc γ N_ω N_T π₂ T_idx
              (V_loc_part j_star) (A_loc_part j_star)) +
            (Real.log (K_amb : ℝ) + Real.log 16 + 1) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro L_loc L_glob K_amb hL_loc hL_glob hK_amb
      J_part V_loc_part A_loc_part G_glob G_loc k_t F_amb
      hVA_loc hF_card hF_mem h_lift
    classical
    obtain ⟨hπ₁_nn, hπ₁_sum, hVA₁, _⟩ := h_law
    let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := by
      dsimp only [ell]
      rw [Real.log_inv, neg_pos]
      exact Real.log_neg hε₀ (by linarith)
    have hell_ne : ell ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hell_pos
    let J : Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun ω => J_part (T_idx ω)
    let p_J_fn : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ :=
      fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π₁ ω else 0
    let π_fib : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin N_ω → ℝ :=
      fun j ω => if J ω = j then π₁ ω / p_J_fn j else 0
    let S_J : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.univ.image J
    let J_pos : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := S_J.filter (fun j => 0 < p_J_fn j)
    have hp_J_nn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p_J_fn j := fun j =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₁_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
    have hω_le_pJ : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, π₁ ω ≤ p_J_fn (J ω) := by
      intro ω
      dsimp only [p_J_fn]
      have h1 : (if J ω = J ω then π₁ ω else 0) ≤
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if J ω' = J ω then π₁ ω' else 0 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω' => if J ω' = J ω then π₁ ω' else 0)
          (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₁_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
          (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      simpa using h1
    have hω_mem_Jpos : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π₁ ω → J ω ∈ J_pos := by
      intro ω hω
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem J (Finset.mem_univ ω), lt_of_lt_of_le hω (hω_le_pJ ω)⟩
    have h_sum_Jpos : ∀ f : Fin N_ω → ℝ, (∀ ω, π₁ ω = 0 → f ω = 0) →

      intro f hf0
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq J_pos (J ω) (fun _ => f ω)]
      by_cases hω : π₁ ω = 0
      · rw [hf0 ω hω, ite_self]
      · have hpos : 0 < π₁ ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ₁_nn ω) (Ne.symm hω)

    have hp_J_sum : ∑ j ∈ J_pos, p_J_fn j = 1 := by
      calc ∑ j ∈ J_pos, p_J_fn j

    have hJ_pos_ne : J_pos.Nonempty := by

      · dsimp only [π_fib]

          rw [Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> simp
        rw [h_rw]
        exact div_self hpj.ne'
      · intro ω hω
        dsimp only [π_fib] at hω
        split_ifs at hω with hJ
        · exact ⟨hJ, (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hpj).mp hω⟩
        · linarith
    
    let B_pair : Fin N_ω → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=

      dsimp only [π_fib]
      split_ifs with hT hJ'
      · rfl
      · exfalso; apply hJ'; dsimp only [J] at hJω ⊢; rw [hT, hJω]
      · simp
    have h_prob2_T_fib : ∀ {β : Type} (Y : Fin N_ω → β), ∀ j ∈ J_pos, ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, J ω = j →

      intro β Y j _ ω hJω
      unfold finProbAt2
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [π_fib]
      split_ifs with hTY hJ'
      · rfl
      · exfalso; apply hJ'; dsimp only [J] at hJω ⊢; rw [hTY.1, hJω]
      · simp
    have h_ent_kt_eq :
        ∑ j ∈ J_pos, p_J_fn j * finCondEntropy ε (π_fib j) T_idx k_t =

      calc ∑ j ∈ J_pos, p_J_fn j * finCondEntropy ε (π_fib j) T_idx k_t

            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            dsimp only [π_fib]
            split_ifs with hJω
            · have hp1 := h_prob_T_fib j hj ω hJω
              have hp2 := h_prob2_T_fib k_t j hj ω hJω
              unfold condSurprise
              rw [hp1, hp2, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hpj.ne']

            unfold finCondEntropy
            exact h_sum_Jpos _ (fun ω h0 => by simp [h0])
    have h_ent_TB_eq :
        ∑ j ∈ J_pos, p_J_fn j * finCondEntropy ε (π_fib j) T_idx (G_loc j) =
          finCondEntropy ε π₁ T_idx B_pair := by
      calc ∑ j ∈ J_pos, p_J_fn j * finCondEntropy ε (π_fib j) T_idx (G_loc j)
          = ∑ j ∈ J_pos, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
              if J ω = j then π₁ ω * condSurprise ε π₁ T_idx B_pair ω else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
            have hpj : 0 < p_J_fn j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
            unfold finCondEntropy
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            dsimp only [π_fib]
            split_ifs with hJω
            · have hp1 := h_prob_T_fib j hj ω hJω
              have hp2 := h_prob2_T_fib (G_loc j) j hj ω hJω
              have hp2_B : finProbAt2 π₁ T_idx (G_loc j) ω = finProbAt2 π₁ T_idx B_pair ω := by
                unfold finProbAt2
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
                have h_iff : (T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ G_loc j ω' = G_loc j ω) ↔

                  constructor
                  · rintro ⟨hT, hG⟩
                    have hJ' : J ω' = j := by dsimp only [J] at hJω ⊢; rw [hT, hJω]

                  · rintro ⟨hT, hB⟩
                    have hJ' : J ω' = j := by dsimp only [J] at hJω ⊢; rw [hT, hJω]

                    rw [hJ', hJω] at hB2

              rw [hp1, hp2, hp2_B, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hpj.ne']

            · ring

            unfold finCondEntropy
            exact h_sum_Jpos _ (fun ω h0 => by simp [h0])
    have h_ent_B_eq :
        ∑ j ∈ J_pos, p_J_fn j * finCondEntropy ε (π_fib j) (fun _ => ()) (G_loc j) =

      have h_unit_glob : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt π₁ (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
        intro ω; unfold finProbAt; simpa using hπ₁_sum
      have h_per_j : ∀ j ∈ J_pos,
          p_J_fn j * finCondEntropy ε (π_fib j) (fun _ => ()) (G_loc j) =
            (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then

            (p_J_fn j * Real.log (p_J_fn j)) / ell := by
        intro j hj
        obtain ⟨hpj, _, hfib_sum, _⟩ := h_fib_law j hj
        have h_unit_fib : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt (π_fib j) (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
          intro ω; unfold finProbAt; simpa using hfib_sum
        have h_term : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
            p_J_fn j * (π_fib j ω * condSurprise ε (π_fib j) (fun _ => ()) (G_loc j) ω) =
              (if J ω = j then π₁ ω * condSurprise ε π₁ (fun _ => ()) B_pair ω else 0) +
              (if J ω = j then π₁ ω else 0) * (Real.log (p_J_fn j) / ell) := by
          intro ω
          dsimp only [π_fib]
          split_ifs with hJω
          · by_cases hπ0 : π₁ ω = 0
            · simp [hπ0]
            · have hπ_pos : 0 < π₁ ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ₁_nn ω) (Ne.symm hπ0)
              have hp2_eq : finProbAt2 (π_fib j) (fun _ => ()) (G_loc j) ω =
                  finProbAt2 π₁ (fun _ => ()) B_pair ω / p_J_fn j := by
                unfold finProbAt2
                rw [Finset.sum_div]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
                dsimp only [π_fib]
                have h_iff : (() = () ∧ B_pair ω' = B_pair ω) ↔

                  constructor
                  · rintro ⟨_, hB⟩
                    obtain ⟨hB1, hB2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hB
                    have hJ' : J ω' = j := hB1.trans hJω
                    rw [hJ', hJω] at hB2
                    exact ⟨hJ', hB2⟩
                  · rintro ⟨hJ', hG⟩
                    exact ⟨rfl, Prod.ext (hJ'.trans hJω.symm)
                      (by dsimp only [B_pair]; rwa [hJ', hJω])⟩
                by_cases hJ' : J ω' = j

                  by_cases hG : G_loc j ω' = G_loc j ω

                    have hR : ¬(() = () ∧ B_pair ω' = B_pair ω) := fun h => hG (h_iff.mp h).2
                    rw [if_neg hL, if_neg hR, zero_div]

                have hle : (if (() = () ∧ B_pair ω = B_pair ω) then π₁ ω else 0) ≤
                    ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if () = () ∧ B_pair ω' = B_pair ω then π₁ ω' else 0 :=
                  Finset.single_le_sum
                    (f := fun ω' => if () = () ∧ B_pair ω' = B_pair ω then π₁ ω' else 0)
                    (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₁_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
                    (Finset.mem_univ ω)
                exact lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_pos (by simpa using hle)

        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => h_term ω),

        dsimp only [p_J_fn]
        ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_per_j, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        h_sum_Jpos _ (fun ω h0 => by simp [h0])]
      unfold finCondEntropy
      dsimp only [H_J]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      ring
    have h_mi_eq :
        ∑ j ∈ J_pos, p_J_fn j * finMutualInfo ε (π_fib j) T_idx (G_loc j) =
          finMutualInfo ε π₁ T_idx B_pair - H_J := by

        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        unfold finMutualInfo
        ring
      rw [h_split, h_ent_B_eq, h_ent_TB_eq]
      unfold finMutualInfo
      ring

    
    let S_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π₁ ω)
    have h_sum_Spos : ∀ f : Fin N_ω → ℝ, ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π₁ ω * f ω = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π₁ ω * f ω := by
      intro f
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (fun ω _ hnot => ?_)
      have hle : π₁ ω ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hp⟩))
      have h0 : π₁ ω = 0 := le_antisymm hle (hπ₁_nn ω)
      simp [h0]
    have h_Spos_one : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π₁ ω = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_sum_Spos (fun _ => 1)

    have h_mi_chain :
        finMutualInfo ε π₁ T_idx B_pair ≤
          finMutualInfo ε π₁ T_idx G_glob + finCondEntropy ε π₁ G_glob B_pair := by
      let p_A := fun ω => finProbAt π₁ G_glob ω
      let p_B := fun ω => finProbAt π₁ B_pair ω
      let p_T := fun ω => finProbAt π₁ T_idx ω
      let p_TA := fun ω => finProbAt2 π₁ T_idx G_glob ω
      let p_TB := fun ω => finProbAt2 π₁ T_idx B_pair ω
      let p_AB := fun ω => finProbAt2 π₁ G_glob B_pair ω
      let p_TAB := fun ω => finProbAt2 π₁ T_idx (fun ω' => (G_glob ω', B_pair ω')) ω
      have h_unit_1 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt π₁ (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
        intro ω; unfold finProbAt; simpa using hπ₁_sum
      have h_unit_2 : ∀ {β : Type} (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
          finProbAt2 π₁ (fun _ => ()) Y ω = finProbAt π₁ Y ω := by
        intro β Y ω; unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt; simp
      have h_pos_probs : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos,

        intro ω hω
        have hπ_pos : 0 < π₁ ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        have h1 : ∀ {α : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α), 0 < finProbAt π₁ X ω := by

          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          have hle := Finset.single_le_sum

            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₁_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
            (Finset.mem_univ ω)

        have h2 : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),

          intro α β X Y; unfold finProbAt2
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun ω' => if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then π₁ ω' else 0)
            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₁_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
            (Finset.mem_univ ω)
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_pos (by simpa using hle)
        exact ⟨h1 _, h1 _, h1 _, h2 _ _, h2 _ _, h2 _ _, h2 _ _⟩
      
      have h_pt_lb : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos,
          1 - (p_AB ω * p_TB ω) / (p_B ω * p_TAB ω) ≤
            ell * ((condSurprise ε π₁ (fun _ => ()) G_glob ω - condSurprise ε π₁ T_idx G_glob ω) +
              condSurprise ε π₁ G_glob B_pair ω -
              (condSurprise ε π₁ (fun _ => ()) B_pair ω - condSurprise ε π₁ T_idx B_pair ω)) := by
        intro ω hω
        obtain ⟨hpA, hpB, hpT, hpTA, hpTB, hpAB, hpTAB⟩ := h_pos_probs ω hω
        have hpTAB_le_pTA : p_TAB ω ≤ p_TA ω := by
          dsimp only [p_TAB, p_TA]
          unfold finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs with h1 h2
          · exact le_rfl
          · exfalso; exact h2 ⟨h1.1, (Prod.mk.inj h1.2).1⟩
          · exact hπ₁_nn ω'
          · exact le_rfl
        have h_term1 : 0 ≤ -Real.log (p_TAB ω / p_TA ω) := by
          have h_le1 : p_TAB ω / p_TA ω ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hpTA).mpr hpTAB_le_pTA
          have h_nn : 0 ≤ p_TAB ω / p_TA ω := div_nonneg hpTAB.le hpTA.le
          linarith [Real.log_nonpos h_nn h_le1]

        have h_term2 : 1 - (p_AB ω * p_TB ω) / (p_B ω * p_TAB ω) ≤
            -Real.log ((p_AB ω * p_TB ω) / (p_B ω * p_TAB ω)) := by
          linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos h_ratio_pos]
        have h_rhs_eq :
            ell * ((condSurprise ε π₁ (fun _ => ()) G_glob ω - condSurprise ε π₁ T_idx G_glob ω) +
              condSurprise ε π₁ G_glob B_pair ω -
              (condSurprise ε π₁ (fun _ => ()) B_pair ω - condSurprise ε π₁ T_idx B_pair ω)) =
            (-Real.log (p_TAB ω / p_TA ω)) +
              (-Real.log ((p_AB ω * p_TB ω) / (p_B ω * p_TAB ω))) := by
          unfold condSurprise
          rw [h_unit_1, h_unit_2, h_unit_2, div_one, div_one]
          change ell * ((-Real.log (p_A ω) / ell - -Real.log (p_TA ω / p_T ω) / ell) +
              -Real.log (p_AB ω / p_A ω) / ell -
              (-Real.log (p_B ω) / ell - -Real.log (p_TB ω / p_T ω) / ell)) =
            (-Real.log (p_TAB ω / p_TA ω)) +
              (-Real.log ((p_AB ω * p_TB ω) / (p_B ω * p_TAB ω)))
          rw [Real.log_div hpTA.ne' hpT.ne',
            Real.log_div hpAB.ne' hpA.ne',
            Real.log_div hpTB.ne' hpT.ne',
            Real.log_div hpTAB.ne' hpTA.ne',
            Real.log_div (mul_pos hpAB hpTB).ne' (mul_pos hpB hpTAB).ne',
            Real.log_mul hpAB.ne' hpTB.ne',
            Real.log_mul hpB.ne' hpTAB.ne']
          field_simp [hell_ne]
          ring
        rw [h_rhs_eq]
        linarith
      
      let S_A := S_pos.image G_glob

                _ = p_TAB ω₀ := by
                    dsimp only [p_TAB]; unfold finProbAt2
                    letI := Classical.propDecidable
                    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
                    have h_iff : (B_pair ω = b₀ ∧ T_idx ω = t₀ ∧ G_glob ω = a₀) ↔

            have h_const : ∀ ω ∈ fib,
                f_rat ω = π₁ ω * ((P_AB a₀ b₀ * P_TB t₀ b₀) / (P_B b₀ * p_TAB ω₀)) := by

    have h_amb_ub :
        finCondEntropy ε π₁ G_glob B_pair ≤ Real.log (K_amb : ℝ) / ell := by
      have hK_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (K_amb : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hK_amb)

      have h_pt_ub : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos,
          ell * condSurprise ε π₁ G_glob B_pair ω - Real.log (K_amb : ℝ) ≤
            p_A ω / ((K_amb : ℝ) * p_AB ω) - 1 := by
        intro ω hω

        have hpA : 0 < p_A ω := by
          dsimp only [p_A]; unfold finProbAt
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun ω' => if G_glob ω' = G_glob ω then π₁ ω' else 0)
            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₁_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
            (Finset.mem_univ ω)
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_pos (by simpa using hle)
        have hpAB : 0 < p_AB ω := by
          dsimp only [p_AB]; unfold finProbAt2
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun ω' => if G_glob ω' = G_glob ω ∧ B_pair ω' = B_pair ω then π₁ ω' else 0)
            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₁_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
            (Finset.mem_univ ω)

        have h_eq : ell * condSurprise ε π₁ G_glob B_pair ω - Real.log (K_amb : ℝ) =

          rw [Real.log_div hpAB.ne' hpA.ne',
            Real.log_div hpA.ne' (mul_pos hK_pos hpAB).ne',
            Real.log_mul hK_pos.ne' hpAB.ne']

        exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hpA (mul_pos hK_pos hpAB))
      let A_pos := S_pos.image G_glob
      let P_A := fun a₀ => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if G_glob ω' = a₀ then π₁ ω' else 0
      have h_sum_amb_le1 :
          ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π₁ ω * (p_A ω / ((K_amb : ℝ) * p_AB ω)) ≤ 1 := by
        let f_amb := fun ω : Fin N_ω => π₁ ω * (p_A ω / ((K_amb : ℝ) * p_AB ω))
        have h_partA : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, f_amb ω =
            ∑ a₀ ∈ A_pos, ∑ b₀ ∈ F_amb a₀,
              ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, if G_glob ω = a₀ ∧ B_pair ω = b₀ then f_amb ω else 0 := by
          trans (∑ a₀ ∈ A_pos, ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, if G_glob ω = a₀ then f_amb ω else 0)
          · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq A_pos (G_glob ω) (fun _ => f_amb ω),
              if_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem G_glob hω)]
          · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a₀ _ => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
            have hπ_pos : 0 < π₁ ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            split_ifs with ha
            · have hb_mem : B_pair ω ∈ F_amb a₀ := by
                rw [← ha]; exact hF_mem ω hπ_pos
              have h_in : (∑ b₀ ∈ F_amb a₀, if G_glob ω = a₀ ∧ B_pair ω = b₀ then f_amb ω else 0) =

                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₀ _ => by simp [ha])
              rw [h_in, Finset.sum_ite_eq (F_amb a₀) (B_pair ω) (fun _ => f_amb ω), if_pos hb_mem]
            · refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b₀ _ => ?_)).symm
              split_ifs with hab
              · exact absurd hab.1 ha
              · rfl
        have h_cell_le : ∀ a₀ ∈ A_pos, ∀ b₀ ∈ F_amb a₀,
            (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, if G_glob ω = a₀ ∧ B_pair ω = b₀ then f_amb ω else 0) ≤

    ⟨hπ₂_nn, hπ₂_sum, hVA_loc j_star, fun ω hω => h_supp₁ ω (hπ₂_supp ω hω).2⟩
  have h_err_23 :
      (Real.log (99225 : ℝ) + Real.log 16 + 1) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ 23 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    have hell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      rw [Real.log_inv, neg_pos]
      exact Real.log_neg hε₀ (by linarith)
    have hlog2_le1 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
      linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    have h_prod_le : (99225 : ℝ) * 16 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (21 : ℕ) := by norm_num
    have h_log_sum : Real.log (99225 : ℝ) + Real.log 16 ≤ 21 := by
      calc Real.log (99225 : ℝ) + Real.log 16
          = Real.log ((99225 : ℝ) * 16) := (Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).symm
        _ ≤ Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ (21 : ℕ)) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h_prod_le
        _ = 21 * Real.log 2 := by rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num
        _ ≤ 21 * 1 := by linarith
        _ = 21 := by norm_num
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hell_pos.le
  refine ⟨π₂, V₂, A₂, h_law₂, ?_⟩
  unfold stdApertureScore
  have hw_id : ((1 + γ) * b_star + (1 - γ) * a_star) -
      ((1 + γ) * 0 + (1 - γ) * (a_star - b_star)) = 2 * b_star := by ring
  dsimp only [G_glob, G_loc, k_t, V₂, A₂, π₂, p_J] at h_glued_ineq ⊢
  linarith [h_glued_ineq, h_err_23, hw_id]

isotropic_prefix_std_localization.definitions:
noncomputable def isoPrefixCell (ε b_star : ℝ)
    (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  (dyadicRealBin ε b_star (V_p 0),
   dyadicRealBin ε b_star (V_p 1),
   dyadicRealBin ε b_star (A_p 0),
   dyadicRealBin ε b_star (A_p 1))

noncomputable def isoPrefixCenter (ε b_star : ℝ) (j₀ j₁ : ℤ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2
    ![((j₀ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_star,
      ((j₁ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_star]

noncomputable def isoPrefixLocalVec (ε b_star : ℝ)
    (center vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  ((2 * ε ^ b_star)⁻¹) • (vec - center)
