signature.statement:
(s σ : ℝ) (a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (blk : CanonicalAffineBlockTied s σ a_pt) :
    Nonempty (ThreeReplicaHomogProfile s σ a_pt blk)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  let P_law : ∀ l : ℕ, (Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l)) → ℝ :=
    fun l b => ∑ i : Fin (blk.N_P l), threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b.2.1 b.2.2
  let par_fn : ∀ N : ℕ, Fin 3 → (Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → Option (Fin N) × Option (Fin N) :=
    fun N r b =>
      if r = 0 then (some b.1, none)
      else if r = 1 then (none, some b.2.1)
      else (some b.1, some b.2.1)
  let chart_fn : ∀ l : ℕ, Fin 3 →
      (Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l)) → Fin 4 :=
    fun l r b =>
      if r = 0 then s1Chart (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1))
      else if r = 1 then s1Chart (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1))
      else 0
  let val_fn : ∀ l : ℕ, Fin 3 →
      (Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l)) → ℝ :=
    fun l r b =>
      if r = 0 then s1Coord (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1))
      else if r = 1 then s1Coord (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1))
      else inner ℝ (flip2D (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1)))
        (paramVec blk l b.2.2)
  let parMass : ∀ {N : ℕ}, ((Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → ℝ) →
      ((Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → Option (Fin N) × Option (Fin N)) →
      (Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → ℝ :=
    fun P par b => ∑ b', if par b' = par b then P b' else 0
  let jointMass : ∀ {N : ℕ}, ℝ → ((Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → ℝ) →
      ((Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → Option (Fin N) × Option (Fin N)) →
      ((Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → Fin 4) →
      ((Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → ℝ) →
      ℝ → (Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → ℝ :=
    fun ρ P par chart val d b =>
      ∑ b', if par b' = par b ∧
          (chart b', dyadicRealBin ρ d (val b')) = (chart b, dyadicRealBin ρ d (val b))
        then P b' else 0

  
  
  
  have h_star_nn : ∀ (l : ℕ) (i : Fin (blk.N_P l)) (b₀ b₁ b₂ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l)),
      0 ≤ threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂ := by
    intro l i b₀ b₁ b₂
    dsimp [threeReplicaStar]
    split_ifs with hμ
    · exact div_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (blk.hπ_nn l i b₀) (blk.hπ_nn l i b₁)) (blk.hπ_nn l i b₂))
        (sq_nonneg _)
    · exact le_rfl

  have hP_nn : ∀ (l : ℕ) (b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l)),
      0 ≤ P_law l b :=
    fun l b => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => h_star_nn l i b.1 b.2.1 b.2.2)

  have hP_sum : ∀ l : ℕ,
      (∑ b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l), P_law l b) = 1 := by
    intro l
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h_swap : (∑ b₀ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), ∑ b₁ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), ∑ b₂ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l),
          ∑ i : Fin (blk.N_P l), threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂) =
        ∑ i : Fin (blk.N_P l), ∑ b₀ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), ∑ b₁ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l),
          ∑ b₂ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂ := by
      calc (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ b₂, ∑ i, threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂)
          = ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ i, ∑ b₂, threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂ :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm))
        _ = ∑ b₀, ∑ i, ∑ b₁, ∑ b₂, threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂ :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
        _ = ∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ b₂, threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂ := Finset.sum_comm
    rw [h_swap]
    have h_each_i : ∀ i : Fin (blk.N_P l),
        (∑ b₀ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), ∑ b₁ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), ∑ b₂ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l),
          threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂) = ∑ b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), blk.π_seq l i b := by
      intro i
      let μ_i := ∑ b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), blk.π_seq l i b
      have hμ_nn : 0 ≤ μ_i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => blk.hπ_nn l i b)
      by_cases hμ : 0 < μ_i
      · have h_term : ∀ b₀ b₁ b₂ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l),
            threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂ =
              (μ_i ^ 2)⁻¹ * (blk.π_seq l i b₀ * (blk.π_seq l i b₁ * blk.π_seq l i b₂)) := by
          intro b₀ b₁ b₂
          dsimp [threeReplicaStar]
          rw [if_pos hμ]
          ring
        simp_rw [h_term, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        change (μ_i ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∑ b₀, blk.π_seq l i b₀ * (∑ b₁, blk.π_seq l i b₁ * μ_i)) = μ_i
        have h1 : (∑ b₁ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), blk.π_seq l i b₁ * μ_i) = μ_i * μ_i := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        simp_rw [h1, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        change (μ_i ^ 2)⁻¹ * (μ_i * (μ_i * μ_i)) = μ_i
        field_simp [hμ.ne']
      · have hμ0 : μ_i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hμ) hμ_nn
        have h_z : ∀ b₀ b₁ b₂ : Fin (blk.N_Θ l), threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂ = 0 := by
          intro b₀ b₁ b₂
          dsimp [threeReplicaStar]
          exact if_neg hμ
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ =>
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => h_z _ _ _)))]
        exact hμ0.symm
    simp_rw [h_each_i]
    exact blk.hπ_sum l

  have h_norm_sq2 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ^ 2 = (v 0) ^ 2 + (v 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

  have h_dirVec_unit : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖dirVec v‖ = 1 := by
    intro v
    dsimp [dirVec]
    split_ifs with hv
    · have hsq : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq2]
        simp
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))]
    · have hvn : ‖v‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hv
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg v)),
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hvn]

  have h_flip_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖flip2D v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    have hsq : ‖flip2D v‖ ^ 2 = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_norm_sq2, h_norm_sq2]
      dsimp [flip2D]
      simp [add_comm]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (flip2D v), norm_nonneg v]

  have h_s1Coord_le : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 → |s1Coord e| ≤ 1 := by
    intro e he
    have he_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_norm_sq2 e
      rw [he] at h1
      linarith
    have h_uv_sq : (e 0 + e 1) ^ 2 + (e 0 - e 1) ^ 2 = 2 := by linarith
    have h_div_bound : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < b → a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 → |a / b| ≤ 1 := by
      intro a b hb hsq
      have hab : |a| ≤ b := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg a, sq_abs a]
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hb, div_le_one hb]
      exact hab
    dsimp [s1Coord, s1Chart]
    split_ifs with h0 h1 h2
    · change |e 0 / e 1| ≤ 1
      exact h_div_bound (e 0) (e 1) (by linarith [h0.1, h0.2]) (by nlinarith [h0.1, h0.2])
    · have hw0 : (chartRot 1 e) 0 = e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : (chartRot 1 e) 1 = e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      change |(chartRot 1 e) 0 / (chartRot 1 e) 1| ≤ 1
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      exact h_div_bound (e 1) (e 0) (by linarith [h1.1, h1.2]) (by nlinarith [h1.1, h1.2])
    · have hw0 : (chartRot 2 e) 0 = -(e 0) := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : (chartRot 2 e) 1 = -(e 1) := by simp [chartRot]
      change |(chartRot 2 e) 0 / (chartRot 2 e) 1| ≤ 1
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      exact h_div_bound (-(e 0)) (-(e 1)) (by linarith [h2.1, h2.2]) (by nlinarith [h2.1, h2.2])
    · have hw0 : (chartRot 3 e) 0 = -(e 1) := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : (chartRot 3 e) 1 = -(e 0) := by simp [chartRot]
      change |(chartRot 3 e) 0 / (chartRot 3 e) 1| ≤ 1
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have hu_le : e 0 + e 1 ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra hu_gt
        have hu_pos : 0 < e 0 + e 1 := by linarith
        have hv_pos : 0 < e 0 - e 1 := by
          by_contra hv_le
          exact h0 ⟨hu_pos, by linarith⟩
        exact h1 ⟨hu_pos.le, hv_pos⟩
      have hv_lt : e 0 - e 1 < 0 := by
        by_contra hv_ge
        have hv_nn : 0 ≤ e 0 - e 1 := le_of_not_gt hv_ge
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hu_le with hu_lt | hu_eq
        · exact h2 ⟨hu_lt, hv_nn⟩
        · have hv_ne : e 0 - e 1 ≠ 0 := by
            intro hv0
            rw [hu_eq, hv0] at h_uv_sq
            norm_num at h_uv_sq
          exact h1 ⟨le_of_eq hu_eq.symm, lt_of_le_of_ne hv_nn hv_ne.symm⟩
      exact h_div_bound (-(e 1)) (-(e 0)) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)

  have h_val_le6 : ∀ (l : ℕ) (r : Fin 3)
      (b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l)),
      |val_fn l r b| ≤ 6 := by
    intro l r b
    fin_cases r
    · dsimp [val_fn]
      exact le_trans (h_s1Coord_le _ (h_dirVec_unit _)) (by norm_num)
    · dsimp [val_fn]
      exact le_trans (h_s1Coord_le _ (h_dirVec_unit _)) (by norm_num)
    · dsimp [val_fn]
      let e_dir := flip2D (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1))
      have he_unit : ‖e_dir‖ = 1 := by rw [h_flip_norm, h_dirVec_unit]
      have hθ := blk.hθ_dom l b.2.2
      have hp0 : (paramVec blk l b.2.2) 0 = (blk.θ_seq l b.2.2).1 := by simp [paramVec]
      have hp1 : (paramVec blk l b.2.2) 1 = (blk.θ_seq l b.2.2).2 := by simp [paramVec]
      have hp_sq : ‖paramVec blk l b.2.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ 36 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq2, hp0, hp1]
        nlinarith [sq_abs (blk.θ_seq l b.2.2).1, sq_abs (blk.θ_seq l b.2.2).2,
          abs_nonneg (blk.θ_seq l b.2.2).1, abs_nonneg (blk.θ_seq l b.2.2).2, hθ.1, hθ.2]
      have hp_le : ‖paramVec blk l b.2.2‖ ≤ 6 := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (paramVec blk l b.2.2)]
      calc |inner ℝ e_dir (paramVec blk l b.2.2)|
          ≤ ‖e_dir‖ * ‖paramVec blk l b.2.2‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ = ‖paramVec blk l b.2.2‖ := by rw [he_unit, one_mul]
        _ ≤ 6 := hp_le

  have h_E_sum : ∀ (l : ℕ)
      (E : Finset (Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l))),
      (∑ b ∈ E, P_law l b) =
        ∑ i : Fin (blk.N_P l), ∑ b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l),
          if b ∈ E then threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b.2.1 b.2.2 else 0 := by
    intro l E
    calc (∑ b ∈ E, P_law l b)
        = ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => b ∈ E), P_law l b := by
            congr 1; ext b; simp
      _ = ∑ b, if b ∈ E then P_law l b else 0 := Finset.sum_filter _ _
      _ = ∑ b, ∑ i, if b ∈ E then threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b.2.1 b.2.2 else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
            by_cases hb : b ∈ E <;> simp [hb, P_law]
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ b, if b ∈ E then threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b.2.1 b.2.2 else 0 :=
            Finset.sum_comm

  have h_chan_id : ∀ (l : ℕ) (d : ℝ)
      (b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l)),
      let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
      parMass (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) 0) b =
        (∑ i, ∑ b₁, ∑ b₂, threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b₁ b₂) ∧
      jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) 0) (chart_fn l 0) (val_fn l 0) d b =
        (∑ i, ∑ b₁, ∑ b₂,
          if dirBin ρ d (dirVec (paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b.1)) =
            dirBin ρ d (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1))
          then threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b₁ b₂ else 0) ∧
      parMass (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) 1) b =
        (∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₂, threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b.2.1 b₂) ∧
      jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) 1) (chart_fn l 1) (val_fn l 1) d b =
        (∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₂,
          if dirBin ρ d (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b₀)) =
            dirBin ρ d (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1))
          then threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b.2.1 b₂ else 0) ∧
      parMass (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) 2) b =
        (∑ i, ∑ b₂, threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b.2.1 b₂) ∧
      jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) 2) (chart_fn l 2) (val_fn l 2) d b =
        (let e_dir := flip2D (dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1))
         let k_cur := dyadicRealBin ρ d (inner ℝ e_dir (paramVec blk l b.2.2))
         ∑ i, ∑ b₂,
           if dyadicRealBin ρ d (inner ℝ e_dir (paramVec blk l b₂)) = k_cur
           then threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b.2.1 b₂ else 0) := by
    intro l d b ρ
    have h_swap3 : ∀ (f : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → Fin (blk.N_P l) → ℝ),
        (∑ x, ∑ y, ∑ i, f x y i) = ∑ i, ∑ x, ∑ y, f x y i := by
      intro f
      calc (∑ x, ∑ y, ∑ i, f x y i)
          = ∑ x, ∑ i, ∑ y, f x y i := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
        _ = ∑ i, ∑ x, ∑ y, f x y i := Finset.sum_comm
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [parMass, par_fn]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b.1
        (fun b₀ _ hb₀ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => by simp [hb₀])))
        (fun habs => absurd (Finset.mem_univ b.1) habs)]
      simp only [↓reduceIte]
      exact h_swap3 (fun b₁ b₂ i => threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b₁ b₂)
    · dsimp [jointMass, par_fn, chart_fn, val_fn]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b.1
        (fun b₀ _ hb₀ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => by simp [hb₀])))
        (fun habs => absurd (Finset.mem_univ b.1) habs)]
      rw [← h_swap3]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₂ _ => ?_))
      let e₁ := dirVec (paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b.1)
      let e₀ := dirVec (paramVec blk l b.2.1 - paramVec blk l b.1)
      by_cases h_eq : dirBin ρ d e₁ = dirBin ρ d e₀
      · have hc : s1Chart e₁ = s1Chart e₀ := congrArg Prod.fst h_eq
        have hv : dyadicRealBin ρ d (s1Coord e₁) = dyadicRealBin ρ d (s1Coord e₀) :=
          congrArg Prod.snd h_eq
        change (if (some b.1, (none : Option (Fin (blk.N_Θ l)))) = (some b.1, none) ∧
            (s1Chart e₁, dyadicRealBin ρ d (s1Coord e₁)) =
              (s1Chart e₀, dyadicRealBin ρ d (s1Coord e₀))
          then P_law l (b.1, b₁, b₂) else 0) =
          ∑ i, if dirBin ρ d e₁ = dirBin ρ d e₀ then threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b₁ b₂ else 0
        simp [hc, hv, h_eq, P_law]
      · change (if (some b.1, (none : Option (Fin (blk.N_Θ l)))) = (some b.1, none) ∧
            dirBin ρ d e₁ = dirBin ρ d e₀
          then P_law l (b.1, b₁, b₂) else 0) =
          ∑ i, if dirBin ρ d e₁ = dirBin ρ d e₀ then threeReplicaStar blk l i b.1 b₁ b₂ else 0
        simp [h_eq]
    · dsimp [parMass, par_fn]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      rw [← h_swap3]

  have h_fiber_tail : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
      (P : (Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → ℝ)
      (X : (Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → α)
      (Y : (Fin N × Fin N × Fin N) → β)
      (S : Finset β) (τ : ℝ),
      (∀ b, 0 ≤ P b) →
      (∑ b : Fin N × Fin N × Fin N, P b) = 1 →
      (∀ b, Y b ∈ S) →
      0 ≤ τ →
      (∑ b : Fin N × Fin N × Fin N,
        if (∑ b', if X b' = X b ∧ Y b' = Y b then P b' else 0) <
            τ * (∑ b', if X b' = X b then P b' else 0)
        then P b else 0) ≤ (S.card : ℝ) * τ := by
    intro N α β _ _ P X Y S τ hP0 hP1 hYS hτ
    let Ω := Fin N × Fin N × Fin N
    let T_X : Finset α := Finset.univ.image X
    let mX : α → ℝ := fun x => ∑ b' : Ω, if X b' = x then P b' else 0
    let mXY : α → β → ℝ := fun x y => ∑ b' : Ω, if X b' = x ∧ Y b' = y then P b' else 0
    have hmX_nn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ mX x :=
      fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b' _ => by split_ifs; exact hP0 b'; exact le_rfl)
    have h_maps : ∀ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset Ω), (X b, Y b) ∈ T_X ×ˢ S :=
      fun b _ => Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem X (Finset.mem_univ b), hYS b⟩
    have h_fib_eq := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps
      (fun b : Ω => if mXY (X b) (Y b) < τ * mX (X b) then P b else 0)
    change (∑ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset Ω),
        if mXY (X b) (Y b) < τ * mX (X b) then P b else 0) ≤ (S.card : ℝ) * τ
    rw [← h_fib_eq]
    have h_cell : ∀ xy ∈ T_X ×ˢ S,
        (∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Ω => (X b, Y b) = xy),
          if mXY (X b) (Y b) < τ * mX (X b) then P b else 0) ≤ τ * mX xy.1 := by
      intro xy _
      by_cases h_lt : mXY xy.1 xy.2 < τ * mX xy.1
      · have h_congr : (∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Ω => (X b, Y b) = xy),
              if mXY (X b) (Y b) < τ * mX (X b) then P b else 0) = mXY xy.1 xy.2 := by
          calc (∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Ω => (X b, Y b) = xy),
                if mXY (X b) (Y b) < τ * mX (X b) then P b else 0)
              = ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Ω => (X b, Y b) = xy), P b := by
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b hb => ?_)
                have hb_eq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
                have hx : X b = xy.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hb_eq
                have hy : Y b = xy.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hb_eq
                rw [hx, hy, if_pos h_lt]
            _ = ∑ b : Ω, if (X b, Y b) = xy then P b else 0 := Finset.sum_filter _ _
            _ = mXY xy.1 xy.2 :=
                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ =>
                  ite_congr (propext Prod.ext_iff) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl))
        rw [h_congr]
        exact h_lt.le
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
        · exact mul_nonneg hτ (hmX_nn xy.1)
        · intro b hb
          have hb_eq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
          have hx : X b = xy.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hb_eq
          have hy : Y b = xy.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hb_eq
          rw [hx, hy, if_neg h_lt]
    have h_sum_mX : (∑ x ∈ T_X, mX x) = 1 := by
      have h_mX_eq : ∀ x ∈ T_X,
          mX x = ∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b' : Ω => X b' = x), P b' :=
        fun x _ => (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_mX_eq,
        Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun b' _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X (Finset.mem_univ b'))]
      exact hP1
    calc (∑ xy ∈ T_X ×ˢ S,
            ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Ω => (X b, Y b) = xy),
              if mXY (X b) (Y b) < τ * mX (X b) then P b else 0)
        ≤ ∑ xy ∈ T_X ×ˢ S, τ * mX xy.1 := Finset.sum_le_sum h_cell
      _ = ∑ x ∈ T_X, ∑ _y ∈ S, τ * mX x := Finset.sum_product _ _ _
      _ = ∑ x ∈ T_X, (S.card : ℝ) * (τ * mX x) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = ∑ x ∈ T_X, ((S.card : ℝ) * τ) * mX x :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
      _ = ((S.card : ℝ) * τ) * ∑ x ∈ T_X, mX x := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ = (S.card : ℝ) * τ := by rw [h_sum_mX, mul_one]

  have h_basic_mass : ∀ (l : ℕ) (r : Fin 3) (d : ℝ)
      (b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l)),
      let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
      P_law l b ≤ jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) (chart_fn l r) (val_fn l r) d b ∧
      jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) (chart_fn l r) (val_fn l r) d b ≤
        parMass (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) b := by
    intro l r d b ρ
    constructor
    · dsimp [jointMass]
      refine le_trans (le_of_eq (by simp))
        (Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun b' =>
            if par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r b' = par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r b ∧
               (chart_fn l r b', dyadicRealBin ρ d (val_fn l r b')) =
                 (chart_fn l r b, dyadicRealBin ρ d (val_fn l r b))
            then P_law l b' else 0)
          (fun b' _ => by split_ifs; exact hP_nn l b'; exact le_rfl)
          (Finset.mem_univ b))
    · dsimp [jointMass, parMass]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b' _ => ?_)
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact absurd h1.1 h2
      · exact hP_nn l b'
      · exact le_rfl

  have h_coarsen : ∀ (ρ d₁ d₂ : ℝ),
      0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ d₁ → d₁ ≤ d₂ →
      ∃ k : ℕ,
        (∀ x : ℝ, dyadicRealBin ρ d₁ x = (dyadicRealBin ρ d₂ x) / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
        ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ρ ^ (-(d₂ - d₁)) := by
    intro ρ d₁ d₂ hρ₀ hρ₁ hd₁ hd₁₂
    have hρ_inv_gt2 : 2 < ρ⁻¹ := by
      have h1 : 2 * ρ < 1 := by linarith
      calc (2 : ℝ) = 2 * ρ * ρ⁻¹ := by field_simp [hρ₀.ne']
        _ < 1 * ρ⁻¹ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (inv_pos.mpr hρ₀)
        _ = ρ⁻¹ := one_mul _
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    have hlogρ_pos : 0 < Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    let L_ρ := Real.log (ρ⁻¹) / Real.log 2
    have hL_pos : 0 < L_ρ := div_pos hlogρ_pos hlog2_pos
    let m₁ := dyadicRealLevel ρ d₁
    let m₂ := dyadicRealLevel ρ d₂
    have hm₁_nn : 0 ≤ m₁ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hd₁ hL_pos.le)
    have hm_le : m₁ ≤ m₂ := Int.floor_mono (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd₁₂ hL_pos.le)
    let k : ℕ := (m₂ - m₁).toNat
    have hk_z : (k : ℤ) = m₂ - m₁ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hm_le)
    have hm₂_eq : m₂ = m₁ + (k : ℤ) := by omega
    refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      dsimp [dyadicRealBin]
      change ⌊x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁⌋ = ⌊x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂⌋ / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℤ)
      have h_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ = (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ * ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [hm₂_eq, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_natCast, Nat.cast_pow,
          Nat.cast_ofNat]
      have h_div : x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ = (x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂) / ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [h_pow]
        have h2k_ne : ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [h2k_ne]
      rw [h_div, Int.floor_div_natCast]
    · have hm₂_ub : (m₂ : ℝ) ≤ d₂ * L_ρ := Int.floor_le _
      have hm₁_lb : d₁ * L_ρ < (m₁ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hk_real : (k : ℝ) = (m₂ : ℝ) - (m₁ : ℝ) := by
        have h1 : ((k : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((m₂ - m₁ : ℤ) : ℝ) := congrArg Int.cast hk_z
        simpa using h1
      have hk_lt : (k : ℝ) ≤ (d₂ - d₁) * L_ρ + 1 := by linarith
      have hk_mul : (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ (d₂ - d₁) * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) + Real.log 2 := by
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk_lt hlog2_pos.le
        have h2 : L_ρ * Real.log 2 = Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlog2_pos.ne'
        calc (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2
            ≤ ((d₂ - d₁) * L_ρ + 1) * Real.log 2 := h1
          _ = (d₂ - d₁) * (L_ρ * Real.log 2) + Real.log 2 := by ring
          _ = (d₂ - d₁) * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) + Real.log 2 := by rw [h2]
      have h_exp_le : Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (k : ℝ)) ≤
          Real.exp (Real.log 2 + Real.log ρ * (-(d₂ - d₁))) := by
        refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
        rw [Real.log_inv] at hk_mul
        linarith
      have h_lhs : Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (k : ℝ)) = ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_def_of_pos zero_lt_two, Real.rpow_natCast, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      have h_rhs : Real.exp (Real.log 2 + Real.log ρ * (-(d₂ - d₁))) =
          2 * ρ ^ (-(d₂ - d₁)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log zero_lt_two, ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ₀]
      rwa [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_exp_le

  have h_mono_mass : ∀ (l : ℕ) (r : Fin 3) (d₁ d₂ : ℝ)
      (b : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l) × Fin (blk.N_Θ l)),
      0 ≤ d₁ → d₁ ≤ d₂ →
      let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
      jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) (chart_fn l r) (val_fn l r) d₂ b ≤
        jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) (chart_fn l r) (val_fn l r) d₁ b := by
    intro l r d₁ d₂ b hd₁ hd₁₂ ρ
    obtain ⟨k, h_div, _⟩ := h_coarsen ρ d₁ d₂ (blk.hρ_bounds l).1 (blk.hρ_bounds l).2 hd₁ hd₁₂
    dsimp [jointMass]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b' _ => ?_)
    split_ifs with h2 h1
    · exact le_rfl
    · exfalso
      apply h1
      refine ⟨h2.1, ?_⟩
      have hc : chart_fn l r b' = chart_fn l r b := congrArg Prod.fst h2.2
      have hb_eq : dyadicRealBin ρ d₂ (val_fn l r b') = dyadicRealBin ρ d₂ (val_fn l r b) :=
        congrArg Prod.snd h2.2
      exact Prod.ext hc (by rw [h_div, h_div, hb_eq])
    · exact hP_nn l b'
    · exact le_rfl

  have h_tail_bounds : ∀ (l : ℕ) (r : Fin 3),
      let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
      let P := P_law l
      let par := par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r
      let chart := chart_fn l r
      let val := val_fn l r
      (∀ (d τ : ℝ), 0 ≤ d → d ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ τ →
        (∑ b, if jointMass ρ P par chart val d b < τ * parMass P par b then P b else 0) ≤
          52 * ρ⁻¹ * τ) ∧
      (∀ τ₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ₀ →
        (∑ b, if jointMass ρ P par chart val 0 b < τ₀ * parMass P par b then P b else 0) ≤
          52 * τ₀) ∧
      (∀ (d₁ d₂ τ₁₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ d₁ → d₁ ≤ d₂ → 0 ≤ τ₁₂ →
        (∑ b, if jointMass ρ P par chart val d₂ b < τ₁₂ * jointMass ρ P par chart val d₁ b
          then P b else 0) ≤ 2 * ρ ^ (-(d₂ - d₁)) * τ₁₂) := by
    intro l r ρ P par chart val
    have hρ₀ : 0 < ρ := (blk.hρ_bounds l).1
    have hρ₁ : ρ < 1 / 2 := (blk.hρ_bounds l).2
    have hρ_inv_gt2 : 2 < ρ⁻¹ := by
      have h1 : 2 * ρ < 1 := by linarith
      calc (2 : ℝ) = 2 * ρ * ρ⁻¹ := by field_simp [hρ₀.ne']
        _ < 1 * ρ⁻¹ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (inv_pos.mpr hρ₀)
        _ = ρ⁻¹ := one_mul _
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    have hlogρ_pos : 0 < Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    let L_ρ := Real.log (ρ⁻¹) / Real.log 2
    have hL_pos : 0 < L_ρ := div_pos hlogρ_pos hlog2_pos
    have h_box : ∀ d : ℝ, 0 ≤ d →
        ∃ S_d : Finset (Fin 4 × ℤ),
          (∀ b, (chart b, dyadicRealBin ρ d (val b)) ∈ S_d) ∧
          S_d.card = 48 * 2 ^ (dyadicRealLevel ρ d).toNat + 4 := by
      intro d hd
      let m_d := dyadicRealLevel ρ d
      have hm_nn : 0 ≤ m_d := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hd hL_pos.le)
      let n_d : ℕ := m_d.toNat
      have hn_z : (n_d : ℤ) = m_d := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hm_nn
      let B : ℤ := ((6 * 2 ^ n_d : ℕ) : ℤ)
      let S_d : Finset (Fin 4 × ℤ) := Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-B) B
      refine ⟨S_d, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro b
        refine Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ?_⟩
        have hv := abs_le.mp (h_val_le6 l r b)
        have h_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d = ((2 ^ n_d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          rw [← hn_z, zpow_natCast, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
        have h2n_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ n_d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
        dsimp [dyadicRealBin]
        change -B ≤ ⌊val b * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d⌋ ∧ ⌊val b * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d⌋ ≤ B
        rw [h_pow]
        constructor
        · rw [Int.le_floor]
          have hB_cast : ((-B : ℤ) : ℝ) = -6 * ((2 ^ n_d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            dsimp [B]; push_cast; ring
          rw [hB_cast]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv.1 h2n_nn
        · rw [Int.floor_le_iff]
          have hB_cast : (B : ℝ) + 1 = 6 * ((2 ^ n_d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
            dsimp [B]; push_cast; ring
          rw [hB_cast]
          linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv.2 h2n_nn]
      · rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.card_Icc]
        have h_card : (B + 1 - -B).toNat = 12 * 2 ^ n_d + 1 := by
          have hB_eq : B + 1 - -B = ((12 * 2 ^ n_d + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
            dsimp [B]; ring
          rw [hB_eq, Int.toNat_natCast]
        rw [h_card]
        ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d τ hd0 hd1 hτ
      obtain ⟨S_d, hS_mem, hS_card⟩ := h_box d hd0
      have h_raw := h_fiber_tail P par (fun b => (chart b, dyadicRealBin ρ d (val b)))
        S_d τ (hP_nn l) (hP_sum l) hS_mem hτ

        have h0_nn : 0 ≤ (if b ∈ T_good then P b else 0) := by split_ifs <;> linarith
        linarith

    have h_bad1 : (∑ b : Ω, ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ k : K_m,
        if jointM_r r (d_m k) b < ρ ^ 4 * parM_r r b then P b else 0) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      have h_swap : (∑ b : Ω, ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ k : K_m,
            if jointM_r r (d_m k) b < ρ ^ 4 * parM_r r b then P b else 0) =
          ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ k : K_m, ∑ b : Ω,
            if jointM_r r (d_m k) b < ρ ^ 4 * parM_r r b then P b else 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
      rw [h_swap]
      have h_each : ∀ (r : Fin 3) (k : K_m),
          (∑ b : Ω, if jointM_r r (d_m k) b < ρ ^ 4 * parM_r r b then P b else 0) ≤ 52 * ρ ^ 3 := by
        intro r k
        have h1 := (h_tail_bounds l r).1 (d_m k) (ρ ^ 4) (hd_m_bounds k).1 (hd_m_bounds k).2
          (by positivity)
        have h2 : 52 * ρ⁻¹ * ρ ^ 4 = 52 * ρ ^ 3 := by field_simp [hρ₀.ne']
        rwa [h2] at h1
      calc (∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ k : K_m, ∑ b : Ω,
              if jointM_r r (d_m k) b < ρ ^ 4 * parM_r r b then P b else 0)
          ≤ ∑ _r : Fin 3, ∑ _k : K_m, (52 * ρ ^ 3) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => h_each r k))
        _ = 3 * (((2 ^ m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (52 * ρ ^ 3)) := by
            simp [K_m, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ = 156 * ((2 ^ m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ρ ^ 3 := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 / 8 := h_low_num

    have h_bad2 : (∑ b : Ω, ∑ r : Fin 3,
        if jointM_r r 0 b < (1 / 1248 : ℝ) * parM_r r b then P b else 0) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      calc (∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ b : Ω,
              if jointM_r r 0 b < (1 / 1248 : ℝ) * parM_r r b then P b else 0)
          ≤ ∑ _r : Fin 3, (52 * (1 / 1248 : ℝ)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => (h_tail_bounds l r).2.1 (1 / 1248) (by norm_num))
        _ = 1 / 8 := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]; norm_num

    have h_bad3 : (∑ b : Ω, ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ k₁ : K_m, ∑ k₂ : K_m,
        if k₁.1 ≤ k₂.1 ∧
           jointM_r r (d_m k₂) b < τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁) * jointM_r r (d_m k₁) b
        then P b else 0) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      have h_swap : (∑ b : Ω, ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ k₁ : K_m, ∑ k₂ : K_m,
            if k₁.1 ≤ k₂.1 ∧
               jointM_r r (d_m k₂) b < τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁) * jointM_r r (d_m k₁) b
            then P b else 0) =
          ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ k₁ : K_m, ∑ k₂ : K_m, ∑ b : Ω,
            if k₁.1 ≤ k₂.1 ∧
               jointM_r r (d_m k₂) b < τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁) * jointM_r r (d_m k₁) b
            then P b else 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
      rw [h_swap]
      have h_each : ∀ (r : Fin 3) (k₁ k₂ : K_m),
          (∑ b : Ω,
            if k₁.1 ≤ k₂.1 ∧
               jointM_r r (d_m k₂) b < τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁) * jointM_r r (d_m k₁) b
            then P b else 0) ≤ 2 * τ_pair := by
        intro r k₁ k₂
        by_cases hk₁₂ : k₁.1 ≤ k₂.1
        · have hd₁₂ : d_m k₁ ≤ d_m k₂ := by
            dsimp [d_m]
            exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hk₁₂) (by positivity)
          have h_congr : (∑ b : Ω,
                if k₁.1 ≤ k₂.1 ∧
                   jointM_r r (d_m k₂) b < τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁) * jointM_r r (d_m k₁) b
                then P b else 0) =
              ∑ b : Ω,
                if jointM_r r (d_m k₂) b <
                    (τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁)) * jointM_r r (d_m k₁) b
                then P b else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
            simp [hk₁₂]
          rw [h_congr]
          have h1 := (h_tail_bounds l r).2.2 (d_m k₁) (d_m k₂)
            (τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁)) (hd_m_bounds k₁).1 hd₁₂ (by positivity)
          have h_cancel : 2 * ρ ^ (-(d_m k₂ - d_m k₁)) * (τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁)) =
              2 * τ_pair := by
            calc 2 * ρ ^ (-(d_m k₂ - d_m k₁)) * (τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁))
                = 2 * τ_pair * (ρ ^ (-(d_m k₂ - d_m k₁)) * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁)) := by ring
              _ = 2 * τ_pair * ρ ^ (-(d_m k₂ - d_m k₁) + (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁)) := by
                  rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ₀]
              _ = 2 * τ_pair := by simp
          rwa [h_cancel] at h1
        · simp [hk₁₂, hτ_pair_pos.le]
      calc (∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ k₁ : K_m, ∑ k₂ : K_m, ∑ b : Ω,
              if k₁.1 ≤ k₂.1 ∧
                 jointM_r r (d_m k₂) b < τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m k₂ - d_m k₁) * jointM_r r (d_m k₁) b
              then P b else 0)
          ≤ ∑ _r : Fin 3, ∑ _k₁ : K_m, ∑ _k₂ : K_m, (2 * τ_pair) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k₁ _ =>
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k₂ _ => h_each r k₁ k₂)))
        _ = 3 * (((2 ^ m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((2 ^ m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * τ_pair))) := by
            simp [K_m, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ = 1 / 8 := by
            dsimp [τ_pair]
            have h_ne : ((2 ^ m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
            field_simp [h_ne]
            norm_num

    have hT_mass : 1 / 2 ≤ ∑ b ∈ T_good, P b := by
      have h_tot := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b (_ : b ∈ Finset.univ) => h_pt_decomp b)
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h_tot
      rw [hP_sum l, ← Finset.sum_filter] at h_tot
      have h_filt : Finset.univ.filter (fun b => b ∈ T_good) = T_good := by ext b; simp
      rw [h_filt] at h_tot
      linarith

    
    let ratio : Fin 3 → K_m → Ω → ℝ := fun r k b => jointM_r r (d_m k) b / parM_r r b
    let surp : Fin 3 → K_m → Ω → ℝ := fun r k b => -Real.log (ratio r k b) / ell
    have h_good_surp : ∀ b ∈ T_good, ∀ (r : Fin 3) (k : K_m),
        0 < ratio r k b ∧ ratio r k b ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ surp r k b ∧ surp r k b ≤ 4 := by
      intro b hb r k
      have hb_prop := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
      have h_bm := h_basic_mass l r (d_m k) b
      have hj_pos : 0 < jointM_r r (d_m k) b := lt_of_lt_of_le hb_prop.1 h_bm.1
      have hp_pos : 0 < parM_r r b := lt_of_lt_of_le hj_pos h_bm.2
      have hrat_pos : 0 < ratio r k b := div_pos hj_pos hp_pos
      have hrat_le1 : ratio r k b ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hp_pos).mpr h_bm.2
      have hrat_lb : ρ ^ 4 ≤ ratio r k b := (le_div_iff₀ hp_pos).mpr (hb_prop.2.1 r k)
      have hsurp_nn : 0 ≤ surp r k b :=
        div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_nonpos hrat_pos.le hrat_le1)) hell_pos.le
      have hsurp_le4 : surp r k b ≤ 4 := by
        dsimp [surp]
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
        have hlog_lb := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hrat_lb
        rw [Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hlog_lb
        linarith [hell_eq]
      exact ⟨hrat_pos, hrat_le1, hsurp_nn, hsurp_le4⟩

    let CubeIdx := (Fin 3 × K_m) → Fin (4 * 2 ^ m + 1)
    let quant : Ω → CubeIdx := fun b rk =>
      ⟨min ⌊surp rk.1 rk.2 b * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋₊ (4 * 2 ^ m),
       Nat.lt_succ_of_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩
    have hCube_card : (Finset.univ : Finset CubeIdx).card = J_m m := by
      rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin,
        Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
    have hCube_ne : (Finset.univ : Finset CubeIdx).Nonempty :=
      ⟨fun _ => ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    have h_sum_fib := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
      (fun b (_ : b ∈ T_good) => Finset.mem_univ (quant b)) P
    have h_const_sum :
        (∑ _q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset CubeIdx), (1 / (2 * (J_m m : ℝ)))) ≤
        ∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset CubeIdx),
          ∑ b ∈ T_good.filter (fun b => quant b = q), P b := by
      rw [h_sum_fib, Finset.sum_const, hCube_card, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have hJ_ne : (J_m m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hJm_pos.ne'
      have h_eq : (J_m m : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * (J_m m : ℝ))) = 1 / 2 := by field_simp [hJ_ne]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨q₀, _, hq₀_mass⟩ := Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le hCube_ne h_const_sum
    let E := T_good.filter (fun b => quant b = q₀)
    have hE_mass_J : 1 / (2 * (J_m m : ℝ)) ≤ ∑ b ∈ E, P b := hq₀_mass
    have hE_mass : ρ ^ (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ ∑ b ∈ E, P b := le_trans h_rpow_J hE_mass_J
    have hE_ne : E.Nonempty := by
      by_contra h_emp
      rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h_emp
      rw [h_emp, Finset.sum_empty] at hE_mass_J
      linarith [div_pos one_pos (mul_pos zero_lt_two hJm_pos)]
    obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀_E⟩ := hE_ne

    let c : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ := fun r k =>
      if hk : k ≤ 2 ^ m then
        ((q₀ (r, ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩)).1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m
      else 0

    have hc_surp_brack : ∀ (r : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2 ^ m), ∀ b ∈ E,
        let kf : K_m := ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩
        c r k ≤ surp r kf b ∧ surp r kf b < c r k + 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      intro r k hk b hbE kf
      obtain ⟨hb_good, hb_q⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hbE
      obtain ⟨_, _, hs_nn, hs_le4⟩ := h_good_surp b hb_good r kf
      have h_q_val : (q₀ (r, kf)).1 = ⌊surp r kf b * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋₊ := by
        have h1 : q₀ (r, kf) = quant b (r, kf) := congrFun hb_q.symm (r, kf)
        have h2 : (q₀ (r, kf)).1 = min ⌊surp r kf b * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋₊ (4 * 2 ^ m) :=
          congrArg Fin.val h1
        have h_fl_le : ⌊surp r kf b * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋₊ ≤ 4 * 2 ^ m := by
          refine Nat.floor_le_of_le ?_
          push_cast
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_le4 (by positivity)
        rw [h2, min_eq_left h_fl_le]
      have h_c_eq : c r k = (⌊surp r kf b * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋₊ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        dsimp [c]
        rw [dif_pos hk, h_q_val]
      rw [h_c_eq]
      have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
      have h_lo := Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hs_nn h2m_pos.le)
      have h_hi := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (surp r kf b * (2 : ℝ) ^ m)
      constructor
      · exact (div_le_iff₀ h2m_pos).mpr h_lo
      · rw [← add_div, lt_div_iff₀ h2m_pos]
        exact h_hi

    refine ⟨E, c, ?_, hE_mass, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro b hbE
      exact ((Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hbE).1).2).1
    · intro r k hk
      dsimp [c]
      rw [dif_pos hk]
      have hq_le : ((q₀ (r, ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩)).1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        have h1 : (q₀ (r, ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩)).1 ≤ 4 * 2 ^ m :=
          Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (q₀ (r, ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩)).2
        calc ((q₀ (r, ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩)).1 : ℝ)
            ≤ ((4 * 2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
          _ = 4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by push_cast; ring
      exact ⟨by positivity, (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr hq_le⟩
    · intro r
      have hk0 : 0 ≤ 2 ^ m := Nat.zero_le _
      let kf0 : K_m := ⟨0, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk0⟩
      have h_br := (hc_surp_brack r 0 hk0 b₀ hb₀_E).1
      have hb₀_good := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb₀_E).1).2
      have h_bm := h_basic_mass l r 0 b₀
      have hp_pos : 0 < parM_r r b₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hb₀_good.1 (le_trans h_bm.1 h_bm.2)
      have hd0_eq : d_m kf0 = 0 := by simp [d_m, kf0]
      have hrat_lb : (1 / 1248 : ℝ) ≤ ratio r kf0 b₀ := by
        dsimp [ratio]
        rw [hd0_eq, le_div_iff₀ hp_pos]
        exact hb₀_good.2.2.1 r
      have hs0_ub : surp r kf0 b₀ ≤ Real.log 1248 / ell := by
        dsimp [surp]
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hell_pos hell_pos]
        have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hrat_lb
        rw [one_div, Real.log_inv] at hlog
        nlinarith
      exact le_trans h_br (le_trans hs0_ub (h_log_cap 1248 (by norm_num) hM_ge_1248))
    · intro r k₁ k₂ hk₁₂ hk₂
      have hk₁ : k₁ ≤ 2 ^ m := le_trans hk₁₂ hk₂
      let kf₁ : K_m := ⟨k₁, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk₁⟩
      let kf₂ : K_m := ⟨k₂, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk₂⟩
      have hbr1 := hc_surp_brack r k₁ hk₁ b₀ hb₀_E
      have hbr2 := hc_surp_brack r k₂ hk₂ b₀ hb₀_E
      have hb₀_good_mem := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb₀_E).1
      have hb₀_good := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb₀_good_mem).2
      obtain ⟨hrat1_pos, _, _, _⟩ := h_good_surp b₀ hb₀_good_mem r kf₁
      obtain ⟨hrat2_pos, _, _, _⟩ := h_good_surp b₀ hb₀_good_mem r kf₂
      have hp_pos : 0 < parM_r r b₀ :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hb₀_good.1
          (le_trans (h_basic_mass l r 0 b₀).1 (h_basic_mass l r 0 b₀).2)
      have hd₁₂ : d_m kf₁ ≤ d_m kf₂ := by
        dsimp [d_m, kf₁, kf₂]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hk₁₂) (by positivity)
      constructor
      · have hj_mono := h_mono_mass l r (d_m kf₁) (d_m kf₂) b₀ (hd_m_bounds kf₁).1 hd₁₂
        have hrat_mono : ratio r kf₂ b₀ ≤ ratio r kf₁ b₀ :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hj_mono hp_pos.le
        have hlog_mono := Real.log_le_log hrat2_pos hrat_mono
        have hs_mono : surp r kf₁ b₀ ≤ surp r kf₂ b₀ := by
          dsimp [surp]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hell_pos.le
        linarith [hbr1.1, hbr2.2]
      · have h_inc := hb₀_good.2.2.2 r kf₁ kf₂ hk₁₂
        have hrat_inc : τ_pair * ρ ^ (d_m kf₂ - d_m kf₁) * ratio r kf₁ b₀ ≤ ratio r kf₂ b₀ := by
          dsimp [ratio]
          rw [← mul_div_assoc]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_inc hp_pos.le
        have hpow_pos : 0 < ρ ^ (d_m kf₂ - d_m kf₁) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ₀ _
        have hlog_inc := Real.log_le_log (mul_pos (mul_pos hτ_pair_pos hpow_pos) hrat1_pos) hrat_inc
        rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos hτ_pair_pos hpow_pos).ne' hrat1_pos.ne',
          Real.log_mul hτ_pair_pos.ne' hpow_pos.ne', Real.log_rpow hρ₀] at hlog_inc
        have hs_diff : surp r kf₂ b₀ - surp r kf₁ b₀ ≤
            (d_m kf₂ - d_m kf₁) + (-Real.log τ_pair) / ell := by
          dsimp [surp]
          rw [← sub_div, div_le_iff₀ hell_pos, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell_pos.ne']
          nlinarith [hell_eq, hlog_inc]
        have h_log_tau : (-Real.log τ_pair) / ell ≤ 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
          have h_tau_inv : -Real.log τ_pair = Real.log (48 * ((2 ^ m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
            dsimp [τ_pair]
            rw [one_div, Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
          rw [h_tau_inv]
          refine h_log_cap (48 * ((2 ^ m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) (by positivity) ?_
          dsimp [M_cap]
          nlinarith
        have hd_diff : d_m kf₂ - d_m kf₁ = ((k₂ : ℝ) - (k₁ : ℝ)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
          dsimp [d_m, kf₁, kf₂]; ring
        linarith [hbr2.1, hbr1.2, hs_diff, h_log_tau, hd_diff]
    · intro r k hk b hbE
      let kf : K_m := ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩
      have hbr := hc_surp_brack r k hk b hbE
      obtain ⟨hrat_pos, _, _, _⟩ := h_good_surp b (Finset.mem_filter.mp hbE).1 r kf
      have h_rpow_surp : ρ ^ (surp r kf b) = ratio r kf b := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ₀]
        have hexp : Real.log ρ * surp r kf b = Real.log (ratio r kf b) := by
          dsimp [surp]
          rw [hell_eq]
          have hlog_ne : Real.log ρ ≠ 0 := by linarith [hell_pos, hell_eq]
          field_simp [hlog_ne]
        rw [hexp, Real.exp_log hrat_pos]
      constructor
      · calc ρ ^ (c r k + 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m)
            ≤ ρ ^ (surp r kf b) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ₀ hρ_lt1.le hbr.2.le
          _ = ratio r kf b := h_rpow_surp
      · have h_sub_le : c r k - 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ surp r kf b := by
          have h2m_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
          linarith [hbr.1]
        calc ratio r kf b
            = ρ ^ (surp r kf b) := h_rpow_surp.symm
          _ ≤ ρ ^ (c r k - 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ₀ hρ_lt1.le h_sub_le

  
  
  
  have h_exists_L : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ l ≥ L, blk.ρ_seq l < stageScaleCap m :=
    fun m => Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (blk.hρ_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (h_cap_pos m)))
  let L_bound : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => Classical.choose (h_exists_L m)
  have hL_bound : ∀ (m l : ℕ), L_bound m ≤ l → blk.ρ_seq l < stageScaleCap m :=
    fun m => Classical.choose_spec (h_exists_L m)

  let φ₀ : ℕ → ℕ := fun m =>
    Nat.rec (L_bound 0) (fun k prev => max (prev + 1) (L_bound (k + 1))) m

  have hφ₀_mono : StrictMono φ₀ :=
    strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ (fun m =>
      lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self (φ₀ m)) (le_max_left (φ₀ m + 1) (L_bound (m + 1))))
  have hφ₀_cap : ∀ m : ℕ, blk.ρ_seq (φ₀ m) < stageScaleCap m := by
    intro m
    cases m with
    | zero => exact hL_bound 0 (L_bound 0) le_rfl
    | succ m => exact hL_bound (m + 1) _ (le_max_right (φ₀ m + 1) (L_bound (m + 1)))

  let E₀ : ∀ m : ℕ,
      Finset (Fin (blk.N_Θ (φ₀ m)) × Fin (blk.N_Θ (φ₀ m)) × Fin (blk.N_Θ (φ₀ m))) :=
    fun m => Classical.choose (h_stage_pigeonhole m (φ₀ m) (hφ₀_cap m))
  let c₀ : ℕ → Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ :=
    fun m => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_stage_pigeonhole m (φ₀ m) (hφ₀_cap m)))
  have h_stage : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (∀ b ∈ E₀ m, 0 < P_law (φ₀ m) b) ∧
      (blk.ρ_seq (φ₀ m)) ^ (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ (∑ b ∈ E₀ m, P_law (φ₀ m) b) ∧
      (∀ (r : Fin 3) (k : ℕ), k ≤ 2 ^ m → c₀ m r k ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 4) ∧
      (∀ r : Fin 3, c₀ m r 0 ≤ 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      (∀ (r : Fin 3) (k₁ k₂ : ℕ), k₁ ≤ k₂ → k₂ ≤ 2 ^ m →
        -(1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m) ≤ c₀ m r k₂ - c₀ m r k₁ ∧
        c₀ m r k₂ - c₀ m r k₁ ≤
          ((k₂ : ℝ) - (k₁ : ℝ)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m +
            1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m + 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      (∀ (r : Fin 3) (k : ℕ), k ≤ 2 ^ m → ∀ b ∈ E₀ m,
        let l := φ₀ m
        let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
        let d_k := (k : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m
        let pM := parMass (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) b
        let jM := jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) (chart_fn l r) (val_fn l r) d_k b
        ρ ^ (c₀ m r k + 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m) ≤ jM / pM ∧
        jM / pM ≤ ρ ^ (c₀ m r k - 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m)) :=
    fun m => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_stage_pigeonhole m (φ₀ m) (hφ₀_cap m)))

  
  let ValSpace := (Fin 3 × ℕ × ℕ) → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 4
  let X_seq : ℕ → ValSpace := fun m rmk =>
    if h : rmk.2.1 ≤ m ∧ rmk.2.2 ≤ 2 ^ rmk.2.1 then
      ⟨c₀ m rmk.1 (rmk.2.2 * 2 ^ (m - rmk.2.1)),
       (h_stage m).2.2.1 rmk.1 _ (by
         calc rmk.2.2 * 2 ^ (m - rmk.2.1)
             ≤ 2 ^ rmk.2.1 * 2 ^ (m - rmk.2.1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h.2
           _ = 2 ^ (rmk.2.1 + (m - rmk.2.1)) := (Nat.pow_add 2 _ _).symm
           _ = 2 ^ m := by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le h.1])⟩
    else ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num⟩⟩

  obtain ⟨L_lim, ψ, hψ_mono, hψ_lim⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq X_seq
  let L_val : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun r m₀ k => (L_lim (r, m₀, k)).1
  have hL_bdd : ∀ r m₀ k, 0 ≤ L_val r m₀ k ∧ L_val r m₀ k ≤ 4 :=
    fun r m₀ k => (L_lim (r, m₀, k)).2

  have h_dyad_lim : ∀ (r : Fin 3) (m₀ k : ℕ), k ≤ 2 ^ m₀ →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => c₀ (ψ n) r (k * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (L_val r m₀ k)) := by
    intro r m₀ k hk
    have h_coord := (continuous_subtype_val.tendsto (L_lim (r, m₀, k))).comp
      (tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hψ_lim (r, m₀, k))
    refine h_coord.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop m₀] with n hn
    have hm_le : m₀ ≤ ψ n := le_trans hn (hψ_mono.id_le n)
    dsimp [Function.comp, X_seq]
    rw [dif_pos ⟨hm_le, hk⟩]

  have h_inv_psi_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ((ψ n : ℝ) + 1))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_)
    have hn : (n : ℝ) ≤ (ψ n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hψ_mono.id_le n
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)

  have h_pow2_psi_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_)
    have h1 : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (ψ n) :=
      le_trans (Nat.succ_le_of_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self)
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (hψ_mono.id_le n))
    have h2 : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) := by
      calc (n : ℝ) + 1 = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
        _ ≤ ((2 ^ (ψ n) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) := by push_cast; rfl
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) h2

  have hL_zero : ∀ r : Fin 3, L_val r 0 0 = 0 := by
    intro r
    have h_lim0 := h_dyad_lim r 0 0 (by omega)
    simp only [Nat.zero_mul] at h_lim0
    have h_le0 : L_val r 0 0 ≤ 0 :=
      le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto h_lim0 h_inv_psi_lim
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (h_stage (ψ n)).2.2.2.1 r))
    exact le_antisymm h_le0 (hL_bdd r 0 0).1

  have hL_lip : ∀ (r : Fin 3) (m₁ k₁ m₂ k₂ : ℕ),
      k₁ ≤ 2 ^ m₁ → k₂ ≤ 2 ^ m₂ →
      (k₁ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ ≤ (k₂ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ →
      0 ≤ L_val r m₂ k₂ - L_val r m₁ k₁ ∧
      L_val r m₂ k₂ - L_val r m₁ k₁ ≤
        (k₂ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ - (k₁ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ := by
    intro r m₁ k₁ m₂ k₂ hk₁ hk₂ hq_le
    let K₁ : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => k₁ * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₁)
    let K₂ : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => k₂ * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₂)
    have h_diff_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => c₀ (ψ n) r (K₂ n) - c₀ (ψ n) r (K₁ n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (L_val r m₂ k₂ - L_val r m₁ k₁)) :=
      (h_dyad_lim r m₂ k₂ hk₂).sub (h_dyad_lim r m₁ k₁ hk₁)
    have h_ev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        -(1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n)) ≤ c₀ (ψ n) r (K₂ n) - c₀ (ψ n) r (K₁ n) ∧
        c₀ (ψ n) r (K₂ n) - c₀ (ψ n) r (K₁ n) ≤
          ((k₂ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ - (k₁ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁) +
            1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) + 1 / ((ψ n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (max m₁ m₂)] with n hn
      have hm₁ : m₁ ≤ ψ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) (hψ_mono.id_le n)
      have hm₂ : m₂ ≤ ψ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn) (hψ_mono.id_le n)
      have hK₁_eq : (K₁ n : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) = (k₁ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ := by
        dsimp [K₁]
        have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n - m₁) := by
          rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hm₁]
        push_cast
        rw [hp]
        have hne : (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n - m₁) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [hne]
      have hK₂_eq : (K₂ n : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) = (k₂ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ := by
        dsimp [K₂]
        have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n - m₂) := by
          rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hm₂]
        push_cast
        rw [hp]
        have hne : (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n - m₂) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [hne]
      have hK₁₂ : K₁ n ≤ K₂ n := by
        have h_real : (K₁ n : ℝ) ≤ (K₂ n : ℝ) := by
          have h2p : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) := by positivity
          rw [← div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right h2p, hK₁_eq, hK₂_eq]
          exact hq_le
        exact_mod_cast h_real
      have hK₂_ub : K₂ n ≤ 2 ^ (ψ n) := by
        calc k₂ * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₂) ≤ 2 ^ m₂ * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₂) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hk₂
          _ = 2 ^ (m₂ + (ψ n - m₂)) := (Nat.pow_add 2 _ _).symm
          _ = 2 ^ (ψ n) := by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hm₂]
      have h_st := (h_stage (ψ n)).2.2.2.2.1 r (K₁ n) (K₂ n) hK₁₂ hK₂_ub
      have h_sub_eq : ((K₂ n : ℝ) - (K₁ n : ℝ)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) =
          (k₂ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ - (k₁ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ := by
        rw [sub_div, hK₂_eq, hK₁_eq]
      rw [h_sub_eq] at h_st
      exact h_st
    constructor
    · have h_lo_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => -(1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_pow2_psi_lim.neg
      exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto h_lo_lim h_diff_lim (h_ev.mono (fun _ h => h.1))
    · have h_hi_lim : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n => ((k₂ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ - (k₁ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁) +
            1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) + 1 / ((ψ n : ℝ) + 1))
          Filter.atTop (nhds ((k₂ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ - (k₁ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁)) := by
        simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.add h_pow2_psi_lim).add h_inv_psi_lim
      exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto h_diff_lim h_hi_lim (h_ev.mono (fun _ h => h.2))

  let S_prof : Fin 3 → ℝ → Set ℝ := fun r d =>
    { y : ℝ | ∃ m₀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 ^ m₀ ∧
        (k : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ ≤ min 1 (max 0 d) ∧ y = L_val r m₀ k }
  let F : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ := fun r d => sSup (S_prof r d)

  have hS_ne : ∀ r d, (S_prof r d).Nonempty := by
    intro r d
    refine ⟨L_val r 0 0, 0, 0, by omega, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
    exact le_min zero_le_one (le_max_left 0 d)

  have hS_bdd : ∀ r d, BddAbove (S_prof r d) := by
    intro r d
    refine ⟨4, ?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨m₀, k, _, _, rfl⟩
    exact (hL_bdd r m₀ k).2

  have hF_dyad : ∀ (r : Fin 3) (m₀ k : ℕ), k ≤ 2 ^ m₀ →
      F r ((k : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀) = L_val r m₀ k := by
    intro r m₀ k hk
    let q := (k : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by positivity
    have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hk)
    have h_clamp : min 1 (max 0 q) = q := by rw [max_eq_right hq0, min_eq_right hq1]
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine csSup_le (hS_ne r q) ?_
      rintro y ⟨m₁, k₁, hk₁, hq₁, rfl⟩
      rw [h_clamp] at hq₁
      have hm := (hL_lip r m₁ k₁ m₀ k hk₁ hk hq₁).1
      linarith
    · refine le_csSup (hS_bdd r q) ⟨m₀, k, hk, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [h_clamp]

  have hF_zero : ∀ r : Fin 3, F r 0 = 0 := by
    intro r
    have h1 := hF_dyad r 0 0 (by omega)
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_div] at h1
    rw [h1, hL_zero r]

  have hF_lip : ∀ (r : Fin 3) (d₁ d₂ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ d₁ → d₁ ≤ d₂ → d₂ ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ F r d₂ - F r d₁ ∧ F r d₂ - F r d₁ ≤ d₂ - d₁ := by
    intro r d₁ d₂ hd₁ hd₁₂ hd₂
    have hc1 : min 1 (max 0 d₁) = d₁ := by
      rw [max_eq_right hd₁, min_eq_right (le_trans hd₁₂ hd₂)]
    have hc2 : min 1 (max 0 d₂) = d₂ := by
      rw [max_eq_right (le_trans hd₁ hd₁₂), min_eq_right hd₂]
    constructor
    · have h_sub : S_prof r d₁ ⊆ S_prof r d₂ := by
        rintro y ⟨m₀, k, hk, hq, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨m₀, k, hk, by rw [hc1] at hq; rw [hc2]; exact le_trans hq hd₁₂, rfl⟩
      have h_le := csSup_le_csSup (hS_bdd r d₂) (hS_ne r d₁) h_sub
      linarith
    · have h_all_δ : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → F r d₂ ≤ F r d₁ + (d₂ - d₁) + δ := by
        intro δ hδ
        obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / δ)
        have hM_lt_pow : (M : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ M := by exact_mod_cast @Nat.lt_two_pow_self M
        have h1δ_lt : 1 / δ < (2 : ℝ) ^ M := lt_trans hM hM_lt_pow
        have h2M_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ M := by positivity
        have h_step_lt : 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ M < δ := by
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2M_pos]
          have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp h1δ_lt
          linarith
        let k₁ := ⌊d₁ * (2 : ℝ) ^ M⌋₊
        have hk₁ : k₁ ≤ 2 ^ M := by
          refine Nat.floor_le_of_le ?_
          push_cast
          nlinarith [le_trans hd₁₂ hd₂, h2M_pos]
        let q₁ := (k₁ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ M
        have hq₁_le : q₁ ≤ d₁ := (div_le_iff₀ h2M_pos).mpr (Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hd₁ h2M_pos.le))
        have hq₁_gt : d₁ - δ < q₁ := by
          have h_hi := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (d₁ * (2 : ℝ) ^ M)
          have h_div : d₁ - 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ M < q₁ := by
            dsimp [q₁]
            rw [lt_div_iff₀ h2M_pos, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2M_pos.ne']
            linarith
          linarith
        have hLq₁_le : L_val r M k₁ ≤ F r d₁ := by
          refine le_csSup (hS_bdd r d₁) ⟨M, k₁, hk₁, ?_, rfl⟩
          rw [hc1]
          exact hq₁_le
        refine csSup_le (hS_ne r d₂) ?_
        rintro y ⟨m₂, k₂, hk₂, hq₂, rfl⟩
        rw [hc2] at hq₂
        rcases le_or_gt ((k₂ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂) q₁ with h_le | h_gt
        · have hm := (hL_lip r m₂ k₂ M k₁ hk₂ hk₁ h_le).1
          linarith
        · have hm := (hL_lip r M k₁ m₂ k₂ hk₁ hk₂ h_gt.le).2
          linarith
      by_contra h_not
      have hδ : 0 < (F r d₂ - F r d₁ - (d₂ - d₁)) / 2 := by linarith
      linarith [h_all_δ _ hδ]

  
  
  
  let φ : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => φ₀ (ψ n)
  let E_seq : ∀ n, Finset (Fin (blk.N_Θ (φ n)) × Fin (blk.N_Θ (φ n)) × Fin (blk.N_Θ (φ n))) :=
    fun n => E₀ (ψ n)
  let ω_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((ψ n : ℝ) + 1)

  have h_homog_all : ∀ (r : Fin 3), ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ b ∈ E_seq n,
        let l := φ n
        let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
        let pM := parMass (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) b
        let jM := jointMass ρ (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) (chart_fn l r) (val_fn l r) d b
        ρ ^ (F r d + ε) ≤ jM / pM ∧ jM / pM ≤ ρ ^ (F r d - ε) := by
    intro r d hd ε hε
    obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hd
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (4 / ε)
    have hm₀_pow : (m₀ : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ := by exact_mod_cast @Nat.lt_two_pow_self m₀
    have h2m₀_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ := by positivity
    have h_step_lt : 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ < ε / 4 := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ h2m₀_pos (by norm_num)]
      have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp (lt_trans hm₀ hm₀_pow)
      linarith
    let k_lo := ⌊d * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀⌋₊
    have hk_lo : k_lo ≤ 2 ^ m₀ := by
      refine Nat.floor_le_of_le ?_
      push_cast
      nlinarith [hd1, h2m₀_pos]
    let k_hi := min (k_lo + 1) (2 ^ m₀)
    have hk_hi : k_hi ≤ 2 ^ m₀ := min_le_right _ _
    let d_lo := (k_lo : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀
    let d_hi := (k_hi : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀
    have hd_lo_nn : 0 ≤ d_lo := by positivity
    have hd_lo_le : d_lo ≤ d :=
      (div_le_iff₀ h2m₀_pos).mpr (Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hd0 h2m₀_pos.le))
    have hd_hi_le1 : d_hi ≤ 1 := (div_le_one h2m₀_pos).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hk_hi)
    have hd_le_hi : d ≤ d_hi := by
      dsimp [d_hi, k_hi]
      by_cases h_cap : k_lo + 1 ≤ 2 ^ m₀
      · rw [min_eq_left h_cap, le_div_iff₀ h2m₀_pos]
        push_cast
        exact (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (d * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀)).le
      · have hk_eq : min (k_lo + 1) (2 ^ m₀) = 2 ^ m₀ := min_eq_right (by omega)
        rw [hk_eq]
        have h_one : ((2 ^ m₀ : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ = 1 := by push_cast; exact div_self h2m₀_pos.ne'
        linarith
    have hd_gap : d_hi - d_lo ≤ 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ := by
      dsimp [d_lo, d_hi]
      rw [← sub_div]
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ h2m₀_pos.le
      have h1 : k_hi ≤ k_lo + 1 := min_le_left _ _
      have h2 : (k_hi : ℝ) ≤ (k_lo : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
      linarith
    have hF_hi_le : F r d_hi ≤ F r d + ε / 4 := by
      have hl := (hF_lip r d d_hi hd0 hd_le_hi hd_hi_le1).2
      linarith
    have hF_lo_ge : F r d - ε / 4 ≤ F r d_lo := by
      have hl := (hF_lip r d_lo d hd_lo_nn hd_lo_le hd1).2
      linarith
    have h_lim_lo : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => c₀ (ψ n) r (k_lo * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (F r d_lo)) := by
      dsimp [d_lo]
      rw [hF_dyad r m₀ k_lo hk_lo]
      exact h_dyad_lim r m₀ k_lo hk_lo
    have h_lim_hi : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => c₀ (ψ n) r (k_hi * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (F r d_hi)) := by
      dsimp [d_hi]
      rw [hF_dyad r m₀ k_hi hk_hi]
      exact h_dyad_lim r m₀ k_hi hk_hi
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_lim_lo (ε / 4) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_lim_hi (ε / 4) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨max m₀ (max N₁ N₂), fun n hn b hb => ?_⟩
    have hm₀_n : m₀ ≤ ψ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) (hψ_mono.id_le n)
    have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
    have hn₂ : N₂ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
    have h_mesh_psi : 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) < ε / 4 := by
      have h_pow_le : (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) :=
        pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hm₀_n
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (one_div_le_one_div_of_le h2m₀_pos h_pow_le) h_step_lt
    let K_lo := k_lo * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀)
    let K_hi := k_hi * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀)
    have hK_lo_ub : K_lo ≤ 2 ^ (ψ n) := by
      calc k_lo * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀) ≤ 2 ^ m₀ * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hk_lo
        _ = 2 ^ (m₀ + (ψ n - m₀)) := (Nat.pow_add 2 _ _).symm
        _ = 2 ^ (ψ n) := by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hm₀_n]
    have hK_hi_ub : K_hi ≤ 2 ^ (ψ n) := by
      calc k_hi * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀) ≤ 2 ^ m₀ * 2 ^ (ψ n - m₀) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hk_hi
        _ = 2 ^ (m₀ + (ψ n - m₀)) := (Nat.pow_add 2 _ _).symm
        _ = 2 ^ (ψ n) := by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hm₀_n]
    have hK_lo_d : (K_lo : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) = d_lo := by
      dsimp [K_lo, d_lo]
      have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n - m₀) := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hm₀_n]
      push_cast; rw [hp]
      have hne : (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n - m₀) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hne]
    have hK_hi_d : (K_hi : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) = d_hi := by
      dsimp [K_hi, d_hi]
      have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n - m₀) := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hm₀_n]
      push_cast; rw [hp]
      have hne : (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n - m₀) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hne]
    let l := φ n
    let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
    have hρ₀ : 0 < ρ := (blk.hρ_bounds l).1
    have hρ_le1 : ρ ≤ 1 := by linarith [(blk.hρ_bounds l).2]
    let pM := parMass (P_law l) (par_fn (blk.N_Θ l) r) b
    have hpM_pos : 0 < pM :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le ((h_stage (ψ n)).1 b hb)
        (le_trans (h_basic_mass l r d b).1 (h_basic_mass l r d b).2)
    have h_st_hi := ((h_stage (ψ n)).2.2.2.2.2 r K_hi hK_hi_ub b hb).1
    have h_st_lo := ((h_stage (ψ n)).2.2.2.2.2 r K_lo hK_lo_ub b hb).2
    rw [hK_hi_d] at h_st_hi
    rw [hK_lo_d] at h_st_lo
    have hm_hi_d := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (h_mono_mass l r d d_hi b hd0 hd_le_hi) hpM_pos.le
    have hm_d_lo := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (h_mono_mass l r d_lo d b hd_lo_nn hd_lo_le) hpM_pos.le
    have hc_lo_dist := abs_lt.mp (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN₁ n hn₁)
    have hc_hi_dist := abs_lt.mp (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN₂ n hn₂)
    constructor
    · have hexp_hi : c₀ (ψ n) r K_hi + 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) ≤ F r d + ε := by
        dsimp [K_hi]; linarith [hc_hi_dist.2, h_mesh_psi, hF_hi_le]
      exact le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ₀ hρ_le1 hexp_hi)
        (le_trans h_st_hi hm_hi_d)
    · have hexp_lo : F r d - ε ≤ c₀ (ψ n) r K_lo - 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ψ n) := by
        dsimp [K_lo]; linarith [hc_lo_dist.1, h_mesh_psi, hF_lo_ge]
      exact le_trans (le_trans hm_d_lo h_st_lo)
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ₀ hρ_le1 hexp_lo)

  have ite_inst_eq : ∀ {P : Prop} {d₁ d₂ : Decidable P} {a b : ℝ},
      @ite ℝ P d₁ a b = @ite ℝ P d₂ a b := by
    intro P d₁ d₂ a b
    cases d₁ <;> cases d₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

  refine ⟨{
    φ := φ
    E_seq := E_seq
    ω_seq := ω_seq
    F_0 := F 0
    F_1 := F 1
    l_sc := F 2
    hφ_mono := hφ₀_mono.comp hψ_mono
    hω_pos := fun n => by dsimp [ω_seq]; positivity
    hω_tendsto := h_inv_psi_lim
    hF0_zero := hF_zero 0
    hF1_zero := hF_zero 1
    hl_zero := hF_zero 2
    hF0_lip := hF_lip 0
    hF1_lip := hF_lip 1
    hl_lip := hF_lip 2
    hE_mass := fun n => by
      have hm := (h_stage (ψ n)).2.1
      rw [h_E_sum (φ n) (E_seq n)] at hm
      refine le_trans hm (le_of_eq ?_)
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ite_inst_eq))
    hE_pos := fun n b hb => (h_stage (ψ n)).1 b hb
    h_dir0_homog := by
      intro d hd ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_homog_all 0 d hd ε hε
      refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn b hb => ?_⟩
      have h_est := hN₀ n hn b hb
      have h_id := h_chan_id (φ n) d b
      dsimp only at h_est h_id ⊢
      rw [h_id.1, h_id.2.1] at h_est
      refine ⟨le_trans h_est.1 (le_of_eq ?_), le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) h_est.2⟩ <;>
      · congr 1
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ =>
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ite_inst_eq)))
    h_dir1_homog := by
      intro d hd ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_homog_all 1 d hd ε hε
      refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn b hb => ?_⟩
      have h_est := hN₀ n hn b hb
      have h_id := h_chan_id (φ n) d b
      dsimp only at h_est h_id ⊢
      rw [h_id.2.2.1, h_id.2.2.2.1] at h_est
      refine ⟨le_trans h_est.1 (le_of_eq ?_), le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) h_est.2⟩ <;>
      · congr 1
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ =>
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ite_inst_eq)))
    h_sc_homog := by
      intro d hd ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_homog_all 2 d hd ε hε
      refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn b hb => ?_⟩
      have h_est := hN₀ n hn b hb
      have h_id := h_chan_id (φ n) d b
      dsimp only at h_est h_id ⊢
      rw [h_id.2.2.2.2.1, h_id.2.2.2.2.2] at h_est
      refine ⟨le_trans h_est.1 (le_of_eq ?_), le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) h_est.2⟩ <;>
      · congr 1
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ite_inst_eq))
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have h_norm2 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ^ 2 = (v 0) ^ 2 + (v 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have h_inner2 : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ u v = u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 := by
    intro u v
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, mul_comm]
  have h_perp0 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), perp2D v 0 = -(v 1) := by
    intro v; simp [perp2D]
  have h_perp1 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), perp2D v 1 = v 0 := by
    intro v; simp [perp2D]
  have h_perp_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖perp2D v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
    rw [h_norm2, h_norm2, h_perp0, h_perp1]
    ring
  have h_dirVec_unit : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖dirVec v‖ = 1 := by
    intro v
    unfold dirVec
    split_ifs with hv
    · refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one).mp ?_
      rw [h_norm2]
      simp
    · have hv_pos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hv_pos, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv_pos.ne']
  have h_sdir_abs : ∀ s_dir : ℝ, s_dir = 1 ∨ s_dir = -1 → |s_dir| = 1 ∧ s_dir ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro s_dir hs
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have h_sdir_norm : ∀ (s_dir : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      s_dir = 1 ∨ s_dir = -1 → ‖s_dir • v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro s_dir v hs
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, (h_sdir_abs s_dir hs).1, one_mul]
  have h_rot_sub : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      chartRot c (u - v) = chartRot c u - chartRot c v := by
    intro c u v; fin_cases c <;> { ext idx; fin_cases idx <;> simp [chartRot] <;> ring }
  have h_rot_norm : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖chartRot c v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro c v
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
    rw [h_norm2, h_norm2]
    fin_cases c <;> simp [chartRot] <;> ring
  have h_chart_cap : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 0) ^ 2 + (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      0 < chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1 ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro e he
    have he_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_norm2 e
      rw [he, one_pow] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have h_ab : (e 0 + e 1) ^ 2 + (e 0 - e 1) ^ 2 = 2 := by linarith [he_sq]
    unfold s1Chart
    split_ifs with h0 h1 h2
    · change (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∧ 0 < e 1 ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ (e 1) ^ 2
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h0.1.le h0.2
      exact ⟨he_sq, by linarith [h0.1, h0.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 1 e 0 = e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 1 e 1 = e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 1 - e 0) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h1.1 (by linarith [h1.2])
      exact ⟨by linarith [he_sq], by linarith [h1.1, h1.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 2 e 0 = -e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 2 e 1 = -e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h2.1.le h2.2
      exact ⟨by nlinarith [he_sq], by linarith [h2.1, h2.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 3 e 0 = -e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 3 e 1 = -e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have ha_le : e 0 + e 1 ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra ha_gt
        have ha_pos : 0 < e 0 + e 1 := lt_of_not_ge ha_gt
        have hb_pos : 0 < e 0 - e 1 := by
          by_contra hb_le
          exact h0 ⟨ha_pos, le_of_not_gt hb_le⟩
        exact h1 ⟨ha_pos.le, hb_pos⟩
      have hb_lt : e 0 - e 1 < 0 := by
        by_contra hb_ge
        have hb_nn : 0 ≤ e 0 - e 1 := le_of_not_gt hb_ge
        have ha_eq : e 0 + e 1 = 0 := by
          by_contra ha_ne
          exact h2 ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne ha_le ha_ne, hb_nn⟩
        have hb_eq : e 0 - e 1 = 0 := by
          by_contra hb_ne
          exact h1 ⟨by linarith [ha_eq], lt_of_le_of_ne hb_nn (Ne.symm hb_ne)⟩
        nlinarith [h_ab, ha_eq, hb_eq]
      have hp : (-(e 0 + e 1)) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith [ha_le]) hb_lt.le
      exact ⟨by nlinarith [he_sq], by linarith [ha_le, hb_lt], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
  have h_s1Coord_lip : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → s1Chart u = c → s1Chart v = c →
      |s1Coord u - s1Coord v| ≤ 2 * ‖u - v‖ := by
    intro c u v hu hv hcu hcv
    let u' := chartRot c u
    let v' := chartRot c v
    have hu_cap := h_chart_cap u hu
    have hv_cap := h_chart_cap v hv
    rw [hcu] at hu_cap
    rw [hcv] at hv_cap
    obtain ⟨_, hu1_pos, hu1_sq⟩ := hu_cap
    obtain ⟨hv_sq, hv1_pos, hv1_sq⟩ := hv_cap
    have h_coord_u : s1Coord u = u' 0 / u' 1 := by simp [s1Coord, hcu, u']
    have h_coord_v : s1Coord v = v' 0 / v' 1 := by simp [s1Coord, hcv, v']
    let num := (u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 1 - v' 0 * (u' 1 - v' 1)
    have h_diff_eq : s1Coord u - s1Coord v = num / (u' 1 * v' 1) := by
      rw [h_coord_u, h_coord_v]
      dsimp [u', v', num]
      field_simp [hu1_pos.ne', hv1_pos.ne']
      ring
    have h_uv_sq : ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = (u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2 := by
      calc ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = ‖chartRot c (u - v)‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h_rot_norm]
        _ = ‖u' - v'‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h_rot_sub]
        _ = (u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2 := h_norm2 (u' - v')
    have h_num_sq : num ^ 2 ≤ ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_lag : ((u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2) * ((v' 0) ^ 2 + (v' 1) ^ 2) - num ^ 2 =
          ((u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 0 + (u' 1 - v' 1) * v' 1) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [num]; ring
      have h_nn := sq_nonneg ((u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 0 + (u' 1 - v' 1) * v' 1)
      rw [hv_sq, mul_one, ← h_uv_sq] at h_lag
      linarith
    have h_num_abs : |num| ≤ ‖u - v‖ :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp (by rwa [sq_abs])
    have h_den_pos : 0 < u' 1 * v' 1 := mul_pos hu1_pos hv1_pos
    have h_den_ge : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ u' 1 * v' 1 := by
      refine (sq_le_sq₀ (by norm_num) h_den_pos.le).mp ?_
      calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) := by norm_num
        _ ≤ (u' 1) ^ 2 * (v' 1) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul hu1_sq hv1_sq (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (u' 1 * v' 1) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h_diff_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos h_den_pos, div_le_iff₀ h_den_pos]
    calc |num| ≤ ‖u - v‖ := h_num_abs
      _ = (2 * ‖u - v‖) * (1 / 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * ‖u - v‖) * (u' 1 * v' 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_den_ge (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (norm_nonneg _))
  have h_dyadic_step : ∀ (ρ L : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ L →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ρ L) * ρ ^ L ≤ 1 ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dyadicRealStep ρ L ≤ ρ ^ L := by
    intro ρ L hρ0 _ _
    let m : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ρ L
    have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    have hm_le : (m : ℝ) ≤ L * (Real.log (ρ⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := Int.floor_le _
    have hm_lt : L * (Real.log (ρ⁻¹) / Real.log 2) < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hm1 : (m : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ L * (-Real.log ρ) := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le hlog2.le
      rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlog2.ne', Real.log_inv] at h
      exact h
    have hm2 : L * (-Real.log ρ) < ((m : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 := by
      have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm_lt hlog2
      rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlog2.ne', Real.log_inv] at h
      exact h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ ^ L ≤ 1
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ ^ L
          = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m : ℝ) * ρ ^ L := by rw [Real.rpow_intCast]
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (m : ℝ)) * Real.exp (Real.log ρ * L) := by
            rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos zero_lt_two, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ0]
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (m : ℝ) + Real.log ρ * L) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp 0 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = 1 := Real.exp_zero
    · have h_step_le : dyadicRealStep ρ L ≤ 2 * ρ ^ L := by
        change (2 : ℝ) ^ (-m) ≤ 2 * ρ ^ L
        calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-m)
            = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((-m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_intCast]
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * ((-m : ℤ) : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_def_of_pos zero_lt_two _
          _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log 2 + Real.log ρ * L) := by
              refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
              push_cast
              linarith
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2) * Real.exp (Real.log ρ * L) := Real.exp_add _ _
          _ = 2 * ρ ^ L := by rw [Real.exp_log zero_lt_two, ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ0]
      linarith

  
  have h_dirBin_ball_R : ∀ (ρ d R : ℝ) (e₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ d → 0 ≤ R →
      ∃ S_bins : Finset (Fin 4 × ℤ),
        (S_bins.card : ℝ) ≤ 32 * R * ρ ^ (-d) + 12 ∧
        ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖u - e₁‖ ≤ R →
          dirBin ρ d u ∈ S_bins := by
    intro ρ d R e₁ hρ0 hρ1 hd hR
    let X : ℝ := 4 * R * ρ ^ (-d)
    have hX_nn : 0 ≤ X := by dsimp [X]; positivity
    let N_span : ℕ := ⌊X⌋₊ + 1
    have hN_le : (N_span : ℝ) ≤ X + 1 := by
      dsimp [N_span]
      push_cast
      linarith [Nat.floor_le hX_nn]
    have hX_lt : X < (N_span : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [N_span]
      push_cast
      exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one X
    let P_wit : Fin 4 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Prop :=
      fun c v => ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ ‖v - e₁‖ ≤ R ∧ s1Chart v = c
    let k_wit : Fin 4 → ℤ := fun c =>
      if hc : ∃ v, P_wit c v then dyadicRealBin ρ d (s1Coord (Classical.choose hc)) else 0
    let S_bins : Finset (Fin 4 × ℤ) :=
      Finset.univ.biUnion (fun c : Fin 4 =>
        (Finset.Icc (k_wit c - (N_span : ℤ)) (k_wit c + (N_span : ℤ))).image (fun k => (c, k)))
    refine ⟨S_bins, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_card : S_bins.card ≤ 8 * N_span + 4 := by
        calc S_bins.card
            ≤ ∑ c : Fin 4,
                ((Finset.Icc (k_wit c - (N_span : ℤ)) (k_wit c + (N_span : ℤ))).image
                  (fun k => (c, k))).card :=

      have hx_lo : k_wit c - (N_span : ℤ) ≤ dyadicRealBin ρ d (s1Coord u) := by

  have h_dirBin_chord : ∀ (ρ d : ℝ) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ d → ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 →
      dirBin ρ d u = dirBin ρ d v → ‖u - v‖ < 3 * ρ ^ d := by
    intro ρ d u v hρ0 hρ1 hd hu hv h_bin
    have hc : s1Chart u = s1Chart v := (Prod.ext_iff.mp h_bin).1
    have hk : dyadicRealBin ρ d (s1Coord u) = dyadicRealBin ρ d (s1Coord v) :=
      (Prod.ext_iff.mp h_bin).2
    let m := dyadicRealLevel ρ d

      have hu_hi : s1Coord u * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hv_lo : (k : ℝ) ≤ s1Coord v * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        dsimp [k]; rw [hk]; exact Int.floor_le _
      have hv_hi : s1Coord v * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
        dsimp [k]; rw [hk]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h_scaled : |s1Coord u - s1Coord v| * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < 1 := by
        rw [← abs_of_pos hm_pos, ← abs_mul, sub_mul]
        exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have h_step_inv : dyadicRealStep ρ d = ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := zpow_neg (2 : ℝ) m
      have h_lt_step : |s1Coord u - s1Coord v| < dyadicRealStep ρ d := by
        rw [h_step_inv]
        have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_scaled (inv_pos.mpr hm_pos)
        rwa [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hm_pos.ne', mul_one, one_mul] at h1
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lt_step h_step_le
    let c := s1Chart u
    let u' := chartRot c u
    let v' := chartRot c v
    have hu_cap := h_chart_cap u hu
    have hv_cap := h_chart_cap v hv
    rw [← hc] at hv_cap
    obtain ⟨hu_sq, hu1_pos, hu1_half⟩ := hu_cap
    obtain ⟨hv_sq, hv1_pos, hv1_half⟩ := hv_cap
    have hu1_le1 : u' 1 ≤ 1 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ hu1_pos.le zero_le_one).mp (by dsimp [u', c]; linarith [sq_nonneg (u' 0)])
    have hv1_le1 : v' 1 ≤ 1 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ hv1_pos.le zero_le_one).mp (by dsimp [v', c]; linarith [sq_nonneg (v' 0)])
    have h_cu : s1Coord u = u' 0 / u' 1 := rfl
    have h_cv : s1Coord v = v' 0 / v' 1 := by simp [s1Coord, ← hc, v', c]
    have h_cross : u' 1 * v' 1 * (s1Coord u - s1Coord v) = u' 0 * v' 1 - v' 0 * u' 1 := by
      rw [h_cu, h_cv]
      dsimp [u', v', c] at hu1_pos hv1_pos ⊢
      field_simp [hu1_pos.ne', hv1_pos.ne']
    have hρd_pos : 0 < ρ ^ d := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ0 d
    have h_c_sq : (s1Coord u - s1Coord v) ^ 2 < 4 * (ρ ^ d) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : |s1Coord u - s1Coord v| ^ 2 < (2 * ρ ^ d) ^ 2 :=
        (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr h_coord_lt
      rw [sq_abs] at h1
      linarith [show (2 * ρ ^ d) ^ 2 = 4 * (ρ ^ d) ^ 2 by ring]
    have h_u1v1_pos : 0 < u' 1 * v' 1 := mul_pos hu1_pos hv1_pos
    have h_u1v1_le1 : (u' 1 * v' 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have hp : u' 1 * v' 1 ≤ 1 := by
        calc u' 1 * v' 1 ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul hu1_le1 hv1_le1 hv1_pos.le zero_le_one
          _ = 1 := mul_one 1
      simpa using (sq_le_sq₀ h_u1v1_pos.le zero_le_one).mpr hp
    have h_cross_sq : (u' 0 * v' 1 - v' 0 * u' 1) ^ 2 < 4 * (ρ ^ d) ^ 2 := by
      have h_id : (u' 0 * v' 1 - v' 0 * u' 1) ^ 2 =
          (u' 1 * v' 1) ^ 2 * (s1Coord u - s1Coord v) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← h_cross]
        ring
      calc (u' 0 * v' 1 - v' 0 * u' 1) ^ 2
          = (u' 1 * v' 1) ^ 2 * (s1Coord u - s1Coord v) ^ 2 := h_id
        _ ≤ 1 * (s1Coord u - s1Coord v) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_u1v1_le1 (sq_nonneg _)
        _ < 4 * (ρ ^ d) ^ 2 := by linarith
    let α_dot : ℝ := u' 0 * v' 0 + u' 1 * v' 1
    have h_u1v1_ge : 1 / 2 ≤ u' 1 * v' 1 := by
      refine (sq_le_sq₀ (by norm_num) h_u1v1_pos.le).mp ?_
      calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) := by norm_num
        _ ≤ (u' 1) ^ 2 * (v' 1) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul hu1_half hv1_half (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (u' 1 * v' 1) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_u0v0_ge : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ u' 0 * v' 0 := by
      have hu0_half : (u' 0) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 := by dsimp [u', c] at *; linarith
      have hv0_half : (v' 0) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 := by dsimp [v', c] at *; linarith
      have hsq0 : |u' 0 * v' 0| ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq_abs]
        calc (u' 0 * v' 0) ^ 2 = (u' 0) ^ 2 * (v' 0) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) := mul_le_mul hu0_half hv0_half (sq_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by norm_num
      exact (abs_le.mp ((sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mp hsq0)).1
    have hα_nn : 0 ≤ α_dot := by dsimp [α_dot]; linarith
    have h_norm_diff : ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (1 - α_dot) := by
      have h_uv : ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = (u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2 := by
        calc ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = ‖chartRot c (u - v)‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h_rot_norm]
          _ = ‖u' - v'‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h_rot_sub]
          _ = (u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2 := h_norm2 _
      rw [h_uv]
      dsimp [α_dot, u', v', c] at *
      linarith [show (chartRot (s1Chart u) u 0 - chartRot (s1Chart u) v 0) ^ 2 +
        (chartRot (s1Chart u) u 1 - chartRot (s1Chart u) v 1) ^ 2 =
        ((chartRot (s1Chart u) u 0) ^ 2 + (chartRot (s1Chart u) u 1) ^ 2) +
        ((chartRot (s1Chart u) v 0) ^ 2 + (chartRot (s1Chart u) v 1) ^ 2) -
        2 * (chartRot (s1Chart u) u 0 * chartRot (s1Chart u) v 0 +
          chartRot (s1Chart u) u 1 * chartRot (s1Chart u) v 1) by ring]
    have hα_le1 : α_dot ≤ 1 := by linarith [sq_nonneg ‖u - v‖, h_norm_diff]
    have h_lagrange : 1 - α_dot ^ 2 = (u' 0 * v' 1 - v' 0 * u' 1) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [α_dot, u', v', c] at *
      calc 1 - (chartRot (s1Chart u) u 0 * chartRot (s1Chart u) v 0 +
              chartRot (s1Chart u) u 1 * chartRot (s1Chart u) v 1) ^ 2
          = ((chartRot (s1Chart u) u 0) ^ 2 + (chartRot (s1Chart u) u 1) ^ 2) *
              ((chartRot (s1Chart u) v 0) ^ 2 + (chartRot (s1Chart u) v 1) ^ 2) -
              (chartRot (s1Chart u) u 0 * chartRot (s1Chart u) v 0 +
                chartRot (s1Chart u) u 1 * chartRot (s1Chart u) v 1) ^ 2 := by
              rw [hu_sq, hv_sq, mul_one]
        _ = (chartRot (s1Chart u) u 0 * chartRot (s1Chart u) v 1 -
              chartRot (s1Chart u) v 0 * chartRot (s1Chart u) u 1) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_sq_lt : ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 < (3 * ρ ^ d) ^ 2 := by
      have h_prod_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * α_dot * (1 - α_dot) :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hα_nn) (by linarith)
      have h_le : 2 * (1 - α_dot) ≤ 2 * (1 - α_dot ^ 2) := by nlinarith
      have hr2_pos : 0 < (ρ ^ d) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hρd_pos
      rw [h_norm_diff, h_lagrange] at *
      linarith [show (3 * ρ ^ d) ^ 2 = 9 * (ρ ^ d) ^ 2 by ring]
    exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp h_sq_lt

  have h_dirBin_nest : ∀ (ρ d₁ d₂ : ℝ),

    intro ρ d₁ d₂ hρ0 hρ1 hd
    have hρ_inv_gt1 : 1 < ρ⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hρ0).mpr (by linarith)
    have h_fac_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (ρ⁻¹) / Real.log 2 :=
      div_nonneg (Real.log_pos hρ_inv_gt1).le (Real.log_pos one_lt_two).le
    have hm_le : dyadicRealLevel ρ d₁ ≤ dyadicRealLevel ρ d₂ :=
      Int.floor_le_floor (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd h_fac_nn)
    let d_lvl : ℕ := (dyadicRealLevel ρ d₂ - dyadicRealLevel ρ d₁).toNat
    have hd_lvl_eq : dyadicRealLevel ρ d₂ = dyadicRealLevel ρ d₁ + (d_lvl : ℤ) := by
      have h1 : (d_lvl : ℤ) = dyadicRealLevel ρ d₂ - dyadicRealLevel ρ d₁ :=

      omega
