    unfold dirBin dyadicRealBin
    dsimp only
    congr 1
    have h_div : (s1Coord u * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ρ d₂)) / ((2 ^ d_lvl : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        s1Coord u * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ρ d₁) := by
      rw [hd_lvl_eq, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_natCast]
      push_cast
      have h2_ne : (2 : ℝ) ^ d_lvl ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [h2_ne]
    rw [← Int.floor_div_natCast, h_div]

  
  have h_dirBin_cover : ∀ (N_A N_B : ℕ)
      (ρ j a_step β s_dir B_coarse B_fine : ℝ)
      (a_mid : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (θ_A : Fin N_A → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (θ_B : Fin N_B → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (Pi_pair : Fin N_A → Fin N_B → ℝ)
      (H_pair : Fin N_A → Fin N_B → Prop),

      0 < β → 0 < a_step →
      β + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * a_step ≤ j →
      j + a_step ≤ 1 →
      8 * ρ ^ (a_step / 2) ≤ 1 →
      (s_dir = 1 ∨ s_dir = -1) →
      0 ≤ B_coarse → 0 < B_fine →
      (∀ a b, 0 ≤ Pi_pair a b) →

      (∀ a b, H_pair a b →
        let d_cur := dirBin ρ j (dirVec (s_dir • (θ_B b - θ_A a)))

    intro N_A N_B ρ j a_step β s_dir B_coarse B_fine a_mid θ_A θ_B Pi_pair H_pair
      hρ0 hρ1 hβ ha_pos hj_sep hja_le hρ_small hs_dir hBc_nn hBf_pos hPi_nn hH_pos h_hom_j h_hom_ja
    have hρ_lt1 : ρ < 1 := by linarith
    have hj_nn : 0 ≤ j := by linarith
    have hja_nn : 0 ≤ j + a_step := by linarith

      have h_exp : a_step / 2 + a_step ≤ j - β := by linarith
      calc 8 * ρ ^ (j - β)
          ≤ 8 * ρ ^ (a_step / 2 + a_step) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ0 hρ_lt1.le h_exp) (by norm_num)

      intro a b hξ_le hw_ge

      let u := s_dir • (θ_A a - a_mid)

        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hqB_sum, mul_one]

        dsimp [W₂]; rw [ha0 a ha]; simp

    let ξ_star : ℝ × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun p =>

    have h_SA_cov : ∀ a ∈ S_A, ∃ p ∈ S_cov₁ ×ˢ S_cov₂, ‖ξ a - ξ_star p‖ < r_ball := by
      intro a ha

  let F_pin : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun s_dir => if s_dir = 1 then prof.F_1 else prof.F_0
  let F_opp : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun s_dir => if s_dir = 1 then prof.F_0 else prof.F_1
  have h_homog_sym : ∀ (s_dir d ε : ℝ),
      (s_dir = 1 ∨ s_dir = -1) → d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 0 < ε →
      ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n →
        let l := prof.φ n
        let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
        let Pi_sym : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → ℝ :=
          fun a b => ∑ i, ∑ b₂, threeReplicaStar blk l i a b b₂

          let d_cur := dirBin ρ d (dirVec (s_dir • (paramVec blk l b - paramVec blk l a)))

            ρ ^ (F_pin s_dir d - ε) * (∑ a', Pi_sym a' b) ∧
          (∑ b', if dirBin ρ d (dirVec (s_dir • (paramVec blk l b' - paramVec blk l a))) = d_cur

            ρ ^ (F_opp s_dir d - ε) * (∑ i, blk.π_seq l i a) := by
    intro s_dir d ε hs_dir hd hε

    obtain ⟨N₀_1, hN1⟩ := prof.h_dir1_homog d hd ε hε

    dsimp only

    let Pi_sym : Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → Fin (blk.N_Θ l) → ℝ :=
      fun a b => ∑ i, ∑ b₂, threeReplicaStar blk l i a b b₂
    intro a b ⟨b₂, ht⟩
    have hn0 : N₀_0 ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn1 : N₀_1 ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    rcases hs_dir with rfl | rfl
    · simp only [if_true] at ht
      have h_pos_t := prof.hE_pos n (a, b, b₂) ht

        refine le_trans

        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun b₀ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b₂' _ => h_star_nn l i b₀ b b₂'))
          (Finset.mem_univ a)
      have hp0_pos : 0 < ∑ i, blk.π_seq l i a := by

        exact Finset.single_le_sum

      have h_tot_b : (∑ b, if ‖e_B b - e₀‖ < r then (∑ a, q a b) else 0) ≤
          1216 * ρ ^ (-ω - ε_hom) * ρ ^ (u * d_mesh k_m) := by
        calc (∑ b, if ‖e_B b - e₀‖ < r then (∑ a, q a b) else 0)
            ≤ ∑ b, (16 * ρ ^ (-ω) * m_par⁻¹) *
                ∑ a, if paramTreeBin ρ j (blk.θ_seq l a) = p_par ∧ H_dir a b ∧
                      dirBin ρ (d_mesh k_m) (V_ab a b) ∈ S_bins
                     then Pi_sym a b else 0 :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => h_pt_b b)
          _ = (16 * ρ ^ (-ω) * m_par⁻¹) *
                ∑ a, ∑ b, if paramTreeBin ρ j (blk.θ_seq l a) = p_par ∧ H_dir a b ∧
                      dirBin ρ (d_mesh k_m) (V_ab a b) ∈ S_bins
                     then Pi_sym a b else 0 := by
              rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm]
          _ ≤ (16 * ρ ^ (-ω) * m_par⁻¹) *
                ∑ a, (if paramTreeBin ρ j (blk.θ_seq l a) = p_par then lam a else 0) *
                  (76 * ρ ^ (u * d_mesh k_m - ε_hom)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => h_each_a a))
                (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (inv_nonneg.mpr hm_par_pos.le))
          _ = (16 * ρ ^ (-ω) * (m_par⁻¹ * m_par)) * (76 * ρ ^ (u * d_mesh k_m - ε_hom)) := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul]; change _ = (16 * ρ ^ (-ω) * (m_par⁻¹ * m_par)) * _; ring
          _ = 1216 * (ρ ^ (-ω) * ρ ^ (u * d_mesh k_m - ε_hom)) := by
              rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hm_par_pos.ne']; ring
          _ = 1216 * ρ ^ (-ω - ε_hom + u * d_mesh k_m) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ0]; ring_nf
          _ = 1216 * ρ ^ (-ω - ε_hom) * ρ ^ (u * d_mesh k_m) := by
              rw [Real.rpow_add hρ0, ← mul_assoc]
      refine le_trans h_tot_b ?_
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ0.le _)
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
      refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ0 hρ_lt1.le ?_
      dsimp [κ_err]
      linarith [blk.hκ_pos l]
    · intro b hqB_pos
      have hex_a : ∃ a, 0 < q a b := by
        by_contra h_no; push_neg at h_no
        have hz : (∑ a, q a b) = 0 :=
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => le_antisymm (h_no a) (hq_nn a b))
        linarith
      obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀_pos⟩ := hex_a
      obtain ⟨S_cov, hSc, hSm⟩ := h_cover_both.1 b (hq_supp a₀ b ha₀_pos).2.2 (h_pin_norm b)
      have h_card_eq : (268 * ρ ^ (-β)) * (B_coarse / B_fine) =
          268 * ρ ^ (-((F_pin s_dir (j + a_step) - F_pin s_dir j) + ε_β * a_step + 2 * ε_hom)) := by
        dsimp [B_coarse, B_fine, β]
        rw [← Real.rpow_sub hρ0, mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hρ0]
        ring_nf
      rw [h_card_eq] at hSc
      refine ⟨S_cov, hSc, fun a hqa => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hH, hcell, _⟩ := hq_supp a b hqa
      have hx : x_P a = ρ ^ (-j) • (paramVec blk l a - a_mid) := if_pos hcell
      rw [hx]
      exact hSm a hH (h_child_norm a hcell)

  
  have h_telescope : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      0 ≤ c → F 0 = 0 →
      (∀ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ d₁ → d₁ ≤ d₂ → d₂ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ F d₂ - F d₁) →
      (∀ M k : ℕ, 3 ≤ M → 2 ≤ k → k + 2 ≤ 2 ^ M →
        c * ((2 : ℝ) ^ M)⁻¹ ≤
          F ((k : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ M)⁻¹ + ((2 : ℝ) ^ M)⁻¹) - F ((k : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ M)⁻¹)) →
      ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, c * d ≤ F d := by
    intro F c hc_nn hF0 hF_mono h_inc d ⟨hd0, hd1⟩
    suffices h_all_ε : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → c * d - ε ≤ F d by
      by_contra h_lt
      push_neg at h_lt
      linarith [h_all_ε ((c * d - F d) / 2) (by linarith)]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (8 * (c + 1) / ε)
    let M : ℕ := M₀ + 3
    have hM3 : 3 ≤ M := Nat.le_add_left 3 M₀
    have h2M_ge8 : (8 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ M := by
      have h_nat : 2 ^ 3 ≤ 2 ^ M := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hM3
      exact_mod_cast h_nat
    have h2M_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ M := by linarith
    let a : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ M)⁻¹
    have ha_pos : 0 < a := inv_pos.mpr h2M_pos
    have ha_le8 : a ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      dsimp [a]; rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ h2M_pos (by norm_num)]; linarith
    have h8ca_le_ε : 8 * (c + 1) * a ≤ ε := by
      have h_gt : 8 * (c + 1) / ε < (2 : ℝ) ^ M := by
        have h1 : M₀ < 2 ^ M₀ := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
        have h2 : 2 ^ M₀ ≤ 2 ^ M := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
        have h3 : (M₀ : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ M := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2)
        linarith
      dsimp [a]
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_iff₀ h2M_pos]
      have h4 := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp h_gt
      linarith
    have hF_nn : 0 ≤ F d := by
      have h := hF_mono 0 d le_rfl hd0 hd1
      linarith [hF0]
    by_cases hd_small : d ≤ 3 * a
    · have hcd : c * d ≤ c * (3 * a) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_small hc_nn
      have h8 : c * (3 * a) ≤ 8 * (c + 1) * a := by nlinarith [hc_nn, ha_pos]
      linarith
    · push_neg at hd_small
      let d' : ℝ := min d (1 - 2 * a)
      have hd'_ge3a : 3 * a ≤ d' := le_min hd_small.le (by linarith)
      have hd'_le_d : d' ≤ d := min_le_left _ _
      have hd'_le_cap : d' ≤ 1 - 2 * a := min_le_right _ _
      have hd_sub_d' : d - d' ≤ 2 * a := by
        dsimp [d']
        by_cases h : d ≤ 1 - 2 * a
        · rw [min_eq_left h]; linarith
        · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h))]; linarith
      let K : ℕ := ⌊d' * (2 : ℝ) ^ M⌋₊
      have hK_ge3 : 3 ≤ K := by
        refine Nat.le_floor ?_
        have h1 : (3 * a) * (2 : ℝ) ^ M ≤ d' * (2 : ℝ) ^ M :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd'_ge3a h2M_pos.le
        have h2 : (3 * a) * (2 : ℝ) ^ M = 3 := by
          dsimp [a]; rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2M_pos.ne', mul_one]
        push_cast; linarith
      have hK_le_r : (K : ℝ) ≤ d' * (2 : ℝ) ^ M :=
        Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg (by linarith) h2M_pos.le)
      have hK_lt_r : d' * (2 : ℝ) ^ M < (K : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hK_cap : K + 2 ≤ 2 ^ M := by
        have h1 : (K : ℝ) + 2 ≤ (1 - 2 * a) * (2 : ℝ) ^ M + 2 := by
          linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd'_le_cap h2M_pos.le]
        have h2 : (1 - 2 * a) * (2 : ℝ) ^ M + 2 = (2 : ℝ) ^ M := by
          dsimp [a]; field_simp [h2M_pos.ne']; ring
        rw [h2] at h1
        exact_mod_cast h1
      have hKa_le_d : (K : ℝ) * a ≤ d := by
        have h1 : (K : ℝ) * a ≤ (d' * (2 : ℝ) ^ M) * a :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK_le_r ha_pos.le
        have h2 : (d' * (2 : ℝ) ^ M) * a = d' := by
          dsimp [a]; rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2M_pos.ne', mul_one]
        linarith
      have hd_lt_K3a : d < ((K : ℝ) + 3) * a := by
        have h1 : (d' * (2 : ℝ) ^ M) * a < ((K : ℝ) + 1) * a :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hK_lt_r ha_pos
        have h2 : (d' * (2 : ℝ) ^ M) * a = d' := by
          dsimp [a]; rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2M_pos.ne', mul_one]
        linarith
      have h_sum_steps : ∀ n_step : ℕ, n_step + 3 ≤ 2 ^ M →
          (n_step : ℝ) * c * a ≤ F (((n_step + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) := by
        intro n_step
        induction n_step with
        | zero =>
          intro _
          simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Nat.zero_add]
          have h2a_le1 : ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a ≤ 1 := by push_cast; linarith
          have hm := hF_mono 0 (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) le_rfl (by positivity) h2a_le1
          linarith [hF0]
        | succ m ih =>
          intro hm_cap
          have hm_prev : m + 3 ≤ 2 ^ M := by omega
          have h_ih := ih hm_prev
          have h_step := h_inc M (m + 2) hM3 (by omega) (by omega)
          change c * a ≤ F (((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a + a) - F (((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) at h_step
          have h_eq1 : ((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a + a = ((m + 1 + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a := by
            push_cast; ring
          rw [h_eq1] at h_step
          have h_alg : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c * a = (m : ℝ) * c * a + c * a := by
            push_cast; ring
          linarith
      obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (show 2 ≤ K by omega)
      have hn₀_eq : K = n₀ + 2 := by omega
      have h_n0_lb := h_sum_steps n₀ (by omega)
      rw [← hn₀_eq] at h_n0_lb
      have hF_Ka_le : F ((K : ℝ) * a) ≤ F d :=
        by linarith [hF_mono ((K : ℝ) * a) d (by positivity) hKa_le_d hd1]
      have h_cd_diff : c * d - (n₀ : ℝ) * c * a ≤ 5 * c * a := by
        have hK_r : (K : ℝ) = (n₀ : ℝ) + 2 := by exact_mod_cast hn₀_eq
        rw [hK_r] at hd_lt_K3a
        have h_n5 : d ≤ ((n₀ : ℝ) + 5) * a := by linarith
        have h1 : c * d ≤ c * (((n₀ : ℝ) + 5) * a) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_n5 hc_nn
        linarith [show c * (((n₀ : ℝ) + 5) * a) = (n₀ : ℝ) * c * a + 5 * c * a by ring]
      have h5 : 5 * c * a ≤ 8 * (c + 1) * a := by nlinarith [hc_nn, ha_pos]
      linarith

  
  let u_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => s * (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1))⁻¹)
  have hm1_ne1 : (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 1 := by norm_num
  have h_boot : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      u_seq m * d ≤ prof.F_0 d ∧ u_seq m * d ≤ prof.F_1 d := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      have hu0_eq : u_seq 0 = s / 2 := by dsimp [u_seq]; norm_num; ring
      have hs2_nn : 0 ≤ s / 2 := by positivity
      have h0 : ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (s / 2) * d ≤ prof.F_0 d :=
        h_telescope prof.F_0 (s / 2) hs2_nn prof.hF0_zero
          (fun d₁ d₂ h1 h2 h3 => (prof.hF0_lip d₁ d₂ h1 h2 h3).1)
          (fun M k hM hk1 hk2 => by
            have h := h_init_inc (-1) M k (Or.inr rfl) hM hk1 hk2
            dsimp only [F_pin] at h
            rwa [if_neg hm1_ne1] at h)
      have h1 : ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (s / 2) * d ≤ prof.F_1 d :=
        h_telescope prof.F_1 (s / 2) hs2_nn prof.hF1_zero
          (fun d₁ d₂ h1 h2 h3 => (prof.hF1_lip d₁ d₂ h1 h2 h3).1)
          (fun M k hM hk1 hk2 => by
            have h := h_init_inc 1 M k (Or.inl rfl) hM hk1 hk2
            dsimp only [F_pin] at h
            rwa [if_pos rfl] at h)
      intro d hd
      rw [hu0_eq]
      exact ⟨h0 d hd, h1 d hd⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      have h2_ge2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) := by
        have h_nat : 2 ^ 1 ≤ 2 ^ (m + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
        exact_mod_cast h_nat
      have h_inv_pos : 0 < ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ := by positivity
      have h_inv_half : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]; linarith
      have hu_pos : 0 < u_seq m := by dsimp [u_seq]; nlinarith
      have hu_le_s : u_seq m ≤ s := by dsimp [u_seq]; nlinarith
      have hu_rec : (s + u_seq m) / 2 = u_seq (m + 1) := by
        dsimp [u_seq]
        rw [pow_succ]
        field_simp
        ring
      have hu1_nn : 0 ≤ u_seq (m + 1) := by rw [← hu_rec]; positivity
      have h0 : ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u_seq (m + 1) * d ≤ prof.F_0 d :=
        h_telescope prof.F_0 (u_seq (m + 1)) hu1_nn prof.hF0_zero
          (fun d₁ d₂ h1 h2 h3 => (prof.hF0_lip d₁ d₂ h1 h2 h3).1)
          (fun M k hM hk1 hk2 => by
            rw [← hu_rec]
            have h_opp1 : ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u_seq m * d ≤ F_opp (-1) d := by
              intro d hd
              dsimp only [F_opp]
              rw [if_neg hm1_ne1]
              exact (ih d hd).2
            have h := h_recip_inc (-1) (u_seq m) M k (Or.inr rfl) hu_pos hu_le_s h_opp1 hM hk1 hk2
            dsimp only [F_pin] at h
            rwa [if_neg hm1_ne1] at h)
      have h1 : ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u_seq (m + 1) * d ≤ prof.F_1 d :=
        h_telescope prof.F_1 (u_seq (m + 1)) hu1_nn prof.hF1_zero
          (fun d₁ d₂ h1 h2 h3 => (prof.hF1_lip d₁ d₂ h1 h2 h3).1)
          (fun M k hM hk1 hk2 => by
            rw [← hu_rec]
            have h_opp0 : ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u_seq m * d ≤ F_opp 1 d := by
              intro d hd
              dsimp only [F_opp]
              rw [if_pos rfl]
              exact (ih d hd).1
            have h := h_recip_inc 1 (u_seq m) M k (Or.inl rfl) hu_pos hu_le_s h_opp0 hM hk1 hk2
            dsimp only [F_pin] at h
            rwa [if_pos rfl] at h)
      intro d hd
      exact ⟨h0 d hd, h1 d hd⟩

  
  intro d hd
  have h_lim : ∀ y : ℝ, (∀ m : ℕ, u_seq m * d ≤ y) → s * d ≤ y := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra h_lt
    push_neg at h_lt
    let gap := s * d - y
    have hgap_pos : 0 < gap := by dsimp [gap]; linarith
    obtain ⟨m, hm_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (s * d / gap)
    have h2m_gt : s * d / gap < (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) := by
      have h1 : m < 2 ^ (m + 1) :=
        lt_trans Nat.lt_two_pow_self (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
      have h2 : (m : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) := by exact_mod_cast h1
      linarith
    have h_err_lt : s * d * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ < gap := by
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h3 := (div_lt_iff₀ hgap_pos).mp h2m_gt
      linarith
    have h_um : u_seq m * d = s * d - s * d * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ := by
      dsimp [u_seq]; ring
    linarith [hy m]
  exact ⟨h_lim (prof.F_0 d) (fun m => (h_boot m d hd).1),
    h_lim (prof.F_1 d) (fun m => (h_boot m d hd).2)⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  have h_geom : ∀ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ (d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖d‖ = 1 →
        let d_perp := perp2D d
        ∀ (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (k_U : ℤ × ℤ),
          ((S.filter (fun nl : ℤ × ℤ =>
            let u_star0 := ((nl.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d 0 + ((nl.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d_perp 0
            let u_star1 := ((nl.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d 1 + ((nl.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d_perp 1
            ⌊u_star0⌋ - 3 ≤ k_U.1 ∧ k_U.1 ≤ ⌊u_star0⌋ + 3 ∧
            ⌊u_star1⌋ - 3 ≤ k_U.2 ∧ k_U.2 ≤ ⌊u_star1⌋ + 3)).card : ℝ) ≤ 169) ∧
      (∀ (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ × ℝ),
        (∀ j, |P j| ≤ 4) →
        (|θ₀.1| ≤ 4 ∧ |θ₀.2| ≤ 4) →
        (|θ₁.1| ≤ 4 ∧ |θ₁.2| ≤ 4) →
        (|θ₂.1| ≤ 4 ∧ |θ₂.2| ≤ 4) →
        let v₀₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![θ₁.1 - θ₀.1, θ₁.2 - θ₀.2]
        0 < ‖v₀₁‖ →
        let α₀₁ := ‖v₀₁‖
        let d := dirVec v₀₁
        let d_perp := perp2D d
        let e_dir := flip2D d
        let X_hat := canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ₀ 0)
        let U₀_hat := canonicalMidU ρ P θ₀
        let U₁_hat := canonicalMidU ρ P θ₁
        let Z₁_hat := canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ₁ 3)
        let Z₂_hat := canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ₂ 3)
        let N_bin := canonicalGridBin ρ (inner ℝ d_perp U₀_hat)
        let L_bin := canonicalGridBin ρ (inner ℝ d U₁_hat)
        let N_hat := ((N_bin : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
        let L_hat := ((L_bin : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
        let kU₁ := (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ₁ 1),
                    canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ₁ 2))
        let u_star0 := ((L_bin : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d 0 + ((N_bin : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d_perp 0
        let u_star1 := ((L_bin : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d 1 + ((N_bin : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d_perp 1
        let w₁₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![θ₂.1 - θ₁.1, θ₂.2 - θ₁.2]
        let a_B := -(inner ℝ e_dir w₁₂)
        let shift := inner ℝ (flip2D w₁₂) d_perp * N_hat +
          (θ₂.1 - θ₁.1) * (θ₂.2 - θ₁.2) * X_hat
        ‖d‖ = 1 ∧
        α₀₁ ≤ 12 ∧
        (⌊u_star0⌋ - 3 ≤ kU₁.1 ∧ kU₁.1 ≤ ⌊u_star0⌋ + 3 ∧
         ⌊u_star1⌋ - 3 ≤ kU₁.2 ∧ kU₁.2 ≤ ⌊u_star1⌋ + 3) ∧
        |L_hat - (inner ℝ d U₀_hat + α₀₁ * X_hat)| ≤ 9 * ρ ∧
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ![L_hat, Z₁_hat]‖ ≤ 200 ∧
        |a_B| ≤ 200 ∧

    have h_ev_sep2 := h_ev_rpow (s * ϑ / 2) (1 / 8) (by positivity) (by norm_num)
    have h_ev_ω : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, prof.ω_seq n < δ_sc / 4 :=
      prof.hω_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity))
    have h_ev_48 := h_ev_rpow (δ_sc / 4) (1 / 48) (by positivity) (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀_all⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N_mesh).and
        (h_ev_sep1.and (h_ev_sep2.and (h_ev_ω.and h_ev_48))))
    refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hn_mesh, hn_sep1, hn_sep2, hn_ω, hn_48⟩ := hN₀_all n hn
    let l := prof.φ n
    let ρ := blk.ρ_seq l
    let κ := blk.κ_seq l
    let ω := prof.ω_seq n
    let K := ρ ^ (-κ)
    have hρ_b := blk.hρ_bounds l
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := hρ_b.1
    have hρ_lt1 : ρ < 1 := by linarith [hρ_b.2]
    have hK_pos : 0 < K := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos _
    let NP := blk.N_P l
    let NΘ := blk.N_Θ l
    let lam : Fin NΘ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i, blk.π_seq l i b
    let μ_pt : Fin NP → ℝ := fun i => ∑ b, blk.π_seq l i b
    have hlam_nn : ∀ b, 0 ≤ lam b := fun b => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => blk.hπ_nn l i b)
    have hlam_sum : ∑ b, lam b = 1 := by
      dsimp [lam]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact blk.hπ_sum l
    have hμ_pt_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ_pt i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => blk.hπ_nn l i b)
    have hμ_pt_sum : ∑ i, μ_pt i = 1 := blk.hπ_sum l
    let Star3 : Fin NP → Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → ℝ :=
      fun i b₀ b₁ b₂ => threeReplicaStar blk l i b₀ b₁ b₂
    have hStar3_nn : ∀ i b₀ b₁ b₂, 0 ≤ Star3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁ b₂
      dsimp only [Star3, threeReplicaStar]
      split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (blk.hπ_nn l i b₀) (blk.hπ_nn l i b₁)) (blk.hπ_nn l i b₂))
          (sq_nonneg _)
      · exact le_rfl
    let P01_pt : Fin NP → Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → ℝ :=
      fun i b₀ b₁ => ∑ b₂, Star3 i b₀ b₁ b₂
    let P01 : Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → ℝ := fun b₀ b₁ => ∑ i, P01_pt i b₀ b₁
    have hP01_pt_nn : ∀ i b₀ b₁, 0 ≤ P01_pt i b₀ b₁ :=
      fun i b₀ b₁ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b₂ _ => hStar3_nn i b₀ b₁ b₂)
    have hP01_nn : ∀ b₀ b₁, 0 ≤ P01 b₀ b₁ :=
      fun b₀ b₁ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hP01_pt_nn i b₀ b₁)
    have hP01_pt_eq : ∀ i b₀ b₁,
        P01_pt i b₀ b₁ =
          if 0 < μ_pt i then blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ / μ_pt i else 0 := by
      intro i b₀ b₁
      by_cases hμ : 0 < μ_pt i
      · rw [if_pos hμ]
        have h_step : ∀ b₂, Star3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ =
            (blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ / (μ_pt i ^ 2)) * blk.π_seq l i b₂ := by
          intro b₂
          dsimp only [Star3, threeReplicaStar]
          rw [if_pos hμ]
          ring
        dsimp [P01_pt]
        simp_rw [h_step, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        change (blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ / (μ_pt i ^ 2)) * μ_pt i = _
        field_simp [hμ.ne']
      · rw [if_neg hμ]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b₂ _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [Star3, threeReplicaStar]
        exact if_neg hμ
    have hP01_pt_sum_i : ∀ i, (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P01_pt i b₀ b₁) = μ_pt i := by
      intro i
      simp_rw [hP01_pt_eq i]
      by_cases hμ : 0 < μ_pt i
      · simp_rw [if_pos hμ]
        have h1 : ∀ b₀, (∑ b₁, blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ / μ_pt i) =
            (blk.π_seq l i b₀ / μ_pt i) * μ_pt i := by
          intro b₀
          calc ∑ b₁, blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ / μ_pt i
              = ∑ b₁, (blk.π_seq l i b₀ / μ_pt i) * blk.π_seq l i b₁ :=
                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
            _ = (blk.π_seq l i b₀ / μ_pt i) * μ_pt i := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        calc ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ / μ_pt i
            = ∑ b₀, (blk.π_seq l i b₀ / μ_pt i) * μ_pt i :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₀ _ => h1 b₀)
          _ = ∑ b₀, blk.π_seq l i b₀ :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₀ _ => div_mul_cancel₀ _ hμ.ne')
          _ = μ_pt i := rfl
      · simp_rw [if_neg hμ, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        exact (le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hμ) (hμ_pt_nn i)).symm
    have hP01_pt_tot : (∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P01_pt i b₀ b₁) = 1 := by
      simp_rw [hP01_pt_sum_i]; exact hμ_pt_sum
    have hP01_tot' : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P01 b₀ b₁) = 1 := by
      calc ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P01 b₀ b₁
          = ∑ b₀, ∑ i, ∑ b₁, P01_pt i b₀ b₁ :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
        _ = ∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P01_pt i b₀ b₁ := Finset.sum_comm
        _ = 1 := hP01_pt_tot
    have hStar3_dom2 : ∀ i b₀ b₁ b₂,
        Star3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ ≤ K * P01_pt i b₀ b₁ * lam b₂ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁ b₂
      rw [hP01_pt_eq i b₀ b₁]
      dsimp only [Star3, threeReplicaStar]
      by_cases hμ : 0 < μ_pt i
      · rw [if_pos hμ, if_pos hμ]
        have hd2 : blk.π_seq l i b₂ ≤ K * μ_pt i * lam b₂ := blk.h_pair_dom l i b₂
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hμ)]
        calc blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ * blk.π_seq l i b₂
            ≤ blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ * (K * μ_pt i * lam b₂) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd2
                (mul_nonneg (blk.hπ_nn l i b₀) (blk.hπ_nn l i b₁))
          _ = K * (blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁ / μ_pt i) * lam b₂ * μ_pt i ^ 2 := by
              field_simp [hμ.ne']
      · change (if 0 < μ_pt i then _ else 0) ≤ _
        rw [if_neg hμ, if_neg hμ]
        simp
    have hP01_pt_dom0 : ∀ i b₀ b₁,
        P01_pt i b₀ b₁ ≤ K * blk.π_seq l i b₀ * lam b₁ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁
      rw [hP01_pt_eq i b₀ b₁]
      split_ifs with hμ
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hμ]
        calc blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁
            ≤ blk.π_seq l i b₀ * (K * μ_pt i * lam b₁) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (blk.h_pair_dom l i b₁) (blk.hπ_nn l i b₀)
          _ = K * blk.π_seq l i b₀ * lam b₁ * μ_pt i := by ring
      · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK_pos.le (blk.hπ_nn l i b₀)) (hlam_nn b₁)
    have hP01_pt_dom1 : ∀ i b₀ b₁,
        P01_pt i b₀ b₁ ≤ K * blk.π_seq l i b₁ * lam b₀ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁
      rw [hP01_pt_eq i b₀ b₁]
      split_ifs with hμ
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hμ]
        calc blk.π_seq l i b₀ * blk.π_seq l i b₁
            = blk.π_seq l i b₁ * blk.π_seq l i b₀ := mul_comm _ _
          _ ≤ blk.π_seq l i b₁ * (K * μ_pt i * lam b₀) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (blk.h_pair_dom l i b₀) (blk.hπ_nn l i b₁)
          _ = K * blk.π_seq l i b₁ * lam b₀ * μ_pt i := by ring
      · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK_pos.le (blk.hπ_nn l i b₁)) (hlam_nn b₀)
    have hP01_dom : ∀ b₀ b₁, P01 b₀ b₁ ≤ K * lam b₀ * lam b₁ := by
      intro b₀ b₁
      calc P01 b₀ b₁
          ≤ ∑ i, K * blk.π_seq l i b₀ * lam b₁ :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hP01_pt_dom0 i b₀ b₁)
        _ = ∑ i, (K * lam b₁) * blk.π_seq l i b₀ :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
        _ = (K * lam b₁) * lam b₀ := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ = K * lam b₀ * lam b₁ := by ring
    let m_E : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin NP, ∑ b : Fin NΘ × Fin NΘ × Fin NΘ,
      if b ∈ prof.E_seq n then Star3 i b.1 b.2.1 b.2.2 else 0
    have hm_E_lb : ρ ^ ω ≤ m_E := by
      refine le_trans (prof.hE_mass n) (le_of_eq ?_)
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    have hm_E_pos : 0 < m_E := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos ω) hm_E_lb
    have hm_E_inv : m_E⁻¹ ≤ ρ ^ (-ω) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ_pos.le]
      exact inv_anti₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos ω) hm_E_lb
    let R_full : Fin NP → Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → ℝ :=
      fun i b₀ b₁ b₂ => if (b₀, b₁, b₂) ∈ prof.E_seq n then Star3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ / m_E else 0
    let R_P01 : Fin NP → Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → ℝ :=
      fun i b₀ b₁ => ∑ b₂, R_full i b₀ b₁ b₂
    let R01 : Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → ℝ := fun b₀ b₁ => ∑ i, R_P01 i b₀ b₁
    have hR_full_nn : ∀ i b₀ b₁ b₂, 0 ≤ R_full i b₀ b₁ b₂ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁ b₂; dsimp [R_full]; split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hStar3_nn i b₀ b₁ b₂) hm_E_pos.le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hR_full_le : ∀ i b₀ b₁ b₂, R_full i b₀ b₁ b₂ ≤ Star3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ / m_E := by
      intro i b₀ b₁ b₂; dsimp [R_full]; split_ifs
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact div_nonneg (hStar3_nn i b₀ b₁ b₂) hm_E_pos.le
    have hR_P01_nn : ∀ i b₀ b₁, 0 ≤ R_P01 i b₀ b₁ :=
      fun i b₀ b₁ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b₂ _ => hR_full_nn i b₀ b₁ b₂)
    have hR_P01_le : ∀ i b₀ b₁, R_P01 i b₀ b₁ ≤ P01_pt i b₀ b₁ / m_E := by
      intro i b₀ b₁
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₂ _ => hR_full_le i b₀ b₁ b₂)
    have hR01_nn : ∀ b₀ b₁, 0 ≤ R01 b₀ b₁ :=
      fun b₀ b₁ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hR_P01_nn i b₀ b₁)
    have hR01_le : ∀ b₀ b₁, R01 b₀ b₁ ≤ P01 b₀ b₁ / m_E := by
      intro b₀ b₁
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hR_P01_le i b₀ b₁)
    have hR01_sum : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, R01 b₀ b₁) = 1 := by
      have h1 : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, R01 b₀ b₁) =
          ∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ b₂, R_full i b₀ b₁ b₂ := by
        calc ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ i, R_P01 i b₀ b₁
            = ∑ b₀, ∑ i, ∑ b₁, R_P01 i b₀ b₁ :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
          _ = ∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ b₂, R_full i b₀ b₁ b₂ := Finset.sum_comm
      have h2 : (∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ b₂, R_full i b₀ b₁ b₂) = m_E / m_E := by
        dsimp [m_E, R_full]
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₀ _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₂ _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [h1, h2]
      exact div_self hm_E_pos.ne'
    let G_pt : Fin NP → Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → Prop :=
      fun i b₀ b₁ => (1 / 8 : ℝ) * P01_pt i b₀ b₁ ≤ R_P01 i b₀ b₁
    let S_good : Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → ℝ :=
      fun b₀ b₁ => ∑ i, if G_pt i b₀ b₁ then R_P01 i b₀ b₁ else 0
    let S_bad : Fin NΘ → Fin NΘ → ℝ :=
      fun b₀ b₁ => ∑ i, if ¬ G_pt i b₀ b₁ then R_P01 i b₀ b₁ else 0
    have hS_bad_nn : ∀ b₀ b₁, 0 ≤ S_bad b₀ b₁ :=
      fun b₀ b₁ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by
        by_cases h : G_pt i b₀ b₁ <;> simp [h, hR_P01_nn i b₀ b₁])
    have hS_split : ∀ b₀ b₁, S_good b₀ b₁ + S_bad b₀ b₁ = R01 b₀ b₁ := by
      intro b₀ b₁
      dsimp [S_good, S_bad, R01]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : G_pt i b₀ b₁ <;> simp [h]
    have hS_bad_tot : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, S_bad b₀ b₁) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      have h_pt : ∀ i b₀ b₁,
          (if ¬ G_pt i b₀ b₁ then R_P01 i b₀ b₁ else 0) ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * P01_pt i b₀ b₁ := by
        intro i b₀ b₁
        by_cases hg : G_pt i b₀ b₁
        · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr hg)]
          exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hP01_pt_nn i b₀ b₁)
        · rw [if_pos hg]
          dsimp [G_pt] at hg
          linarith
      calc ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, S_bad b₀ b₁
          ≤ ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ i, (1 / 8 : ℝ) * P01_pt i b₀ b₁ :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₀ _ =>
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₁ _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_pt i b₀ b₁)))
        _ = ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, (1 / 8 : ℝ) * P01 b₀ b₁ :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₀ _ =>
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm))
        _ = (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P01 b₀ b₁ := by
            simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = 1 / 8 := by rw [hP01_tot', mul_one]
    have h_sep_bad : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁,
        if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then R01 b₀ b₁ else 0) < 1 / 8 := by
      have hρϑ_lo : ρ ≤ ρ ^ ϑ := by
        calc ρ = ρ ^ (1 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one ρ).symm
          _ ≤ ρ ^ ϑ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_pos hρ_lt1.le hϑ₁
      have hρϑ_hi : ρ ^ ϑ ≤ 1 := by
        calc ρ ^ ϑ ≤ ρ ^ (0 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_pos hρ_lt1.le hϑ₀.le
          _ = 1 := Real.rpow_zero ρ
      have h_b0 : ∀ b₀,
          (∑ b₁, if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then R01 b₀ b₁ else 0) ≤
            (K / m_E) * lam b₀ * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s) := by
        intro b₀
        have h_pt : ∀ b₁,
            (if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then R01 b₀ b₁ else 0) ≤
              (K / m_E) * lam b₀ *
                (if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then lam b₁ else 0) := by
          intro b₁
          split_ifs
          · calc R01 b₀ b₁ ≤ P01 b₀ b₁ / m_E := hR01_le b₀ b₁
              _ ≤ (K * lam b₀ * lam b₁) / m_E :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hP01_dom b₀ b₁) hm_E_pos.le
              _ = (K / m_E) * lam b₀ * lam b₁ := by ring
          · simp
        have h_pb := blk.h_param_ball l (paramVec blk l b₀) (ρ ^ ϑ) hρϑ_lo hρϑ_hi
        have h_pb' : (∑ b₁, if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ
            then lam b₁ else 0) ≤ K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s := by
          refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) h_pb
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => ?_)
          dsimp [paramVec, lam]
          split_ifs <;> rfl
        calc (∑ b₁, if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then R01 b₀ b₁ else 0)
            ≤ ∑ b₁, (K / m_E) * lam b₀ *
                (if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then lam b₁ else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₁ _ => h_pt b₁)
          _ = ((K / m_E) * lam b₀) *
                ∑ b₁, (if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then lam b₁ else 0) :=
              (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
          _ ≤ ((K / m_E) * lam b₀) * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pb'
                (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hK_pos.le hm_E_pos.le) (hlam_nn b₀))
      have h_sum_le : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁,
          if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then R01 b₀ b₁ else 0) ≤
          (K / m_E) * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s) := by
        calc (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁,
              if ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ < ρ ^ ϑ then R01 b₀ b₁ else 0)
            ≤ ∑ b₀, (K / m_E) * lam b₀ * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₀ _ => h_b0 b₀)
          _ = ∑ b₀, ((K / m_E) * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s)) * lam b₀ :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
          _ = ((K / m_E) * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s)) * ∑ b₀, lam b₀ := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
          _ = (K / m_E) * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s) := by rw [hlam_sum, mul_one]
      have h_pow_le : (K / m_E) * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s) ≤ ρ ^ (s * ϑ / 2) := by
        have h1 : K / m_E ≤ ρ ^ (-κ) * ρ ^ (-ω) := by
          dsimp [K]
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_E_inv hK_pos.le
        have h2 : (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s = ρ ^ (s * ϑ) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul hρ_pos.le, mul_comm]
        calc (K / m_E) * (K * (ρ ^ ϑ) ^ s)
            ≤ (ρ ^ (-κ) * ρ ^ (-ω)) * (ρ ^ (-κ) * ρ ^ (s * ϑ)) := by
              rw [h2]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
          _ = ρ ^ (-κ) * ρ ^ (-ω) * ρ ^ (-κ) * ρ ^ (s * ϑ) := by ring
          _ = ρ ^ (-κ + -ω + -κ + s * ϑ) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hρ_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hρ_pos]
          _ ≤ ρ ^ (s * ϑ / 2) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_pos hρ_lt1.le (by linarith only [hn_sep1])
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans h_sum_le h_pow_le) hn_sep2
    have h_exists_pair : ∃ b₀ b₁ : Fin NΘ,
        0 < R01 b₀ b₁ ∧

          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => blk.hπ_nn l i' b₂) (Finset.mem_univ i)))

informal_problem.statement:
(s σ : ℝ) (a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hs₀ : 0 < s) (hs₁ : s ≤ 1)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a_pt 0 ∧ a_pt 0 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 1 ∧ a_pt 1 ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 2 ∧ a_pt 2 ≤ 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro hz_lt
  by_contra h_not_le
  have hq_gt : 2 - s < a_pt 1 := lt_of_not_ge h_not_le
  let q : ℝ := a_pt 1
  let z : ℝ := a_pt 2
  have hq_le2 : q ≤ 2 := ha.2.2.2.1
  have hz_nn : 0 ≤ z := ha.2.2.2.2.1
  have hq_pos : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; linarith
  have h_min_eq : min 1 (min q ((q + s) / 2)) = 1 := by
    refine min_eq_left (le_min ?_ ?_) <;> { dsimp [q]; linarith }
  let ϑ : ℝ := (1 - z) / 4
  let α_loss : ℝ := (1 - z) / 4
  have hϑ_pos : 0 < ϑ := by dsimp [ϑ, z]; linarith
  have hϑ_le1 : ϑ ≤ 1 := by dsimp [ϑ, z]; linarith
  have hα_pos : 0 < α_loss := hϑ_pos
  obtain ⟨η, ρ₁, hη_pos, hρ₁_pos, hρ₁_half, h_app⟩ :=
    h_uproj q s α_loss 30 1 hq_pos hq_le2 hs₀ hs₁ hα_pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  
  have h_norm2 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ^ 2 = (v 0) ^ 2 + (v 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have h_inner2 : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ u v = u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 := by
    intro u v
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, mul_comm]
  have h_flip_inv : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), flip2D (flip2D v) = v := by
    intro v; ext idx; fin_cases idx <;> simp [flip2D]
  have h_flip_sub : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), flip2D (u - v) = flip2D u - flip2D v := by
    intro u v; ext idx; fin_cases idx <;> simp [flip2D]
  have h_flip_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖flip2D v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
    rw [h_norm2, h_norm2]
    simp [flip2D]
    ring
  have h_dirVec_unit : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖dirVec v‖ = 1 := by
    intro v
    unfold dirVec
    split_ifs with hv
    · refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one).mp ?_
      rw [h_norm2]
      simp
    · have hv_pos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hv_pos, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv_pos.ne']
  have h_rot_sub : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      chartRot c (u - v) = chartRot c u - chartRot c v := by
    intro c u v; fin_cases c <;> { ext idx; fin_cases idx <;> simp [chartRot] <;> ring }
  have h_rot_norm : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖chartRot c v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro c v
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
    rw [h_norm2, h_norm2]
    fin_cases c <;> simp [chartRot] <;> ring
  have h_chart_cap : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 0) ^ 2 + (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      0 < chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1 ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ (chartRot (s1Chart e) e 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro e he
    have he_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_norm2 e
      rw [he, one_pow] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have h_ab : (e 0 + e 1) ^ 2 + (e 0 - e 1) ^ 2 = 2 := by linarith [he_sq]
    unfold s1Chart
    split_ifs with h0 h1 h2
    · change (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∧ 0 < e 1 ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ (e 1) ^ 2
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h0.1.le h0.2
      exact ⟨he_sq, by linarith [h0.1, h0.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 1 e 0 = e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 1 e 1 = e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 1 - e 0) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h1.1 (by linarith [h1.2])
      exact ⟨by linarith [he_sq], by linarith [h1.1, h1.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 2 e 0 = -e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 2 e 1 = -e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have hp : (e 0 + e 1) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h2.1.le h2.2
      exact ⟨by nlinarith [he_sq], by linarith [h2.1, h2.2], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
    · have hw0 : chartRot 3 e 0 = -e 1 := by simp [chartRot]
      have hw1 : chartRot 3 e 1 = -e 0 := by simp [chartRot]
      rw [hw0, hw1]
      have ha_le : e 0 + e 1 ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra ha_gt
        have ha_pos : 0 < e 0 + e 1 := lt_of_not_ge ha_gt
        have hb_pos : 0 < e 0 - e 1 := by
          by_contra hb_le
          exact h0 ⟨ha_pos, le_of_not_gt hb_le⟩
        exact h1 ⟨ha_pos.le, hb_pos⟩
      have hb_lt : e 0 - e 1 < 0 := by
        by_contra hb_ge
        have hb_nn : 0 ≤ e 0 - e 1 := le_of_not_gt hb_ge
        have ha_eq : e 0 + e 1 = 0 := by
          by_contra ha_ne
          exact h2 ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne ha_le ha_ne, hb_nn⟩
        have hb_eq : e 0 - e 1 = 0 := by
          by_contra hb_ne
          exact h1 ⟨by linarith [ha_eq], lt_of_le_of_ne hb_nn (Ne.symm hb_ne)⟩
        nlinarith [h_ab, ha_eq, hb_eq]
      have hp : (-(e 0 + e 1)) * (e 0 - e 1) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith [ha_le]) hb_lt.le
      exact ⟨by nlinarith [he_sq], by linarith [ha_le, hb_lt], by nlinarith [he_sq, hp]⟩
  have h_s1Coord_lip : ∀ (c : Fin 4) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → s1Chart u = c → s1Chart v = c →
      |s1Coord u - s1Coord v| ≤ 2 * ‖u - v‖ := by
    intro c u v hu hv hcu hcv
    let u' := chartRot c u
    let v' := chartRot c v
    have hu_cap := h_chart_cap u hu
    have hv_cap := h_chart_cap v hv
    rw [hcu] at hu_cap
    rw [hcv] at hv_cap
    obtain ⟨_, hu1_pos, hu1_sq⟩ := hu_cap
    obtain ⟨hv_sq, hv1_pos, hv1_sq⟩ := hv_cap
    have h_coord_u : s1Coord u = u' 0 / u' 1 := by simp [s1Coord, hcu, u']
    have h_coord_v : s1Coord v = v' 0 / v' 1 := by simp [s1Coord, hcv, v']
    let num := (u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 1 - v' 0 * (u' 1 - v' 1)
    have h_diff_eq : s1Coord u - s1Coord v = num / (u' 1 * v' 1) := by
      rw [h_coord_u, h_coord_v]
      dsimp [u', v', num]
      field_simp [hu1_pos.ne', hv1_pos.ne']
      ring
    have h_uv_sq : ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = (u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2 := by
      calc ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = ‖chartRot c (u - v)‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h_rot_norm]
        _ = ‖u' - v'‖ ^ 2 := by rw [h_rot_sub]
        _ = (u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2 := h_norm2 (u' - v')
    have h_num_sq : num ^ 2 ≤ ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_lag : ((u' 0 - v' 0) ^ 2 + (u' 1 - v' 1) ^ 2) * ((v' 0) ^ 2 + (v' 1) ^ 2) - num ^ 2 =
          ((u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 0 + (u' 1 - v' 1) * v' 1) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [num]; ring
      have h_nn := sq_nonneg ((u' 0 - v' 0) * v' 0 + (u' 1 - v' 1) * v' 1)
      rw [hv_sq, mul_one, ← h_uv_sq] at h_lag
      linarith
    have h_num_abs : |num| ≤ ‖u - v‖ :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp (by rwa [sq_abs])
    have h_den_pos : 0 < u' 1 * v' 1 := mul_pos hu1_pos hv1_pos
    have h_den_ge : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ u' 1 * v' 1 := by
      refine (sq_le_sq₀ (by norm_num) h_den_pos.le).mp ?_
      calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) := by norm_num
        _ ≤ (u' 1) ^ 2 * (v' 1) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul hu1_sq hv1_sq (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (u' 1 * v' 1) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h_diff_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos h_den_pos, div_le_iff₀ h_den_pos]
    calc |num| ≤ ‖u - v‖ := h_num_abs
      _ = (2 * ‖u - v‖) * (1 / 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * ‖u - v‖) * (u' 1 * v' 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_den_ge (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (norm_nonneg _))
  have h_dyadic_step : ∀ (ρ L : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ L →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ρ L) * ρ ^ L ≤ 1 := by
    intro ρ L hρ0 _ _
    let m : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ρ L
    have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    have hm_le : (m : ℝ) ≤ L * (Real.log (ρ⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := Int.floor_le _
    have hm1 : (m : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ L * (-Real.log ρ) := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le hlog2.le
      rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlog2.ne', Real.log_inv] at h
      exact h
    change (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ ^ L ≤ 1
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ ^ L
        = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m : ℝ) * ρ ^ L := by rw [Real.rpow_intCast]
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (m : ℝ)) * Real.exp (Real.log ρ * L) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos zero_lt_two, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ0]
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 * (m : ℝ) + Real.log ρ * L) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp 0 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = 1 := Real.exp_zero
  have h_dirBin_ball_cover : ∀ (ρ d_k : ℝ) (e₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ d_k → ‖e₁‖ = 1 →
      ∃ S_bins : Finset (Fin 4 × ℤ), (S_bins.card : ℝ) ≤ 36 ∧
        ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖u - e₁‖ < ρ ^ d_k →
          dirBin ρ d_k u ∈ S_bins := by
    intro ρ d_k e₁ hρ0 hρ1 hd_k _
    let P_wit : Fin 4 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Prop :=
      fun c v => ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ ‖v - e₁‖ < ρ ^ d_k ∧ s1Chart v = c
    let k_wit : Fin 4 → ℤ := fun c =>
      if hc : ∃ v, P_wit c v then dyadicRealBin ρ d_k (s1Coord (Classical.choose hc)) else 0
    let S_bins : Finset (Fin 4 × ℤ) :=
      Finset.univ.biUnion (fun c : Fin 4 =>
        (Finset.Icc (k_wit c - 4) (k_wit c + 4)).image (fun k => (c, k)))
    refine ⟨S_bins, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_card : S_bins.card ≤ 36 := by
        calc S_bins.card
            ≤ ∑ c : Fin 4,
                ((Finset.Icc (k_wit c - 4) (k_wit c + 4)).image (fun k => (c, k))).card :=
              Finset.card_biUnion_le
          _ ≤ ∑ c : Fin 4, (Finset.Icc (k_wit c - 4) (k_wit c + 4)).card :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun _ _ => Finset.card_image_le)
          _ = ∑ _c : Fin 4, 9 := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
              rw [Int.card_Icc]
              omega
          _ = 36 := by norm_num
      exact_mod_cast h_card
    · intro u hu hu_dist
      let c := s1Chart u
      have hc : ∃ v, P_wit c v := ⟨u, hu, hu_dist, rfl⟩
      let v_c := Classical.choose hc
      have hv_c : P_wit c v_c := Classical.choose_spec hc
      have hk_eq : k_wit c = dyadicRealBin ρ d_k (s1Coord v_c) := dif_pos hc
      have h_uv_norm : ‖u - v_c‖ < 2 * ρ ^ d_k := by
        calc ‖u - v_c‖ = ‖(u - e₁) - (v_c - e₁)‖ := by congr 1; abel
          _ ≤ ‖u - e₁‖ + ‖v_c - e₁‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ < ρ ^ d_k + ρ ^ d_k := add_lt_add hu_dist hv_c.2.1
          _ = 2 * ρ ^ d_k := by ring
      have h_coord_diff : |s1Coord u - s1Coord v_c| < 4 * ρ ^ d_k := by
        calc |s1Coord u - s1Coord v_c| ≤ 2 * ‖u - v_c‖ :=
              h_s1Coord_lip c u v_c hu hv_c.1 rfl hv_c.2.2
          _ < 2 * (2 * ρ ^ d_k) := by linarith
          _ = 4 * ρ ^ d_k := by ring
      let m := dyadicRealLevel ρ d_k
      have hm_pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := zpow_pos zero_lt_two m
      have hm_prod : (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ ^ d_k ≤ 1 := h_dyadic_step ρ d_k hρ0 hρ1 hd_k
      let x := s1Coord u * (2 : ℝ) ^ m
      let y := s1Coord v_c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m
      have h_xy : |x - y| < 4 := by
        calc |x - y| = |s1Coord u - s1Coord v_c| * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
              dsimp [x, y]; rw [← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hm_pos]
          _ < (4 * ρ ^ d_k) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_coord_diff hm_pos
          _ = 4 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ ^ d_k) := by ring
          _ ≤ 4 * 1 := by linarith
          _ = 4 := by ring
      have hy_lo : (k_wit c : ℝ) ≤ y := by rw [hk_eq]; exact Int.floor_le y
      have hy_hi : y < (k_wit c : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hk_eq]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one y
      have hx_lo : k_wit c - 4 ≤ dyadicRealBin ρ d_k (s1Coord u) := by
        refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
        push_cast
        linarith [(abs_lt.mp h_xy).1]
      have hx_hi : dyadicRealBin ρ d_k (s1Coord u) ≤ k_wit c + 4 := by
        have hlt : dyadicRealBin ρ d_k (s1Coord u) < k_wit c + 5 := by
          refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
          push_cast
          linarith [(abs_lt.mp h_xy).2]
        omega
      unfold dirBin
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨c, Finset.mem_univ c, ?_⟩
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨dyadicRealBin ρ d_k (s1Coord u), ?_, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hx_lo, hx_hi⟩
  
  have h_mid_err : ∀ (ρ x : ℝ), 0 < ρ → |canonicalGridMid ρ x - x| ≤ ρ / 2 := by
    intro ρ x hρ
    unfold canonicalGridMid canonicalGridBin
    have h_lo : (⌊x / ρ⌋ : ℝ) * ρ ≤ x := (le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.floor_le (x / ρ))
    have h_hi : x < ((⌊x / ρ⌋ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ hρ).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / ρ))
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_midU_dom : ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ),
      0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → (∀ j, |P j| ≤ 4) → |θ.1| ≤ 4 ∧ |θ.2| ≤ 4 →
      ‖canonicalMidU ρ P θ‖ ≤ 30 := by
    intro ρ P θ hρ0 hρ1 hP ⟨hθ1, hθ2⟩
    let u := canonicalMidU ρ P θ
    have hu0_eq : u 0 = canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 1) := by
      simp [u, canonicalMidU]
    have hu1_eq : u 1 = canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 2) := by
      simp [u, canonicalMidU]
    have hm1 : |θ.1 * P 0| ≤ 16 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |θ.1| * |P 0| ≤ 4 * 4 := mul_le_mul hθ1 (hP 0) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 16 := by norm_num
    have hm2 : |θ.2 * P 0| ≤ 16 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |θ.2| * |P 0| ≤ 4 * 4 := mul_le_mul hθ2 (hP 0) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 16 := by norm_num
    have herr1 := h_mid_err ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 1) hρ0
    have herr2 := h_mid_err ρ (canonicalShear4 P θ 2) hρ0
    have hQ1_eq : canonicalShear4 P θ 1 = P 1 + θ.1 * P 0 := by simp [canonicalShear4]
    have hQ2_eq : canonicalShear4 P θ 2 = P 2 + θ.2 * P 0 := by simp [canonicalShear4]
    have hp1 := hP 1
    have hp2 := hP 2
    rw [abs_le] at hm1 hm2 herr1 herr2 hp1 hp2
    have hu0_abs : |u 0| ≤ 21 := by
      rw [hu0_eq]
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hu1_abs : |u 1| ≤ 21 := by
      rw [hu1_eq]
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hu0_sq : (u 0) ^ 2 ≤ 441 := by
      have h := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 21)).mpr hu0_abs
      rw [sq_abs] at h
      linarith
    have hu1_sq : (u 1) ^ 2 ≤ 441 := by
      have h := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 21)).mpr hu1_abs
      rw [sq_abs] at h
      linarith
    refine (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg u) (by norm_num)).mp ?_
    rw [h_norm2 u]
    linarith
  have h_ortho_shear : ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ × ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < ρ → (∀ j, |P j| ≤ 4) →
      (|θ₀.1| ≤ 4 ∧ |θ₀.2| ≤ 4) → (|θ₁.1| ≤ 4 ∧ |θ₁.2| ≤ 4) →
      v 0 = θ₁.1 - θ₀.1 → v 1 = θ₁.2 - θ₀.2 → 0 < ‖v‖ →
      let Q₀ := canonicalShear4 P θ₀
      let Q₁ := canonicalShear4 P θ₁
      let Δ₁ := θ₁.1 - θ₀.1
      let Δ₂ := θ₁.2 - θ₀.2
      |‖v‖ * inner ℝ (canonicalMidU ρ P θ₀) (flip2D (dirVec v)) -
        (canonicalGridMid ρ (Q₁ 3) - canonicalGridMid ρ (Q₀ 3) -
          Δ₁ * Δ₂ * canonicalGridMid ρ (Q₀ 0))| ≤ 41 * ρ := by
    intro ρ P θ₀ θ₁ v hρ hP ⟨hθ₀1, hθ₀2⟩ ⟨hθ₁1, hθ₁2⟩ hv0 hv1 hα
    let Q₀ := canonicalShear4 P θ₀
    let Q₁ := canonicalShear4 P θ₁
    let Δ₁ := θ₁.1 - θ₀.1
    let Δ₂ := θ₁.2 - θ₀.2
    let x_P := canonicalMidU ρ P θ₀
    let X_hat := canonicalGridMid ρ (Q₀ 0)
    let Z0_hat := canonicalGridMid ρ (Q₀ 3)
    let Z1_hat := canonicalGridMid ρ (Q₁ 3)
    let e := flip2D (dirVec v)
    have hv_ne : v ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hα
    have he0 : ‖v‖ * e 0 = Δ₂ := by
      have h_eq : e 0 = ‖v‖⁻¹ * v 1 := by simp [e, flip2D, dirVec, hv_ne]
      rw [h_eq, hv1, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hα.ne']
    have he1 : ‖v‖ * e 1 = Δ₁ := by

                (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ_pos.le _) (by norm_num)
      refine le_trans (le_trans h_pow_inc h_lb_inc) (le_of_eq ?_)
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => ?_))
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    · 
      intro b₁
      have hG_imp : ∀ i : Fin N_P, G i b₁ →
          ρ ^ ϑ ≤ ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ ∧ 0 < blk.π_seq l i b₁ := by
        intro i hGi
        have h_gin : 0 < G_in i b₁ := hν_star_supp i b₁ hGi.2.2
        have h_qsep : 0 < Q_sep i b₀ b₁ := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hm₀_pos).mp h_gin
        have h_sep : ρ ^ ϑ ≤ ‖paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀‖ := by
          by_contra h_not_sep
          dsimp [Q_sep] at h_qsep
          rw [if_neg h_not_sep] at h_qsep
          linarith
        have h_s3_pos : 0 < ∑ b₂, S3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le h_qsep
            (le_trans (hQ_sep_le_raw i b₀ b₁) (hQ_raw_le_S3 i b₀ b₁))
        have hπ_pos : 0 < blk.π_seq l i b₁ := by
          by_contra h_not_pos
          have hπ_z : blk.π_seq l i b₁ = 0 :=
            le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_not_pos) (blk.hπ_nn l i b₁)
          have h_z : (∑ b₂, S3 i b₀ b₁ b₂) = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b₂ _ => ?_)
            dsimp [S3, threeReplicaStar]
            split_ifs <;> simp [hπ_z]
          linarith
        exact ⟨h_sep, hπ_pos⟩
      by_cases hexG : ∃ i : Fin N_P, G i b₁
      · obtain ⟨i_w, hi_w⟩ := hexG
        obtain ⟨hα_ge, hπ_iw⟩ := hG_imp i_w hi_w
        let v_diff := paramVec blk l b₁ - paramVec blk l b₀
        let α_b1 := ‖v_diff‖
        have hρϑ_pos : 0 < ρ ^ ϑ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos ϑ
        have hα_pos_b1 : 0 < α_b1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hρϑ_pos hα_ge
        have hlam1_pos : 0 < ∑ i, blk.π_seq l i b₁ :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_iw
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => blk.hπ_nn l i b₁) (Finset.mem_univ i_w))
        obtain ⟨S_Z, hSZ_card, hSZ_cov⟩ :=
          blk.h_Z_cov l b₁ ρ hlam1_pos (le_refl ρ) (by linarith [hρ_b.2])
        let Δ₁ := (blk.θ_seq l b₁).1 - (blk.θ_seq l b₀).1
        let Δ₂ := (blk.θ_seq l b₁).2 - (blk.θ_seq l b₀).2
        let X_sl := ((t_star : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
        let Z0_sl := ((kZ_star : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
        let c_map : ℝ → ℝ := fun c_Z => (c_Z - Z0_sl - Δ₁ * Δ₂ * X_sl) / α_b1
        obtain ⟨S_cov, hScov_card, hScov_mem⟩ := h_subdiv_cov ρ S_Z c_map hρ_pos hρ_b.2
        refine ⟨S_cov, ?_, ?_⟩
        · calc (S_cov.card : ℝ)
              ≤ (S_Z.card : ℝ) * (90 * ρ ^ (-ϑ)) := hScov_card
            _ ≤ (ρ ^ (-κ) * ρ ^ (-z)) * (90 * ρ ^ (-ϑ)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSZ_card (by positivity)
            _ = 90 * (ρ ^ (-κ) * ρ ^ (-z) * ρ ^ (-ϑ)) := by ring
            _ = M := by
                dsimp [M]
                rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hρ_pos]
                ring_nf
        · intro i hGi
          obtain ⟨_, hπ_i⟩ := hG_imp i hGi
          obtain ⟨c_Z, hcZ_mem, hcZ_est⟩ := hSZ_cov i hπ_i
          refine hScov_mem (inner ℝ (x_P i) (e_B b₁)) ⟨c_Z, hcZ_mem, ?_⟩
          have hv0 : v_diff 0 = Δ₁ := by simp [v_diff, paramVec, Δ₁]
          have hv1 : v_diff 1 = Δ₂ := by simp [v_diff, paramVec, Δ₂]
          have h_sh := h_ortho_shear ρ (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) (blk.θ_seq l b₁)
            v_diff hρ_pos (blk.hP_dom l i) (blk.hθ_dom l b₀) (blk.hθ_dom l b₁)
            hv0 hv1 hα_pos_b1
          have hX_eq : canonicalGridMid ρ
              (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) 0) = X_sl := by
            unfold canonicalGridMid
            change ((bX i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ = X_sl
            rw [hGi.1]
          have hZ0_eq : canonicalGridMid ρ
              (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) 3) = Z0_sl := by
            unfold canonicalGridMid
            change ((bZ₀ i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ = Z0_sl
            rw [hGi.2.1]
          change |α_b1 * inner ℝ (x_P i) (e_B b₁) -
            (canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₁) 3) -
              canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) 3) -
              Δ₁ * Δ₂ * canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (blk.P_seq l i) (blk.θ_seq l b₀) 0))| ≤
            41 * ρ at h_sh
          rw [hX_eq, hZ0_eq] at h_sh
          have h_cmap_mul : α_b1 * c_map c_Z = c_Z - Z0_sl - Δ₁ * Δ₂ * X_sl :=
            mul_div_cancel₀ _ hα_pos_b1.ne'
          rw [abs_le] at h_sh hcZ_est
          have h_scaled : |α_b1 * (inner ℝ (x_P i) (e_B b₁) - c_map c_Z)| ≤ 42 * ρ := by
            rw [mul_sub, h_cmap_mul]
            exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hα_pos_b1] at h_scaled
          have h_div_α : |inner ℝ (x_P i) (e_B b₁) - c_map c_Z| ≤ (42 * ρ) / α_b1 :=
            (le_div_iff₀ hα_pos_b1).mpr (by linarith)
          calc |inner ℝ (x_P i) (e_B b₁) - c_map c_Z|
              ≤ (42 * ρ) / α_b1 := h_div_α
            _ ≤ (42 * ρ) / (ρ ^ ϑ) :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hρϑ_pos hα_ge
            _ = (42 * ρ ^ (-ϑ)) * ρ := by
                rw [Real.rpow_neg hρ_pos.le]
                field_simp [hρϑ_pos.ne']
      · refine ⟨∅, by simp [hM_pos.le], ?_⟩
        intro i hGi
        exact absurd ⟨i, hGi⟩ hexG
  
  rw [h_min_eq] at h_proj_est
  have h_exp_final : ϑ + (-1 + α_loss) ≤ -(z + ϑ + κ) := by
    have hκ_lt : κ < ϑ := hn_κ_ϑ
    dsimp [ϑ, α_loss] at hκ_lt ⊢
    linarith [hκ_lt]
  have h_pow_final : ρ ^ (-(z + ϑ + κ)) ≤ ρ ^ ϑ * ρ ^ (-1 + α_loss) := by
    calc ρ ^ (-(z + ϑ + κ))
        ≤ ρ ^ (ϑ + (-1 + α_loss)) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_pos hρ_lt1.le h_exp_final
      _ = ρ ^ ϑ * ρ ^ (-1 + α_loss) := Real.rpow_add hρ_pos _ _
  have h_pos_lhs : 0 < ρ ^ (-1 + α_loss) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos _
  have h_strict : M < ρ ^ (-1 + α_loss) := by
    dsimp [M]
    calc 90 * ρ ^ (-(z + ϑ + κ))
        ≤ 90 * (ρ ^ ϑ * ρ ^ (-1 + α_loss)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow_final (by norm_num)
      _ = (90 * ρ ^ ϑ) * ρ ^ (-1 + α_loss) := by ring
      _ < 1 * ρ ^ (-1 + α_loss) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith [hn_90]) h_pos_lhs
      _ = ρ ^ (-1 + α_loss) := one_mul _
  linarith [h_proj_est, h_strict]

informal_problem.statement:
(B_dom : ℝ) (hB : 1 ≤ B_dom) :
    ∃ (C_LW C_inv : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_LW ∧ 1 ≤ C_inv ∧
      (∀ {α_P : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] (S_P E_v : Finset α_P)
         (c_pt : α_P → ℝ) (x_pt : α_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (v_bar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ρ R₀ m_ch : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → 0 ≤ R₀ → 0 < m_ch → E_v ⊆ S_P →
        (∀ p ∈ E_v, ∃ F_p : Finset α_P, F_p ⊆ S_P ∧ m_ch ≤ (F_p.card : ℝ) ∧
          ∀ p' ∈ F_p,
            |(x_pt p' 0 - c_pt p' * v_bar 0) - (x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar 0)| ≤ R₀ * ρ ∧
            |(x_pt p' 1 - c_pt p' * v_bar 1) - (x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar 1)| ≤ R₀ * ρ) →
        ((E_v.image (fun p =>
          (⌊(x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar 0) / ρ⌋,
           ⌊(x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar 1) / ρ⌋))).card : ℝ) ≤
          (((2 * ⌈R₀⌉₊ + 3) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (S_P.card : ℝ) / m_ch) ∧
      (∀ {α_P α_V : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
         (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_V : Finset α_V)
         (c_pt : α_P → ℝ) (x_pt : α_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (v_bar : α_V → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (q : α_P → α_V → ℝ) (ρ ϑ K M_P N_int : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 < ϑ → ϑ < 1 → 1 ≤ K → 0 < M_P → 0 ≤ N_int →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, |c_pt p| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p 0| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p 1| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p₁ ∈ S_P, ∀ p₂ ∈ S_P, p₁ ≠ p₂ →
          ρ / 2 ≤ max |c_pt p₁ - c_pt p₂|
            (max |x_pt p₁ 0 - x_pt p₂ 0| |x_pt p₁ 1 - x_pt p₂ 1|)) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, |v_bar v 0| ≤ B_dom ∧ |v_bar v 1| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V, 0 ≤ q p v) →
        (∑ p ∈ S_P, ∑ v ∈ S_V, q p v = 1) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V,
          q p v ≤ K * (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') * (∑ p' ∈ S_P, q p' v)) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') ≤ M_P⁻¹) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, ∃ I_v : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), (I_v.card : ℝ) ≤ N_int ∧
          ∀ p ∈ S_P, 0 < q p v →
            (⌊(x_pt p 0 - c_pt p * v_bar v 0) / ρ⌋,
             ⌊(x_pt p 1 - c_pt p * v_bar v 1) / ρ⌋) ∈ I_v) →
        (∃ (n_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (w_off : ℝ) (S_strip : Finset α_V),
          ‖n_vec‖ = 1 ∧ S_strip ⊆ S_V ∧
          (∀ v ∈ S_strip, |inner ℝ (v_bar v) n_vec - w_off| ≤ 2 * ρ ^ ϑ) ∧
          1 / (8 * K ^ 3) ≤ ∑ v ∈ S_strip, ∑ p ∈ S_P, q p v) ∨
        (M_P / (2 * K ^ 3)) ^ 2 ≤ C_LW * ρ ^ (-(12 * ϑ)) * N_int ^ 3) ∧
      (∀ {α_P α_V : Type} [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
         (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_V : Finset α_V)
         (c_pt x_pt : α_P → ℝ) (v_bar : α_V → ℝ)
         (q : α_P → α_V → ℝ) (ρ a₀ K M_P N_int : ℝ),
        0 < ρ → ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 < a₀ → a₀ < 1 → 1 ≤ K → 0 < M_P → 0 ≤ N_int →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, |c_pt p| ≤ B_dom ∧ |x_pt p| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p₁ ∈ S_P, ∀ p₂ ∈ S_P, p₁ ≠ p₂ →
          ρ / 2 ≤ max |c_pt p₁ - c_pt p₂| |x_pt p₁ - x_pt p₂|) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, |v_bar v| ≤ B_dom) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V, 0 ≤ q p v) →
        (∑ p ∈ S_P, ∑ v ∈ S_V, q p v = 1) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, ∀ v ∈ S_V,
          q p v ≤ K * (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') * (∑ p' ∈ S_P, q p' v)) →
        (∀ p ∈ S_P, (∑ v' ∈ S_V, q p v') ≤ M_P⁻¹) →
        (∀ (x₀ : ℝ) (S_int : Finset α_V), S_int ⊆ S_V →
          (∀ v ∈ S_int, |v_bar v - x₀| ≤ ρ ^ a₀) →
          (∑ v ∈ S_int, ∑ p ∈ S_P, q p v) ≤ 1 / (4 * K ^ 2)) →
        (∀ v ∈ S_V, ∃ I_v : Finset ℤ, (I_v.card : ℝ) ≤ N_int ∧
          ∀ p ∈ S_P, 0 < q p v → ⌊(x_pt p - c_pt p * v_bar v) / ρ⌋ ∈ I_v) →
        M_P / (2 * K ^ 2) ≤ C_inv * ρ ^ (-(2 * a₀)) * N_int ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hB_pos : 0 < B_dom := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB
  let C_LW : ℝ := (22 : ℝ) ^ 6 * B_dom ^ 12
  let C_inv : ℝ := (8 * B_dom + 7) ^ 2
  have hC_LW_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_LW :=
    one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (by norm_num) (one_le_pow₀ hB)
  have hC_inv_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_inv := by
    dsimp [C_inv]
    nlinarith [hB]
  have h_floor_box : ∀ (y y₀ : ℝ) (K_nat : ℕ),
      |y₀ - y| ≤ (K_nat : ℝ) →
      ⌊y₀⌋ ∈ Finset.Icc (⌊y⌋ - ((K_nat : ℤ) + 1)) (⌊y⌋ + ((K_nat : ℤ) + 1)) := by
    intro y y₀ K_nat h_abs
    obtain ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h_abs
    have hy_lo : (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) ≤ y := Int.floor_le y
    have hy_hi : y < (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one y
    have hy0_lo : (⌊y₀⌋ : ℝ) ≤ y₀ := Int.floor_le y₀
    have hy0_hi : y₀ < (⌊y₀⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one y₀
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · have h1 : ((⌊y⌋ - ((K_nat : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) < (⌊y₀⌋ : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        linarith
      exact le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast h1)
    · have h2 : (⌊y₀⌋ : ℝ) < ((⌊y⌋ + ((K_nat : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        linarith
      exact le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast h2)
  have h_card_box : ∀ (c : ℤ) (K_nat : ℕ),
      (Finset.Icc (c - ((K_nat : ℤ) + 1)) (c + ((K_nat : ℤ) + 1))).card = 2 * K_nat + 3 := by
    intro c K_nat
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    omega
  have h_floor_symm_box : ∀ (z : ℝ) (L_nat : ℕ),
      |z| ≤ (L_nat : ℝ) →
      ⌊z⌋ ∈ Finset.Icc (-(L_nat : ℤ)) (L_nat : ℤ) := by
    intro z L_nat hz
    obtain ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hz
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_

(∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)

      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π W X ∧
      0 ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W X ∧
      0 ≤ finCondMutualInfo ε π W X Y ∧

        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, Y ω)) X ∧

      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →

       (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ → X ω₁ = X ω₂ → (Y ω₁ = Y ω₂ ↔ Z ω₁ = Z ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y = finCondEntropy ε π X Z) ∧

       (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),

      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →

        ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → X ω = X ω₀ → Y ω ∈ S_Y) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y ≤ Real.log N_max / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧

       (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),

      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, Q ω ≤ K * π ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → d_min ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω) →
      d_min - Real.log K / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ finCondEntropy ε Q X Y) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_W α_Par α_P α_V : Type}
       [DecidableEq α_W] [DecidableEq α_Par] [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
       (ε K_amb u_blk ζ δ_gap D_cap C_ch p_hi ζ_MI : ℝ)
       (π π_amb : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (W : Fin N_ω → α_W) (Par : Fin N_ω → α_Par)
       (P : Fin N_ω → α_P) (V_obs : Fin N_ω → α_V)
       (E_allow : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ K_amb →
      0 < u_blk → 0 < ζ → 0 < δ_gap → 0 < D_cap → 1 ≤ C_ch →
      0 ≤ p_hi → p_hi ≤ D_cap → 0 ≤ ζ_MI →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_amb ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_amb ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, π ω ≤ K_amb * π_amb ω) →
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, Par ω₁ = Par ω₂ → W ω₁ = W ω₂) →
      1 - δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_allow, π ω →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < π ω₀ → ∃ S_ch : Finset α_P,
        (S_ch.card : ℝ) ≤ C_ch * (ε ^ u_blk) ^ (-D_cap) ∧
        ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → W ω = W ω₀ → P ω ∈ S_ch) →
      finCondEntropy ε π W P ≤ (p_hi - δ_gap) * u_blk →
      finCondMutualInfo ε π W V_obs P ≤ ζ_MI * u_blk →
      ζ_MI / ζ + 1 / (ζ * u_blk * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ≤ δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) →
      C_ch * ε ^ u_blk ≤ δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) →
      let ρ := ε ^ u_blk
      let J_bins : ℕ := 1 + ⌈(D_cap + 2) / ζ⌉₊
      let c_ret : ℝ := δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2) * (J_bins : ℝ))
      ∃ (p_star : ℝ) (E_good : Finset (Fin N_ω)) (G_W : Finset α_W),
        0 ≤ p_star ∧ p_star ≤ p_hi - δ_gap / 2 ∧
        E_good ⊆ E_allow ∧
        (∀ ω ∈ E_good, 0 < π ω) ∧

        ∀ w ∈ G_W,
          let E_w := E_good.filter (fun ω => W ω = w)
          let m_w := ∑ ω ∈ E_w, π ω
          0 < m_w ∧
          (c_ret / 4) * (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if W ω = w then π ω else 0) ≤ m_w ∧
          ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) ≤ ρ ^ (-(p_star + ζ)) ∧

            (∀ ω, ω ∉ E_w → q ω = 0) ∧
            (∀ ω ∈ E_w, q ω ≤ (2 / m_w) * π ω) ∧
            (∀ p₀ v₀,
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀ then q ω else 0) ≤
                (256 / c_ret) * ρ ^ (-ζ) *
                  (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ then q ω else 0) *
                  (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if V_obs ω = v₀ then q ω else 0)) ∧
            (∀ p₀,
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ then q ω else 0) ≤ (8 / c_ret) * ρ ^ p_star) ∧
            (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < q ω →
              (c_ret / (16 * K_amb)) *
                (∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if Par ω' = Par ω then π_amb ω' else 0) ≤
                ∑ ω' ∈ E_w, if Par ω' = Par ω then π_amb ω' else 0))

          have hden : 0 < ε ^ (s + ξ) * pT := mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _) hpT_pos
          have h1 := (le_div_iff₀ hden).mpr h_sum_y
          have h2 : pT / (ε ^ (s + ξ) * pT) = N_k1 := by
            dsimp [N_k1]
            rw [mul_comm (ε ^ (s + ξ)) pT, div_mul_eq_div_div, div_self hpT_pos.ne',
              one_div, Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le]
          rwa [h2] at h1
        exact ⟨S_Y, h_card_le, fun ω hω_pos htid =>
          Finset.mem_image_of_mem k₁ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hP_allow ω hω_pos, htid⟩)⟩)
    have h_log_N : Real.log N_k1 / ell = s + ξ := by
      dsimp [N_k1]
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε_pos, Real.log_exp]
      have hinv : ell = -Real.log ε := Real.log_inv ε
      have h_alg : Real.log ε * -(s + ξ) = (s + ξ) * ell := by rw [hinv]; ring
      rw [h_alg, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hell_pos.ne']
    rwa [h_log_N] at h_card_ent

  have hH_k1_tilde_ub : finCondEntropy ε π_tilde T_idx k₁ ≤ s + ξ :=
    hH_k1_allow_ub π_tilde hπ_t_nn hπ_t_sum hπ_t_allow

  have hH_k1_π0_ub : finCondEntropy ε π₀ T_idx k₁ ≤ s + ξ :=
    hH_k1_allow_ub π₀ hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum (fun ω hpos => (hπ₀_supp ω hpos).1)

  
  have hd_O_ub : d_O ≤ 3 * s - h_cap - β + 5 * ξ := by
    linarith only [hπ_t_score, hH_k1_tilde_ub, h_log_K0_le]

  
  have hH_ku_π0_lb : ∀ u ∈ U_all,
      s * u - 2 * ξ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π₀ T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_val ω)) := by
    intro u hu
    have hkl := hs1_kl ε (s * u - ξ) K₀ π_amb π₀ T_idx
      (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_val ω))
      hε_pos hε_lt_half hK₀_ge hπ_amb_nn hπ_amb_sum hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum hπ₀_le_amb
      (fun ω hpos => by
        have habs := (h_allow_time u hu ω (hπ₀_supp ω hpos).1).1
        linarith only [(abs_sub_le_iff.mp habs).2])
    linarith only [hkl, h_log_K0_le]

  have hH_k1_π0_lb : s - 2 * ξ ≤ finCondEntropy ε π₀ T_idx k₁ := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using hH_ku_π0_lb 1 h1_in_Uall

  have hH_ktp_π0_lb : s * (1 - d_vel) - 2 * ξ ≤ finCondEntropy ε π₀ T_idx k_tp :=
    hH_ku_π0_lb (1 - d_vel) htp_in_Uall

  
  have h_sat_π0_xi :
      h_cap + β - 13 * ξ ≤
        -finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx O₁ + 2 * finCondEntropy ε π₀ T_idx k₁ := by
    rw [h_F1_id π₀ hπ₀_nn]
    linarith only [hH_O1_ub, hd_O_ub, hH_k1_π0_lb]

  
  have h_tilt_xi : ∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (K_Q : ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω, Q ω = 1) → 1 ≤ K_Q →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → 0 < π₀ ω) →
      (∀ ω, Q ω ≤ K_Q * π₀ ω) →
      classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part ≤
        h_cap + 3 * ξ + Real.log (81 * K₀ * K_Q) / ell := by
    intro Q K_Q hQ_nn hQ_sum hK_Q_ge1 hQ_supp hQ_le
    have hM_tilt_ge1 : 1 ≤ K₀ * K_Q := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hK₀_ge hK_Q_ge1
    have hQ_bin : ∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j₁.castSucc := by
      intro ω hQ_pos
      have hμ_pos : 0 < μ₁ ω := (hπ₀_supp ω (hQ_supp ω hQ_pos)).2
      dsimp [μ₁, μ_z, Z₁] at hμ_pos
      by_contra hne
      simp [hne] at hμ_pos
    have hQ_amb : ∀ ω, Q ω ≤ (K₀ * K_Q) * π_amb ω := by
      intro ω
      calc Q ω ≤ K_Q * π₀ ω := hQ_le ω
        _ ≤ K_Q * (K₀ * π_amb ω) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hπ₀_le_amb ω) (by linarith only [hK_Q_ge1])
        _ = (K₀ * K_Q) * π_amb ω := by ring
    have ht := hh_cap_tilt Q (K₀ * K_Q) hQ_nn hQ_sum hM_tilt_ge1 hQ_bin hQ_amb
    have h_mul : 81 * (K₀ * K_Q) = 81 * K₀ * K_Q := by ring
    rwa [h_mul] at ht

  
  have hτ_π0_ub : classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T π₀ T_idx V_part A_part ≤ h_cap + 4 * ξ := by
    have ht := h_tilt_xi π₀ 1 hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum le_rfl (fun _ h => h) (fun ω => by simp)
    rw [mul_one] at ht
    linarith only [ht, h_log_81K0_le]

  have h_mi_diff_lb :
      (2 - 2 * s + β) * d_vel - 24 * ξ ≤
        finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx O_tilde - finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx O₁ := by
    have h_ot := hs3_Otilde_ub π₀ hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum
    have h_δ_tp : δ₁ * (1 - d_vel) ≤ ξ := by
      have h1 : δ₁ * (1 - d_vel) ≤ δ₁ * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hd₀]) hδ₁_pos.le
      dsimp [δ₁] at h1 ⊢
      linarith only [h1, hξ₀]
    have h_alg1 : (β + δ₁) * (1 - d_vel) = β - β * d_vel + δ₁ * (1 - d_vel) := by ring
    have h_alg2 : s * (1 - d_vel) = s - s * d_vel := by ring
    have h_alg3 : (2 - 2 * s + β) * d_vel = 2 * d_vel - 2 * (s * d_vel) + β * d_vel := by ring
    linarith only [h_ot, hτ_π0_ub, h_δ_tp, h_alg1, h_sat_π0_xi, hH_k1_π0_ub, hH_ktp_π0_lb,
      h_alg2, h_alg3]

  let Z_full : Fin M_ω → (ℤ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ((ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
    fun ω => (O_tilde ω, (O₁ ω, V_d ω))

  have h_mi_Zfull_ge : finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx O_tilde ≤ finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx Z_full :=
    (hs1_basic ε π₀ T_idx O_tilde (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω))
      hε_pos hε_lt_half hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum).2.2.2.2

  have hH_Zfull_T : finCondEntropy ε π₀ T_idx Z_full = finCondEntropy ε π₀ T_idx O₁ := by
    refine hs1_equiv ε π₀ T_idx Z_full O₁ hπ₀_nn (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ htid => ?_)
    constructor
    · intro hZ
      exact (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp hZ).2).1
    · intro hO1
      have hOt : O_tilde ω₁ = O_tilde ω₂ := hO_tilde_det ω₁ ω₂ htid hO1
      have hVd : V_d ω₁ = V_d ω₂ := by
        dsimp [V_d, isoVelObs]
        rw [htid]
      dsimp [Z_full]
      rw [hOt, hO1, hVd]

  have hH_Zfull_ub : finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) Z_full ≤ d_OV + 2 * ξ := by
    have h_swap : finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) Z_full =
        finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) (fun ω => ((O₁ ω, V_d ω), O_tilde ω)) :=
      hs1_equiv ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) Z_full (fun ω => ((O₁ ω, V_d ω), O_tilde ω)) hπ₀_nn
        (fun _ _ _ _ _ => by simp [Z_full, Prod.ext_iff, and_comm])
    have h_chain := (hs1_basic ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω)) O_tilde
      hε_pos hε_lt_half hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum).2.2.2.1
    have h_pred_ent :
        finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω)) O_tilde ≤ Real.log 36 / ell := by
      refine hs1_card ε 36 π₀ (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω)) O_tilde
        hε_pos hε_lt_half (by norm_num) hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum (fun ω₀ _ => ?_)
      obtain ⟨S_pred, hS_card, hS_mem⟩ := hO_tilde_pred ω₀
      refine ⟨S_pred, hS_card, fun ω _ heq => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hO, hV⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.mp heq
      exact hS_mem ω hO hV
    rw [h_swap, h_chain]
    linarith only [hH_OV_ub, h_pred_ent, h_log_36_le]

  have h_mi_diff_ub :
      finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx O_tilde - finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx O₁ ≤ d_OV - d_O + 3 * ξ := by
    have h_Z_mi : finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx Z_full - finMutualInfo ε π₀ T_idx O₁ =
        finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) Z_full - finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) O₁ := by
      unfold finMutualInfo
      rw [hH_Zfull_T]
      ring
    linarith only [h_mi_Zfull_ge, h_Z_mi, hH_Zfull_ub, hH_O1_lb, h_log_K0_le]

  have h_exp_vel :
      (2 - 2 * s + β) * d_vel - η₀ ≤ d_OV - d_O - 2 * ξ := by
    linarith only [h_mi_diff_lb, h_mi_diff_ub, hξ_le_η, hξ₀]

  
  refine ⟨ε, h_cap, K₀, M_ω, M_T, π_amb, π₀, T_idx, V_part, A_part, c_val,
    hε_pos, lt_min hε_lt_half hε_lt_target,
    hK₀_ge, hK₀_le_max, hπ_amb_pos_c, hπ_amb_sum,
    hπ₀_bds, hπ₀_sum, hVA_bds, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu ω hω_pos
    have hu_all : u ∈ U_all :=
      Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hu)
    obtain ⟨_, h_lo, h_hi⟩ := h_allow_time u hu_all ω (hπ₀_supp ω hω_pos).1
    have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith only [hε_lt_half]
    have hξ_le_η1 : ξ ≤ η₀ := by linarith only [hξ_le_η, hξ₀]
    refine ⟨le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1
        (by linarith only [hξ_le_η1])) h_lo,
      le_trans h_hi (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1
        (by linarith only [hξ_le_η1]))⟩
  · refine ⟨by linarith only [hh_cap_lo, hξ_le_η, hξ₀],
      by linarith only [hH_O1_ub, hd_O_ub, hh_cap_lo, hξ_le_η, hξ₀],
      by linarith only [h_sat_π0_xi, hξ_le_η, hξ₀],
      ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ω hω_pos
      have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith only [hε_lt_half]
      have hexp : d_O + 2 * ξ ≤ 3 * s - h_cap - β + η₀ := by
        linarith only [hd_O_ub, hξ_le_η, hξ₀]
      exact le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 hexp) (hπ₀_O1_lb ω hω_pos)
    · intro Q K_Q hQ_nn hQ_sum hK_Q_ge1 hQ_supp hQ_le
      have ht := h_tilt_xi Q K_Q hQ_nn hQ_sum hK_Q_ge1 hQ_supp hQ_le
      linarith only [ht, hξ_le_η, hξ₀]
    · intro ω hω_pos
      have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith only [hε_lt_half]
      exact le_trans (h_vel_rat ω hω_pos)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 h_exp_vel) hK₀_pos.le)

subgoal_signatures.name: finite_law_compression_and_entropy_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (T_seq : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T) (c_seq : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_seq ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∃ (M_ω : ℕ) (f : Fin M_ω → Fin N_ω),
        (∀ ω : Fin M_ω, 0 < π (f ω) ∧ c_seq (f ω) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π (f ω) = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T,
          (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_seq (f ω) = tid then π (f ω) else 0) =
            (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_seq ω = tid then π ω else 0)) ∧
        (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
          (∀ ω : Fin M_ω,
            condSurprise ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) ω =
              condSurprise ε π X Y (f ω)) ∧
          finCondEntropy ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) =
            finCondEntropy ε π X Y ∧
          finMutualInfo ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) =
            finMutualInfo ε π X Y) ∧
        (∀ (P : Fin N_ω → Prop) [DecidablePred P],
          (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if P (f ω) then π (f ω) else 0) =
            (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω then π ω else 0))) ∧
    (∀ {M_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
       (W : Fin M_ω → α) (X : Fin M_ω → β) (Y : Fin M_ω → γ_t),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π ω = 1) →
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π W X ∧
      0 ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W X ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π W X + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) X + finCondEntropy ε π X Y ∧
      finMutualInfo ε π W X ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω))) ∧
    (∀ {M_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
       (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β) (Z : Fin M_ω → γ_t),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ → X ω₁ = X ω₂ → (Y ω₁ = Y ω₂ ↔ Z ω₁ = Z ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y = finCondEntropy ε π X Z) ∧
    (∀ {M_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (ε N_max : ℝ) (π : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
       (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ N_max →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < π ω₀ → ∃ S_Y : Finset β, (S_Y.card : ℝ) ≤ N_max ∧
        ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → X ω = X ω₀ → Y ω ∈ S_Y) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y ≤ Real.log N_max / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ {M_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε d_min K : ℝ) (π Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
       (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ K →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, Q ω ≤ K * π ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → d_min ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω) →
      d_min - Real.log K / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ finCondEntropy ε Q X Y) ∧
    (∀ {M_ω N_Z : ℕ} {α_T α_O α_K : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
       (T : Fin M_ω → α_T) (O : Fin M_ω → α_O) (K_t : Fin M_ω → α_K)
       (Z : Fin M_ω → Fin N_Z),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ N_Z →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π ω = 1) →
      let p_Z : Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z ω = z then π ω else 0
      let π_z : Fin N_Z → Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun z ω =>
        if Z ω = z then π ω / p_Z z else 0
      finMutualInfo ε π T Z +
        (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
          if 0 < p_Z z then
            p_Z z * (finMutualInfo ε (π_z z) T O - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_z z) T K_t)
          else 0) ≤
        (finMutualInfo ε π T O - 2 * finCondEntropy ε π T K_t) +
          3 * Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))

subgoal_signatures.name: greedy_root_cap_partition_and_tilt_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ B_iso ε ξ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hB_iso : 1 ≤ B_iso)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) (hξ₀ : 0 < ξ) (hξ₁ : ξ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (M_ω M_T : ℕ) (π_amb : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin M_ω → Fin M_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin M_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_amb ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π_amb ω = 1)
    (hVA : ∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_iso ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_iso) :
    (∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ {N_Z : ℕ} (P : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (Z : Fin M_ω → Fin N_Z),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ P ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, P ω = 1) →
      let p_Z : Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z ω = z then P ω else 0
      let P_z : Fin N_Z → Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun z ω => if Z ω = z then P ω / p_Z z else 0
      (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
        if 0 < p_Z z then
          p_Z z * classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T (P_z z) T_idx V_part A_part
        else 0) ≤
        classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T P T_idx V_part A_part +
          finMutualInfo ε P T_idx Z) ∧
    (let J_cap : ℕ := ⌊2 / ξ⌋₊ + 2
     ∃ Z_cap : Fin M_T → Fin (J_cap + 1),
       (∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
         if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = Fin.last J_cap then π_amb ω else 0) ≤
         (((2 * ⌈B_iso⌉₊ + 3) ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ ξ ∧
       ∀ j : Fin J_cap,
         let h_cap : ℝ := -ξ + (j.val : ℝ) * ξ
         let p₁ : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc then π_amb ω else 0
         (-ξ ≤ h_cap ∧ h_cap ≤ 2) ∧
         (0 < p₁ →
           let μ₁ : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
             if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc then π_amb ω / p₁ else 0
           h_cap ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T μ₁ T_idx V_part A_part) ∧
         (∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (M_tilt : ℝ),
           (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) → 1 ≤ M_tilt →
           (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc) →
           (∀ ω, Q ω ≤ M_tilt * π_amb ω) →
           classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part ≤
             h_cap + 3 * ξ + Real.log (81 * M_tilt) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)))

subgoal_signatures.name: terminal_and_velocity_aperture_universality
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ B_iso d_vel δ_cl : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hB_iso : 1 ≤ B_iso) (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (hd₀ : 0 < d_vel) (hd₁ : d_vel < 1) (hδ_cl : 0 < δ_cl) :
    ∃ (C_alph ε₀ : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_alph ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ {M_ω M_T : ℕ} (ε : ℝ)
        (T_idx : Fin M_ω → Fin M_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin M_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_val : Fin M_ω → ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_iso ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_iso) →
        (∀ ω, c_val ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        let O₁ := isoAnchoredObs ε 1 T_idx V_part A_part c_val
        let k₁ := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε 1 (c_val ω)
        let k_tp := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε (1 - d_vel) (c_val ω)
        let V_d := isoVelObs ε d_vel T_idx V_part
        (∃ S_k1 : Finset ℤ, (S_k1.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε⁻¹ ∧ ∀ ω, k₁ ω ∈ S_k1) ∧
        (∃ S_O1 : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
          (S_O1.card : ℝ) ≤ C_alph * ε ^ (-(3 : ℝ)) ∧ ∀ ω, O₁ ω ∈ S_O1) ∧
        (∃ S_OV : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),

              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB_cl_ge1 (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _)
      exact ⟨hcmid_mem, hkG_eq, hv_tan, hv_norm, hx_tan, hx_norm⟩
    have h_score_le := h_est ε a 1 Δ_time hε₀ hε_lt le_rfl ha_le1 le_rfl hΔ_lb hΔ_ub
      M_ω M_T M_ω Q T_idx k_a G_idx V_part A_part (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => l)
      e_G V_G X_G k_G hQ_nn hQ_sum hVA_cl h_shape h_adm
    have h_id := part3_info_identity ε γ 0 l Q T_idx k_a B_obs G_idx hQ_nn hQ_sum hG_iff
    rw [h_id, mul_zero, zero_add] at h_score_le
    have h_rate_le : (b₀ + δ_cl / 2) * a ≤ (classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_cl) * a :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) ha_pos.le
    linarith
