proof.tactics:
by
  intro M r ν A F μ_comp hν_nn hν_sum hA_nn hμ_nn hμ_sum_raw hF_joint_raw
  have hμ_sum : ∀ l j, (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.image (F l j), μ_comp l j v) ≤ 1 := by
    intro l j
    have h_im_eq : Finset.univ.image (F l j) =
        @Finset.image _ _ (fun a b => Classical.propDecidable (a = b))
          (F l j) Finset.univ := by
      ext v
      rw [@Finset.mem_image, @Finset.mem_image]
    rw [h_im_eq]
    exact hμ_sum_raw l j
  have hF_joint : ∀ (l : Fin r) (v₀ v₁ v₂ : ℤ × ℤ),
      (∑ ω : Fin M, if F l 0 ω = v₀ ∧ F l 1 ω = v₁ ∧ F l 2 ω = v₂ then ν ω else 0) ≤
        A l * μ_comp l 0 v₀ * μ_comp l 1 v₁ * μ_comp l 2 v₂ := by
    intro l v₀ v₁ v₂
    refine le_trans ?_ (hF_joint_raw l v₀ v₁ v₂)
    exact le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> rfl)
  let D_r : ℝ := 6 * (r : ℝ) + 2
  have hDr_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ D_r := by
    dsimp [D_r]
    have hr_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg r
    linarith
  have hDr_pos : 0 < D_r := by linarith
  have hDr_ne : D_r ≠ 0 := hDr_pos.ne'
  let η : ℝ := 1 / D_r
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := one_div_pos.mpr hDr_pos
  haveI : DecidablePred (fun ω : Fin M => 0 < ν ω) := Classical.decPred _
  let S₀ : Finset (Fin M) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin M => 0 < ν ω)
  let I : Fin r → Fin 3 → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := fun l j => Finset.univ.image (F l j)
  let φ : Finset (Fin M) → Fin r → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun S l j =>
    (∑ v ∈ I l j, μ_comp l j v) - (∑ v ∈ S.image (F l j), μ_comp l j v)
  let Φ : Finset (Fin M) → ℝ := fun S =>
    η * ∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S l j
  have hS₀_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω = 1 := by
    dsimp [S₀]
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    have h_eq : ∑ ω : Fin M, (if 0 < ν ω then ν ω else 0) = ∑ ω : Fin M, ν ω := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
      by_cases hpos : 0 < ν ω
      · rw [if_pos hpos]
      · rw [if_neg hpos]
        linarith [hν_nn ω]
    rw [h_eq, hν_sum]
  have hS₀_pot : 1 - ∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω ≤ Φ S₀ := by
    rw [hS₀_sum, sub_self]
    refine mul_nonneg hη_pos.le (Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => ?_)
    dsimp [φ, I]
    rw [sub_nonneg]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      (Finset.image_subset_image (Finset.subset_univ S₀))
      (fun v _ _ => hμ_nn l j v)
  let Stop : Finset (Fin M) → Prop := fun S =>
    ∀ (l : Fin r) (j : Fin 3) (ω : Fin M), ω ∈ S →
      η * μ_comp l j (F l j ω) ≤ ∑ ω' ∈ S, if F l j ω' = F l j ω then ν ω' else 0
  have h_ind : ∀ S : Finset (Fin M),
      S ⊆ S₀ ∧ 1 - ∑ ω ∈ S, ν ω ≤ Φ S →
      ∃ S_keep : Finset (Fin M),
        S_keep ⊆ S₀ ∧ 1 - ∑ ω ∈ S_keep, ν ω ≤ Φ S_keep ∧ Stop S_keep := by
    intro S
    refine Finset.strongInductionOn S fun S ih => ?_
    rintro ⟨hS_sub, hS_pot⟩
    by_cases h_stop : Stop S
    · exact ⟨S, hS_sub, hS_pot, h_stop⟩
    · dsimp [Stop] at h_stop
      push_neg at h_stop
      rcases h_stop with ⟨l₀, j₀, ω₀, hω₀, h_viol⟩
      let v₀ : ℤ × ℤ := F l₀ j₀ ω₀
      change (∑ ω' ∈ S, if F l₀ j₀ ω' = v₀ then ν ω' else 0) < η * μ_comp l₀ j₀ v₀ at h_viol
      let S' : Finset (Fin M) := S.filter (fun ω => ¬ (F l₀ j₀ ω = v₀))
      have hS'_sub_S : S' ⊆ S := Finset.filter_subset _ S
      have hS'_sub_S₀ : S' ⊆ S₀ := hS'_sub_S.trans hS_sub
      have hS'_ssub : S' ⊂ S := by
        rw [Finset.ssubset_def]
        refine ⟨hS'_sub_S, fun h_sup => ?_⟩
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (h_sup hω₀)).2 rfl
      have h_part : (∑ ω' ∈ S, if F l₀ j₀ ω' = v₀ then ν ω' else 0) + ∑ ω ∈ S', ν ω =
          ∑ ω ∈ S, ν ω := by
        have h_add := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S (fun ω => F l₀ j₀ ω = v₀) ν
        rw [Finset.sum_filter] at h_add
        exact h_add
      have h_mass_drop : ∑ ω ∈ S, ν ω - ∑ ω ∈ S', ν ω < η * μ_comp l₀ j₀ v₀ := by
        linarith [h_part, h_viol]
      have hφ_diff_eq : ∀ (l : Fin r) (j : Fin 3),
          φ S' l j - φ S l j =
            (∑ v ∈ S.image (F l j), μ_comp l j v) - (∑ v ∈ S'.image (F l j), μ_comp l j v) := by
        intro l j
        dsimp [φ]
        ring
      have hφ_diff_nn : ∀ (l : Fin r) (j : Fin 3), 0 ≤ φ S' l j - φ S l j := by
        intro l j
        rw [hφ_diff_eq, sub_nonneg]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (Finset.image_subset_image hS'_sub_S)
          (fun v _ _ => hμ_nn l j v)
      have hv₀_not_mem : v₀ ∉ S'.image (F l₀ j₀) := by
        intro hv
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hv with ⟨ω, hω, hFω⟩
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2 hFω
      have hv₀_ins_sub : insert v₀ (S'.image (F l₀ j₀)) ⊆ S.image (F l₀ j₀) :=
        Finset.insert_subset_iff.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem (F l₀ j₀) hω₀, Finset.image_subset_image hS'_sub_S⟩
      have hφ_gain_0 : μ_comp l₀ j₀ v₀ ≤ φ S' l₀ j₀ - φ S l₀ j₀ := by
        have h_ins := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hv₀_ins_sub
          (fun v _ _ => hμ_nn l₀ j₀ v)
        rw [Finset.sum_insert hv₀_not_mem] at h_ins
        rw [hφ_diff_eq]
        linarith
      have h_sum_gain : μ_comp l₀ j₀ v₀ ≤
          (∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S' l j) - (∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S l j) := by
        have h1 : μ_comp l₀ j₀ v₀ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, (φ S' l₀ j - φ S l₀ j) :=
          le_trans hφ_gain_0
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hφ_diff_nn l₀ j) (Finset.mem_univ j₀))
        have h2 : ∑ j : Fin 3, (φ S' l₀ j - φ S l₀ j) ≤
            ∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, (φ S' l j - φ S l j) :=
          Finset.single_le_sum
            (fun l _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hφ_diff_nn l j)
            (Finset.mem_univ l₀)
        have h_eq : (∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, (φ S' l j - φ S l j)) =
            (∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S' l j) - (∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S l j) := by
          simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        linarith
      have hΦ_gain : η * μ_comp l₀ j₀ v₀ ≤ Φ S' - Φ S := by
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_gain hη_pos.le
        have h_eq : η * ((∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S' l j) -
            (∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S l j)) = Φ S' - Φ S := by
          dsimp [Φ]
          ring
        linarith
      have hS'_pot : 1 - ∑ ω ∈ S', ν ω ≤ Φ S' := by
        linarith [hS_pot, h_mass_drop, hΦ_gain]
      exact ih S' hS'_ssub ⟨hS'_sub_S₀, hS'_pot⟩
  obtain ⟨S_keep, hS_sub, hS_pot, hS_floor⟩ := h_ind S₀ ⟨Finset.Subset.rfl, hS₀_pot⟩
  refine ⟨S_keep, ?_⟩
  let M_ret : ℝ := ∑ ω ∈ S_keep, ν ω
  have hM_ret_le_one : M_ret ≤ 1 := by
    calc M_ret = ∑ ω ∈ S_keep, ν ω := rfl
      _ ≤ ∑ ω : Fin M, ν ω := Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg hν_nn
      _ = 1 := hν_sum
  have hΦ_le_half : Φ S_keep ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hφ_le_one : ∀ (l : Fin r) (j : Fin 3), φ S_keep l j ≤ 1 := by
      intro l j
      dsimp [φ, I]
      have h_sub_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ v ∈ S_keep.image (F l j), μ_comp l j v :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun v _ => hμ_nn l j v
      have h_im_le : ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.image (F l j), μ_comp l j v ≤ 1 := hμ_sum l j
      linarith
    have h_sum_le : (∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S_keep l j) ≤ 3 * (r : ℝ) := by
      calc (∑ l : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, φ S_keep l j)
          ≤ ∑ _l : Fin r, ∑ _j : Fin 3, (1 : ℝ) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hφ_le_one l j
        _ = 3 * (r : ℝ) := by
            simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
            ring
    have hΦ_le_frac : Φ S_keep ≤ (3 * (r : ℝ)) / D_r := by
      dsimp [Φ, η]
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_le hη_pos.le
      dsimp [η] at h_mul
      linarith [h_mul, one_div_mul_eq_div D_r (3 * (r : ℝ))]
    have h_frac_le : (3 * (r : ℝ)) / D_r ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hDr_pos]
      dsimp [D_r]
      linarith
    exact le_trans hΦ_le_frac h_frac_le
  have hM_ret_ge_half : 1 / 2 ≤ M_ret := by
    change 1 - M_ret ≤ Φ S_keep at hS_pot
    linarith [hS_pot, hΦ_le_half]
  have hM_ret_pos : 0 < M_ret := by linarith
  have hM_ret_ne : M_ret ≠ 0 := hM_ret_pos.ne'
  have hC2 : ∀ ω ∈ S_keep, 0 < ν ω := fun ω hω =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hS_sub hω)).2
  have hC3 : ∀ (l : Fin r) (j : Fin 3) (ω : Fin M), ω ∈ S_keep →
      (1 / (6 * (r : ℝ) + 2)) * μ_comp l j (F l j ω) ≤
        ∑ ω' ∈ S_keep,
          @ite ℝ (F l j ω' = F l j ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (ν ω') 0 := by
    intro l j ω hω
    refine le_trans (hS_floor l j ω hω) ?_
    exact le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> rfl)
  refine ⟨hM_ret_ge_half, hC2, hC3, ?_⟩
  intro l v₀ v₁ v₂
  let ρ : Fin M → ℝ := fun ω => if ω ∈ S_keep then ν ω / M_ret else 0
  have hρ_nn : ∀ ω : Fin M, 0 ≤ ρ ω := by
    intro ω
    dsimp [ρ]
    split_ifs
    · exact div_nonneg (hν_nn ω) hM_ret_pos.le
    · exact le_rfl
  let R : Fin 3 → ℤ × ℤ → ℝ := fun j v =>
    ∑ ω : Fin M, if F l j ω = v then ρ ω else 0
  have hR_nn : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (v : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ R j v := fun j v =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun ω _ => by split_ifs; exacts [hρ_nn ω, le_rfl]
  let L_joint : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin M,
    if F l 0 ω = v₀ ∧ F l 1 ω = v₁ ∧ F l 2 ω = v₂ then ρ ω else 0
  have h_marg_eq : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (v : ℤ × ℤ),
      M_ret * R j v = ∑ ω' ∈ S_keep, if F l j ω' = v then ν ω' else 0 := by
    intro j v
    dsimp [R]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc ∑ ω : Fin M, M_ret * (if F l j ω = v then ρ ω else 0)
        = ∑ ω : Fin M,
            if ω ∈ S_keep then (if F l j ω = v then ν ω else 0) else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
          dsimp [ρ]
          by_cases h1 : ω ∈ S_keep <;> by_cases h2 : F l j ω = v <;>
            simp [h1, h2, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hM_ret_ne]
      _ = ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ S_keep),
            (if F l j ω = v then ν ω else 0) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      _ = ∑ ω' ∈ S_keep, if F l j ω' = v then ν ω' else 0 := by
          rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
  have h_main : L_joint ≤ A l * D_r ^ 3 * R 0 v₀ * R 1 v₁ * R 2 v₂ := by
    by_cases h_inh : ∃ ω_star ∈ S_keep, F l 0 ω_star = v₀ ∧ F l 1 ω_star = v₁ ∧ F l 2 ω_star = v₂
    · rcases h_inh with ⟨ω_star, hω_star, h0, h1, h2⟩
      have h_factor : ∀ j : Fin 3,
          μ_comp l j (F l j ω_star) ≤ D_r * M_ret * R j (F l j ω_star) := by
        intro j
        have h_fl := hS_floor l j ω_star hω_star
        have h_fl' : η * μ_comp l j (F l j ω_star) ≤ M_ret * R j (F l j ω_star) := by
          rw [h_marg_eq j (F l j ω_star)]
          exact h_fl
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_fl' hDr_pos.le
        have h_lhs_eq : D_r * (η * μ_comp l j (F l j ω_star)) = μ_comp l j (F l j ω_star) := by
          dsimp [η]
          field_simp [hDr_ne]
        linarith
      have hμ0 : μ_comp l 0 v₀ ≤ D_r * M_ret * R 0 v₀ := by
        have h := h_factor 0; rwa [h0] at h
      have hμ1 : μ_comp l 1 v₁ ≤ D_r * M_ret * R 1 v₁ := by
        have h := h_factor 1; rwa [h1] at h
      have hμ2 : μ_comp l 2 v₂ ≤ D_r * M_ret * R 2 v₂ := by
        have h := h_factor 2; rwa [h2] at h
      have h_joint_le : M_ret * L_joint ≤
          A l * μ_comp l 0 v₀ * μ_comp l 1 v₁ * μ_comp l 2 v₂ := by
        dsimp [L_joint]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine le_trans ?_ (hF_joint l v₀ v₁ v₂)
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => ?_
        by_cases h_eq : F l 0 ω = v₀ ∧ F l 1 ω = v₁ ∧ F l 2 ω = v₂
        · rw [if_pos h_eq, if_pos h_eq]
          dsimp [ρ]
          by_cases h_mem : ω ∈ S_keep
          · rw [if_pos h_mem, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hM_ret_ne]
          · rw [if_neg h_mem, mul_zero]
            exact hν_nn ω
        · rw [if_neg h_eq, if_neg h_eq, mul_zero]
      have h_prod_bound :
          A l * μ_comp l 0 v₀ * μ_comp l 1 v₁ * μ_comp l 2 v₂ ≤
            A l * (D_r * M_ret * R 0 v₀) * (D_r * M_ret * R 1 v₁) * (D_r * M_ret * R 2 v₂) := by
        have hDR0_nn : 0 ≤ D_r * M_ret * R 0 v₀ :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hDr_pos.le hM_ret_pos.le) (hR_nn 0 v₀)
        have hDR1_nn : 0 ≤ D_r * M_ret * R 1 v₁ :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hDr_pos.le hM_ret_pos.le) (hR_nn 1 v₁)
        have hs0 : A l * μ_comp l 0 v₀ ≤ A l * (D_r * M_ret * R 0 v₀) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hμ0 (hA_nn l)
        have hs1 : A l * μ_comp l 0 v₀ * μ_comp l 1 v₁ ≤
            A l * (D_r * M_ret * R 0 v₀) * (D_r * M_ret * R 1 v₁) :=
          mul_le_mul hs0 hμ1 (hμ_nn l 1 v₁) (mul_nonneg (hA_nn l) hDR0_nn)
        exact mul_le_mul hs1 hμ2 (hμ_nn l 2 v₂)
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hA_nn l) hDR0_nn) hDR1_nn)
      have h_M_comb : M_ret * L_joint ≤
          M_ret * (M_ret ^ 2 * (A l * D_r ^ 3 * R 0 v₀ * R 1 v₁ * R 2 v₂)) := by
        calc M_ret * L_joint
            ≤ A l * (D_r * M_ret * R 0 v₀) * (D_r * M_ret * R 1 v₁) * (D_r * M_ret * R 2 v₂) :=
              le_trans h_joint_le h_prod_bound
          _ = M_ret * (M_ret ^ 2 * (A l * D_r ^ 3 * R 0 v₀ * R 1 v₁ * R 2 v₂)) := by ring
      have h_L_le : L_joint ≤ M_ret ^ 2 * (A l * D_r ^ 3 * R 0 v₀ * R 1 v₁ * R 2 v₂) :=
        le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_M_comb hM_ret_pos
      have hM_sq_le_one : M_ret ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        nlinarith [hM_ret_pos, hM_ret_le_one]
      have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ A l * D_r ^ 3 * R 0 v₀ * R 1 v₁ * R 2 v₂ :=
        mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hA_nn l) (pow_nonneg hDr_pos.le 3)) (hR_nn 0 v₀))
            (hR_nn 1 v₁))
          (hR_nn 2 v₂)
      exact le_trans h_L_le (mul_le_of_le_one_left h_rhs_nn hM_sq_le_one)
    · have h_L_zero : L_joint = 0 := by
        dsimp [L_joint]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ω _ => ?_
        by_cases h_mem : ω ∈ S_keep
        · have h_not_eq : ¬ (F l 0 ω = v₀ ∧ F l 1 ω = v₁ ∧ F l 2 ω = v₂) :=
            fun h_eq => h_inh ⟨ω, h_mem, h_eq⟩
          rw [if_neg h_not_eq]
        · dsimp [ρ]
          rw [if_neg h_mem, ite_self]
      rw [h_L_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hA_nn l) (pow_nonneg hDr_pos.le 3)) (hR_nn 0 v₀))
          (hR_nn 1 v₁))
        (hR_nn 2 v₂)
  have h_lhs_conv :
      (∑ ω : Fin M,
        @ite ℝ (F l 0 ω = v₀ ∧ F l 1 ω = v₁ ∧ F l 2 ω = v₂) (Classical.propDecidable _)
          (@ite ℝ (ω ∈ S_keep) (Classical.propDecidable _) (ν ω / M_ret) 0) 0) = L_joint := by
    dsimp [L_joint, ρ]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> rfl
  have h_r_conv : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (v : ℤ × ℤ),
      (∑ ω : Fin M,
        @ite ℝ (F l j ω = v) (Classical.propDecidable _)
          (@ite ℝ (ω ∈ S_keep) (Classical.propDecidable _) (ν ω / M_ret) 0) 0) = R j v := by
    intro j v
    dsimp [R, ρ]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> rfl
  change (∑ ω : Fin M,
      @ite ℝ (F l 0 ω = v₀ ∧ F l 1 ω = v₁ ∧ F l 2 ω = v₂) (Classical.propDecidable _)
        (@ite ℝ (ω ∈ S_keep) (Classical.propDecidable _) (ν ω / M_ret) 0) 0) ≤
    A l * (6 * (r : ℝ) + 2) ^ 3 *
      (∑ ω : Fin M,
        @ite ℝ (F l 0 ω = v₀) (Classical.propDecidable _)
          (@ite ℝ (ω ∈ S_keep) (Classical.propDecidable _) (ν ω / M_ret) 0) 0) *
      (∑ ω : Fin M,
        @ite ℝ (F l 1 ω = v₁) (Classical.propDecidable _)
          (@ite ℝ (ω ∈ S_keep) (Classical.propDecidable _) (ν ω / M_ret) 0) 0) *
      (∑ ω : Fin M,
        @ite ℝ (F l 2 ω = v₂) (Classical.propDecidable _)
          (@ite ℝ (ω ∈ S_keep) (Classical.propDecidable _) (ν ω / M_ret) 0) 0)
  rw [h_lhs_conv, h_r_conv 0 v₀, h_r_conv 1 v₁, h_r_conv 2 v₂]
  exact h_main

informal_problem.statement:
(s x z α : ℝ)
    (hs₀ : 0 < s) (hs₁ : s ≤ 1)
    (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x ≤ 1)
    (hz₀ : 0 ≤ z) (hz₁ : z < 1)
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (h_core : FiniteMarginalCoreBound)

    have h_ite_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} (S : Finset ι) (P Q : ι → Prop)

        dsimp [r_X]
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hα₀₁_pos]
        calc r * α₀₁ ≤ r * 12 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hα₀₁_le12 hr_pos.le
          _ = 12 * r := mul_comm _ _
      have hrX_ge_t : ρ_tilde ≤ r_X := le_trans hr₀ hr_le_rX
      have hrX_pow_bound : r_X ^ x ≤ 12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) * r ^ x := by
        have hrX_split : r_X = (12 * α₀₁⁻¹) * r := by dsimp [r_X]; ring
        rw [hrX_split, Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hr_pos.le,
          Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (inv_nonneg.mpr hα₀₁_pos.le)]
        have h12_pow : (12 : ℝ) ^ x ≤ 12 := by
          calc (12 : ℝ) ^ x ≤ (12 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
                Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hx₁
            _ = 12 := Real.rpow_one 12
        have hα_inv_le : α₀₁⁻¹ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) := by
          calc α₀₁⁻¹ ≤ (ρ_tilde ^ η_sl)⁻¹ :=
                inv_anti₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_t_pos _) hα₀₁_lb
            _ = ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) := (Real.rpow_neg hρ_t_pos.le η_sl).symm
        have hα_pow : (α₀₁⁻¹) ^ x ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) := by
          have hexp_le : -η_sl ≤ -η_sl * x := by
            have hm := mul_le_of_le_one_right hη_sl_pos.le hx₁
            linarith
          calc (α₀₁⁻¹) ^ x
              ≤ (ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl)) ^ x :=
                Real.rpow_le_rpow (inv_nonneg.mpr hα₀₁_pos.le) hα_inv_le hx₀.le
            _ = ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl * x) := (Real.rpow_mul hρ_t_pos.le _ _).symm
            _ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) :=
                Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_t_pos hρ_t_le1 hexp_le
        have hprod_le : (12 : ℝ) ^ x * (α₀₁⁻¹) ^ x ≤ 12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) :=
          mul_le_mul h12_pow hα_pow (Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hα₀₁_pos.le) _) (by norm_num)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hr_pos.le _)

      have h_u0_fiber : ∀ u₀ : ℤ × ℤ,
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if |L_hat i - z_L| < r ∧ bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) ≤
            12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) *
              (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) * r ^ x := by
        intro u₀
        let z_X : ℝ := (z_L - g_U₀ u₀) / α₀₁
        let x_of_k : ℤ → ℝ := fun k_X => ((k_X : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
        have h_imp : ∀ i : Fin N_P, |L_hat i - z_L| < r ∧ bU₀ i = u₀ →
            bU₀ i = u₀ ∧ |x_of_k (bX i) - z_X| < r_X := by
          intro i ⟨hLr, hu⟩
          refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
          have hdr := (h_pt_geom i).1
          rw [hu] at hdr
          have h_lin : α₀₁ * x_of_k (bX i) - (z_L - g_U₀ u₀) =
              (L_hat i - z_L) - (L_hat i - (g_U₀ u₀ + α₀₁ * X_hat i)) := by
            dsimp [x_of_k, X_hat]; ring
          have h_lt12 : |α₀₁ * x_of_k (bX i) - (z_L - g_U₀ u₀)| < 12 * r := by
            rw [h_lin]
            linarith [abs_sub (L_hat i - z_L) (L_hat i - (g_U₀ u₀ + α₀₁ * X_hat i)),
              hLr, hdr, hr₀, hr_pos]
          have h_div_id : x_of_k (bX i) - z_X = (α₀₁ * x_of_k (bX i) - (z_L - g_U₀ u₀)) / α₀₁ := by
            dsimp [z_X]; field_simp [hα₀₁_pos.ne']
          rw [h_div_id, abs_div, abs_of_pos hα₀₁_pos]
          exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right h_lt12 hα₀₁_pos
        have h_step1 : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if |L_hat i - z_L| < r ∧ bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) ≤
            ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ ∧ |x_of_k (bX i) - z_X| < r_X then ν_P i else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
          by_cases h : |L_hat i - z_L| < r ∧ bU₀ i = u₀
          · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (h_imp i h)]
          · rw [if_neg h]; split_ifs; exact hν_P_nn i; exact le_rfl
        by_cases hrX1 : r_X ≤ 1
        · have h_part := h_sum_partition_pred Finset.univ S_X bX
            (fun i => bU₀ i = u₀) (fun k_X => |x_of_k k_X - z_X| < r_X) ν_P
            (fun i _ => hbX_mem i)
          have h_coll : (∑ k_X ∈ S_X, if |x_of_k k_X - z_X| < r_X then
              (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X then ν_P i else 0) else 0) =
              ∑ i : Fin N_P, if |X_hat i - z_X| < r_X then ν_P i else 0 := by
            have hp := h_sum_partition_pred Finset.univ S_X bX (fun _ => True)
              (fun k_X => |x_of_k k_X - z_X| < r_X) ν_P (fun i _ => hbX_mem i)
            simp only [true_and] at hp
            exact hp.symm
          calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if |L_hat i - z_L| < r ∧ bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0)
              ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ ∧ |x_of_k (bX i) - z_X| < r_X then ν_P i else 0 :=
                h_step1
            _ = ∑ k_X ∈ S_X, if |x_of_k k_X - z_X| < r_X then
                  (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ ∧ bX i = k_X then ν_P i else 0) else 0 := h_part
            _ ≤ ∑ k_X ∈ S_X, if |x_of_k k_X - z_X| < r_X then
                  ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) *
                    (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X then ν_P i else 0) *
                    (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) else 0 := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k_X _ => ?_)
                split_ifs
                · refine le_trans ?_ (le_trans (h_prod0 k_X u₀) ?_)
                  · exact le_of_eq (h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ ν_P
                      (fun _ _ => ⟨fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩, fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩))
                  · exact le_of_eq (congrArg₂ (· * ·)
                      (congrArg (ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) * ·)
                        (h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ ν_P (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)))
                      (h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ ν_P (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)))
                · exact le_rfl
            _ = ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) *
                  (∑ k_X ∈ S_X, if |x_of_k k_X - z_X| < r_X then
                    (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X then ν_P i else 0) else 0) := by
                rw [Finset.mul_sum]
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro k_X _
                split_ifs <;> ring
            _ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) *
                  (ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) * (12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) * r ^ x)) := by
                rw [h_coll]
                refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_
                  (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ_t_pos.le _)
                    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hν_P_nn i; exact le_rfl)))
                have hb := hν_X_ball z_X r_X hrX_ge_t hrX1
                refine le_trans ?_
                  (le_trans hb (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrX_pow_bound (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ_t_pos.le _)))
                exact le_of_eq (h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ ν_P (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl))
            _ = 12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) *
                  (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) * r ^ x := by
                have hexp : -3 * η_sl = -η_sl + (-η_sl + -η_sl) := by ring
                rw [hexp, Real.rpow_add hρ_t_pos, Real.rpow_add hρ_t_pos]
                ring
        · push_neg at hrX1
          have h1_le_rX : 1 ≤ r_X ^ x := by
            calc (1 : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) ^ x := (Real.one_rpow x).symm
              _ ≤ r_X ^ x := Real.rpow_le_rpow zero_le_one hrX1.le hx₀.le
          have h1_le_2η : 1 ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-2 * η_sl) := by
            calc (1 : ℝ) = ρ_tilde ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ρ_tilde).symm
              _ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-2 * η_sl) :=
                  Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_t_pos hρ_t_le1 (by linarith)
          have h_prod_ge1 : 1 ≤ 12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) * r ^ x := by
            calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := (mul_one 1).symm
              _ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-2 * η_sl) * (12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η_sl) * r ^ x) :=
                  mul_le_mul h1_le_2η (le_trans h1_le_rX hrX_pow_bound) zero_le_one
                    (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ_t_pos.le _)
              _ = 12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) * r ^ x := by
                  have hexp : -3 * η_sl = -2 * η_sl + (-η_sl) := by ring
                  rw [hexp, Real.rpow_add hρ_t_pos]
                  ring
          have h_u0_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0 :=
            Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hν_P_nn i; exact le_rfl)
          calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if |L_hat i - z_L| < r ∧ bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0)
              ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0 := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
                by_cases hu : bU₀ i = u₀
                · rw [if_pos hu]; split_ifs; exact le_rfl; exact hν_P_nn i
                · rw [if_neg hu, if_neg (fun h => hu h.2)]
            _ = 1 * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) := (one_mul _).symm
            _ ≤ (12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) * r ^ x) *
                  (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod_ge1 h_u0_nn
            _ = 12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) *
                  (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) * r ^ x := by ring

      have h_lhs_swap :
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if N_bin i = n_bin ∧ |L_hat i - z_L| < r then ν_P i else 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, if |L_hat i - z_L| < r ∧ f_N (bU₀ i) = n_bin then ν_P i else 0 :=
        h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ ν_P
          (fun _ _ => ⟨fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩, fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩)
      have h_coll_N :
          (∑ u₀ ∈ S_U0, if f_N u₀ = n_bin then
              (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) else 0) =
            ∑ i : Fin N_P, if N_bin i = n_bin then ν_P i else 0 := by
        have hp := h_sum_partition_pred Finset.univ S_U0 bU₀ (fun _ => True)
          (fun u₀ => f_N u₀ = n_bin) ν_P (fun i _ => hbU0_mem i)
        simp only [true_and] at hp
        exact hp.symm
      rw [h_lhs_swap, h_sum_partition_pred Finset.univ S_U0 bU₀
        (fun i => |L_hat i - z_L| < r) (fun u₀ => f_N u₀ = n_bin) ν_P (fun i _ => hbU0_mem i)]
      calc (∑ u₀ ∈ S_U0, if f_N u₀ = n_bin then
              (∑ i : Fin N_P, if |L_hat i - z_L| < r ∧ bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) else 0)
          ≤ ∑ u₀ ∈ S_U0, if f_N u₀ = n_bin then
              12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) *
                (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) * r ^ x else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u₀ _ => ?_)
            split_ifs
            · exact h_u0_fiber u₀
            · exact le_rfl
        _ = 12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) *
              (∑ u₀ ∈ S_U0, if f_N u₀ = n_bin then
                (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = u₀ then ν_P i else 0) else 0) * r ^ x := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u₀ _ => by split_ifs <;> ring)
        _ = 12 * ρ_tilde ^ (-3 * η_sl) *
              (∑ i : Fin N_P, if N_bin i = n_bin then ν_P i else 0) * r ^ x := by
            rw [h_coll_N]

    let p_N : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if N_bin i = n then ν_P i else 0
    let p_X : ℤ → ℝ := fun k_X => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X then ν_P i else 0
    let p_NX : ℤ → ℤ → ℝ := fun n k_X =>
      ∑ i : Fin N_P, if N_bin i = n ∧ bX i = k_X then ν_P i else 0
    have hp_N_nn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ p_N n :=
      fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hν_P_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    have hp_X_nn : ∀ k_X, 0 ≤ p_X k_X :=
      fun k_X => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hν_P_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    have hp_N_sum : ∑ n ∈ S_N, p_N n = 1 := by
      have hp := h_sum_partition Finset.univ S_N N_bin (fun _ => True) ν_P (fun i _ => hN_mem i)
      simp only [true_and, ↓reduceIte] at hp
      linarith [hp, hν_P_sum]
    have hp_X_sum : ∑ k_X ∈ S_X, p_X k_X = 1 := by
      have hp := h_sum_partition Finset.univ S_X bX (fun _ => True) ν_P (fun i _ => hbX_mem i)
      simp only [true_and, ↓reduceIte] at hp
      linarith [hp, hν_P_sum]
    have hp_NX_sum : ∑ n ∈ S_N, ∑ k_X ∈ S_X, p_NX n k_X = 1 := by
      calc ∑ n ∈ S_N, ∑ k_X ∈ S_X, p_NX n k_X
          = ∑ n ∈ S_N, p_N n := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
            exact (h_sum_partition Finset.univ S_X bX (fun i => N_bin i = n) ν_P
              (fun i _ => hbX_mem i)).symm
        _ = 1 := hp_N_sum

    have h_exists_slice : ∃ n_star ∈ S_N, ∃ kX_star ∈ S_X,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * p_N n_star * p_X kX_star < p_NX n_star kX_star := by
      by_contra h_none
      push_neg at h_none
      have h_le : ∑ n ∈ S_N, ∑ k_X ∈ S_X, p_NX n k_X ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        calc ∑ n ∈ S_N, ∑ k_X ∈ S_X, p_NX n k_X
            ≤ ∑ n ∈ S_N, ∑ k_X ∈ S_X, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * p_N n * p_X k_X :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n hn => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k_X hk => h_none n hn k_X hk))
          _ = ∑ n ∈ S_N, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * p_N n) * (∑ k_X ∈ S_X, p_X k_X) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm)
          _ = (∑ n ∈ S_N, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * p_N n) * (∑ k_X ∈ S_X, p_X k_X) :=
              (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ n ∈ S_N, p_N n) * (∑ k_X ∈ S_X, p_X k_X) := by
              rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          _ = 1 / 2 := by rw [hp_N_sum, hp_X_sum, mul_one, mul_one]
      linarith [hp_NX_sum, h_le]

    obtain ⟨n_star, _, kX_star, _, h_sl_gt⟩ := h_exists_slice
    let p_sl : ℝ := p_NX n_star kX_star
    have hp_sl_pos : 0 < p_sl :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (hp_N_nn n_star)) (hp_X_nn kX_star))
        h_sl_gt

    let μ_sl : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i =>
      if N_bin i = n_star ∧ bX i = kX_star then ν_P i / p_sl else 0
    let x_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 ![L_hat i, Z₁_hat i]
    let G_sl : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop :=
      fun i b₂ => 0 < ν_star i b₂ ∧ N_bin i = n_star ∧ bX i = kX_star

    have hμ_sl_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ_sl i := by
      intro i; dsimp [μ_sl]
      split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hν_P_nn i) hp_sl_pos.le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hμ_sl_sum : ∑ i : Fin N_P, μ_sl i = 1 := by
      dsimp [μ_sl]
      have hp : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if N_bin i = n_star ∧ bX i = kX_star then ν_P i / p_sl else 0) =
          p_sl / p_sl := by
        dsimp [p_sl, p_NX]
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> simp)
      rw [hp]
      exact div_self hp_sl_pos.ne'
    have hx_P_bd : ∀ i, ‖x_P i‖ ≤ 200 := fun i => (h_pt_geom i).2

    have hμ_sl_ball : ∀ (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ_tilde ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z₀‖ < r then μ_sl i else 0) ≤
          ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) * r ^ (x + z) := by
      intro z₀ r hr₀ hr₁
      have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_t_pos hr₀
      let S_L : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image L_bin
      let S_Z1 : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image bZ₁
      have hL_mem : ∀ i, L_bin i ∈ S_L := fun i => Finset.mem_image_of_mem L_bin (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have hZ1_mem : ∀ i, bZ₁ i ∈ S_Z1 := fun i => Finset.mem_image_of_mem bZ₁ (Finset.mem_univ i)
      let l_of_k : ℤ → ℝ := fun l => ((l : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ_tilde
      let z_of_k : ℤ → ℝ := fun k_Z => ((k_Z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
      have h_norm_imp : ∀ i : Fin N_P, ‖x_P i - z₀‖ < r →
          |l_of_k (L_bin i) - z₀ 0| < r ∧ |z_of_k (bZ₁ i) - z₀ 1| < r := by
        intro i hlt
        have hx0 : x_P i 0 = l_of_k (L_bin i) := rfl
        have hx1 : x_P i 1 = z_of_k (bZ₁ i) := rfl
        have hsq_eq : ‖x_P i - z₀‖ ^ 2 = ∑ c : Fin 2, ‖(x_P i - z₀) c‖ ^ 2 :=
          PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ => ℝ) (x_P i - z₀)
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hsq_eq
        simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, hx0, hx1, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at hsq_eq
        have hsq_lt : ‖x_P i - z₀‖ ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
          (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mpr hlt
        have h0_sq : |l_of_k (L_bin i) - z₀ 0| ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
          rw [sq_abs]; linarith [sq_nonneg (z_of_k (bZ₁ i) - z₀ 1), hsq_eq, hsq_lt]
        have h1_sq : |z_of_k (bZ₁ i) - z₀ 1| ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
          rw [sq_abs]; linarith [sq_nonneg (l_of_k (L_bin i) - z₀ 0), hsq_eq, hsq_lt]
        exact ⟨(sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mp h0_sq,
               (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mp h1_sq⟩
      have h_num_step1 :
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z₀‖ < r then μ_sl i else 0) ≤
          (∑ i : Fin N_P,
            if (N_bin i = n_star ∧ bX i = kX_star) ∧
               (|l_of_k (L_bin i) - z₀ 0| < r ∧ |z_of_k (bZ₁ i) - z₀ 1| < r)
            then ν_P i else 0) / p_sl := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
        dsimp [μ_sl]
        by_cases h1 : ‖x_P i - z₀‖ < r
        · rw [if_pos h1]
          by_cases h2 : N_bin i = n_star ∧ bX i = kX_star
          · rw [if_pos h2, if_pos ⟨h2, h_norm_imp i h1⟩]
          · rw [if_neg h2, if_neg (fun h => h2 h.1), zero_div]
        · rw [if_neg h1]
          split_ifs
          · exact div_nonneg (hν_P_nn i) hp_sl_pos.le
          · simp

      let g_LZ : Fin N_P → ℤ × ℤ := fun i => (L_bin i, bZ₁ i)
      let Q_LZ : ℤ × ℤ → Prop := fun lk => |l_of_k lk.1 - z₀ 0| < r ∧ |z_of_k lk.2 - z₀ 1| < r

      · exact le_rfl
    have hP3_01_nn : ∀ b₀ b₁, 0 ≤ P3_01 b₀ b₁ :=
      fun b₀ b₁ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hP3_01_i_nn i b₀ b₁)
    have hP3_sum2 : ∀ i b₀ b₁, (∑ b₂, P3 i b₀ b₁ b₂) = P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁
      dsimp [P3, P3_01_i]
      split_ifs with hμ
      · have h_pull : (∑ b₂, π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁ * π_tilde i b₂ / (μ_t i ^ 2)) =
            (π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁ / (μ_t i ^ 2)) * (∑ b₂, π_tilde i b₂) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₂ _ => by ring)
        rw [h_pull, show (∑ b₂, π_tilde i b₂) = μ_t i from rfl]
        field_simp [hμ.ne']
      · simp
    have hP3_01_i_sum : ∀ i, (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P3_01_i i b₀ b₁) = μ_t i := by
      intro i
      dsimp [P3_01_i]
      split_ifs with hμ
      · have h_pull : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁ / μ_t i) =
            ((∑ b₀, π_tilde i b₀) * (∑ b₁, π_tilde i b₁)) / μ_t i := by
          calc (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁ / μ_t i)
              = ∑ b₀, ((∑ b₁, π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁) / μ_t i) :=
                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => (Finset.sum_div _ _ _).symm)
            _ = (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁) / μ_t i :=
                (Finset.sum_div _ _ _).symm
            _ = ((∑ b₀, π_tilde i b₀) * (∑ b₁, π_tilde i b₁)) / μ_t i := by
                rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
        rw [h_pull, show (∑ b₀, π_tilde i b₀) = μ_t i from rfl]
        field_simp [hμ.ne']
      · have h0 : μ_t i = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hμ) (hμ_t_nn i)
        simp [h0]
    have hP3_01_sum : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P3_01 b₀ b₁) = 1 := by
      dsimp [P3_01]
      calc (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ∑ i, P3_01_i i b₀ b₁)
          = ∑ b₀, ∑ i, ∑ b₁, P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
        _ = ∑ i, ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ := Finset.sum_comm
        _ = ∑ i, μ_t i := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hP3_01_i_sum i)
        _ = 1 := hμ_t_sum
    have hP3_01_symm : ∀ b₀ b₁, P3_01 b₀ b₁ = P3_01 b₁ b₀ := by
      intro b₀ b₁
      dsimp [P3_01, P3_01_i]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> ring
    have h_ratio_dom : ∀ i b, 0 < μ_t i → π_tilde i b / μ_t i ≤ K * lam_t b := by
      intro i b hμ
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hμ]
      have hp := hπ_t_pair i b
      dsimp [K, μ_t, lam_t] at hp ⊢
      linarith
    have hP3_dom : ∀ i b₀ b₁ b₂, P3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ ≤ K * P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ * lam_t b₂ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁ b₂
      dsimp [P3, P3_01_i]
      split_ifs with hμ
      · have hid : π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁ * π_tilde i b₂ / (μ_t i ^ 2) =
            (π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁ / μ_t i) * (π_tilde i b₂ / μ_t i) := by
          field_simp [hμ.ne']
        rw [hid]
        have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_ratio_dom i b₂ hμ)
          (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hπ_t_nn i b₀) (hπ_t_nn i b₁)) hμ.le)
        linarith
      · simp
    have hP3_01_i_dom0 : ∀ i b₀ b₁, P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ ≤ K * π_tilde i b₀ * lam_t b₁ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁
      dsimp [P3_01_i]
      split_ifs with hμ
      · have hid : π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁ / μ_t i =
            π_tilde i b₀ * (π_tilde i b₁ / μ_t i) := by ring
        rw [hid]
        have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_ratio_dom i b₁ hμ) (hπ_t_nn i b₀)
        linarith
      · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK_nn (hπ_t_nn i b₀)) (hlam_t_nn b₁)
    have hP3_01_i_dom1 : ∀ i b₀ b₁, P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ ≤ K * π_tilde i b₁ * lam_t b₀ := by
      intro i b₀ b₁
      have hsym : P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ = P3_01_i i b₁ b₀ := by
        dsimp [P3_01_i]; split_ifs <;> ring
      rw [hsym]
      exact hP3_01_i_dom0 i b₁ b₀
    have hP3_01_dom : ∀ b₀ b₁, P3_01 b₀ b₁ ≤ 512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ := by
      intro b₀ b₁
      calc P3_01 b₀ b₁
          ≤ ∑ i, K * π_tilde i b₀ * lam_t b₁ :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hP3_01_i_dom0 i b₀ b₁)
        _ = K * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ ≤ 512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK_le_η (hlam_t_nn b₀)) (hlam_t_nn b₁)

    let τ : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => (θ_lbl b).1 * d₀ 0 + (θ_lbl b).2 * d₀ 1
    let r_ϑ : ℝ := ρ_tilde ^ ϑ
    have hrϑ_ge : ρ_tilde ≤ r_ϑ := by
      calc ρ_tilde = ρ_tilde ^ (1 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one ρ_tilde).symm
        _ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ ϑ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_t_pos hρ_t_le1 hϑ_le1
    have hrϑ_le1 : r_ϑ ≤ 1 := by
      calc ρ_tilde ^ ϑ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (0 : ℝ) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_t_pos hρ_t_le1 hϑ_pos.le
        _ = 1 := Real.rpow_zero ρ_tilde

    have h_exists_unord : ∃ b₀' b₁' : Fin N_Θ,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀' * lam_t b₁' < P3_01 b₀' b₁' ∧
        r_ϑ ≤ |τ b₁' - τ b₀'| := by
      by_contra h_none
      push_neg at h_none
      have h_pt : ∀ b₀ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
          P3_01 b₀ b₁ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ +
            (if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then P3_01 b₀ b₁ else 0) := by
        intro b₀ b₁
        by_cases hsep : |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ
        · rw [if_pos hsep]
          linarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (hlam_t_nn b₀))
            (hlam_t_nn b₁)]
        · rw [if_neg hsep]
          have h1 := h_none b₀ b₁
          have h_or : P3_01 b₀ b₁ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ := by
            by_contra hgt
            exact hsep (h1 (lt_of_not_ge hgt))
          linarith
      have h_low_sum : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁) = 1 / 2 := by
        calc (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁)
            = ∑ b₀, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀) * (∑ b₁, lam_t b₁) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₀ _ => (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm)
          _ = (∑ b₀, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀) * (∑ b₁, lam_t b₁) :=
              (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ b₀, lam_t b₀) * (∑ b₁, lam_t b₁) := by
              rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          _ = 1 / 2 := by rw [hlam_t_sum, mul_one, mul_one]
      have h_unsep_sum :
          (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then P3_01 b₀ b₁ else 0) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        have h_inner : ∀ b₀ : Fin N_Θ,
            (∑ b₁, if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then P3_01 b₀ b₁ else 0) ≤
            (512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * (ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * r_ϑ ^ s)) * lam_t b₀ := by
          intro b₀
          have hball := h_τ_ball (τ b₀) r_ϑ hrϑ_ge hrϑ_le1
          have hball' : (∑ b₁, if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then lam_t b₁ else 0) ≤
              ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * r_ϑ ^ s := by
            refine le_trans ?_ hball
            refine le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => ?_))
            by_cases h : |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ
            · simp [τ, d₀, lam_t, h]
            · simp [τ, d₀, lam_t, h]
          calc (∑ b₁, if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then P3_01 b₀ b₁ else 0)
              ≤ ∑ b₁, if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then
                  512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ else 0 := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₁ _ => ?_)
                split_ifs
                · exact hP3_01_dom b₀ b₁
                · exact le_rfl
            _ = (512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * lam_t b₀) *
                  (∑ b₁, if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then lam_t b₁ else 0) := by
                rw [Finset.mul_sum Finset.univ (fun b₁ => if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then lam_t b₁ else 0)]
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro b₁ _
                split_ifs <;> ring
            _ ≤ (512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * lam_t b₀) * (ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * r_ϑ ^ s) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hball'
                  (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ_t_pos.le _))
                    (hlam_t_nn b₀))
            _ = (512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * (ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * r_ϑ ^ s)) * lam_t b₀ := by ring
        calc (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then P3_01 b₀ b₁ else 0)
            ≤ ∑ b₀, (512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * (ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * r_ϑ ^ s)) * lam_t b₀ :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₀ _ => h_inner b₀)
          _ = (512 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * (ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * r_ϑ ^ s)) * (∑ b₀, lam_t b₀) :=
              (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
          _ = 512 * ρ_tilde ^ (s * ϑ - 2 * η) := by
              rw [hlam_t_sum, mul_one]
              dsimp [r_ϑ]
              rw [← Real.rpow_mul hρ_t_pos.le, ← Real.rpow_add hρ_t_pos,
                mul_assoc 512, ← Real.rpow_add hρ_t_pos]
              congr 2
              ring
          _ ≤ 1 / 4 := h_sep_small
      have h_tot : (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P3_01 b₀ b₁) ≤ 3 / 4 := by
        calc (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, P3_01 b₀ b₁)
            ≤ ∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ +
                (if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then P3_01 b₀ b₁ else 0)) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₀ _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₁ _ => h_pt b₀ b₁))
          _ = (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁) +
              (∑ b₀, ∑ b₁, if |τ b₁ - τ b₀| < r_ϑ then P3_01 b₀ b₁ else 0) := by
              simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          _ ≤ 1 / 2 + 1 / 4 := add_le_add (le_of_eq h_low_sum) h_unsep_sum
          _ = 3 / 4 := by norm_num
      linarith [hP3_01_sum, h_tot]

    obtain ⟨b₀', b₁', h_gt', h_sep'⟩ := h_exists_unord
    have h_exists_ord : ∃ b₀ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ < P3_01 b₀ b₁ ∧
        r_ϑ ≤ τ b₁ - τ b₀ := by
      by_cases h_ord : τ b₀' ≤ τ b₁'
      · refine ⟨b₀', b₁', h_gt', ?_⟩
        rwa [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h_ord)] at h_sep'
      · refine ⟨b₁', b₀', ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hP3_01_symm b₁' b₀']
          linarith
        · push_neg at h_ord
          rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr h_ord)] at h_sep'
          linarith

    obtain ⟨b₀, b₁, h_gt, h_sep⟩ := h_exists_ord
    have hP3_01_pos : 0 < P3_01 b₀ b₁ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (hlam_t_nn b₀)) (hlam_t_nn b₁))
        h_gt
    obtain ⟨i_star, _, hi_star_ne⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hP3_01_pos.ne'
    have hi_star_pos : 0 < P3_01_i i_star b₀ b₁ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (hP3_01_i_nn i_star b₀ b₁) (Ne.symm hi_star_ne)
    have hπ_istar : 0 < π_tilde i_star b₀ ∧ 0 < π_tilde i_star b₁ := by
      dsimp [P3_01_i] at hi_star_pos
      split_ifs at hi_star_pos with hμ
      · have hprod_pos : 0 < π_tilde i_star b₀ * π_tilde i_star b₁ := by
          by_contra hnp
          have hle : π_tilde i_star b₀ * π_tilde i_star b₁ ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp hnp
          have hdiv_le : π_tilde i_star b₀ * π_tilde i_star b₁ / μ_t i_star ≤ 0 :=
            div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hle hμ.le
          linarith
        constructor
        · by_contra h0
          have heq : π_tilde i_star b₀ = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp h0) (hπ_t_nn i_star b₀)
          rw [heq, zero_mul] at hprod_pos
          exact lt_irrefl 0 hprod_pos
        · by_contra h1
          have heq : π_tilde i_star b₁ = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp h1) (hπ_t_nn i_star b₁)
          rw [heq, mul_zero] at hprod_pos
          exact lt_irrefl 0 hprod_pos
      · exact absurd hi_star_pos (lt_irrefl 0)

    have hstr_b₀ := (hπ_t_supp i_star b₀ hπ_istar.1).2
    have hstr_b₁ := (hπ_t_supp i_star b₁ hπ_istar.2).2
    have hlam_t0_pos : 0 < lam_t b₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_istar.1
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hπ_t_nn i b₀) (Finset.mem_univ i_star))
    have hlam_t1_pos : 0 < lam_t b₁ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_istar.2
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hπ_t_nn i b₁) (Finset.mem_univ i_star))
    obtain ⟨hlam_o0_pos, hfib0⟩ := hπ_t_fiber b₀ hlam_t0_pos
    obtain ⟨hlam_o1_pos, hfib1⟩ := hπ_t_fiber b₁ hlam_t1_pos

    let ν₀₁ : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b₂ => P3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ / P3_01 b₀ b₁
    let ν₀₁_P : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ∑ b₂, ν₀₁ i b₂
    have hν₀₁_P_eq : ∀ i, ν₀₁_P i = P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ / P3_01 b₀ b₁ := by
      intro i
      dsimp [ν₀₁_P, ν₀₁]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, hP3_sum2]
    refine ⟨b₀, b₁, ν₀₁, hlam_o0_pos, hlam_o1_pos, hstr_b₀, hstr_b₁, h_sep, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i b₂
      exact div_nonneg (hP3_nn i b₀ b₁ b₂) hP3_01_pos.le
    · change ∑ i, ν₀₁_P i = 1
      simp only [hν₀₁_P_eq, ← Finset.sum_div]
      exact div_self hP3_01_pos.ne'
    · intro i b₂ hν_pos
      dsimp [ν₀₁, P3] at hν_pos
      split_ifs at hν_pos with hμ
      · have hπ2_pos : 0 < π_tilde i b₂ := by
          by_contra h0
          have heq : π_tilde i b₂ = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp h0) (hπ_t_nn i b₂)
          rw [heq] at hν_pos
          simp at hν_pos
        exact (hπ_t_supp i b₂ hπ2_pos).1
      · simp at hν_pos
    · intro i b₂
      change P3 i b₀ b₁ b₂ / P3_01 b₀ b₁ ≤ K * ν₀₁_P i * lam_t b₂
      rw [hν₀₁_P_eq i]
      have hd := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hP3_dom i b₀ b₁ b₂) hP3_01_pos.le
      linarith [show K * P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ * lam_t b₂ / P3_01 b₀ b₁ =
        K * (P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ / P3_01 b₀ b₁) * lam_t b₂ by ring]
    · intro i
      change ν₀₁_P i ≤ 8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * (π_orig i b₀ / (∑ i', π_orig i' b₀)) ∧
             ν₀₁_P i ≤ 8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * (π_orig i b₁ / (∑ i', π_orig i' b₁))
      have hνP_nn : 0 ≤ ν₀₁_P i := by
        rw [hν₀₁_P_eq i]; exact div_nonneg (hP3_01_i_nn i b₀ b₁) hP3_01_pos.le
      have h_mul_eq : P3_01 b₀ b₁ * ν₀₁_P i = P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ := by
        rw [hν₀₁_P_eq i]; exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hP3_01_pos.ne'
      constructor
      · have h1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ * ν₀₁_P i ≤ K * π_tilde i b₀ * lam_t b₁ := by
          calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ * ν₀₁_P i
              ≤ P3_01 b₀ b₁ * ν₀₁_P i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_gt.le hνP_nn
            _ = P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ := h_mul_eq
            _ ≤ K * π_tilde i b₀ * lam_t b₁ := hP3_01_i_dom0 i b₀ b₁
        have h2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * ν₀₁_P i ≤ K * π_tilde i b₀ := by
          refine le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ hlam_t1_pos
          linarith
        have h3 : ν₀₁_P i ≤ 2 * K * (π_tilde i b₀ / lam_t b₀) := by
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, le_div_iff₀ hlam_t0_pos]
          linarith
        calc ν₀₁_P i
            ≤ 2 * K * (π_tilde i b₀ / lam_t b₀) := h3
          _ ≤ 2 * K * (8 * (π_orig i b₀ / (∑ i', π_orig i' b₀))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfib0 i) (by positivity)
          _ = 8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * (π_orig i b₀ / (∑ i', π_orig i' b₀)) := by
              dsimp [K]; ring
      · have h1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ * ν₀₁_P i ≤ K * π_tilde i b₁ * lam_t b₀ := by
          calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₀ * lam_t b₁ * ν₀₁_P i
              ≤ P3_01 b₀ b₁ * ν₀₁_P i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_gt.le hνP_nn
            _ = P3_01_i i b₀ b₁ := h_mul_eq
            _ ≤ K * π_tilde i b₁ * lam_t b₀ := hP3_01_i_dom1 i b₀ b₁
        have h2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam_t b₁ * ν₀₁_P i ≤ K * π_tilde i b₁ := by
          refine le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ hlam_t0_pos
          linarith
        have h3 : ν₀₁_P i ≤ 2 * K * (π_tilde i b₁ / lam_t b₁) := by
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, le_div_iff₀ hlam_t1_pos]
          linarith
        calc ν₀₁_P i
            ≤ 2 * K * (π_tilde i b₁ / lam_t b₁) := h3
          _ ≤ 2 * K * (8 * (π_orig i b₁ / (∑ i', π_orig i' b₁))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfib1 i) (by positivity)
          _ = 8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * (π_orig i b₁ / (∑ i', π_orig i' b₁)) := by
              dsimp [K]; ring

  
  
  
  obtain ⟨b₀, b₁, ν₀₁, hlam_o0_pos, hlam_o1_pos, hstr_b₀, hstr_b₁, h_sep,
    hν₀₁_nn, hν₀₁_sum, hν₀₁_supp, hν₀₁_pair, hν₀₁_dom⟩ := h_pair

  classical
  have h_ite_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} (S : Finset ι) (P Q : ι → Prop)
      {instP : DecidablePred P} {instQ : DecidablePred Q} (f g : ι → ℝ),
      (∀ a ∈ S, P a ↔ Q a) → (∀ a ∈ S, P a → f a = g a) →
      (∑ a ∈ S, @ite ℝ (P a) (instP a) (f a) 0) =
        (∑ a ∈ S, @ite ℝ (Q a) (instQ a) (g a) 0) := by
    intro ι S P Q instP instQ f g hPQ hfg
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a ha => ?_)
    by_cases hP : P a
    · have hQ : Q a := (hPQ a ha).mp hP
      cases instP a with
      | isFalse hnP => exact absurd hP hnP
      | isTrue _ =>
        cases instQ a with
        | isFalse hnQ => exact absurd hQ hnQ
        | isTrue _ => exact hfg a ha hP
    · have hnQ : ¬ Q a := fun hQ => hP ((hPQ a ha).mpr hQ)
      cases instP a with
      | isTrue hp' => exact absurd hp' hP
      | isFalse _ =>
        cases instQ a with
        | isTrue hq' => exact absurd hq' hnQ
        | isFalse _ => rfl

  have h_ite_congr : ∀ {ι : Type} (S : Finset ι) (P Q : ι → Prop)
      {instP : DecidablePred P} {instQ : DecidablePred Q} (f : ι → ℝ),
      (∀ a ∈ S, P a ↔ Q a) →
      (∑ a ∈ S, @ite ℝ (P a) (instP a) (f a) 0) =
        (∑ a ∈ S, @ite ℝ (Q a) (instQ a) (f a) 0) := by
    intro ι S P Q instP instQ f hPQ
    exact h_ite_sum S P Q f f hPQ (fun _ _ _ => rfl)

  have h_sum_partition : ∀ {ι κ : Type} [DecidableEq κ] (S : Finset ι) (T : Finset κ)
      (g : ι → κ) (P : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (f : ι → ℝ),
      (∀ a ∈ S, g a ∈ T) →
      (∑ a ∈ S, if P a then f a else 0) =
        ∑ y ∈ T, ∑ a ∈ S, if P a ∧ g a = y then f a else 0 := by
    intro ι κ _ S T g P _ f hg
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a ha => ?_)
    by_cases hP : P a
    · simp only [hP, true_and]
      exact ((Finset.sum_ite_eq T (g a) (fun _ => f a)).trans (if_pos (hg a ha))).symm
    · simp only [hP, false_and, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]

  have h_sum_partition_pred : ∀ {ι κ : Type} [DecidableEq κ] (S : Finset ι) (T : Finset κ)
      (g : ι → κ) (R : ι → Prop) (Q : κ → Prop) [DecidablePred R] [DecidablePred Q] (f : ι → ℝ),
      (∀ a ∈ S, g a ∈ T) →
      (∑ a ∈ S, if R a ∧ Q (g a) then f a else 0) =
        ∑ y ∈ T, if Q y then (∑ a ∈ S, if R a ∧ g a = y then f a else 0) else 0 := by
    intro ι κ _ S T g R Q _ _ f hg
    rw [h_sum_partition S T g (fun a => R a ∧ Q (g a)) f hg]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
    by_cases hQ : Q y
    · rw [if_pos hQ]
      exact h_ite_congr S _ _ f (fun a _ =>
        ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1.1, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨⟨h.1, h.2.symm ▸ hQ⟩, h.2⟩⟩)
    · rw [if_neg hQ]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => if_neg ?_)
      rintro ⟨⟨_, hQg⟩, hgy⟩
      exact hQ (hgy ▸ hQg)

  let d₀ := perp2D e_n
  let lam_o₀ : ℝ := ∑ i, π_orig i b₀
  let lam_o₁ : ℝ := ∑ i, π_orig i b₁
  let ν₀₁_P : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ∑ b₂, ν₀₁ i b₂
  let lam_t : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b₂ => ∑ i, π_tilde i b₂
  let w₀ : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => π_orig i b₀ / lam_o₀
  let w₁ : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => π_orig i b₁ / lam_o₁
  have hw₀_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w₀ i := fun i => div_nonneg (hπ_orig_nn i b₀) hlam_o0_pos.le
  have hw₁_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w₁ i := fun i => div_nonneg (hπ_orig_nn i b₁) hlam_o1_pos.le
  have hw₀_sum : ∑ i, w₀ i = 1 := by
    dsimp [w₀, lam_o₀]; rw [← Finset.sum_div]; exact div_self hlam_o0_pos.ne'
  have hw₁_sum : ∑ i, w₁ i = 1 := by
    dsimp [w₁, lam_o₁]; rw [← Finset.sum_div]; exact div_self hlam_o1_pos.ne'
  have hν₀₁_P_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ν₀₁_P i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b₂ _ => hν₀₁_nn i b₂)
  have hlam_t_nn : ∀ b₂, 0 ≤ lam_t b₂ := fun b₂ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hπ_t_nn i b₂)
  have hlam_t_sum : ∑ b₂, lam_t b₂ = 1 := by
    dsimp [lam_t]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact hπ_t_sum

  let mid_of_bin : ℤ → ℝ := fun k => ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
  let bX : Fin N_P → ℤ := fun i => canonicalGridBin ρ (P_pt i 0)
  let bU₀ : Fin N_P → ℤ × ℤ := fun i =>
    (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 1),
     canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 2))
  let bZ₀ : Fin N_P → ℤ := fun i => canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 3)
  let bU₁ : Fin N_P → ℤ × ℤ := fun i =>
    (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₁) 1),
     canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₁) 2))
  let bZ₁ : Fin N_P → ℤ := fun i => canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₁) 3)

  let f_N : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ := fun u =>
    canonicalGridBin ρ_tilde (e_n 0 * mid_of_bin u.1 + e_n 1 * mid_of_bin u.2)
  let g_U₀ : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ := fun u => d₀ 0 * mid_of_bin u.1 + d₀ 1 * mid_of_bin u.2
  let Φ_U : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ := fun u =>
    (canonicalGridBin ρ_tilde (mid_of_bin u.1), canonicalGridBin ρ_tilde (mid_of_bin u.2))
  let N_bin : Fin N_P → ℤ := fun i => f_N (bU₀ i)
  let L_bin : Fin N_P → ℤ := fun i =>
    canonicalGridBin ρ_tilde (d₀ 0 * mid_of_bin (bU₁ i).1 + d₀ 1 * mid_of_bin (bU₁ i).2)
  let X_hat : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ((bX i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
  let L_hat : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ((L_bin i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ_tilde
  let Z₁_hat : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ((bZ₁ i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
  let α₀₁ : ℝ :=
    ((θ_lbl b₁).1 * d₀ 0 + (θ_lbl b₁).2 * d₀ 1) -
      ((θ_lbl b₀).1 * d₀ 0 + (θ_lbl b₀).2 * d₀ 1)
  let a_B : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b₂ =>
    -(((θ_lbl b₂).1 - (θ_lbl b₁).1) * d₀ 1 + ((θ_lbl b₂).2 - (θ_lbl b₁).2) * d₀ 0)

  have hα₀₁_lb : ρ_tilde ^ η_sl ≤ α₀₁ :=
    le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ_t_pos hρ_t_le1 hϑ_le_ηsl) h_sep
  have hα₀₁_le12 : α₀₁ ≤ 12 := by
    have hP0 : ∀ j : Fin 4, |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ 4 := fun _ => by norm_num
    have hg0 := h_geom c₀ (fun _ => 0) (θ_lbl b₀) (θ_lbl b₁) (θ_lbl b₁)
      hP0 (hθ_dom b₀) (hθ_dom b₁) (hθ_dom b₁) hstr_b₀ hstr_b₁
    exact le_of_abs_le hg0.1

  let in_box : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ × ℤ → Prop := fun nl k_Ut =>
    let u_star0 := ((nl.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d₀ 0 + ((nl.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * e_n 0
    let u_star1 := ((nl.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * d₀ 1 + ((nl.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * e_n 1
    |k_Ut.1 - ⌊u_star0⌋| ≤ 12 ∧ |k_Ut.2 - ⌊u_star1⌋| ≤ 12

  have h_pt_geom : ∀ i : Fin N_P,
      in_box (N_bin i, L_bin i) (Φ_U (bU₁ i)) ∧
      |L_hat i - (g_U₀ (bU₀ i) + α₀₁ * X_hat i)| ≤ 9 * ρ_tilde ∧
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![L_hat i, Z₁_hat i] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ≤ 200 := by
    intro i
    have hg := h_geom c₀ (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) (θ_lbl b₁) (θ_lbl b₁)
      (hP_dom i) (hθ_dom b₀) (hθ_dom b₁) (hθ_dom b₁) hstr_b₀ hstr_b₁
    exact ⟨hg.2.1, hg.2.2.1, hg.2.2.2.1⟩

  have haB_bd : ∀ b₂ : Fin N_Θ, |a_B b₂| ≤ 200 := by
    intro b₂
    have hP0 : ∀ j : Fin 4, |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ 4 := fun _ => by norm_num
    have hg := h_geom c₀ (fun _ => 0) (θ_lbl b₀) (θ_lbl b₁) (θ_lbl b₂)
      hP0 (hθ_dom b₀) (hθ_dom b₁) (hθ_dom b₂) hstr_b₀ hstr_b₁
    exact hg.2.2.2.2.1

  let A_vec : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * ρ ^ (-κ), 8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * 1521 * ρ ^ (-κ)]
  let F_map : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → Fin N_P → ℤ × ℤ :=
    ![![fun i => (bX i, 0), bU₀, fun _ => (0, 0)],
      ![fun i => (bX i, 0), fun i => (N_bin i, L_bin i), fun i => (bZ₁ i, 0)]]
  let μ_comp : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℤ × ℤ → ℝ :=
    ![![fun v => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if (bX i, (0 : ℤ)) = v then w₀ i else 0,
        fun v => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU₀ i = v then w₀ i else 0,
        fun v => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) = v then w₀ i else 0],
      ![fun v => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if (bX i, (0 : ℤ)) = v then w₁ i else 0,
        fun nl => (1 / 1521 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin N_P, if in_box nl (Φ_U (bU₁ i)) then w₁ i else 0,
        fun v => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if (bZ₁ i, (0 : ℤ)) = v then w₁ i else 0]]

  have h_fin2 : ∀ l : Fin 2, l = 0 ∨ l = 1 := by
    intro l
    by_cases h0 : l.val = 0
    · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext h0)
    · exact Or.inr (Fin.ext (by have := l.isLt; omega))
  have h_fin3 : ∀ j : Fin 3, j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by
    intro j
    by_cases h0 : j.val = 0
    · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext h0)
    · by_cases h1 : j.val = 1
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Fin.ext h1))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Fin.ext (by have := j.isLt; omega)))

  have hA_nn : ∀ l : Fin 2, 0 ≤ A_vec l := by
    intro l
    rcases h_fin2 l with rfl | rfl <;> dsimp [A_vec] <;> positivity

  have h_ind_nn : ∀ (P : Fin N_P → Prop) {instP : DecidablePred P} (w : Fin N_P → ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (P i) (instP i) (w i) 0 := by
    intro P instP w hw
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => ?_)
    cases instP i
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact hw i

  have hμ_comp_nn : ∀ (l : Fin 2) (j : Fin 3) (v : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ μ_comp l j v := by
    intro l j v
    rcases h_fin2 l with rfl | rfl <;> rcases h_fin3 j with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact h_ind_nn (fun i => (bX i, (0 : ℤ)) = v) w₀ hw₀_nn
    · exact h_ind_nn (fun i => bU₀ i = v) w₀ hw₀_nn
    · exact h_ind_nn (fun _ => ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) = v) w₀ hw₀_nn
    · exact h_ind_nn (fun i => (bX i, (0 : ℤ)) = v) w₁ hw₁_nn
    · exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (h_ind_nn (fun i => in_box v (Φ_U (bU₁ i))) w₁ hw₁_nn)
    · exact h_ind_nn (fun i => (bZ₁ i, (0 : ℤ)) = v) w₁ hw₁_nn

  have h_push_sum_le1 : ∀ (f : Fin N_P → ℤ × ℤ) (w : Fin N_P → ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → (∑ i, w i = 1) →
      ∀ (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
        (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ i : Fin N_P, if f i = v then w i else 0) ≤ 1 := by
    intro f w hw_nn hw_sum S
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ v ∈ S, if f i = v then w i else 0)
        = ∑ i : Fin N_P, if f i ∈ S then w i else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_ite_eq S (f i) (fun _ => w i))
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, w i :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact le_rfl; exact hw_nn i)
      _ = 1 := hw_sum

  have hμ_comp_sum_any : ∀ (l : Fin 2) (j : Fin 3) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      (∑ v ∈ S, μ_comp l j v) ≤ 1 := by
    intro l j S
    rcases h_fin2 l with rfl | rfl <;> rcases h_fin3 j with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact h_push_sum_le1 (fun i => (bX i, 0)) w₀ hw₀_nn hw₀_sum S
    · exact h_push_sum_le1 bU₀ w₀ hw₀_nn hw₀_sum S
    · exact h_push_sum_le1 (fun _ => (0, 0)) w₀ hw₀_nn hw₀_sum S
    · exact h_push_sum_le1 (fun i => (bX i, 0)) w₁ hw₁_nn hw₁_sum S
    · change (∑ nl ∈ S, (1 / 1521 : ℝ) *
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, if in_box nl (Φ_U (bU₁ i)) then w₁ i else 0) ≤ 1
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm]
      have h_each : ∀ i : Fin N_P,
          (∑ nl ∈ S, if in_box nl (Φ_U (bU₁ i)) then w₁ i else 0) ≤ 1521 * w₁ i := by
        intro i
        have h_pull : (∑ nl ∈ S, if in_box nl (Φ_U (bU₁ i)) then w₁ i else 0) =
            (∑ nl ∈ S, if in_box nl (Φ_U (bU₁ i)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * w₁ i := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun nl _ => by split_ifs <;> ring)
        rw [h_pull, Finset.sum_boole]
        have h_inv := h_inv_mult S (Φ_U (bU₁ i))
        have h_card_le : ((S.filter (fun nl => in_box nl (Φ_U (bU₁ i)))).card : ℝ) ≤ 1521 := by
          refine le_trans ?_ h_inv
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (fun nl hnl => by
            rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hnl
            rw [Finset.mem_filter]
            exact hnl)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card_le (hw₁_nn i)
      calc (1 / 1521 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ nl ∈ S,
              (if in_box nl (Φ_U (bU₁ i)) then w₁ i else 0)
          ≤ (1 / 1521 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin N_P, 1521 * w₁ i :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_each i)) (by norm_num)
        _ = ∑ i : Fin N_P, w₁ i := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; ring
        _ = 1 := hw₁_sum
    · exact h_push_sum_le1 (fun i => (bZ₁ i, 0)) w₁ hw₁_nn hw₁_sum S

  have h_joint_dom : ∀ (l : Fin 2) (v₀ v₁ v₂ : ℤ × ℤ),
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, if F_map l 0 i = v₀ ∧ F_map l 1 i = v₁ ∧ F_map l 2 i = v₂
        then ν₀₁_P i else 0) ≤
        A_vec l * μ_comp l 0 v₀ * μ_comp l 1 v₁ * μ_comp l 2 v₂ := by
    intro l v₀ v₁ v₂
    have hrhs_nn : 0 ≤ A_vec l * μ_comp l 0 v₀ * μ_comp l 1 v₁ * μ_comp l 2 v₂ :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hA_nn l) (hμ_comp_nn l 0 v₀)) (hμ_comp_nn l 1 v₁))
        (hμ_comp_nn l 2 v₂)
    rcases h_fin2 l with rfl | rfl
    · 
      by_cases hv : v₀.2 = 0 ∧ v₂ = (0, 0)
      · rcases hv with ⟨hv0_2, rfl⟩
        have hv0_eq : v₀ = (v₀.1, 0) := Prod.ext rfl hv0_2
        let S_Z0 : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image bZ₀
        have hbZ0_mem : ∀ i : Fin N_P, bZ₀ i ∈ S_Z0 :=
          fun i => Finset.mem_image_of_mem bZ₀ (Finset.mem_univ i)
        have hμ0_2 : μ_comp 0 2 (0, 0) = 1 := by
          change (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) = (0, 0) then w₀ i else 0) = 1
          simp [hw₀_sum]
        have hμ0_0 : μ_comp 0 0 v₀ = ∑ i, if bX i = v₀.1 then w₀ i else 0 := by
          change (∑ i : Fin N_P, if (bX i, (0 : ℤ)) = v₀ then w₀ i else 0) = _
          exact h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ w₀ (fun i _ => by rw [hv0_eq]; simp)
        have hμ0_1 : μ_comp 0 1 v₁ = ∑ i, if bU₀ i = v₁ then w₀ i else 0 := rfl
        have h_z_sum1 : (∑ k_Z ∈ S_Z0, ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ₀ i = k_Z then w₀ i else 0) = 1 := by
          have hp := h_sum_partition Finset.univ S_Z0 bZ₀ (fun _ => True) w₀
            (fun i _ => hbZ0_mem i)
          simp only [true_and, ↓reduceIte] at hp
          linarith [hp, hw₀_sum]
        have h_w0_bound :
            (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = v₀.1 ∧ bU₀ i = v₁ then w₀ i else 0) ≤
              ρ ^ (-κ) * μ_comp 0 0 v₀ * μ_comp 0 1 v₁ := by
          rw [h_sum_partition Finset.univ S_Z0 bZ₀ (fun i => bX i = v₀.1 ∧ bU₀ i = v₁) w₀
            (fun i _ => hbZ0_mem i)]
          calc (∑ k_Z ∈ S_Z0, ∑ i : Fin N_P,
                  if (bX i = v₀.1 ∧ bU₀ i = v₁) ∧ bZ₀ i = k_Z then w₀ i else 0)
              ≤ ∑ k_Z ∈ S_Z0, ρ ^ (-κ) * μ_comp 0 0 v₀ * μ_comp 0 1 v₁ *
                  (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ₀ i = k_Z then w₀ i else 0) := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k_Z _ => ?_)
                have hcp := h_coord_prod b₀ hlam_o0_pos v₀.1 v₁ k_Z
                dsimp only at hcp
                rw [hμ0_0, hμ0_1]
                refine le_trans ?_ (le_trans hcp ?_)
                · exact le_of_eq (h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ w₀
                    (fun _ _ => ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1.1, h.1.2, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩, h.2.2⟩⟩))
                · refine le_of_eq ?_
                  dsimp only [w₀, lam_o₀]
                  congr 1
                  · congr 1
                    · congr 1
                      exact h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ _ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
                    · exact h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ _ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
                  · exact h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ _ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
            _ = (ρ ^ (-κ) * μ_comp 0 0 v₀ * μ_comp 0 1 v₁) *
                  (∑ k_Z ∈ S_Z0, ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ₀ i = k_Z then w₀ i else 0) :=
                (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
            _ = ρ ^ (-κ) * μ_comp 0 0 v₀ * μ_comp 0 1 v₁ := by rw [h_z_sum1, mul_one]
        calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if F_map 0 0 i = v₀ ∧ F_map 0 1 i = v₁ ∧ F_map 0 2 i = (0, 0)
                then ν₀₁_P i else 0)
            = ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = v₀.1 ∧ bU₀ i = v₁ then ν₀₁_P i else 0 := by
              refine h_ite_congr Finset.univ _ _ ν₀₁_P (fun i _ => ?_)
              change ((bX i, (0 : ℤ)) = v₀ ∧ bU₀ i = v₁ ∧ ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) = (0, 0)) ↔ _
              rw [hv0_eq]; simp
          _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = v₀.1 ∧ bU₀ i = v₁ then
                8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * w₀ i else 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
              split_ifs
              · exact (hν₀₁_dom i).1
              · exact le_rfl
          _ = 8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = v₀.1 ∧ bU₀ i = v₁ then w₀ i else 0) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> ring)
          _ ≤ 8192 * ρ ^ (-κ) * (ρ ^ (-κ) * μ_comp 0 0 v₀ * μ_comp 0 1 v₁) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_w0_bound (by positivity)
