        ≤ 3872 * (ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) * ρ_tilde ^ (-η)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK3 (by norm_num)
      _ = (3872 * ρ_tilde ^ (5 * η₀ / 8)) * ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) := by
          rw [h_rpow3]; ring
      _ ≤ 1 * ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_small (Real.rpow_nonneg hρt_pos.le _)
      _ = ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) := one_mul _

  have h_slope_pref : ρ_tilde ^ (-η) ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρt_pos hρt_lt_one.le (by dsimp [η]; linarith)

  let K_pair : ℝ := 512 * K_o
  have hK_pair_pos : 0 < K_pair := by dsimp [K_pair]; positivity
  have h_inc_pref : ρ_tilde ^ η₀ * K_pair ≤ 1 := by
    have h_exp : ρ_tilde ^ (7 * η₀ / 8) ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (5 * η₀ / 8) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρt_pos hρt_lt_one.le (by linarith)
    have h1 : ρ_tilde ^ η₀ * K_pair ≤ 512 * (ρ_tilde ^ η₀ * ρ_tilde ^ (-η)) := by
      dsimp [K_pair]
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hκ_le_η
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 512) (Real.rpow_nonneg hρt_pos.le η₀))
      linarith
    have h2 : ρ_tilde ^ η₀ * ρ_tilde ^ (-η) = ρ_tilde ^ (7 * η₀ / 8) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hρt_pos]
      congr 1
      dsimp [η]
      ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    linarith

  
  have h_ite_eq : ∀ {ι : Type} (s_fin : Finset ι) (P Q : ι → Prop)
      {d₁ : DecidablePred P} {d₂ : DecidablePred Q}
      (w : ι → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ s_fin, P x ↔ Q x) →
      (∑ x ∈ s_fin, @ite ℝ (P x) (d₁ x) (w x) 0) =
        ∑ x ∈ s_fin, @ite ℝ (Q x) (d₂ x) (w x) 0 := by
    intro ι s_fin P Q d₁ d₂ w hiff
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ?_)
    by_cases hP : P x
    · rw [@if_pos _ (d₁ x) hP, @if_pos _ (d₂ x) ((hiff x hx).mp hP)]
    · rw [@if_neg _ (d₁ x) hP, @if_neg _ (d₂ x) (fun hQ => hP ((hiff x hx).mpr hQ))]

  have h_sum_ind : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t : Type} [DecidableEq α_t]
      (w : Fin N → ℝ) (g : Fin N → α_t) (S : Finset α_t),
      ∑ k ∈ S, (∑ i : Fin N, if g i = k then w i else 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N, if g i ∈ S then w i else 0 := by
    intro N α_t _ w g S
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases hm : g i ∈ S
    · rw [if_pos hm, Finset.sum_eq_single (g i)]
      · exact if_pos rfl
      · intro k _ hk; exact if_neg hk.symm
      · intro habs; exact absurd hm habs
    · rw [if_neg hm]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k hk => if_neg ?_)
      intro heq; rw [heq] at hm; exact hm hk

  have h_sum_ind2 : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t : Type} [DecidableEq α_t] [DecidableEq β_t]
      (w : Fin N → ℝ) (g₁ : Fin N → α_t) (g₂ : Fin N → β_t)
      (S₁ : Finset α_t) (S₂ : Finset β_t),
      ∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, ∑ k₂ ∈ S₂,
        (∑ i : Fin N, if g₁ i = k₁ ∧ g₂ i = k₂ then w i else 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N, if g₁ i ∈ S₁ ∧ g₂ i ∈ S₂ then w i else 0 := by
    intro N α_t β_t _ _ w g₁ g₂ S₁ S₂
    have h_inner : ∀ k₁ : α_t,
        ∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, (∑ i : Fin N, if g₁ i = k₁ ∧ g₂ i = k₂ then w i else 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N, if g₁ i = k₁ then (if g₂ i ∈ S₂ then w i else 0) else 0 := by
      intro k₁
      have h_eq : ∀ k₂ : β_t,
          (∑ i : Fin N, if g₁ i = k₁ ∧ g₂ i = k₂ then w i else 0) =
            ∑ i : Fin N, if g₂ i = k₂ then (if g₁ i = k₁ then w i else 0) else 0 := by
        intro k₂
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : g₁ i = k₁ <;> by_cases h2 : g₂ i = k₂ <;> simp [h1, h2]
      simp_rw [h_eq]
      rw [h_sum_ind]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      by_cases h1 : g₁ i = k₁ <;> by_cases h2 : g₂ i ∈ S₂ <;> simp [h1, h2]
    simp_rw [h_inner]
    rw [h_sum_ind]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases h1 : g₁ i ∈ S₁ <;> by_cases h2 : g₂ i ∈ S₂ <;> simp [h1, h2]

  have h_factor2 : ∀ {α_t β_t : Type} (S₁ : Finset α_t) (S₂ : Finset β_t)
      (C : ℝ) (f₁ : α_t → ℝ) (f₂ : β_t → ℝ),
      (∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, ∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, C * f₁ k₁ * f₂ k₂) =
        C * (∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, f₁ k₁) * (∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, f₂ k₂) := by
    intro α_t β_t S₁ S₂ C f₁ f₂
    calc ∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, ∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, (C * f₁ k₁) * f₂ k₂
        = ∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, (C * f₁ k₁) * (∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, f₂ k₂) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k₁ _ => (Finset.mul_sum S₂ f₂ (C * f₁ k₁)).symm)
      _ = (∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, C * f₁ k₁) * (∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, f₂ k₂) :=
          (Finset.sum_mul S₁ (fun k₁ => C * f₁ k₁) _).symm
      _ = C * (∑ k₁ ∈ S₁, f₁ k₁) * (∑ k₂ ∈ S₂, f₂ k₂) := by
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]

  
  let lam_tilde : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i, π_tilde i b
  let lam_orig : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i, π_orig i b
  have hlam_t_nn : ∀ b, 0 ≤ lam_tilde b :=
    fun b => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hπt_nn i b)
  have hlam_t_sum : ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam_tilde b = 1 := by
    dsimp [lam_tilde]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact hπt_sum
  have hlam_t_ne : ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam_tilde b ≠ 0 := by rw [hlam_t_sum]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨b₀, _, hb₀_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hlam_t_ne
  have hlam_t0 : 0 < lam_tilde b₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hlam_t_nn b₀) (Ne.symm hb₀_ne)
  obtain ⟨hlam_o0, h_fib0⟩ := hπt_fiber b₀ hlam_t0

  let ν₀ : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => π_tilde i b₀ / lam_tilde b₀
  let μ₀ : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => π_orig i b₀ / lam_orig b₀
  have hν₀_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ν₀ i := fun i => div_nonneg (hπt_nn i b₀) hlam_t0.le
  have hμ₀_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ₀ i := fun i => div_nonneg (hπo_nn i b₀) hlam_o0.le
  have hν₀_sum : ∑ i : Fin N_P, ν₀ i = 1 := by
    dsimp [ν₀, lam_tilde]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hlam_t0.ne'
  have hμ₀_sum : ∑ i : Fin N_P, μ₀ i = 1 := by
    dsimp [μ₀, lam_orig]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hlam_o0.ne'
  have hν_le_8μ : ∀ i, ν₀ i ≤ 8 * μ₀ i := h_fib0

  let bX : Fin N_P → ℤ := fun i =>
    canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 0)
  let bU : Fin N_P → ℤ × ℤ := fun i =>
    (canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 1),
     canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 2))
  let bZ : Fin N_P → ℤ := fun i =>
    canonicalGridBin ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 3)
  let p_X : ℤ → ℝ := fun k => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k then ν₀ i else 0
  let q_X : ℤ → ℝ := fun k => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k then μ₀ i else 0

  have h_pigeonhole : ∃ k_s : ℤ, 0 < p_X k_s ∧ q_X k_s ≤ p_X k_s := by
    let S_X : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image bX
    have hν_ne : ∑ i : Fin N_P, ν₀ i ≠ 0 := by rw [hν₀_sum]; norm_num
    obtain ⟨i₀, _, hi₀_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hν_ne
    have hi₀_pos : 0 < ν₀ i₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hν₀_nn i₀) (Ne.symm hi₀_ne)
    let k₀ : ℤ := bX i₀
    have hk₀_mem : k₀ ∈ S_X := Finset.mem_image_of_mem bX (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    have hp₀_pos : 0 < p_X k₀ := by
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hi₀_pos ?_
      have h_self : ν₀ i₀ = (if bX i₀ = k₀ then ν₀ i₀ else 0) := (if_pos rfl).symm
      rw [h_self]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun i => if bX i = k₀ then ν₀ i else 0)
        (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hν₀_nn i; exact le_rfl) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    by_contra h_none
    push_neg at h_none
    have hp_nn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ p_X k :=
      fun k => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hν₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    have hq_nn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ q_X k :=
      fun k => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    have hp_le_q : ∀ k ∈ S_X, p_X k ≤ q_X k := by
      intro k _
      by_cases hk : 0 < p_X k
      · exact (h_none k hk).le
      · have hp0 : p_X k = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hk) (hp_nn k)
        rw [hp0]
        exact hq_nn k
    have h_strict : ∑ k ∈ S_X, p_X k < ∑ k ∈ S_X, q_X k :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum hp_le_q ⟨k₀, hk₀_mem, h_none k₀ hp₀_pos⟩
    have h_sum_p : ∑ k ∈ S_X, p_X k = 1 := by
      dsimp [p_X, S_X]
      rw [h_sum_ind]
      have heq : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i ∈ Finset.univ.image bX then ν₀ i else 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, ν₀ i :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => if_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem bX (Finset.mem_univ i)))
      rw [heq, hν₀_sum]
    have h_sum_q : ∑ k ∈ S_X, q_X k = 1 := by
      dsimp [q_X, S_X]
      rw [h_sum_ind]
      have heq : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i ∈ Finset.univ.image bX then μ₀ i else 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, μ₀ i :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => if_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem bX (Finset.mem_univ i)))
      rw [heq, hμ₀_sum]
    linarith

  obtain ⟨k_X_star, hpX_pos, hq_le_p⟩ := h_pigeonhole
  have hqp_div_le : q_X k_X_star / p_X k_X_star ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hpX_pos).mpr hq_le_p

  let μ_sl : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i =>
    if bX i = k_X_star then ν₀ i / p_X k_X_star else 0
  have hμ_sl_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ_sl i := by
    intro i; dsimp [μ_sl]; split_ifs
    · exact div_nonneg (hν₀_nn i) hpX_pos.le
    · exact le_rfl
  have hμ_sl_sum : ∑ i : Fin N_P, μ_sl i = 1 := by
    have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin N_P, μ_sl i = p_X k_X_star / p_X k_X_star := by
      dsimp [μ_sl, p_X]
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [h_eq]
    exact div_self hpX_pos.ne'

  have h_sl_cell : ∀ (ku : ℤ × ℤ) (kz : ℤ),
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz then μ_sl i else 0) ≤
        (8 * K_o) * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0) *
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0) := by
    intro ku kz
    have h_lhs_eq : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz then μ_sl i else 0) =
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X_star ∧ bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz then ν₀ i else 0) /
          p_X k_X_star := by
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      dsimp [μ_sl]
      by_cases hx : bX i = k_X_star <;> by_cases hu : bU i = ku <;>
        by_cases hz : bZ i = kz <;> simp [hx, hu, hz]
    have h_fib_le : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X_star ∧ bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz then ν₀ i else 0) ≤
        8 * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X_star ∧ bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
      split_ifs
      · exact hν_le_8μ i
      · simp
    have hp_raw := h_coord_prod b₀ hlam_o0 k_X_star ku kz
    have he_jnt : (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (bX i = k_X_star ∧ bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X_star ∧ bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0 :=
      h_ite_eq Finset.univ _ _ μ₀ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
    have he_X : (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (bX i = k_X_star)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) = q_X k_X_star :=
      h_ite_eq Finset.univ _ _ μ₀ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
    have he_U : (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (bU i = ku)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0 :=
      h_ite_eq Finset.univ _ _ μ₀ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
    have he_Z : (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (bZ i = kz)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0 :=
      h_ite_eq Finset.univ _ _ μ₀ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
    change (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (bX i = k_X_star ∧ bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) ≤
      K_o * (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (bX i = k_X_star) (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) *
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (bU i = ku) (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) *
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (bZ i = kz) (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) at hp_raw
    rw [he_jnt, he_X, he_U, he_Z] at hp_raw
    have hpU_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0 :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    have hpZ_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0 :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
    rw [h_lhs_eq]
    calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bX i = k_X_star ∧ bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz then ν₀ i else 0) /
          p_X k_X_star
        ≤ (8 * (K_o * q_X k_X_star *
            (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0) *
            (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0))) / p_X k_X_star :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
            (le_trans h_fib_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_raw (by norm_num)))
            hpX_pos.le
      _ = ((8 * K_o) * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0) *
            (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0)) *
            (q_X k_X_star / p_X k_X_star) := by ring
      _ ≤ (8 * K_o) * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0) *
            (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0) :=
          mul_le_of_le_one_right
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hpU_nn) hpZ_nn) hqp_div_le

  let G_sl : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop := fun i b₁ =>
    bX i = k_X_star ∧ 0 < π_tilde i b₀ ∧ 0 < π_tilde i b₁

  have h_inc_mass : ρ_tilde ^ η₀ ≤
      ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, if G_sl i b₁ then μ_sl i * lam_tilde b₁ else 0 := by
    let μ_t : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ∑ b, π_tilde i b
    let ν_sl : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b₁ =>
      if bX i = k_X_star ∧ 0 < μ_t i then
        (π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁) / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀ * μ_t i)
      else 0
    have hμ_t_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ μ_t i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hπt_nn i b)
    have h_le_μt : ∀ i b, π_tilde i b ≤ μ_t i :=
      fun i b => Finset.single_le_sum (fun b' _ => hπt_nn i b') (Finset.mem_univ b)
    have hν_sum_i : ∀ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, ν_sl i b₁ = μ_sl i := by
      intro i
      dsimp [ν_sl, μ_sl, ν₀]
      by_cases hx : bX i = k_X_star
      · by_cases hpos : 0 < μ_t i
        · have hc : bX i = k_X_star ∧ 0 < μ_t i := ⟨hx, hpos⟩
          rw [if_pos hx]
          have h_pull : (∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, if bX i = k_X_star ∧ 0 < μ_t i
              then (π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁) / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀ * μ_t i) else 0) =
              (π_tilde i b₀ / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀ * μ_t i)) *
                ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, π_tilde i b₁ := by
            calc (∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, if bX i = k_X_star ∧ 0 < μ_t i
                  then (π_tilde i b₀ * π_tilde i b₁) / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀ * μ_t i)
                  else 0)
                = ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
                    (π_tilde i b₀ / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀ * μ_t i)) * π_tilde i b₁ := by
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => ?_)
                  rw [if_pos hc]
                  ring
              _ = (π_tilde i b₀ / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀ * μ_t i)) *
                    ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, π_tilde i b₁ :=
                  (Finset.mul_sum Finset.univ (fun b₁ => π_tilde i b₁) _).symm
          rw [h_pull]
          change (π_tilde i b₀ / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀ * μ_t i)) * μ_t i =
            (π_tilde i b₀ / lam_tilde b₀) / p_X k_X_star
          field_simp [hpX_pos.ne', hlam_t0.ne', hpos.ne']
        · have h0_mu : μ_t i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hμ_t_nn i)
          have h0_pi : π_tilde i b₀ = 0 :=
            le_antisymm (by linarith [h_le_μt i b₀]) (hπt_nn i b₀)
          simp [hx, hpos, h0_pi]
      · have hc : ¬(bX i = k_X_star ∧ 0 < μ_t i) := fun h => hx h.1
        simp [hc, hx]
    have hν_pt : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b₁ : Fin N_Θ),
        ν_sl i b₁ ≤ if G_sl i b₁ then K_pair * (μ_sl i * lam_tilde b₁) else 0 := by
      intro i b₁
      by_cases hG : G_sl i b₁
      · rw [if_pos hG]
        obtain ⟨hx, hpi0, hpi1⟩ := hG
        have hpos_mu : 0 < μ_t i := lt_of_lt_of_le hpi0 (h_le_μt i b₀)
        have hν_eq : ν_sl i b₁ =
            (π_tilde i b₀ / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀)) * (π_tilde i b₁ / μ_t i) := by
          dsimp [ν_sl]
          rw [if_pos ⟨hx, hpos_mu⟩]
          field_simp [hpX_pos.ne', hlam_t0.ne', hpos_mu.ne']
        have hμ_eq : μ_sl i = π_tilde i b₀ / (p_X k_X_star * lam_tilde b₀) := by
          dsimp [μ_sl, ν₀]
          rw [if_pos hx, div_div, mul_comm (lam_tilde b₀) (p_X k_X_star)]
        have h_dom1 : π_tilde i b₁ / μ_t i ≤ K_pair * lam_tilde b₁ := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos_mu]
          have hp := hπt_pair i b₁
          dsimp [K_pair, K_o, μ_t, lam_tilde] at hp ⊢
          linarith
        rw [hν_eq, ← hμ_eq]
        calc μ_sl i * (π_tilde i b₁ / μ_t i)
            ≤ μ_sl i * (K_pair * lam_tilde b₁) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_dom1 (hμ_sl_nn i)
          _ = K_pair * (μ_sl i * lam_tilde b₁) := by ring
      · rw [if_neg hG]
        dsimp [ν_sl]
        split_ifs with h_cond
        · obtain ⟨hx, _⟩ := h_cond
          by_cases hpi0 : 0 < π_tilde i b₀
          · by_cases hpi1 : 0 < π_tilde i b₁
            · exact absurd ⟨hx, hpi0, hpi1⟩ hG
            · have h0 : π_tilde i b₁ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpi1) (hπt_nn i b₁)
              simp [h0]
          · have h0 : π_tilde i b₀ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpi0) (hπt_nn i b₀)
            simp [h0]
        · exact le_rfl
    let S_inc : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, if G_sl i b₁ then μ_sl i * lam_tilde b₁ else 0
    have hS_inc_nn : 0 ≤ S_inc :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b₁ _ => by
        split_ifs
        · exact mul_nonneg (hμ_sl_nn i) (hlam_t_nn b₁)
        · exact le_rfl))
    have h_one_le : 1 ≤ K_pair * S_inc := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ∑ i : Fin N_P, μ_sl i := hμ_sl_sum.symm
        _ = ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, ν_sl i b₁ :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hν_sum_i i).symm)
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
              if G_sl i b₁ then K_pair * (μ_sl i * lam_tilde b₁) else 0 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b₁ _ => hν_pt i b₁))
        _ = K_pair * S_inc := by
            dsimp [S_inc]
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ _ => ?_)
            split_ifs <;> ring
    calc ρ_tilde ^ η₀
        = ρ_tilde ^ η₀ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ η₀ * (K_pair * S_inc) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_one_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hρt_pos.le _)
      _ = (ρ_tilde ^ η₀ * K_pair) * S_inc := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * S_inc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inc_pref hS_inc_nn
      _ = S_inc := one_mul _

  
  have h_mid_err : ∀ x : ℝ, |canonicalGridMid ρ x - x| ≤ ρ / 2 := by
    intro x
    unfold canonicalGridMid canonicalGridBin
    have h1 : (⌊x / ρ⌋ : ℝ) * ρ ≤ x := (le_div_iff₀ hρ₀).mp (Int.floor_le (x / ρ))
    have h2 : x < ((⌊x / ρ⌋ : ℝ) + 1) * ρ := (div_lt_iff₀ hρ₀).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / ρ))
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith

  have h_M12_dom : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ),
      |canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 1)| ≤ 21 ∧
      |canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 2)| ≤ 21 ∧
      |canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 3)| ≤ 101 := by
    intro i b
    have h0 := hP_dom i 0; have h1 := hP_dom i 1; have h2 := hP_dom i 2; have h3 := hP_dom i 3
    have hθ1 := (hθ_dom b).1; have hθ2 := (hθ_dom b).2
    have hm10 : |(θ_lbl b).1 * P_pt i 0| ≤ 16 := by
      rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul hθ1 h0 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
    have hm20 : |(θ_lbl b).2 * P_pt i 0| ≤ 16 := by
      rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul hθ2 h0 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
    have hm12 : |(θ_lbl b).1 * P_pt i 2| ≤ 16 := by
      rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul hθ1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
    have hm21 : |(θ_lbl b).2 * P_pt i 1| ≤ 16 := by
      rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul hθ2 h1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
    have hm12_θ : |(θ_lbl b).1 * (θ_lbl b).2| ≤ 16 := by
      rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul hθ1 hθ2 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
    have hm120 : |(θ_lbl b).1 * (θ_lbl b).2 * P_pt i 0| ≤ 64 := by
      rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul hm12_θ h0 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 16)]
    have hQ1 : |canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 1| ≤ 20 := by
      dsimp [canonicalShear4]; linarith [abs_add_le (P_pt i 1) ((θ_lbl b).1 * P_pt i 0)]
    have hQ2 : |canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 2| ≤ 20 := by
      dsimp [canonicalShear4]; linarith [abs_add_le (P_pt i 2) ((θ_lbl b).2 * P_pt i 0)]
    have hQ3 : |canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 3| ≤ 100 := by
      dsimp [canonicalShear4]
      have ha1 := abs_add_le
        (P_pt i 3 + (θ_lbl b).1 * P_pt i 2 + (θ_lbl b).2 * P_pt i 1)
        ((θ_lbl b).1 * (θ_lbl b).2 * P_pt i 0)
      have ha2 := abs_add_le (P_pt i 3 + (θ_lbl b).1 * P_pt i 2) ((θ_lbl b).2 * P_pt i 1)
      have ha3 := abs_add_le (P_pt i 3) ((θ_lbl b).1 * P_pt i 2)
      linarith
    have he1 := h_mid_err (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 1)
    have he2 := h_mid_err (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 2)
    have he3 := h_mid_err (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b) 3)
    rw [abs_le] at hQ1 hQ2 hQ3 he1 he2 he3
    refine ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩,
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩,
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩

  let d₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := perp2D e_n
  have hd0_0 : d₀ 0 = -(e_n 1) := by simp [d₀, perp2D]
  have hd0_1 : d₀ 1 = e_n 0 := by simp [d₀, perp2D]
  have he_sq : e_n 0 ^ 2 + e_n 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h1 : ‖e_n‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [he_n]; norm_num
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2] at h1
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
  have hd0_sq : d₀ 0 ^ 2 + d₀ 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [hd0_0, hd0_1]; linear_combination he_sq
  have he0_abs : |e_n 0| ≤ 1 := by
    have h : |e_n 0| ^ 2 ≤ 1 ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]; linarith [sq_nonneg (e_n 1)]
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one).mp h
  have he1_abs : |e_n 1| ≤ 1 := by
    have h : |e_n 1| ^ 2 ≤ 1 ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]; linarith [sq_nonneg (e_n 0)]
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one).mp h
  have hd0_0_abs : |d₀ 0| ≤ 1 := by rw [hd0_0, abs_neg]; exact he1_abs
  have hd0_1_abs : |d₀ 1| ≤ 1 := by rw [hd0_1]; exact he0_abs

  let s₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun u => d₀ 1 * u 0 + d₀ 0 * u 1
  let s₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun u => -d₀ 0 * u 0 + d₀ 1 * u 1
  let c_pt : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun α_v β_v =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 ![α_v * d₀ 1 - β_v * d₀ 0, α_v * d₀ 0 + β_v * d₀ 1]

  have h_parseval_diff : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (α_v β_v : ℝ),
      ‖u - c_pt α_v β_v‖ ^ 2 = (s₁ u - α_v) ^ 2 + (s₂ u - β_v) ^ 2 := by
    intro u α_v β_v
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    have hc0 : (u - c_pt α_v β_v) 0 = u 0 - (α_v * d₀ 1 - β_v * d₀ 0) := rfl
    have hc1 : (u - c_pt α_v β_v) 1 = u 1 - (α_v * d₀ 0 + β_v * d₀ 1) := rfl
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hc0, hc1, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, s₁, s₂]
    linear_combination (α_v ^ 2 + β_v ^ 2 - u 0 ^ 2 - u 1 ^ 2) * hd0_sq

  have h_parseval_norm : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      s₁ u ^ 2 + s₂ u ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, s₁, s₂]
    linear_combination (u 0 ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2) * hd0_sq

  let U₀ : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun i =>
    canonicalMidU ρ (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀)
  let B₀ : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => s₁ (U₀ i)
  let Z₀ : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i =>
    canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 3)
  let x_P : Fin N_P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun i =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 ![B₀ i, Z₀ i]

  have hU₀_norm : ∀ i : Fin N_P, ‖U₀ i‖ ≤ 30 := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨hm1, hm2, _⟩ := h_M12_dom i b₀
    have hsq1 : (U₀ i 0) ^ 2 ≤ 21 ^ 2 := by
      have h := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mpr hm1
      rw [sq_abs] at h
      have hu0 : U₀ i 0 = canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 1) := rfl
      rw [hu0]
      linarith
    have hsq2 : (U₀ i 1) ^ 2 ≤ 21 ^ 2 := by
      have h := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mpr hm2
      rw [sq_abs] at h
      have hu1 : U₀ i 1 = canonicalGridMid ρ (canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀) 2) := rfl
      rw [hu1]
      linarith
    have hn2 : ‖U₀ i‖ ^ 2 ≤ 30 ^ 2 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      linarith
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mp hn2

  have hx_P_dom : ∀ i : Fin N_P, ‖x_P i‖ ≤ 200 := by
    intro i
    have hU_sq : ‖U₀ i‖ ^ 2 ≤ 30 ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mpr (hU₀_norm i)
    have hB_sq : B₀ i ^ 2 ≤ 30 ^ 2 := by
      linarith [h_parseval_norm (U₀ i), sq_nonneg (s₂ (U₀ i))]
    obtain ⟨_, _, hm3⟩ := h_M12_dom i b₀
    have hZ_sq : Z₀ i ^ 2 ≤ 101 ^ 2 := by
      have h := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mpr hm3
      rwa [sq_abs] at h
    have hn2 : ‖x_P i‖ ^ 2 ≤ 200 ^ 2 := by

      have hx0 : x_P i 0 = B₀ i := rfl
      have hx1 : x_P i 1 = Z₀ i := rfl
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hx0, hx1, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      linarith
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mp hn2

  
  have h_B₀_ball : ∀ (z_B r : ℝ), ρ_tilde ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, if |B₀ i - z_B| < r then μ₀ i else 0) ≤
        484 * K_o * r ^ (q - 1) := by
    intro z_B r hr₀ hr₁
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hρt_pos hr₀
    have hρ_le_r : ρ ≤ r := le_trans hρ_le hr₀
    let N_lat : ℕ := ⌊120 / r⌋₊ + 1
    let α_row : Fin 4 → ℝ := fun a => z_B + ((2 * (a.1 : ℝ) - 3) / 4) * r
    let β_col : Fin N_lat → ℝ := fun k => -30 + ((k.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * (r / 2)

    have h_Nlat_le : 4 * (N_lat : ℝ) ≤ 484 * r⁻¹ := by
      have hfl : (⌊120 / r⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ 120 / r := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
      have h1_div : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / r := (le_div_iff₀ hr_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      have hcast : (N_lat : ℝ) = (⌊120 / r⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by dsimp [N_lat]; push_cast; rfl
      have hid : 4 * (120 / r + 1 / r) = 484 * r⁻¹ := by ring
      linarith

    have h_cover_pt : ∀ i : Fin N_P, |B₀ i - z_B| < r →
        ∃ (a₀ : Fin 4) (k₀ : Fin N_lat),
          ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a₀) (β_col k₀)‖ < r := by
      intro i hB_lt
      obtain ⟨hB_lo, hB_hi⟩ := abs_lt.mp hB_lt
      have h_row : ∃ a₀ : Fin 4, (s₁ (U₀ i) - α_row a₀) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 / 16 := by
        have hB_def : B₀ i = s₁ (U₀ i) := rfl
        rw [hB_def] at hB_lo hB_hi
        by_cases hc1 : s₁ (U₀ i) ≤ z_B - r / 2
        · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
          have ha : |s₁ (U₀ i) - α_row 0| ≤ r / 4 := by
            dsimp [α_row]; norm_num; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
          have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr ha
          rw [sq_abs] at hsq; linarith
        · by_cases hc2 : s₁ (U₀ i) ≤ z_B
          · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
            have ha : |s₁ (U₀ i) - α_row 1| ≤ r / 4 := by
              dsimp [α_row]; norm_num; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
            have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr ha
            rw [sq_abs] at hsq; linarith
          · by_cases hc3 : s₁ (U₀ i) ≤ z_B + r / 2
            · refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
              have ha : |s₁ (U₀ i) - α_row 2| ≤ r / 4 := by
                dsimp [α_row]; norm_num; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
              have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr ha
              rw [sq_abs] at hsq; linarith
            · refine ⟨3, ?_⟩
              have ha : |s₁ (U₀ i) - α_row 3| ≤ r / 4 := by
                dsimp [α_row]; norm_num; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
              have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr ha
              rw [sq_abs] at hsq; linarith
      obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀_sq⟩ := h_row
      have hU_sq : ‖U₀ i‖ ^ 2 ≤ 30 ^ 2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mpr (hU₀_norm i)
      have hs2_sq : |s₂ (U₀ i)| ^ 2 ≤ 30 ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq_abs]; linarith [h_parseval_norm (U₀ i), sq_nonneg (s₁ (U₀ i))]
      obtain ⟨hs2_lo, hs2_hi⟩ :=
        abs_le.mp ((sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mp hs2_sq)
      let t_lat : ℝ := 2 * (s₂ (U₀ i) + 30) / r
      have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t_lat := div_nonneg (by linarith) hr_pos.le
      have ht_hi : t_lat ≤ 120 / r := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hr_pos.le
      let k_nat : ℕ := ⌊t_lat⌋₊
      have hk_lt : k_nat < N_lat := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.floor_mono ht_hi)
      let k₀ : Fin N_lat := ⟨k_nat, hk_lt⟩
      have hk_lo_r : (k_nat : ℝ) * r ≤ 2 * (s₂ (U₀ i) + 30) :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hr_pos).mp (Nat.floor_le ht_nn)
      have hk_hi_r : 2 * (s₂ (U₀ i) + 30) < ((k_nat : ℝ) + 1) * r :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hr_pos).mp (Nat.lt_floor_add_one t_lat)
      have hk_abs : |s₂ (U₀ i) - β_col k₀| ≤ r / 4 := by
        have hβ : β_col k₀ = -30 + ((k_nat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * (r / 2) := rfl
        rw [hβ]
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hk₀_sq : (s₂ (U₀ i) - β_col k₀) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 / 16 := by
        have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr hk_abs
        rw [sq_abs] at hsq; linarith
      refine ⟨a₀, k₀, ?_⟩
      have h_dist_sq : ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a₀) (β_col k₀)‖ ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_parseval_diff]
        have hr2_pos : 0 < r ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr_pos
        linarith
      exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mp h_dist_sq

    have h_pt_sum : ∀ i : Fin N_P,
        (if |B₀ i - z_B| < r then μ₀ i else 0) ≤
          ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ k : Fin N_lat,
            if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0 := by
      intro i
      by_cases hB : |B₀ i - z_B| < r
      · rw [if_pos hB]
        obtain ⟨a₀, k₀, h_in⟩ := h_cover_pt i hB
        have h1 : μ₀ i ≤ ∑ k : Fin N_lat,
            if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a₀) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0 := by
          calc μ₀ i
              = (if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a₀) (β_col k₀)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0) :=
                (if_pos h_in).symm
            _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin N_lat,
                if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a₀) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0 :=
              Finset.single_le_sum
                (f := fun k => if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a₀) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0)
                (fun _ _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl)
                (Finset.mem_univ k₀)
        refine le_trans h1 ?_
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun a => ∑ k : Fin N_lat,
            if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0)
          (fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl))
          (Finset.mem_univ a₀)
      · rw [if_neg hB]
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ =>
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl))

    have h_each_ball : ∀ (a : Fin 4) (k : Fin N_lat),
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0) ≤
          K_o * r ^ q := by
      intro a k
      have hub := h_U_ball b₀ (c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)) r hlam_o0 hρ_le_r hr₁
      have heq : (∑ i : Fin N_P,
          @ite ℝ (‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r)
            (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0 :=
        h_ite_eq Finset.univ _ _ μ₀ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
      change (∑ i : Fin N_P,
          @ite ℝ (‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r)
            (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) ≤ K_o * r ^ q at hub
      rwa [heq] at hub

    have h_swap : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ k : Fin N_lat,
        if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0) =
        ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ k : Fin N_lat, ∑ i : Fin N_P,
          if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_comm)

    have h_rpow_q1 : r⁻¹ * r ^ q = r ^ (q - 1) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one r, ← Real.rpow_add hr_pos]
      congr 1
      ring

    calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if |B₀ i - z_B| < r then μ₀ i else 0)
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ k : Fin N_lat,
            if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_pt_sum i)
      _ = ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ k : Fin N_lat, ∑ i : Fin N_P,
            if ‖U₀ i - c_pt (α_row a) (β_col k)‖ < r then μ₀ i else 0 := h_swap
      _ ≤ ∑ _a : Fin 4, ∑ _k : Fin N_lat, (K_o * r ^ q) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => h_each_ball a k))
      _ = (4 * (N_lat : ℝ)) * (K_o * r ^ q) := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          ring
      _ ≤ (484 * r⁻¹) * (K_o * r ^ q) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_Nlat_le
            (mul_nonneg hKo_pos.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hr_pos.le _))
      _ = 484 * K_o * (r⁻¹ * r ^ q) := by ring
      _ = 484 * K_o * r ^ (q - 1) := by rw [h_rpow_q1]

  
  have h_ball_2d : ∀ (z_pt : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ_tilde ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z_pt‖ < r then μ_sl i else 0) ≤
        ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) * r ^ (q - 1 + z) := by
    intro z_pt r hr₀ hr₁
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hρt_pos hr₀
    have hρ_le_r : ρ ≤ r := le_trans hρ_le hr₀
    let val_B : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ := fun ku =>
      d₀ 1 * (((ku.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ) + d₀ 0 * (((ku.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ)
    let val_Z : ℤ → ℝ := fun kz => ((kz : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
    let A_U : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
      (Finset.univ.image bU).filter (fun ku => |val_B ku - z_pt 0| < r)
    let A_Z : Finset ℤ :=
      (Finset.univ.image bZ).filter (fun kz => |val_Z kz - z_pt 1| < r)

    have hB_eq_val : ∀ i : Fin N_P, val_B (bU i) = B₀ i := fun _ => rfl
    have hZ_eq_val : ∀ i : Fin N_P, val_Z (bZ i) = Z₀ i := fun _ => rfl

    have h_mem_rect : ∀ i : Fin N_P, ‖x_P i - z_pt‖ < r → bU i ∈ A_U ∧ bZ i ∈ A_Z := by
      intro i h_lt
      have hsq : ‖x_P i - z_pt‖ ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
        (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mpr h_lt
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2] at hsq
      have hc0 : (x_P i - z_pt) 0 = B₀ i - z_pt 0 := rfl
      have hc1 : (x_P i - z_pt) 1 = Z₀ i - z_pt 1 := rfl
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hc0, hc1, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at hsq
      have hB_sq : |B₀ i - z_pt 0| ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq_abs]; linarith [sq_nonneg (Z₀ i - z_pt 1)]
      have hZ_sq : |Z₀ i - z_pt 1| ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq_abs]; linarith [sq_nonneg (B₀ i - z_pt 0)]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem bU (Finset.mem_univ i), ?_⟩,
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem bZ (Finset.mem_univ i), ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [hB_eq_val i]
        exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mp hB_sq
      · rw [hZ_eq_val i]
        exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hr_pos.le).mp hZ_sq

    have h_le_rect : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z_pt‖ < r then μ_sl i else 0) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i ∈ A_U ∧ bZ i ∈ A_Z then μ_sl i else 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact absurd (h_mem_rect i h1) h2
      · exact hμ_sl_nn i
      · exact le_rfl

    have h_AU_sum : ∑ ku ∈ A_U, (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0) ≤
        484 * K_o * r ^ (q - 1) := by
      rw [h_sum_ind]
      have heq : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i ∈ A_U then μ₀ i else 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, if |B₀ i - z_pt 0| < r then μ₀ i else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        have hm : bU i ∈ A_U ↔ |B₀ i - z_pt 0| < r := by
          simp only [A_U, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_image_of_mem bU (Finset.mem_univ i),
            true_and, hB_eq_val i]
        by_cases h : |B₀ i - z_pt 0| < r <;> simp [hm, h]
      rw [heq]
      exact h_B₀_ball (z_pt 0) r hr₀ hr₁

    have h_AZ_sum : ∑ kz ∈ A_Z, (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0) ≤
        K_o * r ^ z := by
      rw [h_sum_ind]
      have heq : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i ∈ A_Z then μ₀ i else 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, if |Z₀ i - z_pt 1| < r then μ₀ i else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        have hm : bZ i ∈ A_Z ↔ |Z₀ i - z_pt 1| < r := by
          simp only [A_Z, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_image_of_mem bZ (Finset.mem_univ i),
            true_and, hZ_eq_val i]
        by_cases h : |Z₀ i - z_pt 1| < r <;> simp [hm, h]
      rw [heq]
      have hzb := h_Z_ball b₀ (z_pt 1) r hlam_o0 hρ_le_r hr₁
      have heq_ite : (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (|Z₀ i - z_pt 1| < r)
          (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N_P, if |Z₀ i - z_pt 1| < r then μ₀ i else 0 :=
        h_ite_eq Finset.univ _ _ μ₀ (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
      change (∑ i : Fin N_P, @ite ℝ (|Z₀ i - z_pt 1| < r)
          (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ₀ i) 0) ≤ K_o * r ^ z at hzb
      rwa [heq_ite] at hzb

    have h_sU_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ ku ∈ A_U, (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by
        split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl))
    have h_sZ_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ kz ∈ A_Z, (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by
        split_ifs; exact hμ₀_nn i; exact le_rfl))

    calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, if ‖x_P i - z_pt‖ < r then μ_sl i else 0)
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i ∈ A_U ∧ bZ i ∈ A_Z then μ_sl i else 0 := h_le_rect
      _ = ∑ ku ∈ A_U, ∑ kz ∈ A_Z,
            (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku ∧ bZ i = kz then μ_sl i else 0) :=
          (h_sum_ind2 μ_sl bU bZ A_U A_Z).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ ku ∈ A_U, ∑ kz ∈ A_Z,
            (8 * K_o) * (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0) *
              (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ku _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun kz _ => h_sl_cell ku kz))
      _ = (8 * K_o) * (∑ ku ∈ A_U, (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0)) *
            (∑ kz ∈ A_Z, (∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0)) :=
          h_factor2 A_U A_Z (8 * K_o)
            (fun ku => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bU i = ku then μ₀ i else 0)
            (fun kz => ∑ i : Fin N_P, if bZ i = kz then μ₀ i else 0)
      _ ≤ (8 * K_o) * (484 * K_o * r ^ (q - 1)) * (K_o * r ^ z) := by
          have hm1 := mul_le_mul h_AU_sum h_AZ_sum h_sZ_nn
            (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg hr_pos.le _))
          have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 8 * K_o)
          linarith
      _ = (3872 * (K_o * K_o * K_o)) * (r ^ (q - 1) * r ^ z) := by ring
      _ = (3872 * (K_o * K_o * K_o)) * r ^ (q - 1 + z) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hr_pos]
      _ ≤ ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) * r ^ (q - 1 + z) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3872_bound (Real.rpow_nonneg hr_pos.le _)

  
  let τ_fn : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b =>
    (θ_lbl b).1 * (perp2D e_n 0) + (θ_lbl b).2 * (perp2D e_n 1)
  let a_B : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b₁ => τ_fn b₀ - τ_fn b₁

  have ha_B_dom : ∀ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, |a_B b₁| ≤ 200 := by
    intro b₁
    have hτ_bd : ∀ b : Fin N_Θ, |τ_fn b| ≤ 8 := by
      intro b
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hθ_dom b
      have hm1 : |(θ_lbl b).1 * (perp2D e_n 0)| ≤ 4 := by
        rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul h1 hd0_0_abs (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
      have hm2 : |(θ_lbl b).2 * (perp2D e_n 1)| ≤ 4 := by
        rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul h2 hd0_1_abs (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
      dsimp [τ_fn]
      linarith [abs_add_le ((θ_lbl b).1 * (perp2D e_n 0)) ((θ_lbl b).2 * (perp2D e_n 1))]
    dsimp [a_B]
    linarith [abs_sub (τ_fn b₀) (τ_fn b₁), hτ_bd b₀, hτ_bd b₁]

  have h_slope_ball : ∀ (a₀ r : ℝ), ρ_tilde ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
      (∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, if |a_B b₁ - a₀| < r then lam_tilde b₁ else 0) ≤
        ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) * r ^ s := by
    intro a₀ r hr₀ hr₁
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hρt_pos hr₀
    have htb := h_tau_ball (τ_fn b₀ - a₀) r hr₀ hr₁
    have heq : (∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, if |a_B b₁ - a₀| < r then lam_tilde b₁ else 0) =
        ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
          @ite ℝ (|τ_fn b₁ - (τ_fn b₀ - a₀)| < r)
            (Classical.propDecidable _) (lam_tilde b₁) 0 := by
      refine h_ite_eq Finset.univ _ _ lam_tilde (fun b₁ _ => ?_)
      have h_id : a_B b₁ - a₀ = -(τ_fn b₁ - (τ_fn b₀ - a₀)) := by dsimp [a_B]; ring
      rw [h_id, abs_neg]
    rw [heq]
    exact le_trans htb (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_slope_pref (Real.rpow_nonneg hr_pos.le _))

  let M_cov : ℝ := K_o * ρ_tilde ^ (-z)
  have hM_cov_pos : 0 < M_cov := mul_pos hKo_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρt_pos _)
  let x_fix : ℝ := ((k_X_star : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ

  have h_cov_all : ∀ b₁ : Fin N_Θ, ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ,
      (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ M_cov ∧
      ∀ i : Fin N_P, G_sl i b₁ →
        ∃ c_val ∈ S_cov, |(x_P i 1 - a_B b₁ * x_P i 0) - c_val| ≤ 200 * ρ_tilde := by
    intro b₁
    by_cases hlam1 : 0 < lam_orig b₁
    · let Δ₁ : ℝ := (θ_lbl b₁).1 - (θ_lbl b₀).1
      let Δ₂ : ℝ := (θ_lbl b₁).2 - (θ_lbl b₀).2
      let shift : ℝ := Δ₁ * Δ₂ * x_fix
      obtain ⟨S_raw, hS_card, hS_mem⟩ := h_Z_cov b₁ hlam1
      refine ⟨S_raw.image (fun c => c - shift),
        le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_image_le) hS_card,
        fun i hG => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hx_sl, hpi0, hpi1⟩ := hG
      obtain ⟨_, h_inn0⟩ := hπt_supp i b₀ hpi0
      obtain ⟨hπo1_pos, h_inn1⟩ := hπt_supp i b₁ hpi1
      obtain ⟨c_z, hc_mem, hc_est⟩ := hS_mem i hπo1_pos
      refine ⟨c_z - shift, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hc_mem, ?_⟩

      let Q₀ := canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₀)
      let Q₁ := canonicalShear4 (P_pt i) (θ_lbl b₁)
      let M₀ := fun j => canonicalGridMid ρ (Q₀ j)
      let M₁_3 := canonicalGridMid ρ (Q₁ 3)
      have hM0_fix : M₀ 0 = x_fix := by
        dsimp [M₀, Q₀, x_fix, canonicalGridMid]
        change ((bX i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ = ((k_X_star : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
        rw [hx_sl]

      
      have h_Q1_id : Q₁ 3 = Q₀ 3 + Δ₁ * Q₀ 2 + Δ₂ * Q₀ 1 + Δ₁ * Δ₂ * Q₀ 0 := by
        dsimp [Q₀, Q₁, Δ₁, Δ₂, canonicalShear4]; ring
      let A_mid : ℝ := M₀ 3 + Δ₂ * M₀ 1 + Δ₁ * M₀ 2
      have h_round_id : A_mid - (M₁_3 - shift) =
          (M₀ 3 - Q₀ 3) + Δ₂ * (M₀ 1 - Q₀ 1) + Δ₁ * (M₀ 2 - Q₀ 2) +
            (Δ₁ * Δ₂) * (M₀ 0 - Q₀ 0) - (M₁_3 - Q₁ 3) := by
        dsimp [A_mid, shift]
        rw [← hM0_fix]
        linear_combination -h_Q1_id
      have hΔ1_bd : |Δ₁| ≤ 8 := by
        dsimp [Δ₁]; have h0 := (hθ_dom b₀).1; have h1 := (hθ_dom b₁).1
        rw [abs_le] at h0 h1 ⊢; constructor <;> linarith
      have hΔ2_bd : |Δ₂| ≤ 8 := by
        dsimp [Δ₂]; have h0 := (hθ_dom b₀).2; have h1 := (hθ_dom b₁).2
        rw [abs_le] at h0 h1 ⊢; constructor <;> linarith
      have hΔ12_bd : |Δ₁ * Δ₂| ≤ 64 := by
        rw [abs_mul]; linarith [mul_le_mul hΔ1_bd hΔ2_bd (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8)]
      have he0 := h_mid_err (Q₀ 0)
      have he1 := h_mid_err (Q₀ 1)
      have he2 := h_mid_err (Q₀ 2)
      have he3 := h_mid_err (Q₀ 3)
      have he3' := h_mid_err (Q₁ 3)
      have hm_a : |Δ₂ * (M₀ 1 - Q₀ 1)| ≤ 8 * (ρ / 2) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hΔ2_bd he1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have hm_b : |Δ₁ * (M₀ 2 - Q₀ 2)| ≤ 8 * (ρ / 2) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hΔ1_bd he2 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have hm_c : |(Δ₁ * Δ₂) * (M₀ 0 - Q₀ 0)| ≤ 64 * (ρ / 2) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hΔ12_bd he0 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have h_round_bd : |A_mid - (M₁_3 - shift)| ≤ 41 * ρ_tilde := by
        rw [h_round_id]
        have ht1 := abs_sub
          ((M₀ 3 - Q₀ 3) + Δ₂ * (M₀ 1 - Q₀ 1) + Δ₁ * (M₀ 2 - Q₀ 2) + (Δ₁ * Δ₂) * (M₀ 0 - Q₀ 0))
          (M₁_3 - Q₁ 3)
        have ht2 := abs_add_le
          ((M₀ 3 - Q₀ 3) + Δ₂ * (M₀ 1 - Q₀ 1) + Δ₁ * (M₀ 2 - Q₀ 2))
          ((Δ₁ * Δ₂) * (M₀ 0 - Q₀ 0))
        have ht3 := abs_add_le ((M₀ 3 - Q₀ 3) + Δ₂ * (M₀ 1 - Q₀ 1)) (Δ₁ * (M₀ 2 - Q₀ 2))
        have ht4 := abs_add_le (M₀ 3 - Q₀ 3) (Δ₂ * (M₀ 1 - Q₀ 1))
        linarith

      
      let inn₀ : ℝ := (θ_lbl b₀).1 * e_n 0 + (θ_lbl b₀).2 * e_n 1
      let inn₁ : ℝ := (θ_lbl b₁).1 * e_n 0 + (θ_lbl b₁).2 * e_n 1
      let δ_inn : ℝ := inn₁ - inn₀
      have h_frame_id : (x_P i 1 - a_B b₁ * x_P i 0) - A_mid =
          -(δ_inn * (e_n 1 * M₀ 1 + e_n 0 * M₀ 2)) := by
        have hx0 : x_P i 0 = d₀ 1 * M₀ 1 + d₀ 0 * M₀ 2 := rfl
        have hx1 : x_P i 1 = M₀ 3 := rfl
        have haB : a_B b₁ =
            ((θ_lbl b₀).1 * d₀ 0 + (θ_lbl b₀).2 * d₀ 1) -
            ((θ_lbl b₁).1 * d₀ 0 + (θ_lbl b₁).2 * d₀ 1) := rfl
        rw [hx0, hx1, haB, hd0_0, hd0_1]
        dsimp [A_mid, δ_inn, inn₀, inn₁, Δ₁, Δ₂]
        linear_combination (Δ₂ * M₀ 1 + Δ₁ * M₀ 2) * he_sq
      have hδ_inn_bd : |δ_inn| ≤ 2 * ρ_tilde := by
        have h_diff : δ_inn = (inn₁ - c₀) - (inn₀ - c₀) := by dsimp [δ_inn]; ring
        rw [h_diff]
        linarith [abs_sub (inn₁ - c₀) (inn₀ - c₀), h_inn0, h_inn1]
      obtain ⟨hM1_bd, hM2_bd, _⟩ := h_M12_dom i b₀
      have heM1 : |e_n 1 * M₀ 1| ≤ 21 := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        linarith [mul_le_mul he1_abs hM1_bd (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one]
      have heM2 : |e_n 0 * M₀ 2| ≤ 21 := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        linarith [mul_le_mul he0_abs hM2_bd (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one]
      have h_comb_M : |e_n 1 * M₀ 1 + e_n 0 * M₀ 2| ≤ 42 := by
        linarith [abs_add_le (e_n 1 * M₀ 1) (e_n 0 * M₀ 2)]
      have h_frame_bd : |(x_P i 1 - a_B b₁ * x_P i 0) - A_mid| ≤ 84 * ρ_tilde := by
        rw [h_frame_id, abs_neg, abs_mul]
        calc |δ_inn| * |e_n 1 * M₀ 1 + e_n 0 * M₀ 2|
            ≤ (2 * ρ_tilde) * 42 :=
              mul_le_mul hδ_inn_bd h_comb_M (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = 84 * ρ_tilde := by ring

      
      have h_tot_split : (x_P i 1 - a_B b₁ * x_P i 0) - (c_z - shift) =
          ((x_P i 1 - a_B b₁ * x_P i 0) - A_mid) +
            (A_mid - (M₁_3 - shift)) + (M₁_3 - c_z) := by ring
      rw [h_tot_split]
      have ht_tot1 := abs_add_le
        (((x_P i 1 - a_B b₁ * x_P i 0) - A_mid) + (A_mid - (M₁_3 - shift)))
        (M₁_3 - c_z)
      have ht_tot2 := abs_add_le
        ((x_P i 1 - a_B b₁ * x_P i 0) - A_mid)
        (A_mid - (M₁_3 - shift))
      change |M₁_3 - c_z| ≤ ρ_tilde at hc_est
      linarith
    · refine ⟨∅, by simp [hM_cov_pos.le], fun i hG => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨_, _, hpi1⟩ := hG
      obtain ⟨hπo1_pos, _⟩ := hπt_supp i b₁ hpi1
      have h_le : π_orig i b₁ ≤ lam_orig b₁ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hπo_nn i' b₁) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le hπo1_pos h_le) hlam1

  
  have h_ball_2d' : ∀ (z_pt : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ_tilde ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i : Fin N_P,
        @ite ℝ (‖x_P i - z_pt‖ < r) (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ_sl i) 0) ≤
        ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) * r ^ (q - 1 + z) := by

      (∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
        @ite ℝ (|a_B b₁ - a₀| < r) (Classical.propDecidable _) (lam_tilde b₁) 0) ≤
        ρ_tilde ^ (-η₀) * r ^ s := by
    intro a₀ r hr₀ hr₁
    refine le_trans ?_ (h_slope_ball a₀ r hr₀ hr₁)

  have h_inc_mass' : ρ_tilde ^ η₀ ≤
      ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b₁ : Fin N_Θ,
        @ite ℝ (G_sl i b₁) (Classical.propDecidable _) (μ_sl i * lam_tilde b₁) 0 := by
    refine le_trans h_inc_mass (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)))
    exact h_ite_eq Finset.univ (fun b₁ => G_sl i b₁) (fun b₁ => G_sl i b₁)
      (fun b₁ => μ_sl i * lam_tilde b₁) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)

  exact h_wt_app ρ_tilde M_cov N_P N_Θ μ_sl x_P lam_tilde a_B G_sl
    hρt_pos hρt_lt_ρ₀ hM_cov_pos hμ_sl_nn hμ_sl_sum hx_P_dom h_ball_2d'
    hlam_t_nn hlam_t_sum ha_B_dom h_slope_ball' h_inc_mass' h_cov_all

informal_problem.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (N_ω : ℕ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) :
    (∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Z ∧
      ((∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ → X ω₁ = X ω₂ → Y ω₁ = Y ω₂) →
        finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤ finCondEntropy ε π Y Z) ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z ∧
      |finMutualInfo ε π X Z - finMutualInfo ε π X Y| ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π Y Z + finCondEntropy ε π Z Y) ∧
    (∀ {α β : Type} (A : Fin N_ω → α) (B : Fin N_ω → β)
      (E_bad : Finset (Fin N_ω)) (K_loc K_glob : ℕ),
      1 ≤ K_loc → 1 ≤ K_glob →
      (∃ S_glob : Finset β, S_glob.card ≤ K_glob ∧ ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → B ω ∈ S_glob) →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < π ω₀ → ω₀ ∉ E_bad →
        ∃ S_loc : Finset β, S_loc.card ≤ K_loc ∧
          ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → ω ∉ E_bad → A ω = A ω₀ → B ω ∈ S_loc) →
      finCondEntropy ε π A B ≤
        (Real.log 2 + Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) +
          (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω →
      let p_E := ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω
      let π_E := chartRowRestrictPi π E
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_E ω) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_E ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, π_E ω ≤ π ω / p_E) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_E ω → ω ∈ E ∧ 0 < π ω) ∧
      (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        finCondEntropy ε π_E X Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y / p_E))

    (∀ (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),

      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_E ω) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_ell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    rw [Real.log_inv, neg_pos]
    exact Real.log_neg hε₀ (by linarith)
  have h_ite_iff : ∀ {P Q : Prop} (dP : Decidable P) (dQ : Decidable Q) (a b : ℝ),
      (P ↔ Q) → @ite ℝ P dP a b = @ite ℝ Q dQ a b := by
    intro P Q dP dQ a b hPQ
    cases dP with
    | isTrue hP => cases dQ with
      | isTrue _ => rfl
      | isFalse hQ => exact absurd (hPQ.mp hP) hQ
    | isFalse hP => cases dQ with
      | isTrue hQ => exact absurd (hPQ.mpr hQ) hP
      | isFalse _ => rfl
  have h_div_mul_le : ∀ (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → (A / B) * B ≤ A := by
    intro A B hA
    by_cases hB : B = 0
    · rw [hB, mul_zero]; exact hA
    · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ A hB]
  have h_pos_nn : ∀ {α β : Type} (u : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ u ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < u ω →
        0 < finProbAt u X ω ∧
        0 < finProbAt2 u X Y ω ∧
        0 ≤ condSurprise ε u X Y ω) ∧
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε u X Y := by
    intro α β u X Y hu_nn
    have h_atom : ∀ ω, 0 < u ω →
        0 < finProbAt u X ω ∧
        0 < finProbAt2 u X Y ω ∧
        0 ≤ condSurprise ε u X Y ω := by
      intro ω hu_pos
      have h_le2 : u ω ≤ finProbAt2 u X Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        calc u ω = (if X ω = X ω ∧ Y ω = Y ω then u ω else 0) := by simp
          _ ≤ ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then u ω' else 0 :=
            Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then u ω' else 0)
              (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hu_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
              (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      have h2_le_1 : finProbAt2 u X Y ω ≤ finProbAt u X ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : X ω' = X ω
        · by_cases h2 : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h1, h2, hu_nn ω']
        · simp [h1]
      have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 u X Y ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hu_pos h_le2
      have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt u X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le h2_pos h2_le_1
      have h_surp_nn : 0 ≤ condSurprise ε u X Y ω := by
        unfold condSurprise
        have h_log_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 u X Y ω / finProbAt u X ω) ≤ 0 :=
          Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg h2_pos.le h1_pos.le) ((div_le_one h1_pos).mpr h2_le_1)
        exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr h_log_np) h_ell_pos.le
      exact ⟨h1_pos, h2_pos, h_surp_nn⟩
    refine ⟨h_atom, ?_⟩
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < u ω
    · exact mul_nonneg hpos.le (h_atom ω hpos).2.2
    · have hzero : u ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hu_nn ω)
      simp [hzero]
  have h_kl_helper : ∀ {α₁ α₂ γ_t : Type}
      (u v : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (X₁ : Fin N_ω → α₁) (f : α₁ → α₂) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ u ω) → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ v ω) → (∀ ω, 0 < u ω → 0 < v ω) →
      finCondEntropy ε u X₁ Z ≤
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, u ω * condSurprise ε v (fun ω' => f (X₁ ω')) Z ω := by
    intro α₁ α₂ γ_t u v X₁ f Z hu_nn hv_nn huv
    haveI : DecidableEq α₁ := Classical.decEq α₁
    haveI : DecidableEq α₂ := Classical.decEq α₂
    haveI : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
    let X₂ : Fin N_ω → α₂ := fun ω' => f (X₁ ω')
    let S_u : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < u ω)
    have hu_zero_off : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S_u → u ω = 0 := by
      intro ω hω
      simp only [S_u, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_lt] at hω
      exact le_antisymm hω (hu_nn ω)
    have h_sum_Su : ∀ g : Fin N_ω → ℝ, (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, u ω * g ω) = ∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * g ω := by
      intro g
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_u)
        (fun ω _ hω => by rw [hu_zero_off ω hω, zero_mul])).symm
    let u1 : α₁ → ℝ := fun x₁ => ∑ ω' ∈ S_u, if X₁ ω' = x₁ then u ω' else 0
    let u1Z : α₁ → γ_t → ℝ := fun x₁ z => ∑ ω' ∈ S_u, if X₁ ω' = x₁ ∧ Z ω' = z then u ω' else 0
    let v2 : α₂ → ℝ := fun x₂ => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₂ ω' = x₂ then v ω' else 0
    let v2Z : α₂ → γ_t → ℝ := fun x₂ z => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₂ ω' = x₂ ∧ Z ω' = z then v ω' else 0
    have h_u1_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt u X₁ ω = u1 (X₁ ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      have h1 : (letI := Classical.propDecidable; ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₁ ω' = X₁ ω then u ω' else 0) =
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₁ ω' = X₁ ω then u ω' else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Iff.rfl)
      rw [h1]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_u) (fun ω' _ hω' => by
        rw [hu_zero_off ω' hω', ite_self])).symm
    have h_u1Z_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 u X₁ Z ω = u1Z (X₁ ω) (Z ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      have h1 : (letI := Classical.propDecidable;
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω then u ω' else 0) =
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω then u ω' else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Iff.rfl)
      rw [h1]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_u) (fun ω' _ hω' => by
        rw [hu_zero_off ω' hω', ite_self])).symm
    have h_v2_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt v X₂ ω = v2 (X₂ ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Iff.rfl)
    have h_v2Z_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 v X₂ Z ω = v2Z (X₂ ω) (Z ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Iff.rfl)
    let R : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
      (v2Z (f (X₁ ω)) (Z ω) * u1 (X₁ ω)) / (v2 (f (X₁ ω)) * u1Z (X₁ ω) (Z ω))
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S_u,
        u ω * (condSurprise ε u X₁ Z ω - condSurprise ε v X₂ Z ω) ≤
          (Real.log (ε⁻¹))⁻¹ * (u ω * R ω - u ω) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hu_pos : 0 < u ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      have hv_pos : 0 < v ω := huv ω hu_pos
      obtain ⟨hu1_p, hu1Z_p, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn u X₁ Z hu_nn).1 ω hu_pos
      obtain ⟨hv2_p, hv2Z_p, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn v X₂ Z hv_nn).1 ω hv_pos
      rw [h_u1_eq ω] at hu1_p
      rw [h_u1Z_eq ω] at hu1Z_p
      rw [h_v2_eq ω] at hv2_p
      rw [h_v2Z_eq ω] at hv2Z_p
      have hR_pos : 0 < R ω :=
        div_pos (mul_pos hv2Z_p hu1_p) (mul_pos hv2_p hu1Z_p)
      have h_mul_id : (u1Z (X₁ ω) (Z ω) / u1 (X₁ ω)) * R ω =
          v2Z (f (X₁ ω)) (Z ω) / v2 (f (X₁ ω)) := by
        dsimp [R, X₂] at hv2_p hv2Z_p ⊢
        field_simp [hu1_p.ne', hu1Z_p.ne', hv2_p.ne']
      have h_log_id : Real.log (u1Z (X₁ ω) (Z ω) / u1 (X₁ ω)) + Real.log (R ω) =
          Real.log (v2Z (f (X₁ ω)) (Z ω) / v2 (f (X₁ ω))) := by
        rw [← Real.log_mul (div_pos hu1Z_p hu1_p).ne' hR_pos.ne', h_mul_id]
      have h_surp_diff : condSurprise ε u X₁ Z ω - condSurprise ε v X₂ Z ω =
          Real.log (R ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        unfold condSurprise
        rw [h_u1_eq ω, h_u1Z_eq ω, h_v2_eq ω, h_v2Z_eq ω]
        dsimp [X₂]
        rw [← sub_div]
        congr 1
        linarith [h_log_id]
      rw [h_surp_diff]
      have h_log_le : Real.log (R ω) ≤ R ω - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hR_pos
      have h_div_le : Real.log (R ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ (R ω - 1) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_log_le h_ell_pos.le
      calc u ω * (Real.log (R ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))
          ≤ u ω * ((R ω - 1) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div_le hu_pos.le
        _ = (Real.log (ε⁻¹))⁻¹ * (u ω * R ω - u ω) := by ring
    have h_sum_R : ∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * R ω ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω := by
      let A₁ : Finset α₁ := S_u.image X₁
      let A_Z : Finset γ_t := Finset.univ.image Z
      have hv2_pos_A1 : ∀ x₁ ∈ A₁, 0 < v2 (f x₁) := by
        intro x₁ hx₁
        obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx₁
        have hv0 : 0 < v ω₀ := huv ω₀ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀).2
        have h1 := ((h_pos_nn v X₂ Z hv_nn).1 ω₀ hv0).1
        rwa [h_v2_eq ω₀] at h1
      have h_expand : ∀ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * R ω =
          ∑ x₁ ∈ A₁, ∑ z ∈ A_Z,
            (((v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ z) *
              (if X₁ ω = x₁ ∧ Z ω = z then u ω else 0)) := by
        intro ω hω
        have hx₁_mem : X₁ ω ∈ A₁ := Finset.mem_image_of_mem X₁ hω
        have hz_mem : Z ω ∈ A_Z := Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z (Finset.mem_univ ω)
        have h_inner : ∀ x₁ : α₁,
            (∑ z ∈ A_Z,
              (((v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ z) *
                (if X₁ ω = x₁ ∧ Z ω = z then u ω else 0))) =
            if X₁ ω = x₁ then
              ((v2Z (f x₁) (Z ω) * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ (Z ω)) * u ω
            else 0 := by
          intro x₁
          by_cases hx : X₁ ω = x₁
          · have h_step1 : (∑ z ∈ A_Z,
                (((v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ z) *
                  (if X₁ ω = x₁ ∧ Z ω = z then u ω else 0))) =
                ∑ z ∈ A_Z, if Z ω = z then
                  ((v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ z) * u ω else 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
              by_cases hz : Z ω = z <;> simp [hx, hz]
            rw [h_step1, Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem A_Z (Z ω)
              (fun z => ((v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ z) * u ω) hz_mem, if_pos hx]
          · simp [hx]
        simp_rw [h_inner]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem A₁ (X₁ ω)
          (fun x₁ => ((v2Z (f x₁) (Z ω) * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ (Z ω)) * u ω) hx₁_mem]
        dsimp only [R]
        ring
      have h_v2Z_sum : ∀ x₂ : α₂, ∑ z ∈ A_Z, v2Z x₂ z = v2 x₂ := by
        intro x₂
        dsimp only [v2Z, v2]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        have hm : Z ω' ∈ A_Z := Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z (Finset.mem_univ ω')
        by_cases hx : X₂ ω' = x₂
        · simp only [hx, true_and]
          exact Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem A_Z (Z ω') (fun _ => v ω') hm
        · simp [hx]
      have h_u1_sum : ∑ x₁ ∈ A₁, u1 x₁ = ∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω := by
        dsimp only [u1]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        exact Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem A₁ (X₁ ω) (fun _ => u ω) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem X₁ hω)
      calc ∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * R ω
          = ∑ ω ∈ S_u, ∑ x₁ ∈ A₁, ∑ z ∈ A_Z,
              (((v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ z) *
                (if X₁ ω = x₁ ∧ Z ω = z then u ω else 0)) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl h_expand
        _ = ∑ x₁ ∈ A₁, ∑ z ∈ A_Z,
              (((v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) / u1Z x₁ z) * u1Z x₁ z) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x₁ _ => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ ≤ ∑ x₁ ∈ A₁, ∑ z ∈ A_Z, (v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x₁ hx₁ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z _ => ?_))
            refine h_div_mul_le _ _ (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg ?_ ?_) (hv2_pos_A1 x₁ hx₁).le)
            · exact Finset.sum_nonneg
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hv_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
            · exact Finset.sum_nonneg
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hu_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
        _ = ∑ x₁ ∈ A₁, u1 x₁ := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x₁ hx₁ => ?_)
            have h_pull : (∑ z ∈ A_Z, v2Z (f x₁) z * u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) =
                (u1 x₁ / v2 (f x₁)) * ∑ z ∈ A_Z, v2Z (f x₁) z := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => by ring)
            rw [h_pull, h_v2Z_sum (f x₁), div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hv2_pos_A1 x₁ hx₁).ne']
        _ = ∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω := h_u1_sum
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [h_sum_Su (condSurprise ε u X₁ Z), h_sum_Su (condSurprise ε v X₂ Z)]
    have h_diff_le : (∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * condSurprise ε u X₁ Z ω) -
        (∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * condSurprise ε v X₂ Z ω) ≤ 0 := by
      calc (∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * condSurprise ε u X₁ Z ω) -
            (∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * condSurprise ε v X₂ Z ω)
          = ∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * (condSurprise ε u X₁ Z ω - condSurprise ε v X₂ Z ω) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
        _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_u, (Real.log (ε⁻¹))⁻¹ * (u ω * R ω - u ω) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
        _ = (Real.log (ε⁻¹))⁻¹ * ((∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω * R ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S_u, u ω)) := by
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
            (inv_nonneg.mpr h_ell_pos.le) (sub_nonpos.mpr h_sum_R)
    linarith
  have h_cond_snd : ∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z ≤ finCondEntropy ε π Y Z := by
    intro α β γ_t X Y Z
    exact h_kl_helper π π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Prod.snd Z hπ_nn hπ_nn (fun _ h => h)

              (fun ω _ _ => Finset.mem_univ (I_bad ω))
        _ = ((∑ u ∈ S_pos.image U, ∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => U ω = u), π ω) *
              Real.log 2) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
        _ = Real.log 2 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
            rw [← h_pos_part U π, h_sum_Spos_one, one_mul]
    let c_p : α × Bool → ℝ := fun p =>
      if p.2 = true then Real.log (K_glob : ℝ) else Real.log (K_loc : ℝ)
    have h_Xai_per_p : ∀ p ∈ S_pos.image X_ai,
        (∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => X_ai ω = p), π ω * condSurprise ε π X_ai B ω) ≤
          ((∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => X_ai ω = p), π ω) * c_p p) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀_pos, hX₀⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      have hπω₀ : 0 < π ω₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_pos).2
      obtain ⟨hA₀, hI₀⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.mp hX₀
      cases h_flag : p.2 with
      | false =>
        have hI₀_f : decide (ω₀ ∈ E_bad) = false := by
          dsimp only [X_ai, I_bad] at hI₀
          exact hI₀.trans h_flag
        have hω₀_nb : ω₀ ∉ E_bad := decide_eq_false_iff_not.mp hI₀_f
        obtain ⟨S_loc, hSl_card, hSl_mem⟩ := h_loc ω₀ hπω₀ hω₀_nb
        have hc_eq : c_p p = Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) := by simp [c_p, h_flag]
        rw [hc_eq]
        refine h_fiber_cap X_ai B p S_loc K_loc hp hSl_card (fun ω hω_pos hXω => ?_)
        have hπω : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_pos).2
        obtain ⟨hAω, hIω⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.mp hXω
        have hIω_f : decide (ω ∈ E_bad) = false := by
          dsimp only [X_ai, I_bad] at hIω
          exact hIω.trans h_flag
        have hω_nb : ω ∉ E_bad := decide_eq_false_iff_not.mp hIω_f
        have hA_eq : A ω = A ω₀ := by
          dsimp only [X_ai] at hAω hA₀
          exact hAω.trans hA₀.symm
        exact hSl_mem ω hπω hω_nb hA_eq
      | true =>
        have hc_eq : c_p p = Real.log (K_glob : ℝ) := by simp [c_p, h_flag]
        rw [hc_eq]
        refine h_fiber_cap X_ai B p S_glob K_glob hp hSg_card (fun ω hω_pos _ => ?_)
        exact hSg_mem ω (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_pos).2
    have h_cp_reassemble :
        (∑ p ∈ S_pos.image X_ai, (∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => X_ai ω = p), π ω) * c_p p) =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * c_p (X_ai ω) := by
      have h1 : (∑ p ∈ S_pos.image X_ai,
          (∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => X_ai ω = p), π ω) * c_p p) =
          ∑ p ∈ S_pos.image X_ai, ∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => X_ai ω = p), π ω * c_p (X_ai ω) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2]
      rw [h1, ← h_pos_part X_ai (fun ω => π ω * c_p (X_ai ω)),
        ← h_sum_Spos_mul (fun ω => c_p (X_ai ω))]
    have h_log_loc_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hK_loc)
    have h_cp_ub : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * c_p (X_ai ω) ≤
        Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) + (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ) := by
      have h_pt_cp : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * c_p (X_ai ω) ≤
          π ω * Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) +
            (if ω ∈ E_bad then π ω else 0) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ) := by
        intro ω
        by_cases hω : ω ∈ E_bad
        · have hd : I_bad ω = true := decide_eq_true hω
          simp only [c_p, X_ai, hd, hω, ↓reduceIte]
          linarith [mul_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) h_log_loc_nn]
        · have hd : I_bad ω = false := decide_eq_false hω
          simp [c_p, X_ai, hd, hω]
      calc ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * c_p (X_ai ω)
          ≤ ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, (π ω * Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) +
              (if ω ∈ E_bad then π ω else 0) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => h_pt_cp ω)
        _ = (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω) * Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) +
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if ω ∈ E_bad then π ω else 0) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) + (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ) := by
            rw [hπ_sum, one_mul, Finset.sum_ite_mem Finset.univ E_bad π, Finset.univ_inter]
    have h_Xai_ub : finCondEntropy ε π X_ai B ≤
        (Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) + (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      unfold finCondEntropy
      rw [h_sum_Spos_mul (condSurprise ε π X_ai B),
        h_pos_part X_ai (fun ω => π ω * condSurprise ε π X_ai B ω)]
      calc (∑ p ∈ S_pos.image X_ai, ∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => X_ai ω = p),

          ≤ ∑ p ∈ S_pos.image X_ai,
              ((∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => X_ai ω = p), π ω) * c_p p) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_Xai_per_p
        _ = (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * c_p (X_ai ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_div, h_cp_reassemble]
        _ ≤ (Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) + (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ)) /
              Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_cp_ub h_ell_pos.le
    calc finCondEntropy ε π A B
        ≤ finCondEntropy ε π U I_bad + finCondEntropy ε π X_ai B := h_split
      _ ≤ Real.log 2 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) +
            (Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) + (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ)) /
              Real.log (ε⁻¹) := add_le_add h_Ibad_ub h_Xai_ub
      _ = (Real.log 2 + Real.log (K_loc : ℝ) +
            (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω) * Real.log (K_glob : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
          ring
  have h_part3 : ∀ (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω →
      let p_E := ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω
      let π_E := chartRowRestrictPi π E
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_E ω) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_E ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, π_E ω ≤ π ω / p_E) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_E ω → ω ∈ E ∧ 0 < π ω) ∧
      (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        finCondEntropy ε π_E X Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y / p_E) := by
    intro E hp_E
    let p_E := ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω
    let π_E := chartRowRestrictPi π E
    change (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_E ω) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_E ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, π_E ω ≤ π ω / p_E) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_E ω → ω ∈ E ∧ 0 < π ω) ∧
      (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        finCondEntropy ε π_E X Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y / p_E)
    have h_apply : ∀ ω, π_E ω = if ω ∈ E then π ω / p_E else 0 := fun ω => rfl
    have hπE_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_E ω := by
      intro ω
      rw [h_apply ω]
      by_cases hω : ω ∈ E
      · rw [if_pos hω]
        exact div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) hp_E.le
      · rw [if_neg hω]
    have hπE_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_E ω = 1 := by
      calc ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_E ω
          = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if ω ∈ E then π ω / p_E else 0 := rfl
        _ = ∑ ω ∈ E, π ω / p_E := by
            rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem Finset.univ E (fun ω => π ω / p_E), Finset.univ_inter]
        _ = p_E / p_E := (Finset.sum_div E π p_E).symm
        _ = 1 := div_self hp_E.ne'
    have hπE_le : ∀ ω, π_E ω ≤ π ω / p_E := by
      intro ω
      rw [h_apply ω]
      by_cases hω : ω ∈ E
      · rw [if_pos hω]
      · rw [if_neg hω]
        exact div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) hp_E.le
    have hπE_supp : ∀ ω, 0 < π_E ω → ω ∈ E ∧ 0 < π ω := by
      intro ω hpos
      rw [h_apply ω] at hpos
      by_cases hω : ω ∈ E
      · rw [if_pos hω] at hpos
        have h_mul := mul_pos hpos hp_E
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp_E.ne'] at h_mul
        exact ⟨hω, h_mul⟩
      · rw [if_neg hω] at hpos
        exact absurd hpos (lt_irrefl 0)
    have hπE_ent : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        finCondEntropy ε π_E X Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y / p_E := by
      intro α β X Y
      have h_kl := h_kl_helper π_E π X id Y hπE_nn hπ_nn (fun ω hω => (hπE_supp ω hω).2)
      refine le_trans h_kl ?_
      calc ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_E ω * condSurprise ε π X Y ω
          ≤ ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, (π ω * condSurprise ε π X Y ω) / p_E := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
            by_cases hπω : 0 < π ω
            · have h_cs_nn := ((h_pos_nn π X Y hπ_nn).1 ω hπω).2.2
              calc π_E ω * condSurprise ε π X Y ω
                  ≤ (π ω / p_E) * condSurprise ε π X Y ω :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hπE_le ω) h_cs_nn
                _ = (π ω * condSurprise ε π X Y ω) / p_E := div_mul_eq_mul_div _ _ _
            · have hπ0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hπω) (hπ_nn ω)
              have hπE0 : π_E ω = 0 := by
                have hle := hπE_le ω
                rw [hπ0, zero_div] at hle
                exact le_antisymm hle (hπE_nn ω)
              rw [hπ0, hπE0, zero_mul, zero_div]
        _ = finCondEntropy ε π X Y / p_E := (Finset.sum_div _ _ p_E).symm
    exact ⟨hπE_nn, hπE_sum, hπE_le, hπE_supp, hπE_ent⟩
  exact ⟨fun X Y Z => ⟨(h_pos_nn π X Z hπ_nn).2, h_data_proc X Y Z, h_subadd X Y Z, h_mi_diff X Y Z⟩,
    h_part2, h_part3⟩

              ring
            have h_HTZ : finCondEntropy ε π T_idx Z =
                (∑ tid : Fin N_T,
                  (-(p_TZ_t tid * Real.log (p_TZ_t tid / p_T tid)) -
                    p_TZ_f tid * Real.log (p_TZ_f tid / p_T tid))) / ell := by
              have h_num : (∑ tid : Fin N_T,
                  (-(p_TZ_t tid * Real.log (p_TZ_t tid / p_T tid)) -
                    p_TZ_f tid * Real.log (p_TZ_f tid / p_T tid))) =
                  ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
                    -(π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx Z ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) := by
                have h_step : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
                    -(p_TZ_t tid * Real.log (p_TZ_t tid / p_T tid)) -
                      p_TZ_f tid * Real.log (p_TZ_f tid / p_T tid) =
                    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then
                      -(π ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx Z ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω))
                    else 0 := by
                  intro tid
                  have hexp_t : p_TZ_t tid * Real.log (p_TZ_t tid / p_T tid) =
                      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = true then π ω else 0) *
                        Real.log (p_TZ_t tid / p_T tid) := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
                  have hexp_f : p_TZ_f tid * Real.log (p_TZ_f tid / p_T tid) =
                      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = false then π ω else 0) *
                        Real.log (p_TZ_f tid / p_T tid) := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
                  rw [hexp_t, hexp_f, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sub_eq_add_neg,
                    ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
                  by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid
                  · have hp1 : finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T tid := by
                      unfold finProbAt
                      dsimp only [p_T]
                      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
                      rw [ht]
                      split_ifs <;> tauto
                    cases hZ : Z ω
                    · have hp2 : finProbAt2 π T_idx Z ω = p_TZ_f tid := by
                        unfold finProbAt2
                        dsimp only [p_TZ_f]
                        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
                        rw [ht, hZ]
                        split_ifs <;> tauto
                      rw [hp1, hp2]
                      simp [ht]
                    · have hp2 : finProbAt2 π T_idx Z ω = p_TZ_t tid := by
                        unfold finProbAt2
                        dsimp only [p_TZ_t]
                        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
                        rw [ht, hZ]
                        split_ifs <;> tauto
                      rw [hp1, hp2]
                      simp [ht]
                  · simp [ht]
                simp_rw [h_step]
                rw [Finset.sum_comm]
                simp
              rw [h_num, Finset.sum_div]
              unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
              dsimp only [ell]
              ring
            unfold finMutualInfo
            rw [h_HUZ, h_HTZ, ← sub_div]
            congr 1
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
            have h1mp_pos : 0 < 1 - p_E := by linarith
            have hpTZt_nn : 0 ≤ p_TZ_t tid :=
              Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
            have hpTZf_nn : 0 ≤ p_TZ_f tid :=
              Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
            have h_part_t :
                p_TZ_t tid * Real.log (p_TZ_t tid / (p_T tid * p_E)) =
                -(p_TZ_t tid * Real.log p_E) +
                  p_TZ_t tid * Real.log (p_TZ_t tid / p_T tid) := by
              by_cases ht0 : p_TZ_t tid = 0
              · simp [ht0]
              · have ht_pos : 0 < p_TZ_t tid := lt_of_le_of_ne hpTZt_nn (Ne.symm ht0)
                have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
                  rw [← hp_TZ_sum tid]
                  linarith
                rw [← div_div, Real.log_div (div_ne_zero ht_pos.ne' hpT_pos.ne') hp_pos.ne']
                ring
            have h_part_f :
                p_TZ_f tid * Real.log (p_TZ_f tid / (p_T tid * (1 - p_E))) =
                -(p_TZ_f tid * Real.log (1 - p_E)) +
                  p_TZ_f tid * Real.log (p_TZ_f tid / p_T tid) := by
              by_cases hf0 : p_TZ_f tid = 0
              · simp [hf0]
              · have hf_pos : 0 < p_TZ_f tid := lt_of_le_of_ne hpTZf_nn (Ne.symm hf0)
                have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
                  rw [← hp_TZ_sum tid]
                  linarith
                rw [← div_div, Real.log_div (div_ne_zero hf_pos.ne' hpT_pos.ne') h1mp_pos.ne']
                ring
            linarith
          have h_ITD_glue :
              (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₂),
                q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell =
              p_E * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d₁ : Fin N₁,
                  q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_T₁ tid * q₁_D d₁))) / ell) +
                (1 - p_E) * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d₂ : Fin N₂,
                  q₂ tid d₂ * Real.log (q₂ tid d₂ / (p_T₂ tid * q₂_D d₂))) / ell) +
                finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z := by
            have h_row_split : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
                (∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₂), q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) =
                p_E * (∑ d₁ : Fin N₁,
                    q₁ tid d₁ * Real.log (q₁ tid d₁ / (p_T₁ tid * q₁_D d₁))) +
                  (1 - p_E) * (∑ d₂ : Fin N₂,
                    q₂ tid d₂ * Real.log (q₂ tid d₂ / (p_T₂ tid * q₂_D d₂))) +
                  (p_TZ_t tid * Real.log (p_TZ_t tid / (p_T tid * p_E)) +
                    p_TZ_f tid * Real.log (p_TZ_f tid / (p_T tid * (1 - p_E)))) := by
              intro tid
              rw [← e_sum.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
              simp only [hqD_inl, hqD_inr, q, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
              have h1 := h_inl_itd tid
              have h2 := h_inr_itd tid
              linarith
            simp_rw [h_row_split]
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
              ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
              add_div, add_div, mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc, h_mi_TZ]
          change p_E * s₁ + (1 - p_E) * s₂ - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z =
            (∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₂), q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) -
              (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N₁ + N₂),
                q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
          dsimp only at hs₁_eq hs₂_eq
          rw [hs₁_eq, hs₂_eq, h_Ew_glue, h_ITD_glue]
          ring
      
      obtain ⟨h_ne_E, _⟩ := h_root_ne_bdd π_E hπE_nn hπE_sum
      obtain ⟨h_ne_Ec, _⟩ := h_root_ne_bdd π_Ec hπEc_nn hπEc_sum
      obtain ⟨_, h_bdd_π⟩ := h_root_ne_bdd π hπ_nn hπ_sum
      have h_rt_split :
          p_E * classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π_E T_idx V_part A_part +
            (1 - p_E) * classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π_Ec T_idx V_part A_part ≤
          classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
            finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z := by
        have h1mp_pos : 0 < 1 - p_E := by linarith
        change p_E * sSup (S_root_of π_E) + (1 - p_E) * sSup (S_root_of π_Ec) ≤
          sSup (S_root_of π) + finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z
        have h_s2_step : ∀ s₂ ∈ S_root_of π_Ec,
            p_E * sSup (S_root_of π_E) + (1 - p_E) * s₂ ≤
              sSup (S_root_of π) + finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z := by
          intro s₂ hs₂
          have h_sup1 : sSup (S_root_of π_E) ≤
              (sSup (S_root_of π) + finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z - (1 - p_E) * s₂) / p_E := by
            refine csSup_le h_ne_E (fun s₁ hs₁ => ?_)
            rw [le_div_iff₀ hp_pos, mul_comm]
            have h_le := le_csSup h_bdd_π (h_glue_mem s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂)
            linarith
          have h_mul1 := (le_div_iff₀ hp_pos).mp h_sup1
          linarith
        have h_sup2 : sSup (S_root_of π_Ec) ≤
            (sSup (S_root_of π) + finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z -
              p_E * sSup (S_root_of π_E)) / (1 - p_E) := by
          refine csSup_le h_ne_Ec (fun s₂ hs₂ => ?_)
          rw [le_div_iff₀ h1mp_pos, mul_comm]
          have h_le := h_s2_step s₂ hs₂
          linarith
        have h_mul2 := (le_div_iff₀ h1mp_pos).mp h_sup2
        linarith
      
      have h_Δ_conv : p_E * Δ π_E + (1 - p_E) * Δ π_Ec ≤ Δ π + 3 * Real.log 2 / ell := by
        dsimp only [Δ]
        linarith [h_sc_split, h_rt_split]
      have h_Δ_abs : Δ π ≤ |Δ π| := le_abs_self (Δ π)
      have h_shift_half : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Δ π_E + η_lb) ≤ p_E * (Δ π_E + η_lb) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp_half (by linarith [hΔ_E_lb])
      have h_shift_Ec_nn : 0 ≤ (1 - p_E) * (Δ π_Ec + η_lb) :=
        mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith [hΔ_Ec_lb])
      have h_shift_id :
          p_E * (Δ π_E + η_lb) + (1 - p_E) * (Δ π_Ec + η_lb) =
            (p_E * Δ π_E + (1 - p_E) * Δ π_Ec) + η_lb := by ring
      have h_log_nn : 0 ≤ 6 * Real.log 2 / ell := div_nonneg (by linarith) hell_pos.le
      have h_6log2 : 2 * (3 * Real.log 2 / ell) = 6 * Real.log 2 / ell := by ring
      refine abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · linarith [hΔ_E_lb, abs_nonneg (Δ π), h_log_nn, hη_lb]
      · linarith [h_Δ_conv, h_Δ_abs, h_shift_half, h_shift_Ec_nn, h_shift_id, h_6log2, hη_lb]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (path : CoherentSaturatedPath γ m)
    (h_exact_e : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, path.a_path u - path.b_path u = m * u)
    (b : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hb_eq : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, b u = path.b_path u)
    (hb_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ → 0 ≤ b u₁ - b u₂ ∧ b u₁ - b u₂ ≤ (1 + m) * (u₂ - u₁))
    (u d : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hu_dyad : IsPosDyadicUnit u)
    (hd_pos : 0 < d) (hd_lt : d < m * u) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let ε := path.ε_seq n
        let M_bin : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
        ∑ ω : Fin (path.N_ω n),
          if (N : ℤ) < cyclicBinDist M_bin
            (angBin ε d (path.θ_time u n ω)) (angBin ε d (path.θ_time 1 n ω))
          then path.π_seq n ω else 0)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
