proof.tactics:
by
  have h_cyc_att : ∀ (M k₁ k₂ : ℤ), 0 ≤ k₁ → k₁ < M → 0 ≤ k₂ → k₂ < M →
      ∃ s : ℤ, |k₁ - k₂ + s * M| = cyclicBinDist M k₁ k₂ := by
    intro M k₁ k₂ hk₁0 hk₁M hk₂0 hk₂M
    unfold cyclicBinDist
    by_cases h_min : |k₁ - k₂| ≤ M - |k₁ - k₂|
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [min_eq_left h_min]
      simp
    · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h_min)]
      by_cases h_ord : k₂ ≤ k₁
      · refine ⟨-1, ?_⟩
        rw [abs_of_neg (by omega), abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]
        ring
      · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
        rw [abs_of_pos (by omega), abs_of_neg (by omega)]
        ring
  have h_cyc_lb : ∀ (M k₁ k₂ s : ℤ), 0 ≤ k₁ → k₁ < M → 0 ≤ k₂ → k₂ < M →
      cyclicBinDist M k₁ k₂ ≤ |k₁ - k₂ + s * M| := by
    intro M k₁ k₂ s hk₁0 hk₁M hk₂0 hk₂M
    unfold cyclicBinDist
    have h_abs_bd : |k₁ - k₂| ≤ M - 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    have h_cases : s = 0 ∨ s = 1 ∨ s = -1 ∨ 2 ≤ s ∨ s ≤ -2 := by omega
    rcases h_cases with rfl | rfl | rfl | hs2 | hsm2
    · simp
    · have habs : |k₁ - k₂ + 1 * M| = k₁ - k₂ + 1 * M := abs_of_nonneg (by omega)
      rw [habs]
      have h1 := min_le_right |k₁ - k₂| (M - |k₁ - k₂|)
      have h2 := neg_le_abs (k₁ - k₂)
      omega
    · have habs : |k₁ - k₂ + (-1) * M| = -(k₁ - k₂ + (-1) * M) := abs_of_nonpos (by omega)
      rw [habs]
      have h1 := min_le_right |k₁ - k₂| (M - |k₁ - k₂|)
      have h2 := le_abs_self (k₁ - k₂)
      omega
    · have hsm : 2 * M ≤ s * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs2 (by omega : (0 : ℤ) ≤ M)
      calc min |k₁ - k₂| (M - |k₁ - k₂|)
          ≤ |k₁ - k₂| := min_le_left _ _
        _ ≤ M - 1 := h_abs_bd
        _ ≤ k₁ - k₂ + 2 * M := by omega
        _ ≤ k₁ - k₂ + s * M := add_le_add_right hsm (k₁ - k₂)
        _ ≤ |k₁ - k₂ + s * M| := le_abs_self _
    · have hsm : s * M ≤ (-2) * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsm2 (by omega : (0 : ℤ) ≤ M)
      calc min |k₁ - k₂| (M - |k₁ - k₂|)
          ≤ |k₁ - k₂| := min_le_left _ _
        _ ≤ M - 1 := h_abs_bd
        _ ≤ -(k₁ - k₂ + (-2) * M) := by omega
        _ ≤ -(k₁ - k₂ + s * M) := neg_le_neg (add_le_add_right hsm (k₁ - k₂))
        _ ≤ |k₁ - k₂ + s * M| := neg_le_abs _
  have h_cyc_tri : ∀ (M k₁ k₂ k₃ : ℤ),
      0 ≤ k₁ → k₁ < M → 0 ≤ k₂ → k₂ < M → 0 ≤ k₃ → k₃ < M →
      cyclicBinDist M k₁ k₃ ≤ cyclicBinDist M k₁ k₂ + cyclicBinDist M k₂ k₃ := by
    intro M k₁ k₂ k₃ hk₁0 hk₁M hk₂0 hk₂M hk₃0 hk₃M
    obtain ⟨s₁₂, hs₁₂⟩ := h_cyc_att M k₁ k₂ hk₁0 hk₁M hk₂0 hk₂M
    obtain ⟨s₂₃, hs₂₃⟩ := h_cyc_att M k₂ k₃ hk₂0 hk₂M hk₃0 hk₃M
    have h_id : k₁ - k₃ + (s₁₂ + s₂₃) * M =
        (k₁ - k₂ + s₁₂ * M) + (k₂ - k₃ + s₂₃ * M) := by ring
    calc cyclicBinDist M k₁ k₃
        ≤ |k₁ - k₃ + (s₁₂ + s₂₃) * M| :=
          h_cyc_lb M k₁ k₃ (s₁₂ + s₂₃) hk₁0 hk₁M hk₃0 hk₃M
      _ = |(k₁ - k₂ + s₁₂ * M) + (k₂ - k₃ + s₂₃ * M)| := by rw [h_id]
      _ ≤ |k₁ - k₂ + s₁₂ * M| + |k₂ - k₃ + s₂₃ * M| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = cyclicBinDist M k₁ k₂ + cyclicBinDist M k₂ k₃ := by rw [hs₁₂, hs₂₃]
  have h_cyc_sum : ∀ (M : ℤ) (m_ind : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℤ),
      1 ≤ M → (∀ j ≤ m_ind, 0 ≤ x j ∧ x j < M) →
      cyclicBinDist M (x 0) (x m_ind) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m_ind, cyclicBinDist M (x i) (x (i + 1)) := by
    intro M m_ind x _
    induction m_ind with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      simp only [cyclicBinDist, sub_self, abs_zero, sub_zero, Finset.sum_range_zero]
      exact min_le_left 0 M
    | succ m_ind ih =>
      intro hx_bds
      have h0 := hx_bds 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      have hm_b := hx_bds m_ind (Nat.le_succ m_ind)
      have hm1_b := hx_bds (m_ind + 1) (le_refl _)
      have h_ih := ih (fun j hj => hx_bds j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hj))
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      exact le_trans (h_cyc_tri M (x 0) (x m_ind) (x (m_ind + 1))
        h0.1 h0.2 hm_b.1 hm_b.2 hm1_b.1 hm1_b.2) (add_le_add_left h_ih _)
  have h_cyc_chain : ∀ (M : ℤ) (L : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℤ),
      1 ≤ M → (∀ j ≤ L, 0 ≤ x j ∧ x j < M) →
      (L : ℤ) < cyclicBinDist M (x 0) (x L) →
      ∃ i : Fin L, 1 < cyclicBinDist M (x i.1) (x (i.1 + 1)) := by
    intro M L x hM_ge1 hx_bds h_gt
    by_contra h_none
    have h_all : ∀ i : Fin L, cyclicBinDist M (x i.1) (x (i.1 + 1)) ≤ 1 :=
      fun i => le_of_not_gt (fun hi => h_none ⟨i, hi⟩)
    have h_sum := h_cyc_sum M L x hM_ge1 hx_bds
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => cyclicBinDist M (x i) (x (i + 1))) L] at h_sum
    have h_ub : ∑ i : Fin L, cyclicBinDist M (x i.1) (x (i.1 + 1)) ≤ (L : ℤ) := by
      calc ∑ i : Fin L, cyclicBinDist M (x i.1) (x (i.1 + 1))
          ≤ ∑ _i : Fin L, (1 : ℤ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_all i)
        _ = (L : ℤ) := by simp
    omega
  have h_ang_range : ∀ (ε θ : ℝ), 0 ≤ θ →
      0 ≤ angBin ε d θ ∧ angBin ε d θ < (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d) := by
    intro ε θ hθ
    dsimp only [angBin]
    set m_lvl := dyadicTimeLevel ε d
    have hM_ge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m_lvl := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have h_arg_nn : 0 ≤ (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_lvl :=
      mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hθ Real.pi_pos.le) (by positivity)
    have h_fl_nn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_lvl⌋ :=
      Int.floor_nonneg.mpr h_arg_nn
    exact ⟨le_min h_fl_nn (by omega), lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by omega)⟩
  obtain ⟨k₀, j₀, hj₀_ge1, _, hu_eq⟩ := hu_dyad
  have hj₀_lt_real : (j₀ : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := by
    have h_lt1 : (j₀ : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ < 1 := by rw [← hu_eq]; exact hu.2
    exact (div_lt_one (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀)).mp h_lt1
  have hj₀_lt : j₀ < 2 ^ k₀ := by exact_mod_cast hj₀_lt_real
  let gap : ℝ := m * u - d
  have hgap_pos : 0 < gap := sub_pos.mpr hd_lt
  let B_mesh : ℝ := path.K_coh * (3 + 2 * m) / gap
  let k₁ : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 (⌈B_mesh⌉₊ + 1)
  let k : ℕ := max k₀ k₁
  have hk₀_le : k₀ ≤ k := le_max_left k₀ k₁
  have hk₁_le : k₁ ≤ k := le_max_right k₀ k₁
  have hB_lt_pow : B_mesh < (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    have h1 : B_mesh ≤ (⌈B_mesh⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil B_mesh
    have h2_nat : ⌈B_mesh⌉₊ + 1 ≤ 2 ^ k :=
      le_trans (Nat.le_pow_clog (by norm_num : 1 < 2) (⌈B_mesh⌉₊ + 1))
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hk₁_le)
    have h2 : ((⌈B_mesh⌉₊ : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by exact_mod_cast h2_nat
    linarith
  have h_mesh_small : path.K_coh * (3 + 2 * m) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k < m * u - d := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k)]
    have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hgap_pos).mp hB_lt_pow
    rw [mul_comm ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) gap] at h
    exact h
  let j_start : ℕ := j₀ * 2 ^ (k - k₀)
  have hj_start_ge1 : 1 ≤ j_start :=
    Nat.mul_pos (by omega : 0 < j₀) (by positivity : 0 < 2 ^ (k - k₀))
  have hj_start_lt : j_start < 2 ^ k := by
    calc j₀ * 2 ^ (k - k₀)
        < 2 ^ k₀ * 2 ^ (k - k₀) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hj₀_lt (by positivity)
      _ = 2 ^ (k₀ + (k - k₀)) := (Nat.pow_add 2 k₀ (k - k₀)).symm
      _ = 2 ^ k := by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hk₀_le]
  let N : ℕ := 2 ^ k - j_start
  have hN_ge1 : 1 ≤ N := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hj_start_lt
  have hjN : j_start + N = 2 ^ k := Nat.add_sub_of_le hj_start_lt.le
  let u_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ((j_start + j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k
  have hu_fn_zero : u_fn 0 = u := by
    dsimp only [u_fn, j_start]
    rw [Nat.add_zero]
    push_cast
    have hk_split : (2 : ℝ) ^ k = (2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k - k₀) := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hk₀_le]
    rw [hk_split, mul_div_mul_right (j₀ : ℝ) ((2 : ℝ) ^ k₀) (by positivity)]
    exact hu_eq.symm
  have hu_fn_N : u_fn N = 1 := by
    dsimp only [u_fn]
    rw [hjN]
    push_cast
    exact div_self (by positivity)
  have hu_fn_dyad : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → IsPosDyadicUnit (u_fn j) := by
    intro j hj
    exact ⟨k, j_start + j, by omega, by omega, rfl⟩
  have hu_le_fn : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → u ≤ u_fn j := by
    intro j _
    rw [← hu_fn_zero]
    dsimp only [u_fn]
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right j_start j
  have hfn_le_one : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → u_fn j ≤ 1 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [← hu_fn_N]
    dsimp only [u_fn]
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
    exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_left hj j_start
  have hfn_ioc : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ N → u_fn j ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro j hj
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hu.1 (hu_le_fn j hj), hfn_le_one j hj⟩
  let B_link : Fin N → ℕ → ℝ := fun i n =>
    let ε := path.ε_seq n
    let M_bin : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
    ∑ ω : Fin (path.N_ω n),
      if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_bin
        (angBin ε d (path.θ_time (u_fn i.1) n ω))
        (angBin ε d (path.θ_time (u_fn (i.1 + 1)) n ω))
      then path.π_seq n ω else 0
  have h_link_lim : ∀ i : Fin N, Filter.Tendsto (B_link i) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro i
    let r : ℝ := u_fn i.1
    let t : ℝ := u_fn (i.1 + 1)
    have hi_le : i.1 ≤ N := Nat.le_of_lt i.2
    have hi1_le : i.1 + 1 ≤ N := i.2
    have hr_dyad : IsPosDyadicUnit r := hu_fn_dyad i.1 hi_le
    have ht_dyad : IsPosDyadicUnit t := hu_fn_dyad (i.1 + 1) hi1_le
    have hr_ioc : r ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := hfn_ioc i.1 hi_le
    have ht_ioc : t ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := hfn_ioc (i.1 + 1) hi1_le
    have hu_le_r : u ≤ r := hu_le_fn i.1 hi_le
    have htr_eq : t - r = 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      dsimp only [r, t, u_fn]
      push_cast
      ring
    have htr_pos : 0 < t - r := by
      rw [htr_eq]
      positivity
    have hrt : r < t := sub_pos.mp htr_pos
    have her : path.a_path r - path.b_path r = m * r := h_exact_e r hr_ioc
    have het : path.a_path t - path.b_path t = m * t := h_exact_e t ht_ioc
    have h_min_lb : m * u ≤ min (path.a_path r - path.b_path r) (path.a_path t - path.b_path t) := by
      rw [her, het]
      exact le_min (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_le_r hm.le)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hu_le_r hrt.le) hm.le)
    have hbr : path.b_path r = b r := (hb_eq r hr_ioc).symm
    have hbt : path.b_path t = b t := (hb_eq t ht_ioc).symm
    obtain ⟨hb_nonneg, hb_ub⟩ := hb_lip r t hrt.le
    have hb_abs : |path.b_path r - path.b_path t| ≤ (1 + m) * (t - r) := by
      rw [hbr, hbt, abs_of_nonneg hb_nonneg]
      exact hb_ub
    have hm_dist : m * (t - r) = m * t - m * r := by ring
    have ha_diff : path.a_path r - path.a_path t = (b r - b t) - m * (t - r) := by
      linarith [her, het, hbr, hbt, hm_dist]
    have hm_tr_pos : 0 < m * (t - r) := mul_pos hm htr_pos
    have h_expand : (1 + m) * (t - r) = (t - r) + m * (t - r) := by ring
    have ha_abs : |path.a_path r - path.a_path t| ≤ (1 + m) * (t - r) := by
      rw [ha_diff]
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hb_nonneg, htr_pos, h_expand], by linarith [hb_ub, hm_tr_pos]⟩
    have h_sum_lip : |path.b_path r - path.b_path t| + |path.a_path r - path.a_path t| + (t - r) ≤
        (3 + 2 * m) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      calc |path.b_path r - path.b_path t| + |path.a_path r - path.a_path t| + (t - r)
          ≤ (1 + m) * (t - r) + (1 + m) * (t - r) + (t - r) := by linarith [hb_abs, ha_abs]
        _ = (3 + 2 * m) * (t - r) := by ring
        _ = (3 + 2 * m) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by rw [htr_eq]; ring
    have h_pen : path.K_coh *
        (|path.b_path r - path.b_path t| + |path.a_path r - path.a_path t| + (t - r)) <
        m * u - d := by
      calc path.K_coh *
            (|path.b_path r - path.b_path t| + |path.a_path r - path.a_path t| + (t - r))
          ≤ path.K_coh * ((3 + 2 * m) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_lip path.hK_coh.le
        _ = path.K_coh * (3 + 2 * m) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by ring
        _ < m * u - d := h_mesh_small
    exact path.h_dyad_coh r t d hr_dyad ht_dyad hrt hd_pos (by linarith [h_min_lb, h_pen])
  let B_tot : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let ε := path.ε_seq n
    let M_bin : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
    ∑ ω : Fin (path.N_ω n),
      if (N : ℤ) < cyclicBinDist M_bin
        (angBin ε d (path.θ_time u n ω)) (angBin ε d (path.θ_time 1 n ω))
      then path.π_seq n ω else 0
  have h_tot_nn : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ B_tot n := by
    intro n
    dsimp only [B_tot]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
    split_ifs
    · exact (path.h_law n).1 ω
    · exact le_rfl
  have h_tot_ub : ∀ n : ℕ, B_tot n ≤ ∑ i : Fin N, B_link i n := by
    intro n
    dsimp only [B_tot, B_link]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
    let ε := path.ε_seq n
    let M_bin : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
    have hM_ge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ M_bin := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hπ_nn : 0 ≤ path.π_seq n ω := (path.h_law n).1 ω
    by_cases hπ_pos : 0 < path.π_seq n ω
    · split_ifs with h_gt
      · let x : ℕ → ℤ := fun j => angBin ε d (path.θ_time (u_fn j) n ω)
        have hx0 : x 0 = angBin ε d (path.θ_time u n ω) := by
          dsimp only [x]
          rw [hu_fn_zero]
        have hxN : x N = angBin ε d (path.θ_time 1 n ω) := by
          dsimp only [x]
          rw [hu_fn_N]
        have hx_bds : ∀ j ≤ N, 0 ≤ x j ∧ x j < M_bin := by
          intro j hj
          have hθ_mem := (path.h_law n).2.2.2.2 (u_fn j) (hu_fn_dyad j hj) ω hπ_pos
          exact h_ang_range ε (path.θ_time (u_fn j) n ω) hθ_mem.1
        have h_gt_x : (N : ℤ) < cyclicBinDist M_bin (x 0) (x N) := by
          rwa [hx0, hxN]
        obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := h_cyc_chain M_bin N x hM_ge1 hx_bds h_gt_x
        have h_term_nn : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)),
            (0 : ℝ) ≤ (if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_bin
              (angBin ε d (path.θ_time (u_fn i.1) n ω))
              (angBin ε d (path.θ_time (u_fn (i.1 + 1)) n ω))
            then path.π_seq n ω else 0) := by
          intro i _
          split_ifs
          · exact hπ_nn
          · exact le_rfl
        have h_single := Finset.single_le_sum h_term_nn (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
        dsimp only [x] at hi₀
        simp only [hi₀, ↓reduceIte] at h_single
        exact h_single
      · refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => ?_)
        split_ifs
        · exact hπ_nn
        · exact le_rfl
    · have hπ0 : path.π_seq n ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hπ_pos) hπ_nn
      simp only [hπ0, ite_self, Finset.sum_const_zero, le_rfl]
  have h_sum_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i : Fin N, B_link i n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_finsetSum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)) (fun i _ => h_link_lim i)
    rwa [Finset.sum_const_zero] at h
  have h_tot_lim : Filter.Tendsto B_tot Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    squeeze_zero h_tot_nn h_tot_ub h_sum_lim
  exact ⟨N, hN_ge1, h_tot_lim⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (useChart0 : Bool) (θ : ℝ),
      IsOnSelectedChart useChart0 θ → |chartRowSlope useChart0 θ| ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (m : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < m →
      ∃ (C_glob C_loc : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_glob ∧ 1 ≤ C_loc ∧
        ∀ (ε u b_u ν : ℝ) (useChart0 : Bool),
          0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
          u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
          0 ≤ b_u → b_u + (1 + m) * u ≤ 1 + m →
          0 < ν → ν < m * u / 2 →
          let d := m * u - ν
          let M_bin : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
          let K_glob : ℕ := ⌈C_glob * ε ^ (-6 * (1 + m))⌉₊
          let K_1 : ℕ := ⌈C_loc * ε ^ (-ν)⌉₊
          let K_2 : ℕ := ⌈C_loc * ε ^ (-2 * ν)⌉₊
          (∃ (S_int_glob : Finset ℤ) (S_obs_glob : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)),
            S_int_glob.card ≤ K_glob ∧ S_obs_glob.card ≤ K_glob ∧
            ∀ (V A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c θ_u θ_1 : ℝ),
              ‖V‖ ≤ 1 → ‖A‖ ≤ 1 →
              c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
              θ_u ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
              θ_1 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
              IsOnSelectedChart useChart0 θ_1 →
              let R := chartRowSlope useChart0 θ_1
              let V' := chartRowVec useChart0 V
              let A' := chartRowVec useChart0 A
              dyadicRealBin ε (m * u) R ∈ S_int_glob ∧
              angBin ε (m * u) θ_u ∈ S_int_glob ∧
              stdApertureObs ε u b_u (b_u + m * u) V A c θ_u ∈ S_obs_glob ∧
              rowObs6 ε m V' A' c R
                (b_u, b_u + u, b_u + m * u, b_u + (1 + m) * u, u) ∈ S_obs_glob) ∧
          (∀ (V₁ A₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c₁ θ_u1 θ_11 : ℝ),
            ‖V₁‖ ≤ 1 → ‖A₁‖ ≤ 1 →
            c₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            θ_u1 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
            θ_11 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
            IsOnSelectedChart useChart0 θ_11 →
            cyclicBinDist M_bin (angBin ε d θ_u1) (angBin ε d θ_11) ≤ (N : ℤ) →
            let R₁ := chartRowSlope useChart0 θ_11
            let V₁' := chartRowVec useChart0 V₁
            let A₁' := chartRowVec useChart0 A₁
            let kr₁ := dyadicRealBin ε (m * u) R₁
            let kang₁ := angBin ε (m * u) θ_u1
            let G_std₁ := stdApertureObs ε u b_u (b_u + m * u) V₁ A₁ c₁ θ_u1
            let G_row₁ := rowObs6 ε m V₁' A₁' c₁ R₁
              (b_u, b_u + u, b_u + m * u, b_u + (1 + m) * u, u)
            ∃ (S_kr S_kang : Finset ℤ)
              (S_row S_std : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)),
              S_kr.card ≤ K_1 ∧ S_kang.card ≤ K_1 ∧
              S_row.card ≤ K_2 ∧ S_std.card ≤ K_2 ∧
              ∀ (V₂ A₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c₂ θ_u2 θ_12 : ℝ),
                ‖V₂‖ ≤ 1 → ‖A₂‖ ≤ 1 →
                c₂ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
                θ_u2 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
                θ_12 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
                IsOnSelectedChart useChart0 θ_12 →
                cyclicBinDist M_bin (angBin ε d θ_u2) (angBin ε d θ_12) ≤ (N : ℤ) →
                let R₂ := chartRowSlope useChart0 θ_12
                let V₂' := chartRowVec useChart0 V₂
                let A₂' := chartRowVec useChart0 A₂
                let kr₂ := dyadicRealBin ε (m * u) R₂
                let kang₂ := angBin ε (m * u) θ_u2
                let G_std₂ := stdApertureObs ε u b_u (b_u + m * u) V₂ A₂ c₂ θ_u2
                let G_row₂ := rowObs6 ε m V₂' A₂' c₂ R₂
                  (b_u, b_u + u, b_u + m * u, b_u + (1 + m) * u, u)
                (kang₂ = kang₁ → kr₂ ∈ S_kr) ∧
                (kr₂ = kr₁ → kang₂ ∈ S_kang) ∧
                (G_std₂ = G_std₁ ∧ kr₂ = kr₁ → G_row₂ ∈ S_row) ∧
                (G_row₂ = G_row₁ ∧ kang₂ = kang₁ → G_std₂ ∈ S_std)))

proof.tactics:
by
  let uVec : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    fun α => WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos α, Real.sin α]
  let rowUnit : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    fun r => (Real.sqrt (1 + r ^ 2))⁻¹ • WithLp.toLp 2 ![(1 : ℝ), r]
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_inner_eq : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ x y = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
    intro x y
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have h_ext2 : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), x 0 = y 0 → x 1 = y 1 → x = y := by
    intro x y h0 h1
    ext i

      obtain ⟨hX_in, hW_in⟩ := (hV_enc V₂).1 ⟨hVp_eq, hVperp_eq⟩
      have hP_in_pair := (hP_enc (A₂ + C_u1 • V₂)).1
        ⟨hPp_eq, by rw [h_bu_u_mu]; exact hPperp_eq⟩
      obtain ⟨hP0_eq, hP1_eq⟩ := hP'_coord V₂ A₂ C_u1 R_mu1
      rw [h_bu_u_mu, hP1_eq, hP0_eq] at hP_in_pair
      dsimp only [rowObs6, S_row]
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton]
      rw [hCu_eq, hRmu_eq]
      exact ⟨hkc_eq, hkr_eq, hX_in, hP_in_pair.1, hW_in, hP_in_pair.2⟩
    · 
      rintro ⟨hGrow_eq, hkang_eq⟩
      dsimp only [rowObs6] at hGrow_eq
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hGrow_eq
      obtain ⟨hkc_eq, hkr_eq, hX_eq, hY_eq, hW_eq, hZ_eq⟩ := hGrow_eq
      have hCu_eq : dyadicTimeMid ε u c₂ = C_u1 := by
        dsimp only [dyadicTimeMid, C_u1]; rw [hkc_eq]
      have hRmu_eq : dyadicRealMid ε (m * u) R₂ = R_mu1 :=
        ((h_real_lvl ε (m * u) hε₀ hε₁).2.2.2 R₁ R₂ hkr_eq).1
      rw [hCu_eq] at hY_eq hZ_eq
      rw [hRmu_eq] at hW_eq hZ_eq
      obtain ⟨hVp_in, hVperp_in⟩ := (hV_enc V₂).2 ⟨hX_eq, hW_eq⟩
      obtain ⟨hP1_0, hP1_1⟩ := hP'_coord V₁ A₁ C_u1 R_mu1
      obtain ⟨hP2_0, hP2_1⟩ := hP'_coord V₂ A₂ C_u1 R_mu1
      have hP_in_pair := (hP_enc (A₂ + C_u1 • V₂)).2
        ⟨by rw [hP2_0, hP1_0]; exact hY_eq,
         by rw [h_bu_u_mu, hP2_1, hP1_1]; exact hZ_eq⟩
      rw [h_bu_u_mu] at hP_in_pair
      dsimp only [stdApertureObs, S_std]
      rw [h_ab_mu, h_au_1m, hkang_eq, hCu_eq]
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton]
      exact ⟨hkc_eq, rfl, hVp_in, hVperp_in, hP_in_pair.1, hP_in_pair.2⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m ε r t b_t : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hr₀ : 0 < r) (hrt : r < t) (ht₁ : t < 1)
    (hε_tilde : ε ^ (t - r) < 1 / 2)
    (hb₀ : 0 ≤ b_t)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω)
    (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1)
    (hVA : ∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1)
    (hcR : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |R_s ω| ≤ 1) :
    let J := fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
      rowGrowthCell ε m r t b_t (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (R_s ω)
    let S_J : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω => 0 < π ω)).image J
    let p_J := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0
    let π_j := fun j => rowGrowthRestrictLaw π (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j))
    let V_j := fun j tid => rowGrowthLocVel ε m t b_t j (V_part tid)
    let A_j := fun j tid => rowGrowthLocPos ε m r t b_t j (V_part tid) (A_part tid)
    let c_j := fun j ω => rowGrowthLocTime ε r j.1 (c_s ω)
    (∀ j ∈ S_J, 0 < p_J j ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_j j ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_j j ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid, ‖V_j j tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_j j tid‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_j j ω → c_j j ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ∧
    finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))) J =
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)))
        (fun ω => dyadicRealBin ε (m * t) (R_s ω)) ∧
    rowObsScore ε γ m t b_t π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s ≤
      ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) -
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))) +
      (t - r) * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
        stdApertureScore (ε ^ (t - r)) γ 1 0 0 (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j)
          (c_j j) (fun _ => 0)) +
      2 * finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)))
        (fun ω => dyadicRealBin ε (m * t) (R_s ω)) +
      16 / Real.log (ε⁻¹)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro J S_J p_J π_j V_j A_j c_j
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_trans hr₀ hrt
  have htr_pos : 0 < t - r := sub_pos.mpr hrt
  let ε_tilde : ℝ := ε ^ (t - r)
  have hε_tilde_pos : 0 < ε_tilde := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (t - r)
  have h1_lt_inv : 1 < ε⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr (by linarith)
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos h1_lt_inv
  have hperp_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖perp2D v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hp0 : (perp2D v) 0 = -(v 1) := rfl
    have hp1 : (perp2D v) 1 = v 0 := rfl
    rw [hp0, hp1, norm_neg, add_comm]
  
  have h_clamp_norm : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖rowGrowthClamp2D w‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro w
    unfold rowGrowthClamp2D
    split_ifs with hw
    · exact hw
    · simp
  have h_clamp_id : ∀ (w0 w1 : ℝ), |w0| ≤ 1 / 2 → |w1| ≤ 1 / 2 →
      rowGrowthClamp2D (WithLp.toLp 2 ![w0, w1]) = WithLp.toLp 2 ![w0, w1] := by
    intro w0 w1 hw0 hw1
    have hnorm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![w0, w1] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have hs0 : w0 ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)])
      have hs1 : w1 ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)])
      exact Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr (by linarith)
    unfold rowGrowthClamp2D
    exact ite_cond_eq_true _ _ (eq_true hnorm)
  
  have h_step : ∀ (δ u : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → 0 < u →
      let m_u := dyadicTimeLevel δ u
      let Δ_u := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_u)⁻¹
      0 < Δ_u ∧ Δ_u ≤ δ ^ u ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ ^ u < Δ_u := by
    intro δ u hδ₀ hδ₁ hu
    let m_u := dyadicTimeLevel δ u
    let Δ_u : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_u)⁻¹
    have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u := by positivity
    have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ_u := inv_pos.mpr h2m_pos
    have hδ_lt1 : δ < 1 := by linarith
    have hδu_pos : 0 < δ ^ u := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hδ₀ u
    have hδ_prod : δ ^ u * δ ^ (-u) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hδ₀, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hΔ_prod : Δ_u * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ h2m_pos.ne'
    have h1_lt_pow : (1 : ℝ) < δ ^ (-u) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = δ ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero δ).symm
        _ < δ ^ (-u) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt hδ₀ hδ_lt1 (by linarith)
    have h1_lt_ceil : 1 < ⌈δ ^ (-u)⌉₊ := Nat.lt_ceil.mpr (by simpa using h1_lt_pow)
    have h_ub_pow : δ ^ (-u) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u := by
      have h_nat : ⌈δ ^ (-u)⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ m_u := Nat.le_pow_clog (by norm_num) _
      have h_cast : ((⌈δ ^ (-u)⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ m_u : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_nat
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h_cast
      exact le_trans (Nat.le_ceil _) h_cast
    have hΔ_le : Δ_u ≤ δ ^ u := by
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ub_pow (mul_nonneg hΔ_pos.le hδu_pos.le)
      nlinarith [hδ_prod, hΔ_prod]
    have hm_pos : 0 < m_u := Nat.clog_pos (by norm_num) h1_lt_ceil
    have h_pred_lt : 2 ^ (m_u - 1) < ⌈δ ^ (-u)⌉₊ :=
      Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self (by norm_num) h1_lt_ceil
    have h_pred_real : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_u - 1) < δ ^ (-u) := by
      have h_cast := Nat.lt_ceil.mp h_pred_lt
      rwa [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h_cast
    have h2m_lt : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u < 2 * δ ^ (-u) := by
      have hm_eq : m_u = (m_u - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hm_pos).symm
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((m_u - 1) + 1) := by rw [← hm_eq]
        _ = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_u - 1) := by rw [pow_succ, mul_comm]
        _ < 2 * δ ^ (-u) := by linarith
    have hΔ_gt : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ ^ u < Δ_u := by
      have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2m_lt (mul_pos hΔ_pos hδu_pos)
      nlinarith [hδ_prod, hΔ_prod]
    exact ⟨hΔ_pos, hΔ_le, hΔ_gt⟩
  
  have h_bin : ∀ (δ u c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      let m_u := dyadicTimeLevel δ u
      let Δ_u := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_u)⁻¹
      let k := dyadicTimeBin δ u c
      (0 ≤ c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u - (k : ℝ) ∧ c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u - (k : ℝ) ≤ 1) ∧
      ((k : ℝ) * Δ_u ≤ c ∧ c ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Δ_u) ∧
      |c - dyadicTimeMid δ u c| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_u := by
    intro δ u c hc
    let m_u := dyadicTimeLevel δ u
    let Δ_u : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_u)⁻¹
    let k := dyadicTimeBin δ u c
    have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u := by positivity
    have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ_u := inv_pos.mpr h2m_pos
    have hΔ_prod : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u * Δ_u = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ h2m_pos.ne'
    have h_loc : 0 ≤ c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u - (k : ℝ) ∧ c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u - (k : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hc.2 with hc_lt | rfl
      · have h_prod_lt : c * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u) <
            (((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
          push_cast; nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u) by positivity]
        have h_fl_le : ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u)⌋ ≤
            (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u) - 1 := by
          have := Int.floor_lt.mpr h_prod_lt
          omega
        have hk_eq : k = ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u⌋ := min_eq_left h_fl_le
        rw [hk_eq]
        exact ⟨by linarith [Int.floor_le (c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u)],
          by linarith [Int.lt_floor_add_one (c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u)]⟩
      · have h_fl_eq : ⌊(1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u)⌋ =
            (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u) := by
          rw [show (1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u) =
              (((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel δ u) : ℤ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,
            Int.floor_intCast]
        have hk_eq : k = (2 : ℤ) ^ m_u - 1 := by
          dsimp only [k, dyadicTimeBin, m_u]
          rw [h_fl_eq]
          exact min_eq_right (by omega)
        rw [hk_eq]
        push_cast
        constructor <;> linarith
    have hc_eq : c = (c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_u) * Δ_u := by rw [mul_assoc, hΔ_prod, mul_one]
    have h_iv : (k : ℝ) * Δ_u ≤ c ∧ c ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Δ_u := by
      rw [hc_eq]
      exact ⟨mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [h_loc.1]) hΔ_pos.le,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [h_loc.2]) hΔ_pos.le⟩
    have h_mid : |c - dyadicTimeMid δ u c| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_u := by
      change |c - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_u| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_u
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith [h_iv.1, h_iv.2]
    exact ⟨h_loc, h_iv, h_mid⟩
  
  have h_quot : ∀ c : ℝ, c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      dyadicTimeBin ε r c =
        (dyadicTimeBin ε t c) / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε t - dyadicTimeLevel ε r)) := by
    intro c hc
    let m_r := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
    let m_t := dyadicTimeLevel ε t
    have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith
    have hm_le : m_r ≤ m_t := by
      refine Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (Nat.ceil_mono ?_)
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le (by linarith)
    let d := m_t - m_r
    have hmt_eq : m_t = m_r + d := (Nat.add_sub_of_le hm_le).symm
    let q : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ d
    have hq_pos : 0 < q := by positivity
    have hq_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq_pos
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hc.2 with hc_lt | rfl
    · have h_lt_r : c * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r) <
          (((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast; nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r) by positivity]
      have h_lt_t : c * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε t) <
          (((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε t) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast; nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε t) by positivity]
      have hkr_eq : dyadicTimeBin ε r c = ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r⌋ :=
        min_eq_left (by have := Int.floor_lt.mpr h_lt_r; omega)
      have hkt_eq : dyadicTimeBin ε t c = ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t⌋ :=
        min_eq_left (by have := Int.floor_lt.mpr h_lt_t; omega)
      rw [hkr_eq, hkt_eq]
      let kr := ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r⌋
      have h_pow_split : c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t = (c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r) * (q : ℝ) := by
        rw [hmt_eq, pow_add]; push_cast [q]; ring
      have h_lo : kr * q ≤ ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t⌋ := Int.le_floor.mpr (by
        rw [h_pow_split]; push_cast
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Int.floor_le _) hq_real_pos.le)
      have h_hi : ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t⌋ < (kr + 1) * q := Int.floor_lt.mpr (by
        rw [h_pow_split]; push_cast
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Int.lt_floor_add_one _) hq_real_pos)
      have h1 : kr ≤ ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t⌋ / q := (Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hq_pos).mpr h_lo
      have h2 : ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t⌋ / q < kr + 1 := Int.ediv_lt_of_lt_mul hq_pos h_hi
      change kr = ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t⌋ / q
      linarith
    · have hkr_eq : dyadicTimeBin ε r 1 = (2 : ℤ) ^ m_r - 1 := by
        dsimp only [dyadicTimeBin, m_r]
        rw [show (1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r) =
            (((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r) : ℤ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,
          Int.floor_intCast]
        exact min_eq_right (by omega)
      have hkt_eq : dyadicTimeBin ε t 1 = (2 : ℤ) ^ m_t - 1 := by
        dsimp only [dyadicTimeBin, m_t]
        rw [show (1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε t) =
            (((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε t) : ℤ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,
          Int.floor_intCast]
        exact min_eq_right (by omega)
      rw [hkr_eq, hkt_eq]
      change (2 : ℤ) ^ m_r - 1 = ((2 : ℤ) ^ m_t - 1) / q
      rw [show (2 : ℤ) ^ m_t = (2 : ℤ) ^ m_r * q by rw [hmt_eq, pow_add]]
      have h_lo : ((2 : ℤ) ^ m_r - 1) * q ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m_r * q - 1 := by linarith
      have h_hi : (2 : ℤ) ^ m_r * q - 1 < (((2 : ℤ) ^ m_r - 1) + 1) * q := by linarith
      have h1 := (Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hq_pos).mpr h_lo
      have h2 := Int.ediv_lt_of_lt_mul hq_pos h_hi

  have h_real : ∀ (δ L : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →

  have h_mi_sub : ∀ {α_T α β : Type} [DecidableEq α_T] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]

        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)

    rw [hp1_eq, hp2_eq, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hpJ_ne]
    change (t - r) * p_J (J ω₀) *
        (π ω / p_J (J ω₀) * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π XJ Y_glob ω / finProbAt π XJ ω) /
          Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹))) =
      π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π XJ Y_glob ω / finProbAt π XJ ω) / ell)
    rw [hlog_tilde]
    have htr_ne : t - r ≠ 0 := htr_pos.ne'
    field_simp [hpJ_ne, htr_ne]
  
  let k_cr := fun ω : Fin N_ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)
  let k_ct := fun ω : Fin N_ω => dyadicTimeBin ε t (c_s ω)
  let k_rt := fun ω : Fin N_ω => dyadicRealBin ε (m * t) (R_s ω)
  let G_t := fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
    rowObs6 ε m (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (R_s ω)
      (b_t, b_t + t, b_t + m * t, b_t + (1 + m) * t, t)
  let G_loc := fun j (ω : Fin N_ω) =>
    stdApertureObs ε_tilde 1 0 0 (V_j j (T_idx ω)) (A_j j (T_idx ω)) (c_j j ω) 0
  let k_loc := fun j (ω : Fin N_ω) => dyadicTimeBin ε_tilde 1 (c_j j ω)
  let G_tilde := fun ω : Fin N_ω => G_loc (J ω) ω
  let k_tilde := fun ω : Fin N_ω => k_loc (J ω) ω
  
  have h_std_sum : (t - r) * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
      stdApertureScore ε_tilde γ 1 0 0 (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) (c_j j) (fun _ => 0)) =
      -(finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω => (J ω, G_tilde ω)) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J) +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, J ω)) k_tilde := by
    have h_term : ∀ j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ,
        p_J j * stdApertureScore ε_tilde γ 1 0 0 (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) (c_j j)
            (fun _ => 0) =
          -(p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) (fun _ => ()) (G_loc j)) +
            p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) T_idx (G_loc j) +
            2 * (p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) T_idx (k_loc j)) := by
      intro j
      unfold stdApertureScore finMutualInfo
      dsimp only [G_loc, k_loc]
      ring
    simp_rw [h_term, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hf1 := h_fib_ent (fun _ => ()) G_loc
    have hf2 := h_fib_ent T_idx G_loc
    have hf3 := h_fib_ent T_idx k_loc
    have hc1 := h_chain_eq (fun _ => ()) J G_tilde
    have hc2 := h_chain_eq T_idx J G_tilde
    unfold finMutualInfo
    dsimp only [G_tilde, k_tilde] at hf1 hf2 hf3 hc1 hc2 ⊢
    linarith
  
  have h_mi_le : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω => (J ω, G_tilde ω)) ≤
      finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_t + Real.log (6480 : ℝ) / ell := by
    have h1 := h_mi_sub T_idx G_t (fun ω => (J ω, G_tilde ω))
    have h2 : finCondEntropy ε π G_t (fun ω => (J ω, G_tilde ω)) ≤
        Real.log (6480 : ℝ) / ell :=
      h_cover_ent G_t (fun ω => (J ω, G_tilde ω)) 6480 cover_JG (by norm_num) hcovJG_card
        (fun ω hω => hcovJG_mem (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (R_s ω) (hcR ω hω).1)
    linarith
  
  have h_time_le : finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_ct ≤
      finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_cr +
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_cr ω)) k_rt +
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, J ω)) k_tilde +
      Real.log (3 : ℝ) / ell := by
    have ht1 := h_subadd T_idx k_cr k_ct
    have ht2 := h_subadd (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_cr ω)) J k_ct
    have ht3 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((T_idx ω, k_cr ω), J ω)) k_ct =
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, J ω)) k_ct := by
      unfold finCondEntropy
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      have h_iff : ∀ ω' : Fin N_ω,
          ((T_idx ω', k_cr ω'), J ω') = ((T_idx ω, k_cr ω), J ω) ↔
            (T_idx ω', J ω') = (T_idx ω, J ω) := by
        intro ω'
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact Prod.ext (congrArg (fun x => x.1.1) h) (congrArg (fun x => x.2) h)
        · intro h
          have hT : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω := congrArg Prod.fst h
          have hJ : J ω' = J ω := congrArg Prod.snd h
          have hk : k_cr ω' = k_cr ω := congrArg Prod.fst hJ
          exact Prod.ext (Prod.ext hT hk) hJ
      have hp1 : finProbAt π (fun ω' => ((T_idx ω', k_cr ω'), J ω')) ω =
          finProbAt π (fun ω' => (T_idx ω', J ω')) ω := by
        unfold finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h : (T_idx ω', J ω') = (T_idx ω, J ω)
        · have h' := (h_iff ω').mpr h
          simp [h, h']
        · have h' : ((T_idx ω', k_cr ω'), J ω') ≠ ((T_idx ω, k_cr ω), J ω) :=
            fun hc => h ((h_iff ω').mp hc)
          simp [h, h']
      have hp2 : finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => ((T_idx ω', k_cr ω'), J ω')) k_ct ω =
          finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (T_idx ω', J ω')) k_ct ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h : (T_idx ω', J ω') = (T_idx ω, J ω)
        · have h' := (h_iff ω').mpr h
          by_cases hk : k_ct ω' = k_ct ω <;> simp [h, h', hk]
        · have h' : ((T_idx ω', k_cr ω'), J ω') ≠ ((T_idx ω, k_cr ω), J ω) :=
            fun hc => h ((h_iff ω').mp hc)
          simp [h, h']
      unfold condSurprise
      rw [hp1, hp2]
    have ht4 := h_subadd (fun ω => (T_idx ω, J ω)) k_tilde k_ct
    have ht5 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((T_idx ω, J ω), k_tilde ω)) k_ct ≤
        Real.log (3 : ℝ) / ell :=
      h_cover_ent (fun ω => ((T_idx ω, J ω), k_tilde ω)) k_ct 3
        (fun x => cover_kt (x.1.2.1, x.2)) (by norm_num) (fun _ => hcovkt_card _)
        (fun ω hω => hcovkt_mem (c_s ω) (hcR ω hω).1)
    dsimp only [k_cr, k_rt] at h_conj2 ⊢
    linarith
  
  have h_err_lt : Real.log (6480 : ℝ) / ell +
      2 * (Real.log (3 : ℝ) / ell) ≤ 16 / ell := by
    have h_sum_eq : Real.log (6480 : ℝ) / ell +
        2 * (Real.log (3 : ℝ) / ell) = Real.log 58320 / ell := by
      have h_logs : Real.log (6480 : ℝ) + 2 * Real.log (3 : ℝ) = Real.log 58320 := by
        have h1 : 2 * Real.log (3 : ℝ) = Real.log (3 * 3) := by
          rw [two_mul, ← Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
        rw [h1, ← Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
      have h_div : Real.log (6480 : ℝ) / ell + 2 * (Real.log (3 : ℝ) / ell) =
          (Real.log (6480 : ℝ) + 2 * Real.log (3 : ℝ)) / ell := by ring
      rw [h_div, h_logs]
    rw [h_sum_eq]
    have h_exp : (2 : ℝ) ^ 16 ≤ Real.exp 16 := by
      have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
        have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
        linarith
      have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ 16 ≤ (Real.exp 1) ^ 16 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) h1 16
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at h2
      have h3 : ((16 : ℕ) * (1 : ℝ)) = 16 := by norm_num
      rwa [h3] at h2
    have h_lt_exp : (58320 : ℝ) < Real.exp 16 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (58320 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ 16) h_exp
    have h_log_lt : Real.log 58320 < 16 := by
      have h := Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 58320) h_lt_exp
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at h
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_log_lt.le hell_pos.le
  change rowObsScore ε γ m t b_t π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s ≤
    ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
      2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_cr) +
    (t - r) * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
      stdApertureScore ε_tilde γ 1 0 0 (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) (c_j j) (fun _ => 0)) +
    2 * finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_cr ω)) k_rt +
    16 / ell
  unfold rowObsScore
  dsimp only [G_t, k_ct] at h_mi_le h_time_le
  linarith [h_std_sum, h_mi_le, h_time_le, h_err_lt]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m ε r t b_t : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hr₀ : 0 < r) (hrt : r < t)
    (hb₀ : 0 ≤ b_t) (hb_hor : b_t + (1 + m) * t ≤ 1 + m)
    (R_bar X_bar Y_bar W_bar Z_bar C_r Δ_r B A : ℝ)
    (e_φ V_D A_D : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hR : |R_bar| ≤ 3 / 2)
    (hΔ₀ : 0 < Δ_r) (hΔ_ub : Δ_r ≤ ε ^ r)
    (hB₀ : 0 ≤ B) (hBA : B ≤ A) (hA₁ : A ≤ 1)
    (he_φ : ‖e_φ‖ = 1) :
    ∃ (p_raw q_raw : ℝ) (e_G V_G X_G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 ≤ p_raw ∧ p_raw ≤ q_raw ∧ q_raw + r ≤ 1 + m ∧ ‖e_G‖ = 1 ∧
      (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + (t - r) * ((1 + γ) * B + (1 - γ) * A) ≤
        (1 + γ) * p_raw + (1 - γ) * q_raw ∧
      (∀ V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        let X := V_p 0
        let W := V_p 1 - R_bar * X
        let Y_r := A_p 0 + C_r * X
        let Z_r := A_p 1 + C_r * (V_p 1) - R_bar * Y_r
        let V_raw := WithLp.toLp 2
          ![(X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t), (W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t))]
        let A_raw := WithLp.toLp 2
          ![((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r),
            ((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) /
              (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r)]
        |inner ℝ (V_raw - V_D) e_φ| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ B →
        |inner ℝ (V_raw - V_D) (perp2D e_φ)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ A →
        |inner ℝ (A_raw - A_D) e_φ| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ B →
        |inner ℝ (A_raw - A_D) (perp2D e_φ)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ A →
        |inner ℝ (V_p - V_G) e_G| ≤ 600 * ε ^ p_raw ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_p - V_G) (perp2D e_G)| ≤ 600 * ε ^ q_raw ∧
        |inner ℝ ((A_p + C_r • V_p) - X_G) e_G| ≤ 600 * ε ^ (p_raw + r) ∧
        |inner ℝ ((A_p + C_r • V_p) - X_G) (perp2D e_G)| ≤ 600 * ε ^ (q_raw + r))

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hγ₁
  have h_inner : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ x y = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
    intro x y
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp
  have h_perp0 : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), (perp2D x) 0 = -(x 1) := by
    intro x
    simp [perp2D]
  have h_perp1 : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), (perp2D x) 1 = x 0 := by
    intro x
    simp [perp2D]
  have h_abs_of_sq : ∀ x C : ℝ, 0 < C → x ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 → |x| ≤ C := by
    intro x C hC hx
    nlinarith [sq_abs x, abs_nonneg x]
  have h_sq_of_abs : ∀ x C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → |x| ≤ C → x ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by
    intro x C hC hx
    nlinarith [sq_abs x, abs_nonneg x]
  have h_cancel_neg : ∀ a b c : ℝ, c < 0 → b * c ≤ a * c → a ≤ b := by
    intro a b c hc hbc
    nlinarith
  
  have h_gram : ∀ (m₀₀ m₀₁ m₁₀ m₁₁ : ℝ),
      m₀₀ * m₁₁ - m₀₁ * m₁₀ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ (lam₁ lam₂ : ℝ) (u₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        0 < lam₂ ∧ lam₂ ≤ lam₁ ∧
        lam₁ * lam₂ = (m₀₀ * m₁₁ - m₀₁ * m₁₀) ^ 2 ∧
        ‖u₁‖ = 1 ∧
        (m₀₀ * u₁ 0 + m₁₀ * u₁ 1) ^ 2 + (m₀₁ * u₁ 0 + m₁₁ * u₁ 1) ^ 2 = lam₁ ∧
        (m₀₀ * (perp2D u₁) 0 + m₁₀ * (perp2D u₁) 1) ^ 2 +
          (m₀₁ * (perp2D u₁) 0 + m₁₁ * (perp2D u₁) 1) ^ 2 = lam₂ ∧
        (∀ y₀ y₁ : ℝ,
          lam₂ * (y₀ ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2) ≤
            (m₀₀ * y₀ + m₁₀ * y₁) ^ 2 + (m₀₁ * y₀ + m₁₁ * y₁) ^ 2 ∧
          (m₀₀ * y₀ + m₁₀ * y₁) ^ 2 + (m₀₁ * y₀ + m₁₁ * y₁) ^ 2 ≤
            lam₁ * (y₀ ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2)) := by
    intro m₀₀ m₀₁ m₁₀ m₁₁ h_det
    let g₀₀ : ℝ := m₀₀ ^ 2 + m₀₁ ^ 2
    let g₀₁ : ℝ := m₀₀ * m₁₀ + m₀₁ * m₁₁
    let g₁₁ : ℝ := m₁₀ ^ 2 + m₁₁ ^ 2
    have hg₀₀_nn : 0 ≤ g₀₀ := by positivity
    have hg₁₁_nn : 0 ≤ g₁₁ := by positivity
    have h_lagr : g₀₀ * g₁₁ - g₀₁ ^ 2 = (m₀₀ * m₁₁ - m₀₁ * m₁₀) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [g₀₀, g₀₁, g₁₁]; ring
    have h_det_sq_pos : 0 < (m₀₀ * m₁₁ - m₀₁ * m₁₀) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero h_det
    have h_tr_pos : 0 < g₀₀ + g₁₁ := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg g₀₁]
    let disc : ℝ := (g₀₀ - g₁₁) ^ 2 + 4 * g₀₁ ^ 2
    have h_disc_nn : 0 ≤ disc := by positivity
    let D : ℝ := Real.sqrt disc
    have hD_nn : 0 ≤ D := Real.sqrt_nonneg disc
    have hD_sq : D ^ 2 = (g₀₀ - g₁₁) ^ 2 + 4 * g₀₁ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt h_disc_nn
    let lam₁ : ℝ := (g₀₀ + g₁₁ + D) / 2
    let lam₂ : ℝ := (g₀₀ + g₁₁ - D) / 2
    have hlam₁₂ : lam₂ ≤ lam₁ := by dsimp [lam₁, lam₂]; linarith
    have hlam_sum : lam₁ + lam₂ = g₀₀ + g₁₁ := by dsimp [lam₁, lam₂]; ring
    have hlam_prod : lam₁ * lam₂ = (m₀₀ * m₁₁ - m₀₁ * m₁₀) ^ 2 := by
      calc lam₁ * lam₂
          = ((g₀₀ + g₁₁) ^ 2 - D ^ 2) / 4 := by dsimp [lam₁, lam₂]; ring
        _ = g₀₀ * g₁₁ - g₀₁ ^ 2 := by rw [hD_sq]; ring
        _ = (m₀₀ * m₁₁ - m₀₁ * m₁₀) ^ 2 := h_lagr
    have hlam₁_pos : 0 < lam₁ := by dsimp [lam₁]; linarith
    have hlam₂_pos : 0 < lam₂ := by nlinarith [hlam_prod, h_det_sq_pos, hlam₁_pos]
    have h_evec : ∃ e₀ e₁ : ℝ,
        e₀ ^ 2 + e₁ ^ 2 = 1 ∧
        g₀₀ * e₀ + g₀₁ * e₁ = lam₁ * e₀ ∧
        g₀₁ * e₀ + g₁₁ * e₁ = lam₁ * e₁ := by
      by_cases hg₀₁ : g₀₁ = 0
      · by_cases h_ord : g₁₁ ≤ g₀₀
        · have hD_eq : D = g₀₀ - g₁₁ := by
            dsimp [D, disc]
            rw [hg₀₁]
            have h_s : (g₀₀ - g₁₁) ^ 2 + 4 * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (g₀₀ - g₁₁) ^ 2 := by ring
            rw [h_s, Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
          have hlam₁_eq : lam₁ = g₀₀ := by dsimp [lam₁]; linarith
          exact ⟨1, 0, by ring, by rw [hg₀₁, hlam₁_eq]; ring, by rw [hg₀₁, hlam₁_eq]; ring⟩
        · have hD_eq : D = g₁₁ - g₀₀ := by
            dsimp [D, disc]
            rw [hg₀₁]
            have h_s : (g₀₀ - g₁₁) ^ 2 + 4 * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (g₁₁ - g₀₀) ^ 2 := by ring
            rw [h_s, Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
          have hlam₁_eq : lam₁ = g₁₁ := by dsimp [lam₁]; linarith
          exact ⟨0, 1, by ring, by rw [hg₀₁, hlam₁_eq]; ring, by rw [hg₀₁, hlam₁_eq]; ring⟩
      · let v₀ : ℝ := g₀₀ - g₁₁ + D
        let v₁ : ℝ := 2 * g₀₁
        have hv₁_pos : 0 < v₁ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hg₀₁)
        have hv_pos : 0 < v₀ ^ 2 + v₁ ^ 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg v₀]
        let N_v : ℝ := Real.sqrt (v₀ ^ 2 + v₁ ^ 2)
        have hNv_pos : 0 < N_v := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hv_pos
        have hNv_ne : N_v ≠ 0 := hNv_pos.ne'
        have hNv_sq : N_v ^ 2 = v₀ ^ 2 + v₁ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hv_pos.le

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m r t δ_target : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (hr₀ : 0 < r) (hrt : r < t) (ht₁ : t < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ_target) :
    ∃ ε_back₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε_back₀ ∧ ε_back₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε b_t : ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε_back₀ → ε ^ (t - r) < 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ b_t → b_t + (1 + m) * t ≤ 1 + m →
        (∀ (R_bar X_bar Y_bar W_bar Z_bar C_r Δ_r B A : ℝ)
          (e_φ V_D A_D : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          |R_bar| ≤ 3 / 2 → 0 < Δ_r → Δ_r ≤ ε ^ r →
          0 ≤ B → B ≤ A → A ≤ 1 → ‖e_φ‖ = 1 →
          ∃ (p_raw q_raw : ℝ) (e_G V_G X_G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            0 ≤ p_raw ∧ p_raw ≤ q_raw ∧ q_raw + r ≤ 1 + m ∧ ‖e_G‖ = 1 ∧
            (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + (t - r) * ((1 + γ) * B + (1 - γ) * A) ≤
              (1 + γ) * p_raw + (1 - γ) * q_raw ∧
            (∀ V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              let X := V_p 0
              let W := V_p 1 - R_bar * X
              let Y_r := A_p 0 + C_r * X
              let Z_r := A_p 1 + C_r * (V_p 1) - R_bar * Y_r
              let V_raw := WithLp.toLp 2
                ![(X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t), (W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t))]
              let A_raw := WithLp.toLp 2
                ![((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r),
                  ((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) /
                    (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r)]
              |inner ℝ (V_raw - V_D) e_φ| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ B →
              |inner ℝ (V_raw - V_D) (perp2D e_φ)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ A →
              |inner ℝ (A_raw - A_D) e_φ| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ B →
              |inner ℝ (A_raw - A_D) (perp2D e_φ)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ A →
              |inner ℝ (V_p - V_G) e_G| ≤ 600 * ε ^ p_raw ∧
              |inner ℝ (V_p - V_G) (perp2D e_G)| ≤ 600 * ε ^ q_raw ∧
              |inner ℝ ((A_p + C_r • V_p) - X_G) e_G| ≤ 600 * ε ^ (p_raw + r) ∧
              |inner ℝ ((A_p + C_r • V_p) - X_G) (perp2D e_G)| ≤ 600 * ε ^ (q_raw + r))) →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |R_s ω| ≤ 1) →
        let J := fun ω : Fin N_ω =>
          rowGrowthCell ε m r t b_t (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (R_s ω)
        let S_J : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω => 0 < π ω)).image J
        let p_J := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0
        let π_j := fun j => rowGrowthRestrictLaw π (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j))
        let V_j := fun j tid => rowGrowthLocVel ε m t b_t j (V_part tid)
        let A_j := fun j tid => rowGrowthLocPos ε m r t b_t j (V_part tid) (A_part tid)
        ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))) +
        (t - r) * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
          classicalRootSupremum (ε ^ (t - r)) 1 γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j)) ≤
        classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
          classicalGrowthRate γ * r + (t - r) * δ_target
