proof.tactics:
by
  
  let η : ℝ := t - r
  have hη : 0 < η := sub_pos.mpr hrt
  let δ_cl : ℝ := η * δ_target / (3 * r)
  have hδ_cl : 0 < δ_cl := div_pos (mul_pos hη hδ) (by positivity)
  have h_ne_rates : (ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ).Nonempty := ⟨2, h_two⟩
  have h_inf_lt : sInf (ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ) < classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_cl := by
    change classicalGrowthRate γ < classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_cl
    linarith
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀_mem, hb₀_lt⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt h_ne_rates h_inf_lt
  obtain ⟨ε_back₀, hε_back_pos, hε_back_lt, h_univ⟩ :=
    hb₀_mem.2.2 600 (1 + m) r δ_cl (by norm_num) (by linarith) hr₀ (by linarith) hδ_cl
  refine ⟨ε_back₀, hε_back_pos, hε_back_lt, ?_⟩
  intro ε b_t hε₀ hε_back hε_tr hb_t hb_hor h_svd
    N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s hπ_nn hπ_sum hVA hcR
    J S_J p_J π_j V_j A_j
  have hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hε_back hε_back_lt
  let ε_tilde : ℝ := ε ^ (t - r)
  have hε_tilde_pos : 0 < ε_tilde := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (t - r)

  
  let m_r : ℕ := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
  let Δ_r : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r := by positivity
  have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ_r := inv_pos.mpr h2m_pos
  have hεr_pos : 0 < ε ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ r
  have hεr_lt1 : ε ^ r < 1 := Real.rpow_lt_one hε₀.le (by linarith) hr₀
  have hε_neg_r : ε ^ (-r) = (ε ^ r)⁻¹ := Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le r
  have h1_lt_eneg : 1 < ε ^ (-r) := by
    rw [hε_neg_r]
    exact one_lt_inv₀ hεr_pos |>.mpr hεr_lt1
  have hΔ_le : Δ_r ≤ ε ^ r := by
    have h_ceil_le : ε ^ (-r) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r := by
      have h1 : ε ^ (-r) ≤ (⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      have h2_nat : ⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ m_r := Nat.le_pow_clog (by omega) _
      have h2 : (⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r := by exact_mod_cast h2_nat
      exact le_trans h1 h2
    have h_inv := inv_anti₀ (lt_trans zero_lt_one h1_lt_eneg) h_ceil_le
    rwa [hε_neg_r, inv_inv] at h_inv
  have hΔ_gt : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r < Δ_r := by
    have h1_lt_ceil_real : (1 : ℝ) < (⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le h1_lt_eneg (Nat.le_ceil _)
    have h1_lt_ceil : 1 < ⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ := by exact_mod_cast h1_lt_ceil_real
    have hm_r_pos : 0 < m_r := by
      by_contra hm0
      have hm_eq : m_r = 0 := by omega
      have h_le : ⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ m_r := Nat.le_pow_clog (by omega) _
      rw [hm_eq] at h_le
      omega
    have h_pred_lt : 2 ^ m_r.pred < ⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ :=
      Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self (by omega) h1_lt_ceil
    have h_pred_real : ((2 ^ m_r.pred : ℕ) : ℝ) < ε ^ (-r) := Nat.lt_ceil.mp h_pred_lt
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h_pred_real
    have hm_succ : m_r.pred + 1 = m_r := Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hm_r_pos
    have h2m_lt : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r < ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r)⁻¹ := by
      have h_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r.pred := by
        calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_r.pred + 1) := by rw [hm_succ]
          _ = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r.pred := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      have h_rhs : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r)⁻¹ = 2 * ε ^ (-r) := by
        rw [hε_neg_r]
        field_simp [hεr_pos.ne']
      linarith
    have h_inv := inv_strictAnti₀ h2m_pos h2m_lt
    rwa [inv_inv] at h_inv

  have h_log2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have h_eps_inv_gt1 : 1 < ε⁻¹ := by
    have h_inv_pos : 0 < ε⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hε₀
    have h_prod : ε * ε⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hε₀.ne'
    nlinarith
  have h_ell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := Real.log_pos h_eps_inv_gt1

  have h_mid1D : ∀ (L x : ℝ),
      |x - dyadicRealMid ε L x| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dyadicRealStep ε L ∧
      |x - dyadicRealMid ε L x| < ε ^ L := by
    intro L x
    let ℓ : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    let s : ℝ := dyadicRealStep ε L
    have hs_pos : 0 < s := by
      dsimp [s, dyadicRealStep]
      positivity
    have h_mul_s : (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * s = 1 := by
      dsimp [s, dyadicRealStep]
      rw [zpow_neg]
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
    let k : ℤ := dyadicRealBin ε L x
    have hk_lo : (k : ℝ) ≤ x * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := Int.floor_le _
    have hk_hi : x * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hx_lo : (k : ℝ) * s ≤ x := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk_lo hs_pos.le
      rwa [mul_assoc, h_mul_s, mul_one] at h1
    have hx_hi : x < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * s := by
      have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hk_hi hs_pos
      rwa [mul_assoc, h_mul_s, mul_one] at h1
    have h_abs_le : |x - dyadicRealMid ε L x| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s := by
      change |x - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have h_s_lt : s < 2 * ε ^ L := by
      have hℓ_hi : L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) < (ℓ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hexp_lt : ((-ℓ : ℤ) : ℝ) < 1 - L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := by
        push_cast
        linarith
      have hs_rpow : s = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((-ℓ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [s, dyadicRealStep, ℓ]
        exact (Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) (-dyadicRealLevel ε L)).symm
      have h_lt1 : s < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)) := by
        rw [hs_rpow]
        exact Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) hexp_lt
      have h_rhs_eq : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)) = 2 * ε ^ L := by
        rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one]
        congr 1
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀,
          Real.log_inv]
        congr 1
        field_simp [h_log2_pos.ne']
      rwa [h_rhs_eq] at h_lt1
    exact ⟨h_abs_le, by linarith⟩

  have h_norm2_sq : ∀ u₀ u₁ : ℝ,
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![u₀, u₁] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ^ 2 = u₀ ^ 2 + u₁ ^ 2 := by
    intro u₀ u₁
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

  have h_clamp_le1 : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖rowGrowthClamp2D w‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro w
    unfold rowGrowthClamp2D
    split_ifs with hw
    · exact hw
    · simp

  have hVA_j : ∀ (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (tid : Fin N_T),
      ‖V_j j tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_j j tid‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro j tid
    exact ⟨h_clamp_le1 _, h_clamp_le1 _⟩

  have h_step_mt_le1 : dyadicRealStep ε (m * t) ≤ 1 := by
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_trans hr₀ hrt
    have hmt_pos : 0 < m * t := mul_pos hm ht_pos
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ (m * t) * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := by positivity
    have hℓ_nn : 0 ≤ dyadicRealLevel ε (m * t) := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr h_nn
    unfold dyadicRealStep
    exact zpow_le_one_of_nonpos₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)

  have h_cell_geom : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
      let j := J ω
      let V_p := V_part (T_idx ω)
      let A_p := A_part (T_idx ω)
      let C_r := ((j.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
      let R_bar := ((j.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t)
      let X_bar := ((j.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t
      let Y_bar := ((j.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + r)
      let W_bar := ((j.2.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t)
      let Z_bar := ((j.2.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t + r)
      let X := V_p 0
      let W := V_p 1 - R_bar * X
      let Y_r := A_p 0 + C_r * X
      let Z_r := A_p 1 + C_r * (V_p 1) - R_bar * Y_r
      C_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      |R_bar| ≤ 3 / 2 ∧
      V_j j (T_idx ω) = WithLp.toLp 2
        ![(X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t), (W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t))] ∧
      A_j j (T_idx ω) = WithLp.toLp 2
        ![((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r),
          ((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) /
            (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r)] := by
    intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨hc_mem, hR_abs⟩ := hcR ω hω
    dsimp only
    have hj1 : (J ω).1 = dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) := rfl
    have hCr_mem : (((J ω).1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [hj1]
      have hk_nn : 0 ≤ dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) := by
        unfold dyadicTimeBin
        refine le_min ?_ ?_
        · exact Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hc_mem.1 (by positivity))
        · have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ dyadicTimeLevel ε r := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
          linarith
      have hk_hi : dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) ≤ (2 ^ m_r : ℤ) - 1 := min_le_right _ _
      have hk_nn_r : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_nn
      have hk_hi_r : (dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r - 1 := by
        have h_cast : (((2 ^ m_r : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r - 1 := by push_cast; ring
        rw [← h_cast]
        exact_mod_cast hk_hi
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      calc ((dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
          ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r) * Δ_r :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hΔ_pos.le
        _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ h2m_pos.ne'
    have hRbar_eq : (((J ω).2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t) =
        dyadicRealMid ε (m * t) (R_s ω) := rfl
    have hRbar_abs : |(((J ω).2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t)| ≤ 3 / 2 := by
      rw [hRbar_eq]
      have h_diff := (h_mid1D (m * t) (R_s ω)).1
      have h_tri : |dyadicRealMid ε (m * t) (R_s ω)| ≤
          |R_s ω| + |R_s ω - dyadicRealMid ε (m * t) (R_s ω)| := by
        calc |dyadicRealMid ε (m * t) (R_s ω)|
            = |R_s ω - (R_s ω - dyadicRealMid ε (m * t) (R_s ω))| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |R_s ω| + |R_s ω - dyadicRealMid ε (m * t) (R_s ω)| := abs_sub _ _
      linarith
    let V_p := V_part (T_idx ω)
    let A_p := A_part (T_idx ω)
    let C_r := (((J ω).1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
    let R_bar := (((J ω).2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t)
    let X := V_p 0
    let W := V_p 1 - R_bar * X
    let Y_r := A_p 0 + C_r * X
    let Z_r := A_p 1 + C_r * (V_p 1) - R_bar * Y_r
    let X_bar := (((J ω).2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t
    let Y_bar := (((J ω).2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + r)
    let W_bar := (((J ω).2.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t)
    let Z_bar := (((J ω).2.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t + r)
    have hXbar_eq : X_bar = dyadicRealMid ε b_t X := rfl
    have hYbar_eq : Y_bar = dyadicRealMid ε (b_t + r) Y_r := rfl
    have hWbar_eq : W_bar = dyadicRealMid ε (b_t + m * t) W := rfl
    have hZbar_eq : Z_bar = dyadicRealMid ε (b_t + m * t + r) Z_r := rfl
    have hεb_pos : 0 < ε ^ b_t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ b_t
    have hεbm_pos : 0 < ε ^ (b_t + m * t) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (b_t + m * t)
    have hX_diff : |X - X_bar| < ε ^ b_t := by
      rw [hXbar_eq]; exact (h_mid1D b_t X).2
    have hW_diff : |W - W_bar| < ε ^ (b_t + m * t) := by
      rw [hWbar_eq]; exact (h_mid1D (b_t + m * t) W).2
    have hY_diff : |Y_r - Y_bar| < 2 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r := by
      have h1 : |Y_r - Y_bar| < ε ^ (b_t + r) := by
        rw [hYbar_eq]; exact (h_mid1D (b_t + r) Y_r).2
      rw [Real.rpow_add hε₀] at h1
      nlinarith
    have hZ_diff : |Z_r - Z_bar| < 2 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r := by
      have h1 : |Z_r - Z_bar| < ε ^ (b_t + m * t + r) := by
        rw [hZbar_eq]; exact (h_mid1D (b_t + m * t + r) Z_r).2
      rw [Real.rpow_add hε₀] at h1
      nlinarith
    have hv0_le : |(X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 8 * ε ^ b_t), div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have hv1_le : |(W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t))| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t)), div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have ha0_le : |((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r), div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h_tri := abs_sub (Y_r - Y_bar) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar))
      have h_mul : |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)| = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * |X - X_bar| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r)]
      nlinarith
    have ha1_le : |((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) /
        (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r),
        div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h_tri := abs_sub (Z_r - Z_bar) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar))
      have h_mul : |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)| = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * |W - W_bar| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r)]
      nlinarith
    let V_raw : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2
      ![(X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t), (W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t))]
    let A_raw : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2
      ![((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r),
        ((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r)]
    have hV_norm : ‖V_raw‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have hsq := h_norm2_sq ((X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t)) ((W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t)))
      have h0 : ((X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t)) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)])
      have h1 : ((W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t))) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)])
      have hV_nn : 0 ≤ ‖V_raw‖ := norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have hA_norm : ‖A_raw‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have hsq := h_norm2_sq
        (((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r))
        (((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r))
      have h0 : (((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r)) ^ 2 ≤
          (1 / 2) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)])
      have h1 : (((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) /
          (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r)) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)])
      have hA_nn : 0 ≤ ‖A_raw‖ := norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have hV_eq : V_j (J ω) (T_idx ω) = V_raw := by
      change rowGrowthClamp2D V_raw = V_raw
      simp [rowGrowthClamp2D, hV_norm]
    have hA_eq : A_j (J ω) (T_idx ω) = A_raw := by
      change rowGrowthClamp2D A_raw = A_raw
      simp [rowGrowthClamp2D, hA_norm]
    exact ⟨hCr_mem, hRbar_abs, hV_eq, hA_eq⟩

  
  let S_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω => 0 < π ω)
  have h_pi_zero : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ω ∉ S_pos → π ω = 0 := by
    intro ω hω
    have hle : π ω ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra hgt
      exact hω (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, lt_of_not_ge hgt⟩)
    exact le_antisymm hle (hπ_nn ω)
  have hS_pos_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω = 1 := by
    rw [← hπ_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos) (fun ω _ hω => h_pi_zero ω hω)
  have hS_pos_ne : S_pos.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hemp
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hemp, Finset.sum_empty] at hS_pos_sum
    norm_num at hS_pos_sum
  obtain ⟨ω_star, hω_star_mem⟩ := hS_pos_ne
  have hj_star_mem : J ω_star ∈ S_J := Finset.mem_image_of_mem J hω_star_mem

  have hp_J_eq_filter : ∀ j, p_J j = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos with J ω = j, π ω := by
    intro j
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos) ?_).symm
    intro ω _ hω
    simp [h_pi_zero ω hω]
  have hp_J_sum : ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j = 1 := by
    calc ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j
        = ∑ j ∈ S_J, ∑ ω ∈ S_pos with J ω = j, π ω :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hp_J_eq_filter j)
      _ = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω :=
          Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem J hω) π
      _ = 1 := hS_pos_sum
  have hp_J_nn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p_J j := fun j =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
  have hp_J_pos : ∀ j ∈ S_J, 0 < p_J j := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨ω, hω_pos, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
    have hω_pi : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_pos).2
    have h_le : (if J ω = J ω then π ω else 0) ≤ p_J (J ω) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω' => if J ω' = J ω then π ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
        (Finset.mem_univ ω)
    simp only [↓reduceIte] at h_le
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pi h_le

  have hπ_j_eq : ∀ j ω, π_j j ω = if J ω = j then π ω / p_J j else 0 := by
    intro j ω
    by_cases h : J ω = j <;> simp [π_j, rowGrowthRestrictLaw, p_J, Finset.sum_filter, h]
  have hπ_j_law : ∀ j ∈ S_J, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_j j ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_j j ω = 1) := by
    intro j hj
    have hpj := hp_J_pos j hj
    refine ⟨fun ω => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hπ_j_eq]
      split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) hpj.le
      · exact le_rfl
    · simp_rw [hπ_j_eq]
      have h_div : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω / p_J j else 0) =
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) / p_J j := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [h_div]
      exact div_self hpj.ne'

  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_TJ : Fin N_T → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun tid j =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j then π ω else 0
  let p_Tj : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin N_T → ℝ := fun j tid =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π_j j ω else 0
  have hp_Tj_div : ∀ j tid, p_Tj j tid = p_TJ tid j / p_J j := by
    intro j tid
    dsimp [p_Tj, p_TJ]
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    rw [hπ_j_eq]
    by_cases h1 : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases h2 : J ω = j <;> simp [h1, h2]
  have hp_TJ_mul : ∀ j ∈ S_J, ∀ tid, p_J j * p_Tj j tid = p_TJ tid j := by
    intro j hj tid
    rw [hp_Tj_div]
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hp_J_pos j hj).ne'

  let e_0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0]
  have he_0_norm : ‖e_0‖ = 1 := by
    have hsq := h_norm2_sq 1 0
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖e_0‖ := norm_nonneg _
    change ‖e_0‖ ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 + 0 ^ 2 at hsq
    nlinarith
  have hperp_e0_norm : ‖perp2D e_0‖ = 1 := by
    have hsq : ‖perp2D e_0‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      unfold perp2D
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [e_0]
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖perp2D e_0‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith

  let ell_tilde : ℝ := Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹)
  have h_ex_loc : ∀ j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ,
      ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        j ∈ S_J →
          (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ 1 ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_Tj j tid) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
            |inner ℝ (V_j j tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_j j tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_j j tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_j j tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_D d)) ∧
          (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
           let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
             q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_Tj j tid * q_D d))) / ell_tilde
           let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
           classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) -
             δ_target / 3 ≤ E_w - I_TD) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j ∈ S_J
    · obtain ⟨hπj_nn, hπj_sum⟩ := hπ_j_law j hj
      let A_set : Set ℝ := { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ 1 ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_Tj j tid) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
            |inner ℝ (V_j j tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_j j tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_j j tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_j j tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_D d)) ∧
          (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
           let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
             q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_Tj j tid * q_D d))) / ell_tilde
           let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
           s = E_w - I_TD) }
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ A_set := by
        refine ⟨1, (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => e_0), (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => 0),
          (fun tid _ => p_Tj j tid), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro _
          exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, zero_le_one, he_0_norm⟩
        · intro tid _
          exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπj_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
        · intro tid
          exact Fin.sum_univ_one _
        · intro tid _ _
          have hv := (hVA_j j tid).1
          have ha := (hVA_j j tid).2
          rw [Real.rpow_zero]
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · calc |inner ℝ (V_j j tid - 0) e_0| ≤ ‖V_j j tid - 0‖ * ‖e_0‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
              _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by rw [sub_zero, he_0_norm]; linarith
              _ ≤ 10 * 1 := by norm_num
          · calc |inner ℝ (V_j j tid - 0) (perp2D e_0)| ≤ ‖V_j j tid - 0‖ * ‖perp2D e_0‖ :=
                abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
              _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by rw [sub_zero, hperp_e0_norm]; linarith
              _ ≤ 10 * 1 := by norm_num
          · calc |inner ℝ (A_j j tid - 0) e_0| ≤ ‖A_j j tid - 0‖ * ‖e_0‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
              _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by rw [sub_zero, he_0_norm]; linarith
              _ ≤ 10 * 1 := by norm_num
          · calc |inner ℝ (A_j j tid - 0) (perp2D e_0)| ≤ ‖A_j j tid - 0‖ * ‖perp2D e_0‖ :=
                abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
              _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by rw [sub_zero, hperp_e0_norm]; linarith
              _ ≤ 10 * 1 := by norm_num
        · dsimp only
          have hqD0 : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_Tj j tid = 1 := by
            calc ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_Tj j tid
                = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ with T_idx ω = tid, π_j j ω :=
                  Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm)
              _ = ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ, π_j j ω := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ T_idx (π_j j)
              _ = 1 := hπj_sum
          have hEw : (∑ d : Fin 1, (∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_Tj j tid) *
              ((1 + γ) * 0 + (1 - γ) * 0)) = 0 := by simp
          have hITD : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin 1,
              p_Tj j tid * Real.log (p_Tj j tid / (p_Tj j tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, p_Tj j tid')))) = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun tid _ => ?_)
            rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, hqD0, mul_one]
            by_cases hp0 : p_Tj j tid = 0
            · simp [hp0]
            · rw [div_self hp0, Real.log_one, mul_zero]
          rw [hEw, hITD, zero_div, sub_zero]
      have h_lt_sup : sSup A_set - δ_target / 3 < sSup A_set := by linarith
      obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_gt⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup ⟨0, h0_mem⟩ h_lt_sup
      obtain ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h1, h2, h3, h4, rfl⟩ := hs_mem
      refine ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, fun _ => ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, ?_⟩⟩
      change classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) -
          δ_target / 3 ≤ _
      have h_sup_eq : classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) =
          sSup A_set := rfl
      rw [h_sup_eq]
      exact hs_gt.le
    · exact ⟨0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0,
        fun _ => Fin.elim0, fun h => absurd h hj⟩
  choose N_D_raw b_raw a_raw e_raw V_raw_c A_raw_c q_raw_k h_raw_spec using h_ex_loc

  let D_max : ℕ := S_J.sup N_D_raw + 1
  have hD_max : 1 ≤ D_max := Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hND_le : ∀ j ∈ S_J, N_D_raw j ≤ D_max := fun j hj =>
    le_trans (Finset.le_sup hj) (Nat.le_succ _)

  let b_pad : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin D_max → ℝ := fun j d =>
    if hd : d.1 < N_D_raw j then b_raw j ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0
  let a_pad : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin D_max → ℝ := fun j d =>
    if hd : d.1 < N_D_raw j then a_raw j ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0
  let e_pad : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin D_max → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j d =>
    if hd : d.1 < N_D_raw j then e_raw j ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else e_0
  let V_pad : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin D_max → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j d =>
    if hd : d.1 < N_D_raw j then V_raw_c j ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0
  let A_pad : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin D_max → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j d =>
    if hd : d.1 < N_D_raw j then A_raw_c j ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0
  let q_pad : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin N_T → Fin D_max → ℝ := fun j tid d =>
    if hd : d.1 < N_D_raw j then q_raw_k j tid ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0

  have h_sum_pad : ∀ (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (hj : j ∈ S_J) (F : Fin D_max → ℝ),
      (∀ d : Fin D_max, ¬ d.1 < N_D_raw j → F d = 0) →
      ∑ d : Fin D_max, F d = ∑ d' : Fin (N_D_raw j), F (Fin.castLEEmb (hND_le j hj) d') := by
    intro j hj F hF_zero
    let emb := Fin.castLEEmb (hND_le j hj)
    have h_sub : ∑ d : Fin D_max, F d = ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.map emb, F d := by
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) ?_).symm
      intro d _ hd_not
      refine hF_zero d (fun hd_lt => hd_not ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_map]
      refine ⟨⟨d.1, hd_lt⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      ext
      rfl
    rw [h_sub, Finset.sum_map]

  let q_Dj : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin D_max → ℝ := fun j d =>
    ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_pad j tid d
  let E_wj : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun j =>
    ∑ d : Fin D_max, q_Dj j d * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d)
  let I_TDj : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun j =>
    (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin D_max,
      q_pad j tid d * Real.log (q_pad j tid d / (p_Tj j tid * q_Dj j d))) / ell_tilde

  have h_pad_props : ∀ j ∈ S_J,
      (∀ d : Fin D_max, 0 ≤ b_pad j d ∧ b_pad j d ≤ a_pad j d ∧ a_pad j d ≤ 1 ∧ ‖e_pad j d‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q_pad j tid d) ∧
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin D_max, q_pad j tid d = p_Tj j tid) ∧
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin D_max, 0 < q_pad j tid d →
        |inner ℝ (V_j j tid - V_pad j d) (e_pad j d)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_pad j d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_j j tid - V_pad j d) (perp2D (e_pad j d))| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_pad j d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_j j tid - A_pad j d) (e_pad j d)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_pad j d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_j j tid - A_pad j d) (perp2D (e_pad j d))| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_pad j d)) ∧
      classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) -
        δ_target / 3 ≤ E_wj j - I_TDj j := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := h_raw_spec j hj
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d
      dsimp [b_pad, a_pad, e_pad]
      split_ifs with hd
      · exact h1 ⟨d.1, hd⟩
      · exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, zero_le_one, he_0_norm⟩
    · intro tid d
      dsimp [q_pad]
      split_ifs with hd
      · exact h2 tid ⟨d.1, hd⟩
      · exact le_rfl
    · intro tid
      rw [h_sum_pad j hj (fun d => q_pad j tid d) (fun d hd => by simp [q_pad, hd])]
      rw [← h3 tid]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d' _ => ?_)
      simp [q_pad, d'.2]
    · intro tid d hq_pos
      dsimp [q_pad] at hq_pos
      split_ifs at hq_pos with hd
      · simp only [b_pad, a_pad, e_pad, V_pad, A_pad, hd, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact h4 tid ⟨d.1, hd⟩ hq_pos
      · linarith
    · have hqD_eq : ∀ d' : Fin (N_D_raw j),
          q_Dj j (Fin.castLEEmb (hND_le j hj) d') = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_raw_k j tid d' := by
        intro d'
        dsimp [q_Dj]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
        simp [q_pad, d'.2]
      have hEw_eq : E_wj j = ∑ d' : Fin (N_D_raw j),
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_raw_k j tid d') *
            ((1 + γ) * b_raw j d' + (1 - γ) * a_raw j d') := by
        dsimp [E_wj]
        rw [h_sum_pad j hj _ (fun d hd => by
          have hq0 : q_Dj j d = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun tid _ => by simp [q_pad, hd])
          simp [hq0])]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d' _ => ?_)
        rw [hqD_eq d']
        simp [b_pad, a_pad, d'.2]
      have hITD_eq : I_TDj j = (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d' : Fin (N_D_raw j),
          q_raw_k j tid d' * Real.log (q_raw_k j tid d' /
            (p_Tj j tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q_raw_k j tid' d')))) / ell_tilde := by
        dsimp [I_TDj]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
        rw [h_sum_pad j hj _ (fun d hd => by simp [q_pad, hd])]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d' _ => ?_)
        rw [hqD_eq d']
        simp [q_pad, d'.2]
      rw [hEw_eq, hITD_eq]
      exact h5

  have h_ex_comp : ∀ (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (d : Fin D_max),
      ∃ (p_c q_c : ℝ) (e_c V_c X_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        j ∈ S_J →
          let C_r := ((j.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
          let R_bar := ((j.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t)
          let X_bar := ((j.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t
          let Y_bar := ((j.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + r)
          let W_bar := ((j.2.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t)
          let Z_bar := ((j.2.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t + r)
          0 ≤ p_c ∧ p_c ≤ q_c ∧ q_c + r ≤ 1 + m ∧ ‖e_c‖ = 1 ∧
          (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + (t - r) * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d) ≤
            (1 + γ) * p_c + (1 - γ) * q_c ∧
          (∀ V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            let X := V_p 0
            let W := V_p 1 - R_bar * X
            let Y_r := A_p 0 + C_r * X
            let Z_r := A_p 1 + C_r * (V_p 1) - R_bar * Y_r
            let V_raw := WithLp.toLp 2
              ![(X - X_bar) / (8 * ε ^ b_t), (W - W_bar) / (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t))]
            let A_raw := WithLp.toLp 2
              ![((Y_r - Y_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (X - X_bar)) / (8 * ε ^ b_t * Δ_r),
                ((Z_r - Z_bar) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (W - W_bar)) /
                  (8 * ε ^ (b_t + m * t) * Δ_r)]
            |inner ℝ (V_raw - V_pad j d) (e_pad j d)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ (b_pad j d) →
            |inner ℝ (V_raw - V_pad j d) (perp2D (e_pad j d))| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ (a_pad j d) →
            |inner ℝ (A_raw - A_pad j d) (e_pad j d)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ (b_pad j d) →
            |inner ℝ (A_raw - A_pad j d) (perp2D (e_pad j d))| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ (t - r)) ^ (a_pad j d) →
            |inner ℝ (V_p - V_c) e_c| ≤ 600 * ε ^ p_c ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_p - V_c) (perp2D e_c)| ≤ 600 * ε ^ q_c ∧
            |inner ℝ ((A_p + C_r • V_p) - X_c) e_c| ≤ 600 * ε ^ (p_c + r) ∧
            |inner ℝ ((A_p + C_r • V_p) - X_c) (perp2D e_c)| ≤ 600 * ε ^ (q_c + r)) := by
    intro j d
    by_cases hj : j ∈ S_J
    · obtain ⟨ω_j, hω_j_mem, hJ_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
      have hω_j_pos : 0 < π ω_j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_j_mem).2
      have hR_j : |((j.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t)| ≤ 3 / 2 := by
        rw [← hJ_eq]
        exact (h_cell_geom ω_j hω_j_pos).2.1
      obtain ⟨hb0, hba, ha1, he1⟩ := (h_pad_props j hj).1 d
      obtain ⟨p_c, q_c, e_c, V_c, X_c, h_out⟩ := h_svd
        (((j.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (m * t))
        (((j.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t)
        (((j.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + r))
        (((j.2.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t))
        (((j.2.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + m * t + r))
        (((j.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r) Δ_r (b_pad j d) (a_pad j d)
        (e_pad j d) (V_pad j d) (A_pad j d)
        hR_j hΔ_pos hΔ_le hb0 hba ha1 he1
      exact ⟨p_c, q_c, e_c, V_c, X_c, fun _ => h_out⟩
    · exact ⟨0, 0, e_0, 0, 0, fun h => absurd h hj⟩
  choose b_comp a_comp e_comp V_comp X_comp h_comp_spec using h_ex_comp

  
  let N_G : ℕ := S_J.card * D_max
  let e_G_idx : ↥S_J × Fin D_max ≃ Fin N_G :=
    (Equiv.prodCongr S_J.equivFin (Equiv.refl (Fin D_max))).trans finProdFinEquiv
  let cell_of : Fin N_G → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun g => (e_G_idx.symm g).1.1
  let idx_of : Fin N_G → Fin D_max := fun g => (e_G_idx.symm g).2
  have hcell_mem : ∀ g : Fin N_G, cell_of g ∈ S_J := fun g => (e_G_idx.symm g).1.2

  let e_prod : Fin N_ω × Fin D_max ≃ Fin (N_ω * D_max) := finProdFinEquiv
  let k_r : Fin N_ω → ℤ := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)
  let π' : Fin (N_ω * D_max) → ℝ := fun z =>
    let p := e_prod.symm z
    if 0 < π p.1 then π p.1 * q_pad (J p.1) (T_idx p.1) p.2 / p_Tj (J p.1) (T_idx p.1) else 0
  let T'_idx : Fin (N_ω * D_max) → Fin N_T := fun z => T_idx (e_prod.symm z).1
  let k'_time : Fin (N_ω * D_max) → ℤ := fun z => k_r (e_prod.symm z).1
  let G_idx : Fin (N_ω * D_max) → Fin N_G := fun z =>
    let p := e_prod.symm z
    if hj : J p.1 ∈ S_J then e_G_idx (⟨J p.1, hj⟩, p.2)
    else e_G_idx (⟨J ω_star, hj_star_mem⟩, p.2)

  have h_pos_pt : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
      J ω ∈ S_J ∧ 0 < p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) ∧ 0 < p_Tj (J ω) (T_idx ω) ∧ 0 < p_T (T_idx ω) := by
    intro ω hω
    have hj : J ω ∈ S_J := Finset.mem_image_of_mem J (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hω⟩)
    have hpTJ : 0 < p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) := by
      have h_le : (if T_idx ω = T_idx ω ∧ J ω = J ω then π ω else 0) ≤ p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω' => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ J ω' = J ω then π ω' else 0)
          (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
          (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      simp only [and_self, ↓reduceIte] at h_le
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω h_le
    have hpTj : 0 < p_Tj (J ω) (T_idx ω) := by
      rw [hp_Tj_div]
      exact div_pos hpTJ (hp_J_pos (J ω) hj)
    have hpT : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω) := by
      have h_le : (if T_idx ω = T_idx ω then π ω else 0) ≤ p_T (T_idx ω) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω' => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω then π ω' else 0)
          (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
          (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      simp only [↓reduceIte] at h_le
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω h_le
    exact ⟨hj, hpTJ, hpTj, hpT⟩

  have hπ'_nn : ∀ z : Fin (N_ω * D_max), 0 ≤ π' z := by
    intro z
    dsimp [π']
    split_ifs with hω
    · obtain ⟨hj, _, hpTj, _⟩ := h_pos_pt (e_prod.symm z).1 hω
      have hq_nn := (h_pad_props (J (e_prod.symm z).1) hj).2.1
        (T_idx (e_prod.symm z).1) (e_prod.symm z).2
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hω.le hq_nn) hpTj.le
    · exact le_rfl

  have h_sum_d_pi' : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ d : Fin D_max, π' (e_prod (ω, d)) = π ω := by
    intro ω
    dsimp [π']
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
    · obtain ⟨hj, _, hpTj, _⟩ := h_pos_pt ω hω
      simp only [hω, ↓reduceIte]
      have h_factor : (∑ d : Fin D_max, π ω * q_pad (J ω) (T_idx ω) d / p_Tj (J ω) (T_idx ω)) =
          π ω * (∑ d : Fin D_max, q_pad (J ω) (T_idx ω) d) / p_Tj (J ω) (T_idx ω) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [h_factor, (h_pad_props (J ω) hj).2.2.1 (T_idx ω), mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hpTj.ne']
    · simp only [hω, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      exact (le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (hπ_nn ω)).symm

  have hπ'_sum : ∑ z : Fin (N_ω * D_max), π' z = 1 := by
    rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv e_prod (fun p => π' (e_prod p)) π' (fun _ => rfl),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [h_sum_d_pi']
    exact hπ_sum

  let p'_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid =>
    ∑ z : Fin (N_ω * D_max), if T'_idx z = tid then π' z else 0
  have hp'_T_eq : p'_T = p_T := by
    ext tid
    dsimp [p'_T, p_T, T'_idx]
    rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv e_prod
      (fun p => if T_idx p.1 = tid then π' (e_prod p) else 0)
      (fun z => if T_idx (e_prod.symm z).1 = tid then π' z else 0)
      (fun p => by simp),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases htid : T_idx ω = tid
    · simp only [htid, ↓reduceIte, h_sum_d_pi']
    · simp [htid]

  have h_root_eq : classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ (N_ω * D_max) N_T π' T'_idx V_part A_part =
      classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part := by
    unfold classicalRootSupremum
    change (let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹); sSup _) = (let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹); sSup _)
    rw [show (fun tid => ∑ z : Fin (N_ω * D_max), if T'_idx z = tid then π' z else 0) = p_T
      from hp'_T_eq]

  
  let p'_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g =>
    ∑ z : Fin (N_ω * D_max), if G_idx z = g then π' z else 0
  let p'_TG : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun tid g =>
    ∑ z : Fin (N_ω * D_max), if T'_idx z = tid ∧ G_idx z = g then π' z else 0

  have hp'_TG_cell : ∀ (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (hj : j ∈ S_J) (tid : Fin N_T) (d : Fin D_max),
      p'_TG tid (e_G_idx (⟨j, hj⟩, d)) = p_J j * q_pad j tid d := by
    intro j hj tid d
    dsimp [p'_TG]
    rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv e_prod
      (fun p => if T'_idx (e_prod p) = tid ∧ G_idx (e_prod p) = e_G_idx (⟨j, hj⟩, d)
        then π' (e_prod p) else 0)
      (fun z => if T'_idx z = tid ∧ G_idx z = e_G_idx (⟨j, hj⟩, d) then π' z else 0)
      (fun _ => rfl),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h_inner : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
        (∑ d' : Fin D_max,
          if T'_idx (e_prod (ω, d')) = tid ∧ G_idx (e_prod (ω, d')) = e_G_idx (⟨j, hj⟩, d)
          then π' (e_prod (ω, d')) else 0) =
        (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j then π ω else 0) * (q_pad j tid d / p_Tj j tid) := by
      intro ω
      dsimp [T'_idx, G_idx, π']
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
      · obtain ⟨hjω, _, _, _⟩ := h_pos_pt ω hω
        simp only [hjω, ↓reduceDIte, hω, ↓reduceIte]
        have h_inj : ∀ d' : Fin D_max,
            (e_G_idx (⟨J ω, hjω⟩, d') = e_G_idx (⟨j, hj⟩, d)) ↔ (J ω = j ∧ d' = d) := by
          intro d'
          rw [e_G_idx.injective.eq_iff, Prod.ext_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]
        simp_rw [h_inj]
        by_cases h_tj : T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j
        · rcases h_tj with ⟨htid, hJeq⟩
          have h_sum_d' : (∑ d' : Fin D_max,
              if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j ∧ d' = d
              then π ω * q_pad (J ω) (T_idx ω) d' / p_Tj (J ω) (T_idx ω) else 0) =
              π ω * q_pad j tid d / p_Tj j tid := by
            simp_rw [htid, hJeq, true_and]
            exact Fintype.sum_ite_eq' d (fun d' => π ω * q_pad j tid d' / p_Tj j tid)
          rw [h_sum_d']
          simp only [htid, hJeq, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          ring
        · simp only [h_tj, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs with h_all
          · exact absurd ⟨h_all.1, h_all.2.1⟩ h_tj
          · rfl
      · have hπ0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (hπ_nn ω)
        simp [hπ0]
    simp_rw [h_inner, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    change p_TJ tid j * (q_pad j tid d / p_Tj j tid) = p_J j * q_pad j tid d
    rw [← hp_TJ_mul j hj tid]
    by_cases hp0 : p_Tj j tid = 0
    · have hq0 : q_pad j tid d = 0 := by
        have h_sum0 : ∑ d' : Fin D_max, q_pad j tid d' = 0 := by
          rw [(h_pad_props j hj).2.2.1 tid, hp0]
        have h_le : q_pad j tid d ≤ ∑ d' : Fin D_max, q_pad j tid d' :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => (h_pad_props j hj).2.1 tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d)
        exact le_antisymm (h_le.trans h_sum0.le) ((h_pad_props j hj).2.1 tid d)
      simp [hp0, hq0]
    · field_simp [hp0]

  have hp'_G_sum_T : ∀ g : Fin N_G, p'_G g = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p'_TG tid g := by
    intro g
    dsimp [p'_G, p'_TG]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
    by_cases hg : G_idx z = g
    · simp only [hg, and_true]
      exact (Fintype.sum_ite_eq (T'_idx z) (fun _ => π' z)).symm
    · simp [hg]

  have hp'_G_cell : ∀ (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (hj : j ∈ S_J) (d : Fin D_max),
      p'_G (e_G_idx (⟨j, hj⟩, d)) = p_J j * q_Dj j d := by
    intro j hj d
    rw [hp'_G_sum_T]
    simp_rw [hp'_TG_cell j hj _ d, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    rfl

  
  let b_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => b_comp (cell_of g) (idx_of g)
  let a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => a_comp (cell_of g) (idx_of g)
  have hEw_lb : (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * E_wj j) ≤
      ∑ g : Fin N_G, p'_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g) := by
    rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv e_G_idx
      (fun jd => p'_G (e_G_idx jd) * ((1 + γ) * b_G (e_G_idx jd) + (1 - γ) * a_G (e_G_idx jd)))
      (fun g => p'_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g))
      (fun _ => rfl),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h_lhs_id : (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * E_wj j) =
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * E_wj j) := by
      calc (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * E_wj j)
          = (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j) * (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) +
            η * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * E_wj j) := by rw [hp_J_sum, one_mul]
        _ = (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t)) +
            (∑ j ∈ S_J, η * (p_J j * E_wj j)) := by rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * E_wj j) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
    rw [h_lhs_id]
    have h_rhs_attach : (∑ j_sub : ↥S_J, ∑ d : Fin D_max,
        p'_G (e_G_idx (j_sub, d)) *
          ((1 + γ) * b_G (e_G_idx (j_sub, d)) + (1 - γ) * a_G (e_G_idx (j_sub, d)))) =
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, ∑ d : Fin D_max,
          (p_J j * q_Dj j d) * ((1 + γ) * b_comp j d + (1 - γ) * a_comp j d) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_attach S_J]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j_sub _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_))
      rw [hp'_G_cell j_sub.1 j_sub.2 d]
      dsimp [b_G, a_G, cell_of, idx_of]
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [h_rhs_attach]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => ?_)
    have hqD_sum1 : ∑ d : Fin D_max, q_Dj j d = 1 := by
      dsimp [q_Dj]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [(h_pad_props j hj).2.2.1]
      calc ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_Tj j tid
          = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ with T_idx ω = tid, π_j j ω :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm)
        _ = ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ, π_j j ω := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ T_idx (π_j j)
        _ = 1 := (hπ_j_law j hj).2
    have h_cell_w : (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * E_wj j =
        ∑ d : Fin D_max, q_Dj j d *
          ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d)) := by
      dsimp [E_wj]
      calc (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) +
            η * ∑ d : Fin D_max, q_Dj j d * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d)
          = (∑ d : Fin D_max, q_Dj j d) * (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) +
            η * ∑ d : Fin D_max, q_Dj j d * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d) := by
            rw [hqD_sum1, one_mul]
        _ = (∑ d : Fin D_max, q_Dj j d * (2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t)) +
            (∑ d : Fin D_max, η * (q_Dj j d * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d))) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ d : Fin D_max, q_Dj j d *
            ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d)) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => by ring)
    rw [h_cell_w, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => ?_)
    have hqD_nn : 0 ≤ p_J j * q_Dj j d :=
      mul_nonneg (hp_J_nn j) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun tid _ => (h_pad_props j hj).2.1 tid d))
    have h_svd_w := (h_comp_spec j d hj).2.2.2.2.1
    calc p_J j * (q_Dj j d *
          ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + η * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d)))
        = (p_J j * q_Dj j d) *
          ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) + (t - r) * ((1 + γ) * b_pad j d + (1 - γ) * a_pad j d)) := by
          dsimp [η]; ring
      _ ≤ (p_J j * q_Dj j d) * ((1 + γ) * b_comp j d + (1 - γ) * a_comp j d) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_svd_w hqD_nn

  
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let S_cells : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image k'_time
  let p'_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ z : Fin (N_ω * D_max), if T'_idx z = tid ∧ k'_time z = k then π' z else 0
  let p_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k then π ω else 0
  have hp'_TC_eq : p'_TC = p_TC := by
    ext tid k
    dsimp [p'_TC, p_TC, T'_idx, k'_time]
    rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv e_prod
      (fun p => if T_idx p.1 = tid ∧ k_r p.1 = k then π' (e_prod p) else 0)
      (fun z => if T_idx (e_prod.symm z).1 = tid ∧ k_r (e_prod.symm z).1 = k then π' z else 0)
      (fun p => by simp),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases htk : T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k
    · simp [htk, h_sum_d_pi']
    · simp [htk]

  have hSt_eq : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
      -(p'_TC tid k * Real.log (p'_TC tid k / p'_T tid))) / ell =
      finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_r := by
    rw [hp'_TC_eq, hp'_T_eq]
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    change _ = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_r ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / ell)
    have h_prob1 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [h]
    have h_prob2 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt2 π T_idx k_r ω = p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_r ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ k_r ω' = k_r ω <;> simp [h]
    simp_rw [h_prob1, h_prob2]
    have h_rhs_div : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        π ω * (-(Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_r ω) / p_T (T_idx ω))) / ell)) =
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_r ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)))) / ell := by
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      ring
    rw [h_rhs_div]
    congr 1
    let d₀ : Fin D_max := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ T_idx
      (fun ω => -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_r ω) / p_T (T_idx ω))))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
    let F_tid := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin N_ω => T_idx ω = tid)
    have h_maps_k : ∀ ω ∈ F_tid, k_r ω ∈ S_cells := by
      intro ω _
      have h_eq : k_r ω = k'_time (e_prod (ω, d₀)) := by
        dsimp [k'_time]
        simp
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem k'_time (Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps_k
      (fun ω => -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_r ω) / p_T (T_idx ω))))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    have h_fib : (∑ ω ∈ F_tid with k_r ω = k,
        -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_r ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)))) =
        ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ with T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k,
          -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr (by ext ω; simp [F_tid]) (fun ω hω => ?_)
      obtain ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
      rw [h1, h2]
    rw [h_fib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_filter]

  
  have hMI_J : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J =
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ j ∈ S_J,
        p_TJ tid j * Real.log (p_TJ tid j / (p_T tid * p_J j))) / ell := by
    unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
    have h_p0 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      simp [hπ_sum]
    have h_pJ : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) J ω = p_J (J ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : J ω' = J ω <;> simp [h]
    have h_pT : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [h]
    have h_pTJ : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt2 π T_idx J ω = p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ J ω' = J ω <;> simp [h]
    simp_rw [h_p0, h_pJ, h_pT, h_pTJ, div_one]
    have h_comb : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-(Real.log (p_J (J ω))) / ell)) -
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-(Real.log (p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) / p_T (T_idx ω))) / ell)) =
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          π ω * (Real.log (p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) - Real.log (p_J (J ω)))) / ell := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      ring
    rw [h_comb]
    congr 1
    have h_sub_pos : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        π ω * (Real.log (p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) - Real.log (p_J (J ω)))) =
        ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * Real.log (p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_J (J ω))) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos)
        (fun ω _ hω => by simp [h_pi_zero ω hω])]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      obtain ⟨hj, hpTJ, _, hpT⟩ := h_pos_pt ω hω_pos
      have hpJ := hp_J_pos (J ω) hj
      rw [← Real.log_div (div_pos hpTJ hpT).ne' hpJ.ne', div_div]
    rw [h_sub_pos, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise S_pos T_idx
      (fun ω => π ω * Real.log (p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_J (J ω))))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
    let S_pos_tid := S_pos.filter (fun ω => T_idx ω = tid)
    have h_maps_J : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos_tid, J ω ∈ S_J := by
      intro ω hω
      exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem J (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps_J
      (fun ω => π ω * Real.log (p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_J (J ω))))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    have h_fib : (∑ ω ∈ S_pos_tid with J ω = j,
        π ω * Real.log (p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_J (J ω)))) =
        (∑ ω ∈ S_pos with T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j, π ω) *
          Real.log (p_TJ tid j / (p_T tid * p_J j)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr (by ext ω; simp [S_pos_tid, and_assoc]) (fun ω hω => ?_)
      obtain ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
      rw [h1, h2]
    rw [h_fib]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos)
      (fun ω _ hω => by simp [h_pi_zero ω hω])

  have hell_tilde_eq : ell_tilde = η * ell := by
    dsimp [ell_tilde, ell, ε_tilde, η]
    rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_rpow hε₀, Real.log_inv]
    ring

  have hITG_eq : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
      p'_TG tid g * Real.log (p'_TG tid g / (p'_T tid * p'_G g))) / ell =
      finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J + η * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * I_TDj j) := by
    rw [hp'_T_eq]
    have h_sum_g : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
        (∑ g : Fin N_G, p'_TG tid g * Real.log (p'_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p'_G g))) =
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, ∑ d : Fin D_max,
          (p_J j * q_pad j tid d) *
            Real.log ((p_J j * q_pad j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_Dj j d))) := by
      intro tid
      rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv e_G_idx
        (fun jd => p'_TG tid (e_G_idx jd) * Real.log (p'_TG tid (e_G_idx jd) / (p_T tid * p'_G (e_G_idx jd))))
        (fun g => p'_TG tid g * Real.log (p'_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p'_G g)))
        (fun _ => rfl),
        Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← Finset.sum_attach S_J]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j_sub _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_))
      rw [hp'_TG_cell j_sub.1 j_sub.2 tid d, hp'_G_cell j_sub.1 j_sub.2 d]
    simp_rw [h_sum_g]
    have h_split_cell : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ), j ∈ S_J →
        (∑ d : Fin D_max,
          (p_J j * q_pad j tid d) *
            Real.log ((p_J j * q_pad j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_Dj j d)))) =
        p_TJ tid j * Real.log (p_TJ tid j / (p_T tid * p_J j)) +
        p_J j * (∑ d : Fin D_max,
          q_pad j tid d * Real.log (q_pad j tid d / (p_Tj j tid * q_Dj j d))) := by
      intro tid j hj
      have hpJ := hp_J_pos j hj
      have h_term : ∀ d : Fin D_max,
          (p_J j * q_pad j tid d) *
            Real.log ((p_J j * q_pad j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_Dj j d))) =
          (p_J j * q_pad j tid d) * Real.log (p_TJ tid j / (p_T tid * p_J j)) +
          p_J j * (q_pad j tid d * Real.log (q_pad j tid d / (p_Tj j tid * q_Dj j d))) := by
        intro d
        have hq_nn := (h_pad_props j hj).2.1 tid d
        by_cases hq_pos : 0 < q_pad j tid d
        · have hpTj_pos : 0 < p_Tj j tid := by
            have h_le : q_pad j tid d ≤ ∑ d' : Fin D_max, q_pad j tid d' :=
              Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => (h_pad_props j hj).2.1 tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d)
            rw [(h_pad_props j hj).2.2.1 tid] at h_le
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos h_le
          have hpTJ_pos : 0 < p_TJ tid j := by
            rw [← hp_TJ_mul j hj tid]
            exact mul_pos hpJ hpTj_pos
          have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
            have h_le : p_TJ tid j ≤ p_T tid := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
              by_cases h1 : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases h2 : J ω = j <;>
                simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpTJ_pos h_le
          have hqD_pos : 0 < q_Dj j d := by
            have h_le : q_pad j tid d ≤ q_Dj j d :=
              Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => (h_pad_props j hj).2.1 tid' d)
                (Finset.mem_univ tid)
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos h_le
          have h_prod : (p_J j * q_pad j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_Dj j d)) =
              (p_TJ tid j / (p_T tid * p_J j)) * (q_pad j tid d / (p_Tj j tid * q_Dj j d)) := by
            rw [← hp_TJ_mul j hj tid]
            field_simp [hpJ.ne', hpT_pos.ne', hpTj_pos.ne', hqD_pos.ne']
          rw [h_prod, Real.log_mul (div_pos hpTJ_pos (mul_pos hpT_pos hpJ)).ne'
            (div_pos hq_pos (mul_pos hpTj_pos hqD_pos)).ne']
          ring
        · have hq0 : q_pad j tid d = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hq_pos) hq_nn
          simp [hq0]
      simp_rw [h_term, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum,
        (h_pad_props j hj).2.2.1 tid, hp_TJ_mul j hj tid]
    have h_sum_T : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ j ∈ S_J, ∑ d : Fin D_max,
        (p_J j * q_pad j tid d) *
          Real.log ((p_J j * q_pad j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_Dj j d)))) =
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ j ∈ S_J,
          p_TJ tid j * Real.log (p_TJ tid j / (p_T tid * p_J j))) +
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin D_max,
          q_pad j tid d * Real.log (q_pad j tid d / (p_Tj j tid * q_Dj j d))) := by
      have h1 : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
          (∑ j ∈ S_J, ∑ d : Fin D_max,
            (p_J j * q_pad j tid d) *
              Real.log ((p_J j * q_pad j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_Dj j d)))) =
          (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_TJ tid j * Real.log (p_TJ tid j / (p_T tid * p_J j))) +
          (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * (∑ d : Fin D_max,
            q_pad j tid d * Real.log (q_pad j tid d / (p_Tj j tid * q_Dj j d)))) := by
        intro tid
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => h_split_cell tid j hj)
      simp_rw [h1, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm)
    rw [h_sum_T, add_div, hMI_J]
    congr 1
    dsimp [I_TDj]
    rw [hell_tilde_eq, Finset.sum_div, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    field_simp [hη.ne', h_ell_pos.ne']

  have h_score_lb : ((2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * m * t) -
      finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
      2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_r) +
      η * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * (E_wj j - I_TDj j)) ≤
      classicalTransportScore ε γ (N_ω * D_max) N_T N_G π' T'_idx k'_time G_idx b_G a_G := by
    unfold classicalTransportScore
    change _ ≤ (∑ g : Fin N_G, p'_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g)) -
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
        p'_TG tid g * Real.log (p'_TG tid g / (p'_T tid * p'_G g))) / ell +
      2 * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
        -(p'_TC tid k * Real.log (p'_TC tid k / p'_T tid))) / ell)
    rw [hITG_eq, hSt_eq]
    have h_sub : ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * (E_wj j - I_TDj j) =
        (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * E_wj j) - (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * I_TDj j) := by
      simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [h_sub, mul_sub]
    linarith [hEw_lb]

  
  let e_G_glob : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun g => e_comp (cell_of g) (idx_of g)
  let V_G_glob : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun g => V_comp (cell_of g) (idx_of g)
  let X_G_glob : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun g => X_comp (cell_of g) (idx_of g)
  let k_G_glob : Fin N_G → ℤ := fun g => (cell_of g).1

  have h_tr_ub := h_univ ε r (1 + m) Δ_r
    hε₀ hε_back le_rfl (by linarith) le_rfl
    (by linarith [hΔ_gt, hεr_pos])
    (by linarith [hΔ_le, hεr_pos])
    (N_ω * D_max) N_T N_G π' T'_idx k'_time G_idx V_part A_part
    b_G a_G e_G_glob V_G_glob X_G_glob k_G_glob
    hπ'_nn hπ'_sum
    (fun tid => ⟨le_trans (hVA tid).1 (by norm_num), le_trans (hVA tid).2 (by norm_num)⟩)
    (fun g => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, _, _⟩ := h_comp_spec (cell_of g) (idx_of g) (hcell_mem g)
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩)
    (fun z hz_pos => by
      let ω := (e_prod.symm z).1
      let d := (e_prod.symm z).2
      have hπ'_z : π' z =
          if 0 < π ω then π ω * q_pad (J ω) (T_idx ω) d / p_Tj (J ω) (T_idx ω) else 0 := rfl
      rw [hπ'_z] at hz_pos
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := by
        by_contra h_not
        simp only [h_not, ↓reduceIte] at hz_pos
        linarith
      simp only [hω_pos, ↓reduceIte] at hz_pos
      obtain ⟨hj, _, hpTj, _⟩ := h_pos_pt ω hω_pos
      have h_num_pos : 0 < π ω * q_pad (J ω) (T_idx ω) d :=
        (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hpTj).mp hz_pos
      have hq_pos : 0 < q_pad (J ω) (T_idx ω) d :=
        pos_of_mul_pos_right h_num_pos hω_pos.le
      have hG_eq : G_idx z = e_G_idx (⟨J ω, hj⟩, d) := by
        simp only [G_idx, ω, d, hj, ↓reduceDIte]
      have hcell_eq : cell_of (G_idx z) = J ω := by
        dsimp [cell_of]
        rw [hG_eq, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      have hidx_eq : idx_of (G_idx z) = d := by
        dsimp [idx_of]
        rw [hG_eq, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      obtain ⟨hCr_mem, _, hVj_eq, hAj_eq⟩ := h_cell_geom ω hω_pos
      have hk_eq : k_G_glob (G_idx z) = k'_time z := by
        dsimp [k_G_glob, k'_time, k_r]
        rw [hcell_eq]
        rfl
      have hcmid_eq : ((k'_time z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r = (((J ω).1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r := by
        rw [← hk_eq]
        dsimp [k_G_glob]
        rw [hcell_eq]
      obtain ⟨hl1, hl2, hl3, hl4⟩ := (h_pad_props (J ω) hj).2.2.2.1 (T_idx ω) d hq_pos
      rw [hVj_eq] at hl1 hl2
      rw [hAj_eq] at hl3 hl4
      have h_glob := (h_comp_spec (J ω) d hj).2.2.2.2.2
        (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) hl1 hl2 hl3 hl4
      refine ⟨?_, hk_eq, ?_⟩
      · rw [hcmid_eq]
        exact hCr_mem
      · dsimp [V_G_glob, X_G_glob, e_G_glob, b_G, a_G, T'_idx]
        rw [hcell_eq, hidx_eq, hcmid_eq]
        exact h_glob)

  rw [h_root_eq] at h_tr_ub

  
  have h_loc_sum : ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
      classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) -
      δ_target / 3 ≤
      ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * (E_wj j - I_TDj j) := by
    have h_lhs : ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
        classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) -
        δ_target / 3 =
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
          (classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde 1 γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx (V_j j) (A_j j) -
            δ_target / 3) := by
      simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp_J_sum, one_mul]
    rw [h_lhs]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_pad_props j hj).2.2.2.2 (hp_J_nn j))

  have h_mul_loc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_loc_sum hη.le
  have h_rate_slack : (b₀ + δ_cl) * r ≤
      classicalGrowthRate γ * r + (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (t - r) * δ_target := by
    have h1 : (b₀ + δ_cl) * r ≤ (classicalGrowthRate γ + 2 * δ_cl) * r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hr₀.le
    have h2 : 2 * δ_cl * r = (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (t - r) * δ_target := by
      dsimp [δ_cl, η]
      field_simp [hr₀.ne']
    linarith

  dsimp [η, ε_tilde, k_r] at h_mul_loc h_score_lb
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ ε_iso₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε_iso₀ ∧ ε_iso₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε_iso₀ →
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 0 π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
          classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ≤
          classicalGrowthRate γ + δ

signature.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ ε_iso₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε_iso₀ ∧ ε_iso₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),

        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_s ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 0 π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s -
