proof.tactics:
by
  have h_ne : (ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ).Nonempty := ⟨2, h_two⟩
  have h_inf_lt : sInf (ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ) < classicalGrowthRate γ + δ / 2 := by
    change classicalGrowthRate γ < classicalGrowthRate γ + δ / 2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀_mem, hb₀_lt⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt h_ne h_inf_lt
  obtain ⟨ε_iso₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, h_est⟩ :=
    hb₀_mem.2.2 4 1 1 (δ / 2) (by norm_num) le_rfl zero_lt_one le_rfl (half_pos hδ)
  refine ⟨ε_iso₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, ?_⟩
  intro ε N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s hε0 hε1 hπ_nn hπ_sum hVA hc_s
  have hε_half : ε < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hε1 hε₀_lt
  let m_1 : ℕ := dyadicTimeLevel ε 1
  let Δ_time : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_1)⁻¹
  let X : ℝ := ε ^ (-(1 : ℝ))
  have hX_eq : X = ε⁻¹ := Real.rpow_neg_one ε
  have hε_inv_gt2 : 2 < ε⁻¹ := by
    rw [← one_div]
    exact (lt_div_iff₀ hε0).mpr (by linarith)
  have hX_gt2 : 2 < X := by rwa [hX_eq]
  have hX_pos : 0 < X := by linarith
  have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 := by positivity
  have h2m_lb : X ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 := by
    have h1 : X ≤ (⌈X⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil X
    have h2_nat : ⌈X⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ m_1 := Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide) ⌈X⌉₊
    have h2 : (⌈X⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 := by exact_mod_cast h2_nat
    exact le_trans h1 h2
  have hm1_pos : 0 < m_1 := by
    by_contra hm0
    have hm_eq0 : m_1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hm0
    have h_pow1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 = 1 := by rw [hm_eq0, pow_zero]
    linarith
  have h2m_ub : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 ≤ 4 * X := by
    have h_lt_clog : m_1 - 1 < Nat.clog 2 ⌈X⌉₊ := Nat.sub_lt hm1_pos zero_lt_one
    have h_pow_nat : 2 ^ (m_1 - 1) < ⌈X⌉₊ := Nat.pow_lt_of_lt_clog h_lt_clog
    have h_pow_real : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_1 - 1) < (⌈X⌉₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_pow_nat
    have h_ceil_ub : (⌈X⌉₊ : ℝ) < X + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hX_pos.le
    have hm_succ : m_1 = (m_1 - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hm1_pos).symm
    have h_pow_eq : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_1 - 1) * 2 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hm_succ]
      exact pow_succ (2 : ℝ) (m_1 - 1)
    linarith
  have hΔ_lo : (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ Δ_time := by
    have h1 : (4 * X)⁻¹ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_1)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ h2m_pos h2m_ub
    have h2 : (4 * X)⁻¹ = (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hX_eq, Real.rpow_one]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hε0]
    rwa [h2] at h1
  have hΔ_hi : Δ_time ≤ 4 * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_1)⁻¹ ≤ X⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hX_pos h2m_lb
    have h2 : X⁻¹ = ε := by rw [hX_eq, inv_inv]
    rw [Real.rpow_one]
    linarith
  have h_real_mid : ∀ z : ℝ,
      |z - ((dyadicRealBin ε 1 z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 1| ≤ ε := by
    intro z
    let l : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε 1
    let s : ℝ := dyadicRealStep ε 1
    have hs_pos : 0 < s := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (-l)
    let α : ℝ := 1 * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h2_neg_α : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) = ε := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      have h_exp_arg : Real.log 2 * (-α) = Real.log ε := by
        dsimp [α]
        rw [Real.log_inv]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hlog2_pos]
      rw [h_exp_arg, Real.exp_log hε0]
    have hl_gt : α - 1 < (l : ℝ) := Int.sub_one_lt_floor α
    have h_neg_l_le : ((-l : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ -α + 1 := by
      push_cast
      linarith
    have hs_le : s ≤ 2 * ε := by
      calc s = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((-l : ℤ) : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) (-l)).symm
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α + 1) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) h_neg_l_le
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_add (by norm_num) (-α) 1
        _ = 2 * ε := by rw [h2_neg_α, Real.rpow_one, mul_comm]
    let b_z : ℤ := dyadicRealBin ε 1 z
    have hb_lo : (b_z : ℝ) ≤ z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l := Int.floor_le _
    have hb_hi : z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l < (b_z : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have h_abs_scaled : |z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_z_id : z - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s =
        (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * s := by
      have h_mul : (2 : ℝ) ^ l * s = 1 := by
        dsimp [s, dyadicRealStep]
        rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero]
      calc z - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s
          = z * ((2 : ℝ) ^ l * s) - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s := by rw [h_mul, mul_one]
        _ = (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * s := by ring
    calc |z - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s|
        = |(z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * s| := by rw [h_z_id]
      _ = |z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| * s := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs_pos]
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_abs_scaled hs_pos.le
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (2 * ε) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs_le (by norm_num)
      _ = ε := by ring
  have h_ang_frame : ∀ k : ℤ,
      let u := angUnitVec ε 0 k
      ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ ‖perp2D u‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ (W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (s₁ s₂ : ℝ),
        inner ℝ (W - (s₁ • u + s₂ • perp2D u)) u = inner ℝ W u - s₁ ∧
        inner ℝ (W - (s₁ • u + s₂ • perp2D u)) (perp2D u) = inner ℝ W (perp2D u) - s₂) := by
    intro k u
    let φ := ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε 0))⁻¹
    have hu_eq : u = WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ] := rfl
    have hu_norm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
      rw [hu_eq, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
    have hp_norm : ‖perp2D u‖ = 1 := by
      rw [hu_eq, PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hcs : Real.sin φ ^ 2 + Real.cos φ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        linarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ]
      simp [perp2D, hcs]
    have huu : inner ℝ u u = 1 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu_norm, one_pow]
    have hpp : inner ℝ (perp2D u) (perp2D u) = 1 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hp_norm, one_pow]
    have hup : inner ℝ u (perp2D u) = 0 := by
      rw [hu_eq, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [perp2D]
      ring
    have hpu : inner ℝ (perp2D u) u = 0 := by
      rw [real_inner_comm, hup]
    refine ⟨hu_norm, hp_norm, fun W s₁ s₂ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real, huu, hpu]
      ring
    · simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real, hup, hpp]
      ring
  let G_raw : Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun ω =>
    stdApertureObs ε 1 0 0 (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)
  let S_G : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.univ.image G_raw
  let N_G : ℕ := S_G.card
  let ι : ↥S_G ≃ Fin N_G := S_G.equivFin
  let G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G := fun ω =>
    ι ⟨G_raw ω, Finset.mem_image_of_mem G_raw (Finset.mem_univ ω)⟩
  let k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε 1 (c_s ω)
  let tup_G : Fin N_G → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun g => (ι.symm g).1
  let k_G : Fin N_G → ℤ := fun g => (tup_G g).1
  let kr_G : Fin N_G → ℤ := fun g => (tup_G g).2.1
  let kx1_G : Fin N_G → ℤ := fun g => (tup_G g).2.2.2.2.1
  let kx2_G : Fin N_G → ℤ := fun g => (tup_G g).2.2.2.2.2
  let b_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun _ => 0
  let a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun _ => 0
  let e_G : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun g => angUnitVec ε 0 (kr_G g)
  let V_G : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun _ => 0
  let X_G : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun g =>
    (((kx1_G g : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 1) • e_G g +
      (((kx2_G g : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 1) • perp2D (e_G g)
  have h_tup_G : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, tup_G (G_idx ω) = G_raw ω := by
    intro ω
    dsimp [tup_G, G_idx]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h_G_iff : ∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, G_idx ω₁ = G_idx ω₂ ↔ G_raw ω₁ = G_raw ω₂ := by
    intro ω₁ ω₂
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 := congrArg tup_G h
      rwa [h_tup_G, h_tup_G] at h1
    · intro h
      dsimp [G_idx]
      exact congrArg ι (Subtype.ext h)
  have hVA_4 : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 4 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 4 := by
    intro tid
    exact ⟨by linarith [(hVA tid).1], by linarith [(hVA tid).2]⟩
  have hG_adm : ∀ g : Fin N_G, 0 ≤ b_G g ∧ b_G g ≤ a_G g ∧ a_G g + 1 ≤ 1 ∧ ‖e_G g‖ = 1 := by
    intro g
    exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, by norm_num [a_G], (h_ang_frame (kr_G g)).1⟩
  have h_supp : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
      let tid := T_idx ω
      let g := G_idx ω
      let c_mid := ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time
      c_mid ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      k_G g = k_time ω ∧
      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| ≤ 4 * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ 4 * ε ^ (a_G g) ∧
      |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (e_G g)| ≤
        4 * ε ^ (b_G g + 1) ∧
      |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤
        4 * ε ^ (a_G g + 1) := by
    intro ω hω_pos
    dsimp only
    obtain ⟨hc0, _⟩ := hc_s ω hω_pos
    have hk_lo : (0 : ℤ) ≤ k_time ω := by
      dsimp [k_time, dyadicTimeBin]
      refine le_min ?_ ?_
      · exact Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hc0 h2m_pos.le)
      · have h1_le : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2 ^ m_1 := one_le_pow₀ (by decide : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2)
        linarith
    have hk_hi : k_time ω ≤ (2 ^ m_1 : ℤ) - 1 := min_le_right _ _
    have hk_lo_r : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k_time ω : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_lo
    have hk_hi_r : (k_time ω : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 - 1 := by exact_mod_cast hk_hi
    have hc_mid_mem : ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      refine ⟨mul_nonneg (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr h2m_pos.le), ?_⟩
      calc ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time
          ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_1)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr h2m_pos.le)
        _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h2m_pos)
    have hk_eq : k_G (G_idx ω) = k_time ω := by
      dsimp only [k_G]
      rw [h_tup_G ω]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨he_norm, hep_norm, h_proj⟩ := h_ang_frame (kr_G (G_idx ω))
    have hV1 : |inner ℝ (V_part (T_idx ω) - V_G (G_idx ω)) (e_G (G_idx ω))| ≤
        4 * ε ^ (b_G (G_idx ω)) := by
      dsimp only [V_G, b_G]
      rw [sub_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
      calc |inner ℝ (V_part (T_idx ω)) (e_G (G_idx ω))|
          ≤ ‖V_part (T_idx ω)‖ * ‖e_G (G_idx ω)‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (hVA (T_idx ω)).1 he_norm.le (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ ≤ 4 := by norm_num
    have hV2 : |inner ℝ (V_part (T_idx ω) - V_G (G_idx ω)) (perp2D (e_G (G_idx ω)))| ≤
        4 * ε ^ (a_G (G_idx ω)) := by
      dsimp only [V_G, a_G]
      rw [sub_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
      calc |inner ℝ (V_part (T_idx ω)) (perp2D (e_G (G_idx ω)))|
          ≤ ‖V_part (T_idx ω)‖ * ‖perp2D (e_G (G_idx ω))‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (hVA (T_idx ω)).1 hep_norm.le (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ ≤ 4 := by norm_num
    let x_p := A_part (T_idx ω) + (((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time) • V_part (T_idx ω)
    let k_ang_raw := angBin ε ((0 : ℝ) - 0) (θ_s ω)
    have hkr : kr_G (G_idx ω) = k_ang_raw := by
      dsimp only [kr_G]
      rw [h_tup_G ω]
      rfl
    have he_eq : angUnitVec ε ((0 : ℝ) - 0) k_ang_raw = e_G (G_idx ω) := by
      dsimp only [e_G]
      rw [hkr]
      exact congrArg (fun z => angUnitVec ε z k_ang_raw) (sub_self (0 : ℝ))
    have hkx1 : kx1_G (G_idx ω) = dyadicRealBin ε 1 (inner ℝ x_p (e_G (G_idx ω))) := by
      have h1 : kx1_G (G_idx ω) =
          dyadicRealBin ε ((0 : ℝ) + 1)
            (inner ℝ x_p (angUnitVec ε ((0 : ℝ) - 0) k_ang_raw)) := by
        dsimp only [kx1_G]
        rw [h_tup_G ω]
        rfl
      rw [h1, zero_add, he_eq]
    have hkx2 : kx2_G (G_idx ω) = dyadicRealBin ε 1 (inner ℝ x_p (perp2D (e_G (G_idx ω)))) := by
      have h1 : kx2_G (G_idx ω) =
          dyadicRealBin ε ((0 : ℝ) + 1)
            (inner ℝ x_p (perp2D (angUnitVec ε ((0 : ℝ) - 0) k_ang_raw))) := by
        dsimp only [kx2_G]
        rw [h_tup_G ω]
        rfl
      rw [h1, zero_add, he_eq]
    have h_pr := h_proj x_p
      (((kx1_G (G_idx ω) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 1)
      (((kx2_G (G_idx ω) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 1)
    have hX1 : |inner ℝ (x_p - X_G (G_idx ω)) (e_G (G_idx ω))| ≤
        4 * ε ^ (b_G (G_idx ω) + 1) := by
      dsimp only [X_G, b_G]
      rw [h_pr.1, hkx1, zero_add, Real.rpow_one]
      have hm := h_real_mid (inner ℝ x_p (e_G (G_idx ω)))
      linarith
    have hX2 : |inner ℝ (x_p - X_G (G_idx ω)) (perp2D (e_G (G_idx ω)))| ≤
        4 * ε ^ (a_G (G_idx ω) + 1) := by
      dsimp only [X_G, a_G]
      rw [h_pr.2, hkx2, zero_add, Real.rpow_one]
      have hm := h_real_mid (inner ℝ x_p (perp2D (e_G (G_idx ω))))
      linarith
    exact ⟨hc_mid_mem, hk_eq, hV1, hV2, hX1, hX2⟩
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let p_TG : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun tid g =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let S_cells : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image k_time
  let p_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then π ω else 0
  have h_collapse : ∀ {β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (S : Finset β) (Y : Fin N_ω → β)
      (hY : ∀ ω, Y ω ∈ S) (F : Fin N_T → β → ℝ) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ b ∈ S, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Y ω = b then F tid b else 0) =
        F (T_idx ω) (Y ω) := by
    intro β _ S Y hY F ω
    have h_inner : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
        (∑ b ∈ S, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Y ω = b then F tid b else 0) =
          if T_idx ω = tid then F tid (Y ω) else 0 := by
      intro tid
      by_cases hT : T_idx ω = tid
      · simp only [hT, true_and, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq S (Y ω) (F tid)]
        simp [hY ω]
      · simp [hT]
    simp_rw [h_inner]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (T_idx ω) (fun tid => F tid (Y ω))]
    simp
  have h_St_eq :
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells, -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) / ell =
        finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_time := by
    have h_num :
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells, -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_time ω) / p_T (T_idx ω))) := by
      have h_exp : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (k : ℤ),
          -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid)) =
            ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
              if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then
                -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))
              else 0 := by
        intro tid k
        dsimp [p_TC]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> ring
      simp_rw [h_exp]
      conv_lhs =>
        arg 2
        ext tid
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      exact h_collapse S_cells k_time
        (fun ω' => Finset.mem_image_of_mem k_time (Finset.mem_univ ω'))
        (fun tid k => -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) ω
    rw [h_num, Finset.sum_div]
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    have hp1 : finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
      unfold finProbAt
      dsimp [p_T]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [h1]
    have hp2 : finProbAt2 π T_idx k_time ω = p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_time ω) := by
      unfold finProbAt2
      dsimp [p_TC]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> by_cases h2 : k_time ω' = k_time ω <;> simp [h1, h2]
    rw [hp1, hp2]
    ring
  have h_ITG_eq :
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
          p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell =
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_raw := by
    have h_num :
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
            p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
            π ω * Real.log (p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_G (G_idx ω))) := by
      have h_exp : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (g : Fin N_G),
          p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g)) =
            ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
              if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then
                π ω * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))
              else 0 := by
        intro tid g
        dsimp [p_TG]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> ring
      simp_rw [h_exp]
      conv_lhs =>
        arg 2
        ext tid
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      exact h_collapse Finset.univ G_idx (fun _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
        (fun tid g => π ω * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) ω
    rw [h_num, Finset.sum_div]
    unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hω_pos : 0 < π ω
    · have hp_unit : finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
        unfold finProbAt
        simp [hπ_sum]
      have hp_G : finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) G_raw ω = p_G (G_idx ω) := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        dsimp [p_G]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h2 : G_idx ω' = G_idx ω
        · have h2' : G_raw ω' = G_raw ω := (h_G_iff ω' ω).mp h2
          simp [h2, h2']
        · have h2' : G_raw ω' ≠ G_raw ω := fun h => h2 ((h_G_iff ω' ω).mpr h)
          simp [h2, h2']
      have hp_T : finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
        unfold finProbAt
        dsimp [p_T]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [h1]
      have hp_TG : finProbAt2 π T_idx G_raw ω = p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        dsimp [p_TG]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω
        · by_cases h2 : G_idx ω' = G_idx ω
          · have h2' : G_raw ω' = G_raw ω := (h_G_iff ω' ω).mp h2
            simp [h1, h2, h2']
          · have h2' : G_raw ω' ≠ G_raw ω := fun h => h2 ((h_G_iff ω' ω).mpr h)
            simp [h1, h2, h2']
        · simp [h1]
      have hpTG_pos : 0 < p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) := by
        have h_le : π ω ≤ p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) := by
          dsimp [p_TG]
          have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ G_idx ω' = G_idx ω then π ω' else 0)
            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
            (Finset.mem_univ ω)
          simpa using h1
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos h_le
      have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω) := by
        have h_le : p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) ≤ p_T (T_idx ω) := by
          dsimp [p_TG, p_T]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω
          · by_cases h2 : G_idx ω' = G_idx ω <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω']
          · simp [h1]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpTG_pos h_le
      have hpG_pos : 0 < p_G (G_idx ω) := by
        have h_le : p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) ≤ p_G (G_idx ω) := by
          dsimp [p_TG, p_G]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          by_cases h2 : G_idx ω' = G_idx ω
          · by_cases h1 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω']
          · simp [h2]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpTG_pos h_le
      unfold condSurprise
      rw [hp_unit, hp_G, hp_T, hp_TG, div_one]
      have h_div_eq : p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_G (G_idx ω)) =
          (p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) / p_G (G_idx ω) :=
        (div_div _ _ _).symm
      rw [h_div_eq,
        Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpTG_pos hpT_pos)) (ne_of_gt hpG_pos)]
      ring
    · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω_pos) (hπ_nn ω)
      simp [h0]
  have h_Ew_eq : ∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g) = 0 := by
    dsimp [b_G, a_G]
    simp
  have h_score_eq :
      stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 0 π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s =
        classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx b_G a_G := by
    unfold stdApertureScore classicalTransportScore
    change ((1 + γ) * 0 + (1 - γ) * 0) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_raw +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_time =
      (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g)) -
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
          p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell +
        2 * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
          -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) / ell)
    rw [h_Ew_eq, h_ITG_eq, h_St_eq]
    ring
  have h_cl := h_est ε 1 1 Δ_time hε0 hε1 le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl hΔ_lo hΔ_hi
    N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx V_part A_part b_G a_G e_G V_G X_G k_G
    hπ_nn hπ_sum hVA_4 hG_adm h_supp
  rw [← h_score_eq] at h_cl
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(γ ε e : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) (he₀ : 0 < e)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (h_law : IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s)
    (h_exc : classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ≤
      stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s) :
    finMutualInfo ε π T_idx
        (fun ω => stdRootObs ε e (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (θ_s ω)) ≤
      (1 - γ) * e -
        classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
        2 + 6 / Real.log (ε⁻¹)

signature.name: std_root_coarsening_info_bound
signature.statement:
(γ ε e : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) (he₀ : 0 < e)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (h_law : IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s)
    (h_exc : classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ≤
      stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s) :
    finMutualInfo ε π T_idx
        (fun ω => stdRootObs ε e (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (θ_s ω)) ≤
      (1 - γ) * e -
        classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
        2 + 6 / Real.log (ε⁻¹)

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := he₀
  obtain ⟨hπ_nn, hπ_sum, hVA_norm, h_supp⟩ := h_law
  have hε_lt_one : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have h1_lt_inv : 1 < ε⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr hε_lt_one
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos h1_lt_inv
  have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlog2_le1 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
  let k_t : Fin N_ω → ℤ := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε 1 (c_s ω)
  let G_std : Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
    fun ω => stdApertureObs ε 1 0 e (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)
  let D_obs : Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
    fun ω => stdRootObs ε e (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (θ_s ω)
  let τ : ℝ := classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part
  have h_score : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_std ≤
      (1 - γ) * e - τ + 2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_t := by
    have h_unfold : stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s =
        ((1 + γ) * 0 + (1 - γ) * e) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_std +
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_t := rfl
    change τ ≤ stdApertureScore ε γ 1 0 e π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s at h_exc
    rw [h_unfold] at h_exc
    linarith
  let F_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
    @Finset.filter (Fin N_ω) (fun ω => 0 < π ω) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
  have hF_pos : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ω ∈ F_pos ↔ 0 < π ω := by
    intro ω
    rw [@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _)]
    simp
  have hπ_zero : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ω ∉ F_pos → π ω = 0 := by
    intro ω hω
    have h_not_pos : ¬ 0 < π ω := fun hp => hω ((hF_pos ω).mpr hp)
    linarith [hπ_nn ω]
  have h_sum_F_pos : ∀ g : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * g ω) = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * g ω := by
    intro g
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_pos) (fun ω _ hω => ?_)).symm
    rw [hπ_zero ω hω, zero_mul]
  have hF_pos_sum1 : ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω = 1 := by
    have h1 := h_sum_F_pos (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [mul_one] at h1
    linarith [hπ_sum]
  have h_gibbs : ∀ {α β : Type} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
      (U : Fin N_ω → α) (V : Fin N_ω → β) (q : α → β → ℝ),
      (∀ ω ∈ F_pos, 0 < q (U ω) (V ω)) →
      (∀ u ∈ F_pos.image U, ∑ v ∈ (F_pos.filter (fun ω => U ω = u)).image V, q u v ≤ 1) →
      finCondEntropy ε π U V ≤
        (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (q (U ω) (V ω)))) / ell := by
    intro α β _ _ U V q hq_pos hq_sum
    let w_U : α → ℝ := fun u => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if U ω' = u then π ω' else 0
    let w_UV : α → β → ℝ := fun u v => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if U ω' = u ∧ V ω' = v then π ω' else 0
    have hw_U_eq : ∀ u : α, w_U u = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => U ω = u), π ω := by
      intro u
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_pos) (fun ω _ hω => ?_)).symm
      rw [hπ_zero ω hω]
      simp
    have hw_UV_eq : ∀ (u : α) (v : β),
        w_UV u v = ∑ ω ∈ (F_pos.filter (fun ω => U ω = u)).filter (fun ω => V ω = v), π ω := by
      intro u v
      rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
      have h_sub : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if U ω = u ∧ V ω = v then π ω else 0) =
          ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, if U ω = u ∧ V ω = v then π ω else 0 := by
        refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_pos) (fun ω _ hω => ?_)).symm
        rw [hπ_zero ω hω]
        simp
      dsimp only [w_UV]
      rw [h_sub]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hu : U ω = u <;> by_cases hv : V ω = v <;> simp [hu, hv]
    have h_prob1 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt π U ω = w_U (U ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : U ω' = U ω <;> simp [h]
    have h_prob2 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt2 π U V ω = w_UV (U ω) (V ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : U ω' = U ω ∧ V ω' = V ω <;> simp [h]
    have h_lhs : finCondEntropy ε π U V =
        (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (w_UV (U ω) (V ω) / w_U (U ω)))) / ell := by
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      change (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π U V ω / finProbAt π U ω)) / ell)) = _
      rw [h_sum_F_pos, Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      rw [h_prob1 ω, h_prob2 ω]
      ring
    rw [h_lhs, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos]
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ F_pos,
        π ω * (-Real.log (w_UV (U ω) (V ω) / w_U (U ω))) -
          π ω * (-Real.log (q (U ω) (V ω))) ≤
          π ω * ((q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω)) - π ω := by
      intro ω hω
      have hπω : 0 < π ω := (hF_pos ω).mp hω
      have hω_fu : ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω' => U ω' = U ω) :=
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω, rfl⟩
      have hω_fuv : ω ∈ (F_pos.filter (fun ω' => U ω' = U ω)).filter (fun ω' => V ω' = V ω) :=
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω_fu, rfl⟩
      have hw_u_pos : 0 < w_U (U ω) := by
        rw [hw_U_eq]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hπω (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω' _ => hπ_nn ω') hω_fu)
      have hw_uv_pos : 0 < w_UV (U ω) (V ω) := by
        rw [hw_UV_eq]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hπω (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω' _ => hπ_nn ω') hω_fuv)
      have hq_ω : 0 < q (U ω) (V ω) := hq_pos ω hω
      have h_arg_pos : 0 < (q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω) :=
        div_pos (mul_pos hq_ω hw_u_pos) hw_uv_pos
      have h_log_id : -Real.log (w_UV (U ω) (V ω) / w_U (U ω)) + Real.log (q (U ω) (V ω)) =
          Real.log ((q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω)) := by
        rw [Real.log_div hw_uv_pos.ne' hw_u_pos.ne',
          Real.log_div (mul_pos hq_ω hw_u_pos).ne' hw_uv_pos.ne',
          Real.log_mul hq_ω.ne' hw_u_pos.ne']
        ring
      have h_kl := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos h_arg_pos
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_log_id.trans_le h_kl) hπω.le
      linarith
    have h_sum_diff : (∑ ω ∈ F_pos,
        (π ω * (-Real.log (w_UV (U ω) (V ω) / w_U (U ω))) -
          π ω * (-Real.log (q (U ω) (V ω))))) ≤
        (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * ((q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω))) -
          ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    have h_fib_sum : (∑ ω ∈ F_pos,
        π ω * ((q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω))) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem U hω)]
      have h_u_bound : ∀ u ∈ F_pos.image U,
          (∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => U ω = u),
            π ω * ((q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω))) ≤ w_U u := by
        intro u hu
        let F_u := F_pos.filter (fun ω => U ω = u)
        change (∑ ω ∈ F_u, π ω * ((q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω))) ≤ w_U u
        rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem V hω)]
        have h_v_eq : ∀ v ∈ F_u.image V,
            (∑ ω ∈ F_u.filter (fun ω => V ω = v),
              π ω * ((q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω))) = q u v * w_U u := by
          intro v hv
          obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀_fu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
          have hω₀_pos : 0 < π ω₀ := (hF_pos ω₀).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_fu).1
          have hω₀_fuv : ω₀ ∈ F_u.filter (fun ω => V ω = V ω₀) :=
            Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω₀_fu, rfl⟩
          have hw_uv_pos : 0 < w_UV u (V ω₀) := by
            rw [hw_UV_eq]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω₀_pos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω' _ => hπ_nn ω') hω₀_fuv)
          have h_congr : (∑ ω ∈ F_u.filter (fun ω => V ω = V ω₀),
              π ω * ((q (U ω) (V ω) * w_U (U ω)) / w_UV (U ω) (V ω))) =
              ∑ ω ∈ F_u.filter (fun ω => V ω = V ω₀),
                π ω * ((q u (V ω₀) * w_U u) / w_UV u (V ω₀)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
            have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1).2
            have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            rw [h1, h2]
          rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← hw_UV_eq u (V ω₀),
            mul_div_cancel₀ _ hw_uv_pos.ne']
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_v_eq, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        have hw_u_nn : 0 ≤ w_U u :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω'])
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left hw_u_nn (hq_sum u hu)
      have h_tot : ∑ u ∈ F_pos.image U, w_U u = 1 := by
        have h1 : ∑ u ∈ F_pos.image U, w_U u =
            ∑ u ∈ F_pos.image U, ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => U ω = u), π ω :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => hw_U_eq u)
        rw [h1, Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem U hω),
          hF_pos_sum1]
      exact (Finset.sum_le_sum h_u_bound).trans_eq h_tot
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at h_sum_diff
    linarith [h_sum_diff, h_fib_sum, hF_pos_sum1]
  have h_cond_ent_fib : ∀ {α β : Type} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Fib : α → Finset β) (K : ℕ),
      1 ≤ K →
      (∀ x : α, (Fib x).card ≤ K) →
      (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → Y ω ∈ Fib (X ω)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y ≤ Real.log (K : ℝ) / ell := by
    intro α β _ _ X Y Fib K hK hFib_card hFib_mem
    have hK_pos : 0 < (K : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < K by omega)
    have h_gb := h_gibbs X Y (fun _ _ => (K : ℝ)⁻¹)
      (fun _ _ => inv_pos.mpr hK_pos)
      (fun x _ => by
        let S_x := (F_pos.filter (fun ω => X ω = x)).image Y
        have h_sub : S_x ⊆ Fib x := by
          intro y hy
          obtain ⟨ω, hω_f, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
          obtain ⟨hω_pos, hXω⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_f
          rw [← hXω]
          exact hFib_mem ω ((hF_pos ω).mp hω_pos)
        have h_card : (S_x.card : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card h_sub).trans (hFib_card x)
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        calc (S_x.card : ℝ) * (K : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (K : ℝ) * (K : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card (inv_nonneg.mpr hK_pos.le)
          _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hK_pos.ne')
    refine h_gb.trans_eq ?_
    have h_const : (∑ ω ∈ F_pos, π ω * (-Real.log ((K : ℝ)⁻¹))) = Real.log (K : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg, ← Finset.sum_mul, hF_pos_sum1, one_mul]
    rw [h_const]
  have h_drop_cond : ∀ {α β γ_Z : Type} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ_Z]
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_Z),
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε π Z Y := by
    intro α β γ_Z _ _ _ X Y Z
    let w_Z : γ_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if Z ω' = z then π ω' else 0
    let w_ZY : γ_Z → β → ℝ := fun z y => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if Z ω' = z ∧ Y ω' = y then π ω' else 0
    have hw_Z_eq : ∀ z : γ_Z, w_Z z = ∑ ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z), π ω := by
      intro z
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_pos) (fun ω _ hω => ?_)).symm
      rw [hπ_zero ω hω]
      simp
    have hw_ZY_eq : ∀ (z : γ_Z) (y : β),
        w_ZY z y = ∑ ω ∈ (F_pos.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z)).filter (fun ω => Y ω = y), π ω := by
      intro z y
      rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
      have h_sub : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Z ω = z ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0) =
          ∑ ω ∈ F_pos, if Z ω = z ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0 := by
        refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_pos) (fun ω _ hω => ?_)).symm
        rw [hπ_zero ω hω]
        simp
      dsimp only [w_ZY]
      rw [h_sub]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hz : Z ω = z <;> by_cases hy : Y ω = y <;> simp [hz, hy]
    have h_gb := h_gibbs (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) Y (fun xz y => w_ZY xz.2 y / w_Z xz.2)
      (fun ω hω => by
        have hπω : 0 < π ω := (hF_pos ω).mp hω
        have hω_fz : ω ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω' => Z ω' = Z ω) :=
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω, rfl⟩
        have hω_fzy : ω ∈ (F_pos.filter (fun ω' => Z ω' = Z ω)).filter (fun ω' => Y ω' = Y ω) :=
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω_fz, rfl⟩
        have hwz : 0 < w_Z (Z ω) := by
          rw [hw_Z_eq]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hπω (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω' _ => hπ_nn ω') hω_fz)
        have hwzy : 0 < w_ZY (Z ω) (Y ω) := by
          rw [hw_ZY_eq]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hπω (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω' _ => hπ_nn ω') hω_fzy)
        exact div_pos hwzy hwz)
      (fun xz hxz => by
        obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀_pos, hω₀_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxz
        have hZ₀ : Z ω₀ = xz.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hω₀_eq
        have hω₀_fz : ω₀ ∈ F_pos.filter (fun ω => Z ω = xz.2) :=
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω₀_pos, hZ₀⟩
        have hwz_pos : 0 < w_Z xz.2 := by
          rw [hw_Z_eq]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((hF_pos ω₀).mp hω₀_pos)
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω' _ => hπ_nn ω') hω₀_fz)
        let S_xz := (F_pos.filter (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω) = xz)).image Y
        let S_z := (F_pos.filter (fun ω => Z ω = xz.2)).image Y
        have h_sub : S_xz ⊆ S_z := by
          intro y hy
          obtain ⟨ω, hω_f, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
          obtain ⟨hω_p, h_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_f
          exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem Y (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω_p, congrArg Prod.snd h_eq⟩)
        have h_le : ∑ y ∈ S_xz, w_ZY xz.2 y / w_Z xz.2 ≤ ∑ y ∈ S_z, w_ZY xz.2 y / w_Z xz.2 := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub (fun y _ _ => ?_)
          have hwzy_nn : 0 ≤ w_ZY xz.2 y :=
            Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω'])
          exact div_nonneg hwzy_nn hwz_pos.le
        have h_sum_z : ∑ y ∈ S_z, w_ZY xz.2 y = w_Z xz.2 := by
          have h1 : ∑ y ∈ S_z, w_ZY xz.2 y =
              ∑ y ∈ S_z, ∑ ω ∈ (F_pos.filter (fun ω => Z ω = xz.2)).filter (fun ω => Y ω = y), π ω :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => hw_ZY_eq xz.2 y)
          rw [h1, Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Y hω),
            ← hw_Z_eq]
        calc ∑ y ∈ S_xz, w_ZY xz.2 y / w_Z xz.2
            ≤ ∑ y ∈ S_z, w_ZY xz.2 y / w_Z xz.2 := h_le
          _ = (∑ y ∈ S_z, w_ZY xz.2 y) / w_Z xz.2 := (Finset.sum_div _ _ _).symm
          _ = 1 := by rw [h_sum_z, div_self hwz_pos.ne'])
    refine h_gb.trans_eq ?_
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    change _ = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π Z Y ω / finProbAt π Z ω)) / ell)
    rw [h_sum_F_pos, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    have hp1 : finProbAt π Z ω = w_Z (Z ω) := by
      unfold finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : Z ω' = Z ω <;> simp [h]
    have hp2 : finProbAt2 π Z Y ω = w_ZY (Z ω) (Y ω) := by
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : Z ω' = Z ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h]
    rw [hp1, hp2]
    ring
  have h_cond_nn : ∀ {τ₁ τ₂ : Type} (U : Fin N_ω → τ₁) (V : Fin N_ω → τ₂),
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π U V := by
    intro τ₁ τ₂ U V
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hπω : π ω = 0
    · rw [hπω, zero_mul]
    · have hπ_pos : 0 < π ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn ω) (Ne.symm hπω)
      have hp2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π U V ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω =>
            @ite ℝ (U ω' = U ω ∧ V ω' = V ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (π ω') 0)
          (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω']) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
        simp at h_le

            ≤ |x_perp - ((g.2.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_e1| +
                |c_m_g * (v_perp - ((g.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_e)| := abs_sub _ _
          _ = |x_perp - ((g.2.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_e1| +
                c_m_g * |v_perp - ((g.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_e| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc_m_nn]
          _ ≤ (1 / 2) * s_e1 + 1 * ((1 / 2) * s_e) := by
              refine add_le_add herr_x ?_
              exact mul_le_mul hc_m_le1 herr_v (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ ≤ (1 / 2) * s_e + (1 / 2) * s_e := by linarith [hs_e1_le]
          _ = s_e := by ring
      obtain ⟨h_lo_se, h_hi_se⟩ := abs_le.mp h_err_a
      let u : ℝ := a_perp * (2 : ℝ) ^ L_e
      let w : ℝ := aa_hat g * (2 : ℝ) ^ L_e
      have hu_lo : w - 1 ≤ u := by
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_lo_se h2Le_pos.le
        have h1 : (-s_e) * (2 : ℝ) ^ L_e = -1 := by linarith [hs_e_mul]
        dsimp only [u, w]
        linarith
      have hu_hi : u ≤ w + 1 := by
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_hi_se h2Le_pos.le
        dsimp only [u, w]
        linarith [hs_e_mul]
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      change ⌊w⌋ - 1 ≤ ⌊u⌋ ∧ ⌊u⌋ ≤ ⌊w⌋ + 1
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
        have hfl_w := Int.floor_le w
        push_cast
        linarith
      · have hfl_u := Int.floor_le u
        have hlt_w := Int.lt_floor_add_one w
        have h_cast_lt : (⌊u⌋ : ℝ) < ((⌊w⌋ + 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
          push_cast
          linarith
        have h_int_lt : ⌊u⌋ < ⌊w⌋ + 2 := Int.cast_lt.mp h_cast_lt
        omega
    dsimp only [Fib_D]
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(d.2.2.2.1, d.2.2.2.2), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hd4_mem, hd5_mem⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hd1, ← hd2, ← hd3]
  have h_root_cond : finCondEntropy ε π G_std D_obs ≤ Real.log (9 : ℝ) / ell :=
    h_cond_ent_fib G_std D_obs Fib_D 9 (by omega) hFib_D_card hFib_D_mem
  have h_mi_step : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_obs ≤
      finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_std + finCondEntropy ε π G_std D_obs :=
    h_mi_transfer T_idx G_std D_obs
  have h_log9_le4 : Real.log (9 : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by
    have h9 : (9 : ℝ) = 3 * 3 := by norm_num
    have hlog3 : Real.log (3 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
      linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
    rw [h9, Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    linarith
  have h_err_le6 : (2 * Real.log 2 + Real.log (9 : ℝ)) / ell ≤ 6 / ell :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hlog2_le1, h_log9_le4]) hell_pos.le
  have h_split_err : 2 * (Real.log 2 / ell) + Real.log (9 : ℝ) / ell =
      (2 * Real.log 2 + Real.log (9 : ℝ)) / ell := by ring
  change finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_obs ≤ (1 - γ) * e - τ + 2 + 6 / ell
  linarith [h_mi_step, h_score, h_time_ent, h_root_cond, h_err_le6, h_split_err]

informal_problem.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1)
    (D : Fin N_ω → α) (f_c : α → α → β)
    (K₁ K₂ : ℕ) (hK₁ : 1 ≤ K₁) (hK₂ : 1 ≤ K₂)
    (Fib₁ : α → Finset β) (Fib₂ : α → Finset β)
    (hFib₁_card : ∀ a₁ : α, (Fib₁ a₁).card ≤ K₁)
    (hFib₂_card : ∀ a₂ : α, (Fib₂ a₂).card ≤ K₂)
    (hFib_mem : ∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 < twoReplicaProb π T_idx ij →
      let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
      f_c (D p.1) (D p.2) ∈ Fib₁ (D p.1) ∧
      f_c (D p.1) (D p.2) ∈ Fib₂ (D p.2)) :
    let π₂ := twoReplicaProb π T_idx
    let T₂ := twoReplicaT T_idx
    (∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 ≤ π₂ ij) ∧
    (∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij = 1) ∧
    finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂
        (fun ij => let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij; (D p.1, D p.2)) +
      finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂
        (fun ij => let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij; f_c (D p.1) (D p.2)) ≤
      2 * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D +
        (Real.log (K₁ : ℝ) + Real.log (K₂ : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have h_inv_gt : 1 < ε⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr hε₁
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos h_inv_gt
  have hell_ne : ell ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hell_pos

  let probOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ], (Fin M → ℝ) → (Fin M → γ) → γ → ℝ :=
    fun μ Z z => ∑ x, if Z x = z then μ x else 0
  let posSupport : ∀ {M : ℕ}, (Fin M → ℝ) → Finset (Fin M) :=
    fun μ => @Finset.filter _ (fun x => 0 < μ x) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
  let suppOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ], (Fin M → ℝ) → (Fin M → γ) → Finset γ :=
    fun μ Z => (posSupport μ).image Z
  let H_nat : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ], (Fin M → ℝ) → (Fin M → γ) → ℝ :=
    fun μ Z => ∑ x, μ x * (-Real.log (probOf μ Z (Z x)))

  have h_mem_posSupport : ∀ {M : ℕ} (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (x : Fin M),
      x ∈ posSupport μ ↔ 0 < μ x := by
    intro M μ x
    dsimp only [posSupport]
    rw [@Finset.mem_filter _ (fun x => 0 < μ x) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _)]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ x, h⟩⟩

  have h_zero_of_not_pos : ∀ {M : ℕ} (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (x : Fin M),
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) → x ∉ posSupport μ → μ x = 0 := by
    intro M μ x hμ hx
    rw [h_mem_posSupport] at hx
    exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hx) (hμ x)

  have h_probOf_nn : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Z : Fin M → γ) (z : γ),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) → 0 ≤ probOf μ Z z := by
    intro M γ _ μ Z z hμ
    dsimp only [probOf]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => ?_)
    split_ifs
    · exact hμ x
    · exact le_rfl

  have h_le_probOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Z : Fin M → γ) (x : Fin M),
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) → μ x ≤ probOf μ Z (Z x) := by
    intro M γ _ μ Z x hμ
    dsimp only [probOf]
    have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun y : Fin M => if Z y = Z x then μ y else 0)
      (fun y _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ y; exact le_rfl)
      (Finset.mem_univ x)
    simpa only [ite_true] using h1

  have h_pos_probOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Z : Fin M → γ) (x : Fin M),
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) → 0 < μ x → 0 < probOf μ Z (Z x) := by
    intro M γ _ μ Z x hμ hx
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx (h_le_probOf μ Z x hμ)

  have h_mem_suppOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Z : Fin M → γ) (z : γ),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) → (z ∈ suppOf μ Z ↔ 0 < probOf μ Z z) := by
    intro M γ _ μ Z z hμ
    dsimp only [suppOf]
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      rw [h_mem_posSupport] at hx
      exact h_pos_probOf μ Z x hμ hx
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨x, _, hx_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hz)
      by_cases hZx : Z x = z
      · rw [if_pos hZx] at hx_ne
        have hx_pos : 0 < μ x := lt_of_le_of_ne (hμ x) (Ne.symm hx_ne)
        exact ⟨x, (h_mem_posSupport μ x).mpr hx_pos, hZx⟩
      · rw [if_neg hZx] at hx_ne
        exact absurd rfl hx_ne

  have h_fiber_probOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Z : Fin M → γ) (z : γ),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) → (∑ x ∈ posSupport μ with Z x = z, μ x) = probOf μ Z z := by
    intro M γ _ μ Z z hμ
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    dsimp only [probOf]
    exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun x _ hx => by
      rw [h_zero_of_not_pos μ x hμ hx, ite_self])

  
  have h_exp_suppOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Z : Fin M → γ) (g : γ → ℝ),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) →
      (∑ x : Fin M, μ x * g (Z x)) = ∑ z ∈ suppOf μ Z, probOf μ Z z * g z := by
    intro M γ _ μ Z g hμ
    have h_trim : (∑ x : Fin M, μ x * g (Z x)) = ∑ x ∈ posSupport μ, μ x * g (Z x) :=
      (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun x _ hx => by
        rw [h_zero_of_not_pos μ x hμ hx, zero_mul])).symm
    have h_maps : ∀ x ∈ posSupport μ, Z x ∈ suppOf μ Z :=
      fun x hx => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z hx
    rw [h_trim, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
    have h_inner : (∑ x ∈ posSupport μ with Z x = z, μ x * g (Z x)) =
        (∑ x ∈ posSupport μ with Z x = z, μ x) * g z := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ?_)
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2]
    rw [h_inner, h_fiber_probOf μ Z z hμ]

  have h_sum_suppOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Z : Fin M → γ),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) → (∑ z ∈ suppOf μ Z, probOf μ Z z) = ∑ x : Fin M, μ x := by
    intro M γ _ μ Z hμ
    have h1 := (h_exp_suppOf μ Z (fun _ => 1) hμ).symm
    simpa only [mul_one] using h1

  have h_H_nat_suppOf : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Z : Fin M → γ),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) →
      H_nat μ Z = ∑ z ∈ suppOf μ Z, probOf μ Z z * (-Real.log (probOf μ Z z)) := by
    intro M γ _ μ Z hμ
    exact h_exp_suppOf μ Z (fun z => -Real.log (probOf μ Z z)) hμ

  have h_H_nat_congr : ∀ {M₁ M₂ : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ₁ : Fin M₁ → ℝ) (Z₁ : Fin M₁ → γ) (μ₂ : Fin M₂ → ℝ) (Z₂ : Fin M₂ → γ),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ₁ x) → (∀ y, 0 ≤ μ₂ y) →
      (∀ z : γ, probOf μ₁ Z₁ z = probOf μ₂ Z₂ z) →
      H_nat μ₁ Z₁ = H_nat μ₂ Z₂ := by
    intro M₁ M₂ γ _ μ₁ Z₁ μ₂ Z₂ hμ₁ hμ₂ heq
    have h_supp : suppOf μ₁ Z₁ = suppOf μ₂ Z₂ := by
      ext z
      rw [h_mem_suppOf μ₁ Z₁ z hμ₁, h_mem_suppOf μ₂ Z₂ z hμ₂, heq z]
    rw [h_H_nat_suppOf μ₁ Z₁ hμ₁, h_H_nat_suppOf μ₂ Z₂ hμ₂, h_supp]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => by rw [heq z])

  
  have h_finProbAt : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (X : Fin M → γ) (x : Fin M),
      finProbAt μ X x = probOf μ X (X x) := by
    intro M γ _ μ X x
    unfold finProbAt
    dsimp only [probOf]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
    split_ifs <;> rfl

  have h_finProbAt2 : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ₁ γ₂ : Type} [DecidableEq γ₁] [DecidableEq γ₂]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (X : Fin M → γ₁) (Y : Fin M → γ₂) (x : Fin M),
      finProbAt2 μ X Y x = probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) (X x, Y x) := by
    intro M γ₁ γ₂ _ _ μ X Y x
    unfold finProbAt2
    dsimp only [probOf]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    split_ifs <;> rfl

  have h_finProbAt_unit : ∀ {M : ℕ} (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (x : Fin M),
      (∑ y : Fin M, μ y = 1) → finProbAt μ (fun _ => ()) x = 1 := by
    intro M μ x hsum
    rw [h_finProbAt]
    dsimp only [probOf]
    simpa only [ite_true] using hsum

  have h_finProbAt2_unit : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ : Type} [DecidableEq γ]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (Y : Fin M → γ) (x : Fin M),
      finProbAt2 μ (fun _ => ()) Y x = probOf μ Y (Y x) := by
    intro M γ _ μ Y x
    unfold finProbAt2
    dsimp only [probOf]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
    simp only [true_and]

  have h_ell_mutualInfo : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ₁ γ₂ : Type} [DecidableEq γ₁] [DecidableEq γ₂]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (X : Fin M → γ₁) (Y : Fin M → γ₂),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) → (∑ x : Fin M, μ x = 1) →
      ell * finMutualInfo ε μ X Y =
        H_nat μ X + H_nat μ Y - H_nat μ (fun x => (X x, Y x)) := by
    intro M γ₁ γ₂ _ _ μ X Y hμ hsum
    have h_uncond : ell * finCondEntropy ε μ (fun _ => ()) Y = H_nat μ Y := by
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      dsimp only [H_nat]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [h_finProbAt2_unit, h_finProbAt_unit μ x hsum, div_one]
      change ell * (μ x * (-Real.log (probOf μ Y (Y x)) / ell)) =
        μ x * -Real.log (probOf μ Y (Y x))
      field_simp [hell_ne]
    have h_cond : ell * finCondEntropy ε μ X Y =
        H_nat μ (fun x => (X x, Y x)) - H_nat μ X := by
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      dsimp only [H_nat]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [h_finProbAt2, h_finProbAt]
      change ell * (μ x * (-Real.log (probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) (X x, Y x) /
          probOf μ X (X x)) / ell)) =
        μ x * -Real.log (probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) (X x, Y x)) -
          μ x * -Real.log (probOf μ X (X x))
      by_cases hx0 : μ x = 0
      · rw [hx0]
        simp
      · have hx_pos : 0 < μ x := lt_of_le_of_ne (hμ x) (Ne.symm hx0)
        have hXY_pos : 0 < probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) (X x, Y x) :=
          h_pos_probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) x hμ hx_pos
        have hX_pos : 0 < probOf μ X (X x) := h_pos_probOf μ X x hμ hx_pos
        rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hXY_pos) (ne_of_gt hX_pos)]
        field_simp [hell_ne]
        ring
    unfold finMutualInfo
    rw [mul_sub, h_uncond, h_cond]
    ring

  have h_H_nat_mono : ∀ {M : ℕ} {γ₁ γ₂ : Type} [DecidableEq γ₁] [DecidableEq γ₂]
      (μ : Fin M → ℝ) (X : Fin M → γ₁) (Y : Fin M → γ₂),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) → H_nat μ X ≤ H_nat μ (fun x => (X x, Y x)) := by
    intro M γ₁ γ₂ _ _ μ X Y hμ
    dsimp only [H_nat]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => ?_)
    by_cases hx0 : μ x = 0
    · rw [hx0]
      simp
    · have hx_pos : 0 < μ x := lt_of_le_of_ne (hμ x) (Ne.symm hx0)
      have hXY_pos : 0 < probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) (X x, Y x) :=
        h_pos_probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) x hμ hx_pos
      have h_prob_le : probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) (X x, Y x) ≤ probOf μ X (X x) := by
        dsimp only [probOf]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X y = X x <;> by_cases hY : Y y = Y x <;>
          simp [hX, hY, hμ y]
      have h_log_le : Real.log (probOf μ (fun y => (X y, Y y)) (X x, Y x)) ≤
          Real.log (probOf μ X (X x)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hXY_pos h_prob_le
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_neg h_log_le) (hμ x)

  
  let π₂ : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → ℝ := twoReplicaProb π T_idx
  let T₂ : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → Fin N_T := twoReplicaT T_idx
  let D₁ : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → α := fun ij => D (finProdFinEquiv.symm ij).1
  let D₂ : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → α := fun ij => D (finProdFinEquiv.symm ij).2
  let Y_pair : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → α × α := fun ij => (D₁ ij, D₂ ij)
  let C : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → β := fun ij => f_c (D₁ ij) (D₂ ij)
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := probOf π T_idx

  have hπ₂_nn : ∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 ≤ π₂ ij := by
    intro ij
    dsimp only [π₂, twoReplicaProb]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hπ_nn _) (hπ_nn _)) h.2.le
    · exact le_rfl

  have hπ₂_eq_pos : ∀ (ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω),
      T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ → 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₁) →
      π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) = (π ω₁ * π ω₂) / p_T (T_idx ω₁) := by
    intro ω₁ ω₂ hT hp
    dsimp only [π₂, twoReplicaProb]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hs : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = T_idx ω₁ then π ω else 0) = p_T (T_idx ω₁) := rfl
    split_ifs with hc
    · rw [hs]
    · exfalso
      apply hc
      rw [hs]
      exact ⟨hT, hp⟩

  have hπ₂_eq_zero : ∀ (ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω),
      ¬ (T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ ∧ 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₁)) →
      π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) = 0 := by
    intro ω₁ ω₂ hnot
    dsimp only [π₂, twoReplicaProb]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hs : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = T_idx ω₁ then π ω else 0) = p_T (T_idx ω₁) := rfl
    split_ifs with hc
    · exfalso
      apply hnot
      rwa [hs] at hc
    · rfl

  have hπ₂_marg1 : ∀ ω₁ : Fin N_ω,
      (∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂))) = π ω₁ := by
    intro ω₁
    by_cases h0 : π ω₁ = 0
    · rw [h0]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω₂ _ => ?_)
      by_cases hc : T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ ∧ 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₁)
      · rw [hπ₂_eq_pos ω₁ ω₂ hc.1 hc.2, h0, zero_mul, zero_div]
      · exact hπ₂_eq_zero ω₁ ω₂ hc
    · have h_pos : 0 < π ω₁ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn ω₁) (Ne.symm h0)
      have hp1 : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₁) := h_pos_probOf π T_idx ω₁ hπ_nn h_pos
      have h_term : ∀ ω₂ : Fin N_ω,
          π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) =
            (π ω₁ / p_T (T_idx ω₁)) * (if T_idx ω₂ = T_idx ω₁ then π ω₂ else 0) := by
        intro ω₂
        by_cases hT : T_idx ω₂ = T_idx ω₁
        · rw [if_pos hT, hπ₂_eq_pos ω₁ ω₂ hT.symm hp1]
          ring
        · rw [if_neg hT, mul_zero]
          exact hπ₂_eq_zero ω₁ ω₂ (fun h => hT h.1.symm)
      simp_rw [h_term, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      change (π ω₁ / p_T (T_idx ω₁)) * p_T (T_idx ω₁) = π ω₁
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ (π ω₁) (ne_of_gt hp1)

  have hπ₂_marg2 : ∀ ω₂ : Fin N_ω,
      (∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω, π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂))) = π ω₂ := by
    intro ω₂
    by_cases h0 : π ω₂ = 0
    · rw [h0]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω₁ _ => ?_)
      by_cases hc : T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ ∧ 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₁)
      · rw [hπ₂_eq_pos ω₁ ω₂ hc.1 hc.2, h0, mul_zero, zero_div]
      · exact hπ₂_eq_zero ω₁ ω₂ hc
    · have h_pos : 0 < π ω₂ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn ω₂) (Ne.symm h0)
      have hp2 : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₂) := h_pos_probOf π T_idx ω₂ hπ_nn h_pos
      have h_term : ∀ ω₁ : Fin N_ω,
          π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) =
            (π ω₂ / p_T (T_idx ω₂)) * (if T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ then π ω₁ else 0) := by
        intro ω₁
        by_cases hT : T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂
        · have hp1 : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₁) := by rwa [hT]
          rw [if_pos hT, hπ₂_eq_pos ω₁ ω₂ hT hp1, hT]
          ring
        · rw [if_neg hT, mul_zero]
          exact hπ₂_eq_zero ω₁ ω₂ (fun h => hT h.1)
      simp_rw [h_term, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      change (π ω₂ / p_T (T_idx ω₂)) * p_T (T_idx ω₂) = π ω₂
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ (π ω₂) (ne_of_gt hp2)

  have hπ₂_sum : ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij = 1 := by
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [hπ₂_marg1]
    exact hπ_sum

  have h_prob_T₂ : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, probOf π₂ T₂ tid = probOf π T_idx tid := by
    intro tid
    dsimp only [probOf, T₂, twoReplicaT]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω₁ _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : T_idx ω₁ = tid
    · simp only [if_pos h]
      exact hπ₂_marg1 ω₁
    · simp only [if_neg h, Finset.sum_const_zero]

  have h_prob_D₁ : ∀ a : α, probOf π₂ D₁ a = probOf π D a := by
    intro a
    dsimp only [probOf, D₁]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω₁ _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : D ω₁ = a
    · simp only [if_pos h]
      exact hπ₂_marg1 ω₁
    · simp only [if_neg h, Finset.sum_const_zero]

  have h_prob_D₂ : ∀ a : α, probOf π₂ D₂ a = probOf π D a := by
    intro a
    dsimp only [probOf, D₂]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω₂ _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : D ω₂ = a
    · simp only [if_pos h]
      exact hπ₂_marg2 ω₂
    · simp only [if_neg h, Finset.sum_const_zero]

  have hH_T₂ : H_nat π₂ T₂ = H_nat π T_idx :=
    h_H_nat_congr π₂ T₂ π T_idx hπ₂_nn hπ_nn h_prob_T₂
  have hH_D₁ : H_nat π₂ D₁ = H_nat π D :=
    h_H_nat_congr π₂ D₁ π D hπ₂_nn hπ_nn h_prob_D₁
  have hH_D₂ : H_nat π₂ D₂ = H_nat π D :=
    h_H_nat_congr π₂ D₂ π D hπ₂_nn hπ_nn h_prob_D₂

  have h_prob_joint : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T), 0 < p_T tid → ∀ (a₁ a₂ : α),
      probOf π₂ (fun ij => (T₂ ij, Y_pair ij)) (tid, (a₁, a₂)) =
        (probOf π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, D ω)) (tid, a₁) *
          probOf π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, D ω)) (tid, a₂)) / p_T tid := by
    intro tid hp a₁ a₂
    dsimp only [probOf]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h_pt : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : Fin N_ω),
        (if (T₂ (finProdFinEquiv (q₁, q₂)), Y_pair (finProdFinEquiv (q₁, q₂))) = (tid, (a₁, a₂))
          then π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (q₁, q₂)) else 0) =
        ((if (T_idx q₁, D q₁) = (tid, a₁) then π q₁ else 0) *
          (if (T_idx q₂, D q₂) = (tid, a₂) then π q₂ else 0)) / p_T tid := by
      intro q₁ q₂
      have hT_simp : T₂ (finProdFinEquiv (q₁, q₂)) = T_idx q₁ := by
        dsimp only [T₂, twoReplicaT]
        rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      have hY_simp : Y_pair (finProdFinEquiv (q₁, q₂)) = (D q₁, D q₂) := by
        dsimp only [Y_pair, D₁, D₂]
        rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [hT_simp, hY_simp]
      by_cases h1 : (T_idx q₁, D q₁) = (tid, a₁)
      · have hT1 : T_idx q₁ = tid := congrArg Prod.fst h1
        have hD1 : D q₁ = a₁ := congrArg Prod.snd h1
        by_cases h2 : (T_idx q₂, D q₂) = (tid, a₂)
        · have hT2 : T_idx q₂ = tid := congrArg Prod.fst h2
          have hD2 : D q₂ = a₂ := congrArg Prod.snd h2
          have h_lhs : (T_idx q₁, (D q₁, D q₂)) = (tid, (a₁, a₂)) := by
            rw [hT1, hD1, hD2]
          have hp1 : 0 < p_T (T_idx q₁) := by rwa [hT1]
          rw [if_pos h_lhs, if_pos h1, if_pos h2,
            hπ₂_eq_pos q₁ q₂ (hT1.trans hT2.symm) hp1, hT1]
        · rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, mul_zero, zero_div]
          by_cases h_lhs : (T_idx q₁, (D q₁, D q₂)) = (tid, (a₁, a₂))
          · have hD2 : D q₂ = a₂ := congrArg Prod.snd (congrArg Prod.snd h_lhs)
            have hT2_ne : T_idx q₂ ≠ tid := fun hT2 => h2 (Prod.ext hT2 hD2)
            rw [if_pos h_lhs]
            exact hπ₂_eq_zero q₁ q₂ (fun hc => hT2_ne (hc.1.symm.trans hT1))
          · exact if_neg h_lhs
      · rw [if_neg h1, zero_mul, zero_div]
        have h_lhs : ¬ (T_idx q₁, (D q₁, D q₂)) = (tid, (a₁, a₂)) := by
          intro heq
          have hT1 : T_idx q₁ = tid := congrArg Prod.fst heq
          have hpair : (D q₁, D q₂) = (a₁, a₂) := congrArg Prod.snd heq
          have hD1 : D q₁ = a₁ := congrArg Prod.fst hpair
          exact h1 (Prod.ext hT1 hD1)
        exact if_neg h_lhs
    simp_rw [h_pt, ← Finset.sum_div, ← Fintype.sum_mul_sum]

  have hH_joint : H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (T₂ ij, Y_pair ij)) =
      2 * H_nat π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, D ω)) - H_nat π T_idx := by
    let f_TD : Fin N_ω → ℝ :=
      fun ω => -Real.log (probOf π (fun q => (T_idx q, D q)) (T_idx ω, D ω))
    let f_T : Fin N_ω → ℝ :=
      fun ω => -Real.log (p_T (T_idx ω))
    dsimp only [H_nat]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h_pt : ∀ (ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω),
        π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) *
          (-Real.log (probOf π₂ (fun ij => (T₂ ij, Y_pair ij))
            (T₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)), Y_pair (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂))))) =
        (π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) * f_TD ω₁ +
          π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) * f_TD ω₂) -
          π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) * f_T ω₁ := by
      intro ω₁ ω₂
      by_cases h0 : π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) = 0
      · rw [h0]
        simp
      · have h_pos2 : 0 < π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ₂_nn _) (Ne.symm h0)
        have hc : T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ ∧ 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₁) := by
          by_contra hnot
          exact h0 (hπ₂_eq_zero ω₁ ω₂ hnot)
        have hω₁_ne : π ω₁ ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          apply h0
          rw [hπ₂_eq_pos ω₁ ω₂ hc.1 hc.2, hz, zero_mul, zero_div]
        have hω₂_ne : π ω₂ ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          apply h0
          rw [hπ₂_eq_pos ω₁ ω₂ hc.1 hc.2, hz, mul_zero, zero_div]
        have hω₁_pos : 0 < π ω₁ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn ω₁) (Ne.symm hω₁_ne)
        have hω₂_pos : 0 < π ω₂ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn ω₂) (Ne.symm hω₂_ne)
        have hTD1_pos : 0 < probOf π (fun q => (T_idx q, D q)) (T_idx ω₁, D ω₁) :=
          h_pos_probOf π (fun q => (T_idx q, D q)) ω₁ hπ_nn hω₁_pos
        have hTD2_pos : 0 < probOf π (fun q => (T_idx q, D q)) (T_idx ω₂, D ω₂) :=
          h_pos_probOf π (fun q => (T_idx q, D q)) ω₂ hπ_nn hω₂_pos
        have hT_eval : T₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) = T_idx ω₁ := by
          dsimp only [T₂, twoReplicaT]
          rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        have hY_eval : Y_pair (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) = (D ω₁, D ω₂) := by
          dsimp only [Y_pair, D₁, D₂]
          rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        rw [hT_eval, hY_eval, h_prob_joint (T_idx ω₁) hc.2 (D ω₁) (D ω₂)]
        have h_pair2 : (T_idx ω₁, D ω₂) = (T_idx ω₂, D ω₂) := by rw [hc.1]
        rw [h_pair2]
        have h_num_pos : 0 < probOf π (fun q => (T_idx q, D q)) (T_idx ω₁, D ω₁) *
            probOf π (fun q => (T_idx q, D q)) (T_idx ω₂, D ω₂) :=
          mul_pos hTD1_pos hTD2_pos
        rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt h_num_pos) (ne_of_gt hc.2),
          Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hTD1_pos) (ne_of_gt hTD2_pos)]
        dsimp only [f_TD, f_T]
        ring
    simp_rw [h_pt, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hs1 : (∑ x : Fin N_ω, ∑ y : Fin N_ω, π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (x, y)) * f_TD x) =
        ∑ x : Fin N_ω, π x * f_TD x := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hπ₂_marg1 x]
    have hs2 : (∑ x : Fin N_ω, ∑ y : Fin N_ω, π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (x, y)) * f_TD y) =
        ∑ y : Fin N_ω, π y * f_TD y := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hπ₂_marg2 y]
    have hs3 : (∑ x : Fin N_ω, ∑ y : Fin N_ω, π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (x, y)) * f_T x) =
        ∑ x : Fin N_ω, π x * f_T x := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hπ₂_marg1 x]
    rw [hs1, hs2, hs3]
    dsimp only [f_TD, f_T, p_T]
    ring

  have h_I_pair : ell * finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ Y_pair =
      2 * (ell * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D) + H_nat π₂ Y_pair - 2 * H_nat π D := by
    have h1 := h_ell_mutualInfo π₂ T₂ Y_pair hπ₂_nn hπ₂_sum
    have h2 := h_ell_mutualInfo π T_idx D hπ_nn hπ_sum
    linarith [h1, h2, hH_T₂, hH_joint]

  
  have h_submod : H_nat π₂ Y_pair + H_nat π₂ C ≤
      H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (D₁ ij, C ij)) + H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (D₂ ij, C ij)) := by
    let q₁₂ := probOf π₂ Y_pair
    let q_C := probOf π₂ C
    let q₁C := probOf π₂ (fun ij => (D₁ ij, C ij))
    let q₂C := probOf π₂ (fun ij => (D₂ ij, C ij))
    let S₁₂ := suppOf π₂ Y_pair
    let S_C := suppOf π₂ C
    let S₁ := suppOf π₂ D₁
    let S₂ := suppOf π₂ D₂
    let g_kl : α × α → ℝ := fun q =>
      (-Real.log (q₁₂ q)) + (-Real.log (q_C (f_c q.1 q.2))) -
        ((-Real.log (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2))) + (-Real.log (q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2))))
    have h_diff_eq : (H_nat π₂ Y_pair + H_nat π₂ C) -
        (H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (D₁ ij, C ij)) + H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (D₂ ij, C ij))) =
        ∑ q ∈ S₁₂, q₁₂ q * g_kl q := by
      have h_raw : (H_nat π₂ Y_pair + H_nat π₂ C) -
          (H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (D₁ ij, C ij)) + H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (D₂ ij, C ij))) =
          ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij * g_kl (Y_pair ij) := by
        dsimp only [H_nat, g_kl, q₁₂, q_C, q₁C, q₂C, Y_pair, C]
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
        ring
      rw [h_raw]
      exact h_exp_suppOf π₂ Y_pair g_kl hπ₂_nn
    have h_S12_mem : ∀ q ∈ S₁₂,
        q.1 ∈ S₁ ∧ q.2 ∈ S₂ ∧ f_c q.1 q.2 ∈ S_C ∧
        0 < q₁₂ q ∧ 0 < q_C (f_c q.1 q.2) ∧
        0 < q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) ∧ 0 < q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2) := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨ij, hij, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      have hij_pos : 0 < π₂ ij := (h_mem_posSupport π₂ ij).mp hij
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem D₁ hij,
        Finset.mem_image_of_mem D₂ hij,
        Finset.mem_image_of_mem C hij,
        h_pos_probOf π₂ Y_pair ij hπ₂_nn hij_pos,
        h_pos_probOf π₂ C ij hπ₂_nn hij_pos,
        h_pos_probOf π₂ (fun kl => (D₁ kl, C kl)) ij hπ₂_nn hij_pos,
        h_pos_probOf π₂ (fun kl => (D₂ kl, C kl)) ij hπ₂_nn hij_pos⟩
    have h_pt_kl : ∀ q ∈ S₁₂,
        q₁₂ q * g_kl q ≤
          (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) * q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2)) / q_C (f_c q.1 q.2) - q₁₂ q := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hq12, hqC, hq1C, hq2C⟩ := h_S12_mem q hq
      let u : ℝ := (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) * q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2)) /
        (q₁₂ q * q_C (f_c q.1 q.2))
      have hu_pos : 0 < u := div_pos (mul_pos hq1C hq2C) (mul_pos hq12 hqC)
      have h_log_u : Real.log u = g_kl q := by
        dsimp only [u, g_kl]
        rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hq1C hq2C)) (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hq12 hqC)),
          Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hq1C) (ne_of_gt hq2C),
          Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hq12) (ne_of_gt hqC)]
        ring
      have h_le1 : g_kl q ≤ u - 1 := by
        rw [← h_log_u]
        exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu_pos
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le1 hq12.le
      have h_alg : q₁₂ q * (u - 1) =
          (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) * q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2)) / q_C (f_c q.1 q.2) - q₁₂ q := by
        dsimp only [u]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hq12, ne_of_gt hqC]
      rwa [h_alg] at h_mul
    have h_sum1 : ∑ q ∈ S₁₂, q₁₂ q * g_kl q ≤
        (∑ q ∈ S₁₂, (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) * q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2)) / q_C (f_c q.1 q.2)) -
          ∑ q ∈ S₁₂, q₁₂ q := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt_kl
    have h_maps_C : ∀ q ∈ S₁₂, f_c q.1 q.2 ∈ S_C := fun q hq => (h_S12_mem q hq).2.2.1
    have h_marg1C : ∀ c : β, (∑ a₁ ∈ S₁, q₁C (a₁, c)) = q_C c := by
      intro c
      have h_rew : ∀ a₁ : α, q₁C (a₁, c) =
          ∑ ij ∈ posSupport π₂, if D₁ ij = a₁ then (if C ij = c then π₂ ij else 0) else 0 := by
        intro a₁
        dsimp only [q₁C]
        rw [← h_fiber_probOf π₂ (fun ij => (D₁ ij, C ij)) (a₁, c) hπ₂_nn, Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
        by_cases hD : D₁ ij = a₁ <;> by_cases hC : C ij = c <;> simp [hD, hC]
      simp_rw [h_rew]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h_in : (∑ ij ∈ posSupport π₂,
          ∑ a₁ ∈ S₁, if D₁ ij = a₁ then (if C ij = c then π₂ ij else 0) else 0) =
          ∑ ij ∈ posSupport π₂, if C ij = c then π₂ ij else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij hij => ?_)
        have h_mem1 : D₁ ij ∈ S₁ := Finset.mem_image_of_mem D₁ hij
        simpa only [eq_comm] using
          Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem S₁ (D₁ ij) (fun _ => if C ij = c then π₂ ij else 0) h_mem1
      rw [h_in, ← Finset.sum_filter, h_fiber_probOf π₂ C c hπ₂_nn]
    have h_marg2C : ∀ c : β, (∑ a₂ ∈ S₂, q₂C (a₂, c)) = q_C c := by
      intro c
      have h_rew : ∀ a₂ : α, q₂C (a₂, c) =
          ∑ ij ∈ posSupport π₂, if D₂ ij = a₂ then (if C ij = c then π₂ ij else 0) else 0 := by
        intro a₂
        dsimp only [q₂C]
        rw [← h_fiber_probOf π₂ (fun ij => (D₂ ij, C ij)) (a₂, c) hπ₂_nn, Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
        by_cases hD : D₂ ij = a₂ <;> by_cases hC : C ij = c <;> simp [hD, hC]
      simp_rw [h_rew]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h_in : (∑ ij ∈ posSupport π₂,
          ∑ a₂ ∈ S₂, if D₂ ij = a₂ then (if C ij = c then π₂ ij else 0) else 0) =
          ∑ ij ∈ posSupport π₂, if C ij = c then π₂ ij else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij hij => ?_)
        have h_mem2 : D₂ ij ∈ S₂ := Finset.mem_image_of_mem D₂ hij
        simpa only [eq_comm] using
          Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem S₂ (D₂ ij) (fun _ => if C ij = c then π₂ ij else 0) h_mem2
      rw [h_in, ← Finset.sum_filter, h_fiber_probOf π₂ C c hπ₂_nn]
    have h_rect_sum : (∑ q ∈ S₁₂,
        (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) * q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2)) / q_C (f_c q.1 q.2)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps_C]
      have h_c_le : ∀ c ∈ S_C,
          (∑ q ∈ S₁₂ with f_c q.1 q.2 = c,
            (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) * q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2)) / q_C (f_c q.1 q.2)) ≤ q_C c := by
        intro c hc
        have hqC_pos : 0 < q_C c := (h_mem_suppOf π₂ C c hπ₂_nn).mp hc
        have h_eq_c : (∑ q ∈ S₁₂ with f_c q.1 q.2 = c,
            (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) * q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2)) / q_C (f_c q.1 q.2)) =
            (∑ q ∈ S₁₂ with f_c q.1 q.2 = c, q₁C (q.1, c) * q₂C (q.2, c)) / q_C c := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq => ?_)
          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2]
        rw [h_eq_c]
        have h_sub_prod : {q ∈ S₁₂ | f_c q.1 q.2 = c} ⊆ S₁ ×ˢ S₂ := by
          intro q hq
          have hq12 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
          exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨(h_S12_mem q hq12).1, (h_S12_mem q hq12).2.1⟩
        have h_num_le : (∑ q ∈ S₁₂ with f_c q.1 q.2 = c, q₁C (q.1, c) * q₂C (q.2, c)) ≤
            q_C c * q_C c := by
          calc (∑ q ∈ S₁₂ with f_c q.1 q.2 = c, q₁C (q.1, c) * q₂C (q.2, c))
              ≤ ∑ p ∈ S₁ ×ˢ S₂, q₁C (p.1, c) * q₂C (p.2, c) :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub_prod (fun p _ _ =>
                  mul_nonneg (h_probOf_nn π₂ _ _ hπ₂_nn) (h_probOf_nn π₂ _ _ hπ₂_nn))
            _ = ∑ a₁ ∈ S₁, ∑ a₂ ∈ S₂, q₁C (a₁, c) * q₂C (a₂, c) :=
                Finset.sum_product' S₁ S₂ (fun a₁ a₂ => q₁C (a₁, c) * q₂C (a₂, c))
            _ = (∑ a₁ ∈ S₁, q₁C (a₁, c)) * (∑ a₂ ∈ S₂, q₂C (a₂, c)) :=
                (Finset.sum_mul_sum S₁ S₂ (fun a₁ => q₁C (a₁, c)) (fun a₂ => q₂C (a₂, c))).symm
            _ = q_C c * q_C c := by rw [h_marg1C c, h_marg2C c]
        calc (∑ q ∈ S₁₂ with f_c q.1 q.2 = c, q₁C (q.1, c) * q₂C (q.2, c)) / q_C c
            ≤ (q_C c * q_C c) / q_C c := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le hqC_pos.le
          _ = q_C c := mul_div_cancel_right₀ (q_C c) (ne_of_gt hqC_pos)
      calc (∑ c ∈ S_C, ∑ q ∈ S₁₂ with f_c q.1 q.2 = c,
              (q₁C (q.1, f_c q.1 q.2) * q₂C (q.2, f_c q.1 q.2)) / q_C (f_c q.1 q.2))
          ≤ ∑ c ∈ S_C, q_C c := Finset.sum_le_sum h_c_le
        _ = ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij := h_sum_suppOf π₂ C hπ₂_nn
        _ = 1 := hπ₂_sum
    have h_sum_q12 : ∑ q ∈ S₁₂, q₁₂ q = 1 :=
      (h_sum_suppOf π₂ Y_pair hπ₂_nn).trans hπ₂_sum
    linarith [h_diff_eq, h_sum1, h_rect_sum, h_sum_q12]

  
  have h_fiber_inc : ∀ (X : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → α) (K : ℕ) (Fib : α → Finset β),
      1 ≤ K → (∀ a, (Fib a).card ≤ K) → (∀ ij, 0 < π₂ ij → C ij ∈ Fib (X ij)) →
      H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (X ij, C ij)) - H_nat π₂ X ≤ Real.log (K : ℝ) := by
    intro X K Fib hK hFib_card h_mem
    have hK_pos : 0 < (K : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    let q_XC := probOf π₂ (fun ij => (X ij, C ij))
    let q_X := probOf π₂ X
    let S_XC := suppOf π₂ (fun ij => (X ij, C ij))
    let S_X := suppOf π₂ X
    let h_kl : α × β → ℝ :=
      fun p => (-Real.log (q_XC p)) - (-Real.log (q_X p.1)) - Real.log (K : ℝ)
    have h_diff_eq : (H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (X ij, C ij)) - H_nat π₂ X) - Real.log (K : ℝ) =
        ∑ p ∈ S_XC, q_XC p * h_kl p := by
      have h_logK : Real.log (K : ℝ) = ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij * Real.log (K : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hπ₂_sum, one_mul]
      have h_raw : (H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (X ij, C ij)) - H_nat π₂ X) - Real.log (K : ℝ) =
          ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij * h_kl (X ij, C ij) := by
        rw [h_logK]
        dsimp only [H_nat, h_kl, q_XC, q_X]
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
        ring
      rw [h_raw]
      exact h_exp_suppOf π₂ (fun ij => (X ij, C ij)) h_kl hπ₂_nn
    have h_SXC_mem : ∀ p ∈ S_XC,
        p.1 ∈ S_X ∧ p.2 ∈ Fib p.1 ∧ 0 < q_XC p ∧ 0 < q_X p.1 := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨ij, hij, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      have hij_pos : 0 < π₂ ij := (h_mem_posSupport π₂ ij).mp hij
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hij,
        h_mem ij hij_pos,
        h_pos_probOf π₂ (fun kl => (X kl, C kl)) ij hπ₂_nn hij_pos,
        h_pos_probOf π₂ X ij hπ₂_nn hij_pos⟩
    have h_pt_kl : ∀ p ∈ S_XC, q_XC p * h_kl p ≤ q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ) - q_XC p := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨_, _, hqXC, hqX⟩ := h_SXC_mem p hp
      let u : ℝ := q_X p.1 / ((K : ℝ) * q_XC p)
      have hu_pos : 0 < u := div_pos hqX (mul_pos hK_pos hqXC)
      have h_log_u : Real.log u = h_kl p := by
        dsimp only [u, h_kl]
        rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hqX) (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hK_pos hqXC)),
          Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hK_pos) (ne_of_gt hqXC)]
        ring
      have h_le1 : h_kl p ≤ u - 1 := by
        rw [← h_log_u]
        exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu_pos
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le1 hqXC.le
      have h_alg : q_XC p * (u - 1) = q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ) - q_XC p := by
        dsimp only [u]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hK_pos, ne_of_gt hqXC]
      rwa [h_alg] at h_mul
    have h_sum1 : ∑ p ∈ S_XC, q_XC p * h_kl p ≤
        (∑ p ∈ S_XC, q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ)) - ∑ p ∈ S_XC, q_XC p := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt_kl
    have h_maps_X : ∀ p ∈ S_XC, p.1 ∈ S_X := fun p hp => (h_SXC_mem p hp).1
    have h_fib_sum : (∑ p ∈ S_XC, q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps_X]
      have h_a_le : ∀ a ∈ S_X,
          (∑ p ∈ S_XC with p.1 = a, q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ)) ≤ q_X a := by
        intro a ha
        have hqX_nn : 0 ≤ q_X a := h_probOf_nn π₂ X a hπ₂_nn
        let F_a : Finset (α × β) := {p ∈ S_XC | p.1 = a}
        have h_maps_snd : Set.MapsTo Prod.snd (F_a : Set (α × β)) (Fib a : Set β) := by
          intro p hp
          have hp_f := Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hp)
          have h_mem_p := (h_SXC_mem p hp_f.1).2.1
          rw [hp_f.2] at h_mem_p
          exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr h_mem_p
        have h_inj_snd : Set.InjOn Prod.snd (F_a : Set (α × β)) := by
          intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ hsnd
          have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hp₁)).2
          have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hp₂)).2
          exact Prod.ext (h1.trans h2.symm) hsnd
        have h_card_nat : F_a.card ≤ K :=
          le_trans (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Prod.snd h_maps_snd h_inj_snd) (hFib_card a)
        have h_card_real : (F_a.card : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr h_card_nat
        have h_const : (∑ p ∈ F_a, q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ)) = (F_a.card : ℝ) * (q_X a / (K : ℝ)) := by
          have h1 : (∑ p ∈ F_a, q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ)) = ∑ _p ∈ F_a, q_X a / (K : ℝ) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p hp => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2])
          rw [h1, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        change (∑ p ∈ F_a, q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ)) ≤ q_X a
        rw [h_const]
        calc (F_a.card : ℝ) * (q_X a / (K : ℝ))
            ≤ (K : ℝ) * (q_X a / (K : ℝ)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card_real (div_nonneg hqX_nn hK_pos.le)
          _ = q_X a := mul_div_cancel₀ (q_X a) (ne_of_gt hK_pos)
      calc (∑ a ∈ S_X, ∑ p ∈ S_XC with p.1 = a, q_X p.1 / (K : ℝ))
          ≤ ∑ a ∈ S_X, q_X a := Finset.sum_le_sum h_a_le
        _ = ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij := h_sum_suppOf π₂ X hπ₂_nn
        _ = 1 := hπ₂_sum
    have h_sum_qXC : ∑ p ∈ S_XC, q_XC p = 1 :=
      (h_sum_suppOf π₂ (fun ij => (X ij, C ij)) hπ₂_nn).trans hπ₂_sum
    linarith [h_diff_eq, h_sum1, h_fib_sum, h_sum_qXC]

  have h_inc1 : H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (D₁ ij, C ij)) ≤ H_nat π D + Real.log (K₁ : ℝ) := by
    have h1 := h_fiber_inc D₁ K₁ Fib₁ hK₁ hFib₁_card (fun ij hpos => (hFib_mem ij hpos).1)
    linarith [h1, hH_D₁]

  have h_inc2 : H_nat π₂ (fun ij => (D₂ ij, C ij)) ≤ H_nat π D + Real.log (K₂ : ℝ) := by
    have h2 := h_fiber_inc D₂ K₂ Fib₂ hK₂ hFib₂_card (fun ij hpos => (hFib_mem ij hpos).2)
    linarith [h2, hH_D₂]

  have h_I_comm : ell * finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ C ≤ H_nat π₂ C := by
    have h1 := h_ell_mutualInfo π₂ T₂ C hπ₂_nn hπ₂_sum
    have h2 := h_H_nat_mono π₂ T₂ C hπ₂_nn
    linarith [h1, h2]

  have h_scaled :
      ell * (finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ Y_pair + finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ C) ≤
        ell * (2 * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D) + (Real.log (K₁ : ℝ) + Real.log (K₂ : ℝ)) := by
    have h_lhs : ell * (finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ Y_pair + finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ C) =
        ell * finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ Y_pair + ell * finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ C := mul_add _ _ _
    have h_rhs : ell * (2 * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D) =
        2 * (ell * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D) := by ring
    linarith [h_lhs, h_rhs, h_I_pair, h_I_comm, h_submod, h_inc1, h_inc2]

  have h_final_bound :
      finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ Y_pair + finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ C ≤
        2 * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D + (Real.log (K₁ : ℝ) + Real.log (K₂ : ℝ)) / ell := by
    have h_div :
        finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ Y_pair + finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ C ≤
          (ell * (2 * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D) + (Real.log (K₁ : ℝ) + Real.log (K₂ : ℝ))) /
            ell := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hell_pos]
      linarith [h_scaled]
    have h_eq_rhs :
        (ell * (2 * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D) + (Real.log (K₁ : ℝ) + Real.log (K₂ : ℝ))) / ell =
          2 * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D + (Real.log (K₁ : ℝ) + Real.log (K₂ : ℝ)) / ell := by
      rw [add_div, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hell_ne]
    rwa [h_eq_rhs] at h_div

  exact ⟨hπ₂_nn, hπ₂_sum, h_final_bound⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(γ ε e : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε ≤ 1 / 64) (he₀ : 0 < e)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (h_law : IsUnitBallStdLaw π V_part A_part c_s θ_s) :
    let D_obs : Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
      fun ω => stdRootObs ε e (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (θ_s ω)
    let f_c : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) →
        (ℕ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
      fun d₁ d₂ => replicaCommonCell ε e (replicaSepTag ε e d₁.1 d₂.1) d₁
    let π₂ := twoReplicaProb π T_idx
    let T₂ := twoReplicaT T_idx
    let v_ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → ℝ := fun ij =>
      let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
      replicaSepDepth e (replicaSepTag ε e (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1)
    (∃ (Fib₁ Fib₂ : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (ℕ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)),
      (∀ d₁, (Fib₁ d₁).card ≤ ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 2) ∧
      (∀ d₂, (Fib₂ d₂).card ≤ (⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 2) * 13068) ∧
      (∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 < π₂ ij →
        let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
        f_c (D_obs p.1) (D_obs p.2) ∈ Fib₁ (D_obs p.1) ∧
        f_c (D_obs p.1) (D_obs p.2) ∈ Fib₂ (D_obs p.2))) ∧
    (∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 ≤ v_ij ij ∧ v_ij ij ≤ e) ∧
    ((∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij * ((1 - γ) * v_ij ij)) -
      finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂
        (fun ij => let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij; f_c (D_obs p.1) (D_obs p.2)) ≤
      classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part) ∧
    ((∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
        π₂ ij * (2 * e - (1 + γ) * v_ij ij - (1 + γ) / 4)) -
      finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂
        (fun ij => let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij; (D_obs p.1, D_obs p.2)) ≤
      classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part)
