proof.tactics:
by
  intro D_obs f_c π₂ T₂ v_ij
  have hε_lt_one : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have hε_le_one : ε ≤ 1 := hε_lt_one.le
  have h1pe_nn : 0 ≤ 1 + e := by linarith
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr hε_lt_one)
  have hell_ne : ell ≠ 0 := hell_pos.ne'
  have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlog2_ne : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := hlog2_pos.ne'

  
  let angPhi : ℝ → ℤ → ℝ := fun L k =>
    ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε L))⁻¹
  have h_ang_norm : ∀ (L : ℝ) (k : ℤ), ‖angUnitVec ε L k‖ = 1 := by
    intro L k
    have hsq : ‖angUnitVec ε L k‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]

    intro w hw

      have h1 : inner ℝ w w = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hw, one_pow]
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
      simpa [RCLike.inner_apply] using h1
    have hp0 : (perp2D w).ofLp 0 = -(w.ofLp 1) := rfl
    have hp1 : (perp2D w).ofLp 1 = w.ofLp 0 := rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hsq : ‖perp2D w‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, hp0, hp1]
        simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
        linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D w)]
    · rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, hp0, hp1]

      simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial, smul_eq_mul]
      fin_cases i
      · change x.ofLp 0 =
          (w.ofLp 0 * x.ofLp 0 + w.ofLp 1 * x.ofLp 1) * w.ofLp 0 +
            (-(w.ofLp 1) * x.ofLp 0 + w.ofLp 0 * x.ofLp 1) * (perp2D w).ofLp 0
        rw [hp0]
        linear_combination -x.ofLp 0 * hw_sq

            (-(w.ofLp 1) * x.ofLp 0 + w.ofLp 0 * x.ofLp 1) * (perp2D w).ofLp 1
        rw [hp1]

  have h_ang_sin : ∀ (L₁ L₂ : ℝ) (k₁ k₂ : ℤ),

    have h11 : (angUnitVec ε L₁ k₁).ofLp 1 = Real.sin (angPhi L₁ k₁) := rfl
    have h20 : (perp2D (angUnitVec ε L₂ k₂)).ofLp 0 = -Real.sin (angPhi L₂ k₂) := rfl
    have h21 : (perp2D (angUnitVec ε L₂ k₂)).ofLp 1 = Real.cos (angPhi L₂ k₂) := rfl

  have h_level_zero : dyadicRealLevel ε 0 = 0 := by
    simp [dyadicRealLevel]
  have h_step_zero : dyadicRealStep ε 0 = 1 := by
    simp [dyadicRealStep, h_level_zero]
  have h_step_bounds : ∀ L : ℝ,
      0 < dyadicRealStep ε L ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L) * dyadicRealStep ε L = 1 ∧
      ε ^ L ≤ dyadicRealStep ε L ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dyadicRealStep ε L ≤ ε ^ L := by
    intro L
    let n : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    let α : ℝ := L * (ell / Real.log 2)
    have h_pos : 0 < dyadicRealStep ε L := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (-n)
    have h_mul : (2 : ℝ) ^ n * dyadicRealStep ε L = 1 := by
      dsimp only [dyadicRealStep, n]
      rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero]
    have h2α : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) = ε ^ L := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [α, ell]
      rw [Real.log_inv]
      field_simp [hlog2_ne]
    have h_rpow : dyadicRealStep ε L = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ)) := by
      change (2 : ℝ) ^ (-n) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ))
      rw [← Int.cast_neg, Real.rpow_intCast]
    have hn_le : (n : ℝ) ≤ α := Int.floor_le α
    have hn_gt : α < (n : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one α
    have h_ge : ε ^ L ≤ dyadicRealStep ε L := by
      rw [← h2α, h_rpow]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by linarith)
    have h_le2 : dyadicRealStep ε L ≤ 2 * ε ^ L := by
      rw [h_rpow, ← h2α]
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ))
          ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 + (-α)) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by linarith)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) :=
            Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) 1 (-α)
        _ = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
    exact ⟨h_pos, h_mul, h_ge, by linarith⟩
  have h_mid_err : ∀ (L x : ℝ),
      |x - ((dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L| ≤

    intro L x
    let n : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    let k : ℤ := dyadicRealBin ε L x

    have hk_lt : x * (2 : ℝ) ^ n < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have h_abs : |x * (2 : ℝ) ^ n - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨h_pos, h_mul, _, _⟩ := h_step_bounds L
    have h_eq : x - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L =
        (x * (2 : ℝ) ^ n - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * dyadicRealStep ε L := by
      dsimp only [n] at h_mul ⊢
      linear_combination -x * h_mul
    rw [h_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_pos]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_abs h_pos.le
  let cellApprox : ℝ → ℤ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    fun L k W =>
      let w := angUnitVec ε L k
      (((dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ W w) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 0) • w +
        (((dyadicRealBin ε L (inner ℝ W (perp2D w)) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L) • perp2D w
  have h_cell_err : ∀ (L : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      let w := angUnitVec ε L k
      |inner ℝ (W - cellApprox L k W) w| ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      |inner ℝ (W - cellApprox L k W) (perp2D w)| ≤ ε ^ L := by
    intro L k W
    let w := angUnitVec ε L k
    have hw : ‖w‖ = 1 := h_ang_norm L k
    obtain ⟨hp_norm, hwp, _⟩ := h_perp_frame w hw
    have hww : inner ℝ w w = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hw, one_pow]
    have hpp : inner ℝ (perp2D w) (perp2D w) = 1 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hp_norm, one_pow]
    have hpw : inner ℝ (perp2D w) w = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm, hwp]
    constructor
    · have h_in : inner ℝ (W - cellApprox L k W) w =
          inner ℝ W w - ((dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ W w) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 0 := by
        dsimp only [cellApprox, w]
        rw [inner_sub_left, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hww, hpw]
        ring
      rw [h_in]
      calc |inner ℝ W w - ((dyadicRealBin ε 0 (inner ℝ W w) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε 0|
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dyadicRealStep ε 0 := h_mid_err 0 (inner ℝ W w)
        _ = 1 / 2 := by rw [h_step_zero, mul_one]
    · have h_in : inner ℝ (W - cellApprox L k W) (perp2D w) =
          inner ℝ W (perp2D w) -
            ((dyadicRealBin ε L (inner ℝ W (perp2D w)) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L := by
        dsimp only [cellApprox, w]
        rw [inner_sub_left, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hwp, hpp]
        ring
      rw [h_in]
      exact le_trans (h_mid_err L (inner ℝ W (perp2D w))) (h_step_bounds L).2.2.2

  
  have h_sep : ∀ k₁ k₂ : ℤ,
      let kt := replicaSepTag ε e k₁ k₂
      let v := replicaSepDepth e kt
      let s := |inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e k₁) (perp2D (angUnitVec ε e k₂))|
      let b_i := max 0 (e - v - 1 / 4)
      kt ≤ ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 1 ∧ 0 ≤ v ∧ v ≤ e ∧ s ≤ ε ^ v ∧
      (0 < b_i → ε ^ (e - b_i) < s) := by
    intro k₁ k₂
    let e₁ := angUnitVec ε e k₁
    let e₂ := angUnitVec ε e k₂
    let s := |inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂)|
    let kt := replicaSepTag ε e k₁ k₂
    let v := replicaSepDepth e kt
    let b_i := max 0 (e - v - 1 / 4)
    have hs_le1 : s ≤ 1 := by
      calc |inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂)|
          ≤ ‖e₁‖ * ‖perp2D e₂‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ = 1 * 1 := by rw [h_ang_norm, (h_perp_frame e₂ (h_ang_norm e k₂)).1]
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    by_cases hs : s ≤ ε ^ e
    · have hkt_eq : kt = ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 1 := by
        dsimp only [kt, replicaSepTag]
        exact if_pos hs
      have hv_eq : v = e := by
        dsimp only [v, replicaSepDepth]
        rw [hkt_eq, if_pos rfl]
      refine ⟨by omega, by linarith, by linarith, ?_, fun hb_pos => ?_⟩
      · change s ≤ ε ^ v
        rwa [hv_eq]
      · have hb0 : b_i = 0 := by
          dsimp only [b_i]
          rw [hv_eq]
          exact max_eq_left (by linarith)
        linarith
    · have hs_gt : ε ^ e < s := lt_of_not_ge hs
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := lt_trans (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ e) hs_gt
      let u_s : ℝ := -Real.log s / ell
      have hus_nn : 0 ≤ u_s :=
        div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_nonpos hs_pos.le hs_le1)) hell_pos.le
      have hε_us : ε ^ u_s = s := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀]
        have h_exp : Real.log ε * u_s = Real.log s := by
          dsimp only [u_s, ell]
          have h_inv : Real.log (ε⁻¹) = -Real.log ε := Real.log_inv ε
          have hlogε_ne : Real.log ε ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0
            apply hell_ne
            dsimp only [ell]
            rw [h_inv, h0, neg_zero]
          rw [h_inv]
          field_simp [hlogε_ne]
        rw [h_exp]
        exact Real.exp_log hs_pos
      have hus_lt_e : u_s < e := by
        by_contra h_ge
        have h_le := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le_one (le_of_not_gt h_ge)
        linarith [hε_us, hs_gt]
      have hfl_le : ⌊4 * u_s⌋₊ ≤ ⌊4 * e⌋₊ := Nat.floor_mono (by linarith)
      have hkt_eq : kt = ⌊4 * u_s⌋₊ := by
        dsimp only [kt, replicaSepTag]
        rw [if_neg hs]
        exact min_eq_left hfl_le
      have hkt_ne : kt ≠ ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 1 := by omega
      have hv_eq : v = (⌊4 * u_s⌋₊ : ℝ) / 4 := by
        dsimp only [v, replicaSepDepth]
        rw [if_neg hkt_ne, hkt_eq]
      have hv_nn : 0 ≤ v := by rw [hv_eq]; positivity
      have hv_le_us : v ≤ u_s := by
        rw [hv_eq]
        have h1 := Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ 4 * u_s)
        linarith
      have hv_le_e : v ≤ e := le_trans hv_le_us hus_lt_e.le
      have hs_le_εv : s ≤ ε ^ v := by
        rw [← hε_us]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le_one hv_le_us
      have hus_lt_v4 : u_s < v + 1 / 4 := by
        rw [hv_eq]
        have h1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (4 * u_s)
        linarith
      have hs_gt_v4 : ε ^ (v + 1 / 4) < s := by
        rw [← hε_us]
        exact Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt hε₀ hε_lt_one hus_lt_v4
      refine ⟨by omega, hv_nn, hv_le_e, hs_le_εv, fun hb_pos => ?_⟩
      have heb_eq : e - b_i = v + 1 / 4 := by
        have h_pos_raw : 0 < e - v - 1 / 4 := by
          by_contra h_le
          have hb0 : b_i = 0 := max_eq_left (le_of_not_gt h_le)
          linarith
        have hb_val : b_i = e - v - 1 / 4 := max_eq_right h_pos_raw.le
        linarith
      rwa [heb_eq]

  
  have h_quot : ∀ (v : ℝ), 0 ≤ v → v ≤ e →
      let m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
      let m_v := dyadicTimeLevel ε v
      let Q : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (m_e - m_v)
      m_v ≤ m_e ∧ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ v ∧
      ∀ k₁ : ℤ,
        let k_c := k₁ / Q
        |angPhi e k₁ - angPhi v k_c| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ v ∧
        |inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e k₁) (perp2D (angUnitVec ε v k_c))| ≤ 2 * ε ^ v := by
    intro v hv_nn hv_le
    let m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
    let m_v := dyadicTimeLevel ε v
    let Q : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (m_e - m_v)
    have h_rpow_le : ε ^ (-v) ≤ ε ^ (-e) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le_one (by linarith)
    have hmv_le_me : m_v ≤ m_e :=
      Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (Nat.ceil_mono h_rpow_le)
    have h2mv_ge : ε ^ (-v) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v := by
      have h1 : ε ^ (-v) ≤ (⌈ε ^ (-v)⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      have h2 : (⌈ε ^ (-v)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ m_v : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.le_pow_clog (by omega) ⌈ε ^ (-v)⌉₊
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h2
      exact le_trans h1 h2
    have h2mv_inv : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ v := by
      have h_prod : 1 ≤ ε ^ v * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (v + (-v)) := by rw [add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
          _ = ε ^ v * ε ^ (-v) := Real.rpow_add hε₀ v (-v)
          _ ≤ ε ^ v * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2mv_ge (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le v)
      have h_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v := by positivity
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod (inv_nonneg.mpr h_pos.le)
      rw [one_mul, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h_pos.ne', mul_one] at h_mul
      exact h_mul
    refine ⟨hmv_le_me, h2mv_inv, fun k₁ => ?_⟩
    let k_c := k₁ / Q
    let r := k₁ % Q
    have hQ_pos : 0 < Q := by positivity
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := Int.emod_nonneg k₁ hQ_pos.ne'
    have hr1 : r ≤ Q - 1 := by
      have hlt := Int.emod_lt_of_pos k₁ hQ_pos
      omega
    have hr0_r : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hr0
    have hr1_r : (r : ℝ) ≤ (Q : ℝ) - 1 := by
      have hcast : (r : ℝ) ≤ ((Q - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hr1
      simpa using hcast
    have hk1_eq : (Q : ℝ) * (k_c : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) = (k₁ : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.mul_ediv_add_emod k₁ Q
    have hQ_real : (Q : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_e - m_v) := by
      dsimp only [Q]
      norm_cast
    have h_pow_split : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v * (Q : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e := by
      rw [hQ_real, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hmv_le_me]
    have h_inv_rel : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v)⁻¹ = (Q : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹ := by
      have hme_ne : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hmv_ne : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hme_ne, hmv_ne]
      linarith [h_pow_split]
    have h_diff_eq : angPhi e k₁ - angPhi v k_c =
        ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (Q : ℝ) / 2) * (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹) := by
      dsimp only [angPhi]
      rw [h_inv_rel, ← hk1_eq]
      ring
    have h_rem_abs : |(r : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (Q : ℝ) / 2| ≤ (Q : ℝ) / 2 :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_scale_pos : 0 < Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have h_phi_bd : |angPhi e k₁ - angPhi v k_c| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ v := by
      rw [h_diff_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_scale_pos]
      calc |(r : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (Q : ℝ) / 2| * (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹)
          ≤ ((Q : ℝ) / 2) * (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_rem_abs h_scale_pos.le
        _ = (Real.pi / 2) * ((Q : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹) := by ring
        _ = (Real.pi / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v)⁻¹ := by rw [← h_inv_rel]
        _ ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ v :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2mv_inv (by positivity)
    have h_sin_bd : |inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e k₁) (perp2D (angUnitVec ε v k_c))| ≤ 2 * ε ^ v := by
      rw [h_ang_sin]
      have hεv_nn : 0 ≤ ε ^ v := Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le v
      have hpi4 : Real.pi ≤ 4 := Real.pi_le_four
      calc |Real.sin (angPhi e k₁ - angPhi v k_c)|
          ≤ |angPhi e k₁ - angPhi v k_c| := Real.abs_sin_le_abs
        _ ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ v := h_phi_bd
        _ ≤ 2 * ε ^ v := by nlinarith
    exact ⟨h_phi_bd, h_sin_bd⟩

  have hFib₁_card : ∀ d₁, (Fib₁ d₁).card ≤ ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 2 := by
    intro d₁

    let e₂ := angUnitVec ε e k₂
    let W₁ := cellApprox e k₁ W
    let W₂ := cellApprox e k₂ W
    let W_int := intCombine k₁ k₂ W₁ W₂
    have hb_nn : 0 ≤ b_i := le_max_left _ _
    have hb_le : b_i ≤ e := max_le he₀.le (by linarith)
    have he₁_norm : ‖e₁‖ = 1 := h_ang_norm e k₁
    obtain ⟨hp1_norm, he1_perp, hu₁_frame⟩ := h_perp_frame e₁ he₁_norm
    have hp2_norm : ‖perp2D e₂‖ = 1 := (h_perp_frame e₂ (h_ang_norm e k₂)).1
    obtain ⟨hu₁_t, hu₁_n⟩ := h_cell_err e k₁ W
    obtain ⟨_, hu₂_n⟩ := h_cell_err e k₂ W
    have hεe_nn : 0 ≤ ε ^ e := Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le e
    refine ⟨hb_nn, hb_le, he₁_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change |inner ℝ (W - W_int) e₁| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_i
      by_cases hb0 : b_i = 0
      · have hW_eq : W_int = W₁ := by
          dsimp only [W_int, intCombine]
          exact if_pos hb0
        rw [hW_eq, hb0, Real.rpow_zero]
        linarith
      · have hb_pos : 0 < b_i := lt_of_le_of_ne hb_nn (Ne.symm hb0)
        have hs_gt : ε ^ (e - b_i) < |inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂)| := hs_strict hb_pos
        let D := inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂)
        have hD_pos : 0 < |D| := lt_trans (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (e - b_i)) hs_gt
        have hD_ne : D ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp hD_pos
        have hW_eq : W_int = W₁ + (inner ℝ (W₂ - W₁) (perp2D e₂) / D) • e₁ := by
          dsimp only [W_int, intCombine]
          exact if_neg hb0
        let u₁ := W - W₁
        let u₂ := W - W₂
        have he11 : inner ℝ e₁ e₁ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he₁_norm, one_pow]
        have h_in_e1 : inner ℝ (W - W_int) e₁ =
            inner ℝ u₁ e₁ - inner ℝ (u₁ - u₂) (perp2D e₂) / D := by
          have h_diff1 : W - W_int = u₁ - (inner ℝ (W₂ - W₁) (perp2D e₂) / D) • e₁ := by
            rw [hW_eq]; dsimp only [u₁]; abel
          have h_diff2 : W₂ - W₁ = u₁ - u₂ := by dsimp only [u₁, u₂]; abel
          rw [h_diff1, h_diff2, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, he11, mul_one]
        have h_cancel : D * inner ℝ (W - W_int) e₁ =
            inner ℝ u₂ (perp2D e₂) -
              inner ℝ u₁ (perp2D e₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂) := by
          have h_u12 : inner ℝ (u₁ - u₂) (perp2D e₂) =
              inner ℝ u₁ (perp2D e₂) - inner ℝ u₂ (perp2D e₂) :=
            inner_sub_left u₁ u₂ (perp2D e₂)
          have hu₁_exp : inner ℝ u₁ (perp2D e₂) =
              inner ℝ u₁ e₁ * D +
                inner ℝ u₁ (perp2D e₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂) := by
            conv_lhs => rw [hu₁_frame u₁]
            rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]
          rw [h_in_e1, mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hD_ne, h_u12, hu₁_exp]
          ring
        have hp12_le : |inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)| ≤ 1 := by
          calc |inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)|
              ≤ ‖perp2D e₁‖ * ‖perp2D e₂‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ = 1 := by rw [hp1_norm, hp2_norm, one_mul]
        have h_prod_le : |D| * |inner ℝ (W - W_int) e₁| ≤ |D| * (2 * ε ^ b_i) := by
          rw [← abs_mul, h_cancel]
          calc |inner ℝ u₂ (perp2D e₂) -
                  inner ℝ u₁ (perp2D e₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)|
              ≤ |inner ℝ u₂ (perp2D e₂)| +
                  |inner ℝ u₁ (perp2D e₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)| := abs_sub _ _
            _ = |inner ℝ u₂ (perp2D e₂)| +
                  |inner ℝ u₁ (perp2D e₁)| * |inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)| := by rw [abs_mul]
            _ ≤ ε ^ e + ε ^ e * 1 :=
                add_le_add hu₂_n (mul_le_mul hu₁_n hp12_le (abs_nonneg _) hεe_nn)
            _ = 2 * (ε ^ (e - b_i) * ε ^ b_i) := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀ (e - b_i) b_i, sub_add_cancel]
                ring
            _ ≤ 2 * (|D| * ε ^ b_i) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_gt.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le b_i))
                  (by norm_num)
            _ = |D| * (2 * ε ^ b_i) := by ring
        have h_le2 : |inner ℝ (W - W_int) e₁| ≤ 2 * ε ^ b_i :=
          le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_prod_le hD_pos
        have hεb_nn : 0 ≤ ε ^ b_i := Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le b_i
        linarith
    · change |inner ℝ (W - W_int) (perp2D e₁)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ e
      by_cases hb0 : b_i = 0
      · have hW_eq : W_int = W₁ := by
          dsimp only [W_int, intCombine]
          exact if_pos hb0
        rw [hW_eq]
        linarith
      · have hW_eq : W_int =
            W₁ + (inner ℝ (W₂ - W₁) (perp2D e₂) / inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂)) • e₁ := by
          dsimp only [W_int, intCombine]
          exact if_neg hb0
        have h_diff : W - W_int =
            (W - W₁) - (inner ℝ (W₂ - W₁) (perp2D e₂) / inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂)) • e₁ := by
          rw [hW_eq]; abel
        rw [h_diff, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, he1_perp, mul_zero, sub_zero]
        linarith

  
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  have hp_T_nn : ∀ tid, 0 ≤ p_T tid := fun tid =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω; exact le_rfl])
  have hp_T_sum : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T tid = 1 := by
    dsimp only [p_T]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_each : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0) = π ω := by
      intro ω
      simp
    simp only [h_each]
    exact h_law.2.1
  have hπ₂_nn : ∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 ≤ π₂ ij := by
    intro ij
    dsimp only [π₂, twoReplicaProb]
    split_ifs with hc
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h_law.1 _) (h_law.1 _)) hc.2.le
    · exact le_rfl
  have h_supp₂ : ∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 < π₂ ij →
      let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
      T_idx p.1 = T_idx p.2 ∧ 0 < π p.1 ∧ 0 < π p.2 := by
    intro ij h_pos
    let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
    have h_unfold : π₂ ij =
        if T_idx p.1 = T_idx p.2 ∧
            0 < (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = T_idx p.1 then π ω else 0)
        then (π p.1 * π p.2) /
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = T_idx p.1 then π ω else 0)
        else 0 := rfl
    rw [h_unfold] at h_pos
    split_ifs at h_pos with hc
    · refine ⟨hc.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · by_contra h1
        have h0 : π p.1 = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h1) (h_law.1 p.1)
        simp [h0] at h_pos
      · by_contra h2
        have h0 : π p.2 = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h2) (h_law.1 p.2)
        simp [h0] at h_pos
    · exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 h_pos)
  have hT₂_marg : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
      (∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), if T₂ ij = tid then π₂ ij else 0) = p_T tid := by
    intro tid
    rw [← finProdFinEquiv.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have ht2 : ∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, T₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) = T_idx ω₁ := by
      intro ω₁ ω₂
      dsimp only [T₂, twoReplicaT]
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hp2 : ∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) =
        if T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ ∧ 0 < p_T (T_idx ω₁)
        then (π ω₁ * π ω₂) / p_T (T_idx ω₁) else 0 := by
      intro ω₁ ω₂
      dsimp only [π₂, twoReplicaProb, p_T]
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    by_cases hp : 0 < p_T tid
    · have h_pt_eq : ∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω,
          (if T₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) = tid then π₂ (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂)) else 0) =
            ((if T_idx ω₁ = tid then π ω₁ else 0) *
              (if T_idx ω₂ = tid then π ω₂ else 0)) / p_T tid := by
        intro ω₁ ω₂
        rw [ht2 ω₁ ω₂, hp2 ω₁ ω₂]
        by_cases h1 : T_idx ω₁ = tid
        · by_cases h2 : T_idx ω₂ = tid
          · simp [h1, h2, hp]
          · simp [h1, h2, Ne.symm h2]
        · simp [h1]
      simp_rw [h_pt_eq, ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ (p_T tid) hp.ne'
    · have hp0 : p_T tid = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hp) (hp_T_nn tid)
      rw [hp0]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω₁ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω₂ _ => ?_))
      rw [ht2 ω₁ ω₂, hp2 ω₁ ω₂]
      by_cases h1 : T_idx ω₁ = tid
      · rw [if_pos h1, h1, hp0, if_neg (fun hc => lt_irrefl 0 hc.2)]
      · rw [if_neg h1]
  have hπ₂_sum : ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij = 1 := by
    calc ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij
        = ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), ∑ tid : Fin N_T, if T₂ ij = tid then π₂ ij else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
          simp
      _ = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), if T₂ ij = tid then π₂ ij else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T tid := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => hT₂_marg tid)
      _ = 1 := hp_T_sum

  let S_root : Set ℝ :=
    { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ 1 + e ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
        (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
         let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
         let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
         s = E_w - I_TD) }
  have h_bdd : BddAbove S_root := by
    refine ⟨2 * (1 + e), ?_⟩
    intro s ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h_geom, hq_nn, hq_marg, _, hs_eq⟩
    let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
    have hq_D_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun tid _ => hq_nn tid d)
    have hq_D_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d = 1 := by
      dsimp only [q_D]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      calc ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d
          = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T tid := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => hq_marg tid)
        _ = 1 := hp_T_sum
    have hEw_le : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) ≤ 2 * (1 + e) := by
      calc ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
          ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * (2 * (1 + e)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hq_D_nn d))
            obtain ⟨hb0, hba, haL, _⟩ := h_geom d
            nlinarith
        _ = (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d) * (2 * (1 + e)) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = 2 * (1 + e) := by rw [hq_D_sum, one_mul]
    have h_kl_pt : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (d : Fin N_D),
        -(q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) ≤
          p_T tid * q_D d - q tid d := by
      intro tid d
      by_cases hq0 : q tid d = 0
      · rw [hq0, zero_mul, neg_zero, sub_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg (hp_T_nn tid) (hq_D_nn d)
      · have hq_pos : 0 < q tid d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq_nn tid d) (Ne.symm hq0)
        have hp_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
          rw [← hq_marg tid]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hq_nn tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d))
        have hqd_pos : 0 < q_D d :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => hq_nn tid' d) (Finset.mem_univ tid))
        let x := (p_T tid * q_D d) / q tid d
        have hx_pos : 0 < x := div_pos (mul_pos hp_pos hqd_pos) hq_pos
        have h_inv : q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d) = x⁻¹ := by
          dsimp only [x]
          rw [inv_div]
        have h_log_le : Real.log x ≤ x - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx_pos
        rw [h_inv, Real.log_inv, mul_neg, neg_neg]
        calc q tid d * Real.log x
            ≤ q tid d * (x - 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log_le hq_pos.le
          _ = p_T tid * q_D d - q tid d := by
              dsimp only [x]
              rw [mul_sub, mul_one, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hq_pos.ne']
    have h_kl_sum : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d)) ≥ 0 := by
      have h_neg_le : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          -(q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) ≤ 0 := by
        calc ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              -(q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d)))
            ≤ ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, (p_T tid * q_D d - q tid d) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun tid _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_kl_pt tid d))
          _ = (∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T tid) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d) -

              simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul_sum]
          _ = 1 * 1 - ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T tid := by
              rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => hq_marg tid), hp_T_sum, hq_D_sum]
          _ = 0 := by rw [hp_T_sum]; ring
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h_neg_le
      linarith
    have hI_nn : 0 ≤ (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell :=
      div_nonneg h_kl_sum hell_pos.le
    dsimp only at hs_eq
    linarith

  have h_comp : ∀ {β : Type} [DecidableEq β]
      (L_fn : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → β)
      (b_lbl a_lbl : β → ℝ)
      (e_lbl V_lbl A_lbl : β → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      (∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 < π₂ ij →
        let tid := T₂ ij
        let y := L_fn ij
        0 ≤ b_lbl y ∧ b_lbl y ≤ a_lbl y ∧ a_lbl y ≤ 1 + e ∧ ‖e_lbl y‖ = 1 ∧

        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_lbl y) (perp2D (e_lbl y))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_lbl y) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_lbl y) (e_lbl y)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_lbl y) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_lbl y) (perp2D (e_lbl y))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_lbl y)) →
      (∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          π₂ ij * ((1 + γ) * b_lbl (L_fn ij) + (1 - γ) * a_lbl (L_fn ij))) -

        classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + e) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part := by
    intro β _ L_fn b_lbl a_lbl e_lbl V_lbl A_lbl h_adm
    let F_pos : Finset (Fin (N_ω * N_ω)) :=
      @Finset.filter (Fin (N_ω * N_ω)) (fun ij => 0 < π₂ ij)
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    have hF_mem : ∀ ij, ij ∈ F_pos ↔ 0 < π₂ ij := by
      intro ij
      simp [F_pos]
    let S_L : Finset β := F_pos.image L_fn
    let N_D : ℕ := Fintype.card ↥S_L
    let e_L : ↥S_L ≃ Fin N_D := Fintype.equivFin ↥S_L
    let y_of : Fin N_D → β := fun d => (e_L.symm d).1
    have hy_inj : Function.Injective y_of := Subtype.val_injective.comp e_L.symm.injective
    let b_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => b_lbl (y_of d)
    let a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => a_lbl (y_of d)
    let e_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => e_lbl (y_of d)
    let V_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => V_lbl (y_of d)
    let A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => A_lbl (y_of d)
    let q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun tid d =>
      ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), if T₂ ij = tid ∧ L_fn ij = y_of d then π₂ ij else 0
    let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
    have hq_D_eq : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
        q_D d = ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), if L_fn ij = y_of d then π₂ ij else 0 := by
      intro d
      dsimp only [q_D, q]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
      by_cases hy : L_fn ij = y_of d
      · simp [hy]
      · simp [hy]
    have h_sum_y : ∀ (ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω)) (g : β → ℝ), 0 < π₂ ij →
        (∑ d : Fin N_D, if L_fn ij = y_of d then g (y_of d) else 0) = g (L_fn ij) := by
      intro ij g h_pos
      have hy_mem : L_fn ij ∈ S_L := Finset.mem_image_of_mem L_fn ((hF_mem ij).mpr h_pos)
      let d₀ : Fin N_D := e_L ⟨L_fn ij, hy_mem⟩
      have hd₀_val : y_of d₀ = L_fn ij := by
        dsimp only [y_of, d₀]
        rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      have h_iff : ∀ d : Fin N_D, (L_fn ij = y_of d) ↔ (d = d₀) := by
        intro d
        rw [← hd₀_val]
        exact ⟨fun h => hy_inj h.symm, fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩
      simp_rw [h_iff]
      simp [hd₀_val]
    have h_geom : ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ 1 + e ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1 := by
      intro d
      obtain ⟨ij₀, hij₀_mem, hij₀_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (e_L.symm d).2
      have h_pos : 0 < π₂ ij₀ := (hF_mem ij₀).mp hij₀_mem
      obtain ⟨hb0, hba, haL, he1, _, _, _, _⟩ := h_adm ij₀ h_pos
      dsimp only [b_D, a_D, e_D, y_of]
      rw [← hij₀_eq]
      exact ⟨hb0, hba, haL, he1⟩
    have hq_nn : ∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d := fun tid d =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ij _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₂_nn ij; exact le_rfl])
    have hq_marg : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid := by
      intro tid
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      rw [← hT₂_marg tid]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
      by_cases h_pos : 0 < π₂ ij
      · by_cases ht : T₂ ij = tid
        · simp only [ht, true_and, ↓reduceIte]
          exact h_sum_y ij (fun _ => π₂ ij) h_pos
        · simp [ht]
      · have h0 : π₂ ij = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_pos) (hπ₂_nn ij)
        simp [h0]
    have hq_supp : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (d : Fin N_D), 0 < q tid d →
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) := by
      intro tid d hq_pos
      obtain ⟨ij, _, hij_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hq_pos.ne'
      split_ifs at hij_ne with hc
      · have h_pos : 0 < π₂ ij := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ₂_nn ij) (Ne.symm hij_ne)
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hv1, hv2, ha1, ha2⟩ := h_adm ij h_pos
        dsimp only [b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D]
        rw [← hc.1, ← hc.2]
        exact ⟨hv1, hv2, ha1, ha2⟩
      · exact False.elim (hij_ne rfl)
    have hEw_eq : (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) =
        ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          π₂ ij * ((1 + γ) * b_lbl (L_fn ij) + (1 - γ) * a_lbl (L_fn ij)) := by
      simp_rw [hq_D_eq, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
      by_cases h_pos : 0 < π₂ ij
      · simp_rw [ite_mul, zero_mul]
        exact h_sum_y ij (fun y => π₂ ij * ((1 + γ) * b_lbl y + (1 - γ) * a_lbl y)) h_pos
      · have h0 : π₂ ij = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_pos) (hπ₂_nn ij)
        simp [h0]
    have hI_eq : ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell) =
        finMutualInfo ε π₂ T₂ L_fn := by
      have h_lhs_exp : ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell) =
          ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
            (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              if T₂ ij = tid ∧ L_fn ij = y_of d then
                π₂ ij * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))
              else 0) / ell := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_div]
        congr 1
        conv_lhs =>
          arg 2; ext tid; arg 2; ext d
          rw [show q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d)) =
            ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
              if T₂ ij = tid ∧ L_fn ij = y_of d then
                π₂ ij * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))
              else 0 by
            dsimp only [q]
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
            split_ifs <;> ring]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      rw [h_lhs_exp]
      unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
      by_cases h_pos : 0 < π₂ ij
      · have hy_mem : L_fn ij ∈ S_L := Finset.mem_image_of_mem L_fn ((hF_mem ij).mpr h_pos)
        let tid₀ : Fin N_T := T₂ ij
        let d₀ : Fin N_D := e_L ⟨L_fn ij, hy_mem⟩
        have hd₀_val : y_of d₀ = L_fn ij := by
          dsimp only [y_of, d₀]
          rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        have h_collapse : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if T₂ ij = tid ∧ L_fn ij = y_of d then
              π₂ ij * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))
            else 0) =
            π₂ ij * Real.log (q tid₀ d₀ / (p_T tid₀ * q_D d₀)) := by
          have h_iff : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (d : Fin N_D),
              (T₂ ij = tid ∧ L_fn ij = y_of d) ↔ (tid = tid₀ ∧ d = d₀) := by
            intro tid d
            rw [← hd₀_val]
            exact ⟨fun ⟨ht, hd⟩ => ⟨ht.symm, hy_inj hd.symm⟩,
              fun ⟨ht, hd⟩ => ⟨ht.symm, hd ▸ rfl⟩⟩
          simp_rw [h_iff]
          have h_in : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
              (∑ d : Fin N_D,
                if tid = tid₀ ∧ d = d₀ then
                  π₂ ij * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))
                else 0) =
              if tid = tid₀ then
                π₂ ij * Real.log (q tid d₀ / (p_T tid * q_D d₀))
              else 0 := by
            intro tid
            by_cases ht : tid = tid₀
            · simp [ht]
            · simp [ht]
          simp_rw [h_in]
          simp
        rw [h_collapse]
        have hp_unit : finProbAt π₂ (fun _ => ()) ij = 1 := by
          unfold finProbAt
          simp [hπ₂_sum]
        have hp_L : finProbAt2 π₂ (fun _ => ()) L_fn ij = q_D d₀ := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          rw [hq_D_eq d₀, hd₀_val]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
          · rfl
          · exact False.elim (h2 h1.2)
          · exact False.elim (h1 ⟨rfl, h2⟩)
          · rfl
        have hp_T2 : finProbAt π₂ T₂ ij = p_T tid₀ := by
          unfold finProbAt
          rw [← hT₂_marg tid₀]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> rfl
        have hp_TL : finProbAt2 π₂ T₂ L_fn ij = q tid₀ d₀ := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          dsimp only [q]
          rw [hd₀_val]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> tauto
        have hq_pos : 0 < q tid₀ d₀ := by
          have h_le : (if T₂ ij = tid₀ ∧ L_fn ij = y_of d₀ then π₂ ij else 0) ≤ q tid₀ d₀ :=
            Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun ij' => if T₂ ij' = tid₀ ∧ L_fn ij' = y_of d₀ then π₂ ij' else 0)
              (fun ij' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ₂_nn ij'; exact le_rfl])
              (Finset.mem_univ ij)
          rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, hd₀_val.symm⟩] at h_le
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_pos h_le
        have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid₀ := by
          rw [← hq_marg tid₀]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d _ => hq_nn tid₀ d) (Finset.mem_univ d₀))
        have hqD_pos : 0 < q_D d₀ :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid _ => hq_nn tid d₀) (Finset.mem_univ tid₀))
        unfold condSurprise
        change _ = π₂ ij * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π₂ (fun _ => ()) L_fn ij /
            finProbAt π₂ (fun _ => ()) ij)) / ell) -
          π₂ ij * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π₂ T₂ L_fn ij / finProbAt π₂ T₂ ij)) / ell)
        rw [hp_unit, hp_L, hp_T2, hp_TL, div_one]
        have h_log_id : Real.log (q tid₀ d₀ / (p_T tid₀ * q_D d₀)) =
            Real.log (q tid₀ d₀ / p_T tid₀) - Real.log (q_D d₀) := by
          rw [← div_div, Real.log_div (div_pos hq_pos hpT_pos).ne' hqD_pos.ne']
        rw [h_log_id]
        ring
      · have h0 : π₂ ij = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_pos) (hπ₂_nn ij)
        simp [h0]
    change _ ≤ sSup S_root
    refine le_csSup h_bdd ?_
    refine ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h_geom, hq_nn, hq_marg, hq_supp, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [hEw_eq, hI_eq]

  
  refine ⟨⟨Fib₁, Fib₂, hFib₁_card, hFib₂_card, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ij h_pos
    let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
    obtain ⟨ht_eq, hp1_pos, hp2_pos⟩ := h_supp₂ ij h_pos
    let tid := T_idx p.1
    have hV_le : ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 := (h_law.2.2.1 tid).1
    have hA_le : ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1 := (h_law.2.2.1 tid).2
    have hθ1 : θ_s p.1 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := (h_law.2.2.2 p.1 hp1_pos).2
    have hθ2 : θ_s p.2 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := (h_law.2.2.2 p.2 hp2_pos).2
    have hD2 : D_obs p.2 = stdRootObs ε e (V_part tid) (A_part tid) (θ_s p.2) := by
      dsimp only [D_obs, tid]
      rw [← ht_eq]
    change f_c (D_obs p.1) (D_obs p.2) ∈ Fib₁ (D_obs p.1) ∧
      f_c (D_obs p.1) (D_obs p.2) ∈ Fib₂ (D_obs p.2)
    rw [hD2]
    exact h_fib_geom (V_part tid) (A_part tid) (θ_s p.1) (θ_s p.2) hV_le hA_le hθ1 hθ2
  · intro ij
    let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
    obtain ⟨_, hv0, hv1, _, _⟩ := h_sep (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1
    exact ⟨hv0, hv1⟩
  · let L_comm : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → ℕ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
      fun ij => let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij; f_c (D_obs p.1) (D_obs p.2)
    have h_le := h_comp L_comm
      (fun _ => 0)
      (fun c => replicaSepDepth e c.1)
      (fun c => angUnitVec ε (replicaSepDepth e c.1) c.2.1)
      commonVecV commonVecA
      (fun ij _ => by
        let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
        let tid := T_idx p.1
        let kt := replicaSepTag ε e (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1
        have hkt_le : kt ≤ ⌊4 * e⌋₊ + 1 := (h_sep (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1).1
        obtain ⟨hv0, hv1, hec_norm, hV1, hV2⟩ :=
          h_comm_approx kt hkt_le (V_part tid) (D_obs p.1).1
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, hA1, hA2⟩ :=
          h_comm_approx kt hkt_le (A_part tid) (D_obs p.1).1
        have hv1_comm : replicaSepDepth e (L_comm ij).1 ≤ 1 + e := by

          linarith
        exact ⟨le_rfl, hv0, hv1_comm, hec_norm, hV1, hV2, hA1, hA2⟩)
    have h_sum_eq : (∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), π₂ ij * ((1 - γ) * v_ij ij)) =
        ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          π₂ ij * ((1 + γ) * (0 : ℝ) + (1 - γ) * replicaSepDepth e (L_comm ij).1) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ij _ => ?_)
      change π₂ ij * ((1 - γ) * v_ij ij) = π₂ ij * ((1 + γ) * 0 + (1 - γ) * v_ij ij)
      ring
    rw [h_sum_eq]
    exact h_le
  · let L_pair : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
      fun ij => let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij; (D_obs p.1, D_obs p.2)
    let b_pair : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ :=
      fun q => max 0 (e - replicaSepDepth e (replicaSepTag ε e q.1.1 q.2.1) - 1 / 4)
    have h_le := h_comp L_pair
      b_pair
      (fun _ => e)
      (fun q => angUnitVec ε e q.1.1)
      (fun q => intCombine q.1.1 q.2.1 (rootCellVecV ε e q.1) (rootCellVecV ε e q.2))
      (fun q => intCombine q.1.1 q.2.1 (rootCellVecA ε e q.1) (rootCellVecA ε e q.2))
      (fun ij h_pos => by
        let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
        obtain ⟨ht_eq, _, _⟩ := h_supp₂ ij h_pos
        let tid := T_idx p.1
        have hV2_eq : rootCellVecV ε e (D_obs p.2) =
            cellApprox e (D_obs p.2).1 (V_part tid) := by
          dsimp only [D_obs, tid]
          rw [← ht_eq]
          rfl
        have hA2_eq : rootCellVecA ε e (D_obs p.2) =
            cellApprox e (D_obs p.2).1 (A_part tid) := by
          dsimp only [D_obs, tid]
          rw [← ht_eq]
          rfl
        obtain ⟨hb0, hbe, he1_norm, hV1, hV2⟩ :=
          h_int_approx (V_part tid) (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, hA1, hA2⟩ :=
          h_int_approx (A_part tid) (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1
        refine ⟨hb0, hbe, by linarith, he1_norm, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · change |inner ℝ (V_part tid - intCombine (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1
              (rootCellVecV ε e (D_obs p.1)) (rootCellVecV ε e (D_obs p.2))) _| ≤ _
          rw [hV2_eq]
          exact hV1
        · change |inner ℝ (V_part tid - intCombine (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1
              (rootCellVecV ε e (D_obs p.1)) (rootCellVecV ε e (D_obs p.2))) _| ≤ _
          rw [hV2_eq]
          exact hV2
        · change |inner ℝ (A_part tid - intCombine (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1
              (rootCellVecA ε e (D_obs p.1)) (rootCellVecA ε e (D_obs p.2))) _| ≤ _
          rw [hA2_eq]
          exact hA1
        · change |inner ℝ (A_part tid - intCombine (D_obs p.1).1 (D_obs p.2).1
              (rootCellVecA ε e (D_obs p.1)) (rootCellVecA ε e (D_obs p.2))) _| ≤ _
          rw [hA2_eq]
          exact hA2)
    have h_sum_le : (∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          π₂ ij * (2 * e - (1 + γ) * v_ij ij - (1 + γ) / 4)) ≤
        ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          π₂ ij * ((1 + γ) * b_pair (L_pair ij) + (1 - γ) * e) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ij _ => ?_)
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hπ₂_nn ij)
      have hb_ge : e - v_ij ij - 1 / 4 ≤ b_pair (L_pair ij) := le_max_right 0 _
      have h_id : 2 * e - (1 + γ) * v_ij ij - (1 + γ) / 4 =
          (1 + γ) * (e - v_ij ij - 1 / 4) + (1 - γ) * e := by ring
      rw [h_id]
      have h1g_pos : 0 ≤ 1 + γ := by linarith
      nlinarith
    linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := hε_lt1.le
  let m_d : ℕ := dyadicTimeLevel ε d₀
  let m_e : ℕ := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
  let M : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ m_d
  let Q : ℕ := 2 ^ (m_e - m_d)
  have hm_le : m_d ≤ m_e := by
    dsimp only [m_d, m_e, dyadicTimeLevel]
    exact Nat.clog_mono_right 2
      (Nat.ceil_mono (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (neg_le_neg hd₀_le)))
  have hm_add : m_d + (m_e - m_d) = m_e := Nat.add_sub_of_le hm_le
  have hQ_pos_nat : 0 < Q := by positivity
  have hQ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hQ_pos_nat
  have hQ_real : (Q : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_e - m_d) := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have h2_me : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d * (Q : ℝ) := by
    rw [hQ_real, ← pow_add, hm_add]
  have hM_real : (M : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d := by
    dsimp only [M]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have h2_me_int : (((2 : ℤ) ^ m_e : ℤ) : ℝ) = (M : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [hM_real]
    exact h2_me
  have h_angBin : ∀ (u θ : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
      angBin ε u θ = ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u)⌋ ∧
      0 ≤ angBin ε u θ ∧
      angBin ε u θ < (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u) := by
    intro u θ hθ
    set m := dyadicTimeLevel ε u
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m :=
      mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hθ.1 Real.pi_pos.le) (by positivity)
    have h_fl_nn : 0 ≤ ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr h_nn
    have h_lt_pow : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < (((2 : ℤ) ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      have h_div : θ / Real.pi < 1 := (div_lt_one Real.pi_pos).mpr hθ.2
      have h_mul : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_div (by positivity)
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_fl_lt : ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ < (2 : ℤ) ^ m :=
      Int.floor_lt.mpr h_lt_pow
    have h_eq : angBin ε u θ = ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ := by
      unfold angBin
      change min ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ((2 : ℤ) ^ m - 1) =
        ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋
      exact min_eq_left (by omega)
    exact ⟨h_eq, h_eq ▸ h_fl_nn, h_eq ▸ h_fl_lt⟩
  have h_mid_floor : ∀ θ : ℝ, θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →

  let w_ang : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ kc ω = k then π ω else 0
  have hw_nn : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (k : ℤ), 0 ≤ w_ang tid k := by
    intro tid k
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
    split_ifs
    · exact hπ_nn ω
    · exact le_rfl
  let k_star : Fin N_T → ℤ := fun tid =>
    Classical.choose (Finset.exists_max_image I_M (w_ang tid) hIM_ne)
  have hk_star_spec : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
      k_star tid ∈ I_M ∧ ∀ k ∈ I_M, w_ang tid k ≤ w_ang tid (k_star tid) :=
    fun tid => Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_max_image I_M (w_ang tid) hIM_ne)
  let N_cyc : ℤ → Finset ℤ := fun k₁ =>
    {if k₁ = 0 then M - 1 else k₁ - 1, k₁, if k₁ = M - 1 then 0 else k₁ + 1}
  have hN_card : ∀ k₁ : ℤ, (N_cyc k₁).card ≤ 3 :=
    fun k₁ => Finset.card_le_three
  have hN_sub : ∀ k₁ ∈ I_M, ∀ k ∈ N_cyc k₁, k ∈ I_M := by
    intro k₁ hk₁ k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk₁ ⊢
    dsimp only [N_cyc] at hk
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hk with rfl | hk
    · split_ifs <;> omega
    · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hk with rfl | hk
      · omega
      · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hk
        subst hk
        split_ifs <;> omega
  have hN_mem : ∀ k₁ ∈ I_M, ∀ k₂ ∈ I_M,
      cyclicBinDist M k₁ k₂ ≤ 1 → k₂ ∈ N_cyc k₁ := by
    intro k₁ hk₁ k₂ hk₂ hdist
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk₁ hk₂
    unfold cyclicBinDist at hdist
    have h_abs : |k₁ - k₂| ≤ 1 ∨ M - |k₁ - k₂| ≤ 1 := min_le_iff.mp hdist
    dsimp only [N_cyc]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (k₁ - k₂) with h_sgn | h_sgn
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg h_sgn] at h_abs
      split_ifs <;> omega
    · rw [abs_of_neg h_sgn] at h_abs
      split_ifs <;> omega
  refine ⟨k_star, ?_⟩
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  have hπ₂_nn : ∀ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω), 0 ≤ twoReplicaProb π T_idx ij := by
    intro ij
    unfold twoReplicaProb
    dsimp only []
    split_ifs with h
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hπ_nn _) (hπ_nn _)) h.2.le
    · exact le_rfl
  let collTerm : Fin N_ω → Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω₁ ω₂ =>
    if cyclicBinDist M (kc ω₁) (kc ω₂) ≤ 1
    then twoReplicaProb π T_idx (finProdFinEquiv (ω₁, ω₂))
    else 0
  have h_step6a : twoReplicaTailProb ε e (d₀ + 1 / 2) π T_idx θ_s ≤
      ∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω, ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, collTerm ω₁ ω₂ := by
    have h_le_ij : twoReplicaTailProb ε e (d₀ + 1 / 2) π T_idx θ_s ≤
        ∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
          if cyclicBinDist M (kc p.1) (kc p.2) ≤ 1
          then twoReplicaProb π T_idx ij else 0 := by
      unfold twoReplicaTailProb
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ij _ => ?_)
      dsimp only []
      set p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
      split_ifs with h_sep h_cyc
      · exact le_rfl
      · by_cases hprob0 : twoReplicaProb π T_idx ij = 0
        · rw [hprob0]
        · exfalso
          have hprob_pos : 0 < twoReplicaProb π T_idx ij :=
            lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ₂_nn ij) (Ne.symm hprob0)
          have hπ_both : 0 < π p.1 ∧ 0 < π p.2 := by
            unfold twoReplicaProb at hprob_pos
            dsimp only [] at hprob_pos
            split_ifs at hprob_pos with h_cond
            · have hp1_ne : π p.1 ≠ 0 := by
                intro h0
                change π (finProdFinEquiv.symm ij).1 = 0 at h0
                rw [h0, zero_mul, zero_div] at hprob_pos
                exact lt_irrefl 0 hprob_pos
              have hp2_ne : π p.2 ≠ 0 := by
                intro h0
                change π (finProdFinEquiv.symm ij).2 = 0 at h0
                rw [h0, mul_zero, zero_div] at hprob_pos
                exact lt_irrefl 0 hprob_pos
              exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn p.1) (Ne.symm hp1_ne),
                     lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn p.2) (Ne.symm hp2_ne)⟩
            · exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hprob_pos)
          exact h_cyc (h_adj (θ_s p.1) (θ_s p.2)
            (hθ_supp p.1 hπ_both.1) (hθ_supp p.2 hπ_both.2) h_sep)
      · exact hπ₂_nn ij
      · exact le_rfl
    have h_reindex :
        (∑ ij : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          let p := finProdFinEquiv.symm ij
          if cyclicBinDist M (kc p.1) (kc p.2) ≤ 1
          then twoReplicaProb π T_idx ij else 0) =
        ∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω, ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, collTerm ω₁ ω₂ := by
      rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv]
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    rwa [h_reindex] at h_le_ij
  have h_step6b : ∀ ω₁ : Fin N_ω,
      ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, collTerm ω₁ ω₂ ≤
        (π ω₁ / p_T (T_idx ω₁)) * (3 * w_ang (T_idx ω₁) (k_star (T_idx ω₁))) := by
    intro ω₁
    set tid := T_idx ω₁
    by_cases hω₁ : 0 < π ω₁
    · have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
        have h_le : (if T_idx ω₁ = tid then π ω₁ else 0) ≤ p_T tid :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω : Fin N_ω => if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0)
            (fun ω _ => by
              split_ifs
              · exact hπ_nn ω
              · exact le_rfl)
            (Finset.mem_univ ω₁)
        rw [if_pos rfl] at h_le
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω₁ h_le
      have hk₁_mem : kc ω₁ ∈ I_M := by
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, h1, h2⟩ := h_mid_floor (θ_s ω₁) (hθ_supp ω₁ hω₁)
        exact Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have h_pt : ∀ ω₂ : Fin N_ω,
          collTerm ω₁ ω₂ ≤
            (π ω₁ / p_T tid) *
              ∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), if T_idx ω₂ = tid ∧ kc ω₂ = k then π ω₂ else 0 := by
        intro ω₂
        have hrhs_nn : 0 ≤ (π ω₁ / p_T tid) *
            ∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), if T_idx ω₂ = tid ∧ kc ω₂ = k then π ω₂ else 0 := by
          refine mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω₁) hpT_pos.le) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => ?_))
          split_ifs
          · exact hπ_nn ω₂
          · exact le_rfl
        by_cases hω₂ : 0 < π ω₂
        · have hk₂_mem : kc ω₂ ∈ I_M := by
            obtain ⟨_, _, _, h1, h2⟩ := h_mid_floor (θ_s ω₂) (hθ_supp ω₂ hω₂)
            exact Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
          dsimp only [collTerm]
          split_ifs with h_cyc
          · unfold twoReplicaProb
            simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
            split_ifs with h_cond
            · have htid_eq : T_idx ω₂ = tid := h_cond.1.symm
              have h_in_N : kc ω₂ ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁) :=
                hN_mem (kc ω₁) hk₁_mem (kc ω₂) hk₂_mem h_cyc
              have h_sum_k :
                  (∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), if T_idx ω₂ = tid ∧ kc ω₂ = k then π ω₂ else 0) =
                    π ω₂ := by
                have h_simp :
                    (∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), if T_idx ω₂ = tid ∧ kc ω₂ = k then π ω₂ else 0) =
                      ∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), if kc ω₂ = k then π ω₂ else 0 := by
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
                  simp [htid_eq]
                rw [h_simp, Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos h_in_N]
              rw [h_sum_k]
              change (π ω₁ * π ω₂) / p_T tid ≤ (π ω₁ / p_T tid) * π ω₂
              exact (div_mul_eq_mul_div (π ω₁) (p_T tid) (π ω₂)).symm.le
            · exact hrhs_nn
          · exact hrhs_nn
        · have hπ₂_zero : π ω₂ = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hω₂) (hπ_nn ω₂)
          have h_coll_zero : collTerm ω₁ ω₂ = 0 := by
            dsimp only [collTerm]
            unfold twoReplicaProb
            simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hπ₂_zero]
          rw [h_coll_zero]
          exact hrhs_nn
      calc ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, collTerm ω₁ ω₂
          ≤ ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, (π ω₁ / p_T tid) *
              ∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), if T_idx ω₂ = tid ∧ kc ω₂ = k then π ω₂ else 0 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω₂ _ => h_pt ω₂)
        _ = (π ω₁ / p_T tid) *
              ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, ∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁),
                if T_idx ω₂ = tid ∧ kc ω₂ = k then π ω₂ else 0 :=
            (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ = (π ω₁ / p_T tid) * ∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), w_ang tid k := by
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        _ ≤ (π ω₁ / p_T tid) * (3 * w_ang tid (k_star tid)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω₁) hpT_pos.le)
            calc ∑ k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), w_ang tid k
                ≤ ∑ _k ∈ N_cyc (kc ω₁), w_ang tid (k_star tid) :=
                  Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k hk =>
                    (hk_star_spec tid).2 k (hN_sub (kc ω₁) hk₁_mem k hk))
              _ = ((N_cyc (kc ω₁)).card : ℝ) * w_ang tid (k_star tid) := by
                  simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
              _ ≤ 3 * w_ang tid (k_star tid) := by
                  have hc : ((N_cyc (kc ω₁)).card : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by
                    exact_mod_cast hN_card (kc ω₁)
                  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (hw_nn tid (k_star tid))
    · have hπ₁_zero : π ω₁ = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hω₁) (hπ_nn ω₁)
      have h_lhs_zero : ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, collTerm ω₁ ω₂ = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω₂ _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [collTerm]
        unfold twoReplicaProb
        simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hπ₁_zero]
      rw [h_lhs_zero, hπ₁_zero, zero_div, zero_mul]
  have h_step6c :
      (∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω, (π ω₁ / p_T (T_idx ω₁)) * (3 * w_ang (T_idx ω₁) (k_star (T_idx ω₁)))) ≤
        3 * ∑ tid : Fin N_T, w_ang tid (k_star tid) := by
    have h_part :
        (∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω, (π ω₁ / p_T (T_idx ω₁)) * (3 * w_ang (T_idx ω₁) (k_star (T_idx ω₁)))) =
          ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω,
            if T_idx ω₁ = tid then (π ω₁ / p_T tid) * (3 * w_ang tid (k_star tid)) else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω₁ _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    rw [h_part, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun tid _ => ?_)
    have h_factor :
        (∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω,
          if T_idx ω₁ = tid then (π ω₁ / p_T tid) * (3 * w_ang tid (k_star tid)) else 0) =
          p_T tid * ((3 * w_ang tid (k_star tid)) / p_T tid) := by
      have h_congr :
          (∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω,
            if T_idx ω₁ = tid then (π ω₁ / p_T tid) * (3 * w_ang tid (k_star tid)) else 0) =
          ∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω,
            (if T_idx ω₁ = tid then π ω₁ else 0) * ((3 * w_ang tid (k_star tid)) / p_T tid) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω₁ _ => ?_)
        split_ifs
        · ring
        · simp
      rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [h_factor]
    by_cases hp0 : p_T tid = 0
    · rw [hp0, zero_mul]
      exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hw_nn tid (k_star tid))
    · rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp0]
  have h_step6d :
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, w_ang tid (k_star tid)) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if angBin ε d₀ (θ_s ω) = k_star (T_idx ω) then π ω else 0 := by
    dsimp only [w_ang, kc]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    have h_ite :
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T,
          if T_idx ω = tid ∧ angBin ε d₀ (θ_s ω) = k_star tid then π ω else 0) =
        ∑ tid : Fin N_T,
          if T_idx ω = tid
          then (if angBin ε d₀ (θ_s ω) = k_star tid then π ω else 0)
          else 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
      by_cases h1 : T_idx ω = tid <;> simp [h1]
    rw [h_ite, Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  have h_total :
      p_good ≤ 3 * ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if angBin ε d₀ (θ_s ω) = k_star (T_idx ω) then π ω else 0 := by
    calc p_good
        ≤ twoReplicaTailProb ε e (d₀ + 1 / 2) π T_idx θ_s := h_good
      _ ≤ ∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω, ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, collTerm ω₁ ω₂ := h_step6a
      _ ≤ ∑ ω₁ : Fin N_ω,
            (π ω₁ / p_T (T_idx ω₁)) * (3 * w_ang (T_idx ω₁) (k_star (T_idx ω₁))) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω₁ _ => h_step6b ω₁)
      _ ≤ 3 * ∑ tid : Fin N_T, w_ang tid (k_star tid) := h_step6c
      _ = 3 * ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if angBin ε d₀ (θ_s ω) = k_star (T_idx ω) then π ω else 0 := by
          rw [h_step6d]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) :
    (∀ {α β₁ β₂ : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (A : Fin N_ω → β₁) (B : Fin N_ω → β₂),
      finMutualInfo ε π T B ≤ finMutualInfo ε π T A + finCondEntropy ε π A B) ∧
    (letI := Classical.propDecidable
     ∀ {β₁ β₂ : Type} [DecidableEq β₂] (A : Fin N_ω → β₁) (B : Fin N_ω → β₂)
       (E_bad : Fin N_ω → Bool) (N_good M_all : ℕ),
       1 ≤ N_good → 1 ≤ M_all →
       (∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
         ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω =>
           0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = false ∧ A ω = A ω₀)).image B).card ≤ N_good) →
       ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = true)).image B).card ≤ M_all →
       finCondEntropy ε π A B ≤
         (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ) +
           (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_bad ω then π ω else 0) * Real.log (M_all : ℝ)) /
           Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ {α κ β₁ β₂ β_c : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (C : Fin N_ω → κ)
      (D₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (D₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂) (G_c : Fin N_ω → β_c),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
        (D₁ ω₁ = D₁ ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂) ∧
        (D₂ ω₁ = D₂ ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂) ∧
        (G_c ω₁ = G_c ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₁ +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) →
      finMutualInfo ε π T (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) + finMutualInfo ε π T G_c -
        finMutualInfo ε π T D₁ - finMutualInfo ε π T D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π D₁ G_c + finCondEntropy ε π D₂ G_c) ∧
    (∀ {α κ β₁ β₂ : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (C : Fin N_ω → κ)
      (D₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (D₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
        T ω₁ = T ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂ → D₁ ω₁ = D₁ ω₂) →
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₁ +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)))

signature.name: fin_entropy_submod_and_support_bounds
signature.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    {N_ω : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) :
    (∀ {α β₁ β₂ : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (A : Fin N_ω → β₁) (B : Fin N_ω → β₂),
      finMutualInfo ε π T B ≤ finMutualInfo ε π T A + finCondEntropy ε π A B) ∧
    (letI := Classical.propDecidable
     ∀ {β₁ β₂ : Type} [DecidableEq β₂] (A : Fin N_ω → β₁) (B : Fin N_ω → β₂)
       (E_bad : Fin N_ω → Bool) (N_good M_all : ℕ),
       1 ≤ N_good → 1 ≤ M_all →
       (∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
         ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω =>
           0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = false ∧ A ω = A ω₀)).image B).card ≤ N_good) →
       ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ E_bad ω = true)).image B).card ≤ M_all →
       finCondEntropy ε π A B ≤
         (Real.log 2 + Real.log (N_good : ℝ) +
           (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_bad ω then π ω else 0) * Real.log (M_all : ℝ)) /
           Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (∀ {α κ β₁ β₂ β_c : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (C : Fin N_ω → κ)
      (D₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (D₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂) (G_c : Fin N_ω → β_c),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
        (D₁ ω₁ = D₁ ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂) ∧
        (D₂ ω₁ = D₂ ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂) ∧
        (G_c ω₁ = G_c ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₁ +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) →
      finMutualInfo ε π T (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) + finMutualInfo ε π T G_c -
        finMutualInfo ε π T D₁ - finMutualInfo ε π T D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π D₁ G_c + finCondEntropy ε π D₂ G_c) ∧
    (∀ {α κ β₁ β₂ : Type} (T : Fin N_ω → α) (C : Fin N_ω → κ)
      (D₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (D₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ →
        T ω₁ = T ω₂ → C ω₁ = C ω₂ → D₁ ω₁ = D₁ ω₂) →
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₁ +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_ite_iff : ∀ {P Q : Prop} (dP : Decidable P) (dQ : Decidable Q) (a b : ℝ),
      (P ↔ Q) → @ite ℝ P dP a b = @ite ℝ Q dQ a b := by
    intro P Q dP dQ a b hPQ
    cases dP with
    | isTrue hP => cases dQ with
      | isTrue _ => rfl
      | isFalse hQ => exact absurd (hPQ.mp hP) hQ
    | isFalse hP => cases dQ with
      | isTrue hQ => exact absurd (hPQ.mpr hQ) hP
      | isFalse _ => rfl
  have h_div_mul_le : ∀ (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → (A / B) * B ≤ A := by
    intro A B hA
    by_cases hB : B = 0
    · rw [hB, mul_zero]; exact hA
    · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ A hB]
  have h_ell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    rw [Real.log_inv, neg_pos]
    exact Real.log_neg hε₀ (by linarith)
  let S_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
    @Finset.filter (Fin N_ω) (fun ω => 0 < π ω) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
  have h_mem_Spos : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ω ∈ S_pos ↔ 0 < π ω := by
    intro ω
    simp [S_pos]
  have h_pi_zero_off : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ω ∉ S_pos → π ω = 0 := by

      (h_pos_nn (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) G_c).2
    have hu_step2 : finCondEntropy ε π U₀ (fun ω => ((G_c ω, D₁ ω), D₂ ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π U₀ (fun ω => (G_c ω, D₁ ω)) +
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (G_c ω, D₁ ω)) D₂ :=
      h_chain_uncond (fun ω => (G_c ω, D₁ ω)) D₂
    have hu_gd1 : finCondEntropy ε π U₀ (fun ω => (G_c ω, D₁ ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π U₀ D₁ + finCondEntropy ε π D₁ G_c := by
      rw [h_symm_target U₀ G_c D₁, h_chain_uncond D₁ G_c]
    have hu_mono : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (G_c ω, D₁ ω)) D₂ ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π G_c D₂ :=
      h_cond_mono G_c D₁ D₂
    have hu_gd2 : finCondEntropy ε π U₀ G_c + finCondEntropy ε π G_c D₂ =
        finCondEntropy ε π U₀ D₂ + finCondEntropy ε π D₂ G_c := by
      rw [← h_chain_uncond G_c D₂, h_symm_target U₀ G_c D₂, h_chain_uncond D₂ G_c]
    have ht_d1 : finCondEntropy ε π T D₁ =
        finCondEntropy ε π T C + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₁ :=
      h_det_split T C D₁ (fun ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2 => (h_det_C ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2).1)
    have ht_d2 : finCondEntropy ε π T D₂ =
        finCondEntropy ε π T C + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) D₂ :=
      h_det_split T C D₂ (fun ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2 => (h_det_C ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2).2.1)
    have ht_d12 : finCondEntropy ε π T (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π T C +
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) :=
      h_det_split T C (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω))
        (fun ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2 h12 => (h_det_C ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2).1 (Prod.ext_iff.mp h12).1)
    have ht_gc : finCondEntropy ε π T G_c =
        finCondEntropy ε π T C + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) G_c :=
      h_det_split T C G_c (fun ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2 => (h_det_C ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2).2.2)
    have ht_gc_nn : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) G_c :=
      (h_pos_nn (fun ω => (T ω, C ω)) G_c).2
    unfold finMutualInfo
    change (finCondEntropy ε π U₀ (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) -
          finCondEntropy ε π T (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω))) +
        (finCondEntropy ε π U₀ G_c - finCondEntropy ε π T G_c) -
        (finCondEntropy ε π U₀ D₁ - finCondEntropy ε π T D₁) -
        (finCondEntropy ε π U₀ D₂ - finCondEntropy ε π T D₂) ≤
      finCondEntropy ε π D₁ G_c + finCondEntropy ε π D₂ G_c
    linarith
  · intro α κ β₁ β₂ T C D₁ D₂ h_det
    let W : Fin N_ω → α × κ := fun ω => (T ω, C ω)
    have h0 : finCondEntropy ε π W D₁ = 0 :=
      h_det_zero W D₁ (fun ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2 hW =>
        h_det ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2 (Prod.ext_iff.mp hW).1 (Prod.ext_iff.mp hW).2)
    have h12 : finCondEntropy ε π W (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π W D₂ :=
      h_det_drop_target W D₁ D₂ (fun ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2 hW _ =>
        h_det ω₁ ω₂ h1 h2 (Prod.ext_iff.mp hW).1 (Prod.ext_iff.mp hW).2)
    change finCondEntropy ε π W D₁ + finCondEntropy ε π W D₂ ≤
      finCondEntropy ε π W (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω))
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m u ξ ν_gap δ_cl : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (hu₀ : 0 < u) (hu₁ : u ≤ 1)
    (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hν : 0 < ν_gap) (hδ : 0 < δ_cl) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε b a d : ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
        0 ≤ b → b < a → a + u ≤ 1 + m →
        0 < d → ν_gap ≤ a - b - d →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ₁ θ₂ : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
          θ₁ ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧ θ₂ ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
        let D₁ := fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
          (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₁ ω)
        let D₂ := fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
          (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₂ ω)
        let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
        let P_sep := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁ ω)) (angBin ε d (θ₂ ω))
          then π ω else 0
        ∃ G_c : Fin N_ω → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
          (∀ ω, (G_c ω).2.1 = dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)) ∧
          (∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ D₁ ω = D₁ ω₀)).image G_c).card ≤
              3000000 * (⌊(1 + m) / ξ⌋₊ + 1) ∧
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ D₂ ω = D₂ ω₀)).image G_c).card ≤
              3000000 * (⌊(1 + m) / ξ⌋₊ + 1)) ∧
          2 * γ * (a - b - d - 2 * ξ) * P_sep - ξ ≤
            stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₁ +
            stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₂ +
            4 * δ_cl * u +
            (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) +
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_c -
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D₁ -
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D₂)
