proof.tactics:
by
  have h2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have h1_lt_2 : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have h1_lt_2_nat : (1 : ℕ) < 2 := by decide
  have h_eighth_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8 := by norm_num
  have h_quarter_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4 := by norm_num
  have h_1_le_4 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by norm_num
  have h_log2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos h1_lt_2
  have h_half_rpow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have h_shifts_card : (({-1, 0, 1} : Finset ℤ)).card = 3 := by decide
  have h_mem_m1 : (-1 : ℤ) ∈ ({-1, 0, 1} : Finset ℤ) := by decide
  have h_mem_0 : (0 : ℤ) ∈ ({-1, 0, 1} : Finset ℤ) := by decide
  have h_mem_1 : (1 : ℤ) ∈ ({-1, 0, 1} : Finset ℤ) := by decide
  have h_box_num : 15 * (9 * (29 * (9 * 29))) ≤ 3000000 := by decide

  have h_ang_norm : ∀ (ε e : ℝ) (k : ℤ), ‖angUnitVec ε e k‖ = 1 := by
    intro ε e k
    have hsq : ‖angUnitVec ε e k‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [angUnitVec, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (angUnitVec ε e k)]

  have h_perp_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ = 1 → ‖perp2D v‖ = 1 := by
    intro v hv
    have hv_sq : v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h := PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) v
      rw [hv, one_pow, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h.symm
    have hp_sq : ‖perp2D v‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [perp2D]
      linarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D v)]

  have h_inner_self_perp : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ v (perp2D v) = 0 := by
    intro v
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [perp2D]
    ring

  have h_ang_sin : ∀ (ε e₁ e₂ : ℝ) (k₁ k₂ : ℤ),
      inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e₁ k₁) (perp2D (angUnitVec ε e₂ k₂)) =
        Real.sin (((k₁ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e₁))⁻¹ -
          ((k₂ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e₂))⁻¹) := by
    intro ε e₁ e₂ k₁ k₂
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [angUnitVec, perp2D, Real.sin_sub]
    ring

  have h_ortho_expand : ∀ (e₀ w v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖e₀‖ = 1 →
      inner ℝ w v =
        inner ℝ w e₀ * inner ℝ e₀ v +
        inner ℝ w (perp2D e₀) * inner ℝ (perp2D e₀) v := by
    intro e₀ w v he₀
    have hsq : e₀ 0 ^ 2 + e₀ 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h := PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) e₀
      rw [he₀, one_pow, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h.symm
    simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, perp2D, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    change v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1 =
      (e₀ 0 * w 0 + e₀ 1 * w 1) * (v 0 * e₀ 0 + v 1 * e₀ 1) +
      ((if (0 : Fin 2) = 0 then -(e₀ 1) else e₀ 0) * w 0 +
        (if (1 : Fin 2) = 0 then -(e₀ 1) else e₀ 0) * w 1) *
      (v 0 * (if (0 : Fin 2) = 0 then -(e₀ 1) else e₀ 0) +
        v 1 * (if (1 : Fin 2) = 0 then -(e₀ 1) else e₀ 0))
    simp only [↓reduceIte, Fin.one_eq_zero_iff, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero]
    calc v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1
        = (v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ = (v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1) * (e₀ 0 ^ 2 + e₀ 1 ^ 2) := by rw [hsq]
      _ = (e₀ 0 * w 0 + e₀ 1 * w 1) * (v 0 * e₀ 0 + v 1 * e₀ 1) +
          (-(e₀ 1) * w 0 + e₀ 0 * w 1) * (v 0 * -(e₀ 1) + v 1 * e₀ 0) := by ring

  have h_skew_bound : ∀ (e₁ e₂ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖e₁‖ = 1 → ‖e₂‖ = 1 →
      |inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂)| * |inner ℝ w e₁| ≤
        |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₂)| + |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₁)| := by
    intro e₁ e₂ w he₁ he₂
    have hexp := h_ortho_expand e₁ w (perp2D e₂) he₁
    have hp₁ := h_perp_norm e₁ he₁
    have hp₂ := h_perp_norm e₂ he₂
    have h_cs : |inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)| ≤ 1 := by
      calc |inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)|
          ≤ ‖perp2D e₁‖ * ‖perp2D e₂‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ = 1 := by rw [hp₁, hp₂, mul_one]
    have h_sub : inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂) * inner ℝ w e₁ =
        inner ℝ w (perp2D e₂) - inner ℝ w (perp2D e₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂) := by
      linarith
    calc |inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂)| * |inner ℝ w e₁|
        = |inner ℝ e₁ (perp2D e₂) * inner ℝ w e₁| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
      _ = |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₂) - inner ℝ w (perp2D e₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)| := by
          rw [h_sub]
      _ ≤ |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₂)| + |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)| :=
          abs_sub _ _
      _ = |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₂)| + |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₁)| * |inner ℝ (perp2D e₁) (perp2D e₂)| := by
          rw [abs_mul]
      _ ≤ |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₂)| + |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₁)| * 1 :=
          add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cs (abs_nonneg _))
      _ = |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₂)| + |inner ℝ w (perp2D e₁)| := by ring

  have h_dyad_time : ∀ (ε x : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ x →
      ε ^ (-x) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε x) ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε x) < 2 * ε ^ (-x) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ x < ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε x))⁻¹ ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε x))⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ x := by
    intro ε x hε₀ hε₁ hx
    unfold dyadicTimeLevel
    let m_x := Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊
    change ε ^ (-x) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x < 2 * ε ^ (-x) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ x < ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ ∧ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ x
    have h1_le : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-x) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ ≤ ε ^ (-x) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hlo : ε ^ (-x) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x := by
      calc ε ^ (-x) ≤ (⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        _ ≤ ((2 ^ m_x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_pow_clog h1_lt_2_nat ⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x := by push_cast; rfl
    have hhi : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x < 2 * ε ^ (-x) := by
      by_cases hc : ⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊ ≤ 1
      · have hm0 : m_x = 0 := by
          have hle : m_x ≤ 0 := (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow h1_lt_2_nat).mpr (by simpa using hc)
          omega
        rw [hm0, pow_zero]
        linarith
      · have hc_gt : 1 < ⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊ := by omega
        have hm_pos : 1 ≤ m_x := by
          by_contra hm_lt
          have hm0 : m_x = 0 := by omega
          have h1 := Nat.le_pow_clog h1_lt_2_nat ⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊
          change ⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ m_x at h1
          rw [hm0] at h1
          omega
        have h_pred_nat : 2 ^ (m_x - 1) < ⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊ :=
          Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self h1_lt_2_nat hc_gt
        have h_pred : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_x - 1) < ε ^ (-x) := by
          have h2 := Nat.lt_ceil.mp h_pred_nat
          simpa using h2
        have hm_eq : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_x - 1) := by
          conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hm_pos, pow_succ, mul_comm]
        linarith
    have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x := pow_pos h2_pos m_x
    have hrpow_pos : 0 < ε ^ x := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ x
    have h_prod : ε ^ (-x) * ε ^ x = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hinv_ub : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ x := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo hrpow_pos.le
      rw [h_prod] at hmul
      have hmul2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul (inv_nonneg.mpr hpow_pos.le)
      rwa [mul_one, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hpow_pos), one_mul] at hmul2
    have hinv_lb : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ x < ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ := by
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hhi hrpow_pos
      rw [mul_assoc, h_prod, mul_one] at hmul
      have hmul2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hmul (mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) (inv_pos.mpr hpow_pos))
      have h_lhs : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x * ε ^ x) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ x := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_assoc (1 / 2 : ℝ), inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hpow_pos), mul_one]
      have h_rhs : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ * 2 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ := by ring
      rw [h_lhs, h_rhs] at hmul2
      exact hmul2
    exact ⟨hlo, hhi, hinv_lb, hinv_ub⟩

  have h_ang_bin : ∀ (ε x θ : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ x →
      θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
      let m_x := dyadicTimeLevel ε x
      let k := angBin ε x θ
      let φ := ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹
      k = ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x⌋ ∧
      0 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ (2 ^ m_x : ℤ) - 1 ∧
      φ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧
      (k : ℝ) ≤ (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x ∧
      (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x < (k : ℝ) + 1 ∧
      |θ - φ| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ x := by
    intro ε x θ hε₀ hε₁ hx hθ m_x k φ
    have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x := pow_pos h2_pos m_x
    have hdiv_nn : 0 ≤ θ / Real.pi := div_nonneg hθ.1 hpi_pos.le
    have hdiv_lt1 : θ / Real.pi < 1 := (div_lt_one hpi_pos).mpr hθ.2
    have hval_nn : 0 ≤ (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x := mul_nonneg hdiv_nn hpow_pos.le
    have hval_lt : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x < ((2 ^ m_x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      calc (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x < 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hdiv_lt1 hpow_pos
        _ = ((2 ^ m_x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    have hfl_nn : 0 ≤ ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr hval_nn
    have hfl_lt : ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x⌋ < (2 ^ m_x : ℤ) := Int.floor_lt.mpr hval_lt
    have hfl_le : ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x⌋ ≤ (2 ^ m_x : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hk_eq : k = ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x⌋ := min_eq_left hfl_le
    have hk_nn : 0 ≤ k := by rw [hk_eq]; exact hfl_nn
    have hk_ub : k ≤ (2 ^ m_x : ℤ) - 1 := by rw [hk_eq]; exact hfl_le
    have hk_real_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x := by
      rw [hk_eq]; exact Int.floor_le _
    have hk_real_lt : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
      rw [hk_eq]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hk_cast_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_nn
    have hk_cast_ub : (k : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x - 1 := by
      have h1 : (k : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ m_x - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_ub
      simpa using h1
    have hφ_pos : 0 < φ := by
      dsimp [φ]
      exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by linarith) hpi_pos) (inv_pos.mpr hpow_pos)
    have hφ_lt : φ < Real.pi := by
      dsimp [φ]
      have h1 : ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ < 1 := by
        rw [mul_inv_lt_iff₀ hpow_pos]
        linarith
      calc ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹
          = (((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹) * Real.pi := by ring
        _ < 1 * Real.pi := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 hpi_pos
        _ = Real.pi := one_mul _
    have h_diff_id : θ - φ =
        (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹) *
          ((θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) := by
      dsimp [φ]
      have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpi_pos
      have hp_ne : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpow_pos
      field_simp [hpi_ne, hp_ne]
    have h_unit_abs : |(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have h_inv_ub := (h_dyad_time ε x hε₀ hε₁ hx).2.2.2
    have h_abs_diff : |θ - φ| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ x := by
      rw [h_diff_id, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hpi_pos (inv_pos.mpr hpow_pos))]
      calc (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹) *
            |(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)|
          ≤ (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹) * (1 / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_unit_abs (mul_nonneg hpi_pos.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hpow_pos.le))
        _ = (Real.pi / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_x)⁻¹ := by ring
        _ ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ x :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_ub (by linarith)
    exact ⟨hk_eq, hk_nn, hk_ub, ⟨hφ_pos, hφ_lt⟩, hk_real_le, hk_real_lt, h_abs_diff⟩

  have h_real_level : ∀ (ε L : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L) ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L) ≤ ε ^ (-L) := by
    intro ε L hε₀ hε₁
    let t : ℝ := L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
    let l : ℤ := ⌊t⌋
    change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L) < (2 : ℝ) ^ l ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ l ≤ ε ^ (-L)
    have h2t : (2 : ℝ) ^ t = ε ^ (-L) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos h2_pos t, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀ (-L)]
      congr 1
      dsimp [t]
      rw [Real.log_inv]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt h_log2_pos]
    have hfl_le : (l : ℝ) ≤ t := Int.floor_le t
    have hfl_lt : t < (l : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one t
    have hfl_gt : t - 1 < (l : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hub : (2 : ℝ) ^ l ≤ ε ^ (-L) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) l, ← h2t]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1_lt_2.le hfl_le
    have hlb : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L) < (2 : ℝ) ^ l := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) l, ← h2t, h_half_rpow, ← Real.rpow_add h2_pos]
      have hexp : (-1 : ℝ) + t = t - 1 := by ring
      rw [hexp]
      exact Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt h1_lt_2 hfl_gt
    exact ⟨hlb, hub⟩

  have h_real_same : ∀ (ε L y₁ y₂ : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      dyadicRealBin ε L y₁ = dyadicRealBin ε L y₂ → |y₁ - y₂| < 2 * ε ^ L := by
    intro ε L y₁ y₂ hε₀ hε₁ heq
    let l := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    let k := dyadicRealBin ε L y₁
    have hy₁_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ y₁ * (2 : ℝ) ^ l := Int.floor_le _
    have hy₁_lt : y₁ * (2 : ℝ) ^ l < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hy₂_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ y₂ * (2 : ℝ) ^ l := by
      change (dyadicRealBin ε L y₁ : ℝ) ≤ _
      rw [heq]
      exact Int.floor_le _
    have hy₂_lt : y₂ * (2 : ℝ) ^ l < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
      change _ < (dyadicRealBin ε L y₁ : ℝ) + 1
      rw [heq]
      exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hzpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ l := zpow_pos h2_pos l
    have h_diff_lt1 : |y₁ - y₂| * (2 : ℝ) ^ l < 1 := by
      have h1 : |(y₁ - y₂) * (2 : ℝ) ^ l| < 1 := by
        rw [sub_mul, abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith
      rwa [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hzpow_pos] at h1
    have hlb := (h_real_level ε L hε₀ hε₁).1
    have h_le_lt : |y₁ - y₂| * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L)) < 1 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlb.le (abs_nonneg _)) h_diff_lt1
    have hrpow_pos : 0 < ε ^ L := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ L
    have h_prod : ε ^ (-L) * ε ^ L = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_le_lt (mul_pos h2_pos hrpow_pos)
    have hlhs : |y₁ - y₂| * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L)) * (2 * ε ^ L) =
        |y₁ - y₂| * (ε ^ (-L) * ε ^ L) := by ring
    rw [hlhs, h_prod, mul_one, one_mul] at hmul
    exact hmul

  have h_real_icc : ∀ (ε L y y₀ : ℝ) (B : ℤ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ B →
      |y - y₀| ≤ (B : ℝ) * ε ^ L →
      dyadicRealBin ε L y ∈ Finset.Icc (dyadicRealBin ε L y₀ - B) (dyadicRealBin ε L y₀ + B) := by
    intro ε L y y₀ B hε₀ hε₁ hB hdist
    let l := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    let k₀ := dyadicRealBin ε L y₀
    have hub := (h_real_level ε L hε₀ hε₁).2
    have hzpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ l := zpow_pos h2_pos l
    have h_prod : ε ^ L * ε ^ (-L) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    have h_scaled : |y * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - y₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ l| ≤ (B : ℝ) := by
      calc |y * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - y₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ l|
          = |y - y₀| * (2 : ℝ) ^ l := by rw [← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hzpow_pos]
        _ ≤ ((B : ℝ) * ε ^ L) * ε ^ (-L) :=
            mul_le_mul hdist hub hzpow_pos.le (mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hB) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le L))
        _ = (B : ℝ) * (ε ^ L * ε ^ (-L)) := by ring
        _ = (B : ℝ) := by rw [h_prod, mul_one]
    have h_abs := abs_le.mp h_scaled
    have hk₀_le : (k₀ : ℝ) ≤ y₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ l := Int.floor_le _
    have hk₀_lt : y₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ l < (k₀ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
      push_cast
      linarith [h_abs.1]
    · have h_lt_succ : dyadicRealBin ε L y < k₀ + B + 1 := by
        refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
        push_cast
        linarith [h_abs.2]
      omega

  let sepBin : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ := fun ε e s =>
    @ite ℕ (s ≤ ε ^ e) (Classical.dec _) ⌊e / ξ⌋₊
      (min ⌊e / ξ⌋₊ ⌊Real.log (s⁻¹) / (Real.log (ε⁻¹) * ξ)⌋₊)
  let sepLo : ℕ → ℝ := fun z => (z : ℝ) * ξ
  let sepHi : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ := fun e z => min e (((z : ℝ) + 1) * ξ)

  have h_sep_props : ∀ (ε e s : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < e →
      s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      let z := sepBin ε e s
      let v_lo := sepLo z
      let v_hi := sepHi e z
      z ≤ ⌊e / ξ⌋₊ ∧
      0 ≤ v_lo ∧
      v_lo ≤ v_hi ∧
      v_hi ≤ e ∧
      v_hi - v_lo ≤ ξ ∧
      s ≤ ε ^ v_lo ∧
      (v_hi = e ∨ ε ^ v_hi < s) := by
    intro ε e s hε₀ hε₁ he hs z v_lo v_hi
    let M_sep : ℕ := ⌊e / ξ⌋₊
    have heξ_nn : 0 ≤ e / ξ := div_nonneg he.le hξ.le
    have hM_le_div : (M_sep : ℝ) ≤ e / ξ := Nat.floor_le heξ_nn
    have hM_lt_div : e / ξ < (M_sep : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (e / ξ)
    have hM_le_e : (M_sep : ℝ) * ξ ≤ e := (le_div_iff₀ hξ).mp hM_le_div
    have hM_gt_e : e < ((M_sep : ℝ) + 1) * ξ := (div_lt_iff₀ hξ).mp hM_lt_div
    by_cases hs_sm : s ≤ ε ^ e
    · have hz_eq : z = M_sep := by
        dsimp [z, sepBin]
        exact if_pos hs_sm
      have hv_lo_eq : v_lo = (M_sep : ℝ) * ξ := by
        dsimp [v_lo, sepLo]
        rw [hz_eq]
      have hv_hi_eq : v_hi = e := by
        dsimp [v_hi, sepHi]
        rw [hz_eq]
        exact min_eq_left hM_gt_e.le
      have hs_le_vlo : s ≤ ε ^ v_lo := by
        refine le_trans hs_sm ?_
        rw [hv_lo_eq]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ (by linarith) hM_le_e
      refine ⟨by rw [hz_eq], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hs_le_vlo, Or.inl hv_hi_eq⟩
      · rw [hv_lo_eq]; positivity
      · rw [hv_lo_eq, hv_hi_eq]; exact hM_le_e
      · rw [hv_hi_eq]
      · rw [hv_lo_eq, hv_hi_eq]; linarith
    · have hs_gt : ε ^ e < s := lt_of_not_ge hs_sm
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := lt_trans (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ e) hs_gt
      have hε_inv_gt1 : 1 < ε⁻¹ := by
        rw [lt_inv_comm₀ zero_lt_one hε₀]
        linarith
      have hell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := Real.log_pos hε_inv_gt1
      have hdenom_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) * ξ := mul_pos hell_pos hξ
      have hsinv_ge1 : 1 ≤ s⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hs_pos).mpr hs.2
      have hlogs_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (s⁻¹) := Real.log_nonneg hsinv_ge1
      let x : ℝ := Real.log (s⁻¹) / (Real.log (ε⁻¹) * ξ)
      have hx_nn : 0 ≤ x := div_nonneg hlogs_nn hdenom_pos.le
      let k : ℕ := ⌊x⌋₊
      have hz_eq : z = min M_sep k := by
        dsimp [z, sepBin]
        exact if_neg hs_sm
      have hz_le_M : z ≤ M_sep := by rw [hz_eq]; exact min_le_left _ _
      have hz_le_k : z ≤ k := by rw [hz_eq]; exact min_le_right _ _
      have hz_cast_M : (z : ℝ) ≤ (M_sep : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hz_le_M
      have hz_cast_k : (z : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hz_le_k
      have hv_lo_nn : 0 ≤ v_lo := by dsimp [v_lo, sepLo]; positivity
      have hv_lo_le_e : v_lo ≤ e := by
        calc v_lo = (z : ℝ) * ξ := rfl
          _ ≤ (M_sep : ℝ) * ξ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz_cast_M hξ.le
          _ ≤ e := hM_le_e
      have hv_lo_le_step : v_lo ≤ ((z : ℝ) + 1) * ξ := by
        dsimp [v_lo, sepLo]; linarith
      have hv_lo_le_hi : v_lo ≤ v_hi := le_min hv_lo_le_e hv_lo_le_step
      have hv_hi_le_e : v_hi ≤ e := min_le_left _ _
      have hv_diff_le : v_hi - v_lo ≤ ξ := by
        have h1 : v_hi ≤ ((z : ℝ) + 1) * ξ := min_le_right _ _
        dsimp [v_lo, sepLo] at *
        linarith
      have hk_le_x : (k : ℝ) ≤ x := Nat.floor_le hx_nn
      have hz_le_x : (z : ℝ) ≤ x := le_trans hz_cast_k hk_le_x
      have hs_le_vlo : s ≤ ε ^ v_lo := by
        have hmul : (z : ℝ) * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) * ξ) ≤ Real.log (s⁻¹) :=
          (le_div_iff₀ hdenom_pos).mp hz_le_x
        have h_lhs_eq : (z : ℝ) * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) * ξ) = v_lo * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
          dsimp [v_lo, sepLo]; ring
        have hlog_vlo : Real.log (ε ^ v_lo) = -(v_lo * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
          rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀, Real.log_inv]
          ring
        have hlog_le : Real.log s ≤ Real.log (ε ^ v_lo) := by
          rw [h_lhs_eq, Real.log_inv s] at hmul
          linarith
        by_contra h_not
        have h_lt : ε ^ v_lo < s := lt_of_not_ge h_not
        have h_log_lt := Real.log_lt_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ v_lo) h_lt
        linarith
      have h_or : v_hi = e ∨ ε ^ v_hi < s := by
        by_cases h_cap : e ≤ ((z : ℝ) + 1) * ξ
        · exact Or.inl (min_eq_left h_cap)
        · right
          have h_step_lt : ((z : ℝ) + 1) * ξ < e := lt_of_not_ge h_cap
          have hv_hi_step : v_hi = ((z : ℝ) + 1) * ξ := min_eq_right h_step_lt.le
          have hz_lt_M : z < M_sep := by
            have h_lt_mul : ((z : ℝ) + 1) * ξ < ((M_sep : ℝ) + 1) * ξ :=
              lt_trans h_step_lt hM_gt_e
            have h_lt_real : (z : ℝ) + 1 < (M_sep : ℝ) + 1 :=
              lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h_lt_mul hξ.le
            have h_z_real : (z : ℝ) < (M_sep : ℝ) := by linarith
            exact_mod_cast h_z_real
          have hz_eq_k : z = k := by omega
          have hx_lt_z1 : x < (z : ℝ) + 1 := by
            rw [hz_eq_k]
            exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one x
          have hmul : Real.log (s⁻¹) < ((z : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) * ξ) :=
            (div_lt_iff₀ hdenom_pos).mp hx_lt_z1
          have h_rhs_eq : ((z : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) * ξ) = v_hi * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
            rw [hv_hi_step]; ring
          have hlog_vhi : Real.log (ε ^ v_hi) = -(v_hi * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
            rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀, Real.log_inv]
            ring
          have hlog_lt : Real.log (ε ^ v_hi) < Real.log s := by
            rw [Real.log_inv, h_rhs_eq] at hmul
            linarith
          by_contra h_not
          have h_le : s ≤ ε ^ v_hi := le_of_not_gt h_not
          have h_log_le := Real.log_le_log hs_pos h_le
          linarith
      exact ⟨hz_le_M, hv_lo_nn, hv_lo_le_hi, hv_hi_le_e, hv_diff_le, hs_le_vlo, h_or⟩

  have h_cyc_sep : ∀ (ε e d θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < e → 0 < d → ν_gap ≤ e - d →
      ε ^ ν_gap < 1 / 8 → ε ^ ξ < 1 / 4 →
      θ₁ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi → θ₂ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
      1 < cyclicBinDist ((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)) (angBin ε d θ₁) (angBin ε d θ₂) →
      e - d - 2 * ξ <
        e - sepHi e (sepBin ε e
          |inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e (angBin ε e θ₁)) (perp2D (angUnitVec ε e (angBin ε e θ₂)))|) := by
    intro ε e d θ₁ θ₂ hε₀ hε₁ he hd h_gap hε_ν hε_ξ hθ₁ hθ₂ h_cyc
    let m_d := dyadicTimeLevel ε d
    let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ m_d
    let kd₁ := angBin ε d θ₁
    let kd₂ := angBin ε d θ₂
    change 1 < min |kd₁ - kd₂| (M_d - |kd₁ - kd₂|) at h_cyc
    have h_min_gt := lt_min_iff.mp h_cyc
    have hkd_lo_int : 2 ≤ |kd₁ - kd₂| := by linarith [h_min_gt.1]
    have hkd_hi_int : |kd₁ - kd₂| ≤ M_d - 2 := by linarith [h_min_gt.2]
    have hkd_lo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ |(kd₁ : ℝ) - (kd₂ : ℝ)| := by
      have h1 : ((2 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((|kd₁ - kd₂| : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkd_lo_int
      simpa using h1
    have hkd_hi : |(kd₁ : ℝ) - (kd₂ : ℝ)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d - 2 := by
      have h1 : ((|kd₁ - kd₂| : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((M_d - 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkd_hi_int
      dsimp [M_d] at h1
      simpa using h1
    have hb₁_d := h_ang_bin ε d θ₁ hε₀ hε₁ hd.le hθ₁
    have hb₂_d := h_ang_bin ε d θ₂ hε₀ hε₁ hd.le hθ₂
    let u₁ : ℝ := (θ₁ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d
    let u₂ : ℝ := (θ₂ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d
    have hu₁_lo : (kd₁ : ℝ) ≤ u₁ := hb₁_d.2.2.2.2.1
    have hu₁_hi : u₁ < (kd₁ : ℝ) + 1 := hb₁_d.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have hu₂_lo : (kd₂ : ℝ) ≤ u₂ := hb₂_d.2.2.2.2.1
    have hu₂_hi : u₂ < (kd₂ : ℝ) + 1 := hb₂_d.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have h_u_diff_lo : 1 < |u₁ - u₂| := by
      rcases le_or_gt (kd₁ : ℝ) (kd₂ : ℝ) with hle | hgt
      · have hk_diff : (kd₂ : ℝ) - (kd₁ : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by
          rwa [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), neg_sub] at hkd_lo
        have h_u21 : 1 < u₂ - u₁ := by linarith
        rw [abs_sub_comm]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_u21 (le_abs_self _)
      · have hk_diff : (kd₁ : ℝ) - (kd₂ : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by
          rwa [abs_of_pos (by linarith)] at hkd_lo
        have h_u12 : 1 < u₁ - u₂ := by linarith
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_u12 (le_abs_self _)
    have h_u_diff_hi : |u₁ - u₂| < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d - 1 := by
      have hk_abs := abs_le.mp hkd_hi
      rw [abs_lt]

        rw [hp_unit, hpG_eq, hpT_eq, hpTG_eq, div_one, ← div_div,

        dsimp only [ell]
        ring
      · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (h_law.1 ω)

    unfold classicalTransportScore at h_raw_bound
    dsimp only at h_raw_bound
    change (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g)) -

          p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell +

    linarith

  
  let ε_ν : ℝ := (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ (1 / ν_gap)

  have hε_ν_pos : 0 < ε_ν := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h_eighth_pos _
  have hε_ξ_pos : 0 < ε_ξ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h_quarter_pos _
  have hε₀_pos : 0 < ε₀ := lt_min hε₁_pos (lt_min hε_ν_pos hε_ξ_pos)

  letI := Classical.propDecidable

  have hε_lt_ξ : ε < ε_ξ :=

      _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hξ)]
      _ = 1 / 4 := Real.rpow_one _
  let e : ℝ := a - b
  have he_pos : 0 < e := sub_pos.mpr hba
  have he_le_1m : e ≤ 1 + m := by dsimp [e]; linarith
  have h_floor_mono : ⌊e / ξ⌋₊ ≤ ⌊(1 + m) / ξ⌋₊ :=
    Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right he_le_1m hξ.le)
  let D₁ := fun ω : Fin N_ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
    (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₁ ω)
  let D₂ := fun ω : Fin N_ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
    (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₂ ω)
  let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
  let P_sep := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
    if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁ ω)) (angBin ε d (θ₂ ω))
    then π ω else 0
  let e₁_fn : Fin N_ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun ω =>
    angUnitVec ε e (angBin ε e (θ₁ ω))
  let e₂_fn : Fin N_ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun ω =>
    angUnitVec ε e (angBin ε e (θ₂ ω))
  let s_fn : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => |inner ℝ (e₁_fn ω) (perp2D (e₂_fn ω))|
  let z_fn : Fin N_ω → ℕ := fun ω => sepBin ε e (s_fn ω)
  let vlo_fn : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => sepLo (z_fn ω)
  let vhi_fn : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => sepHi e (z_fn ω)
  let G_c : Fin N_ω → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun ω =>
    (z_fn ω, stdApertureObs ε u b (b + vlo_fn ω)
      (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ₁ ω))
  have hs_icc : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, s_fn ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro ω
    refine ⟨abs_nonneg _, ?_⟩
    dsimp [s_fn]
    calc |inner ℝ (e₁_fn ω) (perp2D (e₂_fn ω))|

      _ = 1 := by rw [h_ang_norm, h_perp_norm _ (h_ang_norm _ _ _), mul_one]
  have h_sp : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
      z_fn ω ≤ ⌊(1 + m) / ξ⌋₊ ∧
      0 ≤ vlo_fn ω ∧
      vlo_fn ω ≤ vhi_fn ω ∧
      vhi_fn ω ≤ e ∧
      vhi_fn ω - vlo_fn ω ≤ ξ ∧
      s_fn ω ≤ ε ^ (vlo_fn ω) ∧
      (vhi_fn ω = e ∨ ε ^ (vhi_fn ω) < s_fn ω) := by
    intro ω
    obtain ⟨hz, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ :=
      h_sep_props ε e (s_fn ω) hε_pos hε_half he_pos (hs_icc ω)
    exact ⟨le_trans hz h_floor_mono, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
  refine ⟨G_c, fun _ => rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ω₀ hω₀
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨S₁, hS₁_card, hS₁_mem⟩ :=
        h_fiber_card ε b a ⌊(1 + m) / ξ⌋₊ hε_pos hε_half hb hba

          (fun ω hω => (hθ ω hω).1) (fun ω hω => (hθ ω hω).1)

    · obtain ⟨S₂, hS₂_card, hS₂_mem⟩ :=
        h_fiber_card ε b a ⌊(1 + m) / ξ⌋₊ hε_pos hε_half hb hba
          π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ₁ θ₂ z_fn
          (fun ω hω => (hθ ω hω).1) (fun ω hω => (hθ ω hω).2)
          (fun ω _ => (h_sp ω).1) (fun ω _ => le_trans (h_sp ω).2.2.1 (h_sp ω).2.2.2.1)

          ω₀ hω₀
      refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) hS₂_card
      intro y hy
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hy
      obtain ⟨ω, hω_f, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hω_f
      exact hS₂_mem ω hω_f.2.1 hω_f.2.2
  · 
    have h_int_bound := h_s4 ε hε_pos hε_lt₁ π T_idx V_part A_part c_s
      (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) (fun ω => a - vhi_fn ω) (fun _ => a) e₁_fn h_law
      (fun ω _ => by
        have h_v0 : 0 ≤ vhi_fn ω := le_trans (h_sp ω).2.1 (h_sp ω).2.2.1
        have h_ve : vhi_fn ω ≤ a - b := (h_sp ω).2.2.2.1
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, hau, h_ang_norm _ _ _⟩)
      (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ h_pair => by
        obtain ⟨hD1, hD2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h_pair
        have h_kt : dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω₁) = dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω₂) :=
          congr_arg Prod.fst hD1
        have h_kr1 : angBin ε e (θ₁ ω₁) = angBin ε e (θ₁ ω₂) :=
          congr_arg (fun p => p.2.1) hD1
        have h_kr2 : angBin ε e (θ₂ ω₁) = angBin ε e (θ₂ ω₂) :=
          congr_arg (fun p => p.2.1) hD2
        have hs_eq : s_fn ω₁ = s_fn ω₂ := by
          dsimp only [s_fn, e₁_fn, e₂_fn]
          rw [h_kr1, h_kr2]
        have hvhi_eq : vhi_fn ω₁ = vhi_fn ω₂ := by
          dsimp only [vhi_fn, z_fn]
          rw [hs_eq]
        exact ⟨h_kt, by rw [hvhi_eq], rfl⟩)
      (fun ω ω₀ _ _ h_pair => by
        obtain ⟨hD1, hD2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h_pair
        have h_tb := h_s3_inter ε b a (vhi_fn ω₀)
          (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω))
          (V_part (T_idx ω₀)) (A_part (T_idx ω₀))
          (c_s ω) (c_s ω₀) (θ₁ ω) (θ₂ ω) (θ₁ ω₀) (θ₂ ω₀)
          hε_pos hε_half hD1 hD2 (h_sp ω₀).2.2.2.2.2.2
        exact ⟨h_tb.2.2.1, h_tb.2.2.2.1, h_tb.2.2.2.2.1, h_tb.2.2.2.2.2⟩)
    
    let ec_fn : Fin N_ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun ω =>
      angUnitVec ε ((b + vlo_fn ω) - b) (angBin ε ((b + vlo_fn ω) - b) (θ₁ ω))
    have h_com_bound := h_s4 ε hε_pos hε_lt₁ π T_idx V_part A_part c_s
      G_c (fun _ => b) (fun ω => b + vlo_fn ω) ec_fn h_law
      (fun ω _ => by
        have h_v0 : 0 ≤ vlo_fn ω := (h_sp ω).2.1
        have h_ve : vlo_fn ω ≤ a - b := le_trans (h_sp ω).2.2.1 (h_sp ω).2.2.2.1

      (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ hGc_eq => by
        obtain ⟨hz_eq, hobs_eq⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hGc_eq

          dsimp only [vlo_fn]

        exact ⟨h_kt, rfl, by rw [hvlo_eq]⟩)
      (fun ω ω₀ _ _ hGc_eq => by
        obtain ⟨hz_eq, hobs_eq⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hGc_eq
        have hvlo_eq : vlo_fn ω = vlo_fn ω₀ := by
          dsimp only [vlo_fn]
          rw [hz_eq]
        rw [hvlo_eq] at hobs_eq
        have h_tb := h_s3_single ε b (b + vlo_fn ω₀)
          (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω))
          (V_part (T_idx ω₀)) (A_part (T_idx ω₀))
          (c_s ω) (c_s ω₀) (θ₁ ω) (θ₁ ω₀) hε_pos hε_half hobs_eq
        have hp1 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos b
        have hp2 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos (b + vlo_fn ω₀)
        have hp3 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos (b + u)
        have hp4 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos (b + vlo_fn ω₀ + u)
        exact ⟨by linarith [h_tb.2.2.1], by linarith [h_tb.2.2.2.1],
          by linarith [h_tb.2.2.2.2.1], by linarith [h_tb.2.2.2.2.2]⟩)
    
    have h_w_sum : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (2 * γ * (e - vhi_fn ω))) - ξ ≤

        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * (b + vlo_fn ω))) -
        2 * ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a) := by
      have h_two_w : 2 * ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a) =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (2 * ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a)) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h_law.2.1, one_mul]
      have h_xi_sum : ξ = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * ξ := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h_law.2.1, one_mul]
      rw [h_two_w, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      conv_lhs => rw [h_xi_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
      have h_diff_nn : 0 ≤ vhi_fn ω - vlo_fn ω := sub_nonneg.mpr (h_sp ω).2.2.1
      have h_diff_le : vhi_fn ω - vlo_fn ω ≤ ξ := (h_sp ω).2.2.2.2.1
      have h_1mg : (1 - γ) * (vhi_fn ω - vlo_fn ω) ≤ ξ := by nlinarith
      have h_alg : (π ω * ((1 + γ) * (a - vhi_fn ω) + (1 - γ) * a) +
          π ω * ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * (b + vlo_fn ω)) -
          π ω * (2 * ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a))) -
          (π ω * (2 * γ * (e - vhi_fn ω)) - π ω * ξ) =
          π ω * (ξ - (1 - γ) * (vhi_fn ω - vlo_fn ω)) := by
        dsimp only [e]
        ring
      have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ π ω * (ξ - (1 - γ) * (vhi_fn ω - vlo_fn ω)) :=
        mul_nonneg (h_law.1 ω) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h_sep_sum : 2 * γ * (a - b - d - 2 * ξ) * P_sep ≤
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (2 * γ * (e - vhi_fn ω)) := by
      have h_each_nn : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 ≤ π ω * (2 * γ * (e - vhi_fn ω)) := by
        intro ω
        exact mul_nonneg (h_law.1 ω)
          (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr (h_sp ω).2.2.2.1))
      by_cases h_sign : 0 ≤ a - b - d - 2 * ξ
      · dsimp only [P_sep]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases h_c : 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁ ω)) (angBin ε d (θ₂ ω))
        · rw [if_pos h_c]
          by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
          · have h_lt_gap := h_cyc_sep ε e d (θ₁ ω) (θ₂ ω)
              hε_pos hε_half he_pos hd h_gap hε_rpow_ν hε_rpow_ξ
              (hθ ω hω).1 (hθ ω hω).2 h_c

            calc 2 * γ * (a - b - d - 2 * ξ) * π ω

              _ ≤ π ω * (2 * γ * (e - vhi_fn ω)) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le_gap (by positivity)) (h_law.1 ω)
          · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (h_law.1 ω)
            simp [h0]
        · rw [if_neg h_c, mul_zero]
          exact h_each_nn ω
      · have hP_nn : 0 ≤ P_sep :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs; exact h_law.1 ω; exact le_rfl)
        have h_lhs_np : 2 * γ * (a - b - d - 2 * ξ) * P_sep ≤ 0 :=
          mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by positivity) (by linarith)) hP_nn
        exact le_trans h_lhs_np (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => h_each_nn ω))
    unfold stdApertureDeficit stdApertureScore
    change 2 * γ * (a - b - d - 2 * ξ) * P_sep - ξ ≤
      (classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
        classicalGrowthRate γ * u -
        (((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D₁ +
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)))) +
      (classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
        classicalGrowthRate γ * u -
        (((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D₂ +
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)))) +
      4 * δ_cl * u +
      (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx (fun ω => (D₁ ω, D₂ ω)) +
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_c -
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D₁ -
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D₂)
    linarith [h_int_bound, h_com_bound, h_w_sum, h_sep_sum]

informal_problem.statement:
(ε γ m u b a d : ℝ)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hu₀ : 0 < u) (hu₁ : u ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) (hau : a + u ≤ 1 + m) (hd : 0 < d)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (h_law : IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s)
    (hθ : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ_s ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
    ∃ (π_rep : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → ℝ)
      (T_rep : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → Fin N_T)
      (c_rep θ₁_rep θ₂_rep : Fin (N_ω * N_ω) → ℝ)
      (θ_det : Fin N_T × ℤ → ℝ),
      IsUnitBallTimeLaw π_rep V_part A_part c_rep ∧
      (∀ p, 0 < π_rep p →
        θ₁_rep p ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧ θ₂_rep p ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
      stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π_rep T_rep V_part A_part c_rep θ₁_rep =
        stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
      stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π_rep T_rep V_part A_part c_rep θ₂_rep =
        stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s ∧
      (let C_rep := fun p => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_rep p)
       let D₁ := fun p => stdApertureObs ε u b a
         (V_part (T_rep p)) (A_part (T_rep p)) (c_rep p) (θ₁_rep p)
       let D₂ := fun p => stdApertureObs ε u b a
         (V_part (T_rep p)) (A_part (T_rep p)) (c_rep p) (θ₂_rep p)
       finCondEntropy ε π_rep (fun p => (T_rep p, C_rep p)) D₁ +
         finCondEntropy ε π_rep (fun p => (T_rep p, C_rep p)) D₂ ≤
         finCondEntropy ε π_rep (fun p => (T_rep p, C_rep p)) (fun p => (D₁ p, D₂ p))) ∧
      (∀ q, θ_det q ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ_s ω))
            (angBin ε d (θ_det (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))))
        then π ω else 0) ≤
        (∑ p : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
          if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁_rep p)) (angBin ε d (θ₂_rep p))
          then π_rep p else 0)

          if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (K ω₁) (j_star (X_TC ω₁)) then π_pair (ω₁, ω₂) else 0 := by
      by_cases hc : 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (K ω₁) (j_star (X_TC ω₁))
      · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte]
      · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    rw [h_ite_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω₂ _ => ?_)
    by_cases h_eq : X_TC ω₁ = X_TC ω₂
    · rw [h_eq]
    · dsimp only [π_pair]
      rw [if_neg h_eq, ite_self, ite_self]
  have h_rhs_eq :
      (∑ p : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
        if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁_rep p)) (angBin ε d (θ₂_rep p))
        then π_rep p else 0) =
      ∑ ω₂ : Fin N_ω,
        B_miss (X_TC ω₂) (K ω₂) * (π ω₂ / finProbAt π X_TC ω₂) := by
    rw [← h_double_miss K, ← finProdFinEquiv.sum_comp]
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω₁ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω₂ _ => ?_))
    dsimp only [θ₁_rep, θ₂_rep, proj₁, proj₂, π_rep, K]
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h_miss_le :
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ_s ω))
            (angBin ε d (θ_det (T_idx ω, dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))))
        then π ω else 0) ≤
      (∑ p : Fin (N_ω * N_ω),
        if 1 < cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ₁_rep p)) (angBin ε d (θ₂_rep p))
        then π_rep p else 0) := by
    rw [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω₂ _ => ?_)
    by_cases hω₂ : 0 < π ω₂
    · have h_w_nn : 0 ≤ π ω₂ / finProbAt π X_TC ω₂ :=
        div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω₂) (h_fp_nn X_TC ω₂)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hj_min (X_TC ω₂) (K ω₂) (hK_mem ω₂ hω₂)) h_w_nn
    · have h0 : π ω₂ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω₂) (hπ_nn ω₂)
      rw [h0, zero_div, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨π_rep, T_rep, c_rep, θ₁_rep, θ₂_rep, θ_det,
    ⟨hπ_rep_nn, hπ_rep_sum, hVA_norm, fun p hp => hc_mem (proj₁ p) (hπ_rep_pos hp).1⟩,
    fun p hp => ⟨hθ (proj₁ p) (hπ_rep_pos hp).1, hθ (proj₂ p) (hπ_rep_pos hp).2.1⟩,
    h_def1, h_def2, h_cond_indep, hθ_det_mem, h_miss_le⟩

(ε m u b a ν : ℝ)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hu₀ : 0 < u) (hu₁ : u ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) (hau : a + u ≤ 1 + m) (hν : 0 < ν)
    {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s θ_s θ' : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (h_law : IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s)
    (hθ_s : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ_s ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi)
    (hθ' : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ' ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let G_s := fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
      (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_s ω)
    let G' := fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a
      (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ' ω)
    (∃ M_all : ℕ, 1 ≤ M_all ∧
      (M_all : ℝ) ≤ 100000 * ε ^ (-(6 + 5 * m)) ∧
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)).image G').card ≤ M_all) ∧
    (a - b ≤ 2 * ν → (∀ ω, θ' ω = 0) →
      ∃ N_small : ℕ, 1 ≤ N_small ∧
        (N_small : ℝ) ≤ 10000 * ε ^ (-(4 * ν)) ∧
        ∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω ∧ G_s ω = G_s ω₀)).image G').card ≤ N_small) ∧
    (2 * ν < a - b →
      let d := a - b - ν
      let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d)
      ∃ N_good : ℕ, 1 ≤ N_good ∧
        (N_good : ℝ) ≤ 10000000 * ε ^ (-(3 * ν)) ∧
        ∀ ω₀ : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω₀ →
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω =>
            0 < π ω ∧
            cyclicBinDist M_d (angBin ε d (θ_s ω)) (angBin ε d (θ' ω)) ≤ 1 ∧
            G_s ω = G_s ω₀)).image G').card ≤ N_good)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_num_all : (4 : ℝ) * 4 * 5 * 5 * 7 * 7 ≤ 100000 := by norm_num
  have h_num_sm : (9 : ℝ) * 11 * 9 * 11 ≤ 10000 := by norm_num
  have h_num_gd : (20 : ℝ) * 9 * 55 * 9 * 55 ≤ 10000000 := by norm_num
  have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hε_anti : ∀ {x y : ℝ}, x ≤ y → ε ^ y ≤ ε ^ x :=
    fun hxy => Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 hxy
  have hε_ge1 : ∀ {z : ℝ}, 0 ≤ z → 1 ≤ ε ^ (-z) := by
    intro z hz
    calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
      _ ≤ ε ^ (-z) := hε_anti (by linarith)
  have hε_mul_inv : ∀ x : ℝ, ε ^ x * ε ^ (-x) = 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]

  
  
  
  have h_tl : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
      let m_x := dyadicTimeLevel ε x
      ε ^ (-x) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-x) := by
    intro x hx m_x
    let n : ℕ := ⌈ε ^ (-x)⌉₊
    have hm_eq : m_x = Nat.clog 2 n := rfl
    have h1_le : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-x) := hε_ge1 hx
    have h_le_n : ε ^ (-x) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    have hn_le_pow : n ≤ 2 ^ m_x := Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide : 1 < 2) n
    have h_pow_cast : (n : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x := by exact_mod_cast hn_le_pow
    refine ⟨le_trans h_le_n h_pow_cast, ?_⟩
    by_cases hn : n ≤ 1
    · have hm0 : m_x = 0 := by
        rw [hm_eq]
        rcases (by omega : n = 0 ∨ n = 1) with hn0 | hn1
        · rw [hn0]; decide
        · rw [hn1]; decide
      rw [hm0, pow_zero]
      linarith
    · have hn_gt1 : 1 < n := lt_of_not_ge hn
      have hm_pos : 1 ≤ m_x := by
        by_contra hm_not
        have hm0 : m_x = 0 := by omega
        rw [hm0] at hn_le_pow
        omega
      have h_pred_lt : 2 ^ (m_x - 1) < n := by
        rw [hm_eq]
        exact Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self (by decide : 1 < 2) hn_gt1
      have h_pred_real : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_x - 1) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_pred_lt
      have h_pow_split : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_x = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_x - 1) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [(by omega : m_x = (m_x - 1) + 1)]
        ring
      have hn_lt : (n : ℝ) < ε ^ (-x) + 1 :=
        Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-x))
      linarith

  have h_tb : ∀ (v c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      let m_v := dyadicTimeLevel ε v
      dyadicTimeBin ε v c ∈ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) ((2 : ℤ) ^ m_v) ∧
      dyadicTimeMid ε v c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro v c hc
    dsimp only
    have hpow_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε v) := by positivity
    have hpow_pos_int : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε v) :=
      one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2)
    have hfl_nn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε v)⌋ :=
      Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hc.1 hpow_pos_real.le)
    have hkt_nn : 0 ≤ dyadicTimeBin ε v c := by
      dsimp only [dyadicTimeBin]
      exact le_min hfl_nn (sub_nonneg.mpr hpow_pos_int)
    have hkt_le : dyadicTimeBin ε v c ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε v) - 1 := by
      dsimp only [dyadicTimeBin]
      exact min_le_right _ _
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hkt_nn, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    have hkt_nn_r : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkt_nn
    have hkt_le_r : (dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε v) - 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast hkt_le
    dsimp only [dyadicTimeMid]
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr hpow_pos_real.le), ?_⟩
    calc ((dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε v))⁻¹
        ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε v) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε v))⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr hpow_pos_real.le)
      _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hpow_pos_real)

  have h_rl : ∀ L : ℝ,
      let ℓ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L) < (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ ≤ ε ^ (-L) := by
    intro L ℓ
    let β : ℝ := L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h2β : (2 : ℝ) ^ β = ε ^ (-L) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) β,
        Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀ (-L)]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [β]
      rw [Real.log_inv]
      have hlog2_ne : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlog2_pos
      field_simp [hlog2_ne]
    have h_le : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ β := Int.floor_le β
    have h_lt_raw : β < (ℓ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one β
    have h_lt : β - 1 < (ℓ : ℝ) := by linarith
    rw [← Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) ℓ]
    constructor
    · calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L)
          = (2 : ℝ) ^ β / (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
            rw [h2β, Real.rpow_one]
            ring
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (β - 1) := (Real.rpow_sub (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) β 1).symm
        _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ (ℓ : ℝ) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) h_lt
    · calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (ℓ : ℝ)
          ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ β := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) h_le
        _ = ε ^ (-L) := h2β

  have h_rb_close : ∀ (L y₁ y₂ : ℝ),
      dyadicRealBin ε L y₁ = dyadicRealBin ε L y₂ → |y₁ - y₂| ≤ 2 * ε ^ L := by
    intro L y₁ y₂ h_eq
    let ℓ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    let s : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ
    have hs_bds := h_rl L
    have hs_pos : 0 < s := lt_trans (by positivity) hs_bds.1
    have hk1_lo : (dyadicRealBin ε L y₁ : ℝ) ≤ y₁ * s := Int.floor_le _
    have hk1_hi : y₁ * s < (dyadicRealBin ε L y₁ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hk2_lo : (dyadicRealBin ε L y₂ : ℝ) ≤ y₂ * s := Int.floor_le _
    have hk2_hi : y₂ * s < (dyadicRealBin ε L y₂ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    rw [h_eq] at hk1_lo hk1_hi
    have h_diff_lt : |(y₁ - y₂) * s| < 1 := by
      rw [sub_mul, abs_lt]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs_pos] at h_diff_lt
    have h_prod_le : |y₁ - y₂| * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L)) ≤ 1 := by
      calc |y₁ - y₂| * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L))
          ≤ |y₁ - y₂| * s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs_bds.1.le (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 := h_diff_lt.le
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod_le
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ L).le)
    have h_lhs : (|y₁ - y₂| * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L))) * (2 * ε ^ L) = |y₁ - y₂| := by
      calc (|y₁ - y₂| * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-L))) * (2 * ε ^ L)
          = |y₁ - y₂| * (ε ^ L * ε ^ (-L)) := by ring
        _ = |y₁ - y₂| * 1 := by rw [hε_mul_inv L]
        _ = |y₁ - y₂| := mul_one _
    linarith

  have h_rb_int : ∀ (L y y₀ : ℝ) (B : ℕ),
      |y - y₀| ≤ (B : ℝ) * ε ^ L →
      let k₀ := dyadicRealBin ε L y₀
      dyadicRealBin ε L y ∈ Finset.Icc (k₀ - (B : ℤ)) (k₀ + (B : ℤ)) := by
    intro L y y₀ B h_diff k₀
    let ℓ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    let s : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ
    have hs_bds := h_rl L
    have hs_pos : 0 < s := lt_trans (by positivity) hs_bds.1
    have h_scaled : |y * s - y₀ * s| ≤ (B : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : |y * s - y₀ * s| = |y - y₀| * s := by
        rw [← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs_pos]
      rw [h1]
      calc |y - y₀| * s
          ≤ ((B : ℝ) * ε ^ L) * ε ^ (-L) :=
            mul_le_mul h_diff hs_bds.2 hs_pos.le (by positivity)
        _ = (B : ℝ) * (ε ^ L * ε ^ (-L)) := by ring
        _ = (B : ℝ) := by rw [hε_mul_inv L, mul_one]
    have h_abs := abs_le.mp h_scaled
    have hk₀_lo : (k₀ : ℝ) ≤ y₀ * s := Int.floor_le _
    have hk₀_hi : y₀ * s < (k₀ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have h_lo : k₀ - (B : ℤ) ≤ dyadicRealBin ε L y := by
      refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_lt : dyadicRealBin ε L y < k₀ + (B : ℤ) + 1 := by
      refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
      push_cast
      linarith
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h_lo, by omega⟩

  have h_rb_pow : ∀ (C : ℕ) (α : ℝ), 0 ≤ α →
      let B : ℕ := ⌈(C : ℝ) * ε ^ (-α)⌉₊
      (((2 * B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * C + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-α)) ∧
      ∀ (L y y₀ : ℝ), |y - y₀| ≤ (C : ℝ) * ε ^ (L - α) →
        let k₀ := dyadicRealBin ε L y₀
        dyadicRealBin ε L y ∈ Finset.Icc (k₀ - (B : ℤ)) (k₀ + (B : ℤ)) := by
    intro C α hα B
    have h1_le : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-α) := hε_ge1 hα
    have hB_lt : (B : ℝ) < (C : ℝ) * ε ^ (-α) + 1 :=
      Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
    refine ⟨?_, fun L y y₀ hy => ?_⟩
    · push_cast
      nlinarith
    · refine h_rb_int L y y₀ B ?_
      have h_le_B : (C : ℝ) * ε ^ (-α) ≤ (B : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      have hexp : L - α = -α + L := by ring
      rw [hexp, Real.rpow_add hε₀, ← mul_assoc] at hy
      exact le_trans hy (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_le_B (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ L).le)

  
  
  
  have h_ab_floor : ∀ (e θ : ℝ), θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
      angBin ε e θ = ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e)⌋ ∧
      angBin ε e θ ∈ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) ((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e)) := by
    intro e θ hθ
    have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e) := by positivity
    have hdiv_nn : 0 ≤ θ / Real.pi := div_nonneg hθ.1 Real.pi_pos.le
    have hdiv_lt1 : θ / Real.pi < 1 := (div_lt_one Real.pi_pos).mpr hθ.2
    have hprod_nn : 0 ≤ (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e) :=
      mul_nonneg hdiv_nn hpow_pos.le
    have hprod_lt : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e) <
        (((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      nlinarith
    have hfl_nn : 0 ≤ ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e)⌋ :=
      Int.floor_nonneg.mpr hprod_nn
    have hfl_lt : ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e)⌋ <
        (2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e) := Int.floor_lt.mpr hprod_lt
    have h_eq : angBin ε e θ = ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε e)⌋ := by
      dsimp only [angBin]
      exact min_eq_left (by omega)
    rw [h_eq]
    exact ⟨rfl, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hfl_nn, hfl_lt⟩⟩

  have h_ab_zero : ∀ e : ℝ, angBin ε e 0 = 0 := by
    intro e
    rw [(h_ab_floor e 0 ⟨le_rfl, Real.pi_pos⟩).1]
    simp

  have h_ab_nest : ∀ (d e θ : ℝ), 0 ≤ d → d ≤ e → θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
      let m_d := dyadicTimeLevel ε d
      let m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
      let q := m_e - m_d
      m_d ≤ m_e ∧
      (((2 ^ q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-(e - d))) ∧
      angBin ε e θ / ((2 : ℤ) ^ q) = angBin ε d θ ∧
      angBin ε e θ ∈ Finset.Ico (angBin ε d θ * (2 : ℤ) ^ q)
        ((angBin ε d θ + 1) * (2 : ℤ) ^ q) := by
    intro d e θ hd hde hθ m_d m_e q
    have he_nn : 0 ≤ e := le_trans hd hde
    have h_rpow_le : ε ^ (-d) ≤ ε ^ (-e) := hε_anti (by linarith)
    have h_md_le_me : m_d ≤ m_e :=
      Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (Nat.ceil_mono h_rpow_le)
    have hm_sum : m_d + q = m_e := Nat.add_sub_of_le h_md_le_me
    have h_tl_d : ε ^ (-d) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d := (h_tl d hd).1
    have h_tl_e : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-e) := (h_tl e he_nn).2
    have h_2q_bound : ((2 ^ q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-(e - d)) := by
      have h_ed_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-d)
      have h_mul_le : ((2 ^ q : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-d) ≤ (4 * ε ^ (-(e - d))) * ε ^ (-d) := by
        calc ((2 ^ q : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-d)
            ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ q * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d := by
              push_cast
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tl_d (by positivity)
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e := by rw [mul_comm, ← pow_add, hm_sum]
          _ ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-e) := h_tl_e
          _ = (4 * ε ^ (-(e - d))) * ε ^ (-d) := by
              have hexp : -e = -(e - d) + (-d) := by ring
              rw [hexp, Real.rpow_add hε₀]
              ring
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_mul_le h_ed_pos
    let k_d := angBin ε d θ
    let k_e := angBin ε e θ
    have hkd_eq : k_d = ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d⌋ := (h_ab_floor d θ hθ).1
    have hke_eq : k_e = ⌊(θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e⌋ := (h_ab_floor e θ hθ).1
    have hkd_lo : (k_d : ℝ) ≤ (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d := by
      rw [hkd_eq]; exact Int.floor_le _
    have hkd_hi : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d < (k_d : ℝ) + 1 := by
      rw [hkd_eq]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hpow_q_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ q := by positivity
    have h_me_prod : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e =
        ((θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d) * (2 : ℝ) ^ q := by
      rw [← hm_sum, pow_add]
      ring
    have hke_lo : k_d * (2 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ k_e := by
      rw [hke_eq]
      refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
      rw [h_me_prod]
      push_cast
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkd_lo hpow_q_pos.le
    have hke_hi : k_e < (k_d + 1) * (2 : ℤ) ^ q := by
      rw [hke_eq]
      refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
      rw [h_me_prod]
      push_cast
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hkd_hi hpow_q_pos
    have hP_pos : (0 : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ q := by positivity
    have h_div_lo : k_d ≤ k_e / (2 : ℤ) ^ q :=
      (Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hP_pos).mpr hke_lo
    have h_div_hi : k_e / (2 : ℤ) ^ q < k_d + 1 :=
      Int.ediv_lt_of_lt_mul hP_pos hke_hi
    have h_div_le : k_e / (2 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ k_d := by omega
    exact ⟨h_md_le_me, h_2q_bound, le_antisymm h_div_le h_div_lo,
      Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hke_lo, hke_hi⟩⟩

  have h_ab_cyc : ∀ (d e θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ d → d ≤ e →
      θ₁ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi → θ₂ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
      let m_d := dyadicTimeLevel ε d
      let M_d : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ m_d
      let k₁ := angBin ε d θ₁
      let k₂ := angBin ε d θ₂
      cyclicBinDist M_d k₁ k₂ ≤ 1 →
      k₂ ∈ ({k₁ - 1, k₁, k₁ + 1, 0, M_d - 1} : Finset ℤ) ∧
      |inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e (angBin ε e θ₁))
        (perp2D (angUnitVec ε e (angBin ε e θ₂)))| ≤ 12 * ε ^ d := by
    intro d e θ₁ θ₂ hd hde hθ₁ hθ₂ m_d M_d k₁ k₂ h_cyc
    let x₁ : ℝ := (θ₁ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d
    let x₂ : ℝ := (θ₂ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d
    have hk₁_eq : k₁ = ⌊x₁⌋ := (h_ab_floor d θ₁ hθ₁).1
    have hk₂_eq : k₂ = ⌊x₂⌋ := (h_ab_floor d θ₂ hθ₂).1
    have hk₁_bds : 0 ≤ k₁ ∧ k₁ < M_d := Finset.mem_Ico.mp (h_ab_floor d θ₁ hθ₁).2
    have hk₂_bds : 0 ≤ k₂ ∧ k₂ < M_d := Finset.mem_Ico.mp (h_ab_floor d θ₂ hθ₂).2
    have hx₁_lo : (k₁ : ℝ) ≤ x₁ := by rw [hk₁_eq]; exact Int.floor_le _
    have hx₁_hi : x₁ < (k₁ : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hk₁_eq]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hx₂_lo : (k₂ : ℝ) ≤ x₂ := by rw [hk₂_eq]; exact Int.floor_le _
    have hx₂_hi : x₂ < (k₂ : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hk₂_eq]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hMd_cast : (M_d : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d := by dsimp [M_d]; push_cast; rfl
    have h_shift : k₂ ∈ ({k₁ - 1, k₁, k₁ + 1, 0, M_d - 1} : Finset ℤ) ∧
        ∃ n : ℤ, (n = -1 ∨ n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧
          |x₁ - x₂ - (n : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d| ≤ 2 := by
      by_cases h_abs : |k₁ - k₂| ≤ 1
      · have hk_diff := abs_le.mp h_abs
        have hk₂_mem : k₂ ∈ ({k₁ - 1, k₁, k₁ + 1, 0, M_d - 1} : Finset ℤ) := by
          have hk_cases : k₂ = k₁ - 1 ∨ k₂ = k₁ ∨ k₂ = k₁ + 1 := by omega
          rcases hk_cases with hk | hk | hk <;> simp [hk]
        have hk_diff_r1 : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (k₁ : ℝ) - (k₂ : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : -1 ≤ k₁ - k₂ := hk_diff.1
          exact_mod_cast h1
        have hk_diff_r2 : (k₁ : ℝ) - (k₂ : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
          have h2 : k₁ - k₂ ≤ 1 := hk_diff.2
          exact_mod_cast h2
        refine ⟨hk₂_mem, 0, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), ?_⟩
        rw [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, abs_le]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · have h_wrap : M_d - |k₁ - k₂| ≤ 1 := by
          dsimp only [cyclicBinDist] at h_cyc
          rcases min_le_iff.mp h_cyc with h1 | h2
          · exact absurd h1 h_abs
          · exact h2
        have hk₁_hi : k₁ ≤ M_d - 1 := Int.le_sub_one_of_lt hk₁_bds.2
        have hk₂_hi : k₂ ≤ M_d - 1 := Int.le_sub_one_of_lt hk₂_bds.2
        have h_cases : (k₁ = M_d - 1 ∧ k₂ = 0) ∨ (k₁ = 0 ∧ k₂ = M_d - 1) := by
          rcases le_or_gt k₂ k₁ with h_le | h_gt
          · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h_le)] at h_wrap
            exact Or.inl ⟨by linarith [hk₁_bds.1, hk₁_hi, hk₂_bds.1, hk₂_hi],
              by linarith [hk₁_bds.1, hk₁_hi, hk₂_bds.1, hk₂_hi]⟩
          · rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr h_gt)] at h_wrap
            exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith [hk₁_bds.1, hk₁_hi, hk₂_bds.1, hk₂_hi],
              by linarith [hk₁_bds.1, hk₁_hi, hk₂_bds.1, hk₂_hi]⟩
        rcases h_cases with ⟨hk₁_v, hk₂_v⟩ | ⟨hk₁_v, hk₂_v⟩
        · refine ⟨by simp [hk₂_v], 1, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl), ?_⟩
          have hk₁_r : (k₁ : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d - 1 := by
            rw [hk₁_v]; push_cast; linarith [hMd_cast]
          have hk₂_r : (k₂ : ℝ) = 0 := by rw [hk₂_v]; simp
          rw [Int.cast_one, one_mul, abs_le]
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        · refine ⟨by simp [hk₂_v], -1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
          have hk₁_r : (k₁ : ℝ) = 0 := by rw [hk₁_v]; simp
          have hk₂_r : (k₂ : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d - 1 := by
            rw [hk₂_v]; push_cast; linarith [hMd_cast]
          rw [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, neg_one_mul, abs_le]
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    refine ⟨h_shift.1, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn_cases, h_x_diff⟩ := h_shift.2
    have h_pi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
    have h_theta_diff : |θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| ≤ 2 * Real.pi * ε ^ d := by
      have h_id : x₁ - x₂ - (n : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d =
          ((θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)) / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d := by
        dsimp only [x₁, x₂]
        field_simp [h_pi_ne]
        ring
      rw [h_id, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos,
        abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_d)] at h_x_diff
      have h_tl_d := (h_tl d hd).1
      have h_step1 : (|θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| / Real.pi) * ε ^ (-d) ≤ 2 := by
        refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tl_d ?_) h_x_diff
        exact div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) Real.pi_pos.le
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_step1
        (mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ d).le)
      have h_lhs : ((|θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| / Real.pi) * ε ^ (-d)) *
          (Real.pi * ε ^ d) = |θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| := by
        calc ((|θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| / Real.pi) * ε ^ (-d)) * (Real.pi * ε ^ d)
            = (|θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| / Real.pi * Real.pi) *
                (ε ^ d * ε ^ (-d)) := by ring
          _ = |θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| * 1 := by
              rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h_pi_ne, hε_mul_inv d]
          _ = |θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| := mul_one _
      linarith
    let m_e := dyadicTimeLevel ε e
    have he_nn : 0 ≤ e := le_trans hd hde
    have h_mid_approx : ∀ θ : ℝ, θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
        |(((angBin ε e θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹) - θ| ≤
          (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d := by
      intro θ hθ
      have hke_fl := (h_ab_floor e θ hθ).1
      have h_lo : (angBin ε e θ : ℝ) ≤ (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e := by
        rw [hke_fl]; exact Int.floor_le _
      have h_hi : (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e < (angBin ε e θ : ℝ) + 1 := by
        rw [hke_fl]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e := by positivity
      have h_half : |(angBin ε e θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have h_eq_diff : (((angBin ε e θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹) - θ =
          ((angBin ε e θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e) *
            (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹) := by
        have hpow_ne : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpow_pos
        field_simp [h_pi_ne, hpow_ne]
      have h_inv_le : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ d := by
        have h_tl_e := (h_tl e he_nn).1
        have h_inv1 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹ ≤ (ε ^ (-e))⁻¹ :=
          inv_anti₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-e)) h_tl_e
        rw [← Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le, neg_neg] at h_inv1
        exact le_trans h_inv1 (hε_anti hde)
      rw [h_eq_diff, abs_mul,
        abs_of_pos (mul_pos Real.pi_pos (inv_pos.mpr hpow_pos))]
      calc |(angBin ε e θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (θ / Real.pi) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_e| *
            (Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹)
          ≤ (1 / 2) * (Real.pi * ε ^ d) := by
            refine mul_le_mul h_half ?_ (by positivity) (by norm_num)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_le Real.pi_pos.le
        _ = (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d := by ring
    let φ₁ : ℝ := ((angBin ε e θ₁ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹
    let φ₂ : ℝ := ((angBin ε e θ₂ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_e)⁻¹
    have hφ₁ := h_mid_approx θ₁ hθ₁
    have hφ₂ := h_mid_approx θ₂ hθ₂
    have h_phi_diff : |φ₁ - (φ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| ≤ 12 * ε ^ d := by
      have h_tri : |φ₁ - (φ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| ≤
          |φ₁ - θ₁| + |θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)| + |φ₂ - θ₂| := by
        have h_split : φ₁ - (φ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi) =
            (φ₁ - θ₁) + (θ₁ - (θ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi)) + (θ₂ - φ₂) := by ring
        rw [h_split]
        refine le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) ?_
        rw [abs_sub_comm θ₂ φ₂]
        exact add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl
      have h_3pi : 3 * Real.pi * ε ^ d ≤ 12 * ε ^ d :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [Real.pi_lt_four])
          (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ d).le
      linarith
    have h_inner_sin : inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε e (angBin ε e θ₁))
        (perp2D (angUnitVec ε e (angBin ε e θ₂))) = Real.sin (φ₁ - φ₂) := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.sin_sub]
      simp [angUnitVec, perp2D, φ₁, φ₂, m_e]
      ring
    have h_sin_shift : |Real.sin (φ₁ - φ₂)| = |Real.sin (φ₁ - (φ₂ + (n : ℝ) * Real.pi))| := by
      rcases hn_cases with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have h_arg : φ₁ - (φ₂ + ((-1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.pi) = (φ₁ - φ₂) + Real.pi := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_arg, Real.sin_add_pi, abs_neg]
      · have h_arg : φ₁ - (φ₂ + ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.pi) = φ₁ - φ₂ := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_arg]
      · have h_arg : φ₁ - (φ₂ + ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.pi) = (φ₁ - φ₂) - Real.pi := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_arg, Real.sin_sub_pi, abs_neg]
    rw [h_inner_sin, h_sin_shift]
    exact le_trans Real.abs_sin_le_abs h_phi_diff

  
  
  
  have h_perp_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖perp2D v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    have h_sq : ‖perp2D v‖ ^ 2 = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [perp2D]
      ring
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp h_sq

  have h_unit_norm : ∀ (e : ℝ) (k : ℤ), ‖angUnitVec ε e k‖ = 1 := by
    intro e k
    have h_sq : ‖angUnitVec ε e k‖ ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [angUnitVec]
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).mp h_sq

  have h_traj : ∀ (e : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (V A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_m : ℝ),
      ‖V‖ ≤ 1 → ‖A‖ ≤ 1 → c_m ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      let u_dir := angUnitVec ε e k
      let x_p := A + c_m • V
      |inner ℝ V u_dir| ≤ 1 ∧ |inner ℝ V (perp2D u_dir)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |inner ℝ x_p u_dir| ≤ 2 ∧ |inner ℝ x_p (perp2D u_dir)| ≤ 2 := by
    intro e k V A c_m hV hA hc_m u_dir x_p
    have hu : ‖u_dir‖ = 1 := h_unit_norm e k
    have hpu : ‖perp2D u_dir‖ = 1 := (h_perp_norm u_dir).trans hu
    have hxp : ‖x_p‖ ≤ 2 := by
      dsimp only [x_p]
      calc ‖A + c_m • V‖
          ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖c_m • V‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖A‖ + |c_m| * ‖V‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ = ‖A‖ + c_m * ‖V‖ := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hc_m.1]
        _ ≤ 1 + 1 * 1 := add_le_add hA (mul_le_mul hc_m.2 hV (norm_nonneg V) zero_le_one)
        _ = 2 := by norm_num
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc |inner ℝ V u_dir| ≤ ‖V‖ * ‖u_dir‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ = ‖V‖ := by rw [hu, mul_one]
        _ ≤ 1 := hV
    · calc |inner ℝ V (perp2D u_dir)| ≤ ‖V‖ * ‖perp2D u_dir‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ = ‖V‖ := by rw [hpu, mul_one]
        _ ≤ 1 := hV
    · calc |inner ℝ x_p u_dir| ≤ ‖x_p‖ * ‖u_dir‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ = ‖x_p‖ := by rw [hu, mul_one]
        _ ≤ 2 := hxp
    · calc |inner ℝ x_p (perp2D u_dir)| ≤ ‖x_p‖ * ‖perp2D u_dir‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ = ‖x_p‖ := by rw [hpu, mul_one]
        _ ≤ 2 := hxp

  have h_rot : ∀ (u₁ u₂ W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖u₁‖ = 1 → ‖u₂‖ = 1 →
      |inner ℝ W u₂| ≤ |inner ℝ W u₁| + |inner ℝ W (perp2D u₁)| ∧
      |inner ℝ W (perp2D u₂)| ≤
        |inner ℝ W u₁| * |inner ℝ u₁ (perp2D u₂)| + |inner ℝ W (perp2D u₁)| ∧
      |inner ℝ W (perp2D u₂)| ≤ |inner ℝ W u₁| + |inner ℝ W (perp2D u₁)| := by
    intro u₁ u₂ W hu₁ hu₂
    have hu₁_sq : (u₁ 0) ^ 2 + (u₁ 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (β := fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) u₁
      rw [hu₁, one_pow, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        sq_abs, sq_abs] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have hW_decomp : W = inner ℝ W u₁ • u₁ + inner ℝ W (perp2D u₁) • perp2D u₁ := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, perp2D]
        linear_combination -W 0 * hu₁_sq
      · simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, perp2D]
        linear_combination -W 1 * hu₁_sq
    have hpu₁ : ‖perp2D u₁‖ = 1 := (h_perp_norm u₁).trans hu₁
    have hpu₂ : ‖perp2D u₂‖ = 1 := (h_perp_norm u₂).trans hu₂
    have h_gen : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ = 1 →
        |inner ℝ W v| ≤ |inner ℝ W u₁| * |inner ℝ u₁ v| + |inner ℝ W (perp2D u₁)| := by
      intro v hv
      have h_exp : inner ℝ W v =
          inner ℝ W u₁ * inner ℝ u₁ v +
          inner ℝ W (perp2D u₁) * inner ℝ (perp2D u₁) v := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hW_decomp]
        rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]
      have h_cs : |inner ℝ (perp2D u₁) v| ≤ 1 := by
        calc |inner ℝ (perp2D u₁) v| ≤ ‖perp2D u₁‖ * ‖v‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ = 1 := by rw [hpu₁, hv, mul_one]
      rw [h_exp]
      refine le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      refine add_le_add le_rfl ?_
      calc |inner ℝ W (perp2D u₁)| * |inner ℝ (perp2D u₁) v|
          ≤ |inner ℝ W (perp2D u₁)| * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cs (abs_nonneg _)

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ) :
    (∀ (u_min η_lb : ℝ), 0 < u_min → u_min ≤ 1 → 0 < η_lb →
      ∃ ε_lb : ℝ, 0 < ε_lb ∧ ε_lb < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε u b a : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
          (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s θ_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
          0 < ε → ε < ε_lb → u_min ≤ u → u ≤ 1 →
          0 ≤ b → b ≤ a → a + u ≤ 1 + m →
          IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s →
          (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ_s ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
          -η_lb ≤ stdApertureDeficit ε γ (1 + m) u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_s) ∧
    (∀ (ε u : ℝ) {N_ω N_T M_Z : ℕ} {β : Type}
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (Z : Fin N_ω → Fin M_Z) (G : Fin N_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ M_Z →
      IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s →
      let p_Z : Fin M_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Z ω = z then π ω else 0
      let π_Z : Fin M_Z → Fin N_ω → ℝ :=
        fun z ω => if Z ω = z then π ω / p_Z z else 0
      let k_u : Fin N_ω → ℤ := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)
      (∀ z : Fin M_Z, 0 < p_Z z → IsUnitBallTimeLaw (π_Z z) V_part A_part c_s) ∧
      (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z *
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T (π_Z z) T_idx V_part A_part) ≤
        classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z ∧
      (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z *
          (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_idx G - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_idx k_u)) ≤
        (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G - 2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_u) -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z +
          (3 * Real.log (M_Z : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))

by
  have h_ell_pos : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε0 hε1
    have hgt : (2 : ℝ) < ε⁻¹ := by
      rw [lt_inv_comm₀ (by norm_num) hε0]
      linarith
    exact Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have h_cos_sin_frame : ∀ φ : ℝ,
      let e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ, Real.sin φ]
      ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ ‖perp2D e‖ = 1 ∧
      ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (m₁ m₂ : ℝ),
        inner ℝ (w - (m₁ • e + m₂ • perp2D e)) e = inner ℝ w e - m₁ ∧
        inner ℝ (w - (m₁ • e + m₂ • perp2D e)) (perp2D e) = inner ℝ w (perp2D e) - m₂ := by
    intro φ e
    have he_norm_sq : ‖e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [e, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
    have he_norm : ‖e‖ = 1 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg e, he_norm_sq]
    have hp_norm_sq : ‖perp2D e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [perp2D, e]
    have hp_norm : ‖perp2D e‖ = 1 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D e), hp_norm_sq]
    refine ⟨he_norm, hp_norm, fun w m₁ m₂ => ?_⟩
    have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    constructor
    · simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      dsimp [e, perp2D]
      linear_combination -m₁ * hcs
    · simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      dsimp [e, perp2D]
      linear_combination -m₂ * hcs
  have h_mi_mat : ∀ {N_ω N_T M : ℕ} (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      ∀ (T : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T) (Y : Fin N_ω → Fin M),
      finMutualInfo ε π T Y =
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ y : Fin M,
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T ω = tid ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0) *
            Real.log ((∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T ω = tid ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0) /
              ((∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T ω = tid then π ω else 0) *
               (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Y ω = y then π ω else 0)))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro N_ω N_T M ε hε0 hε1 π hπ_nn hπ_sum T Y
    set ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have hell : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos ε hε0 hε1
    have h_num : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ y : Fin M,
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T ω = tid ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0) *
            Real.log ((∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T ω = tid ∧ Y ω = y then π ω else 0) /
              ((∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T ω = tid then π ω else 0) *
               (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Y ω = y then π ω else 0)))) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω *
