      let a_fn : ∀ z, Fin (N_fn z) → ℝ := fun z => (c_fn z).2.2.1
      let e_fn : ∀ z, Fin (N_fn z) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun z => (c_fn z).2.2.2.1
      let V_fn : ∀ z, Fin (N_fn z) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun z => (c_fn z).2.2.2.2.1
      let A_fn : ∀ z, Fin (N_fn z) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun z => (c_fn z).2.2.2.2.2.1
      let q_fn : ∀ z, Fin N_T → Fin (N_fn z) → ℝ := fun z => (c_fn z).2.2.2.2.2.2
      let Idx := Σ z : Fin M_Z, Fin (N_fn z)
      let N_gl : ℕ := Fintype.card Idx
      let e_gl : Idx ≃ Fin N_gl := Fintype.equivFin Idx
      let B_gl : Fin N_gl → ℝ := fun idx => b_fn (e_gl.symm idx).1 (e_gl.symm idx).2
      let A_gl : Fin N_gl → ℝ := fun idx => a_fn (e_gl.symm idx).1 (e_gl.symm idx).2
      let E_gl : Fin N_gl → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        fun idx => e_fn (e_gl.symm idx).1 (e_gl.symm idx).2
      let V_gl : Fin N_gl → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        fun idx => V_fn (e_gl.symm idx).1 (e_gl.symm idx).2
      let X_gl : Fin N_gl → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        fun idx => A_fn (e_gl.symm idx).1 (e_gl.symm idx).2
      let Q : Fin N_T → Fin N_gl → ℝ :=
        fun tid idx => p_Z (e_gl.symm idx).1 * q_fn (e_gl.symm idx).1 tid (e_gl.symm idx).2
      have h_sum_gl : ∀ g : Idx → ℝ,
          (∑ idx : Fin N_gl, g (e_gl.symm idx)) =
            ∑ z : Fin M_Z, ∑ d : Fin (N_fn z), g ⟨z, d⟩ := by
        intro g
        rw [Equiv.sum_comp e_gl.symm g, Fintype.sum_sigma]
      let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
      let p_Tz : Fin M_Z → Fin N_T → ℝ :=
        fun z tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π_Z z ω else 0
      let p_TZ : Fin N_T → Fin M_Z → ℝ :=
        fun tid z => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z then π ω else 0
      have hp_Tz_eq : ∀ (z : Fin M_Z) (tid : Fin N_T),
          p_Tz z tid = p_TZ tid z / p_Z z := by
        intro z tid
        dsimp only [p_Tz, p_TZ, π_Z]
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases hz : Z ω = z <;> simp [ht, hz]
      have h_z_marg : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (z : Fin M_Z),
          p_Z z * (∑ d : Fin (N_fn z), q_fn z tid d) = p_TZ tid z := by
        intro tid z
        by_cases hpz : 0 < p_Z z
        · have hq_eq : ∑ d : Fin (N_fn z), q_fn z tid d = p_Tz z tid :=
            ((hc_spec z).2.2 hpz).1 tid
          rw [hq_eq, hp_Tz_eq z tid, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpz.ne']
        · have hpz0 : p_Z z = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpz) (hp_Z_nn z)
          rw [hpz0, zero_mul]
          symm
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω _ => ?_)
          by_cases h : T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z
          · rw [if_pos h]
            have h_le : π ω ≤ p_Z z := by
              have hs := Finset.single_le_sum
                (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => if Z ω' = z then π ω' else 0)
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
                (Finset.mem_univ ω)
              simpa [h.2] using hs
            exact le_antisymm (h_le.trans hpz0.le) (h_law.1 ω)
          · exact if_neg h
      have hQ_marg : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ idx : Fin N_gl, Q tid idx = p_T tid := by
        intro tid
        dsimp only [Q]
        rw [h_sum_gl (fun zd => p_Z zd.1 * q_fn zd.1 tid zd.2)]
        simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, h_z_marg tid]
        dsimp only [p_TZ, p_T]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Z ω)]
        · by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> simp [ht]
        · intro z _ hne
          exact if_neg (fun hc => hne hc.2.symm)
        · intro h_abs
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h_abs
      let q_D_fn : ∀ z, Fin (N_fn z) → ℝ := fun z d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_fn z tid d
      let Q_D : Fin N_gl → ℝ := fun idx => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, Q tid idx
      have hQ_D_eq : ∀ idx : Fin N_gl,
          Q_D idx = p_Z (e_gl.symm idx).1 * q_D_fn (e_gl.symm idx).1 (e_gl.symm idx).2 := by
        intro idx
        dsimp only [Q_D, Q, q_D_fn]
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      let E_w_z : Fin M_Z → ℝ := fun z =>
        ∑ d : Fin (N_fn z), q_D_fn z d * ((1 + γ) * b_fn z d + (1 - γ) * a_fn z d)
      let I_TD_z : Fin M_Z → ℝ := fun z =>
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin (N_fn z),
          q_fn z tid d * Real.log (q_fn z tid d / (p_Tz z tid * q_D_fn z d))) / ell
      have h_ew_gl : (∑ idx : Fin N_gl, Q_D idx * ((1 + γ) * B_gl idx + (1 - γ) * A_gl idx)) =
          ∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * E_w_z z := by
        simp_rw [hQ_D_eq]
        dsimp only [B_gl, A_gl]
        rw [h_sum_gl (fun zd =>
          (p_Z zd.1 * q_D_fn zd.1 zd.2) * ((1 + γ) * b_fn zd.1 zd.2 + (1 - γ) * a_fn zd.1 zd.2))]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [E_w_z]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => by ring)
      have h_itd_gl : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ idx : Fin N_gl,
          Q tid idx * Real.log (Q tid idx / (p_T tid * Q_D idx))) / ell =
          (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * I_TD_z z) + finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z := by
        have h_tid_z : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (z : Fin M_Z),
            (∑ d : Fin (N_fn z),
              (p_Z z * q_fn z tid d) *
                Real.log ((p_Z z * q_fn z tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_Z z * q_D_fn z d)))) =
            p_Z z * (∑ d : Fin (N_fn z),
              q_fn z tid d * Real.log (q_fn z tid d / (p_Tz z tid * q_D_fn z d))) +
            p_TZ tid z * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) := by
          intro tid z
          by_cases hptz : 0 < p_TZ tid z
          · have hpz : 0 < p_Z z := by
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le hptz ?_
              dsimp only [p_TZ, p_Z]
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
              by_cases h : T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z
              · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h.2]
              · rw [if_neg h]
                split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω; exact le_rfl]
            have hpt : 0 < p_T tid := by
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le hptz ?_
              dsimp only [p_TZ, p_T]
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
              by_cases h : T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z
              · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h.1]
              · rw [if_neg h]
                split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω; exact le_rfl]
            have hptz_div : 0 < p_Tz z tid := by
              rw [hp_Tz_eq z tid]
              exact div_pos hptz hpz
            have h_rhs2 : p_TZ tid z * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) =
                ∑ d : Fin (N_fn z),
                  (p_Z z * q_fn z tid d) * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, h_z_marg tid z]
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, h_rhs2, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
            by_cases hq0 : q_fn z tid d = 0
            · simp [hq0]
            · have hq_pos : 0 < q_fn z tid d :=
                lt_of_le_of_ne ((hc_spec z).2.1 tid d) (Ne.symm hq0)
              have hqd_pos : 0 < q_D_fn z d :=
                lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
                  (Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => (hc_spec z).2.1 tid' d)
                    (Finset.mem_univ tid))
              have hr1_ne : q_fn z tid d / (p_Tz z tid * q_D_fn z d) ≠ 0 :=
                div_ne_zero hq_pos.ne' (mul_ne_zero hptz_div.ne' hqd_pos.ne')
              have hr2_ne : p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z) ≠ 0 :=
                div_ne_zero hptz.ne' (mul_ne_zero hpt.ne' hpz.ne')
              have h_prod : (p_Z z * q_fn z tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_Z z * q_D_fn z d)) =
                  (q_fn z tid d / (p_Tz z tid * q_D_fn z d)) *
                    (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) := by
                rw [hp_Tz_eq z tid]
                have hpz_ne := hpz.ne'
                have hpt_ne := hpt.ne'
                have hptz_ne := hptz.ne'
                have hqd_ne := hqd_pos.ne'
                field_simp [hpz_ne, hpt_ne, hptz_ne, hqd_ne]
              rw [h_prod, Real.log_mul hr1_ne hr2_ne]
              ring
          · have hptz_nn : 0 ≤ p_TZ tid z :=
              Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω; exact le_rfl])
            have hptz0 : p_TZ tid z = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hptz) hptz_nn
            rw [hptz0, zero_mul, add_zero]
            by_cases hpz : 0 < p_Z z
            · have h_sum_q0 : ∑ d : Fin (N_fn z), q_fn z tid d = 0 := by
                have h1 := h_z_marg tid z
                rw [hptz0] at h1
                exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left hpz.ne'
              have hq_all0 : ∀ d : Fin (N_fn z), q_fn z tid d = 0 := by
                intro d
                have hle : q_fn z tid d ≤ ∑ d' : Fin (N_fn z), q_fn z tid d' :=
                  Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => (hc_spec z).2.1 tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d)
                exact le_antisymm (hle.trans h_sum_q0.le) ((hc_spec z).2.1 tid d)
              simp [hq_all0]
            · have hpz0 : p_Z z = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpz) (hp_Z_nn z)
              simp [hpz0]
        have h_inner_tid : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
            (∑ idx : Fin N_gl, Q tid idx * Real.log (Q tid idx / (p_T tid * Q_D idx))) =
            (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * (∑ d : Fin (N_fn z),
              q_fn z tid d * Real.log (q_fn z tid d / (p_Tz z tid * q_D_fn z d)))) +
            (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_TZ tid z * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z))) := by
          intro tid
          simp_rw [hQ_D_eq]
          dsimp only [Q]
          rw [h_sum_gl (fun zd =>
            (p_Z zd.1 * q_fn zd.1 tid zd.2) *
              Real.log ((p_Z zd.1 * q_fn zd.1 tid zd.2) /
                (p_T tid * (p_Z zd.1 * q_D_fn zd.1 zd.2))))]
          simp_rw [h_tid_z tid]
          exact Finset.sum_add_distrib
        simp_rw [h_inner_tid]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div]
        congr 1
        · rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
          simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          dsimp only [I_TD_z]
          rw [mul_div_assoc]
        · exact (h_mi_mat ε hε0 hε1 π h_law.1 h_law.2.1 T_idx Z).symm
      have hQ_mem : (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * (E_w_z z - I_TD_z z)) -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z ∈ RootSet π := by
        refine ⟨N_gl, B_gl, A_gl, E_gl, V_gl, X_gl, Q, ?_, ?_, hQ_marg, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro idx
          exact (hc_spec (e_gl.symm idx).1).1 (e_gl.symm idx).2
        · intro tid idx
          exact mul_nonneg (hp_Z_nn _) ((hc_spec _).2.1 tid _)
        · intro tid idx hQ_pos
          dsimp only [Q] at hQ_pos
          have hpz : 0 < p_Z (e_gl.symm idx).1 := by
            by_contra h_not
            have hp0 : p_Z (e_gl.symm idx).1 = 0 :=
              le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_not) (hp_Z_nn _)
            rw [hp0, zero_mul] at hQ_pos
            exact lt_irrefl 0 hQ_pos
          have hq_pos : 0 < q_fn (e_gl.symm idx).1 tid (e_gl.symm idx).2 :=
            (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hpz).mp hQ_pos
          exact ((hc_spec (e_gl.symm idx).1).2.2 hpz).2.1 tid (e_gl.symm idx).2 hq_pos
        · change (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * (E_w_z z - I_TD_z z)) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z =
            (∑ idx : Fin N_gl, Q_D idx * ((1 + γ) * B_gl idx + (1 - γ) * A_gl idx)) -
              (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ idx : Fin N_gl,
                Q tid idx * Real.log (Q tid idx / (p_T tid * Q_D idx))) / ell
          rw [h_ew_gl, h_itd_gl]
          have h_sub_sum : (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * E_w_z z) -
              (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * I_TD_z z) =
              ∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * (E_w_z z - I_TD_z z) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => by ring)
          linarith [h_sub_sum]
      have h_le_sup : (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * (E_w_z z - I_TD_z z)) -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z ≤
          classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part :=
        le_csSup (h_root_props π h_law).2 hQ_mem
      have h_pt_z : ∀ z : Fin M_Z,
          p_Z z * classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T (π_Z z) T_idx V_part A_part ≤
            p_Z z * (E_w_z z - I_TD_z z) + p_Z z * δ := by
        intro z
        by_cases hpz : 0 < p_Z z
        · have h_opt := ((hc_spec z).2.2 hpz).2.2
          have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_opt hpz.le
          linarith
        · have hpz0 : p_Z z = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpz) (hp_Z_nn z)
          simp [hpz0]
      have h_sum_z := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z (_ : z ∈ Finset.univ) => h_pt_z z)
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp_Z_sum, one_mul] at h_sum_z
      dsimp only [L] at h_le_sup h_sum_z
      linarith
    have h_info_split :
        (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z *
            (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_idx G - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_idx k_u)) ≤
          (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G - 2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_u) -
            finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z +
            (3 * Real.log (M_Z : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      have h_cond_split : ∀ {ξ η : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → ξ) (Y : Fin N_ω → η),
          (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) X Y) =
            finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) Y := by
        intro ξ η X Y
        unfold finCondEntropy
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Z ω)]
        · by_cases hπ0 : π ω = 0
          · dsimp only [π_Z]
            simp [hπ0]
          · have hπ_pos : 0 < π ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (h_law.1 ω) (Ne.symm hπ0)
            have hpz_pos : 0 < p_Z (Z ω) := by
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le hπ_pos ?_
              have hs := Finset.single_le_sum
                (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => if Z ω' = Z ω then π ω' else 0)
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
                (Finset.mem_univ ω)
              simpa using hs
            have h_w : p_Z (Z ω) * π_Z (Z ω) ω = π ω := by
              dsimp only [π_Z]
              rw [if_pos rfl, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpz_pos.ne']
            have h_p2 : finProbAt2 (π_Z (Z ω)) X Y ω =
                finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', Z ω')) Y ω / p_Z (Z ω) := by
              unfold finProbAt2
              dsimp only [π_Z]
              rw [Finset.sum_div]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases hXY : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω <;> by_cases hZ : Z ω' = Z ω
              · rw [if_pos hXY, if_pos hZ, if_pos ⟨Prod.ext hXY.1 hZ, hXY.2⟩]
              · rw [if_pos hXY, if_neg hZ,
                  if_neg (fun hc => hZ (congr_arg Prod.snd hc.1)), zero_div]
              · rw [if_neg hXY,
                  if_neg (fun hc => hXY ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst hc.1, hc.2⟩), zero_div]
              · rw [if_neg hXY,
                  if_neg (fun hc => hXY ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst hc.1, hc.2⟩), zero_div]
            have h_p1 : finProbAt (π_Z (Z ω)) X ω =
                finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', Z ω')) ω / p_Z (Z ω) := by
              unfold finProbAt
              dsimp only [π_Z]
              rw [Finset.sum_div]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hZ : Z ω' = Z ω
              · rw [if_pos hX, if_pos hZ, if_pos (Prod.ext hX hZ)]
              · rw [if_pos hX, if_neg hZ,
                  if_neg (fun hc => hZ (congr_arg Prod.snd hc)), zero_div]
              · rw [if_neg hX, if_neg (fun hc => hX (congr_arg Prod.fst hc)), zero_div]
              · rw [if_neg hX, if_neg (fun hc => hX (congr_arg Prod.fst hc)), zero_div]
            rw [← mul_assoc, h_w]
            congr 1
            unfold condSurprise
            rw [h_p2, h_p1, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hpz_pos.ne']
        · intro z _ hne
          dsimp only [π_Z]
          rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hne), zero_mul, mul_zero]
        · intro h_abs
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h_abs
      have h_unit_fst : ∀ {ξ η : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → ξ) (Y : Fin N_ω → η),
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((), X ω)) Y = finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
        intro ξ η X Y
        unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        have h1 : finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => ((), X ω')) Y ω = finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          dsimp only
          by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω
          · rw [if_pos ⟨Prod.ext rfl h.1, h.2⟩, if_pos h]
          · rw [if_neg (fun hc => h ⟨congr_arg Prod.snd hc.1, hc.2⟩), if_neg h]
        have h2 : finProbAt π (fun ω' => ((), X ω')) ω = finProbAt π X ω := by
          unfold finProbAt
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          dsimp only
          by_cases h : X ω' = X ω <;> simp [h]
        rw [h1, h2]
      have h_chain_symm : ∀ {ξ η₁ η₂ : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → ξ)
          (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → η₁) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → η₂),
          finCondEntropy ε π X Y₁ + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y₁ ω)) Y₂ =
            finCondEntropy ε π X Y₂ + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y₂ ω)) Y₁ := by
        have h_joint : ∀ {ξ η₁ η₂ : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → ξ)
            (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → η₁) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → η₂),
            finCondEntropy ε π X Y₁ + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y₁ ω)) Y₂ =
              finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω => (Y₁ ω, Y₂ ω)) := by
          intro ξ η₁ η₂ X Y₁ Y₂
          unfold finCondEntropy
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          by_cases hπ0 : π ω = 0
          · simp [hπ0]
          · have hπ_pos : 0 < π ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (h_law.1 ω) (Ne.symm hπ0)
            have h_eq_p1 : finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y₁ ω')) ω = finProbAt2 π X Y₁ ω := by
              unfold finProbAt finProbAt2
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω
              · rw [if_pos (Prod.ext h.1 h.2), if_pos h]
              · rw [if_neg (fun hc => h ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst hc, congr_arg Prod.snd hc⟩), if_neg h]
            have h_eq_p2 : finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y₁ ω')) Y₂ ω =
                finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y₁ ω', Y₂ ω')) ω := by
              unfold finProbAt2
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω ∧ Y₂ ω' = Y₂ ω
              · rw [if_pos ⟨Prod.ext h.1 h.2.1, h.2.2⟩,
                  if_pos ⟨h.1, Prod.ext h.2.1 h.2.2⟩]
              · rw [if_neg (fun hc => h ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst hc.1, congr_arg Prod.snd hc.1, hc.2⟩),
                  if_neg (fun hc => h ⟨hc.1, congr_arg Prod.fst hc.2, congr_arg Prod.snd hc.2⟩)]
            have hp3_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y₁ ω', Y₂ ω')) ω := by
              unfold finProbAt2
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
                (Finset.mem_univ ω))
              simp [hπ_pos]
            have hp2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Y₁ ω := by
              unfold finProbAt2
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
                (Finset.mem_univ ω))
              simp [hπ_pos]
            have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := by
              unfold finProbAt
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
                (Finset.mem_univ ω))
              simp [hπ_pos]
            unfold condSurprise
            rw [h_eq_p1, h_eq_p2]
            have h_mul : (finProbAt2 π X Y₁ ω / finProbAt π X ω) *
                (finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y₁ ω', Y₂ ω')) ω / finProbAt2 π X Y₁ ω) =
                finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y₁ ω', Y₂ ω')) ω / finProbAt π X ω :=
              div_mul_div_cancel₀' hp2_pos.ne' _ _
            have h_log := Real.log_mul
              (div_ne_zero hp2_pos.ne' hp1_pos.ne')
              (div_ne_zero hp3_pos.ne' hp2_pos.ne')
            rw [h_mul] at h_log
            rw [h_log]
            ring
        intro ξ η₁ η₂ X Y₁ Y₂
        rw [h_joint X Y₁ Y₂, h_joint X Y₂ Y₁]
        unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        have h_swap : finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y₁ ω', Y₂ ω')) ω =
            finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y₂ ω', Y₁ ω')) ω := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω ∧ Y₂ ω' = Y₂ ω
          · rw [if_pos ⟨h.1, Prod.ext h.2.1 h.2.2⟩,
              if_pos ⟨h.1, Prod.ext h.2.2 h.2.1⟩]
          · rw [if_neg (fun hc => h ⟨hc.1, congr_arg Prod.fst hc.2, congr_arg Prod.snd hc.2⟩),
              if_neg (fun hc => h ⟨hc.1, congr_arg Prod.snd hc.2, congr_arg Prod.fst hc.2⟩)]
        rw [h_swap]
      have h_Z_bounds : ∀ {ξ : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → ξ),
          0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Z ∧
          finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤ Real.log (M_Z : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        intro ξ X
        have hM_pos : 0 < (M_Z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hM_Z
        constructor
        · unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
          refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
          by_cases hπ0 : π ω = 0
          · simp [hπ0]
          · have hπ_pos : 0 < π ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (h_law.1 ω) (Ne.symm hπ0)
            have hp2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Z ω := by
              unfold finProbAt2
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum
                (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
                (Finset.mem_univ ω))
              simp [hπ_pos]
            have hp2_le_p1 : finProbAt2 π X Z ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
              unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω
              · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h.1]
              · rw [if_neg h]
                split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl]
            have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_pos hp2_le_p1
            have h_div_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω :=
              div_pos hp2_pos hp1_pos
            have h_div_le1 : finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω ≤ 1 :=
              (div_le_one hp1_pos).mpr hp2_le_p1
            have h_log_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω) ≤ 0 :=
              Real.log_nonpos h_div_pos.le h_div_le1
            exact mul_nonneg hπ_pos.le (div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr h_log_np) hell.le)
        · change finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤ Real.log (M_Z : ℝ) / ell
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hell]
          have h_lhs_eq : finCondEntropy ε π X Z * ell =
              ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω)) := by
            unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            change (π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω) / ell)) * ell = _
            rw [mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell.ne']
          rw [h_lhs_eq]
          have h_pt : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
              π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω) - Real.log (M_Z : ℝ)) ≤
                (M_Z : ℝ)⁻¹ * (π ω * finProbAt π X ω / finProbAt2 π X Z ω) - π ω := by
            intro ω
            by_cases hπ0 : π ω = 0
            · simp [hπ0]
            · have hπ_pos : 0 < π ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (h_law.1 ω) (Ne.symm hπ0)
              have hp2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Z ω := by
                unfold finProbAt2
                refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum
                  (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
                  (Finset.mem_univ ω))
                simp [hπ_pos]
              have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := by
                unfold finProbAt
                refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum
                  (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
                  (Finset.mem_univ ω))
                simp [hπ_pos]
              let u_val := finProbAt π X ω / ((M_Z : ℝ) * finProbAt2 π X Z ω)
              have hu_pos : 0 < u_val := div_pos hp1_pos (mul_pos hM_pos hp2_pos)
              have h_log_id : -Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω) -
                  Real.log (M_Z : ℝ) = Real.log u_val := by
                dsimp only [u_val]
                rw [Real.log_div hp2_pos.ne' hp1_pos.ne',
                  Real.log_div hp1_pos.ne' (mul_ne_zero hM_pos.ne' hp2_pos.ne'),
                  Real.log_mul hM_pos.ne' hp2_pos.ne']
                ring
              have h_le : Real.log u_val ≤ u_val - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu_pos
              rw [h_log_id]
              have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le hπ_pos.le
              have h_alg : π ω * (u_val - 1) =
                  (M_Z : ℝ)⁻¹ * (π ω * finProbAt π X ω / finProbAt2 π X Z ω) - π ω := by
                dsimp only [u_val]
                field_simp [hM_pos.ne', hp2_pos.ne']
              linarith
          have h_ratio_sum :
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * finProbAt π X ω / finProbAt2 π X Z ω) ≤ (M_Z : ℝ) := by
            letI : DecidableEq ξ := Classical.decEq ξ
            let A : Finset ξ := Finset.univ.image X
            let P_X : ξ → ℝ := fun x => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = x then π ω' else 0
            let P_XZ : ξ → Fin M_Z → ℝ :=
              fun x z => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = x ∧ Z ω' = z then π ω' else 0
            have hP_X_nn : ∀ x : ξ, 0 ≤ P_X x :=
              fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact h_law.1 ω'; exact le_rfl])
            have hP_X_sum : ∑ x ∈ A, P_X x = 1 := by
              dsimp only [P_X]
              rw [Finset.sum_comm]
              have h_in : ∀ ω' : Fin N_ω, (∑ x ∈ A, if X ω' = x then π ω' else 0) = π ω' := by
                intro ω'
                rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (X ω')]
                · simp
                · intro x _ hne
                  exact if_neg (Ne.symm hne)
                · intro h_abs
                  exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem X (Finset.mem_univ ω')) h_abs
              simp_rw [h_in]
              exact h_law.2.1
            have h_expand_ω : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
                π ω * finProbAt π X ω / finProbAt2 π X Z ω =
                  ∑ x ∈ A, ∑ z : Fin M_Z,
                    if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω * (P_X x / P_XZ x z) else 0 := by
              intro ω
              rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (X ω)]
              · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Z ω)]
                · rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩]
                  have h1 : finProbAt π X ω = P_X (X ω) := by
                    unfold finProbAt
                    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
                    by_cases h : X ω' = X ω <;> simp [h]
                  have h2 : finProbAt2 π X Z ω = P_XZ (X ω) (Z ω) := by
                    unfold finProbAt2
                    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
                    by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω <;> simp [h]
                  rw [h1, h2, mul_div_assoc]
                · intro z _ hne
                  exact if_neg (fun hc => hne hc.2.symm)
                · intro h_abs
                  exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h_abs
              · intro x _ hne
                refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun z _ => ?_)
                exact if_neg (fun hc => hne hc.1.symm)
              · intro h_abs
                exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem X (Finset.mem_univ ω)) h_abs
            simp_rw [h_expand_ω]
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            have h_swap_sum : (∑ x ∈ A, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ z : Fin M_Z,
                if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω * (P_X x / P_XZ x z) else 0) =
                ∑ x ∈ A, ∑ z : Fin M_Z, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
                  if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω * (P_X x / P_XZ x z) else 0 :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => Finset.sum_comm)
            rw [h_swap_sum]
            calc ∑ x ∈ A, ∑ z : Fin M_Z, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
                  (if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω * (P_X x / P_XZ x z) else 0)
                ≤ ∑ x ∈ A, ∑ _z : Fin M_Z, P_X x := by
                  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z _ => ?_))
                  have h_fac : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
                      if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω * (P_X x / P_XZ x z) else 0) =
                      P_XZ x z * (P_X x / P_XZ x z) := by
                    dsimp only [P_XZ]
                    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
                    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
                    split_ifs <;> ring
                  rw [h_fac]
                  by_cases h0 : P_XZ x z = 0
                  · rw [h0, zero_mul]
                    exact hP_X_nn x
                  · rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ h0]
              _ = ∑ x ∈ A, (M_Z : ℝ) * P_X x := by
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
                  simp
              _ = (M_Z : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ A, P_X x := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
              _ = (M_Z : ℝ) := by rw [hP_X_sum, mul_one]
          have h_sum_pt := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω (_ : ω ∈ Finset.univ) => h_pt ω)
          have h_lhs_diff : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
              π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω) - Real.log (M_Z : ℝ))) =
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω))) -
                Real.log (M_Z : ℝ) := by
            simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, h_law.2.1, one_mul]
          have h_rhs_diff : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
              ((M_Z : ℝ)⁻¹ * (π ω * finProbAt π X ω / finProbAt2 π X Z ω) - π ω)) =
              (M_Z : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * finProbAt π X ω / finProbAt2 π X Z ω) - 1 := by
            rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, h_law.2.1]
          rw [h_lhs_diff, h_rhs_diff] at h_sum_pt
          have h_prod_le : (M_Z : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * finProbAt π X ω / finProbAt2 π X Z ω) ≤ 1 := by
            calc (M_Z : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * finProbAt π X ω / finProbAt2 π X Z ω)
                ≤ (M_Z : ℝ)⁻¹ * (M_Z : ℝ) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ratio_sum (inv_nonneg.mpr hM_pos.le)
              _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hM_pos.ne'
          linarith
      have h_mi_split : (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_idx G) =
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z +
            finCondEntropy ε π G Z - finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G ω)) Z := by
        unfold finMutualInfo
        simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        rw [h_cond_split (fun _ => ()) G, h_cond_split T_idx G, h_unit_fst Z G]
        have hc1 := h_chain_symm (fun _ => ()) G Z
        rw [h_unit_fst G Z, h_unit_fst Z G] at hc1
        have hc2 := h_chain_symm T_idx G Z
        linarith
      have h_ku_split : (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_idx k_u) =
          finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_u - finCondEntropy ε π T_idx Z +
            finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_u ω)) Z := by
        rw [h_cond_split T_idx k_u]
        have hc3 := h_chain_symm T_idx k_u Z
        linarith
      have h_lhs_comb : (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z *
          (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_idx G - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_idx k_u)) =
          (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_idx G) -
            2 * (∑ z : Fin M_Z, p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_idx k_u) := by
        have h_term : ∀ z : Fin M_Z,
            p_Z z * (finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_idx G - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_idx k_u) =
              p_Z z * finMutualInfo ε (π_Z z) T_idx G -
                2 * (p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (π_Z z) T_idx k_u) :=
          fun z => by ring
        simp_rw [h_term, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [h_lhs_comb, h_mi_split, h_ku_split]
      have hb_GZ := (h_Z_bounds G).2
      have hb_TGZ := (h_Z_bounds (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G ω))).1
      have hb_TZ := (h_Z_bounds T_idx).2
      have hb_TkZ := (h_Z_bounds (fun ω => (T_idx ω, k_u ω))).1
      have h_three : Real.log (M_Z : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) +
          2 * (Real.log (M_Z : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) =
          (3 * Real.log (M_Z : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by ring
      linarith
    exact ⟨h_law_Z, h_root_split, h_info_split⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m r t : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (hr_pos : 0 < r) (hrt : r < t) (ht_le : t ≤ 1)
    (δ_loc : ℝ) (hδ_loc : 0 < δ_loc) :
    ∃ ε_loc : ℝ, 0 < ε_loc ∧ ε_loc < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε b_t a_t : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < ε_loc →
        0 ≤ b_t → b_t ≤ a_t → a_t + t ≤ 1 + m →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s θ_t : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → θ_t ω ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
        ∃ (N_J : ℕ) (J : Fin N_ω → Fin N_J) (k_J : Fin N_J → ℤ)
          (v_J x_J : Fin N_J → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (V'_J A'_J : Fin N_J → Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          let p_J : Fin N_J → ℝ := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0
          let π_J : Fin N_J → Fin N_ω → ℝ :=
            fun j ω => if J ω = j then π ω / p_J j else 0
          let L' : ℝ := (a_t - b_t) + (t - r)
          let m_r : ℕ := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
          1 ≤ N_J ∧
          (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) = k_J (J ω)) ∧
          (∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T),
            ‖V'_J j tid‖ ≤ 10 ∧ ‖A'_J j tid‖ ≤ 10) ∧
          (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
            let j := J ω
            let tid := T_idx ω
            let X_r := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε r (c_s ω)) • V_part tid
            V_part tid - v_J j = (ε ^ b_t) • V'_J j tid ∧
            X_r - x_J j = (((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t) •
              (A'_J j tid + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V'_J j tid)) ∧
          stdApertureScore ε γ t b_t a_t π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_t ≤
            2 * b_t - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
              2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)) +
              (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
                classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) +
              classicalGrowthRate γ * (t - r) + δ_loc

  have htr_le_L' : t - r ≤ L' := by dsimp only [L']; linarith
  have hL'_le_K : L' ≤ 1 + m := by dsimp only [L']; linarith
  have hΔ_lo12 : (12 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ Δ_time := by
    refine le_trans ?_ hΔ_lo
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _)
  have hΔ_hi12 : Δ_time ≤ 12 * ε ^ (t - r) := by
    refine le_trans hΔ_hi ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _)
  have h_cell_est : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
      p_J j * classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G (π_J j) T_idx (k_sub j) G_idx
        (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => e_t) ≤
      p_J j * classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j) +
        p_J j * ((b₀ + δ_cl) * (t - r)) := by
    intro j
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hp_J_nn j) with hp0 | hp_pos
    · rw [← hp0]; simp
    · obtain ⟨hμ_nn, hμ_sum, hμ_supp⟩ := hπ_J_props j hp_pos
      let k'_G : Fin N_G → ℤ := fun g => kt_G g - k_J j * (2 : ℤ) ^ (m_t - m_r)
      have h_cl_j := h_est ε (t - r) L' Δ_time hε₀ hε_lt_ε0 le_rfl htr_le_L' hL'_le_K
        hΔ_lo12 hΔ_hi12 N_ω N_T N_G (π_J j) T_idx (k_sub j) G_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)
        (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => e_t) e_G (V'_G j) (X'_G j) k'_G
        hμ_nn hμ_sum
        (fun tid => ⟨by linarith [(h_bds_J j tid).1], by linarith [(h_bds_J j tid).2]⟩)
        (fun g => ⟨le_rfl, by dsimp only [e_t]; linarith,
          by dsimp only [e_t, L']; exact le_rfl, he_G_norm g⟩)
        (fun ω hω_j => by
          obtain ⟨hω_pos, hj_eq⟩ := hμ_supp ω hω_j
          obtain ⟨_, hc_mem, hv1, hv2, hx1, hx2⟩ := h_local_geom ω hω_pos
          have hkG_eq : k'_G (G_idx ω) = k_sub j ω := by
            dsimp only [k'_G, k_sub, k_t]
            rw [hkt_G ω]
          dsimp only [k_sub, k_t, e_t] at hc_mem hv1 hv2 hx1 hx2 ⊢
          rw [hj_eq] at hc_mem hv1 hv2 hx1 hx2
          exact ⟨hc_mem, hkG_eq, hv1, hv2, hx1, hx2⟩)
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cl_j hp_pos.le
      linarith
  have h_sum_est :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
        classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G (π_J j) T_idx (k_sub j) G_idx
          (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => e_t)) ≤
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
        classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) +
        (b₀ + δ_cl) * (t - r) := by
    calc (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
          classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G (π_J j) T_idx (k_sub j) G_idx
            (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => e_t))
        ≤ ∑ j : Fin N_J, (p_J j *
            classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j) +
            p_J j * ((b₀ + δ_cl) * (t - r))) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => h_cell_est j)
      _ = (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
            classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) +
          (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j) * ((b₀ + δ_cl) * (t - r)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
            classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) +
          (b₀ + δ_cl) * (t - r) := by rw [hp_J_sum, one_mul]
  have h_rate_err : (b₀ + δ_cl) * (t - r) < classicalGrowthRate γ * (t - r) + δ_loc / 2 := by
    have h1 : (b₀ + δ_cl) * (t - r) < (classicalGrowthRate γ + 2 * δ_cl) * (t - r) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith [hb₀_lt]) htr_pos
    have h2 : 2 * δ_cl * (t - r) = δ_loc / 2 := by
      dsimp only [δ_cl]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt htr_pos]
      ring
    linarith
  have h_wt_alg : (1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * a_t = 2 * b_t + (1 - γ) * e_t := by
    dsimp only [e_t]
    ring
  change stdApertureScore ε γ t b_t a_t π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_t ≤
    2 * b_t - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J + 2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_r +
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
        classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) +
      classicalGrowthRate γ * (t - r) + δ_loc
  unfold stdApertureScore
  change ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * a_t) - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_raw +
      2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_t ≤ _
  rw [h_wt_alg, h_mi_raw]
  unfold finMutualInfo
  linarith [h_sum_transport, h_sum_est, h_time_chain, h_uncond_JG, h_cond_TJG,
    h_cov_ent, h_log_tol, h_rate_err]

informal_problem.statement:
(ε γ L_glob r b_t L' η_comp : ℝ) {N_ω N_T N_J : ℕ}
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hr_pos : 0 < r) (hb_t : 0 ≤ b_t) (hL' : 0 ≤ L') (hη_comp : 0 < η_comp)
    (hNJ : 1 ≤ N_J)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (J : Fin N_ω → Fin N_J) (k_J : Fin N_J → ℤ)
    (v_J x_J : Fin N_J → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (V'_J A'_J : Fin N_J → Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (h_law : IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s)
    (hk_J : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) = k_J (J ω))
    (h_bds : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T), ‖V'_J j tid‖ ≤ 10 ∧ ‖A'_J j tid‖ ≤ 10)
    (h_rel : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
      let j := J ω
      let tid := T_idx ω
      let m_r := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
      let X_r := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε r (c_s ω)) • V_part tid
      V_part tid - v_J j = (ε ^ b_t) • V'_J j tid ∧
      X_r - x_J j = (((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t) •
        (A'_J j tid + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V'_J j tid)) :
    let p_J : Fin N_J → ℝ := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0
    let π_J : Fin N_J → Fin N_ω → ℝ :=
      fun j ω => if J ω = j then π ω / p_J j else 0
    ∃ (N_hat N_raw : ℕ)
      (proj_ω : Fin N_hat → Fin N_ω)
      (π_hat : Fin N_hat → ℝ)
      (D_hat : Fin N_hat → Fin N_raw)
      (k_D : Fin N_raw → ℤ)
      (b_raw a_raw φ_raw : Fin N_raw → ℝ)
      (V_glob X_glob : Fin N_raw → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      let T_hat : Fin N_hat → Fin N_T := fun ω_h => T_idx (proj_ω ω_h)
      let c_hat : Fin N_hat → ℝ := fun ω_h => c_s (proj_ω ω_h)
      1 ≤ N_raw ∧
      IsUnitBallTimeLaw π_hat V_part A_part c_hat ∧
      (∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat, 0 < π_hat ω_h → 0 < π (proj_ω ω_h)) ∧
      classicalRootSupremum ε L_glob γ N_hat N_T π_hat T_hat V_part A_part =
        classicalRootSupremum ε L_glob γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ∧
      (∀ (u b a : ℝ) (θ_ω : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        stdApertureDeficit ε γ L_glob u b a π_hat T_hat V_part A_part c_hat
          (fun ω_h => θ_ω (proj_ω ω_h)) =
        stdApertureDeficit ε γ L_glob u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_ω) ∧
      (∀ d_r : Fin N_raw,
        b_t ≤ b_raw d_r ∧ b_raw d_r ≤ a_raw d_r ∧ a_raw d_r ≤ b_t + L' ∧
        φ_raw d_r ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_hat ω_h) = k_D (D_hat ω_h)) ∧
      (∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat, 0 < π_hat ω_h →
        let tid := T_hat ω_h
        let d_r := D_hat ω_h
        let e_r := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos (φ_raw d_r), Real.sin (φ_raw d_r)]
        let X_r := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε r (c_hat ω_h)) • V_part tid
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_glob d_r) e_r| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_raw d_r) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_glob d_r) (perp2D e_r)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_raw d_r) ∧
        |inner ℝ (X_r - X_glob d_r) e_r| ≤ 15 * ε ^ (b_raw d_r + r) ∧
        |inner ℝ (X_r - X_glob d_r) (perp2D e_r)| ≤ 15 * ε ^ (a_raw d_r + r)) ∧
      (2 * b_t - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)) +
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
          classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) - η_comp ≤
      (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_hat ω_h *
          ((1 + γ) * b_raw (D_hat ω_h) + (1 - γ) * a_raw (D_hat ω_h))) -
        finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat D_hat +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π_hat T_hat (fun ω_h => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_hat ω_h)))
