proof.tactics:
by
  intro p_J π_J
  have hπ_nn : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 ≤ π ω := h_law.1
  have hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1 := h_law.2.1
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_joint : Fin N_J → Fin N_T → ℝ :=
    fun j tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j ∧ T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_TJ : Fin N_J → Fin N_T → ℝ :=
    fun j tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π_J j ω else 0

  
  have hp_J_nn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ p_J j :=
    fun j => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl)
  have hp_J_sum : ∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j = 1 := by
    dsimp only [p_J]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_in : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, (∑ j : Fin N_J, if J ω = j then π ω else 0) = π ω := by
      intro ω; simp
    simp_rw [h_in]
    exact hπ_sum
  have hp_joint_nn : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T), 0 ≤ p_joint j tid :=
    fun j tid => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl)
  have hp_joint_le_J : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T), p_joint j tid ≤ p_J j := by
    intro j tid
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases h1 : J ω = j <;> by_cases h2 : T_idx ω = tid <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω]
  have hp_joint_le_T : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T), p_joint j tid ≤ p_T tid := by
    intro j tid
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases h1 : J ω = j <;> by_cases h2 : T_idx ω = tid <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω]
  have hp_TJ_eq : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T), p_TJ j tid = p_joint j tid / p_J j := by
    intro j tid
    dsimp only [p_TJ, π_J, p_joint]
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases h1 : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases h2 : J ω = j <;> simp [h1, h2]
  have hp_TJ_nn : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T), 0 ≤ p_TJ j tid := by
    intro j tid
    rw [hp_TJ_eq]
    exact div_nonneg (hp_joint_nn j tid) (hp_J_nn j)
  have hp_TJ_sum : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < p_J j → ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_TJ j tid = 1 := by
    intro j hpj
    have h_sum_joint : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_joint j tid = p_J j := by
      dsimp only [p_joint, p_J]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hj : J ω = j <;> simp [hj]
    simp_rw [hp_TJ_eq, ← Finset.sum_div, h_sum_joint]
    exact div_self (ne_of_gt hpj)

  
  let canonAngle : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun e =>
    if 0 < e 1 then Real.arccos (e 0)
    else if e 1 < 0 then Real.arccos (-(e 0))
    else 0
  have h_perp_neg : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), perp2D (-e) = -perp2D e := by
    intro e
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D]
  have h_canon_angle : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      canonAngle e ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧
      ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        let e_til := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos (canonAngle e), Real.sin (canonAngle e)]
        |inner ℝ u e_til| = |inner ℝ u e| ∧
        |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_til)| = |inner ℝ u (perp2D e)| := by
    intro e he
    have h_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq e
      rw [he, one_pow, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have h_pm : canonAngle e ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧
        (WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos (canonAngle e), Real.sin (canonAngle e)] = e ∨
         WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos (canonAngle e), Real.sin (canonAngle e)] = -e) := by
      dsimp only [canonAngle]
      by_cases h_pos : 0 < e 1
      · rw [if_pos h_pos]
        have he1_sq : 0 < (e 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos h_pos
        have he0_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 < 1 := by linarith
        have he0_gt : -1 < e 0 := by nlinarith
        have he0_lt : e 0 < 1 := by nlinarith
        refine ⟨⟨Real.arccos_nonneg _, Real.arccos_lt_pi.mpr he0_gt⟩, Or.inl ?_⟩
        have h_cos : Real.cos (Real.arccos (e 0)) = e 0 :=
          Real.cos_arccos he0_gt.le he0_lt.le
        have h_sin : Real.sin (Real.arccos (e 0)) = e 1 := by
          rw [Real.sin_arccos]
          have h1 : 1 - (e 0) ^ 2 = (e 1) ^ 2 := by linarith
          rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h_pos]
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [h_cos, h_sin]
      · rw [if_neg h_pos]
        by_cases h_neg : e 1 < 0
        · rw [if_pos h_neg]
          have he1_sq : 0 < (e 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_neg h_neg
          have hne0_sq : (-(e 0)) ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
          have hne0_gt : -1 < -(e 0) := by nlinarith
          have hne0_lt : -(e 0) < 1 := by nlinarith
          refine ⟨⟨Real.arccos_nonneg _, Real.arccos_lt_pi.mpr hne0_gt⟩, Or.inr ?_⟩
          have h_cos : Real.cos (Real.arccos (-(e 0))) = -(e 0) :=
            Real.cos_arccos hne0_gt.le hne0_lt.le
          have h_sin : Real.sin (Real.arccos (-(e 0))) = -(e 1) := by
            rw [Real.sin_arccos]
            have h1 : 1 - (-(e 0)) ^ 2 = (e 1) ^ 2 := by ring_nf; linarith
            rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_neg h_neg]
          ext i
          fin_cases i <;> simp [h_cos, h_sin]
        · rw [if_neg h_neg]
          have he1_zero : e 1 = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_pos) (le_of_not_gt h_neg)
          have he0_sq1 : (e 0) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [he1_zero] at h_sq; linarith
          refine ⟨⟨le_rfl, Real.pi_pos⟩, ?_⟩
          rcases sq_eq_one_iff.mp he0_sq1 with he0_eq | he0_eq
          · left
            ext i
            fin_cases i <;> simp [he0_eq, he1_zero]
          · right
            ext i
            fin_cases i <;> simp [he0_eq, he1_zero]
    refine ⟨h_pm.1, fun u => ?_⟩
    rcases h_pm.2 with h_eq | h_eq
    · simp only [h_eq, and_self]
    · simp only [h_eq, h_perp_neg, inner_neg_right, abs_neg, and_self]

  
  have h_cell_ex : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < p_J j →
      ∃ (M : ℕ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin M → ℝ)
        (e_D V_D A_D : Fin M → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (q : Fin N_T → Fin M → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin M, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ L' ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin M, q tid d = p_TJ j tid) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin M, 0 < q tid d →
          |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
        classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j) - η_comp <
          (∑ d : Fin M, (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d) * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) -
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin M,
            q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_TJ j tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q tid' d)))) / ell := by
    intro j hpj
    let e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0]
    have he₀_norm : ‖e₀‖ = 1 := by
      have hsq : ‖e₀‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp [e₀]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg e₀]
    have he₀_perp_norm : ‖perp2D e₀‖ = 1 := by
      have hsq : ‖perp2D e₀‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp [e₀, perp2D]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D e₀)]
    let S_j : Set ℝ := { s : ℝ | ∃ (M : ℕ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin M → ℝ)
        (e_D V_D A_D : Fin M → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (q : Fin N_T → Fin M → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin M, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ L' ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin M, q tid d = p_TJ j tid) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin M, 0 < q tid d →
          |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
        (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
         let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin M,
           q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_TJ j tid * q_D d))) / ell
         let E_w := ∑ d : Fin M, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
         s = E_w - I_TD) }
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ S_j := by
      refine ⟨1, (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => e₀), (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => 0),
        (fun tid _ => p_TJ j tid), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro _
        exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, hL', he₀_norm⟩
      · intro tid _
        exact hp_TJ_nn j tid
      · intro tid
        simp
      · intro tid _ _
        rw [sub_zero, sub_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
        have hV := (h_bds j tid).1
        have hA := (h_bds j tid).2
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · calc |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid) e₀| ≤ ‖V'_J j tid‖ * ‖e₀‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ 10 * 1 := by rw [he₀_norm]; linarith
            _ = 10 := mul_one 10
        · calc |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ ‖V'_J j tid‖ * ‖perp2D e₀‖ :=
              abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ 10 * 1 := by rw [he₀_perp_norm]; linarith
            _ = 10 := mul_one 10
        · calc |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid) e₀| ≤ ‖A'_J j tid‖ * ‖e₀‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ 10 * 1 := by rw [he₀_norm]; linarith
            _ = 10 := mul_one 10
        · calc |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ ‖A'_J j tid‖ * ‖perp2D e₀‖ :=
              abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ 10 * 1 := by rw [he₀_perp_norm]; linarith
            _ = 10 := mul_one 10
      · dsimp only
        have h_itd : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ _d : Fin 1,
            p_TJ j tid * Real.log (p_TJ j tid / (p_TJ j tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, p_TJ j tid'))) = 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun tid _ => ?_)
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, hp_TJ_sum j hpj, mul_one]
          by_cases h0 : p_TJ j tid = 0
          · simp [h0]
          · rw [div_self h0, Real.log_one, mul_zero]
        rw [h_itd, zero_div]
        simp
    have h_sup_eq : classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j) =
        sSup S_j := rfl
    rw [h_sup_eq]
    obtain ⟨s_j, hs_mem, hs_lt⟩ :=
      exists_lt_of_lt_csSup ⟨0, h0_mem⟩ (sub_lt_self (sSup S_j) hη_comp)
    rcases hs_mem with ⟨M, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h_adm, hq_nn, hq_sum, h_geom, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨M, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h_adm, hq_nn, hq_sum, h_geom, hs_lt⟩

  let M_cell : Fin N_J → ℕ :=
    fun j => if hp : 0 < p_J j then Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) else 0
  let N_D : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup M_cell + 1
  have hND : 1 ≤ N_D := Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hM_le : ∀ j : Fin N_J, M_cell j ≤ N_D :=
    fun j => le_trans (Finset.le_sup (f := M_cell) (Finset.mem_univ j)) (Nat.le_succ _)

  have sum_pad : ∀ {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ N_D) (f : Fin M → ℝ),
      (∑ d : Fin N_D, if hd : d.1 < M then f ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0) = ∑ d' : Fin M, f d' := by
    intro M hM f
    let S : Finset (Fin N_D) := Finset.univ.filter (fun d : Fin N_D => d.1 < M)
    have h_sub : (∑ d : Fin N_D, if hd : d.1 < M then f ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0) =
        ∑ d ∈ S, (if hd : d.1 < M then f ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0) := by
      symm
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S) (fun d _ hd_not => ?_)
      have h_nlt : ¬ d.1 < M := fun hlt => hd_not (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ d, hlt⟩)
      exact dif_neg h_nlt
    rw [h_sub]
    refine Finset.sum_bij (fun d hd => (⟨d.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2⟩ : Fin M))
      (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
      (fun d₁ _ d₂ _ h_eq => Fin.ext (Fin.mk.inj h_eq))
      (fun d' _ => ⟨⟨d'.1, lt_of_lt_of_le d'.2 hM⟩,
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, d'.2⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩)
      (fun d hd => dif_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2)

  let B_J : Fin N_J → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun j d =>
    if hp : 0 < p_J j then
      if hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) then
        Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp)) ⟨d.1, hd⟩
      else 0
    else 0
  let A_J : Fin N_J → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun j d =>
    if hp : 0 < p_J j then
      if hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) then
        Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp))) ⟨d.1, hd⟩
      else 0
    else 0
  let e_cell_fn : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (hp : 0 < p_J j), Fin (Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j hp =>
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp))))
  let V_cell_fn : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (hp : 0 < p_J j), Fin (Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j hp =>
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp)))))
  let A_cell_fn : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (hp : 0 < p_J j), Fin (Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j hp =>
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp))))))
  let q_cell_fn : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (hp : 0 < p_J j), Fin N_T →
      Fin (Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)) → ℝ := fun j hp =>
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp)))))))
  have h_cell_spec : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (hp : 0 < p_J j),
      let M := Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)
      let b_c := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp))
      let a_c := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp)))
      let e_c := e_cell_fn j hp
      let V_c := V_cell_fn j hp
      let A_c := A_cell_fn j hp
      let q_c := q_cell_fn j hp
      (∀ d : Fin M, 0 ≤ b_c d ∧ b_c d ≤ a_c d ∧ a_c d ≤ L' ∧ ‖e_c d‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q_c tid d) ∧
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin M, q_c tid d = p_TJ j tid) ∧
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin M, 0 < q_c tid d →
        |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_c d) (e_c d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_c d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_c d) (perp2D (e_c d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_c d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_c d) (e_c d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_c d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_c d) (perp2D (e_c d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_c d)) ∧
      classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j) - η_comp <
        (∑ d : Fin M, (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_c tid d) * ((1 + γ) * b_c d + (1 - γ) * a_c d)) -
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin M,
          q_c tid d * Real.log (q_c tid d / (p_TJ j tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q_c tid' d)))) / ell :=
    fun j hp => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp)))))))

  let φ_J : Fin N_J → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun j d =>
    if hp : 0 < p_J j then
      if hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) then
        canonAngle (e_cell_fn j hp ⟨d.1, hd⟩)
      else 0
    else 0
  let V_DJ : Fin N_J → Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j d =>
    if hp : 0 < p_J j then
      if hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) then V_cell_fn j hp ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0
    else 0
  let A_DJ : Fin N_J → Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun j d =>
    if hp : 0 < p_J j then
      if hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) then A_cell_fn j hp ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0
    else 0
  let q_J : Fin N_J → Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun j tid d =>
    if hp : 0 < p_J j then
      if hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) then q_cell_fn j hp tid ⟨d.1, hd⟩ else 0
    else 0

  have h_pad_bds : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (d : Fin N_D),
      0 ≤ B_J j d ∧ B_J j d ≤ A_J j d ∧ A_J j d ≤ L' ∧
      φ_J j d ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
    intro j d
    dsimp only [B_J, A_J, φ_J]
    by_cases hp : 0 < p_J j
    · rw [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hp, dif_pos hp]
      by_cases hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)
      · rw [dif_pos hd, dif_pos hd, dif_pos hd]
        have h_sp := (h_cell_spec j hp).1 ⟨d.1, hd⟩
        exact ⟨h_sp.1, h_sp.2.1, h_sp.2.2.1, (h_canon_angle _ h_sp.2.2.2).1⟩
      · rw [dif_neg hd, dif_neg hd, dif_neg hd]
        exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, hL', ⟨le_rfl, Real.pi_pos⟩⟩
    · rw [dif_neg hp, dif_neg hp, dif_neg hp]
      exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, hL', ⟨le_rfl, Real.pi_pos⟩⟩

  have hq_nn : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T) (d : Fin N_D), 0 ≤ q_J j tid d := by
    intro j tid d
    dsimp only [q_J]
    by_cases hp : 0 < p_J j
    · rw [dif_pos hp]
      by_cases hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)
      · rw [dif_pos hd]
        exact (h_cell_spec j hp).2.1 tid ⟨d.1, hd⟩
      · rw [dif_neg hd]
    · rw [dif_neg hp]

  have hq_marg : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T), ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_J j tid d = p_TJ j tid := by
    intro j tid
    dsimp only [q_J]
    by_cases hp : 0 < p_J j
    · simp_rw [dif_pos hp]
      have hM : Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) ≤ N_D := by
        have h1 := hM_le j
        dsimp only [M_cell] at h1
        rwa [dif_pos hp] at h1
      rw [sum_pad hM (fun d' => q_cell_fn j hp tid d')]
      exact (h_cell_spec j hp).2.2.1 tid
    · simp_rw [dif_neg hp]
      rw [Finset.sum_const_zero]
      have hp0 : p_J j = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hp) (hp_J_nn j)
      rw [hp_TJ_eq, hp0, div_zero]

  have h_pad_geom : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T) (d : Fin N_D), 0 < q_J j tid d →
      let e_d := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos (φ_J j d), Real.sin (φ_J j d)]
      |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d) e_d| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (B_J j d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d) (perp2D e_d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (A_J j d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_DJ j d) e_d| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (B_J j d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_DJ j d) (perp2D e_d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (A_J j d) := by
    intro j tid d hq_pos
    dsimp only [q_J] at hq_pos
    by_cases hp : 0 < p_J j
    · rw [dif_pos hp] at hq_pos
      by_cases hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)
      · rw [dif_pos hd] at hq_pos
        dsimp only [B_J, A_J, φ_J, V_DJ, A_DJ]
        simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hd]
        have he_norm := ((h_cell_spec j hp).1 ⟨d.1, hd⟩).2.2.2
        have h_canV := (h_canon_angle _ he_norm).2 (V'_J j tid - V_cell_fn j hp ⟨d.1, hd⟩)
        have h_canA := (h_canon_angle _ he_norm).2 (A'_J j tid - A_cell_fn j hp ⟨d.1, hd⟩)
        have h_gm := (h_cell_spec j hp).2.2.2.1 tid ⟨d.1, hd⟩ hq_pos
        rw [h_canV.1, h_canV.2, h_canA.1, h_canA.2]
        exact h_gm
      · rw [dif_neg hd] at hq_pos
        exact absurd hq_pos (lt_irrefl 0)
    · rw [dif_neg hp] at hq_pos
      exact absurd hq_pos (lt_irrefl 0)

  let q_DJ : Fin N_J → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun j d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_J j tid d
  let E_w_cell : Fin N_J → ℝ := fun j =>
    ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_DJ j d * ((1 + γ) * B_J j d + (1 - γ) * A_J j d)
  let I_TD_cell : Fin N_J → ℝ := fun j =>
    (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      q_J j tid d * Real.log (q_J j tid d / (p_TJ j tid * q_DJ j d))) / ell

  have h_pad_score :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
        classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) - η_comp ≤
      ∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * (E_w_cell j - I_TD_cell j) := by
    have h_pt : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
        p_J j * (classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j) - η_comp) ≤
          p_J j * (E_w_cell j - I_TD_cell j) := by
      intro j
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hp_J_nn j) with hp0 | hp
      · rw [← hp0, zero_mul, zero_mul]
      · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hp.le
        have hM : Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) ≤ N_D := by
          have h1 := hM_le j
          dsimp only [M_cell] at h1
          rwa [dif_pos hp] at h1
        have hq_DJ_eq : ∀ (d : Fin N_D) (hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)),
            q_DJ j d = ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_cell_fn j hp tid ⟨d.1, hd⟩ := by
          intro d hd
          dsimp only [q_DJ, q_J]
          simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hd]
        have hq_DJ_zero : ∀ (d : Fin N_D), ¬ d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp) →
            q_DJ j d = 0 := by
          intro d hd
          dsimp only [q_DJ, q_J]
          simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_neg hd, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        have hEw_eq : E_w_cell j = ∑ d' : Fin (Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)),
            (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_cell_fn j hp tid d') *
              ((1 + γ) * Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp)) d' +
               (1 - γ) * Classical.choose
                 (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex j hp))) d') := by
          rw [← sum_pad hM]
          dsimp only [E_w_cell]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
          by_cases hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)
          · rw [dif_pos hd, hq_DJ_eq d hd]
            dsimp only [B_J, A_J]
            simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hd]
          · rw [dif_neg hd, hq_DJ_zero d hd, zero_mul]
        have hITD_eq : I_TD_cell j =
            (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d' : Fin (Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)),
              q_cell_fn j hp tid d' * Real.log (q_cell_fn j hp tid d' /
                (p_TJ j tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q_cell_fn j hp tid' d')))) / ell := by
          dsimp only [I_TD_cell]
          congr 1
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
          rw [← sum_pad hM]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
          by_cases hd : d.1 < Classical.choose (h_cell_ex j hp)
          · rw [dif_pos hd, hq_DJ_eq d hd]
            dsimp only [q_J]
            simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hd]
          · rw [dif_neg hd]
            dsimp only [q_J]
            simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_neg hd, zero_mul]
        rw [hEw_eq, hITD_eq]
        exact ((h_cell_spec j hp).2.2.2.2).le
    have h_sum_le := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => h_pt j)
    have h_lhs : (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
        (classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j) - η_comp)) =
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
        classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) - η_comp := by
      simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp_J_sum, one_mul]
    linarith [h_sum_le, h_lhs]

  
  let N_hat : ℕ := N_ω * N_D
  let N_raw : ℕ := N_J * N_D
  have hN_raw : 1 ≤ N_raw := Nat.mul_pos hNJ hND
  let e_hat : Fin N_ω × Fin N_D ≃ Fin N_hat := finProdFinEquiv
  let e_raw : Fin N_J × Fin N_D ≃ Fin N_raw := finProdFinEquiv
  let proj_ω : Fin N_hat → Fin N_ω := fun ω_h => (e_hat.symm ω_h).1
  let proj_d : Fin N_hat → Fin N_D := fun ω_h => (e_hat.symm ω_h).2
  let T_hat : Fin N_hat → Fin N_T := fun ω_h => T_idx (proj_ω ω_h)
  let c_hat : Fin N_hat → ℝ := fun ω_h => c_s (proj_ω ω_h)
  let D_hat : Fin N_hat → Fin N_raw := fun ω_h => e_raw (J (proj_ω ω_h), proj_d ω_h)
  let π_hat : Fin N_hat → ℝ := fun ω_h =>
    π (proj_ω ω_h) * (q_J (J (proj_ω ω_h)) (T_hat ω_h) (proj_d ω_h) /
      p_TJ (J (proj_ω ω_h)) (T_hat ω_h))
  let m_r : ℕ := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
  let k_D : Fin N_raw → ℤ := fun d_r => k_J (e_raw.symm d_r).1
  let b_raw : Fin N_raw → ℝ := fun d_r => b_t + B_J (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2
  let a_raw : Fin N_raw → ℝ := fun d_r => b_t + A_J (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2
  let φ_raw : Fin N_raw → ℝ := fun d_r => φ_J (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2
  let V_glob : Fin N_raw → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d_r =>
    v_J (e_raw.symm d_r).1 + (ε ^ b_t) • V_DJ (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2
  let X_glob : Fin N_raw → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d_r =>
    x_J (e_raw.symm d_r).1 + (((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t) •
      (A_DJ (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2 +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_DJ (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2)

  
  have hπ_hat_nn : ∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat, 0 ≤ π_hat ω_h :=
    fun ω_h => mul_nonneg (hπ_nn _) (div_nonneg (hq_nn _ _ _) (hp_TJ_nn _ _))

  have hπ_hat_pos : ∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat, 0 < π_hat ω_h →
      0 < π (proj_ω ω_h) ∧ 0 < q_J (J (proj_ω ω_h)) (T_hat ω_h) (proj_d ω_h) := by
    intro ω_h hpos
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra h_np
      have h0 : π (proj_ω ω_h) = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_np) (hπ_nn _)
      dsimp only [π_hat] at hpos
      rw [h0, zero_mul] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    · by_contra h_nq
      have h0 : q_J (J (proj_ω ω_h)) (T_hat ω_h) (proj_d ω_h) = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_nq) (hq_nn _ _ _)
      dsimp only [π_hat] at hpos
      rw [h0, zero_div, mul_zero] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos

  have h_marg : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
      (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, if proj_ω ω_h = ω then π_hat ω_h else 0) = π ω := by
    intro ω
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e_hat (fun ω_h => if proj_ω ω_h = ω then π_hat ω_h else 0),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h_step : ∀ ω' : Fin N_ω,
        (∑ d : Fin N_D,
          if proj_ω (e_hat (ω', d)) = ω then π_hat (e_hat (ω', d)) else 0) =
        if ω' = ω then
          ∑ d : Fin N_D, π ω * (q_J (J ω) (T_idx ω) d / p_TJ (J ω) (T_idx ω))
        else 0 := by
      intro ω'
      dsimp only [proj_ω, proj_d, T_hat, π_hat]
      simp_rw [e_hat.symm_apply_apply]
      by_cases h_eq : ω' = ω
      · subst h_eq
        simp
      · simp [h_eq]
    simp_rw [h_step, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ ω),
      ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, hq_marg]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hπ_nn ω) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0, zero_mul]
    · have hp_jt_pos : 0 < p_joint (J ω) (T_idx ω) := by
        have h_le : (if J ω = J ω ∧ T_idx ω = T_idx ω then π ω else 0) ≤
            p_joint (J ω) (T_idx ω) :=
          Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => if J ω' = J ω ∧ T_idx ω' = T_idx ω then π ω' else 0)
            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
        simp only [and_self, ↓reduceIte] at h_le
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos h_le
      have hp_j_pos : 0 < p_J (J ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hp_jt_pos (hp_joint_le_J _ _)
      have hp_tj_pos : 0 < p_TJ (J ω) (T_idx ω) := by
        rw [hp_TJ_eq]
        exact div_pos hp_jt_pos hp_j_pos
      rw [div_self (ne_of_gt hp_tj_pos), mul_one]

  
  have sum_pullback : ∀ g : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
      ∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_hat ω_h * g (proj_ω ω_h) = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * g ω := by
    intro g
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ proj_ω (fun ω_h => π_hat ω_h * g (proj_ω ω_h))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    have h_fib : ∑ ω_h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω_h => proj_ω ω_h = ω),
        π_hat ω_h * g (proj_ω ω_h) =
      (∑ ω_h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω_h => proj_ω ω_h = ω), π_hat ω_h) * g ω := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω_h h_mem => ?_)
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp h_mem).2]
    rw [h_fib, Finset.sum_filter, h_marg ω]

  have sum_pullback_ite : ∀ (P : Fin N_ω → Prop) [d₁ : DecidablePred P]
      [d₂ : DecidablePred (fun ω_h : Fin N_hat => P (proj_ω ω_h))],
      (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, @ite ℝ (P (proj_ω ω_h)) (d₂ ω_h) (π_hat ω_h) 0) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (P ω) (d₁ ω) (π ω) 0 := by
    intro P d₁ d₂
    have h1 : (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, @ite ℝ (P (proj_ω ω_h)) (d₂ ω_h) (π_hat ω_h) 0) =
        ∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_hat ω_h * (@ite ℝ (P (proj_ω ω_h)) (d₁ (proj_ω ω_h)) 1 0) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω_h _ => ?_)
      by_cases hP : P (proj_ω ω_h) <;> simp [hP]
    have h2 : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (P ω) (d₁ ω) (π ω) 0) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (@ite ℝ (P ω) (d₁ ω) 1 0) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hP : P ω <;> simp [hP]
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact sum_pullback (fun ω => @ite ℝ (P ω) (d₁ ω) 1 0)

  have hπ_hat_sum : ∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_hat ω_h = 1 := by
    have h1 := sum_pullback (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [mul_one] at h1
    rw [h1, hπ_sum]

  have h_law_hat : IsUnitBallTimeLaw π_hat V_part A_part c_hat :=
    ⟨hπ_hat_nn, hπ_hat_sum, h_law.2.2.1,
      fun ω_h hpos => h_law.2.2.2 (proj_ω ω_h) (hπ_hat_pos ω_h hpos).1⟩

  have hp_T_hat_pt : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
      (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, if T_hat ω_h = tid then π_hat ω_h else 0) = p_T tid :=
    fun tid => sum_pullback_ite (fun ω => T_idx ω = tid)

  have h_root_eq : classicalRootSupremum ε L_glob γ N_hat N_T π_hat T_hat V_part A_part =
      classicalRootSupremum ε L_glob γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part := by
    unfold classicalRootSupremum
    dsimp only
    simp_rw [hp_T_hat_pt]
    rfl

  have h_ent_pull : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      finCondEntropy ε π_hat (fun ω_h => X (proj_ω ω_h)) (fun ω_h => Y (proj_ω ω_h)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
    intro α β X Y
    have h_p1 : ∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat,
        finProbAt π_hat (fun ω_h' => X (proj_ω ω_h')) ω_h = finProbAt π X (proj_ω ω_h) := by
      intro ω_h
      unfold finProbAt
      exact @sum_pullback_ite (fun ω' => X ω' = X (proj_ω ω_h))
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _)
    have h_p2 : ∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat,
        finProbAt2 π_hat (fun ω_h' => X (proj_ω ω_h')) (fun ω_h' => Y (proj_ω ω_h')) ω_h =
          finProbAt2 π X Y (proj_ω ω_h) := by
      intro ω_h
      unfold finProbAt2
      exact @sum_pullback_ite (fun ω' => X ω' = X (proj_ω ω_h) ∧ Y ω' = Y (proj_ω ω_h))
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _)
    have h_cs : ∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat,
        condSurprise ε π_hat (fun ω_h' => X (proj_ω ω_h')) (fun ω_h' => Y (proj_ω ω_h')) ω_h =
          condSurprise ε π X Y (proj_ω ω_h) := by
      intro ω_h
      unfold condSurprise
      rw [h_p1 ω_h, h_p2 ω_h]
    unfold finCondEntropy
    simp_rw [h_cs]
    exact sum_pullback (fun ω => condSurprise ε π X Y ω)

  have h_mi_pull : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      finMutualInfo ε π_hat (fun ω_h => X (proj_ω ω_h)) (fun ω_h => Y (proj_ω ω_h)) =
        finMutualInfo ε π X Y := by
    intro α β X Y
    unfold finMutualInfo
    rw [← h_ent_pull (fun _ : Fin N_ω => ()) Y, ← h_ent_pull X Y]

  have h_def_pull : ∀ (u b a : ℝ) (θ_ω : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      stdApertureDeficit ε γ L_glob u b a π_hat T_hat V_part A_part c_hat
        (fun ω_h => θ_ω (proj_ω ω_h)) =
      stdApertureDeficit ε γ L_glob u b a π T_idx V_part A_part c_s θ_ω := by
    intro u b a θ_ω
    unfold stdApertureDeficit stdApertureScore
    rw [h_root_eq]
    have h_obs_mi := h_mi_pull T_idx
      (fun ω => stdApertureObs ε u b a (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (θ_ω ω))
    have h_k_ent := h_ent_pull T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω))
    dsimp only [T_hat, c_hat] at h_obs_mi h_k_ent ⊢
    rw [h_obs_mi, h_k_ent]

  
  let p_TD : Fin N_T → Fin N_raw → ℝ := fun tid d_r =>
    ∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, if T_hat ω_h = tid ∧ D_hat ω_h = d_r then π_hat ω_h else 0
  let p_D : Fin N_raw → ℝ := fun d_r =>
    ∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, if D_hat ω_h = d_r then π_hat ω_h else 0

  have hp_TD : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (j : Fin N_J) (d : Fin N_D),
      p_TD tid (e_raw (j, d)) = p_J j * q_J j tid d := by
    intro tid j d
    dsimp only [p_TD]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e_hat
      (fun ω_h => if T_hat ω_h = tid ∧ D_hat ω_h = e_raw (j, d) then π_hat ω_h else 0),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h_inner : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
        (∑ d' : Fin N_D,
          if T_hat (e_hat (ω, d')) = tid ∧ D_hat (e_hat (ω, d')) = e_raw (j, d)
          then π_hat (e_hat (ω, d')) else 0) =
        (if J ω = j ∧ T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0) * (q_J j tid d / p_TJ j tid) := by
      intro ω
      dsimp only [T_hat, D_hat, π_hat, proj_ω, proj_d]
      simp_rw [e_hat.symm_apply_apply, e_raw.injective.eq_iff, Prod.mk.injEq]
      by_cases h_jt : J ω = j ∧ T_idx ω = tid
      · rcases h_jt with ⟨hj, ht⟩
        have h_d : (∑ d' : Fin N_D,
            if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j ∧ d' = d
            then π ω * (q_J (J ω) (T_idx ω) d' / p_TJ (J ω) (T_idx ω)) else 0) =
          ∑ d' : Fin N_D,
            if d' = d then π ω * (q_J j tid d / p_TJ j tid) else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d' _ => ?_)
          by_cases hd' : d' = d <;> simp [hj, ht, hd']
        rw [h_d, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ d)]
        simp [hj, ht]
      · simp only [h_jt, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hd' : T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j ∧ d' = d
        · exact absurd ⟨hd'.2.1, hd'.1⟩ h_jt
        · simp [hd']
    simp_rw [h_inner, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    change p_joint j tid * (q_J j tid d / p_TJ j tid) = p_J j * q_J j tid d
    by_cases h_jt0 : p_joint j tid = 0
    · rw [h_jt0, zero_mul]
      by_cases hp0 : p_J j = 0
      · rw [hp0, zero_mul]
      · have h_ptj0 : p_TJ j tid = 0 := by rw [hp_TJ_eq, h_jt0, zero_div]
        have h_qsum0 : ∑ d' : Fin N_D, q_J j tid d' = 0 := by rw [hq_marg, h_ptj0]
        have h_qd0 : q_J j tid d = 0 :=
          (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun d' _ => hq_nn j tid d')).mp h_qsum0 d
            (Finset.mem_univ d)
        rw [h_qd0, mul_zero]
    · have hp_jt_pos : 0 < p_joint j tid :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (hp_joint_nn j tid) (Ne.symm h_jt0)
      have hp_j_pos : 0 < p_J j := lt_of_lt_of_le hp_jt_pos (hp_joint_le_J j tid)
      have hp_j_ne : p_J j ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hp_j_pos
      rw [hp_TJ_eq]
      field_simp [h_jt0, hp_j_ne]

  have hp_D : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (d : Fin N_D), p_D (e_raw (j, d)) = p_J j * q_DJ j d := by
    intro j d
    have h_sum_td : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_TD tid (e_raw (j, d)) = p_D (e_raw (j, d)) := by
      dsimp only [p_TD, p_D]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω_h _ => ?_)
      by_cases hd : D_hat ω_h = e_raw (j, d) <;> simp [hd]
    rw [← h_sum_td]
    simp_rw [hp_TD, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    rfl

  have h_ew_decomp : ∀ w_raw : Fin N_raw → ℝ,
      ∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_hat ω_h * w_raw (D_hat ω_h) =
        ∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_DJ j d * w_raw (e_raw (j, d))) := by
    intro w_raw
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ D_hat (fun ω_h => π_hat ω_h * w_raw (D_hat ω_h))]
    have h_fib : ∀ d_r : Fin N_raw,
        (∑ ω_h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω_h => D_hat ω_h = d_r), π_hat ω_h * w_raw (D_hat ω_h)) =
        p_D d_r * w_raw d_r := by
      intro d_r
      have h1 : ∑ ω_h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω_h => D_hat ω_h = d_r),
          π_hat ω_h * w_raw (D_hat ω_h) =
        (∑ ω_h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω_h => D_hat ω_h = d_r), π_hat ω_h) * w_raw d_r := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω_h hm => ?_)
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2]
      rw [h1, Finset.sum_filter]
    simp_rw [h_fib]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e_raw (fun d_r => p_D d_r * w_raw d_r), Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    simp_rw [hp_D, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]

  
  have h_mi_formula : ∀ {M M_X M_Y : ℕ} (μ : Fin M → ℝ)
      (hμ_nn : ∀ m : Fin M, 0 ≤ μ m) (hμ_sum : ∑ m : Fin M, μ m = 1)
      (X : Fin M → Fin M_X) (Y : Fin M → Fin M_Y),
      let P_X : Fin M_X → ℝ := fun x => ∑ m : Fin M, if X m = x then μ m else 0
      let P_Y : Fin M_Y → ℝ := fun y => ∑ m : Fin M, if Y m = y then μ m else 0
      let P_XY : Fin M_X → Fin M_Y → ℝ :=
        fun x y => ∑ m : Fin M, if X m = x ∧ Y m = y then μ m else 0
      finMutualInfo ε μ X Y =
        (∑ x : Fin M_X, ∑ y : Fin M_Y,
          P_XY x y * Real.log (P_XY x y / (P_X x * P_Y y))) / ell := by
    intro M M_X M_Y μ hμ_nn hμ_sum X Y P_X P_Y P_XY
    unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
    have h_u1 : ∀ m : Fin M, finProbAt μ (fun _ => ()) m = 1 := by
      intro m
      unfold finProbAt
      simp [hμ_sum]
    have h_u2 : ∀ m : Fin M, finProbAt2 μ (fun _ => ()) Y m = P_Y (Y m) := by
      intro m
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hy : Y m' = Y m <;> simp [hy]
    have h_x1 : ∀ m : Fin M, finProbAt μ X m = P_X (X m) := by
      intro m
      unfold finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hx : X m' = X m <;> simp [hx]
    have h_xy2 : ∀ m : Fin M, finProbAt2 μ X Y m = P_XY (X m) (Y m) := by
      intro m
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hx : X m' = X m <;> by_cases hy : Y m' = Y m <;> simp [hx, hy]
    change (∑ m : Fin M, μ m * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 μ (fun _ => ()) Y m /
          finProbAt μ (fun _ => ()) m) / ell)) -
      (∑ m : Fin M, μ m * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 μ X Y m / finProbAt μ X m) / ell)) = _
    simp_rw [h_u1, div_one, h_u2, h_x1, h_xy2]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have h_term : ∀ m : Fin M,
        μ m * (-Real.log (P_Y (Y m)) / ell) -
          μ m * (-Real.log (P_XY (X m) (Y m) / P_X (X m)) / ell) =
        (μ m * (Real.log (P_XY (X m) (Y m) / P_X (X m)) - Real.log (P_Y (Y m)))) / ell := by
      intro m
      ring
    simp_rw [h_term, ← Finset.sum_div]
    congr 1
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ (fun m : Fin M => (X m, Y m))
      (fun m => μ m * (Real.log (P_XY (X m) (Y m) / P_X (X m)) - Real.log (P_Y (Y m)))),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
    have h_fib_xy : (∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin M => (X m, Y m) = (x, y)),
        μ m * (Real.log (P_XY (X m) (Y m) / P_X (X m)) - Real.log (P_Y (Y m)))) =
      P_XY x y * (Real.log (P_XY x y / P_X x) - Real.log (P_Y y)) := by
      have h1 : (∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin M => (X m, Y m) = (x, y)),
          μ m * (Real.log (P_XY (X m) (Y m) / P_X (X m)) - Real.log (P_Y (Y m)))) =
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin M => (X m, Y m) = (x, y)), μ m) *
          (Real.log (P_XY x y / P_X x) - Real.log (P_Y y)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
        have hxy := Prod.mk.inj (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2
        rw [hxy.1, hxy.2]
      rw [h1, Finset.sum_filter]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      simp [Prod.mk.injEq]
    rw [h_fib_xy]
    have hPXY_nn : 0 ≤ P_XY x y :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => by split_ifs; exact hμ_nn m; exact le_rfl)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hPXY_nn with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · have hPX_pos : 0 < P_X x := by
        have h_le : P_XY x y ≤ P_X x := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => by
          by_cases hx : X m = x <;> by_cases hy : Y m = y <;> simp [hx, hy, hμ_nn m])
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos h_le
      have hPY_pos : 0 < P_Y y := by
        have h_le : P_XY x y ≤ P_Y y := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => by
          by_cases hx : X m = x <;> by_cases hy : Y m = y <;> simp [hx, hy, hμ_nn m])
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos h_le
      have h_q_ne : P_XY x y / P_X x ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hpos) (ne_of_gt hPX_pos)
      rw [← Real.log_div h_q_ne (ne_of_gt hPY_pos), div_div]

  have h_mi_chain :
      finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat D_hat =
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J + ∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * I_TD_cell j := by
    rw [h_mi_formula π_hat hπ_hat_nn hπ_hat_sum T_hat D_hat,
      h_mi_formula π hπ_nn hπ_sum T_idx J]
    dsimp only
    simp_rw [hp_T_hat_pt]
    change (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d_r : Fin N_raw,
        p_TD tid d_r * Real.log (p_TD tid d_r / (p_T tid * p_D d_r))) / ell =
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ j : Fin N_J,
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j then π ω else 0) *
          Real.log ((∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j then π ω else 0) /
            (p_T tid * p_J j))) / ell +
      ∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * I_TD_cell j
    have h_tj_comm : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (j : Fin N_J),
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j then π ω else 0) = p_joint j tid := by
      intro tid j
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases hj : J ω = j <;> simp [ht, hj]
    simp_rw [h_tj_comm]
    have h_rhs_div :
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ j : Fin N_J,
          p_joint j tid * Real.log (p_joint j tid / (p_T tid * p_J j))) / ell +
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * I_TD_cell j) =
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ j : Fin N_J,
          (p_joint j tid * Real.log (p_joint j tid / (p_T tid * p_J j)) +
            p_J j * ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              q_J j tid d * Real.log (q_J j tid d / (p_TJ j tid * q_DJ j d)))) / ell := by
      dsimp only [I_TD_cell]
      simp_rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← add_div]
      congr 1
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun (j : Fin N_J) (tid : Fin N_T) =>
          ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_J j * (q_J j tid d * Real.log (q_J j tid d / (p_TJ j tid * q_DJ j d))))]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [h_rhs_div]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e_raw
      (fun d_r => p_TD tid d_r * Real.log (p_TD tid d_r / (p_T tid * p_D d_r))),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    simp_rw [hp_TD, hp_D]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hp_joint_nn j tid) with h_jt0 | h_jt_pos
    · rw [← h_jt0, zero_mul, zero_add]
      have h_pq0 : ∀ d : Fin N_D, p_J j * q_J j tid d = 0 := by
        intro d
        by_cases hp0 : p_J j = 0
        · rw [hp0, zero_mul]
        · have h_ptj0 : p_TJ j tid = 0 := by rw [hp_TJ_eq, ← h_jt0, zero_div]
          have h_qsum0 : ∑ d' : Fin N_D, q_J j tid d' = 0 := by rw [hq_marg, h_ptj0]
          have h_qd0 : q_J j tid d = 0 :=
            (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun d' _ => hq_nn j tid d')).mp h_qsum0 d
              (Finset.mem_univ d)
          rw [h_qd0, mul_zero]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      have hd0 := h_pq0 d
      calc (p_J j * q_J j tid d) * Real.log ((p_J j * q_J j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_DJ j d)))
          = 0 := by rw [hd0, zero_mul]
        _ = (p_J j * q_J j tid d) * Real.log (q_J j tid d / (p_TJ j tid * q_DJ j d)) := by
            rw [hd0, zero_mul]
        _ = p_J j * (q_J j tid d * Real.log (q_J j tid d / (p_TJ j tid * q_DJ j d))) :=
            mul_assoc _ _ _
    · have hp_j_pos : 0 < p_J j := lt_of_lt_of_le h_jt_pos (hp_joint_le_J j tid)
      have hp_t_pos : 0 < p_T tid := lt_of_lt_of_le h_jt_pos (hp_joint_le_T j tid)
      have hp_tj_pos : 0 < p_TJ j tid := by
        rw [hp_TJ_eq]
        exact div_pos h_jt_pos hp_j_pos
      have h_jt_expand : p_joint j tid = ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_J j * q_J j tid d := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hq_marg, hp_TJ_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hp_j_pos)]
      let R₁ : ℝ := p_joint j tid / (p_T tid * p_J j)
      let R₂_fn : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => q_J j tid d / (p_TJ j tid * q_DJ j d)
      have h_rhs_comb :
          p_joint j tid * Real.log R₁ +
            p_J j * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_J j tid d * Real.log (R₂_fn d)) =
          ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            ((p_J j * q_J j tid d) * Real.log R₁ +
              p_J j * (q_J j tid d * Real.log (R₂_fn d))) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← h_jt_expand, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      change (∑ d : Fin N_D, (p_J j * q_J j tid d) *
          Real.log ((p_J j * q_J j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_DJ j d)))) =
        p_joint j tid * Real.log R₁ +
          p_J j * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_J j tid d * Real.log (R₂_fn d))
      rw [h_rhs_comb]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hq_nn j tid d) with hq0 | hq_pos
      · simp [← hq0]
      · have hq_dj_pos : 0 < q_DJ j d := by
          have h_le : q_J j tid d ≤ q_DJ j d :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun tid' : Fin N_T => q_J j tid' d)
              (fun tid' _ => hq_nn j tid' d) (Finset.mem_univ tid)
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos h_le
        let R₂ : ℝ := R₂_fn d
        have hR₁_pos : 0 < R₁ := div_pos h_jt_pos (mul_pos hp_t_pos hp_j_pos)
        have hR₂_pos : 0 < R₂ := div_pos hq_pos (mul_pos hp_tj_pos hq_dj_pos)
        have h_prod : (p_J j * q_J j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_DJ j d)) = R₁ * R₂ := by
          dsimp only [R₁, R₂, R₂_fn]
          rw [hp_TJ_eq]
          have hpj_ne : p_J j ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hp_j_pos
          have hpt_ne : p_T tid ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hp_t_pos
          have hpjt_ne : p_joint j tid ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_jt_pos
          have hqdj_ne : q_DJ j d ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_dj_pos
          field_simp [hpj_ne, hpt_ne, hpjt_ne, hqdj_ne]
        change (p_J j * q_J j tid d) *
            Real.log ((p_J j * q_J j tid d) / (p_T tid * (p_J j * q_DJ j d))) =
          (p_J j * q_J j tid d) * Real.log R₁ + p_J j * (q_J j tid d * Real.log R₂)
        rw [h_prod, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hR₁_pos) (ne_of_gt hR₂_pos)]
        ring

  
  have h_raw_bds : ∀ d_r : Fin N_raw,
      b_t ≤ b_raw d_r ∧ b_raw d_r ≤ a_raw d_r ∧ a_raw d_r ≤ b_t + L' ∧
      φ_raw d_r ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
    intro d_r
    dsimp only [b_raw, a_raw, φ_raw]
    have hb := h_pad_bds (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2
    exact ⟨by linarith [hb.1], by linarith [hb.2.1], by linarith [hb.2.2.1], hb.2.2.2⟩

  have hk_D_det : ∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat, dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_hat ω_h) = k_D (D_hat ω_h) := by
    intro ω_h
    dsimp only [c_hat, k_D, D_hat]
    rw [e_raw.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hk_J (proj_ω ω_h)

  have h_step_r : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ r := by
    have h_er_pos : 0 < ε ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ r
    have h_2mr_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r := by positivity
    have h_ceil : ε ^ (-r) ≤ (⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    have h_clog : (⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r := by
      have h_nat : ⌈ε ^ (-r)⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ m_r := Nat.le_pow_clog (by omega : 1 < 2) _
      exact_mod_cast h_nat
    have h_inv_le : (ε ^ r)⁻¹ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le r]
      exact le_trans h_ceil h_clog
    exact (inv_le_comm₀ h_2mr_pos h_er_pos).mpr h_inv_le

  have h_raw_geom : ∀ ω_h : Fin N_hat, 0 < π_hat ω_h →
      let tid := T_hat ω_h
      let d_r := D_hat ω_h
      let e_r := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos (φ_raw d_r), Real.sin (φ_raw d_r)]
      let X_r := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε r (c_hat ω_h)) • V_part tid
      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_glob d_r) e_r| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_raw d_r) ∧
      |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_glob d_r) (perp2D e_r)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_raw d_r) ∧
      |inner ℝ (X_r - X_glob d_r) e_r| ≤ 15 * ε ^ (b_raw d_r + r) ∧
      |inner ℝ (X_r - X_glob d_r) (perp2D e_r)| ≤ 15 * ε ^ (a_raw d_r + r) := by
    intro ω_h hpos
    obtain ⟨hπ_pos, hq_pos⟩ := hπ_hat_pos ω_h hpos
    let ω := proj_ω ω_h
    let d := proj_d ω_h
    let j := J ω
    let tid := T_idx ω
    obtain ⟨hV_rel, hX_rel⟩ := h_rel ω hπ_pos
    have h_loc := h_pad_geom j tid d hq_pos
    have h_symm : e_raw.symm (D_hat ω_h) = (j, d) := e_raw.symm_apply_apply (j, d)
    have hb_eq : b_raw (D_hat ω_h) = b_t + B_J j d := by
      dsimp only [b_raw]; rw [h_symm]
    have ha_eq : a_raw (D_hat ω_h) = b_t + A_J j d := by
      dsimp only [a_raw]; rw [h_symm]
    have hφ_eq : φ_raw (D_hat ω_h) = φ_J j d := by
      dsimp only [φ_raw]; rw [h_symm]
    have hVg_eq : V_glob (D_hat ω_h) = v_J j + (ε ^ b_t) • V_DJ j d := by
      dsimp only [V_glob]; rw [h_symm]
    have hXg_eq : X_glob (D_hat ω_h) =
        x_J j + (((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t) • (A_DJ j d + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_DJ j d) := by
      dsimp only [X_glob]; rw [h_symm]
    have hV_diff : V_part tid - V_glob (D_hat ω_h) =
        (ε ^ b_t) • (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d) := by
      rw [hVg_eq, ← sub_sub, hV_rel, ← smul_sub]
    let X_r := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε r (c_s ω)) • V_part tid
    have hX_diff : X_r - X_glob (D_hat ω_h) =
        (((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t) •
          ((A'_J j tid - A_DJ j d) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d)) := by
      rw [hXg_eq, ← sub_sub]
      change (X_r - x_J j) -
          (((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t) • (A_DJ j d + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_DJ j d) = _
      rw [hX_rel, ← smul_sub]
      congr 1
      rw [smul_sub]
      abel
    have h_ebt_pos : 0 < ε ^ b_t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ b_t
    have h_sx_nn : 0 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t := by positivity
    have h_vec_bd : ∀ (u_dir : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (E : ℝ),
        |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d) u_dir| ≤ 10 * ε ^ E →
        |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_DJ j d) u_dir| ≤ 10 * ε ^ E →
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_glob (D_hat ω_h)) u_dir| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_t + E) ∧
        |inner ℝ (X_r - X_glob (D_hat ω_h)) u_dir| ≤ 15 * ε ^ ((b_t + E) + r) := by
      intro u_dir E hV_u hA_u
      have h_eE_nn : 0 ≤ ε ^ E := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ E).le
      have h_ebtE_nn : 0 ≤ ε ^ (b_t + E) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (b_t + E)).le
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hV_diff, real_inner_smul_left, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_ebt_pos]
        calc ε ^ b_t * |inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d) u_dir|
            ≤ ε ^ b_t * (10 * ε ^ E) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV_u h_ebt_pos.le
          _ = 10 * (ε ^ b_t * ε ^ E) := by ring
          _ = 10 * ε ^ (b_t + E) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀ b_t E]
      · rw [hX_diff, real_inner_smul_left, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left,
          abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h_sx_nn]
        have h_tri : |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_DJ j d) u_dir +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d) u_dir| ≤ 15 * ε ^ E := by
          have h1 := abs_add_le (inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_DJ j d) u_dir)
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d) u_dir)
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)] at h1
          linarith [h1, hA_u, hV_u]
        calc (((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t) *
              |inner ℝ (A'_J j tid - A_DJ j d) u_dir +
                (1 / 2 : ℝ) * inner ℝ (V'_J j tid - V_DJ j d) u_dir|
            ≤ (((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ * ε ^ b_t) * (15 * ε ^ E) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tri h_sx_nn
          _ = 15 * ((ε ^ b_t * ε ^ E) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹) := by ring
          _ = 15 * (ε ^ (b_t + E) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀ b_t E]
          _ ≤ 15 * (ε ^ (b_t + E) * ε ^ r) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_step_r h_ebtE_nn
          _ = 15 * ε ^ ((b_t + E) + r) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀ (b_t + E) r]
    dsimp only [T_hat, c_hat]
    rw [hb_eq, ha_eq, hφ_eq]
    obtain ⟨hbV, hbX⟩ := h_vec_bd _ (B_J j d) h_loc.1 h_loc.2.2.1
    obtain ⟨haV, haX⟩ := h_vec_bd _ (A_J j d) h_loc.2.1 h_loc.2.2.2
    exact ⟨hbV, haV, hbX, haX⟩

  
  have h_score_final :
      2 * b_t - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)) +
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j *
          classicalRootSupremum ε L' γ N_ω N_T (π_J j) T_idx (V'_J j) (A'_J j)) - η_comp ≤
      (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_hat ω_h *
          ((1 + γ) * b_raw (D_hat ω_h) + (1 - γ) * a_raw (D_hat ω_h))) -
        finMutualInfo ε π_hat T_hat D_hat +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π_hat T_hat (fun ω_h => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_hat ω_h)) := by
    let w_loc : Fin N_raw → ℝ := fun d_r =>
      (1 + γ) * B_J (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2 +
      (1 - γ) * A_J (e_raw.symm d_r).1 (e_raw.symm d_r).2
    have h_w_split : ∀ d_r : Fin N_raw,
        (1 + γ) * b_raw d_r + (1 - γ) * a_raw d_r = 2 * b_t + w_loc d_r := by
      intro d_r
      dsimp only [b_raw, a_raw, w_loc]
      ring
    have h_ew_glob :
        (∑ ω_h : Fin N_hat, π_hat ω_h *
          ((1 + γ) * b_raw (D_hat ω_h) + (1 - γ) * a_raw (D_hat ω_h))) =
        2 * b_t + ∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * E_w_cell j := by
      simp_rw [h_w_split, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
        hπ_hat_sum, one_mul, h_ew_decomp w_loc]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [w_loc]
      rw [e_raw.symm_apply_apply]
    have h_cell_split :
        ∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * (E_w_cell j - I_TD_cell j) =
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * E_w_cell j) - (∑ j : Fin N_J, p_J j * I_TD_cell j) := by
      simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have h_ent_r := h_ent_pull T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))
    dsimp only [T_hat, c_hat] at h_ent_r ⊢
    linarith [h_pad_score, h_ew_glob, h_mi_chain, h_ent_r, h_cell_split]

  exact ⟨N_hat, N_raw, proj_ω, π_hat, D_hat, k_D, b_raw, a_raw, φ_raw, V_glob, X_glob,
    hN_raw, h_law_hat, fun ω_h hpos => (hπ_hat_pos ω_h hpos).1, h_root_eq, h_def_pull,
    h_raw_bds, hk_D_det, h_raw_geom, h_score_final⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) :
    ∃ C_rnd : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_rnd ∧
      ∀ (ε r b_star a_star ξ : ℝ) {N_ω N_T N_raw : ℕ}
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (D_hat : Fin N_ω → Fin N_raw) (k_D : Fin N_raw → ℤ)
        (b_raw a_raw φ_raw : Fin N_raw → ℝ)
        (V_glob X_glob : Fin N_raw → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < r →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ a_star → 0 ≤ ξ →
        IsUnitBallTimeLaw π V_part A_part c_s →
        (∀ d_r : Fin N_raw, φ_raw d_r ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) →
        (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω) = k_D (D_hat ω)) →
        (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
          let d_r := D_hat ω
          b_star ≤ b_raw d_r ∧ b_raw d_r ≤ b_star + ξ ∧
          a_star ≤ a_raw d_r ∧ a_raw d_r ≤ a_star + ξ) →
        (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
          let tid := T_idx ω
          let d_r := D_hat ω
          let e_r := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos (φ_raw d_r), Real.sin (φ_raw d_r)]
          let X_r := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε r (c_s ω)) • V_part tid
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_glob d_r) e_r| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_raw d_r) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_glob d_r) (perp2D e_r)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_raw d_r) ∧
          |inner ℝ (X_r - X_glob d_r) e_r| ≤ 15 * ε ^ (b_raw d_r + r) ∧
          |inner ℝ (X_r - X_glob d_r) (perp2D e_r)| ≤ 15 * ε ^ (a_raw d_r + r)) →
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω *
            ((1 + γ) * b_raw (D_hat ω) + (1 - γ) * a_raw (D_hat ω))) -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat +
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)) -
          2 * ξ - C_rnd / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤

      calc (∑ g ∈ S_G d, ∑ t ∈ S_T,
              P_TDG t d g * ((P_D d * P_TG t g) / ((M_rnd : ℝ) * P_TDG t d g * P_G g)))
          ≤ ∑ _g ∈ S_G d, (P_D d / (M_rnd : ℝ)) := Finset.sum_le_sum (h_step_t d hd)
        _ = ((S_G d).card : ℝ) * (P_D d / (M_rnd : ℝ)) := by simp
        _ ≤ (M_rnd : ℝ) * (P_D d / (M_rnd : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card_SG (div_nonneg (hPD_nn d) hM_pos.le)
        _ = P_D d := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hM_ne
    have h_sum_PD : ∑ d ∈ S_D, P_D d = 1 := by
      dsimp only [P_D]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← h_sum_pi_pos]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hd_mem : D_hat ω ∈ S_D := Finset.mem_image_of_mem D_hat hω
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (D_hat ω)]
      · simp
      · intro d _ hne; simp [Ne.symm hne]
      · intro hnot; exact absurd hd_mem hnot
    calc (∑ d ∈ S_D, ∑ g ∈ S_G d, ∑ t ∈ S_T,
            P_TDG t d g * ((P_D d * P_TG t g) / ((M_rnd : ℝ) * P_TDG t d g * P_G g)))
        ≤ ∑ d ∈ S_D, P_D d := Finset.sum_le_sum h_step_g
      _ = 1 := h_sum_PD
  have h_mi_bound : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat ≤
      Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell := by
    have h_mul_ell : 0 ≤ ell * (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat + Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell -
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star) := by
      have h_lhs_eq : ell * (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat + Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star) =
        ∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω * (Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) + Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx D_hat ω) +
          Real.log (finProbAt π G_star ω) - Real.log (finProbAt π D_hat ω) -
          Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_star ω)) := by
        have h_logM : ell * (Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell) =
            ∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω * Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) := by
          rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hell_ne, ← Finset.sum_mul, h_sum_pi_pos, one_mul]
        calc ell * (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat + Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell -
              finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star)
            = ell * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat + ell * (Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell) -
                ell * finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star := by ring
          _ = (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω *
                (Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx D_hat ω) - Real.log (finProbAt π T_idx ω) -
                  Real.log (finProbAt π D_hat ω))) +
              (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω * Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ)) -
              (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω *
                (Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_star ω) - Real.log (finProbAt π T_idx ω) -
                  Real.log (finProbAt π G_star ω))) := by
              rw [h_mi_expand D_hat, h_logM, h_mi_expand G_star]
          _ = ∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω * (Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) + Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx D_hat ω) +
                Real.log (finProbAt π G_star ω) - Real.log (finProbAt π D_hat ω) -
                Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_star ω)) := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
              ring
      rw [h_lhs_eq]
      have h_pt_jensen : ∀ ω ∈ Ω_pos,
          π ω * (1 - z_fn ω) ≤ π ω * (Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) +
            Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx D_hat ω) + Real.log (finProbAt π G_star ω) -
            Real.log (finProbAt π D_hat ω) - Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_star ω)) := by
        intro ω hω
        have hpD : 0 < finProbAt π D_hat ω := h_prob_pos D_hat ω hω
        have hpG : 0 < finProbAt π G_star ω := h_prob_pos G_star ω hω
        have hpTG : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx G_star ω := by
          rw [h_prob2_prod]; exact h_prob_pos _ ω hω
        have hpTD : 0 < finProbAt2 π T_idx D_hat ω := by
          rw [h_prob2_prod]; exact h_prob_pos _ ω hω
        have hpTDG : 0 < finProbAt π TDG ω := h_prob_pos TDG ω hω
        have hpTDG_le : finProbAt π TDG ω ≤ finProbAt2 π T_idx D_hat ω := by
          dsimp only [finProbAt, finProbAt2, TDG]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          by_cases h3 : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ D_hat ω' = D_hat ω ∧ G_star ω' = G_star ω
          · simp [h3]
          · have hp : (T_idx ω', D_hat ω', G_star ω') ≠ (T_idx ω, D_hat ω, G_star ω) :=
              fun heq => h3 ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst heq,
                congr_arg (Prod.fst ∘ Prod.snd) heq,
                congr_arg (Prod.snd ∘ Prod.snd) heq⟩
            simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte]
            split_ifs
            · exact h_law.1 ω'
            · exact le_rfl
        have h_log_tdg : Real.log (finProbAt π TDG ω) ≤ Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx D_hat ω) :=
          Real.log_le_log hpTDG hpTDG_le
        have hz_pos : 0 < z_fn ω :=
          div_pos (mul_pos hpD hpTG) (mul_pos (mul_pos hM_pos hpTDG) hpG)
        have h_jensen : Real.log (z_fn ω) ≤ z_fn ω - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hz_pos
        have h_log_z : Real.log (z_fn ω) =
            (Real.log (finProbAt π D_hat ω) + Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx G_star ω)) -
            ((Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) + Real.log (finProbAt π TDG ω)) +
              Real.log (finProbAt π G_star ω)) := by
          dsimp only [z_fn]
          rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hpD hpTG))
              (ne_of_gt (mul_pos (mul_pos hM_pos hpTDG) hpG)),
            Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hpD) (ne_of_gt hpTG),
            Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hM_pos hpTDG)) (ne_of_gt hpG),
            Real.log_mul hM_ne (ne_of_gt hpTDG)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [h_jensen, h_log_z, h_log_tdg]) (h_law.1 ω)
      have h_sum_1mz : 0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω * (1 - z_fn ω) := by
        have h_eq : (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω * (1 - z_fn ω)) =
            (∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω) - ∑ ω ∈ Ω_pos, π ω * z_fn ω := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          ring
        linarith [h_eq, h_sum_pi_pos, h_sum_z_le1]
      exact le_trans h_sum_1mz (Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt_jensen)
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat + Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell -
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star := by
      by_contra h_neg
      have h_lt : finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat + Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h_neg
      have h_prod_lt : ell * (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat + Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star) < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hell_pos h_lt
      linarith [h_mul_ell, h_prod_lt]
    linarith [h_nonneg]
  
  dsimp only [stdApertureScore]
  change (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * ((1 + γ) * b_raw (D_hat ω) + (1 - γ) * a_raw (D_hat ω))) -
      finMutualInfo ε π T_idx D_hat +
      2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω)) -
      2 * ξ - Real.log (M_rnd : ℝ) / ell ≤
    W_star - finMutualInfo ε π T_idx G_star +
      2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε r (c_s ω))
  linarith [h_weight, h_mi_bound]

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_X α_Y : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α_X) (Y : Fin N_ω → α_Y) (E : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω ∈ E, 0 < π ω) → 0 < (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ restrictLaw π E ω) ∧
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, restrictLaw π E ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < restrictLaw π E ω ↔ ω ∈ E) ∧
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε (restrictLaw π E) X Y ∧
      finCondEntropy ε (restrictLaw π E) X Y ≤
        (∑ ω ∈ E, π ω)⁻¹ * finCondEntropy ε π X Y) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω M_obs : ℕ} {α β : Type} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
      (ε a : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → α)
      (obs : Fin M_obs → Fin N_ω → β) (A_cap : Fin M_obs → ℝ),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < a →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ i : Fin M_obs, 0 ≤ A_cap i ∧
        (((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)).image (obs i)).card : ℝ) ≤
          ε ^ (-(A_cap i))) →
      let J_max : ℕ := ∏ i : Fin M_obs, (1 + ⌈(A_cap i + 1) / a⌉₊) ^ 2
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      ∃ (Z : Fin N_ω → Fin (J_max + 1))
        (Z_ret : Finset (Fin J_max))
        (d_uncond d_condT : Fin J_max → Fin M_obs → ℝ),
        1 ≤ J_max ∧
        (∀ z i, d_uncond z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (A_cap i + 1) ∧
          d_condT z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (A_cap i + 1)) ∧
        1 - 2 * (M_obs : ℝ) * ε - 1 / 4 ≤
          (∑ z ∈ Z_ret, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Z ω = z.castSucc then π ω else 0) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Z_ret,
          let E_z := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z.castSucc ∧ 0 < π ω)
          let m_z := ∑ ω ∈ E_z, π ω
          let π_z := restrictLaw π E_z
          (4 * (J_max : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ m_z ∧
          (∀ i : Fin M_obs,
            (d_uncond z i - Real.log (4 * (J_max : ℝ)) / ell ≤
              finCondEntropy ε π_z (fun _ => ()) (obs i) ∧
             finCondEntropy ε π_z (fun _ => ()) (obs i) ≤ d_uncond z i + a) ∧
            (d_condT z i - Real.log (4 * (J_max : ℝ)) / ell ≤
              finCondEntropy ε π_z T_idx (obs i) ∧
             finCondEntropy ε π_z T_idx (obs i) ≤ d_condT z i + a)) ∧
          (∀ (i : Fin M_obs) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → η < 1 →
            ∃ B_u B_c : Finset (Fin N_ω),
              (∑ ω ∈ B_u, π_z ω) ≤ 2 * η ∧
              (∑ ω ∈ B_c, π_z ω) ≤ 2 * η ∧
              ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π_z ω →
                (ω ∉ B_u →
                  d_uncond z i - Real.log (4 * (J_max : ℝ) / η) / ell ≤
                    condSurprise ε π_z (fun _ => ()) (obs i) ω ∧
                  condSurprise ε π_z (fun _ => ()) (obs i) ω ≤
                    d_uncond z i + a + Real.log (1 / η) / ell) ∧
                (ω ∉ B_c →
                  d_condT z i - Real.log (4 * (J_max : ℝ) / η) / ell ≤
                    condSurprise ε π_z T_idx (obs i) ω ∧
                  condSurprise ε π_z T_idx (obs i) ω ≤
                    d_condT z i + a + Real.log (1 / η) / ell)))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_ell_pos : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [one_lt_inv₀ hε₀]
    linarith
  have h_log_rpow : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ∀ r : ℝ,
      Real.log (ε ^ r) = -r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ r
    rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀ r, Real.log_inv]
    ring
  have h_div_mul_le : ∀ A B : ℝ, 0 ≤ A → (A / B) * B ≤ A := by
    intro A B hA
    by_cases hB : B = 0
    · simp [hB, hA]
    · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ A hB]
  have h_sum_ite : ∀ {γ : Type} (s : Finset γ) (a : γ) (f : γ → ℝ)
      (dec_eq : ∀ x : γ, Decidable (a = x)) (dec_mem : Decidable (a ∈ s)),
      (∑ x ∈ s, @ite ℝ (a = x) (dec_eq x) (f x) 0) =
        @ite ℝ (a ∈ s) dec_mem (f a) 0 := by
    intro γ s a f dec_eq dec_mem
    let decγ : DecidableEq γ := Classical.typeDecidableEq γ
    have h1 : (∑ x ∈ s, @ite ℝ (a = x) (dec_eq x) (f x) 0) =
        ∑ x ∈ s, @ite ℝ (a = x) (decγ a x) (f x) 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : a = x <;> simp [h]
    rw [h1, @Finset.sum_ite_eq γ ℝ _ decγ s a f]
    by_cases hs : a ∈ s <;> simp [hs]
  let wX : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {γ : Type},
      (Fin N_ω → ℝ) → Finset (Fin N_ω) → (Fin N_ω → γ) → γ → ℝ :=
    fun w S X x =>
      ∑ ω ∈ S, @ite ℝ (X ω = x) (Classical.propDecidable _) (w ω) 0
  let wXY : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {γ δ : Type},
      (Fin N_ω → ℝ) → Finset (Fin N_ω) → (Fin N_ω → γ) → (Fin N_ω → δ) → γ → δ → ℝ :=
    fun w S X Y x y =>
      ∑ ω ∈ S, @ite ℝ (X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y) (Classical.propDecidable _) (w ω) 0
  let posSupp : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ}, (Fin N_ω → ℝ) → Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
    fun {N_ω} w => @Finset.filter (Fin N_ω) (fun ω => 0 < w ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
  have h_mem_posSupp : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (w : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      ω ∈ posSupp w ↔ 0 < w ω := fun {N_ω} w ω =>
    ⟨fun h => ((@Finset.mem_filter (Fin N_ω) (fun ω' => 0 < w ω')
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ ω).mp h).2,
     fun h => (@Finset.mem_filter (Fin N_ω) (fun ω' => 0 < w ω')
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ ω).mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, h⟩⟩
  have h_w_prob : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {γ δ : Type} (w : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ω))
      (X : Fin N_ω → γ) (Y : Fin N_ω → δ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) → (∀ ω, ω ∉ S → w ω = 0) →
      (∀ ω, finProbAt w X ω = wX w S X (X ω)) ∧
      (∀ ω, finProbAt2 w X Y ω = wXY w S X Y (X ω) (Y ω)) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ wX w S X x) ∧
      (∀ x y, 0 ≤ wXY w S X Y x y) ∧
      (∀ ω ∈ S, w ω ≤ wXY w S X Y (X ω) (Y ω) ∧
        wXY w S X Y (X ω) (Y ω) ≤ wX w S X (X ω)) := by
    intro N_ω γ δ w S X Y hw_nn hw_zero
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ω
      dsimp only [finProbAt, wX]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S) (fun ω' _ hω' => by
        simp only [hw_zero ω' hω', ite_self])).symm
    · intro ω
      dsimp only [finProbAt2, wXY]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S) (fun ω' _ hω' => by
        simp only [hw_zero ω' hω', ite_self])).symm
    · intro x
      dsimp only [wX]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hw_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
    · intro x y
      dsimp only [wXY]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hw_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
    · intro ω hω
      dsimp only [wX, wXY]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun ω' => @ite ℝ (X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (w ω') 0)
          (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hw_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]) hω
        simpa using h_le
      · refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω
        · by_cases hY : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [hX, hY, hw_nn ω']
        · simp [hX]
  have h_surp_nn : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {γ δ : Type} (ε : ℝ) (w : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → γ) (Y : Fin N_ω → δ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) →
      ∀ ω, 0 < w ω → 0 ≤ condSurprise ε w X Y ω := by
    intro N_ω γ δ ε w X Y hε₀ hε₁ hw_nn ω hw_pos
    let S := posSupp w
    have hw_zero : ∀ ω', ω' ∉ S → w ω' = 0 := by
      intro ω' hω'
      have h_not : ¬ 0 < w ω' := fun h => hω' ((h_mem_posSupp w ω').mpr h)
      exact le_antisymm (not_lt.mp h_not) (hw_nn ω')

    refine ⟨hm_z_lb, ?_, ?_⟩
