proof.tactics:
by
  have h_list_ind : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {γ_obs : Type} (ε m : ℝ),
      0 < ε → 0 < m →
      ∀ (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (obs : Fin N_ω → (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ) → γ_obs)
        (L_list : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ)),
        (∀ q : ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ, (q.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
          ∃ Box_q : Finset γ_obs,
            (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → obs ω q ∈ Box_q) ∧
            (Box_q.card : ℝ) ≤
              ε ^ (-(17 + m + max (q.1 : ℝ) 0 + max (q.2.1 : ℝ) 0 +
                max (q.2.2.1 : ℝ) 0 + max (q.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) 0))) →
        (∀ q ∈ L_list, (q.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        0 ≤ rowListCap m L_list ∧
        ∃ B_list : Finset (List γ_obs),
          (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → L_list.map (obs ω) ∈ B_list) ∧
          (B_list.card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-(rowListCap m L_list)) := by
    intro N_ω γ_obs ε m hε₀ hm π obs L_list h_single hL
    let consEmb : (γ_obs × List γ_obs) ↪ List γ_obs :=
      ⟨fun p => p.1 :: p.2, fun p₁ p₂ h => Prod.ext (List.cons.inj h).1 (List.cons.inj h).2⟩
    induction L_list with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨by simp [rowListCap], {[]}, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro ω _
        simp
      · simp [rowListCap]
    | cons q tl ih =>
      have hq : (q.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
        hL q (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
      have hL_tl : ∀ q' ∈ tl, (q'.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
        fun q' hq' => hL q' (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hq'))
      obtain ⟨h_tl_nn, B_tl, hB_tl_mem, hB_tl_card⟩ := ih hL_tl
      obtain ⟨Box_q, hBox_q_mem, hBox_q_card⟩ := h_single q hq
      have h_cap_cons_nn : 0 ≤ rowListCap m (q :: tl) := by
        simp only [rowListCap]
        have h1 : 0 ≤ max (q.1 : ℝ) 0 := le_max_right _ _
        have h2 : 0 ≤ max (q.2.1 : ℝ) 0 := le_max_right _ _
        have h3 : 0 ≤ max (q.2.2.1 : ℝ) 0 := le_max_right _ _
        have h4 : 0 ≤ max (q.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) 0 := le_max_right _ _
        linarith
      let B_cons : Finset (List γ_obs) := (Box_q ×ˢ B_tl).map consEmb
      refine ⟨h_cap_cons_nn, B_cons, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro ω hω
        simp only [List.map_cons]
        have hp : (obs ω q, tl.map (obs ω)) ∈ Box_q ×ˢ B_tl :=
          Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hBox_q_mem ω hω, hB_tl_mem ω hω⟩
        exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨(obs ω q, tl.map (obs ω)), hp, rfl⟩
      · have h_card_eq : (B_cons.card : ℝ) = (Box_q.card : ℝ) * (B_tl.card : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [B_cons]
          rw [Finset.card_map, Finset.card_product, Nat.cast_mul]
        calc (B_cons.card : ℝ)
            = (Box_q.card : ℝ) * (B_tl.card : ℝ) := h_card_eq
          _ ≤ ε ^ (-(17 + m + max (q.1 : ℝ) 0 + max (q.2.1 : ℝ) 0 +
                max (q.2.2.1 : ℝ) 0 + max (q.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) 0)) *
              ε ^ (-(rowListCap m tl)) :=
              mul_le_mul hBox_q_card hB_tl_card (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _)
          _ = ε ^ (-(rowListCap m (q :: tl))) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
              simp only [rowListCap]
              congr 1
              ring
  have h_cover : ∀ (ε m : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < m →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (L_list : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ)),
        IsBoundedRowLaw π V_part A_part c_s R_s →
        (∀ q ∈ L_list, (q.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        0 ≤ rowListCap m L_list ∧
        ∃ B_list : Finset (List (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)),
          (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
            L_list.map (fun q => rowObs6 ε m
              (V_part (T_idx ω)) (A_part (T_idx ω)) (c_s ω) (R_s ω)
              (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2)) ∈ B_list) ∧
          (B_list.card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-(rowListCap m L_list)) := by
    intro ε m hε₀ hε₁ hm
    have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith
    have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
      Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr hε_lt1)
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hlog2_ne : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlog2_pos
    have h_ratio_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2 :=
      div_nonneg hell_pos.le hlog2_pos.le
    have h_two_rpow_eq : ∀ a : ℝ,
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (a * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)) = ε ^ (-a) := by
      intro a
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),
        Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀, Real.log_inv]
      congr 1
      field_simp [hlog2_ne]
    have h_one_le_eps_neg : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 1 ≤ ε ^ (-a) := by
      intro a ha
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ ≤ ε ^ (-a) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (by linarith)
    have h_16128_le : (16128 : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-16 : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-16 : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-16 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hε₀ hε₁.le (by norm_num)
      have h2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-16 : ℝ) = 65536 := by
        have h_cast : (-16 : ℝ) = ((-16 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
        rw [h_cast, Real.rpow_intCast]
        norm_num
      linarith
    have h_real_cover : ∀ (L M_x : ℝ), 0 ≤ M_x →
        ∃ S_bin : Finset ℤ,
          (∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ M_x → dyadicRealBin ε L x ∈ S_bin) ∧
          (S_bin.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * M_x + 2) * ε ^ (-(max L 0)) := by
      intro L M_x hMx
      let l : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
      let s : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ l
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) l
      have hMxs_nn : 0 ≤ M_x * s := mul_nonneg hMx hs_pos.le
      let B_nat : ℕ := ⌊M_x * s⌋₊
      let S_bin : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-(B_nat : ℤ) - 1) (B_nat : ℤ)
      have hB_lt : M_x * s < (B_nat : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (M_x * s)
      have hB_le : (B_nat : ℝ) ≤ M_x * s := Nat.floor_le hMxs_nn
      refine ⟨S_bin, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx_abs
        obtain ⟨hx_lo, hx_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hx_abs
        have hxs_lo : -(M_x * s) ≤ x * s := by
          have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx_lo hs_pos.le
          linarith
        have hxs_hi : x * s ≤ M_x * s :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx_hi hs_pos.le
        have h_fl_lo : -(B_nat : ℤ) - 1 ≤ dyadicRealBin ε L x := by
          unfold dyadicRealBin
          change -(B_nat : ℤ) - 1 ≤ ⌊x * s⌋
          refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
          push_cast
          linarith
        have h_fl_hi : dyadicRealBin ε L x ≤ (B_nat : ℤ) := by
          have h_lt : ⌊x * s⌋ < (B_nat : ℤ) + 1 := by
            refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
            push_cast
            linarith
          unfold dyadicRealBin
          change ⌊x * s⌋ ≤ (B_nat : ℤ)
          omega
        exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h_fl_lo, h_fl_hi⟩
      · have h_card_int : (S_bin.card : ℤ) = 2 * (B_nat : ℤ) + 2 := by
          have hc := Int.card_Icc_of_le (-(B_nat : ℤ) - 1) (B_nat : ℤ) (by omega)
          change (S_bin.card : ℤ) = _ at hc
          omega
        have h_card_real : (S_bin.card : ℝ) = 2 * (B_nat : ℝ) + 2 := by
          have hc := congrArg (Int.cast (R := ℝ)) h_card_int
          push_cast at hc
          exact hc
        have hs_ub : s ≤ ε ^ (-(max L 0)) := by
          have hl_le : (l : ℝ) ≤ (max L 0) * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := by
            calc (l : ℝ)
                ≤ L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) := Int.floor_le _
              _ ≤ (max L 0) * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left L 0) h_ratio_nn
          calc s = (2 : ℝ) ^ (l : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) l).symm
            _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((max L 0) * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)) :=
                Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hl_le
            _ = ε ^ (-(max L 0)) := h_two_rpow_eq (max L 0)
        have h1_le : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-(max L 0)) := h_one_le_eps_neg (max L 0) (le_max_right L 0)
        have h_term1 : 2 * (B_nat : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M_x * ε ^ (-(max L 0)) := by
          calc 2 * (B_nat : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (M_x * s) := by linarith
            _ = (2 * M_x) * s := by ring
            _ ≤ (2 * M_x) * ε ^ (-(max L 0)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs_ub (by linarith)
            _ = 2 * M_x * ε ^ (-(max L 0)) := by ring
        calc (S_bin.card : ℝ) = 2 * (B_nat : ℝ) + 2 := h_card_real
          _ ≤ 2 * M_x * ε ^ (-(max L 0)) + 2 * ε ^ (-(max L 0)) := by linarith
          _ = (2 * M_x + 2) * ε ^ (-(max L 0)) := by ring
    have h_time_slope : ∀ v : ℝ, v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        ∃ (S_kc S_kr : Finset ℤ),
          (∀ c : ℝ, c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            dyadicTimeBin ε v c ∈ S_kc ∧ |dyadicTimeMid ε v c| ≤ 1) ∧
          (S_kc.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-1 : ℝ) ∧
          (∀ R : ℝ, |R| ≤ 1 →
            dyadicRealBin ε (m * v) R ∈ S_kr ∧ |dyadicRealMid ε (m * v) R| ≤ 3 / 2) ∧
          (S_kr.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-m) := by
      intro v hv
      let m_v : ℕ := dyadicTimeLevel ε v
      have h_one_lt : 1 < ε ^ (-v) :=
        Real.one_lt_rpow_of_pos_of_lt_one_of_neg hε₀ hε_lt1 (by linarith [hv.1])
      have h_ceil_gt1 : 1 < ⌈ε ^ (-v)⌉₊ := by
        have h_le : ε ^ (-v) ≤ (⌈ε ^ (-v)⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        have h_lt_r : ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < (⌈ε ^ (-v)⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
          push_cast
          linarith
        exact Nat.cast_lt.mp h_lt_r
      have hm_v_pos : 0 < m_v := Nat.clog_pos (by omega) h_ceil_gt1
      have h_pow_lt_ceil : 2 ^ (m_v - 1) < ⌈ε ^ (-v)⌉₊ :=
        Nat.pow_lt_of_lt_clog (Nat.sub_lt hm_v_pos zero_lt_one)
      have h_pow_lt_rpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_v - 1) < ε ^ (-v) := by
        have h1 : ((2 ^ (m_v - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) < ε ^ (-v) := Nat.lt_ceil.mp h_pow_lt_ceil
        simpa using h1
      have h_2mv_ub : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
        have hm_eq : m_v = (m_v - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hm_v_pos).symm
        have h_ev : ε ^ (-v) ≤ ε ^ (-1 : ℝ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (by linarith [hv.2])
        calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((m_v - 1) + 1) := by rw [← hm_eq]
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_v - 1) * 2 := pow_succ (2 : ℝ) (m_v - 1)
          _ ≤ ε ^ (-v) * 2 := by linarith
          _ ≤ ε ^ (-1 : ℝ) * 2 := by linarith
          _ = 2 * ε ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by ring
      let S_kc : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc 0 ((2 ^ m_v : ℤ) - 1)
      have h2mv_int_ge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 ^ m_v : ℤ) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have h_kc_card : (S_kc.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
        have hc_int : (S_kc.card : ℤ) = (2 ^ m_v : ℤ) := by
          have hc := Int.card_Icc_of_le 0 ((2 ^ m_v : ℤ) - 1) (by omega)
          change (S_kc.card : ℤ) = _ at hc
          omega
        have hc_real := congrArg (Int.cast (R := ℝ)) hc_int
        push_cast at hc_real
        linarith
      obtain ⟨S_kr, hS_kr_mem, hS_kr_card⟩ := h_real_cover (m * v) 1 (by norm_num)
      have hmv_pos : 0 < m * v := mul_pos hm hv.1
      have hmv_le : m * v ≤ m := by
        calc m * v ≤ m * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv.2.le hm.le
          _ = m := mul_one m
      have h_kr_card : (S_kr.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-m) := by
        have h_max : max (m * v) 0 = m * v := max_eq_left hmv_pos.le
        have h_rpow : ε ^ (-(m * v)) ≤ ε ^ (-m) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (by linarith)
        calc (S_kr.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * 1 + 2) * ε ^ (-(max (m * v) 0)) := hS_kr_card
          _ = 4 * ε ^ (-(m * v)) := by rw [h_max]; ring
          _ ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-m) := by linarith
      refine ⟨S_kc, S_kr, ?_, h_kc_card, ?_, h_kr_card⟩
      · intro c hc
        have h2mv_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v := by positivity
        have h_fl_nn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v⌋ :=
          Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hc.1 h2mv_pos.le)
        have h_bin_nn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ dyadicTimeBin ε v c := by
          unfold dyadicTimeBin
          change (0 : ℤ) ≤ min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v⌋ ((2 ^ m_v : ℤ) - 1)
          exact le_min h_fl_nn (sub_nonneg.mpr h2mv_int_ge1)
        have h_bin_hi : dyadicTimeBin ε v c ≤ (2 ^ m_v : ℤ) - 1 := by
          unfold dyadicTimeBin
          exact min_le_right _ _
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h_bin_nn, h_bin_hi⟩, ?_⟩
        have h_bin_r_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) := by
          have hc_le : ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) := Int.cast_le.mpr h_bin_nn
          simpa using hc_le
        have h_bin_r_hi : (dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_v - 1 := by
          have h_c : (dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) ≤ (((2 ^ m_v : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) :=
            Int.cast_le.mpr h_bin_hi
          push_cast at h_c
          exact h_c
        have h_mid_nn : 0 ≤ dyadicTimeMid ε v c := by
          unfold dyadicTimeMid
          change 0 ≤ ((dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v)⁻¹
          exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr h2mv_pos.le)
        have h_mid_le1 : dyadicTimeMid ε v c ≤ 1 := by
          unfold dyadicTimeMid
          change ((dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v)⁻¹ ≤ 1
          calc ((dyadicTimeBin ε v c : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v)⁻¹
              ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_v)⁻¹ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr h2mv_pos.le)
            _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h2mv_pos)
        rw [abs_of_nonneg h_mid_nn]
        exact h_mid_le1
      · intro R hR
        refine ⟨hS_kr_mem R hR, ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨hR_lo, hR_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hR

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m) (b : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∀ (ε : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      IsBoundedRowLaw π V_part A_part c_s R_s →
      0 ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ∧
      classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ≤ 2 * (1 + m)) ∧
    (∀ (ε δ_ub : ℝ) (U_fin : Finset ℝ) (J_max : ℕ)
      {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (Z : Fin N_ω → Fin (J_max + 1))
      (Z_ret : Finset (Fin J_max)),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < δ_ub →
      (∀ u ∈ U_fin, u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ u ∈ U_fin, ∀ (π' : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
        IsBoundedRowLaw π' V_part A_part c_s R_s →
        rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π' T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s ≤
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π' T_idx V_part A_part +
            (classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_ub) * u) →
      IsBoundedRowLaw π V_part A_part c_s R_s →
      1 / 2 ≤ (∑ z ∈ Z_ret, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Z ω = z.castSucc then π ω else 0) →
      ∃ z_star ∈ Z_ret,
        let E_star := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z_star.castSucc ∧ 0 < π ω)
        let π_star := restrictLaw π E_star
        0 < (∑ ω ∈ E_star, π ω) ∧
        IsBoundedRowLaw π_star V_part A_part c_s R_s ∧
        ∀ u ∈ U_fin,
          |rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π_star T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π_star T_idx V_part A_part -
            classicalGrowthRate γ * u| ≤
          δ_ub + 2 * ((∑ u' ∈ U_fin,
            (|rowObsScore ε γ m u' (b u') π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
              classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
              classicalGrowthRate γ * u'| + δ_ub)) +
            (U_fin.card : ℝ) *
              (3 * Real.log ((J_max + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))))

by
  have h_ell_pos : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁
    apply Real.log_pos
    have h_inv_pos : 0 < ε⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hε₀
    have h_mul : ε * ε⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hε₀.ne'
    nlinarith

  have h_sum_Spos : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (π F : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∀ ω, π ω = 0 → F ω = 0) →
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, F ω = ∑ ω ∈ stdApPosSupport π, F ω := by
    intro N_ω π F hπ_nn hF
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun ω _ hω => ?_)
    have hnot : ¬ (0 < π ω) := by simpa [stdApPosSupport] using hω
    exact hF ω (le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hnot) (hπ_nn ω))

  have h_prob_pos : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → ∀ ω ∈ stdApPosSupport π, ∀ (X : Fin N_ω → α),
      0 < finProbAt π X ω := by
    intro N_ω α π hπ_nn ω hω X
    have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := by simpa [stdApPosSupport] using hω
    unfold finProbAt
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    have hle : (if X ω = X ω then π ω else 0) ≤
        ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω then π ω' else 0 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω' => if X ω' = X ω then π ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω']) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
    rw [if_pos rfl] at hle
    linarith

  have h_prob2_eq : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      finProbAt2 π X Y ω = finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) ω := by
    intro N_ω α β π X Y ω
    unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (Prod.ext h.1 h.2)]
    · have h2 : ¬ ((X ω', Y ω') = (X ω, Y ω)) := by
        intro hp
        exact h ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst hp, congr_arg Prod.snd hp⟩
      rw [if_neg h, if_neg h2]

  have h_cond_eq : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
      ∀ (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y =
        stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) - stdApRawEntropy ε π X := by
    intro N_ω α β ε π hπ_nn X Y
    unfold finCondEntropy stdApRawEntropy
    rw [h_sum_Spos π _ hπ_nn (fun ω h0 => by simp [h0])]
    rw [← sub_div, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
    unfold condSurprise
    rw [h_prob2_eq]
    have hpXY : 0 < finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) ω := h_prob_pos π hπ_nn ω hω _
    have hpX : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := h_prob_pos π hπ_nn ω hω _
    rw [Real.log_div hpXY.ne' hpX.ne']

  have h_raw_congr : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (A : Fin N_ω → α) (B : Fin N_ω → β),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, A ω₁ = A ω₂ ↔ B ω₁ = B ω₂) →
      stdApRawEntropy ε π A = stdApRawEntropy ε π B := by
    intro N_ω α β ε π A B hiff
    unfold stdApRawEntropy
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    congr 3
    unfold finProbAt
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : A ω' = A ω
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((hiff ω' ω).mp h)]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hb => h ((hiff ω' ω).mpr hb))]

  have h_raw_unit : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) = 0 := by
    intro N_ω ε π hπ_sum
    unfold stdApRawEntropy
    have h1 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      simpa only [ite_true] using hπ_sum
    simp [h1]

  have h_cond_nonneg : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
    intro N_ω α β ε π X Y hε₀ hε₁ hπ_nn
    have hell : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [h_sum_Spos π _ hπ_nn (fun ω h0 => by simp [h0])]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω hω => ?_)
    have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := by simpa [stdApPosSupport] using hω
    unfold condSurprise
    apply mul_nonneg hω_pos.le
    apply div_nonneg _ hell.le
    rw [neg_nonneg]
    have hp2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
      rw [h_prob2_eq]
      exact h_prob_pos π hπ_nn ω hω _
    have hp2_le : finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
      unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h.1]
      · rw [if_neg h]
        split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω']
    have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_pos hp2_le
    exact Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg hp2_pos.le hp1_pos.le) ((div_le_one hp1_pos).mpr hp2_le)

  have h_cond_fin_ub : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α : Type} (ε : ℝ) (K : ℕ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Z : Fin N_ω → Fin K),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ K →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤ Real.log (K : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro N_ω α ε K π X Z hε₀ hε₁ hK hπ_nn hπ_sum
    letI : DecidableEq α := Classical.typeDecidableEq α
    have hell : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁
    have hK_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (K : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by omega))
    let S_pos := stdApPosSupport π
    have hS_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω = 1 := by
      rw [← h_sum_Spos π π hπ_nn (fun ω h0 => h0)]
      exact hπ_sum
    let u : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => finProbAt π X ω / ((K : ℝ) * finProbAt2 π X Z ω)
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos,
        π ω * condSurprise ε π X Z ω ≤
          (π ω * Real.log (K : ℝ) + π ω * u ω - π ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := by simpa [S_pos, stdApPosSupport] using hω
      have hp1 : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := h_prob_pos π hπ_nn ω hω X
      have hp2 : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Z ω := by
        rw [h_prob2_eq]; exact h_prob_pos π hπ_nn ω hω _
      have hu_pos : 0 < u ω := div_pos hp1 (mul_pos hK_pos hp2)
      have h_inv_eq : finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω = ((K : ℝ) * u ω)⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [u]
        field_simp [hp1.ne', hp2.ne', hK_pos.ne']
      have h_log : -(Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Z ω / finProbAt π X ω)) ≤
          Real.log (K : ℝ) + u ω - 1 := by
        rw [h_inv_eq, Real.log_inv, neg_neg, Real.log_mul hK_pos.ne' hu_pos.ne']
        linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu_pos]
      unfold condSurprise
      rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hell.le
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log hω_pos.le
      linarith
    have h_u_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * u ω ≤ 1 := by
      let ImX : Finset α := S_pos.image X
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (t := ImX) (g := X)
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω)]
      have h_im_sum : ∑ x ∈ ImX, (∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω) = 1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (t := ImX) (g := X)
          (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω)]
        exact hS_sum
      rw [← h_im_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => ?_)
      let S_x := S_pos.filter (fun ω => X ω = x)
      let q_x : ℝ := ∑ ω ∈ S_x, π ω
      have hqx_nn : 0 ≤ q_x := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hπ_nn ω)
      have hp1_on_Sx : ∀ ω ∈ S_x, finProbAt π X ω = q_x := by
        intro ω hω
        have hx : X ω = x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        unfold finProbAt
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        symm
        have h_congr : q_x = ∑ ω' ∈ S_x, if X ω' = X ω then π ω' else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
          have hx' : X ω' = x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω').2
          rw [if_pos (hx'.trans hx.symm)]
        rw [h_congr]
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_x) (fun ω' _ hnot => ?_)
        by_cases hX : X ω' = X ω
        · rw [if_pos hX]
          have hnot_pos : ω' ∉ S_pos := fun hp =>
            hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, hX.trans hx⟩)
          exact le_antisymm
            (not_lt.mp (by simpa [S_pos, stdApPosSupport] using hnot_pos)) (hπ_nn ω')
        · exact if_neg hX
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise S_x Z]
      calc ∑ z : Fin K, ∑ ω ∈ S_x.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z), π ω * u ω
          ≤ ∑ _z : Fin K, (q_x / (K : ℝ)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z _ => ?_)
            let S_xz := S_x.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z)
            have hmem_Sxz : ∀ ω', ω' ∈ S_xz ↔ ω' ∈ S_pos ∧ X ω' = x ∧ Z ω' = z :=
              fun ω' => by simp [S_xz, S_x, and_assoc]
            change ∑ ω ∈ S_xz, π ω * u ω ≤ q_x / (K : ℝ)
            by_cases hemp : S_xz = ∅
            · rw [hemp, Finset.sum_empty]
              exact div_nonneg hqx_nn hK_pos.le
            · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hemp
              let q_xz : ℝ := ∑ ω' ∈ S_xz, π ω'
              have hω₀_pos : 0 < π ω₀ := by
                have h1 := ((hmem_Sxz ω₀).mp hω₀).1
                simpa [S_pos, stdApPosSupport] using h1
              have hqxz_pos : 0 < q_xz :=
                lt_of_lt_of_le hω₀_pos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω' _ => hπ_nn ω') hω₀)
              have hp2_on_Sxz : ∀ ω ∈ S_xz, finProbAt2 π X Z ω = q_xz := by
                intro ω hω
                obtain ⟨_, hω_X, hω_z⟩ := (hmem_Sxz ω).mp hω
                unfold finProbAt2
                letI := Classical.propDecidable
                symm
                have h_congr : q_xz = ∑ ω' ∈ S_xz,
                    if X ω' = X ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω then π ω' else 0 := by
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
                  obtain ⟨_, hω'_X, hω'_z⟩ := (hmem_Sxz ω').mp hω'
                  rw [if_pos ⟨hω'_X.trans hω_X.symm, hω'_z.trans hω_z.symm⟩]
                rw [h_congr]
                refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_xz) (fun ω' _ hnot => ?_)
                by_cases hXZ : X ω' = X ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω
                · rw [if_pos hXZ]
                  have hnot_pos : ω' ∉ S_pos := fun hp =>
                    hnot ((hmem_Sxz ω').mpr ⟨hp, hXZ.1.trans hω_X, hXZ.2.trans hω_z⟩)
                  exact le_antisymm
                    (not_lt.mp (by simpa [S_pos, stdApPosSupport] using hnot_pos)) (hπ_nn ω')
                · exact if_neg hXZ
              have hu_const : ∀ ω ∈ S_xz, π ω * u ω = π ω * (q_x / ((K : ℝ) * q_xz)) := by
                intro ω hω
                obtain ⟨hω_pos_m, hω_X, _⟩ := (hmem_Sxz ω).mp hω
                have hω_Sx : ω ∈ S_x := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω_pos_m, hω_X⟩
                dsimp [u]
                rw [hp1_on_Sx ω hω_Sx, hp2_on_Sxz ω hω]
              rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hu_const, ← Finset.sum_mul]
              change q_xz * (q_x / ((K : ℝ) * q_xz)) ≤ q_x / (K : ℝ)
              apply le_of_eq
              field_simp [hqxz_pos.ne', hK_pos.ne']
        _ = (K : ℝ) * (q_x / (K : ℝ)) := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ = q_x := mul_div_cancel₀ q_x hK_pos.ne'
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [h_sum_Spos π _ hπ_nn (fun ω h0 => by simp [h0])]
    calc ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * condSurprise ε π X Z ω
        ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, ((π ω * Real.log (K : ℝ) + π ω * u ω - π ω) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
      _ = ((∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω) * Real.log (K : ℝ) + (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * u ω) -
            (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ (1 * Real.log (K : ℝ) + 1 - 1) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
          rw [hS_sum]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hell.le
      _ = Real.log (K : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by ring

  have h_root_set_bounds : ∀ (ε L : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ L →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
      let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      let RSet := { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ L ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
          (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
           let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
             q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
           let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
           s = E_w - I_TD) }
      (0 : ℝ) ∈ RSet ∧ (∀ s ∈ RSet, s ≤ 2 * L) ∧
      0 ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ∧
      classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part ≤ 2 * L := by
    intro ε L N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part hε₀ hε₁ hL hπ_nn hπ_sum hVA
    dsimp only
    let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have hell : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁
    have hpT_nn : ∀ tid, 0 ≤ p_T tid := fun tid =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω])
    have hpT_sum : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T tid = 1 := by
      dsimp [p_T]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h1 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0) = π ω := fun ω =>
        Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem Finset.univ (T_idx ω) (fun _ => π ω) (Finset.mem_univ _)
      simpa [h1] using hπ_sum
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ L ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
        (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
         let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
         let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
         s = E_w - I_TD) } := by
      let e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      have he₀_norm : ‖e₀‖ = 1 := by
        rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp [e₀]
      have hperp_norm : ‖perp2D e₀‖ = 1 := by
        rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp [perp2D, e₀]
      refine ⟨1, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => e₀, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0,
        fun tid _ => p_T tid, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro _
        exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, hL, he₀_norm⟩
      · intro tid _
        exact hpT_nn tid
      · intro tid
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_one]
      · intro tid _ _
        rw [sub_zero, sub_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
        have hV := (hVA tid).1
        have hA := (hVA tid).2
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · calc |inner ℝ (V_part tid) e₀| ≤ ‖V_part tid‖ * ‖e₀‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by rw [he₀_norm]; linarith
            _ ≤ 10 := by norm_num
        · calc |inner ℝ (V_part tid) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ ‖V_part tid‖ * ‖perp2D e₀‖ :=
              abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by rw [hperp_norm]; linarith
            _ ≤ 10 := by norm_num
        · calc |inner ℝ (A_part tid) e₀| ≤ ‖A_part tid‖ * ‖e₀‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by rw [he₀_norm]; linarith
            _ ≤ 10 := by norm_num
        · calc |inner ℝ (A_part tid) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ ‖A_part tid‖ * ‖perp2D e₀‖ :=
              abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by rw [hperp_norm]; linarith
            _ ≤ 10 := by norm_num
      · dsimp only
        have hI : ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ _d : Fin 1,
            p_T tid * Real.log (p_T tid / (p_T tid * ∑ tid' : Fin N_T, p_T tid')) = 0 := by
          rw [hpT_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun tid _ => ?_)
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, mul_one]
          by_cases hp : p_T tid = 0
          · simp [hp]
          · rw [div_self hp, Real.log_one, mul_zero]
        rw [hI, zero_div]
        simp
    have hs_le : ∀ s ∈ { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ L ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
        (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
         let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
         let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
         s = E_w - I_TD) }, s ≤ 2 * L := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h_adm, hq_nn, hq_row, _, hs_eq⟩ := hs
      let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
      have hqD_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun tid _ => hq_nn tid d)
      have hqD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d = 1 := by
        dsimp [q_D]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simpa [hq_row] using hpT_sum
      have hEw_le : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) ≤ 2 * L := by
        calc ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
            ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * (2 * L) := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => ?_)
              obtain ⟨_, hba, haL, _⟩ := h_adm d
              have hbL : b_D d ≤ L := hba.trans haL
              have h1 : (1 + γ) * b_D d ≤ (1 + γ) * L :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbL (by linarith)
              have h2 : (1 - γ) * a_D d ≤ (1 - γ) * L :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left haL (by linarith)
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (hqD_nn d)
          _ = (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d) * (2 * L) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          _ = 2 * L := by rw [hqD_sum, one_mul]
      have hI_nn : 0 ≤ (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell := by
        apply div_nonneg _ hell.le
        have h_term : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (d : Fin N_D),
            q tid d - p_T tid * q_D d ≤ q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d)) := by
          intro tid d
          by_cases hq_pos : 0 < q tid d
          · have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
              rw [← hq_row tid]
              exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos
                (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hq_nn tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d))
            have hqD_pos : 0 < q_D d :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos

        stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((T_idx ω, C ω), Z ω)) -
          stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, Z ω)) := by
      rw [h_cond_eq ε π hπ_nn (fun ω => (T_idx ω, Z ω)) C,
        h_raw_congr ε π (fun ω => ((T_idx ω, Z ω), C ω)) (fun ω => ((T_idx ω, C ω), Z ω))
          (by intro ω₁ ω₂; simp only [Prod.ext_iff]
              exact ⟨fun ⟨⟨hT, hZ⟩, hC⟩ => ⟨⟨hT, hC⟩, hZ⟩,
                     fun ⟨⟨hT, hC⟩, hZ⟩ => ⟨⟨hT, hZ⟩, hC⟩⟩)]
    have hc_GZ : finCondEntropy ε π G Z =
        stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => (G ω, Z ω)) - stdApRawEntropy ε π G :=
      h_cond_eq ε π hπ_nn G Z
    have hc_TG_Z : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G ω)) Z =
        stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((T_idx ω, G ω), Z ω)) -
          stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G ω)) :=
      h_cond_eq ε π hπ_nn (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G ω)) Z
    have hc_TZ : finCondEntropy ε π T_idx Z =
        stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, Z ω)) - stdApRawEntropy ε π T_idx :=
      h_cond_eq ε π hπ_nn T_idx Z
    have hc_TC_Z : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, C ω)) Z =
        stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((T_idx ω, C ω), Z ω)) -
          stdApRawEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, C ω)) :=
      h_cond_eq ε π hπ_nn (fun ω => (T_idx ω, C ω)) Z
    have h_exact_id : rowObsScore ε γ m u b_val π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
        (∑ z : Fin K, p_z z * rowObsScore ε γ m u b_val (π_z z) T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s) =
        -finMutualInfo ε π T_idx Z +
          finCondEntropy ε π G Z -
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G ω)) Z +
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx Z -
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, C ω)) Z := by
      linarith [h_score_pi, h_avg_score, h_mi_TZ, hc_uG, hc_TG, hc_TC,
        hc_uZG, hc_TZG, hc_TZC, hc_GZ, hc_TG_Z, hc_TZ, hc_TC_Z]
    have h_nn_TG : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G ω)) Z :=
      h_cond_nonneg ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, G ω)) Z hε₀ hε₁ hπ_nn
    have h_nn_TC : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, C ω)) Z :=
      h_cond_nonneg ε π (fun ω => (T_idx ω, C ω)) Z hε₀ hε₁ hπ_nn
    have h_ub_GZ : finCondEntropy ε π G Z ≤ Real.log (K : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
      h_cond_fin_ub ε K π G Z hε₀ hε₁ hK hπ_nn hπ_sum
    have h_ub_TZ : finCondEntropy ε π T_idx Z ≤ Real.log (K : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
      h_cond_fin_ub ε K π T_idx Z hε₀ hε₁ hK hπ_nn hπ_sum
    have h3 : Real.log (K : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) +
        2 * (Real.log (K : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) =
        3 * Real.log (K : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by ring
    change rowObsScore ε γ m u b_val π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
        (∑ z : Fin K, p_z z * rowObsScore ε γ m u b_val (π_z z) T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s) ≤ _
    linarith

  constructor
  · intro ε N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s hε₀ hε₁ h_law
    have h1m : 0 ≤ 1 + m := by linarith
    have hbds := h_root_set_bounds ε (1 + m) N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part
      hε₀ hε₁ h1m h_law.1 h_law.2.1 h_law.2.2.1
    exact ⟨hbds.2.2.1, hbds.2.2.2⟩
  · intro ε δ_ub U_fin J_max N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s Z Z_ret
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    intro hε₀ hε₁ hδ_ub hU_fin h_ub h_law h_mass
    have h1m : 0 ≤ 1 + m := by linarith
    have hell : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁
    let E_z : Fin (J_max + 1) → Finset (Fin N_ω) := fun w =>
      Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => Z ω = w ∧ 0 < π ω)
    have hEz : ∀ w ω, ω ∈ E_z w ↔ Z ω = w ∧ 0 < π ω := by
      intro w ω
      simp [E_z]
    let p_z : Fin (J_max + 1) → ℝ := fun w => ∑ ω ∈ E_z w, π ω
    let π_z : Fin (J_max + 1) → Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun w => restrictLaw π (E_z w)
    have hpz_nn : ∀ w, 0 ≤ p_z w := fun w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => h_law.1 ω)
    have hpz_eq_ite : ∀ w : Fin (J_max + 1),
        p_z w = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Z ω = w then π ω else 0 := by
      intro w
      dsimp [p_z, E_z]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hZw : Z ω = w
      · by_cases hpos : 0 < π ω
        · rw [if_pos ⟨hZw, hpos⟩, if_pos hZw]
        · rw [if_neg (fun h => hpos h.2), if_pos hZw]
          exact le_antisymm (h_law.1 ω) (not_lt.mp hpos)
      · rw [if_neg (fun h => hZw h.1), if_neg hZw]
    have hpz_sum : ∑ w : Fin (J_max + 1), p_z w = 1 := by
      simp_rw [hpz_eq_ite]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h1 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
          (∑ w : Fin (J_max + 1), if Z ω = w then π ω else 0) = π ω := fun ω =>
        Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem Finset.univ (Z ω) (fun _ => π ω) (Finset.mem_univ _)
      simpa [h1] using h_law.2.1
    have h_law_z : ∀ w : Fin (J_max + 1), 0 < p_z w →
        IsBoundedRowLaw (π_z w) V_part A_part c_s R_s := by
      intro w hpz
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, h_law.2.2.1, ?_⟩
      · intro ω
        dsimp [π_z, restrictLaw]
        split_ifs
        · exact div_nonneg (h_law.1 ω) hpz.le
        · exact le_rfl
      · have h_sub : ∑ ω ∈ E_z w, π_z w ω = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_z w ω := by
          refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ (E_z w)) (fun ω _ hnot => ?_)
          dsimp [π_z, restrictLaw]
          exact if_neg hnot
        rw [← h_sub]
        have h_congr : ∑ ω ∈ E_z w, π_z w ω = ∑ ω ∈ E_z w, (π ω / p_z w) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
          dsimp [π_z, restrictLaw]
          exact if_pos hω
        rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_div]
        exact div_self hpz.ne'
      · intro ω hpos_z
        dsimp [π_z, restrictLaw] at hpos_z
        have hmem : ω ∈ E_z w := by
          by_contra hnot
          rw [if_neg hnot] at hpos_z
          exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos_z
        exact h_law.2.2.2 ω ((hEz w ω).mp hmem).2
    let deficit : (Fin N_ω → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ := fun π' u =>
      classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π' T_idx V_part A_part +
        classicalGrowthRate γ * u -
        rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π' T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s
    let D : Fin (J_max + 1) → ℝ → ℝ := fun w u => deficit (π_z w) u + δ_ub
    have hD_pos : ∀ w : Fin (J_max + 1), 0 < p_z w → ∀ u ∈ U_fin, 0 ≤ D w u := by
      intro w hpz u hu
      have hub_w := h_ub u hu (π_z w) (h_law_z w hpz)
      have hu_lt : u < 1 := (hU_fin u hu).2
      have hδu : δ_ub * u ≤ δ_ub := by
        calc δ_ub * u ≤ δ_ub * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_lt.le hδ_ub.le
          _ = δ_ub := mul_one _
      dsimp [D, deficit]
      linarith
    have hpD_nn : ∀ w : Fin (J_max + 1), ∀ u ∈ U_fin, 0 ≤ p_z w * D w u := by
      intro w u hu
      by_cases hpz : 0 < p_z w
      · exact mul_nonneg hpz.le (hD_pos w hpz u hu)
      · have hpz0 : p_z w = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpz) (hpz_nn w)
        simp [hpz0]
    have h_single_u : ∀ u ∈ U_fin,
        ∑ w : Fin (J_max + 1), p_z w * D w u ≤
          (|rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
              classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
              classicalGrowthRate γ * u| + δ_ub) +
            3 * Real.log ((J_max + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      intro u _
      have hs1 := h_s1_glue ε (1 + m) (J_max + 1) N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part Z E_z hEz
        hε₀ hε₁ h1m h_law.1 h_law.2.1 h_law.2.2.1
      have hs2 := h_s2_split ε u (b u) (J_max + 1) π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s Z E_z hEz
        hε₀ hε₁ (Nat.le_add_left 1 J_max) h_law.1 h_law.2.1
      have hexp : ∑ w : Fin (J_max + 1), p_z w * D w u =
          (∑ w : Fin (J_max + 1),
            p_z w * classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T (π_z w) T_idx V_part A_part) -
          (∑ w : Fin (J_max + 1),
            p_z w * rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) (π_z w) T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s) +
          (classicalGrowthRate γ * u + δ_ub) := by
        have hw_id : ∀ w : Fin (J_max + 1),
            p_z w * D w u =
              p_z w * classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T (π_z w) T_idx V_part A_part -
              p_z w * rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) (π_z w) T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s +
              p_z w * (classicalGrowthRate γ * u + δ_ub) := by
          intro w; dsimp [D, deficit]; ring
        simp_rw [hw_id]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hpz_sum, one_mul]
      have h_abs : classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
          classicalGrowthRate γ * u -
          rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s ≤
          |rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
            classicalGrowthRate γ * u| := by
        have hneg := neg_le_abs
          (rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
            classicalGrowthRate γ * u)
        linarith
      change _ ≤ _ at hs1 hs2
      linarith [hexp, hs1, hs2, h_abs]
    let Z_ret_pos : Finset (Fin J_max) := Z_ret.filter (fun z => 0 < p_z z.castSucc)
    have h_mass_pos : 1 / 2 ≤ ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc := by
      have h_eq1 : (∑ z ∈ Z_ret, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Z ω = z.castSucc then π ω else 0) =
          ∑ z ∈ Z_ret, p_z z.castSucc :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => (hpz_eq_ite z.castSucc).symm)
      have h_eq2 : ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc = ∑ z ∈ Z_ret, p_z z.castSucc := by
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ Z_ret) (fun z hz hnot => ?_)
        have hnp : ¬ (0 < p_z z.castSucc) := fun hp =>
          hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hz, hp⟩)
        exact le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hnp) (hpz_nn z.castSucc)
      linarith [h_mass, h_eq1, h_eq2]
    have hZ_nonempty : Z_ret_pos.Nonempty := by
      by_contra h_emp
      rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h_emp
      rw [h_emp, Finset.sum_empty] at h_mass_pos
      linarith
    let g : Fin J_max → ℝ := fun z => ∑ u' ∈ U_fin, D z.castSucc u'
    let R_tot : ℝ := (∑ u' ∈ U_fin,
        (|rowObsScore ε γ m u' (b u') π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
            classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
            classicalGrowthRate γ * u'| + δ_ub)) +
      (U_fin.card : ℝ) *
        (3 * Real.log ((J_max + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))
    have hR_nn : 0 ≤ R_tot := by
      apply add_nonneg
      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun u' _ => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hδ_ub.le)
      · apply mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        apply div_nonneg _ hell.le
        apply mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
        apply Real.log_nonneg
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_add_left 1 J_max)
    have h_sum_g_le : ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * g z ≤ R_tot := by
      have h_swap : ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * g z =
          ∑ u' ∈ U_fin, ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * D z.castSucc u' := by
        dsimp [g]
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      rw [h_swap]
      have h_sub_u : ∀ u' ∈ U_fin,
          ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * D z.castSucc u' ≤
            ∑ w : Fin (J_max + 1), p_z w * D w u' := by
        intro u' hu'
        have himg : ∑ w ∈ Z_ret_pos.image Fin.castSucc, p_z w * D w u' =
            ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * D z.castSucc u' :=
          Finset.sum_image (fun _ _ _ _ h => Fin.castSucc_inj.mp h)
        rw [← himg]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
          (fun w _ _ => hpD_nn w u' hu')
      calc ∑ u' ∈ U_fin, ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * D z.castSucc u'
          ≤ ∑ u' ∈ U_fin,
              ((|rowObsScore ε γ m u' (b u') π T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
                  classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part -
                  classicalGrowthRate γ * u'| + δ_ub) +
                3 * Real.log ((J_max + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u' hu' => (h_sub_u u' hu').trans (h_single_u u' hu'))
        _ = R_tot := by
            dsimp [R_tot]
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    obtain ⟨z_star, hz_pos_mem, hz_min⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Z_ret_pos g hZ_nonempty
    obtain ⟨hz_mem_ret, hpz_star_pos⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hz_pos_mem
    have hg_star_nn : 0 ≤ g z_star :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun u' hu' => hD_pos z_star.castSucc hpz_star_pos u' hu')
    have hg_star_le : g z_star ≤ 2 * R_tot := by
      have h1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g z_star ≤ ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * g z := by
        calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g z_star
            ≤ (∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc) * g z_star :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_mass_pos hg_star_nn
          _ = ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * g z_star := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ z ∈ Z_ret_pos, p_z z.castSucc * g z :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z hz =>
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hz_min z hz) (hpz_nn z.castSucc))
      linarith [h1, h_sum_g_le]
    refine ⟨z_star, hz_mem_ret, hpz_star_pos, h_law_z z_star.castSucc hpz_star_pos, ?_⟩
    intro u hu
    have hDu_nn : 0 ≤ D z_star.castSucc u := hD_pos z_star.castSucc hpz_star_pos u hu
    have hDu_le_g : D z_star.castSucc u ≤ g z_star :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun u' hu' => hD_pos z_star.castSucc hpz_star_pos u' hu') hu
    dsimp [D, deficit] at hDu_nn hDu_le_g
    refine abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change -(δ_ub + 2 * R_tot) ≤
        rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) (π_z z_star.castSucc) T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T (π_z z_star.castSucc) T_idx V_part A_part -
          classicalGrowthRate γ * u
      linarith
    · change rowObsScore ε γ m u (b u) (π_z z_star.castSucc) T_idx V_part A_part c_s R_s -
          classicalRootSupremum ε (1 + m) γ N_ω N_T (π_z z_star.castSucc) T_idx V_part A_part -
          classicalGrowthRate γ * u ≤ δ_ub + 2 * R_tot
      linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (∀ (ε u : ℝ) {N_ω N_T : ℕ}
      (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
      (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      IsBoundedRowLaw π V_part A_part c_s R_s →
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)) ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π T_idx (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_s ω)) ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ → ℕ)
      (π_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ)
      (T_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → Fin (N_T k))
      (V_seq A_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_T k) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (c_seq R_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ)
      (S_dyad : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ k, 0 < ε_seq k ∧ ε_seq k < 1 / 2) →
      Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      (∀ k, IsBoundedRowLaw (π_seq k) (V_seq k) (A_seq k) (c_seq k) (R_seq k)) →
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, IsPosDyadicUnit u →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
          finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
            (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) u (c_seq k ω)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (S_dyad u))) →
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, IsPosDyadicUnit u →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
          finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k)
            (fun ω => (T_seq k ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) u (c_seq k ω)))
            (fun ω => dyadicRealBin (ε_seq k) (m * u) (R_seq k ω)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) →
      ∃ S : ℝ → ℝ,
        (∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ → 0 ≤ S u₂ - S u₁ ∧ S u₂ - S u₁ ≤ u₂ - u₁) ∧
        S 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
            finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
              (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) v (c_seq k ω)))
            Filter.atTop (nhds (S v))) ∧
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
            finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k)
              (fun ω => (T_seq k ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) v (c_seq k ω)))
              (fun ω => dyadicRealBin (ε_seq k) (m * v) (R_seq k ω)))
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0)))

        (div_lt_one h2l_pos).mpr (by linarith)⟩, ⟨l, j, hj1, by omega, rfl⟩⟩
      have hq₂D : q₂ ∈ D := ⟨⟨div_pos (by positivity) h2l_pos,
        (div_lt_one h2l_pos).mpr hj1_lt_real⟩, ⟨l, j + 1, by omega, hj1_lt_nat.le, rfl⟩⟩
      have hq₁v : q₁ ≤ v := (div_le_iff₀ h2l_pos).mpr hj_le_real
      have hvq₂ : v ≤ q₂ := (le_div_iff₀ h2l_pos).mpr (by push_cast; linarith)
      have hq_diff : q₂ - q₁ < η := by
        have h_eq : q₂ - q₁ = 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ l := by
          dsimp [q₁, q₂]
          rw [← sub_div]
          push_cast
          ring
        rwa [h_eq]
      exact ⟨q₁, q₂, hq₁D, hq₂D, hq₁v, hvq₂, hq_diff⟩
    let A_set : ℝ → Set ℝ := fun u =>
      {(0 : ℝ)} ∪ { y : ℝ | ∃ q ∈ D, q ≤ u ∧ y = S_dyad q }
    let S : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => sSup (A_set u)
    have hA_ne : ∀ u : ℝ, (A_set u).Nonempty := fun _ => ⟨0, Or.inl rfl⟩
    have hA_bdd : ∀ u : ℝ, BddAbove (A_set u) := by
      intro u
      refine ⟨1, fun y hy => ?_⟩
      rcases hy with rfl | ⟨q, hqD, _, rfl⟩
      · norm_num
      · exact le_trans (hS_dyad_bds q hqD).2 hqD.1.2.le
    have hS_nn : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ S u := fun u => le_csSup (hA_bdd u) (Or.inl rfl)
    have hS_zero : S 0 = 0 := by
      refine le_antisymm (csSup_le (hA_ne 0) (fun y hy => ?_)) (hS_nn 0)
      rcases hy with rfl | ⟨q, hqD, hq0, rfl⟩
      · exact le_rfl
      · linarith [hqD.1.1]
    have hS_eq_dyad : ∀ q₀ ∈ D, S q₀ = S_dyad q₀ := by
      intro q₀ hq₀
      refine le_antisymm (csSup_le (hA_ne q₀) (fun y hy => ?_))
        (le_csSup (hA_bdd q₀) (Or.inr ⟨q₀, hq₀, le_rfl, rfl⟩))
      rcases hy with rfl | ⟨q, hqD, hqq₀, rfl⟩
      · exact (hS_dyad_bds q₀ hq₀).1
      · linarith [(hS_dyad_lip q hqD q₀ hq₀ hqq₀).1]
    have hS_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ → 0 ≤ S u₂ - S u₁ ∧ S u₂ - S u₁ ≤ u₂ - u₁ := by
      intro u₁ u₂ hu₁₂

        refine csSup_le_csSup (hA_bdd u₂) (hA_ne u₁) (fun y hy => ?_)

        · exact Or.inl rfl
        · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hqD, le_trans hqu₁ hu₁₂, rfl⟩
      have h_ub : S u₂ ≤ S u₁ + (u₂ - u₁) := by
        refine csSup_le (hA_ne u₂) (fun y hy => ?_)
        rcases hy with rfl | ⟨q₂, hq₂D, hq₂_u₂, rfl⟩
        · linarith [hS_nn u₁]
        · by_cases hq₂_u₁ : q₂ ≤ u₁
          · have h_in : S_dyad q₂ ∈ A_set u₁ := Or.inr ⟨q₂, hq₂D, hq₂_u₁, rfl⟩
            linarith [le_csSup (hA_bdd u₁) h_in]
          · by_cases hu₁_pos : 0 < u₁
            · have hu₁_lt_q₂ : u₁ < q₂ := lt_of_not_ge hq₂_u₁

                h_dyad_straddle u₁ hu₁_ioo η hη

              have h_q1_le : S_dyad q₁ ≤ S u₁ :=
                le_csSup (hA_bdd u₁) (Or.inr ⟨q₁, hq₁D, hq₁_u₁, rfl⟩)

            · linarith [(hS_dyad_bds q₂ hq₂D).2, hS_nn u₁]
      exact ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr h_mono, by linarith⟩
    refine ⟨S, hS_lip, hS_zero, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε_t hε_t
      obtain ⟨q₁, q₂, hq₁D, hq₂D, hq₁v, hvq₂, hq_diff⟩ :=

      have hd₁ := hK₁ k (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk)
      have hd₂ := hK₂ k (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_lt] at hd₁ hd₂

        (fun ω => dyadicRealBin (ε_seq k) (m * v) (R_seq k ω))
        (hε_bounds k).1 (hε_bounds k).2 (h_law_seq k).1
      have h_ub := h_orient_coarse_one (π_seq k) (T_seq k) (V_seq k) (A_seq k)
        (c_seq k) (R_seq k) (hε_bounds k).1 (hε_bounds k).2 huD.1.1.le huv (h_law_seq k)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg h_nn]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)

    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ)

        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f₁ ∧
        (∫ v, ‖f₁ v‖ ^ 2 = 1) ∧
        0 ≤ generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁ ∧
        (∀ ν κ : ℝ,
          HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ↔

        (∀ (t : ℝ) (m_t N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)

          (IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win

      ∃ ε_prep : ℝ, 0 < ε_prep ∧ ε_prep < 1 / 2 ∧

          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

      rw [hdiv, hring] at hm2

      rw [← sq_abs (w 1 - s * (k1 : ℝ))]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hd1_abs 2

  let j₀_of : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
    fun o => cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)

  have h_site_loc : ∀ o : Fin N_O,
      let j₀ := j₀_of o
      let C_r := ((j₀.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c

      j₀.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + (r_O o) % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) = r_O o ∧
      ‖V_O o - gridPt2D s_v j₀.2.1‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v ∧
      ‖X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - gridPt2D s_x j₀.2.2‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x ∧
      ‖gridPt2D s_v j₀.2.1‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys ∧
      ‖gridPt2D s_x j₀.2.2‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys := by
    intro o
    dsimp only [j₀_of, cutLocalizerIdx]
    let k_pow : ℕ := 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
    have hk_pos : 0 < k_pow := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hpow_split : 2 ^ m_r * k_pow = 2 ^ m_t := by
      dsimp only [k_pow]
      rw [← Nat.pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hmr_le_mt]
    have hqr_lt : r_O o / k_pow < 2 ^ m_r := by
      rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hk_pos, hpow_split]

    have hdiv_eq : (r_O o / k_pow) * k_pow + r_O o % k_pow = r_O o := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact Nat.div_add_mod (r_O o) k_pow

    let r_loc := r_O o % k_pow
    let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
    let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
    have hCt_Cr : |C_r - C_t| ≤ (1 / 2) * s_c := by
      have h2mt_real : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r) * (k_pow : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hpow_split.symm

        exact_mod_cast hdiv_eq.symm

      have hrloc_le : (r_loc : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (k_pow : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hrloc_lt
      have hrloc_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r_loc : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have hdiff_eq : C_r - C_t = s_c * (1 / 2 - ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / (k_pow : ℝ)) := by
        dsimp only [C_r, C_t, s_c]

        field_simp [hk_real_pos.ne']

      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right

      h_round_2d s_v (V_O o) hs_v_pos
    let w_x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o
    have hwx0 : w_x 0 = X_O o 0 + (C_r - C_t) * V_O o 0 := rfl
    have hwx1 : w_x 1 = X_O o 1 + (C_r - C_t) * V_O o 1 := rfl
    have hX_diff : ‖w_x - gridPt2D s_x

      rw [← hwx0, ← hwx1]

    have hXO_le : ‖X_O o‖ ≤ cls.B_sys := (ho_props o).2.2.1

      have htri := norm_sub_le (V_O o) (V_O o - gridPt2D s_v
        (Int.floor (V_O o 0 / s_v + 1 / 2), Int.floor (V_O o 1 / s_v + 1 / 2)))
      rw [sub_sub_cancel] at htri
      linarith only [htri, hVO_le, hV_diff, hs_v_le1, hB_sys2]
    have hwx_norm : ‖w_x‖ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * cls.B_sys := by
      have htri := norm_add_le (X_O o) ((C_r - C_t) • V_O o)
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at htri
      have hCt_half : |C_r - C_t| ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith only [hCt_Cr, hs_c_le1]
      have hmul : |C_r - C_t| * ‖V_O o‖ ≤ (1 / 2) * cls.B_sys :=

      linarith only [htri, hwx_norm, hX_diff, hs_x_le1, hB_sys2]
    refine ⟨hqr_lt, hrloc_lt, hdiv_eq, ?_, ?_, hVJ_norm, hXJ_norm⟩
    · exact le_trans hV_diff (le_mul_of_one_le_left hs_v_pos.le (by linarith only [hB_sys2]))
    · exact le_trans hX_diff (le_mul_of_one_le_left hs_x_pos.le (by linarith only [hB_sys2]))

    have h_active_j : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_J j →

subgoal_signatures.name: uniform_all_duration_packet_growth
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hβ_pos : 0 < quantumPacketRate γ) (hβ_le : quantumPacketRate γ ≤ 1)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ)) :
    ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (H_min δ : ℝ),
      0 < H_min → 0 < δ →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L d lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          ε < ε₀ → H_min ≤ H_P → 0 < d → d ≤ L → d ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ d ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ d →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L d cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
            N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
            generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
              quantumPacketRate γ * d + δ

subgoal_signatures.statement:

    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (A₀ ξ R_bud C_cut : ℝ)
    (use_vel_sub : Bool) (d_dim M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr_cut : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hR_bud : 128 * ξ ≤ R_bud)
    (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hC_cut : 2 ≤ C_cut) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr_cut M) :
    let B_cut := A₀ + 12 * cls.K_hor + 20
    ∃ (C_cov ε_menu : ℝ),
      max 2 C_cut ≤ C_cov ∧ 0 < ε_menu ∧ ε_menu < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (M_L : ℕ) (ε H_P L t r h b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t : ℕ)
        (j₀ : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_atom : ℕ) (o_atom : Fin N_atom → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (ψ_atom : Fin N_atom → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (c_atom : Fin N_atom → ℂ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((j₀.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v j₀.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x j₀.2.2
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (o_atom α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (o_atom α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_atom α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        1 ≤ M_L → 0 < ε → ε < ε_menu → 0 < lam_sys → 1 ≤ N_atom →
        (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ L → L ≤ cls.K_hor → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ cls.K_hor →
        (use_vel_sub = true → 0 < h ∧ r = t - 2 * h) →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ L - t → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        j₀.1 < 2 ^ m_r → m_r ≤ m_t →
        ‖V_J‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys → ‖X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys →
        ((N_atom : ℝ) ≤ C_cut * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor + 4))) →
        (∀ α, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_atom α)) ∧
          (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_atom α z = 0) ∧
          (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_atom α) z‖ ≤
            M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k)) →
        (∀ α, ‖V_at α - V_J‖ ≤ (4 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4) * s_v ∧
          ‖X_at α - X_J‖ ≤ (8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10) * s_x) →
        (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => o_atom α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) →
        (∀ α, ε ^ B_cut ≤ ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) →
        (∑ α : Fin N_atom, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) →
        (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
          let C_t := (((j₀.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v →
            ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x →
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
            (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
            (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
            let pair_fn := fun h_in : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ =>
              (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_in v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
            ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (M_tr : ℕ) (R_tr : ℝ), 2 ≤ M_tr → 2 ≤ R_tr →
              let S_near := S.filter (fun α =>
                ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t ∧
                ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * R_tr * σ_r)
              ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v) -
               pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                C_tr_cut M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ))) →
        ∃ (S_loc : ℕ) (N_all_loc N_ret_loc : Fin S_loc → ℕ)
          (whole_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, LocalizerSubclass (N_all_loc s))
          (sub_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_loc s))
          (emb_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_ret_loc s) → Fin (N_all_loc s))
          (idx_all : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_all_loc s) → Fin N_atom)
          (idx_ret : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_ret_loc s) → Fin N_atom),
          1 ≤ S_loc ∧
          Real.log (S_loc : ℝ) / ell ≤ R_bud / 64 ∧
          (∀ v, ∑ α : Fin N_atom, c_atom α * g_at α v =
            ∑ s : Fin S_loc, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_loc s),
              (sub_loc s).c_at α *
                ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star ((sub_loc s).ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1))) *
                  Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))) ∧
          ∀ s : Fin S_loc,
            (sub_loc s).loc_idx = j₀ ∧ (whole_loc s).loc_idx = j₀ ∧
            (sub_loc s).N_all = N_all_loc s ∧ (whole_loc s).N_all = N_all_loc s ∧
            Function.Injective (emb_loc s) ∧ Function.Injective (idx_all s) ∧
            Function.Injective (idx_ret s) ∧
            (∀ α, idx_ret s α = idx_all s (emb_loc s α)) ∧
            (∀ β, (whole_loc s).o_at β = o_atom (idx_all s β) ∧
              (whole_loc s).ψ_at β = ψ_atom (idx_all s β) ∧
              (whole_loc s).c_at β = c_atom (idx_all s β)) ∧
            (sub_loc s).m_bin = (whole_loc s).m_bin ∧
            (sub_loc s).g_bin = (whole_loc s).g_bin ∧
            (sub_loc s).b_loc = (whole_loc s).b_loc ∧
            (sub_loc s).a_loc = (whole_loc s).a_loc ∧
            (∀ α, (sub_loc s).o_at α = (whole_loc s).o_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).ψ_at α = (whole_loc s).ψ_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).c_at α = (whole_loc s).c_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).cap_id α = (whole_loc s).cap_id (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).e_cap α = (whole_loc s).e_cap (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).V_cap α = (whole_loc s).V_cap (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).X_cap α = (whole_loc s).X_cap (emb_loc s α)) ∧
            IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
              m_r m_t M_mult (fun M => 2 * C_tr_cut M) Φ₀ (sub_loc s) ∧
            IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
              m_r m_t M_mult (fun M => 2 * C_tr_cut M) Φ₀ (whole_loc s) ∧
            (∀ β : Fin (N_all_loc s),
              ε ^ (-(whole_loc s).g_bin + pktWeight γ (whole_loc s).b_loc (whole_loc s).a_loc + ξ) ≤
                ((Finset.univ.filter (fun β' : Fin (N_all_loc s) =>
                  (whole_loc s).cap_id β' = (whole_loc s).cap_id β)).card : ℝ)) ∧
            2 * min (L - r - b_star) ((H_P - r) / 2 - b_star) - R_bud ≤ (sub_loc s).g_bin ∧
            (use_vel_sub = false → N_ret_loc s = N_all_loc s) ∧
            (use_vel_sub = true →
              (∃ m_k : ℕ, m_k < Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3 ∧
                (sub_loc s).k_bin = (m_k : ℝ) * ξ) ∧
              (d_dim = 1 → ∀ α : Fin (N_ret_loc s),
                let p_c := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                  (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2)
                ((sub_loc s).is_aligned = true ↔
                  projAngleDist (perp2D ((sub_loc s).e_cap α)) (n_fine p_c) ≤ 2 * ε ^ h)) ∧
              (∀ p_c w,
                ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_ret_loc s) =>
                  let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2)
                  p_at = p_c ∧
                  fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) = w)).card : ℝ) ≤
                ε ^ ((sub_loc s).k_bin - ξ) *
                  ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_ret_loc s) =>
                    atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2) =
                      p_c)).card : ℝ)) ∧
              (∀ p_buf,
                (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin (N_ret_loc s) =>
                  let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2)
                  (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1)))).filter
                    (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
                ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-((sub_loc s).k_bin + ξ))))

subgoal_signatures.name: subclass_local_root_and_rescaling_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u B_cut ξ η R_bud C_cut C_Bes C_cov : ℝ)
    (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr C_rtail : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΔ_u : 0 < Δ_u) (hB_cut : 0 < B_cut) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη_Δ : 4 * η ≤ Δ_u) (hR_bud : 128 * (η + ξ) ≤ R_bud)
    (hC_cut : 2 ≤ C_cut) (hC_Bes : 1 ≤ C_Bes) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov)
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) (hC_rtail : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_rtail M) :
    ∃ ε_root : ℝ, 0 < ε_root ∧ ε_root < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_ret : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let q_r := sub.loc_idx.1
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α * g_at α v
        let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
        let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
        let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
        let ζ'₀ := localGaugeGrad ζ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
        let h'_sub := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_sub
        let H'_P := H_P - r - 2 * b_star
        let L' := L - r - b_star
        let R'_dom := 8 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 20
        let K_sub := generalPacketRootScore ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub
        ε < ε_root →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ L - t → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
        ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
         (0 < r ∧ m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2))) →
        m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
          m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
        ε ^ (B_cut + ξ) ≤ sub.m_bin →
        (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h_sub MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.MemLp h_sub 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
        (∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) →
        (∀ R_d : ℝ, 1 ≤ R_d →
          (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R_d, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤
            C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) ∧
          ∀ (b_F a_F R_cap : ℝ) (M_cap : ℕ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
            2 ≤ R_cap → 3 ≤ M_cap → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
            F_sites ⊆ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R_d →
            (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
            let S_cap := Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
              let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
              let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
              |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀)
            ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤
              C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) +
              C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2)) →
        (0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 → K_sub ≤ subclassProxyA ε sub + R_bud) ∧
        (∀ (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
           (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
           IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
             lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
           (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
             cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
             b_star ≤ b_D d ∧
             0 < generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) →
           0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 ∧
           ∃ (N_Oj : ℕ) (r_loc_O : Fin N_Oj → ℕ)
             (V'_O_loc X'_O_loc : Fin N_Oj → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
             (ψ_O_loc : Fin N_Oj → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
             (b'_D a'_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r'_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
             (V'_D X'_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
             (p_loc : Fin N_Oj → Fin N_D → ℝ),
             2 * Δ_u ≤ H'_P ∧ t - r ≤ H'_P ∧ t - r ≤ L' ∧
             IsValidPacketEnv (localRescaledClass cls 1) ε H'_P L' lam_loc Φ'₀ ζ'₀ h'_sub ∧
             (let loc_d := localRescaledClass cls (t - r)
              H'_P ≤ (t - r) * loc_d.K_hor ∧ L' ≤ (t - r) * loc_d.K_hor ∧
              loc_d.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H'_P) ≤ lam_loc ∧ lam_loc ≤ loc_d.B_sys * ε ^ (-H'_P) ∧
              loc_d.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
              ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ loc_d.B_sys * ε ^ (t - r) ∧
              IsNormalizedPosDefPhase loc_d.a₀ loc_d.a₁ loc_d.A Φ'₀ ζ'₀ ∧
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h'_sub MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              (∀ v', loc_d.R_dom ≤ ‖v'‖ → h'_sub v' = 0) ∧
              MeasureTheory.MemLp h'_sub 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              0 < ∫ v', ‖h'_sub v'‖ ^ 2 ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H'_P L' (t - r) loc_d.B_sys loc_d.R_win
                loc_d.N_mult loc_d.M_win lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc
                b'_D a'_D r'_D e_D V'_D X'_D p_loc ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H'_P L' (t - r) (localRescaledClass cls 1).B_sys
                (localRescaledClass cls 1).R_win (localRescaledClass cls 1).N_mult
                (localRescaledClass cls 1).M_win lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc
                b'_D a'_D r'_D e_D V'_D X'_D p_loc ∧
              generalPacketScore ε γ H'_P (t - r) lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc b'_D a'_D p_loc =
              subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
                r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond)) ∧
        (0 < r → b_star = 0 → (H_P - r) / 2 ≤ L - r → 0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 →
          ∀ ζ_g : ℝ, 0 < ζ_g → 32 * R_bud ≤ ζ_g →
            subclassProxyA ε sub - K_sub + R_bud ≤ ζ_g / 8 →
            2 * ((H_P - r) / 2) + ζ_g < sub.g_bin →
            HasRootWidthGap (ζ_g / 16) (ζ_g / 4) ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub)

subgoal_signatures.name: earlier_laws_and_endpoint_composition
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u A₀ ξ R_bud C_can C_cov : ℝ)
    (use_vel_sub : Bool) (d_dim M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΔ_u : 0 < Δ_u) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hR_bud : 128 * ξ ≤ R_bud)
    (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hC_can : 1 ≤ C_can) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult)
    (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) :
    ∃ ε_law : ℝ, 0 < ε_law ∧ ε_law < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (M_L : ℕ) (ε H_P L t r h b_star lam_sys : ℝ)
