signature.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hβ_pos : 0 < quantumPacketRate γ)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_cl : ClassicalLineGrowthBound γ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (h_coh : CoherentStripMassBoundValid) :
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h_slk ζ_slk A_win ξ C_cov e_slk : ℝ)
       (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 < h_slk → 0 < ζ_slk → 4 * h_slk ≤ ζ_slk →
      0 < A_win → 0 < ξ → 2 ≤ C_cov → 1 ≤ M_mult → (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) →
      0 < e_slk → 16 * ξ ≤ e_slk →
      ∃ ε_slk : ℝ, 0 < ε_slk ∧ ε_slk < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          let r := t - 2 * h_slk
          ε < ε_slk → 0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
          m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
            m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
          (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
            cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
            b_star ≤ b_D d ∧ ζ_slk ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 - a_D d ∧
            (let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
             let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
             let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
             let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
             let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
               ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
                 Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
             ε ^ A_win ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) →
          subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
            r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond ≤
            subclassProxyA ε sub + γ * h_slk + e_slk) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h e₀ ζ_sh A_win ξ C_cov e_al : ℝ)
       (M_L M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 < h → 64 * h < γ * e₀ → 0 < ζ_sh → 0 < A_win → 0 < ξ →
      2 ≤ C_cov → 64 ≤ M_L → (64 * C_cov * cls.B_sys : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ) →
      1 ≤ M_mult → (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) →
      0 < e_al → e_al ≤ γ * e₀ → 64 * (ζ_sh + ξ) ≤ e_al →
      ∃ ε_al : ℝ, 0 < ε_al ∧ ε_al < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (b_ref a_ref : ℝ),
          let r := t - 2 * h
          let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
          ε < ε_al → 0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P → (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          0 ≤ b_star → b_star + 2 * h ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
          e₀ ≤ a_ref - b_ref → |(H_P - t) / 2 - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh → |b_star - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh →
          |(b_star + sub.a_loc) - (H_P - r) / 2| ≤ ζ_sh → e₀ ≤ sub.a_loc - sub.b_loc →
          m_r = Nat.floor (r * ell / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
            m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
          (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
            let p_c := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1
              (gridPt2D (ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)) (sub.o_at α).1)
              (gridPt2D ((lam_sys * ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2))⁻¹) (sub.o_at α).2)
            2 * ε ^ h < projAngleDist (perp2D (sub.e_cap α))
              (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c))) →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
          (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
            cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
            |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧
            projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d))
              (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L
                (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)))) ≤
              ε ^ (4 * h) ∧
            (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              let q_r := r_O o / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
              let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
              let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
              ‖v' - V_O o‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) →
              ‖x' - (X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o)‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ (r + (H_P - t) / 2) →
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x')) ∧
            (let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
             let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
             let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
             let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
             let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
               ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
                 Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
             ε ^ A_win ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) →
          2 * γ * e₀ - 20 * h - e_al ≤
            (Real.log ((sub.N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret : ℝ)) / ell) +
            4 * (subclassProxyA ε sub + 2 * quantumPacketRate γ * h -
              subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
                r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_build_ana :
      ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h_step ξ C_cov : ℝ) (M_mult M_ord : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ),
        0 < h_step → 2 ≤ C_cov → 1 ≤ M_mult → 2 ≤ M_ord →
        ∃ (C_sub_bes C_at_cnt B_V B_X C_far : ℝ),
          1 ≤ C_sub_bes ∧ 1 ≤ C_at_cnt ∧ C_cov ≤ B_V ∧ 2 ≤ B_X ∧ 0 ≤ C_far ∧
          ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
            (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
            (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
            (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
            (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
            (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
            let r := t - 2 * h_step
            let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
            let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
            let s_v := ε ^ b_star
            let s_x := s_c * s_v
            let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
            let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
            let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
            let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
            let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
            let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
            let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
            let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
              (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
                Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
            0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
            IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
            0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
            m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
            cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
            IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
              m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
            IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
              lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
            (ε ^ r ≤ s_c ∧ s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r ∧
             (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ (2 * h_step) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
             ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (2 * h_step) ∧
             (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_sub_bes * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) ∧
             (N_ret : ℝ) ≤ C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) ∧
            (∀ o : Fin N_O, cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx →
              let r_loc := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
              let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
              r_O o = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
              r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
              ‖V_O o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x ∧
              ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
                (B_V * ρ_t ≤ ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ →
                  generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
                    (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) = 0) ∧
                (∀ R_tr : ℝ, B_X ≤ R_tr →
                  R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_O o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ →
                  generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
                    (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤ C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))))) ∧
            (∀ (r_i : ℕ), r_i < 2 ^ m_t →
              ∀ (S_obs : Finset (Fin N_O)), (∀ o ∈ S_obs, r_O o = r_i) →
              ∀ (S_at : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
                ∑ o ∈ S_obs, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                  (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_at, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
                  (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
                  C_sub_bes * ∑ α ∈ S_at, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) ∧
            (letI := Classical.propDecidable
             ∀ o : Fin N_O,
               (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Finset (Fin N_ret)), Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
                 generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                   (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
                   (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
                 2 * generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                   (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
                   (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) +
                 2 * ∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
                   generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
                     (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) ∧
               (∀ (I : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (F_part : (ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (Fin N_ret)),
                 (∀ i₁ ∈ I, ∀ i₂ ∈ I, i₁ ≠ i₂ → Disjoint (F_part i₁) (F_part i₂)) →
                 generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                   (fun v => ∑ α ∈ I.biUnion F_part, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
                   (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
                 (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
                   generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                     (fun v => ∑ α ∈ F_part i, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
                     (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) := by
    intro cls h_step ξ C_cov M_mult M_ord C_tr hh_step hC_cov hM_mult hM_ord
    have h81 : 1 ≤ 81 * M_mult := by omega
    obtain ⟨C_Bes1, hCB1_ge, h_bes1⟩ :=
      equal_time_packed_wave_packet_bessel cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A 4 (81 * M_mult)
        (fun k => max (M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) 1)
        cls.ha₀ cls.ha₁ cls.hA (by norm_num) h81
    obtain ⟨C_Bes2, C_cnt, hCB2_ge, hCcnt_ge, h_bes2⟩ :=
      admissible_packet_fixed_time_bessel cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.K_hor
        cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        cls.ha₀ cls.ha₁ cls.hA cls.hB_sys cls.hK_hor cls.hR_win cls.hN_mult
    obtain ⟨B_amp, D_phase, C_at_cnt, B_V, B_X, hCat_ge, hBV_ge, _, hBX_ge2, h_s4⟩ :=
      subclass_atom_packing_and_far_phase_bounds cls M_atom C_cov M_mult M_ord
        hC_cov hM_mult hM_ord
    obtain ⟨C_ibp, hCibp_nn, h_ibp⟩ :=
      nonstationary_phase_1d_arbitrary_ibp M_ord 4 (by norm_num) B_amp D_phase
    let C_sub_bes : ℝ := max C_cnt (C_Bes2 * C_Bes1)
    let C_far : ℝ := (8 * C_ibp / (cls.a₀ / 2) ^ M_ord) ^ 2
    have hCsub_ge : 1 ≤ C_sub_bes := le_trans hCcnt_ge (le_max_left _ _)
    have hCcnt_le : C_cnt ≤ C_sub_bes := le_max_left _ _
    have hCB_prod_le : C_Bes2 * C_Bes1 ≤ C_sub_bes := le_max_right _ _
    have hCfar_nn : 0 ≤ C_far := sq_nonneg _
    refine ⟨C_sub_bes, C_at_cnt, B_V, B_X, C_far, hCsub_ge, hCat_ge, hBV_ge, hBX_ge2, hCfar_nn, ?_⟩
    intro ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret Φ₀ ζ₀ f
      r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D sub p_cond
      r s_c C_r s_v s_x V_J X_J ρ_r σ_r ρ_t V_at X_at g_at
      hr_pos _ _ ht_HP henv hb0 hb_ut hm_r_eq hmr_le_mt hmt1 hmt2 hsub hadm
    have hr_lt_t : r < t := by dsimp only [r]; linarith only [hh_step]
    have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := by linarith only [hr_pos, hr_lt_t]
    have htr_eq : t - r = 2 * h_step := by dsimp only [r]; ring
    have ⟨hε₀, hε₁, _, hHP_K, _, _, hlam_lo, hlam_hi, h_phase, _⟩ := henv
    have ⟨hadm_site, hadm_sm, hadm_supp, hadm_der, hadm_pack, _⟩ := hadm
    obtain ⟨h4_1, h4_2, h4_2b, h4_3⟩ :=
      h_s4 γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ m_r m_t N_ret C_tr Φ₀ ζ₀ f sub
        hr_pos hr_lt_t ht_HP henv hb0 hb_ut hm_r_eq hmr_le_mt hmt1 hmt2 hsub
    obtain ⟨hs_c1, hs_c2, hm_tr1, hm_tr2, hlam_pos, hρ_pos, hρ_le1, hCr_mem,
        hNret_bd, hw_reg, h_pack81⟩ := h4_1
    rw [htr_eq] at hm_tr1 hm_tr2
    obtain ⟨hNO_cnt, h_obs_bes⟩ :=
      h_bes2 ε H_P t lam_sys m_t hε₀ hε₁ ht_nn ht_HP hHP_K hlam_lo hlam_hi hmt1
        Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase N_O r_O V_O X_O ψ_O hadm_site hadm_sm hadm_supp hadm_der
        (fun r₀ v₀ x₀ => le_of_eq_of_le (by congr) (hadm_pack r₀ v₀ x₀))
    have hNO_bd : (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_sub_bes * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) :=
      le_trans hNO_cnt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCcnt_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _))
    have h_ibp_6 :
        ∀ (L_osc : ℝ), 0 < L_osc →
          ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
            (∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 → L_osc ≤ deriv θ s) →
            (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 →
              |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) s| ≤ L_osc * D_phase m) →
          ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
            (∀ s : ℝ, 4 ≤ |s| → u s = 0) →
            (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u s‖ ≤ B_amp k) →
            ‖∫ s : ℝ, u s * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ s : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L_osc ^ M_ord := by
      intro L_osc hL_osc θ hθ_sm hθ_lo hθ_hi u hu_sm hu_supp hu_bd
      exact h_ibp L_osc hL_osc θ hθ_sm
        (fun s hs => hθ_lo s (by linarith only [hs]))

subgoal_signatures.name: equal_time_packed_wave_packet_bessel
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_w : ℝ) (N_pack : ℕ) (M_w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hRw : 2 ≤ R_w) (hN_pack : 1 ≤ N_pack) :
    ∃ C_Bes : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam ρ₀ c₀ : ℝ),
        0 < lam → 0 < ρ₀ → ρ₀ ≤ 1 → c₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (V X : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (w : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ α : Fin N, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (w α)) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_w ≤ ‖z‖ → w α z = 0) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (w α) z‖ ≤ M_w k)) →
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let σ₀ := (lam * ρ₀)⁻¹
         ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N =>
             ‖V α - v₀‖ ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ‖X α - x₀‖ ≤ σ₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_pack : ℝ)) →
        let φ := fun (α : Fin N) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * w α (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V α)) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (c₀, X α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        (∀ c : Fin N → ℂ,
          let H := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ∑ α : Fin N, c α * φ α v
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖H v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖H v‖ ^ 2 ≤
            C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N, ‖c α‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          ∑ α : Fin N, ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), h v * star (φ α v)‖ ^ 2 ≤
            C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: admissible_packet_fixed_time_bessel
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys K_hor R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hK_hor : 1 ≤ K_hor) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult) :
    ∃ (C_Bes C_cnt : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧ 1 ≤ C_cnt ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ t → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (N_O : ℕ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
        (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ B_sys) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
        (let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
         let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
         ∀ (r : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
             r_O o = r ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤
             (N_mult : ℝ)) →
        ((N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * K_hor))) ∧
        (∀ (r : ℕ), r < 2 ^ m_time →
          ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_O)), (∀ o ∈ S, r_O o = r) →
          ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
            ∑ o ∈ S, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ h
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
              C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: nonstationary_phase_1d_arbitrary_ibp
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (B D : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ C_ibp : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ibp ∧
      ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L →
      ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 → L ≤ deriv θ t) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 →
          |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| ≤ L * D m) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u t‖ ≤ B k) →
        ‖∫ t : ℝ, u t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ t : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L ^ M

subgoal_signatures.name: subclass_atom_packing_and_far_phase_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (C_cov : ℝ) (M_mult M_ord : ℕ)
    (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hM_ord : 2 ≤ M_ord) :
    ∃ (B_amp D_phase : ℕ → ℝ) (C_at_cnt B_V B_X : ℝ),
      1 ≤ C_at_cnt ∧ C_cov ≤ B_V ∧ C_cov ≤ B_X ∧ 2 ≤ B_X ∧
      ∀ (γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_ret : ℕ)
        (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret),
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        0 < r → r < t → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
          m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
        (ε ^ r ≤ s_c ∧ s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r ∧
         (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
         ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (t - r) ∧
         0 < lam_sys ∧ 0 < ρ_r ∧ ρ_r ≤ 1 ∧ C_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
         (N_ret : ℝ) ≤ C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor)) ∧
         (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
           let w := fun z => star (sub.ψ_at α z)
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w) ∧
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → w z = 0) ∧
           (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
             ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k w z‖ ≤
               max (M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) 1)) ∧
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
              ‖V_at α - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_r ∧ ‖X_at α - x₀‖ ≤ σ_r)).card : ℝ) ≤
              ((81 * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ))) ∧
        (∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →
          cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx V_o X_o = sub.loc_idx →
          let r_loc := r_idx % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
          let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          r_idx = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
          r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
          C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
          ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x) ∧
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
           (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Finset (Fin N_ret)), Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
             2 * generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o +
             2 * ∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o) ∧
           (∀ (I : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (F_part : (ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (Fin N_ret)),
             (∀ i₁ ∈ I, ∀ i₂ ∈ I, i₁ ≠ i₂ → Disjoint (F_part i₁) (F_part i₂)) →
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ I.biUnion F_part, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
             (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                 (fun v => ∑ α ∈ F_part i, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o)) ∧
        (∀ (C_ibp : ℝ), 0 ≤ C_ibp →
          (∀ (L_osc : ℝ), 0 < L_osc →
            ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
              (∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 → L_osc ≤ deriv θ s) →
              (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 →
                |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) s| ≤ L_osc * D_phase m) →
            ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
              (∀ s : ℝ, 4 ≤ |s| → u s = 0) →
              (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u s‖ ≤ B_amp k) →
              ‖∫ s : ℝ, u s * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ s : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L_osc ^ M_ord) →
          ∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

            r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →

            (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
            let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
            ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
              (B_V * ρ_t ≤ ‖V_o - V_at α‖ →
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o = 0) ∧
              (∀ R_tr : ℝ, B_X ≤ R_tr →
                R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ →

subgoal_signatures.name: contributor_sampling_and_resampling_entropy
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) :
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    (∀ {N_O N_D S_bins : ℕ} (hS : 1 ≤ S_bins)
       (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ) (w_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
       (bin_D : Fin N_D → Fin S_bins),
       (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
       (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) → 0 < m_O o) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let score_fn := fun q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ =>
         let q_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
         let q_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d
         (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +
         (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) / ell) +
         (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) +
         (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * w_D d)
       let π_b := fun b : Fin S_bins =>
         ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => bin_D d = b), p o d
       let p_b := fun (b : Fin S_bins) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) =>
         if bin_D d = b ∧ 0 < π_b b then p o d / π_b b else 0
       (∀ b, 0 ≤ π_b b) ∧ (∑ b : Fin S_bins, π_b b = 1) ∧
       (∀ b, 0 < π_b b → (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_b b o d) ∧ (∑ o, ∑ d, p_b b o d = 1) ∧
         (∀ o d, 0 < p_b b o d → bin_D d = b ∧ 0 < p o d)) ∧
       score_fn p ≤ (∑ b : Fin S_bins, if 0 < π_b b then π_b b * score_fn (p_b b) else 0) +
         Real.log (S_bins : ℝ) / ell) ∧
    (∀ {N_O N_D N_Z N_T N_R : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ)
       (Z_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_Z) (r_Z : Fin N_Z → Fin N_R) (r_D : Fin N_D → Fin N_R)
       (T_of_Z : Fin N_Z → Finset (Fin N_T)) {K_mass : ℝ} {M_amb : ℕ},
       0 < K_mass → 1 ≤ M_amb →
       (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
       (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) → 0 < m_O o) →
       (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → r_Z (Z_of o) = r_D d) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ z : Fin N_Z, (0 < ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), ∑ d, p o d) →
          (T_of_Z z).Nonempty ∧
          (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z),
            if 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d then m_O o else 0) ≤
            K_mass * ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ)) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (rv : Fin N_R),
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin N_Z => r_Z z = rv ∧ α ∈ T_of_Z z)).card : ℝ) ≤
            (M_amb : ℝ)) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
       let p_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p o d
       let p_ZD := fun z d => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), p o d
       let q := fun (z : Fin N_Z) (d : Fin N_D) (α : Fin N_T) =>
         if α ∈ T_of_Z z then p_ZD z d / ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ) else 0
       let q_T := fun α => ∑ z, ∑ d, q z d α
       let q_TD := fun α d => ∑ z, q z d α
       let q_TR := fun α rv => ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => r_Z z = rv), ∑ d, q z d α
       (∀ z d α, 0 ≤ q z d α) ∧ (∑ z, ∑ d, ∑ α, q z d α = 1) ∧
       (∀ z d α, 0 < q z d α → α ∈ T_of_Z z ∧ ∃ o, Z_of o = z ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
       ((∑ o, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, p_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) ≤
        (∑ α, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d))) / ell) +
        (∑ α, ∑ rv, -(q_TR α rv * Real.log (q_TR α rv / q_T α))) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (M_amb : ℝ) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log K_mass / ell))) ∧
    ((∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},
       0 < B_fib → (∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) → (∑ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ y : Fin N_Y, (0 < ∑ x, P x y) →
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin N_X => 0 < P x y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib) →
       let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x, P x y
       (∑ x, ∑ y, -(P x y * Real.log (P x y / P_Y y))) / ell ≤ Real.log B_fib / ell) ∧
     (∀ {N_T N_D N_E N_M N_U : ℕ} (P : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ)
       (E_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_E) (M_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_M) (U_of : Fin N_D → Fin N_U)
       {K_EM : ℕ},
       1 ≤ N_E → 1 ≤ K_EM →
       (∀ α d, 0 ≤ P α d) → (∑ α, ∑ d, P α d = 1) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ e : Fin N_E,
          (((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e)).image M_of).card : ℝ) ≤ (K_EM : ℝ)) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let P_T := fun α => ∑ d, P α d
       let P_D := fun d => ∑ α, P α d
       let P_E := fun e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P_T α
       let P_DE := fun d e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P α d
       let P_M := fun m => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m), P_T α
       let P_MU := fun m u =>
         ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m),
           ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => U_of d = u), P α d
       let Q_TU := fun α u =>
         if 0 < P_M (M_of α) then P_T α * (P_MU (M_of α) u / P_M (M_of α)) else 0
       let Q_U := fun u => ∑ α, Q_TU α u
       (∀ α u, 0 ≤ Q_TU α u) ∧ (∑ α, ∑ u, Q_TU α u = 1) ∧
       (∀ α u, 0 < Q_TU α u → 0 < P_T α ∧
         ∃ α₀ d₀, M_of α₀ = M_of α ∧ U_of d₀ = u ∧ 0 < P α₀ d₀) ∧
       ((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α))) / ell - Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤
         (∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell) ∧
       (((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell -
         (∑ α, ∑ d, -(P α d * Real.log (P α d / P_DE d (E_of α)))) / ell) ≤
        ((∑ α, ∑ u, -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (Q_TU α u / Q_U u))) / ell -
         (∑ α, ∑ d, -(P α d * Real.log (P α d / P_D d))) / ell) +
        Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) / ell)))

subgoal_signatures.name: slack_classical_line_exclusion
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_cl : ClassicalLineGrowthBound γ)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h_slk ζ_slk A_win ξ C_cov e_slk : ℝ)
    (M_mult M_ord : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (C_sub_bes C_at_cnt B_V B_X C_far : ℝ)
    (hh_slk : 0 < h_slk) (hζ_slk : 0 < ζ_slk) (h4h : 4 * h_slk ≤ ζ_slk)
    (hA_win : 0 < A_win) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov)
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M)
    (he_slk : 0 < e_slk) (h16ξ : 16 * ξ ≤ e_slk)
    (hC_bes : 1 ≤ C_sub_bes) (hC_at : 1 ≤ C_at_cnt)
    (hBV : C_cov ≤ B_V) (hBX : 2 ≤ B_X) (hC_far : 0 ≤ C_far)
    (hM_ord_gt : 10 * cls.K_hor + ξ + 2 < (2 * (M_ord : ℝ)) * min (h_slk / 4) (e_slk / 128))
    (h_ana : ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
      (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      let r := t - 2 * h_slk
      let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
      let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
      let s_v := ε ^ b_star
      let s_x := s_c * s_v
      let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
      let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
      let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
      let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
      let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
      let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
      let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
      let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
        (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *

      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
      0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
      m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
      cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
      IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
        m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
      (ε ^ r ≤ s_c ∧ s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r ∧
       (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ (2 * h_slk) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
       ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (2 * h_slk) ∧
       (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_sub_bes * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) ∧
       (N_ret : ℝ) ≤ C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) ∧
      (∀ o : Fin N_O, cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx →
        let r_loc := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
        let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
        r_O o = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
        r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
        ‖V_O o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x ∧
        ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
          (B_V * ρ_t ≤ ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ →
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)

          (∀ R_tr : ℝ, B_X ≤ R_tr →

      (∀ (r_i : ℕ), r_i < 2 ^ m_t →
        ∀ (S_obs : Finset (Fin N_O)), (∀ o ∈ S_obs, r_O o = r_i) →

      (letI := Classical.propDecidable
       ∀ o : Fin N_O,
         (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Finset (Fin N_ret)), Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
           generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
             (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)

             (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
             (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) +
           2 * ∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)

         (∀ (I : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (F_part : (ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (Fin N_ret)),

           generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
             (fun v => ∑ α ∈ I.biUnion F_part, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
             (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
           (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,

               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ F_part i, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))))
    (h_ent : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      (∀ {N_O N_D S_bins : ℕ} (hS : 1 ≤ S_bins)
         (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ) (w_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
         (bin_D : Fin N_D → Fin S_bins),
         (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
         (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) → 0 < m_O o) →
         letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let score_fn := fun q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ =>

           let q_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d

           (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) / ell) +

         let π_b := fun b : Fin S_bins =>

         (∀ b, 0 < π_b b → (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_b b o d) ∧ (∑ o, ∑ d, p_b b o d = 1) ∧

         score_fn p ≤ (∑ b : Fin S_bins, if 0 < π_b b then π_b b * score_fn (p_b b) else 0) +
           Real.log (S_bins : ℝ) / ell) ∧
      (∀ {N_O N_D N_Z N_T N_R : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ)
         (Z_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_Z) (r_Z : Fin N_Z → Fin N_R) (r_D : Fin N_D → Fin N_R)
         (T_of_Z : Fin N_Z → Finset (Fin N_T)) {K_mass : ℝ} {M_amb : ℕ},
         0 < K_mass → 1 ≤ M_amb →
         (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
         (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) → 0 < m_O o) →
         (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → r_Z (Z_of o) = r_D d) →
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ z : Fin N_Z, (0 < ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), ∑ d, p o d) →
            (T_of_Z z).Nonempty ∧
            (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z),
              if 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d then m_O o else 0) ≤
              K_mass * ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ)) →
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (rv : Fin N_R),
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin N_Z => r_Z z = rv ∧ α ∈ T_of_Z z)).card : ℝ) ≤
              (M_amb : ℝ)) →
         letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
         let p_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p o d
         let p_ZD := fun z d => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), p o d
         let q := fun (z : Fin N_Z) (d : Fin N_D) (α : Fin N_T) =>
           if α ∈ T_of_Z z then p_ZD z d / ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ) else 0
         let q_T := fun α => ∑ z, ∑ d, q z d α
         let q_TD := fun α d => ∑ z, q z d α
         let q_TR := fun α rv => ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => r_Z z = rv), ∑ d, q z d α
         (∀ z d α, 0 ≤ q z d α) ∧ (∑ z, ∑ d, ∑ α, q z d α = 1) ∧

  have h_coarse_vel_dist : ∀ (M_L : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (τ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

      ‖gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at α).1 - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_r ∧ ‖gridPt2D σ_r (o_at α).2 - x₀‖ ≤ σ_r)
    have h_maps : ∀ α ∈ S, o_at α ∈ box := by

      have hv0 : |ρ_r * (((o_at α).1.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) - v₀ 0| ≤ ρ_r :=

      have hv1 : |ρ_r * (((o_at α).1.2 : ℤ) : ℝ) - v₀ 1| ≤ ρ_r :=

      · exact le_rfl
    · have h_inner : ∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ d : Fin N_D,
          (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), q_cand j o d α) =
            if win_of o = j then q o d / π_q j else 0 := by
        intro o d
        by_cases hw : win_of o = j
        · by_cases hq0 : q o d = 0
          · rw [if_pos hw, hq0, zero_div]
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α _ => ?_)
            dsimp only [q_cand]
            rw [hq0, zero_div, zero_div]
            split_ifs <;> rfl
          · have hq_pos : 0 < q o d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq_nn o d) (Ne.symm hq0)
            have hne_T : (T_cand j (Q_of j o)).Nonempty := by
              have h1 := (h_act_geom o d hq_pos).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
              rwa [hw] at h1
            have hcard_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((T_cand j (Q_of j o)).card : ℝ) := by
              exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hne_T
            have hsum_α : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), q_cand j o d α) =
                ∑ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o), (q o d / π_q j) / ((T_cand j (Q_of j o)).card : ℝ) := by
              have h_ite : ∀ α : Fin (N_ret_of j),
                  q_cand j o d α =
                    if α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o) then
                      (q o d / π_q j) / ((T_cand j (Q_of j o)).card : ℝ)
                    else 0 := by
                intro α
                dsimp only [q_cand]
                by_cases hα : α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o)
                · rw [if_pos ⟨hw, hπj, hα⟩, if_pos hα]
                · rw [if_neg (fun h => hα h.2.2), if_neg hα]
              rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => h_ite α), ← Finset.sum_filter,
                Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
            rw [hsum_α, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hcard_pos.ne', if_pos hw]
        · rw [if_neg hw]
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α _ => ?_)
          dsimp only [q_cand]
          exact if_neg (fun h => hw h.1)
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_inner o d))]
      have h_sum_d : ∀ o : Fin N_O,
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, if win_of o = j then q o d / π_q j else 0) =
            if win_of o = j then (∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d) / π_q j else 0 := by
        intro o
        by_cases hw : win_of o = j
        · rw [if_pos hw, Finset.sum_div]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => if_pos hw)
        · rw [if_neg hw]
          exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => if_neg hw)
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h_sum_d o), ← Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_div]
      exact div_self hπj.ne'
    · intro o d α hqc_pos
      dsimp only [q_cand] at hqc_pos
      by_cases hcond : win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_q j ∧ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o)
      · rw [if_pos hcond] at hqc_pos
        obtain ⟨hw_o, _, hα_mem⟩ := hcond
        subst hw_o
        have hq_od : 0 < q o d := by
          by_contra hle
          have h0 : q o d = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hle) (hq_nn o d)
          rw [h0, zero_div, zero_div] at hqc_pos
          exact lt_irrefl 0 hqc_pos
        have hp_od := (hsupp_q o d hq_od).1
        have hps := hp_supp o d hp_od
        have hqa := hq_act o d hq_od
        have hag := h_act_geom o d hq_od
        have had := hadm_d d
        have h_α_bd := hag.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 α hα_mem
        exact ⟨(hadm_site o).1, hqa.2.1, hps.1.symm, had.1, hps.2.2.1, had.2.1,
          le_trans had.2.2.1 (min_le_right _ _), had.2.2.2.2,
          hps.2.2.2.1, hps.2.2.2.2.1, hps.2.2.2.2.2.1,
          hqa.2.2.1, hqa.2.2.2.1, hqa.2.2.2.2.1, hqa.2.2.2.2.2,
          h_α_bd.1, h_α_bd.2⟩
      · rw [if_neg hcond] at hqc_pos
        exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hqc_pos)

  have h_mid_7 :=
    h_s7 ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J Φ₀
      r_O V_O X_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D N_ret_of menu π_q q_cand
      hε₀ hε_lt_cl hr_pos ht_le1 ht_L ht_HP hHP_K hL_K
      hb_star_nn hu_ge hu_plus_h_Lr hd2_bstar hm_r_eq hmr_le_mt
      hlam_lo hlam_hi hmt1 hmt2 hπ_q_nn hπ_q_sum h_qcand_props

  let q_T := fun j α => ∑ o, ∑ d, q_cand j o d α
  let q_TD := fun j α d => ∑ o, q_cand j o d α
  let q_D := fun j d => ∑ o, ∑ α, q_cand j o d α
  let q_TR := fun j α (rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r))) =>
    ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) = rl.1),
      ∑ d, q_cand j o d α

  have h_qT_ent : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_q j →
      (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), -(q_T j α * Real.log (q_T j α))) / ell ≤
        Real.log (N_ret_of j : ℝ) / ell := by
    intro j hπj
    obtain ⟨_, hqc_nn, hqc_sum, _⟩ := h_qcand_props j hπj
    refine h_entropy_ub (q_T j) (h_menu_proxy j).1 hell_pos
      (fun α => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hqc_nn o d α))) ?_
    dsimp only [q_T]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hcomm2 : (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_cand j o d α) =
        ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), q_cand j o d α :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
    rw [hcomm2]
    exact hqc_sum

  have h_sum_split :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, if 0 < π_q j then π_q j * (
        (∑ α, -(q_T j α * Real.log (q_T j α))) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (menu j).m_bin / ell) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (
          (∑ d, q_D j d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)) +
          (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD j α d * Real.log (q_TD j α d / q_D j d))) / ell +
          2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r)),
            -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell) +
          k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h))
       else 0) ≤
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * (Real.log (N_ret_of j : ℝ) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (menu j).m_bin / ell))) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : Fin N_J, if 0 < π_q j then π_q j * (
        (∑ d, q_D j d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)) +
        (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD j α d * Real.log (q_TD j α d / q_D j d))) / ell +
        2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r)),
          -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell))
       else 0) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) := by
    have h_kout_sum : (∑ j : Fin N_J, if 0 < π_q j then π_q j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h)) else 0) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) := by
      have h1 : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
          (if 0 < π_q j then π_q j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h)) else 0) =
            π_q j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h)) := by
        intro j
        by_cases h0 : π_q j = 0
        · rw [h0, if_neg (lt_irrefl 0), zero_mul]
        · rw [if_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_q_nn j) (Ne.symm h0))]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => h1 j), ← Finset.sum_mul, hπ_q_sum, one_mul]
    rw [← h_kout_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
    by_cases h0 : π_q j = 0
    · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [h0, lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte,
        zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, le_refl]
    · have hpos : 0 < π_q j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_q_nn j) (Ne.symm h0)
      simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hpos, ↓reduceIte]
      have hent := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_qT_ent j hpos) hpos.le
      have hring_j :
          π_q j * ((∑ α, -(q_T j α * Real.log (q_T j α))) / ell +
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (menu j).m_bin / ell) +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ d, q_D j d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)) +
              (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD j α d * Real.log (q_TD j α d / q_D j d))) / ell +
              2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r)),
                -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell) +
              k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h)) =
          π_q j * ((∑ α, -(q_T j α * Real.log (q_T j α))) / ell) +
          π_q j * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (menu j).m_bin / ell)) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (π_q j * ((∑ d, q_D j d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)) +
            (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD j α d * Real.log (q_TD j α d / q_D j d))) / ell +
            2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r)),
              -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell))) +
          π_q j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h)) := by ring
      have hring_r :
          π_q j * (Real.log (N_ret_of j : ℝ) / ell +
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (menu j).m_bin / ell)) =
          π_q j * (Real.log (N_ret_of j : ℝ) / ell) +
          π_q j * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (menu j).m_bin / ell)) := by ring
      linarith only [hent, hring_j, hring_r]

  have h_proxy_eq :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * (Real.log (N_ret_of j : ℝ) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (menu j).m_bin / ell))) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * (menu j).g_bin) =
      ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    dsimp only [subclassProxyA, ell]
    ring

  have h_log_err : C_ent_info / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (C_cl_info / ell) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (C_ent_info / ell) = A_log / ell := by
    dsimp only [A_log]; ring

  let F_T_fn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ℕ → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
    fun j r_loc α =>
      let V_J := gridPt2D s_v (menu j).loc_idx.2.1
      let X_J := gridPt2D s_x (menu j).loc_idx.2.2
      let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1 - V_J)
      let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2 - X_J)
      let c_end := ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
      (r_loc,
       roundShift2D (ε ^ (u - h)) 0 V'_α,
       roundShift2D (ε ^ (u + h)) 0 (X'_α + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V'_α))
  let π_FTJ := fun j (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) =>
    ∑ o, ∑ d, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft),
      π_q j * q_cand j o d α
  let π_TFTJ := fun j ft α =>
    ∑ o, ∑ d, if F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft then π_q j * q_cand j o d α else 0
  let π_DFTJ := fun j ft d =>
    ∑ o, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft),
      π_q j * q_cand j o d α
  let π_TDFTJ := fun j ft α d =>
    ∑ o, if F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft then π_q j * q_cand j o d α else 0
  let S_FT : Fin N_J → Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := fun j =>
    (Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).image (fun oα : Fin N_O × Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
      F_T_fn j (r_O oα.1 % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) oα.2)
  let I_TD_FTJ : ℝ :=
    (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      if 0 < π_FTJ j ft then
        π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
          (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))
      else 0) / ell

  have h_A' : generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q ≤
      H_Jq + b_star +
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, if 0 < π_q j then π_q j * (
        (∑ α, -(q_T j α * Real.log (q_T j α))) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (menu j).m_bin / ell) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (
          (∑ d, q_D j d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)) +
          (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD j α d * Real.log (q_TD j α d / q_D j d))) / ell +
          2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r)),
            -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell) +
          k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h))
       else 0) +
      4 * θ + 2 * ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ_sh +
      (7 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell) + C_ent_info / ell :=
    le_of_le_of_eq h_sc_A (by congr)

  have h_B' : H_in - 6 * θ - ζ_sh - (Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell) - C_ent_info / ell ≤
      I_TD_FTJ :=
    le_of_le_of_eq h_info_B (by congr)

  have h_7' :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, if 0 < π_q j then π_q j * (
        (∑ d, q_D j d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)) +
        (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD j α d * Real.log (q_TD j α d / q_D j d))) / ell +
        2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r)),
          -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell))
       else 0) ≤
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * (menu j).g_bin) +
      ((d_dim : ℝ) + 2 * γ) * h - I_TD_FTJ +
      2 * θ + 4 * ζ_sh + 2 * ξ + e_rep / 32 + C_cl_info / ell :=
    le_of_eq_of_le (by congr) (le_of_le_of_eq h_mid_7 (by congr))

  have h_Brq_def : B_rq = H_Jq + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j) := rfl

  linarith only [h_A', h_B', h_7', h_sum_split, h_proxy_eq, h_Brq_def, h_log_err,
    hA_log_le, hθ_erep, h64_err, hlog_S_loc, he_rep]

subgoal_signatures.name: admissible_packet_fixed_time_bessel
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys K_hor R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hK_hor : 1 ≤ K_hor) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult) :
    ∃ (C_Bes C_cnt : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧ 1 ≤ C_cnt ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ t → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (N_O : ℕ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
        (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ B_sys) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
        (let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
         let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
         ∀ (r : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
             r_O o = r ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤
             (N_mult : ℝ)) →
        ((N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * K_hor))) ∧
        (∀ (r : ℕ), r < 2 ^ m_time →
          ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_O)), (∀ o ∈ S, r_O o = r) →
          ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
            ∑ o ∈ S, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ h
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
              C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: equal_time_packed_wave_packet_bessel
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_w : ℝ) (N_pack : ℕ) (M_w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hRw : 2 ≤ R_w) (hN_pack : 1 ≤ N_pack) :
    ∃ C_Bes : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam ρ₀ c₀ : ℝ),
        0 < lam → 0 < ρ₀ → ρ₀ ≤ 1 → c₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (V X : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (w : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ α : Fin N, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (w α)) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_w ≤ ‖z‖ → w α z = 0) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (w α) z‖ ≤ M_w k)) →
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let σ₀ := (lam * ρ₀)⁻¹
         ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N =>
             ‖V α - v₀‖ ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ‖X α - x₀‖ ≤ σ₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_pack : ℝ)) →
        let φ := fun (α : Fin N) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * w α (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V α)) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (c₀, X α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        (∀ c : Fin N → ℂ,
          let H := fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ∑ α : Fin N, c α * φ α v
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖H v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖H v‖ ^ 2 ≤
            C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N, ‖c α‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          ∑ α : Fin N, ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), h v * star (φ α v)‖ ^ 2 ≤
            C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: nonstationary_phase_1d_arbitrary_ibp
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (B D : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ C_ibp : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ibp ∧
      ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L →

        (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 → L ≤ deriv θ t) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ R + 2 →
          |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) t| ≤ L * D m) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ |t| → u t = 0) →

subgoal_signatures.name: moderate_vs_huge_mbin_score_reduction
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h ξ C_cov e_rep C_Bes_obs C_cnt_obs : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (he_rep : 0 < e_rep) (h64ξ : 64 * ξ ≤ e_rep)
    (hCBes : 1 ≤ C_Bes_obs) (hCcnt : 1 ≤ C_cnt_obs) :
    ∃ ε_mbin : ℝ, 0 < ε_mbin ∧ ε_mbin < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
        (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
        (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (k_f α_cur k_out : ℝ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let M_thr := ε ^ (-(20 * cls.K_hor + 20))
        0 < ε → ε < ε_mbin → r = t - 2 * h → 0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        H_P ≤ cls.K_hor → L ≤ cls.K_hor →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        0 ≤ k_f → 0 ≤ α_cur → 0 ≤ k_out →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_f α_cur →
        ((N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt_obs * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor))) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O,
          generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
            C_Bes_obs) →
        (∀ j : Fin N_J,
          1 ≤ N_ret_of j ∧ 0 < (menu j).m_bin ∧
          1 ≤ C_cov * ε ^ (-(menu j).g_bin - 2 * ξ)) →
        (∀ (q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (H_in : ℝ),
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D q →
          (∀ o d, 0 < q o d → 0 < p o d ∧ (menu (win_of o)).m_bin ≤ M_thr) →
          (H_in ≤ 0 ∨
           (0 < k_f ∧
            ∃ (L_grid : ℝ) (τ_Vf τ_Xf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
              (n_f : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ),
              let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
              let s_Vf := L_grid * ε ^ (u_t - h)
              let s_Xf := L_grid * ε ^ (t + u_t - h)
              1 ≤ L_grid ∧ L_grid ≤ 4 ∧ (∀ p_c, ‖n_f p_c‖ = 1) ∧
              (∀ o : Fin N_O, (P_f o).1 = r_O o ∧
                ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)‖ ≤ s_Vf ∧
                ‖X_O o - (τ_Xf + gridPt2D s_Xf (P_f o).2.2)‖ ≤ s_Xf ∧
                (d_dim = 1 →
                  |inner ℝ (V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)) (n_f (P_f o)) -
                    ((W_f o).1 : ℝ) * ε ^ u_t| ≤ ε ^ u_t ∧ (W_f o).2 = 0) ∧
                (d_dim = 2 →
                  ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1) - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_t) (W_f o)‖ ≤
                    2 * ε ^ u_t)) ∧
              (d_dim = 1 → ∀ o d, 0 < q o d →
                projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_f (P_f o)) ≤ 4 * ε ^ h) ∧
              (let q_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
               let q_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), q_O o
               let q_PW := fun p_c w =>
                 ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w), q_O o
               H_in ≤ (∑ p_c ∈ Finset.univ.image P_f, ∑ w ∈ Finset.univ.image W_f,
                 -(q_PW p_c w * Real.log (q_PW p_c w / q_P p_c))) / ell))) →
          let π_q := fun j : Fin N_J =>
            ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
          let H_Jq := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_q j * Real.log (π_q j))) / ell
          let B_rq := H_Jq + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
            N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q ≤
            B_rq + γ * h + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - H_in) + e_rep / 2) →
        let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
          ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
        let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
        let B_r := H_J + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
          N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
          B_r + γ * h + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - k_f + α_cur) + e_rep

subgoal_signatures.name: candidate_truncation_and_strip_coherence
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (h_coh : CoherentStripMassBoundValid)
    (h u_min ζ_sh A₀ ξ C_cov e_rep C_Bes_at : ℝ)
    (d_dim M_L M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hu_min : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * h ≤ u_min)
    (hζ_sh : 0 < ζ_sh) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hξ : 0 < ξ)
    (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hML_64 : 64 ≤ M_L) (hML_bound : (64 * C_cov * cls.B_sys : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ))
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M)
    (he_rep : 0 < e_rep) (hCBes_at : 1 ≤ C_Bes_at)
    (h_ibp_gen : ∀ (M : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∀ (B D : ℕ → ℝ),
      ∃ C_ibp : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ibp ∧
        ∀ (L_osc : ℝ), 0 < L_osc →
        ∀ (θ_fn : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ_fn) →
          (∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ R + 2 → L_osc ≤ deriv θ_fn s) →
          (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ R + 2 →
            |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ_fn) s| ≤ L_osc * D m) →
        ∀ (u_fn : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u_fn) →
          (∀ s : ℝ, R ≤ |s| → u_fn s = 0) →
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u_fn s‖ ≤ B k) →
          ‖∫ s : ℝ, u_fn s * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ_fn s : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L_osc ^ M) :
    let θ := min (h / 64) (e_rep / 256)
    ∃ (C_coh_tot : ℝ) (ε_coh : ℝ),
      1 ≤ C_coh_tot ∧ 0 < ε_coh ∧ ε_coh < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (γ ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys k_out : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret S_per_loc : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (S_act : Finset (Fin N_O)),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let r := t - 2 * h
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let u := (H_P - t) / 2 - b_star
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let s_loc := ε ^ (u + h)
        let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
        let σ_loc := (lam_loc * (ε ^ u))⁻¹
        let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let V'_at := fun α => s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
        let X'_at := fun α => s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
        let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
          ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
        let Q_of : Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun o =>
          let p_buf := coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o))
          let r_loc := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
          let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          let X'_o := s_x⁻¹ • (X_O o - X_J - (C_t - C_r) • V_J)
          (p_buf, r_loc, roundShift2D s_loc 0 X'_o)
        let Z_of : Fin N_O → ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun o =>
          let q := Q_of o
          let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          let X'_o := s_x⁻¹ • (X_O o - X_J - (C_t - C_r) • V_J)
          let X_Q := gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2
          if d_dim = 1 then
            (q, (Int.floor (inner ℝ (X'_o - X_Q) (n_buf q.1) / σ_loc), 0))
          else
            (q, roundShift2D σ_loc 0 (X'_o - X_Q))
        let B_Q : ℝ := 4 * C_cov * cls.B_sys + 4
        let T_cand : ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin N_ret) := fun q =>
          let c_end := ((q.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
          let X_Q := gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2
          Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
            coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)) = q.1 ∧
            ‖(X'_at α + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V'_at α) - X_Q‖ ≤ B_Q * (ε ^ (-θ)) * s_loc)
        ε < ε_coh → 0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        1 ≤ S_per_loc → Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell ≤ e_rep / 64 →
        (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ b_star → u_min ≤ u → 0 ≤ k_out → k_out ≤ 3 * h →
        m_r = Nat.floor (r * ell / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
          m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
        sub.m_bin ≤ ε ^ (-(20 * cls.K_hor + 20)) →
        sub.k_bin = k_out →
        (∀ p_buf,
          (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
            let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)
            (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at (V_at α)))).filter
            (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(k_out + ξ))) →
        (∀ c_vec : Fin N_ret → ℂ,
          let H_fn := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, c_vec α *
            ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H_fn MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          MeasureTheory.MemLp H_fn 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          ∫ v, ‖H_fn v‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_Bes_at * ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖c_vec α‖ ^ 2) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_t ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ cls.B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ cls.B_sys ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧
          (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
          (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k)) →
        (let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
         let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
         ∀ (r_i : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
             r_O o = r_i ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤
             (cls.N_mult : ℝ)) →
        (∀ o ∈ S_act,
          cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
          (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
            ‖v' - V_O o‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) →
            ‖x' - (X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o)‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ (r + (H_P - t) / 2) →
            coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
            coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 v' x')) ∧
          (4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2))⁻¹ * ε ^ A₀ ≤
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) →
        ∃ m_site : Fin N_O → ℝ,
          (∀ o ∈ S_act, 0 < m_site o ∧
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
              4 * m_site o ∧
            (T_cand (Q_of o)).Nonempty) ∧
          (∀ q, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q), m_site o ≤
            C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-ξ) * ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin) ∧
          (∀ z, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), m_site o ≤
            C_coh_tot * ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - 2 * ξ) *
              ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin) ∧
          (∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (r_loc : ℕ),
            (((S_act.image Q_of).filter (fun q => q.2.1 = r_loc ∧ α ∈ T_cand q)).card : ℝ) ≤
              C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) ∧
          (∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (d : Fin N_D),
            b_star ≤ b_D d → |(H_P - t) / 2 - a_D d| ≤ ζ_sh →
            (d_dim = 2 → b_D d = (H_P - t) / 2 ∧ a_D d = (H_P - t) / 2) →
            ‖e_D d‖ = 1 →
            (((S_act.filter (fun o =>
              r_O o = r_D d ∧
              |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d + t) ∧
              |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d + t) ∧
              (d_dim = 1 → projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_buf (Q_of o).1) ≤ ε ^ (4 * h)) ∧
              α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o))).image Z_of).card : ℝ) ≤
              C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh))

subgoal_signatures.name: candidate_b1_cancellation_and_incoming_info
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h u_min ζ_sh ξ C_cov e_rep C_coh_tot : ℝ)
    (d_dim M_L : ℕ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hu_min : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * h ≤ u_min)

    (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hML_64 : 64 ≤ M_L) (he_rep : 0 < e_rep) (hC_coh : 1 ≤ C_coh_tot) :
    let θ := min (h / 64) (e_rep / 256)
    ∃ C_ent_info : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_ent_info ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys k_out H_in : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)

subgoal_signatures.statement:

        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let r := t - 2 * h
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let u := (H_P - t) / 2 - b_star
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let F_T_fn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ℕ → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
          fun j r_loc α =>
            let V_J := gridPt2D s_v (menu j).loc_idx.2.1
            let X_J := gridPt2D s_x (menu j).loc_idx.2.2
            let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1 - V_J)

             roundShift2D (ε ^ (u - h)) 0 V'_α,
             roundShift2D (ε ^ (u + h)) 0 (X'_α + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V'_α))
