proof.tactics:
by
  intro η ε_tilde e_loc Δ_r
  have _ := ht₁
  have _ := hb₀
  have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := lt_trans hε₁ (by norm_num)
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := sub_pos.mpr hrt
  have ht₀ : 0 < t := lt_trans hr₀ hrt
  have hε_tilde_pos : 0 < ε_tilde := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ η
  have hε_tilde_lt1 : ε_tilde < 1 := lt_trans hε_tilde (by norm_num)
  have he_loc_nn : 0 ≤ e_loc := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hda) hη_pos.le

  
  have h_s1 :
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r ≤ Δ_r ∧ Δ_r ≤ ε ^ r) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        locTime ε r c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        dyadicTimeMid ε r c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        dyadicTimeBin ε r c =
          (dyadicTimeBin ε t c) / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε t - dyadicTimeLevel ε r)) ∧
        |dyadicTimeMid ε r c - dyadicTimeMid ε t c| ≤ ε ^ r ∧
        |((dyadicTimeBin ε r c : ℝ) + dyadicTimeMid ε_tilde 1 (locTime ε r c)) * Δ_r -
            dyadicTimeMid ε t c| ≤ ε ^ t) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
        angBin ε d θ =
          (angBin ε (a_t - b_t) θ) /
            ((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε (a_t - b_t) - dyadicTimeLevel ε d)) ∧
        |(((angBin ε (a_t - b_t) θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε (a_t - b_t)))⁻¹) -
          (((angBin ε d θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε d))⁻¹)| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) ∧
      (∀ θ' : ℝ, θ' ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi →
        |(((angBin ε_tilde e_loc θ' : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε_tilde e_loc))⁻¹) - θ'| ≤
          (Real.pi / 2) * ε_tilde ^ e_loc) ∧
      (∃ (F_time : ℤ × ℤ → Finset ℤ) (F_kloc : ℤ → Finset ℤ),
        (∀ p, (F_time p).card ≤ 4) ∧
        (∀ k_t, (F_kloc k_t).card ≤ 2) ∧
        (∀ c : ℝ, c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
          let c_loc := locTime ε r c
          dyadicTimeBin ε t c ∈
            F_time (dyadicTimeBin ε r c, dyadicTimeBin ε_tilde 1 c_loc) ∧
          dyadicTimeBin ε_tilde 1 c_loc ∈ F_kloc (dyadicTimeBin ε t c))) := by
    have h_level_pow_lb : ∀ (ε' u : ℝ), 0 < ε' →
        (ε') ^ (-u) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε' u) := by
      intro ε' u _
      calc (ε') ^ (-u) ≤ (⌈(ε') ^ (-u)⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        _ ≤ ((2 ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε' u) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide : 1 < 2) ⌈(ε') ^ (-u)⌉₊
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε' u) := by push_cast; rfl
    have h_step_ub : ∀ (ε' u : ℝ), 0 < ε' →
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε' u))⁻¹ ≤ (ε') ^ u := by
      intro ε' u hε'
      have h1 := h_level_pow_lb ε' u hε'
      have h_pos_pow : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε' u) := by positivity
      have h_pos_eu : 0 < (ε') ^ u := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε' u
      rw [inv_le_comm₀ h_pos_pow h_pos_eu, ← Real.rpow_neg hε'.le u]
      exact h1
    have h_level_pow_ub : ∀ (ε' u : ℝ), 0 < ε' → ε' < 1 → 0 ≤ u →
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε' u) < 2 * (ε') ^ (-u) := by
      intro ε' u hε'0 hε'1 hu
      set m := dyadicTimeLevel ε' u
      have hx_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (ε') ^ (-u) := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = (ε') ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε').symm
          _ ≤ (ε') ^ (-u) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε'0 hε'1.le (by linarith)
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hm_pos
      · rw [hm0, pow_zero]
        linarith
      · have h_lt_clog : m - 1 < Nat.clog 2 ⌈(ε') ^ (-u)⌉₊ := Nat.sub_lt hm_pos zero_lt_one
        have h_pow_lt : 2 ^ (m - 1) < ⌈(ε') ^ (-u)⌉₊ := Nat.pow_lt_of_lt_clog h_lt_clog
        have h_not_le : ¬ ((ε') ^ (-u) ≤ ((2 ^ (m - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
          intro h_contra
          have h_ceil_le : ⌈(ε') ^ (-u)⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ (m - 1) := Nat.ceil_le.mpr h_contra
          omega
        have h_lt_x : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m - 1) < (ε') ^ (-u) := by
          have h1 : ((2 ^ (m - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) < (ε') ^ (-u) := lt_of_not_ge h_not_le
          simpa using h1
        have hm_eq : m = (m - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hm_pos).symm
        rw [hm_eq, pow_succ]
        linarith
    have hΔr_bds : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r ≤ Δ_r ∧ Δ_r ≤ ε ^ r := by
      refine ⟨?_, h_step_ub ε r hε₀⟩
      have h_ub := h_level_pow_ub ε r hε₀ hε_lt1 hr₀.le
      have h_pow_pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε r) := by positivity
      have h_prod : ε ^ (-r) * ε ^ r = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
      dsimp only [Δ_r]
      rw [le_inv_comm₀ (by positivity) h_pow_pos]
      have h_inv_eq : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r)⁻¹ = 2 * ε ^ (-r) := by
        have her_ne : ε ^ r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ r)
        field_simp [her_ne]
        linarith [h_prod]
      rw [h_inv_eq]
      exact h_ub.le
    have h_level_mono : ∀ (u₁ u₂ : ℝ), u₁ ≤ u₂ →
        dyadicTimeLevel ε u₁ ≤ dyadicTimeLevel ε u₂ := by
      intro u₁ u₂ hu
      unfold dyadicTimeLevel
      exact Nat.clog_mono_right 2
        (Nat.ceil_mono (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le (by linarith)))
    let capBin : ℕ → ℝ → ℤ := fun m z => min ⌊z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1)
    have h_cap_lt1 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ), z < 1 →
        capBin m z = ⌊z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ∧
        0 ≤ z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m - (capBin m z : ℝ) ∧
        z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m - (capBin m z : ℝ) < 1 := by
      intro m z hz1
      have h2m_pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
      have hz_mul : z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < ((2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        calc z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m < 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz1 h2m_pos
          _ = ((2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      have hfl_lt : ⌊z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ < (2 ^ m : ℤ) := Int.floor_lt.mpr hz_mul
      have h_eq : capBin m z = ⌊z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ := min_eq_left (by omega)
      refine ⟨h_eq, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [h_eq]
        linarith [Int.floor_le (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m)]
      · rw [h_eq]
        linarith [Int.lt_floor_add_one (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m)]
    have h_cap_eq1 : ∀ m : ℕ, capBin m 1 = (2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 := by
      intro m
      dsimp only [capBin]
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m = ((2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h1, Int.floor_intCast]
      exact min_eq_right (by omega)
    have h_cap_icc : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ), z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m - (capBin m z : ℝ)) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        (((capBin m z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        |((capBin m z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ - z| ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := by
      intro m z ⟨hz0, hz1⟩
      have h2m_pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
      have h2m_inv_nn : 0 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr h2m_pos.le
      have h_rem : (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m - (capBin m z : ℝ)) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hz1 with hlt | rfl
        · obtain ⟨_, h0, h1⟩ := h_cap_lt1 m z hlt
          exact ⟨h0, h1.le⟩
        · rw [h_cap_eq1 m]
          push_cast
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have h_bin_nn : 0 ≤ capBin m z := by
        dsimp only [capBin]
        refine le_min (Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hz0 h2m_pos.le)) ?_
        have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m := one_le_pow₀ (by omega : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2)
        omega
      have h_bin_hi : capBin m z ≤ (2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 := min_le_right _ _
      have h_mid_icc : (((capBin m z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (capBin m z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_bin_nn
        have hb1 : (capBin m z : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m - 1 := by
          have h_c : (capBin m z : ℝ) ≤ (((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_bin_hi
          push_cast at h_c
          exact h_c
        refine ⟨mul_nonneg (by linarith) h2m_inv_nn, ?_⟩
        calc ((capBin m z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹
            ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) h2m_inv_nn
          _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h2m_pos)
      have h_mid_err : |((capBin m z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ - z| ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := by
        have h_id : ((capBin m z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ - z =
            (1 / 2 - (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m - (capBin m z : ℝ))) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := by
          field_simp [ne_of_gt h2m_pos]
          ring
        rw [h_id, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h2m_inv_nn]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ h2m_inv_nn
        rw [abs_le]
        exact ⟨by linarith [h_rem.2], by linarith [h_rem.1]⟩
      exact ⟨h_rem, h_mid_icc, h_mid_err⟩
    have h_cap_div : ∀ (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) (z : ℝ), m₁ ≤ m₂ → z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        capBin m₁ z = (capBin m₂ z) / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m₂ - m₁)) := by
      intro m₁ m₂ z hm ⟨_, hz1⟩
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hz1 with hlt | rfl
      · rw [(h_cap_lt1 m₁ z hlt).1, (h_cap_lt1 m₂ z hlt).1]
        set Q : ℕ := 2 ^ (m₂ - m₁)
        have hQ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) := by positivity
        have h_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ = (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ * (Q : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [Q]; push_cast; rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hm]
        have h_eq : z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ = (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂) / (Q : ℝ) := by
          rw [h_pow]; field_simp [ne_of_gt hQ_pos]
        rw [h_eq, Int.floor_div_natCast]
        rfl
      · rw [h_cap_eq1 m₁, h_cap_eq1 m₂]
        set Q : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ (m₂ - m₁)
        have hQ_pos : 0 < Q := by positivity
        have h_pow : (2 ^ m₂ : ℤ) = (2 ^ m₁ : ℤ) * Q := by
          dsimp [Q]; rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hm]
        symm
        apply le_antisymm
        · have h_lt : (2 ^ m₂ : ℤ) - 1 < ((2 ^ m₁ : ℤ) - 1 + 1) * Q := by
            rw [sub_add_cancel, ← h_pow]; omega
          have h_div_lt := Int.ediv_lt_of_lt_mul hQ_pos h_lt
          omega
        · rw [Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hQ_pos]
          nlinarith [h_pow, hQ_pos]

    set m_r := dyadicTimeLevel ε r
    set m_t := dyadicTimeLevel ε t
    set m_loc1 := dyadicTimeLevel ε_tilde 1
    have h_exp_prod : ε ^ (-r) * ε_tilde ^ (-1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (-t) := by
      dsimp only [ε_tilde, η]
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε₀.le, ← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hm_lo : m_t ≤ m_r + m_loc1 := by
      have h1 := h_level_pow_ub ε t hε₀ hε_lt1 ht₀.le
      have h2 := h_level_pow_lb ε r hε₀
      have h3 := h_level_pow_lb ε_tilde 1 hε_tilde_pos
      have h_real_lt : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t < (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_r + m_loc1 + 1) := by
        calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t < 2 * ε ^ (-t) := h1
          _ = 2 * (ε ^ (-r) * ε_tilde ^ (-1 : ℝ)) := by rw [h_exp_prod]
          _ ≤ 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_loc1) := by gcongr
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_r + m_loc1 + 1) := by rw [pow_add, pow_succ]; ring
      have h_nat_pow : 2 ^ m_t < 2 ^ (m_r + m_loc1 + 1) := by exact_mod_cast h_real_lt
      have h_lt := (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right (by decide : 1 < 2)).mp h_nat_pow
      omega
    have hm_hi : m_r + m_loc1 ≤ m_t + 1 := by
      have h1 := h_level_pow_ub ε r hε₀ hε_lt1 hr₀.le

      · exact hw

    have h_loc_ball : ∀ (V A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (j : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
        ‖locCellVel ε r b_t d j V‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖locCellPos ε r b_t d j V A‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro V A j
      rcases j with ⟨k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2⟩
      exact ⟨h_clamp_le1 _, h_clamp_le1 _⟩
    have h_proj_dir : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        projAngleOfVec w ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) Real.pi ∧
        (w ≠ 0 → ∃ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
          WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos (projAngleOfVec w), Real.sin (projAngleOfVec w)] =
            (σ / ‖w‖) • w) := by
      intro w
      have hw_sq := h_norm_sq w
      unfold projAngleOfVec
      split_ifs with hw1_pos hw1_neg
      · have hw1_sq : 0 < (w 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hw1_pos
        have h_nsq_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg (w 0)]
        have h_n_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
        have h_abs_lt : |w 0| < ‖w‖ := by
          have h_sq_lt : |w 0| ^ 2 < ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]; linarith
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (w 0), norm_nonneg w]
        have h_div_bds : -1 < w 0 / ‖w‖ ∧ w 0 / ‖w‖ < 1 := by
          rw [abs_lt] at h_abs_lt
          exact ⟨(lt_div_iff₀ h_n_pos).mpr (by linarith), (div_lt_iff₀ h_n_pos).mpr (by linarith)⟩
        refine ⟨⟨Real.arccos_nonneg _, Real.arccos_lt_pi.mpr h_div_bds.1⟩, fun _ => ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩⟩
        have h_cos := Real.cos_arccos h_div_bds.1.le h_div_bds.2.le
        have h_sin : Real.sin (Real.arccos (w 0 / ‖w‖)) = w 1 / ‖w‖ := by
          rw [Real.sin_arccos]
          have h_rad : 1 - (w 0 / ‖w‖) ^ 2 = (w 1 / ‖w‖) ^ 2 := by
            field_simp [ne_of_gt h_n_pos]
            linarith
          rw [h_rad, Real.sqrt_sq (div_nonneg hw1_pos.le h_n_pos.le)]
        refine h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_
        · rw [h_toLp_0, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h_cos]; ring
        · rw [h_toLp_1, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h_sin]; ring
      · have hw1_sq : 0 < (w 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_neg hw1_neg
        have h_nsq_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg (w 0)]
        have h_n_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
        have h_abs_lt : |w 0| < ‖w‖ := by
          have h_sq_lt : |w 0| ^ 2 < ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]; linarith
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (w 0), norm_nonneg w]
        have h_div_bds : -1 < -(w 0 / ‖w‖) ∧ -(w 0 / ‖w‖) < 1 := by
          rw [abs_lt] at h_abs_lt
          have h1 : -1 < w 0 / ‖w‖ := (lt_div_iff₀ h_n_pos).mpr (by linarith)
          have h2 : w 0 / ‖w‖ < 1 := (div_lt_iff₀ h_n_pos).mpr (by linarith)
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        refine ⟨⟨Real.arccos_nonneg _, Real.arccos_lt_pi.mpr h_div_bds.1⟩, fun _ => ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩⟩
        have h_cos := Real.cos_arccos h_div_bds.1.le h_div_bds.2.le
        have h_sin : Real.sin (Real.arccos (-(w 0 / ‖w‖))) = -(w 1 / ‖w‖) := by
          rw [Real.sin_arccos]
          have h_rad : 1 - (-(w 0 / ‖w‖)) ^ 2 = (-(w 1 / ‖w‖)) ^ 2 := by
            field_simp [ne_of_gt h_n_pos]
            linarith
          have h_nn : 0 ≤ -(w 1 / ‖w‖) := by
            rw [neg_nonneg]
            exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hw1_neg.le h_n_pos.le
          rw [h_rad, Real.sqrt_sq h_nn]
        refine h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_
        · rw [h_toLp_0, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h_cos]; ring
        · rw [h_toLp_1, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h_sin]; ring
      · have hw1_zero : w 1 = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hw1_pos) (le_of_not_gt hw1_neg)
        refine ⟨⟨le_rfl, Real.pi_pos⟩, fun hw_ne => ?_⟩
        have h_n_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw_ne
        have h_n_sq0 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w 0) ^ 2 := by rw [hw_sq, hw1_zero]; ring
        have h_n_abs : ‖w‖ = |w 0| := by
          have h1 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = |w 0| ^ 2 := by rwa [sq_abs]
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg w, abs_nonneg (w 0)]
        have hw0_ne : w 0 ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0; rw [h0, abs_zero] at h_n_abs; linarith
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hw0_ne with hw0_neg | hw0_pos
        · refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_⟩
          · rw [h_toLp_0, Real.cos_zero, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h_n_abs, abs_of_neg hw0_neg]
            field_simp [ne_of_lt hw0_neg]
          · rw [h_toLp_1, Real.sin_zero, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hw1_zero, mul_zero]
        · refine ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_⟩
          · rw [h_toLp_0, Real.cos_zero, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h_n_abs, abs_of_pos hw0_pos]
            field_simp [ne_of_gt hw0_pos]
          · rw [h_toLp_1, Real.sin_zero, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hw1_zero, mul_zero]

    have h_real_step_bds : ∀ (ε' L : ℝ), 0 < ε' →
        (ε') ^ L ≤ dyadicRealStep ε' L ∧ dyadicRealStep ε' L < 2 * (ε') ^ L := by
      intro ε' L hε'
      set x_L := L * (Real.log ((ε')⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
      set m_L := dyadicRealLevel ε' L
      have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
      have h_2pow_xL : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-x_L) = (ε') ^ L := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε']
        congr 1
        dsimp [x_L]
        rw [Real.log_inv]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hlog2_pos]
      have h_fl_le : (m_L : ℝ) ≤ x_L := Int.floor_le x_L
      have h_fl_lt1 : x_L < (m_L : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one x_L
      have h_step_eq : dyadicRealStep ε' L = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m_L : ℝ)) := by
        unfold dyadicRealStep
        have h_cast : (-(m_L : ℝ)) = ((-m_L : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [h_cast, Real.rpow_intCast]
      rw [h_step_eq]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← h_2pow_xL]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      · calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m_L : ℝ))
            < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - x_L) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) + (-x_L)) := by ring_nf
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-x_L) := Real.rpow_add (by norm_num) 1 (-x_L)
          _ = 2 * (ε') ^ L := by rw [Real.rpow_one, h_2pow_xL]

    have h_real_mid_lt : ∀ (ε' L y : ℝ), 0 < ε' →
        |y - ((dyadicRealBin ε' L y : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε' L| < (ε') ^ L := by
      intro ε' L y hε'
      set m_L := dyadicRealLevel ε' L
      set k := dyadicRealBin ε' L y
      have h_pos_2m : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L := by positivity
      have h_step_inv : dyadicRealStep ε' L = ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_L)⁻¹ := by
        unfold dyadicRealStep
        exact zpow_neg (2 : ℝ) m_L
      have h_step_pos : 0 < dyadicRealStep ε' L := by rw [h_step_inv]; positivity
      have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ y * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L := Int.floor_le _
      have hk_gt : y * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h_diff_eq : y - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε' L =
          (y * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * dyadicRealStep ε' L := by
        rw [h_step_inv]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt h_pos_2m]
      have h_abs_half : |y * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [abs_le]; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      rw [h_diff_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_step_pos]
      calc |y * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| * dyadicRealStep ε' L
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dyadicRealStep ε' L :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_abs_half h_step_pos.le
        _ < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (2 * (ε') ^ L) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (h_real_step_bds ε' L hε').2 (by norm_num)
        _ = (ε') ^ L := by ring

    have h_real_cover : ∀ (ε' L y y₀ : ℝ) (B : ℕ), 0 < ε' → |y - y₀| ≤ (B : ℝ) * (ε') ^ L →
        dyadicRealBin ε' L y ∈
          Finset.Icc (dyadicRealBin ε' L y₀ - (B : ℤ)) (dyadicRealBin ε' L y₀ + (B : ℤ)) := by
      intro ε' L y y₀ B hε' h_diff
      set m_L := dyadicRealLevel ε' L
      have h_pos_2m : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L := by positivity
      have h_prod_le1 : (ε') ^ L * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L ≤ 1 := by
        have h1 := (h_real_step_bds ε' L hε').1
        have h_step_inv : dyadicRealStep ε' L = ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_L)⁻¹ := zpow_neg (2 : ℝ) m_L
        rw [h_step_inv] at h1
        calc (ε') ^ L * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L
            ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_L)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 h_pos_2m.le
          _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h_pos_2m)
      have h_scaled : |(y - y₀) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L| ≤ (B : ℝ) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_pos_2m]
        calc |y - y₀| * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L
            ≤ ((B : ℝ) * (ε') ^ L) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_diff h_pos_2m.le
          _ = (B : ℝ) * ((ε') ^ L * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L) := by ring
          _ ≤ (B : ℝ) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod_le1 (Nat.cast_nonneg B)
          _ = (B : ℝ) := mul_one _
      rw [abs_le] at h_scaled
      set k₀ := dyadicRealBin ε' L y₀
      have hk₀_le : (k₀ : ℝ) ≤ y₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L := Int.floor_le _
      have hk₀_lt : y₀ * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_L < (k₀ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
        push_cast
        linarith [h_scaled.1]
      · have h_lt_succ : dyadicRealBin ε' L y < k₀ + (B : ℤ) + 1 := by
          refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
          push_cast
          linarith [h_scaled.2]
        omega

    refine ⟨h_ang_norm_all, h_loc_ball, h_proj_dir,
      fun ε' L y hε' => (h_real_mid_lt ε' L y hε').le, h_real_cover, ?_⟩
    rintro V A c θ ⟨k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2⟩ hJ
    dsimp only
    unfold stdApertureObs at hJ
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at hJ
    injection hJ with hkr hJ2
    injection hJ2 with hkang hJ3
    injection hJ3 with hkV1 hJ4
    injection hJ4 with hkV2 hJ5
    injection hJ5 with hkX1 hkX2
    set e_J := angUnitVec ε d k_ang_d
    set c_mid := ((k_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
    set v_J := (((k_V1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t) • e_J +
      (((k_V2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + d)) • perp2D e_J
    set x_J := (((k_X1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + r)) • e_J +
      (((k_X2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + d + r)) • perp2D e_J
    have heJ_norm : ‖e_J‖ = 1 := h_ang_norm_all ε d k_ang_d
    obtain ⟨heJ_ee, heJ_pp, heJ_ep, heJ_pe, heJ_exp⟩ := h_ortho e_J heJ_norm
    have h_eJ_eq : angUnitVec ε d (angBin ε d θ) = e_J := by rw [hkang]
    have h_cmid_eq : dyadicTimeMid ε r c = c_mid := by
      unfold dyadicTimeMid; rw [hkr]
    rw [h_eJ_eq] at hkV1 hkV2 hkX1 hkX2
    rw [h_cmid_eq] at hkX1 hkX2
    have h_vJ_in_e : inner ℝ v_J e_J = ((k_V1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t := by
      dsimp only [v_J]
      rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, heJ_ee, heJ_pe]
      ring
    have h_vJ_in_p : inner ℝ v_J (perp2D e_J) =
        ((k_V2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + d) := by
      dsimp only [v_J]
      rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, heJ_ep, heJ_pp]
      ring
    have h_xJ_in_e : inner ℝ x_J e_J = ((k_X1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + r) := by
      dsimp only [x_J]
      rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, heJ_ee, heJ_pe]
      ring
    have h_xJ_in_p : inner ℝ x_J (perp2D e_J) =
        ((k_X2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + d + r) := by
      dsimp only [x_J]
      rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, heJ_ep, heJ_pp]
      ring
    have h_dV_e : |inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J| < ε ^ b_t := by
      rw [inner_sub_left, h_vJ_in_e, ← hkV1]; exact h_real_mid_lt ε b_t _ hε₀
    have h_dV_p : |inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J)| < ε ^ (b_t + d) := by
      rw [inner_sub_left, h_vJ_in_p, ← hkV2]; exact h_real_mid_lt ε (b_t + d) _ hε₀
    have h_dXmid_e : |inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) e_J| < ε ^ (b_t + r) := by
      rw [inner_sub_left, h_xJ_in_e, ← hkX1]; exact h_real_mid_lt ε (b_t + r) _ hε₀
    have h_dXmid_p : |inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) (perp2D e_J)| < ε ^ (b_t + d + r) := by
      rw [inner_sub_left, h_xJ_in_p, ← hkX2]; exact h_real_mid_lt ε (b_t + d + r) _ hε₀
    have h_rpow_cancel : ∀ L : ℝ, ε ^ (-L) * ε ^ L = 1 := by
      intro L; rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    set V_raw : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := (1 / 10 : ℝ) • WithLp.toLp 2
      ![ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J,
        ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J)]
    have hVraw_0 : |V_raw 0| < 1 / 10 := by
      have h_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-b_t) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
      have h_val : V_raw 0 = (1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J) := rfl
      rw [h_val, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 10), abs_of_pos h_pos]
      calc (1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J|)
          < (1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-b_t) * ε ^ b_t) := by gcongr
        _ = 1 / 10 := by rw [h_rpow_cancel b_t, mul_one]
    have hVraw_1 : |V_raw 1| < 1 / 10 := by
      have h_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
      have h_val : V_raw 1 = (1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J)) := rfl
      rw [h_val, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 10), abs_of_pos h_pos]
      calc (1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J)|)
          < (1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (b_t + d)) := by gcongr
        _ = 1 / 10 := by rw [h_rpow_cancel (b_t + d), mul_one]
    have hVraw_norm : ‖V_raw‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have h_sq := h_norm_sq V_raw
      have h0_sq : (V_raw 0) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (V_raw 0), hVraw_0]
      have h1_sq : (V_raw 1) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (V_raw 1), hVraw_1]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg V_raw]
    have hVloc_eq : locCellVel ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V = V_raw := by
      change clampUnitBall2D V_raw = V_raw
      unfold clampUnitBall2D
      split_ifs
      rfl

    have hΔr_lo : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r ≤ Δ_r := h_s1.1.1
    have hΔr_pos : 0 < Δ_r := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hΔr_lo
    have her_le_2Δ : ε ^ r ≤ 2 * Δ_r := by linarith
    set dX := (A + ((k_r : ℝ) * Δ_r) • V) - (x_J - ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) • v_J)
    have hdX_decomp : dX = ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) - ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) • (V - v_J) := by
      dsimp only [dX, c_mid]
      refine h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_ <;> {
        simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      }
    have hdX_e : |inner ℝ dX e_J| < (5 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * ε ^ b_t := by
      rw [hdX_decomp, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left]
      have h_tri := abs_sub (inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) e_J)
        (((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r)] at h_tri
      have h_ebr : ε ^ (b_t + r) = ε ^ b_t * ε ^ r := Real.rpow_add hε₀ b_t r
      have h_ebt_pos : 0 < ε ^ b_t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ b_t
      have h_m1 : ε ^ b_t * ε ^ r ≤ ε ^ b_t * (2 * Δ_r) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left her_le_2Δ h_ebt_pos.le
      have h_m2 : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) * |inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J| <
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) * ε ^ b_t :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_dV_e (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hdX_p : |inner ℝ dX (perp2D e_J)| < (5 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * ε ^ (b_t + d) := by
      rw [hdX_decomp, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left]
      have h_tri := abs_sub (inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) (perp2D e_J))
        (((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J))
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r)] at h_tri
      have h_ebdr : ε ^ (b_t + d + r) = ε ^ (b_t + d) * ε ^ r := Real.rpow_add hε₀ (b_t + d) r
      have h_ebtd_pos : 0 < ε ^ (b_t + d) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (b_t + d)
      have h_m1 : ε ^ (b_t + d) * ε ^ r ≤ ε ^ (b_t + d) * (2 * Δ_r) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left her_le_2Δ h_ebtd_pos.le
      have h_m2 : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) * |inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J)| <
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) * ε ^ (b_t + d) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_dV_p (by positivity)
      linarith
    set A_raw : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ • WithLp.toLp 2
      ![ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ dX e_J, ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ dX (perp2D e_J)]
    have hAraw_0 : |A_raw 0| < 1 / 4 := by
      have h_pos1 : 0 < (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ := by positivity
      have h_pos2 : 0 < ε ^ (-b_t) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
      have h_val : A_raw 0 = (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ dX e_J) := rfl
      rw [h_val, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_pos1, abs_of_pos h_pos2]
      calc (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ dX e_J|)
          < (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-b_t) * ((5 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * ε ^ b_t)) := by gcongr
        _ = (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * ((5 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (ε ^ (-b_t) * ε ^ b_t)) := by ring
        _ = 1 / 4 := by rw [h_rpow_cancel b_t, mul_one]; field_simp [ne_of_gt hΔr_pos]; ring
    have hAraw_1 : |A_raw 1| < 1 / 4 := by
      have h_pos1 : 0 < (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ := by positivity
      have h_pos2 : 0 < ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
      have h_val : A_raw 1 = (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ dX (perp2D e_J)) := rfl
      rw [h_val, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_pos1, abs_of_pos h_pos2]
      calc (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ dX (perp2D e_J)|)
          < (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ((5 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * ε ^ (b_t + d))) := by gcongr
        _ = (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * ((5 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (b_t + d))) := by ring
        _ = 1 / 4 := by rw [h_rpow_cancel (b_t + d), mul_one]; field_simp [ne_of_gt hΔr_pos]; ring
    have hAraw_norm : ‖A_raw‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have h_sq := h_norm_sq A_raw
      have h0_sq : (A_raw 0) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (A_raw 0), hAraw_0]
      have h1_sq : (A_raw 1) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (A_raw 1), hAraw_1]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg A_raw]
    have hAloc_eq : locCellPos ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V A = A_raw := by
      change clampUnitBall2D A_raw = A_raw
      unfold clampUnitBall2D
      split_ifs
      rfl

    have h_tau_eq : ∀ τ : ℝ,
        locCellPos ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V A +
          τ • locCellVel ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V =
        (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ • WithLp.toLp 2
          ![ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ ((A + (((k_r : ℝ) + τ) * Δ_r) • V) -
              (x_J + ((τ - 1 / 2) * Δ_r) • v_J)) e_J,
            ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ ((A + (((k_r : ℝ) + τ) * Δ_r) • V) -
              (x_J + ((τ - 1 / 2) * Δ_r) • v_J)) (perp2D e_J)] := by
      intro τ
      rw [hAloc_eq, hVloc_eq]
      have h_vec_tau : dX + (τ * Δ_r) • (V - v_J) =
          (A + (((k_r : ℝ) + τ) * Δ_r) • V) - (x_J + ((τ - 1 / 2) * Δ_r) • v_J) := by
        dsimp only [dX]
        refine h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_ <;> {
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        }
      rw [← h_vec_tau, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
      refine h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_
      · change (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ dX e_J) +
            τ * ((1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J)) =
          (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-b_t) * (inner ℝ dX e_J + τ * Δ_r * inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J))
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hΔr_pos]
      · change (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ dX (perp2D e_J)) +
            τ * ((1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J))) =
          (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ *
            (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * (inner ℝ dX (perp2D e_J) + τ * Δ_r * inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J)))
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hΔr_pos]

    have h_rpow_cancel2 : ∀ L : ℝ, ε ^ L * ε ^ (-L) = 1 := by
      intro L; rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    have hV_inv : V = v_J + (10 : ℝ) •
        ((ε ^ b_t * (locCellVel ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V) 0) • e_J +
          (ε ^ (b_t + d) * (locCellVel ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V) 1) •
            perp2D e_J) := by
      rw [hVloc_eq]
      have hc0 : (10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ b_t * V_raw 0) = inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J := by
        change (10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ b_t * ((1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J))) = _
        calc (10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ b_t * ((1 / 10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J)))
            = (ε ^ b_t * ε ^ (-b_t)) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J := by ring
          _ = inner ℝ (V - v_J) e_J := by rw [h_rpow_cancel2 b_t, one_mul]
      have hc1 : (10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (b_t + d) * V_raw 1) = inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J) := by
        change (10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (b_t + d) * ((1 / 10 : ℝ) *
          (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J)))) = _
        calc (10 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (b_t + d) * ((1 / 10 : ℝ) *
              (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J))))
            = (ε ^ (b_t + d) * ε ^ (-(b_t + d))) * inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J) := by ring
          _ = inner ℝ (V - v_J) (perp2D e_J) := by rw [h_rpow_cancel2 (b_t + d), one_mul]
      rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, hc0, hc1, ← heJ_exp (V - v_J), add_sub_cancel]

    have hX_inv : A + c_mid • V = x_J + (10 * Δ_r) •
        ((ε ^ b_t * (locCellPos ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V A +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) • locCellVel ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V) 0) • e_J +
          (ε ^ (b_t + d) * (locCellPos ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V A +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) • locCellVel ε r b_t d (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) V) 1) •
            perp2D e_J) := by
      have h_half := h_tau_eq (1 / 2)
      have h_sub0 : (x_J + ((1 / 2 - 1 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ_r) • v_J) = x_J := by simp
      rw [h_sub0] at h_half
      rw [h_half]
      set W_half := (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ • WithLp.toLp 2
        ![ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) e_J,
          ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) (perp2D e_J)]
      have hc0 : (10 * Δ_r) * (ε ^ b_t * W_half 0) = inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) e_J := by
        change (10 * Δ_r) * (ε ^ b_t * ((10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ *
          (ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) e_J))) = _
        calc (10 * Δ_r) * (ε ^ b_t * ((10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ *
              (ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) e_J)))
            = ((10 * Δ_r) * (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹) * (ε ^ b_t * ε ^ (-b_t)) *
                inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) e_J := by ring
          _ = inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) e_J := by
              rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), h_rpow_cancel2 b_t, one_mul, one_mul]
      have hc1 : (10 * Δ_r) * (ε ^ (b_t + d) * W_half 1) =
          inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) (perp2D e_J) := by
        change (10 * Δ_r) * (ε ^ (b_t + d) * ((10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ *
          (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) (perp2D e_J)))) = _
        calc (10 * Δ_r) * (ε ^ (b_t + d) * ((10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ *
              (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) (perp2D e_J))))
            = ((10 * Δ_r) * (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹) * (ε ^ (b_t + d) * ε ^ (-(b_t + d))) *
                inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) (perp2D e_J) := by ring
          _ = inner ℝ ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J) (perp2D e_J) := by
              rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), h_rpow_cancel2 (b_t + d), one_mul, one_mul]
      rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, hc0, hc1, ← heJ_exp ((A + c_mid • V) - x_J), add_sub_cancel]

    exact ⟨hkr.symm, hVloc_eq, h_tau_eq, hV_inv, hX_inv⟩

  obtain ⟨hΔr_bds, h_time_c, h_ang_θ, h_loc_ang_err, ⟨F_time, F_kloc, hFtime_card, hFkloc_card, h_time_fib⟩⟩ := h_s1
  obtain ⟨h_ang_norm_all, h_loc_ball, h_proj_dir, h_real_mid, h_real_cover, h_inv_all⟩ := h_s2

  
  let L_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    fun e_dir q => WithLp.toLp 2
      ![ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ q e_dir, ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ q (perp2D e_dir)]

  have h_LJ_sub : ∀ (e_dir p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      L_J e_dir p - L_J e_dir q = L_J e_dir (p - q) := by
    intro e_dir p q
    refine h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_
    · change ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ p e_dir - ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ q e_dir =
        ε ^ (-b_t) * inner ℝ (p - q) e_dir
      rw [inner_sub_left]; ring
    · change ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ p (perp2D e_dir) -
          ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ q (perp2D e_dir) =
        ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * inner ℝ (p - q) (perp2D e_dir)
      rw [inner_sub_left]; ring

  have h_fwd_cancel : ∀ (φ_f φ_c : ℝ),
      |φ_f - φ_c| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d →
      let e_f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ_f, Real.sin φ_f]
      let e_c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ_c, Real.sin φ_c]
      let θ_ls := projAngleOfVec (WithLp.toLp 2
        ![inner ℝ e_f e_c, ε ^ (-d) * inner ℝ e_f (perp2D e_c)])
      let e_ld := angUnitVec ε_tilde (e_loc - 0) (angBin ε_tilde (e_loc - 0) θ_ls)
      ∀ q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        (|inner ℝ q e_c| ≤ |inner ℝ q e_f| + |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_f)| ∧
         |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_c)| ≤
           |inner ℝ q e_f| * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) + |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_f)|) ∧
        (|inner ℝ (L_J e_c q) e_ld| ≤
           2 * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ q e_f| +
             ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_f)| ∧
         |inner ℝ (L_J e_c q) (perp2D e_ld)| ≤
           Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ q e_f| +
             ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_f)|) := by
    intro φ_f φ_c hα_abs e_f e_c θ_ls e_ld
    set α := φ_f - φ_c
    have hpi_lt : Real.pi < 3.15 := Real.pi_lt_d2
    have hsin_α_le : |Real.sin α| ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d :=
      le_trans Real.abs_sin_le_abs hα_abs
    have hcos_α_le1 : |Real.cos α| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_cos_le_one α
    have hsin_α_le1 : |Real.sin α| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_sin_le_one α
    have hef_norm : ‖e_f‖ = 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖e_f‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1]; exact Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ_f
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg e_f]
    obtain ⟨hef_ee, hef_pp, hef_ep, hef_pe, hef_exp⟩ := h_ortho e_f hef_norm

    have h_ef_ec : inner ℝ e_f e_c = Real.cos α := by
      rw [h_inner_2d, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1]
      exact (Real.cos_sub φ_f φ_c).symm
    have h_pef_ec : inner ℝ (perp2D e_f) e_c = -Real.sin α := by
      rw [h_inner_2d, h_perp_0, h_perp_1, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1]
      linarith [Real.sin_sub φ_f φ_c]
    have h_ef_pec : inner ℝ e_f (perp2D e_c) = Real.sin α := by
      rw [h_inner_2d, h_perp_0, h_perp_1, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1]
      linarith [Real.sin_sub φ_f φ_c]
    have h_pef_pec : inner ℝ (perp2D e_f) (perp2D e_c) = Real.cos α := by
      rw [h_inner_2d, h_perp_0, h_perp_1, h_perp_0, h_perp_1, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1, h_toLp_0,
        h_toLp_1]
      linarith [Real.cos_sub φ_f φ_c]

    have h_rot_q : ∀ q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        inner ℝ q e_c = inner ℝ q e_f * Real.cos α -
          inner ℝ q (perp2D e_f) * Real.sin α ∧
        inner ℝ q (perp2D e_c) = inner ℝ q e_f * Real.sin α +
          inner ℝ q (perp2D e_f) * Real.cos α := by
      intro q
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · conv_lhs => rw [hef_exp q]
        rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, h_ef_ec, h_pef_ec]
        ring
      · conv_lhs => rw [hef_exp q]
        rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, h_ef_pec, h_pef_pec]

    set t' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos α, ε ^ (-d) * Real.sin α]
    set w_perp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      WithLp.toLp 2 ![-Real.sin α, ε ^ (-d) * Real.cos α]

    have h_emd_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-d) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ ≤ ε ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le (by linarith)
    have h_emd_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-d) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-d)
    have ht'_sq : ‖t'‖ ^ 2 = Real.cos α ^ 2 + (ε ^ (-d) * Real.sin α) ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_norm_sq, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1]
    have ht'_ge1 : 1 ≤ ‖t'‖ := by
      have h_cs : Real.cos α ^ 2 + Real.sin α ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq α
      have h_emd_sq : 1 ≤ (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [h_emd_ge1]
      have h_s_le : Real.sin α ^ 2 ≤ (ε ^ (-d) * Real.sin α) ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : 1 * Real.sin α ^ 2 ≤ (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 * Real.sin α ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_emd_sq (sq_nonneg _)
        linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg t', ht'_sq, h_cs, h_s_le]
    have ht'_ne0 : t' ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, norm_zero] at ht'_ge1; linarith
    have ht'_le2 : ‖t'‖ ≤ 2 := by
      have h_emd_ed : ε ^ (-d) * ε ^ d = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
      have h_t1_abs : |ε ^ (-d) * Real.sin α| ≤ 1.6 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_emd_pos]
        calc ε ^ (-d) * |Real.sin α|
            ≤ ε ^ (-d) * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsin_α_le h_emd_pos.le
          _ = (Real.pi / 2) * (ε ^ (-d) * ε ^ d) := by ring
          _ = Real.pi / 2 := by rw [h_emd_ed, mul_one]
          _ ≤ 1.6 := by linarith [hpi_lt]
      have h_t1_sq : (ε ^ (-d) * Real.sin α) ^ 2 ≤ (1.6 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (ε ^ (-d) * Real.sin α), h_t1_abs]
      have h_c_sq : Real.cos α ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.cos α), hcos_α_le1]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg t', ht'_sq, h_t1_sq, h_c_sq]

    have hw_perp_le : ‖w_perp‖ ≤ ε ^ (-d) := by
      have h_sq : ‖w_perp‖ ^ 2 ≤ (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1]
        have h_cs : Real.sin α ^ 2 + Real.cos α ^ 2 = 1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq α
        have h_emd_sq : 1 ≤ (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [h_emd_ge1]
        have h_s_le : Real.sin α ^ 2 ≤ (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 * Real.sin α ^ 2 := by
          have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_emd_sq (sq_nonneg (Real.sin α))
          linarith
        have h_eq2 : (ε ^ (-d) * Real.cos α) ^ 2 = (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 * Real.cos α ^ 2 := by ring
        have h_sum_eq : (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 * Real.sin α ^ 2 + (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 * Real.cos α ^ 2 =
            (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 := by linear_combination (ε ^ (-d)) ^ 2 * h_cs
        linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg w_perp, h_emd_pos]

    have h_θls_t' : θ_ls = projAngleOfVec t' := by
      dsimp only [θ_ls, t']
      rw [h_ef_ec, h_ef_pec]
    obtain ⟨hθ_mem, h_t'_dir⟩ := h_proj_dir t'
    rw [← h_θls_t'] at hθ_mem h_t'_dir
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ_cases, h_that_eq⟩ := h_t'_dir ht'_ne0
    set t_hat : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos θ_ls, Real.sin θ_ls]
    have ht_hat_norm : ‖t_hat‖ = 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖t_hat‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq, h_toLp_0, h_toLp_1]; exact Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ_ls
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg t_hat]
    have hσ_sq : σ ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hσ_cases with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    have ht'_from_hat : t' = (σ * ‖t'‖) • t_hat := by
      change t_hat = (σ / ‖t'‖) • t' at h_that_eq
      rw [h_that_eq, smul_smul]
      have h_one : (σ * ‖t'‖) * (σ / ‖t'‖) = 1 := by
        have hn_ne : ‖t'‖ ≠ 0 := by linarith
        field_simp [hn_ne]
        exact hσ_sq
      rw [h_one, one_smul]
    have h_t'_ortho_that : inner ℝ t' (perp2D t_hat) = 0 := by
      rw [ht'_from_hat, real_inner_smul_left, (h_ortho t_hat ht_hat_norm).2.2.1, mul_zero]

    have he_ld_norm : ‖e_ld‖ = 1 := h_ang_norm_all ε_tilde (e_loc - 0) _
    have hp_ld_norm : ‖perp2D e_ld‖ = 1 := by
      have h1 : (e_ld 0) ^ 2 + (e_ld 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have h2 := h_norm_sq e_ld; rw [he_ld_norm, one_pow] at h2; exact h2.symm
      have h3 : ‖perp2D e_ld‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq, h_perp_0, h_perp_1]; linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D e_ld)]
    set kl_ang := angBin ε_tilde (e_loc - 0) θ_ls

          h_inv_all V A c θ (j.1, j.2.1, j.2.2.1, j.2.2.2.1, j.2.2.2.2.1, j.2.2.2.2.2) hj_eta_eq
        exact ⟨hV_l, hA_l τ⟩

      set φ_fine := ((angBin ε (a_t - b_t) θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_et)⁻¹
      set φ_coarse := ((angBin ε d θ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_d)⁻¹
      set e_fine := angUnitVec ε (a_t - b_t) g_t.2.1
      have he_fine_eq : e_fine = WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ_fine, Real.sin φ_fine] := rfl
      have he_J_eq : e_J = WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos φ_coarse, Real.sin φ_coarse] := by
        dsimp only [e_J]; rw [hj_snd]; rfl
      have hθ_loc_eq : θ_loc = projAngleOfVec (WithLp.toLp 2
          ![inner ℝ e_fine e_J, ε ^ (-d) * inner ℝ e_fine (perp2D e_J)]) := by
        dsimp only [θ_loc, locTheta, e_fine, e_J]
        rw [hj_snd]; rfl
      set e_ld := angUnitVec ε_tilde (e_loc - 0) (angBin ε_tilde (e_loc - 0) θ_loc)

      have h_fc : ∀ q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          (|inner ℝ q e_J| ≤ |inner ℝ q e_fine| + |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_fine)| ∧
           |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_J)| ≤
             |inner ℝ q e_fine| * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) + |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_fine)|) ∧
          (|inner ℝ (L_J e_J q) e_ld| ≤
             2 * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ q e_fine| +
               ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_fine)| ∧
           |inner ℝ (L_J e_J q) (perp2D e_ld)| ≤
             Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ q e_fine| +
               ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ q (perp2D e_fine)|) := by
        intro q
        have h_raw := h_fwd_cancel φ_fine φ_coarse h_ang_diff q
        dsimp only at h_raw
        rwa [← he_fine_eq, ← he_J_eq, ← hθ_loc_eq] at h_raw

      
      have he_fine_norm : ‖e_fine‖ = 1 := h_ang_norm_all ε (a_t - b_t) g_t.2.1
      obtain ⟨hef_ee, hef_pp, hef_ep, hef_pe, _⟩ := h_ortho e_fine he_fine_norm
      set v_G := vG_fn g_t
      set x_G := xG_fn g_t
      set ct_mid := dyadicTimeMid ε t c
      have hct_eq : ((g_t.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ = ct_mid := rfl
      set u := V - v_G
      set w := (A + ct_mid • V) - x_G
      have hvG_e : inner ℝ v_G e_fine = ((g_t.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε b_t := by
        dsimp only [v_G, vG_fn]
        change inner ℝ (_ • e_fine + _ • perp2D e_fine) e_fine = _
        rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hef_ee, hef_pe]; ring
      have hvG_p : inner ℝ v_G (perp2D e_fine) =
          ((g_t.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε a_t := by
        dsimp only [v_G, vG_fn]
        change inner ℝ (_ • e_fine + _ • perp2D e_fine) (perp2D e_fine) = _
        rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hef_ep, hef_pp]; ring
      have hxG_e : inner ℝ x_G e_fine =
          ((g_t.2.2.2.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (b_t + t) := by
        dsimp only [x_G, xG_fn]
        change inner ℝ (_ • e_fine + _ • perp2D e_fine) e_fine = _
        rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hef_ee, hef_pe]; ring
      have hxG_p : inner ℝ x_G (perp2D e_fine) =
          ((g_t.2.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε (a_t + t) := by
        dsimp only [x_G, xG_fn]
        change inner ℝ (_ • e_fine + _ • perp2D e_fine) (perp2D e_fine) = _
        rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hef_ep, hef_pp]; ring
      have hu_1 : |inner ℝ u e_fine| ≤ ε ^ b_t := by
        dsimp only [u]; rw [inner_sub_left, hvG_e]
        exact h_real_mid ε b_t (inner ℝ V e_fine) hε₀
      have hu_2 : |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine)| ≤ ε ^ a_t := by
        dsimp only [u]; rw [inner_sub_left, hvG_p]
        exact h_real_mid ε a_t (inner ℝ V (perp2D e_fine)) hε₀
      have hw_1 : |inner ℝ w e_fine| ≤ ε ^ (b_t + t) := by
        dsimp only [w]; rw [inner_sub_left, hxG_e]
        exact h_real_mid ε (b_t + t) (inner ℝ (A + ct_mid • V) e_fine) hε₀
      have hw_2 : |inner ℝ w (perp2D e_fine)| ≤ ε ^ (a_t + t) := by
        dsimp only [w]; rw [inner_sub_left, hxG_p]
        exact h_real_mid ε (a_t + t) (inner ℝ (A + ct_mid • V) (perp2D e_fine)) hε₀

      
      have hj_in_BJ : j ∈ B_J g_t := by
        have h_kd_s : j.2.1 = g_t.2.1 / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m_et - m_d)) := by
          rw [hj_snd]; exact h_ang_div
        have h_ec_eq : angUnitVec ε d (g_t.2.1 / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m_et - m_d))) = e_J := by
          rw [← h_kd_s]
        set cr_mid := dyadicTimeMid ε r c
        have h_crm_eq : (((g_t.1 / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m_t - m_r)) : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r = cr_mid := by
          change (((dyadicTimeBin ε t c / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m_t - m_r)) : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r = cr_mid
          rw [← h_kr_div]; rfl
        set x_Gr := x_G + (cr_mid - ct_mid) • v_G
        set z := (A + cr_mid • V) - x_Gr
        have hz_eq : z = w + (cr_mid - ct_mid) • u := by
          dsimp only [z, x_Gr, w, u]
          refine h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_ <;> {
            simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            ring
          }
        have hz_1 : |inner ℝ z e_fine| ≤ 2 * ε ^ (b_t + r) := by
          rw [hz_eq, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
          have h_tri := abs_add_le (inner ℝ w e_fine) ((cr_mid - ct_mid) * inner ℝ u e_fine)
          rw [abs_mul] at h_tri
          have h_prod : |cr_mid - ct_mid| * |inner ℝ u e_fine| ≤ ε ^ r * ε ^ b_t :=
            mul_le_mul h_drift_r hu_1 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have h_er_ebt : ε ^ r * ε ^ b_t = ε ^ (b_t + r) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]; congr 1; ring
          have h_ebtt : ε ^ (b_t + t) ≤ ε ^ (b_t + r) := h_rpow_ge (by linarith)
          linarith
        have hz_2 : |inner ℝ z (perp2D e_fine)| ≤ 2 * ε ^ (b_t + d + r) := by
          rw [hz_eq, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
          have h_tri := abs_add_le (inner ℝ w (perp2D e_fine))
            ((cr_mid - ct_mid) * inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine))
          rw [abs_mul] at h_tri
          have h_prod : |cr_mid - ct_mid| * |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine)| ≤ ε ^ r * ε ^ a_t :=
            mul_le_mul h_drift_r hu_2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have h_er_eat : ε ^ r * ε ^ a_t ≤ ε ^ (b_t + d + r) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]; exact h_rpow_ge (by linarith)
          have h_eatt : ε ^ (a_t + t) ≤ ε ^ (b_t + d + r) := h_rpow_ge (by linarith)
          linarith

        have hu_eJ : |inner ℝ V e_J - inner ℝ v_G e_J| ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ b_t := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left]
          change |inner ℝ u e_J| ≤ _
          have hb := (h_fc u).1.1
          have h_eat : ε ^ a_t ≤ ε ^ b_t := h_rpow_ge hba
          push_cast; linarith [hu_1, hu_2, hb, h_eat]
        have hu_peJ : |inner ℝ V (perp2D e_J) - inner ℝ v_G (perp2D e_J)| ≤
            ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (b_t + d) := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left]
          change |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_J)| ≤ _
          have hb := (h_fc u).1.2
          have h_ebtd : ε ^ b_t * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) ≤ (3.15 / 2) * ε ^ (b_t + d) := by
            have h1 : ε ^ b_t * ε ^ d = ε ^ (b_t + d) := (Real.rpow_add hε₀ b_t d).symm
            have h_eq : ε ^ b_t * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) = (Real.pi / 2) * (ε ^ b_t * ε ^ d) := by ring
            rw [h_eq, h1]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hpi_lt]) (by positivity)
          have h_eat : ε ^ a_t ≤ ε ^ (b_t + d) := h_rpow_ge (by linarith)
          have h_mul : |inner ℝ u e_fine| * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) ≤
              ε ^ b_t * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu_1 (by positivity)
          have h_pos_btd : 0 ≤ ε ^ (b_t + d) := by positivity
          push_cast; linarith [hu_2, h_ebtd, h_eat, h_mul, hb, h_pos_btd]
        have hz_eJ : |inner ℝ (A + cr_mid • V) e_J - inner ℝ x_Gr e_J| ≤
            ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (b_t + r) := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left]
          change |inner ℝ z e_J| ≤ _
          have hb := (h_fc z).1.1
          have h_ebdr : ε ^ (b_t + d + r) ≤ ε ^ (b_t + r) := h_rpow_ge (by linarith)
          push_cast; linarith [hz_1, hz_2, h_ebdr, hb]
        have hz_peJ : |inner ℝ (A + cr_mid • V) (perp2D e_J) - inner ℝ x_Gr (perp2D e_J)| ≤
            ((6 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (b_t + d + r) := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left]
          change |inner ℝ z (perp2D e_J)| ≤ _
          have hb := (h_fc z).1.2
          have h_mul : |inner ℝ z e_fine| * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) ≤
              (2 * ε ^ (b_t + r)) * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz_1 (by positivity)
          have h_ebdr : (2 * ε ^ (b_t + r)) * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) ≤
              3.15 * ε ^ (b_t + d + r) := by
            have h1 : ε ^ (b_t + r) * ε ^ d = ε ^ (b_t + d + r) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]; congr 1; ring
            have h_eq : (2 * ε ^ (b_t + r)) * ((Real.pi / 2) * ε ^ d) =
                Real.pi * (ε ^ (b_t + r) * ε ^ d) := by ring
            rw [h_eq, h1]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpi_lt.le (by positivity)
          have h_pos_btdr : 0 ≤ ε ^ (b_t + d + r) := by positivity
          push_cast; linarith [hz_2, h_mul, h_ebdr, hb, h_pos_btdr]

        have hj_eta : j = (j.1, j.2.1, j.2.2.1, j.2.2.2.1, j.2.2.2.2.1, j.2.2.2.2.2) := rfl
        rw [hj_eta]
        dsimp only [B_J]
        rw [h_ec_eq, h_crm_eq, hct_eq]
        simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton]
        have hj_e_dir : angUnitVec ε ((b_t + d) - b_t) (angBin ε ((b_t + d) - b_t) θ) = e_J := by
          dsimp only [e_J]; rw [hj_snd, add_sub_cancel_left]
        have hj_V1 : j.2.2.1 = dyadicRealBin ε b_t (inner ℝ V e_J) := by
          change dyadicRealBin ε b_t (inner ℝ V _) = _; rw [hj_e_dir]
        have hj_V2 : j.2.2.2.1 = dyadicRealBin ε (b_t + d) (inner ℝ V (perp2D e_J)) := by
          change dyadicRealBin ε (b_t + d) (inner ℝ V (perp2D _)) = _; rw [hj_e_dir]
        have hj_X1 : j.2.2.2.2.1 = dyadicRealBin ε (b_t + r) (inner ℝ (A + cr_mid • V) e_J) := by
          change dyadicRealBin ε (b_t + r) (inner ℝ (A + cr_mid • V) _) = _; rw [hj_e_dir]
        have hj_X2 : j.2.2.2.2.2 =
            dyadicRealBin ε (b_t + d + r) (inner ℝ (A + cr_mid • V) (perp2D e_J)) := by
          change dyadicRealBin ε ((b_t + d) + r) (inner ℝ (A + cr_mid • V) (perp2D _)) = _
          rw [hj_e_dir]
        rw [hj_V1, hj_V2, hj_X1, hj_X2]
        exact ⟨h_kr_div, h_kd_s,
          h_real_cover ε b_t _ _ 2 hε₀ hu_eJ,
          h_real_cover ε (b_t + d) _ _ 3 hε₀ hu_peJ,
          h_real_cover ε (b_t + r) _ _ 4 hε₀ hz_eJ,
          h_real_cover ε (b_t + d + r) _ _ 6 hε₀ hz_peJ⟩

      
      have hgloc_in_Bloc : g_loc ∈ B_loc g_t j g_loc.1 := by
        set V_cen := (1 / 10 : ℝ) • L_J e_J (v_G - v_J)
        have hV_diff : V_loc - V_cen = (1 / 10 : ℝ) • L_J e_J u := by
          rw [h_unclamp.1]
          dsimp only [V_cen]
          rw [← smul_sub, h_LJ_sub]
          have h_sub_vJ : (V - v_J) - (v_G - v_J) = u := by dsimp only [u]; abel
          rw [h_sub_vJ]
        have hV_err_1 : |inner ℝ V_loc e_ld - inner ℝ V_cen e_ld| ≤
            ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε_tilde ^ (0 : ℝ) := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left, hV_diff, real_inner_smul_left, abs_mul,
            abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 10)]
          have hb := (h_fc u).2.1
          have h1 : 2 * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ u e_fine| ≤ 2 := by
            calc 2 * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ u e_fine|
                ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-b_t) * ε ^ b_t :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_1 (by positivity)
              _ = 2 * (ε ^ (-b_t) * ε ^ b_t) := by ring
              _ = 2 := by rw [h_embt_ebt, mul_one]
          have h2 : ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine)| ≤ 1 := by
            calc ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine)|
                ≤ ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ a_t :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_2 (by positivity)
              _ = ε_tilde ^ e_loc := h_embtd_eat
              _ ≤ 1 := h_etilde_eloc_le1
          rw [Real.rpow_zero]; push_cast
          linarith
        have hV_err_2 : |inner ℝ V_loc (perp2D e_ld) - inner ℝ V_cen (perp2D e_ld)| ≤
            ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε_tilde ^ e_loc := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left, hV_diff, real_inner_smul_left, abs_mul,
            abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 10)]
          have hb := (h_fc u).2.2
          have h1 : Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ u e_fine| ≤
              3.15 * ε_tilde ^ e_loc := by
            calc Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ u e_fine|
                ≤ Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ (-b_t) * ε ^ b_t :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_1 (by positivity)
              _ = Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * (ε ^ (-b_t) * ε ^ b_t) := by ring
              _ = Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc := by rw [h_embt_ebt, mul_one]
              _ ≤ 3.15 * ε_tilde ^ e_loc :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpi_lt.le (by positivity)
          have h2 : ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine)| ≤ ε_tilde ^ e_loc := by
            calc ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine)|
                ≤ ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ a_t :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_2 (by positivity)
              _ = ε_tilde ^ e_loc := h_embtd_eat
          have h_pos_eloc : 0 ≤ ε_tilde ^ e_loc := by positivity
          push_cast; linarith [hb, h1, h2, h_pos_eloc]

        have h_tau_c_eq : ((g_loc.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_loc1)⁻¹ = τ := rfl
        set c_tilde := ((j.1 : ℝ) + τ) * Δ_r
        set X_cen := (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ • L_J e_J
          ((x_G + (c_tilde - ct_mid) • v_G) - (x_J + ((τ - 1 / 2) * Δ_r) • v_J))
        set q_pos := w + (c_tilde - ct_mid) • u
        have hX_diff : (A_loc + τ • V_loc) - X_cen = (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹ • L_J e_J q_pos := by
          rw [h_unclamp.2]
          dsimp only [X_cen, c_tilde]
          rw [← smul_sub, h_LJ_sub]
          congr 2
          dsimp only [q_pos, w, u]
          refine h_ext_2d _ _ ?_ ?_ <;> {
            simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            ring
          }
        have h_ctilde_err : |c_tilde - ct_mid| ≤ ε ^ t := by
          dsimp only [c_tilde]; rw [hj_fst]; exact h_drift_tau
        have hq_pos_1 : |inner ℝ q_pos e_fine| ≤ 2 * (ε ^ b_t * ε ^ t) := by
          dsimp only [q_pos]
          rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
          have h_tri := abs_add_le (inner ℝ w e_fine) ((c_tilde - ct_mid) * inner ℝ u e_fine)
          rw [abs_mul] at h_tri
          have h_m : |c_tilde - ct_mid| * |inner ℝ u e_fine| ≤ ε ^ t * ε ^ b_t :=
            mul_le_mul h_ctilde_err hu_1 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have h_ebtt : ε ^ (b_t + t) = ε ^ b_t * ε ^ t := Real.rpow_add hε₀ b_t t
          linarith
        have hq_pos_2 : |inner ℝ q_pos (perp2D e_fine)| ≤ 2 * ε ^ (a_t + t) := by
          dsimp only [q_pos]
          rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
          have h_tri := abs_add_le (inner ℝ w (perp2D e_fine))
            ((c_tilde - ct_mid) * inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine))
          rw [abs_mul] at h_tri
          have h_m : |c_tilde - ct_mid| * |inner ℝ u (perp2D e_fine)| ≤ ε ^ t * ε ^ a_t :=
            mul_le_mul h_ctilde_err hu_2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have h_eatt : ε ^ t * ε ^ a_t = ε ^ (a_t + t) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]; congr 1; ring
          linarith

        have hX_err_1 : |inner ℝ (A_loc + τ • V_loc) e_ld - inner ℝ X_cen e_ld| ≤
            ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε_tilde ^ (0 + 1 : ℝ) := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left, hX_diff, real_inner_smul_left, abs_mul,
            abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹)]
          have hb := (h_fc q_pos).2.1
          have h_in_ub : |inner ℝ (L_J e_J q_pos) e_ld| ≤
              4 * ε ^ t + 2 * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t)) := by
            have h1 : 2 * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ q_pos e_fine| ≤ 4 * ε ^ t := by
              calc 2 * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ q_pos e_fine|
                  ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-b_t) * (2 * (ε ^ b_t * ε ^ t)) :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_pos_1 (by positivity)
                _ = 4 * (ε ^ (-b_t) * ε ^ b_t) * ε ^ t := by ring
                _ = 4 * ε ^ t := by rw [h_embt_ebt, mul_one]
            have h2 : ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ q_pos (perp2D e_fine)| ≤
                2 * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t)) := by
              have h_m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_pos_2
                (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-(b_t + d))).le
              linarith
            linarith
          have h_prod := mul_le_mul h_inv_10Δ h_in_ub (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have h_rhs_eq : ((1 / 5 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-r)) *
              (4 * ε ^ t + 2 * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t))) =
              (4 / 5 : ℝ) * ε_tilde + (2 / 5 : ℝ) * ε_tilde ^ (e_loc + 1) := by
            calc ((1 / 5 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-r)) *
                  (4 * ε ^ t + 2 * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t)))
                = (4 / 5 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-r) * ε ^ t) +
                    (2 / 5 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-r) * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t))) := by ring
              _ = (4 / 5 : ℝ) * ε_tilde + (2 / 5 : ℝ) * ε_tilde ^ (e_loc + 1) := by
                  rw [h_emr_et, h_embtd_eatt]
          rw [zero_add, Real.rpow_one]; push_cast
          linarith [h_prod, h_rhs_eq, h_el1_le, hε_tilde_pos]

        have hX_err_2 : |inner ℝ (A_loc + τ • V_loc) (perp2D e_ld) - inner ℝ X_cen (perp2D e_ld)| ≤
            ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε_tilde ^ (e_loc + 1) := by
          rw [← inner_sub_left, hX_diff, real_inner_smul_left, abs_mul,
            abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (10 * Δ_r)⁻¹)]
          have hb := (h_fc q_pos).2.2
          have h_in_ub : |inner ℝ (L_J e_J q_pos) (perp2D e_ld)| ≤
              2 * Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ t +
                2 * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t)) := by
            have h1 : Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ q_pos e_fine| ≤
                2 * Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ t := by
              calc Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ (-b_t) * |inner ℝ q_pos e_fine|
                  ≤ Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ (-b_t) * (2 * (ε ^ b_t * ε ^ t)) :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_pos_1 (by positivity)
                _ = 2 * Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * (ε ^ (-b_t) * ε ^ b_t) * ε ^ t := by ring
                _ = 2 * Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ t := by rw [h_embt_ebt, mul_one]
            have h2 : ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * |inner ℝ q_pos (perp2D e_fine)| ≤
                2 * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t)) := by
              have h_m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_pos_2
                (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-(b_t + d))).le
              linarith
            linarith
          have h_prod := mul_le_mul h_inv_10Δ h_in_ub (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have h_rhs_eq : ((1 / 5 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-r)) *
              (2 * Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ t +
                2 * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t))) =
              ((2 * Real.pi + 2) / 5) * ε_tilde ^ (e_loc + 1) := by
            have h_el1 : ε_tilde ^ e_loc * (ε ^ (-r) * ε ^ t) = ε_tilde ^ (e_loc + 1) := by
              rw [h_emr_et, Real.rpow_add hε_tilde_pos, Real.rpow_one]
            calc ((1 / 5 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-r)) *
                  (2 * Real.pi * ε_tilde ^ e_loc * ε ^ t +
                    2 * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t)))
                = ((2 * Real.pi) / 5) * (ε_tilde ^ e_loc * (ε ^ (-r) * ε ^ t)) +
                    (2 / 5 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-r) * (ε ^ (-(b_t + d)) * ε ^ (a_t + t))) := by ring
              _ = ((2 * Real.pi + 2) / 5) * ε_tilde ^ (e_loc + 1) := by
                  rw [h_el1, h_embtd_eatt]; ring
          have h_2pi_le : ((2 * Real.pi + 2) / 5) * ε_tilde ^ (e_loc + 1) ≤
              2 * ε_tilde ^ (e_loc + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hpi_lt]) (by positivity)
          push_cast
          linarith [h_prod, h_rhs_eq, h_2pi_le]

        have hg_eta : g_loc =
            (g_loc.1, g_loc.2.1, g_loc.2.2.1, g_loc.2.2.2.1, g_loc.2.2.2.2.1, g_loc.2.2.2.2.2) := rfl
        rw [hg_eta]
        dsimp only [B_loc]
        change _ ∈ ({g_loc.1} : Finset ℤ) ×ˢ _
        rw [← hθ_loc_eq, hct_eq, h_tau_c_eq]
        rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_product,
          Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.mem_singleton]
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl,
          h_real_cover ε_tilde 0 _ _ 1 hε_tilde_pos hV_err_1,
          h_real_cover ε_tilde e_loc _ _ 1 hε_tilde_pos hV_err_2,
          h_real_cover ε_tilde (0 + 1) _ _ 2 hε_tilde_pos hX_err_1,
          h_real_cover ε_tilde (e_loc + 1) _ _ 2 hε_tilde_pos hX_err_2⟩

      dsimp only [F_fwd]
      rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      refine ⟨j, hj_in_BJ, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      refine ⟨g_loc.1, h_kloc_mem, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_image]
      exact ⟨g_loc, hgloc_in_Bloc, rfl⟩

  
  obtain ⟨F_fwd, hFfwd_card, hFfwd_mem⟩ := h_s3
  refine ⟨fun e_u k_ang => h_ang_norm_all ε e_u k_ang, h_loc_ball, ?_, hΔr_bds, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c θ hc
    exact ⟨(h_time_c c hc).1, (h_proj_dir _).1⟩
  · rintro V A c θ ⟨k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2⟩ hc _ hJ
    obtain ⟨hkr_eq, _, _, hV_inv, hX_inv⟩ :=
      h_inv_all V A c θ (k_r, k_ang_d, k_V1, k_V2, k_X1, k_X2) hJ
    dsimp only
    have h_cmid_mem : ((k_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [hkr_eq]
      exact (h_time_c c hc).2.1
    exact ⟨h_cmid_mem, hkr_eq, hV_inv, hX_inv⟩
  · refine ⟨F_fwd, F_time, hFfwd_card, hFtime_card, ?_⟩
    intro V A c θ hc hθ
    exact ⟨hFfwd_mem V A c θ hc hθ, (h_time_fib c hc).1⟩

informal_problem.statement:
{N_ω : ℕ} {α_T α_Kr α_Kt α_J α_Gt α_Gloc α_Kloc : Type}
    [DecidableEq α_J] [DecidableEq α_Gloc] [DecidableEq α_Kt]
    (ε η : ℝ) (M_fwd M_time : ℕ)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (T : Fin N_ω → α_T)
    (K_r : Fin N_ω → α_Kr)
    (K_t : Fin N_ω → α_Kt)
    (J : Fin N_ω → α_J)
    (G_t : Fin N_ω → α_Gt)
    (G_loc : α_J → Fin N_ω → α_Gloc)
    (K_loc : Fin N_ω → α_Kloc)
    (proj_r : α_J → α_Kr)
    (F_fwd : α_Gt → Finset (α_J × α_Gloc))
    (F_time : α_Kr × α_Kloc → Finset α_Kt)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hε_tilde : ε ^ η < 1 / 2)
    (hM_fwd : 1 ≤ M_fwd) (hM_time : 1 ≤ M_time)
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1)
    (h_proj : ∀ ω, proj_r (J ω) = K_r ω)
    (hF_fwd_card : ∀ g, (F_fwd g).card ≤ M_fwd)
    (hF_fwd_mem : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → (J ω, G_loc (J ω) ω) ∈ F_fwd (G_t ω))
    (hF_time_card : ∀ p, (F_time p).card ≤ M_time)
    (hF_time_mem : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → K_t ω ∈ F_time (K_r ω, K_loc ω)) :
    let ε_tilde := ε ^ η
    let S_J : Finset α_J := Finset.univ.image J
    let p_J := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0
    let π_j := fun j => restrictLaw π (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j))
    (finMutualInfo ε π T J +
        η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finMutualInfo ε_tilde (π_j j) T (G_loc j) ≤
      finMutualInfo ε π T G_t + Real.log (M_fwd : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ∧
    (finCondEntropy ε π T K_t - finCondEntropy ε π T K_r ≤
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, K_r ω)) J +
        η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) T K_loc +
        Real.log (M_time : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))
