proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε_tilde S_J p_J π_j
  have _ := hε_tilde
  have h_ell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    rw [Real.log_inv, neg_pos]
    exact Real.log_neg hε₀ (by linarith)
  have h_ell_tilde : Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹) = η * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    dsimp only [ε_tilde]
    rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_rpow hε₀, Real.log_inv]
    ring
  have h_eta_div : ∀ x : ℝ, η * (x / Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹)) = x / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro x
    rw [h_ell_tilde]
    have h1 : η ≠ 0 := hη.ne'
    have h2 : Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≠ 0 := h_ell_pos.ne'
    field_simp [h1, h2]
  have h_ite_iff : ∀ {P Q : Prop} (dP : Decidable P) (dQ : Decidable Q) (a b : ℝ),
      (P ↔ Q) → @ite ℝ P dP a b = @ite ℝ Q dQ a b := by
    intro P Q dP dQ a b hPQ
    cases dP with
    | isTrue hP => cases dQ with
      | isTrue _ => rfl
      | isFalse hQ => exact absurd (hPQ.mp hP) hQ
    | isFalse hP => cases dQ with
      | isTrue hQ => exact absurd (hPQ.mpr hQ) hP
      | isFalse _ => rfl
  have h_div_mul_le : ∀ (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → (A / B) * B ≤ A := by
    intro A B hA
    by_cases hB : B = 0
    · rw [hB, mul_zero]; exact hA
    · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ A hB]
  have h_pos_nn : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
        0 < finProbAt π X ω ∧
        0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω ∧
        0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω) ∧
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
    intro α β X Y
    have h_atom : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
        0 < finProbAt π X ω ∧
        0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω ∧
        0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω := by
      intro ω hπω
      have h_le2 : π ω ≤ finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        let _ := Classical.propDecidable
        calc π ω = (if X ω = X ω ∧ Y ω = Y ω then π ω else 0) := by simp
          _ ≤ ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then π ω' else 0 :=
            Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then π ω' else 0)
              (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
              (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      have h2_le_1 : finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
        let _ := Classical.propDecidable
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : X ω' = X ω
        · by_cases h2 : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω']
        · simp [h1]
      have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hπω h_le2
      have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le h2_pos h2_le_1
      have h_surp_nn : 0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω := by
        unfold condSurprise
        have h_log_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) ≤ 0 :=
          Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg h2_pos.le h1_pos.le) ((div_le_one h1_pos).mpr h2_le_1)
        exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr h_log_np) h_ell_pos.le
      exact ⟨h1_pos, h2_pos, h_surp_nn⟩
    refine ⟨h_atom, ?_⟩
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < π ω
    · exact mul_nonneg hpos.le (h_atom ω hpos).2.2
    · have hz : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hπ_nn ω)
      rw [hz, zero_mul]

  have h_cond_eq : ∀ {α₁ α₂ β : Type} (X₁ : Fin N_ω → α₁) (X₂ : Fin N_ω → α₂) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < π ω₁ → 0 < π ω₂ → (X₁ ω₁ = X₁ ω₂ ↔ X₂ ω₁ = X₂ ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X₁ Y = finCondEntropy ε π X₂ Y := by
    intro α₁ α₂ β X₁ X₂ Y h_iff
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hπω : 0 < π ω
    · congr 1
      unfold condSurprise
      have hp1 : finProbAt π X₁ ω = finProbAt π X₂ ω := by
        unfold finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hπω' : 0 < π ω'
        · exact h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ (h_iff ω' ω hπω' hπω)
        · have hz : π ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hπω') (hπ_nn ω')
          rw [hz, ite_self, ite_self]
      have hp2 : finProbAt2 π X₁ Y ω = finProbAt2 π X₂ Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hπω' : 0 < π ω'
        · exact h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ (and_congr_left' (h_iff ω' ω hπω' hπω))
        · have hz : π ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hπω') (hπ_nn ω')
          rw [hz, ite_self, ite_self]
      rw [hp1, hp2]
    · have hz : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hπω) (hπ_nn ω)
      rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_mul]

  have h_chain : ∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z := by
    intro α β γ_t X Y Z
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    rw [← mul_add]
    by_cases hπω : 0 < π ω
    · congr 1
      have hp_xy : finProbAt π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) ω = finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
        unfold finProbAt finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        exact h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Prod.ext_iff
      have hp_xyz : finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) Z ω =
          finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        refine h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ ?_
        rw [Prod.ext_iff, Prod.ext_iff, and_assoc]
      obtain ⟨hpX, hpXY, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn X Y).1 ω hπω
      obtain ⟨_, hpXYZ, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω'))).1 ω hπω
      unfold condSurprise
      rw [hp_xy, hp_xyz]
      have h_mul : (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) *
          (finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω / finProbAt2 π X Y ω) =
          finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω / finProbAt π X ω := by
        field_simp [hpX.ne', hpXY.ne']
      have h_log : Real.log (finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω / finProbAt π X ω) =
          Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) +
          Real.log (finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω / finProbAt2 π X Y ω) := by
        rw [← h_mul, Real.log_mul (div_pos hpXY hpX).ne' (div_pos hpXYZ hpXY).ne']
      rw [h_log]
      ring
    · have hz : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hπω) (hπ_nn ω)
      rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_mul]

  have h_swap_target : ∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π X (fun ω => (Z ω, Y ω)) := by
    intro α β γ_t X Y Z
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    have hp : finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Y ω', Z ω')) ω =
        finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => (Z ω', Y ω')) ω := by
      unfold finProbAt2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      refine h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ ?_
      rw [Prod.ext_iff, Prod.ext_iff]
      tauto
    rw [hp]

  have h_subadd : ∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z := by
    intro α β γ_t X Y Z
    have hc1 := h_chain X Z Y
    have hc2 := h_chain X Y Z
    have hsw := h_swap_target X Z Y
    have hnn := (h_pos_nn (fun ω => (X ω, Z ω)) Y).2
    linarith

  have h_gibbs : ∀ {α γ_t : Type} [DecidableEq γ_t]
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t)
      (F : α → Finset γ_t) (q : α → γ_t → ℝ),
      (∀ x z, 0 ≤ q x z) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → 0 < q (X ω) (Z ω)) →
      (∀ x, ∑ z ∈ F x, q x z ≤ 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → Z ω ∈ F (X ω)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Z ≤
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω)))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro α γ_t _ X Z F q hq_nn hq_pos hq_sum hF_mem
    have _ : DecidableEq α := Classical.decEq α
    have _ : DecidablePred (fun ω : Fin N_ω => 0 < π ω) := Classical.decPred _
    let S_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)
    have hπ_zero_off : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S_pos → π ω = 0 := by
      intro ω hω
      simp only [S_pos, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_lt] at hω
      exact le_antisymm hω (hπ_nn ω)
    have h_sum_Spos : ∀ g : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * g ω) = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * g ω := by
      intro g
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos)
        (fun ω _ hω => by rw [hπ_zero_off ω hω, zero_mul])).symm
    let pX : α → ℝ := fun x => ∑ ω' ∈ S_pos, if X ω' = x then π ω' else 0
    let pXZ : α → γ_t → ℝ := fun x z => ∑ ω' ∈ S_pos, if X ω' = x ∧ Z ω' = z then π ω' else 0
    have hpX_nn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ pX x :=
      fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
    have h_pX_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt π X ω = pX (X ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt
      have h1 : (let _ := Classical.propDecidable; ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω then π ω' else 0) =
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω then π ω' else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Iff.rfl)
      rw [h1]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos)
        (fun ω' _ hω' => by rw [hπ_zero_off ω' hω', ite_self])).symm
    have h_pXZ_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 π X Z ω = pXZ (X ω) (Z ω) := by
      intro ω
      unfold finProbAt2
      have h1 : (let _ := Classical.propDecidable;
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω then π ω' else 0) =
          ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω then π ω' else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Iff.rfl)
      rw [h1]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos)
        (fun ω' _ hω' => by rw [hπ_zero_off ω' hω', ite_self])).symm
    let R : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => (pX (X ω) * q (X ω) (Z ω)) / pXZ (X ω) (Z ω)
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos,
        π ω * condSurprise ε π X Z ω ≤
          (π ω * (-Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω))) + (π ω * R ω - π ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hπω : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      obtain ⟨hpX_p, hpXZ_p, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn X Z).1 ω hπω
      rw [h_pX_eq ω] at hpX_p
      rw [h_pXZ_eq ω] at hpXZ_p
      have hq_p : 0 < q (X ω) (Z ω) := hq_pos ω hπω
      have hR_pos : 0 < R ω := div_pos (mul_pos hpX_p hq_p) hpXZ_p
      have h_mul_id : (pXZ (X ω) (Z ω) / pX (X ω)) * R ω = q (X ω) (Z ω) := by
        dsimp only [R]
        field_simp [hpX_p.ne', hpXZ_p.ne']
      have h_log_id : Real.log (pXZ (X ω) (Z ω) / pX (X ω)) + Real.log (R ω) =
          Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω)) := by
        rw [← Real.log_mul (div_pos hpXZ_p hpX_p).ne' hR_pos.ne', h_mul_id]
      have h_log_le : Real.log (R ω) ≤ R ω - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hR_pos
      have h_num_le : -(Real.log (pXZ (X ω) (Z ω) / pX (X ω))) ≤
          -Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω)) + (R ω - 1) := by
        linarith [h_log_id, h_log_le]
      unfold condSurprise
      rw [h_pX_eq ω, h_pXZ_eq ω]
      have h_div_le : -(Real.log (pXZ (X ω) (Z ω) / pX (X ω))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
          (-Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω)) + (R ω - 1)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le h_ell_pos.le
      calc π ω * (-(Real.log (pXZ (X ω) (Z ω) / pX (X ω))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))
          ≤ π ω * ((-Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω)) + (R ω - 1)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div_le hπω.le
        _ = (π ω * (-Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω))) + (π ω * R ω - π ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
            ring
    let A_X : Finset α := S_pos.image X
    have h_sum_R : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * R ω ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω := by
      have h_expand : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * R ω =
          ∑ x ∈ A_X, ∑ z ∈ F x,
            (((pX x * q x z) / pXZ x z) * (if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω else 0)) := by
        intro ω hω
        have hπω : 0 < π ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        have hx_mem : X ω ∈ A_X := Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω
        have hz_mem : Z ω ∈ F (X ω) := hF_mem ω hπω
        have h_inner : ∀ x : α,
            (∑ z ∈ F x, ((pX x * q x z) / pXZ x z) *
              (if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω else 0)) =
            if X ω = x then ((pX x * q x (Z ω)) / pXZ x (Z ω)) * π ω else 0 := by
          intro x
          by_cases hx : X ω = x
          · have h_step : (∑ z ∈ F x, ((pX x * q x z) / pXZ x z) *
                (if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω else 0)) =
                ∑ z ∈ F x, if Z ω = z then ((pX x * q x z) / pXZ x z) * π ω else 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
              by_cases hz : Z ω = z <;> simp [hx, hz]
            have hz_mem' : Z ω ∈ F x := hx ▸ hz_mem
            rw [h_step, Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem (F x) (Z ω)
              (fun z => ((pX x * q x z) / pXZ x z) * π ω) hz_mem']
            simp only [hx, ↓reduceIte]
          · simp [hx]
        simp_rw [h_inner]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem A_X (X ω)
          (fun x => ((pX x * q x (Z ω)) / pXZ x (Z ω)) * π ω) hx_mem]
        dsimp only [R]
        ring
      have h_pX_sum : ∑ x ∈ A_X, pX x = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω := by
        dsimp only [pX]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        exact Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem A_X (X ω) (fun _ => π ω) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω)
      calc ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * R ω
          = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, ∑ x ∈ A_X, ∑ z ∈ F x,
              (((pX x * q x z) / pXZ x z) * (if X ω = x ∧ Z ω = z then π ω else 0)) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl h_expand
        _ = ∑ x ∈ A_X, ∑ z ∈ F x, (((pX x * q x z) / pXZ x z) * pXZ x z) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ A_X, ∑ z ∈ F x, (pX x * q x z) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z _ => ?_))
            exact h_div_mul_le _ _ (mul_nonneg (hpX_nn x) (hq_nn x z))
        _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ A_X, pX x := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => ?_)
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
            exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hpX_nn x) (hq_sum x)
        _ = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω := h_pX_sum
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [h_sum_Spos (condSurprise ε π X Z),
      h_sum_Spos (fun ω => -Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω)))]
    calc ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * condSurprise ε π X Z ω
        ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_pos,
            (π ω * (-Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω))) + (π ω * R ω - π ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
      _ = ((∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω)))) +
            ((∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * R ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ ≤ (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (q (X ω) (Z ω)))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
          refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ h_ell_pos.le
          linarith [h_sum_R]

  have h_fiber_bound : ∀ {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β]
      (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (F : α → Finset β) (M : ℕ),
      1 ≤ M →
      (∀ x, (F x).card ≤ M) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → Y ω ∈ F (X ω)) →
      finCondEntropy ε π X Y ≤ Real.log (M : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro α β _ X Y F M hM hF_card hF_mem
    have hM_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hM
    have hM_pos : 0 < (M : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM_ge
    have h_ub := h_gibbs X Y F (fun _ _ => ((M : ℝ))⁻¹)
      (fun _ _ => inv_nonneg.mpr hM_pos.le)
      (fun _ _ => inv_pos.mpr hM_pos)
      (fun x => by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        have h_card : ((F x).card : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (hF_card x)
        calc ((F x).card : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ))⁻¹
            ≤ (M : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card (inv_nonneg.mpr hM_pos.le)
          _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hM_pos.ne')
      hF_mem
    refine le_trans h_ub (le_of_eq ?_)
    have h_log : -Real.log (((M : ℝ))⁻¹) = Real.log (M : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
    simp_rw [h_log]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hπ_sum, one_mul]

  have h_cond_snd : ∀ {α β γ_t : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (Z : Fin N_ω → γ_t),
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z ≤ finCondEntropy ε π Y Z := by
    intro α β γ_t X Y Z
    have _ : DecidableEq β := Classical.decEq β
    have _ : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
    let F_Z : α × β → Finset γ_t := fun _ => Finset.univ.image Z
    let pY : β → ℝ := fun y => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if Y ω' = y then π ω' else 0
    let pYZ : β → γ_t → ℝ := fun y z => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if Y ω' = y ∧ Z ω' = z then π ω' else 0
    have hpY_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt π Y ω = pY (Y ω) :=
      fun ω => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Iff.rfl)
    have hpYZ_eq : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 π Y Z ω = pYZ (Y ω) (Z ω) :=
      fun ω => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => h_ite_iff _ _ _ _ Iff.rfl)
    let q : α × β → γ_t → ℝ := fun xy z => pYZ xy.2 z / pY xy.2
    have hq_nn : ∀ xy z, 0 ≤ q xy z := by
      intro xy z
      exact div_nonneg
        (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]))
        (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]))
    have hq_pos : ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → 0 < q (X ω, Y ω) (Z ω) := by
      intro ω hπω
      obtain ⟨hpY_p, hpYZ_p, _⟩ := (h_pos_nn Y Z).1 ω hπω
      rw [hpY_eq ω] at hpY_p
      rw [hpYZ_eq ω] at hpYZ_p
      exact div_pos hpYZ_p hpY_p
    have hq_sum : ∀ xy : α × β, ∑ z ∈ F_Z xy, q xy z ≤ 1 := by
      intro xy
      dsimp only [q, F_Z]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div]
      have h_num : ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.image Z, pYZ xy.2 z = pY xy.2 := by
        dsimp only [pYZ, pY]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        have hm : Z ω' ∈ Finset.univ.image Z := Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z (Finset.mem_univ ω')
        by_cases hy : Y ω' = xy.2
        · simp only [hy, true_and]
          exact Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem (Finset.univ.image Z) (Z ω') (fun _ => π ω') hm
        · simp [hy]
      rw [h_num]
      by_cases hp0 : pY xy.2 = 0
      · rw [hp0, zero_div]; exact zero_le_one
      · rw [div_self hp0]
    have h_ub := h_gibbs (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Z F_Z q hq_nn hq_pos hq_sum
      (fun ω _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z (Finset.mem_univ ω))
    refine le_trans h_ub (le_of_eq ?_)
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [← hpYZ_eq ω, ← hpY_eq ω, mul_div_assoc]

  have h_mi_one_sided : ∀ {α β₁ β₂ : Type}
      (T₀ : Fin N_ω → α) (A : Fin N_ω → β₁) (B : Fin N_ω → β₂),
      finMutualInfo ε π T₀ B ≤ finMutualInfo ε π T₀ A + finCondEntropy ε π A B := by
    intro α β₁ β₂ T₀ A B
    let U0 : Fin N_ω → Unit := fun _ => ()
    have hc_u_ab := h_chain U0 A B
    have hc_u_ba := h_chain U0 B A
    have hsw_u := h_swap_target U0 A B
    have heq_ua : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (U0 ω, A ω)) B = finCondEntropy ε π A B :=
      h_cond_eq _ _ B (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [U0, Prod.ext_iff])
    have heq_ub : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (U0 ω, B ω)) A = finCondEntropy ε π B A :=
      h_cond_eq _ _ A (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [U0, Prod.ext_iff])
    have hc_t_ab := h_chain T₀ A B
    have hc_t_ba := h_chain T₀ B A
    have hsw_t := h_swap_target T₀ A B
    have h_nn_tab := (h_pos_nn (fun ω => (T₀ ω, A ω)) B).2
    have h_dp_tba := h_cond_snd T₀ B A
    unfold finMutualInfo
    change finCondEntropy ε π U0 B - finCondEntropy ε π T₀ B ≤
      (finCondEntropy ε π U0 A - finCondEntropy ε π T₀ A) + finCondEntropy ε π A B
    linarith

  have h_fiber_disint : ∀ {α_W α_U : Type} (W : Fin N_ω → α_W) (U : α_J → Fin N_ω → α_U),
      η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) W (U j) =
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (J ω, W ω)) (fun ω => U (J ω) ω) := by
    intro α_W α_U W U
    let JW : Fin N_ω → α_J × α_W := fun ω => (J ω, W ω)
    let U_diag : Fin N_ω → α_U := fun ω => U (J ω) ω
    change η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) W (U j) =
      finCondEntropy ε π JW U_diag
    unfold finCondEntropy
    have h_rhs_part : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * condSurprise ε π JW U_diag ω) =
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j),
          π ω * condSurprise ε π JW U_diag ω :=
      (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (fun ω _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem J (Finset.mem_univ ω)) _).symm
    rw [h_rhs_part, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    let F_j : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j)
    have hFj_sum : ∑ ω ∈ F_j, π ω = p_J j := by
      dsimp only [F_j, p_J]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    have hpj_nn : 0 ≤ p_J j := by
      rw [← hFj_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hπ_nn ω)
    by_cases hpj : 0 < p_J j
    · have hπj_eval : ∀ ω, π_j j ω = if ω ∈ F_j then π ω / p_J j else 0 := by
        intro ω
        dsimp only [π_j, restrictLaw, F_j]
        rw [hFj_sum]
      have h_lhs_sub : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_j j ω * condSurprise ε_tilde (π_j j) W (U j) ω) =
          ∑ ω ∈ F_j, π_j j ω * condSurprise ε_tilde (π_j j) W (U j) ω := by
        refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_j) (fun ω _ hω => ?_)).symm
        rw [hπj_eval ω]
        simp only [hω, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
      rw [h_lhs_sub, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hJω : J ω = j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      have hω_Fj : ω ∈ F_j := hω
      have hπj_ω : π_j j ω = π ω / p_J j := by
        rw [hπj_eval ω]
        simp only [hω_Fj, ↓reduceIte]
      have hp1 : finProbAt (π_j j) W ω = finProbAt π JW ω / p_J j := by
        unfold finProbAt
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hJω' : J ω' = j
        · have hω'_mem : ω' ∈ F_j := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω', hJω'⟩
          rw [hπj_eval ω']
          simp only [hω'_mem, ↓reduceIte]
          by_cases hW : W ω' = W ω
          · have hJW : JW ω' = JW ω := Prod.ext (hJω'.trans hJω.symm) hW
            simp only [hW, hJW, ↓reduceIte]
          · have hJW : JW ω' ≠ JW ω := fun h => hW (congr_arg Prod.snd h)
            simp only [hW, hJW, ↓reduceIte, zero_div]
        · have hω'_nmem : ω' ∉ F_j := fun hm => hJω' (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2
          have hJW : JW ω' ≠ JW ω := fun h => hJω' ((congr_arg Prod.fst h).trans hJω)
          rw [hπj_eval ω']
          simp only [hω'_nmem, hJW, ↓reduceIte, ite_self, zero_div]
      have hp2 : finProbAt2 (π_j j) W (U j) ω = finProbAt2 π JW U_diag ω / p_J j := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hJω' : J ω' = j
        · have hω'_mem : ω' ∈ F_j := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω', hJω'⟩
          rw [hπj_eval ω']
          simp only [hω'_mem, ↓reduceIte]
          by_cases hWU : W ω' = W ω ∧ U j ω' = U j ω
          · have hJWU : JW ω' = JW ω ∧ U_diag ω' = U_diag ω := by
              refine ⟨Prod.ext (hJω'.trans hJω.symm) hWU.1, ?_⟩
              dsimp only [U_diag]
              rw [hJω', hJω]
              exact hWU.2
            simp only [hWU, hJWU, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          · have hJWU : ¬ (JW ω' = JW ω ∧ U_diag ω' = U_diag ω) := by
              intro h
              apply hWU
              refine ⟨congr_arg Prod.snd h.1, ?_⟩
              have hu := h.2
              dsimp only [U_diag] at hu
              rwa [hJω', hJω] at hu
            simp only [hWU, hJWU, ↓reduceIte, zero_div]
        · have hω'_nmem : ω' ∉ F_j := fun hm => hJω' (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2
          have hJWU : ¬ (JW ω' = JW ω ∧ U_diag ω' = U_diag ω) :=
            fun h => hJω' ((congr_arg Prod.fst h.1).trans hJω)
          rw [hπj_eval ω']
          simp only [hω'_nmem, hJWU, ↓reduceIte, ite_self, zero_div]
      have h_cs : η * condSurprise ε_tilde (π_j j) W (U j) ω =
          condSurprise ε π JW U_diag ω := by
        unfold condSurprise
        rw [hp1, hp2, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hpj.ne']
        exact h_eta_div _
      calc η * (p_J j * (π_j j ω * condSurprise ε_tilde (π_j j) W (U j) ω))
          = (p_J j * (π ω / p_J j)) * (η * condSurprise ε_tilde (π_j j) W (U j) ω) := by
            rw [hπj_ω]; ring
        _ = π ω * condSurprise ε π JW U_diag ω := by
            rw [mul_div_cancel₀ (π ω) hpj.ne', h_cs]
    · have hpj0 : p_J j = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpj) hpj_nn
      rw [hpj0, zero_mul, mul_zero]
      have h_sum0 : ∑ ω ∈ F_j, π ω = 0 := hFj_sum.trans hpj0
      have h_all0 : ∀ ω ∈ F_j, π ω = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun ω _ => hπ_nn ω)).mp h_sum0
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω hω => by rw [h_all0 ω hω, zero_mul])).symm

  
  have h_conj1 :
      finMutualInfo ε π T J +
        η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finMutualInfo ε_tilde (π_j j) T (G_loc j) ≤
      finMutualInfo ε π T G_t + Real.log (M_fwd : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    let G_diag : Fin N_ω → α_Gloc := fun ω => G_loc (J ω) ω
    let JG : Fin N_ω → α_J × α_Gloc := fun ω => (J ω, G_diag ω)
    let U0 : Fin N_ω → Unit := fun _ => ()
    have h_mi_disint :
        η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finMutualInfo ε_tilde (π_j j) T (G_loc j) =
          finCondEntropy ε π J G_diag - finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, J ω)) G_diag := by
      have h_split : (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finMutualInfo ε_tilde (π_j j) T (G_loc j)) =
          (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) U0 (G_loc j)) -
            (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) T (G_loc j)) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        unfold finMutualInfo
        change p_J j * (finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) U0 (G_loc j) -
          finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) T (G_loc j)) = _
        ring
      rw [h_split, mul_sub, h_fiber_disint U0 G_loc, h_fiber_disint T G_loc]
      have heq1 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (J ω, U0 ω)) G_diag =
          finCondEntropy ε π J G_diag :=
        h_cond_eq _ _ G_diag (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [U0, Prod.ext_iff])
      have heq2 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (J ω, T ω)) G_diag =
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, J ω)) G_diag :=
        h_cond_eq _ _ G_diag (fun _ _ _ _ => by rw [Prod.ext_iff, Prod.ext_iff, and_comm])
      rw [heq1, heq2]
    have h_lhs_eq :
        finMutualInfo ε π T J +
          η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finMutualInfo ε_tilde (π_j j) T (G_loc j) =
        finMutualInfo ε π T JG := by
      rw [h_mi_disint]
      have hc1 := h_chain U0 J G_diag
      have heq_uj : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (U0 ω, J ω)) G_diag =
          finCondEntropy ε π J G_diag :=
        h_cond_eq _ _ G_diag (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [U0, Prod.ext_iff])
      have hc2 := h_chain T J G_diag
      unfold finMutualInfo
      change (finCondEntropy ε π U0 J - finCondEntropy ε π T J) +
        (finCondEntropy ε π J G_diag - finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, J ω)) G_diag) =
        finCondEntropy ε π U0 JG - finCondEntropy ε π T JG
      linarith [hc1, heq_uj, hc2]
    have h_step1 := h_mi_one_sided T G_t JG
    have h_step2 := h_fiber_bound G_t JG F_fwd M_fwd hM_fwd hF_fwd_card hF_fwd_mem
    linarith [h_lhs_eq, h_step1, h_step2]

  
  have h_conj2 :
      finCondEntropy ε π T K_t - finCondEntropy ε π T K_r ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, K_r ω)) J +
          η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * finCondEntropy ε_tilde (π_j j) T K_loc +
          Real.log (M_time : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    have hs1 := h_subadd T K_r K_t
    have hs2 := h_subadd (fun ω => (T ω, K_r ω)) J K_t
    have hs3 := h_subadd (fun ω => ((T ω, K_r ω), J ω)) K_loc K_t
    have h_kloc_cond :
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => ((T ω, K_r ω), J ω)) K_loc =
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (J ω, T ω)) K_loc := by
      refine h_cond_eq _ _ K_loc (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ => ?_)
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact Prod.ext (congr_arg Prod.snd h) (congr_arg (fun p => p.1.1) h)
      · intro h
        have hJ : J ω₁ = J ω₂ := congr_arg Prod.fst h
        have hT : T ω₁ = T ω₂ := congr_arg Prod.snd h
        have hKr : K_r ω₁ = K_r ω₂ := by
          rw [← h_proj ω₁, ← h_proj ω₂, hJ]
        exact Prod.ext (Prod.ext hT hKr) hJ
    have h_kloc_disint := h_fiber_disint T (fun _ => K_loc)
    let F'_time : ((α_T × α_Kr) × α_J) × α_Kloc → Finset α_Kt :=
      fun q => F_time (q.1.1.2, q.2)
    have h_kt_cap :
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (((T ω, K_r ω), J ω), K_loc ω)) K_t ≤
          Real.log (M_time : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
      h_fiber_bound (fun ω => (((T ω, K_r ω), J ω), K_loc ω)) K_t F'_time M_time
        hM_time (fun q => hF_time_card (q.1.1.2, q.2)) (fun ω hπω => hF_time_mem ω hπω)
    linarith [hs1, hs2, hs3, h_kloc_cond, h_kloc_disint, h_kt_cap]

  exact ⟨h_conj1, h_conj2⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(γ ε r t L_hor b_t a_t d B A : ℝ)
    (e_J e_D : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hr₀ : 0 < r) (hrt : r < t)
    (hb₀ : 0 ≤ b_t) (hatL : a_t + t ≤ L_hor)
    (hd₀ : 0 ≤ d) (hda : d ≤ a_t - b_t)
    (hB₀ : 0 ≤ B) (hBA : B ≤ A) (hA_hi : A ≤ 1 + (a_t - b_t - d) / (t - r))
    (heJ : ‖e_J‖ = 1) (heD : ‖e_D‖ = 1) :
    let η := t - r
    let S_J_lin := fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
      (ε ^ b_t * z 0) • e_J + (ε ^ (b_t + d) * z 1) • perp2D e_J
    ∃ (p_raw q_raw : ℝ) (e_G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 ≤ p_raw ∧ p_raw ≤ q_raw ∧ q_raw + r ≤ L_hor ∧ ‖e_G‖ = 1 ∧
      ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
          η * ((1 + γ) * B + (1 - γ) * A) ≤
        (1 + γ) * p_raw + (1 - γ) * q_raw ∧
      ∀ (z w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (Δ_r : ℝ),
        0 < Δ_r → Δ_r ≤ ε ^ r →
        |inner ℝ z e_D| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ η) ^ B →
        |inner ℝ z (perp2D e_D)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ η) ^ A →
        |inner ℝ w e_D| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ η) ^ B →
        |inner ℝ w (perp2D e_D)| ≤ 10 * (ε ^ η) ^ A →
        |inner ℝ ((10 : ℝ) • S_J_lin z) e_G| ≤ 250 * ε ^ p_raw ∧
        |inner ℝ ((10 : ℝ) • S_J_lin z) (perp2D e_G)| ≤ 250 * ε ^ q_raw ∧
        |inner ℝ ((10 * Δ_r) • S_J_lin (w + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • z)) e_G| ≤ 250 * ε ^ (p_raw + r) ∧
        |inner ℝ ((10 * Δ_r) • S_J_lin (w + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • z)) (perp2D e_G)| ≤
          250 * ε ^ (q_raw + r)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro η S_J_lin
  classical
  have norm_sq_eq : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ^ 2 = (v 0) ^ 2 + (v 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have inner_eq : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ x y = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
    intro x y
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have heJ_sq : (e_J 0) ^ 2 + (e_J 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := norm_sq_eq e_J
    rw [heJ] at h
    linarith
  have heD_sq : (e_D 0) ^ 2 + (e_D 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := norm_sq_eq e_D
    rw [heD] at h
    linarith
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := sub_pos.mpr hrt
  have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := hε_lt1.le
  let s₁ : ℝ := ε ^ b_t
  let s₂ : ℝ := ε ^ (b_t + d)
  let t₁ : ℝ := (ε ^ η) ^ B
  let t₂ : ℝ := (ε ^ η) ^ A
  have hs₁_pos : 0 < s₁ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ b_t
  have hs₂_pos : 0 < s₂ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (b_t + d)
  have hs₂_le_s₁ : s₂ ≤ s₁ :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (by linarith)
  have hεη_pos : 0 < ε ^ η := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ η
  have hεη_le1 : ε ^ η ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hε₀.le hε_le1 hη_pos.le
  have ht₁_pos : 0 < t₁ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hεη_pos B
  have ht₂_pos : 0 < t₂ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hεη_pos A
  have ht₂_le_t₁ : t₂ ≤ t₁ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hεη_pos hεη_le1 hBA
  have ht₁_eq : t₁ = ε ^ (η * B) := (Real.rpow_mul hε₀.le η B).symm
  have ht₂_eq : t₂ = ε ^ (η * A) := (Real.rpow_mul hε₀.le η A).symm
  have hs₁t₁_eq : s₁ * t₁ = ε ^ (b_t + η * B) := by
    dsimp only [s₁]
    rw [ht₁_eq, ← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
  have hε_bB_pos : 0 < ε ^ (b_t + η * B) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
  let D_prod : ℝ := ε ^ (2 * b_t + d + η * (B + A))
  have hD_pos : 0 < D_prod := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
  have hD_eq : D_prod = s₁ * s₂ * t₁ * t₂ := by
    dsimp only [D_prod, s₁, s₂]
    rw [ht₁_eq, ht₂_eq]
    have hexp : 2 * b_t + d + η * (B + A) = ((b_t + (b_t + d)) + η * B) + η * A := by ring
    rw [hexp, Real.rpow_add hε₀, Real.rpow_add hε₀, Real.rpow_add hε₀]
  let m₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := t₁ • S_J_lin e_D
  let m₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := t₂ • S_J_lin (perp2D e_D)
  have hm₁_0 : m₁ 0 = t₁ * (s₁ * e_D 0 * e_J 0 - s₂ * e_D 1 * e_J 1) := by
    simp [m₁, S_J_lin, s₁, s₂, perp2D]
    ring
  have hm₁_1 : m₁ 1 = t₁ * (s₁ * e_D 0 * e_J 1 + s₂ * e_D 1 * e_J 0) := by
    simp [m₁, S_J_lin, s₁, s₂, perp2D]
    ring
  have hm₂_0 : m₂ 0 = t₂ * (-s₁ * e_D 1 * e_J 0 - s₂ * e_D 0 * e_J 1) := by
    simp [m₂, S_J_lin, s₁, s₂, perp2D]
    ring
  have hm₂_1 : m₂ 1 = t₂ * (-s₁ * e_D 1 * e_J 1 + s₂ * e_D 0 * e_J 0) := by
    simp [m₂, S_J_lin, s₁, s₂, perp2D]
    ring
  have h_det : m₁ 0 * m₂ 1 - m₁ 1 * m₂ 0 = D_prod := by
    rw [hm₁_0, hm₁_1, hm₂_0, hm₂_1, hD_eq]
    calc (t₁ * (s₁ * e_D 0 * e_J 0 - s₂ * e_D 1 * e_J 1)) *
            (t₂ * (-s₁ * e_D 1 * e_J 1 + s₂ * e_D 0 * e_J 0)) -
          (t₁ * (s₁ * e_D 0 * e_J 1 + s₂ * e_D 1 * e_J 0)) *
            (t₂ * (-s₁ * e_D 1 * e_J 0 - s₂ * e_D 0 * e_J 1))
        = s₁ * s₂ * t₁ * t₂ *
            (((e_J 0) ^ 2 + (e_J 1) ^ 2) * ((e_D 0) ^ 2 + (e_D 1) ^ 2)) := by ring
      _ = s₁ * s₂ * t₁ * t₂ := by rw [heJ_sq, heD_sq]; ring
  let p : ℝ := (m₁ 0) ^ 2 + (m₂ 0) ^ 2
  let q : ℝ := (m₁ 1) ^ 2 + (m₂ 1) ^ 2
  let r_off : ℝ := m₁ 0 * m₁ 1 + m₂ 0 * m₂ 1
  let Q_fn : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ :=
    fun f => (inner ℝ m₁ f) ^ 2 + (inner ℝ m₂ f) ^ 2
  have hQ_eq : ∀ f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      Q_fn f = p * (f 0) ^ 2 + 2 * r_off * (f 0) * (f 1) + q * (f 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro f
    dsimp only [Q_fn, p, q, r_off]
    rw [inner_eq m₁ f, inner_eq m₂ f]
    ring
  have hpq_det : p * q - r_off ^ 2 = D_prod ^ 2 := by
    have h_lagr : p * q - r_off ^ 2 = (m₁ 0 * m₂ 1 - m₁ 1 * m₂ 0) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [p, q, r_off]
      ring
    rw [h_lagr, h_det]
  have hp_pos : 0 < p := by
    by_contra hp_le
    have hp0 : p = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hp_le) (by dsimp only [p]; positivity)
    have h1 : p * q - r_off ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
      rw [hp0, zero_mul, zero_sub]
      exact neg_nonpos.mpr (sq_nonneg r_off)
    linarith [hpq_det, sq_pos_of_pos hD_pos]
  have hq_pos : 0 < q := by
    by_contra hq_le
    have hq0 : q = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hq_le) (by dsimp only [q]; positivity)
    have h1 : p * q - r_off ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
      rw [hq0, mul_zero, zero_sub]
      exact neg_nonpos.mpr (sq_nonneg r_off)
    linarith [hpq_det, sq_pos_of_pos hD_pos]
  let disc : ℝ := (p - q) ^ 2 + 4 * r_off ^ 2
  have hdisc_nn : 0 ≤ disc := by dsimp only [disc]; positivity
  let s_disc : ℝ := Real.sqrt disc
  have hs_nn : 0 ≤ s_disc := Real.sqrt_nonneg disc
  have hs_sq : s_disc ^ 2 = (p - q) ^ 2 + 4 * r_off ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hdisc_nn
  let lam_plus : ℝ := (p + q + s_disc) / 2
  let lam_minus : ℝ := (p + q - s_disc) / 2
  have hlam_prod : lam_plus * lam_minus = D_prod ^ 2 := by
    have h_alg : lam_plus * lam_minus = ((p + q) ^ 2 - s_disc ^ 2) / 4 := by
      dsimp only [lam_plus, lam_minus]
      ring
    rw [h_alg, hs_sq]
    linarith [hpq_det]
  have hlam_plus_pos : 0 < lam_plus := by
    dsimp only [lam_plus]
    linarith
  have hlam_minus_pos : 0 < lam_minus := by
    by_contra h_le
    have h_nonpos : lam_plus * lam_minus ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hlam_plus_pos.le (le_of_not_gt h_le)
    linarith [hlam_prod, sq_pos_of_pos hD_pos]
  have hlam_le : lam_minus ≤ lam_plus := by
    dsimp only [lam_minus, lam_plus]
    linarith
  have heG_exists : ∃ e_G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖e_G‖ = 1 ∧ Q_fn e_G = lam_plus ∧ Q_fn (perp2D e_G) = lam_minus := by
    by_cases hs0 : s_disc = 0
    · have hdisc0 : (p - q) ^ 2 + 4 * r_off ^ 2 = 0 := by
        rw [← hs_sq, hs0, sq]
        ring
      have hpq_eq : p = q := by
        have h1 : (p - q) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by linarith [sq_nonneg r_off]
        have h2 : p - q = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (le_antisymm h1 (sq_nonneg _))
        linarith
      let e_G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0]
      refine ⟨e_G, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hnsq : ‖e_G‖ ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 := by simp [norm_sq_eq, e_G]
        exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg e_G) zero_le_one).mp hnsq
      · rw [hQ_eq]
        simp [e_G, lam_plus, hpq_eq, hs0]
      · rw [hQ_eq]
        simp [e_G, perp2D, lam_minus, hpq_eq, hs0]
    · have hs_pos : 0 < s_disc := lt_of_le_of_ne hs_nn (Ne.symm hs0)
      by_cases hqp : q ≤ p
      · let w_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![p - q + s_disc, 2 * r_off]
        have hw0_pos : 0 < w_vec 0 := by simp [w_vec]; linarith
        have hw_sq_pos : 0 < ‖w_vec‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [norm_sq_eq]
          linarith [sq_pos_of_pos hw0_pos, sq_nonneg (w_vec 1)]
        have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w_vec‖ := by
          by_contra h_le
          have h0 : ‖w_vec‖ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_le) (norm_nonneg w_vec)
          rw [h0] at hw_sq_pos
          norm_num at hw_sq_pos
        let e_G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := ‖w_vec‖⁻¹ • w_vec
        refine ⟨e_G, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hw_pos.le), inv_mul_cancel₀ hw_pos.ne']
        · have hQw : 2 * Q_fn w_vec = (p + q + s_disc) * ‖w_vec‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [hQ_eq, norm_sq_eq]
            have hw0 : w_vec 0 = p - q + s_disc := by simp [w_vec]
            have hw1 : w_vec 1 = 2 * r_off := by simp [w_vec]
            rw [hw0, hw1]
            linear_combination -(p - q + s_disc) * hs_sq
          have hQe : Q_fn e_G = (‖w_vec‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * Q_fn w_vec := by
            rw [hQ_eq e_G, hQ_eq w_vec]
            simp [e_G]
            ring
          rw [hQe]
          dsimp only [lam_plus]
          field_simp [hw_pos.ne']
          linarith
        · have hQpw : 2 * Q_fn (perp2D w_vec) = (p + q - s_disc) * ‖w_vec‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [hQ_eq, norm_sq_eq]
            have hw0 : w_vec 0 = p - q + s_disc := by simp [w_vec]
            have hw1 : w_vec 1 = 2 * r_off := by simp [w_vec]
            have hpw0 : (perp2D w_vec) 0 = -(2 * r_off) := by simp [w_vec, perp2D]
            have hpw1 : (perp2D w_vec) 1 = p - q + s_disc := by simp [w_vec, perp2D]
            rw [hpw0, hpw1, hw0, hw1]
            linear_combination (p - q + s_disc) * hs_sq
          have hp_eq : perp2D e_G = ‖w_vec‖⁻¹ • perp2D w_vec := by
            ext i
            fin_cases i <;> simp [e_G, perp2D] <;> ring
          have hQpe : Q_fn (perp2D e_G) = (‖w_vec‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * Q_fn (perp2D w_vec) := by
            rw [hp_eq, hQ_eq (‖w_vec‖⁻¹ • perp2D w_vec), hQ_eq (perp2D w_vec)]
            simp
            ring
          rw [hQpe]
          dsimp only [lam_minus]
          field_simp [hw_pos.ne']
          linarith
      · have hpq_lt : p < q := lt_of_not_ge hqp
        let w_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![2 * r_off, q - p + s_disc]
        have hw1_pos : 0 < w_vec 1 := by simp [w_vec]; linarith
        have hw_sq_pos : 0 < ‖w_vec‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [norm_sq_eq]
          linarith [sq_pos_of_pos hw1_pos, sq_nonneg (w_vec 0)]
        have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w_vec‖ := by
          by_contra h_le
          have h0 : ‖w_vec‖ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_le) (norm_nonneg w_vec)
          rw [h0] at hw_sq_pos
          norm_num at hw_sq_pos
        let e_G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := ‖w_vec‖⁻¹ • w_vec
        refine ⟨e_G, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hw_pos.le), inv_mul_cancel₀ hw_pos.ne']
        · have hQw : 2 * Q_fn w_vec = (p + q + s_disc) * ‖w_vec‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [hQ_eq, norm_sq_eq]
            have hw0 : w_vec 0 = 2 * r_off := by simp [w_vec]
            have hw1 : w_vec 1 = q - p + s_disc := by simp [w_vec]
            rw [hw0, hw1]
            linear_combination -(q - p + s_disc) * hs_sq
          have hQe : Q_fn e_G = (‖w_vec‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * Q_fn w_vec := by
            rw [hQ_eq e_G, hQ_eq w_vec]
            simp [e_G]
            ring
          rw [hQe]
          dsimp only [lam_plus]
          field_simp [hw_pos.ne']
          linarith
        · have hQpw : 2 * Q_fn (perp2D w_vec) = (p + q - s_disc) * ‖w_vec‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [hQ_eq, norm_sq_eq]
            have hw0 : w_vec 0 = 2 * r_off := by simp [w_vec]
            have hw1 : w_vec 1 = q - p + s_disc := by simp [w_vec]
            have hpw0 : (perp2D w_vec) 0 = -(q - p + s_disc) := by simp [w_vec, perp2D]

    rw [real_inner_smul_left (S_J_lin u_wz) (perp2D e_G) (10 * Δ_r)]
    have h_assoc : 10 * Δ_r * inner ℝ (S_J_lin u_wz) (perp2D e_G) =
        Δ_r * (10 * inner ℝ (S_J_lin u_wz) (perp2D e_G)) := by ring
    rw [h_assoc, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hΔr_pos]
    calc Δ_r * |10 * inner ℝ (S_J_lin u_wz) (perp2D e_G)|
        ≤ ε ^ r * (250 * ε ^ q_raw) :=
          mul_le_mul hΔr_le hu_peG (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le r)
      _ = 250 * (ε ^ q_raw * ε ^ r) := by ring
      _ = 250 * ε ^ (q_raw + r) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
  exact ⟨hz_eG, hz_peG, hwz_eG, hwz_peG⟩

(γ r t L_hor δ_cl : ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)

      ∀ (ε' e' : ℝ),
        0 < ε' → ε' < ε₀' → 0 ≤ e' → 1 + e' ≤ 1 + L_hor / (t - r) →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ}

        stdApertureScore ε' γ 1 0 e' π' T_idx V' A' c' θ' ≤
          classicalRootSupremum ε' (1 + e') γ N_ω N_T π' T_idx V' A' +
            classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_cl) ∧
    (∃ ε₀'' : ℝ, 0 < ε₀'' ∧ ε₀'' < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε b_t a_t d Δ_r : ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε₀'' → ε ^ (t - r) < 1 / 2 →

        0 ≤ d → d ≤ a_t - b_t →
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r ≤ Δ_r → Δ_r ≤ ε ^ r →
      ∀ {N_ω N_T : ℕ} {α_J : Type} [DecidableEq α_J]
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)

        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ j tid, ‖V_loc j tid‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖A_loc j tid‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →

        (let η := t - r

         ∀ (j : α_J), 0 < p_J j →

             ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
                 η * ((1 + γ) * B + (1 - γ) * A) ≤
               (1 + γ) * p_raw + (1 - γ) * q_raw ∧
             (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → J ω = j →
               let tid := T_idx ω
               let c_mid := ((k_r ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
               |inner ℝ (V_loc j tid - V_D) e_D| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ B →

               |inner ℝ (A_loc j tid - A_D) (perp2D e_D)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ A →
               |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G) e_G| ≤ 250 * ε ^ p_raw ∧

               |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G) e_G| ≤
                 250 * ε ^ (p_raw + r) ∧
               |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G) (perp2D e_G)| ≤
                 250 * ε ^ (q_raw + r))) →
        let η := t - r
        let ε_tilde := ε ^ η
        let e_loc := (a_t - b_t - d) / η
        let S_J : Finset α_J := Finset.univ.image J
        let p_J := fun j => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if J ω = j then π ω else 0
        let π_j := fun j => restrictLaw π (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => J ω = j))
        (((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) -
            finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
            2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_r) +
          η * ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
            classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde (1 + e_loc) γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx
              (V_loc j) (A_loc j) ≤
          classicalRootSupremum ε L_hor γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part +
            classicalGrowthRate γ * r + (2 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl * η)

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_trans hr₀ hrt
    have hL_pos : 0 < L_hor := lt_of_lt_of_le ht_pos htL
    have hη_pos : 0 < t - r := sub_pos.mpr hrt
    let K_hor' : ℝ := 1 + L_hor / (t - r)
    have hK_ge1 : 1 ≤ K_hor' := by
      dsimp only [K_hor']
      linarith [div_pos hL_pos hη_pos]
    have h_ne1 : (ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ).Nonempty := ⟨2, h_two⟩
    have h_inf_lt1 : sInf (ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ) < classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_cl / 2 := by
      change classicalGrowthRate γ < classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_cl / 2
      linarith
    obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀_mem, hb₀_lt⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt h_ne1 h_inf_lt1
    obtain ⟨ε₀', hε₀'_pos, hε₀'_lt, h_est⟩ :=
      hb₀_mem.2.2 4 K_hor' 1 (δ_cl / 2) (by norm_num) hK_ge1 zero_lt_one hK_ge1 (half_pos hδ)
    refine ⟨ε₀', hε₀'_pos, hε₀'_lt, ?_⟩
    intro ε' e' hε'₀ hε'_lt he'₀ he'_hi N_ω N_T π' T_idx V' A' c' θ'
      hπ'_nn hπ'_sum hVA' hcθ'
    have hε'_half : ε' < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hε'_lt hε₀'_lt
    set m_1 := dyadicTimeLevel ε' 1
    set Δ_time : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_1)⁻¹
    have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 := by positivity
    have hX_gt2 : (2 : ℝ) < ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]
      have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith : 2 * ε' < 1) (inv_pos.mpr hε'₀)
      rwa [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hε'₀), mul_one, one_mul] at h_mul
    have h2m_bounds : ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 ∧
        (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 ≤ 4 * ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) := by
      have h1 : ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) ≤ (⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      have h2_nat : ⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ m_1 := Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide) _
      have h2 : (⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 := by exact_mod_cast h2_nat
      refine ⟨le_trans h1 h2, ?_⟩
      have h_ceil_gt2 : (2 : ℝ) < (⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hX_gt2 h1
      have h_ceil_gt1_nat : 1 < ⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ := by
        by_contra h_le1
        have h_cast : (⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_not_lt h_le1)
        linarith
      have hm_pos : 0 < m_1 := by
        by_contra hm_z
        have hm0 : m_1 = 0 := by omega
        rw [hm0] at h2_nat
        omega
      have h_lt_clog : m_1 - 1 < Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ := Nat.sub_lt hm_pos zero_lt_one
      have h_pow_lt_nat : 2 ^ (m_1 - 1) < ⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ := Nat.pow_lt_of_lt_clog h_lt_clog
      have h_pow_lt : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_1 - 1)) < (⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast h_pow_lt_nat
      have h_ceil_lt : (⌈ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ))⌉₊ : ℝ) < ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) + 1 :=
        Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by linarith)
      have h_pow_eq : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_1 = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_1 - 1) := by
        have hm_eq : m_1 = (m_1 - 1) + 1 := by omega
        conv_lhs => rw [hm_eq, pow_succ']
      linarith
    have h_inv_neg1 : (ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)))⁻¹ = ε' ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_neg hε'₀.le, neg_neg]
    have hΔ_lo : (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε' ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ Δ_time := by
      dsimp only [Δ_time]
      have h1 : (4 * ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_1)⁻¹ :=
        inv_anti₀ h2m_pos h2m_bounds.2
      rwa [mul_inv, h_inv_neg1] at h1
    have hΔ_hi : Δ_time ≤ 4 * ε' ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
      dsimp only [Δ_time]
      have hX_pos : 0 < ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)) := by linarith
      have h1 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_1)⁻¹ ≤ (ε' ^ (-(1 : ℝ)))⁻¹ :=
        inv_anti₀ hX_pos h2m_bounds.1
      rw [h_inv_neg1, Real.rpow_one] at h1
      rw [Real.rpow_one]
      linarith
    have h_real_err4 : ∀ (L_s z : ℝ),
        |z - ((dyadicRealBin ε' L_s z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε' L_s| ≤
          4 * ε' ^ L_s := by
      intro L_s z
      set l := dyadicRealLevel ε' L_s
      have hs_pos : 0 < dyadicRealStep ε' L_s := by
        unfold dyadicRealStep; exact zpow_pos (by norm_num) (-l)
      set α := L_s * (Real.log (ε'⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
      have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
      have h2_neg_α : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) = ε' ^ L_s := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε'₀]
        congr 1
        dsimp only [α]
        rw [Real.log_inv]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hlog2_pos]
      have hl_gt : α - 1 < (l : ℝ) := Int.sub_one_lt_floor α
      have h_step_ub : dyadicRealStep ε' L_s ≤ 2 * ε' ^ L_s := by
        have h2_add : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α + 1) = 2 * ε' ^ L_s := by
          rw [Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one, h2_neg_α, mul_comm]
        have h_step_rpow : dyadicRealStep ε' L_s = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((-l : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
          unfold dyadicRealStep
          exact (Real.rpow_intCast (2 : ℝ) (-l)).symm
        rw [← h2_add, h_step_rpow]
        refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) ?_
        push_cast; linarith
      set b_z := dyadicRealBin ε' L_s z
      have hb_le : (b_z : ℝ) ≤ z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l := Int.floor_le _
      have hb_lt : z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l < (b_z : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h_abs1 : |z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have h_z_eq : z = (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l) * dyadicRealStep ε' L_s := by
        unfold dyadicRealStep
        rw [zpow_neg, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (ne_of_gt (zpow_pos (by norm_num) l))]
      have h_sub_eq : z - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε' L_s =
          (z * (2 : ℝ) ^ l - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * dyadicRealStep ε' L_s := by
        conv_lhs => rw [h_z_eq]
        ring
      have h_mid : |z - ((b_z : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε' L_s| ≤
          (1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε' L_s := by
        rw [h_sub_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs_pos]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_abs1 hs_pos.le
      have hpos : 0 < ε' ^ L_s := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε'₀ L_s
      linarith
    have h_ang_ortho : ∀ k : ℤ,
        let u_v := angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k
        ‖u_v‖ = 1 ∧
        inner ℝ u_v u_v = 1 ∧
        inner ℝ (perp2D u_v) (perp2D u_v) = 1 ∧
        inner ℝ u_v (perp2D u_v) = 0 ∧
        inner ℝ (perp2D u_v) u_v = 0 := by
      intro k
      set φ := ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε' (e' - 0)))⁻¹
      have hu_norm : ‖angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k‖ = 1 := by
        rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        change Real.sqrt (‖Real.cos φ‖ ^ 2 + ‖Real.sin φ‖ ^ 2) = 1
        simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, Real.sqrt_one]
      have hp_norm : ‖perp2D (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k)‖ = 1 := by
        rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        change Real.sqrt (‖-(Real.sin φ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖Real.cos φ‖ ^ 2) = 1
        simp only [norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
        have h1 : Real.sin φ ^ 2 + Real.cos φ ^ 2 = 1 := by linarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ]
        rw [h1, Real.sqrt_one]
      have huu : inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k) (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k) = 1 := by
        rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu_norm, one_pow]
      have hpp : inner ℝ (perp2D (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k))
          (perp2D (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k)) = 1 := by
        rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hp_norm, one_pow]
      have hup : inner ℝ (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k) (perp2D (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k)) = 0 := by
        rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        change (-(Real.sin φ)) * Real.cos φ + Real.cos φ * Real.sin φ = 0
        ring
      have hpu : inner ℝ (perp2D (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k)) (angUnitVec ε' (e' - 0) k) = 0 := by
        rw [real_inner_comm, hup]
