      η ε_tilde e_loc S_J p_J π_j

    
    have hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hε_lt hε₀''_half
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := hη₀_pos
    have hε_tilde_pos : 0 < ε_tilde := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ η
    have he_loc_nn : 0 ≤ e_loc := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hda) hη_pos.le
    have hL_loc_nn : 0 ≤ 1 + e_loc := by linarith
    have hell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := lt_trans hε₁ (by norm_num)
      have hlog_neg : Real.log ε < 0 := Real.log_neg hε₀ hε_lt1
      rw [Real.log_inv]
      linarith
    have hell_tilde_eq : Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹) = η * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      dsimp only [ε_tilde]
      rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_rpow hε₀, Real.log_inv]
      ring
    have hell_tilde_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹) := by
      rw [hell_tilde_eq]
      exact mul_pos hη_pos hell_pos

    
    have hpJ_nn : ∀ j : α_J, 0 ≤ p_J j := fun j =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω; exact le_rfl)
    have hpJ_sum : ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j = 1 := by
      have h1 : ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω := by
        dsimp only [S_J, p_J]
        simp only [← Finset.sum_filter]
        exact Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
          (fun ω _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem J (Finset.mem_univ ω)) _
      exact h1.trans hπ_sum
    have h_pJ_of_pos : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → 0 < p_J (J ω) := by
      intro ω hω
      have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω' => if J ω' = J ω then π ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      rw [if_pos rfl] at h_le
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω h_le
    let S_J_pos : Finset α_J := S_J.filter (fun j => 0 < p_J j)
    have hSJ_pos_mem : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → J ω ∈ S_J_pos := by
      intro ω hω
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem J (Finset.mem_univ ω), h_pJ_of_pos ω hω⟩
    have hSJ_pos_ne : S_J_pos.Nonempty := by
      have h_ex_ω : ∃ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω := by
        by_contra h_all
        push_neg at h_all
        have h0 : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 0 :=
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω _ => le_antisymm (h_all ω) (hπ_nn ω))
        linarith
      obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := h_ex_ω
      exact ⟨J ω₀, hSJ_pos_mem ω₀ hω₀⟩
    let M_J : ℕ := S_J_pos.card
    have hMJ : 0 < M_J := Finset.card_pos.mpr hSJ_pos_ne
    let e_J_idx : ↥S_J_pos ≃ Fin M_J := S_J_pos.equivFin
    let j_u : Fin M_J → α_J := fun u => (e_J_idx.symm u).1
    have hj_inj : Function.Injective j_u :=
      Subtype.val_injective.comp e_J_idx.symm.injective
    have hj_pos : ∀ u : Fin M_J, 0 < p_J (j_u u) := fun u =>
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp (e_J_idx.symm u).2).2
    have hj_cover : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → ∃ u : Fin M_J, J ω = j_u u := by
      intro ω hω
      refine ⟨e_J_idx ⟨J ω, hSJ_pos_mem ω hω⟩, ?_⟩
      dsimp only [j_u]
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have h_sum_SJ : ∀ F : α_J → ℝ,
        ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * F j = ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * F (j_u u) := by
      intro F
      have h1 : ∑ j ∈ S_J_pos, p_J j * F j = ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j * F j := by
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ S_J) (fun j hj hj_not => ?_)
        have h_le : p_J j ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra h_gt
          exact hj_not (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hj, lt_of_not_ge h_gt⟩)
        have h0 : p_J j = 0 := le_antisymm h_le (hpJ_nn j)
        simp [h0]
      rw [← h1, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort S_J_pos (fun j => p_J j * F j),
        ← e_J_idx.symm.sum_comp (fun x : ↥S_J_pos => p_J x.1 * F x.1)]
    have hpJu_sum : ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_sum_SJ (fun _ => 1)
      simp only [mul_one] at h1
      exact h1.symm.trans hpJ_sum

    
    let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
    let p_TJ : Fin N_T → α_J → ℝ := fun tid j =>
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j then π ω else 0
    let p_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k then π ω else 0
    let p_T_u : Fin M_J → Fin N_T → ℝ := fun u tid =>
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π_j (j_u u) ω else 0
    have hπu_nn : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (ω : Fin N_ω), 0 ≤ π_j (j_u u) ω := by
      intro u ω
      dsimp only [π_j, restrictLaw]
      have h_filt : ∑ ω' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω' => J ω' = j_u u), π ω' = p_J (j_u u) :=
        Finset.sum_filter _ _
      rw [h_filt]
      split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) (hj_pos u).le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hπu_sum : ∀ u : Fin M_J, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_j (j_u u) ω = 1 := by
      intro u
      dsimp only [π_j, restrictLaw]
      have h_filt : ∑ ω' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω' => J ω' = j_u u), π ω' = p_J (j_u u) :=
        Finset.sum_filter _ _
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, ← Finset.sum_div, h_filt,
        div_self (ne_of_gt (hj_pos u))]
    have hpTu_nn : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (tid : Fin N_T), 0 ≤ p_T_u u tid := fun u tid =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs; exact hπu_nn u ω; exact le_rfl)
    have hpTu_sum : ∀ u : Fin M_J, ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T_u u tid = 1 := by
      intro u
      dsimp only [p_T_u]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h1 : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ tid : Fin N_T, if T_idx ω = tid then π_j (j_u u) ω else 0) =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_j (j_u u) ω := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (T_idx ω) (fun _ => π_j (j_u u) ω),
          if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
      exact h1.trans (hπu_sum u)
    have hpTJ_eq : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (tid : Fin N_T),
        p_TJ tid (j_u u) = p_J (j_u u) * p_T_u u tid := by
      intro u tid
      have h_div : p_T_u u tid = p_TJ tid (j_u u) / p_J (j_u u) := by
        dsimp only [p_T_u, p_TJ, π_j, restrictLaw]
        have h_filt : ∑ ω' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω' => J ω' = j_u u), π ω' = p_J (j_u u) :=
          Finset.sum_filter _ _
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        rw [h_filt]
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        by_cases hT : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases hJ : J ω = j_u u <;> simp [hT, hJ]
      rw [h_div, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (hj_pos u))]

    
    let e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0]
    have he₀_norm : ‖e₀‖ = 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [e₀]
    have hperp_e₀_norm : ‖perp2D e₀‖ = 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [perp2D, e₀]
    have h_cap_zero : ∀ v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ‖w‖ = 1 → |inner ℝ (v - 0) w| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro v w hv hw
      rw [sub_zero, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
      have h1 := abs_real_inner_le_norm v w
      rw [hw, mul_one] at h1
      linarith
    let τ_u : Fin M_J → ℝ := fun u =>
      classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde (1 + e_loc) γ N_ω N_T
        (π_j (j_u u)) T_idx (V_loc (j_u u)) (A_loc (j_u u))
    have h_extract_u : ∀ u : Fin M_J,
        ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          (∀ d_i : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d_i ∧ b_D d_i ≤ a_D d_i ∧
            a_D d_i ≤ 1 + e_loc ∧ ‖e_D d_i‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid d_i, 0 ≤ q tid d_i) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d_i : Fin N_D, q tid d_i = p_T_u u tid) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d_i : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d_i →
            |inner ℝ (V_loc (j_u u) tid - V_D d_i) (e_D d_i)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_D d_i) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_loc (j_u u) tid - V_D d_i) (perp2D (e_D d_i))| ≤
              10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_D d_i) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_loc (j_u u) tid - A_D d_i) (e_D d_i)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_D d_i) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_loc (j_u u) tid - A_D d_i) (perp2D (e_D d_i))| ≤
              10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_D d_i)) ∧
          τ_u u - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl <
            (∑ d_i : Fin N_D, (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d_i) *
              ((1 + γ) * b_D d_i + (1 - γ) * a_D d_i)) -
            (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d_i : Fin N_D,
              q tid d_i * Real.log (q tid d_i /
                (p_T_u u tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q tid' d_i)))) /
              Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹) := by
      intro u
      have h_ne_sup : { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          (∀ d_i : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d_i ∧ b_D d_i ≤ a_D d_i ∧
            a_D d_i ≤ 1 + e_loc ∧ ‖e_D d_i‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid d_i, 0 ≤ q tid d_i) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d_i : Fin N_D, q tid d_i = p_T_u u tid) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d_i : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d_i →
            |inner ℝ (V_loc (j_u u) tid - V_D d_i) (e_D d_i)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_D d_i) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_loc (j_u u) tid - V_D d_i) (perp2D (e_D d_i))| ≤
              10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_D d_i) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_loc (j_u u) tid - A_D d_i) (e_D d_i)| ≤ 10 * ε_tilde ^ (b_D d_i) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_loc (j_u u) tid - A_D d_i) (perp2D (e_D d_i))| ≤
              10 * ε_tilde ^ (a_D d_i)) ∧
          (let q_D := fun d_i => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d_i
           let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d_i : Fin N_D,
             q tid d_i * Real.log (q tid d_i / (p_T_u u tid * q_D d_i))) / Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹)
           let E_w := ∑ d_i : Fin N_D, q_D d_i * ((1 + γ) * b_D d_i + (1 - γ) * a_D d_i)
           s = E_w - I_TD) }.Nonempty := by
        refine ⟨_, 1, (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => e₀), (fun _ => 0), (fun _ => 0),
          (fun tid _ => p_T_u u tid),
          fun _ => ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, hL_loc_nn, he₀_norm⟩,
          fun tid _ => hpTu_nn u tid,
          fun tid => Fin.sum_univ_one _,
          fun tid _ _ => ⟨h_cap_zero _ _ (hVA_loc (j_u u) tid).1 he₀_norm,
            h_cap_zero _ _ (hVA_loc (j_u u) tid).1 hperp_e₀_norm,
            h_cap_zero _ _ (hVA_loc (j_u u) tid).2 he₀_norm,
            h_cap_zero _ _ (hVA_loc (j_u u) tid).2 hperp_e₀_norm⟩,
          rfl⟩
      have h_lt_sup : τ_u u - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl < τ_u u := by linarith
      dsimp only [τ_u, classicalRootSupremum] at h_lt_sup
      obtain ⟨s_u, ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h1, h2, h3, h4, rfl⟩, hs_gt⟩ :=
        exists_lt_of_lt_csSup h_ne_sup h_lt_sup
      exact ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h1, h2, h3, h4, hs_gt⟩

    choose N_D b_u a_u e_u V_u A_u q_u h_ex_spec using h_extract_u
    let M_D : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup N_D + 1
    have hMD : 0 < M_D := Nat.succ_pos _
    have hND_le : ∀ u : Fin M_J, N_D u ≤ M_D :=
      fun u => Nat.le_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ u))
    have h_sum_pad : ∀ {N M : ℕ} (hNM : N ≤ M) (f : Fin N → ℝ),
        (∑ d_i : Fin M, if h : d_i.1 < N then f ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else 0) = ∑ i : Fin N, f i := by
      intro N M hNM f
      let emb : Fin N ↪ Fin M :=
        ⟨fun i => ⟨i.1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hNM⟩,
         fun i₁ i₂ h => Fin.ext (Fin.mk.inj h)⟩
      have h_sub : (∑ d_i ∈ Finset.univ.map emb, if h : d_i.1 < N then f ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else 0) =
          ∑ d_i : Fin M, if h : d_i.1 < N then f ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun d_i _ hd_not => ?_)
        by_cases hlt : d_i.1 < N
        · exfalso
          apply hd_not
          rw [Finset.mem_map]
          exact ⟨⟨d_i.1, hlt⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext rfl⟩
        · exact dif_neg hlt
      rw [← h_sub, Finset.sum_map]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      have hi : (emb i).1 < N := i.2
      rw [dif_pos hi]
      exact congr_arg f (Fin.ext rfl)

    let B_pad : Fin M_J → Fin M_D → ℝ :=
      fun u d_i => if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then b_u u ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else 0
    let A_pad : Fin M_J → Fin M_D → ℝ :=
      fun u d_i => if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then a_u u ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else 0
    let e_D_pad : Fin M_J → Fin M_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun u d_i => if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then e_u u ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else e₀
    let V_D_pad : Fin M_J → Fin M_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun u d_i => if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then V_u u ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else 0
    let A_D_pad : Fin M_J → Fin M_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun u d_i => if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then A_u u ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else 0
    let q_pad : Fin M_J → Fin N_T → Fin M_D → ℝ :=
      fun u tid d_i => if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then q_u u tid ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ else 0
    let q_D_pad : Fin M_J → Fin M_D → ℝ :=
      fun u d_i => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_pad u tid d_i

    have h_pad_adm : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (d_i : Fin M_D),
        0 ≤ B_pad u d_i ∧ B_pad u d_i ≤ A_pad u d_i ∧
        A_pad u d_i ≤ 1 + e_loc ∧ ‖e_D_pad u d_i‖ = 1 := by
      intro u d_i
      dsimp only [B_pad, A_pad, e_D_pad]
      by_cases h : d_i.1 < N_D u
      · simp only [dif_pos h]
        exact (h_ex_spec u).1 ⟨d_i.1, h⟩
      · simp only [dif_neg h]
        exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, hL_loc_nn, he₀_norm⟩
    have hq_pad_nn : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (tid : Fin N_T) (d_i : Fin M_D), 0 ≤ q_pad u tid d_i := by
      intro u tid d_i
      dsimp only [q_pad]
      by_cases h : d_i.1 < N_D u
      · rw [dif_pos h]; exact (h_ex_spec u).2.1 tid ⟨d_i.1, h⟩
      · rw [dif_neg h]
    have hq_pad_marg : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (tid : Fin N_T),
        ∑ d_i : Fin M_D, q_pad u tid d_i = p_T_u u tid := by
      intro u tid
      exact (h_sum_pad (hND_le u) (fun i => q_u u tid i)).trans ((h_ex_spec u).2.2.1 tid)
    have hqD_pad_eq : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (d_i : Fin M_D),
        q_D_pad u d_i =
          if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_u u tid ⟨d_i.1, h⟩) else 0 := by
      intro u d_i
      dsimp only [q_D_pad, q_pad]
      by_cases h : d_i.1 < N_D u
      · simp only [dif_pos h]
      · simp only [dif_neg h, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have hqD_pad_nn : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (d_i : Fin M_D), 0 ≤ q_D_pad u d_i := fun u d_i =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun tid _ => hq_pad_nn u tid d_i)
    have hqD_pad_sum : ∀ u : Fin M_J, ∑ d_i : Fin M_D, q_D_pad u d_i = 1 := by
      intro u
      dsimp only [q_D_pad]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h1 : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d_i : Fin M_D, q_pad u tid d_i) =
          ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_T_u u tid :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => hq_pad_marg u tid)
      exact h1.trans (hpTu_sum u)
    have hq_pad_cap : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (tid : Fin N_T) (d_i : Fin M_D),
        0 < q_pad u tid d_i →
        |inner ℝ (V_loc (j_u u) tid - V_D_pad u d_i) (e_D_pad u d_i)| ≤
          10 * ε_tilde ^ (B_pad u d_i) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_loc (j_u u) tid - V_D_pad u d_i) (perp2D (e_D_pad u d_i))| ≤
          10 * ε_tilde ^ (A_pad u d_i) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_loc (j_u u) tid - A_D_pad u d_i) (e_D_pad u d_i)| ≤
          10 * ε_tilde ^ (B_pad u d_i) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_loc (j_u u) tid - A_D_pad u d_i) (perp2D (e_D_pad u d_i))| ≤
          10 * ε_tilde ^ (A_pad u d_i) := by
      intro u tid d_i hq_pos
      dsimp only [q_pad] at hq_pos
      by_cases h : d_i.1 < N_D u
      · rw [dif_pos h] at hq_pos
        dsimp only [B_pad, A_pad, e_D_pad, V_D_pad, A_D_pad]
        simp only [dif_pos h]
        exact (h_ex_spec u).2.2.2.1 tid ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ hq_pos
      · rw [dif_neg h] at hq_pos
        exact absurd hq_pos (lt_irrefl 0)

    let E_w_pad : Fin M_J → ℝ := fun u =>
      ∑ d_i : Fin M_D, q_D_pad u d_i * ((1 + γ) * B_pad u d_i + (1 - γ) * A_pad u d_i)
    let I_TD_pad : Fin M_J → ℝ := fun u =>
      (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d_i : Fin M_D,
        q_pad u tid d_i * Real.log (q_pad u tid d_i / (p_T_u u tid * q_D_pad u d_i))) /
        Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹)
    have h_pad_score : ∀ u : Fin M_J, τ_u u - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl ≤ E_w_pad u - I_TD_pad u := by
      intro u
      have hEw : E_w_pad u =
          ∑ i : Fin (N_D u), (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_u u tid i) *
            ((1 + γ) * b_u u i + (1 - γ) * a_u u i) := by
        dsimp only [E_w_pad]
        have h_term : ∀ d_i : Fin M_D,
            q_D_pad u d_i * ((1 + γ) * B_pad u d_i + (1 - γ) * A_pad u d_i) =
              if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then
                (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_u u tid ⟨d_i.1, h⟩) *
                  ((1 + γ) * b_u u ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ + (1 - γ) * a_u u ⟨d_i.1, h⟩)
              else 0 := by
          intro d_i
          rw [hqD_pad_eq u d_i]
          dsimp only [B_pad, A_pad]
          by_cases h : d_i.1 < N_D u
          · simp only [dif_pos h]
          · simp only [dif_neg h, zero_mul]
        simp_rw [h_term]
        exact h_sum_pad (hND_le u)
          (fun i => (∑ tid : Fin N_T, q_u u tid i) * ((1 + γ) * b_u u i + (1 - γ) * a_u u i))
      have hITD : I_TD_pad u =
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ i : Fin (N_D u),
            q_u u tid i * Real.log (q_u u tid i /
              (p_T_u u tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q_u u tid' i)))) /
            Real.log (ε_tilde⁻¹) := by
        dsimp only [I_TD_pad]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
        have h_term : ∀ d_i : Fin M_D,
            q_pad u tid d_i * Real.log (q_pad u tid d_i / (p_T_u u tid * q_D_pad u d_i)) =
              if h : d_i.1 < N_D u then
                q_u u tid ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ * Real.log (q_u u tid ⟨d_i.1, h⟩ /
                  (p_T_u u tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q_u u tid' ⟨d_i.1, h⟩)))
              else 0 := by
          intro d_i
          rw [hqD_pad_eq u d_i]
          dsimp only [q_pad]
          by_cases h : d_i.1 < N_D u
          · simp only [dif_pos h]
          · simp only [dif_neg h, zero_mul]
        simp_rw [h_term]
        exact h_sum_pad (hND_le u) (fun i =>
          q_u u tid i * Real.log (q_u u tid i /
            (p_T_u u tid * (∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q_u u tid' i))))
      rw [hEw, hITD]
      exact (h_ex_spec u).2.2.2.2.le

    
    have h_comp_ud : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (d_i : Fin M_D),
        ∃ (p_raw q_raw : ℝ) (e_G V_G X_G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          0 ≤ p_raw ∧ p_raw ≤ q_raw ∧ q_raw + r ≤ L_hor ∧ ‖e_G‖ = 1 ∧
          ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
              η * ((1 + γ) * B_pad u d_i + (1 - γ) * A_pad u d_i) ≤
            (1 + γ) * p_raw + (1 - γ) * q_raw ∧
          (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → J ω = j_u u →
            let tid := T_idx ω
            let c_mid := ((k_r ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
            |inner ℝ (V_loc (j_u u) tid - V_D_pad u d_i) (e_D_pad u d_i)| ≤
              10 * ε_tilde ^ (B_pad u d_i) →
            |inner ℝ (V_loc (j_u u) tid - V_D_pad u d_i) (perp2D (e_D_pad u d_i))| ≤
              10 * ε_tilde ^ (A_pad u d_i) →
            |inner ℝ (A_loc (j_u u) tid - A_D_pad u d_i) (e_D_pad u d_i)| ≤
              10 * ε_tilde ^ (B_pad u d_i) →
            |inner ℝ (A_loc (j_u u) tid - A_D_pad u d_i) (perp2D (e_D_pad u d_i))| ≤
              10 * ε_tilde ^ (A_pad u d_i) →
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G) e_G| ≤ 250 * ε ^ p_raw ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G) (perp2D e_G)| ≤ 250 * ε ^ q_raw ∧
            |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G) e_G| ≤ 250 * ε ^ (p_raw + r) ∧
            |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G) (perp2D e_G)| ≤
              250 * ε ^ (q_raw + r)) := by
      intro u d_i
      obtain ⟨hB0, hBA, hA_hi, heD1⟩ := h_pad_adm u d_i
      exact h_compose (j_u u) (hj_pos u)
        (B_pad u d_i) (A_pad u d_i) (e_D_pad u d_i) (V_D_pad u d_i) (A_D_pad u d_i)
        hB0 hBA hA_hi heD1
    choose p_ud q_ud e_G_ud V_G_ud X_G_ud h_ud_spec using h_comp_ud

    let e_G_eq : Fin M_J × Fin M_D ≃ Fin (M_J * M_D) := finProdFinEquiv
    let e_ω : Fin N_ω × Fin M_D ≃ Fin (N_ω * M_D) := finProdFinEquiv
    let b_G : Fin (M_J * M_D) → ℝ := fun g => p_ud (e_G_eq.symm g).1 (e_G_eq.symm g).2
    let a_G : Fin (M_J * M_D) → ℝ := fun g => q_ud (e_G_eq.symm g).1 (e_G_eq.symm g).2
    let e_G_dir : Fin (M_J * M_D) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun g => e_G_ud (e_G_eq.symm g).1 (e_G_eq.symm g).2
    let V_G : Fin (M_J * M_D) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun g => V_G_ud (e_G_eq.symm g).1 (e_G_eq.symm g).2
    let X_G : Fin (M_J * M_D) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun g => X_G_ud (e_G_eq.symm g).1 (e_G_eq.symm g).2
    let k_G : Fin (M_J * M_D) → ℤ :=
      fun g => proj_k (j_u (e_G_eq.symm g).1)

    
    let u_of : Fin N_ω → Fin M_J :=
      fun ω => if h : ∃ u : Fin M_J, J ω = j_u u then Classical.choose h else ⟨0, hMJ⟩
    have hu_of_eq : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → J ω = j_u (u_of ω) := by
      intro ω hω
      have h_ex := hj_cover ω hω
      dsimp only [u_of]
      rw [dif_pos h_ex]
      exact Classical.choose_spec h_ex
    have hu_of_iff : ∀ (ω : Fin N_ω) (u : Fin M_J),
        0 < π ω → (u_of ω = u ↔ J ω = j_u u) := by
      intro ω u hω
      constructor
      · intro hu
        rw [← hu]
        exact hu_of_eq ω hω
      · intro hJ
        apply hj_inj
        rw [← hu_of_eq ω hω, hJ]

    let T' : Fin (N_ω * M_D) → Fin N_T := fun ω' => T_idx (e_ω.symm ω').1
    let k_time' : Fin (N_ω * M_D) → ℤ := fun ω' => k_r (e_ω.symm ω').1
    let G' : Fin (N_ω * M_D) → Fin (M_J * M_D) :=
      fun ω' => e_G_eq (u_of (e_ω.symm ω').1, (e_ω.symm ω').2)
    let π' : Fin (N_ω * M_D) → ℝ := fun ω' =>
      let ω := (e_ω.symm ω').1
      let d_i := (e_ω.symm ω').2
      if 0 < π ω then
        π ω * (q_pad (u_of ω) (T_idx ω) d_i / p_T_u (u_of ω) (T_idx ω))
      else 0

    have hπ'_nn : ∀ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), 0 ≤ π' ω' := by
      intro ω'
      dsimp only [π']
      split_ifs with hω
      · exact mul_nonneg (hπ_nn _) (div_nonneg (hq_pad_nn _ _ _) (hpTu_nn _ _))
      · exact le_rfl

    have hpTu_pos_of_atom : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω → 0 < p_T_u (u_of ω) (T_idx ω) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hJω := hu_of_eq ω hω
      have hpTJ_pos : 0 < p_TJ (T_idx ω) (j_u (u_of ω)) := by
        rw [← hJω]
        have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun ω' => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ J ω' = J ω then π ω' else 0)
          (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl)
          (Finset.mem_univ ω)
        simp only [and_self, ↓reduceIte] at h_le
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω h_le
      rw [hpTJ_eq] at hpTJ_pos
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_right hpTJ_pos (hj_pos (u_of ω)).le

    have h_atom_sum : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ d_i : Fin M_D, π' (e_ω (ω, d_i)) = π ω := by
      intro ω
      dsimp only [π']
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
      · simp only [if_pos hω]
        have hp_pos := hpTu_pos_of_atom ω hω
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, hq_pad_marg,
          div_self (ne_of_gt hp_pos), mul_one]
      · simp only [if_neg hω, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        exact (le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (hπ_nn ω)).symm

    have h_lift_sum : ∀ f : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
        (∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), f (e_ω.symm ω').1 * π' ω') =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, f ω * π ω := by
      intro f
      rw [← e_ω.sum_comp]
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      dsimp only []
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, h_atom_sum ω]

    have hπ'_sum : ∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), π' ω' = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_lift_sum (fun _ => 1)
      simp only [one_mul] at h1
      exact h1.trans hπ_sum

    have hpT'_eq : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
        (∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid then π' ω' else 0) = p_T tid := by
      intro tid
      have h1 := h_lift_sum (fun ω => if T_idx ω = tid then 1 else 0)
      have hL : (∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D),
          (if T_idx (e_ω.symm ω').1 = tid then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * π' ω') =
          ∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid then π' ω' else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [T']
        split_ifs <;> ring
      have hR : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, (if T_idx ω = tid then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * π ω) = p_T tid := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> ring
      exact hL.symm.trans (h1.trans hR)

    have h_root_inv :
        classicalRootSupremum ε L_hor γ (N_ω * M_D) N_T π' T' V_part A_part =
          classicalRootSupremum ε L_hor γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part := by
      unfold classicalRootSupremum
      have hfun : (fun tid => ∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid then π' ω' else 0) = p_T :=
        funext hpT'_eq
      rw [hfun]

    have hpTC'_eq : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (k : ℤ),
        (∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid ∧ k_time' ω' = k then π' ω' else 0) =
          p_TC tid k := by
      intro tid k
      have h1 := h_lift_sum (fun ω => if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k then 1 else 0)
      have hL : (∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D),
          (if T_idx (e_ω.symm ω').1 = tid ∧ k_r (e_ω.symm ω').1 = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
            π' ω') =
          ∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid ∧ k_time' ω' = k then π' ω' else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [T', k_time']
        split_ifs <;> ring
      have hR : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * π ω) = p_TC tid k := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> ring
      exact hL.symm.trans (h1.trans hR)

    
    let p_TG' : Fin N_T → Fin (M_J * M_D) → ℝ := fun tid g =>
      ∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid ∧ G' ω' = g then π' ω' else 0
    let p_G' : Fin (M_J * M_D) → ℝ := fun g =>
      ∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if G' ω' = g then π' ω' else 0

    have hpTG'_eq : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (u : Fin M_J) (d_i : Fin M_D),
        p_TG' tid (e_G_eq (u, d_i)) = p_J (j_u u) * q_pad u tid d_i := by
      intro tid u d_i
      dsimp only [p_TG']
      rw [← e_ω.sum_comp]
      simp only [T', G', Equiv.symm_apply_apply, e_G_eq.injective.eq_iff, Prod.mk.injEq]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      have h_collapse : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ d' : Fin M_D,
          if T_idx ω = tid ∧ u_of ω = u ∧ d' = d_i then π' (e_ω (ω, d')) else 0) =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ u_of ω = u then π' (e_ω (ω, d_i)) else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases hTu : T_idx ω = tid ∧ u_of ω = u
        · rcases hTu with ⟨hT, hu⟩
          simp only [hT, hu, true_and, if_true]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ d_i (fun d' => π' (e_ω (ω, d'))),
            if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
        · have h0 : ∀ d' : Fin M_D, ¬ (T_idx ω = tid ∧ u_of ω = u ∧ d' = d_i) := by
            intro d' ⟨h1, h2, _⟩
            exact hTu ⟨h1, h2⟩
          simp only [hTu, if_false, h0, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      rw [h_collapse]
      have h_atom_term : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if T_idx ω = tid ∧ u_of ω = u then π' (e_ω (ω, d_i)) else 0) =
          p_TJ tid (j_u u) * (q_pad u tid d_i / p_T_u u tid) := by
        dsimp only [p_TJ]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [π']
        simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
        · simp only [if_pos hω]
          have h_iff := hu_of_iff ω u hω
          by_cases hT : T_idx ω = tid
          · by_cases hJ : J ω = j_u u
            · have hu : u_of ω = u := h_iff.mpr hJ
              simp [hT, hu, hJ]
            · have hu : u_of ω ≠ u := fun h => hJ (h_iff.mp h)
              simp [hT, hu, hJ]
          · simp [hT]
        · have hπ0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (hπ_nn ω)
          simp [hω, hπ0]
      rw [h_atom_term, hpTJ_eq u tid]
      by_cases hp0 : p_T_u u tid = 0
      · have hq_sum0 : ∑ d' : Fin M_D, q_pad u tid d' = 0 := (hq_pad_marg u tid).trans hp0
        have hq0 : q_pad u tid d_i = 0 :=
          (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun d' _ => hq_pad_nn u tid d')).mp
            hq_sum0 d_i (Finset.mem_univ d_i)
        simp [hp0, hq0]
      · rw [mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp0]

    have hpG'_eq : ∀ (u : Fin M_J) (d_i : Fin M_D),
        p_G' (e_G_eq (u, d_i)) = p_J (j_u u) * q_D_pad u d_i := by
      intro u d_i
      have h_sum_tid : p_G' (e_G_eq (u, d_i)) =
          ∑ tid : Fin N_T, p_TG' tid (e_G_eq (u, d_i)) := by
        dsimp only [p_G', p_TG']
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hG : G' ω' = e_G_eq (u, d_i)
        · simp only [hG, and_true, if_true]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (T' ω') (fun _ => π' ω'),
            if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
        · simp [hG]
      rw [h_sum_tid]
      simp_rw [hpTG'_eq _ u d_i]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]

    
    have h_Ew_lb :
        ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
          η * (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * E_w_pad u) ≤
          ∑ g : Fin (M_J * M_D), p_G' g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g) := by
      rw [← e_G_eq.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      have h_rhs : (∑ u : Fin M_J, ∑ d_i : Fin M_D,
          p_G' (e_G_eq (u, d_i)) *
            ((1 + γ) * b_G (e_G_eq (u, d_i)) + (1 - γ) * a_G (e_G_eq (u, d_i)))) =
          ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) *
            (∑ d_i : Fin M_D, q_D_pad u d_i *
              ((1 + γ) * p_ud u d_i + (1 - γ) * q_ud u d_i)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d_i _ => ?_)
        rw [hpG'_eq u d_i]
        dsimp only [b_G, a_G]
        simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        ring
      rw [h_rhs]
      have h_lhs : ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
            η * (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * E_w_pad u) =
          ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) *
            (((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) + η * E_w_pad u) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        have h_add : ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) *
            (((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) + η * E_w_pad u) =
            (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u)) * ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
              ∑ u : Fin M_J, η * (p_J (j_u u) * E_w_pad u) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => by ring)
        rw [h_add, hpJu_sum, one_mul]
      rw [h_lhs]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u _ => ?_)
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hj_pos u).le
      have h_cell : ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) + η * E_w_pad u =
          ∑ d_i : Fin M_D, q_D_pad u d_i *
            (((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
              η * ((1 + γ) * B_pad u d_i + (1 - γ) * A_pad u d_i)) := by
        dsimp only [E_w_pad]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        have h1 : ∑ d_i : Fin M_D, q_D_pad u d_i *
            (((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
              η * ((1 + γ) * B_pad u d_i + (1 - γ) * A_pad u d_i)) =
            (∑ d_i : Fin M_D, q_D_pad u d_i) * ((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) +
              ∑ d_i : Fin M_D, η * (q_D_pad u d_i *
                ((1 + γ) * B_pad u d_i + (1 - γ) * A_pad u d_i)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d_i _ => by ring)
        rw [h1, hqD_pad_sum u, one_mul]
      rw [h_cell]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d_i _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_ud_spec u d_i).2.2.2.2.1 (hqD_pad_nn u d_i))

    have h_St_eq :
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.image k_time',
          -((∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid ∧ k_time' ω' = k then π' ω' else 0) *
            Real.log ((∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid ∧ k_time' ω' = k then π' ω' else 0) /
              (∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid then π' ω' else 0)))) /
          Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
        finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_r := by
      have h_img : Finset.univ.image k_time' = Finset.univ.image k_r := by
        ext k
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨ω', rfl⟩
          exact ⟨(e_ω.symm ω').1, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨ω, rfl⟩
          refine ⟨e_ω (ω, ⟨0, hMD⟩), ?_⟩
          dsimp only [k_time']
          rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [h_img]
      simp_rw [hpTC'_eq, hpT'_eq]
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      have h_prob_eq : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
          finProbAt2 π T_idx k_r ω = p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_r ω) ∧
          finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
        intro ω
        constructor
        · unfold finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; tauto)
        · unfold finProbAt
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; tauto)
      have h_rhs_div : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx k_r ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))) =
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_r ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)))) /
            Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        rw [(h_prob_eq ω).1, (h_prob_eq ω).2]
        ring
      rw [h_rhs_div]
      congr 1
      have h_expand : (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.image k_r,
          -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) =
          ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.image k_r,
            if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k then
              -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))
            else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
        have h_in : -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid)) =
            ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, -( (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k then π ω else 0) *
              Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid) ) := by
          dsimp only [p_TC]
          rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        rw [h_in]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> ring
      rw [h_expand, Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      have h_in_k : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.image k_r,
            if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_r ω = k then -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid)) else 0) =
          if T_idx ω = tid then -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tid (k_r ω) / p_T tid)) else 0 := by
        intro tid
        by_cases hT : T_idx ω = tid
        · simp only [hT, true_and, if_true]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.univ.image k_r) (k_r ω)
            (fun k => -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))),
            if_pos (Finset.mem_image_of_mem k_r (Finset.mem_univ ω))]
        · simp [hT]
      simp_rw [h_in_k]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (T_idx ω)
        (fun tid => -(π ω * Real.log (p_TC tid (k_r ω) / p_T tid))),
        if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]

    have h_MI_coarse :
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ u : Fin M_J,
          p_TJ tid (j_u u) * Real.log (p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u)))) /
          Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J := by
      unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
      have h_rhs_div :
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω *
            (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) J ω / finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω)) /
              Real.log (ε⁻¹))) -
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω *
            (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx J ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω)) /
              Real.log (ε⁻¹))) =
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω *
            (Real.log (finProbAt2 π T_idx J ω / finProbAt π T_idx ω) -
             Real.log (finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) J ω / finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω))) /
            Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        ring
      rw [h_rhs_div]
      congr 1
      have h_expand :
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ u : Fin M_J,
            p_TJ tid (j_u u) * Real.log (p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u)))) =
          ∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ u : Fin M_J,
            if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j_u u then
              π ω * Real.log (p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u)))
            else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [p_TJ]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> ring
      rw [h_expand, Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hω : 0 < π ω
      · have h_in_u : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
            (∑ u : Fin M_J,
              if T_idx ω = tid ∧ J ω = j_u u then
                π ω * Real.log (p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u)))
              else 0) =
            if T_idx ω = tid then
              π ω * Real.log (p_TJ tid (J ω) / (p_T tid * p_J (J ω)))
            else 0 := by
          intro tid
          by_cases hT : T_idx ω = tid
          · simp only [hT, true_and, if_true]
            have h_u_rew : ∀ u : Fin M_J,
                (if J ω = j_u u then
                  π ω * Real.log (p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u)))
                else 0) =
                if u_of ω = u then
                  π ω * Real.log (p_TJ tid (J ω) / (p_T tid * p_J (J ω)))
                else 0 := by
              intro u
              have h_iff := hu_of_iff ω u hω
              by_cases hJ : J ω = j_u u
              · have hu : u_of ω = u := h_iff.mpr hJ
                simp [hJ, hu]
              · have hu : u_of ω ≠ u := fun h => hJ (h_iff.mp h)
                simp [hJ, hu]
            simp_rw [h_u_rew]
            rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (u_of ω) _, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
          · simp [hT]
        simp_rw [h_in_u]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (T_idx ω) _, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
        have hp1 : finProbAt π (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
          unfold finProbAt
          simp [hπ_sum]
        have hpJ_ω : finProbAt2 π (fun _ => ()) J ω = p_J (J ω) := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; tauto)
        have hpT_ω : finProbAt π T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
          unfold finProbAt
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; tauto)
        have hpTJ_ω : finProbAt2 π T_idx J ω = p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; tauto)
        rw [hp1, hpJ_ω, hpT_ω, hpTJ_ω, div_one]
        have hpJ_pos_ω : 0 < p_J (J ω) := h_pJ_of_pos ω hω
        have hpTJ_pos_ω : 0 < p_TJ (T_idx ω) (J ω) := by
          have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun ω' => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ J ω' = J ω then π ω' else 0)
            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl)
            (Finset.mem_univ ω)
          simp only [and_self, ↓reduceIte] at h_le
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω h_le
        have hpT_pos_ω : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω) := by
          have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun ω' => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω then π ω' else 0)
            (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl)
            (Finset.mem_univ ω)
          simp only [↓reduceIte] at h_le
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hω h_le
        rw [← Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (div_pos hpTJ_pos_ω hpT_pos_ω)) (ne_of_gt hpJ_pos_ω),
          div_div]
      · have hπ0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω) (hπ_nn ω)
        simp [hπ0]

    have h_ITG_eq :
        (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin (M_J * M_D),
          p_TG' tid g * Real.log (p_TG' tid g /
            ((∑ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), if T' ω' = tid then π' ω' else 0) * p_G' g))) /
          Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
        finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
          η * (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * I_TD_pad u) := by
      simp_rw [hpT'_eq]
      have h_num_split :
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin (M_J * M_D),
            p_TG' tid g * Real.log (p_TG' tid g / (p_T tid * p_G' g))) =
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ u : Fin M_J,
            p_J (j_u u) * ∑ d_i : Fin M_D,
              q_pad u tid d_i * Real.log (q_pad u tid d_i / (p_T_u u tid * q_D_pad u d_i))) +
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ u : Fin M_J,
            p_TJ tid (j_u u) * Real.log (p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u)))) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => ?_)
        rw [← e_G_eq.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
        have h_d_sum :
            (∑ d_i : Fin M_D,
              p_TG' tid (e_G_eq (u, d_i)) *
                Real.log (p_TG' tid (e_G_eq (u, d_i)) /
                  (p_T tid * p_G' (e_G_eq (u, d_i))))) =
            ∑ d_i : Fin M_D,
              (p_J (j_u u) *
                (q_pad u tid d_i * Real.log (q_pad u tid d_i / (p_T_u u tid * q_D_pad u d_i))) +
               (p_J (j_u u) * q_pad u tid d_i) *
                Real.log (p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u)))) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d_i _ => ?_)
          rw [hpTG'_eq tid u d_i, hpG'_eq u d_i]
          by_cases hq_pos : 0 < q_pad u tid d_i
          · have hpJu_pos : 0 < p_J (j_u u) := hj_pos u
            have hpTu_pos : 0 < p_T_u u tid := by
              have h_le : q_pad u tid d_i ≤ ∑ d' : Fin M_D, q_pad u tid d' :=
                Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hq_pad_nn u tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d_i)
              rw [hq_pad_marg u tid] at h_le
              exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos h_le
            have hqD_pos : 0 < q_D_pad u d_i := by
              have h_le : q_pad u tid d_i ≤ ∑ tid' : Fin N_T, q_pad u tid' d_i :=
                Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => hq_pad_nn u tid' d_i) (Finset.mem_univ tid)
              exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos h_le
            have hpTJ_pos : 0 < p_TJ tid (j_u u) := by
              rw [hpTJ_eq u tid]
              exact mul_pos hpJu_pos hpTu_pos
            have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
              have h_le : p_TJ tid (j_u u) ≤ p_T tid := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
                by_cases hT : T_idx ω = tid
                · by_cases hJ : J ω = j_u u <;> simp [hT, hJ, hπ_nn ω]
                · simp [hT]
              exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpTJ_pos h_le
            have h_frac :
                (p_J (j_u u) * q_pad u tid d_i) /
                  (p_T tid * (p_J (j_u u) * q_D_pad u d_i)) =
                (q_pad u tid d_i / (p_T_u u tid * q_D_pad u d_i)) *
                  (p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u))) := by
              rw [hpTJ_eq u tid]
              have h1 : p_J (j_u u) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpJu_pos
              have h2 : p_T_u u tid ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpTu_pos
              have h3 : q_D_pad u d_i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hqD_pos
              have h4 : p_T tid ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpT_pos
              field_simp [h1, h2, h3, h4]
            have hf1_ne : q_pad u tid d_i / (p_T_u u tid * q_D_pad u d_i) ≠ 0 :=
              ne_of_gt (div_pos hq_pos (mul_pos hpTu_pos hqD_pos))
            have hf2_ne : p_TJ tid (j_u u) / (p_T tid * p_J (j_u u)) ≠ 0 :=
              ne_of_gt (div_pos hpTJ_pos (mul_pos hpT_pos hpJu_pos))
            rw [h_frac, Real.log_mul hf1_ne hf2_ne]
            ring
          · have hq0 : q_pad u tid d_i = 0 :=
              le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hq_pos) (hq_pad_nn u tid d_i)
            simp [hq0]
        rw [h_d_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul,
          ← Finset.mul_sum, hq_pad_marg u tid, ← hpTJ_eq u tid]
      rw [h_num_split, add_div, h_MI_coarse, add_comm]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h_u_sum :
          (∑ u : Fin M_J, ∑ tid : Fin N_T,
            p_J (j_u u) * ∑ d_i : Fin M_D,
              q_pad u tid d_i * Real.log (q_pad u tid d_i / (p_T_u u tid * q_D_pad u d_i))) /
            Real.log (ε⁻¹) =
          η * ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * I_TD_pad u := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        dsimp only [I_TD_pad]
        rw [hell_tilde_eq]
        have h1 : η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hη_pos
        have h2 : Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hell_pos
        field_simp [h1, h2]
      exact h_u_sum

    
    have hεr_pos : 0 < ε ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ r
    have hΔr_lo_250 : (250 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ r ≤ Δ_r := by
      have h1 : (250 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ r ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) hεr_pos.le
      exact le_trans h1 hΔr_lo
    have hΔr_hi_250 : Δ_r ≤ 250 * ε ^ r := by
      have h1 : ε ^ r ≤ 250 * ε ^ r := by linarith
      exact le_trans hΔr_hi h1
    have hVA_250 : ∀ tid : Fin N_T, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ 250 ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ 250 := by
      intro tid
      exact ⟨le_trans (hVA tid).1 (by norm_num), le_trans (hVA tid).2 (by norm_num)⟩
    have hG_adm : ∀ g : Fin (M_J * M_D),
        0 ≤ b_G g ∧ b_G g ≤ a_G g ∧ a_G g + r ≤ L_hor ∧ ‖e_G_dir g‖ = 1 := by
      intro g
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, _, _⟩ := h_ud_spec (e_G_eq.symm g).1 (e_G_eq.symm g).2
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have h_supp_glued : ∀ ω' : Fin (N_ω * M_D), 0 < π' ω' →
        let tid := T' ω'
        let g := G' ω'
        let c_mid := ((k_time' ω' : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_r
        c_mid ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        k_G g = k_time' ω' ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G_dir g)| ≤ 250 * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G_dir g))| ≤ 250 * ε ^ (a_G g) ∧
        |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (e_G_dir g)| ≤
          250 * ε ^ (b_G g + r) ∧
        |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (perp2D (e_G_dir g))| ≤
          250 * ε ^ (a_G g + r) := by
      intro ω' hπ'_pos
      set ω := (e_ω.symm ω').1
      set d_i := (e_ω.symm ω').2
      set u := u_of ω
      have hω_pos : 0 < π ω := by
        dsimp only [π'] at hπ'_pos
        by_contra h_not
        rw [if_neg h_not] at hπ'_pos
        exact lt_irrefl 0 hπ'_pos
      have hq_pos : 0 < q_pad u (T_idx ω) d_i := by
        dsimp only [π'] at hπ'_pos
        rw [if_pos hω_pos] at hπ'_pos
        by_contra h_not
        have hq0 : q_pad u (T_idx ω) d_i = 0 :=
          le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h_not) (hq_pad_nn u (T_idx ω) d_i)
        change 0 < π ω * (q_pad u (T_idx ω) d_i / p_T_u u (T_idx ω)) at hπ'_pos
        rw [hq0, zero_div, mul_zero] at hπ'_pos
        exact lt_irrefl 0 hπ'_pos
      have hJω : J ω = j_u u := hu_of_eq ω hω_pos
      obtain ⟨hc_mid_mem, hproj_eq⟩ := h_kr_supp ω hω_pos
      obtain ⟨hv1, hv2, ha1, ha2⟩ := hq_pad_cap u (T_idx ω) d_i hq_pos
      have h_caps := (h_ud_spec u d_i).2.2.2.2.2 ω hω_pos hJω hv1 hv2 ha1 ha2
      dsimp only [T', k_time', G', b_G, a_G, e_G_dir, V_G, X_G, k_G]
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      refine ⟨hc_mid_mem, ?_, h_caps.1, h_caps.2.1, h_caps.2.2.1, h_caps.2.2.2⟩
      rw [← hJω]
      exact hproj_eq

    have h_global_est := h_growth ε r L_hor Δ_r hε₀ hε_lt le_rfl
      (le_trans hrt.le htL) (le_max_right 1 L_hor) hΔr_lo_250 hΔr_hi_250
      (N_ω * M_D) N_T (M_J * M_D) π' T' k_time' G' V_part A_part
      b_G a_G e_G_dir V_G X_G k_G
      hπ'_nn hπ'_sum hVA_250 hG_adm h_supp_glued

    
    have h_ts_lb :
        (((1 + γ) * b_t + (1 - γ) * (b_t + d)) -
          finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J +
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_r) +
        η * (∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
          classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde (1 + e_loc) γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx
            (V_loc j) (A_loc j)) -
        (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl * η ≤
        classicalTransportScore ε γ (N_ω * M_D) N_T (M_J * M_D) π' T' k_time' G' b_G a_G := by
      unfold classicalTransportScore
      dsimp only []
      rw [h_ITG_eq, h_St_eq]
      have h_sum_τ : ∑ j ∈ S_J, p_J j *
          classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde (1 + e_loc) γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx
            (V_loc j) (A_loc j) =
          ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * τ_u u :=
        h_sum_SJ (fun j => classicalRootSupremum ε_tilde (1 + e_loc) γ N_ω N_T (π_j j) T_idx
          (V_loc j) (A_loc j))
      rw [h_sum_τ]
      have h_loc_diff :
          (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * τ_u u) - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl ≤
          (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * E_w_pad u) -
          (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * I_TD_pad u) := by
        have hL : (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * τ_u u) - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl =
            ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * (τ_u u - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl) := by
          have h1 : ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * (τ_u u - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl) =
              (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * τ_u u) -
                (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u)) * ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => by ring)
          rw [h1, hpJu_sum, one_mul]
        have hR : (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * E_w_pad u) -
            (∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * I_TD_pad u) =
            ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * (E_w_pad u - I_TD_pad u) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => by ring)
        rw [hL, hR]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u _ =>
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_pad_score u) (hj_pos u).le)
      have h_eta_diff := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_loc_diff hη_pos.le
      change _ ≤ (∑ g : Fin (M_J * M_D),
          p_G' g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g)) -
        (finMutualInfo ε π T_idx J + η * ∑ u : Fin M_J, p_J (j_u u) * I_TD_pad u) +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε π T_idx k_r
      linarith [h_Ew_lb, h_eta_diff]

    have h_rate_slack :
        (b_comp + δ_cl'') * r ≤ classicalGrowthRate γ * r + (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl * η := by
      have h_mul : (b_comp + δ_cl'') * r ≤ (classicalGrowthRate γ + 2 * δ_cl'') * r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hr₀.le
      have h_2δ : 2 * δ_cl'' * r = (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_cl * η := by
        dsimp only [δ_cl'', η]
        have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr₀
        field_simp [hr_ne]
        ring
      linarith

    rw [h_root_inv] at h_global_est
    linarith [h_ts_lb, h_global_est, h_rate_slack]

informal_problem.statement:
{N_P N_Θ k_grp N_obs : ℕ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k_grp)
    (p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin k_grp → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ)
    (F : Fin N_obs → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)
    (H_set : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop)
    (ζ v M_low : ℝ)
    (hp0_nn : ∀ i b, 0 ≤ p0 i b)
    (hp0_sum : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, p0 i b) = 1)
    (hζ_nn : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hH_mass :
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      1 - ζ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_set i b then p0 i b else 0)
    (hv_pos : 0 < v)
    (hM_low_pos : 0 < M_low)
    (hM_low_le : M_low ≤ 1 - ζ -
      (pairKLDivergence p0 + condCoordMultiInfo p0 Q + 1) / v) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let N_tot : ℕ := N_obs + k_grp + 2
    let δ : ℝ := M_low / (2 * (N_tot : ℝ))
    ∃ (M_ret : ℝ) (π : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ),
      M_low / 2 ≤ M_ret ∧ M_ret ≤ 1 ∧
      (∀ i b, 0 ≤ π i b) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, π i b = 1) ∧
      (∀ i b, 0 < π i b → H_set i b ∧ 0 < p0 i b) ∧
      (∀ i b, M_ret * π i b ≤ p0 i b) ∧
      (∀ i b, π i b ≤ Real.exp v * M_ret * δ ^ (-2 : ℤ) *
        (∑ b', π i b') * (∑ i', π i' b)) ∧
      (∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) →
        ∀ q : Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ,
          let lam_b := ∑ i, π i b
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if (∀ g, Q g i b = q g) then π i b / lam_b else 0) ≤
            Real.exp v * δ ^ (-(k_grp : ℤ)) *
              ∏ g : Fin k_grp,
                (∑ i : Fin N_P, if Q g i b = q g then π i b / lam_b else 0)) ∧
      (∀ (m_idx : Fin N_obs) (z : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
        let r_F := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if F m_idx i b = z then M_ret * π i b else 0
        let p0_F := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if F m_idx i b = z then p0 i b else 0
        0 < r_F → δ * p0_F ≤ r_F ∧ r_F ≤ p0_F)

signature.name: affine_block_kl_core
signature.statement:
{N_P N_Θ k_grp N_obs : ℕ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k_grp)
    (p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin k_grp → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ)
    (F : Fin N_obs → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)
    (H_set : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop)
    (ζ v M_low : ℝ)
    (hp0_nn : ∀ i b, 0 ≤ p0 i b)
    (hp0_sum : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, p0 i b) = 1)
    (hζ_nn : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hH_mass :
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      1 - ζ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_set i b then p0 i b else 0)
    (hv_pos : 0 < v)
    (hM_low_pos : 0 < M_low)
    (hM_low_le : M_low ≤ 1 - ζ -
      (pairKLDivergence p0 + condCoordMultiInfo p0 Q + 1) / v) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let N_tot : ℕ := N_obs + k_grp + 2
    let δ : ℝ := M_low / (2 * (N_tot : ℝ))
    ∃ (M_ret : ℝ) (π : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ),
      M_low / 2 ≤ M_ret ∧ M_ret ≤ 1 ∧
      (∀ i b, 0 ≤ π i b) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, π i b = 1) ∧
      (∀ i b, 0 < π i b → H_set i b ∧ 0 < p0 i b) ∧
      (∀ i b, M_ret * π i b ≤ p0 i b) ∧
      (∀ i b, π i b ≤ Real.exp v * M_ret * δ ^ (-2 : ℤ) *
        (∑ b', π i b') * (∑ i', π i' b)) ∧
      (∀ b, 0 < (∑ i, π i b) →
        ∀ q : Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ,
          let lam_b := ∑ i, π i b
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, if (∀ g, Q g i b = q g) then π i b / lam_b else 0) ≤
            Real.exp v * δ ^ (-(k_grp : ℤ)) *
              ∏ g : Fin k_grp,
                (∑ i : Fin N_P, if Q g i b = q g then π i b / lam_b else 0)) ∧
      (∀ (m_idx : Fin N_obs) (z : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
        let r_F := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if F m_idx i b = z then M_ret * π i b else 0
        let p0_F := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
