proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro N_tot δ
  have hN_tot_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N_tot : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [N_tot]
    positivity
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    positivity
  
  have h_kl_pt : ∀ (p q : ℝ), 0 ≤ p → 0 ≤ q → (0 < p → 0 < q) →
      (if Real.exp v * q < p then v * p else 0) ≤
        p * Real.log (p / q) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * q := by
    intro p q hp_nn hq_nn hpq
    by_cases hp : 0 < p
    · have hq : 0 < q := hpq hp
      by_cases h_lt : Real.exp v * q < p
      · rw [if_pos h_lt]
        have h_div : Real.exp v < p / q := (lt_div_iff₀ hq).mpr h_lt
        have h_log : v ≤ Real.log (p / q) := by
          have h1 := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos v) h_div.le
          rwa [Real.log_exp] at h1
        have h_mul : v * p ≤ p * Real.log (p / q) := by
          calc v * p ≤ Real.log (p / q) * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_log hp_nn
            _ = p * Real.log (p / q) := mul_comm _ _
        linarith
      · rw [if_neg h_lt]
        have h1 : Real.log (q / (2 * p)) ≤ q / (2 * p) - 1 :=
          Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
        have h2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 2 - 1 :=
          Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num)
        have h_prod : (p / q) * (q / (2 * p)) = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          field_simp [hp.ne', hq.ne']
        have h_log_sum : Real.log (p / q) + Real.log (q / (2 * p)) = -Real.log 2 := by
          have hpq_ne : p / q ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hp.ne' hq.ne'
          have hqp_ne : q / (2 * p) ≠ 0 := by positivity
          rw [← Real.log_mul hpq_ne hqp_ne, h_prod, Real.log_inv]
        have h_nonneg_inner : 0 ≤ Real.log (p / q) + q / (2 * p) := by
          linarith
        have h_mul : 0 ≤ p * (Real.log (p / q) + q / (2 * p)) :=
          mul_nonneg hp_nn h_nonneg_inner
        have h_simp : p * (Real.log (p / q) + q / (2 * p)) =
            p * Real.log (p / q) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * q := by
          have hp_ne : p ≠ 0 := hp.ne'
          field_simp [hp_ne]
        linarith
    · have hp0 : p = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hp) hp_nn
      subst hp0
      have h_not : ¬ (Real.exp v * q < 0) :=
        not_lt.mpr (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos v).le hq_nn)
      rw [if_neg h_not]
      linarith

  
  let mu0 : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun i => ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, p0 i b
  let lam0 : Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b
  have hmu0_nn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mu0 i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hp0_nn i b)
  have hlam0_nn : ∀ b, 0 ≤ lam0 b := fun b => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hp0_nn i b)
  have hlam0_sum : ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b = 1 := by
    dsimp [lam0]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact hp0_sum

  
  have h_pair_tail :
      v * (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
        if Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b < p0 i b then p0 i b else 0) ≤
        pairKLDivergence p0 + 1 / 2 := by
    have h_lhs : v * (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b < p0 i b then p0 i b else 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Real.exp v * (mu0 i * lam0 b) < p0 i b then v * p0 i b else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      split_ifs <;> ring
    rw [h_lhs]
    have h_sum_le :
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Real.exp v * (mu0 i * lam0 b) < p0 i b then v * p0 i b else 0) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          (p0 i b * Real.log (p0 i b / (mu0 i * lam0 b)) +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (mu0 i * lam0 b)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => ?_))
      refine h_kl_pt (p0 i b) (mu0 i * lam0 b) (hp0_nn i b)
        (mul_nonneg (hmu0_nn i) (hlam0_nn b)) (fun hp => ?_)
      have h1 : p0 i b ≤ mu0 i :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun b' _ => hp0_nn i b') (Finset.mem_univ b)
      have h2 : p0 i b ≤ lam0 b :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hp0_nn i' b) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact mul_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hp h1) (lt_of_lt_of_le hp h2)
    have h_rhs :
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          (p0 i b * Real.log (p0 i b / (mu0 i * lam0 b)) +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (mu0 i * lam0 b))) =
        pairKLDivergence p0 + 1 / 2 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      have h_prod_sum :
          (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (mu0 i * lam0 b)) =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ i : Fin N_P, mu0 i) * (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b)) := by
        calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (mu0 i * lam0 b))
            = ∑ i : Fin N_P, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * mu0 i) * (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b) := by
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
                rw [Finset.mul_sum]
                exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by ring)
          _ = (∑ i : Fin N_P, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * mu0 i) * (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b) :=
                (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ i : Fin N_P, mu0 i) * (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b)) := by
                rw [← Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
      rw [h_prod_sum, hp0_sum, hlam0_sum]
      ring
    linarith

  
  let q_joint : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b =>
    ∑ i' : Fin N_P, if (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q g i' b = Q g i b) then p0 i' b else 0
  let p_prod : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b =>
    ∏ g : Fin k_grp, (∑ i' : Fin N_P, if Q g i' b = Q g i b then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0)
  have h_coord_tail :
      v * (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
        if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then p0 i b else 0) ≤
        condCoordMultiInfo p0 Q + 1 / 2 := by
    let p_joint : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b =>
      ∑ i' : Fin N_P,
        if (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q g i' b = Q g i b) then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0
    have h_col : ∀ b : Fin N_Θ,
        (∑ i : Fin N_P,
          if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then v * p0 i b else 0) ≤
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b * Real.log (p_joint i b / p_prod i b)) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam0 b := by
      intro b
      by_cases hlam : 0 < lam0 b
      · let tup : Fin N_P → (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) := fun i g => Q g i b
        let S_b : Finset (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.univ.image tup
        let ξ_joint : (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun q =>
          ∑ i' : Fin N_P, if tup i' = q then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0
        let ξ_marg : Fin k_grp → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun g u =>
          ∑ i' : Fin N_P, if Q g i' b = u then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0
        let ξ_prod : (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun q =>
          ∏ g : Fin k_grp, ξ_marg g (q g)
        have hξ_joint_nn : ∀ q, 0 ≤ ξ_joint q := fun q =>
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i' _ => by
            split_ifs
            · exact div_nonneg (hp0_nn i' b) hlam.le
            · exact le_rfl)
        have hξ_marg_nn : ∀ g u, 0 ≤ ξ_marg g u := fun g u =>
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i' _ => by
            split_ifs
            · exact div_nonneg (hp0_nn i' b) hlam.le
            · exact le_rfl)
        have hξ_prod_nn : ∀ q, 0 ≤ ξ_prod q := fun q =>
          Finset.prod_nonneg (fun g _ => hξ_marg_nn g (q g))
        have hp_joint_eq : ∀ i, p_joint i b = ξ_joint (tup i) := by
          intro i
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
          exact if_congr (funext_iff.symm) rfl rfl
        have hp_prod_eq : ∀ i, p_prod i b = ξ_prod (tup i) := fun _ => rfl
        have hq_joint_eq : ∀ i, q_joint i b = lam0 b * ξ_joint (tup i) := by
          intro i
          dsimp [q_joint, ξ_joint]
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
          have h_iff : (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q g i' b = Q g i b) ↔ tup i' = tup i :=
            funext_iff.symm
          rw [if_congr h_iff rfl rfl]
          split_ifs
          · exact (mul_div_cancel₀ (p0 i' b) hlam.ne').symm
          · ring
        have h_group : ∀ Φ : (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ,
            (∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b * Φ (tup i)) =
              lam0 b * ∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_joint q * Φ q := by
          intro Φ
          have h1 : ∀ i : Fin N_P,
              p0 i b * Φ (tup i) =
                ∑ q ∈ S_b, if tup i = q then p0 i b * Φ q else 0 := by
            intro i
            have hmem : tup i ∈ S_b := Finset.mem_image_of_mem tup (Finset.mem_univ i)
            symm
            rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (tup i)
              (fun q _ hq => if_neg (Ne.symm hq))
              (fun h_not => absurd hmem h_not), if_pos rfl]
          simp_rw [h1]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => ?_)
          dsimp [ξ_joint]
          rw [← mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
          split_ifs
          · rw [mul_div_cancel₀ (p0 i' b) hlam.ne']
          · ring
        have h_col_lhs :
            (∑ i : Fin N_P,
              if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then v * p0 i b else 0) =
            lam0 b * ∑ q ∈ S_b,
              (if Real.exp v * ξ_prod q < ξ_joint q then v * ξ_joint q else 0) := by
          have h_rew :
              (∑ i : Fin N_P,
                if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then v * p0 i b else 0) =
              ∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b *
                (if Real.exp v * ξ_prod (tup i) < ξ_joint (tup i) then v else 0) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
            have h_cond : (Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b) ↔
                (Real.exp v * ξ_prod (tup i) < ξ_joint (tup i)) := by
              rw [hq_joint_eq i, hp_prod_eq i]
              have h_mul_eq : Real.exp v * lam0 b * ξ_prod (tup i) =
                  lam0 b * (Real.exp v * ξ_prod (tup i)) := by ring
              rw [h_mul_eq]
              exact ⟨fun h => lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h hlam.le,
                     fun h => mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hlam⟩
            rw [if_congr h_cond rfl rfl]
            split_ifs <;> ring
          rw [h_rew,
              h_group (fun q => if Real.exp v * ξ_prod q < ξ_joint q then v else 0)]
          congr 1
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> ring
        have h_col_rhs :
            (∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b * Real.log (p_joint i b / p_prod i b)) +
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam0 b =
            lam0 b * ((∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_joint q * Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q)) + 1 / 2) := by
          have h_rew :
              (∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b * Real.log (p_joint i b / p_prod i b)) =
              ∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b * Real.log (ξ_joint (tup i) / ξ_prod (tup i)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
            rw [hp_joint_eq i, hp_prod_eq i]
          rw [h_rew,
              h_group (fun q => Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q))]
          ring
        rw [h_col_lhs, h_col_rhs]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hlam.le
        have h_sb_kl :
            (∑ q ∈ S_b, if Real.exp v * ξ_prod q < ξ_joint q then v * ξ_joint q else 0) ≤
            (∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_joint q * Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q)) +
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_prod q := by
          calc (∑ q ∈ S_b, if Real.exp v * ξ_prod q < ξ_joint q then v * ξ_joint q else 0)
              ≤ ∑ q ∈ S_b, (ξ_joint q * Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q) +
                  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ξ_prod q) := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q _ => ?_)
                refine h_kl_pt (ξ_joint q) (ξ_prod q) (hξ_joint_nn q) (hξ_prod_nn q) (fun hpos => ?_)
                obtain ⟨i₀, _, hi₀_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hpos.ne'
                have hi₀_tup : tup i₀ = q := by
                  by_contra hne
                  rw [if_neg hne] at hi₀_ne
                  exact hi₀_ne rfl
                rw [if_pos hi₀_tup] at hi₀_ne
                have hi₀_pos : 0 < p0 i₀ b / lam0 b :=
                  lt_of_le_of_ne (div_nonneg (hp0_nn i₀ b) hlam.le) (Ne.symm hi₀_ne)
                refine Finset.prod_pos (fun g _ => ?_)
                have hqg : Q g i₀ b = q g := congr_fun hi₀_tup g
                have h_term_le :
                    (if Q g i₀ b = q g then p0 i₀ b / lam0 b else 0) ≤ ξ_marg g (q g) :=
                  Finset.single_le_sum
                    (f := fun i' => if Q g i' b = q g then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0)
                    (fun i' _ => by
                      split_ifs
                      · exact div_nonneg (hp0_nn i' b) hlam.le
                      · exact le_rfl)
                    (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
                rw [if_pos hqg] at h_term_le
                exact lt_of_lt_of_le hi₀_pos h_term_le
            _ = (∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_joint q * Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q)) +
                  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_prod q := by
                rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
        have h_prod_sum_le : ∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_prod q ≤ 1 := by
          let U : Fin k_grp → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
            fun g => Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin N_P => Q g i b)
          have h_sub : S_b ⊆ Fintype.piFinset U := by
            intro q hq
            obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
            exact Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr (fun g =>
              Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i))
          calc ∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_prod q
              ≤ ∑ q ∈ Fintype.piFinset U, ∏ g : Fin k_grp, ξ_marg g (q g) :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub
                  (fun q _ _ => hξ_prod_nn q)
            _ = ∏ g : Fin k_grp, ∑ u ∈ U g, ξ_marg g u :=
                (Finset.prod_univ_sum U ξ_marg).symm
            _ = ∏ _g : Fin k_grp, (1 : ℝ) := by
                refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun g _ => ?_)
                dsimp [ξ_marg]
                rw [Finset.sum_comm]
                have h_inner : ∀ i' : Fin N_P,
                    (∑ u ∈ U g, if Q g i' b = u then p0 i' b / lam0 b else 0) =
                      p0 i' b / lam0 b := by
                  intro i'
                  have hmem : Q g i' b ∈ U g :=
                    Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i')
                  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Q g i' b)
                    (fun u _ hu => if_neg (Ne.symm hu))
                    (fun h_not => absurd hmem h_not), if_pos rfl]
                simp_rw [h_inner]
                rw [← Finset.sum_div]
                exact div_self hlam.ne'
            _ = 1 := Finset.prod_const_one
        linarith
      · have hlam0 : lam0 b = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hlam) (hlam0_nn b)
        have hp0_b : ∀ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b = 0 := by
          intro i
          have hle : p0 i b ≤ lam0 b :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hp0_nn i' b) (Finset.mem_univ i)
          exact le_antisymm (hle.trans hlam0.le) (hp0_nn i b)
        simp [hp0_b, hlam0]
    have h_lhs_comm :
        v * (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then p0 i b else 0) =
        ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ i : Fin N_P,
          if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then v * p0 i b else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> ring
    have h_rhs_comm :
        condCoordMultiInfo p0 Q + 1 / 2 =
        ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          ((∑ i : Fin N_P, p0 i b * Real.log (p_joint i b / p_prod i b)) +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam0 b) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hlam0_sum, mul_one]
      congr 1
      unfold condCoordMultiInfo
      dsimp only
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_))
      have h_num :
          (∑ i' : Fin N_P,
            @ite _ (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q g i' b = Q g i b) (Classical.propDecidable _)
              (p0 i' b / lam0 b) 0) = p_joint i b := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hc : ∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q g i' b = Q g i b
        · rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc]
        · rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc]
      have h_den :
          (∏ g : Fin k_grp, ∑ i' : Fin N_P,
            @ite _ (Q g i' b = Q g i b) (Classical.propDecidable _)
              (p0 i' b / lam0 b) 0) = p_prod i b := by
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun g _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_))
        by_cases hc : Q g i' b = Q g i b
        · rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc]
        · rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc]
      rw [h_num, h_den]
    rw [h_lhs_comm, h_rhs_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => h_col b)

  
  let Good : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop := fun i b =>
    H_set i b ∧
    p0 i b ≤ Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b ∧
    q_joint i b ≤ Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b
  let r0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b => if Good i b then p0 i b else 0
  have hr0_nn : ∀ i b, 0 ≤ r0 i b := fun i b => by
    dsimp [r0]
    split_ifs
    · exact hp0_nn i b
    · exact le_rfl
  have hr0_le : ∀ i b, r0 i b ≤ p0 i b := fun i b => by
    dsimp [r0]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact hp0_nn i b
  have hr0_mass : M_low ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, r0 i b := by
    have hH_mass' : 1 - ζ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_set i b then p0 i b else 0 := by
      refine le_trans hH_mass (le_of_eq ?_)
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => if_congr Iff.rfl rfl rfl))
    have h_pt : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ),
        (if H_set i b then p0 i b else 0) ≤
          r0 i b +
          (if Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b < p0 i b then p0 i b else 0) +
          (if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then p0 i b else 0) := by
      intro i b
      have hp_nn := hp0_nn i b
      dsimp [r0, Good]
      by_cases hH : H_set i b
      · by_cases hP : Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b < p0 i b
        · rw [if_pos hH, if_pos hP]
          have h_notG : ¬ (H_set i b ∧ p0 i b ≤ Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b ∧
              q_joint i b ≤ Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b) :=
            fun hg => not_lt_of_ge hg.2.1 hP
          rw [if_neg h_notG]
          split_ifs <;> linarith
        · by_cases hC : Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b
          · rw [if_pos hH, if_neg hP, if_pos hC]
            have h_notG : ¬ (H_set i b ∧ p0 i b ≤ Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b ∧
                q_joint i b ≤ Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b) :=
              fun hg => not_lt_of_ge hg.2.2 hC
            rw [if_neg h_notG]
            linarith
          · have hG : H_set i b ∧ p0 i b ≤ Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b ∧
                q_joint i b ≤ Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b :=
              ⟨hH, not_lt.mp hP, not_lt.mp hC⟩
            rw [if_pos hH, if_pos hG, if_neg hP, if_neg hC]
            linarith
      · rw [if_neg hH]
        have h_notG : ¬ (H_set i b ∧ p0 i b ≤ Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b ∧
            q_joint i b ≤ Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b) :=
          fun hg => hH hg.1
        rw [if_neg h_notG]
        split_ifs <;> linarith
    have h_sum_pt :
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_set i b then p0 i b else 0) ≤
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, r0 i b) +
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b < p0 i b then p0 i b else 0) +
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then p0 i b else 0) := by
      calc (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_set i b then p0 i b else 0)
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
              (r0 i b +
                (if Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b < p0 i b then p0 i b else 0) +
                (if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then p0 i b else 0)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => h_pt i b))
        _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have h_tails_div :
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Real.exp v * mu0 i * lam0 b < p0 i b then p0 i b else 0) +
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Real.exp v * lam0 b * p_prod i b < q_joint i b then p0 i b else 0) ≤
        (pairKLDivergence p0 + condCoordMultiInfo p0 Q + 1) / v := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hv_pos]
      linarith [h_pair_tail, h_coord_tail]
    linarith [hH_mass', h_sum_pt, h_tails_div, hM_low_le]

  
  let G : Fin N_tot → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun α i b =>
    if h1 : α.1 < N_obs then F ⟨α.1, h1⟩ i b
    else if h2 : α.1 < N_obs + k_grp then
      let g : Fin k_grp := ⟨α.1 - N_obs, by omega⟩
      ((b.1 : ℤ), (Q g i b).1, (Q g i b).2, 0)
    else if α.1 = N_obs + k_grp then ((i.1 : ℤ), 0, 0, 0)
    else ((b.1 : ℤ), 0, 0, 0)

  let Ω := Fin N_P × Fin N_Θ
  let Z := ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ
  let U_obs : Fin N_tot → Finset Z :=
    fun α => Finset.univ.image (fun x : Ω => G α x.1 x.2)
  let slice : Fin N_tot → Finset (Fin N_tot × Z) :=
    fun α => (U_obs α).image (Prod.mk α)
  let A0 : Finset (Fin N_tot × Z) := Finset.univ.biUnion slice
  let S_of : Finset (Fin N_tot × Z) → Finset Ω :=
    fun B => Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Ω => ∀ α : Fin N_tot, (α, G α x.1 x.2) ∈ B)
  let fibMass : Finset (Fin N_tot × Z) → (Fin N_tot × Z) → ℝ :=
    fun B p => ∑ x ∈ S_of B, if G p.1 x.1 x.2 = p.2 then r0 x.1 x.2 else 0
  let p0Fib : (Fin N_tot × Z) → ℝ :=
    fun p => ∑ x : Ω, if G p.1 x.1 x.2 = p.2 then p0 x.1 x.2 else 0
  have hp0Fib_nn : ∀ p, 0 ≤ p0Fib p := fun p =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => by
      split_ifs
      · exact hp0_nn x.1 x.2
      · exact le_rfl)
  have h_erase_S : ∀ (B : Finset (Fin N_tot × Z)) (p₀ : Fin N_tot × Z),
      S_of (B.erase p₀) = (S_of B).filter (fun x : Ω => ¬ (G p₀.1 x.1 x.2 = p₀.2)) := by
    intro B p₀
    ext x
    simp only [S_of, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_erase]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun α => (h α).2, fun heq => (h p₀.1).1 (Prod.ext rfl heq)⟩
    · rintro ⟨hB, hne⟩ α
      refine ⟨?_, hB α⟩
      intro heq
      apply hne
      have h1 : α = p₀.1 := congr_arg Prod.fst heq
      have h2 : G α x.1 x.2 = p₀.2 := congr_arg Prod.snd heq
      subst h1
      exact h2
  have h_erase_mass : ∀ (B : Finset (Fin N_tot × Z)) (p₀ : Fin N_tot × Z),
      (∑ x ∈ S_of B, r0 x.1 x.2) - (∑ x ∈ S_of (B.erase p₀), r0 x.1 x.2) =
        fibMass B p₀ := by
    intro B p₀
    rw [h_erase_S B p₀]
    have h_split := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
      (S_of B) (fun x : Ω => G p₀.1 x.1 x.2 = p₀.2) (fun x : Ω => r0 x.1 x.2)
    have h_filt : (∑ x ∈ (S_of B).filter (fun x : Ω => G p₀.1 x.1 x.2 = p₀.2), r0 x.1 x.2) =
        fibMass B p₀ :=
      Finset.sum_filter (fun x : Ω => G p₀.1 x.1 x.2 = p₀.2) (fun x : Ω => r0 x.1 x.2)
    linarith
  have h_trim_ind : ∀ (n : ℕ) (B : Finset (Fin N_tot × Z)), B.card = n →
      ∃ B' : Finset (Fin N_tot × Z), B' ⊆ B ∧
        (∀ p ∈ B', δ * p0Fib p ≤ fibMass B' p) ∧
        (∑ x ∈ S_of B, r0 x.1 x.2) - (∑ x ∈ S_of B', r0 x.1 x.2) ≤
          ∑ p ∈ B \ B', δ * p0Fib p := by
    intro n
    refine Nat.strong_induction_on n (fun n ih B hcard => ?_)
    by_cases hall : ∀ p ∈ B, δ * p0Fib p ≤ fibMass B p
    · refine ⟨B, Finset.Subset.rfl, hall, ?_⟩
      simp
    · push_neg at hall
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀_mem, hp₀_lt⟩ := hall
      let B₁ := B.erase p₀
      have hcard_lt : B₁.card < n := hcard ▸ Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hp₀_mem
      obtain ⟨B', hB'_sub, hB'_fl, hB'_loss⟩ := ih B₁.card hcard_lt B₁ rfl
      have hB'_sub_B : B' ⊆ B := hB'_sub.trans (Finset.erase_subset p₀ B)
      refine ⟨B', hB'_sub_B, hB'_fl, ?_⟩
      have hp₀_not_B₁ : p₀ ∉ B₁ := by simp [B₁]
      have hp₀_not_sdiff : p₀ ∉ B₁ \ B' :=
        fun h => hp₀_not_B₁ (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp h).1
      have h_ins_sub : insert p₀ (B₁ \ B') ⊆ B \ B' := by
        intro p hp
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hp with rfl | hp1
        · exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hp₀_mem, fun hpB' => hp₀_not_B₁ (hB'_sub hpB')⟩
        · exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
            ⟨Finset.erase_subset p₀ B (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hp1).1,
             (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hp1).2⟩
      have h_sdiff_sum :
          δ * p0Fib p₀ + (∑ p ∈ B₁ \ B', δ * p0Fib p) ≤
            ∑ p ∈ B \ B', δ * p0Fib p := by
        have h_ins_eq :
            ∑ p ∈ insert p₀ (B₁ \ B'), δ * p0Fib p =
              δ * p0Fib p₀ + ∑ p ∈ B₁ \ B', δ * p0Fib p :=
          Finset.sum_insert hp₀_not_sdiff
        rw [← h_ins_eq]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_ins_sub
          (fun p _ _ => mul_nonneg hδ_pos.le (hp0Fib_nn p))
      have h_step := h_erase_mass B p₀
      change (∑ x ∈ S_of B, r0 x.1 x.2) - (∑ x ∈ S_of B₁, r0 x.1 x.2) = fibMass B p₀ at h_step
      linarith

  obtain ⟨B', hB'_sub_A0, hB'_fl, hB'_loss⟩ := h_trim_ind A0.card A0 rfl
  have hS_A0 : S_of A0 = Finset.univ := by
    ext x
    simp only [S_of, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, iff_true]
    intro α
    refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨α, Finset.mem_univ α, ?_⟩
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem (Prod.mk α)
      (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun y : Ω => G α y.1 y.2) (Finset.mem_univ x))
  have hA0_sum : ∑ p ∈ A0, δ * p0Fib p = (N_tot : ℝ) * δ := by
    have h_disj : (↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_tot)) : Set (Fin N_tot)).PairwiseDisjoint slice := by
      intro α₁ _ α₂ _ hne
      change Disjoint (slice α₁) (slice α₂)
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro p hp1 hp2
      obtain ⟨z₁, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp1
      obtain ⟨z₂, _, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp2
      exact hne (congr_arg Prod.fst h2).symm
    dsimp [A0]
    rw [Finset.sum_biUnion h_disj]
    have h_each : ∀ α : Fin N_tot, ∑ p ∈ slice α, δ * p0Fib p = δ := by
      intro α
      dsimp [slice]
      have h_inj : Set.InjOn (Prod.mk α) (U_obs α : Set Z) :=
        fun z₁ _ z₂ _ h => congr_arg Prod.snd h
      rw [Finset.sum_image h_inj, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have h_p0_alpha : ∑ z ∈ U_obs α, p0Fib (α, z) = 1 := by
        dsimp [p0Fib]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        have h_in : ∀ x : Ω,
            (∑ z ∈ U_obs α, if G α x.1 x.2 = z then p0 x.1 x.2 else 0) = p0 x.1 x.2 := by
          intro x
          have hmem : G α x.1 x.2 ∈ U_obs α :=
            Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ x)
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (G α x.1 x.2)
            (fun z _ hz => if_neg (Ne.symm hz))
            (fun h_not => absurd hmem h_not), if_pos rfl]
        simp_rw [h_in]
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        exact hp0_sum
      rw [h_p0_alpha, mul_one]
    simp_rw [h_each]
    simp

  let r : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b => if (i, b) ∈ S_of B' then r0 i b else 0
  have hr_nn : ∀ i b, 0 ≤ r i b := fun i b => by
    dsimp [r]
    split_ifs
    · exact hr0_nn i b
    · exact le_rfl
  have hr_le_r0 : ∀ i b, r i b ≤ r0 i b := fun i b => by
    dsimp [r]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact hr0_nn i b
  have hr_le_p0 : ∀ i b, r i b ≤ p0 i b := fun i b => (hr_le_r0 i b).trans (hr0_le i b)
  have hr_sum_eq : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, r i b) = ∑ x ∈ S_of B', r0 x.1 x.2 := by
    rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type (fun x : Ω => r x.1 x.2)]
    dsimp [r]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp
  have hr0_sum_eq : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, r0 i b) = ∑ x ∈ S_of A0, r0 x.1 x.2 := by
    rw [hS_A0, ← Fintype.sum_prod_type (fun x : Ω => r0 x.1 x.2)]
  have hr_mass_lb :
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, r0 i b) - (N_tot : ℝ) * δ ≤
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, r i b := by
    have h_sdiff_le : ∑ p ∈ A0 \ B', δ * p0Fib p ≤ (N_tot : ℝ) * δ := by
      rw [← hA0_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.sdiff_subset
        (fun p _ _ => mul_nonneg hδ_pos.le (hp0Fib_nn p))
    linarith [hr_sum_eq, hr0_sum_eq, hB'_loss, h_sdiff_le]
  have hr_fib : ∀ (α : Fin N_tot) (z : Z),
      let r_G := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if G α i b = z then r i b else 0
      let p0_G := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if G α i b = z then p0 i b else 0
      0 < r_G → δ * p0_G ≤ r_G ∧ r_G ≤ p0_G := by
    intro α z r_G p0_G hr_G_pos
    have hr_G_eq : r_G = fibMass B' (α, z) := by
      dsimp [r_G, fibMass]
      rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type (fun x : Ω => if G α x.1 x.2 = z then r x.1 x.2 else 0)]
      have h_rew : ∀ x : Ω,
          (if G α x.1 x.2 = z then r x.1 x.2 else 0) =
          if x ∈ S_of B' then (if G α x.1 x.2 = z then r0 x.1 x.2 else 0) else 0 := by
        intro x
        dsimp [r]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
      simp_rw [h_rew]
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      congr 1
      ext x
      simp
    have hp0_G_eq : p0_G = p0Fib (α, z) := by
      dsimp [p0_G, p0Fib]
      rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type (fun x : Ω => if G α x.1 x.2 = z then p0 x.1 x.2 else 0)]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr_G_eq] at hr_G_pos ⊢
      rw [hp0_G_eq]
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀_mem, hx₀_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hr_G_pos.ne'
      have hx₀_eq : G α x₀.1 x₀.2 = z := by
        by_contra hne
        rw [if_neg hne] at hx₀_ne
        exact hx₀_ne rfl
      have h_mem_B' : (α, z) ∈ B' := by
        rw [← hx₀_eq]
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx₀_mem).2 α
      exact hB'_fl (α, z) h_mem_B'
    · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => by
        split_ifs
        · exact hr_le_p0 i b
        · exact le_rfl))

  
  let M_ret : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, r i b
  have hM_ret_lb : M_low / 2 ≤ M_ret := by
    have h_Nδ : (N_tot : ℝ) * δ = M_low / 2 := by
      dsimp [δ]
      have hN_ne : (N_tot : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hN_tot_pos.ne'
      field_simp [hN_ne]
    linarith [hr0_mass, hr_mass_lb, h_Nδ]
  have hM_ret_pos : 0 < M_ret := lt_of_lt_of_le (half_pos hM_low_pos) hM_ret_lb
  have hM_ret_le_one : M_ret ≤ 1 := by
    calc M_ret ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, p0 i b :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => hr_le_p0 i b))
      _ = 1 := hp0_sum

  let π : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ := fun i b => r i b / M_ret
  have hπ_nn : ∀ i b, 0 ≤ π i b := fun i b => div_nonneg (hr_nn i b) hM_ret_pos.le
  have hM_mul_π : ∀ i b, M_ret * π i b = r i b :=
    fun i b => mul_div_cancel₀ (r i b) hM_ret_pos.ne'
  have hπ_sum : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, π i b) = 1 := by
    dsimp [π]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hM_ret_pos.ne'
  have hπ_supp_good : ∀ i b, 0 < r i b → Good i b ∧ 0 < p0 i b := by
    intro i b hr_pos
    have hr0_pos : 0 < r0 i b := lt_of_lt_of_le hr_pos (hr_le_r0 i b)
    have hG : Good i b := by
      by_contra hnot
      have h0 : r0 i b = 0 := if_neg hnot
      linarith
    exact ⟨hG, lt_of_lt_of_le hr0_pos (hr0_le i b)⟩

  refine ⟨M_ret, π, hM_ret_lb, hM_ret_le_one, hπ_nn, hπ_sum, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · intro i b hπ_pos
    have hr_pos : 0 < r i b := by
      have h1 : 0 < M_ret * π i b := mul_pos hM_ret_pos hπ_pos
      rwa [hM_mul_π i b] at h1
    obtain ⟨hG, hp0_pos⟩ := hπ_supp_good i b hr_pos
    exact ⟨hG.1, hp0_pos⟩
  
  · intro i b
    rw [hM_mul_π i b]
    exact hr_le_p0 i b
  
  · intro i b

      have h_prod_nn : 0 ≤ ∏ g : Fin k_grp, π_marg g :=
        Finset.prod_nonneg (fun g _ => hπ_marg_nn g)
      have h_total :
          rΘ_b * S_lhs ≤
          rΘ_b * (Real.exp v * δ ^ (-(k_grp : ℤ)) * ∏ g : Fin k_grp, π_marg g) := by
        calc rΘ_b * S_lhs
            ≤ Real.exp v * lam0 b * ∏ g : Fin k_grp, ξ0 g := h_joint_ub
          _ = Real.exp v * (lam0 b * ∏ g : Fin k_grp, ξ0 g) := mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ ≤ Real.exp v * (lam0 b *
                ((δ⁻¹ ^ k_grp) * ((rΘ_b / lam0 b) ^ k_grp) * ∏ g : Fin k_grp, π_marg g)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod_bound hlam0_pos.le)
                (Real.exp_pos v).le
          _ = (lam0 b * ((rΘ_b / lam0 b) ^ k_grp)) *
                (Real.exp v * (δ⁻¹ ^ k_grp) * ∏ g : Fin k_grp, π_marg g) := by ring
          _ ≤ rΘ_b * (Real.exp v * (δ⁻¹ ^ k_grp) * ∏ g : Fin k_grp, π_marg g) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pow_cancel (by positivity)
          _ = rΘ_b * (Real.exp v * δ ^ (-(k_grp : ℤ)) * ∏ g : Fin k_grp, π_marg g) := by
              rw [h_zpow_k]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_total hrΘ_pos
  
  · intro m_idx z
    dsimp only
    let idx_m : Fin N_tot := ⟨m_idx.1, by dsimp [N_tot]; omega⟩
    have hG_m : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ), G idx_m i b = F m_idx i b := by
      intro i b
      have h1 : idx_m.1 < N_obs := m_idx.2
      have hm_eq : (⟨idx_m.1, h1⟩ : Fin N_obs) = m_idx := by
        ext
        rfl
      dsimp [G]
      rw [dif_pos h1, hm_eq]
    have hr_rew :
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          @ite _ (F m_idx i b = z) (Classical.propDecidable _) (M_ret * π i b) 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if G idx_m i b = z then r i b else 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
      by_cases hc : F m_idx i b = z
      · have hc' : G idx_m i b = z := (hG_m i b).trans hc
        rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc', hM_mul_π i b]
      · have hc' : ¬ (G idx_m i b = z) := fun h => hc ((hG_m i b).symm.trans h)
        rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc']
    have hp0_rew :
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          @ite _ (F m_idx i b = z) (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0 i b) 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if G idx_m i b = z then p0 i b else 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
      by_cases hc : F m_idx i b = z
      · have hc' : G idx_m i b = z := (hG_m i b).trans hc
        rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc']
      · have hc' : ¬ (G idx_m i b = z) := fun h => hc ((hG_m i b).symm.trans h)
        rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc']
    rw [hr_rew, hp0_rew]
    exact hr_fib idx_m z

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m σ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (sys : MatchedAspectProfileSystem γ m)
    (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ ≤ 1 / 4) (hσ_κ : 4 * m * σ ≤ sys.κ)
    (i u h K η_err : ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hi : 0 < i) (hu : u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hK : max 2 (2 / m) ≤ K) (huKh : u + K * h < 1)
    (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hη : 0 < η_err) :
    let δ₀ : ℝ := min 1 m / (K * ((⌈4 / σ⌉₊ : ℝ) + 2))
    0 < δ₀ ∧ K * δ₀ ≤ 1 ∧
    ∃ (t₀ c_ret : ℝ),
      t₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 - K * δ₀) ∧ 0 < c_ret ∧
      ∃ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        ∃ E_norm : Finset (Fin (sys.N_ω k)),
          c_ret ≤ (∑ ω ∈ E_norm, sys.π_seq k ω) ∧
          ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M →
            ∀ ω ∈ E_norm, 0 < sys.π_seq k ω →
              letI := Classical.propDecidable
              let ε := sys.ε_seq k
              let u' := u + t₀ * h
              let h' := δ₀ * h
              let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
              let E_obs := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
                rowObs6 ε m (sys.V_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω')) (sys.A_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω'))
                  (sys.c_seq k ω') (sys.R_seq k ω')
                  (i, i + u', i + m * u', i + (1 + m) * u', u')
              let R_d := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
                dyadicRealBin ε (m * u' + d * h') (sys.R_seq k ω')
              (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
                if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω' = R_d ω then sys.π_seq k ω' else 0) ≤
              ε ^ (((5 / 4 : ℝ) * σ * d - η_err) * h') *
                (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then sys.π_seq k ω' else 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_ite_c : ∀ (p : Prop) {d₁ d₂ : Decidable p} (a b : ℝ),
      @ite ℝ p d₁ a b = @ite ℝ p d₂ a b :=
    fun _ {d₁ d₂} _ _ => Subsingleton.elim d₁ d₂ ▸ rfl

  
  have h_s2 : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ (v₁ v₂ c₁ c₂ : ℝ), v₁ ≤ v₂ →
        dyadicTimeBin ε v₂ c₁ = dyadicTimeBin ε v₂ c₂ →
        dyadicTimeBin ε v₁ c₁ = dyadicTimeBin ε v₁ c₂) ∧
      (∀ (L₁ L₂ x₁ x₂ : ℝ), L₁ ≤ L₂ →
        dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x₁ = dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x₂ →
        dyadicRealBin ε L₁ x₁ = dyadicRealBin ε L₁ x₂) ∧
      (∀ (L₁ L₂ Δ : ℝ), L₁ ≤ L₂ → L₂ - L₁ ≤ Δ →
        ∃ (N : ℕ) (lo : ℤ → ℤ),
          1 ≤ N ∧ (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-Δ) ∧
          ∀ x : ℝ,
            let q₁ := dyadicRealBin ε L₁ x
            let q₂ := dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x
            lo q₁ ≤ q₂ ∧ q₂ < lo q₁ + (N : ℤ)) ∧
      (∀ (m' i' u' : ℝ) (V₁ A₁ V₂ A₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c₁ R₁ c₂ R₂ : ℝ),
        V₁ = V₂ → A₁ = A₂ →
        dyadicTimeBin ε u' c₁ = dyadicTimeBin ε u' c₂ →
        dyadicRealBin ε (m' * u') R₁ = dyadicRealBin ε (m' * u') R₂ →
        rowObs6 ε m' V₁ A₁ c₁ R₁ (i', i' + u', i' + m' * u', i' + (1 + m') * u', u') =
        rowObs6 ε m' V₂ A₂ c₂ R₂ (i', i' + u', i' + m' * u', i' + (1 + m') * u', u')) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁
    have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have h_inv_gt1 : 1 < ε⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr (by linarith)
    have hell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := Real.log_pos h_inv_gt1
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    have hell2_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2 := div_pos hell_pos hlog2_pos
    have h_real_div : ∀ (L₁ L₂ : ℝ), L₁ ≤ L₂ →
        let m₁ := dyadicRealLevel ε L₁
        let m₂ := dyadicRealLevel ε L₂
        let d_r : ℕ := (m₂ - m₁).toNat
        m₁ ≤ m₂ ∧ m₂ = m₁ + (d_r : ℤ) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, dyadicRealBin ε L₁ x = dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x / ((2 ^ d_r : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      intro L₁ L₂ hL
      dsimp only
      set m₁ := dyadicRealLevel ε L₁
      set m₂ := dyadicRealLevel ε L₂
      have hm_le : m₁ ≤ m₂ :=
        Int.floor_mono (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL hell2_pos.le)
      set d_r : ℕ := (m₂ - m₁).toNat
      have hdr_eq : (d_r : ℤ) = m₂ - m₁ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hm_le)
      have hm₂_eq : m₂ = m₁ + (d_r : ℤ) := by omega
      refine ⟨hm_le, hm₂_eq, fun x => ?_⟩
      unfold dyadicRealBin
      change ⌊x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁⌋ = ⌊x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂⌋ / ((2 ^ d_r : ℕ) : ℤ)
      have h_pow : x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ = (x * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂) / ((2 ^ d_r : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [hm₂_eq, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_natCast]
        have h2pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 ^ d_r : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
        push_cast
        field_simp [h2pos.ne']
      rw [h_pow, Int.floor_div_natCast]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v₁ v₂ c₁ c₂ hv h_eq
      have hrpow : ε ^ (-v₁) ≤ ε ^ (-v₂) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (neg_le_neg hv)
      have hm_le : dyadicTimeLevel ε v₁ ≤ dyadicTimeLevel ε v₂ :=
        Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (Nat.ceil_mono hrpow)
      set m₁ := dyadicTimeLevel ε v₁
      set m₂ := dyadicTimeLevel ε v₂
      set d_t : ℕ := m₂ - m₁
      have hm₂_eq : m₂ = m₁ + d_t := (Nat.add_sub_of_le hm_le).symm
      have h_div_c : ∀ c : ℝ,
          dyadicTimeBin ε v₁ c = dyadicTimeBin ε v₂ c / ((2 ^ d_t : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        intro c
        unfold dyadicTimeBin
        change min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁⌋ ((2 ^ m₁ : ℤ) - 1) =
          min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂⌋ ((2 ^ m₂ : ℤ) - 1) / ((2 ^ d_t : ℕ) : ℤ)
        by_cases hc : c < 1
        · have h_min : ∀ m' : ℕ,
              min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m'⌋ ((2 ^ m' : ℤ) - 1) = ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m'⌋ := by
            intro m'
            refine min_eq_left ?_
            have h_lt : ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m'⌋ < (2 ^ m' : ℤ) := by
              rw [Int.floor_lt]
              have h2m : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m' := by positivity
              calc c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m' < 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc h2m
                _ = ((2 ^ m' : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
            omega
          rw [h_min m₁, h_min m₂]
          have h_pow : c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ = (c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂) / ((2 ^ d_t : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            rw [hm₂_eq, pow_add]
            have h2pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ d_t := by positivity
            push_cast
            field_simp [h2pos.ne']
          rw [h_pow, Int.floor_div_natCast]
        · have hc1 : 1 ≤ c := le_of_not_gt hc
          have h_min : ∀ m' : ℕ,
              min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m'⌋ ((2 ^ m' : ℤ) - 1) = (2 ^ m' : ℤ) - 1 := by
            intro m'
            refine min_eq_right ?_
            have h_le : (2 ^ m' : ℤ) ≤ ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m'⌋ := by
              rw [Int.le_floor]
              have h2m : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m' := by positivity
              calc ((2 ^ m' : ℤ) : ℝ) = 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m' := by push_cast; ring
                _ ≤ c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1 h2m
            omega
          rw [h_min m₁, h_min m₂]
          set D : ℤ := ((2 ^ d_t : ℕ) : ℤ)
          have hD_pos : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
          have hD_ge1 : 1 ≤ D := hD_pos
          have h2m2 : (2 ^ m₂ : ℤ) = (2 ^ m₁ : ℤ) * D := by dsimp [D]; rw [hm₂_eq, pow_add]
          refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
          · rw [Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le hD_pos]
            linarith
          · have h_lt : ((2 ^ m₂ : ℤ) - 1) / D < (2 ^ m₁ : ℤ) :=
              Int.ediv_lt_of_lt_mul hD_pos (by linarith)
            omega
      rw [h_div_c c₁, h_div_c c₂, h_eq]
    · intro L₁ L₂ x₁ x₂ hL h_eq
      obtain ⟨_, _, h_div⟩ := h_real_div L₁ L₂ hL
      rw [h_div x₁, h_div x₂, h_eq]
    · intro L₁ L₂ Δ hL hΔ
      obtain ⟨hm_le, hm₂_eq, h_div⟩ := h_real_div L₁ L₂ hL
      set m₁ := dyadicRealLevel ε L₁
      set m₂ := dyadicRealLevel ε L₂
      set d_r : ℕ := (m₂ - m₁).toNat
      let N : ℕ := 2 ^ d_r
      have hN_ge1 : 1 ≤ N := Nat.one_le_pow d_r 2 (by omega)
      have hN_bound : (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-Δ) := by
        set ell₂ := Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2
        have hm₂_ub : (m₂ : ℝ) ≤ L₂ * ell₂ := Int.floor_le _
        have hm₁_lb : L₁ * ell₂ - 1 < (m₁ : ℝ) := Int.sub_one_lt_floor _
        have hdr_cast : (d_r : ℝ) = (m₂ : ℝ) - (m₁ : ℝ) := by
          have h_z : (d_r : ℤ) = m₂ - m₁ := by omega
          exact_mod_cast h_z
        have hdr_le : (d_r : ℝ) ≤ Δ * ell₂ + 1 := by
          have h_diff : (L₂ - L₁) * ell₂ ≤ Δ * ell₂ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hΔ hell2_pos.le
          linarith
        have hN_rpow : (N : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (d_r : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [N]; rw [Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_cast
        have h_exp_eq : (2 : ℝ) ^ (Δ * ell₂) = ε ^ (-Δ) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),
            Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀]
          congr 1
          dsimp [ell₂]
          rw [Real.log_inv]
          field_simp [hlog2_pos.ne']
        calc (N : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (d_r : ℝ) := hN_rpow
          _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (Δ * ell₂ + 1) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hdr_le
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (Δ * ell₂) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
              Real.rpow_add (by norm_num) _ _
          _ = 2 * ε ^ (-Δ) := by rw [h_exp_eq, Real.rpow_one]; ring
      refine ⟨N, fun q => (N : ℤ) * q, hN_ge1, hN_bound, fun x => ?_⟩
      dsimp only
      have hq₁ := h_div x
      change (N : ℤ) * dyadicRealBin ε L₁ x ≤ dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x ∧
        dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x < (N : ℤ) * dyadicRealBin ε L₁ x + (N : ℤ)
      have hN_int_pos : 0 < (N : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hN_ge1
      have h_ediv := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod (dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x) (N : ℤ)
      have h_mod_nn := Int.emod_nonneg (dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x) hN_int_pos.ne'
      have h_mod_lt := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x) hN_int_pos
      change dyadicRealBin ε L₁ x = dyadicRealBin ε L₂ x / (N : ℤ) at hq₁
      rw [hq₁]
      omega
    · intro m' i' u' V₁ A₁ V₂ A₂ c₁ R₁ c₂ R₂ hV hA hc hR
      unfold rowObs6 dyadicTimeMid dyadicRealMid
      dsimp only
      rw [hV, hA, hc, hR]

  
  have h_s3 : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_Y : Type} (P : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (A : Fin N_ω → α) (B : Fin N_ω → β) (Y : Fin N_ω → γ_Y),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ P ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, P ω = 1) →
        (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < P ω₁ → 0 < P ω₂ → B ω₁ = B ω₂ → A ω₁ = A ω₂) →
        finCondEntropy ε P B Y ≤ finCondEntropy ε P A Y) ∧
      (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α : Type} (P : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (C : Fin N_ω → α) (Z₁ Z₂ : Fin N_ω → ℤ),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ P ω) →
        (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < P ω₁ → 0 < P ω₂ → Z₂ ω₁ = Z₂ ω₂ → Z₁ ω₁ = Z₁ ω₂) →
        finCondEntropy ε P C Z₂ =
          finCondEntropy ε P C Z₁ +
            finCondEntropy ε P (fun ω => (C ω, Z₁ ω)) Z₂) ∧
      (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (P R : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (E : Finset (Fin N_ω))
        (K_dom w b_up : ℝ) (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ P ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, P ω = 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ R ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, R ω = 1) →
        1 ≤ K_dom →
        (∀ ω, 0 < R ω → ω ∈ E ∧ 0 < P ω) →
        (∀ ω, R ω ≤ K_dom * P ω) →
        ((∀ ω ∈ E, w ≤ condSurprise ε P X Y ω) →
          w - Real.log K_dom / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ finCondEntropy ε R X Y) ∧
        ((∀ ω ∈ E, condSurprise ε P X Y ω ≤ b_up) →
          finCondEntropy ε R X Y ≤ b_up)) ∧
      (∀ {N_ω q : ℕ} {α : Type} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (Δ a : ℝ) (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (ha : 0 < a)
        (P : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (X : Fin q → Fin N_ω → α)
        (Y : Fin q → Fin N_ω → ℤ)
        (lo : Fin q → α → ℤ)
        (N : Fin q → ℕ),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ P ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, P ω = 1) →
        (∀ j : Fin q, 1 ≤ N j ∧ (N j : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-Δ) ∧
          ∀ ω, 0 < P ω → lo j (X j ω) ≤ Y j ω ∧ Y j ω < lo j (X j ω) + (N j : ℤ)) →
        let B_bin : ℕ := ⌊(5 / 2 : ℝ) * Δ / a⌋₊ + 1
        let J : ℕ := B_bin ^ q
        ∃ (E : Fin J → Finset (Fin N_ω)) (w : Fin J → Fin q → ℝ),
          (∀ z₁ z₂ : Fin J, z₁ ≠ z₂ → Disjoint (E z₁) (E z₂)) ∧
          (∀ (z : Fin J) (ω : Fin N_ω), ω ∈ E z → 0 < P ω) ∧

        H_R (q₀ + r_idx) - H_R q₀ := by
      have hm_le : m * v q₀ ≤ m * v (q₀ + r_idx) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv_mono q₀ (q₀ + r_idx) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) hm.le
      have h_add := (h_s3 ε hε0 hε1).2.1 R_law (fun ω => (sys.T_seq k ω, C_k q₀ ω))
        (Z_k q₀) (Z_k (q₀ + r_idx)) hR_nn
        (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ h_eq => (h_s2 ε hε0 hε1).2.1 _ _ _ _ hm_le h_eq)
      dsimp [H_R]
      linarith
    have h_tel_sum : ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico q₀ (q₀ + r_idx), (H_R (r + 1) - H_R r) =
        H_R (q₀ + r_idx) - H_R q₀ :=
      Finset.sum_Ico_sub H_R (Nat.le_add_right q₀ r_idx)
    have h_step_lb : ∀ r ∈ Finset.Ico q₀ (q₀ + r_idx),
        w_seq k z₀ r - Real.log K_dom / ell ≤ H_R (r + 1) - H_R r := by
      intro r hr_mem
      obtain ⟨hq₀_le_r, hr_lt_end⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hr_mem
      have hr_lt_Q : r < Q := by omega
      have hm_le_r : m * v r ≤ m * v (r + 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv_mono r (r + 1) (Nat.le_succ r)) hm.le
      have h_add_r : H_R (r + 1) - H_R r = finCondEntropy ε R_law
          (fun ω => ((sys.T_seq k ω, C_k q₀ ω), Z_k r ω)) (Z_k (r + 1)) := by
        have h_a := (h_s3 ε hε0 hε1).2.1 R_law (fun ω => (sys.T_seq k ω, C_k q₀ ω))
          (Z_k r) (Z_k (r + 1)) hR_nn
          (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ h_eq => (h_s2 ε hε0 hε1).2.1 _ _ _ _ hm_le_r h_eq)
        dsimp [H_R]; linarith
      have h_mono_r : finCondEntropy ε R_law (X₁ k ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩) (Y₁ k ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩) ≤
          finCondEntropy ε R_law
            (fun ω => ((sys.T_seq k ω, C_k q₀ ω), Z_k r ω)) (Z_k (r + 1)) := by
        refine (h_s3 ε hε0 hε1).1 R_law
          (fun ω => ((sys.T_seq k ω, C_k q₀ ω), Z_k r ω))
          (X₁ k ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩) (Z_k (r + 1)) hR_nn hR_sum (fun ω₁ ω₂ _ _ hB => ?_)
        have hT : sys.T_seq k ω₁ = sys.T_seq k ω₂ := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp hB).1).1
        have hCr : C_k r ω₁ = C_k r ω₂ := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp hB).1).2
        have hZr : Z_k r ω₁ = Z_k r ω₂ := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hB).2
        have hCq₀ : C_k q₀ ω₁ = C_k q₀ ω₂ :=
          (h_s2 ε hε0 hε1).1 (v q₀) (v r) _ _ (hv_mono q₀ r hq₀_le_r) hCr
        exact Prod.ext (Prod.ext hT hCq₀) hZr
      have h_dom_r : w_seq k z₀ r - Real.log K_dom / ell ≤
          finCondEntropy ε R_law (X₁ k ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩) (Y₁ k ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩) := by
        dsimp [w_seq]
        rw [dif_pos hr_lt_Q]
        exact ((h_s3 ε hε0 hε1).2.2.1 (sys.π_seq k) R_law (E₁ k z₀) K_dom
          (w₁_fin k z₀ ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩) 0 (X₁ k ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩) (Y₁ k ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩)
          hπ_nn hπ_sum hR_nn hR_sum hK_dom_ge1 hR_supp_E₁ hR_dom_K).1
          (fun ω hω => (hw₁_cell z₀ ⟨r, hr_lt_Q⟩ ω hω).1)
      linarith
    have h_sum_lb : (∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico q₀ (q₀ + r_idx), w_seq k z₀ r) -
        (r_idx : ℝ) * (Real.log K_dom / ell) ≤ H_R (q₀ + r_idx) - H_R q₀ := by
      have h_le := Finset.sum_le_sum h_step_lb
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, nsmul_eq_mul, h_tel_sum] at h_le
      exact h_le
    have h_rs_r := h_prefix_lb r_idx hr1 hrM
    have h_r_tau_eq : (r_idx : ℝ) * τ = d_j * h' := by
      dsimp [d_j, r_idx, τ]; field_simp [hM_pos.ne']
    have ha₂_le : a₂ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * σ * d_j * h' := by
      have hr1_real : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (r_idx : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hr1
      calc a₂ = (1 / 8 : ℝ) * σ * (1 * τ) := by dsimp [a₂]; ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * σ * ((r_idx : ℝ) * τ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr1_real hτ_pos.le)
              (by positivity)
        _ = (1 / 8 : ℝ) * σ * d_j * h' := by rw [h_r_tau_eq]; ring
    have h_pen_le : (r_idx : ℝ) * (Real.log K_dom / ell) ≤ (M : ℝ) * Real.log K_dom / ell := by
      have hrM_real : (r_idx : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hrM
      have hlogK_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log K_dom := Real.log_nonneg hK_dom_ge1
      calc (r_idx : ℝ) * (Real.log K_dom / ell)
          ≤ (M : ℝ) * (Real.log K_dom / ell) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrM_real (div_nonneg hlogK_nn hell_pos.le)
        _ = (M : ℝ) * Real.log K_dom / ell := (mul_div_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have h_rs_dh : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * σ * d_j * h' ≤
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico q₀ (q₀ + r_idx), w_seq k z₀ r := by
      have h_id : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * σ * (r_idx : ℝ) * τ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) * σ * d_j * h' := by
        rw [mul_assoc ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * σ), h_r_tau_eq]; ring
      linarith
    linarith

  
  let goodBase : Fin (sys.N_ω k) → Prop := fun ω =>
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω ≤
      ∑ ω' ∈ E₂ w₀, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then P₀ ω' else 0
  let _ : DecidablePred goodBase := Classical.decPred _
  let _ : ∀ ω : Fin (sys.N_ω k), Decidable ¬goodBase ω := fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _
  let E_norm : Finset (Fin (sys.N_ω k)) := (E₂ w₀).filter goodBase
  let E_bad : Finset (Fin (sys.N_ω k)) := (E₂ w₀).filter (fun ω => ¬goodBase ω)

  have hE_bad_mass : (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, P₀ ω) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 := by
    have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ E_bad, E_obs ω ∈ E_bad.image E_obs :=
      fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem E_obs hω
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps]
    have h_fib_le : ∀ e ∈ E_bad.image E_obs,
        (∑ ω ∈ E_bad.filter (fun ω => E_obs ω = e), P₀ ω) ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 * (∑ ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k), if E_obs ω' = e then P₀ ω' else 0) := by
      intro e he
      obtain ⟨ω_e, hω_e, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
      obtain ⟨_, h_not_good⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_e
      have h_lt : (∑ ω' ∈ E₂ w₀, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω_e then P₀ ω' else 0) <
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω_e := lt_of_not_ge h_not_good
      have h_sub_sum : (∑ ω ∈ E_bad.filter (fun ω => E_obs ω = E_obs ω_e), P₀ ω) ≤
          ∑ ω' ∈ E₂ w₀, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω_e then P₀ ω' else 0 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun ω hω => ?_) (fun ω _ _ => hP₀_nn ω)
        obtain ⟨hω_bad, h_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_bad).1, h_eq⟩
      have hp_eq : finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω_e =
          ∑ ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k), if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω_e then P₀ ω' else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => h_ite_c _ _ _
      rw [← hp_eq]
      exact le_trans h_sub_sum h_lt.le
    calc ∑ e ∈ E_bad.image E_obs, ∑ ω ∈ E_bad.filter (fun ω => E_obs ω = e), P₀ ω
        ≤ ∑ e ∈ E_bad.image E_obs,
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 *
              (∑ ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k), if E_obs ω' = e then P₀ ω' else 0) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib_le
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 *
            (∑ e ∈ E_bad.image E_obs,
              ∑ ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k), if E_obs ω' = e then P₀ ω' else 0) :=
          (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 * (∑ ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k), P₀ ω') := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω' _ => ?_
          by_cases hx : E_obs ω' ∈ E_bad.image E_obs
          · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (E_obs ω')
              (fun e _ hne => ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => absurd h.symm hne)
              (fun habs => absurd hx habs), ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h => absurd rfl h]
          · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun e hmem => ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun (heq : E_obs ω' = e) =>
              False.elim (hx (heq ▸ hmem)))]
            exact hP₀_nn ω'
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 := by rw [hP₀_sum, mul_one]

  have hE_norm_P₀ : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_norm, P₀ ω := by
    have h_split := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (E₂ w₀) goodBase P₀
    change (∑ ω ∈ E_norm, P₀ ω) + (∑ ω ∈ E_bad, P₀ ω) = m'_w0 at h_split

  have hE_norm_sub_E₁ : ∀ ω ∈ E_norm, ω ∈ E₁ k z₀ := by

  have hE_norm_mass : c_ret ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_norm, sys.π_seq k ω := by
    have h_eq : (∑ ω ∈ E_norm, sys.π_seq k ω) = m_cell k z₀ * (∑ ω ∈ E_norm, P₀ ω) := by

      calc (1 / (4 * (J₂ : ℝ))) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * (J₂ : ℝ))) := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm'_w0_lb (by norm_num)
        _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_norm, P₀ ω := hE_norm_P₀
    calc c_ret = c₁ * (1 / (4 * (J₂ : ℝ))) := by dsimp [c_ret]; ring
      _ ≤ m_cell k z₀ * (∑ ω ∈ E_norm, P₀ ω) :=
          mul_le_mul hm_z0_lb h1 (by positivity) hm_z0_pos.le

  refine ⟨E_norm, hE_norm_mass, fun r_idx hr1 hrM ω hω_norm _ => ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  let d : ℝ := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
  let R_d : Fin (sys.N_ω k) → ℤ := fun ω' => dyadicRealBin ε (m * u' + d * h') (sys.R_seq k ω')
  let j : Fin M := ⟨r_idx - 1, by omega⟩
  have hj_succ : j.1 + 1 = r_idx := by dsimp [j]; omega
  have hR_d_eq : R_stg2 j = R_d := by
    ext ω'; dsimp [R_stg2, R_d, d]; rw [hj_succ]

  obtain ⟨hω_E₂, hω_good⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_norm
  have hP₀_ω : 0 < P₀ ω := hE₂_pos w₀ ω hω_E₂

  
  have h_p2_ub : finProbAt2 P₀ E_obs R_d ω ≤ ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω := by
    have hw_ω := (hw₂_cell w₀ j ω hω_E₂).1
    rw [hR_d_eq] at hw_ω
    have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω := by
      unfold finProbAt
      let _ := Classical.propDecidable
      have h_m : P₀ ω = (if E_obs ω = E_obs ω then P₀ ω else 0) := by simp
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hP₀_ω ?_
      rw [h_m]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ω' => if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then P₀ ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hP₀_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
        (Finset.mem_univ ω)
    have hp2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 P₀ E_obs R_d ω := by
      unfold finProbAt2
      let _ := Classical.propDecidable
      have h_m : P₀ ω = (if E_obs ω = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω = R_d ω then P₀ ω else 0) := by simp
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hP₀_ω ?_
      rw [h_m]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun ω' => if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω' = R_d ω then P₀ ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hP₀_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
        (Finset.mem_univ ω)
    set p_c := finProbAt2 P₀ E_obs R_d ω / finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω
    have hpc_pos : 0 < p_c := div_pos hp2_pos hp1_pos
    have h_log_le : Real.log p_c ≤ Real.log ε * w₂ w₀ j := by
      change w₂ w₀ j ≤ -(Real.log p_c) / ell at hw_ω
      have h_mul := (le_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hw_ω
      have h_ell_eq : ell = -Real.log ε := by rw [hell_def, Real.log_inv]
      rw [h_ell_eq] at h_mul
      linarith
    have hpc_le : p_c ≤ ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) := by
      calc p_c = Real.exp (Real.log p_c) := (Real.exp_log hpc_pos).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log ε * w₂ w₀ j) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_log_le
        _ = ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) := (Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε0 _).symm
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hp1_pos).mp hpc_le

  
  have h_num_le : (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
      @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω' = R_d ω) (Classical.propDecidable _)
        (sys.π_seq k ω') 0) ≤
      ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) * (m_cell k z₀ * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω) := by
    have h_le1 : (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
        @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω' = R_d ω) (Classical.propDecidable _)
          (sys.π_seq k ω') 0) =
        m_cell k z₀ * (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
          @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω' = R_d ω) (Classical.propDecidable _)
            (P₀ ω') 0) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω' hω' => ?_
      let _ := Classical.propDecidable
      split_ifs
      · exact hπ_eq_P₀ ω' (hE_norm_sub_E₁ ω' hω')
      · ring
    have h_le2 : (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,

      unfold finProbAt2
      let _ := Classical.propDecidable

    calc (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
          @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω' = R_d ω) (Classical.propDecidable _)
            (sys.π_seq k ω') 0)

          rw [h_le1]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le2 hm_z0_pos.le
      _ ≤ m_cell k z₀ * (ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_p2_ub hm_z0_pos.le
      _ = ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) * (m_cell k z₀ * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω) := by ring

  
  have h_den_lb : m_cell k z₀ * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω ≤
      4 * (J₂ : ℝ) * (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
        @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (sys.π_seq k ω') 0) := by
    have h_fib_inv : ∀ ω' ∈ E₂ w₀, E_obs ω' = E_obs ω → ω' ∈ E_norm := by
      intro ω' hω'_E₂ h_eq
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω'_E₂, ?_⟩
      dsimp [goodBase] at hω_good ⊢
      have hp_eq : finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω' = finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω := by
        unfold finProbAt
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω'' _ => ?_
        rw [h_eq]
      have hs_eq : (∑ ω'' ∈ E₂ w₀, if E_obs ω'' = E_obs ω' then P₀ ω'' else 0) =
          ∑ ω'' ∈ E₂ w₀, if E_obs ω'' = E_obs ω then P₀ ω'' else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω'' _ => ?_
        rw [h_eq]
      rw [hp_eq, hs_eq]
      exact hω_good
    have h_den_eq : (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
        @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (sys.π_seq k ω') 0) =
        m_cell k z₀ * (∑ ω' ∈ E₂ w₀, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then P₀ ω' else 0) := by
      have h_stepA : (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
          @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (sys.π_seq k ω') 0) =
          m_cell k z₀ * (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then P₀ ω' else 0) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω' hω' => ?_
        rw [@h_ite_c (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) inferInstance
          (sys.π_seq k ω') 0]
        split_ifs
        · exact hπ_eq_P₀ ω' (hE_norm_sub_E₁ ω' hω')
        · ring
      have h_stepB : (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then P₀ ω' else 0) =
          ∑ ω' ∈ E₂ w₀, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then P₀ ω' else 0 := by
        dsimp [E_norm]
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω' hω'_E₂ => ?_
        by_cases h_eq : E_obs ω' = E_obs ω
        · have hg : goodBase ω' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (h_fib_inv ω' hω'_E₂ h_eq)).2
          rw [ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h_no => absurd hg h_no]
        · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun _ => ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h_yes => absurd h_yes h_eq,
            ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h_yes => absurd h_yes h_eq]
      rw [h_stepA, h_stepB]
    rw [h_den_eq]
    have h_good_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hω_good hm_z0_pos.le
    have h_p0_nn : 0 ≤ finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω := by
      unfold finProbAt
      let _ := Classical.propDecidable
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hP₀_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]
    have h_4J2_m : 1 ≤ 4 * (J₂ : ℝ) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0) := by
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm'_w0_lb (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * (J₂ : ℝ))
      rw [mul_one_div_cancel (by positivity : (2 * (J₂ : ℝ)) ≠ 0)] at h_mul
      linarith
    calc m_cell k z₀ * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω
        ≤ (4 * (J₂ : ℝ) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0)) * (m_cell k z₀ * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω) :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_left (mul_nonneg hm_z0_pos.le h_p0_nn) h_4J2_m
      _ = 4 * (J₂ : ℝ) * (m_cell k z₀ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m'_w0 * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω)) := by ring
      _ ≤ 4 * (J₂ : ℝ) * (m_cell k z₀ *
            (∑ ω' ∈ E₂ w₀, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then P₀ ω' else 0)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_good_mul (by positivity)

  
  have h_4J2_rpow : 4 * (J₂ : ℝ) * ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) ≤
      ε ^ (((5 / 4 : ℝ) * σ * d - η_err) * h') := by
    have h_4J2_eq : 4 * (J₂ : ℝ) = ε ^ (-(Real.log (4 * (J₂ : ℝ)) / ell)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε0]
      have h_ell_eq : ell = -Real.log ε := by rw [hell_def, Real.log_inv]
      have h_exp_arg : Real.log ε * -(Real.log (4 * (J₂ : ℝ)) / ell) =
          Real.log (4 * (J₂ : ℝ)) := by
        rw [h_ell_eq]
        have hlog_ne : Real.log ε ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0; rw [h0] at h_ell_eq; linarith
        field_simp [hlog_ne]
      rw [h_exp_arg, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
    rw [h_4J2_eq, ← Real.rpow_add hε0]
    refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε0 (by linarith) ?_
    have hw_j := hw₂_lb j
    have h_dj_eq : (((j.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) = d := by dsimp [d]; rw [hj_succ]
    dsimp only at hw_j
    rw [h_dj_eq] at hw_j
    have hd_nn : 0 ≤ d := by dsimp [d]; positivity
    have h_slack : 0 ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * σ * d * h' := by positivity
    have h_pen_split : (M : ℝ) * Real.log K_dom / ell + Real.log (4 * (J₂ : ℝ)) / ell =
        ((M : ℝ) * Real.log K_dom + Real.log (4 * (J₂ : ℝ))) / ell := (add_div _ _ _).symm
    linarith [hw_j, h_s2_pen_k, h_slack, h_pen_split]

  have h_den_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
      @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (sys.π_seq k ω') 0 := by
    let _ := Classical.propDecidable
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hπ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]

  calc (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
        @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω' = R_d ω) (Classical.propDecidable _)
          (sys.π_seq k ω') 0)
      ≤ ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) * (m_cell k z₀ * finProbAt P₀ E_obs ω) := h_num_le
    _ ≤ ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j) * (4 * (J₂ : ℝ) * (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
          @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (sys.π_seq k ω') 0)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_den_lb (Real.rpow_nonneg hε0.le _)
    _ = (4 * (J₂ : ℝ) * ε ^ (w₂ w₀ j)) * (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
          @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (sys.π_seq k ω') 0) := by ring
    _ ≤ ε ^ (((5 / 4 : ℝ) * σ * d - η_err) * h') * (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
          @ite ℝ (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (sys.π_seq k ω') 0) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_4J2_rpow h_den_nn

(γ m s σ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (sys : MatchedAspectProfileSystem γ m)
    (hs₀ : 0 < s) (hs₁ : s ≤ 1) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ ≤ 1 / 4)
    (i u' h' K D_pt c_ret η_aff η_stage L_min : ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hi : 0 < i) (hu' : u' ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hh' : 0 < h')
    (hK : K = max 2 (2 / m)) (hu'Kh' : u' + K * h' < 1)
    (hc_ret : 0 < c_ret) (hM : 2 ≤ M)
    (hη_stage : 0 < η_stage) (hη_stage_le : η_stage ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hη_aff_pos : 0 < η_aff) (hη_aff : 32 * η_aff ≤ η_stage)
    (hL_min : 1 ≤ L_min)
    (hS_inc : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ K →
      |(sys.S (u' + b * h') - sys.S (u' + a * h')) / h' - s * (b - a)| ≤ η_aff)
    (h_freq_norm : ∃ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      ∃ E_norm : Finset (Fin (sys.N_ω k)),
        c_ret ≤ (∑ ω ∈ E_norm, sys.π_seq k ω) ∧
        ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M →
          ∀ ω ∈ E_norm, 0 < sys.π_seq k ω →
            letI := Classical.propDecidable
            let ε := sys.ε_seq k
            let d := (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)
            let E_obs := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
              rowObs6 ε m (sys.V_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω')) (sys.A_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω'))
                (sys.c_seq k ω') (sys.R_seq k ω')
                (i, i + u', i + m * u', i + (1 + m) * u', u')
            let R_d := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
              dyadicRealBin ε (m * u' + d * h') (sys.R_seq k ω')
            (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm,
              if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ R_d ω' = R_d ω then sys.π_seq k ω' else 0) ≤
            ε ^ (((5 / 4 : ℝ) * σ * d - η_aff) * h') *
              (∑ ω' ∈ E_norm, if E_obs ω' = E_obs ω then sys.π_seq k ω' else 0)) :
    (m ≠ 1 → ∀ a_pt : Fin 4 → ℝ,
      (∀ j, 0 ≤ a_pt j ∧ a_pt j ≤ 1) →
      (∀ ζ : (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ,
        InDispCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 ζ →
        (∀ j, |ζ.1 j| ≤ K + 2) → |ζ.2| ≤ K + 2 →
        |(sys.f_raw (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u') + h' • ζ) -
          sys.f_raw (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u'))) / h' -
          ((∑ j : Fin 4, a_pt j * ζ.1 j) + D_pt * ζ.2)| ≤ η_aff) →
      Nonempty (PreCoreDistinctStage s σ a_pt M η_stage L_min)) ∧
    (m = 1 → ∀ a_pt : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (0 ≤ a_pt 0 ∧ a_pt 0 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 1 ∧ a_pt 1 ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ a_pt 2 ∧ a_pt 2 ≤ 1) →
      (let f3 := fun p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ => sys.f_raw (![p.1 0, p.1 1, p.1 1, p.1 2], p.2)
       ∀ ζ : (Fin 3 → ℝ) × ℝ,
        InDispCone 3 ![0, 1, 2] (fun j k => j < k) ζ →
        (∀ j, |ζ.1 j| ≤ K + 2) → |ζ.2| ≤ K + 2 →
        |(f3 (planeEmbed 3 ![0, 1, 2] (i, u') + h' • ζ) -
          f3 (planeEmbed 3 ![0, 1, 2] (i, u'))) / h' -
          ((∑ j : Fin 3, a_pt j * ζ.1 j) + D_pt * ζ.2)| ≤ η_aff) →
      Nonempty (PreCoreTiedStage s σ a_pt M η_stage L_min))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hu'0 : 0 < u' := hu'.1
  have hu'1 : u' < 1 := hu'.2
  have hK_ge2 : 2 ≤ K := by
    rw [hK]
    exact le_max_left 2 (2 / m)
  have hmK_ge2 : 2 ≤ m * K := by
    have h1 : 2 / m ≤ K := by
      rw [hK]
      exact le_max_right 2 (2 / m)
    have h2 := (div_le_iff₀ hm).mp h1
    linarith
  have hK_pos : 0 < K := by linarith
  let v₁ : ℝ := u' + K * h'
  have hv₁_mem : v₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by nlinarith, hu'Kh'⟩
  have hM_pos_nat : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hM
  have hM_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (M : ℝ) := by positivity
  let c4 : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![0, 1, m, 1 + m]
  let p_base : (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ := planeEmbed 4 c4 (i, u')
  have h_cone_edge_pos : ∀ j k : Fin 4, E_cone4 j k → 0 ≤ c4 k - c4 j := by
    intro j k hjk
    rcases hjk with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
      simp [c4] <;> linarith
  have h_cone_base : InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 p_base := by
    refine ⟨hu', fun j k _ => ?_⟩
    simp [p_base, planeEmbed]
    linarith
  have h_disp_pre :
      InDispCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (fun _ => 1, 0) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 4, |(fun _ : Fin 4 => (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)).1 j| ≤ K + 2) ∧
      |(fun _ : Fin 4 => (1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)).2| ≤ K + 2 := by
    refine ⟨fun j k _ => by simp, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [abs_one]
      linarith
    · simp only [abs_zero]
      linarith
  have h_disp_unit : ∀ (t : Fin 4 → ℝ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ t j ∧ t j ≤ 1) →
      InDispCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (t, K) ∧
      (∀ j, |(t, K).1 j| ≤ K + 2) ∧
      |(t, K).2| ≤ K + 2 := by
    intro t ht
    refine ⟨fun j k hjk => ?_, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_diff : t k - t j ≤ 1 := by linarith [(ht k).2, (ht j).1]
      rcases hjk with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · simp [c4]; linarith
      · simp [c4]; linarith
      · have h31 : c4 3 - c4 1 = m := by simp [c4]
        change t 3 - t 1 ≤ (c4 3 - c4 1) * K
        rw [h31]; linarith
      · have h32 : c4 3 - c4 2 = 1 := by simp [c4]
        change t 3 - t 2 ≤ (c4 3 - c4 2) * K
        rw [h32]; linarith
    · exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(ht j).1], by linarith [(ht j).2]⟩
    · dsimp only
      rw [abs_of_pos hK_pos]
      linarith
  have h_cone_add_disp : ∀ ζ : (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ,
      InDispCone 4 c4 E_cone4 ζ →
      u' + h' * ζ.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (p_base + h' • ζ) := by
    intro ζ hζ hv
    refine ⟨by simpa [p_base, planeEmbed, smul_eq_mul] using hv, fun j k hjk => ?_⟩
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hζ j k hjk) hh'.le
    dsimp [p_base, planeEmbed]
    linarith
  have h_cone_time : ∀ d ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      InResolutionCone 4 c4 E_cone4 (p_base.1, u' + d * h') := by
    intro d hd
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := hd.1
    have hd1 : d ≤ 1 := hd.2
    refine ⟨⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith [hu'Kh', hK_ge2]⟩, fun j k hjk => ?_⟩
    have hc_nn := h_cone_edge_pos j k hjk
    have h_mul : 0 ≤ (c4 k - c4 j) * (d * h') := mul_nonneg hc_nn (mul_nonneg hd0 hh'.le)
    dsimp [p_base, planeEmbed]
    linarith
  have h_S_diff : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ 1 →
      |(sys.S (u' + b * h') - sys.S (u' + a * h')) - s * (b - a) * h'| ≤ η_aff * h' := by
    intro a b ha hab hb1
    have hbK : b ≤ K := by linarith
    have h1 := hS_inc a b ha hab hbK
    have h_eq : (sys.S (u' + b * h') - sys.S (u' + a * h')) - s * (b - a) * h' =
        ((sys.S (u' + b * h') - sys.S (u' + a * h')) / h' - s * (b - a)) * h' := by
      field_simp [hh'.ne']
    rw [h_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hh']
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hh'.le

  have h_prob_pos : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type} (w : Fin N → ℝ) (X : Fin N → α) (ω : Fin N),
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ w ω') → 0 < w ω → 0 < finProbAt w X ω := by
    intro N α w X ω hw_nn hω_pos
    unfold finProbAt
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos ?_
    have h_eq : w ω = (if X ω = X ω then w ω else 0) := (if_pos rfl).symm
    rw [h_eq]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun ω' => if X ω' = X ω then w ω' else 0)
      (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hw_nn ω'; exact le_rfl)
      (Finset.mem_univ ω)
  have h_prob2_pos : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α β : Type} (w : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α) (Y : Fin N → β) (ω : Fin N),
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ w ω') → 0 < w ω →
      0 < finProbAt2 w X Y ω ∧ finProbAt2 w X Y ω ≤ finProbAt w X ω := by
    intro N α β w X Y ω hw_nn hω_pos
    constructor
    · unfold finProbAt2
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hω_pos ?_
      have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun ω' => if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then w ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs; exact hw_nn ω'; exact le_rfl)
        (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      simp only [and_self, ite_true] at h_le
      convert h_le
    · unfold finProbAt2 finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω' _ => ?_
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact absurd h1.1 h2
      · exact hw_nn ω'
      · exact le_rfl
  have h_prob_congr : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α₁ α₂ : Type} (w : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X₁ : Fin N → α₁) (X₂ : Fin N → α₂) (ω : Fin N),
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ w ω') →
      (∀ ω', 0 < w ω' → (X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ↔ X₂ ω' = X₂ ω)) →
      finProbAt w X₁ ω = finProbAt w X₂ ω := by
    intro N α₁ α₂ w X₁ X₂ ω hw_nn h_iff
    unfold finProbAt
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω' _ => ?_
    by_cases hpos : 0 < w ω'
    · by_cases h1 : X₁ ω' = X₁ ω
      · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos ((h_iff ω' hpos).mp h1)]
      · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg (fun h2 => h1 ((h_iff ω' hpos).mpr h2))]
    · have h0 : w ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (hw_nn ω')
      simp [h0]
  have h_prob2_congr : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Type} (w : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X₁ : Fin N → α₁) (Y₁ : Fin N → β₁) (X₂ : Fin N → α₂) (Y₂ : Fin N → β₂) (ω : Fin N),
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ w ω') →
      (∀ ω', 0 < w ω' → (X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ∧ Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω ↔ X₂ ω' = X₂ ω ∧ Y₂ ω' = Y₂ ω)) →
      finProbAt2 w X₁ Y₁ ω = finProbAt2 w X₂ Y₂ ω := by
    intro N α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ w X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ ω hw_nn h_iff
    unfold finProbAt2
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω' _ => ?_
    by_cases hpos : 0 < w ω'
    · by_cases h1 : X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ∧ Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω
      · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos ((h_iff ω' hpos).mp h1)]
      · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg (fun h2 => h1 ((h_iff ω' hpos).mpr h2))]
    · have h0 : w ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (hw_nn ω')
      simp [h0]
  have h_surp_congr : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Type} (ε : ℝ) (w : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X₁ : Fin N → α₁) (Y₁ : Fin N → β₁) (X₂ : Fin N → α₂) (Y₂ : Fin N → β₂) (ω : Fin N),
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ w ω') →
      (∀ ω', 0 < w ω' → (X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ↔ X₂ ω' = X₂ ω)) →
      (∀ ω', 0 < w ω' → X₁ ω' = X₁ ω → (Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω ↔ Y₂ ω' = Y₂ ω)) →
      condSurprise ε w X₁ Y₁ ω = condSurprise ε w X₂ Y₂ ω := by
    intro N α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ ε w X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ ω hw_nn hX hY
    unfold condSurprise
    rw [h_prob_congr w X₁ X₂ ω hw_nn hX,
        h_prob2_congr w X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ ω hw_nn (fun ω' hpos => ⟨fun ⟨hx, hy⟩ =>
          ⟨(hX ω' hpos).mp hx, (hY ω' hpos hx).mp hy⟩, fun ⟨hx, hy⟩ =>
          ⟨(hX ω' hpos).mpr hx, (hY ω' hpos ((hX ω' hpos).mpr hx)).mpr hy⟩⟩)]
  have h_ent_congr : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ : Type} (ε : ℝ) (w : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X₁ : Fin N → α₁) (Y₁ : Fin N → β₁) (X₂ : Fin N → α₂) (Y₂ : Fin N → β₂),
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ w ω') →
      (∀ ω ω', 0 < w ω → 0 < w ω' →
        (X₁ ω' = X₁ ω ↔ X₂ ω' = X₂ ω) ∧
        (X₁ ω' = X₁ ω → (Y₁ ω' = Y₁ ω ↔ Y₂ ω' = Y₂ ω))) →
      finCondEntropy ε w X₁ Y₁ = finCondEntropy ε w X₂ Y₂ := by
    intro N α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ ε w X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ hw_nn h_eqv
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
    by_cases hpos : 0 < w ω
    · rw [h_surp_congr ε w X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ ω hw_nn
        (fun ω' h' => (h_eqv ω ω' hpos h').1)
        (fun ω' h' => (h_eqv ω ω' hpos h').2)]
    · have h0 : w ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (hw_nn ω)
      simp [h0]
  have h_surp_uncond_sub : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (w : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α) (Y : Fin N → β) (ω : Fin N),
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ w ω') → (∑ ω', w ω' = 1) → 0 < w ω →
      condSurprise ε w X Y ω =

  · intro hm_eq1 a_pt ha_pt h_aff3

    have h_pb : ∀ (idx_p : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ), H_good idx_p b → 0 < p0 idx_p b →

noncomputable def prePointBins (ε m i u' h' : ℝ)
    (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c_s R_s : ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℤ :=
  let C₀ := dyadicTimeMid ε u' c_s
  let R₀ := dyadicRealMid ε (m * u') R_s
  let X₀ := V_p 0
  let Y₀ := A_p 0 + C₀ * X₀
  let W₀ := V_p 1 - R₀ * X₀
  let Z₀ := A_p 1 + C₀ * (V_p 1) - R₀ * Y₀
  let D₀ : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![X₀, Y₀, W₀, Z₀]
  let L₀ : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![i, i + u', i + m * u', i + (1 + m) * u']
  let ρ := ε ^ h'
  fun j => canonicalGridBin ρ (ε ^ (-L₀ j) * (D₀ j - dyadicRealMid ε (L₀ j) (D₀ j)))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_T β₁ β₂ : Type}
      (ε : ℝ) (N₁₂ N₂₁ : ℕ) (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (T : Fin N_ω → α_T) (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂)
      (F₁₂ : α_T → β₁ → Finset β₂) (F₂₁ : α_T → β₂ → Finset β₁),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ N₁₂ → 1 ≤ N₂₁ →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω →
        Y₂ ω ∈ F₁₂ (T ω) (Y₁ ω) ∧ (F₁₂ (T ω) (Y₁ ω)).card ≤ N₁₂ ∧
        Y₁ ω ∈ F₂₁ (T ω) (Y₂ ω) ∧ (F₂₁ (T ω) (Y₂ ω)).card ≤ N₂₁) →
      |finCondEntropy ε Q T Y₂ - finCondEntropy ε Q T Y₁| ≤
        Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ∧
      ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let err := Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + τ
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if err < |condSurprise ε Q T Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q T Y₁ ω|
