                  @ite ℝ (∀ g : Fin 3, Q_tied g i' b = Q_tied g i b)
                    (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0₂ i' b / lam0 b) 0) /
               (∏ g : Fin 3,
                  ∑ i' : Fin N_P,
                    @ite ℝ (Q_tied g i' b = Q_tied g i b)
                      (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0₂ i' b / lam0 b) 0))) =
          (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ i : Fin N_P,
            let p_joint := ∑ i' : Fin N_P,
              if (∀ g : Fin 3, Q_tied g i' b = Q_tied g i b) then p0₂ i' b / lam0 b else 0
            let p_prod := ∏ g : Fin 3,
              (∑ i' : Fin N_P, if Q_tied g i' b = Q_tied g i b then p0₂ i' b / lam0 b else 0)
            p0₂ i b * Real.log (p_joint / p_prod)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        dsimp only
        congr 3
        · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => by congr 1
        · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun g _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => by congr 1
      rw [h_lhs_congr]
      refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => h_b_fib b) ?_
      calc (∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
              (lam0 b * Real.log (K_dom / m_Y) + lam0 b * Real.log (lam1 b / lam0 b)))
          = (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b) * Real.log (K_dom / m_Y) +
            ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b * Real.log (lam1 b / lam0 b) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 * Real.log (K_dom / m_Y) + ((∑ b, lam1 b) - (∑ b, lam0 b)) := by
            have hg := h_gibbs Finset.univ lam0 lam1
              (fun b _ => hlam0_nn b) (fun b _ => hlam1_nn b) (fun b _ => hlam0_imp_lam1 b)
            rw [hlam0_sum] at hg ⊢
            linarith only [hg]
        _ = Real.log (K_dom / m_Y) := by rw [hlam1_sum, hlam0_sum]; ring
    exact le_trans h_mi_raw hlog_KmY_ub

  
  
  
  let K_Y : Fin M → ℝ := fun r => ρ ^ (-(w r.succ + 1 / (M : ℝ)))
  have hKY_pos : ∀ r : Fin M, 0 < K_Y r := fun r => Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ0 _
  have hY_ret_card : ∀ (b : Fin N_Θ) (r : Fin M),
      (((Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N_P => 0 < p0₂ i b)).image (fun i => Y r i b)).card : ℝ) ≤
        K_Y r := by
    intro b r
    let S_pb := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N_P => 0 < p0₂ i b)
    let I_br := S_pb.image (fun i => Y r i b)
    by_cases hI : I_br.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := hI
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, _⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq₀
      have hp0_i₀ : 0 < p0₂ i₀ b := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₀).2
      have hlam1_b : 0 < lam1 b :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (hp0₂_supp i₀ b hp0_i₀)
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hπ₁_nn i' b) (Finset.mem_univ i₀))
      have h_q_lb : ∀ q ∈ I_br,
          ρ ^ (w r.succ + 1 / (M : ℝ)) ≤
            ∑ i' ∈ Finset.univ with Y r i' b = q, π₁ i' b / lam1 b := by
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨i_q, hi_q, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
        have h_in_E : (i_q, b) ∈ E_Y := (hp0₂_mem_pos i_q b (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi_q).2).1
        have h_lb := (hw_sand i_q b h_in_E r).1
        rwa [Finset.sum_filter]
      let U_sub := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_P)).filter (fun i' => Y r i' b ∈ I_br)
      have h_maps : ∀ i' ∈ U_sub, Y r i' b ∈ I_br := fun i' hi' => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2
      have h_fib_eq : ∀ q ∈ I_br,
          (∑ i' ∈ U_sub with Y r i' b = q, π₁ i' b / lam1 b) =
          (∑ i' ∈ Finset.univ with Y r i' b = q, π₁ i' b / lam1 b) := by
        intro q hq
        refine congrArg (fun s => ∑ i' ∈ s, π₁ i' b / lam1 b) ?_
        ext i'
        simp only [U_sub, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨h.symm ▸ hq, h⟩⟩
      have h_sum_le1 : (I_br.card : ℝ) * ρ ^ (w r.succ + 1 / (M : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
        calc (I_br.card : ℝ) * ρ ^ (w r.succ + 1 / (M : ℝ))
            = ∑ _q ∈ I_br, ρ ^ (w r.succ + 1 / (M : ℝ)) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ I_br, ∑ i' ∈ Finset.univ with Y r i' b = q, π₁ i' b / lam1 b :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum h_q_lb
          _ = ∑ q ∈ I_br, ∑ i' ∈ U_sub with Y r i' b = q, π₁ i' b / lam1 b :=
                Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => (h_fib_eq q hq).symm
          _ = ∑ i' ∈ U_sub, π₁ i' b / lam1 b :=
                Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps _
          _ ≤ ∑ i' : Fin N_P, π₁ i' b / lam1 b :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
                  (fun i' _ _ => div_nonneg (hπ₁_nn i' b) hlam1_b.le)
          _ = 1 := by rw [← Finset.sum_div]; exact div_self hlam1_b.ne'
      have h_pos_pow : 0 < ρ ^ (w r.succ + 1 / (M : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ0 _
      have h_card : (I_br.card : ℝ) ≤ (ρ ^ (w r.succ + 1 / (M : ℝ)))⁻¹ := by
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sum_le1 (inv_nonneg.mpr h_pos_pow.le)
        rwa [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h_pos_pow.ne', mul_one, one_mul] at h_mul
      rwa [← Real.rpow_neg hρ0.le] at h_card
    · change (I_br.card : ℝ) ≤ K_Y r
      rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hI, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
      exact (hKY_pos r).le

  let Θ_map : Fin M → Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ := fun r b => paramTreeBin ρ (d_fn r) (θ b)
  let C_cap : Fin M → Fin M → ℝ := fun r₁ r₂ => 4 * ρ ^ (-2 * (d_fn r₂ - d_fn r₁))
  have hC_pos : ∀ r₁ r₂ : Fin M, 0 < C_cap r₁ r₂ := fun r₁ r₂ => by
    dsimp [C_cap]; positivity
  let η_par : ℝ := 1 / (32 * ((M : ℝ) + 2))
  let τ_cap : ℝ := 1 / (16 * ((M : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)
  have hη_par_pos : 0 < η_par := by dsimp [η_par]; positivity
  have hτ_cap_pos : 0 < τ_cap := by dsimp [τ_cap]; positivity
  have hη_inv_le_K : η_par⁻¹ ≤ K_dom := by
    have h_eq : η_par⁻¹ = 32 * ((M : ℝ) + 2) := by dsimp [η_par]; rw [one_div, inv_inv]
    rw [h_eq]
    refine le_trans ?_ hJB_le_K
    dsimp [J_B]; nlinarith only [hM_ge2_r]
  have h_rpow_le_η : ρ ^ κ₁ ≤ η_par := by
    have h_inv := inv_anti₀ (inv_pos.mpr hη_par_pos) hη_inv_le_K
    rw [inv_inv] at h_inv
    have h_rhs : K_dom⁻¹ = ρ ^ κ₁ := by
      dsimp [K_dom]
      rw [← Real.rpow_neg hρ0.le, neg_neg]
    rwa [h_rhs] at h_inv
  have h4τ_inv_le_K : 4 * τ_cap⁻¹ ≤ K_dom := by
    have h_eq : 4 * τ_cap⁻¹ = J_B := by
      dsimp [τ_cap, J_B]; rw [one_div, inv_inv]; ring
    rw [h_eq]; exact hJB_le_K
  have h_rpow_le_τ4 : ρ ^ κ₁ ≤ τ_cap / 4 := by
    have h_inv := inv_anti₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * τ_cap⁻¹) h4τ_inv_le_K
    have h_lhs : (4 * τ_cap⁻¹)⁻¹ = τ_cap / 4 := by
      field_simp [hτ_cap_pos.ne']
    have h_rhs : K_dom⁻¹ = ρ ^ κ₁ := by
      dsimp [K_dom]; rw [← Real.rpow_neg hρ0.le, neg_neg]
    rwa [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_inv

  let H_good₂ : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop := fun i b =>
    (η_par * lam1 b ≤ lam0 b) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin M,
      η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹ ≤
        ∑ i', if Y r i' b = Y r i b then p0₂ i' b / lam0 b else 0) ∧
    (∀ r₁ : Fin M,
      η_par * (∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b then lam1 b' else 0) ≤
        ∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b then lam0 b' else 0) ∧
    (∀ r₁ r₂ : Fin M, r₁ < r₂ →
      τ_cap * (C_cap r₁ r₂)⁻¹ *
        (∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b then lam0 b' else 0) ≤
      ∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b ∧ Θ_map r₂ b' = Θ_map r₂ b
        then lam0 b' else 0)

  
  let Fail1 : Fin N_Θ → Prop := fun b => lam0 b < η_par * lam1 b
  let Fail2 : Fin M → Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → Prop := fun r i b =>
    (∑ i', if Y r i' b = Y r i b then p0₂ i' b / lam0 b else 0) < η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹
  let Fail3 : Fin M → Fin N_Θ → Prop := fun r₁ b =>
    (∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b then lam0 b' else 0) <
      η_par * (∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b then lam1 b' else 0)
  let Fail4 : Fin M → Fin M → Fin N_Θ → Prop := fun r₁ r₂ b =>
    r₁ < r₂ ∧
    (∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b ∧ Θ_map r₂ b' = Θ_map r₂ b then lam0 b' else 0) <
      τ_cap * (C_cap r₁ r₂)⁻¹ * (∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b then lam0 b' else 0)

  have hFail1_sum : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if Fail1 b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ η_par := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_b : ∀ b : Fin N_Θ,
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, if Fail1 b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ η_par * lam1 b := by
      intro b
      by_cases hf : Fail1 b
      · simp only [hf, ↓reduceIte]
        exact hf.le
      · simp only [hf, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg hη_par_pos.le (hlam1_nn b)
    calc (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ i : Fin N_P, if Fail1 b then p0₂ i b else 0)
        ≤ ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, η_par * lam1 b := Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => h_b b
      _ = η_par * ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam1 b := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ = η_par := by rw [hlam1_sum, mul_one]

  have hFail2_sum : ∀ r : Fin M,
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ η_par := by
    intro r
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_b : ∀ b : Fin N_Θ,
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ η_par * lam0 b := by
      intro b
      by_cases hlam0_b : 0 < lam0 b
      · let S_pb := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N_P => 0 < p0₂ i b)
        let I_br := S_pb.image (fun i => Y r i b)
        let Sf := S_pb.filter (fun i => Fail2 r i b)
        have h_eq_Sf : (∑ i : Fin N_P, if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0) =
            ∑ i ∈ Sf, p0₂ i b := by
          rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          by_cases hp : 0 < p0₂ i b
          · simp [hp]
          · have hz : p0₂ i b = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hp) (hp0₂_nn i b)
            simp [hz]
        rw [h_eq_Sf]
        have h_maps : ∀ i ∈ Sf, Y r i b ∈ I_br :=
          fun i hi => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1
        rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps]
        have h_fib : ∀ q ∈ I_br,
            (∑ i ∈ Sf with Y r i b = q, p0₂ i b) ≤
              η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹ * lam0 b := by
          intro q _
          let Fq := Sf.filter (fun i => Y r i b = q)
          change (∑ i ∈ Fq, p0₂ i b) ≤ η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹ * lam0 b
          by_cases hFq : Fq.Nonempty
          · obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ := hFq
            have hi₁_f : Fail2 r i₁ b := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₁).1).2
            have hi₁_q : Y r i₁ b = q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₁).2
            have h_le_full : (∑ i ∈ Fq, p0₂ i b) ≤
                lam0 b * (∑ i' : Fin N_P, if Y r i' b = Y r i₁ b then p0₂ i' b / lam0 b else 0) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              have h_rhs : (∑ i' : Fin N_P,
                  lam0 b * (if Y r i' b = Y r i₁ b then p0₂ i' b / lam0 b else 0)) =
                  ∑ i' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => Y r i' b = Y r i₁ b), p0₂ i' b := by
                rw [Finset.sum_filter]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
                split_ifs
                · exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hlam0_b.ne'
                · simp
              rw [h_rhs]
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun i _ _ => hp0₂_nn i b)
              intro i hi
              rw [Finset.mem_filter]
              exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2.trans hi₁_q.symm⟩
            calc (∑ i ∈ Fq, p0₂ i b)
                ≤ lam0 b * (∑ i', if Y r i' b = Y r i₁ b then p0₂ i' b / lam0 b else 0) :=
                  h_le_full
              _ ≤ lam0 b * (η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi₁_f.le hlam0_b.le
              _ = η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹ * lam0 b := by ring
          · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hFq, Finset.sum_empty]
            positivity
        calc (∑ q ∈ I_br, ∑ i ∈ Sf with Y r i b = q, p0₂ i b)
            ≤ ∑ _q ∈ I_br, (η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹ * lam0 b) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib
          _ = (I_br.card : ℝ) * (η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹ * lam0 b) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ ≤ K_Y r * (η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹ * lam0 b) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hY_ret_card b r) (by positivity)
          _ = η_par * lam0 b := by field_simp [(hKY_pos r).ne']
      · have hlam0_z : lam0 b = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hlam0_b) (hlam0_nn b)
        have hp0_z : ∀ i : Fin N_P, p0₂ i b = 0 := by
          intro i
          by_contra h_nz
          have hp_pos : 0 < p0₂ i b := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp0₂_nn i b) (Ne.symm h_nz)
          have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hp0₂_nn i' b) (Finset.mem_univ i)
          linarith only [hp_pos, h_le, hlam0_z]
        simp [hp0_z, hlam0_z]
    calc (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ i : Fin N_P, if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0)
        ≤ ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, η_par * lam0 b := Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => h_b b
      _ = η_par * ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ = η_par := by rw [hlam0_sum, mul_one]

  have hFail3_sum : ∀ r₁ : Fin M,
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ η_par := by
    intro r₁
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_col : (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ i : Fin N_P, if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0) =
        ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (Fail3 r₁), lam0 b := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      split_ifs
      · rfl
      · exact Finset.sum_const_zero
    rw [h_col]
    let Sb := Finset.univ.filter (Fail3 r₁)
    let Img_Θ := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_Θ)).image (Θ_map r₁)
    have h_maps : ∀ b ∈ Sb, Θ_map r₁ b ∈ Img_Θ :=
      fun b _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ b)
    have h_maps_all : ∀ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_Θ)), Θ_map r₁ b ∈ Img_Θ :=
      fun b _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ b)
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps]
    have h_fib : ∀ q₁ ∈ Img_Θ,
        (∑ b ∈ Sb with Θ_map r₁ b = q₁, lam0 b) ≤
          η_par * (∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ with Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁, lam1 b') := by
      intro q₁ _
      let Fq := Sb.filter (fun b => Θ_map r₁ b = q₁)
      change (∑ b ∈ Fq, lam0 b) ≤ _
      by_cases hFq : Fq.Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁⟩ := hFq
        have hb₁_f : Fail3 r₁ b₁ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb₁).1).2
        have hb₁_q : Θ_map r₁ b₁ = q₁ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb₁).2
        calc (∑ b ∈ Fq, lam0 b)
            ≤ ∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b' => Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁), lam0 b' := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun b' _ _ => hlam0_nn b')
              intro b hb
              exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ b, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2⟩
          _ = ∑ b' : Fin N_Θ, if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b₁ then lam0 b' else 0 := by
              rw [Finset.sum_filter, hb₁_q]
          _ ≤ η_par * (∑ b' : Fin N_Θ, if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b₁ then lam1 b' else 0) :=
              hb₁_f.le
          _ = η_par * (∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ with Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁, lam1 b') := by
              rw [Finset.sum_filter, hb₁_q]
      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hFq, Finset.sum_empty]
        exact mul_nonneg hη_par_pos.le (Finset.sum_nonneg fun b' _ => hlam1_nn b')
    calc (∑ q₁ ∈ Img_Θ, ∑ b ∈ Sb with Θ_map r₁ b = q₁, lam0 b)
        ≤ ∑ q₁ ∈ Img_Θ, η_par * (∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ with Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁, lam1 b') :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib
      _ = η_par * ∑ q₁ ∈ Img_Θ, ∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ with Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁, lam1 b' :=
          (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ = η_par * ∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ, lam1 b' := by
          rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps_all]
      _ = η_par := by rw [hlam1_sum, mul_one]

  have hFail4_sum : ∀ r₁ r₂ : Fin M,
      (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ τ_cap := by
    intro r₁ r₂
    by_cases hr12 : r₁ < r₂
    · have hd_le : d_fn r₁ ≤ d_fn r₂ := by
        dsimp [d_fn]
        refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hM_pos.le
        exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hr12.le 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h_col : (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ i : Fin N_P, if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0) =
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (Fail4 r₁ r₂), lam0 b := by
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
        split_ifs
        · rfl
        · exact Finset.sum_const_zero
      rw [h_col]
      let Sb := Finset.univ.filter (Fail4 r₁ r₂)
      let Img_Θ1 := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_Θ)).image (Θ_map r₁)
      have h_maps1 : ∀ b ∈ Sb, Θ_map r₁ b ∈ Img_Θ1 :=
        fun b _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ b)
      have h_maps1_all : ∀ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_Θ)), Θ_map r₁ b ∈ Img_Θ1 :=
        fun b _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ b)
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps1]
      have h_per_q1 : ∀ q₁ ∈ Img_Θ1,
          (∑ b ∈ Sb with Θ_map r₁ b = q₁, lam0 b) ≤
            τ_cap * (∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ with Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁, lam0 b') := by
        intro q₁ _
        obtain ⟨S₂, hS2_card, hS2_mem⟩ := h_2d_child (d_fn r₁) (d_fn r₂) hd_le q₁
        let Sb_q1 := Sb.filter (fun b => Θ_map r₁ b = q₁)
        have h_maps2 : ∀ b ∈ Sb_q1, Θ_map r₂ b ∈ S₂ :=
          fun b hb => hS2_mem (θ b) (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
        change (∑ b ∈ Sb_q1, lam0 b) ≤ _
        rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps2]
        let m_p := ∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ with Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁, lam0 b'
        have hm_p_nn : 0 ≤ m_p := Finset.sum_nonneg fun b' _ => hlam0_nn b'
        have h_fib2 : ∀ q₂ ∈ S₂,
            (∑ b ∈ Sb_q1 with Θ_map r₂ b = q₂, lam0 b) ≤
              τ_cap * (C_cap r₁ r₂)⁻¹ * m_p := by
          intro q₂ _
          let Fq2 := Sb_q1.filter (fun b => Θ_map r₂ b = q₂)
          change (∑ b ∈ Fq2, lam0 b) ≤ _
          by_cases hFq2 : Fq2.Nonempty
          · obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁⟩ := hFq2
            have hb₁_q1 : Θ_map r₁ b₁ = q₁ :=
              (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb₁).1).2
            have hb₁_q2 : Θ_map r₂ b₁ = q₂ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb₁).2
            have hb₁_f : Fail4 r₁ r₂ b₁ :=
              (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb₁).1).1).2
            calc (∑ b ∈ Fq2, lam0 b)
                ≤ ∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ.filter
                    (fun b' => Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁ ∧ Θ_map r₂ b' = q₂), lam0 b' := by
                  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun b' _ _ => hlam0_nn b')
                  intro b hb
                  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ b,
                    (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).1).2,
                    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2⟩
              _ = ∑ b' : Fin N_Θ,
                    if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b₁ ∧ Θ_map r₂ b' = Θ_map r₂ b₁
                    then lam0 b' else 0 := by
                  rw [Finset.sum_filter, hb₁_q1, hb₁_q2]
              _ ≤ τ_cap * (C_cap r₁ r₂)⁻¹ *
                    (∑ b' : Fin N_Θ, if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b₁ then lam0 b' else 0) :=
                  hb₁_f.2.le
              _ = τ_cap * (C_cap r₁ r₂)⁻¹ * m_p := by
                  dsimp [m_p]; rw [Finset.sum_filter, hb₁_q1]
          · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hFq2, Finset.sum_empty]
            positivity
        calc (∑ q₂ ∈ S₂, ∑ b ∈ Sb_q1 with Θ_map r₂ b = q₂, lam0 b)
            ≤ ∑ _q₂ ∈ S₂, (τ_cap * (C_cap r₁ r₂)⁻¹ * m_p) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib2
          _ = (S₂.card : ℝ) * (τ_cap * (C_cap r₁ r₂)⁻¹ * m_p) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ ≤ C_cap r₁ r₂ * (τ_cap * (C_cap r₁ r₂)⁻¹ * m_p) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS2_card (by positivity)
          _ = τ_cap * m_p := by field_simp [(hC_pos r₁ r₂).ne']
      calc (∑ q₁ ∈ Img_Θ1, ∑ b ∈ Sb with Θ_map r₁ b = q₁, lam0 b)
          ≤ ∑ q₁ ∈ Img_Θ1, τ_cap * (∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ with Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁, lam0 b') :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_per_q1
        _ = τ_cap * ∑ q₁ ∈ Img_Θ1, ∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ with Θ_map r₁ b' = q₁, lam0 b' :=
            (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ = τ_cap * ∑ b' ∈ Finset.univ, lam0 b' := by
            rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps1_all]
        _ = τ_cap := by rw [hlam0_sum, mul_one]
    · have h_not : ∀ b, ¬ Fail4 r₁ r₂ b := fun b hf => hr12 hf.1
      simp only [h_not, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      exact hτ_cap_pos.le

  have hH_mass : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_good₂ i b then p0₂ i b else 0 := by
    have h_pt : ∀ (i : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ),
        p0₂ i b ≤
          (if H_good₂ i b then p0₂ i b else 0) +
          (if Fail1 b then p0₂ i b else 0) +
          (∑ r : Fin M, if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0) +
          (∑ r₁ : Fin M, if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0) +
          (∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ r₂ : Fin M, if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0) := by
      intro i b
      have hnn1 : 0 ≤ (if Fail1 b then p0₂ i b else 0) := by
        split_ifs; exact hp0₂_nn i b; exact le_rfl
      have hnn2 : 0 ≤ ∑ r : Fin M, (if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun r _ => by split_ifs; exact hp0₂_nn i b; exact le_rfl
      have hnn3 : 0 ≤ ∑ r₁ : Fin M, (if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun r₁ _ => by split_ifs; exact hp0₂_nn i b; exact le_rfl
      have hnn4 : 0 ≤ ∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ r₂ : Fin M, (if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun r₁ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun r₂ _ => by
          split_ifs; exact hp0₂_nn i b; exact le_rfl
      by_cases hH : H_good₂ i b
      · simp only [hH, ↓reduceIte]
        linarith only [hnn1, hnn2, hnn3, hnn4]
      · simp only [hH, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
        by_cases hc1 : η_par * lam1 b ≤ lam0 b
        · by_cases hc2 : ∀ r : Fin M,
              η_par * (K_Y r)⁻¹ ≤ ∑ i', if Y r i' b = Y r i b then p0₂ i' b / lam0 b else 0
          · by_cases hc3 : ∀ r₁ : Fin M,
                η_par * (∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b then lam1 b' else 0) ≤
                  ∑ b', if Θ_map r₁ b' = Θ_map r₁ b then lam0 b' else 0
            · have hc4 : ∃ r₁ r₂ : Fin M, Fail4 r₁ r₂ b := by
                by_contra h_no4
                apply hH
                refine ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, fun r₁ r₂ hr => ?_⟩
                by_contra h_lt
                exact h_no4 ⟨r₁, r₂, hr, lt_of_not_ge h_lt⟩
              obtain ⟨r₁, r₂, hf4⟩ := hc4
              have h_le4 : p0₂ i b ≤
                  ∑ r₁' : Fin M, ∑ r₂' : Fin M, if Fail4 r₁' r₂' b then p0₂ i b else 0 := by
                have h_in2 : p0₂ i b ≤ ∑ r₂' : Fin M, if Fail4 r₁ r₂' b then p0₂ i b else 0 := by
                  calc p0₂ i b
                      = (if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0) := by simp [hf4]
                    _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum
                        (f := fun r₂' => if Fail4 r₁ r₂' b then p0₂ i b else 0)
                        (fun r₂' _ => by split_ifs; exact hp0₂_nn i b; exact le_rfl)
                        (Finset.mem_univ r₂)
                exact le_trans h_in2 (Finset.single_le_sum
                  (f := fun r₁' => ∑ r₂' : Fin M, if Fail4 r₁' r₂' b then p0₂ i b else 0)
                  (fun r₁' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun r₂' _ => by
                    split_ifs; exact hp0₂_nn i b; exact le_rfl)
                  (Finset.mem_univ r₁))
              linarith only [hnn1, hnn2, hnn3, h_le4]
            · have hc3' : ∃ r₁ : Fin M, Fail3 r₁ b := by
                by_contra h_no3
                exact hc3 fun r₁ => le_of_not_gt fun hlt => h_no3 ⟨r₁, hlt⟩
              obtain ⟨r₁, hf3⟩ := hc3'
              have h_le3 : p0₂ i b ≤ ∑ r₁' : Fin M, if Fail3 r₁' b then p0₂ i b else 0 := by
                calc p0₂ i b
                    = (if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0) := by simp [hf3]
                  _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum
                      (f := fun r₁' => if Fail3 r₁' b then p0₂ i b else 0)
                      (fun r₁' _ => by split_ifs; exact hp0₂_nn i b; exact le_rfl)
                      (Finset.mem_univ r₁)
              linarith only [hnn1, hnn2, h_le3, hnn4]
          · have hc2' : ∃ r : Fin M, Fail2 r i b := by
              by_contra h_no2
              exact hc2 fun r => le_of_not_gt fun hlt => h_no2 ⟨r, hlt⟩
            obtain ⟨r, hf2⟩ := hc2'
            have h_le2 : p0₂ i b ≤ ∑ r' : Fin M, if Fail2 r' i b then p0₂ i b else 0 := by
              calc p0₂ i b
                  = (if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0) := by simp [hf2]
                _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum
                    (f := fun r' => if Fail2 r' i b then p0₂ i b else 0)
                    (fun r' _ => by split_ifs; exact hp0₂_nn i b; exact le_rfl)
                    (Finset.mem_univ r)
            linarith only [hnn1, h_le2, hnn3, hnn4]
        · have hf1 : Fail1 b := lt_of_not_ge hc1
          simp only [hf1, ↓reduceIte]
          linarith only [hnn2, hnn3, hnn4]
    have h_tot : 1 ≤
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_good₂ i b then p0₂ i b else 0) +
        η_par + (M : ℝ) * η_par + (M : ℝ) * η_par + (M : ℝ) ^ 2 * τ_cap := by
      have h_s2 : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ r : Fin M,
          if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ (M : ℝ) * η_par := by
        have h_sw : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ r : Fin M,
            if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0) =
            ∑ r : Fin M, ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0 :=
          (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_comm).trans Finset.sum_comm
        rw [h_sw]
        calc (∑ r : Fin M, ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if Fail2 r i b then p0₂ i b else 0)
            ≤ ∑ _r : Fin M, η_par := Finset.sum_le_sum fun r _ => hFail2_sum r
          _ = (M : ℝ) * η_par := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have h_s3 : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ r₁ : Fin M,
          if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ (M : ℝ) * η_par := by
        have h_sw : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ r₁ : Fin M,
            if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0) =
            ∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0 :=
          (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_comm).trans Finset.sum_comm
        rw [h_sw]
        calc (∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if Fail3 r₁ b then p0₂ i b else 0)
            ≤ ∑ _r₁ : Fin M, η_par := Finset.sum_le_sum fun r₁ _ => hFail3_sum r₁
          _ = (M : ℝ) * η_par := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have h_s4 : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ r₂ : Fin M,
          if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ (M : ℝ) ^ 2 * τ_cap := by
        have h_sw : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ r₂ : Fin M,
            if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0) =
            ∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ r₂ : Fin M, ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
              if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0 := by
          trans (∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ r₂ : Fin M,
            if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0)
          · exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_comm).trans Finset.sum_comm
          · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r₁ _ =>
              (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_comm).trans Finset.sum_comm
        rw [h_sw]
        calc (∑ r₁ : Fin M, ∑ r₂ : Fin M, ∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
                if Fail4 r₁ r₂ b then p0₂ i b else 0)
            ≤ ∑ _r₁ : Fin M, ∑ _r₂ : Fin M, τ_cap :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum fun r₁ _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun r₂ _ => hFail4_sum r₁ r₂
          _ = (M : ℝ) ^ 2 * τ_cap := by
              simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
              ring
      have h_sum_le := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun b (_ : b ∈ Finset.univ) => h_pt i b
      rw [hp0₂_sum] at h_sum_le
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h_sum_le
      linarith only [h_sum_le, hFail1_sum, h_s2, h_s3, h_s4]
    have h_err_ub : (2 * (M : ℝ) + 1) * η_par + (M : ℝ) ^ 2 * τ_cap ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have h1 : (2 * (M : ℝ) + 1) * η_par ≤ 1 / 16 := by
        dsimp [η_par]
        rw [mul_one_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith only [hM_pos]
      have h2 : (M : ℝ) ^ 2 * τ_cap ≤ 1 / 16 := by
        dsimp [τ_cap]
        rw [mul_one_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        nlinarith only [hM_pos]
      linarith only [h1, h2]
    linarith only [h_tot, h_err_ub]

  have h_heavy_b : ∃ b₀ : Fin N_Θ,
      0 < lam0 b₀ ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam0 b₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N_P, if H_good₂ i b₀ then p0₂ i b₀ else 0 := by
    by_contra h_none
    have h_all : ∀ b : Fin N_Θ,
        (∑ i : Fin N_P, if H_good₂ i b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam0 b := by
      intro b
      by_cases hb_pos : 0 < lam0 b
      · by_contra h_gt
        exact h_none ⟨b, hb_pos, (lt_of_not_ge h_gt).le⟩
      · have hbz : lam0 b = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hb_pos) (hlam0_nn b)
        have hpz : ∀ i, p0₂ i b = 0 := by
          intro i
          by_contra h_nz
          have hp_pos : 0 < p0₂ i b := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp0₂_nn i b) (Ne.symm h_nz)
          have h_le := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hp0₂_nn i' b) (Finset.mem_univ i)
          linarith only [hp_pos, h_le, hbz]
        simp [hpz, hbz]
    have h_ub : (∑ i : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, if H_good₂ i b then p0₂ i b else 0) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      calc (∑ b : Fin N_Θ, ∑ i : Fin N_P, if H_good₂ i b then p0₂ i b else 0)
          ≤ ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam0 b := Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => h_all b
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, lam0 b := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ = 1 / 2 := by rw [hlam0_sum, mul_one]
    linarith only [hH_mass, h_ub]

  
  
  
  obtain ⟨b₀, hlam0_b0, hb0_heavy⟩ := h_heavy_b
  have hlam1_b0 : 0 < lam1 b₀ := hlam0_imp_lam1 b₀ hlam0_b0
  let S₀ : Finset (Fin N_P) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => H_good₂ i b₀ ∧ 0 < p0₂ i b₀)
  have hS₀_mass : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam0 b₀ ≤ ∑ i ∈ S₀, p0₂ i b₀ := by
    refine le_trans hb0_heavy (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases hp : 0 < p0₂ i b₀
    · simp [hp]
    · have hz : p0₂ i b₀ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hp) (hp0₂_nn i b₀)
      simp [hz]
  have hS₀_nonempty : S₀.Nonempty := by
    have h_pos : 0 < ∑ i ∈ S₀, p0₂ i b₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hS₀_mass
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, _⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h_pos.ne'
    exact ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩
  obtain ⟨i_w, hi_w⟩ := hS₀_nonempty
  have h_eta_b0 : η_par * lam1 b₀ ≤ lam0 b₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi_w).2.1.1
  have hlam1_le_eta_b0 : lam1 b₀ ≤ η_par⁻¹ * lam0 b₀ :=
    (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hη_par_pos).mpr (by linarith only [h_eta_b0])

  have h_heavy_count : ∀ (r : Fin M) (T : Finset ℤ),
      (∀ i ∈ S₀, Y r i b₀ ∈ T) →
      1 ≤ 2 * (T.card : ℝ) * m_Y⁻¹ * η_par⁻¹ * ρ ^ (w r.succ) := by
    intro r T h_maps
    have h_fib : ∀ q ∈ T,
        (∑ i ∈ S₀ with Y r i b₀ = q, p0₂ i b₀) ≤
          m_Y⁻¹ * η_par⁻¹ * lam0 b₀ * ρ ^ (w r.succ) := by
      intro q _
      let Fq := S₀.filter (fun i => Y r i b₀ = q)
      change (∑ i ∈ Fq, p0₂ i b₀) ≤ _
      by_cases hFq : Fq.Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ := hFq
        have hi₁_S0 : i₁ ∈ S₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₁).1
        have hi₁_q : Y r i₁ b₀ = q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₁).2
        have hp0_i₁ : 0 < p0₂ i₁ b₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₁_S0).2.2
        have hi₁_EY : (i₁, b₀) ∈ E_Y := (hp0₂_mem_pos i₁ b₀ hp0_i₁).1
        have hPY_ub : P_Y r i₁ b₀ ≤ ρ ^ (w r.succ) := (hw_sand i₁ b₀ hi₁_EY r).2
        have h_le_π : (∑ i ∈ Fq, p0₂ i b₀) ≤ m_Y⁻¹ * (lam1 b₀ * P_Y r i₁ b₀) := by
          have h_rhs : lam1 b₀ * P_Y r i₁ b₀ =
              ∑ i' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => Y r i' b₀ = Y r i₁ b₀), π₁ i' b₀ := by
            dsimp [P_Y]
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
            split_ifs
            · exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hlam1_b0.ne'
            · simp
          rw [h_rhs]
          calc (∑ i ∈ Fq, p0₂ i b₀)
              ≤ ∑ i ∈ Fq, m_Y⁻¹ * π₁ i b₀ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hp0₂_le i b₀
            _ = m_Y⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Fq, π₁ i b₀ := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
            _ ≤ m_Y⁻¹ * ∑ i' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => Y r i' b₀ = Y r i₁ b₀), π₁ i' b₀ := by
                refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (inv_nonneg.mpr hmY_pos.le)
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun i' _ _ => hπ₁_nn i' b₀)
                intro i hi
                exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
                  ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2.trans hi₁_q.symm⟩
        calc (∑ i ∈ Fq, p0₂ i b₀)
            ≤ m_Y⁻¹ * (lam1 b₀ * P_Y r i₁ b₀) := h_le_π
          _ ≤ m_Y⁻¹ * ((η_par⁻¹ * lam0 b₀) * ρ ^ (w r.succ)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (mul_le_mul hlam1_le_eta_b0 hPY_ub
                  (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i' _ => by
                    split_ifs; exact div_nonneg (hπ₁_nn i' b₀) hlam1_b0.le; exact le_rfl)
                  (by positivity))
                (inv_nonneg.mpr hmY_pos.le)
          _ = m_Y⁻¹ * η_par⁻¹ * lam0 b₀ * ρ ^ (w r.succ) := by ring
      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hFq, Finset.sum_empty]
        positivity
    have h_sum_T : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam0 b₀ ≤
        (T.card : ℝ) * (m_Y⁻¹ * η_par⁻¹ * lam0 b₀ * ρ ^ (w r.succ)) := by

              if Θ_map r₁' b' = Θ_map r₁' b ∧ Θ_map r₂' b' = Θ_map r₂' b
              then m_Y⁻¹ * lam1 b' else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun b' _ => ?_
            split_ifs
            · exact hlam0_le_lam1 b'
            · exact le_rfl
        _ = m_Y⁻¹ * ∑ b' : Fin N_Θ,
              if Θ_map r₁' b' = Θ_map r₁' b ∧ Θ_map r₂' b' = Θ_map r₂' b
              then lam1 b' else 0 := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b' _ => by split_ifs <;> ring
        _ ≤ m_Y⁻¹ * (ρ ^ (s * (d₂ - d₁) - κ₁) * m_par1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hmY_pos.le)
        _ ≤ m_Y⁻¹ * (ρ ^ (s * (d₂ - d₁) - κ₁) * (η_par⁻¹ * m_par0)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_par1_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ0.le _))
              (inv_nonneg.mpr hmY_pos.le)
        _ = ((m_Y⁻¹ * η_par⁻¹) * ρ ^ (s * (d₂ - d₁) - κ₁)) * m_par0 := by ring
        _ ≤ ((K_dom * K_dom) * ρ ^ (s * (d₂ - d₁) - κ₁)) * m_par0 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul hmY_inv_le_K hη_inv_le_K (inv_nonneg.mpr hη_par_pos.le) hK_dom_pos.le)
                (Real.rpow_nonneg hρ0.le _))
              hm_par0_nn
        _ = ρ ^ (-κ₁ + -κ₁ + (s * (d₂ - d₁) - κ₁)) * m_par0 := by
            change (ρ ^ (-κ₁) * ρ ^ (-κ₁) * _) * _ = _
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ0, ← Real.rpow_add hρ0]
        _ ≤ ρ ^ (s * (d₂ - d₁) - (4 * κ₁ + 3 / (M : ℝ))) * m_par0 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρ0 hρ_le1 (by linarith only [h3κ1_le]))
              hm_par0_nn

by
  
  have h_inv_M_tendsto : ∀ (c : ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun l : ℕ => c / ((l + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro c
    have h_nat : Filter.Tendsto (fun l : ℕ => ((l + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 2)
    have h_inv : Filter.Tendsto (fun l : ℕ => (((l + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp h_nat
    have h_mul := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := c)).mul h_inv
    rw [mul_zero] at h_mul
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using h_mul
  have h_log_inv_pos : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := by
    intro ρ hρ
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) < ρ⁻¹ := by
      have heq : (2 : ℝ) = (1 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by norm_num
      rw [heq]
      exact inv_strictAnti₀ hρ.1 hρ.2
    exact Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have h_log9_tendsto : ∀ (ρ_fn : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ n, 0 < ρ_fn n) →
      Filter.Tendsto ρ_fn Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log 9 / Real.log ((ρ_fn n)⁻¹)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro ρ_fn hρ_pos hρ_t
    have h_nhds_gt : Filter.Tendsto ρ_fn Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within ρ_fn hρ_t
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => hρ_pos n)
    have h_inv_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (ρ_fn n)⁻¹) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero.comp h_nhds_gt
    have h_log_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log ((ρ_fn n)⁻¹)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp h_inv_top
    have h_inv_log : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (Real.log ((ρ_fn n)⁻¹))⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp h_log_top
    have h_mul := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := Real.log 9)).mul h_inv_log
    rw [mul_zero] at h_mul
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using h_mul
  have h_tau_rpow : ∀ (ρ r : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 1 / 2 → ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
      let τ := Real.log (r⁻¹) / Real.log (ρ⁻¹)
      0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 ∧ ρ ^ τ = r := by
    intro ρ r hρ hr_lo hr_hi
    have hL_pos : 0 < Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := h_log_inv_pos ρ hρ
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ.1 hr_lo
    have hr_inv_ge1 : 1 ≤ r⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hr_pos).mpr hr_hi
    have hr_inv_le : r⁻¹ ≤ ρ⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hρ.1 hr_lo
    refine ⟨div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hr_inv_ge1) hL_pos.le,
      (div_le_one hL_pos).mpr (Real.log_le_log (inv_pos.mpr hr_pos) hr_inv_le), ?_⟩
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ.1]
    have hlog_ρ : Real.log ρ = -Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := by rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
    rw [hlog_ρ]
    have h_simp : -Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * (Real.log (r⁻¹) / Real.log (ρ⁻¹)) = Real.log r := by
      rw [Real.log_inv r, neg_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hL_pos.ne', neg_neg]
    rw [h_simp, Real.exp_log hr_pos]

  
  have h_upgrade : ∀ {N : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (M : ℕ), 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ M →
      (∀ (κ C_lip : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (w x : Fin N → ℝ),
        0 ≤ κ → 0 ≤ C_lip →
        g 0 = 0 →
        (∀ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, d₁ ≤ d₂ → 0 ≤ g d₂ - g d₁ ∧ g d₂ - g d₁ ≤ C_lip * (d₂ - d₁)) →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → (∑ i : Fin N, w i = 1) →
        (∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ q : ℤ,
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          (∑ i : Fin N,
            if dyadicRealBin ρ ((r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) (x i) = q then w i else 0) ≤
            ρ ^ (g ((r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) - κ)) →
        ∀ (z₀ r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          let τ := Real.log (r⁻¹) / Real.log (ρ⁻¹)
          (∑ i : Fin N, if |x i - z₀| < r then w i else 0) ≤
            ρ ^ (g τ - (κ + C_lip / (M : ℝ) + Real.log 3 / Real.log (ρ⁻¹)))) ∧
      (∀ (κ α : ℝ) (w : Fin N → ℝ) (x : Fin N → ℝ × ℝ),
        0 ≤ κ → 0 ≤ α →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → (∑ i : Fin N, w i = 1) →
        (∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M → ∀ q : ℤ × ℤ,
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          (∑ i : Fin N,
            if paramTreeBin ρ ((r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) (x i) = q then w i else 0) ≤
            ρ ^ (α * ((r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) - κ)) →
        ∀ (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ), ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          (∑ i : Fin N,
            if ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ![(x i).1, (x i).2] - z₀‖ < r then w i else 0) ≤
            ρ ^ (-(κ + α / (M : ℝ) + Real.log 9 / Real.log (ρ⁻¹))) * r ^ α) ∧
      (∀ (κ C_lip : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (S_act : Finset (Fin N)) (x : Fin N → ℝ),
        0 ≤ C_lip →
        (∀ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, d₁ ≤ d₂ → g d₂ - g d₁ ≤ C_lip * (d₂ - d₁)) →
        (∀ (r_idx : ℕ), 1 ≤ r_idx → r_idx ≤ M →
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          (((S_act.image (fun i =>
              dyadicRealBin ρ ((r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) (x i))).card : ℝ) ≤
            ρ ^ (-g ((r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) - κ))) →
        ∀ r : ℝ, ρ ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
          let τ := Real.log (r⁻¹) / Real.log (ρ⁻¹)
          ∃ S_cov : Finset ℝ,
            (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ ρ ^ (-g τ - (κ + C_lip / (M : ℝ))) ∧
            ∀ i ∈ S_act, ∃ c₀ ∈ S_cov, |x i - c₀| ≤ r) := by
    intro N ρ M hρ hM
    have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := hρ.1
    have hρ1 : ρ < 1 := by linarith [hρ.2]
    let L : ℝ := Real.log (ρ⁻¹)
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hL_pos : 0 < L := h_log_inv_pos ρ hρ
    have hM_pos : 0 < (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hM)
    have h_rpow_log : ∀ (C : ℝ), 0 < C → ρ ^ (-(Real.log C / L)) = C := by
      intro C hC
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ0]
      have hlog_ρ : Real.log ρ = -L := by dsimp [L]; rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
      rw [hlog_ρ]
      have h_simp : -L * -(Real.log C / L) = Real.log C := by field_simp [hL_pos.ne']
      rw [h_simp, Real.exp_log hC]
    have h_step_bounds : ∀ d : ℝ,
        ρ ^ d ≤ dyadicRealStep ρ d ∧ dyadicRealStep ρ d < 2 * ρ ^ d := by
      intro d
      let m := dyadicRealLevel ρ d
      let y := d * (L / Real.log 2)
      have hm_le : (m : ℝ) ≤ y := Int.floor_le y
      have hy_lt : y < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one y
      have h2_y : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-y) = ρ ^ d := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), Real.rpow_def_of_pos hρ0]
        congr 1
        have hlog_ρ : Real.log ρ = -L := by dsimp [L]; rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
        rw [hlog_ρ]
        dsimp [y]
        field_simp [hlog2_pos.ne']
      have h2_m : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m : ℝ)) = dyadicRealStep ρ d := by
        dsimp [dyadicRealStep, m]
        rw [← Int.cast_neg, Real.rpow_intCast]
      have h_lo : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-y) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m : ℝ)) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      have h_hi : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m : ℝ)) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - y) :=
        Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      have h2_1my : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - y) = 2 * ρ ^ d := by
        rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one, h2_y]
      rw [h2_y, h2_m] at h_lo
      rw [h2_m, h2_1my] at h_hi
      exact ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩
    have h_bin_1d : ∀ (d z₀ x₀ : ℝ), |x₀ - z₀| < dyadicRealStep ρ d →
        dyadicRealBin ρ d x₀ ∈
          Finset.Icc (dyadicRealBin ρ d z₀ - 1) (dyadicRealBin ρ d z₀ + 1) := by
      intro d z₀ x₀ h_abs
      let m := dyadicRealLevel ρ d
      let S : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ m
      have hS_pos : 0 < S := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) m
      have hΔS : dyadicRealStep ρ d * S = 1 :=
        zpow_neg_mul_zpow_self m (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      obtain ⟨h_lt1, h_lt2⟩ := abs_sub_lt_iff.mp h_abs
      have h_lo_x : z₀ * S - 1 < x₀ * S := by
        have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (show z₀ - dyadicRealStep ρ d < x₀ by linarith) hS_pos
        rwa [sub_mul, hΔS] at hm
      have h_hi_x : x₀ * S < z₀ * S + 1 := by
        have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (show x₀ < z₀ + dyadicRealStep ρ d by linarith) hS_pos
        rwa [add_mul, hΔS] at hm
      let q₀ := dyadicRealBin ρ d z₀
      let q := dyadicRealBin ρ d x₀
      have hq₀_le : (q₀ : ℝ) ≤ z₀ * S := Int.floor_le (z₀ * S)
      have hq₀_lt : z₀ * S < (q₀ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (z₀ * S)
      have hq_le : (q : ℝ) ≤ x₀ * S := Int.floor_le (x₀ * S)
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      refine ⟨Int.le_floor.mpr (by push_cast; linarith), ?_⟩
      have hq_lt2 : (q : ℝ) < ((q₀ + 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
      have hq_lt2_z : q < q₀ + 2 := by exact_mod_cast hq_lt2
      omega
    have h_icc3 : ∀ q₀ : ℤ, (Finset.Icc (q₀ - 1) (q₀ + 1)).card = 3 := by
      intro q₀
      have h : q₀ + 1 + 1 - (q₀ - 1) = 3 := by ring
      rw [Int.card_Icc, h]
      rfl
    have h_bin_cover_sum : ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
        (P_pred : Fin N → Prop) (bin_fn : Fin N → α) (w_fn : Fin N → ℝ)
        (B : Finset α) (bd : ℝ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ w_fn i) →
        (∀ i, P_pred i → bin_fn i ∈ B) →
        (∀ q ∈ B,
          (letI := Classical.propDecidable
           ∑ i : Fin N, if bin_fn i = q then w_fn i else 0) ≤ bd) →
        (∑ i : Fin N, if P_pred i then w_fn i else 0) ≤ (B.card : ℝ) * bd := by
      intro α _ P_pred bin_fn w_fn B bd hw_nn h_in h_bd
      have h_bd' : ∀ q ∈ B, (∑ i : Fin N, if bin_fn i = q then w_fn i else 0) ≤ bd := by
        intro q hq
        convert h_bd q hq
      calc (∑ i : Fin N, @ite ℝ (P_pred i) (Classical.propDecidable _) (w_fn i) 0)
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin N, if bin_fn i ∈ B then w_fn i else 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
            split_ifs with h1 h2
            · exact le_rfl
            · exact absurd (h_in i h1) h2
            · exact hw_nn i
            · exact le_rfl
        _ = ∑ i : Fin N, (∑ q ∈ B, if bin_fn i = q then w_fn i else 0) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            split_ifs with hm
            · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (bin_fn i)]
              · simp
              · intro q _ hq_ne
                split_ifs with heq
                · exact absurd heq.symm hq_ne
                · rfl
              · intro h_abs; exact absurd hm h_abs
            · refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q hq => ?_).symm
              split_ifs with heq
              · exact absurd (heq ▸ hq) hm
              · rfl
        _ = ∑ q ∈ B, (∑ i : Fin N, if bin_fn i = q then w_fn i else 0) := Finset.sum_comm
        _ ≤ ∑ _q ∈ B, bd := Finset.sum_le_sum h_bd'
        _ = (B.card : ℝ) * bd := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h_floor_mesh : ∀ τ : ℝ, 1 / (M : ℝ) ≤ τ → τ ≤ 1 →
        ∃ r_idx : ℕ, 1 ≤ r_idx ∧ r_idx ≤ M ∧
          τ - 1 / (M : ℝ) ≤ (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ) ∧ (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ) ≤ τ := by
      intro τ hτ_lo hτ_hi
      have h1_le_τM : (1 : ℝ) ≤ τ * (M : ℝ) := (div_le_iff₀ hM_pos).mp hτ_lo
      have hτM_nn : 0 ≤ τ * (M : ℝ) := by linarith
      let r_idx : ℕ := min M ⌊τ * (M : ℝ)⌋₊
      have hr1 : 1 ≤ r_idx := le_min hM (Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast h1_le_τM))
      have hrM : r_idx ≤ M := min_le_left M _
      have hd_hi : (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ) ≤ τ := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hM_pos]
        have h_le_fl : r_idx ≤ ⌊τ * (M : ℝ)⌋₊ := min_le_right M _
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h_le_fl) (Nat.floor_le hτM_nn)
      have hd_lo : τ - 1 / (M : ℝ) ≤ (r_idx : ℝ) / (M : ℝ) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hM_pos, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ 1 hM_pos.ne']
        by_cases h_cap : M ≤ ⌊τ * (M : ℝ)⌋₊
        · have hr_eq : r_idx = M := min_eq_left h_cap
          rw [hr_eq]
          have hτM_le : τ * (M : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := by
            calc τ * (M : ℝ) ≤ 1 * (M : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ_hi hM_pos.le
              _ = (M : ℝ) := one_mul _
          linarith
        · have hr_eq : r_idx = ⌊τ * (M : ℝ)⌋₊ := min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h_cap)
          rw [hr_eq]
          linarith [Nat.lt_floor_add_one (τ * (M : ℝ))]
      exact ⟨r_idx, hr1, hrM, hd_lo, hd_hi⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro κ C_lip g w x hκ hC_lip hg0 hg_lip hw_nn hw_sum h_mesh z₀ r hr_lo hr_hi
      dsimp only
      obtain ⟨hτ0, hτ1, hρ_τ⟩ := h_tau_rpow ρ r hρ hr_lo hr_hi
      let τ := Real.log (r⁻¹) / L
      let κ_out := κ + C_lip / (M : ℝ) + Real.log 3 / L
      have hlog3_pos : 0 < Real.log 3 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
      by_cases hτ_small : τ < 1 / (M : ℝ)
      · have hg_τ : g τ ≤ C_lip / (M : ℝ) := by
          have h1 := (hg_lip 0 τ hτ0).2
          rw [hg0, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h1
          have h2 : C_lip * τ ≤ C_lip * (1 / (M : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hτ_small.le hC_lip
          linarith [show C_lip * (1 / (M : ℝ)) = C_lip / (M : ℝ) by ring]
        have hexp_le : g τ - κ_out ≤ 0 := by
          dsimp [κ_out]
          have h_l3 : 0 < Real.log 3 / L := div_pos hlog3_pos hL_pos
          linarith
        calc (∑ i : Fin N, @ite ℝ (|x i - z₀| < r) (Classical.propDecidable _) (w i) 0)
            ≤ ∑ i : Fin N, w i := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
              split_ifs; exact le_rfl; exact hw_nn i
          _ = 1 := hw_sum

            (fun d₁ d₂ hd => by linarith [((stg (φ n)).hg_lip d₁ d₂ hd).2])
            (fun r_idx hr1 hrM => by
              convert (stg (φ n)).h_Y_supp_mesh b hlam_b r_idx hr1 hrM)
            r hr_lo hr_hi
        rw [hτ_eq_d] at hS_card
        have hu := (abs_le.mp (h_unif n d ⟨hd0.le, hd1⟩)).2
        refine ⟨S_cov, ?_, fun i hi => hS_mem i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩)⟩
        exact le_trans hS_card
          (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hρb.1 hρ1.le (by linarith))
    }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_W α_Par α_P α_V : Type}
       [DecidableEq α_W] [DecidableEq α_Par] [DecidableEq α_P] [DecidableEq α_V]
       (ε K_amb u_blk ζ δ_gap D_cap C_ch p_hi ζ_MI : ℝ)
       (π π_amb : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
       (W : Fin N_ω → α_W) (Par : Fin N_ω → α_Par)
       (P : Fin N_ω → α_P) (V_obs : Fin N_ω → α_V)
       (E_allow : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ K_amb →
      0 < u_blk → 0 < ζ → 0 < δ_gap → 0 < D_cap → 1 ≤ C_ch →
      0 ≤ p_hi → p_hi ≤ D_cap → 0 ≤ ζ_MI →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_amb ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_amb ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, π ω ≤ K_amb * π_amb ω) →
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, Par ω₁ = Par ω₂ → W ω₁ = W ω₂) →
      1 - δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_allow, π ω →
      (∀ ω₀, 0 < π ω₀ → ∃ S_ch : Finset α_P,
        (S_ch.card : ℝ) ≤ C_ch * (ε ^ u_blk) ^ (-D_cap) ∧
        ∀ ω, 0 < π ω → W ω = W ω₀ → P ω ∈ S_ch) →
      finCondEntropy ε π W P ≤ (p_hi - δ_gap) * u_blk →
      finCondMutualInfo ε π W V_obs P ≤ ζ_MI * u_blk →
      ζ_MI / ζ + 1 / (ζ * u_blk * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) ≤ δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) →
      C_ch * ε ^ u_blk ≤ δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) →
      let ρ := ε ^ u_blk
      let J_bins : ℕ := 1 + ⌈(D_cap + 2) / ζ⌉₊
      let c_ret : ℝ := δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2) * (J_bins : ℝ))
      ∃ (p_star : ℝ) (E_good : Finset (Fin N_ω)) (G_W : Finset α_W),
        0 ≤ p_star ∧ p_star ≤ p_hi - δ_gap / 2 ∧
        E_good ⊆ E_allow ∧
        (∀ ω ∈ E_good, 0 < π ω) ∧
        c_ret / 2 ≤ ∑ w ∈ G_W, ∑ ω ∈ E_good, (if W ω = w then π ω else 0) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ G_W,
          let E_w := E_good.filter (fun ω => W ω = w)
          let m_w := ∑ ω ∈ E_w, π ω
          0 < m_w ∧
          (c_ret / 4) * (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if W ω = w then π ω else 0) ≤ m_w ∧
          ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) ≤ ρ ^ (-(p_star + ζ)) ∧
          ∃ q : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
            (∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, q ω = 1) ∧
            (∀ ω, ω ∉ E_w → q ω = 0) ∧
            (∀ ω ∈ E_w, q ω ≤ (2 / m_w) * π ω) ∧
            (∀ p₀ v₀,
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀ then q ω else 0) ≤
                (256 / c_ret) * ρ ^ (-ζ) *
                  (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ then q ω else 0) *
                  (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if V_obs ω = v₀ then q ω else 0)) ∧
            (∀ p₀,
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ then q ω else 0) ≤ (8 / c_ret) * ρ ^ p_star) ∧
            (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < q ω →
              (c_ret / (16 * K_amb)) *
                (∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if Par ω' = Par ω then π_amb ω' else 0) ≤
                ∑ ω' ∈ E_w, if Par ω' = Par ω then π_amb ω' else 0)
