proof.tactics:
by
  intro N_ω α_W α_Par α_P α_V _ _ _ _
    ε K_amb u_blk ζ δ_gap D_cap C_ch p_hi ζ_MI
    π π_amb W Par P V_obs E_allow
    hε₀ hε₁ hK_amb hu_blk hζ hδ_gap hD_cap _hC_ch
    _hp_hi₀ hp_hi_D _hζ_MI
    hπ_nn hπ_sum hπ_amb_nn hπ_amb_sum hπ_le_amb hPar_W
    hE_allow _h_ch_cov h_ent h_cmi h_mi_err _h_ch_tail
    ρ J_bins c_ret

  
  have h_marginal_core : ∀ (S₀ : Finset (Fin N_ω)) (ν : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (μP : α_P → ℝ) (μV : α_V → ℝ) (A : ℝ),
      0 ≤ A →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ ν ω) →
      7 / 8 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω →
      ∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω ≤ 1 →
      (∀ p, 0 ≤ μP p) →
      ∑ p ∈ S₀.image P, μP p ≤ 1 →
      (∀ v, 0 ≤ μV v) →
      ∑ v ∈ S₀.image V_obs, μV v ≤ 1 →
      (∀ p₀ v₀, (∑ ω ∈ S₀, if P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀ then ν ω else 0) ≤ A * μP p₀ * μV v₀) →
      ∃ q : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω) ∧
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, q ω = 1) ∧
        (∀ ω, ω ∉ S₀ → q ω = 0) ∧
        (∀ ω ∈ S₀, q ω ≤ 2 * ν ω) ∧
        (∀ p₀ v₀,
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀ then q ω else 0) ≤
            64 * A *
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ then q ω else 0) *
              (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if V_obs ω = v₀ then q ω else 0)) := by
    intro S₀ ν μP μV A hA hν_nn hν_lb hν_ub hμP_nn hμP_sum hμV_nn hμV_sum h_prod
    let IP₀ : Finset α_P := S₀.image P
    let IV₀ : Finset α_V := S₀.image V_obs
    let S_of : Finset α_P → Finset α_V → Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
      fun BP BV => S₀.filter (fun ω => P ω ∈ BP ∧ V_obs ω ∈ BV)
    have h_ind : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (BP : Finset α_P) (BV : Finset α_V),
        BP.card + BV.card = n →
        BP ⊆ IP₀ → BV ⊆ IV₀ →
        (∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S_of BP BV, ν ω) ≤
          (1 / 8) * (∑ p ∈ IP₀ \ BP, μP p) + (1 / 8) * (∑ v ∈ IV₀ \ BV, μV v) →
        ∃ (BP_s : Finset α_P) (BV_s : Finset α_V),
          BP_s ⊆ IP₀ ∧ BV_s ⊆ IV₀ ∧
          (∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S_of BP_s BV_s, ν ω) ≤
            (1 / 8) * (∑ p ∈ IP₀ \ BP_s, μP p) + (1 / 8) * (∑ v ∈ IV₀ \ BV_s, μV v) ∧
          (∀ p₀ ∈ BP_s, (1 / 8) * μP p₀ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ (S_of BP_s BV_s).filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), ν ω) ∧
          (∀ v₀ ∈ BV_s, (1 / 8) * μV v₀ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ (S_of BP_s BV_s).filter (fun ω => V_obs ω = v₀), ν ω) := by
      intro n
      refine Nat.strong_induction_on n (fun n ih => ?_)
      intro BP BV hcard hBP_sub hBV_sub h_inv
      let S := S_of BP BV
      by_cases hbadP : ∃ p₀ ∈ BP, (∑ ω ∈ S.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), ν ω) < (1 / 8) * μP p₀
      · obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀_BP, hp₀_lt⟩ := hbadP
        let BP' := BP.erase p₀
        have hBP'_sub : BP' ⊆ IP₀ := (Finset.erase_subset p₀ BP).trans hBP_sub
        have hcard_lt : BP'.card + BV.card < n := by
          dsimp [BP']
          have := Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hp₀_BP
          omega
        have hS_eq : S_of BP' BV = S.filter (fun ω => ¬ P ω = p₀) := by
          ext ω
          simp only [S_of, S, BP', Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase]
          tauto
        have hS_split : (∑ ω ∈ S.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), ν ω) + (∑ ω ∈ S_of BP' BV, ν ω) =
            ∑ ω ∈ S, ν ω := by
          rw [hS_eq]
          exact Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S (fun ω => P ω = p₀) ν
        have hp₀_IP : p₀ ∈ IP₀ := hBP_sub hp₀_BP
        have hp₀_not_sdiff : p₀ ∉ IP₀ \ BP := by simp [hp₀_BP]
        have hsdiff_eq : IP₀ \ BP' = insert p₀ (IP₀ \ BP) := by
          ext p
          simp only [BP', Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_insert]
          by_cases hp : p = p₀ <;> simp [hp, hp₀_BP, hp₀_IP]
        have hμP_split : ∑ p ∈ IP₀ \ BP', μP p = μP p₀ + ∑ p ∈ IP₀ \ BP, μP p := by
          rw [hsdiff_eq, Finset.sum_insert hp₀_not_sdiff]
        have h_inv' : (∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S_of BP' BV, ν ω) ≤
            (1 / 8) * (∑ p ∈ IP₀ \ BP', μP p) + (1 / 8) * (∑ v ∈ IV₀ \ BV, μV v) := by
          change (∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S, ν ω) ≤ _ at h_inv
          linarith only [h_inv, hp₀_lt, hS_split, hμP_split]
        exact ih (BP'.card + BV.card) hcard_lt BP' BV rfl hBP'_sub hBV_sub h_inv'
      · by_cases hbadV : ∃ v₀ ∈ BV, (∑ ω ∈ S.filter (fun ω => V_obs ω = v₀), ν ω) < (1 / 8) * μV v₀
        · obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀_BV, hv₀_lt⟩ := hbadV
          let BV' := BV.erase v₀
          have hBV'_sub : BV' ⊆ IV₀ := (Finset.erase_subset v₀ BV).trans hBV_sub
          have hcard_lt : BP.card + BV'.card < n := by
            dsimp [BV']
            have := Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hv₀_BV
            omega
          have hS_eq : S_of BP BV' = S.filter (fun ω => ¬ V_obs ω = v₀) := by
            ext ω
            simp only [S_of, S, BV', Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase]
            tauto
          have hS_split : (∑ ω ∈ S.filter (fun ω => V_obs ω = v₀), ν ω) + (∑ ω ∈ S_of BP BV', ν ω) =
              ∑ ω ∈ S, ν ω := by
            rw [hS_eq]
            exact Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S (fun ω => V_obs ω = v₀) ν
          have hv₀_IV : v₀ ∈ IV₀ := hBV_sub hv₀_BV
          have hv₀_not_sdiff : v₀ ∉ IV₀ \ BV := by simp [hv₀_BV]
          have hsdiff_eq : IV₀ \ BV' = insert v₀ (IV₀ \ BV) := by
            ext v
            simp only [BV', Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_insert]
            by_cases hv : v = v₀ <;> simp [hv, hv₀_BV, hv₀_IV]
          have hμV_split : ∑ v ∈ IV₀ \ BV', μV v = μV v₀ + ∑ v ∈ IV₀ \ BV, μV v := by
            rw [hsdiff_eq, Finset.sum_insert hv₀_not_sdiff]
          have h_inv' : (∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S_of BP BV', ν ω) ≤
              (1 / 8) * (∑ p ∈ IP₀ \ BP, μP p) + (1 / 8) * (∑ v ∈ IV₀ \ BV', μV v) := by
            change (∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S, ν ω) ≤ _ at h_inv
            linarith only [h_inv, hv₀_lt, hS_split, hμV_split]
          exact ih (BP.card + BV'.card) hcard_lt BP BV' rfl hBP_sub hBV'_sub h_inv'
        · push Not at hbadP hbadV
          exact ⟨BP, BV, hBP_sub, hBV_sub, h_inv, hbadP, hbadV⟩
    have hS_init : S_of IP₀ IV₀ = S₀ := by
      ext ω
      simp only [S_of, IP₀, IV₀, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, Finset.mem_image_of_mem P h, Finset.mem_image_of_mem V_obs h⟩⟩
    have h_inv_init : (∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω) - (∑ ω ∈ S_of IP₀ IV₀, ν ω) ≤
        (1 / 8) * (∑ p ∈ IP₀ \ IP₀, μP p) + (1 / 8) * (∑ v ∈ IV₀ \ IV₀, μV v) := by
      rw [hS_init]; simp
    obtain ⟨BP_s, BV_s, _hBP_s, _hBV_s, h_inv_s, h_survP, h_survV⟩ :=
      h_ind (IP₀.card + IV₀.card) IP₀ IV₀ rfl (Finset.Subset.refl _) (Finset.Subset.refl _) h_inv_init
    let S_star := S_of BP_s BV_s
    have hS_star_sub : S_star ⊆ S₀ := Finset.filter_subset _ _
    let M : ℝ := ∑ ω ∈ S_star, ν ω
    have hM_ub : M ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hS_star_sub (fun ω _ _ => hν_nn ω)) hν_ub
    have hμP_sdiff : ∑ p ∈ IP₀ \ BP_s, μP p ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.sdiff_subset (fun p _ _ => hμP_nn p)) hμP_sum
    have hμV_sdiff : ∑ v ∈ IV₀ \ BV_s, μV v ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.sdiff_subset (fun v _ _ => hμV_nn v)) hμV_sum
    have hM_half : 1 / 2 ≤ M := by
      change (∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω) - M ≤ _ at h_inv_s
      linarith only [h_inv_s, hν_lb, hμP_sdiff, hμV_sdiff]
    have hM_pos : 0 < M := by linarith only [hM_half]
    let q : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => if ω ∈ S_star then ν ω / M else 0
    have hq_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω := fun ω => by
      dsimp [q]; split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hν_nn ω) hM_pos.le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hq_flt : ∀ (Pred : Fin N_ω → Prop) [DecidablePred Pred],
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if Pred ω then q ω else 0) =
          (∑ ω ∈ S_star.filter Pred, ν ω) / M := by
      intro Pred _
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_star)]
      · have h1 : (∑ ω ∈ S_star, if Pred ω then q ω else 0) =
            ∑ ω ∈ S_star, if Pred ω then ν ω / M else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
          dsimp [q]; simp [hω]
        rw [h1, ← Finset.sum_filter (s := S_star) (p := Pred) (f := fun ω => ν ω / M),
          ← Finset.sum_div]
      · intro ω _ hnot
        dsimp [q]; simp [hnot]
    have hq_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, q ω = 1 := by
      have h1 := hq_flt (fun _ => True)
      simp only [↓reduceIte, Finset.filter_true_of_mem (fun _ _ => trivial)] at h1
      rw [h1]
      exact div_self hM_pos.ne'
    have hq_out : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S₀ → q ω = 0 := fun ω hnot => by
      have hnot_s : ω ∉ S_star := fun hs => hnot (hS_star_sub hs)
      dsimp [q]; simp [hnot_s]
    have hq_ub : ∀ ω ∈ S₀, q ω ≤ 2 * ν ω := fun ω _ => by
      dsimp [q]; split_ifs
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hM_pos]
        have h1 : ν ω * 1 ≤ ν ω * (2 * M) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hM_half]) (hν_nn ω)
        linarith only [h1, show (2 * ν ω) * M = ν ω * (2 * M) by ring]
      · exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hν_nn ω)
    refine ⟨q, hq_nn, hq_sum, hq_out, hq_ub, fun p₀ v₀ => ?_⟩
    let qP : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ then q ω else 0
    let qV : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if V_obs ω = v₀ then q ω else 0
    let qPV : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀ then q ω else 0
    change qPV ≤ 64 * A * qP * qV
    have hqP_nn : 0 ≤ qP := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hq_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
    have hqV_nn : 0 ≤ qV := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hq_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
    by_cases h_in_s : p₀ ∈ BP_s ∧ v₀ ∈ BV_s
    · obtain ⟨hp₀_s, hv₀_s⟩ := h_in_s
      have hMqP : M * qP = ∑ ω ∈ S_star.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), ν ω := by
        dsimp [qP]; rw [hq_flt, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hM_pos.ne']
      have hMqV : M * qV = ∑ ω ∈ S_star.filter (fun ω => V_obs ω = v₀), ν ω := by
        dsimp [qV]; rw [hq_flt, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hM_pos.ne']
      have hMqPV : M * qPV = ∑ ω ∈ S_star.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀), ν ω := by
        dsimp [qPV]; rw [hq_flt, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hM_pos.ne']
      have hμP_le : μP p₀ ≤ 8 * M * qP := by
        have h1 := h_survP p₀ hp₀_s
        change (1 / 8) * μP p₀ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_star.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), ν ω at h1
        linarith only [h1, hMqP]
      have hμV_le : μV v₀ ≤ 8 * M * qV := by
        have h1 := h_survV v₀ hv₀_s
        change (1 / 8) * μV v₀ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_star.filter (fun ω => V_obs ω = v₀), ν ω at h1
        linarith only [h1, hMqV]
      have h_sub_pv : S_star.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀) ⊆
          S₀.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀) :=
        Finset.filter_subset_filter _ hS_star_sub
      have h_pv_le : M * qPV ≤ A * μP p₀ * μV v₀ := by
        rw [hMqPV]
        calc ∑ ω ∈ S_star.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀), ν ω
            ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S₀.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀), ν ω :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub_pv (fun ω _ _ => hν_nn ω)
          _ = ∑ ω ∈ S₀, if P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀ then ν ω else 0 := Finset.sum_filter _ _
          _ ≤ A * μP p₀ * μV v₀ := h_prod p₀ v₀
      have h_mul_pv : A * μP p₀ * μV v₀ ≤ M * (M * (64 * A * qP * qV)) := by
        have h1 : A * μP p₀ ≤ A * (8 * M * qP) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hμP_le hA
        have h2 : (A * μP p₀) * μV v₀ ≤ (A * (8 * M * qP)) * (8 * M * qV) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 hμV_le (hμV_nn v₀) (mul_nonneg hA (by positivity))
        calc A * μP p₀ * μV v₀
            ≤ (A * (8 * M * qP)) * (8 * M * qV) := h2
          _ = M * (M * (64 * A * qP * qV)) := by ring
      have h_qPV_M : qPV ≤ M * (64 * A * qP * qV) :=
        le_of_mul_le_mul_left (le_trans h_pv_le h_mul_pv) hM_pos
      calc qPV
          ≤ M * (64 * A * qP * qV) := h_qPV_M
        _ ≤ 1 * (64 * A * qP * qV) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM_ub (by positivity)
        _ = 64 * A * qP * qV := one_mul _
    · have h_empty : S_star.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀) = ∅ := by
        rw [Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
        intro ω hω ⟨hp, hv⟩
        have hmem := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        rw [hp, hv] at hmem
        exact h_in_s hmem
      have hqPV_zero : qPV = 0 := by
        dsimp [qPV]; rw [hq_flt, h_empty, Finset.sum_empty, zero_div]
      rw [hqPV_zero]
      positivity

  
  classical
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := by
    refine Real.log_pos ?_
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) < ε⁻¹ := by
      rw [← inv_inv (2 : ℝ)]
      exact inv_strictAnti₀ hε₀ (by linarith only [hε₁])
    linarith only [h2]
  have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ u_blk
  have h_ρ_exp : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.exp (-(t * (u_blk * ell))) = ρ ^ t := by
    intro t
    have hinv : ell = -Real.log ε := Real.log_inv ε
    dsimp [ρ]
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε₀.le, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀]
    congr 1; rw [hinv]; ring
  have hJ_pos : 0 < (J_bins : ℝ) := by dsimp [J_bins]; positivity
  have hD2_pos : 0 < D_cap + 2 := by linarith only [hD_cap]
  have hc_ret_pos : 0 < c_ret := by
    dsimp [c_ret]
    exact div_pos hδ_gap (mul_pos (by linarith only [hD_cap]) hJ_pos)
  have hK_amb_pos : 0 < K_amb := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hK_amb

  let PW : α_W → ℝ := fun w => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if W ω' = w then π ω' else 0
  let PWP : α_W → α_P → ℝ := fun w p => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if W ω' = w ∧ P ω' = p then π ω' else 0
  let PWV : α_W → α_V → ℝ := fun w v => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if W ω' = w ∧ V_obs ω' = v then π ω' else 0
  let PWVP : α_W → α_P → α_V → ℝ := fun w p v =>
    ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if W ω' = w ∧ P ω' = p ∧ V_obs ω' = v then π ω' else 0

  have hPW_nn : ∀ w, 0 ≤ PW w :=
    fun w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ_nn ω'])
  have hPWP_nn : ∀ w p, 0 ≤ PWP w p :=
    fun w p => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ_nn ω'])
  have hPWV_nn : ∀ w v, 0 ≤ PWV w v :=
    fun w v => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ_nn ω'])

  have h_prob_W : ∀ ω, finProbAt π W ω = PW (W ω) := by
    intro ω; unfold finProbAt; dsimp [PW]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : W ω' = W ω <;> simp [h]
  have h_prob_WP : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 π W P ω = PWP (W ω) (P ω) := by
    intro ω; unfold finProbAt2; dsimp [PWP]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hp : P ω' = P ω <;> simp [hw, hp]
  have h_prob_WV : ∀ ω, finProbAt π (fun ω' => (W ω', V_obs ω')) ω = PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) := by
    intro ω; unfold finProbAt; dsimp [PWV]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hv : V_obs ω' = V_obs ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, hw, hv]
  have h_prob_WVP : ∀ ω,
      finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (W ω', V_obs ω')) P ω = PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) := by
    intro ω; unfold finProbAt2; dsimp [PWVP]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hp : P ω' = P ω <;>
      by_cases hv : V_obs ω' = V_obs ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, hw, hp, hv]

  let S_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π ω)
  have h_mem_Sp : ∀ ω, ω ∈ S_pos ↔ 0 < π ω := fun ω => by simp [S_pos]
  have hπ_zero_out : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S_pos → π ω = 0 := fun ω hnot =>
    le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot ((h_mem_Sp ω).mpr hp))) (hπ_nn ω)
  have hSp_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω = 1 := by
    rw [← hπ_sum, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos)]
    intro ω _ hnot; exact hπ_zero_out ω hnot

  have h_atom_bds : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos,
      0 < PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) ∧
      PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) ≤ PWP (W ω) (P ω) ∧
      PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) ≤ PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) ∧
      PWP (W ω) (P ω) ≤ PW (W ω) ∧
      PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) ≤ PW (W ω) := by
    intro ω hω
    have hpos : 0 < π ω := (h_mem_Sp ω).mp hω
    have h1 : 0 < PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) := by
      have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => if W ω' = W ω ∧ P ω' = P ω ∧ V_obs ω' = V_obs ω then π ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ_nn ω']) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      simp only [and_self, ↓reduceIte] at hle
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle
    refine ⟨h1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hp : P ω' = P ω <;>
        by_cases hv : V_obs ω' = V_obs ω <;> simp [hw, hp, hv, hπ_nn ω']
    · refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hp : P ω' = P ω <;>
        by_cases hv : V_obs ω' = V_obs ω <;> simp [hw, hp, hv, hπ_nn ω']
    · refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hp : P ω' = P ω <;> simp [hw, hp, hπ_nn ω']
    · refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hv : V_obs ω' = V_obs ω <;> simp [hw, hv, hπ_nn ω']

  
  let r : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
    (PWP (W ω) (P ω) * PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω)) /
      (PW (W ω) * PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω))
  have hr_pos : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos, 0 < r ω := by
    intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨hWVP, hWVP_WP, hWVP_WV, hWP_W, _⟩ := h_atom_bds ω hω
    have hWP : 0 < PWP (W ω) (P ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP hWVP_WP
    have hWV : 0 < PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP hWVP_WV
    have hW : 0 < PW (W ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWP hWP_W
    exact div_pos (mul_pos hWP hWV) (mul_pos hW hWVP)

  have h_cmi_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) ≤ ζ_MI * u_blk * ell := by
    have h_eq : finCondMutualInfo ε π W V_obs P =
        (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (r ω))) / ell := by
      unfold finCondMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
      change (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π W P ω / finProbAt π W ω)) / ell)) -
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (W ω', V_obs ω')) P ω /
            finProbAt π (fun ω' => (W ω', V_obs ω')) ω)) / ell)) = _
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos), Finset.sum_div]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        rw [h_prob_W, h_prob_WP, h_prob_WV, h_prob_WVP]
        obtain ⟨hWVP, hWVP_WP, hWVP_WV, hWP_W, _⟩ := h_atom_bds ω hω
        have hWP : 0 < PWP (W ω) (P ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP hWVP_WP
        have hWV : 0 < PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP hWVP_WV
        have hW : 0 < PW (W ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWP hWP_W
        have h1_pos : 0 < PWP (W ω) (P ω) / PW (W ω) := div_pos hWP hW
        have h2_pos : 0 < PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) / PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) := div_pos hWVP hWV
        have hr_div : r ω = (PWP (W ω) (P ω) / PW (W ω)) /
            (PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) / PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω)) := by
          dsimp [r]; field_simp [hW.ne', hWV.ne', hWVP.ne']
        rw [hr_div, Real.log_div h1_pos.ne' h2_pos.ne']
        ring
      · intro ω _ hnot; simp [hπ_zero_out ω hnot]
    rw [h_eq, div_le_iff₀ hell_pos] at h_cmi
    exact h_cmi

  have hr_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * r ω ≤ 1 := by
    let IW := S_pos.image W
    let IP := S_pos.image P
    let IV := S_pos.image V_obs
    have h_fib := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
      (s := S_pos) (t := IW ×ˢ (IP ×ˢ IV)) (g := fun ω => (W ω, (P ω, V_obs ω)))
      (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem W hω,
        Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem P hω, Finset.mem_image_of_mem V_obs hω⟩⟩)
      (fun ω => π ω * r ω)).symm
    rw [h_fib]
    have h_cell : ∀ t ∈ IW ×ˢ (IP ×ˢ IV),
        (∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => (W ω, (P ω, V_obs ω)) = t), π ω * r ω) ≤
          (PWP t.1 t.2.1 * PWV t.1 t.2.2) / PW t.1 := by
      intro ⟨w, p, v⟩ _
      let F_t := S_pos.filter (fun ω => (W ω, (P ω, V_obs ω)) = (w, (p, v)))
      change (∑ ω ∈ F_t, π ω * r ω) ≤ (PWP w p * PWV w v) / PW w
      by_cases hne : F_t.Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
        obtain ⟨hω₀_sp, heq₀⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
        have hw₀ : W ω₀ = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq₀).1
        have hp₀ : P ω₀ = p := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq₀).2).1
        have hv₀ : V_obs ω₀ = v := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq₀).2).2
        obtain ⟨hWVP₀, hWVP_WP₀, _, hWP_W₀, _⟩ := h_atom_bds ω₀ hω₀_sp
        rw [hw₀, hp₀, hv₀] at hWVP₀ hWVP_WP₀
        rw [hw₀, hp₀] at hWP_W₀
        have hPW_pos : 0 < PW w := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP₀ (le_trans hWVP_WP₀ hWP_W₀)
        have hFt_sum : ∑ ω ∈ F_t, π ω = PWVP w p v := by
          dsimp [PWVP]
          rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos)]
          · dsimp [F_t]; rw [Finset.sum_filter]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            simp only [Prod.ext_iff]
          · intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hπ_zero_out ω' hnot]
        have h_congr : ∑ ω ∈ F_t, π ω * r ω =
            ∑ ω ∈ F_t, π ω * ((PWP w p * PWV w v) / (PW w * PWVP w p v)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
          have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
          have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
          have hp : P ω = p := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).1
          have hv : V_obs ω = v := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).2
          dsimp [r]; rw [hw, hp, hv]
        rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul, hFt_sum]
        have h_eq : PWVP w p v * ((PWP w p * PWV w v) / (PW w * PWVP w p v)) =
            (PWP w p * PWV w v) / PW w := by
          field_simp [hPW_pos.ne', hWVP₀.ne']
        exact h_eq.le
      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
        exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hPWP_nn w p) (hPWV_nn w v)) (hPW_nn w)
    have h_sum_w : ∀ w ∈ IW,
        (∑ pv ∈ IP ×ˢ IV, (PWP w pv.1 * PWV w pv.2) / PW w) = PW w := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨ω_w, hω_w_sp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
      obtain ⟨hWVP_w, hWVP_WP_w, _, hWP_W_w, _⟩ := h_atom_bds ω_w hω_w_sp
      have hPW_pos : 0 < PW (W ω_w) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP_w (le_trans hWVP_WP_w hWP_W_w)
      have h_sum_p : ∑ p ∈ IP, PWP (W ω_w) p = PW (W ω_w) := by
        dsimp [PWP, PW]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hsp : ω' ∈ S_pos
        · have hp_in : P ω' ∈ IP := Finset.mem_image_of_mem P hsp
          by_cases hw_eq : W ω' = W ω_w <;> simp [hw_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq, hp_in]
        · simp [hπ_zero_out ω' hsp]
      have h_sum_v : ∑ v ∈ IV, PWV (W ω_w) v = PW (W ω_w) := by
        dsimp [PWV, PW]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hsp : ω' ∈ S_pos
        · have hv_in : V_obs ω' ∈ IV := Finset.mem_image_of_mem V_obs hsp
          by_cases hw_eq : W ω' = W ω_w <;> simp [hw_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq, hv_in]
        · simp [hπ_zero_out ω' hsp]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_product]
      dsimp only
      have h_prod_pv : (∑ p ∈ IP, ∑ v ∈ IV, PWP (W ω_w) p * PWV (W ω_w) v) =
          (∑ p ∈ IP, PWP (W ω_w) p) * (∑ v ∈ IV, PWV (W ω_w) v) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm)
      rw [h_prod_pv, h_sum_p, h_sum_v]
      field_simp [hPW_pos.ne']
    have h_tot_w : ∑ w ∈ IW, PW w = 1 := by
      dsimp [PW]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos)]
      · have h1 : ∑ ω' ∈ S_pos, ∑ w ∈ IW, (if W ω' = w then π ω' else 0) = ∑ ω' ∈ S_pos, π ω' := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
          have hw_in : W ω' ∈ IW := Finset.mem_image_of_mem W hω'
          simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hw_in]
        rw [h1]; exact hSp_sum
      · intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hπ_zero_out ω' hnot]
    calc ∑ t ∈ IW ×ˢ (IP ×ˢ IV),
            ∑ ω ∈ S_pos.filter (fun ω => (W ω, (P ω, V_obs ω)) = t), π ω * r ω
        ≤ ∑ t ∈ IW ×ˢ (IP ×ˢ IV), (PWP t.1 t.2.1 * PWV t.1 t.2.2) / PW t.1 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_cell
      _ = ∑ w ∈ IW, ∑ pv ∈ IP ×ˢ IV, (PWP w pv.1 * PWV w pv.2) / PW w := by
          rw [Finset.sum_product]
      _ = ∑ w ∈ IW, PW w := Finset.sum_congr rfl h_sum_w
      _ = 1 := h_tot_w

  let E_KL : Finset (Fin N_ω) := S_pos.filter (fun ω => ρ ^ ζ ≤ r ω)
  let B_KL : Finset (Fin N_ω) := S_pos.filter (fun ω => ¬ (ρ ^ ζ ≤ r ω))
  have hE_KL_mass : 1 - δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_KL, π ω := by
    have h_pt_nn : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos, 0 ≤ π ω * (-Real.log (r ω) + r ω) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (hr_pos ω hω)
      exact mul_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) (by linarith only [hlog])
    have h_bad_pt : ∀ ω ∈ B_KL, π ω * (ζ * u_blk * ell) ≤ π ω * (-Real.log (r ω) + r ω) := by
      intro ω hω
      obtain ⟨hω_sp, hnot_ge⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
      have hr_lt : r ω < ρ ^ ζ := lt_of_not_ge hnot_ge
      have hr_p : 0 < r ω := hr_pos ω hω_sp
      have hlog_le : Real.log (r ω) ≤ -(ζ * (u_blk * ell)) := by
        have h1 := Real.log_le_log hr_p hr_lt.le
        rw [← h_ρ_exp ζ, Real.log_exp] at h1
        exact h1
      have h_in : ζ * u_blk * ell ≤ -Real.log (r ω) + r ω := by
        have : ζ * u_blk * ell = ζ * (u_blk * ell) := by ring
        linarith only [hlog_le, hr_p, this]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_in (hπ_nn ω)
    have h_bad_sum : (∑ ω ∈ B_KL, π ω) * (ζ * u_blk * ell) ≤ ζ_MI * u_blk * ell + 1 := by
      calc (∑ ω ∈ B_KL, π ω) * (ζ * u_blk * ell)
          = ∑ ω ∈ B_KL, π ω * (ζ * u_blk * ell) := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ B_KL, π ω * (-Real.log (r ω) + r ω) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_bad_pt
        _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (r ω) + r ω) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
              (fun ω hω _ => h_pt_nn ω hω)
        _ = (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * (-Real.log (r ω))) + (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * r ω) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
        _ ≤ ζ_MI * u_blk * ell + 1 := add_le_add h_cmi_sum hr_sum
    have hζul_pos : 0 < ζ * u_blk * ell := mul_pos (mul_pos hζ hu_blk) hell_pos
    have h_bad_ub : ∑ ω ∈ B_KL, π ω ≤ δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2)) := by
      have h1 : ∑ ω ∈ B_KL, π ω ≤ (ζ_MI * u_blk * ell + 1) / (ζ * u_blk * ell) :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hζul_pos).mpr h_bad_sum
      have h2 : (ζ_MI * u_blk * ell + 1) / (ζ * u_blk * ell) =
          ζ_MI / ζ + 1 / (ζ * u_blk * ell) := by
        rw [add_div]
        congr 1
        have hul_ne : u_blk * ell ≠ 0 := (mul_pos hu_blk hell_pos).ne'
        field_simp [hζ.ne', hu_blk.ne', hell_pos.ne']
      rw [h2] at h1
      exact le_trans h1 h_mi_err
    have h_split := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S_pos (fun ω => ρ ^ ζ ≤ r ω) π
    rw [hSp_sum] at h_split
    linarith only [h_split, h_bad_ub]

  have hE_KL_ineq : ∀ ω ∈ E_KL,
      PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) * PW (W ω) ≤
        ρ ^ (-ζ) * PWP (W ω) (P ω) * PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) := by
    intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨hω_sp, hr_ge⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
    obtain ⟨hWVP, hWVP_WP, _, hWP_W, _⟩ := h_atom_bds ω hω_sp
    have hW : 0 < PW (W ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP (le_trans hWVP_WP hWP_W)
    have hden_pos : 0 < PW (W ω) * PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) := mul_pos hW hWVP
    have h1 : ρ ^ ζ * (PW (W ω) * PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω)) ≤
        PWP (W ω) (P ω) * PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) := (le_div_iff₀ hden_pos).mp hr_ge
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos (-ζ)).le
    have h_canc : ρ ^ (-ζ) * (ρ ^ ζ * (PW (W ω) * PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω))) =
        PWVP (W ω) (P ω) (V_obs ω) * PW (W ω) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hρ_pos, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul, mul_comm]
    linarith only [h2, h_canc,
      show ρ ^ (-ζ) * (PWP (W ω) (P ω) * PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω)) =
        ρ ^ (-ζ) * PWP (W ω) (P ω) * PWV (W ω) (V_obs ω) by ring]

  
  let E_in : Finset (Fin N_ω) := E_allow ∩ E_KL
  have hE_in_mass : 1 - δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2)) ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_in, π ω := by
    have h_ui := Finset.sum_union_inter (s₁ := E_allow) (s₂ := E_KL) (f := π)
    have h_u_le : ∑ ω ∈ E_allow ∪ E_KL, π ω ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← hπ_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun ω _ _ => hπ_nn ω)
    have h_alg : (1 - δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2))) + (1 - δ_gap / (32 * (D_cap + 2))) - 1 =
        1 - δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2)) := by
      field_simp [hD2_pos.ne']
      ring
    change _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_allow ∩ E_KL, π ω
    linarith only [h_ui, h_u_le, hE_allow, hE_KL_mass, h_alg]

  let d : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => condSurprise ε π W P ω / u_blk
  have hd_eq : ∀ ω, d ω = -Real.log (PWP (W ω) (P ω) / PW (W ω)) / (u_blk * ell) := by
    intro ω
    dsimp [d, condSurprise]
    rw [h_prob_WP, h_prob_W, div_div, mul_comm ell u_blk]
  have hd_nn : ∀ ω ∈ S_pos, 0 ≤ d ω := by
    intro ω hω
    rw [hd_eq]
    obtain ⟨hWVP, hWVP_WP, _, hWP_W, _⟩ := h_atom_bds ω hω
    have hWP : 0 < PWP (W ω) (P ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP hWVP_WP
    have hW : 0 < PW (W ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWP hWP_W
    have hlog_np : Real.log (PWP (W ω) (P ω) / PW (W ω)) ≤ 0 :=
      Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg hWP.le hW.le) ((div_le_one hW).mpr hWP_W)
    exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hlog_np) (mul_pos hu_blk hell_pos).le
  have hd_sum_le : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * d ω ≤ p_hi - δ_gap := by
    have h_eq : ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, π ω * d ω = finCondEntropy ε π W P / u_blk := by
      unfold finCondEntropy; dsimp [d]
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos), Finset.sum_div]
      · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
      · intro ω _ hnot; simp [hπ_zero_out ω hnot]
    rw [h_eq, div_le_iff₀ hu_blk]
    exact h_ent

  let T : ℝ := p_hi - δ_gap / 2
  let E_low : Finset (Fin N_ω) := S_pos.filter (fun ω => d ω ≤ T)
  let E_high : Finset (Fin N_ω) := S_pos.filter (fun ω => ¬ (d ω ≤ T))
  let m_low : ℝ := ∑ ω ∈ E_low, π ω
  have hm_low_nn : 0 ≤ m_low := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hπ_nn ω)
  have hm_low_lb : δ_gap / (2 * (D_cap + 2)) ≤ m_low := by
    have h_part := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S_pos (fun ω => d ω ≤ T) π
    rw [hSp_sum] at h_part
    have h_high_lb : (∑ ω ∈ E_high, π ω) * T ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_high, π ω * d ω := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => ?_)
      have hgt : T ≤ d ω := le_of_not_ge (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgt (hπ_nn ω)
    have h_low_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_low, π ω * d ω :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω hω => mul_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) (hd_nn ω (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1))
    have h_d_part := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S_pos (fun ω => d ω ≤ T) (fun ω => π ω * d ω)
    have h_Tm : δ_gap / 2 ≤ m_low * T := by
      have h1 : (1 - m_low) * T = (∑ ω ∈ E_high, π ω) * T := by
        congr 1; linarith only [h_part]
      have h2 : p_hi - δ_gap = T - δ_gap / 2 := by dsimp [T]; ring
      have h3 : (1 - m_low) * T = T - m_low * T := by ring
      linarith only [h1, h2, h3, h_high_lb, h_low_nn, h_d_part, hd_sum_le]
    have hT_le : T ≤ D_cap + 2 := by dsimp [T]; linarith only [hp_hi_D, hδ_gap]
    have h_mD : m_low * T ≤ m_low * (D_cap + 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT_le hm_low_nn
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith only [hD2_pos] : 0 < 2 * (D_cap + 2))]
    linarith only [h_Tm, h_mD, show m_low * (2 * (D_cap + 2)) = 2 * (m_low * (D_cap + 2)) by ring]

  let E_cand : Finset (Fin N_ω) := E_low ∩ E_in
  have hE_cand_mass : 2 * (J_bins : ℝ) * c_ret ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_cand, π ω := by
    have h_ui := Finset.sum_union_inter (s₁ := E_low) (s₂ := E_in) (f := π)
    have h_u_le : ∑ ω ∈ E_low ∪ E_in, π ω ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← hπ_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun ω _ _ => hπ_nn ω)
    have h_2Jc : 2 * (J_bins : ℝ) * c_ret = δ_gap / (8 * (D_cap + 2)) := by
      dsimp [c_ret]
      field_simp [hD2_pos.ne', hJ_pos.ne']
      ring
    have h_7_2 : δ_gap / (8 * (D_cap + 2)) ≤
        δ_gap / (2 * (D_cap + 2)) + (1 - δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2))) - 1 := by
      have h1 : δ_gap / (2 * (D_cap + 2)) + (1 - δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2))) - 1 -
          δ_gap / (8 * (D_cap + 2)) = 5 * (δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2))) := by
        field_simp [hD2_pos.ne']
        ring
      have hpos16 : 0 < δ_gap / (16 * (D_cap + 2)) := div_pos hδ_gap (by linarith only [hD2_pos])
      linarith only [h1, hpos16]
    rw [h_2Jc]
    change _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_low ∩ E_in, π ω
    linarith only [h_ui, h_u_le, hm_low_lb, hE_in_mass, h_7_2]

  let j_bin : Fin N_ω → ℕ := fun ω => ⌊d ω / ζ⌋₊
  have hj_maps : ∀ ω ∈ E_cand, j_bin ω ∈ Finset.range J_bins := by
    intro ω hω
    have hω_low : ω ∈ E_low := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hω).1
    obtain ⟨hω_sp, hd_le_T⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_low
    have hd_le_D : d ω ≤ D_cap + 2 := le_trans hd_le_T (by dsimp [T]; linarith only [hp_hi_D, hδ_gap])
    have h_fl : (j_bin ω : ℝ) ≤ (⌈(D_cap + 2) / ζ⌉₊ : ℝ) := by
      calc (j_bin ω : ℝ)
          ≤ d ω / ζ := Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (hd_nn ω hω_sp) hζ.le)
        _ ≤ (D_cap + 2) / ζ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hd_le_D hζ.le
        _ ≤ (⌈(D_cap + 2) / ζ⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    have h_nat : j_bin ω ≤ ⌈(D_cap + 2) / ζ⌉₊ := by exact_mod_cast h_fl
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    dsimp [J_bins]; omega

  let bin_mass : ℕ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ ω ∈ E_cand.filter (fun ω => j_bin ω = b), π ω
  obtain ⟨j_star, hj_star_mem, hj_star_max⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_max_image (Finset.range J_bins) bin_mass ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by dsimp [J_bins]; omega)⟩
  let p_star : ℝ := (j_star : ℝ) * ζ
  let E_good : Finset (Fin N_ω) := E_cand.filter (fun ω => j_bin ω = j_star)

  have hE_good_mass : 2 * c_ret ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_good, π ω := by
    have h_fib := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hj_maps π).symm
    have h_sum_le : ∑ ω ∈ E_cand, π ω ≤ (J_bins : ℝ) * bin_mass j_star := by
      rw [h_fib]
      calc ∑ b ∈ Finset.range J_bins, bin_mass b
          ≤ ∑ _b ∈ Finset.range J_bins, bin_mass j_star := Finset.sum_le_sum hj_star_max
        _ = (J_bins : ℝ) * bin_mass j_star := by
            simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h1 : (J_bins : ℝ) * (2 * c_ret) ≤ (J_bins : ℝ) * bin_mass j_star := by
      linarith only [hE_cand_mass, h_sum_le, show 2 * (J_bins : ℝ) * c_ret = (J_bins : ℝ) * (2 * c_ret) by ring]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h1 hJ_pos

  have hp_star_nn : 0 ≤ p_star := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg j_star) hζ.le
  have hE_good_allow : E_good ⊆ E_allow := fun ω hω =>
    (Finset.mem_inter.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1).2).1
  have hE_good_KL : E_good ⊆ E_KL := fun ω hω =>
    (Finset.mem_inter.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1).2).2
  have hE_good_low : E_good ⊆ E_low := fun ω hω =>
    (Finset.mem_inter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1).1
  have hE_good_pos : ∀ ω ∈ E_good, 0 < π ω := fun ω hω =>
    (h_mem_Sp ω).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hE_good_KL hω)).1

  have hp_star_hi : p_star ≤ p_hi - δ_gap / 2 := by
    have h_ne : E_good.Nonempty := by
      by_contra h_emp
      rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h_emp, Finset.sum_empty] at hE_good_mass
      linarith only [hE_good_mass, hc_ret_pos]
    obtain ⟨ω_s, hω_s⟩ := h_ne
    obtain ⟨hω_s_sp, hd_s_le⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp (hE_good_low hω_s)
    have hj_eq : j_bin ω_s = j_star := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_s).2
    have h_fl : (j_star : ℝ) ≤ d ω_s / ζ := by
      rw [← hj_eq]
      exact Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (hd_nn ω_s hω_s_sp) hζ.le)
    exact le_trans ((le_div_iff₀ hζ).mp h_fl) hd_s_le

  have hE_good_PWP : ∀ ω ∈ E_good,
      PWP (W ω) (P ω) ≤ ρ ^ p_star * PW (W ω) ∧
      ρ ^ (p_star + ζ) * PW (W ω) ≤ PWP (W ω) (P ω) := by
    intro ω hω
    have hω_sp : ω ∈ S_pos := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hE_good_low hω)).1
    have hj_eq : j_bin ω = j_star := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
    obtain ⟨hWVP, hWVP_WP, _, hWP_W, _⟩ := h_atom_bds ω hω_sp
    have hWP : 0 < PWP (W ω) (P ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWVP hWVP_WP
    have hW : 0 < PW (W ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hWP hWP_W
    have hrat_pos : 0 < PWP (W ω) (P ω) / PW (W ω) := div_pos hWP hW
    have hul_pos : 0 < u_blk * ell := mul_pos hu_blk hell_pos
    have hd_lb : p_star ≤ d ω := by
      have h1 : (j_star : ℝ) ≤ d ω / ζ := by
        rw [← hj_eq]; exact Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (hd_nn ω hω_sp) hζ.le)
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hζ).mp h1
    have hd_ub : d ω < p_star + ζ := by
      have h1 : d ω / ζ < (j_star : ℝ) + 1 := by
        rw [← hj_eq]; exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one (d ω / ζ)
      have h2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hζ).mp h1
      linarith only [h2, show ((j_star : ℝ) + 1) * ζ = p_star + ζ by dsimp [p_star]; ring]
    constructor
    · have hlog_le : Real.log (PWP (W ω) (P ω) / PW (W ω)) ≤ -(p_star * (u_blk * ell)) := by
        rw [hd_eq] at hd_lb
        have h1 := (le_div_iff₀ hul_pos).mp hd_lb
        linarith only [h1]
      have hexp_le := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog_le
      rw [Real.exp_log hrat_pos, h_ρ_exp p_star] at hexp_le
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hW).mp hexp_le
    · have hlog_gt : -((p_star + ζ) * (u_blk * ell)) < Real.log (PWP (W ω) (P ω) / PW (W ω)) := by
        rw [hd_eq] at hd_ub
        have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hul_pos).mp hd_ub
        linarith only [h1]
      have hexp_lt := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hlog_gt
      rw [Real.exp_log hrat_pos, h_ρ_exp (p_star + ζ)] at hexp_lt
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hW).mp hexp_lt.le

  
  let PW_amb : α_W → ℝ := fun w => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if W ω' = w then π_amb ω' else 0
  have hPW_amb_nn : ∀ w, 0 ≤ PW_amb w :=
    fun w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ_amb_nn ω'])
  let Ew_fn : α_W → Finset (Fin N_ω) := fun w => E_good.filter (fun ω => W ω = w)
  let mw_fn : α_W → ℝ := fun w => ∑ ω ∈ Ew_fn w, π ω
  let IW_good : Finset α_W := E_good.image W
  let G_W : Finset α_W :=
    IW_good.filter (fun w => (c_ret / 4) * PW w ≤ mw_fn w ∧ (c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w ≤ mw_fn w)
  let B_W : Finset α_W :=
    IW_good.filter (fun w => ¬ ((c_ret / 4) * PW w ≤ mw_fn w ∧ (c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w ≤ mw_fn w))

  have hG_W_mass : c_ret / 2 ≤ ∑ w ∈ G_W, ∑ ω ∈ E_good, (if W ω = w then π ω else 0) := by
    have h_fib_W : ∑ w ∈ IW_good, mw_fn w = ∑ ω ∈ E_good, π ω :=
      Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem W hω) π
    have h_part_W := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not IW_good
      (fun w => (c_ret / 4) * PW w ≤ mw_fn w ∧ (c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w ≤ mw_fn w) mw_fn
    have h_bad_pt : ∀ w ∈ B_W, mw_fn w ≤ (c_ret / 4) * PW w + (c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w := by
      intro w hw
      have hnot := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).2
      have h1_nn : 0 ≤ (c_ret / 4) * PW w := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hPW_nn w)
      have h2_nn : 0 ≤ (c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hPW_amb_nn w)
      by_cases hc1 : (c_ret / 4) * PW w ≤ mw_fn w
      · have hc2 : mw_fn w < (c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w :=
          lt_of_not_ge (fun hc2 => hnot ⟨hc1, hc2⟩)
        linarith only [hc2, h1_nn]
      · linarith only [lt_of_not_ge hc1, h2_nn]
    have h_PW_B : ∑ w ∈ B_W, PW w ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [PW]; rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← hπ_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hmem : W ω' ∈ B_W
      · simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hmem]
      · simp [hmem, hπ_nn ω']
    have h_PW_amb_B : ∑ w ∈ B_W, PW_amb w ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [PW_amb]; rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← hπ_amb_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hmem : W ω' ∈ B_W
      · simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hmem]
      · simp [hmem, hπ_amb_nn ω']
    have h_bad_ub : ∑ w ∈ B_W, mw_fn w ≤ (3 / 4) * c_ret := by
      calc ∑ w ∈ B_W, mw_fn w
          ≤ ∑ w ∈ B_W, ((c_ret / 4) * PW w + (c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_bad_pt
        _ = (c_ret / 4) * (∑ w ∈ B_W, PW w) + (c_ret / 2) * (∑ w ∈ B_W, PW_amb w) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ ≤ (c_ret / 4) * 1 + (c_ret / 2) * 1 :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_PW_B (by positivity))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_PW_amb_B (by positivity))
        _ = (3 / 4) * c_ret := by ring
    have h_eq_gw : ∑ w ∈ G_W, ∑ ω ∈ E_good, (if W ω = w then π ω else 0) = ∑ w ∈ G_W, mw_fn w :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm)
    rw [h_eq_gw]
    change ∑ w ∈ G_W, mw_fn w + ∑ w ∈ B_W, mw_fn w = _ at h_part_W
    linarith only [h_fib_W, h_part_W, hE_good_mass, h_bad_ub, hc_ret_pos]

  refine ⟨p_star, E_good, G_W, hp_star_nn, hp_star_hi, hE_good_allow, hE_good_pos, hG_W_mass, ?_⟩
  intro w hw_GW
  let E_w : Finset (Fin N_ω) := E_good.filter (fun ω => W ω = w)
  let m_w : ℝ := ∑ ω ∈ E_w, π ω
  obtain ⟨hw_img, hmw_PW, hmw_PW_amb⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hw_GW
  change (c_ret / 4) * PW w ≤ m_w at hmw_PW
  change (c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w ≤ m_w at hmw_PW_amb
  obtain ⟨ω_w, hω_w_good, hw_eq_ω⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw_img
  have hω_w_Ew : ω_w ∈ E_w := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω_w_good, hw_eq_ω⟩
  have hm_w_pos : 0 < m_w := by
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (s := E_w) (f := π) (fun ω _ => hπ_nn ω) hω_w_Ew
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hE_good_pos ω_w hω_w_good) hle
  have hmw_le_PW : m_w ≤ PW w := by
    dsimp [m_w, PW, E_w]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2⟩)
      (fun ω _ _ => hπ_nn ω)
  have hPW_w_pos : 0 < PW w := lt_of_lt_of_le hm_w_pos hmw_le_PW
  have hPW_div_mw : PW w / m_w ≤ 4 / c_ret := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hm_w_pos hc_ret_pos]
    linarith only [hmw_PW]

  have hcard_Ew_P : ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) ≤ ρ ^ (-(p_star + ζ)) := by
    have h_each_p : ∀ p ∈ E_w.image P, ρ ^ (p_star + ζ) * PW w ≤ PWP w p := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨ω_p, hω_p_Ew, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain ⟨hω_p_good, hw_p⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_p_Ew
      have hlb := (hE_good_PWP ω_p hω_p_good).2
      rwa [hw_p] at hlb
    have h_sum_p : ∑ p ∈ E_w.image P, PWP w p ≤ PW w := by
      dsimp [PWP, PW]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hw' : W ω' = w
      · by_cases hp' : P ω' ∈ E_w.image P
        · simp [hw', Finset.sum_ite_eq, hp']
        · simp [hw', hp', hπ_nn ω']
      · simp [hw']
    have h_card_mul : ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) * (ρ ^ (p_star + ζ) * PW w) ≤ 1 * PW w := by
      rw [one_mul]
      calc ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) * (ρ ^ (p_star + ζ) * PW w)
          = ∑ _p ∈ E_w.image P, (ρ ^ (p_star + ζ) * PW w) := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ E_w.image P, PWP w p := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_p
        _ ≤ PW w := h_sum_p
    have h1 : ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) * ρ ^ (p_star + ζ) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← mul_assoc] at h_card_mul
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_card_mul hPW_w_pos
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos (-(p_star + ζ))).le
    have h_canc : ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) * ρ ^ (p_star + ζ) * ρ ^ (-(p_star + ζ)) =
        ((E_w.image P).card : ℝ) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hρ_pos, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
    linarith only [h2, h_canc, one_mul (ρ ^ (-(p_star + ζ)))]

  
  let PPar_amb : α_Par → ℝ := fun u => ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if Par ω' = u then π_amb ω' else 0
  let EwPar_amb : α_Par → ℝ := fun u => ∑ ω' ∈ E_w, if Par ω' = u then π_amb ω' else 0
  let S₀ : Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
    E_w.filter (fun ω => (c_ret / (16 * K_amb)) * PPar_amb (Par ω) ≤ EwPar_amb (Par ω))
  let E_bad : Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
    E_w.filter (fun ω => ¬ ((c_ret / (16 * K_amb)) * PPar_amb (Par ω) ≤ EwPar_amb (Par ω)))
  have hS₀_sub_Ew : S₀ ⊆ E_w := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hS₀_mass_ub : ∑ ω ∈ S₀, π ω ≤ m_w :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hS₀_sub_Ew (fun ω _ _ => hπ_nn ω)
  have hS₀_mass_lb : (7 / 8) * m_w ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S₀, π ω := by
    let B_Par : Finset α_Par := E_bad.image Par
    have h_fib_par : ∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω =
        ∑ u ∈ B_Par, ∑ ω ∈ E_bad.filter (fun ω => Par ω = u), π ω :=
      (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Par hω) π).symm
    have h_each_u : ∀ u ∈ B_Par,
        (∑ ω ∈ E_bad.filter (fun ω => Par ω = u), π ω) ≤ (c_ret / 16) * PPar_amb u := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨ω_u, hω_u_bad, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
      have hnot := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_u_bad).2
      have h_ew_lt : EwPar_amb (Par ω_u) ≤ (c_ret / (16 * K_amb)) * PPar_amb (Par ω_u) :=
        (lt_of_not_ge hnot).le
      have h_sub_u : E_bad.filter (fun ω => Par ω = Par ω_u) ⊆
          E_w.filter (fun ω => Par ω = Par ω_u) :=
        Finset.filter_subset_filter _ (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      calc ∑ ω ∈ E_bad.filter (fun ω => Par ω = Par ω_u), π ω
          ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_bad.filter (fun ω => Par ω = Par ω_u), K_amb * π_amb ω :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => hπ_le_amb ω)
        _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_w.filter (fun ω => Par ω = Par ω_u), K_amb * π_amb ω :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub_u
              (fun ω _ _ => mul_nonneg hK_amb_pos.le (hπ_amb_nn ω))
        _ = K_amb * EwPar_amb (Par ω_u) := by
            dsimp [EwPar_amb]; rw [← Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ ≤ K_amb * ((c_ret / (16 * K_amb)) * PPar_amb (Par ω_u)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ew_lt hK_amb_pos.le
        _ = (c_ret / 16) * PPar_amb (Par ω_u) := by
            field_simp [hK_amb_pos.ne']
    have h_sum_par_W : ∑ u ∈ B_Par, PPar_amb u ≤ PW_amb w := by
      dsimp [PPar_amb, PW_amb]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hu_mem : Par ω' ∈ B_Par
      · obtain ⟨ω_u, hω_u_bad, hpar_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu_mem
        have hw_u : W ω_u = w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_u_bad).1).2
        have hw' : W ω' = w := (hPar_W ω' ω_u hpar_eq.symm).trans hw_u
        simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hu_mem, hw']
      · simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hu_mem]
        split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ_amb_nn ω']
    have h_bad_par_ub : ∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω ≤ (1 / 8) * m_w := by
      rw [h_fib_par]
      calc ∑ u ∈ B_Par, ∑ ω ∈ E_bad.filter (fun ω => Par ω = u), π ω
          ≤ ∑ u ∈ B_Par, (c_ret / 16) * PPar_amb u := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_u
        _ = (c_ret / 16) * ∑ u ∈ B_Par, PPar_amb u := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ (c_ret / 16) * PW_amb w := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_par_W (by positivity)
        _ = (1 / 8) * ((c_ret / 2) * PW_amb w) := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 8) * m_w := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmw_PW_amb (by norm_num)
    have h_part_S₀ := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not E_w
      (fun ω => (c_ret / (16 * K_amb)) * PPar_amb (Par ω) ≤ EwPar_amb (Par ω)) π
    change ∑ ω ∈ S₀, π ω + ∑ ω ∈ E_bad, π ω = m_w at h_part_S₀
    linarith only [h_part_S₀, h_bad_par_ub]

  
  let ν : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => π ω / m_w
  let μP : α_P → ℝ := fun p => PWP w p / PW w
  let μV : α_V → ℝ := fun v => PWV w v / PW w
  let A : ℝ := (4 / c_ret) * ρ ^ (-ζ)

  have hA_nn : 0 ≤ A :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos (-ζ)).le
  have hν_lb : 7 / 8 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω := by
    dsimp [ν]; rw [← Finset.sum_div, le_div_iff₀ hm_w_pos]
    exact hS₀_mass_lb
  have hν_ub : ∑ ω ∈ S₀, ν ω ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [ν]; rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_le_one hm_w_pos]
    exact hS₀_mass_ub
  have hμP_sum : ∑ p ∈ S₀.image P, μP p ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [μP]; rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_le_one hPW_w_pos]
    dsimp [PWP, PW]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw' : W ω' = w
    · by_cases hp' : P ω' ∈ S₀.image P
      · simp [hw', Finset.sum_ite_eq, hp']
      · simp [hw', hp', hπ_nn ω']
    · simp [hw']
  have hμV_sum : ∑ v ∈ S₀.image V_obs, μV v ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [μV]; rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_le_one hPW_w_pos]
    dsimp [PWV, PW]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw' : W ω' = w
    · by_cases hv' : V_obs ω' ∈ S₀.image V_obs
      · simp [hw', Finset.sum_ite_eq, hv']
      · simp [hw', hv', hπ_nn ω']
    · simp [hw']
  have h_prod_S₀ : ∀ p₀ v₀,
      (∑ ω ∈ S₀, if P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀ then ν ω else 0) ≤ A * μP p₀ * μV v₀ := by
    intro p₀ v₀
    have hμP_nn₀ : 0 ≤ μP p₀ := div_nonneg (hPWP_nn w p₀) hPW_w_pos.le
    have hμV_nn₀ : 0 ≤ μV v₀ := div_nonneg (hPWV_nn w v₀) hPW_w_pos.le
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    by_cases hne : (S₀.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀)).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
      obtain ⟨hω₀_S₀, hp₀_eq, hv₀_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
      have hω₀_Ew : ω₀ ∈ E_w := hS₀_sub_Ew hω₀_S₀
      obtain ⟨hω₀_good, hw₀_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_Ew
      have h_kl := hE_KL_ineq ω₀ (hE_good_KL hω₀_good)
      rw [hw₀_eq, hp₀_eq, hv₀_eq] at h_kl
      have h_sub_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S₀.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀), π ω ≤ PWVP w p₀ v₀ := by
        dsimp [PWVP]; rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun ω hω => ?_) (fun ω _ _ => hπ_nn ω)
        obtain ⟨hω_s, hp_w, hv_w⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
        have hw_w : W ω = w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hS₀_sub_Ew hω_s)).2
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hw_w, hp_w, hv_w⟩
      have h_div_PW : PWVP w p₀ v₀ / PW w ≤ ρ ^ (-ζ) * μP p₀ * μV v₀ := by
        have h1 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_kl (mul_pos hPW_w_pos hPW_w_pos).le
        have h_lhs : (PWVP w p₀ v₀ * PW w) / (PW w * PW w) = PWVP w p₀ v₀ / PW w := by
          field_simp [hPW_w_pos.ne']
        have h_rhs : (ρ ^ (-ζ) * PWP w p₀ * PWV w v₀) / (PW w * PW w) =
            ρ ^ (-ζ) * μP p₀ * μV v₀ := by
          dsimp [μP, μV]; field_simp [hPW_w_pos.ne']
        rwa [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h1
      have h_PWVP_nn : 0 ≤ PWVP w p₀ v₀ :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ_nn ω'])
      dsimp [ν]; rw [← Finset.sum_div]
      calc (∑ ω ∈ S₀.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀ ∧ V_obs ω = v₀), π ω) / m_w
          ≤ PWVP w p₀ v₀ / m_w := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sub_sum hm_w_pos.le
        _ = (PW w / m_w) * (PWVP w p₀ v₀ / PW w) := by field_simp [hPW_w_pos.ne', hm_w_pos.ne']
        _ ≤ (4 / c_ret) * (ρ ^ (-ζ) * μP p₀ * μV v₀) :=
            mul_le_mul hPW_div_mw h_div_PW (div_nonneg h_PWVP_nn hPW_w_pos.le) (by positivity)
        _ = A * μP p₀ * μV v₀ := by dsimp [A]; ring
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA_nn hμP_nn₀) hμV_nn₀

  obtain ⟨q, hq_nn, hq_sum, hq_out_S₀, hq_ub_S₀, hq_prod⟩ :=
    h_marginal_core S₀ ν μP μV A hA_nn
      (fun ω => div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) hm_w_pos.le) hν_lb hν_ub
      (fun p => div_nonneg (hPWP_nn w p) hPW_w_pos.le) hμP_sum
      (fun v => div_nonneg (hPWV_nn w v) hPW_w_pos.le) hμV_sum
      h_prod_S₀

  have hq_out_Ew : ∀ ω, ω ∉ E_w → q ω = 0 :=
    fun ω hnot => hq_out_S₀ ω (fun hs => hnot (hS₀_sub_Ew hs))
  have hq_ub_Ew : ∀ ω ∈ E_w, q ω ≤ (2 / m_w) * π ω := by
    intro ω _
    by_cases hs : ω ∈ S₀
    · calc q ω ≤ 2 * ν ω := hq_ub_S₀ ω hs
        _ = (2 / m_w) * π ω := by dsimp [ν]; ring
    · rw [hq_out_S₀ ω hs]
      exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hπ_nn ω)

  refine ⟨hm_w_pos, hmw_PW, hcard_Ew_P, q, hq_nn, hq_sum, hq_out_Ew, hq_ub_Ew, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p₀ v₀
    have h1 := hq_prod p₀ v₀
    have h64A : 64 * A = (256 / c_ret) * ρ ^ (-ζ) := by dsimp [A]; ring
    rwa [h64A] at h1
  · intro p₀
    have h_res : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω = p₀ then q ω else 0) =
        ∑ ω ∈ E_w.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), q ω := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ E_w)]
      · exact (Finset.sum_filter (s := E_w) (p := fun ω => P ω = p₀) (f := q)).symm
      · intro ω _ hnot; simp [hq_out_Ew ω hnot]
    rw [h_res]
    by_cases hne_p : (E_w.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀)).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne_p
      obtain ⟨hω₀_Ew, hp₀_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
      obtain ⟨hω₀_good, hw₀_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_Ew
      have hPWP_ub := (hE_good_PWP ω₀ hω₀_good).1
      rw [hw₀_eq, hp₀_eq] at hPWP_ub
      have h_sub_p : ∑ ω ∈ E_w.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), π ω ≤ PWP w p₀ := by
        dsimp [PWP]; rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun ω hω => ?_) (fun ω _ _ => hπ_nn ω)
        obtain ⟨hω_ew, hp_w⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_ew).2, hp_w⟩
      calc ∑ ω ∈ E_w.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), q ω
          ≤ ∑ ω ∈ E_w.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), (2 / m_w) * π ω :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => hq_ub_Ew ω (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1)
        _ = (2 / m_w) * ∑ ω ∈ E_w.filter (fun ω => P ω = p₀), π ω := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ (2 / m_w) * PWP w p₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sub_p (by positivity)
        _ ≤ (2 / m_w) * (ρ ^ p_star * PW w) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPWP_ub (by positivity)
        _ = 2 * (PW w / m_w) * ρ ^ p_star := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (4 / c_ret) * ρ ^ p_star :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPW_div_mw (by norm_num))
              (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos p_star).le
        _ = (8 / c_ret) * ρ ^ p_star := by ring
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne_p, Finset.sum_empty]
      exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρ_pos p_star).le
  · intro ω hq_pos
    have hω_S₀ : ω ∈ S₀ := by
      by_contra hnot
      have h0 := hq_out_S₀ ω hnot
      linarith only [hq_pos, h0]
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_S₀).2

informal_problem.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (C_cov : ℝ) (M_mult M_ord : ℕ)
    (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hM_ord : 2 ≤ M_ord) :
    ∃ (B_amp D_phase : ℕ → ℝ) (C_at_cnt B_V B_X : ℝ),
      1 ≤ C_at_cnt ∧ C_cov ≤ B_V ∧ C_cov ≤ B_X ∧ 2 ≤ B_X ∧
      ∀ (γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_ret : ℕ)
        (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret),
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        0 < r → r < t → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
          m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
        (ε ^ r ≤ s_c ∧ s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r ∧
         (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
         ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (t - r) ∧
         0 < lam_sys ∧ 0 < ρ_r ∧ ρ_r ≤ 1 ∧ C_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
         (N_ret : ℝ) ≤ C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor)) ∧
         (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
           let w := fun z => star (sub.ψ_at α z)
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w) ∧
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → w z = 0) ∧
           (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
             ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k w z‖ ≤
               max (M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) 1)) ∧
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
              ‖V_at α - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_r ∧ ‖X_at α - x₀‖ ≤ σ_r)).card : ℝ) ≤
              ((81 * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ))) ∧
        (∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →
          cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx V_o X_o = sub.loc_idx →
          let r_loc := r_idx % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
          let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          r_idx = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
          r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
          C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
          ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x) ∧
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
           (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Finset (Fin N_ret)), Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
             2 * generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o +
             2 * ∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o) ∧
           (∀ (I : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (F_part : (ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (Fin N_ret)),
             (∀ i₁ ∈ I, ∀ i₂ ∈ I, i₁ ≠ i₂ → Disjoint (F_part i₁) (F_part i₂)) →
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ I.biUnion F_part, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
             (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                 (fun v => ∑ α ∈ F_part i, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o)) ∧
        (∀ (C_ibp : ℝ), 0 ≤ C_ibp →
          (∀ (L_osc : ℝ), 0 < L_osc →
            ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
              (∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 → L_osc ≤ deriv θ s) →
              (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 →
                |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) s| ≤ L_osc * D_phase m) →
            ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
              (∀ s : ℝ, 4 ≤ |s| → u s = 0) →
              (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u s‖ ≤ B_amp k) →
              ‖∫ s : ℝ, u s * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ s : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L_osc ^ M_ord) →
          ∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →
            cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx V_o X_o = sub.loc_idx →
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
            (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
            let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
            ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
              (B_V * ρ_t ≤ ‖V_o - V_at α‖ →
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o = 0) ∧
              (∀ R_tr : ℝ, B_X ≤ R_tr →
                R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ →
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
                  ((8 * C_ibp / (cls.a₀ / 2) ^ M_ord) ^ 2) * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ)))))

signature.name: subclass_atom_packing_and_far_phase_bounds
signature.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (C_cov : ℝ) (M_mult M_ord : ℕ)
    (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hM_ord : 2 ≤ M_ord) :
    ∃ (B_amp D_phase : ℕ → ℝ) (C_at_cnt B_V B_X : ℝ),
      1 ≤ C_at_cnt ∧ C_cov ≤ B_V ∧ C_cov ≤ B_X ∧ 2 ≤ B_X ∧
      ∀ (γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_ret : ℕ)
        (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret),
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        0 < r → r < t → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
          m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
        (ε ^ r ≤ s_c ∧ s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r ∧
         (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
         ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (t - r) ∧
         0 < lam_sys ∧ 0 < ρ_r ∧ ρ_r ≤ 1 ∧ C_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
         (N_ret : ℝ) ≤ C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor)) ∧
         (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
           let w := fun z => star (sub.ψ_at α z)
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w) ∧
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → w z = 0) ∧
           (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
             ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k w z‖ ≤
               max (M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) 1)) ∧
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
              ‖V_at α - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_r ∧ ‖X_at α - x₀‖ ≤ σ_r)).card : ℝ) ≤
              ((81 * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ))) ∧
        (∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →
          cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx V_o X_o = sub.loc_idx →
          let r_loc := r_idx % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
          let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          r_idx = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
          r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
          C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
          ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x) ∧
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
           (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Finset (Fin N_ret)), Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
             2 * generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o +
             2 * ∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o) ∧
           (∀ (I : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (F_part : (ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (Fin N_ret)),
             (∀ i₁ ∈ I, ∀ i₂ ∈ I, i₁ ≠ i₂ → Disjoint (F_part i₁) (F_part i₂)) →
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ I.biUnion F_part, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
             (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                 (fun v => ∑ α ∈ F_part i, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o)) ∧
        (∀ (C_ibp : ℝ), 0 ≤ C_ibp →
          (∀ (L_osc : ℝ), 0 < L_osc →
            ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
              (∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 → L_osc ≤ deriv θ s) →
              (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 →
                |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) s| ≤ L_osc * D_phase m) →
            ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
              (∀ s : ℝ, 4 ≤ |s| → u s = 0) →
              (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u s‖ ≤ B_amp k) →
              ‖∫ s : ℝ, u s * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ s : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L_osc ^ M_ord) →
          ∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →
            cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx V_o X_o = sub.loc_idx →
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
            (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
            let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
            ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
              (B_V * ρ_t ≤ ‖V_o - V_at α‖ →
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o = 0) ∧
              (∀ R_tr : ℝ, B_X ≤ R_tr →
                R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ →
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
                  ((8 * C_ibp / (cls.a₀ / 2) ^ M_ord) ^ 2) * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ)))))

proof.tactics:
by
  have ha₀ : 0 < cls.a₀ := cls.ha₀
  have ha₁ : cls.a₀ ≤ cls.a₁ := cls.ha₁
  have hA : 1 ≤ cls.A := cls.hA
  have hB_sys : 2 ≤ cls.B_sys := cls.hB_sys
  have hK_hor : 1 ≤ cls.K_hor := cls.hK_hor
  have hR_win : 2 ≤ cls.R_win := cls.hR_win
  have hB_sys_pos : 0 < cls.B_sys := by linarith
  have hR_win_pos : 0 < cls.R_win := by linarith

  let W₁ : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => max (M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win i) 1
  let W₂ : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => max (cls.M_win j) 1
  have hW₁_nn : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ W₁ i := fun i => le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _)
  have hW₂_nn : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ W₂ j := fun j => le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _)
  let B_amp : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * W₁ i * W₂ (k - i)
  let D_phase : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    (2 / cls.a₀ + 10 * cls.B_sys) * cls.A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) +
      cls.B_sys * (m : ℝ) * cls.A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)
  have hD_phase_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ D_phase m := fun m => by
    dsimp only [D_phase]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 2 / cls.a₀ + 10 * cls.B_sys := by positivity
    have h2 : 0 ≤ cls.A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by positivity
    have h3 : 0 ≤ cls.B_sys * (m : ℝ) * cls.A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by positivity
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h1 (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)) (by positivity)) h3

  let R_V : ℝ := 6 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4
  let R_X : ℝ := 12 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10
  have hR_V_nn : 0 ≤ R_V := by dsimp only [R_V]; linarith
  have hR_X_nn : 0 ≤ R_X := by dsimp only [R_X]; linarith
  let C_at_cnt : ℝ := max 1 ((M_mult : ℝ) * (2 * R_V + 3) ^ 2 * (2 * R_X * cls.B_sys + 3) ^ 2)
  let B_V : ℝ := max C_cov (cls.R_win + 4)
  let B_X : ℝ := max C_cov (max 2 ((20 * cls.A * cls.B_sys + 4) / cls.a₀))

  
  have hiv_card : ∀ m : ℤ, (Finset.Icc (m - 1) (m + 1)).card = 3 := by
    intro m; rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
  have hiv_mem : ∀ {s y : ℝ} {k : ℤ}, 0 < s → |s * (k : ℝ) - y| ≤ s →
      k ∈ Finset.Icc (⌊y / s⌋ - 1) (⌊y / s⌋ + 1) := by
    intro s y k hs hab
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hab
    have hk_lo : y / s - 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
      rw [div_sub_one hs.ne', div_le_iff₀ hs]; linarith
    have hk_hi : (k : ℝ) ≤ y / s + 1 := by
      rw [div_add_one hs.ne', le_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith
    let m : ℤ := ⌊y / s⌋
    have hm_le : (m : ℝ) ≤ y / s := Int.floor_le (y / s)
    have hm_lt : y / s < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (y / s)
    have h_ge : m - 1 ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (m : ℝ) - 1 ≤ (k : ℝ))
    have h_lt : k < m + 2 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (k : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 2)
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  have h_sym_card : ∀ L : ℕ, (Finset.Icc (-(L : ℤ)) (L : ℤ)).card = 2 * L + 1 := by
    intro L; rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
  have h_sym_mem : ∀ {s R : ℝ} {k : ℤ × ℤ}, 0 < s → 0 ≤ R → ‖gridPt2D s k‖ ≤ R →
      k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(⌈R * s⁻¹⌉₊ : ℤ)) (⌈R * s⁻¹⌉₊ : ℤ) ×ˢ
        Finset.Icc (-(⌈R * s⁻¹⌉₊ : ℤ)) (⌈R * s⁻¹⌉₊ : ℤ) := by
    intro s R k hs _hR hk
    let L : ℕ := ⌈R * s⁻¹⌉₊
    have h_coord : ∀ m : ℤ, |s * (m : ℝ)| ≤ R → m ∈ Finset.Icc (-(L : ℤ)) (L : ℤ) := by
      intro m hm
      have ha : s * |(m : ℝ)| ≤ R := by rwa [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs] at hm
      have hb : |(m : ℝ)| ≤ R * s⁻¹ := by
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha (inv_nonneg.mpr hs.le)
        rwa [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne', one_mul, mul_comm] at hmul
      have hc : |(m : ℝ)| ≤ (L : ℝ) := hb.trans (Nat.le_ceil _)
      obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp hc
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hlo, by exact_mod_cast hhi⟩
    have h0 : |s * (k.1 : ℝ)| ≤ R := by
      have hp := (PiLp.norm_apply_le (gridPt2D s k) 0).trans hk
      simpa [gridPt2D] using hp
    have h1 : |s * (k.2 : ℝ)| ≤ R := by
      have hp := (PiLp.norm_apply_le (gridPt2D s k) 1).trans hk
      simpa [gridPt2D] using hp
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨h_coord k.1 h0, h_coord k.2 h1⟩

  have h_round_2d : ∀ {s : ℝ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), 0 < s →
      ‖z - gridPt2D s (Int.floor (z 0 / s + 1 / 2), Int.floor (z 1 / s + 1 / 2))‖ ≤ s := by
    intro s z hs
    have h1d : ∀ u : ℝ, (u - s * (Int.floor (u / s + 1 / 2) : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ (s / 2) ^ 2 := by
      intro u
      let m : ℤ := Int.floor (u / s + 1 / 2)
      have hm_le : (m : ℝ) ≤ u / s + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
      have hm_lt : u / s + 1 / 2 < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h_mul1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_le hs.le
      have h_mul2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_lt.le hs.le
      have hus : s * (u / s) = u := mul_div_cancel₀ u hs.ne'
      have habs : |u - s * (m : ℝ)| ≤ s / 2 := by
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith
      exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_pos (half_pos hs)])
    have hsq : ‖z - gridPt2D s (Int.floor (z 0 / s + 1 / 2), Int.floor (z 1 / s + 1 / 2))‖ ^ 2 ≤
        s ^ 2 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [gridPt2D, PiLp.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      dsimp
      have h0 := h1d (z 0)
      have h1 := h1d (z 1)
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z - gridPt2D s (Int.floor (z 0 / s + 1 / 2), Int.floor (z 1 / s + 1 / 2)))]

  have h_loc_geom : ∀ {ε b_star : ℝ} {m_r m_t r_idx : ℕ}
      {loc_idx : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)} {V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)},
      0 < ε → m_r ≤ m_t → r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →
      cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx V_o X_o = loc_idx →
      let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
      let C_r := ((loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
      let s_v := ε ^ b_star
      let s_x := s_c * s_v
      let V_J := gridPt2D s_v loc_idx.2.1
      let X_J := gridPt2D s_x loc_idx.2.2
      let r_loc := r_idx % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
      let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
      r_idx = loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
      r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
      C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
      ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x := by
    intro ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx loc_idx V_o X_o hε₀ hmr_le_mt hr_idx hloc
    dsimp only
    let K₂ : ℕ := 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
    have hK₂_pos : 0 < K₂ := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hK₂_rpos : (0 : ℝ) < (K₂ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK₂_pos
    have hq_eq : r_idx / K₂ = loc_idx.1 := congr_arg Prod.fst hloc
    have hr_div : r_idx = loc_idx.1 * K₂ + r_idx % K₂ := by
      have hd := Nat.div_add_mod r_idx K₂
      rw [hq_eq, mul_comm] at hd
      exact hd.symm
    have hr_mod : r_idx % K₂ < K₂ := Nat.mod_lt r_idx hK₂_pos
    let s_c : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
    have hs_c_pos : 0 < s_c := inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos (by norm_num) m_r)
    let C_t : ℝ := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
    let C_r : ℝ := ((loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
    have h2mt_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t := pow_pos (by norm_num) m_t
    have hCt_mem : C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      have hr_le : r_idx + 1 ≤ 2 ^ m_t := hr_idx
      have hr_r : (r_idx : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t := by exact_mod_cast hr_le
      have h_num : (r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t := by linarith
      calc C_t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_num (inv_nonneg.mpr h2mt_pos.le)
        _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ h2mt_pos.ne'
    have hCt_Cr : |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 := by
      have h_pow_split : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_t = (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r * (K₂ : ℝ) := by
        dsimp only [K₂]
        push_cast
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hmr_le_mt]
      have h_inv_split : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ = s_c * (K₂ : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [h_pow_split, mul_inv_rev, mul_comm]
      let r_loc : ℕ := r_idx % K₂
      have hr_cast : (r_idx : ℝ) = (loc_idx.1 : ℝ) * (K₂ : ℝ) + (r_loc : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hr_div
      have h_diff_eq : C_t - C_r = (((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * (K₂ : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1 / 2) * s_c := by
        dsimp only [C_t, C_r]
        rw [hr_cast, h_inv_split]
        field_simp [hK₂_rpos.ne']
        ring
      have hr_loc_le : r_loc + 1 ≤ K₂ := hr_mod
      have hr_loc_r : (r_loc : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (K₂ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hr_loc_le
      have h_frac_lo : 0 ≤ ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * (K₂ : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
      have h_frac_hi : ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * (K₂ : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
        calc ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * (K₂ : ℝ)⁻¹
            ≤ (K₂ : ℝ) * (K₂ : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr hK₂_rpos.le)
          _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hK₂_rpos.ne'
      have h_abs_coef : |((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * (K₂ : ℝ)⁻¹ - 1 / 2| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
      rw [h_diff_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs_c_pos]
      nlinarith

                  ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) - Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
          intro v

          have h_exp : Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =

        simp_rw [h_pt]
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self
          (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            (star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at))) * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o))) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) - Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) V_at]

        · exact continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk
            (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul ρ_r)))

      let e_toLp : (Fin 2 → ℝ) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=

        have h2 : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving e_toLp

            MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume :=

      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg h_rat_nn (norm_nonneg _)) h_prod_le 2

  
  have h_s3_win :
      ∀ (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ) →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ z = 0) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ z‖ ≤ M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) →
        (let w := fun z => star (ψ z)
         (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w) ∧
         (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → w z = 0) ∧
         (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k w z‖ ≤ W₁ k)) ∧
        (∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
          ∀ (r_sc : ℝ), 0 ≤ r_sc → r_sc ≤ 1 →
          ∀ (z_sh e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖e‖ = 1 →
          ∀ (y₁ : ℝ),
            let u : ℝ → ℂ := fun s =>
              star (ψ (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)) *
                ψ_o (z_sh + r_sc • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e))
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) ∧
            (∀ s : ℝ, 4 ≤ |s| → u s = 0) ∧
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv k u s‖ ≤ B_amp k)) := by
    intro ψ hψ_sm hψ_supp hψ_der
    let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z => star (ψ z)
    have hw_eq : w = ⇑Complex.conjLIE ∘ ψ := by
      ext z; simp [w, Complex.conjLIE_apply]
    have hw_sm : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w := fun k => by
      rw [hw_eq]; exact Complex.conjLIE.contDiff.comp (hψ_sm k)
    have hw_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → w z = 0 := fun z hz => by
      simp [w, hψ_supp z hz]
    have hw_der : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k w z‖ ≤ W₁ k := fun k z => by
      rw [hw_eq, Complex.conjLIE.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left ψ z k]
      exact le_trans (hψ_der k z) (le_max_left _ _)
    refine ⟨⟨hw_sm, hw_supp, hw_der⟩, ?_⟩
    intro ψ_o hψ_o_sm hψ_o_der r_sc hr_sc0 hr_sc1 z_sh e he y₁
    dsimp only
    let Λ₁ : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) e
    let Λ₂ : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (r_sc • e)
    have hΛ₁_app : ∀ s : ℝ, Λ₁ s = s • e := fun s => by simp [Λ₁]
    have hΛ₂_app : ∀ s : ℝ, Λ₂ s = s • (r_sc • e) := fun s => by simp [Λ₂]
    have hΛ₁_norm : ‖Λ₁‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun s => ?_)
      rw [hΛ₁_app, norm_smul, he, mul_one, one_mul]
    have hΛ₂_norm : ‖Λ₂‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun s => ?_)
      rw [hΛ₂_app, norm_smul, norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr_sc0, mul_comm ‖s‖ r_sc]

    let f₂ : ℝ → ℂ := (fun z => ψ_o (z + z₂)) ∘ ⇑Λ₂
    have hf₁_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k f₁ := fun k =>
      ((hw_sm k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).comp Λ₁.contDiff
    have hf₂_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k f₂ := fun k =>
      ((hψ_o_sm k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).comp Λ₂.contDiff
    have hf₁_bd : ∀ (i : ℕ) (s : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f₁ s‖ ≤ W₁ i := by
      intro i s
      have h_sh_cd : ContDiff ℝ i (fun z => w (z + z₁)) :=
        (hw_sm i).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      dsimp only [f₁]
      rw [Λ₁.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_sh_cd s le_rfl, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
      have h_le1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i w (Λ₁ s + z₁)) (fun _ : Fin i => Λ₁)
      have h_prod_le : (∏ _ : Fin i, ‖Λ₁‖) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg Λ₁) hΛ₁_norm
      calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ i w (Λ₁ s + z₁)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ₁)‖

        _ ≤ W₁ i * 1 := mul_le_mul (hw_der i (Λ₁ s + z₁)) h_prod_le

    have hf₂_bd : ∀ (j : ℕ) (s : ℝ), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f₂ s‖ ≤ W₂ j := by
      intro j s

      dsimp only [f₂]
      rw [Λ₂.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_sh_cd s le_rfl, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
      have h_le1 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ s + z₂)) (fun _ : Fin j => Λ₂)
      have h_prod_le : (∏ _ : Fin j, ‖Λ₂‖) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]

      have hψ_W₂ : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ s + z₂)‖ ≤ W₂ j :=

      calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ s + z₂)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ₂)‖
          ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ψ_o (Λ₂ s + z₂)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin j, ‖Λ₂‖ := h_le1
        _ ≤ W₂ j * 1 := mul_le_mul hψ_W₂ h_prod_le
            (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg Λ₂)) (hW₂_nn j)

    have hu_eq : (fun s : ℝ =>
          star (ψ (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)) *
            ψ_o (z_sh + r_sc • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e))) =
        fun s => f₁ s * f₂ s := by
      ext s
      dsimp only [f₁, f₂, w, z₁, z₂, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [hΛ₁_app s, hΛ₂_app s]
      have h_arg2 : s • (r_sc • e) + (z_sh + r_sc • (y₁ • perp2D e)) =
          z_sh + r_sc • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e) := by
        ext i; simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rw [h_arg2]
    refine ⟨fun k => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hu_eq]; exact (hf₁_cd k).mul (hf₂_cd k)
    · intro s hs
      have he_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have h1 : ‖e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [he]; norm_num
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
      have h_norm_sq : 4 ^ 2 ≤ ‖s • e + y₁ • perp2D e‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_eq : ‖s • e + y₁ • perp2D e‖ ^ 2 = s ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2 := by
          rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, perp2D,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
          dsimp
          linear_combination (s ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2) * he_sq
        rw [h_eq]
        have hs_sq : 4 ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by rw [← sq_abs s]; nlinarith
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg y₁]
      have h_norm : 4 ≤ ‖s • e + y₁ • perp2D e‖ := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)]

      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hu_eq]
