      refine le_trans h_mul (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _hi => ?_))
      have h_choose_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      calc (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f₁ s‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) f₂ s‖

            mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (W₁ i * W₂ (k - i)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ h_choose_nn
            exact mul_le_mul (hf₁_bd i s) (hf₂_bd (k - i) s) (norm_nonneg _) (hW₁_nn i)

  have h_iter_id_mul : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n g) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun s : ℝ => s * g s) t =

        rw [hu_Δ]
        dsimp only [ΔX]
        simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.neg_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      have h_z_norm : ‖s • e + z₀‖ ≤ 10 := by
        calc ‖s • e + z₀‖ ≤ ‖s • e‖ + ‖y₁ • perp2D e‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = |s| * ‖e‖ + |y₁| * ‖perp2D e‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul s e, norm_smul y₁ (perp2D e), Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          _ = |s| + |y₁| := by rw [he, hperp_e, mul_one, mul_one]
          _ ≤ 6 + 4 := add_le_add hs hy₁_abs
          _ = 10 := by norm_num
      have h_chirp_σ : |C_t - C_r| * ρ_r ≤ cls.B_sys * σ_r := by
        have h_eq : |C_t - C_r| * ρ_r = (lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * |C_t - C_r|) * σ_r := by
          dsimp only [σ_r]
          field_simp [hlam_pos.ne', hρ_r_pos.ne']
        rw [h_eq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_chirp hσ_r_pos.le
      have h_err_norm : ‖P₂ s - (P₁ s + u_dir)‖ ≤ 10 * cls.B_sys * σ_r := by
        rw [h_err_eq, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hρ_r_pos]
        calc (|C_t - C_r| * ρ_r) * ‖s • e + z₀‖
            ≤ (cls.B_sys * σ_r) * 10 :=
              mul_le_mul h_chirp_σ h_z_norm (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = 10 * cls.B_sys * σ_r := by ring
      have h_lip_inner :
          |inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₂ s) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s + u_dir)) e| ≤
            10 * cls.A * cls.B_sys * σ_r := by
        calc |inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₂ s) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s + u_dir)) e|
            ≤ ‖ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₂ s) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s + u_dir)‖ * ‖e‖ :=
              abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ ≤ (cls.A * ‖P₂ s - (P₁ s + u_dir)‖) * 1 := by
              rw [he]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hζ_lip (v_fn s) (P₁ s + u_dir) (P₂ s)) zero_le_one
          _ ≤ cls.A * (10 * cls.B_sys * σ_r) := by
              rw [mul_one]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_err_norm (by linarith [hA])
          _ = 10 * cls.A * cls.B_sys * σ_r := by ring
      have h_split_ζ : inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₂ s) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s)) e =
          inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s + u_dir) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s)) e +
            inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₂ s) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s + u_dir)) e := by
        rw [← inner_add_left]
        congr 1
        abel
      have h_inner_lo : (cls.a₀ * K - 10 * cls.A * cls.B_sys) * σ_r ≤
          inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₂ s) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s)) e := by
        have h_abs_lo := (abs_le.mp h_lip_inner).1
        rw [h_split_ζ]
        linarith
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inner_lo hlam_ρ_pos.le
      have h_cancel : (lam_sys * ρ_r) * ((cls.a₀ * K - 10 * cls.A * cls.B_sys) * σ_r) =
          2 * L_osc - 10 * cls.A * cls.B_sys := by
        dsimp only [σ_r, L_osc]
        field_simp [hlam_pos.ne', hρ_r_pos.ne']
      rw [h_cancel] at h_mul
      linarith [hL_ge, h_mul]

    
    let dual_e := InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) e
    let G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p =>
      (lam_sys * ρ_r) *
        inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v_fn p.1, P₁ p.1 + p.2 • Q p.1) - ζ₀ (v_fn p.1, P₁ p.1)) e
    let H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p =>
      (lam_sys * ρ_r) * inner ℝ (M_op (v_fn p.1, P₁ p.1 + p.2 • Q p.1) (Q p.1)) e
    have hG_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k G := fun k => by
      have hv1 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => v_fn p.1) := (hv_cd k).comp contDiff_fst
      have hP1 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => P₁ p.1) := (hP₁_cd k).comp contDiff_fst
      have hQ1 : ContDiff ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Q p.1) := (hQ_cd k).comp contDiff_fst
      have hp_seg : ContDiff ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => P₁ p.1 + p.2 • Q p.1) :=
        hP1.add (contDiff_snd.smul hQ1)
      have hζ_seg : ContDiff ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ζ₀ (v_fn p.1, P₁ p.1 + p.2 • Q p.1)) :=
        (hζ_cd k).comp (hv1.prodMk hp_seg)
      have hζ_base : ContDiff ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ζ₀ (v_fn p.1, P₁ p.1)) :=
        (hζ_cd k).comp (hv1.prodMk hP1)
      have hG_eq : G = fun p =>
          (lam_sys * ρ_r) *
            dual_e (ζ₀ (v_fn p.1, P₁ p.1 + p.2 • Q p.1) - ζ₀ (v_fn p.1, P₁ p.1)) := by
        ext p; dsimp only [G, dual_e]; rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, real_inner_comm]
      rw [hG_eq]
      exact contDiff_const.mul (dual_e.contDiff.comp (hζ_seg.sub hζ_base))
    have hG_zero : (fun s : ℝ => G (s, 0)) = fun _ => 0 := by
      ext s; dsimp only [G]; rw [zero_smul, add_zero, sub_self, inner_zero_left, mul_zero]
    have hG_one : (fun s : ℝ => G (s, 1)) = δ := by
      ext s; dsimp only [G, δ, Q]; rw [one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
    have hG_tau_deriv : ∀ (s τ : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun τ' => G (s, τ')) (H (s, τ)) τ := by
      intro s τ
      have hp_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun τ' : ℝ => P₁ s + τ' • Q s) (Q s) τ := by
        have hsm : HasDerivAt (fun τ' : ℝ => τ' • Q s) ((1 : ℝ) • Q s) τ :=
          (hasDerivAt_id τ).smul_const (Q s)
        rw [one_smul] at hsm
        exact hsm.const_add (P₁ s)
      have hζ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v_fn s, p')) (P₁ s + τ • Q s) :=
        (((hζ_cd 1).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)).differentiable
          (by simp)).differentiableAt
      have h_comp0 := (hζ_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ hp_deriv).sub_const (ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s))
      have h_comp1 : HasDerivAt (fun τ' => ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s + τ' • Q s) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s))
          (M_op (v_fn s, P₁ s + τ • Q s) (Q s)) τ := h_comp0
      have h_comp2 := (dual_e.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ h_comp1).const_mul (lam_sys * ρ_r)
      have h_fun_eq : (fun y : ℝ => (lam_sys * ρ_r) *
          (⇑dual_e ∘ fun τ' => ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s + τ' • Q s) - ζ₀ (v_fn s, P₁ s)) y) =
          fun τ' => G (s, τ') := by
        ext τ'; dsimp only [G, dual_e, Function.comp_apply]
        rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, real_inner_comm]
      rw [h_fun_eq] at h_comp2
      have h_val_eq : (lam_sys * ρ_r) * dual_e (M_op (v_fn s, P₁ s + τ • Q s) (Q s)) = H (s, τ) := by
        dsimp only [H, dual_e]; rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, real_inner_comm]
      rwa [h_val_eq] at h_comp2
    let G_iter : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun m p => iteratedDeriv m (fun s => G (s, p.2)) p.1
    have hG_iter : ∀ m : ℕ,
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (G_iter m)) ∧
        (∀ (t τ : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun τ' => G_iter m (t, τ'))
          (iteratedDeriv m (fun s => H (s, τ)) t) τ) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨hG_cd, fun t τ => ?_⟩
        simpa [G_iter] using hG_tau_deriv t τ
      | succ m ih =>
        obtain ⟨hGm_cd, hGm_deriv⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨hGm1_cd, hGm1_comm⟩ := h_clairaut (G_iter m) hGm_cd
        have h_eq : G_iter (m + 1) = fun p => deriv (fun s => G_iter m (s, p.2)) p.1 := by
          ext p; simp only [G_iter, iteratedDeriv_succ]
        rw [h_eq]
        refine ⟨hGm1_cd, fun t τ => ?_⟩
        have h_step := hGm1_comm t τ
        have h_inner_eq : (fun s => deriv (fun u => G_iter m (s, u)) τ) =
            iteratedDeriv m (fun s => H (s, τ)) :=
          funext (fun s => (hGm_deriv s τ).deriv)
        rwa [h_inner_eq, ← iteratedDeriv_succ] at h_step

    have hH_bound : ∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (s : ℝ), |s| ≤ 6 →
        |iteratedDeriv m (fun s' => H (s', τ)) s| ≤ L_osc * D_phase m := by
      intro m hm τ hτ s hs
      let c_τ : ℝ := (1 - τ) * C_r + τ * C_t
      have hc_τ0 : 0 ≤ c_τ := by dsimp only [c_τ]; nlinarith [hτ.1, hτ.2, hC_r.1, hC_t.1]
      have hc_τ1 : c_τ ≤ 1 := by dsimp only [c_τ]; nlinarith [hτ.1, hτ.2, hC_r.2, hC_t.2]
      let q_τ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        (V_base, ((1 - τ) • X_at + τ • X_o) - c_τ • V_base)
      let ξ_τ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        (ρ_r • e, (-(c_τ * ρ_r)) • e)
      let Λ_τ : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) ξ_τ
      have hΛ_τ_norm : ‖Λ_τ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun t => ?_)
        have hξ_norm : ‖ξ_τ‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Prod.norm_def]
          refine max_le ?_ ?_
          · dsimp only [ξ_τ]
            rw [norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ_r_pos.le]
            exact hρ_r_le1
          · dsimp only [ξ_τ]
            rw [norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg,
              abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc_τ0 hρ_r_pos.le)]
            nlinarith [hc_τ1, hρ_r_pos, hρ_r_le1]
        calc ‖Λ_τ t‖ = ‖t • ξ_τ‖ := by simp [Λ_τ]
          _ = |t| * ‖ξ_τ‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          _ ≤ |t| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hξ_norm (abs_nonneg t)
          _ = 1 * ‖t‖ := by rw [mul_one, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      let f_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ → ℝ := fun u t =>
        inner ℝ (M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ) u) e
      have hf_vec : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (f_vec u)) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
            |iteratedDeriv k (f_vec u) t| ≤
              ‖u‖ * (cls.A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3))) := by
        intro u
        let ℓ_u : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
          dual_e.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) u)
        have hℓ_norm : ‖ℓ_u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
          refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg u) (fun T => ?_)
          have h_app : ℓ_u T = inner ℝ e (T u) := by
            simp [ℓ_u, dual_e, InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply]
          rw [h_app, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          calc |inner ℝ e (T u)| ≤ ‖e‖ * ‖T u‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm e (T u)
            _ ≤ 1 * (‖T‖ * ‖u‖) := by
                rw [he]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (T.le_opNorm u) zero_le_one
            _ = ‖u‖ * ‖T‖ := by ring
        have hf_eq : f_vec u = ⇑ℓ_u ∘ ((fun z => M_op (z + q_τ)) ∘ ⇑Λ_τ) := by
          ext t
          dsimp only [f_vec, ℓ_u, dual_e, Function.comp_apply]
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply,
            InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply]
          rw [real_inner_comm]
        refine ⟨fun k => ?_, fun k t => ?_⟩
        · rw [hf_eq]
          exact ℓ_u.contDiff.comp
            (((hM_cd k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).comp Λ_τ.contDiff)
        · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hf_eq]
          have h_sh_cd : ContDiff ℝ k (fun z => M_op (z + q_τ)) :=
            (hM_cd k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
          have h_in_cd : ContDiff ℝ k ((fun z => M_op (z + q_τ)) ∘ ⇑Λ_τ) :=
            h_sh_cd.comp Λ_τ.contDiff
          rw [ℓ_u.iteratedFDeriv_comp_left h_in_cd.contDiffAt le_rfl]
          have h_le1 := ℓ_u.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun z => M_op (z + q_τ)) ∘ ⇑Λ_τ) t)
          have h_le2 := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ)) (fun _ : Fin k => Λ_τ)
          have h_prod_le : (∏ _ : Fin k, ‖Λ_τ‖) ≤ 1 := by
            rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
            exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg Λ_τ) hΛ_τ_norm
          have h_gev := hζ_gevrey k (Λ_τ t + q_τ)
          have h_mid : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun z => M_op (z + q_τ)) ∘ ⇑Λ_τ) t‖ ≤
              cls.A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by
            rw [Λ_τ.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_sh_cd t le_rfl, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right]
            calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => Λ_τ)‖
                ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin k, ‖Λ_τ‖ := h_le2
              _ ≤ (cls.A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) * 1 :=
                  mul_le_mul h_gev h_prod_le
                    (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg Λ_τ)) (by positivity)
              _ = cls.A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := mul_one _
          calc ‖ℓ_u.compContinuousMultilinearMap
                (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun z => M_op (z + q_τ)) ∘ ⇑Λ_τ) t)‖
              ≤ ‖ℓ_u‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ((fun z => M_op (z + q_τ)) ∘ ⇑Λ_τ) t‖ := h_le1
            _ ≤ ‖u‖ * (cls.A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) :=
                mul_le_mul hℓ_norm h_mid (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg u)
      let κ : ℝ := lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * (C_t - C_r)
      have hκ_abs : |κ| ≤ cls.B_sys := by
        dsimp only [κ]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2)]
        exact h_chirp
      let U₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := K • e - (κ * y₁) • perp2D e
      let U₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := (-κ) • e
      have hU₀_norm : ‖U₀‖ ≤ K + 4 * cls.B_sys := by
        calc ‖U₀‖ ≤ ‖K • e‖ + ‖(κ * y₁) • perp2D e‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = K * ‖e‖ + (|κ| * |y₁|) * ‖perp2D e‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul K e, norm_smul (κ * y₁) (perp2D e),
                Real.norm_of_nonneg hK_pos.le, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ K * 1 + (cls.B_sys * 4) * 1 := by
              rw [he, hperp_e]
              exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul hκ_abs hy₁_abs (abs_nonneg _) hB_sys_pos.le) zero_le_one)
          _ = K + 4 * cls.B_sys := by ring
      have hU₁_norm : ‖U₁‖ ≤ cls.B_sys := by
        dsimp only [U₁]
        rw [norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg]
        exact hκ_abs
      have hH_split : (fun t : ℝ => H (t, τ)) =
          f_vec U₀ + fun t => t * f_vec U₁ t := by
        ext t
        have h_arg : (v_fn t, P₁ t + τ • Q t) = Λ_τ t + q_τ := by
          refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
          · ext i
            dsimp only [v_fn, Λ_τ, ξ_τ, q_τ, V_base]
            simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.fst_add,
              PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            simp; ring
          · ext i
            dsimp only [P₁, P₂, Q, v_fn, Λ_τ, ξ_τ, q_τ, c_τ, V_base]
            simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add,
              PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            simp; ring
        have hQ_scaled : (lam_sys * ρ_r) • Q t = U₀ + t • U₁ := by
          have h_lam_ΔX : (lam_sys * ρ_r) • ΔX = K • e := by
            rw [← hKσ_e, smul_smul]
            congr 1
            dsimp only [σ_r]
            field_simp [hlam_pos.ne', hρ_r_pos.ne']
          have hQ_raw : Q t = ΔX - ((C_t - C_r) * ρ_r) • (t • e + z₀) := by
            ext i
            dsimp only [Q, P₁, P₂, v_fn, ΔX]
            simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            ring
          rw [hQ_raw, smul_sub, h_lam_ΔX]
          ext i
          dsimp only [U₀, U₁, z₀, κ]
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        dsimp only [H, f_vec, Pi.add_apply]
        have h_lin : (lam_sys * ρ_r) * inner ℝ (M_op (v_fn t, P₁ t + τ • Q t) (Q t)) e =
            inner ℝ (M_op (v_fn t, P₁ t + τ • Q t) ((lam_sys * ρ_r) • Q t)) e := by
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, real_inner_smul_left]
        rw [h_lin, h_arg, hQ_scaled, ContinuousLinearMap.map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul,
          inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
      obtain ⟨hf0_cd, hf0_bd⟩ := hf_vec U₀
      obtain ⟨hf1_cd, hf1_bd⟩ := hf_vec U₁
      have hsf1_cd : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (fun t : ℝ => t * f_vec U₁ t) := fun k =>
        contDiff_id.mul (hf1_cd k)
      rw [hH_split, iteratedDeriv_add (hf0_cd m).contDiffAt (hsf1_cd m).contDiffAt]
      let k : ℕ := m - 1
      have hk_eq : k + 1 = m := by omega
      let G₁ : ℝ := cls.A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)
      let G₂ : ℝ := cls.A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)
      have hG₁_nn : 0 ≤ G₁ := by dsimp only [G₁]; positivity
      have hG₂_nn : 0 ≤ G₂ := by dsimp only [G₂]; positivity
      have h_t0 : |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₀) s| ≤ (K + 4 * cls.B_sys) * G₁ :=
        le_trans (hf0_bd m s) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hU₀_norm hG₁_nn)
      have h_t1 : |iteratedDeriv m (fun t : ℝ => t * f_vec U₁ t) s| ≤
          6 * cls.B_sys * G₁ + cls.B_sys * (m : ℝ) * G₂ := by
        have h_id_eq : iteratedDeriv m (fun t : ℝ => t * f_vec U₁ t) s =
            s * iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s + (m : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv k (f_vec U₁) s := by
          have h1 := h_iter_id_mul (f_vec U₁) hf1_cd k s
          rwa [hk_eq] at h1
        have hf1_m : |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s| ≤ cls.B_sys * G₁ :=
          le_trans (hf1_bd m s) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hU₁_norm hG₁_nn)
        have hf1_k : |iteratedDeriv k (f_vec U₁) s| ≤ cls.B_sys * G₂ := by
          have h1 := le_trans (hf1_bd k s) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hU₁_norm (by positivity))
          dsimp only [G₂]
          rwa [hk_eq] at h1
        rw [h_id_eq]
        calc |s * iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s + (m : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv k (f_vec U₁) s|

informal_problem.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) :
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    (∀ {N_O N_D S_bins : ℕ} (hS : 1 ≤ S_bins)
       (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ) (w_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
       (bin_D : Fin N_D → Fin S_bins),
       (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
       (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) → 0 < m_O o) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let score_fn := fun q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ =>
         let q_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
         let q_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d
         (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +
         (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) / ell) +
         (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) +
         (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * w_D d)
       let π_b := fun b : Fin S_bins =>
         ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => bin_D d = b), p o d
       let p_b := fun (b : Fin S_bins) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) =>
         if bin_D d = b ∧ 0 < π_b b then p o d / π_b b else 0
       (∀ b, 0 ≤ π_b b) ∧ (∑ b : Fin S_bins, π_b b = 1) ∧
       (∀ b, 0 < π_b b → (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_b b o d) ∧ (∑ o, ∑ d, p_b b o d = 1) ∧
         (∀ o d, 0 < p_b b o d → bin_D d = b ∧ 0 < p o d)) ∧
       score_fn p ≤ (∑ b : Fin S_bins, if 0 < π_b b then π_b b * score_fn (p_b b) else 0) +
         Real.log (S_bins : ℝ) / ell) ∧
    (∀ {N_O N_D N_Z N_T N_R : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ)
       (Z_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_Z) (r_Z : Fin N_Z → Fin N_R) (r_D : Fin N_D → Fin N_R)
       (T_of_Z : Fin N_Z → Finset (Fin N_T)) {K_mass : ℝ} {M_amb : ℕ},
       0 < K_mass → 1 ≤ M_amb →
       (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
       (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) → 0 < m_O o) →
       (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → r_Z (Z_of o) = r_D d) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ z : Fin N_Z, (0 < ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), ∑ d, p o d) →
          (T_of_Z z).Nonempty ∧
          (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z),
            if 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d then m_O o else 0) ≤
            K_mass * ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ)) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (rv : Fin N_R),
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin N_Z => r_Z z = rv ∧ α ∈ T_of_Z z)).card : ℝ) ≤
            (M_amb : ℝ)) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
       let p_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p o d
       let p_ZD := fun z d => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), p o d
       let q := fun (z : Fin N_Z) (d : Fin N_D) (α : Fin N_T) =>
         if α ∈ T_of_Z z then p_ZD z d / ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ) else 0
       let q_T := fun α => ∑ z, ∑ d, q z d α
       let q_TD := fun α d => ∑ z, q z d α
       let q_TR := fun α rv => ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => r_Z z = rv), ∑ d, q z d α
       (∀ z d α, 0 ≤ q z d α) ∧ (∑ z, ∑ d, ∑ α, q z d α = 1) ∧
       (∀ z d α, 0 < q z d α → α ∈ T_of_Z z ∧ ∃ o, Z_of o = z ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
       ((∑ o, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, p_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) ≤
        (∑ α, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d))) / ell) +
        (∑ α, ∑ rv, -(q_TR α rv * Real.log (q_TR α rv / q_T α))) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (M_amb : ℝ) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log K_mass / ell))) ∧
    ((∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},
       0 < B_fib → (∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) → (∑ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ y : Fin N_Y, (0 < ∑ x, P x y) →
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin N_X => 0 < P x y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib) →
       let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x, P x y
       (∑ x, ∑ y, -(P x y * Real.log (P x y / P_Y y))) / ell ≤ Real.log B_fib / ell) ∧
     (∀ {N_T N_D N_E N_M N_U : ℕ} (P : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ)
       (E_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_E) (M_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_M) (U_of : Fin N_D → Fin N_U)
       {K_EM : ℕ},
       1 ≤ N_E → 1 ≤ K_EM →
       (∀ α d, 0 ≤ P α d) → (∑ α, ∑ d, P α d = 1) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ e : Fin N_E,
          (((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e)).image M_of).card : ℝ) ≤ (K_EM : ℝ)) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let P_T := fun α => ∑ d, P α d
       let P_D := fun d => ∑ α, P α d
       let P_E := fun e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P_T α
       let P_DE := fun d e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P α d
       let P_M := fun m => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m), P_T α
       let P_MU := fun m u =>
         ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m),
           ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => U_of d = u), P α d
       let Q_TU := fun α u =>
         if 0 < P_M (M_of α) then P_T α * (P_MU (M_of α) u / P_M (M_of α)) else 0

       (∀ α u, 0 < Q_TU α u → 0 < P_T α ∧
         ∃ α₀ d₀, M_of α₀ = M_of α ∧ U_of d₀ = u ∧ 0 < P α₀ d₀) ∧
       ((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α))) / ell - Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤
         (∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell) ∧
       (((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell -
         (∑ α, ∑ d, -(P α d * Real.log (P α d / P_DE d (E_of α)))) / ell) ≤
        ((∑ α, ∑ u, -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (Q_TU α u / Q_U u))) / ell -

        Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) / ell)))

(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) :
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    (∀ {N_O N_D S_bins : ℕ} (hS : 1 ≤ S_bins)
       (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ) (w_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
       (bin_D : Fin N_D → Fin S_bins),

       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let score_fn := fun q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ =>
         let q_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d

         (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +

       let π_b := fun b : Fin S_bins =>

       score_fn p ≤ (∑ b : Fin S_bins, if 0 < π_b b then π_b b * score_fn (p_b b) else 0) +

    (∀ {N_O N_D N_Z N_T N_R : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ)

       let p_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p o d
       let p_ZD := fun z d => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), p o d
       let q := fun (z : Fin N_Z) (d : Fin N_D) (α : Fin N_T) =>

       let q_TR := fun α rv => ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => r_Z z = rv), ∑ d, q z d α
       (∀ z d α, 0 ≤ q z d α) ∧ (∑ z, ∑ d, ∑ α, q z d α = 1) ∧
       (∀ z d α, 0 < q z d α → α ∈ T_of_Z z ∧ ∃ o, Z_of o = z ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
       ((∑ o, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, p_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) ≤
        (∑ α, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d))) / ell) +
        (∑ α, ∑ rv, -(q_TR α rv * Real.log (q_TR α rv / q_T α))) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (M_amb : ℝ) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log K_mass / ell))) ∧
    ((∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},

     (∀ {N_T N_D N_E N_M N_U : ℕ} (P : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ)
       (E_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_E) (M_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_M) (U_of : Fin N_D → Fin N_U)
       {K_EM : ℕ},
       1 ≤ N_E → 1 ≤ K_EM →
       (∀ α d, 0 ≤ P α d) → (∑ α, ∑ d, P α d = 1) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ e : Fin N_E,
          (((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e)).image M_of).card : ℝ) ≤ (K_EM : ℝ)) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let P_T := fun α => ∑ d, P α d
       let P_D := fun d => ∑ α, P α d
       let P_E := fun e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P_T α
       let P_DE := fun d e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P α d
       let P_M := fun m => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m), P_T α
       let P_MU := fun m u =>
         ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m),
           ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => U_of d = u), P α d
       let Q_TU := fun α u =>
         if 0 < P_M (M_of α) then P_T α * (P_MU (M_of α) u / P_M (M_of α)) else 0
       let Q_U := fun u => ∑ α, Q_TU α u
       (∀ α u, 0 ≤ Q_TU α u) ∧ (∑ α, ∑ u, Q_TU α u = 1) ∧
       (∀ α u, 0 < Q_TU α u → 0 < P_T α ∧
         ∃ α₀ d₀, M_of α₀ = M_of α ∧ U_of d₀ = u ∧ 0 < P α₀ d₀) ∧
       ((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α))) / ell - Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤
         (∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell) ∧
       (((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell -

        ((∑ α, ∑ u, -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (Q_TU α u / Q_U u))) / ell -

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ell
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := by
    dsimp only [ell]
    exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr (by linarith only [hε₁]))
  have hell_nn : 0 ≤ ell := hell_pos.le

  
  
  
  have h_sum_fib_set : ∀ {α : Type} {K : ℕ} (S : Finset α) (g : α → Fin K) (f : α → ℝ)
      (dec : ∀ k : Fin K, DecidablePred (fun i : α => g i = k)),
      (∑ k : Fin K, ∑ i ∈ @Finset.filter α (fun i => g i = k) (dec k) S, f i) =
        ∑ i ∈ S, f i := by
    intro α K S g f dec
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise S g f]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    exact Finset.sum_congr (by ext i; simp) (fun _ _ => rfl)

  have h_sum_fib : ∀ {N K : ℕ} (g : Fin N → Fin K) (f : Fin N → ℝ)
      (dec : ∀ k : Fin K, DecidablePred (fun i : Fin N => g i = k)),
      (∑ k : Fin K, ∑ i ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun i => g i = k) (dec k) Finset.univ, f i) =
        ∑ i : Fin N, f i :=
    fun g f dec => h_sum_fib_set Finset.univ g f dec

  have h_ent_split : ∀ {u v w : ℝ}, 0 ≤ u → (0 < u → 0 < v) → (0 < u → 0 < w) →
      -(u * Real.log (u / w)) = -(u * Real.log (u / v)) + -(u * Real.log (v / w)) := by
    intro u v w hu hv hw
    by_cases hu0 : u = 0
    · simp [hu0]
    · have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_le_of_ne hu (Ne.symm hu0)
      have hv_pos : 0 < v := hv hu_pos
      have hw_pos : 0 < w := hw hu_pos
      have hprod : u / w = (u / v) * (v / w) := by
        field_simp [hv_pos.ne', hw_pos.ne']
      rw [hprod, Real.log_mul (div_pos hu_pos hv_pos).ne' (div_pos hv_pos hw_pos).ne']
      ring

  have h_sum_ent_split : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U w : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < u i → 0 < w) →
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / w))) =
        (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) + -(U * Real.log (U / w)) := by
    intro α S u U w hu_nn hU hw
    have hcongr : (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / w))) =
        ∑ i ∈ S, (-(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) + -(u i * Real.log (U / w))) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      refine h_ent_split (hu_nn i hi) (fun hui => ?_) (hw i hi)
      rw [← hU]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hui (Finset.single_le_sum hu_nn hi)
    rw [hcongr, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hU]

  have h_sum_ent_split_one : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) →
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i))) =
        (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) + -(U * Real.log U) := by
    intro α S u U hu_nn hU
    simpa [div_one] using h_sum_ent_split S u U 1 hu_nn hU (fun _ _ _ => zero_lt_one)

  have h_det_chain : ∀ {α : Type} {K : ℕ} (S : Finset α) (g : α → Fin K) (u : α → ℝ) (w : ℝ)
      (dec : ∀ k : Fin K, DecidablePred (fun i : α => g i = k)),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < u i → 0 < w) →
      let U_k : Fin K → ℝ := fun k => ∑ i ∈ @Finset.filter α (fun i => g i = k) (dec k) S, u i
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / w))) =
        (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U_k (g i)))) +
          ∑ k : Fin K, -(U_k k * Real.log (U_k k / w)) := by
    intro α K S g u w dec hu_nn hw U_k
    rw [← h_sum_fib_set S g (fun i => -(u i * Real.log (u i / w))) dec,
      ← h_sum_fib_set S g (fun i => -(u i * Real.log (u i / U_k (g i)))) dec,
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    have h1 := h_sum_ent_split (@Finset.filter α (fun i => g i = k) (dec k) S) u (U_k k) w
      (fun i hi => hu_nn i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1) rfl
      (fun i hi => hw i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1)
    rw [h1]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2]

  have h_det_chain_one : ∀ {α : Type} {K : ℕ} (S : Finset α) (g : α → Fin K) (u : α → ℝ)
      (dec : ∀ k : Fin K, DecidablePred (fun i : α => g i = k)),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) →
      let U_k : Fin K → ℝ := fun k => ∑ i ∈ @Finset.filter α (fun i => g i = k) (dec k) S, u i
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i))) =
        (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U_k (g i)))) +
          ∑ k : Fin K, -(U_k k * Real.log (U_k k)) := by
    intro α K S g u dec hu_nn
    simpa [div_one] using h_det_chain S g u 1 dec hu_nn (fun _ _ _ => zero_lt_one)

  have h_gibbs : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u w : α → ℝ) (U B : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) → 0 < B →
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < u i → 0 < w i) → (∑ i ∈ S, w i ≤ B) →
      (∑ i ∈ S, (-(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) + u i * Real.log (w i))) ≤ U * Real.log B := by
    intro α S u w U B hu_nn hU hB_pos hw_nn hw_pos hw_sum
    have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := by rw [← hU]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg hu_nn
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · have hu0 : ∀ i ∈ S, u i = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hu_nn).mp (hU.trans hU0)
      rw [hU0, zero_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => by simp [hu0 i hi])]
    · have hU_pos : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU_nn (Ne.symm hU0)
      have hpt : ∀ i ∈ S,
          (-(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) + u i * Real.log (w i)) - u i * Real.log B ≤
            U * (w i / B) - u i := by
        intro i hi
        by_cases hui0 : u i = 0
        · rw [hui0]
          simp only [zero_div, zero_mul, neg_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg hU_nn (div_nonneg (hw_nn i hi) hB_pos.le)
        · have hui_pos : 0 < u i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hu_nn i hi) (Ne.symm hui0)
          have hwi_pos : 0 < w i := hw_pos i hi hui_pos
          let x := (w i / B) / (u i / U)
          have hx_pos : 0 < x := div_pos (div_pos hwi_pos hB_pos) (div_pos hui_pos hU_pos)
          have hlog : Real.log x = Real.log (w i) - Real.log B - Real.log (u i / U) := by
            dsimp only [x]
            rw [Real.log_div (div_pos hwi_pos hB_pos).ne' (div_pos hui_pos hU_pos).ne',
              Real.log_div hwi_pos.ne' hB_pos.ne']
          have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx_pos) hui_pos.le
          have hlhs : u i * Real.log x =
              (-(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) + u i * Real.log (w i)) - u i * Real.log B := by
            rw [hlog]; ring
          have hrhs : u i * (x - 1) = U * (w i / B) - u i := by
            dsimp only [x]
            field_simp [hui_pos.ne', hU_pos.ne', hB_pos.ne']
          rwa [hlhs, hrhs] at h1
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hU,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, hU] at hsum
      have hdiv : (∑ i ∈ S, w i) / B ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hB_pos).mpr hw_sum
      have hmul : U * ((∑ i ∈ S, w i) / B) ≤ U * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv hU_nn
      linarith only [hsum, hmul]

  have h_card_ent : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U K : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) → 0 < K → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K →
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) ≤ U * Real.log K := by
    intro α S u U K hu_nn hU hK_pos hcard
    have hg := h_gibbs S u (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) U K hu_nn hU hK_pos
      (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) (fun _ _ _ => zero_lt_one)
      (by simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]; exact hcard)
    simpa [Real.log_one] using hg

  have h_card_ent_one : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (K : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = 1) → 0 < K → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K →
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i))) ≤ Real.log K := by
    intro α S u K hu_nn hU hK_pos hcard
    simpa [div_one, one_mul] using h_card_ent S u 1 K hu_nn hU hK_pos hcard

  have h_supp_card_ent : ∀ {α : Type} (S₀ S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U K : ℝ),
      S ⊆ S₀ → (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S₀, u i = U) →
      (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 < u i → i ∈ S) → 0 < K → (0 < U → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K) →
      (∑ i ∈ S₀, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) ≤ U * Real.log K := by
    intro α S₀ S u U K hsub hu_nn hU hsupp hK_pos hcard
    have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := by rw [← hU]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg hu_nn
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · have hu0 : ∀ i ∈ S₀, u i = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hu_nn).mp (hU.trans hU0)

  have h_log_sum : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (a b : α → ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ a i) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ b i) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < a i → 0 < b i) →

    intro α S a b ha_nn hb_nn hab_pos

    have hA_nn : 0 ≤ A := Finset.sum_nonneg ha_nn
    by_cases hA0 : A = 0
    · have ha0 : ∀ i ∈ S, a i = 0 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg ha_nn).mp hA0
      rw [hA0, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero,
        Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => by simp [ha0 i hi])]

      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, hai₀⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg ha_nn).mp hA_pos

        lt_of_lt_of_le (hab_pos i₀ hi₀ hai₀) (Finset.single_le_sum hb_nn hi₀)

            dsimp only [x]
            field_simp [hai_pos.ne', hbi_pos.ne', hB_pos.ne']

      have hA_def : ∑ i ∈ S, a i = A := rfl
      have hB_def : ∑ i ∈ S, b i = B := rfl
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hA_def,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, hB_def, hA_def,
        div_self hB_pos.ne', mul_one, sub_self] at hsum

      have hmul : (T.card : ℝ) * (U / (T.card : ℝ)) = U := mul_div_cancel₀ U hcard_pos.ne'

        _ = -(U * (Real.log (U / w) - Real.log (T.card : ℝ))) := by rw [hmul]
        _ = -(U * Real.log (U / w)) + U * Real.log (T.card : ℝ) := by ring

              ∑ e : Fin N_E, -(P_DE d e * Real.log (P_DE d e / P_D d))) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => hd d)
        _ = H_TDE + H_ED := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_comm,
              Finset.sum_comm (f := fun d e => -(P_DE d e * Real.log (P_DE d e / P_D d)))]

    have eq3 : H_QTU = H_TM + H_MU := by
      have hpt : ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (u : Fin N_U),
          -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (Q_TU α u / Q_U u)) =
            -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (P_T α / P_M (M_of α))) +
              -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (P_MU (M_of α) u / Q_U u)) := by
        intro α u
        by_cases hQ0 : Q_TU α u = 0
        · simp [hQ0]
        · have hQ_pos : 0 < Q_TU α u := lt_of_le_of_ne (hQ_nn α u) (Ne.symm hQ0)
          have hPT_pos : 0 < P_T α := (hQ_supp α u hQ_pos).1
          have hPM_pos : 0 < P_M (M_of α) :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le hPT_pos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hPT_nn α')
              (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ α, rfl⟩))
          have hPMU_pos : 0 < P_MU (M_of α) u := by
            obtain ⟨_, α₀, d₀, hm₀, hu₀, hP0⟩ := hQ_supp α u hQ_pos
            have h1 : P α₀ d₀ ≤ ∑ d ∈ F_U u, P α₀ d :=
              Finset.single_le_sum (fun d _ => hP_nn α₀ d)
                (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ d₀, hu₀⟩)
            have h2 : (∑ d ∈ F_U u, P α₀ d) ≤ P_MU (M_of α) u :=
              Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hP_nn α' d))
                (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ α₀, hm₀⟩)
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hP0 (le_trans h1 h2)
          have hQU_pos : 0 < Q_U u :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le hQ_pos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hQ_nn α' u) (Finset.mem_univ α))
          have hQ_def : Q_TU α u = P_T α * (P_MU (M_of α) u / P_M (M_of α)) := by
            dsimp only [Q_TU]; simp only [hPM_pos, ↓reduceIte]
          have hratio : Q_TU α u / Q_U u =
              (P_T α / P_M (M_of α)) * (P_MU (M_of α) u / Q_U u) := by
            rw [hQ_def]; ring
          rw [hratio, Real.log_mul (div_pos hPT_pos hPM_pos).ne' (div_pos hPMU_pos hQU_pos).ne']
          ring
      simp_rw [H_QTU, hpt, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hQ_sum_u α]
      · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        have hu_eq : ∀ u : Fin N_U,
            (∑ α : Fin N_T, -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (P_MU (M_of α) u / Q_U u))) =
              ∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_MU m u * Real.log (P_MU m u / Q_U u)) := by
          intro u
          rw [← h_sum_fib M_of _ _]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
          have hc : (∑ α ∈ F_M m, -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (P_MU (M_of α) u / Q_U u))) =
              ∑ α ∈ F_M m, -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (P_MU m u / Q_U u)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α hα => ?_)
            rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hα).2]
          rw [hc, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hQ_sum_M m u]
        simp_rw [hu_eq]
        exact Finset.sum_comm

    have eq4 : H_E + H_ME = H_M + H_EM := by
      have h1 : (∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_EM e m * Real.log (P_EM e m))) =
          H_ME + H_E := by
        have he : ∀ e : Fin N_E,
            (∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_EM e m * Real.log (P_EM e m))) =
              (∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_EM e m * Real.log (P_EM e m / P_E e))) +
                -(P_E e * Real.log (P_E e)) :=
          fun e => h_sum_ent_split_one Finset.univ (fun m => P_EM e m) (P_E e)
            (fun m _ => hPEM_nn e m) (hPEM_sum_m e)
        simp_rw [he]
        exact Finset.sum_add_distrib
      have h2 : (∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_EM e m * Real.log (P_EM e m))) =
          H_EM + H_M := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        have hm : ∀ m : Fin N_M,
            (∑ e : Fin N_E, -(P_EM e m * Real.log (P_EM e m))) =
              (∑ e : Fin N_E, -(P_EM e m * Real.log (P_EM e m / P_M m))) +
                -(P_M m * Real.log (P_M m)) :=
          fun m => h_sum_ent_split_one Finset.univ (fun e => P_EM e m) (P_M m)
            (fun e _ => hPEM_nn e m) (hPEM_sum_e m)
        simp_rw [hm]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_comm]
      linarith only [h1, h2]

    have eq5 : H_ED + H_MED = H_MD + H_EMD := by
      have hpos_PD : ∀ e m d, 0 < P_EMD e m d → 0 < P_D d := by
        intro e m d hpos
        obtain ⟨α, _, hPαd⟩ :=
          (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun α' _ => hP_nn α' d)).mp hpos
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hPαd
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hP_nn α' d) (Finset.mem_univ α))
      have h1 : (∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ m : Fin N_M,
          -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d))) = H_MED + H_ED := by
        have hed : ∀ (e : Fin N_E) (d : Fin N_D),
            (∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d))) =
              (∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_DE d e))) +
                -(P_DE d e * Real.log (P_DE d e / P_D d)) :=
          fun e d => h_sum_ent_split Finset.univ (fun m => P_EMD e m d) (P_DE d e) (P_D d)
            (fun m _ => hPEMD_nn e m d) (hPEMD_sum_m e d) (fun m _ => hpos_PD e m d)
        simp_rw [hed, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        congr 1
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
      have h2 : (∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ m : Fin N_M,
          -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d))) = H_EMD + H_MD := by
        have hreidx :
            (∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ m : Fin N_M,
              -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d))) =
            ∑ m : Fin N_M, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ e : Fin N_E,
              -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d)) := by
          calc ∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d))
              = ∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ m : Fin N_M, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d)) :=
                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
            _ = ∑ m : Fin N_M, ∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d)) :=
                Finset.sum_comm
            _ = ∑ m : Fin N_M, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ e : Fin N_E, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d)) :=
                Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
        rw [hreidx]
        have hmd : ∀ (m : Fin N_M) (d : Fin N_D),
            (∑ e : Fin N_E, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_D d))) =
              (∑ e : Fin N_E, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_MD m d))) +
                -(P_MD m d * Real.log (P_MD m d / P_D d)) :=
          fun m d => h_sum_ent_split Finset.univ (fun e => P_EMD e m d) (P_MD m d) (P_D d)
            (fun e _ => hPEMD_nn e m d) (hPEMD_sum_e m d) (fun e _ => hpos_PD e m d)
        simp_rw [hmd, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        congr 1
        calc ∑ m : Fin N_M, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ e : Fin N_E, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_MD m d))
            = ∑ m : Fin N_M, ∑ e : Fin N_E, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_MD m d)) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
          _ = H_EMD := Finset.sum_comm
      linarith only [h1, h2]

    have in6 : 0 ≤ H_MED := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => ?_)))
      by_cases h0 : P_EMD e m d = 0
      · simp [h0]
      · have hpos : 0 < P_EMD e m d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hPEMD_nn e m d) (Ne.symm h0)
        have hle : P_EMD e m d ≤ P_DE d e := by
          rw [← hPEMD_sum_m e d]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun m' _ => hPEMD_nn e m' d) (Finset.mem_univ m)
        have hPDE_pos : 0 < P_DE d e := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle
        have hlog_np : Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_DE d e) ≤ 0 :=
          Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg hpos.le hPDE_pos.le) ((div_le_one hPDE_pos).mpr hle)
        have hmul_np : P_EMD e m d * Real.log (P_EMD e m d / P_DE d e) ≤ 0 :=
          mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hpos.le hlog_np
        linarith only [hmul_np]

    have in7 : H_ME ≤ Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) := by
      have hKEM_pos : 0 < (K_EM : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hK_EM)
      have he_le : ∀ e : Fin N_E,
          (∑ m : Fin N_M, -(P_EM e m * Real.log (P_EM e m / P_E e))) ≤
            P_E e * Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) := by
        intro e
        let I_e := (F_E e).image M_of
        have hsupp_I : ∀ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_M)), 0 < P_EM e m → m ∈ I_e := by
          intro m _ hpos
          obtain ⟨α, hα, _⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun α' _ => hPT_nn α')).mp hpos
          obtain ⟨hαE, hαM⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hα
          rw [← hαM]
          exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem M_of hαE
        exact h_supp_card_ent Finset.univ I_e (fun m => P_EM e m) (P_E e) (K_EM : ℝ)
          (Finset.subset_univ I_e) (fun m _ => hPEM_nn e m) (hPEM_sum_m e)
          hsupp_I hKEM_pos (fun _ => hK_EM_card e)
      calc H_ME ≤ ∑ e : Fin N_E, P_E e * Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun e _ => he_le e)
        _ = (∑ e : Fin N_E, P_E e) * Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) := by rw [hPE_sum, one_mul]

    have in8 : H_EMD ≤ H_EM := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun e _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => ?_))
      have hls := h_log_sum Finset.univ (fun d => P_EMD e m d) (fun d => P_MD m d)
        (fun d _ => hPEMD_nn e m d) (fun d _ => hPMD_nn m d)
        (fun d _ hpos => by
          rw [← hPEMD_sum_e m d]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun e' _ => hPEMD_nn e' m d) (Finset.mem_univ e)))
      rwa [hPEMD_sum_d e m, hPMD_sum_d m] at hls

    have in9 : H_MD ≤ H_MU := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => ?_)
      rw [← h_sum_fib U_of (fun d => -(P_MD m d * Real.log (P_MD m d / P_D d))) _]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u _ => ?_)
      have hls := h_log_sum (F_U u) (fun d => P_MD m d) P_D
        (fun d _ => hPMD_nn m d) (fun d _ => hPD_nn d)
        (fun d _ hpos => by
          obtain ⟨α, _, hPαd⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun α' _ => hP_nn α' d)).mp hpos
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hPαd
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hP_nn α' d) (Finset.mem_univ α)))
      have hsum_a : ∑ d ∈ F_U u, P_MD m d = P_MU m u := Finset.sum_comm
      have hsum_b : ∑ d ∈ F_U u, P_D d = Q_U u := (hQU_eq_PU u).symm
      rwa [hsum_a, hsum_b] at hls

    have h_raw : H_TE - H_TDE ≤ (H_QTU - H_TD) + Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) := by
      linarith only [eq0, eq1, eq2, eq3, eq4, eq5, in6, in7, in8, in9]
    have h_part5 : H_TE / ell - H_TDE / ell ≤
        (H_QTU / ell - H_TD / ell) + Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) / ell := by
      have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_raw hell_nn
      have hl : (H_TE - H_TDE) / ell = H_TE / ell - H_TDE / ell := sub_div H_TE H_TDE ell
      have hr : ((H_QTU - H_TD) + Real.log (K_EM : ℝ)) / ell =
          (H_QTU / ell - H_TD / ell) + Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) / ell := by
        rw [add_div, sub_div]
      rwa [hl, hr] at hdiv

    exact ⟨hQ_nn, hQ_tot, hQ_supp, h_part4, h_part5⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_cl : ClassicalLineGrowthBound γ)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h_slk ζ_slk A_win ξ C_cov e_slk : ℝ)
    (M_mult M_ord : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (C_sub_bes C_at_cnt B_V B_X C_far : ℝ)
    (hh_slk : 0 < h_slk) (hζ_slk : 0 < ζ_slk) (h4h : 4 * h_slk ≤ ζ_slk)
    (hA_win : 0 < A_win) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov)
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M)
    (he_slk : 0 < e_slk) (h16ξ : 16 * ξ ≤ e_slk)
    (hC_bes : 1 ≤ C_sub_bes) (hC_at : 1 ≤ C_at_cnt)
    (hBV : C_cov ≤ B_V) (hBX : 2 ≤ B_X) (hC_far : 0 ≤ C_far)
    (hM_ord_gt : 10 * cls.K_hor + ξ + 2 < (2 * (M_ord : ℝ)) * min (h_slk / 4) (e_slk / 128))
    (h_ana : ∀ (ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
      (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      let r := t - 2 * h_slk
      let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
      let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
      let s_v := ε ^ b_star
      let s_x := s_c * s_v
      let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
      let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
      let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
      let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
      let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
      let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
      let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
      let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
        (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
          Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
      0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
      m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
      cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
      IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
        m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
      (ε ^ r ≤ s_c ∧ s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r ∧
       (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ (2 * h_slk) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
       ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (2 * h_slk) ∧
       (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_sub_bes * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) ∧
       (N_ret : ℝ) ≤ C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) ∧
      (∀ o : Fin N_O, cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx →
        let r_loc := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
        let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
        r_O o = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
        r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
        ‖V_O o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x ∧
        ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
          (B_V * ρ_t ≤ ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ →
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) = 0) ∧
          (∀ R_tr : ℝ, B_X ≤ R_tr →
            R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_O o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ →
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤ C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))))) ∧
      (∀ (r_i : ℕ), r_i < 2 ^ m_t →
        ∀ (S_obs : Finset (Fin N_O)), (∀ o ∈ S_obs, r_O o = r_i) →
        ∀ (S_at : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
          ∑ o ∈ S_obs, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
            (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_at, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
            (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
            C_sub_bes * ∑ α ∈ S_at, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) ∧
      (letI := Classical.propDecidable
       ∀ o : Fin N_O,
         (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Finset (Fin N_ret)), Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
           generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
             (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
             (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
           2 * generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
             (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
             (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) +
           2 * ∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) ∧
         (∀ (I : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (F_part : (ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (Fin N_ret)),
           (∀ i₁ ∈ I, ∀ i₂ ∈ I, i₁ ≠ i₂ → Disjoint (F_part i₁) (F_part i₂)) →
           generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
             (fun v => ∑ α ∈ I.biUnion F_part, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
             (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
           (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,

  have h_s3 : ∀ (ε : ℝ) {N_Z N_D N_T N_R : ℕ}

  have h_s4 : ∀ (ε L_cl g_bin : ℝ)

  let R_tr : ℝ := ε ^ (-η_tr)

  have hBXC_eh : B_XC * ε ^ ((11 / 4 : ℝ) * h_slk) ≤ 1 :=

  have hClog_ell : C_log / ell ≤ e_slk / 4 :=

        _ = ε ^ (A_win / 2) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_add hε₀ (A_win / 2) 2

  have hCtail_e2_le : C_tail_prod * ε ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by

    nlinarith only [hC_tail_nn, hε_sq_le, he5, hε₀]

  
  
  
  let score_fn : (Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) → ℝ := fun q =>
    let q_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d

    (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) / ell) +

    have hpD_sum : (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond o d) = 1 := by

    have hw_eq : (∑ d : Fin N_D, (∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond o d) *

  have hmO_pos_cond : ∀ o : Fin N_O, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d) → 0 < m_O o := by

  have h_per_bin : ∀ b : Fin S_a, 0 < π_b b → score_fn (p_b b) ≤ Target_bin := by
    intro b hπb_pos
    obtain ⟨hpb_nn, hpb_sum, hpb_supp⟩ := hp_b_props b hπb_pos
    let a_tilde : ℝ := max b_star ((b.1 : ℝ) * η_a)
    have hb_le_at : b_star ≤ a_tilde := le_max_left _ _
    have hat_nn : 0 ≤ a_tilde := le_trans hb_star0 hb_le_at
    have hpb_active_a : ∀ o d, 0 < p_b b o d →
        b_star ≤ b_D d ∧ a_tilde ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ a_tilde + η_a ∧
        ζ_slk ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 - a_D d ∧ 0 < p_cond o d := by

      have hhi_div := (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (a_D d / η_a)).le

      have ha_hi : a_D d ≤ ((b.1 : ℝ) + 1) * η_a := (div_le_iff₀ hη_a_pos).mp hhi_div
      have hb_st_d : b_star ≤ b_D d := (h_supp o d hpc_pos).2.1
      have hba_d : b_D d ≤ a_D d := (hadm_D d).2.1
      have hat_le_a : a_tilde ≤ a_D d := max_le (le_trans hb_st_d hba_d) ha_lo
      have hbm_le_at : (b.1 : ℝ) * η_a ≤ a_tilde := le_max_right _ _

    have hd0_Lt : a_D d₀_b ≤ L - t := le_trans (hadm_D d₀_b).2.2.1 (min_le_left _ _)
    have hat_Lt : a_tilde ≤ L - t := le_trans hat_le_d0 hd0_Lt
    have hat_ut_slk : a_tilde ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 - ζ_slk := by linarith only [hat_le_d0, hζ_d0]

    
    let s_VZ : ℝ := ε ^ a_tilde

    have hmax_Rtr_σr : max B_X C_cov * R_tr * σ_r ≤ s_XZ := by
      have hexp : (11 / 4 : ℝ) * h_slk + (a_tilde + t) ≤ (H_P + r) / 2 - η_tr := by

        linarith only [hat_ut_slk, h4h, hη_tr_h4]

    have hRσ_nn : 0 ≤ R_tr * σ_r := by

      have hlam_pos : 0 < lam_sys :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hB_sys_pos) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-H_P))) hlam_lo

    have hCcov_Rtr_σr : C_cov * R_tr * σ_r ≤ s_XZ := by
      calc C_cov * R_tr * σ_r = C_cov * (R_tr * σ_r) := by ring
        _ ≤ max B_X C_cov * (R_tr * σ_r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hRσ_nn

        _ ≤ C_cov * (R_tr * σ_r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [hC_cov]) hRσ_nn

    let N_R : ℕ := 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)

    let T_of_Z : Fin N_Z → Finset (Fin N_ret) :=

        let C_tz := (((q_r * N_R + vZ.1.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
        Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
          ‖V_at α - gridPt2D s_VZ vZ.2.1‖ ≤ 3 * s_VZ ∧

              V_at α) - gridPt2D s_XZ (val_Z z).2.2‖ ≤ 3 * s_XZ) := by

    have hmO_pos_b : ∀ o : Fin N_O, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d) → 0 < m_O o := by
      intro o hsum_pos
      have hex_d : ∃ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p_b b o d := by

        have hz : ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d = 0 :=

        (h_supp o d (hpb_supp o d hd).2).2.2.2

    
    let K_mass : ℝ := 2 * (C_sub_bes + 1) * ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin
    have hK_mass_pos : 0 < K_mass :=
      mul_pos (mul_pos (by linarith only [hC_bes]) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-ξ))) hm_bin_pos

    have h_fiber_mass : (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ z : Fin N_Z, (0 < ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), ∑ d, p_b b o d) →
          (T_of_Z z).Nonempty ∧
          (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z),
            if 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d then m_O o else 0) ≤
            K_mass * ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ)) := by
      intro z hz_pos
      let S_obs : Finset (Fin N_O) :=
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => Z_of o = z ∧ 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d)
      have hS_obs_mem : ∀ o : Fin N_O,
          o ∈ S_obs ↔ (Z_of o = z ∧ 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d) := by
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        intro o; simp [S_obs]
      have hS_obs_act : ∀ o ∈ S_obs,
          Z_of o = z ∧
          cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
          ε ^ A_win ≤ m_O o := by
        intro o ho
        obtain ⟨hoz, hsum_o⟩ := (hS_obs_mem o).mp ho
        have hex_d : ∃ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p_b b o d := by
          by_contra hall; push Not at hall
          have hz0 : ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d = 0 :=
            Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => le_antisymm (hall d) (hpb_nn o d))
          linarith only [hsum_o, hz0]
        obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hex_d
        have hpc := (hpb_supp o d hd).2
        exact ⟨hoz, (h_supp o d hpc).1, (h_supp o d hpc).2.2.2⟩
      
      have hex_o1 : ∃ o₁, o₁ ∈ S_obs := by
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        by_contra hall; push Not at hall
        have hz0 : (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => Z_of o = z),
            ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d) = 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => ?_)
          have hoz : Z_of o = z := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2
          have hle0 : ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d ≤ 0 := by
            by_contra hgt; push Not at hgt
            exact hall o ((hS_obs_mem o).mpr ⟨hoz, hgt⟩)
          exact le_antisymm hle0 (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hpb_nn o d))
        linarith only [hz_pos, hz0]
      obtain ⟨o₁, ho₁_mem⟩ := hex_o1
      obtain ⟨ho₁_z, ho₁_loc, ho₁_fl⟩ := hS_obs_act o₁ ho₁_mem
      let rv := (val_Z z).1
      let z_V := (val_Z z).2.1
      let z_X := (val_Z z).2.2
      let r_i : ℕ := q_r * N_R + rv.1
      let C_tz : ℝ := ((r_i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
      have hS_obs_ri : ∀ o ∈ S_obs, r_O o = r_i := by
        intro o ho
        obtain ⟨hoz, holoc, _⟩ := hS_obs_act o ho
        have h_eq_loc := (h_ana_loc o holoc).1
        have h_mod : r_O o % N_R = rv.1 := by
          have hv := hval_Z_of o
          rw [hoz] at hv
          exact (congrArg (fun p => p.1.1) hv).symm
        dsimp only [r_i, q_r, N_R] at h_mod ⊢
        rwa [h_mod] at h_eq_loc
      have hri_lt : r_i < 2 ^ m_t := by
        rw [← hS_obs_ri o₁ ho₁_mem]
        exact (hadm_site o₁).1

      
      have hT_nonempty : (T_of_Z z).Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, hVo1_VJ, hXo1_XJ, _⟩ := h_ana_loc o₁ ho₁_loc
        have ho₁_ri : r_O o₁ = r_i := hS_obs_ri o₁ ho₁_mem
        have hVo1_4B : ‖V_O o₁ - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v := by
          have hsv_nn : 0 ≤ s_v := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ b_star).le
          have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys := by linarith only [cls.hB_sys]
          exact le_trans hVo1_VJ (by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hsv_nn)
        have hXo1_4B : ‖X_O o₁ + (C_r - C_tz) • V_O o₁ - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x := by
          have hsx_nn : 0 ≤ s_x := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ b_star).le
          have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys := by linarith only [cls.hB_sys]
          have hCt_eq : (((r_O o₁ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹) = C_tz := by
            dsimp only [C_tz]; rw [ho₁_ri]
          rw [← hCt_eq]
          exact le_trans hXo1_XJ (by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hsx_nn)
        let S_near : Finset (Fin N_ret) :=
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
            ‖V_O o₁ - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * ρ_t ∧
            ‖X_O o₁ - X_at α - (C_tz - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * R_tr * σ_r)
        have hS_near_mem : ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
            α ∈ S_near ↔
              (‖V_O o₁ - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * ρ_t ∧
               ‖X_O o₁ - X_at α - (C_tz - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * R_tr * σ_r) := by
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          intro α; simp [S_near]
        have h_tr_o1 : ‖((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_sub v * ψ_O o₁ (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o₁)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_tz, X_O o₁, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
            ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, (∑ α ∈ S_near, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) *
              ψ_O o₁ (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o₁)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_tz, X_O o₁, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))‖ ≤
            C_tr M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) := by
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          have h_tr_raw := hsub_tr rv.1 rv.2 (V_O o₁) (X_O o₁) (ψ_O o₁)
          have hr_if : (if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)) = ρ_r :=
            if_neg hr_pos.ne'
          simp only [hr_if] at h_tr_raw
          exact h_tr_raw hVo1_4B hXo1_4B (hadm_sm o₁) (hadm_supp o₁) (hadm_der o₁)
            M_tr R_tr hM_tr_2 hRtr_ge2
        have hS_near_ne : S_near.Nonempty := by
          by_contra h_empty
          rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h_empty
          rw [h_empty] at h_tr_o1
          simp only [Finset.sum_empty, zero_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero]
            at h_tr_o1
          have h_pair_lt : ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_sub v * ψ_O o₁ (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o₁)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_tz, X_O o₁, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ <
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (A_win / 2) :=
            lt_of_le_of_lt h_tr_o1 hCtr_tail_lt
          have hm_eq : m_O o₁ = ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_sub v * ψ_O o₁ (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o₁)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_tz, X_O o₁, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 := by
            dsimp only [m_O, generalPacketObsMass, C_tz, ρ_t]
            rw [ho₁_ri]
          have h_sq_lt : m_O o₁ < (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ε ^ A_win := by
            rw [hm_eq]
            have hnn := norm_nonneg ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_sub v * ψ_O o₁ (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o₁)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_tz, X_O o₁, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
            have hsq1 : ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_sub v * ψ_O o₁ (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o₁)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_tz, X_O o₁, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 <
                ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (A_win / 2)) ^ 2 := by
              nlinarith only [h_pair_lt, hnn]
            have hsq2 : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (A_win / 2)) ^ 2 = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ε ^ A_win := by
              calc ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (A_win / 2)) ^ 2
                  = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (ε ^ (A_win / 2) * ε ^ (A_win / 2)) := by ring
                _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ε ^ A_win := by
                    rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, add_halves]
            rwa [hsq2] at hsq1
          have hAw_pos : 0 < ε ^ A_win := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ A_win
          linarith only [ho₁_fl, h_sq_lt, hAw_pos]
        obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀⟩ := hS_near_ne
        obtain ⟨hdV₀, hdX₀⟩ := (hS_near_mem α₀).mp hα₀
        have hv_eq : val_Z z = raw_Z o₁ := by rw [← ho₁_z]; exact hval_Z_of o₁
        have hzV_eq : z_V = roundShift2D s_VZ 0 (V_O o₁) := congrArg (fun p => p.2.1) hv_eq
        have hzX_eq : z_X = roundShift2D s_XZ 0 (X_O o₁) := congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) hv_eq
        have hVo1_cell : ‖V_O o₁ - gridPt2D s_VZ z_V‖ ≤ 2 * s_VZ := by
          rw [hzV_eq]; exact h_s2.1 s_VZ (V_O o₁) hs_VZ_pos
        have hXo1_cell : ‖X_O o₁ - gridPt2D s_XZ z_X‖ ≤ 2 * s_XZ := by
          rw [hzX_eq]; exact h_s2.1 s_XZ (X_O o₁) hs_XZ_pos
        have h_in_cell := (h_s2.2.2.1 s_VZ s_XZ (C_cov * ρ_t) (C_cov * R_tr * σ_r) (C_tz - C_r)
          (V_O o₁) (X_O o₁) (V_at α₀) (X_at α₀) z_V z_X
          hVo1_cell hXo1_cell hCcov_ρt_le hCcov_Rtr_σr).1 ⟨hdV₀, hdX₀⟩
        exact ⟨α₀, (hT_mem_iff z α₀).mpr h_in_cell⟩

      
      refine ⟨hT_nonempty, ?_⟩
      have h_sum_eq_Sobs :
          (letI := Classical.propDecidable
           ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z),
             if 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d then m_O o else 0) =
          ∑ o ∈ S_obs, m_O o := by
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        dsimp only [S_obs]
        simp_rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
        by_cases h1 : Z_of o = z <;> by_cases h2 : 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_b b o d <;>
          simp [h1, h2]
      rw [h_sum_eq_Sobs]
      let S₁ : Finset (Fin N_ret) := T_of_Z z
      let S₂ : Finset (Fin N_ret) := Finset.univ \ S₁
      have h_disj : Disjoint S₁ S₂ := disjoint_sdiff_self_right
      have h_per_o_split : ∀ o ∈ S_obs,
          m_O o ≤
            2 * generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
              (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) +
            2 * ((C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) ^ 2 * C_far *
              R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin)) := by
        intro o ho
        obtain ⟨hoz, holoc, _⟩ := hS_obs_act o ho
        have hp_split : m_O o ≤
            2 * generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
              (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) +
            2 * ∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
              generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) := by
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          have hp_raw := (h_ana_part o).1 S₁ S₂ h_disj
          have h_u : S₁ ∪ S₂ = Finset.univ := by
            ext α; by_cases h : α ∈ S₁ <;> simp [h, S₂]
          simp_rw [h_u] at hp_raw
          exact hp_raw
        have ho_ri : r_O o = r_i := hS_obs_ri o ho
        have hv_eq : val_Z z = raw_Z o := by rw [← hoz]; exact hval_Z_of o
        have hVo_cell : ‖V_O o - gridPt2D s_VZ z_V‖ ≤ 2 * s_VZ := by
          dsimp only [z_V]
          rw [congrArg (fun p => p.2.1) hv_eq]; exact h_s2.1 s_VZ (V_O o) hs_VZ_pos
        have hXo_cell : ‖X_O o - gridPt2D s_XZ z_X‖ ≤ 2 * s_XZ := by
          dsimp only [z_X]
          rw [congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) hv_eq]; exact h_s2.1 s_XZ (X_O o) hs_XZ_pos
        have hS2_card_le : (S₂.card : ℝ) ≤ C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor)) := by
          have hc : (S₂.card : ℝ) ≤ (N_ret : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast ((Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ S₂)).trans_eq (Fintype.card_fin N_ret))
          exact le_trans hc hNret_cnt
        have h_far_α : ∀ α ∈ S₂,
            ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
              generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
            (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) * (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) *
              (C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ)))) := by
          intro α hαS2
          have hnotS1 : α ∉ S₁ := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hαS2).2
          have hnot_cond : ¬ (‖V_at α - gridPt2D s_VZ z_V‖ ≤ 3 * s_VZ ∧
              ‖(X_at α + (C_tz - C_r) • V_at α) - gridPt2D s_XZ z_X‖ ≤ 3 * s_XZ) :=
            fun hc => hnotS1 ((hT_mem_iff z α).mpr hc)
          have h_dich := (h_s2.2.2.1 s_VZ s_XZ (B_V * ρ_t) (R_tr * σ_r) (C_tz - C_r)
            (V_O o) (X_O o) (V_at α) (X_at α) z_V z_X
            hVo_cell hXo_cell hBV_ρt_le h1_Rtr_σr).2 hnot_cond
          have h_mass_α : generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤ C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) := by
            obtain ⟨h_vel_zero, h_pos_far⟩ := (h_ana_loc o holoc).2.2.2.2.2 α
            rcases h_dich with hV_far | hX_far
            · rw [h_vel_zero hV_far]
              exact mul_nonneg hC_far (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
            · have hCt_eq : (((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹) = C_tz := by
                dsimp only [C_tz]; rw [ho_ri]
              exact h_pos_far R_tr hBX_lt_Rtr.le (by rwa [hCt_eq])
          have hc_at_bd : ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin :=
            (hsub_at α).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
          have hm_nn : 0 ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) := sq_nonneg _
          have hprod1 : ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) ≤
              (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) * (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) :=
            mul_le_mul hc_at_bd hS2_card_le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
              (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le hm_bin_pos.le)
          exact mul_le_mul hprod1 h_mass_α hm_nn
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le hm_bin_pos.le)
              (mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hC_at]) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le))
        have h_sum_S2 : (∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
              generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) ≤
            (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) ^ 2 * C_far *
              R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by
          calc (∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))
              ≤ ∑ _α ∈ S₂, (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) * (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) *
                  (C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ)))) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_far_α
            _ = (S₂.card : ℝ) * ((ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) * (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) *
                  (C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))))) := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
            _ ≤ (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) *
                  ((ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) * (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) *
                  (C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))))) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS2_card_le
                  (mul_nonneg
                    (mul_nonneg
                      (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le hm_bin_pos.le)
                      (mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hC_at]) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le))
                    (mul_nonneg hC_far (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) _).le))
            _ = (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) ^ 2 * C_far *
                  R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by ring
        linarith only [hp_split, h_sum_S2]

      have h_near_sum : ∑ o ∈ S_obs, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
            (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
          C_sub_bes * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) * (S₁.card : ℝ) := by
        have hb1 := h_ana_bes r_i hri_lt S_obs hS_obs_ri S₁
        have hb2 : ∑ α ∈ S₁, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤ (S₁.card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by
          calc ∑ α ∈ S₁, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2
              ≤ ∑ _α ∈ S₁, (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α _ => (hsub_at α).2.2.2.2.2.2.1)
            _ = (S₁.card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        calc ∑ o ∈ S_obs, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
              (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)
            ≤ C_sub_bes * ∑ α ∈ S₁, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 := hb1
          _ ≤ C_sub_bes * ((S₁.card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 (by linarith only [hC_bes])
          _ = C_sub_bes * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) * (S₁.card : ℝ) := by ring

      have h_far_tot : (S_obs.card : ℝ) *
            ((C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) ^ 2 * C_far *
              R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin)) ≤
          (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) * (S₁.card : ℝ) := by
        have hSobs_card : (S_obs.card : ℝ) ≤ C_sub_bes * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) := by
          have hc : (S_obs.card : ℝ) ≤ (N_O : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast ((Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ S_obs)).trans_eq (Fintype.card_fin N_O))
          exact le_trans hc hNO_cnt
        have hRtr_ord : R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) = ε ^ ((2 * (M_ord : ℝ)) * η_tr) := by
          dsimp only [R_tr]
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε₀.le]
          congr 1; ring
        have hexp_combine : ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) * (ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) ^ 2 *
              R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) ≤ ε ^ 2 := by
