    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ A_win) hfl
  let N_R : ℕ := 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
  have hN_R_pos : 0 < N_R := Nat.two_pow_pos (m_t - m_r)
  have hN_R1 : 1 ≤ N_R := hN_R_pos
  let rv_O : Fin N_O → Fin N_R := fun o => ⟨r_O o % N_R, Nat.mod_lt _ hN_R_pos⟩
  let rv_D : Fin N_D → Fin N_R := fun d => ⟨r_D d % N_R, Nat.mod_lt _ hN_R_pos⟩
  have h_act_ba_r : ∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
      |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ rv_O o = rv_D d := by
    intro o d hpd
    obtain ⟨_, hb_sh, ha_sh, _, _, _⟩ := h_act o d hpd
    have hr_eq := (hadm_act o d hpd).2.1
    refine ⟨hb_sh, ha_sh, ?_⟩
    ext
    dsimp only [rv_O, rv_D]
    rw [hr_eq]
  have hNR_bd : (N_R : ℝ) ≤ C_R * ε ^ (-(2 * h)) := by
    have h_cast : (N_R : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r) := by
      dsimp only [N_R]; push_cast; rfl
    have h_lhs_pos : 0 < (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ (2 * h) :=
      mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (by linarith only [hB_sys2])) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _)
    have h_nr_pos : 0 < (N_R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN_R_pos
    rw [← h_cast] at hm_tr_lo
    have h_inv := (inv_le_inv₀ (inv_pos.mpr h_nr_pos) h_lhs_pos).mpr hm_tr_lo
    rw [inv_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, ← Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le] at h_inv
    dsimp only [C_R]
    linarith only [h_inv]
  have hNE_bd : ((Finset.univ.image sub.cap_id).card : ℝ) ≤
      C_E * (sub.N_all : ℝ) * ε ^ (sub.g_bin - pktWeight γ sub.b_loc sub.a_loc - 2 * ξ) := by
    have h_img_eq : Finset.univ.image sub.cap_id =
        @Finset.image _ _ (fun a b => Classical.propDecidable (a = b)) sub.cap_id Finset.univ := by
      ext c
      simp only [Finset.mem_image]
    rw [h_img_eq]
    exact hNE_bd_raw
  let K_fac : ℝ := K_pave2 * R_tr ^ 2
  have hK_fac1 : 1 ≤ K_fac := by
    have hR2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ R_tr ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hR_tr_ge1
    dsimp only [K_fac]
    nlinarith only [hK_pave2_ge1, hR2]
  have h_fib_mass : ∀ (p_buf : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (rv : Fin N_R)
      (S_obs : Finset (Fin N_O)) (T_P : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ o ∈ S_obs, (0 < ∑ d, p_cond o d) ∧ P_obs o = p_buf ∧ rv_O o = rv) →
      (∀ α : Fin N_ret, P_at α = p_buf ↔ α ∈ T_P) →
      S_obs.Nonempty →
      T_P.Nonempty ∧
      ∑ o ∈ S_obs, m_O o ≤ K_fac * ε ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ) * h - ξ) * sub.m_bin * (T_P.card : ℝ) := by
    intro p_buf rv S_obs T_P hS_in hT_P hS_ne
    have ⟨o₁, ho₁⟩ := hS_ne
    let r_i : ℕ := r_O o₁
    have hr_i : r_i < 2 ^ m_t := (hadm_site o₁).1
    have h_act_of_mem : ∀ o ∈ S_obs, ∃ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p_cond o d := by
      intro o ho
      have hsum_pos := (hS_in o ho).1
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      have hz : (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d) = 0 :=
        Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => le_antisymm (hall d) (hp_nn o d))
      linarith only [hsum_pos, hz]
    have hr_eq_all : ∀ o ∈ S_obs, r_O o = sub.loc_idx.1 * N_R + rv.1 := by
      intro o ho
      obtain ⟨d, hpd⟩ := h_act_of_mem o ho
      have hloc := (h_act o d hpd).1
      have hr_decomp := (h_ana_loc o hloc).1
      have hrv_eq : r_O o % N_R = rv.1 := congrArg Fin.val (hS_in o ho).2.2
      dsimp only [N_R] at hrv_eq ⊢
      rw [← hrv_eq]
      exact hr_decomp
    have hr_o_eq_ri : ∀ o ∈ S_obs, r_O o = r_i := by
      intro o ho
      dsimp only [r_i]
      rw [hr_eq_all o ho, hr_eq_all o₁ ho₁]
    have h_loc_far : ∀ o ∈ S_obs,
        let r := t - 2 * h
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        let r_loc := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
        let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
        r_O o = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
        r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
        ‖V_O o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x ∧
        ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
          R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_O o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ →
          generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
            (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤ C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) := by
      intro o ho
      obtain ⟨d, hpd⟩ := h_act_of_mem o ho
      obtain ⟨hr1, hr2, hct, hvj, hxj, hfar_all⟩ := h_ana_loc o (h_act o d hpd).1
      exact ⟨hr1, hr2, hct, hvj, hxj, fun α hdist => (hfar_all α).2 R_tr hR_tr_BX hdist⟩
    have hS_obs_s3 : ∀ o ∈ S_obs,
        let r := t - 2 * h
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
          ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
        r_O o = r_i ∧
        coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) = p_buf ∧
        (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          let q_r := r_O o / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
          let C_r' := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
          let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          ‖v' - V_O o‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) →
          ‖x' - (X_O o + (C_r' - C_t) • V_O o)‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ (r + (H_P - t) / 2) →
          coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
          coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x')) ∧
        ε ^ A_win ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
          (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) := by
      intro o ho
      obtain ⟨d, hpd⟩ := h_act_of_mem o ho
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hbuf_o, hfl_o⟩ := h_act o d hpd
      exact ⟨hr_o_eq_ri o ho, (hS_in o ho).2.1, hbuf_o, hfl_o⟩
    obtain ⟨hTP_imp, hmass_bd⟩ :=
      buffered_cell_paving_fiber_mass_bound cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t h b_star lam_sys A_win ξ C_cov
        M_L M_mult M_ord M_tr m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret C_tr C_sub_bes B_X C_far R_tr
        Φ₀ ζ₀ f τ_V τ_X r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D sub p_cond
        p_buf r_i S_obs T_P
        ⟨h_s1_diam, h_s1_dyad, h_s1_ball, h_s1_ann⟩
        hh hC_cov hML_bound hM_mult hC_bes hBX hC_far hM_tr hR_tr_BX
        hR_tr_eh h_tr_tail h_eh_small h_far_small hr_pos ht_HP
        henv hsub hadm hs_c_hi h_loc_far (h_ana_bes r_i hr_i S_obs hr_o_eq_ri) hr_i hS_obs_s3 hT_P
    exact ⟨hTP_imp hS_ne, hmass_bd⟩
  have h_mk_compat : ∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D),
      P_at α = P_obs o → 0 < p_cond o d →
      ∃ o' : Fin N_O, P_at α = P_obs o' ∧
        cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o') (V_O o') (X_O o') = sub.loc_idx ∧
        |(((r_O o' : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹) - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
        r_O o' = r_D d ∧
        |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧
        projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_buf (P_obs o')) ≤ ε ^ (4 * h) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_O o' - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (X_O o' - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d + t) := by
    intro α o d hP hpd
    obtain ⟨hloc, hb_sh, ha_sh, hpred, _, _⟩ := h_act o d hpd
    obtain ⟨_, _, hct, _, _, _⟩ := h_ana_loc o hloc
    obtain ⟨_, hr_eq, _, hv_perp, _, hx_perp⟩ := hadm_act o d hpd
    exact ⟨o, hP, hloc, hct, hr_eq, hb_sh, ha_sh, hpred, hv_perp, hx_perp⟩
  have h_fib_D : ∀ (d : Fin N_D) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, ∃ o : Fin N_O, P_at α = P_obs o ∧ 0 < p_cond o d) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C_D * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin + (1 - γ) * ((a_ref - b_star) - 2 * ζ_sh) - 2 * ξ) := by
    intro d S hS
    exact h_compat_D d S (fun α hα =>
      let ⟨o, hP, hpd⟩ := hS α hα
      h_mk_compat α o d hP hpd)
  have h_fib_DE : ∀ (d : Fin N_D) (c : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, sub.cap_id α = c ∧ ∃ o : Fin N_O, P_at α = P_obs o ∧ 0 < p_cond o d) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C_DE * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin + 2 * ((a_ref - b_star) - h - 2 * ζ_sh) - 2 * ξ) := by
    intro d c S hS
    exact h_compat_DE d c S (fun α hα =>
      let ⟨hcap, o, hP, hpd⟩ := hS α hα
      ⟨hcap, h_mk_compat α o d hP hpd⟩)
  have h_fib_U : ∀ (u : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℤ × ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, ∃ (α₀ : Fin N_ret) (d₀ : Fin N_D),
        m_raw α₀ = m_raw α ∧ u_raw d₀ = u ∧
        ∃ o : Fin N_O, P_at α₀ = P_obs o ∧ 0 < p_cond o d₀) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C_U * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin + (1 - γ) * sub.b_loc - 2 * ξ) := by
    intro u S hS
    exact h_compat_U u S (fun α hα =>
      let ⟨α₀, d₀, hm_eq, hu_eq, o, hP, hpd⟩ := hS α hα
      ⟨α₀, d₀, hm_eq, hu_eq, h_mk_compat α₀ o d₀ hP hpd⟩)
  have h_s5_res :=
    contributor_cramer_strip_entropy_exclusion
      γ ε h e₀ ζ_sh ξ b_star b_ref a_ref sub.m_bin sub.g_bin sub.b_loc sub.a_loc
      N_O N_D N_ret sub.N_all N_R K_fac C_R C_E C_D C_DE C_U
      p_cond m_O b_D a_D P_obs P_at rv_O rv_D sub.cap_id m_raw u_raw
      hγ₀ hγ₁ hε₀ hε₁ hh hm_bin_pos hN_ret1 hN_all1 hN_R1
      hK_fac1 hC_R_ge1 hC_E_ge1 hC_D_ge1 hC_DE_ge1 hC_U_ge1
      hb_bref he_bloc haloc_hi hp_nn hp_sum hm_pos h_act_ba_r
      hNR_bd hNE_bd h625 h_fib_mass h_fib_D h_fib_DE h_fib_U (h_ent ε hε₀ hε₁)
  have h_s5_clean :
      2 * γ * e₀ ≤
        (Real.log ((sub.N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret : ℝ)) / ell) +
        4 * (subclassProxyA ε sub -
          subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
            r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond) +
        ((37 / 2 : ℝ) + γ) * h +
        16 * ζ_sh + 14 * ξ +
        (6 * Real.log K_fac + 4 * Real.log C_R + Real.log C_E + Real.log C_D +
          Real.log C_DE + Real.log C_U + Real.log 625) / ell := by
    have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := hr_pos.ne'
    have h_win_eq :
        subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
          r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond =
        (let p_O := fun o : Fin N_O => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d
         let p_D := fun d : Fin N_D => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond o d
         (∑ o, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
         (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
         (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, p_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) +
         (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) - b_star) := by
      unfold subclassWinScore generalPacketScore
      simp only [hr_ne, ↓reduceIte]
      rfl
    rw [h_win_eq]
    exact h_s5_res
  have h_log_Kfac :
      (6 * Real.log K_fac + 4 * Real.log C_R + Real.log C_E + Real.log C_D +
        Real.log C_DE + Real.log C_U + Real.log 625) / ell =
      12 * θ + C_log_const / ell := by
    have hK2_pos : 0 < K_pave2 := by linarith only [hK_pave2_ge1]
    have hRtr_pos : 0 < R_tr := by linarith only [hR_tr_ge1]
    have h_log_R2 : Real.log (R_tr ^ 2) = 2 * θ * ell := by
      rw [Real.log_pow]
      dsimp only [R_tr, ell]
      rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀, Real.log_inv]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_log_prod : Real.log K_fac = Real.log K_pave2 + 2 * θ * ell := by
      dsimp only [K_fac]
      rw [Real.log_mul hK2_pos.ne' (pow_pos hRtr_pos 2).ne', h_log_R2]
    rw [h_log_prod]
    dsimp only [C_log_const]
    have hell_ne : ell ≠ 0 := hell_pos.ne'
    field_simp [hell_ne]
    ring
  rw [h_log_Kfac] at h_s5_clean
  have h_beta_pos : 0 < quantumPacketRate γ * h := mul_pos hβ_pos hh
  have h_h_loss : ((37 / 2 : ℝ) + γ) * h < 20 * h := by nlinarith only [hγ₁, hh]
  have h_err_sum : 16 * ζ_sh + 14 * ξ + 12 * θ + C_log_const / ell < e_al := by
    linarith only [h64_err, hζ_sh, hξ, hθ_eal, h_log_const_le, he_al]
  linarith only [h_s5_clean, h_beta_pos, h_h_loss, h_err_sum]

subgoal_signatures.name: annulus_grid_and_dyadic_paving_card_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ (M_L : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (τ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      1 ≤ M_L → 0 < s →
      (let p₁ := roundShift2D s τ z₁
       let p₂ := roundShift2D s τ z₂
       (p₁.1 / (M_L : ℤ), p₁.2 / (M_L : ℤ)) = (p₂.1 / (M_L : ℤ), p₂.2 / (M_L : ℤ))) →
      ‖z₁ - z₂‖ ≤ 2 * (M_L : ℝ) * s) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < s → ‖v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)‖ ≤ 2 * s) ∧
    (∀ (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ),
      m₁ ≤ m₂ → 0 < ρ →
      let s₁ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m₁)⁻¹ * ρ
      let s₂ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m₂)⁻¹ * ρ
      let K : ℤ := ((2 ^ (m₂ - m₁) : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        roundShift2D s₁ 0 v =
          ((roundShift2D s₂ 0 v).1 / K, (roundShift2D s₂ 0 v).2 / K)) ∧
      (∀ k₂ : ℤ × ℤ,
        ‖gridPt2D s₂ k₂ - gridPt2D s₁ (k₂.1 / K, k₂.2 / K)‖ ≤ 2 * s₁)) ∧
    (∀ (s R : ℝ) (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      0 < s → 0 ≤ R →
      (∀ k ∈ S, ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ≤ R) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * (R / s) + 3) ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ (s R Δ : ℝ) (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      0 < s → 0 < R → 0 < Δ → Δ ≤ R / 2 →
      (∀ k ∈ S, R - Δ ≤ ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ∧ ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ≤ R) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (2 * (R / s) + 3) * (6 * (Δ / s) + 4)) ∧
    (∀ {ι : Type} (s : ℝ) (e₀ V₀ X₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
       (V X : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (F : Finset ι),
      0 < s → ‖e₀‖ = 1 →
      (∀ a ∈ F,
        |inner ℝ (V a - V₀) e₀| ≤ s ∧
        |inner ℝ (V a - V₀) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ s ∧
        |inner ℝ (X a - X₀) e₀| ≤ s ∧
        |inner ℝ (X a - X₀) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ s) →
      ((F.image (fun a => (roundShift2D s 0 (V a), roundShift2D s 0 (X a)))).card : ℝ) ≤ 625)

subgoal_signatures.name: buffered_cell_paving_fiber_mass_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (γ ε H_P L t h b_star lam_sys A_win ξ C_cov : ℝ)
    (M_L M_mult M_ord M_tr m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
    (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ) (C_sub_bes B_X C_far R_tr : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
    (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (p_buf : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (r_i : ℕ)
    (S_obs : Finset (Fin N_O)) (T_P : Finset (Fin N_ret))
    (h_grid :
      (∀ (s : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        0 < s → ‖v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)‖ ≤ 2 * s) ∧
      (∀ (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ),
        m₁ ≤ m₂ → 0 < ρ →

        (let p₁ := roundShift2D s τ z₁

          (∀ ω : Fin M_ω,
            condSurprise ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) ω =
              condSurprise ε π X Y (f ω)) ∧
          finCondEntropy ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) =
            finCondEntropy ε π X Y ∧
          finMutualInfo ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) =
            finMutualInfo ε π X Y) ∧
        (∀ (P : Fin N_ω → Prop) [DecidablePred P],

      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π W X ∧
      0 ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W X ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π W X + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y ∧

       (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β),

    · have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun ω' : Fin N => if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then p ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp0 ω'])
        (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      simp only [and_self, ↓reduceIte] at hle
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle
    · refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω
      · by_cases hy : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [hx, hy, hp0 ω']
      · simp [hx]
  have h_ent_nn : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N → α_t) (X : Fin N → β_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) →
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε₀ p W X := by
    intro N α_t β_t ε₀ p W X hε0 hε1 hp0
    have hell0 := h_ell_pos_gen ε₀ hε0 hε1
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < p ω
    · obtain ⟨hp2_pos, hp2_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω hp0 hpos
      have hp1_pos : 0 < finProbAt p W ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_pos hp2_le
      have hlog_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 p W X ω / finProbAt p W ω) ≤ 0 :=
        Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg hp2_pos.le hp1_pos.le) ((div_le_one hp1_pos).mpr hp2_le)
      exact mul_nonneg (hp0 ω) (div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hlog_np) hell0.le)
    · have hpz : p ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hp0 ω)
      simp [hpz]
  have hs2_equiv : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α_t) (Y : Fin N → β_t) (Z : Fin N → γ_t),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) →
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < p ω₁ → 0 < p ω₂ → X ω₁ = X ω₂ → (Y ω₁ = Y ω₂ ↔ Z ω₁ = Z ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p X Y = finCondEntropy ε₀ p X Z := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p X Y Z hp0 heqv
    let _ : DecidableEq α_t := Classical.decEq α_t
    let _ : DecidableEq β_t := Classical.decEq β_t
    let _ : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < p ω
    · have hp_eq : finProbAt2 p X Y ω = finProbAt2 p X Z ω := by
        rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hpos' : 0 < p ω'
        · by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω
          · have hyz := heqv ω' ω hpos' hpos hx
            by_cases hy : Y ω' = Y ω
            · have hz : Z ω' = Z ω := hyz.mp hy
              simp [hx, hy, hz]
            · have hz : Z ω' ≠ Z ω := fun hz => hy (hyz.mpr hz)
              simp [hx, hy, hz]
          · simp [hx]
        · have hpz' : p ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos') (hp0 ω')
          simp [hpz']
      rw [hp_eq]
    · have hpz : p ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hp0 ω)
      simp [hpz]
  have h_cond_equiv : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α₁ α₂ β_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X₁ : Fin N → α₁) (X₂ : Fin N → α₂) (Y : Fin N → β_t),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) →
      (∀ ω₁ ω₂, 0 < p ω₁ → 0 < p ω₂ → (X₁ ω₁ = X₁ ω₂ ↔ X₂ ω₁ = X₂ ω₂)) →
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p X₁ Y = finCondEntropy ε₀ p X₂ Y := by
    intro N α₁ α₂ β_t ε₀ p X₁ X₂ Y hp0 heqv
    let _ : DecidableEq α₁ := Classical.decEq α₁
    let _ : DecidableEq α₂ := Classical.decEq α₂
    let _ : DecidableEq β_t := Classical.decEq β_t
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < p ω
    · have hp1_eq : finProbAt p X₁ ω = finProbAt p X₂ ω := by
        rw [h_probAt_eq, h_probAt_eq]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hpos' : 0 < p ω'
        · have hx := heqv ω' ω hpos' hpos
          by_cases hx1 : X₁ ω' = X₁ ω
          · simp [hx1, hx.mp hx1]
          · have hx2 : X₂ ω' ≠ X₂ ω := fun h => hx1 (hx.mpr h)
            simp [hx1, hx2]
        · have hpz' : p ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos') (hp0 ω')
          simp [hpz']
      have hp2_eq : finProbAt2 p X₁ Y ω = finProbAt2 p X₂ Y ω := by
        rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hpos' : 0 < p ω'
        · have hx := heqv ω' ω hpos' hpos
          by_cases hy : Y ω' = Y ω
          · by_cases hx1 : X₁ ω' = X₁ ω
            · simp [hy, hx1, hx.mp hx1]
            · have hx2 : X₂ ω' ≠ X₂ ω := fun h => hx1 (hx.mpr h)
              simp [hy, hx1, hx2]
          · simp [hy]
        · have hpz' : p ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos') (hp0 ω')
          simp [hpz']
      rw [hp1_eq, hp2_eq]
    · have hpz : p ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hp0 ω)
      simp [hpz]
  have h_unit_ent : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N → α_t) (Y : Fin N → β_t),
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => ((), X ω)) Y = finCondEntropy ε₀ p X Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t ε₀ p X Y
    have h1 : ∀ ω, finProbAt p (fun ω' => ((), X ω')) ω = finProbAt p X ω := by
      intro ω; unfold finProbAt
      congr 1; ext ω'; by_cases h : X ω' = X ω <;> simp [h]
    have h2 : ∀ ω, finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => ((), X ω')) Y ω = finProbAt2 p X Y ω := by
      intro ω; unfold finProbAt2
      congr 1; ext ω'; by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h]
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    simp_rw [h1, h2]
  have h_chain_rule : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N → α_t) (X : Fin N → β_t) (Y : Fin N → γ_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) →
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε₀ p W X + finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0
    let _ : DecidableEq α_t := Classical.decEq α_t
    let _ : DecidableEq β_t := Classical.decEq β_t
    let _ : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < p ω
    · have hp_wxy : finProbAt2 p W (fun ω' => (X ω', Y ω')) ω =
          finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω := by
        rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        by_cases hw : W ω' = W ω <;> by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω <;>
          by_cases hy : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, hw, hx, hy]
      have hp_wx : finProbAt p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) ω = finProbAt2 p W X ω :=
        h_probAt_pair p W X ω
      rw [hp_wxy, hp_wx]
      obtain ⟨hB_pos, hB_le_A⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω hp0 hpos
      have hA_pos : 0 < finProbAt p W ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hB_pos hB_le_A
      obtain ⟨hC_pos, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω hp0 hpos
      have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p W X ω / finProbAt p W ω := div_pos hB_pos hA_pos
      have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt2 p W X ω :=
        div_pos hC_pos hB_pos
      have h_prod : finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt p W ω =
          (finProbAt2 p W X ω / finProbAt p W ω) *
            (finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt2 p W X ω) := by
        field_simp [hA_pos.ne', hB_pos.ne']
      rw [h_prod, Real.log_mul h1_pos.ne' h2_pos.ne']
      ring
    · have hpz : p ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hp0 ω)
      simp [hpz]
  have h_ent_comm : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N → α_t) (X : Fin N → β_t) (Y : Fin N → γ_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, p ω = 1) →
      finCondEntropy ε₀ p W Y + finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => (W ω, Y ω)) X =
        finCondEntropy ε₀ p W X + finCondEntropy ε₀ p (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0 _
    have hc1 := h_chain_rule ε₀ p W Y X hε0 hε1 hp0
    have hc2 := h_chain_rule ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0
    rw [← hc1, ← hc2]
    exact hs2_equiv ε₀ p W (fun ω => (Y ω, X ω)) (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) hp0
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => by simp [Prod.ext_iff, and_comm])
  have h_gibbs : ∀ {N : ℕ} (Q r : Fin N → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → 0 < r ω) →
      (∑ ω ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ, Q ω * r ω) ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ, Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) := by
    intro N Q r hQ0 hQ1 hr_pos hr_sum
    let S_Q := @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    have hS_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_Q, Q ω = 1 := by
      rw [← hQ1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_Q)]
      intro ω _ hnot
      have hnot_pos : ¬ 0 < Q ω := fun hp =>
        hnot ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hp⟩)
      exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnot_pos) (hQ0 ω)
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S_Q, Q ω - Q ω * r ω ≤ Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hpos : 0 < Q ω :=
        ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mp hω).2
      have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (hr_pos ω hpos)
      have h1 : 1 - r ω ≤ -Real.log (r ω) := by linarith only [hlog]
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (hQ0 ω)
      have h3 : Q ω * (1 - r ω) = Q ω - Q ω * r ω := by ring
      linarith only [h2, h3]
    have h_sum_le := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hS_sum] at h_sum_le
    linarith only [h_sum_le, hr_sum]
  have h_cmi_nn : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_t β_t γ_t : Type} (ε₀ : ℝ) (p : Fin N → ℝ)
      (W : Fin N → α_t) (X : Fin N → β_t) (Y : Fin N → γ_t),
      0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N, p ω = 1) →
      0 ≤ finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p W X Y := by
    intro N α_t β_t γ_t ε₀ p W X Y hε0 hε1 hp0 hp1
    let _ : DecidableEq α_t := Classical.decEq α_t
    let _ : DecidableEq β_t := Classical.decEq β_t
    let _ : DecidableEq γ_t := Classical.decEq γ_t
    have hell0 := h_ell_pos_gen ε₀ hε0 hε1
    let S_p := @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun ω => 0 < p ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    have h_mem_Sp : ∀ ω, ω ∈ S_p ↔ 0 < p ω := fun ω => by
      simp only [S_p, @Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _),
        Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    have hp_zero_out : ∀ ω, ω ∉ S_p → p ω = 0 := fun ω hnot =>
      le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hpos => hnot ((h_mem_Sp ω).mpr hpos))) (hp0 ω)
    have hSp_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω = 1 := by
      rw [← hp1, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
      intro ω _ hnot; exact hp_zero_out ω hnot
    let r : Fin N → ℝ := fun ω =>
      (finProbAt2 p W Y ω * finProbAt2 p W X ω) /
        (finProbAt p W ω * finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω)
    have hr_pos : ∀ ω, 0 < p ω → 0 < r ω := by
      intro ω hpos
      obtain ⟨hWY, hWY_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p W Y ω hp0 hpos
      have hW : 0 < finProbAt p W ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hWY hWY_le
      obtain ⟨hWX, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω hp0 hpos
      obtain ⟨hWXY, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω hp0 hpos
      exact div_pos (mul_pos hWY hWX) (mul_pos hW hWXY)
    have h_cmi_eq : finCondMutualInfo ε₀ p W X Y =
        (∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * (-Real.log (r ω))) / Real.log (ε₀⁻¹) := by
      unfold finCondMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p), Finset.sum_div]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hpos : 0 < p ω := (h_mem_Sp ω).mp hω
        obtain ⟨hWY, hWY_le⟩ := h_prob_bds p W Y ω hp0 hpos
        have hW : 0 < finProbAt p W ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hWY hWY_le
        obtain ⟨hWX, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω hp0 hpos
        obtain ⟨hWXY, _⟩ := h_prob_bds p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω hp0 hpos
        have hp_wx : finProbAt p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) ω = finProbAt2 p W X ω :=
          h_probAt_pair p W X ω
        rw [hp_wx]
        have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p W Y ω / finProbAt p W ω := div_pos hWY hW
        have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt2 p W X ω :=
          div_pos hWXY hWX
        have hr_div : r ω = (finProbAt2 p W Y ω / finProbAt p W ω) /
            (finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω / finProbAt2 p W X ω) := by
          dsimp [r]
          field_simp [hW.ne', hWX.ne', hWXY.ne']
        rw [hr_div, Real.log_div h1_pos.ne' h2_pos.ne']
        ring
      · intro ω _ hnot
        simp [hp_zero_out ω hnot]
    let I_W := S_p.image W
    let I_X := S_p.image X
    let I_Y := S_p.image Y
    let P_W : α_t → ℝ := fun w => ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if W ω' = w then p ω' else 0
    let P_WX : α_t → β_t → ℝ := fun w x => ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if W ω' = w ∧ X ω' = x then p ω' else 0
    let P_WY : α_t → γ_t → ℝ := fun w y => ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if W ω' = w ∧ Y ω' = y then p ω' else 0
    let P_WXY : α_t → β_t → γ_t → ℝ := fun w x y =>
      ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, if (W ω' = w ∧ X ω' = x) ∧ Y ω' = y then p ω' else 0
    have hr_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, p ω * r ω ≤ 1 := by
      have h_fib := (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (s := S_p) (t := I_W ×ˢ (I_X ×ˢ I_Y)) (g := fun ω => (W ω, (X ω, Y ω)))
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem W hω,
          Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω, Finset.mem_image_of_mem Y hω⟩⟩)
        (fun ω => p ω * r ω)).symm
      rw [h_fib]
      have h_cell : ∀ t ∈ I_W ×ˢ (I_X ×ˢ I_Y),
          (∑ ω ∈ S_p.filter (fun ω => (W ω, (X ω, Y ω)) = t), p ω * r ω) ≤
            (P_WY t.1 t.2.2 * P_WX t.1 t.2.1) / P_W t.1 := by
        intro ⟨w, x, y⟩ _
        let F_t := S_p.filter (fun ω => (W ω, (X ω, Y ω)) = (w, (x, y)))
        change (∑ ω ∈ F_t, p ω * r ω) ≤ (P_WY w y * P_WX w x) / P_W w
        by_cases hne : F_t.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
          obtain ⟨hω₀_sp, _⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
          have hPW_eq : ∀ ω ∈ F_t, finProbAt p W ω = P_W w := by
            intro ω hω
            have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2).1
            rw [h_probAt_eq, hw, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
          have hPWX_eq : ∀ ω ∈ F_t, finProbAt2 p W X ω = P_WX w x := by
            intro ω hω
            have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
            have hx : X ω = x := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).1
            rw [h_probAt2_eq, hw, hx, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
          have hPWY_eq : ∀ ω ∈ F_t, finProbAt2 p W Y ω = P_WY w y := by
            intro ω hω
            have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
            have hy : Y ω = y := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).2
            rw [h_probAt2_eq, hw, hy, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
          have hPWXY_eq : ∀ ω ∈ F_t,
              finProbAt2 p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω = P_WXY w x y := by
            intro ω hω
            have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            have hw : W ω = w := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
            have hx : X ω = x := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).1
            have hy : Y ω = y := (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2).2
            rw [h_probAt2_eq, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
              simp only [Prod.ext_iff, hw, hx, hy]
            · intro ω' _ hnot; simp [hp_zero_out ω' hnot]
          have hFt_sum : ∑ ω ∈ F_t, p ω = P_WXY w x y := by
            dsimp [F_t, P_WXY]
            rw [Finset.sum_filter]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
            simp only [Prod.ext_iff, and_assoc]
          have hPWXY_pos : 0 < P_WXY w x y := by
            rw [← hPWXY_eq ω₀ hω₀]
            exact (h_prob_bds p (fun ω' => (W ω', X ω')) Y ω₀ hp0 ((h_mem_Sp ω₀).mp hω₀_sp)).1
          have hPW_pos : 0 < P_W w := by
            rw [← hPW_eq ω₀ hω₀]
            obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h_prob_bds p W X ω₀ hp0 ((h_mem_Sp ω₀).mp hω₀_sp)
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
          have h_congr : ∑ ω ∈ F_t, p ω * r ω =
              ∑ ω ∈ F_t, p ω * ((P_WY w y * P_WX w x) / (P_W w * P_WXY w x y)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
            dsimp [r]
            rw [hPW_eq ω hω, hPWX_eq ω hω, hPWY_eq ω hω, hPWXY_eq ω hω]
          rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul, hFt_sum]
          have h_eq : P_WXY w x y * ((P_WY w y * P_WX w x) / (P_W w * P_WXY w x y)) =
              (P_WY w y * P_WX w x) / P_W w := by
            field_simp [hPW_pos.ne', hPWXY_pos.ne']
          exact h_eq.le
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
          have h1 : 0 ≤ P_WY w y := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp0 ω])
          have h2 : 0 ≤ P_WX w x := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hp0 ω])

      (∀ ω, 0 < π ω → c_seq ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∃ (M_ω : ℕ) (f : Fin M_ω → Fin N_ω),
        (∀ ω : Fin M_ω, 0 < π (f ω) ∧ c_seq (f ω) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π (f ω) = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin N_T,
          (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_seq (f ω) = tid then π (f ω) else 0) =
            (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_seq ω = tid then π ω else 0)) ∧
        (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
          (∀ ω : Fin M_ω,
            condSurprise ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) ω =
              condSurprise ε π X Y (f ω)) ∧
          finCondEntropy ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) =
            finCondEntropy ε π X Y ∧
          finMutualInfo ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) =
            finMutualInfo ε π X Y) ∧
        (∀ (P : Fin N_ω → Prop) [DecidablePred P],
          (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if P (f ω) then π (f ω) else 0) =
            (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω then π ω else 0)) := by
    intro N_ω N_T ε π T_seq c_seq hπ0 hπ1 hc_mem
    let S_pos := @Finset.filter (Fin N_ω) (fun ω => 0 < π ω)
      (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
    let M_ω := S_pos.card
    let e : Fin M_ω ≃ ↥S_pos := S_pos.equivFin.symm
    let f : Fin M_ω → Fin N_ω := fun i => (e i).1
    have h_pos_f : ∀ i : Fin M_ω, 0 < π (f i) := fun i =>
      ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mp (e i).2).2
    have h_sum_comp : ∀ (g : Fin N_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, π ω = 0 → g ω = 0) →
        (∑ i : Fin M_ω, g (f i)) = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, g ω := by
      intro g hg0
      have h1 : (∑ i : Fin M_ω, g (f i)) = ∑ x : ↥S_pos, g x.1 :=
        Fintype.sum_equiv e (fun i => g (f i)) (fun x => g x.1) (fun _ => rfl)
      have h2 : (∑ x : ↥S_pos, g x.1) = ∑ ω ∈ S_pos, g ω :=
        Finset.sum_finset_coe g S_pos
      have h3 : (∑ ω ∈ S_pos, g ω) = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, g ω := by
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_pos) (fun ω _ hnot => ?_)
        have hnot_pos : ¬ 0 < π ω := fun hp =>
          hnot ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) _ _).mpr
            ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hp⟩)
        exact hg0 ω (le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnot_pos) (hπ0 ω))
      rw [h1, h2, h3]
    have h_pred : ∀ (P : Fin N_ω → Prop) [DecidablePred P],
        (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if P (f ω) then π (f ω) else 0) =
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if P ω then π ω else 0) := by
      intro P _
      exact h_sum_comp (fun ω => if P ω then π ω else 0) (fun ω h0 => by simp [h0])
    have h_surp_ent : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
        (∀ ω : Fin M_ω,
          condSurprise ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) ω =
            condSurprise ε π X Y (f ω)) ∧
        finCondEntropy ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) =
          finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
      intro α β X Y
      let _ : DecidableEq α := Classical.decEq α
      let _ : DecidableEq β := Classical.decEq β
      have h_surp : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω,
          condSurprise ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) ω =
            condSurprise ε π X Y (f ω) := by
        intro ω
        have hp1 : finProbAt (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) ω =
            finProbAt π X (f ω) := by
          rw [h_probAt_eq, h_probAt_eq]
          exact h_sum_comp (fun z => if X z = X (f ω) then π z else 0)
            (fun z hz => by simp [hz])
        have hp2 : finProbAt2 (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) ω =
            finProbAt2 π X Y (f ω) := by
          rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq]
          exact h_sum_comp (fun z => if X z = X (f ω) ∧ Y z = Y (f ω) then π z else 0)
            (fun z hz => by simp [hz])
        unfold condSurprise
        rw [hp1, hp2]
      refine ⟨h_surp, ?_⟩
      unfold finCondEntropy
      have h_congr : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
            π (f ω) * condSurprise ε (fun ω' => π (f ω')) (fun ω' => X (f ω')) (fun ω' => Y (f ω')) ω =
          ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π (f ω) * condSurprise ε π X Y (f ω) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by rw [h_surp ω])
      rw [h_congr]
      exact h_sum_comp (fun z => π z * condSurprise ε π X Y z) (fun z hz => by simp [hz])
    refine ⟨M_ω, f, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, h_pred⟩
    · exact fun ω => ⟨h_pos_f ω, hc_mem (f ω) (h_pos_f ω)⟩
    · rw [h_sum_comp π (fun _ h => h), hπ1]
    · intro tid
      exact h_pred (fun ω => T_seq ω = tid)
    · intro α β X Y
      obtain ⟨hs, he⟩ := h_surp_ent X Y
      refine ⟨hs, he, ?_⟩
      unfold finMutualInfo
      have he_unit := (h_surp_ent (fun _ : Fin N_ω => ()) Y).2
      exact congrArg₂ Sub.sub he_unit he
  have h_conj2 : ∀ {M_ω : ℕ} {α β γ_t : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
      (W : Fin M_ω → α) (X : Fin M_ω → β) (Y : Fin M_ω → γ_t),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π ω = 1) →
      0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π W X ∧
      0 ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W X ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π W X + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y ∧
      finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) X + finCondEntropy ε π X Y ∧
      finMutualInfo ε π W X ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) := by
    intro M_ω α β γ_t ε π W X Y hε0 hε1 hπ0 hπ1
    have h1 : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π W X := h_ent_nn ε π W X hε0 hε1 hπ0
    have h2 : 0 ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W X := by
      unfold finMutualInfo
      rw [← h_unit_ent ε π W X]
      exact h_cmi_nn ε π (fun _ => ()) W X hε0 hε1 hπ0 hπ1
    have h3 : finCondEntropy ε π W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π W X + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y :=
      h_chain_rule ε π W X Y hε0 hε1 hπ0
    have h4 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) =
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) X + finCondEntropy ε π X Y := by
      rw [h_chain_rule ε π (fun _ => ()) X Y hε0 hε1 hπ0, h_unit_ent]
    have h5 : finMutualInfo ε π W X ≤ finMutualInfo ε π W (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) := by
      unfold finMutualInfo
      rw [h4, h3]
      have h_swap : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) Y =
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (X ω, W ω)) Y :=
        h_cond_equiv ε π (fun ω => (W ω, X ω)) (fun ω => (X ω, W ω)) Y hπ0
          (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [Prod.ext_iff, and_comm])
      have hcmi : 0 ≤ finCondMutualInfo ε π X W Y := h_cmi_nn ε π X W Y hε0 hε1 hπ0 hπ1
      unfold finCondMutualInfo at hcmi
      linarith only [h_swap, hcmi]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
  have h_conj6 : ∀ {M_ω N_Z : ℕ} {α_T α_O α_K : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
      (T : Fin M_ω → α_T) (O : Fin M_ω → α_O) (K_t : Fin M_ω → α_K)
      (Z : Fin M_ω → Fin N_Z),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ N_Z →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π ω = 1) →
      let p_Z : Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z ω = z then π ω else 0
      let π_z : Fin N_Z → Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun z ω =>
        if Z ω = z then π ω / p_Z z else 0
      finMutualInfo ε π T Z +
        (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
          if 0 < p_Z z then
            p_Z z * (finMutualInfo ε (π_z z) T O - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_z z) T K_t)
          else 0) ≤
        (finMutualInfo ε π T O - 2 * finCondEntropy ε π T K_t) +
          3 * Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro M_ω N_Z α_T α_O α_K ε π T O K_t Z hε0 hε1 hNZ hπ0 hπ1 p_Z π_z
    have h_disint : ∀ {α_A α_B : Type} (A : Fin M_ω → α_A) (B : Fin M_ω → α_B),
        (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (π_z z) A B else 0) =
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (Z ω, A ω)) B := by
      intro α_A α_B A B
      let _ : DecidableEq α_A := Classical.decEq α_A
      let _ : DecidableEq α_B := Classical.decEq α_B
      unfold finCondEntropy
      have h_push : ∀ z : Fin N_Z,
          (if 0 < p_Z z then
            p_Z z * ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π_z z ω * condSurprise ε (π_z z) A B ω
          else 0) =
          ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
            if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * (π_z z ω * condSurprise ε (π_z z) A B ω) else 0 := by
        intro z
        by_cases hpz : 0 < p_Z z
        · simp only [hpz, ↓reduceIte, Finset.mul_sum]
        · simp only [hpz, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      simp_rw [h_push]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hpos : 0 < π ω
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Z ω)]
        · have hpZ_le : π ω ≤ p_Z (Z ω) := by
            dsimp [p_Z]
            have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun ω' : Fin M_ω => if Z ω' = Z ω then π ω' else 0)
              (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith only [hπ0 ω'])
              (Finset.mem_univ ω)
            simpa using hle
          have hpZ_pos : 0 < p_Z (Z ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hpZ_le
          simp only [hpZ_pos, ↓reduceIte]
          have hπz_at : π_z (Z ω) ω = π ω / p_Z (Z ω) := by
            dsimp [π_z]; simp
          rw [hπz_at, ← mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpZ_pos.ne']
          congr 1
          unfold condSurprise
          have hp1 : finProbAt (π_z (Z ω)) A ω =
              finProbAt π (fun ω' => (Z ω', A ω')) ω / p_Z (Z ω) := by
            rw [h_probAt_eq, h_probAt_eq, Finset.sum_div]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
            dsimp [π_z]
            by_cases hz' : Z ω' = Z ω <;> by_cases ha' : A ω' = A ω <;>
              simp [Prod.ext_iff, hz', ha']
          have hp2 : finProbAt2 (π_z (Z ω)) A B ω =
              finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (Z ω', A ω')) B ω / p_Z (Z ω) := by
            rw [h_probAt2_eq, h_probAt2_eq, Finset.sum_div]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
            dsimp [π_z]
            by_cases hz' : Z ω' = Z ω <;> by_cases ha' : A ω' = A ω <;>
              by_cases hb' : B ω' = B ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, hz', ha', hb']
          rw [hp1, hp2, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hpZ_pos.ne']
        · intro z _ hz
          have hne : Z ω ≠ z := hz.symm
          have hπz_zero : π_z z ω = 0 := by dsimp [π_z]; simp [hne]
          simp [hπz_zero]
        · intro hnot
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) hnot
      · have hπ_zero : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hπ0 ω)
        have h_all_zero : ∀ z : Fin N_Z,
            (if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * (π_z z ω * condSurprise ε (π_z z) A B ω) else 0) = 0 := by
          intro z
          have hπz_zero : π_z z ω = 0 := by dsimp [π_z]; simp [hπ_zero]
          simp [hπz_zero]
        simp [h_all_zero, hπ_zero]
    have h_sum_split :
        (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
          if 0 < p_Z z then
            p_Z z * (finMutualInfo ε (π_z z) T O - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_z z) T K_t)
          else 0) =
        finCondEntropy ε π Z O -
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, Z ω)) O -
          2 * finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, Z ω)) K_t := by
      have h_term : ∀ z : Fin N_Z,
          (if 0 < p_Z z then
            p_Z z * (finMutualInfo ε (π_z z) T O - 2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_z z) T K_t)
          else 0) =
          (if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (π_z z) (fun _ => ()) O else 0) -
          (if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (π_z z) T O else 0) -
          2 * (if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (π_z z) T K_t else 0) := by
        intro z
        unfold finMutualInfo
        split_ifs <;> ring
      simp_rw [h_term]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
        h_disint (fun _ => ()) O, h_disint T O, h_disint T K_t]
      have hc1 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (Z ω, ())) O = finCondEntropy ε π Z O :=
        h_cond_equiv ε π (fun ω => (Z ω, ())) Z O hπ0 (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp)
      have hc2 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (Z ω, T ω)) O =
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, Z ω)) O :=
        h_cond_equiv ε π (fun ω => (Z ω, T ω)) (fun ω => (T ω, Z ω)) O hπ0
          (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [Prod.ext_iff, and_comm])
      have hc3 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (Z ω, T ω)) K_t =
          finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, Z ω)) K_t :=
        h_cond_equiv ε π (fun ω => (Z ω, T ω)) (fun ω => (T ω, Z ω)) K_t hπ0
          (fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [Prod.ext_iff, and_comm])
      rw [hc1, hc2, hc3]
    rw [h_sum_split]
    have h_sym1 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) O + finCondEntropy ε π O Z =
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) Z + finCondEntropy ε π Z O := by
      have hc := h_ent_comm ε π (fun _ => ()) Z O hε0 hε1 hπ0 hπ1
      rwa [h_unit_ent, h_unit_ent] at hc
    have h_sym2 := h_ent_comm ε π T Z O hε0 hε1 hπ0 hπ1
    have h_sym3 := h_ent_comm ε π T Z K_t hε0 hε1 hπ0 hπ1
    have h_nn1 : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, O ω)) Z :=
      h_ent_nn ε π (fun ω => (T ω, O ω)) Z hε0 hε1 hπ0
    have h_nn2 : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω => (T ω, K_t ω)) Z :=
      h_ent_nn ε π (fun ω => (T ω, K_t ω)) Z hε0 hε1 hπ0
    have h_mi_OZ : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) Z - finCondEntropy ε π O Z :=
      (h_conj2 ε π O Z Z hε0 hε1 hπ0 hπ1).2.1
    have h_mi_TZ : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) Z - finCondEntropy ε π T Z :=
      (h_conj2 ε π T Z Z hε0 hε1 hπ0 hπ1).2.1
    have hNZ_real : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N_Z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hNZ
    have h_cap_Z : finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) Z ≤
        Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      refine hs2_card ε (N_Z : ℝ) π (fun _ => ()) Z hε0 hε1 hNZ_real hπ0 hπ1 (fun _ _ => ?_)
      refine ⟨Finset.univ, ?_, fun ω _ _ => Finset.mem_univ (Z ω)⟩
      simp [Finset.card_univ]
    have h_three : 3 * (Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) =
        3 * Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by ring
    unfold finMutualInfo
    linarith only [h_sym1, h_sym2, h_sym3, h_nn1, h_nn2, h_mi_OZ, h_mi_TZ, h_cap_Z, h_three]
  exact ⟨h_conj1, h_conj2, hs2_equiv, hs2_card, hs2_kl, h_conj6⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(γ B_iso ε ξ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hB_iso : 1 ≤ B_iso)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) (hξ₀ : 0 < ξ) (hξ₁ : ξ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (M_ω M_T : ℕ) (π_amb : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin M_ω → Fin M_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin M_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_amb ω) (hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π_amb ω = 1)
    (hVA : ∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_iso ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_iso) :
    (∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ {N_Z : ℕ} (P : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (Z : Fin M_ω → Fin N_Z),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ P ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, P ω = 1) →
      let p_Z : Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z ω = z then P ω else 0
      let P_z : Fin N_Z → Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun z ω => if Z ω = z then P ω / p_Z z else 0
      (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
        if 0 < p_Z z then
          p_Z z * classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T (P_z z) T_idx V_part A_part
        else 0) ≤
        classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T P T_idx V_part A_part +
          finMutualInfo ε P T_idx Z) ∧
    (let J_cap : ℕ := ⌊2 / ξ⌋₊ + 2
     ∃ Z_cap : Fin M_T → Fin (J_cap + 1),
       (∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
         if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = Fin.last J_cap then π_amb ω else 0) ≤
         (((2 * ⌈B_iso⌉₊ + 3) ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ ξ ∧
       ∀ j : Fin J_cap,
         let h_cap : ℝ := -ξ + (j.val : ℝ) * ξ
         let p₁ : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc then π_amb ω else 0
         (-ξ ≤ h_cap ∧ h_cap ≤ 2) ∧
         (0 < p₁ →
           let μ₁ : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
             if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc then π_amb ω / p₁ else 0
           h_cap ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T μ₁ T_idx V_part A_part) ∧
         (∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (M_tilt : ℝ),
           (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) → 1 ≤ M_tilt →
           (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc) →
           (∀ ω, Q ω ≤ M_tilt * π_amb ω) →
           classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part ≤
             h_cap + 3 * ξ + Real.log (81 * M_tilt) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)))

       (∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
