         (((2 * ⌈B_iso⌉₊ + 3) ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ ξ ∧
       ∀ j : Fin J_cap,
         let h_cap : ℝ := -ξ + (j.val : ℝ) * ξ
         let p₁ : ℝ := ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc then π_amb ω else 0
         (-ξ ≤ h_cap ∧ h_cap ≤ 2) ∧
         (0 < p₁ →
           let μ₁ : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
             if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc then π_amb ω / p₁ else 0
           h_cap ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T μ₁ T_idx V_part A_part) ∧
         (∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (M_tilt : ℝ),
           (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) → 1 ≤ M_tilt →
           (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc) →
           (∀ ω, Q ω ≤ M_tilt * π_amb ω) →
           classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part ≤
             h_cap + 3 * ξ + Real.log (81 * M_tilt) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)))

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hξ₁
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hε_inv_gt1 : 1 < ε⁻¹ := by
    rw [one_lt_inv₀ hε₀]
    linarith
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos hε_inv_gt1
  have hell_ne : ell ≠ 0 := hell_pos.ne'
  have h_log_eps_rpow : ∀ E : ℝ, Real.log (ε ^ E) = -E * ell := by
    intro E
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀, Real.log_exp]
    have hinv : ell = -Real.log ε := Real.log_inv ε
    rw [hinv]
    ring

  have h_sq_eq : ∀ {a b : ℝ}, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 → a = b := by
    intro a b ha hb h
    have h1 : (a - b) * (a + b) = 0 := by linear_combination h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h2 | h2 <;> linarith
  have h_sq_le : ∀ {a b : ℝ}, 0 ≤ b → a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 → a ≤ b := by
    intro a b hb h
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    nlinarith
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_inner_eq : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ x y = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
    intro x y
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have h_coord_le : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 2), |x i| ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x i
    refine h_sq_le (norm_nonneg x) ?_
    rw [sq_abs, h_norm_sq]
    fin_cases i <;> { dsimp; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)] }
  have h_perp_norm : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖perp2D u‖ = ‖u‖ := by
    intro u
    refine h_sq_eq (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) ?_
    rw [h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq]
    change (-(u 1)) ^ 2 + (u 0) ^ 2 = (u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2
    ring
  have h_perp_sub : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖perp2D u - perp2D v‖ = ‖u - v‖ := by
    intro u v
    refine h_sq_eq (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) ?_
    rw [h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq]
    change (-(u 1) - -(v 1)) ^ 2 + (u 0 - v 0) ^ 2 = (u 0 - v 0) ^ 2 + (u 1 - v 1) ^ 2
    ring
  have h_parseval : ∀ (x e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℝ x e) ^ 2 + (inner ℝ x (perp2D e)) ^ 2 := by
    intro x e he
    have he2 : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_norm_sq e
      rw [he] at h1
      linarith
    rw [h_norm_sq, h_inner_eq, h_inner_eq]
    change (x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2 =
      (x 0 * e 0 + x 1 * e 1) ^ 2 + (x 0 * -(e 1) + x 1 * e 0) ^ 2
    linear_combination -((x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2) * he2
  have h_frame_sub : ∀ (X u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (α β : ℝ), ‖u‖ = 1 →
      inner ℝ (X - (α • u + β • perp2D u)) u = inner ℝ X u - α ∧
      inner ℝ (X - (α • u + β • perp2D u)) (perp2D u) = inner ℝ X (perp2D u) - β := by
    intro X u α β hu
    have hu2 : (u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_norm_sq u
      rw [hu] at h1
      linarith
    constructor
    · rw [h_inner_eq, h_inner_eq]
      change (X 0 - (α * u 0 + β * -(u 1))) * u 0 + (X 1 - (α * u 1 + β * u 0)) * u 1 =
        X 0 * u 0 + X 1 * u 1 - α
      linear_combination -α * hu2
    · rw [h_inner_eq, h_inner_eq]
      change (X 0 - (α * u 0 + β * -(u 1))) * -(u 1) + (X 1 - (α * u 1 + β * u 0)) * u 0 =
        X 0 * -(u 1) + X 1 * u 0 - β
      linear_combination -β * hu2

  let e₀_unit : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  have he₀_norm : ‖e₀_unit‖ = 1 := by
    refine h_sq_eq (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one ?_
    rw [h_norm_sq]
    change ((1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (0 : ℝ) ^ 2) = 1 ^ 2
    norm_num

  let p_T_of : (Fin M_ω → ℝ) → Fin M_T → ℝ :=
    fun Q tid => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then Q ω else 0

  let RootSet : (Fin M_ω → ℝ) → Set ℝ := fun Q =>
    { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (q : Fin M_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ 1 ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T_of Q tid) ∧
        (∀ tid : Fin M_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
        (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d
         let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell
         let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
         s = E_w - I_TD) }

  have h_root_eq : ∀ Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ,
      classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part = sSup (RootSet Q) :=
    fun _ => rfl

  have h_root_ne : ∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (RootSet Q).Nonempty := by
    intro Q hQ_nn
    have hpT_nn : ∀ tid, 0 ≤ p_T_of Q tid :=
      fun tid => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hQ_nn ω])
    let q₀ : Fin M_T → Fin M_T → ℝ := fun tid d => if tid = d then p_T_of Q tid else 0
    refine ⟨_, M_T, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => e₀_unit, V_part, A_part, q₀,
      fun _ => ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, zero_le_one, he₀_norm⟩,
      fun tid d => by dsimp [q₀]; split_ifs <;> linarith [hpT_nn tid],
      fun tid => by simp [q₀],
      fun tid d hq_pos => ?_, rfl⟩
    by_cases htd : tid = d
    · subst htd
      simp [Real.rpow_zero]
    · exfalso
      simp [q₀, htd] at hq_pos

  have h_root_ub : ∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      ∀ s ∈ RootSet Q, s ≤ 2 := by
    intro Q hQ_nn hQ_sum s hs
    have hpT_nn : ∀ tid, 0 ≤ p_T_of Q tid :=
      fun tid => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hQ_nn ω])
    have hpT_sum : ∑ tid : Fin M_T, p_T_of Q tid = 1 := by
      dsimp [p_T_of]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp [hQ_sum]
    rcases hs with ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h_adm, hq_nn, hq_sum, _, hs_eq⟩
    let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d
    have hqD_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun tid _ => hq_nn tid d)
    have hqD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d = 1 := by
      dsimp [q_D]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [hq_sum]
      exact hpT_sum
    have hEw_le : (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) ≤ 2 := by
      calc ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
          ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * 2 := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hqD_nn d))
            obtain ⟨hb0, hba, ha1, _⟩ := h_adm d
            nlinarith
        _ = (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d) * 2 := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = 2 := by rw [hqD_sum]; ring
    have h_kl_pt : ∀ (tid : Fin M_T) (d : Fin N_D),
        q tid d - p_T_of Q tid * q_D d ≤ q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) := by
      intro tid d
      by_cases hq_pos : 0 < q tid d
      · have hp_pos : 0 < p_T_of Q tid := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos ?_
          rw [← hq_sum tid]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hq_nn tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d)
        have hqD_pos : 0 < q_D d :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => hq_nn tid' d) (Finset.mem_univ tid))
        let r : ℝ := (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d) / q tid d
        have hr_pos : 0 < r := div_pos (mul_pos hp_pos hqD_pos) hq_pos
        have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hr_pos
        have hinv : q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d) = r⁻¹ := by
          dsimp [r]
          rw [inv_div]
        rw [hinv, Real.log_inv]
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith : 1 - r ≤ -Real.log r) hq_pos.le
        have h_alg : q tid d * (1 - r) = q tid d - p_T_of Q tid * q_D d := by
          dsimp [r]
          field_simp [hq_pos.ne']
        linarith
      · have hq0 : q tid d = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hq_pos) (hq_nn tid d)
        rw [hq0]
        simp
        exact mul_nonneg (hpT_nn tid) (hqD_nn d)
    have h_kl_sum_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) := by
      have h_lb : (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, (q tid d - p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) ≤
          ∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun tid _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_kl_pt tid d))
      have h_zero : (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, (q tid d - p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) = 0 := by
        have h_inner : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
            (∑ d : Fin N_D, (q tid d - p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) = 0 := by
          intro tid
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hq_sum tid, ← Finset.mul_sum, hqD_sum, mul_one, sub_self]
        simp [h_inner]
      linarith
    have hITD_nn : 0 ≤ (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell :=
      div_nonneg h_kl_sum_nn hell_pos.le
    rw [hs_eq]
    linarith

  have h_conj1 : ∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part ≤ 2 := by
    intro Q hQ_nn hQ_sum
    rw [h_root_eq]
    exact csSup_le (h_root_ne Q hQ_nn) (h_root_ub Q hQ_nn hQ_sum)

  have h_root_bdd : ∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      BddAbove (RootSet Q) :=
    fun Q hQ_nn hQ_sum => ⟨2, h_root_ub Q hQ_nn hQ_sum⟩

  refine ⟨h_conj1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro N_Z P Z hP_nn hP_sum p_Z P_z
    let p_T : Fin M_T → ℝ := p_T_of P
    let p_TZ : Fin M_T → Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun tid z =>
      ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z then P ω else 0
    have hpZ_nn : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p_Z z :=
      fun z => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hP_nn ω])
    have hpZ_sum : ∑ z : Fin N_Z, p_Z z = 1 := by
      dsimp [p_Z]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp [hP_sum]
    have hpTZ_nn : ∀ tid z, 0 ≤ p_TZ tid z :=
      fun tid z => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hP_nn ω])
    have hpTZ_sum_z : ∀ tid, ∑ z : Fin N_Z, p_TZ tid z = p_T tid := by
      intro tid
      dsimp [p_TZ, p_T, p_T_of]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> simp [ht]
    have hpTZ_le_pZ : ∀ tid z, p_TZ tid z ≤ p_Z z := by
      intro tid z
      dsimp [p_TZ, p_Z]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hz : Z ω = z
      · by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> simp [ht, hz, hP_nn ω]
      · simp [hz]
    have hpz_law : ∀ z, 0 < p_Z z →
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ P_z z ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, P_z z ω = 1) ∧
        (∀ tid, p_T_of (P_z z) tid = p_TZ tid z / p_Z z) := by
      intro z hpz_pos
      refine ⟨fun ω => ?_, ?_, fun tid => ?_⟩
      · dsimp [P_z]
        split_ifs
        · exact div_nonneg (hP_nn ω) hpz_pos.le
        · exact le_rfl
      · dsimp [P_z]
        have h_pull : (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z ω = z then P ω / p_Z z else 0) =
            (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z ω = z then P ω else 0) / p_Z z := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> simp
        rw [h_pull]
        exact div_self hpz_pos.ne'
      · dsimp [p_T_of, P_z, p_TZ]
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases hz : Z ω = z <;> simp [ht, hz]

    have h_mi_eq : finMutualInfo ε P T_idx Z =
        (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ z : Fin N_Z,
          p_TZ tid z * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z))) / ell := by
      have h_lhs : finMutualInfo ε P T_idx Z =
          (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, P ω * Real.log (p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_Z (Z ω)))) / ell := by
        unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases hP_pos : 0 < P ω
        · have h_fp0 : finProbAt P (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
            unfold finProbAt
            simp [hP_sum]
          have h_fp2_0 : finProbAt2 P (fun _ => ()) Z ω = p_Z (Z ω) := by
            unfold finProbAt2
            dsimp [p_Z]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
            by_cases hz : Z ω' = Z ω <;> simp [hz]
          have h_fpT : finProbAt P T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
            unfold finProbAt
            dsimp [p_T, p_T_of]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
            by_cases ht : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> simp [ht]
          have h_fpTZ : finProbAt2 P T_idx Z ω = p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) := by
            unfold finProbAt2
            dsimp [p_TZ]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
            by_cases ht : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;> by_cases hz : Z ω' = Z ω <;> simp [ht, hz]
          have hpTZ_pos : 0 < p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) := by
            refine lt_of_lt_of_le hP_pos ?_
            dsimp [p_TZ]
            have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun ω' : Fin M_ω => if T_idx ω' = T_idx ω ∧ Z ω' = Z ω then P ω' else 0)
              (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hP_nn ω']) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
            simpa using hle
          have hpZ_pos : 0 < p_Z (Z ω) := lt_of_lt_of_le hpTZ_pos (hpTZ_le_pZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω))
          have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T (T_idx ω) := by
            refine lt_of_lt_of_le hpTZ_pos ?_
            rw [← hpTZ_sum_z (T_idx ω)]
            exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun z' _ => hpTZ_nn (T_idx ω) z') (Finset.mem_univ (Z ω))
          rw [h_fp0, h_fp2_0, h_fpT, h_fpTZ, div_one]
          have h_div_eq : (p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) / p_Z (Z ω) =
              p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_Z (Z ω)) := div_div _ _ _
          have h_log_sub : Real.log (p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_Z (Z ω))) =
              Real.log (p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) - Real.log (p_Z (Z ω)) := by
            rw [← h_div_eq, Real.log_div (div_pos hpTZ_pos hpT_pos).ne' hpZ_pos.ne']
          rw [h_log_sub]
          change P ω * (-Real.log (p_Z (Z ω)) / ell) -
            P ω * (-Real.log (p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) / p_T (T_idx ω)) / ell) = _
          ring
        · have hP0 : P ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hP_pos) (hP_nn ω)
          simp [hP0]
      have h_rhs :
          (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ z : Fin N_Z,
            p_TZ tid z * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z))) =
          ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, P ω * Real.log (p_TZ (T_idx ω) (Z ω) / (p_T (T_idx ω) * p_Z (Z ω))) := by
        have h_exp : ∀ (tid : Fin M_T) (z : Fin N_Z),
            p_TZ tid z * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) =
            ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z then
              P ω * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) else 0 := by
          intro tid z
          dsimp [p_TZ]
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> ring
        simp_rw [h_exp]
        have h_swap : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
            (∑ z : Fin N_Z, ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
              if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z then
                P ω * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) else 0) =
            ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, ∑ z : Fin N_Z,
              if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z then
                P ω * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) else 0 :=
          fun _ => Finset.sum_comm
        simp_rw [h_swap]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        have h1 : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
            (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z ω = z then
              P ω * Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) else 0) =
            if T_idx ω = tid then
              P ω * Real.log (p_TZ tid (Z ω) / (p_T tid * p_Z (Z ω))) else 0 := by
          intro tid
          by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> simp [ht]
        simp_rw [h1]
        simp
      rw [h_lhs, h_rhs]

    refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add (fun δ_sup hδ_pos => ?_)
    have h_cell_ex : ∀ z : Fin N_Z,
        ∃ (N_Dz : ℕ) (b_z a_z : Fin N_Dz → ℝ)
          (e_z V_z A_z : Fin N_Dz → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (q_z : Fin M_T → Fin N_Dz → ℝ),
          (∀ d_z : Fin N_Dz, 0 ≤ b_z d_z ∧ b_z d_z ≤ a_z d_z ∧ a_z d_z ≤ 1 ∧ ‖e_z d_z‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ tid d_z, 0 ≤ q_z tid d_z) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d_z : Fin N_Dz, p_Z z * q_z tid d_z = p_TZ tid z) ∧
          (∀ tid : Fin M_T, ∀ d_z : Fin N_Dz, 0 < p_Z z * q_z tid d_z →
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_z d_z) (e_z d_z)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_z d_z) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_z d_z) (perp2D (e_z d_z))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_z d_z) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_z d_z) (e_z d_z)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_z d_z) ∧
            |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_z d_z) (perp2D (e_z d_z))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_z d_z)) ∧
          (0 < p_Z z →
            let q_Dz := fun d_z => ∑ tid : Fin M_T, q_z tid d_z
            let I_TDz := (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d_z : Fin N_Dz,
              q_z tid d_z * Real.log (q_z tid d_z / ((p_TZ tid z / p_Z z) * q_Dz d_z))) / ell
            let E_wz := ∑ d_z : Fin N_Dz, q_Dz d_z * ((1 + γ) * b_z d_z + (1 - γ) * a_z d_z)
            classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T (P_z z) T_idx V_part A_part - δ_sup ≤
              E_wz - I_TDz) := by
      intro z
      by_cases hpz_pos : 0 < p_Z z
      · obtain ⟨hpz_nn, _, hpz_marg⟩ := hpz_law z hpz_pos
        have h_lt : classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T (P_z z) T_idx V_part A_part - δ_sup <
            sSup (RootSet (P_z z)) := by
          rw [← h_root_eq]
          linarith
        obtain ⟨s_z, hs_z_mem, hs_z_gt⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup (h_root_ne (P_z z) hpz_nn) h_lt
        rcases hs_z_mem with ⟨N_Dz, b_z, a_z, e_z, V_z, A_z, q_z,
          h_adm_z, hq_nn_z, hq_sum_z, hq_cap_z, hs_z_eq⟩
        refine ⟨N_Dz, b_z, a_z, e_z, V_z, A_z, q_z, h_adm_z, hq_nn_z,
          fun tid => ?_, fun tid d_z hprod_pos => ?_, fun _ => ?_⟩
        · rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hq_sum_z tid, hpz_marg tid, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpz_pos.ne']
        · have hqz_pos : 0 < q_z tid d_z := pos_of_mul_pos_right hprod_pos hpz_pos.le
          exact hq_cap_z tid d_z hqz_pos
        · simp_rw [← hpz_marg]
          linarith [hs_z_gt, hs_z_eq]
      · have hpz0 : p_Z z = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpz_pos) (hpZ_nn z)
        refine ⟨0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, fun _ => Fin.elim0,
          fun d => Fin.elim0 d, fun _ d => Fin.elim0 d, fun tid => ?_,
          fun _ d => Fin.elim0 d, fun hpos => absurd hpos hpz_pos⟩
        simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
        exact (le_antisymm (by linarith [hpTZ_le_pZ tid z, hpz0]) (hpTZ_nn tid z)).symm

    let N_Dz : Fin N_Z → ℕ := fun z => Classical.choose (h_cell_ex z)
    let spec_z := fun z => Classical.choose_spec (h_cell_ex z)
    let b_z : ∀ z, Fin (N_Dz z) → ℝ := fun z => Classical.choose (spec_z z)
    let spec_z1 := fun z => Classical.choose_spec (spec_z z)
    let a_z : ∀ z, Fin (N_Dz z) → ℝ := fun z => Classical.choose (spec_z1 z)
    let spec_z2 := fun z => Classical.choose_spec (spec_z1 z)
    let e_z : ∀ z, Fin (N_Dz z) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun z => Classical.choose (spec_z2 z)
    let spec_z3 := fun z => Classical.choose_spec (spec_z2 z)
    let V_z : ∀ z, Fin (N_Dz z) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun z => Classical.choose (spec_z3 z)
    let spec_z4 := fun z => Classical.choose_spec (spec_z3 z)
    let A_z : ∀ z, Fin (N_Dz z) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun z => Classical.choose (spec_z4 z)
    let spec_z5 := fun z => Classical.choose_spec (spec_z4 z)
    let q_z : ∀ z, Fin M_T → Fin (N_Dz z) → ℝ := fun z => Classical.choose (spec_z5 z)
    have h_z_props := fun z => Classical.choose_spec (spec_z5 z)

    let Sig := Σ z : Fin N_Z, Fin (N_Dz z)
    let N_D : ℕ := Fintype.card Sig
    let eqv : Sig ≃ Fin N_D := Fintype.equivFin Sig
    let b_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => b_z (eqv.symm d).1 (eqv.symm d).2
    let a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => a_z (eqv.symm d).1 (eqv.symm d).2
    let e_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => e_z (eqv.symm d).1 (eqv.symm d).2
    let V_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => V_z (eqv.symm d).1 (eqv.symm d).2
    let A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun d => A_z (eqv.symm d).1 (eqv.symm d).2
    let q : Fin M_T → Fin N_D → ℝ :=
      fun tid d => p_Z (eqv.symm d).1 * q_z (eqv.symm d).1 tid (eqv.symm d).2

    let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d
    let I_TD : ℝ := (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
    let E_w : ℝ := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)

    have hs_mem : E_w - I_TD ∈ RootSet P := by
      refine ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q,
        fun d => (h_z_props (eqv.symm d).1).1 (eqv.symm d).2,
        fun tid d => mul_nonneg (hpZ_nn _) ((h_z_props (eqv.symm d).1).2.1 tid _),
        fun tid => ?_, fun tid d hq_pos => (h_z_props (eqv.symm d).1).2.2.2.1 tid _ hq_pos, rfl⟩
      have h_eqv := Equiv.sum_comp eqv.symm
        (fun s_idx : Sig => p_Z s_idx.1 * q_z s_idx.1 tid s_idx.2)
      have hqz_sum : ∀ z : Fin N_Z, ∑ d_z : Fin (N_Dz z), p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z = p_TZ tid z :=
        fun z => (h_z_props z).2.2.1 tid
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [h_eqv, Fintype.sum_sigma]
      simp_rw [hqz_sum]
      exact hpTZ_sum_z tid

    have hs_le_sup : E_w - I_TD ≤ classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T P T_idx V_part A_part := by
      rw [h_root_eq]
      exact le_csSup (h_root_bdd P hP_nn hP_sum) hs_mem

    let q_Dz : ∀ z, Fin (N_Dz z) → ℝ := fun z d_z => ∑ tid : Fin M_T, q_z z tid d_z
    let E_wz : Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun z =>
      ∑ d_z : Fin (N_Dz z), q_Dz z d_z * ((1 + γ) * b_z z d_z + (1 - γ) * a_z z d_z)
    let I_TDz : Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun z =>
      (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d_z : Fin (N_Dz z),
        q_z z tid d_z * Real.log (q_z z tid d_z / ((p_TZ tid z / p_Z z) * q_Dz z d_z))) / ell

    have hqD_sigma : ∀ s_idx : Sig, q_D (eqv s_idx) = p_Z s_idx.1 * q_Dz s_idx.1 s_idx.2 := by
      intro s_idx
      dsimp only [q_D, q, q_Dz]
      rw [eqv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp [Finset.mul_sum]

    have hEw_eq : E_w = ∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * E_wz z else 0 := by
      have h_eqv := (Equiv.sum_comp eqv
        (fun d : Fin N_D => q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d))).symm
      dsimp only [E_w]
      rw [h_eqv]
      have h_step : ∀ s_idx : Sig,
          q_D (eqv s_idx) * ((1 + γ) * b_D (eqv s_idx) + (1 - γ) * a_D (eqv s_idx)) =
          (p_Z s_idx.1 * q_Dz s_idx.1 s_idx.2) *
            ((1 + γ) * b_z s_idx.1 s_idx.2 + (1 - γ) * a_z s_idx.1 s_idx.2) := by
        intro s_idx
        dsimp only [b_D, a_D]
        rw [hqD_sigma, eqv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp_rw [h_step]
      rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
      by_cases hpz_pos : 0 < p_Z z
      · simp only [hpz_pos, ↓reduceIte, E_wz, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
      · have hpz0 : p_Z z = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpz_pos) (hpZ_nn z)
        simp [hpz0]

    have hITD_eq : I_TD =
        (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * I_TDz z else 0) +
          finMutualInfo ε P T_idx Z := by
      dsimp only [I_TD]
      have h_sum_d : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) =
          ∑ z : Fin N_Z, ∑ d_z : Fin (N_Dz z),
            (p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z) *
              Real.log ((p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z) / (p_T tid * (p_Z z * q_Dz z d_z))) := by
        intro tid
        have h_eqv := (Equiv.sum_comp eqv
          (fun d : Fin N_D => q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d)))).symm
        rw [h_eqv]
        have h_step : ∀ s_idx : Sig,
            q tid (eqv s_idx) * Real.log (q tid (eqv s_idx) / (p_T tid * q_D (eqv s_idx))) =
            (p_Z s_idx.1 * q_z s_idx.1 tid s_idx.2) *
              Real.log ((p_Z s_idx.1 * q_z s_idx.1 tid s_idx.2) /
                (p_T tid * (p_Z s_idx.1 * q_Dz s_idx.1 s_idx.2))) := by
          intro s_idx
          dsimp only [q]
          rw [hqD_sigma, eqv.symm_apply_apply]
        simp_rw [h_step]
        rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
      simp_rw [h_sum_d]
      have h_term_split : ∀ (tid : Fin M_T) (z : Fin N_Z) (d_z : Fin (N_Dz z)),
          (p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z) *
            Real.log ((p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z) / (p_T tid * (p_Z z * q_Dz z d_z))) =
          (p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z) *
            Real.log (q_z z tid d_z / ((p_TZ tid z / p_Z z) * q_Dz z d_z)) +
          (p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z) *
            Real.log (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) := by
        intro tid z d_z
        by_cases hprod_pos : 0 < p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z
        · have hpz_pos : 0 < p_Z z := pos_of_mul_pos_left hprod_pos ((h_z_props z).2.1 tid d_z)
          have hqz_pos : 0 < q_z z tid d_z := pos_of_mul_pos_right hprod_pos (hpZ_nn z)
          have hpTZ_pos : 0 < p_TZ tid z := by
            refine lt_of_lt_of_le hprod_pos ?_
            rw [← (h_z_props z).2.2.1 tid]
            exact Finset.single_le_sum
              (fun d_z' _ => mul_nonneg (hpZ_nn z) ((h_z_props z).2.1 tid d_z'))
              (Finset.mem_univ d_z)
          have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := by
            refine lt_of_lt_of_le hpTZ_pos ?_
            rw [← hpTZ_sum_z tid]
            exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun z' _ => hpTZ_nn tid z') (Finset.mem_univ z)
          have hqDz_pos : 0 < q_Dz z d_z :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le hqz_pos
              (Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => (h_z_props z).2.1 tid' d_z) (Finset.mem_univ tid))
          have h_frac : (p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z) / (p_T tid * (p_Z z * q_Dz z d_z)) =
              (q_z z tid d_z / ((p_TZ tid z / p_Z z) * q_Dz z d_z)) *
                (p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z)) := by
            field_simp [hpz_pos.ne', hpT_pos.ne', hpTZ_pos.ne', hqDz_pos.ne']
          have hf1_pos : 0 < q_z z tid d_z / ((p_TZ tid z / p_Z z) * q_Dz z d_z) :=
            div_pos hqz_pos (mul_pos (div_pos hpTZ_pos hpz_pos) hqDz_pos)
          have hf2_pos : 0 < p_TZ tid z / (p_T tid * p_Z z) :=
            div_pos hpTZ_pos (mul_pos hpT_pos hpz_pos)
          rw [h_frac, Real.log_mul hf1_pos.ne' hf2_pos.ne', mul_add]
        · have hprod0 : p_Z z * q_z z tid d_z = 0 :=
            le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hprod_pos) (mul_nonneg (hpZ_nn z) ((h_z_props z).2.1 tid d_z))
          rw [hprod0]
          simp
      simp_rw [h_term_split, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [add_div, h_mi_eq]
      congr 1
      · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
        by_cases hpz_pos : 0 < p_Z z
        · simp only [hpz_pos, ↓reduceIte, I_TDz]
          simp_rw [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          rw [mul_div_assoc]
        · have hpz0 : p_Z z = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpz_pos) (hpZ_nn z)
          simp [hpz0]
      · congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_))
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, (h_z_props z).2.2.1 tid]

    have h_score_lb :
        (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
          if 0 < p_Z z then
            p_Z z * classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T (P_z z) T_idx V_part A_part
          else 0) - δ_sup ≤
        ∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * (E_wz z - I_TDz z) else 0 := by
      have h_del_le :
          (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * δ_sup else 0) ≤ δ_sup := by
        calc (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * δ_sup else 0)
            ≤ ∑ z : Fin N_Z, p_Z z * δ_sup := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z _ => ?_)
              split_ifs
              · exact le_rfl
              · exact mul_nonneg (hpZ_nn z) hδ_pos.le
          _ = (∑ z : Fin N_Z, p_Z z) * δ_sup := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          _ = δ_sup := by rw [hpZ_sum, one_mul]
      have h_step :
          (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
            if 0 < p_Z z then
              p_Z z * (classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T (P_z z) T_idx V_part A_part - δ_sup)
            else 0) ≤
          ∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * (E_wz z - I_TDz z) else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z _ => ?_)
        split_ifs with hpz_pos
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((h_z_props z).2.2.2.2 hpz_pos) hpz_pos.le
        · exact le_rfl
      have h_split :
          (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
            if 0 < p_Z z then
              p_Z z * (classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T (P_z z) T_idx V_part A_part - δ_sup)
            else 0) =
          (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
            if 0 < p_Z z then
              p_Z z * classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T (P_z z) T_idx V_part A_part
            else 0) -
          (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * δ_sup else 0) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> ring
      linarith

    have h_ew_sub_itd :
        E_w - I_TD =
        (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * (E_wz z - I_TDz z) else 0) -
          finMutualInfo ε P T_idx Z := by
      rw [hEw_eq, hITD_eq]
      have h_comb :
          (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * E_wz z else 0) -
          (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * I_TDz z else 0) =
          ∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * (E_wz z - I_TDz z) else 0 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> ring
      linarith

    linarith [hs_le_sup, h_score_lb, h_ew_sub_itd]

  · 
    intro J_cap
    let G_net : ℕ := ⌈100 / ε⌉₊ + 1
    have hG_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (G_net : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [G_net]
      positivity
    have hG_ge_100 : 100 / ε ≤ (G_net : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [G_net]
      push_cast
      linarith [Nat.le_ceil (100 / ε)]
    have hG_inv_le : (G_net : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * ε := by
      have h1 : (G_net : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (100 / ε)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hG_ge_100
      have h2 : (100 / ε)⁻¹ = (1 / 100 : ℝ) * ε := by
        field_simp [hε₀.ne']
      linarith

    let G_Z : ℤ := (G_net : ℤ)
    let S_dir : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
      ((Finset.Icc (-G_Z) G_Z) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-G_Z) G_Z)).filter (fun ij => ij ≠ (0, 0))
    let rawVec : ℤ × ℤ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun ij => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then (ij.1 : ℝ) else (ij.2 : ℝ))
    let u_dir : ℤ × ℤ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun ij => ‖rawVec ij‖⁻¹ • rawVec ij

    have h_raw_pos : ∀ ij ∈ S_dir, 0 < ‖rawVec ij‖ := by
      intro ij hij
      have hne : ij ≠ (0, 0) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).2
      have hsq_pos : 0 < ‖rawVec ij‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq]
        change 0 < (ij.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (ij.2 : ℝ) ^ 2
        by_cases h1 : ij.1 = 0
        · have h2 : ij.2 ≠ 0 := fun h2 => hne (Prod.ext h1 h2)
          have h2r : (ij.2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr h2
          positivity
        · have h1r : (ij.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr h1
          positivity
      by_contra hle
      have h0 : ‖rawVec ij‖ = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hle) (norm_nonneg _)
      rw [h0] at hsq_pos
      norm_num at hsq_pos

    have hu_dir_norm : ∀ ij ∈ S_dir, ‖u_dir ij‖ = 1 := by
      intro ij hij
      have hp := h_raw_pos ij hij
      dsimp [u_dir]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hp.le), inv_mul_cancel₀ hp.ne']

    have h10_mem : ((1 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) ∈ S_dir := by
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, by decide⟩
      · refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> { dsimp [G_Z, G_net]; omega }
      · refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> { dsimp [G_Z, G_net]; omega }

    have hu10_eq : u_dir (1, 0) = e₀_unit := by
      have h_norm10 : ‖rawVec (1, 0)‖ = 1 := by
        refine h_sq_eq (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one ?_
        rw [h_norm_sq]
        change ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 + ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2
        norm_num
      dsimp [u_dir]
      rw [h_norm10, inv_one, one_smul]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [rawVec, e₀_unit]

    have h_net_approx : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 →
        ∃ ij ∈ S_dir, ‖u_dir ij - e‖ ≤ (4 / 100 : ℝ) * ε := by
      intro e he
      let ij : ℤ × ℤ := (⌊(G_net : ℝ) * e 0⌋, ⌊(G_net : ℝ) * e 1⌋)
      have hij_box : ∀ i : Fin 2, ⌊(G_net : ℝ) * e i⌋ ∈ Finset.Icc (-G_Z) G_Z := by
        intro i
        have hc := h_coord_le e i
        rw [he] at hc
        obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp hc
        refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
          dsimp [G_Z]
          push_cast
          nlinarith [hlo, hG_pos]
        · have hfl : ((⌊(G_net : ℝ) * e i⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (G_net : ℝ) * e i := Int.floor_le _
          have hle : ((⌊(G_net : ℝ) * e i⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (G_Z : ℝ) := by
            dsimp [G_Z]
            push_cast
