      have hna_le_M : na ≤ M_ξ :=
        Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ha1 hξ₀.le)
      have hnb_le_M : nb ≤ M_ξ := le_trans hnb_le_na hna_le_M
      let dp : DepthPair :=
        ⟨(⟨nb, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hnb_le_M⟩, ⟨na, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hna_le_M⟩), hnb_le_na⟩
      let b_s : ℝ := (nb : ℝ) * ξ
      let a_s : ℝ := (na : ℝ) * ξ
      have hbs_le : b_s ≤ b := by
        dsimp [b_s, nb]
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hb0 hξ₀.le)) hξ₀.le
        rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'] at h1
      have hbs_gt : b - ξ ≤ b_s := by
        dsimp [b_s, nb]
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (b / ξ)).le hξ₀.le
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'] at h1
        linarith
      have has_le : a_s ≤ a := by
        dsimp [a_s, na]
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (le_trans hb0 hba) hξ₀.le)) hξ₀.le
        rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'] at h1
      have has_gt : a - ξ ≤ a_s := by
        dsimp [a_s, na]
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (a / ξ)).le hξ₀.le
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'] at h1
        linarith
      have hw_s_ge : ((1 + γ) * b + (1 - γ) * a) - 2 * ξ ≤ (1 + γ) * b_s + (1 - γ) * a_s := by
        nlinarith
      have hε_le_as : ε ≤ ε ^ a_s := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← Real.rpow_one ε]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (le_trans has_le ha1)
      have hε_le_bs : ε ≤ ε ^ b_s := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← Real.rpow_one ε]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (le_trans hbs_le (le_trans hba ha1))
      have hεb_le_bs : ε ^ b ≤ ε ^ b_s :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 hbs_le
      have hεa_le_as : ε ^ a ≤ ε ^ a_s :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 has_le
      have hεb_le1 : ε ^ b ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hε₀.le hε_le1 hb0
      have hεa_le1 : ε ^ a ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one hε₀.le hε_le1 (le_trans hb0 hba)

      obtain ⟨ij_e, hij_e_mem, hu_approx⟩ := h_net_approx e he_norm
      let u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := u_dir ij_e
      have hu_norm : ‖u‖ = 1 := hu_dir_norm ij_e hij_e_mem

      have h_rel_vec : ∀ (X X₀ C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          |inner ℝ (X - C) e| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b →
          |inner ℝ (X - C) (perp2D e)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a →
          |inner ℝ (X₀ - C) e| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b →
          |inner ℝ (X₀ - C) (perp2D e)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a →
          |inner ℝ X u - inner ℝ X₀ u| ≤ 22 * ε ^ b_s ∧
          |inner ℝ X (perp2D u) - inner ℝ X₀ (perp2D u)| ≤ 22 * ε ^ a_s := by
        intro X X₀ C hX1 hX2 hX01 hX02
        let ΔX : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := X - X₀
        have hΔ_eq : ΔX = (X - C) - (X₀ - C) := by dsimp [ΔX]; abel
        have hΔ_e : |inner ℝ ΔX e| ≤ 20 * ε ^ b := by
          rw [hΔ_eq, inner_sub_left]
          linarith [abs_sub (inner ℝ (X - C) e) (inner ℝ (X₀ - C) e)]
        have hΔ_pe : |inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D e)| ≤ 20 * ε ^ a := by
          rw [hΔ_eq, inner_sub_left]
          linarith [abs_sub (inner ℝ (X - C) (perp2D e)) (inner ℝ (X₀ - C) (perp2D e))]
        have hΔ_norm : ‖ΔX‖ ≤ 29 := by
          refine h_sq_le (by norm_num) ?_
          rw [h_parseval ΔX e he_norm]
          have he1 : |inner ℝ ΔX e| ≤ 20 := by linarith
          have he2 : |inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D e)| ≤ 20 := by linarith
          have hs1 : (inner ℝ ΔX e) ^ 2 ≤ 20 ^ 2 := by
            rw [← sq_abs (inner ℝ ΔX e), ← sq_abs (20 : ℝ)]
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans he1 (le_abs_self _)) 2
          have hs2 : (inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D e)) ^ 2 ≤ 20 ^ 2 := by
            rw [← sq_abs (inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D e)), ← sq_abs (20 : ℝ)]
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans he2 (le_abs_self _)) 2
          linarith
        constructor
        · have h_split : inner ℝ X u - inner ℝ X₀ u = inner ℝ ΔX e + inner ℝ ΔX (u - e) := by
            dsimp [ΔX]
            rw [← inner_sub_left, ← inner_add_right, add_sub_cancel]
          have hcs : |inner ℝ ΔX (u - e)| ≤ 29 * ((4 / 100 : ℝ) * ε) := by
            calc |inner ℝ ΔX (u - e)|
                ≤ ‖ΔX‖ * ‖u - e‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
              _ ≤ 29 * ((4 / 100 : ℝ) * ε) :=
                  mul_le_mul hΔ_norm hu_approx (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          rw [h_split]
          linarith [abs_add_le (inner ℝ ΔX e) (inner ℝ ΔX (u - e)), hΔ_e, hcs, hεb_le_bs, hε_le_bs]
        · have h_split : inner ℝ X (perp2D u) - inner ℝ X₀ (perp2D u) =
              inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D e) + inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D u - perp2D e) := by
            dsimp [ΔX]
            rw [← inner_sub_left, ← inner_add_right, add_sub_cancel]
          have hcs : |inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D u - perp2D e)| ≤ 29 * ((4 / 100 : ℝ) * ε) := by
            calc |inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D u - perp2D e)|
                ≤ ‖ΔX‖ * ‖perp2D u - perp2D e‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
              _ = ‖ΔX‖ * ‖u - e‖ := by rw [h_perp_sub]
              _ ≤ 29 * ((4 / 100 : ℝ) * ε) :=
                  mul_le_mul hΔ_norm hu_approx (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          rw [h_split]
          linarith [abs_add_le (inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D e)) (inner ℝ ΔX (perp2D u - perp2D e)),
            hΔ_pe, hcs, hεa_le_as, hε_le_as]

      have h_proj_bd : ∀ (X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖X‖ ≤ B_iso →
          |inner ℝ X u| ≤ B_iso ∧ |inner ℝ X (perp2D u)| ≤ B_iso := by
        intro X hX
        constructor
        · calc |inner ℝ X u| ≤ ‖X‖ * ‖u‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ B_iso := by rw [hu_norm, mul_one]; exact hX
        · calc |inner ℝ X (perp2D u)| ≤ ‖X‖ * ‖perp2D u‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ B_iso := by rw [h_perp_norm, hu_norm, mul_one]; exact hX

      obtain ⟨IV1, hIV1_c, hIV1_R, hIV1_cov⟩ :=
        h_1d_three_shifts (inner ℝ (V_part tid₀) u) (ε ^ b_s)
          (h_proj_bd _ (hVA tid₀).1).1 hε_le_bs
      obtain ⟨IV2, hIV2_c, hIV2_R, hIV2_cov⟩ :=
        h_1d_three_shifts (inner ℝ (V_part tid₀) (perp2D u)) (ε ^ a_s)
          (h_proj_bd _ (hVA tid₀).1).2 hε_le_as
      obtain ⟨IA1, hIA1_c, hIA1_R, hIA1_cov⟩ :=
        h_1d_three_shifts (inner ℝ (A_part tid₀) u) (ε ^ b_s)
          (h_proj_bd _ (hVA tid₀).2).1 hε_le_bs
      obtain ⟨IA2, hIA2_c, hIA2_R, hIA2_cov⟩ :=
        h_1d_three_shifts (inner ℝ (A_part tid₀) (perp2D u)) (ε ^ a_s)
          (h_proj_bd _ (hVA tid₀).2).2 hε_le_as

      let dir_e : ↥S_dir := ⟨ij_e, hij_e_mem⟩
      let S_cov : Finset MenuType :=
        ((IV1.attach ×ˢ IV2.attach) ×ˢ (IA1.attach ×ˢ IA2.attach)).image
          (fun q => (dp, dir_e,
            (⟨q.1.1.val, hIV1_R _ q.1.1.prop⟩, ⟨q.1.2.val, hIV2_R _ q.1.2.prop⟩),
            (⟨q.2.1.val, hIA1_R _ q.2.1.prop⟩, ⟨q.2.2.val, hIA2_R _ q.2.2.prop⟩)))

      have hScov_card : (S_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ 81 := by
        have h_nat : S_cov.card ≤ 81 := by
          calc S_cov.card
              ≤ ((IV1.attach ×ˢ IV2.attach) ×ˢ (IA1.attach ×ˢ IA2.attach)).card :=
                Finset.card_image_le
            _ = (IV1.card * IV2.card) * (IA1.card * IA2.card) := by
                simp [Finset.card_product]
            _ ≤ (3 * 3) * (3 * 3) :=
                Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul hIV1_c hIV2_c) (Nat.mul_le_mul hIA1_c hIA2_c)
            _ = 81 := by norm_num
        exact_mod_cast h_nat

      refine ⟨S_cov, hScov_card, fun m hm => ?_, fun tid htid => ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨q, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
        exact hw_s_ge
      · obtain ⟨hV_u, hV_pu⟩ := h_rel_vec (V_part tid) (V_part tid₀) V₀
          htid.1 htid.2.1 htid₀.1 htid₀.2.1
        obtain ⟨hA_u, hA_pu⟩ := h_rel_vec (A_part tid) (A_part tid₀) A₀
          htid.2.2.1 htid.2.2.2 htid₀.2.2.1 htid₀.2.2.2
        obtain ⟨kV1, hkV1_in, hkV1_bd⟩ := hIV1_cov (inner ℝ (V_part tid) u) hV_u
        obtain ⟨kV2, hkV2_in, hkV2_bd⟩ := hIV2_cov (inner ℝ (V_part tid) (perp2D u)) hV_pu
        obtain ⟨kA1, hkA1_in, hkA1_bd⟩ := hIA1_cov (inner ℝ (A_part tid) u) hA_u
        obtain ⟨kA2, hkA2_in, hkA2_bd⟩ := hIA2_cov (inner ℝ (A_part tid) (perp2D u)) hA_pu
        let q_t : (↥IV1 × ↥IV2) × (↥IA1 × ↥IA2) :=
          ((⟨kV1, hkV1_in⟩, ⟨kV2, hkV2_in⟩), (⟨kA1, hkA1_in⟩, ⟨kA2, hkA2_in⟩))
        let m_t : MenuType := (dp, dir_e,
          (⟨q_t.1.1.val, hIV1_R _ q_t.1.1.prop⟩, ⟨q_t.1.2.val, hIV2_R _ q_t.1.2.prop⟩),
          (⟨q_t.2.1.val, hIA1_R _ q_t.2.1.prop⟩, ⟨q_t.2.2.val, hIA2_R _ q_t.2.2.prop⟩))
        have hm_t_in : m_t ∈ S_cov := by
          refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q_t, ?_, rfl⟩
          simp [Finset.mem_product]
        refine ⟨m_t, hm_t_in, (h_cap_mem m_t tid).mpr ?_⟩
        have hfV := h_frame_sub (V_part tid) u ((kV1 : ℝ) * ε ^ b_s) ((kV2 : ℝ) * ε ^ a_s) hu_norm
        have hfA := h_frame_sub (A_part tid) u ((kA1 : ℝ) * ε ^ b_s) ((kA2 : ℝ) * ε ^ a_s) hu_norm
        exact ⟨by simpa [V_menu, e_menu, b_menu, a_menu, m_t, dp, dir_e, q_t, b_s, a_s, u] using
            (by rw [hfV.1]; exact hkV1_bd),
          by simpa [V_menu, e_menu, b_menu, a_menu, m_t, dp, dir_e, q_t, b_s, a_s, u] using
            (by rw [hfV.2]; exact hkV2_bd),
          by simpa [A_menu, e_menu, b_menu, a_menu, m_t, dp, dir_e, q_t, b_s, a_s, u] using
            (by rw [hfA.1]; exact hkA1_bd),
          by simpa [A_menu, e_menu, b_menu, a_menu, m_t, dp, dir_e, q_t, b_s, a_s, u] using
            (by rw [hfA.2]; exact hkA2_bd)⟩

    
    let p_T_amb : Fin M_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π_amb ω else 0
    have hp_amb_nn : ∀ tid, 0 ≤ p_T_amb tid :=
      fun tid => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω])
    have hp_amb_sum : ∑ tid : Fin M_T, p_T_amb tid = 1 := by
      dsimp [p_T_amb]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp [hπ_sum]

    have h_exhaust : ∀ (n_card : ℕ) (R₀ : Finset (Fin M_T)), R₀.card = n_card → ∀ (h : ℝ),
        ∃ (R' : Finset (Fin M_T)) (K : ℕ)
          (m_step : Fin K → MenuType) (E_step : Fin K → Finset (Fin M_T)),
          (Set.univ : Set (Fin K)).PairwiseDisjoint E_step ∧
          Disjoint R' (Finset.univ.biUnion E_step) ∧
          R' ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion E_step = R₀ ∧
          (∀ k : Fin K, E_step k ⊆ C_menu (m_step k) ∧
            ε ^ (w_menu (m_step k) - h) ≤ ∑ tid ∈ E_step k, p_T_amb tid) ∧
          (∀ m : MenuType, ∑ tid ∈ R' ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid ≤ ε ^ (w_menu m - h)) := by
      intro n_card
      refine Nat.strongRecOn n_card (fun n ih R₀ hcard h => ?_)
      by_cases h_ex : ∃ m : MenuType, ε ^ (w_menu m - h) ≤ ∑ tid ∈ R₀ ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid
      · obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := h_ex
        let E₀ : Finset (Fin M_T) := R₀ ∩ C_menu m₀
        have hE₀_pos : 0 < ∑ tid ∈ E₀, p_T_amb tid :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hm₀
        have hE₀_ne : E₀.Nonempty := by
          rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
          intro hemp
          rw [hemp, Finset.sum_empty] at hE₀_pos
          linarith
        have h_lt : (R₀ \ E₀).card < n := by
          rw [← hcard]
          exact Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.sdiff_ssubset Finset.inter_subset_left hE₀_ne)
        obtain ⟨R', K₁, m₁, E₁, h_disj₁, h_R'_disj₁, h_union₁, h_k₁, h_rem₁⟩ :=
          ih (R₀ \ E₀).card h_lt (R₀ \ E₀) rfl h
        let m_step : Fin (K₁ + 1) → MenuType := Fin.cons m₀ m₁
        let E_step : Fin (K₁ + 1) → Finset (Fin M_T) := Fin.cons E₀ E₁
        have h_biU_eq : Finset.univ.biUnion E_step = E₀ ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion E₁ := by
          ext tid
          simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
            refine Fin.cases (fun h0 => Or.inl h0) (fun k' hk' => Or.inr ⟨k', hk'⟩) k hk
          · rintro (h0 | ⟨k', hk'⟩)
            · exact ⟨0, h0⟩
            · exact ⟨k'.succ, hk'⟩
        have h_sub_sdiff : Finset.univ.biUnion E₁ ⊆ R₀ \ E₀ := by
          rw [← h_union₁]
          exact Finset.subset_union_right
        have h_R'_sub_sdiff : R' ⊆ R₀ \ E₀ := by
          rw [← h_union₁]
          exact Finset.subset_union_left
        have h_disj_E0_E1 : Disjoint E₀ (Finset.univ.biUnion E₁) :=
          Disjoint.mono_right h_sub_sdiff Finset.disjoint_sdiff
        have h_disj_R'_E0 : Disjoint R' E₀ :=
          (Disjoint.mono_right h_R'_sub_sdiff Finset.disjoint_sdiff).symm
        refine ⟨R', K₁ + 1, m_step, E_step, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, h_rem₁⟩
        · intro i _ j _ hij
          change Disjoint (E_step i) (E_step j)
          rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩ <;>
            rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
          · exact absurd rfl hij
          · simp only [E_step, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
            exact Disjoint.mono_right
              (Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem E₁ (Finset.mem_univ j')) h_disj_E0_E1
          · simp only [E_step, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_zero]
            exact (Disjoint.mono_right
              (Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem E₁ (Finset.mem_univ i')) h_disj_E0_E1).symm
          · simp only [E_step, Fin.cons_succ]
            exact h_disj₁ (Set.mem_univ i') (Set.mem_univ j') (fun heq => hij (congrArg Fin.succ heq))
        · rw [h_biU_eq]
          exact Finset.disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨h_disj_R'_E0, h_R'_disj₁⟩
        · rw [h_biU_eq, ← Finset.union_assoc, Finset.union_comm R' E₀, Finset.union_assoc,
            h_union₁, Finset.union_comm E₀ (R₀ \ E₀),
            Finset.sdiff_union_of_subset Finset.inter_subset_left]
        · intro k
          refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ k
          · simp only [E_step, m_step, Fin.cons_zero]
            exact ⟨Finset.inter_subset_right, hm₀⟩
          · intro k'
            simp only [E_step, m_step, Fin.cons_succ]
            exact h_k₁ k'
      · push_neg at h_ex
        refine ⟨R₀, 0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0,
          fun i => Fin.elim0 i,
          by simp,
          by simp,
          fun k => Fin.elim0 k,
          fun m => (h_ex m).le⟩

    have h_multi_peel : ∀ (n : ℕ) (R_top : Finset (Fin M_T)),
        (∀ m : MenuType, ∑ tid ∈ R_top ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid ≤ ε ^ (w_menu m - (-ξ + (n : ℝ) * ξ))) →
        ∃ U : Fin (n + 1) → Finset (Fin M_T),
          (Set.univ : Set (Fin (n + 1))).PairwiseDisjoint U ∧
          Finset.univ.biUnion U = R_top ∧
          (∀ m : MenuType, ∑ tid ∈ U (Fin.last n) ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid ≤ ε ^ (w_menu m + ξ)) ∧
          (∀ j : Fin n,
            let h_j := -ξ + (j.val : ℝ) * ξ
            (∀ m : MenuType, ∑ tid ∈ U j.castSucc ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid ≤ ε ^ (w_menu m - h_j - ξ)) ∧
            ∃ (K_j : ℕ) (m_step : Fin K_j → MenuType) (E_step : Fin K_j → Finset (Fin M_T)),
              (Set.univ : Set (Fin K_j)).PairwiseDisjoint E_step ∧
              Finset.univ.biUnion E_step = U j.castSucc ∧
              ∀ k : Fin K_j, E_step k ⊆ C_menu (m_step k) ∧
                ε ^ (w_menu (m_step k) - h_j) ≤ ∑ tid ∈ E_step k, p_T_amb tid) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro R_top hR_top
        let U : Fin 1 → Finset (Fin M_T) := fun _ => R_top
        refine ⟨U, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun j => Fin.elim0 j⟩
        · intro i _ j _ hij
          exfalso
          apply hij
          ext
          omega
        · ext tid
          simp [U]
        · intro m
          have h1 := hR_top m
          have hexp : w_menu m - (-ξ + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ξ) = w_menu m + ξ := by push_cast; ring
          rwa [hexp] at h1
      | succ n ih =>
        intro R_top hR_top
        let h_n : ℝ := -ξ + (n : ℝ) * ξ
        obtain ⟨R', K_n, m_n, E_n, hE_disj, hR'_disj, hR'_union, hE_pieces, hR'_rem⟩ :=
          h_exhaust R_top.card R_top rfl h_n
        let U_n : Finset (Fin M_T) := Finset.univ.biUnion E_n
        obtain ⟨U', hU'_disj, hU'_union, hU'_tail, hU'_bins⟩ := ih R' hR'_rem
        let U : Fin (n + 2) → Finset (Fin M_T) := fun i =>
          if h_lt : i.val < n then U' ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt h_lt⟩
          else if i.val = n then U_n
          else U' (Fin.last n)
        have hU_sub_R' : ∀ z' : Fin (n + 1), U' z' ⊆ R' := by
          intro z'
          rw [← hU'_union]
          exact Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem U' (Finset.mem_univ z')
        refine ⟨U, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i _ j _ hij
          change Disjoint (U i) (U j)
          dsimp only [U]
          split_ifs with hi1 hi2 hj1 hj2 hj3 hj4
          · refine hU'_disj (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) (fun heq => hij ?_)
            ext
            exact Fin.mk.inj_iff.mp heq
          · exact Disjoint.mono_left (hU_sub_R' _) hR'_disj
          · refine hU'_disj (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) (fun heq => ?_)
            have hv := congrArg Fin.val heq
            simp at hv
            omega
          · exact (Disjoint.mono_left (hU_sub_R' _) hR'_disj).symm
          · exfalso
            apply hij
            ext
            omega
          · exact (Disjoint.mono_left (hU_sub_R' _) hR'_disj).symm
          · refine hU'_disj (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) (fun heq => ?_)
            have hv := congrArg Fin.val heq
            simp at hv
            omega
          · exact Disjoint.mono_left (hU_sub_R' _) hR'_disj
          · exfalso
            apply hij
            ext
            have := i.isLt
            have := j.isLt
            omega
        · ext tid
          simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
            rw [← hR'_union, Finset.mem_union]
            dsimp only [U] at hi
            split_ifs at hi with hi1 hi2
            · exact Or.inl (hU_sub_R' _ hi)
            · exact Or.inr hi
            · exact Or.inl (hU_sub_R' _ hi)
          · intro htid
            rw [← hR'_union, Finset.mem_union] at htid
            rcases htid with h_in_R' | h_in_Un
            · rw [← hU'_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at h_in_R'
              obtain ⟨z', _, hz'⟩ := h_in_R'
              by_cases hz_lt : z'.val < n
              · refine ⟨⟨z'.val, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
                dsimp only [U]
                rw [dif_pos hz_lt]
                convert hz'
              · have hz_last : z' = Fin.last n := by
                  ext
                  have := z'.isLt
                  simp
                  omega
                subst hz_last
                refine ⟨Fin.last (n + 1), ?_⟩
                dsimp only [U]
                have h1 : ¬ (Fin.last (n + 1)).val < n := by simp
                have h2 : (Fin.last (n + 1)).val ≠ n := by simp
                rw [dif_neg h1, if_neg h2]
                exact hz'
            · refine ⟨⟨n, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
              dsimp only [U]
              simp only [lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte]
              exact h_in_Un
        · intro m
          dsimp only [U]
          have h1 : ¬ (Fin.last (n + 1)).val < n := by simp
          have h2 : (Fin.last (n + 1)).val ≠ n := by simp
          rw [dif_neg h1, if_neg h2]
          exact hU'_tail m
        · intro j
          by_cases hj_lt : j.val < n
          · have hU_eq : U j.castSucc = U' (⟨j.val, hj_lt⟩ : Fin n).castSucc := by
              dsimp only [U]
              have h1 : j.castSucc.val < n := hj_lt
              rw [dif_pos h1]
              rfl
            rw [hU_eq]
            exact hU'_bins ⟨j.val, hj_lt⟩
          · have hj_eq : j.val = n := by
              have := j.isLt
              omega
            have hU_eq : U j.castSucc = U_n := by
              dsimp only [U]
              have h1 : ¬ j.castSucc.val < n := by simpa using hj_lt
              have h2 : j.castSucc.val = n := hj_eq
              rw [dif_neg h1, if_pos h2]
            rw [hU_eq]
            have h_hj_eq : -ξ + (j.val : ℝ) * ξ = h_n := by rw [hj_eq]
            rw [h_hj_eq]
            refine ⟨fun m => ?_, K_n, m_n, E_n, hE_disj, rfl, hE_pieces⟩
            have hUn_sub : U_n ⊆ R_top := by
              rw [← hR'_union]
              exact Finset.subset_union_right
            have h_sub_cap : U_n ∩ C_menu m ⊆ R_top ∩ C_menu m :=
              Finset.inter_subset_inter_right hUn_sub
            have hexp : w_menu m - (-ξ + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ξ) = w_menu m - h_n - ξ := by
              dsimp [h_n]
              push_cast
              ring
            calc ∑ tid ∈ U_n ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid
                ≤ ∑ tid ∈ R_top ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid :=
                  Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub_cap (fun tid _ _ => hp_amb_nn tid)
              _ ≤ ε ^ (w_menu m - (-ξ + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ξ)) := hR_top m
              _ = ε ^ (w_menu m - h_n - ξ) := by rw [hexp]

    have h_top_init : ∀ m : MenuType,
        ∑ tid ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin M_T)) ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid ≤
          ε ^ (w_menu m - (-ξ + (J_cap : ℝ) * ξ)) := by
      intro m
      have h_gt2 : 2 ≤ -ξ + (J_cap : ℝ) * ξ := by
        dsimp [J_cap]
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (2 / ξ)).le hξ₀.le
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'] at h1
        push_cast
        linarith
      have hw_le2 : w_menu m ≤ 2 := (h_menu_adm m).2.2.2.2.2
      have hexp_le0 : w_menu m - (-ξ + (J_cap : ℝ) * ξ) ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have h_rpow_ge1 : 1 ≤ ε ^ (w_menu m - (-ξ + (J_cap : ℝ) * ξ)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_zero ε]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 hexp_le0
      calc ∑ tid ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin M_T)) ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid
          ≤ ∑ tid : Fin M_T, p_T_amb tid :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun tid _ _ => hp_amb_nn tid)
        _ = 1 := hp_amb_sum
        _ ≤ ε ^ (w_menu m - (-ξ + (J_cap : ℝ) * ξ)) := h_rpow_ge1

    obtain ⟨U_cap, hU_disj, hU_union, hU_tail, hU_bins⟩ := h_multi_peel J_cap Finset.univ h_top_init

    have h_tid_ex : ∀ tid : Fin M_T, ∃ z : Fin (J_cap + 1), tid ∈ U_cap z := by
      intro tid
      have hmem : tid ∈ Finset.univ.biUnion U_cap := by
        rw [hU_union]
        exact Finset.mem_univ tid
      obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hmem
      exact ⟨z, hz⟩

    let Z_cap : Fin M_T → Fin (J_cap + 1) := fun tid => Classical.choose (h_tid_ex tid)
    have hZ_iff : ∀ (tid : Fin M_T) (z : Fin (J_cap + 1)), Z_cap tid = z ↔ tid ∈ U_cap z := by
      intro tid z
      constructor
      · rintro rfl
        exact Classical.choose_spec (h_tid_ex tid)
      · intro h_in
        by_contra hne
        have h_in0 : tid ∈ U_cap (Z_cap tid) := Classical.choose_spec (h_tid_ex tid)
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp
          (hU_disj (Set.mem_univ (Z_cap tid)) (Set.mem_univ z) hne) h_in0 h_in

    have h_marg_z : ∀ z : Fin (J_cap + 1),
        (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = z then π_amb ω else 0) =
        ∑ tid ∈ U_cap z, p_T_amb tid := by
      intro z
      have h_uz_flt : U_cap z = Finset.univ.filter (fun tid : Fin M_T => Z_cap tid = z) := by
        ext tid
        simp [hZ_iff]
      rw [h_uz_flt, Finset.sum_filter]
      have h_step : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
          (if Z_cap tid = z then p_T_amb tid else 0) =
          ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z_cap tid = z then π_amb ω else 0 := by
        intro tid
        by_cases hz : Z_cap tid = z <;> simp [p_T_amb, hz]
      simp_rw [h_step]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      have h_in : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
          (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ Z_cap tid = z then π_amb ω else 0) =
          if T_idx ω = tid then (if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = z then π_amb ω else 0) else 0 := by
        intro tid
        by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid
        · subst ht
          simp
        · simp [ht]
      simp_rw [h_in]
      simp

    have h_tail_bound :
        (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = Fin.last J_cap then π_amb ω else 0) ≤
          (((2 * ⌈B_iso⌉₊ + 3) ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ ξ := by
      rw [h_marg_z (Fin.last J_cap)]
      have h_cov_sum :
          (∑ tid ∈ U_cap (Fin.last J_cap), p_T_amb tid) ≤
          ∑ m ∈ S₀, ∑ tid ∈ U_cap (Fin.last J_cap) ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid := by
        have h_rhs_rw :
            (∑ m ∈ S₀, ∑ tid ∈ U_cap (Fin.last J_cap) ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid) =
            ∑ tid ∈ U_cap (Fin.last J_cap),
              ∑ m ∈ S₀, if tid ∈ C_menu m then p_T_amb tid else 0 := by
          have h1 : ∀ m : MenuType,
              (∑ tid ∈ U_cap (Fin.last J_cap) ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid) =
              ∑ tid ∈ U_cap (Fin.last J_cap), if tid ∈ C_menu m then p_T_amb tid else 0 := by
            intro m
            have h_set : U_cap (Fin.last J_cap) ∩ C_menu m =
                (U_cap (Fin.last J_cap)).filter (fun tid => tid ∈ C_menu m) := by
              ext tid
              simp
            rw [h_set, Finset.sum_filter]
          simp_rw [h1]
          exact Finset.sum_comm
        rw [h_rhs_rw]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun tid _ => ?_)
        obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀_S0, hm₀_cap⟩ := hS₀_cov tid
        have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun m : MenuType => if tid ∈ C_menu m then p_T_amb tid else 0)
          (fun m _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hp_amb_nn tid]) hm₀_S0
        simpa [hm₀_cap] using hle
      calc ∑ tid ∈ U_cap (Fin.last J_cap), p_T_amb tid
          ≤ ∑ m ∈ S₀, ∑ tid ∈ U_cap (Fin.last J_cap) ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid := h_cov_sum
        _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ S₀, ε ^ ξ := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm => ?_)
            have h1 := hU_tail m
            rw [hS₀_zero m hm, zero_add] at h1
            exact h1
        _ = (S₀.card : ℝ) * ε ^ ξ := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ (((2 * ⌈B_iso⌉₊ + 3) ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ ξ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS₀_card (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ ξ).le

    
    refine ⟨Z_cap, h_tail_bound, fun j => ?_⟩
    intro h_cap p₁
    obtain ⟨h_bin_cap, K_j, m_step, E_step, hE_disj, hE_union, hE_pieces⟩ := hU_bins j

    have hh_cap_bds : -ξ ≤ h_cap ∧ h_cap ≤ 2 := by
      dsimp [h_cap]
      constructor
      · have hnn : 0 ≤ (j.val : ℝ) * ξ := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hξ₀.le
        linarith
      · have hj_le : j.val ≤ ⌊2 / ξ⌋₊ + 1 := by
          have hj_lt : j.val < ⌊2 / ξ⌋₊ + 2 := j.isLt
          omega
        have hj_r : (j.val : ℝ) ≤ (⌊2 / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hj_le
        have hfl : (⌊2 / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) * ξ ≤ 2 := by
          have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.floor_le (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 / ξ)) hξ₀.le
          rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'] at h1
        calc -ξ + (j.val : ℝ) * ξ
            ≤ -ξ + ((⌊2 / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) * ξ := by
              linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hj_r hξ₀.le]
          _ = (⌊2 / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) * ξ := by ring
          _ ≤ 2 := hfl

    refine ⟨hh_cap_bds, fun hp₁_pos => ?_, fun Q M_tilt hQ_nn hQ_sum hM_ge1 hQ_supp hQ_tilt => ?_⟩
    · 
      intro μ₁
      have hp₁_le1 : p₁ ≤ 1 := by
        dsimp [p₁]
        calc (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc then π_amb ω else 0)
            ≤ ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π_amb ω := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
              split_ifs <;> linarith [hπ_nn ω]
          _ = 1 := hπ_sum
      have hμ₁_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ μ₁ ω := by
        intro ω
        dsimp [μ₁]
        split_ifs
        · exact div_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) hp₁_pos.le
        · exact le_rfl
      have hμ₁_sum : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, μ₁ ω = 1 := by
        dsimp [μ₁]
        have h_pull : (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z_cap (T_idx ω) = j.castSucc then π_amb ω / p₁ else 0) =
            p₁ / p₁ := by
          dsimp [p₁]
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          split_ifs <;> simp
        rw [h_pull, div_self hp₁_pos.ne']
      have hpT_μ₁_eq : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
          p_T_of μ₁ tid = if tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc then p_T_amb tid / p₁ else 0 := by
        intro tid
        dsimp [p_T_of, μ₁, p_T_amb]
        by_cases h_in : tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc
        · have hz : Z_cap tid = j.castSucc := (hZ_iff _ _).mpr h_in
          simp only [h_in, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid
          · subst ht
            simp [hz]
          · simp [ht]
        · have hz : Z_cap tid ≠ j.castSucc := fun heq => h_in ((hZ_iff _ _).mp heq)
          simp only [h_in, ↓reduceIte]
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω _ => ?_)
          by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid
          · subst ht
            simp [hz]
          · simp [ht]
      have hpT_μ₁_nn : ∀ tid, 0 ≤ p_T_of μ₁ tid :=
        fun tid => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hμ₁_nn ω])
      have hpT_μ₁_sum : ∑ tid : Fin M_T, p_T_of μ₁ tid = 1 := by
        dsimp [p_T_of]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simp [hμ₁_sum]

      let b_D : Fin K_j → ℝ := fun k => b_menu (m_step k)
      let a_D : Fin K_j → ℝ := fun k => a_menu (m_step k)
      let e_D : Fin K_j → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun k => e_menu (m_step k)
      let V_D : Fin K_j → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun k => V_menu (m_step k)
      let A_D : Fin K_j → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun k => A_menu (m_step k)
      let q : Fin M_T → Fin K_j → ℝ :=
        fun tid k => if tid ∈ E_step k then p_T_of μ₁ tid else 0
      let q_D : Fin K_j → ℝ := fun k => ∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid k
      let I_TD : ℝ := (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ k : Fin K_j,
        q tid k * Real.log (q tid k / (p_T_of μ₁ tid * q_D k))) / ell
      let E_w : ℝ := ∑ k : Fin K_j, q_D k * ((1 + γ) * b_D k + (1 - γ) * a_D k)

      have hq_sum_tid : ∀ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ k : Fin K_j, q tid k = p_T_of μ₁ tid := by
        intro tid
        by_cases h_in : tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc
        · rw [← hE_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at h_in
          obtain ⟨k₀, _, hk₀⟩ := h_in
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k₀]
          · simp [q, hk₀]
          · intro k _ hne
            have hnot : tid ∉ E_step k :=
              Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hE_disj (Set.mem_univ k₀) (Set.mem_univ k) hne.symm) hk₀
            simp [q, hnot]
          · intro habs
            exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ k₀) habs
        · have hp0 : p_T_of μ₁ tid = 0 := by simp [hpT_μ₁_eq tid, h_in]
          simp [q, hp0]

      have hs_mem : E_w - I_TD ∈ RootSet μ₁ := by
        refine ⟨K_j, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q,
          fun k => ⟨(h_menu_adm (m_step k)).1, (h_menu_adm (m_step k)).2.1,
            (h_menu_adm (m_step k)).2.2.1, (h_menu_adm (m_step k)).2.2.2.1⟩,
          fun tid k => by dsimp [q]; split_ifs <;> linarith [hpT_μ₁_nn tid],
          hq_sum_tid,
          fun tid k hq_pos => ?_, rfl⟩
        have h_in_E : tid ∈ E_step k := by
          by_contra hnot
          simp [q, hnot] at hq_pos
        exact (h_cap_mem (m_step k) tid).mp ((hE_pieces k).1 h_in_E)

      have hqD_sum : ∑ k : Fin K_j, q_D k = 1 := by
        dsimp [q_D]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simp_rw [hq_sum_tid]
        exact hpT_μ₁_sum

      have h_piece_score : ∀ k : Fin K_j,
          q_D k * h_cap ≤
            q_D k * ((1 + γ) * b_D k + (1 - γ) * a_D k) -
              (∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid k * Real.log (q tid k / (p_T_of μ₁ tid * q_D k))) / ell := by
        intro k
        have hqD_eq : q_D k = (∑ tid ∈ E_step k, p_T_amb tid) / p₁ := by
          dsimp [q_D, q]
          rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
          have h_flt : Finset.univ.filter (fun tid : Fin M_T => tid ∈ E_step k) = E_step k := by
            ext tid
            simp
          rw [h_flt, Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun tid htid => ?_)
          have h_in_U : tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc := by
            rw [← hE_union]
            exact Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem E_step (Finset.mem_univ k) htid
          rw [hpT_μ₁_eq tid, if_pos h_in_U]
        have h_sk_lb := (hE_pieces k).2
        have h_sk_pos : 0 < ∑ tid ∈ E_step k, p_T_amb tid :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) h_sk_lb
        have hqD_ge_sk : (∑ tid ∈ E_step k, p_T_amb tid) ≤ q_D k := by
          rw [hqD_eq, le_div_iff₀ hp₁_pos]
          nlinarith [hp₁_le1, h_sk_pos]
        have hqD_ge_rpow : ε ^ (w_menu (m_step k) - h_cap) ≤ q_D k :=
          le_trans h_sk_lb hqD_ge_sk
        have hqD_pos : 0 < q_D k :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hqD_ge_rpow
        have h_log_qD : -(w_menu (m_step k) - h_cap) * ell ≤ Real.log (q_D k) := by
          have h1 := Real.log_le_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hqD_ge_rpow
          rwa [h_log_eps_rpow] at h1
        have h_w_lb : h_cap ≤ w_menu (m_step k) + Real.log (q_D k) / ell := by
          have h2 := (le_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mpr (by linarith :
            (h_cap - w_menu (m_step k)) * ell ≤ Real.log (q_D k))
          linarith
        have h_kl_k :
            (∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid k * Real.log (q tid k / (p_T_of μ₁ tid * q_D k))) =
            -(q_D k * Real.log (q_D k)) := by
          have h_pt : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
              q tid k * Real.log (q tid k / (p_T_of μ₁ tid * q_D k)) =
              -(q tid k * Real.log (q_D k)) := by
            intro tid
            by_cases hq_pos : 0 < q tid k
            · have h_in_E : tid ∈ E_step k := by
                by_contra hnot
                simp [q, hnot] at hq_pos
              have hq_eq : q tid k = p_T_of μ₁ tid := by simp [q, h_in_E]
              have hp_pos : 0 < p_T_of μ₁ tid := hq_eq ▸ hq_pos
              have h_div : q tid k / (p_T_of μ₁ tid * q_D k) = (q_D k)⁻¹ := by
                rw [hq_eq]
                field_simp [hp_pos.ne', hqD_pos.ne']
              rw [h_div, Real.log_inv]
              ring
            · have hq0 : q tid k = 0 :=
                le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hq_pos) (by dsimp [q]; split_ifs <;> linarith [hpT_μ₁_nn tid])
              simp [hq0]
          simp_rw [h_pt]
          rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        rw [h_kl_k]
        have h_rhs_eq :
            q_D k * ((1 + γ) * b_D k + (1 - γ) * a_D k) - -(q_D k * Real.log (q_D k)) / ell =
            q_D k * (w_menu (m_step k) + Real.log (q_D k) / ell) := by
          dsimp [w_menu, b_D, a_D]
          ring
        rw [h_rhs_eq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_w_lb hqD_pos.le

      have h_tot_lb : h_cap ≤ E_w - I_TD := by
        have h_rearr : E_w - I_TD = ∑ k : Fin K_j,
            (q_D k * ((1 + γ) * b_D k + (1 - γ) * a_D k) -
              (∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid k * Real.log (q tid k / (p_T_of μ₁ tid * q_D k))) / ell) := by
          dsimp [E_w, I_TD]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := Finset.univ (α := Fin M_T)), Finset.sum_div,
            Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        rw [h_rearr]
        calc h_cap
            = (∑ k : Fin K_j, q_D k) * h_cap := by rw [hqD_sum, one_mul]
          _ = ∑ k : Fin K_j, q_D k * h_cap := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin K_j,
                (q_D k * ((1 + γ) * b_D k + (1 - γ) * a_D k) -
                  (∑ tid : Fin M_T,
                    q tid k * Real.log (q tid k / (p_T_of μ₁ tid * q_D k))) / ell) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => h_piece_score k)

      rw [h_root_eq]
      exact le_trans h_tot_lb (le_csSup (h_root_bdd μ₁ hμ₁_nn hμ₁_sum) hs_mem)

    · 
      have hpTQ_nn : ∀ tid, 0 ≤ p_T_of Q tid :=
        fun tid => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hQ_nn ω])
      have hpTQ_sum : ∑ tid : Fin M_T, p_T_of Q tid = 1 := by
        dsimp [p_T_of]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simp [hQ_sum]
      have hpTQ_le_bin : ∀ tid : Fin M_T,
          p_T_of Q tid ≤ M_tilt * (if tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc then p_T_amb tid else 0) := by
        intro tid
        by_cases h_in : tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc
        · simp only [h_in, ↓reduceIte]
          dsimp [p_T_of, p_T_amb]
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
          split_ifs
          · exact hQ_tilt ω
          · linarith
        · have hz_ne : Z_cap tid ≠ j.castSucc := fun heq => h_in ((hZ_iff _ _).mp heq)
          simp only [h_in, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
          have h0 : p_T_of Q tid = 0 := by
            dsimp [p_T_of]
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω _ => ?_)
            by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid
            · have hQ0 : Q ω = 0 := by
                by_contra hne0
                have hQ_pos : 0 < Q ω := lt_of_le_of_ne (hQ_nn ω) (Ne.symm hne0)
                have hz_eq := hQ_supp ω hQ_pos
                rw [ht] at hz_eq
                exact hz_ne hz_eq
              simp [ht, hQ0]
            · simp [ht]
          linarith

      have h_menu_Q_ub : ∀ m : MenuType,
          (∑ tid ∈ C_menu m, p_T_of Q tid) ≤ M_tilt * ε ^ (w_menu m - h_cap - ξ) := by
        intro m
        have h_flt_eq :
            (∑ tid ∈ C_menu m, if tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc then p_T_amb tid else 0) =
            ∑ tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid := by
          have h_set : U_cap j.castSucc ∩ C_menu m =
              (C_menu m).filter (fun tid => tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc) := by
            ext tid
            simp [and_comm]
          conv_rhs => rw [h_set, Finset.sum_filter]
        calc ∑ tid ∈ C_menu m, p_T_of Q tid
            ≤ ∑ tid ∈ C_menu m, M_tilt * (if tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc then p_T_amb tid else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun tid _ => hpTQ_le_bin tid)
          _ = M_tilt * ∑ tid ∈ U_cap j.castSucc ∩ C_menu m, p_T_amb tid := by
              rw [← Finset.mul_sum, h_flt_eq]
          _ ≤ M_tilt * ε ^ (w_menu m - h_cap - ξ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_bin_cap m) (by linarith)

      let B_ub : ℝ := h_cap + 3 * ξ + Real.log (81 * M_tilt) / ell
      rw [h_root_eq]
      refine csSup_le (h_root_ne Q hQ_nn) (fun s hs => ?_)
      rcases hs with ⟨N_D, b_D, a_D, e_D, V_D, A_D, q, h_adm, hq_nn, hq_sum, hq_cap, hs_eq⟩
      let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d
      have hqD_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun tid _ => hq_nn tid d)
      have hqD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d = 1 := by
        dsimp [q_D]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simp_rw [hq_sum]
        exact hpTQ_sum

      have h_d_bound : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
          q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) -
            (∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell ≤
            q_D d * B_ub := by
        intro d
        let w_d : ℝ := (1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d
        by_cases hqD_pos : 0 < q_D d
        · have h_ex_tid₀ : ∃ tid₀ : Fin M_T, 0 < q tid₀ d := by
            by_contra h_all
            push_neg at h_all
            have h0 : q_D d = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero
              (fun tid _ => le_antisymm (h_all tid) (hq_nn tid d))
            linarith
          obtain ⟨tid₀, htid₀_pos⟩ := h_ex_tid₀
          let Supp_d : Finset (Fin M_T) :=
            @Finset.filter (Fin M_T) (fun tid => 0 < q tid d)
              (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
          have h_mem_supp : ∀ tid : Fin M_T, tid ∈ Supp_d ↔ 0 < q tid d := by
            intro tid
            dsimp [Supp_d]
            rw [@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _)]
            simp
          let P_d : ℝ := ∑ tid ∈ Supp_d, p_T_of Q tid
          have hPd_pos : 0 < P_d := by
            have hp0_pos : 0 < p_T_of Q tid₀ := by
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le htid₀_pos ?_
              rw [← hq_sum tid₀]
              exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hq_nn tid₀ d') (Finset.mem_univ d)
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp0_pos
              (Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid _ => hpTQ_nn tid) ((h_mem_supp tid₀).mpr htid₀_pos))
          obtain ⟨hb0, hba, ha1, he_n⟩ := h_adm d
          obtain ⟨S_cov, hScov_c, hScov_w, hScov_cov⟩ :=
            h_81_cov (b_D d) (a_D d) (e_D d) (V_D d) (A_D d) tid₀
              hb0 hba ha1 he_n (hq_cap tid₀ d htid₀_pos)
          have hPd_ub : P_d ≤ (81 * M_tilt) * ε ^ (w_d - h_cap - 3 * ξ) := by
            have h_cov_sum : P_d ≤ ∑ m ∈ S_cov, ∑ tid ∈ C_menu m, p_T_of Q tid := by
              have h_rhs_rw :
                  (∑ m ∈ S_cov, ∑ tid ∈ C_menu m, p_T_of Q tid) =
                  ∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ m ∈ S_cov, if tid ∈ C_menu m then p_T_of Q tid else 0 := by
                have h1 : ∀ m : MenuType,
                    (∑ tid ∈ C_menu m, p_T_of Q tid) =
                    ∑ tid : Fin M_T, if tid ∈ C_menu m then p_T_of Q tid else 0 := by
                  intro m
                  have h_set : C_menu m = Finset.univ.filter (fun tid : Fin M_T => tid ∈ C_menu m) := by
                    ext tid
                    simp
                  conv_lhs => rw [h_set]
                  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
                simp_rw [h1]
                exact Finset.sum_comm
              rw [h_rhs_rw]
              calc ∑ tid ∈ Supp_d, p_T_of Q tid
                  ≤ ∑ tid ∈ Supp_d, ∑ m ∈ S_cov, if tid ∈ C_menu m then p_T_of Q tid else 0 := by
                    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun tid htid => ?_)
                    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀_in, hm₀_cap⟩ :=
                      hScov_cov tid (hq_cap tid d ((h_mem_supp tid).mp htid))
                    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
                      (f := fun m : MenuType => if tid ∈ C_menu m then p_T_of Q tid else 0)
                      (fun m _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hpTQ_nn tid]) hm₀_in
                    simpa [hm₀_cap] using hle
                _ ≤ ∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ m ∈ S_cov, if tid ∈ C_menu m then p_T_of Q tid else 0 :=
                    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
                      (fun tid _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg
                        (fun m _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hpTQ_nn tid]))
            calc P_d
                ≤ ∑ m ∈ S_cov, ∑ tid ∈ C_menu m, p_T_of Q tid := h_cov_sum
              _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ S_cov, M_tilt * ε ^ (w_menu m - h_cap - ξ) :=
                  Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => h_menu_Q_ub m)
              _ ≤ ∑ _m ∈ S_cov, M_tilt * ε ^ (w_d - h_cap - 3 * ξ) := by
                  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm => ?_)
                  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by linarith)
                  refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 ?_
                  have hwm := hScov_w m hm
                  dsimp [w_d] at hwm ⊢
                  linarith
              _ = (S_cov.card : ℝ) * (M_tilt * ε ^ (w_d - h_cap - 3 * ξ)) := by
                  simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
              _ ≤ (81 * M_tilt) * ε ^ (w_d - h_cap - 3 * ξ) := by
                  have h_nn : 0 ≤ M_tilt * ε ^ (w_d - h_cap - 3 * ξ) :=
                    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le
                  linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hScov_c h_nn]

          have h_wd_Pd_ub : w_d + Real.log P_d / ell ≤ B_ub := by
            have h81M_pos : 0 < 81 * M_tilt := by linarith
            have h_log_le := Real.log_le_log hPd_pos hPd_ub
            rw [Real.log_mul h81M_pos.ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne',
              h_log_eps_rpow] at h_log_le
            have h_alg : (B_ub - w_d) * ell =
                Real.log (81 * M_tilt) - (w_d - h_cap - 3 * ξ) * ell := by
              dsimp [B_ub]
              field_simp [hell_ne]
              ring
            have h_div2 : Real.log P_d / ell ≤ B_ub - w_d :=
              (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mpr (by linarith [h_log_le, h_alg])
            linarith

          have h_kl_fiber :
              -(∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) ≤
                q_D d * Real.log P_d := by
            have h_qD_supp : ∑ tid ∈ Supp_d, q tid d = q_D d := by
              dsimp [q_D]
              rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ Supp_d)]
              intro tid _ hnot
              have hle0 : q tid d ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp (fun hp => hnot ((h_mem_supp tid).mpr hp))
              exact le_antisymm hle0 (hq_nn tid d)
            have h_sum_supp :
                (∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) =
                ∑ tid ∈ Supp_d, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ Supp_d)]
              intro tid _ hnot
              have hle0 : q tid d ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp (fun hp => hnot ((h_mem_supp tid).mpr hp))
              have hq0 : q tid d = 0 := le_antisymm hle0 (hq_nn tid d)
              simp [hq0]
            have h_pt : ∀ tid ∈ Supp_d,
                q tid d - q_D d * (p_T_of Q tid / P_d) ≤
                  q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) +
                    q tid d * Real.log P_d := by
              intro tid htid
              have hq_pos : 0 < q tid d := (h_mem_supp tid).mp htid
              have hp_pos : 0 < p_T_of Q tid := by
                refine lt_of_lt_of_le hq_pos ?_
                rw [← hq_sum tid]
                exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hq_nn tid d') (Finset.mem_univ d)
              let r : ℝ := (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d) / (q tid d * P_d)
              have hr_pos : 0 < r := div_pos (mul_pos hp_pos hqD_pos) (mul_pos hq_pos hPd_pos)
              have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hr_pos
              have h_comb_log :
                  Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) + Real.log P_d = -Real.log r := by
                have hf1_pos : 0 < q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d) :=
                  div_pos hq_pos (mul_pos hp_pos hqD_pos)
                rw [← Real.log_mul hf1_pos.ne' hPd_pos.ne']
                have h_inv : (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) * P_d = r⁻¹ := by
                  dsimp [r]
                  field_simp [hq_pos.ne', hp_pos.ne', hqD_pos.ne', hPd_pos.ne']
                rw [h_inv, Real.log_inv]
              have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith : 1 - r ≤ -Real.log r) hq_pos.le
              have h_lhs_alg : q tid d * (1 - r) = q tid d - q_D d * (p_T_of Q tid / P_d) := by
                dsimp [r]
                field_simp [hq_pos.ne', hPd_pos.ne']
              have h_rhs_alg :
                  q tid d * (Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d)) + Real.log P_d) =
                  q tid d * (-Real.log r) := by
                rw [h_comb_log]
              linarith
            have h_sum_pt := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
            have h_lhs_zero : (∑ tid ∈ Supp_d, (q tid d - q_D d * (p_T_of Q tid / P_d))) = 0 := by
              rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h_qD_supp, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div]
              change q_D d - q_D d * (P_d / P_d) = 0
              rw [div_self hPd_pos.ne', mul_one, sub_self]
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, h_qD_supp, ← h_sum_supp] at h_sum_pt
            linarith

          have h_div_kl :
              -(∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell ≤
                q_D d * (Real.log P_d / ell) := by
            rw [← mul_div_assoc]
            exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_kl_fiber hell_pos.le
          have h_step1 :
              q_D d * w_d -
                (∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell ≤
                q_D d * (w_d + Real.log P_d / ell) := by
            have h_neg :
                -(∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell =
                -((∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell) :=
              neg_div _ _
            linarith [h_div_kl, h_neg]
          exact le_trans h_step1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_wd_Pd_ub hqD_pos.le)
        · have hqD0 : q_D d = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hqD_pos) (hqD_nn d)
          have hq_all0 : ∀ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d = 0 := by
            intro tid
            have hle : q tid d ≤ q_D d :=
              Finset.single_le_sum (fun tid' _ => hq_nn tid' d) (Finset.mem_univ tid)
            exact le_antisymm (hqD0 ▸ hle) (hq_nn tid d)
          simp [hqD0, hq_all0]

      rw [hs_eq]
      have h_rearr :
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) -
            (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell =
          ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            (q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) -
              (∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := Finset.univ (α := Fin M_T)), Finset.sum_div,
          Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [h_rearr]
      calc ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            (q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) -
              (∑ tid : Fin M_T, q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T_of Q tid * q_D d))) / ell)
          ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * B_ub := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_d_bound d)
        _ = (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d) * B_ub := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = B_ub := by rw [hqD_sum, one_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ B_iso d_vel δ_cl : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hB_iso : 1 ≤ B_iso) (h_two : (2 : ℝ) ∈ ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)
    (hd₀ : 0 < d_vel) (hd₁ : d_vel < 1) (hδ_cl : 0 < δ_cl) :
    ∃ (C_alph ε₀ : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_alph ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ {M_ω M_T : ℕ} (ε : ℝ)
        (T_idx : Fin M_ω → Fin M_T)
        (V_part A_part : Fin M_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (c_val : Fin M_ω → ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_iso ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_iso) →
        (∀ ω, c_val ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        let O₁ := isoAnchoredObs ε 1 T_idx V_part A_part c_val
        let k₁ := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε 1 (c_val ω)
        let k_tp := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε (1 - d_vel) (c_val ω)
        let V_d := isoVelObs ε d_vel T_idx V_part
        (∃ S_k1 : Finset ℤ, (S_k1.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε⁻¹ ∧ ∀ ω, k₁ ω ∈ S_k1) ∧
        (∃ S_O1 : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
          (S_O1.card : ℝ) ≤ C_alph * ε ^ (-(3 : ℝ)) ∧ ∀ ω, O₁ ω ∈ S_O1) ∧
        (∃ S_OV : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
          (S_OV.card : ℝ) ≤ C_alph * ε ^ (-(5 : ℝ)) ∧ ∀ ω, (O₁ ω, V_d ω) ∈ S_OV) ∧
        (∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
          -finMutualInfo ε Q T_idx O₁ + 2 * finCondEntropy ε Q T_idx k₁ ≤
            classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part +
              classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_cl) ∧
        (∃ O_tilde : Fin M_ω → ℤ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
          (∀ ω₁ ω₂, T_idx ω₁ = T_idx ω₂ → O₁ ω₁ = O₁ ω₂ → O_tilde ω₁ = O_tilde ω₂) ∧
          (∀ ω₀ : Fin M_ω, ∃ S_pred : Finset (ℤ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
            (S_pred.card : ℝ) ≤ 36 ∧
            ∀ ω, O₁ ω = O₁ ω₀ → V_d ω = V_d ω₀ → O_tilde ω ∈ S_pred) ∧
          (∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
            2 * d_vel - finMutualInfo ε Q T_idx O_tilde + 2 * finCondEntropy ε Q T_idx k_tp ≤
              classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ M_ω M_T Q T_idx V_part A_part +
                (classicalGrowthRate γ + δ_cl) * (1 - d_vel)))

by
  let C_alph : ℝ := 2 * (4 * B_iso + 3) ^ 4
  have h4B_ge7 : (7 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * B_iso + 3 := by linarith
  have hC_alph_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_alph := by

    have hsq : (49 : ℝ) ≤ (4 * B_iso + 3) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h4 : (4 * B_iso + 3) ^ 4 = ((4 * B_iso + 3) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring

  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀_mem, hb₀_lt⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt h_ne h_inf_lt
  let B_cl : ℝ := B_iso + 4
  have hB_cl_ge5 : (5 : ℝ) ≤ B_cl := by dsimp [B_cl]; linarith
  have hB_cl_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ B_cl := by linarith
  have hB_cl_pos : (0 : ℝ) < B_cl := by linarith
  have hB_cl_inv_le_half : B_cl⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [inv_le_comm₀ hB_cl_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
    norm_num
    linarith
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt_half, h_est⟩ :=
    hb₀_mem.2.2 B_cl 1 (1 - d_vel) (δ_cl / 2) hB_cl_ge1 le_rfl (by linarith) (by linarith)
      (half_pos hδ_cl)
  refine ⟨C_alph, ε₀, hC_alph_ge1, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt_half, ?_⟩
  intro M_ω M_T ε T_idx V_part A_part c_val hε_pos hε_lt_ε₀ hVA hc
  have hε_lt_half : ε < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hε_lt_ε₀ hε₀_lt_half
  have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hε_inv_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ε⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hε_pos).mpr hε_le1
  have hε_inv_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ε⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hε_pos
  have hVA_cl : ∀ tid : Fin M_T, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl := by
    intro tid
    exact ⟨le_trans (hVA tid).1 (by dsimp [B_cl]; linarith),
      le_trans (hVA tid).2 (by dsimp [B_cl]; linarith)⟩
  have h_coord_le : ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 2), |v i| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    intro v i
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le v i

  
  have h_time_step : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u) ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-u) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ u ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u))⁻¹ ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u))⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ u := by
    intro u hu
    let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε u
    have hεu_pos : 0 < ε ^ u := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos u
    have hε_neg_u_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-u) := by
      have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith : -u ≤ (0 : ℝ))
      rwa [Real.rpow_zero] at this
    have h_pow_ge : ε ^ (-u) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      have h_nat : ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊ ≤ 2 ^ m := Nat.le_pow_clog (by omega) ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊
      have h_cast : (⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by exact_mod_cast h_nat
      exact le_trans (Nat.le_ceil _) h_cast
    have h_pow_le : (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ 2 * ε ^ (-u) := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hm_pos
      · rw [hm0]
        norm_num
        linarith
      · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hm_pos.ne'
        have hk_lt : k < Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊ := by
          change k < m
          omega
        have h2k_lt_nat : 2 ^ k < ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊ := Nat.pow_lt_of_lt_clog hk_lt
        have h2k_lt : (2 : ℝ) ^ k < ε ^ (-u) := by
          have := Nat.lt_ceil.mp h2k_lt_nat
          simpa using this
        rw [hk, pow_succ]
        linarith
    have h_ub : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ u := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le] at h_pow_ge
      exact inv_le_of_inv_le₀ hεu_pos h_pow_ge
    have h_lb : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ u ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := by
      have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
      rw [le_inv_comm₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hεu_pos) h2m_pos]
      have h_inv_eq : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ u)⁻¹ = 2 * ε ^ (-u) := by
        rw [mul_inv, Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le]
        ring
      rwa [h_inv_eq]
    exact ⟨h_pow_le, h_lb, h_ub⟩

  have h_time_div : ∀ (u₁ u₂ c : ℝ), 0 ≤ u₁ → u₁ ≤ u₂ →
      dyadicTimeBin ε u₁ c =
        (dyadicTimeBin ε u₂ c) / ((2 : ℤ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u₂ - dyadicTimeLevel ε u₁)) := by
    intro u₁ u₂ c hu₁ hu₁₂
    let m₁ := dyadicTimeLevel ε u₁
    let m₂ := dyadicTimeLevel ε u₂
    have hm_le : m₁ ≤ m₂ := by
      dsimp [m₁, m₂, dyadicTimeLevel]
      refine Nat.clog_mono_right 2 (Nat.ceil_mono ?_)
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith)
    let d := m₂ - m₁
    have hm₂_eq : m₂ = m₁ + d := (Nat.add_sub_of_le hm_le).symm
    let D : ℤ := (2 : ℤ) ^ d
    have hD_pos : 0 < D := by positivity
    have h_min_div : ∀ a b : ℤ, (min a b) / D = min (a / D) (b / D) := by
      intro a b
      rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
      · rw [min_eq_left hab, min_eq_left (Int.ediv_le_ediv hD_pos hab)]
      · rw [min_eq_right hba, min_eq_right (Int.ediv_le_ediv hD_pos hba)]
    change min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁⌋ ((2 ^ m₁ : ℤ) - 1) =
      (min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂⌋ ((2 ^ m₂ : ℤ) - 1)) / D
    rw [h_min_div]
    congr 1
    · have hD_nat : D = ((2 ^ d : ℕ) : ℤ) := (Nat.cast_pow 2 d).symm
      rw [hD_nat, ← Int.floor_div_natCast (c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂) (2 ^ d)]
      congr 1
      rw [hm₂_eq, pow_add]
      push_cast
      have h2d_ne : ((2 : ℝ) ^ d) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [h2d_ne]
    · have h_decomp : (2 ^ m₂ : ℤ) - 1 = (D - 1) + ((2 ^ m₁ : ℤ) - 1) * D := by
        dsimp [D]
        rw [hm₂_eq, pow_add]
        ring
      have hD_ge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ D := one_le_pow₀ (by omega : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2)
      have h_rem0 : (D - 1) / D = 0 :=
        Int.ediv_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [h_decomp, Int.add_mul_ediv_right _ _ hD_pos.ne', h_rem0, zero_add]

  have h_time_mid : ∀ (u c : ℝ), 0 ≤ u → c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      0 ≤ dyadicTimeBin ε u c ∧
      dyadicTimeBin ε u c < (2 ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u) : ℤ) ∧
      dyadicTimeMid ε u c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      |c - dyadicTimeMid ε u c| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ u := by
    intro u c hu ⟨hc₀, hc₁⟩
    let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε u
    let k := dyadicTimeBin ε u c
    have h2m_int_ge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 ^ m : ℤ) := one_le_pow₀ (by omega : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2)
    have h2m_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
    have hfl_nn : 0 ≤ ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hc₀ h2m_real_pos.le)
    have hk_nn : 0 ≤ k := le_min hfl_nn (by change 0 ≤ (2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1; omega)
    have hk_le_sub : k ≤ (2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 := min_le_right _ _
    have hk_lt : k < (2 ^ m : ℤ) := by omega
    have hk_real_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_nn
    have hk_real_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m - 1 := by
      have : ((k : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_le_sub
      simpa using this
    have hmid_nn : 0 ≤ dyadicTimeMid ε u c := by
      change 0 ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹
      positivity
    have hmid_le1 : dyadicTimeMid ε u c ≤ 1 := by
      change ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ ≤ 1
      rw [ ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one h2m_real_pos]
      linarith
    have h_abs_scaled : |c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      let z := c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m
      by_cases hcase : ⌊z⌋ ≤ (2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1
      · have hk_eq : k = ⌊z⌋ := min_eq_left hcase
        have h1 : (k : ℝ) ≤ z := by rw [hk_eq]; exact Int.floor_le z
        have h2 : z < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hk_eq]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one z
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · have hcase' : (2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 < ⌊z⌋ := lt_of_not_ge hcase
        have hk_eq : k = (2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1 := min_eq_right hcase'.le
        have hfl_ge : (2 ^ m : ℤ) ≤ ⌊z⌋ := by omega
        have hz_ge : (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ z := by
          have h1 : ((2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hfl_ge
          have h2 : (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) ≤ z := Int.floor_le z
          simpa using le_trans h1 h2
        have hz_le : z ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
          dsimp [z]
          nlinarith
        have hk_real_eq : (k : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m - 1 := by
          rw [hk_eq]
          push_cast
          ring
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_diff : c - dyadicTimeMid ε u c =
        (c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := by
      change c - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ = _
      have h_cancel : (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ h2m_real_pos.ne'
      calc c - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹
          = c * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := by
              rw [h_cancel, mul_one]
        _ = (c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := by ring
    have h_step_ub := (h_time_step u hu).2.2
    have h_inv_nn : 0 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr h2m_real_pos.le
    have h_err : |c - dyadicTimeMid ε u c| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ u := by
      rw [h_diff, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h_inv_nn]
      nlinarith
    exact ⟨hk_nn, hk_lt, ⟨hmid_nn, hmid_le1⟩, h_err⟩

  
  have h_real_grid : ∀ (L x : ℝ),
      ε ^ L ≤ dyadicRealStep ε L ∧
      dyadicRealStep ε L ≤ 2 * ε ^ L ∧
      0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L) ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L) ≤ ε ^ (-L) ∧
      |x - dyadicRealMid ε L x| ≤ ε ^ L := by
    intro L x
    let ℓ : ℤ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    let α : ℝ := L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)
    have hℓ_le : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ α := Int.floor_le α
    have hα_lt : α < (ℓ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one α
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h2_neg_α : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) = ε ^ L := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),
        Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε_pos]
      congr 1
      dsimp [α]
      rw [Real.log_inv]
      field_simp [hlog2_pos.ne']
    have h_step_rpow : dyadicRealStep ε L = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((-ℓ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [dyadicRealStep, ℓ]
      rw [Real.rpow_intCast]
    have h_step_lb : ε ^ L ≤ dyadicRealStep ε L := by
      rw [← h2_neg_α, h_step_rpow]
      refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) ?_
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_step_ub : dyadicRealStep ε L ≤ 2 * ε ^ L := by
      have h2_1mα : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - α) = 2 * ε ^ L := by
        have h_split : (1 : ℝ) - α = 1 + (-α) := by ring
        rw [h_split, Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), Real.rpow_one, h2_neg_α]
      rw [← h2_1mα, h_step_rpow]
      refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) ?_
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h2ℓ_pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) ℓ
    have h2ℓ_ub : (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ ≤ ε ^ (-L) := by
      have h_inv_step : (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ = (dyadicRealStep ε L)⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [dyadicRealStep, ℓ]
        rw [zpow_neg, inv_inv]
      rw [h_inv_step, Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le]
      exact inv_anti₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos L) h_step_lb
    have h_mid_err : |x - dyadicRealMid ε L x| ≤ ε ^ L := by
      let b : ℤ := dyadicRealBin ε L x
      have hb_le : (b : ℝ) ≤ x * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := Int.floor_le _
      have hb_lt : x * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ < (b : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h_abs_half : |x * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ - ((b : ℝ) + 1 / 2)| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have h_prod : (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * dyadicRealStep ε L = 1 := by
        dsimp [dyadicRealStep, ℓ]
        rw [zpow_neg]
        exact mul_inv_cancel₀ h2ℓ_pos.ne'
      have h_diff_eq : x - dyadicRealMid ε L x =
          (x * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ - ((b : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * dyadicRealStep ε L := by
        change x - ((b : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L = _
        calc x - ((b : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L
            = x * ((2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * dyadicRealStep ε L) -
                ((b : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L := by
                rw [h_prod, mul_one]
          _ = (x * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ - ((b : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) * dyadicRealStep ε L := by ring
      have h_step_nn : 0 ≤ dyadicRealStep ε L :=
        le_trans (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le L) h_step_lb
      rw [h_diff_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h_step_nn]
      nlinarith
    exact ⟨h_step_lb, h_step_ub, h2ℓ_pos, h2ℓ_ub, h_mid_err⟩

  
  let I_box : ℝ → ℝ → Finset ℤ := fun L R =>
    let K : ℕ := ⌈R * ε ^ (-L)⌉₊
    Finset.Icc (-(K : ℤ)) (K : ℤ)
  have hI_box : ∀ (L R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
      ((I_box L R).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * R * ε ^ (-L) + 3 ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ, |y| ≤ R → dyadicRealBin ε L y ∈ I_box L R := by
    intro L R hR
    let K : ℕ := ⌈R * ε ^ (-L)⌉₊
    have h_card : ((I_box L R).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * R * ε ^ (-L) + 3 := by
      have hc_eq : (I_box L R).card = 2 * K + 1 := by
        dsimp [I_box, K]
        rw [Int.card_Icc]
        have h_int : (K : ℤ) + 1 - -(K : ℤ) = ((2 * K + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h_int, Int.toNat_natCast]
      have hK_ub : (K : ℝ) ≤ R * ε ^ (-L) + 1 :=
        (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (mul_nonneg hR (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le (-L)))).le
      have hc_real : ((I_box L R).card : ℝ) = 2 * (K : ℝ) + 1 := by
        rw [hc_eq]
        push_cast
        ring
      linarith
    refine ⟨h_card, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_, _, h2ℓ_pos, h2ℓ_ub, _⟩ := h_real_grid L y
    let ℓ := dyadicRealLevel ε L
    have h_prod_abs : |y * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ| ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h2ℓ_pos]
      calc |y| * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ ≤ R * ε ^ (-L) :=
            mul_le_mul hy h2ℓ_ub h2ℓ_pos.le hR
        _ ≤ (K : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    obtain ⟨h_lo_r, h_hi_r⟩ := abs_le.mp h_prod_abs
    dsimp [I_box, dyadicRealBin]
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
      simpa using h_lo_r
    · have h_lt : ⌊y * (2 : ℝ) ^ ℓ⌋ < (K : ℤ) + 1 := by
        refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
        push_cast
        linarith
      exact Int.lt_add_one_iff.mp h_lt

  intro O₁ k₁ k_tp V_d
  let m₁ := dyadicTimeLevel ε 1
  let S_k1 : Finset ℤ := Finset.Ico 0 (2 ^ m₁ : ℤ)
  have hS_k1_card_2 : (S_k1.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε⁻¹ := by
    have hc_eq : S_k1.card = 2 ^ m₁ := by
      dsimp [S_k1]
      rw [Int.card_Ico]
      have h_int : (2 ^ m₁ : ℤ) - 0 = ((2 ^ m₁ : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_int, Int.toNat_natCast]
    have h2m1 := (h_time_step 1 zero_le_one).1
    rw [Real.rpow_neg_one] at h2m1
    have hc_real : (S_k1.card : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ := by rw [hc_eq]; push_cast; rfl
    rwa [hc_real]
  have hS_k1_mem : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, k₁ ω ∈ S_k1 := by
    intro ω
    obtain ⟨hk_nn, hk_lt, _, _⟩ := h_time_mid 1 (c_val ω) zero_le_one (hc ω)

  let S_O1 : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=
    S_k1 ×ˢ (I_box 1 (2 * B_iso) ×ˢ I_box 1 (2 * B_iso))
  have hI1_card : ((I_box 1 (2 * B_iso)).card : ℝ) ≤ (4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹ := by
    have h1 := (hI_box 1 (2 * B_iso) (by linarith)).1
    rw [Real.rpow_neg_one] at h1
    nlinarith
  have hS_O1_card_sharp : (S_O1.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (4 * B_iso + 3) ^ 2 * (ε⁻¹) ^ 3 := by
    have hc : (S_O1.card : ℝ) =
        (S_k1.card : ℝ) * (((I_box 1 (2 * B_iso)).card : ℝ) * ((I_box 1 (2 * B_iso)).card : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [S_O1]
      simp only [Finset.card_product, Nat.cast_mul]
    rw [hc]
    have h_prod1 :
        ((I_box 1 (2 * B_iso)).card : ℝ) * ((I_box 1 (2 * B_iso)).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹) * ((4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul hI1_card hI1_card (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    calc (S_k1.card : ℝ) * (((I_box 1 (2 * B_iso)).card : ℝ) * ((I_box 1 (2 * B_iso)).card : ℝ))
        ≤ (2 * ε⁻¹) * (((4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹) * ((4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹)) :=
          mul_le_mul hS_k1_card_2 h_prod1 (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = 2 * (4 * B_iso + 3) ^ 2 * (ε⁻¹) ^ 3 := by ring
  have hS_O1_card : (S_O1.card : ℝ) ≤ C_alph * ε ^ (-(3 : ℝ)) := by
    have h_rpow3 : ε ^ (-(3 : ℝ)) = (ε⁻¹) ^ 3 := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le, show (3 : ℝ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num,
        Real.rpow_natCast, inv_pow]
    rw [h_rpow3]
    refine le_trans hS_O1_card_sharp ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
    dsimp [C_alph]
    have h_sq_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (4 * B_iso + 3) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have hS_O1_mem : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, O₁ ω ∈ S_O1 := by
    intro ω
    obtain ⟨_, _, ⟨hmid0, hmid1⟩, _⟩ := h_time_mid 1 (c_val ω) zero_le_one (hc ω)
    let tid := T_idx ω
    let x₁ := A_part tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε 1 (c_val ω)) • V_part tid
    have hx₁_bd : ∀ i : Fin 2, |x₁ i| ≤ 2 * B_iso := by
      intro i
      have h_eq : x₁ i = A_part tid i + dyadicTimeMid ε 1 (c_val ω) * V_part tid i := by
        simp [x₁]
      rw [h_eq]
      have hA_i : |A_part tid i| ≤ B_iso := le_trans (h_coord_le _ i) (hVA tid).2
      have hV_i : |V_part tid i| ≤ B_iso := le_trans (h_coord_le _ i) (hVA tid).1
      calc |A_part tid i + dyadicTimeMid ε 1 (c_val ω) * V_part tid i|
          ≤ |A_part tid i| + |dyadicTimeMid ε 1 (c_val ω) * V_part tid i| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |A_part tid i| + dyadicTimeMid ε 1 (c_val ω) * |V_part tid i| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hmid0]
        _ ≤ B_iso + 1 * B_iso := by
            gcongr
        _ = 2 * B_iso := by ring
    dsimp [S_O1, O₁, isoAnchoredObs]
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hS_k1_mem ω,
      Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨(hI_box 1 (2 * B_iso) (by linarith)).2 _ (hx₁_bd 0),
         (hI_box 1 (2 * B_iso) (by linarith)).2 _ (hx₁_bd 1)⟩⟩

  let S_OV : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
    S_O1 ×ˢ (I_box d_vel B_iso ×ˢ I_box d_vel B_iso)
  have hId_card : ((I_box d_vel B_iso).card : ℝ) ≤ (4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹ := by
    have h1 := (hI_box d_vel B_iso (by linarith)).1
    have h_rpow_le : ε ^ (-d_vel) ≤ ε⁻¹ := by
      have h2 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith : -(1 : ℝ) ≤ -d_vel)
      rwa [Real.rpow_neg_one] at h2
    nlinarith
  have hS_OV_card : (S_OV.card : ℝ) ≤ C_alph * ε ^ (-(5 : ℝ)) := by
    have h_rpow5 : ε ^ (-(5 : ℝ)) = (ε⁻¹) ^ 5 := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le, show (5 : ℝ) = ((5 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num,
        Real.rpow_natCast, inv_pow]
    rw [h_rpow5]
    have hc : (S_OV.card : ℝ) =
        (S_O1.card : ℝ) * (((I_box d_vel B_iso).card : ℝ) * ((I_box d_vel B_iso).card : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [S_OV]
      simp only [Finset.card_product, Nat.cast_mul]
    rw [hc]
    have h_prod2 :
        ((I_box d_vel B_iso).card : ℝ) * ((I_box d_vel B_iso).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹) * ((4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul hId_card hId_card (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    calc (S_O1.card : ℝ) * (((I_box d_vel B_iso).card : ℝ) * ((I_box d_vel B_iso).card : ℝ))
        ≤ (2 * (4 * B_iso + 3) ^ 2 * (ε⁻¹) ^ 3) *
            (((4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹) * ((4 * B_iso + 3) * ε⁻¹)) :=
          mul_le_mul hS_O1_card_sharp h_prod2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = C_alph * (ε⁻¹) ^ 5 := by dsimp [C_alph]; ring
  have hS_OV_mem : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, (O₁ ω, V_d ω) ∈ S_OV := by
    intro ω
    have hV0 : |V_part (T_idx ω) 0| ≤ B_iso := le_trans (h_coord_le _ 0) (hVA (T_idx ω)).1
    have hV1 : |V_part (T_idx ω) 1| ≤ B_iso := le_trans (h_coord_le _ 1) (hVA (T_idx ω)).1
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hS_O1_mem ω,
      Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨(hI_box d_vel B_iso (by linarith)).2 _ hV0,
         (hI_box d_vel B_iso (by linarith)).2 _ hV1⟩⟩

  
  have h_bridge : ∀ {β_Obs : Type} (b_shape a_shape : ℝ)
      (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (k_time : Fin M_ω → ℤ) (Obs : Fin M_ω → β_Obs),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      ∃ G_idx : Fin M_ω → Fin M_ω,
        (∀ ω : Fin M_ω, Obs (G_idx ω) = Obs ω) ∧
        classicalTransportScore ε γ M_ω M_T M_ω Q T_idx k_time G_idx
            (fun _ => b_shape) (fun _ => a_shape) =
          ((1 + γ) * b_shape + (1 - γ) * a_shape) -
            finMutualInfo ε Q T_idx Obs +
            2 * finCondEntropy ε Q T_idx k_time := by
    intro β_Obs b_shape a_shape Q k_time Obs hQ_nn hQ_sum
    classical
    let F_obs : Fin M_ω → Finset (Fin M_ω) := fun ω =>
      Finset.univ.filter (fun ω' : Fin M_ω => Obs ω' = Obs ω)
    have hF_ne : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, (F_obs ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
      ⟨ω, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, rfl⟩⟩
    let G_idx : Fin M_ω → Fin M_ω := fun ω => (F_obs ω).min' (hF_ne ω)
    have hG_obs : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, Obs (G_idx ω) = Obs ω := fun ω =>
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.min'_mem (F_obs ω) (hF_ne ω))).2
    have hG_iff : ∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin M_ω, G_idx ω₁ = G_idx ω₂ ↔ Obs ω₁ = Obs ω₂ := by
      intro ω₁ ω₂
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [← hG_obs ω₁, ← hG_obs ω₂, h]
      · intro h
        have h1 : G_idx ω₁ ≤ G_idx ω₂ := by
          refine Finset.min'_le (F_obs ω₁) (G_idx ω₂) ?_
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (hG_obs ω₂).trans h.symm⟩
        have h2 : G_idx ω₂ ≤ G_idx ω₁ := by
          refine Finset.min'_le (F_obs ω₂) (G_idx ω₁) ?_
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (hG_obs ω₁).trans h⟩
        exact le_antisymm h1 h2
    refine ⟨G_idx, hG_obs, ?_⟩
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    let p_T : Fin M_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then Q ω else 0
    let p_G : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun g => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if G_idx ω = g then Q ω else 0
    let p_TG : Fin M_T → Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun tid g =>
      ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then Q ω else 0
    let S_cells : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image k_time
    let p_TC : Fin M_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
      ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then Q ω else 0
    have hpG_sum : ∑ g : Fin M_ω, p_G g = 1 := by
      dsimp [p_G]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      calc ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, ∑ g : Fin M_ω, (if G_idx ω = g then Q ω else 0)
          = ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq])
        _ = 1 := hQ_sum
    have hE_w : ∑ g : Fin M_ω, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_shape + (1 - γ) * a_shape) =
        (1 + γ) * b_shape + (1 - γ) * a_shape := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hpG_sum, one_mul]
    have h_prob_T : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, finProbAt Q T_idx ω = p_T (T_idx ω) := by
      intro ω
      dsimp [finProbAt, p_T]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    have h_prob_TC : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω = p_TC (T_idx ω) (k_time ω) := by
      intro ω
      dsimp [finProbAt2, p_TC]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    have h_prob_unit : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 := by
      intro ω
      dsimp [finProbAt]
      simpa using hQ_sum
    have h_prob_G : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω = p_G (G_idx ω) := by
      intro ω
      dsimp [finProbAt2, p_G]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      simp [← hG_iff]
    have h_prob_TG : ∀ ω : Fin M_ω, finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω = p_TG (T_idx ω) (G_idx ω) := by
      intro ω
      dsimp [finProbAt2, p_TG]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      simp [← hG_iff]
    have hS_t : (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
        -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) / ell =
        finCondEntropy ε Q T_idx k_time := by
      have h_cell : ∀ (tid : Fin M_T) (k : ℤ),
          -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid)) =
            ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
              if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then
                -(Q ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω))
              else 0 := by
        intro tid k
        dsimp [p_TC]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases h : T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k
        · obtain ⟨ht, hk⟩ := h
          simp only [ht, hk, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [h_prob_TC ω, h_prob_T ω, ht, hk]
        · simp [h]
      have h_num : (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
          -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) =
          ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
            -(Q ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) := by
        simp_rw [h_cell]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        calc ∑ k ∈ S_cells, ∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
              (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then
                -(Q ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) else 0)
            = ∑ k ∈ S_cells, ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, ∑ tid : Fin M_T,
              (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then
                -(Q ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
          _ = ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, ∑ k ∈ S_cells, ∑ tid : Fin M_T,
              (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then
                -(Q ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_comm
          _ = ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
              -(Q ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
              have hk_in : k_time ω ∈ S_cells :=
                Finset.mem_image_of_mem k_time (Finset.mem_univ ω)
              have h_inner : ∀ k : ℤ,
                  (∑ tid : Fin M_T,
                    if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then
                      -(Q ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω))
                    else 0) =
                  if k_time ω = k then
                    -(Q ω * Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx k_time ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω))
                  else 0 := by
                intro k
                by_cases hk : k_time ω = k
                · simp [hk, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
                · simp [hk]
              simp_rw [h_inner]
              simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hk_in]
      rw [h_num, Finset.sum_div]
      dsimp [finCondEntropy, condSurprise, ell]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      ring
    have hI_TG : (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ g : Fin M_ω,
        p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell =
        finMutualInfo ε Q T_idx Obs := by
      have h_log_split : ∀ (tid : Fin M_T) (g : Fin M_ω),
          p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g)) =
            p_TG tid g * (-Real.log (p_G g) + Real.log (p_TG tid g / p_T tid)) := by
        intro tid g
        by_cases hp0 : p_TG tid g = 0
        · simp [hp0]
        · have hp_nn : 0 ≤ p_TG tid g :=
            Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> linarith [hQ_nn ω])
          have hp_pos : 0 < p_TG tid g := lt_of_le_of_ne hp_nn (Ne.symm hp0)
          have hp_le_T : p_TG tid g ≤ p_T tid :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => by
              by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases hg : G_idx ω = g <;> simp [ht, hg, hQ_nn ω])
          have hp_le_G : p_TG tid g ≤ p_G g :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => by
              by_cases ht : T_idx ω = tid <;> by_cases hg : G_idx ω = g <;> simp [ht, hg, hQ_nn ω])
          have hpT_pos : 0 < p_T tid := lt_of_lt_of_le hp_pos hp_le_T
          have hpG_pos : 0 < p_G g := lt_of_lt_of_le hp_pos hp_le_G
          have hdiv_pos : 0 < p_TG tid g / p_T tid := div_pos hp_pos hpT_pos
          rw [← div_div, Real.log_div hdiv_pos.ne' hpG_pos.ne']
          ring
      have h_cell2 : ∀ (tid : Fin M_T) (g : Fin M_ω),
          p_TG tid g * (-Real.log (p_G g) + Real.log (p_TG tid g / p_T tid)) =
            ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
              if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then
                Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω / finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω) +
                  Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω))
              else 0 := by
        intro tid g
        dsimp [p_TG]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases h : T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g
        · obtain ⟨ht, hg⟩ := h
          simp only [ht, hg, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [h_prob_G ω, h_prob_unit ω, div_one, h_prob_TG ω, h_prob_T ω, ht, hg]
        · simp [h]
      have h_num2 : (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ g : Fin M_ω,
          p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) =
          ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
            Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω / finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω) +
              Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) := by
        simp_rw [h_log_split, h_cell2]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        calc ∑ g : Fin M_ω, ∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
              (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then
                Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω / finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω) +
                  Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) else 0)
            = ∑ g : Fin M_ω, ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, ∑ tid : Fin M_T,
              (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then
                Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω / finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω) +
                  Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
          _ = ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, ∑ g : Fin M_ω, ∑ tid : Fin M_T,
              (if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then
                Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω / finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω) +
                  Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_comm
          _ = ∑ ω : Fin M_ω,
              Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω / finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω) +
                Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω)) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
              have h_inner : ∀ g : Fin M_ω,
                  (∑ tid : Fin M_T,
                    if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then
                      Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω /
                          finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω) +
                        Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω))
                    else 0) =
                  if G_idx ω = g then
                    Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Obs ω /
                        finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω) +
                      Real.log (finProbAt2 Q T_idx Obs ω / finProbAt Q T_idx ω))
                  else 0 := by
                intro g
                by_cases hg : G_idx ω = g
                · simp [hg, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
                · simp [hg]
              simp_rw [h_inner]
              simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      rw [h_num2, Finset.sum_div]
      unfold finMutualInfo finCondEntropy condSurprise
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      dsimp [ell]
      ring
    change (∑ g : Fin M_ω, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_shape + (1 - γ) * a_shape)) -
        (∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ g : Fin M_ω,
          p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell +
        2 * ((∑ tid : Fin M_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
          -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) / ell) = _
    rw [hE_w, hI_TG, hS_t]

  
  let e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
