  have he₀_norm : ‖e₀‖ = 1 := by

      simp [e₀]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg e₀]
  have he₀_inner0 : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ w e₀ = w 0 := by

  have he₀_inner1 : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ w (perp2D e₀) = w 1 := by

  let Δ₁ : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε 1))⁻¹
  let Δ_tp : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε (1 - d_vel)))⁻¹
  have hΔ₁_lb : B_cl⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ Δ₁ :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB_cl_inv_le_half (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
      (h_time_step 1 zero_le_one).2.1
  have hΔ₁_ub : Δ₁ ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
    calc Δ₁ ≤ 1 * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [one_mul]; exact (h_time_step 1 zero_le_one).2.2
      _ ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB_cl_ge1 (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
  have hΔ_tp_lb : B_cl⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 - d_vel) ≤ Δ_tp :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB_cl_inv_le_half (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
      (h_time_step (1 - d_vel) (by linarith)).2.1
  have hΔ_tp_ub : Δ_tp ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (1 - d_vel) := by
    calc Δ_tp ≤ 1 * ε ^ (1 - d_vel) := by
          rw [one_mul]; exact (h_time_step (1 - d_vel) (by linarith)).2.2
      _ ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (1 - d_vel) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB_cl_ge1 (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)

  let x_tp : Fin M_ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun ω =>

  have hk1_to_ktp : ∀ ω₁ ω₂ : Fin M_ω, k₁ ω₁ = k₁ ω₂ →

    · dsimp [dyadicTimeMid]
      change ((k₁ ω₁ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * _ = ((k₁ ω₂ : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * _
      rw [hk]
    · dsimp [dyadicTimeMid]

signature.statement:
{M_ω : ℕ} {α_T α_O α_V : Type} [DecidableEq α_O] [DecidableEq α_V]
    (ε ξ K₁ C_alph F_low : ℝ)
    (π_amb μ₁ : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
    (T_idx : Fin M_ω → α_T) (k₁ : Fin M_ω → ℤ)
    (O₁ : Fin M_ω → α_O) (V_d : Fin M_ω → α_V)
    (E_allow : Finset (Fin M_ω))
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) (hξ₀ : 0 < ξ) (hξ₁ : ξ ≤ 1 / 10)
    (hK₁ : 1 ≤ K₁) (hC_alph : 1 ≤ C_alph) (hF_low : -1 ≤ F_low)

    (h_small_J : 3 * Real.log ((((⌊4 / ξ⌋₊ + 1) * (⌊6 / ξ⌋₊ + 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) /
      Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ ξ / 10)
    (h_small_keep : ε ^ ξ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let J_hom : ℕ := (⌊4 / ξ⌋₊ + 1) * (⌊6 / ξ⌋₊ + 1)
    ∃ (d_O d_OV K₀ : ℝ) (π_tilde π₀ : Fin M_ω → ℝ),
      0 ≤ d_O ∧ d_O ≤ 4 ∧ 0 ≤ d_OV ∧ d_OV ≤ 6 ∧
      1 ≤ K₀ ∧ K₀ ≤ K₁ * (100 * (J_hom : ℝ) / ξ) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  intro J_hom
  classical

  
  
  
  let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  have hε_inv_gt2 : (2 : ℝ) < ε⁻¹ := by
    rw [← inv_inv (2 : ℝ)]
    exact inv_strictAnti₀ hε₀ (by linarith only [hε₁])
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos (by linarith only [hε_inv_gt2])
  have hlog_ε : Real.log ε = -ell := by
    dsimp [ell]; rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
  have h_rpow_log : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.log (ε ^ t) = -(t * ell) := by
    intro t
    rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlog_ε]
    ring
  have h_exp_ell : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.exp (-(t * ell)) = ε ^ t := by
    intro t
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀, hlog_ε]
    congr 1; ring

  let J_O : ℕ := ⌊4 / ξ⌋₊ + 1
  let J_OV : ℕ := ⌊6 / ξ⌋₊ + 1
  have hJ_hom_eq : J_hom = J_O * J_OV := rfl
  have hJ_hom_pos_nat : 0 < J_hom := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.succ_pos _)
  have hJ_hom_pos : 0 < (J_hom : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hJ_hom_pos_nat

  
  
  
  have h_prob1 : ∀ {α : Type} (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (X : Fin M_ω → α) (ω : Fin M_ω)
      [DecidablePred (fun ω' => X ω' = X ω)],
      finProbAt Q X ω = ∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if X ω' = X ω then Q ω' else 0 := by
    intro α Q X ω _
    unfold finProbAt
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : X ω' = X ω <;> simp [h]

  have h_prob2 : ∀ {α β : Type} (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β) (ω : Fin M_ω)
      [DecidablePred (fun ω' => X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω)],
      finProbAt2 Q X Y ω = ∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then Q ω' else 0 := by
    intro α β Q X Y ω _
    unfold finProbAt2
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hy : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [hx, hy]

  have h_prob_bds : ∀ {α β : Type} (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β)
      (hQ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) (ω : Fin M_ω),
      0 ≤ finProbAt Q X ω ∧
      0 ≤ finProbAt2 Q X Y ω ∧
      Q ω ≤ finProbAt2 Q X Y ω ∧
      finProbAt2 Q X Y ω ≤ finProbAt Q X ω := by
    intro α β Q X Y hQ_nn ω
    rw [h_prob1, h_prob2]
    refine ⟨Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hQ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]),
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hQ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun ω' : Fin M_ω => if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then Q ω' else 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hQ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl]) (Finset.mem_univ ω)
      simpa using hle
    · refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases hx : X ω' = X ω <;> by_cases hy : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [hx, hy, hQ_nn ω']

  have h_prob_unit : ∀ {β : Type} (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (Y : Fin M_ω → β)
      (hQ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) (ω : Fin M_ω),
      finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω = 1 ∧
      finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Y ω = finProbAt Q Y ω := by
    intro β Q Y hQ_sum ω
    constructor
    · rw [h_prob1]
      simp [hQ_sum]
    · rw [h_prob2, h_prob1]
      simp

  have h_ent_on_pos : ∀ {α β : Type} (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β)
      (hQ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω),
      finCondEntropy ε Q X Y =
        (∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω),
          Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω))) / ell := by
    intro α β Q X Y hQ_nn
    let S_p := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
    unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
    change (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω)) / ell)) =
      (∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω))) / ell
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p), Finset.sum_div]
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
    · intro ω _ hnot
      have hQ0 : Q ω = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot (by simp [S_p, hp]))) (hQ_nn ω)
      simp [hQ0]

  have h_pos_sum : ∀ (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (hQ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) (hQ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1),
      ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω), Q ω = 1 := by
    intro Q hQ_nn hQ_sum
    rw [← hQ_sum, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)]
    intro ω _ hnot
    exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot (by simp [hp]))) (hQ_nn ω)

  
  have h_gibbs : ∀ (Q r : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
      (hQ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) (hQ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1),
      let S_p := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
      (∀ ω ∈ S_p, 0 < r ω) →
      (∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * r ω ≤ 1) →
      0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) := by
    intro Q r hQ_nn hQ_sum S_p hr_pos hr_sum
    have hSp_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω = 1 := h_pos_sum Q hQ_nn hQ_sum
    have h_pt : ∀ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω - Q ω * r ω ≤ Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) := by
      intro ω hω
      have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (hr_pos ω hω)
      have h1 : 1 - r ω ≤ -Real.log (r ω) := by linarith only [hlog]
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (hQ_nn ω)
      linarith only [h2, show Q ω * (1 - r ω) = Q ω - Q ω * r ω by ring]
    have h_le := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hSp_sum] at h_le
    linarith only [h_le, hr_sum]

  
  have h_ent_nn : ∀ {α β : Type} (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε Q X Y := by
    intro α β Q X Y hQ_nn
    rw [h_ent_on_pos Q X Y hQ_nn]
    refine div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω hω => ?_)) hell_pos.le
    have hQp : 0 < Q ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
    obtain ⟨_, _, hQ_le2, h2_le1⟩ := h_prob_bds Q X Y hQ_nn ω
    have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 Q X Y ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hQp hQ_le2
    have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt Q X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le h2_pos h2_le1
    have hlog_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω) ≤ 0 :=
      Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg h2_pos.le h1_pos.le) ((div_le_one h1_pos).mpr h2_le1)
    exact mul_nonneg hQp.le (neg_nonneg.mpr hlog_np)

  
  have h_ent_cap : ∀ {α β : Type} (N_max : ℝ) (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin M_ω → α) (Y : Fin M_ω → β) (S_Y : Finset β),
      1 ≤ N_max →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (S_Y.card : ℝ) ≤ N_max →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → Y ω ∈ S_Y) →
      finCondEntropy ε Q X Y ≤ Real.log N_max / ell := by
    intro α β N_max Q X Y S_Y hN_max hQ_nn hQ_sum hSY_card hSY_mem
    have hN_pos : 0 < N_max := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hN_max
    let S_p := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
    have hSp_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω = 1 := h_pos_sum Q hQ_nn hQ_sum
    let r : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun ω => finProbAt Q X ω / (N_max * finProbAt2 Q X Y ω)
    have hr_pos : ∀ ω ∈ S_p, 0 < r ω := by
      intro ω hω
      have hQp : 0 < Q ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
      obtain ⟨_, _, hQ_le2, h2_le1⟩ := h_prob_bds Q X Y hQ_nn ω
      have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 Q X Y ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hQp hQ_le2
      have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt Q X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le h2_pos h2_le1
      exact div_pos h1_pos (mul_pos hN_pos h2_pos)
    have hr_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * r ω ≤ 1 := by
      let I_X := S_p.image X
      let PX : α → ℝ := fun x => ∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if X ω' = x then Q ω' else 0
      have hPX_nn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ PX x :=
        fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hQ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
      have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ S_p, (X ω, Y ω) ∈ I_X ×ˢ S_Y := fun ω hω =>
        Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω, hSY_mem ω (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2⟩
      rw [(Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps (fun ω => Q ω * r ω)).symm]
      have h_cell : ∀ xy ∈ I_X ×ˢ S_Y,
          (∑ ω ∈ S_p.filter (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω) = xy), Q ω * r ω) ≤ PX xy.1 / N_max := by
        intro ⟨x, y⟩ _
        let F_xy := S_p.filter (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω) = (x, y))
        change (∑ ω ∈ F_xy, Q ω * r ω) ≤ PX x / N_max
        by_cases hne : F_xy.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
          obtain ⟨hω₀_sp, heq₀⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
          have hx₀ : X ω₀ = x := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq₀).1
          have hy₀ : Y ω₀ = y := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq₀).2
          have hQp₀ : 0 < Q ω₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_sp).2
          obtain ⟨_, _, hQ_le2₀, _⟩ := h_prob_bds Q X Y hQ_nn ω₀
          have h2_pos₀ : 0 < finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hQp₀ hQ_le2₀
          have hF_sum : ∑ ω ∈ F_xy, Q ω = finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀ := by
            rw [h_prob2, hx₀, hy₀, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
            · dsimp [F_xy]; rw [Finset.sum_filter]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
              simp only [Prod.ext_iff]
            · intro ω' _ hnot
              have hQ0 : Q ω' = 0 :=
                le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot (by simp [S_p, hp]))) (hQ_nn ω')
              simp [hQ0]
          have h_congr : ∑ ω ∈ F_xy, Q ω * r ω =
              ∑ ω ∈ F_xy, Q ω * (PX x / (N_max * finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
            have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            have hx : X ω = x := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
            have hy : Y ω = y := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2
            have h1_eq : finProbAt Q X ω = PX x := by
              rw [h_prob1, hx]
            have h2_eq : finProbAt2 Q X Y ω = finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀ := by
              rw [h_prob2, h_prob2, hx, hy, hx₀, hy₀]
            dsimp [r]; rw [h1_eq, h2_eq]
          rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul, hF_sum]
          have h_eq : finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀ * (PX x / (N_max * finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀)) =
              PX x / N_max := by
            field_simp [hN_pos.ne', h2_pos₀.ne']
          exact h_eq.le
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
          exact div_nonneg (hPX_nn x) hN_pos.le
      have h_tot_x : ∑ x ∈ I_X, PX x = 1 := by
        dsimp [PX]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_p)]
        · have h1 : ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, ∑ x ∈ I_X, (if X ω' = x then Q ω' else 0) = ∑ ω' ∈ S_p, Q ω' := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
            have hx_in : X ω' ∈ I_X := Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω'
            simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hx_in]
          rw [h1]; exact hSp_sum
        · intro ω' _ hnot
          have hQ0 : Q ω' = 0 :=
            le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot (by simp [S_p, hp]))) (hQ_nn ω')
          simp [hQ0]
      calc ∑ xy ∈ I_X ×ˢ S_Y, ∑ ω ∈ S_p.filter (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω) = xy), Q ω * r ω
          ≤ ∑ xy ∈ I_X ×ˢ S_Y, PX xy.1 / N_max := Finset.sum_le_sum h_cell
        _ = ∑ x ∈ I_X, ∑ _y ∈ S_Y, PX x / N_max := by rw [Finset.sum_product]
        _ = ∑ x ∈ I_X, (S_Y.card : ℝ) * (PX x / N_max) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
            simp
        _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ I_X, N_max * (PX x / N_max) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ =>
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSY_card (div_nonneg (hPX_nn x) hN_pos.le))
        _ = ∑ x ∈ I_X, PX x :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => mul_div_cancel₀ (PX x) hN_pos.ne')
        _ = 1 := h_tot_x
    have h_gb := h_gibbs Q r hQ_nn hQ_sum hr_pos hr_sum
    have h_ident : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) =
        Real.log N_max - ell * finCondEntropy ε Q X Y := by
      rw [h_ent_on_pos Q X Y hQ_nn, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hell_pos.ne']
      have h_lhs : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log (r ω)) =
          (∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * Real.log N_max) -
            ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω)) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hQp : 0 < Q ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        obtain ⟨_, _, hQ_le2, h2_le1⟩ := h_prob_bds Q X Y hQ_nn ω
        have h2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 Q X Y ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hQp hQ_le2
        have h1_pos : 0 < finProbAt Q X ω := lt_of_lt_of_le h2_pos h2_le1
        have hq_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω := div_pos h2_pos h1_pos
        have hr_eq : r ω = (N_max * (finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω))⁻¹ := by
          dsimp [r]; field_simp [hN_pos.ne', h1_pos.ne', h2_pos.ne']
        rw [hr_eq, Real.log_inv, Real.log_mul hN_pos.ne' hq_pos.ne']
        ring
      rw [h_lhs, ← Finset.sum_mul, hSp_sum, one_mul]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hell_pos]
    linarith only [h_gb, h_ident, show finCondEntropy ε Q X Y * ell = ell * finCondEntropy ε Q X Y by ring]

  
  have h_uncond_lb : ∀ {β : Type} (M_hi : ℝ) (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (Y : Fin M_ω → β),
      0 < M_hi → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → finProbAt Q Y ω ≤ M_hi) →
      -Real.log M_hi / ell ≤ finCondEntropy ε Q (fun _ => ()) Y := by
    intro β M_hi Q Y _hM_hi hQ_nn hQ_sum h_ub
    let S_p := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
    have hSp_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω = 1 := h_pos_sum Q hQ_nn hQ_sum
    rw [h_ent_on_pos Q (fun _ => ()) Y hQ_nn, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos]
    calc -Real.log M_hi
        = (∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω) * (-Real.log M_hi) := by rw [hSp_sum, one_mul]
      _ = ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log M_hi) := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Y ω / finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => ?_)
          have hQp : 0 < Q ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
          obtain ⟨hu1, hu2⟩ := h_prob_unit Q Y hQ_sum ω
          rw [hu1, hu2, div_one]
          obtain ⟨_, _, hQ_le2, h2_le1⟩ := h_prob_bds Q Y Y hQ_nn ω
          have hY_pos : 0 < finProbAt Q Y ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hQp (le_trans hQ_le2 h2_le1)
          have hlog := Real.log_le_log hY_pos (h_ub ω hQp)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_neg hlog) hQp.le

  have h_uncond_ub : ∀ {β : Type} (m_lo : ℝ) (Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ) (Y : Fin M_ω → β),
      0 < m_lo → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → m_lo ≤ finProbAt Q Y ω) →
      finCondEntropy ε Q (fun _ => ()) Y ≤ -Real.log m_lo / ell := by
    intro β m_lo Q Y hm_lo hQ_nn hQ_sum h_lb
    let S_p := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
    have hSp_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω = 1 := h_pos_sum Q hQ_nn hQ_sum
    rw [h_ent_on_pos Q (fun _ => ()) Y hQ_nn, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos]
    calc ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q (fun _ => ()) Y ω / finProbAt Q (fun _ => ()) ω))
        ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω * (-Real.log m_lo) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => ?_)
          have hQp : 0 < Q ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
          obtain ⟨hu1, hu2⟩ := h_prob_unit Q Y hQ_sum ω
          rw [hu1, hu2, div_one]
          have hlog := Real.log_le_log hm_lo (h_lb ω hQp)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_neg hlog) hQp.le
      _ = (∑ ω ∈ S_p, Q ω) * (-Real.log m_lo) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
      _ = -Real.log m_lo := by rw [hSp_sum, one_mul]

  
  have h_part_avg : ∀ {N_Z : ℕ} {γ_A γ_B : Type}
      (Z : Fin M_ω → Fin N_Z) (A : Fin M_ω → γ_A) (B : Fin M_ω → γ_B),
      let p_Z : Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z ω = z then μ₁ ω else 0
      let μ_z : Fin N_Z → Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun z ω => if Z ω = z then μ₁ ω / p_Z z else 0
      (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (μ_z z) A B else 0) =
        finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun ω => (Z ω, A ω)) B := by
    intro N_Z γ_A γ_B Z A B p_Z μ_z
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [(Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ Z
      (fun ω => μ₁ ω * condSurprise ε μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', A ω')) B ω)).symm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
    let F_z := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z)
    change (if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, μ_z z ω * condSurprise ε (μ_z z) A B ω) else 0) =
      ∑ ω ∈ F_z, μ₁ ω * condSurprise ε μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', A ω')) B ω
    by_cases hz : 0 < p_Z z
    · rw [if_pos hz, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ F_z)]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hZω : Z ω = z := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        have h_wt : p_Z z * μ_z z ω = μ₁ ω := by
          dsimp [μ_z]; rw [if_pos hZω, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hz.ne']
        have hp1 : finProbAt (μ_z z) A ω = finProbAt μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', A ω')) ω / p_Z z := by
          rw [h_prob1, h_prob1, Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          dsimp [μ_z]
          by_cases hZ' : Z ω' = z <;> by_cases hA' : A ω' = A ω <;>
            simp [Prod.ext_iff, hZω, hZ', hA']
        have hp2 : finProbAt2 (μ_z z) A B ω = finProbAt2 μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', A ω')) B ω / p_Z z := by
          rw [h_prob2, h_prob2, Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          dsimp [μ_z]
          by_cases hZ' : Z ω' = z <;> by_cases hA' : A ω' = A ω <;>
            by_cases hB' : B ω' = B ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, hZω, hZ', hA', hB']
        have h_cs : condSurprise ε (μ_z z) A B ω =
            condSurprise ε μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', A ω')) B ω := by
          unfold condSurprise
          rw [hp2, hp1, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hz.ne']
        rw [← mul_assoc, h_wt, h_cs]
      · intro ω _ hnot
        have hZne : Z ω ≠ z := fun heq => hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, heq⟩)
        dsimp [μ_z]; rw [if_neg hZne]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hz]
      have hpZ_eq : p_Z z = ∑ ω ∈ F_z, μ₁ ω := by
        dsimp [p_Z, F_z]; rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      have hpZ_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ F_z, μ₁ ω := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hμ_nn ω)
      have hpZ_zero : ∑ ω ∈ F_z, μ₁ ω = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (by linarith only [le_of_not_gt hz, hpZ_eq]) hpZ_nn
      have h_zero_all := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun ω _ => hμ_nn ω)).mp hpZ_zero
      symm
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω hω => ?_)
      rw [h_zero_all ω hω, zero_mul]

  
  have h_part_score : ∀ {N_Z : ℕ} (hNZ : 1 ≤ N_Z) (Z : Fin M_ω → Fin N_Z),
      let p_Z : Fin N_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z ω = z then μ₁ ω else 0
      let μ_z : Fin N_Z → Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun z ω => if Z ω = z then μ₁ ω / p_Z z else 0
      (-finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun _ => ()) O₁ + 3 * finCondEntropy ε μ₁ T_idx k₁) -
        3 * Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / ell ≤
        ∑ z : Fin N_Z,
          if 0 < p_Z z then
            p_Z z * (-finCondEntropy ε (μ_z z) (fun _ => ()) O₁ +
              3 * finCondEntropy ε (μ_z z) T_idx k₁)
          else 0 := by
    intro N_Z hNZ Z p_Z μ_z
    let S_μ := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < μ₁ ω)
    have hSμ_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_μ, μ₁ ω = 1 := h_pos_sum μ₁ hμ_nn hμ_sum

    
    have h_ZO_unit : finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun ω => (Z ω, ())) O₁ = finCondEntropy ε μ₁ Z O₁ := by
      unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      have e1 : finProbAt μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', ())) ω = finProbAt μ₁ Z ω := by
        rw [h_prob1, h_prob1]; simp
      have e2 : finProbAt2 μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', ())) O₁ ω = finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω := by
        rw [h_prob2, h_prob2]; simp
      rw [e1, e2]

    have h_HO_cond : finCondEntropy ε μ₁ Z O₁ ≤ finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun _ => ()) O₁ := by
      let r_O : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
        (finProbAt μ₁ Z ω * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω) / finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω
      have hrO_pos : ∀ ω ∈ S_μ, 0 < r_O ω := by
        intro ω hω
        have hμp : 0 < μ₁ ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        obtain ⟨_, _, hle_ZO, hZO_Z⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ Z O₁ hμ_nn ω
        obtain ⟨_, _, hle_OO, hOO_O⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ O₁ O₁ hμ_nn ω
        have hZO_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp hle_ZO
        have hZ_pos : 0 < finProbAt μ₁ Z ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hZO_pos hZO_Z
        have hO_pos : 0 < finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp (le_trans hle_OO hOO_O)
        exact div_pos (mul_pos hZ_pos hO_pos) hZO_pos
      have hrO_sum : ∑ ω ∈ S_μ, μ₁ ω * r_O ω ≤ 1 := by
        let I_O := S_μ.image O₁
        let PO : α_O → ℝ := fun o => ∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω' = o then μ₁ ω' else 0
        have hpZ_nn : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p_Z z :=
          fun z => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hμ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
        have hPO_nn : ∀ o, 0 ≤ PO o :=
          fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hμ_nn ω'; exact le_rfl])
        have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ S_μ, (Z ω, O₁ ω) ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_Z)) ×ˢ I_O :=
          fun ω hω => Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_image_of_mem O₁ hω⟩
        rw [(Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps (fun ω => μ₁ ω * r_O ω)).symm]
        have h_cell : ∀ zo ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_Z)) ×ˢ I_O,
            (∑ ω ∈ S_μ.filter (fun ω => (Z ω, O₁ ω) = zo), μ₁ ω * r_O ω) ≤ p_Z zo.1 * PO zo.2 := by
          intro ⟨z, o⟩ _
          let F_zo := S_μ.filter (fun ω => (Z ω, O₁ ω) = (z, o))
          change (∑ ω ∈ F_zo, μ₁ ω * r_O ω) ≤ p_Z z * PO o
          by_cases hne : F_zo.Nonempty
          · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
            obtain ⟨hω₀_sp, heq₀⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
            have hz₀ : Z ω₀ = z := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq₀).1
            have ho₀ : O₁ ω₀ = o := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq₀).2
            have hμp₀ : 0 < μ₁ ω₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_sp).2
            obtain ⟨_, _, hle_ZO₀, _⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ Z O₁ hμ_nn ω₀
            have hZO_pos₀ : 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp₀ hle_ZO₀
            have hF_sum : ∑ ω ∈ F_zo, μ₁ ω = finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω₀ := by
              rw [h_prob2, hz₀, ho₀, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_μ)]
              · dsimp [F_zo]; rw [Finset.sum_filter]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
                simp only [Prod.ext_iff]
              · intro ω' _ hnot
                have h0 : μ₁ ω' = 0 :=
                  le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot (by simp [S_μ, hp]))) (hμ_nn ω')
                simp [h0]
            have h_congr : ∑ ω ∈ F_zo, μ₁ ω * r_O ω =
                ∑ ω ∈ F_zo, μ₁ ω * ((p_Z z * PO o) / finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω₀) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
              have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
              have hz : Z ω = z := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).1
              have ho : O₁ ω = o := (Prod.ext_iff.mp heq).2
              have eZ : finProbAt μ₁ Z ω = p_Z z := by rw [h_prob1, hz]
              have eO : finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω = PO o := by rw [h_prob1, ho]
              have eZO : finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω = finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω₀ := by
                rw [h_prob2, h_prob2, hz, ho, hz₀, ho₀]
              dsimp [r_O]; rw [eZ, eO, eZO]
            rw [h_congr, ← Finset.sum_mul, hF_sum, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hZO_pos₀.ne']
          · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
            exact mul_nonneg (hpZ_nn z) (hPO_nn o)
        have hpZ_tot : ∑ z : Fin N_Z, p_Z z = 1 := by
          dsimp [p_Z]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hμ_sum]
        have hPO_tot : ∑ o ∈ I_O, PO o = 1 := by
          dsimp [PO]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_μ)]
          · have h1 : ∑ ω' ∈ S_μ, ∑ o ∈ I_O, (if O₁ ω' = o then μ₁ ω' else 0) = ∑ ω' ∈ S_μ, μ₁ ω' := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' hω' => ?_)
              have ho_in : O₁ ω' ∈ I_O := Finset.mem_image_of_mem O₁ hω'
              simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, ho_in]
            rw [h1]; exact hSμ_sum
          · intro ω' _ hnot
            have h0 : μ₁ ω' = 0 :=
              le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot (by simp [S_μ, hp]))) (hμ_nn ω')
            simp [h0]
        calc ∑ zo ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_Z)) ×ˢ I_O,
                ∑ ω ∈ S_μ.filter (fun ω => (Z ω, O₁ ω) = zo), μ₁ ω * r_O ω
            ≤ ∑ zo ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_Z)) ×ˢ I_O, p_Z zo.1 * PO zo.2 :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum h_cell
          _ = ∑ z : Fin N_Z, ∑ o ∈ I_O, p_Z z * PO o := by rw [Finset.sum_product]
          _ = (∑ z : Fin N_Z, p_Z z) * (∑ o ∈ I_O, PO o) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_mul]
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm)
          _ = 1 := by rw [hpZ_tot, hPO_tot, one_mul]
      have h_gb := h_gibbs μ₁ r_O hμ_nn hμ_sum hrO_pos hrO_sum
      have h_diff : (finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun _ => ()) O₁ - finCondEntropy ε μ₁ Z O₁) * ell =
          ∑ ω ∈ S_μ, μ₁ ω * (-Real.log (r_O ω)) := by
        rw [h_ent_on_pos μ₁ (fun _ => ()) O₁ hμ_nn, h_ent_on_pos μ₁ Z O₁ hμ_nn,
          sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell_pos.ne', div_mul_cancel₀ _ hell_pos.ne',
          ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hμp : 0 < μ₁ ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        obtain ⟨hu1, hu2⟩ := h_prob_unit μ₁ O₁ hμ_sum ω
        rw [hu1, hu2, div_one]
        obtain ⟨_, _, hle_ZO, hZO_Z⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ Z O₁ hμ_nn ω
        obtain ⟨_, _, hle_OO, hOO_O⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ O₁ O₁ hμ_nn ω
        have hZO_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp hle_ZO
        have hZ_pos : 0 < finProbAt μ₁ Z ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hZO_pos hZO_Z
        have hO_pos : 0 < finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp (le_trans hle_OO hOO_O)
        have hq_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω / finProbAt μ₁ Z ω := div_pos hZO_pos hZ_pos
        have hr_div : r_O ω = finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω / (finProbAt2 μ₁ Z O₁ ω / finProbAt μ₁ Z ω) := by
          dsimp [r_O]; field_simp [hZ_pos.ne', hZO_pos.ne']
        rw [hr_div, Real.log_div hO_pos.ne' hq_pos.ne']
        ring
      have h_prod_nn : 0 ≤ (finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun _ => ()) O₁ - finCondEntropy ε μ₁ Z O₁) * ell := by
        linarith only [h_gb, h_diff]
      have h_sub_nn : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun _ => ()) O₁ - finCondEntropy ε μ₁ Z O₁ :=
        nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left h_prod_nn hell_pos
      linarith only [h_sub_nn]

    
    have h_HK_drop : finCondEntropy ε μ₁ T_idx k₁ -
        finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun ω => (Z ω, T_idx ω)) k₁ ≤
        Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / ell := by
      have h_chain : finCondEntropy ε μ₁ T_idx k₁ ≤
          finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun ω => (Z ω, T_idx ω)) k₁ +
            finCondEntropy ε μ₁ T_idx Z := by
        rw [h_ent_on_pos μ₁ T_idx k₁ hμ_nn,
          h_ent_on_pos μ₁ (fun ω => (Z ω, T_idx ω)) k₁ hμ_nn,
          h_ent_on_pos μ₁ T_idx Z hμ_nn, ← add_div,
          div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => ?_)
        have hμp : 0 < μ₁ ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
        obtain ⟨_, _, hle_ZTK, hZTK_ZT⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', T_idx ω')) k₁ hμ_nn ω
        obtain ⟨_, _, hle_TK, hTK_T⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ T_idx k₁ hμ_nn ω
        obtain ⟨_, _, hle_TZ, hTZ_T⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ T_idx Z hμ_nn ω
        have hZTK_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', T_idx ω')) k₁ ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp hle_ZTK
        have hZT_pos : 0 < finProbAt μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', T_idx ω')) ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hZTK_pos hZTK_ZT
        have hTK_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ T_idx k₁ ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp hle_TK
        have hTZ_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ T_idx Z ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp hle_TZ
        have hT_pos : 0 < finProbAt μ₁ T_idx ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hTK_pos hTK_T
        have hZT_eq_TZ : finProbAt μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', T_idx ω')) ω = finProbAt2 μ₁ T_idx Z ω := by
          rw [h_prob1, h_prob2]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          by_cases hz : Z ω' = Z ω <;> by_cases ht : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;>
            simp [Prod.ext_iff, hz, ht]
        have hZTK_le_TK : finProbAt2 μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', T_idx ω')) k₁ ω ≤
            finProbAt2 μ₁ T_idx k₁ ω := by
          rw [h_prob2, h_prob2]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          by_cases hz : Z ω' = Z ω <;> by_cases ht : T_idx ω' = T_idx ω <;>
            by_cases hk : k₁ ω' = k₁ ω <;> simp [Prod.ext_iff, hz, ht, hk, hμ_nn ω']
        let q_ZT := finProbAt2 μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', T_idx ω')) k₁ ω /
          finProbAt μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', T_idx ω')) ω
        let q_Z := finProbAt2 μ₁ T_idx Z ω / finProbAt μ₁ T_idx ω
        let q_T := finProbAt2 μ₁ T_idx k₁ ω / finProbAt μ₁ T_idx ω
        have hqZT_pos : 0 < q_ZT := div_pos hZTK_pos hZT_pos
        have hqZ_pos : 0 < q_Z := div_pos hTZ_pos hT_pos
        have h_prod_le : q_ZT * q_Z ≤ q_T := by
          have h_eq : q_ZT * q_Z =
              finProbAt2 μ₁ (fun ω' => (Z ω', T_idx ω')) k₁ ω / finProbAt μ₁ T_idx ω := by
            dsimp [q_ZT, q_Z]
            rw [hZT_eq_TZ]
            field_simp [hTZ_pos.ne', hT_pos.ne']
          rw [h_eq]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hZTK_le_TK hT_pos.le
        have hlog := Real.log_le_log (mul_pos hqZT_pos hqZ_pos) h_prod_le
        rw [Real.log_mul hqZT_pos.ne' hqZ_pos.ne'] at hlog
        have h_neg : -Real.log q_T ≤ -Real.log q_ZT + -Real.log q_Z := by linarith only [hlog]
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_neg hμp.le
        change μ₁ ω * (-Real.log q_T) ≤ μ₁ ω * (-Real.log q_ZT) + μ₁ ω * (-Real.log q_Z)
        linarith only [h_mul,
          show μ₁ ω * (-Real.log q_ZT + -Real.log q_Z) =
            μ₁ ω * (-Real.log q_ZT) + μ₁ ω * (-Real.log q_Z) by ring]
      have hNZ_real : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N_Z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hNZ
      have h_Z_cap : finCondEntropy ε μ₁ T_idx Z ≤ Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / ell :=
        h_ent_cap (N_Z : ℝ) μ₁ T_idx Z Finset.univ hNZ_real hμ_nn hμ_sum
          (by simp) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
      linarith only [h_chain, h_Z_cap]

    
    have h_avg_O := h_part_avg Z (fun _ => ()) O₁
    have h_avg_K := h_part_avg Z T_idx k₁
    dsimp only at h_avg_O h_avg_K
    rw [h_ZO_unit] at h_avg_O
    have h_rhs_eq : (∑ z : Fin N_Z,
          if 0 < p_Z z then
            p_Z z * (-finCondEntropy ε (μ_z z) (fun _ => ()) O₁ +
              3 * finCondEntropy ε (μ_z z) T_idx k₁)
          else 0) =
        -(∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (μ_z z) (fun _ => ()) O₁ else 0) +
          3 * (∑ z : Fin N_Z, if 0 < p_Z z then p_Z z * finCondEntropy ε (μ_z z) T_idx k₁ else 0) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> ring
    rw [h_rhs_eq, h_avg_O, h_avg_K]
    have h_3 : 3 * (finCondEntropy ε μ₁ T_idx k₁ -
        finCondEntropy ε μ₁ (fun ω => (Z ω, T_idx ω)) k₁) ≤
        3 * (Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / ell) := by linarith only [h_HK_drop]
    have h_3_eq : 3 * (Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / ell) = 3 * Real.log (N_Z : ℝ) / ell := by ring
    linarith only [h_HO_cond, h_3, h_3_eq]

  
  
  
  let d_O_fn : Fin J_hom → ℝ := fun j => ((finProdFinEquiv.symm j).1.val : ℝ) * ξ
  let d_OV_fn : Fin J_hom → ℝ := fun j => ((finProdFinEquiv.symm j).2.val : ℝ) * ξ

  have hd_grid_bds : ∀ j : Fin J_hom,
      0 ≤ d_O_fn j ∧ d_O_fn j ≤ 4 ∧ 0 ≤ d_OV_fn j ∧ d_OV_fn j ≤ 6 := by
    intro j
    let ij := finProdFinEquiv.symm j
    have hiO_le : ij.1.val ≤ ⌊4 / ξ⌋₊ := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp ij.1.isLt
    have hiOV_le : ij.2.val ≤ ⌊6 / ξ⌋₊ := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp ij.2.isLt
    have h1 : (ij.1.val : ℝ) ≤ 4 / ξ :=
      le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hiO_le) (Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hξ₀.le))
    have h2 : (ij.2.val : ℝ) ≤ 6 / ξ :=
      le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hiOV_le) (Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hξ₀.le))
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hξ₀.le, ?_,
      mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hξ₀.le, ?_⟩
    · calc d_O_fn j ≤ (4 / ξ) * ξ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hξ₀.le
        _ = 4 := div_mul_cancel₀ 4 hξ₀.ne'
    · calc d_OV_fn j ≤ (6 / ξ) * ξ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hξ₀.le
        _ = 6 := div_mul_cancel₀ 6 hξ₀.ne'

  let E_main : Finset (Fin M_ω) := E_allow.filter (fun ω =>
    0 < μ₁ ω ∧ ε ^ (4 : ℝ) ≤ finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ∧ ε ^ (6 : ℝ) ≤ finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω)
  let s_O : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun ω => -Real.log (finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω) / ell
  let s_OV : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun ω => -Real.log (finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω) / ell

  have hE_main_surp : ∀ ω ∈ E_main,
      0 < finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ∧ 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω ∧
      0 ≤ s_O ω ∧ s_O ω ≤ 4 ∧ 0 ≤ s_OV ω ∧ s_OV ω ≤ 6 ∧
      ⌊s_O ω / ξ⌋₊ < J_O ∧ ⌊s_OV ω / ξ⌋₊ < J_OV := by
    intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨_, hμp, hO_ge, hOV_ge⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
    obtain ⟨_, _, hle_OV, hOV_O⟩ := h_prob_bds μ₁ O₁ V_d hμ_nn ω
    have hOV_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hμp hle_OV
    have hO_pos : 0 < finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hOV_pos hOV_O
    have hO_le1 : finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ≤ 1 := by
      rw [h_prob1, ← hμ_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact le_rfl; exact hμ_nn ω'])
    have hOV_le1 : finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω ≤ 1 := le_trans hOV_O hO_le1
    have hsO_nn : 0 ≤ s_O ω :=
      div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_nonpos hO_pos.le hO_le1)) hell_pos.le
    have hsOV_nn : 0 ≤ s_OV ω :=
      div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_nonpos hOV_pos.le hOV_le1)) hell_pos.le
    have hsO_le4 : s_O ω ≤ 4 := by
      dsimp [s_O]; rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
      have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ 4) hO_ge
      rw [h_rpow_log 4] at hlog
      linarith only [hlog]
    have hsOV_le6 : s_OV ω ≤ 6 := by
      dsimp [s_OV]; rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
      have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ 6) hOV_ge
      rw [h_rpow_log 6] at hlog
      linarith only [hlog]
    have hiO_lt : ⌊s_O ω / ξ⌋₊ < J_O :=
      Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsO_le4 hξ₀.le))
    have hiOV_lt : ⌊s_OV ω / ξ⌋₊ < J_OV :=
      Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsOV_le6 hξ₀.le))
    exact ⟨hO_pos, hOV_pos, hsO_nn, hsO_le4, hsOV_nn, hsOV_le6, hiO_lt, hiOV_lt⟩

  let Z₂ : Fin M_ω → Fin (J_hom + 1) := fun ω =>
    if hω : ω ∈ E_main then
      (finProdFinEquiv
        (⟨⌊s_O ω / ξ⌋₊, (hE_main_surp ω hω).2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩,
         ⟨⌊s_OV ω / ξ⌋₊, (hE_main_surp ω hω).2.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩)).castSucc
    else
      Fin.last J_hom

  have hZ₂_main : ∀ (j : Fin J_hom) (ω : Fin M_ω), Z₂ ω = j.castSucc →
      ω ∈ E_allow ∧ 0 < μ₁ ω ∧
      ε ^ (d_O_fn j + ξ) ≤ finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ∧ finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ≤ ε ^ (d_O_fn j) ∧
      ε ^ (d_OV_fn j + ξ) ≤ finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω ∧ finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω ≤ ε ^ (d_OV_fn j) := by
    intro j ω hZ
    have hω_main : ω ∈ E_main := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hlast : Z₂ ω = Fin.last J_hom := dif_neg hnot
      rw [hZ] at hlast
      exact Fin.castSucc_ne_last j hlast
    obtain ⟨hω_allow, hμp, _, _⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_main
    obtain ⟨hO_pos, hOV_pos, hsO_nn, _, hsOV_nn, _, _, _⟩ := hE_main_surp ω hω_main
    have h_eq_j : finProdFinEquiv
        (⟨⌊s_O ω / ξ⌋₊, (hE_main_surp ω hω_main).2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩,
         ⟨⌊s_OV ω / ξ⌋₊, (hE_main_surp ω hω_main).2.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩) = j := by
      have h1 : Z₂ ω = j.castSucc := hZ
      dsimp only [Z₂] at h1
      rw [dif_pos hω_main] at h1
      exact Fin.castSucc_inj.mp h1
    have h_symm := congrArg finProdFinEquiv.symm h_eq_j
    rw [finProdFinEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h_symm
    have hdO_eq : d_O_fn j = (⌊s_O ω / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) * ξ := by
      dsimp [d_O_fn]; rw [← h_symm]
    have hdOV_eq : d_OV_fn j = (⌊s_OV ω / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) * ξ := by
      dsimp [d_OV_fn]; rw [← h_symm]
    have hsO_lo : d_O_fn j ≤ s_O ω := by
      rw [hdO_eq]
      have hfl := Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hsO_nn hξ₀.le)
      calc (⌊s_O ω / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) * ξ ≤ (s_O ω / ξ) * ξ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfl hξ₀.le
        _ = s_O ω := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'
    have hsO_hi : s_O ω ≤ d_O_fn j + ξ := by
      rw [hdO_eq]
      have hlt := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (s_O ω / ξ)
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlt.le hξ₀.le
      have heq1 : (s_O ω / ξ) * ξ = s_O ω := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'
      linarith only [hmul, heq1, show ((⌊s_O ω / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) * ξ = (⌊s_O ω / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) * ξ + ξ by ring]
    have hsOV_lo : d_OV_fn j ≤ s_OV ω := by
      rw [hdOV_eq]
      have hfl := Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hsOV_nn hξ₀.le)
      calc (⌊s_OV ω / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) * ξ ≤ (s_OV ω / ξ) * ξ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfl hξ₀.le
        _ = s_OV ω := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'
    have hsOV_hi : s_OV ω ≤ d_OV_fn j + ξ := by
      rw [hdOV_eq]
      have hlt := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (s_OV ω / ξ)
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlt.le hξ₀.le
      have heq1 : (s_OV ω / ξ) * ξ = s_OV ω := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hξ₀.ne'
      linarith only [hmul, heq1, show ((⌊s_OV ω / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) * ξ = (⌊s_OV ω / ξ⌋₊ : ℝ) * ξ + ξ by ring]
    have h_log_O : -( (d_O_fn j + ξ) * ell ) ≤ Real.log (finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω) ∧
        Real.log (finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω) ≤ -(d_O_fn j * ell) := by
      have h1 : d_O_fn j * ell ≤ -Real.log (finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω) := (le_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hsO_lo
      have h2 : -Real.log (finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω) ≤ (d_O_fn j + ξ) * ell := (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hsO_hi
      exact ⟨by linarith only [h2], by linarith only [h1]⟩
    have h_log_OV : -( (d_OV_fn j + ξ) * ell ) ≤ Real.log (finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω) ∧
        Real.log (finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω) ≤ -(d_OV_fn j * ell) := by
      have h1 : d_OV_fn j * ell ≤ -Real.log (finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω) := (le_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hsOV_lo
      have h2 : -Real.log (finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω) ≤ (d_OV_fn j + ξ) * ell := (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hsOV_hi
      exact ⟨by linarith only [h2], by linarith only [h1]⟩
    refine ⟨hω_allow, hμp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← h_exp_ell (d_O_fn j + ξ), ← Real.exp_log hO_pos]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_log_O.1
    · rw [← h_exp_ell (d_O_fn j), ← Real.exp_log hO_pos]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_log_O.2
    · rw [← h_exp_ell (d_OV_fn j + ξ), ← Real.exp_log hOV_pos]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_log_OV.1
    · rw [← h_exp_ell (d_OV_fn j), ← Real.exp_log hOV_pos]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_log_OV.2

  have hZ₂_tail : (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z₂ ω = Fin.last J_hom then μ₁ ω else 0) ≤ ξ / 50 := by
    let S_μ := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < μ₁ ω)
    let T_set := S_μ.filter (fun ω => Z₂ ω = Fin.last J_hom)
    let B_allow := Finset.univ \ E_allow
    let B_O := S_μ.filter (fun ω => finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω < ε ^ (4 : ℝ))
    let B_OV := S_μ.filter (fun ω => finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω < ε ^ (6 : ℝ))
    have h_tail_eq : (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z₂ ω = Fin.last J_hom then μ₁ ω else 0) =
        ∑ ω ∈ T_set, μ₁ ω := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_μ)]
      · exact (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
      · intro ω _ hnot
        have h0 : μ₁ ω = 0 :=
          le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hp => hnot (by simp [S_μ, hp]))) (hμ_nn ω)
        simp [h0]
    have h_sub : T_set ⊆ (B_allow ∪ B_O) ∪ B_OV := by
      intro ω hω
      obtain ⟨hω_sp, hZlast⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω
      have hμp : 0 < μ₁ ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_sp).2
      have hnot_main : ω ∉ E_main := by
        intro hm
        have hc : Z₂ ω = (finProdFinEquiv _).castSucc := dif_pos hm
        rw [hZlast] at hc
        exact Fin.castSucc_ne_last _ hc.symm
      by_cases ha : ω ∈ E_allow
      · by_cases ho : ε ^ (4 : ℝ) ≤ finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω
        · have hov : finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω < ε ^ (6 : ℝ) := by
            by_contra hge
            exact hnot_main (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ha, hμp, ho, le_of_not_gt hge⟩)
          exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω_sp, hov⟩)
        · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
            (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω_sp, lt_of_not_ge ho⟩))
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _
          (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, ha⟩))
    have h_union_le : ∀ (A B : Finset (Fin M_ω)),
        ∑ ω ∈ A ∪ B, μ₁ ω ≤ (∑ ω ∈ A, μ₁ ω) + (∑ ω ∈ B, μ₁ ω) := by
      intro A B
      have hui := Finset.sum_union_inter (s₁ := A) (s₂ := B) (f := μ₁)
      have hi_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ ω ∈ A ∩ B, μ₁ ω := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hμ_nn ω)
      linarith only [hui, hi_nn]
    have hB_allow : ∑ ω ∈ B_allow, μ₁ ω ≤ ξ / 100 := by
      have hsdiff := Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ E_allow) (f := μ₁)
      rw [hμ_sum] at hsdiff
      dsimp [B_allow]
      linarith only [hsdiff, h_allow]
    obtain ⟨S_O1, hSO1_card, hSO1_mem⟩ := h_alph_O1
    have hB_O : ∑ ω ∈ B_O, μ₁ ω ≤ C_alph * ε := by
      have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ B_O, O₁ ω ∈ S_O1 := fun ω _ => hSO1_mem ω
      rw [(Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps μ₁).symm]
      have h_fib : ∀ o ∈ S_O1,
          (∑ ω ∈ B_O.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), μ₁ ω) ≤ ε ^ (4 : ℝ) := by
        intro o _
        let F_o := B_O.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o)
        change (∑ ω ∈ F_o, μ₁ ω) ≤ ε ^ (4 : ℝ)
        by_cases hne : F_o.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
          obtain ⟨hω₀_BO, ho₀⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
          have hlt₀ : finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω₀ < ε ^ (4 : ℝ) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_BO).2
          have hle_prob : ∑ ω ∈ F_o, μ₁ ω ≤ finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω₀ := by
            rw [h_prob1, ho₀, ← Finset.sum_filter]
            exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
              (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2⟩)
              (fun ω _ _ => hμ_nn ω)
          exact le_trans hle_prob hlt₀.le
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
          exact Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le 4
      calc ∑ o ∈ S_O1, ∑ ω ∈ B_O.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), μ₁ ω
          ≤ ∑ _o ∈ S_O1, ε ^ (4 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib
        _ = (S_O1.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (4 : ℝ) := by simp
        _ ≤ (C_alph * ε ^ (-(3 : ℝ))) * ε ^ (4 : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSO1_card (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le 4)
        _ = C_alph * (ε ^ (-(3 : ℝ)) * ε ^ (4 : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ = C_alph * ε := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, show (-(3 : ℝ)) + (4 : ℝ) = 1 by ring, Real.rpow_one]
    obtain ⟨S_OV, hSOV_card, hSOV_mem⟩ := h_alph_OV
    have hB_OV : ∑ ω ∈ B_OV, μ₁ ω ≤ C_alph * ε := by
      have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ B_OV, (O₁ ω, V_d ω) ∈ S_OV := fun ω _ => hSOV_mem ω
      rw [(Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps μ₁).symm]
      have h_fib : ∀ pv ∈ S_OV,
          (∑ ω ∈ B_OV.filter (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω) = pv), μ₁ ω) ≤ ε ^ (6 : ℝ) := by
        intro pv _
        let F_pv := B_OV.filter (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω) = pv)
        change (∑ ω ∈ F_pv, μ₁ ω) ≤ ε ^ (6 : ℝ)
        by_cases hne : F_pv.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
          obtain ⟨hω₀_BOV, hpv₀⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀
          have hlt₀ : finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω₀ < ε ^ (6 : ℝ) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_BOV).2
          have hle_prob : ∑ ω ∈ F_pv, μ₁ ω ≤ finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω₀ := by
            rw [h_prob2, ← Finset.sum_filter]
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun ω _ _ => hμ_nn ω)
            intro ω hω
            have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
            rw [← hpv₀] at heq
            exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, Prod.ext_iff.mp heq⟩
          exact le_trans hle_prob hlt₀.le
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
          exact Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le 6
      calc ∑ pv ∈ S_OV, ∑ ω ∈ B_OV.filter (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω) = pv), μ₁ ω
          ≤ ∑ _pv ∈ S_OV, ε ^ (6 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib
        _ = (S_OV.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (6 : ℝ) := by simp
        _ ≤ (C_alph * ε ^ (-(5 : ℝ))) * ε ^ (6 : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSOV_card (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le 6)
        _ = C_alph * (ε ^ (-(5 : ℝ)) * ε ^ (6 : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ = C_alph * ε := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, show (-(5 : ℝ)) + (6 : ℝ) = 1 by ring, Real.rpow_one]
    rw [h_tail_eq]
    have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub (fun ω _ _ => hμ_nn ω)
    have h2 := h_union_le (B_allow ∪ B_O) B_OV
    have h3 := h_union_le B_allow B_O
    linarith only [h1, h2, h3, hB_allow, hB_O, hB_OV, h_small_tail]

  
  
  
  let p₂ : Fin (J_hom + 1) → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z₂ ω = z then μ₁ ω else 0
  let μ_z : Fin (J_hom + 1) → Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun z ω => if Z₂ ω = z then μ₁ ω / p₂ z else 0
  let G : (Fin M_ω → ℝ) → ℝ := fun Q =>
    -finCondEntropy ε Q (fun _ => ()) O₁ + 3 * finCondEntropy ε Q T_idx k₁

  have hp₂_nn : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p₂ z :=
    fun z => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hμ_nn ω; exact le_rfl])
  have hp₂_sum : ∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), p₂ z = 1 := by
    dsimp [p₂]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq, hμ_sum]
  have hp₂_le1 : ∀ z, p₂ z ≤ 1 := fun z => by
    rw [← hp₂_sum]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun z' _ => hp₂_nn z') (Finset.mem_univ z)
  have hμ_z_law : ∀ z, 0 < p₂ z → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ μ_z z ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, μ_z z ω = 1) := by
    intro z hz
    constructor
    · intro ω; dsimp [μ_z]; split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hμ_nn ω) hz.le
      · exact le_rfl
    · dsimp [μ_z]
      have h_eq : (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, if Z₂ ω = z then μ₁ ω / p₂ z else 0) = p₂ z / p₂ z := by
        dsimp [p₂]; rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [h_eq, div_self hz.ne']

  
  obtain ⟨S_k1, hSk1_card, hSk1_mem⟩ := h_alph_k1
  have h_G_cap : ∀ Q : Fin M_ω → ℝ, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin M_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      G Q - F_low ≤ 5 := by
    intro Q hQ_nn hQ_sum
    have hO_nn : 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε Q (fun _ => ()) O₁ := h_ent_nn Q (fun _ => ()) O₁ hQ_nn
    have h4inv_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε⁻¹ := by linarith only [hε_inv_gt2]
    have hK_cap : finCondEntropy ε Q T_idx k₁ ≤ Real.log (4 * ε⁻¹) / ell :=
      h_ent_cap (4 * ε⁻¹) Q T_idx k₁ S_k1 h4inv_ge1 hQ_nn hQ_sum hSk1_card (fun ω _ => hSk1_mem ω)
    have h_log4_eq : Real.log (4 * ε⁻¹) / ell = Real.log 4 / ell + 1 := by
      have hε_inv_pos : 0 < ε⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hε₀
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hε_inv_pos.ne', add_div]
      change Real.log 4 / ell + ell / ell = _
      rw [div_self hell_pos.ne']
    rw [h_log4_eq] at hK_cap
    dsimp [G]
    linarith only [hO_nn, hK_cap, h_small_log4, hF_low]

  let term : Fin (J_hom + 1) → ℝ := fun z =>
    if 0 < p₂ z then p₂ z * (G (μ_z z) - F_low) else 0
  have h_term_ub : ∀ z, term z ≤ 5 * p₂ z := by
    intro z
    dsimp [term]; split_ifs with hz
    · obtain ⟨h_nn, h_s⟩ := hμ_z_law z hz
      have hcap := h_G_cap (μ_z z) h_nn h_s
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcap hz.le
      linarith only [hmul, show p₂ z * 5 = 5 * p₂ z by ring]
    · exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hp₂_nn z)

  have h_term_sum_lb : -ξ / 5 ≤ ∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), term z := by
    have h_cons := h_part_score (by omega : 1 ≤ J_hom + 1) Z₂
    dsimp only at h_cons
    change G μ₁ - 3 * Real.log (((J_hom + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / ell ≤
      ∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), if 0 < p₂ z then p₂ z * G (μ_z z) else 0 at h_cons
    have hJ_small : 3 * Real.log (((J_hom + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / ell ≤ ξ / 10 := h_small_J
    have h_F_sum : (∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), if 0 < p₂ z then p₂ z * F_low else 0) = F_low := by
      have h1 : (∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), if 0 < p₂ z then p₂ z * F_low else 0) =
          ∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), p₂ z * F_low := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
        split_ifs with hz
        · rfl
        · have hp0 : p₂ z = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hz) (hp₂_nn z)
          simp [hp0]
      rw [h1, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp₂_sum, one_mul]
    have h_split_term : ∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), term z =
        (∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), if 0 < p₂ z then p₂ z * G (μ_z z) else 0) -
          (∑ z : Fin (J_hom + 1), if 0 < p₂ z then p₂ z * F_low else 0) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
      dsimp [term]; split_ifs <;> ring
    rw [h_split_term, h_F_sum]
    linarith only [h_score, h_cons, hJ_small]

  let c₂ : ℝ := ξ / (50 * (J_hom : ℝ))
  have hc₂_pos : 0 < c₂ := div_pos hξ₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hJ_hom_pos)
  let G₂ : Finset (Fin J_hom) := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin J_hom => c₂ ≤ p₂ j.castSucc)
  let G₂_bad : Finset (Fin J_hom) := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin J_hom => ¬(c₂ ≤ p₂ j.castSucc))

  have hG₂_bad_mass : ∑ j ∈ G₂_bad, p₂ j.castSucc ≤ ξ / 50 := by
    have h_le : ∑ j ∈ G₂_bad, p₂ j.castSucc ≤ ∑ _j ∈ G₂_bad, c₂ :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => le_of_not_ge (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2)
    have h_card : (G₂_bad.card : ℝ) ≤ (J_hom : ℝ) := by
      have hc : G₂_bad.card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin J_hom)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ G₂_bad)
      rw [Finset.card_fin] at hc
      exact_mod_cast hc
    calc ∑ j ∈ G₂_bad, p₂ j.castSucc
        ≤ ∑ _j ∈ G₂_bad, c₂ := h_le
      _ = (G₂_bad.card : ℝ) * c₂ := by simp
      _ ≤ (J_hom : ℝ) * c₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card hc₂_pos.le
      _ = ξ / 50 := by dsimp [c₂]; field_simp [hJ_hom_pos.ne']

  have hG₂_mass_lb : 1 / 2 ≤ ∑ j ∈ G₂, p₂ j.castSucc := by
    have h_univ := Fin.sum_univ_castSucc p₂
    rw [hp₂_sum] at h_univ
    have h_flt := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin J_hom)) (fun j => c₂ ≤ p₂ j.castSucc) (fun j => p₂ j.castSucc)
    have h_tail : p₂ (Fin.last J_hom) ≤ ξ / 50 := hZ₂_tail
    linarith only [h_univ, h_flt, hG₂_bad_mass, h_tail, hξ₁]

  have hG₂_term_lb : -2 * ξ / 5 ≤ ∑ j ∈ G₂, term j.castSucc := by
    have h_univ := Fin.sum_univ_castSucc term
    have h_flt := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin J_hom)) (fun j => c₂ ≤ p₂ j.castSucc) (fun j => term j.castSucc)
    have h_bad_ub : ∑ j ∈ G₂_bad, term j.castSucc ≤ 5 * (∑ j ∈ G₂_bad, p₂ j.castSucc) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => h_term_ub j.castSucc)
    have h_last_ub : term (Fin.last J_hom) ≤ 5 * p₂ (Fin.last J_hom) := h_term_ub (Fin.last J_hom)
    have h_tail : p₂ (Fin.last J_hom) ≤ ξ / 50 := hZ₂_tail
    linarith only [h_term_sum_lb, h_univ, h_flt, h_bad_ub, h_last_ub, hG₂_bad_mass, h_tail]

  have h_exists_star : ∃ j_star ∈ G₂, F_low - ξ ≤ G (μ_z j_star.castSucc) := by
    by_contra h_none
    push Not at h_none
    have h_pt : ∀ j ∈ G₂, term j.castSucc ≤ p₂ j.castSucc * (-ξ) := by
      intro j hj
      have hp_ge : c₂ ≤ p₂ j.castSucc := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hp_pos : 0 < p₂ j.castSucc := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₂_pos hp_ge
      have hlt : G (μ_z j.castSucc) - F_low ≤ -ξ := by linarith only [h_none j hj]
      dsimp [term]; rw [if_pos hp_pos]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlt hp_pos.le
    have h_sum_ub : ∑ j ∈ G₂, term j.castSucc ≤ (∑ j ∈ G₂, p₂ j.castSucc) * (-ξ) := by
      calc ∑ j ∈ G₂, term j.castSucc
          ≤ ∑ j ∈ G₂, p₂ j.castSucc * (-ξ) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
        _ = (∑ j ∈ G₂, p₂ j.castSucc) * (-ξ) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
    have h_half_ξ : (∑ j ∈ G₂, p₂ j.castSucc) * (-ξ) ≤ -ξ / 2 := by
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hG₂_mass_lb hξ₀.le
      linarith only [hm, show (∑ j ∈ G₂, p₂ j.castSucc) * (-ξ) = -((∑ j ∈ G₂, p₂ j.castSucc) * ξ) by ring]
    linarith only [hG₂_term_lb, h_sum_ub, h_half_ξ, hξ₀]

  obtain ⟨j_star, hj_star_G₂, hj_star_score⟩ := h_exists_star
  let d_O : ℝ := d_O_fn j_star
  let d_OV : ℝ := d_OV_fn j_star
  let p_star : ℝ := p₂ j_star.castSucc
  let π_tilde : Fin M_ω → ℝ := μ_z j_star.castSucc

  obtain ⟨hd_O_nn, hd_O_le4, hd_OV_nn, hd_OV_le6⟩ := hd_grid_bds j_star
  have hp_star_ge : c₂ ≤ p_star := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj_star_G₂).2
  have hp_star_pos : 0 < p_star := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₂_pos hp_star_ge
  have hp_star_le1 : p_star ≤ 1 := hp₂_le1 j_star.castSucc
  obtain ⟨hπt_nn, hπt_sum⟩ := hμ_z_law j_star.castSucc hp_star_pos

  have hπt_le_μ : ∀ ω, π_tilde ω ≤ p_star⁻¹ * μ₁ ω := by
    intro ω; dsimp [π_tilde, μ_z]; split_ifs
    · rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
    · exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hp_star_pos.le) (hμ_nn ω)

  have hπt_supp : ∀ ω, 0 < π_tilde ω →
      ω ∈ E_allow ∧ 0 < μ₁ ω ∧
      ε ^ (d_O + ξ) ≤ finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ∧ finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ≤ ε ^ d_O ∧
      ε ^ (d_OV + ξ) ≤ finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω ∧ finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω ≤ ε ^ d_OV := by
    intro ω hpos
    have hZ_eq : Z₂ ω = j_star.castSucc := by
      by_contra hne
      have h0 : π_tilde ω = 0 := by dsimp [π_tilde, μ_z]; rw [if_neg hne]
      linarith only [hpos, h0]
    exact hZ₂_main j_star ω hZ_eq

  
  
  
  let η_keep : ℝ := ε ^ ξ
  have hη_pos : 0 < η_keep := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ ξ
  let E₂ : Finset (Fin M_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < π_tilde ω)
  have hE₂_sum : ∑ ω ∈ E₂, π_tilde ω = 1 := h_pos_sum π_tilde hπt_nn hπt_sum
  let E_keep : Finset (Fin M_ω) :=
    E₂.filter (fun ω => η_keep * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ≤ finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω)
  let E_drop : Finset (Fin M_ω) :=
    E₂.filter (fun ω => ¬(η_keep * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ≤ finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω))

  have hE_drop_ub : ∑ ω ∈ E_drop, π_tilde ω ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    let I_drop := E_drop.image O₁
    have h_maps : ∀ ω ∈ E_drop, O₁ ω ∈ I_drop := fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem O₁ hω
    rw [(Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to h_maps π_tilde).symm]
    have h_fib : ∀ o ∈ I_drop,
        (∑ ω ∈ E_drop.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), π_tilde ω) ≤
          η_keep * (∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω' = o then μ₁ ω' else 0) := by
      intro o ho
      obtain ⟨ω_o, hω_o_drop, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ho
      have hlt : finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω_o < η_keep * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω_o :=
        lt_of_not_ge (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_o_drop).2
      have hle_pt : ∑ ω ∈ E_drop.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = O₁ ω_o), π_tilde ω ≤
          finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω_o := by
        rw [h_prob1]
        have hrhs : (∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω' = O₁ ω_o then π_tilde ω' else 0) =
            ∑ ω' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω' => O₁ ω' = O₁ ω_o), π_tilde ω' :=
          (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
        rw [hrhs]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2⟩)
          (fun ω _ _ => hπt_nn ω)
      rw [← h_prob1]
      exact le_trans hle_pt hlt.le
    have h_sum_μ_drop : ∑ o ∈ I_drop, (∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω' = o then μ₁ ω' else 0) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← hμ_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      split_ifs <;> [exact le_rfl; exact hμ_nn ω']
    calc ∑ o ∈ I_drop, ∑ ω ∈ E_drop.filter (fun ω => O₁ ω = o), π_tilde ω
        ≤ ∑ o ∈ I_drop, η_keep * (∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω' = o then μ₁ ω' else 0) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_fib
      _ = η_keep * ∑ o ∈ I_drop, (∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if O₁ ω' = o then μ₁ ω' else 0) :=
          (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ η_keep * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_μ_drop hη_pos.le
      _ = η_keep := mul_one _
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 := h_small_keep

  let m_keep : ℝ := ∑ ω ∈ E_keep, π_tilde ω
  have hm_keep_half : 1 / 2 ≤ m_keep := by
    have h_flt := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not E₂
      (fun ω => η_keep * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ≤ finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω) π_tilde
    rw [hE₂_sum] at h_flt
    linarith only [h_flt, hE_drop_ub]
  have hm_keep_pos : 0 < m_keep := by linarith only [hm_keep_half]
  have hm_keep_le1 : m_keep ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← hπt_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ E_keep) (fun ω _ _ => hπt_nn ω)

  let π₀ : Fin M_ω → ℝ := fun ω => if ω ∈ E_keep then π_tilde ω / m_keep else 0
  let K₀ : ℝ := K₁ / (p_star * m_keep)

  have hpm_pos : 0 < p_star * m_keep := mul_pos hp_star_pos hm_keep_pos
  have hpm_le1 : p_star * m_keep ≤ 1 :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul hp_star_le1 hm_keep_le1 hm_keep_pos.le zero_le_one) (by norm_num)
  have hpm_inv_le_K₀ : (p_star * m_keep)⁻¹ ≤ K₀ := by
    dsimp [K₀]; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK₁ (inv_nonneg.mpr hpm_pos.le)
  have hK₀_ge1 : 1 ≤ K₀ := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ (p_star * m_keep)⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ hpm_pos).mpr hpm_le1
    exact le_trans h1 hpm_inv_le_K₀
  have hK₀_pos : 0 < K₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hK₀_ge1
  have hK₀_ub : K₀ ≤ K₁ * (100 * (J_hom : ℝ) / ξ) := by
    have h_den_lb : ξ / (100 * (J_hom : ℝ)) ≤ p_star * m_keep := by
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul hp_star_ge hm_keep_half (by norm_num) hp_star_pos.le
      have hc_eq : c₂ * (1 / 2) = ξ / (100 * (J_hom : ℝ)) := by
        dsimp [c₂]; field_simp [hJ_hom_pos.ne']; ring
      linarith only [h_mul, hc_eq]
    have h_den_pos : 0 < ξ / (100 * (J_hom : ℝ)) :=
      div_pos hξ₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hJ_hom_pos)
    have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hK₁] : 0 ≤ K₁) h_den_pos h_den_lb
    have h_rhs : K₁ / (ξ / (100 * (J_hom : ℝ))) = K₁ * (100 * (J_hom : ℝ) / ξ) := by
      field_simp [hξ₀.ne', hJ_hom_pos.ne']
    dsimp [K₀]
    linarith only [h_div, h_rhs]

  have hπ₀_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π₀ ω := by
    intro ω; dsimp [π₀]; split_ifs
    · exact div_nonneg (hπt_nn ω) hm_keep_pos.le
    · exact le_rfl

  have hπ₀_le_pm : ∀ ω, π₀ ω ≤ (p_star * m_keep)⁻¹ * μ₁ ω := by
    intro ω; dsimp [π₀]; split_ifs
    · calc π_tilde ω / m_keep
          = m_keep⁻¹ * π_tilde ω := div_eq_inv_mul _ _
        _ ≤ m_keep⁻¹ * (p_star⁻¹ * μ₁ ω) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hπt_le_μ ω) (inv_nonneg.mpr hm_keep_pos.le)
        _ = (p_star * m_keep)⁻¹ * μ₁ ω := by rw [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]
    · exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hpm_pos.le) (hμ_nn ω)

  have hπ₀_le_amb : ∀ ω, π₀ ω ≤ K₀ * π_amb ω := by
    intro ω
    calc π₀ ω
        ≤ (p_star * m_keep)⁻¹ * μ₁ ω := hπ₀_le_pm ω
      _ ≤ (p_star * m_keep)⁻¹ * (K₁ * π_amb ω) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hμ_le ω) (inv_nonneg.mpr hpm_pos.le)
      _ = K₀ * π_amb ω := by dsimp [K₀]; ring

  have hπ₀_le_K₀μ : ∀ ω, π₀ ω ≤ K₀ * μ₁ ω := fun ω =>
    le_trans (hπ₀_le_pm ω) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpm_inv_le_K₀ (hμ_nn ω))

  have hπt_le_K₀μ : ∀ ω, π_tilde ω ≤ K₀ * μ₁ ω := by
    intro ω
    have hp_inv_le : p_star⁻¹ ≤ K₀ := by
      have h1 : p_star * m_keep ≤ p_star := by
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_keep_le1 hp_star_pos.le
      exact le_trans ((inv_le_inv₀ hp_star_pos hpm_pos).mpr h1) hpm_inv_le_K₀
    exact le_trans (hπt_le_μ ω) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp_inv_le (hμ_nn ω))

  have hπ₀_sum : ∑ ω : Fin M_ω, π₀ ω = 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ E_keep)]
    · have h1 : ∑ ω ∈ E_keep, π₀ ω = (∑ ω ∈ E_keep, π_tilde ω) / m_keep := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
        dsimp [π₀]; rw [if_pos hω]
      rw [h1]; exact div_self hm_keep_pos.ne'
    · intro ω _ hnot; dsimp [π₀]; rw [if_neg hnot]

  have hπ₀_pos_mem : ∀ ω, 0 < π₀ ω → ω ∈ E_keep := by
    intro ω hpos
    by_contra hnot
    have h0 : π₀ ω = 0 := by dsimp [π₀]; rw [if_neg hnot]
    linarith only [hpos, h0]

  have hπ₀_pos_πt : ∀ ω, 0 < π₀ ω → 0 < π_tilde ω := fun ω hpos =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hπ₀_pos_mem ω hpos)).1).2

  have hπ₀_allow : ∀ ω, 0 < π₀ ω → ω ∈ E_allow ∧ 0 < μ₁ ω := fun ω hpos => by
    obtain ⟨ha, hμp, _⟩ := hπt_supp ω (hπ₀_pos_πt ω hpos)
    exact ⟨ha, hμp⟩

  
  have hπ₀_O1_lb : ∀ ω, 0 < π₀ ω → ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ) ≤ finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω := by
    intro ω hpos
    have hω_keep : ω ∈ E_keep := hπ₀_pos_mem ω hpos
    have h_keep_ineq : η_keep * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω ≤ finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_keep).2
    have h_intact : finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω = finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω / m_keep := by
      rw [h_prob1, h_prob1, Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases ho : O₁ ω' = O₁ ω
      · rw [if_pos ho, if_pos ho]
        have e_μ : finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω' = finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω := by rw [h_prob1, h_prob1, ho]
        have e_t : finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω' = finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω := by rw [h_prob1, h_prob1, ho]
        by_cases hω'_pos : 0 < π_tilde ω'
        · have hω'_keep : ω' ∈ E_keep := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
            ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω', hω'_pos⟩,
             by rw [e_μ, e_t]; exact h_keep_ineq⟩
          dsimp [π₀]; rw [if_pos hω'_keep]
        · have h0 : π_tilde ω' = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hω'_pos) (hπt_nn ω')
          have hnot_keep : ω' ∉ E_keep := fun hk =>
            hω'_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).1).2
          dsimp [π₀]; rw [if_neg hnot_keep, h0, zero_div]
      · rw [if_neg ho, if_neg ho, zero_div]
    obtain ⟨hπt_O_nn, _, _, _⟩ := h_prob_bds π_tilde O₁ O₁ hπt_nn ω
    have h_div_ge : finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω ≤ finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω / m_keep := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hm_keep_pos]
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_keep_le1 hπt_O_nn
    obtain ⟨_, _, hμ_O_lb, _, _, _⟩ := hπt_supp ω (hπ₀_pos_πt ω hpos)
    calc ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ)
        = η_keep * ε ^ (d_O + ξ) := by
          dsimp [η_keep]
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
          congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ η_keep * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hμ_O_lb hη_pos.le
      _ ≤ finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω := h_keep_ineq
      _ ≤ finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω := by rwa [h_intact]

  
  have hπt_O1_ub : ∀ ω, 0 < π_tilde ω → finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω ≤ K₀ * ε ^ d_O := by
    intro ω hpos
    have h1 : finProbAt π_tilde O₁ ω ≤ K₀ * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω := by
      rw [h_prob1, h_prob1, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      split_ifs
      · exact hπt_le_K₀μ ω'
      · simp
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hπt_supp ω hpos).2.2.2.1 hK₀_pos.le)

  have hπ₀_O1_ub : ∀ ω, 0 < π₀ ω → finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω ≤ K₀ * ε ^ d_O := by
    intro ω hpos
    have h1 : finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω ≤ K₀ * finProbAt μ₁ O₁ ω := by
      rw [h_prob1, h_prob1, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      split_ifs
      · exact hπ₀_le_K₀μ ω'
      · simp
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hπt_supp ω (hπ₀_pos_πt ω hpos)).2.2.2.1 hK₀_pos.le)

  have hπ₀_OV_ratio : ∀ ω, 0 < π₀ ω →
      finProbAt2 π₀ O₁ V_d ω / finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω ≤ K₀ * ε ^ (d_OV - d_O - 2 * ξ) := by
    intro ω hpos
    have h_num : finProbAt2 π₀ O₁ V_d ω ≤ K₀ * ε ^ d_OV := by
      have h1 : finProbAt2 π₀ O₁ V_d ω ≤ K₀ * finProbAt2 μ₁ O₁ V_d ω := by
        rw [h_prob2, h_prob2, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        split_ifs
        · exact hπ₀_le_K₀μ ω'
        · simp
      exact le_trans h1
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hπt_supp ω (hπ₀_pos_πt ω hpos)).2.2.2.2.2 hK₀_pos.le)
    have h_den : ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ) ≤ finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω := hπ₀_O1_lb ω hpos
    have h_den_pos : 0 < ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
    have h_num_nn : 0 ≤ K₀ * ε ^ d_OV := mul_nonneg hK₀_pos.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le d_OV)
    calc finProbAt2 π₀ O₁ V_d ω / finProbAt π₀ O₁ ω
        ≤ (K₀ * ε ^ d_OV) / ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ) := div_le_div₀ h_num_nn h_num h_den_pos h_den
      _ = K₀ * (ε ^ d_OV / ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ)) := mul_div_assoc _ _ _
      _ = K₀ * ε ^ (d_OV - d_O - 2 * ξ) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_sub hε₀]
          congr 2; ring

  
  let S_ret : Finset (α_O × α_V) := E_keep.image (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω))
  have hS_ret_card : (S_ret.card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-(d_OV + ξ)) := by
    have h_pt : ∀ pv ∈ S_ret,
        ε ^ (d_OV + ξ) ≤ ∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if (O₁ ω', V_d ω') = pv then μ₁ ω' else 0 := by
      intro pv hpv
      obtain ⟨ω_p, hω_p_keep, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpv
      have hω_p_pos : 0 < π_tilde ω_p :=
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_p_keep).1).2
      have hlb := (hπt_supp ω_p hω_p_pos).2.2.2.2.1
      rw [h_prob2] at hlb
      refine le_trans hlb (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)))
      simp only [Prod.ext_iff]
    have h_mul_sum : (S_ret.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (d_OV + ξ) ≤ 1 := by
      calc (S_ret.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (d_OV + ξ)
          = ∑ _pv ∈ S_ret, ε ^ (d_OV + ξ) := by simp
        _ ≤ ∑ pv ∈ S_ret, ∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, if (O₁ ω', V_d ω') = pv then μ₁ ω' else 0 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
        _ = ∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, ∑ pv ∈ S_ret, if (O₁ ω', V_d ω') = pv then μ₁ ω' else 0 :=
            Finset.sum_comm
        _ ≤ ∑ ω' : Fin M_ω, μ₁ ω' := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
            rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
            split_ifs <;> [exact le_rfl; exact hμ_nn ω']
        _ = 1 := hμ_sum
    have h_mOV_pos : 0 < ε ^ (d_OV + ξ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le, ← one_div, le_div_iff₀ h_mOV_pos]
    exact h_mul_sum

  
  have hM_hi_pos : 0 < K₀ * ε ^ d_O := mul_pos hK₀_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ d_O)
  have h_log_Mhi : -Real.log (K₀ * ε ^ d_O) / ell = d_O - Real.log K₀ / ell := by
    have hrp_pos : 0 < ε ^ d_O := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ d_O
    rw [Real.log_mul hK₀_pos.ne' hrp_pos.ne', h_rpow_log d_O]
    field_simp [hell_pos.ne']
    ring

  have hπt_H_lb : d_O - Real.log K₀ / ell ≤ finCondEntropy ε π_tilde (fun _ => ()) O₁ := by
    rw [← h_log_Mhi]
    exact h_uncond_lb (K₀ * ε ^ d_O) π_tilde O₁ hM_hi_pos hπt_nn hπt_sum hπt_O1_ub

  have hπt_score_out : F_low - ξ ≤ -(d_O - Real.log K₀ / ell) +
      3 * finCondEntropy ε π_tilde T_idx k₁ := by
    change F_low - ξ ≤ -finCondEntropy ε π_tilde (fun _ => ()) O₁ +
      3 * finCondEntropy ε π_tilde T_idx k₁ at hj_star_score
    linarith only [hj_star_score, hπt_H_lb]

  have hπ₀_H_lb : d_O - Real.log K₀ / ell ≤ finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) O₁ := by
    rw [← h_log_Mhi]
    exact h_uncond_lb (K₀ * ε ^ d_O) π₀ O₁ hM_hi_pos hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum hπ₀_O1_ub

  have hπ₀_H_ub : finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) O₁ ≤ d_O + 2 * ξ := by
    have hm_lo_pos : 0 < ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
    have h1 := h_uncond_ub (ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ)) π₀ O₁ hm_lo_pos hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum hπ₀_O1_lb
    have h_eq : -Real.log (ε ^ (d_O + 2 * ξ)) / ell = d_O + 2 * ξ := by
      rw [h_rpow_log (d_O + 2 * ξ)]
      field_simp [hell_pos.ne']
    rwa [h_eq] at h1

  have hπ₀_HOV_ub : finCondEntropy ε π₀ (fun _ => ()) (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω)) ≤ d_OV + ξ := by
    have hN_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-(d_OV + ξ)) := by
      have h_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith only [hε₁]
      have h_exp_np : -(d_OV + ξ) ≤ 0 := by linarith only [hd_OV_nn, hξ₀]
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ ≤ ε ^ (-(d_OV + ξ)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ h_le1 h_exp_np
    have h1 := h_ent_cap (ε ^ (-(d_OV + ξ))) π₀ (fun _ => ()) (fun ω => (O₁ ω, V_d ω))
      S_ret hN_ge1 hπ₀_nn hπ₀_sum hS_ret_card
      (fun ω hpos => Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun ω' => (O₁ ω', V_d ω')) (hπ₀_pos_mem ω hpos))
    have h_eq : Real.log (ε ^ (-(d_OV + ξ))) / ell = d_OV + ξ := by
      rw [h_rpow_log (-(d_OV + ξ))]
      field_simp [hell_pos.ne']
    rwa [h_eq] at h1

  exact ⟨d_O, d_OV, K₀, π_tilde, π₀,
    hd_O_nn, hd_O_le4, hd_OV_nn, hd_OV_le6,
    hK₀_ge1, hK₀_ub,
    hπt_nn, hπt_sum,
    fun ω hpos => (hπt_supp ω hpos).1,
    hπt_score_out,
    fun ω => ⟨hπ₀_nn ω, hπ₀_le_amb ω⟩,
    hπ₀_sum,
    hπ₀_allow,
    hπ₀_O1_lb,
    hπ₀_H_lb,
    hπ₀_H_ub,
    hπ₀_HOV_ub,
    hπ₀_OV_ratio⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (M_L : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (τ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      1 ≤ M_L → 0 < s →
      (let p₁ := roundShift2D s τ z₁
       let p₂ := roundShift2D s τ z₂
       (p₁.1 / (M_L : ℤ), p₁.2 / (M_L : ℤ)) = (p₂.1 / (M_L : ℤ), p₂.2 / (M_L : ℤ))) →
      ‖z₁ - z₂‖ ≤ 2 * (M_L : ℝ) * s) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < s → ‖v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)‖ ≤ 2 * s) ∧
    (∀ (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ),
      m₁ ≤ m₂ → 0 < ρ →
      let s₁ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m₁)⁻¹ * ρ
      let s₂ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m₂)⁻¹ * ρ
      let K : ℤ := ((2 ^ (m₂ - m₁) : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        roundShift2D s₁ 0 v =
          ((roundShift2D s₂ 0 v).1 / K, (roundShift2D s₂ 0 v).2 / K)) ∧
      (∀ k₂ : ℤ × ℤ,
        ‖gridPt2D s₂ k₂ - gridPt2D s₁ (k₂.1 / K, k₂.2 / K)‖ ≤ 2 * s₁)) ∧
    (∀ (s R : ℝ) (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      0 < s → 0 ≤ R →
      (∀ k ∈ S, ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ≤ R) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * (R / s) + 3) ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ (s R Δ : ℝ) (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      0 < s → 0 < R → 0 < Δ → Δ ≤ R / 2 →
      (∀ k ∈ S, R - Δ ≤ ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ∧ ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ≤ R) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (2 * (R / s) + 3) * (6 * (Δ / s) + 4)) ∧
    (∀ {ι : Type} (s : ℝ) (e₀ V₀ X₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
       (V X : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (F : Finset ι),
      0 < s → ‖e₀‖ = 1 →
      (∀ a ∈ F,
        |inner ℝ (V a - V₀) e₀| ≤ s ∧
        |inner ℝ (V a - V₀) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ s ∧
        |inner ℝ (X a - X₀) e₀| ≤ s ∧
        |inner ℝ (X a - X₀) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ s) →
      ((F.image (fun a => (roundShift2D s 0 (V a), roundShift2D s 0 (X a)))).card : ℝ) ≤ 625)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq w, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_mem_Icc_floor : ∀ (L U : ℝ) (a : ℤ),
      L ≤ (a : ℝ) → (a : ℝ) ≤ U → a ∈ Finset.Icc ⌊L⌋ ⌊U⌋ := by
    intro L U a hL hU
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨?_, Int.le_floor.mpr hU⟩
    have h1 : ⌊L⌋ ≤ ⌊(a : ℝ)⌋ := Int.floor_mono hL
    rwa [Int.floor_intCast] at h1
  have h_card_Icc_floor : ∀ (L U B : ℝ),
      0 ≤ B → U - L ≤ B → ((Finset.Icc ⌊L⌋ ⌊U⌋).card : ℝ) ≤ B + 2 := by
    intro L U B hB hUL
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    set d : ℤ := ⌊U⌋ + 1 - ⌊L⌋
    rcases le_or_gt d 0 with hd | hd
    · rw [Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr hd, Nat.cast_zero]
      linarith
    · have hd_cast : ((d.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = (⌊U⌋ : ℝ) + 1 - (⌊L⌋ : ℝ) := by
        have h_z : ((d.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = d := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hd.le
        calc ((d.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = (((d.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) := (Int.cast_natCast _).symm
          _ = (d : ℝ) := by rw [h_z]
          _ = (⌊U⌋ : ℝ) + 1 - (⌊L⌋ : ℝ) := by dsimp [d]; push_cast; ring
      rw [hd_cast]
      have hU_le : (⌊U⌋ : ℝ) ≤ U := Int.floor_le U
      have hL_lt : L < (⌊L⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one L
      linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro M_L s τ z₁ z₂ hML hs hp
    set M : ℤ := (M_L : ℤ)
    have hM_pos : 0 < M := by omega
    have hM_ne : M ≠ 0 := hM_pos.ne'
    have hML_r : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hML
    have h_coord : ∀ (x₁ x₂ c : ℝ),
        ⌊(x₁ - c) / s⌋ / M = ⌊(x₂ - c) / s⌋ / M →
        (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 := by
      intro x₁ x₂ c hq
      set k₁ : ℤ := ⌊(x₁ - c) / s⌋
      set k₂ : ℤ := ⌊(x₂ - c) / s⌋
      have hed₁ := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod k₁ M
      have hed₂ := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod k₂ M
      rw [hq] at hed₁
      set q_prod : ℤ := M * (k₂ / M)
      have hr₁_lo : 0 ≤ k₁ % M := Int.emod_nonneg k₁ hM_ne
      have hr₁_hi : k₁ % M < M := Int.emod_lt_of_pos k₁ hM_pos
      have hr₂_lo : 0 ≤ k₂ % M := Int.emod_nonneg k₂ hM_ne
      have hr₂_hi : k₂ % M < M := Int.emod_lt_of_pos k₂ hM_pos
      have hk_lo_z : -(M - 1) ≤ k₁ - k₂ := by omega
      have hk_hi_z : k₁ - k₂ ≤ M - 1 := by omega
      have hk_lo : -((M_L : ℝ) - 1) ≤ (k₁ : ℝ) - (k₂ : ℝ) := by
        have h1 : ((-(M - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((k₁ - k₂ : ℤ) : ℝ) := Int.cast_le.mpr hk_lo_z
        dsimp [M] at h1
        push_cast at h1
        linarith
      have hk_hi : (k₁ : ℝ) - (k₂ : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ) - 1 := by
        have h1 : ((k₁ - k₂ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((M - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := Int.cast_le.mpr hk_hi_z
        dsimp [M] at h1
        push_cast at h1
        linarith
      have hu₁_lo : (k₁ : ℝ) ≤ (x₁ - c) / s := Int.floor_le _
      have hu₁_hi : (x₁ - c) / s < (k₁ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hu₂_lo : (k₂ : ℝ) ≤ (x₂ - c) / s := Int.floor_le _
      have hu₂_hi : (x₂ - c) / s < (k₂ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hdiff_lo : -(M_L : ℝ) < (x₁ - c) / s - (x₂ - c) / s := by linarith
      have hdiff_hi : (x₁ - c) / s - (x₂ - c) / s < (M_L : ℝ) := by linarith
      have h_id : x₁ - x₂ = ((x₁ - c) / s - (x₂ - c) / s) * s := by
        rw [sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs.ne', div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs.ne']
        ring
      rw [h_id]
      have hx_lo : -((M_L : ℝ) * s) < ((x₁ - c) / s - (x₂ - c) / s) * s := by nlinarith
      have hx_hi : ((x₁ - c) / s - (x₂ - c) / s) * s < (M_L : ℝ) * s := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    have hp_inj := Prod.mk.inj hp
    have hc0 : (z₁ 0 - z₂ 0) ^ 2 ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 := h_coord (z₁ 0) (z₂ 0) (τ 0) hp_inj.1
    have hc1 : (z₁ 1 - z₂ 1) ^ 2 ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 := h_coord (z₁ 1) (z₂ 1) (τ 1) hp_inj.2
    have hnsq : ‖z₁ - z₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * (M_L : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 := by
      have hsub := h_norm_sq (z₁ - z₂)
      simp only [PiLp.sub_apply] at hsub
      nlinarith
    have h_nn1 : 0 ≤ ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h_nn2 : 0 ≤ 2 * (M_L : ℝ) * s := by positivity
    nlinarith
  · intro s v hs
    have h_1d : ∀ x : ℝ, (x - s * (⌊x / s⌋ : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      have h_lo : (⌊x / s⌋ : ℝ) ≤ x / s := Int.floor_le (x / s)
      have h_hi : x / s < (⌊x / s⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / s)
      have hx_lo : s * (⌊x / s⌋ : ℝ) ≤ x := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lo hs.le
        rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hs.ne'] at this
      have hx_hi : x < s * (⌊x / s⌋ : ℝ) + s := by
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_hi hs
        rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hs.ne', mul_add, mul_one] at this
        exact this
      nlinarith
    let w := gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)
