        (Finset.Icc (⌊W₀ 1 / s⌋ - 2) (⌊W₀ 1 / s⌋ + 2))
    have h_card5 : ∀ k : ℤ, (Finset.Icc (k - 2) (k + 2)).card = 5 := by
      intro k
      rw [Int.card_Icc]
      have h5 : k + 2 + 1 - (k - 2) = 5 := by ring
      rw [h5]
      rfl
    have h_box25_card : ∀ W₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), (box25 W₀).card = 25 := by
      intro W₀
      dsimp only [box25]
      rw [Finset.card_product, h_card5, h_card5]
    have h_coord_5 : ∀ (x x₀ : ℝ),
        (x - x₀) ^ 2 < ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 →
        ⌊(x - 0) / s⌋ ∈ Finset.Icc (⌊x₀ / s⌋ - 2) (⌊x₀ / s⌋ + 2) := by
      intro x x₀ h_sq
      rw [sub_zero, Finset.mem_Icc]
      have h_lo : (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * s < x - x₀ := by nlinarith
      have h_hi : x - x₀ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * s := by nlinarith
      have h_div_lo : -(3 / 2 : ℝ) < x / s - x₀ / s := by
        have h1 : ((-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * s) / s < (x - x₀) / s := div_lt_div_of_pos_right h_lo hs
        rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hs.ne', sub_div] at h1
        exact h1
      have h_div_hi : x / s - x₀ / s < (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        have h1 : (x - x₀) / s < ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * s) / s := div_lt_div_of_pos_right h_hi hs
        rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hs.ne', sub_div] at h1
        exact h1
      set k : ℤ := ⌊x₀ / s⌋
      have hk_lo : (k : ℝ) ≤ x₀ / s := Int.floor_le (x₀ / s)
      have hk_hi : x₀ / s < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x₀ / s)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
        push_cast
        linarith
      · have h_fl_le : (⌊x / s⌋ : ℝ) ≤ x / s := Int.floor_le (x / s)
        have h_lt_3 : ((⌊x / s⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) < ((k + 3 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
          push_cast
          linarith
        have h_z : ⌊x / s⌋ < k + 3 := Int.cast_lt.mp h_lt_3
        omega
    have h_box25_mem : ∀ (W W₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        |inner ℝ (W - W₀) e₀| ≤ s →
        |inner ℝ (W - W₀) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ s →
        roundShift2D s 0 W ∈ box25 W₀ := by
      intro W W₀ h1 h2
      have h1_sq : (inner ℝ (W - W₀) e₀) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (inner ℝ (W - W₀) e₀)]
      have h2_sq : (inner ℝ (W - W₀) (perp2D e₀)) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (inner ℝ (W - W₀) (perp2D e₀))]
      have h_sum_sq : (W 0 - W₀ 0) ^ 2 + (W 1 - W₀ 1) ^ 2 < ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 := by
        have hp := h_parseval (W - W₀)
        simp only [PiLp.sub_apply] at hp
        nlinarith
      rw [Finset.mem_product]
      exact ⟨h_coord_5 (W 0) (W₀ 0) (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (W 1 - W₀ 1)]),
             h_coord_5 (W 1) (W₀ 1) (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (W 0 - W₀ 0)])⟩
    let img := F.image (fun a => (roundShift2D s 0 (V a), roundShift2D s 0 (X a)))
    have h_sub : img ⊆ box25 V₀ ×ˢ box25 X₀ := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain ⟨hV1, hV2, hX1, hX2⟩ := hF a ha
      exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨h_box25_mem (V a) V₀ hV1 hV2, h_box25_mem (X a) X₀ hX1 hX2⟩
    have h_card_nat : img.card ≤ 625 := by
      calc img.card
          ≤ (box25 V₀ ×ˢ box25 X₀).card := Finset.card_le_card h_sub
        _ = 625 := by rw [Finset.card_product, h_box25_card, h_box25_card]
    exact_mod_cast h_card_nat

informal_problem.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (γ ε H_P L t h b_star lam_sys A_win ξ C_cov : ℝ)
    (M_L M_mult M_ord M_tr m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
    (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ) (C_sub_bes B_X C_far R_tr : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
    (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (p_buf : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (r_i : ℕ)
    (S_obs : Finset (Fin N_O)) (T_P : Finset (Fin N_ret))
    (h_grid :
      (∀ (s : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        0 < s → ‖v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)‖ ≤ 2 * s) ∧
      (∀ (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ),
        m₁ ≤ m₂ → 0 < ρ →
        let s₁ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m₁)⁻¹ * ρ
        let s₂ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m₂)⁻¹ * ρ
        let K : ℤ := ((2 ^ (m₂ - m₁) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          roundShift2D s₁ 0 v =
            ((roundShift2D s₂ 0 v).1 / K, (roundShift2D s₂ 0 v).2 / K)) ∧
        (∀ k₂ : ℤ × ℤ,
          ‖gridPt2D s₂ k₂ - gridPt2D s₁ (k₂.1 / K, k₂.2 / K)‖ ≤ 2 * s₁)) ∧
      (∀ (s R : ℝ) (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
        0 < s → 0 ≤ R →
        (∀ k ∈ S, ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ≤ R) →
        (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * (R / s) + 3) ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ (s R Δ : ℝ) (v₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
        0 < s → 0 < R → 0 < Δ → Δ ≤ R / 2 →
        (∀ k ∈ S, R - Δ ≤ ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ∧ ‖gridPt2D s k - v₀‖ ≤ R) →
        (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (2 * (R / s) + 3) * (6 * (Δ / s) + 4)))
    (hh : 0 < h) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hML_bound : (64 * C_cov * cls.B_sys : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ))
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_bes : 1 ≤ C_sub_bes) (hBX : 2 ≤ B_X) (hC_far : 0 ≤ C_far)
    (hM_tr : 2 ≤ M_tr) (hR_tr_BX : B_X ≤ R_tr)
    (hR_tr_eh : R_tr * ε ^ h ≤ 1)
    (h_tr_tail : C_tr M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (A_win / 2))
    (h_eh_small : 8 * ε ^ (h / 2) ≤ 1)
    (h_far_small : 16 * (N_O : ℝ) * (N_ret : ℝ) * C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))) ≤ 1)
    (hr_pos : 0 < t - 2 * h) (ht_HP : t ≤ H_P)
    (henv : IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f)
    (hsub : IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t (t - 2 * h) b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
      m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub)
    (hadm : IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
      lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond)
    (hs_c_hi : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ (t - 2 * h))
    (h_loc_far : ∀ o ∈ S_obs,
      let r := t - 2 * h
      let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
      let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
      let s_v := ε ^ b_star
      let s_x := s_c * s_v
      let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
      let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
      let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
      let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
      let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
      let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
      let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
        (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
          Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      let r_loc := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
      let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
      r_O o = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
      r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
      ‖V_O o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x ∧
      ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
        R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_O o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ →
        generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α)
          (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤ C_far * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ))))
    (h_bessel : ∀ S_at : Finset (Fin N_ret),
      let r := t - 2 * h
      let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
      let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
      let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
      let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
      let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
      let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
      let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
        (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
          Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      ∑ o ∈ S_obs, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
        (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_at, sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
        (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
        C_sub_bes * ∑ α ∈ S_at, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2)
    (hr_i : r_i < 2 ^ m_t)
    (hS_obs : ∀ o ∈ S_obs,
      let r := t - 2 * h
      let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
      let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
      let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
      let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
      let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
        ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
          Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
      r_O o = r_i ∧
      coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) = p_buf ∧
      (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        let q_r := r_O o / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
        let C_r' := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
        ‖v' - V_O o‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) →
        ‖x' - (X_O o + (C_r' - C_t) • V_O o)‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 32) * ε ^ (r + (H_P - t) / 2) →
        coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
        coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x')) ∧
      ε ^ A_win ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
        (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))
    (hT_P : ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
      let r := t - 2 * h
      coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1
        (gridPt2D (ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)) (sub.o_at α).1)
        (gridPt2D ((lam_sys * ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2))⁻¹) (sub.o_at α).2)) = p_buf ↔ α ∈ T_P) :
    (S_obs.Nonempty → T_P.Nonempty) ∧
    (let r := t - 2 * h
     let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
     let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
     let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
     let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
     let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α *
       ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
         Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
     ∑ o ∈ S_obs, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
       (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
       (131072 * C_sub_bes * C_cov ^ 3 * (M_mult : ℝ)) * R_tr ^ 2 *
         ε ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ) * h - ξ) * sub.m_bin * (T_P.card : ℝ))

informal_problem.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (γ ε H_P L t h e₀ ζ_sh ξ C_cov b_star lam_sys b_ref a_ref : ℝ)
    (M_L M_mult m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
    (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret)
    (h_coarse_625 :
      (∀ (M_L' : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (τ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        1 ≤ M_L' → 0 < s →
        (let p₁ := roundShift2D s τ z₁
         let p₂ := roundShift2D s τ z₂
         (p₁.1 / (M_L' : ℤ), p₁.2 / (M_L' : ℤ)) = (p₂.1 / (M_L' : ℤ), p₂.2 / (M_L' : ℤ))) →
        ‖z₁ - z₂‖ ≤ 2 * (M_L' : ℝ) * s) ∧
      (∀ (s : ℝ) (e₀_v V₀ X₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (V X : Fin N_ret → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (F : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
        0 < s → ‖e₀_v‖ = 1 →
        (∀ α ∈ F,
          |inner ℝ (V α - V₀) e₀_v| ≤ s ∧
          |inner ℝ (V α - V₀) (perp2D e₀_v)| ≤ s ∧
          |inner ℝ (X α - X₀) e₀_v| ≤ s ∧
          |inner ℝ (X α - X₀) (perp2D e₀_v)| ≤ s) →
        ((F.image (fun α => (roundShift2D s 0 (V α), roundShift2D s 0 (X α)))).card : ℝ) ≤ 625) ∧
      (∀ (s : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        0 < s → ‖v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)‖ ≤ 2 * s))
    (h_angle_cramer :
      (∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖perp2D u‖ = ‖u‖ ∧ inner ℝ u (perp2D u) = 0 ∧ perp2D (perp2D u) = -u) ∧
      (∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), projAngleDist u v = projAngleDist v u) ∧
      (∀ u v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → ‖w‖ = 1 →
        projAngleDist u w ≤ projAngleDist u v + projAngleDist v w) ∧
      (∀ z u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 →
        projAngleDist u v * ‖z‖ ≤ |inner ℝ z u| + |inner ℝ z v|) ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ 1 →
        let e_tilde : (ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun k =>
          let w := gridPt2D ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * s) k
          if k = (0, 0) then WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0] else ‖w‖⁻¹ • w
        (∀ k : ℤ × ℤ, ‖e_tilde k‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e‖ = 1 →
          let k := roundShift2D ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * s) 0 e
          ‖e_tilde k - e‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖perp2D (e_tilde k) - perp2D e‖ ≤ s)))
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hh : 0 < h) (h64h : 64 * h < γ * e₀)
    (hζ_sh : 0 < ζ_sh) (h64ζ : 64 * ζ_sh < e₀) (hML_1 : 1 ≤ M_L)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hr_pos : 0 < t - 2 * h) (hn_buf : ∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1)
    (hb_star0 : 0 ≤ b_star) (he0_ab : e₀ ≤ a_ref - b_ref)
    (hut_aref : |(H_P - t) / 2 - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh) (hb_bref : |b_star - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh)
    (haloc_ur : |(b_star + sub.a_loc) - (H_P - (t - 2 * h)) / 2| ≤ ζ_sh)
    (he0_loc : e₀ ≤ sub.a_loc - sub.b_loc)
    (hs_c_lo : ε ^ (t - 2 * h) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹)
    (hsub : IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t (t - 2 * h) b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
      m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub)
    (h_misalign : ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
      let r := t - 2 * h
      let p_c := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1
        (gridPt2D (ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)) (sub.o_at α).1)
        (gridPt2D ((lam_sys * ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2))⁻¹) (sub.o_at α).2)
      2 * ε ^ h < projAngleDist (perp2D (sub.e_cap α))
        (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)))
    (hd_adm : ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧
      a_D d ≤ min (L - t) ((H_P - t) / 2) ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1)
    (h_ex_d : ∃ d₀ : Fin N_D, |a_D d₀ - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh) :
    let r := t - 2 * h
    let e := a_ref - b_star
    let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
    let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
    let s_v := ε ^ b_star
    let s_x := s_c * s_v
    let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
    let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
    let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
    let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
    let s_M := ε ^ sub.b_loc
    let V'_at := fun α : Fin N_ret => s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1 - V_J)
    let X'_at := fun α : Fin N_ret => s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2 - X_J)
    let P_obs := fun o : Fin N_O =>
      coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o))
    let P_at := fun α : Fin N_ret =>
      coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1
        (gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2))
    let Compat : Fin N_ret → Fin N_D → Prop := fun α d =>
      ∃ o : Fin N_O, P_at α = P_obs o ∧
        cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
        |(((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹) - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
        r_O o = r_D d ∧
        |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧
        projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_buf (P_obs o)) ≤ ε ^ (4 * h) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d + t)
    let m_raw : Fin N_ret → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun α =>
      (roundShift2D s_M 0 (V'_at α), roundShift2D s_M 0 (X'_at α))
    let u_raw : Fin N_D → (ℤ × ℤ) × ℤ × ℤ := fun d =>
      let C_t := ((r_D d : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
      let v_perp := s_v⁻¹ * inner ℝ (V_D d - V_J) (perp2D (e_D d))
      let x_perp := s_x⁻¹ * inner ℝ (X_D d - (C_t - C_r) • V_D d - X_J) (perp2D (e_D d))
      (roundShift2D ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * s_M) 0 (e_D d),
       Int.floor (v_perp / s_M), Int.floor (x_perp / s_M))
    let R_D := 8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 2 * (M_L : ℝ) + 10
    let R_U := 10 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 2 * (M_L : ℝ) + 13
    (e₀ - h - 2 * ζ_sh ≤ e - sub.b_loc ∧ sub.a_loc ≤ e + h + 2 * ζ_sh) ∧
    (∀ (c : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, sub.cap_id α = c) →
      ((S.image m_raw).card : ℝ) ≤ 625) ∧
    (∀ (d : Fin N_D) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, Compat α d) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C_cov * R_D ^ 4 * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin + (1 - γ) * (e - 2 * ζ_sh) - 2 * ξ)) ∧
    (∀ (d : Fin N_D) (c : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, sub.cap_id α = c ∧ Compat α d) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤
        C_cov * (2 * R_D + 2) ^ 4 * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin + 2 * (e - h - 2 * ζ_sh) - 2 * ξ)) ∧
    (∀ (u : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℤ × ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, ∃ (α₀ : Fin N_ret) (d₀ : Fin N_D),
        m_raw α₀ = m_raw α ∧ u_raw d₀ = u ∧ Compat α₀ d₀) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C_cov * R_U ^ 4 * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin + (1 - γ) * sub.b_loc - 2 * ξ))

    · have hpkt : pktWeight γ 0 sub.b_loc = (1 - γ) * sub.b_loc := by
        unfold pktWeight; ring

    · intro α hα
      obtain ⟨α₀, d₀, hm_eq, hu_eq, hcomp₀⟩ := hS α hα

      obtain ⟨hv0_n, hx0_n, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hsub_at α₀

      have hm_v : roundShift2D s_M 0 (V'_at α₀) = roundShift2D s_M 0 (V'_at α) :=

        congrArg (fun q => q.2.1) hu_eq
      have hj_x : Int.floor (x_perp_fn d₀ / s_M) = u.2.2 :=
        congrArg (fun q => q.2.2) hu_eq
      have hn_diff : ‖n_U - perp2D (e_D d₀)‖ ≤ s_M := by

        dsimp only [n_U, e_U, e_tilde] at h_ed ⊢
        rwa [hk_u] at h_ed

      · change |inner ℝ (V'_at α - V_U) n_U| ≤ R_U * s_M

        have h_abs := le_trans (abs_add_le _ _)

              inner ℝ (X'_at α₀) (n_U - perp2D (e_D d₀))) +

        have h2 : |inner ℝ (X'_at α₀) (n_U - perp2D (e_D d₀))| ≤

          calc |inner ℝ (X'_at α₀) (n_U - perp2D (e_D d₀))|
              ≤ ‖X'_at α₀‖ * ‖n_U - perp2D (e_D d₀)‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
            _ ≤ (8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10) * s_M :=
                mul_le_mul hx0_n hn_diff (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith only [hB_sys2, hR_win2])
        have h3 : |inner ℝ (X'_at α₀) (perp2D (e_D d₀)) - x_perp_fn d₀| ≤
            (2 * (M_L : ℝ) + 2 * cls.B_sys) * s_M :=
          le_trans hx0_tr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_e2z_sM (by linarith only [hML_nn, hB_sys2]))
        have h4 : |x_perp_fn d₀ - (u.2.2 : ℝ) * s_M| ≤ s_M := h_fl_err (x_perp_fn d₀) u.2.2 hj_x
        rw [h_4hop]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ ε h e₀ ζ_sh ξ b_star b_ref a_ref m_bin g_bin b_loc a_loc : ℝ)
    (N_O N_D N_ret N_all N_R : ℕ)
    (K_fac C_R C_E C_D C_DE C_U : ℝ)
    (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ)
    (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (P_obs : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (P_at : Fin N_ret → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (rv_O : Fin N_O → Fin N_R) (rv_D : Fin N_D → Fin N_R)
    (cap_fn : Fin N_ret → ℕ)
    (m_fn : Fin N_ret → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (u_fn : Fin N_D → (ℤ × ℤ) × ℤ × ℤ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hm_bin : 0 < m_bin)
    (hN_ret : 1 ≤ N_ret) (hN_all : 1 ≤ N_all) (hN_R : 1 ≤ N_R)
    (hK_fac : 1 ≤ K_fac) (hC_R : 1 ≤ C_R) (hC_E : 1 ≤ C_E)
    (hC_D : 1 ≤ C_D) (hC_DE : 1 ≤ C_DE) (hC_U : 1 ≤ C_U)
    (hb_bref : |b_star - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh)
    (he_bloc : e₀ - h - 2 * ζ_sh ≤ (a_ref - b_star) - b_loc)
    (haloc_hi : a_loc ≤ (a_ref - b_star) + h + 2 * ζ_sh)
    (hp_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_cond o d) (hp_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d = 1)
    (hm_pos : ∀ o : Fin N_O, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d) → 0 < m_O o)
    (h_act_ba_r : ∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
      |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ rv_O o = rv_D d)
    (hNR_bd : (N_R : ℝ) ≤ C_R * ε ^ (-(2 * h)))
    (hNE_bd : ((Finset.univ.image cap_fn).card : ℝ) ≤
      C_E * (N_all : ℝ) * ε ^ (g_bin - pktWeight γ b_loc a_loc - 2 * ξ))
    (h625 : ∀ (c : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, cap_fn α = c) → ((S.image m_fn).card : ℝ) ≤ 625)
    (h_fib_mass : ∀ (p_buf : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (rv : Fin N_R)
      (S_obs : Finset (Fin N_O)) (T_P : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ o ∈ S_obs, (0 < ∑ d, p_cond o d) ∧ P_obs o = p_buf ∧ rv_O o = rv) →
      (∀ α : Fin N_ret, P_at α = p_buf ↔ α ∈ T_P) →
      S_obs.Nonempty →
      T_P.Nonempty ∧
      ∑ o ∈ S_obs, m_O o ≤ K_fac * ε ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ) * h - ξ) * m_bin * (T_P.card : ℝ))
    (h_fib_D : ∀ (d : Fin N_D) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, ∃ o : Fin N_O, P_at α = P_obs o ∧ 0 < p_cond o d) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C_D * ε ^ (-g_bin + (1 - γ) * ((a_ref - b_star) - 2 * ζ_sh) - 2 * ξ))
    (h_fib_DE : ∀ (d : Fin N_D) (c : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, cap_fn α = c ∧ ∃ o : Fin N_O, P_at α = P_obs o ∧ 0 < p_cond o d) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C_DE * ε ^ (-g_bin + 2 * ((a_ref - b_star) - h - 2 * ζ_sh) - 2 * ξ))
    (h_fib_U : ∀ (u : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℤ × ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ret)),
      (∀ α ∈ S, ∃ (α₀ : Fin N_ret) (d₀ : Fin N_D),
        m_fn α₀ = m_fn α ∧ u_fn d₀ = u ∧
        ∃ o : Fin N_O, P_at α₀ = P_obs o ∧ 0 < p_cond o d₀) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ C_U * ε ^ (-g_bin + (1 - γ) * b_loc - 2 * ξ))
    (h_ent_eps :
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      (∀ {N_O' N_D' N_Z N_T N_R' : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O' → Fin N_D' → ℝ) (m : Fin N_O' → ℝ)
         (Z_of : Fin N_O' → Fin N_Z) (r_Z : Fin N_Z → Fin N_R') (r_D' : Fin N_D' → Fin N_R')
         (T_of_Z : Fin N_Z → Finset (Fin N_T)) {K_mass : ℝ} {M_amb : ℕ},
         0 < K_mass → 1 ≤ M_amb →
         (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O', ∑ d : Fin N_D', p o d = 1) →
         (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D', p o d) → 0 < m o) →
         (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → r_Z (Z_of o) = r_D' d) →
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ z : Fin N_Z, (0 < ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), ∑ d, p o d) →
            (T_of_Z z).Nonempty ∧
            (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z),
              if 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D', p o d then m o else 0) ≤
              K_mass * ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ)) →
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (rv : Fin N_R'),
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin N_Z => r_Z z = rv ∧ α ∈ T_of_Z z)).card : ℝ) ≤
              (M_amb : ℝ)) →
         letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let p_O' := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D', p o d
         let p_D' := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O', p o d
         let p_ZD := fun z d => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), p o d
         let q := fun (z : Fin N_Z) (d : Fin N_D') (α : Fin N_T) =>
           if α ∈ T_of_Z z then p_ZD z d / ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ) else 0
         let q_T := fun α => ∑ z, ∑ d, q z d α
         let q_TD := fun α d => ∑ z, q z d α
         let q_TR := fun α rv => ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => r_Z z = rv), ∑ d, q z d α
         (∀ z d α, 0 ≤ q z d α) ∧ (∑ z, ∑ d, ∑ α, q z d α = 1) ∧
         (∀ z d α, 0 < q z d α → α ∈ T_of_Z z ∧ ∃ o, Z_of o = z ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
         ((∑ o, -(p_O' o * Real.log (p_O' o))) / ell +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D' d))) / ell) +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, p_O' o * Real.log (m o)) / ell) ≤
          (∑ α, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D' d))) / ell) +
          (∑ α, ∑ rv, -(q_TR α rv * Real.log (q_TR α rv / q_T α))) / ell +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (M_amb : ℝ) / ell) +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log K_mass / ell))) ∧
      (∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},
         0 < B_fib → (∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) → (∑ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) →
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ y : Fin N_Y, (0 < ∑ x, P x y) →
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin N_X => 0 < P x y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib) →
         let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x, P x y
         (∑ x, ∑ y, -(P x y * Real.log (P x y / P_Y y))) / ell ≤ Real.log B_fib / ell) ∧
      (∀ {N_T N_D' N_E N_M N_U : ℕ} (P : Fin N_T → Fin N_D' → ℝ)
         (E_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_E) (M_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_M) (U_of : Fin N_D' → Fin N_U)
         {K_EM : ℕ},
         1 ≤ N_E → 1 ≤ K_EM →
         (∀ α d, 0 ≤ P α d) → (∑ α, ∑ d, P α d = 1) →
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ e : Fin N_E,
            (((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e)).image M_of).card : ℝ) ≤ (K_EM : ℝ)) →
         letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let P_T := fun α => ∑ d, P α d
         let P_D := fun d => ∑ α, P α d
         let P_E := fun e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P_T α
         let P_DE := fun d e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P α d
         let P_M := fun m => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m), P_T α
         let P_MU := fun m u =>
           ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m),
             ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => U_of d = u), P α d
         let Q_TU := fun α u =>
           if 0 < P_M (M_of α) then P_T α * (P_MU (M_of α) u / P_M (M_of α)) else 0
         let Q_U := fun u => ∑ α, Q_TU α u
         (∀ α u, 0 ≤ Q_TU α u) ∧ (∑ α, ∑ u, Q_TU α u = 1) ∧
         (∀ α u, 0 < Q_TU α u → 0 < P_T α ∧
           ∃ α₀ d₀, M_of α₀ = M_of α ∧ U_of d₀ = u ∧ 0 < P α₀ d₀) ∧
         ((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α))) / ell - Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤
           (∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell) ∧
         (((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell -
           (∑ α, ∑ d, -(P α d * Real.log (P α d / P_DE d (E_of α)))) / ell) ≤
          ((∑ α, ∑ u, -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (Q_TU α u / Q_U u))) / ell -
           (∑ α, ∑ d, -(P α d * Real.log (P α d / P_D d))) / ell) +
          Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) / ell))) :
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    let p_O := fun o : Fin N_O => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d
    let p_D := fun d : Fin N_D => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond o d
    let P_score :=
      (∑ o, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, p_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) - b_star
    let A_proxy :=
      Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log m_bin / ell) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g_bin
    2 * γ * e₀ ≤
      (Real.log ((N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret : ℝ)) / ell) +
      4 * (A_proxy - P_score) +
      ((37 / 2 : ℝ) + γ) * h +
      16 * ζ_sh + 14 * ξ +
      (6 * Real.log K_fac + 4 * Real.log C_R + Real.log C_E + Real.log C_D +
        Real.log C_DE + Real.log C_U + Real.log 625) / ell

proof.tactics:
by

  let p_ZD := fun (z : Fin N_Z) (d : Fin N_D) =>
    ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => Z_of o = z), p_cond o d

    if α ∈ T_of_Z z then p_ZD z d / ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ) else 0

  let q_TD := fun (α : Fin N_ret) (d : Fin N_D) => ∑ z : Fin N_Z, q z d α
  let q_TR := fun (α : Fin N_ret) (rv : Fin N_R) =>
    ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin N_Z => r_Z z = rv), ∑ d : Fin N_D, q z d α
  obtain ⟨hq_nn, hq_sum, hq_pos, h_bridge⟩ :=

        rw [h_filt, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hT_card_pos.ne']

  let H_T : ℝ := (∑ α : Fin N_ret, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell

    (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d))) / ell

  have hBgap_lo : 0 ≤ B_gap + err_D := by

  let RHS_star : ℝ :=

    rw [h_log_1, h_log_Kmass, hHT_eq, hHTD_eq] at h_bridge

        (Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell - A_gap) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (g_bin - (1 - γ) * e - B_gap) +
          (Real.log C_R / ell + 2 * h) +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * 0 +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log K_fac / ell + (5 / 4 : ℝ) * h + ξ + Real.log m_bin / ell) +
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - γ) * e + 2 * ζ_sh) =
        A_proxy - (A_gap + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B_gap) +
          (31 / 8 : ℝ) * h + 2 * ζ_sh + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ξ +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log K_fac / ell) + Real.log C_R / ell := by
      dsimp only [A_proxy]
      ring
    dsimp only [RHS_star, P_score, W_term] at hW_bd ⊢
    linarith only [h_bridge, hW_bd, hHRT_bd, h_alg]

  
  let P_DE : Fin N_D → Fin N_E → ℝ :=

    have hPTDE_marg : ∀ y : Fin (N_D * N_E),

      have h_row : ∀ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ y : Fin (N_D * N_E), P_TDE α y = ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_TD α d := by
        intro α
        rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv (fun y => P_TDE α y), Fintype.sum_prod_type]

        dsimp only [P_TDE]

    have h_rhs : Real.log B_DE / ell =

  have hHQTU_bd : H_QTU ≤ Real.log C_U / ell + g_bin - (1 - γ) * b_loc + 2 * ξ := by
    let B_U : ℝ := C_U * ε ^ (-g_bin + (1 - γ) * b_loc - 2 * ξ)
    have hBU_pos : 0 < B_U := mul_pos hC_U_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _)
    have hQTU_fib : ∀ u_idx : Fin N_U, (0 < ∑ α : Fin N_ret, Q_TU α u_idx) →
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret => 0 < Q_TU α u_idx)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_U := by
      intro u_idx _
      refine h_fib_U (eU.symm u_idx).1 _ (fun α hα => ?_)
      have hpos : 0 < Q_TU α u_idx := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα).2
      obtain ⟨_, α₀, d₀, hM_eq, hU_d₀, hq₀⟩ := hQ_pos α u_idx hpos
      have hm_eq : m_fn α₀ = m_fn α := by
        rw [← hgM_eq α₀, ← hgM_eq α, hM_eq]
      have hu_eq : u_fn d₀ = (eU.symm u_idx).1 := by
        rw [← hU_eq d₀, hU_d₀]
      exact ⟨α₀, d₀, hm_eq, hu_eq, hqTD_compat α₀ d₀ hq₀⟩
    have h_raw := h_ent_eps.2.1 Q_TU hBU_pos hQ_nn hQ_sum hQTU_fib
    have h_rhs : Real.log B_U / ell =
        Real.log C_U / ell + g_bin - (1 - γ) * b_loc + 2 * ξ := by
      dsimp only [B_U]
      rw [h_log_eps_mul hC_U_pos]
      ring
    change H_QTU ≤ Real.log B_U / ell at h_raw
    linarith only [h_raw, h_rhs]

  
  let d₁ : ℝ := Real.log ((N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret : ℝ)) / ell
  have hC_E_pos : 0 < C_E := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_E
  have hN_all_pos : 0 < (N_all : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN_all
  have hN_E_pos : 0 < (N_E : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN_E
  have h_log_NE : Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤
      Real.log C_E / ell + Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell + d₁ - g_bin +
        (1 + γ) * b_loc + (1 - γ) * (e + h + 2 * ζ_sh) + 2 * ξ := by
    have hNE_le : (N_E : ℝ) ≤
        (C_E * (N_all : ℝ)) * ε ^ (g_bin - pktWeight γ b_loc a_loc - 2 * ξ) := hNE_bd
    have hCN_pos : 0 < C_E * (N_all : ℝ) := mul_pos hC_E_pos hN_all_pos
    have h_log_le : Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤
        Real.log ((C_E * (N_all : ℝ)) * ε ^ (g_bin - pktWeight γ b_loc a_loc - 2 * ξ)) / ell :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.log_le_log hN_E_pos hNE_le) hell_pos.le
    have h_log_expand :
        Real.log ((C_E * (N_all : ℝ)) * ε ^ (g_bin - pktWeight γ b_loc a_loc - 2 * ξ)) / ell =
        Real.log C_E / ell + Real.log (N_all : ℝ) / ell - g_bin +
          pktWeight γ b_loc a_loc + 2 * ξ := by
      rw [h_log_eps_mul hCN_pos, Real.log_mul hC_E_pos.ne' hN_all_pos.ne', add_div]
      ring
    have h_d1_eq : Real.log (N_all : ℝ) / ell = Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell + d₁ := by
      dsimp only [d₁]
      rw [Real.log_div hN_all_pos.ne' hN_ret_pos.ne', sub_div]
      ring
    have h_pkt : pktWeight γ b_loc a_loc ≤ (1 + γ) * b_loc + (1 - γ) * (e + h + 2 * ζ_sh) := by
      dsimp only [pktWeight, e]
      nlinarith only [hγ₁, haloc_hi]
    linarith only [h_log_le, h_log_expand, h_d1_eq, h_pkt]
  have h_HTE_lo' : H_T - Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤ H_TE := by
    have h_PT_eq : (∑ α : Fin N_ret,
        -((∑ d : Fin N_D, q_TD α d) * Real.log (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_TD α d))) / ell = H_T := by
      dsimp only [H_T]
      simp_rw [hqTD_marg_T]
    change (∑ α : Fin N_ret,
        -((∑ d : Fin N_D, q_TD α d) * Real.log (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_TD α d))) / ell -
        Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤ H_TE at h_HTE_lo
    linarith only [h_HTE_lo, h_PT_eq]
  have h_markov' : H_TE - H_TDE ≤ H_QTU - H_TD + Real.log (625 : ℝ) / ell := by
    have h_PD_eq : (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / (∑ α' : Fin N_ret, q_TD α' d)))) / ell = H_TD := by
      dsimp only [H_TD]
      simp_rw [hqTD_marg_D]
    have h_625_cast : Real.log ((625 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ell = Real.log (625 : ℝ) / ell := by norm_num
    change H_TE - H_TDE ≤
      (H_QTU - (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / (∑ α' : Fin N_ret, q_TD α' d)))) / ell) +
      Real.log ((625 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ell at h_markov
    linarith only [h_markov, h_PD_eq, h_625_cast]
  have h_CMI_lo :
      (1 + γ) * (e - b_loc) - d₁ - A_gap - (3 - γ) * h - (6 - 2 * γ) * ζ_sh - 4 * ξ -
        Real.log C_E / ell - Real.log C_DE / ell ≤ H_TE - H_TDE := by
    have h_alg :
        (Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell - A_gap) -
          (Real.log C_E / ell + Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell + d₁ - g_bin +
            (1 + γ) * b_loc + (1 - γ) * (e + h + 2 * ζ_sh) + 2 * ξ) -
          (Real.log C_DE / ell + g_bin - 2 * (e - h - 2 * ζ_sh) + 2 * ξ) =
        (1 + γ) * (e - b_loc) - d₁ - A_gap - (3 - γ) * h - (6 - 2 * γ) * ζ_sh - 4 * ξ -
          Real.log C_E / ell - Real.log C_DE / ell := by ring
    linarith only [h_HTE_lo', hHT_eq, h_log_NE, hHTDE_bd, h_alg]
  have h_CMI_hi :
      H_TE - H_TDE ≤
        (1 - γ) * (e - b_loc) + B_gap + 2 * ξ + Real.log C_U / ell + Real.log (625 : ℝ) / ell := by
    have h_alg :
        (Real.log C_U / ell + g_bin - (1 - γ) * b_loc + 2 * ξ) -
          (g_bin - (1 - γ) * e - B_gap) + Real.log (625 : ℝ) / ell =
        (1 - γ) * (e - b_loc) + B_gap + 2 * ξ + Real.log C_U / ell + Real.log (625 : ℝ) / ell := by
      ring
    linarith only [h_markov', hHTD_eq, hHQTU_bd, h_alg]

  
  have h_AB_up : A_gap + B_gap ≤ 4 * RHS_star + err_D := by
    let U_nn : ℝ := A_gap + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B_gap + err_D)
    have hUnn : 0 ≤ U_nn := by
      dsimp only [U_nn]
      linarith only [hAgap_nn, hBgap_lo]
    have h_id : (A_gap + B_gap) + A_gap + 2 * U_nn =
        4 * (A_gap + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B_gap) + err_D := by
      dsimp only [U_nn]
      ring
    linarith only [hAgap_nn, hUnn, h_id, h_score_bridge]
  have h_ebloc_2g : 2 * γ * e₀ - 2 * γ * h - 4 * γ * ζ_sh ≤ 2 * γ * (e - b_loc) := by
    have h_mul : 2 * γ * (e₀ - h - 2 * ζ_sh) ≤ 2 * γ * (e - b_loc) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he_bloc (by linarith only [hγ₀] : 0 ≤ 2 * γ)
    have h_alg : 2 * γ * (e₀ - h - 2 * ζ_sh) = 2 * γ * e₀ - 2 * γ * h - 4 * γ * ζ_sh := by ring
    linarith only [h_mul, h_alg]
  have h_cmi_diff :
      (1 + γ) * (e - b_loc) - (1 - γ) * (e - b_loc) = 2 * γ * (e - b_loc) := by ring
  have h_final_alg :
      2 * γ * h + 4 * γ * ζ_sh + d₁ + (4 * RHS_star + err_D) +
        (3 - γ) * h + (6 - 2 * γ) * ζ_sh + 6 * ξ +
        Real.log C_E / ell + Real.log C_DE / ell +
        Real.log C_U / ell + Real.log (625 : ℝ) / ell =
      (Real.log ((N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret : ℝ)) / ell) +
        4 * (A_proxy - P_score) +
        ((37 / 2 : ℝ) + γ) * h +
        16 * ζ_sh + 14 * ξ +
        (6 * Real.log K_fac + 4 * Real.log C_R + Real.log C_E + Real.log C_D +
          Real.log C_DE + Real.log C_U + Real.log 625) / ell := by
    dsimp only [RHS_star, err_D, d₁]
    field_simp [hell_ne]
    ring
  linarith only [h_ebloc_2g, h_CMI_lo, h_CMI_hi, h_cmi_diff, h_AB_up, h_final_alg]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hβ_pos : 0 < quantumPacketRate γ) (hβ_le : quantumPacketRate γ ≤ 1)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ)) :
    ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (H_min δ : ℝ),
      0 < H_min → 0 < δ →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L d lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          ε < ε₀ → H_min ≤ H_P → 0 < d → d ≤ L → d ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ d ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ d →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L d cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
            N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
            generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
              quantumPacketRate γ * d + δ

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hβ_le

  
  have h_round_err : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), 0 < s →
      ‖x - gridPt2D s (pktRound2D s x)‖ ≤ s := by
    intro s x hs
    let k0 : ℤ := ⌊s⁻¹ * x 0 + 1 / 2⌋
    let k1 : ℤ := ⌊s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2⌋
    have hk0_lo : (k0 : ℝ) ≤ s⁻¹ * x 0 + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
    have hk0_hi : s⁻¹ * x 0 + 1 / 2 < (k0 : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hk1_lo : (k1 : ℝ) ≤ s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
    have hk1_hi : s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2 < (k1 : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hd0_abs : |x 0 - s * (k0 : ℝ)| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s := by
      have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk0_lo hs.le
      have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk0_hi.le hs.le
      have hdiv : s * (s⁻¹ * x 0 + 1 / 2) = x 0 + (1 / 2) * s := by field_simp [hs.ne']
      have hring : s * ((k0 : ℝ) + 1) = s * (k0 : ℝ) + s := by ring
      rw [hdiv] at hm1
      rw [hdiv, hring] at hm2
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hm1], by linarith only [hm2]⟩
    have hd1_abs : |x 1 - s * (k1 : ℝ)| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s := by
      have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1_lo hs.le
      have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1_hi.le hs.le
      have hdiv : s * (s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2) = x 1 + (1 / 2) * s := by field_simp [hs.ne']
      have hring : s * ((k1 : ℝ) + 1) = s * (k1 : ℝ) + s := by ring
      rw [hdiv] at hm1
      rw [hdiv, hring] at hm2
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hm1], by linarith only [hm2]⟩
    have hd0_sq : (x 0 - s * (k0 : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (x 0 - s * (k0 : ℝ))]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hd0_abs 2
    have hd1_sq : (x 1 - s * (k1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (x 1 - s * (k1 : ℝ))]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hd1_abs 2
    have hsq : ‖x - gridPt2D s (pktRound2D s x)‖ ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [gridPt2D, pktRound2D, PiLp.sub_apply, Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte,
        one_ne_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have hs_sq_nn : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 := sq_nonneg s
      have hhalf_sq : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s) ^ 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith only [hd0_sq, hd1_sq, hs_sq_nn, hhalf_sq]
    have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hs.le] at hsqrt

  
  have h_rescaled_win : ∀ (R_win K_sc ρ_obs ρ_tilde lam_sys C_box : ℝ)
      (M_win : ℕ → ℝ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      0 < ρ_obs → ρ_obs ≤ ρ_tilde → 1 ≤ K_sc → ρ_tilde / ρ_obs ≤ K_sc →
      Continuous Φ₀ → (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
      let κ_sc := ρ_tilde / ρ_obs
      let ψ_tilde : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z => (κ_sc : ℂ) * ψ_o (κ_sc • z)
      let g_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun v =>
        ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_tilde) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_tilde z = 0) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_tilde z‖ ≤ K_sc ^ (k + 1) * max (M_win k) 0) ∧
      Continuous g_o ∧
      (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖V_o‖ + R_win * ρ_obs ≤ ‖v‖ → g_o v = 0) ∧
      (∀ h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
        (ρ_tilde⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          h v * ψ_tilde (ρ_tilde⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          h v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
      (∀ (S : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) (c : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ℂ),
        (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          (∑ q ∈ S, c q * pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v) *
            ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        ∑ q ∈ S, c q *
          ((ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) := by
    intro R_win K_sc ρ_obs ρ_tilde lam_sys C_box M_win V_o X_o Φ₀ ψ_o
      hρ_obs hρ_le hK_sc h_ratio hΦ₀_cont h_pou_smooth hψ_smooth hψ_supp hψ_deriv
    dsimp only
    let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
    let κ_sc : ℝ := ρ_tilde / ρ_obs
    let ψ_tilde : E → ℂ := fun z => (κ_sc : ℂ) * ψ_o (κ_sc • z)
    let g_o : E → ℂ := fun v =>
      ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    have hρ_tilde_pos : 0 < ρ_tilde := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_obs hρ_le
    have hκ_ge1 : 1 ≤ κ_sc := (one_le_div hρ_obs).mpr hρ_le
    have hκ_nn : 0 ≤ κ_sc := by linarith only [hκ_ge1]
    have hK_nn : 0 ≤ K_sc := by linarith only [hK_sc]
    let L_in : E →L[ℝ] E := κ_sc • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E
    have hLin_norm : ‖L_in‖ ≤ K_sc := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound L_in hK_nn (fun x => ?_)
      simp only [L_in, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hκ_nn]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_ratio (norm_nonneg x)
    have hψ_smul : (fun z : E => ((ρ_tilde / ρ_obs : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ_o ((ρ_tilde / ρ_obs) • z)) =
        fun z : E => κ_sc • (ψ_o ∘ L_in) z := by
      ext z
      simp only [κ_sc, L_in, Function.comp_apply, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,
        Complex.real_smul]
    have hg_cont : Continuous g_o := by
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun v : E => ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o))) :=
        (hψ_smooth 0).continuous.comp
          ((continuous_const (y := ρ_obs⁻¹)).smul (continuous_id.sub (continuous_const (y := V_o))))
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun v : E =>
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :=
        Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.mul
            (hΦ₀_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))))))
      exact hc1.mul hc2
