  have hK₄_le : K₄ ≤ K_big :=
    le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _)
      (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))
  have hK₅_le : K₅ ≤ K_big :=
    le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _)
      (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))))
  have h1_le_Kbig : 1 ≤ K_big :=
    le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _)
      (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))))

  let ε₀ : ℝ := min ε_mod (min (1 / 4) (Real.exp (-K_big)))
  have hε₀_pos : 0 < ε₀ := lt_min hε_mod_pos (lt_min (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos _))
  have hε₀_lt : ε₀ < 1 / 2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_lt, ?_⟩

  intro ε H_P L d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ ζ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p
    hε_lt hH_min_le hd_pos hd_le_L hd_le_HP henv hm1 hm2 hadm

  by_cases hd_ge : d_min ≤ d
  · 
    have hε_lt_mod : ε < ε_mod := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_est := h_mod_go ε H_P L d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ ζ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
      b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p hε_lt_mod hd_ge hd_le_L hd_le_HP henv hm1 hm2 hadm
    have hd_le_K : d ≤ cls.K_hor := le_trans hd_le_HP henv.2.2.2.1
    have h_err_le : δ_mod * d ≤ δ / 2 := by
      calc δ_mod * d ≤ δ_mod * cls.K_hor := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_le_K hδ_mod_pos.le
        _ = δ / 2 := by
          dsimp only [δ_mod]
          field_simp [hK_pos.ne']
    linarith only [h_est, h_err_le, hδ]
  · 
    have hd_lt_min : d < d_min := lt_of_not_ge hd_ge
    have hd_lt_δ4 : d < δ / 4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hd_lt_min hd_min_le_δ4
    obtain ⟨hε_pos, hε_half, _, hHP_le_K, _, hL_le_K, hlam_lo, hlam_hi,
      hphase, hf_meas, hf_supp, hf_l2, hf_pos⟩ := henv
    have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith only [hε_half]
    have hε_lt_exp : ε < Real.exp (-K_big) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have hKbig_lt_ell : K_big < ell := by
      have h_inv_gt : (Real.exp (-K_big))⁻¹ < ε⁻¹ := inv_strictAnti₀ hε_pos hε_lt_exp
      rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_inv] at h_inv_gt
      have hlog := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos K_big) h_inv_gt
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at hlog
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_trans h1_le_Kbig hKbig_lt_ell.le)
    have h_exp_decay : ∀ {W α : ℝ}, 0 < W → 0 < α → (Real.log W + 1) / α ≤ K_big →
        W < ε ^ (-α) ∧ W * ε ^ α < 1 := by
      intro W α hW hα hK_le
      have hdiv_lt : (Real.log W + 1) / α < ell := lt_of_le_of_lt hK_le hKbig_lt_ell
      have hmul_lt : Real.log W + 1 < ell * α := (div_lt_iff₀ hα).mp hdiv_lt
      have hlog_lt : Real.log W < Real.log ε * (-α) := by
        have hlog_inv : ell = -Real.log ε := Real.log_inv ε
        rw [hlog_inv] at hmul_lt
        have hneg_mul : -Real.log ε * α = Real.log ε * (-α) := by ring
        linarith only [hmul_lt, hneg_mul]
      have hexp_lt : W < ε ^ (-α) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε_pos (-α), ← Real.exp_log hW]
        exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hlog_lt
      refine ⟨hexp_lt, ?_⟩
      have h_pos_α : 0 < ε ^ α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos α
      calc W * ε ^ α < ε ^ (-α) * ε ^ α := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hexp_lt h_pos_α
        _ = 1 := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]

    have hH_eff_le_HP : H_eff ≤ H_P := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hH_min_le
    have hW₁_lt : W₁ < ε ^ (-H_eff) := (h_exp_decay hW₁_pos hH_eff_pos hK₁_le).1
    have h_rpow_HP : ε ^ (-H_eff) ≤ ε ^ (-H_P) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le (by linarith only [hH_eff_le_HP])
    have hL_req_le_lam : L_req ≤ lam_sys := by
      have h1 : cls.B_sys * L_req ≤ ε ^ (-H_P) := le_trans hW₁_lt.le h_rpow_HP
      have h2 : L_req ≤ cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) := by
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hB_pos.le)
        rwa [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hB_pos.ne', one_mul] at hm
      exact le_trans h2 hlam_lo
    have hlam_ge4 : 4 ≤ lam_sys := le_trans hL_req_ge4 hL_req_le_lam
    have hlam_pos : 0 < lam_sys := by linarith only [hlam_ge4]
    have hlam_ge1 : 1 ≤ lam_sys := by linarith only [hlam_ge4]
    have hlog_lam_ge : 2 * cls.B_sys + 5 ≤ Real.log lam_sys := by
      have hexp_le : Real.exp (2 * cls.B_sys + 5) ≤ lam_sys :=
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hL_req_le_lam
      have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hexp_le
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at hlog

    have hW₂_dec : (4 * C_Bes * C_modes * cls.B_sys ^ 2) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      have h1 := (h_exp_decay hW₂_pos (by norm_num) hK₂_le).2
      dsimp only [W₂] at h1
      linarith only [h1]
    have hW₃_dec : (C_tail M₁ * cls.B_sys ^ (M₁ - 1)) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      have h1 := (h_exp_decay hW₃_pos (by norm_num) hK₃_le).2
      dsimp only [W₃] at h1
      linarith only [h1]
    have hW₄_dec : (2 * C_cnt * C_tail M₂) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) < (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      have h1 := (h_exp_decay hW₄_pos (by norm_num) hK₄_le).2
      have h4Mc_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
      rw [inv_eq_one_div, lt_div_iff₀ h4Mc_pos]
      dsimp only [W₄] at h1
      linarith only [h1]
    have hC_info_div : C_info / ell ≤ δ / 4 := by
      have hdiv_lt : (C_info + 1) / (δ / 4) < ell := lt_of_le_of_lt hK₅_le hKbig_lt_ell
      have hmul_lt : C_info + 1 < ell * (δ / 4) := (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hdiv_lt
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
      linarith only [hmul_lt]

    
    let ρ₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
    let ρ_obs : ℝ := ε ^ ((H_P - d) / 2)
    let ρ_tilde : ℝ := max ρ₀ ρ_obs
    have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam_pos)
    have hρ₀_le1 : ρ₀ ≤ 1 := by
      refine inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ ?_
      have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hlam_ge1
      rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at hs
    have hρ_obs_pos : 0 < ρ_obs := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _
    have hρ_obs_le1 : ρ_obs ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one hε_pos.le hε_lt1.le (by linarith only [hd_le_HP])
    have hρ₀_le_tilde : ρ₀ ≤ ρ_tilde := le_max_left _ _
    have hρ_obs_le_tilde : ρ_obs ≤ ρ_tilde := le_max_right _ _
    have hρ_tilde_le1 : ρ_tilde ≤ 1 := max_le hρ₀_le1 hρ_obs_le1
    have hlam_inv_HP : lam_sys⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ H_P := by
      have h_lhs_pos : 0 < cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) :=
        mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hB_pos) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _)
      have hinv := inv_anti₀ h_lhs_pos hlam_lo
      rwa [mul_inv, inv_inv, ← Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le, neg_neg] at hinv
    have hρ₀_le_sqrtB : ρ₀ ≤ Real.sqrt cls.B_sys * ρ_obs := by
      have h_obs_sq : ρ_obs ^ 2 = ε ^ (H_P - d) := by
        dsimp only [ρ_obs]
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast _ 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
        congr 1
        ring
      have h_HP_le_obs : ε ^ H_P ≤ ρ_obs ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_obs_sq]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le (by linarith only [hd_pos])
      have h_sq_le : ρ₀ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt cls.B_sys * ρ_obs) ^ 2 := by
        have hρ₀_sq : ρ₀ ^ 2 = lam_sys⁻¹ := by
          dsimp only [ρ₀]
          rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hlam_pos.le]
        rw [hρ₀_sq, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hB_pos.le]
        exact le_trans hlam_inv_HP (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_HP_le_obs hB_pos.le)
      have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
      rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hρ₀_pos.le,
        Real.sqrt_sq (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hρ_obs_pos.le)] at hs
    have hsqrtB_ge1 : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt cls.B_sys := by
      have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith only [hB_sys2] : (1 : ℝ) ≤ cls.B_sys)
      rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at hs
    have hsqrtB_le_B : Real.sqrt cls.B_sys ≤ cls.B_sys := by
      have hsq : (Real.sqrt cls.B_sys) ^ 2 ≤ cls.B_sys ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt hB_pos.le]
        nlinarith only [hB_sys2]
      have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
      rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hB_pos.le] at hs
    have h_ratio_sqrtB : ρ_tilde / ρ_obs ≤ Real.sqrt cls.B_sys := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hρ_obs_pos]
      refine max_le hρ₀_le_sqrtB ?_
      calc ρ_obs = 1 * ρ_obs := (one_mul _).symm
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt cls.B_sys * ρ_obs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrtB_ge1 hρ_obs_pos.le
    have hρ₀_le_B_obs : ρ₀ ≤ cls.B_sys * ρ_obs :=
      le_trans hρ₀_le_sqrtB (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrtB_le_B hρ_obs_pos.le)

    
    have hΦ₀_cont : Continuous Φ₀ := (hphase.1 0).continuous
    obtain ⟨hadm_site, hadm_smooth, hadm_supp, hadm_deriv, hadm_pack,
      hadm_D, hadm_p_nn, hadm_p_sum, hadm_p_supp⟩ := hadm
    obtain ⟨hNO_cnt, h_bes⟩ := h_bessel_all ε H_P d lam_sys m_time
      hε_pos hε_half hd_pos.le hd_le_HP hHP_le_K hlam_lo hlam_hi hm1 Φ₀ ζ₀ hphase
      N_O r_O V_O X_O ψ_O hadm_site hadm_smooth hadm_supp hadm_deriv
      (by
        dsimp only
        intro r v₀ x₀
        rw [← Finset.filter_congr_decidable Finset.univ _ (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _)]
        exact hadm_pack r v₀ x₀)
    obtain ⟨h_sum_j, h_parseval, h_pair_exp, h_synth⟩ :=
      h_fourier lam_sys cls.R_dom hlam_ge1 cls.hR_dom Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2
    obtain ⟨F_modes, X_ex, o_root, hF_geom, hF_card, hF_in_root, hF_mult, hF_mass, hF_tail⟩ :=
      h_modes_all lam_sys hlam_ge4 Φ₀ ζ₀ hphase

    let E_f : ℝ := ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2
    let c : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ℂ := fun q => pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2
    let F_bin : Fin M_c → Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := fun m_idx =>
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      F_modes.filter (fun q =>
        ε ^ (((m_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1) * ξ') * E_f ≤ ‖c q‖ ^ 2 ∧
        (m_idx.1 = 0 ∨ ‖c q‖ ^ 2 < ε ^ ((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ') * E_f))
    let h_syn : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
      fun S v => ∑ q ∈ S, c q * pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v
    let m_bin : Fin M_c → Fin N_O → ℝ := fun m_idx o =>
      generalPacketObsMass ε H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ (h_syn (F_bin m_idx))
        (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)

    
    have h_tiny_budget : (4 * C_Bes * C_modes * lam_sys ^ 2) * ε ^ ((M_c : ℝ) * ξ') ≤
        (1 / 16) * ε ^ A'_0 := by
      have hlam_K : lam_sys ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-cls.K_hor) := by
        refine le_trans hlam_hi (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hB_pos.le)
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le (by linarith only [hHP_le_K])
      have hlam_sq : lam_sys ^ 2 ≤ cls.B_sys ^ 2 * ε ^ (-(2 * cls.K_hor)) := by
        have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ hlam_pos.le hlam_K 2
        rw [mul_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast (ε ^ (-cls.K_hor)) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le] at hsq
        have hexp : (-cls.K_hor) * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = -(2 * cls.K_hor) := by push_cast; ring
        rwa [hexp] at hsq
      have hBcut_lt : B'_cut < (M_c : ℝ) * ξ' := by
        have hlt : B'_cut / ξ' < (M_c : ℝ) := by
          dsimp only [M_c]
          push_cast
          exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one (B'_cut / ξ')
        exact (div_lt_iff₀ hξ'_pos).mp hlt
      have hrpow_Mc : ε ^ ((M_c : ℝ) * ξ') ≤
          ε ^ (2 * cls.K_hor) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) * ε ^ A'_0 := by
        have hle := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le hBcut_lt.le
        have hsplit : ε ^ B'_cut = ε ^ (2 * cls.K_hor) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) * ε ^ A'_0 := by
          dsimp only [B'_cut]
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
          congr 1
          ring
        rwa [hsplit] at hle
      have hcancel : ε ^ (-(2 * cls.K_hor)) * ε ^ (2 * cls.K_hor) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
      calc (4 * C_Bes * C_modes * lam_sys ^ 2) * ε ^ ((M_c : ℝ) * ξ')
          ≤ (4 * C_Bes * C_modes * (cls.B_sys ^ 2 * ε ^ (-(2 * cls.K_hor)))) *
              (ε ^ (2 * cls.K_hor) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) * ε ^ A'_0) := by
            refine mul_le_mul ?_ hrpow_Mc (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le (by positivity)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlam_sq (by positivity)
        _ = ((4 * C_Bes * C_modes * cls.B_sys ^ 2) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ)) *
              (ε ^ (-(2 * cls.K_hor)) * ε ^ (2 * cls.K_hor)) * ε ^ A'_0 := by ring
        _ = ((4 * C_Bes * C_modes * cls.B_sys ^ 2) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ)) * ε ^ A'_0 := by
            rw [hcancel, mul_one]
        _ ≤ (1 / 16) * ε ^ A'_0 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hW₂_dec (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le

    have h_compl_M₁_budget : C_tail M₁ * ρ₀ ^ (2 * M₁ - 2) * E_f ≤
        (1 / 16) * (ε ^ A'_0 * E_f) := by
      have h_even : 2 * M₁ - 2 = 2 * (M₁ - 1) := by omega
      have hρ₀_pow : ρ₀ ^ (2 * M₁ - 2) = (lam_sys⁻¹) ^ (M₁ - 1) := by
        rw [h_even, pow_mul]
        congr 1
        dsimp only [ρ₀]
        rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hlam_pos.le]
      have hlam_inv_eff : lam_sys⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ H_eff :=
        le_trans hlam_inv_HP (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le hH_eff_le_HP) hB_pos.le)
      have hM₁_exp : A'_0 + 2 ≤ H_eff * ((M₁ - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        have hceil : (A'_0 + 2) / H_eff ≤ (⌈(A'_0 + 2) / H_eff⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        have hnat : ⌈(A'_0 + 2) / H_eff⌉₊ ≤ M₁ - 1 := by dsimp only [M₁]; omega
        have hcast : (⌈(A'_0 + 2) / H_eff⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ ((M₁ - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
        have hm := (div_le_iff₀ hH_eff_pos).mp (le_trans hceil hcast)
        linarith only [hm]
      have hrpow_M₁ : (ε ^ H_eff) ^ (M₁ - 1) ≤ ε ^ (2 : ℝ) * ε ^ A'_0 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (ε ^ H_eff) (M₁ - 1), ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
        refine le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le hM₁_exp) ?_
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, add_comm]
      have hCM₁_nn : 0 ≤ C_tail M₁ := by linarith only [hCM₁]
      calc C_tail M₁ * ρ₀ ^ (2 * M₁ - 2) * E_f
          = C_tail M₁ * (lam_sys⁻¹) ^ (M₁ - 1) * E_f := by rw [hρ₀_pow]
        _ ≤ C_tail M₁ * (cls.B_sys * ε ^ H_eff) ^ (M₁ - 1) * E_f := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hCM₁_nn) hf_pos.le
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr hlam_pos.le) hlam_inv_eff (M₁ - 1)
        _ = C_tail M₁ * (cls.B_sys ^ (M₁ - 1) * (ε ^ H_eff) ^ (M₁ - 1)) * E_f := by
            rw [mul_pow]
        _ ≤ C_tail M₁ * (cls.B_sys ^ (M₁ - 1) * (ε ^ (2 : ℝ) * ε ^ A'_0)) * E_f := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hCM₁_nn) hf_pos.le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_M₁ (pow_nonneg hB_pos.le _)
        _ = ((C_tail M₁ * cls.B_sys ^ (M₁ - 1)) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ)) * (ε ^ A'_0 * E_f) := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 16) * (ε ^ A'_0 * E_f) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hW₃_dec
              (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le hf_pos.le)

    
    have hF_vel : ∀ q ∈ F_modes, q.1 ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys cls.R_dom :=
      fun q hq => (hF_geom q hq).1
    have h_bin_upper : ∀ (m_idx : Fin M_c), ∀ q ∈ F_bin m_idx,
        q ∈ F_modes ∧
        ε ^ (((m_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1) * ξ') * E_f ≤ ‖c q‖ ^ 2 ∧
        ‖c q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ ((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ') * E_f := by
      intro m_idx q hq
      obtain ⟨hqF, hlo, hhi⟩ := (letI := Classical.propDecidable; Finset.mem_filter.mp hq)
      refine ⟨hqF, hlo, ?_⟩
      rcases hhi with hm0 | hlt
      · rw [hm0, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
        have h1 := h_subset_parseval (pktVelBox lam_sys cls.R_dom) c E_f h_sum_j h_parseval {q}
          (fun x hx => by rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx]; exact hF_vel q hqF)
        simpa using h1
      · exact hlt.le

    have h_root_bin : ∀ (m_idx : Fin M_c), ∀ q ∈ F_bin m_idx,
        o_root q ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys cls.R_dom ∧
        (o_root q).1 = q.1 ∧
        ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ (o_root q).2 - X_ex q‖ ≤ ρ₀ ∧
        ε ^ (((m_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1) * ξ') * E_f ≤
          C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (o_root q) := by
      intro m_idx q hq
      obtain ⟨hqF, hlo, _⟩ := h_bin_upper m_idx q hq
      obtain ⟨_, ho1, ho2⟩ := hF_geom q hqF
      exact ⟨hF_in_root hlog_lam_ge q hqF, ho1, ho2,
        le_trans hlo (hF_mass f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2 q hqF)⟩

    have h_mult_bin : ∀ (m_idx : Fin M_c) (o_r : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
        ((F_bin m_idx).filter (fun q => o_root q = o_r)).card ≤ M_mult_r := by
      intro m_idx o_r
      have hsub : (F_bin m_idx).filter (fun q => o_root q = o_r) ⊆
          F_modes.filter (fun q => o_root q = o_r) := by
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨hqb, hor⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(h_bin_upper m_idx q hqb).1, hor⟩
      exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (hF_mult o_r)

    
    have h_site_Cbox : ∀ (r_idx : ℕ), r_idx < 2 ^ m_time →
        (((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      intro r_idx hr_lt
      have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m_time := by positivity
      have hr_le : (r_idx : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m_time := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hr_lt
      refine ⟨mul_nonneg (by positivity) (inv_nonneg.mpr h2m_pos.le), ?_⟩
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one h2m_pos]
      linarith only [hr_le]

    have h_winner_all : ∀ o : Fin N_O, (∀ m_idx : Fin M_c, 0 ≤ m_bin m_idx o) ∧
        (ε ^ A'_0 * E_f ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
          (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) →
          ∃ m_idx : Fin M_c,
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
              4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2 * m_bin m_idx o) := by
      intro o
      refine ⟨fun m_idx => by unfold m_bin generalPacketObsMass; exact sq_nonneg _, fun hfl_o => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hr_o, hVo_le, hXo_le⟩ := hadm_site o
      let C_o : ℝ := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
      have hCo_mem : C_o ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := h_site_Cbox (r_O o) hr_o
      obtain ⟨hψt_sm, hψt_supp, hψt_der, hgo_cont, hgo_supp, hpair_inv, hpair_lin_o⟩ :=
        h_rescaled_win cls.R_win (Real.sqrt cls.B_sys) ρ_obs ρ_tilde lam_sys C_o cls.M_win
          (V_O o) (X_O o) Φ₀ (ψ_O o) hρ_obs_pos hρ_obs_le_tilde hsqrtB_ge1 h_ratio_sqrtB
          hΦ₀_cont h_pou_smooth (hadm_smooth o) (hadm_supp o) (hadm_deriv o)
      have h_tail_M₁ := (hF_tail M₁ hM₁_ge3 ρ_tilde C_o E_f hρ₀_le_tilde hρ_tilde_le1
        hCo_mem hf_pos.le (V_O o) (X_O o) hVo_le hXo_le _ hψt_sm hψt_supp hψt_der
        f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2).1 h_sum_j h_parseval.le
      let pair_o : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ := fun j n =>
        (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_O o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_o, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have hpair_eq : ∀ j n : ℤ × ℤ,
          (ρ_tilde⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v *
              ((fun z => ((ρ_tilde / ρ_obs : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ_O o ((ρ_tilde / ρ_obs) • z))
                (ρ_tilde⁻¹ • (v - V_O o))) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_o, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          pair_o j n := fun j n => hpair_inv (pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n)
      simp_rw [hpair_eq] at h_tail_M₁
      have h_bes_o : ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          generalPacketObsMass ε H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ h (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
            C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2 := by
        intro h hh_m hh_i
        have hb := h_bes (r_O o) hr_o {o}
          (fun o' ho' => by rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp ho']) h hh_m hh_i
        simpa using hb
      have h_exp_o := (h_pair_exp _ hgo_cont ⟨‖V_O o‖ + cls.R_win * ρ_obs, hgo_supp⟩).2
      have h_win_res := (h_bin_winner ε H_P d lam_sys cls.R_dom ξ' A'_0 E_f C_Bes C_modes
        m_time M_c (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) Φ₀ f (ψ_O o) F_modes
        hε_pos hε_lt1 hξ'_pos hM_c_ge1 hf_pos hC_Bes hF_vel hF_card h_sum_j h_parseval
        h_synth h_bes_o h_tiny_budget).2
      exact h_win_res h_exp_o (fun S => hpair_lin_o S c) h_tail_M₁.1
        (le_trans h_tail_M₁.2 h_compl_M₁_budget) hfl_o

    have h_fiber_all : ∀ (m_idx : Fin M_c) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → a ≤ (H_P - d) / 2 →
        ∀ (r : ℕ), r < 2 ^ m_time →
        ∀ (k_V k_Y : ℤ × ℤ),
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          let C_r := ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
          let S_Z := Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
            r_O o = r ∧
            pktRound2D (ε ^ a) (V_O o) = k_V ∧
            pktRound2D (ε ^ a) (X_O o + (1 / 2 - C_r) • V_O o) = k_Y ∧
            (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ε ^ A'_0 * E_f ≤ m_bin m_idx o)
          let T_Z := (F_bin m_idx).filter (fun q =>
            ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1 - gridPt2D (ε ^ a) k_V‖ ≤ (R'_win + 6) * ε ^ a ∧
            ‖X_ex q - gridPt2D (ε ^ a) k_Y‖ ≤ ε ^ (-η') * ρ₀ + (R'_win + 6) * ε ^ a)
          S_Z.Nonempty →
          T_Z.Nonempty ∧
          ∑ o ∈ S_Z, m_bin m_idx o ≤
            C_fib * (ε ^ ((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ') * E_f) * (T_Z.card : ℝ) := by
      intro m_idx a _ ha_hi r hr k_V k_Y
      let K_up : ℝ := ε ^ ((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ') * E_f
      have hK_up_pos : 0 < K_up := mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _) hf_pos
      let E_far : ℝ := C_tail M₂ * (ε ^ (-η')) ^ (-((2 * M₂ - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * E_f
      have hR_eta_ge1 : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-η') :=
        Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hε_pos hε_lt1.le (by linarith only [hη'_pos])
      have h_pair_lin_all : ∀ (o : Fin N_O) (S : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
          let C_o := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
          (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            (∑ q ∈ S, c q * pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v) *
              ψ_O o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_o, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          ∑ q ∈ S, c q *
            ((ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v * ψ_O o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_o, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
        intro o S
        exact (h_rescaled_win cls.R_win (Real.sqrt cls.B_sys) ρ_obs ρ_tilde lam_sys
          (((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹) cls.M_win
          (V_O o) (X_O o) Φ₀ (ψ_O o) hρ_obs_pos hρ_obs_le_tilde hsqrtB_ge1 h_ratio_sqrtB
          hΦ₀_cont h_pou_smooth (hadm_smooth o) (hadm_supp o) (hadm_deriv o)).2.2.2.2.2.2 S c
      have h_far_tail_r : ∀ (o : Fin N_O), r_O o = r →
          let C_r := ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
          ∀ (S_far : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))), S_far ⊆ F_bin m_idx →
            (∀ q ∈ S_far,
              cls.R_win * ρ_tilde + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1 - V_O o‖ ∨
              ε ^ (-η') * ρ₀ ≤ ‖X_ex q - (X_O o + (1 / 2 - C_r) • gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1)‖) →
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀
              (fun v => ∑ q ∈ S_far, c q * pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v)
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤ E_far := by
        intro o hr_eq _ S_far hS_sub hS_sep
        obtain ⟨hr_o, hVo_le, hXo_le⟩ := hadm_site o
        let C_r := ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
        have hCr_mem : C_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := h_site_Cbox r hr
        obtain ⟨hψt_sm, hψt_supp, hψt_der, _, _, hpair_inv, hpair_lin_o⟩ :=
          h_rescaled_win cls.R_win (Real.sqrt cls.B_sys) ρ_obs ρ_tilde lam_sys C_r cls.M_win
            (V_O o) (X_O o) Φ₀ (ψ_O o) hρ_obs_pos hρ_obs_le_tilde hsqrtB_ge1 h_ratio_sqrtB
            hΦ₀_cont h_pou_smooth (hadm_smooth o) (hadm_supp o) (hadm_deriv o)
        have hS_modes : S_far ⊆ F_modes :=
          fun q hq => (h_bin_upper m_idx q (hS_sub hq)).1
        have hS_energy : ∑ q ∈ S_far, ‖c q‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f :=
          h_subset_parseval (pktVelBox lam_sys cls.R_dom) c E_f h_sum_j h_parseval S_far
            (fun q hq => hF_vel q (hS_modes hq))
        have h_tail_M₂ := (hF_tail M₂ hM₂_ge3 ρ_tilde C_r E_f hρ₀_le_tilde hρ_tilde_le1
          hCr_mem hf_pos.le (V_O o) (X_O o) hVo_le hXo_le _ hψt_sm hψt_supp hψt_der
          f hf_meas hf_supp hf_l2).2 (ε ^ (-η')) hR_eta_ge1 S_far hS_modes hS_sep hS_energy
        have hpair_eq : ∀ j n : ℤ × ℤ,
            (ρ_tilde⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v *
                ((fun z => ((ρ_tilde / ρ_obs : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ_O o ((ρ_tilde / ρ_obs) • z))
                  (ρ_tilde⁻¹ • (v - V_O o))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
            (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_O o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
          fun j n => hpair_inv (pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n)
        simp_rw [hpair_eq] at h_tail_M₂
        unfold generalPacketObsMass
        rw [hr_eq]
        change ‖(ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, (∑ q ∈ S_far, c q * pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v) *
          ψ_O o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_far
        rw [hpair_lin_o S_far c]
        exact h_tail_M₂
      
      have hE_far_nn : 0 ≤ E_far := by
        dsimp only [E_far]
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hCM₂])
          (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _) _).le) hf_pos.le
      have hM₂_exp : B'_cut + 4 * cls.K_hor + 2 ≤ η' * ((2 * M₂ - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        have hceil : (B'_cut + 4 * cls.K_hor + 2) / (2 * η') ≤
            (⌈(B'_cut + 4 * cls.K_hor + 2) / (2 * η')⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        have hnat : 2 * ⌈(B'_cut + 4 * cls.K_hor + 2) / (2 * η')⌉₊ ≤ 2 * M₂ - 2 := by
          dsimp only [M₂]
          omega
        have hcast : 2 * (⌈(B'_cut + 4 * cls.K_hor + 2) / (2 * η')⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤
            ((2 * M₂ - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
        have hm1 := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * η')).mp hceil
        nlinarith only [hm1, hcast, hη'_pos]
      have hR_M₂_le : (ε ^ (-η')) ^ (-((2 * M₂ - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
          ε ^ (4 * cls.K_hor) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) * ε ^ B'_cut := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
        have hprod_eq : (-η') * (-((2 * M₂ - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = η' * ((2 * M₂ - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by ring
        rw [hprod_eq]
        refine le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le hM₂_exp) ?_
        apply le_of_eq
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
        congr 1
        ring
      have h2NO_Efar : 2 * (N_O : ℝ) * E_far ≤
          ((2 * C_cnt * C_tail M₂) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ)) * ε ^ B'_cut * E_f := by
        have hcancel : ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) * ε ^ (4 * cls.K_hor) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
        calc 2 * (N_O : ℝ) * E_far
            ≤ 2 * (C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor))) *
                (C_tail M₂ * (ε ^ (4 * cls.K_hor) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) * ε ^ B'_cut) * E_f) := by
              refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNO_cnt (by norm_num)) ?_
                hE_far_nn (by positivity)
              dsimp only [E_far]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR_M₂_le (by linarith only [hCM₂])) hf_pos.le
          _ = ((2 * C_cnt * C_tail M₂) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ)) *
                (ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) * ε ^ (4 * cls.K_hor)) * ε ^ B'_cut * E_f := by ring
          _ = ((2 * C_cnt * C_tail M₂) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ)) * ε ^ B'_cut * E_f := by
              rw [hcancel, mul_one]
      let C_r := ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
      let S_Z :=
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
          r_O o = r ∧
          pktRound2D (ε ^ a) (V_O o) = k_V ∧
          pktRound2D (ε ^ a) (X_O o + (1 / 2 - C_r) • V_O o) = k_Y ∧
          (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ε ^ A'_0 * E_f ≤ m_bin m_idx o)
      have hSZ_le_NO : (S_Z.card : ℝ) ≤ (N_O : ℝ) := by
        have hnat : S_Z.card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card (letI := Classical.propDecidable; Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        rw [Finset.card_fin] at hnat
        exact_mod_cast hnat
      have hSZ_Efar : 2 * (S_Z.card : ℝ) * E_far ≤ 2 * (N_O : ℝ) * E_far :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSZ_le_NO (by norm_num)) hE_far_nn
      have hBcut_A0 : ε ^ B'_cut ≤ ε ^ A'_0 :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le
          (by dsimp only [B'_cut]; linarith only [hK_pos])
      have h_far_lt_fl : 2 * (S_Z.card : ℝ) * E_far <
          (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ε ^ A'_0 * E_f := by
        have h_strict : ((2 * C_cnt * C_tail M₂) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ)) * (ε ^ B'_cut * E_f) <
            (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (ε ^ B'_cut * E_f) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hW₄_dec (mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _) hf_pos)
        have h_mono : (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (ε ^ B'_cut * E_f) ≤
            (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (ε ^ A'_0 * E_f) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBcut_A0 hf_pos.le) (by positivity)
        linarith only [hSZ_Efar, h2NO_Efar, h_strict, h_mono]
      have h_m_le_Bcut : (m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ' ≤ B'_cut := by
        have hnat : m_idx.1 ≤ ⌊B'_cut / ξ'⌋₊ := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp m_idx.2
        have hcast : (m_idx.1 : ℝ) ≤ (⌊B'_cut / ξ'⌋₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
        have hfl : (⌊B'_cut / ξ'⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ B'_cut / ξ' :=
          Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hB'_cut_nn hξ'_pos.le)
        exact (le_div_iff₀ hξ'_pos).mp (le_trans hcast hfl)
      have hBcut_Kup : ε ^ B'_cut ≤ ε ^ ((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ') :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le h_m_le_Bcut
      have h_far_le_Kup : 2 * (S_Z.card : ℝ) * E_far ≤ K_up := by
        have h4Mc_inv_le1 : (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
          inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith only [hMc_real_ge1])
        have hcoeff_le1 : (2 * C_cnt * C_tail M₂) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 :=
          le_trans hW₄_dec.le h4Mc_inv_le1
        calc 2 * (S_Z.card : ℝ) * E_far
            ≤ ((2 * C_cnt * C_tail M₂) * ε ^ (2 : ℝ)) * ε ^ B'_cut * E_f :=
              le_trans hSZ_Efar h2NO_Efar
          _ ≤ 1 * ε ^ ((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ') * E_f := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hf_pos.le
              exact mul_le_mul hcoeff_le1 hBcut_Kup (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le zero_le_one
          _ = K_up := by dsimp only [K_up]; ring
      exact h_fiber_sep ε H_P d lam_sys cls.B_sys cls.R_win η' A'_0 E_f K_up E_far C_Bes
        m_time N_O M_c r a k_V k_Y Φ₀ r_O V_O X_O ψ_O (F_bin m_idx) X_ex c
        hε_pos hε_lt1 cls.hB_sys cls.hR_win ha_hi hr hK_up_pos hC_Bes hρ₀_le_B_obs
        (fun q hq => (h_bin_upper m_idx q hq).2.2) h_synth (h_bes r hr)
        h_pair_lin_all h_far_tail_r h_far_lt_fl h_far_le_Kup

    
    have hadm_R' : IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L d cls.B_sys R'_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p :=
      ⟨hadm_site, hadm_smooth,
       fun o z hz => hadm_supp o z (le_trans hR_le_R' hz),
       hadm_deriv, hadm_pack, hadm_D, hadm_p_nn, hadm_p_sum, hadm_p_supp⟩
    have h_score_push := h_push ε H_P L d lam_sys m_time hε_pos hε_half
      hd_pos hd_le_L hL_le_K hd_le_HP hHP_le_K hlam_ge4 hlam_lo hm1
      Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont f hf_meas hf_l2 hf_pos N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p
      hadm_R' hNO_cnt F_bin X_ex o_root m_bin h_root_bin h_mult_bin h_winner_all h_fiber_all
    have hβd_pos : 0 < quantumPacketRate γ * d := mul_pos hβ_pos hd_pos
    change generalPacketScore ε γ H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤ _
    linarith only [h_score_push, hd_lt_δ4, hη'_leδ, hξ'_leδ, hC_info_div, hδ, hβd_pos]

subgoal_signatures.name: admissible_packet_fixed_time_bessel
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys K_hor R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hK_hor : 1 ≤ K_hor) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult) :
    ∃ (C_Bes C_cnt : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧ 1 ≤ C_cnt ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ t → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (N_O : ℕ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
        (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ B_sys) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
        (let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
         let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
         ∀ (r : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
             r_O o = r ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤
             (N_mult : ℝ)) →
        ((N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * K_hor))) ∧
        (∀ (r : ℕ), r < 2 ^ m_time →
          ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_O)), (∀ o ∈ S, r_O o = r) →
          ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
            ∑ o ∈ S, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ h
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
              C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: gevrey_partition_and_fourier_synthesis
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ C_χ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_χ ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) ∧
      (∀ (lam_sys R_dom : ℝ), 1 ≤ lam_sys → 1 ≤ R_dom →
        ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
          Continuous Φ₀ →
        ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
            Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2)) ∧
          (∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
            (∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2) =
              ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (∀ (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            Continuous g →
            (∃ R_g : ℝ, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_g ≤ ‖v‖ → g v = 0) →
            (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
                pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n *
                  ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * g v)) ∧
            ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), f v * g v =
              ∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
                ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n *
                  ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * g v) ∧
          (∀ (F : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
              (fun v => ∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun v => ‖∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              ‖∑ q ∈ F, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 *
                pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ q.1 q.2 v‖ ^ 2) ≤
              4 * ∑ q ∈ F, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2))

subgoal_signatures.name: root_mode_bijection_and_transport_tail
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys R_win C_χ : ℝ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom) (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hC_χ : 1 ≤ C_χ)
    (h_pou_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k pktPou2D)
    (h_pou_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → pktPou2D z = 0)
    (h_pou_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k pktPou2D z‖ ≤ C_χ ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    ∃ (C_can C_modes : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tail : ℕ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ C_can ∧ 1 ≤ C_modes ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧ (∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ C_tail M) ∧
      ∀ (lam_sys : ℝ), 4 ≤ lam_sys →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∃ (F_modes : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
        (X_ex : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (o_root : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        (∀ q ∈ F_modes, q.1 ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom ∧
          (o_root q).1 = q.1 ∧ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ (o_root q).2 - X_ex q‖ ≤ ρ₀) ∧
        ((F_modes.card : ℝ) ≤ C_modes * lam_sys ^ 2) ∧
        (2 * B_sys + 5 ≤ Real.log lam_sys →
          ∀ q ∈ F_modes, o_root q ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom) ∧
        (∀ o_r : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
          (F_modes.filter (fun q => o_root q = o_r)).card ≤ M_mult) ∧
        (∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          ∀ q ∈ F_modes,
            ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤
              C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (o_root q)) ∧
        (∀ (M : ℕ), 3 ≤ M →
          ∀ (ρ_obs C_box E_f : ℝ),
            ρ₀ ≤ ρ_obs → ρ_obs ≤ 1 → C_box ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ E_f →
          ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ‖V_o‖ ≤ B_sys → ‖X_o‖ ≤ B_sys →
          ∀ (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
            (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
          ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
            MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          let pair_o : (ℤ × ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℂ := fun j n =>
            (ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              pktLinearAtom lam_sys Φ₀ j n v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (((∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ => ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2)) →
            (∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n‖ ^ 2) ≤ E_f →
            (∀ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              Summable (fun n : ℤ × ℤ =>
                if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ)
                else pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n * pair_o j n)) ∧
            ‖∑ j ∈ pktVelBox lam_sys R_dom,
              ∑' n : ℤ × ℤ,
                if (j, n) ∈ F_modes then (0 : ℂ)
                else pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f j n * pair_o j n‖ ^ 2 ≤
              C_tail M * ρ₀ ^ (2 * M - 2) * E_f) ∧
           (∀ (R : ℝ), 1 ≤ R →
             ∀ (S_far : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))), S_far ⊆ F_modes →
               (∀ q ∈ S_far,
                 R_win * ρ_obs + 2 * ρ₀ ≤ ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1 - V_o‖ ∨
                 R * ρ₀ ≤ ‖X_ex q - (X_o + (1 / 2 - C_box) • gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1)‖) →
               (∑ q ∈ S_far, ‖pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ E_f) →
               ‖∑ q ∈ S_far, pktLinearCoeff lam_sys Φ₀ f q.1 q.2 * pair_o q.1 q.2‖ ^ 2 ≤
                 C_tail M * R ^ (-((2 * M - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * E_f)))

subgoal_signatures.name: contributor_backward_push_score_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ R_dom B_sys K_hor R_win η ξ A₀ C_cnt C_can C_fib : ℝ)
    (N_mult M_mult M_c : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom) (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hK_hor : 1 ≤ K_hor) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win)
    (hη₀ : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1 / 8) (hξ₀ : 0 < ξ) (hξ₁ : ξ ≤ 1 / 8)
    (hA₀ : 6 * K_hor + 2 ≤ A₀)
    (hC_cnt : 1 ≤ C_cnt) (hC_can : 1 ≤ C_can) (hC_fib : 1 ≤ C_fib)
    (hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hM_c : 1 ≤ M_c) :
    ∃ C_info : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_info ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        0 < t → t ≤ L → L ≤ K_hor → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor →
        4 ≤ lam_sys →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
        Continuous Φ₀ →
      ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
        0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2 →
      ∀ (N_O N_D : ℕ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
        (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
          lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        ((N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * K_hor))) →
      ∀ (F_bin : Fin M_c → Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
        (X_ex : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (o_root : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)))
        (m_bin : Fin M_c → Fin N_O → ℝ),
        let E_f := ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2
        let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
        (∀ (m_idx : Fin M_c), ∀ q ∈ F_bin m_idx,
          o_root q ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom ∧
          (o_root q).1 = q.1 ∧
          ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ (o_root q).2 - X_ex q‖ ≤ ρ₀ ∧
          ε ^ (((m_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1) * ξ) * E_f ≤
            C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (o_root q)) →
        (∀ (m_idx : Fin M_c) (o_r : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
          ((F_bin m_idx).filter (fun q => o_root q = o_r)).card ≤ M_mult) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, (∀ m_idx : Fin M_c, 0 ≤ m_bin m_idx o) ∧
          (ε ^ A₀ * E_f ≤ generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
            (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) →
            ∃ m_idx : Fin M_c,
              generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
                (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
                4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2 * m_bin m_idx o)) →
        (∀ (m_idx : Fin M_c) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → a ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
          ∀ (r : ℕ), r < 2 ^ m_time →
          ∀ (k_V k_Y : ℤ × ℤ),
            letI := Classical.propDecidable
            let C_r := ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
            let S_Z := Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
              r_O o = r ∧
              pktRound2D (ε ^ a) (V_O o) = k_V ∧
              pktRound2D (ε ^ a) (X_O o + (1 / 2 - C_r) • V_O o) = k_Y ∧
              (4 * (M_c : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ε ^ A₀ * E_f ≤ m_bin m_idx o)
            let T_Z := (F_bin m_idx).filter (fun q =>
              ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ q.1 - gridPt2D (ε ^ a) k_V‖ ≤ (R_win + 6) * ε ^ a ∧
              ‖X_ex q - gridPt2D (ε ^ a) k_Y‖ ≤ ε ^ (-η) * ρ₀ + (R_win + 6) * ε ^ a)
            S_Z.Nonempty →
            T_Z.Nonempty ∧
            ∑ o ∈ S_Z, m_bin m_idx o ≤
              C_fib * (ε ^ ((m_idx.1 : ℝ) * ξ) * E_f) * (T_Z.card : ℝ)) →
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f
          N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            t + 5 * η + 4 * ξ + C_info / Real.log (ε⁻¹)

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (A₀ ξ R_bud C_cut : ℝ)
    (use_vel_sub : Bool) (d_dim M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr_cut : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hR_bud : 128 * ξ ≤ R_bud)
    (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hC_cut : 2 ≤ C_cut) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr_cut M) :
    let B_cut := A₀ + 12 * cls.K_hor + 20
    ∃ (C_cov ε_menu : ℝ),
      max 2 C_cut ≤ C_cov ∧ 0 < ε_menu ∧ ε_menu < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (M_L : ℕ) (ε H_P L t r h b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t : ℕ)
        (j₀ : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_atom : ℕ) (o_atom : Fin N_atom → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (ψ_atom : Fin N_atom → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (c_atom : Fin N_atom → ℂ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((j₀.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v j₀.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x j₀.2.2
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (o_atom α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (o_atom α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_atom α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        1 ≤ M_L → 0 < ε → ε < ε_menu → 0 < lam_sys → 1 ≤ N_atom →
        (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ L → L ≤ cls.K_hor → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ cls.K_hor →
        (use_vel_sub = true → 0 < h ∧ r = t - 2 * h) →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ L - t → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        j₀.1 < 2 ^ m_r → m_r ≤ m_t →
        ‖V_J‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys → ‖X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys →
        ((N_atom : ℝ) ≤ C_cut * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor + 4))) →
        (∀ α, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_atom α)) ∧
          (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_atom α z = 0) ∧
          (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_atom α) z‖ ≤
            M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k)) →
        (∀ α, ‖V_at α - V_J‖ ≤ (4 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4) * s_v ∧
          ‖X_at α - X_J‖ ≤ (8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10) * s_x) →
        (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => o_atom α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) →
        (∀ α, ε ^ B_cut ≤ ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) →
        (∑ α : Fin N_atom, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) →
        (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
          let C_t := (((j₀.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v →
            ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x →
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
            (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
            (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
            let pair_fn := fun h_in : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ =>
              (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h_in v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
            ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (M_tr : ℕ) (R_tr : ℝ), 2 ≤ M_tr → 2 ≤ R_tr →
              let S_near := S.filter (fun α =>
                ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t ∧
                ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * R_tr * σ_r)
              ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v) -
               pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                C_tr_cut M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ))) →
        ∃ (S_loc : ℕ) (N_all_loc N_ret_loc : Fin S_loc → ℕ)
          (whole_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, LocalizerSubclass (N_all_loc s))
          (sub_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_loc s))
          (emb_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_ret_loc s) → Fin (N_all_loc s))
          (idx_all : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_all_loc s) → Fin N_atom)
          (idx_ret : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_ret_loc s) → Fin N_atom),
          1 ≤ S_loc ∧
          Real.log (S_loc : ℝ) / ell ≤ R_bud / 64 ∧
          (∀ v, ∑ α : Fin N_atom, c_atom α * g_at α v =
            ∑ s : Fin S_loc, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_loc s),
              (sub_loc s).c_at α *
                ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star ((sub_loc s).ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1))) *
                  Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))) ∧
          ∀ s : Fin S_loc,
            (sub_loc s).loc_idx = j₀ ∧ (whole_loc s).loc_idx = j₀ ∧
            (sub_loc s).N_all = N_all_loc s ∧ (whole_loc s).N_all = N_all_loc s ∧
            Function.Injective (emb_loc s) ∧ Function.Injective (idx_all s) ∧
            Function.Injective (idx_ret s) ∧
            (∀ α, idx_ret s α = idx_all s (emb_loc s α)) ∧
            (∀ β, (whole_loc s).o_at β = o_atom (idx_all s β) ∧
              (whole_loc s).ψ_at β = ψ_atom (idx_all s β) ∧
              (whole_loc s).c_at β = c_atom (idx_all s β)) ∧
            (sub_loc s).m_bin = (whole_loc s).m_bin ∧
            (sub_loc s).g_bin = (whole_loc s).g_bin ∧
            (sub_loc s).b_loc = (whole_loc s).b_loc ∧
            (sub_loc s).a_loc = (whole_loc s).a_loc ∧
            (∀ α, (sub_loc s).o_at α = (whole_loc s).o_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).ψ_at α = (whole_loc s).ψ_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).c_at α = (whole_loc s).c_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).cap_id α = (whole_loc s).cap_id (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).e_cap α = (whole_loc s).e_cap (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).V_cap α = (whole_loc s).V_cap (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).X_cap α = (whole_loc s).X_cap (emb_loc s α)) ∧
            IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
              m_r m_t M_mult (fun M => 2 * C_tr_cut M) Φ₀ (sub_loc s) ∧
            IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
              m_r m_t M_mult (fun M => 2 * C_tr_cut M) Φ₀ (whole_loc s) ∧
            (∀ β : Fin (N_all_loc s),
              ε ^ (-(whole_loc s).g_bin + pktWeight γ (whole_loc s).b_loc (whole_loc s).a_loc + ξ) ≤
                ((Finset.univ.filter (fun β' : Fin (N_all_loc s) =>
                  (whole_loc s).cap_id β' = (whole_loc s).cap_id β)).card : ℝ)) ∧
            2 * min (L - r - b_star) ((H_P - r) / 2 - b_star) - R_bud ≤ (sub_loc s).g_bin ∧
            (use_vel_sub = false → N_ret_loc s = N_all_loc s) ∧
            (use_vel_sub = true →
              (∃ m_k : ℕ, m_k < Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3 ∧
                (sub_loc s).k_bin = (m_k : ℝ) * ξ) ∧
              (d_dim = 1 → ∀ α : Fin (N_ret_loc s),
                let p_c := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                  (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2)
                ((sub_loc s).is_aligned = true ↔
                  projAngleDist (perp2D ((sub_loc s).e_cap α)) (n_fine p_c) ≤ 2 * ε ^ h)) ∧
              (∀ p_c w,
                ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_ret_loc s) =>
                  let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2)
                  p_at = p_c ∧
                  fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) = w)).card : ℝ) ≤
                ε ^ ((sub_loc s).k_bin - ξ) *
                  ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_ret_loc s) =>
                    atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                      (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2) =
                      p_c)).card : ℝ)) ∧
              (∀ p_buf,
                (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin (N_ret_loc s) =>
                  let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1) (gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2)
                  (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at
                    (gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1)))).filter
                    (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
                ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-((sub_loc s).k_bin + ξ))))

        (c_atom : Fin N_atom → ℂ),

        ‖V_J‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys → ‖X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys →

            ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (M_tr : ℕ) (R_tr : ℝ), 2 ≤ M_tr → 2 ≤ R_tr →

              ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v) -
               pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                C_tr_cut M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ))) →
        ∃ (S_loc : ℕ) (N_all_loc N_ret_loc : Fin S_loc → ℕ)

          (idx_ret : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_ret_loc s) → Fin N_atom),
          1 ≤ S_loc ∧
          Real.log (S_loc : ℝ) / ell ≤ R_bud / 64 ∧
          (∀ v, ∑ α : Fin N_atom, c_atom α * g_at α v =
            ∑ s : Fin S_loc, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_loc s),
              (sub_loc s).c_at α *
                ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star ((sub_loc s).ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).1))) *
                  Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r ((sub_loc s).o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))) ∧
          ∀ s : Fin S_loc,

            Function.Injective (emb_loc s) ∧ Function.Injective (idx_all s) ∧

            (sub_loc s).m_bin = (whole_loc s).m_bin ∧
            (sub_loc s).g_bin = (whole_loc s).g_bin ∧
            (sub_loc s).b_loc = (whole_loc s).b_loc ∧
            (sub_loc s).a_loc = (whole_loc s).a_loc ∧
            (∀ α, (sub_loc s).o_at α = (whole_loc s).o_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).ψ_at α = (whole_loc s).ψ_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).c_at α = (whole_loc s).c_at (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).cap_id α = (whole_loc s).cap_id (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).e_cap α = (whole_loc s).e_cap (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).V_cap α = (whole_loc s).V_cap (emb_loc s α) ∧
              (sub_loc s).X_cap α = (whole_loc s).X_cap (emb_loc s α)) ∧
            IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
              m_r m_t M_mult (fun M => 2 * C_tr_cut M) Φ₀ (sub_loc s) ∧
            IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
              m_r m_t M_mult (fun M => 2 * C_tr_cut M) Φ₀ (whole_loc s) ∧
            (∀ β : Fin (N_all_loc s),
              ε ^ (-(whole_loc s).g_bin + pktWeight γ (whole_loc s).b_loc (whole_loc s).a_loc + ξ) ≤
                ((Finset.univ.filter (fun β' : Fin (N_all_loc s) =>
                  (whole_loc s).cap_id β' = (whole_loc s).cap_id β)).card : ℝ)) ∧
            2 * min (L - r - b_star) ((H_P - r) / 2 - b_star) - R_bud ≤ (sub_loc s).g_bin ∧
            (use_vel_sub = false → N_ret_loc s = N_all_loc s) ∧
            (use_vel_sub = true →
              (∃ m_k : ℕ, m_k < Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3 ∧
                (sub_loc s).k_bin = (m_k : ℝ) * ξ) ∧
              (d_dim = 1 → ∀ α : Fin (N_ret_loc s),

              (∀ p_buf,

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have anisotropic_cap_menu_and_covering :
      ∀ (γ ε ξ W_max R_dom : ℝ)
        (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
        (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
        (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hW₀ : 0 < W_max) (hR_dom : 1 ≤ R_dom)
        (N : ℕ) (V' X' : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (h_dom : ∀ α : Fin N, ‖V' α‖ ≤ R_dom ∧ ‖X' α‖ ≤ R_dom),
        let N_w : ℕ := Nat.ceil (W_max / (ξ / 4))
        let w_of : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => min ((i : ℝ) * (ξ / 4)) W_max
        ∃ (M_menu : ℕ)
          (ib_menu ia_menu : Fin M_menu → ℕ)
          (e_menu V_menu X_menu : Fin M_menu → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          let b_menu := fun κ : Fin M_menu => w_of (ib_menu κ)
          let a_menu := fun κ : Fin M_menu => w_of (ia_menu κ)
          let in_cap := fun (κ : Fin M_menu) (α : Fin N) =>
            |inner ℝ (V' α - V_menu κ) (e_menu κ)| ≤ ε ^ (b_menu κ) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V' α - V_menu κ) (perp2D (e_menu κ))| ≤ ε ^ (a_menu κ) ∧
            |inner ℝ (X' α - X_menu κ) (e_menu κ)| ≤ ε ^ (b_menu κ) ∧
            |inner ℝ (X' α - X_menu κ) (perp2D (e_menu κ))| ≤ ε ^ (a_menu κ)
          1 ≤ M_menu ∧
          (∀ κ : Fin M_menu,
            ib_menu κ ≤ ia_menu κ ∧ ia_menu κ ≤ N_w ∧
            0 ≤ b_menu κ ∧ b_menu κ ≤ a_menu κ ∧ a_menu κ ≤ W_max ∧
            ‖e_menu κ‖ = 1) ∧
          (∀ α : Fin N, ∃ κ : Fin M_menu,
            ib_menu κ = N_w ∧ ia_menu κ = N_w ∧
            b_menu κ = W_max ∧ a_menu κ = W_max ∧ in_cap κ α) ∧
          (∀ (b_F a_F R_F : ℝ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
             (S_F : Finset (Fin N)),
            0 ≤ b_F → b_F ≤ a_F → a_F ≤ W_max → 1 ≤ R_F → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
            (∀ α ∈ S_F,
              |inner ℝ (V' α - V_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (V' α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (X' α - X_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (X' α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F) →
            ∃ M_cov : Finset (Fin M_menu),
              (M_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ (R_dom + 9) ^ 4 * R_F ^ 4 ∧
              (∀ κ ∈ M_cov, pktWeight γ b_F a_F - ξ / 2 ≤ pktWeight γ (b_menu κ) (a_menu κ)) ∧
              (∀ α ∈ S_F, ∃ κ ∈ M_cov, in_cap κ α)) := by
    clear hC_tr hM_mult hC_cut hd_dim hR_bud hξ hA₀ C_tr_cut M_mult d_dim use_vel_sub
      C_cut R_bud ξ A₀ cls M_atom hγ₁ hγ₀ γ
    intro γ ε ξ W_max R_dom hγ₀ hγ₁ hε₀ hε₁ hξ hW₀ hR_dom N V' X' h_dom N_w w_of
    have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith
    have hδw : 0 < ξ / 4 := by linarith
    have h_inner2 : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ x y = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
      intro x y
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [mul_comm]
    have h_norm_sq2 : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        sq_abs, sq_abs]
    have h_perp_norm : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖perp2D u‖ = ‖u‖ := by
      intro u
      have hsq : ‖perp2D u‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq2, h_norm_sq2]
        simp [perp2D]
        ring
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D u), norm_nonneg u]
    have h_perp_sub : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), perp2D (u - v) = perp2D u - perp2D v := by
      intro u v
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simp [perp2D]; ring
      · simp [perp2D]
    have h_onb : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ = 1 →
        ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ),
          inner ℝ (z - (c₁ • u + c₂ • perp2D u)) u = inner ℝ z u - c₁ ∧
          inner ℝ (z - (c₁ • u + c₂ • perp2D u)) (perp2D u) = inner ℝ z (perp2D u) - c₂ := by
      intro u hu z c₁ c₂
      have hu_sq : (u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [← h_norm_sq2 u, hu, one_pow]
      constructor
      · rw [h_inner2, h_inner2]
        simp only [perp2D, WithLp.ofLp_toLp, ↓reduceIte, Fin.one_eq_zero_iff]
        calc (z 0 - (c₁ * u 0 + c₂ * -u 1)) * u 0 + (z 1 - (c₁ * u 1 + c₂ * u 0)) * u 1
            = z 0 * u 0 + z 1 * u 1 - c₁ * ((u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2) := by ring
          _ = z 0 * u 0 + z 1 * u 1 - c₁ := by rw [hu_sq, mul_one]
      · rw [h_inner2, h_inner2]
        simp only [perp2D, WithLp.ofLp_toLp, ↓reduceIte, Fin.one_eq_zero_iff]
        calc (z 0 - (c₁ * u 0 + c₂ * -u 1)) * -u 1 + (z 1 - (c₁ * u 1 + c₂ * u 0)) * u 0
            = z 0 * -u 1 + z 1 * u 0 - c₂ * ((u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2) := by ring
          _ = z 0 * -u 1 + z 1 * u 0 - c₂ := by rw [hu_sq, mul_one]

    have hw_nn : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ w_of i := fun i =>
      le_min (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg i) hδw.le) hW₀.le
    have hw_le_max : ∀ i : ℕ, w_of i ≤ W_max := fun i => min_le_right _ _
    have hw_mono : ∀ {i j : ℕ}, i ≤ j → w_of i ≤ w_of j := by
      intro i j hij
      exact min_le_min_right W_max (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hij) hδw.le)
    have hw_Nw : w_of N_w = W_max := by
      refine min_eq_right ?_
      exact (div_le_iff₀ hδw).mp (Nat.le_ceil (W_max / (ξ / 4)))
    let idx_w : ℝ → ℕ := fun x => Nat.floor (x / (ξ / 4))
    have h_idx_w : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ W_max →
        idx_w x ≤ N_w ∧ w_of (idx_w x) ≤ x ∧ x - w_of (idx_w x) ≤ ξ / 4 := by
      intro x hx₀ hxW
      have hdiv_nn : 0 ≤ x / (ξ / 4) := div_nonneg hx₀ hδw.le
      have hdiv_le : x / (ξ / 4) ≤ (N_w : ℝ) :=
        le_trans ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hδw).mpr hxW) (Nat.le_ceil _)
      have hi_le_Nw : idx_w x ≤ N_w := by
        have hfl := Nat.floor_mono hdiv_le
        rwa [Nat.floor_natCast] at hfl
      have hmul_le : (idx_w x : ℝ) * (ξ / 4) ≤ x :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hδw).mp (Nat.floor_le hdiv_nn)
      have hwof_eq : w_of (idx_w x) = (idx_w x : ℝ) * (ξ / 4) :=
        min_eq_left (le_trans hmul_le hxW)
      have hlt_succ : x < ((idx_w x : ℝ) + 1) * (ξ / 4) :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hδw).mp (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (x / (ξ / 4)))
      refine ⟨hi_le_Nw, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hwof_eq]; exact hmul_le
      · rw [hwof_eq]; linarith

    have hεW_pos : 0 < ε ^ W_max := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ W_max
    have hεnegW_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-W_max) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-W_max)
    have hεnegW_gt1 : 1 < ε ^ (-W_max) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ < ε ^ (-W_max) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt hε₀ hε_lt1 (by linarith)
    let K_net : ℕ := Nat.ceil (8 * ε ^ (-W_max)) + 2
    let I_net : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-(K_net : ℤ)) (K_net : ℤ)
    let Lat_box : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := (I_net ×ˢ I_net).erase (0, 0)
    let p_def : ℤ × ℤ := ((K_net : ℤ), 0)
    have hp_def_mem : p_def ∈ Lat_box := by
      refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h
        have h1 : (K_net : ℤ) = 0 := congr_arg Prod.fst h
        omega
      · simp only [p_def, I_net, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc]
        omega

    have h_lat_norm_pos : ∀ p ∈ Lat_box, 0 < ‖gridPt2D 1 p‖ := by
      intro p hp
      have hp_ne : p ≠ (0, 0) := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hp).1
      have hsq_ge1_int : (1 : ℤ) ≤ p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 := by
        have h_nz_sq : ∀ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ z ^ 2 := by
          intro z hz
          rcases lt_trichotomy z 0 with hlt | rfl | hgt
          · nlinarith
          · exact False.elim (hz rfl)
          · nlinarith
        rcases p with ⟨p₁, p₂⟩
        dsimp only
        by_cases h₁ : p₁ = 0
        · have h₂ : p₂ ≠ 0 := fun h₂ => hp_ne (Prod.ext h₁ h₂)
          linarith [h_nz_sq p₂ h₂, sq_nonneg p₁]
        · linarith [h_nz_sq p₁ h₁, sq_nonneg p₂]
      have hsq_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖gridPt2D 1 p‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq2]
        simp only [gridPt2D, WithLp.ofLp_toLp, ↓reduceIte, Fin.one_eq_zero_iff, one_mul]
        exact_mod_cast hsq_ge1_int
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (gridPt2D 1 p)]

    let u_of_lat : (ℤ × ℤ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun p => ‖gridPt2D 1 p‖⁻¹ • gridPt2D 1 p
    have hu_norm : ∀ p ∈ Lat_box, ‖u_of_lat p‖ = 1 := by
      intro p hp
      have hpos := h_lat_norm_pos p hp
      dsimp only [u_of_lat]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hpos), inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']

    have h_net_approx : ∀ e_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
        ∃ p ∈ Lat_box,
          ‖u_of_lat p - e_F‖ ≤ (1 / 4) * ε ^ W_max ∧
          ‖perp2D (u_of_lat p) - perp2D e_F‖ ≤ (1 / 4) * ε ^ W_max := by
      intro e_F he_F
      let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := (K_net : ℝ) • e_F
      have hw_norm : ‖w‖ = (K_net : ℝ) := by
        dsimp only [w]
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg K_net), he_F, mul_one]
      let p : ℤ × ℤ := (Int.floor (w 0 + 1 / 2), Int.floor (w 1 + 1 / 2))
      have h_coord : ∀ (x : ℝ), |x| ≤ (K_net : ℝ) →
          Int.floor (x + 1 / 2) ∈ I_net ∧ |x - (Int.floor (x + 1 / 2) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨hx_lo, hx_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hx
        let k := Int.floor (x + 1 / 2)
        have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ x + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le (x + 1 / 2)
        have hk_lt : x + 1 / 2 < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x + 1 / 2)
        have hk_ge_K : -(K_net : ℤ) ≤ k := by
          refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
          push_cast
          linarith
        have hk_lt_K1 : k < (K_net : ℤ) + 1 := by
          refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
          push_cast
          linarith
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hk_ge_K, by omega⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
      have hw0_abs : |w 0| ≤ (K_net : ℝ) := by
        calc |w 0| = ‖w 0‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖w‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le w 0
          _ = (K_net : ℝ) := hw_norm
      have hw1_abs : |w 1| ≤ (K_net : ℝ) := by
        calc |w 1| = ‖w 1‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖w‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le w 1
          _ = (K_net : ℝ) := hw_norm
      obtain ⟨hp0_mem, hp0_err⟩ := h_coord (w 0) hw0_abs
      obtain ⟨hp1_mem, hp1_err⟩ := h_coord (w 1) hw1_abs
      let g := gridPt2D 1 p
      have hwg_le1 : ‖w - g‖ ≤ 1 := by
        have hsq : ‖w - g‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
          rw [h_norm_sq2]
          obtain ⟨l0, u0⟩ := abs_le.mp hp0_err
          obtain ⟨l1, u1⟩ := abs_le.mp hp1_err
          simp [g, gridPt2D, p]
          nlinarith
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (w - g)]
      have hg_ge : 8 * ε ^ (-W_max) < ‖g‖ := by
        have htri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖g‖ + ‖w - g‖ := by
          calc ‖w‖ = ‖g + (w - g)‖ := by abel_nf
            _ ≤ ‖g‖ + ‖w - g‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        have hceil : 8 * ε ^ (-W_max) ≤ (Nat.ceil (8 * ε ^ (-W_max)) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        have hK_eq : (K_net : ℝ) = (Nat.ceil (8 * ε ^ (-W_max)) : ℝ) + 2 := by
          dsimp only [K_net]; push_cast; ring
        linarith
      have hg_pos : 0 < ‖g‖ := lt_trans (by positivity) hg_ge
      have hp_mem : p ∈ Lat_box := by
        refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hp0_mem, hp1_mem⟩⟩
        intro hp00
        have hg0 : g = 0 := by
          ext i
          fin_cases i <;> simp [g, gridPt2D, hp00]
        rw [hg0, norm_zero] at hg_pos
        exact lt_irrefl 0 hg_pos
      have herr : ‖u_of_lat p - e_F‖ ≤ (1 / 4) * ε ^ W_max := by
        have h_id : u_of_lat p - e_F = ‖g‖⁻¹ • ((g - w) + ((K_net : ℝ) - ‖g‖) • e_F) := by
          have hnz : ‖gridPt2D 1 p‖ ≠ 0 := hg_pos.ne'
          ext i
          simp [u_of_lat, g, w]
          field_simp [hnz]
          ring
        have h_norm_diff : |(K_net : ℝ) - ‖g‖| ≤ 1 := by
          rw [← hw_norm]
          exact le_trans (abs_norm_sub_norm_le w g) hwg_le1
        have h_num_le2 : ‖(g - w) + ((K_net : ℝ) - ‖g‖) • e_F‖ ≤ 2 := by
          calc ‖(g - w) + ((K_net : ℝ) - ‖g‖) • e_F‖
              ≤ ‖g - w‖ + ‖((K_net : ℝ) - ‖g‖) • e_F‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖w - g‖ + |(K_net : ℝ) - ‖g‖| * ‖e_F‖ := by
                rw [norm_sub_rev, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            _ ≤ 1 + 1 * 1 := by
                rw [he_F]
                linarith
            _ = 2 := by norm_num
        rw [h_id, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hg_pos)]
        have h_inv_le : ‖g‖⁻¹ ≤ (8 * ε ^ (-W_max))⁻¹ :=
          (inv_le_inv₀ hg_pos (by positivity)).mpr hg_ge.le
        calc ‖g‖⁻¹ * ‖(g - w) + ((K_net : ℝ) - ‖g‖) • e_F‖
            ≤ (8 * ε ^ (-W_max))⁻¹ * 2 :=
              mul_le_mul h_inv_le h_num_le2 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = (1 / 4) * ε ^ W_max := by
              rw [mul_inv, Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le, inv_inv]
              ring
      refine ⟨p, hp_mem, herr, ?_⟩
      rw [← h_perp_sub, h_perp_norm]
      exact herr

    let B_ctr : ℤ := (Nat.ceil (R_dom * ε ^ (-W_max)) : ℤ) + 2
    let I_ctr : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-B_ctr) B_ctr
    let W_pairs : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
      (Finset.range (N_w + 1) ×ˢ Finset.range (N_w + 1)).filter (fun ij => ij.1 ≤ ij.2)
    let CtrBox : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := (I_ctr ×ˢ I_ctr) ×ˢ (I_ctr ×ˢ I_ctr)
    let MenuSet : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℤ × ℤ) × ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) :=
      W_pairs ×ˢ (Lat_box ×ˢ CtrBox)
    have h0_Ictr : (0 : ℤ) ∈ I_ctr := by
      simp only [I_ctr, B_ctr, Finset.mem_Icc]
      omega
    have hMenu_ne : MenuSet.Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨((0, 0), (p_def, ((0, 0), (0, 0)))), ?_⟩
      simp only [MenuSet, W_pairs, CtrBox, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, le_rfl⟩, hp_def_mem, ⟨h0_Ictr, h0_Ictr⟩, ⟨h0_Ictr, h0_Ictr⟩⟩

    let M_menu : ℕ := MenuSet.card
    have hM_pos : 1 ≤ M_menu := Finset.one_le_card.mpr hMenu_ne
    let eM : { x // x ∈ MenuSet } ≃ Fin M_menu := MenuSet.equivFin
    let tup_of : Fin M_menu → (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℤ × ℤ) × ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
      fun κ => (eM.symm κ).1
    let ib_menu : Fin M_menu → ℕ := fun κ => (tup_of κ).1.1
    let ia_menu : Fin M_menu → ℕ := fun κ => (tup_of κ).1.2
    let e_menu : Fin M_menu → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun κ => u_of_lat (tup_of κ).2.1
    let V_menu : Fin M_menu → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun κ =>
      let u := u_of_lat (tup_of κ).2.1
      let nV := (tup_of κ).2.2.1
      ((nV.1 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of (ib_menu κ))) • u +
        ((nV.2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of (ia_menu κ))) • perp2D u
    let X_menu : Fin M_menu → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun κ =>
      let u := u_of_lat (tup_of κ).2.1
      let nX := (tup_of κ).2.2.2
      ((nX.1 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of (ib_menu κ))) • u +
        ((nX.2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of (ia_menu κ))) • perp2D u

    have h_round : ∀ (z v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (s : ℝ),
        ‖z‖ ≤ R_dom → ‖v‖ = 1 → ε ^ W_max ≤ s →
        let k := Int.floor (inner ℝ z v / s + 1 / 2)
        k ∈ I_ctr ∧ |inner ℝ z v - (k : ℝ) * s| ≤ s := by
      intro z v s hz hv hs
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le hεW_pos hs
      let y := inner ℝ z v
      let k := Int.floor (y / s + 1 / 2)
      have hy_abs : |y| ≤ R_dom := by
        calc |y| ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖v‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm z v
          _ = ‖z‖ := by rw [hv, mul_one]
          _ ≤ R_dom := hz
      have hys_abs : |y / s| ≤ (Nat.ceil (R_dom * ε ^ (-W_max)) : ℝ) := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs_pos]
        have h1 : |y| / s ≤ R_dom / (ε ^ W_max) :=
          div_le_div₀ (by linarith) hy_abs hεW_pos hs
        have h2 : R_dom / (ε ^ W_max) = R_dom * ε ^ (-W_max) := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le]
        exact le_trans h1 (h2 ▸ Nat.le_ceil _)
      obtain ⟨hys_lo, hys_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hys_abs
      have hk_ge : -B_ctr ≤ k := by
        refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
        dsimp only [B_ctr]; push_cast; linarith
      have hk_lt : k < B_ctr + 1 := by
        refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
        dsimp only [B_ctr]; push_cast; linarith
      have hk_le_fl : (k : ℝ) ≤ y / s + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
      have hk_lt_fl : y / s + 1 / 2 < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have herr_div : |y / s - (k : ℝ)| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have herr_s : |y - (k : ℝ) * s| ≤ s := by
        have h_eq : y - (k : ℝ) * s = (y / s - (k : ℝ)) * s := by
          field_simp [hs_pos.ne']
        rw [h_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs_pos]
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right herr_div hs_pos.le
        linarith
      dsimp only [k, y] at hk_ge hk_lt ⊢
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hk_ge, by omega⟩, herr_s⟩

    let n_of_atom : ℕ → ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ) → Fin N → ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
      fun ib ia p α =>
        let u := u_of_lat p
        let sb := ε ^ (w_of ib)
        let sa := ε ^ (w_of ia)
        ((Int.floor (inner ℝ (V' α) u / sb + 1 / 2),
          Int.floor (inner ℝ (V' α) (perp2D u) / sa + 1 / 2)),
         (Int.floor (inner ℝ (X' α) u / sb + 1 / 2),
          Int.floor (inner ℝ (X' α) (perp2D u) / sa + 1 / 2)))

    have h_atom_tup : ∀ (ib ia : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (α : Fin N),
        ib ≤ ia → ia ≤ N_w → p ∈ Lat_box →
        let tup := ((ib, ia), (p, n_of_atom ib ia p α))
        ∃ hmem : tup ∈ MenuSet,
          let κ := eM ⟨tup, hmem⟩
          ib_menu κ = ib ∧ ia_menu κ = ia ∧
          |inner ℝ (V' α - V_menu κ) (e_menu κ)| ≤ ε ^ (w_of (ib_menu κ)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V' α - V_menu κ) (perp2D (e_menu κ))| ≤ ε ^ (w_of (ia_menu κ)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (X' α - X_menu κ) (e_menu κ)| ≤ ε ^ (w_of (ib_menu κ)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (X' α - X_menu κ) (perp2D (e_menu κ))| ≤ ε ^ (w_of (ia_menu κ)) := by
      intro ib ia p α hibia hiaNw hp
      let u := u_of_lat p
      have hu1 : ‖u‖ = 1 := hu_norm p hp
      have hpu1 : ‖perp2D u‖ = 1 := (h_perp_norm u).trans hu1
      have hsb_ge : ε ^ W_max ≤ ε ^ (w_of ib) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le (hw_le_max ib)
      have hsa_ge : ε ^ W_max ≤ ε ^ (w_of ia) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le (hw_le_max ia)
      obtain ⟨hm1, he1⟩ := h_round (V' α) u (ε ^ (w_of ib)) (h_dom α).1 hu1 hsb_ge
      obtain ⟨hm2, he2⟩ := h_round (V' α) (perp2D u) (ε ^ (w_of ia)) (h_dom α).1 hpu1 hsa_ge
      obtain ⟨hm3, he3⟩ := h_round (X' α) u (ε ^ (w_of ib)) (h_dom α).2 hu1 hsb_ge
      obtain ⟨hm4, he4⟩ := h_round (X' α) (perp2D u) (ε ^ (w_of ia)) (h_dom α).2 hpu1 hsa_ge
      have hmem : ((ib, ia), (p, n_of_atom ib ia p α)) ∈ MenuSet := by
        simp only [MenuSet, W_pairs, CtrBox, n_of_atom, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_filter,
          Finset.mem_range]
        exact ⟨⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hibia⟩, hp, ⟨hm1, hm2⟩, ⟨hm3, hm4⟩⟩
      refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
      let κ := eM ⟨((ib, ia), (p, n_of_atom ib ia p α)), hmem⟩
      have htup_κ : tup_of κ = ((ib, ia), (p, n_of_atom ib ia p α)) := by
        dsimp only [tup_of, κ]
        rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      have hib_κ : ib_menu κ = ib := congr_arg (fun t => t.1.1) htup_κ
      have hia_κ : ia_menu κ = ia := congr_arg (fun t => t.1.2) htup_κ
      have he_κ : e_menu κ = u := by
        dsimp only [e_menu]; rw [htup_κ]
      have hV_κ : V_menu κ =
          (((n_of_atom ib ia p α).1.1 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of ib)) • u +
            (((n_of_atom ib ia p α).1.2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of ia)) • perp2D u := by
        dsimp only [V_menu, ib_menu, ia_menu]; rw [htup_κ]
      have hX_κ : X_menu κ =
          (((n_of_atom ib ia p α).2.1 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of ib)) • u +
            (((n_of_atom ib ia p α).2.2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of ia)) • perp2D u := by
        dsimp only [X_menu, ib_menu, ia_menu]; rw [htup_κ]
      obtain ⟨hVp1, hVp2⟩ := h_onb u hu1 (V' α)
        (((n_of_atom ib ia p α).1.1 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of ib))
        (((n_of_atom ib ia p α).1.2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of ia))
      obtain ⟨hXp1, hXp2⟩ := h_onb u hu1 (X' α)
        (((n_of_atom ib ia p α).2.1 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of ib))
        (((n_of_atom ib ia p α).2.2 : ℝ) * ε ^ (w_of ia))
      refine ⟨hib_κ, hia_κ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hV_κ, he_κ, hib_κ, hVp1]; exact he1
      · rw [hV_κ, he_κ, hia_κ, hVp2]; exact he2
      · rw [hX_κ, he_κ, hib_κ, hXp1]; exact he3
      · rw [hX_κ, he_κ, hia_κ, hXp2]; exact he4

    refine ⟨M_menu, ib_menu, ia_menu, e_menu, V_menu, X_menu, hM_pos, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro κ
      have hmem : tup_of κ ∈ MenuSet := (eM.symm κ).2
      simp only [MenuSet, W_pairs, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hmem
      have hibia : ib_menu κ ≤ ia_menu κ := hmem.1.2
      have hiaNw : ia_menu κ ≤ N_w := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hmem.1.1.2
      exact ⟨hibia, hiaNw, hw_nn (ib_menu κ), hw_mono hibia, hw_le_max (ia_menu κ),
        hu_norm _ hmem.2.1⟩
    · intro α
      obtain ⟨hmem, hib_κ, hia_κ, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ :=
        h_atom_tup N_w N_w p_def α le_rfl le_rfl hp_def_mem
      refine ⟨eM ⟨_, hmem⟩, hib_κ, hia_κ, ?_, ?_, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩
      · dsimp only; rw [hib_κ, hw_Nw]
      · dsimp only; rw [hia_κ, hw_Nw]
    · intro b_F a_F R_F e_F V_F X_F S_F hb₀ hba haW hRF heF hSF
      by_cases hSF_ne : S_F.Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀⟩ := hSF_ne
        let ib := idx_w b_F
        let ia := idx_w a_F
        obtain ⟨hib_Nw, hwb_le, hwb_diff⟩ := h_idx_w b_F hb₀ (le_trans hba haW)
        obtain ⟨hia_Nw, hwa_le, hwa_diff⟩ := h_idx_w a_F (le_trans hb₀ hba) haW

        have h_wt_loss : pktWeight γ b_F a_F - ξ / 2 ≤ pktWeight γ (w_of ib) (w_of ia) := by
          dsimp only [pktWeight]
          have h1 : (1 + γ) * (b_F - w_of ib) ≤ (1 + γ) * (ξ / 4) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwb_diff (by linarith)
          have h2 : (1 - γ) * (a_F - w_of ia) ≤ (1 - γ) * (ξ / 4) :=

        let f_box : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin M_menu := fun n =>
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
