        let M_cov : Finset (Fin M_menu) := S_F.image (fun α => f_box (n_of_atom ib ia p α))

        let D : ℝ := (2 + R_dom / 2) * R_F
        have hD_nn : 0 ≤ D := by positivity
        let R_int : ℤ := (Nat.ceil D : ℤ)
        let I_around : ℤ → Finset ℤ := fun k₀ => Finset.Icc (k₀ - R_int) (k₀ + R_int)
        have h_I_card : ∀ k₀ : ℤ, (I_around k₀).card = 2 * Nat.ceil D + 1 := by
          intro k₀
          simp only [I_around, R_int, Int.card_Icc]
          omega
        have h_shift_mem : ∀ (y y₀ s : ℝ), 0 < s → |y - y₀| ≤ D * s →
            Int.floor (y / s + 1 / 2) ∈ I_around (Int.floor (y₀ / s + 1 / 2)) := by
          intro y y₀ s hs_pos hy_diff
          have hdiv : |y / s - y₀ / s| ≤ (Nat.ceil D : ℝ) := by
            have h1 : |y / s - y₀ / s| = |y - y₀| / s := by
              rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hs_pos]
            rw [h1]
            exact le_trans ((div_le_iff₀ hs_pos).mpr hy_diff) (Nat.le_ceil D)
          obtain ⟨hd_lo, hd_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hdiv
          let k₀ := Int.floor (y₀ / s + 1 / 2)
          have hk₀_le : (k₀ : ℝ) ≤ y₀ / s + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
          have hk₀_lt : y₀ / s + 1 / 2 < (k₀ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
          refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_
            dsimp only [R_int]; push_cast; linarith
          · have hlt : Int.floor (y / s + 1 / 2) < k₀ + R_int + 1 := by
              refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_
              dsimp only [R_int]; push_cast; linarith
            omega

        have h_proj_diff : ∀ (z z₀ C u_dir e_dir : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (w_val w_grid : ℝ),
            ‖z‖ ≤ R_dom → ‖z₀‖ ≤ R_dom →
            |inner ℝ (z - C) e_dir| ≤ R_F * ε ^ w_val →
            |inner ℝ (z₀ - C) e_dir| ≤ R_F * ε ^ w_val →
            ‖u_dir - e_dir‖ ≤ (1 / 4) * ε ^ W_max →
            w_grid ≤ w_val → w_grid ≤ W_max →
            |inner ℝ z u_dir - inner ℝ z₀ u_dir| ≤ D * ε ^ w_grid := by
          intro z z₀ C u_dir e_dir w_val w_grid hz hz₀ hzc hz₀c hud hw1 hw2
          have hzz₀_norm : ‖z - z₀‖ ≤ 2 * R_dom := by
            calc ‖z - z₀‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖z₀‖ := norm_sub_le z z₀
              _ ≤ R_dom + R_dom := add_le_add hz hz₀
              _ = 2 * R_dom := by ring
          have h_ediff : |inner ℝ (z - z₀) e_dir| ≤ 2 * R_F * ε ^ w_val := by
            have h_eq : z - z₀ = (z - C) - (z₀ - C) := by abel
            rw [h_eq, inner_sub_left]
            calc |inner ℝ (z - C) e_dir - inner ℝ (z₀ - C) e_dir|
                ≤ |inner ℝ (z - C) e_dir| + |inner ℝ (z₀ - C) e_dir| := abs_sub _ _
              _ ≤ R_F * ε ^ w_val + R_F * ε ^ w_val := add_le_add hzc hz₀c
              _ = 2 * R_F * ε ^ w_val := by ring
          have h_rem : |inner ℝ (z - z₀) (u_dir - e_dir)| ≤ (R_dom / 2) * ε ^ W_max := by
            calc |inner ℝ (z - z₀) (u_dir - e_dir)|
                ≤ ‖z - z₀‖ * ‖u_dir - e_dir‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
              _ ≤ (2 * R_dom) * ((1 / 4) * ε ^ W_max) :=
                  mul_le_mul hzz₀_norm hud (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
              _ = (R_dom / 2) * ε ^ W_max := by ring
          have h_s1 : ε ^ w_val ≤ ε ^ w_grid :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le hw1
          have h_s2 : ε ^ W_max ≤ ε ^ w_grid :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le hw2
          have h_split : inner ℝ z u_dir - inner ℝ z₀ u_dir =
              inner ℝ (z - z₀) e_dir + inner ℝ (z - z₀) (u_dir - e_dir) := by
            rw [← inner_sub_left, ← inner_add_right, add_sub_cancel]
          rw [h_split]
          calc |inner ℝ (z - z₀) e_dir + inner ℝ (z - z₀) (u_dir - e_dir)|
              ≤ |inner ℝ (z - z₀) e_dir| + |inner ℝ (z - z₀) (u_dir - e_dir)| := abs_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * R_F * ε ^ w_val + (R_dom / 2) * ε ^ W_max := add_le_add h_ediff h_rem
            _ ≤ 2 * R_F * ε ^ w_grid + (R_dom / 2) * R_F * ε ^ w_grid := by
                refine add_le_add
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_s1 (by positivity)) ?_
                calc (R_dom / 2) * ε ^ W_max
                    ≤ (R_dom / 2) * ε ^ w_grid := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_s2 (by positivity)
                  _ = (R_dom / 2) * 1 * ε ^ w_grid := by ring
                  _ ≤ (R_dom / 2) * R_F * ε ^ w_grid :=
                      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRF (by positivity))
                        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ w_grid).le
            _ = D * ε ^ w_grid := by dsimp only [D]; ring

        let n₀ := n_of_atom ib ia p α₀
        let BoxAround : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
          (I_around n₀.1.1 ×ˢ I_around n₀.1.2) ×ˢ (I_around n₀.2.1 ×ˢ I_around n₀.2.2)
        have hMcov_sub : M_cov ⊆ BoxAround.image f_box := by
          intro κ hκ
          obtain ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hκ
          refine Finset.mem_image_of_mem f_box ?_
          obtain ⟨hcV1, hcV2, hcX1, hcX2⟩ := hSF α hα
          obtain ⟨hcV1₀, hcV2₀, hcX1₀, hcX2₀⟩ := hSF α₀ hα₀
          have hd1 := h_proj_diff (V' α) (V' α₀) V_F u e_F b_F (w_of ib)
            (h_dom α).1 (h_dom α₀).1 hcV1 hcV1₀ hu_err hwb_le (hw_le_max ib)
          have hd2 := h_proj_diff (V' α) (V' α₀) V_F (perp2D u) (perp2D e_F) a_F (w_of ia)
            (h_dom α).1 (h_dom α₀).1 hcV2 hcV2₀ hpu_err hwa_le (hw_le_max ia)
          have hd3 := h_proj_diff (X' α) (X' α₀) X_F u e_F b_F (w_of ib)
            (h_dom α).2 (h_dom α₀).2 hcX1 hcX1₀ hu_err hwb_le (hw_le_max ib)
          have hd4 := h_proj_diff (X' α) (X' α₀) X_F (perp2D u) (perp2D e_F) a_F (w_of ia)
            (h_dom α).2 (h_dom α₀).2 hcX2 hcX2₀ hpu_err hwa_le (hw_le_max ia)
          simp only [BoxAround, n_of_atom, n₀, Finset.mem_product]
          exact ⟨⟨h_shift_mem _ _ _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hd1,
                  h_shift_mem _ _ _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hd2⟩,
                 ⟨h_shift_mem _ _ _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hd3,
                  h_shift_mem _ _ _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hd4⟩⟩

        have hMcov_card : (M_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ (R_dom + 9) ^ 4 * R_F ^ 4 := by
          have hc_nat : M_cov.card ≤ (2 * Nat.ceil D + 1) ^ 4 := by
            calc M_cov.card ≤ (BoxAround.image f_box).card := Finset.card_le_card hMcov_sub
              _ ≤ BoxAround.card := Finset.card_image_le
              _ = ((2 * Nat.ceil D + 1) * (2 * Nat.ceil D + 1)) *
                    ((2 * Nat.ceil D + 1) * (2 * Nat.ceil D + 1)) := by
                  simp only [BoxAround, Finset.card_product, h_I_card]
              _ = (2 * Nat.ceil D + 1) ^ 4 := by ring
          have h1d : ((2 * Nat.ceil D + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (R_dom + 9) * R_F := by
            have hceil_lt : (Nat.ceil D : ℝ) < D + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hD_nn
            push_cast
            dsimp only [D] at hceil_lt
            linarith
          calc (M_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ (((2 * Nat.ceil D + 1) ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hc_nat
            _ = ((2 * Nat.ceil D + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4 := by push_cast; rfl
            _ ≤ ((R_dom + 9) * R_F) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1d 4
            _ = (R_dom + 9) ^ 4 * R_F ^ 4 := by ring

        refine ⟨M_cov, hMcov_card, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro κ hκ
          obtain ⟨α, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hκ
          obtain ⟨hmem, hib_κ, hia_κ, _⟩ := h_atom_tup ib ia p α hibia hia_Nw hp_mem
          have hf_eq : f_box (n_of_atom ib ia p α) = eM ⟨_, hmem⟩ := dif_pos hmem
          rw [hf_eq]
          dsimp only
          rw [hib_κ, hia_κ]
          exact h_wt_loss
        · intro α hα
          obtain ⟨hmem, _, _, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := h_atom_tup ib ia p α hibia hia_Nw hp_mem
          have hf_eq : f_box (n_of_atom ib ia p α) = eM ⟨_, hmem⟩ := dif_pos hmem
          refine ⟨f_box (n_of_atom ib ia p α), Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hα, ?_⟩
          rw [hf_eq]
          exact ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩
      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hSF_ne
        subst hSF_ne
        refine ⟨∅, ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
        rw [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
        positivity

  
  have greedy_set_removal_and_grouping :
      ∀ (ε ξ W_lo W_hi Q_cnt : ℝ)
        (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) (hξ : 0 < ξ)
        (hW_lo : 0 ≤ W_lo) (_hW_hi : 0 ≤ W_hi) (_hQ_cnt : 0 ≤ Q_cnt)
        (N M_menu N_w : ℕ)
        (E : Fin M_menu → Finset (Fin N))
        (w : Fin M_menu → ℝ)
        (ib ia : Fin M_menu → ℕ)
        (B : Finset (Fin N))
        (hB_ne : B.Nonempty)
        (hB_card : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-Q_cnt))
        (hw_bounds : ∀ κ : Fin M_menu,
          0 ≤ w κ ∧ w κ ≤ W_hi ∧ ib κ ≤ N_w ∧ ia κ ≤ N_w)
        (h_cover : ∀ α ∈ B, ∃ κ : Fin M_menu, α ∈ E κ ∧ W_lo ≤ w κ),
        ∃ (G_cnt : ℕ) (G_set : Fin G_cnt → Finset (Fin N))
          (g_idx_of ib_of ia_of : Fin G_cnt → ℕ)
          (step_of : Fin N → ℕ) (κ_of : Fin N → Fin M_menu),
          1 ≤ G_cnt ∧
          G_cnt ≤ (Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) + 1) * (N_w + 1) ^ 2 ∧
          (∀ g : Fin G_cnt, (G_set g).Nonempty) ∧
          (∀ g₁ g₂ : Fin G_cnt, g₁ ≠ g₂ → Disjoint (G_set g₁) (G_set g₂)) ∧
          (Finset.univ.biUnion G_set = B) ∧
          (∀ g : Fin G_cnt,
            let g_bin := ((g_idx_of g : ℝ) + 1) * ξ
            W_lo < g_bin ∧
            g_idx_of g < Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) + 1 ∧
            ib_of g ≤ N_w ∧ ia_of g ≤ N_w ∧
            (∀ α ∈ G_set g,
              α ∈ E (κ_of α) ∧
              ib (κ_of α) = ib_of g ∧
              ia (κ_of α) = ia_of g ∧
              (∀ α' ∈ G_set g, step_of α = step_of α' → κ_of α = κ_of α')) ∧
            (∀ κ : Fin M_menu,
              (((G_set g) ∩ (E κ)).card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-g_bin + w κ)) ∧
            (∀ α ∈ G_set g,
              ε ^ (-g_bin + w (κ_of α) + ξ) ≤
                (((G_set g).filter (fun α' => step_of α' = step_of α)).card : ℝ))) := by
    clear anisotropic_cap_menu_and_covering hC_tr hM_mult hC_cut hd_dim hR_bud hξ hA₀
      C_tr_cut M_mult d_dim use_vel_sub C_cut R_bud ξ A₀ cls M_atom hγ₁ hγ₀ γ
    intro ε ξ W_lo W_hi Q_cnt hε₀ hε₁ hξ hW_lo _ _ N M_menu N_w E w ib ia B hB_ne hB_card hw_bounds h_cover
    let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have hε_inv_gt1 : 1 < ε⁻¹ := by
      rw [one_lt_inv₀ hε₀]
      linarith
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos hε_inv_gt1
    have hlogε : Real.log ε = -ell := by
      simp only [ell, Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
    have h_le_rpow : ∀ {x Z : ℝ}, 0 < x → Real.log x / ell ≤ Z → x ≤ ε ^ (-Z) := by
      intro x Z hx hZ
      have h1 : Real.log x ≤ Z * ell := (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hZ
      have h2 : Real.log x ≤ Real.log ε * (-Z) := by rw [hlogε]; linarith
      calc x = Real.exp (Real.log x) := (Real.exp_log hx).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log ε * (-Z)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
        _ = ε ^ (-Z) := (Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀ (-Z)).symm
    have h_rpow_le : ∀ {x Z : ℝ}, 0 < x → Z ≤ Real.log x / ell → ε ^ (-Z) ≤ x := by
      intro x Z hx hZ
      have h1 : Z * ell ≤ Real.log x := (le_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hZ
      have h2 : Real.log ε * (-Z) ≤ Real.log x := by rw [hlogε]; linarith
      calc ε ^ (-Z) = Real.exp (Real.log ε * (-Z)) := Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀ (-Z)
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log x) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
        _ = x := Real.exp_log hx

    let obj : Finset (Fin N) → Fin M_menu → ℝ :=
      fun S κ => Real.log (((S ∩ E κ).card : ℝ)) / ell + w κ

    have h_trace : ∀ (n : ℕ) (rem : Finset (Fin N)),
        rem ⊆ B → rem.card = n →
        ∃ (K : ℕ) (rem_seq : Fin K → Finset (Fin N)) (κ_seq : Fin K → Fin M_menu),
          (rem.Nonempty → 1 ≤ K) ∧
          (∀ t : Fin K, rem_seq t ⊆ rem) ∧
          (∀ t : Fin K, (rem_seq t ∩ E (κ_seq t)).Nonempty) ∧
          (∀ t : Fin K, ∀ κ : Fin M_menu, (rem_seq t ∩ E κ).Nonempty →
            obj (rem_seq t) κ ≤ obj (rem_seq t) (κ_seq t)) ∧
          (∀ t₁ t₂ : Fin K, t₁ ≤ t₂ → rem_seq t₂ ⊆ rem_seq t₁) ∧
          (∀ t₁ t₂ : Fin K, t₁ ≠ t₂ →
            Disjoint (rem_seq t₁ ∩ E (κ_seq t₁)) (rem_seq t₂ ∩ E (κ_seq t₂))) ∧
          (Finset.univ.biUnion (fun t : Fin K => rem_seq t ∩ E (κ_seq t)) = rem) := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        intro rem hrem_sub hcard
        by_cases hrem_ne : rem.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀⟩ := hrem_ne
          obtain ⟨κ_w, hα₀_E, _⟩ := h_cover α₀ (hrem_sub hα₀)
          let Cand : Finset (Fin M_menu) :=
            Finset.univ.filter (fun κ : Fin M_menu => (rem ∩ E κ).Nonempty)
          have hCand_ne : Cand.Nonempty :=
            ⟨κ_w, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
              ⟨α₀, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hα₀, hα₀_E⟩⟩⟩⟩
          obtain ⟨κ₀, hκ₀_mem, hκ₀_max⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Cand (obj rem) hCand_ne
          let F₀ : Finset (Fin N) := rem ∩ E κ₀
          have hF₀_ne : F₀.Nonempty := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hκ₀_mem).2
          let rem' : Finset (Fin N) := rem \ F₀
          have hrem'_sub : rem' ⊆ rem := Finset.sdiff_subset
          have hrem'_lt : rem'.card < n := by
            rw [← hcard]
            refine Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hrem'_sub, ?_⟩)
            intro heq
            obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hF₀_ne
            have hx_rem : x ∈ rem := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1
            rw [← heq] at hx_rem
            exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx_rem).2 hx
          obtain ⟨K', rem_seq', κ_seq', _, hsub', hne', hmax', hmono', hdisj', hbiU'⟩ :=
            ih rem'.card hrem'_lt rem' (hrem'_sub.trans hrem_sub) rfl
          refine ⟨K' + 1, Fin.cons rem rem_seq', Fin.cons κ₀ κ_seq',
            fun _ => by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro t
            refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t
            · simp only [Fin.cons_zero]; exact Finset.Subset.rfl
            · intro i; simp only [Fin.cons_succ]; exact (hsub' i).trans hrem'_sub
          · intro t
            refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t
            · simp only [Fin.cons_zero]; exact hF₀_ne
            · intro i; simp only [Fin.cons_succ]; exact hne' i
          · intro t
            refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t
            · simp only [Fin.cons_zero]
              intro κ hκ_ne
              exact hκ₀_max κ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hκ_ne⟩)
            · intro i; simp only [Fin.cons_succ]; exact hmax' i
          · intro t₁ t₂
            refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t₁
            · refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t₂
              · intro _; simp only [Fin.cons_zero]; exact Finset.Subset.rfl
              · intro j _; simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
                exact (hsub' j).trans hrem'_sub
            · intro i
              refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t₂
              · intro hle
                exfalso
                have hval : (i.succ : ℕ) ≤ (0 : Fin (K' + 1)).1 := hle
                simp at hval
              · intro j hle
                simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
                exact hmono' i j (Fin.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hle)
          · intro t₁ t₂
            refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t₁
            · refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t₂
              · intro hne_t; exact False.elim (hne_t rfl)
              · intro j _
                simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
                rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
                intro x hx₀ hxj
                have hxj_rem' : x ∈ rem' := hsub' j (Finset.mem_inter.mp hxj).1
                exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hxj_rem').2 hx₀
            · intro i
              refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ t₂
              · intro _
                simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
                rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
                intro x hxi hx₀
                have hxi_rem' : x ∈ rem' := hsub' i (Finset.mem_inter.mp hxi).1
                exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hxi_rem').2 hx₀
              · intro j hne_t
                simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
                exact hdisj' i j (fun hij => hne_t (congr_arg Fin.succ hij))
          · ext x
            simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fin.exists_fin_succ,
              Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
            have h_tail : (∃ i : Fin K', x ∈ rem_seq' i ∩ E (κ_seq' i)) ↔ x ∈ rem' := by
              rw [← hbiU']
              simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
            rw [h_tail]
            constructor
            · rintro (hx₀ | hx')
              · exact (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx₀).1
              · exact hrem'_sub hx'
            · intro hx_rem
              by_cases hx₀ : x ∈ F₀
              · exact Or.inl hx₀
              · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx_rem, hx₀⟩)
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hrem_ne
          subst hrem_ne
          refine ⟨0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0,
            fun h => False.elim (Finset.not_nonempty_empty h),
            fun t => Fin.elim0 t, fun t => Fin.elim0 t, fun t => Fin.elim0 t,
            fun t₁ => Fin.elim0 t₁, fun t₁ => Fin.elim0 t₁, by simp⟩

    obtain ⟨K, rem_seq, κ_seq, hK_ne, hrem_sub, hF_ne, hobj_max, hrem_mono, hF_disj, hF_biU⟩ :=
      h_trace B.card B Finset.Subset.rfl rfl
    have hK_pos : 1 ≤ K := hK_ne hB_ne
    let F_seq : Fin K → Finset (Fin N) := fun t => rem_seq t ∩ E (κ_seq t)
    let μ : Fin K → ℝ := fun t => obj (rem_seq t) (κ_seq t)
    let g_idx : Fin K → ℕ := fun t => Nat.floor (μ t / ξ)

    have hμ_bounds : ∀ t : Fin K,
        W_lo ≤ μ t ∧
        (g_idx t : ℝ) * ξ ≤ μ t ∧
        μ t < ((g_idx t : ℝ) + 1) * ξ ∧
        g_idx t < Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) + 1 := by
      intro t
      obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀_F⟩ := hF_ne t
      have hα₀_rem : α₀ ∈ rem_seq t := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hα₀_F).1
      obtain ⟨κ_w, hα₀_Ew, hW_lo_w⟩ := h_cover α₀ (hrem_sub t hα₀_rem)
      have h_inter_ne : (rem_seq t ∩ E κ_w).Nonempty := ⟨α₀, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hα₀_rem, hα₀_Ew⟩⟩
      have h_card_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((rem_seq t ∩ E κ_w).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.one_le_card.mpr h_inter_ne
      have h_log_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (((rem_seq t ∩ E κ_w).card : ℝ)) / ell :=
        div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg h_card_ge1) hell_pos.le
      have hμ_ge : W_lo ≤ μ t := by
        have hmax := hobj_max t κ_w h_inter_ne
        dsimp only [μ, obj] at hmax ⊢
        linarith
      have hμ_nn : 0 ≤ μ t := le_trans hW_lo hμ_ge
      have hg_le : (g_idx t : ℝ) * ξ ≤ μ t :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hξ).mp (Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hμ_nn hξ.le))
      have hg_lt : μ t < ((g_idx t : ℝ) + 1) * ξ :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hξ).mp (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (μ t / ξ))
      have hFt_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((F_seq t).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.one_le_card.mpr (hF_ne t)
      have hFt_le_B : ((F_seq t).card : ℝ) ≤ (B.card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (Finset.inter_subset_left.trans (hrem_sub t))
      have hFt_le_Q : ((F_seq t).card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-Q_cnt) := le_trans hFt_le_B hB_card
      have hlog_Q : Real.log (((F_seq t).card : ℝ)) / ell ≤ Q_cnt := by
        have hlog_le := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hFt_le_Q
        rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlogε] at hlog_le
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
        linarith
      have hw_hi : w (κ_seq t) ≤ W_hi := (hw_bounds (κ_seq t)).2.1
      have hμ_hi : μ t ≤ Q_cnt + W_hi := by
        dsimp only [μ, obj, F_seq]
        linarith
      have hdiv_hi : μ t / ξ ≤ (Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) : ℝ) :=
        le_trans ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hξ).mpr hμ_hi) (Nat.le_ceil _)
      have hg_ceil : g_idx t ≤ Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) := by
        have hfl := Nat.floor_mono hdiv_hi
        rwa [Nat.floor_natCast] at hfl
      exact ⟨hμ_ge, hg_le, hg_lt, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hg_ceil⟩

    have hB_ex_t : ∀ α : Fin N, α ∈ B → ∃ t : Fin K, α ∈ F_seq t := by
      intro α hα
      rw [← hF_biU] at hα
      simpa only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hα

    let t_default : Fin K := ⟨0, hK_pos⟩
    let step_fin : Fin N → Fin K := fun α =>
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      if hα : α ∈ B then Classical.choose (hB_ex_t α hα) else t_default
    have hstep_fin_eq : ∀ (t : Fin K) (α : Fin N), α ∈ F_seq t → step_fin α = t := by
      intro t α hαF
      have hαB : α ∈ B := hrem_sub t (Finset.mem_inter.mp hαF).1
      have h_ch : step_fin α = Classical.choose (hB_ex_t α hαB) := dif_pos hαB
      rw [h_ch]
      have hα_ch : α ∈ F_seq (Classical.choose (hB_ex_t α hαB)) :=
        Classical.choose_spec (hB_ex_t α hαB)
      by_contra hne
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hF_disj _ _ hne) hα_ch hαF

    let step_of : Fin N → ℕ := fun α => (step_fin α).1
    let κ_of : Fin N → Fin M_menu := fun α => κ_seq (step_fin α)

    let key : Fin K → ℕ × (ℕ × ℕ) := fun t => (g_idx t, (ib (κ_seq t), ia (κ_seq t)))
    let Keys : Finset (ℕ × (ℕ × ℕ)) := Finset.univ.image key
    have hKeys_ne : Keys.Nonempty := ⟨key t_default, Finset.mem_image_of_mem key (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩
    let G_cnt : ℕ := Keys.card
    have hG_pos : 1 ≤ G_cnt := Finset.one_le_card.mpr hKeys_ne
    let BoxK : Finset (ℕ × (ℕ × ℕ)) :=
      Finset.range (Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) + 1) ×ˢ
        (Finset.range (N_w + 1) ×ˢ Finset.range (N_w + 1))
    have hKeys_sub : Keys ⊆ BoxK := by
      intro k hk
      obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk
      simp only [BoxK, key, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨(hμ_bounds t).2.2.2,
        ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hw_bounds (κ_seq t)).2.2.1,
         Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hw_bounds (κ_seq t)).2.2.2⟩⟩
    have hG_le : G_cnt ≤ (Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) + 1) * (N_w + 1) ^ 2 := by
      calc G_cnt ≤ BoxK.card := Finset.card_le_card hKeys_sub
        _ = (Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) + 1) * ((N_w + 1) * (N_w + 1)) := by
            simp only [BoxK, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_range]
        _ = (Nat.ceil ((Q_cnt + W_hi) / ξ) + 1) * (N_w + 1) ^ 2 := by ring

    let eK : { x // x ∈ Keys } ≃ Fin G_cnt := Keys.equivFin
    let k_of_g : Fin G_cnt → ℕ × (ℕ × ℕ) := fun g => (eK.symm g).1
    let g_idx_of : Fin G_cnt → ℕ := fun g => (k_of_g g).1
    let ib_of : Fin G_cnt → ℕ := fun g => (k_of_g g).2.1
    let ia_of : Fin G_cnt → ℕ := fun g => (k_of_g g).2.2
    let T_g : Fin G_cnt → Finset (Fin K) :=
      fun g => Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin K => key t = k_of_g g)
    have hTg_ne : ∀ g : Fin G_cnt, (T_g g).Nonempty := by
      intro g
      have hk_mem : k_of_g g ∈ Keys := (eK.symm g).2
      obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk_mem
      exact ⟨t, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ht⟩⟩
    let G_set : Fin G_cnt → Finset (Fin N) := fun g => (T_g g).biUnion F_seq

    refine ⟨G_cnt, G_set, g_idx_of, ib_of, ia_of, step_of, κ_of,
      hG_pos, hG_le, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro g
      obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩ := hTg_ne g
      obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀⟩ := hF_ne t₀
      exact ⟨α₀, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t₀, ht₀, hα₀⟩⟩
    · intro g₁ g₂ hne
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro α hα₁ hα₂
      obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, hαF₁⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hα₁
      obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂, hαF₂⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hα₂
      have ht_eq : t₁ = t₂ := by
        by_contra ht_ne
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hF_disj t₁ t₂ ht_ne) hαF₁ hαF₂
      subst ht_eq
      have hk₁ : key t₁ = k_of_g g₁ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht₁).2
      have hk₂ : key t₁ = k_of_g g₂ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht₂).2
      have hsub_eq : eK.symm g₁ = eK.symm g₂ := Subtype.ext (hk₁.symm.trans hk₂)
      exact hne (eK.symm.injective hsub_eq)
    · ext α
      simp only [G_set, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, t, _, hαF⟩
        exact hrem_sub t (Finset.mem_inter.mp hαF).1
      · intro hαB
        obtain ⟨t, hαF⟩ := hB_ex_t α hαB
        have hk_mem : key t ∈ Keys := Finset.mem_image_of_mem key (Finset.mem_univ t)
        let g : Fin G_cnt := eK ⟨key t, hk_mem⟩
        have hkg : k_of_g g = key t := by
          dsimp only [k_of_g, g]
          rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        refine ⟨g, t, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ t, hkg.symm⟩, hαF⟩
    · intro g
      let g_bin : ℝ := ((g_idx_of g : ℝ) + 1) * ξ
      let t_first : Fin K := (T_g g).min' (hTg_ne g)
      have ht_first_mem : t_first ∈ T_g g := Finset.min'_mem (T_g g) (hTg_ne g)
      have hkey_first : key t_first = k_of_g g := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht_first_mem).2
      have hg_first : g_idx t_first = g_idx_of g := congr_arg Prod.fst hkey_first
      have hib_first : ib (κ_seq t_first) = ib_of g :=
        congr_arg (fun p => p.2.1) hkey_first
      have hia_first : ia (κ_seq t_first) = ia_of g :=
        congr_arg (fun p => p.2.2) hkey_first
      obtain ⟨hW_lo_first, _, hμ_lt_first, hg_ceil_first⟩ := hμ_bounds t_first
      rw [hg_first] at hμ_lt_first hg_ceil_first
      refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hW_lo_first hμ_lt_first, hg_ceil_first,
        hib_first ▸ (hw_bounds (κ_seq t_first)).2.2.1,
        hia_first ▸ (hw_bounds (κ_seq t_first)).2.2.2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro α hαG
        obtain ⟨t, ht_mem, hαF⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hαG
        have hkey_t : key t = k_of_g g := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht_mem).2
        have hsf_α : step_fin α = t := hstep_fin_eq t α hαF
        have hκ_α : κ_of α = κ_seq t := congr_arg κ_seq hsf_α
        refine ⟨hκ_α ▸ (Finset.mem_inter.mp hαF).2,
          (congr_arg ib hκ_α).trans (congr_arg (fun p => p.2.1) hkey_t),
          (congr_arg ia hκ_α).trans (congr_arg (fun p => p.2.2) hkey_t), ?_⟩
        intro α' _ hstep_eq
        have hsf_eq : step_fin α = step_fin α' := Fin.ext hstep_eq
        exact congr_arg κ_seq hsf_eq
      · intro κ
        have hG_sub_first : G_set g ⊆ rem_seq t_first := by
          intro x hxG
          obtain ⟨t, ht_mem, hxF⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hxG
          have hle_t : t_first ≤ t := Finset.min'_le (T_g g) t ht_mem
          exact hrem_mono t_first t hle_t (Finset.mem_inter.mp hxF).1
        have h_inter_sub : G_set g ∩ E κ ⊆ rem_seq t_first ∩ E κ :=
          fun x hx => Finset.mem_inter.mpr
            ⟨hG_sub_first (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).2⟩
        by_cases h_ne_κ : (rem_seq t_first ∩ E κ).Nonempty
        · have h_card_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (((rem_seq t_first ∩ E κ).card : ℝ)) := by
            exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr h_ne_κ
          have hmax_κ := hobj_max t_first κ h_ne_κ
          have hlog_le : Real.log (((rem_seq t_first ∩ E κ).card : ℝ)) / ell ≤ g_bin - w κ := by
            dsimp only [μ, obj, g_bin] at hmax_κ hμ_lt_first ⊢
            linarith
          have hrpow := h_le_rpow h_card_pos hlog_le
          have hexp_eq : -(g_bin - w κ) = -g_bin + w κ := by ring
          rw [hexp_eq] at hrpow
          have hcard_le : (((G_set g ∩ E κ).card : ℝ)) ≤ (((rem_seq t_first ∩ E κ).card : ℝ)) := by
            exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card h_inter_sub
          exact le_trans hcard_le hrpow
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h_ne_κ
          have hemp : G_set g ∩ E κ = ∅ := Finset.subset_empty.mp (h_inter_sub.trans (by rw [h_ne_κ]))
          rw [hemp, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
          exact Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _
      · intro α hαG
        obtain ⟨t, ht_mem, hαF⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hαG
        have hkey_t : key t = k_of_g g := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht_mem).2
        have hg_t : g_idx t = g_idx_of g := congr_arg Prod.fst hkey_t
        have hsf_α : step_fin α = t := hstep_fin_eq t α hαF
        have hκ_α : κ_of α = κ_seq t := congr_arg κ_seq hsf_α
        have hfib_eq : (G_set g).filter (fun α' => step_of α' = step_of α) = F_seq t := by
          ext α'
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hα'G, hstep_eq⟩
            obtain ⟨t', _, hα'F'⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hα'G
            have hsf_α' : step_fin α' = t' := hstep_fin_eq t' α' hα'F'
            have ht'_eq : t' = t := by
              apply Fin.ext
              calc (t' : ℕ) = step_of α' := congr_arg Fin.val hsf_α'.symm
                _ = step_of α := hstep_eq
                _ = (t : ℕ) := congr_arg Fin.val hsf_α
            rwa [← ht'_eq]
          · intro hα'F
            refine ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t, ht_mem, hα'F⟩, ?_⟩
            have hsf_α' : step_fin α' = t := hstep_fin_eq t α' hα'F
            dsimp only [step_of]
            rw [hsf_α', hsf_α]
        rw [hfib_eq, hκ_α]
        have hFt_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (((F_seq t).card : ℝ)) := by
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr (hF_ne t)
        have hg_le_t := (hμ_bounds t).2.1
        rw [hg_t] at hg_le_t
        have hlog_ge : g_bin - w (κ_seq t) - ξ ≤ Real.log (((F_seq t).card : ℝ)) / ell := by
          dsimp only [μ, obj, F_seq, g_bin] at hg_le_t ⊢
          linarith
        have hrpow := h_rpow_le hFt_pos hlog_ge
        have hexp_eq : -(g_bin - w (κ_seq t) - ξ) = -g_bin + w (κ_seq t) + ξ := by ring
        rwa [hexp_eq] at hrpow

  
  have two_stage_velocity_subdivision :
      ∀ (ε H_P t r h ξ Q_cnt : ℝ)
        (d_dim M_L N q_r : ℕ)
        (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (V_at X_at e_at : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (W_all : Finset (Fin N))
        (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
        (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hh : 0 < h) (hr_eq : r = t - 2 * h) (_hQ_cnt : 0 ≤ Q_cnt)
        (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2) (hML : 1 ≤ M_L)
        (hn_buf : ∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1)
        (h_log16 : Real.log 16 / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ ξ)
        (hW_ne : W_all.Nonempty)
        (hW_card : (W_all.card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-Q_cnt)),
        let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
        let p_of := fun α : Fin N => atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r (V_at α) (X_at α)
        let w_of := fun α : Fin N => fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine (p_of α) (V_at α)
        ∃ (U_cnt : ℕ) (R_set : Fin U_cnt → Finset (Fin N))
          (al_of : Fin U_cnt → Bool) (mk_of : Fin U_cnt → ℕ),
          1 ≤ U_cnt ∧
          U_cnt ≤ 2 * (Nat.ceil (Q_cnt / ξ) + 1) * (Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3) ∧
          (∀ u : Fin U_cnt, (R_set u).Nonempty) ∧
          (∀ u₁ u₂ : Fin U_cnt, u₁ ≠ u₂ → Disjoint (R_set u₁) (R_set u₂)) ∧
          (Finset.univ.biUnion R_set = W_all) ∧
          (∀ u : Fin U_cnt,
            let k_bin := (mk_of u : ℝ) * ξ
            mk_of u < Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3 ∧
            (d_dim = 1 → ∀ α ∈ R_set u,
              (al_of u = true ↔
                projAngleDist (perp2D (e_at α)) (n_fine (p_of α)) ≤ 2 * ε ^ h)) ∧
            (∀ p_c w,
              (((R_set u).filter (fun α => p_of α = p_c ∧ w_of α = w)).card : ℝ) ≤
                ε ^ (k_bin - ξ) * (((R_set u).filter (fun α => p_of α = p_c)).card : ℝ)) ∧
            (∀ p_buf,
              ((((R_set u).image (fun α => (p_of α, w_of α))).filter
                (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
                ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(k_bin + ξ)))) := by
    clear greedy_set_removal_and_grouping anisotropic_cap_menu_and_covering
      hC_tr hM_mult hC_cut hd_dim hR_bud hξ hA₀ C_tr_cut M_mult d_dim use_vel_sub
      C_cut R_bud ξ A₀ cls M_atom hγ₁ hγ₀ γ
    intro ε H_P t r h ξ Q_cnt d_dim M_L N q_r τ_V τ_X n_buf V_at X_at e_at W_all
      hε₀ hε₁ hξ hh hr_eq _ hd_dim hML hn_buf h_log16 hW_ne hW_card n_fine p_of w_of
    let ell : ℝ := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith
    have hε_inv_gt1 : 1 < ε⁻¹ := by rw [one_lt_inv₀ hε₀]; linarith
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos hε_inv_gt1
    have hlogε : Real.log ε = -ell := by simp only [ell, Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
    have h_le_rpow : ∀ {x Z : ℝ}, 0 < x → Real.log x / ell ≤ Z → x ≤ ε ^ (-Z) := by
      intro x Z hx hZ
      have h1 : Real.log x ≤ Z * ell := (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hZ
      have h2 : Real.log x ≤ Real.log ε * (-Z) := by rw [hlogε]; linarith
      calc x = Real.exp (Real.log x) := (Real.exp_log hx).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log ε * (-Z)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
        _ = ε ^ (-Z) := (Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀ (-Z)).symm
    have h_rpow_le : ∀ {x Z : ℝ}, 0 < x → Z ≤ Real.log x / ell → ε ^ (-Z) ≤ x := by
      intro x Z hx hZ
      have h1 : Z * ell ≤ Real.log x := (le_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hZ
      have h2 : Real.log ε * (-Z) ≤ Real.log x := by rw [hlogε]; linarith
      calc ε ^ (-Z) = Real.exp (Real.log ε * (-Z)) := Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀ (-Z)
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log x) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
        _ = x := Real.exp_log hx

    let u_t : ℝ := (H_P - t) / 2
    let u_r : ℝ := (H_P - r) / 2
    let s_t : ℝ := ε ^ u_t
    let s_r : ℝ := ε ^ u_r
    have hs_t_pos : 0 < s_t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ u_t
    have hs_r_pos : 0 < s_r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ u_r
    have hur_eq : u_r = u_t + h := by dsimp only [u_r, u_t]; rw [hr_eq]; ring
    have hst_div_sr : s_t / s_r = ε ^ (-h) := by
      dsimp only [s_t, s_r]
      rw [hur_eq, Real.rpow_add hε₀, div_mul_eq_div_div, div_self hs_t_pos.ne',
        one_div, ← Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le]
    have hεnegh_gt1 : 1 < ε ^ (-h) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ε ^ (0 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_zero ε).symm
        _ < ε ^ (-h) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt hε₀ hε_lt1 (by linarith)

    have h_w_per_pc : ∀ (p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (S : Finset (Fin N)),
        (∀ α ∈ S, p_of α = p_c) →
        (((S.image w_of).card : ℝ)) ≤ 16 * ε ^ (-((d_dim : ℝ) * h)) := by
      intro p_c S hS_pc
      have hv_rel_coords : ∀ α ∈ S,
          let v_rel := V_at α - fineCellCenterV s_t τ_V p_c.2.1
          |v_rel 0| ≤ (1 / 2) * s_t ∧ |v_rel 1| ≤ (1 / 2) * s_t ∧ ‖v_rel‖ ≤ s_t := by
        intro α hα v_rel
        have hp_eq : p_of α = p_c := hS_pc α hα
        have hk_eq : roundShift2D s_t τ_V (V_at α) = p_c.2.1 := by
          have := congr_arg (fun p => p.2.1) hp_eq
          simpa only [p_of, atomOutCell, s_t, u_t] using this
        have hk0 : p_c.2.1.1 = Int.floor (((V_at α) 0 - τ_V 0) / s_t) := by
          rw [← hk_eq]; rfl
        have hk1 : p_c.2.1.2 = Int.floor (((V_at α) 1 - τ_V 1) / s_t) := by
          rw [← hk_eq]; rfl
        have h_1d : ∀ (z τ_i : ℝ) (k : ℤ), k = Int.floor ((z - τ_i) / s_t) →
            |z - (τ_i + s_t * (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2 * s_t)| ≤ (1 / 2) * s_t := by
          intro z τ_i k hk
          have hle : (k : ℝ) ≤ (z - τ_i) / s_t := hk ▸ Int.floor_le _
          have hlt : (z - τ_i) / s_t < (k : ℝ) + 1 := hk ▸ Int.lt_floor_add_one _
          have hm1 : s_t * (k : ℝ) ≤ z - τ_i := by
            have := (le_div_iff₀ hs_t_pos).mp hle
            linarith
          have hm2 : z - τ_i < s_t * ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
            have := (div_lt_iff₀ hs_t_pos).mp hlt
            linarith
          exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have hv0 : |v_rel 0| ≤ (1 / 2) * s_t := by
          dsimp only [v_rel]
          simp only [fineCellCenterV, gridPt2D]
          exact h_1d ((V_at α) 0) (τ_V 0) p_c.2.1.1 hk0
        have hv1 : |v_rel 1| ≤ (1 / 2) * s_t := by
          dsimp only [v_rel]
          simp only [fineCellCenterV, gridPt2D, Fin.one_eq_zero_iff]
          exact h_1d ((V_at α) 1) (τ_V 1) p_c.2.1.2 hk1
        have hv_norm : ‖v_rel‖ ≤ s_t := by
          have hsq : ‖v_rel‖ ^ 2 ≤ s_t ^ 2 := by
            rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              sq_abs, sq_abs]
            obtain ⟨l0, u0⟩ := abs_le.mp hv0
            obtain ⟨l1, u1⟩ := abs_le.mp hv1
            nlinarith
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg v_rel, hs_t_pos]
        exact ⟨hv0, hv1, hv_norm⟩

      rcases hd_dim with hd1 | hd2
      · let B₁ : ℕ := Nat.ceil (ε ^ (-h))
        let Box1 : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.Icc (-(B₁ : ℤ)) (B₁ : ℤ) ×ˢ ({0} : Finset ℤ)
        have h_sub1 : S.image w_of ⊆ Box1 := by
          intro w hw
          obtain ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
          have hp_eq : p_of α = p_c := hS_pc α hα
          obtain ⟨_, _, hvn⟩ := hv_rel_coords α hα
          dsimp only [w_of, fineVelBin]
          rw [hp_eq, if_pos hd1]
          let v_rel := V_at α - fineCellCenterV s_t τ_V p_c.2.1
          have h_in_abs : |inner ℝ v_rel (n_fine p_c) / s_r| ≤ (B₁ : ℝ) := by
            rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs_r_pos]
            have hcs : |inner ℝ v_rel (n_fine p_c)| ≤ s_t := by
              calc |inner ℝ v_rel (n_fine p_c)|
                  ≤ ‖v_rel‖ * ‖n_fine p_c‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
                _ = ‖v_rel‖ := by rw [hn_buf _, mul_one]
                _ ≤ s_t := hvn
            have hdiv : |inner ℝ v_rel (n_fine p_c)| / s_r ≤ ε ^ (-h) := by
              rw [← hst_div_sr]
              exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hs_r_pos).mpr hcs
            exact le_trans hdiv (Nat.le_ceil _)
          obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp h_in_abs
          have hk_ge : -(B₁ : ℤ) ≤ Int.floor (inner ℝ v_rel (n_fine p_c) / s_r) := by
            refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_; push_cast; linarith
          have hk_lt : Int.floor (inner ℝ v_rel (n_fine p_c) / s_r) < (B₁ : ℤ) + 1 := by
            refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_; push_cast; linarith
          dsimp only [v_rel, s_t, s_r, u_t, u_r] at hk_ge hk_lt ⊢
          exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hk_ge, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_singleton_self 0⟩
        have hcard1 : (S.image w_of).card ≤ 2 * B₁ + 1 := by
          calc (S.image w_of).card ≤ Box1.card := Finset.card_le_card h_sub1
            _ = 2 * B₁ + 1 := by
                simp only [Box1, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Icc, Finset.card_singleton]
                omega
        have hceil1 : (B₁ : ℝ) < ε ^ (-h) + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
        rw [hd1, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
        calc (((S.image w_of).card : ℝ)) ≤ ((2 * B₁ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard1
          _ = 2 * (B₁ : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
          _ ≤ 16 * ε ^ (-h) := by linarith
      · let B₂ : ℕ := Nat.ceil ((1 / 2) * ε ^ (-h))
        let I₂ : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-(B₂ : ℤ)) (B₂ : ℤ)
        let Box2 : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := I₂ ×ˢ I₂
        have h_sub2 : S.image w_of ⊆ Box2 := by
          intro w hw
          obtain ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
          have hp_eq : p_of α = p_c := hS_pc α hα
          obtain ⟨hv0, hv1, _⟩ := hv_rel_coords α hα
          have hd_ne1 : d_dim ≠ 1 := by omega
          dsimp only [w_of, fineVelBin]
          rw [hp_eq, if_neg hd_ne1]
          have h_1d_mem : ∀ y : ℝ, |y| ≤ (1 / 2) * s_t → Int.floor (y / s_r) ∈ I₂ := by
            intro y hy
            have hdiv : |y / s_r| ≤ (B₂ : ℝ) := by
              rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs_r_pos]
              have h1 : |y| / s_r ≤ ((1 / 2) * s_t) / s_r :=
                (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hs_r_pos).mpr hy
              have h2 : ((1 / 2) * s_t) / s_r = (1 / 2) * ε ^ (-h) := by
                rw [mul_div_assoc, hst_div_sr]
              exact le_trans h1 (h2 ▸ Nat.le_ceil _)
            obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp hdiv
            have hk_ge : -(B₂ : ℤ) ≤ Int.floor (y / s_r) := by
              refine Int.le_floor.mpr ?_; push_cast; linarith
            have hk_lt : Int.floor (y / s_r) < (B₂ : ℤ) + 1 := by
              refine Int.floor_lt.mpr ?_; push_cast; linarith
            exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hk_ge, by omega⟩
          exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨h_1d_mem _ hv0, h_1d_mem _ hv1⟩
        have hcard2 : (S.image w_of).card ≤ (2 * B₂ + 1) ^ 2 := by
          calc (S.image w_of).card ≤ Box2.card := Finset.card_le_card h_sub2
            _ = (2 * B₂ + 1) * (2 * B₂ + 1) := by
                simp only [Box2, I₂, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Icc]
                have h_sub_int : ((B₂ : ℤ) + 1 - -(B₂ : ℤ)).toNat = 2 * B₂ + 1 := by omega
                rw [h_sub_int]
            _ = (2 * B₂ + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
        have hceil2 : (B₂ : ℝ) < (1 / 2) * ε ^ (-h) + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity)
        have h1d_le : ((2 * B₂ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-h) := by
          push_cast; linarith
        have hexp2 : (ε ^ (-h)) ^ 2 = ε ^ (-((2 : ℝ) * h)) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul hε₀.le]
          ring_nf
        rw [hd2, Nat.cast_ofNat]
        calc (((S.image w_of).card : ℝ)) ≤ (((2 * B₂ + 1) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard2
          _ = ((2 * B₂ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by push_cast; rfl
          _ ≤ (4 * ε ^ (-h)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1d_le 2
          _ = 16 * (ε ^ (-h)) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = 16 * ε ^ (-((2 : ℝ) * h)) := by rw [hexp2]

    let al_tag : Fin N → Bool := fun α =>
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      if d_dim = 1 then decide (projAngleDist (perp2D (e_at α)) (n_fine (p_of α)) ≤ 2 * ε ^ h)
      else false
    let W₁ : Fin N → Finset (Fin N) := fun α => W_all.filter (fun β => al_tag β = al_tag α)
    let c_pw : Fin N → ℕ := fun α =>
      ((W₁ α).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α ∧ w_of β = w_of α)).card
    let m₁ : Fin N → ℕ := fun α => Nat.floor ((Real.log (c_pw α : ℝ) / ell) / ξ)
    let W₂ : Fin N → Finset (Fin N) := fun α => (W₁ α).filter (fun β => m₁ β = m₁ α)
    let W_dist : Fin N → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := fun α =>
      ((W₂ α).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α)).image w_of
    let c_w : Fin N → ℕ := fun α => (W_dist α).card
    let mk : Fin N → ℕ := fun α => Nat.floor ((Real.log (c_w α : ℝ) / ell) / ξ)
    let vel_key : Fin N → Bool × (ℕ × ℕ) := fun α => (al_tag α, (m₁ α, mk α))

    have hm₁_inv : ∀ α β : Fin N,
        al_tag β = al_tag α → p_of β = p_of α → w_of β = w_of α →
        c_pw β = c_pw α ∧ m₁ β = m₁ α := by
      intro α β hal hp hw
      have hW1 : W₁ β = W₁ α := by ext γ; simp only [W₁, Finset.mem_filter, hal]
      have hcpw : c_pw β = c_pw α := by
        dsimp only [c_pw]
        rw [hW1]
        congr 1
        ext γ
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hp, hw]
      exact ⟨hcpw, by dsimp only [m₁]; rw [hcpw]⟩

    have hmk_inv : ∀ α β : Fin N,
        al_tag β = al_tag α → m₁ β = m₁ α → p_of β = p_of α →
        W_dist β = W_dist α ∧ c_w β = c_w α ∧ mk β = mk α := by
      intro α β hal hm1 hp
      have hW1 : W₁ β = W₁ α := by ext γ; simp only [W₁, Finset.mem_filter, hal]
      have hW2 : W₂ β = W₂ α := by
        dsimp only [W₂]; rw [hW1]; ext γ; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hm1]
      have hWd : W_dist β = W_dist α := by
        dsimp only [W_dist]; rw [hW2]; congr 1; ext γ; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hp]
      have hcw : c_w β = c_w α := by dsimp only [c_w]; rw [hWd]
      exact ⟨hWd, hcw, by dsimp only [mk]; rw [hcw]⟩

    have h_key_bounds : ∀ α ∈ W_all,
        m₁ α < Nat.ceil (Q_cnt / ξ) + 1 ∧
        mk α < Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3 := by
      intro α hα
      have hα_cpw : α ∈ (W₁ α).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α ∧ w_of β = w_of α) := by
        simp only [W₁, Finset.mem_filter, hα, true_and]
      have hcpw_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (c_pw α : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.one_le_card.mpr ⟨α, hα_cpw⟩
      have hcpw_le_Q : (c_pw α : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-Q_cnt) := by
        have hsub : (W₁ α).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α ∧ w_of β = w_of α) ⊆ W_all :=
          Finset.filter_subset _ _ |>.trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub) hW_card
      have hlog_cpw : Real.log (c_pw α : ℝ) / ell ≤ Q_cnt := by
        have hlog_le := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hcpw_le_Q
        rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlogε] at hlog_le
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
        linarith
      have hm1_div : (Real.log (c_pw α : ℝ) / ell) / ξ ≤ (Nat.ceil (Q_cnt / ξ) : ℝ) :=
        le_trans ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hξ).mpr hlog_cpw) (Nat.le_ceil _)
      have hm1_le : m₁ α ≤ Nat.ceil (Q_cnt / ξ) := by
        have hfl := Nat.floor_mono hm1_div
        rwa [Nat.floor_natCast] at hfl

      have hα_W2p : α ∈ (W₂ α).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α) := by
        simp only [W₂, W₁, Finset.mem_filter, hα, true_and]
      have hcw_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (c_w α : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.one_le_card.mpr ⟨w_of α, Finset.mem_image_of_mem w_of hα_W2p⟩
      have hcw_le16 : (c_w α : ℝ) ≤ 16 * ε ^ (-((d_dim : ℝ) * h)) :=
        h_w_per_pc (p_of α) ((W₂ α).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α))
          (fun β hβ => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hβ).2)
      have hlog_cw : Real.log (c_w α : ℝ) / ell ≤ ξ + (d_dim : ℝ) * h := by
        have hlog_le := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hcw_le16
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne',
          Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlogε] at hlog_le
        have hdiv_le : Real.log (c_w α : ℝ) / ell ≤ Real.log 16 / ell + (d_dim : ℝ) * h := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
          have h16 := (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mp (le_refl (Real.log 16 / ell))
          linarith
        linarith [h_log16]
      have hmk_div : (Real.log (c_w α : ℝ) / ell) / ξ ≤
          ((Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        have h1 : (Real.log (c_w α : ℝ) / ell) / ξ ≤ 1 + ((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ := by
          have := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hξ).mpr hlog_cw
          rwa [add_div, div_self hξ.ne'] at this
        have h2 : ((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ ≤ (Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        push_cast
        linarith
      have hmk_le : mk α ≤ Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 1 := by
        have hfl := Nat.floor_mono hmk_div
        rwa [Nat.floor_natCast] at hfl
      exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm1_le, by omega⟩

    let Keys : Finset (Bool × (ℕ × ℕ)) := W_all.image vel_key
    obtain ⟨α_init, hα_init⟩ := hW_ne
    have hKeys_ne : Keys.Nonempty := ⟨vel_key α_init, Finset.mem_image_of_mem vel_key hα_init⟩
    let U_cnt : ℕ := Keys.card
    have hU_pos : 1 ≤ U_cnt := Finset.one_le_card.mpr hKeys_ne
    let BoxU : Finset (Bool × (ℕ × ℕ)) :=
      (Finset.univ : Finset Bool) ×ˢ
        (Finset.range (Nat.ceil (Q_cnt / ξ) + 1) ×ˢ
          Finset.range (Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3))
    have hKeys_sub : Keys ⊆ BoxU := by
      intro k hk
      obtain ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk
      obtain ⟨hm1_lt, hmk_lt⟩ := h_key_bounds α hα
      simp only [BoxU, vel_key, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_range, true_and]
      exact ⟨hm1_lt, hmk_lt⟩
    have hU_le : U_cnt ≤ 2 * (Nat.ceil (Q_cnt / ξ) + 1) * (Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3) := by
      calc U_cnt ≤ BoxU.card := Finset.card_le_card hKeys_sub
        _ = 2 * ((Nat.ceil (Q_cnt / ξ) + 1) * (Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3)) := by
            simp only [BoxU, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_bool, Finset.card_range]
        _ = 2 * (Nat.ceil (Q_cnt / ξ) + 1) * (Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3) := by ring

    let eU : { x // x ∈ Keys } ≃ Fin U_cnt := Keys.equivFin
    let k_of_u : Fin U_cnt → Bool × (ℕ × ℕ) := fun u => (eU.symm u).1
    let al_of : Fin U_cnt → Bool := fun u => (k_of_u u).1
    let mk_of : Fin U_cnt → ℕ := fun u => (k_of_u u).2.2
    let R_set : Fin U_cnt → Finset (Fin N) :=
      fun u => W_all.filter (fun α => vel_key α = k_of_u u)

    have hR_fiber : ∀ (u : Fin U_cnt) (α₀ : Fin N), α₀ ∈ R_set u →
        (R_set u).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α₀) =
          (W₂ α₀).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α₀) := by
      intro u α₀ hα₀R
      have hk_α₀ : vel_key α₀ = k_of_u u := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα₀R).2
      ext β
      simp only [R_set, W₂, W₁, Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hβW, hk_β⟩, hp_β⟩
        have hk_eq : vel_key β = vel_key α₀ := hk_β.trans hk_α₀.symm
        exact ⟨⟨⟨hβW, congr_arg Prod.fst hk_eq⟩, congr_arg (fun q => q.2.1) hk_eq⟩, hp_β⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hβW, hal_β⟩, hm1_β⟩, hp_β⟩
        have hmk_β : mk β = mk α₀ := (hmk_inv α₀ β hal_β hm1_β hp_β).2.2
        have hk_eq : vel_key β = vel_key α₀ := Prod.ext hal_β (Prod.ext hm1_β hmk_β)
        exact ⟨⟨hβW, hk_eq.trans hk_α₀⟩, hp_β⟩

    have hW2_pw : ∀ α₁ : Fin N,
        (W₂ α₁).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α₁ ∧ w_of β = w_of α₁) =
          (W₁ α₁).filter (fun β => p_of β = p_of α₁ ∧ w_of β = w_of α₁) := by
      intro α₁
      ext β
      simp only [W₂, Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hβW1, _⟩, hpw⟩; exact ⟨hβW1, hpw⟩
      · rintro ⟨hβW1, hp, hw⟩
        have hal : al_tag β = al_tag α₁ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hβW1).2
        exact ⟨⟨hβW1, (hm₁_inv α₁ β hal hp hw).2⟩, hp, hw⟩

    have hR_ne : ∀ u : Fin U_cnt, (R_set u).Nonempty := by
      intro u
      have hk_mem : k_of_u u ∈ Keys := (eU.symm u).2
      obtain ⟨α, hαW, hk_α⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk_mem
      exact ⟨α, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hαW, hk_α⟩⟩

    refine ⟨U_cnt, R_set, al_of, mk_of, hU_pos, hU_le, hR_ne, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u₁ u₂ hne
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro α hα₁ hα₂
      have hk₁ : vel_key α = k_of_u u₁ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα₁).2
      have hk₂ : vel_key α = k_of_u u₂ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα₂).2
      exact hne (eU.symm.injective (Subtype.ext (hk₁.symm.trans hk₂)))
    · ext α
      simp only [R_set, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_filter, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, hαW, _⟩; exact hαW
      · intro hαW
        have hk_mem : vel_key α ∈ Keys := Finset.mem_image_of_mem vel_key hαW
        let u : Fin U_cnt := eU ⟨vel_key α, hk_mem⟩
        refine ⟨u, hαW, ?_⟩
