  have hN_le_Q : (N_atom : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-Q_cnt) := by
    have hε_lt_e1 : ε < ε₁ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have h2C : 2 * C_cut < ε⁻¹ := (lt_inv_comm₀ hε₀ (by linarith)).mp hε_lt_e1
    have hC_le : C_cut ≤ ε ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]; linarith
    calc (N_atom : ℝ) ≤ C_cut * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor + 4)) := hN_at_le
      _ ≤ ε ^ (-1 : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor + 4)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le
      _ = ε ^ (-Q_cnt) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
          congr 1; dsimp only [Q_cnt]; ring

  have h_log16 : Real.log 16 / ell ≤ ξ := by
    have hε_lt_e2 : ε < ε₂ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hexp_lt : Real.exp ((Real.log 16 + 1) / ξ) < ε⁻¹ :=
      (lt_inv_comm₀ hε₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).mp hε_lt_e2
    have hlog_lt := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos _) hexp_lt
    rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog_lt
    have hm := (div_lt_iff₀ hξ).mp hlog_lt
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
    linarith

  have h_log_Smax : Real.log (S_max : ℝ) / ell ≤ R_bud / 64 := by
    have hε_lt_e3 : ε < ε₃ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
    have hexp_lt : Real.exp ((Real.log (S_max : ℝ) + 1) / (R_bud / 64)) < ε⁻¹ :=
      (lt_inv_comm₀ hε₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).mp hε_lt_e3
    have hlog_lt := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos _) hexp_lt
    rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog_lt
    have hm := (div_lt_iff₀ hR64_pos).mp hlog_lt
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
    linarith

  let W_max : ℝ := min (L - r - b_star) ((H_P - r) / 2 - b_star)
  have hW_pos : 0 < W_max := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hW_le_K : W_max ≤ cls.K_hor :=
    le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
  have hs_v_pos : 0 < s_v := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ b_star
  have hs_c_pos : 0 < s_c := by dsimp only [s_c]; positivity
  have hs_x_pos : 0 < s_x := mul_pos hs_c_pos hs_v_pos
  have hρ_t_pos : 0 < ρ_t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
  have hρ_r_pos : 0 < ρ_r := by
    dsimp only [ρ_r]
    split_ifs
    · exact inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam_pos)
    · exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
  have hσ_r_pos : 0 < σ_r := inv_pos.mpr (mul_pos hlam_pos hρ_r_pos)

  let V'_at : Fin N_atom → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun α => s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
  let X'_at : Fin N_atom → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun α => s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
  have hVX'_tight : ∀ α : Fin N_atom,
      ‖V'_at α‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4 ∧
      ‖X'_at α‖ ≤ 8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10 := by
    intro α
    obtain ⟨hV, hX⟩ := hVX_at α
    constructor
    · dsimp only [V'_at]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs_v_pos)]
      calc s_v⁻¹ * ‖V_at α - V_J‖
          ≤ s_v⁻¹ * ((4 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4) * s_v) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV (inv_pos.mpr hs_v_pos).le
        _ = 4 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4 := by field_simp [hs_v_pos.ne']
    · dsimp only [X'_at]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs_x_pos)]
      calc s_x⁻¹ * ‖X_at α - X_J‖
          ≤ s_x⁻¹ * ((8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10) * s_x) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX (inv_pos.mpr hs_x_pos).le
        _ = 8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10 := by field_simp [hs_x_pos.ne']
  have hVX'_dom : ∀ α : Fin N_atom, ‖V'_at α‖ ≤ R_loc_dom ∧ ‖X'_at α‖ ≤ R_loc_dom := by
    intro α
    obtain ⟨hV, hX⟩ := hVX'_tight α
    exact ⟨by dsimp only [R_loc_dom]; linarith, hX⟩

  let e_mass : Fin N_atom → ℝ := fun α => -Real.log (‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) / ell
  let m_idx : Fin N_atom → ℕ := fun α => Nat.floor (e_mass α / ξ)
  let m_bin_val : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => ε ^ (((m : ℝ) + 1) * ξ)
  have hm_atom_props : ∀ α : Fin N_atom,
      m_idx α < M_mass ∧
      m_bin_val (m_idx α) ≤ ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ (-ξ) * m_bin_val (m_idx α) := by
    intro α
    have hc_pos : 0 < ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ B_cut) (hc_lo α)
    have hc_le1 : ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun β => ‖c_atom β‖ ^ 2)
        (fun β _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ α)) hc_sum
    have hlog_le0 : Real.log (‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ≤ 0 := by
      simpa using Real.log_le_log hc_pos hc_le1
    have hem_nn : 0 ≤ e_mass α := div_nonneg (by linarith) hell_pos.le
    have hem_le_B : e_mass α ≤ B_cut := by
      have hlog_lo := Real.log_le_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ B_cut) (hc_lo α)
      rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlogε] at hlog_lo
      dsimp only [e_mass]
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
      linarith
    have hdiv_le : e_mass α / ξ ≤ (Nat.ceil (B_cut / ξ) : ℝ) :=
      le_trans ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hξ).mpr hem_le_B) (Nat.le_ceil _)
    have hm_le : m_idx α ≤ Nat.ceil (B_cut / ξ) := by
      have hfl := Nat.floor_mono hdiv_le
      rwa [Nat.floor_natCast] at hfl
    have hm_lo_e : (m_idx α : ℝ) * ξ ≤ e_mass α :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hξ).mp (Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hem_nn hξ.le))
    have hm_hi_e : e_mass α < ((m_idx α : ℝ) + 1) * ξ :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ hξ).mp (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _)
    have hlog_div_eq : Real.log (‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) / ell = -e_mass α := by
      dsimp only [e_mass]; ring
    have hc_ge_m : m_bin_val (m_idx α) ≤ ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : -(((m_idx α : ℝ) + 1) * ξ) ≤ Real.log (‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) / ell := by
        rw [hlog_div_eq]; linarith
      have hr := h_rpow_le hc_pos h1
      rwa [neg_neg] at hr
    have hc_le_m : ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ (-ξ) * m_bin_val (m_idx α) := by
      have h1 : Real.log (‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) / ell ≤ -((m_idx α : ℝ) * ξ) := by
        rw [hlog_div_eq]; linarith
      have hr := h_le_rpow hc_pos h1
      rw [neg_neg] at hr
      have hexp : ε ^ ((m_idx α : ℝ) * ξ) = ε ^ (-ξ) * m_bin_val (m_idx α) := by
        dsimp only [m_bin_val]
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
        congr 1; ring
      rwa [hexp] at hr
    exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm_le, hc_ge_m, hc_le_m⟩

  let MassKeys : Finset ℕ := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_atom)).image m_idx
  let α_def : Fin N_atom := ⟨0, hN_atom⟩
  have hMassKeys_ne : MassKeys.Nonempty :=
    ⟨m_idx α_def, Finset.mem_image_of_mem m_idx (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩
  have hMassKeys_card : MassKeys.card ≤ M_mass := by
    have hsub : MassKeys ⊆ Finset.range M_mass := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨α, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hm_atom_props α).1
    exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (by simp)
  let B_of : ℕ → Finset (Fin N_atom) := fun m => Finset.univ.filter (fun α => m_idx α = m)

  let N_w : ℕ := Nat.ceil (W_max / (ξ / 4))
  let w_of_menu : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => min ((i : ℝ) * (ξ / 4)) W_max
  have hNw_succ_le : N_w + 1 ≤ M_w := by
    have hδ : 0 < ξ / 4 := by linarith
    have hle : N_w ≤ Nat.ceil (cls.K_hor / (ξ / 4)) :=
      Nat.ceil_mono ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hδ).mpr hW_le_K)
    dsimp only [M_w]
    omega

  obtain ⟨M_menu, ib_menu, ia_menu, e_menu, V_menu, X_menu,
    _, hmenu_props, hmenu_all_W, hmenu_cov⟩ :=
    anisotropic_cap_menu_and_covering γ ε ξ W_max R_loc_dom
      hγ₀ hγ₁ hε₀ hε₁_half hξ hW_pos hR_loc_ge1 N_atom V'_at X'_at hVX'_dom

  let b_menu : Fin M_menu → ℝ := fun κ => w_of_menu (ib_menu κ)
  let a_menu : Fin M_menu → ℝ := fun κ => w_of_menu (ia_menu κ)
  let in_cap : Fin M_menu → Fin N_atom → Prop := fun κ α =>
    |inner ℝ (V'_at α - V_menu κ) (e_menu κ)| ≤ ε ^ (b_menu κ) ∧
    |inner ℝ (V'_at α - V_menu κ) (perp2D (e_menu κ))| ≤ ε ^ (a_menu κ) ∧
    |inner ℝ (X'_at α - X_menu κ) (e_menu κ)| ≤ ε ^ (b_menu κ) ∧
    |inner ℝ (X'_at α - X_menu κ) (perp2D (e_menu κ))| ≤ ε ^ (a_menu κ)
  let E_cap : Fin M_menu → Finset (Fin N_atom) := fun κ =>
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    Finset.univ.filter (in_cap κ)
  have hE_cap_iff : ∀ κ α, α ∈ E_cap κ ↔ in_cap κ α := by
    intro κ α
    simp [E_cap]
  let w_cap : Fin M_menu → ℝ := fun κ => pktWeight γ (b_menu κ) (a_menu κ)

  have hw_cap_bounds : ∀ κ : Fin M_menu,
      0 ≤ w_cap κ ∧ w_cap κ ≤ 2 * cls.K_hor ∧ ib_menu κ ≤ N_w ∧ ia_menu κ ≤ N_w := by
    intro κ
    obtain ⟨hibia, hiaNw, hb0, hba, haW, _⟩ := hmenu_props κ
    dsimp only at hb0 hba haW
    have hbK : b_menu κ ≤ cls.K_hor := le_trans hba (le_trans haW hW_le_K)
    have haK : a_menu κ ≤ cls.K_hor := le_trans haW hW_le_K
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, le_trans hibia hiaNw, hiaNw⟩
    · dsimp only [w_cap, pktWeight, b_menu, a_menu, w_of_menu]; nlinarith
    · dsimp only [w_cap, pktWeight]
      have h1 : (1 + γ) * b_menu κ ≤ (1 + γ) * cls.K_hor :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbK (by linarith)
      have h2 : (1 - γ) * a_menu κ ≤ (1 - γ) * cls.K_hor :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left haK (by linarith)
      linarith

  have h_all_cover_W : ∀ α : Fin N_atom, ∃ κ : Fin M_menu,
      α ∈ E_cap κ ∧ 2 * W_max ≤ w_cap κ := by
    intro α
    obtain ⟨κ, _, _, hbW, haW, hinc⟩ := hmenu_all_W α
    dsimp only at hbW haW hinc
    refine ⟨κ, (hE_cap_iff κ α).mpr hinc, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [w_cap, pktWeight, b_menu, a_menu, w_of_menu]
    rw [hbW, haW]
    linarith

  have h_greedy_each : ∀ m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys },
      ∃ (G_cnt : ℕ) (G_set : Fin G_cnt → Finset (Fin N_atom))
        (g_idx_of ib_of ia_of : Fin G_cnt → ℕ)
        (step_of : Fin N_atom → ℕ) (κ_of : Fin N_atom → Fin M_menu),
        1 ≤ G_cnt ∧ G_cnt ≤ M_grp ∧
        (∀ g : Fin G_cnt, (G_set g).Nonempty) ∧
        (∀ g₁ g₂ : Fin G_cnt, g₁ ≠ g₂ → Disjoint (G_set g₁) (G_set g₂)) ∧
        (Finset.univ.biUnion G_set = B_of m.1) ∧
        (∀ g : Fin G_cnt,
          let g_bin := ((g_idx_of g : ℝ) + 1) * ξ
          2 * W_max < g_bin ∧
          ib_of g ≤ N_w ∧ ia_of g ≤ N_w ∧
          (∀ α ∈ G_set g,
            in_cap (κ_of α) α ∧
            ib_menu (κ_of α) = ib_of g ∧
            ia_menu (κ_of α) = ia_of g ∧
            (∀ α' ∈ G_set g, step_of α = step_of α' → κ_of α = κ_of α')) ∧
          (∀ κ : Fin M_menu,
            (((G_set g) ∩ (E_cap κ)).card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-g_bin + w_cap κ)) ∧
          (∀ α ∈ G_set g,
            ε ^ (-g_bin + w_cap (κ_of α) + ξ) ≤
              (((G_set g).filter (fun α' => step_of α' = step_of α)).card : ℝ))) := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨α₀, _, hα₀_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp m.2
    have hBm_ne : (B_of m.1).Nonempty :=
      ⟨α₀, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hα₀_eq⟩⟩
    have hBm_card : ((B_of m.1).card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-Q_cnt) := by
      have hle_N : ((B_of m.1).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_atom : ℝ) := by
        have := Finset.card_le_univ (B_of m.1)
        rw [Fintype.card_fin] at this
        exact_mod_cast this
      exact le_trans hle_N hN_le_Q
    obtain ⟨G_cnt, G_set, g_idx_of, ib_of, ia_of, step_of, κ_of,
      hG1, hG_le_raw, hG_ne, hG_disj, hG_biU, hG_props⟩ :=
      greedy_set_removal_and_grouping ε ξ (2 * W_max) (2 * cls.K_hor) Q_cnt
        hε₀ hε₁_half hξ (by linarith) (by linarith) hQ_cnt_nn
        N_atom M_menu N_w E_cap w_cap ib_menu ia_menu (B_of m.1)
        hBm_ne hBm_card hw_cap_bounds (fun α _ => h_all_cover_W α)
    have hG_le : G_cnt ≤ M_grp :=
      le_trans hG_le_raw (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hNw_succ_le 2))
    refine ⟨G_cnt, G_set, g_idx_of, ib_of, ia_of, step_of, κ_of,
      hG1, hG_le, hG_ne, hG_disj, hG_biU, fun g => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hg_lo, _, hib_g, hia_g, h_at, h_cap_hi, h_fib_lo⟩ := hG_props g
    refine ⟨hg_lo, hib_g, hia_g, ?_, h_cap_hi, h_fib_lo⟩
    intro α hαG
    obtain ⟨hαE, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h_at α hαG
    exact ⟨(hE_cap_iff _ _).mp hαE, h1, h2, h3⟩

  choose G_cnt G_set g_idx_of ib_of ia_of step_of κ_of hG_spec using h_greedy_each

  let p_at_atom : Fin N_atom → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
    fun α => atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)
  let w_at_atom : Fin N_atom → ℤ × ℤ :=
    fun α => fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine (p_at_atom α) (V_at α)

  have h_vel_each : ∀ (m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys }) (g : Fin (G_cnt m)),
      ∃ (U_cnt : ℕ) (R_set : Fin U_cnt → Finset (Fin N_atom))
        (al_of : Fin U_cnt → Bool) (mk_of : Fin U_cnt → ℕ),
        1 ≤ U_cnt ∧ U_cnt ≤ M_vel ∧
        (∀ u : Fin U_cnt, (R_set u).Nonempty) ∧
        (∀ u₁ u₂ : Fin U_cnt, u₁ ≠ u₂ → Disjoint (R_set u₁) (R_set u₂)) ∧
        (Finset.univ.biUnion R_set = G_set m g) ∧
        (use_vel_sub = false → ∀ u : Fin U_cnt, R_set u = G_set m g) ∧
        (use_vel_sub = true → ∀ u : Fin U_cnt,
          let k_bin := (mk_of u : ℝ) * ξ
          mk_of u < Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) + 3 ∧
          (d_dim = 1 → ∀ α ∈ R_set u,
            (al_of u = true ↔
              projAngleDist (perp2D (e_menu (κ_of m α))) (n_fine (p_at_atom α)) ≤ 2 * ε ^ h)) ∧
          (∀ p_c w,
            (((R_set u).filter (fun α => p_at_atom α = p_c ∧ w_at_atom α = w)).card : ℝ) ≤
              ε ^ (k_bin - ξ) * (((R_set u).filter (fun α => p_at_atom α = p_c)).card : ℝ)) ∧
          (∀ p_buf,
            ((((R_set u).image (fun α => (p_at_atom α, w_at_atom α))).filter
              (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
              ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(k_bin + ξ)))) := by
    intro m g
    cases h_uvs : use_vel_sub
    · refine ⟨1, fun _ => G_set m g, fun _ => false, fun _ => 0,
        le_rfl, h4_vel, fun _ => (hG_spec m).2.2.1 g, ?_, ?_, fun _ _ => rfl,
        fun ht => False.elim (Bool.false_ne_true ht)⟩
      · intro u₁ u₂ hne; exfalso; exact hne (Subsingleton.elim u₁ u₂)
      · ext α; simp
    · obtain ⟨hh_pos, hr_eq⟩ := hvel_h h_uvs
      have hG_card_Q : ((G_set m g).card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-Q_cnt) := by
        have hle_N : ((G_set m g).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_atom : ℝ) := by
          have := Finset.card_le_univ (G_set m g)
          rw [Fintype.card_fin] at this
          exact_mod_cast this
        exact le_trans hle_N hN_le_Q
      obtain ⟨U_cnt, R_set, al_of, mk_of, hU1, hU_le_raw, hR_ne, hR_disj, hR_biU, hR_props⟩ :=
        two_stage_velocity_subdivision ε H_P t r h ξ Q_cnt d_dim M_L N_atom j₀.1
          τ_V τ_X n_buf V_at X_at (fun α => e_menu (κ_of m α)) (G_set m g)
          hε₀ hε₁_half hξ hh_pos hr_eq hQ_cnt_nn hd_dim hML hn_buf h_log16
          ((hG_spec m).2.2.1 g) hG_card_Q
      have hd_le2 : (d_dim : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
        rcases hd_dim with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
      have hdh_le_K : (d_dim : ℝ) * h ≤ cls.K_hor := by
        calc (d_dim : ℝ) * h ≤ 2 * h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd_le2 hh_pos.le
          _ = t - r := by linarith [hr_eq]
          _ ≤ cls.K_hor := by linarith
      have hceil_le : Nat.ceil (((d_dim : ℝ) * h) / ξ) ≤ Nat.ceil (cls.K_hor / ξ) :=
        Nat.ceil_mono ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hξ).mpr hdh_le_K)
      have hU_le : U_cnt ≤ M_vel :=
        le_trans hU_le_raw (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.add_le_add_right hceil_le 3))
      exact ⟨U_cnt, R_set, al_of, mk_of, hU1, hU_le, hR_ne, hR_disj, hR_biU,
        fun hf => False.elim (Bool.false_ne_true hf.symm), fun _ => hR_props⟩

  choose U_cnt R_set al_of mk_of hU_spec using h_vel_each

  let Idx := Σ (m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys }) (g : Fin (G_cnt m)), Fin (U_cnt m g)
  have : DecidableEq Idx := Classical.decEq Idx
  let S_loc : ℕ := Fintype.card Idx
  let eS : Idx ≃ Fin S_loc := Fintype.equivFin Idx
  let m_init : { x // x ∈ MassKeys } :=
    ⟨m_idx α_def, Finset.mem_image_of_mem m_idx (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩
  have hS_loc_ge1 : 1 ≤ S_loc := by
    let g₀ : Fin (G_cnt m_init) := ⟨0, (hG_spec m_init).1⟩
    let u₀ : Fin (U_cnt m_init g₀) := ⟨0, (hU_spec m_init g₀).1⟩
    have : Nonempty Idx := ⟨⟨m_init, g₀, u₀⟩⟩
    exact Fintype.card_pos
  have hS_loc_le_max : S_loc ≤ S_max := by
    have hcard_sig : S_loc =
        ∑ m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys }, ∑ g : Fin (G_cnt m), U_cnt m g := by
      dsimp only [S_loc, Idx]
      simp only [Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [hcard_sig]
    have h_inner : ∀ m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys },
        ∑ g : Fin (G_cnt m), U_cnt m g ≤ M_grp * M_vel := by
      intro m
      calc ∑ g : Fin (G_cnt m), U_cnt m g
          ≤ ∑ _g : Fin (G_cnt m), M_vel :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun g _ => (hU_spec m g).2.1)
        _ = G_cnt m * M_vel := by simp
        _ ≤ M_grp * M_vel := Nat.mul_le_mul_right M_vel (hG_spec m).2.1
    calc ∑ m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys }, ∑ g : Fin (G_cnt m), U_cnt m g
        ≤ ∑ _m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys }, M_grp * M_vel :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => h_inner m)
      _ = MassKeys.card * (M_grp * M_vel) := by simp
      _ ≤ M_mass * (M_grp * M_vel) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hMassKeys_card
      _ = S_max := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

  have hS_loc_log : Real.log (S_loc : ℝ) / ell ≤ R_bud / 64 := by
    have hlog_le : Real.log (S_loc : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (S_max : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hS_loc_ge1) (by exact_mod_cast hS_loc_le_max)
    exact le_trans ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr hlog_le) h_log_Smax

  have h_card_filter_pb : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin N_atom))
      (P : Fin T.card → Prop) (Q : Fin N_atom → Prop)
      (dp : DecidablePred P) (dq : DecidablePred Q),
      let idx := fun α : Fin T.card => (T.equivFin.symm α).1
      (∀ α : Fin T.card, P α ↔ Q (idx α)) →
      (@Finset.filter _ P dp Finset.univ).card = (@Finset.filter _ Q dq T).card := by
    intro T P Q dp dq idx hPQ
    let eT := T.equivFin
    have hinj : Function.Injective idx := fun α₁ α₂ h => eT.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
    rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj]
    congr 1
    ext β
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨α, hPα, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(eT.symm α).2, (hPQ α).mp hPα⟩
    · rintro ⟨hβT, hQβ⟩
      refine ⟨eT ⟨β, hβT⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hPQ]; dsimp only [idx, eT]; rwa [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      · dsimp only [idx, eT]; rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

  have h_image_pb : ∀ {γ_t : Type} (d1 d2 : DecidableEq γ_t) (T : Finset (Fin N_atom))
      (f : Fin T.card → γ_t) (g : Fin N_atom → γ_t),
      let idx := fun α : Fin T.card => (T.equivFin.symm α).1
      (∀ α : Fin T.card, f α = g (idx α)) →
      @Finset.image _ _ d1 f Finset.univ = @Finset.image _ _ d2 g T := by
    intro γ_t d1 d2 T f g idx hfg
    let eT := T.equivFin
    ext y
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨α, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨idx α, (eT.symm α).2, (hfg α).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨β, hβT, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨eT ⟨β, hβT⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hfg]; dsimp only [idx, eT]; rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

  let mkSub := fun (m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys }) (g : Fin (G_cnt m))
      (T : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (k_val : ℝ) (al_val : Bool) =>
    let eT := T.equivFin
    let idx := fun α : Fin T.card => (eT.symm α).1
    ({ loc_idx := j₀
       N_all := (G_set m g).card
       m_bin := m_bin_val m.1
       g_bin := ((g_idx_of m g : ℝ) + 1) * ξ
       b_loc := w_of_menu (ib_of m g)
       a_loc := w_of_menu (ia_of m g)
       k_bin := k_val
       is_aligned := al_val
       o_at := fun α => o_atom (idx α)
       ψ_at := fun α => ψ_atom (idx α)
       c_at := fun α => c_atom (idx α)
       cap_id := fun α => step_of m (idx α)
       e_cap := fun α => e_menu (κ_of m (idx α))
       V_cap := fun α => V_menu (κ_of m (idx α))
       X_cap := fun α => X_menu (κ_of m (idx α)) } : LocalizerSubclass T.card)

  have h_mkSub_valid : ∀ (m : { x // x ∈ MassKeys }) (g : Fin (G_cnt m))
      (T : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (k_val : ℝ) (al_val : Bool),
      T.Nonempty → T ⊆ G_set m g →
      IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
        m_r m_t M_mult (fun M => 2 * C_tr_cut M) Φ₀ (mkSub m g T k_val al_val) := by
    intro m g T k_val al_val hT_ne hT_sub_G
    let sub := mkSub m g T k_val al_val
    let eT := T.equivFin
    let idx : Fin T.card → Fin N_atom := fun α => (eT.symm α).1
    have hidx_inj : Function.Injective idx := fun α₁ α₂ h => eT.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
    have hidx_T : ∀ α : Fin T.card, idx α ∈ T := fun α => (eT.symm α).2
    have hidx_G : ∀ α : Fin T.card, idx α ∈ G_set m g := fun α => hT_sub_G (hidx_T α)
    have hG_Bm : G_set m g ⊆ B_of m.1 := by
      intro β hβG
      rw [← (hG_spec m).2.2.2.2.1]
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨g, Finset.mem_univ g, hβG⟩
    obtain ⟨_, hib_g, hia_g, hG_at, hG_cap_hi, hG_fib_lo⟩ := (hG_spec m).2.2.2.2.2 g
    obtain ⟨α₀_G, hα₀_G⟩ := (hG_spec m).2.2.1 g
    obtain ⟨_, hib_α₀, hia_α₀, _⟩ := hG_at α₀_G hα₀_G
    obtain ⟨hibia_α₀, _, hb0_α₀, hba_α₀, haW_α₀, _⟩ := hmenu_props (κ_of m α₀_G)
    dsimp only at hb0_α₀ hba_α₀ haW_α₀
    rw [hib_α₀] at hb0_α₀ hba_α₀
    rw [hia_α₀] at hba_α₀ haW_α₀

    unfold IsValidSubclassAtoms
    let _ := Classical.propDecidable
    refine ⟨Finset.one_le_card.mpr hT_ne, Finset.card_le_card hT_sub_G, hqr_lt,
      hVJ_le, hXJ_le, Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _, hb0_α₀, hba_α₀, haW_α₀, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro α
      have hβG : idx α ∈ G_set m g := hidx_G α
      have hβB : idx α ∈ B_of m.1 := hG_Bm hβG
      have hm_eq : m_idx (idx α) = m.1 := by simpa [B_of] using hβB
      obtain ⟨_, hc_ge, hc_le⟩ := hm_atom_props (idx α)
      rw [hm_eq] at hc_ge hc_le
      obtain ⟨hinc, hib_α, hia_α, hstep_κ⟩ := hG_at (idx α) hβG
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, he_norm⟩ := hmenu_props (κ_of m (idx α))
      dsimp only [in_cap, b_menu, a_menu] at hinc
      rw [hib_α] at hinc
      rw [hia_α] at hinc
      exact ⟨(hψ_at (idx α)).1, (hψ_at (idx α)).2.1, (hψ_at (idx α)).2.2,
        (hVX'_tight (idx α)).1, (hVX'_tight (idx α)).2,
        hc_ge, hc_le, he_norm, hinc.1, hinc.2.1, hinc.2.2.1, hinc.2.2.2,
        fun α' hstep_eq => by
          have hκ_eq := hstep_κ (idx α') (hidx_G α') hstep_eq
          exact ⟨congr_arg e_menu hκ_eq, congr_arg V_menu hκ_eq, congr_arg X_menu hκ_eq⟩⟩
    · intro o₀
      have hc1 : (Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin T.card => sub.o_at α = o₀)).card =
          (T.filter (fun β => o_atom β = o₀)).card :=
        h_card_filter_pb T _ _ _ _ (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
      have hc2 : (T.filter (fun β => o_atom β = o₀)).card ≤
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun β : Fin N_atom => o_atom β = o₀)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (fun β hβ =>
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ β, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hβ).2⟩)
      exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (hc1 ▸ hc2)) (hmult_at o₀)
    · let g_bin := ((g_idx_of m g : ℝ) + 1) * ξ
      let w_loc := pktWeight γ (w_of_menu (ib_of m g)) (w_of_menu (ia_of m g))
      let G := G_set m g
      let C_all : Finset ℕ := G.image (step_of m)
      have himg_T : (Finset.univ.image sub.cap_id).card ≤ C_all.card := by
        rw [h_image_pb _ _ T sub.cap_id (step_of m) (fun _ => rfl)]
        exact Finset.card_le_card (Finset.image_subset_image hT_sub_G)
      have hG_sum : (G.card : ℝ) =
          ∑ c ∈ C_all, (((G.filter (fun β => step_of m β = c)).card : ℝ)) := by
        have hc := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image (step_of m) G
        exact_mod_cast hc
      have h_each_c : ∀ c ∈ C_all,
          ε ^ (-g_bin + w_loc + ξ) ≤
            (((G.filter (fun β => step_of m β = c)).card : ℝ)) := by
        intro c hc
        obtain ⟨β, hβG, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
        obtain ⟨_, hib_β, hia_β, _⟩ := hG_at β hβG
        have hw_eq : w_cap (κ_of m β) = w_loc := by
          dsimp only [w_cap, b_menu, a_menu, w_loc]
          rw [hib_β, hia_β]
        have hfib := hG_fib_lo β hβG
        rw [hw_eq] at hfib
        have hcard_eq : (G.filter (fun α' => step_of m α' = step_of m β)).card =
            (@Finset.filter _ (fun α' => step_of m α' = step_of m β)
              (fun _ => Nat.decEq _ _) G).card :=
          congr_arg Finset.card (by ext x; simp)
        rw [hcard_eq]
        exact hfib
      have hCall_mul : (C_all.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (-g_bin + w_loc + ξ) ≤ (G.card : ℝ) := by
        rw [hG_sum]
        have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_c
        rwa [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at hs
      have hCall_le : (C_all.card : ℝ) ≤ (G.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (g_bin - w_loc - ξ) := by
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCall_mul
          (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (g_bin - w_loc - ξ)).le
        have hcancel : (C_all.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (-g_bin + w_loc + ξ) * ε ^ (g_bin - w_loc - ξ) =
            (C_all.card : ℝ) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
          have hz : -g_bin + w_loc + ξ + (g_bin - w_loc - ξ) = 0 := by ring
          rw [hz, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
        rwa [hcancel] at hm
      have hexp_le : ε ^ (g_bin - w_loc - ξ) ≤ ε ^ (g_bin - w_loc - 2 * ξ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le (by linarith)
      calc ((Finset.univ.image sub.cap_id).card : ℝ)
          ≤ (C_all.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast himg_T
        _ ≤ (G.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (g_bin - w_loc - ξ) := hCall_le
        _ = 1 * (G.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (g_bin - w_loc - ξ) := by ring
        _ ≤ C_cov * (G.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (g_bin - w_loc - 2 * ξ) := by
            refine mul_le_mul
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hC_cov_ge2]) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
              hexp_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le
              (mul_nonneg (by linarith [hC_cov_ge2]) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    · intro b_F a_F R_F e_F V_F X_F hb₀ hba haW hRF heF
      let P_rot : Fin N_atom → Prop := fun β =>
        |inner ℝ (V'_at β - V_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
        |inner ℝ (V'_at β - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F ∧
        |inner ℝ (X'_at β - X_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
        |inner ℝ (X'_at β - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F
      let S_F : Finset (Fin N_atom) := T.filter P_rot
      have hcard_pb : (Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin T.card =>
          |inner ℝ (s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1 - V_J) - V_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
          |inner ℝ (s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1 - V_J) - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F ∧
          |inner ℝ (s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2 - X_J) - X_F) e_F| ≤ R_F * ε ^ b_F ∧
          |inner ℝ (s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2 - X_J) - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ R_F * ε ^ a_F)).card =
          S_F.card :=
        h_card_filter_pb T _ P_rot _ _ (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
      rw [hcard_pb]
      obtain ⟨M_cov, hMcov_card, hMcov_wt, hMcov_cov⟩ :=
        hmenu_cov b_F a_F R_F e_F V_F X_F S_F hb₀ hba haW hRF heF
          (fun β hβ => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hβ).2)
      let G := G_set m g
      let g_bin := ((g_idx_of m g : ℝ) + 1) * ξ
      have hSF_sub_biU : S_F ⊆ M_cov.biUnion (fun κ => G ∩ E_cap κ) := by
        intro β hβSF
        have hβT : β ∈ T := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hβSF).1
        obtain ⟨κ, hκM, hinc_β⟩ := hMcov_cov β hβSF
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
          ⟨κ, hκM, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hT_sub_G hβT, (hE_cap_iff κ β).mpr hinc_β⟩⟩
      have hSF_nat : S_F.card ≤ ∑ κ ∈ M_cov, (G ∩ E_cap κ).card :=
        le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hSF_sub_biU) Finset.card_biUnion_le
      have h_each_κ : ∀ κ ∈ M_cov,
          (((G ∩ E_cap κ).card : ℝ)) ≤ ε ^ (-g_bin + pktWeight γ b_F a_F - 2 * ξ) := by
        intro κ hκ
        have h1 := hG_cap_hi κ
        have hwt := hMcov_wt κ hκ
        dsimp only at hwt
        have hcard_inter : (G ∩ E_cap κ).card =
            (@Inter.inter (Finset (Fin N_atom))
              (@Finset.instInter _ (instDecidableEqFin N_atom)) G (E_cap κ)).card :=
          congr_arg Finset.card (by ext x; simp)
        rw [hcard_inter]
        have hexp : ε ^ (-g_bin + w_cap κ) ≤ ε ^ (-g_bin + pktWeight γ b_F a_F - 2 * ξ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_lt1.le
            (by dsimp only [w_cap, b_menu, a_menu, w_of_menu]; linarith)
        exact le_trans h1 hexp
      calc (S_F.card : ℝ)
          ≤ ∑ κ ∈ M_cov, (((G ∩ E_cap κ).card : ℝ)) := by exact_mod_cast hSF_nat
        _ ≤ ∑ _κ ∈ M_cov, ε ^ (-g_bin + pktWeight γ b_F a_F - 2 * ξ) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_κ
        _ = (M_cov.card : ℝ) * ε ^ (-g_bin + pktWeight γ b_F a_F - 2 * ξ) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ (C_cov * R_F ^ 4) * ε ^ (-g_bin + pktWeight γ b_F a_F - 2 * ξ) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).le
              calc (M_cov.card : ℝ) ≤ C_menu * R_F ^ 4 := hMcov_card
                _ ≤ C_cov * R_F ^ 4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_cov_menu (by positivity)
        _ = C_cov * R_F ^ 4 * ε ^ (-g_bin + pktWeight γ b_F a_F - 2 * ξ) := by ring
    · intro r_loc hrloc C_t V_o X_o ψ_o hVo hXo hψ1 hψ2 hψ3 pair_fn M_tr R_tr hM_tr hR_tr S_near_sub
      let P_cov : Fin N_atom → Prop := fun β =>
        ‖V_o - V_at β‖ ≤ C_cov * ρ_t ∧
        ‖X_o - X_at β - (C_t - C_r) • V_at β‖ ≤ C_cov * R_tr * σ_r
      let P_cut : Fin N_atom → Prop := fun β =>
        ‖V_o - V_at β‖ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t ∧
        ‖X_o - X_at β - (C_t - C_r) • V_at β‖ ≤ C_cut * R_tr * σ_r
      have h_img_T : Finset.univ.image idx = T :=
        h_image_pb _ _ T idx id (fun _ => rfl) |>.trans Finset.image_id
      have h_sum_T : (fun v => ∑ α : Fin T.card, sub.c_at α *
          ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))) =
          (fun v => ∑ β ∈ T, c_atom β * g_at β v) := by
        ext v
        conv_rhs => rw [← h_img_T]
        rw [Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ hxy => hidx_inj hxy)]
      have h_sum_near : (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near_sub, sub.c_at α *
          ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))))) =
          (fun v => ∑ β ∈ T.filter P_cov, c_atom β * g_at β v) := by
        ext v
        have h_filt_eq : T.filter P_cov = S_near_sub.image idx := by
          conv_lhs => rw [← h_img_T]
          rw [Finset.filter_image]
        rw [h_filt_eq, Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ hxy => hidx_inj hxy)]
      have h_double_filt : (T.filter P_cov).filter P_cut = T.filter P_cut := by
        ext β
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, P_cov, P_cut]
        constructor
        · exact fun h => ⟨h.1.1, h.2⟩
        · intro ⟨hβT, h1, h2⟩
          refine ⟨⟨hβT, ?_, ?_⟩, h1, h2⟩
          · exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_cov_cut hρ_t_pos.le)
          · exact le_trans h2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_cov_cut (by linarith)) hσ_r_pos.le)
      have htr1 := h_tr r_loc hrloc V_o X_o ψ_o hVo hXo hψ1 hψ2 hψ3 T M_tr R_tr hM_tr hR_tr
      have htr2 := h_tr r_loc hrloc V_o X_o ψ_o hVo hXo hψ1 hψ2 hψ3 (T.filter P_cov) M_tr R_tr hM_tr hR_tr
      dsimp only at htr1 htr2
      rw [h_double_filt] at htr2
      rw [h_sum_T, h_sum_near]
      let z₁ := pair_fn (fun v => ∑ β ∈ T, c_atom β * g_at β v)
      let z₂ := pair_fn (fun v => ∑ β ∈ T.filter P_cov, c_atom β * g_at β v)
      let z₀ := pair_fn (fun v => ∑ β ∈ T.filter P_cut, c_atom β * g_at β v)
      have hz_split : z₁ - z₂ = (z₁ - z₀) - (z₂ - z₀) := by ring
      calc ‖z₁ - z₂‖ = ‖(z₁ - z₀) - (z₂ - z₀)‖ := congr_arg norm hz_split
        _ ≤ ‖z₁ - z₀‖ + ‖z₂ - z₀‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ C_tr_cut M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) +
              C_tr_cut M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) := add_le_add htr1 htr2
        _ = (2 * C_tr_cut M_tr) * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) := by ring

  let idx_tup : Fin S_loc → Idx := fun s => eS.symm s
  let m_of_s : Fin S_loc → { x // x ∈ MassKeys } := fun s => (idx_tup s).1
  let g_of_s : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (G_cnt (m_of_s s)) := fun s => (idx_tup s).2.1
  let u_of_s : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (U_cnt (m_of_s s) (g_of_s s)) := fun s => (idx_tup s).2.2
  let G_of_s : Fin S_loc → Finset (Fin N_atom) := fun s => G_set (m_of_s s) (g_of_s s)
  let R_of_s : Fin S_loc → Finset (Fin N_atom) :=
    fun s => R_set (m_of_s s) (g_of_s s) (u_of_s s)
  have hR_sub_G : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, R_of_s s ⊆ G_of_s s := by
    intro s β hβR
    dsimp only [G_of_s]
    rw [← (hU_spec (m_of_s s) (g_of_s s)).2.2.2.2.1]
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨u_of_s s, Finset.mem_univ _, hβR⟩

  let N_all_loc : Fin S_loc → ℕ := fun s => (G_of_s s).card
  let N_ret_loc : Fin S_loc → ℕ := fun s => (R_of_s s).card
  let whole_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, LocalizerSubclass (N_all_loc s) :=
    fun s => mkSub (m_of_s s) (g_of_s s) (G_of_s s) 0 false
  let sub_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_loc s) :=
    fun s => mkSub (m_of_s s) (g_of_s s) (R_of_s s)
      ((mk_of (m_of_s s) (g_of_s s) (u_of_s s) : ℝ) * ξ)
      (al_of (m_of_s s) (g_of_s s) (u_of_s s))
  let idx_all : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_all_loc s) → Fin N_atom :=
    fun s β => ((G_of_s s).equivFin.symm β).1
  let idx_ret : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_ret_loc s) → Fin N_atom :=
    fun s α => ((R_of_s s).equivFin.symm α).1
  let emb_loc : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Fin (N_ret_loc s) → Fin (N_all_loc s) :=
    fun s α => (G_of_s s).equivFin ⟨idx_ret s α, hR_sub_G s ((R_of_s s).equivFin.symm α).2⟩

  have hidx_all_inj : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Function.Injective (idx_all s) :=
    fun s β₁ β₂ h => (G_of_s s).equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  have hidx_ret_inj : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Function.Injective (idx_ret s) :=
    fun s α₁ α₂ h => (R_of_s s).equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  have hidx_comp : ∀ (s : Fin S_loc) (α : Fin (N_ret_loc s)),
      idx_ret s α = idx_all s (emb_loc s α) := by
    intro s α
    dsimp only [idx_all, emb_loc]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hemb_inj : ∀ s : Fin S_loc, Function.Injective (emb_loc s) := by
    intro s α₁ α₂ h
    have h1 := congr_arg (idx_all s) h
    rw [← hidx_comp s α₁, ← hidx_comp s α₂] at h1
    exact hidx_ret_inj s h1

  have hR_disj_s : ∀ s₁ s₂ : Fin S_loc, s₁ ≠ s₂ → Disjoint (R_of_s s₁) (R_of_s s₂) := by
    intro s₁ s₂ hne
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro β hβ₁ hβ₂
    have hβG₁ : β ∈ G_of_s s₁ := hR_sub_G s₁ hβ₁
    have hβG₂ : β ∈ G_of_s s₂ := hR_sub_G s₂ hβ₂
    have hm_eq : m_of_s s₁ = m_of_s s₂ := by
      have hB₁ : β ∈ B_of (m_of_s s₁).1 := by
        rw [← (hG_spec (m_of_s s₁)).2.2.2.2.1]
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨g_of_s s₁, Finset.mem_univ _, hβG₁⟩
      have hB₂ : β ∈ B_of (m_of_s s₂).1 := by
        rw [← (hG_spec (m_of_s s₂)).2.2.2.2.1]
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨g_of_s s₂, Finset.mem_univ _, hβG₂⟩
      exact Subtype.ext ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hB₁).2.symm.trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hB₂).2)
    rcases hm₁ : idx_tup s₁ with ⟨m₁_v, g₁_v, u₁_v⟩
    rcases hm₂ : idx_tup s₂ with ⟨m₂_v, g₂_v, u₂_v⟩
    have hm_v : m₁_v = m₂_v := by
      dsimp only [m_of_s] at hm_eq
      rwa [hm₁, hm₂] at hm_eq
    subst hm_v
    have hβG₁' : β ∈ G_set m₁_v g₁_v := by dsimp only [G_of_s, m_of_s, g_of_s] at hβG₁; rwa [hm₁] at hβG₁
    have hβG₂' : β ∈ G_set m₁_v g₂_v := by dsimp only [G_of_s, m_of_s, g_of_s] at hβG₂; rwa [hm₂] at hβG₂
    have hg_v : g₁_v = g₂_v := by
      by_contra hg_ne
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp ((hG_spec m₁_v).2.2.2.1 g₁_v g₂_v hg_ne) hβG₁' hβG₂'
    subst hg_v
    have hβR₁' : β ∈ R_set m₁_v g₁_v u₁_v := by
      dsimp only [R_of_s, m_of_s, g_of_s, u_of_s] at hβ₁; rwa [hm₁] at hβ₁
    have hβR₂' : β ∈ R_set m₁_v g₁_v u₂_v := by
      dsimp only [R_of_s, m_of_s, g_of_s, u_of_s] at hβ₂; rwa [hm₂] at hβ₂
    have hu_v : u₁_v = u₂_v := by
      by_contra hu_ne
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp ((hU_spec m₁_v g₁_v).2.2.2.1 u₁_v u₂_v hu_ne) hβR₁' hβR₂'
    subst hu_v
    have htup_eq : eS.symm s₁ = eS.symm s₂ := hm₁.trans hm₂.symm
    exact hne (eS.symm.injective htup_eq)

  have hR_biU_univ : Finset.univ.biUnion R_of_s = Finset.univ := by
    ext β
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
    let m_β : { x // x ∈ MassKeys } := ⟨m_idx β, Finset.mem_image_of_mem m_idx (Finset.mem_univ β)⟩
    have hβB : β ∈ B_of m_β.1 := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ β, rfl⟩
    rw [← (hG_spec m_β).2.2.2.2.1] at hβB
    obtain ⟨g_β, _, hβG⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hβB
    rw [← (hU_spec m_β g_β).2.2.2.2.1] at hβG
    obtain ⟨u_β, _, hβR⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hβG
    let s_β : Fin S_loc := eS ⟨m_β, g_β, u_β⟩
    have htup : idx_tup s_β = ⟨m_β, g_β, u_β⟩ := Equiv.symm_apply_apply eS _
    refine ⟨s_β, ?_⟩
    have h_gen : ∀ p : Idx, p = ⟨m_β, g_β, u_β⟩ → β ∈ R_set p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 := by
      rintro _ rfl; exact hβR
    exact ⟨trivial, h_gen (idx_tup s_β) htup⟩

  refine ⟨S_loc, N_all_loc, N_ret_loc, whole_loc, sub_loc, emb_loc, idx_all, idx_ret,
    hS_loc_ge1, hS_loc_log, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v
    have h_biU_sum : ∑ β : Fin N_atom, c_atom β * g_at β v =
        ∑ s : Fin S_loc, ∑ β ∈ R_of_s s, c_atom β * g_at β v := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hR_biU_univ]
      exact Finset.sum_biUnion (fun s₁ _ s₂ _ hne => hR_disj_s s₁ s₂ hne)
    rw [h_biU_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s _ => ?_)
    have h_img_R : Finset.univ.image (idx_ret s) = R_of_s s :=
      h_image_pb _ _ (R_of_s s) (idx_ret s) id (fun _ => rfl) |>.trans Finset.image_id
    conv_lhs => rw [← h_img_R]
    rw [Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ hxy => hidx_ret_inj s hxy)]
  · let _ := Classical.propDecidable
    intro s
    let m := m_of_s s
    let g := g_of_s s
    let u := u_of_s s
    obtain ⟨hg_lo, _, _, hG_at, _, hG_fib_lo⟩ := (hG_spec m).2.2.2.2.2 g
    refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hemb_inj s, hidx_all_inj s, hidx_ret_inj s,
      hidx_comp s, fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_,
      h_mkSub_valid m g (R_of_s s) _ _ ((hU_spec m g).2.2.1 u) (hR_sub_G s),
      h_mkSub_valid m g (G_of_s s) _ _ ((hG_spec m).2.2.1 g) Finset.Subset.rfl,
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro α
      have hc := hidx_comp s α
      exact ⟨congr_arg o_atom hc, congr_arg ψ_atom hc, congr_arg c_atom hc,
        congr_arg (step_of m) hc,
        congr_arg (fun β => e_menu (κ_of m β)) hc,
        congr_arg (fun β => V_menu (κ_of m β)) hc,
        congr_arg (fun β => X_menu (κ_of m β)) hc⟩
    · intro β
      have hβG : idx_all s β ∈ G_of_s s := ((G_of_s s).equivFin.symm β).2
      obtain ⟨_, hib_β, hia_β, _⟩ := hG_at (idx_all s β) hβG
      have hw_eq : w_cap (κ_of m (idx_all s β)) =
          pktWeight γ ((whole_loc s).b_loc) ((whole_loc s).a_loc) := by
        dsimp only [w_cap, b_menu, a_menu, whole_loc, mkSub]
        rw [hib_β, hia_β]
      have hfib := hG_fib_lo (idx_all s β) hβG
      rw [hw_eq] at hfib
      have hc_pb : (Finset.univ.filter (fun β' : Fin (N_all_loc s) =>
          (whole_loc s).cap_id β' = (whole_loc s).cap_id β)).card =
          (@Finset.filter _ (fun α' => step_of m α' = step_of m (idx_all s β))
            (fun _ => Nat.decEq _ _) (G_set m g)).card :=
        h_card_filter_pb (G_of_s s) _ _ _ _ (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
      rw [hc_pb]
      dsimp only [whole_loc, mkSub, m, g]
      exact hfib
    · change 2 * W_max - R_bud ≤ ((g_idx_of m g : ℝ) + 1) * ξ
      linarith [hg_lo, hR_bud_pos]
    · intro huvs_f
      dsimp only [N_ret_loc, N_all_loc, R_of_s, G_of_s]
      rw [(hU_spec m g).2.2.2.2.2.1 huvs_f u]
    · intro huvs_t
      obtain ⟨hmk_lt, hal_iff, h_pcw, h_pbuf⟩ := (hU_spec m g).2.2.2.2.2.2 huvs_t u
      refine ⟨⟨mk_of m g u, hmk_lt, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hd1 α
        exact hal_iff hd1 (idx_ret s α) (((R_of_s s).equivFin.symm α).2)
      · intro p_c w
        refine le_trans ?_ (le_trans (h_pcw p_c w) ?_)
        · apply le_of_eq
          congr 1
          exact h_card_filter_pb (R_of_s s) _ _ _ _ (fun _ => Iff.rfl)
        · apply le_of_eq
          dsimp only [sub_loc, mkSub, m, g, u]
          congr 2
          exact (h_card_filter_pb (R_of_s s) _ _ _ _ (fun _ => Iff.rfl)).symm
      · intro p_buf
        refine le_trans ?_ (le_trans (h_pbuf p_buf) (le_of_eq rfl))
        apply le_of_eq
        congr 1
        apply congr_arg Finset.card
        ext pw
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rintro ⟨⟨α, rfl⟩, hc⟩
          exact ⟨⟨idx_ret s α, ((R_of_s s).equivFin.symm α).2, rfl⟩, hc⟩
        · rintro ⟨⟨β, hβR, rfl⟩, hc⟩
          refine ⟨⟨(R_of_s s).equivFin ⟨β, hβR⟩, ?_⟩, hc⟩
          have h_eq : idx_ret s ((R_of_s s).equivFin ⟨β, hβR⟩) = β := by
            dsimp only [idx_ret]; rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
          dsimp only [sub_loc, mkSub, p_at_atom, w_at_atom]
          change (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
              (V_at (idx_ret s ((R_of_s s).equivFin ⟨β, hβR⟩)))
              (X_at (idx_ret s ((R_of_s s).equivFin ⟨β, hβR⟩))),
            fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine
              (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X j₀.1
                (V_at (idx_ret s ((R_of_s s).equivFin ⟨β, hβR⟩)))
                (X_at (idx_ret s ((R_of_s s).equivFin ⟨β, hβR⟩))))
              (V_at (idx_ret s ((R_of_s s).equivFin ⟨β, hβR⟩)))) = _
          rw [h_eq]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u B_cut ξ η R_bud C_cut C_Bes C_cov : ℝ)
    (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr C_rtail : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΔ_u : 0 < Δ_u) (hB_cut : 0 < B_cut) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη_Δ : 4 * η ≤ Δ_u) (hR_bud : 128 * (η + ξ) ≤ R_bud)
    (hC_cut : 2 ≤ C_cut) (hC_Bes : 1 ≤ C_Bes) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov)
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) (hC_rtail : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_rtail M) :
    ∃ ε_root : ℝ, 0 < ε_root ∧ ε_root < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_ret : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let q_r := sub.loc_idx.1
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α * g_at α v
        let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
        let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
        let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
        let ζ'₀ := localGaugeGrad ζ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
        let h'_sub := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_sub
        let H'_P := H_P - r - 2 * b_star
        let L' := L - r - b_star
        let R'_dom := 8 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 20
        let K_sub := generalPacketRootScore ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub
        ε < ε_root →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ L - t → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
        ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
         (0 < r ∧ m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2))) →
        m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
          m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
        ε ^ (B_cut + ξ) ≤ sub.m_bin →
        (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h_sub MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.MemLp h_sub 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
        (∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) →
        (∀ R_d : ℝ, 1 ≤ R_d →
          (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R_d, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤
            C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) ∧
          ∀ (b_F a_F R_cap : ℝ) (M_cap : ℕ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
            2 ≤ R_cap → 3 ≤ M_cap → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
            F_sites ⊆ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R_d →
            (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
            let S_cap := Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
              let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
              let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
              |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀)
            ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤
              C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) +
              C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2)) →
        (0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 → K_sub ≤ subclassProxyA ε sub + R_bud) ∧
        (∀ (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
           (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
           IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
             lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
           (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
             cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
             b_star ≤ b_D d ∧
             0 < generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) →
           0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 ∧
           ∃ (N_Oj : ℕ) (r_loc_O : Fin N_Oj → ℕ)
             (V'_O_loc X'_O_loc : Fin N_Oj → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
             (ψ_O_loc : Fin N_Oj → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
             (b'_D a'_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r'_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
             (V'_D X'_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
             (p_loc : Fin N_Oj → Fin N_D → ℝ),
             2 * Δ_u ≤ H'_P ∧ t - r ≤ H'_P ∧ t - r ≤ L' ∧
             IsValidPacketEnv (localRescaledClass cls 1) ε H'_P L' lam_loc Φ'₀ ζ'₀ h'_sub ∧
             (let loc_d := localRescaledClass cls (t - r)
              H'_P ≤ (t - r) * loc_d.K_hor ∧ L' ≤ (t - r) * loc_d.K_hor ∧
              loc_d.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H'_P) ≤ lam_loc ∧ lam_loc ≤ loc_d.B_sys * ε ^ (-H'_P) ∧
              loc_d.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
              ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ loc_d.B_sys * ε ^ (t - r) ∧
              IsNormalizedPosDefPhase loc_d.a₀ loc_d.a₁ loc_d.A Φ'₀ ζ'₀ ∧
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h'_sub MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              (∀ v', loc_d.R_dom ≤ ‖v'‖ → h'_sub v' = 0) ∧
              MeasureTheory.MemLp h'_sub 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              0 < ∫ v', ‖h'_sub v'‖ ^ 2 ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H'_P L' (t - r) loc_d.B_sys loc_d.R_win
                loc_d.N_mult loc_d.M_win lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc
                b'_D a'_D r'_D e_D V'_D X'_D p_loc ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H'_P L' (t - r) (localRescaledClass cls 1).B_sys
                (localRescaledClass cls 1).R_win (localRescaledClass cls 1).N_mult
                (localRescaledClass cls 1).M_win lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc
                b'_D a'_D r'_D e_D V'_D X'_D p_loc ∧
              generalPacketScore ε γ H'_P (t - r) lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc b'_D a'_D p_loc =
              subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
                r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond)) ∧
        (0 < r → b_star = 0 → (H_P - r) / 2 ≤ L - r → 0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 →
          ∀ ζ_g : ℝ, 0 < ζ_g → 32 * R_bud ≤ ζ_g →
            subclassProxyA ε sub - K_sub + R_bud ≤ ζ_g / 8 →
            2 * ((H_P - r) / 2) + ζ_g < sub.g_bin →
            HasRootWidthGap (ζ_g / 16) (ζ_g / 4) ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub)

signature.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u B_cut ξ η R_bud C_cut C_Bes C_cov : ℝ)
    (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr C_rtail : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΔ_u : 0 < Δ_u) (hB_cut : 0 < B_cut) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη_Δ : 4 * η ≤ Δ_u) (hR_bud : 128 * (η + ξ) ≤ R_bud)
    (hC_cut : 2 ≤ C_cut) (hC_Bes : 1 ≤ C_Bes) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov)
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) (hC_rtail : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_rtail M) :
    ∃ ε_root : ℝ, 0 < ε_root ∧ ε_root < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_ret : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let q_r := sub.loc_idx.1
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        let h_sub := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, sub.c_at α * g_at α v
        let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
        let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
        let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
        let ζ'₀ := localGaugeGrad ζ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
        let h'_sub := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_sub
        let H'_P := H_P - r - 2 * b_star
        let L' := L - r - b_star
        let R'_dom := 8 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 20
        let K_sub := generalPacketRootScore ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub
        ε < ε_root →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ L - t → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
        ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
         (0 < r ∧ m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2))) →
        m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
          m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
        ε ^ (B_cut + ξ) ≤ sub.m_bin →
        (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h_sub MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.MemLp h_sub 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
        (∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) →
        (∀ R_d : ℝ, 1 ≤ R_d →
          (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R_d, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤
            C_Bes * ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) ∧
          ∀ (b_F a_F R_cap : ℝ) (M_cap : ℕ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
            2 ≤ R_cap → 3 ≤ M_cap → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
            F_sites ⊆ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R_d →
            (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
              |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
            let S_cap := Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
              let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
              let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
              |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
              |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀)
            ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤
              C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) +
              C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2)) →
        (0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 → K_sub ≤ subclassProxyA ε sub + R_bud) ∧
        (∀ (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
           (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
           IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
             lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_cond →
           (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond o d →
             cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
             b_star ≤ b_D d ∧
             0 < generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
               (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) →
           0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 ∧
           ∃ (N_Oj : ℕ) (r_loc_O : Fin N_Oj → ℕ)
             (V'_O_loc X'_O_loc : Fin N_Oj → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
             (ψ_O_loc : Fin N_Oj → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
             (b'_D a'_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r'_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
             (V'_D X'_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
             (p_loc : Fin N_Oj → Fin N_D → ℝ),
             2 * Δ_u ≤ H'_P ∧ t - r ≤ H'_P ∧ t - r ≤ L' ∧
             IsValidPacketEnv (localRescaledClass cls 1) ε H'_P L' lam_loc Φ'₀ ζ'₀ h'_sub ∧
             (let loc_d := localRescaledClass cls (t - r)
              H'_P ≤ (t - r) * loc_d.K_hor ∧ L' ≤ (t - r) * loc_d.K_hor ∧
              loc_d.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H'_P) ≤ lam_loc ∧ lam_loc ≤ loc_d.B_sys * ε ^ (-H'_P) ∧
              loc_d.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
              ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ loc_d.B_sys * ε ^ (t - r) ∧
              IsNormalizedPosDefPhase loc_d.a₀ loc_d.a₁ loc_d.A Φ'₀ ζ'₀ ∧
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h'_sub MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              (∀ v', loc_d.R_dom ≤ ‖v'‖ → h'_sub v' = 0) ∧
              MeasureTheory.MemLp h'_sub 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              0 < ∫ v', ‖h'_sub v'‖ ^ 2 ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H'_P L' (t - r) loc_d.B_sys loc_d.R_win
                loc_d.N_mult loc_d.M_win lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc
                b'_D a'_D r'_D e_D V'_D X'_D p_loc ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H'_P L' (t - r) (localRescaledClass cls 1).B_sys
                (localRescaledClass cls 1).R_win (localRescaledClass cls 1).N_mult
                (localRescaledClass cls 1).M_win lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc
                b'_D a'_D r'_D e_D V'_D X'_D p_loc ∧
              generalPacketScore ε γ H'_P (t - r) lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc b'_D a'_D p_loc =
              subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
                r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D sub p_cond)) ∧
        (0 < r → b_star = 0 → (H_P - r) / 2 ≤ L - r → 0 < ∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2 →
          ∀ ζ_g : ℝ, 0 < ζ_g → 32 * R_bud ≤ ζ_g →
            subclassProxyA ε sub - K_sub + R_bud ≤ ζ_g / 8 →
            2 * ((H_P - r) / 2) + ζ_g < sub.g_bin →
            HasRootWidthGap (ζ_g / 16) (ζ_g / 4) ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_s1_s2 :
      (∀ (ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ_in lam_loc : ℝ)
         (Φ'₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
         (h'_sub : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
         0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
         let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
         let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom
         let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
         let K_sub := generalPacketRootScore ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ_in lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub
         (∀ o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o) ∧
         (∀ (B_norm B_tot C_cap : ℝ),
           0 < ∫ v, ‖h'_sub v‖ ^ 2 →
           0 < B_norm → ∫ v, ‖h'_sub v‖ ^ 2 ≤ B_norm →
           0 < B_tot → (∑ o ∈ O₀, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤ B_tot) →
           0 < C_cap →
           (∀ (b_F a_F : ℝ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
              0 ≤ b_F → b_F ≤ a_F → a_F ≤ min L' (H'_P / 2) → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
              F_sites ⊆ O₀ →
              (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
              ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤
                C_cap * ε ^ (pktWeight γ_in b_F a_F)) →
           K_sub ≤ max ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log B_norm / ell))
             (Real.log B_tot / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log C_cap / ell))) ∧
         (∀ (ν κ B_tot B_gap : ℝ),
           0 < γ_in → γ_in < 1 →
           0 < B_tot → (∑ o ∈ O₀, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤ B_tot) →
           0 < B_gap →
           (∀ (b_F a_F : ℝ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
              0 ≤ b_F → H'_P / 2 - ν ≤ b_F → b_F ≤ a_F → a_F ≤ H'_P / 2 → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
              F_sites ⊆ O₀ →
              (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
              ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤ B_gap) →
           Real.log B_tot / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log B_gap / ell) + H'_P / 2 ≤ K_sub - κ →
           HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ_in lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub)) ∧
      (∀ {N : ℕ} (s₁ s₂ W : ℝ) (M_m : ℕ)
         (c₁ c₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (o_at : Fin N → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
         (S : Finset (Fin N)),
         0 < s₁ → 0 < s₂ → 0 ≤ W →
         (∀ (T_fib : Finset (Fin N)) (o₀ : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)),
           (∀ α ∈ T_fib, o_at α = o₀) → (T_fib.card : ℝ) ≤ (M_m : ℝ)) →
         (∀ α ∈ S,
           |(gridPt2D s₁ (o_at α).1 - c₁) 0| ≤ W ∧
           |(gridPt2D s₁ (o_at α).1 - c₁) 1| ≤ W ∧
           |(gridPt2D s₂ (o_at α).2 - c₂) 0| ≤ W ∧
           |(gridPt2D s₂ (o_at α).2 - c₂) 1| ≤ W) →
         (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (M_m : ℝ) * (2 * (W / s₁) + 2) ^ 2 * (2 * (W / s₂) + 2) ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ (ρ W : ℝ) (e V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
         (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
         0 < ρ → 0 ≤ W → ‖e‖ = 1 →
         (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
           |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ o.1 - V_F) e| ≤ W ∧
           |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e)| ≤ W ∧
           |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ o.2 - X_F) e| ≤ W ∧
           |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e)| ≤ W) →
         (F_sites.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 * (W / ρ) + 2) ^ 4) := by
    have h_1d_box : ∀ (s c W : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 ≤ W →
        let I : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc ⌊(c - W) / s⌋ ⌊(c + W) / s⌋
        (∀ z : ℤ, |s * (z : ℝ) - c| ≤ W → z ∈ I) ∧
        (I.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (W / s) + 2 := by
      intro s c W hs hW
      let lo : ℤ := ⌊(c - W) / s⌋
      let hi : ℤ := ⌊(c + W) / s⌋
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hz
        have hlo_r : (lo : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) :=
          le_trans (Int.floor_le _) ((div_le_iff₀ hs).mpr (by linarith only [h1]))
        have hhi_z : z ≤ hi :=
          Int.le_floor.mpr ((le_div_iff₀ hs).mpr (by linarith only [h2]))
        exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Int.cast_le.mp hlo_r, hhi_z⟩
      · change ((Finset.Icc lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (W / s) + 2
        rw [Int.card_Icc]
        by_cases hle : hi + 1 - lo ≤ 0
        · rw [Int.toNat_of_nonpos hle, Nat.cast_zero]
          positivity
        · push Not at hle
          have hcast : (((hi + 1 - lo).toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((hi + 1 - lo : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hle.le
          rw [hcast]
          push_cast
          have hhi_le : (hi : ℝ) ≤ (c + W) / s := Int.floor_le _
          have hlo_gt : (c - W) / s < (lo : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
          have hdiff : (c + W) / s - (c - W) / s = 2 * (W / s) := by ring
          linarith only [hhi_le, hlo_gt, hdiff]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ε H'_P L' R'_dom γ_in lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub hε₀ hε₁
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom
      let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
      let m_fn := fun o => canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o
      have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith only [hε₁]
      have hell_pos : 0 < ell := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr hε_lt1)
      have hlog_eps : Real.log ε = -ell := by
        dsimp only [ell]; rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
      have hm_nn : ∀ o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ m_fn o := by
        intro o
        dsimp only [m_fn, canonicalRootMass]
        let S_m : Set ℝ := { m : ℝ | ∃ ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
          IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ ∧
          m = ‖(ρ'₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            h'_sub v * ψ (ρ'₀⁻¹ • (v - gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ'₀ (1 / 2, gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 }
        change 0 ≤ sSup S_m
        by_cases hbdd : BddAbove S_m
        · refine le_csSup hbdd ⟨fun _ => 0, ⟨fun _ => contDiff_const, fun _ _ => rfl, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
          · intro k z
            rw [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero, Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
            positivity
          · simp
        · rw [Real.sSup_of_not_bddAbove hbdd]
      have h_gibbs : ∀ (S : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) (q : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → ℝ)
          (Q B : ℝ),
          0 ≤ Q → (∀ o ∈ S, 0 ≤ q o) → (∑ o ∈ S, q o = Q) → 0 < B →
          (∀ o ∈ S, 0 < q o → 0 < m_fn o) → (∑ o ∈ S, m_fn o ≤ B) →
          ∑ o ∈ S, (-(q o * Real.log (q o / Q)) + q o * Real.log (m_fn o)) ≤ Q * Real.log B := by
        intro S q Q B hQ_nn hq_nn hq_sum hB_pos hq_pos_m hm_sum
        by_cases hQ0 : Q = 0
        · subst hQ0
          rw [zero_mul]
          refine le_of_eq (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => ?_))
          have hq0 : q o = 0 :=
            le_antisymm (hq_sum ▸ Finset.single_le_sum hq_nn ho) (hq_nn o ho)
          simp [hq0]
        · have hQ_pos : 0 < Q := lt_of_le_of_ne hQ_nn (Ne.symm hQ0)
          have h_term : ∀ o ∈ S,
              -(q o * Real.log (q o / Q)) + q o * Real.log (m_fn o) - q o * Real.log B ≤
                (Q / B) * m_fn o - q o := by
            intro o ho
            by_cases hqo0 : q o = 0
            · rw [hqo0]; simp only [zero_mul, neg_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]
              exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hQ_pos.le hB_pos.le) (hm_nn o)
            · have hqo_pos : 0 < q o := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq_nn o ho) (Ne.symm hqo0)
              have hmo_pos : 0 < m_fn o := hq_pos_m o ho hqo_pos
              let x : ℝ := (m_fn o / B) / (q o / Q)
              have hx_pos : 0 < x := by dsimp only [x]; positivity
              have hlog_x : Real.log x = Real.log (m_fn o) - Real.log B - Real.log (q o / Q) := by
                dsimp only [x]

          rw [hX'D_eq]; dsimp only [X'_O_loc, o]; rw [hr_eq]; simp only [smul_sub]; abel
        have hsv_inv_eq : s_v⁻¹ = ε ^ (-b_star) := by
          dsimp only [s_v]; rw [← Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le]
        have hsx_inv_le : s_x⁻¹ ≤ ε ^ (-r - b_star) := by
          dsimp only [s_x]
          rw [mul_inv, hsv_inv_eq]
          calc s_c⁻¹ * ε ^ (-b_star)
              ≤ ε ^ (-r) * ε ^ (-b_star) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsc_inv_hi (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le
            _ = ε ^ (-r - b_star) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
        have h_scale_v : ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ex : ℝ),
            |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) w| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ ex →
            |inner ℝ (V'_O_loc o' - V'_D d) w| ≤ B'_sys * ε ^ (ex - b_star) := by
          intro w ex h_in
          rw [hdV_eq, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real, abs_mul,
            abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs_v_pos), hsv_inv_eq]
          calc ε ^ (-b_star) * |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) w|
              ≤ ε ^ (-b_star) * (cls.B_sys * ε ^ ex) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_in (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le
            _ = cls.B_sys * (ε ^ (-b_star) * ε ^ ex) := by ring
            _ = cls.B_sys * ε ^ (ex - b_star) := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]; congr 2; ring
            _ ≤ B'_sys * ε ^ (ex - b_star) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB'_ge_B (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le
        have h_scale_x : ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ex : ℝ),
            |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) w| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (ex + t) →
            |inner ℝ (X'_O_loc o' - X'_D d) w| ≤ B'_sys * ε ^ ((ex - b_star) + (t - r)) := by
          intro w ex h_in
          rw [hdX_eq, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real, abs_mul,
            abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs_x_pos)]
          calc s_x⁻¹ * |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) w|
              ≤ ε ^ (-r - b_star) * (cls.B_sys * ε ^ (ex + t)) :=
                mul_le_mul hsx_inv_le h_in (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le
            _ = cls.B_sys * (ε ^ (-r - b_star) * ε ^ (ex + t)) := by ring
            _ = cls.B_sys * ε ^ ((ex - b_star) + (t - r)) := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]; congr 2; ring
            _ ≤ B'_sys * ε ^ ((ex - b_star) + (t - r)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB'_ge_B (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le
        rw [hb'_eq, ha'_eq]
        exact ⟨hm_pos, hrloc_eq,
          h_scale_v (e_D d) (b_D d) hv1,
          h_scale_v (perp2D (e_D d)) (a_D d) hv2,
          h_scale_x (e_D d) (b_D d) hx1,
          h_scale_x (perp2D (e_D d)) (a_D d) hx2⟩
    have hscore_eq : generalPacketScore ε γ H'_P (t - r) lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
        N_Oj N_D r_loc_O V'_O_loc X'_O_loc ψ_O_loc b'_D a'_D p_loc =
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
          N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_cond - b_star := by
      unfold generalPacketScore
      let p_cond_O : Fin N_O → ℝ := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d
      have hpO_zero_off : ∀ o : Fin N_O, o ∉ S_O_j → p_cond_O o = 0 :=
        fun o ho => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => hp_zero_off o ho d)
      have hHO_eq : ∑ o' : Fin N_Oj, -((∑ d, p_loc o' d) * Real.log (∑ d, p_loc o' d)) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_cond_O o * Real.log (p_cond_O o)) := by
        refine h_sum_O (fun o => -(p_cond_O o * Real.log (p_cond_O o))) (fun o ho => ?_)
        rw [hpO_zero_off o ho]; simp
      have hHOD_eq : ∑ o' : Fin N_Oj, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(p_loc o' d * Real.log (p_loc o' d / (∑ o₁, p_loc o₁ d))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_cond_D d)) := by
        simp_rw [hp_loc_D]
        refine h_sum_O
          (fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_cond_D d)))
          (fun o ho => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => ?_))
        rw [hp_zero_off o ho d]; simp
      have hEmass_eq : ∑ o' : Fin N_Oj, (∑ d, p_loc o' d) * Real.log
            (generalPacketObsMass ε H'_P (t - r) lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
              (r_loc_O o') (V'_O_loc o') (X'_O_loc o') (ψ_O_loc o')) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond_O o * Real.log
            (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) := by
        have hcongr : ∑ o' : Fin N_Oj, (∑ d, p_loc o' d) * Real.log
              (generalPacketObsMass ε H'_P (t - r) lam_loc (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ h'_sub
                (r_loc_O o') (V'_O_loc o') (X'_O_loc o') (ψ_O_loc o')) =
            ∑ o' : Fin N_Oj, p_cond_O (emb o') * Real.log
              (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub
                (r_O (emb o')) (V_O (emb o')) (X_O (emb o')) (ψ_O (emb o'))) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o' _ => ?_)
          rw [(ho'_geom o').2.2.2.2.2.2]
        rw [hcongr]
        refine h_sum_O
          (fun o => p_cond_O o * Real.log
            (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)))
          (fun o ho => ?_)
        rw [hpO_zero_off o ho, zero_mul]
      have hpD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond_D d = 1 := by
        dsimp only [p_cond_D]; rw [Finset.sum_comm, hp_sum]
      have hEw_eq : ∑ d : Fin N_D, (∑ o', p_loc o' d) * ((1 + γ) * b'_D d + (1 - γ) * a'_D d) =
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) - 2 * b_star := by
        simp_rw [hp_loc_D]
        have hterm : ∀ d : Fin N_D, p_cond_D d * ((1 + γ) * b'_D d + (1 - γ) * a'_D d) =
            p_cond_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) - p_cond_D d * (2 * b_star) := by
          intro d
          dsimp only [b'_D, a'_D]
          split_ifs with hpD_pos
          · ring
          · have hpD0 : p_cond_D d = 0 :=
              le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpD_pos)
                (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hp_nn o d))
            rw [hpD0]; ring
        simp_rw [hterm, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hpD_sum, one_mul]
      dsimp only
      rw [hHO_eq, hHOD_eq, hEmass_eq, hEw_eq]
      ring
    refine ⟨N_Oj, r_loc_O, V'_O_loc, X'_O_loc, ψ_O_loc, b'_D, a'_D, r'_D, V'_D, X'_D, p_loc,
      h2Δ_H', htr_H', htr_L', henv_loc1,
      le_trans hH'_K hK_loc_d, le_trans hL'_K hK_loc_d,
      hlam_loc_lo, hlam_loc_hi, hm_loc_lo, hm_loc_hi,
      hphase_loc, hh'_meas, hh'_supp, hh'_l2, hh'_int_pos,
      hadm_res, hadm_res, hscore_eq⟩

  let e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0]
  have he₀_norm : ‖e₀‖ = 1 := by
    have hsq : ‖e₀‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [e₀]
    have h1 := congr_arg Real.sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_one] at h1
  have hperp_e₀_norm : ‖perp2D e₀‖ = 1 := by
    have hsq : ‖perp2D e₀‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [perp2D, e₀]
    have h1 := congr_arg Real.sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_one] at h1
  have he₀_inner : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ u e₀ = u 0 ∧ inner ℝ u (perp2D e₀) = u 1 := by
    intro u

    · rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]

  have hgrid_smul : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ),

    intro a b k

    fin_cases i <;> simp [gridPt2D, mul_assoc]
  have hmr_dyadic : ∀ (ε r : ℝ) (m_r : ℕ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 → 0 < r → m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) →
      ε ^ r ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ∧ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ r := by
    intro ε r m_r hε_pos hε1 hr_pos hmr_eq
    have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    let x := r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2
    have hx_nn : 0 ≤ x := by
      have : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε_pos).mpr hε1)
      positivity
    have hfl1 : (m_r : ℝ) ≤ x := by rw [hmr_eq]; exact Nat.floor_le hx_nn
    have hfl2 : x < (m_r : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hmr_eq]; exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one x
    have hmul1 : (m_r : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := (le_div_iff₀ hlog2_pos).mp hfl1
    have hmul2 : r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) < ((m_r : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hlog2_pos).mp hfl2
    have hεr_eq : ε ^ r = Real.exp (-(r * Real.log (ε⁻¹))) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε_pos, Real.log_inv]; ring_nf
    have h2mr_eq : ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ = Real.exp (-((m_r : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (2 : ℝ) m_r, Real.rpow_def_of_pos zero_lt_two, ← Real.exp_neg]
      ring_nf
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hεr_eq, h2mr_eq]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith only [hmul1])
    · have h2_eq : 2 * ε ^ r = Real.exp (Real.log 2 - r * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
        rw [hεr_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log zero_lt_two]
      rw [h2mr_eq, h2_eq]
      have hexp_hi : -((m_r : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ≤ Real.log 2 - r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
        have hring : ((m_r : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 = (m_r : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 2 := by ring
        linarith only [hmul2, hring]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp_hi

  have hB_sys2 : 2 ≤ cls.B_sys := cls.hB_sys
  have hB_pos : 0 < cls.B_sys := by linarith only [hB_sys2]
  have hRw2 : 2 ≤ cls.R_win := cls.hR_win

  let R_box : ℝ := 8 * cls.B_sys + 2 * cls.R_win + 10
  have hR_box1 : 1 ≤ R_box := by dsimp only [R_box]; linarith only [hB_sys2, hRw2]
  let R_pt : ℝ := 10 + C_cut * Real.sqrt cls.B_sys
  have hR_pt1 : 1 ≤ R_pt := by
    dsimp only [R_pt]
    have hnn : 0 ≤ C_cut * Real.sqrt cls.B_sys := by positivity
    linarith only [hnn]
  let C_RF : ℝ := R_pt ^ 4
  have hC_RF1 : 1 ≤ C_RF := one_le_pow₀ hR_pt1
  let M_cap₁ : ℕ := max 3 (Nat.ceil ((B_cut + 3 * ξ + cls.K_hor + 4 * η) / (2 * η)) + 1)

  have hM_cap₁_ge : B_cut + 3 * ξ + cls.K_hor ≤ (2 * (M_cap₁ : ℝ) - 4) * η := by

    have h2 : (Nat.ceil q : ℝ) ≤ (M_cap₁ : ℝ) := by

    have h3 : B_cut + 3 * ξ + cls.K_hor + 4 * η ≤ (M_cap₁ : ℝ) * (2 * η) :=

  have hM_cap₂_3 : 3 ≤ M_cap₂ := le_max_left 3 _
  have hM_cap₂_ge : B_cut + ξ ≤ (2 * (M_cap₂ : ℝ) - 4) * η := by

    have h1 : ε₄⁻¹ ≤ ε⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hε_pos hε_lt_4.le
    dsimp only [ε₄] at h1

  have hsc_bounds : ε ^ r ≤ s_c ∧ s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r := by

  have hsv_sq : s_v ^ 2 = ε ^ (2 * b_star) := by
    dsimp only [s_v]
    rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]; ring_nf
  have hexp_H' : ε ^ r * ε ^ (2 * b_star) * ε ^ (-H_P) = ε ^ (-H'_P) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
    congr 1; dsimp only [H'_P]; ring
  have hlam_loc_pos : 0 < lam_loc := by dsimp only [lam_loc]; positivity
  have hρ'₀_pos : 0 < ρ'₀ := by dsimp only [ρ'₀]; positivity
  have hlam_loc_lo_raw : cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H'_P) ≤ lam_loc := by
    calc cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H'_P)
        = (cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P)) * (ε ^ r * ε ^ (2 * b_star)) := by
          rw [← hexp_H']; ring
      _ ≤ lam_sys * (s_c * s_v ^ 2) := by

  have hlam_loc_hi_raw : lam_loc ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (-H'_P) := by
    calc lam_loc
        = (s_c * s_v ^ 2) * lam_sys := by dsimp only [lam_loc]
      _ ≤ (2 * ε ^ r * ε ^ (2 * b_star)) * (cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P)) := by
          rw [hsv_sq]
          exact mul_le_mul
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsc_hi (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).le)
            hlam_hi hlam_pos.le (by positivity)
      _ = (2 * cls.B_sys) * (ε ^ r * ε ^ (2 * b_star) * ε ^ (-H_P)) := by ring
      _ = (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (-H'_P) := by rw [hexp_H']

  have hρ'₀_hi : ρ'₀ ≤ Real.sqrt cls.B_sys * ε ^ (H'_P / 2) := by
    let rhs := Real.sqrt cls.B_sys * ε ^ (H'_P / 2)

    have hsq_eq : (rhs⁻¹) ^ 2 = cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H'_P) := by
      dsimp only [rhs]
      rw [mul_inv, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hB_pos.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hε_pos.le,

  obtain ⟨hN_ret1, _, hqr_lt, _, _, hmbin_pos, _, _, _,

  have hρ_r_bounds : 0 < ρ_r ∧ ρ_r ≤ s_v := by

  have hN_ret_hi : (N_ret : ℝ) ≤ (C_cov * R_box ^ 4) * ε ^ (-sub.g_bin - 2 * ξ) := by

    have hpw0 : -sub.g_bin + pktWeight γ 0 0 - 2 * ξ = -sub.g_bin - 2 * ξ := by
