            |inner ℝ (s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J) - gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2) e₀| ≤ W_pt ∧
            |inner ℝ (s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J) - gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2) (perp2D e₀)| ≤ W_pt := by
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα).2
        obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩ := hα_in
        have hv_eq : s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J) - gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 =
            gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1 - c₁ := by
          dsimp only [V_at, c₁]
          rw [hsv_1, inv_one, one_smul]
          abel
        have hx_eq : s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J) - gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 =
            gridPt2D s₂ (sub.o_at α).2 - c₂ := by
          dsimp only [X_at, c₂, s₂]
          rw [smul_sub, hgrid_smul]
          abel
        rw [hv_eq, (he₀_inner _).1] at b1
        rw [hv_eq, (he₀_inner _).2] at b2
        rw [hx_eq, (he₀_inner _).1] at b3
        rw [hx_eq, (he₀_inner _).2] at b4
        exact ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4⟩
      have hScap_card_raw := hs2_box ρ_r s₂ W_pt M_mult c₁ c₂ sub.o_at S_cap
        hρ_r_pos hs₂_pos hW_pt_nn hfib_sub hScap_box
      have hW_s1 : 2 * (W_pt / ρ_r) + 2 ≤ (2 * R_pt + 2) * ε ^ (-η) := by
        rw [hρ_r_eq]
        have hdiv : W_pt / ε ^ v_sc ≤ R_pt * ε ^ (-η) :=
          (div_le_iff₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _)).mpr hW_pt_hi
        linarith only [hdiv, h1_le_εη]
      have hW_s2 : 2 * (W_pt / s₂) + 2 ≤ (4 * cls.B_sys * R_pt + 2) * ε ^ (-η) := by
        have hdiv : W_pt / s₂ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys * R_pt * ε ^ (-η) := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          calc W_pt * s₂⁻¹
              ≤ (R_pt * ε ^ (-η) * ε ^ v_sc) * (2 * cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-v_sc)) :=
                mul_le_mul hW_pt_hi hs₂_inv_hi (inv_nonneg.mpr hs₂_pos.le) (by positivity)
            _ = 2 * cls.B_sys * R_pt * ε ^ (-η) * (ε ^ v_sc * ε ^ (-v_sc)) := by ring
            _ = 2 * cls.B_sys * R_pt * ε ^ (-η) := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
        linarith only [hdiv, h1_le_εη]
      have hScap_card : (S_cap.card : ℝ) ≤ C_pt_card * ε ^ (-4 * η) := by
        have hsq1 : (2 * (W_pt / ρ_r) + 2) ^ 2 ≤ ((2 * R_pt + 2) * ε ^ (-η)) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hW_s1 2
        have hsq2 : (2 * (W_pt / s₂) + 2) ^ 2 ≤ ((4 * cls.B_sys * R_pt + 2) * ε ^ (-η)) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hW_s2 2
        have h4η : (ε ^ (-η)) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-η)) ^ 2 = ε ^ (-4 * η) := by
          rw [← pow_add, ← Real.rpow_natCast (ε ^ (-η)) 4, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
          ring_nf
        calc (S_cap.card : ℝ)
            ≤ (M_mult : ℝ) * (2 * (W_pt / ρ_r) + 2) ^ 2 * (2 * (W_pt / s₂) + 2) ^ 2 :=
              hScap_card_raw
          _ ≤ (M_mult : ℝ) * ((2 * R_pt + 2) * ε ^ (-η)) ^ 2 *
                ((4 * cls.B_sys * R_pt + 2) * ε ^ (-η)) ^ 2 :=
              mul_le_mul
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
                hsq2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
          _ = C_pt_card * ((ε ^ (-η)) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-η)) ^ 2) := by
              dsimp only [C_pt_card]; ring
          _ = C_pt_card * ε ^ (-4 * η) := by rw [h4η]
      have hpt_term1 : C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          (C_Bes * C_pt_card) * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin := by
        have hsum_c : ∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤
            (S_cap.card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by
          calc ∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2
              ≤ ∑ _α ∈ S_cap, (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α _ => (hsub_at α).2.2.2.2.2.2.1)
            _ = (S_cap.card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        calc C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2)
            ≤ C_Bes * ((S_cap.card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_c hC_Bes_pos.le
          _ ≤ C_Bes * ((C_pt_card * ε ^ (-4 * η)) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hScap_card (by positivity)) hC_Bes_pos.le
          _ = (C_Bes * C_pt_card) * (ε ^ (-4 * η) * ε ^ (-ξ)) * sub.m_bin := by ring
          _ = (C_Bes * C_pt_card) * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
      have hpt_term2 : C_rtail M_cap₂ * (ε ^ (-η)) ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap₂ : ℝ)) *
            (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          C_rtail M_cap₂ * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin := by
        have h1_le_4ηξ : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_zero ε]
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le (by linarith only [hη, hξ])
        have hrpow_tail : (ε ^ (-η)) ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap₂ : ℝ)) ≤ ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin := by
          have h1 : (ε ^ (-η)) ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap₂ : ℝ)) = ε ^ ((2 * (M_cap₂ : ℝ) - 4) * η) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]; congr 1; ring
          rw [h1]
          calc ε ^ ((2 * (M_cap₂ : ℝ) - 4) * η)
              ≤ ε ^ (B_cut + ξ) :=
                Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le hM_cap₂_ge
            _ ≤ sub.m_bin := hmbin_lo
            _ = 1 * sub.m_bin := (one_mul _).symm
            _ ≤ ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1_le_4ηξ hmbin_pos.le
        calc C_rtail M_cap₂ * (ε ^ (-η)) ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap₂ : ℝ)) *
              (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2)
            ≤ C_rtail M_cap₂ * (ε ^ (-η)) ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap₂ : ℝ)) * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc_sum_le1
                (mul_nonneg (hC_rtail M_cap₂) (by positivity))
          _ ≤ C_rtail M_cap₂ * (ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by
              rw [mul_one]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_tail (hC_rtail M_cap₂)
          _ = C_rtail M_cap₂ * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      have h_add : (C_Bes * C_pt_card) * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin +
          C_rtail M_cap₂ * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin =
          C_pt_mass * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin := by
        dsimp only [C_pt_mass]; ring
      exact le_trans hrc (h_add ▸ add_le_add hpt_term1 hpt_term2)

    let B_gap : ℝ := (C_lat * C_pt_mass) * sub.m_bin * ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 4) - 4 * η - ξ)
    have hC_lat_pt_pos : 0 < C_lat * C_pt_mass := by linarith only [hC_lat_pt1]
    have hBg_pos : 0 < B_gap := by dsimp only [B_gap]; positivity
    have hgap_cap : ∀ (b_F a_F : ℝ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
        0 ≤ b_F → H'_P / 2 - ζ_g / 16 ≤ b_F → b_F ≤ a_F → a_F ≤ H'_P / 2 → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
        F_sites ⊆ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom →
        (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
        ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o ≤ B_gap := by
      intro b_F a_F e_F V_F X_F F_sites _ hb_lo hba _ he_F hF_sub hF_cap
      let W_gap : ℝ := 10 * ε ^ (v_sc - ζ_g / 16)
      have hW_gap_nn : 0 ≤ W_gap := by dsimp only [W_gap]; positivity
      have hε_b_le : 10 * ε ^ b_F ≤ W_gap := by
        dsimp only [W_gap]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
        rw [← hH'_half]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le hb_lo
      have hε_a_le : 10 * ε ^ a_F ≤ W_gap :=
        le_trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le hba) (by norm_num))
          hε_b_le
      have hF_rot_cap : ∀ o ∈ F_sites,
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ W_gap ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ W_gap ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ W_gap ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ W_gap := by
        intro o ho
        obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4⟩ := hF_cap o ho
        exact ⟨le_trans c1 hε_b_le, le_trans c2 hε_a_le, le_trans c3 hε_b_le, le_trans c4 hε_a_le⟩
      have hF_card_raw := hs2_rot ρ'₀ W_gap e_F V_F X_F F_sites hρ'₀_pos hW_gap_nn he_F hF_rot_cap
      have h1_le_ζ : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 16)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_zero ε]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_lt1.le (by linarith only [hζ_g])
      have hW_div_ρ : 3 * (W_gap / ρ'₀) + 2 ≤
          (30 * Real.sqrt (2 * cls.B_sys) + 2) * ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 16)) := by
        have hdiv : W_gap / ρ'₀ ≤ 10 * Real.sqrt (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 16)) := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          have hρ_v : ρ'₀⁻¹ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (-v_sc) := by
            have hh : -H'_P / 2 = -v_sc := by linarith only [hH'_half]
            rwa [hh] at hρ'₀_inv_hi
          calc W_gap * ρ'₀⁻¹
              ≤ (10 * ε ^ (v_sc - ζ_g / 16)) * (Real.sqrt (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (-v_sc)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρ_v hW_gap_nn
            _ = 10 * Real.sqrt (2 * cls.B_sys) * (ε ^ (v_sc - ζ_g / 16) * ε ^ (-v_sc)) := by ring
            _ = 10 * Real.sqrt (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 16)) := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]; congr 2; ring
        linarith only [hdiv, h1_le_ζ]
      have hF_card : (F_sites.card : ℝ) ≤ C_lat * ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 4)) := by
        have hp4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hW_div_ρ 4
        have hexp4 : (ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 16))) ^ 4 = ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 4)) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast _ 4, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
          congr 1; ring
        calc (F_sites.card : ℝ)
            ≤ (3 * (W_gap / ρ'₀) + 2) ^ 4 := hF_card_raw
          _ ≤ ((30 * Real.sqrt (2 * cls.B_sys) + 2) * ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 16))) ^ 4 := hp4
          _ = C_lat * (ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 16))) ^ 4 := by dsimp only [C_lat]; rw [mul_pow]
          _ = C_lat * ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 4)) := by rw [hexp4]
      calc ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_sub o
          ≤ ∑ _o ∈ F_sites, (C_pt_mass * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun o ho => hpt_mass o (hF_sub ho))
        _ = (F_sites.card : ℝ) * (C_pt_mass * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ (C_lat * ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 4))) * (C_pt_mass * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ) * sub.m_bin) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hF_card (by positivity)
        _ = (C_lat * C_pt_mass) * sub.m_bin * (ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 4)) * ε ^ (-4 * η - ξ)) := by ring
        _ = B_gap := by
            dsimp only [B_gap]
            have hex : -(ζ_g / 4) + (-4 * η - ξ) = -(ζ_g / 4) - 4 * η - ξ := by ring
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, hex]

    have hlog_Bg : Real.log B_gap / ell =
        Real.log (C_lat * C_pt_mass) / ell + Real.log sub.m_bin / ell +
          ζ_g / 4 + 4 * η + ξ := by
      have h1 : Real.log B_gap = Real.log (C_lat * C_pt_mass) + Real.log sub.m_bin +
          Real.log (ε ^ (-(ζ_g / 4) - 4 * η - ξ)) := by
        dsimp only [B_gap]
        rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _).ne',
          Real.log_mul hC_lat_pt_pos.ne' hmbin_pos.ne']
      rw [h1, Real.log_rpow hε_pos, hlog_eps]
      field_simp [hell_pos.ne']; ring

    have hlog_A_part3 : Real.log C_Bes / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (C_lat * C_pt_mass) / ell) ≤
        A_log / ell := by
      have hnum : Real.log C_Bes + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (C_lat * C_pt_mass) ≤ A_log := by
        dsimp only [A_log]
        linarith only [hlog_Bes_nn, hlog_box_nn, hlog_cap_nn, hlog_lat_nn]
      have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hell_pos.le
      have hlhs : (Real.log C_Bes + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (C_lat * C_pt_mass)) / ell =
          Real.log C_Bes / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (C_lat * C_pt_mass) / ell) := by ring
      rwa [hlhs] at hdiv

    have hK_gap_le : Real.log B_tot / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log B_gap / ell) + H'_P / 2 ≤
        K_sub - ζ_g / 4 := by
      have hd2_unfold : Real.log (N_ret : ℝ) / ell + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log sub.m_bin / ell) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sub.g_bin - K_sub + R_bud ≤ ζ_g / 8 := hd2_le
      rw [hH'_half]
      have hg_gt_v : 2 * v_sc + ζ_g < sub.g_bin := hg_gt
      linarith only [hlog_Bt, hlog_Bg, hlog_A_part3, hA_log_le, hR_bud, hη, hξ,
        hd2_unfold, hg_gt_v]

    exact hs1_gap (ζ_g / 16) (ζ_g / 4) B_tot B_gap hγ₀ hγ₁ hBt_pos hroot_sum_le_Bt
      hBg_pos hgap_cap hK_gap_le

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u A₀ ξ R_bud C_can C_cov : ℝ)
    (use_vel_sub : Bool) (d_dim M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΔ_u : 0 < Δ_u) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hR_bud : 128 * ξ ≤ R_bud)
    (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hC_can : 1 ≤ C_can) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult)
    (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) :
    ∃ ε_law : ℝ, 0 < ε_law ∧ ε_law < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (M_L : ℕ) (ε H_P L t r h b_star lam_sys : ℝ)
        (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_ret_of N_all_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
        (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
        (whole_menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_all_of j))
        (emb_ret : ∀ j : Fin N_J, Fin (N_ret_of j) → Fin (N_all_of j))
        (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
          ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
        let p_cond := fun (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) =>
          if win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j then p o d / π_J j else 0
        let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
        let d₁ := fun j : Fin N_J =>
          Real.log (((menu j).N_all : ℝ) / (N_ret_of j : ℝ)) / ell
        let A_of := fun j : Fin N_J => subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
        let P_of := fun j : Fin N_J =>
          subclassWinScore γ ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t Φ₀
            r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (menu j) (p_cond j)
        let B_r := H_J + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * A_of j
        let K_r_star := B_r + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * d₁ j
        let K₀ := generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f
        let P_t := generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
          N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p
        1 ≤ M_L → ε < ε_law → 1 ≤ N_O → 1 ≤ N_J → 1 ≤ S_per_loc →
        Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell ≤ R_bud / 32 →
        (∀ j₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N_J =>
          (menu j).loc_idx = j₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (S_per_loc : ℝ)) →
        (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        (use_vel_sub = true → 0 < h ∧ r = t - 2 * h) →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ L - t → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
        ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
         (0 < r ∧ m_r = Nat.floor (r * ell / Real.log 2))) →
        m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        (∀ j : Fin N_J,
          IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
            m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ (menu j) ∧
          IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
            m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ (whole_menu j) ∧
          Function.Injective (emb_ret j) ∧
          (whole_menu j).loc_idx = (menu j).loc_idx ∧
          (menu j).N_all = N_all_of j ∧
          (whole_menu j).N_all = N_all_of j ∧
          (whole_menu j).m_bin = (menu j).m_bin ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_grid_coord : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ),
      (gridPt2D s k) 0 = s * (k.1 : ℝ) ∧ (gridPt2D s k) 1 = s * (k.2 : ℝ) :=
    fun _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

  have h_e10_norm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ = 1 := by
    have hsq : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      change ‖(1 : ℝ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖(0 : ℝ)‖ ^ 2 = 1
      norm_num
    have hsqrt := congr_arg Real.sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_one] at hsqrt

  have h_neg_xlogx_le : ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → -(x * Real.log x) ≤ 1 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with rfl | hx_pos
    · simp
    · have h1 : Real.log (x⁻¹) ≤ x⁻¹ - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hx_pos)
      rw [Real.log_inv] at h1
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hx_pos.le
      have h3 : x * (x⁻¹ - 1) = 1 - x := by
        rw [mul_sub, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx_pos.ne', mul_one]
      linarith only [h2, h3, hx_pos]

  have h_parseval_bound : ∀ (u e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (A B : ℝ),
      ‖e‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B →
      |inner ℝ u e| ≤ A → |inner ℝ u (perp2D e)| ≤ B → ‖u‖ ≤ A + B := by
    intro u e A B he hA hB h1 h2
    have hu : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = (u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have he2 : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h0 : ‖e‖ ^ 2 = (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [he, one_pow] at h0
      exact h0.symm
    have hi1 : inner ℝ u e = u 0 * e 0 + u 1 * e 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      ring
    have hi2 : inner ℝ u (perp2D e) = -(u 0 * e 1) + u 1 * e 0 := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hp0 : (perp2D e) 0 = -(e 1) := rfl
      have hp1 : (perp2D e) 1 = e 0 := rfl
      change inner ℝ (u 0) ((perp2D e) 0) + inner ℝ (u 1) ((perp2D e) 1) = _
      rw [hp0, hp1]
      simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      ring
    have hsq_eq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℝ u e) ^ 2 + (inner ℝ u (perp2D e)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hu, hi1, hi2]
      linear_combination ((u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2) * he2.symm
    have hs1 : (inner ℝ u e) ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
    have hs2 : (inner ℝ u (perp2D e)) ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h2 2
    have hsq_le : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ (A + B) ^ 2 := by nlinarith only [hsq_eq, hs1, hs2, hA, hB]
    have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq_le
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg u), Real.sqrt_sq (add_nonneg hA hB)] at hsqrt

  have h_int_mem_icc : ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : ℝ) (R : ℕ),
      |(k : ℝ) - y| ≤ (R : ℝ) → k ∈ Finset.Icc (⌊y⌋ - (R : ℤ)) (⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ)) := by
    intro k y R h
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    have h_abs := abs_le.mp h
    have h_fl_le : (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) ≤ y := Int.floor_le y
    have h_lt_fl : y < (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one y
    constructor
    · have h1 : ((⌊y⌋ - (R : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
        push_cast; linarith only [h_abs.1, h_fl_le]
      have h2 : ⌊y⌋ - (R : ℤ) < k + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
      omega
    · have h1 : (k : ℝ) < ((⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast; linarith only [h_abs.2, h_lt_fl]
      have h2 : k < ⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
      omega

  have h_floor_mem_icc : ∀ (z y : ℝ) (R : ℕ),
      |z - y| ≤ (R : ℝ) → ⌊z⌋ ∈ Finset.Icc (⌊y⌋ - (R : ℤ)) (⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ)) := by
    intro z y R h
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    have h_abs := abs_le.mp h
    have h_fl_y : (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) ≤ y := Int.floor_le y
    have h_lt_y : y < (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one y
    have h_fl_z : (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) ≤ z := Int.floor_le z
    constructor
    · rw [Int.le_floor]; push_cast; linarith only [h_abs.1, h_fl_y]
    · have h1 : (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) < ((⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast; linarith only [h_fl_z, h_abs.2, h_lt_y]
      have h2 : ⌊z⌋ < ⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
      omega

  have h_dyadic_mr : ∀ (ε r : ℝ) (m_r : ℕ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < r →
      m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) →
      ε ^ r ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ∧ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ r := by
    intro ε r m_r hε₀ hε₁ hr_pos hmr
    have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hε_inv : 1 < ε⁻¹ := by rw [one_lt_inv₀ hε₀]; linarith only [hε₁]
    have hell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := Real.log_pos hε_inv
    have hx_nn : 0 ≤ r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2 :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr_pos.le hell_pos.le) hlog2.le
    have hfl_le : (m_r : ℝ) ≤ r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2 := by
      rw [hmr]; exact Nat.floor_le hx_nn
    have hlt_fl : r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2 < (m_r : ℝ) + 1 := by
      rw [hmr]; exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have h2_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ m_r = Real.exp ((m_r : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), mul_comm]
    have hε_r : ε ^ r = Real.exp (-(r * Real.log (ε⁻¹))) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε₀, Real.log_inv]; ring_nf
    constructor
    · have hm1 : (m_r : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := (le_div_iff₀ hlog2).mp hfl_le
      rw [hε_r, h2_pow, ← Real.exp_neg]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith only [hm1])
    · have hm2 : r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) < ((m_r : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hlog2).mp hlt_fl
      have hexp_mul : 2 * Real.exp (-(r * Real.log (ε⁻¹))) =
          Real.exp (Real.log 2 - r * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), div_eq_mul_inv, Real.exp_neg]
      rw [hε_r, h2_pow, ← Real.exp_neg, hexp_mul]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith only [hm2])

  have h_roundShift_center : ∀ (s : ℝ) (τ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < s →
      let τ' := τ + WithLp.toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s)
      let k := roundShift2D s τ z
      τ' + gridPt2D s k = fineCellCenterV s τ k ∧
      ‖z - (τ' + gridPt2D s k)‖ ≤ s := by
    intro s τ z hs τ' k
    have h_eq : τ' + gridPt2D s k = fineCellCenterV s τ k := by
      dsimp only [τ', fineCellCenterV]; abel
    refine ⟨h_eq, ?_⟩
    have hc0 : |(z - (τ' + gridPt2D s k)) 0| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s := by
      have h_coord : (z - (τ' + gridPt2D s k)) 0 =
          (z 0 - τ 0) - ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s + s * (k.1 : ℝ)) := by
        change z 0 - ((τ 0 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s) + s * (k.1 : ℝ)) = _; ring
      have hk1 : s * (k.1 : ℝ) = (⌊(z 0 - τ 0) / s⌋ : ℝ) * s := by
        dsimp only [k, roundShift2D]; ring
      rw [h_coord, hk1, abs_le]
      have hm1 := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le ((z 0 - τ 0) / s))
      have hm2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one ((z 0 - τ 0) / s))
      constructor <;> nlinarith only [hm1, hm2, hs]
    have hc1 : |(z - (τ' + gridPt2D s k)) 1| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s := by
      have h_coord : (z - (τ' + gridPt2D s k)) 1 =
          (z 1 - τ 1) - ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s + s * (k.2 : ℝ)) := by
        change z 1 - ((τ 1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s) + s * (k.2 : ℝ)) = _; ring
      have hk2 : s * (k.2 : ℝ) = (⌊(z 1 - τ 1) / s⌋ : ℝ) * s := by
        dsimp only [k, roundShift2D]; ring
      rw [h_coord, hk2, abs_le]
      have hm1 := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le ((z 1 - τ 1) / s))
      have hm2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one ((z 1 - τ 1) / s))
      constructor <;> nlinarith only [hm1, hm2, hs]
    have hsq : ‖z - (τ' + gridPt2D s k)‖ ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h0 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hc0 2
      have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hc1 2
      nlinarith only [h0, h1, hs]
    have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hs.le] at hsqrt

  have h_fineVelBin_bounds : ∀ (ε H_P t r : ℝ) (d_b : ℕ)
      (τ_V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (n_cell : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < ε →
      let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
      let u_r := (H_P - r) / 2
      let v_rel := v - fineCellCenterV (ε ^ u_t) τ_V p_c.2.1
      let w := fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_b τ_V n_cell p_c v
      (d_b = 1 → |inner ℝ v_rel (n_cell p_c) - (w.1 : ℝ) * ε ^ u_r| ≤ ε ^ u_r ∧ w.2 = 0) ∧
      (d_b = 2 → ‖v_rel - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_r) w‖ ≤ 2 * ε ^ u_r) := by
    intro ε H_P t r d_b τ_V n_cell p_c v hε₀ u_t u_r v_rel w
    have hs : 0 < ε ^ u_r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ u_r
    constructor
    · intro hd1
      have hw_eq : w = (Int.floor (inner ℝ v_rel (n_cell p_c) / (ε ^ u_r)), 0) := by
        dsimp only [w, fineVelBin]; rw [if_pos hd1]
      rw [hw_eq]
      refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
      rw [abs_le]
      have hm1 := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le (inner ℝ v_rel (n_cell p_c) / (ε ^ u_r)))
      have hm2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (inner ℝ v_rel (n_cell p_c) / (ε ^ u_r)))
      constructor <;> linarith only [hm1, hm2]
    · intro hd2
      have hd_ne1 : d_b ≠ 1 := by omega
      have hw_eq : w = (Int.floor (v_rel 0 / (ε ^ u_r)), Int.floor (v_rel 1 / (ε ^ u_r))) := by
        dsimp only [w, fineVelBin]; rw [if_neg hd_ne1]
      have hc0 : |(v_rel - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_r) w) 0| ≤ ε ^ u_r := by
        have h_coord : (v_rel - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_r) w) 0 = v_rel 0 - ε ^ u_r * (w.1 : ℝ) := rfl
        rw [h_coord, hw_eq, abs_le]
        have hfl1 := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le (v_rel 0 / (ε ^ u_r)))
        have hfl2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (v_rel 0 / (ε ^ u_r)))
        constructor <;> linarith only [hfl1, hfl2]
      have hc1 : |(v_rel - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_r) w) 1| ≤ ε ^ u_r := by
        have h_coord : (v_rel - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_r) w) 1 = v_rel 1 - ε ^ u_r * (w.2 : ℝ) := rfl
        rw [h_coord, hw_eq, abs_le]
        have hfl1 := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le (v_rel 1 / (ε ^ u_r)))
        have hfl2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (v_rel 1 / (ε ^ u_r)))
        constructor <;> linarith only [hfl1, hfl2]
      have hsq : ‖v_rel - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_r) w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * ε ^ u_r) ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have h0 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hc0 2
        have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hc1 2
        nlinarith only [h0, h1, hs]
      have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
      rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at hsqrt

  have h_fin_ent_le : ∀ {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (P : ι → ℝ) (Z M : ℝ),
      1 ≤ M → (∀ i, 0 ≤ P i) → (∑ i : ι, P i = Z) →
      (∀ S : Finset ι, (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < P i) → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ M) →
      ∑ i : ι, -(P i * Real.log (P i / Z)) ≤ Z * Real.log M := by
    intro ι _ P Z M _ hP_nn hP_sum h_supp
    have : DecidablePred (fun i : ι => 0 < P i) := Classical.decPred _
    let S_pos := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => 0 < P i)
    have hZ_nn : 0 ≤ Z := by rw [← hP_sum]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hP_nn i)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hZ_nn with rfl | hZ_pos
    · have hP0 : ∀ i, P i = 0 := fun i =>
        le_antisymm (by
          have := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hP_nn j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
          linarith only [this, hP_sum]) (hP_nn i)
      simp [hP0]
    · have hS_sum : ∑ i ∈ S_pos, P i = Z := by
        rw [← hP_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        by_cases hp : 0 < P i
        · simp [hp]
        · have h0 : P i = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hp) (hP_nn i)
          simp [h0]
      have hS_ne : S_pos.Nonempty := by
        by_contra hemp
        rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hemp
        rw [hemp, Finset.sum_empty] at hS_sum
        linarith only [hS_sum, hZ_pos]
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hS_ne
      have hcard_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (S_pos.card : ℝ) :=
        Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩)
      have hcard_le : (S_pos.card : ℝ) ≤ M :=
        h_supp S_pos (fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2)
      have h_lhs_eq : ∑ i : ι, -(P i * Real.log (P i / Z)) =
          Z * ∑ i ∈ S_pos, -((P i / Z) * Real.log (P i / Z)) := by
        have h1 : ∑ i : ι, -(P i * Real.log (P i / Z)) =
            ∑ i ∈ S_pos, -(P i * Real.log (P i / Z)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          by_cases hp : 0 < P i
          · simp [hp]
          · have h0 : P i = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hp) (hP_nn i)
            simp [h0]
        rw [h1, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        have h_c : Z * (P i / Z) = P i := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hZ_pos.ne'
        calc -(P i * Real.log (P i / Z))
            = -((Z * (P i / Z)) * Real.log (P i / Z)) := by rw [h_c]
          _ = Z * -((P i / Z) * Real.log (P i / Z)) := by ring
      rw [h_lhs_eq]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hZ_pos.le
      have hq_sum : ∑ i ∈ S_pos, (P i / Z) = 1 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, hS_sum, div_self hZ_pos.ne']
      have h_term : ∀ i ∈ S_pos,
          -((P i / Z) * Real.log (P i / Z)) ≤
            (P i / Z) * Real.log (S_pos.card : ℝ) + ((S_pos.card : ℝ)⁻¹ - P i / Z) := by
        intro i hi
        have hp : 0 < P i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        have hq : 0 < P i / Z := div_pos hp hZ_pos
        have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos (inv_pos.mpr hcard_pos) hq)
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hq.le
        have hid1 : (P i / Z) * Real.log ((S_pos.card : ℝ)⁻¹ / (P i / Z)) =
            -(P i / Z) * Real.log (S_pos.card : ℝ) - (P i / Z) * Real.log (P i / Z) := by
          rw [Real.log_div (inv_ne_zero hcard_pos.ne') hq.ne', Real.log_inv]; ring
        have hid2 : (P i / Z) * ((S_pos.card : ℝ)⁻¹ / (P i / Z) - 1) =
            (S_pos.card : ℝ)⁻¹ - P i / Z := by
          rw [mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hq.ne', mul_one]
        linarith only [hmul, hid1, hid2]
      have hsum_le := Finset.sum_le_sum h_term
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hq_sum, one_mul,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hcard_pos.ne', hq_sum, sub_self, add_zero] at hsum_le
      exact le_trans hsum_le (Real.log_le_log hcard_pos hcard_le)

  have h_push_ent : ∀ {Ω Y : Type} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Y]
      (S_Y : Finset Y) (μ : Ω → ℝ) (F : Ω → Y) (M_fib : ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ μ ω) → (∑ ω : Ω, μ ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < μ ω → F ω ∈ S_Y) →
      (∀ y ∈ S_Y, ∀ S : Finset Ω, (∀ ω ∈ S, F ω = y ∧ 0 < μ ω) → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ M_fib) →
      (∑ ω : Ω, -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω))) - Real.log M_fib ≤
        ∑ y ∈ S_Y, -((∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => F ω = y), μ ω) *
          Real.log (∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => F ω = y), μ ω)) := by
    intro Ω Y _ _ S_Y μ F M_fib hμ_nn hμ_sum hF_mem h_fib
    have : DecidablePred (fun ω : Ω => 0 < μ ω) := Classical.decPred _
    let p_Y : Y → ℝ := fun y => ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => F ω = y), μ ω
    have hpY_sum : ∑ y ∈ S_Y, p_Y y = 1 := by
      have h1 : ∑ y ∈ S_Y, p_Y y = ∑ ω : Ω, ∑ y ∈ S_Y, (if F ω = y then μ ω else 0) := by
        simp_rw [p_Y, Finset.sum_filter]; exact Finset.sum_comm
      rw [h1, ← hμ_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq S_Y (F ω) (fun _ => μ ω)]
      by_cases hpos : 0 < μ ω
      · simp [hF_mem ω hpos]
      · have h0 : μ ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (hμ_nn ω)
        simp [h0]
    have hω_part : ∑ ω : Ω, -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω)) =
        ∑ y ∈ S_Y, ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => F ω = y ∧ 0 < μ ω),
          -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω)) := by
      have h1 : ∑ y ∈ S_Y, ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => F ω = y ∧ 0 < μ ω),
          -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω)) =
          ∑ ω : Ω, ∑ y ∈ S_Y, (if F ω = y ∧ 0 < μ ω then -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω)) else 0) := by
        simp_rw [Finset.sum_filter]; exact Finset.sum_comm
      rw [h1]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases hpos : 0 < μ ω
      · have h_ite : (∑ y ∈ S_Y, if F ω = y ∧ 0 < μ ω then -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω)) else 0) =
            ∑ y ∈ S_Y, if F ω = y then -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω)) else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => by simp [hpos])
        rw [h_ite, Finset.sum_ite_eq S_Y (F ω) (fun _ => -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω)))]
        simp [hF_mem ω hpos]
      · have h0 : μ ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (hμ_nn ω)
        simp [h0]
    have h_per_y : ∀ y ∈ S_Y,
        ∑ ω ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => F ω = y ∧ 0 < μ ω), -(μ ω * Real.log (μ ω)) ≤
          -(p_Y y * Real.log (p_Y y)) + p_Y y * Real.log M_fib := by
      intro y hy
      let Ω_y := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Ω => F ω = y ∧ 0 < μ ω)
      have hpY_eq : p_Y y = ∑ ω ∈ Ω_y, μ ω := by
        dsimp only [p_Y, Ω_y]
        rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases hFy : F ω = y
        · by_cases hpos : 0 < μ ω
          · simp [hFy, hpos]
          · have h0 : μ ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (hμ_nn ω)
            simp [hFy, h0]
        · simp [hFy]
      by_cases hne : Ω_y.Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩ := hne
        have hpY_pos : 0 < p_Y y := by
          rw [hpY_eq]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀).2.2
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω _ => hμ_nn ω) hω₀)

          Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩)

          h_fib y hy Ω_y (fun ω hω => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2)

          have hq_sum : ∑ ω ∈ Ω_y, (μ ω / p_Y y) = 1 := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hpY_eq, div_self hpY_pos.ne']
          have h_term : ∀ ω ∈ Ω_y,

                (μ ω / p_Y y) * Real.log (Ω_y.card : ℝ) +
                  ((Ω_y.card : ℝ)⁻¹ - μ ω / p_Y y) := by
            intro ω hω

                  (μ ω / p_Y y) * Real.log (μ ω / p_Y y) := by
              rw [Real.log_div (inv_ne_zero hcard_pos.ne') hq_pos.ne', Real.log_inv]; ring
            have h_id2 : (μ ω / p_Y y) * ((Ω_y.card : ℝ)⁻¹ / (μ ω / p_Y y) - 1) =
                (Ω_y.card : ℝ)⁻¹ - μ ω / p_Y y := by
              rw [mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hq_pos.ne', mul_one]
            linarith only [hmul, h_id1, h_id2]
          have hsum_le := Finset.sum_le_sum h_term
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hq_sum, one_mul,
            Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul,
            mul_inv_cancel₀ hcard_pos.ne', hq_sum, sub_self, add_zero] at hsum_le

            -(p_Y y * Real.log (p_Y y)) +
              p_Y y * ∑ ω ∈ Ω_y, -((μ ω / p_Y y) * Real.log (μ ω / p_Y y)) := by
          have h_each : ∀ ω ∈ Ω_y,

                -(μ ω * Real.log (p_Y y)) +

            intro ω hω

                    (p_Y y * (μ ω / p_Y y)) * (-(Real.log (μ ω) - Real.log (p_Y y))) := by
                  rw [h_c]; ring

                    p_Y y * (-((μ ω / p_Y y) * (Real.log (μ ω) - Real.log (p_Y y)))) := by ring
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_each, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          have h_first : ∑ ω ∈ Ω_y, -(μ ω * Real.log (p_Y y)) = -(p_Y y * Real.log (p_Y y)) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← hpY_eq]
          rw [h_first]

      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
        have hpY0 : p_Y y = 0 := by rw [hpY_eq, hne, Finset.sum_empty]

    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hpY_sum, one_mul] at h_tot
    dsimp only [p_Y] at h_tot
    linarith only [hω_part, h_tot]

  have h_site_preimage_bound : ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ)

        Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_product]

      · refine h_int_mem_icc kv0 (v₀ 0 / s_v) R_V_loc ?_

        have h_eq : (s_v⁻¹ • (v₀ - gridPt2D s_v (kv0, kv1))) 1 = v₀ 1 / s_v - (kv1 : ℝ) := by

  have h_dedup_sites : ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ)

        (∀ o' : Fin N'_O,

            (r'_O (F_O ⟨j, α⟩)) (V'_O (F_O ⟨j, α⟩)) (X'_O (F_O ⟨j, α⟩)) (ψ'_O (F_O ⟨j, α⟩))) ∧
        (∀ o' : Fin N'_O, ∀ S : Finset (Σ j : Fin N_J, Fin (N_fam j)),

    intro ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_J S_per_loc Φ₀ f N_fam sub_fam

        obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hmbin_pos, _⟩ := h_valid ja.1
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_log hmbin_pos (h_FO_mass ja.1 ja.2)) (hμ_nn ja)
      let Fib_cap : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ℕ → Finset (Fin (N_fam j)) :=
        fun j c => Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin (N_fam j) => (sub_fam j).cap_id α = c)
      have hp'_cell : ∀ (o' : Fin N'_O) (d' : Fin N_D'),
          p' o' d' = (π_J (j_of_D d') / (N_fam (j_of_D d') : ℝ)) *
            ((Finset.filter (fun α => F_O ⟨j_of_D d', α⟩ = o')
              (Fib_cap (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d'))).card : ℝ) := by
        intro o' d'; dsimp only [p']; rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
        have h_j : ∀ j₁ : Fin N_J,
            (∑ α : Fin (N_fam j₁),
              if F_O ⟨j₁, α⟩ = o' ∧ F_D ⟨j₁, α⟩ = d' then μ ⟨j₁, α⟩ else 0) =
            if j₁ = j_of_D d' then
              ∑ α : Fin (N_fam j₁),
                if F_O ⟨j₁, α⟩ = o' ∧ (sub_fam j₁).cap_id α = c_of_D d'
                then π_J j₁ / (N_fam j₁ : ℝ) else 0
            else 0 := by
          intro j₁
          by_cases hj1 : j₁ = j_of_D d'
          · rw [if_pos hj1]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
            have hfd_iff : F_D ⟨j₁, α⟩ = d' ↔ (sub_fam j₁).cap_id α = c_of_D d' := by
              constructor
              · intro h; rw [← h, hFD_c]
              · intro h; dsimp only [F_D]; rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
                refine Sigma.ext hj1 ?_; subst hj1; exact heq_of_eq (Subtype.ext h)
            simp only [hfd_iff, μ]
          · rw [if_neg hj1]
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α _ => ?_)
            have hne : F_D ⟨j₁, α⟩ ≠ d' := fun h => hj1 (by rw [← h, hFD_j])
            simp [hne]
        simp_rw [h_j]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (j_of_D d')
          (fun j₁ => ∑ α : Fin (N_fam j₁),
            if F_O ⟨j₁, α⟩ = o' ∧ (sub_fam j₁).cap_id α = c_of_D d'
            then π_J j₁ / (N_fam j₁ : ℝ) else 0)]
        simp only [Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]; dsimp only [Fib_cap]
        rw [Finset.filter_filter, ← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
        congr 3; ext α; simp [and_comm]
      have hp'_D_eq : ∀ d' : Fin N_D',
          p'_D d' = (π_J (j_of_D d') / (N_fam (j_of_D d') : ℝ)) *
            ((Fib_cap (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d')).card : ℝ) := by
        intro d'; dsimp only [p'_D]; simp_rw [hp'_cell _ d', ← Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1
        norm_cast
        exact (Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
          (s := Fib_cap (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d')) (t := Finset.univ)
          (f := fun α => F_O ⟨j_of_D d', α⟩) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)).symm
      have hp'_D_sum1 : ∑ d' : Fin N_D', p'_D d' = 1 := by
        dsimp only [p'_D]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact hp'_sum1
      have h_HOD_per_d : ∀ d' : Fin N_D',
          p'_D d' * (Real.log ((Fib_cap (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d')).card : ℝ) -
            Real.log (M_mult : ℝ)) ≤
          ∑ o' : Fin N'_O, -(p' o' d' * Real.log (p' o' d' / p'_D d')) := by
        intro d'
        let j := j_of_D d'
        let c := c_of_D d'
        let W := Fib_cap j c
        have hW_ne : W.Nonempty := ⟨rep_cap d', Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hrep_cap d'⟩⟩
        have hW_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (W.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr hW_ne)
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hπ_nn j) with hπ0 | hπ_pos
        · have hpD0 : p'_D d' = 0 := by
            rw [hp'_D_eq d']; change (π_J j / _) * _ = 0; rw [← hπ0, zero_div, zero_mul]
          have hp0 : ∀ o', p' o' d' = 0 := by
            intro o'; rw [hp'_cell o' d']; change (π_J j / _) * _ = 0; rw [← hπ0, zero_div, zero_mul]
          simp [hpD0, hp0]
        · have hpD_pos : 0 < p'_D d' := by
            rw [hp'_D_eq d']; exact mul_pos (div_pos hπ_pos (hN_pos j)) hW_pos
          let Ω_W := { α : Fin (N_fam j) // α ∈ W }
          let μ_W : Ω_W → ℝ := fun _ => (W.card : ℝ)⁻¹
          let F_W : Ω_W → Fin N'_O := fun x => F_O ⟨j, x.1⟩
          have hμW_nn : ∀ x : Ω_W, 0 ≤ μ_W x := fun _ => inv_nonneg.mpr hW_pos.le
          have hμW_sum : ∑ x : Ω_W, μ_W x = 1 := by
            dsimp only [Ω_W, μ_W]
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, nsmul_eq_mul,
              mul_inv_cancel₀ hW_pos.ne']
          have hp_ent := h_push_ent (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N'_O)) μ_W F_W (M_mult : ℝ)
            hμW_nn hμW_sum (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
            (fun o' _ S_W hSW => by
              let S_sub : Finset (Fin (N_fam j)) := S_W.map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩
              have hcard_eq : S_W.card = S_sub.card := (Finset.card_map _).symm
              rw [hcard_eq]
              exact_mod_cast h_FO_cond j o' S_sub (fun α hα => by
                obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hα; exact (hSW x hx).1))
          have hH_μW : ∑ x : Ω_W, -(μ_W x * Real.log (μ_W x)) = Real.log (W.card : ℝ) := by
            dsimp only [Ω_W, μ_W]
            simp only [Real.log_inv, mul_neg, neg_neg, Finset.sum_const,
              Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
              mul_inv_cancel₀ hW_pos.ne', one_mul]
          have h_cond_eq : ∀ o' : Fin N'_O,
              (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Ω_W => F_W x = o'), μ_W x) =
                p' o' d' / p'_D d' := by
            intro o'
            simp only [μ_W, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
            rw [hp'_cell o' d', hp'_D_eq d']
            change ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Ω_W => F_O ⟨j, x.1⟩ = o')).card : ℝ) * (W.card : ℝ)⁻¹ =
              ((π_J j / (N_fam j : ℝ)) * ((W.filter (fun α => F_O ⟨j, α⟩ = o')).card : ℝ)) /
                ((π_J j / (N_fam j : ℝ)) * (W.card : ℝ))
            rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ (div_pos hπ_pos (hN_pos j)).ne', div_eq_mul_inv]
            congr 2; exact Finset.card_bij (fun (x : Ω_W) _ => x.1)
              (fun x hx => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨x.2, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩)
              (fun x₁ _ x₂ _ h => Subtype.ext h)
              (fun α hα => ⟨⟨α, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα).1⟩,
                Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα).2⟩, rfl⟩)
          rw [hH_μW] at hp_ent; simp_rw [h_cond_eq] at hp_ent
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_ent hpD_pos.le
          rw [Finset.mul_sum] at hmul
          refine hmul.trans_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o' _ => ?_))
          have hc : p'_D d' * (p' o' d' / p'_D d') = p' o' d' := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpD_pos.ne'
          calc p'_D d' * -(p' o' d' / p'_D d' * Real.log (p' o' d' / p'_D d'))
              = -((p'_D d' * (p' o' d' / p'_D d')) * Real.log (p' o' d' / p'_D d')) := by ring
            _ = -(p' o' d' * Real.log (p' o' d' / p'_D d')) := by rw [hc]
      have h_HOD_tot : (∑ d' : Fin N_D', p'_D d' * Real.log ((Fib_cap (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d')).card : ℝ)) -
            Real.log (M_mult : ℝ) ≤
          ∑ o' : Fin N'_O, ∑ d' : Fin N_D', -(p' o' d' * Real.log (p' o' d' / p'_D d')) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d' (_ : d' ∈ Finset.univ) => h_HOD_per_d d')
        simp_rw [mul_sub] at hs
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp'_D_sum1, one_mul] at hs
        exact hs
      have h_sum_D_sigma : ∀ g : Fin N_J → ℕ → ℝ,
          ∑ d' : Fin N_D', p'_D d' * g (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d') =
            ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
              ∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) * g j c := by
        intro g; simp_rw [hp'_D_eq]
        have h_eqv := Fintype.sum_equiv eD
          (fun d' : Fin N_D' =>
            (π_J (j_of_D d') / (N_fam (j_of_D d') : ℝ)) *
              ((Fib_cap (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d')).card : ℝ) * g (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d'))
          (fun x : IdxD =>
            (π_J x.1 / (N_fam x.1 : ℝ)) * ((Fib_cap x.1 x.2.1).card : ℝ) * g x.1 x.2.1)
          (fun _ => rfl)
        rw [h_eqv, Fintype.sum_sigma]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort (Caps j)]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => by ring)
      have h_Ew_eq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            (∑ d' : Fin N_D', p'_D d' * ((1 + γ) * b_D' d' + (1 - γ) * a_D' d')) =
          b_star + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
            ∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
              pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc := by
        have h_w : ∀ d' : Fin N_D',
            (1 + γ) * b_D' d' + (1 - γ) * a_D' d' =
              2 * b_star + pktWeight γ (sub_fam (j_of_D d')).b_loc (sub_fam (j_of_D d')).a_loc := by
          intro d'; dsimp only [b_D', a_D', pktWeight]; ring
        simp_rw [h_w, mul_add]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp'_D_sum1, one_mul,
          h_sum_D_sigma (fun j _ => pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc)]
        ring
      have h_HOD_sum := h_sum_D_sigma (fun j c => Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ))
      rw [h_HOD_sum] at h_HOD_tot
      have h_HO_div := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr h_HO
      have h_Em_div := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr h_Emass) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2)
      have h_HOD_div := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr h_HOD_tot) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
      have h_alg :
          (((∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) +
              (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log (N_fam j : ℝ)) -
              Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) - Real.log ((C_loc_ov * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ)) / ell) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
              ∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ)) - Real.log (M_mult : ℝ)) / ell) +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log ((sub_fam j).m_bin)) / ell) +
          (b_star + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
            ∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
              pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc) =
          H_J + b_star +
            (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
              (Real.log (N_fam j : ℝ) / ell +
               (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (sub_fam j).m_bin / ell) +
               (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c ∈ Caps j,
                 (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                   (Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / ell +
                    pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc))) -
            Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell -
            (Real.log ((C_loc_ov * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (M_mult : ℝ)) / ell := by
        dsimp only [H_J]
        have hs1 : (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log (N_fam j : ℝ)) / ell =
            ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (Real.log (N_fam j : ℝ) / ell) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
        have hs2 : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log ((sub_fam j).m_bin)) / ell) =
            ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ((sub_fam j).m_bin) / ell)) := by
          rw [mul_div_assoc', Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
        have hs3 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
              ∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ)) / ell) =
            ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c ∈ Caps j,
              (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                (Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / ell)) := by
          rw [mul_div_assoc', Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
          have h_sum_c : (∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ)) / ell =
              ∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                (Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / ell) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_div]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
          rw [← h_sum_c]; ring
        have hs4 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
              ∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc =
            ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c ∈ Caps j,
              (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
        have h_comb : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
            π_J j * (Real.log (N_fam j : ℝ) / ell) +
            π_J j * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ((sub_fam j).m_bin) / ell)) +
            π_J j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c ∈ Caps j,
              (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                (Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / ell)) +
            π_J j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c ∈ Caps j,
              (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc) =
            π_J j * (Real.log (N_fam j : ℝ) / ell +
              (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ((sub_fam j).m_bin) / ell) +
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c ∈ Caps j,
                (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                  (Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / ell +
                    pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc)) := by
          intro j
          have h_in : (∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                (Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / ell)) +
              (∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc) =
              ∑ c ∈ Caps j, (((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / (N_fam j : ℝ)) *
                (Real.log ((Fib_cap j c).card : ℝ) / ell +
                  pktWeight γ (sub_fam j).b_loc (sub_fam j).a_loc) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring)
          rw [← h_in]; ring
        have h_sum_comb := Finset.sum_congr (rfl : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_J)) = Finset.univ)
          (fun j _ => h_comb j)
        simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h_sum_comb
        rw [sub_div, sub_div, add_div, sub_div, mul_sub, hs1, hs2, hs3, hs4,
          add_div (Real.log ((C_loc_ov * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ)), mul_div_assoc]
        linarith only [h_sum_comb]
      have h_score_def : generalPacketScore ε γ H_P r lam_sys m_r Φ₀ f
          N'_O N_D' r'_O V'_O X'_O ψ'_O b_D' a_D' p' =
        (∑ o' : Fin N'_O, -(p'_O o' * Real.log (p'_O o'))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o' : Fin N'_O, ∑ d' : Fin N_D',
          -(p' o' d' * Real.log (p' o' d' / p'_D d'))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o' : Fin N'_O, p'_O o' * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P r lam_sys m_r Φ₀ f (r'_O o') (V'_O o') (X'_O o') (ψ'_O o'))) / ell) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d' : Fin N_D', p'_D d' * ((1 + γ) * b_D' d' + (1 - γ) * a_D' d')) := rfl
      linarith only [h_score_def, h_HO_div, h_Em_div, h_HOD_div, h_Ew_eq, h_alg]

  
  let C_J0 : ℕ := (6 * ⌈cls.B_sys⌉₊ + 1) ^ 4
  let R_V_loc : ℕ := 4 * ⌈cls.B_sys⌉₊ + ⌈cls.R_win⌉₊ + 4
  let R_X_loc : ℕ := 8 * ⌈cls.B_sys⌉₊ + 2 * ⌈cls.R_win⌉₊ + 10
  let C_loc_ov : ℕ := (2 * R_V_loc + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * R_X_loc + 1) ^ 2
  let C_law_log : ℝ :=
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 4 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ) +
    Real.log ((C_loc_ov * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (M_mult : ℝ) +
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_can + 1
  have hCJ0_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_J0 := Nat.one_le_pow 4 _ (by omega)
  have hCloc_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_loc_ov :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.one_le_pow 2 _ (by omega)) (Nat.one_le_pow 2 _ (by omega))
  have hlog4_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log 4 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hlogCJ0_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hCJ0_ge1)
  have hlogCM_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log ((C_loc_ov * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul hCloc_ge1 hM_mult)
  have hlogM_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (M_mult : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hM_mult)
  have hlogCcan_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log C_can := Real.log_nonneg hC_can
  have hR_bud_pos : 0 < R_bud := by linarith only [hξ, hR_bud]
  let ε_law : ℝ := min (1 / 4 : ℝ) ((Real.exp (2 * C_law_log / R_bud))⁻¹)
  have hε_law_pos : 0 < ε_law :=
    lt_min (by norm_num) (inv_pos.mpr (Real.exp_pos _))
  have hε_law_lt : ε_law < 1 / 2 :=
    (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)

  refine ⟨ε_law, hε_law_pos, hε_law_lt, ?_⟩
  intro M_L ε H_P L t r h b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc

          calc p_root_D d' * -(p_root o d' / p_root_D d' * Real.log (p_root o d' / p_root_D d'))
              = -((p_root_D d' * (p_root o d' / p_root_D d')) *
                  Real.log (p_root o d' / p_root_D d')) := by ring
            _ = -(p_root o d' * Real.log (p_root o d' / p_root_D d')) := by rw [hc]
      have h_cap_fl_d : ∀ d' : Fin N_allD,
          ((whole_menu (j_of_D d')).g_bin -
            pktWeight γ (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).b_loc (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).a_loc - ξ) * ell ≤
          Real.log ((Fib_cap (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d')).card : ℝ) := by
        intro d'
        let j := j_of_D d'
        let β₀ := rep_cap d'
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hfl_sub, _⟩ := h_sub_all j
        have hfl_raw := hfl_sub β₀
        have hfl : ε ^ (-(whole_menu j).g_bin +
            pktWeight γ (whole_menu j).b_loc (whole_menu j).a_loc + ξ) ≤
          ((Fib_cap j (c_of_D d')).card : ℝ) := by
          rw [← hrep_cap d']
          convert hfl_raw using 3; ext β'; simp [Fib_cap, j, β₀]
        have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hfl
        rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀] at hlog
        have hlog_inv : Real.log ε = -ell := by
          dsimp only [ell]; rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
        rw [hlog_inv] at hlog
        linarith only [hlog]
      have h_HOD_Ew :
          b_star + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (whole_menu j).g_bin) -
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ξ - ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (M_mult : ℝ)) / ell ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d' : Fin N_allD,
            -(p_root o d' * Real.log (p_root o d' / p_root_D d'))) / ell) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d' : Fin N_allD,
            p_root_D d' * ((1 + γ) * b_root d' + (1 - γ) * a_root d')) := by
        have hp_D_nn : ∀ d', 0 ≤ p_root_D d' :=
          fun d' => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hp_r_nn o d')
        have h_per_d : ∀ d' : Fin N_allD,
            p_root_D d' * (((whole_menu (j_of_D d')).g_bin -
              pktWeight γ (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).b_loc (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).a_loc - ξ) * ell -
              Real.log (M_mult : ℝ)) ≤
            ∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_root o d' * Real.log (p_root o d' / p_root_D d')) :=
          fun d' => (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (sub_le_sub_right (h_cap_fl_d d') _) (hp_D_nn d')).trans (h_HOD_per_d d')
        have hsum_d := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d' (_ : d' ∈ Finset.univ) => h_per_d d')
        rw [← Finset.sum_comm (s := O₀)] at hsum_d
        have h_j_marg : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
            ∑ d' : Fin N_allD, (if j_of_D d' = j then p_root_D d' else 0) = π_J j := by
          intro j
          simp_rw [hp_D_eq]
          have h_eqv := Fintype.sum_equiv eD
            (fun d' : Fin N_allD =>
              if j_of_D d' = j then
                (π_J (j_of_D d') / (N_all_of (j_of_D d') : ℝ)) *
                  ((Fib_cap (j_of_D d') (c_of_D d')).card : ℝ) else 0)
            (fun x : IdxD =>
              if x.1 = j then (π_J x.1 / (N_all_of x.1 : ℝ)) * ((Fib_cap x.1 x.2.1).card : ℝ) else 0)
            (fun _ => rfl)
          rw [h_eqv, Fintype.sum_sigma]
          have hj1 : ∀ j₁ : Fin N_J,
              (∑ c : { c // c ∈ Caps j₁ }, if j₁ = j then
                (π_J j₁ / (N_all_of j₁ : ℝ)) * ((Fib_cap j₁ c.1).card : ℝ) else 0) =
              if j₁ = j then π_J j₁ else 0 := by
            intro j₁
            by_cases h1 : j₁ = j
            · subst h1
              simp only [↓reduceIte, ← Finset.mul_sum]
              have h_coe : (∑ i : { c // c ∈ Caps j₁ }, ((Fib_cap j₁ i.1).card : ℝ)) =
                  ∑ c ∈ Caps j₁, ((Fib_cap j₁ c).card : ℝ) :=
                Finset.sum_coe_sort (Caps j₁) (fun c => ((Fib_cap j₁ c).card : ℝ))
              rw [h_coe]
              have hf : ∑ c ∈ Caps j₁, ((Fib_cap j₁ c).card : ℝ) = (N_all_of j₁ : ℝ) := by
                norm_cast
                simpa [Fib_cap] using (Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
                  (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (N_all_of j₁))))
                  (t := Caps j₁) (f := (whole_menu j₁).cap_id)
                  (fun β _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ β))).symm
              rw [hf, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hN_pos j₁).ne']
            · simp [h1]
          simp_rw [hj1]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ j π_J]; simp
        have h_sum_fn : ∀ g : Fin N_J → ℝ,
            ∑ d' : Fin N_allD, p_root_D d' * g (j_of_D d') = ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * g j := by
          intro g
          simp_rw [← h_j_marg, Finset.sum_mul]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d' _ => ?_)
          have h_ite : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
              (if j_of_D d' = j then p_root_D d' else 0) * g j =
              if j_of_D d' = j then p_root_D d' * g j else 0 :=
            fun _ => by split_ifs <;> ring
          simp_rw [h_ite]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (j_of_D d') (fun j => p_root_D d' * g j)]; simp
        have h_div := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr hsum_d) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
        have h_lhs_simp : (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            ((∑ d' : Fin N_allD, p_root_D d' * (((whole_menu (j_of_D d')).g_bin -
              pktWeight γ (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).b_loc (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).a_loc - ξ) * ell -
              Real.log (M_mult : ℝ))) / ell) =
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (whole_menu j).g_bin) -
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * pktWeight γ (whole_menu j).b_loc (whole_menu j).a_loc) -
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ξ - ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (M_mult : ℝ)) / ell := by
          have h_d_sp : ∀ d' : Fin N_allD,
              p_root_D d' * (((whole_menu (j_of_D d')).g_bin -
                pktWeight γ (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).b_loc (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).a_loc - ξ) * ell -
                Real.log (M_mult : ℝ)) =
              (p_root_D d' * (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).g_bin -
               p_root_D d' * pktWeight γ (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).b_loc (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).a_loc -
               p_root_D d' * ξ) * ell - p_root_D d' * Real.log (M_mult : ℝ) := fun _ => by ring
          simp_rw [h_d_sp]
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
            Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h_sum_fn (fun j => (whole_menu j).g_bin),
            h_sum_fn (fun j => pktWeight γ (whole_menu j).b_loc (whole_menu j).a_loc),
            ← Finset.sum_mul, hp_D_sum1, one_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp_D_sum1, one_mul,
            sub_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hell_pos.ne']
          ring
        have h_Ew_eq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d' : Fin N_allD,
              p_root_D d' * ((1 + γ) * b_root d' + (1 - γ) * a_root d')) =
            b_star + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
              pktWeight γ (whole_menu j).b_loc (whole_menu j).a_loc := by
          have hw : ∀ d' : Fin N_allD,
              (1 + γ) * b_root d' + (1 - γ) * a_root d' =
                2 * b_star + pktWeight γ (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).b_loc (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).a_loc := by
            intro d'; dsimp only [b_root, a_root, pktWeight]; ring
          simp_rw [hw, mul_add]
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hp_D_sum1, one_mul,
            h_sum_fn (fun j => pktWeight γ (whole_menu j).b_loc (whole_menu j).a_loc)]
          ring
        linarith only [h_div, h_lhs_simp, h_Ew_eq]
      have h_HO_div := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr h_HO
      have h_Em_div := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr h_Emass) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2)
      have h_kr_id : K_r_all = H_J + b_star +
          ((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log (N_all_of j : ℝ)) / ell) +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log ((whole_menu j).m_bin)) / ell) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (whole_menu j).g_bin) := by
        have hj : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
            π_J j * subclassProxyA ε (whole_menu j) =
            (π_J j * Real.log (N_all_of j : ℝ)) / ell +
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((π_J j * Real.log (whole_menu j).m_bin) / ell) +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (π_J j * (whole_menu j).g_bin) := by
          intro j
          dsimp only [subclassProxyA, ell]
          ring
        dsimp only [K_r_all]
        simp_rw [hj]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_div,
          ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring
      have h_ho_alg :
          ((∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) +
            (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log (N_all_of j : ℝ)) -
            Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) - Real.log ((C_loc_ov * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ)) / ell =
          H_J + (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log (N_all_of j : ℝ)) / ell -
            Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell - Real.log ((C_loc_ov * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ) / ell := by
        dsimp only [H_J]; ring
      have h_em_alg : (3 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log ((whole_menu j).m_bin)) - Real.log C_can) / ell) =
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * Real.log ((whole_menu j).m_bin)) / ell) -
            ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_can) / ell := by ring
      have h_loss_alg : Loss₀ = Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ξ +
          Real.log ((C_loc_ov * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ) / ell +
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (M_mult : ℝ)) / ell +
          ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_can) / ell := by dsimp only [Loss₀]; ring
      dsimp only [s_root]
      linarith only [h_HO_div, h_Em_div, h_HOD_Ew, h_kr_id, h_ho_alg, h_em_alg, h_loss_alg]
    have hKr_le_s : K_r_star - R_bud ≤ s_root := by
      linarith only [h_Kr_eq, hLoss0_le, hs_root_lb]
    constructor
    · have h_bdd : BddAbove ({ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2) / ell) } ∪
          { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ) (b a : Fin N_D → ℝ)
              (e_dir V_c X_c : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b d ∧ b d ≤ a d ∧ a d ≤ min L (H_P / 2) ∧ ‖e_dir d‖ = 1) ∧
              (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) ∧
              (∀ o d, o ∉ O₀ → p o d = 0) ∧
              (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) ∧
              (∀ o ∈ O₀, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
                0 < canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d) ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
                |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d)) ∧
              (let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
               let p_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d
               let H_O := (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell
               let H_O_D := (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
                 -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell
               let E_mass := (∑ o ∈ O₀,
                 p_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)) / ell
               let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D,
                 p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b d + (1 - γ) * a d)
               s = H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w) }) := by
        refine BddAbove.union bddAbove_singleton ⟨(3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((O₀.card : ℝ) / ell) +
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o ∈ O₀, |Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)|) / ell) +
          H_P / 2, ?_⟩
        rintro s ⟨N_D', b', a', e', V_c', X_c', p', h_ba, hp'_nn, _, hp'_sum1, _, hs_eq⟩
        let p'_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D', p' o d
        let p'_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p' o d
        have hp'O_nn : ∀ o, 0 ≤ p'_O o := fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hp'_nn o d)
        have hp'D_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ p'_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hp'_nn o d)
        have hp'D_sum1 : ∑ d : Fin N_D', p'_D d = 1 := by
          dsimp only [p'_D]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact hp'_sum1
        have hHO_ub : (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p'_O o * Real.log (p'_O o))) / ell ≤ (O₀.card : ℝ) / ell := by
          refine (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr ?_
          have h1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := O₀) (fun o _ => h_neg_xlogx_le (p'_O o) (hp'O_nn o))
          simpa using h1
        have hHOD_ub : (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D', -(p' o d * Real.log (p' o d / p'_D d))) / ell ≤
            (O₀.card : ℝ) / ell := by
          refine (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr ?_
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          have h_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D',
              ∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p' o d * Real.log (p' o d / p'_D d)) ≤ p'_D d * (O₀.card : ℝ) := by
            intro d
            rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hp'D_nn d) with hd0 | hd_pos
            · have hp0 : ∀ o ∈ O₀, p' o d = 0 := fun o ho =>
                le_antisymm ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun x _ => hp'_nn x d) ho).trans_eq hd0.symm)
                  (hp'_nn o d)
              rw [← hd0, zero_mul]
              exact le_of_eq (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => by simp [hp0 o ho]))
            · have h_each : ∀ o ∈ O₀,
                  -(p' o d * Real.log (p' o d / p'_D d)) ≤ p'_D d * 1 := by
                intro o _
                have hc : p'_D d * (p' o d / p'_D d) = p' o d := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hd_pos.ne'
                have h_rew : -(p' o d * Real.log (p' o d / p'_D d)) =
                    p'_D d * -((p' o d / p'_D d) * Real.log (p' o d / p'_D d)) := by
                  have h_r : p'_D d * -((p' o d / p'_D d) * Real.log (p' o d / p'_D d)) =
                      -((p'_D d * (p' o d / p'_D d)) * Real.log (p' o d / p'_D d)) := by ring
                  rw [h_r, hc]
                rw [h_rew]
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (h_neg_xlogx_le _ (div_nonneg (hp'_nn o d) hd_pos.le)) hd_pos.le
              have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each
              simpa [mul_comm] using hs
          have hs_d := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d (_ : d ∈ Finset.univ) => h_d d)
          rwa [← Finset.sum_mul, hp'D_sum1, one_mul] at hs_d
        have hEm_ub : (∑ o ∈ O₀, p'_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)) / ell ≤
            (∑ o ∈ O₀, |Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)|) / ell := by
          refine (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hell_pos).mpr (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun o ho => ?_))
          have hpO_le1 : p'_O o ≤ 1 :=
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun x _ => hp'O_nn x) ho).trans_eq hp'_sum1
          exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self _) (hp'O_nn o)).trans
            (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hpO_le1)
        have hEw_ub : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D', p'_D d * ((1 + γ) * b' d + (1 - γ) * a' d)) ≤
            H_P / 2 := by
          have h_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D',
              p'_D d * ((1 + γ) * b' d + (1 - γ) * a' d) ≤ p'_D d * H_P := by
            intro d
            obtain ⟨_, hba_d, ha_min, _⟩ := h_ba d
            have ha_hp : a' d ≤ H_P / 2 := ha_min.trans (min_le_right _ _)
            have hb_hp : b' d ≤ H_P / 2 := hba_d.trans ha_hp
            have hw_le : (1 + γ) * b' d + (1 - γ) * a' d ≤ H_P := by
              nlinarith only [hb_hp, ha_hp, hγ₀, hγ₁]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_le (hp'D_nn d)
          have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d (_ : d ∈ Finset.univ) => h_d d)
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hp'D_sum1, one_mul] at hs
          linarith only [hs]
        rw [hs_eq]
        linarith only [hHO_ub, hHOD_ub, hEm_ub, hEw_ub]
      have hs_le_K0 : s_root ≤ K₀ :=
        le_csSup h_bdd (Or.inr ⟨N_allD, b_root, a_root, e_root, V_root, X_root, p_root,
          h_root_adm1, hp_r_nn, hp_r_out, hp_r_sum1, h_root_adm2, rfl⟩)
      exact hKr_le_s.trans hs_le_K0
    · intro ν κ hgap hb_nu
      have hs_le_gap : s_root ≤ K₀ - κ :=
        hgap N_allD b_root a_root e_root V_root X_root p_root h_root_adm1
          (fun d' _ => by
            have hb_loc_nn : 0 ≤ (whole_menu (j_of_D d')).b_loc :=
              (hval_whole0 (j_of_D d')).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
            dsimp only [b_root]
            linarith only [hb_nu, hb_loc_nn])
          hp_r_nn hp_r_out hp_r_sum1 h_root_adm2
      exact hKr_le_s.trans hs_le_gap

  refine ⟨h_conj1, ?_, fun hr_pos => (h_pos_r hr_pos).2, h_zero_r⟩
  intro hr_pos
  obtain ⟨N'_O, r'_O, V'_O, X'_O, ψ'_O, N_allD, j_of_D, b_all, a_all, r_all,
    e_all, V_all, X_all, p_all, hadm_all, hba_all, hmarg_all, hscore_all⟩ := (h_pos_r hr_pos).1
  refine ⟨N'_O, r'_O, V'_O, X'_O, ψ'_O, N_allD, j_of_D, b_all, a_all, r_all,
    e_all, V_all, X_all, p_all, hadm_all, hba_all, fun j => ?_, hscore_all⟩
  rw [← hmarg_all j]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o' _ => Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl))
  ext d'; simp

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_T β₁ β₂ : Type}
      (ε : ℝ) (N₁₂ N₂₁ : ℕ) (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (T : Fin N_ω → α_T) (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → β₁) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → β₂)
      (F₁₂ : α_T → β₁ → Finset β₂) (F₂₁ : α_T → β₂ → Finset β₁),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ N₁₂ → 1 ≤ N₂₁ →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω →
        Y₂ ω ∈ F₁₂ (T ω) (Y₁ ω) ∧ (F₁₂ (T ω) (Y₁ ω)).card ≤ N₁₂ ∧
        Y₁ ω ∈ F₂₁ (T ω) (Y₂ ω) ∧ (F₂₁ (T ω) (Y₂ ω)).card ≤ N₂₁) →
      |finCondEntropy ε Q T Y₂ - finCondEntropy ε Q T Y₁| ≤

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have h_ell_pos : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁
    exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr (by linarith))

  have h_log_rpow : ∀ (ε t : ℝ), 0 < ε → Real.log (ε ^ t) = -(t * Real.log (ε⁻¹)) := by
    intro ε t hε₀
    rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀ t, Real.log_inv]
    ring

  have h_le_of_log_le : ∀ {a b : ℝ}, 0 < a → 0 < b → Real.log a ≤ Real.log b → a ≤ b := by
    intro a b ha hb hlog
    by_contra h_not
    linarith [Real.log_lt_log hb (lt_of_not_ge h_not)]

  have h_lt_of_log_lt : ∀ {a b : ℝ}, 0 < a → 0 < b → Real.log a < Real.log b → a < b := by
    intro a b ha hb hlog
    by_contra h_not
    linarith [Real.log_le_log hb (le_of_not_gt h_not)]

  let Spos : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ}, (Fin N_ω → ℝ) → Finset (Fin N_ω) :=
    fun Q => Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)

  have h_zero_of_not_mem : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → ∀ ω, ω ∉ Spos Q → Q ω = 0 := by
    intro N_ω Q hQ_nn ω hω
    have hnot : ¬ 0 < Q ω := fun hpos => hω (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hpos⟩)
    exact le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hnot) (hQ_nn ω)

  have h_ite_Spos : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (P : Fin N_ω → Prop)
      {inst₁ inst₂ : DecidablePred P},
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) →
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (P ω) (inst₁ ω) (Q ω) 0) =
        ∑ ω ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_ω) P inst₂ (Spos Q), Q ω := by
    intro N_ω Q P inst₁ inst₂ hQ_nn
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    have h_sub : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (P ω) (inst₁ ω) (Q ω) 0) =
        ∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, @ite ℝ (P ω) (inst₁ ω) (Q ω) 0 := by
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ (Spos Q)) ?_).symm
      intro ω _ hnot
      have h0 : Q ω = 0 := h_zero_of_not_mem Q hQ_nn ω hnot
      by_cases hP : P ω <;> simp [hP, h0]
    rw [h_sub]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hP : P ω <;> simp [hP]

  have h_prob1_eq : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α : Type} (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (Z : Fin N_ω → α) (ω : Fin N_ω)
      [DecidablePred (fun ω' => Z ω' = Z ω)],
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ Q ω') →
      finProbAt Q Z ω = ∑ ω' ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω' => Z ω' = Z ω), Q ω' := by
    intro N_ω α Q Z ω _ hQ_nn
    unfold finProbAt
    exact h_ite_Spos Q (fun ω' => Z ω' = Z ω) hQ_nn

  have h_prob2_eq : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (Z : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω)
      [DecidablePred (fun ω' => Z ω' = Z ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω)],
      (∀ ω', 0 ≤ Q ω') →
      finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω =
        ∑ ω' ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω' => Z ω' = Z ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω), Q ω' := by
    intro N_ω α β Q Z Y ω _ hQ_nn
    unfold finProbAt2
    exact h_ite_Spos Q (fun ω' => Z ω' = Z ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω) hQ_nn

  have h_sum_Spos_mul : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (Q f : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) →
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω * f ω) = ∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω * f ω := by
    intro N_ω Q f hQ_nn
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ (Spos Q)) ?_).symm
    intro ω _ hnot
    rw [h_zero_of_not_mem Q hQ_nn ω hnot, zero_mul]

  have h_sum_Spos : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω) = ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω := by
    intro N_ω Q hQ_nn
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ (Spos Q)) ?_
    intro ω _ hnot
    exact h_zero_of_not_mem Q hQ_nn ω hnot

  have h_sum_event_Spos : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (G : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) →
      (∑ ω ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => ω ∈ G), Q ω) = ∑ ω ∈ G, Q ω := by
    intro N_ω Q G hQ_nn
    refine Finset.sum_subset (fun ω hω => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2) ?_
    intro ω hωG hnot
    have hnot_pos : ω ∉ Spos Q := fun hpos => hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpos, hωG⟩)
    exact h_zero_of_not_mem Q hQ_nn ω hnot_pos

  have h_sum_compl_Spos : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (G : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∑ ω ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => ω ∉ G), Q ω) = 1 - ∑ ω ∈ G, Q ω := by
    intro N_ω Q G hQ_nn hQ_sum
    have h1 := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Spos Q) (fun ω => ω ∈ G) Q
    rw [h_sum_event_Spos Q G hQ_nn, h_sum_Spos Q hQ_nn, hQ_sum] at h1
    linarith

  have h_filter_or_le : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin N_ω))
      (P P₁ P₂ : Fin N_ω → Prop),
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∀ ω ∈ S, P ω → P₁ ω ∨ P₂ ω) →
      (∑ ω ∈ S.filter P, Q ω) ≤
        (∑ ω ∈ S.filter P₁, Q ω) + (∑ ω ∈ S.filter P₂, Q ω) := by
    intro N_ω Q S P P₁ P₂ hQ_nn himp
    rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => ?_)
    by_cases hP : P ω
    · rcases himp ω hω hP with h1 | h2
      · by_cases h2' : P₂ ω <;> simp [hP, h1, h2', hQ_nn ω]
      · by_cases h1' : P₁ ω <;> simp [hP, h1', h2, hQ_nn ω]
    · by_cases h1 : P₁ ω <;> by_cases h2 : P₂ ω <;> simp [hP, h1, h2, hQ_nn ω]

  have h_prob_bds : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (Z : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω', 0 ≤ Q ω') → ω ∈ Spos Q →
      Q ω ≤ finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω ∧
      0 < finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω ∧
      finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω ≤ finProbAt Q Z ω ∧
      0 < finProbAt Q Z ω ∧
      0 ≤ condSurprise ε Q Z Y ω := by
    intro N_ω α β ε Q Z Y ω hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω
    have hQ_pos : 0 < Q ω := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2
    have h_le2 : Q ω ≤ finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω := by
      rw [h_prob2_eq Q Z Y ω hQ_nn]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun ω' _ => hQ_nn ω')
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω, rfl, rfl⟩)
    have h_pos2 : 0 < finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω := lt_of_lt_of_le hQ_pos h_le2
    have h_2le1 : finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω ≤ finProbAt Q Z ω := by
      rw [h_prob2_eq Q Z Y ω hQ_nn, h_prob1_eq Q Z ω hQ_nn]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun ω' _ _ => hQ_nn ω')
      intro ω' hω'
      rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω' with ⟨hs, hZ, _⟩
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hs, hZ⟩
    have h_pos1 : 0 < finProbAt Q Z ω := lt_of_lt_of_le h_pos2 h_2le1
    have h_rat_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω / finProbAt Q Z ω := div_pos h_pos2 h_pos1
    have h_rat_le1 : finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω / finProbAt Q Z ω ≤ 1 :=
      (div_le_one h_pos1).mpr h_2le1
    have h_log_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω / finProbAt Q Z ω) ≤ 0 :=
      Real.log_nonpos h_rat_pos.le h_rat_le1
    have h_surp_nn : 0 ≤ condSurprise ε Q Z Y ω := by
      unfold condSurprise
      exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr h_log_np) (h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁).le
    exact ⟨h_le2, h_pos2, h_2le1, h_pos1, h_surp_nn⟩

  have h_ent_nn : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (Z : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → 0 ≤ finCondEntropy ε Q Z Y := by
    intro N_ω α β ε Q Z Y hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [h_sum_Spos_mul Q _ hQ_nn]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω hω =>
      mul_nonneg (hQ_nn ω) (h_prob_bds ε Q Z Y ω hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω).2.2.2.2)

  have h_dbl_fiber : ∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_Z β_Y : Type}
      (S S_sub : Finset (Fin N_ω)) (Z : Fin N_ω → α_Z) (Y : Fin N_ω → β_Y)
      (F : α_Z → Finset β_Y) (m_base : α_Z → ℝ) (g : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (M_cap c : ℝ),
      S_sub ⊆ S →
      0 ≤ c →
      (∀ z ∈ S.image Z, 0 ≤ m_base z) →
      (∀ ω ∈ S_sub, Y ω ∈ F (Z ω)) →
      (∀ z ∈ S.image Z, ((F z).card : ℝ) ≤ M_cap) →
      (∀ z ∈ S.image Z, ∀ y ∈ F z,
        (∑ ω ∈ S_sub.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z ∧ Y ω = y), g ω) ≤ c * m_base z) →
      (∑ ω ∈ S_sub, g ω) ≤ M_cap * c * (∑ z ∈ S.image Z, m_base z) := by
    intro N_ω α_Z β_Y S S_sub Z Y F m_base g M_cap c h_sub hc_nn hm_nn h_maps h_card h_cell
    have h_outer : (∑ ω ∈ S_sub, g ω) =
        ∑ z ∈ S.image Z, ∑ ω ∈ S_sub.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z), g ω :=
      (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z (h_sub hω)) g).symm
    rw [h_outer]
    calc ∑ z ∈ S.image Z, ∑ ω ∈ S_sub.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z), g ω
        ≤ ∑ z ∈ S.image Z, (M_cap * c) * m_base z := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z hz => ?_)
          have h_inner : (∑ ω ∈ S_sub.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z), g ω) =
              ∑ y ∈ F z, ∑ ω ∈ (S_sub.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z)).filter (fun ω => Y ω = y), g ω :=
            (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
              (fun ω hω => by
                rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hω_sub, hZz⟩
                rw [← hZz]
                exact h_maps ω hω_sub) g).symm
          rw [h_inner]
          calc ∑ y ∈ F z, ∑ ω ∈ (S_sub.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z)).filter (fun ω => Y ω = y), g ω
              ≤ ∑ _y ∈ F z, (c * m_base z) := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y hy => ?_)
                rw [Finset.filter_filter]
                exact h_cell z hz y hy
            _ = ((F z).card : ℝ) * (c * m_base z) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
            _ ≤ M_cap * (c * m_base z) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_card z hz) (mul_nonneg hc_nn (hm_nn z hz))
            _ = (M_cap * c) * m_base z := by ring
      _ = M_cap * c * ∑ z ∈ S.image Z, m_base z := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro N_ω α_T β₁ β₂ ε N₁₂ N₂₁ Q T Y₁ Y₂ F₁₂ F₂₁ hε₀ hε₁ hN₁₂ hN₂₁ hQ_nn hQ_sum h_fib
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos ε hε₀ hε₁
    let M_cap : ℝ := max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)
    have hN12_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N₁₂ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN₁₂
    have hM_ge1 : 1 ≤ M_cap := le_trans hN12_ge1 (le_max_left _ _)
    have hM_pos : 0 < M_cap := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM_ge1
    have hQ_Spos_sum : ∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω = 1 := by
      rw [h_sum_Spos Q hQ_nn, hQ_sum]

    have h_one_dir : ∀ {α_Z β_Y : Type} (Z : Fin N_ω → α_Z) (Y : Fin N_ω → β_Y)
        (F : α_Z → Finset β_Y),
        (∀ ω ∈ Spos Q, Y ω ∈ F (Z ω) ∧ ((F (Z ω)).card : ℝ) ≤ M_cap) →
        finCondEntropy ε Q Z Y ≤ Real.log M_cap / ell ∧
        (∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
          let err := Real.log M_cap / ell + τ
          (∑ ω ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => err < condSurprise ε Q Z Y ω), Q ω) ≤ ε ^ τ) := by
      intro α_Z β_Y Z Y F hF
      let m_Z : α_Z → ℝ := fun z => ∑ ω ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => Z ω = z), Q ω
      have hm_Z_nn : ∀ z ∈ (Spos Q).image Z, 0 ≤ m_Z z :=

      have hF_card_img : ∀ z ∈ (Spos Q).image Z, ((F z).card : ℝ) ≤ M_cap := by
        intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨ω_z, hω_z, rfl⟩

      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have h_ratio_sum :
            (∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω * (finProbAt Q Z ω / finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω)) ≤ M_cap := by
