            (fun ω => Q ω * (finProbAt Q Z ω / finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω)) M_cap 1
            (Finset.Subset.refl _) zero_le_one hm_Z_nn (fun ω hω => (hF ω hω).1) hF_card_img
            (fun z hz y _ => by
              let Cell := (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => Z ω = z ∧ Y ω = y)
              change (∑ ω ∈ Cell, Q ω * (finProbAt Q Z ω / finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω)) ≤ 1 * m_Z z
              by_cases hne : Cell.Nonempty
              · rcases hne with ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩
                rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀ with ⟨hω₀_pos, hZ0, hY0⟩
                have hp2_0 : finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω₀ = ∑ ω' ∈ Cell, Q ω' := by
                  rw [h_prob2_eq Q Z Y ω₀ hQ_nn]
                  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
                  ext ω'
                  simp only [Cell, Finset.mem_filter, hZ0, hY0]
                have hp2_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω₀ :=
                  (h_prob_bds ε Q Z Y ω₀ hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω₀_pos).2.1
                have h_cell_eq : (∑ ω ∈ Cell, Q ω * (finProbAt Q Z ω / finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω)) =
                    (∑ ω ∈ Cell, Q ω) * (m_Z z / finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω₀) := by
                  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
                  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω hω => ?_)
                  rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨_, hZw, hYw⟩
                  have hp1 : finProbAt Q Z ω = m_Z z := by
                    rw [h_prob1_eq Q Z ω hQ_nn]
                    simp only [m_Z, hZw]
                  have hp2 : finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω = finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω₀ := by
                    rw [h_prob2_eq Q Z Y ω hQ_nn, h_prob2_eq Q Z Y ω₀ hQ_nn]
                    simp only [hZw, hYw, hZ0, hY0]
                  rw [hp1, hp2]
                rw [h_cell_eq, ← hp2_0, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp2_pos.ne', one_mul]
              · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty, one_mul]
                exact hm_Z_nn z hz)
          rw [hm_Z_sum, mul_one, mul_one] at hb
          exact hb
        have h_ptwise : ∀ ω ∈ Spos Q,
            Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω / finProbAt Q Z ω)) ≤
              Q ω * Real.log M_cap +
                M_cap⁻¹ * (Q ω * (finProbAt Q Z ω / finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω)) - Q ω := by
          intro ω hω
          have hbds := h_prob_bds ε Q Z Y ω hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω
          have hp2 : 0 < finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω := hbds.2.1
          have hp1 : 0 < finProbAt Q Z ω := hbds.2.2.2.1
          have hu_pos : 0 < finProbAt Q Z ω / (M_cap * finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω) :=
            div_pos hp1 (mul_pos hM_pos hp2)
          have h_gibbs := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu_pos

            rw [Real.log_div hp1.ne' (mul_pos hM_pos hp2).ne',

            have h_eq : finProbAt Q Z ω / (M_cap * finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω) =

            linarith
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ineq (hQ_nn ω)
          linarith
        have h_sum_nlog :
            (∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω / finProbAt Q Z ω))) ≤

          have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum h_ptwise
          simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
            ← Finset.mul_sum] at hs
          rw [hQ_Spos_sum, one_mul] at hs
          have h_sc : M_cap⁻¹ *

            calc M_cap⁻¹ * (∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω * (finProbAt Q Z ω / finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω))

              _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hM_pos.ne'
          linarith
        unfold finCondEntropy condSurprise
        rw [h_sum_Spos_mul Q _ hQ_nn]
        have h_pull :
            (∑ ω ∈ Spos Q,
              Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω / finProbAt Q Z ω) / ell)) =
            (∑ ω ∈ Spos Q,
              Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω / finProbAt Q Z ω))) / ell := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
          ring
        change (∑ ω ∈ Spos Q,
            Q ω * (-Real.log (finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω / finProbAt Q Z ω) / ell)) ≤

        rw [h_pull]

      · intro τ hτ err
        let S_tail := (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => err < condSurprise ε Q Z Y ω)

        have hb := h_dbl_fiber (Spos Q) S_tail Z Y F m_Z Q M_cap (ε ^ τ / M_cap)
          (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hc_pos.le hm_Z_nn
          (fun ω hω => (hF ω (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1).1) hF_card_img
          (fun z hz y _ => by
            let Cell_sub := S_tail.filter (fun ω => Z ω = z ∧ Y ω = y)

            by_cases hne : Cell_sub.Nonempty
            · rcases hne with ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩
              rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀ with ⟨hω₀_tail, hZ0, hY0⟩
              rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_tail with ⟨hω₀_pos, herr_lt⟩
              have hbds := h_prob_bds ε Q Z Y ω₀ hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω₀_pos
              have hp2 : 0 < finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω₀ := hbds.2.1
              have hp1 : 0 < finProbAt Q Z ω₀ := hbds.2.2.2.1
              let p := finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω₀ / finProbAt Q Z ω₀
              have hp_pos : 0 < p := div_pos hp2 hp1
              have herr_unfold : Real.log M_cap / ell + τ < -Real.log p / ell := herr_lt
              have h_mul_ell : (Real.log M_cap / ell + τ) * ell < -Real.log p :=
                (lt_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mp herr_unfold
              have h_lhs_simp : (Real.log M_cap / ell + τ) * ell =
                  Real.log M_cap + τ * ell := by

              have h_log_rhs : Real.log (ε ^ τ / M_cap) = -(τ * ell) - Real.log M_cap := by
                rw [Real.log_div (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ τ).ne' hM_pos.ne',
                  h_log_rpow ε τ hε₀]
              have h_log_lt : Real.log p < Real.log (ε ^ τ / M_cap) := by
                linarith
              have hp_le : p ≤ ε ^ τ / M_cap :=
                (h_lt_of_log_lt hp_pos hc_pos h_log_lt).le
              have hp2_le : finProbAt2 Q Z Y ω₀ ≤ (ε ^ τ / M_cap) * m_Z z := by

    let Z₁ : Fin N_ω → α_T × β₁ := fun ω => (T ω, Y₁ ω)

    have h_bayes : ∀ ω ∈ Spos Q,

      intro ω hω

      have hpTY1 : 0 < finProbAt2 Q T Y₁ ω := (h_prob_bds ε Q T Y₁ ω hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω).2.1
      have hpTY2 : 0 < finProbAt2 Q T Y₂ ω := (h_prob_bds ε Q T Y₂ ω hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω).2.1
      have hpZ12 : 0 < finProbAt2 Q Z₁ Y₂ ω := (h_prob_bds ε Q Z₁ Y₂ ω hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω).2.1
      have hZ1_eq : finProbAt Q Z₁ ω = finProbAt2 Q T Y₁ ω := by

        refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)

      rw [hZ1_eq, hZ2_eq, hZ12_eq,

        Real.log_div hpTY1.ne' hpT.ne',
        Real.log_div hpZ12.ne' hpTY1.ne',
        Real.log_div hpZ12.ne' hpTY2.ne']

    · have h_ent_diff :

    · intro τ hτ

        (fun ω => err < |condSurprise ε Q T Y₂ ω - condSurprise ε Q T Y₁ ω|)

        (fun ω => err < condSurprise ε Q Z₂ Y₁ ω) hQ_nn
        (fun ω hω herr => by

  · 
    intro N_ω α_X α_Y ε A C_alph H α ζ Q X Y F_supp G

    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)

    have hQ_Spos_sum : ∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω = 1 := by

    have h_sqrt_log : ∀ {p : ℝ}, 0 < p → p * (-Real.log p) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt p := by
      intro p hp
      let r := Real.sqrt p
      have hr_pos : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp
      have hrr : r * r = p := Real.mul_self_sqrt hp.le
      have h_inv_log : Real.log (r⁻¹) ≤ r⁻¹ := by
        linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr_pos)]

        have h1 : Real.log p = 2 * Real.log r := by

        have h2 : Real.log (r⁻¹) = -Real.log r := Real.log_inv r
        linarith

          ≤ p * (2 * r⁻¹) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_nlog hp.le
        _ = (r * r) * (2 * r⁻¹) := by rw [hrr]
        _ = 2 * r := by
            field_simp [hr_pos.ne']

    let s : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω => condSurprise ε Q X Y ω
    have h_ent_sub : |finCondEntropy ε Q X Y - H| ≤ ∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω * |s ω - H| := by

      refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) ?_
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hQ_nn ω)]

    have h_on_SB : ∑ ω ∈ S_B, Q ω * |s ω - H| ≤ ζ * H + ∑ ω ∈ S_B, Q ω * s ω := by
      calc ∑ ω ∈ S_B, Q ω * |s ω - H|

    let B_mid := S_B.filter (fun ω => s ω ≤ 2 * A + 2)

    have h_split_B :

      (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S_B (fun ω => s ω ≤ 2 * A + 2) _).symm

      calc ∑ ω ∈ B_mid, Q ω * s ω

            refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => ?_)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2 (hQ_nn ω)
        _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_B, Q ω * (2 * A + 2) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _) ?_
            intro ω _ _

        _ = (∑ ω ∈ S_B, Q ω) * (2 * A + 2) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ ζ * (2 * A + 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hSB_le_zeta (by linarith)

    have h_Bhi_le_Thi : ∑ ω ∈ B_hi, Q ω * s ω ≤ ∑ ω ∈ T_hi, Q ω * s ω := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
      · intro ω hω

        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hωB).1, not_le.mp hnot_le⟩

      change (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          @ite ℝ (err < |s_Q ω - H|) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω) 0) ≤
        ζ / c_ret + 2 * η
      rw [h_ite_Spos Q (fun ω => err < |s_Q ω - H|) hQ_nn]

      let S_bad_all := (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => err < |s_Q ω - H|)
      change (∑ ω ∈ S_bad_all, Q ω) ≤ ζ / c_ret + 2 * η
      have h_split_conc :
          (∑ ω ∈ S_bad_all, Q ω) =
            (∑ ω ∈ S_bad_all.filter (fun ω => ω ∈ E_conc), Q ω) +
              (∑ ω ∈ S_bad_all.filter (fun ω => ω ∉ E_conc), Q ω) :=
        (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S_bad_all (fun ω => ω ∈ E_conc) Q).symm
      rw [h_split_conc]

      
      have h_outside_le : ∑ ω ∈ S_bad_all.filter (fun ω => ω ∉ E_conc), Q ω ≤ ζ / c_ret := by
        calc ∑ ω ∈ S_bad_all.filter (fun ω => ω ∉ E_conc), Q ω
            ≤ ∑ ω ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => ω ∉ E_conc), Q ω := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun ω _ _ => hQ_nn ω)
              intro ω hω
              rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hb, hnot⟩
              exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).1, hnot⟩
          _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => ω ∉ E_conc), c_ret⁻¹ * π ω :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => hQ_le_pi ω)
          _ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ (Spos π).filter (fun ω => ω ∉ E_conc), c_ret⁻¹ * π ω := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_
                (fun ω _ _ => mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hc_ret.le) (hπ_nn ω))
              intro ω hω
              rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hQ, hnot⟩
              exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hSQ_sub_Spi hQ, hnot⟩
          _ = c_ret⁻¹ * ∑ ω ∈ (Spos π).filter (fun ω => ω ∉ E_conc), π ω :=
              (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
          _ ≤ c_ret⁻¹ * ζ := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (inv_nonneg.mpr hc_ret.le)
              rw [h_sum_compl_Spos π E_conc hπ_nn hπ_sum]
              linarith
          _ = ζ / c_ret := by ring

      
      let E₁ := (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => ω ∈ E_conc)
      have h_split_conc' :
          (∑ ω ∈ S_bad_all.filter (fun ω => ω ∈ E_conc), Q ω) =
            ∑ ω ∈ E₁.filter (fun ω => err < |s_Q ω - H|), Q ω := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
        ext ω
        simp only [S_bad_all, E₁, Finset.mem_filter]
        tauto
      rw [h_split_conc']

      have h_pi_exp_bds : ∀ ω ∈ E₁,
          ε ^ (H + α) ≤ finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω ∧
          finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω ≤ ε ^ (H - α) := by
        intro ω hω
        rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hω_Q, hω_conc⟩
        have hω_pi : ω ∈ Spos π := hSQ_sub_Spi hω_Q
        have hbpi := h_prob_bds ε π X Y ω hε₀ hε₁ hπ_nn hω_pi
        let p_pi := finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω
        have hp_pi_pos : 0 < p_pi := div_pos hbpi.2.1 hbpi.2.2.2.1
        have hsurp := abs_le.mp (hE_conc_surp ω hω_conc (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_pi).2)
        dsimp only [condSurprise, p_pi, ell] at hsurp ⊢
        have h1 : H - α ≤ -Real.log p_pi / ell := by linarith [hsurp.1]
        have h2 : -Real.log p_pi / ell ≤ H + α := by linarith [hsurp.2]
        have h1' : (H - α) * ell ≤ -Real.log p_pi := (le_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mp h1
        have h2' : -Real.log p_pi ≤ (H + α) * ell := (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mp h2
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · refine h_le_of_log_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hp_pi_pos ?_
          rw [h_log_rpow ε (H + α) hε₀]
          linarith
        · refine h_le_of_log_le hp_pi_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) ?_
          rw [h_log_rpow ε (H - α) hε₀]
          linarith

      have h_split_tails := h_filter_or_le Q E₁
        (fun ω => err < |s_Q ω - H|)
        (fun ω => s_Q ω - H < -err)
        (fun ω => err < s_Q ω - H) hQ_nn
        (fun ω _ herr => by
          rcases lt_abs.mp herr with h1 | h2
          · exact Or.inr h1
          · exact Or.inl (by linarith))

      
      have h_low_le : ∑ ω ∈ E₁.filter (fun ω => s_Q ω - H < -err), Q ω ≤ η := by
        let S_bad_par := (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => finProbAt Q X ω < η * finProbAt π X ω)
        have h_sub_par : E₁.filter (fun ω => s_Q ω - H < -err) ⊆ S_bad_par := by
          intro ω hω
          rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hω_E1, hlow⟩
          have hω_Q : ω ∈ Spos Q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_E1).1
          have hbQ := h_prob_bds ε Q X Y ω hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω_Q
          have hbpi := h_prob_bds ε π X Y ω hε₀ hε₁ hπ_nn (hSQ_sub_Spi hω_Q)
          let p_Qw := finProbAt2 Q X Y ω / finProbAt Q X ω
          have hp_Qw_pos : 0 < p_Qw := div_pos hbQ.2.1 hbQ.2.2.2.1
          have h_pi_up : finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ ε ^ (H - α) * finProbAt π X ω :=
            (div_le_iff₀ hbpi.2.2.2.1).mp (h_pi_exp_bds ω hω_E1).2
          have hlow' : -Real.log p_Qw / ell < H - α - Real.log (κ⁻¹) / ell := by
            rw [herr_eq] at hlow
            dsimp only [s_Q, condSurprise, p_Qw] at hlow ⊢
            linarith
          have hlow_mul : -Real.log p_Qw < (H - α - Real.log (κ⁻¹) / ell) * ell :=
            (div_lt_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hlow'
          have h_rhs_simp : (H - α - Real.log (κ⁻¹) / ell) * ell =
              (H - α) * ell - Real.log (κ⁻¹) := by
            field_simp [hell_pos.ne']
          have h_log_gt : Real.log (κ⁻¹ * ε ^ (H - α)) < Real.log p_Qw := by
            rw [Real.log_mul (inv_pos.mpr hκ_pos).ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne',
              h_log_rpow ε (H - α) hε₀]
            linarith
          have hp_Q_gt : κ⁻¹ * ε ^ (H - α) < p_Qw :=
            h_lt_of_log_lt
              (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hκ_pos) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _))
              hp_Qw_pos h_log_gt
          refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hω_Q, ?_⟩
          by_contra h_ge
          rw [not_lt] at h_ge
          have hp2_Q_le : finProbAt2 Q X Y ω ≤ (κ⁻¹ * ε ^ (H - α)) * finProbAt Q X ω := by
            calc finProbAt2 Q X Y ω
                ≤ c_ret⁻¹ * finProbAt2 π X Y ω := h_prob2_Q_le ω
              _ ≤ c_ret⁻¹ * (ε ^ (H - α) * finProbAt π X ω) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pi_up (inv_nonneg.mpr hc_ret.le)
              _ = (κ⁻¹ * ε ^ (H - α)) * (η * finProbAt π X ω) := by
                  dsimp [κ]
                  field_simp [hc_ret.ne', hη₀.ne']
              _ ≤ (κ⁻¹ * ε ^ (H - α)) * finProbAt Q X ω :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ge
                    (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hκ_pos.le) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _))
          have hp_Q_le : p_Qw ≤ κ⁻¹ * ε ^ (H - α) :=
            (div_le_iff₀ hbQ.2.2.2.1).mpr hp2_Q_le
          linarith
        calc ∑ ω ∈ E₁.filter (fun ω => s_Q ω - H < -err), Q ω
            ≤ ∑ ω ∈ S_bad_par, Q ω :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub_par (fun ω _ _ => hQ_nn ω)
          _ = ∑ x ∈ (Spos Q).image X, ∑ ω ∈ S_bad_par.filter (fun ω => X ω = x), Q ω :=
              (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
                (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1) Q).symm
          _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ (Spos Q).image X,
                η * ∑ ω ∈ (Spos π).filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => ?_)
              let Cell_x := S_bad_par.filter (fun ω => X ω = x)
              change (∑ ω ∈ Cell_x, Q ω) ≤ η * ∑ ω ∈ (Spos π).filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω
              by_cases hne : Cell_x.Nonempty
              · rcases hne with ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩
                rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀ with ⟨hω₀_bp, hX0⟩
                have hlt_par : finProbAt Q X ω₀ < η * finProbAt π X ω₀ :=
                  (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_bp).2
                have h_sub_x : ∑ ω ∈ Cell_x, Q ω ≤ finProbAt Q X ω₀ := by
                  rw [h_prob1_eq Q X ω₀ hQ_nn]
                  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun ω _ _ => hQ_nn ω)
                  intro ω hω
                  rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hbp, hXw⟩
                  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
                    ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hbp).1, hXw.trans hX0.symm⟩
                have hp_pi_eq : finProbAt π X ω₀ =
                    ∑ ω ∈ (Spos π).filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω := by
                  rw [h_prob1_eq π X ω₀ hπ_nn]
                  simp only [hX0]
                rw [hp_pi_eq] at hlt_par
                linarith
              · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
                exact mul_nonneg hη₀.le (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hπ_nn ω))
          _ = η * ∑ x ∈ (Spos Q).image X, ∑ ω ∈ (Spos π).filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω :=
              (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
          _ ≤ η * ∑ x ∈ (Spos π).image X, ∑ ω ∈ (Spos π).filter (fun ω => X ω = x), π ω := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hη₀.le
              exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
                (Finset.image_subset_image hSQ_sub_Spi)
                (fun _ _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hπ_nn ω))
          _ = η * ∑ ω ∈ Spos π, π ω := by
              rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
                (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω) π]
          _ = η := by rw [hpi_Spos_sum, mul_one]

      
      have h_hi_le : ∑ ω ∈ E₁.filter (fun ω => err < s_Q ω - H), Q ω ≤ η := by
        let E_hi := E₁.filter (fun ω => err < s_Q ω - H)
        let F_ret : α_X → Finset α_Y := fun x => (E₁.filter (fun ω => X ω = x)).image Y
        let m_QX : α_X → ℝ := fun x => ∑ ω ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => X ω = x), Q ω
        have hm_QX_nn : ∀ x ∈ E₁.image X, 0 ≤ m_QX x :=
          fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hQ_nn ω)
        have hF_ret_card : ∀ x ∈ E₁.image X, ((F_ret x).card : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-(H + α)) := by
          intro x hx
          rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨ω_x, hω_x, hXx⟩
          have hω_x_pi : ω_x ∈ Spos π := hSQ_sub_Spi (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_x).1
          let S_πx := (Spos π).filter (fun ω => X ω = x)
          let p_X := ∑ ω ∈ S_πx, π ω
          have hp_X_eq : finProbAt π X ω_x = p_X := by
            rw [h_prob1_eq π X ω_x hπ_nn]
            simp only [S_πx, p_X, hXx]
          have hp_X_pos : 0 < p_X := by
            rw [← hp_X_eq]
            exact (h_prob_bds ε π X Y ω_x hε₀ hε₁ hπ_nn hω_x_pi).2.2.2.1
          have h_each_y : ∀ y ∈ F_ret x,
              ε ^ (H + α) * p_X ≤ ∑ ω' ∈ S_πx.filter (fun ω' => Y ω' = y), π ω' := by
            intro y hy
            rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hy with ⟨ω_y, hω_y_filt, hYy⟩
            rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_y_filt with ⟨hω_y_E1, hXy⟩
            have hlb := (h_pi_exp_bds ω_y hω_y_E1).1
            have hp1_eq : finProbAt π X ω_y = p_X := by
              rw [h_prob1_eq π X ω_y hπ_nn]
              simp only [S_πx, p_X, hXy]
            have hp2_eq : finProbAt2 π X Y ω_y =
                ∑ ω' ∈ S_πx.filter (fun ω' => Y ω' = y), π ω' := by
              rw [h_prob2_eq π X Y ω_y hπ_nn]
              refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
              ext ω'
              simp only [S_πx, Finset.mem_filter, hXy, hYy, and_assoc]
            rw [hp1_eq, hp2_eq] at hlb
            exact (le_div_iff₀ hp_X_pos).mp hlb
          have h_sum_y : ((F_ret x).card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (H + α) * p_X) ≤ p_X := by
            calc ((F_ret x).card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (H + α) * p_X)
                = ∑ _y ∈ F_ret x, (ε ^ (H + α) * p_X) := by
                  rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
              _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ F_ret x, ∑ ω' ∈ S_πx.filter (fun ω' => Y ω' = y), π ω' :=
                  Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_y
              _ ≤ p_X := by
                  let A_x := S_πx.filter (fun ω' => Y ω' ∈ F_ret x)
                  have h_fib_A :
                      (∑ y ∈ F_ret x, ∑ ω' ∈ A_x.filter (fun ω' => Y ω' = y), π ω') =
                        ∑ ω' ∈ A_x, π ω' :=
                    Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
                      (fun ω' hω' => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω').2) π
                  have h_congr :
                      (∑ y ∈ F_ret x, ∑ ω' ∈ S_πx.filter (fun ω' => Y ω' = y), π ω') =
                        ∑ y ∈ F_ret x, ∑ ω' ∈ A_x.filter (fun ω' => Y ω' = y), π ω' := by
                    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y hy => Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl))
                    ext ω'
                    simp only [A_x, Finset.mem_filter]
                    exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨⟨h1, h2 ▸ hy⟩, h2⟩, fun ⟨⟨h1, _⟩, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
                  rw [h_congr, h_fib_A]
                  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
                    (fun ω' _ _ => hπ_nn ω')
          have h_den_pos : 0 < ε ^ (H + α) * p_X :=
            mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _) hp_X_pos
          have h_div : ((F_ret x).card : ℝ) ≤ p_X / (ε ^ (H + α) * p_X) :=
            (le_div_iff₀ h_den_pos).mpr h_sum_y
          have h_simp : p_X / (ε ^ (H + α) * p_X) = ε ^ (-(H + α)) := by
            rw [Real.rpow_neg hε₀.le]
            field_simp [hp_X_pos.ne', (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (H + α)).ne']
          rwa [h_simp] at h_div

        have hc_pos : 0 < η * ε ^ (H + α) := mul_pos hη₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _)
        have hb := h_dbl_fiber E₁ E_hi X Y F_ret m_QX Q
          (ε ^ (-(H + α))) (η * ε ^ (H + α))
          (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hc_pos.le hm_QX_nn
          (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Y
            (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1, rfl⟩))
          hF_ret_card
          (fun x hx y _ => by
            let Cell_hi := E_hi.filter (fun ω => X ω = x ∧ Y ω = y)
            change (∑ ω ∈ Cell_hi, Q ω) ≤ (η * ε ^ (H + α)) * m_QX x
            by_cases hne : Cell_hi.Nonempty
            · rcases hne with ⟨ω₀, hω₀⟩
              rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀ with ⟨hω₀_hi, hX0, hY0⟩
              rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_hi with ⟨hω₀_E1, hhi⟩
              have hω₀_Q : ω₀ ∈ Spos Q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_E1).1
              have hbQ := h_prob_bds ε Q X Y ω₀ hε₀ hε₁ hQ_nn hω₀_Q
              let p_Q0 := finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀ / finProbAt Q X ω₀
              have hp_Q0_pos : 0 < p_Q0 := div_pos hbQ.2.1 hbQ.2.2.2.1
              have hhi' : H + α + Real.log (κ⁻¹) / ell < -Real.log p_Q0 / ell := by
                rw [herr_eq] at hhi
                dsimp only [s_Q, condSurprise, p_Q0] at hhi ⊢
                linarith
              have hhi_mul : (H + α + Real.log (κ⁻¹) / ell) * ell < -Real.log p_Q0 :=
                (lt_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hhi'
              have h_lhs_simp : (H + α + Real.log (κ⁻¹) / ell) * ell =
                  (H + α) * ell + Real.log (κ⁻¹) := by
                field_simp [hell_pos.ne']
              have h_log_lt : Real.log p_Q0 < Real.log (η * ε ^ (H + α)) := by
                rw [Real.log_mul hη₀.ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne',
                  h_log_rpow ε (H + α) hε₀]
                have h_inv_eta : Real.log (η⁻¹) = -Real.log η := Real.log_inv η
                linarith
              have hp_Q0_le : p_Q0 ≤ η * ε ^ (H + α) :=
                (h_lt_of_log_lt hp_Q0_pos hc_pos h_log_lt).le
              have hp1_eq : finProbAt Q X ω₀ = m_QX x := by
                rw [h_prob1_eq Q X ω₀ hQ_nn]
                simp only [m_QX, hX0]
              have hp2_le : finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀ ≤ (η * ε ^ (H + α)) * m_QX x := by
                rw [← hp1_eq]
                exact (div_le_iff₀ hbQ.2.2.2.1).mp hp_Q0_le
              have h_sub_le : ∑ ω ∈ Cell_hi, Q ω ≤ finProbAt2 Q X Y ω₀ := by
                rw [h_prob2_eq Q X Y ω₀ hQ_nn]
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun ω _ _ => hQ_nn ω)
                intro ω hω
                rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hω_ehi, hXw, hYw⟩
                have hω_Q' : ω ∈ Spos Q :=
                  (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω_ehi).1).1
                exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
                  ⟨hω_Q', hXw.trans hX0.symm, hYw.trans hY0.symm⟩
              exact le_trans h_sub_le hp2_le
            · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
              exact mul_nonneg hc_pos.le (hm_QX_nn x hx))
        have h_m_QX_le1 : ∑ x ∈ E₁.image X, m_QX x ≤ 1 := by
          calc ∑ x ∈ E₁.image X, m_QX x
              ≤ ∑ x ∈ (Spos Q).image X, m_QX x :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
                  (Finset.image_subset_image (Finset.filter_subset _ _))
                  (fun _ _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hQ_nn ω))
            _ = ∑ ω ∈ Spos Q, Q ω :=
                Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
                  (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem X hω) Q
            _ = 1 := hQ_Spos_sum
        have h_cap_prod : ε ^ (-(H + α)) * (η * ε ^ (H + α)) = η := by
          have h1 : ε ^ (-(H + α)) * ε ^ (H + α) = 1 := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
          calc ε ^ (-(H + α)) * (η * ε ^ (H + α))
              = η * (ε ^ (-(H + α)) * ε ^ (H + α)) := by ring
            _ = η := by rw [h1, mul_one]
        rw [h_cap_prod] at hb
        calc ∑ ω ∈ E_hi, Q ω
            ≤ η * ∑ x ∈ E₁.image X, m_QX x := hb
          _ ≤ η * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_m_QX_le1 hη₀.le
          _ = η := mul_one η

      linarith

  · 
    intro N_ω α_T α_E γ₁ γ₂ B Q G T E Y₁ Y₂ hB hQ_nn hQ_sum hG_bound
    let Z : Fin N_ω → α_E × γ₁ := fun ω' => (E ω', Y₁ ω')
    let Bad : Fin N_ω → Prop := fun ω => 2 * B * finProbAt Q Z ω < finProbAt2 Q Z Y₂ ω
    change (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        @ite ℝ (Bad ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω) 0) ≤
      2 * (1 - ∑ ω ∈ G, Q ω)
    rw [h_ite_Spos Q Bad hQ_nn]
    rw [← h_sum_compl_Spos Q G hQ_nn hQ_sum]

    let S_bad := (Spos Q).filter Bad
    let π_ZY₂ : Fin N_ω → (α_E × γ₁) × γ₂ := fun ω => (Z ω, Y₂ ω)
    let P_bad := S_bad.image π_ZY₂
    let S_compl := (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => ω ∉ G)

    have h_bad_fib :
        (∑ ω ∈ S_bad, Q ω) =
          ∑ p ∈ P_bad, ∑ ω ∈ S_bad.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω :=
      (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem π_ZY₂ hω) Q).symm
    change (∑ ω ∈ S_bad, Q ω) ≤ 2 * ∑ ω ∈ S_compl, Q ω
    rw [h_bad_fib]

    have h_each_p : ∀ p ∈ P_bad,
        (∑ ω ∈ S_bad.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω) ≤
          2 * ∑ ω ∈ S_compl.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω := by
      intro p hp
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hp with ⟨ω₀, hω₀_bad, rfl⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀_bad with ⟨hω₀_pos, hBad0⟩
      let F_p := (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = π_ZY₂ ω₀)
      let m_Z := finProbAt Q Z ω₀
      have hm_Z_eq : m_Z = ∑ ω ∈ (Spos Q).filter (fun ω => Z ω = Z ω₀), Q ω :=
        h_prob1_eq Q Z ω₀ hQ_nn
      have hm_Fp_eq : finProbAt2 Q Z Y₂ ω₀ = ∑ ω ∈ F_p, Q ω := by
        rw [h_prob2_eq Q Z Y₂ ω₀ hQ_nn]
        refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
        ext ω
        simp [F_p, π_ZY₂, Prod.ext_iff]
      have h_strict : 2 * B * m_Z < ∑ ω ∈ F_p, Q ω := by
        dsimp [Bad, m_Z] at hBad0
        rwa [hm_Fp_eq] at hBad0
      have h_sub_Fp : ∑ ω ∈ S_bad.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = π_ZY₂ ω₀), Q ω ≤ ∑ ω ∈ F_p, Q ω := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun ω _ _ => hQ_nn ω)
        intro ω hω
        rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hb, heq⟩
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).1, heq⟩
      have h_split_Fp :
          (∑ ω ∈ F_p, Q ω) =
            (∑ ω ∈ F_p.filter (fun ω => ω ∈ G), Q ω) +
              (∑ ω ∈ F_p.filter (fun ω => ω ∉ G), Q ω) :=
        (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not F_p (fun ω => ω ∈ G) Q).symm
      have h_Fp_G_le : ∑ ω ∈ F_p.filter (fun ω => ω ∈ G), Q ω ≤ B * m_Z := by
        let S_T := (Spos Q).image T
        have h_lhs_T :
            (∑ ω ∈ F_p.filter (fun ω => ω ∈ G), Q ω) =
              ∑ t ∈ S_T, ∑ ω ∈ (F_p.filter (fun ω => ω ∈ G)).filter (fun ω => T ω = t), Q ω :=
          (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
            (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem T
              (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1).1) Q).symm
        have h_rhs_T :
            m_Z = ∑ t ∈ S_T,
              ∑ ω ∈ ((Spos Q).filter (fun ω => Z ω = Z ω₀)).filter (fun ω => T ω = t), Q ω := by
          rw [hm_Z_eq]
          exact (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
            (fun ω hω => Finset.mem_image_of_mem T (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).1) Q).symm
        rw [h_lhs_T, h_rhs_T, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => ?_)
        let Cell_t := (F_p.filter (fun ω => ω ∈ G)).filter (fun ω => T ω = t)
        change (∑ ω ∈ Cell_t, Q ω) ≤
          B * ∑ ω ∈ ((Spos Q).filter (fun ω => Z ω = Z ω₀)).filter (fun ω => T ω = t), Q ω
        by_cases hne : Cell_t.Nonempty
        · rcases hne with ⟨ω₁, hω₁⟩
          rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₁ with ⟨hω₁_FpG, hT1⟩
          rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₁_FpG with ⟨hω₁_Fp, hω₁_G⟩
          rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₁_Fp with ⟨hω₁_pos, hZY1⟩
          obtain ⟨hZ1, hY1⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.mp hZY1
          have h_gb := hG_bound ω₁ hω₁_G (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₁_pos).2
          have h_cell_le : ∑ ω ∈ Cell_t, Q ω ≤
              finProbAt2 Q (fun ω' => (T ω', E ω', Y₁ ω')) Y₂ ω₁ := by
            rw [h_prob2_eq Q (fun ω' => (T ω', E ω', Y₁ ω')) Y₂ ω₁ hQ_nn]
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun ω _ _ => hQ_nn ω)
            intro ω hω
            rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hω with ⟨hFpG, hTw⟩
            rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hFpG).1 with ⟨hpos_w, hZYw⟩
            obtain ⟨hZw, hYw⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.mp hZYw
            refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpos_w, ?_, hYw.trans hY1.symm⟩
            exact Prod.ext (hTw.trans hT1.symm) (hZw.trans hZ1.symm)
          have h_rhs_eq : finProbAt Q (fun ω' => (T ω', E ω', Y₁ ω')) ω₁ =
              ∑ ω ∈ ((Spos Q).filter (fun ω => Z ω = Z ω₀)).filter (fun ω => T ω = t), Q ω := by
            rw [h_prob1_eq Q (fun ω' => (T ω', E ω', Y₁ ω')) ω₁ hQ_nn]
            refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
            ext ω
            simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
            change Z ω₁ = Z ω₀ at hZ1
            change (ω ∈ Spos Q ∧ (T ω, Z ω) = (T ω₁, Z ω₁)) ↔
              (ω ∈ Spos Q ∧ Z ω = Z ω₀) ∧ T ω = t
            simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, hT1, hZ1]
            tauto
          exact le_trans h_cell_le (by rwa [← h_rhs_eq])
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
          exact mul_nonneg hB (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => hQ_nn ω))
      have h_Fp_notG_eq :
          F_p.filter (fun ω => ω ∉ G) = S_compl.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = π_ZY₂ ω₀) := by
        ext ω
        simp only [F_p, S_compl, Finset.mem_filter]
        tauto
      rw [h_Fp_notG_eq] at h_split_Fp
      linarith

    calc ∑ p ∈ P_bad, ∑ ω ∈ S_bad.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω
        ≤ ∑ p ∈ P_bad, 2 * ∑ ω ∈ S_compl.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_p
      _ = 2 * ∑ p ∈ P_bad, ∑ ω ∈ S_compl.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω :=
          (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ 2 * ∑ ω ∈ S_compl, Q ω := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
          let U := S_compl.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω ∈ P_bad)
          have h_fib_U :
              (∑ p ∈ P_bad, ∑ ω ∈ U.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω) = ∑ ω ∈ U, Q ω :=
            Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
              (fun ω hω => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω).2) Q
          have h_congr :
              (∑ p ∈ P_bad, ∑ ω ∈ S_compl.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω) =
                ∑ p ∈ P_bad, ∑ ω ∈ U.filter (fun ω => π_ZY₂ ω = p), Q ω := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p hp => Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl))
            ext ω
            simp only [U, Finset.mem_filter]
            exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨⟨h1, h2 ▸ hp⟩, h2⟩, fun ⟨⟨h1, _⟩, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
          rw [h_congr, h_fib_U]
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
            (fun ω _ _ => hQ_nn ω)

informal_problem.statement:
(γ m : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (sys : MatchedAspectProfileSystem γ m)
    (N_pts : ℕ) (p : Fin N_pts → (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ)
    (hp_cone : ∀ r : Fin N_pts,
      InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 (p r))
    (δ_pt : ℝ) (hδ_pt : 0 < δ_pt) :
    ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      ∃ E_pts : Finset (Fin (sys.N_ω k)),
        (∀ ω ∈ E_pts, 0 < sys.π_seq k ω) ∧
        1 - δ_pt ≤ (∑ ω ∈ E_pts, sys.π_seq k ω) ∧
        ∀ ω ∈ E_pts, ∀ r : Fin N_pts,
          let ε := sys.ε_seq k
          let O_r := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
            rowObs6 ε m (sys.V_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω')) (sys.A_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω'))
              (sys.c_seq k ω') (sys.R_seq k ω')
              ((p r).1 0, (p r).1 1, (p r).1 2, (p r).1 3, (p r).2)
          let k_c := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
            dyadicTimeBin ε (p r).2 (sys.c_seq k ω')
          let k_r := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
            dyadicRealBin ε (m * (p r).2) (sys.R_seq k ω')
          |condSurprise ε (sys.π_seq k) (fun _ => ()) O_r ω -
            (sys.f_raw (p r) + sys.S (p r).2)| ≤ δ_pt ∧
          |condSurprise ε (sys.π_seq k) (sys.T_seq k) k_c ω -
            sys.S (p r).2| ≤ δ_pt ∧
          |condSurprise ε (sys.π_seq k)
            (fun ω' => (sys.T_seq k ω', k_c ω')) k_r ω| ≤ δ_pt

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hs1_fib, hs1_ui, _, _⟩ := bounded_fiber_surprise_and_restriction_transfer
  let ell_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => Real.log ((sys.ε_seq k)⁻¹)
  have hell_pos : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < ell_fn k := by
    intro k
    have hε₀ := (sys.hε_bounds k).1
    have hε₁ := (sys.hε_bounds k).2
    have h_gt1 : 1 < (sys.ε_seq k)⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr (by linarith)
    exact Real.log_pos h_gt1
  have h_ell_inv : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (ell_fn k)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h_gt0 : Filter.Tendsto sys.ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within sys.ε_seq sys.hε_tendsto
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun k => (sys.hε_bounds k).1))
    have h_inv : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (sys.ε_seq k)⁻¹) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      h_gt0.inv_tendsto_nhdsGT_zero
    have h_log : Filter.Tendsto ell_fn Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp h_inv
    exact tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp h_log
  have h_eps_div_ell : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => sys.ε_seq k / ell_fn k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h_mul := sys.hε_tendsto.mul h_ell_inv
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h_mul
  have h_rpow_tendsto : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (sys.ε_seq k) ^ τ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hc := (Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 0 τ (Or.inr hτ.le)).tendsto.comp sys.hε_tendsto
    rwa [Real.zero_rpow hτ.ne'] at hc
  have h_log_bound : ∀ (k N₁ N₂ : ℕ) (C β : ℝ),
      1 ≤ N₂ → N₂ ≤ N₁ → 0 < C →
      (N₁ : ℝ) ≤ C * (sys.ε_seq k) ^ (-β) →
      Real.log (max (N₁ : ℝ) (N₂ : ℝ)) / ell_fn k ≤ Real.log C * (ell_fn k)⁻¹ + β := by
    intro k N₁ N₂ C β hN₂_pos hN₂₁ hC hN₁_le
    have hε₀ : 0 < sys.ε_seq k := (sys.hε_bounds k).1
    have hmax : max (N₁ : ℝ) (N₂ : ℝ) = (N₁ : ℝ) := max_eq_left (by exact_mod_cast hN₂₁)
    have hN₁_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N₁ : ℝ) := by
      have : 1 ≤ N₁ := le_trans hN₂_pos hN₂₁
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < N₁)
    have hlog_le : Real.log (N₁ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log C + β * ell_fn k := by
      calc Real.log (N₁ : ℝ)
          ≤ Real.log (C * (sys.ε_seq k) ^ (-β)) := Real.log_le_log hN₁_pos hN₁_le
        _ = Real.log C + Real.log ((sys.ε_seq k) ^ (-β)) :=
            Real.log_mul hC.ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-β)).ne'
        _ = Real.log C + (-β) * Real.log (sys.ε_seq k) := by rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀]
        _ = Real.log C + β * ell_fn k := by
            dsimp [ell_fn]
            rw [Real.log_inv]
            ring
    rw [hmax]
    have hell_k_pos : 0 < ell_fn k := hell_pos k
    have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog_le hell_k_pos.le
    have hsplit : (Real.log C + β * ell_fn k) / ell_fn k = Real.log C * (ell_fn k)⁻¹ + β := by
      rw [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ β hell_k_pos.ne', div_eq_mul_inv]
    linarith
  have h_single : ∀ (pt : (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ),
      InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 pt →
      ∀ (δ_mass : ℝ), 0 < δ_mass →
      ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        ∃ E_pt : Finset (Fin (sys.N_ω k)),
          (∀ ω ∈ E_pt, 0 < sys.π_seq k ω) ∧
          1 - δ_mass ≤ (∑ ω ∈ E_pt, sys.π_seq k ω) ∧
          ∀ ω ∈ E_pt,
            let ε := sys.ε_seq k
            let O_p := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
              rowObs6 ε m (sys.V_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω')) (sys.A_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω'))
                (sys.c_seq k ω') (sys.R_seq k ω')
                (pt.1 0, pt.1 1, pt.1 2, pt.1 3, pt.2)
            let kc_p := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
              dyadicTimeBin ε pt.2 (sys.c_seq k ω')
            let kr_p := fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
              dyadicRealBin ε (m * pt.2) (sys.R_seq k ω')
            |condSurprise ε (sys.π_seq k) (fun _ => ()) O_p ω -
              (sys.f_raw pt + sys.S pt.2)| ≤ δ_pt ∧
            |condSurprise ε (sys.π_seq k) (sys.T_seq k) kc_p ω -
              sys.S pt.2| ≤ δ_pt ∧
            |condSurprise ε (sys.π_seq k)
              (fun ω' => (sys.T_seq k ω', kc_p ω')) kr_p ω| ≤ δ_pt := by
    intro pt hp δ_mass hδ_mass
    let L : Fin 4 → ℝ := pt.1
    let v : ℝ := pt.2
    have hv₀ : 0 < v := hp.1.1
    have hv₁ : v < 1 := hp.1.2
    have hp_Lv : InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 (L, v) := hp
    let η_rat : ℝ := min (δ_pt / (4 * (2 * (5 + m) + 2))) ((1 - v) / 2)
    have hη_denom_pos : 0 < 4 * (2 * (5 + m) + 2) := by positivity
    have hη_rat : 0 < η_rat := lt_min (div_pos hδ_pt hη_denom_pos) (by linarith)
    have hη_rat_cap : (2 * (5 + m) + 2) * η_rat ≤ δ_pt / 4 := by
      have h1 : η_rat ≤ δ_pt / (4 * (2 * (5 + m) + 2)) := min_le_left _ _
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * (5 + m) + 2)
      have hne : (2 * (5 + m) + 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h_eq : (2 * (5 + m) + 2) * (δ_pt / (4 * (2 * (5 + m) + 2))) = δ_pt / 4 := by
        field_simp [hne]
      linarith
    let δ_hom : ℝ := min (δ_pt / 4) (δ_mass / 4)
    have hδ_hom : 0 < δ_hom := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hδ_hom_pt : δ_hom ≤ δ_pt / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hδ_hom_mass : δ_hom ≤ δ_mass / 4 := min_le_right _ _
    obtain ⟨q_v, hqv_gt, hqv_lt⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (by linarith : v < v + η_rat)
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀_gt, hq₀_lt⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (by linarith : L 0 < L 0 + η_rat)
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁_gt, hq₁_lt⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (by linarith : L 1 < L 1 + η_rat)
    obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂_gt, hq₂_lt⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (by linarith : L 2 < L 2 + η_rat)
    obtain ⟨q₃, hq₃_gt, hq₃_lt⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (by linarith : L 3 < L 3 + η_rat)
    have hqv_ioo : (q_v : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
      have hη_le : η_rat ≤ (1 - v) / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      linarith
    let q : ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ := (q₀, q₁, q₂, q₃, q_v)
    let q_L : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![(q₀ : ℝ), (q₁ : ℝ), (q₂ : ℝ), (q₃ : ℝ)]
    have hL_le : ∀ j : Fin 4, L j ≤ q_L j := by
      intro j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [q_L] <;> linarith
    have hqL_le : ∀ j : Fin 4, q_L j ≤ L j + η_rat := by
      intro j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [q_L] <;> linarith
    have hQ_cone : ∀ L_list ∈ ({[q]} : Finset (List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ))),
        ∀ q' ∈ L_list, (q'.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      intro L_list hL_mem q' hq'_mem
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hL_mem
      subst hL_mem
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hq'_mem
      subst hq'_mem
      exact hqv_ioo
    let O_p : ∀ k, Fin (sys.N_ω k) → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun k ω' =>
      rowObs6 (sys.ε_seq k) m (sys.V_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω')) (sys.A_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω'))
        (sys.c_seq k ω') (sys.R_seq k ω') (L 0, L 1, L 2, L 3, v)
    let kc_p : ∀ k, Fin (sys.N_ω k) → ℤ := fun k ω' =>
      dyadicTimeBin (sys.ε_seq k) v (sys.c_seq k ω')
    let kr_p : ∀ k, Fin (sys.N_ω k) → ℤ := fun k ω' =>
      dyadicRealBin (sys.ε_seq k) (m * v) (sys.R_seq k ω')
    let O_q : ∀ k, Fin (sys.N_ω k) → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun k ω' =>
      rowObs6 (sys.ε_seq k) m (sys.V_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω')) (sys.A_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω'))
        (sys.c_seq k ω') (sys.R_seq k ω') (q_L 0, q_L 1, q_L 2, q_L 3, (q_v : ℝ))
    let kc_q : ∀ k, Fin (sys.N_ω k) → ℤ := fun k ω' =>
      dyadicTimeBin (sys.ε_seq k) (q_v : ℝ) (sys.c_seq k ω')
    let kr_q : ∀ k, Fin (sys.N_ω k) → ℤ := fun k ω' =>
      dyadicRealBin (sys.ε_seq k) (m * (q_v : ℝ)) (sys.R_seq k ω')
    have h_obs_eq : ∀ k : ℕ,
        (fun ω' : Fin (sys.N_ω k) =>
          [q].map (fun q' => rowObs6 (sys.ε_seq k) m
            (sys.V_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω')) (sys.A_seq k (sys.T_seq k ω'))
            (sys.c_seq k ω') (sys.R_seq k ω')
            (q'.1, q'.2.1, q'.2.2.1, q'.2.2.2.1, q'.2.2.2.2))) =
        (fun ω' => [O_q k ω']) := by
      intro k

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_T β₁ β₂ : Type}
      (ε : ℝ) (N₁₂ N₂₁ : ℕ) (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)

      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω →
        Y₂ ω ∈ F₁₂ (T ω) (Y₁ ω) ∧ (F₁₂ (T ω) (Y₁ ω)).card ≤ N₁₂ ∧
        Y₁ ω ∈ F₂₁ (T ω) (Y₂ ω) ∧ (F₂₁ (T ω) (Y₂ ω)).card ≤ N₂₁) →
      |finCondEntropy ε Q T Y₂ - finCondEntropy ε Q T Y₁| ≤
        Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ∧
      ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let err := Real.log (max (N₁₂ : ℝ) (N₂₁ : ℝ)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) + τ

          then Q ω else 0) ≤ 2 * ε ^ τ) ∧
    (∀ {N_ω : ℕ} {α_X α_Y : Type}
      (ε A C_alph H α ζ : ℝ) (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
      (X : Fin N_ω → α_X) (Y : Fin N_ω → α_Y)
      (F_supp : α_X → Finset α_Y) (G : Finset (Fin N_ω)),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ A → 1 ≤ C_alph → 0 ≤ H → 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ ζ →
      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1) →
      (∀ ω, 0 < Q ω → Y ω ∈ F_supp (X ω) ∧ ((F_supp (X ω)).card : ℝ) ≤ C_alph * ε ^ (-A)) →
      1 - ζ ≤ (∑ ω ∈ G, Q ω) →
      (∀ ω ∈ G, 0 < Q ω → |condSurprise ε Q X Y ω - H| ≤ α) →
      |finCondEntropy ε Q X Y - H| ≤

      (ε c_ret : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (E_sub : Finset (Fin N_ω))

      (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) → (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →

      ∀ (H α ζ η : ℝ) (E_conc : Finset (Fin N_ω)),

        1 - ζ ≤ (∑ ω ∈ E_conc, π ω) →

      (T : Fin N_ω → α_T) (E : Fin N_ω → α_E)
      (Y₁ : Fin N_ω → γ₁) (Y₂ : Fin N_ω → γ₂),
      letI := Classical.propDecidable

  let iccCenter : ℝ → ℕ → Finset ℤ := fun c H => Finset.Icc (⌊c⌋ - (H : ℤ)) (⌊c⌋ + (H : ℤ))
  have h_iccCenter_card : ∀ (c : ℝ) (H : ℕ), (iccCenter c H).card = 2 * H + 1 := fun c H => by

  have h_iccCenter_mem : ∀ (x x₀ Δ : ℝ) (H : ℕ),

  have h_coarsen_mid_and_floor : ∀ (kc kf D : ℤ) (Δf Δc : ℝ),
      1 ≤ D → kc = kf / D → 0 < Δf → Δc = (D : ℝ) * Δf →
      |(((kf : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δf) - (((kc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δc)| ≤ (1 / 2) * Δc ∧
      ⌊(((kf : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δf) / Δc⌋ = kc :=
    fun kc kf D Δf Δc hD hkc hΔf hΔc => by
      have hD_pos : (0 : ℤ) < D := by omega
      have hD_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (D : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD_pos
      let r : ℤ := kf % D
      have hkf_eq : kf = D * kc + r := by
        rw [hkc]
        exact (Int.mul_ediv_add_emod kf D).symm
      have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Int.emod_nonneg kf (by omega)
      have hr1 : (r : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ) - 1 := by
        have hlt : r < D := Int.emod_lt_of_pos kf hD_pos
        have hle : r ≤ D - 1 := by omega
        exact_mod_cast hle
      have hkf_real : (kf : ℝ) = (D : ℝ) * (kc : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkf_eq
      constructor
      · rw [hΔc, hkf_real]
        have h_diff : (((D : ℝ) * (kc : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δf -
            ((kc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((D : ℝ) * Δf)) =
          ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (1 / 2) * (D : ℝ)) * Δf := by ring
        rw [h_diff, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hΔf]
        have habs : |(r : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (1 / 2) * (D : ℝ)| ≤ (1 / 2) * (D : ℝ) := by
          rw [abs_le]
          constructor <;> linarith
        calc |(r : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - (1 / 2) * (D : ℝ)| * Δf
            ≤ ((1 / 2) * (D : ℝ)) * Δf := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs hΔf.le
          _ = (1 / 2) * ((D : ℝ) * Δf) := by ring
      · have h_quot : (((kf : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δf) / Δc =
            (kc : ℝ) + ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / (D : ℝ) := by
          rw [hΔc, hkf_real]
          field_simp [hΔf.ne', hD_real_pos.ne']
          ring
        rw [h_quot]
        refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
        · have hlt : ⌊(kc : ℝ) + ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / (D : ℝ)⌋ < kc + 1 := by
            rw [Int.floor_lt]
            have h_lt1 : ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / (D : ℝ) < 1 := by
              rw [div_lt_one hD_real_pos]
              linarith
            push_cast
            linarith
          omega
        · rw [Int.le_floor]
          have h_nn : 0 ≤ ((r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / (D : ℝ) :=
            div_nonneg (by linarith) hD_real_pos.le
          linarith

    fun m₁ m₂ hm12 => by

      have hne2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero m₂ (by norm_num)

  let packObs6 : (ℤ × ℤ) → (Fin 4 → ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :=

  have h_pack_unpack : ∀ o : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
      packObs6 (o.1, o.2.1) (unpackObs6 o) = o := fun _ => rfl
  have h_obs6_box_mem : ∀ (kr : ℤ × ℤ) (I : Fin 4 → Finset ℤ) (o : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ),
      (o.1, o.2.1) = kr → (∀ j : Fin 4, unpackObs6 o j ∈ I j) →
      o ∈ (Fintype.piFinset I).image (packObs6 kr) :=
    fun kr I o hkr hmem => by
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨unpackObs6 o, Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr hmem, ?_⟩
      rw [← hkr, h_pack_unpack]

      ((Fintype.piFinset I).image (packObs6 kr)).card ≤ ∏ j : Fin 4, (I j).card :=
    fun kr I => Finset.card_image_le.trans (le_of_eq (Fintype.card_piFinset I))

  let L₀ : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![i, i + u', i + m * u', i + (1 + m) * u']
  let shearFactor : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![1, 3 / 2, 2, 3]

  have h_shear_add : ∀ (P₁ P₂ : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ab : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 4),
      canonicalShear4 (fun k => P₁ k + P₂ k) ab j =
        canonicalShear4 P₁ ab j + canonicalShear4 P₂ ab j :=
    fun P₁ P₂ ab j => by
      fin_cases j <;> simp [canonicalShear4] <;> ring

  have h_shear_sub : ∀ (P₁ P₂ : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ab : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 4),
      canonicalShear4 (fun k => P₁ k - P₂ k) ab j =
        canonicalShear4 P₁ ab j - canonicalShear4 P₂ ab j :=
    fun P₁ P₂ ab j => by

  have h_shear_inv : ∀ (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ab : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 4),

    fun P ab j => by
      fin_cases j <;> simp [canonicalShear4] <;> ring

  have h_shear_scale : ∀ (P : Fin 4 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 4),
      canonicalShear4 (fun k => ε ^ (L₀ k) * P k) (ε ^ u' * θ.1, ε ^ (m * u') * θ.2) j =
        ε ^ (L₀ j) * canonicalShear4 P θ j :=
    fun P θ j => by
      have hL1 : ε ^ (i + u') = ε ^ i * ε ^ u' := Real.rpow_add hε₀ i u'
      have hL2 : ε ^ (i + m * u') = ε ^ i * ε ^ (m * u') := Real.rpow_add hε₀ i (m * u')
      have hL3 : ε ^ (i + (1 + m) * u') = ε ^ i * ε ^ u' * ε ^ (m * u') := by
        rw [show i + (1 + m) * u' = (i + u') + m * u' by ring, Real.rpow_add hε₀, hL1]
      fin_cases j <;> simp [canonicalShear4, L₀, hL1, hL2, hL3] <;> ring

  have h_shear_bound : ∀ (E : Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (ab : ℝ × ℝ),
      0 ≤ B → (∀ k : Fin 4, |E k| ≤ B) → |ab.1| ≤ 1 / 2 → |ab.2| ≤ 1 →
      ∀ j : Fin 4, |canonicalShear4 E ab j| ≤ shearFactor j * B :=
    fun E B ab hB hE hab1 hab2 j => by
      fin_cases j
      · dsimp [canonicalShear4, shearFactor]
        linarith [hE 0]
      · dsimp [canonicalShear4, shearFactor]
        have hm1 : |ab.1 * E 0| ≤ (1 / 2) * B := by
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul hab1 (hE 0) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        calc |E 1 + ab.1 * E 0| ≤ |E 1| + |ab.1 * E 0| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ B + (1 / 2) * B := add_le_add (hE 1) hm1
          _ = (3 / 2) * B := by ring
      · dsimp [canonicalShear4, shearFactor]
        have hm2 : |ab.2 * E 0| ≤ 1 * B := by
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul hab2 (hE 0) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        calc |E 2 + ab.2 * E 0| ≤ |E 2| + |ab.2 * E 0| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ B + 1 * B := add_le_add (hE 2) hm2
          _ = 2 * B := by ring
      · dsimp [canonicalShear4, shearFactor]
        have hm1 : |ab.1 * E 2| ≤ (1 / 2) * B := by
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul hab1 (hE 2) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        have hm2 : |ab.2 * E 1| ≤ 1 * B := by
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul hab2 (hE 1) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        have hab12 : |ab.1 * ab.2| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          rw [abs_mul]

        have hm3 : |ab.1 * ab.2 * E 0| ≤ (1 / 2) * B := by
          rw [abs_mul]

        calc |E 3 + ab.1 * E 2 + ab.2 * E 1 + ab.1 * ab.2 * E 0|
            ≤ |E 3 + ab.1 * E 2 + ab.2 * E 1| + |ab.1 * ab.2 * E 0| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ |E 3 + ab.1 * E 2| + |ab.2 * E 1| + |ab.1 * ab.2 * E 0| :=
              add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ |E 3| + |ab.1 * E 2| + |ab.2 * E 1| + |ab.1 * ab.2 * E 0| :=
              add_le_add (add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl) le_rfl
          _ ≤ B + (1 / 2) * B + 1 * B + (1 / 2) * B :=
              add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (hE 3) hm1) hm2) hm3
          _ = 3 * B := by ring

  let D₀_bar : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → (Fin 4 → ℝ) :=

          _ = 1 := (h_rpow_cancel (m * u')).2
      have h_sh_diff : ∀ j : Fin 4,

          ((ε ^ (-m * u') * (R₀_e e - ((kr_d : ℝ) + 1) * Δ_rd)) / δ_ρ)
          (θ.2 / δ_ρ)
          ((ε ^ (-m * u') * (R₀_e e - (kr_d : ℝ) * Δ_rd)) / δ_ρ) 2 ?_ ?_ ?_
        · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by rw [hθ2_def]; nlinarith [hkr_bds.2, hpos_nmu.le])
            hδ_ρ_pos.le
        · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by rw [hθ2_def]; nlinarith [hkr_bds.1, hpos_nmu.le])
            hδ_ρ_pos.le
        · have h_sub : (ε ^ (-m * u') * (R₀_e e - (kr_d : ℝ) * Δ_rd)) / δ_ρ -
              (ε ^ (-m * u') * (R₀_e e - ((kr_d : ℝ) + 1) * Δ_rd)) / δ_ρ =
            (ε ^ (-m * u') * Δ_rd) / δ_ρ := by ring
          rw [h_sub, div_le_iff₀ hδ_ρ_pos]
          have h1 : Δ_rd ≤ 2 * (ε ^ (m * u') * ρ ^ d) := by rwa [h_rpow_step_d] at h_rd_hi
          have h_nmu_eq : ε ^ (-m * u') = ε ^ (-(m * u')) := by congr 1; ring
          calc ε ^ (-m * u') * Δ_rd
              ≤ ε ^ (-(m * u')) * (2 * (ε ^ (m * u') * ρ ^ d)) := by
                rw [h_nmu_eq]
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _)
            _ = 2 * ((ε ^ (-(m * u')) * ε ^ (m * u')) * ρ ^ d) := by ring
            _ = 2 * ρ ^ d := by rw [(h_rpow_cancel (m * u')).2, one_mul]
            _ ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ_ρ := by push_cast; linarith
      · rw [h_iccLeft_card]; omega

  
  · intro u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₁₂
    refine ⟨fun k => k / (2 ^ (dyadicTimeLevel ε u₂ - dyadicTimeLevel ε u₁) : ℤ),
      fun c_s _hcs => ?_⟩
    exact (h_dyad ε u₁ u₂ c_s 0 0 0 hε₀ hε₁ hu₁.le hu₁₂ le_rfl).2.1

  
  · intro L₁ L₂ hL₁₂
    refine ⟨fun k => k / (2 ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L₂ - dyadicRealLevel ε L₁).toNat : ℤ),
      fun x => ?_⟩
    exact (h_dyad ε 0 0 0 L₁ L₂ x hε₀ hε₁ le_rfl le_rfl hL₁₂).2.2.2.2.2.2.1

  
  · intro d₁ d₂ _hd₁ hd₁₂
    let Dp : ℤ := (2 ^ (dyadicRealLevel ρ d₂ - dyadicRealLevel ρ d₁).toNat : ℤ)
    refine ⟨fun b => (b.1 / Dp, b.2 / Dp), fun θ' => ?_⟩
    unfold paramTreeBin
    exact Prod.ext
      (h_dyad ρ 0 0 0 d₁ d₂ θ'.1 hρ₀ hρ_half le_rfl le_rfl hd₁₂).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      (h_dyad ρ 0 0 0 d₁ d₂ θ'.2 hρ₀ hρ_half le_rfl le_rfl hd₁₂).2.2.2.2.2.2.1

informal_problem.statement:
{N_ω k_grp : ℕ} {α_E : Type}
    (ε ρ η_stage : ℝ)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ) (hρ_half : ρ < 1 / 2)
    (hη : 0 < η_stage)
    (Q : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (hQ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Q ω) (hQ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω = 1)
    (E_obs : Fin N_ω → α_E)
    (κ_P : Fin N_ω → (Fin 4 → ℤ))
    (β : Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ)
    (θ_map : α_E → ℤ × ℤ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (h_dom : ∀ ω, 0 < Q ω →
      (∀ j, |gridMidPt4 ρ (κ_P ω) j| ≤ 4) ∧
      |(θ_map (E_obs ω) (β ω)).1| ≤ 4 ∧ |(θ_map (E_obs ω) (β ω)).2| ≤ 4)
    (Q_grp_fn : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → (ℝ × ℝ) → Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ)
    (H_cell : α_E → (Fin 4 → ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop)
    (h_pair_exp :
      Real.log (ε⁻¹) * (finCondEntropy ε Q E_obs κ_P -
        finCondEntropy ε Q (fun ω => (E_obs ω, β ω)) κ_P) ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹))
    (h_coord_exp :
      Real.log (ε⁻¹) * ((∑ g : Fin k_grp,
          finCondEntropy ε Q (fun ω => (E_obs ω, β ω))
            (fun ω => Q_grp_fn (gridMidPt4 ρ (κ_P ω)) (θ_map (E_obs ω) (β ω)) g)) -
        finCondEntropy ε Q (fun ω => (E_obs ω, β ω))
          (fun ω => Q_grp_fn (gridMidPt4 ρ (κ_P ω)) (θ_map (E_obs ω) (β ω)))) ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹))
    (h_bad_exp :
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if ¬ H_cell (E_obs ω) (κ_P ω) (β ω) then Q ω else 0) ≤
        (1 / 8 : ℝ) * η_stage) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    ∃ (e₀ : α_E) (N_P N_Θ : ℕ)
      (k_of : Fin N_P → (Fin 4 → ℤ)) (β_of : Fin N_Θ → ℤ × ℤ)
      (p0 : Fin N_P → Fin N_Θ → ℝ),
      let q_e₀ := ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_obs ω = e₀ then Q ω else 0
      let P := fun idx_p => gridMidPt4 ρ (k_of idx_p)
      let θ := fun b => θ_map e₀ (β_of b)
      let H_good := fun idx_p b => H_cell e₀ (k_of idx_p) (β_of b)
      0 < q_e₀ ∧
      Function.Injective k_of ∧ Function.Injective β_of ∧
      (∀ idx_p b, 0 ≤ p0 idx_p b) ∧
      (∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ, p0 idx_p b) = 1 ∧
      (∀ idx_p j, |P idx_p j| ≤ 4) ∧
      (∀ b, |(θ b).1| ≤ 4 ∧ |(θ b).2| ≤ 4) ∧
      pairKLDivergence p0 ≤ η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) ∧
      condCoordMultiInfo p0 (fun g idx_p b => Q_grp_fn (P idx_p) (θ b) g) ≤
        η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) ∧
      1 - η_stage ≤ (∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
        if H_good idx_p b then p0 idx_p b else 0) ∧
      (∀ (idx_p : Fin N_P) (b : Fin N_Θ), 0 < p0 idx_p b →
        ∃ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < Q ω ∧ E_obs ω = e₀ ∧ κ_P ω = k_of idx_p ∧ β ω = β_of b) ∧
      (∀ Pred : (Fin 4 → ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop,
        (∑ idx_p : Fin N_P, ∑ b : Fin N_Θ,
          if Pred (k_of idx_p) (β_of b) then p0 idx_p b else 0) =
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if E_obs ω = e₀ ∧ Pred (κ_P ω) (β ω) then Q ω else 0) / q_e₀)
