proof.tactics:
by
  have hε_lt_one : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have hρ_lt_one : ρ < 1 := by linarith
  have hℓ_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr hε_lt_one)
  have hL_pos : 0 < Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hρ₀).mpr hρ_lt_one)
  have hηL_pos : 0 < η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := mul_pos hη hL_pos
  have h78_lt_one : (1 / 4 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 + 1 / 8 < 1 := by norm_num
  classical

  
  have h_gibbs_pt : ∀ (p q : ℝ), 0 ≤ p → 0 ≤ q → (0 < p → 0 < q) →
      p - q ≤ p * Real.log (p / q) := by
    intro p q hp_nn hq_nn hpq
    by_cases hp : 0 < p
    · have hq : 0 < q := hpq hp
      have h_le : Real.log (q / p) ≤ q / p - 1 :=
        Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hq hp)
      have h_neg : Real.log (q / p) = -Real.log (p / q) := by
        rw [Real.log_div hq.ne' hp.ne', Real.log_div hp.ne' hq.ne']
        ring
      rw [h_neg] at h_le
      have h_mul : p * (-Real.log (p / q)) ≤ p * (q / p - 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le hp.le
      have h_simp : p * (q / p - 1) = q - p := by
        rw [mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ q hp.ne', mul_one]
      linarith
    · have hp0 : p = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hp) hp_nn
      rw [hp0, zero_sub, zero_mul]
      linarith

  have h_kl_nn : ∀ {M_P M_Θ : ℕ} (p0 : Fin M_P → Fin M_Θ → ℝ),
      (∀ i b, 0 ≤ p0 i b) → (∑ i : Fin M_P, ∑ b : Fin M_Θ, p0 i b) = 1 →
      0 ≤ pairKLDivergence p0 := by
    intro M_P M_Θ p0 hp0_nn hp0_sum
    unfold pairKLDivergence
    dsimp only
    let mu0 : Fin M_P → ℝ := fun i => ∑ b : Fin M_Θ, p0 i b
    let lam0 : Fin M_Θ → ℝ := fun b => ∑ i : Fin M_P, p0 i b
    have h_pt : ∀ (i : Fin M_P) (b : Fin M_Θ),
        p0 i b - mu0 i * lam0 b ≤ p0 i b * Real.log (p0 i b / (mu0 i * lam0 b)) := by
      intro i b
      have hmu_nn : 0 ≤ mu0 i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b' _ => hp0_nn i b')
      have hlam_nn : 0 ≤ lam0 b := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i' _ => hp0_nn i' b)
      refine h_gibbs_pt (p0 i b) (mu0 i * lam0 b) (hp0_nn i b) (mul_nonneg hmu_nn hlam_nn) (fun hp => ?_)
      have hmu_pos : 0 < mu0 i :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hp (Finset.single_le_sum (fun b' _ => hp0_nn i b') (Finset.mem_univ b))
      have hlam_pos : 0 < lam0 b :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hp (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hp0_nn i' b) (Finset.mem_univ i))
      exact mul_pos hmu_pos hlam_pos
    have h_sum_le :
        (∑ i : Fin M_P, ∑ b : Fin M_Θ, (p0 i b - mu0 i * lam0 b)) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin M_P, ∑ b : Fin M_Θ, p0 i b * Real.log (p0 i b / (mu0 i * lam0 b)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => h_pt i b))
    have h_prod_sum : (∑ i : Fin M_P, ∑ b : Fin M_Θ, mu0 i * lam0 b) = 1 := by
      have h1 : (∑ i : Fin M_P, ∑ b : Fin M_Θ, mu0 i * lam0 b) =
          (∑ i : Fin M_P, mu0 i) * (∑ b : Fin M_Θ, lam0 b) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm)
      have h_lam_sum : (∑ b : Fin M_Θ, lam0 b) = 1 := by
        dsimp only [lam0]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        exact hp0_sum
      rw [h1, hp0_sum, h_lam_sum, mul_one]
    have h_lhs : (∑ i : Fin M_P, ∑ b : Fin M_Θ, (p0 i b - mu0 i * lam0 b)) = 0 := by
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [hp0_sum, h_prod_sum, sub_self]
    linarith

  have h_mi_nn : ∀ {M_P M_Θ : ℕ} (p0 : Fin M_P → Fin M_Θ → ℝ)
      (Q_grp : Fin k_grp → Fin M_P → Fin M_Θ → ℤ × ℤ),
      (∀ i b, 0 ≤ p0 i b) → 0 ≤ condCoordMultiInfo p0 Q_grp := by
    intro M_P M_Θ p0 Q_grp hp0_nn
    unfold condCoordMultiInfo
    dsimp only
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => ?_)
    let lam0 : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin M_P, p0 i b
    have hlam0_nn : 0 ≤ lam0 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hp0_nn i b)
    by_cases hlam0_pos : 0 < lam0
    · let tup : Fin M_P → (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) := fun i g => Q_grp g i b
      let S_b : Finset (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.univ.image tup
      let ξ_joint : (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun q =>
        ∑ i' : Fin M_P, if tup i' = q then p0 i' b / lam0 else 0
      let ξ_marg : Fin k_grp → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun g u =>
        ∑ i' : Fin M_P, if Q_grp g i' b = u then p0 i' b / lam0 else 0
      let ξ_prod : (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun q =>
        ∏ g : Fin k_grp, ξ_marg g (q g)
      have h_term_eq : ∀ i : Fin M_P,
          p0 i b * Real.log
            ((∑ i' : Fin M_P,
                @ite ℝ (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_grp g i' b = Q_grp g i b)
                  (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0 i' b / lam0) 0) /
              (∏ g : Fin k_grp,
                ∑ i' : Fin M_P,
                  @ite ℝ (Q_grp g i' b = Q_grp g i b)
                    (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0 i' b / lam0) 0)) =
          p0 i b * Real.log (ξ_joint (tup i) / ξ_prod (tup i)) := by
        intro i
        have hj : (∑ i' : Fin M_P,
            @ite ℝ (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_grp g i' b = Q_grp g i b)
              (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0 i' b / lam0) 0) = ξ_joint (tup i) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
          have hiff : (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_grp g i' b = Q_grp g i b) ↔ tup i' = tup i :=
            funext_iff.symm
          by_cases h : tup i' = tup i
          · rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hiff.mpr h), if_pos h]
          · rw [@if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (mt hiff.mp h), if_neg h]
        have hp : (∏ g : Fin k_grp,
            ∑ i' : Fin M_P,
              @ite ℝ (Q_grp g i' b = Q_grp g i b)
                (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0 i' b / lam0) 0) = ξ_prod (tup i) := by
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun g _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_))
          by_cases h : Q_grp g i' b = Q_grp g i b
          · rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) h, if_pos h]
          · rw [@if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) h, if_neg h]
        rw [hj, hp]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => h_term_eq i)]
      have h_col_eq :
          (∑ i : Fin M_P, p0 i b * Real.log (ξ_joint (tup i) / ξ_prod (tup i))) =
          lam0 * ∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_joint q * Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        have h_rhs : ∀ q ∈ S_b,
            lam0 * (ξ_joint q * Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q)) =
            ∑ i : Fin M_P,
              if tup i = q then p0 i b * Real.log (ξ_joint (tup i) / ξ_prod (tup i)) else 0 := by
          intro q _
          rw [← mul_assoc]
          have h1 : lam0 * ξ_joint q = ∑ i : Fin M_P, if tup i = q then p0 i b else 0 := by
            dsimp only [ξ_joint]
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
            by_cases h : tup i = q
            · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hlam0_pos.ne']
            · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero]
          rw [h1, Finset.sum_mul]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          by_cases h : tup i = q
          · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, h]
          · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, zero_mul]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_rhs, Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (tup i)]
        · exact (if_pos rfl).symm
        · intro q _ hq
          exact if_neg (Ne.symm hq)
        · intro h_not
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem tup (Finset.mem_univ i)) h_not
      rw [h_col_eq]
      refine mul_nonneg hlam0_pos.le ?_
      have h_ξj_nn : ∀ q, 0 ≤ ξ_joint q := fun q =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i' _ => by
          by_cases h : tup i' = q
          · rw [if_pos h]; exact div_nonneg (hp0_nn i' b) hlam0_pos.le
          · rw [if_neg h])
      have h_ξm_nn : ∀ g u, 0 ≤ ξ_marg g u := fun g u =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i' _ => by
          by_cases h : Q_grp g i' b = u
          · rw [if_pos h]; exact div_nonneg (hp0_nn i' b) hlam0_pos.le
          · rw [if_neg h])
      have h_ξp_nn : ∀ q, 0 ≤ ξ_prod q := fun q =>
        Finset.prod_nonneg (fun g _ => h_ξm_nn g (q g))
      have h_pt_q : ∀ q ∈ S_b,
          ξ_joint q - ξ_prod q ≤ ξ_joint q * Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q) := by
        intro q _
        refine h_gibbs_pt (ξ_joint q) (ξ_prod q) (h_ξj_nn q) (h_ξp_nn q) (fun hpos => ?_)
        obtain ⟨i₀, _, hi₀⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hpos.ne'
        have hi₀_eq : tup i₀ = q := by
          by_contra hne
          rw [if_neg hne] at hi₀
          exact hi₀ rfl
        rw [if_pos hi₀_eq] at hi₀
        have hi₀_pos : 0 < p0 i₀ b / lam0 :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (div_nonneg (hp0_nn i₀ b) hlam0_pos.le) (Ne.symm hi₀)
        refine Finset.prod_pos (fun g _ => ?_)
        have hg_eq : Q_grp g i₀ b = q g := congr_fun hi₀_eq g
        have h_le : (if Q_grp g i₀ b = q g then p0 i₀ b / lam0 else 0) ≤ ξ_marg g (q g) :=
          Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun i' : Fin M_P => if Q_grp g i' b = q g then p0 i' b / lam0 else 0)
            (fun i' _ => by
              by_cases h : Q_grp g i' b = q g
              · rw [if_pos h]; exact div_nonneg (hp0_nn i' b) hlam0_pos.le
              · rw [if_neg h])
            (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
        rw [if_pos hg_eq] at h_le
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hi₀_pos h_le
      have h_sum_j : (∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_joint q) = 1 := by
        dsimp only [ξ_joint]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        have h_inner : ∀ i' : Fin M_P,
            (∑ q ∈ S_b, if tup i' = q then p0 i' b / lam0 else 0) = p0 i' b / lam0 := by
          intro i'
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (tup i')]
          · exact if_pos rfl
          · intro q _ hq; exact if_neg (Ne.symm hq)
          · intro h_not; exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem tup (Finset.mem_univ i')) h_not
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => h_inner i'), ← Finset.sum_div,
          div_self hlam0_pos.ne']
      let U : Fin k_grp → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := fun g =>
        Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin M_P => Q_grp g i b)
      have h_sub_pi : S_b ⊆ Fintype.piFinset U := by
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
        exact Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr (fun g => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i))
      have h_sum_m : ∀ g : Fin k_grp, (∑ u ∈ U g, ξ_marg g u) = 1 := by
        intro g
        dsimp only [ξ_marg]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        have h_inner : ∀ i' : Fin M_P,
            (∑ u ∈ U g, if Q_grp g i' b = u then p0 i' b / lam0 else 0) = p0 i' b / lam0 := by
          intro i'
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Q_grp g i' b)]
          · exact if_pos rfl
          · intro u _ hu; exact if_neg (Ne.symm hu)
          · intro h_not; exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i')) h_not
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => h_inner i'), ← Finset.sum_div,
          div_self hlam0_pos.ne']
      have h_sum_p : (∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_prod q) ≤ 1 := by
        calc ∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_prod q
            ≤ ∑ q ∈ Fintype.piFinset U, ξ_prod q :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_sub_pi (fun q _ _ => h_ξp_nn q)
          _ = ∏ g : Fin k_grp, ∑ u ∈ U g, ξ_marg g u := (Finset.prod_univ_sum U ξ_marg).symm
          _ = ∏ _g : Fin k_grp, (1 : ℝ) := Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun g _ => h_sum_m g)
          _ = 1 := Finset.prod_const_one
      have h_diff_le :
          (∑ q ∈ S_b, (ξ_joint q - ξ_prod q)) ≤
          ∑ q ∈ S_b, ξ_joint q * Real.log (ξ_joint q / ξ_prod q) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt_q
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h_sum_j] at h_diff_le
      linarith
    · have hlam0_zero : lam0 = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hlam0_pos) hlam0_nn
      have h_zero : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin M_P)),
          p0 i b * Real.log
            ((∑ i' : Fin M_P,
                @ite ℝ (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_grp g i' b = Q_grp g i b)
                  (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0 i' b / lam0) 0) /
              (∏ g : Fin k_grp,
                ∑ i' : Fin M_P,
                  @ite ℝ (Q_grp g i' b = Q_grp g i b)
                    (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0 i' b / lam0) 0)) = 0 := by
        intro i _
        have hi_le : p0 i b ≤ lam0 :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hp0_nn i' b) (Finset.mem_univ i)
        have hi_zero : p0 i b = 0 := le_antisymm (hi_le.trans hlam0_zero.le) (hp0_nn i b)
        rw [hi_zero, zero_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero h_zero]

  
  let S_pos : Finset (Fin N_ω) := Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω)
  let S_E : Finset α_E := S_pos.image E_obs
  let q_cell : α_E → ℝ := fun e => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_obs ω = e then Q ω else 0
  let F_cell : α_E → Finset (Fin N_ω) := fun e =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => 0 < Q ω ∧ E_obs ω = e)
  let S_P : α_E → Finset (Fin 4 → ℤ) := fun e => (F_cell e).image κ_P
  let S_Θ : α_E → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := fun e => (F_cell e).image β
  let N_P : α_E → ℕ := fun e => (S_P e).card
  let N_Θ : α_E → ℕ := fun e => (S_Θ e).card
  let ev_P : ∀ e, ↥(S_P e) ≃ Fin (N_P e) := fun e => (S_P e).equivFin
  let ev_Θ : ∀ e, ↥(S_Θ e) ≃ Fin (N_Θ e) := fun e => (S_Θ e).equivFin
  let k_of : ∀ e, Fin (N_P e) → (Fin 4 → ℤ) := fun e i => ((ev_P e).symm i).1
  let β_of : ∀ e, Fin (N_Θ e) → ℤ × ℤ := fun e b => ((ev_Θ e).symm b).1
  let p0_of : ∀ e, Fin (N_P e) → Fin (N_Θ e) → ℝ := fun e i b =>
    (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
      if E_obs ω = e ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e i ∧ β ω = β_of e b then Q ω else 0) / q_cell e

  have hk_inj : ∀ e, Function.Injective (k_of e) := fun e _ _ h =>
    (ev_P e).symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  have hβ_inj : ∀ e, Function.Injective (β_of e) := fun e _ _ h =>
    (ev_Θ e).symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)

  have h_sum_SE : ∀ (g : Fin N_ω → ℝ), (∀ ω, Q ω = 0 → g ω = 0) →
      (∑ e ∈ S_E, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_obs ω = e then g ω else 0) =
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, g ω := by
    intro g hg0
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hQ : 0 < Q ω
    · have h_mem : E_obs ω ∈ S_E :=
        Finset.mem_image_of_mem E_obs (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hQ⟩)
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (E_obs ω)]
      · exact if_pos rfl
      · intro e _ he; exact if_neg (Ne.symm he)
      · intro h_not; exact absurd h_mem h_not
    · have hQ0 : Q ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hQ) (hQ_nn ω)
      rw [hg0 ω hQ0]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => ite_self _)

  have hq_nn : ∀ e, 0 ≤ q_cell e := fun e =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by
      by_cases h : E_obs ω = e
      · rw [if_pos h]; exact hQ_nn ω
      · rw [if_neg h])

  have hq_sum : (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e) = 1 := by
    rw [h_sum_SE Q (fun _ h => h), hQ_sum]

  have hq_pos : ∀ e ∈ S_E, 0 < q_cell e := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    have hQ₀ : 0 < Q ω₀ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₀).2
    have h_le : (if E_obs ω₀ = E_obs ω₀ then Q ω₀ else 0) ≤ q_cell (E_obs ω₀) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun ω : Fin N_ω => if E_obs ω = E_obs ω₀ then Q ω else 0)
        (fun ω _ => by
          by_cases h : E_obs ω = E_obs ω₀
          · rw [if_pos h]; exact hQ_nn ω
          · rw [if_neg h])
        (Finset.mem_univ ω₀)
    rw [if_pos rfl] at h_le
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hQ₀ h_le

  have hp0_nn : ∀ e, 0 < q_cell e → ∀ i b, 0 ≤ p0_of e i b := by
    intro e hqe i b
    refine div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ?_)) hqe.le
    by_cases h : E_obs ω = e ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e i ∧ β ω = β_of e b
    · rw [if_pos h]; exact hQ_nn ω
    · rw [if_neg h]

  
  have h_mat_sum : ∀ (e : α_E), 0 < q_cell e →
      ∀ (f : Fin (N_P e) → Fin (N_Θ e) → ℝ) (g : Fin N_ω → ℝ),
      (∀ ω i b, 0 < Q ω → E_obs ω = e → k_of e i = κ_P ω → β_of e b = β ω → f i b = g ω) →
      q_cell e * (∑ i : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e), p0_of e i b * f i b) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_obs ω = e then Q ω * g ω else 0 := by
    intro e hqe f g hfg
    have h_expand : ∀ (i : Fin (N_P e)) (b : Fin (N_Θ e)),
        q_cell e * (p0_of e i b * f i b) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if E_obs ω = e ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e i ∧ β ω = β_of e b then Q ω * f i b else 0 := by
      intro i b
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      have h1 : q_cell e * p0_of e i b =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
            if E_obs ω = e ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e i ∧ β ω = β_of e b then Q ω else 0 :=
        mul_div_cancel₀ _ hqe.ne'
      rw [h1, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : E_obs ω = e ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e i ∧ β ω = β_of e b
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, zero_mul]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, h_expand]
    have h_inner_swap : ∀ i : Fin (N_P e),
        (∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e), ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if E_obs ω = e ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e i ∧ β ω = β_of e b then Q ω * f i b else 0) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e),
          if E_obs ω = e ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e i ∧ β ω = β_of e b then Q ω * f i b else 0 :=
      fun _ => Finset.sum_comm
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => h_inner_swap i), Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases he : E_obs ω = e
    · by_cases hQ : 0 < Q ω
      · have hω_F : ω ∈ F_cell e := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ ω, hQ, he⟩
        have hk_mem : κ_P ω ∈ S_P e := Finset.mem_image_of_mem κ_P hω_F
        have hβ_mem : β ω ∈ S_Θ e := Finset.mem_image_of_mem β hω_F
        let i_ω : Fin (N_P e) := ev_P e ⟨κ_P ω, hk_mem⟩
        let b_ω : Fin (N_Θ e) := ev_Θ e ⟨β ω, hβ_mem⟩
        have hi_eq : k_of e i_ω = κ_P ω := by
          dsimp only [k_of, i_ω]
          rw [(ev_P e).symm_apply_apply]
        have hb_eq : β_of e b_ω = β ω := by
          dsimp only [β_of, b_ω]
          rw [(ev_Θ e).symm_apply_apply]
        rw [if_pos he]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i_ω]
        · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b_ω]
          · rw [if_pos ⟨he, hi_eq.symm, hb_eq.symm⟩, hfg ω i_ω b_ω hQ he hi_eq hb_eq]
          · intro b _ hb_ne
            have hβ_ne : β ω ≠ β_of e b := by
              intro h_eq
              exact hb_ne (hβ_inj e (h_eq.symm.trans hb_eq.symm))
            exact if_neg (fun h => hβ_ne h.2.2)
          · intro h_not; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b_ω) h_not
        · intro i _ hi_ne
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b _ => ?_)
          have hk_ne : κ_P ω ≠ k_of e i := by
            intro h_eq
            exact hi_ne (hk_inj e (h_eq.symm.trans hi_eq.symm))
          exact if_neg (fun h => hk_ne h.2.1)
        · intro h_not; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i_ω) h_not
      · have hQ0 : Q ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hQ) (hQ_nn ω)
        rw [if_pos he, hQ0, zero_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b _ => ?_))
        rw [zero_mul, ite_self]
    · rw [if_neg he]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b _ => ?_))
      exact if_neg (fun h => he h.1)

  have h_pred_sum : ∀ (e : α_E), 0 < q_cell e →
      ∀ (Pred : (Fin 4 → ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop)
        (inst₁ : ∀ i b, Decidable (Pred (k_of e i) (β_of e b)))
        (inst₂ : ∀ ω, Decidable (E_obs ω = e ∧ Pred (κ_P ω) (β ω))),
      (∑ i : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e),
        @ite ℝ (Pred (k_of e i) (β_of e b)) (inst₁ i b) (p0_of e i b) 0) =
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        @ite ℝ (E_obs ω = e ∧ Pred (κ_P ω) (β ω)) (inst₂ ω) (Q ω) 0) / q_cell e := by
    intro e hqe Pred inst₁ inst₂
    rw [eq_div_iff hqe.ne', mul_comm]
    have h_lhs :
        (∑ i : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e),
          @ite ℝ (Pred (k_of e i) (β_of e b)) (inst₁ i b) (p0_of e i b) 0) =
        ∑ i : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e),
          p0_of e i b * (if Pred (k_of e i) (β_of e b) then 1 else 0) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
      by_cases h : Pred (k_of e i) (β_of e b)
      · rw [@if_pos _ (inst₁ i b) h, if_pos h, mul_one]
      · rw [@if_neg _ (inst₁ i b) h, if_neg h, mul_zero]
    rw [h_lhs, h_mat_sum e hqe
      (fun i b => if Pred (k_of e i) (β_of e b) then 1 else 0)
      (fun ω => if Pred (κ_P ω) (β ω) then 1 else 0)
      (fun ω i b _ _ hi hb => by
        by_cases h : Pred (κ_P ω) (β ω) <;> simp [hi, hb, h])]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases he : E_obs ω = e
    · by_cases hp : Pred (κ_P ω) (β ω)
      · rw [if_pos he, if_pos hp, mul_one, @if_pos _ (inst₂ ω) ⟨he, hp⟩]
      · rw [if_pos he, if_neg hp, mul_zero, @if_neg _ (inst₂ ω) (fun h => hp h.2)]
    · rw [if_neg he, @if_neg _ (inst₂ ω) (fun h => he h.1)]

  have hp0_sum : ∀ (e : α_E), 0 < q_cell e →
      (∑ i : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e), p0_of e i b) = 1 := by
    intro e hqe
    have h1 := h_pred_sum e hqe (fun _ _ => True)
      (fun _ _ => inferInstance) (fun _ => inferInstance)
    simp only [ite_true, and_true] at h1
    rw [h1, div_self hqe.ne']

  
  have h_fp_pos : ∀ {α₁ : Type} (Z₁ : Fin N_ω → α₁) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      0 < Q ω → 0 < finProbAt Q Z₁ ω := by
    intro α₁ Z₁ ω hQ
    unfold finProbAt
    have h_le :
        @ite ℝ (Z₁ ω = Z₁ ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω) 0 ≤
        ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (Z₁ ω' = Z₁ ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω') 0 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω =>
          @ite ℝ (Z₁ ω' = Z₁ ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω') 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by
          by_cases h : Z₁ ω' = Z₁ ω
          · rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) h]; exact hQ_nn ω'
          · rw [@if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) h])
        (Finset.mem_univ ω)
    rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) rfl] at h_le
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hQ h_le

  have h_fp2_pos : ∀ {α₁ α₂ : Type} (Z₁ : Fin N_ω → α₁) (Z₂ : Fin N_ω → α₂) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      0 < Q ω → 0 < finProbAt2 Q Z₁ Z₂ ω := by
    intro α₁ α₂ Z₁ Z₂ ω hQ
    unfold finProbAt2
    have h_le :
        @ite ℝ (Z₁ ω = Z₁ ω ∧ Z₂ ω = Z₂ ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω) 0 ≤
        ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω,
          @ite ℝ (Z₁ ω' = Z₁ ω ∧ Z₂ ω' = Z₂ ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω') 0 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun ω' : Fin N_ω =>
          @ite ℝ (Z₁ ω' = Z₁ ω ∧ Z₂ ω' = Z₂ ω) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω') 0)
        (fun ω' _ => by
          by_cases h : Z₁ ω' = Z₁ ω ∧ Z₂ ω' = Z₂ ω
          · rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) h]; exact hQ_nn ω'
          · rw [@if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) h])
        (Finset.mem_univ ω)
    rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) ⟨rfl, rfl⟩] at h_le
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hQ h_le

  let X_Eβ : Fin N_ω → α_E × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun ω => (E_obs ω, β ω)
  let Y_tup : Fin N_ω → (Fin k_grp → ℤ × ℤ) := fun ω =>
    Q_grp_fn (gridMidPt4 ρ (κ_P ω)) (θ_map (E_obs ω) (β ω))
  let Y_g : Fin k_grp → Fin N_ω → ℤ × ℤ := fun g ω => Y_tup ω g

  have h_lam0_eq : ∀ (e : α_E) (hqe : 0 < q_cell e) (ω : Fin N_ω) (b : Fin (N_Θ e)),
      E_obs ω = e → β_of e b = β ω →
      (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), p0_of e i' b) = finProbAt Q X_Eβ ω / q_cell e := by
    intro e hqe ω b he hb
    let Pred_b : (Fin 4 → ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop := fun _ b_v => b_v = β_of e b
    have h_lhs :
        (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b' : Fin (N_Θ e),
          if Pred_b (k_of e i') (β_of e b') then p0_of e i' b' else 0) =
        ∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), p0_of e i' b := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
      · exact if_pos rfl
      · intro b' _ hb'; exact if_neg (fun h => hb' (hβ_inj e h))
      · intro h_not; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h_not
    have h_rhs :
        (∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_b (κ_P ω') (β ω') then Q ω' else 0) =
        finProbAt Q X_Eβ ω := by
      unfold finProbAt
      dsimp only [X_Eβ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      have hiff : (E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_b (κ_P ω') (β ω')) ↔
          (E_obs ω', β ω') = (E_obs ω, β ω) := by
        dsimp only [Pred_b]
        rw [hb, @Prod.mk.injEq α_E (ℤ × ℤ), he]
      by_cases h : E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_b (κ_P ω') (β ω')
      · rw [if_pos h, @if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hiff.mp h)]
      · rw [if_neg h, @if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (mt hiff.mpr h)]
    exact h_lhs.symm.trans ((h_pred_sum e hqe Pred_b _ _).trans (congrArg (· / q_cell e) h_rhs))

  have h_pair_cell : ∀ (e : α_E), 0 < q_cell e →
      q_cell e * pairKLDivergence (p0_of e) =
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if E_obs ω = e then
          Q ω * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) *
            (condSurprise ε Q E_obs κ_P ω - condSurprise ε Q X_Eβ κ_P ω))
        else 0 := by
    intro e hqe
    unfold pairKLDivergence
    dsimp only
    refine h_mat_sum e hqe _ _ (fun ω i b hQ he hi hb => ?_)
    have h_mu0 :
        (∑ b' : Fin (N_Θ e), p0_of e i b') = finProbAt2 Q E_obs κ_P ω / q_cell e := by
      let Pred_i : (Fin 4 → ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop := fun k_v _ => k_v = k_of e i
      have h_lhs :
          (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b' : Fin (N_Θ e),
            if Pred_i (k_of e i') (β_of e b') then p0_of e i' b' else 0) =
          ∑ b' : Fin (N_Θ e), p0_of e i b' := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
        · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => if_pos rfl)
        · intro i' _ hi'
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun _ _ => if_neg (fun h => hi' (hk_inj e h)))
        · intro h_not; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h_not
      have h_rhs :
          (∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_i (κ_P ω') (β ω') then Q ω' else 0) =
          finProbAt2 Q E_obs κ_P ω := by
        unfold finProbAt2
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
        have hiff : (E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_i (κ_P ω') (β ω')) ↔
            (E_obs ω' = E_obs ω ∧ κ_P ω' = κ_P ω) := by
          dsimp only [Pred_i]
          rw [hi, he]
        by_cases h : E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_i (κ_P ω') (β ω')
        · rw [if_pos h, @if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hiff.mp h)]
        · rw [if_neg h, @if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (mt hiff.mpr h)]
      exact h_lhs.symm.trans ((h_pred_sum e hqe Pred_i _ _).trans (congrArg (· / q_cell e) h_rhs))
    have h_lam0 := h_lam0_eq e hqe ω b he hb
    have h_p0 : p0_of e i b = finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ κ_P ω / q_cell e := by
      dsimp only [p0_of]
      congr 1
      unfold finProbAt2
      dsimp only [X_Eβ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      have hiff :
          (E_obs ω' = e ∧ κ_P ω' = k_of e i ∧ β ω' = β_of e b) ↔
          ((E_obs ω', β ω') = (E_obs ω, β ω) ∧ κ_P ω' = κ_P ω) := by
        rw [hi, hb, @Prod.mk.injEq α_E (ℤ × ℤ), he]
        tauto
      by_cases h : E_obs ω' = e ∧ κ_P ω' = k_of e i ∧ β ω' = β_of e b
      · rw [if_pos h, @if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hiff.mp h)]
      · rw [if_neg h, @if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (mt hiff.mpr h)]
    have h_qe_fp : q_cell e = finProbAt Q E_obs ω := by
      dsimp only [q_cell]
      unfold finProbAt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : E_obs ω' = e
      · rw [if_pos h, @if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (h.trans he.symm)]
      · rw [if_neg h, @if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (fun h' => h (h'.trans he))]
    let A := finProbAt Q E_obs ω
    let B := finProbAt2 Q E_obs κ_P ω
    let C := finProbAt Q X_Eβ ω
    let D := finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ κ_P ω
    have hA_pos : 0 < A := h_fp_pos E_obs ω hQ
    have hB_pos : 0 < B := h_fp2_pos E_obs κ_P ω hQ
    have hC_pos : 0 < C := h_fp_pos X_Eβ ω hQ
    have hD_pos : 0 < D := h_fp2_pos X_Eβ κ_P ω hQ
    rw [h_p0, h_mu0, h_lam0, h_qe_fp]
    change Real.log ((D / A) / ((B / A) * (C / A))) =
      Real.log (ε⁻¹) * (condSurprise ε Q E_obs κ_P ω - condSurprise ε Q X_Eβ κ_P ω)
    have h_rat : (D / A) / ((B / A) * (C / A)) = (D / C) / (B / A) := by
      have hA_ne : A ≠ 0 := hA_pos.ne'
      have hB_ne : B ≠ 0 := hB_pos.ne'
      have hC_ne : C ≠ 0 := hC_pos.ne'
      field_simp
    rw [h_rat, Real.log_div (div_pos hD_pos hC_pos).ne' (div_pos hB_pos hA_pos).ne']
    unfold condSurprise
    change Real.log (D / C) - Real.log (B / A) =
      Real.log (ε⁻¹) * (-(Real.log (B / A)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) - -(Real.log (D / C)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))
    rw [mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hℓ_pos.ne', mul_div_cancel₀ _ hℓ_pos.ne']
    ring

  have h_coord_cell : ∀ (e : α_E), 0 < q_cell e →
      q_cell e * condCoordMultiInfo (p0_of e)
        (fun g idx_p b => Q_grp_fn (gridMidPt4 ρ (k_of e idx_p)) (θ_map e (β_of e b)) g) =
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
        if E_obs ω = e then
          Q ω * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) *
            ((∑ g : Fin k_grp, condSurprise ε Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω) -
              condSurprise ε Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω))
        else 0 := by
    intro e hqe
    unfold condCoordMultiInfo
    dsimp only
    refine h_mat_sum e hqe _ _ (fun ω i b hQ he hi hb => ?_)
    let Q_e : Fin k_grp → Fin (N_P e) → Fin (N_Θ e) → ℤ × ℤ :=
      fun g idx_p b' => Q_grp_fn (gridMidPt4 ρ (k_of e idx_p)) (θ_map e (β_of e b')) g
    let lam0 : ℝ := ∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), p0_of e i' b
    let C := finProbAt Q X_Eβ ω
    have hC_pos : 0 < C := h_fp_pos X_Eβ ω hQ
    have h_lam0 : lam0 = C / q_cell e := h_lam0_eq e hqe ω b he hb
    have hQ_at : ∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i b = Y_tup ω g := by
      intro g
      dsimp only [Q_e, Y_tup]
      rw [hi, hb, he]
    have h_pj :
        (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
          @ite ℝ (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b)
            (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e i' b / lam0) 0) =
        finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω / C := by
      have h_pull :
          (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
            @ite ℝ (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b)
              (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e i' b / lam0) 0) =
          (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
            if (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Y_tup ω g) then p0_of e i' b else 0) / lam0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
        have hiff : (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b) ↔
            (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Y_tup ω g) := by
          simp_rw [hQ_at]
        by_cases h : ∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Y_tup ω g
        · rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hiff.mpr h), if_pos h]
        · rw [@if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (mt hiff.mp h), if_neg h, zero_div]
      have h_num :
          (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
            if (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Y_tup ω g) then p0_of e i' b else 0) =
          finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω / q_cell e := by
        let Pred_j : (Fin 4 → ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop := fun k_v b_v =>
          b_v = β_of e b ∧
          ∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_grp_fn (gridMidPt4 ρ k_v) (θ_map e b_v) g = Y_tup ω g
        have h_lhs :
            (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b' : Fin (N_Θ e),
              if Pred_j (k_of e i') (β_of e b') then p0_of e i' b' else 0) =
            ∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
              if (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Y_tup ω g) then p0_of e i' b else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
          · by_cases h : ∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Y_tup ω g
            · rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, h⟩, if_pos h]
            · rw [if_neg (fun h' => h h'.2), if_neg h]
          · intro b' _ hb'
            exact if_neg (fun h => hb' (hβ_inj e h.1))
          · intro h_not; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h_not
        have h_rhs :
            (∑ ω' : Fin N_ω,
              if E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_j (κ_P ω') (β ω') then Q ω' else 0) =
            finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          dsimp only [X_Eβ]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          have hiff :
              (E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_j (κ_P ω') (β ω')) ↔
              ((E_obs ω', β ω') = (E_obs ω, β ω) ∧ Y_tup ω' = Y_tup ω) := by
            dsimp only [Pred_j]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨he', hb', hg'⟩
              refine ⟨Prod.ext (he'.trans he.symm) (hb'.trans hb), funext (fun g => ?_)⟩
              dsimp only [Y_tup]
              rw [he']
              exact hg' g
            · rintro ⟨hprod, hy⟩
              have he' : E_obs ω' = e := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hprod).1.trans he
              have hb' : β ω' = β_of e b := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hprod).2.trans hb.symm
              refine ⟨he', hb', fun g => ?_⟩
              rw [← he']
              exact congr_fun hy g
          by_cases h : E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_j (κ_P ω') (β ω')
          · rw [if_pos h, @if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hiff.mp h)]
          · rw [if_neg h, @if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (mt hiff.mpr h)]
        exact h_lhs.symm.trans ((h_pred_sum e hqe Pred_j _ _).trans (congrArg (· / q_cell e) h_rhs))
      rw [h_pull, h_num, h_lam0]
      have hqe_ne : q_cell e ≠ 0 := hqe.ne'
      have hC_ne : C ≠ 0 := hC_pos.ne'
      field_simp
    have h_pm : ∀ g : Fin k_grp,
        (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
          @ite ℝ (Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b)
            (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e i' b / lam0) 0) =
        finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / C := by
      intro g
      have h_pull :
          (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
            @ite ℝ (Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b)
              (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e i' b / lam0) 0) =
          (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
            if Q_e g i' b = Y_g g ω then p0_of e i' b else 0) / lam0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
        have hiff : Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b ↔ Q_e g i' b = Y_g g ω := by
          dsimp only [Y_g]
          rw [hQ_at g]
        by_cases h : Q_e g i' b = Y_g g ω
        · rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hiff.mpr h), if_pos h]
        · rw [@if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (mt hiff.mp h), if_neg h, zero_div]
      have h_num :
          (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), if Q_e g i' b = Y_g g ω then p0_of e i' b else 0) =
          finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / q_cell e := by
        let Pred_m : (Fin 4 → ℤ) → (ℤ × ℤ) → Prop := fun k_v b_v =>
          b_v = β_of e b ∧ Q_grp_fn (gridMidPt4 ρ k_v) (θ_map e b_v) g = Y_g g ω
        have h_lhs :
            (∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b' : Fin (N_Θ e),
              if Pred_m (k_of e i') (β_of e b') then p0_of e i' b' else 0) =
            ∑ i' : Fin (N_P e), if Q_e g i' b = Y_g g ω then p0_of e i' b else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
          · by_cases h : Q_e g i' b = Y_g g ω
            · rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, h⟩, if_pos h]
            · rw [if_neg (fun h' => h h'.2), if_neg h]
          · intro b' _ hb'
            exact if_neg (fun h => hb' (hβ_inj e h.1))
          · intro h_not; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h_not
        have h_rhs :
            (∑ ω' : Fin N_ω,
              if E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_m (κ_P ω') (β ω') then Q ω' else 0) =
            finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω := by
          unfold finProbAt2
          dsimp only [X_Eβ]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
          have hiff :
              (E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_m (κ_P ω') (β ω')) ↔
              ((E_obs ω', β ω') = (E_obs ω, β ω) ∧ Y_g g ω' = Y_g g ω) := by
            dsimp only [Pred_m]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨he', hb', hg'⟩
              refine ⟨Prod.ext (he'.trans he.symm) (hb'.trans hb), ?_⟩
              dsimp only [Y_g, Y_tup]
              rw [he']
              exact hg'
            · rintro ⟨hprod, hy⟩
              have he' : E_obs ω' = e := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hprod).1.trans he
              have hb' : β ω' = β_of e b := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hprod).2.trans hb.symm
              refine ⟨he', hb', ?_⟩
              dsimp only [Y_g, Y_tup] at hy
              rwa [he'] at hy
          by_cases h : E_obs ω' = e ∧ Pred_m (κ_P ω') (β ω')
          · rw [if_pos h, @if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hiff.mp h)]
          · rw [if_neg h, @if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (mt hiff.mpr h)]
        exact h_lhs.symm.trans ((h_pred_sum e hqe Pred_m _ _).trans (congrArg (· / q_cell e) h_rhs))
      rw [h_pull, h_num, h_lam0]
      have hqe_ne : q_cell e ≠ 0 := hqe.ne'
      have hC_ne : C ≠ 0 := hC_pos.ne'
      field_simp
    have h_prod_eq :
        (∏ g : Fin k_grp,
          ∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
            @ite ℝ (Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b)
              (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e i' b / lam0) 0) =
        ∏ g : Fin k_grp, (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / C) :=
      Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun g _ => h_pm g)
    change Real.log
        ((∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
            @ite ℝ (∀ g : Fin k_grp, Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b)
              (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e i' b / lam0) 0) /
          (∏ g : Fin k_grp,
            ∑ i' : Fin (N_P e),
              @ite ℝ (Q_e g i' b = Q_e g i b)
                (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e i' b / lam0) 0)) =
      Real.log (ε⁻¹) *
        ((∑ g : Fin k_grp, condSurprise ε Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω) - condSurprise ε Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω)
    rw [h_pj, h_prod_eq]
    have h_pj_pos : 0 < finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω / C :=
      div_pos (h_fp2_pos X_Eβ Y_tup ω hQ) hC_pos
    have h_pm_pos : ∀ g : Fin k_grp, 0 < finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / C :=
      fun g => div_pos (h_fp2_pos X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω hQ) hC_pos
    have h_prod_pos : 0 < ∏ g : Fin k_grp, (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / C) :=
      Finset.prod_pos (fun g _ => h_pm_pos g)
    rw [Real.log_div h_pj_pos.ne' h_prod_pos.ne',
      Real.log_prod (fun g _ => (h_pm_pos g).ne')]
    unfold condSurprise
    have h_sum_cs :
        Real.log (ε⁻¹) *
          (∑ g : Fin k_grp, -(Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / C)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) =
        -∑ g : Fin k_grp, Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / C) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => mul_div_cancel₀ _ hℓ_pos.ne')
    have h_tup_cs :
        Real.log (ε⁻¹) * (-(Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω / C)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) =
        -Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω / C) :=
      mul_div_cancel₀ _ hℓ_pos.ne'
    change Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω / C) -
        ∑ g : Fin k_grp, Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / C) =
      Real.log (ε⁻¹) *
        ((∑ g : Fin k_grp, -(Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω / C)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) -
          -(Real.log (finProbAt2 Q X_Eβ Y_tup ω / C)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹))
    rw [mul_sub, h_sum_cs, h_tup_cs]
    ring

  
  let D_pair : α_E → ℝ := fun e => pairKLDivergence (p0_of e)
  let D_coord : α_E → ℝ := fun e =>
    condCoordMultiInfo (p0_of e)
      (fun g idx_p b => Q_grp_fn (gridMidPt4 ρ (k_of e idx_p)) (θ_map e (β_of e b)) g)
  let bad_mass : α_E → ℝ := fun e =>
    ∑ idx_p : Fin (N_P e), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e),
      if ¬ H_cell e (k_of e idx_p) (β_of e b) then p0_of e idx_p b else 0

  have h_pair_sum :
      (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * D_pair e) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := by
    have h_eq : (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * D_pair e) =
        Real.log (ε⁻¹) * (finCondEntropy ε Q E_obs κ_P - finCondEntropy ε Q X_Eβ κ_P) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e he => h_pair_cell e (hq_pos e he)),
        h_sum_SE _ (fun ω h0 => by rw [h0, zero_mul])]
      unfold finCondEntropy
      rw [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_pair_exp

  have h_coord_sum :
      (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * D_coord e) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := by
    have h_eq : (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * D_coord e) =
        Real.log (ε⁻¹) *
          ((∑ g : Fin k_grp, finCondEntropy ε Q X_Eβ (Y_g g)) -
            finCondEntropy ε Q X_Eβ Y_tup) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e he => h_coord_cell e (hq_pos e he)),
        h_sum_SE _ (fun ω h0 => by rw [h0, zero_mul])]
      unfold finCondEntropy
      have h_swap_g :
          (∑ g : Fin k_grp, ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω * condSurprise ε Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω) =
          ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, Q ω * ∑ g : Fin k_grp, condSurprise ε Q X_Eβ (Y_g g) ω := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm)
      rw [h_swap_g, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_coord_exp

  have h_bad_sum : (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * bad_mass e) ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * η_stage := by
    have h_cell_bad : ∀ e ∈ S_E,
        q_cell e * bad_mass e =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if E_obs ω = e then
            (if ¬ H_cell (E_obs ω) (κ_P ω) (β ω) then Q ω else 0)
          else 0 := by
      intro e he
      have hqe := hq_pos e he
      have h_bad_eq : bad_mass e =
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if E_obs ω = e ∧ ¬ H_cell e (κ_P ω) (β ω) then Q ω else 0) / q_cell e :=
        h_pred_sum e hqe (fun k_v b_v => ¬ H_cell e k_v b_v) _ _
      rw [h_bad_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hqe.ne']
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases he' : E_obs ω = e
      · by_cases hh : ¬ H_cell (E_obs ω) (κ_P ω) (β ω)
        · have hh' : ¬ H_cell e (κ_P ω) (β ω) := by rwa [← he']
          rw [if_pos ⟨he', hh'⟩, if_pos he', if_pos hh]
        · have hh' : ¬ ¬ H_cell e (κ_P ω) (β ω) := by rwa [← he']
          rw [if_neg (fun h => hh' h.2), if_pos he', if_neg hh]
      · rw [if_neg (fun h => he' h.1), if_neg he']
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_cell_bad,
      h_sum_SE _ (fun ω h0 => by rw [h0, ite_self])]
    have h_bridge :
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if ¬ H_cell (E_obs ω) (κ_P ω) (β ω) then Q ω else 0) =
        ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          @ite ℝ (¬ H_cell (E_obs ω) (κ_P ω) (β ω)) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω) 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : ¬ H_cell (E_obs ω) (κ_P ω) (β ω) <;> simp [h]
    rw [h_bridge]
    exact h_bad_exp

  have h_exists_e0 : ∃ e₀ ∈ S_E,
      D_pair e₀ + D_coord e₀ + Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e₀ ≤ η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := by
    by_contra h_none
    push_neg at h_none
    have h_lb :
        η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * (D_pair e + D_coord e + Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e) := by
      calc η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹)
          = (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e) * (η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹)) := by rw [hq_sum, one_mul]
        _ = ∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * (η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹)) := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * (D_pair e + D_coord e + Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun e he =>
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_none e he).le (hq_nn e))
    have h_bad_scaled :
        (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * (Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e)) ≤
        (1 / 8 : ℝ) * η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := by
      have h_factor :
          (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * (Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e)) =
          Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * ∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * bad_mass e := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => by ring)
      rw [h_factor]
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_bad_sum hL_pos.le
      linarith
    have h_ub :
        (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * (D_pair e + D_coord e + Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e)) ≤
        ((1 / 4 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 + 1 / 8) * (η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹)) := by
      have h_split :
          (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * (D_pair e + D_coord e + Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e)) =
          (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * D_pair e) +
          (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * D_coord e) +
          (∑ e ∈ S_E, q_cell e * (Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e)) := by
        simp_rw [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [h_split]
      linarith
    have h_strict :
        ((1 / 4 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 + 1 / 8) * (η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹)) <
        1 * (η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹)) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h78_lt_one hηL_pos
    linarith

  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀_mem, he₀_bound⟩ := h_exists_e0
  have hqe₀ : 0 < q_cell e₀ := hq_pos e₀ he₀_mem
  have hp0_e₀_nn : ∀ idx_p b, 0 ≤ p0_of e₀ idx_p b := hp0_nn e₀ hqe₀
  have hp0_e₀_sum : (∑ idx_p : Fin (N_P e₀), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e₀), p0_of e₀ idx_p b) = 1 :=
    hp0_sum e₀ hqe₀
  have hD_pair_nn : 0 ≤ D_pair e₀ := h_kl_nn (p0_of e₀) hp0_e₀_nn hp0_e₀_sum
  have hD_coord_nn : 0 ≤ D_coord e₀ := h_mi_nn (p0_of e₀) _ hp0_e₀_nn
  have h_bad_nn : 0 ≤ bad_mass e₀ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun idx_p _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => by
      by_cases h : ¬ H_cell e₀ (k_of e₀ idx_p) (β_of e₀ b)
      · rw [if_pos h]; exact hp0_e₀_nn idx_p b
      · rw [if_neg h]))
  have h_scaled_bad_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e₀ := mul_nonneg hL_pos.le h_bad_nn

  have hD_pair_le : D_pair e₀ ≤ η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := by linarith
  have hD_coord_le : D_coord e₀ ≤ η_stage * Real.log (ρ⁻¹) := by linarith
  have h_bad_le : bad_mass e₀ ≤ η_stage := by
    have h1 : Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * bad_mass e₀ ≤ Real.log (ρ⁻¹) * η_stage := by linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h1 hL_pos

  
  refine ⟨e₀, N_P e₀, N_Θ e₀, k_of e₀, β_of e₀, p0_of e₀, ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  have h_qe₀_bridge :
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (E_obs ω = e₀) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Q ω) 0) = q_cell e₀ := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : E_obs ω = e₀ <;> simp [h]
  refine ⟨?_, hk_inj e₀, hβ_inj e₀, hp0_e₀_nn, hp0_e₀_sum, ?_, ?_,
    hD_pair_le, hD_coord_le, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h_qe₀_bridge]
    exact hqe₀
  · intro idx_p j
    have h_mem : k_of e₀ idx_p ∈ S_P e₀ := ((ev_P e₀).symm idx_p).2
    obtain ⟨ω₁, hω₁, hk₁⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h_mem
    have hQ₁ : 0 < Q ω₁ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₁).2.1
    rw [← hk₁]
    exact (h_dom ω₁ hQ₁).1 j
  · intro b
    have h_mem : β_of e₀ b ∈ S_Θ e₀ := ((ev_Θ e₀).symm b).2
    obtain ⟨ω₂, hω₂, hβ₂⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h_mem
    obtain ⟨hQ₂, he₂⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hω₂).2
    rw [← hβ₂, ← he₂]
    exact (h_dom ω₂ hQ₂).2
  · have h_good_bridge :
        (∑ idx_p : Fin (N_P e₀), ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e₀),
          @ite ℝ (H_cell e₀ (k_of e₀ idx_p) (β_of e₀ b))
            (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e₀ idx_p b) 0) + bad_mass e₀ = 1 := by
      dsimp only [bad_mass]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      have h_row : ∀ idx_p : Fin (N_P e₀),
          (∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e₀),
            @ite ℝ (H_cell e₀ (k_of e₀ idx_p) (β_of e₀ b))
              (Classical.propDecidable _) (p0_of e₀ idx_p b) 0) +
          (∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e₀),
            if ¬ H_cell e₀ (k_of e₀ idx_p) (β_of e₀ b) then p0_of e₀ idx_p b else 0) =
          ∑ b : Fin (N_Θ e₀), p0_of e₀ idx_p b := by
        intro idx_p
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
        by_cases h : H_cell e₀ (k_of e₀ idx_p) (β_of e₀ b)
        · rw [@if_pos _ (Classical.propDecidable _) h, if_neg (not_not.mpr h), add_zero]
        · rw [@if_neg _ (Classical.propDecidable _) h, if_pos h, zero_add]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun idx_p _ => h_row idx_p)]
      exact hp0_e₀_sum
    linarith
  · intro idx_p b hp_pos
    have h_num_pos :
        0 < ∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
          if E_obs ω = e₀ ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e₀ idx_p ∧ β ω = β_of e₀ b then Q ω else 0 := by
      have h_eq :
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω,
            if E_obs ω = e₀ ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e₀ idx_p ∧ β ω = β_of e₀ b then Q ω else 0) =
          p0_of e₀ idx_p b * q_cell e₀ :=
        (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hqe₀.ne').symm
      rw [h_eq]
      exact mul_pos hp_pos hqe₀
    obtain ⟨ω, _, hω_ne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h_num_pos.ne'
    have h_cond : E_obs ω = e₀ ∧ κ_P ω = k_of e₀ idx_p ∧ β ω = β_of e₀ b := by
      by_contra h_not
      rw [if_neg h_not] at hω_ne
      exact hω_ne rfl
    rw [if_pos h_cond] at hω_ne
    exact ⟨ω, lt_of_le_of_ne (hQ_nn ω) (Ne.symm hω_ne), h_cond.1, h_cond.2.1, h_cond.2.2⟩
  · intro Pred
    rw [h_qe₀_bridge]
    exact h_pred_sum e₀ hqe₀ Pred _ _

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ)) :
    (∀ u v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → ‖w‖ = 1 →
      projAngleDist u v = projAngleDist v u ∧
      projAngleDist (perp2D u) (perp2D v) = projAngleDist u v ∧
      projAngleDist u w ≤ projAngleDist u v + projAngleDist v w ∧
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        projAngleDist u v * ‖z‖ ≤ |inner ℝ z u| + |inner ℝ z v|) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
      ∃ f₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f₁ ∧
        (∫ v, ‖f₁ v‖ ^ 2 = 1) ∧
        0 ≤ generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁ ∧
        (∀ ν κ : ℝ,
          HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ↔
          HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁) ∧
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (m_t N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
          (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          (IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
             lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ↔
           IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
             lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f₁ N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p) ∧
          (IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
             lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
           generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f₁ N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p -
             generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f₁ =
           generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p -
             generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f)) ∧
        (∀ (cls' : PacketBoundClass) (t h C_cell : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ) (δ_def k_cred α_cred : ℝ),
          IsCutChainState γ cls' ε H_P L t h lam_sys C_cell d_dim Φ₀ f₁ δ_def k_cred α_cred ↔
          IsCutChainState γ cls' ε H_P L t h lam_sys C_cell d_dim Φ₀ f δ_def k_cred α_cred)) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (t_min δ_mod : ℝ),
      0 < t_min → t_min ≤ cls.K_hor → 0 < δ_mod →
      ∃ ε_prep : ℝ, 0 < ε_prep ∧ ε_prep < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ) (m_t d_dim N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (Δ_cur k_f α_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_prep → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f → (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2 = 1) →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur ≤
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_f α_cur →
          let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
          let A₀ := 4 * cls.K_hor + 4
          (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t ≤ 1 / 4 →
            ∀ ζ_fl : ℝ, 0 < ζ_fl → ε ^ ζ_fl ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (N'_O : ℕ) (emb : Fin N'_O → Fin N_O) (p' : Fin N'_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              1 ≤ N'_O ∧ Function.Injective emb ∧
              (∀ o' d, 0 < p' o' d → 0 < p (emb o') d) ∧
              (∀ o' : Fin N'_O, ε ^ A₀ ≤
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  (r_O (emb o')) (V_O (emb o')) (X_O (emb o')) (ψ_O (emb o'))) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb)
                b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p' ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t - (4 * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t + 3 / ell) + δ_mod * t) ≤
                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D
                  (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb) b_D a_D p' ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N'_O N_D
                (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) e_D p' k_f
                (α_cur + ζ_fl + Real.log 4 / ell)) ∧
          (∀ (S_bins : ℕ) (E : Fin S_bins → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Prop) (p_union ζ_ret : ℝ),
            1 ≤ S_bins → (∀ o d, ∀ b₁ b₂, E b₁ o d → E b₂ o d → b₁ = b₂) →
            0 < p_union →
            (letI := Classical.propDecidable
             p_union ≤ ∑ b : Fin S_bins, ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
               if E b o d then p o d else 0) →
            0 < ζ_ret → ε ^ ζ_ret ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (b_sel : Fin S_bins) (p_sel : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              (∀ o d, 0 < p_sel o d → E b_sel o d ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_sel ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t -
                  ((4 / p_union) * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t +
                    (3 * Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2)) / (2 * ell)) + δ_mod * t) ≤
                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_sel ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p_sel k_f
                (α_cur + ζ_ret + Real.log (8 * (S_bins : ℝ) / p_union) / ell))) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (M_L : ℕ), 64 ≤ M_L →
      ∀ (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        0 < h → 2 * h < t → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        ∃ (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          letI := Classical.propDecidable
          let r := t - 2 * h
          let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
          let δ_buf := ((M_L : ℝ) / 32)
          3 / 4 ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              let q_r := r_O o / 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
              let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
              let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
              ‖v' - V_O o‖ ≤ δ_buf * ε ^ u_t →
              ‖x' - (X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o)‖ ≤ δ_buf * ε ^ (r + u_t) →
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)) =
              coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X q_r v' x'))
            then p o d else 0) ∧
    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h e₀ ζ_sh δ_mod : ℝ) (M_L : ℕ),
      0 < h → 64 * h < γ * e₀ → 0 < ζ_sh → 64 * ζ_sh ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h →
      0 < δ_mod → 64 * δ_mod ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h → 64 ≤ M_L →
      ∃ ε_norm : ℝ, 0 < ε_norm ∧ ε_norm < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (b_ref a_ref Δ_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_norm → 2 * h < t → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          ε ^ (t - 2 * h) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ (t - 2 * h) →
          m_r ≤ m_t → cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          e₀ ≤ a_ref - b_ref → (H_P - t) / 2 - ζ_sh ≤ a_ref →
          (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh) →
          64 * Δ_cur ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h →
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur ≤
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          ∃ n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            letI := Classical.propDecidable
            (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) ∧
            3 / 4 ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              if projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d))
                   (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L
                     (fineOutCell ε H_P t (t - 2 * h) m_r m_t τ_V τ_X
                       (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)))) ≤ ε ^ (4 * h)
              then p o d else 0)

    (∀ u v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → ‖w‖ = 1 →
      projAngleDist u v = projAngleDist v u ∧
      projAngleDist (perp2D u) (perp2D v) = projAngleDist u v ∧

    (∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ)

      let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam_sys R'_dom

      { (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖g v‖ ^ 2) / ell) } ∪

            (e_dir V_c X_c : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ),
            (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b d ∧ b d ≤ a d ∧ a d ≤ min L (H_P / 2) ∧ ‖e_dir d‖ = 1) ∧

                          hd_pos.le

            _ = 2 * W_pos := by rw [hpD_sum, one_mul]

          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          0 ≤ t → t ≤ H_P → cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) := by
    intro cls
    obtain ⟨_, C_cnt, _, hC_cnt, h_bes⟩ :=
      admissible_packet_fixed_time_bessel cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.K_hor
        cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win cls.ha₀ cls.ha₁ cls.hA cls.hB_sys
        cls.hK_hor cls.hR_win cls.hN_mult
    refine ⟨C_cnt, hC_cnt, fun ε H_P L t lam_sys m_t N_O N_D Φ₀ ζ₀ f
      r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p henv ht0 htHP hm_t1 hadm => ?_⟩
    exact (h_bes ε H_P t lam_sys m_t henv.1 henv.2.1 ht0 htHP henv.2.2.2.1
      henv.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 henv.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 hm_t1 Φ₀ ζ₀ henv.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      N_O r_O V_O X_O ψ_O hadm.1 hadm.2.1 hadm.2.2.1 hadm.2.2.2.1
      (fun r v₀ x₀ => by
        convert hadm.2.2.2.2.1 r v₀ x₀ using 3
        ext o
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter])).1
  have h_fib_ent : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},
        0 < B_fib → (∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) → (∑ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) →
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ y : Fin N_Y, (0 < ∑ x, P x y) →
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin N_X => 0 < P x y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib) →
        let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x, P x y
        (∑ x, ∑ y, -(P x y * Real.log (P x y / P_Y y))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
          Real.log B_fib / Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
    fun {_} hε₀ hε₁ => (contributor_sampling_and_resampling_entropy _ hε₀ hε₁).2.2.1
  refine ⟨h_c1, h_c2,
    mass_floor_and_credit_bin_selection γ hγ₀ hγ₁ h_mod h_site_cnt h_fib_ent,
    h_c4,
    two_copy_isotropic_normal_prediction γ hγ₀ hγ₁ h_mod h_perp_norm
      (fun u v hu hv => (h_c1 u v u hu hv hu).1)
      (fun u v hu hv z => (h_c1 u v u hu hv hu).2.2.2 z)
      h_fib_ent⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: admissible_packet_fixed_time_bessel
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys K_hor R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hK_hor : 1 ≤ K_hor) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hN_mult : 1 ≤ N_mult) :
    ∃ (C_Bes C_cnt : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧ 1 ≤ C_cnt ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ t → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (N_O : ℕ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
        (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ B_sys) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
        (let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
         let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
         ∀ (r : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
             r_O o = r ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤
             (N_mult : ℝ)) →
        ((N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * K_hor))) ∧
        (∀ (r : ℕ), r < 2 ^ m_time →
          ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_O)), (∀ o ∈ S, r_O o = r) →
          ∀ (h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ‖h v‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
            ∑ o ∈ S, generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ h
              (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
              C_Bes * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖h v‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: contributor_sampling_and_resampling_entropy
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2) :
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    (∀ {N_O N_D S_bins : ℕ} (hS : 1 ≤ S_bins)
       (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ) (w_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
       (bin_D : Fin N_D → Fin S_bins),
       (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
       (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) → 0 < m_O o) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let score_fn := fun q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ =>
         let q_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
         let q_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d
         (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +
         (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) / ell) +
         (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) +
         (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * w_D d)
       let π_b := fun b : Fin S_bins =>
         ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => bin_D d = b), p o d
       let p_b := fun (b : Fin S_bins) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) =>
         if bin_D d = b ∧ 0 < π_b b then p o d / π_b b else 0
       (∀ b, 0 ≤ π_b b) ∧ (∑ b : Fin S_bins, π_b b = 1) ∧
       (∀ b, 0 < π_b b → (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_b b o d) ∧ (∑ o, ∑ d, p_b b o d = 1) ∧
         (∀ o d, 0 < p_b b o d → bin_D d = b ∧ 0 < p o d)) ∧
       score_fn p ≤ (∑ b : Fin S_bins, if 0 < π_b b then π_b b * score_fn (p_b b) else 0) +
         Real.log (S_bins : ℝ) / ell) ∧
    (∀ {N_O N_D N_Z N_T N_R : ℕ} (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (m_O : Fin N_O → ℝ)
       (Z_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_Z) (r_Z : Fin N_Z → Fin N_R) (r_D : Fin N_D → Fin N_R)
       (T_of_Z : Fin N_Z → Finset (Fin N_T)) {K_mass : ℝ} {M_amb : ℕ},
       0 < K_mass → 1 ≤ M_amb →
       (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
       (∀ o, (0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) → 0 < m_O o) →
       (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → r_Z (Z_of o) = r_D d) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ z : Fin N_Z, (0 < ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), ∑ d, p o d) →
          (T_of_Z z).Nonempty ∧
          (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z),
            if 0 < ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d then m_O o else 0) ≤
            K_mass * ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ)) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (rv : Fin N_R),
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin N_Z => r_Z z = rv ∧ α ∈ T_of_Z z)).card : ℝ) ≤
            (M_amb : ℝ)) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
       let p_D := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p o d
       let p_ZD := fun z d => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), p o d
       let q := fun (z : Fin N_Z) (d : Fin N_D) (α : Fin N_T) =>
         if α ∈ T_of_Z z then p_ZD z d / ((T_of_Z z).card : ℝ) else 0
       let q_T := fun α => ∑ z, ∑ d, q z d α
       let q_TD := fun α d => ∑ z, q z d α
       let q_TR := fun α rv => ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => r_Z z = rv), ∑ d, q z d α
       (∀ z d α, 0 ≤ q z d α) ∧ (∑ z, ∑ d, ∑ α, q z d α = 1) ∧
       (∀ z d α, 0 < q z d α → α ∈ T_of_Z z ∧ ∃ o, Z_of o = z ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
       ((∑ o, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, p_O o * Real.log (m_O o)) / ell) ≤
        (∑ α, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d))) / ell) +
        (∑ α, ∑ rv, -(q_TR α rv * Real.log (q_TR α rv / q_T α))) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (M_amb : ℝ) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log K_mass / ell))) ∧
    ((∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},
       0 < B_fib → (∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) → (∑ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ y : Fin N_Y, (0 < ∑ x, P x y) →
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin N_X => 0 < P x y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib) →
       let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x, P x y
       (∑ x, ∑ y, -(P x y * Real.log (P x y / P_Y y))) / ell ≤ Real.log B_fib / ell) ∧
     (∀ {N_T N_D N_E N_M N_U : ℕ} (P : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ)
       (E_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_E) (M_of : Fin N_T → Fin N_M) (U_of : Fin N_D → Fin N_U)
       {K_EM : ℕ},
       1 ≤ N_E → 1 ≤ K_EM →
       (∀ α d, 0 ≤ P α d) → (∑ α, ∑ d, P α d = 1) →
       (letI := Classical.propDecidable
        ∀ e : Fin N_E,
          (((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e)).image M_of).card : ℝ) ≤ (K_EM : ℝ)) →
       letI := Classical.propDecidable
       let P_T := fun α => ∑ d, P α d
       let P_D := fun d => ∑ α, P α d
       let P_E := fun e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P_T α
       let P_DE := fun d e => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => E_of α = e), P α d
       let P_M := fun m => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m), P_T α
       let P_MU := fun m u =>
         ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => M_of α = m),
           ∑ d ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun d => U_of d = u), P α d
       let Q_TU := fun α u =>
         if 0 < P_M (M_of α) then P_T α * (P_MU (M_of α) u / P_M (M_of α)) else 0
       let Q_U := fun u => ∑ α, Q_TU α u
       (∀ α u, 0 ≤ Q_TU α u) ∧ (∑ α, ∑ u, Q_TU α u = 1) ∧
       (∀ α u, 0 < Q_TU α u → 0 < P_T α ∧
         ∃ α₀ d₀, M_of α₀ = M_of α ∧ U_of d₀ = u ∧ 0 < P α₀ d₀) ∧
       ((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α))) / ell - Real.log (N_E : ℝ) / ell ≤
         (∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell) ∧
       (((∑ α, -(P_T α * Real.log (P_T α / P_E (E_of α)))) / ell -
         (∑ α, ∑ d, -(P α d * Real.log (P α d / P_DE d (E_of α)))) / ell) ≤
        ((∑ α, ∑ u, -(Q_TU α u * Real.log (Q_TU α u / Q_U u))) / ell -
         (∑ α, ∑ d, -(P α d * Real.log (P α d / P_D d))) / ell) +
        Real.log (K_EM : ℝ) / ell)))

subgoal_signatures.name: mass_floor_and_credit_bin_selection
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ))
    (h_site_cnt : ∀ cls : PacketBoundClass,
      ∃ C_cnt : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_cnt ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          0 ≤ t → t ≤ H_P → cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)))
    (h_fib_ent : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},
        0 < B_fib → (∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) → (∑ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) →
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ y : Fin N_Y, (0 < ∑ x, P x y) →
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin N_X => 0 < P x y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib) →
        let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x, P x y
        (∑ x, ∑ y, -(P x y * Real.log (P x y / P_Y y))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
          Real.log B_fib / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :
    ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (t_min δ_mod : ℝ),
      0 < t_min → t_min ≤ cls.K_hor → 0 < δ_mod →
      ∃ ε_prep : ℝ, 0 < ε_prep ∧ ε_prep < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ) (m_t d_dim N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (Δ_cur k_f α_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_prep → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f → (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2 = 1) →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur ≤
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_f α_cur →
          let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
          let A₀ := 4 * cls.K_hor + 4
          (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t ≤ 1 / 4 →
            ∀ ζ_fl : ℝ, 0 < ζ_fl → ε ^ ζ_fl ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (N'_O : ℕ) (emb : Fin N'_O → Fin N_O) (p' : Fin N'_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              1 ≤ N'_O ∧ Function.Injective emb ∧
              (∀ o' d, 0 < p' o' d → 0 < p (emb o') d) ∧
              (∀ o' : Fin N'_O, ε ^ A₀ ≤
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  (r_O (emb o')) (V_O (emb o')) (X_O (emb o')) (ψ_O (emb o'))) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb)
                b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p' ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t - (4 * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t + 3 / ell) + δ_mod * t) ≤
                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D
                  (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb) b_D a_D p' ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N'_O N_D
                (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) e_D p' k_f
                (α_cur + ζ_fl + Real.log 4 / ell)) ∧
          (∀ (S_bins : ℕ) (E : Fin S_bins → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Prop) (p_union ζ_ret : ℝ),
            1 ≤ S_bins → (∀ o d, ∀ b₁ b₂, E b₁ o d → E b₂ o d → b₁ = b₂) →
            0 < p_union →
            (letI := Classical.propDecidable
             p_union ≤ ∑ b : Fin S_bins, ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
               if E b o d then p o d else 0) →
            0 < ζ_ret → ε ^ ζ_ret ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (b_sel : Fin S_bins) (p_sel : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              (∀ o d, 0 < p_sel o d → E b_sel o d ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_sel ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t -
                  ((4 / p_union) * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t +

informal_problem.statement:
{N_ω N_T : ℕ}
    (ε m : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (hπ_nn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω)
    (T : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V A : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s R_s : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :
    let O := fun ω' : Fin N_ω =>
      rowObs6 ε m (V (T ω')) (A (T ω')) (c_s ω') (R_s ω') q
    let kc := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => dyadicTimeBin ε q.2.2.2.2 (c_s ω')
    let kr := fun ω' : Fin N_ω => dyadicRealBin ε (m * q.2.2.2.2) (R_s ω')
    (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      condSurprise ε π X (fun ω' => [Y ω']) ω = condSurprise ε π X Y ω) ∧
    (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      0 < π ω → 0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω) ∧
    (∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (τ : ℝ),
      0 < τ →
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if τ < |condSurprise ε π X Y ω| then π ω else 0) ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y / τ) ∧
    (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
      condSurprise ε π T O ω =
        condSurprise ε π T kc ω + condSurprise ε π (fun ω' => (T ω', kc ω')) kr ω) ∧
    finCondEntropy ε π T O =
      finCondEntropy ε π T kc + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => (T ω', kc ω')) kr ∧
    finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) O =
      finMutualInfo ε π T O + finCondEntropy ε π T kc +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => (T ω', kc ω')) kr
