      by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h, hπ_nn ω']
  have h_prob2_le : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := by
    intro α β X Y ω
    dsimp only [finProbAt2, finProbAt]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases h1 : X ω' = X ω
    · by_cases h2 : Y ω' = Y ω <;> simp [h1, h2, hπ_nn ω']
    · simp [h1]
  have h_c1 : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      condSurprise ε π X (fun ω' => [Y ω']) ω = condSurprise ε π X Y ω := by
    intro α β X Y ω
    unfold condSurprise
    have h_eq : finProbAt2 π X (fun ω' => [Y ω']) ω = finProbAt2 π X Y ω := by
      dsimp only [finProbAt2]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω
      · have h' : X ω' = X ω ∧ [Y ω'] = [Y ω] := ⟨h.1, congrArg (fun z => [z]) h.2⟩
        simp only [h', h]
      · have h' : ¬ (X ω' = X ω ∧ [Y ω'] = [Y ω]) := fun hc =>
          h ⟨hc.1, List.singleton_inj.mp hc.2⟩
        simp only [h', h, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [h_eq]
  have h_c2 : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω),
      0 < π ω → 0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω := by
    intro α β X Y ω hpos
    unfold condSurprise
    have hp1 : 0 < finProbAt π X ω := h_prob1_pos X ω hpos
    have hp2 : 0 < finProbAt2 π X Y ω := h_prob2_pos X Y ω hpos
    have hp_le : finProbAt2 π X Y ω ≤ finProbAt π X ω := h_prob2_le X Y ω
    have h_div_nn : 0 ≤ finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω := div_nonneg hp2.le hp1.le
    have h_div_le1 : finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hp1).mpr hp_le
    have h_log_np : Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω) ≤ 0 :=
      Real.log_nonpos h_div_nn h_div_le1
    exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr h_log_np) hell_pos.le
  have h_c3 : ∀ {α β : Type} (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (τ : ℝ),
      0 < τ →
      (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if τ < |condSurprise ε π X Y ω| then π ω else 0) ≤
        finCondEntropy ε π X Y / τ := by
    intro α β X Y τ hτ
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hτ, Finset.sum_mul]
    unfold finCondEntropy
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < π ω
    · have h_nn : 0 ≤ condSurprise ε π X Y ω := h_c2 X Y ω hpos
      by_cases hgt : τ < |condSurprise ε π X Y ω|
      · simp only [hgt, ↓reduceIte]
        have hgt' : τ < condSurprise ε π X Y ω := by rwa [abs_of_nonneg h_nn] at hgt
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgt'.le (hπ_nn ω)
      · simp only [hgt, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
        exact mul_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) h_nn
    · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (hπ_nn ω)
      simp [h0]
  have h_TO_iff : ∀ ω' ω : Fin N_ω,
      (T ω' = T ω ∧ O ω' = O ω) ↔ ((T ω' = T ω ∧ kc ω' = kc ω) ∧ kr ω' = kr ω) := by
    intro ω' ω
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hT, hO⟩
      have hkc : kc ω' = kc ω := congrArg Prod.fst hO
      have hkr : kr ω' = kr ω := congrArg (fun z => z.2.1) hO
      exact ⟨⟨hT, hkc⟩, hkr⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hT, hkc⟩, hkr⟩
      refine ⟨hT, ?_⟩
      have hkc' : dyadicTimeBin ε v (c_s ω') = dyadicTimeBin ε v (c_s ω) := hkc
      have hkr' : dyadicRealBin ε (m * v) (R_s ω') = dyadicRealBin ε (m * v) (R_s ω) := hkr
      have hC : dyadicTimeMid ε v (c_s ω') = dyadicTimeMid ε v (c_s ω) := by
        unfold dyadicTimeMid
        rw [hkc']
      have hR : dyadicRealMid ε (m * v) (R_s ω') = dyadicRealMid ε (m * v) (R_s ω) := by
        unfold dyadicRealMid
        rw [hkr']
      dsimp only [O, rowObs6]
      rw [hT, hkc', hkr', hC, hR]
  have h_prob_Tkc : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
      finProbAt π (fun ω' => (T ω', kc ω')) ω = finProbAt2 π T kc ω := by
    intro ω
    dsimp only [finProbAt, finProbAt2]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    simp [Prod.ext_iff]
  have h_prob_Tkckr : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω,
      finProbAt2 π (fun ω' => (T ω', kc ω')) kr ω = finProbAt2 π T O ω := by
    intro ω
    dsimp only [finProbAt2]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω' _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : T ω' = T ω ∧ O ω' = O ω
    · rcases (h_TO_iff ω' ω).mp h with ⟨⟨hT, hkc⟩, hkr⟩
      simp [hT, hkc, hkr, h.2]
    · have h' : ¬ ((T ω', kc ω') = (T ω, kc ω) ∧ kr ω' = kr ω) := fun hc =>
        h ((h_TO_iff ω' ω).mpr ⟨⟨congrArg Prod.fst hc.1, congrArg Prod.snd hc.1⟩, hc.2⟩)
      simp only [h', h, ↓reduceIte]
  have h_c4 : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π ω →
      condSurprise ε π T O ω =
        condSurprise ε π T kc ω + condSurprise ε π (fun ω' => (T ω', kc ω')) kr ω := by
    intro ω hpos
    unfold condSurprise
    rw [h_prob_Tkc ω, h_prob_Tkckr ω]
    have hp_T : 0 < finProbAt π T ω := h_prob1_pos T ω hpos
    have hp_Tkc : 0 < finProbAt2 π T kc ω := h_prob2_pos T kc ω hpos
    have hp_TO : 0 < finProbAt2 π T O ω := h_prob2_pos T O ω hpos
    have h_mul : finProbAt2 π T O ω / finProbAt π T ω =
        (finProbAt2 π T O ω / finProbAt2 π T kc ω) *
          (finProbAt2 π T kc ω / finProbAt π T ω) := by
      have h1 : finProbAt π T ω ≠ 0 := hp_T.ne'
      have h2 : finProbAt2 π T kc ω ≠ 0 := hp_Tkc.ne'
      field_simp
    have h_log : Real.log (finProbAt2 π T O ω / finProbAt π T ω) =
        Real.log (finProbAt2 π T O ω / finProbAt2 π T kc ω) +
          Real.log (finProbAt2 π T kc ω / finProbAt π T ω) := by
      rw [h_mul]
      exact Real.log_mul (div_ne_zero hp_TO.ne' hp_Tkc.ne') (div_ne_zero hp_Tkc.ne' hp_T.ne')
    rw [h_log]
    ring
  have h_c5 : finCondEntropy ε π T O =
      finCondEntropy ε π T kc + finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => (T ω', kc ω')) kr := by
    unfold finCondEntropy
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpos : 0 < π ω
    · rw [h_c4 ω hpos, mul_add]
    · have h0 : π ω = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hpos) (hπ_nn ω)
      simp [h0]
  have h_c6 : finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) O =
      finMutualInfo ε π T O + finCondEntropy ε π T kc +
        finCondEntropy ε π (fun ω' => (T ω', kc ω')) kr := by
    unfold finMutualInfo
    linarith [h_c5]
  exact ⟨@h_c1, @h_c2, @h_c3, h_c4, h_c5, h_c6⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h ξ C_cov e_rep C_Bes_obs C_cnt_obs : ℝ) (d_dim : ℕ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (he_rep : 0 < e_rep) (h64ξ : 64 * ξ ≤ e_rep)
    (hCBes : 1 ≤ C_Bes_obs) (hCcnt : 1 ≤ C_cnt_obs) :
    ∃ ε_mbin : ℝ, 0 < ε_mbin ∧ ε_mbin < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
        (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
        (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (k_f α_cur k_out : ℝ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let M_thr := ε ^ (-(20 * cls.K_hor + 20))
        0 < ε → ε < ε_mbin → r = t - 2 * h → 0 < r → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        H_P ≤ cls.K_hor → L ≤ cls.K_hor →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        0 ≤ k_f → 0 ≤ α_cur → 0 ≤ k_out →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_f α_cur →
        ((N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt_obs * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor))) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O,
          generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
            C_Bes_obs) →
        (∀ j : Fin N_J,
          1 ≤ N_ret_of j ∧ 0 < (menu j).m_bin ∧
          1 ≤ C_cov * ε ^ (-(menu j).g_bin - 2 * ξ)) →
        (∀ (q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (H_in : ℝ),
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D q →
          (∀ o d, 0 < q o d → 0 < p o d ∧ (menu (win_of o)).m_bin ≤ M_thr) →
          (H_in ≤ 0 ∨
           (0 < k_f ∧
            ∃ (L_grid : ℝ) (τ_Vf τ_Xf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
              (n_f : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
              (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ),
              let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
              let s_Vf := L_grid * ε ^ (u_t - h)
              let s_Xf := L_grid * ε ^ (t + u_t - h)
              1 ≤ L_grid ∧ L_grid ≤ 4 ∧ (∀ p_c, ‖n_f p_c‖ = 1) ∧
              (∀ o : Fin N_O, (P_f o).1 = r_O o ∧
                ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)‖ ≤ s_Vf ∧
                ‖X_O o - (τ_Xf + gridPt2D s_Xf (P_f o).2.2)‖ ≤ s_Xf ∧
                (d_dim = 1 →
                  |inner ℝ (V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)) (n_f (P_f o)) -
                    ((W_f o).1 : ℝ) * ε ^ u_t| ≤ ε ^ u_t ∧ (W_f o).2 = 0) ∧
                (d_dim = 2 →
                  ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1) - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_t) (W_f o)‖ ≤
                    2 * ε ^ u_t)) ∧
              (d_dim = 1 → ∀ o d, 0 < q o d →
                projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_f (P_f o)) ≤ 4 * ε ^ h) ∧
              (let q_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
               let q_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), q_O o
               let q_PW := fun p_c w =>
                 ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w), q_O o
               H_in ≤ (∑ p_c ∈ Finset.univ.image P_f, ∑ w ∈ Finset.univ.image W_f,
                 -(q_PW p_c w * Real.log (q_PW p_c w / q_P p_c))) / ell))) →
          let π_q := fun j : Fin N_J =>
            ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
          let H_Jq := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_q j * Real.log (π_q j))) / ell
          let B_rq := H_Jq + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
            N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q ≤
            B_rq + γ * h + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - H_in) + e_rep / 2) →
        let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
          ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
        let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
        let B_r := H_J + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
          N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
          B_r + γ * h + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (k_out - k_f + α_cur) + e_rep

proof.tactics:
by
  let A_const : ℝ :=
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_cnt_obs +
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_Bes_obs +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_cov +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 225 +
    Real.log 2
  have hlog_cnt_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log C_cnt_obs := Real.log_nonneg hCcnt
  have hlog_bes_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log C_Bes_obs := Real.log_nonneg hCBes
  have hlog_cov_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log C_cov := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlog_225_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (225 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hlog_2_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  let ε_mbin : ℝ := min (1 / 4) ((Real.exp ((A_const + 1) / (e_rep / 4)))⁻¹)
  have hε_mbin_pos : 0 < ε_mbin :=
    lt_min (by norm_num) (inv_pos.mpr (Real.exp_pos _))
  have hε_mbin_lt : ε_mbin < 1 / 2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)

  have h_ell_pos : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [one_lt_inv₀ hε₀]
    linarith

  have h_log_div_ell : ∀ {ε A δ : ℝ},
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < δ →
      ε < (Real.exp ((A + 1) / δ))⁻¹ →
      A / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤ δ := by
    intro ε A δ hε₀ hε₁ hδ hlt
    have hell : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hell]
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp ((A + 1) / δ) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hinv_lt : Real.exp ((A + 1) / δ) < ε⁻¹ := (lt_inv_comm₀ hε₀ hexp_pos).mp hlt
    have hlog_lt : (A + 1) / δ < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
      have h1 := Real.log_lt_log hexp_pos hinv_lt
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at h1
    have hmul := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp hlog_lt
    linarith

  have h_log_rpow_eps : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ∀ a : ℝ,
      Real.log (ε ^ a) = -a * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ a
    rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀ a, Real.log_inv]
    ring

  have h_card_ent : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U K : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) → 0 < K → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K →
      ∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) ≤ U * Real.log K := by
    intro α S u U K hu_nn hU hK hcard
    have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := by rw [← hU]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg hu_nn
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · have hz : ∀ i ∈ S, u i = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hu_nn).mp (hU.trans hU0)
      rw [hU0, zero_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => by simp [hz i hi])]
    · have hU_pos : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU_nn (Ne.symm hU0)
      have h_pt : ∀ i ∈ S,
          -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) ≤ u i * Real.log K + (U / K - u i) := by
        intro i hi
        by_cases hui0 : u i = 0
        · simp only [hui0, zero_mul, neg_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]
          exact div_nonneg hU_pos.le hK.le
        · have hui : 0 < u i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hu_nn i hi) (Ne.symm hui0)
          have hq_pos : 0 < u i / U := div_pos hui hU_pos
          have hx_pos : 0 < K⁻¹ * (u i / U)⁻¹ :=
            mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hK) (inv_pos.mpr hq_pos)
          have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx_pos
          rw [Real.log_mul (inv_ne_zero hK.ne') (inv_ne_zero hq_pos.ne'),
            Real.log_inv, Real.log_inv] at hlog
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hui.le
          have h_rhs : u i * (K⁻¹ * (u i / U)⁻¹ - 1) = U / K - u i := by
            field_simp [hK.ne', hui.ne', hU_pos.ne']
          rw [h_rhs] at hmul
          linarith
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
      have h_eval : ∑ i ∈ S, (u i * Real.log K + (U / K - u i)) =
          U * Real.log K + (S.card : ℝ) * (U / K) - U := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
          Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hU]
        ring
      rw [h_eval] at hsum
      have h_card_mul : (S.card : ℝ) * (U / K) ≤ K * (U / K) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (div_nonneg hU_pos.le hK.le)
      have h_cancel : K * (U / K) = U := mul_div_cancel₀ U hK.ne'
      linarith

  have h_card_ent_one : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (K : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = 1) → 0 < K → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K →
      ∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i)) ≤ Real.log K := by
    intro α S u K hu_nn h1 hK hcard
    have h := h_card_ent S u 1 K hu_nn h1 hK hcard
    simpa only [div_one, one_mul] using h

  have h_disj_ent : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (b : α → Bool) (u : α → ℝ) {P₁ P₂ : ℝ},
      0 < P₁ → 0 < P₂ →
      (∑ i ∈ S, if b i = true then u i else 0) = P₁ →
      (∑ i ∈ S, if b i = false then u i else 0) = P₂ →
      let u₁ := fun i => if b i = true then u i / P₁ else 0
      let u₂ := fun i => if b i = false then u i / P₂ else 0
      ∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i)) =
        P₁ * (∑ i ∈ S, -(u₁ i * Real.log (u₁ i))) +
        P₂ * (∑ i ∈ S, -(u₂ i * Real.log (u₂ i))) -
        P₁ * Real.log P₁ - P₂ * Real.log P₂ := by
    intro α S b u P₁ P₂ hP₁ hP₂ hsum₁ hsum₂ u₁ u₂
    have h_pt : ∀ i ∈ S,
        -(u i * Real.log (u i)) =
          P₁ * -(u₁ i * Real.log (u₁ i)) +
          P₂ * -(u₂ i * Real.log (u₂ i)) -
          (if b i = true then u i else 0) * Real.log P₁ -
          (if b i = false then u i else 0) * Real.log P₂ := by
      intro i _
      dsimp only [u₁, u₂]
      cases hb : b i
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, neg_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]
        by_cases hui0 : u i = 0
        · simp [hui0]
        · rw [Real.log_div hui0 hP₂.ne']
          have hc : P₂ * (u i / P₂) = u i := mul_div_cancel₀ (u i) hP₂.ne'
          have hr : P₂ * -(u i / P₂ * (Real.log (u i) - Real.log P₂)) =
              -(P₂ * (u i / P₂)) * (Real.log (u i) - Real.log P₂) := by ring
          rw [hr, hc]
          ring
      · simp only [↓reduceIte, Bool.true_eq_false, zero_mul, neg_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]
        by_cases hui0 : u i = 0
        · simp [hui0]
        · rw [Real.log_div hui0 hP₁.ne']
          have hc : P₁ * (u i / P₁) = u i := mul_div_cancel₀ (u i) hP₁.ne'
          have hr : P₁ * -(u i / P₁ * (Real.log (u i) - Real.log P₁)) =
              -(P₁ * (u i / P₁)) * (Real.log (u i) - Real.log P₁) := by ring
          rw [hr, hc]
          ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_pt]
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
      ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, hsum₁, hsum₂]

  have h_bin_cond_ent : ∀ {α β : Type} (S_X : Finset α) (S_Y : Finset β)
      (q₁ q₂ : α → β → ℝ) {P₁ P₂ : ℝ},
      0 < P₁ → 0 < P₂ →
      (∀ x ∈ S_X, ∀ y ∈ S_Y, 0 ≤ q₁ x y) →
      (∀ x ∈ S_X, ∀ y ∈ S_Y, 0 ≤ q₂ x y) →
      let p := fun x y => P₁ * q₁ x y + P₂ * q₂ x y
      let Q₁ := fun y => ∑ x ∈ S_X, q₁ x y
      let Q₂ := fun y => ∑ x ∈ S_X, q₂ x y
      let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x ∈ S_X, p x y
      ∑ y ∈ S_Y, ∑ x ∈ S_X, -(p x y * Real.log (p x y / P_Y y)) ≤
        P₁ * (∑ y ∈ S_Y, ∑ x ∈ S_X, -(q₁ x y * Real.log (q₁ x y / Q₁ y))) +
        P₂ * (∑ y ∈ S_Y, ∑ x ∈ S_X, -(q₂ x y * Real.log (q₂ x y / Q₂ y))) +
        (∑ y ∈ S_Y, P_Y y) * Real.log 2 := by
    intro α β S_X S_Y q₁ q₂ P₁ P₂ hP₁ hP₂ hq₁_nn hq₂_nn p Q₁ Q₂ P_Y
    have h_part : ∀ (P_k : ℝ) (q_k r_other : α → β → ℝ),
        0 < P_k →
        (∀ x ∈ S_X, ∀ y ∈ S_Y, 0 ≤ q_k x y) →
        (∀ x ∈ S_X, ∀ y ∈ S_Y, 0 ≤ r_other x y) →
        ∀ y ∈ S_Y, ∀ x ∈ S_X,
          let Q_ky := ∑ x' ∈ S_X, q_k x' y;
          let U_ky := P_k * Q_ky;
          let p_xy := P_k * q_k x y + r_other x y;
          let P_Yy := U_ky + ∑ x' ∈ S_X, r_other x' y;
          -((P_k * q_k x y) * Real.log (p_xy / P_Yy)) ≤
            P_k * -(q_k x y * Real.log (q_k x y / Q_ky)) -
            (P_k * q_k x y) * Real.log (U_ky / P_Yy) := by
      intro P_k q_k r_other hPk hqk_nn hro_nn y hy x hx Q_ky U_ky p_xy P_Yy
      by_cases hqk0 : q_k x y = 0
      · simp [hqk0]
      · have hqk_pos : 0 < q_k x y := lt_of_le_of_ne (hqk_nn x hx y hy) (Ne.symm hqk0)
        have hQ_ge : q_k x y ≤ Q_ky :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun x' hx' => hqk_nn x' hx' y hy) hx
        have hQ_pos : 0 < Q_ky := lt_of_lt_of_le hqk_pos hQ_ge
        have hU_pos : 0 < U_ky := mul_pos hPk hQ_pos
        have hro_sum_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ x' ∈ S_X, r_other x' y :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x' hx' => hro_nn x' hx' y hy)
        have hPY_pos : 0 < P_Yy := by dsimp only [P_Yy]; linarith
        have h_prod_eq : (q_k x y / Q_ky) * (U_ky / P_Yy) = (P_k * q_k x y) / P_Yy := by
          dsimp only [U_ky]
          field_simp [hQ_pos.ne', hPY_pos.ne']
        have h_num_le : P_k * q_k x y ≤ p_xy := by
          dsimp only [p_xy]
          linarith [hro_nn x hx y hy]
        have h_div_le : (q_k x y / Q_ky) * (U_ky / P_Yy) ≤ p_xy / P_Yy := by
          rw [h_prod_eq]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le hPY_pos.le
        have hr1_pos : 0 < q_k x y / Q_ky := div_pos hqk_pos hQ_pos
        have hr2_pos : 0 < U_ky / P_Yy := div_pos hU_pos hPY_pos
        have hlog_le := Real.log_le_log (mul_pos hr1_pos hr2_pos) h_div_le
        rw [Real.log_mul hr1_pos.ne' hr2_pos.ne'] at hlog_le
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_le (mul_pos hPk hqk_pos).le
        linarith
    have h_y : ∀ y ∈ S_Y,
        ∑ x ∈ S_X, -(p x y * Real.log (p x y / P_Y y)) ≤
          P₁ * (∑ x ∈ S_X, -(q₁ x y * Real.log (q₁ x y / Q₁ y))) +
          P₂ * (∑ x ∈ S_X, -(q₂ x y * Real.log (q₂ x y / Q₂ y))) +
          P_Y y * Real.log 2 := by
      intro y hy
      let U₁ := P₁ * Q₁ y
      let U₂ := P₂ * Q₂ y
      have hPY_eq : P_Y y = U₁ + U₂ := by
        dsimp only [P_Y, p, U₁, U₂, Q₁, Q₂]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have h_x : ∀ x ∈ S_X,
          -(p x y * Real.log (p x y / P_Y y)) ≤
            P₁ * -(q₁ x y * Real.log (q₁ x y / Q₁ y)) +
            P₂ * -(q₂ x y * Real.log (q₂ x y / Q₂ y)) -
            (P₁ * q₁ x y) * Real.log (U₁ / P_Y y) -
            (P₂ * q₂ x y) * Real.log (U₂ / P_Y y) := by
        intro x hx
        have h1 := h_part P₁ q₁ (fun x' y' => P₂ * q₂ x' y') hP₁ hq₁_nn
          (fun x' hx' y' hy' => mul_nonneg hP₂.le (hq₂_nn x' hx' y' hy')) y hy x hx
        have h2 := h_part P₂ q₂ (fun x' y' => P₁ * q₁ x' y') hP₂ hq₂_nn
          (fun x' hx' y' hy' => mul_nonneg hP₁.le (hq₁_nn x' hx' y' hy')) y hy x hx
        have hp_eq2 : P₂ * q₂ x y + P₁ * q₁ x y = p x y := by dsimp only [p]; ring
        have hPY_eq1 : P₁ * (∑ x' ∈ S_X, q₁ x' y) + ∑ x' ∈ S_X, P₂ * q₂ x' y = P_Y y := by
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; exact hPY_eq.symm
        have hPY_eq2 : P₂ * (∑ x' ∈ S_X, q₂ x' y) + ∑ x' ∈ S_X, P₁ * q₁ x' y = P_Y y := by
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum, add_comm]; exact hPY_eq.symm
        dsimp only at h1 h2
        rw [hPY_eq1] at h1
        rw [hp_eq2, hPY_eq2] at h2
        have hsplit : -(p x y * Real.log (p x y / P_Y y)) =
            -((P₁ * q₁ x y) * Real.log (p x y / P_Y y)) +
            -((P₂ * q₂ x y) * Real.log (p x y / P_Y y)) := by
          dsimp only [p]; ring
        linarith
      have hsum_x := Finset.sum_le_sum h_x
      have h_rhs_x : ∑ x ∈ S_X, (P₁ * -(q₁ x y * Real.log (q₁ x y / Q₁ y)) +
            P₂ * -(q₂ x y * Real.log (q₂ x y / Q₂ y)) -
            (P₁ * q₁ x y) * Real.log (U₁ / P_Y y) -
            (P₂ * q₂ x y) * Real.log (U₂ / P_Y y)) =
          P₁ * (∑ x ∈ S_X, -(q₁ x y * Real.log (q₁ x y / Q₁ y))) +
          P₂ * (∑ x ∈ S_X, -(q₂ x y * Real.log (q₂ x y / Q₂ y))) +
          (-(U₁ * Real.log (U₁ / P_Y y)) + -(U₂ * Real.log (U₂ / P_Y y))) := by
        simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
          ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
        dsimp only [U₁, U₂, Q₁, Q₂]
        ring
      rw [h_rhs_x] at hsum_x
      have hU1_nn : 0 ≤ U₁ :=
        mul_nonneg hP₁.le (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x hx => hq₁_nn x hx y hy))
      have hU2_nn : 0 ≤ U₂ :=
        mul_nonneg hP₂.le (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x hx => hq₂_nn x hx y hy))
      let u_bin : Fin 2 → ℝ := fun i => if i = 0 then U₁ else U₂
      have h_bin := h_card_ent (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) u_bin (P_Y y) 2
        (fun i _ => by dsimp only [u_bin]; split_ifs; exact hU1_nn; exact hU2_nn)
        (by rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]; dsimp only [u_bin]; simp [hPY_eq])
        (by norm_num)
        (by simp)
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h_bin
      dsimp only [u_bin] at h_bin
      rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0)] at h_bin
      linarith
    have hsum_y := Finset.sum_le_sum h_y
    simpa only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul] using hsum_y

  have h_fib_sum : ∀ {N K : ℕ} (g : Fin N → Fin K) (u : Fin N → ℝ)
      (dec : ∀ k : Fin K, DecidablePred (fun o : Fin N => g o = k)),
      let π := fun k : Fin K =>
        ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun o => g o = k) (dec k) Finset.univ, u o;
      (∑ k : Fin K, π k = ∑ o : Fin N, u o) ∧
      (∀ b : Fin K → Bool,
        (∑ k : Fin K, if b k = true then π k else 0) =
          ∑ o : Fin N, if b (g o) = true then u o else 0) ∧
      (∀ b : Fin K → Bool,
        (∑ k : Fin K, if b k = false then π k else 0) =
          ∑ o : Fin N, if b (g o) = false then u o else 0) := by
    intro N K g u dec π
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_))
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ g u)
      dsimp only [π]
      exact Finset.sum_congr (by ext o; simp) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    · intro b
      refine Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_))
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ g (fun o => if b (g o) = true then u o else 0))
      dsimp only [π]
      by_cases hbk : b k = true
      · rw [if_pos hbk]
        refine Finset.sum_congr (by ext o; simp) (fun o ho => ?_)
        rw [((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun a => instDecidableEqFin K (g a) k) _ _).mp ho).2, if_pos hbk]
      · rw [if_neg hbk]
        refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => ?_)).symm
        rw [((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun a => instDecidableEqFin K (g a) k) _ _).mp ho).2, if_neg hbk]
    · intro b
      refine Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_))
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ g (fun o => if b (g o) = false then u o else 0))
      dsimp only [π]
      by_cases hbk : b k = false
      · rw [if_pos hbk]
        refine Finset.sum_congr (by ext o; simp) (fun o ho => ?_)
        rw [((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun a => instDecidableEqFin K (g a) k) _ _).mp ho).2, if_pos hbk]
      · rw [if_neg hbk]
        refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => ?_)).symm
        rw [((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ (fun a => instDecidableEqFin K (g a) k) _ _).mp ho).2, if_neg hbk]

  have h_pw_sum : ∀ {N : ℕ} {α_P α_W : Type} (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_W : Finset α_W)
      (P_f : Fin N → α_P) (W_f : Fin N → α_W) (u : Fin N → ℝ)
      (decP : ∀ p_c, DecidablePred (fun o => P_f o = p_c))
      (decPW : ∀ p_c w, DecidablePred (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w)),
      (∀ o, P_f o ∈ S_P) → (∀ o, W_f o ∈ S_W) →
      (∀ p_c,
        (∑ w ∈ S_W, ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w) (decPW p_c w) Finset.univ, u o) =
          ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ, u o) ∧
      ((∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ, u o) =
        ∑ o : Fin N, u o) := by
    intro N α_P α_W S_P S_W P_f W_f u decP decPW hP hW
    classical
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p_c
      let sP := @Finset.filter (Fin N) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ
      refine Eq.trans
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ =>
          Finset.sum_congr (by ext o; simp only [sP, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and])
            (fun _ _ => rfl)))
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun o _ => hW o) u)
    · refine Eq.trans
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ =>
          Finset.sum_congr (by ext o; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and])
            (fun _ _ => rfl)))
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun o _ => hP o) u)

  have h_wf_card : ∀ {ε H_P t L_grid : ℝ} {N_O : ℕ}
      (τ_Vf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (V_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
      (n_f : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ)
      (S_W : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → L_grid ≤ 4 →
      (∀ p_c, ‖n_f p_c‖ = 1) →
      (let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
       let s_Vf := L_grid * ε ^ (u_t - h)
       ∀ o : Fin N_O,
         ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)‖ ≤ s_Vf ∧
         (d_dim = 1 →
           |inner ℝ (V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)) (n_f (P_f o)) -
             ((W_f o).1 : ℝ) * ε ^ u_t| ≤ ε ^ u_t ∧ (W_f o).2 = 0) ∧
         (d_dim = 2 →
           ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1) - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_t) (W_f o)‖ ≤
             2 * ε ^ u_t)) →
      (∀ w ∈ S_W, ∃ o : Fin N_O, W_f o = w) →
      (S_W.card : ℝ) ≤ 225 * ε ^ (-2 * h) := by
    intro ε H_P t L_grid N_O τ_Vf V_O P_f n_f W_f S_W hε₀ hε₁ hL4 hnf hgeom hSW
    let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
    let s_Vf := L_grid * ε ^ (u_t - h)
    have h_ut_pos : 0 < ε ^ u_t := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ u_t

      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hε₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)

    let R_W : ℝ := 4 * ε ^ (-h) + 2
    have hR_W_nn : 0 ≤ R_W := by dsimp only [R_W]; linarith
    have h_w_bound : ∀ o : Fin N_O,
        |((W_f o).1 : ℝ)| ≤ R_W ∧ |((W_f o).2 : ℝ)| ≤ R_W := by
      intro o
      obtain ⟨hv, hw1, hw2⟩ := hgeom o
      change ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)‖ ≤ s_Vf at hv
      let ΔV := V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)
      rcases hd_dim with hd1 | hd2
      · obtain ⟨h_in_abs, hw2_0⟩ := hw1 hd1
        have hin_le : |inner ℝ ΔV (n_f (P_f o))| ≤ s_Vf := by
          calc |inner ℝ ΔV (n_f (P_f o))|
              ≤ ‖ΔV‖ * ‖n_f (P_f o)‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm ΔV (n_f (P_f o))
            _ = ‖ΔV‖ * 1 := by rw [hnf (P_f o)]

        obtain ⟨hi1, hi2⟩ := abs_le.mp hin_le
        obtain ⟨hd1_lo, hd1_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp h_in_abs
        have h_prod_abs : |((W_f o).1 : ℝ) * ε ^ u_t| ≤ R_W * ε ^ u_t := by
          refine abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · dsimp only [R_W]; linarith
          · dsimp only [R_W]; linarith
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_ut_pos] at h_prod_abs
        refine ⟨le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_prod_abs h_ut_pos, ?_⟩
        rw [hw2_0, Int.cast_zero, abs_zero]
        exact hR_W_nn
      · have h_d2 := hw2 hd2
        let gW := gridPt2D (ε ^ u_t) (W_f o)
        have hgW_eq : gW = ΔV - (ΔV - gW) := (sub_sub_cancel ΔV gW).symm
        have hgW_norm : ‖gW‖ ≤ R_W * ε ^ u_t := by
          rw [hgW_eq]
          have htri := norm_sub_le ΔV (ΔV - gW)
          dsimp only [R_W]

        have hc1 : |gW 1| ≤ ‖gW‖ := by

    let B_W : ℤ := Int.floor R_W
    have hBW_nn : 0 ≤ B_W := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr hR_W_nn
    have hBW_le : (B_W : ℝ) ≤ R_W := Int.floor_le R_W
    have h_mem_icc : ∀ m : ℤ, |(m : ℝ)| ≤ R_W → m ∈ Finset.Icc (-B_W) B_W := by

      have hnm_hi : -m ≤ B_W := Int.le_floor.mpr (by push_cast; linarith)

    let box_W : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := Finset.Icc (-B_W) B_W ×ˢ Finset.Icc (-B_W) B_W

    have h_card_nat : S_W.card ≤ box_W.card := Finset.card_le_card h_sub

      have h_cast : ((Finset.Icc (-B_W) B_W).card : ℝ) = 2 * (B_W : ℝ) + 1 := by
        have h1 : (((Finset.Icc (-B_W) B_W).card : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((B_W + 1 - (-B_W) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by

      linarith

    have h_box_real : (box_W.card : ℝ) ≤ 225 * ε ^ (-2 * h) := by
      have hprod : (box_W.card : ℝ) =

        rfl

      have hrhs : (15 * ε ^ (-h)) * (15 * ε ^ (-h)) = 225 * ε ^ (-2 * h) := by

  have h_score_ub : ∀ {ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ} {m_t N_O N_D : ℕ}
      {Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ}
      {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ}
      {r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ} {V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
      {ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ}
      {b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ} {r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ}
      {e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
      (q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < t → H_P ≤ cls.K_hor →
      ((N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt_obs * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor))) →
      (∀ o : Fin N_O,
        generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
          C_Bes_obs) →
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D q →
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q ≤
        (13 / 2 : ℝ) * cls.K_hor +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log C_cnt_obs / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log C_Bes_obs / ell) := by
    intro ε H_P L t lam_sys m_t N_O N_D Φ₀ f r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D q
      hε₀ hε₁ ht_pos hHP_K hNO_cnt hobs_bes hadm_q ell
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    have hq_d := hadm_q.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have hq_nn := hadm_q.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have hq_sum := hadm_q.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have hq_act := hadm_q.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
    let q_O : Fin N_O → ℝ := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
    let q_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d
    have hqO_nn : ∀ o : Fin N_O, 0 ≤ q_O o :=
      fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq_nn o d)
    have hqD_nn : ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ q_D d :=
      fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hq_nn o d)
    have hqO_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o = 1 := hq_sum
    have hqD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d = 1 := by
      dsimp only [q_D]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact hq_sum
    let K_cnt : ℝ := C_cnt_obs * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor))
    have hCcnt_pos : 0 < C_cnt_obs := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hCcnt
    have hrp_cnt_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
    have hK_cnt_pos : 0 < K_cnt := mul_pos hCcnt_pos hrp_cnt_pos
    have hcard_NO : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)).card : ℝ) ≤ K_cnt := by
      simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hNO_cnt
    have hlog_Kcnt : Real.log K_cnt = Real.log C_cnt_obs + 4 * cls.K_hor * ell := by
      dsimp only [K_cnt, ell]
      rw [Real.log_mul hCcnt_pos.ne' hrp_cnt_pos.ne', h_log_rpow_eps hε₀]
      ring
    have h_HO : (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell ≤
        4 * cls.K_hor + Real.log C_cnt_obs / ell := by
      have h1 := h_card_ent_one Finset.univ q_O K_cnt (fun o _ => hqO_nn o) hqO_sum hK_cnt_pos hcard_NO
      rw [hlog_Kcnt] at h1
      have h2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hell_pos.le
      have heq : (Real.log C_cnt_obs + 4 * cls.K_hor * ell) / ell =
          4 * cls.K_hor + Real.log C_cnt_obs / ell := by
        field_simp [hell_pos.ne']; ring
      rwa [heq] at h2
    have h_HOD : (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) / ell ≤
        4 * cls.K_hor + Real.log C_cnt_obs / ell := by
      have h_per_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d)) ≤ q_D d * Real.log K_cnt :=
        fun d => h_card_ent Finset.univ (fun o => q o d) (q_D d) K_cnt
          (fun o _ => hq_nn o d) rfl hK_cnt_pos hcard_NO
      have h1 : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d)) ≤ Real.log K_cnt := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        calc ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))
            ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * Real.log K_cnt := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_per_d d)
          _ = (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d) * Real.log K_cnt := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          _ = Real.log K_cnt := by rw [hqD_sum, one_mul]
      rw [hlog_Kcnt] at h1
      have h2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hell_pos.le
      have heq : (Real.log C_cnt_obs + 4 * cls.K_hor * ell) / ell =
          4 * cls.K_hor + Real.log C_cnt_obs / ell := by
        field_simp [hell_pos.ne']; ring
      rwa [heq] at h2
    have h_Emass : (∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o * Real.log
        (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell ≤
        Real.log C_Bes_obs / ell := by
      have h_pt : ∀ o : Fin N_O,
          q_O o * Real.log (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) ≤
            q_O o * Real.log C_Bes_obs := by
        intro o
        by_cases hqO0 : q_O o = 0
        · simp [hqO0]
        · have hqO_pos : 0 < q_O o := lt_of_le_of_ne (hqO_nn o) (Ne.symm hqO0)
          obtain ⟨d, _, hqod⟩ :=
            (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun d _ => hq_nn o d)).mp hqO_pos
          have hm_pos := (hq_act o d hqod).1
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_log hm_pos (hobs_bes o)) hqO_pos.le
      have hsum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o * Real.log
            (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) ≤
          Real.log C_Bes_obs := by
        calc ∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o * Real.log _
            ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o * Real.log C_Bes_obs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun o _ => h_pt o)
          _ = (∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o) * Real.log C_Bes_obs := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          _ = Real.log C_Bes_obs := by rw [hqO_sum, one_mul]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsum hell_pos.le
    have h_Ew : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) ≤ cls.K_hor := by
      have h_pt : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
          q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) ≤ q_D d * cls.K_hor := by
        intro d
        obtain ⟨hb0, hba, ha_min, _⟩ := hq_d d
        have ha_ut : a_D d ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 := le_trans ha_min (min_le_right _ _)
        have ha_K : a_D d ≤ cls.K_hor / 2 := by linarith
        have hb_K : b_D d ≤ cls.K_hor / 2 := le_trans hba ha_K
        have h1 : (1 + γ) * b_D d ≤ (1 + γ) * (cls.K_hor / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb_K (by linarith)
        have h2 : (1 - γ) * a_D d ≤ (1 - γ) * (cls.K_hor / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha_K (by linarith)
        have hw_le : (1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d ≤ cls.K_hor := by linarith
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_le (hqD_nn d)
      calc ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
          ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * cls.K_hor := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_pt d)
        _ = (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d) * cls.K_hor := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = cls.K_hor := by rw [hqD_sum, one_mul]
    unfold generalPacketScore
    dsimp only [ell, q_O, q_D] at h_HO h_HOD h_Emass h_Ew ⊢
    linarith

  have h_Br_huge_lb : ∀ {ε b_star : ℝ} {N_J : ℕ}
      {N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ}
      {menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j)}
      (π_q : Fin N_J → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 ≤ b_star →
      (∀ j : Fin N_J,
        1 ≤ N_ret_of j ∧ 0 < (menu j).m_bin ∧
        1 ≤ C_cov * ε ^ (-(menu j).g_bin - 2 * ξ)) →
      (∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ π_q j) →
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j = 1) →
      (∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_q j → ε ^ (-(20 * cls.K_hor + 20)) < (menu j).m_bin) →

    intro ε b_star N_J N_ret_of menu π_q hε₀ hε₁ hb_star0 hmenu hπ_nn hπ_sum hπ_huge ell H_Jq

      · have hπ_pos : 0 < π_q j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_nn j) (Ne.symm hπ0)
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hπ_pos.le
        obtain ⟨hN1, _, hcov⟩ := hmenu j
        have hN_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (N_ret_of j : ℝ) / ell := by
          have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N_ret_of j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN1
          exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg h1) hell_pos.le
        have hm_gt := hπ_huge j hπ_pos
        have hM_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-(20 * cls.K_hor + 20)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
        have hlog_m := Real.log_le_log hM_pos hm_gt.le
        rw [h_log_rpow_eps hε₀] at hlog_m
        have hm_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog_m hell_pos.le
        have hm_eq : (- -(20 * cls.K_hor + 20) * ell) / ell = 20 * cls.K_hor + 20 := by

        rw [hm_eq] at hm_div
        have hCcov_pos : 0 < C_cov := by linarith

        have hlog_c := Real.log_le_log zero_lt_one hcov
        rw [Real.log_one, Real.log_mul hCcov_pos.ne' hrp_pos.ne', h_log_rpow_eps hε₀] at hlog_c

        rw [hc_eq] at hc_div
        unfold subclassProxyA

    have hsum_j : L_huge ≤ ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j) := by
      calc L_huge = (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j) * L_huge := by rw [hπ_sum, one_mul]

        _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => h_pt j)
    dsimp only [L_huge] at hsum_j
    linarith

  have h_cred_ub : ∀ {ε : ℝ} {N_O N_D : ℕ} {α_P α_W : Type}
      (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_W : Finset α_W)
      (P_f : Fin N_O → α_P) (W_f : Fin N_O → α_W)
      (decP : ∀ p_c, DecidablePred (fun o => P_f o = p_c))
      (decPW : ∀ p_c w, DecidablePred (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w))
      (q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 2 * h ≤ cls.K_hor →
      (∀ o, P_f o ∈ S_P) → (∀ o, W_f o ∈ S_W) →
      (S_W.card : ℝ) ≤ 225 * ε ^ (-2 * h) →
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ q o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d = 1) →
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      let q_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
      let q_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ, q_O o
      let q_PW := fun p_c w => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w) (decPW p_c w) Finset.univ, q_O o;
      (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q_PW p_c w * Real.log (q_PW p_c w / q_P p_c))) / ell ≤
        cls.K_hor + Real.log 225 / ell := by
    intro ε N_O N_D α_P α_W S_P S_W P_f W_f decP decPW q
      hε₀ hε₁ h2h_K hP hW hcard_SW hq_nn hq_sum ell q_O q_P q_PW
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    have hqO_nn : ∀ o : Fin N_O, 0 ≤ q_O o :=
      fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq_nn o d)
    obtain ⟨h_sum_w, h_sum_p⟩ := h_pw_sum S_P S_W P_f W_f q_O decP decPW hP hW
    let K_W : ℝ := 225 * ε ^ (-2 * h)
    have hrp_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-2 * h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
    have hKW_pos : 0 < K_W := mul_pos (by norm_num) hrp_pos
    have hlog_KW : Real.log K_W = Real.log 225 + 2 * h * ell := by
      dsimp only [K_W, ell]
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hrp_pos.ne', h_log_rpow_eps hε₀]
      ring
    have h_per_pc : ∀ p_c ∈ S_P,
        ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q_PW p_c w * Real.log (q_PW p_c w / q_P p_c)) ≤ q_P p_c * Real.log K_W := by
      intro p_c _
      exact h_card_ent S_W (q_PW p_c) (q_P p_c) K_W
        (fun w _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hqO_nn o))
        (h_sum_w p_c) hKW_pos hcard_SW
    have h_tot : ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q_PW p_c w * Real.log (q_PW p_c w / q_P p_c)) ≤
        Real.log K_W := by
      calc ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q_PW p_c w * Real.log (q_PW p_c w / q_P p_c))
          ≤ ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, q_P p_c * Real.log K_W := Finset.sum_le_sum h_per_pc
        _ = (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, q_P p_c) * Real.log K_W := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = Real.log K_W := by rw [h_sum_p, hq_sum, one_mul]
    rw [hlog_KW] at h_tot
    have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_tot hell_pos.le
    have h_eq : (Real.log 225 + 2 * h * ell) / ell = 2 * h + Real.log 225 / ell := by
      field_simp [hell_pos.ne']; ring
    rw [h_eq] at h_div
    linarith

  have h_cred_lb : ∀ {ε k_f α_cur : ℝ} {N_O N_D : ℕ} {α_P α_W : Type}
      (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_W : Finset α_W)
      (P_f : Fin N_O → α_P) (W_f : Fin N_O → α_W)
      (decP : ∀ p_c, DecidablePred (fun o => P_f o = p_c))
      (decPW : ∀ p_c w, DecidablePred (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w))
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ o, P_f o ∈ S_P) → (∀ o, W_f o ∈ S_W) →
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
      (let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
       let p_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ, p_O o
       let p_PW := fun p_c w => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w) (decPW p_c w) Finset.univ, p_O o
       ∀ p_c w, p_PW p_c w ≤ ε ^ (k_f - α_cur) * p_P p_c) →
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
      let p_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ, p_O o
      let p_PW := fun p_c w => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w) (decPW p_c w) Finset.univ, p_O o
      k_f - α_cur ≤
        (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) / ell := by
    intro ε k_f α_cur N_O N_D α_P α_W S_P S_W P_f W_f decP decPW p
      hε₀ hε₁ hP hW hp_nn hp_sum hcap ell p_O p_P p_PW
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    have hpO_nn : ∀ o : Fin N_O, 0 ≤ p_O o :=
      fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hp_nn o d)
    have hpPW_nn : ∀ p_c w, 0 ≤ p_PW p_c w :=
      fun p_c w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hpO_nn o)
    obtain ⟨h_sum_w, h_sum_p⟩ := h_pw_sum S_P S_W P_f W_f p_O decP decPW hP hW
    have h_pt : ∀ p_c ∈ S_P, ∀ w ∈ S_W,
        p_PW p_c w * ((k_f - α_cur) * ell) ≤
          -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c)) := by
      intro p_c _ w hw
      by_cases h0 : p_PW p_c w = 0
      · simp [h0]
      · have hpos : 0 < p_PW p_c w := lt_of_le_of_ne (hpPW_nn p_c w) (Ne.symm h0)
        have hpP_ge : p_PW p_c w ≤ p_P p_c := by
          dsimp only [p_P]
          rw [← h_sum_w p_c]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun w' _ => hpPW_nn p_c w') hw
        have hpP_pos : 0 < p_P p_c := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hpP_ge
        have hdiv_le : p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c ≤ ε ^ (k_f - α_cur) :=
          (div_le_iff₀ hpP_pos).mpr (hcap p_c w)
        have hlog_le := Real.log_le_log (div_pos hpos hpP_pos) hdiv_le
        rw [h_log_rpow_eps hε₀] at hlog_le
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_le hpos.le
        dsimp only [ell] at hmul ⊢
        linarith
    have h_tot : (k_f - α_cur) * ell ≤
        ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c)) := by
      have h_sum1 : ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, p_PW p_c w * ((k_f - α_cur) * ell) =
          (k_f - α_cur) * ell := by
        have hw_eq : ∀ p_c ∈ S_P,
            ∑ w ∈ S_W, p_PW p_c w * ((k_f - α_cur) * ell) = p_P p_c * ((k_f - α_cur) * ell) := by
          intro p_c _
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h_sum_w p_c]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hw_eq, ← Finset.sum_mul, h_sum_p, hp_sum, one_mul]
      rw [← h_sum1]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p_c hpc => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun w hw => h_pt p_c hpc w hw))
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hell_pos).mpr h_tot

  have h_bool_part : ∀ {K : ℕ} (b : Fin K → Bool) (π : Fin K → ℝ),
      (∀ j : Fin K, 0 ≤ π j) → (∑ j : Fin K, π j = 1) →
      let P₁ := ∑ j : Fin K, if b j = true then π j else 0
      let P₂ := ∑ j : Fin K, if b j = false then π j else 0
      0 ≤ P₁ ∧ 0 ≤ P₂ ∧ P₁ + P₂ = 1 ∧
      (P₁ = 0 → ∀ j : Fin K, 0 < π j → b j = false) := by
    intro K b π hπ_nn hπ_sum P₁ P₂
    have h1 : 0 ≤ P₁ := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn j; exact le_rfl)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ P₂ := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn j; exact le_rfl)
    have hsum : P₁ + P₂ = 1 := by
      dsimp only [P₁, P₂]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← hπ_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      cases b j <;> simp
    refine ⟨h1, h2, hsum, ?_⟩
    intro hP1_0 j hπj
    cases hbj : b j
    · rfl
    · exfalso
      have hle : π j ≤ P₁ := by
        have heq : π j = (if b j = true then π j else 0) := by rw [hbj, if_pos rfl]
        rw [heq]
        dsimp only [P₁]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun j' => if b j' = true then π j' else 0)
          (fun j' _ => by split_ifs; exact hπ_nn j'; exact le_rfl) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      linarith

  have h_zero_false_supp : ∀ {N_O N_D : ℕ} (b_O : Fin N_O → Bool) (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) →
      (∑ o : Fin N_O, if b_O o = false then (∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) else 0) = 0 →
      ∀ o d, 0 < p o d → b_O o = true := by
    intro N_O N_D b_O p hp_nn hsum0 o d hpod
    cases hbo : b_O o
    · exfalso
      have hpo_ge : p o d ≤ ∑ d' : Fin N_D, p o d' :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hp_nn o d') (Finset.mem_univ d)
      have hle : (∑ d' : Fin N_D, p o d') ≤
          ∑ o' : Fin N_O, if b_O o' = false then (∑ d' : Fin N_D, p o' d') else 0 := by
        have heq : (∑ d' : Fin N_D, p o d') =
            (if b_O o = false then (∑ d' : Fin N_D, p o d') else 0) := by rw [hbo, if_pos rfl]
        rw [heq]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun o' => if b_O o' = false then (∑ d' : Fin N_D, p o' d') else 0)
          (fun o' _ => by split_ifs; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d' _ => hp_nn o' d'); exact le_rfl)
          (Finset.mem_univ o)
      linarith
    · rfl

  have h_mixture_decomp : ∀ {ε H_P t b_star lam_sys : ℝ} {m_t N_O N_D N_J : ℕ}
      {Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ}
      {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ}
      {r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ} {V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
      {ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ}
      {b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ}
      {N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ}
      {menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j)}
      (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
      (decJ : ∀ j : Fin N_J, DecidablePred (fun o : Fin N_O => win_of o = j))
      (b_mod : Fin N_J → Bool)
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) →
      (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
        ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => win_of o = j) (decJ j) Finset.univ,
          ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
      let P_mod := ∑ j : Fin N_J, if b_mod j = true then π_J j else 0
      let P_huge := ∑ j : Fin N_J, if b_mod j = false then π_J j else 0
      0 < P_mod → 0 < P_huge →
      let q₁ := fun o d => if b_mod (win_of o) = true then p o d / P_mod else 0
      let q₂ := fun o d => if b_mod (win_of o) = false then p o d / P_huge else 0
      let π_q₁ := fun j : Fin N_J =>
        ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => win_of o = j) (decJ j) Finset.univ,
          ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₁ o d
      let π_q₂ := fun j : Fin N_J =>
        ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => win_of o = j) (decJ j) Finset.univ,
          ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₂ o d
      let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
      let B_r := H_J + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
      let H_Jq₁ := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_q₁ j * Real.log (π_q₁ j))) / ell
      let B_rq₁ := H_Jq₁ + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q₁ j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)
      let H_Jq₂ := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_q₂ j * Real.log (π_q₂ j))) / ell
      let B_rq₂ := H_Jq₂ + b_star + ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q₂ j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j);
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ q₁ o d) ∧ (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₁ o d = 1) ∧
      (∀ o d, 0 < q₁ o d → b_mod (win_of o) = true ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ q₂ o d) ∧ (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₂ o d = 1) ∧
      (∀ o d, 0 < q₂ o d → b_mod (win_of o) = false ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ π_q₂ j) ∧ (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q₂ j = 1) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_q₂ j → b_mod j = false) ∧
      (generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p - B_r ≤
        P_mod * (generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q₁ - B_rq₁) +
        P_huge * (generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q₂ - B_rq₂) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log 2 / ell)) := by
    intro ε H_P t b_star lam_sys m_t N_O N_D N_J Φ₀ f r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D N_ret_of menu
      win_of decJ b_mod p hε₀ hε₁ hp_nn hp_sum ell π_J P_mod P_huge hPmod hPhuge
      q₁ q₂ π_q₁ π_q₂ H_J B_r H_Jq₁ B_rq₁ H_Jq₂ B_rq₂
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    let p_O : Fin N_O → ℝ := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
    let q1_O : Fin N_O → ℝ := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₁ o d
    let q2_O : Fin N_O → ℝ := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₂ o d
    let p_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p o d
    let q1_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q₁ o d
    let q2_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q₂ o d
    obtain ⟨hπJ_sum, hfib_t, hfib_f⟩ := h_fib_sum win_of p_O decJ
    have hπJ_nn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ π_J j :=
      fun j => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hp_nn o d))
    have hP_sum : P_mod + P_huge = 1 :=
      (h_bool_part b_mod π_J hπJ_nn (hπJ_sum.trans hp_sum)).2.2.1
    have hq1_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ q₁ o d := by
      intro o d; dsimp only [q₁]; split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hp_nn o d) hPmod.le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hq2_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ q₂ o d := by
      intro o d; dsimp only [q₂]; split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hp_nn o d) hPhuge.le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hq1O_eq : ∀ o : Fin N_O, q1_O o = if b_mod (win_of o) = true then p_O o / P_mod else 0 := by
      intro o; dsimp only [q1_O, q₁, p_O]
      cases b_mod (win_of o)
      · simp
      · simp [Finset.sum_div]
    have hq2O_eq : ∀ o : Fin N_O, q2_O o = if b_mod (win_of o) = false then p_O o / P_huge else 0 := by
      intro o; dsimp only [q2_O, q₂, p_O]
      cases b_mod (win_of o)
      · simp [Finset.sum_div]
      · simp
    have hq1_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₁ o d = 1 := by
      change ∑ o : Fin N_O, q1_O o = 1
      have h1 : ∀ o : Fin N_O, q1_O o = (if b_mod (win_of o) = true then p_O o else 0) / P_mod := by
        intro o; rw [hq1O_eq o]; cases b_mod (win_of o) <;> simp
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h1 o), ← Finset.sum_div, ← hfib_t b_mod]
      exact div_self hPmod.ne'
    have hq2_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₂ o d = 1 := by
      change ∑ o : Fin N_O, q2_O o = 1
      have h1 : ∀ o : Fin N_O, q2_O o = (if b_mod (win_of o) = false then p_O o else 0) / P_huge := by
        intro o; rw [hq2O_eq o]; cases b_mod (win_of o) <;> simp
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h1 o), ← Finset.sum_div, ← hfib_f b_mod]
      exact div_self hPhuge.ne'
    have hq1_supp : ∀ o d, 0 < q₁ o d → b_mod (win_of o) = true ∧ 0 < p o d := by
      intro o d hpos; dsimp only [q₁] at hpos
      cases hb : b_mod (win_of o)
      · rw [hb] at hpos; simp at hpos
      · rw [hb, if_pos rfl] at hpos
        exact ⟨rfl, (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hPmod).mp hpos⟩
    have hq2_supp : ∀ o d, 0 < q₂ o d → b_mod (win_of o) = false ∧ 0 < p o d := by
      intro o d hpos; dsimp only [q₂] at hpos
      cases hb : b_mod (win_of o)
      · rw [hb, if_pos rfl] at hpos
        exact ⟨rfl, (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hPhuge).mp hpos⟩
      · rw [hb] at hpos; simp at hpos
    have hπq1_eq : ∀ j : Fin N_J, π_q₁ j = if b_mod j = true then π_J j / P_mod else 0 := by
      intro j
      have hflt : @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => win_of o = j) (decJ j) Finset.univ =
          Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j) := by ext o; simp
      dsimp only [π_q₁, π_J]
      rw [hflt]
      cases hbj : b_mod j
      · rw [if_neg (by simp)]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => ?_)
        change q1_O o = 0
        rw [hq1O_eq o, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2, hbj]
        simp
      · rw [if_pos rfl, Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o ho => ?_)
        change q1_O o = p_O o / P_mod
        rw [hq1O_eq o, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2, hbj, if_pos rfl]
    have hπq2_eq : ∀ j : Fin N_J, π_q₂ j = if b_mod j = false then π_J j / P_huge else 0 := by
      intro j
      have hflt : @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => win_of o = j) (decJ j) Finset.univ =
          Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j) := by ext o; simp
      dsimp only [π_q₂, π_J]
      rw [hflt]
      cases hbj : b_mod j
      · rw [if_pos rfl, Finset.sum_div]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o ho => ?_)
        change q2_O o = p_O o / P_huge
        rw [hq2O_eq o, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2, hbj, if_pos rfl]
      · rw [if_neg (by simp)]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => ?_)
        change q2_O o = 0
        rw [hq2O_eq o, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2, hbj]
        simp
    have hπq2_nn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ π_q₂ j :=
      fun j => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq2_nn o d))
    have hπq2_sum : ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q₂ j = 1 := by
      have h1 : ∀ j : Fin N_J, π_q₂ j = (if b_mod j = false then π_J j else 0) / P_huge := by
        intro j; rw [hπq2_eq j]; cases b_mod j <;> simp
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => h1 j), ← Finset.sum_div]
      exact div_self hPhuge.ne'
    have hπq2_supp : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_q₂ j → b_mod j = false := by
      intro j hpos; rw [hπq2_eq j] at hpos
      cases hb : b_mod j
      · rfl
      · rw [hb] at hpos; simp at hpos
    have hp_mix : ∀ o d, P_mod * q₁ o d + P_huge * q₂ o d = p o d := by
      intro o d; dsimp only [q₁, q₂]
      cases b_mod (win_of o)
      · simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hPhuge.ne']
      · simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hPmod.ne']
    have hpO_mix : ∀ o : Fin N_O, P_mod * q1_O o + P_huge * q2_O o = p_O o := by
      intro o; rw [hq1O_eq o, hq2O_eq o]
      cases b_mod (win_of o)
      · simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hPhuge.ne']
      · simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hPmod.ne']
    have hpD_mix : ∀ d : Fin N_D, P_mod * q1_D d + P_huge * q2_D d = p_D d := by
      intro d; dsimp only [q1_D, q2_D, p_D]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => hp_mix o d)
    have hπJ_mix : ∀ j : Fin N_J, P_mod * π_q₁ j + P_huge * π_q₂ j = π_J j := by
      intro j; rw [hπq1_eq j, hπq2_eq j]
      cases b_mod j
      · simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hPhuge.ne']
      · simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hPmod.ne']
    have h_ent_O := h_disj_ent Finset.univ (fun o => b_mod (win_of o)) p_O hPmod hPhuge
      (hfib_t b_mod).symm (hfib_f b_mod).symm
    have h_ent_O' : ∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o)) =
        P_mod * (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q1_O o * Real.log (q1_O o))) +
        P_huge * (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q2_O o * Real.log (q2_O o))) -
        P_mod * Real.log P_mod - P_huge * Real.log P_huge := by
      have hc1 : (∑ o : Fin N_O, -((if b_mod (win_of o) = true then p_O o / P_mod else 0) *
          Real.log (if b_mod (win_of o) = true then p_O o / P_mod else 0))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q1_O o * Real.log (q1_O o)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => by rw [hq1O_eq o])
      have hc2 : (∑ o : Fin N_O, -((if b_mod (win_of o) = false then p_O o / P_huge else 0) *
          Real.log (if b_mod (win_of o) = false then p_O o / P_huge else 0))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q2_O o * Real.log (q2_O o)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => by rw [hq2O_eq o])
      dsimp only at h_ent_O
      rwa [hc1, hc2] at h_ent_O
    have h_ent_J := h_disj_ent Finset.univ b_mod π_J hPmod hPhuge rfl rfl
    have h_ent_J' : ∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j)) =
        P_mod * (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_q₁ j * Real.log (π_q₁ j))) +
        P_huge * (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_q₂ j * Real.log (π_q₂ j))) -
        P_mod * Real.log P_mod - P_huge * Real.log P_huge := by
      have hc1 : (∑ j : Fin N_J, -((if b_mod j = true then π_J j / P_mod else 0) *
          Real.log (if b_mod j = true then π_J j / P_mod else 0))) =
          ∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_q₁ j * Real.log (π_q₁ j)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [hπq1_eq j])
      have hc2 : (∑ j : Fin N_J, -((if b_mod j = false then π_J j / P_huge else 0) *
          Real.log (if b_mod j = false then π_J j / P_huge else 0))) =
          ∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_q₂ j * Real.log (π_q₂ j)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [hπq2_eq j])
      dsimp only at h_ent_J
      rwa [hc1, hc2] at h_ent_J
    have h_HO_HJ :
        (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell - H_J =
        P_mod * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q1_O o * Real.log (q1_O o))) / ell - H_Jq₁) +
        P_huge * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q2_O o * Real.log (q2_O o))) / ell - H_Jq₂) := by
      dsimp only [H_J, H_Jq₁, H_Jq₂]
      rw [h_ent_O', h_ent_J']
      field_simp [hell_pos.ne']
      ring
    have h_cond := h_bin_cond_ent (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_D))
      q₁ q₂ hPmod hPhuge (fun o _ d _ => hq1_nn o d) (fun o _ d _ => hq2_nn o d)
    have h_HOD_le :
        (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell ≤
        P_mod * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q₁ o d * Real.log (q₁ o d / q1_D d))) / ell) +
        P_huge * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q₂ o d * Real.log (q₂ o d / q2_D d))) / ell) +
        Real.log 2 / ell := by
      dsimp only at h_cond
      have h_lhs_eq : (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O,
            -((P_mod * q₁ o d + P_huge * q₂ o d) *
              Real.log ((P_mod * q₁ o d + P_huge * q₂ o d) /
                (∑ o' : Fin N_O, (P_mod * q₁ o' d + P_huge * q₂ o' d))))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_))
        have hsum_o : (∑ o' : Fin N_O, (P_mod * q₁ o' d + P_huge * q₂ o' d)) = p_D d :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o' _ => hp_mix o' d)
        rw [hp_mix o d, hsum_o]
      have hpD_sum : (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o' : Fin N_O, (P_mod * q₁ o' d + P_huge * q₂ o' d)) = 1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        calc ∑ o' : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, (P_mod * q₁ o' d + P_huge * q₂ o' d)
            = ∑ o' : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o' d :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => hp_mix o' d))
          _ = 1 := hp_sum
      have h_rhs1_eq : (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O,
            -(q₁ o d * Real.log (q₁ o d / (∑ o' : Fin N_O, q₁ o' d)))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q₁ o d * Real.log (q₁ o d / q1_D d)) :=
        Finset.sum_comm
      have h_rhs2_eq : (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O,
            -(q₂ o d * Real.log (q₂ o d / (∑ o' : Fin N_O, q₂ o' d)))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q₂ o d * Real.log (q₂ o d / q2_D d)) :=
        Finset.sum_comm
      rw [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs1_eq, h_rhs2_eq, hpD_sum, one_mul] at h_cond
      have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_cond hell_pos.le
      have hrhs_div :
          (P_mod * (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q₁ o d * Real.log (q₁ o d / q1_D d))) +
           P_huge * (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q₂ o d * Real.log (q₂ o d / q2_D d))) +
           Real.log 2) / ell =
          P_mod * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q₁ o d * Real.log (q₁ o d / q1_D d))) / ell) +
          P_huge * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q₂ o d * Real.log (q₂ o d / q2_D d))) / ell) +
          Real.log 2 / ell := by
        rw [add_div, add_div, mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc]
      rwa [hrhs_div] at h_div
    have h_Emass_eq :
        (∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell =
        P_mod * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, q1_O o * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) +
        P_huge * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, q2_O o * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) := by
      have h1 : (∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log
            (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) =
          P_mod * (∑ o : Fin N_O, q1_O o * Real.log
            (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) +
          P_huge * (∑ o : Fin N_O, q2_O o * Real.log
            (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
        rw [← hpO_mix o]; ring
      rw [h1, add_div, mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc]
    have h_Ew_eq :
        ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) =
        P_mod * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q1_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) +
        P_huge * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q2_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      rw [← hpD_mix d]; ring
    have h_proxy_eq :
        ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j) =
        P_mod * (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q₁ j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)) +
        P_huge * (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_q₂ j * subclassProxyA ε (menu j)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [← hπJ_mix j]; ring
    have hb_star_eq : b_star = P_mod * b_star + P_huge * b_star := by
      rw [← add_mul, hP_sum, one_mul]
    refine ⟨hq1_nn, hq1_sum, hq1_supp, hq2_nn, hq2_sum, hq2_supp,
      hπq2_nn, hπq2_sum, hπq2_supp, ?_⟩
    unfold generalPacketScore
    dsimp only [B_r, B_rq₁, B_rq₂, ell, p_O, q1_O, q2_O, p_D, q1_D, q2_D] at h_HO_HJ h_HOD_le h_Emass_eq h_Ew_eq h_proxy_eq ⊢
    linarith [hb_star_eq]

  have h_cred_mixture : ∀ {ε : ℝ} {N_O N_D : ℕ} {α_P α_W : Type}
      (S_P : Finset α_P) (S_W : Finset α_W)
      (P_f : Fin N_O → α_P) (W_f : Fin N_O → α_W)
      (decP : ∀ p_c, DecidablePred (fun o => P_f o = p_c))
      (decPW : ∀ p_c w, DecidablePred (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w))
      (b_O : Fin N_O → Bool)
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) {P_mod P_huge : ℝ},
      0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ o, P_f o ∈ S_P) → (∀ o, W_f o ∈ S_W) →
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) → (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
      0 < P_mod → 0 < P_huge →
      let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
      let q₁ := fun o d => if b_O o = true then p o d / P_mod else 0
      let q₂ := fun o d => if b_O o = false then p o d / P_huge else 0
      let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
      let p_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ, p_O o
      let p_PW := fun p_c w => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w) (decPW p_c w) Finset.univ, p_O o
      let q1_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₁ o d
      let q1_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ, q1_O o
      let q1_PW := fun p_c w => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w) (decPW p_c w) Finset.univ, q1_O o
      let q2_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q₂ o d
      let q2_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c) (decP p_c) Finset.univ, q2_O o
      let q2_PW := fun p_c w => ∑ o ∈ @Finset.filter (Fin N_O) (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w) (decPW p_c w) Finset.univ, q2_O o;
      (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) / ell ≤
        P_mod * ((∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q1_PW p_c w * Real.log (q1_PW p_c w / q1_P p_c))) / ell) +
        P_huge * ((∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q2_PW p_c w * Real.log (q2_PW p_c w / q2_P p_c))) / ell) +
        Real.log 2 / ell := by
    intro ε N_O N_D α_P α_W S_P S_W P_f W_f decP decPW b_O p P_mod P_huge
      hε₀ hε₁ hP hW hp_nn hp_sum hPmod hPhuge ell q₁ q₂ p_O p_P p_PW q1_O q1_P q1_PW q2_O q2_P q2_PW
    have hell_pos : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    have hq1_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ q₁ o d := by
      intro o d; dsimp only [q₁]; split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hp_nn o d) hPmod.le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hq2_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ q₂ o d := by
      intro o d; dsimp only [q₂]; split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hp_nn o d) hPhuge.le
      · exact le_rfl
    have hq1PW_nn : ∀ p_c w, 0 ≤ q1_PW p_c w :=
      fun p_c w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq1_nn o d))
    have hq2PW_nn : ∀ p_c w, 0 ≤ q2_PW p_c w :=
      fun p_c w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq2_nn o d))
    have hp_mix : ∀ o d, P_mod * q₁ o d + P_huge * q₂ o d = p o d := by
      intro o d; dsimp only [q₁, q₂]
      cases b_O o
      · simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hPhuge.ne']
      · simp [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hPmod.ne']
    have hpO_mix : ∀ o : Fin N_O, P_mod * q1_O o + P_huge * q2_O o = p_O o := by
      intro o; dsimp only [q1_O, q2_O, p_O]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => hp_mix o d)
    have hpPW_mix : ∀ p_c w, P_mod * q1_PW p_c w + P_huge * q2_PW p_c w = p_PW p_c w := by
      intro p_c w; dsimp only [q1_PW, q2_PW, p_PW]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => hpO_mix o)
    obtain ⟨hq1_w, _⟩ := h_pw_sum S_P S_W P_f W_f q1_O decP decPW hP hW
    obtain ⟨hq2_w, _⟩ := h_pw_sum S_P S_W P_f W_f q2_O decP decPW hP hW
    obtain ⟨hp_w, hp_tot⟩ := h_pw_sum S_P S_W P_f W_f p_O decP decPW hP hW
    have h_cond := h_bin_cond_ent S_W S_P (fun w p_c => q1_PW p_c w) (fun w p_c => q2_PW p_c w)
      hPmod hPhuge (fun w _ p_c _ => hq1PW_nn p_c w) (fun w _ p_c _ => hq2PW_nn p_c w)
    dsimp only at h_cond
    have h_lhs_eq : (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
          -((P_mod * q1_PW p_c w + P_huge * q2_PW p_c w) *
            Real.log ((P_mod * q1_PW p_c w + P_huge * q2_PW p_c w) /
              (∑ w' ∈ S_W, (P_mod * q1_PW p_c w' + P_huge * q2_PW p_c w'))))) =
        ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_))
      have h_wsum : (∑ w' ∈ S_W, (P_mod * q1_PW p_c w' + P_huge * q2_PW p_c w')) = p_P p_c := by
        calc ∑ w' ∈ S_W, (P_mod * q1_PW p_c w' + P_huge * q2_PW p_c w')
            = ∑ w' ∈ S_W, p_PW p_c w' := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w' _ => hpPW_mix p_c w')
          _ = p_P p_c := hp_w p_c
      rw [hpPW_mix p_c w, h_wsum]
    have h_q1_rhs : (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
          -(q1_PW p_c w * Real.log (q1_PW p_c w / (∑ w' ∈ S_W, q1_PW p_c w')))) =
        ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q1_PW p_c w * Real.log (q1_PW p_c w / q1_P p_c)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => by rw [hq1_w p_c]))
    have h_q2_rhs : (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
          -(q2_PW p_c w * Real.log (q2_PW p_c w / (∑ w' ∈ S_W, q2_PW p_c w')))) =
        ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q2_PW p_c w * Real.log (q2_PW p_c w / q2_P p_c)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => by rw [hq2_w p_c]))
    have h_pP_sum : (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w' ∈ S_W, (P_mod * q1_PW p_c w' + P_huge * q2_PW p_c w')) = 1 := by
      calc ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w' ∈ S_W, (P_mod * q1_PW p_c w' + P_huge * q2_PW p_c w')
          = ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, p_P p_c :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ =>
              (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w' _ => hpPW_mix p_c w')).trans (hp_w p_c))
        _ = ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o := hp_tot
        _ = 1 := hp_sum
    rw [h_lhs_eq, h_q1_rhs, h_q2_rhs, h_pP_sum, one_mul] at h_cond
    have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_cond hell_pos.le
    have hrhs_div :
        (P_mod * (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q1_PW p_c w * Real.log (q1_PW p_c w / q1_P p_c))) +
         P_huge * (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q2_PW p_c w * Real.log (q2_PW p_c w / q2_P p_c))) +
         Real.log 2) / ell =
        P_mod * ((∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q1_PW p_c w * Real.log (q1_PW p_c w / q1_P p_c))) / ell) +
        P_huge * ((∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(q2_PW p_c w * Real.log (q2_PW p_c w / q2_P p_c))) / ell) +
        Real.log 2 / ell := by
      rw [add_div, add_div, mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc]
    rwa [hrhs_div] at h_div

  have h_Aconst_split : ∀ {ell : ℝ},
      ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log C_cnt_obs / ell) +
       (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log C_Bes_obs / ell) +
       (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log C_cov / ell) +
       (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log 225 / ell) +
       Real.log 2 / ell) = A_const / ell := by
    intro ell
    dsimp only [A_const]
    ring

  refine ⟨ε_mbin, hε_mbin_pos, hε_mbin_lt, ?_⟩
  intro ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J
    Φ₀ f r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D N_ret_of menu win_of p k_f α_cur k_out
  intro ell M_thr hε₀ hε_lt hr_eq hr_pos ht_le1 ht_L ht_HP hHP_K hL_K
    hb_star0 hb_star_ut hk_f0 hα_cur0 hk_out0 hadm_p hcred_p hNO_cnt hobs_bes hmenu h_red
    π_J H_J B_r

  have hε_q : ε < 1 / 4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε_half : ε < 1 / 2 := by linarith only [hε_q]
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε_half
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by linarith only [hr_eq, hr_pos, hh]
  have h2h_K : 2 * h ≤ cls.K_hor := by linarith only [hr_eq, hr_pos, ht_HP, hHP_K]
  have hK_hor1 : 1 ≤ cls.K_hor := cls.hK_hor
  have hγh_pos : 0 < γ * h := mul_pos hγ₀ hh
  have hε_lt_exp : ε < (Real.exp ((A_const + 1) / (e_rep / 4)))⁻¹ :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_right _ _)
  have hA_const_le : A_const / ell ≤ e_rep / 4 :=
    h_log_div_ell hε₀ hε_half (by linarith only [he_rep]) hε_lt_exp
  have hA_const_exp := (h_Aconst_split (ell := ell)).trans_le hA_const_le
  have hlog_cnt_div_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log C_cnt_obs / ell := div_nonneg hlog_cnt_nn hell_pos.le

    (d_dim M_L M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hu_min : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * h ≤ u_min)
    (hζ_sh : 0 < ζ_sh) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hξ : 0 < ξ)
    (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hML_64 : 64 ≤ M_L) (hML_bound : (64 * C_cov * cls.B_sys : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ))
    (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hC_tr : ∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M)
    (he_rep : 0 < e_rep) (hCBes_at : 1 ≤ C_Bes_at)
    (h_ibp_gen : ∀ (M : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∀ (B D : ℕ → ℝ),

          (∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ R + 2 → L_osc ≤ deriv θ_fn s) →
          (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ R + 2 →
            |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ_fn) s| ≤ L_osc * D m) →
        ∀ (u_fn : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u_fn) →
          (∀ s : ℝ, R ≤ |s| → u_fn s = 0) →
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u_fn s‖ ≤ B k) →

      ∀ (γ ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys k_out : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret S_per_loc : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)

        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

          let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          let X'_o := s_x⁻¹ • (X_O o - X_J - (C_t - C_r) • V_J)

          else
            (q, roundShift2D σ_loc 0 (X'_o - X_Q))

            coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)) = q.1 ∧
            ‖(X'_at α + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V'_at α) - X_Q‖ ≤ B_Q * (ε ^ (-θ)) * s_loc)

        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ b_star → u_min ≤ u → 0 ≤ k_out → k_out ≤ 3 * h →
        m_r = Nat.floor (r * ell / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →

        sub.k_bin = k_out →

          ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(k_out + ξ))) →
        (∀ c_vec : Fin N_ret → ℂ,
          let H_fn := fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_ret, c_vec α *
            ((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *

          MeasureTheory.MemLp H_fn 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          ∫ v, ‖H_fn v‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_Bes_at * ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ‖c_vec α‖ ^ 2) →

          (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
          (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k)) →
        (let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
         let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
         ∀ (r_i : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
             r_O o = r_i ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤
             (cls.N_mult : ℝ)) →
        (∀ o ∈ S_act,
          cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = sub.loc_idx ∧
          (∀ (v' x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

        ∃ m_site : Fin N_O → ℝ,

          (∀ q, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q), m_site o ≤

            (d_dim = 2 → b_D d = (H_P - t) / 2 ∧ a_D d = (H_P - t) / 2) →
            ‖e_D d‖ = 1 →

              (d_dim = 1 → projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_buf (Q_of o).1) ≤ ε ^ (4 * h)) ∧
              α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o))).image Z_of).card : ℝ) ≤
              C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh))

  have h_sub_L2 : ∀ S : Finset (Fin N_ret),
