    rw [← hψ_eq] at hψl_sm hψl_supp_R hψl_supp_ML hψl_der hψl_pair
    obtain ⟨hr_decomp, hrloc_lt, hCt_mem, hCt_Cr, hVo_VJ, hXo_XJ⟩ :=
      hs1_loc (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (h_obs_win o).1 (h_Sact o ho).1
    let C_t : ℝ := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
    let r_loc : ℕ := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
    let P_pair : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) → ℂ :=
      fun g ψ => (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        g v * ψ (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))

    
    have h_amp_floor : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ E_fl ≤ ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o)‖ := by
      have hell_pos : 0 < ell := by
        dsimp only [ell]
        exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε_pos).mpr (by linarith only [hε_lt_half]))
      have hS_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (S_per_loc : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hS_per1
      have hlog_le : Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (ε ^ (-(e_rep / 64))) := by
        have h1 : Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) ≤ (e_rep / 64) * ell :=
          (div_le_iff₀ hell_pos).mp hS_per_log
        have h2 : (e_rep / 64) * ell = Real.log (ε ^ (-(e_rep / 64))) := by
          dsimp only [ell]
          rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_rpow hε_pos]
          ring
        linarith only [h1, h2]
      have hS_le : (S_per_loc : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-(e_rep / 64)) :=
        (Real.log_le_log_iff hS_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos _)).mp hlog_le
      have h4S2_pos : 0 < 4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2) := by positivity
      have h4S2_le : 4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ 4 * ε ^ (-(e_rep / 32)) := by
        have hsq : (S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (ε ^ (-(e_rep / 64))) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hS_pos.le hS_le 2
        have hexp : (ε ^ (-(e_rep / 64))) ^ 2 = ε ^ (-(e_rep / 32)) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
          congr 1; push_cast; ring
        linarith only [hsq, hexp]
      have h_inv_4S2 : (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (e_rep / 32) ≤ (4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        have hprod : (4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2)) * ((4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (e_rep / 32)) ≤ 1 := by
          calc (4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2)) * ((4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (e_rep / 32))
              ≤ (4 * ε ^ (-(e_rep / 32))) * ((4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (e_rep / 32)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4S2_le
                  (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
            _ = ε ^ (-(e_rep / 32)) * ε ^ (e_rep / 32) := by ring
            _ = 1 := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
        calc (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (e_rep / 32)
            = ((4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2))⁻¹ * (4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2))) *
                ((4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (e_rep / 32)) := by
              rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h4S2_pos), one_mul]
          _ = (4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2))⁻¹ *
                ((4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2)) * ((4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (e_rep / 32))) :=
              mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ ≤ (4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2))⁻¹ * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (inv_nonneg.mpr h4S2_pos.le)
          _ = (4 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2))⁻¹ := mul_one _
      have hsq_le : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ E_fl) ^ 2 ≤ ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o)‖ ^ 2 := by
        have hlhs : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ E_fl) ^ 2 = (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ε ^ (e_rep / 32) * ε ^ A₀ := by
          rw [mul_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast (ε ^ E_fl), ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
          have heq : E_fl * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = e_rep / 32 + A₀ := by
            dsimp only [E_fl]; push_cast; ring
          rw [heq, Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
          ring
        rw [hlhs]
        exact le_trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_4S2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le A₀))
          (h_Sact o ho).2.2
      exact h_le_of_sq_le_sq
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le E_fl))
        (norm_nonneg (P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o))) hsq_le

    
    let S_vel : Finset (Fin N_ret) :=
      Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret => ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * ρ_t)
    let h_vel : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
      fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_vel, sub.c_at α * g_at α v

    have h_vel_pair_eq : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖x - X_O o‖ ≤ 20 * cls.a₀⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-θ)) * (lam_sys * ρ_t)⁻¹ →
        ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          h_sub v * ψ_O o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          h_vel v * ψ_O o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      intro x hx_dist
      have hx_sx : ‖x - X_O o‖ ≤ s_x := by
        calc ‖x - X_O o‖
            ≤ 20 * cls.a₀⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-θ)) * (cls.B_sys * ε ^ (3 * h) * s_x) :=
              le_trans hx_dist
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσ_t_sx
                  (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (inv_nonneg.mpr cls.ha₀.le))
                    (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)))
          _ = (20 * cls.a₀⁻¹ * cls.B_sys * (ε ^ (-θ) * ε ^ (3 * h))) * s_x := by ring
          _ = (20 * cls.a₀⁻¹ * cls.B_sys * ε ^ (3 * h - θ)) * s_x := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
              congr 3; ring
          _ ≤ 1 * s_x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sm_xloc hs_x_pos.le
          _ = s_x := one_mul _
      have hVo_4B : ‖V_O o - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v := by
        have h1_4B : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys := by linarith only [cls.hB_sys]
        calc ‖V_O o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v := hVo_VJ
          _ = 1 * s_v := (one_mul s_v).symm
          _ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1_4B hs_v_pos.le
      have hx_4B : ‖x + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x := by
        have htri : ‖x + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J‖ ≤
            ‖x - X_O o‖ + ‖X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J‖ := by
          have heq : x + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J =
              (x - X_O o) + (X_O o + (C_r - C_t) • V_O o - X_J) := by abel
          rw [heq]; exact norm_add_le _ _
        have h2_4B : 2 * s_x ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [cls.hB_sys]) hs_x_pos.le
        linarith only [htri, hx_sx, hXo_XJ, h2_4B]
      have hCt_eq : (((sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ = C_t := by
        dsimp only [C_t, r_loc]
        rw [← hr_decomp]
      have hρr_if : (if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)) = ρ_r :=
        if_neg (ne_of_gt hr_pos)
      have h_tr_fn := h_sub_trunc r_loc hrloc_lt
      dsimp only at h_tr_fn
      rw [hCt_eq] at h_tr_fn
      simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hρr_if] at h_tr_fn
      have h_tr_x := h_tr_fn (V_O o) x (ψ_O o) hVo_4B hx_4B
        (h_obs_win o).2.2.2.1 (h_obs_win o).2.2.2.2.1 (h_obs_win o).2.2.2.2.2
      let I_all : ℂ := ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        h_sub v * ψ_O o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      let I_vel : ℂ := ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        h_vel v * ψ_O o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have hCcov_pos : 0 < C_cov := by linarith only [hC_cov]
      have hCσ_pos : 0 < C_cov * σ_r := mul_pos hCcov_pos hσ_r_pos
      let R₀ : ℝ := max 2 (1 + ∑ α : Fin N_ret,
        ‖x - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ / (C_cov * σ_r))
      have h_diff_zero : (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * I_all - (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * I_vel = 0 := by
        rw [← norm_eq_zero]
        by_contra h_ne
        have hδ_pos : 0 < ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * I_all - (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * I_vel‖ :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm h_ne)
        let δ := ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * I_all - (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * I_vel‖
        let R_tr : ℝ := max R₀ ((C_tr 2 + 1) / δ)
        have hR0_ge2 : 2 ≤ R₀ := le_max_left _ _
        have hRtr_geR0 : R₀ ≤ R_tr := le_max_left _ _
        have hRtr_ge2 : 2 ≤ R_tr := le_trans hR0_ge2 hRtr_geR0
        have hRtr_pos : 0 < R_tr := by linarith only [hRtr_ge2]
        have hS_near_eq : Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
            ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * ρ_t ∧
            ‖x - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * R_tr * σ_r) = S_vel := by
          ext α
          simp (config := { decide := false }) only [S_vel, Finset.mem_filter,
            Finset.mem_univ, true_and, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
          intro _
          have h_term_le : ‖x - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ / (C_cov * σ_r) ≤
              ∑ β : Fin N_ret, ‖x - X_at β - (C_t - C_r) • V_at β‖ / (C_cov * σ_r) :=
            Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun β => ‖x - X_at β - (C_t - C_r) • V_at β‖ / (C_cov * σ_r))
              (fun β _ => div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hCσ_pos.le)
              (Finset.mem_univ α)
          have h_le_Rtr : ‖x - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ / (C_cov * σ_r) ≤ R_tr := by
            have h1 : 1 + ∑ β : Fin N_ret,
                ‖x - X_at β - (C_t - C_r) • V_at β‖ / (C_cov * σ_r) ≤ R₀ :=
              le_max_right _ _
            linarith only [h_term_le, h1, hRtr_geR0]
          have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hCσ_pos).mp h_le_Rtr
          have hcomm : R_tr * (C_cov * σ_r) = C_cov * R_tr * σ_r := by ring
          linarith only [hmul, hcomm]
        have h_bd := h_tr_x 2 R_tr (le_refl 2) hRtr_ge2
        rw [hS_near_eq] at h_bd
        have hrpow_inv : R_tr ^ (1 - ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = R_tr⁻¹ := by
          have heq : (1 : ℝ) - ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = -1 := by norm_num
          rw [heq, Real.rpow_neg_one]
        rw [hrpow_inv] at h_bd
        have h_lt : C_tr 2 * R_tr⁻¹ < δ := by
          have h1 : (C_tr 2 + 1) / δ ≤ R_tr := le_max_right _ _
          have h2 : C_tr 2 + 1 ≤ R_tr * δ := (div_le_iff₀ hδ_pos).mp h1
          have h3 : C_tr 2 < R_tr * δ := by linarith only [h2]
          calc C_tr 2 * R_tr⁻¹ < (R_tr * δ) * R_tr⁻¹ :=
                mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h3 (inv_pos.mpr hRtr_pos)
            _ = δ * (R_tr * R_tr⁻¹) := by ring
            _ = δ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hRtr_pos), mul_one]
        have h_bd' : δ ≤ C_tr 2 * R_tr⁻¹ := h_bd
        linarith only [h_bd', h_lt]
      have hρt_c_ne : (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast inv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hρ_t_pos)
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hρt_c_ne (sub_eq_zero.mp h_diff_zero)

    
    have h_vel_supp : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ((17 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) * ρ_t ≤ ‖v - V_O o‖ → h_vel v = 0 := by
      intro v hv_out
      dsimp only [h_vel]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α hα => ?_)
      have hα_vel : ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cov * ρ_t := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα).2
      have hv_Vat : 4 * ρ_r ≤ ‖v - V_at α‖ := by
        have htri : ‖v - V_O o‖ ≤ ‖v - V_at α‖ + ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ := by
          have heq : v - V_O o = (v - V_at α) + (V_at α - V_O o) := by abel
          rw [heq, norm_sub_rev (V_O o) (V_at α)]
          exact norm_add_le _ _
        have hVO_le : ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ ≤ ((16 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) * ρ_t :=
          le_trans hα_vel (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCcov_ML hρ_t_pos.le)
        have h4ρr_le : 4 * ρ_r ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) * ρ_t := by
          rw [hρ_r_eq_t, ← mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sm_4h hρ_t_pos.le
        linarith only [hv_out, htri, hVO_le, h4ρr_le]
      have hz_ge4 : 4 ≤ ‖ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α)‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ_r_pos.le)]
        have hv_Vat' : 4 * ρ_r ≤ ‖v - V_at α‖ := hv_Vat
        rw [mul_comm 4 ρ_r] at hv_Vat'
        exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hρ_r_pos).mpr hv_Vat'
      have hψ_z : sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α)) = 0 := (h_at_props α).2.1 _ hz_ge4
      dsimp only [g_at]
      rw [hψ_z, star_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero]

    obtain ⟨hmeas_all, hmem_all, hL2_all⟩ := h_sub_L2 Finset.univ
    obtain ⟨hmeas_vel, hmem_vel, hL2_vel⟩ := h_sub_L2 S_vel
    have hh_sub_eq : h_sub = fun v => ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ, sub.c_at α * g_at α v := rfl

    have h_err1 : ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_sub (ψ_loc o)‖ ≤
        (2 * C_loc * Real.sqrt (C_Bes_at * C_at_cnt)) * ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl := by
      have h_at_X0 : P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) = P_pair h_vel (ψ_O o) := by
        dsimp only [P_pair]
        rw [h_vel_pair_eq (X_O o) (by
          rw [sub_self, norm_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (inv_nonneg.mpr cls.ha₀.le))
              (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
            (inv_nonneg.mpr (mul_pos hlam_pos hρ_t_pos).le))]
      rw [h_at_X0]
      have h_raw := hψl_pair h_sub h_vel hmeas_all hmem_all hmeas_vel hmem_vel
        h_vel_supp h_vel_pair_eq
      have hexp_ge : E_fl + 2 * θ ≤ (N_tay : ℝ) * θ + -(12 * cls.K_hor + 10 + ξ) := by
        have hNt : E_fl + (13 * cls.K_hor + 10 + ξ) + 2 * θ ≤ (N_tay : ℝ) * θ := hNtay_mul
        linarith only [hNt, cls.hK_hor]
      have hrpow_le : ε ^ ((N_tay : ℝ) * θ) * ε ^ (-(12 * cls.K_hor + 10 + ξ)) ≤
          ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, add_comm (2 * θ) E_fl]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε_pos hε_le1 hexp_ge
      calc ‖P_pair h_vel (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_sub (ψ_loc o)‖
          ≤ C_loc * ε ^ ((N_tay : ℝ) * θ) *
              (Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖h_vel v‖ ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖h_sub v‖ ^ 2)) := h_raw
        _ ≤ C_loc * ε ^ ((N_tay : ℝ) * θ) *
              (2 * (Real.sqrt (C_Bes_at * C_at_cnt) * ε ^ (-(12 * cls.K_hor + 10 + ξ)))) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_
              (mul_nonneg hCloc_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
            linarith only [hL2_vel, hL2_all]
        _ = (2 * C_loc * Real.sqrt (C_Bes_at * C_at_cnt)) *
              (ε ^ ((N_tay : ℝ) * θ) * ε ^ (-(12 * cls.K_hor + 10 + ξ))) := by ring
        _ ≤ (2 * C_loc * Real.sqrt (C_Bes_at * C_at_cnt)) * (ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le
              (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hCloc_nn) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
        _ = (2 * C_loc * Real.sqrt (C_Bes_at * C_at_cnt)) * ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl := by ring

    
    let S_buf : Finset (Fin N_ret) :=
      Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret => ‖V_O o - V_at α‖ ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) / 64) * ρ_t)
    let S_rem : Finset (Fin N_ret) := S_buf \ T_cand (Q_of o)
    let h_cand_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
      fun v => ∑ α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o), sub.c_at α * g_at α v

    have h_pair_sum : ∀ S : Finset (Fin N_ret),
        P_pair (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) (ψ_loc o) =
          ∑ α ∈ S, sub.c_at α * P_pair (g_at α) (ψ_loc o) := by
      intro S
      dsimp only [P_pair]
      have h_int_each : ∀ α ∈ S, MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            sub.c_at α * g_at α v * ψ_loc o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
          MeasureTheory.volume := fun α _ =>
        h_single_int Φ₀ hΦ₀_cont lam_sys ρ_r ρ_t C_r C_t cls.R_win hρ_t_pos
          (sub.c_at α) (V_at α) (X_at α) (V_O o) (X_O o) (sub.ψ_at α) (ψ_loc o)
          ((h_at_props α).1 0).continuous (hψl_sm 0).continuous hψl_supp_R
      have h_fn : (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          (∑ α ∈ S, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) * ψ_loc o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
          (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S,
            sub.c_at α * g_at α v * ψ_loc o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
        ext v
        rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [h_fn, MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum S h_int_each, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
      have h_pull : (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          sub.c_at α * g_at α v * ψ_loc o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
          (fun v => sub.c_at α * (g_at α v * ψ_loc o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) := by
        ext v; ring

      ring

            rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ (C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor))) * (ε ^ (-(10 * cls.K_hor + 10 + ξ)) *
              (C_far * (4 * C_cov) ^ (-(M_ord : ℝ)) * ε ^ ((M_ord : ℝ) * θ))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard_le
              (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
                (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCfar_nn (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _))
                  (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)))
        _ = (C_at_cnt * C_far * (4 * C_cov) ^ (-(M_ord : ℝ))) *
              (ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor)) *
                (ε ^ (-(10 * cls.K_hor + 10 + ξ)) * ε ^ ((M_ord : ℝ) * θ))) := by ring
        _ ≤ (C_at_cnt * C_far * (4 * C_cov) ^ (-(M_ord : ℝ))) * (ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le
              (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCat_pos.le hCfar_nn)
                (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _))
        _ = (C_at_cnt * C_far * (4 * C_cov) ^ (-(M_ord : ℝ))) * ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl := by
            ring

    
    have h_tot_err : ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o)‖ := by
      have htri : ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ ≤
          ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_sub (ψ_loc o)‖ +
            ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_loc o) - P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ := by
        have heq : P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o) =
            (P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_sub (ψ_loc o)) +
              (P_pair h_sub (ψ_loc o) - P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)) := by abel
        rw [heq]; exact norm_add_le _ _
      have hsum_le : ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_sub (ψ_loc o)‖ +
          ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_loc o) - P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ ≤
          C_err_coef * ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl := by
        have h1pos : 0 ≤ ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl :=
          mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
        have h_add_coef :
            (2 * C_loc * Real.sqrt (C_Bes_at * C_at_cnt)) * ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl +
              (C_at_cnt * C_far * (4 * C_cov) ^ (-(M_ord : ℝ))) * ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl +
              (ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl) =
            C_err_coef * ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl := by
          dsimp only [C_err_coef]; ring
        linarith only [h_err1, h_err2, h1pos, h_add_coef]
      have h_quarter : C_err_coef * ε ^ (2 * θ) * ε ^ E_fl ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ε ^ E_fl :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sm_err (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le E_fl)
      linarith only [htri, hsum_le, h_quarter, h_amp_floor]

    have h_half_le : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o)‖ ≤ ‖P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ := by
      have htri : ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o)‖ ≤
          ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ + ‖P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ := by
        have heq : P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) =
            (P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o) - P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)) +
              P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o) := by abel
        conv_lhs => rw [heq]
        exact norm_add_le _ _
      linarith only [htri, h_tot_err]

    have h_cand_pos : 0 < ‖P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ := by
      have hpos : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ε ^ E_fl :=
        mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos E_fl)
      linarith only [hpos, h_amp_floor, h_half_le]

    have hm_site_pos : 0 < m_site o := sq_pos_of_pos h_cand_pos
    have hm_site_ratio :
        generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ h_sub (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
          4 * m_site o := by
      change ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ‖P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ ^ 2
      have h2 : ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ := by
        linarith only [h_half_le]
      calc ‖P_pair h_sub (ψ_O o)‖ ^ 2
          ≤ (2 * ‖P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h2 2
        _ = 4 * ‖P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o)‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    have hT_nonempty : (T_cand (Q_of o)).Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      intro hempty
      have hzero : P_pair h_cand_o (ψ_loc o) = 0 := by
        have h_int_0 : (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            h_cand_o v * ψ_loc o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
            (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
          ext v
          change (∑ α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o), sub.c_at α * g_at α v) *
              ψ_loc o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_O o)) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_O o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 0
          rw [hempty, Finset.sum_empty, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        dsimp only [P_pair]
        rw [h_int_0, MeasureTheory.integral_zero, mul_zero]
      rw [hzero, norm_zero] at h_cand_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 h_cand_pos
    exact ⟨hm_site_pos, hm_site_ratio, hT_nonempty⟩

  
  have h_s4_act : ∀ o ∈ S_act,
      r_O o = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
      r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_loc o)) ∧
      (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_loc o z = 0) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_loc o) z‖ ≤ M_win_loc k) ∧
      (T_cand (Q_of o)).Nonempty := by
    intro o ho
    have hψ_eq : ψ_loc o = Classical.choose (hex_ψ o ho) := dif_pos ho
    obtain ⟨hψl_sm, hψl_supp_R, _, hψl_der, _⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (hex_ψ o ho)
    rw [← hψ_eq] at hψl_sm hψl_supp_R hψl_der
    obtain ⟨hr_decomp, hrloc_lt, _⟩ :=
      hs1_loc (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (h_obs_win o).1 (h_Sact o ho).1
    exact ⟨hr_decomp, hrloc_lt, hψl_sm, hψl_supp_R, hψl_der, (h_conc1 o ho).2.2⟩

  obtain ⟨h_bridge_Q, h_bridge_Z⟩ :=
    h_s4 ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys k_out m_r m_t N_O N_ret Φ₀ ζ₀ τ_V τ_X n_buf
      r_O V_O X_O ψ_loc sub S_act
      hε_pos hε_lt_half rfl hb_star0 hu_nn hs_c_lo hs_c_hi hmr_le_mt hqr_lt
      hlam_lo hlam_hi h_phase hnbuf hm_bin_pos.le
      (fun α => ⟨hw_reg α, (h_at_props α).2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩)
      h_o_mult h_vel_cnt
      (fun S => ⟨(h_sub_L2 S).1, (h_sub_L2 S).2.1⟩)
      h_s4_act h_obs_pack

  
  obtain ⟨h_list_Q, h_list_Z⟩ :=
    h_s5 ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret τ_V τ_X n_buf
      r_O V_O X_O b_D a_D r_D e_D X_D sub.loc_idx sub.o_at S_act
      hε_pos hε_lt_half rfl hs_c_lo hs_c_hi hlam_lo hlam_hi hnbuf

  refine ⟨m_site, h_conc1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q
    refine le_trans (h_bridge_Q q) ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hm_bin_pos.le
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCbridge_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
  · intro z
    refine le_trans (h_bridge_Z z) ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hm_bin_pos.le
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCbridge_le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  · intro α r_loc
    exact le_trans (h_list_Q α r_loc)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hClist_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
  · intro α d hbD haD hd2 heD
    exact le_trans (h_list_Z α d hbD haD hd2 heD)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hClist_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))

subgoal_signatures.name: subclass_atom_packing_and_far_phase_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (C_cov : ℝ) (M_mult M_ord : ℕ)
    (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) (hM_ord : 2 ≤ M_ord) :
    ∃ (B_amp D_phase : ℕ → ℝ) (C_at_cnt B_V B_X : ℝ),
      1 ≤ C_at_cnt ∧ C_cov ≤ B_V ∧ C_cov ≤ B_X ∧ 2 ≤ B_X ∧
      ∀ (γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_ret : ℕ)
        (C_tr : ℕ → ℝ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret),
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        0 < r → r < t → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        m_r = Nat.floor (r * Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2) → m_r ≤ m_t →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsValidSubclassAtoms cls M_atom γ ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys ξ C_cov
          m_r m_t M_mult C_tr Φ₀ sub →
        (ε ^ r ≤ s_c ∧ s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r ∧
         (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ (t - r) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ∧
         ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ (t - r) ∧
         0 < lam_sys ∧ 0 < ρ_r ∧ ρ_r ≤ 1 ∧ C_r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
         (N_ret : ℝ) ≤ C_at_cnt * ε ^ (-(3 * cls.K_hor)) ∧
         (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
           let w := fun z => star (sub.ψ_at α z)
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w) ∧
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → w z = 0) ∧
           (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
             ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k w z‖ ≤
               max (M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) 1)) ∧
         (letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
              ‖V_at α - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_r ∧ ‖X_at α - x₀‖ ≤ σ_r)).card : ℝ) ≤
              ((81 * M_mult : ℕ) : ℝ))) ∧
        (∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →
          cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx V_o X_o = sub.loc_idx →
          let r_loc := r_idx % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
          let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          r_idx = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc ∧
          r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
          C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |C_t - C_r| ≤ s_c / 2 ∧
          ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ s_v ∧ ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ s_x) ∧
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
           (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
           (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Finset (Fin N_ret)), Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁ ∪ S₂, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
             2 * generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S₁, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o +
             2 * ∑ α ∈ S₂, ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 * (S₂.card : ℝ) *
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o) ∧
           (∀ (I : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (F_part : (ℤ × ℤ) → Finset (Fin N_ret)),
             (∀ i₁ ∈ I, ∀ i₂ ∈ I, i₁ ≠ i₂ → Disjoint (F_part i₁) (F_part i₂)) →
             generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
               (fun v => ∑ α ∈ I.biUnion F_part, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
             (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
               generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
                 (fun v => ∑ α ∈ F_part i, sub.c_at α * g_at α v) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o)) ∧
        (∀ (C_ibp : ℝ), 0 ≤ C_ibp →
          (∀ (L_osc : ℝ), 0 < L_osc →
            ∀ (θ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k θ) →
              (∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 → L_osc ≤ deriv θ s) →
              (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 6 →
                |iteratedDeriv m (deriv θ) s| ≤ L_osc * D_phase m) →
            ∀ (u : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k u) →
              (∀ s : ℝ, 4 ≤ |s| → u s = 0) →
              (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ M_ord → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k u s‖ ≤ B_amp k) →
              ‖∫ s : ℝ, u s * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ s : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_ibp / L_osc ^ M_ord) →
          ∀ (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            r_idx < 2 ^ m_t →
            cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t r_idx V_o X_o = sub.loc_idx →
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
            (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
            let C_t := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
            ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
              (B_V * ρ_t ≤ ‖V_o - V_at α‖ →
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o = 0) ∧
              (∀ R_tr : ℝ, B_X ≤ R_tr →
                R_tr * σ_r ≤ ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ →
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ (g_at α) r_idx V_o X_o ψ_o ≤
                  ((8 * C_ibp / (cls.a₀ / 2) ^ M_ord) ^ 2) * R_tr ^ (-(2 * (M_ord : ℝ)))))

subgoal_signatures.name: microlocal_buffer_window_localization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win h θ : ℝ) (M_L N_tay : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ_le : θ ≤ h / 64)
    (hML : 256 ≤ M_L) (hNtay : 2 ≤ N_tay) :
    ∃ (M_win_loc : ℕ → ℝ) (C_loc ε_loc : ℝ),
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ M_win_loc k) ∧ 0 ≤ C_loc ∧ 0 < ε_loc ∧ ε_loc < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (ε lam_sys ρ_t C_t : ℝ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε_loc →
        0 < lam_sys → 0 < ρ_t → ρ_t ≤ ε ^ ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * h) →
        (lam_sys * ρ_t)⁻¹ ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (2 * h) →
        C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
        ∃ ψ_loc : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_loc) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_loc z = 0) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ((31 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_loc z = 0) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_loc z‖ ≤ M_win_loc k) ∧
          (∀ (H_all H_in : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H_all MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.MemLp H_all 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H_in MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.MemLp H_in 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              ((17 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) * ρ_t ≤ ‖v - V_o‖ → H_in v = 0) →
            (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              ‖x - X_o‖ ≤ 20 * a₀⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-θ)) * (lam_sys * ρ_t)⁻¹ →
              ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                H_all v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
              ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                H_in v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) →

        (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret => sub.o_at α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) →
        (∀ p_buf,
          (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
            let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)
            (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at (V_at α)))).filter
            (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(k_out + ξ))) →
        (∀ S : Finset (Fin N_ret),
          let H_S := fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, sub.c_at α * g_at α v

        (∀ o ∈ S_act,

          (T_cand (Q_of o)).Nonempty) →

         ∀ (r_i : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),

        fun d => (hd_adm d).2.2.2.2
      have h_VD_proj : ∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
          |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d) := by
        intro o d hpod
        obtain ⟨_, _, hv1, hv2, _, _⟩ := hp_pos_adm o d hpod
        exact ⟨hv1, hv2⟩
      have h_act_s4 : ∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
          let j := win_of o
          (menu j).loc_idx = cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) ∧
          (∀ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o),
            ‖gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1 - V_O o‖ ≤
              (2 * (M_L : ℝ) + 4) * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) ∧
            ‖(gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2 +
                (((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ -
                  (((menu j).loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c) •
                  gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) - X_O o‖ ≤
              (8 * C_cov * cls.B_sys + 16) * (ε ^ (-θ)) * s_x * ε ^ (u + h)) := by
        intro o d hpod
        obtain ⟨h1, _, _, _, _, _, _, h8⟩ := h_act o d hpod
        exact ⟨h1, h8⟩

      obtain ⟨h_card_FTJ, h_card_TW, h_card_DW⟩ :=
        h_s4 ε H_P t b_star lam_sys L_grid m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc
          τ_Vf τ_Xf r_O V_O X_O b_D a_D e_D V_D
          N_ret_of menu win_of p Q_of T_cand P_f n_f W_f
          hε₀ hε₁ hr_pos ht_HP hS_loc_1 hcard_loc hb_star_nn hu_ge
          hsc_lo hsc_hi hmr_le_mt hp_nn h_eD_unit h_VD_proj h_act_s4
          hL1 hL4 hnf_unit hPf_props h_align h_apert

      let B_FTJ : ℝ := C_geom * (S_per_loc : ℝ) * ε ^ (-2 * θ)
      let B_TW : ℝ := C_geom * ε ^ (-2 * θ)
      let B_DW : ℝ := C_geom * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh)
      have hε_rpow1 : 0 < ε ^ (-2 * θ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
      have hε_rpow2 : 0 < ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
      have hB_FTJ_pos : 0 < B_FTJ := mul_pos (mul_pos hC_geom_pos hS_loc_pos) hε_rpow1
      have hB_TW_pos : 0 < B_TW := mul_pos hC_geom_pos hε_rpow1
      have hB_DW_pos : 0 < B_DW := mul_pos hC_geom_pos hε_rpow2

      have h_cmi_bound :
          (let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
           let p_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), p_O o
           let p_PW := fun p_c w =>
             ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w), p_O o
           (∑ p_c ∈ Finset.univ.image P_f, ∑ w ∈ Finset.univ.image W_f,
             -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) / ell) -
          (Real.log B_FTJ + Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW) / ell ≤ I_TD_FTJ :=
        hI_lb P_f W_f B_FTJ B_TW B_DW hB_FTJ_pos hB_TW_pos hB_DW_pos
          h_card_FTJ h_card_TW h_card_DW

      have hlog_ε : Real.log ε = -ell := by
        dsimp only [ell]
        rw [Real.log_inv]
        ring
      have hlog_FTJ :
          Real.log B_FTJ = Real.log C_geom + Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) + 2 * θ * ell := by
        dsimp only [B_FTJ]
        rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos hC_geom_pos hS_loc_pos).ne' hε_rpow1.ne',
          Real.log_mul hC_geom_pos.ne' hS_loc_pos.ne', Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlog_ε]
        ring
      have hlog_TW : Real.log B_TW = Real.log C_geom + 2 * θ * ell := by
        dsimp only [B_TW]
        rw [Real.log_mul hC_geom_pos.ne' hε_rpow1.ne', Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlog_ε]
        ring
      have hlog_DW : Real.log B_DW = Real.log C_geom + (2 * θ + ζ_sh) * ell := by
        dsimp only [B_DW]
        rw [Real.log_mul hC_geom_pos.ne' hε_rpow2.ne', Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlog_ε]
        ring
      have hlog_tot :
          (Real.log B_FTJ + Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW) / ell =
            6 * θ + ζ_sh + Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell + (3 * Real.log C_geom) / ell := by
        rw [hlog_FTJ, hlog_TW, hlog_DW]
        have hsplit :
            (Real.log C_geom + Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) + 2 * θ * ell +
              (Real.log C_geom + 2 * θ * ell) +
              (Real.log C_geom + (2 * θ + ζ_sh) * ell)) / ell =
            (6 * θ + ζ_sh) * (ell / ell) + Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell +
              (3 * Real.log C_geom) / ell := by ring
        rw [hsplit, div_self hell_pos.ne']
        ring
      have hgeom_div : (3 * Real.log C_geom) / ell ≤ C_ent_info / ell :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC_ent_right hell_pos.le
      linarith only [hHin_ent, h_cmi_bound, hlog_tot, hgeom_div]

subgoal_signatures.name: multi_localizer_score_and_winner_list_split
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass) :
    ∃ C_split : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_split ∧
      ∀ (γ ε H_P L t h b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
        (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
        (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (m_site : Fin N_J → Fin N_O → ℝ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let r := t - 2 * h
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 4 → 0 < h → 0 < r →
        1 ≤ S_per_loc →
        (∀ j₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N_J =>
          (menu j).loc_idx = j₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (S_per_loc : ℝ)) →
        0 ≤ b_star → ε ^ r ≤ s_c → m_r ≤ m_t →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        (∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
          let j := win_of o
          (menu j).loc_idx = cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) ∧
          b_star ≤ b_D d ∧
          0 < m_site j o ∧
          generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
            16 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2) * m_site j o) →
        let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
          ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
        let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
        let p_cond := fun (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) =>
          if win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j then p o d / π_J j else 0
        (∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ π_J j) ∧
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j = 1) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_J j →
          (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_cond j o d) ∧
          (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond j o d = 1) ∧
          (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond j o d → win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p o d)) ∧
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
          H_J + b_star +
          (∑ j : Fin N_J, if 0 < π_J j then π_J j * (
            let p_jO := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond j o d
            let p_jD := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond j o d
            (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_jO o * Real.log (p_jO o))) / ell +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_jD d))) / ell) +
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, p_jO o * Real.log (m_site j o)) / ell) +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_jD d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)))
           else 0) +
          (7 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell) + C_split / ell

subgoal_signatures.name: single_localizer_b1_entropy_cancellation
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ε h ζ_sh ξ θ k_out m_bin C_coh_tot : ℝ)
    (d_dim M_L m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
    (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (Q_of : Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (Z_of : Fin N_O → ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (T_cand : ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin N_ret))
    (m_site : Fin N_O → ℝ)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 4)
    (hML : 1 ≤ M_L) (hC_coh : 1 ≤ C_coh_tot) (hm_bin : 0 < m_bin)
    (hp_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_cond o d)
    (hp_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d = 1) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    let p_O := fun o : Fin N_O => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d
    let p_D := fun d : Fin N_D => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond o d
    let S_act := Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => 0 < p_O o)
    (∀ o ∈ S_act,
      (Z_of o).1 = Q_of o ∧
      (Q_of o).2.1 = r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
      0 < m_site o ∧
      (T_cand (Q_of o)).Nonempty) →
    (∀ q, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q), m_site o ≤
      C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-ξ) * ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * m_bin) →
    (∀ z, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), m_site o ≤
      C_coh_tot * ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - 2 * ξ) *
        ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) * m_bin) →
    (∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (r_loc : ℕ),
      (((S_act.image Q_of).filter (fun q =>
        q.2.1 = r_loc ∧ α ∈ T_cand q)).card : ℝ) ≤ C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) →
    (∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (d : Fin N_D),
      0 < p_D d →
      (((S_act.filter (fun o => 0 < p_cond o d ∧ α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o))).image
        Z_of).card : ℝ) ≤ C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh)) →
    let q_cand : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin N_ret → ℝ := fun o d α =>
      if α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o) then p_cond o d / ((T_cand (Q_of o)).card : ℝ) else 0
    let q_T := fun α => ∑ o, ∑ d, q_cand o d α
    let q_TD := fun α d => ∑ o, q_cand o d α
    let q_D := fun d => ∑ o, ∑ α, q_cand o d α
    let q_TR := fun α (rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r))) =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) = rl.1),
        ∑ d, q_cand o d α
    q_D = p_D ∧
    (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log (m_site o)) / ell) ≤
    (∑ α : Fin N_ret, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell +
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log m_bin / ell) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (
      (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / q_D d))) / ell +
      2 * ((∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r)),
        -(q_TR α rl * Real.log (q_TR α rl / q_T α))) / ell) +
      k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) +
    4 * θ + 2 * ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ_sh +
    (3 * Real.log C_coh_tot + 2 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ)) / ell

subgoal_signatures.name: assembled_cmi_lower_bound_of_fiber_lists
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 4)
    (N_O N_D N_J : ℕ) (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
    (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (Q_of : Fin N_J → Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (T_cand : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin (N_ret_of j)))
    (F_of : ∀ j : Fin N_J, Fin N_O → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hp_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d)
    (hp_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1)
    (hT_ne : ∀ o d, 0 < p o d → (T_cand (win_of o) (Q_of (win_of o) o)).Nonempty) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
    let q_cand : ∀ j : Fin N_J, Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℝ :=
      fun j o d α =>
        if win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j ∧ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o) then
          (p o d / π_J j) / ((T_cand j (Q_of j o)).card : ℝ)
        else 0
    let π_FTJ := fun j (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) =>
      ∑ o, ∑ d, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_of j o α = ft),
        π_J j * q_cand j o d α
    let π_TFTJ := fun j ft α =>
      ∑ o, ∑ d, if F_of j o α = ft then π_J j * q_cand j o d α else 0
    let π_DFTJ := fun j ft d =>
      ∑ o, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_of j o α = ft),
        π_J j * q_cand j o d α
    let π_TDFTJ := fun j ft α d =>
      ∑ o, if F_of j o α = ft then π_J j * q_cand j o d α else 0
    let S_FT : Fin N_J → Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := fun j =>
      (Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).image (fun oα : Fin N_O × Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
        F_of j oα.1 oα.2)
    let I_TD_FTJ : ℝ :=
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        if 0 < π_FTJ j ft then
          π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
            (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))
        else 0) / ell
    0 ≤ I_TD_FTJ ∧
    (∀ (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
       (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ)
       (B_FTJ B_TW B_DW : ℝ),
       0 < B_FTJ → 0 < B_TW → 0 < B_DW →
       (∀ p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
         (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => P_f o = p_c ∧ 0 < ∑ d, p o d)).biUnion
           (fun o => (T_cand (win_of o) (Q_of (win_of o) o)).image
             (fun α => (win_of o, F_of (win_of o) o α)))).card : ℝ) ≤ B_FTJ) →
       (∀ (j : Fin N_J) (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (α : Fin (N_ret_of j)),
         (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
           win_of o = j ∧ (0 < ∑ d, p o d) ∧ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o) ∧
             F_of j o α = ft)).image W_f).card : ℝ) ≤ B_TW) →
       (∀ (j : Fin N_J) (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (d : Fin N_D),
         (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
           win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p o d ∧
             ∃ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o), F_of j o α = ft)).image W_f).card : ℝ) ≤ B_DW) →
       let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
       let p_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), p_O o
       let p_PW := fun p_c w =>
         ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w), p_O o
       (∑ p_c ∈ Finset.univ.image P_f, ∑ w ∈ Finset.univ.image W_f,
         -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) / ell -
       (Real.log B_FTJ + Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW) / ell ≤ I_TD_FTJ)

subgoal_signatures.name: incoming_credit_ft_wf_fiber_card_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass) (h u_min ζ_sh C_cov e_rep : ℝ) (d_dim M_L : ℕ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hu_min : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * h ≤ u_min)
    (hζ_sh : 0 < ζ_sh) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov)
    (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hML_64 : 64 ≤ M_L) (he_rep : 0 < e_rep) :
    let θ := min (h / 64) (e_rep / 256)
    ∃ C_geom : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_geom ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P t b_star lam_sys L_grid : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc : ℕ)
        (τ_Vf τ_Xf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (e_D V_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
        (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
        (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (Q_of : Fin N_J → Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (T_cand : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin (N_ret_of j)))
        (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (n_f : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let r := t - 2 * h
        let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
        let u := u_t - b_star
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let s_Vf := L_grid * ε ^ (u_t - h)
        let s_Xf := L_grid * ε ^ (t + u_t - h)
        let F_T_fn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ℕ → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
          fun j r_loc α =>
            let V_J := gridPt2D s_v (menu j).loc_idx.2.1
            let X_J := gridPt2D s_x (menu j).loc_idx.2.2

            -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell))
         else 0) ≤
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (menu j).g_bin) +
        ((d_dim : ℝ) + 2 * γ) * h - I_TD_FTJ +
        2 * θ + 4 * ζ_sh + 2 * ξ + e_rep / 32 + C_cl_info / ell

proof.tactics:
by
  intro θ
  
  
  
  have h_ell_pos : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁
    exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr (by linarith only [hε₁]))

  have h_card_cond_ent : ∀ {α : Type} [Fintype α] (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U B : ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i : α, u i = U) → (∀ i, 0 < u i → i ∈ S) →
      0 < B → (0 < U → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ B) →
      (∑ i : α, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) ≤ U * Real.log B := by
    intro α _ S u U B hu_nn hU hsupp hB_pos hcard
    have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := by rw [← hU]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hu_nn i)
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · have hu0 : ∀ i : α, u i = 0 := fun i =>
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => hu_nn j)).mp (hU.trans hU0) i
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
      simp [hU0, hu0]
    · have hU_pos : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU_nn (Ne.symm hU0)
      have hzero_out : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α), i ∉ S → u i = 0 := by
        intro i _ hiS
        by_contra hne
        exact hiS (hsupp i (lt_of_le_of_ne (hu_nn i) (Ne.symm hne)))
      have hU_S : ∑ i ∈ S, u i = U :=
        (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S) hzero_out).trans hU
      have hent_S : (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) =
          ∑ i : α, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) :=
        Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S)
          (fun i hi hiS => by simp [hzero_out i hi hiS])
      rw [← hent_S]
      have hpt : ∀ i ∈ S,
          -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) - u i * Real.log B ≤ U / B - u i := by
        intro i _
        by_cases hui0 : u i = 0
        · simp only [hui0, zero_div, zero_mul, neg_zero, sub_zero]
          exact div_nonneg hU_nn hB_pos.le
        · have hui_pos : 0 < u i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hu_nn i) (Ne.symm hui0)
          let x := (U / B) / u i
          have hx_pos : 0 < x := div_pos (div_pos hU_pos hB_pos) hui_pos
          have hlog : Real.log x = -Real.log (u i / U) - Real.log B := by
            dsimp only [x]
            rw [Real.log_div (div_pos hU_pos hB_pos).ne' hui_pos.ne',
              Real.log_div hU_pos.ne' hB_pos.ne',
              Real.log_div hui_pos.ne' hU_pos.ne']
            ring
          have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx_pos) hui_pos.le
          have hlhs : u i * Real.log x = -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) - u i * Real.log B := by
            rw [hlog]; ring
          have hrhs : u i * (x - 1) = U / B - u i := by
            dsimp only [x]
            rw [mul_sub, mul_one, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hui_pos.ne']
          rwa [hlhs, hrhs] at h1
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hU_S,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hU_S] at hsum
      have hcard_mul : (S.card : ℝ) * (U / B) ≤ U := by
        calc (S.card : ℝ) * (U / B) ≤ B * (U / B) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcard hU_pos) (div_nonneg hU_nn hB_pos.le)
          _ = U := mul_div_cancel₀ U hB_pos.ne'
      linarith only [hsum, hcard_mul]

  have h_log_sum : ∀ {α : Type} [Fintype α] (a b : α → ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) → (∀ i, 0 < a i → 0 < b i) →
      (∑ i : α, -(a i * Real.log (a i / b i))) ≤
        -((∑ i : α, a i) * Real.log ((∑ i : α, a i) / (∑ i : α, b i))) := by
    intro α _ a b ha_nn hb_nn hab_pos
    let A := ∑ i : α, a i
    let B := ∑ i : α, b i
    change (∑ i : α, -(a i * Real.log (a i / b i))) ≤ -(A * Real.log (A / B))
    have hA_nn : 0 ≤ A := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => ha_nn i)
    by_cases hA0 : A = 0
    · have ha0 : ∀ i : α, a i = 0 := fun i =>
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => ha_nn j)).mp hA0 i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      simp [hA0, ha0]
    · have hA_pos : 0 < A := lt_of_le_of_ne hA_nn (Ne.symm hA0)
      obtain ⟨i₀, _, hai₀⟩ :=
        (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => ha_nn j)).mp hA_pos
      have hB_pos : 0 < B :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (hab_pos i₀ hai₀)
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hb_nn j) (Finset.mem_univ i₀))
      have hpt : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α),
          -(a i * Real.log (a i / b i)) + a i * Real.log (A / B) ≤ A * (b i / B) - a i := by
        intro i _
        by_cases hai0 : a i = 0
        · simp only [hai0, zero_div, zero_mul, neg_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg hA_nn (div_nonneg (hb_nn i) hB_pos.le)
        · have hai_pos : 0 < a i := lt_of_le_of_ne (ha_nn i) (Ne.symm hai0)
          have hbi_pos : 0 < b i := hab_pos i hai_pos
          let x := (A / B) / (a i / b i)
          have hx_pos : 0 < x := div_pos (div_pos hA_pos hB_pos) (div_pos hai_pos hbi_pos)
          have hlog : Real.log x = Real.log (A / B) - Real.log (a i / b i) :=
            Real.log_div (div_pos hA_pos hB_pos).ne' (div_pos hai_pos hbi_pos).ne'
          have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx_pos) hai_pos.le
          have hlhs : a i * Real.log x =
              -(a i * Real.log (a i / b i)) + a i * Real.log (A / B) := by
            rw [hlog]; ring
          have hrhs : a i * (x - 1) = A * (b i / B) - a i := by
            dsimp only [x]
            field_simp [hai_pos.ne', hbi_pos.ne', hB_pos.ne']
          rwa [hlhs, hrhs] at h1
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
      have hA_def : ∑ i : α, a i = A := rfl
      have hB_def : ∑ i : α, b i = B := rfl
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hA_def,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, hB_def, hA_def,
        div_self hB_pos.ne', mul_one, sub_self] at hsum
      linarith only [hsum]

  
  
  
  let u_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := PiLp.single 2 (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)
  have hu_vec : ‖u_vec‖ = 1 := by simp [u_vec]

  have h_perp_orth : ∀ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      inner ℝ e (perp2D e) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (perp2D e) e = 0 ∧ ‖perp2D e‖ = ‖e‖ := by
    intro e
    have h1 : inner ℝ e (perp2D e) = 0 := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [perp2D]; ring
    have h2 : inner ℝ (perp2D e) e = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm, h1]
    have h3 : ‖perp2D e‖ = ‖e‖ := by
      have hsq : ‖perp2D e‖ ^ 2 = ‖e‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp [perp2D, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]; ring
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D e), norm_nonneg e, hsq]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

  have h_perp_sub : ∀ e₁ e₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      perp2D (e₁ - e₂) = perp2D e₁ - perp2D e₂ := by
    intro e₁ e₂
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D] <;> ring

  have h_norm_le_proj : ∀ (z e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      ‖z‖ ≤ |inner ℝ z e| + |inner ℝ z (perp2D e)| := by
    intro z e he
    have he_sq : e 0 ^ 2 + e 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [he]; norm_num
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h1
    have hz_sq : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hin1 : inner ℝ z e = z 0 * e 0 + z 1 * e 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [mul_comm]
    have hin2 : inner ℝ z (perp2D e) = -(z 0 * e 1) + z 1 * e 0 := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [perp2D]; ring
    have h_ident : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℝ z e) ^ 2 + (inner ℝ z (perp2D e)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hz_sq, hin1, hin2]
      calc z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 = (z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ = (z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2) * (e 0 ^ 2 + e 1 ^ 2) := by rw [he_sq]
        _ = (z 0 * e 0 + z 1 * e 1) ^ 2 + (-(z 0 * e 1) + z 1 * e 0) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_sq_le : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (|inner ℝ z e| + |inner ℝ z (perp2D e)|) ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_ident]
      have h_abs1 : |inner ℝ z e| ^ 2 = (inner ℝ z e) ^ 2 := sq_abs _
      have h_abs2 : |inner ℝ z (perp2D e)| ^ 2 = (inner ℝ z (perp2D e)) ^ 2 := sq_abs _
      have h_prod : 0 ≤ |inner ℝ z e| * |inner ℝ z (perp2D e)| := by positivity
      nlinarith only [h_abs1, h_abs2, h_prod]
    have habs := sq_le_sq.mp h_sq_le
    rwa [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg z), abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at habs

  have h_floor_err_1d : ∀ (s x : ℝ), 0 < s → |x - (Int.floor (x / s) : ℝ) * s| ≤ s := by
    intro s x hs
    have h1 : (Int.floor (x / s) : ℝ) ≤ x / s := Int.floor_le (x / s)
    have h2 : x / s < (Int.floor (x / s) : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / s)
    have hlo : (Int.floor (x / s) : ℝ) * s ≤ x := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp h1
    have hhi : x ≤ (Int.floor (x / s) : ℝ) * s + s := by
      have h2' := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp h2
      linarith only [h2']
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hlo, hs], by linarith only [hhi]⟩

  have h_round2D_err : ∀ (s : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), 0 < s →
      ‖v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)‖ ≤ 2 * s := by
    intro s v hs
    have h_coord : ∀ x : ℝ, (x - s * (Int.floor ((x - 0) / s) : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      rw [sub_zero, mul_comm s]
      have habs := h_floor_err_1d s x hs
      exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_pos hs])
    have h_norm_sq : ‖v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hc0 : ‖(v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)) 0‖ ^ 2 =

        simp [gridPt2D, roundShift2D, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have hc1 : ‖(v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)) 1‖ ^ 2 =
          (v 1 - s * (Int.floor ((v 1 - 0) / s) : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        simp [gridPt2D, roundShift2D, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [hc0, hc1]
      nlinarith only [h_coord (v 0), h_coord (v 1), hs]
    have habs := sq_le_sq.mp h_norm_sq
    rwa [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at habs

  let dec_e : ℝ → ℤ × ℤ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun δ k_a =>
    let w := gridPt2D δ k_a
    if ‖w‖ = 0 then u_vec else ‖w‖⁻¹ • w

  have h_dec_e_unit : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (k_a : ℤ × ℤ), ‖dec_e δ k_a‖ = 1 := by
    intro δ k_a
    dsimp only [dec_e]
    split_ifs with hw0
    · exact hu_vec
    · have hw_pos : 0 < ‖gridPt2D δ k_a‖ :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hw0)
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hw_pos), inv_mul_cancel₀ hw0]

  have h_dec_e_approx : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < δ → δ < 1 / 4 → ‖e‖ = 1 →
      ‖perp2D (dec_e δ (roundShift2D δ 0 e)) - perp2D e‖ ≤ 4 * δ := by
    intro δ e hδ₀ hδ₁ he
    let k_a := roundShift2D δ 0 e
    let w := gridPt2D δ k_a
    have hew : ‖e - w‖ ≤ 2 * δ := h_round2D_err δ e hδ₀
    have hw_gt : 1 / 2 < ‖w‖ := by
      have h1 : ‖e‖ - ‖w‖ ≤ ‖e - w‖ := norm_sub_norm_le e w
      rw [he] at h1
      linarith only [h1, hew, hδ₁]
    have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := by linarith only [hw_gt]
    have hdec_eq : dec_e δ k_a = ‖w‖⁻¹ • w := if_neg hw_pos.ne'
    have hdec_w : ‖dec_e δ k_a - w‖ ≤ ‖e - w‖ := by
      rw [hdec_eq]
      have hsmul : ‖w‖⁻¹ • w - w = (‖w‖⁻¹ - 1) • w := by rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
      rw [hsmul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hmul : |‖w‖⁻¹ - 1| * ‖w‖ = |1 - ‖w‖| := by
        calc |‖w‖⁻¹ - 1| * ‖w‖ = |‖w‖⁻¹ - 1| * |‖w‖| := by rw [abs_of_pos hw_pos]
          _ = |(‖w‖⁻¹ - 1) * ‖w‖| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
          _ = |1 - ‖w‖| := by
              rw [sub_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw_pos.ne', one_mul]
      rw [hmul, ← he]
      exact abs_norm_sub_norm_le e w
    have hdec_e : ‖dec_e δ k_a - e‖ ≤ 4 * δ := by
      have htri : ‖dec_e δ k_a - e‖ ≤ ‖dec_e δ k_a - w‖ + ‖w - e‖ := by
        simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le (dec_e δ k_a - w) (w - e)
      rw [norm_sub_rev w e] at htri
      linarith only [htri, hdec_w, hew]
    rw [← h_perp_sub, (h_perp_orth _).2.2]
    exact hdec_e

  let I_1d : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Finset ℤ := fun s x₀ R =>
    Finset.Icc (Int.floor (x₀ / s - R)) (Int.floor (x₀ / s + R))

  have h_I1d_mem : ∀ (s x₀ R x : ℝ), 0 < s → |x - x₀| ≤ R * s →
      Int.floor (x / s) ∈ I_1d s x₀ R := by
    intro s x₀ R x hs habs
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
    have hlo : x₀ / s - R ≤ x / s := by
      have hdiv : (x₀ - R * s) / s ≤ x / s :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [h1]) hs.le
      rwa [sub_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ R hs.ne'] at hdiv
    have hhi : x / s ≤ x₀ / s + R := by
      have hdiv : x / s ≤ (x₀ + R * s) / s :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [h2]) hs.le
      rwa [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ R hs.ne'] at hdiv
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Int.floor_mono hlo, Int.floor_mono hhi⟩

  have h_I1d_card : ∀ (s x₀ R : ℝ), 1 ≤ R → ((I_1d s x₀ R).card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * R := by
    intro s x₀ R hR
    let a := Int.floor (x₀ / s - R)
    let b := Int.floor (x₀ / s + R)
    have hab : a ≤ b := Int.floor_mono (by linarith only [hR])
    have hnn : 0 ≤ b + 1 - a := by omega
    have hcz : ((Finset.Icc a b).card : ℤ) = b + 1 - a := by
      rw [Int.card_Icc, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn]
    have hcr : ((I_1d s x₀ R).card : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) + 1 - (a : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hcz
    have hb_le : (b : ℝ) ≤ x₀ / s + R := Int.floor_le (x₀ / s + R)
    have ha_gt : x₀ / s - R < (a : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x₀ / s - R)
    linarith only [hcr, hb_le, ha_gt, hR]

  
  
  
  let B_cl : ℝ := 16 * cls.B_sys + 4 * cls.R_win + 20
  let K_V : ℝ := 2 * (M_L : ℝ) + 3 * cls.B_sys + 6
  let K_X : ℝ := 8 * C_cov * cls.B_sys + 3 * cls.B_sys + 18

  have hKV_ge1 : 1 ≤ K_V := by
    have hML_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg M_L
    dsimp only [K_V]; linarith [cls.hB_sys, hML_nn]
  have hKX_ge1 : 1 ≤ K_X := by
    have hCB_nn : 0 ≤ C_cov * cls.B_sys := mul_nonneg (by linarith [hC_cov]) hB_sys_nn

  have hθ_pos : 0 < θ := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hθ_le_h64 : θ ≤ h / 64 := min_le_left _ _

  have h_s2 :
      ∀ (ε H_P t b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_T : ℕ)
        (loc_idx : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (o_at : Fin N_T → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin N_T → ℝ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let r := t - 2 * h

        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x loc_idx.2.2

        let X'_at : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
          fun α => s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r (o_at α).2 - X_J)
        let A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
          fun α => X'_at α - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V'_at α
        let F_T_loc : ℕ → Fin N_T → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
          fun r_loc α =>
            let c_end := ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
            (r_loc,
             roundShift2D (ε ^ (u - h)) 0 (V'_at α),
             roundShift2D (ε ^ (u + h)) 0 (X'_at α + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V'_at α))
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ b_star → u_min ≤ u → (d_dim = 2 → b_star = 0) →
        ε ^ r ≤ s_c → m_r ≤ m_t →
        (∀ α : Fin N_T, ‖V'_at α‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys + cls.R_win + 4) →
        (∀ o d α, 0 < q o d α →
          r_O o = r_D d ∧
          cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) = loc_idx ∧
