        (∀ r_loc α, (F_T_loc r_loc α).1 = r_loc) →
        (∀ d ft, (Y_bar d ft).1 = ft.1) →
        (∀ o d α, 0 < q o d α → ∀ y, w_D d ≤ pktWeight γ (b_Y y) (a_Y y) + Δ_w) →
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ d : Fin N_D,
           (((Finset.univ.filter (fun oα : Fin N_O × Fin N_T => 0 < q oα.1 d oα.2)).image
             (fun oα => Y_bar d (F_T_loc (r_O oα.1 % N_R) oα.2))).card : ℝ) ≤ B_Y) →
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let q_T := fun α => ∑ o, ∑ d, q o d α
        let q_TD := fun α d => ∑ o, q o d α
        let q_D := fun d => ∑ o, ∑ α, q o d α
        let q_TR := fun α (rl : Fin N_R) =>
          ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => r_O o % N_R = rl.1), ∑ d, q o d α
        let q_FT := fun (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) =>
          ∑ o, ∑ d, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft), q o d α
        let q_TFT := fun ft α =>
          ∑ o, ∑ d, if F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft then q o d α else 0
        let q_DFT := fun ft d =>
          ∑ o, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft), q o d α
        let q_TDFT := fun ft α d =>
          ∑ o, if F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft then q o d α else 0
        let S_FT : Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
          (Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).image (fun oα : Fin N_O × Fin N_T =>
            F_T_loc (r_O oα.1 % N_R) oα.2)
        let I_j : ℝ :=
          (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if 0 < q_FT ft then
              q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log ((q_TDFT ft α d * q_FT ft) / (q_TFT ft α * q_DFT ft d))
            else 0) / ell
        ∃ (N_ω N_G : ℕ)
          (π_cl : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
          (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
          (k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ)
          (G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G)
          (val_G : Fin N_G → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
          (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_cl ω) ∧
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_cl ω = 1) ∧
          (∀ α : Fin N_T,
            (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (T_idx ω = α) (instDecidableEqFin N_T (T_idx ω) α) (π_cl ω) 0) =
              q_T α) ∧
          (∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π_cl ω →
            ∃ (rl : Fin N_R) (d₀ : Fin N_D),
              k_time ω = (rl.1 : ℤ) ∧
              ((val_G (G_idx ω)).1 : ℤ) = k_time ω ∧
              val_G (G_idx ω) = Y_bar d₀ (F_T_loc rl.1 (T_idx ω))) ∧
          ((∑ d, q_D d * w_D d) +
           (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / q_D d))) / ell +
           2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin N_R, -(q_TR α rl * Real.log (q_TR α rl / q_T α))) / ell) ≤
           classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π_cl T_idx k_time G_idx
             (fun g => b_Y (val_G g)) (fun g => a_Y (val_G g)) +
           (∑ α : Fin N_T, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell +
           Δ_w - I_j + Real.log B_Y / ell) := by
    intro ε hε₀ hε₁ N_O N_D N_T N_R hNR r_O r_D w_D F_T_loc Y_bar b_Y a_Y q Δ_w B_Y
      hB_Y hq_nn hq_sum hr_sync hFT_fst hY_fst hw_shift hY_list
    have hNR_pos : 0 < N_R := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hNR
    have hell_pos : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε₁
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    intro ell q_T q_TD q_D q_TR q_FT q_TFT q_DFT q_TDFT S_FT I_j
    have hqT_nn : ∀ α, 0 ≤ q_T α :=
      fun α => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq_nn o d α))
    have hqTD_nn : ∀ α d, 0 ≤ q_TD α d :=
      fun α d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hq_nn o d α)
    have hqD_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d :=
      fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun α _ => hq_nn o d α))
    have hqTR_nn : ∀ α rl, 0 ≤ q_TR α rl :=
      fun α _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq_nn o d α))
    have hqTDFT_nn : ∀ ft α d, 0 ≤ q_TDFT ft α d :=
      fun _ α d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => ite_nonneg (hq_nn o d α) le_rfl)
    have hqTFT_nn : ∀ ft α, 0 ≤ q_TFT ft α :=
      fun _ α => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ =>
        ite_nonneg (hq_nn o d α) le_rfl))
    have hqDFT_eq : ∀ ft d, q_DFT ft d =
        ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ α : Fin N_T, if F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft then q o d α else 0 := by
      intro ft d; dsimp only [q_DFT]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_filter _ _)
    have hqDFT_nn : ∀ ft d, 0 ≤ q_DFT ft d :=
      fun _ d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun α _ => hq_nn o d α))
    have hqFT_eq_sum_d : ∀ ft, q_FT ft = ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_DFT ft d := by
      intro ft; dsimp only [q_FT, q_DFT]; exact Finset.sum_comm
    have hqFT_nn : ∀ ft, 0 ≤ q_FT ft :=
      fun ft => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun α _ => hq_nn o d α)))
    have h_sum_TDFT_d : ∀ ft α, (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_TDFT ft α d) = q_TFT ft α := by
      intro ft α; dsimp only [q_TDFT, q_TFT]; exact Finset.sum_comm
    have h_sum_TDFT_α : ∀ ft d, (∑ α : Fin N_T, q_TDFT ft α d) = q_DFT ft d := by
      intro ft d; rw [hqDFT_eq ft d]; dsimp only [q_TDFT]; exact Finset.sum_comm
    have h_sum_TFT_α : ∀ ft, (∑ α : Fin N_T, q_TFT ft α) = q_FT ft := by
      intro ft; rw [hqFT_eq_sum_d ft]
      simp_rw [← h_sum_TDFT_d, ← h_sum_TDFT_α]
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    have h_mem_SFT : ∀ (o : Fin N_O) (α : Fin N_T), F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α ∈ S_FT :=
      fun o α => Finset.mem_image.mpr
        ⟨(o, α), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, Finset.mem_univ α⟩, rfl⟩
    have h_sum_SFT_ite : ∀ (o : Fin N_O) (α : Fin N_T) (v : ℝ),
        (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, if F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft then v else 0) = v := by
      intro o α v
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq S_FT (F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α) (fun _ => v), if_pos (h_mem_SFT o α)]
    have h_sum_DFT_ft : ∀ d, (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, q_DFT ft d) = q_D d := by
      intro d
      simp_rw [hqDFT_eq]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => h_sum_SFT_ite o α (q o d α))
    have hqD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d = 1 := by
      dsimp only [q_D]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact hq_sum
    have hqT_sum : ∑ α : Fin N_T, q_T α = 1 := by
      dsimp only [q_T]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_comm)).trans hq_sum
    have hqTR_eq_TFT : ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (rl : Fin N_R),
        q_TR α rl = q_TFT (F_T_loc rl.1 α) α := by
      intro α rl
      dsimp only [q_TR, q_TFT]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
      by_cases hmod : r_O o % N_R = rl.1
      · rw [if_pos hmod]
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => if_pos (by rw [hmod]))).symm
      · rw [if_neg hmod]
        refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => if_neg ?_)).symm
        intro heq
        have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst heq
        rw [hFT_fst, hFT_fst] at h1
        exact hmod h1
    have hqTR_sum_rl : ∀ α : Fin N_T, (∑ rl : Fin N_R, q_TR α rl) = q_T α := by
      intro α
      let rl_of_O : Fin N_O → Fin N_R := fun o => ⟨r_O o % N_R, Nat.mod_lt _ hNR_pos⟩
      have hcongr : ∀ rl : Fin N_R,
          q_TR α rl = ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => rl_of_O o = rl), ∑ d, q o d α := by
        intro rl; dsimp only [q_TR]
        refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
        ext o
        simp (config := { decide := false }) only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
          rl_of_O, Fin.ext_iff]
      simp_rw [hcongr]
      exact Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ rl_of_O (fun o => ∑ d, q o d α)

    let YB_tri : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin N_T → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
      fun o d α => Y_bar d (F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α)
    let S_act_tri : Finset (Fin N_O × Fin N_D × Fin N_T) :=
      Finset.univ.filter (fun t => 0 < q t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
    let S_G : Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) :=
      S_act_tri.image (fun t => YB_tri t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
    have hSG_ne : S_G.Nonempty := by
      have hpos1 : 0 < ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin N_T, q o d α := by
        rw [hq_sum]; exact zero_lt_one
      obtain ⟨o₀, _, ho₀⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun α _ => hq_nn o d α)))).mp hpos1
      obtain ⟨d₀, _, hd₀⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun d _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun α _ => hq_nn o₀ d α))).mp ho₀
      obtain ⟨α₀, _, hα₀⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun α _ => hq_nn o₀ d₀ α)).mp hd₀
      exact Finset.Nonempty.image ⟨(o₀, d₀, α₀),
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hα₀⟩⟩ _
    let N_G : ℕ := S_G.card
    have hNG_pos : 0 < N_G := Finset.card_pos.mpr hSG_ne
    let e_G : S_G ≃ Fin N_G := S_G.equivFin
    let val_G : Fin N_G → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := fun g => (e_G.symm g).1
    let g_idx_of : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))) → Fin N_G :=
      fun y => if hy : y ∈ S_G then e_G ⟨y, hy⟩ else ⟨0, hNG_pos⟩
    have hval_g_idx : ∀ y, y ∈ S_G → val_G (g_idx_of y) = y := by
      intro y hy; dsimp only [val_G, g_idx_of]; rw [dif_pos hy, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    let y_idx : Fin N_D → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_G :=
      fun d ft => g_idx_of (Y_bar d ft)
    have hDFT_pos_mem_SG : ∀ ft d, 0 < q_DFT ft d →
        Y_bar d ft ∈ S_G ∧ ∃ o α, 0 < q o d α ∧ F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft := by
      intro ft d hpos
      rw [hqDFT_eq] at hpos
      obtain ⟨o, _, ho⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun α _ => ite_nonneg (hq_nn o d α) le_rfl))).mp hpos
      obtain ⟨α, _, hα⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun α _ => ite_nonneg (hq_nn o d α) le_rfl)).mp ho
      by_cases hft : F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft
      · rw [if_pos hft] at hα
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(o, d, α),
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hα⟩, ?_⟩, o, α, hα, hft⟩
        dsimp only [YB_tri]; rw [hft]
      · rw [if_neg hft] at hα; exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hα)
    have hval_G_lt_NR : ∀ g : Fin N_G, (val_G g).1 < N_R := by
      intro g
      have hmem : val_G g ∈ S_G := (e_G.symm g).2
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hmem with ⟨t, _, heq⟩
      rw [← heq]; dsimp only [YB_tri]; rw [hY_fst, hFT_fst]
      exact Nat.mod_lt _ hNR_pos
    let rl_of_G : Fin N_G → Fin N_R := fun g => ⟨(val_G g).1, hval_G_lt_NR g⟩

    let P_FT_Y : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_G → ℝ :=
      fun ft g => ∑ d : Fin N_D, if y_idx d ft = g then q_DFT ft d else 0
    let P_DY : Fin N_D → Fin N_G → ℝ :=
      fun d g => ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, if y_idx d ft = g then q_DFT ft d else 0
    let P_Y : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => ∑ d : Fin N_D, P_DY d g
    have hP_FT_Y_nn : ∀ ft g, 0 ≤ P_FT_Y ft g :=
      fun ft _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => ite_nonneg (hqDFT_nn ft d) le_rfl)
    have hP_DY_nn : ∀ d g, 0 ≤ P_DY d g :=
      fun d _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ft _ => ite_nonneg (hqDFT_nn ft d) le_rfl)
    have hP_FT_Y_sum_g : ∀ ft, (∑ g : Fin N_G, P_FT_Y ft g) = q_FT ft := by
      intro ft; dsimp only [P_FT_Y]; rw [Finset.sum_comm, hqFT_eq_sum_d]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (y_idx d ft), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    have hP_DY_sum_g : ∀ d, (∑ g : Fin N_G, P_DY d g) = q_D d := by
      intro d; dsimp only [P_DY]; rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← h_sum_DFT_ft d]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (y_idx d ft), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    have hP_Y_eq_sum_ft : ∀ g, P_Y g = ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, P_FT_Y ft g := by
      intro g; dsimp only [P_Y, P_DY, P_FT_Y]; exact Finset.sum_comm
    have hP_FT_Y_pos_imp : ∀ ft g, 0 < P_FT_Y ft g →
        ∃ d₀ : Fin N_D, 0 < q_DFT ft d₀ ∧ val_G g = Y_bar d₀ ft ∧ (val_G g).1 = ft.1 := by
      intro ft g hpos
      obtain ⟨d₀, _, hd₀⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun d _ => ite_nonneg (hqDFT_nn ft d) le_rfl)).mp hpos
      by_cases hy : y_idx d₀ ft = g
      · rw [if_pos hy] at hd₀
        have hmem := (hDFT_pos_mem_SG ft d₀ hd₀).1
        have hval : val_G g = Y_bar d₀ ft := by rw [← hy]; exact hval_g_idx _ hmem
        exact ⟨d₀, hd₀, hval, by rw [hval, hY_fst]⟩
      · rw [if_neg hy] at hd₀; exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hd₀)

    let N_ω : ℕ := N_R * (N_T * N_G)
    let e_ω : (Fin N_R × (Fin N_T × Fin N_G)) ≃ Fin N_ω :=
      (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin N_R)) finProdFinEquiv).trans finProdFinEquiv
    let T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T := fun ω => (e_ω.symm ω).2.1
    let G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G := fun ω => (e_ω.symm ω).2.2
    let k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ := fun ω => ((e_ω.symm ω).1.1 : ℤ)
    let π_raw : Fin N_R → Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun rl α g =>
      let ft := F_T_loc rl.1 α
      if 0 < q_FT ft then q_TR α rl * (P_FT_Y ft g / q_FT ft) else 0
    let π_cl : Fin N_ω → ℝ := fun ω =>
      let p := e_ω.symm ω
      π_raw p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
    have h_reidx : ∀ F : Fin N_ω → ℝ,
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, F ω) =
          ∑ rl : Fin N_R, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G, F (e_ω (rl, (α, g))) := by
      intro F
      rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e_ω F, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Fintype.sum_prod_type _)
    have hπ_app : ∀ rl α g, π_cl (e_ω (rl, (α, g))) = π_raw rl α g := by
      intro rl α g; dsimp only [π_cl]; rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hT_app : ∀ rl α g, T_idx (e_ω (rl, (α, g))) = α := by
      intro rl α g; dsimp only [T_idx]; rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hG_app : ∀ rl α g, G_idx (e_ω (rl, (α, g))) = g := by
      intro rl α g; dsimp only [G_idx]; rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hk_app : ∀ rl α g, k_time (e_ω (rl, (α, g))) = (rl.1 : ℤ) := by
      intro rl α g; dsimp only [k_time]; rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hπ_nn : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 ≤ π_cl ω := by
      intro ω; dsimp only [π_cl, π_raw]
      split_ifs with hft
      · exact mul_nonneg (hqTR_nn _ _) (div_nonneg (hP_FT_Y_nn _ _) hft.le)
      · exact le_rfl
    have hπ_sum_g : ∀ rl α, (∑ g : Fin N_G, π_raw rl α g) = q_TR α rl := by
      intro rl α; dsimp only [π_raw]
      by_cases hft : 0 < q_FT (F_T_loc rl.1 α)
      · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hft, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, hP_FT_Y_sum_g, div_self hft.ne', mul_one]
      · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hft, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        have h0 : q_FT (F_T_loc rl.1 α) = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hft) (hqFT_nn _)
        have hle : q_TR α rl ≤ q_FT (F_T_loc rl.1 α) := by
          rw [hqTR_eq_TFT α rl, ← h_sum_TFT_α]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hqTFT_nn (F_T_loc rl.1 α) α') (Finset.mem_univ α)
        exact (le_antisymm (hle.trans h0.le) (hqTR_nn α rl)).symm
    have hp_T_eq : ∀ α : Fin N_T,
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = α then π_cl ω else 0) = q_T α := by
      intro α; rw [h_reidx]
      simp_rw [hT_app, hπ_app]
      have hin : ∀ rl : Fin N_R,
          (∑ α' : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G, if α' = α then π_raw rl α' g else 0) = q_TR α rl := by
        intro rl
        have h1 : ∀ α' : Fin N_T,
            (∑ g : Fin N_G, if α' = α then π_raw rl α' g else 0) =
              if α' = α then q_TR α rl else 0 := by
          intro α'; by_cases hα : α' = α
          · subst hα; simp (config := { decide := false }) only [↓reduceIte, hπ_sum_g]
          · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hα, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        simp_rw [h1]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ α, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ α)]
      simp_rw [hin]
      exact hqTR_sum_rl α
    have hc_T : ∀ tid : Fin N_T,
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (T_idx ω = tid) (instDecidableEqFin N_T (T_idx ω) tid) (π_cl ω) 0) =
          q_T tid := fun tid =>
      (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ite_congr rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl))).trans (hp_T_eq tid)
    have hπ_sum : ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π_cl ω = 1 := by
      rw [h_reidx]; simp_rw [hπ_app, hπ_sum_g]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [hqTR_sum_rl]; exact hqT_sum
    have h_supp_ω : ∀ ω : Fin N_ω, 0 < π_cl ω →
        ∃ (rl : Fin N_R) (d₀ : Fin N_D),
          k_time ω = (rl.1 : ℤ) ∧
          ((val_G (G_idx ω)).1 : ℤ) = k_time ω ∧
          val_G (G_idx ω) = Y_bar d₀ (F_T_loc rl.1 (T_idx ω)) := by
      intro ω hω
      let p := e_ω.symm ω
      let rl := p.1
      let α := p.2.1
      let g := p.2.2
      change 0 < π_raw rl α g at hω
      dsimp only [π_raw] at hω
      let ft := F_T_loc rl.1 α
      by_cases hft : 0 < q_FT ft
      · rw [if_pos hft] at hω
        have hP_pos : 0 < P_FT_Y ft g := by
          by_contra hle
          have h0 : P_FT_Y ft g = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hle) (hP_FT_Y_nn ft g)
          rw [h0, zero_div, mul_zero] at hω; exact lt_irrefl 0 hω
        obtain ⟨d₀, _, hval_eq, hfst_eq⟩ := hP_FT_Y_pos_imp ft g hP_pos
        rw [hFT_fst] at hfst_eq
        exact ⟨rl, d₀, rfl, by change ((val_G g).1 : ℤ) = (rl.1 : ℤ); rw [hfst_eq], hval_eq⟩
      · rw [if_neg hft] at hω; exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hω)

    refine ⟨N_ω, N_G, π_cl, T_idx, k_time, G_idx, val_G,
      hπ_nn, hπ_sum, hc_T, h_supp_ω, ?_⟩

    unfold classicalTransportScore
    dsimp only
    let p_TG : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun α g =>
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = α ∧ G_idx ω = g then π_cl ω else 0
    let p_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g =>
      ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if G_idx ω = g then π_cl ω else 0
    let π_FT_TG : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun ft α g =>
      if 0 < q_FT ft then q_TFT ft α * (P_FT_Y ft g / q_FT ft) else 0
    have hπ_FT_TG_nn : ∀ ft α g, 0 ≤ π_FT_TG ft α g := by
      intro ft α g; dsimp only [π_FT_TG]
      split_ifs with hft
      · exact mul_nonneg (hqTFT_nn ft α) (div_nonneg (hP_FT_Y_nn ft g) hft.le)
      · exact le_rfl
    have hp_TG_eq_raw : ∀ α g, p_TG α g = π_raw (rl_of_G g) α g := by
      intro α g; dsimp only [p_TG]; rw [h_reidx]
      simp_rw [hT_app, hG_app, hπ_app]
      have hin : ∀ rl : Fin N_R,
          (∑ α' : Fin N_T, ∑ g' : Fin N_G, if α' = α ∧ g' = g then π_raw rl α' g' else 0) =
            π_raw rl α g := by
        intro rl
        have h1 : ∀ α' : Fin N_T,
            (∑ g' : Fin N_G, if α' = α ∧ g' = g then π_raw rl α' g' else 0) =
              if α' = α then π_raw rl α g else 0 := by
          intro α'; by_cases hα : α' = α
          · subst hα; rw [if_pos rfl]
            simp (config := { decide := false }) only [true_and]
            rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ g, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ g)]
          · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hα, false_and, ↓reduceIte,
              Finset.sum_const_zero]
        simp_rw [h1]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ α, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ α)]
      simp_rw [hin]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_single (rl_of_G g) ?_ (fun hnot => False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ _)))
      intro rl _ hne; dsimp only [π_raw]
      by_cases hft : 0 < q_FT (F_T_loc rl.1 α)
      · rw [if_pos hft]
        have hP0 : P_FT_Y (F_T_loc rl.1 α) g = 0 := by
          by_contra hPne
          have hPpos : 0 < P_FT_Y (F_T_loc rl.1 α) g :=
            lt_of_le_of_ne (hP_FT_Y_nn _ g) (Ne.symm hPne)
          obtain ⟨_, _, _, hfst⟩ := hP_FT_Y_pos_imp _ g hPpos
          rw [hFT_fst] at hfst
          exact hne (Fin.ext hfst.symm)
        rw [hP0, zero_div, mul_zero]
      · rw [if_neg hft]
    have hπ_FT_TG_single : ∀ ft ∈ S_FT, ∀ α g,
        ft ≠ F_T_loc (rl_of_G g).1 α → π_FT_TG ft α g = 0 := by
      intro ft _ α g hne; dsimp only [π_FT_TG]
      by_cases hft : 0 < q_FT ft
      · rw [if_pos hft]
        by_cases hP0 : P_FT_Y ft g = 0
        · rw [hP0, zero_div, mul_zero]
        · have hPpos : 0 < P_FT_Y ft g := lt_of_le_of_ne (hP_FT_Y_nn ft g) (Ne.symm hP0)
          obtain ⟨_, _, _, hfst⟩ := hP_FT_Y_pos_imp ft g hPpos
          have hTFT0 : q_TFT ft α = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => if_neg ?_))
            intro heq
            have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst heq
            rw [hFT_fst] at h1
            have hrl_val : r_O o % N_R = (rl_of_G g).1 := h1.trans hfst.symm
            rw [hrl_val] at heq; exact hne heq.symm
          rw [hTFT0, zero_mul]
      · rw [if_neg hft]
    have hπ_FT_TG_sum_ft : ∀ α g, (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, π_FT_TG ft α g) = p_TG α g := by
      intro α g; rw [hp_TG_eq_raw α g]
      let ft₀ := F_T_loc (rl_of_G g).1 α
      by_cases hmem : ft₀ ∈ S_FT
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ft₀ (fun ft hft hne => hπ_FT_TG_single ft hft α g hne)
          (fun hnot => False.elim (hnot hmem))]
        dsimp only [π_FT_TG, π_raw]; rw [hqTR_eq_TFT α (rl_of_G g)]
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ft hft =>
          hπ_FT_TG_single ft hft α g (fun heq => hmem (by dsimp only [ft₀]; rwa [← heq])))]
        have hqFT0 : q_FT ft₀ = 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => ?_))
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α' hα' => ?_)
          have heq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα').2
          exact False.elim (hmem (heq ▸ h_mem_SFT o α'))
        dsimp only [π_raw]
        change 0 = if 0 < q_FT ft₀ then _ else 0
        rw [hqFT0, if_neg (lt_irrefl 0)]
    have hπ_FT_TG_sum_α : ∀ ft g, (∑ α : Fin N_T, π_FT_TG ft α g) = P_FT_Y ft g := by
      intro ft g; dsimp only [π_FT_TG]
      by_cases hft : 0 < q_FT ft
      · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hft, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h_sum_TFT_α ft, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hft.ne']
      · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hft, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        have h0 : q_FT ft = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hft) (hqFT_nn ft)
        have hle : P_FT_Y ft g ≤ q_FT ft := by
          rw [← hP_FT_Y_sum_g ft]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun g' _ => hP_FT_Y_nn ft g') (Finset.mem_univ g)
        exact (le_antisymm (hle.trans h0.le) (hP_FT_Y_nn ft g)).symm
    have hπ_FT_TG_sum_g : ∀ ft α, (∑ g : Fin N_G, π_FT_TG ft α g) = q_TFT ft α := by
      intro ft α; dsimp only [π_FT_TG]
      by_cases hft : 0 < q_FT ft
      · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hft, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, hP_FT_Y_sum_g ft, div_self hft.ne', mul_one]
      · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hft, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        have h0 : q_FT ft = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hft) (hqFT_nn ft)
        have hle : q_TFT ft α ≤ q_FT ft := by
          rw [← h_sum_TFT_α ft]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hqTFT_nn ft α') (Finset.mem_univ α)
        exact (le_antisymm (hle.trans h0.le) (hqTFT_nn ft α)).symm
    have hp_G_eq_PY : ∀ g : Fin N_G, p_G g = P_Y g := by
      intro g
      have hpG_sum : p_G g = ∑ α : Fin N_T, p_TG α g := by
        dsimp only [p_G, p_TG]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => ?_)
        by_cases hg : G_idx ω = g
        · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hg, and_true, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (T_idx ω), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
        · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hg, and_false, ↓reduceIte,
            Finset.sum_const_zero]
      rw [hpG_sum]; simp_rw [← hπ_FT_TG_sum_ft]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hπ_FT_TG_sum_α]
      exact (hP_Y_eq_sum_ft g).symm

    let emb_R : Fin N_R → ℤ := fun rv => (rv.1 : ℤ)
    have hemb_inj : Set.InjOn emb_R ↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_R)) :=
      fun _ _ _ _ heq => Fin.ext (Int.ofNat.inj heq)
    have h_S_cells_sub : (Finset.univ.image k_time : Finset ℤ) ⊆ Finset.univ.image emb_R := by
      intro k hk
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hk with ⟨ω, _, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(e_ω.symm ω).1, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    have h_St_match : ∀ α : Fin N_T,
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.image k_time,
          -((∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = α ∧ k_time ω = k then π_cl ω else 0) *
            Real.log ((∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = α ∧ k_time ω = k then π_cl ω else 0) / q_T α))) =
        ∑ rv : Fin N_R, -(q_TR α rv * Real.log (q_TR α rv / q_T α)) := by
      intro α
      rw [Finset.sum_subset h_S_cells_sub]
      · rw [Finset.sum_image hemb_inj]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun rv _ => ?_)
        have hpTC_rv : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = α ∧ k_time ω = emb_R rv then π_cl ω else 0) =
            q_TR α rv := by
          rw [h_reidx]; simp_rw [hT_app, hk_app, hπ_app]
          have hin : ∀ rl : Fin N_R,
              (∑ α' : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
                if α' = α ∧ (rl.1 : ℤ) = emb_R rv then π_raw rl α' g else 0) =
              if rl = rv then q_TR α rv else 0 := by
            intro rl
            by_cases hrl : rl = rv
            · subst hrl
              have h1 : ∀ α' : Fin N_T,
                  (∑ g : Fin N_G, if α' = α ∧ (rl.1 : ℤ) = emb_R rl then π_raw rl α' g else 0) =
                    if α' = α then q_TR α rl else 0 := by
                intro α'
                by_cases hα : α' = α
                · subst hα; simp (config := { decide := false }) only [emb_R, and_self, ↓reduceIte, hπ_sum_g]
                · simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hα, false_and, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
              simp_rw [h1]
              simp (config := { decide := false }) only [↓reduceIte]
              rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ α, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ α)]
            · have hne : (rl.1 : ℤ) ≠ emb_R rv := fun hc => hrl (Fin.ext (Int.ofNat.inj hc))
              rw [if_neg hrl]
              refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α' _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun g _ => ?_))
              simp (config := { decide := false }) only [hne, and_false, ↓reduceIte]
          simp_rw [hin]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ rv, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ rv)]
        rw [hpTC_rv]
      · intro k _ hk_not
        have hp0 : (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = α ∧ k_time ω = k then π_cl ω else 0) = 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ω _ => if_neg ?_)
          rintro ⟨_, rfl⟩
          exact hk_not (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨ω, Finset.mem_univ ω, rfl⟩)
        rw [hp0, zero_mul, neg_zero]

    let H_TG : ℝ := ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G, -(p_TG α g * Real.log (p_TG α g / P_Y g))
    let H_T : ℝ := ∑ α : Fin N_T, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))
    have h_MI_TG : -(∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
          p_TG α g * Real.log (p_TG α g / (q_T α * P_Y g))) = H_TG - H_T := by
      have hpTG_nn : ∀ α g, 0 ≤ p_TG α g :=
        fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => ite_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) le_rfl)
      have hpTG_sum_g : ∀ α, (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_TG α g) = q_T α := by
        intro α; simp_rw [← hπ_FT_TG_sum_ft]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hπ_FT_TG_sum_g]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_sum_SFT_ite o α (q o d α))
      have h_term : ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (g : Fin N_G),
          -(p_TG α g * Real.log (p_TG α g / (q_T α * P_Y g))) =
          -(p_TG α g * Real.log (p_TG α g / P_Y g)) + p_TG α g * Real.log (q_T α) := by
        intro α g
        by_cases h0 : p_TG α g = 0
        · rw [h0]; ring
        · have hpos : 0 < p_TG α g := lt_of_le_of_ne (hpTG_nn α g) (Ne.symm h0)
          have hqT_pos : 0 < q_T α := by
            rw [← hpTG_sum_g α]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun g' _ => hpTG_nn α g') (Finset.mem_univ g))
          have hPY_pos : 0 < P_Y g := by
            rw [← hp_G_eq_PY g]
            have hpG_ge : p_TG α g ≤ p_G g :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => by
                by_cases h1 : T_idx ω = α ∧ G_idx ω = g
                · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h1.2]
                · rw [if_neg h1]; exact ite_nonneg (hπ_nn ω) le_rfl)
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hpG_ge
          have hdiv : p_TG α g / (q_T α * P_Y g) = (p_TG α g / P_Y g) / q_T α := by
            rw [div_div, mul_comm (P_Y g) (q_T α)]
          rw [hdiv, Real.log_div (div_pos hpos hPY_pos).ne' hqT_pos.ne']
          ring
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have h1 : (∑ α : Fin N_T, -(∑ g : Fin N_G, p_TG α g * Real.log (p_TG α g / (q_T α * P_Y g)))) =
          ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
            (-(p_TG α g * Real.log (p_TG α g / P_Y g)) + p_TG α g * Real.log (q_T α)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
        rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => h_term α g)
      rw [h1]
      have h2 : (∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
            (-(p_TG α g * Real.log (p_TG α g / P_Y g)) + p_TG α g * Real.log (q_T α))) =
          H_TG + ∑ α : Fin N_T, (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_TG α g) * Real.log (q_T α) := by
        dsimp only [H_TG]; rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [h2]; simp_rw [hpTG_sum_g]; dsimp only [H_T]
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      simp (config := { decide := false }) only [neg_neg]

    have hw_comp : (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * w_D d) ≤
        (∑ g : Fin N_G, P_Y g * ((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G g) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G g))) + Δ_w := by
      have hpt : ∀ (d : Fin N_D) (g : Fin N_G),
          P_DY d g * w_D d ≤
            P_DY d g * ((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G g) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G g)) + P_DY d g * Δ_w := by
        intro d g
        by_cases h0 : P_DY d g = 0
        · rw [h0]; simp (config := { decide := false }) only [zero_mul, add_zero, le_refl]
        · have hpos : 0 < P_DY d g := lt_of_le_of_ne (hP_DY_nn d g) (Ne.symm h0)
          obtain ⟨ft, _, hft_pos⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
            (fun ft _ => ite_nonneg (hqDFT_nn ft d) le_rfl)).mp hpos
          have hDFT_pos : 0 < q_DFT ft d := by
            by_cases hy : y_idx d ft = g
            · rwa [if_pos hy] at hft_pos
            · rw [if_neg hy] at hft_pos; exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hft_pos)
          obtain ⟨_, o, α, hq_pos, _⟩ := hDFT_pos_mem_SG ft d hDFT_pos
          have hw := hw_shift o d α hq_pos (val_G g)
          dsimp only [pktWeight] at hw
          have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw hpos.le
          linarith only [hm, show P_DY d g * (((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G g) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G g)) + Δ_w) =
            P_DY d g * ((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G g) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G g)) + P_DY d g * Δ_w by ring]
      have hsum_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * w_D d ≤
          (∑ g : Fin N_G, P_DY d g * ((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G g) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G g))) +
            q_D d * Δ_w := by
        intro d
        have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun g (_ : g ∈ Finset.univ) => hpt d g)
        rwa [← Finset.sum_mul, hP_DY_sum_g d, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
          hP_DY_sum_g d] at hs
      have hsum_all := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d (_ : d ∈ Finset.univ) => hsum_d d)
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hqD_sum, one_mul, Finset.sum_comm] at hsum_all
      have h_g_eq : (∑ x : Fin N_G, ∑ y : Fin N_D,
            P_DY y x * ((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G x) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G x))) =
          ∑ g : Fin N_G, P_Y g * ((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G g) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G g)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm)
      rwa [h_g_eq] at hsum_all

    let H_TD : ℝ := ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / q_D d))
    let I_num : ℝ := ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      if 0 < q_FT ft then
        q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log ((q_TDFT ft α d * q_FT ft) / (q_TFT ft α * q_DFT ft d))
      else 0
    let H_T_FT : ℝ := ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, -(q_TFT ft α * Real.log (q_TFT ft α / q_FT ft))
    let H_FT_D : ℝ := ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / q_D d))
    let H_FT_Y : ℝ := ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ g : Fin N_G, -(P_FT_Y ft g * Real.log (P_FT_Y ft g / P_Y g))
    let H_Y_D : ℝ := ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ g : Fin N_G, -(P_DY d g * Real.log (P_DY d g / q_D d))
    let H_FT_DY : ℝ := ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / P_DY d (y_idx d ft)))

    have h_id1 : H_TD = -I_num + H_T_FT + H_FT_D := by
      have h_single_td : ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (d : Fin N_D),
          -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / q_D d)) =
            ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_TDFT ft α d / q_D d)) := by
        intro α d
        by_cases h0 : q_TD α d = 0
        · rw [h0, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero]
          refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ft _ => ?_)).symm
          have hle : q_TDFT ft α d ≤ q_TD α d :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun o _ => by
              by_cases hc : F_T_loc (r_O o % N_R) α = ft
              · rw [if_pos hc]
              · rw [if_neg hc]; exact hq_nn o d α)
          have hft0 : q_TDFT ft α d = 0 := le_antisymm (hle.trans h0.le) (hqTDFT_nn ft α d)
          rw [hft0, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero]
        · have hpos : 0 < q_TD α d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hqTD_nn α d) (Ne.symm h0)
          obtain ⟨o₀, _, ho₀⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun o _ => hq_nn o d α)).mp hpos
          let ft₁ := F_T_loc (r_D d % N_R) α
          have hft₁_mem : ft₁ ∈ S_FT := by
            have hr₀ := hr_sync o₀ d α ho₀
            dsimp only [ft₁]; rw [← hr₀]; exact h_mem_SFT o₀ α
          have h_other : ∀ ft ∈ S_FT, ft ≠ ft₁ →
              -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_TDFT ft α d / q_D d)) = 0 := by
            intro ft _ hne
            have hft0 : q_TDFT ft α d = 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o _ => ?_)
              by_cases hq0 : q o d α = 0
              · rw [hq0, ite_self]
              · have hq_pos : 0 < q o d α := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq_nn o d α) (Ne.symm hq0)
                have hr_eq := hr_sync o d α hq_pos
                exact if_neg (fun heq => hne (by dsimp only [ft₁]; rw [← hr_eq]; exact heq.symm))
            rw [hft0, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero]
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ft₁ h_other (fun hnot => False.elim (hnot hft₁_mem))]
          have h_at : q_TDFT ft₁ α d = q_TD α d := by
            dsimp only [q_TDFT, q_TD]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
            by_cases hq0 : q o d α = 0
            · rw [hq0, ite_self]
            · have hq_pos : 0 < q o d α := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq_nn o d α) (Ne.symm hq0)
              rw [if_pos (by dsimp only [ft₁]; rw [hr_sync o d α hq_pos])]
          rw [h_at]
      have h_term : ∀ ft ∈ S_FT, ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (d : Fin N_D),
          -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_TDFT ft α d / q_D d)) =
            -(if 0 < q_FT ft then
                q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log ((q_TDFT ft α d * q_FT ft) / (q_TFT ft α * q_DFT ft d))
              else 0) +
            (-(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_TFT ft α / q_FT ft))) +
            (-(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / q_D d))) := by
        intro ft hft_mem α d
        by_cases h0 : q_TDFT ft α d = 0
        · rw [h0]; split_ifs <;> ring
        · have hpos : 0 < q_TDFT ft α d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hqTDFT_nn ft α d) (Ne.symm h0)
          have hTFT_pos : 0 < q_TFT ft α := by
            rw [← h_sum_TDFT_d ft α]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos
              (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hqTDFT_nn ft α d') (Finset.mem_univ d))
          have hFT_pos : 0 < q_FT ft := by
            rw [← h_sum_TFT_α ft]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hTFT_pos
              (Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hqTFT_nn ft α') (Finset.mem_univ α))
          have hDFT_pos : 0 < q_DFT ft d := by
            rw [← h_sum_TDFT_α ft d]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos
              (Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hqTDFT_nn ft α' d) (Finset.mem_univ α))
          have hD_pos : 0 < q_D d := by
            rw [← h_sum_DFT_ft d]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hDFT_pos
              (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ft' _ => hqDFT_nn ft' d) hft_mem)
          rw [if_pos hFT_pos]
          let r1 := (q_TDFT ft α d * q_FT ft) / (q_TFT ft α * q_DFT ft d)
          let r2 := q_TFT ft α / q_FT ft
          let r3 := q_DFT ft d / q_D d
          have hr1 : 0 < r1 := div_pos (mul_pos hpos hFT_pos) (mul_pos hTFT_pos hDFT_pos)
          have hr2 : 0 < r2 := div_pos hTFT_pos hFT_pos
          have hr3 : 0 < r3 := div_pos hDFT_pos hD_pos
          have hprod : q_TDFT ft α d / q_D d = r1 * r2 * r3 := by
            dsimp only [r1, r2, r3]
            have hFT_ne := hFT_pos.ne'
            have hTFT_ne := hTFT_pos.ne'
            have hDFT_ne := hDFT_pos.ne'
            calc q_TDFT ft α d / q_D d
                = q_TDFT ft α d * (q_FT ft * (q_FT ft)⁻¹) * (q_TFT ft α * (q_TFT ft α)⁻¹) *
                    (q_DFT ft d * (q_DFT ft d)⁻¹) * (q_D d)⁻¹ := by
                  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hFT_ne, mul_inv_cancel₀ hTFT_ne, mul_inv_cancel₀ hDFT_ne,
                    mul_one, mul_one, mul_one, div_eq_mul_inv]
              _ = ((q_TDFT ft α d * q_FT ft) * (q_TFT ft α * q_DFT ft d)⁻¹) *
                    (q_TFT ft α * (q_FT ft)⁻¹) * (q_DFT ft d * (q_D d)⁻¹) := by
                  rw [mul_inv]; ring
              _ = r1 * r2 * r3 := by simp only [r1, r2, r3, div_eq_mul_inv]
          rw [hprod, Real.log_mul (mul_pos hr1 hr2).ne' hr3.ne', Real.log_mul hr1.ne' hr2.ne']
          ring
      have h1 : H_TD = ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_TDFT ft α d / q_D d)) := by
        dsimp only [H_TD]; simp_rw [h_single_td]
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => Finset.sum_comm)).trans Finset.sum_comm
      rw [h1]
      have h2 : (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_TDFT ft α d / q_D d))) =
          (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(if 0 < q_FT ft then
                q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log ((q_TDFT ft α d * q_FT ft) / (q_TFT ft α * q_DFT ft d))
              else 0)) +
          (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_TFT ft α / q_FT ft))) +
          (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / q_D d))) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft hft => ?_)
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_term ft hft α d)
      rw [h2]
      have ht1 : (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(if 0 < q_FT ft then
                q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log ((q_TDFT ft α d * q_FT ft) / (q_TFT ft α * q_DFT ft d))
              else 0)) = -I_num := by
        dsimp only [I_num]; simp_rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have ht2 : (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_TFT ft α / q_FT ft))) = H_T_FT := by
        dsimp only [H_T_FT]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_))
        rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, h_sum_TDFT_d ft α]
      have ht3 : (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(q_TDFT ft α d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / q_D d))) = H_FT_D := by
        dsimp only [H_FT_D]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, h_sum_TDFT_α ft d]
      rw [ht1, ht2, ht3]

    have h_id2 : H_TG = H_T_FT + H_FT_Y := by
      have h_single_tg : ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (g : Fin N_G),
          -(p_TG α g * Real.log (p_TG α g / P_Y g)) =
            ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, -(π_FT_TG ft α g * Real.log (π_FT_TG ft α g / P_Y g)) := by
        intro α g
        by_cases h0 : p_TG α g = 0
        · rw [h0, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero]
          refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ft hft => ?_)).symm
          have hle : π_FT_TG ft α g ≤ p_TG α g := by
            rw [← hπ_FT_TG_sum_ft α g]
            exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun ft' _ => hπ_FT_TG_nn ft' α g) hft
          have hft0 : π_FT_TG ft α g = 0 := le_antisymm (hle.trans h0.le) (hπ_FT_TG_nn ft α g)
          rw [hft0, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero]
        · let ft₀ := F_T_loc (rl_of_G g).1 α
          have hmem : ft₀ ∈ S_FT := by
            by_contra hnot
            have hall0 : p_TG α g = 0 := by
              rw [← hπ_FT_TG_sum_ft α g]
              exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ft hft =>
                hπ_FT_TG_single ft hft α g (fun heq => hnot (by dsimp only [ft₀]; rwa [← heq])))
            exact h0 hall0
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ft₀
            (fun ft hft hne => by rw [hπ_FT_TG_single ft hft α g hne, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero])
            (fun hnot => False.elim (hnot hmem))]
          have hat : π_FT_TG ft₀ α g = p_TG α g := by
            rw [← hπ_FT_TG_sum_ft α g,
              Finset.sum_eq_single ft₀ (fun ft hft hne => hπ_FT_TG_single ft hft α g hne)
                (fun hnot => False.elim (hnot hmem))]
          rw [hat]
      have h_term : ∀ ft ∈ S_FT, ∀ (α : Fin N_T) (g : Fin N_G),
          -(π_FT_TG ft α g * Real.log (π_FT_TG ft α g / P_Y g)) =
            -(π_FT_TG ft α g * Real.log (q_TFT ft α / q_FT ft)) +
            -(π_FT_TG ft α g * Real.log (P_FT_Y ft g / P_Y g)) := by
        intro ft hft α g
        by_cases h0 : π_FT_TG ft α g = 0
        · rw [h0]; ring
        · have hpos : 0 < π_FT_TG ft α g := lt_of_le_of_ne (hπ_FT_TG_nn ft α g) (Ne.symm h0)
          have hFT_pos : 0 < q_FT ft := by
            by_contra hnot
            have hz : π_FT_TG ft α g = 0 := if_neg hnot
            exact h0 hz
          have hdef : π_FT_TG ft α g = q_TFT ft α * (P_FT_Y ft g / q_FT ft) := if_pos hFT_pos
          have hTFT_pos : 0 < q_TFT ft α := by
            by_contra hle
            have hz : q_TFT ft α = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hle) (hqTFT_nn ft α)
            rw [hdef, hz, zero_mul] at hpos; exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
          have hPFT_pos : 0 < P_FT_Y ft g := by
            by_contra hle
            have hz : P_FT_Y ft g = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hle) (hP_FT_Y_nn ft g)
            rw [hdef, hz, zero_div, mul_zero] at hpos; exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
          have hPY_pos : 0 < P_Y g := by
            rw [hP_Y_eq_sum_ft g]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hPFT_pos
              (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ft' _ => hP_FT_Y_nn ft' g) hft)
          have hprod : π_FT_TG ft α g / P_Y g = (q_TFT ft α / q_FT ft) * (P_FT_Y ft g / P_Y g) := by
            rw [hdef]; simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
          rw [hprod, Real.log_mul (div_pos hTFT_pos hFT_pos).ne' (div_pos hPFT_pos hPY_pos).ne']
          ring
      have h1 : H_TG = ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
          -(π_FT_TG ft α g * Real.log (π_FT_TG ft α g / P_Y g)) := by
        dsimp only [H_TG]; simp_rw [h_single_tg]
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => Finset.sum_comm)).trans Finset.sum_comm
      rw [h1]
      have h2 : (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
            -(π_FT_TG ft α g * Real.log (π_FT_TG ft α g / P_Y g))) =
          (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
            -(π_FT_TG ft α g * Real.log (q_TFT ft α / q_FT ft))) +
          (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ α : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
            -(π_FT_TG ft α g * Real.log (P_FT_Y ft g / P_Y g))) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft hft => ?_)
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => h_term ft hft α g)
      rw [h2]; congr 1
      · dsimp only [H_T_FT]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_))
        rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hπ_FT_TG_sum_g ft α]
      · dsimp only [H_FT_Y]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hπ_FT_TG_sum_α ft g]

    have h_id3 : H_FT_D = H_Y_D + H_FT_DY := by
      have h_term : ∀ ft ∈ S_FT, ∀ d : Fin N_D,
          -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / q_D d)) =
            -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (P_DY d (y_idx d ft) / q_D d)) +
            -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / P_DY d (y_idx d ft))) := by
        intro ft hft d
        by_cases h0 : q_DFT ft d = 0
        · rw [h0]; ring
        · have hpos : 0 < q_DFT ft d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hqDFT_nn ft d) (Ne.symm h0)
          have hPDY_ge : q_DFT ft d ≤ P_DY d (y_idx d ft) := by
            dsimp only [P_DY]
            have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun ft' => if y_idx d ft' = y_idx d ft then q_DFT ft' d else 0)
              (fun ft' _ => ite_nonneg (hqDFT_nn ft' d) le_rfl) hft
            rwa [if_pos rfl] at h1
          have hPDY_pos : 0 < P_DY d (y_idx d ft) := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hPDY_ge
          have hD_pos : 0 < q_D d := by
            rw [← h_sum_DFT_ft d]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun ft' _ => hqDFT_nn ft' d) hft)
          have hprod : q_DFT ft d / q_D d =
              (P_DY d (y_idx d ft) / q_D d) * (q_DFT ft d / P_DY d (y_idx d ft)) := by
            calc q_DFT ft d / q_D d
                = (P_DY d (y_idx d ft) * (P_DY d (y_idx d ft))⁻¹) * (q_DFT ft d * (q_D d)⁻¹) := by
                  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hPDY_pos.ne', one_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
              _ = (P_DY d (y_idx d ft) / q_D d) * (q_DFT ft d / P_DY d (y_idx d ft)) := by
                  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
          rw [hprod, Real.log_mul (div_pos hPDY_pos hD_pos).ne' (div_pos hpos hPDY_pos).ne']
          ring
      have h1 : H_FT_D =
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT, -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (P_DY d (y_idx d ft) / q_D d))) +
          H_FT_DY := by
        dsimp only [H_FT_D, H_FT_DY]
        have hs : (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / q_D d))) =
            (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (P_DY d (y_idx d ft) / q_D d))) +
            (∑ ft ∈ S_FT, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / P_DY d (y_idx d ft)))) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft hft => ?_)
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_term ft hft d)
        rw [hs, Finset.sum_comm]
      rw [h1]; congr 1; dsimp only [H_Y_D]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      have hfib : ∀ ft ∈ S_FT,
          -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (P_DY d (y_idx d ft) / q_D d)) =
            ∑ g : Fin N_G, -(if y_idx d ft = g then q_DFT ft d else 0) * Real.log (P_DY d g / q_D d) := by
        intro ft _
        have hite : ∀ g : Fin N_G,
            -(if y_idx d ft = g then q_DFT ft d else 0) * Real.log (P_DY d g / q_D d) =
              if y_idx d ft = g then -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (P_DY d g / q_D d)) else 0 := by
          intro g; by_cases hg : y_idx d ft = g
          · rw [if_pos hg, if_pos hg, neg_mul]
          · rw [if_neg hg, if_neg hg, neg_zero, zero_mul]
        simp_rw [hite]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (y_idx d ft), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hfib, Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => ?_)
      simp_rw [neg_mul]; rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]

    have h_ineq4 : H_FT_DY ≤ H_FT_Y := by
      have h_ft_le : ∀ ft ∈ S_FT,
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / P_DY d (y_idx d ft)))) ≤
            ∑ g : Fin N_G, -(P_FT_Y ft g * Real.log (P_FT_Y ft g / P_Y g)) := by
        intro ft hft
        let a_fg : Fin N_G → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun g d => if y_idx d ft = g then q_DFT ft d else 0
        have h_lhs : (∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / P_DY d (y_idx d ft)))) =
            ∑ g : Fin N_G, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(a_fg g d * Real.log (a_fg g d / P_DY d g)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
          have hite : ∀ g : Fin N_G,
              -(a_fg g d * Real.log (a_fg g d / P_DY d g)) =
                if y_idx d ft = g then -(q_DFT ft d * Real.log (q_DFT ft d / P_DY d g)) else 0 := by
            intro g; dsimp only [a_fg]
            by_cases hg : y_idx d ft = g
            · rw [if_pos hg, if_pos hg]
            · rw [if_neg hg, if_neg hg, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero]
          simp_rw [hite]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (y_idx d ft), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
        rw [h_lhs]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun g _ => ?_)
        exact h_log_sum (a_fg g) (fun d => P_DY d g)
          (fun d => ite_nonneg (hqDFT_nn ft d) le_rfl)
          (fun d => hP_DY_nn d g)
          (fun d hpos => by
            dsimp only [a_fg] at hpos
            by_cases hg : y_idx d ft = g
            · rw [if_pos hg] at hpos
              have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
                (f := fun ft' => if y_idx d ft' = g then q_DFT ft' d else 0)
                (fun ft' _ => ite_nonneg (hqDFT_nn ft' d) le_rfl) hft
              rw [if_pos hg] at hle
              exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle
            · rw [if_neg hg] at hpos; exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hpos))
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum h_ft_le

    have h_HYD_le : H_Y_D ≤ Real.log B_Y := by
      have h_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
          (∑ g : Fin N_G, -(P_DY d g * Real.log (P_DY d g / q_D d))) ≤ q_D d * Real.log B_Y := by
        intro d
        let Img_d := (Finset.univ.filter (fun oα : Fin N_O × Fin N_T => 0 < q oα.1 d oα.2)).image
          (fun oα => Y_bar d (F_T_loc (r_O oα.1 % N_R) oα.2))
        let S_gd : Finset (Fin N_G) := Img_d.image g_idx_of
        have h_supp : ∀ g : Fin N_G, 0 < P_DY d g → g ∈ S_gd := by
          intro g hpos
          obtain ⟨ft, _, hft_pos⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
            (fun ft _ => ite_nonneg (hqDFT_nn ft d) le_rfl)).mp hpos
          by_cases hy : y_idx d ft = g
          · rw [if_pos hy] at hft_pos
            obtain ⟨_, o, α, hq_pos, hft_eq⟩ := hDFT_pos_mem_SG ft d hft_pos
            refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨Y_bar d ft, ?_, hy⟩
            refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(o, α),
              Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hq_pos⟩, ?_⟩
            dsimp only; rw [hft_eq]
          · rw [if_neg hy] at hft_pos; exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hft_pos)
        have h_card : (S_gd.card : ℝ) ≤ B_Y := by
          have hc1 : (S_gd.card : ℝ) ≤ (Img_d.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_image_le
          exact le_trans hc1 (hY_list d)
        exact h_card_cond_ent S_gd (P_DY d) (q_D d) B_Y
          (fun g => hP_DY_nn d g) (hP_DY_sum_g d) h_supp hB_Y (fun _ => h_card)
      have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d (_ : d ∈ Finset.univ) => h_d d)
      rwa [← Finset.sum_mul, hqD_sum, one_mul] at hs

    have h_cls_eq :
        (let ell_c := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
         let p_T_c : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid =>
           ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (T_idx ω = tid) (instDecidableEqFin N_T (T_idx ω) tid) (π_cl ω) 0
         let p_G_c : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g =>
           ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (G_idx ω = g) (instDecidableEqFin N_G (G_idx ω) g) (π_cl ω) 0
         let p_TG_c : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun tid g =>
           ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g)
             (@instDecidableAnd _ _ (instDecidableEqFin N_T (T_idx ω) tid)
               (instDecidableEqFin N_G (G_idx ω) g)) (π_cl ω) 0
         let S_cells_c : Finset ℤ := @Finset.image (Fin N_ω) ℤ Int.instDecidableEq k_time Finset.univ
         let p_TC_c : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
           ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k)
             (@instDecidableAnd _ _ (instDecidableEqFin N_T (T_idx ω) tid)
               (Int.instDecidableEq (k_time ω) k)) (π_cl ω) 0
         (∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G_c g * ((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G g) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G g))) -
           (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
             p_TG_c tid g * Real.log (p_TG_c tid g / (p_T_c tid * p_G_c g))) / ell_c +
           2 * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells_c,
             -(p_TC_c tid k * Real.log (p_TC_c tid k / p_T_c tid))) / ell_c)) =
        (∑ g : Fin N_G, P_Y g * ((1 + γ) * b_Y (val_G g) + (1 - γ) * a_Y (val_G g))) -
          (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
            p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (q_T tid * P_Y g))) / ell +
          2 * ((∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ rv : Fin N_R,
            -(q_TR tid rv * Real.log (q_TR tid rv / q_T tid))) / ell) := by
      dsimp only
      have hc_G : ∀ g : Fin N_G,
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (G_idx ω = g) (instDecidableEqFin N_G (G_idx ω) g) (π_cl ω) 0) =
            P_Y g := fun g =>
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ite_congr rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl))).trans (hp_G_eq_PY g)
      have hc_TG : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (g : Fin N_G),
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g)
            (@instDecidableAnd _ _ (instDecidableEqFin N_T (T_idx ω) tid)
              (instDecidableEqFin N_G (G_idx ω) g)) (π_cl ω) 0) = p_TG tid g := fun tid g =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ite_congr rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl))
      have hc_S : (@Finset.image (Fin N_ω) ℤ Int.instDecidableEq k_time Finset.univ) =
          Finset.univ.image k_time := by
        ext k; simp (config := { decide := false }) only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      have hc_TC : ∀ (tid : Fin N_T) (k : ℤ),
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, @ite ℝ (T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k)
            (@instDecidableAnd _ _ (instDecidableEqFin N_T (T_idx ω) tid)
              (Int.instDecidableEq (k_time ω) k)) (π_cl ω) 0) =
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then π_cl ω else 0) := fun tid k =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => ite_congr rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl))
      simp_rw [hc_T, hc_G, hc_TG, hc_S, hc_TC, h_St_match]
      rfl
    rw [h_cls_eq]
    have h_neg_ITG : -((∑ tid, ∑ g, p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (q_T tid * P_Y g))) / ell) =
        H_TG / ell - H_T / ell := by
      rw [← neg_div, h_MI_TG, sub_div]
    have h_ent_diff : H_TD - H_TG ≤ Real.log B_Y - I_num := by
      linarith only [h_id1, h_id2, h_id3, h_ineq4, h_HYD_le]
    have h_ent_div : H_TD / ell - H_TG / ell ≤ Real.log B_Y / ell - I_num / ell := by
      rw [← sub_div, ← sub_div]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_ent_diff hell_pos.le
    linarith only [hw_comp, h_neg_ITG, h_ent_div]

  
  
  
  let K_cl : ℝ := cls.K_hor
  let t_min : ℝ := min (2 * h) 1
  let δ_cl : ℝ := e_rep / (64 * h)
  have ht_min_pos : 0 < t_min := lt_min (mul_pos (by norm_num) hh) zero_lt_one
  have ht_min_le : t_min ≤ K_cl := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) cls.hK_hor
  have hδ_cl_pos : 0 < δ_cl := div_pos he_rep (mul_pos (by norm_num) hh)
  obtain ⟨ε_cl, hε_cl_pos, hε_cl_lt, h_cl_est⟩ :=
    h_cl B_cl K_cl t_min δ_cl hBcl_ge1 cls.hK_hor ht_min_pos ht_min_le hδ_cl_pos
  let C_cl_info : ℝ := Real.log (50625 * C_cov) + Real.log C_Y
  have h50625_ge1 : 1 ≤ 50625 * C_cov := by linarith only [hC_cov]
  have hC_cl_nn : 0 ≤ C_cl_info :=
    add_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg h50625_ge1) (Real.log_nonneg hCY_ge1)
  have h_rate_mul : (γ + δ_cl) * (2 * h) = 2 * γ * h + e_rep / 32 := by
    dsimp only [δ_cl]
    have hh_ne : h ≠ 0 := hh.ne'
    calc (γ + e_rep / (64 * h)) * (2 * h)
        = 2 * γ * h + (e_rep / 32) * ((64 * h)⁻¹ * (64 * h)) := by
          rw [mul_inv]; ring
      _ = 2 * γ * h + e_rep / 32 := by
          rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hh_ne), mul_one]
  have hNR_ge1 : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ 2 ^ k := fun k => Nat.one_le_pow k 2 (by norm_num)
  have h_cmid_icc : ∀ (k r_val : ℕ), r_val < 2 ^ k →
      (((r_val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro k r_val hr_lt
    have hr_le : r_val + 1 ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hr_lt
    have hr_cast : ((r_val : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by exact_mod_cast hr_le
    have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k := pow_pos (by norm_num) k
    have hlo : 0 ≤ ((r_val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ :=
      mul_nonneg (add_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by norm_num)) (inv_nonneg.mpr hpow_pos.le)
    have hhi : ((r_val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one hpow_pos]
      linarith only [hr_cast]
    exact ⟨hlo, hhi⟩

  refine ⟨C_cl_info, ε_cl, hC_cl_nn, hε_cl_pos, hε_cl_lt, ?_⟩
  intro ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J Φ₀
    r_O V_O X_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D N_ret_of menu π_J q_cand
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  intro r ell u s_c s_v s_x ρ_r σ_r F_T_fn
    hε₀ hε_lt_cl hr_pos ht_le1 ht_L ht_HP hHP_K hL_K
    hb_star_nn hu_ge hu_plus_h_Lr hd2_bstar hm_r_eq hmr_le_mt
    hlam_lo hlam_hi hmt_lo hmt_hi hπ_nn hπ_sum h_active
    q_T q_TD q_D q_TR π_FTJ π_TFTJ π_DFTJ π_TDFTJ S_FT I_TD_FTJ

  have hε_half : ε < 1 / 2 := lt_trans hε_lt_cl hε_cl_lt
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := h_ell_pos hε₀ hε_half
  have ht_min_2h : t_min ≤ 2 * h := min_le_left _ _
  have h2h_le_uh : 2 * h ≤ u + h := by linarith only [hu_min, hu_ge, hh]
  have huh_nn : 0 ≤ u + h := by linarith only [hu_min, hu_ge, hh]
  have huh_le_K : u + h ≤ K_cl := by
    dsimp only [K_cl]
    linarith only [hu_plus_h_Lr, hr_pos, hb_star_nn, hL_K]
  let N_R : ℕ := 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
  let Δ_time : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
  let w_D_loc : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)
  let Δ_w : ℝ := (d_dim : ℝ) * h + 2 * ζ_sh
  let B_Y : ℝ := C_Y * ε ^ (-2 * θ - 2 * ζ_sh)
  have hBY_pos : 0 < B_Y :=
    mul_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hCY_ge1) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _)
  have hlog_BY : Real.log B_Y / ell = 2 * θ + 2 * ζ_sh + Real.log C_Y / ell := by
    have hCY_pos : 0 < C_Y := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hCY_ge1
    have hrpow_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-2 * θ - 2 * ζ_sh) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
    dsimp only [B_Y, ell]
    rw [Real.log_mul hCY_pos.ne' hrpow_pos.ne', Real.log_rpow hε₀, Real.log_inv, add_div]
    have hlne : Real.log ε ≠ 0 := by
      have h1 := hell_pos; dsimp only [ell] at h1; rw [Real.log_inv] at h1; linarith
    have h_cancel : (-2 * θ - 2 * ζ_sh) * Real.log ε / (-Real.log ε) = 2 * θ + 2 * ζ_sh := by
      rw [div_neg, mul_div_cancel_right₀ (-2 * θ - 2 * ζ_sh) hlne]; ring
    rw [h_cancel]; ring

  let num_I : Fin N_J → ℝ := fun j =>
    ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      if 0 < π_FTJ j ft then
        π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
          (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))
      else 0
  let Const_RHS : ℝ := ((d_dim : ℝ) + 2 * γ) * h +
    2 * θ + 4 * ζ_sh + 2 * ξ + e_rep / 32 + C_cl_info / ell

  have h_per_j : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
      (if 0 < π_J j then π_J j * (
        (∑ d, q_D j d * w_D_loc d) +
        (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD j α d * Real.log (q_TD j α d / q_D j d))) / ell +
        2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin N_R,
          -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell))
       else 0) ≤
      π_J j * (menu j).g_bin - num_I j / ell + π_J j * Const_RHS := by
    intro j
    by_cases hπj : 0 < π_J j
    · rw [if_pos hπj]
      obtain ⟨hvalid_j, hqc_nn, hqc_sum, hqc_supp⟩ := h_active j hπj
      obtain ⟨hsc_lo, _, hΔ_lo, hΔ_hi, hVA_bd, h_root_sup⟩ :=
        h_s3 ε H_P L t b_star lam_sys m_r m_t (N_ret_of j) Φ₀ (menu j)
          hε₀ hε_half hr_pos huh_nn hu_plus_h_Lr hm_r_eq hmr_le_mt hmt_lo hmt_hi hvalid_j
      obtain ⟨Y_bar, b_Y, a_Y, e_Y, V_Y, X_Y,
        hY_fst, hY_geom, hw_shift, hY_faith, hY_list⟩ :=
        h_s2 ε H_P t b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D (N_ret_of j)
          (menu j).loc_idx (menu j).o_at r_O V_O X_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D (q_cand j)
          hε₀ hε_half hb_star_nn hu_ge hd2_bstar hsc_lo hmr_le_mt
          (fun α => (hVA_bd α).1)
          (fun o d α hpos => (hqc_supp o d α hpos).2)
      obtain ⟨N_ω, N_G, π_cl, T_idx, k_time, G_idx, val_G,
        hπcl_nn, hπcl_sum, hpT_cl, hsupp_cl, h_chain⟩ :=
        h_s4 ε hε₀ hε_half N_O N_D (N_ret_of j) N_R (hNR_ge1 (m_t - m_r))
          r_O r_D w_D_loc (F_T_fn j) Y_bar b_Y a_Y (q_cand j) Δ_w B_Y hBY_pos
          hqc_nn hqc_sum
          (fun o d α hpos => (hqc_supp o d α hpos).2.1)
          (fun _ _ => rfl) hY_fst
          (fun o d α hpos y => by
            dsimp only [w_D_loc, Δ_w]
            linarith only [hw_shift o d α hpos y])
          hY_list
      let V_part : Fin (N_ret_of j) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        fun α => s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1 - gridPt2D s_v (menu j).loc_idx.2.1)
      let X'_at : Fin (N_ret_of j) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        fun α => s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2 - gridPt2D s_x (menu j).loc_idx.2.2)
      let A_part : Fin (N_ret_of j) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        fun α => X'_at α - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • V_part α
      have h_cl_j := h_cl_est ε (2 * h) (u + h) Δ_time
        hε₀ hε_lt_cl ht_min_2h h2h_le_uh huh_le_K hΔ_lo hΔ_hi
        N_ω (N_ret_of j) N_G π_cl T_idx k_time G_idx V_part A_part
        (fun g => b_Y (val_G g)) (fun g => a_Y (val_G g))
        (fun g => e_Y (val_G g)) (fun g => V_Y (val_G g)) (fun g => X_Y (val_G g))
        (fun g => ((val_G g).1 : ℤ))
        hπcl_nn hπcl_sum
        (fun α => ⟨(hVA_bd α).2.1, (hVA_bd α).2.2⟩)
        (fun g => hY_geom (val_G g))
        (fun ω hω => by
          obtain ⟨rl, d₀, hk_eq, hkG_eq, hval_eq⟩ := hsupp_cl ω hω
          have hcmid_eq : ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time =
              ((rl.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time := by
            rw [hk_eq]; push_cast; rfl
          have hf := hY_faith rl.1 d₀ (T_idx ω)
          dsimp only at hf
          rw [← hval_eq] at hf
          rw [hcmid_eq]
          exact ⟨h_cmid_icc (m_t - m_r) rl.1 rl.2, hkG_eq, hf.1, hf.2.1, hf.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2⟩)
      have h_root_j := h_root_sup N_ω π_cl T_idx hπcl_nn hπcl_sum
      dsimp only at h_root_j
      simp_rw [hpT_cl] at h_root_j
      let q_FT_j := fun (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) =>
        ∑ o, ∑ d, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_T_fn j (r_O o % N_R) α = ft), q_cand j o d α
      let q_TFT_j := fun ft α =>
        ∑ o, ∑ d, if F_T_fn j (r_O o % N_R) α = ft then q_cand j o d α else 0
      let q_DFT_j := fun ft d =>
        ∑ o, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_T_fn j (r_O o % N_R) α = ft), q_cand j o d α
      let q_TDFT_j := fun ft α d =>
        ∑ o, if F_T_fn j (r_O o % N_R) α = ft then q_cand j o d α else 0
      have hπ_FTJ_eq : ∀ ft, π_FTJ j ft = π_J j * q_FT_j ft := by
        intro ft; dsimp only [π_FTJ, q_FT_j, N_R]
        simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      have hπ_TFTJ_eq : ∀ ft α, π_TFTJ j ft α = π_J j * q_TFT_j ft α := by
        intro ft α; dsimp only [π_TFTJ, q_TFT_j, N_R]
        have hin : ∀ o d,
            (if F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft then π_J j * q_cand j o d α else 0) =
              π_J j * (if F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft then q_cand j o d α else 0) := by
          intro o d; by_cases hc : F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft
          · rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc]
          · rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc, mul_zero]
        simp_rw [hin, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have hπ_DFTJ_eq : ∀ ft d, π_DFTJ j ft d = π_J j * q_DFT_j ft d := by
        intro ft d; dsimp only [π_DFTJ, q_DFT_j, N_R]
        simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      have hπ_TDFTJ_eq : ∀ ft α d, π_TDFTJ j ft α d = π_J j * q_TDFT_j ft α d := by
        intro ft α d; dsimp only [π_TDFTJ, q_TDFT_j, N_R]
        have hin : ∀ o,
            (if F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft then π_J j * q_cand j o d α else 0) =
              π_J j * (if F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft then q_cand j o d α else 0) := by
          intro o; by_cases hc : F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α = ft
          · rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc]
          · rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc, mul_zero]
        simp_rw [hin, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      let I_j_loc : ℝ :=
        (∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          if 0 < q_FT_j ft then
            q_TDFT_j ft α d * Real.log ((q_TDFT_j ft α d * q_FT_j ft) /
              (q_TFT_j ft α * q_DFT_j ft d))
          else 0) / ell
      have h_numI_eq : num_I j / ell = π_J j * I_j_loc := by
        dsimp only [num_I, I_j_loc]
        rw [← mul_div_assoc]
        congr 1
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ft _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ =>
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)))
        rw [hπ_FTJ_eq ft, hπ_TFTJ_eq ft α, hπ_DFTJ_eq ft d, hπ_TDFTJ_eq ft α d]
        by_cases hq_pos : 0 < q_FT_j ft
        · rw [if_pos (mul_pos hπj hq_pos), if_pos hq_pos]
          have h_sq_ne : π_J j * π_J j ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hπj.ne' hπj.ne'
          have h_rat : ((π_J j * q_TDFT_j ft α d) * (π_J j * q_FT_j ft)) /
              ((π_J j * q_TFT_j ft α) * (π_J j * q_DFT_j ft d)) =
              (q_TDFT_j ft α d * q_FT_j ft) / (q_TFT_j ft α * q_DFT_j ft d) := by
            calc ((π_J j * q_TDFT_j ft α d) * (π_J j * q_FT_j ft)) /
                  ((π_J j * q_TFT_j ft α) * (π_J j * q_DFT_j ft d))
                = ((π_J j * π_J j) * (q_TDFT_j ft α d * q_FT_j ft)) /
                    ((π_J j * π_J j) * (q_TFT_j ft α * q_DFT_j ft d)) := by ring
              _ = (q_TDFT_j ft α d * q_FT_j ft) / (q_TFT_j ft α * q_DFT_j ft d) :=
                  mul_div_mul_left _ _ h_sq_ne
          rw [h_rat, mul_assoc]
        · have hnot_mul : ¬ (0 < π_J j * q_FT_j ft) :=
            fun hm => hq_pos ((mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hπj).mp hm)
          rw [if_neg hnot_mul, if_neg hq_pos, mul_zero]
      have h_comb_j :
          (∑ d, q_D j d * w_D_loc d) +
          (∑ α, ∑ d, -(q_TD j α d * Real.log (q_TD j α d / q_D j d))) / ell +
          2 * ((∑ α, ∑ rl : Fin N_R,
            -(q_TR j α rl * Real.log (q_TR j α rl / q_T j α))) / ell) ≤
          (menu j).g_bin - I_j_loc + Const_RHS := by
        have h_c_unfold : Const_RHS = Δ_w + (γ + δ_cl) * (2 * h) + 2 * ξ +
            Real.log B_Y / ell + Real.log (50625 * C_cov) / ell := by
          rw [h_rate_mul, hlog_BY]
          dsimp only [Const_RHS, Δ_w, C_cl_info]
          ring
        rw [h_c_unfold]
        linarith only [h_chain, h_cl_j, h_root_j]
      have hmul_j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_comb_j hπj.le
      linarith only [hmul_j, h_numI_eq, show π_J j * ((menu j).g_bin - I_j_loc + Const_RHS) =
        π_J j * (menu j).g_bin - π_J j * I_j_loc + π_J j * Const_RHS by ring]
    · rw [if_neg hπj]
      have hπ0 : π_J j = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hπj) (hπ_nn j)
      have hnum0 : num_I j = 0 := by
        dsimp only [num_I]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ft _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α _ =>
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => ?_)))
        have hFTJ0 : π_FTJ j ft = 0 := by
          dsimp only [π_FTJ]
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d' _ =>
            Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α' _ => ?_)))
          rw [hπ0, zero_mul]
        rw [hFTJ0, if_neg (lt_irrefl 0)]
      rw [hπ0, hnum0, zero_mul, zero_div, sub_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]

  have h_sum_j := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => h_per_j j)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_div,
    ← Finset.sum_mul, hπ_sum, one_mul] at h_sum_j
  change _ ≤ (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (menu j).g_bin) + ((d_dim : ℝ) + 2 * γ) * h -
    (∑ j : Fin N_J, num_I j) / ell + 2 * θ + 4 * ζ_sh + 2 * ξ + e_rep / 32 + C_cl_info / ell
  have halg : ((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (menu j).g_bin) - (∑ j : Fin N_J, num_I j) / ell + Const_RHS) =
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * (menu j).g_bin) + ((d_dim : ℝ) + 2 * γ) * h -
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, num_I j) / ell + 2 * θ + 4 * ζ_sh + 2 * ξ + e_rep / 32 + C_cl_info / ell := by
    dsimp only [Const_RHS]; ring
  linarith only [h_sum_j, halg]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ))
    (h_site_cnt : ∀ cls : PacketBoundClass,
      ∃ C_cnt : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_cnt ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          0 ≤ t → t ≤ H_P → cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)))
    (h_fib_ent : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},
        0 < B_fib → (∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) → (∑ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) →
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ y : Fin N_Y, (0 < ∑ x, P x y) →
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin N_X => 0 < P x y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib) →
        let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x, P x y
        (∑ x, ∑ y, -(P x y * Real.log (P x y / P_Y y))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
          Real.log B_fib / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :
    ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (t_min δ_mod : ℝ),
      0 < t_min → t_min ≤ cls.K_hor → 0 < δ_mod →
      ∃ ε_prep : ℝ, 0 < ε_prep ∧ ε_prep < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t h lam_sys : ℝ) (m_t d_dim N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (Δ_cur k_f α_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_prep → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f → (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2 = 1) →
          cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur ≤
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p k_f α_cur →
          let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
          let A₀ := 4 * cls.K_hor + 4
          (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t ≤ 1 / 4 →
            ∀ ζ_fl : ℝ, 0 < ζ_fl → ε ^ ζ_fl ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (N'_O : ℕ) (emb : Fin N'_O → Fin N_O) (p' : Fin N'_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              1 ≤ N'_O ∧ Function.Injective emb ∧
              (∀ o' d, 0 < p' o' d → 0 < p (emb o') d) ∧
              (∀ o' : Fin N'_O, ε ^ A₀ ≤
                generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  (r_O (emb o')) (V_O (emb o')) (X_O (emb o')) (ψ_O (emb o'))) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb)
                b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p' ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t - (4 * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t + 3 / ell) + δ_mod * t) ≤
                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D
                  (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb) b_D a_D p' ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N'_O N_D
                (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) e_D p' k_f
                (α_cur + ζ_fl + Real.log 4 / ell)) ∧
          (∀ (S_bins : ℕ) (E : Fin S_bins → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Prop) (p_union ζ_ret : ℝ),
            1 ≤ S_bins → (∀ o d, ∀ b₁ b₂, E b₁ o d → E b₂ o d → b₁ = b₂) →
            0 < p_union →
            (letI := Classical.propDecidable
             p_union ≤ ∑ b : Fin S_bins, ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
               if E b o d then p o d else 0) →
            0 < ζ_ret → ε ^ ζ_ret ≤ 1 / 2 →
            ∃ (b_sel : Fin S_bins) (p_sel : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
              (∀ o d, 0 < p_sel o d → E b_sel o d ∧ 0 < p o d) ∧
              IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
                lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p_sel ∧
              generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
                quantumPacketRate γ * t -
                  ((4 / p_union) * (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t +
                    (3 * Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2)) / (2 * ell)) + δ_mod * t) ≤
                generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
                  N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_sel ∧
              HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D p_sel k_f
                (α_cur + ζ_ret + Real.log (8 * (S_bins : ℝ) / p_union) / ell))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have h_shannon : ∀ {M : ℕ}, 1 ≤ M → ∀ (w : Fin M → ℝ),
      (∀ m, 0 ≤ w m) → (∑ m : Fin M, w m = 1) →
      ∑ m : Fin M, -(w m * Real.log (w m)) ≤ Real.log (M : ℝ) := by
    intro M hM w hw_nn hw_sum
    have hM_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (M : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have h_pt : ∀ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin M)),
        -(w m * Real.log (w m)) - w m * Real.log (M : ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (M : ℝ) - w m := by
      intro m _
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hw_nn m) with h0 | hwm
      · rw [← h0]; simp
      · have hx : 0 < ((M : ℝ) * w m)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (mul_pos hM_pos hwm)
        have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx
        rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_mul hM_pos.ne' hwm.ne'] at hlog
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hwm.le
        have h_cancel : w m * ((M : ℝ) * w m)⁻¹ = (1 : ℝ) / (M : ℝ) := by
          field_simp [hM_pos.ne', hwm.ne']
        linarith
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hw_sum, one_mul,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    have hM_div : (M : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) = 1 := mul_one_div_cancel hM_pos.ne'
    linarith
  have h_inner2 : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ a b = a 0 * b 0 + a 1 * b 1 := by
    intro a b
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have h_perp0 : ∀ b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), (perp2D b) 0 = -(b 1) := fun b => by simp [perp2D]
  have h_perp1 : ∀ b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), (perp2D b) 1 = b 0 := fun b => by simp [perp2D]
  have h_norm_sq2 : ∀ a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖a‖ ^ 2 = a 0 ^ 2 + a 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro a
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_parseval : ∀ (e z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖e‖ = 1 →
      ‖z‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ z e ^ 2 + inner ℝ z (perp2D e) ^ 2 := by
    intro e z he
    have he_sq : e 0 ^ 2 + e 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h := h_norm_sq2 e
      rw [he, one_pow] at h
      exact h.symm
    rw [h_norm_sq2, h_inner2, h_inner2, h_perp0, h_perp1]
    calc z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 = (e 0 ^ 2 + e 1 ^ 2) * (z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2) := by rw [he_sq, one_mul]
      _ = (z 0 * e 0 + z 1 * e 1) ^ 2 + (z 0 * -e 1 + z 1 * e 0) ^ 2 := by ring
  have h_β_nn : 0 ≤ quantumPacketRate γ := Real.sInf_nonneg (fun b hb => hb.1)
  intro cls t_min δ_mod ht_min₀ ht_min_K hδ_mod
  obtain ⟨ε_mod, hε_mod_pos, hε_mod_lt, h_mod_est⟩ :=
    h_mod cls t_min δ_mod ht_min₀ ht_min_K hδ_mod
  obtain ⟨C_cnt, hC_cnt, h_cnt_est⟩ := h_site_cnt cls
  let C_fib : ℝ := (cls.N_mult : ℝ) * (2 * cls.B_sys ^ 2 + 3) ^ 4
  have hN_mult_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (cls.N_mult : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast cls.hN_mult
  have hB_factor_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys ^ 2 + 3 := by
    have hsq : 0 ≤ cls.B_sys ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    linarith only [hsq]
  have hC_fib_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_fib := by
    dsimp [C_fib]
    calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ (cls.N_mult : ℝ) * (2 * cls.B_sys ^ 2 + 3) ^ 4 :=
          mul_le_mul hN_mult_ge1 (one_le_pow₀ hB_factor_ge1) zero_le_one (by linarith only [hN_mult_ge1])
  have hC_fib_pos : 0 < C_fib := by linarith only [hC_fib_ge1]
  have hC_cnt_pos : 0 < C_cnt := by linarith only [hC_cnt]
  let C_log : ℝ := max (Real.log C_cnt + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_fib) 12
  have hC_log_12 : 12 ≤ C_log := le_max_right _ _
  have hC_log_ge : Real.log C_cnt + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_fib ≤ C_log := le_max_left _ _
  let ε_prep : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (min ε_mod (Real.exp (C_log + 1))⁻¹)
  have hε_prep_pos : 0 < ε_prep :=
    lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min hε_mod_pos (inv_pos.mpr (Real.exp_pos _)))
  have hε_prep_lt : ε_prep < 1 / 2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨ε_prep, hε_prep_pos, hε_prep_lt, ?_⟩
  intro ε H_P L t h lam_sys m_t d_dim N_O N_D Φ₀ ζ₀ f
    r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p Δ_cur k_f α_cur
    hε_prep ht_min ht_L ht_HP henv hf_norm hm_t1 hm_t2 hadm hscore hcred
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let A₀ := 4 * cls.K_hor + 4
  have hε₀ : 0 < ε := henv.1
  have hε₁ : ε < 1 / 2 := henv.2.1
  have ht₀ : 0 ≤ t := le_trans ht_min₀.le ht_min
  have hε_lt_mod : ε < ε_mod :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hε_prep (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hε_lt_exp : ε < (Real.exp (C_log + 1))⁻¹ :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hε_prep (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  have hell_gt_Clog : C_log + 1 < ell := by
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (C_log + 1) := Real.exp_pos _
    have h_inv_gt : Real.exp (C_log + 1) < ε⁻¹ := by
      have h1 : Real.exp (C_log + 1) * ε < Real.exp (C_log + 1) * (Real.exp (C_log + 1))⁻¹ :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hε_lt_exp hexp_pos
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hexp_pos.ne'] at h1
      have h2 : (Real.exp (C_log + 1) * ε) * ε⁻¹ < 1 * ε⁻¹ :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (inv_pos.mpr hε₀)
      rwa [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hε₀.ne', mul_one, one_mul] at h2
    have hlog := Real.log_lt_log hexp_pos h_inv_gt
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at hlog
  have hell_gt_13 : 13 < ell := by linarith
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := by linarith
  have hlog_eps : Real.log ε = -ell := by
    dsimp [ell]; rw [Real.log_inv, neg_neg]
  have hC_log_div : (Real.log C_cnt + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log C_fib) / ell ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hell_pos]
    linarith
  have h3_div_ell : 3 / ell ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hell_pos]
    linarith
