            have hwd0 : w_d m = 0 := by dsimp [w_d]; rw [if_pos hm, ← hqD0]; simp
            simp [hqo0, hwd0]
          · have hwd_eq : w_d m = (π_bin m * q_D m d) / p_D d := by dsimp [w_d]; rw [if_pos hm]
            have hwd_pos : 0 < w_d m := by rw [hwd_eq]; exact div_pos (mul_pos hm hqD_pos) hpD_pos
            have h_o_le : ∀ o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)),
                -(q_bin m o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d)) - -(q_bin m o d * Real.log (q_bin m o d / q_D m d)) ≤
                  q_bin m o d * (-Real.log (w_d m)) := by
              intro o _
              rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hq_nn m o d) with h0 | hq_pos
              · rw [← h0]; simp
              · have h_le_pod : π_bin m * q_bin m o d ≤ p o d := by
                  have ht := h_term m o d
                  rw [if_pos hm] at ht
                  rw [ht]
                  split_ifs <;> [exact le_rfl; exact hp_nn o d]
                have hpod_pos : 0 < p o d := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hm hq_pos) h_le_pod
                have h_prod_le : w_d m * (q_bin m o d / q_D m d) ≤ p o d / p_D d := by
                  have h_id : w_d m * (q_bin m o d / q_D m d) = (π_bin m * q_bin m o d) / p_D d := by
                    rw [hwd_eq]
                    field_simp [hpD_pos.ne', hqD_pos.ne']
                  rw [h_id]
                  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_le_pod hpD_pos.le
                have h_ratio_le : q_bin m o d / q_D m d ≤ (w_d m)⁻¹ * (p o d / p_D d) := by
                  calc q_bin m o d / q_D m d
                      = (w_d m)⁻¹ * (w_d m * (q_bin m o d / q_D m d)) := by field_simp [hwd_pos.ne']
                    _ ≤ (w_d m)⁻¹ * (p o d / p_D d) :=
                        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod_le (inv_nonneg.mpr hwd_pos.le)
                have hq_div_pos : 0 < q_bin m o d / q_D m d := div_pos hq_pos hqD_pos
                have hp_div_pos : 0 < p o d / p_D d := div_pos hpod_pos hpD_pos
                have hlog := Real.log_le_log hq_div_pos h_ratio_le
                rw [Real.log_mul (inv_ne_zero hwd_pos.ne') hp_div_pos.ne', Real.log_inv] at hlog
                have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hq_pos.le
                linarith only [hmul]
            have hsum_o := Finset.sum_le_sum h_o_le
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul] at hsum_o
            have hmul_m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_o hm.le
            have h_id2 : π_bin m * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, q_bin m o d) * (-Real.log (w_d m))) =
                p_D d * -(w_d m * Real.log (w_d m)) := by
              rw [hwd_eq]
              dsimp [q_D]
              field_simp [hpD_pos.ne']
            linarith only [hmul_m, h_id2]
        · rw [if_neg hm]
          have hwd0 : w_d m = 0 := by dsimp [w_d]; rw [if_neg hm]; simp
          simp [hwd0]
    have h_HOD : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d)) ≤
        (∑ m : Fin M, if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_bin m o d * Real.log (q_bin m o d / q_D m d))) else 0) +
          Real.log (M : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have hsum_d := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d (_ : d ∈ Finset.univ) => h_HOD_col d)
      have hpD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d = 1 := by
        dsimp [p_D]; rw [Finset.sum_comm, hp_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hpD_sum, one_mul] at hsum_d
      refine le_trans hsum_d ?_
      have h_swap_rhs : (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ m : Fin M,
          if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_bin m o d * Real.log (q_bin m o d / q_D m d))) else 0) =
        ∑ m : Fin M, if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_bin m o d * Real.log (q_bin m o d / q_D m d))) else 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
        by_cases hm : 0 < π_bin m
        · simp only [if_pos hm, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          congr 1
          exact Finset.sum_comm
        · simp [if_neg hm]
      rw [h_swap_rhs]
    
    have h_HO_div : (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell ≤
        (∑ m : Fin M, (if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O m o * Real.log (q_O m o))) else 0) / ell) +
          Real.log (M : ℝ) / ell := by
      have hd := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_HO hell_pos.le
      rw [add_div] at hd
      conv at hd => rhs; arg 1; rw [Finset.sum_div]
      exact hd
    have h_HOD_div : (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell ≤
        (∑ m : Fin M, (if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_bin m o d * Real.log (q_bin m o d / q_D m d))) else 0) / ell) +
          Real.log (M : ℝ) / ell := by
      have hd := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_HOD hell_pos.le
      rw [add_div] at hd
      conv at hd => rhs; arg 1; rw [Finset.sum_div]
      exact hd
    have h_Emass_div : (∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log (m_obs o)) / ell =
        ∑ m : Fin M, (if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O m o * Real.log (m_obs o)) else 0) / ell := by
      rw [h_Emass, Finset.sum_div]
    have h_rhs_expand : (∑ m : Fin M,
        if 0 < π_bin m then
          π_bin m * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
            N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin m)
        else 0) =
      (∑ m : Fin M, (if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O m o * Real.log (q_O m o))) else 0) / ell) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ m : Fin M, (if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_bin m o d * Real.log (q_bin m o d / q_D m d))) else 0) / ell) +
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ m : Fin M, (if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O m o * Real.log (m_obs o)) else 0) / ell) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ m : Fin M, if 0 < π_bin m then π_bin m * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D m d * w_ap d) else 0) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum,
        ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      by_cases hm : 0 < π_bin m
      · rw [if_pos hm, if_pos hm, if_pos hm, if_pos hm, if_pos hm]
        unfold generalPacketScore
        change π_bin m *
            ((∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O m o * Real.log (q_O m o))) / ell +
             (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_bin m o d * Real.log (q_bin m o d / q_D m d))) / ell) +
             (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O m o * Real.log (m_obs o)) / ell) +
             (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D m d * w_ap d)) = _
        ring
      · simp [if_neg hm]
    change generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
      (∑ m : Fin M,
        if 0 < π_bin m then
          π_bin m * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin m)
        else 0) + (3 * Real.log (M : ℝ)) / (2 * ell)
    rw [h_rhs_expand, ← h_Emass_div, ← h_Ew]
    conv_lhs => unfold generalPacketScore
    change (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log (m_obs o)) / ell) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * w_ap d) ≤ _
    have h_pen : Real.log (M : ℝ) / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (M : ℝ) / ell) =
        (3 * Real.log (M : ℝ)) / (2 * ell) := by ring
    linarith only [h_HO_div, h_HOD_div, h_pen]

  
  have h_emb_pull : ∀ {N'_O : ℕ} (emb : Fin N'_O → Fin N_O) (q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) {α' : ℝ},
      Function.Injective emb →
      (∀ o d, (∀ o' : Fin N'_O, emb o' ≠ o) → q o d = 0) →
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D q →
      HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O e_D q k_f α' →
      let p' : Fin N'_O → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun o' d => q (emb o') d
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb)
        b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p' ∧
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D
        (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb) b_D a_D p' =
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q ∧
      HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N'_O N_D
        (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) e_D p' k_f α' := by
    intro N'_O emb q α' hemb hq_out hadm_q hcred_q
    dsimp only
    have h_sum_emb : ∀ (G : Fin N_O → ℝ),
        (∀ o, (∀ o' : Fin N'_O, emb o' ≠ o) → G o = 0) →
        (∑ o' : Fin N'_O, G (emb o')) = ∑ o : Fin N_O, G o := by
      intro G hG
      rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := G) (s := Finset.univ) (g := emb) (fun x _ y _ hxy => hemb hxy)]
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun o _ ho_not => hG o (fun o' heq => ?_))
      exact ho_not (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨o', Finset.mem_univ o', heq⟩)
    have hqO_out : ∀ o, (∀ o', emb o' ≠ o) → (∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d) = 0 :=
      fun o ho => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => hq_out o d ho)
    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3, hq4, hq5, hq6, hq_nn, hq_sum, hq_supp⟩ := hadm_q
    have hp'_sum : ∑ o' : Fin N'_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q (emb o') d = 1 := by
      rw [h_sum_emb (fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d) hqO_out]
      exact hq_sum
    have hp'_adm : IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb)
        b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D (fun o' d => q (emb o') d) := by
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      refine ⟨fun o' => hq1 (emb o'), fun o' => hq2 (emb o'), fun o' => hq3 (emb o'),
        fun o' => hq4 (emb o'), ?_, hq6, fun o' d => hq_nn (emb o') d, hp'_sum,
        fun o' d hp' => hq_supp (emb o') d hp'⟩
      intro r v₀ x₀
      refine le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr ?_) (hq5 r v₀ x₀)
      refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn emb (fun o' ho' => ?_) (fun x _ y _ hxy => hemb hxy)
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at ho' ⊢
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ho'.2⟩
    have hp'_D : ∀ d : Fin N_D, (∑ o' : Fin N'_O, q (emb o') d) = ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d :=
      fun d => h_sum_emb (fun o => q o d) (fun o ho => hq_out o d ho)
    have h_score_eq : generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N'_O N_D
        (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) (ψ_O ∘ emb) b_D a_D (fun o' d => q (emb o') d) =
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q := by
      unfold generalPacketScore
      dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
      simp_rw [hp'_D]
      have h1 : (∑ o' : Fin N'_O, -((∑ d : Fin N_D, q (emb o') d) * Real.log (∑ d : Fin N_D, q (emb o') d))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, -((∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d) * Real.log (∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d)) :=
        h_sum_emb (fun o => -((∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d) * Real.log (∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d)))
          (fun o ho => by rw [hqO_out o ho]; simp)
      have h2 : (∑ o' : Fin N'_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q (emb o') d * Real.log (q (emb o') d / ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / ∑ o₁ : Fin N_O, q o₁ d)) :=
        h_sum_emb (fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / ∑ o₁ : Fin N_O, q o₁ d)))
          (fun o ho => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => by rw [hq_out o d ho]; simp))
      have h3 : (∑ o' : Fin N'_O, (∑ d : Fin N_D, q (emb o') d) *
          Real.log (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O (emb o')) (V_O (emb o')) (X_O (emb o')) (ψ_O (emb o')))) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, (∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d) *
            Real.log (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) :=
        h_sum_emb (fun o => (∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d) *
          Real.log (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)))
          (fun o ho => by rw [hqO_out o ho]; simp)
      rw [h1, h2, h3]
    have h_cred_eq : HasIncomingCredit ε H_P t h 4 d_dim N'_O N_D
        (r_O ∘ emb) (V_O ∘ emb) (X_O ∘ emb) e_D (fun o' d => q (emb o') d) k_f α' := by
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      unfold HasIncomingCredit at hcred_q ⊢
      rcases hcred_q with hk0 | ⟨hk_pos, L_grid, τ_V, τ_X, P_f, n_f, W_f, hL1, hL2, hn_f, hgeom, hal, hprob⟩
      · exact Or.inl hk0
      · refine Or.inr ⟨hk_pos, L_grid, τ_V, τ_X, P_f ∘ emb, n_f, W_f ∘ emb, hL1, hL2, hn_f,
          fun o' => hgeom (emb o'), fun hd1 o' d hp' => hal hd1 (emb o') d hp', ?_⟩
        intro p_c w
        have hf1 : (∑ o' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o' => (P_f ∘ emb) o' = p_c ∧ (W_f ∘ emb) o' = w),
            ∑ d : Fin N_D, q (emb o') d) =
          ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w), ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d := by
          rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
          exact h_sum_emb (fun o => if P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w then ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d else 0)
            (fun o ho => by split_ifs <;> [exact hqO_out o ho; rfl])
        have hf2 : (∑ o' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o' => (P_f ∘ emb) o' = p_c),
            ∑ d : Fin N_D, q (emb o') d) =
          ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d := by
          rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
          exact h_sum_emb (fun o => if P_f o = p_c then ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d else 0)
            (fun o ho => by split_ifs <;> [exact hqO_out o ho; rfl])
        rw [hf1, hf2]
        exact hprob p_c w
    exact ⟨hp'_adm, h_score_eq, h_cred_eq⟩

  
  have h_cnt_NO : (N_O : ℝ) ≤ C_cnt * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor)) :=
    h_cnt_est ε H_P L t lam_sys m_t N_O N_D Φ₀ ζ₀ f
      r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p henv ht₀ ht_HP hm_t1 hadm
  have h_low_bound : ∀ (q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D q →
      (∀ o d, 0 < q o d →
        generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤ ε ^ A₀) →
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q ≤ -6 := by
    intro q hadm_q h_low
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hpack, hd_bounds, hq_nn, hq_sum, hq_supp⟩ := hadm_q
    have hNO_ge1 : 1 ≤ N_O := by
      by_contra h0
      have hNO0 : N_O = 0 := by omega
      subst hNO0
      simp at hq_sum
    have hNO_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N_O : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    let q_O := fun o : Fin N_O => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
    let q_D := fun d : Fin N_D => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d
    have hqO_nn : ∀ o, 0 ≤ q_O o := fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq_nn o d)
    have hqO_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o = 1 := hq_sum
    have hqD_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hq_nn o d)
    have hqD_sum : ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d = 1 := by dsimp [q_D]; rw [Finset.sum_comm, hq_sum]
    
    have h_HO_le : (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell ≤
        4 * cls.K_hor + Real.log C_cnt / ell := by
      have h1 := h_shannon hNO_ge1 q_O hqO_nn hqO_sum
      have h2 := Real.log_le_log hNO_pos h_cnt_NO
      rw [Real.log_mul hC_cnt_pos.ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _).ne',
        Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlog_eps] at h2
      have h3 : ∑ o : Fin N_O, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o)) ≤ Real.log C_cnt + 4 * cls.K_hor * ell := by
        linarith
      have h4 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h3 hell_pos.le
      rw [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hell_pos.ne'] at h4
      linarith
    
    have h_Emass_le : (3 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ((∑ o : Fin N_O, q_O o * Real.log (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) ≤
        -6 * cls.K_hor - 6 := by
      have h_o : ∀ o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)),
          q_O o * Real.log (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o)) ≤
            q_O o * (-A₀ * ell) := by
        intro o _
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hqO_nn o) with h0 | hpos
        · rw [← h0]; simp
        · have hex : ∃ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q o d := by
            by_contra hall; push_neg at hall
            have hz : q_O o = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => le_antisymm (hall d) (hq_nn o d))
            linarith
          obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀⟩ := hex
          have hm_pos := (hq_supp o d₀ hd₀).1
          have hm_le := h_low o d₀ hd₀
          have hlog := Real.log_le_log hm_pos hm_le
          rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀, hlog_eps] at hlog
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hpos.le
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_o
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hqO_sum, one_mul] at hsum
      have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsum hell_pos.le
      rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hell_pos.ne'] at hdiv
      dsimp [A₀] at hdiv
      linarith
    
    let u_t : ℝ := (H_P - t) / 2
    let ρ_obs : ℝ := ε ^ u_t

      have hsub_le : p_b b - p_union / (16 * (S_bins : ℝ)) ≤
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, if E b o d ∧ GoodFib_b b (P_in o) then p o d else 0 := by
        linarith [hrb, hκ_pow_le]
      refine ⟨?_, hsub_le⟩
      have h7 : (7 * p_union) / (16 * (S_bins : ℝ)) =
          p_union / (2 * (S_bins : ℝ)) - p_union / (16 * (S_bins : ℝ)) := by ring
      linarith
    have hqb_out : ∀ b : Fin S_bins, b ∉ B_big → q_b b = 0 := by
      intro b hb
      dsimp [q_b, E']
      simp [hb]
    let Q : ℝ := ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b
    have hQ_ge : p_union / 4 ≤ Q := by
      have hsum_lb := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b hb => (hqb_big b hb).2)
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum_lb
      have hc : (B_big.card : ℝ) * (p_union / (16 * (S_bins : ℝ))) ≤ p_union / 16 := by
        calc (B_big.card : ℝ) * (p_union / (16 * (S_bins : ℝ)))
            ≤ (S_bins : ℝ) * (p_union / (16 * (S_bins : ℝ))) := by
              have h1 : B_big.card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin S_bins)).card :=
                Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ _)
              rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
              have h1r : (B_big.card : ℝ) ≤ (S_bins : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1r (by positivity)
          _ = p_union / 16 := by field_simp [hS_pos.ne']
      dsimp [Q]
      linarith
    have hE'_disj : ∀ o d b₁ b₂, E' b₁ o d → E' b₂ o d → b₁ = b₂ :=
      fun o d b₁ b₂ h1 h2 => hE_disj o d b₁ b₂ h1.2.1 h2.2.1
    let bin_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin (S_bins + 1) := fun o d =>
      if h : ∃ b : Fin S_bins, E' b o d then (Classical.choose h).castSucc else Fin.last S_bins
    have hbin_iff : ∀ (b : Fin S_bins) o d, bin_of o d = b.castSucc ↔ E' b o d := by
      intro b o d
      dsimp [bin_of]
      constructor
      · intro heq
        split_ifs at heq with hex
        · have hch := Fin.castSucc_injective S_bins heq
          rw [← hch]
          exact Classical.choose_spec hex
        · exact False.elim (Fin.castSucc_ne_last b heq.symm)
      · intro heb
        have hex : ∃ b₀ : Fin S_bins, E' b₀ o d := ⟨b, heb⟩
        rw [dif_pos hex]
        congr 1
        exact hE'_disj o d (Classical.choose hex) b (Classical.choose_spec hex) heb
    obtain ⟨hπ_nn, hπ_sum, hq_adm, hsc_part⟩ := h_part (by omega : 1 ≤ S_bins + 1) bin_of
    let π_bin : Fin (S_bins + 1) → ℝ := fun m =>
      ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, if bin_of o d = m then p o d else 0
    let q_bin : Fin (S_bins + 1) → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun m o d =>
      if bin_of o d = m ∧ 0 < π_bin m then p o d / π_bin m else 0
    have hπ_cast : ∀ b : Fin S_bins, π_bin b.castSucc = q_b b := by
      intro b
      dsimp [π_bin, q_b]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_))
      by_cases he : E' b o d
      · rw [if_pos ((hbin_iff b o d).mpr he), if_pos he]
      · rw [if_neg (fun hc => he ((hbin_iff b o d).mp hc)), if_neg he]
    have hsum_qb : ∑ b : Fin S_bins, q_b b = Q := by
      dsimp [Q]
      exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun b _ hb => hqb_out b hb)).symm
    have hπ_last : π_bin (Fin.last S_bins) = 1 - Q := by
      have h1 : ∑ m : Fin (S_bins + 1), π_bin m = 1 := hπ_sum
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] at h1
      simp_rw [hπ_cast] at h1
      rw [hsum_qb] at h1
      linarith only [h1]
    have h_last_ub : (if 0 < π_bin (Fin.last S_bins) then
        π_bin (Fin.last S_bins) * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
          N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin (Fin.last S_bins))
        else 0) ≤ (1 - Q) * B_mod := by
      by_cases hl : 0 < π_bin (Fin.last S_bins)
      · rw [if_pos hl]
        have hub := h_mod_q _ (hq_adm _ hl).2
        rw [← hπ_last]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hub hl.le
      · rw [if_neg hl]
        have hz : π_bin (Fin.last S_bins) = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hl) (hπ_nn _)
        rw [← hπ_last, hz]; simp
    have h_cast_sum : (∑ b : Fin S_bins,
        if 0 < π_bin b.castSucc then
          π_bin b.castSucc * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
            N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b.castSucc)
        else 0) =
      ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
        N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b.castSucc) := by
      simp_rw [hπ_cast]
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ B_big) (fun b _ hb => by simp [hqb_out b hb])]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b hb => ?_)
      have hqb_pos : 0 < q_b b := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (hqb_big b hb).1
      rw [if_pos hqb_pos]
    have h_log_S : (3 * Real.log ((S_bins + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / (2 * ell) ≤
        (3 * Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2)) / (2 * ell) := by
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
      have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < ((S_bins + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h2 : ((S_bins + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2 := by push_cast; linarith
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_log h1 h2) (by norm_num)
    let D_tot : ℝ := Δ_cur + δ_mod * t + (3 * Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2)) / (2 * ell)
    have hD_tot_nn : 0 ≤ D_tot := by
      have hlog_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
      have hdiv_nn : 0 ≤ (3 * Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2)) / (2 * ell) := by positivity
      dsimp [D_tot]; linarith
    have h_avg_def : ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b *
        (B_mod - generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b.castSucc)) ≤
        D_tot := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] at hsc_part
      change generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
        ((∑ b : Fin S_bins,
            if 0 < π_bin b.castSucc then
              π_bin b.castSucc * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b.castSucc)
            else 0) +
         (if 0 < π_bin (Fin.last S_bins) then
            π_bin (Fin.last S_bins) * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin (Fin.last S_bins))
          else 0)) +
        (3 * Real.log ((S_bins + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / (2 * ell) at hsc_part
      rw [h_cast_sum] at hsc_part
      have hQ_B : ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b * B_mod = Q * B_mod := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
      have h_sub_sum : ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b *
          (B_mod - generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b.castSucc)) =
          Q * B_mod - ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b *
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b.castSucc) := by
        simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hQ_B]
      rw [h_sub_sum]
      have hB_eq : B_mod - (Δ_cur + δ_mod * t) = K₀_val + quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur := by
        dsimp [B_mod]; ring
      have h1mQ : (1 - Q) * B_mod = B_mod - Q * B_mod := by ring
      have hD_def : D_tot = Δ_cur + δ_mod * t + (3 * Real.log (2 * (S_bins : ℝ) + 2)) / (2 * ell) := rfl
      linarith only [hB_eq, h1mQ, hD_def, hscore, hsc_part, h_last_ub, h_log_S]
    have h_sum_target : ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b *
        (B_mod - generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b.castSucc)) ≤
        ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b * ((4 / p_union) * D_tot) := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (4 / p_union) * Q := by
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ_ge (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 / p_union by positivity)
        have hcan : (4 / p_union) * (p_union / 4) = 1 := by field_simp [hp_union.ne']
        linarith
      calc ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b *
            (B_mod - generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b.castSucc))
          ≤ 1 * D_tot := by rw [one_mul]; exact h_avg_def
        _ ≤ ((4 / p_union) * Q) * D_tot := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hD_tot_nn
        _ = Q * ((4 / p_union) * D_tot) := by ring
        _ = ∑ b ∈ B_big, q_b b * ((4 / p_union) * D_tot) := by
            dsimp [Q]; rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    obtain ⟨b_sel, hb_sel_mem, hb_sel_le⟩ := Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le hB_big_ne h_sum_target
    have hqb_sel_pos : 0 < q_b b_sel := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (hqb_big b_sel hb_sel_mem).1
    have hπ_sel_pos : 0 < π_bin b_sel.castSucc := by rwa [hπ_cast]
    have h_def_sel : B_mod - generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f
        N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D (q_bin b_sel.castSucc) ≤ (4 / p_union) * D_tot :=
      le_of_mul_le_mul_left hb_sel_le hqb_sel_pos
    let p_sel := q_bin b_sel.castSucc
    refine ⟨b_sel, p_sel, ?_, (hq_adm b_sel.castSucc hπ_sel_pos).2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro o d hp_sel
      obtain ⟨hbin_eq, hp_pos⟩ := (hq_adm b_sel.castSucc hπ_sel_pos).1 o d hp_sel
      exact ⟨((hbin_iff b_sel o d).mp hbin_eq).2.1, hp_pos⟩
    · have h_def' : (K₀_val + quantumPacketRate γ * t + δ_mod * t) -
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_sel ≤
          (4 / p_union) * D_tot := by
        have hB_exp : B_mod = K₀_val + quantumPacketRate γ * t + δ_mod * t := by dsimp [B_mod]; ring
        rw [← hB_exp]
        exact h_def_sel
      have hδt_nn : 0 ≤ δ_mod * t := mul_nonneg hδ_mod.le ht₀
      change K₀_val + quantumPacketRate γ * t -
        ((4 / p_union) * D_tot + δ_mod * t) ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_sel
      linarith only [h_def', hδt_nn]
    · have hret_sel := (h_ret (E b_sel) κ_ret ζ_ret hκ_ret_pos hζ_ret).2
      dsimp only at hret_sel
      have hqb_eq_pA' : q_b b_sel =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, if E b_sel o d ∧ GoodFib_b b_sel (P_in o) then p o d else 0 := by
        dsimp [q_b, E']
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_))
        simp [hb_sel_mem]
      have hpA'_pos : 0 < ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, if E b_sel o d ∧ GoodFib_b b_sel (P_in o) then p o d else 0 := by
        rwa [← hqb_eq_pA']
      have hcred_raw := hret_sel hpA'_pos
      rw [hκ_ret_inv] at hcred_raw
      have hp_sel_eq : p_sel = fun o d =>
          if E b_sel o d ∧ GoodFib_b b_sel (P_in o) then
            p o d / (∑ o₁ : Fin N_O, ∑ d₁ : Fin N_D, if E b_sel o₁ d₁ ∧ GoodFib_b b_sel (P_in o₁) then p o₁ d₁ else 0)
          else 0 := by
        ext o d
        dsimp [p_sel, q_bin]
        rw [hπ_cast, hqb_eq_pA']
        by_cases he : E b_sel o d ∧ GoodFib_b b_sel (P_in o)
        · have he' : E' b_sel o d := ⟨hb_sel_mem, he.1, he.2⟩
          rw [if_pos ⟨(hbin_iff b_sel o d).mpr he', hpA'_pos⟩, if_pos he]
        · have hne' : ¬ E' b_sel o d := fun hc => he ⟨hc.2.1, hc.2.2⟩
          rw [if_neg (fun hc => hne' ((hbin_iff b_sel o d).mp hc.1)), if_neg he]
      rwa [hp_sel_eq]

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ) (hγ₀ : 0 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 1)
    (h_mod : UniformPacketGrowthModulus γ (quantumPacketRate γ))
    (h_perp_norm : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖perp2D u‖ = ‖u‖)
    (h_symm : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → projAngleDist u v = projAngleDist v u)
    (h_cramer : ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 →
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        projAngleDist u v * ‖z‖ ≤ |inner ℝ z u| + |inner ℝ z v|)
    (h_fib_ent : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ {N_X N_Y : ℕ} (P : Fin N_X → Fin N_Y → ℝ) {B_fib : ℝ},
        0 < B_fib → (∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y) → (∑ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1) →
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         ∀ y : Fin N_Y, (0 < ∑ x, P x y) →
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin N_X => 0 < P x y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib) →
        let P_Y := fun y => ∑ x, P x y
        (∑ x, ∑ y, -(P x y * Real.log (P x y / P_Y y))) / Real.log (ε⁻¹) ≤
          Real.log B_fib / Real.log (ε⁻¹)) :
    ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (h e₀ ζ_sh δ_mod : ℝ) (M_L : ℕ),
      0 < h → 64 * h < γ * e₀ → 0 < ζ_sh → 64 * ζ_sh ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h →
      0 < δ_mod → 64 * δ_mod ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h → 64 ≤ M_L →
      ∃ ε_norm : ℝ, 0 < ε_norm ∧ ε_norm < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (b_ref a_ref Δ_cur : ℝ),
          ε < ε_norm → 2 * h < t → t ≤ 1 → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
          IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
          ε ^ (t - 2 * h) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ (t - 2 * h) →
          m_r ≤ m_t → cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
            lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          e₀ ≤ a_ref - b_ref → (H_P - t) / 2 - ζ_sh ≤ a_ref →
          (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → |b_D d - b_ref| ≤ ζ_sh ∧ |a_D d - a_ref| ≤ ζ_sh) →
          64 * Δ_cur ≤ 2 * γ * e₀ - 28 * h →
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
            quantumPacketRate γ * t - Δ_cur ≤
            generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p →
          ∃ n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            letI := Classical.propDecidable
            (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) ∧
            3 / 4 ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              if projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d))
                   (n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L
                     (fineOutCell ε H_P t (t - 2 * h) m_r m_t τ_V τ_X
                       (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o)))) ≤ ε ^ (4 * h)
              then p o d else 0

                ≤ ‖fineCellCenterX S_X τ_X p_ref0.2.2 - Y_ref‖ * ‖perp2D (e_D d)‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
              _ ≤ S_X * 1 := by rw [hu_d]; linarith
              _ = (M_L : ℝ) * ε ^ (r + u_t) := by dsimp only [S_X]; ring
              _ ≤ (M_L : ℝ) * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rut_le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          have h_yo : |inner ℝ (Y_o - Y_D) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 2 * B_sys * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
            have hy_id : Y_o - Y_D = (X_O o - X_D d) + (C_rd - C_td) • (V_O o - V_D d) := by
              dsimp only [Y_o, Y_D]; module
            rw [hy_id, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
            have c1 : |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) :=
              le_trans hx_o (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (by dsimp only [r, u_t]; linarith)) (by linarith))
            have c2 : |(C_rd - C_td) * inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤
                B_sys * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
              rw [abs_mul]
              calc |C_rd - C_td| * |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))|
                  ≤ ε ^ r * (B_sys * ε ^ (u_t - 2 * ζ_sh)) :=
                    mul_le_mul hcd_d
                      (le_trans hv_o (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 ha_o) (by linarith)))
                      (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _)
                _ = B_sys * (ε ^ r * ε ^ (u_t - 2 * ζ_sh)) := by ring
                _ = B_sys * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
                    rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]; congr 2; ring
            linarith [abs_add_le (inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d)))
              ((C_rd - C_td) * inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d)))]
          have h_yref : |inner ℝ (Y_ref - Y_D) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 2 * B_sys * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
            have hy_id : Y_ref - Y_D = (X_O o_ref - X_D d) + (C_rd - C_td) • (V_O o_ref - V_D d) := by
              dsimp only [Y_ref, Y_D]; module
            rw [hy_id, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
            have c1 : |inner ℝ (X_O o_ref - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) :=
              le_trans hx_ref (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (by dsimp only [r, u_t]; linarith)) (by linarith))
            have c2 : |(C_rd - C_td) * inner ℝ (V_O o_ref - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤
                B_sys * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
              rw [abs_mul]
              calc |C_rd - C_td| * |inner ℝ (V_O o_ref - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))|
                  ≤ ε ^ r * (B_sys * ε ^ (u_t - 2 * ζ_sh)) :=
                    mul_le_mul hcd_d
                      (le_trans hv_ref (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 ha_ref) (by linarith)))
                      (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _)
                _ = B_sys * (ε ^ r * ε ^ (u_t - 2 * ζ_sh)) := by ring
                _ = B_sys * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
                    rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀]; congr 2; ring
            linarith [abs_add_le (inner ℝ (X_O o_ref - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d)))
              ((C_rd - C_td) * inner ℝ (V_O o_ref - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d)))]
          have t1 := abs_sub (inner ℝ (fineCellCenterX S_X τ_X p_c.2.2 - Y_o) (perp2D (e_D d)) +
            inner ℝ (Y_o - Y_D) (perp2D (e_D d)) - inner ℝ (Y_ref - Y_D) (perp2D (e_D d)))
            (inner ℝ (fineCellCenterX S_X τ_X p_ref0.2.2 - Y_ref) (perp2D (e_D d)))
          have t2 := abs_sub (inner ℝ (fineCellCenterX S_X τ_X p_c.2.2 - Y_o) (perp2D (e_D d)) +
            inner ℝ (Y_o - Y_D) (perp2D (e_D d)))
            (inner ℝ (Y_ref - Y_D) (perp2D (e_D d)))
          have t3 := abs_add_le (inner ℝ (fineCellCenterX S_X τ_X p_c.2.2 - Y_o) (perp2D (e_D d)))
            (inner ℝ (Y_o - Y_D) (perp2D (e_D d)))
          linarith
        exact ⟨h1_eq, hV_strip, hY_strip⟩

      let E_exp := 4 * h + 2 * ζ_sh
      let R₁ := (4 * B_sys + 4) * ε ^ (-E_exp)
      let R₂ := (8 * B_sys + 4) * ε ^ (-E_exp)
      have h1_le_E : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-E_exp) := by
        have h0 : ε ^ (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε ^ (-E_exp) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε₀ hε_le1 (by dsimp only [E_exp]; linarith)
        rwa [Real.rpow_zero] at h0
      have hI_box : ∀ p_c ∈ I,
          p_c.1 = p_ref0.1 ∧
          |(p_c.2.1.1 : ℝ) - (p_ref0.2.1.1 : ℝ)| ≤ R₁ ∧
          |(p_c.2.1.2 : ℝ) - (p_ref0.2.1.2 : ℝ)| ≤ R₁ ∧
          |(p_c.2.2.1 : ℝ) - (p_ref0.2.2.1 : ℝ)| ≤ R₂ ∧
          |(p_c.2.2.2 : ℝ) - (p_ref0.2.2.2 : ℝ)| ≤ R₂ := by
        intro p_c hp_c
        obtain ⟨hpc1, hpc2⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hp_c
        obtain ⟨o₁, ho₁, hpc_eq1⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpc1
        obtain ⟨o₂, ho₂, hpc_eq2⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpc2
        obtain ⟨h1_eq, hv1, hy1⟩ := h_single_strip d₁ o₁ o₁₀ p_c
          (h_pod d₁ o₁ ho₁) (h_pod d₁ o₁₀ ho₁₀) hpc_eq1 hp₀_eq1
        obtain ⟨_, hv2, hy2⟩ := h_single_strip d₂ o₂ o₂₀ p_c
          (h_pod d₂ o₂ ho₂) (h_pod d₂ o₂₀ ho₂₀) hpc_eq2 hp₀_eq2
        let ΔV := fineCellCenterV S_V τ_V p_c.2.1 - fineCellCenterV S_V τ_V p_ref0.2.1
        let ΔY := fineCellCenterX S_X τ_X p_c.2.2 - fineCellCenterX S_X τ_X p_ref0.2.2
        have hcr_V : ε ^ (4 * h) * ‖ΔV‖ ≤
            (4 * B_sys + 4 * (M_L : ℝ)) * ε ^ (u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
          have hc := h_cramer u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ ΔV
          have hm : ε ^ (4 * h) * ‖ΔV‖ ≤ projAngleDist u₁ u₂ * ‖ΔV‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsep.le (norm_nonneg _)
          linarith
        have hcr_Y : ε ^ (4 * h) * ‖ΔY‖ ≤
            (8 * B_sys + 4 * (M_L : ℝ)) * ε ^ (r + u_t - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
          have hc := h_cramer u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ ΔY
          have hm : ε ^ (4 * h) * ‖ΔY‖ ≤ projAngleDist u₁ u₂ * ‖ΔY‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsep.le (norm_nonneg _)
          linarith
        have h_coord_bound : ∀ (S u_exp B_coeff : ℝ) (τ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
            (k k₀ : ℤ × ℤ),
            S = (M_L : ℝ) * ε ^ u_exp → 0 ≤ B_coeff →
            ε ^ (4 * h) * ‖fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀‖ ≤
              (B_coeff + 4 * (M_L : ℝ)) * ε ^ (u_exp - 2 * ζ_sh) →
            |(k.1 : ℝ) - (k₀.1 : ℝ)| ≤ (B_coeff + 4) * ε ^ (-E_exp) ∧
            |(k.2 : ℝ) - (k₀.2 : ℝ)| ≤ (B_coeff + 4) * ε ^ (-E_exp) := by
          intro S u_exp B_coeff τ k k₀ hS_eq hBc hcr
          have hS_pos : 0 < S := by rw [hS_eq]; positivity
          have he4h_pos : 0 < ε ^ (4 * h) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
          have hc0 : S * |(k.1 : ℝ) - (k₀.1 : ℝ)| ≤
              ‖fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀‖ := by
            have hv0 : (fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀) 0 =
                S * ((k.1 : ℝ) - (k₀.1 : ℝ)) := by simp [fineCellCenterV, gridPt2D]; ring
            have ha : |(fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀) 0| ≤
                ‖fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀‖ := by
              simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
                PiLp.norm_apply_le (fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀) 0
            rwa [hv0, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hS_pos] at ha
          have hc1 : S * |(k.2 : ℝ) - (k₀.2 : ℝ)| ≤
              ‖fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀‖ := by
            have hv1 : (fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀) 1 =
                S * ((k.2 : ℝ) - (k₀.2 : ℝ)) := by simp [fineCellCenterV, gridPt2D]; ring
            have ha : |(fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀) 1| ≤
                ‖fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀‖ := by
              simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
                PiLp.norm_apply_le (fineCellCenterV S τ k - fineCellCenterV S τ k₀) 1
            rwa [hv1, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hS_pos] at ha
          have h_prod_pos : 0 < ε ^ (4 * h) * S := mul_pos he4h_pos hS_pos
          have h_rhs_le : (B_coeff + 4 * (M_L : ℝ)) * ε ^ (u_exp - 2 * ζ_sh) ≤
              (ε ^ (4 * h) * S) * ((B_coeff + 4) * ε ^ (-E_exp)) := by
            have hexp : ε ^ (4 * h) * (ε ^ u_exp * ε ^ (-E_exp)) = ε ^ (u_exp - 2 * ζ_sh) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hε₀, ← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
              congr 1; dsimp only [E_exp]; ring
            have hcoef : B_coeff + 4 * (M_L : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ) * (B_coeff + 4) := by
              nlinarith [hBc, hML_pos]
            calc (B_coeff + 4 * (M_L : ℝ)) * ε ^ (u_exp - 2 * ζ_sh)
                ≤ ((M_L : ℝ) * (B_coeff + 4)) * ε ^ (u_exp - 2 * ζ_sh) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef (Real.rpow_nonneg hε₀.le _)
              _ = ((M_L : ℝ) * (B_coeff + 4)) * (ε ^ (4 * h) * (ε ^ u_exp * ε ^ (-E_exp))) := by
                  rw [hexp]
              _ = (ε ^ (4 * h) * S) * ((B_coeff + 4) * ε ^ (-E_exp)) := by rw [hS_eq]; ring
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · have hm := le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc0 he4h_pos.le) (le_trans hcr h_rhs_le)
            exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) h_prod_pos
          · have hm := le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc1 he4h_pos.le) (le_trans hcr h_rhs_le)
            exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) h_prod_pos
        obtain ⟨b11, b12⟩ := h_coord_bound S_V u_t (4 * B_sys) τ_V p_c.2.1 p_ref0.2.1 rfl
          (by linarith) hcr_V
        dsimp only [ΔY] at hcr_Y
        rw [h_centerX_eq] at hcr_Y
        obtain ⟨b21, b22⟩ := h_coord_bound S_X (r + u_t) (8 * B_sys) τ_X p_c.2.2 p_ref0.2.2 rfl
          (by linarith) hcr_Y
        exact ⟨h1_eq, b11, b12, b21, b22⟩
      have hc := h_box4_card R₁ R₂ p_ref0 I (by positivity) (by positivity) hI_box
      have hR1_sq : (2 * R₁ + 2) ^ 2 ≤ (8 * B_sys + 10) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-E_exp)) ^ 2 := by
        have hb : 2 * R₁ + 2 ≤ (8 * B_sys + 10) * ε ^ (-E_exp) := by
          dsimp only [R₁]; nlinarith [h1_le_E, hB_sys]
        rw [← mul_pow]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hb 2
      have hR2_sq : (2 * R₂ + 2) ^ 2 ≤ (16 * B_sys + 10) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-E_exp)) ^ 2 := by
        have hb : 2 * R₂ + 2 ≤ (16 * B_sys + 10) * ε ^ (-E_exp) := by
          dsimp only [R₂]; nlinarith [h1_le_E, hB_sys]
        rw [← mul_pow]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hb 2
      have h_e4E : (ε ^ (-E_exp)) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-E_exp)) ^ 2 = ε ^ (-(16 * h + 8 * ζ_sh)) := by
        rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add hε₀, ← Real.rpow_add hε₀]
        congr 1; dsimp only [E_exp]; ring
      calc (I.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * R₁ + 2) ^ 2 * (2 * R₂ + 2) ^ 2 := hc
        _ ≤ ((8 * B_sys + 10) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-E_exp)) ^ 2) *
              ((16 * B_sys + 10) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-E_exp)) ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul hR1_sq hR2_sq (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = C_sep * ((ε ^ (-E_exp)) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-E_exp)) ^ 2) := by dsimp only [C_sep]; ring
        _ = C_sep * ε ^ (-(16 * h + 8 * ζ_sh)) := by rw [h_e4E]
    · change (I.card : ℝ) ≤ _
      rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hI]
      simp; positivity

  
  let S_P : Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := Finset.univ.image P_buf
  let N_P : ℕ := S_P.card
  let e_P : S_P ≃ Fin N_P := S_P.equivFin
  let P_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_P := fun o =>
    e_P ⟨P_buf o, Finset.mem_image_of_mem P_buf (Finset.mem_univ o)⟩
  let g_P : Fin N_P → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun ip => (e_P.symm ip).1
  have hgP_Pof : ∀ o : Fin N_O, g_P (P_of o) = P_buf o := by
    intro o; dsimp only [g_P, P_of]; simp
  have hgP_inj : Function.Injective g_P :=
    fun x y hxy => e_P.symm.injective (Subtype.ext hxy)

  let S_B : Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := S_P.image B_P
  let N_B : ℕ := S_B.card
  let e_B : S_B ≃ Fin N_B := S_B.equivFin
  let B_of : Fin N_P → Fin N_B := fun ip =>
    e_B ⟨B_P (e_P.symm ip).1, Finset.mem_image_of_mem B_P (e_P.symm ip).2⟩
  let g_B : Fin N_B → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun ib => (e_B.symm ib).1
  have hgB_Bof : ∀ ip : Fin N_P, g_B (B_of ip) = B_P (g_P ip) := by
    intro ip; dsimp only [g_B, B_of, g_P]; simp
  have hgB_inj : Function.Injective g_B :=
    fun x y hxy => e_B.symm.injective (Subtype.ext hxy)

  let Sep : Fin N_D → Fin N_D → Prop := fun d₁ d₂ =>
    ε ^ (4 * h) < projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d₁)) (perp2D (e_D d₂))
  have hSep_symm : ∀ d₁ d₂, Sep d₁ d₂ → Sep d₂ d₁ := by
    intro d₁ d₂ hs; dsimp only [Sep] at hs ⊢
    rwa [h_symm (perp2D (e_D d₂)) (perp2D (e_D d₁))
      (by rw [h_perp_norm, (hd_unit d₂).2]) (by rw [h_perp_norm, (hd_unit d₁).2])]

  let B_sep : ℝ := C_sep * ε ^ (-(16 * h + 8 * ζ_sh))
  have hB_sep : 0 < B_sep := mul_pos hC_sep (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _)

  have hcard_OP :
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      ∀ (ip : Fin N_P) (d : Fin N_D),
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => P_of o = ip ∧ 0 < p o d)).card : ℝ) ≤
          C_OP * ε ^ (-(4 * h)) := by
    intro ip d
    refine le_trans ?_ (h_b1_OP (g_P ip) (r_D d))
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (fun o ho => by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ho ⊢
      obtain ⟨_, hpo, hpod⟩ := ho
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, by rw [← hpo, hgP_Pof o], (hp_geom o d hpod).2.2.1⟩)

  have hcard_BD :
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      ∀ d : Fin N_D,
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ib : Fin N_B =>
          ∃ o : Fin N_O, 0 < p o d ∧ B_of (P_of o) = ib)).card : ℝ) ≤ C_BD := by
    intro d
    refine le_trans ?_ (h_b2_BD d)
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn g_B
      (fun ib hib => by
        rw [Finset.mem_coe] at hib ⊢
        obtain ⟨_, o, hpod, hbo⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hib
        rw [← hbo, hgB_Bof, hgP_Pof]
        refine Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun o => B_P (P_buf o)) ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_filter]
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, by rw [if_pos hpod]; trivial⟩)
      (fun x _ y _ hxy => hgB_inj hxy))

  have hcard_iso : ∀ ib : Fin N_B,
      (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => B_of (P_of o) = ib)).image D_iso).card : ℝ) ≤
        C_iso * ε ^ (-(6 * h)) := by
    intro ib
    refine le_trans ?_ (h_b3_iso (g_B ib))
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (Finset.image_subset_image (fun o ho => by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ho ⊢
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, ?_⟩
      rw [← ho.2, hgB_Bof, hgP_Pof]))

  have h_sep_fib :
      letI := Classical.propDecidable
      ∀ d₁ d₂ : Fin N_D, Sep d₁ d₂ →
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ip : Fin N_P =>
          (∃ o : Fin N_O, 0 < p o d₁ ∧ P_of o = ip) ∧
          (∃ o' : Fin N_O, 0 < p o' d₂ ∧ P_of o' = ip))).card : ℝ) ≤ B_sep := by
    intro d₁ d₂ hsep
    refine le_trans ?_ (h_b4_sep d₁ d₂ hsep)
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn g_P
      (fun ip hip => by
        rw [Finset.mem_coe] at hip ⊢
        obtain ⟨_, ⟨o₁, hp1, hpo1⟩, ⟨o₂, hp2, hpo2⟩⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hip
        rw [Finset.mem_inter]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← hpo1, hgP_Pof]
          refine Finset.mem_image_of_mem P_buf ?_
          rw [Finset.mem_filter]
          exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ o₁, by rw [if_pos hp1]; trivial⟩
        · rw [← hpo2, hgP_Pof]
          refine Finset.mem_image_of_mem P_buf ?_
          rw [Finset.mem_filter]
          exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ o₂, by rw [if_pos hp2]; trivial⟩)
      (fun x _ y _ hxy => hgP_inj hxy))

  let S_cap : ℝ := generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f +
    (quantumPacketRate γ + δ_mod) * t
  let Δ_p : ℝ := Δ_cur + δ_mod * t
  have h_score_ub : ∀ (N'_D : ℕ) (b'_D a'_D : Fin N'_D → ℝ) (r'_D : Fin N'_D → ℕ)
      (e'_D V'_D X'_D : Fin N'_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (q' : Fin N_O → Fin N'_D → ℝ),
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N'_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b'_D a'_D r'_D e'_D V'_D X'_D q' →
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N'_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b'_D a'_D q' ≤ S_cap :=
    fun N'_D b'_D a'_D r'_D e'_D V'_D X'_D q' hadm_q' =>
      h_mod_ub ε H_P L t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ ζ₀ f N_O N'_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
        b'_D a'_D r'_D e'_D V'_D X'_D q' hε_lt_mod ht_gt.le ht_L ht_HP henv hmt_lo hmt_hi hadm_q'
  have hp_score : S_cap - Δ_p ≤
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p := by
    dsimp only [S_cap, Δ_p]; linarith [hscore_p]

  have h_contra_gap :
      16 * Δ_p +
        (24 * Real.log 2 + Real.log 4 + Real.log C_OP + Real.log C_iso +

        (1 / 2) * ((π₁ * (∑ o, ∑ d, -(q₁ o d * Real.log (q₁ o d / q₁_D d))) +

        π₁ * ((∑ o, -(q₁_O o * Real.log (q₁_O o))) / ell +
          (1 / 2) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(q₁ o d * Real.log (q₁ o d / q₁_D d))) / ell)) +
        π₂ * ((∑ o, -(q₂_O o * Real.log (q₂_O o))) / ell +
          (1 / 2) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(q₂ o d * Real.log (q₂ o d / q₂_D d))) / ell)) +
        (3 * Real.log 2) / (2 * ell) := by
      field_simp [hell_pos.ne']; ring
    linarith

  
  have hp_adm_sub : ∀ q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ,
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ q o d) → (∑ o, ∑ d, q o d = 1) → (∀ o d, 0 < q o d → 0 < p o d) →
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q ≤ S_cap := by
    intro q hq_nn hq_sum hq_supp
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, _, _, h9⟩ := hadm_p
    exact h_score_ub N_D b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D q
      ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, hq_nn, hq_sum, fun o d hq => h9 o d (hq_supp o d hq)⟩
  have hΔ_p_nn : 0 ≤ Δ_p := by
    have hub := hp_adm_sub p hp_nn hp_sum (fun _ _ h => h)
    linarith [hp_score, hub]

  let p_PD : Fin N_P → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun ip d =>
    ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), p o d
  let p_P : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun ip => ∑ d, p_PD ip d
  have hpPD_nn : ∀ ip d, 0 ≤ p_PD ip d := fun ip d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hp_nn o d)
  have hpP_nn : ∀ ip, 0 ≤ p_P ip := fun ip => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hpPD_nn ip d)
  have hpP_eq : ∀ ip, p_P ip = ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), ∑ d, p o d :=
    fun _ => Finset.sum_comm
  let decCond := fun o₁ o₂ => Classical.propDecidable (P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁))
  let Pi_law : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ =>
    @ite ℝ (P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)) (decCond o₁ o₂)
      (p o₁ d₁ * p o₂ d₂ / p_P (P_of o₁)) 0
  have hPi_nn : ∀ o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂, 0 ≤ Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ := by
    intro o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂; dsimp only [Pi_law]
    by_cases hc : P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hp_nn _ _) (hp_nn _ _)) hc.2.le
    · rw [if_neg hc]
  have hPi_marg1 : ∀ o₁ d₁, (∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) = p o₁ d₁ := by
    intro o₁ d₁
    by_cases hp0 : p o₁ d₁ = 0
    · refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d₂ _ => ?_))).trans hp0.symm
      dsimp only [Pi_law]
      by_cases hc : P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)
      · rw [if_pos hc, hp0]; ring
      · rw [if_neg hc]
    · have hp_pos : 0 < p o₁ d₁ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp_nn o₁ d₁) (Ne.symm hp0)
      have hpP_pos : 0 < p_P (P_of o₁) := by
        rw [hpP_eq]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hp_pos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d _ => hp_nn o₁ d) (Finset.mem_univ d₁)))
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hp_nn o d))
            (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o₁, rfl⟩))
      have h_o2 : ∀ o₂ : Fin N_O, (∑ d₂, Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) =
          if P_of o₂ = P_of o₁ then p o₁ d₁ * (∑ d₂, p o₂ d₂) / p_P (P_of o₁) else 0 := by
        intro o₂
        by_cases heq : P_of o₂ = P_of o₁
        · have hc : P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁) := ⟨heq.symm, hpP_pos⟩
          rw [if_pos heq]
          have hd2 : ∀ d₂, Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ = p o₁ d₁ * p o₂ d₂ / p_P (P_of o₁) :=
            fun d₂ => if_pos hc
          simp_rw [hd2, ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        · have hc : ¬ (P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)) := fun h => heq h.1.symm
          rw [if_neg heq]
          exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d₂ _ => if_neg hc)
      simp_rw [h_o2, ← Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← hpP_eq]
      exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ (p o₁ d₁) hpP_pos.ne'
  have hPi_symm : ∀ o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂, Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ = Pi_law o₂ d₂ o₁ d₁ := by
    intro o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂; dsimp only [Pi_law]
    by_cases hc : P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)
    · have hc' : P_of o₂ = P_of o₁ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₂) := ⟨hc.1.symm, hc.1 ▸ hc.2⟩
      rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc', hc.1]; ring
    · have hc' : ¬ (P_of o₂ = P_of o₁ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₂)) :=
        fun h => hc ⟨h.1.symm, h.1 ▸ h.2⟩
      rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc']

  let decSep := fun d₁ d₂ => Classical.propDecidable (Sep d₁ d₂)
  let decNotSep := fun d₁ d₂ => @instDecidableNot _ (decSep d₁ d₂)
  let π_A : ℝ := ∑ o₁, ∑ d₁, ∑ o₂, ∑ d₂,
    @ite ℝ (Sep d₁ d₂) (decSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0
  let π_comp : ℝ := ∑ o₁, ∑ d₁, ∑ o₂, ∑ d₂,
    @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0
  have hπA_nn : 0 ≤ π_A := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₁ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₁ _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₂ _ => by
      by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂ <;> simp [decSep, hs, hPi_nn]))))
  have hπcomp_nn : 0 ≤ π_comp := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₁ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₁ _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₂ _ => by
      by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂ <;> simp [decNotSep, hs, hPi_nn]))))
  have hπ_tot : π_A + π_comp = 1 := by
    dsimp only [π_A, π_comp]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have h_pt : ∀ o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂,
        @ite ℝ (Sep d₁ d₂) (decSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0 +
        @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0 =
        Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ := by
      intro o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂
      by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂ <;> simp [decSep, decNotSep, hs]
    simp_rw [h_pt, hPi_marg1]
    exact hp_sum

  
  have h_s2 : ∀ (q : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) (Δ'_q : ℝ),
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ q o d) →
      (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d = 1) →
      (∀ o d, 0 < q o d → 0 < p o d) →
      S_cap - Δ'_q ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D q →
      let q_D := fun d : Fin N_D => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d
      let q_PD := fun (ip : Fin N_P) (d : Fin N_D) =>
        ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), q o d
      let q_P := fun ip : Fin N_P => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_PD ip d
      let q_BD := fun (ib : Fin N_B) (d : Fin N_D) =>
        ∑ ip ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ip => B_of ip = ib), q_PD ip d
      let q_B := fun ib : Fin N_B =>
        ∑ ip ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ip => B_of ip = ib), q_P ip
      let H_P_D := (∑ ip : Fin N_P, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(q_PD ip d * Real.log (q_PD ip d / q_D d))) / ell
      let H_P_B := (∑ ip : Fin N_P,
        -(q_P ip * Real.log (q_P ip / q_B (B_of ip)))) / ell
      let H_P_DB := (∑ ip : Fin N_P, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(q_PD ip d * Real.log (q_PD ip d / q_BD (B_of ip) d))) / ell
      let H_B_D := (∑ ib : Fin N_B, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(q_BD ib d * Real.log (q_BD ib d / q_D d))) / ell
      ((1 + γ) * (a_ref - b_ref) - 4 * h - 4 * ζ_sh - Real.log C_OP / ell - 2 * Δ'_q ≤ H_P_D) ∧
      (H_P_B - H_P_DB ≤
        (1 - γ) * (a_ref - b_ref) + 6 * h + 4 * ζ_sh +
          (Real.log C_iso + Real.log C_BD) / ell + 2 * Δ'_q) ∧
      (H_B_D ≤ Real.log C_BD / ell) := by
    intro q Δ'_q hq_nn hq_sum hq_supp hq_score
    dsimp only
    let q_O := fun o : Fin N_O => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q o d
    let q_D := fun d : Fin N_D => ∑ o : Fin N_O, q o d
    let q_PD := fun (ip : Fin N_P) (d : Fin N_D) =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), q o d
    let q_P := fun ip : Fin N_P => ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_PD ip d
    let q_BD := fun (ib : Fin N_B) (d : Fin N_D) =>
      ∑ ip ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ip => B_of ip = ib), q_PD ip d
    let q_B := fun ib : Fin N_B =>
      ∑ ip ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ip => B_of ip = ib), q_P ip
    have hqO_nn : ∀ o, 0 ≤ q_O o := fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hq_nn o d)
    have hqD_nn : ∀ d, 0 ≤ q_D d := fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hq_nn o d)
    have hqPD_nn : ∀ ip d, 0 ≤ q_PD ip d := fun ip d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hq_nn o d)
    have hqP_nn : ∀ ip, 0 ≤ q_P ip := fun ip => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hqPD_nn ip d)
    have hqBD_nn : ∀ ib d, 0 ≤ q_BD ib d := fun ib d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ip _ => hqPD_nn ip d)
    have hqD_sum : ∑ d, q_D d = 1 := by dsimp only [q_D]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact hq_sum
    have hqPD_sum_ip : ∀ d, ∑ ip, q_PD ip d = q_D d :=
      fun d => Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ P_of (fun o => q o d)
    have hqBD_sum_ib : ∀ d, ∑ ib, q_BD ib d = q_D d :=
      fun d => (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ B_of (fun ip => q_PD ip d)).trans (hqPD_sum_ip d)
    have hqP_eq : ∀ ip, q_P ip = ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), q_O o :=
      fun _ => Finset.sum_comm
    have hqP_sum : ∑ ip, q_P ip = 1 := by
      simp_rw [hqP_eq]
      exact (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ P_of q_O).trans hq_sum
    have hqB_sum : ∑ ib, q_B ib = 1 :=
      (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ B_of q_P).trans hqP_sum

    
    have hEw_q : ∑ d, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) ≤
        (1 + γ) * b_ref + (1 - γ) * a_ref + 2 * ζ_sh := by
      have h_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d) ≤
          q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_ref + (1 - γ) * a_ref + 2 * ζ_sh) := by
        intro d
        by_cases h0 : q_D d = 0
        · simp [h0]
        · have hpos : 0 < q_D d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hqD_nn d) (Ne.symm h0)
          have hex : ∃ o, 0 < q o d := by
            by_contra hall; push Not at hall
            exact h0 (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o _ => le_antisymm (hall o) (hq_nn o d)))
          obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := hex
          obtain ⟨hb, ha⟩ := hp_ba o d (hq_supp o d ho)
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hpos.le
          have hb_hi := (abs_le.mp hb).2
          have ha_hi := (abs_le.mp ha).2
          nlinarith only [hγ₀, hγ₁, hb_hi, ha_hi]
      calc ∑ d, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
          ≤ ∑ d, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_ref + (1 - γ) * a_ref + 2 * ζ_sh) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_d d)
        _ = (∑ d, q_D d) * ((1 + γ) * b_ref + (1 - γ) * a_ref + 2 * ζ_sh) :=
            (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = (1 + γ) * b_ref + (1 - γ) * a_ref + 2 * ζ_sh := by rw [hqD_sum, one_mul]

    
    have hH_BD_le : (∑ ib : Fin N_B, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(q_BD ib d * Real.log (q_BD ib d / q_D d))) / ell ≤ Real.log C_BD / ell := by
      have h_sum1 : ∑ ib, ∑ d, q_BD ib d = 1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hqBD_sum_ib]; exact hqD_sum
      have h_fib : letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ d : Fin N_D, (0 < ∑ ib, q_BD ib d) →
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ib : Fin N_B => 0 < q_BD ib d)).card : ℝ) ≤ C_BD := by
        intro d _
        have hcd := hcard_BD d
        refine le_trans ?_ hcd
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (fun ib hib => by
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hib ⊢
          have hpos := hib.2
          dsimp only [q_BD] at hpos
          have hex_ip : ∃ ip ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ip => B_of ip = ib), 0 < q_PD ip d := by
            by_contra hall; push Not at hall
            exact hpos.ne' (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun ip hip => le_antisymm (hall ip hip) (hqPD_nn ip d)))
          obtain ⟨ip, hip, hqpd_pos⟩ := hex_ip
          dsimp only [q_PD] at hqpd_pos
          have hex_o : ∃ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), 0 < q o d := by
            by_contra hall; push Not at hall
            exact hqpd_pos.ne' (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => le_antisymm (hall o ho) (hq_nn o d)))
          obtain ⟨o, ho, hqo⟩ := hex_o
          exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ ib, o, hq_supp o d hqo,
                 (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2 ▸ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hip).2⟩)
      have hent := h_fib_ent hε₀ hε₁ q_BD hC_BD hqBD_nn h_sum1 h_fib
      simpa only [hqBD_sum_ib, ell] using hent

    
    let e_std : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, 0]
    have he_std_norm : ‖e_std‖ = 1 := by
      have hsq : ‖e_std‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp [e_std]
      have hnn := norm_nonneg e_std
      nlinarith only [hsq, hnn]
    have ha1 := hadm_p.1
    have ha2 := hadm_p.2.1
    have ha3 := hadm_p.2.2.1
    have ha4 := hadm_p.2.2.2.1
    have ha5 := hadm_p.2.2.2.2.1
    have ha9 := hadm_p.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
    have hqO_obs : ∀ o : Fin N_O, 0 < q_O o →
        0 < generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) := by
      intro o hqo
      dsimp only [q_O] at hqo
      have hex : ∃ d, 0 < q o d := by
        by_contra hall; push Not at hall
        exact hqo.ne' (Finset.sum_eq_zero (s := Finset.univ) (fun d _ => le_antisymm (hall d) (hq_nn o d)))
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hex
      exact (ha9 o d (hq_supp o d hd)).1

    
    let w_top := min (L - t) ((H_P - t) / 2)
    have hw_top_nn : 0 ≤ w_top := le_trans hb_min_nn hb_min_w
    let q_top : Fin N_O → Fin N_O → ℝ := fun o o' => if o = o' then q_O o else 0
    have hadm_top : IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
        lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_O r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
        (fun _ => w_top) (fun _ => w_top) r_O (fun _ => e_std) V_O X_O q_top := by
      refine ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3, ha4, ha5, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro o'
        exact ⟨hw_top_nn, le_rfl, le_rfl, (ha1 o').1, he_std_norm⟩
      · intro o o'; dsimp only [q_top]; split_ifs <;> linarith [hqO_nn o]
      · have h1 : ∀ o, (∑ o', q_top o o') = q_O o := fun o => by simp [q_top]
        simp_rw [h1]; exact hq_sum
      · intro o o' hq_pos
        dsimp only [q_top] at hq_pos
        by_cases hoo' : o = o'
        · subst hoo'
          simp only [↓reduceIte] at hq_pos
          refine ⟨hqO_obs o hq_pos, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
            { simp only [sub_self, inner_zero_left, abs_zero]; positivity }
        · simp [hoo'] at hq_pos
    have h_ub_top := h_score_ub N_O (fun _ => w_top) (fun _ => w_top) r_O
      (fun _ => e_std) V_O X_O q_top hadm_top
    have h_sc_top : generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_O r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
        (fun _ => w_top) (fun _ => w_top) q_top =
        (∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, q_O o * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) +
        w_top := by
      unfold generalPacketScore
      have hO : ∀ o, (∑ o', q_top o o') = q_O o := fun o => by simp [q_top]
      have hD : ∀ o', (∑ o, q_top o o') = q_O o' := fun o' => by simp [q_top]
      have hHOD0 : ∑ o, ∑ o', -(q_top o o' * Real.log (q_top o o' / (∑ o₁, q_top o₁ o'))) = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o' _ => ?_))
        rw [hD o']
        by_cases hoo' : o = o'
        · subst hoo'
          by_cases h0 : q_O o = 0
          · simp [q_top, h0]
          · simp [q_top, div_self h0]
        · simp [q_top, hoo']
      have hEw : (∑ o', q_O o' * ((1 + γ) * w_top + (1 - γ) * w_top)) = 2 * w_top := by
        have hw : (1 + γ) * w_top + (1 - γ) * w_top = 2 * w_top := by ring
        rw [hw, ← Finset.sum_mul, hq_sum, one_mul]
      change (∑ o, -((∑ o', q_top o o') * Real.log (∑ o', q_top o o'))) / ell +
        (1 / 2) * ((∑ o, ∑ o', -(q_top o o' * Real.log (q_top o o' / (∑ o₁, q_top o₁ o')))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2) * ((∑ o, (∑ o', q_top o o') * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) +
        (1 / 2) * (∑ o', (∑ o, q_top o o') * ((1 + γ) * w_top + (1 - γ) * w_top)) = _
      rw [hHOD0]; simp_rw [hO, hD]; rw [hEw]; ring

    
    have hH_OPD_le : (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_PD (P_of o) d))) / ell ≤
        Real.log C_OP / ell + 4 * h := by
      let P_flat : Fin N_O → Fin (N_P * N_D) → ℝ := fun o y =>
        let pd := finProdFinEquiv.symm y
        if P_of o = pd.1 then q o pd.2 else 0
      have hPf_nn : ∀ o y, 0 ≤ P_flat o y := by
        intro o y; dsimp only [P_flat]; split_ifs <;> linarith [hq_nn o (finProdFinEquiv.symm y).2]
      have hPf_Y : ∀ y, (∑ o, P_flat o y) = q_PD (finProdFinEquiv.symm y).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm y).2 := by
        intro y; dsimp only [P_flat, q_PD]
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      have hPf_sum : ∑ o, ∑ y, P_flat o y = 1 := by
        have h1 : ∀ o, (∑ y, P_flat o y) = q_O o := by
          intro o
          dsimp only [P_flat]
          rw [Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv.symm (fun pd => if P_of o = pd.1 then q o pd.2 else 0)]
          rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
          simp [q_O]
        simp_rw [h1]; exact hq_sum
      have hPf_ent_eq : (∑ o, ∑ y, -(P_flat o y * Real.log (P_flat o y / (∑ o', P_flat o' y)))) =
          ∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_PD (P_of o) d)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
        simp_rw [hPf_Y]
        dsimp only [P_flat]
        rw [Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv.symm (fun pd =>
          -((if P_of o = pd.1 then q o pd.2 else 0) *
            Real.log ((if P_of o = pd.1 then q o pd.2 else 0) / q_PD pd.1 pd.2)))]
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (P_of o)]
        · simp
        · intro ip _ hip; simp [Ne.symm hip]
        · intro hmem; exact False.elim (hmem (Finset.mem_univ _))
      have hPf_fib : letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ y : Fin (N_P * N_D), (0 < ∑ o, P_flat o y) →
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => 0 < P_flat o y)).card : ℝ) ≤

        intro y _
        let pd := finProdFinEquiv.symm y
        have hco := hcard_OP pd.1 pd.2

        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (fun o ho => by
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ho ⊢
          have hp_pos : 0 < if P_of o = pd.1 then q o pd.2 else 0 := ho.2
          by_cases hpo : P_of o = pd.1
          · rw [if_pos hpo] at hp_pos
            exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, hpo, hq_supp o pd.2 hp_pos⟩
          · rw [if_neg hpo] at hp_pos
            exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hp_pos))
      have hent := h_fib_ent hε₀ hε₁ P_flat (mul_pos hC_OP (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _))
        hPf_nn hPf_sum hPf_fib
      change (∑ o, ∑ y, -(P_flat o y * Real.log (P_flat o y / (∑ o', P_flat o' y)))) / ell ≤
        Real.log (C_OP * ε ^ (-(4 * h))) / ell at hent
      rwa [hPf_ent_eq, h_log_eps_pow hC_OP] at hent

    
    have hHOD_chain : (∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) =
        (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(q_PD ip d * Real.log (q_PD ip d / q_D d))) +
        (∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_PD (P_of o) d))) := by
      have c1 := h_sh_cond q hq_nn
      have c2 := h_sh_cond q_PD hqPD_nn
      simp_rw [hqPD_sum_ip] at c2
      have c3 := h_sh_fiber (fun od : Fin N_O × Fin N_D => (P_of od.1, od.2))
        (fun od => q od.1 od.2) (fun od => hq_nn od.1 od.2)
      have h_fb : ∀ pd : Fin N_P × Fin N_D,
          (∑ od ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun od : Fin N_O × Fin N_D => (P_of od.1, od.2) = pd), q od.1 od.2) =

        intro pd
        rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        simp_rw [Prod.ext_iff]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_eq_single pd.2]
        · simp [q_PD, Finset.sum_filter]
        · intro d _ hd; simp [hd]
        · intro hm; exact False.elim (hm (Finset.mem_univ _))
      dsimp only at c3
      simp_rw [h_fb] at c3
      simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at c3
      linarith

    have h11_7 : (1 + γ) * (a_ref - b_ref) - 4 * h - 4 * ζ_sh - Real.log C_OP / ell - 2 * Δ'_q ≤
        (∑ ip : Fin N_P, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_PD ip d * Real.log (q_PD ip d / q_D d))) / ell := by
      have hsc_q := hq_score
      unfold generalPacketScore at hsc_q
      change S_cap - Δ'_q ≤ (∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +
        (1 / 2) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2) * ((∑ o, q_O o * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) +
        (1 / 2) * (∑ d, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) at hsc_q
      rw [h_sc_top] at h_ub_top
      rw [hHOD_chain, add_div] at hsc_q
      linarith [h_ub_top, hsc_q, ha_ref_w, hEw_q, hH_OPD_le]

    
    let S_iso := Finset.univ.image D_iso
    let N_iso := S_iso.card
    let e_iso : S_iso ≃ Fin N_iso := S_iso.equivFin
    let d_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_iso := fun o =>
      e_iso ⟨D_iso o, Finset.mem_image_of_mem D_iso (Finset.mem_univ o)⟩
    let g_iso : Fin N_iso → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun d' => (e_iso.symm d').1
    have hg_dof : ∀ o : Fin N_O, g_iso (d_of o) = D_iso o := by
      intro o; dsimp only [g_iso, d_of]; simp
    let V'_iso : Fin N_iso → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=

    let X'_iso : Fin N_iso → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun d' => fineCellCenterV (ε ^ (b_min + t)) 0 (g_iso d').2.2

    have hadm_iso : IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win

        (fun _ => b_min) (fun _ => b_min) (fun d' => (g_iso d').1)
        (fun _ => e_std) V'_iso X'_iso q_iso := by
      refine ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3, ha4, ha5, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro d'
        have hmem : g_iso d' ∈ S_iso := (e_iso.symm d').2
        obtain ⟨o, _, ho_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
        have hr_lt : (g_iso d').1 < 2 ^ m_t := by
          rw [← ho_eq]; exact (ha1 o).1
        exact ⟨hb_min_nn, le_rfl, hb_min_w, hr_lt, he_std_norm⟩
      · intro o d'; dsimp only [q_iso]; split_ifs <;> linarith [hqO_nn o]
      · have h1 : ∀ o, (∑ d', q_iso o d') = q_O o := fun o => by simp [q_iso]
        simp_rw [h1]; exact hq_sum
      · intro o d' hq_pos
        dsimp only [q_iso] at hq_pos
        by_cases hdo : d_of o = d'
        · subst hdo
          simp only [↓reduceIte] at hq_pos
          have hg_eq := hg_dof o

          have hsb1 : 0 < ε ^ b_min := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
          have hsbt : 0 < ε ^ (b_min + t) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _
          have hkV : roundShift2D (ε ^ b_min) 0 (V_O o) = (g_iso (d_of o)).2.1 := by rw [hg_eq]
          have hkX : roundShift2D (ε ^ (b_min + t)) 0 (X_O o) = (g_iso (d_of o)).2.2 := by rw [hg_eq]
          obtain ⟨hv0, hv1, _⟩ := h_mid_unit (ε ^ b_min) 0 (V_O o) (g_iso (d_of o)).2.1 hsb1 hkV
          obtain ⟨hx0, hx1, _⟩ := h_mid_unit (ε ^ (b_min + t)) 0 (X_O o) (g_iso (d_of o)).2.2 hsbt hkX
          have hin_e : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ w e_std = w 0 := by
            intro w; rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [e_std]
          have hin_p : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ w (perp2D e_std) = w 1 := by
            intro w; rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [e_std, perp2D]
          refine ⟨hqO_obs o hq_pos, hr_eq, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hin_e]; dsimp only [V'_iso]; nlinarith only [hv0, hB_sys, hsb1]
          · rw [hin_p]; dsimp only [V'_iso]; nlinarith only [hv1, hB_sys, hsb1]
          · rw [hin_e]; dsimp only [X'_iso]; nlinarith only [hx0, hB_sys, hsbt]
          · rw [hin_p]; dsimp only [X'_iso]; nlinarith only [hx1, hB_sys, hsbt]
        · simp [hdo] at hq_pos

    have h_ub_iso := h_score_ub N_iso (fun _ => b_min) (fun _ => b_min)
      (fun d' => (g_iso d').1) (fun _ => e_std) V'_iso X'_iso q_iso hadm_iso
    let q_iso_D : Fin N_iso → ℝ := fun d' =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => d_of o = d'), q_O o
    have h_sc_iso : generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_iso r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
        (fun _ => b_min) (fun _ => b_min) q_iso =
        (∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o / q_iso_D (d_of o)))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o, q_O o * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) +
        b_min := by
      unfold generalPacketScore
      have hO : ∀ o, (∑ d', q_iso o d') = q_O o := fun o => by simp [q_iso]
      have hD : ∀ d', (∑ o, q_iso o d') = q_iso_D d' :=
        fun d' => by simp [q_iso, q_iso_D, Finset.sum_filter]
      have hD_sum : ∑ d', q_iso_D d' = 1 :=
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ d_of q_O).trans hq_sum
      have hHOD_iso : (∑ o, ∑ d', -(q_iso o d' * Real.log (q_iso o d' / q_iso_D d'))) =
          ∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o / q_iso_D (d_of o))) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (d_of o)]
        · simp [q_iso]
        · intro d' _ hd'; simp [q_iso, Ne.symm hd']
        · intro hm; exact False.elim (hm (Finset.mem_univ _))
      have hEw_iso : (∑ d', q_iso_D d' * ((1 + γ) * b_min + (1 - γ) * b_min)) = 2 * b_min := by
        have hb : (1 + γ) * b_min + (1 - γ) * b_min = 2 * b_min := by ring
        rw [hb, ← Finset.sum_mul, hD_sum, one_mul]
      change (∑ o, -((∑ d', q_iso o d') * Real.log (∑ d', q_iso o d'))) / ell +
        (1 / 2) * ((∑ o, ∑ d', -(q_iso o d' * Real.log (q_iso o d' / (∑ o₁, q_iso o₁ d')))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2) * ((∑ o, (∑ d', q_iso o d') * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) +
        (1 / 2) * (∑ d', (∑ o, q_iso o d') * ((1 + γ) * b_min + (1 - γ) * b_min)) = _
      simp_rw [hO, hD]; rw [hHOD_iso, hEw_iso]; ring

    
    have h_OPD_le_OP : (∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_PD (P_of o) d))) ≤
        ∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o / q_P (P_of o))) := by
      let Q_prod : Fin N_O × Fin N_D → ℝ := fun od =>
        if 0 < q_P (P_of od.1) then q_PD (P_of od.1) od.2 * (q_O od.1 / q_P (P_of od.1)) else 0
      have hQ_nn : ∀ od, 0 ≤ Q_prod od := by
        intro od; dsimp only [Q_prod]
        split_ifs with hpos
        · exact mul_nonneg (hqPD_nn _ _) (div_nonneg (hqO_nn _) hpos.le)
        · exact le_rfl
      have hQ_sum : ∑ od : Fin N_O × Fin N_D, Q_prod od ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ P_of (fun o => ∑ d, Q_prod (o, d))]
        have h_ip : ∀ ip : Fin N_P,
            (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), ∑ d, Q_prod (o, d)) ≤ q_P ip := by
          intro ip
          by_cases hpos : 0 < q_P ip
          · have h_eq : ∀ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip),
                (∑ d, Q_prod (o, d)) = q_O o := by
              intro o ho
              have hpo := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2
              dsimp only [Q_prod]
              simp only [hpo, hpos, ↓reduceIte, ← Finset.sum_mul]
              change q_P ip * (q_O o / q_P ip) = q_O o
              field_simp [hpos.ne']
            rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_eq, hqP_eq ip]
          · have h_zero : ∀ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip),
                (∑ d, Q_prod (o, d)) = 0 := by
              intro o ho
              have hpo := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2
              dsimp only [Q_prod]; simp [hpo, hpos]
            rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
            exact hqP_nn ip
        exact le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ip _ => h_ip ip)) hqP_sum.le
      have hQ_pos : ∀ od : Fin N_O × Fin N_D, 0 < q od.1 od.2 → 0 < Q_prod od := by
        intro od hq_od
        have hqo : 0 < q_O od.1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hq_od
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d _ => hq_nn od.1 d) (Finset.mem_univ od.2))
        have hqpd : 0 < q_PD (P_of od.1) od.2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hq_od
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun o _ => hq_nn o od.2)
            (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ od.1, rfl⟩))
        have hqp : 0 < q_P (P_of od.1) := lt_of_lt_of_le hqpd
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d _ => hqPD_nn _ d) (Finset.mem_univ od.2))
        dsimp only [Q_prod]; simp only [hqp, ↓reduceIte]
        exact mul_pos hqpd (div_pos hqo hqp)
      have hg := h_gibbs (fun od : Fin N_O × Fin N_D => q od.1 od.2) Q_prod
        (fun od => hq_nn od.1 od.2) (by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; exact hq_sum)
        hQ_nn hQ_sum hQ_pos
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at hg
      have h_id : ∀ o d,
          -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_PD (P_of o) d)) -
          -(q o d * Real.log (q_O o / q_P (P_of o))) =
          q o d * Real.log (Q_prod (o, d) / q o d) := by
        intro o d
        by_cases h0 : q o d = 0
        · simp [h0]
        · have hq_od : 0 < q o d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq_nn o d) (Ne.symm h0)
          have hqo : 0 < q_O o := lt_of_lt_of_le hq_od
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hq_nn o d') (Finset.mem_univ d))
          have hqpd : 0 < q_PD (P_of o) d := lt_of_lt_of_le hq_od
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun o' _ => hq_nn o' d)
              (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, rfl⟩))
          have hqp : 0 < q_P (P_of o) := lt_of_lt_of_le hqpd
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hqPD_nn _ d') (Finset.mem_univ d))
          have hQp : Q_prod (o, d) = q_PD (P_of o) d * (q_O o / q_P (P_of o)) := by
            dsimp only [Q_prod]; simp [hqp]
          have hrat : Q_prod (o, d) / q o d =
              (q_O o / q_P (P_of o)) / (q o d / q_PD (P_of o) d) := by
            rw [hQp]; field_simp [hq_od.ne', hqpd.ne', hqp.ne']
          rw [hrat, Real.log_div (div_pos hqo hqp).ne' (div_pos hq_od hqpd).ne']; ring
      have h_sum_diff : (∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_PD (P_of o) d))) -
          (∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o / q_P (P_of o)))) =
          ∑ o, ∑ d, q o d * Real.log (Q_prod (o, d) / q o d) := by
        have h_r : (∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o / q_P (P_of o)))) =
            ∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q_O o / q_P (P_of o))) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
          simp only [q_O, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        rw [h_r, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_id o d)
      linarith

    
    let P_isoB : Fin N_iso → Fin N_B → ℝ := fun d' ib =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => d_of o = d' ∧ B_of (P_of o) = ib), q_O o

      intro d'
      dsimp only [P_isoB, q_iso_D]
      have h_flt : ∀ ib, Finset.univ.filter (fun o => d_of o = d' ∧ B_of (P_of o) = ib) =

      intro ib
