        simp_rw [hqP_eq]
        rw [← Finset.sum_biUnion]
        · congr 1; ext o; simp
        · intro x _ y _ hxy; change Disjoint _ _; rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
          intro o hox hoy; exact hxy ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hox).2.symm.trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hoy).2)
      rw [hqB_o]
      dsimp only [P_isoB]
      have h_flt : ∀ d', Finset.univ.filter (fun o => d_of o = d' ∧ B_of (P_of o) = ib) =
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun o => B_of (P_of o) = ib)).filter (fun o => d_of o = d') := by
        intro d'; ext o; simp [and_comm]
      simp_rw [h_flt]
      exact Finset.sum_fiberwise _ d_of q_O
    have hPiso_sum : ∑ d', ∑ ib, P_isoB d' ib = 1 := by
      simp_rw [hPiso_d]
      exact (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ d_of q_O).trans hq_sum
    have hH_Diso_B : (∑ d', ∑ ib, -(P_isoB d' ib * Real.log (P_isoB d' ib / q_B ib))) / ell ≤
        Real.log C_iso / ell + 6 * h := by
      have h_fib : letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ ib : Fin N_B, (0 < ∑ d', P_isoB d' ib) →
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun d' : Fin N_iso => 0 < P_isoB d' ib)).card : ℝ) ≤
              C_iso * ε ^ (-(6 * h)) := by
        intro ib _
        have hci := hcard_iso ib
        refine le_trans ?_ hci
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn g_iso
          (fun d' hd' => by
            have hpos := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd').2
            dsimp only [P_isoB] at hpos
            have hex : ∃ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => d_of o = d' ∧ B_of (P_of o) = ib), 0 < q_O o := by
              by_contra hall; push Not at hall
              exact hpos.ne' (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => le_antisymm (hall o ho) (hqO_nn o)))
            obtain ⟨o, ho, _⟩ := hex
            obtain ⟨_, hdo, hbo⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho
            rw [Finset.mem_coe, ← hdo, hg_dof o]
            exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem D_iso (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, hbo⟩))
          (fun x _ y _ hxy => e_iso.symm.injective (Subtype.ext hxy)))
      have hent := h_fib_ent hε₀ hε₁ P_isoB (mul_pos hC_iso (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ _))
        hPiso_nn hPiso_sum h_fib
      change (∑ d', ∑ ib, -(P_isoB d' ib * Real.log (P_isoB d' ib / (∑ d'', P_isoB d'' ib)))) / ell ≤
        Real.log (C_iso * ε ^ (-(6 * h))) / ell at hent
      simpa only [hPiso_b, h_log_eps_pow hC_iso] using hent

    have h11_8 : (∑ ip : Fin N_P, -(q_P ip * Real.log (q_P ip / q_B (B_of ip)))) / ell -
        (∑ ip : Fin N_P, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_PD ip d * Real.log (q_PD ip d / q_BD (B_of ip) d))) / ell ≤
        (1 - γ) * (a_ref - b_ref) + 6 * h + 4 * ζ_sh +
          (Real.log C_iso + Real.log C_BD) / ell + 2 * Δ'_q := by
      
      have e_PB := h_sh_fiber B_of q_P hqP_nn
      have e_OP := h_sh_fiber P_of q_O hqO_nn
      simp_rw [← hqP_eq] at e_OP
      have e_ODiso := h_sh_fiber d_of q_O hqO_nn
      have e_DisoB := h_sh_cond P_isoB hPiso_nn
      simp_rw [hPiso_b] at e_DisoB
      have h_dom_iso := h_sh_dom P_isoB hPiso_nn
      simp_rw [hPiso_d] at h_dom_iso
      have e_PD := h_sh_cond q_PD hqPD_nn
      simp_rw [hqPD_sum_ip] at e_PD
      have e_BD := h_sh_cond q_BD hqBD_nn
      simp_rw [hqBD_sum_ib] at e_BD
      have e_PDB := h_sh_fiber (fun pd : Fin N_P × Fin N_D => (B_of pd.1, pd.2))
        (fun pd => q_PD pd.1 pd.2) (fun pd => hqPD_nn pd.1 pd.2)
      have h_fb2 : ∀ bd : Fin N_B × Fin N_D,
          (∑ pd ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun pd : Fin N_P × Fin N_D => (B_of pd.1, pd.2) = bd), q_PD pd.1 pd.2) =
          q_BD bd.1 bd.2 := by
        intro bd
        rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        simp_rw [Prod.ext_iff]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_eq_single bd.2]
        · simp [q_BD, Finset.sum_filter]
        · intro d _ hd; simp [hd]
        · intro hm; exact False.elim (hm (Finset.mem_univ _))
      dsimp only at e_PDB
      simp_rw [h_fb2] at e_PDB
      simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at e_PDB
      have h_raw_diff :
          ((∑ ip, -(q_P ip * Real.log (q_P ip / q_B (B_of ip)))) -
           (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(q_PD ip d * Real.log (q_PD ip d / q_BD (B_of ip) d)))) ≤
          ((∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o / q_iso_D (d_of o)))) -
           (∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d)))) +
          (∑ d', ∑ ib, -(P_isoB d' ib * Real.log (P_isoB d' ib / q_B ib))) +
          (∑ ib, ∑ d, -(q_BD ib d * Real.log (q_BD ib d / q_D d))) := by
        dsimp only [q_B] at e_PB ⊢
        linarith [e_PB, e_OP, e_ODiso, e_DisoB, h_dom_iso, hHOD_chain, h_OPD_le_OP, e_PD, e_BD, e_PDB]
      have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_raw_diff hell_pos.le
      rw [sub_div, add_div, add_div, sub_div] at h_div
      have hsc_q := hq_score
      unfold generalPacketScore at hsc_q
      change S_cap - Δ'_q ≤ (∑ o, -(q_O o * Real.log (q_O o))) / ell +
        (1 / 2) * ((∑ o, ∑ d, -(q o d * Real.log (q o d / q_D d))) / ell) +
        (3 / 2) * ((∑ o, q_O o * Real.log
          (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell) +
        (1 / 2) * (∑ d, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) at hsc_q
      rw [h_sc_iso] at h_ub_iso
      have hlog_add : (Real.log C_iso + Real.log C_BD) / ell =
          Real.log C_iso / ell + Real.log C_BD / ell := add_div _ _ _
      rw [hlog_add]
      linarith [h_div, h_ub_iso, hsc_q, hEw_q, hb_min_ref, hH_Diso_B, hH_BD_le]

    exact ⟨h11_7, h11_8, hH_BD_le⟩

  
  have hπA_le : π_A ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    by_contra hgt
    have hπA_gt : 1 / 4 < π_A := lt_of_not_ge hgt
    have hπA_pos : 0 < π_A := by linarith
    let Pi_tilde : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ =>
      @ite ℝ (Sep d₁ d₂) (decSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0 / π_A
    let p_tilde : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun o₁ d₁ => ∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, Pi_tilde o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂
    have hPit_nn : ∀ o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂, 0 ≤ Pi_tilde o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ := by
      intro o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂; dsimp only [Pi_tilde]
      refine div_nonneg ?_ hπA_pos.le
      by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂ <;> simp [decSep, hs, hPi_nn]
    have hPit_symm : ∀ o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂, Pi_tilde o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ = Pi_tilde o₂ d₂ o₁ d₁ := by
      intro o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂; dsimp only [Pi_tilde]
      have hs_iff : Sep d₁ d₂ ↔ Sep d₂ d₁ := ⟨hSep_symm d₁ d₂, hSep_symm d₂ d₁⟩
      by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂
      · have hs' := hs_iff.mp hs
        simp [decSep, hs, hs', hPi_symm o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂]
      · have hs' : ¬ Sep d₂ d₁ := fun h => hs (hs_iff.mpr h)
        simp [decSep, hs, hs']
    have hpt_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_tilde o d :=
      fun o d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₂ _ => hPit_nn o d o₂ d₂))
    have hpt_sum : ∑ o, ∑ d, p_tilde o d = 1 := by
      dsimp only [p_tilde, Pi_tilde]
      simp_rw [← Finset.sum_div]
      exact div_self hπA_pos.ne'
    have hpt_supp : ∀ o d, 0 < p_tilde o d → 0 < p o d := by
      intro o d hpt
      by_contra hnp
      have hp0 : p o d = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnp) (hp_nn o d)
      have h0 : p_tilde o d = 0 := by
        dsimp only [p_tilde, Pi_tilde, Pi_law]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d₂ _ => ?_))
        by_cases hs : Sep d d₂
        · rw [if_pos hs]
          by_cases hc : P_of o = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o)
          · rw [if_pos hc, hp0]; ring
          · rw [if_neg hc]; ring
        · rw [if_neg hs]; ring
      linarith

    
    let Δ'_pt := 4 * Δ_p + (6 * Real.log 2) / ell
    have hlog2_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    have hpt_score : S_cap - Δ'_pt ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_tilde := by
      by_cases hcomp0 : π_comp = 0
      · have hπA1 : π_A = 1 := by linarith [hπ_tot, hcomp0]
        have hall_zero : ∀ o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂,
            @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0 = 0 := by
          intro o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂
          have hs1 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun o₁' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₁' _ =>
            Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₂' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₂' _ => by
              by_cases hs : Sep d₁' d₂' <;> simp [decNotSep, hs, hPi_nn]))))).mp hcomp0 o₁ (Finset.mem_univ _)
          have hs2 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun d₁' _ =>
            Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₂' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₂' _ => by
              by_cases hs : Sep d₁' d₂' <;> simp [decNotSep, hs, hPi_nn])))).mp hs1 d₁ (Finset.mem_univ _)
          have hs3 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun o₂' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₂' _ => by
              by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂' <;> simp [decNotSep, hs, hPi_nn]))).mp hs2 o₂ (Finset.mem_univ _)
          exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun d₂' _ => by
              by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂' <;> simp [decNotSep, hs, hPi_nn])).mp hs3 d₂ (Finset.mem_univ _)
        have hpt_eq_p : p_tilde = p := by
          ext o₁ d₁
          dsimp only [p_tilde, Pi_tilde]
          rw [hπA1]
          have h_term : ∀ o₂ d₂,
              @ite ℝ (Sep d₁ d₂) (decSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0 / 1 = Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂ := by
            intro o₂ d₂
            have hz := hall_zero o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂
            by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂ <;> simp [decSep, decNotSep, hs] at hz ⊢ <;> linarith
          simp_rw [h_term, hPi_marg1]
        rw [hpt_eq_p]
        have hpos_log : 0 ≤ (6 * Real.log 2) / ell := div_nonneg (by positivity) hell_pos.le
        dsimp only [Δ'_pt]; linarith [hp_score, hΔ_p_nn, hpos_log]
      · have hπcomp_pos : 0 < π_comp := lt_of_le_of_ne hπcomp_nn (Ne.symm hcomp0)
        let p_prox : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun o₁ d₁ =>
          (∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0) / π_comp
        have hpprox_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_prox o d := by
          intro o d; dsimp only [p_prox]
          refine div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₂ _ => ?_))) hπcomp_pos.le
          by_cases hs : Sep d d₂ <;> simp [decNotSep, hs, hPi_nn]
        have hpprox_sum : ∑ o, ∑ d, p_prox o d = 1 := by
          dsimp only [p_prox]; simp_rw [← Finset.sum_div]; exact div_self hπcomp_pos.ne'
        have hpprox_supp : ∀ o d, 0 < p_prox o d → 0 < p o d := by
          intro o d hpp
          by_contra hnp
          have hp0 : p o d = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnp) (hp_nn o d)
          have h0 : p_prox o d = 0 := by
            dsimp only [p_prox, Pi_law]
            have hs0 : (∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d d₂) (decNotSep d d₂)
                (@ite ℝ (P_of o = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o)) (decCond o o₂)
                  (p o d * p o₂ d₂ / p_P (P_of o)) 0) 0) = 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d₂ _ => ?_))
              by_cases hns : ¬ Sep d d₂
              · rw [if_pos hns]
                by_cases hc : P_of o = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o)
                · rw [if_pos hc, hp0]; ring
                · rw [if_neg hc]
              · rw [if_neg hns]
            rw [hs0, zero_div]
          linarith
        have hconv : ∀ o d, p o d = π_A * p_tilde o d + π_comp * p_prox o d := by
          intro o₁ d₁
          dsimp only [p_tilde, Pi_tilde, p_prox]
          simp_rw [← Finset.sum_div]
          rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hπA_pos.ne', mul_div_cancel₀ _ hπcomp_pos.ne', ← hPi_marg1 o₁ d₁]
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₂ _ => ?_)
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₂ _ => ?_)
          by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂ <;> simp [decSep, decNotSep, hs]
        have hqc := h_score_qconc π_A π_comp p_tilde p_prox hπA_pos hπcomp_pos hπ_tot
          hpt_nn hpt_sum hpprox_nn hpprox_sum hconv
        have hub_pt := hp_adm_sub p_tilde hpt_nn hpt_sum hpt_supp
        have hub_pr := hp_adm_sub p_prox hpprox_nn hpprox_sum hpprox_supp
        have h_mul_pr : π_comp * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_prox ≤
            π_comp * S_cap := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hub_pr hπcomp_pos.le
        have hπ_Scap : π_A * S_cap + π_comp * S_cap = S_cap := by
          rw [← add_mul, hπ_tot, one_mul]
        have h_gap_nn : 0 ≤ S_cap - generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_tilde :=
          sub_nonneg.mpr hub_pt
        have h_piA_gap : (1 / 4) * (S_cap - generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_tilde) ≤
            π_A * (S_cap - generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p_tilde) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hπA_gt.le h_gap_nn
        have h_four_log : 4 * ((3 * Real.log 2) / (2 * ell)) = (6 * Real.log 2) / ell := by
          field_simp [hell_pos.ne']; ring
        dsimp only [Δ'_pt]
        linarith [hp_score, hqc, h_mul_pr, hπ_Scap, h_piA_gap, h_four_log]

    obtain ⟨h_s2_1, h_s2_2, h_s2_3⟩ := h_s2 p_tilde Δ'_pt hpt_nn hpt_sum hpt_supp hpt_score

    
    let w : Fin N_P → Fin N_D → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun ip d₁ d₂ =>
      ∑ o₁ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o₁ => P_of o₁ = ip),
        ∑ o₂ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o₂ => P_of o₂ = ip), Pi_tilde o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂
    let w_PD : Fin N_P → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun ip d =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), p_tilde o d
    let w_P : Fin N_P → ℝ := fun ip => ∑ d, w_PD ip d
    let w_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ ip, w_PD ip d
    let w_BD : Fin N_B → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun ib d =>
      ∑ ip ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ip => B_of ip = ib), w_PD ip d
    let w_B : Fin N_B → ℝ := fun ib =>
      ∑ ip ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ip => B_of ip = ib), w_P ip
    let w_DD : Fin N_D → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d₁ d₂ => ∑ ip, w ip d₁ d₂
    let w_BDD : Fin N_B → Fin N_D → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun ib d₁ d₂ =>
      ∑ ip ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ip => B_of ip = ib), w ip d₁ d₂

    have hw_nn : ∀ ip d₁ d₂, 0 ≤ w ip d₁ d₂ :=
      fun ip d₁ d₂ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₁ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₂ _ => hPit_nn o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂))
    have hw_symm : ∀ ip d₁ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ = w ip d₂ d₁ := by
      intro ip d₁ d₂; dsimp only [w]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₁ _ => hPit_symm o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂))
    have hw_marg1 : ∀ ip d₁, (∑ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂) = w_PD ip d₁ := by
      intro ip d₁; dsimp only [w, w_PD, p_tilde]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₁ ho₁ => ?_)
      have hpo1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho₁).2
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₂ _ => ?_)
      by_cases hpo2 : P_of o₂ = ip
      · rw [if_pos hpo2]
      · have hc : ¬ (P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)) :=
          fun h => hpo2 (h.1.symm.trans hpo1)
        rw [if_neg hpo2]
        refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d₂ _ => ?_)).symm
        dsimp only [Pi_tilde, Pi_law]
        by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂
        · rw [if_pos hs, if_neg hc, zero_div]
        · rw [if_neg hs, zero_div]
    have hw_marg2 : ∀ ip d₂, (∑ d₁, w ip d₁ d₂) = w_PD ip d₂ := by
      intro ip d₂; simp_rw [hw_symm ip _ d₂]; exact hw_marg1 ip d₂
    have hwPD_nn : ∀ ip d, 0 ≤ w_PD ip d := fun ip d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hpt_nn o d)
    have hwP_nn : ∀ ip, 0 ≤ w_P ip := fun ip => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hwPD_nn ip d)
    have hwBD_nn : ∀ ib d, 0 ≤ w_BD ib d := fun ib d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ip _ => hwPD_nn ip d)
    have hwB_nn : ∀ ib, 0 ≤ w_B ib := fun ib => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ip _ => hwP_nn ip)
    have hwBDD_nn : ∀ ib d₁ d₂, 0 ≤ w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ :=
      fun ib d₁ d₂ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ip _ => hw_nn ip d₁ d₂)
    have hwPD_sum : ∑ ip, ∑ d, w_PD ip d = 1 := by
      dsimp only [w_PD]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have hf : ∀ d, (∑ ip, ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), p_tilde o d) = ∑ o, p_tilde o d :=
        fun d => Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ P_of (fun o => p_tilde o d)
      simp_rw [hf]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact hpt_sum
    have hwP_sum : ∑ ip, w_P ip = 1 := hwPD_sum
    have hw_sum : ∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ = 1 := by simp_rw [hw_marg1]; exact hwPD_sum
    have hwBDD_sum_ib : ∀ d₁ d₂, (∑ ib, w_BDD ib d₁ d₂) = w_DD d₁ d₂ :=
      fun d₁ d₂ => Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ B_of (fun ip => w ip d₁ d₂)
    have hwBDD_sum : ∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun ib d₂ => w_BDD ib _ d₂), hwBDD_sum_ib]
      have h1 : (∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w_DD d₁ d₂) = ∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ := by
        dsimp only [w_DD]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ => Finset.sum_comm), Finset.sum_comm]
      rw [h1]; exact hw_sum

    
    let decSepP := fun ip d₁ d₂ => Classical.propDecidable (Sep d₁ d₂ ∧ 0 < p_P ip)
    have hw_formula : ∀ ip d₁ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ =
        @ite ℝ (Sep d₁ d₂ ∧ 0 < p_P ip) (decSepP ip d₁ d₂)
          ((p_PD ip d₁ * p_PD ip d₂) / (p_P ip * π_A)) 0 := by
      intro ip d₁ d₂
      dsimp only [w, Pi_tilde, Pi_law]
      by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d₂
      · by_cases hpP_pos : 0 < p_P ip
        · have hsp : Sep d₁ d₂ ∧ 0 < p_P ip := ⟨hs, hpP_pos⟩
          rw [if_pos hsp]
          have h_inner : ∀ o₁ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o₁ => P_of o₁ = ip),
              ∀ o₂ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o₂ => P_of o₂ = ip),
              @ite ℝ (Sep d₁ d₂) (decSep d₁ d₂)
                (@ite ℝ (P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)) (decCond o₁ o₂)
                  (p o₁ d₁ * p o₂ d₂ / p_P (P_of o₁)) 0) 0 / π_A =
              (p o₁ d₁ * p o₂ d₂) / (p_P ip * π_A) := by
            intro o₁ ho₁ o₂ ho₂
            have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho₁).2
            have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho₂).2
            have hc : P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁) := ⟨h1.trans h2.symm, h1 ▸ hpP_pos⟩
            rw [if_pos hs, if_pos hc, h1, div_div]
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₁ ho₁ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₂ ho₂ => h_inner o₁ ho₁ o₂ ho₂))]
          simp_rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
          rfl
        · have hsp : ¬ (Sep d₁ d₂ ∧ 0 < p_P ip) := fun h => hpP_pos h.2
          rw [if_neg hsp]
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₁ ho₁ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₂ _ => ?_))
          have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho₁).2
          have hc : ¬ (P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)) := fun h => hpP_pos (h1 ▸ h.2)
          rw [if_pos hs, if_neg hc, zero_div]
      · have hsp : ¬ (Sep d₁ d₂ ∧ 0 < p_P ip) := fun h => hs h.1
        rw [if_neg hsp]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₁ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₂ _ => ?_))
        rw [if_neg hs, zero_div]

    
    have hH_PDD_le : (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂ / w_DD d₁ d₂))) / ell ≤
        Real.log B_sep / ell := by
      let P_PDD : Fin N_P → Fin (N_D * N_D) → ℝ := fun ip y =>
        let dd := finProdFinEquiv.symm y
        w ip dd.1 dd.2
      have hPP_nn : ∀ ip y, 0 ≤ P_PDD ip y := fun ip y => hw_nn ip _ _
      have hPP_Y : ∀ y, (∑ ip, P_PDD ip y) = w_DD (finProdFinEquiv.symm y).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm y).2 :=
        fun _ => rfl
      have hPP_sum : ∑ ip, ∑ y, P_PDD ip y = 1 := by
        have h1 : ∀ ip, (∑ y, P_PDD ip y) = ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ := by
          intro ip
          dsimp only [P_PDD]
          rw [Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv.symm (fun dd => w ip dd.1 dd.2), Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        simp_rw [h1]; exact hw_sum
      have hPP_ent : (∑ ip, ∑ y, -(P_PDD ip y * Real.log (P_PDD ip y / (∑ ip', P_PDD ip' y)))) =
          ∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂ / w_DD d₁ d₂)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ip _ => ?_)
        simp_rw [hPP_Y]
        dsimp only [P_PDD]
        rw [Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv.symm (fun dd =>
          -(w ip dd.1 dd.2 * Real.log (w ip dd.1 dd.2 / w_DD dd.1 dd.2))), Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      have hPP_fib : letI := Classical.propDecidable
          ∀ y : Fin (N_D * N_D), (0 < ∑ ip, P_PDD ip y) →
            ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ip : Fin N_P => 0 < P_PDD ip y)).card : ℝ) ≤ B_sep := by
        intro y hy_pos
        let dd := finProdFinEquiv.symm y
        change 0 < ∑ ip, w ip dd.1 dd.2 at hy_pos
        have hex_ip : ∃ ip, 0 < w ip dd.1 dd.2 := by
          by_contra hall; push Not at hall
          exact hy_pos.ne' (Finset.sum_eq_zero (s := Finset.univ)
            (fun ip _ => le_antisymm (hall ip) (hw_nn ip dd.1 dd.2)))
        obtain ⟨ip₀, hip₀⟩ := hex_ip
        have hs_dd : Sep dd.1 dd.2 := by
          rw [hw_formula] at hip₀
          by_contra hns
          have hsp : ¬ (Sep dd.1 dd.2 ∧ 0 < p_P ip₀) := fun h => hns h.1
          rw [if_neg hsp] at hip₀
          exact lt_irrefl 0 hip₀
        have hsf := h_sep_fib dd.1 dd.2 hs_dd
        refine le_trans ?_ hsf
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (fun ip hip => by
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hip ⊢
          have hw_pos : 0 < w ip dd.1 dd.2 := hip.2
          rw [hw_formula] at hw_pos
          by_cases hpP_pos : 0 < p_P ip
          · have hsp : Sep dd.1 dd.2 ∧ 0 < p_P ip := ⟨hs_dd, hpP_pos⟩
            rw [if_pos hsp] at hw_pos
            have hnum : 0 < p_PD ip dd.1 * p_PD ip dd.2 :=
              (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (mul_pos hpP_pos hπA_pos)).mp hw_pos
            have hnn1 := hpPD_nn ip dd.1
            have hnn2 := hpPD_nn ip dd.2
            have hp1 : 0 < p_PD ip dd.1 := by nlinarith only [hnum, hnn1, hnn2]
            have hp2 : 0 < p_PD ip dd.2 := by nlinarith only [hnum, hnn1, hnn2]
            dsimp only [p_PD] at hp1 hp2
            have ex1 : ∃ o, 0 < p o dd.1 ∧ P_of o = ip := by
              by_contra hall; push Not at hall
              exact hp1.ne' (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho =>
                le_antisymm (by by_cases hp : 0 < p o dd.1
                                · exact False.elim (hall o hp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2)
                                · linarith) (hp_nn o dd.1)))
            have ex2 : ∃ o', 0 < p o' dd.2 ∧ P_of o' = ip := by
              by_contra hall; push Not at hall
              exact hp2.ne' (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o' ho' =>
                le_antisymm (by by_cases hp : 0 < p o' dd.2
                                · exact False.elim (hall o' hp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho').2)
                                · linarith) (hp_nn o' dd.2)))
            exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ ip, ex1, ex2⟩
          · have hsp : ¬ (Sep dd.1 dd.2 ∧ 0 < p_P ip) := fun h => hpP_pos h.2
            rw [if_neg hsp] at hw_pos
            exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 hw_pos))
      have hent := h_fib_ent hε₀ hε₁ P_PDD hB_sep hPP_nn hPP_sum hPP_fib
      change (∑ ip, ∑ y, -(P_PDD ip y * Real.log (P_PDD ip y / (∑ ip', P_PDD ip' y)))) / ell ≤
        Real.log B_sep / ell at hent
      rwa [hPP_ent] at hent

    
    have hI_raw_le :
        2 * (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d))) -
        (∑ ip, -(w_P ip * Real.log (w_P ip))) -
        (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂))) ≤ Real.log 4 := by
      let decP := fun ip => Classical.propDecidable (0 < p_P ip)
      let Q₁ : Fin N_P × Fin N_D → ℝ := fun pd =>
        @ite ℝ (0 < p_P pd.1) (decP pd.1) (w_P pd.1 * (p_PD pd.1 pd.2 / p_P pd.1)) 0
      let Q₂ : Fin N_P × Fin N_D → ℝ := fun pd => p_PD pd.1 pd.2
      have hQ₁_nn : ∀ pd, 0 ≤ Q₁ pd := by
        intro pd; dsimp only [Q₁]
        by_cases hp : 0 < p_P pd.1
        · rw [if_pos hp]
          exact mul_nonneg (hwP_nn _) (div_nonneg (hpPD_nn _ _) hp.le)
        · rw [if_neg hp]
      have hQ₁_sum : ∑ pd, Q₁ pd ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        have h_ip : ∀ ip, (∑ d, Q₁ (ip, d)) ≤ w_P ip := by
          intro ip; dsimp only [Q₁]
          by_cases hp : 0 < p_P ip
          · simp_rw [if_pos hp, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div]
            change (w_P ip * (p_P ip / p_P ip)) ≤ w_P ip
            rw [div_self hp.ne', mul_one]
          · simp_rw [if_neg hp]; simp [hwP_nn ip]
        exact le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ip _ => h_ip ip)) hwP_sum.le
      have hQ₂_sum : ∑ pd, Q₂ pd ≤ 1 := by
        dsimp only [Q₂, p_PD]
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
        have hf : ∀ d, (∑ ip, ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip), p o d) = ∑ o, p o d :=
          fun d => Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ P_of (fun o => p o d)
        simp_rw [hf]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact hp_sum.le
      have hwPD_supp : ∀ pd : Fin N_P × Fin N_D, 0 < w_PD pd.1 pd.2 →
          0 < w_P pd.1 ∧ 0 < p_PD pd.1 pd.2 ∧ 0 < p_P pd.1 := by
        intro pd hpos
        have hwp : 0 < w_P pd.1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d _ => hwPD_nn pd.1 d) (Finset.mem_univ pd.2))
        dsimp only [w_PD] at hpos
        have hex : ∃ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = pd.1), 0 < p_tilde o pd.2 := by
          by_contra hall; push Not at hall
          exact hpos.ne' (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o ho => le_antisymm (hall o ho) (hpt_nn o pd.2)))
        obtain ⟨o, ho, hpto⟩ := hex
        have hppd : 0 < p_PD pd.1 pd.2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (hpt_supp o pd.2 hpto)
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun o' _ => hp_nn o' pd.2) ho)
        have hpp : 0 < p_P pd.1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hppd
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d _ => hpPD_nn pd.1 d) (Finset.mem_univ pd.2))
        exact ⟨hwp, hppd, hpp⟩
      have hg₁ := h_gibbs (fun pd : Fin N_P × Fin N_D => w_PD pd.1 pd.2) Q₁
        (fun pd => hwPD_nn pd.1 pd.2) (by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; exact hwPD_sum)
        hQ₁_nn hQ₁_sum (fun pd hpos => by
          obtain ⟨hwp, hppd, hpp⟩ := hwPD_supp pd hpos
          dsimp only [Q₁]; rw [if_pos hpp]; exact mul_pos hwp (div_pos hppd hpp))
      have hg₂ := h_gibbs (fun pd : Fin N_P × Fin N_D => w_PD pd.1 pd.2) Q₂
        (fun pd => hwPD_nn pd.1 pd.2) (by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; exact hwPD_sum)
        (fun pd => hpPD_nn pd.1 pd.2) hQ₂_sum (fun pd hpos => (hwPD_supp pd hpos).2.1)
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at hg₁ hg₂
      have s_pd1 : (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, -(w_PD ip d₁ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₁))) =
          ∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₁)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ip _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ => ?_))
        rw [← hw_marg1 ip d₁, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have s_pd2 : (∑ ip, ∑ d₂, -(w_PD ip d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₂))) =
          ∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₂)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ip _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun d₁ d₂ => -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₂)))]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₂ _ => ?_)
        rw [← hw_marg2 ip d₂, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have s_p : (∑ ip, -(w_P ip * Real.log (w_P ip))) =
          ∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_P ip)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ip _ => ?_)
        have hwP_w : w_P ip = ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ := by dsimp only [w_P]; simp_rw [hw_marg1]
        rw [hwP_w]; simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have s_kl1 : (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, w_PD ip d₁ * Real.log (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁)) =
          ∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ip _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ => ?_))
        rw [← hw_marg1 ip d₁, Finset.sum_mul]
      have s_kl2 : (∑ ip, ∑ d₂, w_PD ip d₂ * Real.log (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂)) =
          ∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ip _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun d₁ d₂ => w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂))]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₂ _ => ?_)
        rw [← hw_marg2 ip d₂, Finset.sum_mul]
      have s_const : (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (1 / π_A)) = Real.log (1 / π_A) := by
        simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hw_sum, one_mul]
      have h_pt_id : ∀ ip d₁ d₂,
          (-(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₁)) + -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₂)) -
           -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_P ip)) - -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂))) =
          w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (1 / π_A) +
          w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁) +
          w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂) := by
        intro ip d₁ d₂
        by_cases hw0 : w ip d₁ d₂ = 0
        · simp [hw0]
        · have hw_pos : 0 < w ip d₁ d₂ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hw_nn ip d₁ d₂) (Ne.symm hw0)
          have hpd1_pos : 0 < w_PD ip d₁ := by
            rw [← hw_marg1 ip d₁]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hw_pos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d₂' _ => hw_nn ip d₁ d₂') (Finset.mem_univ d₂))
          have hpd2_pos : 0 < w_PD ip d₂ := by
            rw [← hw_marg2 ip d₂]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hw_pos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d₁' _ => hw_nn ip d₁' d₂) (Finset.mem_univ d₁))
          obtain ⟨hwp_pos, hppd1, hpp_pos⟩ := hwPD_supp (ip, d₁) hpd1_pos
          have hppd2 := (hwPD_supp (ip, d₂) hpd2_pos).2.1
          have hw_eq : w ip d₁ d₂ = (p_PD ip d₁ * p_PD ip d₂) / (p_P ip * π_A) := by
            have hf := hw_formula ip d₁ d₂
            by_cases hc : Sep d₁ d₂ ∧ 0 < p_P ip
            · rwa [if_pos hc] at hf
            · rw [if_neg hc] at hf; exact False.elim (hw0 hf)
          have hQ₁_eq : Q₁ (ip, d₁) = w_P ip * (p_PD ip d₁ / p_P ip) := by
            dsimp only [Q₁]; rw [if_pos hpp_pos]
          have h_prod_eq : (w ip d₁ d₂ * w_P ip) / (w_PD ip d₁ * w_PD ip d₂) =
              (1 / π_A) * (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁) * (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂) := by
            rw [hw_eq, hQ₁_eq]; dsimp only [Q₂]
            field_simp [hpp_pos.ne', hπA_pos.ne', hpd1_pos.ne', hpd2_pos.ne']
          have hl1 : Real.log ((w ip d₁ d₂ * w_P ip) / (w_PD ip d₁ * w_PD ip d₂)) =
              Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂) + Real.log (w_P ip) - Real.log (w_PD ip d₁) - Real.log (w_PD ip d₂) := by
            rw [Real.log_div (mul_pos hw_pos hwp_pos).ne' (mul_pos hpd1_pos hpd2_pos).ne',
                Real.log_mul hw_pos.ne' hwp_pos.ne', Real.log_mul hpd1_pos.ne' hpd2_pos.ne']
            ring
          have hl2 : Real.log ((1 / π_A) * (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁) * (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂)) =
              Real.log (1 / π_A) + Real.log (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁) + Real.log (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂) := by
            have hq1_pos : 0 < Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁ := by
              rw [hQ₁_eq]; exact div_pos (mul_pos hwp_pos (div_pos hppd1 hpp_pos)) hpd1_pos
            have hq2_pos : 0 < Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂ := div_pos hppd2 hpd2_pos
            rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hπA_pos) hq1_pos).ne' hq2_pos.ne',
                Real.log_mul (one_div_pos.mpr hπA_pos).ne' hq1_pos.ne']
          have hl_eq : Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂) + Real.log (w_P ip) - Real.log (w_PD ip d₁) - Real.log (w_PD ip d₂) =
              Real.log (1 / π_A) + Real.log (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁) + Real.log (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂) := by
            rw [← hl1, h_prod_eq, hl2]
          calc -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₁)) + -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₂)) -
               -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_P ip)) - -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂))
              = w ip d₁ d₂ * (Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂) + Real.log (w_P ip) - Real.log (w_PD ip d₁) - Real.log (w_PD ip d₂)) := by ring
            _ = w ip d₁ d₂ * (Real.log (1 / π_A) + Real.log (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁) + Real.log (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂)) := by rw [hl_eq]
            _ = _ := by ring
      have h_id_sum : 2 * (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d))) -
          (∑ ip, -(w_P ip * Real.log (w_P ip))) -
          (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂))) =
          Real.log (1 / π_A) +
          (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, w_PD ip d₁ * Real.log (Q₁ (ip, d₁) / w_PD ip d₁)) +
          (∑ ip, ∑ d₂, w_PD ip d₂ * Real.log (Q₂ (ip, d₂) / w_PD ip d₂)) := by
        have h_two : 2 * (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d))) =
            (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₁))) +
            (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_PD ip d₂))) := by
          rw [← s_pd1, ← s_pd2]; ring
        rw [h_two, s_p, s_kl1, s_kl2, ← s_const]
        simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ip _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ =>
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₂ _ => h_pt_id ip d₁ d₂)))
      have hlog4 : Real.log (1 / π_A) ≤ Real.log 4 :=
        Real.log_le_log (one_div_pos.mpr hπA_pos) (by rw [div_le_iff₀ hπA_pos]; linarith)
      linarith [h_id_sum, hg₁, hg₂, hlog4]

    
    have hBDD_neg_mi :
        (∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BDD ib d₁ d₂))) +
        (∑ ib, -(w_B ib * Real.log (w_B ib))) -
        2 * (∑ ib, ∑ d, -(w_BD ib d * Real.log (w_BD ib d))) ≤ 0 := by
      let decWB := fun ib => Classical.propDecidable (0 < w_B ib)
      let Q_BDD : Fin N_B × Fin N_D × Fin N_D → ℝ := fun t_idx =>
        @ite ℝ (0 < w_B t_idx.1) (decWB t_idx.1)
          (w_BD t_idx.1 t_idx.2.1 * (w_BD t_idx.1 t_idx.2.2 / w_B t_idx.1)) 0
      have hwBD_sum_d : ∀ ib, (∑ d, w_BD ib d) = w_B ib := fun _ => Finset.sum_comm
      have hQB_nn : ∀ t_idx, 0 ≤ Q_BDD t_idx := by
        intro t_idx; dsimp only [Q_BDD]
        by_cases hb : 0 < w_B t_idx.1
        · rw [if_pos hb]
          exact mul_nonneg (hwBD_nn _ _) (div_nonneg (hwBD_nn _ _) hb.le)
        · rw [if_neg hb]
      have hQB_sum : ∑ t_idx, Q_BDD t_idx ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ib _ => Fintype.sum_prod_type _)]
        have h_ib : ∀ ib, (∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, Q_BDD (ib, d₁, d₂)) ≤ w_B ib := by
          intro ib; dsimp only [Q_BDD]
          by_cases hb : 0 < w_B ib
          · simp_rw [if_pos hb, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_div, hwBD_sum_d]
            rw [div_self hb.ne', mul_one]
          · simp_rw [if_neg hb]; simp [hwB_nn ib]
        have hwB_tot : ∑ ib, w_B ib = 1 :=
          (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ B_of w_P).trans hwP_sum
        exact le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ib _ => h_ib ib)) hwB_tot.le
      have hBDD_supp : ∀ ib d₁ d₂, 0 < w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ →
          0 < w_BD ib d₁ ∧ 0 < w_BD ib d₂ ∧ 0 < w_B ib := by
        intro ib d₁ d₂ hpos
        have hm1 : 0 < ∑ d₂', w_BDD ib d₁ d₂' := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d₂' _ => hwBDD_nn ib d₁ d₂') (Finset.mem_univ d₂))
        have hm1_eq : (∑ d₂', w_BDD ib d₁ d₂') = w_BD ib d₁ := by
          dsimp only [w_BDD, w_BD]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hw_marg1]
        rw [hm1_eq] at hm1
        have hm2 : 0 < ∑ d₁', w_BDD ib d₁' d₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d₁' _ => hwBDD_nn ib d₁' d₂) (Finset.mem_univ d₁))
        have hm2_eq : (∑ d₁', w_BDD ib d₁' d₂) = w_BD ib d₂ := by
          dsimp only [w_BDD, w_BD]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hw_marg2]
        rw [hm2_eq] at hm2
        have hwb : 0 < w_B ib := by
          rw [← hwBD_sum_d ib]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hm1 (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d _ => hwBD_nn ib d) (Finset.mem_univ d₁))
        exact ⟨hm1, hm2, hwb⟩
      have hgB := h_gibbs (fun t_idx : Fin N_B × Fin N_D × Fin N_D => w_BDD t_idx.1 t_idx.2.1 t_idx.2.2) Q_BDD
        (fun t_idx => hwBDD_nn t_idx.1 t_idx.2.1 t_idx.2.2)
        (by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ib _ => Fintype.sum_prod_type _)]; exact hwBDD_sum)
        hQB_nn hQB_sum (fun t_idx hpos => by
          obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hBDD_supp t_idx.1 t_idx.2.1 t_idx.2.2 hpos
          dsimp only [Q_BDD]; rw [if_pos h3]; exact mul_pos h1 (div_pos h2 h3))
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ib _ => Fintype.sum_prod_type _)] at hgB
      have s_bd1 : (∑ ib, ∑ d₁, -(w_BD ib d₁ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₁))) =
          ∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₁)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ib _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ => ?_))
        have hm : w_BD ib d₁ = ∑ d₂, w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ := by
          dsimp only [w_BDD, w_BD]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hw_marg1]
        rw [hm, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have s_bd2 : (∑ ib, ∑ d₂, -(w_BD ib d₂ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₂))) =
          ∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₂)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ib _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun d₁ d₂ => -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₂)))]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₂ _ => ?_)
        have hm : w_BD ib d₂ = ∑ d₁, w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ := by
          dsimp only [w_BDD, w_BD]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hw_marg2]
        rw [hm, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have s_wb : (∑ ib, -(w_B ib * Real.log (w_B ib))) =
          ∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_B ib)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ib _ => ?_)
        have hm : w_B ib = ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ := by
          rw [← hwBD_sum_d ib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ => ?_)
          dsimp only [w_BDD, w_BD]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hw_marg1]
        rw [hm]; simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have h_pt_B : ∀ ib d₁ d₂,
          -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BDD ib d₁ d₂)) + -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_B ib)) -
          -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₁)) - -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₂)) =
          w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (Q_BDD (ib, d₁, d₂) / w_BDD ib d₁ d₂) := by
        intro ib d₁ d₂
        by_cases h0 : w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ = 0
        · simp [h0]
        · have hpos : 0 < w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hwBDD_nn ib d₁ d₂) (Ne.symm h0)
          obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hBDD_supp ib d₁ d₂ hpos
          have hQ_eq : Q_BDD (ib, d₁, d₂) = w_BD ib d₁ * (w_BD ib d₂ / w_B ib) := by
            dsimp only [Q_BDD]; rw [if_pos h3]
          have hrat : Q_BDD (ib, d₁, d₂) / w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ =
              (w_BD ib d₁ * w_BD ib d₂) / (w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * w_B ib) := by
            rw [hQ_eq]; field_simp [hpos.ne', h3.ne']
          rw [hrat, Real.log_div (mul_pos h1 h2).ne' (mul_pos hpos h3).ne',
              Real.log_mul h1.ne' h2.ne', Real.log_mul hpos.ne' h3.ne']
          ring
      have h_id_B : (∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BDD ib d₁ d₂))) +
          (∑ ib, -(w_B ib * Real.log (w_B ib))) -
          2 * (∑ ib, ∑ d, -(w_BD ib d * Real.log (w_BD ib d))) =
          ∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (Q_BDD (ib, d₁, d₂) / w_BDD ib d₁ d₂) := by
        have h_two : 2 * (∑ ib, ∑ d, -(w_BD ib d * Real.log (w_BD ib d))) =
            (∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₁))) +
            (∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BD ib d₂))) := by
          rw [← s_bd1, ← s_bd2]; ring
        rw [h_two, s_wb]
        simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ib _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ =>
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₂ _ => by linarith [h_pt_B ib d₁ d₂])))
      linarith

    
    have h_dom_BDD : (∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_DD d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_DD d₁ d₂))) ≤
        ∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BDD ib d₁ d₂)) := by
      have hd := h_sh_dom (fun (dd : Fin N_D × Fin N_D) (ib : Fin N_B) => w_BDD ib dd.1 dd.2)
        (fun dd ib => hwBDD_nn ib dd.1 dd.2)
      simp_rw [hwBDD_sum_ib] at hd
      simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at hd
      have hcomm : (∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, ∑ ib, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BDD ib d₁ d₂))) =
          ∑ ib, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_BDD ib d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_BDD ib d₁ d₂)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ => Finset.sum_comm), Finset.sum_comm]
      rwa [hcomm] at hd

    have e_wPD := h_sh_cond w_PD hwPD_nn
    have e_wPB := h_sh_fiber B_of w_P hwP_nn
    have e_wBD := h_sh_cond w_BD hwBD_nn
    have hwBD_sum_ib : ∀ d, ∑ ib, w_BD ib d = w_D d :=
      fun d => Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ B_of (fun ip => w_PD ip d)
    simp_rw [hwBD_sum_ib] at e_wBD
    have e_wPDB := h_sh_fiber (fun pd : Fin N_P × Fin N_D => (B_of pd.1, pd.2))
      (fun pd => w_PD pd.1 pd.2) (fun pd => hwPD_nn pd.1 pd.2)
    have h_fbw : ∀ bd : Fin N_B × Fin N_D,
        (∑ pd ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun pd : Fin N_P × Fin N_D => (B_of pd.1, pd.2) = bd), w_PD pd.1 pd.2) =
        w_BD bd.1 bd.2 := by
      intro bd
      rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp_rw [Prod.ext_iff]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_eq_single bd.2]
      · simp [w_BD, Finset.sum_filter]
      · intro d _ hd; simp [hd]
      · intro hm; exact False.elim (hm (Finset.mem_univ _))
    dsimp only at e_wPDB
    simp_rw [h_fbw] at e_wPDB
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at e_wPDB
    have e_wPDD := h_sh_cond (fun (ip : Fin N_P) (dd : Fin N_D × Fin N_D) => w ip dd.1 dd.2)
      (fun ip dd => hw_nn ip dd.1 dd.2)
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at e_wPDD

    have hw_D_eq : ∀ d, w_D d = ∑ o, p_tilde o d :=
      fun d => Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ P_of (fun o => p_tilde o d)
    simp_rw [← hw_D_eq] at h_s2_1 h_s2_3
    change _ ≤ (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d / w_D d))) / ell at h_s2_1
    change (∑ ip, -(w_P ip * Real.log (w_P ip / w_B (B_of ip)))) / ell -
      (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d / w_BD (B_of ip) d))) / ell ≤ _ at h_s2_2
    change (∑ ib, ∑ d, -(w_BD ib d * Real.log (w_BD ib d / w_D d))) / ell ≤ _ at h_s2_3
    change (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d / w_D d))) =
      (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d))) - (∑ d, -(w_D d * Real.log (w_D d))) at e_wPD
    change (∑ ip, -(w_P ip * Real.log (w_P ip / w_B (B_of ip)))) =
      (∑ ip, -(w_P ip * Real.log (w_P ip))) - (∑ ib, -(w_B ib * Real.log (w_B ib))) at e_wPB
    change (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂ / w_DD d₁ d₂))) =
      (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂))) -
      (∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w_DD d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w_DD d₁ d₂))) at e_wPDD

    have h_raw_chain :
        ((∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d / w_D d))) -
         (∑ ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, -(w ip d₁ d₂ * Real.log (w ip d₁ d₂ / w_DD d₁ d₂)))) -
        ((∑ ip, -(w_P ip * Real.log (w_P ip / w_B (B_of ip)))) -
         (∑ ip, ∑ d, -(w_PD ip d * Real.log (w_PD ip d / w_BD (B_of ip) d)))) ≤
        Real.log 4 + (∑ ib, ∑ d, -(w_BD ib d * Real.log (w_BD ib d / w_D d))) := by
      linarith [e_wPD, e_wPB, e_wBD, e_wPDB, e_wPDD, hI_raw_le, hBDD_neg_mi, h_dom_BDD]

    have h_div_chain := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_raw_chain hell_pos.le
    rw [sub_div, sub_div, sub_div, add_div] at h_div_chain
    have h4Δ : 4 * Δ'_pt = 16 * Δ_p + (24 * Real.log 2) / ell := by
      dsimp only [Δ'_pt]; field_simp [hell_pos.ne']; ring
    have h_logs : (24 * Real.log 2 + Real.log 4 + Real.log C_OP + Real.log C_iso +
        2 * Real.log C_BD + Real.log B_sep) / ell =
        (24 * Real.log 2) / ell + Real.log 4 / ell + Real.log C_OP / ell +
        (Real.log C_iso + Real.log C_BD) / ell + Real.log C_BD / ell + Real.log B_sep / ell := by
      field_simp [hell_pos.ne']; ring
    dsimp only [ell] at h_contra_gap h_logs h4Δ h_div_chain h_s2_1 h_s2_2 h_s2_3 hH_PDD_le
    linarith [h_div_chain, h_s2_1, h_s2_2, h_s2_3, hH_PDD_le, h4Δ, h_logs, h_contra_gap]

  
  have hπcomp_ge : 3 / 4 ≤ π_comp := by linarith [hπ_tot, hπA_le]
  have hND_ne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_D)).Nonempty := ⟨d₀, Finset.mem_univ d₀⟩
  let M_prox : Fin N_P → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun ip d' =>
    ∑ o₁ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o₁ => P_of o₁ = ip),
      ∑ d₁ : Fin N_D, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d') (decNotSep d₁ d') (p o₁ d₁) 0
  have hM_nn : ∀ ip d', 0 ≤ M_prox ip d' := by
    intro ip d'; dsimp only [M_prox]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o₁ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d₁ _ => ?_))
    by_cases hs : Sep d₁ d' <;> simp [decNotSep, hs, hp_nn]
  have hex_sel : ∀ ip : Fin N_P, ∃ d_m : Fin N_D, ∀ d' : Fin N_D, M_prox ip d' ≤ M_prox ip d_m := by
    intro ip
    obtain ⟨d_m, _, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (M_prox ip) hND_ne
    exact ⟨d_m, fun d' => hmax d' (Finset.mem_univ d')⟩
  let d_sel : Fin N_P → Fin N_D := fun ip => Classical.choose (hex_sel ip)
  have hd_sel_max : ∀ ip d', M_prox ip d' ≤ M_prox ip (d_sel ip) :=
    fun ip => Classical.choose_spec (hex_sel ip)

  have h_sel_ge : 3 / 4 ≤ ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d (d_sel (P_of o))) (decNotSep d (d_sel (P_of o))) (p o d) 0 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ P_of (fun o =>
      ∑ d : Fin N_D, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d (d_sel (P_of o))) (decNotSep d (d_sel (P_of o))) (p o d) 0)]
    have h_rhs_eq : ∀ ip : Fin N_P,
        (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip),
          ∑ d : Fin N_D, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d (d_sel (P_of o))) (decNotSep d (d_sel (P_of o))) (p o d) 0) =
        M_prox ip (d_sel ip) := by
      intro ip; dsimp only [M_prox]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o ho => ?_)
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).2]
    simp_rw [h_rhs_eq]
    refine le_trans hπcomp_ge ?_
    dsimp only [π_comp]
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ P_of (fun o₁ =>
      ∑ d₁, ∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0)]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ip _ => ?_)
    let F_ip := Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_of o = ip)
    by_cases hpP_pos : 0 < p_P ip
    · have h_fib_ip :
          (∑ o₁ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0) =
          ∑ o₂ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₂, (p o₂ d₂ / p_P ip) * M_prox ip d₂ := by
        have h_o1 : ∀ o₁ ∈ F_ip, ∀ d₁ : Fin N_D,
            (∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0) =
            ∑ o₂ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₂, (p o₂ d₂ / p_P ip) * @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (p o₁ d₁) 0 := by
          intro o₁ ho₁ d₁
          have hpo1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho₁).2
          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₂ _ => ?_)
          by_cases hpo2 : P_of o₂ = ip
          · have hc : P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁) := ⟨hpo1.trans hpo2.symm, hpo1 ▸ hpP_pos⟩
            rw [if_pos hpo2]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₂ _ => ?_)
            dsimp only [Pi_law]
            by_cases hns : ¬ Sep d₁ d₂
            · rw [if_pos hns, if_pos hc, if_pos hns, hpo1]; ring
            · rw [if_neg hns, if_neg hns]; ring
          · rw [if_neg hpo2]
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d₂ _ => ?_)
            have hc : ¬ (P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)) := fun h => hpo2 (h.1.symm.trans hpo1)
            dsimp only [Pi_law]
            by_cases hns : ¬ Sep d₁ d₂
            · rw [if_pos hns, if_neg hc]
            · rw [if_neg hns]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₁ ho₁ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₁ _ => h_o1 o₁ ho₁ d₁))]
        have sw1 : ∀ o₁ ∈ F_ip,
            (∑ d₁, ∑ o₂ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₂, (p o₂ d₂ / p_P ip) * @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (p o₁ d₁) 0) =
            ∑ o₂ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, (p o₂ d₂ / p_P ip) * @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (p o₁ d₁) 0 :=
          fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl sw1, Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o₂ _ => ?_)
        have sw2 : ∀ o₁ ∈ F_ip,
            (∑ d₁, ∑ d₂, (p o₂ d₂ / p_P ip) * @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (p o₁ d₁) 0) =
            ∑ d₂, ∑ d₁, (p o₂ d₂ / p_P ip) * @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (p o₁ d₁) 0 :=
          fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl sw2, Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d₂ _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [M_prox, F_ip]
        simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      change (∑ o₁ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0) ≤
        M_prox ip (d_sel ip)
      rw [h_fib_ip]
      calc ∑ o₂ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₂, (p o₂ d₂ / p_P ip) * M_prox ip d₂
          ≤ ∑ o₂ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₂, (p o₂ d₂ / p_P ip) * M_prox ip (d_sel ip) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d₂ _ =>
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hd_sel_max ip d₂) (div_nonneg (hp_nn _ _) hpP_pos.le)))
        _ = ((∑ o₂ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₂, p o₂ d₂) / p_P ip) * M_prox ip (d_sel ip) := by
            simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_div]
        _ = M_prox ip (d_sel ip) := by
            dsimp only [F_ip]
            rw [← hpP_eq ip, div_self hpP_pos.ne', one_mul]
    · have h_zero : (∑ o₁ ∈ F_ip,
          ∑ d₁, ∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0) = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₁ ho₁ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d₁ _ =>
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun o₂ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d₂ _ => ?_))))
        have hpo1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho₁).2
        have hc : ¬ (P_of o₁ = P_of o₂ ∧ 0 < p_P (P_of o₁)) := fun h => hpP_pos (hpo1 ▸ h.2)
        dsimp only [Pi_law]
        by_cases hns : ¬ Sep d₁ d₂
        · rw [if_pos hns, if_neg hc]
        · rw [if_neg hns]
      change (∑ o₁ ∈ F_ip, ∑ d₁, ∑ o₂, ∑ d₂, @ite ℝ (¬ Sep d₁ d₂) (decNotSep d₁ d₂) (Pi_law o₁ d₁ o₂ d₂) 0) ≤
        M_prox ip (d_sel ip)
      rw [h_zero]; exact hM_nn ip (d_sel ip)

  refine ⟨d_sel, ?_⟩
  refine le_trans h_sel_ge (le_of_eq ?_)
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_))
  by_cases hns : ¬ Sep d (d_sel (P_of o))
  · rw [if_pos hns, if_pos hns]
  · rw [if_neg hns, if_neg hns]

informal_problem.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass) :
    ∃ C_split : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_split ∧
      ∀ (γ ε H_P L t h b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
        (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
        (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (m_site : Fin N_J → Fin N_O → ℝ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let r := t - 2 * h
        let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 4 → 0 < h → 0 < r →
        1 ≤ S_per_loc →
        (∀ j₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N_J =>
          (menu j).loc_idx = j₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (S_per_loc : ℝ)) →
        0 ≤ b_star → ε ^ r ≤ s_c → m_r ≤ m_t →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        (∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
          let j := win_of o
          (menu j).loc_idx = cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) ∧
          b_star ≤ b_D d ∧
          0 < m_site j o ∧
          generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ≤
            16 * ((S_per_loc : ℝ) ^ 2) * m_site j o) →
        let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
          ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
        let H_J := (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(π_J j * Real.log (π_J j))) / ell
        let p_cond := fun (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) =>
          if win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j then p o d / π_J j else 0
        (∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ π_J j) ∧
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j = 1) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_J j →
          (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_cond j o d) ∧

        let r := t - 2 * h

            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,

by
  let B_ceil : ℕ := ⌈cls.B_sys⌉₊
  let K_box : ℕ := 3 * B_ceil
  let C_J0 : ℕ := (2 * K_box + 1) ^ 4
  let C_split : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ) + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 16
  have hCJ0_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_J0 := by
    dsimp only [C_J0]
    exact Nat.one_le_pow 4 (2 * K_box + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _)
  have hCJ0_r_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (C_J0 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hCJ0_ge1
  have hCJ0_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (C_J0 : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hCJ0_r_ge1
  have hC_split_nn : 0 ≤ C_split := by
    have hlog1 : 0 ≤ Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hCJ0_r_ge1
    have hlog16 : 0 ≤ Real.log (16 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    dsimp only [C_split]
    linarith
  have h_parseval_bound : ∀ (u e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (A B : ℝ),
      ‖e‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B →
      |inner ℝ u e| ≤ A → |inner ℝ u (perp2D e)| ≤ B →
      ‖u‖ ≤ A + B ∧ |u 0| ≤ ‖u‖ ∧ |u 1| ≤ ‖u‖ := by
    intro u e A B he hA hB h1 h2
    have hu_sq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = (u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have he_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq e
      rw [he, one_pow, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h.symm
    have hin1 : inner ℝ u e = u 0 * e 0 + u 1 * e 1 := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [mul_comm]
    have hin2 : inner ℝ u (perp2D e) = -(u 0 * e 1) + u 1 * e 0 := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [perp2D, mul_comm]
    have h_parseval : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℝ u e) ^ 2 + (inner ℝ u (perp2D e)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hu_sq, hin1, hin2]
      calc (u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2
          = ((u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ = ((u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2) * ((e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2) := by rw [he_sq]
        _ = (u 0 * e 0 + u 1 * e 1) ^ 2 + (-(u 0 * e 1) + u 1 * e 0) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hsq1 : (inner ℝ u e) ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (inner ℝ u e)]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (inner ℝ u e)]
    have hsq2 : (inner ℝ u (perp2D e)) ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (inner ℝ u (perp2D e))]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (inner ℝ u (perp2D e))]
    have h_norm_le : ‖u‖ ≤ A + B := by
      have h_le_sq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ (A + B) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg u]
    have h_u0 : |u 0| ≤ ‖u‖ := by
      have h0 : |u 0| ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs, hu_sq]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 1)]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (u 0), norm_nonneg u]
    have h_u1 : |u 1| ≤ ‖u‖ := by
      have h1' : |u 1| ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs, hu_sq]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0)]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (u 1), norm_nonneg u]
    exact ⟨h_norm_le, h_u0, h_u1⟩
  have h_floor_mem_icc : ∀ (z y : ℝ) (R : ℕ),

      ⌊z⌋ ∈ Finset.Icc (⌊y⌋ - (R : ℤ)) (⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ)) := by

    have hy_fl : (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) ≤ y := Int.floor_le y
    have hy_lt : y < (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one y
    have hz_fl : (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) ≤ z := Int.floor_le z

    constructor
    · apply Int.le_floor.mpr
      push_cast
      linarith
    · have hlt_real : (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) < ((⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        linarith
      have hlt_int : ⌊z⌋ < ⌊y⌋ + (R : ℤ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hlt_real

    intro m
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    omega
  have h_box_card : ∀ (q_d : ℕ) (m1 m2 m3 m4 : ℤ),
      (({q_d} : Finset ℕ) ×ˢ
        ((Finset.Icc (m1 - (K_box : ℤ)) (m1 + (K_box : ℤ)) ×ˢ
          Finset.Icc (m2 - (K_box : ℤ)) (m2 + (K_box : ℤ))) ×ˢ

          Finset.Icc (m4 - (K_box : ℤ)) (m4 + (K_box : ℤ))))).card = C_J0 := by
    intro q_d m1 m2 m3 m4
    rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_singleton,
      Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product,
      h_icc_card, h_icc_card, h_icc_card, h_icc_card]
    dsimp only [C_J0]
    ring
  refine ⟨C_split, hC_split_nn, ?_⟩
  intro γ ε H_P L t h b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc
    Φ₀ f r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D
    N_ret_of menu win_of p m_site
  intro r ell s_c
  intro hε₀ hε₁ hh hr_pos hS_loc_1 h_card_loc hb_star_nn hsc_lo hmr_le_mt hadm h_act

  have hε_lt1 : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := hε_lt1.le
  have hell_pos : 0 < ell := by

    exact Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr hε_lt1)
  have hS_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (S_per_loc : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hS_loc_1
  have hS_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (S_per_loc : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hS_ge1
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hd_adm, hp_nn, hp_sum, hp_pos_adm⟩ := hadm

  let p_O : Fin N_O → ℝ := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
  let p_D : Fin N_D → ℝ := fun d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p o d
  have hpO_nn : ∀ o : Fin N_O, 0 ≤ p_O o :=
    fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hp_nn o d)
  have hpD_nn : ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ p_D d :=
    fun d => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hp_nn o d)
  have hpO_sum1 : ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o = 1 := hp_sum
  have hpD_sum1 : ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d = 1 := by

    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact hp_sum

  have hπ_eq_ite : ∀ j : Fin N_J,

    have h_term : p_O o = (if win_of o = win_of o then p_O o else 0) := (if_pos rfl).symm
    rw [h_term]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun o' => if win_of o' = win_of o then p_O o' else 0)
      (fun o' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hpO_nn o'; exact le_rfl])

  have hπ_nn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ π_J j :=
    fun j => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hp_nn o d))

  have hπ_sum1 : ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j = 1 := by
    simp_rw [hπ_eq_ite]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h_one : ∀ o : Fin N_O,
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, if win_of o = j then p_O o else 0) = p_O o := by
      intro o
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp_rw [h_one]
    exact hpO_sum1

  have hp_cond_props : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 < π_J j →
      (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_cond j o d) ∧
      (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond j o d = 1) ∧
      (∀ o d, 0 < p_cond j o d → win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p o d) := by
    intro j hπj
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro o d
      dsimp only [p_cond]
      split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (hp_nn o d) hπj.le
      · exact le_rfl
    · have h_row : ∀ o : Fin N_O,
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond j o d) =
            (if win_of o = j then p_O o else 0) / π_J j := by
        intro o
        by_cases hwo : win_of o = j
        · have hc : win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j := ⟨hwo, hπj⟩
          have h_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D, p_cond j o d = p o d / π_J j := by
            intro d; dsimp only [p_cond]; exact if_pos hc
          simp_rw [h_d]
          rw [← Finset.sum_div, if_pos hwo]
        · have h_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D, p_cond j o d = 0 := by
            intro d; dsimp only [p_cond]; exact if_neg (fun hc => hwo hc.1)
          simp_rw [h_d]
          rw [Finset.sum_const_zero, if_neg hwo, zero_div]
      simp_rw [h_row]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hπ_eq_ite j, div_self hπj.ne']

      dsimp only [p_cond] at hpos
      by_cases hc : win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j
      · rw [if_pos hc] at hpos

        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hπj.ne'] at hmul_pos
        exact ⟨hc.1, hmul_pos⟩
      · rw [if_neg hc] at hpos

  let p_cond_O : Fin N_J → Fin N_O → ℝ := fun j o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond j o d
  let p_cond_D : Fin N_J → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun j d => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond j o d
  let P_JD : Fin N_J → Fin N_D → ℝ := fun j d =>
    ∑ o : Fin N_O, if win_of o = j then p o d else 0
  have hPJD_nn : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (d : Fin N_D), 0 ≤ P_JD j d := by
    intro j d
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => ?_)
    split_ifs
    · exact hp_nn o d
    · exact le_rfl
  have hPJD_sum_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D, ∑ j : Fin N_J, P_JD j d = p_D d := by
    intro d
    dsimp only [P_JD, p_D]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
    simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  have hp_le_PJD : ∀ (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D), p o d ≤ P_JD (win_of o) d := by
    intro o d

    have h_term : p o d = (if win_of o = win_of o then p o d else 0) := (if_pos rfl).symm
    rw [h_term]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun o' => if win_of o' = win_of o then p o' d else 0)
      (fun o' _ => by split_ifs <;> [exact hp_nn o' d; exact le_rfl])
      (Finset.mem_univ o)
  have hPJD_le_π : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (d : Fin N_D), P_JD j d ≤ π_J j := by
    intro j d

    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun o _ => ?_)
    split_ifs
    · exact hp_le_pO o d
    · exact le_rfl
  have h_mul_pcond : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D),

    intro j o d
    dsimp only [p_cond]
    by_cases hwo : win_of o = j
    · by_cases hπj : 0 < π_J j
      · rw [if_pos ⟨hwo, hπj⟩, if_pos hwo, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hπj.ne']
      · have hπ0 : π_J j = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hπj) (hπ_nn j)
        have hp0 : p o d = 0 := by
          have hle : p o d ≤ π_J j :=
            le_trans (hp_le_pO o d) (by rw [← hwo]; exact hpO_le_π o)
          exact le_antisymm (hπ0 ▸ hle) (hp_nn o d)
        rw [if_neg (fun hc => hπj hc.2), if_pos hwo, mul_zero, hp0]
    · rw [if_neg (fun hc => hwo hc.1), if_neg hwo, mul_zero]
  have h_mul_pcond_O : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O),
      π_J j * p_cond_O j o = if win_of o = j then p_O o else 0 := by
    intro j o
    dsimp only [p_cond_O, p_O]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    simp_rw [h_mul_pcond j o]
    by_cases hwo : win_of o = j
    · simp [hwo]
    · simp [hwo]
  have h_mul_pcond_D : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (d : Fin N_D),
      π_J j * p_cond_D j d = P_JD j d := by
    intro j d
    dsimp only [p_cond_D, P_JD]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h_mul_pcond j o d)
  have h_ite_pi : ∀ (F : Fin N_J → ℝ) (j : Fin N_J) [Decidable (0 < π_J j)],
      (@ite ℝ (0 < π_J j) _ (π_J j * F j) 0) = π_J j * F j := by
    intro F j _
    by_cases hπj : 0 < π_J j
    · exact if_pos hπj
    · have hπ0 : π_J j = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hπj) (hπ_nn j)
      rw [if_neg hπj, hπ0, zero_mul]

  have h_HO_pt : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O),

    intro j o
    by_cases hwo : win_of o = j
    · rw [if_pos hwo]

      · rw [← hpO0]
        simp only [zero_mul, neg_zero, zero_add]
        by_cases hπ0 : π_J j = 0
        · rw [hπ0, zero_mul]
        · have hprod := h_mul_pcond_O j o
          rw [if_pos hwo, ← hpO0] at hprod
          have hpc0 : p_cond_O j o = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left hπ0
          rw [hpc0, zero_mul, neg_zero, mul_zero]
      · have hπ_pos : 0 < π_J j := lt_of_lt_of_le hpO_pos (by rw [← hwo]; exact hpO_le_π o)
        have hprod := h_mul_pcond_O j o
        rw [if_pos hwo] at hprod
        have hpc_eq : p_cond_O j o = p_O o / π_J j := by
