        have hhalf_sc_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_c := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hsc_pos.le
        have hx0_bd : |(((X_O o) 0 + (C_rd - C_td) * (V_O o) 0) / s_x + 1 / 2) - x0_d| ≤ (K_box : ℝ) := by
          have h_eq : (((X_O o) 0 + (C_rd - C_td) * (V_O o) 0) / s_x + 1 / 2) - x0_d =
              (((X_O o) 0 - (X_D d) 0) + (C_rd - C_td) * ((V_O o) 0 - (V_D d) 0)) / s_x := by
            dsimp only [x0_d]; ring
          rw [h_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hsx_pos, div_le_iff₀ hsx_pos]
          have htri := abs_add_le ((X_O o) 0 - (X_D d) 0) ((C_rd - C_td) * ((V_O o) 0 - (V_D d) 0))
          rw [abs_mul] at htri
          have hprod_le : |C_rd - C_td| * |(V_O o) 0 - (V_D d) 0| ≤ cls.B_sys * s_x := by
            have hm := mul_le_mul hC_diff_abs hV0_abs (abs_nonneg _) hhalf_sc_nn
            have hid : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_c) * (2 * cls.B_sys * s_v) = cls.B_sys * s_x := by
              dsimp only [s_x]; ring
            rwa [hid] at hm
          linarith only [htri, hX0_abs, hprod_le, h3B_sx]
        have hx1_bd : |(((X_O o) 1 + (C_rd - C_td) * (V_O o) 1) / s_x + 1 / 2) - x1_d| ≤ (K_box : ℝ) := by
          have h_eq : (((X_O o) 1 + (C_rd - C_td) * (V_O o) 1) / s_x + 1 / 2) - x1_d =
              (((X_O o) 1 - (X_D d) 1) + (C_rd - C_td) * ((V_O o) 1 - (V_D d) 1)) / s_x := by
            dsimp only [x1_d]; ring
          rw [h_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hsx_pos, div_le_iff₀ hsx_pos]
          have htri := abs_add_le ((X_O o) 1 - (X_D d) 1) ((C_rd - C_td) * ((V_O o) 1 - (V_D d) 1))
          rw [abs_mul] at htri
          have hprod_le : |C_rd - C_td| * |(V_O o) 1 - (V_D d) 1| ≤ cls.B_sys * s_x := by
            have hm := mul_le_mul hC_diff_abs hV1_abs (abs_nonneg _) hhalf_sc_nn
            have hid : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_c) * (2 * cls.B_sys * s_v) = cls.B_sys * s_x := by
              dsimp only [s_x]; ring
            rwa [hid] at hm
          linarith only [htri, hX1_abs, hprod_le, h3B_sx]
        have h_mem_box : (menu j).loc_idx ∈ Box_d := by
          rw [hloc_eq, hr_eq]
          dsimp only [cutLocalizerIdx, Box_d]
          refine Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_singleton_self q_d, ?_⟩
          refine Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
          · exact h_floor_mem_icc _ _ K_box hv0_bd
          · exact h_floor_mem_icc _ _ K_box hv1_bd
          · exact h_floor_mem_icc _ _ K_box hx0_bd
          · exact h_floor_mem_icc _ _ K_box hx1_bd
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(menu j).loc_idx, h_mem_box,
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, rfl⟩⟩
      have h_fib_le : ∀ j₀ ∈ Box_d, (fib_fn j₀).card ≤ S_per_loc := by
        intro j₀ _
        have h1 : (fib_fn j₀).card =
            (@Finset.filter (Fin N_J) (fun j => (menu j).loc_idx = j₀)
              (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ).card := by
          dsimp only [fib_fn]
          congr 1
          ext j'
          simp
        have h2 := h_card_loc j₀
        rw [h1]
        exact Nat.cast_le.mp h2
      have h_card_nat : S_d.card ≤ C_J0 * S_per_loc := by
        calc S_d.card
            ≤ (Box_d.biUnion fib_fn).card := Finset.card_le_card h_sub
          _ ≤ Box_d.card * S_per_loc := Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul Box_d fib_fn S_per_loc h_fib_le
          _ = C_J0 * S_per_loc := by rw [h_box_card]
      have h_card_d : (S_d.card : ℝ) ≤ B_fib := by
        have hc : (S_d.card : ℝ) ≤ ((C_J0 * S_per_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_card_nat
        simpa [B_fib] using hc
      have h_sum_Sd : ∑ j ∈ S_d, P_JD j d = p_D d := by
        rw [← hPJD_sum_d d]
        dsimp only [S_d]
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        by_cases hj : 0 < P_JD j d
        · exact if_pos hj
        · have hj0 : P_JD j d = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hj) (hPJD_nn j d)
          rw [if_neg hj, hj0]
      have h_ent_Sd :
          (∑ j : Fin N_J, -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d))) =
          ∑ j ∈ S_d, -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) := by
        dsimp only [S_d]
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        by_cases hj : 0 < P_JD j d
        · exact (if_pos hj).symm
        · have hj0 : P_JD j d = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hj) (hPJD_nn j d)
          rw [if_neg hj, hj0, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero]
      rw [h_ent_Sd]
      have h_pt_j : ∀ j ∈ S_d,
          -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) - P_JD j d * Real.log B_fib ≤
            p_D d / B_fib - P_JD j d := by
        intro j hj
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
        have hPj : 0 < P_JD j d := hj.2
        let x_j : ℝ := p_D d / (B_fib * P_JD j d)
        have hxj_pos : 0 < x_j := div_pos hpD_pos (mul_pos hB_fib_pos hPj)
        have hlog_xj : Real.log x_j = -Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d) - Real.log B_fib := by
          dsimp only [x_j]
          rw [Real.log_div hpD_pos.ne' (mul_pos hB_fib_pos hPj).ne',
            Real.log_mul hB_fib_pos.ne' hPj.ne',
            Real.log_div hPj.ne' hpD_pos.ne']
          ring
        have h_sub1 : Real.log x_j ≤ x_j - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hxj_pos
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sub1 hPj.le
        have h_lhs : P_JD j d * Real.log x_j =
            -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) - P_JD j d * Real.log B_fib := by
          rw [hlog_xj]; ring
        have h_rhs : P_JD j d * (x_j - 1) = p_D d / B_fib - P_JD j d := by
          dsimp only [x_j]
          have hB_ne : B_fib ≠ 0 := hB_fib_pos.ne'
          have hP_ne : P_JD j d ≠ 0 := hPj.ne'
          field_simp [hB_ne, hP_ne]
        linarith only [h_mul, h_lhs, h_rhs]
      have h_sum_ineq := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt_j
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
        Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, h_sum_Sd] at h_sum_ineq
      have h_card_mul : (S_d.card : ℝ) * (p_D d / B_fib) ≤ p_D d := by
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card_d (div_pos hpD_pos hB_fib_pos).le
        rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hB_fib_pos.ne'] at h1
      linarith only [h_sum_ineq, h_card_mul]

  have h_HJD_le :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d))) ≤
        Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ) + Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ j : Fin N_J, -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d))
        ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * Real.log B_fib := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_gibbs_d d)
      _ = (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d) * Real.log B_fib := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
      _ = Real.log B_fib := by rw [hpD_sum1, one_mul]
      _ = Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ) + Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) :=
          Real.log_mul hCJ0_pos.ne' hS_pos.ne'

  have h_HOD_pt1 : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D),
      π_J j * -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d)) =
        if win_of o = j then -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / P_JD j d)) else 0 := by
    intro j o d
    by_cases hwo : win_of o = j
    · rw [if_pos hwo]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hp_nn o d) with hpod0 | hpod_pos
      · rw [← hpod0]
        simp only [zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero]
        dsimp only [p_cond]
        rw [← hpod0, zero_div]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      · have hPJD_pos : 0 < P_JD j d := lt_of_lt_of_le hpod_pos (by rw [← hwo]; exact hp_le_PJD o d)
        have hπ_pos : 0 < π_J j := lt_of_lt_of_le hPJD_pos (hPJD_le_π j d)
        have hpc_eq : p_cond j o d = p o d / π_J j := by
          dsimp only [p_cond]
          exact if_pos ⟨hwo, hπ_pos⟩
        have hpcd_eq : p_cond_D j d = P_JD j d / π_J j := by
          rw [← h_mul_pcond_D j d, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hπ_pos.ne']
        have hdiv_eq : (p o d / π_J j) / (P_JD j d / π_J j) = p o d / P_JD j d := by
          have hπ_ne : π_J j ≠ 0 := hπ_pos.ne'
          have hP_ne : P_JD j d ≠ 0 := hPJD_pos.ne'
          field_simp [hπ_ne, hP_ne]
        rw [hpc_eq, hpcd_eq, hdiv_eq]
        have hcancel : π_J j * (p o d / π_J j) = p o d := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hπ_pos.ne'
        calc π_J j * -(p o d / π_J j * Real.log (p o d / P_JD j d))
            = -(π_J j * (p o d / π_J j)) * Real.log (p o d / P_JD j d) := by ring
          _ = -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / P_JD j d)) := by rw [hcancel]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hwo]
      have hpc0 : p_cond j o d = 0 := by
        dsimp only [p_cond]
        exact if_neg (fun hc => hwo hc.1)
      rw [hpc0, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero, neg_zero, mul_zero]

  have h_HOD_sum1 :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
        (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d)))) =
      ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / P_JD (win_of o) d)) := by
    have h_in : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
        π_J j * (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d))) =
        ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          if win_of o = j then -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / P_JD j d)) else 0 := by
      intro j
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_HOD_pt1 j o d)
    simp_rw [h_in]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
    simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]

  have h_HOD_sum2 :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d))) =
      ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (P_JD (win_of o) d / p_D d)) := by
    have h_expand : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (d : Fin N_D),
        -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) =
        ∑ o : Fin N_O, if win_of o = j then -(p o d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) else 0 := by
      intro j d
      dsimp only [P_JD]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> ring
    simp_rw [h_expand]
    calc (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O,
            if win_of o = j then -(p o d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) else 0)
        = ∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if win_of o = j then -(p o d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
      _ = ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if win_of o = j then -(p o d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ j : Fin N_J,
            if win_of o = j then -(p o d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d)) else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
      _ = ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (P_JD (win_of o) d / p_D d)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_))
          simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]

  have h_HOD_split :
      (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) =
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
        (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d)))) +
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(P_JD j d * Real.log (P_JD j d / p_D d))) := by
    rw [h_HOD_sum1, h_HOD_sum2, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hp_nn o d) with hpod0 | hpod_pos
    · rw [← hpod0]
      simp
    · have hPJD_pos : 0 < P_JD (win_of o) d := lt_of_lt_of_le hpod_pos (hp_le_PJD o d)
      have hpD_pos : 0 < p_D d := lt_of_lt_of_le hpod_pos (hp_le_pD o d)
      have h_div_mul : (p o d / P_JD (win_of o) d) * (P_JD (win_of o) d / p_D d) = p o d / p_D d :=
        div_mul_div_cancel₀ hPJD_pos.ne'
      have h1_ne : p o d / P_JD (win_of o) d ≠ 0 := (div_pos hpod_pos hPJD_pos).ne'
      have h2_ne : P_JD (win_of o) d / p_D d ≠ 0 := (div_pos hPJD_pos hpD_pos).ne'
      rw [← h_div_mul, Real.log_mul h1_ne h2_ne]
      ring

  have h_HOD_le :
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell) ≤
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d))) / ell))) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell) + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ)) / ell := by
    have h_num_le :
        (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) ≤
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
          (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d)))) +
        (Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ) + Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ)) := by
      linarith [h_HOD_split, h_HJD_le]
    have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le hell_pos.le
    have h_mul12 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    have h_rhs_eq :
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (((∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
          (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d)))) +
          (Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ) + Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ))) / ell) =
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j *
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d))) / ell))) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell) + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ)) / ell := by
      rw [add_div, mul_add, Finset.sum_div, Finset.mul_sum]
      have h_sum_rw :
          (∑ j : Fin N_J, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (π_J j *
            (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d))) / ell)) =
          ∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d))) / ell)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
      rw [h_sum_rw]
      ring
    linarith

  refine ⟨hπ_nn, hπ_sum1, hp_cond_props, ?_⟩
  let score_j : Fin N_J → ℝ := fun j =>
    (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_cond_O j o * Real.log (p_cond_O j o))) / ell +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d))) / ell) +
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond_O j o * Real.log (m_site j o)) / ell) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond_D j d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star))
  have h_jsum_eq :
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, @ite ℝ (0 < π_J j) (Classical.propDecidable _) (π_J j * score_j j) 0) =
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_cond_O j o * Real.log (p_cond_O j o))) / ell)) +
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        -(p_cond j o d * Real.log (p_cond j o d / p_cond_D j d))) / ell))) +
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond_O j o * Real.log (m_site j o)) / ell))) +
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, π_J j * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D,
        p_cond_D j d * pktWeight γ (b_D d - b_star) (a_D d - b_star)))) := by
    have h_step : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
        @ite ℝ (0 < π_J j) (Classical.propDecidable _) (π_J j * score_j j) 0 = π_J j * score_j j :=
      fun j => @h_ite_pi score_j j (Classical.propDecidable _)
    simp_rw [h_step]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    dsimp only [score_j]
    ring
  have h_const_eq :
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (C_J0 : ℝ)) / ell + ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 16) / ell =
      C_split / ell := by
    dsimp only [C_split]
    ring
  have h_score_def :
      generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p =
      (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log (m_f o)) / ell) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)) := rfl
  change generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
      H_J + b_star + (∑ j : Fin N_J, @ite ℝ (0 < π_J j) (Classical.propDecidable _) (π_J j * score_j j) 0) +
      (7 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (S_per_loc : ℝ) / ell) + C_split / ell
  linarith [h_score_def, h_HO_eq, h_HOD_le, h_Emass_le, h_Ew_eq, h_jsum_eq, h_const_eq]

informal_problem.statement:
(ε h ζ_sh ξ θ k_out m_bin C_coh_tot : ℝ)
    (d_dim M_L m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
    (p_cond : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (Q_of : Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (Z_of : Fin N_O → ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (T_cand : ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin N_ret))
    (m_site : Fin N_O → ℝ)
    (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 4)
    (hML : 1 ≤ M_L) (hC_coh : 1 ≤ C_coh_tot) (hm_bin : 0 < m_bin)
    (hp_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ p_cond o d)
    (hp_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d = 1) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    let p_O := fun o : Fin N_O => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d
    let p_D := fun d : Fin N_D => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_cond o d
    let S_act := Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => 0 < p_O o)
    (∀ o ∈ S_act,
      (Z_of o).1 = Q_of o ∧
      (Q_of o).2.1 = r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
      0 < m_site o ∧
      (T_cand (Q_of o)).Nonempty) →
    (∀ q, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q), m_site o ≤
      C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-ξ) * ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * m_bin) →
    (∀ z, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), m_site o ≤
      C_coh_tot * ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - 2 * ξ) *
        ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) * m_bin) →
    (∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (r_loc : ℕ),
      (((S_act.image Q_of).filter (fun q =>
        q.2.1 = r_loc ∧ α ∈ T_cand q)).card : ℝ) ≤ C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) →
    (∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (d : Fin N_D),
      0 < p_D d →
      (((S_act.filter (fun o => 0 < p_cond o d ∧ α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o))).image
        Z_of).card : ℝ) ≤ C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh)) →
    let q_cand : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin N_ret → ℝ := fun o d α =>
      if α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o) then p_cond o d / ((T_cand (Q_of o)).card : ℝ) else 0
    let q_T := fun α => ∑ o, ∑ d, q_cand o d α
    let q_TD := fun α d => ∑ o, q_cand o d α
    let q_D := fun d => ∑ o, ∑ α, q_cand o d α
    let q_TR := fun α (rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r))) =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) = rl.1),
        ∑ d, q_cand o d α
    q_D = p_D ∧
    (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d))) / ell) +
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log (m_site o)) / ell) ≤
    (∑ α : Fin N_ret, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))) / ell +
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log m_bin / ell) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (
      (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / q_D d))) / ell +
      2 * ((∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ rl : Fin (2 ^ (m_t - m_r)),
        -(q_TR α rl * Real.log (q_TR α rl / q_T α))) / ell) +
      k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) +
    4 * θ + 2 * ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ_sh +
    (3 * Real.log C_coh_tot + 2 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ)) / ell

    let q_T := fun α => ∑ o, ∑ d, q_cand o d α

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  
  have hell_pos_raw : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
    Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr (by linarith only [hε₁]))
  have hlog_eps : Real.log ε = -Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    rw [Real.log_inv]; ring
  have hlog_rpow : ∀ e : ℝ, Real.log (ε ^ e) = -e * Real.log (ε⁻¹) := by
    intro e
    rw [Real.log_rpow hε₀ e, hlog_eps]
    ring
  have hC_coh_pos : 0 < C_coh_tot := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_coh
  have hML_pos : 0 < (M_L : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hML)
  have hML4_cast : ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (M_L : ℝ) ^ 4 := Nat.cast_pow M_L 4
  have hML4_pos : 0 < ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hML4_cast]; exact pow_pos hML_pos 4
  have hlog_ML4 : Real.log (((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 4 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ) := by
    rw [hML4_cast, Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_two_pow_pos : 0 < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) := Nat.two_pow_pos (m_t - m_r)

  have h_sum_fib_maps_to : ∀ {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β]
      (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) (g : α → β) (f : α → ℝ)
      (dec : ∀ b : β, DecidablePred (fun a : α => g a = b)),
      (∀ a ∈ S, g a ∈ T) →
      (∑ b ∈ T, ∑ a ∈ @Finset.filter α (fun a => g a = b) (dec b) S, f a) =
        ∑ a ∈ S, f a := by
    intro α β _ S T g f dec hmaps
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps f]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]

  have h_ite_sum : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (P : Prop) (dec : Decidable P)
      (u : α → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
      (∑ a ∈ S, @ite ℝ P dec (u a / C) 0) = @ite ℝ P dec ((∑ a ∈ S, u a) / C) 0 := by
    intro α S P dec u C
    by_cases hP : P <;> simp [hP, Finset.sum_div]

  have h_ent_split : ∀ {u v w : ℝ}, 0 ≤ u → (0 < u → 0 < v) → (0 < u → 0 < w) →
      -(u * Real.log (u / w)) = -(u * Real.log (u / v)) + -(u * Real.log (v / w)) := by
    intro u v w hu hv hw
    by_cases hu0 : u = 0
    · simp [hu0]
    · have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_le_of_ne hu (Ne.symm hu0)
      have hv_pos : 0 < v := hv hu_pos
      have hw_pos : 0 < w := hw hu_pos
      have hprod : u / w = (u / v) * (v / w) := by
        field_simp [hv_pos.ne', hw_pos.ne']
      rw [hprod, Real.log_mul (div_pos hu_pos hv_pos).ne' (div_pos hv_pos hw_pos).ne']
      ring

  have h_sum_ent_split : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U w : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < u i → 0 < w) →
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / w))) =
        (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) + -(U * Real.log (U / w)) := by
    intro α S u U w hu_nn hU hw
    have hcongr : (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / w))) =
        ∑ i ∈ S, (-(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) + -(u i * Real.log (U / w))) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      refine h_ent_split (hu_nn i hi) (fun hui => ?_) (hw i hi)
      rw [← hU]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hui (Finset.single_le_sum hu_nn hi)
    rw [hcongr, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hU]

  have h_sum_ent_split_one : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) →
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i))) =
        (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) + -(U * Real.log U) := by
    intro α S u U hu_nn hU
    simpa only [div_one] using h_sum_ent_split S u U 1 hu_nn hU (fun _ _ _ => zero_lt_one)

  have h_gibbs : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u w : α → ℝ) (U B : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) → 0 < B →
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < u i → 0 < w i) → (∑ i ∈ S, w i ≤ B) →
      (∑ i ∈ S, (-(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) + u i * Real.log (w i))) ≤ U * Real.log B := by
    intro α S u w U B hu_nn hU hB_pos hw_nn hw_pos hw_sum
    have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := by rw [← hU]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg hu_nn
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · have hu0 : ∀ i ∈ S, u i = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hu_nn).mp (hU.trans hU0)
      rw [hU0, zero_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => by simp [hu0 i hi])]
    · have hU_pos : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU_nn (Ne.symm hU0)
      have hpt : ∀ i ∈ S,
          (-(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) + u i * Real.log (w i)) - u i * Real.log B ≤
            U * (w i / B) - u i := by
        intro i hi
        by_cases hui0 : u i = 0
        · rw [hui0]
          simp only [zero_div, zero_mul, neg_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg hU_nn (div_nonneg (hw_nn i hi) hB_pos.le)
        · have hui_pos : 0 < u i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hu_nn i hi) (Ne.symm hui0)
          have hwi_pos : 0 < w i := hw_pos i hi hui_pos
          let x := (w i / B) / (u i / U)
          have hx_pos : 0 < x := div_pos (div_pos hwi_pos hB_pos) (div_pos hui_pos hU_pos)
          have hlog : Real.log x = Real.log (w i) - Real.log B - Real.log (u i / U) := by
            dsimp only [x]
            rw [Real.log_div (div_pos hwi_pos hB_pos).ne' (div_pos hui_pos hU_pos).ne',
              Real.log_div hwi_pos.ne' hB_pos.ne']
          have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx_pos) hui_pos.le
          have hlhs : u i * Real.log x =
              (-(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) + u i * Real.log (w i)) - u i * Real.log B := by
            rw [hlog]; ring
          have hrhs : u i * (x - 1) = U * (w i / B) - u i := by
            dsimp only [x]
            field_simp [hui_pos.ne', hU_pos.ne', hB_pos.ne']
          rwa [hlhs, hrhs] at h1
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hU,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, hU] at hsum
      have hdiv : (∑ i ∈ S, w i) / B ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hB_pos).mpr hw_sum
      have hmul : U * ((∑ i ∈ S, w i) / B) ≤ U * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv hU_nn
      linarith only [hsum, hmul]

  have h_gibbs_chain : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u w : α → ℝ) (U v_den B : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < u i → 0 < v_den) →
      0 < B → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < u i → 0 < w i) → (∑ i ∈ S, w i ≤ B) →
      (∑ i ∈ S, (-(u i * Real.log (u i / v_den)) + u i * Real.log (w i))) ≤
        -(U * Real.log (U / v_den)) + U * Real.log B := by
    intro α S u w U v_den B hu_nn hU hv hB_pos hw_nn hw_pos hw_sum
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, h_sum_ent_split S u U v_den hu_nn hU hv]
    have hg := h_gibbs S u w U B hu_nn hU hB_pos hw_nn hw_pos hw_sum
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hg
    linarith only [hg]

  have h_gibbs_chain_one : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u w : α → ℝ) (U B : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) →
      0 < B → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < u i → 0 < w i) → (∑ i ∈ S, w i ≤ B) →
      (∑ i ∈ S, (-(u i * Real.log (u i)) + u i * Real.log (w i))) ≤
        -(U * Real.log U) + U * Real.log B := by
    intro α S u w U B hu_nn hU hB_pos hw_nn hw_pos hw_sum
    simpa only [div_one] using h_gibbs_chain S u w U 1 B hu_nn hU
      (fun _ _ _ => zero_lt_one) hB_pos hw_nn hw_pos hw_sum

  have h_card_ent : ∀ {α : Type} (S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U K : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S, u i = U) → 0 < K → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K →
      (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) ≤ U * Real.log K := by
    intro α S u U K hu_nn hU hK_pos hcard
    have hg := h_gibbs S u (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) U K hu_nn hU hK_pos
      (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) (fun _ _ _ => zero_lt_one)
      (by simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]; exact hcard)
    simpa only [Real.log_one, mul_zero, add_zero] using hg

  have h_supp_card_ent : ∀ {α : Type} (S₀ S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U K : ℝ),
      S ⊆ S₀ → (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S₀, u i = U) →
      (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 < u i → i ∈ S) → 0 < K → (0 < U → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K) →
      (∑ i ∈ S₀, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) ≤ U * Real.log K := by
    intro α S₀ S u U K hsub hu_nn hU hsupp hK_pos hcard
    have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := by rw [← hU]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg hu_nn
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · have hu0 : ∀ i ∈ S₀, u i = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hu_nn).mp (hU.trans hU0)
      rw [hU0, zero_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => by simp [hu0 i hi])]
    · have hU_pos : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU_nn (Ne.symm hU0)
      have hzero_out : ∀ i ∈ S₀, i ∉ S → u i = 0 := by
        intro i hi₀ hiS
        by_contra hne
        exact hiS (hsupp i hi₀ (lt_of_le_of_ne (hu_nn i hi₀) (Ne.symm hne)))
      have hU_S : ∑ i ∈ S, u i = U := by
        rw [← hU]
        exact Finset.sum_subset hsub hzero_out
      have hent_S : (∑ i ∈ S, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) =
          ∑ i ∈ S₀, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) :=
        Finset.sum_subset hsub (fun i hi₀ hiS => by simp [hzero_out i hi₀ hiS])
      rw [← hent_S]
      exact h_card_ent S u U K (fun i hi => hu_nn i (hsub hi)) hU_S hK_pos (hcard hU_pos)

  have h_supp_card_chain : ∀ {α : Type} (S₀ S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U v_den K : ℝ),
      S ⊆ S₀ → (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S₀, u i = U) →
      (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 < u i → 0 < v_den) →
      (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 < u i → i ∈ S) → 0 < K → (0 < U → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K) →
      (∑ i ∈ S₀, -(u i * Real.log (u i / v_den))) ≤
        -(U * Real.log (U / v_den)) + U * Real.log K := by
    intro α S₀ S u U v_den K hsub hu_nn hU hv hsupp hK_pos hcard
    rw [h_sum_ent_split S₀ u U v_den hu_nn hU hv]
    have hs := h_supp_card_ent S₀ S u U K hsub hu_nn hU hsupp hK_pos hcard
    linarith only [hs]

  have h_supp_card_chain_one : ∀ {α : Type} (S₀ S : Finset α) (u : α → ℝ) (U K : ℝ),
      S ⊆ S₀ → (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 ≤ u i) → (∑ i ∈ S₀, u i = U) →
      (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 < u i → i ∈ S) → 0 < K → (0 < U → (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K) →
      (∑ i ∈ S₀, -(u i * Real.log (u i))) ≤
        -(U * Real.log U) + U * Real.log K := by
    intro α S₀ S u U K hsub hu_nn hU hsupp hK_pos hcard
    simpa only [div_one] using h_supp_card_chain S₀ S u U 1 K hsub hu_nn hU
      (fun _ _ _ => zero_lt_one) hsupp hK_pos hcard

  have h_ite_card : ∀ {N : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin N)) (c : ℝ)
      (dec : DecidablePred (fun α : Fin N => α ∈ T)),
      (∑ α : Fin N, @ite ℝ (α ∈ T) (dec α) c 0) = (T.card : ℝ) * c := by
    intro N T c dec
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ T) (fun α _ hα => by simp [hα])]
    have hcongr : (∑ α ∈ T, @ite ℝ (α ∈ T) (dec α) c 0) = ∑ _α ∈ T, c :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α hα => by simp [hα])
    rw [hcongr, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]

  have h_unif_sum : ∀ {N : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin N)) (U : ℝ)
      (dec : DecidablePred (fun α : Fin N => α ∈ T)),
      0 ≤ U → (0 < U → T.Nonempty) →
      (∑ α : Fin N, @ite ℝ (α ∈ T) (dec α) (U / (T.card : ℝ)) 0) = U := by
    intro N T U dec hU_nn hne
    rw [h_ite_card]
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · simp [hU0]
    · have hU_pos : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU_nn (Ne.symm hU0)
      have hcard_pos : 0 < (T.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr (hne hU_pos))
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ U hcard_pos.ne'

  have h_unif_ent : ∀ {N : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin N)) (U w : ℝ)
      (dec : DecidablePred (fun α : Fin N => α ∈ T)),
      0 ≤ U → (0 < U → T.Nonempty) → (0 < U → 0 < w) →
      let f := fun α : Fin N => @ite ℝ (α ∈ T) (dec α) (U / (T.card : ℝ)) 0
      (∑ α : Fin N, -(f α * Real.log (f α / w))) =
        -(U * Real.log (U / w)) + U * Real.log (T.card : ℝ) := by
    intro N T U w dec hU_nn hne hw f
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · have hf0 : ∀ α : Fin N, f α = 0 := by
        intro α; dsimp only [f]; rw [hU0, zero_div, ite_self]
      simp [hf0, hU0]
    · have hU_pos : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU_nn (Ne.symm hU0)
      have hcard_pos : 0 < (T.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr (hne hU_pos))
      have hw_pos : 0 < w := hw hU_pos
      let c := -((U / (T.card : ℝ)) * Real.log ((U / (T.card : ℝ)) / w))
      have hcongr : (∑ α : Fin N, -(f α * Real.log (f α / w))) =
          ∑ α : Fin N, @ite ℝ (α ∈ T) (dec α) c 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [f, c]
        by_cases hα : α ∈ T <;> simp [hα]
      rw [hcongr, h_ite_card]
      dsimp only [c]
      have hdiv_eq : (U / (T.card : ℝ)) / w = (U / w) / (T.card : ℝ) := by
        rw [div_div, mul_comm (T.card : ℝ) w, ← div_div]
      rw [hdiv_eq, Real.log_div (div_pos hU_pos hw_pos).ne' hcard_pos.ne']
      have hmul : (T.card : ℝ) * (U / (T.card : ℝ)) = U := mul_div_cancel₀ U hcard_pos.ne'
      calc (T.card : ℝ) * -((U / (T.card : ℝ)) * (Real.log (U / w) - Real.log (T.card : ℝ)))
          = -(((T.card : ℝ) * (U / (T.card : ℝ))) * (Real.log (U / w) - Real.log (T.card : ℝ))) := by ring
        _ = -(U * (Real.log (U / w) - Real.log (T.card : ℝ))) := by rw [hmul]
        _ = -(U * Real.log (U / w)) + U * Real.log (T.card : ℝ) := by ring

  have h_unif_ent_one : ∀ {N : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin N)) (U : ℝ)
      (dec : DecidablePred (fun α : Fin N => α ∈ T)),
      0 ≤ U → (0 < U → T.Nonempty) →
      let f := fun α : Fin N => @ite ℝ (α ∈ T) (dec α) (U / (T.card : ℝ)) 0
      (∑ α : Fin N, -(f α * Real.log (f α))) =
        -(U * Real.log U) + U * Real.log (T.card : ℝ) := by
    intro N T U dec hU_nn hne f
    simpa only [div_one] using h_unif_ent T U 1 dec hU_nn hne (fun _ => zero_lt_one)

  
  
  
  letI := Classical.propDecidable

  have hpO_nn : ∀ o : Fin N_O, 0 ≤ p_O o :=

  have hpO_zero_of_not_mem : ∀ {o : Fin N_O}, o ∉ S_act → p_O o = 0 := by

  have h_sum_SZ : ∀ φ : Fin N_O → ℝ, (∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ o ∈ F_z z, φ o) = ∑ o ∈ S_act, φ o :=

    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hzq]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem Q_of ho₀
    · rwa [hzq]
    · have ho₀_F : o₀ ∈ F_z (Z_of o₀) := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ho₀, rfl⟩

  have hqQT_sum_rl : ∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (rl : Fin N_rl),

      ext o

        obtain ⟨ho_act, _⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp h_arl
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ho_act, hqo⟩
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨ho_act, hqo⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp h

        = ∑ q ∈ S_Q_rl rl, ∑ o ∈ H_q q, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_cand o d α :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => hqQT_fib q α)
      _ = ∑ q ∈ S_Q_rl rl, ∑ o ∈ A_rl.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q), ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_cand o d α :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq => by rw [hfib_eq q hq])
      _ = ∑ o ∈ A_rl, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_cand o d α :=
          h_sum_fib_maps_to A_rl (S_Q_rl rl) Q_of _ _ hmaps
      _ = q_TR α rl := by
          dsimp only [q_TR]
          refine Finset.sum_subset ?_ ?_
          · intro o ho
            obtain ⟨_, hmod⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho
            exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, hmod⟩
          · intro o ho_u ho_n
            have hmod : r_O o % N_rl = rl.1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho_u).2
            have ho_not_act : o ∉ S_act :=
              fun ho_act => ho_n (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ho_act, hmod⟩)
            exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => hqc_zero_of_not_mem ho_not_act d α)

  have hqTR_sum : ∀ α : Fin N_ret, (∑ rl : Fin N_rl, q_TR α rl) = q_T α := by
    intro α
    calc ∑ rl : Fin N_rl, q_TR α rl
        = ∑ rl : Fin N_rl, ∑ q ∈ S_Q_rl rl, q_QT q α :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun rl _ => (hqQT_sum_rl α rl).symm)
      _ = ∑ q ∈ S_Q, q_QT q α := h_sum_SQ_rl (fun q => q_QT q α)
      _ = q_T α := hqQT_sum_q α

  
  
  
  let H_O := ∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))
  let H_OD := ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d))
  let E_site := ∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log (m_site o)
  let H_Z := ∑ z ∈ S_Z, -(p_Z z * Real.log (p_Z z))
  let H_ZD := ∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_ZD z d * Real.log (p_ZD z d / p_D d))
  let M_Z := ∑ z ∈ S_Z, p_Z z * Real.log (m_Z z)
  let H_Q := ∑ q ∈ S_Q, -(p_Q q * Real.log (p_Q q))
  let H_ZQ := ∑ q ∈ S_Q, ∑ z ∈ G_q q, -(p_Z z * Real.log (p_Z z / p_Q q))

  have hHO_act : H_O = ∑ o ∈ S_act, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o)) := by
    dsimp only [H_O]
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_act) (fun o _ ho => ?_)).symm
    rw [hpO_zero_of_not_mem ho, zero_mul, neg_zero]

  have hHOD_act : H_OD = ∑ o ∈ S_act, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
      -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d)) := by
    dsimp only [H_OD]
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_act) (fun o _ ho => ?_)).symm
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => ?_)
    rw [hp_zero_of_not_mem ho d, zero_div, zero_mul, neg_zero]

  have hEsite_act : E_site = ∑ o ∈ S_act, p_O o * Real.log (m_site o) := by
    dsimp only [E_site]
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ S_act) (fun o _ ho => ?_)).symm
    rw [hpO_zero_of_not_mem ho, zero_mul]

  have h_OZ_uncond : H_O + E_site ≤ H_Z + M_Z := by
    rw [hHO_act, hEsite_act, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      ← h_sum_SZ (fun o => -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o)) + p_O o * Real.log (m_site o))]
    dsimp only [H_Z, M_Z]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z hz => ?_)
    exact h_gibbs_chain_one (F_z z) p_O m_site (p_Z z) (m_Z z)
      (fun o _ => hpO_nn o) rfl (hZ_props hz).2.2
      (fun o ho => (h_act o (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).1).2.2.1.le)
      (fun o ho _ => (h_act o (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).1).2.2.1)
      le_rfl

  have h_OZ_cond : H_OD + E_site ≤ H_ZD + M_Z := by
    have h_lhs : H_OD + E_site = ∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        ∑ o ∈ F_z z, (-(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d)) +
          p_cond o d * Real.log (m_site o)) := by
      rw [hHOD_act, hEsite_act]
      have hE_expand : (∑ o ∈ S_act, p_O o * Real.log (m_site o)) =
          ∑ o ∈ S_act, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d * Real.log (m_site o) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => Finset.sum_mul Finset.univ (fun d => p_cond o d) _)
      rw [hE_expand, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      have h_inner : (∑ o ∈ S_act, ((∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d))) +
            ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_cond o d * Real.log (m_site o))) =
          ∑ o ∈ S_act, ∑ d : Fin N_D, (-(p_cond o d * Real.log (p_cond o d / p_D d)) +
            p_cond o d * Real.log (m_site o)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib.symm)
      rw [h_inner, ← h_sum_SZ]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
    have h_rhs : H_ZD + M_Z = ∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        (-(p_ZD z d * Real.log (p_ZD z d / p_D d)) + p_ZD z d * Real.log (m_Z z)) := by
      dsimp only [H_ZD, M_Z]
      have hM_expand : (∑ z ∈ S_Z, p_Z z * Real.log (m_Z z)) =
          ∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_ZD z d * Real.log (m_Z z) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => by
          rw [← hpZD_sum_d z, Finset.sum_mul])
      rw [hM_expand, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib.symm)
    rw [h_lhs, h_rhs]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z hz => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => ?_))
    exact h_gibbs_chain (F_z z) (fun o => p_cond o d) m_site (p_ZD z d) (p_D d) (m_Z z)
      (fun o _ => hp_nn o d) rfl (fun o _ hpos => hpD_pos_of_p_pos hpos)
      (hZ_props hz).2.2
      (fun o ho => (h_act o (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).1).2.2.1.le)
      (fun o ho _ => (h_act o (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).1).2.2.1)
      le_rfl

  have h_ZQ_split : H_Z = H_Q + H_ZQ := by
    dsimp only [H_Z, H_Q, H_ZQ]
    rw [← h_sum_SZ_SQ (fun z => -(p_Z z * Real.log (p_Z z))), add_comm, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ =>
      h_sum_ent_split_one (G_q q) p_Z (p_Q q) (fun z _ => hpZ_nn z) rfl)

  
  
  
  let E_card := ∑ q ∈ S_Q, p_Q q * Real.log ((T_cand q).card : ℝ)

  have h_Ecard_Z : (∑ z ∈ S_Z, p_Z z * Real.log ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ)) = E_card := by
    rw [← h_sum_SZ_SQ]
    dsimp only [E_card]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => ?_)
    have hcongr : (∑ z ∈ G_q q, p_Z z * Real.log ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ)) =
        ∑ z ∈ G_q q, p_Z z * Real.log ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z hz => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2])
    rw [hcongr, ← Finset.sum_mul]

  have h_coh_Q : H_ZQ + M_Z ≤
      E_card + Real.log m_bin + ξ * ell + Real.log C_coh_tot := by
    have hMZ_fib : M_Z = ∑ q ∈ S_Q, ∑ z ∈ G_q q, p_Z z * Real.log (m_Z z) :=
      (h_sum_SZ_SQ (fun z => p_Z z * Real.log (m_Z z))).symm
    have hlhs : H_ZQ + M_Z =
        ∑ q ∈ S_Q, ∑ z ∈ G_q q, (-(p_Z z * Real.log (p_Z z / p_Q q)) + p_Z z * Real.log (m_Z z)) := by
      dsimp only [H_ZQ]
      rw [hMZ_fib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib.symm)
    have h_pt : ∀ q ∈ S_Q,
        (∑ z ∈ G_q q, (-(p_Z z * Real.log (p_Z z / p_Q q)) + p_Z z * Real.log (m_Z z))) ≤
          p_Q q * Real.log ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) +
            p_Q q * (Real.log m_bin + ξ * ell + Real.log C_coh_tot) := by
      intro q hq
      have hcard_pos : 0 < ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) :=
        Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr (hQ_props hq).1)
      have hrpow_pos : 0 < ε ^ (-ξ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-ξ)
      let B_Q := C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-ξ) * ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * m_bin
      have hBQ_pos : 0 < B_Q :=
        mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hC_coh_pos hrpow_pos) hcard_pos) hm_bin
      have hm_le : ∑ z ∈ G_q q, m_Z z ≤ B_Q := by
        rw [hmZ_sum_G q]
        exact hQ_sum q
      have hg := h_gibbs (G_q q) p_Z m_Z (p_Q q) B_Q
        (fun z _ => hpZ_nn z) rfl hBQ_pos
        (fun z hz => (hZ_props (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).1).2.2.le)
        (fun z hz _ => (hZ_props (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).1).2.2)
        hm_le
      have hlog_BQ : Real.log B_Q =
          Real.log ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) + (Real.log m_bin + ξ * ell + Real.log C_coh_tot) := by
        dsimp only [B_Q, ell]
        rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos (mul_pos hC_coh_pos hrpow_pos) hcard_pos).ne' hm_bin.ne',
          Real.log_mul (mul_pos hC_coh_pos hrpow_pos).ne' hcard_pos.ne',
          Real.log_mul hC_coh_pos.ne' hrpow_pos.ne',
          hlog_rpow (-ξ)]
        ring
      rw [hlog_BQ, mul_add] at hg
      exact hg
    rw [hlhs]
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hpQ_sum, one_mul] at hsum
    change (∑ q ∈ S_Q, ∑ z ∈ G_q q, (-(p_Z z * Real.log (p_Z z / p_Q q)) + p_Z z * Real.log (m_Z z))) ≤
      E_card + (Real.log m_bin + ξ * ell + Real.log C_coh_tot) at hsum
    linarith only [hsum]

  have h_coh_Z : M_Z ≤ E_card + Real.log m_bin +
      (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h + 2 * θ + 2 * ξ) * ell +
      Real.log C_coh_tot + 4 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ) := by
    let exp_Z := (d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - 2 * ξ
    let C_Z_const := Real.log m_bin + (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h + 2 * θ + 2 * ξ) * ell +
      Real.log C_coh_tot + 4 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ)
    have h_pt : ∀ z ∈ S_Z, p_Z z * Real.log (m_Z z) ≤
        p_Z z * Real.log ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) + p_Z z * C_Z_const := by
      intro z hz
      have hmZ_pos : 0 < m_Z z := (hZ_props hz).2.2
      have hcard_pos : 0 < ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) :=
        Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr (hZ_props hz).2.1)
      have hrpow_pos : 0 < ε ^ exp_Z := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ exp_Z
      let B_Z := C_coh_tot * ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ exp_Z * ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) * m_bin
      have hlog_le : Real.log (m_Z z) ≤ Real.log B_Z :=
        Real.log_le_log hmZ_pos (hZ_sum z)
      have hlog_BZ : Real.log B_Z = Real.log ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) + C_Z_const := by
        dsimp only [B_Z, C_Z_const, exp_Z, ell]
        rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hC_coh_pos hML4_pos) hrpow_pos) hcard_pos).ne' hm_bin.ne',
          Real.log_mul (mul_pos (mul_pos hC_coh_pos hML4_pos) hrpow_pos).ne' hcard_pos.ne',
          Real.log_mul (mul_pos hC_coh_pos hML4_pos).ne' hrpow_pos.ne',
          Real.log_mul hC_coh_pos.ne' hML4_pos.ne',
          hlog_ML4, hlog_rpow ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - 2 * ξ)]
        ring
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_le (hpZ_nn z)
      rwa [hlog_BZ, mul_add] at hmul
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pt
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, h_Ecard_Z, ← Finset.sum_mul, hpZ_sum, one_mul] at hsum
    dsimp only [C_Z_const] at hsum
    linarith only [hsum]

  
  
  
  let H_qT := ∑ α : Fin N_ret, -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α))
  let H_qTD := ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d))
  let H_qTR := ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ rl : Fin N_rl, -(q_TR α rl * Real.log (q_TR α rl / q_T α))

  have h_QT_bound : H_Q + E_card ≤ H_qT + H_qTR + 2 * θ * ell + Real.log C_coh_tot := by
    have h_expand : (∑ q ∈ S_Q, ∑ α : Fin N_ret, -(q_QT q α * Real.log (q_QT q α))) =
        H_Q + E_card := by
      dsimp only [H_Q, E_card]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq => ?_)
      exact h_unif_ent_one (T_cand q) (p_Q q) _ (hpQ_nn q) (fun _ => (hQ_props hq).1)
    let K_Q := C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ)
    have hrpow_Q : 0 < ε ^ (-2 * θ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-2 * θ)
    have hKQ_pos : 0 < K_Q := mul_pos hC_coh_pos hrpow_Q
    have hlog_KQ : Real.log K_Q = 2 * θ * ell + Real.log C_coh_tot := by
      dsimp only [K_Q, ell]
      rw [Real.log_mul hC_coh_pos.ne' hrpow_Q.ne', hlog_rpow (-2 * θ)]
      ring
    have h_α : ∀ α : Fin N_ret,
        (∑ q ∈ S_Q, -(q_QT q α * Real.log (q_QT q α))) ≤
          -(q_T α * Real.log (q_T α)) +
            (∑ rl : Fin N_rl, -(q_TR α rl * Real.log (q_TR α rl / q_T α))) +
            q_T α * Real.log K_Q := by
      intro α
      rw [← h_sum_SQ_rl (fun q => -(q_QT q α * Real.log (q_QT q α)))]
      have h_rl : ∀ rl : Fin N_rl,
          (∑ q ∈ S_Q_rl rl, -(q_QT q α * Real.log (q_QT q α))) ≤
            -(q_TR α rl * Real.log (q_TR α rl)) + q_TR α rl * Real.log K_Q := by
        intro rl
        let S_Q_act := S_Q.filter (fun q => q.2.1 = rl.1 ∧ α ∈ T_cand q)
        have hsub : S_Q_act ⊆ S_Q_rl rl := by
          intro q hq
          obtain ⟨hq_S, hq_rl, _⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hq_S, hq_rl⟩
        have hsupp : ∀ q ∈ S_Q_rl rl, 0 < q_QT q α → q ∈ S_Q_act := by
          intro q hq hpos
          obtain ⟨hq_S, hq_rl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
          refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hq_S, hq_rl, ?_⟩
          by_contra hnot
          have h0 : q_QT q α = 0 := by
            dsimp only [q_QT]
            split_ifs
            rfl
          linarith only [hpos, h0]
        exact h_supp_card_chain_one (S_Q_rl rl) S_Q_act (fun q => q_QT q α) (q_TR α rl) K_Q
          hsub (fun q _ => hqQT_nn q α) (hqQT_sum_rl α rl) hsupp hKQ_pos
          (fun _ => hQ_card α rl.1)
      have hsum_rl := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun rl (_ : rl ∈ Finset.univ) => h_rl rl)
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hqTR_sum α,
        h_sum_ent_split_one Finset.univ (fun rl => q_TR α rl) (q_T α)
          (fun rl _ => hqTR_nn α rl) (hqTR_sum α)] at hsum_rl
      linarith only [hsum_rl]
    rw [← h_expand, Finset.sum_comm]
    have hsum_α := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α (_ : α ∈ Finset.univ) => h_α α)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
      hqT_sum, one_mul, hlog_KQ] at hsum_α
    dsimp only [H_qT, H_qTR]
    linarith only [hsum_α]

  have h_ZTD_bound : H_ZD + E_card ≤
      H_qTD + (2 * θ + ζ_sh) * ell + Real.log C_coh_tot := by
    have h_expand : (∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin N_ret,
        -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d))) = H_ZD + E_card := by
      have h_z : ∀ z ∈ S_Z,
          (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin N_ret, -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d))) =
            (∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p_ZD z d * Real.log (p_ZD z d / p_D d))) +
              p_Z z * Real.log ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) := by
        intro z hz
        have h_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
            (∑ α : Fin N_ret, -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d))) =
              -(p_ZD z d * Real.log (p_ZD z d / p_D d)) +
                p_ZD z d * Real.log ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) := by
          intro d
          refine h_unif_ent (T_cand z.1) (p_ZD z d) (p_D d) _ (hpZD_nn z d)
            (fun _ => (hZ_props hz).2.1) (fun hpos => ?_)
          rw [← hpZD_sum_z d]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (Finset.single_le_sum (fun z' _ => hpZD_nn z' d) hz)
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_d d), Finset.sum_add_distrib,
          ← Finset.sum_mul, hpZD_sum_d z]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_z, Finset.sum_add_distrib, h_Ecard_Z]
    let K_ZD := C_coh_tot * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh)
    have hrpow_ZD : 0 < ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε₀ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh)
    have hKZD_pos : 0 < K_ZD := mul_pos hC_coh_pos hrpow_ZD
    have hlog_KZD : Real.log K_ZD = (2 * θ + ζ_sh) * ell + Real.log C_coh_tot := by
      dsimp only [K_ZD, ell]
      rw [Real.log_mul hC_coh_pos.ne' hrpow_ZD.ne', hlog_rpow (-2 * θ - ζ_sh)]
      ring
    have h_swap : (∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin N_ret,
          -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d))) =
        ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ z ∈ S_Z,
          -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d)) := by
      calc ∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin N_ret,
              -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d))
          = ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ z ∈ S_Z, ∑ α : Fin N_ret,
              -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d)) := Finset.sum_comm
        _ = ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ z ∈ S_Z,
              -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d)) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm)
        _ = ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ z ∈ S_Z,
              -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d)) := Finset.sum_comm
    have h_αd : ∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (d : Fin N_D),
        (∑ z ∈ S_Z, -(q_ZTD z d α * Real.log (q_ZTD z d α / p_D d))) ≤
          -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d)) + q_TD α d * Real.log K_ZD := by
      intro α d
      let S_Z_ad :=
        (S_act.filter (fun o => 0 < p_cond o d ∧ α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o))).image Z_of
      have hsub : S_Z_ad ⊆ S_Z := by
        intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨o, ho, rfl⟩
        exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z_of (Finset.mem_filter.mp ho).1
      have hpD_of_qZTD : ∀ z ∈ S_Z, 0 < q_ZTD z d α → 0 < p_D d := by
        intro z hz hpos
        have hle : q_ZTD z d α ≤ q_TD α d := by
          rw [← hqZTD_sum_z α d]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun z' _ => hqZTD_nn z' d α) hz
        have hle2 : q_TD α d ≤ p_D d := by
          rw [← hqTD_sum_α d]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hqTD_nn α' d) (Finset.mem_univ α)
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (le_trans hle hle2)
      have hsupp : ∀ z ∈ S_Z, 0 < q_ZTD z d α → z ∈ S_Z_ad := by
        intro z _ hpos
        have hα_mem : α ∈ T_cand z.1 := by
          by_contra hnot
          have h0 : q_ZTD z d α = 0 := by
            dsimp only [q_ZTD]
            split_ifs
            rfl
          linarith only [hpos, h0]
        have hpos_div : 0 < p_ZD z d / ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) := by
          dsimp only [q_ZTD] at hpos
          split_ifs at hpos
          exact hpos
        have hcard_pos : 0 < ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) :=
          Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨α, hα_mem⟩)
        have hpZD_pos : 0 < p_ZD z d := by
          by_contra hle
          have h0 : p_ZD z d = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hle) (hpZD_nn z d)
          rw [h0, zero_div] at hpos_div
          exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos_div
        obtain ⟨o, ho_F, hp_pos⟩ :=
          (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun o' _ => hp_nn o' d)).mp hpZD_pos
        obtain ⟨ho_act, hzo⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho_F
        have hqo : Q_of o = z.1 := (h_act o ho_act).1.symm.trans (congrArg Prod.fst hzo)
        rw [← hqo] at hα_mem
        rw [← hzo]
        exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem Z_of (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ho_act, hp_pos, hα_mem⟩)
      have hcard_guard : 0 < q_TD α d → (S_Z_ad.card : ℝ) ≤ K_ZD := by
        intro hqTD_pos
        have hpD_pos : 0 < p_D d := by
          rw [← hqTD_sum_α d]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hqTD_pos
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hqTD_nn α' d) (Finset.mem_univ α))
        exact hZ_card α d hpD_pos
      exact h_supp_card_chain S_Z S_Z_ad (fun z => q_ZTD z d α) (q_TD α d) (p_D d) K_ZD
        hsub (fun z _ => hqZTD_nn z d α) (hqZTD_sum_z α d) hpD_of_qZTD hsupp hKZD_pos hcard_guard
    rw [← h_expand, h_swap]
    have hsum_αd := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α (_ : α ∈ Finset.univ) =>
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d (_ : d ∈ Finset.univ) => h_αd α d))
    have hrhs_split : (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
          (-(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d)) + q_TD α d * Real.log K_ZD)) =
        H_qTD + (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_TD α d) * Real.log K_ZD := by
      dsimp only [H_qTD]
      have h1 : (∑ α : Fin N_ret, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            (-(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d)) + q_TD α d * Real.log K_ZD)) =
          ∑ α : Fin N_ret, ((∑ d : Fin N_D, -(q_TD α d * Real.log (q_TD α d / p_D d))) +
            (∑ d : Fin N_D, q_TD α d) * Real.log K_ZD) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul])
      rw [h1, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [hrhs_split, hqTD_sum, one_mul, hlog_KZD] at hsum_αd
    linarith only [hsum_αd]

  
  
  
  refine ⟨hqD_eq, ?_⟩
  have h_raw : H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_OD + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_site ≤
      H_qT + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log m_bin +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (H_qTD + 2 * H_qTR + (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) * ell) +
        (4 * θ + 2 * ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ_sh) * ell +
        (3 * Real.log C_coh_tot + 2 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ)) := by
    linarith only [h_OZ_uncond, h_OZ_cond, h_ZQ_split, h_coh_Q, h_coh_Z, h_QT_bound, h_ZTD_bound]

  have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_raw hell_nn
  have hlhs_div : (H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_OD + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_site) / ell =
      H_O / ell + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (H_OD / ell) + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (E_site / ell) := by
    ring
  have hrhs_div :
      (H_qT + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log m_bin +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (H_qTD + 2 * H_qTR + (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) * ell) +
        (4 * θ + 2 * ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ_sh) * ell +
        (3 * Real.log C_coh_tot + 2 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ))) / ell =
      H_qT / ell + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log m_bin / ell) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (H_qTD / ell + 2 * (H_qTR / ell) +
          (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) * (ell / ell)) +
        (4 * θ + 2 * ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ_sh) * (ell / ell) +
        (3 * Real.log C_coh_tot + 2 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ)) / ell := by
    ring
  rw [hlhs_div, hrhs_div, div_self hell_pos.ne'] at h_div
  have hrhs_clean :
      H_qT / ell + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log m_bin / ell) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (H_qTD / ell + 2 * (H_qTR / ell) +
          (k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) * 1) +
        (4 * θ + 2 * ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ_sh) * 1 +
        (3 * Real.log C_coh_tot + 2 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ)) / ell =
      H_qT / ell + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log m_bin / ell) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (H_qTD / ell + 2 * (H_qTR / ell) + k_out - (d_dim : ℝ) * h) +
        4 * θ + 2 * ξ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ_sh +
        (3 * Real.log C_coh_tot + 2 * Real.log (M_L : ℝ)) / ell := by
    ring
  rw [hrhs_clean] at h_div
  dsimp only [H_O, H_OD, E_site, H_qT, H_qTD, H_qTR, N_rl] at h_div
  rwa [hqD_eq]

informal_problem.statement:
(ε : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : ε < 1 / 4)
    (N_O N_D N_J : ℕ) (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
    (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (Q_of : Fin N_J → Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (T_cand : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin (N_ret_of j)))
    (F_of : ∀ j : Fin N_J, Fin N_O → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hp_nn : ∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d)
    (hp_sum : ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1)
    (hT_ne : ∀ o d, 0 < p o d → (T_cand (win_of o) (Q_of (win_of o) o)).Nonempty) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
    let π_J := fun j : Fin N_J =>
      ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => win_of o = j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
    let q_cand : ∀ j : Fin N_J, Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℝ :=
      fun j o d α =>
        if win_of o = j ∧ 0 < π_J j ∧ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o) then
          (p o d / π_J j) / ((T_cand j (Q_of j o)).card : ℝ)
        else 0
    let π_FTJ := fun j (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) =>
      ∑ o, ∑ d, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_of j o α = ft),
        π_J j * q_cand j o d α
    let π_TFTJ := fun j ft α =>
      ∑ o, ∑ d, if F_of j o α = ft then π_J j * q_cand j o d α else 0
    let π_DFTJ := fun j ft d =>
      ∑ o, ∑ α ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun α => F_of j o α = ft),
        π_J j * q_cand j o d α
    let π_TDFTJ := fun j ft α d =>
      ∑ o, if F_of j o α = ft then π_J j * q_cand j o d α else 0
    let S_FT : Fin N_J → Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := fun j =>
      (Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).image (fun oα : Fin N_O × Fin (N_ret_of j) =>
        F_of j oα.1 oα.2)
    let I_TD_FTJ : ℝ :=
      (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
        if 0 < π_FTJ j ft then
          π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
            (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))
        else 0) / ell
    0 ≤ I_TD_FTJ ∧
    (∀ (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
       (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ)
       (B_FTJ B_TW B_DW : ℝ),
       0 < B_FTJ → 0 < B_TW → 0 < B_DW →
       (∀ p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
         (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => P_f o = p_c ∧ 0 < ∑ d, p o d)).biUnion
           (fun o => (T_cand (win_of o) (Q_of (win_of o) o)).image
             (fun α => (win_of o, F_of (win_of o) o α)))).card : ℝ) ≤ B_FTJ) →
       (∀ (j : Fin N_J) (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (α : Fin (N_ret_of j)),
         (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
           win_of o = j ∧ (0 < ∑ d, p o d) ∧ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o) ∧
             F_of j o α = ft)).image W_f).card : ℝ) ≤ B_TW) →
       (∀ (j : Fin N_J) (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (d : Fin N_D),
         (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
           win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p o d ∧
             ∃ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o), F_of j o α = ft)).image W_f).card : ℝ) ≤ B_DW) →
       let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
       let p_P := fun p_c => ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), p_O o
       let p_PW := fun p_c w =>
         ∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w), p_O o
       (∑ p_c ∈ Finset.univ.image P_f, ∑ w ∈ Finset.univ.image W_f,
         -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) / ell -
       (Real.log B_FTJ + Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW) / ell ≤ I_TD_FTJ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hell_pos_raw : 0 < Real.log (ε⁻¹) :=
    Real.log_pos ((one_lt_inv₀ hε₀).mpr (by linarith only [hε₁]))
  have hell_nn_raw : 0 ≤ Real.log (ε⁻¹) := hell_pos_raw.le

  have h_log_le_sub_one : ∀ {y x : ℝ}, 0 < y → y ≤ x → Real.log y ≤ x - 1 := by
    intro y x hy hyx
    exact (Real.log_le_log hy hyx).trans (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hy hyx))

  have h_supp_card_ent : ∀ {ι : Type} (S₀ L : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (U B : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 ≤ u i) →
      (∑ i ∈ S₀, u i = U) →
      (∀ i ∈ S₀, 0 < u i → i ∈ L) →
      0 < B →
      (L.card : ℝ) ≤ B →
      (∑ i ∈ S₀, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) ≤ U * Real.log B := by
    intro ι S₀ L u U B hu_nn hU hsupp hB_pos hL_card
    have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := by rw [← hU]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg hu_nn
    by_cases hU0 : U = 0
    · have hu0 : ∀ i ∈ S₀, u i = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hu_nn).mp (hU.trans hU0)
      rw [hU0, zero_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => by
        rw [hu0 i hi, zero_div, zero_mul, neg_zero])]
    · have hU_pos : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU_nn (Ne.symm hU0)
      let dec_pos : DecidablePred (fun i : ι => 0 < u i) :=
        fun i => Classical.propDecidable (0 < u i)
      let S_pos : Finset ι := @Finset.filter ι (fun i => 0 < u i) dec_pos S₀
      have hsub_S₀ : S_pos ⊆ S₀ := @Finset.filter_subset ι (fun i => 0 < u i) dec_pos S₀
      have hzero_out : ∀ i ∈ S₀, i ∉ S_pos → u i = 0 := by
        intro i hi₀ hi_not
        have hnot_pos : ¬ (0 < u i) := fun hpos =>
          hi_not ((@Finset.mem_filter ι (fun i => 0 < u i) dec_pos S₀ i).mpr ⟨hi₀, hpos⟩)
        exact le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hnot_pos) (hu_nn i hi₀)
      have hU_pos_sum : ∑ i ∈ S_pos, u i = U := by
        rw [← hU]
        exact Finset.sum_subset hsub_S₀ hzero_out
      have hent_eq : (∑ i ∈ S_pos, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U))) =
          ∑ i ∈ S₀, -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) :=
        Finset.sum_subset hsub_S₀ (fun i hi₀ hi_not => by
          rw [hzero_out i hi₀ hi_not, zero_div, zero_mul, neg_zero])
      have hsub_L : S_pos ⊆ L := by
        intro i hi
        have hm := (@Finset.mem_filter ι (fun i => 0 < u i) dec_pos S₀ i).mp hi
        exact hsupp i hm.1 hm.2
      have hS_pos_card : (S_pos.card : ℝ) ≤ B :=
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.card_le_card hsub_L)).trans hL_card
      have hpt : ∀ i ∈ S_pos,
          -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) - u i * Real.log B ≤ U / B - u i := by
        intro i hi
        have hui : 0 < u i := ((@Finset.mem_filter ι (fun i => 0 < u i) dec_pos S₀ i).mp hi).2
        let x := (U / B) / u i
        have hx_pos : 0 < x := div_pos (div_pos hU_pos hB_pos) hui
        have hlog : Real.log x = -Real.log (u i / U) - Real.log B := by
          dsimp only [x]
          rw [Real.log_div (div_pos hU_pos hB_pos).ne' hui.ne',
            Real.log_div hU_pos.ne' hB_pos.ne',
            Real.log_div hui.ne' hU_pos.ne']
          ring
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx_pos) hui.le
        have hlhs : u i * Real.log x = -(u i * Real.log (u i / U)) - u i * Real.log B := by
          rw [hlog]; ring
        have hrhs : u i * (x - 1) = U / B - u i := by
          dsimp only [x]
          rw [mul_sub, mul_one, mul_div_cancel₀ (U / B) hui.ne']
        rwa [hlhs, hrhs] at h1
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hU_pos_sum, hent_eq,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hU_pos_sum] at hsum
      have hcard_mul : (S_pos.card : ℝ) * (U / B) ≤ U := by
        calc (S_pos.card : ℝ) * (U / B)
            ≤ B * (U / B) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS_pos_card (div_nonneg hU_pos.le hB_pos.le)
          _ = U := mul_div_cancel₀ U hB_pos.ne'
      linarith only [hsum, hcard_mul]

  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  intro ell π_J q_cand π_FTJ π_TFTJ π_DFTJ π_TDFTJ S_FT I_TD_FTJ
  have hell_nn : 0 ≤ ell := hell_nn_raw

  
  let wt : ∀ j : Fin N_J, Fin N_O → Fin N_D → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℝ :=
    fun j o d α => π_J j * q_cand j o d α
  have hπJ_nn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, 0 ≤ π_J j :=
    fun _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hp_nn o d))
  have h_wt : ∀ (j : Fin N_J) (o : Fin N_O) (d : Fin N_D) (α : Fin (N_ret_of j)),
      wt j o d α =
        if win_of o = j ∧ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o) then
