      intro o
      rw [h_sum_S_JFT (fun u => w_FT u.1 u.2 o),
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hw_FT_sum_ft j o), Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_wt_sum_jα o d)

    have hQ4_nn : ∀ u p_c w, 0 ≤ Q_4 u p_c w := by
      intro u p_c w
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w
      · rw [if_pos h]; exact hw_FT_nn u.1 u.2 o
      · rw [if_neg h]

    have hQUP_nn : ∀ u p_c, 0 ≤ Q_UP u p_c := by
      intro u p_c
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : P_f o = p_c
      · rw [if_pos h]; exact hw_FT_nn u.1 u.2 o
      · rw [if_neg h]

    have hPW_nn : ∀ j ft w, 0 ≤ P_W j ft w := by
      intro j ft w
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : W_f o = w
      · rw [if_pos h]; exact hw_FT_nn j ft o
      · rw [if_neg h]

    have hQ4_sum_w : ∀ u p_c, (∑ w ∈ S_W, Q_4 u p_c w) = Q_UP u p_c := by
      intro u p_c
      dsimp only [Q_4, Q_UP]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h_sum_and_S_W o p_c (w_FT u.1 u.2 o))

    have hQ4_sum_p : ∀ u w, (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, Q_4 u p_c w) = P_W u.1 u.2 w := by
      intro u w
      dsimp only [Q_4, P_W]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h_sum_and_S_P o w (w_FT u.1 u.2 o))

    have hQ4_sum_u : ∀ p_c w, (∑ u ∈ S_JFT, Q_4 u p_c w) = p_PW p_c w := by
      intro p_c w
      dsimp only [Q_4, p_PW]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : P_f o = p_c ∧ W_f o = w
      · rw [if_pos h]
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => if_pos h)).trans (hw_FT_sum_u o)
      · rw [if_neg h]
        exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun u _ => if_neg h)

    have hQUP_sum_u : ∀ p_c, (∑ u ∈ S_JFT, Q_UP u p_c) = p_P p_c := by
      intro p_c
      dsimp only [Q_UP, p_P]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
      by_cases h : P_f o = p_c
      · rw [if_pos h]
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => if_pos h)).trans (hw_FT_sum_u o)
      · rw [if_neg h]
        exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun u _ => if_neg h)

    have hQUP_sum_p : ∀ u, (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, Q_UP u p_c) = π_FTJ u.1 u.2 := by
      intro u
      dsimp only [Q_UP]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h_sum_ite_S_P o (w_FT u.1 u.2 o))).trans
        (hw_FT_sum_o u.1 u.2)

    have hPW_sum_w : ∀ j ft, (∑ w ∈ S_W, P_W j ft w) = π_FTJ j ft := by
      intro j ft
      dsimp only [P_W]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h_sum_ite_S_W o (w_FT j ft o))).trans
        (hw_FT_sum_o j ft)

    have hpO_nn : ∀ o, 0 ≤ p_O o := fun o => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hp_nn o d)
    have hpPW_nn : ∀ p_c w, 0 ≤ p_PW p_c w :=
      fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => hpO_nn o)
    have hpPW_sum_w : ∀ p_c, (∑ w ∈ S_W, p_PW p_c w) = p_P p_c := by
      intro p_c
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => (hQ4_sum_u p_c w).symm), Finset.sum_comm,
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => hQ4_sum_w u p_c), hQUP_sum_u p_c]

    have hpP_sum : (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, p_P p_c) = 1 := by
      dsimp only [p_P, p_O]
      have h1 : ∀ p_c, (∑ o ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun o => P_f o = p_c), ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d) =
          ∑ o : Fin N_O, if P_f o = p_c then ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d else 0 :=
        fun _ => Finset.sum_filter _ _
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ => h1 p_c), Finset.sum_comm]
      exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h_sum_ite_S_P o _)).trans hp_sum

    have h_4way_pt : ∀ u ∈ S_JFT, ∀ p_c ∈ S_P, ∀ w ∈ S_W,
        Q_4 u p_c w * (-Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c) +
          Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c) +
          Real.log (P_W u.1 u.2 w / π_FTJ u.1 u.2)) ≤
          (if 0 < π_FTJ u.1 u.2 then
            (Q_UP u p_c * P_W u.1 u.2 w) / π_FTJ u.1 u.2
          else 0) - Q_4 u p_c w := by
      intro u hu p_c hp_c w hw
      by_cases hQ0 : Q_4 u p_c w = 0
      · rw [hQ0, zero_mul, sub_zero]
        by_cases hUu : 0 < π_FTJ u.1 u.2
        · rw [if_pos hUu]
          exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hQUP_nn u p_c) (hPW_nn u.1 u.2 w)) hUu.le
        · rw [if_neg hUu]
      · have hQ_pos : 0 < Q_4 u p_c w := lt_of_le_of_ne (hQ4_nn u p_c w) (Ne.symm hQ0)
        have hQ_le_pPW : Q_4 u p_c w ≤ p_PW p_c w := by
          rw [← hQ4_sum_u p_c w]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun u' _ => hQ4_nn u' p_c w) hu
        have hpPW_pos : 0 < p_PW p_c w := lt_of_lt_of_le hQ_pos hQ_le_pPW
        have hpP_pos : 0 < p_P p_c := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hpPW_pos ?_
          rw [← hpPW_sum_w p_c]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun w' _ => hpPW_nn p_c w') hw
        have hQUP_pos : 0 < Q_UP u p_c := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hQ_pos ?_
          rw [← hQ4_sum_w u p_c]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun w' _ => hQ4_nn u p_c w') hw
        have hPW_pos : 0 < P_W u.1 u.2 w := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hQ_pos ?_
          rw [← hQ4_sum_p u w]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun p_c' _ => hQ4_nn u p_c' w) hp_c
        have hUu_pos : 0 < π_FTJ u.1 u.2 := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hPW_pos ?_
          rw [← hPW_sum_w u.1 u.2]
          exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun w' _ => hPW_nn u.1 u.2 w') hw
        rw [if_pos hUu_pos]
        let y := (Q_UP u p_c / p_PW p_c w) * (P_W u.1 u.2 w / π_FTJ u.1 u.2)
        let x := (Q_UP u p_c / Q_4 u p_c w) * (P_W u.1 u.2 w / π_FTJ u.1 u.2)
        have hy_pos : 0 < y := mul_pos (div_pos hQUP_pos hpPW_pos) (div_pos hPW_pos hUu_pos)
        have hyx : y ≤ x :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hQUP_pos.le hQ_pos hQ_le_pPW)
            (div_pos hPW_pos hUu_pos).le
        have hlog : Real.log y =
            -Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c) +
              Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c) +
              Real.log (P_W u.1 u.2 w / π_FTJ u.1 u.2) := by
          dsimp only [y]
          rw [Real.log_mul (div_pos hQUP_pos hpPW_pos).ne' (div_pos hPW_pos hUu_pos).ne',
            Real.log_div hQUP_pos.ne' hpPW_pos.ne',
            Real.log_div hPW_pos.ne' hUu_pos.ne',
            Real.log_div hpPW_pos.ne' hpP_pos.ne',
            Real.log_div hQUP_pos.ne' hpP_pos.ne']
          ring
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_log_le_sub_one hy_pos hyx) hQ_pos.le
        have hrhs : Q_4 u p_c w * (x - 1) =
            (Q_UP u p_c * P_W u.1 u.2 w) / π_FTJ u.1 u.2 - Q_4 u p_c w := by
          dsimp only [x]
          rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ (Q_UP u p_c) hQ_pos.ne',
            mul_div_assoc']
        rwa [hlog, hrhs] at h1

    have h_4way_sum :
        (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) -
          (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ u ∈ S_JFT, -(Q_UP u p_c * Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c))) ≤
          ∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, H_W_fiber j ft := by
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u hu =>
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p_c hp_c =>
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun w hw => h_4way_pt u hu p_c hp_c w hw)))
      have hrhs_zero : (∑ u ∈ S_JFT, ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
          ((if 0 < π_FTJ u.1 u.2 then
            (Q_UP u p_c * P_W u.1 u.2 w) / π_FTJ u.1 u.2
          else 0) - Q_4 u p_c w)) = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun u _ => ?_)
        have hq4_pw : (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, Q_4 u p_c w) = π_FTJ u.1 u.2 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ => hQ4_sum_w u p_c), hQUP_sum_p u]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ => Finset.sum_sub_distrib _ _),
          Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hq4_pw]
        by_cases hUu : 0 < π_FTJ u.1 u.2
        · have h_in : ∀ p_c ∈ S_P,
              (∑ w ∈ S_W, if 0 < π_FTJ u.1 u.2 then
                (Q_UP u p_c * P_W u.1 u.2 w) / π_FTJ u.1 u.2 else 0) = Q_UP u p_c := by
            intro p_c _
            rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => if_pos hUu), ← Finset.sum_div,
              ← Finset.mul_sum, hPW_sum_w u.1 u.2, mul_div_cancel_right₀ (Q_UP u p_c) hUu.ne']
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_in, hQUP_sum_p u, sub_self]
        · have hUu0 : π_FTJ u.1 u.2 = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hUu) (hπ_FTJ_nn u.1 u.2)
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun p_c _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun w _ => if_neg hUu)),
            hUu0, sub_self]
      have hlhs_split : (∑ u ∈ S_JFT, ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
          Q_4 u p_c w * (-Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c) +
            Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c) +
            Real.log (P_W u.1 u.2 w / π_FTJ u.1 u.2))) =
          (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) -
            (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ u ∈ S_JFT, -(Q_UP u p_c * Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c))) -
            (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, H_W_fiber j ft) := by
        have hexp : ∀ u p_c w,
            Q_4 u p_c w * (-Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c) +
              Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c) +
              Real.log (P_W u.1 u.2 w / π_FTJ u.1 u.2)) =
            -(Q_4 u p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c)) -
              -(Q_4 u p_c w * Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c)) -
              -(Q_4 u p_c w * Real.log (P_W u.1 u.2 w / π_FTJ u.1 u.2)) := by
          intro u p_c w; ring
        have h1 : (∑ u ∈ S_JFT, ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
            -(Q_4 u p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) =
            ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hQ4_sum_u p_c w]
        have h2 : (∑ u ∈ S_JFT, ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
            -(Q_4 u p_c w * Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c))) =
            ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ u ∈ S_JFT, -(Q_UP u p_c * Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p_c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_))
          rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hQ4_sum_w u p_c]
        have h3 : (∑ u ∈ S_JFT, ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
            -(Q_4 u p_c w * Real.log (P_W u.1 u.2 w / π_FTJ u.1 u.2))) =
            ∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, H_W_fiber j ft := by
          rw [← h_sum_S_JFT (fun u => H_W_fiber u.1 u.2)]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hQ4_sum_p u w]
        simp_rw [hexp, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        rw [h1, h2, h3]
      rw [hlhs_split, hrhs_zero] at hsum
      linarith only [hsum]

    have h_FTJ_ent : (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ u ∈ S_JFT,
        -(Q_UP u p_c * Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c))) ≤ Real.log B_FTJ := by
      have h_pc : ∀ p_c ∈ S_P,
          (∑ u ∈ S_JFT, -(Q_UP u p_c * Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c))) ≤
            p_P p_c * Real.log B_FTJ := by
        intro p_c _
        refine h_supp_card_ent S_JFT
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => P_f o = p_c ∧ 0 < ∑ d, p o d)).biUnion
            (fun o => (T_cand (win_of o) (Q_of (win_of o) o)).image
              (fun α => (win_of o, F_of (win_of o) o α))))
          (fun u => Q_UP u p_c) (p_P p_c) B_FTJ
          (fun u _ => hQUP_nn u p_c) (hQUP_sum_u p_c) ?_ hB_FTJ_pos (hB_FTJ p_c)
        rintro ⟨j, ft⟩ _ hpos
        have h_nonneg1 : ∀ o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)),
            0 ≤ if P_f o = p_c then w_FT j ft o else 0 := by
          intro o _
          by_cases hp : P_f o = p_c
          · rw [if_pos hp]; exact hw_FT_nn j ft o
          · rw [if_neg hp]
        obtain ⟨o, _, ho_pos⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg h_nonneg1).mp hpos
        have hPo : P_f o = p_c := by
          by_contra hne
          rw [if_neg hne] at ho_pos
          exact lt_irrefl 0 ho_pos
        rw [if_pos hPo] at ho_pos
        have h_nonneg2 : ∀ d ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_D)),
            0 ≤ ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), if F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0 := by
          intro d _
          refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun α _ => ?_)
          by_cases hF : F_of j o α = ft
          · rw [if_pos hF]; exact h_wt_nn j o d α
          · rw [if_neg hF]
        obtain ⟨d, _, hd_pos⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg h_nonneg2).mp ho_pos
        have h_nonneg3 : ∀ α ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (N_ret_of j))),
            0 ≤ if F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0 := by
          intro α _
          by_cases hF : F_of j o α = ft
          · rw [if_pos hF]; exact h_wt_nn j o d α
          · rw [if_neg hF]
        obtain ⟨α, _, hα_pos⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg h_nonneg3).mp hd_pos
        have hF : F_of j o α = ft := by
          by_contra hne
          rw [if_neg hne] at hα_pos
          exact lt_irrefl 0 hα_pos
        rw [if_pos hF] at hα_pos
        obtain ⟨hwin, hpod, hα_mem⟩ := h_wt_pos hα_pos
        have hpO_pos : 0 < ∑ d' : Fin N_D, p o d' :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hpod (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hp_nn o d') (Finset.mem_univ d))
        subst hwin
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨o,
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, hPo, hpO_pos⟩,
          Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨α, hα_mem, Prod.ext rfl hF⟩⟩
      calc (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ u ∈ S_JFT, -(Q_UP u p_c * Real.log (Q_UP u p_c / p_P p_c)))
          ≤ ∑ p_c ∈ S_P, p_P p_c * Real.log B_FTJ := Finset.sum_le_sum h_pc
        _ = (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, p_P p_c) * Real.log B_FTJ := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = Real.log B_FTJ := by rw [hpP_sum, one_mul]

    
    have h_fiber_gk : ∀ (j : Fin N_J), ∀ ft ∈ S_FT j,
        H_W_fiber j ft - π_FTJ j ft * (Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW) ≤
          ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if 0 < π_FTJ j ft then
              π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))
            else 0 := by
      intro j ft _
      by_cases hU : 0 < π_FTJ j ft
      · have hrhs_congr : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
            if 0 < π_FTJ j ft then
              π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))
            else 0) =
            ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
              π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d)) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => if_pos hU))
        rw [hrhs_congr]
        let P_3 : Fin (N_ret_of j) → Fin N_D → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ :=
          fun α d w => ∑ o : Fin N_O, if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0
        let P_TW : Fin (N_ret_of j) → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun α w => ∑ d : Fin N_D, P_3 α d w
        let P_DW : Fin N_D → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ := fun d w => ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), P_3 α d w

        have h_sum_F_S_W : ∀ (o : Fin N_O) (α : Fin (N_ret_of j)) (c : ℝ),
            (∑ w ∈ S_W, if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then c else 0) =
              if F_of j o α = ft then c else 0 := by
          intro o α c
          by_cases hF : F_of j o α = ft
          · have hcongr : (∑ w ∈ S_W, if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then c else 0) =
                ∑ w ∈ S_W, if W_f o = w then c else 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
              by_cases hw : W_f o = w
              · rw [if_pos ⟨hw, hF⟩, if_pos hw]
              · rw [if_neg (fun h => hw h.1), if_neg hw]
            rw [if_pos hF, hcongr, h_sum_ite_S_W o c]
          · rw [if_neg hF]
            exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun w _ => if_neg (fun h => hF h.2))

        have hP3_nn : ∀ α d w, 0 ≤ P_3 α d w := by
          intro α d w
          refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun o _ => ?_)
          by_cases h : W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft
          · rw [if_pos h]; exact h_wt_nn j o d α
          · rw [if_neg h]

        have hPTW_nn : ∀ α w, 0 ≤ P_TW α w :=
          fun α w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => hP3_nn α d w)
        have hPDW_nn : ∀ d w, 0 ≤ P_DW d w :=
          fun d w => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun α _ => hP3_nn α d w)

        have hP3_sum_w : ∀ α d, (∑ w ∈ S_W, P_3 α d w) = π_TDFTJ j ft α d := by
          intro α d
          dsimp only [P_3, π_TDFTJ, wt]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => h_sum_F_S_W o α (wt j o d α))

        have hPTW_sum_w : ∀ α, (∑ w ∈ S_W, P_TW α w) = π_TFTJ j ft α := by
          intro α
          dsimp only [P_TW]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => hP3_sum_w α d),
            hπ_TDFTJ_sum_d j ft α]

        have hPDW_sum_w : ∀ d, (∑ w ∈ S_W, P_DW d w) = π_DFTJ j ft d := by
          intro d
          dsimp only [P_DW]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => hP3_sum_w α d),
            hπ_TDFTJ_sum_α j ft d]

        have hPTW_sum_α : ∀ w, (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), P_TW α w) = P_W j ft w := by
          intro w
          dsimp only [P_TW, P_3, P_W, w_FT]
          have h1 : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O,
              if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0) =
              ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j),
                if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0 := by
            calc (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O,
                  if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0)
                = ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ o : Fin N_O,
                    if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0 := Finset.sum_comm
              _ = ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j),
                    if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0 :=
                  Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => Finset.sum_comm)
              _ = ∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j),
                    if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0 := Finset.sum_comm
          rw [h1]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun o _ => ?_)
          by_cases hw : W_f o = w
          · rw [if_pos hw]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_))
            by_cases hF : F_of j o α = ft
            · rw [if_pos ⟨hw, hF⟩, if_pos hF]
            · rw [if_neg (fun h => hF h.2), if_neg hF]
          · rw [if_neg hw]
            exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ =>
              Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α _ => if_neg (fun h => hw h.1)))

        have hPDW_sum_d : ∀ w, (∑ d : Fin N_D, P_DW d w) = P_W j ft w := by
          intro w
          dsimp only [P_DW]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          exact hPTW_sum_α w

        have h_3way_pt : ∀ (α : Fin (N_ret_of j)) (d : Fin N_D), ∀ w ∈ S_W,
            P_3 α d w * (-Real.log (P_W j ft w / π_FTJ j ft) +
              Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α) +
              Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d) -
              Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))) ≤
              (if 0 < P_W j ft w then
                (P_TW α w * P_DW d w) / P_W j ft w
              else 0) - P_3 α d w := by
          intro α d w hw
          by_cases hP0 : P_3 α d w = 0
          · rw [hP0, zero_mul, sub_zero]
            by_cases hPW : 0 < P_W j ft w
            · rw [if_pos hPW]
              exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hPTW_nn α w) (hPDW_nn d w)) hPW.le
            · rw [if_neg hPW]
          · have hP_pos : 0 < P_3 α d w := lt_of_le_of_ne (hP3_nn α d w) (Ne.symm hP0)
            have hP_le_PTD : P_3 α d w ≤ π_TDFTJ j ft α d := by
              rw [← hP3_sum_w α d]
              exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun w' _ => hP3_nn α d w') hw
            have hPTD_pos : 0 < π_TDFTJ j ft α d := lt_of_lt_of_le hP_pos hP_le_PTD
            have hPTW_pos : 0 < P_TW α w :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hP_pos
                (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hP3_nn α d' w) (Finset.mem_univ d))
            have hPT_pos : 0 < π_TFTJ j ft α := by
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le hPTW_pos ?_
              rw [← hPTW_sum_w α]
              exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun w' _ => hPTW_nn α w') hw
            have hPDW_pos : 0 < P_DW d w :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hP_pos
                (Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hP3_nn α' d w) (Finset.mem_univ α))
            have hPD_pos : 0 < π_DFTJ j ft d := by
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le hPDW_pos ?_
              rw [← hPDW_sum_w d]
              exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun w' _ => hPDW_nn d w') hw
            have hPW_pos : 0 < P_W j ft w := by
              refine lt_of_lt_of_le hPTW_pos ?_
              rw [← hPTW_sum_α w]
              exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun α' _ => hPTW_nn α' w) (Finset.mem_univ α)
            rw [if_pos hPW_pos]
            let y := (P_TW α w / P_W j ft w) * (P_DW d w / π_TDFTJ j ft α d)
            let x := (P_TW α w / P_W j ft w) * (P_DW d w / P_3 α d w)
            have hy_pos : 0 < y := mul_pos (div_pos hPTW_pos hPW_pos) (div_pos hPDW_pos hPTD_pos)
            have hyx : y ≤ x :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hPDW_pos.le hP_pos hP_le_PTD)
                (div_pos hPTW_pos hPW_pos).le
            have hlog : Real.log y =
                -Real.log (P_W j ft w / π_FTJ j ft) +
                  Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α) +
                  Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d) -
                  Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                    (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d)) := by
              dsimp only [y]
              rw [Real.log_mul (div_pos hPTW_pos hPW_pos).ne' (div_pos hPDW_pos hPTD_pos).ne',
                Real.log_div hPTW_pos.ne' hPW_pos.ne',
                Real.log_div hPDW_pos.ne' hPTD_pos.ne',
                Real.log_div hPW_pos.ne' hU.ne',
                Real.log_div hPTW_pos.ne' hPT_pos.ne',
                Real.log_div hPDW_pos.ne' hPD_pos.ne',
                Real.log_div (mul_pos hPTD_pos hU).ne' (mul_pos hPT_pos hPD_pos).ne',
                Real.log_mul hPTD_pos.ne' hU.ne',
                Real.log_mul hPT_pos.ne' hPD_pos.ne']
              ring
            have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_log_le_sub_one hy_pos hyx) hP_pos.le
            have hrhs : P_3 α d w * (x - 1) =
                (P_TW α w * P_DW d w) / P_W j ft w - P_3 α d w := by
              dsimp only [x]
              have hprod : P_3 α d w * ((P_TW α w / P_W j ft w) * (P_DW d w / P_3 α d w)) =
                  (P_TW α w / P_W j ft w) * (P_3 α d w * (P_DW d w / P_3 α d w)) := by ring
              rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hprod, mul_div_cancel₀ (P_DW d w) hP_pos.ne',
                div_mul_eq_mul_div]
            rwa [hlog, hrhs] at h1

        have h_3way_sum :
            H_W_fiber j ft -
              (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                -(P_TW α w * Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α))) -
              (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                -(P_DW d w * Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d))) ≤
              ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
                π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                  (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d)) := by
          have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α (_ : α ∈ Finset.univ) =>
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d (_ : d ∈ Finset.univ) =>
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun w hw => h_3way_pt α d w hw)))
          have hrhs_zero : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
              ((if 0 < P_W j ft w then
                (P_TW α w * P_DW d w) / P_W j ft w
              else 0) - P_3 α d w)) = 0 := by
            let F_rhs : Fin (N_ret_of j) → Fin N_D → (ℤ × ℤ) → ℝ :=
              fun α d w =>
                (if 0 < P_W j ft w then
                  (P_TW α w * P_DW d w) / P_W j ft w
                else 0) - P_3 α d w
            have hswap : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W, F_rhs α d w) =
                ∑ w ∈ S_W, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), F_rhs α d w := by
              calc (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W, F_rhs α d w)
                  = ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ w ∈ S_W, F_rhs α d w :=
                    Finset.sum_comm
                _ = ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), F_rhs α d w :=
                    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => Finset.sum_comm)
                _ = ∑ w ∈ S_W, ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), F_rhs α d w :=
                    Finset.sum_comm
            change (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W, F_rhs α d w) = 0
            rw [hswap]
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun w _ => ?_)
            dsimp only [F_rhs]
            have hp3_pw : (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), P_3 α d w) = P_W j ft w :=
              hPDW_sum_d w
            rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => Finset.sum_sub_distrib _ _),
              Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hp3_pw]
            by_cases hPW : 0 < P_W j ft w
            · have h_in : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
                  (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), if 0 < P_W j ft w then
                    (P_TW α w * P_DW d w) / P_W j ft w else 0) = P_DW d w := by
                intro d
                rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => if_pos hPW), ← Finset.sum_div,
                  ← Finset.sum_mul, hPTW_sum_α w, mul_comm,
                  mul_div_cancel_right₀ (P_DW d w) hPW.ne']
              rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h_in d), hPDW_sum_d w, sub_self]
            · have hPW0 : P_W j ft w = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hPW) (hPW_nn j ft w)
              rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ =>
                Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α _ => if_neg hPW)), hPW0, sub_self]
          have hlhs_split : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
              P_3 α d w * (-Real.log (P_W j ft w / π_FTJ j ft) +
                Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α) +
                Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d) -
                Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                  (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d)))) =
              H_W_fiber j ft -
                (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                  -(P_TW α w * Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α))) -
                (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                  -(P_DW d w * Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d))) -
                (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
                  π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                    (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))) := by
            have hexp : ∀ α d w,
                P_3 α d w * (-Real.log (P_W j ft w / π_FTJ j ft) +
                  Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α) +
                  Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d) -
                  Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                    (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))) =
                -(P_3 α d w * Real.log (P_W j ft w / π_FTJ j ft)) -
                  -(P_3 α d w * Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α)) -
                  -(P_3 α d w * Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d)) -
                  (P_3 α d w * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                    (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))) := by
              intro α d w; ring
            have h1 : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                -(P_3 α d w * Real.log (P_W j ft w / π_FTJ j ft))) = H_W_fiber j ft := by
              have h_α : ∀ α : Fin (N_ret_of j),
                  (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                    -(P_3 α d w * Real.log (P_W j ft w / π_FTJ j ft))) =
                  ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(P_TW α w * Real.log (P_W j ft w / π_FTJ j ft)) := by
                intro α
                rw [Finset.sum_comm]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
                rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
              rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => h_α α), Finset.sum_comm]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
              rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hPTW_sum_α w]
            have h2 : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                -(P_3 α d w * Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α))) =
                ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                  -(P_TW α w * Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α)) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => ?_)
              rw [Finset.sum_comm]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
              rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
            have h3 : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                -(P_3 α d w * Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d))) =
                ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                  -(P_DW d w * Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_comm]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
              rw [Finset.sum_comm]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
              rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
            have h4 : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                P_3 α d w * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                  (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d))) =
                ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ d : Fin N_D,
                  π_TDFTJ j ft α d * Real.log ((π_TDFTJ j ft α d * π_FTJ j ft) /
                    (π_TFTJ j ft α * π_DFTJ j ft d)) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_))
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hP3_sum_w α d]
            simp_rw [hexp, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
          rw [hlhs_split, hrhs_zero] at hsum
          linarith only [hsum]

        have h_TW_ent : (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ w ∈ S_W,
            -(P_TW α w * Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α))) ≤
            π_FTJ j ft * Real.log B_TW := by
          have h_α : ∀ α : Fin (N_ret_of j),
              (∑ w ∈ S_W, -(P_TW α w * Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α))) ≤
                π_TFTJ j ft α * Real.log B_TW := by
            intro α
            refine h_supp_card_ent S_W
              ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
                win_of o = j ∧ (0 < ∑ d, p o d) ∧ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o) ∧
                  F_of j o α = ft)).image W_f)
              (fun w => P_TW α w) (π_TFTJ j ft α) B_TW
              (fun w _ => hPTW_nn α w) (hPTW_sum_w α) ?_ hB_TW_pos (hB_TW j ft α)
            intro w _ hpos
            obtain ⟨d, _, hd_pos⟩ :=
              (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun d _ => hP3_nn α d w)).mp hpos
            have h_nonneg_o : ∀ o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)),
                0 ≤ if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0 := by
              intro o _
              by_cases h : W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft
              · rw [if_pos h]; exact h_wt_nn j o d α
              · rw [if_neg h]
            obtain ⟨o, _, ho_pos⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg h_nonneg_o).mp hd_pos
            have hcond : W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft := by
              by_contra hne
              rw [if_neg hne] at ho_pos
              exact lt_irrefl 0 ho_pos
            rw [if_pos hcond] at ho_pos
            obtain ⟨hwin, hpod, hα_mem⟩ := h_wt_pos ho_pos
            have hpO_pos : 0 < ∑ d' : Fin N_D, p o d' :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hpod
                (Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => hp_nn o d') (Finset.mem_univ d))
            exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨o,
              Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, hwin, hpO_pos, hα_mem, hcond.2⟩,
              hcond.1⟩
          calc (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                -(P_TW α w * Real.log (P_TW α w / π_TFTJ j ft α)))
              ≤ ∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), π_TFTJ j ft α * Real.log B_TW :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α _ => h_α α)
            _ = (∑ α : Fin (N_ret_of j), π_TFTJ j ft α) * Real.log B_TW :=
                (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
            _ = π_FTJ j ft * Real.log B_TW := by rw [hπ_TFTJ_sum_α j ft]

        have h_DW_ent : (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
            -(P_DW d w * Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d))) ≤
            π_FTJ j ft * Real.log B_DW := by
          have h_d : ∀ d : Fin N_D,
              (∑ w ∈ S_W, -(P_DW d w * Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d))) ≤
                π_DFTJ j ft d * Real.log B_DW := by
            intro d
            refine h_supp_card_ent S_W
              ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
                win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p o d ∧
                  ∃ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o), F_of j o α = ft)).image W_f)
              (fun w => P_DW d w) (π_DFTJ j ft d) B_DW
              (fun w _ => hPDW_nn d w) (hPDW_sum_w d) ?_ hB_DW_pos (hB_DW j ft d)
            intro w _ hpos
            obtain ⟨α, _, hα_pos⟩ :=
              (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun α _ => hP3_nn α d w)).mp hpos
            have h_nonneg_o : ∀ o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N_O)),
                0 ≤ if W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft then wt j o d α else 0 := by
              intro o _
              by_cases h : W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft
              · rw [if_pos h]; exact h_wt_nn j o d α
              · rw [if_neg h]
            obtain ⟨o, _, ho_pos⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg h_nonneg_o).mp hα_pos
            have hcond : W_f o = w ∧ F_of j o α = ft := by
              by_contra hne
              rw [if_neg hne] at ho_pos
              exact lt_irrefl 0 ho_pos
            rw [if_pos hcond] at ho_pos
            obtain ⟨hwin, hpod, hα_mem⟩ := h_wt_pos ho_pos
            exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨o,
              Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ o, hwin, hpod, ⟨α, hα_mem, hcond.2⟩⟩,
              hcond.1⟩
          calc (∑ d : Fin N_D, ∑ w ∈ S_W,
                -(P_DW d w * Real.log (P_DW d w / π_DFTJ j ft d)))
              ≤ ∑ d : Fin N_D, π_DFTJ j ft d * Real.log B_DW :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d _ => h_d d)
            _ = (∑ d : Fin N_D, π_DFTJ j ft d) * Real.log B_DW :=
                (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
            _ = π_FTJ j ft * Real.log B_DW := by rw [hπ_DFTJ_sum_d j ft]

        have h_mul_add : π_FTJ j ft * (Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW) =
            π_FTJ j ft * Real.log B_TW + π_FTJ j ft * Real.log B_DW := mul_add _ _ _
        linarith only [h_3way_sum, h_TW_ent, h_DW_ent, h_mul_add]
      · have hU0 : π_FTJ j ft = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hU) (hπ_FTJ_nn j ft)
        have hPW0 : ∀ w ∈ S_W, P_W j ft w = 0 :=
          (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun w _ => hPW_nn j ft w)).mp
            ((hPW_sum_w j ft).trans hU0)
        have hHW0 : H_W_fiber j ft = 0 :=
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun w hw => by
            rw [hPW0 w hw, zero_div, zero_mul, neg_zero])
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun α _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => if_neg hU)),
          hHW0, hU0, zero_mul, sub_zero]

    
    have h_sum_gk := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun (j : Fin N_J) (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) =>
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ft hft => h_fiber_gk j ft hft))
    have hlhs_gk : (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j,
        (H_W_fiber j ft - π_FTJ j ft * (Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW))) =
        (∑ j : Fin N_J, ∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, H_W_fiber j ft) -
          (Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Finset.sum_sub_distrib _ _),
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      congr 1
      have h_in : ∀ j : Fin N_J,
          (∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, π_FTJ j ft * (Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW)) =
            (∑ ft ∈ S_FT j, π_FTJ j ft) * (Real.log B_TW + Real.log B_DW) :=
        fun _ => (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => h_in j), ← Finset.sum_mul, hπ_FTJ_total, one_mul]
    rw [hlhs_gk] at h_sum_gk
    have h_raw : (∑ p_c ∈ S_P, ∑ w ∈ S_W, -(p_PW p_c w * Real.log (p_PW p_c w / p_P p_c))) -

    rw [← sub_div]

informal_problem.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass) (h u_min ζ_sh C_cov e_rep : ℝ) (d_dim M_L : ℕ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hu_min : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * h ≤ u_min)
    (hζ_sh : 0 < ζ_sh) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov)
    (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hML_64 : 64 ≤ M_L) (he_rep : 0 < e_rep) :
    let θ := min (h / 64) (e_rep / 256)
    ∃ C_geom : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_geom ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P t b_star lam_sys L_grid : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_J S_per_loc : ℕ)
        (τ_Vf τ_Xf : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (e_D V_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (N_ret_of : Fin N_J → ℕ)
        (menu : ∀ j : Fin N_J, LocalizerSubclass (N_ret_of j))
        (win_of : Fin N_O → Fin N_J)
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (Q_of : Fin N_J → Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (T_cand : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin (N_ret_of j)))
        (P_f : Fin N_O → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (n_f : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (W_f : Fin N_O → ℤ × ℤ),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let r := t - 2 * h
        let u_t := (H_P - t) / 2
        let u := u_t - b_star
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let s_Vf := L_grid * ε ^ (u_t - h)
        let s_Xf := L_grid * ε ^ (t + u_t - h)
        let F_T_fn : ∀ j : Fin N_J, ℕ → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
          fun j r_loc α =>
            let V_J := gridPt2D s_v (menu j).loc_idx.2.1
            let X_J := gridPt2D s_x (menu j).loc_idx.2.2
            let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1 - V_J)
            let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2 - X_J)
            let c_end := ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
            (r_loc,
             roundShift2D (ε ^ (u - h)) 0 V'_α,
             roundShift2D (ε ^ (u + h)) 0 (X'_α + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V'_α))
        let F_of : ∀ j : Fin N_J, Fin N_O → Fin (N_ret_of j) → ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ) :=
          fun j o α => F_T_fn j (r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)) α
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 4 → 0 < r → t ≤ H_P →
        1 ≤ S_per_loc →
        (∀ j₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N_J =>
          (menu j).loc_idx = j₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (S_per_loc : ℝ)) →
        0 ≤ b_star → u_min ≤ u →
        ε ^ r ≤ s_c → s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r → m_r ≤ m_t →
        (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) →
        (∀ d : Fin N_D, ‖e_D d‖ = 1) →
        (∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
          |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d)) →
        (∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
          let j := win_of o
          (menu j).loc_idx = cutLocalizerIdx ε b_star m_r m_t (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) ∧
          (∀ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o),
            ‖gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1 - V_O o‖ ≤
              (2 * (M_L : ℝ) + 4) * ε ^ u_t ∧
            ‖(gridPt2D σ_r ((menu j).o_at α).2 +
                (((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ -
                  (((menu j).loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c) •
                  gridPt2D ρ_r ((menu j).o_at α).1) - X_O o‖ ≤
              (8 * C_cov * cls.B_sys + 16) * (ε ^ (-θ)) * s_x * ε ^ (u + h))) →
        1 ≤ L_grid → L_grid ≤ 4 → (∀ p_c, ‖n_f p_c‖ = 1) →
        (∀ o : Fin N_O, (P_f o).1 = r_O o ∧
          ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)‖ ≤ s_Vf ∧
          ‖X_O o - (τ_Xf + gridPt2D s_Xf (P_f o).2.2)‖ ≤ s_Xf ∧
          (d_dim = 1 →
            |inner ℝ (V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1)) (n_f (P_f o)) -
              ((W_f o).1 : ℝ) * ε ^ u_t| ≤ ε ^ u_t ∧ (W_f o).2 = 0) ∧
          (d_dim = 2 →
            ‖V_O o - (τ_Vf + gridPt2D s_Vf (P_f o).2.1) - gridPt2D (ε ^ u_t) (W_f o)‖ ≤
              2 * ε ^ u_t)) →
        (d_dim = 1 → ∀ o d, 0 < p o d →
          projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_f (P_f o)) ≤ 4 * ε ^ h) →
        (∀ o d, 0 < p o d → |u_t - a_D d| ≤ ζ_sh ∧
          (d_dim = 2 → b_D d = u_t ∧ a_D d = u_t)) →
        (∀ p_c : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ),
          (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O => P_f o = p_c ∧ 0 < ∑ d, p o d)).biUnion
            (fun o => (T_cand (win_of o) (Q_of (win_of o) o)).image
              (fun α => (win_of o, F_of (win_of o) o α)))).card : ℝ) ≤
            C_geom * (S_per_loc : ℝ) * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin N_J) (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (α : Fin (N_ret_of j)),
          (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
            win_of o = j ∧ (0 < ∑ d, p o d) ∧ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o) ∧
              F_of j o α = ft)).image W_f).card : ℝ) ≤
            C_geom * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin N_J) (ft : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) (d : Fin N_D),
          (((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
            win_of o = j ∧ 0 < p o d ∧
              ∃ α ∈ T_cand j (Q_of j o), F_of j o α = ft)).image W_f).card : ℝ) ≤
            C_geom * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  
  let box1D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Finset ℤ := fun s u₀ R =>
    Finset.Icc (Int.floor (u₀ / s) - (⌈R⌉₊ : ℤ)) (Int.floor (u₀ / s) + (⌈R⌉₊ : ℤ))
  have h_box1D_card : ∀ (s u₀ R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R → ((box1D s u₀ R).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * R + 3 := by
    intro s u₀ R hR
    have hc : (box1D s u₀ R).card = 2 * ⌈R⌉₊ + 1 := by
      dsimp only [box1D]
      rw [Int.card_Icc]
      omega
    have hlt : (⌈R⌉₊ : ℝ) < R + 1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hR
    rw [hc]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have h_box1D_mem : ∀ (s u₀ R : ℝ) (k : ℤ),
      0 < s → 0 ≤ R → |s * (k : ℝ) - u₀| ≤ R * s → k ∈ box1D s u₀ R := by
    intro s u₀ R k hs hR habs
    let m₀ : ℤ := Int.floor (u₀ / s)
    let N : ℕ := ⌈R⌉₊
    have hm_lo : (m₀ : ℝ) * s ≤ u₀ := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le (u₀ / s))
    have hm_hi : u₀ < ((m₀ : ℝ) + 1) * s := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (u₀ / s))
    have hN_ge : R * s ≤ (N : ℝ) * s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.le_ceil R) hs.le
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
    have hk_lo_r : ((m₀ - (N : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * s ≤ (k : ℝ) * s := by
      push_cast
      linarith
    have hk_lo : m₀ - (N : ℤ) ≤ k :=
      Int.cast_le.mp (le_of_mul_le_mul_right hk_lo_r hs)
    have hk_hi_r : (k : ℝ) * s < ((m₀ + (N : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * s := by
      push_cast
      linarith
    have hk_hi : k ≤ m₀ + (N : ℤ) := by
      have h1 : k < m₀ + (N : ℤ) + 1 := Int.cast_lt.mp (lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right hk_hi_r hs.le)
      omega
    dsimp only [box1D]
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hk_lo, hk_hi⟩
  let box2D : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ → Finset (ℤ × ℤ) := fun s z₀ R =>
    box1D s (z₀ 0) R ×ˢ box1D s (z₀ 1) R
  have h_box2D_card : ∀ (s : ℝ) (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (R : ℝ),
      0 ≤ R → ((box2D s z₀ R).card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * R + 3) ^ 2 := by
    intro s z₀ R hR
    dsimp only [box2D]
    rw [Finset.card_product, Nat.cast_mul, sq]
    exact mul_le_mul (h_box1D_card s (z₀ 0) R hR) (h_box1D_card s (z₀ 1) R hR)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith)
  have h_box2D_mem : ∀ (s : ℝ) (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (R : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ),
      0 < s → 0 ≤ R → ‖gridPt2D s k - z₀‖ ≤ R * s → k ∈ box2D s z₀ R := by
    intro s z₀ R k hs hR hnorm
    have hc0 : |s * (k.1 : ℝ) - z₀ 0| ≤ R * s := by
      have h1 : ‖(gridPt2D s k - z₀).ofLp 0‖ ≤ ‖gridPt2D s k - z₀‖ :=
        PiLp.norm_apply_le (gridPt2D s k - z₀) 0
      have h2 : (gridPt2D s k - z₀).ofLp 0 = s * (k.1 : ℝ) - z₀ 0 := by simp [gridPt2D]
      rw [h2, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact le_trans h1 hnorm
    have hc1 : |s * (k.2 : ℝ) - z₀ 1| ≤ R * s := by
      have h1 : ‖(gridPt2D s k - z₀).ofLp 1‖ ≤ ‖gridPt2D s k - z₀‖ :=
        PiLp.norm_apply_le (gridPt2D s k - z₀) 1
      have h2 : (gridPt2D s k - z₀).ofLp 1 = s * (k.2 : ℝ) - z₀ 1 := by simp [gridPt2D]
      rw [h2, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact le_trans h1 hnorm
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨h_box1D_mem s (z₀ 0) R k.1 hs hR hc0, h_box1D_mem s (z₀ 1) R k.2 hs hR hc1⟩
  have h_roundShift_err : ∀ (s : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < s → ‖gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 z) - z‖ ≤ 2 * s := by
    intro s z hs
    have h1d : ∀ x : ℝ, (s * (Int.floor ((x - 0) / s) : ℝ) - x) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      have hlo : (Int.floor ((x - 0) / s) : ℝ) * s ≤ x - 0 :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le _)
      have hhi : x - 0 < ((Int.floor ((x - 0) / s) : ℝ) + 1) * s :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one _)
      nlinarith
    have hnsq : ‖gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 z) - z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [gridPt2D, roundShift2D, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have h0 := h1d (z 0)
      have h1 := h1d (z 1)

(a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win h θ : ℝ) (M_L N_tay : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ_le : θ ≤ h / 64)
    (hML : 256 ≤ M_L) (hNtay : 2 ≤ N_tay) :
    ∃ (M_win_loc : ℕ → ℝ) (C_loc ε_loc : ℝ),
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ M_win_loc k) ∧ 0 ≤ C_loc ∧ 0 < ε_loc ∧ ε_loc < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (ε lam_sys ρ_t C_t : ℝ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε_loc →
        0 < lam_sys → 0 < ρ_t → ρ_t ≤ ε ^ ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * h) →
        (lam_sys * ρ_t)⁻¹ ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (2 * h) →
        C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_win k) →
        ∃ ψ_loc : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_loc) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_loc z = 0) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ((31 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_loc z = 0) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_loc z‖ ≤ M_win_loc k) ∧
          (∀ (H_all H_in : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H_all MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.MemLp H_all 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H_in MeasureTheory.volume →
            MeasureTheory.MemLp H_in 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              ((17 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) * ρ_t ≤ ‖v - V_o‖ → H_in v = 0) →
            (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              ‖x - X_o‖ ≤ 20 * a₀⁻¹ * (ε ^ (-θ)) * (lam_sys * ρ_t)⁻¹ →
              ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                H_all v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
              ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                H_in v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) →
            ‖((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                H_in v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
             ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
                H_all v * ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))‖ ≤
              C_loc * ε ^ ((N_tay : ℝ) * θ) *
                (Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_in v‖ ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_all v‖ ^ 2)))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win : ℝ) (N_tay : ℕ)

      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ D_z_exp k) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_u_coeff m) ∧

      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)

          let σ_t := (lam_sys * ρ_t)⁻¹
          let ΔΘ_o : (ℝ × ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun u z =>
            lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o + σ_t • y_map u, V_o + ρ_t • z) -
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o + ρ_t • z) -

            let h_ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z =>
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((ΔΘ_o ξ z : ℝ) : ℂ))
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k h_ξ) ∧

            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k G_z) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  let W₁ : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => max (M_atom_bd i) 1
  let W₂ : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => max (M_win_bd j) 1
  let B_amp : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * W₁ i * W₂ (k - i)
  let D_phase : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
    (2 / a₀ + 10 * B_sys) * A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) +
      B_sys * (m : ℝ) * A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)

  
  have h_s1_slice :
      ∀ (lam_sys ρ_r ρ_t C_r C_t : ℝ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (V_at X_at V_o X_o e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_at ψ_loc : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (M_sl : ℝ),
        0 < ρ_r → ρ_r ≤ ρ_t → Continuous Φ₀ →
        Continuous ψ_at →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_at z = 0) →
        Continuous ψ_loc →
        ‖e‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ M_sl →
        (∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4,
          ‖∫ s : ℝ,
            (star (ψ_at (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)) *
              ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (V_at - V_o) + (ρ_r / ρ_t) • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e))) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_at + ρ_r • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)) -
                Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, V_at + ρ_r • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e))) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤ M_sl) →
        ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          (((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) *
           ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
           Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))‖ ≤
          8 * M_sl := by
    clear ha₀ ha₁ hA hB_sys hR_win hM_ord h_ibp_gen W₁ W₂ B_amp D_phase M_atom_bd M_win_bd
    intro lam_sys ρ_r ρ_t C_r C_t Φ₀ V_at X_at V_o X_o e ψ_at ψ_loc M_sl
      hρ_r hρ_le hΦ_cont hψ_at_cont hψ_at_supp hψ_loc_cont he hM_sl h_slice
    have hρ_t : 0 < ρ_t := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_r hρ_le
    have hρ_r_ne : ρ_r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hρ_r
    have hρ_t_ne : ρ_t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hρ_t
    have hr_sc_nn : 0 ≤ ρ_r / ρ_t := div_nonneg hρ_r.le hρ_t.le
    have hr_sc_le : ρ_r / ρ_t ≤ 1 := div_le_one_of_le₀ hρ_le hρ_t.le
    have he_sq : (e 0) ^ 2 + (e 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h := PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) e
      rw [he, one_pow, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h.symm
    let R_e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      { toFun := fun u => (u 0) • e + (u 1) • perp2D e
        map_add' := fun u v => by
          ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D] <;> ring
        map_smul' := fun c u => by
          ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D] <;> ring
        invFun := fun z => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 =>
          if i = 0 then z 0 * e 0 + z 1 * e 1 else -(z 0 * e 1) + z 1 * e 0)
        left_inv := fun u => by
          ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D]
          · linear_combination (u 0) * he_sq
          · linear_combination (u 1) * he_sq
        right_inv := fun z => by
          ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [perp2D]
          · linear_combination (z 0) * he_sq
          · linear_combination (z 1) * he_sq
        norm_map' := fun u => by
          have h1 := PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) ((u 0) • e + (u 1) • perp2D e)
          have h2 := PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) u
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1 h2
          have hsq : ‖(u 0) • e + (u 1) • perp2D e‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
            rw [h1, h2]
            simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, perp2D,
              Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
            norm_num
            linear_combination ((u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2) * he_sq
          exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp hsq }
    have h_rot_norm_sq : ∀ s y₁ : ℝ, ‖s • e + y₁ • perp2D e‖ ^ 2 = s ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2 := by
      intro s y₁
      have h1 := PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
      rw [h1]
      simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, perp2D,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      norm_num
      linear_combination (s ^ 2 + y₁ ^ 2) * he_sq
    let G_z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z =>
      (star (ψ_at z) * ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (V_at - V_o) + (ρ_r / ρ_t) • z)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_at + ρ_r • z) -
            Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, V_at + ρ_r • z)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    have h_haar :
        (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          (((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) *
           ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
           Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
        ((ρ_r / ρ_t : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), G_z z := by
      let F₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun v =>
        (star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at))) * ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o))) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) - Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have h_pt : (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          (((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) *
           ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
           Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) =
          (fun v => (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * F₀ v) := by
        ext v
        dsimp only [F₀]
        have hexp :
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) - Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
          rw [← Complex.exp_add]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        calc (((ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at))) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) *
             ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
             Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
            = (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * ((star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at))) * ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o))) *
                (Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))) := by ring
          _ = (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * ((star (ψ_at (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at))) * ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                  ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) - Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, v)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by rw [hexp]
      rw [h_pt, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
        ← MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self F₀ V_at]
      have h_shift : (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => F₀ (u + V_at)) =
          (fun u => G_z (ρ_r⁻¹ • u)) := by
        ext u
        dsimp only [F₀, G_z]
        have hu2 : u + V_at = V_at + ρ_r • (ρ_r⁻¹ • u) := by
          rw [smul_inv_smul₀ hρ_r_ne, add_comm]
        have hu3 : ρ_t⁻¹ • (u + V_at - V_o) =
            ρ_t⁻¹ • (V_at - V_o) + (ρ_r / ρ_t) • (ρ_r⁻¹ • u) := by
          have hsub : u + V_at - V_o = (V_at - V_o) + ρ_r • (ρ_r⁻¹ • u) := by
            rw [smul_inv_smul₀ hρ_r_ne]; abel
          rw [hsub, smul_add, smul_smul]
          congr 2
          ring
        rw [add_sub_cancel_right, hu3, hu2]
      rw [h_shift,
        MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_inv_smul_of_nonneg MeasureTheory.volume G_z hρ_r.le,
        finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, Complex.real_smul]
      have hρr_c : (ρ_r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hρ_r_ne
      have hρt_c : (ρ_t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hρ_t_ne
      push_cast
      field_simp [hρr_c, hρt_c]
    have hG_cont : Continuous G_z := by
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => star (ψ_at z)) :=
        continuous_star.comp hψ_at_cont
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (V_at - V_o) + (ρ_r / ρ_t) • z)) :=
        hψ_loc_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul (ρ_r / ρ_t)))
      have hc_v : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => V_at + ρ_r • z) :=
        continuous_const.add (continuous_id.const_smul ρ_r)
      have hc_ph1 : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_at + ρ_r • z)) :=
        hΦ_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk hc_v))
      have hc_ph2 : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, V_at + ρ_r • z)) :=
        hΦ_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk hc_v))
      have hc3 : Continuous (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_at + ρ_r • z) -
              Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, V_at + ρ_r • z)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :=
        Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.mul (hc_ph1.sub hc_ph2))))
      exact (hc1.mul hc2).mul hc3
    have hG_supp : HasCompactSupport G_z := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 4) ?_
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz
      have hz4 : 4 ≤ ‖z‖ := le_of_lt (not_le.mp hz)
      dsimp only [G_z]
      rw [hψ_at_supp z hz4, star_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    have hG_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable G_z MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hG_cont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hG_supp
    let e1 : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃ᵐ (Fin 2 → ℝ) := MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.symm
    let e2 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv
    let e3 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      R_e.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv
    let Φ_rot : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := (e1.trans e2).trans e3
    have h_mp : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving Φ_rot MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have hm1 : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving e1 MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow (α := ℝ)).symm
      have hm2 : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving e2 MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume :=
        PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 2)
      have hm3 : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving e3 MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume :=
        R_e.measurePreserving
      exact (hm1.trans hm2).trans hm3
    have h_comp_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (G_z ∘ ⇑Φ_rot) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_mp.integrable_comp_of_integrable hG_int
    have h_fubini :
        ∫ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), G_z z =
          ∫ y₁ : ℝ, ∫ s : ℝ, G_z (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e) := by
      rw [← h_mp.integral_comp' G_z]
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_prod_symm (G_z ∘ ⇑Φ_rot) h_comp_int
    have h_compl_zero : ∀ y₁ : ℝ, y₁ ∉ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4 →
        (∫ s : ℝ, G_z (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)) = 0 := by
      intro y₁ hy₁
      have hy₁_gt : 4 < |y₁| := by
        rw [Set.mem_Icc] at hy₁
        rcases lt_or_ge y₁ (-4) with hlt | hge
        · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
        · have hgt : 4 < y₁ := lt_of_not_ge (fun hle => hy₁ ⟨hge, hle⟩)
          rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; exact hgt
      have h_fn_zero : (fun s : ℝ => G_z (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)) = (fun _ => 0) := by
        ext s
        have hnorm4 : 4 ≤ ‖s • e + y₁ • perp2D e‖ := by
          have hsq := h_rot_norm_sq s y₁
          have habs_sq : |y₁| ^ 2 = y₁ ^ 2 := sq_abs y₁
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e), sq_nonneg s, hy₁_gt, habs_sq, hsq]
        dsimp only [G_z]
        rw [hψ_at_supp _ hnorm4, star_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul]

      have hc_τ1 : c_τ ≤ 1 := by
        dsimp only [c_τ]
        nlinarith [hτ.1, hτ.2, hCr.2, hCt.2]
      let q_τ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        (V_base, ((1 - τ) • X_at + τ • X_o) - c_τ • V_base)
      let ξ_τ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
        (ρ_r • e, -(c_τ * ρ_r) • e)
      have hξ_norm : ‖ξ_τ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Prod.norm_def, max_le_iff]
        constructor
        · dsimp only [ξ_τ]
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ_r.le, he, mul_one]
          exact hρ_r1
        · dsimp only [ξ_τ]
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg,
            abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc_τ0 hρ_r.le), he, mul_one]
          nlinarith [hc_τ0, hc_τ1, hρ_r.le, hρ_r1]
      let Λ_τ : ℝ →L[ℝ] (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
        (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight ξ_τ
      have hΛ_norm : ‖Λ_τ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        refine Λ_τ.opNorm_le_bound zero_le_one (fun t => ?_)
        simp only [Λ_τ, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, one_apply_eq_self,
          norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg t) hξ_norm
      have h_traj : ∀ t : ℝ, (v_fn t, P₁ t + τ • Q t) = Λ_τ t + q_τ := by
        intro t
        apply Prod.ext
        · dsimp only [v_fn, V_base, Λ_τ, q_τ, ξ_τ]
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, one_apply_eq_self,
            Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst]
          ext i
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        · dsimp only [P₁, Q, P₂, v_fn, V_base, Λ_τ, q_τ, ξ_τ, c_τ]
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, one_apply_eq_self,
            Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd]
          ext i
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
      let M_sub : ℝ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
        (fun q => M_op (q + q_τ)) ∘ ⇑Λ_τ
      have hM_sh_sm : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (fun q => M_op (q + q_τ)) :=
        fun k => (hM_op_sm k).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      have hM_sub_sm : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k M_sub :=
        fun k => (hM_sh_sm k).comp Λ_τ.contDiff
      have hM_sub_bd : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_sub t‖ ≤ A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by
        intro k t
        dsimp only [M_sub]
        rw [Λ_τ.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right (hM_sh_sm k) t le_rfl,
          iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right k q_τ (Λ_τ t)]
        have h_norm :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ)) (fun _ : Fin k => Λ_τ)
        have h_prod : (∏ _ : Fin k, ‖Λ_τ‖) ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
          exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg Λ_τ) hΛ_norm
        calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ)).compContinuousLinearMap
              (fun _ => Λ_τ)‖
            ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ)‖ * ∏ _ : Fin k, ‖Λ_τ‖ := h_norm
          _ ≤ (A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul (hζ_gev k (Λ_τ t + q_τ)) h_prod
                (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg Λ_τ)) (by positivity)
          _ = A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := mul_one _
      let eval_u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →
          ((EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
        fun u => L_e.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) u)
      have heval_norm : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖eval_u u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
        intro u
        refine (eval_u u).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg u) (fun T => ?_)
        change ‖L_e (T u)‖ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖T‖
        rw [hL_e_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc |inner ℝ (T u) e| ≤ ‖T u‖ * ‖e‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ ≤ (‖T‖ * ‖u‖) * 1 := by
              rw [he]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (T.le_opNorm u) zero_le_one
          _ = ‖u‖ * ‖T‖ := by ring
      let f_vec : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ → ℝ := fun u => ⇑(eval_u u) ∘ M_sub
      have hf_vec_sm : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ k (f_vec u) :=
        fun u k => (eval_u u).contDiff.comp (hM_sub_sm k)
      have hf_vec_bd : ∀ (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
          |iteratedDeriv k (f_vec u) t| ≤ ‖u‖ * A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by
        intro u k t
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
        dsimp only [f_vec]
        rw [(eval_u u).iteratedFDeriv_comp_left (hM_sub_sm k).contDiffAt le_rfl]
        calc ‖(eval_u u).compContinuousMultilinearMap (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_sub t)‖
            ≤ ‖eval_u u‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k M_sub t‖ :=
              (eval_u u).norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap_le _
          _ ≤ ‖u‖ * (A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) :=
              mul_le_mul (heval_norm u) (hM_sub_bd k t) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg u)
          _ = ‖u‖ * A ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      have hH_decomp : (fun t : ℝ => H (t, τ)) =
          (fun t => f_vec U₀ t + t * f_vec U₁ t) := by
        ext t
        dsimp only [H, f_vec, eval_u, M_sub]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
        rw [h_traj t]
        have h_smul : (lam_sys * ρ_r) * L_e (M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ) (Q t)) =
            L_e (M_op (Λ_τ t + q_τ) ((lam_sys * ρ_r) • Q t)) := by
          rw [map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [h_smul, hQ_scaled t, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hH_decomp]
      have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ m (f_vec U₀) s := (hf_vec_sm U₀ m).contDiffAt
      have hcd2 : ContDiffAt ℝ m (fun t : ℝ => t * f_vec U₁ t) s :=
        (contDiff_id.mul (hf_vec_sm U₁ m)).contDiffAt
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add hcd1 hcd2, h_iter_mul_id (f_vec U₁) (hf_vec_sm U₁) m s]
      have h_pow_m : A ^ (m - 1 + 1) = A ^ m := by
        congr 1; omega
      have hb0 := hf_vec_bd U₀ m s
      have hb1 := hf_vec_bd U₁ m s
      have hb2 := hf_vec_bd U₁ (m - 1) s
      rw [h_pow_m] at hb2
      have h_g1 : 0 ≤ A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by positivity
      have h_g2 : 0 ≤ A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := by positivity
      have h_term0 : |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₀) s| ≤
          (K + 4 * B_sys) * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by
        calc |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₀) s|
            ≤ ‖U₀‖ * A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := hb0
          _ = ‖U₀‖ * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ ≤ (K + 4 * B_sys) * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hU₀_norm h_g1
      have h_term1 : |s * iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s| ≤
          (6 * B_sys) * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        have h1 : |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s| ≤
            B_sys * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by
          calc |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s|
              ≤ ‖U₁‖ * A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := hb1
            _ = ‖U₁‖ * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := mul_assoc _ _ _
            _ ≤ B_sys * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hU₁_norm h_g1
        calc |s| * |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s|
            ≤ 6 * (B_sys * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3))) :=
              mul_le_mul hs6 h1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          _ = (6 * B_sys) * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by ring
      have h_term2 : |(m : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (m - 1) (f_vec U₁) s| ≤
          B_sys * (m : ℝ) * (A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m)]
        have h1 : |iteratedDeriv (m - 1) (f_vec U₁) s| ≤
            B_sys * (A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by
          calc |iteratedDeriv (m - 1) (f_vec U₁) s|
              ≤ ‖U₁‖ * A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) := hb2
            _ = ‖U₁‖ * (A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := mul_assoc _ _ _
            _ ≤ B_sys * (A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hU₁_norm h_g2
        calc (m : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv (m - 1) (f_vec U₁) s|
            ≤ (m : ℝ) * (B_sys * (A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg m)
          _ = B_sys * (m : ℝ) * (A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by ring
      have h_tri :
          |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₀) s +
              (s * iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s +
                (m : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (m - 1) (f_vec U₁) s)| ≤
            |iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₀) s| +
              |s * iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s| +
              |(m : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (m - 1) (f_vec U₁) s| := by
        have h1 := abs_add_le (iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₀) s)
          (s * iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s + (m : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (m - 1) (f_vec U₁) s)
        have h2 := abs_add_le (s * iteratedDeriv m (f_vec U₁) s)
          ((m : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (m - 1) (f_vec U₁) s)
        linarith
      have hK_eq_L : K = (2 / a₀) * L_osc := by
        dsimp only [L_osc]
        field_simp [ha₀.ne']
      have h_coef1 : K + 10 * B_sys ≤ L_osc * (2 / a₀ + 10 * B_sys) := by
        rw [hK_eq_L]
        nlinarith [hB_sys, hL_ge1]
      have h_part1 :
          (K + 10 * B_sys) * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) ≤
            L_osc * ((2 / a₀ + 10 * B_sys) * A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by
        have hm1' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coef1 h_g1
        linarith [show L_osc * (2 / a₀ + 10 * B_sys) * (A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) =
          L_osc * ((2 / a₀ + 10 * B_sys) * A ^ (m + 1) * ((m.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) by ring]
      have h_part2 :
          B_sys * (m : ℝ) * (A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) ≤
            L_osc * (B_sys * (m : ℝ) * A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by
        have h_nn : 0 ≤ B_sys * (m : ℝ) * A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3) :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg m)) (by positivity))
            (by positivity)
        have h_assoc : B_sys * (m : ℝ) * (A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) =
            1 * (B_sys * (m : ℝ) * A ^ m * (((m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by ring
        rw [h_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL_ge1 h_nn
      dsimp only [D_phase]
      linarith [h_tri, h_term0, h_term1, h_term2, h_part1, h_part2]

    refine ⟨hθ_sm, hθ_lo, ?_⟩
    intro m hm1 s hs6
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : m ≠ 0)
    let g_τ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun s' => G (s', τ)) s
    have hg_τ_hd : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt g_τ
        (iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun s' => H (s', τ)) s) τ := by
      intro τ
      have h_lhs : g_τ = fun τ' => d1 ((d1^[n]) G) (s, τ') := by
        ext τ'
        dsimp only [g_τ]
        rw [← h_d1_iter G (n + 1) s τ', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      have h_rhs : iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun s' => H (s', τ)) s =
          d1 (d2 ((d1^[n]) G)) (s, τ) := by
        rw [hd2_iter n, ← Function.iterate_succ_apply' d1 n H, h_d1_iter H (n + 1) s τ]
      rw [h_lhs, h_rhs]
      exact h_schwarz ((d1^[n]) G) (hG_iter_sm n) s τ
    have hg0 : g_τ 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp only [g_τ]
      have hG0 : (fun s' : ℝ => G (s', 0)) = (fun _ => 0) := by
        ext s'
        dsimp only [G]
        rw [zero_smul, add_zero, sub_self, map_zero, mul_zero]
      have h_iter_zero : ∀ j : ℕ, iteratedDeriv j (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) = (fun _ => 0) := by
        intro j
        induction j with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ j ih =>
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih]
          ext x
          exact deriv_const x (0 : ℝ)
      rw [hG0, h_iter_zero (n + 1)]
    have hg1 : g_τ 1 = iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (deriv θ) s := by
      dsimp only [g_τ]
      have hG1 : (fun s' : ℝ => G (s', 1)) = deriv θ := by
        ext s'
        rw [hθ_deriv s']
        dsimp only [G, Q]
        rw [one_smul, add_sub_cancel, hL_e_apply]
      rw [hG1]
    have h_mvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le (𝕜 := ℝ)
      (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (f := g_τ) (C := L_osc * D_phase (n + 1))
      (fun τ _ => (hg_τ_hd τ).differentiableAt)
      (fun τ hτ => by
        rw [(hg_τ_hd τ).deriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hH_iter_bd (n + 1) hm1 s hs6 τ hτ)
      (convex_Icc 0 1)
      (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)
      (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)
    rw [hg1, hg0, sub_zero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_one, mul_one] at h_mvt
    exact h_mvt

  
  obtain ⟨C_ibp, hC_ibp_nn, h_ibp⟩ :=
    h_ibp_gen M_ord 4 (by norm_num) B_amp D_phase
  let B_X : ℝ := max 2 ((20 * A * B_sys + 4) / a₀)
  let C_far : ℝ := 8 * C_ibp / (a₀ / 2) ^ M_ord
  have hB_X_ge2 : 2 ≤ B_X := le_max_left _ _
  have hC_far_nn : 0 ≤ C_far :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_ibp_nn) (pow_nonneg (half_pos ha₀).le M_ord)
  refine ⟨B_X, C_far, hB_X_ge2, hC_far_nn, ?_⟩

  intro Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_sys ρ_r ρ_t s_c C_r C_t V_at X_at V_o X_o ψ_at ψ_loc
    hlam hρ_r hρ_le hρ_t1 _hs_c h_sc_bd hCr hCt hCt_Cr
    hψ_at_sm hψ_at_supp hψ_at_bd hψ_loc_sm _hψ_loc_supp hψ_loc_bd
    R_tr hR_tr h_sep

  have hρ_t : 0 < ρ_t := lt_of_lt_of_le hρ_r hρ_le
  have hρ_r1 : ρ_r ≤ 1 := le_trans hρ_le hρ_t1
  have hr_sc0 : 0 ≤ ρ_r / ρ_t := div_nonneg hρ_r.le hρ_t.le
  have hr_sc1 : ρ_r / ρ_t ≤ 1 := div_le_one_of_le₀ hρ_le hρ_t.le
  have h_chirp : lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 * |C_t - C_r| ≤ B_sys := by
    have hpos : 0 < lam_sys * ρ_r ^ 2 := mul_pos hlam (sq_pos_of_pos hρ_r)
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCt_Cr hpos.le
    linarith [h1, h_sc_bd]
  let ΔX : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := X_o - X_at - (C_t - C_r) • V_at
  let K : ℝ := (lam_sys * ρ_r) * ‖ΔX‖
  have hlam_ρr_pos : 0 < lam_sys * ρ_r := mul_pos hlam hρ_r
  have hR_le_K : R_tr ≤ K := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sep hlam_ρr_pos.le
    have hlhs : (lam_sys * ρ_r) * (R_tr * (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹) = R_tr := by
      field_simp [hlam_ρr_pos.ne']
    rwa [hlhs] at hmul
  have hK_thr : (20 * A * B_sys + 4) / a₀ ≤ K :=
    le_trans (le_max_right 2 _) (le_trans hR_tr hR_le_K)
  have hR_tr_pos : 0 < R_tr := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (le_trans hB_X_ge2 hR_tr)

  obtain ⟨hL_pos, e, he, h_θ_all⟩ :=
    h_s3_phase Φ₀ ζ₀ h_phase lam_sys ρ_r C_r C_t hlam hρ_r hρ_r1 hCr hCt h_chirp
      V_at X_at X_o hK_thr
  let L_osc : ℝ := (a₀ / 2) * K
  let M_sl : ℝ := C_ibp / L_osc ^ M_ord
  have hM_sl_nn : 0 ≤ M_sl := div_nonneg hC_ibp_nn (pow_nonneg hL_pos.le M_ord)

  have h_slice_bd : ∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4,
      ‖∫ s : ℝ,
        (star (ψ_at (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)) *
          ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (V_at - V_o) + (ρ_r / ρ_t) • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e))) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_at + ρ_r • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e)) -
            Φ₀ (C_r, X_at, V_at + ρ_r • (s • e + y₁ • perp2D e))) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤ M_sl := by
    intro y₁ hy₁
    obtain ⟨hθ_sm, hθ_lo, hθ_hi⟩ := h_θ_all y₁ hy₁
    obtain ⟨hu_sm, hu_supp, hu_bd⟩ :=
      h_s2_leibniz ψ_at ψ_loc hψ_at_sm hψ_at_supp hψ_at_bd hψ_loc_sm hψ_loc_bd
        (ρ_r / ρ_t) hr_sc0 hr_sc1 (ρ_t⁻¹ • (V_at - V_o)) e he y₁
    exact h_ibp L_osc hL_pos _ hθ_sm
      (fun s hs => hθ_lo s (by linarith))
      (fun m hm1 _hmM s hs => hθ_hi m hm1 s (by linarith))
      _ hu_sm hu_supp (fun k _hkM s => hu_bd k s)

  have h_2d :=
    h_s1_slice lam_sys ρ_r ρ_t C_r C_t Φ₀ V_at X_at V_o X_o e ψ_at ψ_loc M_sl
      hρ_r hρ_le (h_phase.1 0).continuous (hψ_at_sm 0).continuous hψ_at_supp
      (hψ_loc_sm 0).continuous he hM_sl_nn h_slice_bd

  have ha2_pos : 0 < a₀ / 2 := half_pos ha₀
  have haR_pos : 0 < (a₀ / 2) * R_tr := mul_pos ha2_pos hR_tr_pos
  have haR_le_L : (a₀ / 2) * R_tr ≤ L_osc :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR_le_K ha2_pos.le
  have hpow_le : ((a₀ / 2) * R_tr) ^ M_ord ≤ L_osc ^ M_ord :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ haR_pos.le haR_le_L M_ord
  have hpow_pos : 0 < ((a₀ / 2) * R_tr) ^ M_ord := pow_pos haR_pos M_ord

  refine le_trans h_2d ?_
  calc 8 * M_sl
      = (8 * C_ibp) / L_osc ^ M_ord := by dsimp only [M_sl]; ring
    _ ≤ (8 * C_ibp) / ((a₀ / 2) * R_tr) ^ M_ord :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_ibp_nn) hpow_pos hpow_le
    _ = C_far * (R_tr ^ M_ord)⁻¹ := by
        dsimp only [C_far]
