informal_problem.statement:
(cls : PacketBoundClass)
    (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_resc : LocalPhaseRescalingValid)
    (h_coh : CoherentStripMassBoundValid)
    (h ξ C_cov θ : ℝ) (d_dim M_L M_mult : ℕ) (M_win_loc : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2)
    (hML_64 : 64 ≤ M_L) (hM_mult : 1 ≤ M_mult) :
    ∃ C_bridge : ℝ,
      1 ≤ C_bridge ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys k_out : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_ret : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_loc : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (sub : LocalizerSubclass N_ret) (S_act : Finset (Fin N_O)),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let u := (H_P - t) / 2 - b_star
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((sub.loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v sub.loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x sub.loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let s_loc := ε ^ (u + h)
        let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
        let σ_loc := (lam_loc * (ε ^ u))⁻¹
        let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (sub.o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (sub.o_at α).2
        let V'_at := fun α => s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
        let X'_at := fun α => s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
        let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
          (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (sub.ψ_at α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
            Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        let Q_of : Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun o =>
          let p_buf := coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o))
          let r_loc := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
          let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          let X'_o := s_x⁻¹ • (X_O o - X_J - (C_t - C_r) • V_J)
          (p_buf, r_loc, roundShift2D s_loc 0 X'_o)
        let Z_of : Fin N_O → ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun o =>
          let q := Q_of o
          let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          let X'_o := s_x⁻¹ • (X_O o - X_J - (C_t - C_r) • V_J)
          let X_Q := gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2
          if d_dim = 1 then
            (q, (Int.floor (inner ℝ (X'_o - X_Q) (n_buf q.1) / σ_loc), 0))
          else
            (q, roundShift2D σ_loc 0 (X'_o - X_Q))
        let B_Q : ℝ := 4 * C_cov * cls.B_sys + 4
        let T_cand : ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin N_ret) := fun q =>
          let c_end := ((q.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
          let X_Q := gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2
          Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
            coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)) = q.1 ∧
            ‖(X'_at α + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V'_at α) - X_Q‖ ≤ B_Q * (ε ^ (-θ)) * s_loc)
        let m_site : Fin N_O → ℝ := fun o =>
          generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀
            (fun v => ∑ α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o), sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
            (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_loc o)
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → r = t - 2 * h → 0 ≤ b_star → 0 ≤ u →
        ε ^ r ≤ s_c → s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r → m_r ≤ m_t → sub.loc_idx.1 < 2 ^ m_r →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
        (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
        0 ≤ sub.m_bin →
        (∀ α : Fin N_ret,
          (let w := fun z => star (sub.ψ_at α z)
           (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k w) ∧
           (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → w z = 0) ∧
           (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
             ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k w z‖ ≤
               max (M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k) 1)) ∧
          ‖sub.c_at α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) →
        (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret => sub.o_at α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) →
        (∀ p_buf,
          (((Finset.univ.image (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
            let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)
            (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at (V_at α)))).filter
            (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(k_out + ξ))) →
        (∀ S : Finset (Fin N_ret),
          let H_S := fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, sub.c_at α * g_at α v
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H_S MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          MeasureTheory.MemLp H_S 2 MeasureTheory.volume) →
        (∀ o ∈ S_act,
          r_O o = sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
          r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_loc o)) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_loc o z = 0) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_loc o) z‖ ≤ M_win_loc k) ∧
          (T_cand (Q_of o)).Nonempty) →
        (let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
         let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
         ∀ (r_i : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
           ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
             r_O o = r_i ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤
             (cls.N_mult : ℝ)) →
        (∀ q, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q), m_site o ≤
          C_bridge * ε ^ (-ξ) * ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin) ∧
        (∀ z, ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z), m_site o ≤
          C_bridge * ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - 2 * ξ) *
            ((T_cand z.1).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_ediv_diff : ∀ (M k₁ k₂ : ℤ), 0 < M → k₁ / M = k₂ / M →
      -M + 1 ≤ k₁ - k₂ ∧ k₁ - k₂ ≤ M - 1 := by
    intro M k₁ k₂ hM hq
    have h1 := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod k₁ M
    have h2 := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod k₂ M
    have hr1_nn : 0 ≤ k₁ % M := Int.emod_nonneg k₁ (ne_of_gt hM)
    have hr1_lt : k₁ % M < M := Int.emod_lt_of_pos k₁ hM
    have hr2_nn : 0 ≤ k₂ % M := Int.emod_nonneg k₂ (ne_of_gt hM)
    have hr2_lt : k₂ % M < M := Int.emod_lt_of_pos k₂ hM
    rw [hq] at h1
    omega

  have h_norm2d_le : ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (R : ℝ),
      0 ≤ R → |w 0| ≤ R → |w 1| ≤ R → ‖w‖ ≤ 2 * R := by
    intro w R hR h0 h1
    have hsq : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hw0 : (w 0) ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (w 0)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h0 2
    have hw1 : (w 1) ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (w 1)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
    have hle : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * R) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]

  have h_coord_le_norm : ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      |w 0| ≤ ‖w‖ ∧ |w 1| ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    have hsq : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w 0) ^ 2 + (w 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have h0_sq : |w 0| ^ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq_abs]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w 1)]
    have h1_sq : |w 1| ^ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq_abs]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w 0)]
    exact ⟨by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (w 0), norm_nonneg w],
      by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (w 1), norm_nonneg w]⟩

  have h_floor_quot_abs : ∀ (M_arg : ℕ) (s x y τ_c : ℝ),
      1 ≤ M_arg → 0 < s →
      Int.floor ((x - τ_c) / s) / (M_arg : ℤ) = Int.floor ((y - τ_c) / s) / (M_arg : ℤ) →
      |x - y| ≤ (M_arg : ℝ) * s := by
    intro M_arg s x y τ_c hM hs hq
    have hM_pos : (0 : ℤ) < (M_arg : ℤ) := by omega
    let k₁ := Int.floor ((x - τ_c) / s)
    let k₂ := Int.floor ((y - τ_c) / s)
    obtain ⟨hk_lo, hk_hi⟩ := h_ediv_diff (M_arg : ℤ) k₁ k₂ hM_pos hq
    have hk_lo_r : ((-((M_arg : ℤ)) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((k₁ - k₂ : ℤ) : ℝ) := Int.cast_le.mpr hk_lo
    have hk_hi_r : ((k₁ - k₂ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (((M_arg : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := Int.cast_le.mpr hk_hi
    push_cast at hk_lo_r hk_hi_r
    have ha_lo : (k₁ : ℝ) ≤ (x - τ_c) / s := Int.floor_le _
    have ha_hi : (x - τ_c) / s < (k₁ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hb_lo : (k₂ : ℝ) ≤ (y - τ_c) / s := Int.floor_le _
    have hb_hi : (y - τ_c) / s < (k₂ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hdiff_eq : (x - y) / s = (x - τ_c) / s - (y - τ_c) / s := by ring
    have hdiv_abs : |(x - y) / s| ≤ (M_arg : ℝ) := by
      rw [hdiff_eq, abs_le]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs, div_le_iff₀ hs] at hdiv_abs
    exact hdiv_abs

  have h_coarse_vel : ∀ (M_arg : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (τ z₁ z₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      1 ≤ M_arg → 0 < s →
      (let p₁ := roundShift2D s τ z₁
       let p₂ := roundShift2D s τ z₂
       (p₁.1 / (M_arg : ℤ), p₁.2 / (M_arg : ℤ)) = (p₂.1 / (M_arg : ℤ), p₂.2 / (M_arg : ℤ))) →
      ‖z₁ - z₂‖ ≤ 2 * ((M_arg : ℝ) * s) := by
    intro M_arg s τ z₁ z₂ hM hs hq
    obtain ⟨hq0, hq1⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hq
    have hsub0 : (z₁ - z₂) 0 = z₁ 0 - z₂ 0 := rfl
    have hsub1 : (z₁ - z₂) 1 = z₁ 1 - z₂ 1 := rfl
    refine h_norm2d_le (z₁ - z₂) ((M_arg : ℝ) * s) (by positivity) ?_ ?_
    · rw [hsub0]
      exact h_floor_quot_abs M_arg s (z₁ 0) (z₂ 0) (τ 0) hM hs hq0
    · rw [hsub1]
      exact h_floor_quot_abs M_arg s (z₁ 1) (z₂ 1) (τ 1) hM hs hq1

  have h_round0_dist : ∀ (s : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < s → ‖v - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 v)‖ ≤ 2 * s := by
    intro s v hs
    let k := roundShift2D s 0 v
    have h_1d : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - s * (Int.floor ((x - 0) / s) : ℝ)| ≤ s := by
      intro x
      rw [sub_zero]
      have hlo : (Int.floor (x / s) : ℝ) * s ≤ x := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le (x / s))
      have hhi : x < ((Int.floor (x / s) : ℝ) + 1) * s :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / s))
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hc0 : (v - gridPt2D s k) 0 = v 0 - s * (Int.floor ((v 0 - 0) / s) : ℝ) := rfl
    have hc1 : (v - gridPt2D s k) 1 = v 1 - s * (Int.floor ((v 1 - 0) / s) : ℝ) := rfl
    refine h_norm2d_le (v - gridPt2D s k) s hs.le ?_ ?_
    · rw [hc0]; exact h_1d (v 0)
    · rw [hc1]; exact h_1d (v 1)

  have h_floor_eq_abs : ∀ (δ x y : ℝ),
      0 < δ → Int.floor (x / δ) = Int.floor (y / δ) → |x - y| ≤ δ := by
    intro δ x y hδ hq
    let k := Int.floor (x / δ)
    have hx_lo : (k : ℝ) ≤ x / δ := Int.floor_le _
    have hx_hi : x / δ < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hy_lo : (k : ℝ) ≤ y / δ := by dsimp [k]; rw [hq]; exact Int.floor_le _
    have hy_hi : y / δ < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by dsimp [k]; rw [hq]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hdiv : |(x - y) / δ| ≤ 1 := by
      have heq : (x - y) / δ = x / δ - y / δ := by ring
      rw [heq, abs_le]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hδ, div_le_iff₀ hδ, one_mul] at hdiv
    exact hdiv

  have h_mem_Icc_grid : ∀ (δ y : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (m : ℤ),
      0 < δ → |δ * (m : ℝ) - y| ≤ (L : ℝ) * δ →
      m ∈ Finset.Icc (Int.floor (y / δ) - (L : ℤ)) (Int.floor (y / δ) + (L : ℤ)) := by
    intro δ y L m hδ habs
    let k := Int.floor (y / δ)
    have hk_lo : (k : ℝ) * δ ≤ y := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mp (Int.floor_le (y / δ))
    have hk_hi : y < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * δ := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (y / δ))
    obtain ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
    have hm_lo_r : ((k - (L : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * δ ≤ (m : ℝ) * δ := by
      push_cast; linarith
    have hm_hi_r : (m : ℝ) * δ < ((k + (L : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * δ := by
      push_cast; linarith
    have hm_lo : k - (L : ℤ) ≤ m :=
      Int.cast_le.mp (le_of_mul_le_mul_right hm_lo_r hδ)
    have hm_lt : m < k + (L : ℤ) + 1 :=
      Int.cast_lt.mp (lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right hm_hi_r hδ.le)
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm_lo, by omega⟩

  have h_cover4d : ∀ {N_ret N_Q M_m : ℕ} (B_s ρ_r σ_r s_v s_x s_loc : ℝ)
      (V_J X_J v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (o_at : Fin N_ret → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
      (α_of : Fin N_Q → Fin N_ret)
      (S_ball : Finset (Fin N_Q)),
      0 < ρ_r → 0 < σ_r → 0 < s_v → 0 < s_x → 0 < s_loc →
      s_v * s_loc = ρ_r → s_x * s_loc ≤ 2 * B_s * σ_r →
      Function.Injective α_of →
      (∀ o₀, ∀ F : Finset (Fin N_ret), (∀ α ∈ F, o_at α = o₀) → F.card ≤ M_m) →
      (∀ T ∈ S_ball,
        ‖s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at (α_of T)).1 - V_J) - v₀‖ ≤ s_loc ∧
        ‖s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r (o_at (α_of T)).2 - X_J) - x₀‖ ≤ s_loc) →
      S_ball.card ≤ 9 * (2 * Nat.ceil (2 * B_s) + 2) ^ 2 * M_m := by
    intro N_ret N_Q M_m B_s ρ_r σ_r s_v s_x s_loc V_J X_J v₀ x₀ o_at α_of S_ball
      hρ_r hσ_r hs_v hs_x _ h_sv_sloc h_sx_sloc hα_inj h_fib h_mem
    let L_X : ℕ := Nat.ceil (2 * B_s)
    have hLX_ge : 2 * B_s ≤ (L_X : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil (2 * B_s)
    have h_sx_LX : s_x * s_loc ≤ (L_X : ℝ) * σ_r :=
      le_trans h_sx_sloc (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLX_ge hσ_r.le)
    let v₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := V_J + s_v • v₀
    let x₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := X_J + s_x • x₀
    let kv0 := Int.floor (v₁ 0 / ρ_r)
    let kv1 := Int.floor (v₁ 1 / ρ_r)
    let kx0 := Int.floor (x₁ 0 / σ_r)
    let kx1 := Int.floor (x₁ 1 / σ_r)
    let box_V0 := Finset.Icc (kv0 - 1) (kv0 + 1)
    let box_V1 := Finset.Icc (kv1 - 1) (kv1 + 1)
    let box_X0 := Finset.Icc (kx0 - (L_X : ℤ)) (kx0 + (L_X : ℤ))
    let box_X1 := Finset.Icc (kx1 - (L_X : ℤ)) (kx1 + (L_X : ℤ))
    let B_4d : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) := (box_V0 ×ˢ box_V1) ×ˢ (box_X0 ×ˢ box_X1)
    have h_maps : ∀ T ∈ S_ball, o_at (α_of T) ∈ B_4d := by
      intro T hT
      obtain ⟨hVT, hXT⟩ := h_mem T hT
      have hV_diff : gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at (α_of T)).1 - v₁ =
          s_v • (s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at (α_of T)).1 - V_J) - v₀) := by
        rw [smul_sub, smul_inv_smul₀ hs_v.ne']
        dsimp [v₁]
        abel
      have hV_norm : ‖gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at (α_of T)).1 - v₁‖ ≤ (1 : ℕ) * ρ_r := by
        rw [hV_diff, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_v.le, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
        calc s_v * ‖s_v⁻¹ • (gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at (α_of T)).1 - V_J) - v₀‖
            ≤ s_v * s_loc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hVT hs_v.le
          _ = ρ_r := h_sv_sloc
      have hX_diff : gridPt2D σ_r (o_at (α_of T)).2 - x₁ =
          s_x • (s_x⁻¹ • (gridPt2D σ_r (o_at (α_of T)).2 - X_J) - x₀) := by
        rw [smul_sub, smul_inv_smul₀ hs_x.ne']
        dsimp [x₁]
        abel
      have hX_norm : ‖gridPt2D σ_r (o_at (α_of T)).2 - x₁‖ ≤ (L_X : ℝ) * σ_r := by
        rw [hX_diff, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_x.le]
        exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXT hs_x.le) h_sx_LX
      obtain ⟨hV0, hV1⟩ := h_coord_le_norm (gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at (α_of T)).1 - v₁)
      obtain ⟨hX0, hX1⟩ := h_coord_le_norm (gridPt2D σ_r (o_at (α_of T)).2 - x₁)
      have hgV0 : (gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at (α_of T)).1 - v₁) 0 =
          ρ_r * ((o_at (α_of T)).1.1 : ℝ) - v₁ 0 := rfl
      have hgV1 : (gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at (α_of T)).1 - v₁) 1 =
          ρ_r * ((o_at (α_of T)).1.2 : ℝ) - v₁ 1 := rfl
      have hgX0 : (gridPt2D σ_r (o_at (α_of T)).2 - x₁) 0 =
          σ_r * ((o_at (α_of T)).2.1 : ℝ) - x₁ 0 := rfl
      have hgX1 : (gridPt2D σ_r (o_at (α_of T)).2 - x₁) 1 =
          σ_r * ((o_at (α_of T)).2.2 : ℝ) - x₁ 1 := rfl
      rw [hgV0] at hV0; rw [hgV1] at hV1; rw [hgX0] at hX0; rw [hgX1] at hX1
      have hmV0 := h_mem_Icc_grid ρ_r (v₁ 0) 1 (o_at (α_of T)).1.1 hρ_r (le_trans hV0 hV_norm)
      have hmV1 := h_mem_Icc_grid ρ_r (v₁ 1) 1 (o_at (α_of T)).1.2 hρ_r (le_trans hV1 hV_norm)
      have hmX0 := h_mem_Icc_grid σ_r (x₁ 0) L_X (o_at (α_of T)).2.1 hσ_r (le_trans hX0 hX_norm)
      have hmX1 := h_mem_Icc_grid σ_r (x₁ 1) L_X (o_at (α_of T)).2.2 hσ_r (le_trans hX1 hX_norm)
      exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hmV0, hmV1⟩,
        Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hmX0, hmX1⟩⟩
    have h_fib_T : ∀ o₀ ∈ B_4d, (S_ball.filter (fun T => o_at (α_of T) = o₀)).card ≤ M_m := by
      intro o₀ _
      let F_T := S_ball.filter (fun T => o_at (α_of T) = o₀)
      have h_eq : (F_T.image α_of).card = F_T.card := Finset.card_image_of_injective F_T hα_inj
      rw [← h_eq]
      refine h_fib o₀ (F_T.image α_of) (fun α hα => ?_)
      obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hα
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).2
    have h_card_mul := Finset.card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to h_maps M_m h_fib_T
    have h_B4d_card : B_4d.card ≤ 9 * (2 * L_X + 2) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [B_4d, box_V0, box_V1, box_X0, box_X1]
      rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product,
        Int.card_Icc, Int.card_Icc, Int.card_Icc, Int.card_Icc]
      have hcV0 : (kv0 + 1 + 1 - (kv0 - 1)).toNat = 3 := by omega
      have hcV1 : (kv1 + 1 + 1 - (kv1 - 1)).toNat = 3 := by omega
      have hcX0 : (kx0 + (L_X : ℤ) + 1 - (kx0 - (L_X : ℤ))).toNat ≤ 2 * L_X + 2 := by omega
      have hcX1 : (kx1 + (L_X : ℤ) + 1 - (kx1 - (L_X : ℤ))).toNat ≤ 2 * L_X + 2 := by omega
      rw [hcV0, hcV1, sq]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul le_rfl (Nat.mul_le_mul hcX0 hcX1)
    calc S_ball.card
        ≤ M_m * B_4d.card := h_card_mul
      _ ≤ M_m * (9 * (2 * L_X + 2) ^ 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left M_m h_B4d_card
      _ = 9 * (2 * L_X + 2) ^ 2 * M_m := Nat.mul_comm _ _

  have h_perp2d_props : ∀ n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖n‖ = 1 →
      inner ℝ n n = 1 ∧ inner ℝ n (perp2D n) = 0 ∧ ‖perp2D n‖ = 1 := by
    intro n hn
    have hnn : inner ℝ n n = 1 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn, one_pow]
    have hperp : inner ℝ n (perp2D n) = 0 := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hp0 : (perp2D n) 0 = -(n 1) := rfl
      have hp1 : (perp2D n) 1 = n 0 := rfl
      rw [hp0, hp1]
      simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      ring
    have hnorm_sq : ‖perp2D n‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have hn_sq : (n 0) ^ 2 + (n 1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have h := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq n
        rw [hn, one_pow, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h.symm
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hp0 : (perp2D n) 0 = -(n 1) := rfl
      have hp1 : (perp2D n) 1 = n 0 := rfl
      rw [hp0, hp1]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      linarith
    refine ⟨hnn, hperp, ?_⟩
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D n)]

  have h_z_fiber : ∀ {N_obs : ℕ} (s_loc σ_loc : ℝ)
      (X_Q n_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (X'_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (k_Z : ℤ × ℤ) (S_Z : Finset (Fin N_obs)),
      0 < s_loc → 0 < σ_loc → ‖n_P‖ = 1 →
      (∀ i : Fin N_obs, ‖X'_O i - X_Q‖ ≤ 2 * s_loc) →
      (∀ i ∈ S_Z,
        (d_dim = 1 → (Int.floor (inner ℝ (X'_O i - X_Q) n_P / σ_loc), (0 : ℤ)) = k_Z) ∧
        (d_dim = 2 → roundShift2D σ_loc 0 (X'_O i - X_Q) = k_Z)) →
      ∃ x_Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ∀ i ∈ S_Z,
        (d_dim = 1 →
          |inner ℝ (X'_O i - x_Z) n_P| ≤ σ_loc ∧
          |inner ℝ (X'_O i - x_Z) (perp2D n_P)| ≤ 2 * s_loc) ∧
        (d_dim = 2 → ‖X'_O i - x_Z‖ ≤ 2 * σ_loc) := by
    intro N_obs s_loc σ_loc X_Q n_P X'_O k_Z S_Z hs_loc hσ_loc hn_P hXQ hSZ
    obtain ⟨hnn, hperp, hn_perp⟩ := h_perp2d_props n_P hn_P
    rcases hd_dim with hd1 | hd2
    · refine ⟨X_Q + ((k_Z.1 : ℝ) * σ_loc) • n_P, fun i hi => ⟨fun _ => ?_, fun h2 => by omega⟩⟩
      have hk_eq := (hSZ i hi).1 hd1
      have hfl : Int.floor (inner ℝ (X'_O i - X_Q) n_P / σ_loc) = k_Z.1 :=
        (Prod.mk.inj hk_eq).1
      have hlo : (k_Z.1 : ℝ) * σ_loc ≤ inner ℝ (X'_O i - X_Q) n_P := by
        rw [← hfl]
        exact (le_div_iff₀ hσ_loc).mp (Int.floor_le _)
      have hhi : inner ℝ (X'_O i - X_Q) n_P < ((k_Z.1 : ℝ) + 1) * σ_loc := by
        rw [← hfl]
        exact (div_lt_iff₀ hσ_loc).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one _)
      have hvec : X'_O i - (X_Q + ((k_Z.1 : ℝ) * σ_loc) • n_P) =
          (X'_O i - X_Q) - ((k_Z.1 : ℝ) * σ_loc) • n_P := by abel
      constructor
      · rw [hvec, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, hnn, mul_one]
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · rw [hvec, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, hperp, mul_zero, sub_zero]
        calc |inner ℝ (X'_O i - X_Q) (perp2D n_P)|
            ≤ ‖X'_O i - X_Q‖ * ‖perp2D n_P‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ = ‖X'_O i - X_Q‖ := by rw [hn_perp, mul_one]
          _ ≤ 2 * s_loc := hXQ i
    · refine ⟨X_Q + gridPt2D σ_loc k_Z, fun i hi => ⟨fun h1 => by omega, fun _ => ?_⟩⟩
      have hk_eq := (hSZ i hi).2 hd2
      obtain ⟨hk0, hk1⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hk_eq
      have hvec : X'_O i - (X_Q + gridPt2D σ_loc k_Z) =
          (X'_O i - X_Q) - gridPt2D σ_loc k_Z := by abel
      have h_1d : ∀ (y : ℝ) (m : ℤ), Int.floor ((y - 0) / σ_loc) = m →
          |y - σ_loc * (m : ℝ)| ≤ σ_loc := by
        intro y m hm
        rw [sub_zero] at hm
        have hlo : (m : ℝ) * σ_loc ≤ y := by
          rw [← hm]
          exact (le_div_iff₀ hσ_loc).mp (Int.floor_le _)
        have hhi : y < ((m : ℝ) + 1) * σ_loc := by
          rw [← hm]
          exact (div_lt_iff₀ hσ_loc).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one _)
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hc0 : ((X'_O i - X_Q) - gridPt2D σ_loc k_Z) 0 =
          (X'_O i - X_Q) 0 - σ_loc * (k_Z.1 : ℝ) := rfl
      have hc1 : ((X'_O i - X_Q) - gridPt2D σ_loc k_Z) 1 =
          (X'_O i - X_Q) 1 - σ_loc * (k_Z.2 : ℝ) := rfl
      rw [hvec]
      refine h_norm2d_le _ σ_loc hσ_loc.le ?_ ?_
      · rw [hc0]; exact h_1d ((X'_O i - X_Q) 0) k_Z.1 hk0
      · rw [hc1]; exact h_1d ((X'_O i - X_Q) 1) k_Z.2 hk1

  have h_vel_bin_width : ∀ (ε H_P t r s_v s_loc : ℝ)
      (τ_V V_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (p_buf p_at₁ p_at₂ : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
      (v₁ v₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
      let n_fine := fun p_c => n_buf (coarseOfFineCell M_L p_c)
      0 < s_v → 0 < ρ_r → s_v * s_loc = ρ_r →
      coarseOfFineCell M_L p_at₁ = p_buf →
      (p_at₁, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at₁ v₁) =
        (p_at₂, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at₂ v₂) →
      let v'_1 := s_v⁻¹ • (v₁ - V_J)
      let v'_2 := s_v⁻¹ • (v₂ - V_J)
      (d_dim = 1 → |inner ℝ (v'_1 - v'_2) (n_buf p_buf)| ≤ s_loc) ∧
      (d_dim = 2 → ‖v'_1 - v'_2‖ ≤ 2 * s_loc) := by
    intro ε H_P t r s_v s_loc τ_V V_J n_buf p_buf p_at₁ p_at₂ v₁ v₂ ρ_r n_fine
      hs_v hρ_r h_sv_sloc hcoarse hpw v'_1 v'_2
    obtain ⟨hp_eq, hbin_eq⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hpw
    subst hp_eq
    have h_sv_inv : s_v⁻¹ * ρ_r = s_loc := by
      rw [← h_sv_sloc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hs_v.ne']
    have hv'_diff : v'_1 - v'_2 = s_v⁻¹ • (v₁ - v₂) := by
      dsimp [v'_1, v'_2]
      rw [← smul_sub]
      congr 1; abel
    let c_V := fineCellCenterV (ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)) τ_V p_at₁.2.1
    rcases hd_dim with hd1 | hd2
    · refine ⟨fun _ => ?_, fun h2 => by omega⟩
      unfold fineVelBin at hbin_eq
      rw [if_pos hd1, if_pos hd1] at hbin_eq
      have hfl := (Prod.mk.inj hbin_eq).1
      have hn_eq : n_fine p_at₁ = n_buf p_buf := by dsimp [n_fine]; rw [hcoarse]
      rw [hn_eq] at hfl
      have h_abs_v : |inner ℝ (v₁ - c_V) (n_buf p_buf) - inner ℝ (v₂ - c_V) (n_buf p_buf)| ≤ ρ_r :=
        h_floor_eq_abs ρ_r _ _ hρ_r hfl
      have h_inner_diff : inner ℝ (v₁ - c_V) (n_buf p_buf) - inner ℝ (v₂ - c_V) (n_buf p_buf) =
          inner ℝ (v₁ - v₂) (n_buf p_buf) := by
        rw [← inner_sub_left]; congr 1; abel
      rw [h_inner_diff] at h_abs_v
      rw [hv'_diff, real_inner_smul_left, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs_v), ← h_sv_inv]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_abs_v (inv_nonneg.mpr hs_v.le)
    · refine ⟨fun h1 => by omega, fun _ => ?_⟩
      have hd_ne1 : d_dim ≠ 1 := by omega
      unfold fineVelBin at hbin_eq
      rw [if_neg hd_ne1, if_neg hd_ne1] at hbin_eq
      obtain ⟨hfl0, hfl1⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hbin_eq
      have ha0 := h_floor_eq_abs ρ_r ((v₁ - c_V) 0) ((v₂ - c_V) 0) hρ_r hfl0
      have ha1 := h_floor_eq_abs ρ_r ((v₁ - c_V) 1) ((v₂ - c_V) 1) hρ_r hfl1

        ≤ (cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P)) * (2 * ε ^ r) * ε ^ (H_P - r) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
            exact mul_le_mul hlam_hi hs_c_hi hs_c_pos.le
              (mul_nonneg hBsys_pos.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
      _ = 2 * cls.B_sys * (ε ^ (-H_P) * ε ^ r * ε ^ (H_P - r)) := by ring
      _ = 2 * cls.B_sys := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
            have hz : -H_P + r + (H_P - r) = 0 := by ring
            rw [hz, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
  have h_lam_sloc_hi : lam_loc * s_loc ^ 2 ≤ B_cell :=
    le_trans h_lam_sloc_2B h2Bsys_le_Bcell
  have h_sx_sloc_ub : s_x * s_loc ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys * σ_r := by
    have hid : s_x * s_loc = (lam_loc * s_loc ^ 2) * σ_r := by
      have hne : lam_sys * ρ_r ≠ 0 := (mul_pos hlam_pos hρ_r_pos).ne'
      have h1 : (s_x * s_loc) * (lam_sys * ρ_r) = lam_loc * s_loc ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [lam_loc, s_x]
        rw [← h_sv_sloc]
        ring
      calc s_x * s_loc
          = ((s_x * s_loc) * (lam_sys * ρ_r)) * (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹ :=
              (mul_inv_cancel_right₀ hne (s_x * s_loc)).symm
        _ = (lam_loc * s_loc ^ 2) * σ_r := by rw [h1]
    rw [hid]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_lam_sloc_2B hσ_r_pos.le

  have h_per_q : ∀ q : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ),
      (S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q)).Nonempty →
      (∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q), m_site o ≤
        C_bridge * ε ^ (-ξ) * ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin) ∧
      (∀ k_Z : ℤ × ℤ,
        ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Z_of o = (q, k_Z)), m_site o ≤
          C_bridge * ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - 2 * ξ) *
            ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin) := by
    intro q hSQ
    let S_Q := S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q)
    obtain ⟨o₀, ho₀⟩ := hSQ
    obtain ⟨ho₀_act, ho₀_Q⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho₀
    let p_buf := q.1
    let r_loc := q.2.1
    let k_XQ := q.2.2
    let r_full : ℕ := sub.loc_idx.1 * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc
    let C_t_q : ℝ := ((r_full : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
    let c_end : ℝ := ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
    let X_Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D s_loc k_XQ
    let n_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := n_buf p_buf
    have hr_loc_o₀ : r_O o₀ % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) = r_loc := congrArg (fun x => x.2.1) ho₀_Q
    have hr_loc_lt : r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) := by
      rw [← hr_loc_o₀]
      exact (h_act o₀ ho₀_act).2.1
    have hT_ne : (T_cand q).Nonempty := by
      rw [← ho₀_Q]
      exact (h_act o₀ ho₀_act).2.2.2.2.2
    have hc_end_mem : c_end ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [Set.mem_Icc]
      have hle_nat : r_loc + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hr_loc_lt
      have hle_r : (r_loc : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r) := by exact_mod_cast hle_nat
      have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r) := by positivity
      refine ⟨by dsimp [c_end]; positivity, ?_⟩
      dsimp [c_end]
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one hpow_pos]
      linarith
    let R : ℝ := B_Q * ε ^ (-θ)
    have hBQ_eq : B_Q = B_Q₀ := rfl
    have hε_mθ_ge1 : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-θ) :=
      Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith)
    have hR_ge1 : 1 ≤ R := by
      dsimp [R]
      rw [hBQ_eq]
      nlinarith [hBQ0_ge1, hε_mθ_ge1]
    have hr_O_eq : ∀ o ∈ S_Q, r_O o = r_full := by
      intro o ho
      obtain ⟨ho_act, ho_Q⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho
      have hrem : r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) = r_loc := congrArg (fun x => x.2.1) ho_Q
      rw [(h_act o ho_act).1, hrem]

    let N_Q : ℕ := (T_cand q).card
    let e_Q : ↥(T_cand q) ≃ Fin N_Q := (T_cand q).equivFin
    let α_of : Fin N_Q → Fin N_ret := fun T => (e_Q.symm T).1
    have hα_mem : ∀ T : Fin N_Q, α_of T ∈ T_cand q := fun T => (e_Q.symm T).2
    have hα_inj : Function.Injective α_of :=
      fun T₁ T₂ h => e_Q.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)

    let N_obs : ℕ := S_Q.card
    let e_obs : ↥S_Q ≃ Fin N_obs := S_Q.equivFin
    let o_of : Fin N_obs → Fin N_O := fun i => (e_obs.symm i).1
    have ho_mem : ∀ i : Fin N_obs, o_of i ∈ S_Q := fun i => (e_obs.symm i).2
    have ho_inj : Function.Injective o_of :=
      fun i₁ i₂ h => e_obs.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)

    let pw_fn : Fin N_ret → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun α =>
      let p_at := atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)
      (p_at, fineVelBin ε H_P t r d_dim τ_V n_fine p_at (V_at α))
    let B_bins := (T_cand q).image pw_fn
    let K : ℕ := B_bins.card
    let e_bin : ↥B_bins ≃ Fin K := B_bins.equivFin
    let bin_of : Fin N_Q → Fin K :=
      fun T => e_bin ⟨pw_fn (α_of T), Finset.mem_image_of_mem pw_fn (hα_mem T)⟩
    have hK_ge1 : 1 ≤ K := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.card_pos.mpr (hT_ne.image pw_fn))
    have hK_le : (K : ℝ) ≤ ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(k_out + ξ)) := by
      have hsub_bins : B_bins ⊆ (Finset.univ.image pw_fn).filter
          (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf) := by
        intro pw hpw
        obtain ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpw
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem pw_fn (Finset.mem_univ α),
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp hα).2.1⟩
      have hcard_nat : K ≤ ((Finset.univ.image pw_fn).filter
          (fun pw => coarseOfFineCell M_L pw.1 = p_buf)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card hsub_bins
      exact le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard_nat) (h_vel_cnt p_buf)

    let V_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := s_v⁻¹ • (V_O o₀ - V_J)
    let V_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun T => V'_at (α_of T)
    let X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun T => X'_at (α_of T)
    let η_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun T z => star (sub.ψ_at (α_of T) z)
    let V'_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun i => s_v⁻¹ • (V_O (o_of i) - V_J)
    let X'_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      fun i => s_x⁻¹ • (X_O (o_of i) - X_J - (C_t_q - C_r) • V_J)
    let ψ_O_loc : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun i => ψ_loc (o_of i)

    have ho₀_coarse_V :
        ((roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_O o₀)).1 / (M_L : ℤ),
         (roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_O o₀)).2 / (M_L : ℤ)) = p_buf.2.1 :=
      congrArg (fun p_c => p_c.2.1) (congrArg Prod.fst ho₀_Q)

    have hVT_VP : ∀ T : Fin N_Q, ‖V_T T - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ := by
      intro T
      have hα_c : coarseOfFineCell M_L
          (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X sub.loc_idx.1 (V_at (α_of T)) (X_at (α_of T))) = p_buf :=
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hα_mem T)).2.1
      have hV_c :
          ((roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_at (α_of T))).1 / (M_L : ℤ),
           (roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_at (α_of T))).2 / (M_L : ℤ)) =
          ((roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_O o₀)).1 / (M_L : ℤ),
           (roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_O o₀)).2 / (M_L : ℤ)) :=
        (congrArg (fun p_c => p_c.2.1) hα_c).trans ho₀_coarse_V.symm
      have hdist := h_coarse_vel M_L ρ_obs τ_V (V_at (α_of T)) (V_O o₀) hML_ge1 hρ_obs_pos hV_c
      have hsub_eq : V_T T - V_P = s_v⁻¹ • (V_at (α_of T) - V_O o₀) := by
        dsimp [V_T, V'_at, V_P]
        rw [← smul_sub]
        congr 1; abel
      rw [hsub_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hs_v_pos.le)]
      calc s_v⁻¹ * ‖V_at (α_of T) - V_O o₀‖
          ≤ s_v⁻¹ * (2 * ((M_L : ℝ) * ρ_obs)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist (inv_nonneg.mpr hs_v_pos.le)
        _ = 2 * (M_L : ℝ) * (s_v⁻¹ * (s_v * ρ)) := by rw [← h_sv_ρ]; ring
        _ = 2 * (M_L : ℝ) * ρ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hs_v_pos.ne']
        _ ≤ B_cell * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2ML_le_Bcell hρ_pos.le

    have hVO_VP : ∀ i : Fin N_obs, ‖V'_O i - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ := by
      intro i
      have hi_Q : Q_of (o_of i) = q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ho_mem i)).2
      have hV_c :
          ((roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_O (o_of i))).1 / (M_L : ℤ),
           (roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_O (o_of i))).2 / (M_L : ℤ)) =
          ((roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_O o₀)).1 / (M_L : ℤ),
           (roundShift2D ρ_obs τ_V (V_O o₀)).2 / (M_L : ℤ)) :=
        (congrArg (fun p_c => p_c.2.1) (congrArg Prod.fst hi_Q)).trans ho₀_coarse_V.symm
      have hdist := h_coarse_vel M_L ρ_obs τ_V (V_O (o_of i)) (V_O o₀) hML_ge1 hρ_obs_pos hV_c
      have hsub_eq : V'_O i - V_P = s_v⁻¹ • (V_O (o_of i) - V_O o₀) := by
        dsimp [V'_O, V_P]
        rw [← smul_sub]
        congr 1; abel
      rw [hsub_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hs_v_pos.le)]
      calc s_v⁻¹ * ‖V_O (o_of i) - V_O o₀‖
          ≤ s_v⁻¹ * (2 * ((M_L : ℝ) * ρ_obs)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist (inv_nonneg.mpr hs_v_pos.le)
        _ = 2 * (M_L : ℝ) * (s_v⁻¹ * (s_v * ρ)) := by rw [← h_sv_ρ]; ring
        _ = 2 * (M_L : ℝ) * ρ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hs_v_pos.ne']
        _ ≤ B_cell * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2ML_le_Bcell hρ_pos.le

    have hXO_XQ : ∀ i : Fin N_obs, ‖X'_O i - X_Q‖ ≤ 2 * s_loc := by
      intro i
      have hi_Q : Q_of (o_of i) = q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ho_mem i)).2
      have hi_r : r_O (o_of i) = r_full := hr_O_eq (o_of i) (ho_mem i)
      have hk_eq : roundShift2D s_loc 0 (X'_O i) = k_XQ := by
        have h22 := congrArg (fun x => x.2.2) hi_Q
        dsimp [Q_of, X'_O, C_t_q] at h22 ⊢
        rwa [hi_r] at h22
      dsimp [X_Q]
      rw [← hk_eq]
      exact h_round0_dist s_loc (X'_O i) hs_loc_pos

    let h_cand_q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
      fun v => ∑ T : Fin N_Q, sub.c_at (α_of T) * g_at (α_of T) v
    have hh_cand_eq : h_cand_q = fun v => ∑ α ∈ T_cand q, sub.c_at α * g_at α v := by
      ext v
      dsimp [h_cand_q, α_of]
      rw [Equiv.sum_comp e_Q.symm (fun x : ↥(T_cand q) => sub.c_at x.1 * g_at x.1 v)]
      exact Finset.sum_attach (T_cand q) (fun α => sub.c_at α * g_at α v)
    obtain ⟨hmeas_q, hmem_q⟩ := h_L2 (T_cand q)
    rw [← hh_cand_eq] at hmeas_q hmem_q

    let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r sub.loc_idx.1 s_v V_J X_J
    let ζ'₀ := localGaugeGrad ζ₀ m_r sub.loc_idx.1 s_v V_J X_J
    let c_T : Fin N_Q → ℂ := fun T =>
      sub.c_at (α_of T) *
        Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at (α_of T), V_J) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    let h_Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun v' => ∑ T : Fin N_Q, c_T T *
      ((s_loc⁻¹ : ℂ) * η_T T (s_loc⁻¹ • (v' - V_T T)) *
        Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ'₀ (1 / 2, X_T T, v') : ℝ) : ℂ))))
    let m_obs : Fin N_obs → ℝ := fun i =>
      ‖(ρ⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v', h_Q v' * ψ_O_loc i (ρ⁻¹ • (v' - V'_O i)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_loc * Φ'₀ (c_end, X'_O i, v') : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2

    obtain ⟨h_ph_loc, hc_T_norm, h_mass_eq⟩ :=
      h_resc_sum Φ₀ ζ₀ m_r m_t sub.loc_idx.1 ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys V_J X_J N_Q
        (fun T => V_at (α_of T)) (fun T => X_at (α_of T)) η_T (fun T => sub.c_at (α_of T))
        h_phase hmr_le_mt hqr_lt hε_pos hε_lt hr_eq hb_star hlam_pos hmeas_q hmem_q

    have hm_site_eq : ∀ i : Fin N_obs, m_site (o_of i) = m_obs i := by
      intro i
      have hi_Q : Q_of (o_of i) = q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ho_mem i)).2
      have hi_r : r_O (o_of i) = r_full := hr_O_eq (o_of i) (ho_mem i)
      dsimp [m_site]
      rw [hi_Q, ← hh_cand_eq, hi_r]
      exact h_mass_eq r_loc hr_loc_lt (V_O (o_of i)) (X_O (o_of i)) (ψ_loc (o_of i))

    have h_atom_pack_q : ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
          ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s_loc ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s_loc)).card : ℝ) ≤
          (M_mult_coh : ℝ) := by
      intro v₀ x₀
      have h_fib : ∀ o₀, ∀ F : Finset (Fin N_ret), (∀ α ∈ F, sub.o_at α = o₀) → F.card ≤ M_mult := by
        intro o₀ F hF
        have hsub_F : F ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret => sub.o_at α = o₀) :=
          fun α hα => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ α, hF α hα⟩
        exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub_F) (Nat.cast_le.mp (h_o_mult o₀))
      have hcard := h_cover4d cls.B_sys ρ_r σ_r s_v s_x s_loc V_J X_J v₀ x₀ sub.o_at α_of
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q => ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s_loc ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s_loc))
        hρ_r_pos hσ_r_pos hs_v_pos hs_x_pos hs_loc_pos h_sv_sloc h_sx_sloc_ub hα_inj h_fib
        (fun T hT => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).2)
      exact Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard

    have h_bin_sep_q : ∀ T₁ T₂ : Fin N_Q, bin_of T₁ = bin_of T₂ →
        (d_dim = 1 → |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P| ≤ B_cell * s_loc) ∧
        (d_dim = 2 → ‖V_T T₁ - V_T T₂‖ ≤ B_cell * s_loc) := by
      intro T₁ T₂ hbin
      have hpw_eq : pw_fn (α_of T₁) = pw_fn (α_of T₂) :=
        Subtype.mk.inj (e_bin.injective hbin)
      have hcoarse₁ : coarseOfFineCell M_L (pw_fn (α_of T₁)).1 = p_buf :=
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hα_mem T₁)).2.1
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h_vel_bin_width ε H_P t r s_v s_loc τ_V V_J n_buf p_buf
        (pw_fn (α_of T₁)).1 (pw_fn (α_of T₂)).1 (V_at (α_of T₁)) (V_at (α_of T₂))
        hs_v_pos hρ_r_pos h_sv_sloc hcoarse₁ hpw_eq
      exact ⟨fun hd1 => le_trans (h1 hd1) (by nlinarith [hB_cell_ge2, hs_loc_pos.le]),
        fun hd2 => le_trans (h2 hd2) (by nlinarith [hB_cell_ge2, hs_loc_pos.le])⟩

    have h_obs_pack_q : ∀ v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N_obs =>
          ‖V'_O i - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X'_O i - x₀‖ ≤ σ_loc)).card : ℝ) ≤ (cls.N_mult : ℝ) := by
      intro v₀ x₀
      let v₁ := V_J + s_v • v₀
      let x₁ := X_J + (C_t_q - C_r) • V_J + s_x • x₀
      let S_sub := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N_obs =>
        ‖V'_O i - v₀‖ ≤ ρ ∧ ‖X'_O i - x₀‖ ≤ σ_loc)
      let S_glob := Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
        r_O o = r_full ∧ ‖V_O o - v₁‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₁‖ ≤ σ_obs)
      have h_maps_o : ∀ i ∈ S_sub, o_of i ∈ S_glob := by
        intro i hi
        obtain ⟨hVi, hXi⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        have hV_eq : V_O (o_of i) - v₁ = s_v • (V'_O i - v₀) := by
          dsimp [V'_O, v₁]
          rw [smul_sub, smul_inv_smul₀ hs_v_pos.ne']
          abel
        have hX_eq : X_O (o_of i) - x₁ = s_x • (X'_O i - x₀) := by
          dsimp [X'_O, x₁]
          rw [smul_sub, smul_inv_smul₀ hs_x_pos.ne']
          abel
        refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hr_O_eq (o_of i) (ho_mem i), ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hV_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_v_pos.le, ← h_sv_ρ]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hVi hs_v_pos.le
        · rw [hX_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_x_pos.le, ← h_sx_σ]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXi hs_x_pos.le
      have hcard_le := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn o_of h_maps_o
        (fun i₁ _ i₂ _ h => ho_inj h)
      exact le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard_le) (h_obs_pack r_full v₁ x₁)

    obtain ⟨h_coh_Q, h_coh_Z⟩ :=
      h_coh_bound Φ'₀ ζ'₀ h_ph_loc lam_loc ρ s_loc c_end R
        hlam_loc_pos hs_loc_pos hsloc_le_ρ hρ_le1 h_lam_sloc_lo h_lam_sloc_hi
        hc_end_mem hR_ge1 V_P X_Q n_P (hnbuf p_buf) d_dim N_Q K N_obs hd_dim hK_ge1
        V_T X_T η_T c_T bin_of V'_O X'_O ψ_O_loc
        ⟨fun T => ⟨(h_at (α_of T)).1.1, (h_at (α_of T)).1.2.1, (h_at (α_of T)).1.2.2,
          hVT_VP T, (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hα_mem T)).2.2⟩,
         h_atom_pack_q, h_bin_sep_q,
         fun i =>
           let ho_act := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ho_mem i)).1
           ⟨(h_act (o_of i) ho_act).2.2.1, (h_act (o_of i) ho_act).2.2.2.1,
            (h_act (o_of i) ho_act).2.2.2.2.1, hVO_VP i⟩,
         h_obs_pack_q⟩

    have hsum_cT_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hsum_cT_le : ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by
      calc ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2
          = ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖sub.c_at (α_of T)‖ ^ 2 :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun T _ => hc_T_norm T)
        _ ≤ ∑ _T : Fin N_Q, (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun T _ => (h_at (α_of T)).2)
        _ = ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]

    constructor
    · have hsum_SQ : ∑ o ∈ S_Q, m_site o = ∑ i : Fin N_obs, m_obs i := by
        have h1 : ∑ i : Fin N_obs, m_site (o_of i) = ∑ o ∈ S_Q, m_site o := by
          dsimp [o_of]
          rw [Equiv.sum_comp e_obs.symm (fun x : ↥S_Q => m_site x.1)]
          exact Finset.sum_attach S_Q m_site
        rw [← h1]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hm_site_eq i)
      rw [hsum_SQ]
      calc ∑ i : Fin N_obs, m_obs i
          ≤ C_coh * ∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2 := h_coh_Q
        _ ≤ C_coh * (((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_cT_le (by linarith [hC_coh])
        _ ≤ C_bridge * (((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCcoh_le_bridge
              (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
                (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _) hm_bin_nn))
        _ = C_bridge * ε ^ (-ξ) * ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin := by ring
    · intro k_Z
      let S_Z : Finset (Fin N_obs) :=
        Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N_obs => Z_of (o_of i) = (q, k_Z))
      have hSZ_cond : ∀ i ∈ S_Z,
          (d_dim = 1 → (Int.floor (inner ℝ (X'_O i - X_Q) n_P / σ_loc), (0 : ℤ)) = k_Z) ∧
          (d_dim = 2 → roundShift2D σ_loc 0 (X'_O i - X_Q) = k_Z) := by
        intro i hi
        have hZ_eq : Z_of (o_of i) = (q, k_Z) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        have hi_Q : Q_of (o_of i) = q := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ho_mem i)).2
        have hi_r : r_O (o_of i) = r_full := hr_O_eq (o_of i) (ho_mem i)
        have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hZ_eq
        dsimp [Z_of, X'_O, C_t_q, X_Q, n_P, p_buf, k_XQ] at h2 ⊢
        rw [hi_Q, hi_r] at h2
        constructor
        · intro hd1
          rw [if_pos hd1] at h2
          exact h2
        · intro hd2
          have hne1 : d_dim ≠ 1 := by rw [hd2]; norm_num
          rw [if_neg hne1] at h2
          exact h2
      obtain ⟨x_Z, hx_Z⟩ :=
        h_z_fiber s_loc σ_loc X_Q n_P X'_O k_Z S_Z hs_loc_pos hσ_loc_pos (hnbuf p_buf) hXO_XQ hSZ_cond
      have hx_Z_coh : ∀ i ∈ S_Z,
          (d_dim = 1 → |inner ℝ (X'_O i - x_Z) n_P| ≤ B_cell * σ_loc ∧
            |inner ℝ (X'_O i - x_Z) (perp2D n_P)| ≤ B_cell * s_loc) ∧
          (d_dim = 2 → ‖X'_O i - x_Z‖ ≤ B_cell * σ_loc) := by
        intro i hi
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hx_Z i hi
        exact ⟨fun hd1 =>
          ⟨le_trans (h1 hd1).1 (by nlinarith [hB_cell_ge2, hσ_loc_pos.le]),
           le_trans (h1 hd1).2 (by nlinarith [hB_cell_ge2, hs_loc_pos.le])⟩,
          fun hd2 => le_trans (h2 hd2) (by nlinarith [hB_cell_ge2, hσ_loc_pos.le])⟩
      have hsum_SZ : ∑ o ∈ S_act.filter (fun o => Z_of o = (q, k_Z)), m_site o =
          ∑ i ∈ S_Z, m_obs i := by
        symm
        refine Finset.sum_nbij o_of ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun i _ => (hm_site_eq i).symm)
        · intro i hi
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp (ho_mem i)).1,
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩
        · intro i₁ _ i₂ _ h
          exact ho_inj h
        · intro o ho
          obtain ⟨ho_act, ho_Z⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho
          have hZ1 : (Z_of o).1 = Q_of o := by
            dsimp [Z_of]; split_ifs <;> rfl
          have ho_Q : Q_of o = q := hZ1.symm.trans (congrArg Prod.fst ho_Z)
          have ho_SQ : o ∈ S_Q := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ho_act, ho_Q⟩
          let i₀ : Fin N_obs := e_obs ⟨o, ho_SQ⟩
          have hi₀_o : o_of i₀ = o := by
            dsimp [o_of, i₀]
            rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
          refine ⟨i₀, Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩), hi₀_o⟩
          rwa [hi₀_o]
      rw [hsum_SZ]
      have h_raw := h_coh_Z x_Z S_Z hx_Z_coh
      have h_R_sq : R ^ 2 = B_Q₀ ^ 2 * ε ^ (-2 * θ) := by
        dsimp [R]
        rw [hBQ_eq, mul_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast (ε ^ (-θ)) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le]
        congr 2; push_cast; ring
      have h_ratio_pow : (s_loc / ρ) ^ d_dim = ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h) := by
        have hdiv : s_loc / ρ = ε ^ h := by
          dsimp [s_loc, ρ]
          rw [← Real.rpow_sub hε_pos]
          congr 1; ring
        rw [hdiv, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hε_pos.le, mul_comm]
      have h_prod1 : (K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s_loc / ρ) ^ d_dim ≤
          ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * B_Q₀ ^ 2 * ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - ξ) := by
        rw [h_R_sq, h_ratio_pow]
        calc (K : ℝ) * (B_Q₀ ^ 2 * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) * ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h)
            ≤ (((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ (-(k_out + ξ))) *
                (B_Q₀ ^ 2 * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) * ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK_le
                (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
          _ = ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * B_Q₀ ^ 2 *
                (ε ^ (-(k_out + ξ)) * ε ^ (-2 * θ) * ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h)) := by ring
          _ = ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * B_Q₀ ^ 2 * ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - ξ) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
              congr 2; ring
      calc ∑ i ∈ S_Z, m_obs i
          ≤ C_coh * ((K : ℝ) * R ^ 2 * (s_loc / ρ) ^ d_dim) * (∑ T : Fin N_Q, ‖c_T T‖ ^ 2) := by
            linarith [h_raw]
        _ ≤ C_coh * (((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * B_Q₀ ^ 2 *
              ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - ξ)) *
              (((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * (ε ^ (-ξ) * sub.m_bin)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul ?_ hsum_cT_le hsum_cT_nn ?_
            · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod1 (by linarith [hC_coh])
            · exact mul_nonneg (by linarith [hC_coh])
                (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
                  (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
        _ = (C_coh * B_Q₀ ^ 2) * ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              (ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - ξ) * ε ^ (-ξ)) *
              ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin := by ring
        _ = C_bridge * ((M_L ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              ε ^ ((d_dim : ℝ) * h - k_out - 2 * θ - 2 * ξ) *
              ((T_cand q).card : ℝ) * sub.m_bin := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
            dsimp [C_bridge]
            congr 3; ring

  constructor
  · intro q
    by_cases hne : (S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = q)).Nonempty
    · exact (h_per_q q hne).1
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
      exact mul_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith [hC_bridge_ge1]) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
          (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        hm_bin_nn
  · intro z
    by_cases hne : (S_act.filter (fun o => Z_of o = z)).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨o₀, ho₀⟩ := hne
      obtain ⟨ho₀_act, ho₀_Z⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ho₀
      have hZ1 : (Z_of o₀).1 = Q_of o₀ := by
        dsimp [Z_of]; split_ifs <;> rfl
      have ho₀_Q : Q_of o₀ = z.1 := hZ1.symm.trans (congrArg Prod.fst ho₀_Z)
      have hSQ_ne : (S_act.filter (fun o => Q_of o = z.1)).Nonempty :=
        ⟨o₀, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ho₀_act, ho₀_Q⟩⟩
      simpa only [Prod.mk.eta] using (h_per_q z.1 hSQ_ne).2 z.2
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
      exact mul_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith [hC_bridge_ge1]) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
            (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _))
          (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        hm_bin_nn

informal_problem.statement:
(B_sys h ζ_sh C_cov θ : ℝ) (d_dim M_L : ℕ)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hh : 0 < h) (hζ_sh : 0 < ζ_sh)
    (hC_cov : 2 ≤ C_cov) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hd_dim : d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2) :
    ∃ C_list : ℝ,
      1 ≤ C_list ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret : ℕ)
        (τ_V τ_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (n_buf : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ) (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
        (e_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (loc_idx : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (o_at : Fin N_ret → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
        (S_act : Finset (Fin N_O)),
        letI := Classical.propDecidable
        let u := (H_P - t) / 2 - b_star
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((loc_idx.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let V_J := gridPt2D s_v loc_idx.2.1
        let X_J := gridPt2D s_x loc_idx.2.2
        let ρ_r := ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let s_loc := ε ^ (u + h)
        let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
        let σ_loc := (lam_loc * (ε ^ u))⁻¹
        let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (o_at α).1
        let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (o_at α).2
        let V'_at := fun α => s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
        let X'_at := fun α => s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
        let Q_of : Fin N_O → (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun o =>
          let p_buf := coarseOfFineCell M_L (fineOutCell ε H_P t r m_r m_t τ_V τ_X (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o))
          let r_loc := r_O o % 2 ^ (m_t - m_r)
          let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          let X'_o := s_x⁻¹ • (X_O o - X_J - (C_t - C_r) • V_J)
          (p_buf, r_loc, roundShift2D s_loc 0 X'_o)
        let Z_of : Fin N_O → ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) × (ℤ × ℤ) := fun o =>
          let q := Q_of o
          let C_t := ((r_O o : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
          let X'_o := s_x⁻¹ • (X_O o - X_J - (C_t - C_r) • V_J)
          let X_Q := gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2
          if d_dim = 1 then
            (q, (Int.floor (inner ℝ (X'_o - X_Q) (n_buf q.1) / σ_loc), 0))
          else
            (q, roundShift2D σ_loc 0 (X'_o - X_Q))
        let B_Q : ℝ := 4 * C_cov * B_sys + 4
        let T_cand : ((ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) × ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Finset (Fin N_ret) := fun q =>
          let c_end := ((q.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
          let X_Q := gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2
          Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin N_ret =>
            coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α)) = q.1 ∧
            ‖(X'_at α + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V'_at α) - X_Q‖ ≤ B_Q * (ε ^ (-θ)) * s_loc)
        0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → r = t - 2 * h →
        ε ^ r ≤ s_c → s_c ≤ 2 * ε ^ r →
        B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
        (∀ p_c, ‖n_buf p_c‖ = 1) →
        (∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (r_loc : ℕ),
          (((S_act.image Q_of).filter (fun q => q.2.1 = r_loc ∧ α ∈ T_cand q)).card : ℝ) ≤
            C_list * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) ∧
        (∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (d : Fin N_D),
          b_star ≤ b_D d → |(H_P - t) / 2 - a_D d| ≤ ζ_sh →
          (d_dim = 2 → b_D d = (H_P - t) / 2 ∧ a_D d = (H_P - t) / 2) →
          ‖e_D d‖ = 1 →
          (((S_act.filter (fun o =>
            r_O o = r_D d ∧
            |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d + t) ∧
            |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d + t) ∧
            (d_dim = 1 → projAngleDist (perp2D (e_D d)) (n_buf (Q_of o).1) ≤ ε ^ (4 * h)) ∧
            α ∈ T_cand (Q_of o))).image Z_of).card : ℝ) ≤
            C_list * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh))

by
  
  have h_floor_mem_Icc_floor : ∀ {L U y : ℝ},
      L ≤ y → y ≤ U → Int.floor y ∈ Finset.Icc (Int.floor L) (Int.floor U) := by
    intro L U y hL hU
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Int.floor_mono hL, Int.floor_mono hU⟩

  have h_mem_Icc_floor : ∀ {L U : ℝ} {k : ℤ},
      L ≤ (k : ℝ) → (k : ℝ) ≤ U → k ∈ Finset.Icc (Int.floor L) (Int.floor U) := by
    intro L U k hL hU
    have hm := h_floor_mem_Icc_floor hL hU
    rwa [Int.floor_intCast] at hm

  have h_card_Icc_floor : ∀ {L U B : ℝ},
      0 ≤ B → U - L ≤ B → ((Finset.Icc (Int.floor L) (Int.floor U)).card : ℝ) ≤ B + 2 := by
    intro L U B hB hUL
    set l := Int.floor L
    set u₀ := Int.floor U
    rw [Int.card_Icc l u₀]
    rcases le_or_gt (u₀ + 1 - l) 0 with hle | hgt
    · have hz : (u₀ + 1 - l).toNat = 0 := Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr hle
      rw [hz]
      push_cast
      linarith
    · have hnn : 0 ≤ u₀ + 1 - l := le_of_lt hgt
      have hcast : (((u₀ + 1 - l).toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((u₀ + 1 - l : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn
      rw [hcast]
      push_cast
      have hu_le : (u₀ : ℝ) ≤ U := Int.floor_le U
      have hl_gt : L < (l : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one L
      linarith

  have h_coord_le_norm : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (i : Fin 2), |z i| ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    intro z i
    have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le z i
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h

  have h_round0_dist : ∀ (s : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      0 < s → ‖z - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 z)‖ ≤ 2 * s := by
    intro s z hs
    let k0 : ℤ := Int.floor ((z 0 - (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 0) / s)
    let k1 : ℤ := Int.floor ((z 1 - (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 1) / s)
    have h0_le : s * (k0 : ℝ) ≤ z.ofLp 0 := by
      have h := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le ((z 0 - (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 0) / s))
      change (k0 : ℝ) * s ≤ z.ofLp 0 - 0 at h
      linarith
    have h0_lt : z.ofLp 0 < s * (k0 : ℝ) + s := by
      have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp
        (Int.lt_floor_add_one ((z 0 - (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 0) / s))
      change z.ofLp 0 - 0 < ((k0 : ℝ) + 1) * s at h
      linarith
    have h1_le : s * (k1 : ℝ) ≤ z.ofLp 1 := by
      have h := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp (Int.floor_le ((z 1 - (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 1) / s))
      change (k1 : ℝ) * s ≤ z.ofLp 1 - 0 at h
      linarith
    have h1_lt : z.ofLp 1 < s * (k1 : ℝ) + s := by
      have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp
        (Int.lt_floor_add_one ((z 1 - (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 1) / s))
      change z.ofLp 1 - 0 < ((k1 : ℝ) + 1) * s at h
      linarith
    have hsq : ‖z - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 z)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hc0 : (z - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 z)).ofLp 0 = z.ofLp 0 - s * (k0 : ℝ) := rfl
      have hc1 : (z - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 z)).ofLp 1 = z.ofLp 1 - s * (k1 : ℝ) := rfl
      rw [hc0, hc1, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs]
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z - gridPt2D s (roundShift2D s 0 z))]

  have h_parseval_perp2D : ∀ (w e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖e‖ = 1 → ‖perp2D e‖ = 1 ∧ ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℝ w e) ^ 2 + (inner ℝ w (perp2D e)) ^ 2 := by
    intro w e he
    have he_sq : e.ofLp 0 ^ 2 + e.ofLp 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [he, one_pow]
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        sq_abs, sq_abs] at h1
      exact h1
    have hp0 : (perp2D e).ofLp 0 = -(e.ofLp 1) := rfl
    have hp1 : (perp2D e).ofLp 1 = e.ofLp 0 := rfl
    have hp_sq : ‖perp2D e‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, hp0, hp1,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs]
      linarith [he_sq]
    have hp_norm : ‖perp2D e‖ = 1 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (perp2D e), hp_sq]
    refine ⟨hp_norm, ?_⟩
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs, PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      hp0, hp1]
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    linear_combination -(w.ofLp 0 ^ 2 + w.ofLp 1 ^ 2) * he_sq

  have h_norm_le_of_perp2D : ∀ (w e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (M : ℝ),
      ‖e‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ M → |inner ℝ w e| ≤ M → |inner ℝ w (perp2D e)| ≤ M → ‖w‖ ≤ 2 * M := by
    intro w e M he hM h1 h2
    have hpar := (h_parseval_perp2D w e he).2
    have hs1 : (inner ℝ w e) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (inner ℝ w e)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
    have hs2 : (inner ℝ w (perp2D e)) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (inner ℝ w (perp2D e))]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h2 2
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg w, hpar, hs1, hs2]

  have h_unit_normal_rot : ∀ (n_q n_d : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (δ σ_s : ℝ),
      0 ≤ δ → ‖n_q‖ = 1 → ‖n_d‖ = 1 → projAngleDist n_d n_q ≤ δ →
      ((σ_s = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ inner ℝ n_q n_d) ∨ (σ_s = -1 ∧ inner ℝ n_q n_d < 0)) →
      |σ_s| = 1 ∧ ‖n_q - σ_s • n_d‖ ≤ 2 * δ := by
    intro n_q n_d δ σ_s hδ hnq hnd hproj hbranch
    have hpar := (h_parseval_perp2D n_d n_q hnq).2
    rw [hnd, one_pow, real_inner_comm n_q n_d] at hpar
    have hp_sq : (inner ℝ n_d (perp2D n_q)) ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hproj 2
    have hx_sq_le1 : (inner ℝ n_q n_d) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      linarith [sq_nonneg (inner ℝ n_d (perp2D n_q)), hpar]
    have h1_sub_x2 : 1 - (inner ℝ n_q n_d) ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 := by
      linarith [hpar, hp_sq]
    rcases hbranch with ⟨rfl, hip⟩ | ⟨rfl, hip⟩
    · refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
      have hx_le1 : inner ℝ n_q n_d ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [hx_sq_le1]
      have hdiff_sq : ‖n_q - (1 : ℝ) • n_d‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * δ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_sub_sq_real, one_smul, hnq, hnd]
        nlinarith [hip, hx_le1, h1_sub_x2]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (n_q - (1 : ℝ) • n_d), hδ, hdiff_sq]
    · refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
      have hx_ge_neg1 : -1 ≤ inner ℝ n_q n_d := by nlinarith [hx_sq_le1]
      have hdiff_sq : ‖n_q - (-1 : ℝ) • n_d‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * δ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_neg, abs_one, one_mul, hnq, hnd]
        nlinarith [hip, hx_ge_neg1, h1_sub_x2]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (n_q - (-1 : ℝ) • n_d), hδ, hdiff_sq]

  
  let C_Q : ℝ := (8 * C_cov * B_sys + 10) ^ 2
  let C_Z1 : ℝ := 2 * B_sys ^ 2 + 16 * B_sys + 2
  let C_Z2 : ℝ := (4 * B_sys ^ 2 + 2) ^ 2
  let C_list : ℝ := C_Q * C_Z2
  have hCQ_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_Q := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ 8 * C_cov * B_sys + 10 := by nlinarith [hB_sys, hC_cov]
    dsimp [C_Q]
    nlinarith [h1]
  have hCZ2_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_Z2 := by
    dsimp [C_Z2]
    nlinarith [hB_sys]
  have hC_list_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_list := by
    dsimp [C_list]
    nlinarith [hCQ_ge1, hCZ2_ge1]
  have hCQ_le_Clist : C_Q ≤ C_list := by
    dsimp [C_list]
    nlinarith [hCQ_ge1, hCZ2_ge1]
  have hCZ1_le_CZ2 : C_Z1 ≤ C_Z2 := by
    dsimp [C_Z1, C_Z2]
    nlinarith [hB_sys, sq_nonneg (B_sys ^ 2)]
  have hCQCZ1_le_Clist : C_Q * C_Z1 ≤ C_list := by
    dsimp [C_list]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCZ1_le_CZ2 (by linarith [hCQ_ge1])

  refine ⟨C_list, hC_list_ge1, ?_⟩
  intro ε H_P t r b_star lam_sys m_r m_t N_O N_D N_ret
    τ_V τ_X n_buf r_O V_O X_O b_D a_D r_D e_D X_D loc_idx o_at S_act
  intro u s_c C_r s_v s_x V_J X_J ρ_r σ_r s_loc lam_loc σ_loc
    V_at X_at V'_at X'_at Q_of Z_of B_Q T_cand
  intro hε_pos hε_half hr_eq hsc_lo hsc_hi hlam_lo hlam_hi hnbuf
  letI := Classical.propDecidable

  
  have hε_le1 : ε ≤ 1 := by linarith only [hε_half]
  have hBsys_pos : 0 < B_sys := by linarith only [hB_sys]
  have hs_c_pos : 0 < s_c := inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) m_r)
  have hs_v_pos : 0 < s_v := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos b_star
  have hs_x_pos : 0 < s_x := mul_pos hs_c_pos hs_v_pos
  have hs_loc_pos : 0 < s_loc := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos (u + h)
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam_sys :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hBsys_pos) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos (-H_P))) hlam_lo
  have hlam_loc_pos : 0 < lam_loc :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos hs_c_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hs_v_pos)) hlam_pos
  have hε_u_pos : 0 < ε ^ u := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hε_pos u
  have hσ_loc_pos : 0 < σ_loc := inv_pos.mpr (mul_pos hlam_loc_pos hε_u_pos)
  have hσ_loc_inv_pos : 0 < σ_loc⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hσ_loc_pos
  have hσ_loc_inv_eq : σ_loc⁻¹ = lam_loc * (ε ^ u) := inv_inv (lam_loc * (ε ^ u))
  have h1_θ : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-θ) :=
    Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith only [hθ])
  have h1_ζ : 1 ≤ ε ^ (-ζ_sh) :=
    Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hε_pos hε_le1 (by linarith only [hζ_sh])
  have hBQ_pos : 0 < B_Q := by
    dsimp only [B_Q]
    nlinarith [hB_sys, hC_cov]
  have h2BQ_sq : (2 * B_Q + 2) ^ 2 = C_Q := by
    dsimp only [B_Q, C_Q]
    ring

  
  have hsx_σloc_inv : s_x⁻¹ * σ_loc⁻¹ ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-(H_P + t) / 2) := by
    have hs_c_ne : s_c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_c_pos
    have hs_v_ne : s_v ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_v_pos
    have h_prod_eq : s_x⁻¹ * σ_loc⁻¹ = lam_sys * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) := by
      rw [hσ_loc_inv_eq]
      dsimp only [s_x, lam_loc]
      have halg : (s_c * s_v)⁻¹ * (s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys * ε ^ u) =
          (s_c⁻¹ * s_c) * (s_v⁻¹ * s_v) * (lam_sys * (s_v * ε ^ u)) := by
        rw [mul_inv]
        ring
      rw [halg, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs_c_ne, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs_v_ne, one_mul, one_mul]
      dsimp only [s_v, u]
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
      have hexp : b_star + ((H_P - t) / 2 - b_star) = (H_P - t) / 2 := by ring
      rw [hexp]
    rw [h_prod_eq]
    calc lam_sys * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        ≤ (B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P)) * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlam_hi (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
      _ = B_sys * (ε ^ (-H_P) * ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = B_sys * ε ^ (-(H_P + t) / 2) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
          congr 2
          ring

  
  have hσloc_inv_ub : σ_loc⁻¹ ≤ 2 * B_sys * ε ^ (-u - 2 * h) := by
    rw [hσ_loc_inv_eq]
    dsimp only [lam_loc]
    have hsv_sq : s_v ^ 2 = ε ^ (b_star + b_star) := by
      dsimp only [s_v]

    have h1 : s_c * s_v ^ 2 ≤ (2 * ε ^ r) * ε ^ (b_star + b_star) := by

          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hε_u_pos.le
      _ = 2 * B_sys * (ε ^ r * ε ^ (b_star + b_star) * ε ^ (-H_P) * ε ^ u) := by ring
      _ = 2 * B_sys * ε ^ (-u - 2 * h) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hε_pos]
          congr 2
          dsimp only [u]
          rw [hr_eq]

  have h_bound_Q : ∀ (α : Fin N_ret) (r_loc : ℕ),
      (((S_act.image Q_of).filter (fun q => q.2.1 = r_loc ∧ α ∈ T_cand q)).card : ℝ) ≤
        C_Q * ε ^ (-2 * θ) := by
    intro α r_loc
    let F_Q := (S_act.image Q_of).filter (fun q => q.2.1 = r_loc ∧ α ∈ T_cand q)
    let p_α := coarseOfFineCell M_L (atomOutCell ε H_P t r τ_V τ_X loc_idx.1 (V_at α) (X_at α))
    let c_end0 : ℝ := ((r_loc : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹
    let Y_α : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := X'_at α + (c_end0 - 1 / 2) • V'_at α
    let R_Q : ℝ := B_Q * (ε ^ (-θ)) * s_loc
    have hRQ_nn : 0 ≤ R_Q :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hBQ_pos.le (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)) hs_loc_pos.le
    let I_Q0 : Finset ℤ :=
      Finset.Icc (Int.floor ((Y_α 0 - R_Q) / s_loc)) (Int.floor ((Y_α 0 + R_Q) / s_loc))
    let I_Q1 : Finset ℤ :=
      Finset.Icc (Int.floor ((Y_α 1 - R_Q) / s_loc)) (Int.floor ((Y_α 1 + R_Q) / s_loc))
    let Box_Q := (I_Q0 ×ˢ I_Q1).image (fun k : ℤ × ℤ => (p_α, r_loc, k))
    have hsub : F_Q ⊆ Box_Q := by
      intro q hq
      rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hq with ⟨_, hq_rloc, hα_cand⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hα_cand with ⟨_, hp_eq, hdist⟩
      have hc_eq : (((q.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹) = c_end0 := by
        rw [hq_rloc]
      change ‖(X'_at α + ((((q.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m_t - m_r))⁻¹) - 1 / 2) • V'_at α) -
        gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2‖ ≤ R_Q at hdist
      rw [hc_eq] at hdist
      change ‖Y_α - gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2‖ ≤ R_Q at hdist
      rw [norm_sub_rev] at hdist
      have hc0 : |s_loc * (q.2.2.1 : ℝ) - Y_α 0| ≤ R_Q := by
        have h0 := le_trans (h_coord_le_norm (gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2 - Y_α) 0) hdist
        have heq0 : (gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2 - Y_α) 0 = s_loc * (q.2.2.1 : ℝ) - Y_α 0 := rfl
        rwa [heq0] at h0
      have hc1 : |s_loc * (q.2.2.2 : ℝ) - Y_α 1| ≤ R_Q := by
        have h1 := le_trans (h_coord_le_norm (gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2 - Y_α) 1) hdist
        have heq1 : (gridPt2D s_loc q.2.2 - Y_α) 1 = s_loc * (q.2.2.2 : ℝ) - Y_α 1 := rfl
        rwa [heq1] at h1
      have hm0 : q.2.2.1 ∈ I_Q0 := by
        rcases abs_le.mp hc0 with ⟨hl0, hu0⟩
        refine h_mem_Icc_floor ?_ ?_
        · rw [div_le_iff₀ hs_loc_pos]

          linarith
      have hm1 : q.2.2.2 ∈ I_Q1 := by
        rcases abs_le.mp hc1 with ⟨hl1, hu1⟩
        refine h_mem_Icc_floor ?_ ?_
        · rw [div_le_iff₀ hs_loc_pos]
          linarith
        · rw [le_div_iff₀ hs_loc_pos]
          linarith
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q.2.2, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hm0, hm1⟩, ?_⟩
      rcases q with ⟨q1, q21, q22⟩
      dsimp only at hp_eq hq_rloc ⊢
      change p_α = q1 at hp_eq
      rw [hp_eq, hq_rloc]
    have hcard_nat : F_Q.card ≤ I_Q0.card * I_Q1.card := by
      calc F_Q.card ≤ Box_Q.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        _ ≤ (I_Q0 ×ˢ I_Q1).card := Finset.card_image_le
        _ = I_Q0.card * I_Q1.card := Finset.card_product I_Q0 I_Q1
    have hcard_real : (F_Q.card : ℝ) ≤ (I_Q0.card : ℝ) * (I_Q1.card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hcard_nat
    have h2BQ_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * B_Q * ε ^ (-θ) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith only [hBQ_pos]) (Real.rpow_nonneg hε_pos.le _)
    have h_iq0 : (I_Q0.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * B_Q + 2) * ε ^ (-θ) := by
      have hw0 : (Y_α 0 + R_Q) / s_loc - (Y_α 0 - R_Q) / s_loc ≤ 2 * B_Q * ε ^ (-θ) := by

              = (2 * B_Q * ε ^ (-θ) * s_loc) / s_loc := by ring
            _ = 2 * B_Q * ε ^ (-θ) := mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hs_ne
        exact le_of_eq h_eq
      have hc := h_card_Icc_floor h2BQ_nn hw0
      nlinarith [hc, h1_θ]
    have h_iq1 : (I_Q1.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 * B_Q + 2) * ε ^ (-θ) := by
      have hw1 : (Y_α 1 + R_Q) / s_loc - (Y_α 1 - R_Q) / s_loc ≤ 2 * B_Q * ε ^ (-θ) := by
        have h_eq : (Y_α 1 + R_Q) / s_loc - (Y_α 1 - R_Q) / s_loc = 2 * B_Q * ε ^ (-θ) := by

      _ = (2 * B_Q + 2) ^ 2 * (ε ^ (-θ) * ε ^ (-θ)) := by ring
      _ = C_Q * ε ^ (-2 * θ) := by

        _ ≤ (C_Q * ε ^ (-2 * θ)) * (C_Z2 * ε ^ (-ζ_sh)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hFQd_card hCZ2_nn
        _ = C_list * (ε ^ (-2 * θ) * ε ^ (-ζ_sh)) := by
            dsimp only [C_list]
            ring
        _ = C_list * ε ^ (-2 * θ - ζ_sh) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hε_pos, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
