proof.tactics:
by
  have hML_real : (256 : ℝ) ≤ (M_L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hML
  have hML_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (M_L : ℝ) := by linarith

  let χ₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => max 0 (min 1 (2 - |s|))
  have hχ₁_cont : Continuous χ₁ :=
    continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min (continuous_const.sub continuous_abs))
  have hχ₁_01 : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ χ₁ s ∧ χ₁ s ≤ 1 := fun s =>
    ⟨le_max_left 0 (min 1 (2 - |s|)),
     max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left 1 (2 - |s|))⟩
  have hχ₁_one : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 1 → χ₁ s = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    dsimp only [χ₁]
    rw [min_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_right zero_le_one]
  have hχ₁_zero : ∀ s : ℝ, 2 ≤ |s| → χ₁ s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    dsimp only [χ₁]
    rw [min_eq_right (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]

  let R_in : ℝ := ((30 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ)
  let R_out : ℝ := ((31 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ)
  have hRin_pos : 0 < R_in := by dsimp only [R_in]; positivity
  have hRin_lt_Rout : R_in < R_out := by dsimp only [R_in, R_out]; linarith
  have hRout_pos : 0 < R_out := lt_trans hRin_pos hRin_lt_Rout
  let d_ann : ℝ := R_out ^ 2 - R_in ^ 2
  have hd_ann_pos : 0 < d_ann := by
    dsimp only [d_ann]
    nlinarith [hRin_pos, hRin_lt_Rout]
  let q_ann : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun z => (R_out ^ 2 - ‖z‖ ^ 2) / d_ann
  let χ_ann_real : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun z => Real.smoothTransition (q_ann z)
  let χ_ann : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z => (χ_ann_real z : ℂ)

  have hχ_ann_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k χ_ann := by
    intro k
    have hq : ContDiff ℝ (↑(k : ℕ∞)) q_ann :=
      (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)).div_const d_ann
    have hreal : ContDiff ℝ (↑(k : ℕ∞)) χ_ann_real :=
      (@Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (k : ℕ∞)).comp hq
    exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hreal

  have hχ_ann_one : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖z‖ ≤ R_in → χ_ann z = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    have hsq : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ R_in ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg z, hz]
    have hq_ge : 1 ≤ q_ann z := by
      dsimp only [q_ann, d_ann]
      exact (one_le_div hd_ann_pos).mpr (by linarith)
    dsimp only [χ_ann, χ_ann_real]
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le hq_ge, Complex.ofReal_one]

  have hχ_ann_zero : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_out ≤ ‖z‖ → χ_ann z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hsq : R_out ^ 2 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hRout_pos, hz]
    have hq_le : q_ann z ≤ 0 :=
      div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hd_ann_pos.le
    dsimp only [χ_ann, χ_ann_real]
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hq_le, Complex.ofReal_zero]

  have hχ_ann_bd : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖χ_ann z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖(1 : ℂ) - χ_ann z‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro z
    have h0 : 0 ≤ χ_ann_real z := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
    have h1 : χ_ann_real z ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
    constructor
    · dsimp only [χ_ann]
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h0]
      exact h1
    · have hsub : (1 : ℂ) - χ_ann z = ((1 - χ_ann_real z : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        dsimp only [χ_ann]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hsub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      linarith

  have hχ_ann_supp : HasCompactSupport χ_ann := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) R_out) (fun z hz => ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
    exact hχ_ann_zero z hz.le

  have hex_ann_bd : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ,
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k χ_ann z‖ ≤ C := fun k =>
    (hχ_ann_supp.iteratedFDeriv k).exists_bound_of_continuous
      (hχ_ann_smooth k).continuous_iteratedFDeriv'

  let M_ann : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => max (Classical.choose (hex_ann_bd k)) 1
  have hM_ann_ge1 : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ M_ann k := fun k => le_max_right _ _
  have hχ_ann_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k χ_ann z‖ ≤ M_ann k := fun k z =>
    le_trans (Classical.choose_spec (hex_ann_bd k) z) (le_max_left _ _)

  let R₀ : ℝ := ((17 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ)
  let L₁ : ℝ := ((19 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ)
  let L₂ : ℝ := ((20 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ)
  let δ_L : ℝ := L₂ - L₁
  have hL₁_pos : 0 < L₁ := by dsimp only [L₁]; positivity
  have hL₁_lt_L₂ : L₁ < L₂ := by dsimp only [L₁, L₂]; linarith
  have hR₀_lt_L₁ : R₀ < L₁ := by dsimp only [R₀, L₁]; linarith
  have hδ_L_pos : 0 < δ_L := sub_pos.mpr hL₁_lt_L₂

  let η_real : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    Real.smoothTransition ((L₂ - s) / δ_L) * Real.smoothTransition ((L₂ + s) / δ_L)
  let η₁ : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => (η_real s : ℂ)

  have hη₁_top : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) η₁ := by
    have h_aff1 : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) (fun s : ℝ => (L₂ - s) / δ_L) :=
      (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).div_const δ_L
    have h_aff2 : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) (fun s : ℝ => (L₂ + s) / δ_L) :=
      (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id).div_const δ_L
    have h_real : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) η_real :=
      ((@Real.smoothTransition.contDiff ⊤).comp h_aff1).mul
        ((@Real.smoothTransition.contDiff ⊤).comp h_aff2)
    exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp h_real

  have hη₁_one : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ L₁ → η₁ s = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := abs_le.mp hs
    have h1 : 1 ≤ (L₂ - s) / δ_L := (one_le_div hδ_L_pos).mpr (by dsimp only [δ_L]; linarith)
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (L₂ + s) / δ_L := (one_le_div hδ_L_pos).mpr (by dsimp only [δ_L]; linarith)
    dsimp only [η₁, η_real]
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h1, Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h2,
      mul_one, Complex.ofReal_one]

  have hη₁_zero : ∀ s : ℝ, L₂ ≤ |s| → η₁ s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    dsimp only [η₁, η_real]
    rcases le_abs.mp hs with hs_pos | hs_neg
    · have h1 : (L₂ - s) / δ_L ≤ 0 :=
        div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hδ_L_pos.le
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h1, zero_mul, Complex.ofReal_zero]
    · have h2 : (L₂ + s) / δ_L ≤ 0 :=
        div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hδ_L_pos.le
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h2, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero]

  have hη₁_supp : HasCompactSupport η₁ := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (-L₂) L₂)) (fun s hs => ?_)
    apply hη₁_zero s
    by_contra hlt
    rw [not_le] at hlt
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hlt
    exact hs ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩

  have hη₁_deriv_in : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| < L₁ → ∀ m : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv m η₁ s = if m = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro s hs m
    have hr : 0 < L₁ - |s| := sub_pos.mpr hs
    have hev : η₁ =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds s hr) (fun y hy => ?_)
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hy
      have hy_le : |y| ≤ L₁ := by
        have htri : |y| ≤ |s| + |y - s| := by
          simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using abs_add_le s (y - s)
        linarith
      exact hη₁_one y hy_le
    rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq m, iteratedDeriv_const]

  have hη₁_deriv_out : ∀ s : ℝ, L₂ < |s| → ∀ m : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv m η₁ s = 0 := by
    intro s hs m
    have hr : 0 < |s| - L₂ := sub_pos.mpr hs
    have hev : η₁ =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds s hr) (fun y hy => ?_)
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hy
      have hy_ge : L₂ ≤ |y| := by
        have htri : |s| ≤ |y| + |s - y| := by
          simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using abs_add_le y (s - y)
        rw [abs_sub_comm] at hy
        linarith
      exact hη₁_zero y hy_ge
    rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq m, iteratedDeriv_const, ite_self]

  let η_sch : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ := hη₁_supp.toSchwartzMap hη₁_top
  have hη_sch_coe : (⇑η_sch : ℝ → ℂ) = η₁ := by
    ext s
    exact HasCompactSupport.toSchwartzMap_toFun hη₁_supp hη₁_top s
  let η_hat_sch : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ := FourierTransform.fourier η_sch
  let η_hat : ℝ → ℂ := ⇑η_hat_sch
  have hη_hat_eq : η_hat = FourierTransform.fourier η₁ := by
    dsimp only [η_hat, η_hat_sch]
    rw [SchwartzMap.fourier_coe, hη_sch_coe]
  have hη_cont : Continuous η_hat := η_hat_sch.continuous
  have hη_int : ∀ k : ℕ,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => |ξ| ^ k * ‖η_hat ξ‖) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro k
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using η_hat_sch.integrable_pow_mul MeasureTheory.volume k

  have hη₁_iter_supp : ∀ n : ℕ, HasCompactSupport (iteratedDeriv n η₁) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hη₁_supp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact ih.deriv
  have hη₁_iter_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (iteratedDeriv n η₁) := fun n =>
    ContDiff.continuous_iteratedDeriv n hη₁_top (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_top : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤))
  have hη₁_iter_int : ∀ n : ℕ,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv n η₁) MeasureTheory.volume := fun n =>
    (hη₁_iter_cont n).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hη₁_iter_supp n)

  have h_master_1d : ∀ (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ),
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ m *
        (∫ ξ : ℝ,
          ((ξ ^ m : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ * s) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
      iteratedDeriv m η₁ s := by
    intro m s
    have h_four_deriv : FourierTransform.fourier (iteratedDeriv m η₁) =
        fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (ξ : ℂ)) ^ m • η_hat ξ := by
      have h_raw :=
        Real.fourier_iteratedDeriv hη₁_top (fun n _ => hη₁_iter_int n) (le_top : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
      rw [← hη_hat_eq] at h_raw
      exact h_raw
    have h_four_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (FourierTransform.fourier (iteratedDeriv m η₁)) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [h_four_deriv]
      have h_dom : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi) ^ m * (|ξ| ^ m * ‖η_hat ξ‖)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (hη_int m).const_mul ((2 * Real.pi) ^ m)
      have h_cont_rhs : Continuous
          (fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (ξ : ℂ)) ^ m • η_hat ξ) := by
        simp only [smul_eq_mul]
        exact (((continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal).pow m).mul hη_cont)
      refine h_dom.mono' h_cont_rhs.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ => ?_))
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
      have h2 : ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ = 2 := by
        have heq : (2 : ℂ) = ((2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_num
        rw [heq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num)]
      have hpi : ‖(Real.pi : ℂ)‖ = Real.pi := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le]
      have hxi : ‖(ξ : ℂ)‖ = |ξ| := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      rw [h2, hpi, hxi, mul_pow (2 * Real.pi) |ξ| m, mul_assoc]
    have h_inv := congr_fun
      ((hη₁_iter_cont m).fourierInv_fourier_eq (hη₁_iter_int m) h_four_int) s
    rw [Real.fourierInv_eq', h_four_deriv] at h_inv
    rw [← h_inv, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ => ?_))
    have hexp_eq : Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ ξ s : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ * s) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      congr 1
      rw [RCLike.inner_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial]
      push_cast
      ring
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hexp_eq, mul_pow (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ξ : ℂ) m, Complex.ofReal_pow]
    ring

  have hc_ne : ∀ m : ℕ, (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ m ≠ 0 := by
    intro m
    refine pow_ne_zero m (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero ?_) Complex.I_ne_zero)
    exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero

  let F_1d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun m s t =>
    ((t ^ m : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat t *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * (t * s) : ℝ) : ℂ))

  have h_1d_in_zero : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| < L₁ → ∫ t : ℝ, F_1d 0 s t = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    have h0 := h_master_1d 0 s
    rw [hη₁_deriv_in s hs 0] at h0
    dsimp only [F_1d]
    simpa only [↓reduceIte, pow_zero, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul] using h0

  have h_1d_in_pos : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| < L₁ → ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∫ t : ℝ, F_1d m s t = 0 := by
    intro s hs m hm
    have hm_ne : m ≠ 0 := by omega
    have h := h_master_1d m s
    rw [hη₁_deriv_in s hs m] at h
    simp only [hm_ne, ↓reduceIte] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (hc_ne m)

  have h_1d_out : ∀ s : ℝ, L₂ < |s| → ∀ m : ℕ, ∫ t : ℝ, F_1d m s t = 0 := by
    intro s hs m
    have h := h_master_1d m s
    rw [hη₁_deriv_out s hs m] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (hc_ne m)

  have h_2d_factor : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (p q : ℕ),
      (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
        ((ξ.1 ^ p * ξ.2 ^ q : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
      (∫ t : ℝ, F_1d p (z 0) t) * (∫ t : ℝ, F_1d q (z 1) t) := by
    intro z p q
    have h_integrand : (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((ξ.1 ^ p * ξ.2 ^ q : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
      (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => F_1d p (z 0) ξ.1 * F_1d q (z 1) ξ.2) := by
      ext ξ
      dsimp only [F_1d]
      have hexp_split :
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hexp_split, Complex.ofReal_mul]
      ring
    rw [h_integrand]
    change (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, F_1d p (z 0) ξ.1 * F_1d q (z 1) ξ.2
      ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ))) = _
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_prod_mul (F_1d p (z 0)) (F_1d q (z 1))

  have h_2d_in : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖z‖ ≤ R₀ →
      (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
        η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 1) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℕ, 1 ≤ p + q →
        ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
          ((ξ.1 ^ p * ξ.2 ^ q : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 0) := by
    intro z hz
    have hz0_le : |z 0| ≤ ‖z‖ := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le z (0 : Fin 2)
    have hz1_le : |z 1| ≤ ‖z‖ := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le z (1 : Fin 2)
    have hz0_lt : |z 0| < L₁ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans hz0_le hz) hR₀_lt_L₁
    have hz1_lt : |z 1| < L₁ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans hz1_le hz) hR₀_lt_L₁
    constructor
    · have h00 := h_2d_factor z 0 0
      simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul] at h00
      rw [h00, h_1d_in_zero (z 0) hz0_lt, h_1d_in_zero (z 1) hz1_lt, mul_one]
    · intro p q hpq
      rw [h_2d_factor z p q]
      rcases (by omega : 1 ≤ p ∨ 1 ≤ q) with hp | hq
      · rw [h_1d_in_pos (z 0) hz0_lt p hp, zero_mul]
      · rw [h_1d_in_pos (z 1) hz1_lt q hq, mul_zero]

  have h_2d_out : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      R_in ≤ ‖z‖ →
      ∀ p q : ℕ,
        ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
          ((ξ.1 ^ p * ξ.2 ^ q : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 0 := by
    intro z hz p q
    have hz_sq_ge : R_in ^ 2 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hRin_pos, hz]
    have hnorm_sq : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = |z 0| ^ 2 + |z 1| ^ 2 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) z, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h2L₂_lt : 2 * L₂ ^ 2 < R_in ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [L₂, R_in]
      nlinarith [hML_pos]
    have h_max_gt : L₂ < |z 0| ∨ L₂ < |z 1| := by
      by_contra h_both
      rw [not_or, not_lt, not_lt] at h_both
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := h_both
      have hsq0 : |z 0| ^ 2 ≤ L₂ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (z 0), h0]
      have hsq1 : |z 1| ^ 2 ≤ L₂ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (z 1), h1]
      linarith [hz_sq_ge, hnorm_sq, h2L₂_lt, hsq0, hsq1]
    rw [h_2d_factor z p q]
    rcases h_max_gt with h0 | h1
    · rw [h_1d_out (z 0) h0 p, zero_mul]
    · rw [h_1d_out (z 1) h1 q, mul_zero]

  exact ⟨η_hat, χ₁, χ_ann, M_ann,
    hM_ann_ge1, hχ₁_cont, hχ₁_01, hχ₁_one, hχ₁_zero,
    hχ_ann_smooth, hχ_ann_one, hχ_ann_zero, hχ_ann_bd, hχ_ann_deriv,
    hη_cont, hη_int, h_2d_in, h_2d_out⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(a₀ a₁ A B_sys R_win : ℝ) (N_tay : ℕ)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ ≤ a₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (hB_sys : 2 ≤ B_sys) (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hNtay : 2 ≤ N_tay) :
    ∃ (D_z_exp C_u_coeff : ℕ → ℝ) (C_rem : ℝ),
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ D_z_exp k) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_u_coeff m) ∧
      0 ≤ C_rem ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam_sys ρ_t C_t : ℝ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        0 < lam_sys → 0 < ρ_t → ρ_t ≤ 1 →
        (lam_sys * ρ_t)⁻¹ ≤ B_sys →
        C_t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        ∃ y_map : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          let σ_t := (lam_sys * ρ_t)⁻¹
          let ΔΘ_o : (ℝ × ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := fun u z =>
            lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, X_o + σ_t • y_map u, V_o + ρ_t • z) -
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o + ρ_t • z) -
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o + σ_t • y_map u, V_o) +
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o))
          (∀ (R_cut : ℝ) (ξ : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ R_cut →
            |ξ.1| ≤ 2 * R_cut → |ξ.2| ≤ 2 * R_cut →
            ‖y_map ξ‖ ≤ 20 * a₀⁻¹ * R_cut) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (Function.uncurry ΔΘ_o)) ∧
          (∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
            let h_ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z =>
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((ΔΘ_o ξ z : ℝ) : ℂ))
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k h_ξ) ∧
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k h_ξ z‖ ≤ D_z_exp k * (1 + |ξ.1| + |ξ.2|) ^ k)) ∧
          (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖z‖ ≤ R_win →
            let G_z : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun u =>
              Complex.exp (Complex.I *
                ((ΔΘ_o u z - 2 * Real.pi * (u.1 * z 0 + u.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))
            G_z (0, 0) = 1 ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k G_z) ∧
            (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m < N_tay →
              ∃ c_poly : (Fin m → Bool) → ℂ,
                (∀ b : Fin m → Bool, ‖c_poly b‖ ≤ C_u_coeff m) ∧
                (∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                  ((m.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) •
                    iteratedDeriv m (fun s : ℝ => G_z (s • ξ)) 0 =
                    ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                      c_poly b *
                        ((ξ.1 ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card *
                          ξ.2 ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
            (∀ (R_cut δ_small : ℝ), 1 ≤ R_cut → 0 ≤ δ_small →
              ρ_t * R_cut ≤ δ_small →
              σ_t * R_cut ^ 2 ≤ B_sys * δ_small →
              (∀ i : ℕ, 2 ≤ i → i ≤ N_tay →
                σ_t ^ (i - 1) * R_cut ^ i ≤ (B_sys * δ_small) ^ i) →
              ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, |ξ.1| ≤ 2 * R_cut → |ξ.2| ≤ 2 * R_cut →
              ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
                ‖iteratedDeriv N_tay (fun s' : ℝ => G_z (s' • ξ)) s‖ ≤
                  C_rem * δ_small ^ N_tay))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_s1 : ∀ (J_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      (∀ u w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ (J_o u) w = inner ℝ u (J_o w)) →
      (∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (J_o u) u) →
      ∃ y_map : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖y_map‖ ≤ 10 * a₀⁻¹ ∧
        (∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ‖y_map ξ‖ ≤ 7 * a₀⁻¹ * (|ξ.1| + |ξ.2|)) ∧
        (∀ (R_cut : ℝ) (ξ : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ R_cut →
          |ξ.1| ≤ 2 * R_cut → |ξ.2| ≤ 2 * R_cut →
          ‖y_map ξ‖ ≤ 20 * a₀⁻¹ * R_cut) ∧
        (∀ (u : ℝ × ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          inner ℝ (J_o (y_map u)) z = 2 * Real.pi * (u.1 * z 0 + u.2 * z 1)) := by
    intro J_o hJ_symm hJ_coerc
    let e₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)
    let e₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)
    have h_inner_e0 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ v e₀ = v 0 := by
      intro v
      simp [e₀, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    have h_inner_e1 : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ v e₁ = v 1 := by
      intro v
      simp [e₁, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    have h_decomp : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        v = (inner ℝ v e₀) • e₀ + (inner ℝ v e₁) • e₁ := by
      intro v
      rw [h_inner_e0, h_inner_e1]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e₀, e₁]
    have h_norm_sq : ∀ α β : ℝ, ‖α • e₀ + β • e₁‖ ^ 2 = α ^ 2 + β ^ 2 := by
      intro α β
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [e₀, e₁, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have he0_sq : ‖e₀‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 : e₀ = (1 : ℝ) • e₀ + (0 : ℝ) • e₁ := by simp
      rw [h1, h_norm_sq]; ring
    let m₀₀ : ℝ := inner ℝ (J_o e₀) e₀
    let m₀₁ : ℝ := inner ℝ (J_o e₁) e₀
    let m₁₁ : ℝ := inner ℝ (J_o e₁) e₁
    let Δ_o : ℝ := m₀₀ * m₁₁ - m₀₁ ^ 2
    have hm01_symm : inner ℝ (J_o e₀) e₁ = m₀₁ := by
      rw [hJ_symm e₀ e₁, real_inner_comm]
    have hJe0 : J_o e₀ = m₀₀ • e₀ + m₀₁ • e₁ := by
      conv_lhs => rw [h_decomp (J_o e₀)]
      rw [hm01_symm]
    have hJe1 : J_o e₁ = m₀₁ • e₀ + m₁₁ • e₁ := h_decomp (J_o e₁)
    have hm00_ge : a₀ ≤ m₀₀ := by
      have hc := hJ_coerc e₀
      rw [he0_sq, mul_one] at hc
      exact hc
    have hm00_pos : 0 < m₀₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le ha₀ hm00_ge
    let w₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := m₀₁ • e₀ + (-m₀₀) • e₁
    have hw0_sq : ‖w₀‖ ^ 2 = m₀₁ ^ 2 + m₀₀ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [w₀]
      rw [h_norm_sq]; ring
    have hJw0 : J_o w₀ = (-Δ_o) • e₁ := by
      dsimp only [w₀, Δ_o]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hJe0, hJe1]
      module
    have hJw0_inner : inner ℝ (J_o w₀) w₀ = m₀₀ * Δ_o := by
      rw [hJw0]
      dsimp only [w₀]
      rw [real_inner_comm, inner_smul_right, inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_left]
      simp [h_inner_e1, e₀, e₁]
      ring
    have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ_o := by
      have hc := hJ_coerc w₀
      rw [hw0_sq, hJw0_inner] at hc
      have h1 : a₀ * m₀₀ ^ 2 ≤ m₀₀ * Δ_o := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg m₀₁, ha₀]
      have h2 : a₀ * m₀₀ ≤ Δ_o := by nlinarith [hm00_pos]
      nlinarith [ha₀, hm00_pos]
    have hΔ_ne : Δ_o ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hΔ_pos
    let f₀ : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      m₁₁ • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ - m₀₁ • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ
    let f₁ : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      (-m₀₁) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + m₀₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ
    let J_inv : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      Δ_o⁻¹ • (f₀.smulRight e₀ + f₁.smulRight e₁)
    let y_map : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := (2 * Real.pi) • J_inv
    have hJ_Jinv : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, J_o (J_inv ξ) = ξ.1 • e₀ + ξ.2 • e₁ := by
      intro ξ
      have h_app : J_inv ξ =
          (Δ_o⁻¹ * (m₁₁ * ξ.1 - m₀₁ * ξ.2)) • e₀ +
            (Δ_o⁻¹ * (-m₀₁ * ξ.1 + m₀₀ * ξ.2)) • e₁ := by
        dsimp only [J_inv, f₀, f₁]
        simp [smul_add, smul_smul]
      rw [h_app, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hJe0, hJe1, smul_add, smul_add,
        smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
      have hc0 : Δ_o⁻¹ * (m₁₁ * ξ.1 - m₀₁ * ξ.2) * m₀₀ +
          Δ_o⁻¹ * (-m₀₁ * ξ.1 + m₀₀ * ξ.2) * m₀₁ = ξ.1 := by
        have hid : Δ_o⁻¹ * (m₁₁ * ξ.1 - m₀₁ * ξ.2) * m₀₀ +
            Δ_o⁻¹ * (-m₀₁ * ξ.1 + m₀₀ * ξ.2) * m₀₁ = Δ_o⁻¹ * (Δ_o * ξ.1) := by
          dsimp only [Δ_o]; ring
        rw [hid, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hΔ_ne]
      have hc1 : Δ_o⁻¹ * (m₁₁ * ξ.1 - m₀₁ * ξ.2) * m₀₁ +
          Δ_o⁻¹ * (-m₀₁ * ξ.1 + m₀₀ * ξ.2) * m₁₁ = ξ.2 := by
        have hid : Δ_o⁻¹ * (m₁₁ * ξ.1 - m₀₁ * ξ.2) * m₀₁ +
            Δ_o⁻¹ * (-m₀₁ * ξ.1 + m₀₀ * ξ.2) * m₁₁ = Δ_o⁻¹ * (Δ_o * ξ.2) := by
          dsimp only [Δ_o]; ring
        rw [hid, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hΔ_ne]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e₀, e₁] <;>
        [linear_combination hc0; linear_combination hc1]
    have hy_lin : ∀ (u : ℝ × ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        inner ℝ (J_o (y_map u)) z = 2 * Real.pi * (u.1 * z 0 + u.2 * z 1) := by
      intro u z
      have he0z : inner ℝ e₀ z = z 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm, h_inner_e0 z]
      have he1z : inner ℝ e₁ z = z 1 := by rw [real_inner_comm, h_inner_e1 z]

            exact mul_le_mul

informal_problem.statement:
(R_win : ℝ) (M_L N_tay : ℕ) (D_z_exp C_u_coeff : ℕ → ℝ) (C_rem : ℝ)
    (η_hat : ℝ → ℂ) (χ₁ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hR_win : 2 ≤ R_win) (hML : 256 ≤ M_L) (hNtay : 2 ≤ N_tay)
    (hDz : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ D_z_exp k)
    (hCu : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_u_coeff m)
    (hCrem : 0 ≤ C_rem)
    (hχ₁_cont : Continuous χ₁)
    (hχ₁_01 : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ χ₁ s ∧ χ₁ s ≤ 1)
    (hχ₁_one : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 1 → χ₁ s = 1)
    (hχ₁_zero : ∀ s : ℝ, 2 ≤ |s| → χ₁ s = 0)
    (hη_cont : Continuous η_hat)
    (hη_int : ∀ k : ℕ,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => |ξ| ^ k * ‖η_hat ξ‖) MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hη_in : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖z‖ ≤ ((17 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) →
      (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
        η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 1) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℕ, 1 ≤ p + q →
        ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
          ((ξ.1 ^ p * ξ.2 ^ q : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 0))
    (hη_out : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ((30 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ →
      ∀ p q : ℕ,
        ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
          ((ξ.1 ^ p * ξ.2 ^ q : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 0) :
    ∃ (M_W : ℕ → ℝ) (C_W : ℝ),
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ M_W k) ∧
      0 ≤ C_W ∧
      ∀ (r_cut δ_small : ℝ) (ΔΘ_o : (ℝ × ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ),
        0 < r_cut → r_cut ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ δ_small →
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (Function.uncurry ΔΘ_o)) →
        (∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
          let h_ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z =>
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((ΔΘ_o ξ z : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k h_ξ) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k h_ξ z‖ ≤ D_z_exp k * (1 + |ξ.1| + |ξ.2|) ^ k)) →
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖z‖ ≤ R_win →
          let G_z : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun u =>
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((ΔΘ_o u z - 2 * Real.pi * (u.1 * z 0 + u.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))
          G_z (0, 0) = 1 ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k G_z) ∧
          (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m < N_tay →
            ∃ c_poly : (Fin m → Bool) → ℂ,
              (∀ b : Fin m → Bool, ‖c_poly b‖ ≤ C_u_coeff m) ∧
              (∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                ((m.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) •
                  iteratedDeriv m (fun s : ℝ => G_z (s • ξ)) 0 =
                  ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                    c_poly b *
                      ((ξ.1 ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card *
                        ξ.2 ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
          (∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, |ξ.1| ≤ 2 * r_cut⁻¹ → |ξ.2| ≤ 2 * r_cut⁻¹ →
            ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
              ‖iteratedDeriv N_tay (fun s' : ℝ => G_z (s' • ξ)) s‖ ≤
                C_rem * δ_small ^ N_tay)) →
        let W_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z =>
          ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
            ((χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((ΔΘ_o ξ z : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k W_o) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k W_o z‖ ≤ M_W k) ∧
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          ‖z‖ ≤ R_win → ‖z‖ ≤ ((17 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) →
          ‖W_o z - 1‖ ≤ C_W * (δ_small ^ N_tay + r_cut ^ N_tay)) ∧
        (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          ‖z‖ ≤ R_win → ((30 : ℝ) / 2048) * (M_L : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ →
          ‖W_o z‖ ≤ C_W * (δ_small ^ N_tay + r_cut ^ N_tay))

  have _ := hML

  have hw1_nn : ∀ (j : ℕ) (s : ℝ), 0 ≤ w1 j s :=
    fun j s => mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg s) j) (norm_nonneg (η_hat s))
  let I_mom : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ∫ s : ℝ, w1 j s
  have hI_nn : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ I_mom j :=
    fun j => MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (hw1_nn j)
  let E_tail : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p q =>
    I_mom (p + N_tay) * I_mom q + I_mom p * I_mom (q + N_tay)
  have hE_tail_nn : ∀ p q : ℕ, 0 ≤ E_tail p q := fun p q =>
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hI_nn _) (hI_nn _)) (mul_nonneg (hI_nn _) (hI_nn _))
  let M_W : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    max 1 (D_z_exp k * (3 : ℝ) ^ k * (I_mom 0 ^ 2 + 2 * I_mom k * I_mom 0))
  have hMW_ge1 : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ M_W k := fun k => le_max_left _ _
  let C_tay : ℝ := C_rem * I_mom 0 ^ 2
  have hCtay_nn : 0 ≤ C_tay := mul_nonneg hCrem (sq_nonneg _)
  let C_cut : ℝ := E_tail 0 0 +
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
      C_u_coeff m *
        ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
          E_tail (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                 (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card
  have hCcut_nn : 0 ≤ C_cut := by
    refine add_nonneg (hE_tail_nn 0 0) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => ?_))
    exact mul_nonneg (hCu m) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hE_tail_nn _ _))
  let C_W : ℝ := C_tay + C_cut
  have hCW_nn : 0 ≤ C_W := add_nonneg hCtay_nn hCcut_nn
  refine ⟨M_W, C_W, hMW_ge1, hCW_nn, ?_⟩
  intro r_cut δ_small ΔΘ_o hr_pos _hr_le1 hδ_nn hΔΘ_smooth hh_ξ hG_z W_o

  
  have h_pow3 : ∀ (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b →
      (1 + a + b) ^ k ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 + a ^ k + b ^ k) := by
    intro k a b ha hb
    let M : ℝ := max 1 (max a b)
    have h1M : 1 ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
    have haM : a ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left a b) (le_max_right 1 _)
    have hbM : b ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_right a b) (le_max_right 1 _)
    have hsum_le : 1 + a + b ≤ 3 * M := by linarith
    have hpow_le : (1 + a + b) ^ k ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ k * M ^ k := by
      calc (1 + a + b) ^ k ≤ (3 * M) ^ k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hsum_le k
        _ = (3 : ℝ) ^ k * M ^ k := mul_pow 3 M k
    have hMk : M ^ k ≤ 1 + a ^ k + b ^ k := by
      have hak : 0 ≤ a ^ k := pow_nonneg ha k
      have hbk : 0 ≤ b ^ k := pow_nonneg hb k
      rcases max_choice 1 (max a b) with hM1 | hMab
      · change M = 1 at hM1
        rw [hM1, one_pow]
        linarith
      · change M = max a b at hMab
        rcases max_choice a b with hab1 | hab2
        · rw [hMab, hab1]; linarith
        · rw [hMab, hab2]; linarith
    exact le_trans hpow_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMk (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) k))

  
  let α : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun ξ =>
    ((χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2
  have hα_cont : Continuous α :=
    ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
      ((hχ₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst)).mul
        (hχ₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)))).mul
      (hη_cont.comp continuous_fst)).mul
      (hη_cont.comp continuous_snd)
  have hχ_prod_01 : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
      0 ≤ χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) ∧
      χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro ξ
    have h1 := hχ₁_01 (r_cut * ξ.1)
    have h2 := hχ₁_01 (r_cut * ξ.2)
    exact ⟨mul_nonneg h1.1 h2.1, by nlinarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]⟩
  have hα_bd : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ‖α ξ‖ ≤ w1 0 ξ.1 * w1 0 ξ.2 := by
    intro ξ
    obtain ⟨h_nn, h_le1⟩ := hχ_prod_01 ξ
    have hχ_norm : ‖((χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h_nn]
      exact h_le1
    have hw0 : ∀ s : ℝ, w1 0 s = ‖η_hat s‖ := fun s => by dsimp [w1]; rw [pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [hw0, hw0]
    calc ‖α ξ‖ = ‖((χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
          ‖η_hat ξ.1‖ * ‖η_hat ξ.2‖ := by dsimp [α]; rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖η_hat ξ.1‖ * ‖η_hat ξ.2‖ := by gcongr
      _ = ‖η_hat ξ.1‖ * ‖η_hat ξ.2‖ := by rw [one_mul]

  
  have hw_prod_int : ∀ a b : ℕ,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => w1 a ξ.1 * w1 b ξ.2)
        MeasureTheory.volume :=
    fun a b => (hη_int a).mul_prod (hη_int b)
  have hw_prod_eq : ∀ a b : ℕ,
      (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, w1 a ξ.1 * w1 b ξ.2) = I_mom a * I_mom b :=
    fun a b => MeasureTheory.integral_prod_mul (w1 a) (w1 b)
  let dom : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun k ξ =>
    D_z_exp k * (3 : ℝ) ^ k *
      (w1 0 ξ.1 * w1 0 ξ.2 + w1 k ξ.1 * w1 0 ξ.2 + w1 0 ξ.1 * w1 k ξ.2)
  have hdom_int : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (dom k) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro k
    exact (((hw_prod_int 0 0).add (hw_prod_int k 0)).add (hw_prod_int 0 k)).const_mul
      (D_z_exp k * (3 : ℝ) ^ k)
  have hdom_integral : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, dom k ξ) =
        D_z_exp k * (3 : ℝ) ^ k * (I_mom 0 ^ 2 + 2 * I_mom k * I_mom 0) := by
    intro k
    have h_pair : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => w1 0 ξ.1 * w1 0 ξ.2 + w1 k ξ.1 * w1 0 ξ.2)
        MeasureTheory.volume := (hw_prod_int 0 0).add (hw_prod_int k 0)
    dsimp only [dom]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      MeasureTheory.integral_add h_pair (hw_prod_int 0 k),
      MeasureTheory.integral_add (hw_prod_int 0 0) (hw_prod_int k 0),
      hw_prod_eq 0 0, hw_prod_eq k 0, hw_prod_eq 0 k]
    ring

  let h_fn : (ℝ × ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun ξ z =>
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((ΔΘ_o ξ z : ℝ) : ℂ))
  have h_slice_dom : ∀ (k : ℕ) (ξ : ℝ × ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (h_fn ξ) z‖ ≤ dom k ξ := by
    intro k ξ z
    have hDz_nn : 0 ≤ D_z_exp k := le_trans zero_le_one (hDz k)
    have hd_bd : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (h_fn ξ) z‖ ≤
        D_z_exp k * ((3 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 + |ξ.1| ^ k + |ξ.2| ^ k)) := by
      refine le_trans ((hh_ξ ξ).2 k z) ?_
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (h_pow3 k |ξ.1| |ξ.2| (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) hDz_nn
    rw [norm_smul]
    calc ‖α ξ‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (h_fn ξ) z‖
        ≤ (w1 0 ξ.1 * w1 0 ξ.2) *
            (D_z_exp k * ((3 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 + |ξ.1| ^ k + |ξ.2| ^ k))) :=
          mul_le_mul (hα_bd ξ) hd_bd (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (hw1_nn 0 ξ.1) (hw1_nn 0 ξ.2))
      _ = dom k ξ := by
          dsimp only [dom, w1]
          rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
          ring

  
  let H_joint : (ℝ × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun p =>
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Function.uncurry ΔΘ_o p : ℝ) : ℂ))
  have hH_smooth : ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ m H_joint := fun m =>
    Complex.contDiff_exp.comp
      (contDiff_const.mul (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (hΔΘ_smooth m)))
  have h_slice_cont : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h_fn ξ) z) := by
    intro m z
    let ι₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    have h_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h_fn ξ) z) =
        fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ =>
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL (fun _ : Fin m => ι₂)
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m H_joint (ξ, z)) := by
      ext ξ v
      have h_sh_sm : ContDiff ℝ m (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          H_joint ((ξ, 0) + p)) :=
        (hH_smooth m).comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id)
      have hfun : h_fn ξ =
          (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => H_joint ((ξ, 0) + p)) ∘ ι₂ := by
        ext y
        simp [h_fn, H_joint, ι₂]
      rw [hfun, ι₂.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h_sh_sm z le_rfl,
        iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left]
      simp [ι₂]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMapL (fun _ : Fin m => ι₂)).continuous.comp
      (((hH_smooth m).continuous_iteratedFDeriv le_rfl).comp
        (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))

  
  have h_smul_cont : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (h_fn ξ) z) :=
    fun n z => hα_cont.smul (h_slice_cont n z)
  let J : (m : ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →
      ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ :=
    fun m z => ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h_fn ξ) z
  have hJ_int : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h_fn ξ) z)
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro m z
    exact (hdom_int m).mono'
      (h_smul_cont m z).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ => h_slice_dom m ξ z))
  have hJ_hasFDeriv : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      HasFDerivAt (J m)
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ
          (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ (J (m + 1) z₀)) z₀ := by
    intro m z₀
    let L_m : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ]
        (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ]
          ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ) :=
      continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ
        (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ
    have h_pt_deriv : ∀ (ξ : ℝ × ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        HasFDerivAt (fun y => α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h_fn ξ) y)
          (L_m (α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (h_fn ξ) z)) z := by
      intro ξ z
      have hd : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h_fn ξ)) :=
        ((hh_ξ ξ).1 (m + 1)).differentiable_iteratedFDeriv
          (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self m)
      have hf := (hd z).hasFDerivAt.const_smul (α ξ)
      rw [fderiv_iteratedFDeriv] at hf
      convert hf using 1
      ext v u
      simp [L_m]
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (J m)
        (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, L_m (α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (h_fn ξ) z₀)) z₀ := by
      refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
        (s := Set.univ) Filter.univ_mem
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => (h_smul_cont m z).aestronglyMeasurable))
        (hJ_int m z₀)
        (L_m.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (h_smul_cont (m + 1) z₀).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ z _ => ?_))
        (hdom_int (m + 1))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ z _ => h_pt_deriv ξ z))
      rw [L_m.norm_map]
      exact h_slice_dom (m + 1) ξ z
    have hcomm : (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, L_m (α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (h_fn ξ) z₀)) =
        L_m (J (m + 1) z₀) :=
      LinearIsometry.integral_comp_comm
        (E := ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ)
        (F := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ]
          ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ)
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (𝕜 := ℝ)
        L_m.toLinearIsometry
        (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) (h_fn ξ) z₀)
    rwa [hcomm] at h1

  have hW_int : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => α ξ * h_fn ξ z) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro z
    have hcont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => α ξ * h_fn ξ z) :=
      hα_cont.mul (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
          ((hΔΘ_smooth 0).continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)))))
    refine ((hη_int 0).mul_prod (hη_int 0)).mono' hcont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ => ?_))
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one]
    exact hα_bd ξ
  have hW_iter : ∀ m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m W_o = J m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      ext z x
      let L₀ := (continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ).symm
      have h1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 W_o z = L₀ (W_o z) := by
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]
        rfl
      have h2 : (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (h_fn ξ) z) =
          fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => L₀ (α ξ * h_fn ξ z) := by
        ext ξ y
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]
        simp [L₀]
      have hW_eq : W_o z = ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, α ξ * h_fn ξ z := rfl
      have hcomm : (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, L₀ (α ξ * h_fn ξ z)) =
          L₀ (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, α ξ * h_fn ξ z) :=
        L₀.toLinearIsometry.integral_comp_comm (fun ξ => α ξ * h_fn ξ z)
      have hJ0 : J 0 z = L₀ (W_o z) := by
        dsimp only [J]
        rw [h2, hcomm, ← hW_eq]
      rw [h1, hJ0]
    | succ m ih =>
      ext z v
      let L_m := continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ
        (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℂ
      have h1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) W_o z =
          L_m.symm (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m W_o) z) := by
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left]
        rfl
      rw [h1, ih, (hJ_hasFDeriv m z).fderiv, L_m.symm_apply_apply]
  have hJ_diff : ∀ m : ℕ, Differentiable ℝ (J m) :=
    fun m z => (hJ_hasFDeriv m z).differentiableAt
  have hW_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k W_o := by
    intro k
    rw [contDiff_nat_iff_continuous_differentiable]
    refine ⟨fun m _ => ?_, fun m _ => ?_⟩
    · rw [hW_iter m]; exact (hJ_diff m).continuous
    · rw [hW_iter m]; exact hJ_diff m
  have hW_fderiv_bd : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k W_o z‖ ≤ M_W k := by
    intro k z
    rw [hW_iter k]
    calc ‖J k z‖
        ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ‖α ξ • iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (h_fn ξ) z‖ :=
          MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, dom k ξ :=
          MeasureTheory.integral_mono (hJ_int k z).norm (hdom_int k)
            (fun ξ => h_slice_dom k ξ z)
      _ = D_z_exp k * (3 : ℝ) ^ k * (I_mom 0 ^ 2 + 2 * I_mom k * I_mom 0) :=
          hdom_integral k
      _ ≤ M_W k := le_max_right _ _

  
  have h_chi_diff : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
      |χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) - 1| ≤
        r_cut ^ N_tay * (|ξ.1| ^ N_tay + |ξ.2| ^ N_tay) := by
    intro ξ
    have hr_ne : r_cut ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr_pos
    by_cases h_in : |ξ.1| ≤ r_cut⁻¹ ∧ |ξ.2| ≤ r_cut⁻¹
    · have h1 : |r_cut * ξ.1| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
        calc r_cut * |ξ.1| ≤ r_cut * r_cut⁻¹ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_in.1 hr_pos.le
          _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne
      have h2 : |r_cut * ξ.2| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
        calc r_cut * |ξ.2| ≤ r_cut * r_cut⁻¹ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_in.2 hr_pos.le
          _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne
      rw [hχ₁_one _ h1, hχ₁_one _ h2]
      norm_num
      exact mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le N_tay)
        (add_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) N_tay) (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) N_tay))
    · obtain ⟨_h_nn, h_le1⟩ := hχ_prod_01 ξ
      have habs_le1 : |χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) - 1| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h_le1)]
        linarith [(hχ_prod_01 ξ).1]
      have h1_le_rhs : 1 ≤ r_cut ^ N_tay * (|ξ.1| ^ N_tay + |ξ.2| ^ N_tay) := by
        rw [not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at h_in
        rcases h_in with h1_gt | h2_gt
        · have hprod1 : 1 ≤ r_cut * |ξ.1| := by
            calc (1 : ℝ) = r_cut * r_cut⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne).symm
              _ ≤ r_cut * |ξ.1| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_gt.le hr_pos.le
          calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ (r_cut * |ξ.1|) ^ N_tay := one_le_pow₀ hprod1
            _ = r_cut ^ N_tay * |ξ.1| ^ N_tay := mul_pow _ _ _
            _ ≤ r_cut ^ N_tay * (|ξ.1| ^ N_tay + |ξ.2| ^ N_tay) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (le_add_of_nonneg_right (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) N_tay))
                  (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le N_tay)
        · have hprod2 : 1 ≤ r_cut * |ξ.2| := by
            calc (1 : ℝ) = r_cut * r_cut⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne).symm
              _ ≤ r_cut * |ξ.2| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2_gt.le hr_pos.le
          calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ (r_cut * |ξ.2|) ^ N_tay := one_le_pow₀ hprod2
            _ = r_cut ^ N_tay * |ξ.2| ^ N_tay := mul_pow _ _ _
            _ ≤ r_cut ^ N_tay * (|ξ.1| ^ N_tay + |ξ.2| ^ N_tay) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (le_add_of_nonneg_left (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) N_tay))
                  (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le N_tay)
      exact le_trans habs_le1 h1_le_rhs

  
  have h_approx : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (_hz_win : ‖z‖ ≤ R_win) (val₀ : ℂ),
      (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
        ((ξ.1 ^ 0 * ξ.2 ^ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = val₀) →
      (∀ p q : ℕ, 1 ≤ p + q →
        ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
          ((ξ.1 ^ p * ξ.2 ^ q : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 0) →
      ‖W_o z - val₀‖ ≤ C_W * (δ_small ^ N_tay + r_cut ^ N_tay) := by
    intro z hz_win val₀ h_int_00 h_int_pq
    let e_z : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun ξ =>
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    let μ_full : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p q ξ =>
      ((ξ.1 ^ p * ξ.2 ^ q : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 * e_z ξ
    let μ_cut : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p q ξ =>
      ((χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * μ_full p q ξ
    have hμ_full_norm : ∀ (p q : ℕ) (ξ : ℝ × ℝ),
        ‖μ_full p q ξ‖ = w1 p ξ.1 * w1 q ξ.2 := by
      intro p q ξ
      dsimp only [μ_full, e_z, w1]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one,
        Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_pow]
      ring
    have hμ_full_cont : ∀ p q : ℕ, Continuous (μ_full p q) := by
      intro p q
      dsimp only [μ_full, e_z]
      fun_prop
    have hμ_full_int : ∀ p q : ℕ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (μ_full p q) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro p q
      refine ((hη_int p).mul_prod (hη_int q)).mono' (hμ_full_cont p q).aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ => ?_))
      rw [hμ_full_norm]
    have hμ_cut_int : ∀ p q : ℕ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (μ_cut p q) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro p q
      have hc : Continuous (μ_cut p q) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
          ((hχ₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst)).mul
            (hχ₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)))).mul
          (hμ_full_cont p q)
      refine ((hη_int p).mul_prod (hη_int q)).mono' hc.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ => ?_))
      obtain ⟨h_nn, h_le1⟩ := hχ_prod_01 ξ
      dsimp only [μ_cut]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h_nn, hμ_full_norm]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (mul_nonneg (hw1_nn p ξ.1) (hw1_nn q ξ.2)) h_le1
    have hμ_tail : ∀ p q : ℕ,
        ‖(∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_cut p q ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_full p q ξ)‖ ≤
          r_cut ^ N_tay * E_tail p q := by
      intro p q
      let maj : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ =>
        r_cut ^ N_tay * (w1 (p + N_tay) ξ.1 * w1 q ξ.2 + w1 p ξ.1 * w1 (q + N_tay) ξ.2)
      have hmaj_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable maj MeasureTheory.volume :=
        ((hw_prod_int (p + N_tay) q).add (hw_prod_int p (q + N_tay))).const_mul (r_cut ^ N_tay)
      have hmaj_eq : (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, maj ξ) = r_cut ^ N_tay * E_tail p q := by
        dsimp only [maj, E_tail]
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
          MeasureTheory.integral_add (hw_prod_int (p + N_tay) q) (hw_prod_int p (q + N_tay)),
          hw_prod_eq (p + N_tay) q, hw_prod_eq p (q + N_tay)]
      have hpt : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ‖μ_cut p q ξ - μ_full p q ξ‖ ≤ maj ξ := by
        intro ξ
        have hsub : μ_cut p q ξ - μ_full p q ξ =
            ((χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * μ_full p q ξ := by
          dsimp only [μ_cut]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [hsub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, hμ_full_norm]
        calc |χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) * χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) - 1| * (w1 p ξ.1 * w1 q ξ.2)
            ≤ (r_cut ^ N_tay * (|ξ.1| ^ N_tay + |ξ.2| ^ N_tay)) *
                (w1 p ξ.1 * w1 q ξ.2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_chi_diff ξ)
                (mul_nonneg (hw1_nn p ξ.1) (hw1_nn q ξ.2))
          _ = maj ξ := by
              dsimp only [maj, w1]
              rw [pow_add |ξ.1| p N_tay, pow_add |ξ.2| q N_tay]
              ring
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub (hμ_cut_int p q) (hμ_full_int p q)]
      calc ‖∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, (μ_cut p q ξ - μ_full p q ξ)‖
          ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ‖μ_cut p q ξ - μ_full p q ξ‖ :=
            MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, maj ξ :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_mono ((hμ_cut_int p q).sub (hμ_full_int p q)).norm hmaj_int hpt
        _ = r_cut ^ N_tay * E_tail p q := hmaj_eq

    
    let G_z : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun u =>
      Complex.exp (Complex.I *
        ((ΔΘ_o u z - 2 * Real.pi * (u.1 * z 0 + u.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    obtain ⟨hG0, hG_sm, hG_poly, hG_rem⟩ := hG_z z hz_win
    let c_coeff : (m : ℕ) → (Fin m → Bool) → ℂ := fun m =>
      if hm : 1 ≤ m ∧ m < N_tay then Classical.choose (hG_poly m hm.1 hm.2) else fun _ => 0
    have hc_spec : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m < N_tay →
        (∀ b : Fin m → Bool, ‖c_coeff m b‖ ≤ C_u_coeff m) ∧
        (∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
          ((m.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • iteratedDeriv m (fun s : ℝ => G_z (s • ξ)) 0 =
            ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
              c_coeff m b *
                ((ξ.1 ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card *
                  ξ.2 ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      intro m hm1 hm2
      have h_eq : c_coeff m = Classical.choose (hG_poly m hm1 hm2) := by
        simp [c_coeff, hm1, hm2]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (hG_poly m hm1 hm2)
    let P_z : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun ξ =>
      (1 : ℂ) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
        ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
          c_coeff m b *
            ((ξ.1 ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card *
              ξ.2 ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have h_tay_box : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, |ξ.1| ≤ 2 * r_cut⁻¹ → |ξ.2| ≤ 2 * r_cut⁻¹ →
        ‖G_z ξ - P_z ξ‖ ≤ C_rem * δ_small ^ N_tay := by
      intro ξ hξ1 hξ2
      let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => G_z (s • ξ)
      have hF_sm : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k F := fun k =>
        (hG_sm k).comp (contDiff_id.smul contDiff_const)
      have hF0 : F 0 = 1 := by
        dsimp only [F]; rw [zero_smul]; exact hG0
      have hF1 : F 1 = G_z ξ := by
        dsimp only [F]; rw [one_smul]
      let n₀ : ℕ := N_tay - 1
      have hn₀ : n₀ + 1 = N_tay := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)
      let E_rem : ℝ := C_rem * δ_small ^ N_tay
      have hE_nn : 0 ≤ E_rem := mul_nonneg hCrem (pow_nonneg hδ_nn N_tay)
      have hu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := uniqueDiffOn_Icc zero_lt_one
      have h_idw : ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          iteratedDerivWithin k F (Set.Icc 0 1) y = iteratedDeriv k F y :=
        fun k y hy => iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hu (hF_sm k).contDiffAt hy
      have h_on : ContDiffOn ℝ (n₀ + 1) F (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
        exact_mod_cast (hF_sm (n₀ + 1)).contDiffOn
      have h_tay := taylor_mean_remainder_bound (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (C := E_rem) (x := 1)
        (n := n₀) zero_le_one h_on ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
        (fun y hy => by
          rw [h_idw (n₀ + 1) y hy, hn₀]
          exact hG_rem ξ hξ1 hξ2 y hy)
      have h_rhs : E_rem * (1 - (0 : ℝ)) ^ (n₀ + 1) / (n₀.factorial : ℝ) ≤ E_rem := by
        rw [sub_zero, one_pow, mul_one]
        exact div_le_self hE_nn (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos n₀)
      have h_eval : taylorWithinEval F n₀ (Set.Icc 0 1) 0 1 = P_z ξ := by
        rw [taylor_within_apply, hn₀]
        have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
        have h_sum_eq : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N_tay,
            ((k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - (0 : ℝ)) ^ k) •
              iteratedDerivWithin k F (Set.Icc 0 1) 0) =
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 0 N_tay, ((k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • iteratedDeriv k F 0 := by
          rw [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
          rw [sub_zero, one_pow, mul_one, h_idw k 0 h0_mem]
        rw [h_sum_eq, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (by omega : 0 < N_tay)]
        have h0_term : (((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • iteratedDeriv 0 F 0 = (1 : ℂ) := by
          simp [hF0]
        rw [h0_term]
        dsimp only [P_z]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
        obtain ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm
        exact (hc_spec m hm1 hm2).2 ξ
      rw [← hF1, ← h_eval]
      exact h_tay.trans h_rhs

    
    let S_cut : ℂ := (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_cut 0 0 ξ) +
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
        ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
          c_coeff m b *
            ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
              μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ
    have hP_exp : (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => α ξ * P_z ξ * e_z ξ) =
        fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => μ_cut 0 0 ξ +
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
            ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
              c_coeff m b *
                μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ := by
      ext ξ
      dsimp only [α, P_z, μ_cut, μ_full]
      rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
      push_cast
      rw [mul_add, add_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      congr 1
      · ring
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
        ring
    have hP_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => α ξ * P_z ξ * e_z ξ) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [hP_exp]
      refine (hμ_cut_int 0 0).add (MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum _ (fun m _ => ?_))
      exact MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum _ (fun b _ => (hμ_cut_int _ _).const_mul _)
    have hP_integral : (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, α ξ * P_z ξ * e_z ξ) = S_cut := by
      rw [hP_exp]
      have h_sum_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay, ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
            c_coeff m b *
              μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ)
          MeasureTheory.volume :=
        MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum _ (fun m _ =>
          MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum _ (fun b _ => (hμ_cut_int _ _).const_mul _))
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (hμ_cut_int 0 0) h_sum_int,
        MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum _ (fun m _ =>
          MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum _ (fun b _ => (hμ_cut_int _ _).const_mul _))]
      dsimp only [S_cut]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum _ (fun b _ => (hμ_cut_int _ _).const_mul _)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul _ _

    
    have h_tay_err : ‖W_o z - S_cut‖ ≤ C_tay * δ_small ^ N_tay := by
      have hW_eq : W_o z = ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, α ξ * h_fn ξ z := rfl
      rw [hW_eq, ← hP_integral, ← MeasureTheory.integral_sub (hW_int z) hP_int]
      let maj_tay : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => (C_rem * δ_small ^ N_tay) * (w1 0 ξ.1 * w1 0 ξ.2)
      have hmaj_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable maj_tay MeasureTheory.volume :=
        ((hη_int 0).mul_prod (hη_int 0)).const_mul (C_rem * δ_small ^ N_tay)
      have hpt : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ‖α ξ * h_fn ξ z - α ξ * P_z ξ * e_z ξ‖ ≤ maj_tay ξ := by
        intro ξ
        have hh_fac : h_fn ξ z = G_z ξ * e_z ξ := by
          dsimp only [h_fn, G_z, e_z]
          rw [← Complex.exp_add]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        have hdiff : α ξ * h_fn ξ z - α ξ * P_z ξ * e_z ξ =
            α ξ * (G_z ξ - P_z ξ) * e_z ξ := by
          rw [hh_fac]; ring
        rw [hdiff]
        by_cases hα0 : α ξ = 0
        · rw [hα0, zero_mul, zero_mul, norm_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCrem (pow_nonneg hδ_nn N_tay))
            (mul_nonneg (hw1_nn 0 ξ.1) (hw1_nn 0 ξ.2))
        · have hχ1_ne : χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.1) ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0; apply hα0; dsimp [α]; simp [h0]
          have hχ2_ne : χ₁ (r_cut * ξ.2) ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0; apply hα0; dsimp [α]; simp [h0]
          have h1_lt : |r_cut * ξ.1| < 2 := by
            by_contra hge; exact hχ1_ne (hχ₁_zero _ (not_lt.mp hge))
          have h2_lt : |r_cut * ξ.2| < 2 := by
            by_contra hge; exact hχ2_ne (hχ₁_zero _ (not_lt.mp hge))
          have hξ1_le : |ξ.1| ≤ 2 * r_cut⁻¹ := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_pos] at h1_lt
            have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_lt.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hr_pos.le)
            rwa [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr_pos), one_mul, mul_comm] at hm
          have hξ2_le : |ξ.2| ≤ 2 * r_cut⁻¹ := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_pos] at h2_lt
            have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2_lt.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hr_pos.le)
            rwa [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr_pos), one_mul, mul_comm] at hm
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one]
          calc ‖α ξ‖ * ‖G_z ξ - P_z ξ‖
              ≤ (w1 0 ξ.1 * w1 0 ξ.2) * (C_rem * δ_small ^ N_tay) :=
                mul_le_mul (hα_bd ξ) (h_tay_box ξ hξ1_le hξ2_le)
                  (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (hw1_nn 0 ξ.1) (hw1_nn 0 ξ.2))
            _ = maj_tay ξ := by dsimp only [maj_tay]; ring
      calc ‖∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, (α ξ * h_fn ξ z - α ξ * P_z ξ * e_z ξ)‖
          ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ‖α ξ * h_fn ξ z - α ξ * P_z ξ * e_z ξ‖ :=
            MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, maj_tay ξ :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_mono ((hW_int z).sub hP_int).norm hmaj_int hpt
        _ = C_tay * δ_small ^ N_tay := by
            dsimp only [maj_tay, C_tay]
            rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hw_prod_eq 0 0]
            ring

    
    have h_card_sum : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → Bool),
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card +
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card = m := by
      intro m b
      have h_eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => b i = false)) =
          Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => ¬ (b i = true)) := by
        ext i; simp
      rw [h_eq, Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    have h_cut_err : ‖S_cut - val₀‖ ≤ C_cut * r_cut ^ N_tay := by
      have h_sub_eq : S_cut - val₀ =
          ((∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_cut 0 0 ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_full 0 0 ξ)) +
            ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
              ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                c_coeff m b *
                  ((∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                      μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                            (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ) -
                   (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                      μ_full (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                             (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ)) := by
        dsimp only [S_cut]
        have h00' : (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_full 0 0 ξ) = val₀ := h_int_00
        rw [h00']
        have h_sum_eq : (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
            ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
              c_coeff m b *
                ((∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                    μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ) -
                 (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                    μ_full (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                           (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ))) =
            ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
              ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                c_coeff m b *
                  ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                    μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
          obtain ⟨hm1, _⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
          have hpq : 1 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card +
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card := by
            rw [h_card_sum m b]; exact hm1
          have h0 : (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
              μ_full (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                     (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ) = 0 :=
            h_int_pq _ _ hpq
          rw [h0, sub_zero]
        rw [h_sum_eq]
        ring
      rw [h_sub_eq]
      have h_sum_bd : ‖∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
            ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
              c_coeff m b *
                ((∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                    μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ) -
                 (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                    μ_full (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                           (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ))‖ ≤
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
            (C_u_coeff m *
              ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                E_tail (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                       (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card) *
              r_cut ^ N_tay := by
        refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm => ?_))
        obtain ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm
        refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) ?_
        calc ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
              ‖c_coeff m b *
                ((∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                    μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ) -
                 (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                    μ_full (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                           (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ))‖
            ≤ ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                C_u_coeff m *
                  (r_cut ^ N_tay *
                    E_tail (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                           (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card) := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => ?_)
              rw [norm_mul]
              exact mul_le_mul ((hc_spec m hm1 hm2).1 b) (hμ_tail _ _)
                (norm_nonneg _) (hCu m)
          _ = (C_u_coeff m *
                ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                  E_tail (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                         (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card) *
                r_cut ^ N_tay := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
              ring
      calc ‖((∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_cut 0 0 ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_full 0 0 ξ)) +
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
                ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                  c_coeff m b *
                    ((∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                        μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                              (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ) -
                     (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                        μ_full (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                               (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ))‖
          ≤ ‖(∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_cut 0 0 ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, μ_full 0 0 ξ)‖ +
              ‖∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
                ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                  c_coeff m b *
                    ((∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                        μ_cut (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                              (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ) -
                     (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
                        μ_full (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                               (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card ξ))‖ :=
            norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ r_cut ^ N_tay * E_tail 0 0 +
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N_tay,
                (C_u_coeff m *
                  ∑ b : Fin m → Bool,
                    E_tail (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card
                           (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i = false)).card) *
                  r_cut ^ N_tay :=
            add_le_add (hμ_tail 0 0) h_sum_bd
        _ = C_cut * r_cut ^ N_tay := by
            dsimp only [C_cut]
            rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
            ring

    
    have h_tri : ‖W_o z - val₀‖ ≤ ‖W_o z - S_cut‖ + ‖S_cut - val₀‖ := by
      have heq : W_o z - val₀ = (W_o z - S_cut) + (S_cut - val₀) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      exact norm_add_le _ _
    have hδ_pow_nn : 0 ≤ δ_small ^ N_tay := pow_nonneg hδ_nn N_tay
    have hr_pow_nn : 0 ≤ r_cut ^ N_tay := pow_nonneg hr_pos.le N_tay
    dsimp only [C_W]
    nlinarith [h_tri, h_tay_err, h_cut_err, hCtay_nn, hCcut_nn, hδ_pow_nn, hr_pow_nn]

  refine ⟨hW_smooth, hW_fderiv_bd, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz_win hz_in
    refine h_approx z hz_win 1 ?_ (hη_in z hz_in).2
    have h0 : (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((ξ.1 ^ 0 * ξ.2 ^ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
        fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ =>
          η_hat ξ.1 * η_hat ξ.2 *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((2 * Real.pi * (ξ.1 * z 0 + ξ.2 * z 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      ext ξ; simp
    rw [h0]
    exact (hη_in z hz_in).1
  · intro z hz_win hz_out
    have h_res := h_approx z hz_win 0 (hη_out z hz_out 0 0) (fun p q _ => hη_out z hz_out p q)
    rwa [sub_zero] at h_res

informal_problem.statement:
(Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (hΦ₀_cont : Continuous Φ₀)
    (lam_sys ρ_t C_t R_win R_supp_in R_in M_0 E_err : ℝ)
    (hρ_t : 0 < ρ_t) (hR_win : 0 < R_win)
    (hM_0 : 0 ≤ M_0) (hE_err : 0 ≤ E_err)
    (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_o W_o χ_ann : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (hψ_cont : Continuous ψ_o) (hW_cont : Continuous W_o) (hχ_cont : Continuous χ_ann)
    (hψ_supp : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0)
    (hψ_bd : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖ψ_o z‖ ≤ M_0)
    (hχ_one : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖z‖ ≤ R_in → χ_ann z = 1)
    (hχ_sub_bd : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖(1 : ℂ) - χ_ann z‖ ≤ 1)
    (hW_in : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖z‖ ≤ R_win → ‖z‖ ≤ R_supp_in → ‖W_o z - 1‖ ≤ E_err)
    (hW_out : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖z‖ ≤ R_win → R_in ≤ ‖z‖ → ‖W_o z‖ ≤ E_err)
    (α_wt : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (x_of : ℝ × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hα_cont : Continuous α_wt)
    (hα_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable α_wt MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hx_cont : Continuous x_of)
    (hW_rep : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      W_o z = ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
        α_wt ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
          ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o + ρ_t • z) -
            Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o + ρ_t • z) -
            Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) +
            Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (H_all H_in : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (hHall_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H_all MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hHall_l2 : MeasureTheory.MemLp H_all 2 MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hHin_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable H_in MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hHin_l2 : MeasureTheory.MemLp H_in 2 MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hHin_supp : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_supp_in * ρ_t ≤ ‖v - V_o‖ → H_in v = 0)
    (h_pair_eq : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, α_wt ξ ≠ 0 →
      ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        H_all v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        H_in v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
    let ψ_loc : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun z => χ_ann z * W_o z * ψ_o z
    ‖((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        H_in v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
     ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        H_all v * ψ_loc (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))‖ ≤
      (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * M_0 * E_err) *
        (Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_in v‖ ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_all v‖ ^ 2))
