proof.tactics:
by
  intro ψ_loc
  let z_of : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun v => ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)
  let e_X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
    fun v => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
  have hρ_inv_pos : 0 < ρ_t⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hρ_t
  have hρ_ne : ρ_t ≠ 0 := hρ_t.ne'
  have hz_cont : Continuous z_of :=
    (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ρ_t⁻¹)).smul
      (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  have heX_cont : Continuous e_X :=
    Complex.continuous_exp.comp
      (continuous_const.mul
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
          (continuous_const.mul
            (hΦ₀_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))))))
  have heX_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖e_X v‖ = 1 :=
    fun v => Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal _
  have hz_inv : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), V_o + ρ_t • z_of v = v := by
    intro v
    dsimp only [z_of]
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ_ne, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
  have hz_norm : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖z_of v‖ = ρ_t⁻¹ * ‖v - V_o‖ := by
    intro v
    dsimp only [z_of]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ_inv_pos.le]
  have hz_le_of_le : ∀ {R : ℝ} {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)},
      ‖v - V_o‖ ≤ R * ρ_t → ‖z_of v‖ ≤ R := by
    intro R v hv
    rw [hz_norm v]
    calc ρ_t⁻¹ * ‖v - V_o‖
        ≤ ρ_t⁻¹ * (R * ρ_t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv hρ_inv_pos.le
      _ = R * (ρ_t⁻¹ * ρ_t) := by ring
      _ = R := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ_ne, mul_one]
  have hψ_z_supp : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      R_win * ρ_t < ‖v - V_o‖ → ψ_o (z_of v) = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    apply hψ_supp
    by_contra hlt
    have hle : ‖z_of v‖ ≤ R_win := le_of_not_ge hlt
    rw [hz_norm v] at hle
    have hv_le : ‖v - V_o‖ ≤ R_win * ρ_t := by
      calc ‖v - V_o‖ = ρ_t * (ρ_t⁻¹ * ‖v - V_o‖) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ_ne, one_mul]
        _ ≤ ρ_t * R_win := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hρ_t.le
        _ = R_win * ρ_t := mul_comm _ _
    exact hv.not_ge hv_le

  let B_W : ℝ := ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ‖α_wt ξ‖
  have hBW_nn : 0 ≤ B_W := MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun ξ => norm_nonneg (α_wt ξ))
  have hW_bd_glob : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖W_o z‖ ≤ B_W := by
    intro z
    rw [hW_rep z]
    refine le_trans (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) (le_of_eq ?_)
    dsimp only [B_W]
    congr 1
    ext ξ
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one]
  have hχ_bd_glob : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖χ_ann z‖ ≤ 2 := by
    intro z
    have heq : χ_ann z = (1 : ℂ) - ((1 : ℂ) - χ_ann z) := (sub_sub_cancel 1 (χ_ann z)).symm
    rw [heq]
    calc ‖(1 : ℂ) - ((1 : ℂ) - χ_ann z)‖
        ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ) - χ_ann z‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + 1 := by
          rw [norm_one]
          exact add_le_add le_rfl (hχ_sub_bd z)
      _ = 2 := by norm_num

  
  have h_l2_ball : ∀ (K : ℝ), 0 ≤ K →
      ∀ (H F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        MeasureTheory.MemLp H 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable F MeasureTheory.volume →
        (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win * ρ_t < ‖v - V_o‖ → F v = 0) →
        (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖F v‖ ≤ K * ‖H v‖) →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable F MeasureTheory.volume ∧
        ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), F v‖ ≤
          (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * K) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H v‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro K hK H F hH_l2 hF_meas hF_supp hF_bd
    let R : ℝ := R_win * ρ_t
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := mul_pos hR_win hρ_t
    let B_o : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) := Metric.closedBall V_o R
    have hBo_meas : MeasurableSet B_o := measurableSet_closedBall
    have hBo_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume B_o ≠ ⊤ := MeasureTheory.measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne
    let ind_K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ := B_o.indicator (fun _ => K)
    have h_ind_l2 : MeasureTheory.MemLp ind_K 2 MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.memLp_indicator_const 2 hBo_meas K (Or.inr hBo_ne_top)
    have hH_norm_l2 : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun v => ‖H v‖) 2 MeasureTheory.volume := hH_l2.norm
    have h_dom_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ind_K v * ‖H v‖) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      simpa only [Pi.mul_def] using h_ind_l2.integrable_mul hH_norm_l2
    have h_dom : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖F v‖ ≤ ind_K v * ‖H v‖ := by
      intro v
      by_cases hv : v ∈ B_o
      · dsimp only [ind_K]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hv]
        exact hF_bd v
      · dsimp only [ind_K]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hv, zero_mul]
        have hv_out : R < ‖v - V_o‖ := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hv
          exact lt_of_not_ge hv
        rw [hF_supp v hv_out, norm_zero]
    have hF_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable F MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_dom_int.mono' hF_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_dom)
    refine ⟨hF_int, ?_⟩
    have h_ind_nn : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 0 ≤ ind_K v :=
      fun v => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => hK) v
    have h_ind_l2' : MeasureTheory.MemLp ind_K (ENNReal.ofReal (2 : ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]
    have hH_norm_l2' :
        MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun v => ‖H v‖) (ENNReal.ofReal (2 : ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]
    have h_holder := MeasureTheory.integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg
      Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_ind_nn)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => norm_nonneg (H v)))
      h_ind_l2' hH_norm_l2'
    simp_rw [Real.rpow_two, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] at h_holder
    have h_ind_sq : (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ind_K v ^ 2) =
        (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * ρ_t * K) ^ 2 := by
      have h_fn : (fun v => ind_K v ^ 2) = B_o.indicator (fun _ => K ^ 2) := by
        ext v
        by_cases hv : v ∈ B_o <;> simp [ind_K, hv]
      have h_vol : (MeasureTheory.volume B_o).toReal = R ^ 2 * Real.pi := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.volume_closedBall_fin_two V_o R,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow hR_pos.le 2,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg R),
          ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg R) Real.pi_pos.le)]
      rw [h_fn, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_const (K ^ 2) hBo_meas,
        MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, smul_eq_mul, h_vol]
      calc R ^ 2 * Real.pi * K ^ 2
          = R ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt Real.pi ^ 2) * K ^ 2 := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt Real.pi_pos.le]
        _ = (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * ρ_t * K) ^ 2 := by
            dsimp only [R]
            ring
    have h_pref_nn : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * ρ_t * K :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hR_win.le) hρ_t.le) hK
    have h_sqrt_ind :
        Real.sqrt (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ind_K v ^ 2) =
          Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * ρ_t * K := by
      rw [h_ind_sq, Real.sqrt_sq h_pref_nn]
    have h_int_bd : ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), F v‖ ≤
        (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * ρ_t * K) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H v‖ ^ 2) := by
      calc ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), F v‖
          ≤ ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖F v‖ :=
            MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm F
        _ ≤ ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ind_K v * ‖H v‖ :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => norm_nonneg (F v)))
              h_dom_int (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_dom)
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ v, ind_K v ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H v‖ ^ 2) := h_holder
        _ = (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * ρ_t * K) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H v‖ ^ 2) := by
            rw [h_sqrt_ind]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ_t.le]
    calc ρ_t⁻¹ * ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), F v‖
        ≤ ρ_t⁻¹ * ((Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * ρ_t * K) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H v‖ ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_bd hρ_inv_pos.le
      _ = (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * K) * (ρ_t⁻¹ * ρ_t) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H v‖ ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * K) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H v‖ ^ 2) := by
          rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ_ne, mul_one]

  
  have h_fub_single : ∀ (H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => H v * ψ_o (z_of v)) MeasureTheory.volume →
      ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), H v * (W_o (z_of v) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v =
        ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
          (α_wt ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * (-Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) + Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
          (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            H v * ψ_o (z_of v) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
    intro H hK_int
    let K_H : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun v => H v * ψ_o (z_of v)
    let M_mod : (ℝ × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun p =>
      α_wt p.1 * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
        ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, x_of p.1, p.2) - Φ₀ (C_t, x_of p.1, V_o) +
          Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    let f_H : (ℝ × ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun ξ v => M_mod (ξ, v) * K_H v
    have hM_cont : Continuous M_mod := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Φ₀ (C_t, x_of p.1, p.2)) :=
        hΦ₀_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk ((hx_cont.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd))
      have h2 : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          Φ₀ (C_t, x_of p.1, V_o)) :=
        hΦ₀_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk ((hx_cont.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_const))
      exact (hα_cont.comp continuous_fst).mul
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
              (continuous_const.mul ((h1.sub h2).add continuous_const)))))
    have hf_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f_H)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) :=
      hM_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hK_int.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_snd
    have hf_dom_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖α_wt p.1‖ * ‖K_H p.2‖)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) :=
      hα_int.norm.mul_prod hK_int.norm
    have hf_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry f_H)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
      refine hf_dom_int.mono' hf_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => ?_))
      change ‖M_mod p * K_H p.2‖ ≤ ‖α_wt p.1‖ * ‖K_H p.2‖
      dsimp only [M_mod]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one]
    have h_inner_ξ : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        (∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, f_H ξ v) = H v * (W_o (z_of v) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v := by
      intro v
      have h_integrand : (fun ξ : ℝ × ℝ => f_H ξ v) = fun ξ =>
          (K_H v * e_X v) * (α_wt ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o + ρ_t • z_of v) -
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o + ρ_t • z_of v) -
              Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) +
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
        ext ξ
        dsimp only [f_H, M_mod, K_H, e_X]
        have h_phase_eq :
            Complex.I * ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) - Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) +
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            Complex.I * ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o + ρ_t • z_of v) -
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o + ρ_t • z_of v) -
              Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) +
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
            Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          rw [hz_inv v]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_phase_eq, Complex.exp_add]
        ring
      rw [h_integrand, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, ← hW_rep (z_of v)]
      dsimp only [K_H]
      ring
    have h_inner_v : ∀ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
        (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), f_H ξ v) =
          (α_wt ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * (-Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) + Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
          (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
            H v * ψ_o (z_of v) *
              Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
      intro ξ
      have h_integrand : (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => f_H ξ v) = fun v =>
          (α_wt ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
            ((lam_sys * (-Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) + Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
          (H v * ψ_o (z_of v) *
            Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
        ext v
        dsimp only [f_H, M_mod, K_H]
        have h_phase_eq :
            Complex.I * ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) - Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) +
              Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            Complex.I * ((lam_sys * (-Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) + Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
            Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_phase_eq, Complex.exp_add]
        ring
      rw [h_integrand, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    calc ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), H v * (W_o (z_of v) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v
        = ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, f_H ξ v := by
          simp_rw [h_inner_ξ]
      _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ, ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), f_H ξ v :=
          (MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hf_int).symm
      _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ × ℝ,
            (α_wt ξ * Complex.exp (Complex.I *
              ((lam_sys * (-Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, V_o) + Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, V_o)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
            (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
              H v * ψ_o (z_of v) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, x_of ξ, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
          simp_rw [h_inner_v]

  have hψ_z_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v => ψ_o (z_of v)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (hψ_cont.comp hz_cont).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hW_z_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v => W_o (z_of v)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (hW_cont.comp hz_cont).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hχ_z_meas :
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v => χ_ann (z_of v)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (hχ_cont.comp hz_cont).aestronglyMeasurable
  have heX_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable e_X MeasureTheory.volume :=
    heX_cont.aestronglyMeasurable

  have hHall_ψ_int :
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => H_all v * ψ_o (z_of v)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (h_l2_ball M_0 hM_0 H_all (fun v => H_all v * ψ_o (z_of v)) hHall_l2
      (hHall_meas.mul hψ_z_meas)
      (fun v hv => by rw [hψ_z_supp v hv, mul_zero])
      (fun v => by
        rw [norm_mul, mul_comm M_0 ‖H_all v‖]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hψ_bd (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg (H_all v)))).1

  have hHin_ψ_int :
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => H_in v * ψ_o (z_of v)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (h_l2_ball M_0 hM_0 H_in (fun v => H_in v * ψ_o (z_of v)) hHin_l2
      (hHin_meas.mul hψ_z_meas)
      (fun v hv => by rw [hψ_z_supp v hv, mul_zero])
      (fun v => by
        rw [norm_mul, mul_comm M_0 ‖H_in v‖]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hψ_bd (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg (H_in v)))).1

  have h_fub_eq :
      (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), H_all v * (W_o (z_of v) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v) =
      (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), H_in v * (W_o (z_of v) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v) := by
    rw [h_fub_single H_all hHall_ψ_int, h_fub_single H_in hHin_ψ_int]
    congr 1
    ext ξ
    by_cases hα : α_wt ξ = 0
    · simp [hα]
    · dsimp only [z_of]
      rw [h_pair_eq ξ hα]

  
  let F_in_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun v => H_in v * ψ_o (z_of v) * e_X v
  let F_in_W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
    fun v => H_in v * (W_o (z_of v) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v
  let F_all_W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ :=
    fun v => H_all v * (W_o (z_of v) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v
  let F_all_loc : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun v => H_all v * ψ_loc (z_of v) * e_X v

  have hInt_in_o : MeasureTheory.Integrable F_in_o MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (h_l2_ball M_0 hM_0 H_in F_in_o hHin_l2
      ((hHin_meas.mul hψ_z_meas).mul heX_meas)
      (fun v hv => by dsimp only [F_in_o]; rw [hψ_z_supp v hv, mul_zero, zero_mul])
      (fun v => by
        dsimp only [F_in_o]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, heX_norm v, mul_one, mul_comm M_0 ‖H_in v‖]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hψ_bd (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg (H_in v)))).1

  have hInt_in_W : MeasureTheory.Integrable F_in_W MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (h_l2_ball (B_W * M_0) (mul_nonneg hBW_nn hM_0) H_in F_in_W hHin_l2
      ((hHin_meas.mul (hW_z_meas.mul hψ_z_meas)).mul heX_meas)
      (fun v hv => by dsimp only [F_in_W]; rw [hψ_z_supp v hv, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul])
      (fun v => by
        dsimp only [F_in_W]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, heX_norm v, mul_one, mul_comm (B_W * M_0) ‖H_in v‖]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul (hW_bd_glob (z_of v)) (hψ_bd (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg _) hBW_nn)
          (norm_nonneg (H_in v)))).1

  have hInt_all_W : MeasureTheory.Integrable F_all_W MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (h_l2_ball (B_W * M_0) (mul_nonneg hBW_nn hM_0) H_all F_all_W hHall_l2
      ((hHall_meas.mul (hW_z_meas.mul hψ_z_meas)).mul heX_meas)
      (fun v hv => by dsimp only [F_all_W]; rw [hψ_z_supp v hv, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul])
      (fun v => by
        dsimp only [F_all_W]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, heX_norm v, mul_one, mul_comm (B_W * M_0) ‖H_all v‖]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul (hW_bd_glob (z_of v)) (hψ_bd (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg _) hBW_nn)
          (norm_nonneg (H_all v)))).1

  have hInt_all_loc : MeasureTheory.Integrable F_all_loc MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (h_l2_ball (2 * B_W * M_0) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hBW_nn) hM_0)
      H_all F_all_loc hHall_l2
      ((hHall_meas.mul ((hχ_z_meas.mul hW_z_meas).mul hψ_z_meas)).mul heX_meas)
      (fun v hv => by dsimp only [F_all_loc, ψ_loc]; rw [hψ_z_supp v hv, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul])
      (fun v => by
        dsimp only [F_all_loc, ψ_loc]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, heX_norm v, mul_one,
          mul_comm (2 * B_W * M_0) ‖H_all v‖]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg (H_all v))
        exact mul_le_mul
          (mul_le_mul (hχ_bd_glob (z_of v)) (hW_bd_glob (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
          (hψ_bd (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hBW_nn))).1

  let F_err1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun v => F_in_o v - F_in_W v
  let F_err2 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ := fun v => F_all_W v - F_all_loc v
  have hME_nn : 0 ≤ M_0 * E_err := mul_nonneg hM_0 hE_err

  have h_err1_bd : ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), F_err1 v‖ ≤
      (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * (M_0 * E_err)) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_in v‖ ^ 2) := by
    refine (h_l2_ball (M_0 * E_err) hME_nn H_in F_err1 hHin_l2
      (hInt_in_o.aestronglyMeasurable.sub hInt_in_W.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_ ?_).2
    · intro v hv
      dsimp only [F_err1, F_in_o, F_in_W]
      rw [hψ_z_supp v hv]
      ring
    · intro v
      have h_factor : F_err1 v = H_in v * (((1 : ℂ) - W_o (z_of v)) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v := by
        dsimp only [F_err1, F_in_o, F_in_W]
        ring
      rw [h_factor]
      by_cases hv_win : R_win * ρ_t < ‖v - V_o‖
      · rw [hψ_z_supp v hv_win, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, norm_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg hME_nn (norm_nonneg (H_in v))
      · by_cases hv_supp : R_supp_in * ρ_t ≤ ‖v - V_o‖
        · simp [hHin_supp v hv_supp]
        · have hz_win : ‖z_of v‖ ≤ R_win := hz_le_of_le (not_lt.mp hv_win)
          have hz_supp : ‖z_of v‖ ≤ R_supp_in := hz_le_of_le (lt_of_not_ge hv_supp).le
          have hW1 : ‖(1 : ℂ) - W_o (z_of v)‖ ≤ E_err := by
            rw [norm_sub_rev]
            exact hW_in (z_of v) hz_win hz_supp
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, heX_norm v, mul_one]
          calc ‖H_in v‖ * (‖(1 : ℂ) - W_o (z_of v)‖ * ‖ψ_o (z_of v)‖)
              ≤ ‖H_in v‖ * (E_err * M_0) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (mul_le_mul hW1 (hψ_bd (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg _) hE_err)
                  (norm_nonneg (H_in v))
            _ = (M_0 * E_err) * ‖H_in v‖ := by ring

  have h_err2_bd : ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), F_err2 v‖ ≤
      (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * (M_0 * E_err)) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_all v‖ ^ 2) := by
    refine (h_l2_ball (M_0 * E_err) hME_nn H_all F_err2 hHall_l2
      (hInt_all_W.aestronglyMeasurable.sub hInt_all_loc.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_ ?_).2
    · intro v hv
      dsimp only [F_err2, F_all_W, F_all_loc, ψ_loc]
      rw [hψ_z_supp v hv]
      ring
    · intro v
      have h_factor :
          F_err2 v = H_all v * (((1 : ℂ) - χ_ann (z_of v)) * W_o (z_of v) * ψ_o (z_of v)) * e_X v := by
        dsimp only [F_err2, F_all_W, F_all_loc, ψ_loc]
        ring
      rw [h_factor]
      by_cases hv_win : R_win * ρ_t < ‖v - V_o‖
      · rw [hψ_z_supp v hv_win, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, norm_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg hME_nn (norm_nonneg (H_all v))
      · by_cases hz_in : ‖z_of v‖ ≤ R_in
        · rw [hχ_one (z_of v) hz_in, sub_self, zero_mul, zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul, norm_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg hME_nn (norm_nonneg (H_all v))
        · have hz_win : ‖z_of v‖ ≤ R_win := hz_le_of_le (not_lt.mp hv_win)
          have hz_out : R_in ≤ ‖z_of v‖ := (lt_of_not_ge hz_in).le
          have hχW : ‖(1 : ℂ) - χ_ann (z_of v)‖ * ‖W_o (z_of v)‖ ≤ E_err := by
            calc ‖(1 : ℂ) - χ_ann (z_of v)‖ * ‖W_o (z_of v)‖
                ≤ 1 * E_err :=
                  mul_le_mul (hχ_sub_bd (z_of v)) (hW_out (z_of v) hz_win hz_out)
                    (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
              _ = E_err := one_mul E_err
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, heX_norm v, mul_one]
          calc ‖H_all v‖ * (‖(1 : ℂ) - χ_ann (z_of v)‖ * ‖W_o (z_of v)‖ * ‖ψ_o (z_of v)‖)
              ≤ ‖H_all v‖ * (E_err * M_0) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (mul_le_mul hχW (hψ_bd (z_of v)) (norm_nonneg _) hE_err)
                  (norm_nonneg (H_all v))
            _ = (M_0 * E_err) * ‖H_all v‖ := by ring

  
  have h_sub1 : (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), F_err1 v) =
      (∫ v, F_in_o v) - (∫ v, F_in_W v) :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_sub hInt_in_o hInt_in_W
  have h_sub2 : (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), F_err2 v) =
      (∫ v, F_all_W v) - (∫ v, F_all_loc v) :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_sub hInt_all_W hInt_all_loc
  have h_telescope :
      ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_in_o v) - ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_all_loc v) =
      ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_err1 v) + ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_err2 v) := by
    rw [h_sub1, h_sub2, h_fub_eq]
    ring
  change ‖((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_in_o v) - ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_all_loc v)‖ ≤ _
  rw [h_telescope]
  calc ‖((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_err1 v) + ((ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_err2 v)‖
      ≤ ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_err1 v‖ + ‖(ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, F_err2 v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * (M_0 * E_err)) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_in v‖ ^ 2) +
          (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * (M_0 * E_err)) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_all v‖ ^ 2) :=
        add_le_add h_err1_bd h_err2_bd
    _ = (Real.sqrt Real.pi * R_win * M_0 * E_err) *
          (Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_in v‖ ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖H_all v‖ ^ 2)) := by ring

import Mathlib
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

/-!
# Bochner–Riesz Multipliers in Three Dimensions (Theorem 1.1)

Formal problem statement for **Theorem 1.1** from:
OpenAI, *Bochner–Riesz multipliers in three dimensions*,
September 24, 2026.
https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/Bochner-Riesz-Multipliers-in-Three-Dimensions-September-24-2026/Bochner-Riesz-Multipliers-in-Three-Dimensions-September-24-2026.pdf
-/

/-- The Bochner–Riesz multiplier symbol `m_δ(ξ) = (1 - |ξ|²)_+^δ` on `ℝ³`. -/
noncomputable def bochnerRieszSymbol (δ : ℝ) (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ :=
  (max (1 - ‖ξ‖ ^ 2) 0) ^ δ

/-- The Bochner–Riesz multiplier operator `T_δ` on `ℝ³` of order `δ > 0`, acting on a Schwartz
function `f ∈ 𝓢(ℝ³)` by
`T_δ f(x) = ∫_{ℝ³} (1 - |ξ|²)_+^δ f̂(ξ) e^{2πi x · ξ} dξ`,
where `f̂(ξ) = ∫_{ℝ³} f(x) e^{-2πi x · ξ} dx` is the Fourier transform `FourierTransform.fourier f`. -/
noncomputable def bochnerRiesz (δ : ℝ)
    (f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) ℂ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
    (bochnerRieszSymbol δ ξ : ℂ) * FourierTransform.fourier f ξ *
      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (inner ℝ x ξ : ℝ))

/- **Theorem 1.1** (Three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz multiplier bound on `L³(ℝ³)`):
For every `δ > 0`, there is a finite constant `C_δ` such that
`‖T_δ f‖_{L³(ℝ³)} ≤ C_δ ‖f‖_{L³(ℝ³)}` for all `f ∈ 𝓢(ℝ³)`. -/

noncomputable def bochnerRieszKernel (δ : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
    (bochnerRieszSymbol δ ξ : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (inner ℝ z ξ : ℝ))


noncomputable def spatialConv (K g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), K (x - y) * g y


noncomputable def shellOscKernel (δ σ lam : ℝ)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ((lam ^ (-2 - δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * ‖z‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
    a (lam⁻¹ • z)


noncomputable def distPhaseOscOp (σ lam : ℝ)
    (a g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℂ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
    Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((σ * lam * ‖z - y‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      a (z - y) * g y

noncomputable def oscIntegralOp2D (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (B : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (cx : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ (cx.1, cx.2, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      B (cx.1, cx.2, v) * f v

def IsEllipticGevreyPhase (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
    (Φ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k Φ) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ζ) ∧
  (∀ (c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ (x v u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      fderiv ℝ (fun v' => Φ (c, x, v')) v u = inner ℝ (ζ (v, x - c • v)) u) ∧
  (∀ (v p u w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) w =
      inner ℝ u (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p w)) ∧
  ((∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
      inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) u ≤ a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2) ∨
   (∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ -inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
      -inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (v, p')) p u) u ≤ a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2)) ∧
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
      (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ (q.1, p')) q.2) vp‖ ≤
      A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3))

noncomputable def gridPt2D (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ × ℤ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then s * (k.1 : ℝ) else s * (k.2 : ℝ))

noncomputable def perp2D (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then -(e 1) else e 0)

def IsNormalizedPosDefPhase (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k Φ₀) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ζ₀) ∧
  (∀ (c : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), Φ₀ (c, x, 0) = 0) ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), Φ₀ (0, 0, v) = 0) ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ζ₀ (v, 0) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (c : ℝ), c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ (x v u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      fderiv ℝ (fun v' => Φ₀ (c, x, v')) v u = inner ℝ (ζ₀ (v, x - c • v)) u) ∧
  (∀ (v p u w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) w =
      inner ℝ u (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p w)) ∧
  (∀ (v p u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    a₀ * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) u ∧
    inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (v, p')) p u) u ≤ a₁ * ‖u‖ ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ (j : ℕ) (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
      (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun p' => ζ₀ (q.1, p')) q.2) vp‖ ≤
      A ^ (j + 1) * ((j.factorial : ℝ) ^ 3))

def IsCanonicalRootWindow (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ) ∧
  (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), 100 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ z = 0) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ z‖ ≤ (100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ((k.factorial : ℝ) ^ 10))

noncomputable def canonicalRootMass (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) : ℝ :=
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  let V := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1
  let X := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2
  sSup { m : ℝ | ∃ ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ,
    IsCanonicalRootWindow ψ ∧
    m = ‖(ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      f v * ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V)) *
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 }

noncomputable def rootSiteFinset (lam R_dom : ℝ) : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  let B_V : ℤ := ⌈Real.sqrt lam * (R_dom + 100)⌉₊ + 1
  let B_X : ℤ := ⌈Real.sqrt lam * (R_dom + 100 + Real.log lam)⌉₊ + 1
  let boxV := (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V)
  let boxX := (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X)
  (boxV ×ˢ boxX).filter (fun o =>
    ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1‖ ≤ R_dom + 100 ∧
    ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2‖ ≤ R_dom + 100 + Real.log lam)

noncomputable def rootPacketScore (lam R_dom γ : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam R_dom
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  sSup ({ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2) / Real.log lam) } ∪
    { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
        (b a : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (e_dir V_c X_c : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b d ∧ b d ≤ a d ∧ a d ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ‖e_dir d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) ∧
        (∀ o d, o ∉ O₀ → p o d = 0) ∧
        (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) ∧
        (∀ o ∈ O₀, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
          0 < canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ f o ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-(b d)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-(a d)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-(b d)) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * lam ^ (-(a d))) ∧
        (let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
         let p_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d
         let H_O := (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / Real.log lam
         let H_O_D := (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / Real.log lam
         let E_mass := (∑ o ∈ O₀,
           p_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam Φ₀ f o)) / Real.log lam
         let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b d + (1 - γ) * a d)
         s = H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w) })

noncomputable def endpointSiteFinset (lam R_dom : ℝ) :
    Finset (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let m_lam : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 ⌈lam⌉₊
  let B_V : ℤ := ⌈R_dom⌉₊ + 1
  let B_X : ℤ := ⌈lam * R_dom⌉₊ + 1
  let boxR := Finset.range (2 ^ m_lam)
  let boxV := (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V)
  let boxX := (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X)
  (boxR ×ˢ (boxV ×ˢ boxX)).filter (fun o =>
    ‖gridPt2D 1 o.2.1‖ ≤ R_dom ∧
    ‖gridPt2D lam⁻¹ o.2.2‖ ≤ R_dom)

noncomputable def endpointPacketMass (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ψ_end : (ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (o : ℕ × (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) : ℝ :=
  let m_lam : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 ⌈lam⌉₊
  let C_r : ℝ := ((o.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_lam)⁻¹
  let V_j := gridPt2D 1 o.2.1
  let X_k := gridPt2D lam⁻¹ o.2.2
  ‖∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
    f v * ψ_end o (v - V_j) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (C_r, X_k, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def pcGevrey2Bump (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  expNegInvGlue t * expNegInvGlue (1 - t)

noncomputable def pcGevrey2Step (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, pcGevrey2Bump u)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..t, pcGevrey2Bump u

noncomputable def pcDistDerivProfile (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - pcGevrey2Step (u - 10000)) *
    (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + Real.smoothTransition (2 * u + 3 / 2) * u))⁻¹ +
  pcGevrey2Step (u - 10000) * (1 / 2)

noncomputable def pcConvexifiedDist2D (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  1 + ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(‖q‖ ^ 2), pcDistDerivProfile u

noncomputable def pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  (2 * pcDistDerivProfile (‖q‖ ^ 2)) • q

noncomputable def pcSmoothRecipDepth (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / 4 + 8 * Real.smoothTransition (64 * c + 1) * c

noncomputable def pcPhase (σ : ℝ)
    (cxv : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  2 * Real.pi * σ * (pcSmoothRecipDepth cxv.1)⁻¹ *
    pcConvexifiedDist2D ((8 : ℝ) • cxv.2.1 - pcSmoothRecipDepth cxv.1 • cxv.2.2)

noncomputable def pcGrad (σ : ℝ)
    (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  (-2 * Real.pi * σ) • pcConvexifiedDistGrad2D ((8 : ℝ) • vp.2 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • vp.1)

def pcGluePolyCoeff : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
  | 0, 0 => 1
  | 0, _ + 1 => 0
  | _ + 1, 0 => 0
  | _ + 1, 1 => 0
  | j + 1, k + 2 => pcGluePolyCoeff j k - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * pcGluePolyCoeff j (k + 1)

noncomputable def pcHalfNegCoeff : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1 / 2
  | k + 1 => (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) * pcHalfNegCoeff k

noncomputable def canonicalRootAtom (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (o : (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam)⁻¹
  let V := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1
  let X := gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2
  (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V))) *
    Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam * Φ₀ (1 / 2, X, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))

noncomputable def classicalRootSupremum (ε L γ : ℝ) (N_ω N_T : ℕ)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  sSup { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
      (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (e_D V_D A_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (q : Fin N_T → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧ a_D d ≤ L ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid d, 0 ≤ q tid d) ∧
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D, q tid d = p_T tid) ∧
      (∀ tid : Fin N_T, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < q tid d →
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
        |inner ℝ (A_part tid - A_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a_D d)) ∧
      (let q_D := fun d => ∑ tid : Fin N_T, q tid d
       let I_TD := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
         q tid d * Real.log (q tid d / (p_T tid * q_D d))) / ell
       let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, q_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
       s = E_w - I_TD) }

noncomputable def classicalTransportScore (ε γ : ℝ) (N_ω N_T N_G : ℕ)
    (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ) (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
    (k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ) (G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G)
    (b_G a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let p_T : Fin N_T → ℝ := fun tid => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid then π ω else 0
  let p_G : Fin N_G → ℝ := fun g => ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let p_TG : Fin N_T → Fin N_G → ℝ := fun tid g =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ G_idx ω = g then π ω else 0
  let S_cells : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.image k_time
  let p_TC : Fin N_T → ℤ → ℝ := fun tid k =>
    ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, if T_idx ω = tid ∧ k_time ω = k then π ω else 0
  let E_w := ∑ g : Fin N_G, p_G g * ((1 + γ) * b_G g + (1 - γ) * a_G g)
  let I_TG := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ g : Fin N_G,
    p_TG tid g * Real.log (p_TG tid g / (p_T tid * p_G g))) / ell
  let S_t := (∑ tid : Fin N_T, ∑ k ∈ S_cells,
    -(p_TC tid k * Real.log (p_TC tid k / p_T tid))) / ell
  E_w - I_TG + 2 * S_t

def ClassicalLineGrowthBound (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (B_cl K_hor t_min δ_cl : ℝ),
    1 ≤ B_cl → 1 ≤ K_hor → 0 < t_min → t_min ≤ K_hor → 0 < δ_cl →
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε t L Δ_time : ℝ),
        0 < ε → ε < ε₀ → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → L ≤ K_hor →
        B_cl⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ Δ_time → Δ_time ≤ B_cl * ε ^ t →
      ∀ (N_ω N_T N_G : ℕ)
        (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
        (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
        (k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ)
        (G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G)
        (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (b_G a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ)
        (e_G V_G X_G : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (k_G : Fin N_G → ℤ),
        (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
        (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
        (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl) →
        (∀ g, 0 ≤ b_G g ∧ b_G g ≤ a_G g ∧ a_G g + t ≤ L ∧ ‖e_G g‖ = 1) →
        (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
          let tid := T_idx ω
          let g := G_idx ω
          let c_mid := ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time
          c_mid ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
          k_G g = k_time ω ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧
          |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g) ∧
          |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (e_G g)| ≤
            B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g + t) ∧
          |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤
            B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g + t)) →
        classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx b_G a_G ≤
          classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part + (γ + δ_cl) * t

noncomputable def generalPacketRootScore (ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  sSup ({ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log (∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2) / ell) } ∪
    { s : ℝ | ∃ (N_D : ℕ)
        (b a : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (e_dir V_c X_c : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b d ∧ b d ≤ a d ∧ a d ≤ min L (H_P / 2) ∧ ‖e_dir d‖ = 1) ∧
        (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) ∧
        (∀ o d, o ∉ O₀ → p o d = 0) ∧
        (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) ∧
        (∀ o ∈ O₀, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
          0 < canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
          |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d)) ∧
        (let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
         let p_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d
         let H_O := (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell
         let H_O_D := (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell
         let E_mass := (∑ o ∈ O₀,
           p_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)) / ell
         let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D,
           p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b d + (1 - γ) * a d)
         s = H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w) })

noncomputable def generalPacketObsMass (ε H_P t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (r_idx : ℕ) (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
  let C_box := ((r_idx : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹
  ‖(ρ_obs⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
    f v * ψ_o (ρ_obs⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_box, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def generalPacketScore (ε γ H_P t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (N_O N_D : ℕ)
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
    (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let p_O := fun o : Fin N_O => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
  let p_D := fun d : Fin N_D => ∑ o : Fin N_O, p o d
  let H_O := (∑ o : Fin N_O, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell
  let H_O_D := (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D,
    -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell
  let E_mass := (∑ o : Fin N_O, p_O o * Real.log
    (generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o))) / ell
  let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b_D d + (1 - γ) * a_D d)
  H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w

def IsAdmissiblePacketLaw (ε H_P L t B_sys R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ)
    (lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (N_O N_D : ℕ)
    (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
    (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
    (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let ρ_obs := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
  let σ_obs := (lam_sys * ρ_obs)⁻¹
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, r_O o < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖V_O o‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖X_O o‖ ≤ B_sys) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_O o) z‖ ≤ M_win k) ∧
  (∀ (r : ℕ) (v₀ x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o : Fin N_O =>
      r_O o = r ∧ ‖V_O o - v₀‖ ≤ ρ_obs ∧ ‖X_O o - x₀‖ ≤ σ_obs)).card : ℝ) ≤ (N_mult : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b_D d ∧ b_D d ≤ a_D d ∧
    a_D d ≤ min (L - t) ((H_P - t) / 2) ∧ r_D d < 2 ^ m_time ∧ ‖e_D d‖ = 1) ∧
  (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) ∧
  (∑ o : Fin N_O, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) ∧
  (∀ o : Fin N_O, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
    0 < generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f (r_O o) (V_O o) (X_O o) (ψ_O o) ∧
    r_O o = r_D d ∧
    |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d) ∧
    |inner ℝ (V_O o - V_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d) ∧
    |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (e_D d)| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (b_D d + t) ∧
    |inner ℝ (X_O o - X_D d) (perp2D (e_D d))| ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (a_D d + t))

def ValidPacketGrowthRates (γ : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  { b : ℝ | 0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
    ∀ (a₀ a₁ A R_dom B_sys K_hor R_win t_min δ : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A → 1 ≤ R_dom → 2 ≤ B_sys →
      1 ≤ K_hor → 2 ≤ R_win → 0 < t_min → t_min ≤ K_hor → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ N_mult →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ),
          0 < ε → ε < ε₀ →
          t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P → H_P ≤ K_hor → L ≤ K_hor →
          B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys → lam_sys ≤ B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) →
          B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ B_sys * ε ^ t →
        ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
          (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
          IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
        ∀ (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
          0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2 →
        ∀ (N_O N_D : ℕ)
          (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ)
          (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
          (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
          (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ)
          (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
          IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
            lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
          generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
            generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + (b + δ) * t }

noncomputable def quantumPacketRate (γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf (ValidPacketGrowthRates γ)

noncomputable def endpointVelFinset (R_dom : ℝ) : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let B_V : ℤ := ⌈R_dom⌉₊ + 1
  ((Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V)).filter
    (fun j => ‖gridPt2D 1 j‖ ≤ R_dom)

noncomputable def endpointPosFinset (lam R_dom : ℝ) : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let B_X : ℤ := ⌈lam * R_dom⌉₊ + 1
  ((Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_X) B_X)).filter
    (fun k => ‖gridPt2D lam⁻¹ k‖ ≤ R_dom)

noncomputable def endpointPhaseWindow (lam : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (χ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (B : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (c₁ C₀ : ℝ) (x₁ X₀ V₀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  (χ₀ z : ℂ) * B (c₁, x₁, V₀ + z) *
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam * (Φ₀ (c₁, x₁, V₀ + z) - Φ₀ (C₀, X₀, V₀ + z)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

noncomputable def endpointOutputBox (lam : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (k : ℤ × ℤ) :
    Set (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
  let m_lam : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 ⌈lam⌉₊
  let Δ_c : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_lam)⁻¹
  let X_k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := gridPt2D lam⁻¹ k
  Set.Icc ((r : ℝ) * Δ_c) (((r : ℝ) + 1) * Δ_c) ×ˢ
    { x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) |
      |x 0 - X_k 0| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam⁻¹ ∧
      |x 1 - X_k 1| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * lam⁻¹ }

noncomputable def pktUnitBump1D (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pcGevrey2Bump ((s + 1) / 2)

noncomputable def pktPou1D (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pktUnitBump1D s / Real.sqrt (∑' m : ℤ, (pktUnitBump1D (s - (m : ℝ))) ^ 2)

noncomputable def pktPou2D (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  pktPou1D (z 0) * pktPou1D (z 1)

noncomputable def pktVelBox (lam_sys R_dom : ℝ) : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  let B_V : ℤ := ⌈Real.sqrt lam_sys * (R_dom + 2)⌉₊ + 1
  ((Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc (-B_V) B_V)).filter
    (fun j => ‖gridPt2D ρ₀ j‖ ≤ R_dom + 2)

noncomputable def pktLinearCoeff (lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (j n : ℤ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  let V_j := gridPt2D ρ₀ j
  ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) * ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
    f v * (pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.I *
        ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v) -
          (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

noncomputable def pktLinearAtom (lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (j n : ℤ × ℤ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  let V_j := gridPt2D ρ₀ j
  ((4 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (ρ₀⁻¹ : ℂ)) * (pktPou2D (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℂ) *
    Complex.exp (Complex.I *
      ((-lam_sys * Φ₀ (1 / 2, 0, v) +
        (Real.pi / 2) * inner ℝ (gridPt2D 1 n) (ρ₀⁻¹ • (v - V_j)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

noncomputable def pktRound2D (s : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (⌊s⁻¹ * x 0 + 1 / 2⌋, ⌊s⁻¹ * x 1 + 1 / 2⌋)

def ValidClassicalGrowthRates (γ : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  { b : ℝ | 0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ 2 ∧
    ∀ (B_cl K_hor t_min δ_cl : ℝ),
      1 ≤ B_cl → 1 ≤ K_hor → 0 < t_min → t_min ≤ K_hor → 0 < δ_cl →
      ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
        ∀ (ε t L Δ_time : ℝ),
          0 < ε → ε < ε₀ → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → L ≤ K_hor →
          B_cl⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ Δ_time → Δ_time ≤ B_cl * ε ^ t →
        ∀ (N_ω N_T N_G : ℕ)
          (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
          (T_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_T)
          (k_time : Fin N_ω → ℤ)
          (G_idx : Fin N_ω → Fin N_G)
          (V_part A_part : Fin N_T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (b_G a_G : Fin N_G → ℝ)
          (e_G V_G X_G : Fin N_G → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (k_G : Fin N_G → ℤ),
          (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π ω) →
          (∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω = 1) →
          (∀ tid, ‖V_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl ∧ ‖A_part tid‖ ≤ B_cl) →
          (∀ g, 0 ≤ b_G g ∧ b_G g ≤ a_G g ∧ a_G g + t ≤ L ∧ ‖e_G g‖ = 1) →
          (∀ ω, 0 < π ω →
            let tid := T_idx ω
            let g := G_idx ω
            let c_mid := ((k_time ω : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Δ_time
            c_mid ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
            k_G g = k_time ω ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (e_G g)| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g) ∧
            |inner ℝ (V_part tid - V_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤ B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g) ∧
            |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (e_G g)| ≤
              B_cl * ε ^ (b_G g + t) ∧
            |inner ℝ ((A_part tid + c_mid • V_part tid) - X_G g) (perp2D (e_G g))| ≤
              B_cl * ε ^ (a_G g + t)) →
          classicalTransportScore ε γ N_ω N_T N_G π T_idx k_time G_idx b_G a_G ≤
            classicalRootSupremum ε L γ N_ω N_T π T_idx V_part A_part + (b + δ_cl) * t }

noncomputable def classicalGrowthRate (γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf (ValidClassicalGrowthRates γ)

noncomputable def dyadicTimeLevel (ε u : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.clog 2 ⌈ε ^ (-u)⌉₊

noncomputable def dyadicTimeBin (ε u c : ℝ) : ℤ :=
  let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε u
  min ⌊c * (2 : ℝ) ^ m⌋ ((2 ^ m : ℤ) - 1)

noncomputable def dyadicTimeMid (ε u c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let m := dyadicTimeLevel ε u
  ((dyadicTimeBin ε u c : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹

noncomputable def dyadicRealLevel (ε L : ℝ) : ℤ :=
  ⌊L * (Real.log (ε⁻¹) / Real.log 2)⌋

noncomputable def dyadicRealStep (ε L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ (-dyadicRealLevel ε L)

noncomputable def dyadicRealBin (ε L x : ℝ) : ℤ :=
  ⌊x * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicRealLevel ε L)⌋

noncomputable def dyadicRealMid (ε L x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((dyadicRealBin ε L x : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicRealStep ε L

noncomputable def finProbAt {N_ω : ℕ} {α : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (X : Fin N_ω → α) (ω : Fin N_ω) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω then π ω' else 0

noncomputable def finProbAt2 {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  ∑ ω' : Fin N_ω, if X ω' = X ω ∧ Y ω' = Y ω then π ω' else 0

noncomputable def condSurprise {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) (ω : Fin N_ω) : ℝ :=
  -(Real.log (finProbAt2 π X Y ω / finProbAt π X ω)) / Real.log (ε⁻¹)

noncomputable def finCondEntropy {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ω : Fin N_ω, π ω * condSurprise ε π X Y ω

noncomputable def finMutualInfo {N_ω : ℕ} {α β : Type} (ε : ℝ) (π : Fin N_ω → ℝ)
    (X : Fin N_ω → α) (Y : Fin N_ω → β) : ℝ :=
  finCondEntropy ε π (fun _ => ()) Y - finCondEntropy ε π X Y

def HasIsotropicExtremizer (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (B_iso s : ℝ)
    (ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (N_ω N_T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (π_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ)
    (T_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → Fin (N_T n))
    (V_seq A_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_T n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_seq : ∀ n, Fin (N_ω n) → ℝ),
    1 ≤ B_iso ∧ 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧
    (∀ n, 0 < ε_seq n ∧ ε_seq n < 1 / 2) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ n, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_seq n ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n), π_seq n ω = 1) ∧
      (∀ tid, ‖V_seq n tid‖ ≤ B_iso ∧ ‖A_seq n tid‖ ≤ B_iso) ∧
      (∀ ω, 0 < π_seq n ω → c_seq n ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
      let ε := ε_seq n
      let k_t := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε 1 (c_seq n ω)
      let O_end := fun ω : Fin (N_ω n) =>
        let tid := T_seq n ω
        let x_pos := A_seq n tid + (dyadicTimeMid ε 1 (c_seq n ω)) • V_seq n tid
        (k_t ω, dyadicRealBin ε 1 (x_pos 0), dyadicRealBin ε 1 (x_pos 1))
      (-finMutualInfo ε (π_seq n) (T_seq n) O_end +
        2 * finCondEntropy ε (π_seq n) (T_seq n) k_t) -
        classicalRootSupremum ε 1 γ (N_ω n) (N_T n) (π_seq n) (T_seq n) (V_seq n) (A_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (classicalGrowthRate γ)) ∧
    (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n =>
        let ε := ε_seq n
        let k_u := fun ω => dyadicTimeBin ε u (c_seq n ω)
        ∑ ω : Fin (N_ω n),
          if δ < |condSurprise ε (π_seq n) (T_seq n) k_u ω - s * u| then π_seq n ω else 0)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

def InResolutionCone (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (p : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : Prop :=
  p.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
  ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → p.1 k - p.1 j ≤ (c k - c j) * p.2

def InDispCone (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (ξ : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ j k : Fin n, E_cone j k → ξ.1 k - ξ.1 j ≤ (c k - c j) * ξ.2

def planeEmbed (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (iu : ℝ × ℝ) : (Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ :=
  (fun j => iu.1 + c j * iu.2, iu.2)

def IsSubmodularConeProfile (n : ℕ) (c d : Fin n → ℝ) (d_v : ℝ)
    (E_cone : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ (L : Fin n → ℝ) (v h : ℝ) (j : Fin n),
    0 ≤ h →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L, v) →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (Function.update L j (L j + h), v) →
    0 ≤ f (Function.update L j (L j + h), v) - f (L, v) ∧
    f (Function.update L j (L j + h), v) - f (L, v) ≤ d j * h) ∧
  (∀ (L : Fin n → ℝ) (v h : ℝ),
    0 ≤ h →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L, v) →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L, v + h) →
    0 ≤ f (L, v + h) - f (L, v) ∧
    f (L, v + h) - f (L, v) ≤ d_v * h) ∧
  (∀ (L : Fin n → ℝ) (v h₁ h₂ : ℝ) (j k : Fin n),
    j ≠ k → 0 ≤ h₁ → 0 ≤ h₂ →
    let L_j := Function.update L j (L j + h₁)
    let L_k := Function.update L k (L k + h₂)
    let L_jk := Function.update L_j k (L_j k + h₂)
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L, v) →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L_j, v) →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L_k, v) →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L_jk, v) →
    f (L_jk, v) - f (L_j, v) - f (L_k, v) + f (L, v) ≤ 0) ∧
  (∀ (L : Fin n → ℝ) (v h₁ h₂ : ℝ) (j : Fin n),
    0 ≤ h₁ → 0 ≤ h₂ →
    let L_j := Function.update L j (L j + h₁)
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L, v) →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L_j, v) →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L, v + h₂) →
    InResolutionCone n c E_cone (L_j, v + h₂) →
    f (L_j, v + h₂) - f (L_j, v) - f (L, v + h₂) + f (L, v) ≤ 0)

def E_cone4 (j k : Fin 4) : Prop :=
  (j = 0 ∧ k = 1) ∨ (j = 0 ∧ k = 2) ∨ (j = 1 ∧ k = 3) ∨ (j = 2 ∧ k = 3)

noncomputable def rowObs6 (ε m : ℝ) (V_p A_p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (c_s R_s : ℝ) (q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  let (L_X, L_Y, L_W, L_Z, v) := q
  let k_c := dyadicTimeBin ε v c_s
  let C_v := dyadicTimeMid ε v c_s
  let k_r := dyadicRealBin ε (m * v) R_s
  let R_mv := dyadicRealMid ε (m * v) R_s
  let X := V_p 0
  let Y := A_p 0 + C_v * X
  let W := V_p 1 - R_mv * X
  let Z := A_p 1 + C_v * (V_p 1) - R_mv * Y
  (k_c, k_r, dyadicRealBin ε L_X X, dyadicRealBin ε L_Y Y,
    dyadicRealBin ε L_W W, dyadicRealBin ε L_Z Z)

def MatchedClockRatesDistinct (s σ : ℝ) (r : Fin 4 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ j : Fin 4, 0 ≤ r j ∧ r j ≤ 1) ∧
  (0 < r 0 → min 1 (r 0 + s) ≤ r 1) ∧
  (0 < r 2 → min 1 (r 2 + s) ≤ r 3) ∧
  (0 < r 0 → min 1 (r 0 + σ) ≤ r 2) ∧
  (0 < r 1 → min 1 (r 1 + σ) ≤ r 3)

def MatchedClockRatesTied (s : ℝ) (r : Fin 3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ r 0 ∧ r 0 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ r 1 ∧ r 1 ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ r 2 ∧ r 2 ≤ 1 ∧
  (0 < r 0 → s ≤ r 1) ∧
  (0 < r 0 ∧ r 2 < 1 → r 0 + s ≤ r 2) ∧
  (r 2 < 1 → r 1 ≤ 2 - s)

structure MatchedAspectProfileSystem (γ m : ℝ) : Type where
  B_sys : ℝ
  κ : ℝ
  τ : ℝ
  b : ℝ → ℝ
  S : ℝ → ℝ
  f_raw : ((Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ
  g_x : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  N_ω : ℕ → ℕ
  N_T : ℕ → ℕ
  π_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ
  T_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → Fin (N_T k)
  V_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_T k) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  A_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_T k) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
  c_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ
  R_seq : ∀ k, Fin (N_ω k) → ℝ
  H_uncond : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ) → ℝ
  H_condT : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ) → ℝ
  hB_sys : 1 ≤ B_sys
  hκ : 0 < κ
  hτ : 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 2 * (1 + m)
  hb_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ → 0 ≤ b u₁ - b u₂ ∧ b u₁ - b u₂ ≤ (1 + m) * (u₂ - u₁)
  hb_dom : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ b u ∧ b u + (1 + m) * u ≤ 1 + m
  hS_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, u₁ ≤ u₂ → 0 ≤ S u₂ - S u₁ ∧ S u₂ - S u₁ ≤ u₂ - u₁
  hS_zero : S 0 = 0
  hε_bounds : ∀ k, 0 < ε_seq k ∧ ε_seq k < 1 / 2
  hε_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  h_law : ∀ k, (∀ ω, 0 ≤ π_seq k ω) ∧ (∑ ω : Fin (N_ω k), π_seq k ω = 1) ∧
    (∀ tid, ‖V_seq k tid‖ ≤ B_sys ∧ ‖A_seq k tid‖ ≤ B_sys) ∧
    (∀ ω, 0 < π_seq k ω → c_seq k ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ |R_seq k ω| ≤ B_sys)
  h_homog : ∀ (Q_fin : Finset (List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ × ℚ))) (δ : ℝ),
    (∀ L_list ∈ Q_fin, ∀ q ∈ L_list, (q.2.2.2.2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    0 < δ →
    ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K₀ ≤ k →
      ∃ E_good : Finset (Fin (N_ω k)),
        1 - δ ≤ (∑ ω ∈ E_good, π_seq k ω) ∧
        ∀ ω ∈ E_good, ∀ L_list ∈ Q_fin,
          let obs := fun ω' : Fin (N_ω k) =>
            L_list.map (fun q => rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m
              (V_seq k (T_seq k ω')) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω')) (c_seq k ω') (R_seq k ω')
              (q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.1, q.2.2.2.2))
          |condSurprise (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (fun _ => ()) obs ω - H_uncond L_list| ≤ δ ∧
          |condSurprise (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k) obs ω - H_condT L_list| ≤ δ
  h_time_ent : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
      finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
        (fun ω => dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) v (c_seq k ω)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (S v))
  h_orient_pred : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun k =>
      finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k)
        (fun ω => (T_seq k ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) v (c_seq k ω)))
        (fun ω => dyadicRealBin (ε_seq k) (m * v) (R_seq k ω)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  h_orient_growth : ∀ (v a δ : ℝ),
    0 < v → 0 < a → v + a < 1 → 0 < δ →
    ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K₀ ≤ k →
      κ * a - δ ≤ finCondEntropy (ε_seq k) (π_seq k)
        (fun ω => (T_seq k ω, dyadicTimeBin (ε_seq k) v (c_seq k ω)))
        (fun ω => dyadicRealBin (ε_seq k) (m * (v + a)) (R_seq k ω))
  h_f_lim : ∀ K_c : Set ((Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ),
    K_c ⊆ { p | InResolutionCone 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] E_cone4 p } →
    IsCompact K_c →
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k (p : (Fin 4 → ℝ) × ℝ) =>
      finMutualInfo (ε_seq k) (π_seq k) (T_seq k)
        (fun ω => rowObs6 (ε_seq k) m
          (V_seq k (T_seq k ω)) (A_seq k (T_seq k ω)) (c_seq k ω) (R_seq k ω)
          (p.1 0, p.1 1, p.1 2, p.1 3, p.2)))
      f_raw Filter.atTop K_c
  h_submod : IsSubmodularConeProfile 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] ![1, 1, 1, 1] (1 + m) E_cone4 f_raw
  h_obstacle : ∀ (i u : ℝ),
    u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → 0 ≤ i → i + (1 + m) * u ≤ 1 + m →
    2 * i + (1 - γ) * m * u + 2 * S u - classicalGrowthRate γ * u - τ ≤
      f_raw (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u))
  h_contact : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
    f_raw (planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (b u, u)) =
      2 * (b u) + (1 - γ) * m * u + 2 * S u - classicalGrowthRate γ * u - τ
  h_x_refine : ∀ u₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
    g_x u₀ 0 = 0 ∧
    (∀ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, d₁ ≤ d₂ → 0 ≤ g_x u₀ d₂ - g_x u₀ d₁ ∧ g_x u₀ d₂ - g_x u₀ d₁ ≤ d₂ - d₁) ∧
    (∀ d : ℝ, 0 ≤ d → d ≤ m * u₀ → γ * d ≤ g_x u₀ d) ∧
    (∀ (lam_s h i t : ℝ),
      0 < lam_s → lam_s < min 1 m → 0 < h → h < u₀ →
      b u₀ ≤ i → i ≤ b u₀ + lam_s * h → 0 < t → i + t < b u₀ + m * u₀ →
      let p₀ := planeEmbed 4 ![0, 1, m, 1 + m] (i, u₀ - h)
      let p_t := (Function.update p₀.1 0 (p₀.1 0 + t), p₀.2)
      g_x u₀ (i - b u₀ + t) - g_x u₀ (i - b u₀) ≤ f_raw p_t - f_raw p₀)

def IsValidPacketEnv (cls : PacketBoundClass) (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 2 ∧
  0 < H_P ∧ H_P ≤ cls.K_hor ∧ 0 < L ∧ L ≤ cls.K_hor ∧
  cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (-H_P) ≤ lam_sys ∧ lam_sys ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (-H_P) ∧
  IsNormalizedPosDefPhase cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A Φ₀ ζ₀ ∧
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume ∧
  (∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), cls.R_dom ≤ ‖v‖ → f v = 0) ∧
  MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
  0 < ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖f v‖ ^ 2

noncomputable def localGaugePhase
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (cxv : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let c := C_r + s_c * (cxv.1 - 1 / 2)
  let x := X_J + (s_c * (cxv.1 - 1 / 2)) • V_J + s_x • cxv.2.1
  let v := V_J + s_v • cxv.2.2
  let c₀ := C_r - s_c / 2
  let x₀ := X_J - (s_c / 2) • V_J
  (s_c * s_v ^ 2)⁻¹ *
    (Φ₀ (c, x, v) - Φ₀ (c, x, V_J) - Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, v) + Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J))

noncomputable def localGaugeGrad
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (vp : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let s_x := s_c * s_v
  let v := V_J + s_v • vp.1
  s_x⁻¹ •
    (ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + s_x • (vp.2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • vp.1)) -
     ζ₀ (v, X_J - C_r • v + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * s_x) • vp.1))

noncomputable def localGaugeInput
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r q_r : ℕ) (s_v : ℝ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (v' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) : ℂ :=
  let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
  let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
  let c₀ := C_r - s_c / 2
  let x₀ := X_J - (s_c / 2) • V_J
  let v := V_J + s_v • v'
  (s_v : ℂ) * f v *
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * (Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, v) - Φ₀ (c₀, x₀, V_J)) : ℝ) : ℂ))

def LocalPhaseRescalingValid : Prop :=
  ∀ (a₀ a₁ A : ℝ), 0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A →
  ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
  ∀ (m_r m_t q_r : ℕ), m_r ≤ m_t → q_r < 2 ^ m_r →
  ∀ (ε H_P t r b_star s_v lam_sys : ℝ),
    0 < ε → 0 < s_v → s_v ≤ 1 → s_v = ε ^ b_star → 0 < lam_sys →
  ∀ (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
    let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
    let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
    let s_x := s_c * s_v
    let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
    let ζ'₀ := localGaugeGrad ζ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
    let f'₀ := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J f
    IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ (3 * A) Φ'₀ ζ'₀ ∧
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f'₀ MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f'₀ 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (∫ v', ‖f'₀ v'‖ ^ 2 = ∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ R_supp : ℝ, (∀ v, R_supp ≤ ‖v - V_J‖ → f v = 0) →
      ∀ v', s_v⁻¹ * R_supp ≤ ‖v'‖ → f'₀ v' = 0) ∧
    (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
      ∀ (V'_o X'_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        let r_full := q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc
        let C_t := ((r_full : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
        generalPacketObsMass ε (H_P - r - 2 * b_star) (t - r) (s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys)
          (m_t - m_r) Φ'₀ f'₀ r_loc V'_o X'_o ψ_o =
        generalPacketObsMass ε H_P t lam_sys m_t Φ₀ f r_full
          (V_J + s_v • V'_o) (X_J + (C_t - C_r) • V_J + s_x • X'_o) ψ_o)

def HasRootWidthGap (ν κ ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys : ℝ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let O₀ := rootSiteFinset lam_sys R_dom
  let ρ₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹
  let ell := Real.log (ε⁻¹)
  let K₀ := generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f
  ∀ (N_D : ℕ) (b a : Fin N_D → ℝ) (e_dir V_c X_c : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ)) → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    (∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 ≤ b d ∧ b d ≤ a d ∧ a d ≤ min L (H_P / 2) ∧ ‖e_dir d‖ = 1) →
    (∀ d : Fin N_D, (0 < ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d) → H_P / 2 - ν ≤ b d) →
    (∀ o d, 0 ≤ p o d) →
    (∀ o d, o ∉ O₀ → p o d = 0) →
    (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d = 1) →
    (∀ o ∈ O₀, ∀ d : Fin N_D, 0 < p o d →
      0 < canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.1 - V_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (e_dir d)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (b d) ∧
      |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ₀ o.2 - X_c d) (perp2D (e_dir d))| ≤ 10 * ε ^ (a d)) →
    let p_O := fun o => ∑ d : Fin N_D, p o d
    let p_D := fun d => ∑ o ∈ O₀, p o d
    let H_O := (∑ o ∈ O₀, -(p_O o * Real.log (p_O o))) / ell
    let H_O_D := (∑ o ∈ O₀, ∑ d : Fin N_D, -(p o d * Real.log (p o d / p_D d))) / ell
    let E_mass := (∑ o ∈ O₀, p_O o * Real.log (canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f o)) / ell
    let E_w := ∑ d : Fin N_D, p_D d * ((1 + γ) * b d + (1 - γ) * a d)
    H_O + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * H_O_D + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * E_mass + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * E_w ≤ K₀ - κ

def IsDurationOneSaturatingClass (γ Δ : ℝ) (cls : PacketBoundClass) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      ε < ε₀ ∧ 1 ≤ H_P ∧ 1 ≤ L ∧
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f ∧
      cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ∧
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L 1 cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ∧
      generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + quantumPacketRate γ - Δ ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p

def IsForcedSaturatingClass (γ ν κ Δ : ℝ) (cls : PacketBoundClass) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ → ε₀ < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ (ε H_P L lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
      (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
      (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
      (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
      (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
      ε < ε₀ ∧ 1 ≤ H_P ∧ 1 ≤ L ∧
      IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f ∧
      cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ (1 : ℝ) ∧
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L 1 cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p ∧
      generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + quantumPacketRate γ - Δ ≤
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ∧
      HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f

def ForcedRootSystemExists (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ν κ : ℝ), 0 < ν ∧ 0 < κ ∧
    ∀ Δ : ℝ, 0 < Δ → ∃ cls : PacketBoundClass, IsForcedSaturatingClass γ ν κ Δ cls

def UniformPacketGrowthModulus (γ b_rate : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (t_min δ : ℝ),
    0 < t_min → t_min ≤ cls.K_hor → 0 < δ →
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ε₀ < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
        (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
        ε < ε₀ → t_min ≤ t → t ≤ L → t ≤ H_P →
        IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ →
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_time)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L t cls.B_sys cls.R_win cls.N_mult cls.M_win
          lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
        generalPacketScore ε γ H_P t lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ≤
          generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L cls.R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f + (b_rate + δ) * t

def DurationScalingValid (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (ε H_P L d R_dom B_sys R_win : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ) (M_win : ℕ → ℝ) (lam_sys : ℝ) (m_time : ℕ)
    (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
    (N_O N_D : ℕ) (r_O : Fin N_O → ℕ) (V_O X_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (ψ_O : Fin N_O → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (b_D a_D : Fin N_D → ℝ)
    (r_D : Fin N_D → ℕ) (e_D V_D X_D : Fin N_D → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin N_O → Fin N_D → ℝ),
    0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → 0 < d → ε ^ d < 1 / 2 →
    (IsAdmissiblePacketLaw ε H_P L d B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D r_D e_D V_D X_D p →
      IsAdmissiblePacketLaw (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) 1 B_sys R_win N_mult M_win
        lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O (fun j => b_D j / d) (fun j => a_D j / d)
        r_D e_D V_D X_D p) ∧
    generalPacketScore (ε ^ d) γ (H_P / d) 1 lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O
      (fun j => b_D j / d) (fun j => a_D j / d) p =
      d⁻¹ * generalPacketScore ε γ H_P d lam_sys m_time Φ₀ f N_O N_D r_O V_O X_O ψ_O b_D a_D p ∧
    generalPacketRootScore (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f =
      d⁻¹ * generalPacketRootScore ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ∧
    (∀ ν κ : ℝ,
      HasRootWidthGap (ν / d) (κ / d) (ε ^ d) (H_P / d) (L / d) R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f ↔
      HasRootWidthGap ν κ ε H_P L R_dom γ lam_sys Φ₀ f)

def PacketCutDecompositionValid (M_atom : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cls : PacketBoundClass) (Δ_u A_amp B_cut : ℝ),
    0 < Δ_u → 0 < A_amp → 2 * A_amp + 12 * cls.K_hor + 16 ≤ B_cut →
    ∃ (C_cut C_can C_Bes : ℝ) (M_mult : ℕ) (C_tr C_rtail : ℕ → ℝ) (ε_cut : ℝ),
      2 ≤ C_cut ∧ 1 ≤ C_can ∧ 1 ≤ C_Bes ∧ 1 ≤ M_mult ∧
      (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_tr M) ∧ (∀ M, 0 ≤ C_rtail M) ∧ 0 < ε_cut ∧ ε_cut < 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ (ε H_P L t r b_star lam_sys : ℝ) (m_r m_t q_r : ℕ)
        (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (V_J X_J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        ε < ε_cut → IsValidPacketEnv cls ε H_P L lam_sys Φ₀ ζ₀ f →
        0 ≤ r → r < t → t ≤ H_P → 0 ≤ b_star → b_star ≤ (H_P - t) / 2 →
        Δ_u ≤ (H_P - r) / 2 - b_star →
        ((r = 0 ∧ m_r = 0) ∨
         (0 < r ∧ (2 * cls.B_sys)⁻¹ * ε ^ r ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ∧
           ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹ ≤ (2 * cls.B_sys) * ε ^ r)) →
        m_r ≤ m_t → q_r < 2 ^ m_r →
        cls.B_sys⁻¹ * ε ^ t ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹ ≤ cls.B_sys * ε ^ t →
        ‖V_J‖ ≤ 2 * cls.B_sys → ‖X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys →
        let s_c := ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_r)⁻¹
        let C_r := ((q_r : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * s_c
        let s_v := ε ^ b_star
        let s_x := s_c * s_v
        let ρ_r := if r = 0 then (Real.sqrt lam_sys)⁻¹ else ε ^ ((H_P - r) / 2)
        let σ_r := (lam_sys * ρ_r)⁻¹
        let ρ_t := ε ^ ((H_P - t) / 2)
        ∃ (N_atom : ℕ) (o_atom : Fin N_atom → (ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))
          (ψ_atom : Fin N_atom → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ) (c_atom : Fin N_atom → ℂ),
          let V_at := fun α => gridPt2D ρ_r (o_atom α).1
          let X_at := fun α => gridPt2D σ_r (o_atom α).2
          let g_at := fun α (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =>
            (ρ_r⁻¹ : ℂ) * star (ψ_atom α (ρ_r⁻¹ • (v - V_at α))) *
              Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_r, X_at α, v) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
          (∀ α, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_atom α)) ∧
            (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_atom α z = 0) ∧
            (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ_atom α) z‖ ≤
              M_atom cls.a₀ cls.a₁ cls.A cls.B_sys cls.R_win k)) ∧
          (∀ α, ‖V_at α - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v + cls.R_win * s_v + 4 * s_v ∧
            ‖X_at α - X_J‖ ≤ 8 * cls.B_sys * s_x + 2 * cls.R_win * s_x + 10 * s_x) ∧
          (∀ o₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun α => o_atom α = o₀)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
          ((N_atom : ℝ) ≤ C_cut * ε ^ (-(4 * cls.K_hor + 4))) ∧
          (∀ α, ε ^ B_cut * (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (∑ α : Fin N_atom, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
          (0 < r → ∀ α, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 =
            generalPacketObsMass ε H_P r lam_sys m_r Φ₀ f q_r (V_at α) (X_at α) (ψ_atom α)) ∧
          (r = 0 → ∀ α, o_atom α ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_sys cls.R_dom ∧
            ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_can * canonicalRootMass lam_sys Φ₀ f (o_atom α)) ∧
          (∀ (r_loc : ℕ), r_loc < 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) →
            let C_t := (((q_r * 2 ^ (m_t - m_r) + r_loc : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_t)⁻¹
            ∀ (V_o X_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ψ_o : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
              ‖V_o - V_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_v →
              ‖X_o + (C_r - C_t) • V_o - X_J‖ ≤ 4 * cls.B_sys * s_x →
              (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k ψ_o) →
              (∀ z, cls.R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_o z = 0) →
              (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k ψ_o z‖ ≤ cls.M_win k) →
              let pair_fn := fun h : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ =>
                (ρ_t⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ v, h v * ψ_o (ρ_t⁻¹ • (v - V_o)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((lam_sys * Φ₀ (C_t, X_o, v) : ℝ) : ℂ))
              ‖pair_fn f - pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α : Fin N_atom, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                C_cut * ε ^ A_amp * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2) ∧
              ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N_atom)) (M_tr : ℕ) (R_tr : ℝ), 2 ≤ M_tr → 2 ≤ R_tr →
                letI := Classical.propDecidable
                let S_near := S.filter (fun α =>
                  ‖V_o - V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * ρ_t ∧
                  ‖X_o - X_at α - (C_t - C_r) • V_at α‖ ≤ C_cut * R_tr * σ_r)
                ‖pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v) -
                 pair_fn (fun v => ∑ α ∈ S_near, c_atom α * g_at α v)‖ ≤
                  C_tr M_tr * R_tr ^ (1 - (M_tr : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (∫ v, ‖f v‖ ^ 2)) ∧
          (∀ S : Finset (Fin N_atom),
            let h_S := fun v => ∑ α ∈ S, c_atom α * g_at α v
            let lam_loc := s_c * s_v ^ 2 * lam_sys
            let ρ'₀ := (Real.sqrt lam_loc)⁻¹
            let Φ'₀ := localGaugePhase Φ₀ m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J
            let h'_S := localGaugeInput Φ₀ lam_sys m_r q_r s_v V_J X_J h_S
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable h_S MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            MeasureTheory.MemLp h_S 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            (∫ v, ‖h_S v‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_Bes * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
            (∀ R'_dom : ℝ, 1 ≤ R'_dom →
              (∑ o ∈ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
                C_Bes * ∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) ∧
              ∀ (b_F a_F R_cap : ℝ) (M_cap : ℕ) (e_F V_F X_F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
                (F_sites : Finset ((ℤ × ℤ) × (ℤ × ℤ))),
                2 ≤ R_cap → 3 ≤ M_cap → ‖e_F‖ = 1 →
                F_sites ⊆ rootSiteFinset lam_loc R'_dom →
                (∀ o ∈ F_sites,
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.1 - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F ∧
                  |inner ℝ (gridPt2D ρ'₀ o.2 - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F) →
                letI := Classical.propDecidable
                let S_cap := S.filter (fun α =>
                  let V'_α := s_v⁻¹ • (V_at α - V_J)
                  let X'_α := s_x⁻¹ • (X_at α - X_J)
                  |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (V'_α - V_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) e_F| ≤ 10 * ε ^ b_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀ ∧
                  |inner ℝ (X'_α - X_F) (perp2D e_F)| ≤ 10 * ε ^ a_F + C_cut * R_cap * ρ'₀)
                ∑ o ∈ F_sites, canonicalRootMass lam_loc Φ'₀ h'_S o ≤
                  C_Bes * (∑ α ∈ S_cap, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2) +
                  C_rtail M_cap * R_cap ^ (4 - 2 * (M_cap : ℝ)) * (∑ α ∈ S, ‖c_atom α‖ ^ 2)))

def CoherentStripMassBoundValid : Prop :=
  ∀ (a₀ a₁ A B_cell R_win : ℝ) (N_mult M_mult : ℕ) (M_atom M_win : ℕ → ℝ),
    0 < a₀ → a₀ ≤ a₁ → 1 ≤ A → 2 ≤ B_cell → 2 ≤ R_win → 1 ≤ N_mult → 1 ≤ M_mult →
    ∃ C_coh : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_coh ∧
      ∀ (Φ₀ : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ)
        (ζ₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        IsNormalizedPosDefPhase a₀ a₁ A Φ₀ ζ₀ →
      ∀ (lam_loc ρ s c_end R : ℝ),
        0 < lam_loc → 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ 1 →
        B_cell⁻¹ ≤ lam_loc * s ^ 2 → lam_loc * s ^ 2 ≤ B_cell →
        c_end ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → 1 ≤ R →
      ∀ (V_P X_Q n_P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), ‖n_P‖ = 1 →
      ∀ (d_dim N_Q K N_obs : ℕ), (d_dim = 1 ∨ d_dim = 2) → 1 ≤ K →
      ∀ (V_T X_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (η_T : Fin N_Q → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ)
        (c_T : Fin N_Q → ℂ) (bin_of : Fin N_Q → Fin K)
        (V_O X_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
        (ψ_O : Fin N_obs → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℂ),
        (letI := Classical.propDecidable
         let σ := (lam_loc * ρ)⁻¹
         (∀ T, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (η_T T)) ∧ (∀ z, 4 ≤ ‖z‖ → η_T T z = 0) ∧
           (∀ k z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (η_T T) z‖ ≤ M_atom k) ∧
           ‖V_T T - V_P‖ ≤ B_cell * ρ ∧
           ‖(X_T T + (c_end - 1 / 2) • V_T T) - X_Q‖ ≤ R * s) ∧
         (∀ v₀ x₀, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Fin N_Q =>
           ‖V_T T - v₀‖ ≤ s ∧ ‖X_T T - x₀‖ ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤ (M_mult : ℝ)) ∧
         (∀ T₁ T₂, bin_of T₁ = bin_of T₂ →
           (d_dim = 1 → |inner ℝ (V_T T₁ - V_T T₂) n_P| ≤ B_cell * s) ∧
           (d_dim = 2 → ‖V_T T₁ - V_T T₂‖ ≤ B_cell * s)) ∧
         (∀ o, (∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ k (ψ_O o)) ∧ (∀ z, R_win ≤ ‖z‖ → ψ_O o z = 0) ∧
